q_26355.ground_truth: If the FQDN of LCUP could uniquely identify an LCUP instance, the UE would start the LCUP DNS query with pre-provisioned or with the OMA defined push mechanism or LPP assistance delivery. The LMF returns the cooperated LCUP assistance information based on serving area or UE IP/identity.

q_26356.question: What must the USS provide the 3GPP system with during the establishment or modification procedure of the PDU Session/PDN connection for C2 communication?
q_26356.ground_truth: The USS must provide the 3GPP system with traffic filters and QoS requirements during the establishment or modification procedure of the PDU Session/PDN connection for C2 communication.

q_26357.question: What type of traffic is considered in the measurement of total number of DL PDCP SDU packets in gNB-CU-UP and total number of DL RLC SDU packets in gNB-DU?
q_26357.ground_truth: Only user-plane traffic (DTCH) is considered in these measurements.

q_26358.question: What is the first PRB provided for a frequency hopping UE to transmit the PUCCH in slots with even number for repetitions of a PUCCH transmission across slots with pucch-DMRS-Bundling enabled?
q_26358.ground_truth: The UE performs frequency hopping per slot and transmits the PUCCH starting from a first PRB, provided by startingPRB, in slots with even number.

q_26359.question: What is the name of the positioning procedure used by an LMF to support UE based and UE assisted positioning and delivery of assistance data?
q_26359.ground_truth: The LPP protocol defined in TS~37.355

q_26360.question: In the context of RRC_CONNECTED state with generic procedure parameters Connectivity NR and Test Mode On, what should be the UE's state after following the step defined in clause 6.3H.1.1.4.3?
q_26360.ground_truth: The UE should be in the RRC_CONNECTED state with generic procedure parameters Connectivity NR, Connected without release On, Test Mode On and Test Loop Function On.

q_26361.question: How is the record opening time and reason derived in the CDR?
q_26361.ground_truth: For SGW/PGW/TDF/IPE-CDRs and M-CDR, the record opening reason can be derived from the field "Sequence number". If the field is missing or has a value of one, it means the activation of IP-CAN bearer, GPRS attachment, TDF session establishment, IP-CAN session establishment or inter-SGSN routing area update.

q_26362.question: Which channel for the potential Rel-18 UE has better coverage than the bottleneck channel of the reference NR UE and does not require coverage recovery in the Urban scenario at 4 GHz with DL PSD of 33 dBm/MHz?
q_26362.ground_truth: PUSCH for the potential Rel-18 UE, with or without 3dB UE antenna efficiency loss, has better coverage than the bottleneck channel of the reference NR UE and does not require coverage recovery in the Urban scenario at 4 GHz with DL PSD of 33 dBm/MHz.

q_26363.question: What is required for the FDD absolute RSRP under time-domain measurement resource restriction with MBSFN ABS (eICIC) test to pass in the scenario?
q_26363.ground_truth: The ratio of successful reported values in each test must be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

q_26364.question: What indication does the SN include in the SgNB Modification Request Acknowledge message if the MN requested the SCG to be activated?
q_26364.ground_truth: The SN indicates whether the SCG is activated or deactivated.

q_26365.question: What is the maximum reporting range of RSRP in the FDD-TDD inter-frequency absolute accuracy test?
q_26365.ground_truth: The reporting range of RSRP is defined from -140 dBm to -44 dBm with 1 dB resolution in the FDD-TDD inter-frequency absolute accuracy test.

q_26366.question: What is the definition of a narrowband in the context of 3GPP TS 36.211 clause 6.2.7?
q_26366.ground_truth: A narrowband is defined as six non-overlapping consecutive physical resource blocks in the frequency domain.

q_26367.question: What message does the gNB-DU send to the U2N Relay UE to establish a PC5 Relay RLC channel for relaying of U2N Remote UE's SRB1 over PC5 and a Uu Relay RLC channel for relaying of U2N Remote UE's SRB1 over Uu?
q_26367.ground_truth: INITIAL UL RRC MESSAGE TRANSFER message

q_26368.question: How should the UE determine the size of the buffer in a BSR report?
q_26368.ground_truth: The size of the buffer should identify the total amount of data available across all logical channels of a logical channel group after the MAC PDU has been built. The amount of data is indicated in number of bytes and shall include all data that is available for transmission in the RLC layer and in the PDCP layer.

q_26369.question: Which UE capabilities factor into determining if a CSI-RS measurement is required to have restrictions when the SSB and CSI-RS for RLM are transmitted in the same OFDM symbol or the same BWP but with different SCS?
q_26369.ground_truth: The UE's support for simultaneousRxDataSSB-DiffNumerology determines if CSI-RS measurement restrictions apply.

q_26370.question: What is the definition of transmit OFF power in the minimum conformance requirements?
q_26370.ground_truth: The transmit OFF power is defined as the TRP in the channel bandwidth per component carrier when the transmitter is OFF. The transmitter is considered OFF when the UE is not allowed to transmit or during periods when the UE is not transmitting a sub-frame.

q_26371.question: How many SCI can be valid for a PSSCH duration?
q_26371.ground_truth: At most one SCI can be valid for a PSSCH duration.

q_26372.question: What is the difference between "Application Client" and "Application Server" in the context of the document?
q_26372.ground_truth: "Application Client" refers to the client-side application software in the UE, while "Application Server" refers to the server-side application software in the cloud.

q_26373.question: What is the significance of privacy protection mechanism in NWDAF?
q_26373.ground_truth: Privacy protection mechanism in NWDAF is essential to prevent user data leakage and to ensure privacy-related information is processed before being utilized by NWDAF to output analysis results.

q_26374.question: What is the maximum number of MAC PDU sub-headers that can be transmitted per TB per UE?
q_26374.ground_truth: A maximum of one MAC PDU can be transmitted per TB per UE.

q_26375.question: What is the L3 filter used for in the test procedure?
q_26375.ground_truth: The L3 filter is used to filter measuring values for RSRP, RSRQ, and RS-SINR to meet the applicable requirements in clause~9 in 3GPP TS 36.133.

q_26376.question: Which release of NR UE and EUTRA UE does this test apply to, as specified in 6.3.2.2.8.2?
q_26376.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of NR UE release 17 and forward and all types of EUTRA UE release 17 and forward supporting EN-DC.

q_26377.question: What is the purpose of the Cell Traffic Trace procedure?
q_26377.ground_truth: The Cell Traffic Trace procedure is used to send the allocated Trace Recording Session Reference and the Trace Reference to the MeNB.

q_26378.question: Which GBA modes can a UE indicate in the User-Agent header field for HTTP requests?
q_26378.ground_truth: A UE can indicate both AKA-based and GBA_Digest modes in the User-Agent header field, separated by multiple "product" tokens.

q_26379.question: What is the maximum power reduction (A-MPR) allowed for the maximum output power in SUL with UL MIMO, unless stated otherwise?
q_26379.ground_truth: An A-MPR of 0 dB is allowed for the maximum output power in SUL with UL MIMO, unless stated otherwise.

q_26380.question: What is the step size for the CW interfering signal in the Procedure step 7.5.4.2.2.5?
q_26380.ground_truth: The CW interfering signal is swept with a step size of 1 MHz.

q_26381.question: Which entity in the 5GC interact with the AF if it is in the untrusted domain?
q_26381.ground_truth: If the AF is in the untrusted domain, it interacts with the NFs in 5GC via NEF.

q_26382.question: In the context of clause~4.23.7.2.3, what is the rule for the home routed roaming procedure when a V-SMF is replaced by an I-SMF during inter NG-RAN node N2 handover procedure?
q_26382.ground_truth: The home routed roaming procedure defined in clause~4.9.1.4 is applied, with V-SMF replaced by I-SMF.

q_26383.question: Who is this test case applicable to?
q_26383.ground_truth: This test case applies to all types of NR UE release 16 and forward that support NR standalone shared spectrum channel access.

q_26384.question: What is the expected action of the UE in the test described in 9.2.3.1.17, if the UE is in the EMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH state and the TAI of the current cell belongs to the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming"?
q_26384.ground_truth: The UE does not attempt to send TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message if the serving cell belongs to the TAI where the UE was rejected. If the UE enters a cell belonging to the same PLMN and TAI is not in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming", the UE sends TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message. If the UE enters a cell belonging to a different PLMN and TAI of the current cell is not in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming", the UE initiates the attach procedure with IMSI.

q_26385.question: What is the difference between step 2a and step 2b of clause 5.6.3.1 in the procedure for reporting Monitoring Events by the MME/SGSN or HSS?
q_26385.ground_truth: Step 2a describes the Monitoring Indication message sent by the MME/SGSN, while step 2b describes the Monitoring Indication message sent by the HSS. Step 2b also includes External ID or MSISDN if the indication is associated with an individual Group Member UE.

q_26386.question: What should the UE do if it detects that a particular SIB is no longer present while attempting to acquire it?
q_26386.ground_truth: The UE should stop trying to acquire the particular SIB.

q_26387.question: What is the action taken by the SMF if the AMF received N2 SM information in step 14?
q_26387.ground_truth: The AMF shall forward the N2 SM information to the relevant SMF per PDU Session ID.

q_26388.question: In solution #31, which TA(s) does the Slice-Specific Service Area information element include when a slice is available in some TAs of the RA, and the Slice-Specific Service Area information element is provided to the UE for a slice that is not rejected or allowed?
q_26388.ground_truth: The Slice-Specific Service Area information element includes TA(s) in the RA where the slice is available, based on which the UE may request the not allowed S-NSSAI again if it is in a TA of the RA where the slice is available i.e. based on Slice-Specific Service Area information.

q_26389.question: What function does the LMF need to support for interworking between 5GS and EPS?
q_26389.ground_truth: The LMF needs to support determining the 5GS location QoS that corresponds to an EPS location QoS, and sending this information to the UE and AMF.

q_26390.question: What information element is included in the PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message when the back-off timer value is present?
q_26390.ground_truth: The Back-off timer value IE is included in the PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message when the network requests a minimum time interval before procedure retry is allowed.

q_26391.question: What response code is sent when the verification service receives a request with a Date header field value that is older than the local policy of the CSP for freshness permits?

q_26392.question: What must the default public user identity indicated by the HSS to the S-CSCF be?
q_26392.ground_truth: The default public user identity indicated by the HSS to the S-CSCF must be a registered public user identity.

q_26393.question: What is the purpose of studying potential enhancements for UL transmissions and DL receptions in SBFD symbols and non-SBFD symbols?
q_26393.ground_truth: The purpose is to improve resource allocation and utilization in frequency, time, power, and spatial domains, taking into account the inter-slot/intra-slot/inter-repetition/inter-group frequency hopping with DMRS bundling of PUSCH/PUCCH, if applicable.

q_26394.question: What does the eDRX-Related-RAT AVP indicate in the 3GPP network?
q_26394.ground_truth: The eDRX-Related-RAT AVP indicates the RAT type to which the eDRX Cycle Length is related in the 3GPP network.

q_26395.question: What is the purpose of discreet monitoring and audit of user content in the MC system?
q_26395.ground_truth: Discreet monitoring and audit allow access to user voice, video, and data communications for public safety authorities. They are required functions in a public-safety network and are performed in real-time for monitoring, or at some point after recording for audit purposes.

q_26396.question: What action should the NF Service Consumer take when it receives a 4xx/5xx response from the SMF with a handover resource allocation failure?
q_26396.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer should regard the hoState of the SM Context to be NONE.

q_26397.question: What are the minimum performance requirements that are applicable to both SA and NSA, as defined in Clauses 5-8, except for Clauses 9 and 10?
q_26397.ground_truth: All minimum performance requirements defined in Clauses 5-8 are applicable to both SA and NSA, unless explicitly stated otherwise in Clauses 9 and 10.

q_26398.question: What is the rule for setting the physical cell identity of Cell 2 for next iteration of the test procedure loop?
q_26398.ground_truth: Set Cell 2 physical cell identity = ((current cell 2 physical cell identity + 1) mod 1008) for next iteration of the test procedure loop.

q_26399.question: What is the role of the CBE and its interface with the CBC in CBS?
q_26399.ground_truth: The CBE (Cell Broadcast Entity) connected to the Cell Broadcast Centre, is responsible for providing CBS messages, while CBC is responsible for sending these messages to the cells. The interface between CBE and CBC is however out of the scope of 3GPP specifications.

q_26400.question: What is used to encode DTMF events in an IMS network?
q_26400.ground_truth: The IETF RFC 4733 is used to encode DTMF events in an IMS network.

q_26401.question: What should the UE do if there are at least one ProSe application traffic descriptor(s) to be used for the relayed traffic which has not yet been evaluated?
q_26401.ground_truth: The UE should select the RSC associated with the matched ProSe application traffic descriptor for solicitation.

q_26402.question: What is the purpose of the Uplink power control window in the context of the test requirements specified in the document?
q_26402.ground_truth: The purpose of the Uplink power control window is to ensure that the actual UE output power is no greater than the target power level, and as close as possible to the target power level.

q_26403.question: What is the operational testing feature in 5G networks designed to do?
q_26403.ground_truth: The operational testing feature in 5G networks is designed to assist in testing upgraded network nodes in the operational network, increasing the agility of 5G networks. This is achieved through slicing and virtualization, allowing for the creation of a test network slice instance or test NF for testing purposes.

q_26404.question: In which procedures can a network utilize the PLMN-assigned UE Radio Capability ID without involving the UE?
q_26404.ground_truth: A network may utilize the PLMN-assigned UE Radio Capability ID without involving the UE in legacy UE use cases or MOCN network sharing scenarios for caching PLMN assigned UE Radio Capability IDs per PLMN ID.

q_26405.question: In the definition of "IABTNLAddressesRequested", what does "IABTNLAddressesRequested" represent?
q_26405.ground_truth: IABTNLAddressesRequested represents the request for IP addresses (IPv4 or IPv6) or prefixes.

q_26406.question: What is the difference between an FDM solution and a TDM solution, in terms of eNB application to IDC problems?
q_26406.ground_truth: An FDM solution moves the LTE signal away from the ISM band, while a TDM solution ensures that transmission of a radio signal does not coincide with reception of another radio signal.

q_26407.question: What is the responsibility of the non-controlling MCData function when a SIP 4xx, 5xx, or 6xx response is received?
q_26407.ground_truth: The non-controlling MCData function shall forward the SIP response to the originating participating MCData function and take no further action.

q_26408.question: What is the condition that needs to be met for the UE to start sending the SYNCH-UL sequence in the UpPTS on cell 2 or 3 to perform a Tracking Area Update procedure on the target cell?
q_26408.ground_truth: The UE must camp on the target cell and start sending the SYNCH-UL sequence in the UpPTS on cell 2 or 3.

q_26409.question: What security mechanisms are used to secure PMIP messages in the reference points S2a, S2b, S5, and S8?
q_26409.ground_truth: Security for PMIP messages between MAG and LMA can be provided either by a chain of security associations in a hop-by-hop fashion or by one security association per direction in an end-to-end fashion. Confidentiality protection is optional. TS 33.210 and TS 33.310 are used to secure PMIP messages in the reference points S2a, S2b, S5, and S8.

q_26410.question: What should be the state-info XML element value within the application/vnd.3gpp.state-and-event-info+xml MIME body, if a SIP 180 (Ringing) response to the SIP INVITE request has not been received yet in any of the early dialogs associated with the originating early session?
q_26410.ground_truth: The state-info XML element should contain "pre-alerting".

q_26411.question: What action must the VAE-S take upon receiving a V2X message from a V2X application server for target geographical areas?
q_26411.ground_truth: The VAE-S must send a HTTP POST request message to each VAE-C associated with the target geographical area.

q_26412.question: When should the MCData client report that it is listening to an MBS session?
q_26412.ground_truth: The MCData client should report that it is listening to the MBS session when it receives an announcement, sends a UE session join notification, enters an MBS service area with a specific session stream, experiences good or bad MBS session radio conditions, or suffers from bad MBS session radio conditions.

q_26413.question: What is a software application that integrates audio-visual content into the user's real-world environment in AR devices?

q_26414.question: What is the purpose of associating a specific V-EASDF address with a specific HPLMN ID, S-NSSAI, and DNN?
q_26414.ground_truth: This association allows the V-EASDF to support DNS contexts with the same (private) UE IP address from different PLMNs, S-NSSAI, and DNNs, and identify the DNS context matching an incoming DNS request.

q_26415.question: What message does the target MME send to the target Serving GW when relocating the Serving GW in the local network?

q_26416.question: Which clause in TS 36.304 provides the rules for the UE to limit measurements for Srxlev and Squal of non-serving cells for reselection purposes?

q_26417.question: What is the time duration that starts the BWP switching process on all serving cells for a UE?
q_26417.ground_truth: The time duration TMultipleBWPswitchDelay starts from the beginning of DL slot n, where slot n is the earliest DL slot where a BWP switching request is received among all serving cells on which the UE is performing simultaneous DCI-based BWP switching.

q_26418.question: What are the basic requirements for streaming in 3GPP networks?
q_26418.ground_truth: The streaming service uses a client / server model which is transparent to the PLMN, utilizes existing standards (codecs and protocols) where these are available, and utilizes the PS Domain with QoS requirements as specified in 3GPP TS 22.105.

q_26419.question: Which protocol termination options are available for MCG and SCG bearers in MR-DC with 5GC?
q_26419.ground_truth: MCG bearers can be terminated in the MN or SN, while SCG bearers can be terminated in the MN or SN. From a UE perspective, MCG and SCG bearers are always terminated in the SN, but: if the SCG is terminated in the SN, the MCG cannot be terminated in the SN too.

q_26420.question: What is the purpose of a TEID in the context of GTP tunnels?
q_26420.ground_truth: A TEID (Tunnel Endpoint Identifier) unambiguously identifies a tunnel endpoint in the scope of a path, and each GTP tunnel is identified with a TEID, an IP address, and a UDP port number.

q_26421.question: What shall the eNodeB do if it is not able to admit all suspended bearers during the resumption of the RRC connection?
q_26421.ground_truth: The eNodeB shall indicate this in the list of rejected EPS bearers in the S1-AP UE Context Resume Request message.

q_26422.question: What is the name of the abstract behavior IOC for each ML entity or AI/ML inference function in the solution for monitoring and control of AI/ML behavior?
q_26422.ground_truth: The name of the abstract behavior IOC is "abstractBehavior".

q_26423.question: How are carriers placed for NRTC1 in transmitter tests?
q_26423.ground_truth: In NRTC1 transmitter tests, as many carriers as the Base Station supports within an operating band and fit in the rest of the declared maximum Base Station RF Bandwidth are selected and placed adjacent to each other starting from the upper Base Station RF Bandwidth edge.

q_26424.question: What elements should a <Speed> element contain?
q_26424.ground_truth: A <Speed> element should contain a <MinimumSpeed> element and a <MaximumSpeed> element.

q_26425.question: What information does the HSS read from the EPS-UDR or the 5GS-UDR in the SRVCC procedure?
q_26425.ground_truth: The HSS reads STN-SR and UE SRVCC Capability data from the EPS-UDR or the 5GS-UDR in the SRVCC procedure.

q_26426.question: What should the UE do when it receives a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message with the EMM cause set to 'Illegal ME'?
q_26426.ground_truth: The UE considers the USIM as invalid for EPS services and non-EPS services and enters state EMM-DEREGISTERED

q_26427.question: In clause 7.3.3, what should the receiving UE do with the protocol data unit after checking the destination layer-2 ID of the received protocol data unit?
q_26427.ground_truth: The receiving UE should pass the protocol data unit to the corresponding upper layer entity if the protocol data unit type is set to IP, Ethernet, Address Resolution Protocol, or Unstructured.

q_26428.question: What is the signal expression used in the asymptotic expansion approach for CFFNF?
q_26428.ground_truth: The signal expression used in the asymptotic expansion approach for CFFNF is given by the superposition of the fields generated by each element of the antenna array and the probe antenna with the known offset and antenna pattern. This expression is used to calculate the optimized DUT orientation for the NF measurement.

q_26429.question: What message is created by the initiating UE if the PROSE DIRECT LINK AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message cannot be accepted during the 5G ProSe direct link authentication procedure?
q_26429.ground_truth: The initiating UE creates a PROSE DIRECT LINK AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message.

q_26430.question: In what situation does the SMF bypass the PCF and sends QoS monitoring reports to the local AF/NEF?
q_26430.ground_truth: When the QoS monitoring reports are sent by the SMF bypassing the PCF, the SMF updates the PCC rule with the "refQosMon" attribute referring to a QosMonitoringData instance which does not include the "directNotifInd" attribute set to true and still includes the "notifyUri", and the "notifyCorreId" attributes.

q_26431.question: What should the UE do upon T310 expiry, random access problem indication from MAC, or indication from RLC that the maximum number of retransmissions has been reached?
q_26431.ground_truth: The UE should consider radio link failure to be detected and store the following radio link failure information in the VarRLF-Report by setting its fields as specified in TS 36.331, clause 5.3.11.3.

q_26432.question: What is the effect of setting NR Cell 2 physical cell identity = (current NR cell 2 physical cell identity + 1) mod 1008?
q_26432.ground_truth: This sets the physical cell identity of NR Cell 2 to the next value in the sequence while maintaining the same identity due to the modulo operation.

q_26433.question: What information is reported by the AMF to PCF/AF during the PDU session establishment procedure related to satellite backhaul?
q_26433.ground_truth: The AMF reports the satellite constellation information including 'LEO or MEO polar-orbit satellite constellation with or without cross-seam ISLs supported', if multi-hops of ISLs are involved by a polar-orbit satellite constellation.

q_26434.question: What should the user equipment (UE) do with a PDCP SDU when the discard timer for a PDCP SDU expires or when the successful delivery of a PDCP SDU is confirmed by PDCP status report?
q_26434.ground_truth: The UE should discard the PDCP SDU along with the corresponding PDCP PDU. If the corresponding PDCP PDU has already been submitted to lower layers, the discard is indicated to lower layers.

q_26435.question: What is the purpose of the "SNRM-C" (SEAL Network Resource Management Client) in the document?
q_26435.ground_truth: The SNRM-C (SEAL Network Resource Management Client) acts as the application client for network resource management related transactions.

q_26436.question: When should a pre-establish session control message be ignored?
q_26436.ground_truth: A pre-establish session control message should be ignored when the subtype is unknown, when there are unspecified fields, and when there are syntactically incorrect optional fields.

q_26437.question: What is the purpose of the PduSessionCreateData type name?
q_26437.ground_truth: It provides session create information for SMF

q_26438.question: What unit is used for the measurement of mean virtual CPU usage for a virtualized 3GPP NF?
q_26438.ground_truth: The unit used for the measurement of mean virtual CPU usage for a virtualized 3GPP NF is %.

q_26439.question: When should T312 be started for the corresponding SpCell in the reporting procedure when useT312 is set to true?
q_26439.ground_truth: T312 should be started for the corresponding SpCell if T310 for the SpCell is running, and T312 is not running for the SpCell during the measurement reporting procedure.

q_26440.question: What are the types of networks that can support 5G connectivity to a selected SNPN?
q_26440.ground_truth: The UE can select a non-3GPP access network that supports 5G connectivity to the selected SNPN.

q_26441.question: What happens when the terminating AS receives a CC invocation request for a URI that is not available for the requested CC service at destination B?
q_26441.ground_truth: The terminating AS sends a NOTIFY request to the originating AS with a "queued" status in the body.

q_26442.question: What should the destination IP address be when sending PFCP session related messages for sessions that are already established?
q_26442.ground_truth: The IP address received in the F-SEID allocated by the peer function should be used to send PFCP session related messages for sessions that are already established.

q_26443.question: What action should an AS take when it receives a request with a "logme" header field parameter in the SIP Session-ID header field?
q_26443.ground_truth: If required by local policy, the AS should log the request; if the AS receives any response to this request, it should also log the response.

q_26444.question: How does the transmitting side of an AM RLC entity react to a positive acknowledgement for an AMD PDU?
q_26444.ground_truth: When the transmitting side of an AM RLC entity receives a positive acknowledgement for an AMD PDU with SN = VT(A), it sets VT(A) equal to the SN of the AMD PDU with the smallest SN, whose SN falls within the range VT(A) < SN < VT(S) and for which a positive acknowledgment has not been received yet. If positive acknowledgements have been received for all AMD PDUs associated with a transmitted RLC SDU, the transmitting side shall send an indication to the upper layers of successful delivery of the RLC SDU.

q_26445.question: In what scenario is the Serving GW required to request both IPv6 network prefix and IPv4 address in the Proxy Binding Update for handover attach using PMIP-based S5/S8?
q_26445.ground_truth: The Serving GW requests both IPv6 network prefix and IPv4 address in the Proxy Binding Update for handover attach using PMIP-based S5/S8 when the UE requested deferred IPv4 address allocation for this PDN connection. This allows the UE to renew the IPv4 address allocation using DHCPv4 after the default bearer establishment procedure is completed.

q_26446.question: What operation must the UE perform if the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message indicates that the IMEISV is requested?
q_26446.ground_truth: The UE must include its IMEISV in the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message if the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message indicates that the IMEISV is requested.

q_26447.question: What is the role of the Policy Control Function (PCF) in the 5G System?
q_26447.ground_truth: The Policy Control Function (PCF) supports a unified policy framework to govern network behavior and provides Access and Mobility Management related policies to the NF service consumer.

q_26448.question: What action should the SCMS-S take if the sender of a CoAP PUT request for a user profile document is not authorized?
q_26448.ground_truth: The SCMS-S shall respond with a CoAP 4.03 (Forbidden) response and skip the rest of the steps.

q_26449.question: What is the procedure for PC5-MO-LR initiated by the Target UE?
q_26449.ground_truth: The Target UE issues a Determine Location Request message to the SL Positioning Server UE to determine its location, then reports the calculated Target UE location information to an authorized SL Positioning Client UE if necessary, and finally the SL Positioning Client UE acknowledges receipt of the Target UE location information.

q_26450.question: What is the reference signal level for the calculations in this process?
q_26450.ground_truth: The reference signal level is -39 dBV for analogue and -16 dBm0 for digital connections.

q_26451.question: What action should the network take upon receiving an AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message from the UE with 5GMM cause #71 "ngKSI already in use"?
q_26451.ground_truth: The network should perform necessary actions to select a new ngKSI and send the same 5G authentication challenge to the UE. Upon receiving the new AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message, the UE should stop the timer T3520, if running, and then process the 5G challenge information as normal.

q_26452.question: What is the maximum value for the Expires header field, as defined in IETF RFC 3261?
q_26452.ground_truth: The maximum value for the Expires header field is 232-1, or 4294967295.

q_26453.question: What is the cardinality rule for application clients?
q_26453.ground_truth: One or more application clients can exist per PIN client.

q_26454.question: When is it possible to delete the default QoS rule using the rule operation "Delete existing QoS rule"?
q_26454.ground_truth: This is possible when deleting an existing QoS rule that is already set to the default QoS rule.

q_26455.question: In what scenario does the MME send the MO Exception Data Counter to the Serving GW?
q_26455.ground_truth: To reduce signaling, the MME may send the MO Exception Data Counter to the Serving GW when it cannot send the MO Exception Data Counter to the Serving GW after each TAU.

q_26456.question: What is the purpose of the ECS in the authentication process between the EEC and EES?
q_26456.ground_truth: The ECS acts as an intermediate between the EEC and EES, helping to select the authentication mechanism based on the security capabilities of both the EEC and EES, and the HPLMN's supported mechanisms. The ECS provides the selection result to the EEC during the service provisioning procedure.

q_26457.question: What is the maximum channel bandwidth for which the RSTD measurement accuracy must be met during the RSTD measurement period for a PRS bandwidth?
q_26457.ground_truth: The maximum channel bandwidth is the minimum channel bandwidth of the component carriers on which RSTD measurement is performed during the RSTD measurement period.

q_26458.question: What should the P-CSCF do when sending the 200 (OK) response for a REGISTER request that concludes a re-authentication?
q_26458.ground_truth: The P-CSCF shall keep the set of security associations that was used for the REGISTER request that initiated the re-authentication, keep the newly established set of security associations created during this authentication and use the set of security associations and associated contact address that was used to protect the REGISTER request that initiated the re-authentication for further requests sent towards the UE as appropriate.

q_26459.question: What is the role of the NFVO in the EES termination process?
q_26459.ground_truth: The NFVO sends the NS Lifecycle Change notification to ECSP provisioning MnS producer indicating the result of termination procedure in the EES termination process.

q_26460.question: What are the main benefits of using the edgePMU concept in distribution networks?
q_26460.ground_truth: The main benefits include utilizing the scalability of cloud infrastructure, decreasing the specialization needed in the data acquisition device, simplifying the adoption and deployment of PMUs, providing flexible cloud solutions for different data use cases, and having great flexibility in the development of monitoring and automation functionalities. The increased computational power offered by 5G edge cloud enables more computationally challenging algorithms to be deployed.

q_26461.question: What information does the NSACF use to control the number of UEs in hierarchical NSACF architecture?
q_26461.ground_truth: In hierarchical NSACF architecture, the NSACF shall invoke the NumOfUEsUpdate service operation to request the NSACF to perform network slice admission control procedure based on UE admission quota or UE admission threshold to control the number of UEs.

q_26462.question: What is the difference between a User Identity and a User Identifier?
q_26462.ground_truth: A User Identity represents a user in a specific context, while a User Identifier is a piece of information used to identify one specific User Identity in one or more systems.

q_26463.question: What is a requirement for protecting data and information in transfer, as per industry best practice?
q_26463.ground_truth: The usage of cryptographically protected network protocols is required. The transmission of data with a need of protection shall use industry standard network protocols with sufficient security measures and industry accepted algorithms.

q_26464.question: What action should the UE take when it receives a DETACH REQUEST message with a detach type indicating "IMSI detach"?
q_26464.ground_truth: The UE shall not deactivate the EPS bearer contexts, set the MM update status to U2 NOT UPDATED, and send a DETACH ACCEPT message to the network. It will then re-attach to non-EPS services by performing the combined tracking area updating procedure.

q_26465.question: What should the MCPTT server do if it receives a SIP PUBLISH request with an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body containing an <mcptt-access-token> element and an <mcptt-client-id> element?
q_26465.ground_truth: The MCPTT server shall identify the IMS public user identity from the P-Asserted-Identity header field, perform the procedures in clause 7.3.1A, and check if the number of maximum simultaneous authorizations has been reached. If it exceeds the limit, the MCPTT server shall send a SIP 486 (Busy Here) response towards the MCPTT client with the warning text set to: "164 maximum number of service authorizations reached" in a Warning header field as specified in clause 4.4.

q_26466.question: What diameter application AVP is specify the service requested by the SCS in the S6m/S6n interface protocol?
q_26466.ground_truth: The Service-ID AVP is of type Enumerated and it shall identify the service requested by the SCS in the S6m/S6n interface protocol.

q_26467.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP management system notifying about predicted threshold-crossing conditions in key issue #3?
q_26467.ground_truth: The purpose is to support the DSO regarding the coordination of recovery actions, as the DSO needs to be notified in advance about pending threshold crossings.

q_26468.question: What should the mobile station do if the "Follow-on proceed" information element is present in the LOCATION UPDATING ACCEPT message and there is a pending CM application request?
q_26468.ground_truth: The mobile station shall send a CM SERVICE REQUEST to the network and proceed as in subclause 4.5.1.1.

q_26469.question: What should an NF Service Consumer do if it receives LCIs with overlapping scopes?
q_26469.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer should perform load balancing considering the LCI received with the finer scope for each candidate NF instance or NF service instance.

q_26470.question: What is an ongoing session in the context of PS-CS access transfer?
q_26470.ground_truth: An ongoing session is a session for which the SIP 2xx response for the initial SIP INVITE request to establish the session has been sent or received.

q_26471.question: When is the periodical reporting for a measId triggered for an event with the periodic reporting timer?
q_26471.ground_truth: Upon expiry of the periodical reporting timer for a measId, the UE shall initiate the measurement reporting procedure, as specified in 5.5.5.

q_26472.question: What should the AMF do if the timer T3447 is running and the UE does not support service gap control and certain conditions are met?
q_26472.ground_truth: The AMF shall send back to the UE the message which was not forwarded, send the 5GMM cause #22 "Congestion", and may include a back-off timer set to the remaining time of the timer T3447 as specified in subclause~5.4.5.3.1 case f).

q_26473.question: Which entities are updated with new data in EDI as per the SMF implementation?
q_26473.ground_truth: AF, NEF, UDR, and EASDF are updated with new data in EDI as per the SMF implementation.

q_26474.question: What is the role of the RTC MSH in the process of establishing a WebRTC session with a remote endpoint?
q_26474.ground_truth: The RTC MSH receives information about the media streams and their associated 5-Tuples from the application and requests network assistance for the RTC session.

q_26475.question: How does the network fulfill QoS alignment requirements in the QoS flow coordination group?
q_26475.ground_truth: The network fulfills QoS alignment requirements in the QoS flow coordination group based on the group level treatment policy.

q_26476.question: What should the UE do upon receipt of the PDN CONNECTIVITY ACCEPT message?
q_26476.ground_truth: Upon receipt of the PDN CONNECTIVITY ACCEPT message, the UE shall check the PTI to identify the UE requested PDN connectivity, stop timer T3582 and enter the state PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE. The UE should ensure that the PTI assigned to this procedure is not released immediately. The UE should wait for the Router Advertisement from the network with the IPv6 prefix information if it receives an IPv6 interface identifier in the PDN CONNECTIVITY ACCEPT message. If the UE accepts the PDN connection, it shall send a PDN CONNECTIVITY COMPLETE message and enter the state PDN CONNECTION ESTABLISHED.

q_26477.question: When does the requirement of 6.7.5.3 for the intermodulation level apply to the full Base Station RF Bandwidth edges of each operating band?
q_26477.ground_truth: When the inter RF Bandwidth gap is less than 3.2 MHz, the requirement of 6.7.5.3 applies to the full Base Station RF Bandwidth edges of each operating band.

q_26478.question: What parameters does the VAL server performance analytics monitor?
q_26478.ground_truth: The VAL server performance analytics monitors parameters related to e.g. VAL server number of connections for a given time and area, VAL server rate of connection requests, connection probability failure rates, RTT and deviations for a VAL server or VAL UE session, packet loss rates etc.

q_26479.question: What should the controlling MCPTT function do if the number of affiliated members is lower than the specified value and the group document contains required group members who are not affiliated?
q_26479.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function should send a SIP 480 (Temporarily Unavailable) response with a warning text set to "112 group call abandoned due to required group members not part of the group session".

q_26480.question: What are some of the security challenges associated with sharing virtualized resources?
q_26480.ground_truth: Some of the security challenges associated with sharing virtualized resources include the need to ensure that VNFs can be isolated from one another, particularly in the case where they have specific security requirements, and the potential risks of the noisy neighbour problem and side-channel attacks.

q_26481.question: What is the format of the Tracking Area Identity based N3IWF FQDN using a 2-octet TAC?

q_26482.question: When do both the UE and gNB/ng-eNB initiate ciphering and integrity protection of UP (User Plane) and AS (Access Stratum) downlink and uplink?
q_26482.ground_truth: At the transition from RRC IDLE to RRC CONNECTED state (as per clause 6.6.2)

q_26483.question: What is the test procedure sequence described in 7.1.7.1.12.3 in the context of TS 36.212, TS 36.213, and TS 36.306?
q_26483.ground_truth: The test procedure sequence in 7.1.7.1.12.3 refers to the test described in TS 36.212, TS 36.213, and TS 36.306, which specifies the test conditions, pre-test conditions, and specific message contents for the test.

q_26484.question: What is the minimum requirement for the OTA in-band selectivity for IAB-MT type 1-O and IAB-MT type 2-O?
q_26484.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for the OTA in-band selectivity for IAB-MT type 1-O is the same as for BS type 1-O in TS38.104, subclause 10.5.1.2. For IAB-MT type 2-O, the minimum requirement is the same as for BS type 2-O in TS38.104, subclause 10.5.1.3. The requirement applies at the RIB when the AoA of the incident wave of the received signal and the interfering signal are from the same direction and within the OTA REFSENS RoAoA, and the throughput should be greater than or equal to 95% of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channel.

q_26485.question: What is the function of the colon character (:) in a URI?
q_26485.ground_truth: It terminates an URI scheme component, separates host subcomponent from the port subcomponent, or separates the authority component from the query component.

q_26486.question: What should the system display when it receives a SIP INVITE request for an MCData emergency group communication?
q_26486.ground_truth: The system should display an indication that this is a SIP INVITE request for an MCData emergency group communication, the MCData ID of the originator, the MCData group identity with the emergency condition, and if the alert indicator is true, an indication of the emergency alert and associated information.

q_26487.question: What is the requirement for the frequency step size when setting the parameters of the CW signal generator for an interfering signal in this process?
q_26487.ground_truth: The frequency step size is specified in MHz.

q_26488.question: What is the maximum number of cells that can be served simultaneously by an EN-DC?
q_26488.ground_truth: The maximum number of cells that can be served simultaneously by an EN-DC is 8.

q_26489.question: What action does P-CSCF#1 take after receiving the "reservation successful" message from the terminating side?
q_26489.ground_truth: P-CSCF#1 forwards the "reservation successful" message to UE#1 along the signalling path established by the INVITE message.

q_26490.question: What is the requirement for minimum conformance for E-UTRAN TDD in the 3GPP TS 36.133 standard?
q_26490.ground_truth: The delay within which the UE shall be able to activate the deactivated SCell depends upon the specified conditions with CSI reporting and the PCell interruption requirements.

q_26491.question: What is the purpose of the window duration represented by "/<X>/Speech/<X>/PLR/DURATION"?
q_26491.ground_truth: The purpose of the window duration represented by "/<X>/Speech/<X>/PLR/DURATION" is to observe and compute the Packet Loss Rate (PLR) over this duration, and then compare the computed PLR with various thresholds.

q_26492.question: What is the format of the BroadcastMRBs-Setup-List object in the BroadcastContextSetupResponse message?
q_26492.ground_truth: The BroadcastMRBs-Setup-List object is a SEQUENCE of ProtocolIE-SingleContainer objects that contains a set of BroadcastMRBs-Setup-ItemIEs.

q_26493.question: How does the MAC entity identify the logical channel(s) for BRID or DAA?
q_26493.ground_truth: The MAC entity identifies the logical channel(s) for BRID or DAA based on the QoS information associated to BRID or DAA, i.e. PQI(s), from upper layers.

q_26494.question: What is the message that initializes the NRPPA-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE for errorIndication?

q_26495.question: What is the maximum amount of the magnitude of the timing change in one adjustment for UE transmit timing accuracy in E-UTRAN TDD?
q_26495.ground_truth: The maximum amount of the magnitude of the timing change in one adjustment for UE transmit timing accuracy in E-UTRAN TDD is 58.83*Ts seconds.

q_26496.question: What is the difference between the datagram transport mode and the stream transport mode in the context of MPQUIC-IP steering functionality?
q_26496.ground_truth: In the datagram transport mode, data packets are transferred inside QUIC DATAGRAM frames, while in the stream transport mode, data packets are transferred inside QUIC STREAM frames.

q_26497.question: What should the SS do if it does not receive the last CSI report or observe DTX for the SCells during the last 4 subframes of each specified time period in the TDD case?
q_26497.ground_truth: The SS counts a fail for the event "Deactivation" if it does not receive the last CSI report or observe DTX for the SCells during the specified subframes in the TDD case.

q_26498.question: What message does the MME send to the UE if the bearer resource allocation requested cannot be accepted?

q_26499.question: What should the eNodeB do after receiving the Attach Complete message from the UE, if the ESM message container was included in the initial Attach Request message?
q_26499.ground_truth: The eNodeB can forward the Attach Complete message to the new MME in an Uplink NAS Transport message, and uplink packets can be sent towards the eNodeB, which will then be tunnelled to the Serving GW and PDN GW.

q_26500.question: How does 3GPP network monitor specific events using the Monitoring Events feature?
q_26500.ground_truth: The Monitoring Events feature in the 3GPP network allows for event identification, detection, and reporting to authorized users via the SCEF. This feature supports monitoring the association of the UE and UICC, UE reachability, location and change in location of the UE, loss of connectivity, communication failure, roaming status, number of UEs present in a geographical area, availability after DDN failure, and PDN Connectivity Status.

q_26501.question: What are the two interfaces that can be used between the MP Remote UE and MP Relay UE in a multi-path relay scenario?

q_26502.question: What is the minimum requirement for SAN type 1-O for in-channel selectivity?
q_26502.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for SAN type 1-O for in-channel selectivity is specified in TS 36.108, clause 10.9.2.

q_26503.question: What should be done to the measResultNeighCellList in measResultFreqList when a UE detects a failure?
q_26503.ground_truth: Set the measResultNeighCellList in measResultFreqList to include the best measured cells, ordered such that the best cell is listed first, and based on measurements collected up to the moment the UE detected the failure.

q_26504.question: Who is the applicable subject for the 5.2.3.2.21 test case?
q_26504.ground_truth: This test case applies to all types of NR UE release 17 and forward that support SFN scheme B for PDCCH scheduling SFN Scheme B PDSCH.

q_26505.question: What parameter is used in the ci-3gpp2 value when the Carrier-ID is included?
q_26505.ground_truth: The length of the ci-3gpp2 parameter is 40 hexadecimal characters when the Carrier-ID is included.

q_26506.question: What does the user initially need to connect to the company's intranet through the fixed IP VPN in this use case?
q_26506.ground_truth: The user initially needs to use their laptop to build a connection to the company's intranet through the fixed IP VPN.

q_26507.question: What is a required function for XR Spatial Compute in order to place 3D objects on real surfaces and provide navigation functions?

q_26508.question: What is the formula for calculating Kp in the context of NCSG with high layer signalling of smtc2?
q_26508.ground_truth: Kp = 1/(1- (SMTC period /VIRP)), where for cells indicated in the pci-List parameter in smtc2, the SMTC periodicity corresponds to the value of higher layer parameter smtc2, and for other cells, the SMTC periodicity corresponds to the value of higher layer parameter smtc1.

q_26509.question: What is the architecture called where XR Spatial Computing is done entirely on the AR device without the use of a server for storage or computation?

q_26510.question: In which network layer is PDCP not used until AS security is activated in the context of NB-IoT UE that supports Control Plane CIoT EPS optimisation and S1-U data transfer or User Plane CIoT EPS optimisation?

q_26511.question: What is the difference between the use of the SUCI and the 5G-GUTI during the initial registration process for the FN-RG?
q_26511.ground_truth: The AMF uses the SUCI to select an AUSF, while the 5G-GUTI is used to indicate that there is no need to map the SUCI to the SUPI.

q_26512.question: What is the condition that the SS checks before increasing the number of successes for the event "Activation" in step 6a or 6b?
q_26512.ground_truth: The SS checks if a CSI report with a non-zero CQI index is received by the SS earlier than or equal to a specific subframe, and if DTX in PCell is not observed outside certain subframes.

q_26513.question: What should the UE do upon receiving a NAS signalling not associated with establishing either a CS emergency call or a PDN connection for emergency bearer services?
q_26513.ground_truth: The UE should wait for the local release of the established NAS signalling connection upon expiry of timer T3440 or T3440 being stopped before proceeding. Alternatively, if the UE receives a request to establish either a CS emergency call or a PDN connection for emergency bearer services, the UE should stop timer T3440 and locally release the NAS signalling connection.

q_26514.question: What is the HTTP status code that should be returned with additional error information in the response body, if the resource exists but the requesting SMF is not the one currently registered for the UE, when updating a parameter (e.g. PGW FQDN) in the SMF registration?

q_26515.question: What is the purpose of studying service differentiation for the EEL?
q_26515.ground_truth: The purpose is to enable efficient and optimized communication between different entities in the network.

q_26516.question: What are the two structures in which the protocols over the Uu and NG interfaces are divided?
q_26516.ground_truth: The two structures are user plane protocols, which implement the actual PDU Session service and carry user data through the access stratum, and control plane protocols, which control the PDU Sessions and the connection between the UE and the network from different aspects.

q_26517.question: What is the expiration time set to for a new MCData group information entry when the expiration time of the original entry is not yet expired?
q_26517.ground_truth: The expiration time of the new MCData group information entry is set to the current time increased with the candidate expiration interval.

q_26518.question: What is the purpose of the MCData client ID and when is it preserved?
q_26518.ground_truth: The MCData client assigns the MCData client ID when the MCData client is used for the first time, and it is preserved while the MCData client is SIP registered, while the MCData client is not SIP registered and the UE serving the MCData client is switched on, while the UE serving the MCData client is switched off, and while the UE serving the MCData client is power-cycled.

q_26519.question: How does a PLMN PLMN support Ranging/Sidelink Positioning?
q_26519.ground_truth: A PLMN supports Ranging/Sidelink Positioning by exchanging Ranging and Sidelink Positioning Protocol (RSPP) messages between UEs in a serving PLMN. This allows UEs to communicate over PC5 and obtain Ranging/Sidelink Positioning location results with assistance from an LMF in the serving PLMN. The information in the SLPP messages from UE 2 to n received by UE-1 is included in the SLPP container in the supplementary service messages from UE-1 to LMF.

q_26520.question: Which three IDs are mandatory in the PositioningMeasurementRequestIEs F1AP-Protocol-IES?
q_26520.ground_truth: id-TransactionID, id-LMF-MeasurementID, and id-RAN-MeasurementID are the three IDs that are mandatory in the PositioningMeasurementRequestIEs F1AP-Protocol-IES.

q_26521.question: What must the SMF do if the RSD of the URSP rule received from the PCF does not match the PDU session attributes?
q_26521.ground_truth: The SMF should reject the PDU Session Establishment request with a proper cause value.

q_26522.question: What SL Positioning Client UE data is used by a SL Positioning Server UE for Vetting functionality?
q_26522.ground_truth: A SL Positioning Server UE uses SL Positioning Client UE data such as the location request type, accuracy, client identity, and SL Reference UE ID(s) to determine whether the SL Positioning Client UE is authorized and is authorized to retrieve the location information of the Target UE.

q_26523.question: What is the purpose of the "Call-to-Call Variability Adjustment" (CCVA) in the test method described in clause 7.10.4.1 and 7.10.4.2?
q_26523.ground_truth: The CCVA is used to take into account the synchronization of speech frame processing in the UE to the bits of the speech frames at the UE antenna. This adjustment can lead to a variability of up to 20 ms of the measured UE receive delay between different calls. The CCVA is calculated by subtracting the delay introduced by the test equipment and the simulated transport network packet delay introduced by the delay and loss profile from the first electrical event at the electrical access point of the test equipment to the first bit of the corresponding speech frame at the system simulator antenna. The CCVA is added to the obtained delay for the speech signal to adjust the UE delay.

q_26524.question: What type of data does EFADN contain?
q_26524.ground_truth: EFADN contains Abbreviated Dialling Numbers, Supplementary Service Control strings, identifiers of associated network/bearer capabilities, and identifiers of extension records. It may also contain associated alpha-tagging.

q_26525.question: What is the reporting range for RSRP in 9.1.43.2.3 in TDD Intra Frequency Relative RSRP Accuracy for UE category 0?
q_26525.ground_truth: The reporting range of RSRP is defined from -140 dBm to -44 dBm with 1 dB resolution.

q_26526.question: What is indicated in the message "Context Acknowledge (ISR Activated)" that the old MME should do with the UE's contexts?
q_26526.ground_truth: The old MME should maintain the UE's contexts and stop the timer started in step 3.

q_26527.question: What is the procedure for the UE if it receives a reject message for the Service Request during RRC establishment?
q_26527.ground_truth: The UE assumes it is in the same network, performs cell reselection, internally marks the cell of the malicious base station as an invalid cell, and starts initial registration.

q_26528.question: In the context of T3230 in GERAN, what is Criterion 1 that triggers cell reselection to a higher absolute priority layer?
q_26528.ground_truth: Criterion 1 is fulfilled when the SrxtlevnonServingCell,x of a cell on an evaluated higher absolute priority layer is greater than Threshx,high during a time interval Treselection.

q_26529.question: When is the co-location transmitter intermodulation requirement considered sufficient in BS type 1-H?
q_26529.ground_truth: The co-location transmitter intermodulation requirement is considered sufficient in BS type 1-H if the interference signal for the co-location requirement is higher than the declared interference signal for the intra-system transmitter intermodulation requirement.

q_26530.question: When should the non-controlling MCPTT function reject the SIP request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response and not process the remaining steps when receiving a "SIP INVITE request for non-controlling MCPTT function of an MCPTT group"?
q_26530.ground_truth: The non-controlling MCPTT function should reject the request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response and not process the remaining steps if an Accept-Contact header field does not include the g.3gpp.mcptt media feature tag or an Accept-Contact header field does not include the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag containing the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcptt".

q_26531.question: In what order does the UE use the WLANSP rules from different PLMNs when roaming over 3GPP access?
q_26531.ground_truth: The UE uses the WLANSP rules from the visited PLMN first, then the valid WLANSP rules from the equivalent PLMN in which the UE last received WLANSP, and finally the valid WLANSP rules from the home PLMN.

q_26532.question: What should the PCF provide to indicate that a PCC rule shall be bound to the default QoS flow?
q_26532.ground_truth: The PCF shall provide the "defQosFlowIndication" attribute set to true in order to indicate that the related PCC rule shall be bound to the default QoS flow.

q_26533.question: What is the role of ECS in the negotiation procedure if there is no shared authentication mechanism with UE?
q_26533.ground_truth: The network could cease the authentication, and the following steps from step 3 will not take place.

q_26534.question: What must be performed if neither of the specified conditions are true and a Resource-Priority header field is included in the received SIP INVITE request with the value indicated for emergency calls, in order to avoid a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response and continue with the rest of the steps?
q_26534.ground_truth: Both of the following conditions must be true in order to avoid a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response and continue with the rest of the steps: 1) the SIP INVITE request does not contain an authorised request for an MCVideo emergency call as determined in step 4 above; and 2) the originating MCVideo user is not in an in-progress emergency private call state with the targeted MCVideo user.

q_26535.question: What shall the MS do if the ATTACH ACCEPT message contains a P-TMSI?
q_26535.ground_truth: The MS shall use the received P-TMSI as the new temporary identity for GPRS services and send an ATTACH COMPLETE message back to the network.

q_26536.question: What is the role of the MC gateway server in the MCVideo system and interconnected MCVideo system?
q_26536.ground_truth: The MC gateway server is responsible for relaying call control and floor control signalling messages, and media between MCVideo servers within the MCVideo system and the interconnected MCVideo system.

q_26537.question: What is the cell selection criterion S for evaluating a cell as a result of a periodic search for a higher priority PLMN while camped normally in a VPLMN, as specified in TS 36.304, clause 5.2.3.2?
q_26537.ground_truth: The cell selection criterion S is fulfilled when the signalled value QrxlevminOffset is a positive value and the measured signal strength of the cell is greater than the threshold value.

q_26538.question: What should the MRFC do when it receives an initial request for a dialog or a request for a standalone transaction?
q_26538.ground_truth: When the MRFC generates an initial request for a dialog or a request for a standalone transaction, the MRFC shall insert a P-Charging-Vector header field with the "icid-value" header field parameter populated as specified in 3GPP TS 32.260.

q_26539.question: What should the PCF provide if the "PartNetSliceSupport" feature is supported and the UE is registered via 3GPP access with a changed Partially Allowed NSSAI in a PDU session with home routed roaming?
q_26539.ground_truth: The updated Partially Allowed NSSAI should be provided within the "partAllowedNssai" attribute.

q_26540.question: What information does the MC service client send to the MC service server regarding the broadcast reception quality?
q_26540.ground_truth: The MC service client sends the MBS listening status report to the MC service server, which may be sent multiple times due to broadcast reception quality level changes. The report includes the current broadcast reception quality level.

q_26541.question: How can a UE obtain localized service information in a scenario where no business relationship exists between the home network and the hosting network?
q_26541.ground_truth: The UE can obtain this information from the hosting network by manually selecting a network, using default credentials, or obtaining credentials provided by the hosting network.

q_26542.question: Which numbering plan should be included in the called and calling party address when using ANSI T1.112 SCCP for inter-PLMN addressing?
q_26542.ground_truth: The called and calling party address should include the global title indicators 0010 and the Translation Type field coded appropriately (as 9, 14 or 10) when using ANSI T1.112 SCCP for inter-PLMN addressing.

q_26543.question: When does a UE need to instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure to generate the Timing Advance report MAC control element?
q_26543.ground_truth: If the MAC entity has UL resources allocated for new transmission for this TTI, and the allocated UL resources can accommodate the Timing Advance Report MAC control element plus its subheader, as a result of logical channel prioritization.

q_26544.question: What is the required probability that a Device Under Test (DUT) passing the test actually meets the test requirement when testing a parameter with a statistical nature?
q_26544.ground_truth: A confidence level is set to establish the probability that a DUT passing the test actually meets the test requirement.

q_26545.question: Which ROHC packet header profiles can be used when delivering packets over MBMS to save network resources?
q_26545.ground_truth: Profile 0x0101 for RTP/UDP/IP compression, and profile 0x0000 for sending uncompressed packets.

q_26546.question: What should the UE not transmit or receive on the SSB symbols used for L1-RSRP measurement?
q_26546.ground_truth: The UE should not transmit PUCCH, PUSCH or SRS or receive PDCCH, PDSCH, TRS, CSI-RS for tracking or CSI-RS for CQI on SSB symbols to be measured for L1-RSRP.

q_26547.question: What should a mobile station do if it supports eMLPP and receives a CALL PROCEEDING message containing a priority level?
q_26547.ground_truth: The mobile station should indicate this priority level to higher sublayers and store this information for the duration of the call for further action.

q_26548.question: What is the requirement for inter-band carrier aggregation with two non-contiguous carriers assigned to one NR band, in terms of the additional maximum output power reduction?
q_26548.ground_truth: The requirement is the same as that for intra-band contiguous carrier aggregation in subclause 6.2A.3.1.2.

q_26549.question: What are the procedures that should be supported at the II-NNI for Inter-UE transfer (IUT)?
q_26549.ground_truth: The REFER request, including a Refer-To header field with a body parameter and a Replaces header field, should be supported at the roaming II-NNI. The NOTIFY requests containing a "sipfrag" MIME body should be supported at the II-NNI, as well as the "g.3gpp.iut-controller" media feature tag in the Accept-Contact header field.

q_26550.question: What is the maximum time until which an interruption can occur on the PCell and/or activated SCell when deactivating an SCell in either E-UTRA TDD or FDD, when the PCell and/or the activated SCell being interrupted and the SCell being deactivated do not belong to the same type of E-UTRA?
q_26550.ground_truth: The interruption on the PCell and/or the activated SCell should not occur after subframe n+9 in this case.

q_26551.question: What shall the NEF do if updated MBS Service Information is provided and it decided to interact with the PCF during MBS Session Creation?
q_26551.ground_truth: The NEF shall interact with the PCF for MBS policy authorization of the received updated MBS Service Information and the update of the corresponding MBS Application Session Context.

q_26552.question: How many allowed retransmissions are available for the initiating UE if timer T5092 expires in the 5G ProSe direct link authentication procedure?
q_26552.ground_truth: The maximum number of allowed retransmissions is UE implementation specific.

q_26553.question: What are the main functions of the protocols that are part of the NAS?
q_26553.ground_truth: The NAS supports the mobility of the user equipment and the support of session management procedures to establish and maintain IP connectivity between the UE and a PDN GW.

q_26554.question: What is the trigger for event A6 in the 3GPP specification?
q_26554.ground_truth: The event A6 is triggered based on the entering condition defined as Mn + Ocn - Hys > Ms + Ocs + Off, where Mn is the measurement result of the neighboring cell, Ocn is the cell specific offset of the neighbor cell, Ms is the measurement result of the serving cell, Ocs is the cell specific offset of the serving cell, Hys is the hysteresis parameter for this event, and Off is the offset parameter for this event.

q_26555.question: What are the two requirements that allow the waiving of the carrier leakage measurement and the UE's UL signal to remain uncorrected for carrier leakage?
q_26555.ground_truth: The two requirements are when the UE reports the parameter 3300 or 3301, and when the UE doesn't indicate the DC location parameters.

q_26556.question: What should a UE assume for the purpose of deriving the CQI index, in the CSI reference resource, for transmission mode 9 CSI reporting of a non-BL/CE UE?
q_26556.ground_truth: The UE should assume the first 3 OFDM symbols are occupied by control signalling, no resource elements used by primary or secondary synchronization signals or PBCH or EPDCCH, CP length of non-MBSFN subframes, redundancy version 0, and the ratio of PDSCH EPRE to CSI-RS EPRE as given in Clause 7.2.5.

q_26557.question: What is the purpose of the scene-based audio capture device in this process?
q_26557.ground_truth: The scene-based audio capture device is used to estimate the sound pressure at the geometric center of the free-field volume and periphonic loudspeaker array.

q_26558.question: What is the finest granularity for QoS forwarding treatment in the 5G System?

q_26559.question: What are the common parameters included in each xIRI in the PTC Server?
q_26559.ground_truth: Each xIRI in the PTC Server includes at a minimum the following information: Target identity, Time stamp, Correlation information, Location information (if required and available), PTC related information (e.g., PTC group ID, PTC party), Encryption parameters (if required and available), and Direction (floor control source or destination port).

q_26560.question: Which use cases are being focused on in the 3GPP project on studying AI/ML for NR air interface?
q_26560.ground_truth: The use cases being focused on in the 3GPP project on studying AI/ML for NR air interface include CSI feedback enhancement, beam management, and positioning accuracy enhancements.

q_26561.question: What should the target UE do upon successfully completing the 5G ProSe direct link re-keying procedure?
q_26561.ground_truth: The target UE should create a PROSE DIRECT LINK REKEYING RESPONSE message and pass it to the lower layers for transmission along with the initiating UE's layer-2 ID for unicast communication and its own layer-2 ID for unicast communication.

q_26562.question: What is the impact of IAB on the 5GC in terms of function visibility?
q_26562.ground_truth: The IAB operation is invisible to the 5GC in terms of function visibility.

q_26563.question: What should the ME do to delete an MM (Multimedia Message) in EFMDF file?
q_26563.ground_truth: After a successful deletion of an MM in EFMDF file, the terminal updates the information in EFMDF accordingly.

q_26564.question: What is the mechanism used to determine the session path during session initiation?
q_26564.ground_truth: CSCFs store a certain part of the session path determined during session initiation and use the "Record-Route" mechanism to remain in the signalling path for subsequent requests.

q_26565.question: What is the format of the MulticastMRBs-Setup-List in the MulticastContextSetupResponseIEs F1AP-PROTOCOL-IES?
q_26565.ground_truth: The MulticastMRBs-Setup-List in the MulticastContextSetupResponseIEs F1AP-PROTOCOL-IES is a sequence of one or more ProtocolIE-SingleContainer elements, each containing zero or more ProtocolIE-SingleItem elements.

q_26566.question: What happens to the PCC rule's rating group when no rating group is included for Non-3GPP access in the MA PDU session control information?
q_26566.ground_truth: The PCC rule's rating group is used for the SDF traffic carried via both accesses (3GPP and non-3GPP) in this case.

q_26567.question: What is the restriction for a UE to measure CSI-RS for BFD when SSB for RLM, BFD, CBD, or L1-RSRP measurement is within the same OFDM symbol and has the same SCS as CSI-RS for BFD measurement in FR1?
q_26567.ground_truth: The UE shall be able to perform CSI-RS measurement without restrictions.

q_26568.question: What action does the mobile station take if the GPRS attach attempt counter is incremented due to an abnormal case?
q_26568.ground_truth: The mobile station takes actions depending on the Location Area Identities (stored on SIM/USIM) and the value of the attach attempt counter. If the update status is U1 UPDATED, the stored LAI is equal to the one of the current serving cell, and the attach attempt counter is smaller than 5, the mobile station keeps the update status to U1 UPDATED, and changes the MM state to MM IDLE substate NORMAL SERVICE. If the attach attempt counter is smaller than 5 and the stored LAI is different from the one of the current serving cell or the update status is different from U1 UPDATED, the mobile station deletes LAI, TMSI, ciphering key sequence number stored in the SIM/USIM, and sets the update status to U2 NOT UPDATED. The MM state remains MM LOCATION UPDATING PENDING. If the attach attempt counter is greater than or equal to 5, the mobile station deletes any information stored in SIM/USIM and performs appropriate MM specific procedures in MM IDLE state or PLMN search state.

q_26569.question: What is the minimum duration for which the UE should reach PCMAX,c level on SCC when continuously uplink power control "up" commands are sent in every uplink scheduling information?
q_26569.ground_truth: At least 200ms starting from the first TPC command in this step.

q_26570.question: What is the target power level in step 2 of the test procedure, before adding the uplink power control window size?
q_26570.ground_truth: The target power level in step 2 of the test procedure is 10 dBm.

q_26571.question: What does Solution #19 propose regarding the EEL entity selecting the ACR scenario(s) combination?
q_26571.ground_truth: Solution #19 proposes that the EES select a single ACR scenario or multi-ACR scenarios when requested by the EEC.

q_26572.question: What is the purpose of the "iotl" SIP URI parameter in the context of II-NNI traversal scenarios?
q_26572.ground_truth: The "iotl" SIP URI parameter is used to identify the II-NNI traversal scenario, which can be used by intermediary entities to make policy decisions related to traffic management, media anchoring, and charging. The value of the "iotl" parameter can be used to identify the II-NNI traversal scenario, and it is included by the start and removed by the end of the II-NNI traversal scenario.

q_26573.question: In the "ProtocolIE-Container" of the "HandoverRequestAcknowledge" section, what does the "ID id-PDUSessionResourcesAdmitted-List" field contain?
q_26573.ground_truth: In the "ProtocolIE-Container" of the "HandoverRequestAcknowledge" section, "ID id-PDUSessionResourcesAdmitted-List" field contains a list of PDUSessionResources that are admitted in the handover process.

q_26574.question: In which direction does the VLR initiate the MM information procedure?
q_26574.ground_truth: The VLR may initiate the MM information procedure by transferring an SGsAP-MM-INFORMATION-REQUEST message to the MME if for the target UE for the MM information procedure the state of the SGs association in the VLR is SGs-ASSOCIATED.

q_26575.question: What happens to special subframes in the first half-frame in a 5 ms downlink-to-uplink switch-point periodicity scenario?
q_26575.ground_truth: The special subframe exists in the first half-frame only.

q_26576.question: What action does the MME take if the UE is temporarily not reachable due to power saving and the PDN GW attempts to send a bearer modification message?
q_26576.ground_truth: If the UE is temporarily not reachable due to power saving and the PDN GW attempts to send a bearer modification message, the PDN GW will re-attempt the procedure after it receives an indication that the UE is available for end-to-end signaling in the subsequent Modify Bearer Request message.

q_26577.question: What is the purpose of creating a Federated Learning group in the described solution?
q_26577.ground_truth: The purpose of creating a Federated Learning group is to coordinate operations among participant NWDAFs when performing federated learning for a given analytics request from any NF.

q_26578.question: What parameter does the periodicity in TSCAI relate to in the current system?

q_26579.question: What is the pass fail decision as specified in 6.2.1.2.1.1.5 of the document?
q_26579.ground_truth: The pass fail decision is determined based on the test procedure outlined in 6.2.1.2.1.1.4.2.

q_26580.question: What is the role of the NWDAF in monitoring the correctness of an analytics ID?
q_26580.ground_truth: The NWDAF monitors the correctness of an analytics ID by calculating its performance information.

q_26581.question: What is the requirement description for port scanning in 4.4.2?
q_26581.ground_truth: The requirement description for port scanning in 4.4.2 is that it shall be ensured that on all network interfaces, only documented ports on the transport layer respond to requests from outside the system.

q_26582.question: In situation 11b, what is the condition for the number of non-consecutive DTX subframes observed by the SS during each specified subframe range?
q_26582.ground_truth: The condition is that no more than 2 non-consecutive DTX subframes are observed by the SS during each specified subframe range.

q_26583.question: What does it mean when the "5.2.48P /<x>/<x>/OnNetwork/PrivateCall/AllowedCallBackRequest" field is set to "true"?
q_26583.ground_truth: When the "5.2.48P /<x>/<x>/OnNetwork/PrivateCall/AllowedCallBackRequest" field is set to "true", the MCPTT user is allowed to request a private call call-back.

q_26584.question: Which message type is used by the NG-RAN node to request the AMF to provide mapping information for the indicated UE Radio Capability ID?
q_26584.ground_truth: 9.2.13.4 UE RADIO CAPABILITY ID MAPPING REQUEST

q_26585.question: Which scenario does the minimum conformance requirement apply to for inter-band EN-DC within FR1 with 4 DL CCs (3NR DL CCs)?
q_26585.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements apply to inter-band EN-DC with FR1 and 4 DL CCs (3NR DL CCs). This scenario requires E-UTRA test point analysis and E-UTRA measurements are performed. The LTE anchor agnostic approach is not applied.

q_26586.question: What should the target eNodeB do if it received both the UE radio capabilities and the UE Radio Capability ID but it does not have any stored UE radio capability information corresponding to the UE Radio Capability ID?
q_26586.ground_truth: The target eNodeB may request the full UE radio capability information from the core network. If the full UE radio capability information is not promptly received from the core network, the target eNodeB shall proceed with the UE radio capabilities sent by the source RAN node.

q_26587.question: Which clauses in TS 36.331 and TS 36.213 specify the conformance requirements for test case 8.3.1.19.2?

q_26588.question: What are some alternatives to the FFT used in the baseband processing of the LP WUR architectures?
q_26588.ground_truth: Goertzel filters are an alternative to the FFT used in the baseband processing of the LP WUR architectures to compute signals for one or more tones.

q_26589.question: What should the network do if two or more packet filters in a TFT have identical packet filter identifiers?
q_26589.ground_truth: In this case, the network should reject the activation request with cause "syntactical errors in packet filter(s)".

q_26590.question: For TDD-FDD CA with TDD PCell and 5 DL CC, what is the required difference between the wideband CQI indices of SCell1 and SCell3 reported for more than 90% of the time?
q_26590.ground_truth: The required difference between the wideband CQI indices of SCell1 and SCell3 reported for TDD-FDD CA with TDD PCell and 5 DL CC is 2.

q_26591.question: What may the SMF do if the UE initiates PDU session modification to modify the PDU session to an always-on PDU session?
q_26591.ground_truth: The SMF shall include an Always-on PDU Session Granted indication in the PDU Session Modification Command to indicate whether the PDU session was granted.

q_26592.question: What is the role of the Media Player in the 5GMSd UE functions?
q_26592.ground_truth: The Media Player is responsible for providing functions for accessing media content, such as DASH-formatted media segments, and presenting the media using an appropriate output device enabling possible interaction with the media.

q_26593.question: Which child element allows specifying whether the user is allowed to request the presence status in the XML schema?
q_26593.ground_truth: The "allow-presence-status" element of the "xs:element" type is used to specify whether the user is allowed to request the presence status.

q_26594.question: What is the definition of the measurement reporting delay in the described procedure?
