q_26594.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay is defined as the time from the beginning of time period T2 to the moment when the UE sends the measurement report on PUSCH.

q_26595.question: What HTTP method should be used to update an existing Policy in the NSCE Server?
q_26595.ground_truth: The HTTP PUT/PATCH method should be used to update an existing Policy in the NSCE Server.

q_26596.question: What occurs when a BH link is considered unavailable for a packet?
q_26596.ground_truth: In this case, the IAB-node may perform local rerouting, i.e., select another BH link by considering only the packet's BAP address or, in some cases, by header rewriting. In this manner, the packet can be delivered via an alternative path.

q_26597.question: Which release of NR RedCap UE does the test described in section 16.6.2.9 apply to?
q_26597.ground_truth: The test described in section 16.6.2.9 applies to all types of NR RedCap UE with 1 Rx (Receiver) from Release 17 onwards.

q_26598.question: Which protocolIE-SingleContainer is used to define the setup items in the response Message?

q_26599.question: What does the security functions rejection of the UE cause in the RAU procedure?
q_26599.ground_truth: The new S4~SGSN sends a reject indication to the old MME, causing the MME to continue as if the Identification and Context Request was never received.

q_26600.question: How does the MCData server fetch a file for distribution over MBS sessions?
q_26600.ground_truth: The MCData server fetches a file by accessing the MCData content server over the MCData-FD-5 reference point using the file URL provided by MCData users. It can then ingest the file into the MBSTF for distribution over MBS sessions.

q_26601.question: What is the NSCE service area?
q_26601.ground_truth: The NSCE service area is the area where the Network Slice Capability Enablement server owner provides its services, equivalent to the collection of coverage area of slices it can enable.

q_26602.question: In the context of ACK missed detection, what is the probability of false detection of the ACK defined as?
q_26602.ground_truth: The probability of false detection of the ACK is defined as a conditional probability of erroneous detection of the ACK when input is only noise.

q_26603.question: What is used by NG-RAN to order the UE to start, modify or stop measurements?
q_26603.ground_truth: Measurement commands are used by NG-RAN to order the UE to start, modify or stop measurements.

q_26604.question: What is the action taken when the NDI is toggled in the downlink assignment for the same HARQ process or a downlink assignment received for the MAC entity's Semi-Persistent Scheduling C-RNTI?
q_26604.ground_truth: The NDI is considered not to have been toggled.

q_26605.question: What potential security requirement is needed to protect the software package and the artifacts within the package of a virtualized 3GPP NF containing sensitive information during its onboarding, storage, and instantiation?
q_26605.ground_truth: The software package and the artifacts within the package of a virtualized 3GPP NF containing sensitive information should support confidentiality protection. Solutions to this requirement are required outside 3GPP.

q_26606.question: Which requirement specifies the spurious emissions for intra-band non-contiguous EN-DC in TS 38.101-3?
q_26606.ground_truth: The requirement is specified in clause 7.9B.2 of TS 38.101-3.

q_26607.question: What is the maximum number of occurrences for the "any" element with a namespace of "#other"?
q_26607.ground_truth: The maximum number of occurrences for the "any" element with a namespace of "#other" is unbounded.

q_26608.question: When testing PRACH performance requirements, for which PRACH format shall the tests be carried out for each supported channel bandwidth?
q_26608.ground_truth: The tests shall be carried out for each PRACH format declared to be supported.

q_26609.question: What is the purpose of the sidelink HARQ NACK-only operation in NR-V2X groupcast services?
q_26609.ground_truth: The purpose of the sidelink HARQ NACK-only operation in NR-V2X groupcast services is to create a lower sidelink resource demand when a larger number of Rx UEs need to send feedback to the same Tx UE. This operation is useful in scenarios such as extended sensors, where re-transmission will occur if any UE fails to decode successfully.

q_26610.question: What happens when the initiating UE receives a PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message but the PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message did not include the Target user info IE?
q_26610.ground_truth: It is up to the UE implementation to consider the 5G ProSe direct link establishment procedure as complete or to restart the timer T5080.

q_26611.question: What action does the SMF take when it receives a PDU session establishment request with a requested DNN/S-NSSAI dedicated for aerial services but without a Service Level Device ID (CAA-Level UAV ID)?
q_26611.ground_truth: The SMF rejects the PDU session establishment with a cause indicating that USS authorization is required.

q_26612.question: In what scenario would the PCF for the UE determine that the access and mobility related policy information can change at the start and stop of an application traffic detection?
q_26612.ground_truth: The PCF for the UE would determine that the access and mobility related policy information can change at the start and stop of an application traffic detection when it provides access and mobility related policy information for a UE and when the PCF for the PDU Session of this UE provides session management related policies.

q_26613.question: What should the gNB-DU do upon receiving the BROADCAST CONTEXT RELEASE REQUEST message?
q_26613.ground_truth: Upon receiving the BROADCAST CONTEXT RELEASE REQUEST message, the gNB-DU should trigger the Broadcast Context Release procedure.

q_26614.question: Who is responsible for allocating and ensuring the uniqueness of the AMSID, the identifier used to indicate which UE should be provided with an AMSID for federated learning (FL)?
q_26614.ground_truth: The AF or the 5GC entity, i.e. the AFLSF, is responsible for allocating and ensuring the uniqueness of the AMSID.

q_26615.question: What is the term used to describe a UE's ability to prioritize or down-prioritize a specific NES cell in 6.5.1?

q_26616.question: What should be the port number of the media line if media control is multiplexed with audio in the MCVideo function?
q_26616.ground_truth: If media control is multiplexed with audio in the MCVideo function, the port number of the media line should be set to 9.

q_26617.question: When should the UE resume eDRX after PDN disconnection for emergency bearer service?
q_26617.ground_truth: The UE and the network shall resume eDRX upon successful completion of the PDN disconnect procedure of the PDN connection for emergency bearer services or EPS bearer context deactivation procedure of the EPS bearer context for emergency.

q_26618.question: When is the tracking area updating attempt counter incremented?
q_26618.ground_truth: The tracking area updating attempt counter is incremented when a normal or periodic tracking area updating procedure fails and is less than 5, and the TAI of the current serving cell is not included in the TAI list or the EPS update status is different to EU1 UPDATED.

q_26619.question: What should the MeNB do if it receives the SENB MODIFICATION REQUIRED message after it has initiated the MeNB initiated SeNB Modification procedure?
q_26619.ground_truth: The MeNB should respond with the SENB MODIFICATION REFUSE message to the SeNB with an appropriate cause value in the Cause IE.

q_26620.question: What is the length limit for an MBMS Service Area Identity (MBMS SAI)?
q_26620.ground_truth: The MBMS SAI is a decimal number between 0 and 65,535 (inclusive).

q_26621.question: What condition must be met for the UE to send event triggered measurement reports for cells 2, 3, and 4?
q_26621.ground_truth: The UE must send Event B1 triggered measurement reports for cells 2, 3, and 4 with a measurement reporting delay less than 7.68s (cell 2) and 115.2s (cell 3 and 4) from the beginning of time period T2.

q_26622.question: What action does the PDN GW take when it receives a Proxy Binding Update with a PDN connection identity and the corresponding Proxy Binding Update contains multiple PDN connections to a single APN?
q_26622.ground_truth: The PDN GW shall acknowledge if it supports multiple PDN connections to a single APN.

q_26623.question: What is the procedure for the removal of a participant from the ongoing ad-hoc group communication?
q_26623.ground_truth: The MC service server sends the ad-hoc group call leave request to the leaving participant, the leaving participant is notified of the request, and the MC service server removes the leaving participant from the ongoing ad-hoc group communication.

q_26624.question: When is the UE allowed to send a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message for the same S-NSSAI in the new SNPN, if T3585 applied for all the equivalent SNPNs is running or is deactivated for an S-NSSAI and old SNPN, but T3585 is not running and is not deactivated for the S-NSSAI and new non-equivalent SNPN?
q_26624.ground_truth: The UE is allowed to send a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message for the same S-NSSAI in the new SNPN, if T3585 applied for all the equivalent SNPNs is running or is deactivated for an S-NSSAI and old SNPN, but T3585 is not running and is not deactivated for the S-NSSAI and new non-equivalent SNPN.

q_26625.question: In case of unsuccessful modification of an E-RAB, how should the MME report the cause value?
q_26625.ground_truth: The MME should report the cause value with precise information to enable the eNB to know the reason for an unsuccessful modification.

q_26626.question: What is the initiating message for the procedure code id-F1Removal?

q_26627.question: What is the flag that the Event Consumer NF, DCCF or NWDAF has to include when it wants to retrieve muted stored events from the Event Producer NF?
q_26627.ground_truth: The Event Consumer NF has to include the retrieval notification flag when it wants to retrieve muted stored events from the Event Producer NF.

q_26628.question: What action should the SC UE take upon receiving information from the lower layers that the CS to PS SRVCC access transfer is initiated if a CS call exists in Active state?
q_26628.ground_truth: The SC UE starts rendering speech media of the determined active call being transferred, starts sending speech media of the determined active call being transferred with the ATGW transfer details received from the lower layers, and sends a SIP INVITE request to STI-rSR.

q_26629.question: What does the AMF do when existing PDU Sessions need to be released due to barring of Packet Oriented Services?
q_26629.ground_truth: The AMF requests the SMF to release all existing PDU Sessions, or releases associated PDU Sessions with a particular path, depending on the barring category.

q_26630.question: What are the functionalities supported by PIN-4 reference point?
q_26630.ground_truth: The functionalities supported by PIN-4 reference point include authorizing PIN clients to access PIN, discovery of services offered by other PIN elements, discovery and selection of PIN elements, and notifying the PIN information modification details.

q_26631.question: What is the smallest SCS (Subcarrier Spacing) used to define the length of a slot in mixed numerologies for CSI-RS based intra-frequency measurements?

q_26632.question: What procedure does the NG-RAN node initiate to request UE Radio Capability information mapped to the UE Radio Capability ID?
q_26632.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node initiates the UE Radio Capability ID Mapping procedure by sending a UE RADIO CAPABILITY ID MAPPING REQUEST message.

q_26633.question: What should the participating MCData function do if it is unable to process a SIP INVITE request for a standalone MCData session over media plane?
q_26633.ground_truth: If the participating MCData function is unable to process the SIP INVITE request, it may reject the request with a SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response and include a Retry-After header field in the response.

q_26634.question: What procedures should a MS execute when moving to a new RA in Iu mode?
q_26634.ground_truth: If the MS is in state GMM-REGISTERED or GMM-ROUTING-AREA-UPDATING-INITIATED and is in operation mode A in Iu mode, the MS shall execute a Normal Routing Area Update when moving to a new RA in Iu mode.

q_26635.question: What type of security method is supported when SEAL server, using CAPIF, invokes an API offered by an external service?
q_26635.ground_truth: One of the security methods supported when using CAPIF with a SEAL service is OAuth2, using the "Client Credentials" authorization grant.

q_26636.question: What should be the maximum time requirement for the cell to remain known for the closest SMTC occasions available for measurement?
q_26636.ground_truth: The maximum time requirement for the cell to remain known for the closest SMTC occasions available for measurement is the same as the maximum time requirement for the cell to remain known for the inter-frequency measurements.

q_26637.question: Which country is the youngest on Earth?

q_26638.question: What should be the overall delays measured in this test case?
q_26638.ground_truth: The overall delays measured should be less than a total of 8002 ms in this test case.

q_26639.question: What is the procedure for an Application Client on the non-MSGin5G UE to de-register from the MSGin5G Client on the MSGin5G UE?
q_26639.ground_truth: Upon reception of the de-registration request, the MSGin5G Client on the MSGin5G UE removes the mapping between the Application ID and transport identifier of the Application Client on the non-MSGin5G UE, constructs the de-registration response, and sends it to the Application Client on the non-MSGin5G UE, which may include the De-registration Result, Registration ID if the de-registration is accepted, and Failure Reason if the de-registration is not accepted.

q_26640.question: What is the requirement for RTP/AVPF support in an MTSI client in terminal using fixed access?
q_26640.ground_truth: An MTSI client in terminal using fixed access and supporting RTP/AVPF shall do RTP profile negotiation as defined in clause~6.2.1a.

q_26641.question: In the "3GPP-E-UTRAN-FDD" or "3GPP-E-UTRAN-TDD" access type, what parameter is used to represent the concatenation of the MCC, MNC, Tracking Area Code, and E-UTRAN Cell Identity?

q_26642.question: Which solution is a viable technical solution to address key issue #6 for supporting utilization of improved analytics?
q_26642.ground_truth: Solution #6, Network situation enhanced with analytics, is a viable technical solution to address key issue #6 for supporting utilization of improved analytics.

q_26643.question: What are the default test frequencies for NR cells, UTRA cells, and E-UTRA cells?
q_26643.ground_truth: NRf1 is the default test frequency for NR cells, f8 is the default test frequency for UTRA cells, and f1 is the default test frequency for E-UTRA cells.

q_26644.question: What is the target cell search time (Tsearch) when the cell is unknown and the signal quality is sufficient for successful cell detection on the first attempt?

q_26645.question: What should the AMF include in the Create SM Context request if the smfUri IE or hSmfUri IE is provided by the AMF and is different from the smfUri IE or hSmfUri IE in the SM context returned in the Retrieve SM Context response?
q_26645.ground_truth: The AMF should prevail the IEs received in the Retrieve SM Context response and use them to trigger the create service operation to the (H-)SMF.

q_26646.question: What message is sent by the E-SMLC to transfer assistance information?

q_26647.question: What are the carrier frequency ranges and corresponding SS/PBCH block SCS choices in the 3GPP specification for NR-based 5G systems?
q_26647.ground_truth: The carrier frequency ranges in this specification are divided into several frequency bands. The corresponding SS/PBCH block SCS choices depend on the frequency band and the SCS of SS/PBCH blocks, with options including 15 kHz, 30 kHz, 120 kHz, 240 kHz, 480 kHz, and 960 kHz.

q_26648.question: What should a participating MCData function do if the presence of the isfocus media feature tag is not present in the URI of the Contact header field when receiving a SIP INVITE request for standalone SDS over media plane for terminating participating MCData function?
q_26648.ground_truth: If the isfocus media feature tag is not present in the URI of the Contact header field, the participating MCData function should reject the SIP INVITE request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response and the warning text set to "104 isfocus not assigned" in a Warning header field.

q_26649.question: How is the UE MM Core Network Capability handled in the 5G System?
q_26649.ground_truth: The UE MM Core Network Capability is split into the S1 UE network capability and the UE 5GMM Core Network Capability, and is transferred during specific CN node changes. The UE shall send the UE MM Core Network Capability information to the AMF during the Initial Registration and Mobility Registration Update procedure.

q_26650.question: What procedures should be followed during the restoration of a PGW after a restart?
q_26650.ground_truth: The PGW should delete all MM Bearer contexts and place a PGW restart counter value in GTPv2 echo requests/responses and PMIPv6 heartbeat responses

q_26651.question: What is the role of the source UE in the LIU procedure in the context of UE-to-UE Relay?
q_26651.ground_truth: The source UE initiates the LIU procedure by sending a Link Identifier Update (LIU) Request message to the UE-to-UE Relay, which includes new L2 ID and security parameters for the management link, as well as new E2E security parameters and a new E2E identifier for the E2E link with the target UE.

q_26652.question: What must be done with the Vendor-Specific-Application-Id AVP when receiving a command in the S6a/S6d interface?
q_26652.ground_truth: The Vendor-Specific-Application-Id AVP shall be ignored by the receiving node when received in any of the commands defined in this specification.

q_26653.question: What is the procedure for handling MBMS bearer suspension notification?
q_26653.ground_truth: The MC service server can choose to instruct some MC clients to send the MBMS bearer suspension report when notified by RAN. The MC gateway UE then notifies the MC clients it is serving so that MC clients can report the same to the MC service server.

q_26654.question: What is an example of local policy enforcement that can be handled by an MCData gateway server?
q_26654.ground_truth: If an MCData gateway server receives a SIP request or response that contains sensitive information that cannot be exposed to the targeted interconnected system based on local policies, but does not prevent the service from being delivered, the MCData gateway server can remove that information from the outgoing SIP message before forwarding it.

q_26655.question: What is the goal of Solution #11?
q_26655.ground_truth: The goal of Solution #11 is to address Key Issue #3, which focuses on providing security for AI/ML model storage and sharing between different vendors.

q_26656.question: What protocol does the PDU Set Handling Service propose to use for UL and DL XR traffic?
q_26656.ground_truth: The MASQUE protocol, which relies on HTTP/3 over QUIC.

q_26657.question: What is the maximum duration for the timer-based BWP switch, after which the UE shall start BWP switch?
q_26657.ground_truth: The maximum duration is the length of a DL subframe (FR1) or DL half-subframe (FR2) immediately after a BWP-inactivity timer bwp-InactivityTimer expires on a serving cell.

q_26658.question: What should a UE do if the field1 is absent in the RRCMessage-IEs?
q_26658.ground_truth: The UE does not modify or take any action on the child fields of field1.

q_26659.question: What action does the UDM take when it decides that the UE needs to be authenticated?
q_26659.ground_truth: The UDM requests a new primary authentication procedure for the UE towards the AMF, taking the action to initiate a new authentication process.

q_26660.question: When should the floor participant interface perform the actions specified in clause 6.3.2.3?
q_26660.ground_truth: The floor participant interface should perform the actions in clause 6.3.2.3 when it receives an instruction from the application and signalling plane to split the ongoing group session.

q_26661.question: What is the threat name for the usage of weak cryptographic algorithms for stored or transmitted sensitive information in GNP?

q_26662.question: What resources can be shared in the 5G MOCN network sharing architecture?
q_26662.ground_truth: The 5G MOCN network sharing architecture allows participating operators to share resources of a single shared network, including the radio access network and radio resources.

q_26663.question: What value shall the participating MCData function include in the P-Asserted-Service header field of the outgoing SIP INVITE request?
q_26663.ground_truth: The participating MCData function shall include the ICSI value "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcdata.fd" in the P-Asserted-Service header field of the outgoing SIP INVITE request.

q_26664.question: What is the mandatory transport protocol used for CMPv2 messages between end entities and RA/CA?
q_26664.ground_truth: An HTTP-based protocol, as specified in IETF RFC 6712, is used for the transport of CMPv2 messages between end entities and RA/CA.

q_26665.question: What message is sent by the network to the UE to indicate the result of the Routing Area Update procedure?
q_26665.ground_truth: A ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT or a ROUTING AREA UPDATE REJECT message is sent by the network to the UE to indicate the result of the Routing Area Update procedure.

q_26666.question: What should the target NG-RAN node not deliver in terms of uplink packets for each DRB in the DRBs Subject to Status Transfer List IE?
q_26666.ground_truth: The target NG-RAN node should not deliver any uplink packet which has a PDCP-SN lower than the value contained within the UL COUNT Value IE for each DRB in the DRBs Subject to Status Transfer List IE.

q_26667.question: What should the MCData server do if timer F expires for the SIP PUBLISH request sent for a (de)affiliation request?
q_26667.ground_truth: If timer F expires for the SIP PUBLISH request sent for a (de)affiliation request, the MCData server should remove each MCData group ID entry associated with the MCData client information entry of the served MCData user information entry.

q_26668.question: What happens when the SCC AS sends a SIP RE-INVITE to the Remote UE to modify the media components?
q_26668.ground_truth: The Remote UE receives the new media parameters, returns an answer, and starts the reception/transmission of these media components.

q_26669.question: What should the controlling MCData function include in the P-Asserted-Identity header field of a SIP request for an MCData emergency alert?
q_26669.ground_truth: The P-Asserted-Identity header field should be set to the public service identity of the controlling MCData function.

q_26670.question: When the FN-RG is used, what procedures regarding user profile management are not applicable?
q_26670.ground_truth: Steering of roaming information is not applicable, since roaming is not supported.

q_26671.question: What should the UE do if the number of non-CA and CA band combinations supported by it exceeds the maximum number of band combinations of supportedBandCombination?
q_26671.ground_truth: The selection of a subset of band combinations is up to UE implementation if the number of non-CA and CA band combinations supported by the UE exceeds the maximum number of band combinations of supportedBandCombination.

q_26672.question: What message does the AMF send to the NG-RAN node to request a release of already established NG-U resources for a multicast MBS session?

q_26673.question: What is the MIME body that the MCData client should include in the SIP re-INVITE request if the MCData user is cancelling an in-progress emergency condition and an MCData emergency alert originated by the MCData user?
q_26673.ground_truth: The MCData client should include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body by executing the procedure in clause~6.2.8.3.6.

q_26674.question: What should the NSCE client send to the NSCE server to trigger a network slice adaptation for the VAL application?
q_26674.ground_truth: The NSCE client sends a network slice adaptation trigger request to the NSCE server for the VAL application. This trigger may be in the form of an exact requested network slice for the VAL UE of the VAL application or an indication that the VAL application needs to be remapped to a different network slice, including additional parameters based on the step 1 request, such as requested location criteria, time window, access type preference, associated group id, or UE IP address preservation indicator.

q_26675.question: What is the purpose of the Mobility Parameters Information IE in the handover procedure?
q_26675.ground_truth: The Mobility Parameters Information IE contains the change of the Handover Trigger as compared to its current value, which corresponds to the threshold at which a cell initializes the handover preparation procedure towards a specific neighbor cell.

q_26676.question: When is the UE expected to transmit PUCCH/PUSCH/SRS during intra-frequency measurements in a TDD band due to SS-RSRP?
q_26676.ground_truth: The UE is not expected to transmit PUCCH/PUSCH/SRS on SSB symbols to be measured, and on 1 data symbol before each consecutive SSB symbols to be measured and 1 data symbol after each consecutive SSB symbols to be measured within SMTC window duration.

q_26677.question: What message does the SGW send to the PDN GW if the List of NE Type to trace specifies Tracing in the PDN GW, SGW shall send Trace Session Activation?
q_26677.ground_truth: Trace Session Activation to PDN GW via the PCRF as part of the IP CAN session establishment or as a standalone procedure.

q_26678.question: What is the format of the MO-Data-Request command message for the T6a/b, T6ai/bi, and T7 interfaces?
q_26678.ground_truth: The MO-Data-Request command message for the T6a/b, T6ai/bi, and T7 interfaces consists of a Diameter Header with Command Code set to 8388733, a Session-Id, User-Identifier, Bearer-Identifier, Auth-Session-State, Origin-Host, and Origin-Realm. Additionally, it can include DRMP, Destination-Host, Destination-Realm, OC-Supported-Features, Supported-Features, Non-IP-Data, Proxy-Info, Route-Record, RRC-Cause-Counter, and AVP fields.

q_26679.question: What feature is used to reduce the need for DECOR reroute by using an indication sent from the UE to select the correct DCN?
q_26679.ground_truth: UE assisted Dedicated Core Network selection

q_26680.question: What should the MS do upon reception of a paging indication?
q_26680.ground_truth: The MS can initiate a paging response or a routing area update procedure, depending on the current GMM procedure.

q_26681.question: What should be the highest value of Authorized IP QoS Parameters if there are forked responses with different QoS requirements for the same media component?
q_26681.ground_truth: The highest value of Authorized IP QoS Parameters should be set to the highest value requested for the IP flow(s) of that media component by any of the active forked responses.

q_26682.question: What is the result of using the "+CMOLRE" with a value of "3" in the context of an MT and its positioning sessions?
q_26682.ground_truth: The error code "3 UE busy" in the context of an MT and its positioning sessions indicates that there is already one ongoing positioning session and the UE does not support multiple simultaneous sessions.

q_26683.question: What is the role of P-CSCF when an "anonymous user" emergency session is established?
q_26683.ground_truth: P-CSCF accepts the emergency session request and forwards it to an appropriate E-CSCF without establishing a security association between the UE and P-CSCF.

q_26684.question: What is the formula for the measurement period for PRS RSTD measurement in positioning frequency layer i as specified in clause 5.6A.4.5?
q_26684.ground_truth: The measurement period for PRS RSTD measurement in positioning frequency layer i is calculated as N1/2, where N1 is the total number of subframes or slots or subslots in the measurement period.

q_26685.question: What is the test purpose in 6.2E.1.1.1 and 6.2E.1.3.1.1?
q_26685.ground_truth: Both test purposes are to verify that the UE's transmit power doesn't exceed the range prescribed by the specified power value.

q_26686.question: What value is taken as the input for calculating the GFBR of a QoS Flow, when there are multiple PCC rules with the same sharing indication for a direction and bound to the same QoS Flow?
q_26686.ground_truth: The SMF shall take the highest GBR value from each set of PCC rules related with the same sharing indication for this direction and bound to the same QoS Flow and uses that value as input for calculating the GFBR of the QoS Flow.

q_26687.question: What is the role of the MDF2 present in the AMF in the 5GC network?
q_26687.ground_truth: The MDF2 present in the AMF receives the IRI messages from the IRI-POI and delivers the same to the LEMF over LI_HI2 as part of the Interception Product.

q_26688.question: What are the possible implementation scenarios for UE capable of multi-beam/chain simultaneous DL reception on a single component carrier?
q_26688.ground_truth: The possible implementation scenarios for UE capable of multi-beam/chain simultaneous DL reception on a single component carrier include single TCI reception on different beams, which can be achieved with either a single panel or multiple panels, and dual TCI operation combined with the Rel-17 mTRP framework deployed as a single TRP.

q_26689.question: What is the procedure for retrieving a PIN profile from a PIN server using the PIN profile recovery procedure?
q_26689.ground_truth: The procedure involves the PEMC sending a PIN Profile Query request to the PIN server, which then determines if the PEMC is authorized to perform the operation and respond with the PIN profile, which includes information such as the PIN name, PIN description, list of Device Info (PINE), PIN duration, and PEGC information.

q_26690.question: What should the MAC entity do when it receives a PDCCH while being in enhanced coverage or NB-IoT UE?
q_26690.ground_truth: The MAC entity executes the corresponding action specified in this clause in the subframe following the subframe containing the last repetition of the PDCCH reception.

q_26691.question: What action should the NRM server take if it receives an error code from the PCF upon attempting to delete an existing TSC stream in the "Individual TSC Stream" resource?
q_26691.ground_truth: The NRM server should take proper error handling action and respond to the VAL server with a proper error status code as an unsuccessful result.

q_26692.question: What is the maximum time alignment error (TAE) allowed for intra-band contiguous CA, with or without MIMO, in nanoseconds?

q_26693.question: Which step in the test procedure of 6.2.2.4.2 includes sending uplink power control "up" commands to the UE?
q_26693.ground_truth: Step 2 of the test procedure in 6.2.2.4.2 includes sending uplink power control "up" commands to the UE.

q_26694.question: What should the source eNB do if the Integrity Protection Indication IE in the Handover Request message is set to "not needed" for a specific E-RAB?
q_26694.ground_truth: The source eNB shall not perform user plane integrity protection for the concerned E-RAB.

q_26695.question: What is the maximum size of an MSGin5G message that the MSGin5G Client can send?
q_26695.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Client compares the size of the received message from the Application Client to the maximum allowed MSGin5G message segmentation size. If the size exceeds, the MSGin5G Client shall segment the MSGin5G message into a set of segmented MSGin5G messages such that each segmented MSGin5G message can fit within the maximum allowed MSGin5G message segmentation size.

q_26696.question: What is the main performance issue for a wide area Base Station's receiver?
q_26696.ground_truth: The main performance issue for a wide area Base Station's receiver is the large power in the TX sub-bands entering the receiver.

q_26697.question: How does a UE determine if the network supports simultaneous connectivity over multiple accesses for MAPCON?
q_26697.ground_truth: The UE determines that the network supports such simultaneous connectivity if it is provisioned with or has received per-APN inter-system routing policies from the home network.

q_26698.question: What is the exception to the ACLR requirement in case carrier leakage or I/Q image lands inside the gap spectrum?
q_26698.ground_truth: The exception is a 3dB relaxation in the ACLR requirement if carrier leakage or I/Q image lands inside the gap spectrum and the UL CCs are synchronized with frequencies in the gap.

q_26699.question: What is the least common multiple between and used to derive in the equation for the measurement gap repetition period in positioning frequency layer i?
q_26699.ground_truth: is the least common multiple between and used to derive in the equation for the measurement gap repetition period in positioning frequency layer i.

q_26700.question: What are the compatibility principles applied in the X2AP procedure text?
q_26700.ground_truth: The X2AP procedure text specifies the forwards and backwards compatibility of the protocol by including ID and criticality fields that are coded in a standard format, which can always be decoded regardless of the standard version.

q_26701.question: What should the network do when user plane CIoT EPS optimization is used and the RRC connection is resumed when in EMM-IDLE mode with suspend indication?
q_26701.ground_truth: The network should enter EMM-CONNECTED mode upon resuming the RRC connection.

q_26702.question: Which parameter in the uplink power control window calculation includes the test system relative power measurement uncertainty?
q_26702.ground_truth: UE power step tolerance + Test system relative power measurement uncertainty

q_26703.question: What is the emerg-reg timer and when is it started?
q_26703.ground_truth: The emerg-reg timer is a timer that the UE may start when it decides that an emergency call is to be established via the IM CN subsystem. The UE starts the emerg-reg timer when it decides that an emergency call is to be established via the IM CN subsystem and stops it when it determines that an initial emergency registration is not required or upon receipt of any final SIP response during the initial emergency registration.

q_26704.question: What is the function of the HPLMN when a non-roaming PDU session is established in the 5GC?
q_26704.ground_truth: The 5GC functions related to non-roaming PDU sessions are located in the HPLMN.

q_26705.question: What must the terminating participating MCData function include in the outgoing SIP re-INVITE request, if the incoming SIP re-INVITE request contained a Resource-Priority header field?
q_26705.ground_truth: The terminating participating MCData function must include in the outgoing SIP re-INVITE request a Resource-Priority header field set to the value indicated in the Resource-Priority header field of the received SIP re-INVITE request.

q_26706.question: What is the required channel bandwidth to be tested for the RSRP FDD relative accuracy test?
q_26706.ground_truth: The required channel bandwidth to be tested for the RSRP FDD relative accuracy test is 10 MHz.

q_26707.question: What is the action taken by the floor control arbitration logic when it receives a Floor Request message with overriding pre-emptive floor priority in the 'Start-stop' state?
q_26707.ground_truth: The floor control arbitration logic creates one instance of the 'dual floor control operation' state machine, stores the SSRC of the floor participant, stores the received Track Info field if included, and enters the state 'D: Floor Taken'.

q_26708.question: What is the RSRP measurement accuracy for all measured cells as specified in sub-clauses 9.1.21.1 and 9.1.21.2?
q_26708.ground_truth: The RSRP measurement accuracy for all measured cells is as specified in the sub-clauses 9.1.21.1 and 9.1.21.2.

q_26709.question: What technology is used to enable communication with hosts/servers on the DN in an N6 deployment?
q_26709.ground_truth: The solution supports communication with hosts/servers on the DN, if needed, in both native N6 and N6 overlay deployments.

q_26710.question: How does MDA contribute to beam selection optimization in 5G networks?
q_26710.ground_truth: MDA can recommend means to prioritize and select beams during handover for a specific target cell by providing beam level Handover Optimization analysis. It considers information on the handover performance of different beam combinations between the source and target cell pairs and prioritizes successful beam handovers, enhancing handover success while reducing energy loss and improving network performance.

q_26711.question: What information does the RAN Usage data report message include when sent by the eNodeB to the MME during an inter-RAT handover?

q_26712.question: What type of area can be specified for entering a polygon area location criterion?
q_26712.ground_truth: A specific geographic area defined by a polygon.

q_26713.question: What happens if data or events transmission start after the immediate trigger "zero data transmission without reporting" has been met, and the NF (CTF) generates charging information related to the service delivered?
q_26713.ground_truth: A charging data message should be reported even if there is zero usage for the immediate triggers.

q_26714.question: What requirements apply for NR SL-U inter-band concurrent operation's NR sidelink operation in unlicensed band?
q_26714.ground_truth: The requirements specified in clause 6.3.4 shall apply for NR SL-U's NR Uu operation in licensed band and the requirements specified in clause 6.3E.4F.1 and 6.3E.4F.2 shall apply for NR SL-U's sidelink operation in unlicensed band.

q_26715.question: What does the <allow-presence-status> element indicate in the <anyExt> element of the <OnNetwork> element and what is its type?
q_26715.ground_truth: The <allow-presence-status> element indicates if the presence status can be shared and is of type Boolean.

q_26716.question: What action should be taken if the `<alert-ind>` element is set to "false" in the received SIP MESSAGE request and the MCPTT emergency alert state is set to "MEA 4: Emergency-alert-cancel-pending"?
q_26716.ground_truth: The MCPTT emergency alert state should be set to "MEA 1: no-alert" and the MCPTT emergency state should be cleared if it is not already cleared.

q_26717.question: Which parameter can be used to waive the carrier leakage measurement requirement in clause 6.4F.2.2 and 6.4F.2.3?
q_26717.ground_truth: If the parameter 3300 or 3301 is reported from UE via txDirectCurrentLocation IE, the carrier leakage measurement requirement in clause 6.4F.2.2 and 6.4F.2.3 can be waived.

q_26718.question: How is the "transit-ioi" header field parameter value used in the example given?
q_26718.ground_truth: In the example, the "transit-ioi" header field parameter value is used to identify the operator networks that a request or response transmitted through. It is an indexed value that is incremented each time a value is added, and "void" entries are taken into account when calculating the index.

q_26719.question: What is another specification document that is reused in the definition of the Mandatory Flags field?

q_26720.question: When does the MME initiate the setup of user plane radio bearer(s) after receiving a CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message in this specification?
q_26720.ground_truth: The MME may initiate the setup of user plane radio bearer(s) if downlink user data is pending to be delivered via the user plane after completing the EMM common procedures.

q_26721.question: What is the format of the Replacement field in the NAPTR record associated to the Country based Emergency Numbers FQDN?
q_26721.ground_truth: The Replacement field in the NAPTR record associated to the Country based Emergency Numbers FQDN takes the form of "<emergency-type>.<emergency-number>.sos.en.epc.mcc<MCC>...."

q_26722.question: In what situation should a MCPTT client display to a user an indication of the cancellation of an in-progress emergency state of a MCPTT group call?
q_26722.ground_truth: When the received SIP MESSAGE request contains an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body with the <emergency-ind> element set to a value of "false".

q_26723.question: What is the role of the SCG Failure Transfer procedure during analysis of PSCell change failures?
q_26723.ground_truth: The SCG Failure Transfer procedure is used to transfer the SCG Failure Information to the source SN if the MN or the last serving SN is not responsible for the SCG failure.

q_26724.question: Under what conditions can a UE initiate the connection procedure outlined in 5.3.7.2?
q_26724.ground_truth: A UE can initiate the connection procedure either when AS security has been activated or if the UE supports RRC connection re-establishment for Control Plane CIoT EPS/5GS optimisation and meets one of the specified conditions.

q_26725.question: What is the difference in the remote end point in the "M2" and "M1" interfaces in E-UTRAN?
q_26725.ground_truth: The "M2" interface is between MCE and eNB, while the "M1" interface is between MBMS GW and eNB.

q_26726.question: When is a UE not required to monitor PDCCH?
q_26726.ground_truth: A UE does not expect to monitor PDCCH when the UE performs RRM measurements over a bandwidth that is not within the active DL BWP for the UE.

q_26727.question: What is the purpose of the ProSe direct discovery service authorization from the ProSe Function of the HPLMN?
q_26727.ground_truth: The ProSe direct discovery service authorization from the ProSe Function of the HPLMN includes parameters related to ProSe UE-to-network relaying, group member discovery, and ProSe direct communication service authorization.

q_26728.question: What is the maximum allowed Tmargin for inter-frequency handover for a cell being identified or measured?
q_26728.ground_truth: The maximum allowed Tmargin for inter-frequency handover for a cell being identified or measured is 2 ms.

q_26729.question: How is a Class 2 EP considered in F1AP?
q_26729.ground_truth: A Class 2 EP is always considered successful in F1AP.

q_26730.question: What action does the TSN AF take when timer T150 expires in abnormal cases?
q_26730.ground_truth: The TSN AF shall retransmit the MANAGE USER PLANE NODE COMMAND message and reset and start timer T150. This retransmission is repeated four times before aborting the procedure.

q_26731.question: What action does the SMF take if two UEs are served by the same DNAI via GEO UPF?
q_26731.ground_truth: The SMF determines the traffic steering rules for the two UEs based on the target IP, and enables satellite edge computing or local data switching via on-board UPF acting as UL CL/BP and local PSA.

q_26732.question: What is the expected behavior of the UE when the integrity check fails while the UE is in E-UTRA RRC_CONNECTED state?
q_26732.ground_truth: When the integrity check fails while the UE is in E-UTRA RRC_CONNECTED state, the UE initiates the RRC connection re-establishment procedure.

q_26733.question: What should a UE do upon receiving 5GMM cause #79 over 3GPP access in single registration mode?
q_26733.ground_truth: The UE shall abort the initial registration procedure, set the 5GS update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED, enter state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION or 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH, reset the registration attempt counter, and not include the service-level device ID set to the CAA-level UAV ID in the Service-level-AA container IE of REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

q_26734.question: What is the role of the SCEF in obtaining location information of a group of UEs via PCRF?
q_26734.ground_truth: The SCEF can request the location information of a group of UEs via PCRF, and the PCRF reports it to the SCEF for applicable IP-CAN types and RAT types.

q_26735.question: What are the TLS protection protocol used in Service Based Interfaces (SBI)?
q_26735.ground_truth: The TLS protection protocol used in Service Based Interfaces (SBI) is mutually authenticated TLS and HTTPS. NFs shall support both server-side and client-side certificates with TLS client and server certificates compliant with the SBA certificate profile specified in clause 6.1.3c of TS 33.310. The TLS profile follows the profile given in clause 6.2 of TS 33.210 with the restriction that it shall be compliant with the profile given by HTTP/2 as defined in RFC 9113. TLS shall be used for transport protection within a PLMN unless network security is provided by other means.

q_26736.question: What is the minimum requirement for single RAT E-UTRA operation?
q_26736.ground_truth: There is no spectrum emission mask requirement for a single RAT E-UTRA AAS BS.

q_26737.question: What action can the AMF take if the UE reports an inaccurate location?
q_26737.ground_truth: The AMF can reject the UE Registration Request and provide a cause value to the UE and/or NG-RAN.

q_26738.question: What is the role of the floor control interface towards the MCPTT client in the controlling MCPTT function?
q_26738.ground_truth: The floor control interface towards the MCPTT client in the controlling MCPTT function is responsible for receiving and transmitting floor control messages from and to the MCPTT client via the participating MCPTT function or non-controlling MCPTT function.

q_26739.question: What is the minimum length of the "PEIPS assistance information" information element?
q_26739.ground_truth: The PEIPS assistance information information element has a minimum length of 3 octets.

q_26740.question: In which CSS set and when is the UE expected to receive the PDSCH that corresponds to the PDCCH that UE monitors for RMSI scheduling for multiplexing patterns 2?
q_26740.ground_truth: The UE is expected to receive PDSCH that corresponds to the PDCCH that UE monitors in the Type0-PDCCH CSS set, on SSB symbols to be measured for RLM, for the SSB for RLM and CORESET for RMSI scheduling multiplexing patterns 2.

q_26741.question: What steps should the H-SMF take when releasing resources in 3GPP access during the PDU Session Establishment procedure from 3GPP to untrusted non-3GPP access?
q_26741.ground_truth: The H-SMF should perform steps 3b, 4, 6, and 7a as specified in clause 4.3.4.2 to release the resources over the source 3GPP access, but not execute step 11 and send the N1 SM container.

q_26742.question: What is the significance of the K-ID in the MCX system architecture?
q_26742.ground_truth: The K-ID is a 32-bit key identifier that is unique within the MC domain. It is generated by an MCX entity when creating a key, and is used to index the key within the KMS, facilitate the sharing of the key between two MCX entities, and determine whether end-point diversity should be applied to the key.

q_26743.question: How many External Identifiers can be associated with one IMSI?
q_26743.ground_truth: One IMSI can have one or several External Identifiers, with at least one designated as the default External Identifier and one or more additional External Identifiers.

q_26744.question: What is the purpose of the "CRITICALITY" field in the "protocolIE" sequence of the mentioned messages?
q_26744.ground_truth: The "CRITICALITY" field in the "protocolIE" sequence indicates the criticality of the information contained in the message. It can have one of three values: "ignore", "ignore" with a "protocol level criticality" of "negociated", or "reject". The "ignore" value indicates that the information is not critical, but is included for additional information or future use. The "ignore" value with a "protocol level criticality" of "negociated" indicates that the information is not critical, but is included for additional information and that the receiver should treat it as critical if prescribed in the negotiated protocol. The "reject" value indicates that the absence or occurrence of the information is critical, and if this is not satisfied, the receiver should reject the message.

q_26745.question: What should the floor control server interface do when receiving a Floor Deny message sent from the controlling MCPTT function?
q_26745.ground_truth: It should forward the Floor Deny message to the identified floor participant interface and remove the floor request from the passive floor request queue if needed.

q_26746.question: What should be the value of the first bit within Octet 7 if the report types indicated by octet 7 are specific to a Standards Development Organization or an enterprise identified by the Enterprise ID?
q_26746.ground_truth: At least one bit shall be set to "1".

q_26747.question: What HTTP status code is returned if the EES authorizes the delete request?
q_26747.ground_truth: The EES responds with an HTTP "204 No Content" status code upon success.

q_26748.question: What is the purpose of the test described in section 7.6A.4.2.4?
q_26748.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify a receiver's ability to receive an NR signal at its assigned CA channel frequencies in the presence of an unwanted narrow band CW interferer at a frequency, which is less than the nominal channel spacing.

q_26749.question: How should server-initiated communication be described in OpenAPI specification files?
q_26749.ground_truth: Server-initiated communication, such as notifications, should be described as "callbacks" in OpenAPI specification files.

q_26750.question: In case spatial HARQ-ACK bundling is not applied, what does K represent in the number of transport blocks received or the SPS release PDCCH/EPDCCH received in subframe(s) in serving cell, where K is the number of elements in set M?
q_26750.ground_truth: K represents the number of transport blocks or SPS release PDCCH/EPDCCH received in subframe(s) in serving cell.

q_26751.question: In what circumstances can a UE initiate the MBS Interest Indication procedure?
q_26751.ground_truth: A UE can initiate the MBS Interest Indication procedure in several cases, including upon successful connection establishment/resume, entering or leaving the broadcast service area, MBS broadcast session start or stop, change of interest or priority, changing to a PCell providing SIB21 or nonServingCellMII in SIB1, receiving SIB20 of an SCell via dedicated signalling, handover, RRC connection re-establishment, changing to a PCell providing nonServingCellMII in SIB1, starting or stopping reception of MBS broadcast service on a non-serving cell, and change of CFR information or subcarrier spacing for MBS broadcast reception on a non-serving cell.

q_26752.question: What should the P-CSCF do when it detects that signalling bearer is no longer available?
q_26752.ground_truth: If the P-CSCF receives an indication that the signalling bearer is no longer available, it shall send out a CANCEL request to cancel the dialog and include a Reason header field containing a 503 (Service Unavailable) status code.

q_26753.question: What does each message indicating a failed external parameter deletion increments in the relevant subcounter per failure cause by 1 in the NEF?
q_26753.ground_truth: The subcounter per failure cause of the number of failed external parameter deletions in the NEF.

q_26754.question: What action will the P-CSCF take if the SDP offer contains a "RTP/AVPF" transport offering a "UDP/TLS/RTP/SAVP" or "UDP/TLS/RTP/SAVPF" transport protocol?
q_26754.ground_truth: If the SDP offer contains an end-to-end security mechanism for RTP media using DTLS-SRTP and certificate fingerprints, the P-CSCF will invoke IMS-ALG procedures, act as defined in the specification, and handle SDP and RTP accordingly.

q_26755.question: What is the format of the ggsn parameter and dslcid parameter?
q_26755.ground_truth: The ggsn parameter and dslcid parameter are transferred from the GGSN and the BRAS respectively, to the P-CSCF via the Rx and Gx interfaces. They are transferred in binary format, and on receipt of this header field, a node receiving a ggsn or dslcid shall decode from hexadecimal into binary format.

q_26756.question: What should an EMM-REGISTERED UE do when the periodic TAU update timer T3412 expires as per TS 23.401, clause 4.3.5.2?
q_26756.ground_truth: An EMM-REGISTERED UE should start the TAU procedure and send a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message with the EPS update type as 'Periodic updating' when the TAU update timer expires.

q_26757.question: What is the condition for success in Test 1 and Test 3 for UE supporting other power class?
q_26757.ground_truth: The overall delay measured from the beginning of time period T2 should be less than 7682 ms.

q_26758.question: What message is sent from the floor participant to the floor control server to control reception of unicast media flow of the designated communication?
q_26758.ground_truth: The Unicast Media Flow Control message

q_26759.question: What is required for any endpoint to use or access end-to-end secure communications in MCPTT networks?
q_26759.ground_truth: It needs to be provisioned with keying material associated with its identity by the KMS

q_26760.question: What is the name of the measurement that provides the mean number of QoS flows of UPF, and is expressed as a single integer value?
q_26760.ground_truth: This measurement is called "Mean number of QoS flows".

q_26761.question: What is one security requirement for mitigating the risk of container breakout?
q_26761.ground_truth: The virtualization platform should provide capabilities to limit the impact on co-hosted containers caused by a rogue container escaping its isolation.

q_26762.question: What should be the response of the UE when it receives an AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message with SQN out of range?
q_26762.ground_truth: The UE should send an AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message to the network, with EMM cause "synch failure" and a re-synchronization token.

q_26763.question: What HTTP method is used for Data Change Notifications in the described mechanism?
q_26763.ground_truth: The POST method is used for Data Change Notifications.

q_26764.question: How are the HTTP communications between the MCData message store function and MCData notification server authenticated/authorized?
q_26764.ground_truth: The HTTP communications between the MCData message store function and MCData notification server are authenticated/authorized as per the security mechanisms described in 3GPP TS 33.180.

q_26765.question: What is the use of an alternative S-NSSAI in Solution #5?
q_26765.ground_truth: An alternative S-NSSAI is used in Solution #5 as another S-NSSAI from the network slice selection criteria within the URSP rules in the UE, which is included by the UE in the PDU Session Establishment Request and is stored in the UE context within the AMF for PDU Session handover to this alternative S-NSSAI if the current S-NSSAI is not supported or overloaded in the target CN.

q_26766.question: When does the NG-RAN prefer to use specific radio resources for data radio bearer(s) in 5G system?
q_26766.ground_truth: The NG-RAN may prefer to use specific radio resources per data radio bearer(s), e.g. depending on the Network Slices associated to the data radio bearer used by the UE, when UP resources are activated for the UE in the network.

q_26767.question: Which ITU-T draft Recommendation studies influencing factors on quality of experience (QoE) for virtual reality services?
q_26767.ground_truth: Draft ITU-T G.QoE-VR provides a study on influencing factors on quality of experience (QoE) for virtual reality services.

q_26768.question: What is the purpose of verifying the integrity of an access token in the context of network service authorization?
q_26768.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure that the access token has not been tampered with during transmission and that it is genuinely issued by a trusted authority.

q_26769.question: What information is provided by UPF for the MP-DCCP-LL functionality?
q_26769.ground_truth: UPF provides two "UE link-specific MP-DCCP-LL" IP addresses, "MP-DCCP Address Information" which contains the "UPF link-specific MP-DCCP-LL" IP address for the UPF, and one UPF port number per MP-DCCP connection.

q_26770.question: What should the SS look for in subframes (m+5), (m+9), and (m+13) and (m+18) up to the end of T2 for intra-band CA UE in step 8a?

q_26771.question: What actions should the UE take if it receives a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST with certain cause values and the de-registration type indicates "re-registration not required"?
q_26771.ground_truth: The UE shall delete the TAI list, last visited registered TAI, list of equivalent PLMNs or SNPNs, set the 5GS update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED, start timer T3502, and delete 5G-GUTI and ngKSI if it is not registering or has not registered to the same PLMN over both 3GPP access and non-3GPP access.

q_26772.question: What should the Controlling MCPTT function do if the in-progress emergency state of the group is set to "false" and the SIP INVITE request contains an imminent peril indication with a value of "true"?
q_26772.ground_truth: The Controlling MCPTT function should validate that the SIP INVITE request includes a Resource-Priority header field populated with the values for an MCPTT imminent peril group call and if not, perform certain actions such as sending a SIP UPDATE request generated in clause~6.3.3.1.8 towards the initiator of the SIP INVITE request.

q_26773.question: What should the ADRF include in the Location HTTP header field when responding with "201 Created" after successfully processing an HTTP POST request?
q_26773.ground_truth: The ADRF should include the URI of the created record in the Location HTTP header field.

q_26774.question: What action does the PCF take if non-matching traffic is detected?
q_26774.ground_truth: The PCF determines if the traffic should be blocked or if new URSP rules should be installed for routing traffic via a different S-NSSAI.

q_26775.question: What is the purpose of storing collected data and analytics in the Analytics Data and ML Model Repository (ADRF) as specified in clause 6.2B.1?
q_26775.ground_truth: The data and analytics may be stored in the ADRF for future use or analysis, or they may be deleted when they are no longer needed.

q_26776.question: When is the UE that supports simultaneousRxDataSSB-DiffNumerology able to perform CSI-RS measurement without restrictions for FR1 in active BWP with different SCS than the CSI-RS for L1-RSRP measurement?
q_26776.ground_truth: The UE is able to perform CSI-RS measurement without restrictions in this case.

q_26777.question: What should the SeNB do if it receives an SENB MODIFICATION REQUEST message containing a E-RAB Level QoS Parameters IE which contains a QCI IE indicating a GBR bearer but does not contain the GBR QoS Information IE?
q_26777.ground_truth: The SeNB should not admit the corresponding E-RAB.

q_26778.question: What action does the SGW take when it receives a Change Notification Request with an unknown IMSI/IMEI?
q_26778.ground_truth: The SGW may silently discard the Change Notification Request message and the MME/SGSN may initiate PDN disconnection for all of these PDN Connections.

q_26779.question: What is the purpose of the EDGE-9 reference point between the Edge Enabler Servers (EES)?
q_26779.ground_truth: The EDGE-9 reference point enables interactions between the EES, supporting discovery of T-EAS information to support Application Context Relocation (ACR), EEC context relocation procedures, and transparent transfer of the application context during Edge Enabler layer Managed ACR.

q_26780.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for E-UTRAN RSRQ absolute accuracy for 2Rx RedCap UE in section 16.7.6.0.1?
q_26780.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirement for E-UTRAN RSRQ absolute accuracy for 2Rx RedCap UE in section 16.7.6.0.1 is given in clause 6.7.6.0.1 of the reference document.

q_26781.question: What requirements must the L1-RSRP reports from the UE meet for the test to pass in terms of successful reported values ratio and confidence level?
q_26781.ground_truth: At least 90% for each requirement (R1 to R4) with a confidence level of 95%.

q_26782.question: What does the V field indicate in the Enhanced Multiple Entry PHR MAC CE?
q_26782.ground_truth: The V field indicates if the PH value is based on a real transmission or a reference format. For Type 1 PH, the V field set to 0 indicates real transmission on PUSCH and the V field set to 1 indicates that a PUSCH reference format is used.

q_26783.question: What is the functional role of the Content Provider as defined in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_26783.ground_truth: The functional role of the Content Provider, as defined in the 3GPP technical specification, is to provide media, service descriptions, and control data to the BM-SC to set up and manage MBMS User Service(s).

q_26784.question: What should the UE do if it does not receive a random access response after sending the first 4 preambles in Test 2?
q_26784.ground_truth: The UE shall consider the random access response reception not successful then re-select a preamble and transmit with the calculated PRACH transmission power when the backoff time expires if no random access response is received within the RA Response window of 10 sub-frames.

q_26785.question: How is TLS used to secure communication in the CAPIF architecture?
q_26785.ground_truth: TLS is used to provide integrity protection, replay protection, and confidentiality protection in the CAPIF architecture. It is mandatory for CAPIF-1e and CAPIF-1 reference points but optional for other interfaces based on the domain administrator's policy.

q_26786.question: What should the UE do when it receives the Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming" or "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service" IE in an ATTACH REJECT message?
q_26786.ground_truth: The UE stores the TAI(s) for the current PLMN in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming" or "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service" and ignores the TAI(s) that do not belong to the serving PLMN. If a certain EMM cause value is received in the ATTACH REJECT message, the UE takes additional actions such as setting the EPS update status to EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED and deleting certain information.

q_26787.question: What is the role of the management service discovery (MnS) in an operator's management system?
q_26787.ground_truth: The MnS discovery service enables MnS consumer to discover management capabilities of MnS producer(s), making MnS instances discoverable to the operator's management system when they become operative.

q_26788.question: What is the communication method between two UEs that allows them to have a line-of-sight (LOS) communication?
q_26788.ground_truth: LOS communication between two UEs is a characteristic of electromagnetic radiation or acoustic wave propagation which means the waves are not diffracted, refracted, reflected, or absorbed by the atmosphere and obstructions with material.

q_26789.question: In the context of case m2), what should the AMF set the Payload container IE to?
q_26789.ground_truth: The AMF should set the Payload container IE to the UPP-CMI container received from the LMF in the context of case m2).

q_26790.question: What measures does the UPF take when multiple SEIDs in the CP F-SEID are not unique within the SMF set?
q_26790.ground_truth: The UPF does not (need to) know whether the SEID in the CP F-SEID is uniquely assigned in the SMF set or not. However, the assigned CP F-SEID shall be unique within the SMF set.

q_26791.question: What is the role of the AMF during the Registration procedure in terms of non-3GPP access?
q_26791.ground_truth: The AMF updates the UDM registration for non-3GPP access after the user-plane resources over the new non-3GPP access are established and indicates to the SMF that the AMF and the UE support non-3GPP path switch during the MA PDU Session Establishment.

q_26792.question: What is the vendor identifier assigned by IANA to 3GPP in the context of Diameter applications?
q_26792.ground_truth: The vendor identifier assigned by IANA to 3GPP in the context of Diameter applications is 10415.

q_26793.question: When is a UE required to send an empty report in logged MDT procedures?
q_26793.ground_truth: A UE is required to send an empty report in logged MDT procedures when retrieval is attempted and the RPLMN is not in the MDT PLMN list.

q_26794.question: What is the function of the RRC Transfer procedure in the 3GPP 5G system?
q_26794.ground_truth: The RRC Transfer procedure is used to deliver an RRC message, encapsulated in a PDCP PDU between the MN and the SN, so that it may be forwarded to/from the UE using split SRB.

q_26795.question: What is the test applicability requirement for the E-UTRAN FDD - FDD Intra-band Inter-frequency async DAPS handover test?
q_26795.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA FDD UE release 16 and forward. Applicability requires support for Inter-frequency async DAPS handover and FGI bits 5, 13 and 25.

q_26796.question: What should the floor control arbitration logic in the IWF floor control server do when a new MCPTT call is initiated and a confirmed indication is required, at least one invited media endpoint has accepted the invitation and the initialised MCPTT call is not a temporary group session?
q_26796.ground_truth: The floor control arbitration logic in the IWF floor control server should create an instance of the 'general floor control operation' state machine and wait for the 'basic floor control operation towards the floor participant' to be initialized before continuing the following steps.

q_26797.question: What must both the UE and MME continue to use for communication, until the MME initiates a security mode control procedure?

q_26798.question: What should the MBMS GW do when it receives an MBMS Session Update from the BM-SC during an Sm path failure modifying the MBMS Service Area?
q_26798.ground_truth: The MBMS GW will encode the original MBMS Service Area in the MBMS Session Start Request sent to the alternative MME and subsequently send an MBMS Session Update Request with the modified MBMS Service Area to the new MME controlling the MBMS session.

q_26799.question: What must the UE do to keep the uplink time alignment during time duration T1?
q_26799.ground_truth: The UE must be provided with a new Timing Advance Command MAC control element at least once every 500ms to restart the Time Alignment Timer.

q_26800.question: What is the first action the controlling MCPTT function should take upon receiving a SIP INVITE request for controlling MCPTT function of a private call, if the session-type is set to "private"?
q_26800.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function should check whether the public service identity contained in the Request-URI is allocated for private call and perform the actions specified in clause~6.3.7.1 if it is not allocated.

q_26801.question: What is the name of the data type "EntryType" which contains a sequence of uri-entry, display-name, and anyExt, with the attribute "entry-info" of type "EntryInfoTypeList"?
q_26801.ground_truth: The data type is "EntryType" with an attribute of type "EntryInfoTypeList".

q_26802.question: What happens if the SMF sends an N4 Session Modification Request to UPF (PSA) with different CN Tunnel Info?
q_26802.ground_truth: If the SMF selects a new UPF to act as intermediate UPF for the PDU Session and the different CN Tunnel Info need be used, the SMF sends N4 Session Modification Request message to UPF (PSA).

q_26803.question: What is the definition of intermodulation response rejection as a directional requirement at the RIB, as specified in clause 7.8.1?
q_26803.ground_truth: Intermodulation response rejection is a measure of the capability of the receiver unit to receive a wanted signal on its assigned channel frequency in the presence of two interfering signals which have a specific frequency relationship to the wanted signal.

q_26804.question: What must the participating MCData function include in a SIP MESSAGE request, when cancelling an MBMS bearer announcement associated with an <announcement> element?
q_26804.ground_truth: The participating MCData function must include the same TMGI value as in the <announcement> element to be cancelled in the <TMGI> element, and must not include an <mbms-service-areas> element.

q_26805.question: What are the required factors for CHF selection by the NF consumer or in the SCP?
q_26805.ground_truth: The required factors are CHF Group ID of the UE's SUPI or SUPI, or both.

q_26806.question: How does the AS layer determine the mapping of multiple PC5 QoS Flows to the same radio bearer?
q_26806.ground_truth: The AS layer determines the mapping based on the information provided by the destination Layer-2 ID and the PC5 QoS Flows.

q_26807.question: What are the two ways for a UE-A to indicate resources in coordination information?
q_26807.ground_truth: UE-A can indicate resources preferred to be included in unicast and resources preferred to be excluded in unicast, groupcast, or broadcast.

q_26808.question: What should the UE do when the received measObject includes the cellsToRemoveList in the 5.5.2.5 procedure?
q_26808.ground_truth: The UE should remove the entry with the matching physCellId from the cellsToAddModList for each physCellId included in the cellsToRemoveList.

q_26809.question: What should the MS do if it holds a valid GUTI and enters state GMM-REGISTERED.SUSPENDED?
q_26809.ground_truth: The MS should not stop timers T3312 and T3323 when entering state GMM-REGISTERED.SUSPENDED.

q_26810.question: What is the action taken by the UP function when the EDBN bit is set to "1"?
q_26810.ground_truth: When the EDBN bit is set to "1", the UP function sends DL packet notifications to report the arrival of the first buffered DL packet for each QoS flow for a given FAR to the CP function for the duration indicated by the DL Buffering Duration.

q_26811.question: What is the role of the MC gateway UE in mission critical communications?
q_26811.ground_truth: The MC gateway UE provides service access with the MC service system for multiple MC service clients and enables MC service access for MC service clients operating on devices that have no MC service capabilities.

q_26812.question: What should be done if any of the received VAL group IDs is a temporary group when creating a group in the SGM-S?
q_26812.ground_truth: The SGM-S shall not create the group and respond with a CoAP 4.03 (Forbidden) response to the CoAP POST request.

q_26813.question: What is the role of an assistant UE in the Ranging/Sidelink positioning procedure?
q_26813.ground_truth: An assistant UE provides assistance in the Ranging/Sidelink positioning procedure by acting as a relay or a reference point, but may not obtain the final ranging result between UE1 and UE2.

q_26814.question: What is the 5G DDNMF of the UE-to-UE Relay supposed to check when authorizing a Monitor Request from the 5G DDNMF of the Source UE/Target UE?
q_26814.ground_truth: The 5G DDNMF of the UE-to-UE Relay is supposed to check whether the Source UE/Target UE and the UE-to-UE Relay are authorized to perform the U2U discovery under the specific U2U relay service.

q_26815.question: What is the condition for the UE to detect no uplink signal?
q_26815.ground_truth: UE output power equal to or less than Transmit OFF power -48.5 dBm.

q_26816.question: What is the purpose of Burst Arrival Time in the context of Key Issue 6 solutions?
q_26816.ground_truth: The purpose of Burst Arrival Time (BAT) is to enable low latency communication in 5G by giving the AF the ability to conform to the latency requirements.

q_26817.question: What are the potential types of measurements for direct AI/ML positioning, considering performance impact and associated signalling overhead?
q_26817.ground_truth: The potential types of measurements are: Potential new measurement: CIR/PDP, Existing measurement: e.g., RSRP/RSRPP/RSTD, and Note: Details of potential new measurement and/or potential enhancement to existing measurement is to be studied.

q_26818.question: When are radiated performance requirements for IAB-DU not specified for a IAB-DU supporting CA?
q_26818.ground_truth: Radiated performance requirements for a IAB-DU supporting CA are defined in terms of single carrier requirements.

q_26819.question: What test parameter in 7.9.4.2 is different for IAB type 1-O and IAB type 2-O in terms of the receiver target reference direction?
q_26819.ground_truth: The receiver target reference direction (D.31) is used for IAB type 1-O, while OTA REFSENS receiver target reference direction (D.54) is used for IAB type 2-O.

q_26820.question: When does the drx-RetransmissionTimer start for a corresponding HARQ process?
q_26820.ground_truth: When a HARQ RTT Timer expires in this subframe and the data in the soft buffer of the corresponding HARQ process was not successfully decoded.

q_26821.question: What is the role of the WT Release procedure in the Change of WT procedure?
q_26821.ground_truth: The WT Release procedure is used to initiate the release of the UE context at the WT in the Change of WT procedure.

q_26822.question: What action is taken by the UP function when the counted usage exceeds the quota in a URR with at least one Aggregated URRs IE included?
q_26822.ground_truth: The UP function shall stop packets forwarding for all Aggregated URRs when the counted usage exceeds the quota.

q_26823.question: What action does the UE take if it is in EMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE or EMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH state and the TAI of the current cell belongs to the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming"?
q_26823.ground_truth: If the UE is in EMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE or EMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH state and the TAI of the current cell belongs to the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming", it should not attempt to attach to that cell. However, the UE should attempt to attach if it enters a cell belonging to a tracking area not in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming".

q_26824.question: What does the "ROHC Parameters" IE carry?
q_26824.ground_truth: The ROCH parameters for header compressions.

q_26825.question: What message does the MAG function of the Trusted Non-3GPP IP Access or ePDG send to the Serving GW to initiate a handover of PDN connections to non-3GPP access?
q_26825.ground_truth: A Proxy Binding Update (MN-NAI, Lifetime, Access Technology Type, Handover Indicator, APN, GRE key for downlink traffic, PDN GW address, Additional Parameters) message.

q_26826.question: What is required for service continuity in a 5G system?
q_26826.ground_truth: The system should minimize service disruption when changing the communication path from one PIN element to another, including licensed and unlicensed spectrum as well as 3GPP and non-3GPP access.

q_26827.question: What is the target confidence level that the total number of successful tests must be more than in the test to pass?

q_26828.question: When is a UE allowed to initiate a PDU session establishment procedure?
q_26828.ground_truth: The UE is allowed to initiate a PDU session establishment procedure if the procedure is for emergency services and the back-off timer is running or the timer is deactivated.

q_26829.question: What should the SCEF do if the authorization is implicitly revoked at a given time and a new NIDD Authorization request is needed?
q_26829.ground_truth: The SCEF shall consider the authorization being implicitly revoked at the indicated time, and may issue a new NIDD Authorization request towards the HSS.

q_26830.question: What is the maximum range of values for the /<x>/<x>/OffNetwork/MaxTransmitMembers element, as defined in section 6.2.23AL?
q_26830.ground_truth: The maximum range of values for the /<x>/<x>/OffNetwork/MaxTransmitMembers element is 0-65535.

q_26831.question: What is the minimum percentage of successful channelOccupancy reports required for the FS3 channel occupancy test to pass, with a confidence level of 95%?
q_26831.ground_truth: The minimum percentage of successful channelOccupancy reports required for the FS3 channel occupancy test to pass, with a confidence level of 95%, is more than 90%.

q_26832.question: What information should be included in the drx-Preference in the UEAssistanceInformation message?
q_26832.ground_truth: If the UE has a preference on DRX parameters for the cell group, the preferredDRX-LongCycle, preferredDRX-InactivityTimer, preferredDRX-ShortCycle or preferredDRX-ShortCycleTimer should be included in the DRX-PreferenceIE with the preferred value.

q_26833.question: How long is the Logged MBSFN MDT trace session preserved in the UE?
q_26833.ground_truth: The Logged MBSFN MDT trace session is preserved in the UE until the duration time of the trace session expires, including also multiple idle periods interrupted by idle-connected-idle state transitions.

q_26834.question: What task does the 5G PKMF of the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay perform after receiving the Key Request message for a relay service authorization check?
q_26834.ground_truth: The 5G PKMF of the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay checks if the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay is authorized to provide the relay service to the 5G ProSe Remote UE based on the received RSC and the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay's identity associated with the key used to establish the secure PC8 connection.

q_26835.question: What must the USAT application do when the UICC/ME interface transport level is present in a command?
q_26835.ground_truth: The USAT application must provide the requested transport layer protocols under the channel and use the object containing a set of parameters required to make the transport connection.

q_26836.question: What is the definition of Adjacent Channel Leakage power Ratio (ACLR) in the context of NR transmitter testing?
q_26836.ground_truth: ACLR is the ratio of the filtered mean power centred on the assigned channel frequency to the filtered mean power centred on an adjacent channel frequency.

q_26837.question: What is the purpose of the Comprehension Required mechanism in GTPv2?
q_26837.ground_truth: The Comprehension Required mechanism in GTPv2 allows a sender to force the receiver to support comprehension of specific IEs (Information Elements) as a precondition to process a backward incompatible message.

q_26838.question: What is the role of BGCF in the origination procedures for a session?
q_26838.ground_truth: BGCF determines the appropriate path for the interworking of the PSTN with IMS, either in the same or a different network. It selects a MGCF in the interworking network and forwards the request to it.
