q_26839.question: Which HTTP method is used for deregistration notifications, and what URI format is used in this method as provided during the registration procedure?
q_26839.ground_truth: The POST method is used for deregistration notifications, and the URI is defined as "<callbackReference>" as provided during the registration procedure.

q_26840.question: When should the target end UE layer-2 ID set to the layer-2 ID of the target 5G ProSe end UE be included in the PROSE DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION REQUEST message?
q_26840.ground_truth: This should be included if the UE acts as a source 5G ProSe end UE and the 5G ProSe direct link is between the source 5G ProSe end UE and the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE.

q_26841.question: What must the participating MCData function include in an SIP MESSAGE request towards the MCData client, if the MBMS bearer is carrying the general purpose MBMS subchannel?
q_26841.ground_truth: The participating MCData function must include one <GPMS> element, giving the number of the "m=application" media line in the application/sdp MIME body to be used for the general purpose MBMS subchannel.

q_26842.question: What is used as the Source or Destination Layer-2 ID for one-to-one communications in ProSe sidelink communication?
q_26842.ground_truth: The ProSe UE ID provided by higher layer is used directly as the Source Layer-2 ID or the Destination Layer-2 ID in the MAC layer.

q_26843.question: What message types may be included in the first message received for a specific TNL association, if it is not an X2 SETUP REQUEST, X2 SETUP RESPONSE, or X2 SETUP FAILURE message?
q_26843.ground_truth: Any other ongoing procedure (except another Reset procedure) on the same X2 interface.

q_26844.question: What is the relationship between the Slot Number variable and the SpatialDirectionInformation variable in NR?
q_26844.ground_truth: The Slot Number variable represents the number of the slot within the radio frame for the NR network, while the SpatialDirectionInformation variable represents the spatial direction information of a beam in the NR network. The Slot Number variable is an integer that ranges from 0 to 79, while the SpatialDirectionInformation variable is a sequence that contains information about the NR-PCI and the Scrambling Sequence.

q_26845.question: What is the purpose of the UE providing reason for registration to S-NSSAI in Solution #36 and what are the three possible reasons for registration explained in the solution?
q_26845.ground_truth: The purpose of the UE providing reason for registration to S-NSSAI in Solution #36 is to assist the network in assuring proper utilization of the network slices. The three possible reasons for registration include: "immediate use", "default applications", and "proactive registration". "Immediate use" denotes the UE needs the slice registration for immediate usage, "default applications" refers to S-NSSAIs correlated with default applications (e.g. IMS voice for a voice-centric UE), and "proactive registration" indicates the UE wants to register to an S-NSSAI in advance for future usage.

q_26846.question: What is the function of the PCF in the 5G System?
q_26846.ground_truth: The PCF (Policy Control Function) is responsible for authorizing requests and creating PCC (Packet Caching Context) rules in the 5G System.

q_26847.question: What are the actions taken by the CAPIF core function when the onboarding request is successfully validated?
q_26847.ground_truth: When the onboarding request is successfully validated, the CAPIF core function creates an API invoker Profile, a new resource as defined in clause~8.4.3, and sends the API invoker Profile, API List of APIs the API invoker is allowed to access and the CAPIF Resource URI in the response message to the API invoker.

q_26848.question: Who provides the SVSP to the UE in 5G network?
q_26848.ground_truth: The Home PLMN (HPLMN) may provide the SVSP to the UE in 5G network to indicate in which condition the UE is allowed to trigger VPLMN selection to find a network that supports slices the UE wants to use.

q_26849.question: What must the destination ID in the corresponding SL control information match in order to transmit a groupcast or broadcast PSCCH/PSSCH transmission sharing the initiated channel occupancy?
q_26849.ground_truth: The destination ID in the corresponding SL control information must match the destination ID in the groupcast or broadcast PSCCH/PSSCH transmission carrying the channel occupancy sharing information or match an additional destination ID and associated cast type if provided by the channel occupancy sharing information and the corresponding COT sharing cast type indicates '00' or '01' value for groupcast or broadcast cast type, respectively.

q_26850.question: What happens when the SCS/AS sends a Group Message Request using xMB to the SCEF with a ServiceId through application level interaction?
q_26850.ground_truth: When the SCS/AS sends a Group Message Request using xMB to the SCEF with a ServiceId through application level interaction, the application in the UE can activate reception using MBMS APIs.

q_26851.question: What is a Name space in the context of the present document?
q_26851.ground_truth: A name space is a collection of names with a hierarchical containment structure, including its simplest form - the one-level, flat name space. In the context of the present document, all Managed Objects in a MIB are included in the corresponding name space and the MIB/name space shall only support a strict hierarchical containment structure with one root object.

q_26852.question: What type of E-UTRA TDD UE does the 9.2.33.2 test apply to?
q_26852.ground_truth: All types of E-UTRA TDD UE release 12 and forward

q_26853.question: What is the role of STI-AS in the process where originating IMS network invokes the signing on behalf of 3rd party?
q_26853.ground_truth: STI-AS signs the SIP identity header based on the STIR/SHAKEN framework and draft-ietf-stir-passport-rcd-18 in the process where originating IMS network invokes the signing on behalf of 3rd party.

q_26854.question: What triggers the SL Positioning service in the PC5 connection procedure?
q_26854.ground_truth: The SL Positioning service is triggered when the SL Positioning Client UE tries to discover the target UE and/or one or more SL Reference UE(s)/Located UE(s) during the discovery procedure.

q_26855.question: What is the requirement for the PDSCH BLER in high power subframes using the transport format indicated by the wideband CQI median if it is less than or equal to 0.1?
q_26855.ground_truth: If the PDSCH BLER in the high power subframes using the transport format indicated by the wideband CQI median is less than or equal to 0.1, the BLER in high power subframes using the transport format indicated by (wideband CQI median + 1) shall be greater than 0.1.

q_26856.question: What is a potential benefit of using multiple machine learning models in Key Issue #10?
q_26856.ground_truth: Potential benefits include enabling the selection of an ML model based on specific context, such as UE location or time of day, leading to improved analytics correctness for a given Analytics ID.

q_26857.question: What is the significance of the sequence number in SLPP messages?
q_26857.ground_truth: The sequence number in SLPP messages is used to match acknowledgements with the correct message and to indicate the order in which messages should be sent and received.

q_26858.question: What is the role of Inter Operator Identification (IOI) in network charging?
q_26858.ground_truth: IOI is introduced for different operators involved in IMS sessions to identify each other, allowing for inter operator charging support. The IOI concept can be applied on a peer-to-peer basis between operators and included within SIP signalling for unique operator identification.

q_26859.question: What should a GPRS MS do if the GPRS detach and GPRS attach procedure collide and the detach type indicates "re-attach required"?
q_26859.ground_truth: The network should ignore the ATTACH REQUEST message and progress the detach procedure if the detach type is "re-attach required". If "re-attach not required" or "IMSI detach" is specified, the network should progress both procedures or abort the GPRS detach procedure and progress the GPRS attach procedure.

q_26860.question: How does a network request inter-RAT cell re-selection, and when would it occur?
q_26860.ground_truth: A network can request inter-RAT cell re-selection by providing priority-based re-selection parameters and enabling the algorithm for inter-RAT re-selection in TS 45.008 section 6.6.6 and 10.1.3.3. The network would request this when mobile station signals the system that it supports the algorithm and priority-based re-selection. The mobile station then performs autonomous cell re-selection to the E-UTRA cell when re-selection criteria are met.

q_26861.question: What is the effect of CFU on the served user's ability to originate communication?
q_26861.ground_truth: The CFU supplementary service does not affect the served user's ability to originate communications.

q_26862.question: What should the UE do with a first PUCCH transmission of smaller priority index that is not dropped and its UCI is not multiplexed in a second PUCCH transmission of larger priority index in an overlapping slot?
q_26862.ground_truth: The first PUCCH transmission is associated with the next overlapping slot with subslotLengthForPUCCH symbols for PUCCH transmissions with the larger priority index.

q_26863.question: When an NF Service Consumer creates a session context for callback, what is shared by all NF (Service) instances pertaining to the same NF (Service) set?
q_26863.ground_truth: The session context data is shared by all NF (Service) instances pertaining to the same NF (Service) set.

q_26864.question: What is the objective of the link level evaluation in sub-clause 4.4.2?
q_26864.ground_truth: The objective of the link level evaluation in sub-clause 4.4.2 is to analyze the PDSCH performance in a scenario with inter-user interference for MU-MIMO and to compare differing receiver structures in combination with differing sources of interference parameters.

q_26865.question: How is the removal of a single value from a multivalue attribute reported?
q_26865.ground_truth: The operation used is "remove" and no value is present.

q_26866.question: What is the impact on the valid policy decision and/or condition data when the SMF reports PCC and/or session rule errors for all the provisioned PCC rules and/or session rules?
q_26866.ground_truth: The valid policy decision and/or condition data provided in the corresponding update response can remain valid in the SMF until the PCF removes them.

q_26867.question: How does 3GPP management system manage network functions not specified by 3GPP SDOs?
q_26867.ground_truth: 3GPP management system may provide link requirements (e.g. topology, QOS parameters) to the TN management system to ensure proper functionality.

q_26868.question: What is the LoS-NLoSInformation ::= CHOICE sequence used for?
q_26868.ground_truth: The LoS-NLoSInformation ::= CHOICE sequence is used to indicate the line-of-sight (LoS) or non-line-of-sight (NLoS) status of a measured location. It can specify the LoS-NLoSIndicatorSoft (soft LoS-NLoS) or LoS-NLoSIndicatorHard (hard LoS-NLoS) parameters, as well as any additional information (iE-Extensions).

q_26869.question: What is the size of the sequence number modulo used for standard L3 messages in the MM+CC+SS (via CS domain) message flow when the RR connection starts with a core network of Release 98 or earlier?

q_26870.question: What is the purpose of the UUAA procedure in the context of UAV operation?
q_26870.ground_truth: The UUAA procedure is used to authenticate and authorize a UAV with the USS during 5GS registration, PDU session establishment and PDN connection establishment, and to perform USS authorization of C2 Communication.

q_26871.question: What is the requirement for the UE when the network provides the T3324 value in an attach or tracking area updating procedure for the use of PSM?
q_26871.ground_truth: The UE may use PSM only if the network has provided the T3324 value different from "d".

q_26872.question: What should the NF service consumer do if the "PartialPull" feature is supported and the PFDF requests the NF service consumer to retrieve the PFDs with the "pfdOp" attribute set to "FULLPULL"?
q_26872.ground_truth: If the "PartialPull" feature is supported and if the PFDF requests the NF service consumer to retrieve the PFDs with the "pfdOp" attribute set to the value "FULLPULL", the NF service consumer shall invoke the full pull procedure defined in clause~4.2.2.2.

q_26873.question: Who is the test applicable to?
q_26873.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA UE on or after release 16, supporting EN-DC, RRM measurements, UL with a shared spectrum NR carrier, BWP adaptation of at least 2BWPs, DCI and timer-based active BWP switching delay Type1 or Type2 and 2DL CA on shared channel access.

q_26874.question: What information does the UE include in the ATTACH REQUEST message when it supports neither A/Gb mode nor Iu mode and there is no valid GUTI available?
q_26874.ground_truth: The UE includes the IMSI in the ATTACH REQUEST message.

q_26875.question: How many times will an SLPP message be retransmitted if not acknowledged?
q_26875.ground_truth: An SLPP message will be retransmitted up to three times if it is not acknowledged before the timeout period expires.

q_26876.question: What type of MIME body is required when including location information in a SIP request for an MCPTT emergency alert?

q_26877.question: How is the measurement window, T, determined in this process?
q_26877.ground_truth: The measurement window, T, shall be identical to the test signal period, T, with the measurement window synchronized to the PN-sequence of the test signal.

q_26878.question: What is the benefit of reusing the existing provisioning MnS operations and notifications with extensions of the NRM for ML inference emulation?
q_26878.ground_truth: Reusing the existing provisioning MnS operations and notifications with extensions of the NRM for ML inference emulation provides flexibility and allows any function that can execute n ML entity to be the MnS producer for ML inference emulation, for example an inference function or a generic sandbox function. It also enables requests for inference emulation for a given ML entity to be instantiated using provisioning management service implemented via CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations on the request objects.

q_26879.question: What should the controlling MCData function do upon receiving a SIP re-INVITE request with an emergency indication set to "false" and an unauthorized request for an MCData emergency private communication cancellation?
q_26879.ground_truth: The controlling MCData function should generate a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response to reject the SIP re-INVITE request and include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body with the <emergency-ind> element set to a value of "true".

q_26880.question: What type of operation is supported on the UE-contexts resource?
q_26880.ground_truth: There is no standard operation supported on this resource.

q_26881.question: What does the NRF network product class refer to in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_26881.ground_truth: The NRF network product class refers to a specific set of security requirements and test cases related to the Network Repository Function in the 3GPP 5G System.

q_26882.question: Which set of carriers should be selected when constructing NRTC2 on a per band basis?
q_26882.ground_truth: Those with smallest or largest sum of channel bandwidths of component carriers, or with the narrowest carrier with the smallest supported subcarrier spacing at the lower or upper Base Station RF Bandwidth edge, and with the smallest number of component carriers or the widest carrier with the smallest supported subcarrier spacing being adjacent to the selected carrier.

q_26883.question: What should the ATCF do if it fails to forward the SIP REGISTER request to any entry point?
q_26883.ground_truth: The ATCF should send back a SIP 504 (Server Time-Out) response.

q_26884.question: What is the function of the group management service of SEAL in V2X communication?
q_26884.ground_truth: The group management service of SEAL provides support for platooning groups and pre-arranged groups for V2X communications.

q_26885.question: What is the purpose of the V-PCF in delivering a transparent policy to a UE?
q_26885.ground_truth: The V-PCF delivers a transparent policy to a UE to ensure successful installation of updated URSP rules.

q_26886.question: What should the MCData client do when it receives a SIP MESSAGE request with an application/vnd.3gpp.mvdata-mbs-usage-info+xml MIME body?
q_26886.ground_truth: The MCData client should replace or store the announcement element and follow the procedure in clause 19.3.2, mapping the terminology as specified in clause I.3.4.

q_26887.question: What should a UE attached for access to RLOS do when it receives a paging indication from the network?
q_26887.ground_truth: It should ignore the paging indication from the network.

q_26888.question: Under what conditions should the UE perform V2X sidelink communication operation?
q_26888.ground_truth: The UE should perform V2X sidelink communication operation only if the conditions related to the serving cell or the UE's state are met as specified in TS 36.331, clause 5.10.1d.

q_26889.question: Which command is used to open a new logical channel and select the application identified by the <dfname> received with the command in the currently selected UICC?
q_26889.ground_truth: The Open logical channel +CCHO command is used to open a new logical channel and select the application identified by the <dfname> received with the command in the currently selected UICC.

q_26890.question: What are the two assignment models for the Network Identifier (NID) in Stand-alone Non-Public Networks?
q_26890.ground_truth: The two assignment models for the Network Identifier (NID) in Stand-alone Non-Public Networks are Self-assignment, where NIDs are chosen individually by SNPNs at deployment time and use a different numbering space than coordinated assignment NIDs, and Coordinated assignment, where NIDs are assigned such that they are globally unique independent of the PLMN ID used or the combination of NID and PLMN ID is globally unique.

q_26891.question: What is the role of the "Service data flow template" in a PCC rule?
q_26891.ground_truth: The "Service data flow template" contains information for matching user plane packets, instructing the UPF to identify packets belonging to a particular service data flow. It may include any number of service data flow filters or an application identifier.

q_26892.question: What action should the CBC take if it receives the same RESTART-INDICATION-E-UTRAN message twice?
q_26892.ground_truth: If the same RESTART-INDICATION-E-UTRAN message is received twice, the CBC shall consider the message as a duplicate and ignore it.

q_26893.question: What information does the V-SMF send in the PDU Session Create Request to the H-SMF when creating a HR breakout session?
q_26893.ground_truth: The V-SMF sends the VPLMN-provided policy information for the HR breakout session in the PDU Session Create Request to the H-SMF.

q_26894.question: What is the timing advance adjustment value in the second time period of the test procedure in the E-UTRAN FDD Timing Advance Adjustment Accuracy Test for CE UE in CEModeA?
q_26894.ground_truth: The timing advance adjustment value in the second time period is NTA = 128.

q_26895.question: Who is responsible for verifying the authorization of the DAA support information request before sending it to the UAE client?
q_26895.ground_truth: The UAE server is responsible for verifying that the DAA support information request from the application specific server is authorized before sending the DAA support information to the UAE client.

q_26896.question: When at least one different numerology/slot pattern is used in aggregated cells, what requirement must be applied for intra-band SL CA operation?
q_26896.ground_truth: The same requirement as specified in clause 6.2E.4.3 in TS38.101-1 must be applied.

q_26897.question: What is the minimum requirement for single RAT UTRA operation for UTRA BS in the context of in-channel selectivity?
q_26897.ground_truth: This requirement is not applicable for UTRA BS.

q_26898.question: What is the V2X user ID used for in V2X communication?
q_26898.ground_truth: The V2X user ID is used for authentication and authorization purposes, indicates the V2X service provider with whom the V2X user has a V2X service agreement, and is a URI that represents the V2X user.

q_26899.question: What should a UE indicate if it supports category 12 in MBMS?
q_26899.ground_truth: A UE that supports category 12 in MBMS should also indicate category 10, 7 and 4.

q_26900.question: What is required for a pre-arranged group session to be initiated in the MCPTT system?
q_26900.ground_truth: The pre-arranged sessions must be already active and the use of pre-established sessions must be required for the pre-arranged group session to be initiated.

q_26901.question: What should the PCF do if the AF requests the PCF to report on the Out of credit event for associated service data flow(s)?
q_26901.ground_truth: The PCF must inform the AF that credit is no longer available for the service data flow(s) related to the AF session together with the applied termination action.

q_26902.question: What is expected when the SS detects certain uplink power levels during subtest b) in the test procedure?
q_26902.ground_truth: When the SS on Cell2 detects uplink power equal to or higher than -39 dBm in the On-duration part of every DRX cycle during the period from time point A to time point B and does not detect any uplink power higher than -48.5 dBm between time point C and T3 expiration, the SS must increase the number of successful tests by one. Otherwise, the number of failed tests is incremented.

q_26903.question: What entity sends a PIN services de-registration response containing the status of the de-registration request?

q_26904.question: What is the condition for a UE to consider an NB-IoT neighbour cell in cell reselection?
q_26904.ground_truth: The UE shall not consider a NB-IoT neighbour cell in cell reselection, if it is indicated as not allowed in the measurement control system information of the serving NB-IoT cell.

q_26905.question: What is the recommended approach for testing the terminal in the testing setup described?
q_26905.ground_truth: The recommended way for testing is to connect the terminal to the system simulator with exact defined settings and access points. The test sequences are fed in either electrically using a reference codec, using the direct signal processing approach, or acoustically using ITU-T specified devices.

q_26906.question: What is the primary function of a base station simulator in the context of UTRA?
q_26906.ground_truth: A base station simulator is used to set up a communication link with the equipment under test (EUT) in order to evaluate its performance under various conditions.

q_26907.question: What action must the UE take upon receipt of a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message with the 5GSM cause value #39 "reactivation requested" and the PDU session is being transferred from EPS to 5GS and established with the request type set to "existing PDU session"?
q_26907.ground_truth: The UE should re-initiate the UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure for the PDU session type associated with the transferred PDU session, the SSC mode associated with the transferred PDU session, the DNN associated with the transferred PDU session, and the S-NSSAI associated with (if available in roaming scenarios) a mapped S-NSSAI if provided in the UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure of the transferred PDU session.

q_26908.question: What bits of the E-UTRAN <M-TMSI> are mapped into bit 29 and down to bit 24 of the GERAN/UTRAN <P-TMSI> when mapping the GUTI in the UE?
q_26908.ground_truth: 6 bits of the E-UTRAN <M-TMSI> starting at bit 29 and down to bit 24 are mapped into bit 29 and down to bit 24 of the GERAN/UTRAN <P-TMSI> when mapping the GUTI in the UE.

q_26909.question: What identity is used by the ePDG to authenticate itself to the UE during the establishment of UE-initiated IPsec tunnels?
q_26909.ground_truth: The identity used by the ePDG to authenticate itself to the UE is the same as the FQDN of the ePDG, which is determined by the ePDG selection procedures defined in TS 23.402.

q_26910.question: What should the controlling MCPTT function do, as specified in clause 6.3.3.3, if timer TNG1 (acknowledged call setup timer) is running and a final SIP 4xx, 5xx or 6xx response is received from an affiliated and <on-network-required> group member?
q_26910.ground_truth: Follow the relevant procedures specified in clause 6.3.3.3.

q_26911.question: When should a UE replace any stored pending NSSAI with the pending NSSAI received in the registered PLMN?
q_26911.ground_truth: A UE should replace any stored pending NSSAI with the pending NSSAI received in the registered PLMN when the registration area contains TAIs belonging to different PLMNs, which are equivalent PLMNs, for each of the equivalent PLMNs.

q_26912.question: What form does the Small Data Rate Control information take?
q_26912.ground_truth: The Small Data Rate Control information is in the form of an integer 'number of packets per time unit' and an integer 'number of additional allowed exception report packets per time unit' for both uplink and downlink.

q_26913.question: What is Reflective QoS in the context of 5G?
q_26913.ground_truth: Reflective QoS is a feature that enables the UE to map uplink user plane traffic to QoS Flows without SMF provided QoS rules, by creating UE derived QoS rules in the UE based on the received downlink traffic.

q_26914.question: How is a change in the contents of the present document indicated?
q_26914.ground_truth: When the TSG modifies the contents of the present document, it will be re-released by the TSG with an identifying change of release date and an increase in version number.

q_26915.question: Which method is used to send an LCS event notify to the NF Service Consumer in the 6.4.5.2.3 section?
q_26915.ground_truth: The "POST" method is used to send an LCS event notify to the NF Service Consumer in the 6.4.5.2.3 section.

q_26916.question: What is the value range for "Values" in the "RulesForDeaffiliation/ListOfLocationCriteria/Entry/ExitSpecificArea/Heading/MaximumHeading" field?
q_26916.ground_truth: The value for "Values" in the "RulesForDeaffiliation/ListOfLocationCriteria/Entry/ExitSpecificArea/Heading/MaximumHeading" field is in the range of 0-359.

q_26917.question: What is the minimum requirement for the transmitter OFF power spectral density for BS type 1-C?
q_26917.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for the transmitter OFF power spectral density for BS type 1-C is less than -85 dBm/MHz per antenna connector.

q_26918.question: Where can NWDAF instance(s) be collocated?
q_26918.ground_truth: NWDAF instance(s) can be collocated with a 5GS NF.

q_26919.question: What should the releasing UE do with the direct link if the release reason is #3 "Direct connection is not available any more"?
q_26919.ground_truth: The releasing UE should release the direct link locally.

q_26920.question: What should be considered as the served MCPTT group information entries if a participating MCPTT function has performed a service authorization for an MCPTT ID?
q_26920.ground_truth: A copy of the list of MCPTT group information entries of the served MCPTT client information entry should be considered as the served MCPTT group information entries.

q_26921.question: What is the expected behavior of the UE during the period from time point A to time point D?
q_26921.ground_truth: The UE is expected to decode the uplink grant and switch to uplink to complete the corresponding uplink transmission during this period.

q_26922.question: What is the function of the TSCTSF in the notification procedures for burst timing preference signalling?
q_26922.ground_truth: The TSCTSF derives exact BAT from the BAW, includes BAT to the NEF, and provides the updated BAT value as part of TSC Assistance container to the SMF.

q_26923.question: What is the measurement reporting delay defined as in the context of a user equipment (UE) transmitting measurement reports in an LTE system?
q_26923.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay is defined as the time between the point when UE receives an ECID-RequestLocationInformation message and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface, excluding certain delays such as those caused by other RRC signaling, no UL resources, RRC connection release, or signaling connection with the MME.

q_26924.question: What message does the source gNB send to the target gNB upon reception of the PATH SWITCH REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message from the AMF to inform the success of the handover?
q_26924.ground_truth: The source gNB sends a UE CONTEXT RELEASE message to the target gNB to inform the success of the handover upon reception of the PATH SWITCH REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message from the AMF.

q_26925.question: Which Diameter application provides a Diameter application to support the transport of EAP over Diameter?

q_26926.question: What does the target eNB release after receiving the PATH SWITCH REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message from the MME during a handover?
q_26926.ground_truth: The target eNB releases radio and C-plane related resources associated to the UE context.

q_26927.question: What is the influence of Carrier leakage in the transmit modulation quality requirements for inter-band CA?
q_26927.ground_truth: In case the parameter 3300 or 3301 is reported from UE via txDirectCurrentLocation IE, the carrier leakage measurement requirement in clause 6.4F.2.2 and 6.4F.2.3 shall be waived, and the RF correction with regard to the carrier leakage and IQ image shall be omitted during the calculation of transmit modulation quality.

q_26928.question: What should a P-CSCF do upon receiving a notification of loss of signalling connectivity from the PCRF/PCF?
q_26928.ground_truth: The P-CSCF should assume that the IMS SIP signalling transport for the user is lost and reject subsequent incoming session requests towards the remote endpoint.

q_26929.question: How does a client NWDAF participate in Horizontal Federated Learning?
q_26929.ground_truth: A client NWDAF participates in Horizontal Federated Learning by locally training the local ML model with its own data and sharing it to the coordinator NWDAF. The coordinator NWDAF aggregates the local ML models into a global or optimal ML model or ML model parameters and sends them back to the client NWDAF.

q_26930.question: Which subclause of the IOC applies to the data types "NsacfCapability", "NwdafInfo", "NwdafCapability", "MlAnalyticsInfo", "PlmnIdNid", "SeppInfo", "UdsfInfo", "SmsfInfo", and "PlmnRange" in the context described in the document?

q_26931.question: What is the purpose of the SSB Offset Modification Range IE?
q_26931.ground_truth: The SSB Offset Modification Range IE contains the range of SSB Offset values permitted by the NG-RAN node at the moment the MOBILITY CHANGE FAILURE message is sent.

q_26932.question: What is the length of the PLMN List information element content?
q_26932.ground_truth: The PLMN List information element content is a type 4 information element with a minimum length of 5 octets and a maximum length of 47 octets.

q_26933.question: How does JPath relate to the XPath data model?
q_26933.ground_truth: JPath provides a mapping from a JSON document to the XPath data model, making XPath expressions applicable to JSON.

q_26934.question: What must the MCPTT server do if confidentiality protection has not been applied to the required elements?
q_26934.ground_truth: The MCPTT server must identify the MCPTT ID of the user in the partner and primary MCPTT systems, and the selected user profile index from the received elements.

q_26935.question: What is the role of the SM-PCF in 5G system?
q_26935.ground_truth: The SM-PCF is responsible for handling UE Policy Association with the SMF+PGW-C and providing the UE Policy Container which includes the UE Policy for the UE in EPS. It can also relocate the UE Policy Association established in 5GS from AMF to SM-PCF.

q_26936.question: What is the special treatment given to SIP transactions with priority in the ATCF?
q_26936.ground_truth: The special treatment can include filtering, higher priority processing, routing, or call gapping.

q_26937.question: What is one of the requirements during the test described in 6.6.2.12.4.2?
q_26937.ground_truth: During the test, the UE shall not have any timing information of NR cell 2 during time duration T1.

q_26938.question: In the LBO roaming scenarios, who does the V-PCF for the PDU Session contact first in step 1?
q_26938.ground_truth: The V-PCF for the PDU Session contacts the V-PCF for the UE first in step 1.

q_26939.question: In which specification is the usage of the Enhanced Coverage Restricted parameter at the AS layer defined?
q_26939.ground_truth: The usage of the Enhanced Coverage Restricted parameter at the AS layer is defined in the RAN specification.

q_26940.question: What should a Sidelink process do when the Sidelink HARQ Entity requests a new transmission for sidelink communication?
q_26940.ground_truth: When the Sidelink HARQ Entity requests a new transmission, the Sidelink process should store the MAC PDU in the associated HARQ buffer, store the sidelink grant received from the Sidelink HARQ Entity, and generate a transmission as described.

q_26941.question: What is the definition of "absolute accuracy of RSRP" in the context of 3GPP TS 36.133?
q_26941.ground_truth: The "absolute accuracy of RSRP" is the RSRP measured from a cell that has different carrier frequency from the serving cell.

q_26942.question: What should the MCVideo client do upon receiving a request to release an MCVideo emergency group call with the state set to "MVEGC 2: emergency-call-requested"?
q_26942.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should set the MCVideo emergency group call state to "MVEGC 1: emergency-gc-capable", if the MCVideo client emergency group state of the group is "MVEG 3: confirm-pending", it should set the MCVideo client emergency group state of the group to "MVEG 1: no-emergency", and if the MCVideo emergency alert state is set to "MVEA 2: emergency-alert-confirm-pending", it should set the MCVideo emergency alert state to "MVEA 1: no-alert".

q_26943.question: In which network topology cases should the HSS provide IRI-POI functions?
q_26943.ground_truth: The HSS should provide IRI-POI functions in the non-roaming case and in the roaming case when the UE is in the home PLMN.

q_26944.question: What should be the relationship between the resolution bandwidth and measurement bandwidth in a measurement setting for accurate results?
q_26944.ground_truth: To improve accuracy, sensitivity, and efficiency, the resolution bandwidth should be smaller than the measurement bandwidth, with the result integrated over the measurement bandwidth to obtain the equivalent noise bandwidth.

q_26945.question: What do the V4 and V6 flags in the F-SEID indicate?
q_26945.ground_truth: The V4 flag indicates whether the IPv4 address field is present, while the V6 flag indicates the presence of the IPv6 address field.

q_26946.question: What is the difference between P* rated,c,TABC,GEO and P* rated,c,TABC,LEO?
q_26946.ground_truth: P* rated,c,TABC,GEO is the rated carrier output power per TAB connector of the SAN GEO class, while P* rated,c,TABC,LEO is the rated carrier output power per TAB connector of the SAN LEO class.

q_26947.question: What is the purpose of the measurement "Wideband CQI distribution"?
q_26947.ground_truth: This measurement provides the distribution of Wideband CQI (Channel Quality Indicator) reported by UEs in the cell. This measurement is obtained by incrementing the appropriate measurement bin when a wideband CQI value is reported by a UE in the cell.

q_26948.question: What is the role of the 5G PKMF in 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay security?
q_26948.ground_truth: The 5G PKMF is responsible for provisioning PC5 security policies to the 5G ProSe Remote UE and the UE-to-Network Relay during service authorization and security materials provisioning procedures. Additionally, the 5G PKMF stores PC5 security policies associated with each 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay service.

q_26949.question: What should a UE do when all target TCI states in the active TCI state list are unknown?
q_26949.ground_truth: When all target TCI states in the active TCI state list are unknown, the requirements specified in this clause are not applicable.

q_26950.question: What should the UE do upon receiving a request from upper layers to send or receive data for ProSe direct communication in a given group?
q_26950.ground_truth: The UE shall initiate the procedure for ProSe direct communication, performing ProSe direct communication procedures specified in subclause 10.2.2 for case a, and ProSe direct communication procedures specified in subclause 10.2.3 for case b and c.

q_26951.question: What is the format of the Reason Code field in the MCPTT pre-session messaging?
q_26951.ground_truth: The Reason Code field in the MCPTT pre-session messaging is a 16-bit binary value indicating the reason for accepting, rejecting, or disconnecting from a pre-established MCPTT call.

q_26952.question: What is the requirement for the test in terms of total successful tests and confidence level for it to pass?
q_26952.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the total number of successful tests shall be more than 90% of the cases with a confidence level of 95%.

q_26953.question: What is one of the criteria used in UE-to-UE relay operation to select the best route before U2U relay connection setup?
q_26953.ground_truth: Radio link quality criteria is one of the criteria used in UE-to-UE relay operation to select the best route before U2U relay connection setup.

q_26954.question: What is the maximum allowed delay for the first report in event triggered periodic measurement reporting as specified in clause~8.6.3.1.2.1.1.3?
q_26954.ground_truth: The UE shall not send any event triggered measurement reports, as long as no reporting criteria are fulfilled. The first report in event triggered periodic measurement reporting shall meet the requirements specified in clause~8.6.3.1.2.1.1.3.

q_26955.question: What potential threats do flexible and low-cost security monitoring agents pose in a virtualized environment, and how can they be mitigated?
q_26955.ground_truth: Without appropriate protection, an attacker may be able to identify multiple logical locations within NFVI, correlate signaling, and take action based on this information, potentially exposing user privacy. To mitigate these threats, solutions should increase assurance that virtualized 3GPP NFs are protected from distributed monitoring attacks and dynamically assign VNF resources to prevent long-term data leakage and exposure.

q_26956.question: What should the P-CSCF do when no signalling plane security mechanism is selected from the Security-Client header field?
q_26956.ground_truth: The P-CSCF shall continue with the procedures described in the remainder of the subclause, including the GPRS-IMS-Bundled authentication procedures, performing NASS-IMS bundled authentication (if the P-CSCF supports both SIP digest and NASS-IMS bundled authentication), following the SIP digest without TLS procedures, or following the IMS-AKA procedures for eP-CSCF (if the REGISTER request is received by eP-CSCF over TLS and contains an Authorization header field with an "algorithm" header field parameter set to "AKAv2-SHA-256").

q_26957.question: What should the controlling MCData function do when there is a risk of congestion and a SIP INVITE request is received for an ongoing MCData session?
q_26957.ground_truth: The controlling MCData function may reject the SIP INVITE request with a SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response and include a Retry-After header field.

q_26958.question: What is the result of step 4b of the procedure for the partner ACMS when the request targets a functional alias that is not currently active?
q_26958.ground_truth: If the functional alias is not currently active, the ACM server stores the request.

q_26959.question: In the Session Breakout scenario, what is the simple solution to keep EC traffic to 3GPP access for UL-CL that is reachable only through that access?
q_26959.ground_truth: One solution is to set the Access Type Preference to "3GPP" in the corresponding URSP rule for this PDU Session and use WIFI offload for other non-EC traffic.

q_26960.question: Which CRS-IM features is a UE required to support for TMs 1-9 if it includes the crs-IM-TM1-toTM9-OneRX-Port field?
q_26960.ground_truth: A UE that includes the crs-IM-TM1-toTM9-OneRX-Port field must support CRS-IM with 2 CRS antenna ports for PDSCH with 1 receiver antenna port and CRS-IM with 4 CRS antenna ports for PDSCH with 1 receiver antenna port for TMs 1-9.

q_26961.question: What is the expected HTTP status code when the UAE Server is not able to delete an existing USS Change Policy?
q_26961.ground_truth: The expected HTTP status code when the UAE Server is not able to delete an existing USS Change Policy is an appropriate HTTP status code indicating the error in the HTTP DELETE response body.

q_26962.question: What is the transport protocol used for EPC-level ProSe discovery messages over the PC3 interface?
q_26962.ground_truth: The UE and the ProSe Function use HTTP~1.1 as the transport protocol.

q_26963.question: Which protocol is used to request a UE Radio Capability ID Mapping?

q_26964.question: What information is included in the NG-RAN's shared delivery establishment response for a location dependent MBS session?
q_26964.ground_truth: The NG-RAN's shared delivery establishment response includes MBS service areas and Area Session IDs associated with the same MBS session.

q_26965.question: What should a TWAN do when it receives a GTP error indication for a non-default bearer from a PGW?
q_26965.ground_truth: The TWAN should delete its bearer context and may notify the Operation and Maintenance network element.

q_26966.question: What should the UE do when it receives the ATTACH ACCEPT message with a GUTI?
q_26966.ground_truth: The UE should use this GUTI as the new temporary identity, and delete the old GUTI while storing the new assigned GUTI.

q_26967.question: What is the protocol used for the Rx reference point interface?
q_26967.ground_truth: The Rx reference point interface is based on RESTful HTTP and XML.

q_26968.question: What happens in step 7 of the forward relocation procedure towards the source eNodeB during the data forwarding execution phase?
q_26968.ground_truth: The source MME sends the message Handover Command to the Source eNodeB, and the Source eNodeB initiates data forwarding for the bearers specified in the "Bearers Subject to Data Forwarding List" to the target SGSN or via the Serving GW based on the source MME and/or target SGSN's decision.

q_26969.question: What type of functions are the 5GMSu AF and 5GMSu AS in the context of 5G uplink media streaming?
q_26969.ground_truth: The 5GMSu AF is an Application Function dedicated to 5G uplink media streaming, while the 5GMSu AS is an Application Server dedicated to 5G uplink media streaming.

q_26970.question: When can Core Network type restriction be applied for a UE?
q_26970.ground_truth: The Core Network type restriction can be applied for a UE to connect to 5GC only, EPC only, or both 5GC and EPC for a PLMN. This applies to both 3GPP and non-3GPP Access Types.

q_26971.question: What is the role of the MTSI MGW in packet size considerations?
q_26971.ground_truth: The MTSI MGW is responsible for indicating the maximum SDU size of the application data that can be transmitted without segmentation, and for determining the specific maximum SDU size limit through the maximumAl2SDUSize and maximumAl3SDUSize fields of the H223Capability member in H.245 TerminalCapabilitySet message.

q_26972.question: In what order does the UE include the cells in the MeasurementReport message for the purpose of 'reportStrongestCells' or 'reportStrongestCellsForSON'?
q_26972.ground_truth: The UE includes the cells in the MeasurementReport message in order of decreasing triggerQuantity when the purpose is set to 'reportStrongestCells', and in order of decreasing quantity when the purpose is set to 'reportStrongestCellsForSON'.

q_26973.question: What is the purpose of the "Retrieve" operation in AKMA API?
q_26973.ground_truth: The purpose of the "Retrieve" operation in AKMA API is to allow a service consumer to retrieve AKMA application key information via the NEF.

q_26974.question: In the 'G: Initialising' state, what must the floor control arbitration logic do upon receiving a floor request (R: mcptt-floor-request) from a constituent MCPTT group?
q_26974.ground_truth: The floor control arbitration logic must cache the mcptt-floor-request and remain in the 'G: Initialising' state.

q_26975.question: In the context of the measurement reporting procedure, what should be done if the trigger type is set to event and the event's entry condition is fulfilled for one or more applicable cells not included in the cellsTriggeredList for all measurements after layer 3 filtering?
q_26975.ground_truth: Set the numberOfReportsSent to 0, include the concerned cells in the cellsTriggeredList within the VarMeasReportList for this measId, and initiate the measurement reporting procedure as specified in 5.5.5.

q_26976.question: What does the "OK~" indicate after the AT+CDU command is executed?

q_26977.question: What should the MCData client do upon receiving a SIP BYE request for releasing the MCData adhoc group session?
q_26977.ground_truth: Upon receiving a SIP BYE request for releasing the MCData adhoc group session, the MCData client should send a SIP 200 (OK) response towards the MCData server, interact with the media plane to release all media plane resources, and notify the MCData user with a reason for release of communication if the SIP BYE request contains a reason header.

q_26978.question: What is the condition for a UE to complete the DL and UL TCI state switch as specified in clause 8.21.5?
q_26978.ground_truth: A UE is expected to complete the DL and UL TCI state switch before receiving on DL based on the target TCI state.

q_26979.question: What aspects should be considered in alignment with 3GPP TS 23.247 when including solutions that reflect the life cycle of broadcast and multicast MBS sessions?
q_26979.ground_truth: The aspects to be considered include broadcast and multicast MBS sessions being identified via MBS session ID, utilizing the MBS session mode information element, providing common procedures for broadcast and multicast MBS sessions, and including procedures for established multicast MBS sessions with state transitions.

q_26980.question: What is an example of a DN in string representation?
q_26980.ground_truth: An example of a DN in string representation is "DC=com,DC=CompanyXYZ,DC=marketing,IRPAgent=ATMPVCBilling, Log=19990101131000,AccountingRecord=100098".

q_26981.question: How can the version number format in the document's title be interpreted in terms of its contents and changes?
q_26981.ground_truth: The format x.y.z indicates the following: the first digit (x) represents the status of the document, either presented to TSG for information, presented to TSG for approval, or TSG approved under change control; the second digit (y) is incremented for all changes of substance (e.g., technical enhancements, corrections, updates); the third digit (z) is incremented when only editorial changes have been incorporated in the document.

q_26982.question: What is the action taken by the AF upon successful reception of an updated DNAI Mapping information notification request from the NEF?
q_26982.ground_truth: The AF acknowledges its successful reception by sending a HTTP POST response message with an HTTP "204 No Content" status code.

q_26983.question: What should the UE initiate upon receiving a request from upper layers to send/receive ProSe direct communication data in a given group as specified in TS 24.334, clause 10.2.1?
q_26983.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the procedure for ProSe direct communication as specified in subclause 10.2.2 or 10.2.3, depending on whether the UE is served by E-UTRAN or not, and whether ProSe direct communication is supported by the network.

q_26984.question: What is the process used by the UE to determine the preferred PLMN to use for S-NSSAI registration?
q_26984.ground_truth: The UE selects the PLMN ID associated with the S-NSSAI that maximizes the number of S-NSSAIs that the UE can use, or if all S-NSSAIs can be used in a set of PLMNs, the UE selects the common PLMN ID across all the Network-Slice-Aware PLMN list which ranks higher on average.

q_26985.question: What is non-contiguous spectrum?
q_26985.ground_truth: Non-contiguous spectrum is a type of spectrum that consists of two or more sub-blocks separated by sub-block gap(s).

q_26986.question: What is a method used to reduce interference in the UL sub-bands in FR1 Wide Area BS?
q_26986.ground_truth: Digital IC is used to reduce interference in the UL sub-bands in FR1 Wide Area BS. It involves capturing and sampling the interference signals in the digital domain, then subtracting the interference at the receiver.

q_26987.question: What is the mandatory and optional CDR format on the Bm interface in MMS?
q_26987.ground_truth: The support of FQPCs is mandatory, the support of RPCs is optional on the Bm interface in MMS.

q_26988.question: What should the UE do if it has not been granted user-plane resources for PDU sessions and receives a request from the upper layers to perform emergency services fallback or establish an emergency PDU session?
q_26988.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T3540 and locally release the N1 NAS signalling connection, before proceeding as specified in subclause 5.5.1.

q_26989.question: Which devices are not applicable to the ANDSP policy, V2X Policy, and ProSe Policy in the 3GPP 5G system?
q_26989.ground_truth: 5G-RG, FN-RG, and AUN3 devices are not applicable to the ANDSP policy, V2X Policy, and ProSe Policy in the 3GPP 5G system.

q_26990.question: What is the requirement for the server implementing the bootstrapping function in 3GPP AKA infrastructure?
q_26990.ground_truth: The server implementing the bootstrapping function needs to be trusted by the home operator to handle authentication vectors.

q_26991.question: What must the SeNB do when the SENB ADDITION REQUEST message contains the Correlation ID IE for the concerned E-RAB?
q_26991.ground_truth: The SeNB must use this information for LIPA operation for the concerned E-RAB.

q_26992.question: How many virtual resource blocks (VRBs) can be allocated for a UE with PDCCH DCI format 1A when the CRC is scrambled by P-RNTI, RA-RNTI, or SI-RNTI?
q_26992.ground_truth: The number of VRBs allocated for a UE with PDCCH DCI format 1A when the CRC is scrambled by P-RNTI, RA-RNTI, or SI-RNTI varies from a single VRB up to 110 VRBs.

q_26993.question: What is the format of the "protocolIEs" in the "UEContextModificationRefuse" sequence?
q_26993.ground_truth: The "protocolIEs" in the "UEContextModificationRefuse" sequence is a container for "UEContextModificationRefuseIEs" which is a sequence of protocol IEs.

q_26994.question: What is the method used by the Content Provider to push files to the BM-SC in Push Mode?
q_26994.ground_truth: WebDAV or HTTP v1.1 over TLS is used by the Content Provider to push files to the BM-SC in Push Mode. The Content Provider uses the PUT method and places the file in the message body of the request associated with the push-url.

q_26995.question: What is the condition for a UE to consider the leaving condition for event A3 to be satisfied?
q_26995.ground_truth: The leaving condition for event A3 is considered satisfied when the inequality A3-2 is fulfilled, which means that the measurement result of the neighboring cell is higher than the offset parameter for this event by the value of the hysteresis parameter for this event.

q_26996.question: What must the controlling MCVideo function do if the in-progress emergency state of the group is set to a value of "true" and this MCVideo user is indicating a new emergency indication?
q_26996.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function shall cache the MCVideo ID of the MCVideo user that has initiated an MCVideo emergency call, check if an alert indication is set to "true" and send a SIP MESSAGE request notification of the MCVideo user's emergency indication to the other affiliated members of the group.

q_26997.question: What is the definition of "SAN RF Bandwidth" as given in this specification?
q_26997.ground_truth: SAN RF Bandwidth is the RF bandwidth in which a SAN transmits and/or receives single or multiple carrier(s) within a supported operating band.

q_26998.question: What action should the UE take if the received PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for UE-to-network relay discovery solicitation meets the specified criteria?
q_26998.ground_truth: If the received message is valid, the UE shall generate a PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for UE-to-network relay discovery response. The UE sets the necessary parameters such as Discoveree info, relay service code, resource status indicator, UTC-based counter, and MIC field in the PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for UE-to-network relay discovery response.

q_26999.question: What information is included in the PDU Session Resource Modify Response Transfer IE if any QoS flows have failed to be setup or modified during the PDU Session Resource Modify procedure?
q_26999.ground_truth: The list of QoS flows which have failed to be setup or modified is included in the QoS Flow Failed to Add or Modify List IE of the PDU Session Resource Modify Response Transfer IE.

q_27000.question: What is one example of a projection method to map a spherical coordinate system into a cylindrical coordinate system?
q_27000.ground_truth: Equirectangular Projection (ERP) is an example of projection methods to map a spherical coordinate system into a cylindrical coordinate system.

q_27001.question: What should a UE do if it has not successfully received MsgB, and the Random Access Response Reception is not considered successful within the MsgB Response Window?
q_27001.ground_truth: The UE shall again perform the Random Access Resource selection procedure and transmit MsgA with the calculated MsgA PRACH and MsgA PUSCH transmission power.

q_27002.question: What is the response format when the access token request is successful?
q_27002.ground_truth: The response contains the requested access token and the token type set to value "Bearer", the expiration time for the token, and the NF service name(s) of the requested NF service producer(s).

q_27003.question: What is the purpose of the "Test" command for the +CDIS command?
q_27003.ground_truth: The "Test" command for the +CDIS command returns the maximum length of each display element.

q_27004.question: What is the maximum number of transmitting Sidelink processes associated with each Sidelink HARQ Entity for V2X sidelink communication?
q_27004.ground_truth: The maximum number of transmitting Sidelink processes associated with each Sidelink HARQ Entity for V2X sidelink communication is 8.

q_27005.question: What is the purpose of the Ga reference point in 3GPP networks?
q_27005.ground_truth: The Ga reference point in 3GPP networks is used for CDR transfer between a CDF and the CGF.

q_27006.question: What is the role of the MCPTT client procedures in the MCPTT user's affiliation status change?
q_27006.ground_truth: The MCPTT client procedures consist of an affiliation status change procedure, an affiliation status determination procedure, a procedure for sending an affiliation status change request to another MCPTT user, a procedure for receiving an affiliation status change request from another MCPTT user, and a rules-based affiliation status change procedure.

q_27007.question: Why the positioning measurements of a UE are not bound to a specific PLMN?
q_27007.ground_truth: The positioning measurements reported by the UE are not bound to a specific PLMN because the PRS broadcast by the base stations shared by different PLMNs is not bound to a specific PLMN. This allows for positioning measurements to work for each of the PLMNs sharing the base stations, for the LMF of each of the PLMNs to detect FBS using the UE reported measurements.

q_27008.question: What combinations of system information blocks (NR-X) are used in multi band multi cell carrier aggregation scenarios?
q_27008.ground_truth: Combinations NR-3, NR-4, NR-5, NR-10, NR-11, NR-19, and NR-22 are used in multi band multi cell carrier aggregation scenarios.

q_27009.question: What is the result of sending the MC service emergency alert request when an emergency alert is initiated by an MC service user?
q_27009.ground_truth: The MC service emergency alert request message is sent to the MC service clients of each of the affiliated MC service group members, in order to notify them of the emergency.

q_27010.question: When is the third digit incremented in the version numbering system?
q_27010.ground_truth: The third digit is incremented when editorial only changes have been incorporated in the document.

q_27011.question: What happens when the selected expiration time is zero in the MCData server?
q_27011.ground_truth: When the selected expiration time is zero in the MCData server, the MCData user information entry is removed.

q_27012.question: What entity is responsible for translating the assistance request from UE to the request for 5GC when AIML-T is integrated at IEAF or AF?

q_27013.question: Which element appears in both "UNR-discovery-security-parameters-request-type" and "UNR-discovery-security-parameters-accept-type" complex types?
q_27013.ground_truth: The element "relay-service-code" appears in both complex types.

q_27014.question: What is the requirement for the UE not to consider a E-UTRA neighbour cell in cell reselection?
q_27014.ground_truth: If it is indicated as not allowed in the measurement control system information of the serving cell, the UE shall not consider a E-UTRA neighbour cell in cell reselection.

q_27015.question: What happens when eNB1 initiates the X2AP Message Transfer procedure by sending the X2AP MESSAGE TRANSFER message to eNB2?
q_27015.ground_truth: Upon receiving the X2 MESSAGE TRANSFER message, eNB2 may retrieve the X2AP message included in the X2AP Message IE and consider the target eNB ID contained in the Target eNB ID IE as the destination for the X2AP message.

q_27016.question: What is a disadvantage of the zero-IF architecture with baseband envelope detection compared to the heterodyne architecture with IF envelope detection in FSK receivers?
q_27016.ground_truth: Susceptibility to LO leakage (DC offset) and flicker (1/f) noise

q_27017.question: When do all POs have associated NRS in the DRX parameters?
q_27017.ground_truth: All POs have associated NRS if nB is equal to 4T, 2T, T, T/2, T/4, T/8, T/16, T/32, T/64, T/128, T/256, T/512, or T/1024.

q_27018.question: What is the difference between registered relation types and extension relation types for 3GPP Service Based Interface APIs?
q_27018.ground_truth: Registered relation types are identified by a token, such as "self," and can be reused by other applications. They are preferred when expressing the link relation between two resources. Extension relation types, on the other hand, are used when no registered relation exists to express the relation between two resources. They may be defined as a string token or as a URI.

q_27019.question: What is UESliceMaximumBitRateList?
q_27019.ground_truth: UESliceMaximumBitRateList is a sequence of UESliceMaximumBitRateItem with size constraint between 1 and maxnoofAllowedS-NSSAIs.

q_27020.question: What information is required for AMF selection, if applicable, in an NF profile?
q_27020.ground_truth: NF instance ID, NF type, PLMN ID or PLMN ID + NID, Network Slice related Identifiers such as S-NSSAI or NSI ID, FQDN or IP address of NF, NF capacity information, and NF priority information.

q_27021.question: What must the UE do when all PDN connections are allowed to be handed over to WLAN access and a valid IARP rule from HPLMN is present?
q_27021.ground_truth: The UE shall apply the internal IARP for APN rules and ignore their RAN validity conditions if present.

q_27022.question: What must the participating MCPTT function include in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-mbms-usage-info+xml MIME body when announcing an MBMS bearer?
q_27022.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT function must include one or more MBMS bearer announcement elements in an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-mbms-usage-info+xml MIME body when announcing an MBMS bearer. Each MBMS bearer announcement element announces one MBMS bearer intended to carry a general purpose MBMS subchannel used for application level multicast signaling in a specified MBMS service area. Additionally, the message may announce zero or more extra MBMS bearers intended to carry media and media control.

q_27023.question: What are the procedures for inviting an MCData user to an MCData session, as initiated by the controlling MCData function?
q_27023.ground_truth: The controlling MCData function should generate a SIP INVITE request with an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body, include the Supported header field set to "timer", may include the Session-Expires header field, and follow specific procedures depending on whether a standalone SDS message or SDS session or FD is required. It should also include a Referred-By header field, a specific mcdata-info+xml application body, and set the Request-URI and P-Asserted-Identity header field accordingly.

q_27024.question: What steps are taken during the Broadcast Session Start procedure for MOCN NG-RANs?
q_27024.ground_truth: During the Broadcast Session Start procedure for MOCN NG-RANs, the AF performs TMGI allocation and MBS session creation for each operator and provides a TMGI list for the broadcast service. The NG-RAN node selects a primary TMGI out of the TMGI list and delivers it to AF. MB-SMF then blocks and does not deliver Broadcast service media streams to the NG-RAN if the TMGI is different from the primary TMGI.

q_27025.question: What are the two methods for power detection in a spectrum analyser?
q_27025.ground_truth: The two methods are "sample" detection with video bandwidth setting at least three times its RBW setting, and response to the average of the power (root-mean-square of the voltage) across the measurement cell.

q_27026.question: What state does the transmission control interface enter when it receives a Transmission Revoke message with the Reject Cause field set to #3?
q_27026.ground_truth: The 'U: not permitted but sends media' state.

q_27027.question: What custom operation is used to enable a service consumer to request SEALDD Data Storage delivery to the SEALDD Server?
q_27027.ground_truth: DataDeliveryRequest is the custom operation used for this purpose.

q_27028.question: What is the procedure for conducting a substitution method measurement for radiated emission testing?
q_27028.ground_truth: In a substitution method measurement, the mean power of any spurious components is detected by the test antenna and measuring receiver. At each frequency where a component is detected, the BS is rotated and the height of the test antenna adjusted to obtain maximum response. The effective radiated power (e.r.p.) of that component is then determined by a substitution measurement, and the process is repeated with the test antenna in the orthogonal polarization plane.

q_27029.question: What should the UE consider as the sorting quantity when determining the reporting order for eventA3, eventA3H1, eventA3H2, and eventA6 in a 5G NR cell?
q_27029.ground_truth: The quantity used in the aN-Offset.

q_27030.question: What must a UE do to identify and report a new CGI of an E-UTRA cell, when no explicit neighbor list is provided and the purpose is 'reportCGI'?
q_27030.ground_truth: The UE shall identify and report the CGI when requested by the network for the purpose 'reportCGI'. The UE may make autonomous gaps in downlink reception and uplink transmission for receiving MIB and SIB1-BR message.

q_27031.question: What is the BS transmission power assumed in the first scenario for semi-static SBFD at low load level?
q_27031.ground_truth: The BS transmission power assumed in the first scenario for semi-static SBFD at low load level is 49dBm.

q_27032.question: When must a UE immediately acquire SIB6, SIB7, or SIB8 if it is ETWS or CMAS capable and received a Short Message with the specified conditions met?
q_27032.ground_truth: The UE must immediately acquire SIB6, SIB7, or SIB8 as specified in clause 5.2.2.3.2 if it is ETWS or CMAS capable and received a Short Message with the specified conditions met.

q_27033.question: What are the two types of failures in Diameter based on the error scenarios?
q_27033.ground_truth: The two types of failures in Diameter are Permanent Failures and Transient Failures. Permanent Failures indicate that a request failed and should not be attempted again, while Transient Failures indicate that a request could not be satisfied at the time it was received but may be satisfied in the future.

q_27034.question: When does the UE start MBMS reception on a non-serving cell?
q_27034.ground_truth: The UE starts MBMS reception on the Non-Serving neighbour cell when SIB15 indicates that the MBMS service is available on a frequency on an inter-frequency neighbour cell within the UE signalled supportedBandCombination capabilities.

q_27035.question: What is the purpose of the test procedure outlined in step 6.2F.3.4.2?
q_27035.ground_truth: The purpose of the test procedure is to test the transmission of uplink scheduling information and the measurement of the mean power of the UE in the channel bandwidth.

q_27036.question: Which clause specifies the RF conditions and the required success rate for the SDR test for EN-DC within FR1 in Clause 9.4B.1.1.1?
q_27036.ground_truth: The RF conditions and the required success rate for the SDR test for EN-DC within FR1 in Clause 9.4B.1.1.1 are specified in the clause itself.

q_27037.question: What is the meaning of the ENUMERATED value in ResetAll, which represents the different types of reset that can be performed?
q_27037.ground_truth: The ENUMERATED value in ResetAll are: reset-all.

q_27038.question: What is the impact of introducing a Traffic Category in the URSP rule on entities and interfaces?
q_27038.ground_truth: A new parameter "traffic category" is introduced in the traffic descriptor part of the URSP rule, and the UE shall support receiving and matching it with the traffic category component in the Traffic Descriptor provided as part of the URSP rule.

q_27039.question: What is the MIB-SL message periodicity and on which subframes is it scheduled?
q_27039.ground_truth: The MIB-SL message has a periodicity of 40 ms without repetitions and is scheduled in subframes indicated by syncOffsetIndicator. In particular, the MIB-SL is scheduled in subframes for which (10*DFN + subframe number) mod 40 = syncOffsetIndicator.

q_27040.question: What are the two parts of a standard L3 message header for the MM, GMM, CC and SM protocols defined in 3GPP TS 24.008?
q_27040.ground_truth: The two parts of a standard L3 message header for the MM, GMM, CC and SM protocols defined in 3GPP TS 24.008 are the protocol discriminator (1/2 octet) and a message type octet.

q_27041.question: What is the role of the "ModifiedBy" attribute in the "groupStatusType" complex type in the context of constructing an application/simple-filter+xml MIME body indicating per-group dynamic data restrictions of presence event package notification information?
q_27041.ground_truth: The "ModifiedBy" attribute is used to specify the URI that modified the group status. It is an optional attribute in the "groupStatusType" complex type.

q_27042.question: What value of the "entry-info" attribute in the <entry> element within the <MCDataGroupInitiation> element for an on-network group emergency alert indicates the use of the currently selected MCData group as the destination address?

q_27043.question: What is the total number of FeatureSets (size of the pool) for NR DL?

q_27044.question: What is the purpose of the Resource Status Indicator bit of the status indicator parameter in the PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message?
q_27044.ground_truth: The Resource Status Indicator bit is set to indicate whether or not the UE has resources available to provide a connectivity service for additional ProSe-enabled UEs.

q_27045.question: What is the rule for a UE roaming in a VPLMN and not having an ongoing IMS session, in terms of transferring the PDN connection providing access to IMS between EPC via non-3GPP access and 5GCN via NG-RAN?
q_27045.ground_truth: If the UE is roaming in a VPLMN and does not have an ongoing IMS session, it is allowed to transfer the PDN connection providing access to IMS between EPC via non-3GPP access and 5GCN via NG-RAN.

q_27046.question: What is the procedure for pre-registration when a UE moves from E-UTRAN to HRPD?
q_27046.ground_truth: The UE interacts directly with the HRPD system to perform authentication through the HS-GW and establish a security association directly. This process is tunneled over the E-UTRAN/EPS.

q_27047.question: When does a new 5G-GUTI be allocated to a UE as per the requirement?
q_27047.ground_truth: The AMF should allocate a new 5G-GUTI to the UE during the registration procedure after a successful activation of NAS security, upon receiving a Registration Request message of type "initial registration" or "mobility registration update" and during mobility registration update.

q_27048.question: What is the benchmark used for comparing the AI/ML based CSI compression?
q_27048.ground_truth: The benchmark used for comparing the AI/ML based CSI compression is Rel-16 Type II codebook.

q_27049.question: What is the purpose of the NR intra-frequency RRC re-establishment test in FR2 without serving cell timing?
q_27049.ground_truth: The purpose is to verify that the RRC re-establishment delay is within the specified limits and to verify the requirements in TS 38.133 clause 6.2.1.

q_27050.question: When is a cardinality of "M..N" allowed for data types "array(<type>)" and "map(<type>)"?
q_27050.ground_truth: A cardinality of "M..N" is only allowed for data types "array(<type>)" and "map(<type>)" if the values of M and N are greater than 0 and M is less than or equal to N.

q_27051.question: What conditions must be met for the initiation or cease of SLSS transmission with V2X sidelink communication for eNB as Timing Reference?
q_27051.ground_truth: The test purposes to verify that the V2X UE meets the requirements related to the maximum evaluation time allowed to initiate and cease SLSS transmissions defined in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 13.3.1.1, when the downlink timing of the serving cell or PCell on a non-V2X sidelink carrier is used as the timing reference.

q_27052.question: What is the difference between Tracking Area in E-UTRAN and NG-RAN?
q_27052.ground_truth: Both in E-UTRAN and NG-RAN, a warning message with the same Message Code and Update Number may or may not be "new" in the next cell, depending on whether the next cell is in the same Tracking Area as the current cell.

q_27053.question: What should the controlling MCPTT function do to modify the participants of an ad-hoc group call?
q_27053.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function interprets an incoming SIP re-INVITE request with an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body to modify the participants of an ad-hoc group call.

q_27054.question: What does the AF do with the candidate UE list provided by the NEF?
q_27054.ground_truth: The AF selects the candidate UEs based on its internal logic and information received from the NWDAF and notifies AF for the UE candidate list.

q_27055.question: What is the purpose of the tests for PUSCH in clause 8.2.1.3?
q_27055.ground_truth: The purpose of these tests is to verify the receiver's ability to achieve throughput under multipath fading propagation conditions for a given SNR.

q_27056.question: When would an MCVideo emergency call cancellation request be considered authorized?
q_27056.ground_truth: An MCVideo emergency call cancellation request would be considered authorized if the <allow-cancel-imminent-peril> element of the <ruleset> element within the MCVideo user profile document identified by the MCVideo ID of the calling user is set to "true".

q_27057.question: What steps does the initiating UE take after receiving the PROSE DIRECT LINK IDENTIFIER UPDATE ACCEPT message?
q_27057.ground_truth: The initiating UE saves its new IP address/prefix if received on the PROSE DIRECT LINK IDENTIFIER UPDATE ACCEPT message, updates the associated 5G ProSe direct link context with the new identifiers, uses the new layer-2 IDs to transmit the PC5 signalling message and PC5 user plane data, and continues to receive traffic with the old layer-2 IDs from the target UE until it receives traffic with the new layer-2 IDs from the target UE.

q_27058.question: What must SGM-C include in the "GroupMember" object when sending a CoAP PUT request for group registration?
q_27058.ground_truth: MembershipState set to "registered" as true, and optionally, messageFilter attribute and other attributes unchanged.

q_27059.question: What is the indication that the target SGSN sends in the RANAP Common ID message to the source SGSN during PS Handover procedures for SRVCC?

q_27060.question: What is the definition of a CSI-RS based inter-frequency measurement in the context of 9.10D.3.1?
q_27060.ground_truth: A CSI-RS based inter-frequency measurement is a measurement that is not considered an intra-frequency measurement, and is performed on identified inter-frequency cells with the help of CSI-RS-Resource-Mobility and associatedSSB parameters.

q_27061.question: What resource can be queried by the TSCTSF for the SUPI(s) that belong to the provided External or Internal Group Identifier?
q_27061.ground_truth: The Group Identifiers resource (6.1.3.20) can be queried by the TSCTSF to get the SUPI(s) that belong to the provided External or Internal Group Identifier.

q_27062.question: When will the EATF store the received SIP 18x response on the remote leg?
q_27062.ground_truth: The EATF will store this SIP 18x response on the remote leg if a SIP 18x response is received on the remote leg after receiving a SIP INVITE request due to E-STN-SR and this SIP 18x response does not require use of reliable provisional responses.

q_27063.question: What is one of the conditions that must be met for an AS to remove the Contact header field or modify a 3xx response to an appropriate non 2xx response code before sending the response towards the UE?
q_27063.ground_truth: If the response contains a Contact header field and the AS protects against attacks using 3xx responses.

q_27064.question: What is the role of a PIN Element with Gateway Capability in a PIN?
q_27064.ground_truth: A PIN Element with Gateway Capability is a PIN Element that has the ability to provide connectivity to and from the 5G network for other PIN Elements.

q_27065.question: What is a PCC rule in 5G architecture?
q_27065.ground_truth: A PCC rule is a set of information elements enabling the detection of a service data flow and providing parameters for policy control and/or charging control. It can be dynamically provisioned by the PCF to the SMF or predefined in the SMF.

q_27066.question: What is the action of the MS in A/Gb mode if there is no available UMTS security context, and the MS has indicated support for integrity protection in MS network capability IE to the network but the network does not activate integrity protection?
q_27066.ground_truth: If the network does not activate integrity protection by indicating a GPRS GSM integrity algorithm or does not include a message authentication code to the MS in the AUTHENTICATION AND CIPHERING REQUEST message, then the MS ignores the AUTHENTICATION AND CIPHERING REQUEST message.

q_27067.question: What is the content type used for HTTP bodies in the MSGin5G APIs?
q_27067.ground_truth: JSON (IETF RFC 8259) is used for HTTP bodies in the MSGin5G APIs.

q_27068.question: When should the rlf-InfoAvailable flag be included in the RRCConnectionResumeComplete message, for NB-IoT?
q_27068.ground_truth: The rlf-InfoAvailable flag should be included in the RRCConnectionResumeComplete message if the UE has radio link failure information available in VarRLF-Report-NB and if the RPLMN is included in plmn-IdentityList stored in VarRLF-Report-NB.

q_27069.question: In 8.2.4.20.2, what is the scope and description of the test case with inter-band CA?
q_27069.ground_truth: The test case has the same scope as 8.2.4.20.1, with the differences being that inter-band CA replaces intra-band contiguous CA, Cell 10 replaces Cell 3, Cell 30 replaces Cell 12, and Cell 1, Cell 10, and Cell 30 are on the same PLMN.

q_27070.question: What is the purpose of defining "shall" and "shall not" constructions in Technical Specifications produced by the 3GPP?
q_27070.ground_truth: The purpose is to indicate a mandatory requirement to do something and an interdiction (prohibition) to do something, respectively, within the context of normative provisions.

q_27071.question: What is the function of the Network Slice Admission Control Function (NSACF) in 5G networks?
q_27071.ground_truth: The NSACF monitors and controls the number of registered UEs and PDU Sessions per network slice in 5G networks.

q_27072.question: How many bits does the most significant part of the LAC and MME group id map to in the M-TMSI?
q_27072.ground_truth: The most significant 8 bits of the NRI map to the MME code and 6 bits of the GERAN/UTRAN P-TMSI starting at bit 29 and down to bit 24 are mapped into bit 29 and down to bit 24 of the E-UTRAN M-TMSI.

q_27073.question: What information does the UE need to provide to support IMS data channel capability registration?
q_27073.ground_truth: The UE needs to provide information about its data channel capability registration as specified in clause 5.4.1.7 of TS 24.229.

q_27074.question: What measurements should PSCC intra-frequency and SCC intra-frequency measurements meet as per the document?
q_27074.ground_truth: PSCC intra-frequency and SCC intra-frequency measurements should meet all applicable requirements in clauses 8.1.2.2 and 8.3.3, respectively.

q_27075.question: Which two types of capability exchange are required for Trusted N3GPP solutions?
