q_27075.ground_truth: The two types of capability exchange required for Trusted N3GPP solutions are 5G Session Management (5GSM) and 5G Mobility Management (5GMM) to ensure smooth communication and connectivity in the network.

q_27076.question: What should the MME do after receiving a SECURITY MODE REJECT message from the UE?
q_27076.ground_truth: The MME shall stop timer T3460 and abort the ongoing procedure that triggered the initiation of the NAS security mode control procedure.

q_27077.question: What is the function that the User Equipment (UE) Beamlock Function (UBF) activates by performing a procedure specified in TS 38.508-1 clause 4.9.2 with the condition of Tx only?
q_27077.ground_truth: The UE Beamlock Function (UBF) activates the procedure as specified in TS 38.508-1 clause 4.9.2 using condition Tx only.

q_27078.question: What is the use of the global frequency raster in NR-ARFCN?
q_27078.ground_truth: The global frequency raster is used to identify the position of RF channels, SS blocks and other elements in NR-ARFCN.

q_27079.question: What information does the UE include in the MeasurementReport message for reporting measurements of neighboring cells?
q_27079.ground_truth: For each cell that is included in the measResultNeighCells, the UE includes the physical cell identity (physCellId) in the MeasurementReport message.

q_27080.question: What is the action taken by the UE when it receives a PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for UE-to-UE relay discovery solicitation?
q_27080.ground_truth: When the UE receives a PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for UE-to-UE relay discovery solicitation, it uses the associated DUSK, DUCK, and UTC-based counter to unscramble, decrypt, and verify the MIC field in the message.

q_27081.question: What action does the SLPKMF perform related to provisioning discovery security materials to ProSe capable UEs, as per clause 6.2.2?
q_27081.ground_truth: The SLPKMF provisions discovery security materials to ProSe capable UEs, and these materials are associated with the Ranging/SL Positioning application identifier.

q_27082.question: What factor determines whether the UE can request eDRX cycle during a registration procedure?
q_27082.ground_truth: Whether the UE can request eDRX cycle during a registration procedure depends on whether the UE is registered for emergency services.

q_27083.question: How does the ITU-T define Quality of Experience (QoE)?
q_27083.ground_truth: QoE is the degree of delight or annoyance of the user of an application or service, including the complete end-to-end system effects (client, terminal, network, services infrastructure, etc.) and influenced by user expectations and context.

q_27084.question: What is the difference between alternatives 6a and 6b for restoring energy distribution?
q_27084.ground_truth: Alternative 6a is when there is no UPS capacity remaining in the infrastructure that serves the distribution substations, and manual intervention is required to restore energy distribution. Alternative 6b is when prior arrangement is made so that UPS capacity remains in the infrastructure at the time it is needed to restore energy distribution service, and the DSO employs smart energy services to restore service to customers rapidly.

q_27085.question: What should the network product do to ensure software package integrity?
q_27085.ground_truth: The network product software should validate software package integrity during installation or upgrade, support software package integrity validation via cryptographic means such as digital signatures (using keys from a list of authorized software sources), and reject tampered software if the integrity check fails. Only authorized individuals should be able to initiate and deploy software updates, and modify the list of public keys.

q_27086.question: What is the role of the Data Collection AF in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_27086.ground_truth: The Data Collection AF is responsible for collecting data and reporting it to the Data Collection AF. It is also responsible for managing the provisioning state for data collection and reporting.

q_27087.question: What should the system do if the Resource-Priority header field is not included in the INVITE request for an MCVideo emergency group call?
q_27087.ground_truth: If the Resource-Priority header field is not included in the INVITE request for an MCVideo emergency group call, the system should perform the actions specified in clause 6.3.3.1.8, send an UPDATE request towards the initiator of the SIP INVITE request, and wait for a 200(OK) response before proceeding with the rest of the steps.

q_27088.question: What action does the UE take when it receives a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message with the EMM cause set to 'Tracking Area not allowed'?
q_27088.ground_truth: The UE sets the EPS update status to EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, deletes any GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI List and KSI, enters the state EMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE and stores the current TAI in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service".

q_27089.question: What does the "0" value represent in the defined values of the parameter "<n>", which enables or disables reporting of changes in the MT's IMS capabilities?
q_27089.ground_truth: The "0" value in the defined values of the parameter "<n>" represents disabling the reporting of changes in the MT's IMS capabilities.

q_27090.question: What should be provided as input to the QoS sustainability analytics to derive the analytics in a finer granularity area of interest?
q_27090.ground_truth: The necessary granularity of the area of interest should be indicated and provided as input to the QoS sustainability analytics to derive the analytics in a finer granularity area of interest.

q_27091.question: What should the UE include in a SIP request when it wants to indicate the privacy of the P-Asserted-Identity that will be generated by the P-CSCF?
q_27091.ground_truth: The UE can indicate privacy of the P-Asserted-Identity by inserting a P-Access-Network-Info header field into any request for a dialog, any subsequent request (except CANCEL requests) or response (except CANCEL responses) within a dialog or any request for a standalone method. This is defined in subclause 7.2A.4 of the IMS communication service.

q_27092.question: What is the purpose of the AC field in the BFD-RS set of the Serving Cell?
q_27092.ground_truth: The AC field in the BFD-RS set of the Serving Cell indicates the presence of the Candidate RS ID field in this octet. It is set to 1 if at least one of the SSBs with SS-RSRP above rsrp-ThresholdBFR amongst the SSBs in list of candidate beams is available.

q_27093.question: What are the two categories of solutions in Key Issue #7 for enhancing QoS Sustainability analytics?
q_27093.ground_truth: The two categories are enhancing the QoS Sustainability analytics with a finer granularity area (e.g. below Cell level) and enhancing the QoS Sustainability analytics with additional input data.

q_27094.question: What is the reference point for the measurement result after layer 1 filtering in the E-UTRA measurement model?
q_27094.ground_truth: The reference point for the measurement result after layer 1 filtering in the E-UTRA measurement model is point B.

q_27095.question: What is the expected impact of PT1 and PT2 on data rate in the relaxed UE processing timeline?
q_27095.ground_truth: No impact on instantaneous peak data rate is expected from PT1 and PT2.

q_27096.question: What is the maximum allowed measurement reporting delay for Event A3 triggered measurement report in Test 1?
q_27096.ground_truth: The maximum allowed measurement reporting delay for Event A3 triggered measurement report in Test 1 is less than 6.4 seconds from the beginning of time period T2.

q_27097.question: What are the two IE (Information Elements) used in the TBS (Terrestrial Beacon System) to provide TBS measurements to the location server?
q_27097.ground_truth: The two IEs used in the TBS ICD to provide TBS measurements to the location server are TBS-MeasurementInformation and MBS-BeaconMeasList.

q_27098.question: What service does this solution propose to introduce for AI/ML traffic transport?
q_27098.ground_truth: This solution proposes to introduce the Application Data Transfer (ADT) service to address the key issue of enabling AI/ML traffic transport.

q_27099.question: What should a UE do when it cannot access the channel for a transmission prior to an intended SL transmission, and it has failed to access the channel before?
q_27099.ground_truth: If a UE fails to access the channel prior to an intended SL transmission and it has failed to access the channel before, then Layer 1 notifies higher layers about the channel access failure and the channel(s) that the UE fails to access.

q_27100.question: What essential information is derived from the GTP-U header for user plane traffic by the NG-RAN?
q_27100.ground_truth: The NG-RAN derives the boundaries of the PDU Set (e.g. an XR frame) and the dependencies of PDU Sets.

q_27101.question: What is a key challenge in enabling the State Estimation service?
q_27101.ground_truth: A key challenge is the availability of measurement devices with real-time communication capabilities, as the instrumentation penetration at the distribution level is usually poor.

q_27102.question: What is the MAP-user procedure used for delivering a location estimate for an LDR initiated earlier by either the network or the UE?
q_27102.ground_truth: The deferredmt-lrResponse procedure is used for delivering a location estimate for an LDR initiated earlier by either the network or the UE.

q_27103.question: What is the purpose of the private message mechanism for non-standard use?
q_27103.ground_truth: The private message mechanism for non-standard use may be used for special operator- (and/or vendor) specific features considered not to be part of the basic functionality, and by vendors for research purposes.

q_27104.question: What is the purpose of using a separate MP-DCCP connection for each QoS flow?
q_27104.ground_truth: The purpose of using a separate MP-DCCP connection for each QoS flow is to ensure that PDUs belonging to different QoS flows, which may require different QoS treatment, are not multiplexed in the same MP-DCCP connection, without the need for QoS-aware scheduling in each MP-DCCP connection.

q_27105.question: What interfaces are used for the provisioning of UE policies between the PCF in the HPLMN and PCF in the VPLMN?

q_27106.question: What is the TB success rate supposed to be sustained during at least?

q_27107.question: What is the purpose of the URSP rules with Non-Seamless Offload indication when performing Non-Seamless Offload of data traffic to a WLAN access network?
q_27107.ground_truth: It is used to send the traffic outside the IPSec tunnel encapsulation.

q_27108.question: What is the purpose of the OTA UTRA inner loop power control in the downlink test?
q_27108.ground_truth: The purpose of the OTA UTRA inner loop power control in the downlink test is to verify that it is within the limits specified by the minimum requirement.

q_27109.question: What is the name of the new video coding standard that MPEG started working on in January 2019?

q_27110.question: What should an MTSI client do when it receives an SDP offer with multiple codecs and an offer for ECN, but ECN-triggered adaptation is only supported for some of the codecs?
q_27110.ground_truth: An MTSI client should first select which codec to accept and then accept or reject the offer for ECN depending on whether ECN-triggered adaptation is supported for that codec or not. If ECN is accepted for a codec where ECN-triggered adaptation is not supported, the MTSI client should re-negotiate the session to disable ECN.

q_27111.question: What is the role of ADAES in the VAL server performance analytics procedure?
q_27111.ground_truth: ADAES is responsible for performing the VAL server performance analytics based on data collected from the ongoing VAL sessions as well as data from the DN (VAL server, DN database or networking stack at DN).

q_27112.question: What are the pre-conditions that the initiating UE must meet before initiating the path switching procedure from the direct communication path over PC5 to the direct communication path over Uu?
q_27112.ground_truth: The initiating UE and the target UE must be communicating with each other via the 5G ProSe direct link over PC5 reference point, and the communication mode of the 5G ProSe direct link must be set to unicast mode.

q_27113.question: What procedure is recommended before the actual test for MTSI-based speech with LTE, NR, or WLAN access for the convergence of the jitter buffer management of the UE?
q_27113.ground_truth: Applying a conditioning sequence consisting of the British-English single talk sequence described in ITU-T Recommendation P.501 with a level of -16 dBm0.

q_27114.question: What does the Precedence for TFT packet filter allocation parameter determine in PCC rules?
q_27114.ground_truth: The Precedence for TFT packet filter allocation parameter determines the order in which TFT (Traffic Flow Template) packet filters are allocated for PCC rules. The PCF may include this parameter if there is a possibility to run into a restriction regarding the number of TFT packet filters that can be allocated for the PDU Session when interworking with EPS (Evolved Packet System) with N26 deployment is supported.

q_27115.question: What is the timing offset base value for MsgA signal with 15 kHz SCS?
q_27115.ground_truth: The timing offset base value for MsgA signal with 15 kHz SCS is 0.

q_27116.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 7.3.38.4?
q_27116.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described in 7.3.38.4 is to verify the behavior of the UE during different time durations (T1, T2, and T3) in DRX mode with two cells, Cell1 as PCell and Cell2 as PSCell.

q_27117.question: What is the purpose of the circular buffer in the UL-SCH transport channel processing?
q_27117.ground_truth: The purpose of the circular buffer in the UL-SCH transport channel processing is to collect and concatenate the rate matching outputs for the different code blocks.

q_27118.question: What should the MCData client do when it is processing a SIP REFER request and the MCData user is not allowed to initiate emergency MCData communications, as determined in clause 6.3.7.2.6?
q_27118.ground_truth: The MCData client should reject the SIP request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response including warning text set to "233 user not authorised to initiate emergency communication" in a Warning header field as specified in clause 4.9.

q_27119.question: What information does the eNodeB include in the S1 UE Context Release Complete message if Dual Connectivity was activated?
q_27119.ground_truth: The last known PSCell ID and the time elapsed since the Dual Connectivity was released.

q_27120.question: What elements make up the IFPEI?
q_27120.ground_truth: The IFPEI is composed of the Type Approval Code (TAC), Final Assembly Code (FAC), Serial Number (SNR), and Software Version Number (SVN).

q_27121.question: What action does the UE take upon expiry of the timer T3583 associated with a derived QoS rule?
q_27121.ground_truth: Upon expiry of timer T3583 associated with a derived QoS rule, the UE shall remove the derived QoS rule.

q_27122.question: What is the requirement for a L2 U2N Remote UE to monitor paging occasions for SI modifications and/or PWS notifications?
q_27122.ground_truth: A L2 U2N Remote UE is not required to monitor paging occasion for SI modifications and/or PWS notifications.

q_27123.question: What event triggers the UE to initiate the registration procedure for initial registration when moving from GERAN to NG-RAN coverage or from UTRAN to NG-RAN coverage?
q_27123.ground_truth: The UE initiates the registration procedure for initial registration when it moves from GERAN to NG-RAN coverage or from UTRAN to NG-RAN coverage, and the UE did not perform a successful EPS attach or tracking area updating procedure in S1 mode or registration procedure in N1 mode after the GPRS attach or routing area updating procedure while in A/Gb mode or Iu mode.

q_27124.question: What function does the 3GPP portal perform when a CR is successfully reserved?
q_27124.ground_truth: The 3GPP portal pushes the completed CR cover page to the user, eliminating transcription errors.

q_27125.question: What are the specific conditions that the time domain measurement resource restriction pattern for the measured cell needs to meet in order to be valid for performing RSRP measurements?
q_27125.ground_truth: The time domain measurement resource restriction pattern for the measured cell needs to indicate at least one subframe per radio frame for performing the RSRP measurement, and four symbols containing CRS have to be available in all subframes indicated by the pattern.

q_27126.question: What should be used by the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay and 5G ProSe Remote UE during 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay Discovery and PC5 link establishment for emergency service?
q_27126.ground_truth: The dedicated RSC(s) for emergency service should be used by the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay and 5G ProSe Remote UE during 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay Discovery and PC5 link establishment for emergency service.

q_27127.question: What should an ePDG do when it receives a GTP error indication for the default bearer from a PGW?
q_27127.ground_truth: The ePDG should delete all the bearer contexts associated with the PDN connection and initiate the release of the corresponding SWu instance. The ePDG may also notify the Operation and Maintenance network element.

q_27128.question: What is the SIP INVITE request that establishes a pre-established session?
q_27128.ground_truth: A SIP INVITE request with the Request-URI set to a public service identity of the participating MCData function and contains in an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body with an <mcdataInfo> element containing an <mcdata-Params> element with an <anyExt> element and a <pre-established-session-ind> element set to a value of "true".

q_27129.question: When will the AMF consider the UE as unreachable?
q_27129.ground_truth: When the Start of unavailability period starts, the AMF shall consider the UE as unreachable until the UE registers for normal service again.

q_27130.question: What is the effect of a non-critical extension on the decoding of a PDU?
q_27130.ground_truth: Non-critical extensions do not affect the decoding of the essential parts of a PDU; they can be skipped by the decoder if not comprehended, and the decoder can still complete the decoding of the comprehended parts.

q_27131.question: What TPC command should the SS transmit on the MPDCCH DCI format 6-0A for the scheduling of the PUSCH in sub-test 1.2 and 2.2?
q_27131.ground_truth: The SS should transmit a +1dB TPC command for sub-test 1.2 and a -1dB TPC command for sub-test 2.2.

q_27132.question: Which message type contains the SRES or the first 4 octets of the RES, depending on the type of authentication challenge, and should be sent from the network to the MS after an authentication and ciphering request?

q_27133.question: In the context of positioning frequency layers in a cellular network, what does Case 1 refer to in terms of PRS resources?
q_27133.ground_truth: In Case 1, only the PRS resources that are unmuted and fully or partially overlap with the first T2 ms of PPW are considered.

q_27134.question: What happens when the IWK-SCEF receives a request indicating deletion of a Monitoring Event Request?
q_27134.ground_truth: The IWK-SCEF performs final operations necessary, deletes any stored parameters, and sends an acknowledgement to the MME/SGSN.

q_27135.question: What are the two types of bandwidth information indicated by the Rx-Request-Type AVP?
q_27135.ground_truth: The two types of bandwidth information indicated by the Rx-Request-Type AVP are RTCP receiver reports (RR-Bandwidth AVP) and RTCP sender reports (RS-Bandwidth AVP).

q_27136.question: Which protocols are used for the CEMAF's communication in the CEMAF Enrolment and MAnagement Framework solution?
q_27136.ground_truth: The CEMAF's communication is HTTP-based and can be secured using TLS, OCSP, or CMPv2 protocols.

q_27137.question: What is the physical channel parameter used in the NB-IoT test model?
q_27137.ground_truth: The NPDCCH format 1 is used as the physical channel parameter in the NB-IoT test model.

q_27138.question: What action should the UE take if timer T5086 expires during the 5G ProSe direct link keep-alive procedure?
q_27138.ground_truth: The UE should either initiate a 5G ProSe direct link keep-alive procedure to check the link or initiate the 5G ProSe direct link release procedure, depending on its implementation.

q_27139.question: What is the difference between Service Continuity and Session Continuity?
q_27139.ground_truth: Service Continuity is the uninterrupted user experience of a service, including changes in IP address and anchoring point, while Session Continuity refers to the continuity of a PDU session and the preservation of the IP address for the lifetime of the PDU session.

q_27140.question: What is the purpose of the PDC Measurement Initiation procedure?
q_27140.ground_truth: The purpose of the PDC Measurement Initiation procedure is to enable the gNB-CU to request the gNB-DU to report measurements used for propagation delay compensation at the gNB-CU or UE.

q_27141.question: In 3GPP Release 18, what type of bearers are used in dual connectivity and what resources do they correspond to?
q_27141.ground_truth: MCG bearers correspond to MeNB resources and SCG bearers correspond to serving cells associated with the MeNB or the SeNB.

q_27142.question: What are the common characteristics that enable trained ML model sharing between different vendors, as listed in Key Issue #5?
q_27142.ground_truth: The common characteristics that enable trained ML model sharing between different vendors include the interoperability indicator, interoperable token, and ML model filter information such as ML model file format and supported AI framework.

q_27143.question: What is the role of the 3GPP AAA Proxy in the handover procedure?
q_27143.ground_truth: In non-roaming cases, the 3GPP AAA Proxy is not involved in the handover procedure, except for the authentication and authorization step in home routed roaming cases.

q_27144.question: What does the MS need to initiate the secondary PDP context activation procedure with the same PDP address and APN as an already active PDP context?
q_27144.ground_truth: The MS should send an ACTIVATE SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message to the network, containing the selected NSAPI, QoS profile, requested LLC SAPI, Linked TI and TFT.

q_27145.question: What method is used to read the existing application AM context for a given AF and a given application AM context Id?
q_27145.ground_truth: The GET method, as specified in clause 5.17.1.3.3.2 of the document, is used to read the existing application AM context for a given AF and a given application AM context Id.

q_27146.question: What is the aim of the minimum conformance requirements in 6.6.4.5.3?
q_27146.ground_truth: The aim of the minimum conformance requirements in 6.6.4.5.3 is to ensure that the UE meets the required measurement performance within predefined measurement conditions.

q_27147.question: What additional trigger conditions does ATG support for conditional handover?
q_27147.ground_truth: The RRM measurement-based event A4 and a location-based trigger condition.

q_27148.question: What information is used to determine the N6 traffic routing in the case of Ethernet PDU Session Type?
q_27148.ground_truth: The N6 traffic routing information can be, for example, a VLAN ID or the identifier of a VPN or a tunnel identifier at the UPF.

q_27149.question: What message does the server send to the target to provide periodic assistance data in the Assistance Data Delivery procedure?

q_27150.question: What is the test requirement for maximum RRC procedure delay in the E-UTRAN TDD-TDD Inter Frequency Handover test?
q_27150.ground_truth: The maximum RRC procedure delay is 15 ms.

q_27151.question: What is the role of the Verifier in the attestation process of VNFs?
q_27151.ground_truth: The Verifier, in the attestation process of VNFs, validates the measurements reported by the virtualization layer software for the virtual instance and VNF software.

q_27152.question: What should the P-CSCF do when it receives a request without a Security-Client header field or with only media plane security mechanisms and the Require and Proxy-Require header fields do not contain "sec-agree"?
q_27152.ground_truth: The P-CSCF shall continue with the procedures described in the remainder of the subclause and either follow GPRS-IMS-Bundled authentication procedures, perform NASS-IMS bundled authentication (if the P-CSCF supports both SIP digest and NASS-IMS bundled authentication), follow the SIP digest without TLS procedures, or follow the IMS-AKA procedures for eP-CSCF (if the REGISTER request is received by eP-CSCF over TLS and contains an Authorization header field with an "algorithm" header field parameter set to "AKAv2-SHA-256").

q_27153.question: What is the test signal used for measuring the sending sensitivity of a desktop hands-free UE?
q_27153.ground_truth: The test signal used for measuring the sending sensitivity of a desktop hands-free UE is the British-English single talk sequence described in ITU-T Recommendation P.501.

q_27154.question: What is the transmitter OFF power spectral density minimum requirement for an E-UTRA frequency error?
q_27154.ground_truth: The transmitter OFF power spectral density minimum requirement for an E-UTRA frequency error is the same as defined in subclause 6.5.2.2 and subclause 6.5.2.4.

q_27155.question: What HTTP method is used to destroy a Server Certificate resource in a 5GMS system?
q_27155.ground_truth: The HTTP DELETE method is used to destroy a Server Certificate resource in a 5GMS system.

q_27156.question: What are the two keys used for message encryption and integrity protection in the 3GPP Sidelink Positioning broadcast?
q_27156.ground_truth: PEK (Positioning Encryption Key) and PIK (Positioning Integrity Key)

q_27157.question: When should the network include the interface identifier for the UE's link local address in the PDN address information?
q_27157.ground_truth: The network should include the interface identifier when the PDN type is set to IPv6 or IPv4v6.

q_27158.question: When must a UE not activate PSM?
q_27158.ground_truth: A UE must not activate PSM if it is attached for emergency bearer services or has a PDN connection for emergency bearer services or if it is attached for access to RLOS.

q_27159.question: What should the participating MCVideo function perform, if the procedures of clause 8.2.2.2.12 for implicit affiliation were performed in the current procedure?
q_27159.ground_truth: If the procedures of clause 8.2.2.2.12 for implicit affiliation were performed in the current procedure, the participating MCVideo function should complete the implicit affiliation by performing the procedures of clause 8.2.2.2.13.

q_27160.question: What is the role of the Network Repository Function (NRF) in the network?
q_27160.ground_truth: The NRF is not responsible for storing individual IPv4 addresses or IPv6 prefixes of User Equipments (UEs).

q_27161.question: What must the manufacturer declare regarding the rated output power for the base station?
q_27161.ground_truth: The manufacturer must declare for the base station under test the rated output power for each supported transmit channel bandwidth.

q_27162.question: What is the difference between a bi-directional navigable association and a bi-directional non-navigable association?
q_27162.ground_truth: In a bi-directional navigable association, each model element has a pointer to the other, while in a bi-directional non-navigable association, each model element does not have a pointer to the other.

q_27163.question: What should the MME do if the EPS update result IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message indicates "TA updated" but not "combined TA/LA updated"?
q_27163.ground_truth: The MME should return a TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message to the network if the TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message contains a GUTI or a TMSI or both.

q_27164.question: What is the role of the Network Repository Function (NRF) in the consumer PLMN in the roaming scenario?
q_27164.ground_truth: The NRF in the consumer PLMN authenticates the NF Service Consumer, verifies the input parameters in the access token request, and forwards the request to the NRF in the producer PLMN if verification is successful.

q_27165.question: What are the different states a Media Player can have and what does each state indicate?
q_27165.ground_truth: The Media Player can be in the INITIALIZED state, the READY state, the PRELOADED state, the PAUSED state, and the PLAYING state, each indicating a different state of readiness and/or playback. The INITIALIZED state indicates that the Media Player has been created, the READY state indicates that the Media Player is ready for use, the PRELOADED state indicates that the Media Player has preloaded media, the PAUSED state indicates that the playback has been paused, and the PLAYING state indicates that the playback has been initiated.

q_27166.question: What information does the SMF include in the Traffic Parameter Measurement Control Information IE to request the UPF to perform N6 Jitter and Periodicity Measurement?
q_27166.ground_truth: The SMF includes the DL Periodicity if it is available and sets the Traffic Parameter Measurement Indication to request the UPF to measure and report N6 Jitter and conditionally the DL and/or UL Periodicity if the SMF does not receive the DL and/or UL Periodicity from the PCF.

q_27167.question: What information do all Sidelink BSRs transmitted in a TTI reflect regarding the buffer status?
q_27167.ground_truth: All Sidelink BSRs transmitted in a TTI always reflect the buffer status after all MAC PDUs have been built for this TTI.

q_27168.question: What should the AMF do for each PDU session indicated in the PDU Session ID IE upon receiving the HANDOVER REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message?
q_27168.ground_truth: The AMF should transfer transparently the Handover Request Acknowledge Transfer IE or Handover Resource Allocation Unsuccessful Transfer IE to the SMF associated with the concerned PDU session.

q_27169.question: What information is included in the Available Access Networks Info of the Access Network Info Response message?
q_27169.ground_truth: The Available Access Networks Info contains a list of access networks that are available in the vicinity of UE. If the UE included one or more access technology types in the Access Network Info Request, then information about neighbor access network with the requested access technology types is included.

q_27170.question: What should the MAC entity do if it receives a Serving Cell Set based SRS Spatial Relation Indication MAC CE on a Serving Cell?
q_27170.ground_truth: The MAC entity should indicate to lower layers the information regarding the Serving Cell set based SRS Spatial Relation Indication MAC CE.

q_27171.question: What is the requirement for testing ancillary RF amplifiers, as per section 4.5.6 of the document?
q_27171.ground_truth: When testing the repeater with an ancillary RF amplifier, you must use the connecting network declared by the manufacturer and choose the attenuation value as one of the extreme values. This must be done for each test with the amplifier fitted and, if optional, without the amplifier.

q_27172.question: What is the role of the CAPIF core function/authorization function in the authentication of the API invoker?
q_27172.ground_truth: The CAPIF core function/authorization function is responsible for authenticating the identity of the API invoker using the certificate or shared key related to the AKMA/GBA/API invoker onboarding procedure.

q_27173.question: What is the purpose of step 7 in the procedure for Solution #4?
q_27173.ground_truth: The purpose of step 7 in the procedure for Solution #4 is for the UDM to invoke the SIDF to map the SUCI to the SUPI and select an authentication method based on the SUPI.

q_27174.question: At low load level, what is the mean UL Average-UPT gain in case of using SBFD Alt 2 and large packet size?
q_27174.ground_truth: The mean UL Average-UPT gain with SBFD Alt 2 and large packet size at low load level is 103.52%.

q_27175.question: How should the MS treat the CONNECT message when the MS receives an RR message with semantic errors?
q_27175.ground_truth: The MS should follow the reactions specified in the procedural part of 3GPP TS 24.008 clauses 3, 4, 5, and 6, and if required, return a status message (STATUS or MM STATUS) with cause value #101 "mandatory information element(s) missing" or cause value #104 "conditional information element(s) missing".

q_27176.question: In what scenario would a UE request a new 5G-GUTI assignment due to a change in the timing of paging occasions?
q_27176.ground_truth: When the MUSIM UE supporting the paging timing collision control needs to request a new 5G-GUTI assignment and is not registered for emergency services.

q_27177.question: What happens when an AF is not considered trusted?
q_27177.ground_truth: If the AF is not considered trusted, it interacts with the NEF instead of the AF. If the AF provides explicit QoS parameters, then the AF (or NEF in case the AF is not trusted) interacts with PCF.

q_27178.question: Which 5G entity detects the available mean bitrate of the non-GBR QoS Flow?
q_27178.ground_truth: The RAN (Radio Access Network) detects the available mean bitrate of the non-GBR QoS Flow.

q_27179.question: What is the purpose of the "fields" query parameter when retrieving a subset of a resource?
q_27179.ground_truth: The "fields" query parameter is used to carry the identities of the attributes to be retrieved from a resource that has multiple attributes. This parameter is particularly useful when the NF only needs to retrieve specific attributes or individual members of a map in a large resource.

q_27180.question: Which field is only applicable if the UE supports recommendedBitRate-r14?
q_27180.ground_truth: The "recommendedBitRateMultiplier-r16" field is only applicable if the UE supports recommendedBitRate-r14.

q_27181.question: What measure does the 5G network function take to ensure that it operates within its nominal capacity?
q_27181.ground_truth: It supports various measures such as load (re-)balancing, overload control, and NAS level congestion control.

q_27182.question: In what scenario may a UE have to register over 3GPP access and check for Emergency Services support?
q_27182.ground_truth: When the UE initiates a session to ePDG over untrusted WLAN and 3GPP access becomes available.

q_27183.question: What aspects are recommended to be addressed to support and optimize the deployment of unicast live TV services in 5G Systems?
q_27183.ground_truth: The recommended aspects include integrating into TS 26.501 (Stage 2) with specific updates to reference points, defining capability mechanisms, provisioning support for operation points and policy templates, creating necessary extensions for DASH and HLS chunked CMAF low-latency modes, providing protocols for time synchronization, extending QoE metrics schemes, providing informative guidelines on using different Operation Points, and studying even lower-latency streaming technologies.

q_27184.question: Which bit in Octet 5 of the L2TP Session Indications IE indicates that the UP function shall request the UE IP address from the LNS?

q_27185.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for the NR SA FR2 cell re-selection test case?
q_27185.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirement is specified in clause 7.1.1.0.1 of TS 38.133.

q_27186.question: What action should the UE take upon receiving a SECURITY MODE COMMAND message or an indication from the lower layers that the user plane radio bearers are set up successfully, in clause 5.6.1.1, cases a, b, and c?
q_27186.ground_truth: The UE should start timer T3449 upon receipt of the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message or the user plane radio bearers set up indication, and wait for a SERVICE ACCEPT message to arrive.

q_27187.question: What is the condition for passing the UE in step 5?
q_27187.ground_truth: The condition for passing the UE in step 5 is if the ratio of NACK to (ACK + NACK) is greater than 0.1.

q_27188.question: How does a UE determine the resource allocation granularity and precoding granularity in terms of PRB pairs in the frequency domain for a PDSCH transmission in a cell?
q_27188.ground_truth: The UE assumes the resource allocation granularity and precoding granularity in terms of PRB pairs in the frequency domain to be N, where N is given by the higher layer parameter resAllocGranularity-r12 associated with the cell, for any PDSCH transmission scheduled by a cell with a given physical cell identity and transmission mode.

q_27189.question: What conditions does the network need to provide via RRC indication for activating/deactivating Pre-MG pattern through the network-controlled activation/deactivation mechanism?
q_27189.ground_truth: The network should provide the activation/deactivation status via RRC indication preConfGapStatus for all the DL BWPs of all the activated CCs, and for all the deactivated SCCs.

q_27190.question: What are the two approaches discussed for self-interference leakage evaluation in the gNB RX subband in FR2-1?
q_27190.ground_truth: The two approaches for self-interference leakage evaluation in the gNB RX subband in FR2-1 are IM3 analysis and direct leakage mitigation techniques.

q_27191.question: What is the minimum requirement for in-channel selectivity for E-UTRA in the context of MSR operation?
q_27191.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for in-channel selectivity for E-UTRA in the context of MSR operation is specified in subclause 10.9.4.

q_27192.question: What is the requirement for the interruption time in intra-frequency or inter-frequency handover from NR FR1 cell to NR FR1 cell, as specified in clause 6.1.1.2.1?
q_27192.ground_truth: The requirement for the interruption time in intra-frequency or inter-frequency handover from NR FR1 cell to NR FR1 cell, as specified in clause 6.1.1.2.1, is that the UE shall start transmission of the new PRACH within Dhandover milliseconds from the end of the last TTI containing the RRC command, where Dhandover is the applicable RRC procedure delay plus the interruption time.

q_27193.question: When should a UE initiate the UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure for the S-NSSAI in a partially allowed NSSAI?
q_27193.ground_truth: If the current TAI is in the list of TAs for which the S-NSSAI is allowed, the UE can initiate the UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure for the S-NSSAI.

q_27194.question: What is the purpose of the "Use cases" subclause in the Management service template?
q_27194.ground_truth: The "Use cases" subclause describes the motivation for requirements and the benefits of the management capability. Each use case is labelled and should describe what the capability is good for, rather than how to use a certain feature.

q_27195.question: What should the AMF set the Paging restriction bit to, if the network decides to accept the paging restriction and the UE has set the Follow-on request indicator to "Follow-on request pending" in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message?
q_27195.ground_truth: The AMF should set the paging restriction bit to "paging restriction supported" in the 5GS network feature support IE of the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message if the network decides to accept the paging restriction, and the UE has set the Follow-on request indicator to "Follow-on request pending" in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

q_27196.question: What should the AMF do when it receives a REGISTRATION REQUEST message with 5GS registration type IE set to "mobility registration updating" or "periodic registration updating" before the REGISTRATION COMPLETE message, if the REGISTRATION COMPLETE message is expected?
q_27196.ground_truth: The AMF should stop T3550 and start the registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update.

q_27197.question: In which direction does the network provide the MSISDN if available?
q_27197.ground_truth: In the network to MS direction

q_27198.question: Who is responsible for validating the user's service profile in S-CSCF#1?
q_27198.ground_truth: S-CSCF#1 is responsible for validating the user's service profile and may invoke appropriate service control logic.

q_27199.question: What is the role of the system simulator (SS) in the test procedure for RRC re-establishment?
q_27199.ground_truth: The system simulator (SS) is used as a trigger for the completion of the test and it receives the PRACH for the completion of the test.

q_27200.question: What message is displayed when the command to dial a URI is executed successfully?

q_27201.question: What is the purpose of the detailed call flow in 6.37.3.1-1 for (re)locating the same EAS to a collection of UEs?
q_27201.ground_truth: The purpose of the detailed call flow is to ensure that the same EAS IP address is applied to all the UEs in the group, allowing for changes in DNAI due to UE mobility or AF influence.

q_27202.question: What is the mean and 5% UL Average-UPT gain for operator 2 when using SBFD Alt 4 and large packet size at low load level?
q_27202.ground_truth: The mean and 5% UL Average-UPT gain for operator 2 when using SBFD Alt 4 and large packet size at low load level are 154.62% and 24.88%, respectively.

q_27203.question: What should be the Expiry Time of the PSDKs when they are provided to the UE?
q_27203.ground_truth: The Expiry Time of the PSDKs needs to be set such that the keys for later periods have a longer expiration period. Each PSDK for each Key Type ID shall be associated with a different Expiry Time value.

q_27204.question: When is a UE not allowed to attempt to attach after receiving a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message?
q_27204.ground_truth: When the UE is in EMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH state and detects a cell belonging to the same PLMN which is stored in the "forbidden PLMNs for GPRS service" list.

q_27205.question: What is the purpose of MCCH in 5G network?
q_27205.ground_truth: MCCH is a PTM downlink channel used for transmitting MBS broadcast or MBS multicast control information associated with one or several MTCH from the network to the UE.

q_27206.question: What is the format of the Communication-Pattern-Set, and which values are mandatory when the Periodic-Communication-Indicator is set to PERIODICALLY?
q_27206.ground_truth: The Communication-Pattern-Set is of type Grouped and shall contain a set of Communication-Pattern. If the Periodic-Communication-Indicator is set to PERIODICALLY, the Communication-duration-time and Periodic-Time values are mandatory.

q_27207.question: What action is taken by the source eNB upon reception of the HANDOVER REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message, if the procedure was initiated for an immediate handover?
q_27207.ground_truth: The source eNB shall start the timer TX2RELOCoverall and defines a Prepared Handover for that X2 UE-associated signalling.

q_27208.question: What is the split AI/ML operation in the image recognition task based on?
q_27208.ground_truth: The split AI/ML operation in the image recognition task is based on the legacy model during the development or invocation of the model.

q_27209.question: What is the fundamental building block of the Service Based Management Architecture (SBMA)?
q_27209.ground_truth: The fundamental building block of the SBMA is the Management Service (MnS).

q_27210.question: What is the effect of PDU session management functionality on PEGC?
q_27210.ground_truth: PDU session management functionality can be used by the PEGC to map PIN or PIN packets to an existing PDU session or establish a new PDU session when new packets (PIN signalling or PIN traffic or creation of PIN) are detected from a device in the PIN.

q_27211.question: How does 5GC GMLC interconnect with EPC for MT-LR Location Request?
q_27211.ground_truth: 5GC GMLC interconnects with EPC for MT-LR Location Request when a LCS service request is received by the 5GC GMLC and the target UE is served by EPC in non-roaming case, and when an LCS request is received by the 5GC GMLC in the HPLMN of the target UE and the target UE is served by EPC in the VPLMN in roaming case.

q_27212.question: What type of requests are sent from a serving AMF for the target UE to an LMF in the NL1 reference point?
q_27212.ground_truth: Location requests are sent from a serving AMF for the target UE to an LMF in the NL1 reference point.

q_27213.question: Under what conditions will the +CGPIAF command affect the format of the IPv6 address returned by +CGPADDR?
q_27213.ground_truth: The format of the IPv6 address returned by +CGPADDR is influenced by the +CGPIAF command only when it is supported.

q_27214.question: What should the AMF do when it has initiated a NGAP UE Context Modification procedure in order to take a new KgNB into use and receives a request for an inter-AMF handover from the serving gNB/ng-eNB?
q_27214.ground_truth: The AMF should wait for the (successful or unsuccessful) completion of the UE Context Modification procedure before initiating an inter-AMF handover.

q_27215.question: What is the role of UPF in handling PDU sets based on their dependency?
q_27215.ground_truth: UPF buffers the PDU set for a period, determines the importance of a PDU set based on backward dependency, and retransmits or drops the PDU set accordingly. If a PDU set is not transmitted successfully, the UPF may drop all dependent PDU sets to save RAN and N3 resources.

q_27216.question: What is the size of the Format field in the MAC header for SL-SCH?
q_27216.ground_truth: The size of the Format field in the MAC header for SL-SCH is 1 bit.

q_27217.question: What conditions must be met for the requirements in clause 9.9.6 to apply to UE PRS-RSRPP measurements?
q_27217.ground_truth: The requirements in clause 9.9.6 apply for periodic and triggered PRS-RSRPP measurements, provided PRS-RSRPP related side conditions given in clause 10.1.38 are met for a corresponding Band.

q_27218.question: What is the required SNR at UCI block error probability not exceeding 1% for BS type 1-O and BS type 2-O?
q_27218.ground_truth: The required SNR at UCI block error probability not exceeding 1% is defined in clauses 8.3.4.5.1, 8.3.4.5.2, 8.3.5.5.1, and 8.3.5.5.2.

q_27219.question: What should be the alignment of the manufacturer declared coordinate system orientation of the BS with the test system for the OTA test setup?
q_27219.ground_truth: The manufacturer declared coordinate system orientation of the BS should be aligned with the test system for the OTA test setup.

q_27220.question: What is the definition of ON power, as specified in clause 6.3E.3.2?
q_27220.ground_truth: The ON power is defined as the mean power over the duration of at least one slot excluding any transient period and non-transmitted symbols.

q_27221.question: In which case should the UE notify the user that emergency session cannot be established?
q_27221.ground_truth: The UE should notify the user that emergency session cannot be established if the DNS response does not contain any record, or if the DNS response contains one or more records but the UE fails to select a PLMN that supports emergency services in non-3GPP access, or if the Emergency Registration procedure has failed for all PLMNs supporting emergency services in non-3GPP access.

q_27222.question: What should the UE do if it receives a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message with reject cause #97 "message type non-existent or not implemented"?
q_27222.ground_truth: The UE sets the tracking area updating attempt counter to 5, starts timer T3402, and performs tracking area updating on the expiry of timers T3402.

q_27223.question: What is the role of the VAE capabilities in file distribution to the V2X application specific layer?
q_27223.ground_truth: The VAE capabilities provide support for file distribution to the V2X application specific layer. The VAE capabilities abstract the aspects like file chunking, QoE management, file delivery from the V2X application specific layer.

q_27224.question: What is the parameter used to retrieve the LO position from the parameter txDirectCurrentLocation in UplinkTxDirectCurrent IE?
q_27224.ground_truth: The parameter used to retrieve the LO position from the parameter txDirectCurrentLocation in UplinkTxDirectCurrent IE is the LO position.

q_27225.question: What message does the TNAN send towards the UE via the TNAP upon completion of successful authentication and on reception of the acknowledgement from the UE that it had received the access network parameters?

q_27226.question: What is the maximum data rate supported by PTP Transmission for MBS multicast data delivery?
q_27226.ground_truth: PTP Transmission for MBS multicast data delivery supports a lossless transmission at the maximum data rate supported by the channel.

q_27227.question: What is the difference between intra-band contiguous and non-contiguous carrier aggregation?
q_27227.ground_truth: In intra-band contiguous carrier aggregation, contiguous carriers are aggregated in the same operating band. In contrast, intra-band non-contiguous carrier aggregation involves aggregation of non-contiguous carriers in the same operating band.

q_27228.question: What action should the IRI-POI in the AMF take when it detects that the UE policies forwarded to a target UE have been accepted by the UE?
q_27228.ground_truth: The IRI-POI in the AMF should generate an xIRI containing an AMFUEPolicyTransfer record when it detects this event.

q_27229.question: When should the regular discontinuous reception as defined in clause~5.13 be used rather than the extended idle mode DRX?
q_27229.ground_truth: The regular discontinuous reception should be used if the UE has bearers for emergency bearer services or if the UE is attached for RLOS services.

q_27230.question: What is the purpose of the Paging Cause Indication for Voice Service feature in IAB operation?
q_27230.ground_truth: The Paging Cause Indication for Voice Service feature in IAB operation is used to indicate Voice Service in the S1AP paging message only if the UE indicates support for the feature, allowing the UE to determine whether the Paging Cause Indication for Voice Service feature is supported in the current Tracking Area.

q_27231.question: What should the NF Service Consumer do if the SMF indicated in the request that the SM context resource is updated with the anType IE in the Send MO Data service operation?
q_27231.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer should change the access type of the PDU session with the value of anType IE.

q_27232.question: What should the HSS do to request the identity and location information of the access network where the UE is currently attached?
q_27232.ground_truth: The HSS shall set the Access-Network-Info-Request bit in the PPR-Flags AVP bit to request the identity and location information of the access network where the UE is currently attached. In this case, the HSS shall only invoke this procedure if the 3GPP AAA Server has indicated support for the corresponding feature.

q_27233.question: What are the procedures for processing a registration request with hosting network re-registration information in the home network?
q_27233.ground_truth: The home network AMF receives a REGISTRATION REQUEST message from the UE, determines the local hosting network-specific back-off timer range, assigns a back-off timer value to the UE, and sends a REGISTRATION REJECT message to the UE with the anti-congestion information. The UE waits until the expiry of the back-off timer value and repeats the registration request procedure.

q_27234.question: What should be done when the UE supports single xDD mode and UEScapabilityInformation includes the field fdd-Add-UE-EUTRA-Capabilities and tdd-Add-UE-EUTRA-Capabilities?
q_27234.ground_truth: The fields of UECapabilityInformation, except fdd-Add-UE-EUTRA-Capabilities and tdd-Add-UE-EUTRA-Capabilities, should be set to include the values applicable for the xDD mode supported by the UE.

q_27235.question: When is the SDP answer recorded in case of a successful session setup during the first negotiation?
q_27235.ground_truth: It is recorded in case of successful session setup.

q_27236.question: What requirement should an SNRM-S follow when handling a CoAP DELETE request from a SNRM-C?
q_27236.ground_truth: The SNRM-S should follow the procedures specified in IETF RFC 7252 when handling a CoAP DELETE request from a SNRM-C, and it should respond with a CoAP 4.03 (Forbidden) response if the request is not valid.

q_27237.question: What is the method for determining the UE's in-sync or out-of-sync status in the test specified in clause 10.3.1?
q_27237.ground_truth: The UE's in-sync or out-of-sync status is determined based on the uplink signal, which is verified based on the UE output power. If the UE output power is higher than Transmit OFF power -50 dBm, it is considered an uplink signal, and if it is equal to or less than Transmit OFF power -50 dBm, it is considered no uplink signal.

q_27238.question: What is the minimum total number of carrier frequency layers that a UE indicating support for increased UE carrier monitoring E-UTRA or increased UE carrier monitoring UTRA must be capable of monitoring?
q_27238.ground_truth: A minimum of 12 carrier frequency layers, consisting of any combination of E-UTRA FDD, E-UTRA TDD, UTRA FDD, UTRA TDD, GSM, cdma2000 1x, HRPD layers.

q_27239.question: What does the UDM provide to the AUSF if the Default Credentials Server (DCS) provides the UDM with the information of a Provisioning Server (PVS FQDN(s) and/or IP address(es))?
q_27239.ground_truth: The UDM provides the PVS info to the AUSF.

q_27240.question: In section 11e, how many ways are there for the SS to observe DTX in order to meet the condition for the event "Deactivation" to be considered a failure?
q_27240.ground_truth: There are 7 ways for the SS to observe DTX in order to meet the condition for the event "Deactivation" to be considered a failure.

q_27241.question: What is the role of the Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF) in the EPS interworking procedures?
q_27241.ground_truth: The Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF) plays a vital role in the EPS interworking procedures. It is responsible for initiating the release of the 3GPP access resources for the MA PDU session which is not expected to be transferred to EPC, and for requesting the release of the MA PDU session which has resources established for 3GPP access, but not expected to be transferred to EPC. These actions play a crucial role in ensuring a smooth transition between 5GS and EPS.

q_27242.question: What should the UE include in the RRCConnectionReestablishmentComplete message under specific conditions?
q_27242.ground_truth: If the UE has radio link failure or handover failure information available in VarRLF-Report and if the RPLMN is included in plmn-IdentityList stored in VarRLF-Report, the UE should include the rlf-InfoAvailable in the RRCConnectionReestablishmentComplete message.

q_27243.question: What should the participating MCData function include in the P-Asserted-Identity header field of the outgoing SIP INVITE request?
q_27243.ground_truth: The public service identity of the participating MCData function

q_27244.question: What should the UE do when the periodical reporting timer expires for a measId?
q_27244.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the measurement reporting procedure, as specified in 5.5.5.

q_27245.question: What should the MCData user interface display if a specific condition is met during an MCData emergency private communication?
q_27245.ground_truth: If the SIP INVITE request contains an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body with the <mcdatainfo> element containing the <mcdata-Params> element containing a <request-type> element set to a value of "one-to-one-fd" and also containing an <emergency-ind> element set to a value of "true", then the MCData user interface should display to the MCData user an indication that this is a SIP INVITE request for an MCData emergency private communication, the MCData ID of the originator of the MCData emergency private communication, and if the <alert-ind> element within the <mcdata-Params> element of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body is set to "true", an indication of the MCData emergency alert and associated information.

q_27246.question: What is the use of MLContext attribute on MLEntity?
q_27246.ground_truth: The MLContext attribute on MLEntity is a notifiable datatype that provides the ability to monitor changes in the ML context based on statistical properties of data.

q_27247.question: What is the purpose of the id-LMF-UE-Measurement-ID in E-CIDMeasurementInitiationFailure message?
q_27247.ground_truth: The id-LMF-UE-Measurement-ID in E-CIDMeasurementInitiationFailure message represents the unique measurement identifier that is used to identify the measurement.

q_27248.question: In the case of emergency services over Layer-2 U2N Relay, what information does the remote UE report to the network if the network is using Network provided Location Information (NPLI)?
q_27248.ground_truth: The remote UE reports the NCGI obtained from the Relay UE during the Discovery procedure and a confidence factor indicative of its distance from the Relay UE.

q_27249.question: What must be established and provided for the reporting of Trace data under all Trace Recording Sessions of the same Trace Session reported by the same data producer?
q_27249.ground_truth: A connection from the data producer to the data consumer and information about Trace Session.

q_27250.question: What is used to control the idle mode measurements on HRPD and 1xRTT in the E-UTRAN network?
q_27250.ground_truth: The intra-3GPP inter-RAT idle mode measurement control is re-used to control the idle mode measurements on HRPD and 1xRTT in the E-UTRAN network.

q_27251.question: What is the difference between the "time slot start" and "transaction start" in the context of data analytics?
q_27251.ground_truth: "Time slot start" refers to the beginning of a time period for which data analytics are requested, while "transaction start" refers to the start of a specific transaction with respect to data analytics.

q_27252.question: What is required before initiating the 5G ProSe direct link establishment procedure by the initiating UE?
q_27252.ground_truth: The initiating UE must receive a request to transmit a packet, be authorized for 5G ProSe direct communication, have an available link layer identifier, know the link layer identifier of the target UE, be in unicast mode, and the 5G ProSe direct link for the pair of peer application layer IDs must not already exist or must meet certain conditions.

q_27253.question: What is the purpose of provisioning security materials in solution #15?
q_27253.ground_truth: The purpose of provisioning security materials in solution #15 is to protect the information exchanged between UEs using group communication for a Ranging/SL Positioning service. The mechanism proposes to provision security materials to the UEs which belong to a particular group for a SL positioning service. By using the provisioned security materials, a UE in the group can send confidentiality and integrity protected messages that include information related to the SL positioning service, and other UEs in the same group can undo the protection of the received messages.

q_27254.question: What is the procedure for the E-UTRAN Initial Attach procedure for emergency services?
q_27254.ground_truth: The E-UTRAN Initial Attach procedure is used for emergency services by UEs that need to perform emergency services but cannot gain normal services from the network. These UEs are in a limited service state and shall indicate that the attach is to receive emergency services. UEs that are not in a limited service state should initiate normal initial attach when not already attached and shall initiate the UE Requested PDN Connectivity procedure to receive emergency EPS bearer services. The Initial Attach procedure may also be used to establish the first PDN connection over E-UTRAN when the UE already has active PDN connections over a non-3GPP access network and wants to establish simultaneous PDN connections to different APNs over multiple accesses. During the Attach procedure, a Multi-USIM UE may indicate to the MME a Requested IMSI Offset to avoid paging collisions.

q_27255.question: Who is responsible for V2X dynamic group information and ProSe Layer-2 Group ID assignment for application layer V2X dynamic group formation in off-network dynamic group creation?
q_27255.ground_truth: The VAE layer on the client supports the assignment of a ProSe Layer-2 Group ID for application layer V2X dynamic group formation in off-network dynamic group creation.

q_27256.question: In the indoor hotspot scenario, what percentage of PC1 UE can achieve a minimum SINR of 30 dB at the BS side at 39 GHz (n260)?

q_27257.question: What is the minimum requirement for IAB type 1-H in terms of receiving a wanted signal at its assigned channel while in the presence of an unwanted out-of-band interferer?
q_27257.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for IAB type 1-H is to verify the ability of the receiver to receive a wanted signal at its assigned channel at the TAB connector for IAB type 1-H in the presence of an unwanted interferer out of the operating band, which is a CW signal for out-of-band blocking.

q_27258.question: What is the UE requirement for the NR SA FR1-FR1 handover with unknown target cell test during time period T2?
q_27258.ground_truth: The UE shall start to transmit the PRACH to Cell 2 less than 132 ms from the beginning of time period T2.

q_27259.question: What are the two types of packet filters supported for V2X communication over PC5?
q_27259.ground_truth: The two types of packet filters supported for V2X communication over PC5 are the IP packet filter set and the V2X packet filter set.

q_27260.question: What is the condition for the IWF to send individual IWF group call request messages to the IWF for each affiliated LMR user in step 6 of subclause 10.3.3.3?
q_27260.ground_truth: The MCPTT server must have received individual affiliations from the group's LMR users.

q_27261.question: What IE indicates the cause of the requested UE-associated logical S1-connection release in the UE CONTEXT RELEASE REQUEST message?
q_27261.ground_truth: The cause value, e.g., "User Inactivity", "Radio Connection With UE Lost", etc.

q_27262.question: What HTTP status code should be returned if the requested resource does not exist when updating a parameter (e.g. PGW FQDN) in the SMF registration?

q_27263.question: What message does the AMF send to the UE after accepting the Registration Request for Onboarding SNPN in step 21?
q_27263.ground_truth: The AMF sends a Registration Accept message to the UE indicating that the Registration Request for Onboarding SNPN has been accepted.

q_27264.question: What should the MCVideo client do when the MCVideo user indicates a call should be released or rejected while waiting for a response to a received GROUP CALL BROADCAST message?
q_27264.ground_truth: In this case, the MCVideo client should release the stored current call type, ProSe per-packet priority, Last call type change time, and Last user to change call type. However, it should remain in the "T0: waiting for the call to establish" state.

q_27265.question: What is the condition that allows the PIN server to identify the new PINE which can take up the role of PEMC in case of PEMC replacement triggered by PIN server?
q_27265.ground_truth: The PEMC-2 PIN element has already indicated that it can act as PEMC during the registration process.

q_27266.question: In the context of session reactivation result error cause IE with a 5GMM cause set to #92 "insufficient user-plane resources for the PDU session", what should the UE do when it receives this error?
q_27266.ground_truth: The UE may initiate a registration procedure for mobility or periodic registration update after a certain time, or upon release of the N1 NAS signalling connection.

q_27267.question: What is the function of NG-RAN in relation to the transport network CNC?
q_27267.ground_truth: NG-RAN provides stream requirements to transport network CNC, and allocates separate tunnel end-point destination addresses per QoS Flow used for the N3 tunnels.

q_27268.question: How does the PEGC UE communicate the allocated IP address to the PIN Application server?
q_27268.ground_truth: The PEGC UE updates the PIN Application server about the allocated IP address through the application layer over the user plane.

q_27269.question: What is the meaning of the term "normative" in the context of 3GPP Technical Specifications?
q_27269.ground_truth: In the context of 3GPP Technical Specifications, "normative" refers to mandatory requirements or interdictions.

q_27270.question: What should a participating MCData function do if the public service identity of the controlling MCData function for the adhoc group data communication service of SDS cannot be identified?
q_27270.ground_truth: A participating MCData function should reject the SIP INVITE request with a SIP 404 (Not Found) response with the warning text "142 unable to determine the controlling function" in a Warning header field if it is unable to identify the public service identity of the controlling MCData function for the adhoc group data communication service.

q_27271.question: What is the expected action when the UE receives a DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message with any valid ESM cause in 22.6.1.1.1 (6)?
q_27271.ground_truth: The UE deactivates the default EPS bearer context for this PDN connection between the UE and the SS.

q_27272.question: What should be the disposition type in the Content-Disposition header field if the P-CSCF includes an IM CN subsystem XML body containing an "<ims-3gpp>" element?
q_27272.ground_truth: The disposition type in the Content-Disposition header field should be "render".

q_27273.question: What action should the MCPTT client take when it receives a SIP re-INVITE request within the pre-established session targeted by the sent SIP REFER request, and if the received SIP re-INVITE request contains an SDP offer including an a=key-mgmt attribute field with a "mikey" attribute value containing a MIKEY-SAKKE I_MESSAGE?
q_27273.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should extract the MCPTT ID of the sender of the SIP 200 (OK) response from the initiator field (IDRi) of the I_MESSAGE. Then, it should convert the MCPTT ID to a UID and validate the signature of the MIKEY-SAKKE I_MESSAGE using the UID.

q_27274.question: What should the UE do if all received MsgBs contain Random Access Preamble identifiers that do not match the transmitted Random Access Preamble after successfully receiving the PDCCH addressed to UE containing a fallbackRAR MAC subPDU in the 4-step RA type?
q_27274.ground_truth: The UE shall perform the Random Access Resource selection procedure for the next available PRACH occasion and transmit the preamble with the calculated MsgA PRACH and MsgA PUSCH transmission power if the UL CCA is successful.

q_27275.question: What are the key areas of improvement for AI/ML applications in the 5G system with on-board AI inference?
q_27275.ground_truth: The key areas of improvement are high-quality audio and video content analysis and enhancement, real-time on-demand downloads of large AI/ML models, and providing services relying on downloads on end-user devices based on user preferences and device characteristics.

q_27276.question: Which RFC defines a Diameter protocol application used for Authentication, Authorization and Accounting (AAA) services in the NAS environment?

q_27277.question: What is the role of the PGW Restart Notification feature in handling a PGW failure?
q_27277.ground_truth: The PGW Restart Notification feature enables the SGW to initiate the cleanup of hanging PDN connections associated with the failed PGW and the corresponding MMEs/S4-SGSNs.

q_27278.question: What operations are suspended when a UE performs GNSS acquisition and resumed when it is completed?
q_27278.ground_truth: AS operations such as RLM related timers, dataInactivityTimer, CHO execution, neighbor cell measurement, RACH, SR, and BSR are suspended when a UE performs GNSS acquisition and resumed when it is completed.

q_27279.question: What is the first action taken by the MCPTT server when checking a private call request?
q_27279.ground_truth: The MCPTT server first checks if the MCPTT user at the MCPTT client is authorized and able to receive the private call.

q_27280.question: What does the "NSSAI DELETE REQUEST" message do in the "NSSAI delete messages" section?
q_27280.ground_truth: The "NSSAI DELETE REQUEST" message is used to delete NSSAI (Network Slice Selection Assistance Information) stored information from the UE in E-UTRA-PC5 communications.

q_27281.question: What is the purpose of applying psophometric noise weighting in the measurement?
q_27281.ground_truth: The purpose of applying psophometric noise weighting in the measurement is to make the results more reliable and consistent, particularly when there is a variation in speech coding and voice processing.

q_27282.question: What defines the transient period(s) allowed between transmit OFF power and transmit ON power symbols?
q_27282.ground_truth: The transmit power time mask defines the transient period(s) allowed between transmit OFF power as defined in clause 6.3F.2 and transmit ON power symbols (transmit ON/OFF).

q_27283.question: Which two aspects should be considered before the conclusion of Solution~11 regarding data privacy and security issues?
q_27283.ground_truth: Whether data privacy and security issues exist or not when raw data or analytics is exchanged between the H-PLMN and V-PLMN, and how to solve potential issues.

q_27284.question: What is the purpose of the Local Identifier in an External Identifier?
q_27284.ground_truth: The Local Identifier in an External Identifier is used to derive or obtain the IMSI, and is managed by the Mobile Network Operator. It is unique within the applicable domain.

q_27285.question: What is the role of the 5G PKMF in 5G System?
q_27285.ground_truth: The 5G PKMF is responsible for handling network related actions required for the key management and the security material for discovery and communication between 5G ProSe UEs.

q_27286.question: What information is included in the MCPTT private call request from the MCPTT server to the IWF?
q_27286.ground_truth: The MCPTT private call request includes the MCPTT IDs of the calling and called parties, an SDP offer containing one or more media types, and other parameters such as encryption algorithm and indication of floor request.

q_27287.question: What is the test purpose defined in clause 16.5.2.6?
q_27287.ground_truth: The test purpose is to verify that the UE properly detects CSI-RS-based beam failure and performs correct CSI-RS-based link recovery for an FR1 serving cell with 2 Rx UE and no DRX mode.

q_27288.question: How many packet filters should the SMF assigning the QoS rules consider that the UE supports for the corresponding PDU session in S1 mode?

q_27289.question: What action does the AMF take when cancelling a location request before the UE becomes reachable?
q_27289.ground_truth: The AMF skips steps 10-18 and returns an indication of location cancelation to the VGMLC or (H)GMLC.

q_27290.question: What is the role of the W-AGF in the 5G-RG or network requested PDU Session Release procedure via W-5GAN?
q_27290.ground_truth: The W-AGF can trigger the release of the corresponding W-UP resource when it receives an AN session release request message from the AMF requesting release of the PDU Session.

q_27291.question: What happens if the UE requests multi-connection mode and this request is accepted by the network?
q_27291.ground_truth: If the UE requests multi-connection mode and this request is accepted by the network, the UE is made aware if non-seamless WLAN offload is authorized and receives the address or prefix of the non-seamless WLAN offload connection as part of steps 9 and 15. In multi-connection mode, steps 3-7 and steps 10-14 are skipped.

q_27292.question: What is the difference between Equivalent Home Service Providers (EHSP) and Preferred Service Provider List (PSPL) in Home Network Preferences?
q_27292.ground_truth: EHSP contains a list of service providers equivalent to the HPLMN, used for PLMN selection over WLAN. PSPL is a prioritized list of preferred service providers for WLAN roaming, used for WLAN and PLMN selection.

q_27293.question: What protocol is used as the transport protocol in the control plane over Sxa, Sxb, Sxc, combined Sxa/Sxb, N4 and N4mb reference points?

q_27294.question: What are the technologies used for ranging in the finding pets use case?
q_27294.ground_truth: The technologies used are Two-Way Ranging (TWR), Time Difference of Arrival (TDoA), and Phase Difference of Arrival (PDoA), all of which measure the Time of Flight (ToF) between two radio transceivers.

q_27295.question: What is the role of the V2X application server in the functional model?
q_27295.ground_truth: The V2X application server provides the server-side functionalities corresponding to the V2X applications. It utilizes the VAE server for the V2X application layer support functions and communicates with the V2X UEs over V1 reference point.

q_27296.question: What is the objective of the TDD Intra Frequency Absolute RSRQ Accuracy test?
q_27296.ground_truth: To verify that the TDD intra frequency absolute RSRQ measurement accuracy is within the specified limit for all TDD bands.

q_27297.question: What is the condition that should be met for the delay requirement of PUCCH SCell activation to apply?
q_27297.ground_truth: The delay requirement applies provided that the target pathloss reference signal determined during PUCCH SCell activation is known, the RA on PUCCH SCell is not interrupted by the RA on PCell, and no SRS carrier based switching or SRS antenna port switching occurs during the SCell activation procedure.

q_27298.question: What message does the source MME send to the target SGSN during the relocation of PS bearers?
q_27298.ground_truth: Forward Relocation Request (Source to Target Transparent Container, MM Context, PDN Connections IE)

q_27299.question: In what scenario does the 5GMS AF get invoked with the optional "media-entry-point" query parameter?
q_27299.ground_truth: The 5GMS AF gets invoked with the optional "media-entry-point" query parameter in collaboration scenarios where the 5GMS AF is deployed in the Trusted DN.

q_27300.question: Under what conditions will the UE reselect a cell with a lower priority RAT/frequency compared to the current serving cell?
q_27300.ground_truth: The UE reselects the cell with a lower priority RAT/frequency if the serving cell fulfills Squal < ThreshServing, LowQ and a cell with a lower priority RAT/frequency fulfills Srxlev > ThreshX, LowP or Squal > ThreshX, LowP during a time interval TreselectionRAT, and more than 1 second has passed since the UE camped on the current serving cell.

q_27301.question: What is the default value for carrierType-r14 in the ASN.1 definition?
q_27301.ground_truth: The default value for carrierType-r14 in the ASN.1 definition is mbms.

q_27302.question: What should a UE do when it receives a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message with EMM cause value #12 "Tracking area not allowed"?
q_27302.ground_truth: The UE sets the EPS update status to EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, deletes certain stored information, stores the current TAI in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service", and enters the state EMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE.

q_27303.question: How is the SECAM catalogue constructed?
q_27303.ground_truth: The SECAM catalogue is constructed iteratively, while working on SCASs for specific network product classes. Security requirements that are found useful for a specific network product class are added to the catalogue to be reused in the normative phase of other network product classes. This catalogue does not include any requirements before they have been found useful for a specific network product class.

q_27304.question: What is the 5G Access Stratum-based Time Distribution used for in 5G systems?
q_27304.ground_truth: It is used for NG RAN synchronization and is also distributed to the User Equipment (UE).

q_27305.question: What is the purpose of the "shall" and "shall not" constructions in 3GPP documents?
q_27305.ground_truth: The "shall" and "shall not" constructions indicate mandatory requirements and interdictions (prohibitions) in normative elements of 3GPP documents.

q_27306.question: What is the range of values for the "/<x>/<x>/Common/MCPTTGroupLevel" and "/<x>/<x>/Common/UserLevel" elements?
q_27306.ground_truth: The range of values for the "/<x>/<x>/Common/MCPTTGroupLevel" and "/<x>/<x>/Common/UserLevel" elements is 0-255.

q_27307.question: When can the SMF perform maximum group data rate limitation control?
q_27307.ground_truth: The SMF can perform maximum group data rate limitation control to 5G VN groups when the maximum data rate of PDU sessions associated within a 5G VN group has been exceeded. The SMF can reject the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message against the 5G VN group using S-NSSAI based congestion control in this case.

q_27308.question: Which UE is this test case applicable to?
q_27308.ground_truth: This test case applies to all types of NR UE from release 16 onwards and supporting relaxed measurement.

q_27309.question: Which SIP role is required by the UE, with exceptions and additional capabilities in SDP and SigComp described in subclause 5.1, 6.1, and 8.1?
q_27309.ground_truth: The UE provides the User Equipment role in SIP with the exceptions and additional capabilities described in subclause 5.1, 6.1, and 8.1.

q_27310.question: What should the Content-Type header field be set to in the HTTP POST request?
q_27310.ground_truth: The Content-Type header field should be set to "application/vnd.3gpp.vae-info+xml".

q_27311.question: What should the SMF do when it receives a PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST message with the "ed" parameter set to "IE" in the access type IE?
q_27311.ground_truth: The SMF should proceed with both the UE-requested and network-requested PDU session release procedures.

q_27312.question: What is the input to the integrity protection algorithm for the NAS ciphering algorithm?
q_27312.ground_truth: The input to the integrity protection algorithm for the NAS ciphering algorithm is the bearer ID, direction bit, NAS COUNT, NAS encryption key, and the length of the key stream to be generated by the encryption algorithm.

q_27313.question: What is the format of the External Group Identifier?
q_27313.ground_truth: The format of the External Group Identifier is "<Local Identifier>@<Domain Identifier>".
