q_27314.question: What is the result if the timer T3594 expires and the SMF has sent the SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message four times without a response from the UE?
q_27314.ground_truth: The SMF shall abort the procedure and send a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message with the 5GSM cause #29 "user authentication or authorization failed" to the UE.

q_27315.question: What is the function of the "tra-SCTP-association" SDP attribute in the AS?
q_27315.ground_truth: The "tra-SCTP-association" SDP attribute in the AS helps determine which media streams need to be multiplexed into the same SCTP association when interacting with MRF.

q_27316.question: What is the purpose of the Error Vector Magnitude (EVM) measurement for SUL, as specified in section 6.4C.2.1.4?
q_27316.ground_truth: The purpose of this measurement is to verify the test requirement for EVM measured on the SUL carrier.

q_27317.question: What should the MCVideo server do upon receiving a SIP PUBLISH request with an application/pidf+xml MIME body indicating per-user functional alias information?
q_27317.ground_truth: The MCVideo server should identify the served MCVideo ID and the originating MCVideo ID in the SIP PUBLISH request, and if they match, send a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response or a SIP 423 (Interval Too Brief) response with a Min-Expires header field set to 4294967295. If the Expires header field has a nonzero value, the MCVideo server should determine the candidate expiration interval.

q_27318.question: When selecting a new synchronization reference source, what should the UE be synchronized to directly?
q_27318.ground_truth: The UE should be always synchronized to GNSS directly during the evaluation of GNSS synchronization source reliability.

q_27319.question: Who is the owner of the group-broadcast group in the procedure for group-broadcast group call with an interworking group defined in the MCPTT system?
q_27319.ground_truth: The MCPTT server is the owner of the group-broadcast group in the procedure for group-broadcast group call with an interworking group defined in the MCPTT system.

q_27320.question: What is the coordination type in 5G SgNB?
q_27320.ground_truth: The type of coordination between cells in a 5G network

q_27321.question: What are the main impacts on the SMF in terms of signaling for this solution?
q_27321.ground_truth: The main impacts on the SMF include supporting signaling for transmission opportunities request and information, as well as translating the start of frame indication from the 5G internal clock reference to the external clock reference.

q_27322.question: What is the meaning of the term "Background Data Transfer (BDT)" in the context of the present document?
q_27322.ground_truth: The term "Background Data Transfer (BDT)" refers to procedures for negotiating services in the 5GS that save network resources and reduce device energy consumption in the context of the present document.

q_27323.question: What notifications are supported by the OperatorEdgeFederation IOC?
q_27323.ground_truth: The OperatorEdgeFederation IOC supports the common notifications defined in clause 5.5 of TS 28.541, without exceptions or additions.

q_27324.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for the UE transmit timing accuracy, as per clause 4.4.1.1.3, in the 3GPP 5G specifications?
q_27324.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirement is specified in clause 4.4.1.0.1.

q_27325.question: What is the function of the Slice-specific N3IWF prefix information for the HPLMN and VPLMN in the N3IWF selection solution?
q_27325.ground_truth: The Slice-specific N3IWF prefix information is used to provide a list of supported S-NSSAIs and a prefix to be added to the existing Tracking Area (TA) or Operator Identifier (OI) FQDNs. The UE uses this information during N3IWF selection procedure to determine an appropriate N3IWF that supports the S-NSSAI(s) needed by the UE.

q_27326.question: What network architecture is used for the network architecture corresponding to the display AR glasses-based device architecture without edge rendering?
q_27326.ground_truth: The AR/MR Application, Scene Manager and Media Access Function reside on the 5G Device, and an XR Runtime API is on the 5G Device, and the XR Runtime is on the AR Glasses Device, and the interactions between the XR Runtime API and the XR Runtime are proprietary for the network architecture corresponding to the display AR glasses-based device architecture without edge rendering.

q_27327.question: What should the eNB do, if the Paging Message includes a list of CSG IDs?
q_27327.ground_truth: The eNB may use the list of CSG IDs to avoid paging the UE at CSG cells whose CSG ID does not appear in the list.

q_27328.question: What must the UE include in the de-registration request to indicate a redirection to a hosting network is preferred?
q_27328.ground_truth: The UE includes a de-registration request message with cause "redirection is requested" in the message to indicate a redirection to a hosting network is preferred.

q_27329.question: What message is sent by the AMF to the NG-RAN node to confirm the cancellation of an ongoing handover?

q_27330.question: What information does the SSRC field carry in the Remote Transmission request message?
q_27330.ground_truth: The SSRC field in the Remote Transmission request message carries the RTCP SSRC of the sending transmission control entity.

q_27331.question: How many times can the "any-mbms-sa-change" element appear in the "tMbmsSaChangeType" complex type?
q_27331.ground_truth: The "any-mbms-sa-change" element can appear 0 or 1 times in the "tMbmsSaChangeType" complex type.

q_27332.question: What should the UE do when it receives a DETACH REQUEST message with the Detach type IE set to "re-attach not required" and with no EMM cause IE included, while being in the EMM-REGISTERED state?
q_27332.ground_truth: The UE should delete any GUTI, TAI list, last visited registered TAI, list of equivalent PLMNs, KSI, set the update status to EU2 NOT UPDATED and start timer T3402. When T3402 expires, the UE attempts to attach again.

q_27333.question: What must the HAAnF provide to the AF in step 4 of the AKMA procedure?
q_27333.ground_truth: The HAAnF provides the KAF and the KAF expiration time together with the SUPI of the UE to the AF in step 4 of the AKMA procedure.

q_27334.question: What is the trigger scope value that indicates that the media interception is to be done bidirectionally?
q_27334.ground_truth: The media interception is done bidirectionally when the TriggerScope value is "Bidirectional".

q_27335.question: What should a UE do when the current maxBW-Preference information for the cell group is different from the one indicated in the last transmission of the UEAssistanceInformation message?
q_27335.ground_truth: If the current maxBW-Preference information for the cell group is different from the one indicated in the last transmission of the UEAssistanceInformation message and timer T346b associated with the cell group is not running, then the UE should start the timer T346b and initiate transmission of the UEAssistanceInformation message in accordance with 5.7.4.3 to provide the current maxBW-Preference and/or maxBW-PreferenceFR2-2.

q_27336.question: Which functional entities are part of the application architecture for enabling PINAPP?
q_27336.ground_truth: The functional entities include PIN element with Management Capabilities (PEMC), PIN server, PIN element with Gateway Capabilities (PEGC), PIN client, and Application client.

q_27337.question: What is the role of the queue in the interfaces between the transmission and reception control interface towards the MCVideo client and the transmission request queue and between the transmission and reception control arbitration logic and the transmission request queue?
q_27337.ground_truth: The queue is used to store received Transmission Request messages in these interfaces. The interfaces also include requests to remove Transmission Request messages from the queue and indications that the queue is modified.

q_27338.question: What should the participating MCPTT function do if it receives a SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP re-INVITE request?
q_27338.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT function should generate a SIP 200 (OK) response with an SDP answer based on the SDP answer in the received SIP 200 (OK) response and send it to the MCPTT client.

q_27339.question: How is the NAS security context used in the Control Plane Optimization for 5GS CIoT?
q_27339.ground_truth: The NAS security context is used for integrity protection and ciphering of small user data or SMS using NAS messages in both uplink and downlink directions.

q_27340.question: What is a Multi-Access PDU (MA PDU) Session in 5G system?
q_27340.ground_truth: A MA PDU Session is a concept in 5G system that allows user-plane resources on two access networks (3GPP and non-3GPP) and applies network-provided policies for distributing uplink and downlink traffic across the two access networks.

q_27341.question: What is the maximum OTA channel bandwidth that the out-of-band emissions requirement applies to for a RIB operating in multi-carrier mode?
q_27341.ground_truth: The out-of-band emissions requirement applies to the SAN channel bandwidths of the outermost carrier.

q_27342.question: When can the network include the Back-off timer value IE and the Re-attempt indicator IE in the PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT message?
q_27342.ground_truth: The network can include the Back-off timer value IE and the Re-attempt indicator IE in the PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT message if the ESM cause value is different from #26, #28, #50, #51, #54, #57, #58, #61, #65, #66, #95 - #111, and #112, and the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message was received via a NAS signalling connection established with RRC establishment cause "High priority access AC 11 - 15".

q_27343.question: What type of virtual resource blocks are used in MPDCCH with DCI format 6-2 for scheduling and transmission?
q_27343.ground_truth: Localized virtual resource blocks are used in MPDCCH with DCI format 6-2 for scheduling and transmission.

q_27344.question: What type of discovery message is used by the Discoverer UE in the Group Member Discovery procedure for Model B?
q_27344.ground_truth: The Discoverer UE uses a Group Member Discovery Solicitation message in the Group Member Discovery procedure for Model B.

q_27345.question: What should the UE do when it receives an EMM cause value #13?
q_27345.ground_truth: The UE should set the EPS update status to EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED and delete any GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI list and eKSI. The UE should also delete the list of equivalent PLMNs and reset the attach attempt counter. The UE should enter the state EMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE or optionally EMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH.

q_27346.question: What is the method used by the BM-SC to retrieve the MPD in DASH service for Application mode?
q_27346.ground_truth: The BM-SC uses the application-entry-point-url to retrieve the MPD in DASH service for Application mode.

q_27347.question: What should the transmission participant do when a new instance of the 'Transmission participant state transition diagram for general reception control operation' is initiated?
q_27347.ground_truth: The transmission participant should create an instance of a 'Transmission participant state transition diagram for general reception control operation', and enter the 'U: reception controller' state.

q_27348.question: What is the purpose of the EAR mechanism in MC System?
q_27348.ground_truth: The EAR mechanism in MC System allows an MC client or MC network entity to verify the origin, target, and purpose of a signalling request and ensure that the origin is authorized to make such a request.

q_27349.question: What is the purpose of the "MDT PLMN List" IE in the 3GPP NG RAN protocol?
q_27349.ground_truth: The "MDT PLMN List" IE provides the list of PLMN allowed for MDT in the 3GPP NG RAN protocol.

q_27350.question: What is the purpose of the NSACF in the NS quota management solution based on Network Slice quota management between the CHF and the NSACF?
q_27350.ground_truth: The NSACF is responsible for managing the NS quota in the network slice quota management solution by communicating with the CCS for requesting more NS quota for the number of registered UEs.

q_27351.question: What is the maximum number of "Polygon" or "CircularArea" elements that the "PolygonListType" or "CircularAreaListType" complex type can contain?
q_27351.ground_truth: The "PolygonListType" or "CircularAreaListType" complex type can contain zero or more "Polygon" or "CircularArea" elements.

q_27352.question: Which TS specifies the Network Slice Management Charging related to the Converged Charging System (CCS)?

q_27353.question: What happens in the periodic or triggered MT-LR case if multiple location QoS is provided in the location request and there is a mapped location QoS?
q_27353.ground_truth: If the LCS QoS class in the location request is "multiple QoS class" and there is a mapped location QoS mapped by GMLC in the location request, the LMF includes the mapped location QoS in the UE response for area event reporting to EPC-GMLC or 5GC-GMLC for event reporting in the 5GS.

q_27354.question: What is the expression for the sensitivity in the measurement of a hand-held hands-free UE receiving?
q_27354.ground_truth: The sensitivity is expressed in terms of dBPa/V in the measurement of a hand-held hands-free UE receiving.

q_27355.question: What is the test coverage for different number of component carriers in 8.1.2.4?
q_27355.ground_truth: The test coverage for different number of component carriers is defined in 8.1.2.4.

q_27356.question: What is the purpose of the test in 7.7B.2 and 7.7B.2.1?
q_27356.ground_truth: The purpose of the test in 7.7B.2 and 7.7B.2.1 is to ensure that the UE has a spurious response within the specified limit.

q_27357.question: What response code will SGM-S send to SGM-C upon successful group registration?

q_27358.question: What procedure is used by an MCPTT UE to perform service authorization for MCPTT along with other MC services using SIP REGISTER?
q_27358.ground_truth: Multipart MIME bodies for each MC service are included in the SIP REGISTER request, and multiple contact addresses can be included in the SIP REGISTER request, provided they all contain the same IP address and port number.

q_27359.question: What should the UE do if the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message includes the "Negotiated PEIPS assistance parameters IE" and the UE has set the RCMAP bit to "Sending of REGISTRATION COMPLETE message for negotiated PEIPS assistance information supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message?
q_27359.ground_truth: The UE shall return a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF to acknowledge reception of the Negotiated PEIPS assistance parameters IE.

q_27360.question: Which element specifies the maximum duration of a non-real-time video mode?
q_27360.ground_truth: The "mcvideo-non-real-time-video-mode" element specifies the maximum duration of a non-real-time video mode.

q_27361.question: In Solution #2, what are the three procedures described for NPNACF based converged charging: registration, number of UEs threshold reached, and account and rating control?
q_27361.ground_truth: Registration, threshold checking and update, and account and rating control.

q_27362.question: What information is sent to the UE during PDN connection establishment in the EPC regarding the S-NSSAI associated with the PDN connection?
q_27362.ground_truth: The S-NSSAI associated with the PDN connection, a PLMN ID that the S-NSSAI relates to, and a combination of SMF+PGW-C address and APN are sent to the UE in PCO.

q_27363.question: In what scenarios does the network make the decision on what mobility protocol to use for connectivity during initial attach to a non-3GPP access?
q_27363.ground_truth: The network makes the decision on what mobility protocol to use for connectivity during initial attach to a non-3GPP access based on the capabilities indicated by the UE during network access authentication for trusted non-3GPP accesses, or authentication for tunnel establishment with ePDG for untrusted non-3GPP accesses.

q_27364.question: What is the name of the measurement that provides the average UL packet delay between PSA UPF and UE, including the D1 UL PDCP delay occurred in the UE, and is expressed in subcounters per S-NSSAI?
q_27364.ground_truth: This measurement is called "Average UL packet delay between PSA UPF and UE (including D1)".

q_27365.question: What does the MCVideo server include in the SIP NOTIFY request to indicate per-user affiliation information?
q_27365.ground_truth: The MCVideo server includes an application/pidf+xml MIME body in the SIP NOTIFY request to indicate per-user affiliation information.

q_27366.question: What is the name of the network interface entity (IED) that is required to stay "on" for a longer duration during abnormal conditions in a distributed energy resource (DER) interconnected with a utility power grid?

q_27367.question: What must the 5G-AN do if it cannot select an AMF based on the Requested NSSAI when routing NAS signalling from an UE?
q_27367.ground_truth: The 5G-AN must send the request to a default AMF.

q_27369.question: What is the purpose of transmitting UE policy container, UE parameters update transparent container or removing Paging Restriction Information in an area with service restriction?
q_27369.ground_truth: These transmissions are part of the mobility related service and are allowed in an area with service restriction.

q_27370.question: What action should the participating MCData function take if it cannot find a binding between the public user identity and an MCData ID?
q_27370.ground_truth: It shall reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 404 (Not Found) response and include the warning text "141 user unknown to the participating function" in a Warning header field.

q_27371.question: What are the commands supported between the SWd interface and SWa interface in the 3GPP AAA Proxy?
q_27371.ground_truth: The SWd interface supports authentication and authorization procedures, HSS/AAA initiated detach procedures, and untrusted non-3GPP access network initiated detach procedures. The SWa interface supports authentication and authorization procedures and HSS/AAA initiated detach procedures.

q_27372.question: How many carriers and cells are specified in the test procedure?
q_27372.ground_truth: There are two carriers and two cells specified in the test.

q_27373.question: Which clause provides the minimum conformance requirements for the tests defined in 6.5A.2.1 and 6.5A.2.2?
q_27373.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements are defined in clause 6.5A.2.1.0.

q_27374.question: What action does the MCVideo client take if it is in the "T1: in-progress emergency group call" state and receives a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message with specific conditions met?
q_27374.ground_truth: The MCVideo client sets the stored last call type change time, updates the stored call type, updates the stored ProSe per-packet priority, stops a specific timer, starts a different timer, and enters the "T1: in-progress emergency group call" state.

q_27375.question: What is the purpose of the 5.2.3.2.21 test case in the NR UE performance evaluation?
q_27375.ground_truth: The purpose of the 5.2.3.2.21 test case is to verify the UE performance in the HST-SFN Scheme B scenario.

q_27376.question: What is the role of Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) in XR applications?
q_27376.ground_truth: SLAM is a computational problem that involves creating or updating a map of an unknown environment while simultaneously keeping track of the user's location within that environment.

q_27377.question: What should the network do if it receives a Supported Codec List information element in a SETUP or EMERGENCY SETUP message for speech calls?
q_27377.ground_truth: The network shall use this list to select the codec for UTRAN.

q_27378.question: Which bit in the re-attempt indicator IE and its derivation is not applicable in an SNPN?
q_27378.ground_truth: The RATC bit in the re-attempt indicator IE and its derivation is not applicable in an SNPN.

q_27379.question: Which data types are defined in 3GPP TS 23.554 and referenced by the MSGin5G specifications?
q_27379.ground_truth: The BGMessageDelivery data type and its attributes, as well as several data types related to MSGin5G APIs, are defined in 3GPP TS 23.554 and referenced in the MSGin5G specifications.

q_27380.question: What is the format of ServedCellsToActivate in the CellActivationRequest message sequence?
q_27380.ground_truth: The ServedCellsToActivate is a component of the CellActivationRequest message sequence, which can take one of three formats: nr-cells, e-utra-cells, or a ProtocolIE-Single-Container containing additional information.

q_27381.question: Which network elements are associated with SGSN-InterfaceList?

q_27382.question: How can the SEALDD enabler layer ensure a guaranteed transmission quality (KI #3)?
q_27382.ground_truth: Solutions #9, #13, #14, and #15 address KI #3 by providing QoS information for the VAL server, transmission quality measurement, adjusting regular transmission, and using N6 packet header information for resource scheduling.

q_27383.question: What is the job of the SS in the test?
q_27383.ground_truth: The SS in the test is responsible for sending and receiving various messages to and from the UE, as well as enabling and disabling the CCA model, to test the UE's ability to make correct reporting of an event.

q_27384.question: What is the role of the spatial computing server in the XR conference system?
q_27384.ground_truth: The spatial computing server is used to store the layout of the physical space in the XR conference system.

q_27385.question: In the sidelink transmission procedure, what determines the PSCCH resource m for a UE when it always transmits PSCCH and the corresponding PSSCH in adjacent resource blocks in a subframe?
q_27385.ground_truth: The PSCCH resource m for a UE when it always transmits PSCCH and the corresponding PSSCH in adjacent resource blocks in a subframe is the set of two contiguous resource blocks with the physical resource block number for j=0 and 1, where startRBSubchannel and sizeSubchannel are higher layer parameters that determine the specific resource blocks used.

q_27386.question: What must the source Layer-2 ID and source IP address be changed over time and randomized in case of IP based V2X communication over PC5 reference point, if the UE has an active V2X application requiring privacy support?
q_27386.ground_truth: They must be changed over time and randomized to ensure that a source UE cannot be tracked or identified by any other UEs beyond a certain short time-period required by the application.

q_27387.question: What is the purpose of an exposed MnS discovery service?
q_27387.ground_truth: The exposed MnS discovery service allows interested authorized consumers to discover exposed MnS, which are only exposed to a discovery service entity with a pre-existing contract.

q_27388.question: What is the duration of time that the user equipment (UE) is required to transmit a measurement report containing the cell global identifier of cell 2, relative to the start of T3?
q_27388.ground_truth: The UE is required to transmit a measurement report containing the cell global identifier of cell 2 within 5120 ms from the start of T3.

q_27389.question: What does the NEF do in the case of roaming scenarios for monitoring events?
q_27389.ground_truth: In roaming scenarios, a roaming agreement needs to be made between the HPLMN and the VPLMN. If the AMF/SMF in the VPLMN determine that normalization of an event report is required, the AMF/SMF normalize the event report before sending it to the NEF.

q_27390.question: What is the name of the field in the NCR Downlink Backhaul Link Beam Indication MAC CE that indicates the downlink beam to be used for backhaul link transmission?

q_27391.question: What is defined in clause 4.7.3.1.5-1?
q_27391.ground_truth: Clause 4.7.3.1.5-1 defines the primary level settings including test tolerances for all tests.

q_27392.question: What status code and header does the HSS return in the case of redirection in sections 5.3.2.5.3, 5.3.2.5.4, and 5.3.2.7.x?
q_27392.ground_truth: In the case of redirection, the HSS returns 3xx status code, which shall contain a Location header with an URI pointing to the endpoint of another HSS (service) instance in sections 5.3.2.5.3, 5.3.2.5.4, and 5.3.2.7.x.

q_27393.question: When should the UE and the AMF start the periodic registration timer after completion of the Registration procedure?
q_27393.ground_truth: If the UE indicates its support of 'Strictly Periodic Registration Timer Indication' in the Registration Request message, the AMF may provide a Strictly Periodic Registration Timer Indication to the UE together with the periodic registration timer value, e.g. based on Expected UE Behaviour. After completion of the Registration procedure, the UE and the AMF shall start the periodic registration timer.

q_27394.question: What is the requirement for the ratio of successful reported RSRP values for the FDD inter-frequency absolute accuracy test to pass?
q_27394.ground_truth: The ratio of successful reported RSRP values for the FDD inter-frequency absolute accuracy test to pass must be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

q_27395.question: What does the reserved bit (R) in the LTM Cell Switch Command MAC CE stand for?
q_27395.ground_truth: The reserved bit R in the LTM Cell Switch Command MAC CE is reserved for future use, and should be set to 0.

q_27396.question: What is the rule for creating a binding of a functional alias with an MCPTT group for the MCPTT user?
q_27396.ground_truth: An MCPTT user can bind the same functional alias with multiple MCPTT groups, but an MCPTT user cannot bind multiple functional aliases to the same MCPTT group. Only activated functional aliases are used for creating a binding with a MCPTT group or list of MCPTT groups.

q_27397.question: What actions does the PCF take when it receives an updated policy from the AF?
q_27397.ground_truth: The PCF updates the corresponding policy information about the PDU Session, maps the SFC identifier to the corresponding Traffic Steering Policy identifier, and includes the Traffic Steering Policy ID in the relevant PCC rule.

q_27398.question: What are the requirements for the inter-band concurrent NR V2X operation's uplink in licensed band and sidelink in Band n47?
q_27398.ground_truth: The requirements specified in clause 6.3.4 shall apply for the uplink in licensed band and the requirements specified in clause 6.3E.4.1 and 6.3E.4.2 shall apply for the sidelink in Band n47.

q_27399.question: What is the minimum code domain power requirement for downlink power control in UTRA FDD test method?
q_27399.ground_truth: The minimum code domain power for downlink power control in UTRA FDD is TAB connector maximum output power (Pmax,c,TABC) -26.9 dB.

q_27400.question: What type of signal does the 5G System provide as an enhancement for timing resiliency solutions to satellite signal loss, jamming, or spoofing in power utility companies?
q_27400.ground_truth: The 5G System provides a timing resiliency service that can complement or act as a backup for GNSS timing services.

q_27401.question: What is the value of the "network name" parameter for EPS in the EAP-AKA' authentication method?
q_27401.ground_truth: The value of the "network name" parameter for EPS in the EAP-AKA' authentication method is "access network identity".

q_27402.question: What is the maximum number of PLMN supported in QMC?

q_27403.question: What is the test coverage for different numbers of component carriers in 8.13.3.5.1-4, 8.13.3.5.2-4, 8.13.3.6.1-4, 8.13.3.6.2-4, 8.13.3.7.1-4, and 8.13.3.7.2-4?
q_27403.ground_truth: The test coverage for different numbers of component carriers is defined in 8.1.2.4, but it is not specified in the mentioned sections.

q_27404.question: What is the syntax of the "g-3gpp-trf" feature-capability indicator when it is used in a Feature-Caps header field in a SIP INVITE request?
q_27404.ground_truth: The "g-3gpp-trf" feature-capability indicator follows the syntax "< SIP-URI >" when used in a Feature-Caps header field in a SIP INVITE request.

q_27405.question: How many preambles are defined in each time-frequency PRACH occasion?
q_27405.ground_truth: There are 64 preambles defined in each time-frequency PRACH occasion.

q_27406.question: What information does the LMF include in the request to the target UE when performing a location determination for a specific coordinate system?
q_27406.ground_truth: The LMF includes the Coordinate ID in the request to the target UE when performing a location determination for a specific coordinate system.

q_27407.question: How should the manufacturer declared coordinate system orientation of the IAB DU be aligned with the test system?
q_27407.ground_truth: The manufacturer declared coordinate system orientation of the IAB DU should be aligned with the test system.

q_27408.question: What action does the 5G ProSe Remote UE perform when successfully authenticating its connection with the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay?
q_27408.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe Remote UE sends the Direct Security Mode Complete message containing its PC5 user plane security policies to the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network relay, which is protected by Krelay-int derived from Krelay-sess.

q_27409.question: What steps should a participating MCData function follow when receiving a SIP INVITE request for MCData adhoc group session for originating participating MCData function?
q_27409.ground_truth: The participating MCData function should determine the MCData ID of the calling user, determine the public service identity of the controlling MCData function for the adhoc group data communication service, check if the user is authorised to initiate adhoc group data communications, generate a SIP INVITE request in accordance with 3GPP~TS~24.229, set the Request-URI to the public service identity of the controlling MCData function, include the option tag "timer" in the Supported header field, include the Session-Expires header field, copy the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body from the incoming SIP INVITE request to the outgoing SIP INVITE request, include the MCData ID of the originating user in the <mcdata-calling-user-id> element of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body of the outgoing SIP INVITE request.

q_27410.question: What does the source gNB do when the L2 U2N Remote UE reports one or multiple candidate L2 U2N Relay UE(s) for path switch in a service continuity scenario?
q_27410.ground_truth: The source gNB decides to trigger path switch for the L2 U2N Remote UE based on the MeasurementReport and RRM information, and sends a HANDOVER REQUEST message to the target gNB to prepare for the path switch at the target side.

q_27411.question: What should the proponent do if there are changes in the BCS sheet?
q_27411.ground_truth: The proponent should mark the changed fields in yellow and indicate "Modified" in the first column.

q_27412.question: What is the role of DCSF in anchoring application data channel in IMS?
q_27412.ground_truth: DCSF communicates with the DC Application Server for DC resource control when it determines that the added application data channel media of the offer takes the DC Application Server as the target endpoint, requiring anchoring in the local DCMF or enhanced MRF.

q_27413.question: What is the function of the MME in handling the S101 reference point for handovers to HRPD?
q_27413.ground_truth: The MME is responsible for selecting and maintaining the HRPD access node for handovers to HRPD, and handling the S101 reference point for the same.

q_27414.question: What are the initial conditions for the test procedure in 8.3.12.1.4.2?
q_27414.ground_truth: The initial conditions for the test procedure in 8.3.12.1.4.2 include a normal test environment, single carrier M RF channels to be tested, and the OTA REFSENS receiver target reference direction.

q_27415.question: In which TS are the conformance requirements for the current TC specified?
q_27415.ground_truth: The conformance requirements for the current TC are specified in TS 36.211, clause 6.2.7; TS 36.212, clause 5.3.3.1.12; TS 36.213, clauses 7.1.6, 7.1.6.3, 7.1.7, 7.1.7.1, 7.1.7.2, and 7.1.7.2.1; and TS 36.306 clause 4.1A.

q_27416.question: What should the floor participant interface do when it receives an MCPTT call release step 1 request from the application and signalling plane?
q_27416.ground_truth: The floor participant interface should stop sending floor control messages to the floor participant, request the network media interface to stop sending RTP media packets towards the MCPTT client, ignore any floor control messages received from the floor participant, request the network media interface to stop forwarding RTP media packets from the MCPTT client to the media distributor, indicate to the floor control server interface that the MCPTT client has started to disconnect from the session, and enter the 'P: Releasing' state.

q_27417.question: What should a NB-IoT UE do if there are not enough subframes for one SI message transmission in the radio frames provided in si-RepetitionPattern?
q_27417.ground_truth: Continue to receive the SI message transmission in the radio frames following the radio frame indicated in si-RepetitionPattern.

q_27418.question: What is the data type of the "off-network-ProSe-emergency-call-media-PQI" element?
q_27418.ground_truth: The data type of the "off-network-ProSe-emergency-call-media-PQI" element is xs:hexBinary.

q_27419.question: What is the applicability condition for the test in 9.2.4.2.2?
q_27419.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA TDD UE release 13 and forward of UE category 1bis, with support for FGI bits 16 and 25.

q_27420.question: What are the conditions for selecting the session being transferred when there are confirmed dialogs supporting a session with an inactive speech media component?
q_27420.ground_truth: If there are confirmed dialogs supporting a session with an inactive speech media component in the transferable session set, the ATCF shall select the confirmed dialog supporting a session with an inactive speech media component that became inactive most recently as the session being transferred.

q_27421.question: Which network entity is responsible for receiving the positioning assistance information from the LMF and broadcasting it in Positioning SI message(s) in a 5G network?
q_27421.ground_truth: The gNB-DU is responsible for receiving the positioning assistance information from the LMF and broadcasting it in Positioning SI message(s) in a 5G network.

q_27422.question: What should be included in the sl-poolReportIdentity and sl-CBR-ResultsNR for each transmission resource pool to be reported if there is at least one applicable transmission resource pool for NR sidelink communication/discovery (for measResultsSL)?
q_27422.ground_truth: If there is at least one applicable transmission resource pool for NR sidelink communication/discovery, the measResultsListSL should be set to include the CBR measurement results. For each transmission resource pool to be reported, the sl-poolReportIdentity should be set to the identity of this transmission resource pool, and the sl-CBR-ResultsNR should be set to the CBR measurement results on PSSCH and PSCCH of this transmission resource pool provided by lower layers, if available.

q_27423.question: What should an S-CSCF do if there is no original dialog identifier present in the topmost Route header field of the incoming request and the Request-URI of the received request is not a GRUU?
q_27423.ground_truth: The S-CSCF shall build an ordered list of initial filter criteria based on the public user identity in the Request-URI of the received request.

q_27424.question: What is the procedure code for the trace start message?

q_27425.question: What is the action taken by the MME for the non-GBR bearers while preserving and suspending them?
q_27425.ground_truth: The MME sends a Suspend Notification message towards S-GW for the non-GBR bearers, which releases S1-U bearers for the UE and sends a Suspend Notification message to the P-GW. The MME stores in the UE context that UE is in suspended status and marks all the preserved non-GBR bearers as suspended status in the S-GW and P-GW. The P-GW should discard packets if received for the suspended UE.

q_27426.question: What is required for the Media Player to start playback of the media after the attach() method is called?
q_27426.ground_truth: The Media Player identifies the earliest media time for start-up based on the type of the MPD, any present anchors, the wall-clock time, and other MPD information. The Access Client then schedules and generates requests for the relevant media segments based on the ABR Controller information and throughput estimation, before downloading the media and initializing the track buffers for each selected media type.

q_27427.question: What should the controlling MCData function do if the user is not allowed to send group MCData communications on the indicated group identity?
q_27427.ground_truth: If the MCData server group FD procedures indicate that the user identified by the MCData ID is not allowed to send group MCData communications on the indicated group identity, the controlling MCData function shall reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response with the warning text set to "201 user not authorized to transmit data on this group identity".

q_27428.question: In what scenario would the SMF+PGW-C generate an SMFPDUSessionModification record?
q_27428.ground_truth: When the SMF+PGW-C detects that a single-access PDU Session or PDN Connection has been modified for the target UE.

q_27429.question: What should the UE not transmit or receive during the measurement of SSB indexes or periodic/semi-persistent/aperiodic CSI-RS resources for L1-RSRP measurement in HST scenario?
q_27429.ground_truth: PUCCH/PUSCH/SRS or PDCCH/PDSCH/CSI-RS for tracking/CSI-RS for CQI on the corresponding symbols and one data symbol before and one data symbol after each consecutive SSB symbols/CSI-RS resources to be measured for L1-RSRP.

q_27430.question: What details are included in the unsolicited result code +CAULEV in the "modem-compatible" mode of operation?
q_27430.ground_truth: The unsolicited result code +CAULEV includes the current uplink access status (uplink free or uplink busy) for an active VGCS call in the "modem-compatible" mode of operation.

q_27431.question: What should the MME consider when activating an MDT trace session for the UE?
q_27431.ground_truth: The MME must consider the MDT user consent information when activating an MDT trace session for the UE. Detailed procedures about user consent are described in section 4.6.

q_27432.question: How does the Federated Learning Assistance Function notify the AF of changes in UE availability or suitability?
q_27432.ground_truth: The Federated Learning Assistance Function notifies the AF when suggested UEs become unavailable or no longer meet selection criteria, and provides relevant time information and suggestions for new UEs.

q_27433.question: What protocols are used to establish IPSec security associations between the UE and the ePDG in the context of untrusted Non-3GPP IP Accesses?
q_27433.ground_truth: The UE and the ePDG use IKEv2, as specified in RFC 5996, to establish IPSec security associations.

q_27434.question: What must the controlling MCPTT function do if the in-progress emergency group state of the group is set to true and the MCPTT user and group are authorized for emergency alerts?
q_27434.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function must populate the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body and the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-location-info+xml MIME body as specified in clause~6.3.3.1.12.

q_27435.question: What is the requirement for the UE to initiate the RRC connection procedure for mobile originating MMTEL voice or video based on the SystemInformationBlockType2 message?
q_27435.ground_truth: The UE is required to initiate the RRC connection procedure for mobile originating MMTEL voice or video if the SystemInformationBlockType2 message includes ac-BarringSkipForMMTELVoice or ac-BarringSkipForMMTELVideo.

q_27436.question: What should the MCPTT client do when in the "T1: in-progress emergency group call" state, it receives a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message with the MCPTT group ID IE matching with MCPTT group ID of the ongoing call and the Call Identifier IE being the same as the stored call identifier of the call, and the stored last user to change call type of the call is same as the Last user to change call type IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message, but the stored last call type change time is not smaller than Last call type change time IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message?
q_27436.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should not update the last call type change time or the last user to change call type, and should maintain the current state and call type.

q_27437.question: What steps does the participating MCData function need to take prior to sending an initial MBMS bearer announcement message?
q_27437.ground_truth: Prior to sending an initial MBMS bearer announcement message, the participating MCData function shall generate the MSCCK(s) and MuSiK(s) with the corresponding MSCCK-ID(s) and MuSiK-IDs as necessary, and shall distribute the MSCCKs, MSCCK-IDs, MuSiKs and MuSiK-IDs to the MCData clients using the keying material received from the key management server for security protection.

q_27438.question: What is the test requirement in clause 6.4B.2.4.2D.5 and 6.4B.2.4.2_1.1.5?
q_27438.ground_truth: The test requirement is not explicitly stated in these clauses. However, it can be inferred from other clauses that the test requirement is to evaluate the performance of the NR carrier under certain conditions.

q_27439.question: What is the Uplink power control window size used to ensure the UE output power is within the target power level?
q_27439.ground_truth: The Uplink power control window size is calculated as 1dB (UE power step size) + 0.7dB (UE power step tolerance) + (Test system relative power measurement uncertainty).

q_27440.question: In what type of mobility is the described handover procedure applied, and what is the additional function performed during the handover?
q_27440.ground_truth: The described handover procedure is applied in inter-system mobility from E-UTRAN to UTRAN Iu (3G), with the additional function of associating the received RABs and existing Bearer Id related to the particular NSAPI.

q_27441.question: What enumeration represents C2 Operation Mode Management Completion status?
q_27441.ground_truth: The enumeration C2OpModeStatus represents C2 Operation Mode Management Completion status.

q_27442.question: What determines whether an inter-frequency L1-RSRP measurement layer in Minter,i,j, is contributed in FR2?
q_27442.ground_truth: An inter-frequency L1-RSRP measurement layer in Minter,i,j is contributed the number equal to the cell number for L1-RSRP measurement in this inter-frequency layer, which is candidate to be measured in gap j, for FR2.

q_27443.question: What should be set in the "sl-CapabilityInformationSidelink" field to include UECapabilityInformationSidelink message, if any, received from the associated peer UE in NR sidelink communication transmission?
q_27443.ground_truth: The "sl-CapabilityInformationSidelink" field should be set to include UECapabilityInformationSidelink message, if any, received from the associated peer UE in NR sidelink communication transmission.

q_27444.question: Which three types of signals are used for monitoring the user equipment (UE)-side and gNB-side model for AI/ML based positioning?
q_27444.ground_truth: The three types of signals used are: signalling from monitoring entity to request ground-truth label, signalling from monitoring entity to request model output, and signalling for potential request/report of monitoring metric.

q_27445.question: In which case are there significantly more beam switches with 2 beams per RRH than with 1 beam per RRH?
q_27445.ground_truth: In uni-directional Scenario-B with DPS and a DRX cycle below 160 ms

q_27446.question: What should the NEF do if the AF is not authorized to perform the Enhanced Coverage Restriction request in step 2?
q_27446.ground_truth: The NEF should provide a cause value indicating the failure result to the AF in step 2.

q_27447.question: What should an eNodeB do when it receives a Trace Session activation message from the EM for a given E-UTRAN cell?
q_27447.ground_truth: The eNodeB shall start a Trace Session for the given E-UTRAN cell.

q_27448.question: What is the name of the MBS signal acquisition assistance data requested by the location server?

q_27449.question: What is the purpose of an LPP session in the context of LPP?
q_27449.ground_truth: An LPP session is used between a Location Server and the target device to obtain location related measurements or a location estimate or to transfer assistance data.

q_27450.question: What is the procedure when the MME selects one of the PDN Connections serving the UE to establish the UE Policy association between SM-PCF and UE-PCF during 5GS to EPS mobility using N26 interface?
q_27450.ground_truth: The MME creates and includes a UE Policy Container for UE with only the indication of MME Created UE Policy Container for 5GS to EPS Mobility in the Modify bearer Request to UE-PCF.

q_27451.question: What is the condition for the relative difference between the maximum coefficient in Range 1 and the minimum coefficient in Range 2 as per the additional requirements in 6.4.2.4.3 for uplink allocations contained within both Range 1 and Range 2?
q_27451.ground_truth: The relative difference between the maximum coefficient in Range 1 and the minimum coefficient in Range 2 must not be larger than 7 dB + TT for uplink allocations contained within both Range 1 and Range 2.

q_27452.question: What method is used by the 5GMS Application Provider to create a Provisioning Session with the 5GMS AF?
q_27452.ground_truth: The 5GMS Application Provider uses the HTTP POST method to create a Provisioning Session with the 5GMS AF.

q_27453.question: Which 3GPP standard does the minimum requirement for single RAT UTRA FDD operation AAS BS IPDL time mask apply to?
q_27453.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for single RAT UTRA FDD operation AAS BS IPDL time mask applies to 3GPP TS 25.104 subclause 6.4.5.1.

q_27454.question: When is the TEID field required to be present?
q_27454.ground_truth: The TEID field is required to be present if the Outer Header Creation Description requests the creation of a GTP-U header, i.e. if in Octet 5 any of the bits 5/1 and 5/2 are set.

q_27455.question: What information does the AMF require to set the IMS voice over PS Session Supported Indication?
q_27455.ground_truth: The AMF requires more information on the UE radio capabilities support to be able to set the IMS voice over PS Session Supported Indication.

q_27456.question: What is the purpose of the 5G ProSe direct link security mode control procedure?
q_27456.ground_truth: It is used to establish security between two UEs during a 5G ProSe direct link establishment procedure or a 5G ProSe direct link re-keying procedure.

q_27457.question: What is the measure of a transmitter's capability to inhibit the generation of signals in its non-linear elements caused by the presence of an interfering signal?
q_27457.ground_truth: The transmitter intermodulation requirement is a measure of this capability.

q_27458.question: What is the grouping type '3gag' defined for in the context of 3GPP PSS Annex G buffer parameters?
q_27458.ground_truth: The grouping type '3gag' defines the grouping criterion for 3GPP PSS Annex G buffer parameters and indicates that the associated video stream complies with PSS Annex G.

q_27459.question: What is the main benefit of using the CMP protocol for certificate enrolment and renewal in Solution #2?
q_27459.ground_truth: The main benefit of using the CMP protocol is that it offers a single certificate management protocol and procedures for the certificate enrolment and renewal, avoiding manual certificate management and ensuring built-in integrity protection and authentication.

q_27460.question: What is the role of the SCEF+NEF when 5GC+EPC is determined as the CN type serving the UE or the group of UEs?
q_27460.ground_truth: The SCEF+NEF determines that service APIs for both 5GC and EPC are available to the UE or the group of UEs.

q_27461.question: Who is responsible for determining the Ranging/Sidelink positioning result calculation mode and the requested info in the process of Ranging/Sidelink positioning?
q_27461.ground_truth: The LMF determines the Ranging/Sidelink positioning result calculation mode and the requested info based on LMF Ranging/Sidelink positioning capability, UE Ranging/Sidelink positioning capability, UE preference of Ranging/Sidelink positioning calculation node, and Operator policy.

q_27462.question: What is a Redundant Steering Mode in the context of a CP function?
q_27462.ground_truth: A Redundant Steering Mode is a steering mode for CP functions that duplicates traffic over multiple accesses to add redundancy.

q_27463.question: In what scenarios is the association between the SMF ID and the PDU Session ID released and the EBIs assigned for this PDU Session are released?
q_27463.ground_truth: This occurs in clauses 4.3.4.2, 4.3.4.3, 4.9.2.2, or 4.9.2.4 when the PDU Session is released and the AMF receives a new EBI allocation request but there is no EBI available.

q_27464.question: In what ways can secure exchange of NAS messages be re-established between the UE and the MME after an inter-system change in idle mode from A/Gb mode or Iu mode to S1 mode, if the UE has no current EPS security context?
q_27464.ground_truth: The UE shall send the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message without integrity protection and encryption, including a nonce and a GPRS ciphering key sequence number for creation of a mapped EPS security context.

q_27465.question: What decision can the AF make based on the received information about FL analytics in steps 9-11 of the process?
q_27465.ground_truth: Based on the received information, the AF can estimate latency performance of FL model training, take decisions on FL training such as start or delay FL training, increase targeted latency per iteration and start FL, add new FL members and request assistance from the 5GS for new candidate members, or use another FL selection algorithm.

q_27466.question: What is the focus of Solution #51 for supporting Federated Learning in 5GC?
q_27466.ground_truth: Solution #51 focuses on the NWDAF selection in the preparation phase and monitoring and maintenance in the execution phase for Federated Learning.

q_27467.question: When is an object considered to be created successfully by the MnS producer?
q_27467.ground_truth: The object must be created and the "createMOI" response returned immediately after creation. The MnS producer should not wait for other potentially long-lasting processes to complete.

q_27468.question: What is the use of pdcch-BlindDetectionMCG-UE-r17 and pdcch-BlindDetectionSCG-UE-r17 if the UE does not report pdcch-MonitoringCA-r17?
q_27468.ground_truth: The UE indicates through pdcch-BlindDetectionMCG-UE-r17 and pdcch-BlindDetectionSCG-UE-r17, respective maximum values for pdcch-BlindDetection4 for the MCG and the SCG, and the sum of these values should be less than or equal to NRB-DL,cells, the total number of downlink cells in NR-DC.

q_27469.question: What are the three cells used for the test procedure in 5.5.2.8.4.2?
q_27469.ground_truth: Cell1 (E-UTRAN Pcell), Cell2 (NR FR1 PSCell), and Cell3 (SCell operating in downlink without PUCCH/PUSCH).

q_27470.question: What does each subcounter per registration type represent in the measurement of the mean time of registration procedure?
q_27470.ground_truth: Each subcounter per registration type represents the number of successful registration procedures observed for each type during the granularity period.

q_27471.question: What value does the eKSI have when the EPS security context is a native EPS security context?
q_27471.ground_truth: When the EPS security context is a native EPS security context, the eKSI has the value of KSIASME.

q_27472.question: What is the time duration specified for the UE to perform PDCCH reception and applying spatial QCL information received in DCI for PDSCH processing in clause 8.10B.4?

q_27473.question: What message does the new SGSN send to the old MME after determining a Serving GW relocation?
q_27473.ground_truth: The new SGSN sends a Context Acknowledge (Serving GW change indication) message to the old MME.

q_27474.question: In a standard L3 message description, what does the IEI represent and what is its format?
q_27474.ground_truth: IEI represents the Information Element Identifier and is given in hexadecimal format.

q_27475.question: What request method should the MSGin5G Client use to send a MSGin5G message delivery status report?
q_27475.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Client should use a CoAP POST request to send a MSGin5G message delivery status report.

q_27476.question: What is the purpose of the Service-level-AA payload information element?
q_27476.ground_truth: The Service-level-AA payload information element carries the upper layer payload for authentication and authorization between the UE and the service-level-AA server.

q_27477.question: What is the criterion for a correct event in the test?
q_27477.ground_truth: A correct event is defined as UE behaves correctly in all steps, and the correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

q_27478.question: What is the difference between PRS in Case 1 and PRS in Case 2 in the calculation of the measurement period for PRS RSTD measurement in positioning frequency layer i?
q_27478.ground_truth: PRS in Case 1 has a ppw-durationOfPRS-Processing1-r17, while PRS in Case 2 has a ppw-durationOfPRS-Processing2-r17.

q_27479.question: When is the Short Macro eNodeB ID used in the Extended Macro eNodeB ID?
q_27479.ground_truth: The Short Macro eNodeB ID with a length of 18 Bits is used in the Extended Macro eNodeB ID when the SMeNB flag is set.

q_27480.question: When should the receiving side of an AM RLC entity discard a received RLC data PDU when a RLC data PDU is received from lower layer?
q_27480.ground_truth: The receiving side of an AM RLC entity shall discard the received RLC data PDU if x falls outside of the receiving window or if byte segment numbers y to z of the AMD PDU with SN = x have been received before.

q_27481.question: How is the TIP and TIR services in the 3GPP network authorized for use by the operator?
q_27481.ground_truth: The TIP and TIR services are authorized by setting the "authorized" attributes of <operator-terminating-identity-presentation> and <operator-terminating-identity-presentation-restriction> to "true" respectively.

q_27482.question: What should the AMF do after completing the registration procedure if the UE has at least one of the required bits set in the 5GMM capability IE for V2X communication?
q_27482.ground_truth: The AMF should not immediately release the NAS signalling connection after the completion of the registration procedure.

q_27483.question: What should the MCData imminent peril group state be set to if the SIP INVITE request contains a specific MIME body and MIME elements?
q_27483.ground_truth: The MCData imminent peril group state should be set to "MDIG 2: in-progress" if the SIP INVITE request contains an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body with the <mcdatainfo> element containing an <mcdata-Params> element containing an <mcdata-calling-group-id> element and containing a <request-type> element set to a value of "group-fd" and also containing an <imminentperil-ind> element set to a value of "true".

q_27484.question: What should the PCF provide if the "RFSPValidityTime" feature is supported and the PCF determines to provide an RFSP index value indicating EPC/E-UTRAN access is prioritized in a PDU session with home routed roaming?
q_27484.ground_truth: The PCF may provide, based on operator policies, a validity time for the RFSP index value within the "rfspValTime" attribute.

q_27485.question: What is the meaning of the term "PLMN ID" in the context of these measurements?
q_27485.ground_truth: PLMN ID stands for Public Land Mobile Network Identification and is a unique identifier for a public land mobile network.

q_27486.question: Who is responsible for determining the target DNAI which is applicable to the current UE location?
q_27486.ground_truth: The SMF determines the target DNAI which is applicable to the current UE location based on the PCC rules related with AF influence traffic mechanism.

q_27487.question: What is the initial condition for the measurement environment in testing the spurious emissions of a BS, as specified in clause 6.6.5.4.1?
q_27487.ground_truth: The initial condition for the measurement environment is normal, as specified in annex B.2.

q_27488.question: What is the primary aim of the SEAL location-related architecture enhancement or new architecture model in the 5G network?
q_27488.ground_truth: The primary aim is to enable enhanced performance, support for high-accuracy positioning based on LCS and 5G network exposure, and to accommodate new service requirements and the evolving application enablement capabilities.

q_27489.question: What is the role of the eNB in LWA mobility?
q_27489.ground_truth: The eNB provides the UE with a WLAN mobility set and manages UE mobility to WLAN APs within the mobility set and not belonging to the UE mobility set.

q_27490.question: What happens when the AMF-UE changes and the UE is connected to a MBSR?
q_27490.ground_truth: The new AMF-UE sends a Registration Accept to the UE with TAI List that only includes the TAI received in step 1, and the AMF-MBSR maps the allocated Link ID to the MBSR.

q_27491.question: What is the purpose of the frequency error test for UL MIMO, both for the receiver and the transmitter?
q_27491.ground_truth: For the receiver, the purpose is to extract the correct frequency from the stimulus signal under ideal propagation conditions and low level. For the transmitter, the purpose is to derive the correct modulated carrier frequency for each antenna connector from the results gained by the receiver.

q_27492.question: What is the role of the 3GPP management system in NPN fault management for 5G industry terminals in vertical industry scenarios?
q_27492.ground_truth: The 3GPP management system needs to provide fault management capabilities to detect rapidly whether or not the faults occurred on the NPN side.

q_27493.question: What information is contained in a MCPTT client information entry maintained by the MCPTT server?
q_27493.ground_truth: A MCPTT client information entry maintained by the MCPTT server includes a MCPTT client ID that uniquely identifies the MCPTT client information entry, and a list of MCPTT group information entries.

q_27494.question: What is the internal state managed by the MCData client to track the IPEG state of the group?

q_27495.question: What is the maximum number of HARQ-ACK information bits if the UE multiplexes the first, second, and third HARQ-ACK information bits in a PUCCH transmission in slot n+k?
q_27495.ground_truth: OACK is the total number of the first HARQ-ACK information bits, the second HARQ-ACK information bits if any and the third HARQ-ACK information bits if any.

q_27496.question: What is the purpose of the "pqi" attribute in a <qos-parameter-set> element?
q_27496.ground_truth: The "pqi" attribute in a <qos-parameter-set> element contains the parameter defined in clause~11.6.2.16, which indicates the packet numbering or sequencing for the QoS flow used by the UE for 5G ProSe direct communication.

q_27497.question: In this specification, what abbreviation is used to represent Time Domain Channel Properties?

q_27498.question: What should the AMF indicate to the UE regarding Multi-USIM features?
q_27498.ground_truth: The AMF indicates to the UE the support of Multi-USIM features based on the Multi-USIM features supported by the network and any preference policy by the network.

q_27499.question: How is a PIN created in the PIN management procedure?
q_27499.ground_truth: The PIN creation can only be triggered by the PEMC, and the PINE receives the role of PEMC during the registration procedure towards PIN server. The PEMC sends the PIN create request to PIN server with the GPSI, PIN client ID, UE location, security credential, and PIN profile.

q_27500.question: What are the security parameters provisioned to the End UEs and U2U relay in Scenario #1?
q_27500.ground_truth: The End UEs are provisioned with direct discovery security parameters and relay discovery security parameters, while the U2U relay is provisioned with a U2U Relay protected discovery message.

q_27501.question: What is required for SM-over-IP sender to support status report capabilities of the SC?
q_27501.ground_truth: The support of status report capabilities is optional for the SM-over-IP sender.

q_27502.question: What is the nominal channel spacing defined as for two adjacent E-UTRA carriers?

q_27503.question: What is the purpose of the "<anyExt>" element in the "<functional-alias-URI>" of the -Params> element?
q_27503.ground_truth: It is used to include the URI of the active functional alias in the SIP MESSAGE request, if the MCData client needs to do so.

q_27504.question: What is the role of the E-SMLC in providing location assistance data information for broadcasting?
q_27504.ground_truth: The E-SMLC can interact with an eNodeB that has signaling access to the E-SMLC to provide location assistance data information for broadcasting, including positioning System Information Blocks (posSIBs) together with assistance information and broadcast periodicity.

q_27505.question: What kind of protection is required for the E1 interface between CU-CP and CU-UP in a split DU-CU implementation?
q_27505.ground_truth: The E1 interface between CU-CP and CU-UP shall be confidentiality, integrity and replay protected.

q_27506.question: What is the maximum number of transmissions for synchronous HARQ, excluding transmission of a MAC PDU stored in the Msg3 buffer?

q_27507.question: What is the reason for sending the OTDOA INFORMATION FAILURE message by the eNB in 8.2.5.3?
q_27507.ground_truth: The eNB sends the OTDOA INFORMATION FAILURE message in case it does not have any OTDOA information to report.

q_27508.question: What action must the HSS take if it sets the "Local Time Zone Request" bit of the IDR-Flags?
q_27508.ground_truth: The HSS must provide the Local Time Zone corresponding to the location of the UE if supported.

q_27509.question: What is the purpose of the id-Cause in E-CIDMeasurementFailureIndication message?
q_27509.ground_truth: The id-Cause in E-CIDMeasurementFailureIndication message represents the cause of the failure to initiate a measurement.

q_27510.question: What is the size of the NS-PmaxValueNR-r15 and NS-PmaxValueNR-Aerial-r18 sequences in terms of number of elements?
q_27510.ground_truth: Both the NS-PmaxValueNR-r15 and NS-PmaxValueNR-Aerial-r18 sequences can contain up to 8 elements.

q_27511.question: What is the role of EEC in the edge node sharing scenario?
q_27511.ground_truth: EEC performs service provisioning from ECS-B, and may register to EES-B as specified in 3GPP TS 23.558.

q_27512.question: What is the role of the relay service code in UE-to-network relay discovery and connection setup between the 5G ProSe layer-3 remote UE and the 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-network relay UE?
q_27512.ground_truth: The relay service code is used to identify the N3IWF access for the relayed traffic in UE-to-network relay discovery with both models A and B. The 5G ProSe layer-3 remote UE shall select and send the relay service code to the 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-network relay UE when intending to access 5GC via N3IWF.

q_27513.question: What is the test purpose for EVM equalizer spectrum flatness?
q_27513.ground_truth: The purpose of the EVM equalizer spectrum flatness test is to ensure that the zero-forcing equalizer correction applied in the EVM measurement process meets a spectral flatness requirement for the EVM measurement to be valid. The equalizer correction must meet the EVM equalizer spectrum flatness minimum requirements for the EVM result to be valid. This test applies to all types of NR UE release 16 and forward that support NR standalone.

q_27514.question: What is the purpose of time duration T2 in the test procedure?
q_27514.ground_truth: The purpose of time duration T2 is for the SS to wait for random access requests information from the UE to perform cell re-selection on the higher priority E-UTRA Cell 1.

q_27515.question: When is a UE expected to decode a PDSCH scheduled with C-RNTI, MCS-C-RNTI, or CS-RNTI?
q_27515.ground_truth: A UE is expected to decode a PDSCH scheduled with C-RNTI, MCS-C-RNTI, or CS-RNTI during a process of autonomous SI acquisition.

q_27516.question: What is the value that the UE shall include in the 5GS update type IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message to indicate that it no longer requires the use of SMS over NAS?
q_27516.ground_truth: If the UE no longer requires the use of SMS over NAS, then the UE shall include the 5GS update type IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message with the SMS requested bit set to "SMS over NAS not supported".

q_27517.question: What is the output of the USIM when the sequence number is in the correct range and the input is RAND and AUTN?
q_27517.ground_truth: The output is either RES or AUTS.

q_27518.question: What is the action that the controlling MCVideo function shall perform when receiving a SIP INVITE request for controlling MCVideo function of an ambient viewing call, if the public service identity is not allocated?
q_27518.ground_truth: Perform the actions specified in clause~6.3.7.1 and return a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response with the warning text as specified in "Warning header field".

q_27519.question: What is content preparation in the context of 5G Media Streaming?
q_27519.ground_truth: Content preparation in 5G Media Streaming refers to the process of preparing and/or modifying content, which can be applied in uplink and downlink streaming scenarios. Content preparation can involve uplink ingest content formats, content preparation instructions, and the use of existing formats such as MPEG-2 Transport Stream, CMAF content, and RIST.

q_27520.question: What are the two sub-elements that can be included in the "requested-identity" element?
q_27520.ground_truth: The "requested-identity" element can include either a "VAL-user-id" element or a "VAL-group-id" element.

q_27521.question: What information is transmitted by the SS during the connection setup phase?
q_27521.ground_truth: During the connection setup, the SS transmits a Paging message (including PagingRecord with UE-Identity) in Cell 1 and sends a UEInformationRequest message, requesting UE to report idle mode CA/DC measurements.

q_27522.question: What are the modifications for Type B1 multi-channel access procedures described in clause 4.1.6.2.1?
q_27522.ground_truth: The modifications for Type B1 multi-channel access procedures involve maintaining a single CWp value for the set of channels, and for determining CWp for channel access on the selected channel, using step 2 of the procedure described in clause 4.1.4.1 with a modification for determining CWp for a set of channels. Any PDSCH that fully or partially overlaps with any channel in the set is used in the procedure described in clause 4.1.4.2.

q_27523.question: What is the measurement obtained by accumulating the time interval for every successful registration procedure per S-NSSAI per registration type between the receipt by the AMF from the UE of a "REGISTRATION REQUEST" and the sending of a "REGISTRATION ACCEPT" message during a granularity period using DER?
q_27523.ground_truth: The arithmetic mean of the time taken for successful registration procedures.

q_27524.question: How many bits does the truncated modulation and coding scheme field have in the random access response grant for CEmodeA and B?
q_27524.ground_truth: The truncated modulation and coding scheme field has 4 bits for both CEmodeA and B in the random access response grant.

q_27525.question: What attribute is defined as a restriction of the "xs:string" base type?
q_27525.ground_truth: The "IPAddress-type" is defined as a restriction of the "xs:string" base type.

q_27526.question: What is the DCI format used to schedule uplink data on E-UTRA subframe n-1 for Carrier 2, with a subcarrier spacing of 15 kHz?

q_27527.question: What is the standard command code range allocated by IANA for 3GPP?
q_27527.ground_truth: The standard command code range allocated by IANA for 3GPP is 300-313.

q_27528.question: What is the name of the message flow for satellite backhaul charging in clause 5.2.2.20.2.1?

q_27529.question: How is the main challenge for gNB-side SBFD operation in FR2-1, despite having similar leakage ratio as existing FR2-1 out-of-channel requirements?
q_27529.ground_truth: The main challenge is that PA characteristics need to be carried through a feedback link from the output of the PA, which is more difficult in mmWave for FR2-1 due to signal attenuation, making it significantly more challenging to exploit DPD as in FR1.

q_27530.question: What information does the AF provide to the AFLSF when indicating which UE should be provided with an AMSID, in addition to identifying the UE?
q_27530.ground_truth: The AF may provide other conditions that need to be met before the UE is allowed to engage in FL, such as the location of the UE, time of day, duration and frequency of the FL operation, conditions for rejoining an ongoing training session, and the number of UEs required for FL.

q_27531.question: What is the initial condition for message contents in 9.2.33.4.1?
q_27531.ground_truth: The message contents are defined in clause 9.2.33.4.3.

q_27532.question: What is the minimum rate of correct events required during repeated tests?
q_27532.ground_truth: The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests must be at least 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

q_27533.question: How does the UE handle a new 5G-GUTI upon receipt?
q_27533.ground_truth: Upon receipt of a 5GMM message containing a new 5G-GUTI, the UE considers the new 5G-GUTI as valid and the old 5G-GUTI as invalid, stops timer T3519 if running, and deletes any stored SUCI.

q_27534.question: What is the purpose of the test in clause 7.5A.3.1?
q_27534.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify the receiver's ability to receive a wanted 4DL carrier aggregated at its assigned channel frequency in the presence of an adjacent channel signal at a given frequency offset from the center frequency of the assigned channel.

q_27535.question: What can happen if the MTSI client in a terminal cannot maintain the required bit rate, frame rate, or quantization parameter in video streaming?
q_27535.ground_truth: If the MTSI client in a terminal cannot maintain the required bit rate, frame rate, or quantization parameter, the video stream might be put on hold, dropped, or the session might be ended.

q_27536.question: What is the maximum duration of consecutive DTX that can be observed by the SS for the event "DTX" to be counted as a success?
q_27536.ground_truth: No longer than 8 consecutive DTX is observed by the SS.

q_27537.question: What information is included in the access token generated by the hNRF for the NF Service Consumer?
q_27537.ground_truth: The access token includes the NF Instance Id of the NRF (issuer), NF Instance Id of the NF Service Consumer (subject), NF type of the NF Service Producer (audience), expected services name(s), expiration time, and optionally "additional scope" information.

q_27538.question: In what scenarios is the measurement assistance information used by the UE to send access availability/unavailability to the UPF?
q_27538.ground_truth: When the UE is only capable of supporting MPTCP functionality with any steering mode and the ATSSS-LL functionality with only the active-standby steering mode, the MPQUIC functionality with any steering mode and the ATSSS-LL functionality with only the active-standby steering mode, or both of them with any steering mode and the ATSSS-LL functionality with only the active-standby steering mode.

q_27539.question: What is the definition of Tactile Internet in the context of 3GPP Technical Reports?
q_27539.ground_truth: Tactile Internet is a network or network of networks for remotely accessing, perceiving, manipulating, or controlling real or virtual objects or processes in perceived real time by humans or machines.

q_27540.question: What action must the SN take if the MN requests the SN to allocate radio resources for split SRB operation?
q_27540.ground_truth: The SN must store the information provided by the MN and use it when establishing SN terminated bearers.

q_27541.question: What is the purpose of charging data records (CDR) in the 3GPP charging architecture?
q_27541.ground_truth: Charging data records (CDR) are a formatted collection of information about a chargeable event for use in billing and accounting. For each party to be charged for parts of or all charges of a chargeable event, a separate CDR shall be generated, i.e. more than one CDR may be generated for a single chargeable event. This allows for the proper and accurate tracking of resource and service usage and charges for billing purposes.

q_27542.question: When sending a SIP BYE request, what should the controlling MCVideo function do when the last MCVideo client is removed from the session?
q_27542.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function should stop timer TNG3 (group call timer) if it has not expired.

q_27543.question: What parameter can indicate if the format is alphanumeric or numeric in the SIM/USIM preferred operator list selection?

q_27544.question: What are the differences between Collaboration Scenario 4 and Collaboration Scenario 5?
q_27544.ground_truth: In Collaboration Scenario 5, the 5GMSu AS and 5GMSu AF reside in the trusted DN/domain, and the external 5GMSu Application Provider uses the M2u API for content egest. Meanwhile, Collaboration Scenario 4 has the 5GMSu AS and 5GMSu AF in the external DN/domain and follow 3GPP specifications.

q_27545.question: What is the sidelink power control applied for the transmission of Relay discovery messages?
q_27545.ground_truth: The sidelink power control applied for the transmission of Relay discovery messages is the same as for NR sidelink communication.

q_27546.question: What steps are replaced in the tracking area update procedure with Serving GW change in TS 23.401?
q_27546.ground_truth: Step 9a in the tracking area update procedure with Serving GW change in TS 23.401 is replaced by SM Policy Association Modification.

q_27547.question: What is the initial BSIC identification in the context of GSM cells?
q_27547.ground_truth: Initial BSIC identification is the process of searching for and decoding the BSIC of a GSM cell for the first time, when there is no prior knowledge about the relative timing between the E-UTRAN FDD and GSM cells.

q_27548.question: When would the IRI-POI in the PTC server generate an xIRI containing a PTCSessionEnd record?
q_27548.ground_truth: The IRI-POI in the PTC server generates the xIRI containing a PTCSessionEnd record when the IRI-POI present in the PTC server detects that the PTC session is released for any reason (i.e. normal or abnormal release) and voice communications ends.

q_27549.question: What requirement must be fulfilled by the SGSN for sending the Update CSG Location Procedure with CSS?
q_27549.ground_truth: The UE initiates the RAU procedure in a VPLMN supporting Autonomous CSG Roaming, and the HPLMN has enabled Autonomous CSG Roaming in the VPLMN via Service Level Agreement.

q_27550.question: What is the minimum required change for the second digit in the document versioning used by 3GPP?
q_27550.ground_truth: Substance changes, such as technical enhancements, corrections, or updates

q_27551.question: How does the slice enabler layer support the translation of requirements from different verticals?
q_27551.ground_truth: The slice enabler layer acts as a mediator between the vertical customer and the 5GS to decompose and translate the requirements of different verticals. It decomposes vertical requirements into specific network parameters and translates them into 5GS network requirements. The service provided by the slice enabler layer can be from the control plane, management plane, or SA6 slice enabler layer itself.

q_27552.question: What procedure does the VAE server perform to establish a session-oriented service with a VAE client?
q_27552.ground_truth: The VAE server performs the procedure specified in clause~9.19.5.2 to establish session-oriented service with a VAE client.

q_27553.question: What message does the target I-SMF send to the target I-UPF to release all resources allocated for the N4 session?
q_27553.ground_truth: Target I-SMF to Target I-UPF: N4 Session Release Request

q_27554.question: What is the Global eNB ID IE used for in the Write-Replace Warning Request message?
q_27554.ground_truth: The Global eNB ID IE is used to identify the eNodeB in the Write-Replace Warning Request message.

q_27555.question: What is a requirement for the use of a third-party specific user identity in the solution described in section 6.2.2.1?
q_27555.ground_truth: The requirement is that the third-party Authorization Server must be authorized by the serving IMS network to provide the third-party specific user identity for a specific group of UEs.

q_27556.question: What must the UE check when receiving the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message in order to determine if it can be accepted?
q_27556.ground_truth: When the UE receives the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message, it must check the integrity of the message and ensure that the Replayed UE security capabilities IE has not been altered compared to the latest values it sent to the network.

q_27557.question: What is the purpose of the GCS AS deciding on the delivery method for public safety services?
q_27557.ground_truth: The GCS AS decides the delivery method for public safety services based on UE reports, which allows switching between multicast, broadcast, and unicast delivery methods.

q_27558.question: What is the difference between power control for inter-band and intra-band concurrent NR V2X transmissions?
q_27558.ground_truth: For inter-band concurrent NR V2X transmissions, the requirements specified in clause 6.3.4 shall apply for the uplink in licensed band, while for intra-band concurrent NR V2X transmissions, the same clause 6.3.4 applies for both the uplink and sidelink in the licensed band.
