q_27559.question: What is the purpose of the /<x>/<x>/Common/MCVideo/AllowedVideoResolutions element, as defined in section 6.2.23AC?
q_27559.ground_truth: This element defines the allowed video resolutions for MCVideo sessions on the group.

q_27560.question: What is the default value of the `<mcvideo-allow-emergency-call>` element if it is not present in the MCVideo group document?
q_27560.ground_truth: The default value of the `<mcvideo-allow-emergency-call>` element is "false" if it is not present in the MCVideo group document.

q_27561.question: What attribute must the MCVideo server include in the <affiliation> element in the MIME body indicating per-group dynamic data?

q_27562.question: What response message does the PCF send upon successful deletion of an Individual MBS Policy?
q_27562.ground_truth: The PCF responds with an HTTP "204 No Content" status code.

q_27563.question: What is the impact on the message waiting indication (MWI) service when identities are shared?
q_27563.ground_truth: The MWI is not supported for the identities, which are shared.

q_27564.question: What should the UE expect for the number of SRS resources when two TPMIs are indicated?
q_27564.ground_truth: The UE should expect the number of SRS-Ports for the two indicated SRS resources to be the same when two TPMIs are indicated.

q_27565.question: What is a requirement for the NWDAF containing AnLF to access multiple ML models in Key Issue #10?
q_27565.ground_truth: Each ML model needs to have a unique identifier within the PLMN, and an NWDAF containing AnLF should be able to get all available ML models for a specific Analytics ID from an NWDAF containing MTLF.

q_27566.question: When is it necessary to start mac-ContentionResolutionTimer and restart at each HARQ retransmission of the bundle in the subframe containing the last repetition of the corresponding PUSCH transmission?
q_27566.ground_truth: This will occur when, for EDT, edt-SmallTBS-Enabled is not set to TRUE for the corresponding PRACH resource.

q_27567.question: In the context of PFCP protocol, what does the term "UP function" refer to?
q_27567.ground_truth: The User Plane (UP) function is a network function that is responsible for handling user data packets in 5G, and it is one of the two main functions of the PFCP protocol, the other being the Control Plane (CP) function.

q_27568.question: What is the primary objective of the test in 8.1.8.1 and which time domain measurement resource restriction pattern is applied in this test?
q_27568.ground_truth: The primary objective of the test in 8.1.8.1 is to verify that the UE correctly detects and reports Event A3 under a time domain measurement resource restriction pattern. A time domain measurement resource restriction pattern is applied in this test.

q_27569.question: How does Solution #37 propose to handle UE inactivity with a given S-NSSAI?
q_27569.ground_truth: Solution #37 proposes to deregister the slice once slice inactivity is detected by AMF, and release the PDU session once the slice inactivity is detected at UE end. The UE PDU session status and Allowed NSSAI will be always synchronized with the network later. Solution #37 also supports passing the control of handling UE inactivity to the UE, relieving a serving AMF or SMF load.

q_27570.question: What functionalities are required to be supported by the MC service server and the MC service clients for 5G MBS session group communications?
q_27570.ground_truth: The MC service server and the MC service clients are required to support the different functionalities related to the 5G MBS session in order to support the MC service group communications over 5G MBS sessions.

q_27571.question: What is the probability threshold that the probability of re-selection from Cell 1 to Cell 2 during T2 observed during testing should meet or exceed?

q_27572.question: What information is provided by the Type 2 power headroom in Power Headroom Reporting?
q_27572.ground_truth: The Type 2 power headroom provides the difference between the nominal UE maximum transmit power and the estimated power for UL-SCH and PUCCH transmission on SpCell of the other MAC entity (i.e. E-UTRA MAC entity in EN-DC, NE-DC, and NGEN-DC cases).

q_27573.question: What is the condition for a UE to initiate the measurement reporting procedure for this measId?
q_27573.ground_truth: The UE initiates the measurement reporting procedure for this measId when a periodical reporting timer for this measId expires or if the purpose is included and set to 'reportCGI' and if the UE acquired the information needed to set all fields of cgi-Info for the requested cell.

q_27574.question: What is the role of the group management server in the process of group regrouping in the MC system?
q_27574.ground_truth: The group management server is responsible for checking if the group regroup operation is authorized, creating and storing the information of the temporary group, notifying the IWF and the MC service server of the group regroup operation, and providing a group regroup response to the group management client.

q_27575.question: What command controls whether or not an extended format of incoming call indication is used in GPRS?

q_27576.question: What happens to the UE's discontinuous coverage wait timer upon returning to coverage after being out of coverage due to discontinuous coverage?
q_27576.ground_truth: The UE shall stop the discontinuous coverage wait timer and initiate NAS signalling if the UE receives paging message, has pending emergency services or when UE enters a TAI outside the registration area.

q_27577.question: What are the possible target identifier formats in the ETSI TS 103 221-1 messages for provisioning the MDF2?
q_27577.ground_truth: The possible target identifier formats in the ETSI TS 103 221-1 messages for provisioning the MDF2 are SUPIIMSI, SUPINAI, GPSIMSISDN, GPSINAI, IMSI, and MSISDN.

q_27578.question: What is the role of the PDN GW in the proxy binding acknowledgement step?
q_27578.ground_truth: The PDN GW processes the proxy binding update and allocates IP address(es) for the UE. It then sends a Proxy Binding Acknowledgement message to the Serving GW, containing the MN NAI, Lifetime, UE Address Info, GRE key for uplink traffic, Charging ID, and Additional Parameters.

q_27579.question: Who initiates the Paging procedure in the specified context?
q_27579.ground_truth: The AMF initiates the Paging procedure by sending the PAGING message to the NG-RAN node.

q_27580.question: How long is the validity period of the short-live certificate?
q_27580.ground_truth: The validity period of the short-live certificate is typically one hour.

q_27581.question: What type is used for the qos-flow-id attribute in the QoSFlow-info complex type and what is its data type?

q_27582.question: What is the process of PDU Session release by the AMF during network slice termination?
q_27582.ground_truth: The AMF releases inactive PDU Sessions first and then checks whether the active PDU Sessions are for emergency, critical, or priority services. If they are not, the AMF releases the active PDU Sessions after a predefined period of time. If they are, the AMF keeps the PDU Sessions for an operator's predefined period of time before releasing them.

q_27583.question: What is the purpose of the GPRS timer 3 information element?
q_27583.ground_truth: The purpose of the GPRS timer 3 information element is to specify GPRS specific timer values, e.g. for the timer T3396.

q_27584.question: What should SMF+PGW-C do upon reception of UE Policy Container ePCO in Create Session Request?
q_27584.ground_truth: The SMF+PGW-C forwards the UE Policy Container to the PCF at SM Policy Association establishment and uses the reception of UPDP Container as an additional reason to establish the SM Policy Association.

q_27585.question: What is the format of the DRBsToBeModified-List-Modified-SNterminated sequence?
q_27585.ground_truth: The DRBsToBeModified-List-Modified-SNterminated sequence is a collection of data elements that define the downlink (DL) and uplink (UL) transport network layer (TNL) information for dedicated radio bear (DRB) in a network.

q_27586.question: What should the MCPTT client do when the MCPTT user does not act on the terminating call in the "S5: pending user action with confirm indication" state or the "S4: pending user action without confirm indication" state, upon expiration of timer TFG4?
q_27586.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should start timer TFG5 and enter the "S6: ignoring incoming call announcements" state.

q_27587.question: What happens when the UE does not meet the service conditions for localized services?
q_27587.ground_truth: If the UE does not meet the service area conditions, the AMF sends a notification to the SMF, which then instructs the UPF to stop forwarding the traffic flow of the service.

q_27588.question: What is the scope of the test procedure for IMS MO call establishment in 5GC?
q_27588.ground_truth: The purpose of this procedure is to establish an IMS MO speech call in 5GC.

q_27589.question: What tolerance should be assumed for frame boundary alignment when deriveSSB-IndexFromCell is enabled in a UE?
q_27589.ground_truth: The tolerance for frame boundary alignment when deriveSSB-IndexFromCell is enabled in a UE is min(2 SSB symbols, 1 PDSCH symbol) for sub-carrier spacing of SSB and PDSCH up-to 240 kHz, and min (3 SSB symbols, NPDSCH PDSCH symbols) for sub-carrier spacing of 480 kHz and 960kHz of either SSB or PDSCH.

q_27590.question: What conditions must be met for the test in 8.22.8 to pass?
q_27590.ground_truth: The total number of successful tests must be more than 90% of the cases with a confidence level of 95%.

q_27591.question: What should the UE do upon detecting radio link failure, in accordance with TS 36.331, clause.2?
q_27591.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the connection re-establishment procedure.

q_27592.question: Which interface is responsible for connecting the eNB to the IP network in case SIPTO@LN with collocated L-GW is supported?
q_27592.ground_truth: The SGi interface is responsible for connecting the eNB to the IP network in case SIPTO@LN with collocated L-GW is supported.

q_27593.question: What is the role of the position estimate computation in UE positioning methods?
q_27593.ground_truth: The position estimate computation may be made by the UE or by the LMF in UE positioning methods.

q_27594.question: What is the purpose of the ID IE in the PDUSessionResourceModificationResponseInfo-SNterminated-ExtIEs sequence?
q_27594.ground_truth: The ID IE in the PDUSessionResourceModificationResponseInfo-SNterminated-ExtIEs sequence is used to indicate the type of extension information (ExtIEs) that is being provided about the PDU session resource modification response.

q_27595.question: What is the home network requirement for a UE with SNPN in the case of localized service information construction?
q_27595.ground_truth: The home network of the UE should be SNPN for the construction of localized service information.

q_27596.question: When should the UE report a Long BSR and a Short BSR?
q_27596.ground_truth: If more than one LCG has data available for transmission in the TTI where the BSR is transmitted, the UE should report a Long BSR. If only one LCG has data available for transmission in the TTI where the BSR is transmitted, the UE should report a Short BSR.

q_27597.question: What is the NGAP UE-TNLA-binding in the context of 5G AN?
q_27597.ground_truth: NGAP UE-TNLA-binding refers to the association of a UE with a specific TNL in the 5G AN node. This binding is updated by the AMF at any time while the UE is in CM-CONNECTED state, such as when changing TNL associations for the UE, or releasing the NGAP UE-TNLA-binding for a UE while maintaining N3 (user-plane connectivity) for the UE.

q_27598.question: What entity is responsible for generating alternative QoS Parameter Sets based on the RT latency requirement?

q_27599.question: When must the UE check for the presence of the "outbound" option tag in the Require header field if the REGISTER request contains certain parameters?
q_27599.ground_truth: The UE must check for the presence of the "outbound" option tag in the Require header field if the REGISTER request contains the "reg-id" and "+sip.instance" Contact header field parameter and the "outbound" option tag in a Supported header field.

q_27600.question: What action should the network take if the MS has indicated support of PS inter-RAT handover from GERAN to UTRAN Iu mode in the ROUTING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message and the network accepts it?
q_27600.ground_truth: Include a request to provide the Inter RAT information container in the ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message.

q_27601.question: What is the name of the message flow for Edge Computing charging with satellite backhaul in clause 5.2.2.20.2.2?
q_27601.ground_truth: Edge Computing charging with satellite backhaul

q_27602.question: What element specifies the interval for periodic reports to be sent to the VAE-C?
q_27602.ground_truth: The "periodic-report" element specifies the interval for periodic reports to be sent to the VAE-C.

q_27603.question: What is the function of the 'WUS Assistance Information' IE?
q_27603.ground_truth: The WUS Assistance Information IE provides assistance to eNBs in determining the WUS group for the UE during handover.

q_27604.question: How does the UE determine the downlink transmit energy per resource element?
q_27604.ground_truth: The UE determines the downlink transmit energy per resource element based on the information received from the eNodeB. For the purpose of RSRP and RSRQ measurements, the UE may assume that downlink cell-specific RS EPRE is constant across the downlink system bandwidth and subframes with discovery signal transmissions until different cell-specific RS power information is received. For a cell that is not a LAA SCell, the UE may assume that downlink cell-specific RS EPRE is constant across the downlink system bandwidth and subframes with or without discovery signal transmissions.

q_27605.question: What message is sent by the new NG-RAN node to the old NG-RAN node in RACH based SDT without UE context relocation to request termination of the SDT session?
q_27605.ground_truth: The Retrieve UE Context Confirm procedure is used to request termination of the SDT session from the new NG-RAN node to the old NG-RAN node in RACH based SDT without UE context relocation.

q_27606.question: What is the one-way end-to-end maximum latency target when performed by the cellular network?
q_27606.ground_truth: The one-way end-to-end maximum latency targets are 10 seconds for longer latency and 1 second for shorter latency.

q_27607.question: What is the purpose of the NAS SMC before sending the Registration Reject message?
q_27607.ground_truth: The NAS SMC is performed before sending the Registration Reject message to ensure the integrity of the NAS.

q_27608.question: What is the term used to describe a measurement that is not defined as an intra-frequency measurement?

q_27609.question: What should a receiver of a PFCP signaling message do when it receives an optional Information Element with a Value that is not in the range defined for that Information Element?
q_27609.ground_truth: The receiver should discard the Information Element but continue processing the rest of the message as if the IE was absent.

q_27610.question: What should the UE do if the UE receives a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message with the 5GSM cause value #69 and the ABO bit is not set, and no Back-off timer value is received?
q_27610.ground_truth: The UE may send another PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message or PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message for the same S-NSSAI.

q_27611.question: What message is sent by the eNB to give feedback on assistance information broadcasting?

q_27612.question: What is the purpose of the monitoring UE procedure for UE-to-UE relay discovery?
q_27612.ground_truth: The purpose of the monitoring UE procedure for UE-to-UE relay discovery is to enable a ProSe-enabled UE to become aware of proximity of a connectivity service provided by a 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE, upon a request from upper layers, or to enable a ProSe-enabled UE to perform measurements of signal strength of PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY messages from 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE(s) for UE-to-UE relay selection/reselection.

q_27613.question: What is the threshold for the SNR value in time duration T1 during subtest 1 and subtest 2?
q_27613.ground_truth: The SNR value in time duration T1 during subtest 1 is -22.0 dB and in subtest 2 is -14.4 dB.

q_27614.question: What are the orbital correction correlation time, orbit error, orbit error rate, mean and standard deviation, and satellite and constellation residual risks in the context of SSR Orbit Corrections?
q_27614.ground_truth: These are parameters that are provided for integrity purposes in SSR Orbit Corrections for a GNSS receiver. The correlation time for orbit error and orbit error rate, and the mean and standard deviation of the residual orbit error and its associated error rate, as well as the satellite and constellation residual risks, provide information about the accuracy and reliability of the GNSS signal.

q_27615.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 5.3.2.2.3.4.1?
q_27615.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify the behavior of the random access procedure and that the MsgA PRACH and MsgA PUSCH power settings and timing are within specified limits.

q_27616.question: How is the constrained regional probability calculated in the 'OR combining' method?
q_27616.ground_truth: In the 'OR combining' method, the constrained regional probability for each point is considered '1' if that point is successful in at least one of the AoA pairs it participates in.

q_27617.question: What transmission mode should the AAS BS be set to in step 1 of the UTRA FDD Procedure (6.6.3.4.2.2) for single carrier tests?

q_27618.question: What is the condition for counting a success for the event "ACK/NACK" during the test?
q_27618.ground_truth: More than 99.5% of uplink transmissions are received by SS.

q_27619.question: What is the attribute name of the media level type that is not subject to the charset attribute and allows bypassing of a border gateway in networks with OMR procedures?

q_27620.question: What is an internal state of the MCData client which aids in managing the MCData emergency state and related actions in conjunction with the MCData emergency alert state?

q_27621.question: When is the Network-based IP flow mobility information used?
q_27621.ground_truth: The NBIFOM container is used to transfer information associated with network-based IP flow mobility.

q_27622.question: What message does the LMF send to the gNB to request Multi-RTT measurement information?
q_27622.ground_truth: The LMF sends a NRPPa message to the selected gNB to request Multi-RTT measurement information.

q_27623.question: What is the maximum number of FDD inter-frequencies that a UE is required to be capable of performing RSRP and RSRQ measurements for?
q_27623.ground_truth: The UE is required to be capable of performing RSRP and RSRQ measurements for up to 2 FDD inter-frequencies.

q_27624.question: What is the difference between the two types of GRUUs, P-GRUU and T-GRUU, in terms of the information they reveal and their duration?
q_27624.ground_truth: P-GRUUs reveal the Public User Identity and are long-lived, while T-GRUUs have a URI that does not reveal the Public User Identity and are valid until the contact is explicitly de-registered or the current registration expires.

q_27625.question: When a 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay needs to establish RRC Connection for emergency service while a 5G ProSe Remote UE has requested emergency service over the PC5 link, which RRC establishment cause should be used by the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay?
q_27625.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay should use RRC establishment cause "emergency" when it needs to establish an RRC Connection for emergency service while a 5G ProSe Remote UE has requested emergency service over the PC5 link.

q_27626.question: In which messages is the Management Based MDT PLMN List IE included to communicate user consent in the case of EN-DC and NR-DC?
q_27626.ground_truth: In the case of EN-DC, the Management Based MDT PLMN List IE is included in the INITIAL CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message and, optionally, in the SGNB ADDITION REQUEST message sent to the gNB-CU-CP. In the case of NR-DC, the Management Based MDT PLMN List IE is included in the INITIAL CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message sent to the MN and in the S-NODE ADDITION REQUEST message sent to the SgNB-CU-CP.

q_27627.question: What message is sent by the NEF in response to the HTTP PATCH request sent by the (H-) PCF to the "Individual PDTQ Policy" resource?
q_27627.ground_truth: The NEF sends an HTTP PATCH response message to the AF.

q_27628.question: What should the NF service consumer include in the "ascReqData" attribute in the HTTP PATCH request message, if it wants to update the TSC QoS related information using the "qosReference" attribute and the "altSerReqs" attribute?
q_27628.ground_truth: The NF service consumer should update the "qosReference" attribute and/or indicate the update of the alternative service requirements by updating the "altSerReqs" attribute.

q_27629.question: What should the UE do upon initiating the connection establishment procedure for mobile originating calls if SystemInformationBlockType2 includes ac-BarringForMO-Data and the UE has valid Access Classes with at least one corresponding bit in ac-BarringForSpecialAC set to zero in ac-BarringForMO-Data?
q_27629.ground_truth: Consider access to the cell as not barred.

q_27630.question: Which parameter represents the information related to each call forwarding service?

q_27631.question: What is the procedure called for re-establishing the user plane for one or more PDU Sessions associated with non-3GPP access for a N5CW device in the CM-CONNECTED state over a trusted WLAN access point (TWAP)?
q_27631.ground_truth: The Service Request procedure for N5CW devices as specified in clause~4.12a.4.1.

q_27632.question: What is the role of the NSCE client in the solution for key issue #12?
q_27632.ground_truth: If the NSCE client needs to be remapped to a different NSCE server due to the expected change of UE location, the NSCE client establishes a new connection with T-NSCE and terminates the one with S-NSCE.

q_27633.question: What should the UE in the "B2: in-progress broadcast group call" state or "B4: ignoring same call ID" state do when timer TFB1 (max duration) expires?
q_27633.ground_truth: For the terminating UE, it should release the media session, clear the stored call identifier, stop floor control if running, and enter the "B1: start-stop" state. For the originating UE, it should release the media session, generate a GROUP CALL BROADCAST END message with the stored call identifier and MCPTT group ID, send it, stop timer TFB2 (broadcast retransmission), clear the stored call identifier, and enter the "B1: start-stop" state.

q_27634.question: What is the role of the signal range parameters (center azimuth, center elevation, azimuth range, elevation range, and tilt angle) in describing a 360 video with restricted coverage?
q_27634.ground_truth: These parameters specify the center point, the range of angles, and the amount of tilt in the sphere region covered by the signal.

q_27635.question: In what situations should the MME include the EMM cause value #40 "no EPS bearer context activated" in the SERVICE REJECT message?
q_27635.ground_truth: The MME should include the EMM cause value #40 "no EPS bearer context activated" in the SERVICE REJECT message when the service request received is due to CS fallback or 1xCS fallback.

q_27636.question: What is the action taken by the H-PCRF if it does not differentiate between primary and non-primary BBERFs in IP flow mobility routing rules?
q_27636.ground_truth: The H-PCRF derives PCC rules for the PCEF and QoS rules for the BBERF(s), based on the BCM mode of the GW control session.

q_27637.question: What is appended to all the packets of a PDU set to identify it uniquely?
q_27637.ground_truth: A sequence number known as "PDU sequence mark" (PSM) is appended to all the packets of a PDU set.

q_27638.question: What should the MB-SMF do if it decides not to interact with the PCF in step 5?
q_27638.ground_truth: The MB-SMF should continue with step 11.

q_27639.question: Which setup is used for the AoA in this test?
q_27639.ground_truth: The AoA setup for this test is Setup 3 as defined in clause A.9.

q_27640.question: What message does the MME send to eNodeB to indicate that the UE should be moved to UTRAN/GERAN?
q_27640.ground_truth: The MME sends an S1-AP UE Context Modification Request (CS Fallback Indicator, LAI) message to eNodeB.

q_27641.question: What information is included in the Handover Required message sent from the E-UTRAN to the MME?
q_27641.ground_truth: The Handover Required message includes the target ID, a generic Source to Target Transparent Container, a SRVCC HO Indication, old BSS to new BSS information for the CS domain, and an indication that the UE is not available for PS service in the target cell.

q_27642.question: What are the two common charging modes for non-public networks?
q_27642.ground_truth: The two common charging modes for non-public networks are End user charging and Inter-provider charging. End user charging refers to the charges for using non-public network services by end-users, and Inter-provider charging refers to the charges between NPN service providers for utilizing their networks and related network services.

q_27643.question: What is the aspect of solution #21 in representing Traffic Category?
q_27643.ground_truth: Solution #21 proposes to reuse the current Traffic Descriptor (TD) type to represent Traffic Category. It suggests introducing a new special DNN in the TD to represent Traffic Category or a new standardized Application descriptor to achieve this.

q_27644.question: What is the most significant bit of the Home eNodeB ID?
q_27644.ground_truth: Bit 4 of Octet 9 is the most significant bit of the Home eNodeB ID.

q_27645.question: What is included in the response body if some of the modification instructions in a PATCH request are discarded in the SMSF, and the NF service consumer supports the "PatchReport" feature?

q_27646.question: During RLM/BFD relaxation, what is the condition for the UE to perform RLM and/or BFD relaxation based on low mobility and good serving cell quality?
q_27646.ground_truth: The UE is allowed to perform RLM and/or BFD relaxation based on low mobility if (SS-RSRPRef - SS-RSRP) < SSearchDeltaP-Connected.

q_27647.question: What procedures are used for Dedicated Bearer Establishment and Modification for vSRVCC?
q_27647.ground_truth: The procedures involve the PCRF in the serving PLMN interacting with the P-GW or S-GW, and the inclusion of a "vSRVCC indicator" in Create Bearer Request or Update Bearer Request messages to indicate that the bearer has been allocated for video media.

q_27648.question: What message does the LMF send to the serving gNB to request deactivation of UL-SRS resource sets?
q_27648.ground_truth: The LMF sends the NRPPa Positioning Deactivation message to the serving gNB to request deactivation of UL-SRS resource sets.

q_27649.question: What is the procedure to be followed if the UE receives a CONNECT message after transmitting a HANDOVER COMPLETE message in the context of an MO IMS voice call?
q_27649.ground_truth: The UE should transmit a CONNECT ACKNOWLEDGE message.

q_27650.question: What measurements are included in E-CID measurements for E-UTRA?
q_27650.ground_truth: E-UTRA E-CID measurements include RSRP, RSRQ, UE E-UTRA Rx - Tx time difference, GERAN RSSI, UTRAN CPICH RSCP, UTRAN CPICH Ec/Io, and WLAN RSSI, WLAN RSSI, SS Reference signal received power (SS-RSRP), and SS Reference Signal Received Quality (SS-RSRQ).

q_27651.question: What is the motivation for extending 5GMS principles in the integration of AR services and experiences into 5G Networks?
q_27651.ground_truth: The motivation is that it allows for support of any type of media services including real-time communication, split rendering and spatial computing, and is not specific or limited to XR and AR experiences.

q_27652.question: What is included in the Policy/parameters for 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay Discovery for a 5G ProSe Remote UE?
q_27652.ground_truth: It includes 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay Discovery parameters, default destination Layer-2 IDs, PDU session parameters, ProSe application Traffic Descriptor, and security related content.

q_27653.question: Under what conditions will the AMF abort the procedure when the Payload container type is set to "SMS"?
q_27653.ground_truth: The AMF will abort the procedure if it does not have an SMSF address associated with the UE, if it cannot forward the content of the Payload container to the SMSF associated with the available SMSF address, or if the UE has registered to a PLMN via a satellite NG-RAN cell that is not allowed to operate at the present UE location.

q_27654.question: Which carrier belongs to a single TAG in SUL operation?
q_27654.ground_truth: The SUL carrier belongs to a single TAG.

q_27655.question: What is the basis of Solution #3 for addressing the issue?
q_27655.ground_truth: The basis of Solution #3 for addressing the issue is that a NF sending a request to SCP implicitly authorizes the SCP to process the request, by sending a CCA.

q_27656.question: What should the SS do as per step 5a if the UE is a Release 16 or forward 5G NR UE?
q_27656.ground_truth: The SS is required to apply a backoff on the PCell power by activating the UE Power Limit Function (UPLF), and the UE shall transmit ACTIVATE POWER LIMIT RESPONSE to SS.

q_27657.question: What message does the new SGSN send to the RNC to establish a radio access bearer?
q_27657.ground_truth: The new SGSN sends a RAB Assignment Request message to the RNC to establish a radio access bearer.

q_27658.question: What is the test requirement for maximum input level for CA (3DL CA) described in clause 7.4A.2.5?
q_27658.ground_truth: The test requirement is the same as in clause 7.4A.1.5: the throughput measurement derived in the test procedure shall be greater than or equal to 95% of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channels as specified in Annex A.

q_27659.question: In what circumstances should a MS using a SIM without access technology information storage use the "PLMN Selector" data file instead of the "User Controlled PLMN Selector with Access Technology" or the "Operator Controlled PLMN Selector with Access Technology"?
q_27659.ground_truth: If the "User Controlled PLMN Selector with Access Technology" and the "Operator Controlled PLMN Selector with Access Technology" data files are not present on the SIM.

q_27660.question: What is the disadvantage of reserving the ideal location (focus) for the antenna serving the highest frequencies and using offset locations for antennae serving lower frequencies?
q_27660.ground_truth: The disadvantage is the prediction of the non-linear phase variation varying with frequency, which can cause problems for inter-band testing.

q_27661.question: When is the UE required to include the IMSI in the EPS mobile identity IE in the ATTACH REQUEST message when attaching for emergency bearer services?
q_27661.ground_truth: If the UE is attaching for emergency bearer services and does not hold a valid GUTI, P-TMSI, or IMSI, the IMEI shall be included in the EPS mobile identity IE.

q_27662.question: What is the purpose of the "Mean interruption time interval for 5QI 1 QoS Flow released due to double NG (double UE context)" measurement?
q_27662.ground_truth: The "Mean interruption time interval for 5QI 1 QoS Flow released due to double NG (double UE context)" measurement provides the average interruption time interval for 5QI 1 QoS Flow released due to double NG (double UE context).

q_27663.question: What are the types of V2X messages supported over the PC5 reference point?
q_27663.ground_truth: Both IP based and non-IP based V2X messages are supported over the PC5 reference point.

q_27664.question: What does the List of APNs IE indicate in the Overload Control Information?
q_27664.ground_truth: The List of APNs IE indicates one or more APNs for which the Overload Control Information is applicable. It determines the scope of the overload control information, whether it is applicable to the list of indicated APNs or the entire GTP-C entity.

q_27665.question: How is the bit width of the PTRS-DMRS association field determined for the case with transform precoder enabled and disabled?
q_27665.ground_truth: If the Transform precoder indicator field is present, the bit width of the PTRS-DMRS association field for the case with transform precoder enabled and disabled should be the same.

q_27666.question: What is the effect of fine-tuning dataset size on positioning error when changing the network synchronization error from 0 ns to 50 ns?
q_27666.ground_truth: The positioning error varies, with a smaller fine-tuning dataset size resulting in a larger positioning error.

q_27667.question: What is the "S-NSSAIs per TAI mapping" event that the AMF exposes?
q_27667.ground_truth: The "S-NSSAIs per TAI mapping" event provides, per TAI, the related access type and list of supported S-NSSAIs, including indication of S-NSSAIs restricted by AMF.

q_27668.question: What interworking procedures are included in clause 4.11 for interworking between EPS and 5GS?
q_27668.ground_truth: Procedures for interworking with EPS based on N26 interface, interworking without N26 interface, handover procedures between EPS and 5GC-N3IWF, handover procedures between EPS and 5GC-TNGF, and handover procedures between EPC/ePDG and 5GS are included in clause 4.11.

q_27669.question: What cell is used as the target for CSI-RS based CMR and dedicated IMR L1-SINR measurements in the test environment?
q_27669.ground_truth: Cell 2, also known as the PSCell, is used as the target for CSI-RS based CMR and dedicated IMR L1-SINR measurements in the test environment.

q_27670.question: What is the role of the SMF in allocating/releasing IP addresses in 5G network?
q_27670.ground_truth: The SMF shall process the UE IP address management related messages, maintain the corresponding state information and provide the response messages to the UE, furthermore, the SMF shall inform the PCF about an allocated IPv4 address, and shall act as the DHCP server towards the UE for IP address allocation, and act as the DHCP client towards the external DHCP server for IP address allocation.

q_27671.question: What is the role of the 5G system in supporting the Smart Grid applications?
q_27671.ground_truth: The 5G system supports the Smart Grid applications by providing different isolation modes, with dedicated core network elements and radio resources for the physical isolation requirements, while offering shared network resources for logical isolation requirements.

q_27672.question: What happens to a DOWNLINK GENERIC NAS TRANSPORT message if it is not delivered for any reason?
q_27672.ground_truth: The MME may discard the message.

q_27673.question: What is the modulus base used in arithmetic operations in AM data transfer?
q_27673.ground_truth: All arithmetic operations involved in comparing state variables or SN values in AM data transfer are affected by the AM modulus. The modulus base is the same as the maximum value that state variables or SN values can take in AM data transfer. For 10-bit SN, the modulus base is 1024, and for 16-bit SN, it is 65536. Thus, VT(A), VT(MS), and VT(S) in the transmitting side of an AM RLC entity shall be compared with the modulus base.

q_27674.question: What should the UPF in PLMN perform upon detection of the DL traffic with the specific DSCP and N3IWF IP address?
q_27674.ground_truth: The UPF in PLMN should perform DSCP re-marking for the detected traffic and send the marked packet to the NG-RAN.

q_27675.question: What should the MCVideo client include in the SIP REFER request for establishing a remote initiated ambient viewing call within a pre-established session?
q_27675.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should include the request-URI, Refer-Sub header field, Supported header field with specific option tag, optional P-Preferred-Identity header field, P-Preferred-Service header field, Refer-To header field, and specific elements in the application/resource-lists+xml MIME body (including a single entry element and a proper uri attribute value).

q_27676.question: What is required for two User Equipments (UEs) to establish a one-to-one ProSe Direct Communication?
q_27676.ground_truth: Each UE needs to have a Layer-2 ID for unicast communication that is included in the Source Layer-2 ID field of every frame that it sends on the layer-2 link and in the Destination Layer-2 ID of every frame that it receives on the layer-2 link. The UE needs to ensure that the Layer-2 ID for unicast communication is at least locally unique.

q_27677.question: When must the MCData UE perform re-registration containing the parameters for the other operating MC services?
q_27677.ground_truth: The MCData UE must perform re-registration containing the parameters for the other operating MC services when the MCData client logs off from the MCData service but other MC service clients are to remain registered.

q_27678.question: What is the measurement "DL PDCP SDU Data Volume" used for in the 5G network?
q_27678.ground_truth: This measurement is used to measure the data volume delivered to the PDCP layer in the downlink in the 5G network, and it is used for performance assurance within integrity area (user plane connection quality) and in the energy efficency (EE) area.

q_27679.question: What is the SIP INVITE request for a standalone SDS over media plane for the originating participating MCData function?
q_27679.ground_truth: A SIP INVITE request with an Accept-Contact header field containing the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcdata.sds" in the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag and a P-Asserted-Service header field containing the value "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcdata.sds", and a <request-type> element set to "one-to-one-sds" or "group-sds" in an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body.

q_27680.question: What must the UE do upon successful reception of TMGI and other information when MBS decision is set to "MBS join is accepted"?
q_27680.ground_truth: The UE must consider that it has successfully joined the multicast MBS session, store the received TMGI and MBS service area, and provide the TMGI to lower layers.

q_27681.question: When should the media feature tags be included in the SIP response other than the 100 (Trying) response to the SIP INVITE request?
q_27681.ground_truth: The media feature tags should be included in the SIP response other than the 100 (Trying) response to the SIP INVITE request, for all supported streaming media types in the UE.

q_27682.question: What request is used by the originating side to confirm the successful resource reservation at the terminating UE?
q_27682.ground_truth: An SIP UPDATE request is used by the originating side to confirm the successful resource reservation at the terminating UE.

q_27683.question: What are the two options for ATG BS antenna modelling in the context of ATG coexistence study?
q_27683.ground_truth: The two options for ATG BS antenna modelling are the non sub-array model and the sub-array model.

q_27684.question: What action does an MCData client take upon expiry of timer TFS1 (SDS retransmission)?
q_27684.ground_truth: Upon expiry of timer TFS1 (SDS retransmission), the MCData client generates a SDS OFF-NETWORK MESSAGE message as specified in clause 15.1.7, increments the counter CFS1(SDS retransmission) by 1, and starts timer TFS1 (SDS retransmission) if the associated counter CFS1 (SDS retransmission) has not reached its upper limit.

q_27685.question: What kind of data is expected to be provided in the request body when using the "GET" method for the NWDAF Analytics resource?
q_27685.ground_truth: The "GET" method for the NWDAF Analytics resource does not require a request body.

q_27686.question: In what scenario will the gNB-CU consider that the backhaul link between the gNB-DU and the node is congested, when receiving the GNB-DU STATUS INDICATION message with the IAB Congestion Indication IE?
q_27686.ground_truth: If the IAB Congestion Indication IE includes the Child Node Identifier IE but not the BH RLC CH ID IE.

q_27687.question: What kind of data is collected for VAL session performance analytics?
q_27687.ground_truth: The ADAEC collects data about the RTT, throughput, jitter, QoE measurements, QoS profile load, etc. for VAL session performance analytics.

q_27688.question: How does a device join a PIN?
q_27688.ground_truth: A device sends the Join PIN request to the PEMC via the established connection between the device and PEMC, including PIN ID, Device ID, PINE type, capability, Service, name, etc. PEMC determines to accept the request and allocates the PINE ID for the device. PEMC sends the Join PIN response to the device, including the result (accept or reject), PIN Info, and PINE Info.

q_27689.question: What should the P-Charging-Vector header field parameter be populated with in the dialog request?
q_27689.ground_truth: The P-Charging-Vector header field parameter should be populated with the "icid-value" and a type 1 "orig-ioi" header field parameter in the dialog request.

q_27690.question: What is the purpose of softwar separation of VNFs in a 3GPP network?
q_27690.ground_truth: The purpose of software separation of VNFs in a 3GPP network is to limit both incoming and outgoing traffic in an efficient and scalable way using software defined traffic rules applied directly to each virtual function.

q_27691.question: What is the minimum number of cells that the UE should be able to detect and measure inter-frequency RSTD for, as specified in UE Category 1bis?
q_27691.ground_truth: The UE should be able to detect and measure inter-frequency RSTD for at least 16 cells, including the reference cell.

q_27692.question: What additional parameters may the AF provide if it is able to adjust the transmission time and periodicity?
q_27692.ground_truth: If the AF is able to adjust the transmission time and periodicity, it may provide a BAT Window, the capability for BAT adaptation, or the Periodicity Range to the TSCTSF.

q_27693.question: In which situations should the UE submit the FailureInformation message via SRB1 for transmission?
q_27693.ground_truth: If the procedure was triggered to provide RLC failure information for an MCG RLC bearer or DAPS failure information.

q_27694.question: What is the procedure to establish a direct link between two UEs in ProSe-Enabled technology?
q_27694.ground_truth: The direct link between two UEs is established during the direct link setup procedure or direct link rekeying procedure, with the exchange of message contents related to direct security mode establishment. After successful completion of the direct security mode control procedure, the selected security algorithms and keys are used to integrity protect and cipher all PC5 Signalling messages and data plane traffic exchanged between the UEs.

q_27695.question: What is the charging method that can be assigned to a PDU session to indicate a charging method applicable at the PDU session level, and can only be used at the offline phase?
q_27695.ground_truth: A PDU session charging method indicating "offline only"

q_27696.question: Which field in LCS CDR parameters contains the type of the location in the LCS CDR?
q_27696.ground_truth: The "Location Type" field in the LCS CDR parameters contains the type of the location.

q_27697.question: What action should the UE take if it receives the Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming" in the SERVICE ACCEPT message, and the TAI(s) included in the IE which are belonging to the serving PLMN or equivalent PLMN(s) is not part of the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming"?
q_27697.ground_truth: The UE should store the TAI(s) included in the IE into the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming" and ignore the TAI(s) which do not belong to the serving PLMN or equivalent PLMN(s).

q_27698.question: When is the downlink TCI state known, based on the given conditions?
q_27698.ground_truth: The downlink TCI state is known if the given conditions are met during the period from the last transmission of the RS resource used for the L1-RSRP measurement reporting for the target downlink TCI state to the completion of active downlink TCI state switch.

q_27699.question: In the context of 6.5D.3.1.3, what is the spurious emission requirement for each antenna connector of the UE?
q_27699.ground_truth: The spurious emission requirement is specified at each transmit antenna connector and is applicable for UEs supporting UL MIMO with two transmit antenna connectors in a closed-loop spatial multiplexing scheme.

q_27700.question: What is the format of the Globally Unique Temporary Identifier (GUTI) and Last visited registered Tracking Area Identity (TAI) content?
q_27700.ground_truth: The GUTI is coded as the GUTI part of the EPS mobile identity information element defined in TS 24.301, where Byte 1 corresponds to "octet 2" of an EPS mobile identity information element containing a GUTI and Byte 12 corresponds to "octet 13" of an EPS mobile identity information element containing a GUTI. The Last visited registered TAI is coded as the content of the tracking area identity information element defined in TS 24.301, where Byte 13 corresponds to "octet 2" of a tracking area identity information element and Byte 17 corresponds to "octet 6" of a tracking area identity information element.

q_27701.question: What is the RSTD measurement reporting delay defined as in 8.16.2.3.1.1?
q_27701.ground_truth: The RSTD measurement reporting delay is defined as the time between the point when UE receives both the OTDOA-RequestLocationInformation message and the OTDOA assistance data in the OTDOA-ProvideAssistanceData message, and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface.

q_27702.question: How does the distributed ES function make a decision for the NR capacity booster cell to enter the energySaving state in the distributed energy saving solution?
q_27702.ground_truth: The distributed ES function makes a decision for the NR capacity booster cell to enter the energySaving state based on the cell traffic load information.

q_27703.question: What is the requirement for inter-band carrier aggregation with uplink assigned to two NR bands in terms of NR adjacent channel leakage power ratio?
q_27703.ground_truth: The NR adjacent channel leakage power ratio is defined per component carrier while both component carriers are active and the requirement is specified in clause 6.5.2.4.1.

q_27704.question: Which component carrier is used for connection setup in the test described in clause 7.1.6.4.2?
q_27704.ground_truth: PCell is used for connection setup in the test described in clause 7.1.6.4.2.

q_27705.question: In which scenario is an internal AF in HPLMN required to determine the UE roaming status and provide an encryption key to VPLMN?
q_27705.ground_truth: Case 1 and step 6a1 of the solution details suggest that an internal AF in HPLMN should determine the UE roaming status and provide an encryption key to VPLMN when the registered SN ID is different from the PLMN in which the AF is located and the AF decides to support pushing encryption keys to VPLMN.

q_27706.question: What is the name of the complex type with an "xs:any" wildcard allowing other elements, with the "lax" processContents, and a maximum occurrence of unbounded?

q_27707.question: What is required in the Solicitation message in the Ranging/Sidelink Positioning procedure?
q_27707.ground_truth: The Solicitation message may include Type of Discovery Message, Ranging/Sidelink Positioning service Code, Reference UE info, Target UE info, Role indication (Reference UE) and Reference UE capability.

q_27708.question: Which message includes the DRB-CountInfoListExt-r15 sequence?

q_27709.question: What information does the N3IWF include in the GRE header to enable reflective QoS?
q_27709.ground_truth: The N3IWF includes a Reflective QoS Indicator (RQI) in the GRE header to enable reflective QoS.

q_27710.question: What does the SCEF send in response to the SCS/AS when more than one transfer policy is included in the HTTP response in the procedures for resource management of background data transfer?
q_27710.ground_truth: After receiving the HTTP PATCH message, the SCEF shall include the Bdt data type in the response body and send an HTTP response to the SCS/AS with a "200 OK" status code, indicating that the SCEF has received the message. If an error is identified, a corresponding failure code is sent instead.

q_27711.question: Which field in the "ResourceStatusUpdateIEs" F1AP-PROTOCOL-IES has a CRITICALITY value of "ignore" and allows for the inclusion of the "HardwareLoadIndicator" type?

q_27712.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network in developing enhanced Over-the-Air (OTA) test methods for NR FR1 Total Radiated Power (TRP) and Total Radiated Sensitivity (TRS)?
q_27712.ground_truth: The purpose of 3GPP is to develop a full set of OTA test methods to cover different UE features for TRP and TRS measurement in NR standalone (SA) and NR non-standalone (NSA) operation mode.

q_27713.question: Which message does the gNB-CU-UP send to the gNB-CU-CP to initiate the Bearer Context Release (gNB-CU-CP initiated) procedure?
q_27713.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-UP sends the BEARER CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND message to the gNB-CU-CP to initiate the Bearer Context Release (gNB-CU-CP initiated) procedure.

q_27714.question: How is the low access priority indicator used in charging records and EPS Bearer contexts?
q_27714.ground_truth: The low access priority indicator may be included in charging records by the visited and home networks and stored in the MME EPS Bearer contexts. It is passed as part of these contexts to other network nodes in mobility management procedures for the purpose of including it in charging records.

q_27715.question: What is the significance of the "hname" parameter in the headers portion of a SIP URI?
q_27715.ground_truth: The "hname" parameter in the headers portion of a SIP URI specifies the MIME body type of the message, which can be "application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml" for standalone SDS message and SDS session or FD session.

q_27716.question: What should the S-NG-RAN node include in the S-NODE MODIFICATION REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message if the S-CPAC Request Information IE is contained in the Conditional PSCell Addition Information Modification Request IE included in the S-NODE MODIFICATION REQUEST message?
q_27716.ground_truth: The S-NG-RAN node should include the Conditional PSCell Addition Information Modification Acknowledge IE in the S-NODE MODIFICATION REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message.

q_27717.question: What does the 'num-levels-priority-hierarchy' element specify for the 'off-network' element?
q_27717.ground_truth: The 'num-levels-priority-hierarchy' element specifies the number of priority levels in the hierarchy for the 'off-network' element.

q_27718.question: Which step measures the output power of the UE PUSCH transmission during one slot?
q_27718.ground_truth: Step 3.1 in the OFF power sub test

q_27719.question: What is the purpose of the test described in section 7.3.53 of the document?
q_27719.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to verify that the HD-FDD CE UE properly detects the in-sync state for monitoring downlink radio link quality of the serving cell.

q_27720.question: What is the role of the UE and how does it use the public key of the CN in this process?
q_27720.ground_truth: The UE acts as the "verifier" and uses the public key of the CN, along with the cell-specific PVT, to verify the digital signature of the system information.

q_27721.question: What should the S-CSCF do if there is an original dialog identifier present in the topmost Route header field of the incoming request?
q_27721.ground_truth: If there is an original dialog identifier present in the topmost Route header field of the incoming request, the S-CSCF should store the value of the "orig-ioi" header field parameter received in the P-Charging-Vector header field, if present, remove the received "orig-ioi" header field parameter if next hop is not an AS, include a type 1 "orig-ioi" header field parameter if next hop is not an AS, based on local policy, add an "fe-addr" element of the "fe-identifier" header field parameter to the P-Charging-Vector header field with its own address or if not already available, and remove any received Relayed-Charge header field if next hop is not an AS.

q_27722.question: How should the bodies of HTTP PATCH requests be described in OpenAPI specification files?
q_27722.ground_truth: The bodies of HTTP PATCH requests can be described using either "JSON Merge Patch" encoding as defined in IETF RFC 7396, or "JSON Patch" encoding as defined in IETF RFC 6902.

q_27723.question: In what state does the floor control interface send a Floor Idle message to the associated floor participant when in the 'general floor control operation' state machine and the state is 'G: Idle'?
q_27723.ground_truth: The floor control interface shall send a Floor Idle message to the associated floor participant, including the Floor Indicator field with appropriate indications if the group call is a broadcast group call, a system call, an emergency call, an imminent peril call, or a temporary group session.

q_27724.question: What cell status is indicated as "not barred" and "reserved" for operator use for any PLMN?
q_27724.ground_truth: When cell status is indicated as "not barred" and "reserved" for operator use for any PLMN, UEs assigned to Access Class 11 or 15 operating in their HPLMN/EHPLMN shall treat this cell as a candidate during the cell selection and reselection procedures.

q_27725.question: What is the higher layer parameter that determines the PUSCH to PT-RS power ratio per layer per RE when the UE is scheduled with 1 or 2 PT-RS ports in uplink and the number of scheduled layers is greater than 1?

q_27726.question: Which mobility management procedures are specified for 3GPP accesses and WiMAX to minimize the service interruption during handover and support bidirectional service continuity?
q_27726.ground_truth: The mobility management procedures specified in 4.1.2 of the specification

q_27727.question: What are the performance requirements for PUSCH for high speed train only applicable to?
q_27727.ground_truth: Wide Area Base Stations and Medium Range Base Stations

q_27728.question: What types of custom operations without associated resources are defined for the 5GLANParameterProvision API in this specification release?
q_27728.ground_truth: No custom operations without associated resources are defined for the 5GLANParameterProvision API in this specification release.

q_27729.question: What should the UE do when there is no reference signal received for the CSI measurement over the minimum requirements?
q_27729.ground_truth: If there is no reference signal received for the CSI measurement over the minimum requirements, the UE shall report corresponding valid CSI for the activated SCell on the next available uplink reporting resource after receiving the reference signal.

q_27730.question: What is the purpose of the "eventReportList" attribute in the MbsSessionEventReportList data structure?
q_27730.ground_truth: The "eventReportList" attribute in the MbsSessionEventReportList data structure contains one or several individual MBS session event reports, with each one of them encoded within the MbsSessionEventReport data structure.

q_27731.question: What should be used in the local network with a collocated SGW and LGW for the selection of the SGW in SIPTO service?
q_27731.ground_truth: The Local (H)(e)NB Network ID provided by the (H)(e)NB in the S1-AP/RANAP message should be used to discover the SGW via the DNS.

q_27732.question: What actions are taken to resume suspended bearers after a CS voice call is terminated and the UE returns to E-UTRAN?
q_27732.ground_truth: The UE sends a TAU to the MME, which then informs S-GW and P-GW to resume the suspended bearers using Modify Bearer Request message if triggered by the procedure in operation, or using Resume Notification message in other cases.

q_27733.question: In the OCNG test model, what conditions must be satisfied when OCNG is activated in a non-PCell?
q_27733.ground_truth: While activating OCNG on a non-PCell, TTCN needs to consider the timing information such that the SFN and subframe number correspond to the PCell SFN modulo x = 0, where x is the size of the subframePattern bit string divided by 10 and the subframe number of Pcell equals 0.

q_27734.question: What should the system do if the in-progress imminent peril state of the group is set to false and an MCVideo user has initiated an imminent peril call?
q_27734.ground_truth: If the in-progress imminent peril state of the group is set to false and an MCVideo user has initiated an imminent peril call, the system should set the value of the in-progress imminent peril state of the group to true, generate SIP re-INVITE requests for the MCVideo imminent peril group call to the other affiliated and joined participants of the chat MCVideo group, generate SIP INVITE requests for the MCVideo imminent peril call to the affiliated but not joined members of the chat MCVideo group, send the SIP INVITE request towards the MCVideo client, and cache the information that this MCVideo user has initiated an MCVideo imminent peril call.

q_27735.question: What is the purpose of acquiring the requested SI message(s) corresponding to the requested SIB(s) in clause 5.2.2.3.2?
q_27735.ground_truth: The purpose of acquiring the requested SI message(s) corresponding to the requested SIB(s) in clause 5.2.2.3.2 is to allow the UE to receive the required system information for the cell.

q_27736.question: How does the UE access the localized service in this solution?
q_27736.ground_truth: The UE registers to the hosting network and authenticates using credentials provisioned in step 2. After registration, the UE has access to the localized service.

q_27737.question: In what circumstances should the target UE derive a new KNRP by performing one or more 5G ProSe direct link authentication procedures?
q_27737.ground_truth: When the target UE does not have an existing KNRP for the KNRP ID included in the PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message or when the target UE wishes to derive a new KNRP.

q_27738.question: Which entity in the 5G Uplink Media Streaming architecture obtains feedback from the 5GMSu AF for 5G Media Streaming system provisioning?
q_27738.ground_truth: The 5GMSu Application Provider, via the M1u (5GMSu Provisioning API) interface.

q_27739.question: What attribute in the policy request contains the list of Internal Group Identifiers?
q_27739.ground_truth: The attribute that contains the list of Internal Group Identifiers is "groupIds".

q_27740.question: What should the MME do if the initial delivery of the SGsAP-IMSI-DETACH-INDICATION message to the VLR fails?
q_27740.ground_truth: The MME should attempt to inform the VLR about the detach event by using a retry scheme if the initial delivery of the SGsAP-IMSI-DETACH-INDICATION message fails.

q_27741.question: Which message does the SMF send to initiate the establishment of user-plane resources over the trusted non-3GPP access for the MA PDU Session?
q_27741.ground_truth: The SMF sends an Update SM Context Request to SMF containing a Non-3GPP path switch indication, which indicates that the requested update is for switching the data traffic of an MA PDU Session to the trusted non-3GPP access.

q_27742.question: Which attribute is used to indicate the user local IP address in untrusted non-3GPP access in the "ueLoc" attribute?
q_27742.ground_truth: The user local IP address in untrusted non-3GPP access can be found in the "ueIpv4Addr" or "ueIpv6Addr" attribute in the "ueLoc" attribute.

q_27743.question: Which two types of cells can be the source cell in 4.3.32 NRCellRelation?
q_27743.ground_truth: The two types of cells that can be the source cell in 4.3.32 NRCellRelation are NRCellCU instance and EUtranGenericCell.

q_27744.question: What security parameters are introduced in the solution for protecting the direct discovery set and U2U discovery set?
q_27744.ground_truth: Two sets of security parameters are introduced in the solution: one for protecting the direct discovery set and the other for protecting U2U discovery set.

q_27745.question: What should a UE do when switching from a normal mode to a low mobility scenario, stationary scenario, or stationary and not-at-cell-edge scenario during cell-reselection period?
q_27745.ground_truth: The UE should fulfill the requirements corresponding to normal mode over the measurement period (Tnormal) and thereafter switch to requirements corresponding to the low mobility scenario, stationary scenario, or stationary and not-at-cell edge scenario.

q_27746.question: If the S-CSCF determines that loopback routeing is applicable for an incoming request, what information should it save for subsequent processing?
q_27746.ground_truth: The S-CSCF should save any URI representing the TRF address preference received from the visited network, and the ICID received in the request.

q_27747.question: What should the MCVideo client do when it is in the 'O: pending request' state and it receives RTP media packets with SSRC not associated with any transmitter stored in its transmitter list?
q_27747.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should request the transmission participant to render the received RTP media packets, store the SSRC of RTP media packet in the transmitter list as unknown user, start timer T203 (End of RTP media) associated with the SSRC, and remain in the 'O: pending request' state.

q_27748.question: In Scenario #2, what message does End UE#1 send to End UE#2 after End UE#1 decides to perform U2U Relay reselection with coordinated release of the initial connection?
q_27748.ground_truth: End UE#1 sends a Link Modification Request message which includes an indication to request a coordinated release of the initial connection via Relay#1 and other reselection related parameters.

q_27749.question: What message should the target UE create if the DIRECT LINK AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message cannot be accepted during the PC5 unicast link authentication procedure?
q_27749.ground_truth: The target UE shall create a DIRECT LINK AUTHENTICATION REJECT message, including a PC5 signalling protocol cause IE indicating either authentication failure or lack of resources for PC5 unicast link.

q_27750.question: What does the term "A/V" represent in the 3GPP Technical Specification Group documents?
q_27750.ground_truth: The term "A/V" represents Audio/Visual in the 3GPP Technical Specification Group documents.

q_27751.question: What should an MCVideo client do when it receives a request from an MCVideo user to release a private call session established using on-demand session signalling?
q_27751.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should follow the procedures as specified in clause 6.2.5.1 for on-demand session or clause 6.2.6 for terminating session.

q_27752.question: What is the effect of using the AT+CHCCS command with the parameter "5"?
q_27752.ground_truth: It terminates the connection with the call that has the identification number "5".

q_27753.question: What action does the target gNB/ng-eNB take when it receives a UE's RRCResumeRequest message?
q_27753.ground_truth: The target gNB/ng-eNB extracts the I-RNTI from the message and contacts the source gNB/ng-eNB for UE validation and context retrieval, and it prepares an Xn-AP Retrieve UE Context Request message to send to the source gNB/ng-eNB.

q_27754.question: What should the MCPTT client do upon receiving a SIP 200 (OK) response after sending a SIP INVITE request?
q_27754.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should interact with the media plane, notify the user if it's a remotely initiated ambient listening call, provide no indication to the user if it's a locally initiated ambient listening call, and cache the ambient listening type of the call.

q_27755.question: Which protocol IE is optional and has CRITICALITY ignore in the UplinkS1cdma2000tunnelling structure?
q_27755.ground_truth: There are multiple protocol IEs that are optional and have CRITICALITY ignore in the UplinkS1cdma2000tunnelling structure, including id-EUTRANRoundTripDelayEstimationInfo, id-cdma2000HORequiredIndication, id-cdma2000OneXSRVCCInfo, id-cdma2000OneXRAND, and id-cdma2000SectorID.

q_27756.question: What action does the PCEF take to enforce the authorized QoS of the identified QoS rules?
q_27756.ground_truth: The PCEF installs, modifies or removes the identified QoS Rules, and enforces the authorized QoS of the corresponding QoS Rules.

q_27757.question: What should be the throughput for each component carrier as a percentage of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channels?
q_27757.ground_truth: The throughput for each component carrier should be at least 95% of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channels as specified in Annex A.2 and A.3.

q_27758.question: In which cases should the procedure in clause 6.2 be skipped when performing Network Domain Security?
q_27758.ground_truth: The procedure in clause 6.2 may be skipped if the security procedure in clause 9.2.2.2 for DS-MIPv6 is performed over a trusted access network and if the trusted access network has the properties listed in clause 9.2.2.1.

q_27759.question: What is the role of the EF in storing cell information, and what is the minimum storage capacity provided for this purpose?
q_27759.ground_truth: The EF provides a minimum storage capacity of 46 bytes for storing at least two cell information TLV objects (e.g. GSM/FDD or FDD/TDD).

q_27760.question: What should the MCS UE do upon receiving the identity of the partner MC system selected by the user in manual partner MC system selection mode?
q_27760.ground_truth: The MCS UE shall select the partner MC system identified by the identity of a partner MC system selected by the user.

q_27761.question: What is the purpose of the requirements in clause 8.16.3 for the MAC-CE based uplink TCI state switch delay?
q_27761.ground_truth: The purpose of the requirements in clause 8.16.3 is to specify the delay for the MAC-CE based uplink TCI state switch, which applies for both separate UL TCI state switch and joint TCI state switch. The requirements ensure that the source RS in UL TCI state or joint TCI state is associated with a PCI different from that of the serving cell, and that the cell with a different PCI satisfies the known cell condition. If the known cell condition is not met, a longer delay may be expected. The requirements also specify that the UE is not expected to transmit on uplink based on the target TCI state before completing the downlink and uplink TCI state switch.

q_27762.question: What is the duplication factor in the context of network traffic duplication solutions, and how is it defined?
q_27762.ground_truth: The duplication factor is a percentage between 0% and 100% that determines the amount of traffic duplicated on a secondary access. It can be used to limit the number of duplicated packets to the ones seen as important for the user equipment (UE) and the user plane function (UPF).

q_27763.question: What steps does the PCF need to follow when modifying an existing session rule with conditional data?
q_27763.ground_truth: The PCF shall provision a session rule as defined in clause~4.2.6.3.1 and include within its "refCondData" attribute the corresponding ConditionData's "condId" attribute value. The PCF shall also ensure that the referenced ConditionData instance is included in the "conds" map within the SmPolicyDecision data structure following the procedures defined in clause~4.2.6.1. When modifying the attribute(s) within a session rule, the PCF shall include the modified attribute(s) with the new value(s) within the SessionRule data instance. If the PCF only needs to modify the content of referenced policy decision data, it shall include the corresponding policy decision data within the corresponding map attributes within the SmPolicyDecision data structure.

q_27764.question: Which parameter in the Sbi-Binding-Header header indicates the name of a service?

q_27765.question: What procedure is used for NF/NF service discovery across PLMNs in TS~23.502?
q_27765.ground_truth: The NF/NF service discovery procedure across PLMNs is specified in clause~4.17.5 of TS~23.502. The NRF in the local PLMN interacts with the NRF in the remote PLMN to retrieve the NF profile(s) of the NF instance(s) in the remote PLMN that matches the discovery criteria.

q_27766.question: What does the "ESM-Info" NAS-PDU indicate in the context of 5GC?
q_27766.ground_truth: The "ESM-Info" NAS-PDU contains a 5GC-UE or UE-5GC message in 5GS, which is transferred without interpretation in the NG-RAN node.

q_27767.question: What is the maximum length of the ProSe application code when using application-controlled extension in a PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message?
q_27767.ground_truth: The ProSe application code is encoded as a 184 bitstring when using application-controlled extension in a PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message.

q_27768.question: In what frequency bands do the requirements for power class 1 not apply for inter-band carrier aggregation with one uplink component carrier assigned to one E-UTRA band, as specified in subclause 6.2.2?
q_27768.ground_truth: The requirements for power class 1 do not apply for inter-band carrier aggregation with one uplink component carrier assigned to one E-UTRA band in E-UTRA bands 3, 20, 28, or 31, as specified in subclause 6.2.2.

q_27769.question: What is the purpose of the RequestCapabilities message body in a LPP message?
q_27769.ground_truth: The RequestCapabilities message body in a LPP message is used by the location server to request the target device capability information for LPP and the supported individual positioning methods.

q_27770.question: What is the user plane interface defined for RCLWI in the non-collocated scenario?
q_27770.ground_truth: There is no user plane interface defined between the eNB and the WT in RCLWI for the non-collocated scenario.

q_27771.question: What is the range of MR synchronization/resynchronization energy consumption for various Effective per UE paging arrival rate, duty cycle ratio, ON power, and FAR values?
q_27771.ground_truth: The range of MR synchronization/resynchronization energy consumption is between 1000unit and 3000unit for various Effective per UE paging arrival rate, duty cycle ratio, ON power, and FAR values.

q_27772.question: What should the target UE do upon receipt of a DIRECT LINK IDENTIFIER UPDATE REQUEST message?
q_27772.ground_truth: If the PC5 unicast link associated with this request message is still valid and the timer T5010 for the PC5 unicast link identified by this request message is not running, then the target UE accepts this request and responds with a DIRECT LINK IDENTIFIER UPDATE ACCEPT message.

q_27773.question: What is the purpose of declaring sensitivity RoAoA in OSDD?
q_27773.ground_truth: The purpose of declaring sensitivity RoAoA in OSDD is to ensure that the SAN meets the minimum sensitivity requirement in the specified range of angles of arrival.

q_27774.question: What is the action taken by a UE when it receives a 5GMM cause value of #10 while acting as a 5G-RG on behalf of the AUN3 device over a wireline access network?
q_27774.ground_truth: The UE should abort the initial registration procedure that was initiated on behalf of the AUN3 device. The 5G-RG should set its 5GS update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED and delete its 5G-GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI list, ngKSI, and registration attempt counter. It should then enter the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.

q_27775.question: What are the initial conditions for the procedure described in 4.9.41.2?
q_27775.ground_truth: In the procedure described in 4.9.41.2, the initial conditions include a single NR cell connected to 5GC with default parameters, 1 NR-SS-UE, 1 GNSS simulator, and a user equipment that is in state 3N-A.

q_27776.question: Which components are involved in the HSS/AAA-initiated detach procedure with GTP on S2b in the non-roaming, home routed roaming and local breakout case?
q_27776.ground_truth: The HSS, AAA, ePDG, and PDN GW are involved in this procedure.

q_27777.question: What does the UE do after successfully receiving and decoding data from the network, as specified in the test purpose in section 7.1.3.13.3.2?
q_27777.ground_truth: The UE sends an ACK to the network.

q_27778.question: What is the impact of the Traffic Category Traffic Descriptor in URSP rules on UE behavior?
q_27778.ground_truth: When the UE receives URSP rules with Traffic Category traffic descriptors, it considers them applicable only if the Traffic Category of the detected application matches the Traffic Category of the Traffic Descriptor in the URSP rule.

q_27779.question: What is the unique PDU Session ID creation method in the SMF+PGW-C during establishment of non-emergency PDN connection and emergency PDN connection for a UE that does not support 5GC NAS?
q_27779.ground_truth: The SMF+PGW-C creates a unique PDU Session ID for each PDN connection of the UE based on the EPS Bearer IDs assigned by the MME for the PDN Connections associated with the UE and not be in the range of PDU Session ID values that can be created by a 5GC NAS capable UE. If handover between EPS and EPC/ePDG is required, the SMF+PGW-C may perform additional steps to ensure the uniqueness of PDU Session ID.

q_27780.question: What is the purpose of the P-Asserted-Service header field in the SIP PUBLISH request for sending a functional alias status change towards the MCPTT server owning the functional alias?
q_27780.ground_truth: The P-Asserted-Service header field includes the ICSI value "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcptt" (coded as specified in 3GPP TS 24.229) to indicate the service involved in the SIP message.

q_27781.question: What is the DL peak data rate in NR satellite access, as defined in Report ITU-R M.2514?
q_27781.ground_truth: The DL peak data rate in NR satellite access is calculated as the product of the channel bandwidth and the peak spectral efficiency for DL, as defined in equation 4.2-1 of Report ITU-R M.2514.

q_27782.question: What state transition occurs when a UE receives a STATUS message with a cause value other than #81 or #97?
q_27782.ground_truth: No state transition occurs, but local actions are possible.

q_27783.question: What message does the UE send to the PDN GW to de-register its DSMIPv6 binding in the scenario where a UE uses a trusted or untrusted non-3GPP access system?
q_27783.ground_truth: The UE sends a BU (lifetime) to the PDN GW to de-register its DSMIPv6 binding.

q_27784.question: What is the difference between short-term denial and long-term denial in CCBS service?
q_27784.ground_truth: Short-term denial is a temporary inability of the network to accept user A's request to activate the CC service, while long-term denial is a situation where the network cannot accept user A's request to activate the CC service, and a later attempt to activate the CC service for the same destination B will also be rejected.

q_27785.question: What is the procedure for sending a SEALDD Transmission Request?
q_27785.ground_truth: To send a SEALDD Transmission Request, the service consumer sends an HTTP POST request to the SEALDD Server with the request body including the TransReq data structure, specifying the type of transmission requested ("regular" or "urllc"). Upon success, the SEALDD Server responds with an HTTP "200 OK" status code, and on failure, it returns an appropriate error status code and additional information.

q_27786.question: What information is provided by the "LTE-M Indication" IE in the 3GPP NG RAN protocol?
q_27786.ground_truth: The "LTE-M Indication" IE is provided by the NG-RAN node to inform that the UE indicates category M1 or M2 in its UE Radio Capability.

q_27787.question: In what situation should the MCData server send a SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP PUBLISH request?
q_27787.ground_truth: The MCData server should send a SIP 200 (OK) response if the SIP PUBLISH request is valid and the required conditions are met.

q_27788.question: What is the procedure followed by the AS for the session setup when originating a session, as per the Application Server Origination Procedure?
q_27788.ground_truth: The AS may proceed by sending the session initiation request to the S-CSCF if the session requires the use of a S-CSCF, or if the Public Service Identity on whose behalf the AS intends to generate the session does not require the use of a S-CSCF, then the AS sends the session initiation request directly towards the terminating network, using the principles defined in IETF~RFC~3263 to route the session initiation request.

q_27789.question: What should the SCC AS do when it receives a SIP BYE or SIP CANCEL request containing certain information on the target access leg and the operator specific timer has not yet expired?
q_27789.ground_truth: The SCC AS should send a SIP 200 (OK) response to the BYE or CANCEL request and wait until the operator specific timer expires or until a SIP UPDATE request containing certain information is received before cancelling the call as specified in 3GPP TS 24.229.

q_27790.question: When shall the mobile station (MS) ignore a SETUP, EMERGENCY SETUP, or START CC message received with octet 1 part of the TI value coded as "111"?
q_27790.ground_truth: When TI EXT bit =1 or no extension is used

q_27791.question: What is the impact on the positioning accuracy improvement for Redcap UEs in FR1 UMi scenario when phase offset between hops is considered and frequency hopping with partial overlap for phase offset compensation is used?
q_27791.ground_truth: The positioning accuracy improvement is observed for UL TDOA, DL TDOA, and Multi-RTT when the phase offset between hops is considered, and frequency hopping with partial overlap for phase offset compensation is used in FR1 UMi scenario.

q_27792.question: What kind of sensors are typically used in AR systems for real-time localization?
q_27792.ground_truth: Most AR systems use vision sensors such as cameras, an inertial measurement unit, and a GPS.

q_27793.question: What information does the "ECGI" attribute provide in the <transmission> and <reception> elements?
q_27793.ground_truth: The "ECGI" attribute in the <transmission> and <reception> elements contains the parameter defined in subclause~12.4.2.5, indicating E-UTRAN Cell Global Identification of the E-UTRAN cell where the UE was camping on or which the UE used in the EMM-CONNECTED mode when transmitting or receiving the data.
