q_27794.question: What happens when the NG-RAN node(s) joins the delivery of the broadcast MBS session if multicast transport is used over N3mb?
q_27794.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node(s) responds with the N2 MBS Session Setup Response message including a MBS Session Setup or Modification Transfer IE if a Shared NG-U Unicast TNL Information needs to be allocated for unicast transport over N3mb interface.

q_27795.question: What is the function of the Central Binding Server (CBS) in common EAS selection?
q_27795.ground_truth: The function of the Central Binding Server (CBS) in common EAS selection is to decide whether to proceed with the currently selected EAS or instruct to use another EAS for the UE group. The CBS maintains the binding information for the UE group and uses EDN id to identify EDN (Edge Network Domain) to ensure the correct mapping of UEs to the corresponding EAS.

q_27796.question: What should the UE do when performing the handover procedure and the physical frequency remains unchanged but the band is changed?
q_27796.ground_truth: E-UTRAN releases the measObject corresponding to the source frequency and adds a measObject corresponding to the target frequency.

q_27797.question: Which record does the IRI-POI in the PTC server generate when the IRI-POI detects that the PTC target initiates an on-demand session or receives an invitation to join an on-demand session?
q_27797.ground_truth: The IRI-POI in the PTC server generates an xIRI containing a PTCSessionInitiation record when it detects that the PTC target initiates an on-demand session or receives an invitation to join an on-demand session.

q_27798.question: What should the MBSF do upon success when updating an MBS User Service?
q_27798.ground_truth: The MBSF should update the concerned "Individual MBS User Service" resource and respond to the NF service consumer with either an HTTP "200 OK" status code containing the updated representation of the resource within the MBSUserService data structure or an HTTP "204 No Content" status code.

q_27799.question: What is one condition that would lead the UE to initiate the monitor request procedure?
q_27799.ground_truth: When the UE is triggered by an upper layer application to perform restricted ProSe direct discovery model A monitoring corresponding to at least one RPAUID, and the UE has no valid Restricted Discovery Filters corresponding to the requested RPAUID for that upper layer application.

q_27800.question: What is the role of the test equipment in this test, as specified in clause 6.4.1.1.4.2?
q_27800.ground_truth: The test equipment is used to monitor all SRS transmissions and verify that the UE transmit timing offset stays within a specified range.

q_27801.question: Which element in the XML schema has the complex type name "tSessionOrientedServiceInfoType"?
q_27801.ground_truth: The element with the name "v2x-service-id" has the complex type name "tSessionOrientedServiceInfoType".

q_27802.question: Which message is used to verify validity of the indicated cell access mode and CSG ID for a closed HeNB in case of S1 INITIAL UE MESSAGE, S1 PATH SWITCH REQUEST, and S1 HANDOVER REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message?
q_27802.ground_truth: S1 INITIAL UE MESSAGE, S1 PATH SWITCH REQUEST, and S1 HANDOVER REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message.

q_27803.question: Which information element is used to indicate the PDCP change indication in the "S-Node Modification Required" sequence?
q_27803.ground_truth: The "id-PDCPChangeIndication" information element is used to indicate the PDCP change indication in the "S-Node Modification Required" sequence.

q_27804.question: What is the purpose of Test Case 14 (TC14)?
q_27804.ground_truth: The purpose of TC14 is to test UTRA, E-UTRA, and NB-IoT standalone multi-carrier aspects.

q_27805.question: What subframe should the SS receive the first CSI report for intra-band CA UE in step 6b?

q_27806.question: What is the recommended UE delay for ensuring a good conversational experience?
q_27806.ground_truth: It is generally desirable to minimize UE delays to ensure low enough end-to-end delays and hence a good conversational experience, guidance is found in ITU-T Recommendation G.114.

q_27807.question: What is the role of the SL Positioning Client UE in the Ranging/SL positioning operation when the SL Positioning Client UE consumes the Ranging/SL positioning service?
q_27807.ground_truth: The SL Positioning Client UE triggers the Ranging/SL positioning, and then requests the network to perform the Ranging/SL positioning between the UE1 and UE2. It includes the Ranging/SL positioning requirement in the MO-LR Request toward the AMF3.

q_27808.question: What generic term is used to describe the process of providing NR sidelink synchronization information for NR sidelink communication/discovery and SLSS/PSBCH transmission?
q_27808.ground_truth: The term is "Sidelink synchronization information transmission procedure for NR sidelink communication/discovery/positioning."

q_27809.question: What is the purpose of reporting only the top K largest MSD values?
q_27809.ground_truth: Reporting only the top K largest MSD values together with the corresponding mechanism index and improved MSD values reduces signaling overhead and saves UE memory size.

q_27810.question: What privacy issue is addressed in Key Issue #4 regarding UE-to-UE relay?
q_27810.ground_truth: The main privacy issue addressed is protecting the privacy of identities exchanged in communications between peer UEs over a UE-to-UE relay.

q_27811.question: What is the first step in creating a PDU session with "5G VN internal" switching in the local PSA UPF(s)?
q_27811.ground_truth: The first step is to associate the UL traffic on the access side of the PDU Session with "5G VN internal" switching in the local PSA UPF(s).

q_27812.question: What should the MCVideo client do upon receiving a PRIVATE CALL ACCEPT ACK message or RTP media from the originating user, when in the "P5: pending" state of a private video pull call?
q_27812.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should follow the procedure as defined in clause~10.3.2.4.3.4 with the clarification to not start transmission control as the terminating MCVideo client.

q_27813.question: What should a transmission participant do when it receives a Transmission Arbitration Taken message and there is no stored current transmission arbitrator?
q_27813.ground_truth: If the <User ID> value in the User ID field in the Transmission Arbitration Taken message doesn't match with the User ID in the transmitter list, the transmission participant should start timer T203 (End of RTP media). It should then store the value of the <User ID> field of the Transmission Arbitration Taken message as the current transmission arbitrator and remain in the 'O: pending request' state.

q_27814.question: What entities are responsible for collecting charging information in case of interworking between 5GS and EPC?
q_27814.ground_truth: The dedicated PGW-C + SMF collects charging information using the same mechanisms as the SMF.

q_27815.question: What is the syntax of the XnAP-PDU definition?
q_27815.ground_truth: The syntax of the XnAP-PDU definition is a choice between initiatingMessage, successfulOutcome, and unsuccessfulOutcome.

q_27816.question: Which keys and associated key identifiers are used for protecting the media sent and received by MCData clients in an on-network MCData communication for an MCData group?
q_27816.ground_truth: The GMK and the GMK-ID of the MCData group are used for protecting the media sent and received by MCData clients in an on-network MCData communication for an MCData group.

q_27817.question: What should the UE do if it receives a request from upper layers to establish an eCall over IMS while in the EMM-DEREGISTERED.eCALL-INACTIVE substate?
q_27817.ground_truth: The UE should enter the EMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-ATTACH substate and use the relevant EMM and ESM procedures to establish the eCall over IMS at the earliest opportunity.

q_27818.question: What is the term defined in the document that refers to the time period available to repair the primary timing source when it is lost?

q_27819.question: What is required for the PCF to include MA PDU Session control information within the PCC rule for ATSSS support?
q_27819.ground_truth: The SMF and the PCF should both support the "ATSSS" feature as defined in clause 5.8 and there should be detected service data flow within the PCC rule.

q_27820.question: What is the size of the supportedBandListEUTRA IE in the OTDOA-ProvideCapabilities IE in the ASN.1 definition of the OTDOA-Positioning scheme?

q_27821.question: What should an MCPTT client do when the <allow-call-transfer> element of the user profile document is set to a value of "false" and it receives a request to transfer an ongoing MCPTT private call?
q_27821.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should indicate to the requesting MCPTT user that they are not authorized to initiate a call transfer request, and skip the other steps.

q_27822.question: What existing features can support the functionality of the eRG in ensuring the required QoS for AR/VR gaming in a 5G context?
q_27822.ground_truth: 3GPP TS 22.220 and TS 22.261 specify requirements and features for indoor base stations and 5GLAN networks that can be used to provide the same 5G LAN-type service to AR/VR devices in a 5G network.

q_27823.question: What should the target UE do if it receives a new PROSE DIRECT LINK IDENTIFIER UPDATE REQUEST message from the same layer-2 ID while the ongoing 5G ProSe direct link identifier update procedure is still in progress?
q_27823.ground_truth: The target UE should stop the timer T5083 and abort the ongoing 5G ProSe direct link identifier update procedure.

q_27824.question: What should the NSACF do if it receives a request to mute events from the NWDAF or DCCF, and the "notifFlag" attribute is set to "DEACTIVATE"?
q_27824.ground_truth: The NSACF should mute the event notification and store the available events.

q_27825.question: What is the HTTP request header used for conveying the client credentials assertion when sending messages over the N32 interface in 3GPP networks?

q_27826.question: What is the procedure for group affiliation to an interworking group defined in the LMR system via the IWF?
q_27826.ground_truth: The procedure involves sending a MC service group affiliation request from the MC service client to the MC service server, which then sends an IWF group affiliation request to the IWF. The IWF performs the necessary translations and protocol conversions and sends an IWF group affiliation response back to the MC service server, which then stores the group affiliation status of the MC service client for the requested interworking group.

q_27827.question: How does the NRF perform authorization for ML model retrieval in this solution?
q_27827.ground_truth: The NRF performs service authorization of ML model retrieval using token-based authorization at the NRF.

q_27828.question: What action should the MS take if timer T3396 is running when the MS is switched off and then on again with the same SIM/USIM?
q_27828.ground_truth: If t1 is greater than t, then the timer shall be restarted with the value t1 - t. If t1 is equal to or less than t, then the timer need not be restarted.

q_27829.question: What should the UE do when it receives a PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message for a PDU session that is in the state PDU SESSION INACTIVE in the UE?
q_27829.ground_truth: The UE should include the 5GSM cause #43 "Invalid PDU session identity" in the 5GSM STATUS message and set the PDU session ID to the received PDU session ID in the UL NAS TRANSPORT message.

q_27830.question: What is the primary technique for self-interference suppression for a LA BS with a smaller array size in the Ericsson study?

q_27831.question: Under what conditions is the UE-initiated Detach procedure used to disconnect the last PDN connection?
q_27831.ground_truth: The UE uses the UE-initiated Detach procedure in clause~5.3.8.2 to disconnect the last PDN connection if "Attach without PDN Connectivity is supported" and the UE requires the last PDN connection to be disconnected.

q_27832.question: What is the effect of the PCF returning "200 OK" response message during an SM policy association update?
q_27832.ground_truth: A successful SM policy association update is added to the relevant subcounter per S-NSSAI.

q_27833.question: In what scenarios can other PGW-C/SMFs from the same PGW-C/SMF set take over the control of PDN connections served by an unavailable PGW-C/SMF?
q_27833.ground_truth: This can occur when a PGW-C/SMF becomes no longer available due to failure (without restart or with a scale-in operation) or when a change in the PGW-C/SMF of a PDN connection is required, causing a PGW-C/SMF to be de-instantiated from the PGW-C/SMF set.

q_27834.question: What initial conditions does the method of test 8.3.7.4.2 specified for, as outlined in clause 8.3.7.4.2.1, regarding the BS and the test environment?
q_27834.ground_truth: The BS's manufacturer declared coordinate system reference point should be placed in the same position and aligned with the test system in a normal test environment.

q_27835.question: What are the conditions for PUSCH with DM-RS bundling performance tests to apply to different antenna connectors in a BS of type 1-C?
q_27835.ground_truth: The PUSCH with DM-RS bundling performance tests with low MIMO correlation level apply only for the highest number of supported connectors in a BS of type 1-C, using the specific connectors declared by the manufacturer.

q_27836.question: How many resource block groups are present in a resource allocation field for uplink resource allocation type 1?
q_27836.ground_truth: A resource allocation field for uplink resource allocation type 1 includes two sets of resource blocks with each set including one or more consecutive resource block groups of size P.

q_27837.question: What should be assigned in sl-RemoteUE-L2Identity for L2 U2U Remote UE if a local ID pair is to be assigned or modified for an end-to-end PC5 connection?
q_27837.ground_truth: The new local UE ID should be set in sl-RemoteUE-LocalIdentity and the source L2 ID of the L2 U2U Remote UE should be set in sl-RemoteUE-L2Identity, if needed.

q_27838.question: What action should the S-CSCF take regarding the Relayed-Charge header field when it is not the next hop?
q_27838.ground_truth: The S-CSCF should remove the Relayed-Charge header field when it is not the next hop.

q_27839.question: How many subcarrier spacings for UL does the UE support on one carrier of one band entry in a band combination?

q_27840.question: What does the term "UE" refer to in the context of the document?

q_27841.question: What is the purpose of step 9-12 in the immediate messaging procedure to unregistered Public User Identity?
q_27841.ground_truth: The MESSAGE request is acknowledged with an appropriate acknowledgement response, which traverses the transaction path back to UE#1.

q_27842.question: In the context of UE DL Category M1, under AWGN (Additive White Gaussian Noise) conditions, what is the requirement for the PDSCH BLER using the transport format indicated by the median CQI in a TDD system?
q_27842.ground_truth: If the PDSCH BLER using the transport format indicated by the median CQI is greater than 0.1, the BLER using transport format indicated by (median CQI - 1) shall be less than or equal to 0.1.

q_27843.question: What should the UE do upon receiving N311 consecutive "in-sync" indications from lower layers while T310 is running as specified in TS 36.331 clause 5.3.11.2?
q_27843.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T310 and resume the RRC connection without explicit signalling.

q_27844.question: What is the role of the NSSAAF in the NSS-AAA initiated revocation of network slice authorization?
q_27844.ground_truth: The NSSAAF is responsible for releasing the corresponding resources and interacting with its succeeding Network Function (AMF) to revoke network slice authorization.

q_27845.question: What should the User Equipment (UE) indicate to support access performance measurements per QoS Flow?
q_27845.ground_truth: The UE should indicate its support for access performance measurements per QoS Flow in its Access Traffic Steering, Switching and Splitting (ATSSS) capabilities.

q_27846.question: What is the test setup for EN-DC including FR1 and FR2 carriers in terms of the PCell?
q_27846.ground_truth: The test setup for EN-DC including FR1 and FR2 carriers in terms of the PCell is specified in Clause 9.1.2.

q_27847.question: What is the purpose of the re-selection delay in the test?
q_27847.ground_truth: The re-selection delay is used to define the time it takes for the UE to re-select a lower priority cell, which is used as a test requirement in the test case.

q_27848.question: What should be placed if neither NB-IoT guard-band nor NB-IoT in-band operation is supported but NR and E-UTRA operations are supported?
q_27848.ground_truth: An E-UTRA carrier should be placed if neither NB-IoT guard-band nor NB-IoT in-band operation is supported, but NR and E-UTRA operations are supported.

q_27849.question: What information corresponds to the actual individual presence reporting area when the UE enters or leaves one or more presence reporting areas related to a PRA set?
q_27849.ground_truth: The additional presence reporting area information

q_27850.question: What should the floor control server do upon receiving a Floor Release message for which a Floor Revoke message has been sent in multi-talker floor control?
q_27850.ground_truth: The floor control server should request the media distributor to stop forwarding RTP media packets, stop timer T1 (End of RTP media) and T3 (Stop talking grace), remove the participant from the list of currently granted talkers, and send a Floor Release Multi Talker message. If the active floor request queue is not empty, the floor control server should enter the 'G: Idle' state. If both the active floor request queue and the list of currently granted talkers are empty, the floor control server should also enter the 'G: Idle' state. If the active floor request queue is empty but the list of currently granted talkers is not, the floor control server should enter the 'G: Floor Taken' state.

q_27851.question: What does the DS-TT port number in the device refer to when the DS-TT functionality is supported?
q_27851.ground_truth: The DS-TT port number represents the PDU Session's DS-TT port number in the device.

q_27852.question: When should the UE initiate transmission of the MBMSInterestIndication message if SystemInformationBlockType20 is broadcast by the PCell?
q_27852.ground_truth: The UE should initiate transmission of the MBMSInterestIndication message if it is connected to a PCell not broadcasting SystemInformationBlockType20 since the last transmission of the MBMSInterestIndication message, or if the set of MBMS services of interest is different from the mbms-Services included in the last transmission of the MBMSInterestIndication message.

q_27853.question: What attribute should be provided if a list of top applications is to be requested based on the maximum number of traffic contribution in uplink and/or downlink directions in the User Data Congestion feature?
q_27853.ground_truth: The "maxTopAppUlNbr" attribute for uplink direction traffic and/or the "maxTopAppDlNbr" attribute for downlink direction traffic should be provided to request a list of top applications.

q_27854.question: What is beam correspondence in the context of 3GPP beam management procedures?
q_27854.ground_truth: Beam correspondence is the ability of a user equipment (UE) to determine its uplink transmit beam based on downlink measurements on one or more receive beams.

q_27855.question: What is the minimum link budget difference between NR and PUSCH in an Urban scenario at 4 GHz with a DL PSD of 33 dBm/MHz and maximum 11-PRB UE bandwidth?

q_27856.question: What should the AMF do if the DNN selected by the network is a LADN DNN after a successful SMF selection?
q_27856.ground_truth: The AMF should determine the UE presence in LADN service area.

q_27857.question: What should be contained in the message body for a 4xx/5xx response in step 2b of the policy update procedures with an I-SMF?
q_27857.ground_truth: A VsmfUpdateError structure, including N4 response information if available (e.g. PFCP Session Establishment Response with a rejection cause).

q_27858.question: What is the requirement for the difference between the wideband CQI indices of the PCell and SCell for CA with 2 DL CC under AWGN conditions?
q_27858.ground_truth: The difference between the wideband CQI indices of the PCell and SCell should be greater than or equal to 2 for more than 90% of the time.

q_27859.question: What is the maximum allowed time for an event triggered measurement report to be sent after the beginning of time period T2?
q_27859.ground_truth: The maximum allowed time for an event triggered measurement report to be sent after the beginning of time period T2 is 802 ms, including a TTI insertion uncertainty of 2 ms.

q_27860.question: What can be used for classification of the PDU sessions for communication of a certain 5G VN group?
q_27860.ground_truth: The DNN/S-NSSAI can be used for classification of the PDU sessions for communication of a certain 5G VN group.

q_27861.question: What should the UE do upon the expiry of timer T3247?
q_27861.ground_truth: Upon the expiry of timer T3247, the UE should remove all tracking areas from the list of "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service" and "forbidden tracking areas for roaming", set the USIM to valid for EPS services and non-EPS services if certain conditions are met, and remove PLMNs from the list of forbidden PLMNs for each PLMN-specific attempt counter that meets certain conditions.

q_27862.question: What is the method used to determine the coded media in an SRTP (unencrypted header, encrypted payload) packet, as the RTP header is part of the encrypted payload and doesn't provide meta-information on the media carried?
q_27862.ground_truth: The application supplements by conveying different desired QoS handling priority by using different IPv6 flow labels, DSCP, sender ports.

q_27863.question: What is the expected behavior of the UE when a mobile originated detach is required during an attach procedure?
q_27863.ground_truth: The UE aborts the attach procedure and performs the UE initiated detach procedure.

q_27864.question: What entity represents the localized service provider in the network to provision non-UE specific localized service data?
q_27864.ground_truth: An AF, which is an external party to the network, represents the localized service provider in the network to provision non-UE specific localized service data.

q_27865.question: What is required in the initiation of a conversation using MBMS bearer procedures?
q_27865.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT function sends a Map Group To Bearer message over the MCPTT-9 reference point to indicate the association information between the group identity of the call and the TMGI of the MBMS bearer, as well as additional necessary parameters.

q_27866.question: What should be the maximum time within which the UE shall be able to activate the deactivated LAA SCell?
q_27866.ground_truth: The delay within which the UE shall be able to activate the deactivated SCell depends upon the specified conditions, as given in 8.26.1.3.

q_27867.question: What is the requirement for the TB success rate during the SDR test for EN-DC including FR2 NR carrier in Clause 9.4B.1.2.1?
q_27867.ground_truth: The TB success rate should be higher than 85% for EN-DC including FR2 NR carrier in Clause 9.4B.1.2.1.

q_27868.question: What should the UE do with the TIN in the non-volatile memory in the ME upon successful completion of the detach procedure?
q_27868.ground_truth: The UE should store the TIN in the non-volatile memory in the ME for a subsequent attach procedure if it supports A/Gb mode or Iu mode.

q_27869.question: What does the LCS-to-GCS-Translation::= SEQUENCE sequence translate to?
q_27869.ground_truth: LCS-to-GCS-Translation sequence translates to a 360-degree spherical coordinate system used for seamless indoor and outdoor navigation. It contains alpha, beta, and gamma values and is used for providing coordinates to the GCS (Global Coordinate System). The iE-Extensions represent additional information that can be added to this sequence.

q_27870.question: What should the UE do if it receives a RRCConnectionReestablishment message and has logged measurements available with the RPLMN included in plmn-IdentityList stored in VarLogMeasReport?
q_27870.ground_truth: The UE should include the logMeasAvailable in the RRCConnectionReestablishmentComplete message and submit it to lower layers for transmission indicates the availability of logged measurements when re-establishing the connection.

q_27871.question: What must the manufacturer declare for each supported channel bandwidth regarding NB-IoT operation?
q_27871.ground_truth: The manufacturer must declare whether the base station supports NB-IoT in-band and/or guard band operation and the number of supported NB-IoT PRBs (physical resource blocks) for each supported channel bandwidth.

q_27872.question: What information must the UE include in the ATTACH REQUEST message if there is no valid GUTI available?
q_27872.ground_truth: If there is no valid GUTI available, the UE must include the IMSI in the ATTACH REQUEST message.

q_27873.question: What is the procedure for IPv4 address allocation for a UE after successful PDU session establishment procedure?
q_27873.ground_truth: IPv4 address allocation via DHCPv4 procedure after successful PDU session establishment procedure.

q_27874.question: What information is contained in the "operator-specific-GI" field?

q_27875.question: What identifies the cause of failure in a Charging Data Request STOP towards the CDF in a session termination?

q_27876.question: What information is transmitted by means of the DCI format N1 when the format N1 CRC is scrambled by a G-RNTI?
q_27876.ground_truth: The information transmitted includes the information for SC-MCCH change notification.

q_27877.question: What YANG parameter can be used to identify a host towards a DetNet controller in a 5GS node?
q_27877.ground_truth: The YANG parameter of host type as defined in RFC 6021 can be used to identify a host towards a DetNet controller in a 5GS node, which can be either an IP address or a domain name.

q_27878.question: What should the UE do if SystemInformationBlockType2 includes ac-BarringPerPLMN-List and the ac-BarringPerPLMN-List contains an AC-BarringPerPLMN entry with the plmn-IdentityIndex corresponding to the PLMN selected by upper layers?
q_27878.ground_truth: The UE shall select the AC-BarringPerPLMN entry with the plmn-IdentityIndex corresponding to the PLMN selected by upper layers; and in the remainder of this procedure, use the selected AC-BarringPerPLMN entry irrespective of the common access barring parameters included in SystemInformationBlockType2.

q_27879.question: What is the maximum throughput performance required for E-UTRA bands to pass the test procedure?
q_27879.ground_truth: The maximum throughput must be 95% or more of the reference measurement channel's maximum throughput.

q_27880.question: When is the Extension PDP-Address parameter used?
q_27880.ground_truth: The Extension PDP-Address parameter is used to indicate an additional address of the data protocol, and it is included when the PDP supports dual-stack (IPv4v6).

q_27881.question: What should be done with the RLC data PDUs that are received in duplication in AM RLC?
q_27881.ground_truth: The receiving side of an AM RLC entity should detect duplicated RLC data PDUs and discard them to avoid redundancy.

q_27882.question: What is a measurable QoS parameter that can be monitored by the UPF in the 5G network?
q_27882.ground_truth: An example of a measurable QoS parameter is packet delay monitoring, which allows for the measurement of UL packet delay, DL packet delay, or round trip packet delay between UE and PSA UPF.

q_27883.question: What action does the PCF take when the NWDAF determines that the network performance goes below the threshold?
q_27883.ground_truth: When the NWDAF determines that the network performance goes below the threshold, the NWDAF notifies the PCF with the network performance analytics in the area of interest and time window. The PCF may try to re-negotiate the affected BDT policies with AFs that accepted BDT policy re-negotiation.

q_27884.question: What is the difference between frame-packed stereoscopic 3D video and multiview stereoscopic 3D video in the document?
q_27884.ground_truth: Frame-packed stereoscopic 3D video consists of two views packed into a single stream before compression, while multiview stereoscopic 3D video consists of two views packed into a single stream during compression.

q_27885.question: What protocol is used by the P-GW to deliver an IPv6 prefix to the S-GW in the case of using PMIP-based S5/S8?
q_27885.ground_truth: The prefix is delivered from the P-GW to the S-GW in the IPv6 Home Network Prefix Option IE of a Proxy Binding Ackowledgement message.

q_27886.question: What happens when the user receives MBS data in RRC Inactive state and needs to access a new RAN node?
q_27886.ground_truth: The user needs to activate the associated PDU session via the service request or registration procedure if an RRC connection needs to be established.

q_27887.question: What are the requirements for the fraction of falsely detected ACKs in the testing procedure for PUCCH format 2 ACK detection in the IAB-DU tester?
q_27887.ground_truth: The requirement for the fraction of falsely detected ACKs in the testing procedure for PUCCH format 2 ACK detection in the IAB-DU tester is less than 1%.

q_27888.question: What are the two different values provided by the timing adjustment for IAB operation and when are they used?
q_27888.ground_truth: The two different values provided by the timing adjustment for IAB operation are Tdelta, which is used to determine the IAB-DU DL Tx timing adjustment for the Case-1 timing mode and the IAB-DU DL Tx and IAB-MT UL Tx timing adjustment for the Case-6 timing mode, and Toffset,2, which is used to determine the IAB-MT UL Tx timing adjustment for the Case-7 timing mode. These timing adjustments are provided to an IAB node by its parent node for time-domain synchronization across multiple backhaul hops.

q_27889.question: What are the four modifications to the Service Request procedure specified in clause~4.12a.4.1 for the trusted non-3GPP access when applied to a trusted WLAN access point (TWAP)?
q_27889.ground_truth: The four modifications are: (1) the trusted non-3GPP access is substituted by a TWAP, (2) the TNGF is substituted by the TWIF, (3) the TWIF sends and receives NAS messages on behalf of the N5CW device, and (4) the user plane between the N5CW device and TWIF is established using Yt' connection instead of IKEv2 signalling.

q_27890.question: In what scenario will a UE store the TAI(s) belonging to the current registration area in the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming" when receiving a REGISTRATION REJECT message with integrity protection?
q_27890.ground_truth: When the UE is not operating in SNPN access operation mode and the REGISTRATION REJECT message is received from one of the TAI(s) in the current registration area.

q_27891.question: What is the 5G network's role when the AI/ML server is not allowed to access the user's location information?
q_27891.ground_truth: The 5G network can still interact with the AI/ML model server for prediction of need of certain AI/ML model without breaking user privacy policies. Two possible solutions include prediction based on monitoring function of the 5G network and prediction based on NWDAF analytics function of the 5G network.

q_27892.question: What entity allocates resources for the M2u protocol and format in the 5GMSu system?
q_27892.ground_truth: The 5GMSu AS (Application Server) interacts with the 5GMSu AS at reference point M3u to allocate resources for the M2u protocol and format.

q_27893.question: What should an MCPTT client distinguish between for private call call-back request for terminating client?
q_27893.ground_truth: The MCPTT client needs to distinguish between SIP MESSAGE requests containing a Content-Type header field set to "application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml" and including an XML body containing a <mcpttinfo> root element containing the <mcptt-Params> element and an <anyExt> element containing the <request-type> element set to a value of "private-call-call-back-request" for private call call-back request for terminating client.

q_27894.question: What should the UE do when a PDCP SDU is successfully delivered?
q_27894.ground_truth: The UE should discard the PDCP SDU along with the corresponding PDCP PDU. If the corresponding PDCP PDU has already been submitted to lower layers, the discard is indicated to lower layers.

q_27895.question: What are the minimum conformance requirements for the accuracy of RSRP of a non-overlapping carrier in the test described?
q_27895.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements for the accuracy of RSRP of a non-overlapping carrier include the use of different carrier frequency from the serving cell and the fulfillment of certain conditions such as the transmission of cell specific reference signals, the fulfillment of 3GPP TS 36.101 clause 7.3 for reference sensitivity, and a specific range of RSRP.

q_27896.question: What is the purpose of the transmitter test for the single-band or multi-band connector under test?
q_27896.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify the ability of the transmitter units associated with the single-band connectors or multi-band connectors to restrict the generation of intermodulation products in its nonlinear elements caused by the presence of the wanted signal and an interfering signal reaching the transmitter via the antenna to below specified levels.

q_27897.question: When are there restrictions on the scheduling availability for intra-frequency measurements in TDD bands?
q_27897.ground_truth: There are restrictions on the scheduling availability for intra-frequency measurements in TDD bands when the UE performs SS-RSRP or SS-SINR measurement or SS-RSRQ measurement.

q_27898.question: What is the action taken when the MTLF0 with FL Client lacks data over the requested Area of Interest?
q_27898.ground_truth: When the MTLF0 with FL Client lacks data over the requested Area of Interest, it determines that training based on Horizontal Federated Learning is needed.

q_27899.question: What is the meaning of the tree structure identified under the vendor identified in the ext node?
q_27899.ground_truth: The tree structure identified under the vendor identified in the ext node is not defined and can include one or more unstandardized sub-trees.

q_27900.question: What should the controlling MCPTT function do upon receipt of a SIP re-INVITE request for an MCPTT session identity identifying an ongoing MCPTT group call, if a Resource-Priority header field is included and set to the value indicated for emergency calls, but the SIP re-INVITE request does not contain an emergency indication?
q_27900.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function shall reject the SIP re-INVITE request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response, as specified in clause 6.3.3.1.13.

q_27901.question: What should the SMF do if there are no PDU sessions to transmit the multicast MBS session data in the UPF and unicast transport is used over N19mb?
q_27901.ground_truth: The SMF should release the DL N19mb tunnel endpoint and inform the SMF.

q_27902.question: What should be the value of the maximum inactivity period in the DIRECT LINK KEEPALIVE REQUEST message, in relation to the keep-alive timer T5003?
q_27902.ground_truth: The maximum inactivity period value should be slightly higher than the value of keep-alive timer T5003.

q_27903.question: How should the power of PUSCH transmissions be measured in the test procedure?
q_27903.ground_truth: The power of PUSCH transmissions should be measured as the sum power at each antenna connector in the test procedure.

q_27904.question: What does the UE transmit on the uplink reference measurement channel when it has no payload data to send?
q_27904.ground_truth: When the UE has no payload data to send, it transmits uplink MAC padding bits on the uplink reference measurement channel.

q_27905.question: What is the role of the group-level N4 Session in enabling broadcast traffic forwarding of a 5G VN group in a UPF?
q_27905.ground_truth: The group-level N4 Session provides the PDR that detects the broadcast packet sent via the "internal interface" and instructs the UPF on how to perform processing (using associated FAR, URR, QER) on the copy instead of the original packet. It also matches the broadcast packet against all PDRs installed at the "internal interface".

q_27906.question: What should the P-CSCF do if it receives a request on a dialog for which it initiated session release?
q_27906.ground_truth: The P-CSCF shall terminate this received request and answer it with a 481 (Call/Transaction Does Not Exist) response.

q_27907.question: What action should the MAC entity take if it receives a UL grant indicating a SUL switch while a Random Access procedure is ongoing?

q_27908.question: What is the purpose of the MC service server sending an MBS session leave request to the MC service client and what are the conditions for this request?
q_27908.ground_truth: The MC service server sends an MBS session leave request to the MC service client when it decides that one or several MC service clients should leave a certain multicast MBS session. This can be triggered for example once no further MC media is needed to be delivered to the targeted MC service group, the multicast MBS session is no longer associated to the MC group, or a certain MC service client is no longer authorized to receive data to the associated MC service group. The MC service client then initiates an MBS session leave procedure to release the respective network resources.

q_27909.question: What is the EAS Service KPI used for in TS 23.222?
q_27909.ground_truth: The EAS Service KPI is used as a new IE in Service APIs provided by EAS as API Provider, to convey information about service characteristics provided by the Service API. It can be mapped to EAS Service KPIs in EAS Profile of the EAS providing the Service API.

q_27910.question: What is the main function of FL server NWDAF and FL client NWDAF in Federated Learning among multiple NWDAFs containing MTLF?
q_27910.ground_truth: FL server NWDAF discovers and selects FL client NWDAFs to participant in an FL procedure, requests FL client NWDAFs to do local model training and to report local model information. FL client NWDAF locally trains ML model that tasked by the FL server NWDAF with the available local data set, reports the trained local ML model information to the FL server NWDAF, and receives the global ML model feedback from FL server NWDAF and repeats training iteration if needed.

q_27911.question: What is the role of the PEMC in the PIN Management PINE join into PIN request process?
q_27911.ground_truth: The PEMC determines whether to forward the request to the PEMC or PIN server for authorization and responds accordingly.

q_27912.question: What is the purpose of the "Repetition-Period NG-RAN" parameter in the Warning Message Content NG-RAN?
q_27912.ground_truth: The Repetition-Period NG-RAN parameter in the Warning Message Content NG-RAN indicates the periodicity in seconds of the warning message to be broadcast, with a value between 0 and 217-1.

q_27913.question: In what scenario does the network provide a Local Emergency Numbers List to the UE?
q_27913.ground_truth: The network provides a Local Emergency Numbers List to the UE in the ATTACH ACCEPT or TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT messages.

q_27914.question: What is the function of the integruty risk probability in GNSS positioning?
q_27914.ground_truth: The integrity risk probability represents the probability that the residual errors after the positioning corrections have been applied exceed the Bound. It is decomposed into a constant Residual Risk component and a variable IRallocation component that depends on the desired Bound.

q_27915.question: How does Solution #33 propose to remove the slice from the allowed list when inactivity is detected?
q_27915.ground_truth: Solution #33 proposes that both UE and AMF can remove the slice from the allowed list when inactivity is detected in case of no PDU session. However, for PDU session with no data transfer, only releasing the PDU session is not sufficient. The UE can remove the slice from the allowed list, but SMF needs to indicate AMF so that AMF will remove the slice as well.

q_27916.question: What type of message is used to request the de-registration of PIN services by a PIN entity?
q_27916.ground_truth: The PIN services de-registration request is sent by a PIN Element to the PEMC to request the de-registration of PIN services.

q_27917.question: How can the network indicate its preferred READY timer value to the MS?
q_27917.ground_truth: The network can include a timer value for the READY timer in the ATTACH ACCEPT or ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT messages, respectively.

q_27918.question: What is the maximum interval between two successive indications from Layer 1?
q_27918.ground_truth: Two successive indications from Layer 1 shall be separated by at least max(10ms, rmax*G) in the out-of-sync and in-sync evaluations of the PCell.

q_27919.question: What is the requirement for a UE that is performing HA discovery based on DHCPv6?
q_27919.ground_truth: A UE performing HA discovery based on DHCPv6 shall support the implementation of stateless DHCPv6 and the DHCPv6 options as specified in draft-ietf-mip6-hiopt.

q_27920.question: What is the data type used to represent the training data samples?
q_27920.ground_truth: Training data samples are not quantized, i.e., Float32 is used/represented.

q_27921.question: What are the two possible values of the RequestStatus attribute in the MLInferenceEmulationRequest, and what do they indicate?
q_27921.ground_truth: The two possible values of the RequestStatus attribute in the MLInferenceEmulationRequest are "Pending" and "Triggered". "Pending" indicates that no action has been taken for the request, while "Triggered" indicates that an MLInferenceEmulationProcess has been instantiated.

q_27922.question: Which type of data is the "SS-Notification" in the NotifySS-Arg sequence?
q_27922.ground_truth: The "SS-Notification" in the NotifySS-Arg sequence is an octet string used to indicate various notifications related to a supplementary service.

q_27923.question: What is the purpose of the UE being scheduled on PCell continuously throughout the test?
q_27923.ground_truth: The purpose of the UE being scheduled on PCell continuously throughout the test is to ensure that the UE sends one Event A6 triggered measurement report, with a measurement reporting delay less than 25602 ms from the beginning of time period T2, and to ensure that at least 99.5% of all expected ACK/NACKs are transmitted by the UE from the start of T1 until the measurement report is received during T2.

q_27924.question: What should the network do when a packet filter consists of conflicting packet filter components which would render the packet filter ineffective?
q_27924.ground_truth: The network should reject the activation request with cause "semantic errors in packet filter(s)".

q_27925.question: What is the OTA REFSENS requirement in the context of SAN type 1-O?
q_27925.ground_truth: The OTA REFSENS requirement is a directional requirement for SAN type 1-O that is intended to ensure a minimum OTA reference sensitivity level for a declared OTA REFSENS RoAoA. This requirement ensures that the receiver is able to receive signals at the minimum power level required.

q_27926.question: What is the name of the location criteria for deactivation that is based on a minimum and maximum speed, measured in kilometers per hour?
q_27926.ground_truth: 10.2.97B3C15, where the minimum speed is a non-negative integer and the maximum speed is also a non-negative integer, measured in units of kilometers/hour.

q_27927.question: How is the security context established for an on-network remotely initiated video push communication?
q_27927.ground_truth: The security context for an on-network remotely initiated video push communication is established by creating a PCK for the session and providing it securely in the Private communication request from MCVideo client 1 to MCVideo client 2.

q_27928.question: What is the purpose of the PDN GW in the 3GPP network?
q_27928.ground_truth: The PDN GW hosts functions such as per-user based packet filtering, lawful interception, and UE IP address allocation.

q_27929.question: What should the MCPTT client include in the <forwarding-immediate-list> element if the MCPTT client initiates the private call upon accepting a request to perform a private call forwarding and if the incoming SIP MESSAGE request contained a <forwarding-reason> with a value of "immediate"?
q_27929.ground_truth: The MCPTT client shall append an entry containing the MCPTT ID of the forwarded MCPTT user and a <anyExt> element containing necessary elements, including the <forwarding-sequence-number>, <forwarded-by-mcptt-id>, <forwarded-by-functional-alias>, <forwarding-target-orig-id>, <forwarding-target-is-functional-alias>, and <forwarding-target-id> elements.

q_27930.question: What conditions does an IARP/ISRP rule contain when utilizing access thresholds or the OPI value?
q_27930.ground_truth: RAN validity conditions, threshold conditions, the OPI condition

q_27931.question: What is the purpose of the RRC establishment cause "MO Exception Data" in the context of LTE-M?
q_27931.ground_truth: The RRC establishment cause "MO Exception Data" is used to indicate the use of the LTE-M RAT type in the Modify Bearer Request message from the Serving GW to the PDN GW.

q_27932.question: What is the purpose of the Redial information element?
q_27932.ground_truth: The Redial information element is used to indicate to the network that a call is the result of a redial attempt to switch from speech to multimedia or vice-versa.

q_27933.question: What HTTP method is used by the Content Provider to retrieve all the notifications from the BM-SC?
q_27933.ground_truth: The Content Provider uses the HTTP GET method to retrieve all the notifications from the BM-SC.

q_27934.question: What is the role of the Media Application Provider in the generalized Media Delivery architecture?
q_27934.ground_truth: The Media Application Provider plays the role of the RTC Application Provider in the generalized Media Delivery architecture.

q_27935.question: In OTDOA Intra-Frequency RSTD Measurements, when using CRS along with PRS is enabled in the OTDOA assistance data, what is the UE implementation's choice regarding the use of CRS for RSTD measurements and how should the reported UE RSTD measurements meet the requirements specified in the section?
q_27935.ground_truth: UE implementation can freely choose whether to use CRS for RSTD measurements. However, when used, the reported RSTD measurements by the UE shall meet the requirements specified in this section. If network-based CRS interference mitigation is enabled, UE capable of supporting this feature must perform RSTD measurements that meet all requirements, provided the CRS are available within at least the PRS bandwidth in the subframes with PRS.

q_27936.question: What command is used to request the UE to transmit a Recommended bit rate query to the serving eNB or gNB for a specific EPS bearer context or 5G QoS flow?
q_27936.ground_truth: The 10.1.68 +CGBRRREQ command is used to request the UE to transmit a Recommended bit rate query to the serving eNB or gNB for a specific EPS bearer context or 5G QoS flow.

q_27937.question: How is a discovered UAV set up for PC5 direct communication with the AAM?
q_27937.ground_truth: The AAM uses ProSe Direct Discovery over PC5 reference point with method B, providing the detected Remote-ID as Application-Layer-ID. Once the UAV is discovered, the AAM uses the "UE-oriented link establishment procedure" to connect to the discovered Layer-2-ID (i.e. to the UAV with the detected Remote-ID).

q_27938.question: What should the controlling MCData function do to establish an MSRP session with the originating MCData client?
q_27938.ground_truth: The controlling MCData function should act as an MSRP client to send MSRP SEND requests, establish a TLS connection with the originating participating MCData function or the originating MCData client, and act as a "passive" endpoint to bind the MSRP connection to the MSRP session as specified in IETF RFC 4975.

q_27939.question: In Event Y1, what are the units of Mp and Mr?
q_27939.ground_truth: In Event Y1, Mp is expressed in dBm (in case of RSRP) or dB (in case of RSRQ and SINR), and Mr is expressed in dBm or dB, depending on the measurement quantity of the candidate L2 U2N Relay UE.

q_27940.question: What happens in step 3b.1 of the Connection Resume procedure?
q_27940.ground_truth: In step 3b.1 of the Connection Resume procedure, the NG-RAN sends an N2 message to the AMF indicating that the UE is in CM-CONNECTED.

q_27941.question: What is the format of an information element with an IE Type Extension field?
q_27941.ground_truth: The IE Type in octet 1 of an information element with an IE Type Extension field is set to 254, and the value encoded in the IE Type Extension field in octets 5 and 6 indicates the type of the Information Element.

q_27942.question: What should the UE do when the network does not provide the support of 3GPP PS data off during the default bearer context activation procedure of the PDN connection?
q_27942.ground_truth: If the network does not provide indication of support of 3GPP PS data off, the UE behavior is implementation dependent.

q_27943.question: What new CSI computation delay requirements need to be defined if relaxed UE processing time in terms of Z and Z' is introduced in the relaxed UE processing timeline?
q_27943.ground_truth: New CSI computation delay requirements need to be defined, including new values of Z and Z', as well as how the CSI computation time is determined by Z and Z'.

q_27944.question: What should the floor control interface do when it receives a Floor Release message from the associated floor participant in the 'U: permitted' state, and the first bit in the subtype of the Floor Release message is set to '1' (Acknowledgment is required)?
q_27944.ground_truth: The floor control interface should send a Floor Ack message, which includes the Message Type field set to '4' (Floor Release), the Source field set to '2' (the controlling MCPTT function is the source), and the Track Info field if it was included in the Floor Release message.

q_27945.question: What is the primary goal of the Transmission Power Control (TPC) function in NR/5GC?
q_27945.ground_truth: The primary goal of the Transmission Power Control (TPC) function in NR/5GC is to manage the maximum power reduction (MPR), power management maximum power reduction (P-MPR), and total radiated power (TRP) for the transmission and receiving (Tx/Rx) devices.

q_27946.question: What should the floor participant interface do when it receives a Floor Release Multi Talker message from the floor control server interface?
q_27946.ground_truth: The floor participant interface should send the Floor Release Multi Talker message to the floor participant and remain in the 'P: has no permission' state.

q_27947.question: When does a UE with non-zero Treselection value perform reselection?
q_27947.ground_truth: A UE with non-zero Treselection value performs reselection only on evaluations that occur simultaneously to, or later than, the expiry of the Treselection timer.

q_27948.question: In which cases should the requirement for non-contiguous spectrum be applied to sub-block gap for interfering signal offsets where the interfering signal falls completely within the sub-block gap?
q_27948.ground_truth: The requirement is applicable inside a sub-block gap for interfering signal offsets where the interfering signal falls completely within the sub-block gap.

q_27949.question: What should the UE do during T3 in this test scenario?
q_27949.ground_truth: During T3, the UE is expected to detect out-of-sync and declare RLM (Radio Link Failure).

q_27950.question: What is the selection criteria for the Source Layer-2 ID in 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay Communication with integrated Discovery?
q_27950.ground_truth: The Source Layer-2 ID in 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay Communication with integrated Discovery is self-selected by the source 5G ProSe End UE or the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay, depending on the message being sent.

q_27951.question: What is the purpose of the solution described in 6.22.3, if it does not address how to use ciphering and/or integrity keys to protect broadcast messages?
q_27951.ground_truth: The purpose of the solution described in 6.22.3 is to reuse the broadcast key provision mechanism defined in TS 23.273 for provisioning broadcast protection keys to the Target/Reference UEs, when the UEs broadcast/receive Sidelink Positioning data in coverage scenario.

q_27952.question: What is the impact of the test tolerance on the minimum requirement in the test?
q_27952.ground_truth: If the test requirement differs from the minimum requirement, a non-zero test tolerance is applied, which means the minimum requirement has been relaxed, and the explanation of the relaxation is given in annex C.

q_27953.question: What security requirement does this solution address for Ranging/SL positioning services?
q_27953.ground_truth: This solution addresses the second security requirement in Key Issue #1, which is privacy protection during communication for Ranging/SL positioning.

q_27954.question: What the absolute time in CDMA2000 SystemTimeInfoCDMA2000 informs the UE about?
q_27954.ground_truth: SystemTimeInfoCDMA2000 informs the UE about the absolute time in the current cell in CDMA2000 system time. This allows the UE to derive the CDMA2000 Physical cell identity, expressed as PNOffset. The UE needs the CDMA2000 system time with a certain level of accuracy for performing measurements as well as for communicating with the CDMA2000 network (HRPD or 1xRTT).

q_27955.question: What should be the minimum reporting criteria for RSRP and RSRQ measurements in order to be reported to higher layers?
q_27955.ground_truth: The requirements for reporting RSRP and RSRQ measurements to higher layers are specified in 3GPP TS 36.133 clauses 9.1.3.1, 9.1.3.2, 9.1.6.1, and 9.1.6.2.

q_27956.question: In the 3GPP 5G NR standard, what abbreviation is used to refer to the user equipment?

q_27957.question: What test case scenarios does Combination 2 apply to?
q_27957.ground_truth: Combination 2 applies to the following test case scenarios: E-UTRA FDD intra-frequency multi cell scenario with neighbouring cell related information, E-UTRA TDD intra-frequency multi cell scenario with neighbouring cell related information.

q_27958.question: What action should the MS take if it receives a DEACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message without tear down indicator information element for a default PDP context?
q_27958.ground_truth: The MS shall deactivate the default PDP context as specified in subclause~6.1.3.4.2. Additionally the MS shall deactivate all other active PDP contexts sharing the same PDP address and APN as the default PDP context locally without peer-to-peer signalling.

q_27959.question: What is the function of the RRC Release message when the NG-RAN initiates RRC release with suspend indication towards the UE?
q_27959.ground_truth: The RRC Release message releases the UE to RRC-Inactive with CM-Idle.

q_27960.question: What does the Capacity Value IE indicate in the E-UTRAN resources?
q_27960.ground_truth: The Capacity Value IE indicates the amount of resources that are available relative to the total E-UTRAN resources.

q_27961.question: What is the procedure described in section 6.21.2.1 used for?
q_27961.ground_truth: The procedure described in section 6.21.2.1 is applied to some data channel use cases in which it's a video session and only unidirectional interaction is needed between both UEs.

q_27962.question: What is the purpose of on-demand multicast MBS session?
q_27962.ground_truth: It provides operators with flexibility to provide services with resource efficiency, dynamically creating multicast session when required by the service, and releasing them when not required.

q_27963.question: What does H.265 NAL unit header Type field indicate in the RTP payload carrying H.265 video slices?
q_27963.ground_truth: The 6-bit Type field in the H.265 NAL unit header can indicate the content of VCL NAL unit and can be used to identify the importance information of NAL unit carrying the PDU Set/slice.

q_27964.question: How does the C-CRC method protect against man-in-the-middle (MitM) attacks?
q_27964.ground_truth: The C-CRC method protects against MitM attacks by ensuring that the UE and gNB generate the same cryptographic message authentication code (CMAC) using a common secret key (K) and the unique identifier of the physical time and frequency resources used to transmit the data at the MAC layer. Any attempt to modify or intercept messages would result in a different CMAC, revealing the attacker's presence.

q_27965.question: What is the minimum percentage of correct coverage enhancement level 0 selection events required for the tests <6.2.18.4> and <6.2.19.4> to pass?
q_27965.ground_truth: The minimum percentage of correct coverage enhancement level 0 selection events required for the tests <6.2.18.4> and <6.2.19.4> to pass is at least 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

q_27966.question: What is the requirement for the RRC re-establishment delay for a known E-UTRA FDD intra frequency cell?
q_27966.ground_truth: The RRC re-establishment delay to a known E-UTRA FDD intra frequency cell shall be less than 7 seconds.

q_27967.question: What is one of the responsibilities of the SMF in terms of non-3GPP delay budget?
q_27967.ground_truth: The SMF includes the non-3GPP delay budget provided by the PCF in the N1 SM container when completing the PDU Session modification.

q_27968.question: What should the MCVideo client do when it receives a PRIVATE CALL RELEASE ACK message in the "P3: waiting for release response" state?
q_27968.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should stop timer TFP3, terminate the media session, start timer TFP7, and enter the "P1: ignoring same call id" state.

q_27969.question: What are the conditions under which IMSI based SUPI is not supported for SNPN?
q_27969.ground_truth: IMSI based SUPI is not supported for SNPN when the MCC and MNC of the SNPN is not unique or if the SNPN and CH (where CH can be another SNPN or PLMN) share PLMN ID.

q_27970.question: In the 3GPP TS 24.483 specification, what does the <entry> element of the <ImplicitAffiliations> list element indicate?
q_27970.ground_truth: An MCPTT group ID of an MCPTT group that the MCPTT user is implicitly affiliated with

q_27971.question: What signalling protection algorithm is used to protect NAS and RRC signalling, but is only allowed for unauthenticated emergency calls?

q_27972.question: What is the action taken when the triggerType is set to 'event' and the leaving condition is satisfied for all measurements?
q_27972.ground_truth: When the triggerType is set to 'event' and the leaving condition is satisfied for all measurements, the concerned cells are removed from the cellsTriggeredList and, if reportOnLeave is set to TRUE, the measurement reporting procedure is initiated again.

q_27973.question: What is the purpose of the F1 UE context setup procedure?
q_27973.ground_truth: The F1 UE context setup procedure is performed to setup one or more bearers in the gNB-DU.

q_27974.question: What is the default AMF charging profile provided by in the 3GPP 5G charging system?
q_27974.ground_truth: The default AMF charging profile is provided by the Charging Characteristics which is described in Annex A.

q_27975.question: What is the criticality of the QoEInformationTransfer procedure?
q_27975.ground_truth: The criticality of the QoEInformationTransfer procedure is ignore.

q_27976.question: What is the role of the operator policy in determining accepted DRX parameters in the 5G System?
q_27976.ground_truth: The operator policy may change the UE requested values of the accepted DRX parameters, subject to the AMF determining the accepted DRX parameters based on the received UE specific DRX parameters.

q_27977.question: What is the range used for RSRP and RSRQ in the context of Ter?
q_27977.ground_truth: The range used for RSRP is 0 - 127, and for RSRQ is also 0 - 127.

q_27978.question: What should the terminating MCData participating function do when it receives an MSRP SEND message that qualifies for MBMS delivery but is not destined for an MCData client listening to the MBMS subchannel?
q_27978.ground_truth: It should handle the message as a unicast MSRP SEND message, as specified in clause 6.2.1.5.3.

q_27979.question: Which keyword is used in the OpenAPI specification to define a nullable data type in the `exAnyTypeNullableElement` attribute?
q_27979.ground_truth: The `nullable` keyword is used to define a nullable data type in the `exAnyTypeNullableElement` attribute.

q_27980.question: What should the SCC AS do when it receives a request from the SC UE for CONF service to replace an existing session within the same dialog?
q_27980.ground_truth: The SCC AS shall deliver the request for CONF service on the Gm controlled any of access legs or over the I1 interface if I1 interface control is used or to the CS leg if only a CS leg exists, to the SC UE.

q_27981.question: How is the representative value of coverage margin for a channel derived in Rel-17 RedCap SI?
q_27981.ground_truth: The representative value of coverage margin for a channel is derived by taking the mean value (in the dB domain) from the coverage margins from all sourcing companies, excluding the highest and lowest values when the number of samples is more than 3. If the number of samples is less than 4 for a channel in a scenario, no representative value is provided.

q_27982.question: What should the UE do when it receives a 503 (Service Unavailable) response for a request and the Retry-After header field indicates a time bigger than the specified value for timer F or timer B?
q_27982.ground_truth: If the UE is not using the multiple registration mechanism, it should consider the contact address as not bound to any public user identity, mark the currently used P-CSCF address as unavailable for the time indicated by the Retry-After header field, initiate an initial registration using a different unavailable P-CSCF, or get a new set of P-CSCF addresses and initiate an initial registration. If the UE is using the multiple registration mechanism, it should declare the registration flow dead and mark the currently used P-CSCF address as unavailable for the time indicated by the Retry-After header field.

q_27983.question: When can the UE apply the received SIBs?
q_27983.ground_truth: The UE may apply the received SIBs immediately, i.e. the UE does not need to delay using a SIB until all SI messages have been received.

q_27984.question: What is the MCVideo user action that triggers the emergency alert origination procedure as specified in clause 12.1.1.1?
q_27984.ground_truth: The MCVideo user is not in emergency state, and the MCVideo client has received indication that MCVideo client has entered a pre-defined emergency alert area.

q_27985.question: What should be the value of the MCData emergency group state in the SIP INVITE request if the MCData emergency group state of the group is set to a value other than "MDEG 2: in-progress"?
q_27985.ground_truth: The MCData emergency group state should be set to "MDEG 4: confirm-pending".

q_27986.question: What is a DAPS bearer in 3GPP NR?
q_27986.ground_truth: A DAPS bearer is a bearer whose radio protocols are located in both the source gNB and the target gNB during DAPS handover to use both source gNB and target gNB resources.

q_27987.question: What is the function of the NTN payload in the connection between the NTN Gateway and the NTN payload?
q_27987.ground_truth: The NTN payload transparently forwards the radio protocol received from the UE to the NTN Gateway and vice-versa.

q_27988.question: What must a controlling MCPTT function do upon receipt of a SIP MESSAGE request for emergency notification, if the request is an authorized request for an MCPTT emergency alert and the sending MCPTT user is not affiliated with the MCPTT group?
q_27988.ground_truth: It must check if the MCPTT user is eligible to be implicitly affiliated with the MCPTT group and if the user is eligible, it must perform the implicit affiliation.

q_27989.question: What is the purpose of the "Request extended LADN information +CRELADN" command in the 5G Network?
q_27989.ground_truth: The "Request extended LADN information +CRELADN" command in the 5G Network enables the TE to request extended LADN information from the MT for the specified LADN DNN(s) and S-NSSAI(s) associated with the LADN.

q_27990.question: What should the rrc-MessageSegmentType be set to if the current segment is the last segment of the UL DCCH message?
q_27990.ground_truth: The rrc-MessageSegmentType should be set to lastSegment if the current segment is the last segment of the UL DCCH message.

q_27991.question: What is a JSON PATCH in an OpenAPI specification?
q_27991.ground_truth: A JSON PATCH in an OpenAPI specification is a mutually exclusive list of all allowed modifications as <path, op, value> tuples, where "path" is a string containing a JSON Pointer value referring to a JSON object that is allowed to be modified, "op" is an enumeration of allowed JSON PATCH operations on the JSON object identified by "path," and "value" represents the schema/type of the value that will be updated or added at the JSON object identified by "path."

q_27992.question: What should be the detection mode of the measurement device used for testing the spurious frequencies of a SAN transponder?
q_27992.ground_truth: The detection mode of the measurement device should be True RMS.

q_27993.question: What functionality is related to UE-to-UE Relay communication setup in the UE?
q_27993.ground_truth: New functionality related to UE-to-UE Relay communication setup.

q_27994.question: What should the participating MCVideo function include in the application/sdp MIME body of an initial MBMS bearer announcement message?
q_27994.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function should include an application/sdp MIME body with an "a=FEC-declaration" session attribute set to "0" for each media line to be used as the MBMS subchannel for video in an initial MBMS bearer announcement message.

q_27995.question: What should an RNC do when it receives the MDT report from the UE in case of Logged MDT?
q_27995.ground_truth: The RNC shall capture the MDT report and put it to the trace record if the TRPLMN (PLMN portion of Trace Reference) matches with the PLMN where TCE used to collect MDT data resides. Otherwise, it shall discard the MDT report.

q_27996.question: What is the general procedure for location acquisition in the 5GC environment?
q_27996.ground_truth: The location acquisition procedure in the 5GC environment involves the LEA requesting the AMF location services and the MME/AMF overriding any user consent, privacy, and paging restrictions concerned with location acquisition that may apply to the target UE. The location acquisition procedure is used for network-provided location access to the target UE.

q_27997.question: What are the reference points specified in the 5G system architecture enhancements to support V2X services?
q_27997.ground_truth: The PC5 reference point supports V2X communications over the LTE and/or NR, while the Uu reference point supports V2X communications over E-UTRA connected to 5GC and/or NR connected to 5GC.

q_27998.question: What action should the transmission control server take when it has received RTP media packets from another transmission participant on uplink but cannot send the RTP media packet on downstream?
q_27998.ground_truth: The transmission control server should send the Media Reception Override Notify message to the transmission participant and remain in the 'U: permitted to receive' state.

q_27999.question: What parameter managed by OMC/EM identifies the type of trace for GSM only tracing request?

q_28000.question: What is the purpose of providing a Simplified Entry Point in the context of 5G AR-related processing and communication?
q_28000.ground_truth: The Simplified Entry Point is generated by 5G cloud/edge processes to support offloading processing workloads from UE by lowering the complexity of the AR/MR content.

q_28001.question: What is the mandatory information needed in a CellActivationFailure message?
q_28001.ground_truth: A CellActivationFailure message must include an 'ActivationIDforCellActivation' and a 'Cause' field, both of which are critical and mandatory.

q_28002.question: What is the process of associating packets, belonging to a service data flow, to a charging key and applying online charging or offline charging, as appropriate?

q_28003.question: What type of management components (A, B, or C) are provided by the ng-eNB NRM for the management of ng-eNB in the ng-eNB management domain?

q_28004.question: What is the purpose of the test case described in 10.2.4?
q_28004.ground_truth: The purpose of the test case described in 10.2.4 is to verify the ProSe UE's ability to initiate and cease SLSS transmissions during cell selection state and if the UE meets the maximum evaluation time.

q_28005.question: What should the participating MCData function do upon receiving a SIP 200 (OK) response for the SIP INVITE request?
q_28005.ground_truth: Upon receiving a SIP 200 (OK) response for the SIP INVITE request, the participating MCData function should interact with the media plane, include the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body received in the SIP 200 (OK) response into the generated final SIP 200 (OK) response, and send it to the MCData client.

q_28006.question: In the context of the 3GPP specification, what is the purpose of the SgNB UE X2AP ID IE included in certain messages during EN-DC handover procedures?
q_28006.ground_truth: The SgNB UE X2AP ID IE is used as the old or new UE ID, depending on which network entity is sending the message, to identify the UE in the EN-DC handover procedures.

q_28007.question: What is the effect of applying "fe-identifier" in P-Charging-Vector header field within the operator domain?
q_28007.ground_truth: When an "fe-identifier" header field parameter of P-Charging-Vector is received in the operator domain, the ISC gateway function adds its own address or identifier in the P-Charging-Vector header field and removes all received "fe-identifier" header field parameter. In the response to an initial request, the ISC gateway function stores and processes P-Charging-Function-Addresses header field values, and removes the P-Charging-Function-Addresses header field before forwarding the response, with some exceptions.

q_28008.question: How does the network indicate "MM connection establishment due to SRVCC handover" or "MM connection establishment due to vSRVCC handover" to the upper layer?
q_28008.ground_truth: After completing MM connection establishment, the MM layer shall indicate "MM connection establishment due to SRVCC handover" or "MM connection establishment due to vSRVCC handover" to the upper layer.

q_28009.question: What should the EAP message IE of the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message be set to in order to bring the partial native 5G NAS security context into use?
q_28009.ground_truth: The EAP message IE of the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message should be set to an EAP-success message in order to bring the partial native 5G NAS security context into use.

q_28010.question: What type of information is included in the PIN discovery request from the PIN client to the PIN server?
q_28010.ground_truth: The PIN discovery request includes the security credentials of the UE or PIN client and may include the UE identifier such as GPSI, PIN client ID, UE location, the service that PINE wants to consume, and PIN client profile(s) information.

q_28011.question: What happens if the result of the EAB check specifies that access to the cell is barred?
q_28011.ground_truth: The UE shall inform upper layers about the failure to establish the RRC connection and that EAB is applicable, upon which the procedure ends.

q_28012.question: In the context of 12.1.2.1, if the UE receives PDCP SDUs from multiple logical channels multiplexed on transport block 1 and transport block 2 within the same TTI, what should the UE do?
q_28012.ground_truth: The UE should forward the received PDCP SDUs from the logical channels to upper layers.

q_28013.question: What does the H-PCF determine based on various inputs in step 7 before provisioning/updating ANDSP or URSP?
q_28013.ground_truth: The H-PCF determines based on various inputs, such as NF service consumer inputs, received list of UPSIs, UE parameters, and local policies, whether and which ANDSP and/or URSP to provision/update in step 7.

q_28014.question: What is the required format for images in MTSI clients supporting still images?
q_28014.ground_truth: MTSI clients supporting still images shall support HEVC encoded images that conform to the HEVC bitstream requirements specified in 5.2.2 of the document.

q_28015.question: What happens to the ongoing RLC transmissions with the UE during a handover when data forwarding is performed from the source eNB to the target eNB?
q_28015.ground_truth: The source eNB does not need to abort ongoing RLC transmissions with the UE as it starts data forwarding to the target eNB.

q_28016.question: What is the procedure for establishing security during the PC5 link setup between the target UE and U2U relay?
q_28016.ground_truth: During the PC5 link setup procedure between the target UE and U2U relay, the U2U relay is aware of the security protection scheme to be used between the source UE and U2U relay. The U2U relay proceeds to set up the PC5 link with the target UE with the same protection scheme as the one between the source UE and U2U relay. If hop-by-hop security protection is already established between the source UE and U2U relay, the PC5 link setup includes security establishment between the target UE and U2U relay.

q_28017.question: What should the IWF floor control server do when timer T20 (Floor Granted) expires and counter C20 (Floor Granted) reaches its upper limit?
q_28017.ground_truth: The IWF floor control server should remain in the 'G: Floor Taken' state.

q_28018.question: Which transport network can the QoS monitoring be applied to?
q_28018.ground_truth: The QoS monitoring can be applied to packet switched traffic in the 5GS.

q_28019.question: What should the controlling MCData function do if the authorized MCData user is not authorized during the validation process when releasing the communication?
q_28019.ground_truth: If the MCData user is not authorized, the controlling MCData function should generate a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response and send it towards the originating participating function and the MCData client.

q_28020.question: What is the procedure for PIN communication via 5GS in the case of internet services?
q_28020.ground_truth: The PINE establishes a direct connection with the PEGC using a password or username and sends a relay request to the PEMC or PIN server to relay the traffic to other PINE via the PEGC using 5GS. If the request is related to internet services, the DN-specific ID would be included.

q_28021.question: What is the offset used to determine the time location of a PEI occasion for a UE's PO?
q_28021.ground_truth: The offset is a symbol-level offset from the reference point to the start of the first PDCCH MO of this PEI occasion.

q_28022.question: In what scenarios can the SEALDD service be used?
q_28022.ground_truth: The SEALDD service can be used for both signalling and data traffic transfer (scenario a), or only for data traffic transfer (scenario b).

q_28023.question: When can the MME remove the IMSI Offset value?
q_28023.ground_truth: The MME does not remove the IMSI Offset value if the Tracking Area Update Request is for periodic Tracking Area Update.

q_28024.question: When should the initiating UE initiate the PC5 unicast link release procedure?
q_28024.ground_truth: The initiating UE may initiate the PC5 unicast link release procedure upon expiry of timer T5005, to release an established PC5 unicast link if the UE has reached the maximum number of established PC5 unicast links and there is a need to establish a new PC5 unicast link.

q_28025.question: What is the test signal level used to measure the receiving sensitivity for hands-free terminals?
q_28025.ground_truth: The test signal level used for measuring the receiving sensitivity for hands-free terminals is -16 dBm0 measured at the digital reference point or the equivalent analogue point.

q_28026.question: What is one of the conditions for the SCC AS to indicate the CS to PS SRVCC capability for a UE in the SIP response for PS to CS SRVCC?
q_28026.ground_truth: One of the conditions for the SCC AS to indicate the CS to PS SRVCC capability for a UE in the SIP response for PS to CS SRVCC is that there is a private user identity of a UE associated with the C-MSISDN in the P-Asserted-Identity header field of the SIP INVITE request due to STN-SR and there is a binding of a contact address for the private user identity of the UE with the g.3gpp.cs2ps-srvcc media feature tag and the g.3gpp.atcf feature-capability indicator in the Feature-Caps header field of the SIP REGISTER request.

q_28027.question: What is the purpose of the test specified in section 6.2.16.1?
q_28027.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify the behavior of the random access procedure of a category NB1 UE (User Equipment) in Normal Coverage.

q_28028.question: What action should the network take if a UE is not allowed to operate as an IAB-node?
q_28028.ground_truth: The network should set the 5GMM cause value to #36 "IAB-node operation not authorized" in the DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message.

q_28029.question: What action is taken when the UE fails to complete the UL transmission before T2 expires?
q_28029.ground_truth: If the UE fails to complete the UL transmission before T2 expires, the number of failed tests is increased by one and the test is restarted from step 1.

q_28030.question: What functionality does the 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay provide to support indirect connectivity to the 5GS for 5G ProSe Layer-3 Remote UEs?
q_28030.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay provides the functionality to support indirect connectivity to the 5GS for 5G Prose Layer-3 Remote UEs, which can be located within or outside of NG-RAN coverage.
