q_28031.question: What action should the UE take when it receives an EAP-response message associated with a specific S-NSSAI during the network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure?
q_28031.ground_truth: The UE should create a NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message, set the EAP message IE and S-NSSAI IE in the message, and send it to the network.

q_28032.question: Which field holds the unique units and information connected to the reported units, in the context of CHF-CDR?
q_28032.ground_truth: In the CHF-CDR, the "Used Unit Container" field, which is part of the "List of Multiple Unit Usage", holds the used units and information connected to the reported units.

q_28033.question: When does an NGAP UE-TNLA-binding get created for a UE by the 5G-AN node?
q_28033.ground_truth: An NGAP UE-TNLA-binding gets created for a UE by the 5G-AN node during registration, service request, and handovers. Specifically, when a UE connects to the 5GC via a 5G-AN node without providing any UE identities or if the 5G-AN node cannot associate the provided UE identities with any of its connected AMFs, the 5G-AN node selects an AMF and creates an NGAP UE-TNLA-binding for the UE.

q_28034.question: How does the network determine if the UE needs to transition to the RRC_CONNECTED state to retrieve clock quality information?
q_28034.ground_truth: The UE in the RRC_INACTIVE or RRC_IDLE state compares the reference report ID in SIB information with its locally stored reference report ID to determine whether it has the latest available clock quality information already or it needs to transit to the RRC_CONNECTED state to retrieve it.

q_28035.question: What is the effect of transmitting at PUMAX level for UL power control?
q_28035.ground_truth: Sending continuously uplink power control "up" commands will make the UE transmit at its PUMAX level.

q_28036.question: What does MMBox management involve in MMS charging?
q_28036.ground_truth: MMBox management is a logical entity of the MMS R/S that supports persistent network-based storage of MMs. It enables MMS User Agents to store, retrieve and delete incoming and submitted MMs. In MMS charging, MMBox management involves transactions similar to those of the MM1 interface, such as submission, reception, delivery-report, read-reply report, etc.

q_28037.question: What are the conditions for the minimum conformance requirements regarding the relative accuracy of RSRQ stated in 9.2.4.2.3?
q_28037.ground_truth: The relative accuracy of RSRQ in inter frequency case is defined as the RSRQ measured from one cell compared to the RSRQ measured from another cell on a different frequency. The conditions include the use of specific antenna ports and reference sensitivity as defined in 3GPP TS 36.101. The RSRP requirements and the corresponding RSRQ mapping of measured quantity are also specified.

q_28038.question: What is the intended use of the 3GPP SSO Service?
q_28038.ground_truth: The 3GPP SSO Service is intended to provide secure, seamless, and transparent access to data applications for users, and interwork with Identity Management (IdM) specifications.

q_28039.question: What action should the EES take if the UE location is not available to discover EAS?
q_28039.ground_truth: The EES fails to discover the EAS and the notification will not be sent.

q_28040.question: What is the purpose of MPEG-I Carriage of Point Cloud Compression Data?
q_28040.ground_truth: The purpose of MPEG-I Carriage of Point Cloud Compression Data is to provide a standard format for encapsulating and storing coded volumetric media. It defines how to structure and carry the various components in a V3C bitstream or G-PCC bitstream in an ISOBMFF media container. It also defines new DASH descriptors that signal metadata about the type of component carried by each adaptation set and using pre-selections to group the adaptation sets of the different components associated with the volumetric media content.

q_28041.question: What is the requirement for the number of identified-intra-frequency cells that the UE physical layer should be capable of reporting measurements with?
q_28041.ground_truth: The UE physical layer should be capable of reporting measurements for 6 identified-intra-frequency cells.

q_28042.question: What is the function of the "NRPPa Signalling Transport function" (5.18)?
q_28042.ground_truth: The "NRPPa Signalling Transport function" provides means to transport an NRPPa message transparently over the NG interface.

q_28043.question: What HTTP method is used to partially modify a pending device triggering delivery by the SCS/AS in the DeviceTriggering API?
q_28043.ground_truth: If the "PatchUpdate" feature is supported, the SCS/AS can partially modify a pending device triggering delivery by using the HTTP PATCH method on the concerned Individual Device Triggering Transaction resource in the DeviceTriggering API.

q_28044.question: What should the CP function do when it receives a PFCP Session Establishment Request message?
q_28044.ground_truth: The CP function sends the PFCP Session Establishment Response message with a rejection cause if the session established request is not accepted.

q_28045.question: What is the scheme used for carrier specific scaling factor calculation in EN-DC when measGapSharingScheme is applied?
q_28045.ground_truth: The RRC parameter MeasGapSharingScheme is applied to the calculation of carrier specific scaling factor as specified in clause 9.1.5.2.1 of TS 38.133.

q_28046.question: How is the 5G NAS security context established?
q_28046.ground_truth: The 5G NAS security context is established as a result of a primary authentication and key agreement procedure between the AMF and the UE, during an N1 mode to N1 mode handover, or during the inter-system change procedure from S1 mode to N1 mode.

q_28047.question: What is the main security concern in the 3GPP system for the UE-to-UE relay scenario?
q_28047.ground_truth: The main security concern is establishing a secure connection between the source UE and the target UE, and authorizing UEs for UE-to-UE relay operation.

q_28048.question: What is the purpose of the AI/ML assistance information provided by the AF in the 5G system?
q_28048.ground_truth: The AI/ML assistance information provided by the AF is used by the AI/ML server to make AI/ML decisions for split inference in the 5G system.

q_28049.question: In NR inter-frequency measurements for SAN, what is required for a UE to identify new inter-frequency cells and perform SS-RSRP, SS-RSRQ, and SS-SINR measurements if no explicit neighbor list is provided?
q_28049.ground_truth: The UE requires carrier frequency information from the PCell and the valid parameters of ephemeris information, epoch time of the ephemeris, common TA, validity timer information, and downlink polarization information for the target NR SAN cell.

q_28050.question: What is the purpose of the "IP Multicast Deny" action value in a FAR?
q_28050.ground_truth: The "IP Multicast Deny" action value in a FAR indicates that the UPF should not accept the corresponding IGMP and MLD Membership Report message to join a multicast group.

q_28051.question: What R1 49-4 option is available for indicating the desired UL PSD range?
q_28051.ground_truth: The enumerated value "supported" in desired-ul-tx-PowerAdjustment-r17 indicates the desired UL PSD range.

q_28052.question: When can the UE send event reports in the 5GC-MT-LR procedure?
q_28052.ground_truth: The UE can only send event reports when it is inside of the event report allowed area. However, if the UE is outside the event report allowed area, it can still generate and send event reports if the reporting indication allows it, to reduce UE power consumption.

q_28053.question: What should the MME do when it receives a Purge UE response from the HSS with a successful result code?
q_28053.ground_truth: The MME shall check the PUA flag "freeze M-TMSI", and if set, freeze the M-TMSI i.e. block it for immediate re-use.

q_28054.question: What is the name of the element that may be included in the MaxAffiliationsN2 group, which can contain one or more entry elements?

q_28055.question: What is the effect of inter-frequency carrier aggregation on the scheduling restrictions for UE when performing inter-frequency measurements without measurement gaps in a TDD band?
q_28055.ground_truth: The scheduling restrictions for a given serving cell due to SS-RSRP/RSRQ/SINR measurement should also apply to all other serving cells in the same band on the symbols that fully or partially overlap with the restricted symbols.

q_28056.question: What is the OTA sensitivity requirement based on?
q_28056.ground_truth: The OTA sensitivity requirement is based on the declaration of one or more OTA sensitivity direction declarations (OSDD), related to a SAN type 1-H and SAN type 1-O receiver.

q_28057.question: What should a GTPv2 entity do when it receives a message with an unknown GTP version?
q_28057.ground_truth: If a GTPv2 entity receives a message with a GTP version that is unsupported or higher than GTPv2, it should return a Version Not Supported Indication message and silently discard the received message.

q_28058.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 5.5.5.2?
q_28058.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described in 5.5.5.2 is to verify that the UE properly detects SSB-based beam failure in the set q0 and performs correct SSB-based link recovery based on beam candidate set q1, and to test the downlink monitoring for beam failure detection within the UEs active DL BWP of the PSCell during the evaluation period, and link recovery when DRX is used.

q_28059.question: What is the handover delay requirement for the test to pass?
q_28059.ground_truth: The handover delay Dhandover shall be less than Dhandover, where Dhandover equals the maximum RRC procedure delay plus the interruption time.

q_28060.question: What are the four levels of detail defined in 3GPP trace high-level architecture?
q_28060.ground_truth: The four levels of detail defined in 3GPP trace high-level architecture are Maximum, Medium, Minimum, and MaximumWithoutVendorSpecificExtension. These levels of detail allow for retrieval of signalling interface messages in encoded format, decoded subset of IEs contained in the signalling interface messages, and radio measurement IEs.

q_28061.question: What is the role of the NSACF in the 5GS only slices solution?
q_28061.ground_truth: The NSACF is responsible for performing the PLMN global counting for the entire PLMN in the 5GS only slices solution.

q_28062.question: What parameter is used in SRS-ResourceSet to indicate a different SRS resource set association for PUSCH repetition type A or B?
q_28062.ground_truth: Higher layer parameter usage in SRS-ResourceSet

q_28063.question: What must the AMF include in the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message if the UE is a 5G-RG acting on behalf of an AUN3 device, and the AUN3 device supports 5G key hierarchy?
q_28063.ground_truth: If the UE is a 5G-RG acting on behalf of an AUN3 device, and the AUN3 device supports 5G key hierarchy, the AMF must include the AUN3 device security key IE in the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message with its value set to the KWAGF key.

q_28064.question: What is the service provided by the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals, as specified in Release 18, and what is its purpose?
q_28064.ground_truth: The service provided by the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals, as specified in Release 18, is the Spending Limit Control Service of the 5G System. This service enables the NF service consumer to retrieve policy counter status information.

q_28065.question: In what situations is the <PrivateCallKMSURI> element present in the 3GPP TS 24.483 specification?
q_28065.ground_truth: When the URI of the KMS for the associated MCPTT ID is different from the KMS URI in the <uri-entry> element.

q_28066.question: What is the role of gNB in the NG-RAN architecture?
q_28066.ground_truth: A gNB is a set of base station nodes connected to the 5GC through the NG interface and supports FDD mode, TDD mode or dual mode operation. It can have one or more gNB-DUs connected to one gNB-CU.

q_28067.question: What should a NF as HTTP client do if it receives a 5xx (Server Error) response status code that is not defined in the API specification?
q_28067.ground_truth: The NF should stop processing and go to an error handling process.

q_28068.question: What will the MME do if it receives an EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message containing a Request type of "NAS signalling connection release" or "Rejection of paging" in the UE request type IE in the EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message and if the UE requests restriction of paging by including the Paging restriction IE?
q_28068.ground_truth: The MME may accept the paging restriction and include the EPS additional request result IE in the SERVICE ACCEPT message and set the Paging restriction decision to "paging restriction is accepted" and store the paging restriction of the UE and enforce these restrictions in the paging procedure; or the MME may reject the paging restriction and include the EPS additional request result IE in the SERVICE ACCEPT message and set the Paging restriction decision to "paging restriction is rejected", and shall discard the received paging restriction. The MME shall delete any stored paging restriction for the UE and stop restricting paging; and the MME shall initiate the release of the NAS signalling connection after the completion of the service request procedure.

q_28069.question: What is one of the main advantages of having a standard communication flow between the DSO and MNO for energy recovery use case?
q_28069.ground_truth: A standard communication flow between the DSO and MNO for energy recovery use case enables both parties to adapt their processes to the existing constraints and efficiently manage resources to ensure high availability of remote access to DA assets during a power outage.

q_28070.question: What is the impact of QER's Gate Status being set to CLOSED on packet discarding in the UP function?
q_28070.ground_truth: Packets matching a PDR associated with a QER provisioned with the Gate Status set to CLOSED will be discarded by the UP function.

q_28071.question: What is the aim of the "Rel-18 downlink interruption for NR and EN-DC band combinations at dynamic Tx Switching in Uplink" Work Item?
q_28071.ground_truth: The objective of this Work Item is to discuss and specify inter-band uplink CA and EN-DC combinations for which DL interruption is not allowed during dynamic switching between two uplink carriers.

q_28072.question: In section 7.1, what is the assumed value of REFSENS and MBR used in the SNR calculation for UE demodulation testing methodology enhancements?
q_28072.ground_truth: The assumed value of REFSENS is -82.8 dBm/50 MHz and the assumed value of MBR is 1.0 dB.

q_28073.question: What is the condition for a UE to indicate a capability for dynamic power sharing between E-UTRA and NR for EN-DC in the context of FR1?
q_28073.ground_truth: A UE indicates a capability for dynamic power sharing between E-UTRA and NR for EN-DC in the context of FR1 if its transmission(s) in subframe of the MCG overlap in time with UE transmission(s) in slot of the SCG in FR1.

q_28074.question: What information does the Reporting Flags IE indicate for direct event notification reporting?
q_28074.ground_truth: The Reporting Flags IE indicates the DUPL bit to show if the UP function shall report event notifications over N4 in addition to directly to the Event Notification URI.

q_28075.question: Which parameter is used in the InitialContextSetupResponseIEs to indicate the list of E-RABs that failed to be set up?

q_28076.question: How many authorized QoS rules can the UE find in case 7 to avoid diagnosing an error in processing the request, assuming case 7a was also detected?
q_28076.ground_truth: The UE can find at least one other valid QoS rule in the 5GSM cause #83 "semantic error in the QoS operation" in the Authorized QoS rules IE.

q_28077.question: What action should the SM-over-IP receiver take when it receives a short message for an MSISDN less operation?
q_28077.ground_truth: The SM-over-IP receiver should check if the received short message contains a TP-OA field set to the dummy MSISDN value, and if the received SIP MESSAGE contains a Feature-Caps header field with a "+g.3gpp.smsip-msisdn-less" header field parameter. If both conditions are met, the SM-over-IP receiver should create a delivery report for the received short message.

q_28078.question: What is the purpose of the Diameter Accounting messages during primary and secondary PDP context activation procedures?
q_28078.ground_truth: The Diameter Accounting messages are used during both primary and secondary PDP context activation for non-EPC based packet domain (both the default bearer and dedicated bearer for the EPC based packet domain) and deactivation procedures respectively.

q_28079.question: What scheduling restrictions are applied to UEs which do not support simultaneousRxDataSSB-DiffNumerology when performing beam failure detection with a different subcarrier spacing than PDSCH/PDCCH on FR1?
q_28079.ground_truth: The UE is not expected to transmit PUCCH, PUSCH or SRS or receive PDCCH, PDSCH or CSI-RS for tracking or CSI-RS for CQI on SSB symbols to be measured for beam failure detection.

q_28080.question: What should be the pm-dsg value for the UE to pass the test in the first part?
q_28080.ground_truth: If the pm-dsg is less than or equal to 1%, the UE passes the first part of the test.

q_28081.question: What is the main challenge addressed in the first key issue related to XR/media services in 5GS?
q_28081.ground_truth: The main challenge addressed is meeting the very low Round-Trip latency requirement with the variable and unbalanced uplink/downlink latency overhead.

q_28082.question: In the context of clause~4.23.7.2.1, what is the procedure when both I-SMF and SMF are available for a PDU Session and no I-SMF change or removal is needed during inter NG-RAN node N2 handover procedure?
q_28082.ground_truth: The procedure defined in clause~4.9.1.3.2 and 4.9.1.3.3 are used with some differences.

q_28083.question: What should the UE do if it receives RRCConnectionReject with deprioritisationReq?
q_28083.ground_truth: The UE should consider the current carrier frequency and all the frequencies of EUTRA to be the lowest priority frequency while T325 is running, irrespective of the camped RAT.

q_28084.question: What action does the eNB take regarding ongoing RLC transmissions when data forwarding to the target node starts?
q_28084.ground_truth: The eNB does not need to abort ongoing RLC transmissions with the UE as it starts data forwarding to the target node.

q_28085.question: What is the maximum number of interfaces that TraceInterfaceList can contain?

q_28086.question: What should the UE do if it receives a PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message with the same PDU session ID as the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message it sent to the network?
q_28086.ground_truth: The UE should proceed with the network-requested PDU session release procedure and abort the UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure. However, if the UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure was for a handover of an existing PDU session between 3GPP access and non-3GPP access, the UE shall abort the PDU session establishment procedure and proceed with the network-requested PDU session release procedure.

q_28087.question: What is the purpose of the intent validation module in the potential solution for intent-driven management?
q_28087.ground_truth: The intent validation module checks the compliance of the intent format and the consistency among the intent expectations.

q_28088.question: When can an IAB-node provide information via MAC-CE to a parent node?
q_28088.ground_truth: An IAB-node can provide information via MAC-CE to a parent node to facilitate enhanced scheduling at the IAB-node and/or at the parent node, specifically when it supports enhanced multiplexing capabilities. This includes recommended IAB-MT Tx/Rx beams, desired IAB-MT Tx PSD range, desired parent node's IAB-DU Tx power adjustment, and required IAB-MT's uplink transmission timing mode.

q_28089.question: What is the function of the "Maximum time offset" information element?
q_28089.ground_truth: The "Maximum time offset" information element is used to provide the UE with a maximum time offset after returning from discontinuous coverage.

q_28090.question: When is the PROSE DIRECT LINK IDENTITY RESPONSE message sent in the 5G ProSe direct link identification procedure?
q_28090.ground_truth: The PROSE DIRECT LINK IDENTITY RESPONSE message is sent by the target UE upon receipt of the PROSE DIRECT LINK IDENTITY REQUEST message.

q_28091.question: What is the role of Step 4 in the procedure of NWDAF registering to NRF with its FL related information?
q_28091.ground_truth: In Step 4, the NWDAF registers its permitted-server-NWDAF list for each Analytics ID when it serves as a client NWDAF.

q_28092.question: What kind of measurement is being performed on neighbor cells in this test?

q_28093.question: What are the components needed in the field for the SE service?
q_28093.ground_truth: The needed components in the field for the SE service are sensors and meters.

q_28094.question: What should the dedicatedPosSysInfoDelivery perform upon reception of the contained posSIB(s)?
q_28094.ground_truth: The dedicatedPosSysInfoDelivery should perform the action specified in clause 5.2.2.4.16 upon reception of the contained posSIB(s).

q_28095.question: What should be done with the location information when forwarding a SIP INVITE request if the MCPTT user profile document contains the allow-location-info-when-talking rule element set to true?
q_28095.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT function shall include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-location-info+xml MIME body with a <Report> element in the <location-info> root element when forwarding the SIP INVITE request, if it has available the location of the initiating MCPTT client.

q_28096.question: What DL TEID address is provided by the MN in the NG-U interface for the new tunnel?
q_28096.ground_truth: The MN provides a DL TEID address to be applied as the additional DL tunnel address on the NG-U interface and the QoS flows associated with that tunnel.

q_28097.question: In what situation does the SN provide Xn-U DL TNL address information in the Xn-U Address Indication message?
q_28097.ground_truth: This occurs when the MN requests the SN to allocate resources for SN terminated bearers using MCG resources.

q_28098.question: What type of information element is the redirecting party BCD number?
q_28098.ground_truth: The redirecting party BCD number is a type 4 information element with a minimum length of 3 octets and a maximum length of 19 octets.

q_28099.question: What is the maximum number of activated TCI states for the DL TCI state in the Enhanced Unified TCI States Activation/Deactivation MAC CE for Separate TCI States?
q_28099.ground_truth: The maximum number of activated TCI states for the DL TCI state in the Enhanced Unified TCI States Activation/Deactivation MAC CE for Separate TCI States is 32.

q_28100.question: What protocol is required to carry the AKMA Key Identifier (A-KID) in the Ua* reference point?

q_28101.question: What is the purpose of NTC3 in the context of testing UTRA and E-UTRA multi RAT non-contiguous aspects?
q_28101.ground_truth: The purpose of NTC3 is to test UTRA and E-UTRA multi RAT non-contiguous aspects.

q_28102.question: What is the role of the AKMA Anchor Function (AAnF) in the 5G System?
q_28102.ground_truth: The AKMA Anchor Function (AAnF) stores the AKMA Anchor Key and generates key material between the UE and the Application Function (AF) in the 5G System.

q_28103.question: What is the procedure for a Multi-USIM UE to be released to ECM-IDLE state for a USIM due to activity on another USIM?
q_28103.ground_truth: The Multi-USIM UE initiates the Service Request procedure or a Tracking Area Update procedure by including a Release Request indication and Paging Restriction Information, if supported by the UE and network.

q_28104.question: What makes the External Group Identifier globally unique?
q_28104.ground_truth: The combination of Local Identifier and Domain Identifier makes the External Group Identifier globally unique.

q_28105.question: What should the NWDAF service consumer do if it needs to discover an NWDAF containing AnLF that is serving or holds data for a UE?
q_28105.ground_truth: The NWDAF service consumer can query UDM with the target SUPI and the Analytics ID. If the response from UDM indicates multiple candidate NWDAFs, the NWDAF service consumer may determine an appropriate instance based on registration time and query the NRF for their capabilities.

q_28106.question: How should the CA tests be executed for FDD CA tests specified in 8.2.1.1.1, 8.2.1.4.3, 8.7.1, 8.13.1.1.1, and 8.13.1.2.1?
q_28106.ground_truth: If corresponding CA tests with the largest number of CCs supported by the UE are tested, the test coverage can be considered fulfilled without executing the CA tests with less than the largest number of CCs supported by the UE.

q_28107.question: In TS 36.211, clause 5.5.1.3, what determines the group-hopping pattern for PUSCH and SRS?
q_28107.ground_truth: The group-hopping pattern for PUSCH and SRS is given by where the pseudo-random sequence is defined by clause 7.2. The pseudo-random sequence generator shall be initialized with the value at the beginning of each radio frame, where is given by clause 5.5.1.5.

q_28108.question: What is the function of the TrGW when forwarding media streams between IM CN subsystem networks?
q_28108.ground_truth: The TrGW provides functions like network address/port translation and IPv4/IPv6 protocol translation. NAT-PT binds addresses in IPv6 network with addresses in IPv4 network and vice versa to provide transparent routing between the two IP domains without requiring any changes to end points.

q_28109.question: What is the role of the 5G Media Streaming Architecture (5GMSA) in User Equipment (UE) and Media Application Server (AS)?
q_28109.ground_truth: The 5G Media Streaming Architecture (5GMSA) provides the framework for media streaming services in User Equipment (UE) and Media Application Server (AS). The codecs and formats recommended for 5G Media Streaming apply to the components in UE and the Media Application Server.

q_28110.question: What should be the principle when applying tests for a Base Station capable of multi-band operation with three or more bands?
q_28110.ground_truth: The supported multi-band combination covering the widest radio bandwidth should be tested first, followed by those with larger rated total output power, larger total number of supported carriers, or larger Maximum Base Station RF Bandwidth.

q_28111.question: How many NSCE servers can be located in a PLMN per Network Slice Provider as per the architecture?
q_28111.ground_truth: One or more NSCE servers can be located in a PLMN per Network Slice Provider.

q_28112.question: What is the input used to calculate the ShortResumeMAC-I in the RRC Resume Request message?
q_28112.ground_truth: The inputs used to calculate the ShortResumeMAC-I in the RRC Resume Request message are the integrity algorithm (EIA) in the stored AS security context, the current KRRCint, and the VarShortResumeMAC-Input as defined in TS 36.331 with the following inputs: source C-RNTI, source PCI, resume constant, and target Cell-ID.

q_28113.question: What should be the SSB measurement period for the SCell activation delay to be equal to TFirstATRS + 5ms in the FR1 band?
q_28113.ground_truth: The SSB measurement period should be equal to or smaller than 2400ms.

q_28114.question: What colorimetry is required for a Bitstream conforming to the 3GPP VR Basic H.264/AVC Operation Point?
q_28114.ground_truth: The 3GPP VR Basic H.264/AVC Operation Point Bitstream shall use ITU-R BT.709 colorimetry.

q_28115.question: What is the mean and 5% DL Average-UPT loss for operator 1 when using SBFD Alt 4 and large packet size at medium load level?
q_28115.ground_truth: The mean and 5% DL Average-UPT loss for operator 1 when using SBFD Alt 4 and large packet size at medium load level are -24.42% and 0%, respectively.

q_28116.question: What should the non-controlling MCVideo function of an MCVideo group do if it has not established a mutual aid relationship with the primary MCVideo system identified in the P-Asserted-Identity header field and receives a SIP INVITE request for a non-controlling MCVideo function of an MCVideo group?
q_28116.ground_truth: The non-controlling MCVideo function of an MCVideo group should reject the request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response and not process the remaining steps.

q_28117.question: What is the size limit of a SIB and how does it affect the transmission of public key certificates to UEs?
q_28117.ground_truth: A SIB has a size limit of 2976 bits (372 bytes). This means that an X.509v3 certificate, which is about 545 bytes for ECDSA-256 with SHA-256, cannot fit into a single SIB. Therefore, it is desirable to avoid transmitting public key certificates to UEs to minimize message overhead.

q_28118.question: What is the expected QoS for UE1 as it moves to another floor while maintaining its service with UE2 through an indirect communication path?
q_28118.ground_truth: UE1 is expected to maintain the same QoS with UE2 through the indirect communication path as it was through the original direct communication path.

q_28119.question: What is the format of the ENVELOPE (ProSe Report) command parameter when sending a ProSe Report to the UICC?
q_28119.ground_truth: The ENVELOPE (ProSe Report) command parameters include device identities, with the source set to ME and the destination set to UICC. The ProSe Report Data data object contains the ProSe Report. The Last Envelope TLV is included to indicate the last information concerning the ProSe Report has been sent.

q_28120.question: What should the MME do upon receiving an EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message with specific service type and CSFB response, and the Call Cancelled Flag is set to "true"?
q_28120.ground_truth: The MME sets the Call Cancelled Flag to "false" and rejects the CS fallback call if the EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message has a service type set to "mobile terminating CS fallback or 1xCS fallback" and CSFB response set to "CS fallback accepted by the UE".

q_28121.question: What conditions must be met for the UE to establish an RRC connection and perform an attach procedure in 3GPP Release 17?
q_28121.ground_truth: The UE must be in EMM-DEREGISTERED/RRC-IDLE state and find a cell which provides access by E-UTRA NTN RAT. When the UE has a valid GNSS position, and the cell broadcasts systemInformationBlockType31, then the UE shall establish RRC connection, include gnss-validityDuration in RRCConnectionSetupComplete-NB message, and successfully perform an attach procedure. Otherwise, the UE shall not establish an RRC connection.

q_28122.question: What is the requirement for secure connection between the SKM-C and the SKM-S in the SEAL key provisioning procedure?
q_28122.ground_truth: A secure connection must be established between the SKM-C and the SKM-S prior to any associated key provisioning requests in the SEAL key provisioning procedure.

q_28123.question: What is the S1AP protocol value that corresponds to the radio network layer?

q_28124.question: Who was the first man to walk on the moon?

q_28125.question: What can cause a difference in radiation pattern between the V-pol and H-pol of an antenna module in practical UE design?
q_28125.ground_truth: In practical UE design, the difference between the V-pol and H-pol of an antenna module can be caused by severe blockage, which can lead to reflection and polarization mismatch. This difference may still exist even if the metal frame near the antenna module is replaced by other materials to avoid blockage.

q_28126.question: What should the MSGin5G Server do if it receives an MSGin5G delivery status report for multiple messages?
q_28126.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Server may aggregate the individual delivery status reports into one single message, and check whether the reports can be aggregated as specified in clause~6.4.1.2.7.

q_28127.question: What is the RRC procedure delay in this test case?
q_28127.ground_truth: The RRC procedure delay is 50 ms.

q_28128.question: What is the state of Cell 3 during the initial connection setup?
q_28128.ground_truth: Cell 3 is switched off during the initial connection setup.

q_28129.question: What should the 5GMSd Application Provider include in the Policy Template when provisioning a Background Data Transfer policy?
q_28129.ground_truth: The Policy Template provisioned by the 5GMSd Application Provider should include network QoS parameters and either reference an existing Background Data Transfer policy that embodies the Service Level Agreement or directly specify Background Data Transfer parameters in line with the aforementioned Service Level Agreement.

q_28130.question: What should the NF service consumer do if it successfully processes and accepts an HTTP DELETE request for deleting a specific stored record?
q_28130.ground_truth: The NF service consumer should remove the corresponding stored record and respond with HTTP "204 No Content" status code.

q_28131.question: In which step should the participating MCPTT function perform the procedures of clause~9.2.2.2.14 if the implicit affiliation procedures were invoked and it received a SIP 4xx, 5xx or 6xx response to the SIP INVITE request?

q_28132.question: What are the different registration intention indicators or types?
q_28132.ground_truth: The available registration intention indicators include "Local service information Query only", "Registration with local service information query", and "Registration only".

q_28133.question: What are the co-location emission requirements specified for a base station?
q_28133.ground_truth: The co-location emission requirements are specified as the power sum of the supported polarization(s) at the conducted output(s) of the Common Local Antenna System (CLTA).

q_28134.question: What should the AMF include in the PDU session ID IE when it sends a single uplink CIoT user data container which is not forwarded due to routing failure?
q_28134.ground_truth: The AMF should include the PDU session ID in the PDU session ID IE when it sends a single uplink CIoT user data container which is not forwarded due to routing failure.

q_28135.question: What action does the MS take if the T3346 value in the ROUTING AREA UPDATE REJECT message is not zero or deactivated?
q_28135.ground_truth: The MS aborts the routing area updating procedure, resets the routing area updating attempt counter, and starts timer T3346 with the provided value if the message is integrity protected, or with a random value from the default range if not.

q_28136.question: What is the difference between a user plane message and a signalling message in a GTP-U PDU?
q_28136.ground_truth: User plane messages are used to carry user data packets between GTP-U entities, while signalling messages are sent between network nodes for path management and tunnel management.

q_28137.question: What is the purpose of the Procedure Transaction Id (PTI) parameter in the Update Bearer Request message?
q_28137.ground_truth: The Procedure Transaction Id (PTI) parameter is used to identify the procedure initiated by a UE Requested Bearer Resource Modification Procedure.

q_28138.question: What is the parameter that specifies the number of carriers used for all cdma2000 1X cells in the neighbor cell list for cdma2000 RAT?
q_28138.ground_truth: The parameter is 'Number of CDMA2000 1X Neighbour Frequency'.

q_28139.question: What should the SCC AS include in the SDP answer in a SIP 183 (Session Progress) response in the scenario where one or more early dialogs related to the originating call not accepted yet are available and the remote UE has not provided an Allow header field listing the SIP UPDATE method?
q_28139.ground_truth: The SCC AS should include media of media types received in SDP offer of the SIP INVITE request due to STN-SR, which are also offered in the SIP INVITE request from the served user, and the signalling elements described in subclause~6A.4.3A.

q_28140.question: What is the name of the rule that determines how incoming IP packets are filtered at the Network and Transport Layers of the ISO/OSI stack?
q_28140.ground_truth: The first rule in the Packet filtering requirement

q_28141.question: What is the procedure if the deviation does not disappear in the offset cases?
q_28141.ground_truth: If the deviation does not disappear, it may be due to the fact that the offset has made the frequency of the unwanted signal correspond to the frequency of another narrow band response. In such a case, the procedure is repeated with the increase and decrease of the frequency of the unwanted signal set to 1.25 times the offset frequency.

q_28142.question: What is the requirement for the ciphering keys for the user plane in RNs?
q_28142.ground_truth: The ciphering keys for the user plane in RNs are KUPenc. For the control plane, it is KRRCenc. For the SLRB that needs integrity protection and verification, the key required is PIK.

q_28143.question: What is the role of the Gate Status IE in the QER when controlling the forwarding of IP packets in PGW-U and TDF-U for EPC and in UPF for 5GC?
q_28143.ground_truth: The Gate Status IE indicates whether the service data flow or detected application traffic is allowed to be forwarded or discarded in the uplink and/or downlink directions.

q_28144.question: What is the required state of the User Equipment (UE) during the test described in step 6.3B.4.1.4.2?
q_28144.ground_truth: The UE is required to be in State 2A-NB with CP CIoT Optimisation during the test described in step 6.3B.4.1.4.2.

q_28145.question: When must the UE meet the requirements for transmission on both assigned component carriers for the relative power tolerance, as defined in 6.3A.4.1.2.1?
q_28145.ground_truth: The UE must meet the requirements when the power of the target and reference sub-frames on each component carrier exceed the minimum output power and the total power is limited by PUMAX. Additionally, the average transmit power per PRB must be aligned across both assigned carriers when transitioning between PUSCH, PUCCH, and SRS.

q_28146.question: What is the required throughput for the PUSCH in the presence of an interfering signal for SAN type 1-H, as specified in clause 8.2.2?
q_28146.ground_truth: The throughput should be greater than or equal to 95% of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channel for SAN type 1-H.

q_28147.question: What happens when a PRIVATE CALL SETUP REQUEST message is received by an idle MCPTT client, with the Call type IE set to "EMERGENCY PRIVATE CALL"?
q_28147.ground_truth: The MCPTT client sets the stored current call type to "EMERGENCY PRIVATE CALL", and sets the stored current ProSe per-packet priority to value corresponding to MCPTT off-network emergency private call.

q_28148.question: In EN-DC operation, what is the minimum number of effective carrier frequency layers (excluding NR serving carriers) that the UE must be capable of monitoring for CSI-RS based L3 measurement?
q_28148.ground_truth: The UE must be capable of monitoring at least 1 effective carrier frequency layer for CSI-RS based L3 measurement in EN-DC operation (i.e. NCSI = 1).

q_28149.question: What should the floor control server do upon receiving an implicit floor request in an emergency group call or an imminent peril call?
q_28149.ground_truth: If there is only one MCPTT client in the MCPTT call, the floor control server should reject the request. If the floor request is granted, the floor control server shall stop timer T4 (Inactivity), shall stop timer T7 (Floor Idle), and shall enter the 'G: Floor Taken' state.

q_28150.question: What is one of the responsibilities of the LAF?
q_28150.ground_truth: The LAF is responsible for processing the location requests received from the LEA during the location acquisition procedure.

q_28151.question: What shall the participating MCData function include in the outgoing SIP INVITE request's MIME body if it is present in the incoming SIP INVITE request?
q_28151.ground_truth: The participating MCData function shall include the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body that was present in the incoming SIP INVITE request in the outgoing SIP INVITE request.

q_28152.question: What is the effect of EAP re-authentication on the UE and EPC network when it is supported?
q_28152.ground_truth: EAP re-authentication can provide enhanced performance and optimize the user experience by enabling Fast Initial Link Setup and minimalizing the link-setup delay between the UE and the non-3GPP access network. UEs can connect to EPC via non-3GPP access and utilize EPC services with enhanced performance.

q_28153.question: How many sources achieved the target requirement of 6~12 months for battery life with extended DRX cycle and ultra-deep sleep state?

q_28154.question: What protocol does the media storage function on the MCData content server use to process HTTP GET requests?
q_28154.ground_truth: The media storage function on the MCData content server uses the HTTP protocol to process HTTP GET requests.

q_28155.question: What is the role of the NSSAAF in the 5GS architecture?
q_28155.ground_truth: The NSSAAF is a logical network that provides specific network capabilities and network characteristics, and it is responsible for Network Slice-Specific Authentication and Authorization in the 5GS architecture.

q_28156.question: What is the reference point between the PINE and the PEGC in Personal IoT Networks in 5GS?
q_28156.ground_truth: This reference point is based on the direct user plane path to 5GS, relay path via the PEGC, or other communication path via Internet.

q_28157.question: What is the impact of the selected protection policy information on subsequent message transfers over N32-f in the parameter exchange procedure for protection policy exchange?
q_28157.ground_truth: The selected protection policy information contains the IEs allowed to be modified by an IPX on the side of the responding SEPP. The SEPPs shall store the modification policy and the encryption policy, which is applicable for both the directions of communication between the SEPPs. The SEPP receiving the subsequent message transfers over N32-f shall check whether the modifications performed by the IPXs were permitted by the respective modification policy.

q_28158.question: What should the UE do if the EMM cause value received is #11 or #35, and the UE is not in its HPLMN or EHPLMN?
q_28158.ground_truth: If the EMM cause value received is #11 or #35, and the UE is not in its HPLMN or EHPLMN, the UE should increment the PLMN-specific attempt counter of the PLMN that sent the reject message and handle 5GMM parameters for rejected registration request or service request procedures over 3GPP access.

q_28159.question: What should be the action taken by a GTP entity if it receives an information element with a reserved value?
q_28159.ground_truth: The GTP entity should treat the information element as invalid, log the error, and send a response with Cause set to "Mandatory IE incorrect" if the invalid IE is mandatory or verifiable conditional.

q_28160.question: What is the format of the MulticastMRBs-ToBeSetupMod-List in the MulticastContextModificationRequest?
q_28160.ground_truth: The MulticastMRBs-ToBeSetupMod-List in the MulticastContextModificationRequest is a SEQUENCE of ProtocolIE-SingleContainer, containing MulticastMRBs-ToBeSetupMod-ItemIEs.

q_28161.question: What is the size of the "TCI State ID" field in the Aperiodic CSI Trigger State Subselection MAC CE?
q_28161.ground_truth: The size of the "TCI State ID" field in the Aperiodic CSI Trigger State Subselection MAC CE is 7 bits.

q_28162.question: What is the role of a "resource owner" as defined in the document?
q_28162.ground_truth: A resource owner is an entity capable of granting access to a protected resource.

q_28163.question: When does the counter for "MM.HoExeInterSucc" in 5G mobility management get incremented?
q_28163.ground_truth: The counter is incremented by 1 when a successful handover is indicated by the receipt of UE CONTEXT RELEASE at the source gNB from the target gNB or AMF following a successful inter gNB handover or legacy handover.

q_28164.question: What terms and documentation were identified as E-UTRAN/EPS specific in the Mission Critical specifications?
q_28164.ground_truth: Terms such as UE-R, UE-to-network relay, EPC-level roaming, GCSE_LTE, MBMS, BM-SC, MB2-U, MB2-C, GC1, TMGI, MBSFN, ECGI, SAI, TS 23.246, TS 23.468, TS-29.468, PC5, ProSe, TS 23.303, APN, PAP, CHAP, QCI, LTE, EPS, EPC, E-UTRAN, S1, TS 23.331, GSMA PRD IR.88, and HSS were identified as E-UTRAN/EPS (Evolved Packet Core) specific in the Mission Critical specifications.

q_28165.question: What does the ResourceIsolationRule IOC represent in the IOC?
q_28165.ground_truth: The ResourceIsolationRule IOC represents a set of isolation requirements for managed resources, specifying a list of rules for the isolation of managed resources using the resourceIsolationRuleList attribute.

q_28166.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects Telecommunication Management?
q_28166.ground_truth: The purpose is to provide a standard set of Trace and Minimization of Drive Test (MDT) data, as well as a common format for trace and MDT records and a method for reporting of Trace and MDT results across management interfaces.

q_28167.question: What should the UP function do when it receives a PFCP Session Modification Request message?
q_28167.ground_truth: The UP function removes all rules identified by a Rule ID to be removed and removes the Rule ID from the PDR(s) from where they are referenced.

q_28168.question: What should the mobile station (MS) do if both the network and the MS support the Cell Notification and a new READY timer value is negotiated?
q_28168.ground_truth: The MS should use any LLC frame except the LLC NULL frame for the initial cell update.

q_28169.question: In which direction does the Control Plane CIoT 5GS Optimisation exchange user data between the UE and the SMF?
q_28169.ground_truth: The Control Plane CIoT 5GS Optimisation exchanges user data between the UE and the SMF in both uplink and downlink directions.

q_28170.question: How many subframes are allowed for intra-band Carrier Aggregation in the 3GPP TS 36.133 standard for interruption of Primary Cell?
q_28170.ground_truth: The intra-band CA allows a maximum of 5 subframes for interruption of the Primary Cell.

q_28171.question: What is the total maximum allowed time for cell re-selection delay expressed in seconds?
q_28171.ground_truth: The total maximum allowed time for cell re-selection delay is 34 seconds.

q_28172.question: What information is included in the Modify Bearer Request message that is sent to the Serving GW to prompt the PDN GW to tunnel packets from non-3GPP IP access to 3GPP access system?

q_28173.question: What is the PCF's role in determining the alternative S-NSSAI for the network?
q_28173.ground_truth: The PCF determines the alternative S-NSSAI for the network; however, since it is not specified in solution #40 how the PCF knows whether the alternative S-NSSAI is supported in the current TA and associated RAN node, further clarification is required to ensure proper functionality.

q_28174.question: What is the function of the PGW in NIDD using a PtP SGi tunnel, and how is the user plane different from NIDD using SCEF?
q_28174.ground_truth: The PGW provides an IRI-POI and a CC-POI for NIDD using a PtP SGi tunnel, and it terminates the PtP SGi tunnel with the SCS/AS, which has the same capabilities as SCEF for NIDD. The user plane for NIDD using a PtP SGi tunnel flows through MME and SGW, unlike in NIDD using SCEF where the user traffic is exchanged with DoNAS between UE and MME, over T6a interface between MME and SCEF, and finally over T8 interface between SCEF and SCS/AS.

q_28175.question: What parameter shall be included if the handover is requested for a speech bearer and the MS is in UMTS or GERAN Iu-mode access?

q_28176.question: What is the procedure for origination of an MCPTT private call for call transfer request in MCPTT technology?
q_28176.ground_truth: Upon completion of the procedures of clause~11.1.1.2.1.1 or clause~11.1.1.2.2.1, the MCPTT client should generate a SIP MESSAGE request with a P-Preferred-Service header field containing a specific value and an Accept-Contact header field with the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag containing the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcptt".

q_28177.question: What determines the priority of a floor request in off-network floor control?
q_28177.ground_truth: The priority of a floor request in off-network floor control is determined by checking the presence of a Floor Priority field in the received Floor Request message, and using the lowest value from the Field, UserPriority, and NumLevelHierarchy leaf nodes.

q_28178.question: What percentage of subframes does the SS-UE utilize in order to achieve 10% congestion?
q_28178.ground_truth: The SS-UE utilizes 1 out of 10 consecutive subframes in order to achieve 10% congestion.

q_28179.question: Under what circumstances should the UE start the back-off timer for the PDU session modification procedure?
q_28179.ground_truth: The UE should start the back-off timer for the PDU session modification procedure if the network has rejected the request due to a 5GSM cause value different from the specified list and the Back-off timer value IE is included.

q_28180.question: What is the role of the CS restoration indicator in an SGs paging request?
q_28180.ground_truth: The CS restoration indicator in an SGs paging request is used to indicate that the MME serving the UE is no longer in service, and that the VLR should send the paging request to one alternative MME in the same MME pool.

q_28181.question: What are the two (Optional) steps involved in NSCOF's communication with the Network Slice Orchestrator (NSO)?
q_28181.ground_truth: 2a) The NSO may request certificates for network functions (NFs) associated with specific network slice subnet segment identifiers (NSSAIs) after verifying a successful deployment of NFs. 2b) The NSO can identify NFs associated with NSSAIs and send the Certificate Signing Request to the Operator's CA on their behalf.

q_28182.question: How does the Averaging Window (AW) determine the measurement periodicity in the 5GS?
q_28182.ground_truth: The Averaging Window (AW) determines the measurement periodicity by representing the duration over which the GFBR and MFBR shall be calculated, which affects the rate of GFBR/MFBR measurement.

q_28183.question: Which entity is responsible for including the "dstscp" parameter in the header during the HTTP request or response message?
q_28183.ground_truth: The "dstscp" parameter, indicating the FQDN of the Destination SCP, is included by an SCP while relaying the HTTP request or response message.

q_28184.question: What is the state of the UE prior to the start of time duration T1?
q_28184.ground_truth: The UE is fully synchronized to Cell 1 and has no information on Cell 2.

q_28185.question: What may cause an interruption on the primary cell (PCell) or on activated secondary cells (SCells) during uplink bandwidth switching in New Radio (NR) PCell or SCell?
q_28185.ground_truth: Consistent uplink LBT failures on the NR PCell can cause an interruption on PCell or on activated SCells in the multi-connectivity group (MCG).

q_28186.question: What type of decoder is required for a bitstream to conform to the 3GPP MPEG-H Audio Operation Point?
q_28186.ground_truth: The audio stream shall comply with the MPEG-H 3D Audio Low Complexity (LC) Profile, Levels 1, 2 or 3.

q_28187.question: What is the primary CPICH used for in NR DAPS handover?
q_28187.ground_truth: The primary CPICH, or phase reference, is used to change the NR PCell to another NR cell in NR DAPS handover.

q_28188.question: Who is responsible for mapping 5G QoS to wireline access network resources for the FN-RG?
q_28188.ground_truth: The W-AGF is responsible for mapping 5G QoS to wireline access network resources for the FN-RG.

q_28189.question: In the procedure for establishing end-to-end security between UEs, what is the role of the "end-to-end protection key" and how is it derived?
q_28189.ground_truth: The "end-to-end protection key" is a symmetric key used to protect the end-to-end link between the UEs. It is derived by the Target UE using the Source UE's ephemeral public key (UE1.ePK) and its own ephemeral private key (UE2.eSK).

q_28190.question: How long does a user agent that wishes to use the ECT service need to wait for a response the first time it sends a REFER method?
q_28190.ground_truth: The user agent that wishes to use the ECT service should wait for a response to the REFER method for a maximum of 64 seconds.

q_28191.question: What is the main role of PDCP in the RRC protocol?
q_28191.ground_truth: The main role of PDCP in the RRC protocol is to provide integrity protection and ciphering of information.

q_28192.question: Under what condition is the special subframe not present in the second half-frame?
q_28192.ground_truth: The special subframe is not present in the second half-frame in case of 10 ms downlink-to-uplink switch-point periodicity.

q_28193.question: What should the UE consider as RLC data volume for MAC buffer status reporting?
q_28193.ground_truth: The UE should consider RLC SDUs and RLC SDU segments that have not yet been included in an RLC data PDU, RLC data PDUs that are pending for initial transmission, and RLC data PDUs that are pending for retransmission as RLC data volume for MAC buffer status reporting.

q_28194.question: Under what conditions should the participating MCVideo function reject a SIP INVITE request for originating participating MCVideo function?
q_28194.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function may reject a SIP INVITE request for originating participating MCVideo function if it is unable to process the request due to a lack of resources or a risk of congestion. It may also reject the request if the public user identity in the P-Asserted-Identity header field of the SIP INVITE request is not bound to an MCVideo ID or if the validity period of an existing binding has expired. Additionally, the participating MCVideo function should reject the SIP INVITE request if the user is not authorized to initiate an ambient viewing call or if the user is not authorized to make a private call to the specific user in the request.

q_28195.question: In the eNB, what should be done with the received Handover Restriction List IE in the INITIAL CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message?
q_28195.ground_truth: The eNB should store the received Handover Restriction List in the UE context to manage any roaming or access restrictions.

q_28196.question: What is the purpose of the "P-Asserted-Identity" header field in the 3GPP MCPTT specification?
q_28196.ground_truth: The "P-Asserted-Identity" header field is used to indicate the public service identity of the MCPTT server in the MCPTT system.

q_28197.question: What should be done if the received SIP INVITE request contains an unauthorized request for an MCVideo imminent peril group call?
q_28197.ground_truth: A SIP 403 (Forbidden) response should be returned with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response with an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body as specified in clause~F.1 with the <mcvideoinfo> element containing the <mcvideo-Params> element with the <imminentperil-ind> element set to a value of "false", and skip the rest of the steps.

q_28198.question: What is the performance objective for N-MOS-LQOn score for G-MOS-LQOn?
q_28198.ground_truth: There is no performance objective for N-MOS-LQOn score for G-MOS-LQOn.

q_28199.question: What does the IP/UDP/DTLS/SCTP overhead include in the bandwidth value for SCTP-based media?
q_28199.ground_truth: The IP/UDP/DTLS/SCTP overhead includes the IP, UDP, DTLS, and SCTP protocol headers in the bandwidth value for SCTP-based media.

q_28200.question: What determines the priority of an MCData group transaction in the presence of other group MCData and one-to-one user transactions?
q_28200.ground_truth: The lowest RelativePresentationPriority value shall be considered as the MCData group transaction having the lowest priority for presentation among other group MCData and one-to-one user transactions.

q_28201.question: What is the goal of the solution for RT latency fulfillment based on UL/DL AQP Adaptation?
q_28201.ground_truth: The goal of the solution is to provide RT latency guarantee for real-time XRM services in 5G system to meet very low RT latency requirements for better user experience.

q_28202.question: When must a UE include the "HPLMN ID" IE when establishing a 5G ProSe direct link?
q_28202.ground_truth: The UE must include the "HPLMN ID" IE if the UP-PRUK ID of the UE is included and is not in NAI format.

q_28203.question: What should be done continuously in the uplink scheduling information to the UE until the UE transmits at PUMAX level?
q_28203.ground_truth: Send continuously uplink power control "up" commands in the uplink scheduling information to the UE.

q_28204.question: What is the maximum number of SRS Positioning resource sets in a BWP?
q_28204.ground_truth: The maximum number of SRS Positioning resource sets in a BWP is 16.

q_28205.question: What should be measured to calculate the total power within the range of all frequencies for measuring the occupied bandwidth of a NR UE?
q_28205.ground_truth: The power spectrum distribution should be measured as the sum of the powers from both UE transmit antenna connectors within a specific range over the requirement for Occupied Bandwidth specification, centered on the current carrier frequency.

q_28206.question: What should the MCPTT client do upon receipt of a SIP BYE request in the dialog of an ambient listening session, if the cached ambient listening client role is equal to "listened-to MCPTT user"?
q_28206.ground_truth: The MCPTT client shall provide no indication that an ambient listening call has been terminated.

q_28207.question: What are some potential standardization areas for AR conversational services?
q_28207.ground_truth: Some potential standardization areas for AR conversational services include immersive media format and profile with integration into 5G architecture, scene description format and functionality, media codecs, CMAF encapsulation of immersive media for 5G media streaming, and capability exchange mechanism.

q_28208.question: What is the objective of Test 1, 2, and 3 in clauses 7.1.11.4.2 and 7.1.11.5?
q_28208.ground_truth: The objective of Test 1, 2, and 3 in clauses 7.1.11.4.2 and 7.1.11.5 is to verify the UE's capability to follow the frame timing change of the connected System Simulator for Cat-M1 UE in CEModeA.

q_28209.question: When should the initiating UE send a PROSE DIRECT LINK RELEASE REQUEST message containing PC5 signalling protocol cause value #2 "direct communication to the target UE no longer needed"?
q_28209.ground_truth: When the initiating UE is acting as a 5G ProSe layer-3 end UE and the direct link is between the initiating UE and a 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-UE relay UE and the communication between the initiating UE and the peer 5G ProSe layer-3 end UE is no longer available.

q_28210.question: What happens when the CSG ID list is requested and the ME is not camped on a CSG or Hybrid cell?
q_28210.ground_truth: The ME returns a "ME currently not able to process command - no service" message.

q_28211.question: What is the purpose of the initial conditions specified in step 6.3.3.2.2.4.1?
q_28211.ground_truth: The purpose of the initial conditions specified in step 6.3.3.2.2.4.1 is to define the environmental conditions, test frequencies, test channel bandwidths, and sub-carrier spacing the UE needs to be tested in, and the steps for the SS to take with the UE to reach the correct measurement state.

q_28212.question: What is the role of the UE in the ePDG selection procedure if it cannot determine whether it is located in the home country or a visited country?
q_28212.ground_truth: The UE shall stop the ePDG selection procedure.

q_28213.question: When can a UE switch to another communication path for a ProSe Service?
q_28213.ground_truth: A UE can switch to another communication path for a ProSe Service when both PC5 and Uu are permitted.

q_28214.question: What should the UE do if there is a semantic error in a packet filter and the QoS rule is not the default QoS rule?
q_28214.ground_truth: The UE shall send a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message to delete the QoS rule with 5GSM cause #44 "semantic error in packet filter(s)".

q_28215.question: What is the difference requirement for SCell 1 and SCell 2 in TDD-FDD CA with FDD PCell with 2 DL CC?
q_28215.ground_truth: The difference requirement for SCell 1 and SCell 2 in TDD-FDD CA with FDD PCell with 2 DL CC is 2 or greater for more than 90% of the time.

q_28216.question: What should the UE do if the first expiry of the timer T3481 occurs while waiting for the bearer resource modification indication from the MME?
q_28216.ground_truth: The UE should re-send the BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message. This retransmission is repeated four times, and if the fifth expiry of the timer T3481 occurs, the UE should abort the procedure, release the PTI allocated for this action, and enter the state PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE.

q_28217.question: What type of element is "ellipsoid-arc-area" in the context of 3GPP TS 23.032 clause 5.7?
q_28217.ground_truth: It is an optional element specifying an area as an ellipsoid arc.

q_28218.question: What does the "Alternative QoS Parameters Set Index" IE indicate in the 3GPP NG RAN protocol?
q_28218.ground_truth: The "Alternative QoS Parameters Set Index" IE indicates the QoS parameters set which can currently be fulfilled by the NG-RAN node to the UE.

q_28219.question: What are the procedures involved in the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay Discovery?
q_28219.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay Discovery consists of two procedures: 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay Discovery with Model A and 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay Discovery with Model B. Each procedure consists of multiple steps as specified in the respective clauses.

q_28220.question: What is the role of the transmitter power of the UE in the E-UTRAN FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync?
q_28220.ground_truth: The transmitter power of the UE is expected to turn off within 40 ms after the expiry of T310 timer, preventing unnecessary transmission.

q_28221.question: What type of noise was used for RFR measurement in the prototype playback system?

q_28222.question: What is the test purpose for the TDD - TDD inter frequency absolute RSRQ accuracy test?
q_28222.ground_truth: The TDD - TDD inter frequency absolute RSRQ accuracy test aims to verify that the TDD - TDD inter frequency absolute RSRQ measurement accuracy is within the specified limit for all bands.

q_28223.question: What is the primary requirement for the PLMN code associated with an S-NSSAI in the MCS UE's list of partner MC systems?
q_28223.ground_truth: If the MCS UE is registered to a PLMN via 5GS and the PLMN code is associated with an S-NSSAI, then the associated S-NSSAI must be included in the allowed NSSAI.

q_28224.question: How does the AF select the common DNAI and common EAS in Solution #17?
q_28224.ground_truth: The AF selects the common DNAI and common EAS from the candidate DNAI(s) provided by all the SMF(s) for each group member UE.

q_28225.question: What is the local collision avoidance rule provided by the AAM to UAVs/UEs in the network-assisted (ground based) DAA mechanism?
q_28225.ground_truth: The local collision avoidance rule provided by the AAM to UAVs/UEs in the network-assisted (ground based) DAA mechanism is policies applied in the specific airspace of the area/arena to avoid UAVs crashing into each other or different structures.

q_28226.question: What is the format of the E2E data volume transfer time analytics output by the NWDAF?
q_28226.ground_truth: The NWDAF provides E2E data volume transfer time analytics as statistics, predictions, or both, to the service consumer. If the target of analytics reporting is an individual UE, the NWDAF provides the analytics transfer time result for the UE.

q_28227.question: What should the UE do if it receives a SL DRX Command MAC CE for the Source Layer-2 ID and Destination Layer-2 ID pair of a unicast?
q_28227.ground_truth: Stop sl-drx-onDurationTimer and sl-drx-InactivityTimer for the Source Layer-2 ID and Destination Layer-2 ID pair of a unicast.

q_28228.question: What should the VAE-S include in the Content-Type header field of the HTTP 200 (OK) response message, in the V2X service registration procedure?

q_28229.question: What message is used to request the UE Radio Capability from the UE when the MME has not stored the UE Radio Capability information and CIoT EPS Optimisations do not apply?
q_28229.ground_truth: The DOWNLINK NAS TRANSPORT message during Attach or TAU procedure.

q_28230.question: What happens when a UE indicates support for GRUU in the IMS network?
q_28230.ground_truth: When a UE indicates support for GRUU in the IMS network, the IMS network shall generate P-GRUU's and T-GRUU's for all implicitly registered Public User Identities belonging to the same implicit registration set and communicate them to the UE. The IMS network shall also direct registrations of all GRUUs associated with a specific Public User Identity to the same S-CSCF, and route requests destined to a GRUU to the UE instance registered with that GRUU. The IMS network should reject the request if the URI in the SIP Contact header of the sender does not comply with the GRUU requirement or if there is no registration corresponding to the GRUU. The IMS network shall also differentiate between a GRUU and a Public User Identity and not fork SIP requests addressed to a GRUU to separate UEs. A UE capable of supporting GRUUs shall also be able to inter-work with a UE not supporting GRUUs.

q_28231.question: What should a participating MCVideo function do if the <session-type> element is set to "private" and the <IncomingPrivateCallList> element exists in the MCVideo user profile document, but the <mcvideo-calling-user-id> does not match with any of the <entry> elements in the MCVideo user profile document and the <allow-to-receive-private-call-from-any-user> is not set to "true"?
q_28231.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function should reject the SIP INVITE request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response and a warning text set to "159 user not authorised to be called by this originating user".

q_28232.question: What is the responsibility of the MTLF1 with FL Server when acting as a coordinator for Horizontal Federated Learning?
q_28232.ground_truth: The MTLF1 with FL Server acting as a coordinator for Horizontal Federated Learning is responsible for selecting multiple MTLF with FL clients, sending a request to the selected MTLF with FL clients including necessary parameters, aggregating all the local ML model training results, and sending the aggregated ML model information to the selected MTLF with FL client.

q_28233.question: What is the format of the SNPN Identifier based N3IWF FQDN?
q_28233.ground_truth: The SNPN Identifier based N3IWF FQDN is constructed as "n3iwf.5gc.snpnid<SNPNID>.mcc<MCC>.pub.3gppnetwork.org", where <SNPNID> is the identifier of the SNPN in the form of PLMN ID||NID and <MCC> is the Mobile Country Code.

q_28234.question: What is the purpose of the ACL functionality, as defined in the document?
q_28234.ground_truth: ACL functionality is a type of functionality that controls the access to network nodes, often applying Access Control Lists to restrict connections from unknown source addresses.

q_28235.question: What action does the NSACF take when the MA PDU Session Release is received over a single Access Type?
q_28235.ground_truth: The NSACF removes only the received Access Type entry while keeping the PDU Session ID.

q_28236.question: What is the age of location information of a given object?
q_28236.ground_truth: The age of location information of a given object can be found by looking for the ageOfLocationInformation in the oCTE of the object.

q_28237.question: When should the UE initiate the first measurement report if the purpose is set to 'reportStrongestCellsForSON'?
q_28237.ground_truth: The UE initiates the first measurement report when it has determined the strongest cells on the associated frequency.

q_28238.question: What attribute should be used instead of "msNetAssistInvocation" for collecting Media Streaming Network Assistance invocation information for an UE application if the "MSEventExposure" feature is supported?
q_28238.ground_truth: If the "MSEventExposure" feature is supported, the Media Streaming Network Assistance invocation collected for an UE application via the Data Collection AF as "msNetAssistInvocation" attribute should be used instead of "msNetAssistInvocation".

q_28239.question: What should the UAE-S include in the HTTP 200 (OK) response after successfully removing the stored UAS UE information for the UAE-C during de-registration?
q_28239.ground_truth: The UAE-S should include a result element set to "success" in the de-registration-info element in the UAE-info root element.

q_28240.question: What is the requirement for the SNR in the test for PUCCH format 4?
q_28240.ground_truth: The performance is measured by the required SNR at UCI block error probability not exceeding 1%.

q_28241.question: What should the MCData client do upon receiving a SIP INFO request when an ongoing group session is identified in the Request-URI?
q_28241.ground_truth: The MCData client should follow the actions specified in clause 6.2.8.1.13.

q_28242.question: What is the role of the "ipAddr" attribute and "pei" attribute in the UAVAuthInfo data type during the UUAA-SM procedure?
q_28242.ground_truth: The "ipAddr" attribute carries the IP Address associated with the PDU session, and the "pei" attribute carries the PEI of the UAV in the UAVAuthInfo data type during the UUAA-SM procedure.

q_28243.question: When must the UE set the NAS signalling connection release bit to "NAS signalling connection release supported" in the UE network capability IE of the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message?
q_28243.ground_truth: For all cases except case b

q_28244.question: Which security protocol is used for the security communication in the MSGin5G-3 interface in the MSGin5G Service?
q_28244.ground_truth: TLS is used for the security communication between the MSGin5G Server and the Application Server over the MSGin5G-3 interface.

q_28245.question: What action should the UE take when it diagnoses a "missing conditional IE" error or an "unexpected conditional IE" error, or when it receives a message containing at least one syntactically incorrect conditional IE?
q_28245.ground_truth: The UE should ignore the message and shall return a status message with cause #100 "conditional IE error".

q_28246.question: What does the term "shall" indicate in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
q_28246.ground_truth: In 3GPP technical specifications, the term "shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

q_28247.question: What is the purpose of the network slice usage control feature in the PCF?
q_28247.ground_truth: The network slice usage control feature in the PCF is used to check whether any of the UE's S-NSSAI(s) are subject to network slice usage control and provision network slice usage control information for each on-demand S-NSSAI of the UE's Allowed NSSAI.

q_28248.question: What is the function of the BWP ID field in the enhanced SP CSI reporting on PUCCH Activation/Deactivation MAC CE?
q_28248.ground_truth: The BWP ID field in the enhanced SP CSI reporting on PUCCH Activation/Deactivation MAC CE indicates a UL BWP for which the MAC CE applies as the codepoint of the DCI bandwidth part indicator field as specified in TS 38.212.

q_28249.question: What should the PCF do if the group is subject to data rate limitation and the Remaining Maximum Group Data Rate reaches a certain operator defined threshold?
q_28249.ground_truth: The PCF may apply a policy decision to strengthen the traffic restrictions for individual PDU Sessions accessing the 5G VN group and interact with the UDR accordingly.

q_28250.question: What are the different roles of the NPN operator in managing the SNPN-PLMN connectivity?
q_28250.ground_truth: The NPN operator can play the role of mobile network operator only, mobile network operator and the enterprise, or the vertical only. The mobile network operator is always responsible for managing the SNPN-PLMN connectivity.

q_28251.question: What is the meaning of the term "EPS" in the context of a bearer?
q_28251.ground_truth: An EPS bearer as defined in 3GPP TS 36.331.

q_28252.question: What should be the contents of the Speed element?
q_28252.ground_truth: The Speed element should contain a MinimumSpeed element and a MaximumSpeed element.

q_28253.question: Which types of data are included in the "RDN" choice type?
q_28253.ground_truth: The "RDN" choice type includes four choices: presentationAllowedAddress, presentationRestricted, numberNotAvailableDueToInterworking, and presentationRestrictedAddress.

q_28254.question: What is the role of the "imageattr" attribute in session setup when handling video?
q_28254.ground_truth: The "imageattr" attribute is used to determine the applicable bandwidth(s), RTP profile, video codec, profile, and level for video sessions. It should be supported in session setup for video.

q_28255.question: What happens when the TSN AF does not receive the MANAGE USER PLANE NODE COMPLETE message from the NW-TT due to transmission failure?
q_28255.ground_truth: The NW-TT considers the TSN AF-initiated User plane node management procedure complete, and no further action is taken to re-transmit or diagnose the error.

q_28256.question: In which 3GPP TS 23.501 subclause is the usage of reflective QoS not applicable for a PDU session with control plane only indication?
q_28256.ground_truth: 6.2.5.1.4 of 3GPP TS 23.501 specifies that reflective QoS is not applicable for a PDU session with control plane only indication.

q_28257.question: What must the SGM-S do upon reception of an CoAP PUT request where the CoAP URI of the request identifies an Individual VAL Group Document resource?
q_28257.ground_truth: Upon reception of an CoAP PUT request where the CoAP URI of the request identifies an Individual VAL Group Document resource, the SGM-S shall determine the identity of the sender of the received request and, if authorized, handle the request and update the VAL group document accordingly.

q_28258.question: What does the "Ti" field indicate in the TCI States Activation/Deactivation for UE-specific PDSCH MAC CE?
q_28258.ground_truth: The "Ti" field in the TCI States Activation/Deactivation for UE-specific PDSCH MAC CE indicates the activation/deactivation status of the TCI state with TCI-StateId i.

q_28259.question: What should the UE perform upon valid matches in the discovery query filter for PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY messages and meeting requirements for a match event?
q_28259.ground_truth: Instruct the lower layers to start monitoring for PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY messages as specified in 3GPP TS 38.331 and announce the corresponding ProSe response code in the PC5 interface as a response.

q_28260.question: When is High latency communication used in 3GPP system?
q_28260.ground_truth: High latency communication is used in 3GPP system to handle mobile terminated (MT) communication with UEs being unreachable while using power saving functions or due to discontinuous coverage. It is supported by extended buffering of downlink data in the UPF, SMF or NEF when a UE is using power saving functions in CM-IDLE state or in RRC_INACTIVE state.

q_28261.question: What is the procedure for handling MAP request primitives?
q_28261.ground_truth: The procedure for handling MAP request primitives involves activating a requesting SSM and sending a TC-INVOKE request to TCAP. When a confirm is received from TCAP, the requesting SSM forwards a MAP service confirm to the MAP-Service User.

q_28262.question: What should the SC UE do if it supports PS to CS SRVCC for originating calls in pre-alerting phase and successfully performs access transfer to the CS domain under specific conditions?
q_28262.ground_truth: The UE should continue the call in the CS domain in the "Mobile originating call proceeding" call state.

q_28263.question: What is the purpose of establishing a Layer-2 link between UE-1 and UE-2 for C2 connection over PC5?
q_28263.ground_truth: The purpose of establishing a Layer-2 link between UE-1 and UE-2 for C2 connection over PC5 is to enable communication between the two devices over the PC5 reference point.

q_28264.question: What actions should an SMF take when a UE is out of all MBS service areas for a location dependent MBS session?
q_28264.ground_truth: The SMF should reject the multicast session join request if the UE is out of all MBS service areas for the location dependent MBS session.

q_28265.question: What can be permitted after a feature has been frozen in terms of development?
q_28265.ground_truth: After a feature has been frozen, the only further development permitted is the essential correction of errors, the completion of the test and O&M specifications, and unavoidable adjustments required to cater for interworking with other features in the same Release.

q_28266.question: Which attribute specifies that the content of the element can be processed if it is laxly validated against the specified namespace?
q_28266.ground_truth: The "processContents" attribute, with the value "lax", specifies that the content of the element can be processed if it is laxly validated against the specified namespace.

q_28267.question: What response will the SNRM-S send if an unauthorized sender tries to access it?
q_28267.ground_truth: The SNRM-S will respond with an HTTP 403 (Forbidden) response message.

q_28268.question: What procedure should the UE follow when it has user data to send via the control plane after attaching with Control Plane CIoT EPS optimization for EPS services?
q_28268.ground_truth: The UE should initiate a Service request procedure for EPS services with Control Plane CIoT EPS optimization by sending a CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message with the user data in the ESM DATA TRANSPORT message.

q_28269.question: What is the function of V-UL-CL in routing traffic to V-PSA or V-UPF?
q_28269.ground_truth: V-UL-CL routes traffic to V-PSA if the IP packet has a destination address of V-EAS and routes other traffic to V-UPF.

q_28270.question: What should be the value of the "sec-agree" Unsupported header field in the 420 (Bad Extension) response if the P-CSCF supports GPRS-IMS-Bundled authentication?
