q_28740.ground_truth: The ProSeUserID-entry element should contain a DiscoveryGroupID element, a User-Info-ID element, and have an "index" attribute.

q_28741.question: What is the procedure for initiating a new QoS flow or modifying existing QoS flows for a source 5G ProSe layer-3 end UE?
q_28741.ground_truth: The source 5G ProSe layer-3 end UE provides the PC5 QoS flow context and PC5 QoS rules (if new or modified flows are added) to the 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-UE relay UE via the 5G ProSe direct link security mode control or modification procedure.

q_28742.question: What is the minimum number of PRS subframes per cell measurement, as specified in Section 9.1.21.17?
q_28742.ground_truth: is the minimum number of PRS subframes per cell measurement.

q_28743.question: What is the purpose of PIN-1 reference point?
q_28743.ground_truth: PIN-1 reference point is used for interactions related to enabling PINAPP between the Application client and the PIN client.

q_28744.question: What is the purpose of the "IMSI" and "IMSPrivateUserIdentity" information elements?
q_28744.ground_truth: The "IMSI" information element contains the IMSI that is associated with the IMS Public User Identity present in the request, while the "IMSPrivateUserIdentity" information element contains all IMS Private User Identities associated with the IMS Public User Identity present in the request. These information elements are used to identify the user's public and private user identities in the request.

q_28745.question: What should the controlling MCVideo function include in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body in the outgoing SIP MESSAGE request when sending a notification of the cancellation of an emergency alert?
q_28745.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function should include the <mcvideo-client-id> element with the MCVideo client ID that was included in the incoming SIP MESSAGE request, and set the <emergency-ind> element to a value of "false".

q_28746.question: What is the name of the enumerated type used to indicate the type of user equipment in the "SecondaryRATType" field?
q_28746.ground_truth: The enumerated type used to indicate the type of user equipment in the "SecondaryRATType" field is nR, which is short for Narrowband IoT.

q_28747.question: How can vendor-specific data be added to JSON objects in 3GPP 5GC APIs?
q_28747.ground_truth: Vendor-specific data can be added to JSON objects in 3GPP 5GC APIs by using the naming scheme "vendorSpecific-nnnnnn" for vendor-specific member names, where "nnnnnn" is a 6-digit string associated with a given vendor using the IANA-assigned "SMI Network Management Private Enterprise Codes". The content and usage of those vendor-specific member elements is not defined by any of the 3GPP Technical Specifications, and they can be of any type (objects, arrays, or simple types) allowed in the JSON specification.

q_28748.question: What should be the ratio of successful reported values for the test to pass in the context of SS-RSRQ measurement accuracy?
q_28748.ground_truth: The ratio of successful reported values should be more than 90%.

q_28749.question: What information does the enabling data contain for each MDA capability?
q_28749.ground_truth: The enabling data contains the necessary inputs for implementing each MDA capability, but it is not restrictive or mandatory to use the analytics inputs exactly the same as the provided enabling data for implementation. Other (additional or different) data are also allowed to facilitate the production of analytics outputs.

q_28750.question: What should a UE do upon receiving an IDENTITY REQUEST message with the identity type IE set to "SUCI" while in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode and with timer T3519 not running?
q_28750.ground_truth: The UE should generate a fresh SUCI, send an IDENTITY RESPONSE message containing the SUCI, start timer T3519, and store the value of the SUCI sent in the IDENTITY RESPONSE message.

q_28751.question: What is the difference between the CD service and Communication Forwarding services?
q_28751.ground_truth: The CD service enables the served user to respond to an incoming communication by requesting redirection of that communication to another user before the connection is established, while Communication Forwarding services, such as CFNRc, enable a user to have the network redirect all incoming communications when the user is not reachable to another user.

q_28752.question: What is the difference between IAB type 1-H and IAB type 1-O in terms of requirement sets?
q_28752.ground_truth: IAB type 1-H has a requirement set consisting of conducted requirements defined at individual TAB connectors and OTA requirements defined at RIB, while IAB type 1-O has a requirement set consisting only of OTA requirements defined at the RIB.

q_28753.question: What command is sent from a trusted non-3GPP access network to a 3GPP AAA Server to initiate SWa authentication and authorization procedures?

q_28754.question: What is the general definition of output intermodulation in 6.8.1.1 for repeaters?
q_28754.ground_truth: Output intermodulation requirement is a measure of the capability of the repeater to inhibit the generation of signals in its non-linear elements caused by the presence of the wanted signal and an interfering signal reaching the repeater via the output port.

q_28755.question: What is one possible additional header size used by the MP-DCCP-LL solution to encapsulate and transport PDUs over the user-plane?
q_28755.ground_truth: 61/65 Bytes, including generic header, MP-SEQ, MP-RTT, IP, UDP, and payload.

q_28756.question: What is the purpose of the "mbms-service-area-id" sub-element within the "location-information" element?
q_28756.ground_truth: The "mbms-service-area-id" sub-element within the "location-information" element specifies the MBMS service area id that the SLM-C is using.

q_28757.question: What should the UE do when either the validity timer of the ProSe application code or ProSe application code prefix expires in case of open 5G ProSe direct discovery or when the validity timer of the ProSe restricted code or ProSe restricted code prefix expires in case of restricted 5G ProSe direct discovery?
q_28757.ground_truth: The UE may instruct the lower layers to stop announcing UE procedure for 5G ProSe direct discovery, and if in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode, the UE shall trigger the corresponding procedure in lower layers as specified in 3GPP TS 38.331.

q_28758.question: What happens when a DRX Command MAC control element is received in this subframe?
q_28758.ground_truth: onDurationTimer is stopped and drx-InactivityTimer is stopped.

q_28759.question: What is the maximum time the UE is required to store the handover failure information in VarRLF-Report, after the failure is detected?
q_28759.ground_truth: 48 hours, upon power off or upon detach

q_28760.question: What is the effect of the DHCPv4 Address Allocation Procedure Indication message in the PMIP-based S5/S8 architecture?
q_28760.ground_truth: The DHCPv4 Address Allocation Procedure Indication message in the PMIP-based S5/S8 architecture is used to indicate that the UE has requested deferred IPv4 address allocation. In this case, the UE initiates the IPv4 address allocation using DHCPv4 after the default bearer establishment procedure is completed. If the IPv4 address lease expires or the UE releases the IPv4 address using DHCPv4, the PDN GW initiates the "PDN-GW initiated PDN-disconnection" procedure to delete the IPv4 address from the PDN connection and bearer contexts. The same IPv4 address shall not be allocated to another UE immediately.

q_28761.question: What should a UE do when it receives the ATTACH REJECT message including EMM cause #5 "IMEI not accepted" in a 3GPP network?
q_28761.ground_truth: Upon receiving the ATTACH REJECT message including EMM cause #5, the UE should enter the state EMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-IMSI.

q_28762.question: What is the maximum aggregate adjustment rate for a UE when the transmission timing error exceeds Te?
q_28762.ground_truth: The maximum aggregate adjustment rate for a UE is Tq per 200 ms for UL signals smaller or equal to 120 kHz, and 100 ms for UL signals larger or equal to 480 kHz.

q_28763.question: In case c) in subclause~5.4.5.2.1, what shall the UE set the Payload container type IE to if it needs to deliver a SLPP message payload?
q_28763.ground_truth: The UE shall set the Payload container type IE to "SLPP message container" in case c) in subclause~5.4.5.2.1.

q_28764.question: What entity selects the LMF for Ranging/SL positioning based on the service request and new factors?

q_28765.question: What should the NG-RAN node do if it receives the RRC Inactive Transition Report Request IE in the INITIAL CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message and sets it to "subsequent state transition report"?
q_28765.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node should send the RRC INACTIVE TRANSITION REPORT message to the AMF to report the RRC state of the UE when the UE enters or leaves RRC_INACTIVE state.

q_28766.question: What is the purpose of Spatial Anchors in XR and AR experiences?
q_28766.ground_truth: Spatial anchors establish the position of a 3D object in a shared XR or AR experience and are accurate within a limited space, allowing users to explore virtual content while maintaining the localization of the XR Viewer Pose.

q_28767.question: When is the DE-REGISTRATION REQUEST message (UE originating de-registration) sent with integrity protection but without ciphering?
q_28767.ground_truth: The DE-REGISTRATION REQUEST message (UE originating de-registration) is sent with integrity protection but without ciphering when it is sent as an initial NAS message.

q_28768.question: What should the UE set the reestablishmentCause to in the RRCConnectionReestablishmentRequest message if the re-establishment procedure was initiated due to handover failure?
q_28768.ground_truth: The UE should set the reestablishmentCause to the value 'handoverFailure'.

q_28769.question: In the context of the document, what does the term "conducted test methods and conformance requirements" refer to?
q_28769.ground_truth: The term "conducted test methods and conformance requirements" refers to the specific methods and requirements outlined in the document for evaluating the performance of an AAS BS in a controlled laboratory or shielded environment.

q_28770.question: How are security policies determined for 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay direct communication?
q_28770.ground_truth: Security policies for 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay direct communication include the signalling integrity protection policy, signalling ciphering policy, user plane integrity protection policy, and user plane ciphering policy.

q_28771.question: What is the expected result of a test in the context of network product evaluation?
q_28771.ground_truth: The expected result of a test in network product evaluation should show that the network product is acting as expected and cannot describe the behavior of other network entities or personnel in the environment of the network product.

q_28772.question: For AI/ML assisted positioning with timing information and drop parameters, what is the range of the positioning error when fine-tuning dataset size is 2.0% to 10.0% of the full training dataset size?
q_28772.ground_truth: The positioning error is (1.27-7.68) x E0,B.

q_28773.question: In case a) in subclause~5.4.5.2.3, what should the AMF do if it has received a PDU session routing context for the UE and the PDU session ID, and the Request type IE is not included or is included but set to other value than "initial request", "existing PDU session", "initial emergency request", "existing emergency PDU session", or "MA PDU request"?
q_28773.ground_truth: In case a) in subclause~5.4.5.2.3, the AMF shall send the 5GSM message, and the PDU session ID IE towards the SMF identified by the SMF ID of the PDU session routing context.

q_28774.question: When must the UE send aperiodic L1-SINR measurement reports?
q_28774.ground_truth: The UE should sends aperiodic L1-SINR measurement reports only if a DCI for triggering report has been received.

q_28775.question: What is the purpose of the Positioning Assistance Information Feedback procedure?
q_28775.ground_truth: The purpose of the Positioning Assistance Information Feedback procedure is to allow the gNB-DU to give feedback to the gNB-CU on positioning assistance information broadcasting. It uses non-UE-associated signaling.

q_28776.question: What should a participating MCVideo function do if it receives a SIP INVITE request for a terminating MCVideo client containing an emergency indication or imminent peril indication?
q_28776.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function should check for the presence of a Resource-Priority header field and perform further actions accordingly, generate an outgoing SIP re-INVITE request, include an SDP offer based on the SDP offer in the received SIP re-INVITE request, and send the SIP re-INVITE request towards the MCVideo client.

q_28777.question: Which System Information Block contains neighboring cell related information relevant only for intra-frequency cell re-selection?

q_28778.question: How can the Network Functions indicate the purpose of the certificate being requested in the CSR (Certificate Signing Request) to the operator CA?
q_28778.ground_truth: The Network Functions should be able to indicate the purpose of the certificate being requested in the CSR (Certificate Signing Request) to the operator CA by explicitly stating it in the CSR.

q_28779.question: What is the definition of relative CSI-RSRP accuracy in an inter-frequency case?
q_28779.ground_truth: It is the difference in CSI-RSRP measured from one cell on a frequency in FR2 compared to the CSI-RSRP measured from another cell on another frequency in FR2.

q_28780.question: What is the procedure when a first cell triggers the event in eventTriggered reporting type with no numberOfTriggeringCells and the entry condition is fulfilled for at least one applicable cell?
q_28780.ground_truth: Include a measurement reporting entry within the VarMeasReportList for this measId, set the numberOfReportsSent to 0, and include the concerned cell(s) in the cellsTriggeredList defined within the VarMeasReportList for this measId, as well as initiate the measurement reporting procedure, as specified in 5.5.5.

q_28781.question: What are the conditions for returning an authentication error due to insufficient memory space in EF_MSK during an MSK Update Mode procedure?
q_28781.ground_truth: The USIM returns an authentication error due to insufficient memory space in EF_MSK when there is no empty record available, the MSK update procedure involves a new MUK key, and the status word '9866' is returned. The ME should run an MSK Deletion Mode procedure to free up space in EF_MSK to avoid this error.

q_28782.question: What is defined as in-band blocking characteristics in clause 6.19?
q_28782.ground_truth: It is a measure of the receiver's ability to receive a wanted signal at its assigned channel at the TAB connector for NCR-MT type 1-C and NCR-MT type 1-H in the presence of an unwanted interferer, which is an NR signal for general blocking or an NR signal with one resource block for narrowband blocking.

q_28783.question: Which requirements in section 9 of the specification apply to intra-frequency RSRP, RSRQ, and RS-SINR measurements accuracy for PSCell and SCell?
q_28783.ground_truth: The requirements for intra-frequency RSRP, RSRQ, and RS-SINR measurements accuracy for PSCell and SCell are specified in section 9 of the specification.

q_28784.question: What happens if the UE has not re-selected Cell 1 or Cell 2 by the time T2 or T3 expires, respectively, in the area update procedure?
q_28784.ground_truth: If the UE has not re-selected Cell 1 or Cell 2 by the time T2 or T3 expires, then the procedure continues with the next step.

q_28785.question: Which type of E-UTRA UE does the test applicability specified in 4.3.2.2.1.2 apply to?
q_28785.ground_truth: The test applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 15 and forward, supporting EN-DC.

q_28786.question: What is the requirement for a non-3GPP access network when the UE is onboarding via Trusted non-3GPP access?
q_28786.ground_truth: The non-3GPP access network should advertise an Onboarding enabled indication.

q_28787.question: What action should the NG-RAN node take for each QoS flow in the QoS Flow Add or Modify Request List IE when the QoS Flow Add or Modify Request Item IE is included for an existing QoS Flow Identifier IE?
q_28787.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node should overwrite the content of the full QoS Flow Add or Modify Request Item IE for the existing QoS flow identified by the QoS Flow Identifier IE.

q_28788.question: What should the receiving UE do when it derives new PC5 QoS parameters for a destination layer-2 ID over PC5?
q_28788.ground_truth: The receiving UE should provide the new PC5 QoS parameters for that destination layer-2 ID to lower layers.

q_28789.question: What is the role of priority traffic in message throttling due to PFCP overload control?
q_28789.ground_truth: When performing message throttling, priority traffic (e.g. eMPS and emergency) has the highest priority. These PFCP requests are the last to be throttled, and the priority traffic is exempted from throttling unless necessary to achieve the requested traffic reduction.

q_28790.question: What are the conditions for cell reselection to a cell on a higher absolute priority layer than the camped frequency?
q_28790.ground_truth: Cell reselection to a cell on a higher absolute priority layer than the camped frequency shall be performed if criterion 1 is fulfilled, which is when the SrxlevnonServingCell,x of a cell on an evaluated higher absolute priority layer is greater than Threshx,high during a time interval Treselection.

q_28791.question: What functions does the MC service server have to support in order to enable the support of MC service group communications over MBS sessions?
q_28791.ground_truth: The MC service server is required to support the different 5G MBS service functionalities to enable the support of MC service group communications over MBS sessions.

q_28792.question: What is the role of the PSER in 5G network services and how is it related to the PSDB?
q_28792.ground_truth: PSER defines an upper bound for non-congestion-related packet losses. In uncongested scenarios, PDU-Sets should not experience a delay exceeding the 5QI's PSDB. For GBR QoS Flows with Delay-critical GBR resource type, a PDU-Set delayed more than PSDB is counted as lost, and included in the PSER unless the QoS Flow is exceeding the GFBR.

q_28793.question: What is the objective of the OTA performance requirements for PUCCH format 0?
q_28793.ground_truth: The objective of the OTA performance requirements for PUCCH format 0 is to verify the receiver's ability to detect ACK under multipath fading propagation conditions for a given SNR.

q_28794.question: How does the transmission control interface determine the effective priority level of the Transmission request?
q_28794.ground_truth: The effective priority level is determined using the transmission priority and call type. If the MCVideo client negotiated transmission priority, the lower of the transmission priority included in the Transmission Media Request message and the negotiated maximum transmission priority is used. Otherwise, the default priority is used, based on the negotiation status of the client and the call type (normal call, emergency call, etc.).

q_28795.question: What is the procedure that involves searching for the BSIC and decoding the BSIC for the first time when there is no knowledge about the relative timing between the E-UTRAN FDD and GSM cells?

q_28796.question: What happens to the timer T3396 if an emergency PDN connection is requested while it is already running or deactivated?
q_28796.ground_truth: It does not affect the ability of the UE to request an emergency PDN connection.

q_28797.question: What should the SM entity do when it receives the DEACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message from the network in the GSM case?
q_28797.ground_truth: The SM entity should locally release the related LLC links and acknowledge the network with the DEACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT ACCEPT message.

q_28798.question: What information must the MN provide in step 1 of the Conditional SN Addition procedure when requesting resources for SN terminated bearers?
q_28798.ground_truth: The MN must provide a list of available DRB IDs for SN terminated bearers and Xn-U TNL address information for the respective DRB.

q_28799.question: What address does the UE use to discover the UDP port of the PMF in the UPF when establishing an MA PDU session of IPv4 or IPv4v6 PDU session type?
q_28799.ground_truth: The UE discovers the UDP port of the PMF in the UPF using the source port field of an UDP/IPv4 packet, received via the MA PDU session, with the destination port field set to the UDP port of the PMF in the UPF and the destination address field set to the IPv4 address of the PMF in the UPF.

q_28800.question: What is the difference between the Certificate-based and Identity-based approaches in the UE-to-UE relay hop-by-hop security establishment procedure?
q_28800.ground_truth: In the Certificate-based approach, the security materials include the UE's certificate and the root CA certificate(s), which allows the UE to verify the certificates of other UEs. In contrast, the Identity-based approach includes the UE's identity, secret signing key (SSK), public validation token (PVT), and KMS public authentication key(s) (KPAK), which allows the UE to verify the signatures of other UEs in the hop-by-hop security establishment procedure.

q_28801.question: When should the target eNB include the Direct Forwarding Path Availability IE in the Target eNB to Source eNB Transparent Container IE within the HANDOVER REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message?
q_28801.ground_truth: The target eNB should include the Direct Forwarding Path Availability IE in the Target eNB to Source eNB Transparent Container IE within the HANDOVER REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message if it can be used to decide whether direct forwarding path is available between the target eNB and this source RAN node, and if such direct forwarding path is available.

q_28802.question: What should UE1 and UE2 negotiate during PC5 connection setup when ProSe service allowed path switching is used?
q_28802.ground_truth: UE1 and UE2 negotiate QoS within the provisioned PC5 QoS parameters to be allowed for path switching.

q_28803.question: What is the function of the Non-IP Type header in the Non-IP PDCP SDU?
q_28803.ground_truth: The Non-IP Type header in the Non-IP PDCP SDU indicates the V2X message family used by the application layer.

q_28804.question: What is required for users connected to an IMS network to communicate with users on a separate addressing range?
q_28804.ground_truth: NA(P)T functionality should be set at the border of the IMS network to enable communication with users on a separate addressing range.

q_28805.question: Which field in the ReferenceTime-r16 IEs contains the refDays-r16?

q_28806.question: Which component of the F1-C signalling transport deployment is used for the Initial Registration with separate per-PLMN signalling?
q_28806.ground_truth: Each F1-C interface instance uses a separate signalling transport or shares signalling transport with other F1-C interface instances.

q_28807.question: What is the minimum mean power that should be applied to the single antenna port for UE category NB1 and NB2 to meet the reference sensitivity power level requirement?
q_28807.ground_truth: The minimum mean power that should be applied to the single antenna port for UE category NB1 and NB2 to meet the reference sensitivity power level requirement is the minimum power at which the throughput of the UE meets or exceeds the requirements for the specified reference measurement channel.

q_28808.question: What should the UE do upon failing to establish the RRC connection for mobile originating signalling if both timers T302 and T305 are not running and a random number is lower than the value indicated by ac-BarringFactor included in ac-BarringForMO-Signalling?
q_28808.ground_truth: Consider access to the cell as not barred.

q_28809.question: What is the purpose of using the PDU Set ID in the GTP-U header?
q_28809.ground_truth: The PDU Set ID in the GTP-U header is used to identify a PDU set and indicate its transmission status between UPF and RAN.

q_28810.question: What is the role of the AF in providing assistance information for power savings in NG-RAN?
q_28810.ground_truth: The AF is responsible for providing the set of periodicities and the associated jitter ranges associated with a specific AF session, which would assist NG-RAN in determining the appropriate power saving scheme for XR applications.

q_28811.question: What is one of the functions of the Session Stop indicator in the Accounting-Request STOP message in avoiding race conditions?
q_28811.ground_truth: The Session Stop indicator indicates that the PDU session is terminated and the IPv4 address and/or IPv6 prefix and GTP tunnel can be released. The DN-AAA server shall not assume the PDU session terminated until an Accounting-Request STOP with the Session Stop indicator is received.

q_28812.question: What is the function of the Restricted Security parameter in ProSe Direct Discovery?
q_28812.ground_truth: The Restricted Security parameter contains security information elements for ProSe Direct Discovery communication between UEs.

q_28813.question: What is the maximum number of entries in 'stts', 'stsc', and 'stco' boxes if all movie data is contained in Movie Fragments in a 3GP file that conforms to the Adaptive-Streaming profile?
q_28813.ground_truth: The maximum number of entries in these boxes should be set to 0, as all movie data should be contained in Movie Fragments.

q_28814.question: How does a participating MCPTT function determine the MCPTT ID of the calling user from the SIP MESSAGE request?
q_28814.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT function shall determine the MCPTT ID of the calling user from the public user identity in the P-Asserted-Identity header field of the SIP MESSAGE request.

q_28815.question: What is the maximum throughput that can be indicated by peak throughput class 9?

q_28816.question: What is the requirement for a UE to get authorization to use V2X communications over PC5 reference point on a per PLMN basis in the serving PLMN?
q_28816.ground_truth: The UE gets authorization from the V2X Control Function in the HPLMN, which requests authorization information from the V2X Control Function of the serving PLMN. The final authorization information is then informed to the UE.

q_28817.question: What protocols can be used for e2ae protection of real-time traffic in IMS?
q_28817.ground_truth: DTLS-SRTP or SDP Security Descriptions (SDES) can be used for e2ae protection of real-time traffic in IMS.

q_28818.question: What action does the UE perform when DRBs are re-established during inter-RAT handover?
q_28818.ground_truth: The UE re-establishes the RLC entity for each DRB that is not suspended.

q_28819.question: What should the MCData client do when it receives a SIP re-INVITE request within a pre-established session and the pre-established session does not have an associated MCData session, and the <mcdata-communication-state> element in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body of the SIP re-INVITE request is set to a value of "establish-request"?
q_28819.ground_truth: If the <request-type> element in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body of the SIP re-INVITE request is set to a value of "one-to-one-sds", the MCData client should follow the procedures in clause 9.2.3.2.4. If the <request-type> element is set to a value of "one-to-one-sds-session", the MCData client should follow the procedures in clause 9.2.4.2.4.

q_28820.question: What should a UE do when it detects an inter-RAT E-UTRAN cell that is indicated as not allowed in the measurement control system information of the serving cell?
q_28820.ground_truth: The UE is not required to perform measurements on that cell.

q_28821.question: What is the purpose of the PDN DISCONNECT REJECT message?
q_28821.ground_truth: This message is sent by the network to the UE to reject release of a PDN connection.

q_28822.question: What is the exception requirement for both NR and E-UTRA for certain test cases?
q_28822.ground_truth: The exception requirement for both NR and E-UTRA for certain test cases is that the LTE anchor agnostic approach is not applied, and E-UTRA test point analysis is included, with E-UTRA measurements being performed.

q_28823.question: What is the minimum number of channel bandwidths that need to be supported by an E-UTRA BS for the additional blocking requirement to be applicable for the protection of E-UTRA BS or NB-IoT receivers when other base stations are co-located?
q_28823.ground_truth: The requirement is applicable to all channel bandwidths supported by the E-UTRA BS.

q_28824.question: In TS 36.331, clause 5.5.4.3, what should the UE do when the entering condition for an event is fulfilled and the VarMeasReportList does not include a measurement reporting entry for this measId?
q_28824.ground_truth: The UE should include a measurement reporting entry within the VarMeasReportList for this measId, set the numberOfReportsSent to 0, include the concerned cell(s) in the cellsTriggeredList, and initiate the measurement reporting procedure.

q_28825.question: What action does eNB2 take upon receipt of a RESET REQUEST message?
q_28825.ground_truth: eNB2 aborts any other ongoing procedures over X2 between eNB1 and eNB2, deletes all the context information related to eNB1, and releases the corresponding resources. After completing the release of the resources, eNB2 responds with a RESET RESPONSE message.

q_28826.question: What are two tasks involved in media content analysis?
q_28826.ground_truth: Object detection and face recognition are two tasks involved in media content analysis.

q_28827.question: What is the effect of the current test plan on inter-frequency and inter-RAT system information combinations?
q_28827.ground_truth: The current test plan excludes inter-frequency and inter-RAT test cases due to limitations in RAN4. Inter-frequency, inter-RAT system information combinations are not considered.

q_28828.question: What attribute should be provided if identification of network area(s) is required in the QoS sustainability feature?
q_28828.ground_truth: The "networkArea" attribute should be provided if identification of network area(s) is required in the QoS sustainability feature.

q_28829.question: What is the less stringent requirement of the two requirements that the UE has to meet during the transition time interval?
q_28829.ground_truth: The UE has to meet the less stringent requirement of the two requirements corresponding to the first state and the second state during the transition time interval.

q_28830.question: What does the SCEF check if the SCEF EPS bearer context corresponding to the External Identifier and SCS/AS Identifier is found?
q_28830.ground_truth: The SCEF checks whether the SCS/AS is authorized to send NIDD requests and that the SCS/AS has not exceeded its rate control quota or rate of data submission to the SCEF EPS bearer.

q_28831.question: What should the NF service consumer do if it receives a "Retry-After" HTTP header field?
q_28831.ground_truth: The NF service consumer shall not send the same service information to the PCF again until the retry interval has elapsed.

q_28832.question: What is required so that the majority of the UEs within a network can use the LCS feature without compromising the radio transmission or signaling capabilities of the E-UTRAN?
q_28832.ground_truth: The LCS feature should be network-implementation-dependent and the uncertainty may vary between networks as well as from one area within a network to another.

q_28833.question: What is the purpose of setting timeSinceSHR in VarSuccessHO-Report?
q_28833.ground_truth: It is set to the time that elapsed since the execution of the associated mobilityFromNRCommand.

q_28834.question: What should the UE do if it is registered to a PLMN or SNPN and has a stored list of "non-allowed tracking areas" while the current TAI is not in that list?
q_28834.ground_truth: The UE is allowed to initiate any 5GMM and 5GSM procedures and stay in or enter the state 5GMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE.

q_28835.question: When is the Back-off timer value information element used in the 3GPP TS 24.008 standard?
q_28835.ground_truth: The network may include the Back-off timer value IE if the SM cause is not #65 "maximum number of PDP contexts reached", to request a minimum time interval before procedure retry is allowed.

q_28836.question: Which entity is responsible for managing the UE access control via MBSR in the 5GS?
q_28836.ground_truth: The CN, RAN, and UE manage the UE access control during the CM-CONNECTED mobility, while the CN and RAN manage the access control via MBSR during the CM-CONNECTED mobility.

q_28837.question: What is the function of the Registration with AMF re-allocation procedure during a Registration procedure?
q_28837.ground_truth: The Registration with AMF re-allocation procedure is used to reroute the NAS message of the UE to the target AMF during a Registration procedure if the initial AMF is not the appropriate AMF to serve the UE.

q_28838.question: What is the goal of standardising the automated certificate management protocol and procedures within intra-PLMN 5G SBA?
q_28838.ground_truth: The goal is to achieve a consistent and secure model for certificate management within 5G SBA, support mutual TLS in slicing, enable cross-certification considerations, and adhere to principles for Chain of Trust of Certificate Authorities hierarchies and security of CA's cryptographic private key.

q_28839.question: What is the AT command used to define a media profile offering both audio and video?

q_28840.question: What information is specified by the <minimum-interval-length> element in the XML schema?
q_28840.ground_truth: The <minimum-interval-length> element in the XML schema specifies the interval time between consecutive reports. The value is given in seconds and defaults to 0 if absent.

q_28841.question: What should the NEF check before forwarding an MBS TMGI(s) allocation request to the MB-SMF?
q_28841.ground_truth: The NEF should check whether the AF is authorized to perform the MBS TMGI(s) allocation request, whether the MBS Service Area is supported, and whether the MBS Service Area can be covered by the network.

q_28842.question: What is the role of the NSCE Server with respect to other network elements, such as VAL Servers and other NSCE Servers?
q_28842.ground_truth: The NSCE Server provides NSCE application layer support functions to VAL Servers and other NSCE Servers over reference points NSCE-S and NSCE-E, respectively. This includes network slice policy management, network slice related performance and analytics monitoring management, network slice adaptation management, network slice related communication services management, and network slice information retrieval and delivery management.

q_28843.question: What should the AF do when an SDI is received within the AF session signalling?
q_28843.ground_truth: The AF shall perform mapping from the SDI received within the AF session signalling to service information passed to the PCF over the Rx or N5 interface.

q_28844.question: How are security and privacy maintained in communication between UEs using a UE-to-UE Relay?
q_28844.ground_truth: Security and privacy are maintained by using a unique link with a UE-to-UE Relay and establishing a secure end-to-end PC5 unicast link between peer UEs, with the UE-to-UE Relay forwarding messages transparently without the ability to read or replay them. The identity information of UEs is protected using additional security-related parameters and procedures.

q_28845.question: What is the procedure for supporting Edge Computing in a 5G system?
q_28845.ground_truth: The procedure for supporting Edge Computing in a 5G system includes the discovery and re-discovery of Edge Application Servers, edge relocation, network exposure to Edge Application Servers, support of 3GPP application layer architecture, and support of AF guidance to PCF determination of proper URSP rules.

q_28846.question: Which message is sent by the UE to the network to request the modification of a dedicated bearer resource?

q_28847.question: When does the PCF deregister at the BSF from being the PCF serving the MBS Session?
q_28847.ground_truth: The PCF may deregister at the BSF from being the PCF serving the MBS Session when the targeted MBS Policy Association is successfully deleted and for a location-dependent MBS service, this is the last MBS Policy Association associated to the location-dependent MBS service (i.e., associated to the corresponding MBS Session ID).

q_28848.question: How many inter-RAT (UTRAN) cells does the ME report for each monitored frequency in the inter-RAT (UTRAN) measurements?
q_28848.ground_truth: The ME reports up to 8 strongest inter-RAT UTRAN cells per monitored frequency in the inter-RAT (UTRAN) measurements.

q_28849.question: Which IP version does the outer GTPv1-U packet layer support as defined in 3GPP TS 23.060?
q_28849.ground_truth: The outer GTPv1-U packet layer supports IPv4 as defined by IETF RFC 791 and should support IPv6 as defined by IETF RFC 8200.

q_28850.question: What might the source MME/SGSN need to do if it supports one or more of the CIoT optimization features and the UE does not have any EPS bearer context(s) for SGi IP or Non-IP PDN connections that can be transferred to the target serving node?
q_28850.ground_truth: In this case, the source MME/SGSN should not proceed with the Forward Relocation Request procedure and should make sure that the target serving node supports SGi Non-IP or SCEF Non-IP PDN connections before transferring EPS bearer context(s).

q_28851.question: What should the controlling MCPTT function do upon receiving a SIP INVITE request with an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-location-info+xml MIME body that contains a <location-info> root element with a <Report> element?
q_28851.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function can remember the location information contained in the <location-info> root element.

q_28852.question: What should the UE do if there are LADN DNNs which are included in the LADN indication IE but not in the LADN information and Extended LADN information in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message?
q_28852.ground_truth: The UE considers such LADN DNNs as not available in the current registration area.

q_28853.question: What is the data type of the "allow-activate-adhoc-group-emergency-alert" element in the 3GPP specification?
q_28853.ground_truth: The "allow-activate-adhoc-group-emergency-alert" element is a Boolean data type in the 3GPP specification.

q_28854.question: What is the purpose of the Partial Failure feature in TWAN?
q_28854.ground_truth: The Partial Failure feature in TWAN is used to handle failures in a specific PDN connection without affecting the entire TWAN.

q_28855.question: In what scenario does the MCPTT client set the MCPTT private emergency alert state to "MPEA 4: emergency-alert-cancel-pending"?
q_28855.ground_truth: The MCPTT client sets the MCPTT private emergency alert state to "MPEA 4: emergency-alert-cancel-pending" when the MCPTT user has indicated that they want to cancel both an MCPTT emergency private call and an MCPTT emergency alert.

q_28856.question: What action should the S-CSCF take if the received authentication challenge response and the expected authentication challenge response do not match in a REGISTER request?
q_28856.ground_truth: The S-CSCF shall reject the REGISTER request by generating a 401 (Unauthorized) response.

q_28857.question: Which modal verb in a 3GPP Technical Specification indicates a mandatory requirement to do something?
q_28857.ground_truth: The modal verb "shall" in a 3GPP Technical Specification indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

q_28858.question: What is the action taken by the HARQ process when it receives a HARQ ACK alone?
q_28858.ground_truth: When the HARQ process receives a HARQ ACK alone, it keeps the data in the HARQ buffer.

q_28859.question: What should the UE inform upper layers about if AS security is not started and radio link failure occurs before the successful delivery of ULInformationTransfer messages has been confirmed by lower layers?
q_28859.ground_truth: The UE shall inform upper layers about the possible failure to deliver the information contained in the concerned ULInformationTransfer messages, unless the messages include dedicatedInfoF1c and no dedicatedInfoType is included.

q_28860.question: What is the purpose of synchronizing supplementary services settings in different domains?
q_28860.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure that the most recent changes applied in one domain are propagated to the other domain, and to make the busy state of the UE available in both domains.

q_28861.question: What is the use of URSP Compliance Request (UCR) in Solution #7 for URSP Compliance Verification?
q_28861.ground_truth: In Solution #7 for URSP Compliance Verification, the UE-PCF can request the UE to assist the URSP compliance by sending URSP Compliance Request (UCR) together with URSP rules with the UE Policy Container. The UCR indicates the UE to report the URSP Rule Identifier (URID) associated URSP rule that causes the establishment of the PDU Session. If the UE receives the UCR, the UE includes the URID in the PDU Session Establishment request when initiating a PDU Session caused by the URSP rule. The UE-PCF uses this URID to verify whether the PDU Session Establishment request is compliant with the URSP rule.

q_28862.question: What entity is responsible for reporting TSC management information events directly to a TSN AF or TSCTSF?
q_28862.ground_truth: A UPF (User Plane Function) that supports the DRTSC (Direct Reporting of TSC management information events) feature.

q_28863.question: What is the role of the LMF in the Measurement procedure if the NG-RAN node is a gNB?
q_28863.ground_truth: The LMF initiates the Measurement procedure by sending a MEASUREMENT REQUEST message to the NG-RAN node, requesting specific positioning measurements from the indicated TRP(s).

q_28864.question: What is the definition of a Gateway UE in the context of 3GPP system charging and accounting?
q_28864.ground_truth: A Gateway UE is a UE that acts as a gateway, providing access to and from the 3GPP network for one or more non-3GPP devices that are connected to the gateway UE.

q_28865.question: What is a "Node Feature" in the context of GTPv2?
q_28865.ground_truth: A "Node Feature" is a function extending the base GTPv2 functionality that has a significant meaning to the operation of GTPv2, and is supported homogeneously for all GTP tunnels, UEs, and PDN connections.

q_28866.question: What should the UE do if it receives an AUTHENTICATION REJECT message without integrity protection and neither timer T3516 nor T3520 is running?
q_28866.ground_truth: The UE should discard the AUTHENTICATION REJECT message and may request RRC to locally release the RRC connection, treating the active cell as barred.

q_28867.question: What is the definition of the E1AP-PROTOCOL-IES for MCBearerContextSetupResponse?
q_28867.ground_truth: The E1AP-PROTOCOL-IES for MCBearerContextSetupResponse is a set of protocol IE definitions for the MC Bearer Context Setup Response message. It contains definitions for the following IEs: id-GNB-CU-CP-MBS-E1AP-ID, id-GNB-CU-UP-MBS-E1AP-ID, id-MCBearerContextToSetupResponse, and id-CriticalityDiagnostics.

q_28868.question: What should the S-CSCF do when the UE re-authenticates after the S-CSCF processed the registration request?
q_28868.ground_truth: After processing the registration request, the S-CSCF shall wait for the user to re-authenticate.

q_28869.question: What is the purpose of the Network Slice Instance Identifier (NSI ID)?
q_28869.ground_truth: The NSI ID uniquely identifies a Network Slice Instance (NSI) within a PLMN or SNPN, and it is used when multiple NSIs of a same Network Slice are deployed and need to be differentiated in the 5GC.

q_28870.question: What is the role of the UE in the authentication process with the ECS/EES?
q_28870.ground_truth: The UE is responsible for authenticating the EEC with a method out of the scope of the solution. The UE and HPLMN run primary authentication and derive KAKMA, which is used to authenticate the EEC and UE. The EEC then sends a session establishment request to the ECS/EES, including the parameters A-KID and E(KAF, EEC-ID).

q_28871.question: What is the objective of Solution #4 in addressing Network Slice Service continuity?
q_28871.ground_truth: The objective of Solution #4 is to allow PDU Session establishment on a compatible network slice if the initially required network slice is not available or overloaded.

q_28872.question: In the described scenario, what is the purpose of the PIN service discovery request and response?
q_28872.ground_truth: The PIN service discovery request is sent by the PINE A to the PEMC requesting a list of services. The PEMC performs an authorization check and provides the list of PINE endpoint(s) offering the requested services in the PIN service discovery response.

q_28873.question: What is the condition for a test to pass for E-UTRAN HD-FDD Timing Advance Adjustment Accuracy Test for CE UE in CEModeB?
q_28873.ground_truth: The test passes if the total number of successful tests is more than 90% of the cases with a confidence level of 95%.

q_28874.question: How does the UE mitigate replay attacks in this procedure?
q_28874.ground_truth: The UE mitigates replay attacks by verifying the freshness of the message through comparing the timer counter in the message against UE local time. If the time difference is within a tolerant window, the message is considered fresh, otherwise, the message is considered expired.

q_28875.question: How does the MC service client switch from unicast delivery to broadcast MBS session reception after re-entering the broadcast service area?
q_28875.ground_truth: Based on the MapGroupToSessionStream received before, the MC service client receives the DL MC service via both the broadcast MBS session and the unicast delivery. If any information about the broadcast MBS session stream has changed, the MC service server provides the MapGroupToSessionStream again.

q_28876.question: What is the purpose of the N15 reference point in the 5G System?
q_28876.ground_truth: The N15 reference point is used by the Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF) to access the Access and Mobility Policy Control Service at the PCF.

q_28877.question: What is the procedure to measure the code domain power of the DPCH under test using TM2 in the UTRA FDD test method?
q_28877.ground_truth: The code domain power of the DPCH under test is set to Pmax,c,TABC - 3 dB, and the code domain power of the code channel under test is measured using the method defined in annex E in TS~25.141.

q_28878.question: What is the length of the Date and time information element?
q_28878.ground_truth: The Date and time information element is a type 3 information element with a length of 5 octets.

q_28879.question: What is the role of the LMISF in the IMS signalling and media packet delivery process?
q_28879.ground_truth: The LMISF is responsible for capturing and delivering selective user plane packets of inbound roaming UEs in the IMS signalling and media.

q_28880.question: When does the time start for performing RSTD measurements in DL-TDOA in NR for deferred MT-LR, if the associated event(s) is not "Periodic Location"?
q_28880.ground_truth: The time starts from the first MG instance aligned with a DL PRS resource(s) in the assistance data after the associated event(s) occurs.

q_28881.question: What should the TLSb entity do if it cannot successfully perform the revocation check of the cross-certificate for Operator A's TLS client CA?
q_28881.ground_truth: It shall treat this as an error and abort the TLS handshake.

q_28882.question: What authentication method is used to authenticate UEs when establishing a UE-initiated IPsec tunnel?
q_28882.ground_truth: EAP-AKA, as specified in RFC 4187, within IKEv2, as specified in RFC 5996, is used to authenticate UEs.

q_28883.question: Which clause of 3GPP TS 36.133 relates to the TDD RSRP relative accuracy measurement requirements?

q_28884.question: What is the requirement for the difference between CRS EPRE and the MBSFN RS EPRE for FDD with FeMBMS for subcarrier spacing as 15kHz?
q_28884.ground_truth: The difference between CRS EPRE and the MBSFN RS EPRE for FDD with FeMBMS for subcarrier spacing as 15kHz should be set to 0 dB, as the UE demodulation performance might be different when this condition is not met.

q_28885.question: What is the purpose of step 14-25 in the session origination with PSTN termination procedure?
q_28885.ground_truth: This step involves the generation of the ringing message by the terminating endpoint, which is then forwarded to the originator via the session path. Upon answer by the destination party, a SIP 200-OK final response is returned to the originating endpoint, signaling the successful establishment of the session.

q_28886.question: What is the benefit of using two sets of security materials in Solution #23 and Solution #24?
q_28886.ground_truth: Using two sets of security materials in Solution #23 and Solution #24 prevents security threats that may arise if a source UE (or a target UE) that is authorized to use the RSC for U2U discovery can decrypt and manipulate any direct discovery sets that are delivered using the same RSC. The Announcement message and the direct discovery set(s) are protected using the respective set of security materials to ensure that only the intended UE can access the information.

q_28887.question: What is the scope of the NB-IoT control plane CIoT EPS optimization for EPS in TS 36.331?
q_28887.ground_truth: The NB-IoT control plane CIoT EPS optimization for EPS in TS 36.331 covers the features relevant to Control Plane CIoT EPS optimization for EPS services, including Attach for Control Plane CIoT EPS optimization for EPS services, UE and Network transmission of user data via the control plane for non-SMS service, UE and Network transmission of SMS via the control plane, PDN handling during attach, EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection, RRC connection establishment, UE connection release, and section T22 in TS 36.331.

q_28888.question: What should the UE do if the T3346 value in the DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message is not zero or deactivated and the request is for 3GPP access only or for both 3GPP and non-3GPP access in single-registration mode?
q_28888.ground_truth: The UE should set the EPS update status to EU2 NOT UPDATED, reset the attach attempt counter, and enter the state EMM-DEREGISTERED.

q_28889.question: What is the test frequency limit for the NR SA FR2 interruptions during the measurement on the deactivated NR SCC in section 7.5.2.1?
q_28889.ground_truth: The test frequency limit for the NR SA FR2 interruptions during the measurement on the deactivated NR SCC in section 7.5.2.1 is 40.8 GHz.

q_28890.question: In which scenarios is a GPRS attach made by a GPRS MS?
q_28890.ground_truth: A GPRS attach is made by a GPRS MS when activated and capable of services which require registration, but only if the selected PLMN is not contained in the list of "forbidden PLMNs for GPRS service".

q_28891.question: What type of network can the 5G-RG support when connected to EPC and EPC interworking is allowed?

q_28892.question: What action should the MCData client take if it receives a SIP REFER request for an emergency group communication or an imminent peril group communication and the MCData emergency group communication state is set to "MDEGC 2: emergency-call-requested"?
q_28892.ground_truth: The MCData client should set the MCData client emergency group state of the group to "MDEG 2: in-progress" and the MCData emergency group communication state to "MDEGC 3: emergency-call-granted".

q_28893.question: What should the UE include in the locationInfo if detailed location information is available?
q_28893.ground_truth: If detailed location information is available, the UE should include the locationCoordinates and the horizontalVelocity in the locationInfo.

q_28894.question: What is one of the challenges with digital cancellation in a mMIMO system for a wide area base station implementation?
q_28894.ground_truth: The complexity of the cancellation results in high energy consumption, which can easily become extreme with a large number of TRXs.

q_28895.question: What is the role of the ASPro (Application Service Provider) in the PFD Management service within the 5G System?
q_28895.ground_truth: The ASPro manages the PFDs (Packet Flow Descriptions) used for application detection filters in the SMF and UPF through the NEF (PFDF). The ASPro provisions, updates, and deletes PFDs for each application identifier maintained in the SMF/UPF.

q_28896.question: What JSON object is used to represent the content of the payload of the HTTP message in SEPP messages?

q_28897.question: Which MM sublayer state on the network side is compatible with the IDLE state of the MM sublayer on the mobile station side?
q_28897.ground_truth: The IDLE state on the network side is compatible with the IDLE state on the mobile station side.

q_28898.question: When does the SMF use the N4 Association Setup or Update procedures to provision the UPF to report the clock drifting?
q_28898.ground_truth: The SMF uses the N4 Association Setup or Update procedures to provision the UPF to report the clock drifting if the "TimeSensitiveCommunication" feature is supported and the "tscaiTimeDom" attribute is not included in the PCC rule.

q_28899.question: What are the two possible methods for providing PER/ARP of associated QoS flow to SMF for determining whether a UE can be sent to RRC Inactive state to receive multicast MBS session data?
q_28899.ground_truth: The two possible methods are: (1) via PCF, where the AF provides the flow description, PER to PCF, and PCF provides the rule to SMF, and (2) similar with UDM/UDR based solution, where the AF provides the (PER/ARP and related UE list) for the MBS session to UDM/UDM, and the SMF obtains these information.

q_28900.question: What is the effect of the activation of the AT command +CAPPLEVMC in the UE?
q_28900.ground_truth: The activation of the AT command +CAPPLEVMC in the UE results in the provisioning of measurement reporting from the lower layers to the application within the UE by an unsolicited result code +CAPPLEVMC.

q_28901.question: What is the contiguous transmission bandwidth in the context of IAB channel bandwidth?

q_28902.question: What condition warrants a gNB-CU-CP initiated MC Bearer Context Release procedure?
q_28902.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-UP can request the gNB-CU-CP to trigger the release of MBS session resources for a multicast MBS session by sending the MC BEARER CONTEXT RELEASE REQUEST message.

q_28903.question: What part of the SIP NOTIFY request includes the generated application/pidf+xml MIME body indicating per-group dynamic data?

q_28904.question: What information is carried by the <coverage> element?
q_28904.ground_truth: The <coverage> element carries information whether the UE was in E-UTRAN coverage or out of E-UTRAN coverage, with a mandatory "in-coverage" attribute, optional "timestamp" attribute, <location> elements, <anyExt> elements, and elements from other namespaces defined in future releases.

q_28905.question: What should a UE do when the SSB for RLM, BFD, CBD or L1-RSRP measurement is within the active BWP and has a different SCS than CSI-RS for CBD measurement in FR1?
q_28905.ground_truth: If the UE supports simultaneousRxDataSSB-DiffNumerology, it can perform CSI-RS based CBD measurement without restrictions. Otherwise, it is required to measure either one of CSI-RS for CBD measurement and SSB with a longer measurement period.

q_28906.question: What should the UE do if the message has been successfully integrity checked by the NAS and the message was received by a UE that has not indicated support for CIoT optimizations or received by a UE over non-3GPP access?
q_28906.ground_truth: The UE shall treat it as an abnormal case and follow the behavior specified in subclause 5.5.1.3.7.

q_28907.question: What is the size of the transport block used to calculate the CRC parity bits?
q_28907.ground_truth: The size of the transport block used to calculate the CRC parity bits is denoted by A.

q_28908.question: In the MTSI-based architecture extension, what is the purpose of the data channel server?
q_28908.ground_truth: The data channel server provides rich user experiences by enabling features such as sitting side by side on a bench.

q_28909.question: What is the process followed by a SL Positioning Client UE to invoke the ranging service of a Reference UE?
q_28909.ground_truth: A SL Positioning Client UE discovers and selects a Reference UE, performs the direct link establishment procedure with the Assistant UE, sends a ranging service request to the Assistant UE via the PC5 message to request the Ranging estimation/result between UE#1 and UE#2, and receives the Ranging service response, which includes the Ranging result between UE#1 and UE#2.

q_28910.question: What should the MCPTT client do if it receives a SIP 480 (Temporarily Unavailable) response with warning text set to "175 call is forwarded"?
q_28910.ground_truth: If the MCPTT client receives a SIP MESSAGE request for forwarding private call within a time decided by the client implementation, the MCPTT client shall follow the actions specified in clause~11.1.9.2.2. If it does not receive a SIP MESSAGE request for forwarding private call within that time, the MCPTT client shall generate a SIP MESSAGE request with specific header fields and a MIME body.

q_28911.question: What are the minimum conformance requirements for the FD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync in DRX for UE category 0?
q_28911.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements for the FD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync in DRX for UE category 0 are defined in 3GPP TS 36.133 Section 7.11.1, 7.11.2, and A.7.3.29.

q_28912.question: How does a third-party Application Service Provider gain access to specific network slices in the 5G system?
q_28912.ground_truth: A third-party Application Service Provider can negotiate with the MNO, and the MNO may create or allocate network slices based on the service requirements. Afterwards, the Application Function informs the 5GC that the target application service can use the specific network slices by providing application guidance for UE Route Selection Policy (URSP) determination.

q_28913.question: How can the 5G network determine the end-to-end delay to make it below a desired delay value?
q_28913.ground_truth: By taking into account the variation of the non-5G delays, the 5G network can adjust the delays within the 5G network to make the end-to-end delay below a desired value 99% of the time.

q_28914.question: What is the role of the CHF in 5G non-roaming MVNOs charging?
q_28914.ground_truth: The CHF (Charging Function) in the MNO collects charging information for 5G data connectivity usage for each MVNO, while the MVNO deploys their own billing and charging, but no other NFs.

q_28915.question: What is the maximum repetition period of relevant system info blocks that needs to be received by the UE to camp on a cell in this test case?

q_28916.question: What information can the intent handling function include to support different kinds of intents?
q_28916.ground_truth: The intent handling function includes a list of supportedIntentHandlingCapability which represent intent handling function's capabilities in support of intent handling, including supportedExpectationObjects and supportedExpectationTargets.

q_28917.question: When a UE with higher layer parameter shortProcessingTime receives multiple TPC commands in a subframe, which TPC command is used for determining the power control adjustment?
q_28917.ground_truth: The TPC command in the PDCCH/EPDCCH with DCI format 0A/0B/0C/4A/4B with CRC scrambled by C-RNTI which schedules PUSCH transmission in subframe i.

q_28918.question: What is the role of the transmitting side of an AM RLC entity in generating AMD PDUs?
q_28918.ground_truth: The transmitting side of an AM RLC entity generates AMD PDUs for each RLC SDU. It segments the RLC SDUs, if needed, to fit within the total size of RLC PDUs and updates RLC headers accordingly. It also supports retransmission of RLC SDUs or RLC SDU segments.

q_28919.question: What assistance information does the network provide a UE in RRC_IDLE during periods of no coverage to save power?
q_28919.ground_truth: The network provides NTN payload assistance information such as ephemeris parameters, start-time, and/or carrier frequency of upcoming NTN payload coverage to enable the UE to predict when coverage will be provided by upcoming NTN payloads.

q_28920.question: What is the time duration T2 within which the UE is required to respond on Cell 2 in the test procedure mentioned?
q_28920.ground_truth: The UE is required to respond on Cell 2 within 21 seconds from the beginning of time period T2.

q_28921.question: What message does the MME send to the eNB to initiate the Initial Context Setup procedure in case of an Idle-to-Active transition?
q_28921.ground_truth: The MME initiates the Initial Context Setup procedure by sending INITIAL CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST to the eNB.

q_28922.question: What should the floor participant interface toward the MCPTT client do when it receives a Floor Ack message while an indication exists that a Floor Ack message is expected for the message in the Message Type field?
q_28922.ground_truth: The floor participant interface toward the MCPTT client should forward the Floor Ack message to the floor control server interface and remove the indication that a Floor Ack message is expected for the message in the Message Type field.

q_28923.question: What is the role of the BSS in the described service order procedure?
q_28923.ground_truth: The BSS notifies the NSC that the product order has been completed and sends the necessary access information for the MnS discovery service to the NSC.

q_28924.question: What is the purpose of implementing EIA0 for AS integrity protection in MMEs, RNs, and eNBs?
q_28924.ground_truth: The purpose of implementing EIA0 for AS integrity protection in MMEs, RNs, and eNBs is to ensure that unauthenticated emergency calling is supported where it is a regulatory requirement.

q_28925.question: In the scenario where the NDI in the received HARQ information is 1, what should be done regarding the NDI for the corresponding HARQ process?
q_28925.ground_truth: The NDI for the corresponding HARQ process should not be toggled.

q_28926.question: What should the UE do with SIP responses received from the P-CSCF outside of the registration and authentication procedures if a security association or TLS session exists?
q_28926.ground_truth: The UE shall discard those responses.

q_28927.question: What should the reception control arbitration logic do when it enters the 'Gr: Reception Idle' state from any state except the 'Start-stop' state?
q_28927.ground_truth: It starts timer T5, initializes counter C7 to 0, sets the general state to the 'Gr: Reception Idle' state, and starts timer T5.

q_28928.question: What is the maximum number of times that the "distanceMeters" and "duration" elements can occur in the "tRouteLegStepType" complex type?
q_28928.ground_truth: The "distanceMeters" and "duration" elements can occur only once in the "tRouteLegStepType" complex type, as indicated by the "minOccurs" and "maxOccurs" attributes.

q_28929.question: What is the format of "UERadioCapabilityInfoIndicationIEs" in NGAP-PROTOCOL-IES?
q_28929.ground_truth: The format of "UERadioCapabilityInfoIndicationIEs" in NGAP-PROTOCOL-IES is a set of information elements, including ID id-AMF-UE-NGAP-ID, ID id-RAN-UE-NGAP-ID, ID id-UERadioCapability, ID id-UERadioCapabilityForPaging, ID id-UERadioCapability-EUTRA-Format.

q_28930.question: What is the mean UL Average-UPT gain for semi-static SBFD at medium load level with SBFD Alt 3 and large packet size?
q_28930.ground_truth: The mean UL Average-UPT gain for semi-static SBFD at medium load level with SBFD Alt 3 and large packet size is 152.63%.

q_28931.question: What should the network do upon receiving the CM SERVICE ABORT message?
q_28931.ground_truth: Upon receipt of the CM SERVICE ABORT message, the network shall abort ongoing processes, release the appropriate resources, and initiate a normal release of the RR connection unless another MM connection establishment is pending or an RRLP procedure or LCS procedure over RRC is ongoing.

q_28932.question: What is the definition of out-of-band emissions in ITU terminology?
q_28932.ground_truth: Out-of-band emissions are unwanted emissions immediately outside the channel bandwidth resulting from the modulation process and non-linearity in the transmitter, but excluding spurious emissions.

q_28933.question: What should the UE do when it receives a GUTI in the ATTACH ACCEPT message and reselects a cell belonging to a new tracking area?
q_28933.ground_truth: The UE restarts the attach procedure.

q_28934.question: What information is required to be included in the "eutraLocation" or "nrLocation" attribute for 3GPP access in the "EventsNotification" data type in the "200 OK" response to the HTTP POST request?
q_28934.ground_truth: The user location information is required in the "eutraLocation" or "nrLocation" attribute for 3GPP access.

q_28935.question: What should be the physical cell identity of Cell 2 in the next iteration of the test procedure loop in step 8?
q_28935.ground_truth: The physical cell identity of Cell 2 in the next iteration of the test procedure loop is set to ((current cell 2 physical cell identity + 1) mod 14 + 2).

q_28936.question: What action should the NG-RAN node take if the Partially Allowed NSSAI IE is received in the CONNECTION ESTABLISHMENT INDICATION message and the total number of S-NSSAIs exceeds eight?
q_28936.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node should consider the procedure as failed.

q_28937.question: What is the third step after performing the actions needed to fulfill the API in the scenario where there is an API invocation request at the NEF for PEC mode?
q_28937.ground_truth: If authorized, the NEF continues the API invocation processing and sends the API Invocation Response.

q_28938.question: What message does the 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-UE Relay send upon reception of the Link Modification Request message if there are other UEs using the layer-2 link?
q_28938.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-UE Relay sends a Link Modification Request message to the target 5G ProSe Layer-3 End UE in order to release the PC5 QoS Flow(s) and deletes the context data associated with the PC5 QoS Flow(s).

q_28939.question: In the case of satellite access for Cellular IoT, what should a UE with location capability do when selecting a PLMN for access?
q_28939.ground_truth: The UE should use its awareness of its location and select a PLMN that is allowed to operate the UE location.

q_28940.question: What is responsible for managing the authorization of communication in the FRMCS system?
q_28940.ground_truth: The Authorisation of communication manages the authorization of communication in the FRMCS system.

q_28941.question: What should the UE do if it has one or more Access Classes that are valid for use and for at least one of these Access Classes the corresponding bit in the ac-BarringForSpecialAC is set to zero?
q_28941.ground_truth: The UE should consider access to the cell as not barred.

q_28942.question: What type of data does the variablepathQuality contain in the provided protocol?
q_28942.ground_truth: The variablepathQuality contains TRPMeasurementQuality data in the provided protocol.

q_28943.question: Which architecture enhancements are the basis for the solution described in clause 7.25.1?
q_28943.ground_truth: The architecture enhancements specified in clause 6.5 are the basis for the solution described in clause 7.25.1.

q_28944.question: What type of element can be used as the "center" of an "ellipsoid-arc-area" with a maximum of one occurrence?

q_28945.question: What action is expected when the reset() method is called in any state of the Media Player?
q_28945.ground_truth: All information related to the media and the Media Presentation described by the MPD is destroyed.

q_28946.question: What is the name of the message used to provide CDMA2000 1xRTT Parameters to the UE so the UE can register with the CDMA2000 1xRTT Network to support CSFB to CDMA2000 1xRTT?

q_28947.question: What should be sent in the response body when a successful HTTP POST request is sent to the Notification URI during the SMF-NEF connection release procedure?
q_28947.ground_truth: No response body is returned in case of success.

q_28948.question: What is the purpose of the A-GNSS-ProvideAssistanceData IE in the 3GPP specification?
q_28948.ground_truth: It is used by the location server to provide A-GNSS assistance data to enable UE-based and UE-assisted A-GNSS. It may also be used to provide GNSS positioning specific error reasons.

q_28949.question: What is the objective of solution #6 in addressing key issue #3: enhancements to service continuity planning?
q_28949.ground_truth: Solution #6 proposes introducing a new procedure to modify ACR parameters in order to address the open issues in KI#3.

q_28950.question: Which HTTP method is used to read all TMGI Allocation resource for a given SCS/AS in the GMDviaMBMSbyMB2 API?
q_28950.ground_truth: The GET method reads all TMGI Allocation resource for a given SCS/AS in the GMDviaMBMSbyMB2 API. It is initiated by the SCS/AS and answered by the SCEF.

q_28951.question: What is a feature that can be supported by the PCF, allowing media flows to use the same Allocation and Retention Priority as other "Individual Application Session Context" resources?

q_28952.question: What message does the target gNB send to the source gNB to indicate the successful switch of the data path to the indirect path via the target L2 U2N Relay UE?

q_28953.question: When should the MME include the CSG Id IE in the PATH SWITCH REQUEST message?
q_28953.ground_truth: The MME should include the CSG Id IE in the PATH SWITCH REQUEST message if the UE is entering a CSG cell or if it is being moved from a CSG or hybrid cell to a non-CSG cell.

q_28954.question: In the context of the requirements for handover testing, what is the cell identification requirement for a cell to be known?
q_28954.ground_truth: For a cell to be known in the context of handover testing, it must have been meeting the relevant cell identification requirement during the last 5 seconds.

q_28955.question: In the context of inter-frequency handover from NR FR2 to NR FR1, what is the maximum allowed interruption time (Tinterrupt) for UE processing and margin?
q_28955.ground_truth: Tinterrupt = Tprocessing + Tmargin ms, where Tprocessing can be up to 40ms, and Tmargin can be up to 2ms.

q_28956.question: What should the S-CSCF do if the user requires re-authentication and the REGISTER request did not include an Authorization header field with a digest response?
q_28956.ground_truth: The S-CSCF shall proceed with the authentication procedures as described for the initial REGISTER in subclauses 5.4.1.2.1 and 5.4.1.2.1B.

q_28957.question: Which two new messages for the ATSSS rules have been introduced for traffic duplication suspension?
q_28957.ground_truth: The two new messages are for suspending duplication and reactivating duplication.

q_28958.question: What information does the VAE Server send in a 201 Created message when a new Individual File Distribution resource is created?
q_28958.ground_truth: The VAE Server sends a Location header field containing the URI for the created resource.

q_28959.question: What should the UE include in the "UE capability container" if it supports multiple UTRA FDD Frequency Bands or a single UTRA FDD Frequency Band different from Band I?
q_28959.ground_truth: If the UE supports multiple UTRA FDD Frequency Bands, or a single UTRA FDD Frequency Band different from Band I, it should include the "UE radio access capability" and the "UE radio access capability extension" in the "UE capability container".

q_28960.question: Which clause of the document specifies the minimum conformance requirements for UE specific channel bandwidth (CBW) change?

q_28961.question: What interface does the procedure affect in 5GS?

q_28962.question: What is the base data type for the "tRadioParametersType" complex type?
q_28962.ground_truth: The base data type for the "tRadioParametersType" complex type is "xs:string" which represents a string value.

q_28963.question: What is the maximum repetition period of relevant system info blocks that needs to be received by the UE to camp on a cell, as assumed in this test case?
q_28963.ground_truth: The maximum repetition period of relevant system info blocks that needs to be received by the UE to camp on a cell, as assumed in this test case, is 1280 ms.

q_28964.question: When does the UE provide the list of stored PSIs during initial registration in 5G?
q_28964.ground_truth: The UE provides the list of stored PSIs during initial registration or when the UE moves from EPS to 5GS to request synchronization.

q_28965.question: What is the maximum allowed time for the UE to identify a new FDD inter-frequency cell in the test procedure?
q_28965.ground_truth: The maximum allowed time for the UE to identify a new FDD inter-frequency cell is defined as TBasic_Identify_Inter, which is 480 ms.

q_28966.question: When should a UE skip decoding a transport block in an initial transmission?
q_28966.ground_truth: A UE should skip decoding a transport block in an initial transmission if the effective channel code rate is higher than 0.930, where the effective channel code rate is defined as the number of downlink information bits (including CRC bits) divided by the number of physical channel bits on PDSCH.

q_28967.question: What should be measured for the first preamble?
q_28967.ground_truth: The power and timing of the first preamble, which should not exceed the values specified in 7.3.2.2.2.5.

q_28968.question: What is the gain provided by the semi-static SBFD in the UL when using SBFD Alt 3 and a large packet size at a high load level?
q_28968.ground_truth: The semi-static SBFD provides a mean and 5% UL Average-UPT gain of 1.08%.

q_28969.question: What is the specific procedure for service specific parameter provisioning from the AF to the VPLMN?
q_28969.ground_truth: The procedure for service specific parameter provisioning by the AF to the VPLMN involves the AF sending a request to the NEF, the NEF authorizing the request, and the NEF storing the AF request information in the UDR as the "Application Data". The NEF also sends the Service Parameters to the targeted UE through the PCF when the UE is reachable.

q_28970.question: What is the role of NWDAF in delivering analytics for location accuracy?
q_28970.ground_truth: The NWDAF is responsible for deriving analytics for location accuracy, using the location data provided by the GMLC. NWDAF then submits these analytics to the consumer for further processing.

q_28971.question: What must the PCF do upon receiving a PDU session establishment request when the UE is moving from 5GS to EPC?
q_28971.ground_truth: The PCF must establish a UE Policy Association towards the PCF-UE upon a PDU session establishment request when the UE is moving from 5GS to EPC.

q_28972.question: What is the meaning of the "access-type" parameter in the P-Access-Network-Info header field?
q_28972.ground_truth: The "access-type" parameter in the P-Access-Network-Info header field indicates the type of IP-CAN based on the access technology.

q_28973.question: What information must be included in each xIRI?
q_28973.ground_truth: Each xIRI must include the target identity, time stamp, correlation information, location information, and session related information.

q_28974.question: What should the MME/SGSN do if it receives a session reestablishment trigger notification while the Session Transfer procedure is in progress?
q_28974.ground_truth: The MME/SGSN should send a session reestablishment trigger notification to the UE to start the recovery procedure.

q_28975.question: When is a UE not required to decode a PDSCH on the primary cell, even when a PDCCH with CRC scrambled by the C-RNTI or SPS C-RNTI is detected in the same subframe?
q_28975.ground_truth: A UE is not required to decode a PDSCH on the primary cell, even when a PDCCH with CRC scrambled by the C-RNTI or SPS C-RNTI is detected in the same subframe, when RA-RNTI and either C-RNTI or SPS C-RNTI are assigned in the same subframe.

q_28976.question: What is the requirement for discovering SSBs in FR2 inter-frequency measurements with CCA?
q_28976.ground_truth: UE shall be able to identify new inter-frequency cells in carrier frequencies with CCA and perform SS-RSRP, SS-RSRQ, and SS-SINR measurements even if no explicit neighbor list is provided.

q_28977.question: When must the UE indicate support for Reflective QoS in a PDU Session that has been transferred from EPS with N26 interface?
q_28977.ground_truth: The UE indicates Reflective QoS support using the PDU Session Modification procedure after the first inter-system change from EPS to 5GS.

q_28978.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for this test as specified in 6.5.7C.1.3?
q_28978.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 6.5.7C.0.

q_28979.question: Which 3GPP TS 23.107 standard defined parameter specifies the type of application for which the UMTS bearer service is optimized in the 3G Quality of Service profile?

q_28980.question: What information the target UE should include in the DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION ACCEPT message if the DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION REQUEST message is to add new V2X service, add new PC5 QoS flow(s) or modify any existing PC5 QoS flow(s) in the PC5 unicast link?
q_28980.ground_truth: The target UE should include the PQFI(s), the corresponding PC5 QoS parameters and the V2X service identifier(s) that the target UE accepts in the DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION ACCEPT message.

q_28981.question: What information about the NF Service Consumer does the NRF validate for service request authorization?
q_28981.ground_truth: The NRF validates the NF Type, NF Instance ID, PLMN-ID, and FQDN of the NF Service Consumer.

q_28982.question: What is the general rule for the resolution bandwidth of the measuring equipment used for UE emission measurements?
q_28982.ground_truth: As a general rule, the resolution bandwidth of the measuring equipment should be equal to the measurement bandwidth.

q_28983.question: What is the role of a protection relay in power distribution?
