q_28983.ground_truth: A protection relay measures the local current, receives the sampled current values from the remote protection relay, and time-aligns the two current samples to calculate the differential current. If the differential current exceeds the threshold, it sends a trip command to the circuit breaker to protect the power line.

q_28984.question: What is the purpose of the "V2P application requirement request" in the V2X application specific server?
q_28984.ground_truth: The "V2P application requirement request" is used to describe information elements from the V2X Application Specific Server (VASS) to the VAE server, including details about the V2P application requirements.

q_28985.question: How does the SMF intercept a copy of the packets for all DNs the subject is connected to, in the in-bound roaming case for home-routed roaming?
q_28985.ground_truth: The SMF intercepts a copy of the packets sent and received on the N6 interface side of the PDU Anchor UPF for all DNs the subject is connected to, in the in-bound roaming case for home-routed roaming. In this case, the CSP shall deliver a copy of the packets sent and received on the N9 side of the PDU Anchor UPF towards the serving network.

q_28986.question: What is the procedure followed in Solution #20 when the target UE is out of coverage?
q_28986.ground_truth: In Solution #20, when the target UE is out of coverage, the GMLC determines to use Network assisted sidelink positioning to locate the target UE and selects a Located UE based on the target area. The LMF then triggers the LCS procedure of the Located UE to get the location of the Target UE.

q_28987.question: What happens when the network accepts a UE POLICY PROVISIONING REQUEST message?
q_28987.ground_truth: Upon receipt of an accepted UE POLICY PROVISIONING REQUEST message, the PCF creates a MANAGE UE POLICY COMMAND message and sends it to the UE with the same PTI as included in the UE POLICY PROVISIONING REQUEST message.

q_28988.question: What triggers the start of T2 in the intra-band PCell TDD case?
q_28988.ground_truth: T2 starts in subframe m for the intra-band PCell TDD case if the first CSI report for SCell1 is received by the SS in a specific subframe, which depends on whether certain subframes were subject to interruption and an intra-band SCell is activated.

q_28989.question: What message is used by the Serving GW to inform the PDN GW of the change of, for example, the RAT type, for Serving GW relocation?
q_28989.ground_truth: The Serving GW sends the message Modify Bearer Request per PDN connection to the PDN GW to inform it of the change of the RAT type for Serving GW relocation.

q_28990.question: How often does the UE need to receive a new Timing Advance Command MAC control element?
q_28990.ground_truth: The UE needs to be provided at least once every 1280ms with new Timing Advance Command MAC control element to restart the Time alignment timer.

q_28991.question: What type of E-UTRA HD-FDD UE with support for intra-frequency SI acquisition for HO is this test applicable to, starting from release 12?

q_28992.question: What should the MCPTT server do if it receives a request with a non-existent public service identity?
q_28992.ground_truth: The MCPTT server should return a SIP 404 (Not Found) response.

q_28993.question: What HTTP method is supported for the "Resource: Individual File Distribution" to support the request data structures?
q_28993.ground_truth: The HTTP method "POST" is supported for the "Resource: Individual File Distribution" to support the request data structures.

q_28994.question: What is concatenation, segmentation, and reassembly in the context of RLC sublayer?
q_28994.ground_truth: Concatenation refers to the combination of several SDUs into a single PDU, segmentation involves breaking down a large SDU into smaller segments and attaching them into multiple PDUs, and reassembly means combining the segments into the original SDU after they have been transmitted. These functions are available for UM and AM data transfer in the RLC sublayer.

q_28995.question: What should the UE do when access is barred for signalling in the cell it is camping?
q_28995.ground_truth: The UE will not initiate the tracking area updating procedure on the current cell and will apply the normal cell reselection process.

q_28996.question: What is the specification impact to support enhancements to inter-UE CLI measurement resources and reporting?
q_28996.ground_truth: The specification impact to support enhancements to inter-UE CLI measurement resources and reporting includes: For L1/L2 UE-to-UE CLI reporting, periodic and/or semi-persistent and/or aperiodic reporting, and for L1/L2 UE-to-UE CLI measurement, periodic and/or semi-persistent and/or aperiodic measurement resource.

q_28997.question: What determines the measurement duration for the last PRS RSTD sample in positioning frequency layer i?
q_28997.ground_truth: The measurement duration for the last PRS RSTD sample in positioning frequency layer i is derived from the duration of PRS-ProcessingSymbolsInEveryTms and the least common multiple between the duration of PRS-ProcessingSymbolsInEveryTms and the DRX cycle length.

q_28998.question: What additional KPIs can be reported by companies in addition to the required KPIs for system performance evaluation?
q_28998.ground_truth: Other KPIs that can be reported by companies include UCI report overhead (e.g., number of UCI reports and UCI payload size) and/or UCI overhead reduction for inference of the AI/ML model, latency reduction, and power consumption reduction.

q_28999.question: What action should the en-gNB take if the Integrity Protection Indication IE is set to "required" and it does not support integrity protection for a certain E-RAB in the SGNB ADDITION REQUEST message?
q_28999.ground_truth: The en-gNB should reject the addition of the concerned E-RAB with an appropriate cause value.

q_29000.question: What should the IBCF do if it receives an initial request for a dialog and the network uses the Resource-Priority header field to control the priority of emergency calls?
q_29000.ground_truth: If the request includes a Resource-Priority header field and the network uses the Resource-Priority header field to control the priority of emergency calls, the IBCF should include a topmost Route header field set to the URI associated with an E-CSCF.

q_29001.question: What is the purpose of DBI signaling when used between an MSMTSI client and MSMTSI MRF in multiparty conferencing?
q_29001.ground_truth: DBI signaling is used to improve end-to-end delay and quality performance of the RTP streams exchanged between the clients and conferencing server in multiparty conferencing. It allows negotiation of available additional delay budget for the RTP streams received and sent by the clients and the MRF.

q_29002.question: Which two pieces of information are required by the PDCP for ciphering, as input to the ciphering algorithm?
q_29002.ground_truth: The COUNT value and DIRECTION (direction of the transmission: 0 for uplink, 1 for downlink), as specified in TS 33.401.

q_29003.question: What is the purpose of the OTDOA-ReferenceCellInfo's 'physCellId' field?
q_29003.ground_truth: The 'physCellId' field of the OTDOA-ReferenceCellInfo represents the physical cell identity of the cell.

q_29004.question: What are the conditions for a CSI-RS based RLM for FR1 and FR2-1 regarding measuring or receiving restrictions?
q_29004.ground_truth: For both FR1 and FR2-1, the NCR-MT is not required to receive CSI-RS for RLM in the PRBs that overlap with an SSB, and it must consider restrictions while performing CSI-RS measurements based on its capabilities. For FR1, if SSB is present within the active BWP and has a different SCS than CSI-RS for RLM, NCR-MT can have no restrictions or required to measure only one of CSI-RS or SSB, if NCR-MT does not support simultaneousRxDataSSB-DiffNumerology. For FR1, if CSI-RS for RLM is in the same OFDM symbol as another CSI-RS for RLM, BFD, CBD, or L1-RSRP measurement, it can measure the CSI-RS for RLM without any restrictions. For FR2-1, if CSI-RS for RLM measurement on one CC is in the same OFDM symbol as CSI-RS for RLM, BFD, CBD, or L1-RSRP measurement on the same CC or different CCs in the same band, NCR-MT is required to measure one of but not both CSI-RS for RLM and CSI-RS. Longer measurement periods for SSB based RLM are expected, and no requirements are defined.

q_29005.question: What action should the eNB take upon receiving the UE CONTEXT RESUME FAILURE message from the MME?
q_29005.ground_truth: The eNB should release the RRC connection and release all related signalling and user data transport resources.

q_29006.question: What actions should the floor participant take when it receives a Floor Deny message and the <User ID> value in the User ID field matches its own MCPTT ID and the SSRC of the floor participant sending the Floor Deny message matches the stored SSRC of the candidate arbitrator?
q_29006.ground_truth: The floor participant shall stop the timer T201 (Floor Request), provide a floor deny notification to the user, reset the timer T203 (End of RTP media), display the floor deny reason to the user, and enter the 'O: has no permission' state.

q_29007.question: What is the first step in the location reporting procedure when a UE is served by an MBSR (Mobile Base Station Relay)?
q_29007.ground_truth: The AMF serving UE is triggered to initiate the location reporting procedure for UE as specified in TS~23.273.

q_29008.question: What must be taken into account when the AMF triggers paging for a UE in CM-IDLE state?
q_29008.ground_truth: The AMF takes into account the MBS service area information when triggering paging for a UE in CM-IDLE state. Only the NG-RAN nodes within the MBS service area are required to trigger paging.

q_29009.question: What action does the old I-SMF take if the old I-UPF receives end marker packets and there is no associated tunnel to forward these packets in the case of I-SMF change?
q_29009.ground_truth: The old I-UPF discards the received end marker packets and does not send any Data Notification to SMF.

q_29010.question: What channel coding scheme is used for transport blocks in the NR physical layer?
q_29010.ground_truth: The channel coding scheme for transport blocks in the NR physical layer uses quasi-cyclic low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes with 2 base graphs and 8 sets of parity check matrices for each base graph. The channel coding scheme for PBCH and control information is Polar coding based on nested sequences.

q_29011.question: What are some possible elements in the management loop constituted for the MDA process?
q_29011.ground_truth: Observation, Analytics, Decision, and Execution are some possible elements in the management loop for the MDA process.

q_29012.question: What is the role of the "P-Asserted-Identity" header field in a SIP MESSAGE request?
q_29012.ground_truth: It is used to include the public service identity of the non-controlling MCData function in the SIP MESSAGE request.

q_29013.question: What interfaces does group FD using MBMS delivery support in accordance with clause 10.2.6?
q_29013.ground_truth: Group FD using MBMS delivery in clause 10.2.6 supports unicast session for delivery via the media plane and MBMS delivery via the MB2 interface.

q_29014.question: What is the requirement for the total number of successful tests for the NR SA FR2 event-triggered reporting with gap in DRX test case in order for the test to pass?
q_29014.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the total number of successful tests shall be more than 90% of the cases with a confidence level of 95%.

q_29015.question: What is the requirement for reporting RSRP and RSRQ measurements in event triggered measurement reports?
q_29015.ground_truth: The reported RSRP and RSRQ measurement contained in event triggered measurement reports shall meet the requirements in 3GPP TS 36.133 in clauses 9.1.21.9, 9.1.21.10, 9.1.21.13 and 9.1.21.14.

q_29016.question: What action does the EES take after processing the ACR status update request in IEC charging?
q_29016.ground_truth: The EES sends an ACR status update response to the EAS.

q_29017.question: Under what circumstances is the indicator "Location Information Confirmed in HLR" set to "Not Confirmed"?
q_29017.ground_truth: When the VLR receives a "Reset" message from the HLR with which the MS is registered, or when the VLR in a Super-Charged network receives a Cancel Location message that indicates an "updateProcedure".

q_29018.question: What is the purpose of the Gateway Control Session Establishment Procedure in step A.1?
q_29018.ground_truth: The purpose of the Gateway Control Session Establishment Procedure in step A.1 is for the Serving GW to obtain the rules required for the Serving GW to perform the bearer binding for all the active sessions the UE may establish as a result of the handover procedure.

q_29019.question: When determining a SR transmission occasion in a PUCCH, if the number of symbols available for the PUCCH transmission in a slot is smaller than the value provided by nrofSymbols, what does the UE not do in the slot?
q_29019.ground_truth: The UE does not transmit the PUCCH in the slot.

q_29020.question: What is the action taken by a UE capable of NR sidelink U2N Remote UE operation when the RSRP measurement of the PCell or the cell on which the UE camps is above threshHighRemote?
q_29020.ground_truth: The UE will consider the threshold conditions not to be met, which is referred to as leaving.

q_29021.question: What happens to the gNB when the UE sends a wake-up signal with Technique A-3-2?
q_29021.ground_truth: When the UE sends a wake-up signal, the gNB can transit to become active for transmitting or receiving a channel/signal as the gNB may be inactive before the receiving the uplink signal from the UE.

q_29022.question: Which message is sent by the UE to the SS without integrity protection before NAS security mode control procedure has been successfully completed, but with new EPS security context after?

q_29023.question: What key issue does the solution in 3GPP TS 23.558 clause 7.27.3 address?
q_29023.ground_truth: The solution in 3GPP TS 23.558 clause 7.27.3 addresses Key Issue #17, discovery of a common EAS.

q_29024.question: What should the participating MCPTT function include in the P-Asserted-Identity header field of the outgoing SIP MESSAGE request to the controlling MCPTT function for the private call transfer service for the requesting MCPTT user?
q_29024.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT function should include the public service identity of the participating MCPTT function in the P-Asserted-Identity header field of the outgoing SIP MESSAGE request to the controlling MCPTT function for the private call transfer service for the requesting MCPTT user.

q_29025.question: What should the controlling MCData function do if the SIP MESSAGE does not contain a required MIME body?
q_29025.ground_truth: If the SIP MESSAGE does not contain an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body, the controlling MCData function shall reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response.

q_29026.question: After how many milliseconds should the MeasurementReport message be transmitted after the beginning of time period T2, as per the requirement in test 1 and 2?
q_29026.ground_truth: Less than 1080 ms for Test 1 and less than 10240 ms for Test 2.

q_29027.question: When shall the UE include in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message the MS determined PLMN with disaster condition IE indicating the MS determined PLMN with disaster condition?
q_29027.ground_truth: The UE shall include the MS determined PLMN with disaster condition IE indicating the MS determined PLMN with disaster condition in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message when it initiates the registration procedure for disaster roaming services.

q_29028.question: What action starts a trace recording when triggered events occur at the UE?
q_29028.ground_truth: When any of the triggering events occur at the UE, and the service or user-related conditions within the received management operation occur, the UE starts a trace recording and includes a Start Trigger Event in the outgoing SIP service signalling message.

q_29029.question: What are the two parameters that determine the performance requirement of single-user PUCCH format 0 for ACK missed detection?
q_29029.ground_truth: The two parameters are the probability of false detection of the ACK and the probability of detection of ACK.

q_29030.question: Which system calculate the packet delay between NG-RAN and PSA UPF?
q_29030.ground_truth: The UPF (User Plane Function) calculates the packet delay between NG-RAN and PSA UPF and reports the packet delay value(s) between NG-RAN and PSA UPF, RAN part delay value(s) to SMF.

q_29031.question: What is the purpose of the IP discovery authorization required indication in the PC5 Link Establishment procedure between UE1 and the UE-to-UE Relay?
q_29031.ground_truth: The IP discovery authorization required indication is used to indicate that UE1 requires authorization before its IP address can be discovered by UE2. This provides an additional layer of security to ensure that UE2 is authorized to receive IP address/prefix information of UE1.

q_29032.question: What action should the SGSN take before it activates a Trace Session towards other NE?
q_29032.ground_truth: The SGSN has to find the identity of the mobile before it activates a Trace Session towards other NE, such as by getting the IMEI(SV) from the Mobile by using the Identification procedure on the Iu interface.

q_29033.question: What is the maximum resolution and frame rate supported by UHD-1 phase 2 exclusively operating with HEVC?
q_29033.ground_truth: The maximum resolution supported by UHD-1 phase 2 exclusively operating with HEVC is 7680x4320, and the maximum frame rate supported is 120 Hz.

q_29034.question: Which waveform is the most robust to frequency error, depending on guard-band size between segments?
q_29034.ground_truth: Single frequency segment OOK waveform (except OOK3) is the most robust to frequency error, depending on guard-band size between segments.

q_29035.question: What is the consequence if neither the Assistance Information IE nor the Broadcast IE are included in the ASSISTANCE INFORMATION CONTROL message?
q_29035.ground_truth: If neither the Assistance Information IE nor the Broadcast IE are included in the ASSISTANCE INFORMATION CONTROL message, the NG-RAN Node will consider the procedure as failed.

q_29036.question: What is the purpose of the Additional RRM Policy Index (ARPI) parameter in the Radio Resource Management functions in 3GPP specifications?
q_29036.ground_truth: The Additional RRM Policy Index (ARPI) parameter is used in the Radio Resource Management functions to prioritize the allocation of RAN resources to a set of UEs with the same ARPI. The ARPI parameter can also be used to carry information that is independent of the Reference SPID values.

q_29037.question: How many offset positions are there for the phi-axis and theta-axis ripple tests in the quiet zone ripple test?
q_29037.ground_truth: There are three offset positions for the phi-axis ripple test and eight offset positions for the theta-axis ripple test in the quiet zone ripple test.

q_29038.question: What is the role of the PDN connection in determining the forwarding of data in GTP-U packets?
q_29038.ground_truth: The PDN connection identifies the bearer to which the forwarded data belongs, determined by the F-TEID in the header of the encapsulating GTP-U packet.

q_29039.question: In the scenario where there is no mutual authentication between the NF Service Consumer and the NRF at the transport layer, which network element authenticates the NF Service Consumer when the NF Service Consumer requests an access token from the SCP?
q_29039.ground_truth: The NRF authenticates the NF Service Consumer when the NF Service Consumer requests an access token from the SCP.

q_29040.question: What protocol is used by the UE to determine which SNPNs in the visited country support emergency services in untrusted non-3GPP access via N3IWF?
q_29040.ground_truth: DNS (Domain Name System) is used by the UE to determine which SNPNs in the visited country support emergency services in untrusted non-3GPP access via N3IWF.

q_29041.question: What is the purpose of "SRBs-Required-ToBeReleased-List" and "DRBs-Required-ToBeReleased-List"?
q_29041.ground_truth: Both "SRBs-Required-ToBeReleased-List" and "DRBs-Required-ToBeReleased-List" are used to specify the list of SRBs and DRBs, respectively, that are required to be released during the UE context modification.

q_29042.question: What is the role of the NEF in AF requests for QoS resources for the AI/ML operation?
q_29042.ground_truth: The NEF provides QoS resources for the AF's AI/ML operation, and when successful, allocates QoS resources for the UEs and initiates QoS monitoring.

q_29043.question: Which sub-element does "session-oriented-change-info" contain to indicate the reliability requirement of the V2X application?

q_29044.question: What should the VLR do if it decides to deallocate the TMSI of the UE?
q_29044.ground_truth: The VLR shall include the IMSI of the UE in the SGsAP-LOCATION-UPDATE-ACCEPT message.

q_29045.question: Under what conditions should an MME send a Notify Request (Homogeneous Support of IMS Voice over PS Sessions) message to the HSS?
q_29045.ground_truth: The MME should send this message if it has evaluated the support of IMS Voice over PS Sessions and if it determines that it needs to update the Homogeneous Support of IMS Voice over PS Sessions.

q_29046.question: Under what circumstances would an xIRI containing a PTCSessionAbandon record be created in a PTC server?
q_29046.ground_truth: The xIRI containing a PTCSessionAbandon record is created in a PTC server when the IRI-POI present in the PTC server detects that the PTC Session is not established and the request is abandoned before the PTC session starts.

q_29047.question: What should the MS do if it has received indication that some of the forbidden PLMNs provide disaster roaming services to the MS of the RPLMN?
q_29047.ground_truth: The MS may indicate to the user that those PLMN support disaster roaming services.

q_29048.question: What entity is responsible for selecting the Sidelink Positioning Broadcast Key (SLPBK) and generating a key identifier (SLPBK-ID) for the sending UE-1 in the broadcast key request phase?

q_29049.question: What message does the UE send to the E-SMLC if it is unable to perform the requested measurements in the network-assisted GNSS method?
q_29049.ground_truth: The UE sends an LPP Provide Location Information message to the E-SMLC, indicating the cause for the not provided location information.

q_29050.question: What should the floor participant include in the Floor Queue Position Info message when responding to a Floor Queue Position Request message?
q_29050.ground_truth: The floor participant should include the floor participant's own MCPTT ID in the User ID field, the queue position and floor priority in the Queue Info field, the SSRC of floor participant requesting floor queue status info in the SSRC of queued floor participant field, and the value of the User ID field from the received Floor Queue Position Request message in the Queued User ID field.

q_29051.question: Which type of orbit does a geostationary satellite occupy?
q_29051.ground_truth: A geostationary satellite occupies a geosynchronous orbit that lies in the plane of the Earth's equator.

q_29052.question: What is the purpose of Customized Alerting Tones (CAT) in the 3GPP TS 24.182 standard?
q_29052.ground_truth: CAT is a feature that matches the corresponding CS supplementary service in 3GPP TS 24.182 and specifies the binary description of service data for a subset of MMTEL services.

q_29053.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network's Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access (E-UTRA) and Evolved Packet Core (EPC) user equipment (UE) conformance specification, part 3: test suites (Release 18)?
q_29053.ground_truth: The purpose of the specification is to provide the protocol and signaling conformance testing in TTCN-3 for the 3GPP UE at the UE-E-UTRAN radio interface.

q_29054.question: What is the purpose of the V-EASDF in the process described?
q_29054.ground_truth: The V-EASDF is used for DNS query handling, EC service selection, and EAS discovery. It assists and validates the L-PSA selected by the V-SMF based on H-EASDF trigger.

q_29055.question: What is the role of the count sequence number in the eNB keys security of the E-UTRAN?
q_29055.ground_truth: The count sequence number is used as input to the ciphering and integrity protection of the eNB keys. It must only be used once for a given eNB key (except for identical re-transmission) on the same radio bearer in the same direction. The same sequence number can be used for both ciphering and integrity protection.

q_29056.question: What is the expression of sensitivity in dB in clause 7.4.4?
q_29056.ground_truth: The expression of sensitivity in dB in clause 7.4.4 is dBPa/V.

q_29057.question: Which network entity is responsible for buffering data and notifying the AF about UE reachability in the event of coverage loss?
q_29057.ground_truth: HLCOM (High Layer Connection Management) can be applied while the UE is in PSM/MICO mode to buffer data in the network and notify the AF about UE reachability.

q_29058.question: What should the AMF do if it receives a CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message with the Data type field indicates "control plane user data" and the PDU session ID is not in the AMF's routing context?
q_29058.ground_truth: The AMF may send back to the UE the CIoT user data container or control plane user data which was not forwarded as specified in subclause 5.4.5.3.1 case l1) or case l2).

q_29059.question: What is the purpose of the Paging restriction information element?
q_29059.ground_truth: The Paging restriction information element is used to request the network to restrict paging.

q_29060.question: How is the PLMN level NRF FQDN constructed when the PLMN level NRF addresses and FDQN are not provisioned into the NF?
q_29060.ground_truth: If the PLMN level NRF addresses and FDQN are not provisioned into the NF, the NF self-constructs the PLMN level NRF FQDN as specified in clause~28.3.2.3.2. The PLMN level NRF FQDN for an NRF in an operator's PLMN shall be constructed by prefixing the Home Network Domain Name of the PLMN, located in which the NRF is located with the label "nrf."

q_29061.question: What are the procedures in which the "transfer" custom operation is used in the 5G system?
q_29061.ground_truth: The "transfer" custom operation is used in the MBS (Multicast-Broadcast Service) session activation procedure, MBS session deactivation procedure, and multicast session update procedure.

q_29062.question: What is the format of the "a=key-mgmt" attribute field in the received SDP offer or SDP answer, if present?
q_29062.ground_truth: The "a=key-mgmt" attribute field in the received SDP offer or SDP answer should contain the "mikey" attribute value, if present.

q_29063.question: What is the effect of setting the expiration time of a new MCVideo group information entry to the current time increased with the candidate expiration interval?
q_29063.ground_truth: This means that the expiration time of the new MCVideo group information entry is set to the current time plus the candidate expiration interval, which keeps the entry valid for a certain period.

q_29064.question: What happens when the SMF decides to insert an UL Classifier (UL CL) in the data path of a PDU Session?
q_29064.ground_truth: When the SMF decides to insert an UL Classifier (UL CL) in the data path of a PDU Session, it enables the forwarding of UL traffic towards different PDU Session Anchors and the merge of DL traffic to the UE. This is based on traffic detection and forwarding rules provided by the SMF.

q_29065.question: What is the role of the MC gateway UE when the MC client is hosted by the MC gateway UE and the non-3GPP device does not host an MC client?
q_29065.ground_truth: The MC gateway UE hosts the MC client for the non-3GPP device and acts as an MC application connection node which enables and handles user signalling traffic and media plane traffic individually, i.e. on per MC service user basis, between the non-3GPP device and the corresponding MC server.

q_29066.question: What is the purpose of the overload control mechanisms in the IMS?
q_29066.ground_truth: The overload control mechanisms in the IMS are used to manage traffic and prevent network congestion. They include a feedback-based mechanism that utilizes the Via header field of signalling messages, and an event package for distributing load filters. These mechanisms can be used to address expected overload situations and prioritize certain types of traffic, such as priority and emergency calls.

q_29067.question: What framework is used for the authentication and assertion of a Caller ID in the STIR/SHAKEN framework?
q_29067.ground_truth: The STIR/SHAKEN framework utilizes the framework defined in the IETF STIR Working Group, which works together in an end-to-end architecture for the authentication and assertion of a Caller ID by an originating service provider and the verification of this identity by a terminating service provider.

q_29068.question: What field in the Ethernet Inactivity Timer IE type indicates the event quota to be monitored by the UP function?

q_29069.question: Which type of MAC control element consists of a single field containing the C-RNTI of a MAC entity?

q_29070.question: What should the VAE-C include in the Request-URI field of the HTTP POST request?
q_29070.ground_truth: The URI corresponding to the identity of the other VAE-C.

q_29071.question: In what scenarios might a UE proactively inform the RAN of updates/changes to its supported models or functionalities?
q_29071.ground_truth: When there is a need for AI/ML model or functionality updates, or when a UE moves to a new cell or changes its capabilities.

q_29072.question: What is checked in step 6 of the test procedure outlined in section 10.5.3.2.4.2?
q_29072.ground_truth: In step 6 of the test procedure outlined in section 10.5.3.2.4.2, the SS-SINR value of Cell 3 reported by the UE is compared to the expected SS-SINR.

q_29073.question: What must the gNB ensure while deactivating a PUCCH SCell?
q_29073.ground_truth: NG-RAN ensures that SCells mapped to PUCCH SCell are deactivated before the PUCCH SCell is changed or removed.

q_29074.question: What criteria must be met for a PRS resource to be considered fully overlapped with PPW?
q_29074.ground_truth: All instances of the PRS resource are overlapped with a PPW occasion.

q_29075.question: What is the provision for NF certificates in clause 6.1.3c.3 in addition to clause 6.1.1 and the provisions of RFC 5280?
q_29075.ground_truth: The provision for NF certificates in clause 6.1.3c.3 is to use subjectAltName entries (DNS-ID, SRV-ID, URI-ID) over the use of the subject field (CN-ID) where available, and to follow the CA-browser forum requirement on the CN-ID if present.

q_29076.question: What is the data type of the "expectationFulfilmentResult" property in the "IntentFulfilmentReport" data type?
q_29076.ground_truth: The data type of the "expectationFulfilmentResult" property is an array of "ExpectationFulfilmentResult" objects.

q_29077.question: What is the purpose of the "Knrp" element in the 3GPP 5G Pro Se PC3ach interface?
q_29077.ground_truth: The "Knrp" element contains the "KNRP" parameter, which is used to indicate the "Known NG-RAN Node Response" in the 5G network.

q_29078.question: What should a participating MCPTT client do when it receives a SIP MESSAGE request with an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-mbs-usage-info+xml MIME body and the mbs-service-areas element is present but no <announcement> element with the same value of the mbs-session-id element is stored?
q_29078.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT client shall store the received <announcement> element.

q_29079.question: What is the process to release an ongoing MC service ad-hoc group call?
q_29079.ground_truth: The MC service server identifies the participants of the ongoing ad-hoc group call, generates a group call release request, sends the release request to each participant, receives acknowledgment, and subsequently releases the floor control and media plane resources associated with the group call.

q_29080.question: What is the initial condition regarding the system information messages for the generic test procedure for IMS call establishment in E-UTRA?
q_29080.ground_truth: The default system information messages are used.

q_29081.question: How long does the UE have to finish BWP switching as per 3GPP TS 38.133 Clause 8.6.2?
q_29081.ground_truth: The UE is allowed to have an interruption of up to X slots to other active serving cells during BWP switching delay TBWPswitchDelay as defined in TS 38.133 Clause 8.6.2.

q_29082.question: What procedure is used to notify a gsmSCF about the invocation of a GSM Supplementary Service?

q_29083.question: In what sub-state of the GMM-REGISTERED state can user data and signalling information be sent and received?

q_29084.question: What should a UE do upon receiving the TAU Accept message with ISR Activated indication and a GUTI TIN?
q_29084.ground_truth: The UE should set its TIN to "GUTI" in this situation.

q_29085.question: What are the additional spurious emissions requirements for inter-band EN-DC with Tx Diversity within FR1?
q_29085.ground_truth: The additional spurious emissions requirements specified for E-UTRA in clause 6.6.3.3 of TS 36.101 and for NR Tx Diversity specified in clause 6.5G.3 of TS 38.101-1 apply for each component carrier.

q_29086.question: In A/Gb and Iu mode, what happens to the PDP contexts and MBMS contexts when the GPRS detach procedure is performed?
q_29086.ground_truth: In both A/Gb and Iu mode, if the GPRS detach procedure is performed, the PDP contexts and MBMS contexts are deactivated locally without peer-to-peer signaling between the SM and LLC entities in the MS and the network.

q_29087.question: How is an IMSI-Group Identifier composed?
q_29087.ground_truth: An IMSI-Group Identifier is composed of four parts: Group Service Identifier, Mobile Country Code (MCC), Mobile Network Code (MNC), and Local Group Id.

q_29088.question: In the 3GPP Technical Specification, what does the symbol "A" represent in the context of network energy savings for NR (Release 18)?
q_29088.ground_truth: The symbol "A" represents the ratio between the dynamic power consumption of the antenna part and the dynamic DL power consumption of a base station in an active state.

q_29089.question: For NB-IoT in NR, what is the minimum requirement for in-band and guard band operation?
q_29089.ground_truth: The E-UTRA minimum requirement specified in clause 6.6.4.1 should apply.

q_29090.question: How frequently should the UE filter RSRP or RSRQ measurements of inter-frequency cells?
q_29090.ground_truth: The UE should filter RSRP or RSRQ measurements of each measured higher, lower, and equal priority inter-frequency cell using at least 2 measurements, with at least two measurements spaced by at least Tmeasure,EUTRAN_Inter/2 within the set of measurements used for the filtering.

q_29091.question: When do UE start or restart drx-InactivityTimer for a new transmission (DL or UL)?
q_29091.ground_truth: When a DRX Command MAC control element is received, or drx-InactivityTimer expires in this subframe, and the PDCCH indicates a new transmission (DL or UL) for a UE not in Active Time. For NB-IoT, a DL or UL transmission for a NB-IoT UE causes immediate stop of drx-InactivityTimer, drx-ULRetransmissionTimer, and onDurationTimer.

q_29092.question: In which aspects may PT1 increase the complexity for the scheduling, in the context of relaxed UE processing timeline?
q_29092.ground_truth: PT1 may increase the complexity for the scheduling in scenarios where Rel-18 RedCap UEs coexist with legacy UEs, may have an impact on scheduling flexibility as several timing requirements are related to N1/N2 values, and may cause potential coexistence issues with legacy UEs if early identification of Rel-18 RedCap UEs prior to Msg2 scheduling is not supported.

q_29093.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for the NR SA FR1 event-triggered reporting tests for FR1 with NCSG for inter-frequency measurement?
q_29093.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 6.6.19.0.

q_29094.question: What does the GCS AS do when it detects a restart in the BM-SC?
q_29094.ground_truth: When the GCS AS detects a restart in the BM-SC, it assumes that all the TMGIs that had been assigned by the restarted BM-SC have been de-allocated and all the related MBMS bearers have been deactivated. The GCS AS may restore the MBMS delivery using the MB2-C procedures.

q_29095.question: What is the size of the "Transport blocks in a bundle" field when the DCI Field "HARQ-ACK bundling flag" is set to 1?
q_29095.ground_truth: 2 bits, which can indicate from 1 to 4 transport blocks in a bundle.

q_29096.question: What must the AMF do if the UE received a Service Request message with a Release Request indication or a Reject Paging Indication over 3GPP access?
q_29096.ground_truth: The AMF removes any stored Paging Restriction Information from the UE context and triggers the AN Release procedure.

q_29097.question: What should the MCData client do upon receipt of a SIP 300 (Multiple Choices) response to the SIP INVITE request?
q_29097.ground_truth: The MCData client should use the MCData ID of the invited MCData user contained in the <mcdata-request-uri><value></mcdata-request-uri> element of the received application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info MIME body as the MCData ID of the invited MCData user.

q_29098.question: What are two methods for image rejection that can be used in the heterodyne architecture with IF envelope detection?
q_29098.ground_truth: Image Rejection Filter or Image Rejection Mixer

q_29099.question: What is the maximum number of cells that the interFreqRSTDmeasurement-r10 parameter of the OTDOA-ProvideCapabilities IE can take?

q_29100.question: When can the Sidelink Positioning and Ranging services be performed without network involvement?
q_29100.ground_truth: The Sidelink Positioning and Ranging services can be performed without the network involvement when UE C and UE D are out of coverage or with partial network coverage.

q_29101.question: Which type of E-UTRA UE does 6.5B.2.3.3.1.2 apply to?
q_29101.ground_truth: This test case applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 15 and forward, supporting inter-band EN-DC within FR1 with 1 NR UL.

q_29102.question: What is the purpose of the Floor Priority field in the floor control messages?
q_29102.ground_truth: The Floor Priority field in the floor control messages describes the level of priority requested in a Floor Request message or granted in a Floor Granted message, with the maximum priority level negotiated between the MCPTT client and the controlling MCPTT function.

q_29103.question: Which header field must the participating MCData function include in the outgoing SIP INVITE request, and what must it be set to?
q_29103.ground_truth: P-Asserted-Identity header field must be included and set to the public service identity of the participating MCData function.

q_29104.question: What happens when more than one PLMN identity is broadcast in a cell?
q_29104.ground_truth: The cell is considered to be part of all tracking areas with TAIs constructed from the PLMN identities and the TAC broadcast in the cell.

q_29105.question: What is the allowed handover delay in the E-UTRAN FDD - cdma2000 1xRTT handover test?
q_29105.ground_truth: The allowed handover delay is less than 130 ms (maximum RRC procedure delay) + Tinterrupt in the E-UTRAN FDD - cdma2000 1xRTT handover test.

q_29106.question: What is the command used for downloading a USAT profile onto the UICC automatically upon start-up?
q_29106.ground_truth: The command is +CUSATD, which can determine if and optionally which profile should be downloaded to the UICC automatically upon start-up.

q_29107.question: What are the SIP header fields applicable on a roaming II-NNI?
q_29107.ground_truth: The SIP header fields applicable on a roaming II-NNI are Authentication-Info, Authorization, P-Associated-URI, P-Called-Party-ID, P-Preferred-Service, P-Profile-Key, P-Served-User, P-Visited-Network-ID, Path, Priority-Share, Proxy-Authenticate, Proxy-Authorization, Resource-Share, Restoration-Info, Service-Route, and WWW-Authenticate.

q_29108.question: What action should the User Agent (UA) take to invoke Communication Deflection?
q_29108.ground_truth: The UA should send a 302 (Moved Temporarily) response to the initial INVITE request, including a Contact header field with the address where the communication is diverted to.

q_29109.question: In Example 1, when the NAI decoration is not used, what is the format of the Fast Re-authentication NAI?
q_29109.ground_truth: The Fast Re-authentication NAI takes the form of "username@domain", where the username is the fast re-authentication identity returned by the 3GPP AAA Server (458405627015 in this example) and the domain is the domain name corresponding to the HPLMN (wlan.mnc015.mcc234.3gppnetwork.org in this example).

q_29110.question: What is the MCS group identity when the MCS group document is an MCVideo group document and defines a temporary MCS group?
q_29110.ground_truth: The MCS group identity is also the temporary MCVideo group ID in this case.

q_29111.question: What is the criticality of the id-NG-RANnode1CellID field in the MobilityChangeRequest-IEs?
q_29111.ground_truth: The criticality of the id-NG-RANnode1CellID field in the MobilityChangeRequest-IEs is reject.

q_29112.question: What should the EPS bearer identity be set to, in the mapped EPS bearer context or the association between QoS flow and mapped EPS bearer in the PDU session?
q_29112.ground_truth: The EPS bearer identity should be set to the EPS bearer identity received in the mapped EPS bearer context, or the EPS bearer identity associated with the QoS flow.

q_29113.question: What is the purpose of the SIP INFO request in sending the URL of the file where the MCVideo media stream will be recorded?
q_29113.ground_truth: The purpose of the SIP INFO request is to send additional information about the video call, specifically the URL of the file where the media stream will be recorded.

q_29114.question: What should the UE do with the mapped 5G security context if the handover is not completed successfully?
q_29114.ground_truth: The UE should delete the mapped 5G security context.

q_29115.question: What happens to the SMS over IP usage when the network operator's preference for selection of the domain to not invoke the SMS service over IP networks?
q_29115.ground_truth: The policy on usage of SMS over IP has no effect.

q_29116.question: What reference points are used in the EDGEAPP architecture for federation functionalities?
q_29116.ground_truth: EDGE-9 and EDGE-10 are used in the EDGEAPP architecture to support federation functionalities, such as EAS discovery, ECS registration, and service provisioning information retrieval. These reference points enable sharing of edges nodes and facilitate roaming, federation, and edge node sharing.

q_29117.question: What is the subcounter in MM.HoOutExe5gsToEpsReq that provides the number of failed executions at the source gNB for handovers from 5GS to EPS, split into subcounters per failure cause?

q_29118.question: What should the UE do if it receives a duplicate warning message in ETWS?
q_29118.ground_truth: For ETWS, the UE shall perform duplicate message detection independently for primary and secondary notifications and ignore the duplicated message.

q_29119.question: When should the UE stop the periodical reporting timer for a measId, if the cellsTriggeredList defined within the VarMeasReportList for that measId is empty?
q_29119.ground_truth: The UE should stop the periodical reporting timer for that measId if the cellsTriggeredList defined within the VarMeasReportList for that measId is empty.

q_29120.question: What parameters are used to evaluate the diversity performance of a massive MIMO antenna system?
q_29120.ground_truth: The primary parameters used for evaluating the diversity performance are isolation between antenna elements and envelope correlation coefficient (ECC).

q_29121.question: What should the non-controlling MCPTT function do if a prearranged group call is not ongoing and it receives a "SIP INVITE request for non-controlling MCPTT function of an MCPTT group" with a lack of resources or risk of congestion?
q_29121.ground_truth: The non-controlling MCPTT function may reject the SIP INVITE request with a SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response.

q_29122.question: What must the CPTT group do for the MCPTT imminent peril group call to the affiliated but not joined members of the chat MCPTT group?
q_29122.ground_truth: The CPTT group shall generate SIP INVITE requests for the MCPTT imminent peril group call to the affiliated but not joined members of the chat MCPTT group.

q_29123.question: What is the procedure for a 5GMS Client to request a bit rate recommendation using a Network Assistance Session identifier?
q_29123.ground_truth: The 5GMS Client may use the Network Assistance Session identifier to explicitly request a bit rate recommendation by invoking a remote procedure call provided for this purpose by the 5GMS~AF. This procedure is further specified in clause~11.6.4.3.

q_29124.question: What should be provided by the RSPP for unicast mode in the PC5 unicast link establishment procedure?
q_29124.ground_truth: The RSPP needs to provide the Application Layer IDs of the UE and the peer UE for the unicast mode in the PC5 unicast link establishment procedure.

q_29125.question: What does the A-ADRF store in the ADAE internal architecture?
q_29125.ground_truth: The A-ADRF stores historical data and/or analytics, i.e., data and/or analytics related to past time period that has been obtained by the consumer (e.g. ADAE server).

q_29126.question: What should be indicated for QoS parameters in the QoS Sustainability analytics output?
q_29126.ground_truth: The Crossed Reporting Thresholds for QoS parameters, such as Throughput, Delay, and Packet loss, should be indicated in the QoS Sustainability analytics output.

q_29127.question: What is the purpose of the "odb-all-interzonal-og-and-internat-og-not-to-HPLMN-country" feature?
q_29127.ground_truth: This feature allows for the implementation of the ability to perform interzonal and international GPRS operations, except for those restricted to the home PMLN country.

q_29128.question: What action should the receiving side of an AM RLC entity take when t-Reordering expires?
q_29128.ground_truth: When t-Reordering expires, the receiving side of an AM RLC entity should update the state variables and start t-Reordering as needed.

q_29129.question: In the Change of SSC mode 3 PDU Session Anchor procedure, when does the SMF determine that the serving UPF or the SMF needs to be changed?
q_29129.ground_truth: The SMF determines that the serving UPF or the SMF needs to be changed if the "Indication of application relocation possibility" attributes in the PCC rule indicate no DNAI change takes place once selected for this application.

q_29130.question: What message is used by IAB-MT to request the network to allocate IP addresses for the collocated IAB-DU or inform the network about IP addresses allocated to the collocated IAB-DU?

q_29131.question: What happens to the UE when it receives a request from upper layers to establish an eCall over IMS in the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.eCALL-INACTIVE substate?
q_29131.ground_truth: The UE enters the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION and uses the relevant 5GMM and 5GSM procedures to establish the eCall over IMS at the earliest opportunity.

q_29132.question: What is the purpose of the test in 7.5.4.2 of the specification?
q_29132.ground_truth: The purpose of the test in 7.5.4.2 is to verify that for each TAB connector receiver dynamic range, the relative throughput shall fulfill the specified limit.

q_29133.question: What happens when the P-CSCF has restarted and lost all bindings for a particular user, leading to the rejection of incoming requests with a 404 (Not Found) response?
q_29133.ground_truth: The P-CSCF initiates the restoration procedure by sending an indication to the HSS if UDM/HSS or HSS based P-CSCF restoration is applied, or includes the IMSI in a Restoration-Header field included in an initial INVITE request if PCF or PCRF based restoration is used.

q_29134.question: What happens if the PROSE DIRECT LINK AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message cannot be accepted by the target UE during the 5G ProSe direct link authentication procedure?
q_29134.ground_truth: The target UE creates a PROSE DIRECT LINK AUTHENTICATION REJECT message, indicating one of the cause values: lack of resources for 5G ProSe direct link or authentication failure.

q_29135.question: What does the IPUPS do in relation to GTP-U packets?
q_29135.ground_truth: The IPUPS forwards GTP-U packets that contain an F-TEID that belongs to an active PDU session and discards all others.

q_29136.question: How does Fred provision the 24/7 wearable monitoring device?
q_29136.ground_truth: Fred unpacks the device and scans the QR code using his 5G enabled UE, which initiates a sequence of events that includes the provisioning of credentials onto the 24/7 wearable monitoring device, enabling it to set up an identifiable connection to an application server through the 5G core network.

q_29137.question: What shall the UE do if it receives 5GMM cause #76 from a CAG cell and the CAG information list includes the serving VPLMN?
q_29137.ground_truth: The UE shall replace the serving VPLMN's entry of the "CAG information list" stored in the UE with the serving VPLMN's entry of the received CAG information list.

q_29138.question: What is the role of MAC reset after receiving an LTM cell switch command MAC CE?
q_29138.ground_truth: After receiving an LTM cell switch command MAC CE, the UE performs MAC reset to clear the data in the MAC layer before switching to the target cell.

q_29139.question: What must the TEID value be when both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses are present in the F-TEID IE?
q_29139.ground_truth: When both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses are present in the F-TEID IE, the TEID value must be shared by both addresses.

q_29140.question: What is the requirement for the UE to report RSTD measurements, as specified in the sub-clause 8.1.2.6.4?
q_29140.ground_truth: The UE physical layer shall be capable of reporting RSTD for the reference cell and all the neighbor cells i out of at least (n-1) neighbor cells within, provided that certain conditions are met.

q_29141.question: What is the purpose of Mobility Restrictions functionality?
q_29141.ground_truth: Mobility Restrictions functionality is provided by the UE, the radio access network, and the core network to restrict mobility handling of a UE in E-UTRAN access. Mobility Restriction functionality in ECM-IDLE is executed in UE based on information received from the core network, while in ECM-CONNECTED, it is executed in the radio network and the core network.

q_29142.question: What does the HSCSD automatic user initiated upgrading +CHSU command control in non-transparent HSCSD calls?
q_29142.ground_truth: The HSCSD automatic user initiated upgrading +CHSU command controls whether or not automatic user initiated service level upgrading is used for non-transparent HSCSD calls based on the UP bit in the received RLP frames.

q_29143.question: What action should the MCVideo client take if the media-level section for the offered MCVideo video media stream and the media-level section of the offered media-transmission control entity are not the same as what was negotiated in the existing pre-established session, when sending a SIP re-INVITE request within a pre-established session?
q_29143.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should indicate this as specified in clause~6.4, and shall not include an SDP offer with the media parameters that differ from the existing pre-established session.

q_29144.question: What should the source RNC include in the Relocation Required message for a handover to a hybrid cell?
q_29144.ground_truth: The source RNC should include the CSG access mode in the Relocation Required message when the target cell is a hybrid cell.

q_29145.question: What is the main objective of Solution #61 in the context of improving the correctness of NWDAF analytics?
q_29145.ground_truth: The main objective of Solution #61 is to use a historical ML model with different model information as Priori Knowledge and train it upon new datasets, aiming to achieve higher accuracy than retraining a new ML model.

q_29146.question: What should the ME do upon receiving an OPEN CHANNEL command related to (I-)WLAN bearer, if the user stops the (I-)WLAN service activation attempt before a result is received from the network?
q_29146.ground_truth: The ME informs the UICC using TERMINAL RESPONSE (user cleared down call before connection or network release)

q_29147.question: What will be the BSF response if the "PCF for a UE Bindings" resource does not exist in 4.2.4.3?
q_29147.ground_truth: The BSF shall respond with a "404 Not Found" HTTP error code.

q_29148.question: What is used as the transport layer for RSPP in V2X capable UEs and 5G ProSe capable UEs?
q_29148.ground_truth: PC5-U is used as the transport layer for RSPP in both V2X capable UEs and 5G ProSe capable UEs.

q_29149.question: What are the functions of the MME in the 3GPP network?
q_29149.ground_truth: The MME is responsible for functions such as E-UTRAN access control, roaming, authentication, bearer management, and support for PWS message transmission.

q_29150.question: What should the MCPTT imminent peril group call state be set to if the MCPTT imminent peril group call state is set to "MIGC 2: imminent-peril-call-requested", and the SIP RE-INVITE request contains an <imminentperil-ind> element set to a value of "false" and an <emergency-ind> element set to a value of "true"?
q_29150.ground_truth: The MCPTT imminent peril group state should be set to "MIG 2: in-progress".

q_29151.question: Which clause in 3GPP TS 36.133 defines Nfreq?
q_29151.ground_truth: Nfreq is defined in clause 8.1.2.1.1 of 3GPP TS 36.133.

q_29152.question: What is the threat name for the potential disclosure of sensitive information about the GNP and its operation?

q_29153.question: Which command is used to activate or deactivate the UAE layer support in the MT?
q_29153.ground_truth: The +CUAEACT command is used to activate or deactivate the UAE layer support in the MT.

q_29154.question: In what situation would the UP function assign an IPv6 address?
q_29154.ground_truth: The UP function shall assign an IPv6 address if bit 6 (CHV6) is set to "1" and the V6 bit or CHV6 bit is set to "1" and the IPv6 address field is not present in the UE IP Address.

q_29155.question: What are the conditions for an SMTC occasion and a measurement gap occasion to be considered colliding?
q_29155.ground_truth: The SMTC occasion and the measurement gap occasion are considered colliding if they are fully or partially overlapping in time domain or if the magnitude of the distance between them in time domain is less than or equal to 4ms.

q_29156.question: What is the procedure followed by the I-CSCF upon receiving an initial request with more than one Route header field?
q_29156.ground_truth: The I-CSCF removes its own SIP URI from the topmost Route header field and forwards the request based on the topmost Route header field.

q_29157.question: In what situations should the UE initiate the UL message segment transfer procedure?
q_29157.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the UL message segment transfer procedure if the RRC message segmentation is enabled and the encoded RRC message is larger than the maximum supported size of a PDCP SDU.

q_29158.question: In what situation would a participating MCVideo function reject a SIP REFER request for a pre-established session with a SIP 404 (Not Found) response?
q_29158.ground_truth: If the participating MCVideo function is unable to identify the controlling MCVideo function for the private call service associated with the originating user's MCVideo ID.

q_29159.question: What is the function of KSEAF in the key hierarchy in the EAP-AKA' authentication method?
q_29159.ground_truth: KSEAF is the anchor key in the key hierarchy and is used to derive the KAMF using the ABBA parameter and the SUPI.

q_29160.question: When the UE is in Automatic network selection mode, what will it do if it is camped on a VPLMN cell and cells of a HPLMN are available when the higher priority PLMN search timer T expires?
q_29160.ground_truth: The UE will select and camp on a cell of the HPLMN and attempt a Tracking Area Update on the selected cell, indicating the selected PLMN to the user upon successful registration.

q_29161.question: What is the purpose of the MDAS producer in relation to network slice throughput?
q_29161.ground_truth: The MDAS producer assists the consumer in analyzing network slice throughput issues and identifying root causes to ensure throughput assurance. It can work at both the domain-specific and cross-domain levels for optimum throughput performance.

q_29162.question: What is the time duration of T1 and T2 in sub-test 1 and sub-test 2?
q_29162.ground_truth: T1 is 200 ms and T2 is 1000 ms in both sub-tests.

q_29163.question: When should the UE resend the BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message and reset timer T3481 upon the first expiry of timer T3481?
q_29163.ground_truth: The UE should resend the BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message and reset timer T3481 upon the first expiry of timer T3481.

q_29164.question: What is the significance of the <n> parameter in the definition of the <stat> value in the +CREG command?
q_29164.ground_truth: The <n> parameter in the definition of the <stat> value in the +CREG command indicates the circuit mode registration status.

q_29165.question: What protocol is used between the P-GW and a Diameter server or proxy for applications to deliver information related to the user session?

q_29166.question: What is the maximum number of "restricted-discovery-filter" elements that can be present in the "RestrictedMonitorRsp-info" complex type?
q_29166.ground_truth: The maximum number of "restricted-discovery-filter" elements that can be present in the "RestrictedMonitorRsp-info" complex type is unbounded, meaning there is no limit on the number of occurrences.

q_29167.question: What is the implication of 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay for the emergency services over ProSe U2N Relay?
q_29167.ground_truth: 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay provides a critical connection for the user of the remote UE and Public Safety Access Point that is reached through UE's emergency call.

q_29168.question: What is the purpose of the XML HMAC signature mechanism in the example provided?
q_29168.ground_truth: The XML HMAC signature mechanism in the example provided is used for integrity protection of XML MIME bodies transported in SIP requests and responses.

q_29169.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement specified in section 17.3.2.2.4.3?
q_29169.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 17.3.2.2.0.2.

q_29170.question: Who controls model/functionality in the network-side model inference in a network?
q_29170.ground_truth: The gNB controls the model/functionality in the network-side model inference, where inference is performed and input data is generated at the UE.

q_29171.question: What is the objective of T1 in the test?
q_29171.ground_truth: During T1, the test checks if the UE's channel occupancy ratio is higher than 1% when the sidelink UEs transmit with a low CBR.

q_29172.question: In case 1, what error will the network report for the TFT operation "Delete packet filters from existing TFT"?
q_29172.ground_truth: The network will reject the modification request with ESM cause #41 "semantic error in the TFT operation".

q_29173.question: What should the AMF do if there are PDU sessions that failed to handover due to timeout of SMF responses in any step of the handover preparation phase?
q_29173.ground_truth: The AMF should consider that the PDU session will be released by the MME and remove the PDU session context from the UE context. For a Home Routed PDU session or a PDU session with I-SMF, the AMF should also release the SM Context in the V-SMF or the I-SMF only.

q_29174.question: What is the function of the 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-UE Relay Communication?
q_29174.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-UE Relay provides the functionality to support connectivity between 5G ProSe Layer-3 End UEs. A 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-UE Relay and 5G ProSe Layer-3 End UEs can be located within NG-RAN coverage or outside of NG-RAN coverage. The 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-UE Relay is responsible for relaying any IP, Ethernet or Unstructured traffic for 5G ProSe applications.

q_29175.question: What action is recommended for video encoders when transitioning from a held full-duplex session to a full-duplex session in the HOLD supplementary service?
q_29175.ground_truth: The recommended action for video encoders is to start the updated session with a full infra refresh.

q_29176.question: What is the maximum number of CSI-RS resources that can be specified in the "supportedCSI-RS-ResourceList-r18" parameter?
q_29176.ground_truth: The maximum number of CSI-RS resources that can be specified in the "supportedCSI-RS-ResourceList-r18" parameter is "maxNrofCSI-RS-ResourcesExt-r16".

q_29177.question: What is the role of PDU Set Error Rate (PSER) parameter in 5G networks?
q_29177.ground_truth: The PDU Set Error Rate (PSER) parameter, when indicated, overrides the PER (Packet Error Rate) of the corresponding 5QI in the control plane of 5G networks.

q_29178.question: What is the general rule for processing piggybacked initial messages?
q_29178.ground_truth: The triggered response message carrying the piggybacked message is processed first, followed by the independent processing of the piggybacked initial message. If the processing of a dedicated bearer activation message results in an error, this should not affect the default bearer establishment. If the default bearer establishment fails, the dedicated bearer activation related message is discarded.

q_29179.question: What is the variable that represents the carrier specific scaling factor for PRS-RSRP measurements, in the equation for the scaling factor for a positioning frequency layer within the associated measurement gap pattern?
q_29179.ground_truth: is the carrier specific scaling factor for PRS-RSRP measurements.

q_29180.question: What are the two subcategories of runtime-based method for managing UEs returning from a hosting network to their home network?
q_29180.ground_truth: The two subcategories of runtime-based method for managing UEs returning from a hosting network to their home network are (1) using existing mechanisms without any additional enhancements, and (2) grouping UEs to create an Internal-Group Identifier specific to local hosting network and/or local service and then reusing the existing UE group-specific NAS level congestion control mechanism.

q_29181.question: What should the transmission participant do upon receiving RTP media packets with a SSRC not associated with any transmitter stored in the transmitter list?
q_29181.ground_truth: The transmission participant should request the MCVideo client to render the received RTP media packets, store the SSRC of the RTP media packet in the transmitter list as an unknown user, start the T203 (End of RTP media) timer associated with the SSRC, and remain in the 'O: transmission arbitration' state.

q_29182.question: What does the NWDAF provide as output for DN Performance Analytics?
q_29182.ground_truth: The NWDAF provides analytics for user plane performance in the form of statistics or predictions to a service consumer for a specific Edge Computing application or a specific UE, group of UEs, or any UE over a specific serving anchor UPF, DNAI, or Edge Application Server Instance.

q_29183.question: Which protocol element is conditional to be included in the "MeasurementRequest-IEs" sequence?
q_29183.ground_truth: The "ID id-MeasurementPeriodicityExtended" element is conditional in the "MeasurementRequest-IEs" sequence, only when the MeasurementPeriodicity IE is set to the value "extended".

q_29184.question: What is the purpose of having a Weight Factor per DCN in a network with the same PLMN and MMEGI value?
q_29184.ground_truth: The Weight Factor per DCN is used to achieve load balancing across MMEs of the same MME pool area supporting the same DCN, based on the capacity of an MME node for a specific DCN relative to other MME nodes' capacity for that DCN.

q_29185.question: What is the role of the NWDAF in the 5G network?
q_29185.ground_truth: The NWDAF provides potentially aggregated analytics to the AMF in the 5G network.

q_29186.question: What is the role of the "MulticastSessionDeactivationRequest" structure in the NGAP-PROTOCOL-IES for 5G mobile communication networks?
q_29186.ground_truth: The "MulticastSessionDeactivationRequest" structure is a message in the NGAP-PROTOCOL-IES used in 5G mobile communication networks to request the deactivation of a multicast session from the network. The message contains various fields that are used to specify the session and the reason for deactivating it.

q_29187.question: What is the purpose of the Re-attempt indicator information element?
q_29187.ground_truth: The purpose of the Re-attempt indicator information element is to indicate a condition under which the MS is allowed to re-attempt an EPS session management procedure.

q_29188.question: In the context of NG-U TNL information and associated list of QoS flows, what information does the "QoS Flow per TNL Information" IE indicate?
q_29188.ground_truth: The "QoS Flow per TNL Information" IE indicates the NG-U transport layer information and associated list of QoS flows for a UE's communication.

q_29189.question: Under which circumstances should a SIP re-INVITE request be used to cancel the in-progress imminent peril group state of the group?
q_29189.ground_truth: This occurs when a member of the MCVideo group wishes to cancel the in-progress imminent peril state of the group.

q_29190.question: What signaling protocol is used between the P-GW and the PDN, when initial IPv4 address is not available for the UE?

q_29191.question: What H.265/HEVC video resolution is required to be supported by a 5GMSd Client that supports the Television (TV) profile?
q_29191.ground_truth: A 5GMSd Client that supports the Television (TV) profile should support the H.265/HEVC 720p HD, Full HD, UHD, Full HD HDR, and UHD HDR Operation Point Receiver requirements.

q_29192.question: In which operating bands is the minimum requirement for the transmitter transient period applicable in the case of a multi-band TAB connector?
q_29192.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for the transmitter transient period is applicable during the transmitter OFF period in all supported operating bands for a multi-band TAB connector.

q_29193.question: What are the two methods for sending an announcement during the establishment of a communication session as defined in 3GPP TS 24.628?
q_29193.ground_truth: The two methods are sending an announcement as early media and sending an Alert-Info header field in the 180 (Ringing) response to the INVITE request.

q_29194.question: What is the purpose of the hop-by-hop security establishment procedure in the UE-to-UE relay solution?
q_29194.ground_truth: The hop-by-hop security establishment procedure in the UE-to-UE relay solution aims to secure the communication between the Source UE, Target UE, and the UE-to-UE Relay, both within and outside the network coverage.

q_29195.question: What actions does the receiving side of an AM RLC entity perform when it receives AMD PDUs?
q_29195.ground_truth: The receiving side of an AM RLC entity detects duplicated AMD PDUs and discards them, detects the loss of AMD PDUs and requests retransmissions, and reassembles RLC SDUs from received AMD PDUs.

q_29196.question: What is the role of the EIR in checking the mobile equipment identity?
q_29196.ground_truth: The EIR identifies the mobile equipment based on the first 14 digits of the IMEI AVP and may also use the Software-Version AVP to check against prohibited and tracking lists.

q_29197.question: What is the purpose of the Local IP Access (LIPA) function in the HeNB system?
q_29197.ground_truth: The LIPA function enables a UE connected via a HeNB to access other entities in the same residential/enterprise network without the user plane traversing the mobile operator's network except the HeNB subsystem.

q_29198.question: When must the UE not respond to a paging message, even if it receives one?
q_29198.ground_truth: The UE must not respond to the paging message if the paging identity is TMGI and it matches with a multicast MBS session that the UE has joined.

q_29199.question: What information does the PCF send to the NF service consumer when it invokes the Npcf_PolicyAuthorization_Notify service operation to trigger the creation of an Individual Application Session Context resource?
q_29199.ground_truth: The PCF sends the "PduSessionTsnBridge" data type including TSC user plane node information such as the tsnBridgeInfo attribute, the tsnPortManContDstt attribute and/or the tsnPortManContNwtts attribute (if available), MTU size for IPv4 and IPv6 (if the "MTU_Size" feature is supported), and UE IPv4 address, UE IPv6 prefix, DNN, S-NSSAI, and domain identity (if available) in the HTTP POST request.

q_29200.question: What is the standard for MP-DCCP-LL solution to create an MP-DCCP connection to carry the traffic that matches a derived QoS rule?
q_29200.ground_truth: The MP-DCCP-LL solution does not specify how an MP-DCCP connection can be created to carry the traffic that matches a derived QoS rule.

q_29201.question: What is the measurement period requirement for the UE, as specified in clause 4.5.5.5?
q_29201.ground_truth: The UE should be able to measure multiple DL RSTD and DL RSCPD measurements during the measurement period as specified in the clause, which depends on various factors such as the number of positioning frequency layers, the periodicity of the PRS RSTD measurement in each positioning frequency layer, and the UE Rx beam sweeping factor.

q_29202.question: In Urban scenario at 2.6 GHz with DL PSD of 33 dBm/MHz, what is the characteristic of the representative values of the coverage margins for the potential Rel-18 UE with maximum 12-PRB bandwidth for all channels with 3-dB UE antenna efficiency loss?
q_29202.ground_truth: The representative values of the coverage margins for the potential Rel-18 UE with maximum 12-PRB bandwidth for all channels with 3-dB UE antenna efficiency loss are positive, indicating better coverage than the bottleneck channel of the reference NR UE.

q_29203.question: What does the information flow IWF floor granted indicate in interworking floor control?
q_29203.ground_truth: The information flow IWF floor granted is used to indicate that a request for floor is granted and media transfer is possible, from the IWF to the MCPTT floor control server and from the MCPTT floor control server to the IWF.

q_29204.question: What is the main function of the "Uplink Message Delivery" notification?
q_29204.ground_truth: The "Uplink Message Delivery" notification is used by the VAE Server to deliver an uplink message to the update the policy.

q_29205.question: In the third-party REGISTER request, what should the S-CSCF include in the message body if there is only one message body to be included?
q_29205.ground_truth: The S-CSCF sets the Content-Type header field to the content type specified for the body.

q_29206.question: What message does the server send to the target in step 1 of the Periodic Assistance Data Transfer procedure to indicate the update capabilities of the target device?

q_29207.question: What action does the TSCTSF take when it receives information from the PCF for device side ports but does not have a corresponding AF session?
q_29207.ground_truth: The TSCTSF creates an AF session with the PCF when it does not have a corresponding AF session upon reception of the information from the PCF for device side ports.

q_29208.question: What data type is specified for the "transaction-ID" element in the "RestrictedDiscReq-info" complex type?
q_29208.ground_truth: The "transaction-ID" element in the "RestrictedDiscReq-info" complex type is specified as an "xs:integer" data type.

q_29209.question: What is the maximum value for the length of BCD number/SSC contents in EFADN?
q_29209.ground_truth: The maximum value for the length of BCD number/SSC contents in EFADN is 11.

q_29210.question: What should the reporting periodicity be for CSI in this test?
q_29210.ground_truth: The reporting periodicity for CSI should be 5 ms in this test.

q_29211.question: What is the implication of the update flag parameter from the AMF indicating decrease?
q_29211.ground_truth: The NSACF removes the entry associated with the NF ID upon reception of a request having update flag indicating decrease.

q_29212.question: What is the role of the PCRF in providing static QoS policies for non-3GPP access in case of non-support of Gxa/b or S9 interface?
q_29212.ground_truth: The PCRF can provide the static QoS policies for non-3GPP access to the PDN GW through the Gx interface if present and supported.

q_29213.question: What is the significance of the IP address range in the MC client's communication with the MC server?
q_29213.ground_truth: The IP address range must be known by the MC service environment beforehand to enable the MC client's host routing between the MC client and the MC server via an MC gateway UE.

q_29214.question: In the procedure of Ranging/SL positioning, what kind of UEs are involved in the result calculation if a higher location accuracy is required?
q_29214.ground_truth: Both UE and LMF will be involved for result calculation

q_29215.question: In the NF Service Consumer's POST request for CancelLocation service operation, what does the "CancelLocInfo" data structure indicate?
q_29215.ground_truth: The "CancelLocInfo" data structure in the POST request for CancelLocation service operation indicates the desired cancellation of reporting periodic or events triggered location of the UE.

q_29216.question: What is the purpose of the uplink NAS COUNT associated with the most recent NAS Security Mode Complete in non-3GPP access?
q_29216.ground_truth: It is used as the parameter in the derivation of the KN3IWF in non-3GPP access.

q_29217.question: When a voice centric CSFB capable UE receives "CSFB Not Preferred" or "SMS-only" indication during combined EPS/IMSI attach or combined TA/LA Update procedures and cannot obtain voice services over IMS, which radio access networks can it re-select to?

q_29218.question: Which protocol is used for the 3GP-DASH quality reporting protocol for reporting QoE metrics?
q_29218.ground_truth: The 3GP-DASH quality reporting protocol is used for the 3GP-DASH quality reporting scheme, which specifies the XML-based report format and the reporting protocol to report QoE metrics.

q_29219.question: What is the challenge described in 6.1.1.1.1 related to V2P communications, specifically for a pedestrian UE?
q_29219.ground_truth: The challenge is that a pedestrian UE might have a lower battery capacity and limited radio capability, and therefore may have to work in a low power consumption mode. Continuous sending/receiving V2X messages by the pedestrian UE would affect UE power efficiency.

q_29220.question: How many classes of acoustical interface are considered in the document?
q_29220.ground_truth: Five classes of acoustical interface are considered in the document: handset UE, softphone UE used as a handset, headset UE, softphone UE used with headset, desktop-mounted hands-free UE, softphone UE with external loudspeaker(s) in hands-free mode, hand-held hands-free UE, and softphone UE with internal loudspeaker(s) in hands-free mode.

q_29221.question: What is a characteristic of the input CMAF track that can be described by a DASH MPD manifest in order to correctly initialize the media transcoder?
q_29221.ground_truth: Maximum segment duration, video width, height, and frame rate

q_29222.question: What is user-plane resources in 3GPP TS 23.501?
q_29222.ground_truth: User-plane resources in 3GPP TS 23.501 are resources established between the UE and the UPF, which consist of one or more of the following: user plane radio bearers via the Uu reference point, a tunnel via the N3 reference point and a tunnel via the N9 reference point (if any) for 3GPP access; IPsec tunnels via the NWu reference point, a tunnel via the N3 reference point and a tunnel via the N9 reference point (if any) for untrusted non-3GPP access; IPsec tunnels via the NWt reference point, a tunnel via the N3 reference point and a tunnel via the N9 reference point (if any) for trusted non-3GPP access; a layer-2 connection via the Yt reference point, a layer-2 or layer-3 connection via the Yw reference point, a tunnel via the N3 reference point and a tunnel via the N9 reference point (if any) for trusted non-3GPP access used by the UE; W-UP resources via Y4 reference point, a tunnel via the N3 reference point and a tunnel via the N9 reference point (if any) for wireline access used by the 5G-RG; and L-W-UP resources via Y5 reference point, a tunnel via the N3 reference point and a tunnel via the N9 reference point (if any) for wireline access used by the FN-RG.

q_29223.question: Under which condition must the "discSupportedProc-r12" parameter be present?
q_29223.ground_truth: The "discSupportedProc-r12" parameter must be present if sidelink discovery is supported on at least one band, which is indicated by the "discSupportedBands-r12" parameter.

q_29224.question: What is the purpose of the test described in section 8.16.21?
q_29224.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described in section 8.16.21 is to verify the UE's ability to make correct reportings of Event A2 under deactivated SCell in non-DRX for 20MHz+10MHz bandwidth.

q_29225.question: After successfully passing the integrity check, which indicators must the UE store from the received SOR transparent container IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message?
q_29225.ground_truth: The UE must store the SOR counter and set the ME support of SOR-CMCI indicator to "SOR-CMCI supported by the ME" when specified in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message. Additionally, the UE may set the SOR-SNPN-SI and SOR-SNPN-SI-LS indicators if supported and applicable.

q_29226.question: What type of network access is not supported by the MPTCP functionality with any steering mode?
q_29226.ground_truth: The MPTCP functionality with any steering mode is not supported for MA PDU sessions of Ethernet type.
