q_29227.question: What is the maximum rate of ACK/NACK feedback loss allowed for interruptions due to RRM measurements on dormant SCell(s) during SCell dormancy?
q_29227.ground_truth: The rate of ACK/NACK feedback loss on any non-dormant serving cell resulting from RRM measurements on dormant SCells shall not exceed 1.0%.

q_29228.question: What kind of interface is used for the PC5 Unicast link for C2 communication in the solution "C2 Communication via PC5"?
q_29228.ground_truth: The PC5 Unicast link for C2 communication in the solution "C2 Communication via PC5" is supported over the NR based PC5 reference point.

q_29229.question: What is the recommended approach for avoiding ambiguity in the use of "may" and "need not" constructions in 3GPP specifications?
q_29229.ground_truth: The recommended approach is to use the unambiguous constructions "might not" or "shall not" instead.

q_29230.question: What is the difference between activation/hibernation and deactivation in the test procedure for E-UTRAN TDD hibernation and activation of unknown SCell in non-DRX test?
q_29230.ground_truth: During activation/hibernation, the first CSI report is checked, while during deactivation, the last CSI report is not checked since it would have already stopped. A possible DTX period is observed during activation/hibernation while during deactivation, the DTX period would have already occurred during T5.

q_29231.question: What is the role of an IWF in group affiliation to an interworking group defined in the MC system?
q_29231.ground_truth: The IWF can inform the MC service server of group affiliations on behalf of the LMR system. When the IWF has affiliated to a group, the MCPTT system recognizes this as an affiliation on behalf of the LMR users associated with the IWF, and allows requests from these users for actions on the group to which the IWF has affiliated.

q_29232.question: What is the meaning of "maxNrofCandidateBeams-r16" in the context of candidateBeamRS-List-r16?
q_29232.ground_truth: The value of "maxNrofCandidateBeams-r16" defines the maximum number of candidate beams in the list for a given RAT type.

q_29233.question: Which release of NR UE does the test applicability in 6.7.6.1.2 apply to?
q_29233.ground_truth: The test applies to all types of NR UE from Release 15 onwards supporting E-UTRA.

q_29234.question: What is the role of NAPTR records in the S-NAPTR procedure?
q_29234.ground_truth: NAPTR records are used to identify a list of host names, each with a service, protocol, port, and a list of IPv4 and IPv6 addresses. These records are used consistently in the S-NAPTR procedure to specify the rules for determining the domain name syntax and parameter values.

q_29235.question: What information can the NWDAF collect from a target UE or group of target UEs using LCS in procedure 6.2.12.1?
q_29235.ground_truth: The NWDAF can collect various information such as location estimate, time stamp, velocity, information about positioning method used, indication of area event or motion event.

q_29236.question: What is the value of mpdcch-NumRepetition-Paging-r13 for Type1-common search space for P-RNTI?
q_29236.ground_truth: The value of mpdcch-NumRepetition-Paging-r13 for Type1-common search space for P-RNTI is r16.

q_29237.question: What should the UE do when an emergency service is started and a registration, de-registration or service request procedure or an uplink user data packet is triggered?
q_29237.ground_truth: The UE maps such attempts to access category 2 (emergency) while the emergency service is ongoing.

q_29238.question: What is the purpose of the "extraCertsField" when sending a PKIMessage in the NF and CA/RA communication?
q_29238.ground_truth: The "extraCertsField" is used to include necessary intermediate CA certificates when the NF certificate is not signed directly by a root CA. It is omitted when sending a PKIMessage carrying the certificate confirm request and confirmation response.

q_29239.question: Which solutions address key issue 1l that deals with charging quota management?

q_29240.question: How do the UE and AMF maintain 5G NAS security contexts?
q_29240.ground_truth: The UE and AMF can maintain two 5G NAS security contexts simultaneously, a current and a non-current, in case of a 5G re-authentication, during an inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode, or when the UE supports both S1 mode and N1 mode. The number of 5G NAS security contexts to be maintained is limited by specific requirements.

q_29241.question: What does the first bit (leftmost bit) of a bit string represent in terms of significance in the context of the semantics description of an IE?
q_29241.ground_truth: The first bit (leftmost bit) of a bit string contains the most significant bit (MSB).

q_29242.question: What is the role of the source NG-RAN in sending "end marker" packets during handover?
q_29242.ground_truth: The source NG-RAN is responsible for forwarding "end marker" packets to the target NG-RAN immediately after switching the path.

q_29243.question: What action should the controlling MCPTT function take if it receives an MCPTT emergency group call and the in-progress emergency state of the group is set to "false"?
q_29243.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function should set the in-progress emergency state of the group to "true", start timer TNG2 (in-progress emergency group call timer), handle its expiry as specified in clause~6.3.3.1.16, generate SIP re-INVITE requests for the MCPTT emergency group call to the other call participants, and send the SIP re-INVITEs towards the other participants of the MCPTT group call.

q_29244.question: In Topology 2, what is the role of the intermediate node?
q_29244.ground_truth: In Topology 2, the intermediate node acts as a relay, transferring Ambient IoT data and/or signalling between the basestation (BS) and the Ambient IoT device.

q_29245.question: When should the mobile station (MS) stop the READY timer in Iu mode?
q_29245.ground_truth: The MS should stop the READY timer upon completion of a successful GPRS attach or routing area updating procedure in Iu mode.

q_29246.question: What is one of the potential new requirements (PR) needed to support the media share within PINs use case?
q_29246.ground_truth: One of the potential new requirements is for the 5G system to support that a PIN Element may be a member of more than one PIN.

q_29247.question: What is the function of the N4 Association Update Procedure in 4G Core Network?
q_29247.ground_truth: The N4 Association Update Procedure is used to modify an existing N4 association between the SMF and the UPF, allowing for updating of the supported features or available resources of the UP function.

q_29248.question: What must a UE obtain for generating a UTC-based counter in the context of 5G ProSe direct discovery?
q_29248.ground_truth: The UE must obtain a valid UTC time for the discovery transmission from the lower layers.

q_29249.question: What is the purpose of redundant transmission in URLLC communication?
q_29249.ground_truth: The purpose of redundant transmission in URLLC communication is to support highly reliable URLLC services. It can be achieved through three different methods: dual connectivity based end to end redundant user plane paths, redundant transmission on N3/N9 interfaces, or redundant transmission at transport layer.

q_29250.question: What should be the bandwidth selection for the base station RF if 5 MHz E-UTRA carriers are not supported by the beam?
q_29250.ground_truth: The narrowest supported channel bandwidth should be selected instead for the base station RF bandwidth.

q_29251.question: What is the drx-InactivityTimer, and what does it specify?
q_29251.ground_truth: The drx-InactivityTimer specifies the number of consecutive PDCCH-subframe(s) after successfully decoding a PDCCH indicating an initial UL or DL user data transmission for this UE.

q_29252.question: What does the "V2X Services Authorized" IE indicate in relation to the UE?
q_29252.ground_truth: The "V2X Services Authorized" IE provides information on the authorization status of the UE to use the sidelink for V2X services.

q_29253.question: Which off-network signalling requests can a client be authorized to use?
q_29253.ground_truth: A client can be authorised to use specific off-network signalling requests, such as MCPTT Group call announcement, MCPTT emergency alert announcement, MCVideo Capability request, etc.

q_29254.question: What is the role of the MSGin5G Client on the MSGin5G UE in the registration process with the Application Client on the non-MSGin5G UE?
q_29254.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Client on the MSGin5G UE retrieves the transport identifier from the transport layer, which can be a Layer-2 ID like a MAC address or a Layer-3 ID like an IP address with a specific UDP port.

q_29255.question: What is the function of the EF~SDN file?
q_29255.ground_truth: The EF~SDN file contains special service numbers (SDN) and/or the respective supplementary service control strings (SSC).

q_29256.question: What action does the UE take when the network does not indicate the support of 3GPP PS data off in the default bearer context activation procedure, but later indicates it in the UE-requested bearer resource modification procedure?
q_29256.ground_truth: If the network does not provide the support of 3GPP PS data off in the default bearer context activation procedure but indicates it in the UE-requested bearer resource modification procedure, the UE shall indicate the change of the 3GPP PS data off UE status for the PDN connection by using the UE-requested bearer resource modification procedure as specified in clause 6.5.4.

q_29257.question: If another PCF is serving the MBS session, what action should the current PCF take?
q_29257.ground_truth: The PCF should indicate to the MB-SMF that another PCF serving the MBS session shall be contacted and provide the ID of that other PCF. The MB-SMF will then repeat the procedure towards that other PCF.

q_29258.question: What must the AF include in the payload of the HTTP POST request when sending an acknowledgment for the UP path management event notification and if the application layer is ready?
q_29258.ground_truth: The AF shall include the AfAckInfo data type with the "afStatus" attribute set to "SUCCESS" in the payload of the HTTP POST request.

q_29259.question: What parameter is used by the VLR to indicate to the HLR that SoLSA is supported?

q_29260.question: What is the difference between Direct Mode and Off-Network communications in the rail sector?
q_29260.ground_truth: Direct Mode refers to the ability of User Equipment to communicate directly with each other, independent of the network, while Off-Network communications can be used for communication where network services are not available, and 3GPP MCX specifications allow Off-Network communications to be set up even when network services are available.

q_29261.question: What is the purpose of the Maximum Bit Rate field for transparent and non-transparent CS data services?
q_29261.ground_truth: The Maximum Bit Rate field is used to make code reservations in the downlink of the radio interface for CS data services. It can limit the delivered bit-rate to applications or external networks with limitations or allow maximum wanted user bit-rate to be defined for applications able to operate with different rates.

q_29262.question: What should be the system's approach to managing VNF attestation?
q_29262.ground_truth: Solutions are required both inside and outside 3GPP for effective VNF attestation management in a 3GPP network.

q_29263.question: What should an external renderer apply to the metadata provided in the interface of MPEG-H 3DA?
q_29263.ground_truth: An external renderer should apply the metadata provided in the interface of MPEG-H 3DA in the same manner as if MPEG-H internal rendering is applied, including preserving intended target loudness, applying transmitted Downmix and HOA Rendering matrices correctly, and rendering spatial attributes of objects appropriately.

q_29264.question: When is the PCF required to provide received DS-TT and/or NW-TT PMIC(s) and/or UMIC for the corresponding PDU session in 3GPP TS 29.512?
q_29264.ground_truth: As a result of the NF service consumer providing DS-TT and/or NW-TT PMIC(s) and/or UMIC for the corresponding PDU session in the 3GPP TS 29.512.

q_29265.question: What are the performance criteria for transient phenomena for BS in section 6.2?
q_29265.ground_truth: At the conclusion of the total test, the EUT shall operate as intended with no loss of user control functions or stored data, as specified by the manufacturer, and the communication link shall have been maintained.

q_29266.question: What should the UP function have at least in order to perform traffic redirection through the UP function (UP)?
q_29266.ground_truth: The UP function should have at least one HTTP packet for traffic redirection.

q_29267.question: What is the purpose of the list of "PLMNs not allowed to operate at the present UE location" in the satellite E-UTRAN access?
q_29267.ground_truth: The list is used to store a PLMN's identity, geographical location, and a UE-implementation specific distance value when the UE receives an ATTACH REJECT or TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message with certain EMM causes. The UE uses this list to prevent accessing a PLMN unlikely to be in a UE's location.

q_29268.question: In what context should the numberOfReportsSent be set to 0 when the entry condition is fulfilled for one or more applicable CSI-RS resources not included in the csi-RS-TriggeredList for all measurements after layer 3 filtering?
q_29268.ground_truth: If the trigger type is set to event and the entry condition is fulfilled for one or more applicable CSI-RS resources not included in the csi-RS-TriggeredList for all measurements after layer 3 filtering, set the numberOfReportsSent to 0, include the concerned CSI-RS resource(s) in the csi-RS-TriggeredList, and initiate the measurement reporting procedure.

q_29269.question: What should the UE do if no DNS response is received when selecting an ePDG?
q_29269.ground_truth: The UE should terminate the ePDG selection procedure.

q_29270.question: What action should the UE take if it does not receive the corresponding radio resources in the NG-RAN for a specific QoS Flow with a default QoS Rule of a PDU Session?
q_29270.ground_truth: The UE considers that the user plane of this PDU Session is deactivated.

q_29271.question: What is the reason for extending the "customized MOS at AF or QoE metrics at UE (via AF)" service in the context of FL operation?
q_29271.ground_truth: The extension is required because FL is one of the new main service types supported by 5GS and is used as a platform to support AI/ML services.

q_29272.question: What is the maximum number of carriers that can be used in a NB-IoT system?
q_29272.ground_truth: The maximum number of carriers (maxCarrier-r14) that can be used in a NB-IoT system is 5.

q_29273.question: What should the UE do in step 6 of the procedure if it fails to send SR on PUCCH for PSCell in the first available uplink SR resource no later than T3?
q_29273.ground_truth: If the UE fails to send SR on PUCCH for PSCell in the first available uplink SR resource no later than T3, it should increase the number of failed iterations by one, switch off the UE, and continue with step 11 of the procedure.

q_29274.question: What is the effect of CDMA2000 synchronousSystemTime changes on system information change notification and systemInfoValueTag in SIB1 in TTCN?
q_29274.ground_truth: The changes of CDMA2000 synchronousSystemTime will not result in system information change notification, nor in a modification of systemInfoValueTag in SIB1 in TTCN.

q_29275.question: What is the applicability rule for 1024QAM capable UEs if corresponding tests specified in the 4Rx CA/DC test lists are tested?
q_29275.ground_truth: The test coverage can be considered fulfilled without executing the corresponding tests listed from the 2Rx CA/DC test lists.

q_29276.question: What is the role of the PDN GW in determining a change in the authorized QoS of a service data flow?
q_29276.ground_truth: The PDN GW uses the locally applied QoS policy to determine if the authorized QoS of a service data flow has changed, and then generates the Traffic Flow Template (TFT) and updates the EPS Bearer QoS to match the traffic flow aggregate.

q_29277.question: What should be the initial conditions of the System Simulator for the IMS MT video call establishment procedure in 5GC?
q_29277.ground_truth: The System Simulator should have 1 NR Cell connected to 5GC with default parameters.

q_29278.question: Who is responsible for determining the list of UE IDs that fulfill a proximity criterion in relative proximity analytics?
q_29278.ground_truth: The DCAF determines the list of UE IDs that fulfill a proximity criterion in relative proximity analytics based on the input information collected from the UE application.

q_29279.question: How is a BAP SDU encapsulating a non-F1 packet considered to be received from, in cases where the same IP address is shared by two logical DUs?
q_29279.ground_truth: It is up to the mobile IAB-node's implementation to decide the logical DU where a BAP SDU encapsulating a non-F1 packet is considered to be received from. The non-F1 traffic does not have to be confined/associated with one specific logical DU.

q_29280.question: What is the trigger for the SMF initiated SM Policy Modification procedure?
q_29280.ground_truth: The trigger for the SMF initiated SM Policy Modification procedure is a change in Access Type or a change in UE location.

q_29281.question: What should SCPs and SEPPs do when forwarding OCI headers with a scope set to NF Service Producer or NF Service Consumer?
q_29281.ground_truth: SCPs and SEPPs should forward OCI headers with a scope set to NF Service Producer or NF Service Consumer when forwarding messages to the next hop.

q_29282.question: What is the name of the procedure sent from the S-CSCF to the HSS when the S-CSCF stores the user information for that indicated user?
q_29282.ground_truth: The name of the procedure sent from the S-CSCF to the HSS when the S-CSCF stores the user information for that indicated user is Cx-Put.

q_29283.question: What is the requirement for the rate of correct events observed during repeated tests in Test 1 and Test 2 as specified in section 16.6.2.1.5?
q_29283.ground_truth: The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests should be at least 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

q_29284.question: In the 'O: has permission' state, what should the floor participant do upon receiving a Floor Request message that is not pre-emptive?
q_29284.ground_truth: The floor participant sends a Floor Deny message with the Reject Cause field including the cause #1 (Another MCPTT client has permission) and remains in the 'O: has permission' state.

q_29285.question: What information may be included in the N4 Session Establishment Response from the LNS server for the UE in step 3?
q_29285.ground_truth: This information may include the DNS server address and other UE related information.

q_29286.question: What should be the value of the Termination information type IE when generating an FD HTTP TERMINATION message?
q_29286.ground_truth: The Termination information type IE should be set to "TERMINATION REQUEST" when generating an FD HTTP TERMINATION message.

q_29287.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for the cell re-selection delay to an already detected cell in 4G LTE?

q_29288.question: What is the validity of a SUCI, given that it is a single-use identifier?
q_29288.ground_truth: A SUCI is only valid at the single point in time when the association event is detected and reported to the ICF by the IEF.

q_29289.question: When will the UE use Control Plane CIoT 5GS Optimisation to report events in the deferred 5GC-MT-LR procedure for Periodic or Triggered Location Events using low power event reporting?
q_29289.ground_truth: The UE uses Control Plane CIoT 5GS Optimisation to report events when the LMF decides to allow it and the UE is not in CM CONNECTED state or is accessing E-UTRA connected to 5GC, unless the criteria specified by the LMF are not met.

q_29290.question: What is the reference value for the timing advance used by the UE in the test?
q_29290.ground_truth: A reference value for the timing advance used by the UE in the test is established by sending one message with a Timing Advance Command MAC Control Element with a Timing Advance Command value of 31 during time duration T1.

q_29291.question: What is the expected behavior of the UDSF when one or more conditions given in the request header fields evaluate to false?
q_29291.ground_truth: The UDSF shall respond with "412 Precondition Failed" and may include an execution report or error information in the response body.

q_29292.question: What is the component that determines a new policy for a UE when a UE updates its policy requirement?

q_29293.question: What is the condition for the overall delays measured from the beginning of time period T2 in Test 1 to be considered successful?
q_29293.ground_truth: The overall delays measured from the beginning of time period T2 in Test 1 must be less than 4322 ms.

q_29294.question: What must the UE include in the Binding Update message to the PDN GW if it wants to request an IPv6 home prefix?
q_29294.ground_truth: The UE may include the APN of the PDN it wants to access and can also request the IPv6 home prefix as defined in RFC 5026 to influence the IPv6 home network prefix assignment procedure.

q_29295.question: What are the procedures for releasing a MCPTT call using a pre-established session in MCPTT communications?
q_29295.ground_truth: The procedures for releasing a MCPTT call using a pre-established session in MCPTT communications are defined in clause 6.2.5.2 and 6.3.2.2.8.2 of the 3GPP specification.

q_29296.question: What are the implications of applying NF findings to multi-Rx UE RF testing in the immediate NF with the anchor probe mounted to the roll motor with independent positioning control?
q_29296.ground_truth: Applying NF findings to multi-Rx UE RF testing in the immediate NF requires accurate positioning of the NF probe and the anchor probe mounted to the roll motor with independent positioning control. It is also necessary to determine the exact location of all active antenna pairs for each AoA2 probe direction, and the NF probe must guarantee the same DL conditions to both active DUT receivers as a FF probe would since UE RF requirements are defined in the FF.

q_29297.question: What are the charging models supported by the PCC charging in 5G Core Network Charging?
q_29297.ground_truth: The PCC charging supports Volume based charging, Time based charging, Volume and time based charging, Event based charging, and No charging.

q_29298.question: In the context of clause 6.23, what can be calculated and randomized to reduce the impact on the source satellite system?
q_29298.ground_truth: If the UE application layer has the knowledge when there is no network coverage, the RRC Connection Request to the source satellite system can be calculated and randomized, preventing UEs from attacking the source satellite system.

q_29299.question: What information does MOP-SR-DM monitor for updating radio resource partitioning policies?
q_29299.ground_truth: MOP-SR-DM monitors the radio usage resources measurement (e.g. UL/DL PRB used for data traffic, RRC connections) for POP A and POP B, and send such radio usage resources measurements to MnS consumer. Based on this information and other changes in service traffic requirements, the radio resources partitioning policies may be updated.

q_29300.question: What should an offering DCMTSI client in terminal do if the data channel SCTP association is accepted in the SDP answer?
q_29300.ground_truth: It may use any offered stream ID that has a corresponding "a=dcmap" line in the SDP answer, and consider as rejected data channels with "a=dcmap" lines in the SDP offer that are not included in the SDP answer.

q_29301.question: What should the 5G-RG do when the network provides URSP rules with any new component in the traffic descriptor which is not recognized by the UE?
q_29301.ground_truth: The 5G-RG shall skip this URSP rule when evaluating the URSP rules to associate an application with a PDU session.

q_29302.question: What action does the S-CSCF take if the authentication attempt fails to match the expected digest response?
q_29302.ground_truth: If the digest response does not match the expected digest response calculated by the S-CSCF, the S-CSCF shall consider the authentication attempt as failed and reject the request by issuing a 403 (Forbidden) response.

q_29303.question: When should the MME send a Detach Notification (Local Detach) message to the associated SGSN?
q_29303.ground_truth: The MME shall send a Detach Notification (Local Detach) message to the associated SGSN if the MME detects that the UE currently has an ongoing IMS emergency session, or ISR is activated, and the SGsAP-PAGING-REQUEST message does not include the Location area identifier or the "VLR-Reliable" MM context variable is set to "false".

q_29304.question: What is the format of the DRB-CountMSB-Info sequence?
q_29304.ground_truth: The DRB-CountMSB-Info sequence is a sequence of DRB-CountMSB-Info elements, where each DRB-CountMSB-Info element contains a drb-Identity, countMSB-Uplink, and countMSB-Downlink.

q_29305.question: What measures should be taken to protect the long-term key(s) used for authentication and security association setup purposes in a split DU-CU implementation?
q_29305.ground_truth: The long-term key(s) used for authentication and security association setup purposes should be protected from physical attacks and never leave the secure environment of the UDM/ARPF unprotected.

q_29306.question: What action does the S-CSCF take if no Line-Identifier is received over the Cx interface during the registration process for an already registered public user identity linked to the same private user identity?
q_29306.ground_truth: The S-CSCF returns a 500 (Server Internal Error) response to the REGISTER request.

q_29307.question: What is the function of PSBCH in the LTE V2X sidelink?
q_29307.ground_truth: PSBCH in the LTE V2X sidelink transmits the SL-BCH transport channel, which carries the sidelink V2X Master Information Block (MIB-V2X) from the RRC layer.

q_29308.question: What must the Edge Enabler Client (EEC) be able to do to fulfill the security requirement for mutual authentication with the Application Client over EDGE-5 interface?
q_29308.ground_truth: The EEC must be able to provide a mechanism for mutual authentication with the Application Client over the EDGE-5 interface, ensuring that both parties can verify the identity of the other before proceeding with communication.

q_29309.question: In 9.10.3.3.1 and 9.10.3.3.2, how many CSI-RSs must the UE be capable of performing for each inter-frequency layer during each layer 1 measurement period for FR1 and FR2, respectively?
q_29309.ground_truth: The UE must be capable of performing at least 14 CSI-RSs with different CSI-RS index and/or PCI for each inter-frequency layer during each layer 1 measurement period for FR1, and at least 24 CSI-RSs with different CSI-RS index and/or PCI for each inter-frequency layer during each layer 1 measurement period for FR2.

q_29310.question: What is the recommended percentage bandwidth for multi-band AA in frequency range 24-29 GHz which includes n257/n258/n261, and in frequency range 37-48 GHz which includes n260/n259/n262?
q_29310.ground_truth: Based on existing technology, a multi-band AA with common radiated element with 19.5% percentage bandwidth is recommended for frequency range 24-29 GHz (n257/n258/n261), and 26.3% percentage bandwidth for frequency range 37-48 GHz (n260/n259/n262) is recommended.

q_29311.question: What should the MAC entity do for the HARQ process when it receives a downlink assignment for a new transmission on the PDCCH for the MAC entity's C-RNTI after the first PUSCH transmission to the Serving Cell?
q_29311.ground_truth: Consider the LTM cell switch to be successfully completed and indicate it to upper layers.

q_29312.question: What kind of analytics may the NWDAF derive for "DN Performance" in this 5GS assistance for FL member selection?
q_29312.ground_truth: The NWDAF may derive the latency divergence in "DN Performance".

q_29313.question: What should the Roaming Intermediary do if it detects an N32-f related error and forwards the response message to the cSEPP?
q_29313.ground_truth: If the Roaming Intermediary decides to forward the response message to the cSEPP, it should consider handling mechanisms specified for 5GC SBI for handling such situations if the NF consumers and NF producers end up with de-synchronized status.

q_29314.question: When is the "Partially allowed NSSAI" information element included in the 5G network?
q_29314.ground_truth: The "Partially allowed NSSAI" information element is included in the 5G network to assign a partially allowed NSSAI to the UE.

q_29315.question: What action does the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay perform after successfully verifying the Direct Security Mode Complete message from the 5G ProSe Remote UE?
q_29315.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay responds with a Direct Communication Accept message to the 5G ProSe Remote UE to finish the PC5 connection establishment procedures and stores the CP-PRUK ID in the security context associated to the PC5 link with the 5G ProSe Remote UE.

q_29316.question: What is the data type of the "functionalAliasID" attribute in the "functionalAliasType" complex type?
q_29316.ground_truth: The "functionalAliasID" attribute in the "functionalAliasType" complex type is of the data type "xs:anyURI".

q_29317.question: What are the possible values of the epoch-frame field within the networkTime choice in the MeasurementReferenceTime fragmentor for the LTE/HPS format?
q_29317.ground_truth: The possible values of the epoch-frame field within the networkTime choice in the MeasurementReferenceTime fragmentor for the LTE/HPS format are the subframe index (0..10239) and the FDD carrier group number (0..31). Further, each value corresponds to an LTE FDD or TDD specific cell.

q_29318.question: How can the NRF Service Producer recognize HTTP headers that should not be considered in the calculation of hash when appending HTTP standard headers?
q_29318.ground_truth: NRF Service Producer cannot recognize those headers that should not be considered in the calculation of hash as those are added by SCP. To mitigate this, additional details about HTTP headers and order among HTTP headers that should be considered in the calculation of hash need to be transmitted to the NF Service Producer.

q_29319.question: What kind of functionality does the ATSSS-LL functionality enable in the UE and UPF?
q_29319.ground_truth: The ATSSS-LL functionality is needed in the 5GC for MA PDU Session of type Ethernet and it enables traffic steering, switching and splitting across 3GPP access and non-3GPP access in the UE and UPF.

q_29320.question: What should the UE do if it receives the requested service option not authorized in this PLMN indicator (#35) while operating in single-registration mode?
q_29320.ground_truth: The UE should set the EPS update status to EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, delete any 5G-GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI list and ngKSI, delete the list of equivalent PLMNs and reset the registration attempt counter. The UE should also set the 5GMM state to 5GMM-DEREGISTERED and 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED.

q_29321.question: What state is the floor participant in when it creates an instance of the state transition diagram for basic operation?
q_29321.ground_truth: The floor participant is in the 'Start-stop' state when it creates an instance of the state transition diagram for basic operation.

q_29322.question: In case h) in subclause~5.4.5.2.1, what should the UE include in the Payload container if it is located outside the LADN service area and performs the UE-initiated NAS transport procedure to send CIoT user data via the control plane for a PDU session for LADN?
q_29322.ground_truth: In case h) in subclause~5.4.5.2.1, the UE shall include the PDU session ID, and Release assistance indication (if available), and set the Payload container IE to "CIoT user data container" containing the user data.

q_29323.question: What is the EUTRAN-Positioning-Data AVP in 3GPP TS 29.002 used to indicate?
q_29323.ground_truth: The EUTRAN-Positioning-Data AVP is used to indicate the encoded content of the "Positioning-Data" Information Element as defined in 3GPP TS 29.171.

q_29324.question: What is the impact of the AW value on the latency of QNC triggering in the 5GS?
q_29324.ground_truth: The AW value determines the latency of QNC triggering as it affects the time span from GFBR measurement to QNC generation. A lower AW value results in lower latency, which is useful for reducing the chance of NG-RAN congestion.

q_29325.question: What is the coded value for a reliability class of '010' in the MS to network direction?

q_29326.question: What is the role of the SCMF in determining the common DNAI for a collection of PDU Sessions associated with the same "influence-id"?
q_29326.ground_truth: The SCMF may consider the UE locations, network topology, or the current Analytics from NWDAF for service experience between the gNB and candidate UPFs. It determines the common DNAI per each "influence-id" and notifies the SMF(s) of the corresponding "influence-id" for the result.

q_29327.question: What should a UE do when it receives a WLCP BEARER RELEASE REQUEST message from a TWAG indicating the cause as #36 "regular deactivation"?
q_29327.ground_truth: Upon receipt of a WLCP BEARER RELEASE REQUEST message from a TWAG with cause #36 "regular deactivation", the UE shall delete the WLCP bearer identified by the WLCP bearer identity, send a WLCP BEARER RELEASE ACCEPT message, and enter the state WLCP BEARER CONTEXT INACTIVE.

q_29328.question: In what state does the UE initiate the attach procedure by sending an ATTACH REQUEST message to the MME when entering a cell that provides normal service?

q_29329.question: Under which conditions does the S-GW trigger a new priority paging towards MME?
q_29329.ground_truth: The S-GW triggers a new priority paging towards MME if the ongoing paging is lower priority than the incoming data received in the S-GW for IMS terminating session.

q_29330.question: What are the basic principles of URLLC slice provisioning with radio resources?
q_29330.ground_truth: URLLC slices can be assigned shared, prioritized, or dedicated radio resources within the same cell. Hardware/software resource isolation is up to implementation. Each slice may be assigned radio resource by RRM implementation and SLA as in TS 28.541. The URLLC service has more stringent requirement on latency, and pre-emption may happen when the resource for URLLC is not enough under co-existence scenario.

q_29331.question: How can an SCP use cached profiles from the NRF to serve new service requests from NFs with different requester's information?
q_29331.ground_truth: If an SCP receives complete NF profiles (including authorization attributes) from the NRF, it may use these cached profiles to serve new service requests for NFs with different requester's information by checking the authorization parameters of the complete profiles.

q_29332.question: What is the test purpose in EN-DC FR1-FR1 Event-triggered reporting for FR1 cell without SSB time index detection when DRX is used?
q_29332.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the UE can correctly report an event in non-DRX with SSB time index detection in EN-DC FR1-FR1 Event-triggered reporting for FR1 cell without SSB time index detection when DRX is used.

q_29333.question: What response should be sent if the "SIP REFER request for originating participating MCPTT function" is for a user not authorized to call any of the requested users in a first-to-answer call?
q_29333.ground_truth: A SIP 403 (Forbidden) response, including warning text set to "153 user not authorized to call any of the users requested in the first-to-answer call" in a Warning header field should be sent.

q_29334.question: What is the recommended granularity for announcing a new Overload Reduction Metric Information?
q_29334.ground_truth: During the typical operating condition of the sender, a larger variation in the Overload Reduction Metric, e.g. 5 or more units, should be considered as reasonable enough for advertising a new Overload Reduction Metric Information.

q_29335.question: What is the definition of PCBD in the context of 8.18.6.2-2?
q_29335.ground_truth: PCBD is the number of band(s) on which UE is performing candidate beam detection only for SCell.

q_29336.question: What functions are used for tracking area list management?
q_29336.ground_truth: The mobility management functions are used to keep track of the current location of a UE, and Intra-RAT mobility for NB-IoT UEs is supported. Inter-RAT idle mode mobility between NB-IoT and WB-EUTRAN/UTRAN/GERAN is also supported, requiring tracking area list management to ensure that at inter-RAT mobility, the UE performs a TAU or RAU procedure.

q_29337.question: What is the applicability requirement for the UE Transmit Timing Accuracy Test?
q_29337.ground_truth: The UE Transmit Timing Accuracy Test applies to all types of E-UTRA FDD UE release 11 and forward, that support Uplink Carrier Aggregation and meet the FGI bit 5 requirement.

q_29338.question: What is the validity of certificates received from the peer end entity verified by in path validation?
q_29338.ground_truth: The validity of certificates received from the peer end entity is verified by CRLs or OCSP responses retrieved via the mechanisms specified in section 6.1.1, based on the CRL Distribution Point or Authority Information Access extensions in the certificates.

q_29339.question: What is one of the capabilities of the SMF (Session Management Function) related to satellite backhaul?
q_29339.ground_truth: The SMF is capable of triggering GTP-U path monitoring when satellite backhaul is used.

q_29340.question: How many "o-bcsm-camel-TDP-data" elements can occur within "o-bcsm-camel-TDP-data-list" definition?
q_29340.ground_truth: Up to 10 "o-bcsm-camel-TDP-data" elements can occur within the "o-bcsm-camel-TDP-data-list-type" definition.

q_29341.question: What message is sent from the old SGSN to the new SGSN over the S16 interface to forward RNC contexts to the target system?
q_29341.ground_truth: A Forward Access Context Notification message is sent.

q_29342.question: What is the purpose of the TDD absolute RSRP accuracy test?
q_29342.ground_truth: The purpose of the TDD absolute RSRP accuracy test is to verify that TDD absolute RSRP measurement accuracy in carrier aggregation is within the specified limits under AWGN propagation conditions.

q_29343.question: What should the UE do upon receiving a UEInformationRequest message that includes a logMeasReportReq and an RPLMN included in plmn-IdentityList stored in VarLogMeasReport?
q_29343.ground_truth: The UE should include the logMeasReport in the UEInformationResponse message and submit it to lower layers for transmission via SRB2.

q_29344.question: What action should a UE take if a barred cell meets certain conditions?
q_29344.ground_truth: If a barred cell is to be treated as if the cell status is "barred" due to unable to acquire certain system information, the UE may exclude the barred cell as a candidate for cell selection/reselection for up to 300 seconds and may select another cell on the same frequency if the selection criteria are fulfilled.

q_29345.question: Which flag should be set in the Alternative SMF IP Address IE to be used preferentially when contacting an alternative PFCP entity?
q_29345.ground_truth: The PPE flag should be set to "1" when contacting an alternative PFCP entity preferentially.

q_29346.question: What does GTPv2-C stand for in the context of the 3GPP Evolved Packet System?
q_29346.ground_truth: GTPv2-C refers to the GPRS Tunnelling Protocol, Version 2, Control plane.

q_29347.question: What types of UEs can use V2X communication procedures for RSPP transport over PC5?
q_29347.ground_truth: V2X capable UEs use V2X communication procedures for RSPP transport over PC5.

q_29348.question: What protocol is used to negotiate the specific media capabilities in an IMS-based telepresence call?

q_29349.question: What are the main steps of the local ML model training procedure within the federated learning framework?
q_29349.ground_truth: The main steps of the local ML model training are as follows: (1) receiving a request from the central MTLF to train a local ML model, (2) collecting data required to train the local ML model, (3) locally training the ML model, (4) exchanging ML model parameters with the central MTLF to allow aggregation of gradients and loss factors, and (5) updating the central trained model using the aggregated model parameters.

q_29350.question: What should the MCData client do if the received SIP MESSAGE request contains an <alert-ind> element set to a value of "true" and the MCData emergency alert state is set to "MDEA 4: emergency-alert-cancel-pending"?
q_29350.ground_truth: If the MCData emergency alert state is set to "MDEA 4: emergency-alert-cancel-pending", the MCData emergency alert state should be set to "MDEA 3: emergency-alert-initiated".

q_29351.question: What action does the UE take when the current available UE EPTI value is 7FFFH after initiating a PMFP procedure?
q_29351.ground_truth: The UE sets the current available UE EPTI value to 0000H.

q_29352.question: In 5GC, what is the process of forwarding of uplink traffic received in the CP function to the UP function for a PDR per PDU session?
q_29352.ground_truth: The CP function provisions a PDR with an IP address and TEID uniquely assigned in the UP function for the N4-u tunnel, with the field Outer Header Removal Description in the Outer Header Removal IE set to "0" or "1"; and an FAR enabling the UP function to forward the received uplink data from the CP function.

q_29353.question: How is the Type 1 power headroom (PH) reported for the PCell in the Dual Connectivity PHR MAC Control Element?
q_29353.ground_truth: When Type 1 PH is reported for the PCell, it is reported in ascending order based on the ServCellIndex, starting with an octet containing the Type 1 PH field followed by an octet with the associated PCMAX,c field (if reported). This is indicated by the Ci field set to "1" in the Dual Connectivity PHR MAC Control Element.

q_29354.question: What type of area can be specified in the "geographical-area-change" element?
q_29354.ground_truth: The "geographical-area-change" element can specify any geographical area change, or a specific geographical area that the VAE-S will send monitoring reports to the VAE-C when entered or exited.

q_29355.question: What is the role of the UE-to-UE Relay in the process of E2E QoS negotiation?
q_29355.ground_truth: The UE-to-UE Relay is responsible for transferring the E2E PC5-S messages between the Source UE and the Target UE using the RAN specified L2 relay method.

q_29356.question: What is the role of the Network Slice Capability Enablement (NSCE) client in the network slice architecture?
q_29356.ground_truth: The NSCE client acts as the application client for slice enablement and interacts with the NSCE server to trigger network slice related operations, such as mapping or migrating vertical applications to network slices, and dynamic network slice lifecycle management.

q_29357.question: Which node provides in textual format the QoE metrics that need to be reported, the measurement frequency, the reporting interval and the reporting range?
q_29357.ground_truth: The Metrics node is the one that provides the QoE metrics in textual format, and its format is "chr".

q_29358.question: What should be the form of the temporarily not available indication when the service authorization for acting as a 5G ProSe Remote UE or as a 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay is revoked?
q_29358.ground_truth: The form of the temporarily not available indication will be determined by stage 3.

q_29359.question: What determines the PDCCH monitoring occasions for MCCH message reception in the MCCH transmission window when searchspaceMCCH is set to zero?
q_29359.ground_truth: The PDCCH monitoring occasions for MCCH message reception in the MCCH transmission window are the same as PDCCH monitoring occasions for SIB1 where the mapping between PDCCH monitoring occasions and SSBs is specified in TS 38.213.

q_29360.question: What does the floor control interface do if the MCPTT client negotiated support of queueing of floor requests as specified in clause~14, the effective priority level is not pre-emptive and the maximum queue length has not been reached?
q_29360.ground_truth: The floor control interface inserts the MCPTT client into the active floor request queue, updates the position of the MCPTT client in the active floor request queue, sends a Floor Queue Position Info message to the floor participant and remains in the 'U: not permitted and Floor Taken' state.

q_29361.question: What is the priority order for reselecting frequency when it supports at least one NSAG provided by NAS?
q_29361.ground_truth: The frequencies are prioritized in the order of the NAS-provided priority for the NSAG with highest priority supported on the frequency.

q_29362.question: What is the minimum number of PRS RSTD samples that must be taken for positioning measurements?
q_29362.ground_truth: The minimum number of PRS RSTD samples that must be taken for positioning measurements is 1, which occurs when the UE supports supportedDL-PRS-ProcessingSamples-RRC-Inactive and the LMF requests the UE to perform positioning measurements with reduced number of samples. In this case, the UE must take 1 PRS RSTD sample for positioning measurements.

q_29363.question: What does codebookTypeRequest-r16 contain in the UE-CapabilityRequestFilterCommon?
q_29363.ground_truth: The codebookTypeRequest-r16 in the UE-CapabilityRequestFilterCommon is a sequence that contains the different codebook types and their respective selections. It is included in the capability container request list.

q_29364.question: What is the value of the MCVideo ID that should be set for the <mcvideo-request-uri> element in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body?
q_29364.ground_truth: The value of the MCVideo ID of the targeted MCVideo user.

q_29365.question: What is the requirement for Test Requirements in clause 6.2.4.5, 6.2.5.5 and 6.3.5 for NB-IoT operation in E-UTRA in-band or guard band?
q_29365.ground_truth: The test requirement is specified in TS~36.141 clause~6.3.3.5.

q_29366.question: What does "FBW" stand for in the context of the 3GPP Technical Specification?

q_29367.question: Which four aspects are included when selecting a 5GC network and routing traffic via the 5GC network?
q_29367.ground_truth: Access network discovery procedures, access network selection procedures, access network reselection procedures, and PLMN selection procedures.

q_29368.question: What does the "stat" parameter indicate when the EPSFB status reporting is enabled?
q_29368.ground_truth: The "stat" parameter indicates the EPS fallback status when a MO/MT call is initiated in 5GS, such as 5GS to EPS fallback started, successful, or failure.

q_29369.question: What is the meaning of a Relying Party in the context of attestation?
q_29369.ground_truth: A Relying Party depends on the Attestation Results to apply specific actions, such as deciding the extent to which it will interact with the attested system.

q_29370.question: What aspects need to be considered for service continuity in different path switching cases?
q_29370.ground_truth: The aspects that need to be considered for service continuity in different path switching cases include the triggers and criteria for path switching, how to select a UE-to-Network Relay for path switching, the path switch procedure with service continuity consideration, and what service continuity to be achieved for the solution in path switching.

q_29371.question: What is the condition for the test to pass?
q_29371.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the total number of successful tests must be more than 90% of the cases with a confidence level of 95%.

q_29372.question: What type of element is the "manual-deactivation-not-allowed-if-location-criteria-met" under the "anyExt" element of the "entry" element in the "FunctionalAliasList" list element of the "anyExt" element of the "OnNetwork" element, and what 3GPP specification does it correspond to?
q_29372.ground_truth: The "manual-deactivation-not-allowed-if-location-criteria-met" element is of type "Boolean" and corresponds to the "ManualDeactivationNotAllowedIfLocationCriteriaMet" element of clause 5.2.48W6C in 3GPP TS 24.483.

q_29373.question: What is the procedure for authenticating a UE behind a 5G-RG or FN-RG?
q_29373.ground_truth: A UE connected to a 5G-RG or FN-RG can access the 5GC via N3IWF. When using untrusted non-3GPP access, the authentication is as specified in clause 7.2.1. When using trusted non-3GPP access, the authentication is as specified in clause 7A.2.1.

q_29374.question: Who is responsible for generating the IOI in aType 1, Type 2, and Type 3 cases for network charging?
q_29374.ground_truth: For Type 1 IOI: the P-CSCF generates the originating IOI, while the S-CSCF in the Home PLMN generates the terminating IOI; For Type 2 IOI, the S-CSCF in the originating party's IMS network generates the originating IOI, and the S-CSCF in the terminating party's IMS home network generates the terminating IOI; For Type 3 IOI, the S-CSCF in the Home PLMN generates the originating IOI, and the AS contacted by this S-CSCF generates the terminating IOI.

q_29375.question: What identity does the ePDG use as the UE identifier when the IMSI cannot be authenticated or the UE has not provided it during the IKE tunnel establishment procedure?
q_29375.ground_truth: The ePDG uses the IMEI as the UE identifier when the IMSI cannot be authenticated or the UE has not provided it during the IKE tunnel establishment procedure.

q_29376.question: What method should the NF Service Consumer use to send a request to transfer a UE context?
q_29376.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer should send an HTTP POST request to invoke the "transfer" custom method on the URI of the "Individual ueContext" resource.

q_29377.question: Which custom operation is used by the NF service consumer (AUSF) to request ProSe authentication vector(s) for the 5G ProSe Remote UE or for the 5G ProSe End UE from the UDM, if the SUPI is provided and EAP-AKA' is selected in the ProSeSecurityInformation resource?
q_29377.ground_truth: The "generate-av" custom operation is used by the NF service consumer (AUSF) to request ProSe authentication vector(s) for the 5G ProSe Remote UE or for the 5G ProSe End UE from the UDM, if the SUPI is provided and EAP-AKA' is selected in the ProSeSecurityInformation resource.

q_29378.question: What shall the LMISF-IRI that receives the xIRI do with the information received in the xIRI?
q_29378.ground_truth: The LMISF-IRI that receives the xIRI shall store or update the record with the information received in the xIRI (e.g. UE location) as applicable, for future handling.

q_29379.question: What is the function of the HSS upon receiving an indication that the authentication vector is for EAP-AKA'?
q_29379.ground_truth: The HSS generates an authentication vector with AMF separation bit = 1 and transforms it into a new authentication vector compatible with the requested access network identity.

q_29380.question: What is the expected behave of the PSSCH transmissions by UE #65-84 during T2?
q_29380.ground_truth: The rate of PSSCH transmissions on the resources by UE #65-84 should be more than 90%.

q_29381.question: In which cases must the UE include the Paging restriction IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message, and when must the UE not include it?
q_29381.ground_truth: The UE must include the Paging restriction IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message when the UE is in 5GMM-IDLE mode and the network supports the N1 NAS signalling connection release, and must not include it when the paging restriction is already indicated in the current stored registration area and the UE is requesting NAS signalling connection release during mobility and periodic registration update.

q_29382.question: What protocol does the PMF operate on top of in an MA PDU Session with type Ethernet, over 3GPP access?
q_29382.ground_truth: The PMF operates on top of Ethernet in an MA PDU Session with type Ethernet, over 3GPP access.

q_29383.question: What is the purpose of the Rule Precedence of URSP rule in PDU Session Establishment Request?
q_29383.ground_truth: The Rule Precedence of URSP rule in PDU Session Establishment Request indicates the priority of the URSP rules, which the PCF for SM policy control can use to retrieve the content of the URSP rule and generate the policy for session management.

q_29384.question: What happens if the back-off timer is started or deactivated for a specific SM procedure and PLMN/APN combination and the MS changes to a new PLMN or inter-system mode?
q_29384.ground_truth: The back-off timer remains active or deactivated, and the MS can still be prevented from sending another ACTIVATE SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message in the PLMN for the same APN.

q_29385.question: What message is sent by the gNB-CU to initiate PDC measurements?

q_29386.question: What is the maximum length of the "Called party BCD number" information element sent by the network, excluding PCS1900?
q_29386.ground_truth: The maximum length of the "Called party BCD number" information element sent by the network, excluding PCS1900, is 13 octets.

q_29387.question: What information should the NEF provide to the MB-SMF when it allocates TMGI based on some policy that applies per specific content from AF?
q_29387.ground_truth: The NEF should allocate TMGI and keep the afID so it can assign TMGI based on some policy that applies per specific content from AF.

q_29388.question: In the context of clause 5.3A.4.2, what is considered void?

q_29389.question: What is the purpose of the LPPa Transport procedure in 5G?
q_29389.ground_truth: The LPPa Transport procedure is used to carry LPPa signalling between eNB and E-SMLC over the S1 Interface, supporting E-CID and UTDOA positioning of a specific UE or obtaining assistance data from an eNB to support OTDOA positioning for any UE.

q_29390.question: What action does the V-PCF take if the AMF informs it that the UE is accessing over a satellite backhaul?
q_29390.ground_truth: The V-PCF includes the Satellite Backhaul Category in the information it sends to the H-PCF.

q_29391.question: What is the condition for an SS to pass the test?
q_29391.ground_truth: The UE passes the test if the TB success rate is greater than 85% with no PDCP SDU loss and sustained during at least 300 frames as outlined in 7.5.1.5.

q_29392.question: What should the MCVideo client include in the SIP INVITE request for a private call with transmission control?
q_29392.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should include an application/resource-lists+xml MIME body with the MCVideo ID of the invited MCVideo user in a "uri" attribute of an "<entry>" element of a "<list>" element of the "<resource-lists>" element in the application/resource-lists+xml MIME body.

q_29393.question: What is the difference between sidelink communication and sidelink discovery?
q_29393.ground_truth: Sidelink communication refers to ProSe Direct Communication between nearby UEs using E-UTRA technology but not traversing any network node, while sidelink discovery is the AS functionality enabling ProSe Direct Discovery between nearby UEs, also using E-UTRA technology and not traversing any network node.

q_29394.question: What should be the number of successful tests compared to the number of failure tests for the test to pass?
q_29394.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the number of successful tests should be more than 90% of the total number of tests performed.

q_29395.question: What is the role of the CSI prediction part in the CSI prediction use case?
q_29395.ground_truth: The CSI prediction part is used to predict future CSI values based on past and current CSI measurements. This information can be used for various purposes, such as for precoding in multi-antenna systems.

q_29396.question: What network entities can interfere with the end-to-end codec negotiation in an IMS network?
q_29396.ground_truth: The IBCF, the MRFC, or other IMS network entities can interfere with the end-to-end codec negotiation.

q_29397.question: Which channel does the ROHC feedback refer to?
q_29397.ground_truth: Feedback received on one ROHC channel for this PDCP entity shall always refer to the ROHC channel in the opposite direction for this same PDCP entity.

q_29398.question: How is the 5G-GUTI constructed for paging purposes?
q_29398.ground_truth: The 5G-S-TMSI is constructed from the AMF Set ID, the AMF Pointer, and the 5G-TMSI for paging purposes in the 5G System.

q_29399.question: What is the objective for narrowband services in terms of call quality?
q_29399.ground_truth: The objective is to reach a quality as close as possible to ITU-T standards for PSTN circuits. However, due to technical and economic factors, there cannot be full compliance with the general characteristics of international telephone connections and circuits recommended by the ITU-T.

q_29400.question: What is the difference between the "Supported Analytics Delay" and the "Time when analytics information is needed"?
q_29400.ground_truth: The "Supported Analytics Delay" indicates the maximum delay allowed for the NWDAF to deliver the analytics report after receiving a request, while the "Time when analytics information is needed" indicates the latest time that the analytics consumer expects to receive the analytics result provided by the NWDAF.

q_29401.question: What is the difference between sidelink resource allocation mode 3 and 4?
q_29401.ground_truth: Mode 3 is for resource allocation scheduled by eNB while mode 4 is for UE autonomous resource selection.

q_29402.question: When is the requirement for the BS type 1-H and BS type 1-O to be met for the radiated receiver characteristics?
q_29402.ground_truth: The requirement for the BS type 1-H and BS type 1-O to be met for the radiated receiver characteristics is during the base station (BS) receive period and with any transmitter setting. The requirements for FDD operation should be met with the transmitter unit(s) ON. The throughput requirements for the radiated receiver characteristics do not assume HARQ retransmissions.

q_29403.question: How is the Protection Area Information Provisioning (PAIP) procedure triggered in the 5G network?
q_29403.ground_truth: The PAIP procedure is triggered when a UE (User Equipment) sends a Registration Request message to the AMF/SEAF (Access and Mobility Management Function/Session and Mobility Management Function) and if the AMF/SEAF supports Anti-False-Base-Station (AFBS).

q_29404.question: What should be the action of the User Equipment (UE) when it receives downlink assignment on the NPDCCH with a C-RNTI unknown by the UE and data is available in the associated subframe?
q_29404.ground_truth: The UE should not send any HARQ feedback on the HARQ process.

q_29405.question: What is the purpose of the GTP-U sender determining round trip time (RTT) periodically in the 3GPP domain?
q_29405.ground_truth: The GTP-U sender determines RTT periodically to detect changes in transport delays. This helps in monitoring QoS for a QoS Flow.

q_29406.question: When should the UE not stop timer T3584, even upon a PLMN change, SNPN change, or inter-system change?
q_29406.ground_truth: When the timer value is deactivated but has not expired yet.

q_29407.question: When should the NG-RAN send an N2 MBS Session request message?
q_29407.ground_truth: The NG-RAN sends an N2 MBS Session request message when it decides to establish shared delivery for a multicast MBS session, or when handing over to a target RAN node that does not have a shared delivery tunnel established for the multicast MBS session.

q_29408.question: What is the purpose of the 'service request verification' payload in the CCA?
q_29408.ground_truth: The 'service request verification' payload is used to ensure the integrity of the service request and protect against unauthorized modifications during indirect communication. It includes the service request message or a hash of it, as well as a protected header list of custom headers that shall be integrity protected.

q_29409.question: What is the purpose of modifying clause 8.4.2.2.2, EEC registration, in the 3GPP TS 23.558 changes?
q_29409.ground_truth: The purpose of modifying clause 8.4.2.2.2, EEC registration, is to provide the EES with information about the EEC's expected use of the EES' services and the EAS selection request indicator, to enable EAS selection and synchronization of the information about selected EAS(s) between the EEC and EES.

q_29410.question: When should the 5G ProSe end UE consider the candidate 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE as discovered?
q_29410.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe end UE shall consider the candidate 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE as discovered if the relay service code parameter, direct discover set parameter, and UE-to-UE relay UE info parameter of the PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for UE-to-UE relay discovery response satisfy specific conditions.

q_29411.question: What does SAN stand for in the context of NR SAN FR1 test models?
q_29411.ground_truth: SAN stands for Single-input and Single-output in the context of NR SAN FR1 test models.

q_29412.question: What is required during the registration procedure for UAS services to authorize direct C2 communication?
q_29412.ground_truth: To authorize direct C2 communication during the registration procedure for UAS services, a UE (unmanned aerial system) should provide the CAA-level~UAV~ID and C2 authorization payload.

q_29413.question: What type of E-UTRA UE does this test apply to?
q_29413.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 15 onwards, supporting EN-DC, BWP adaptation of at least 2BWPs, DCI and timer-based active BWP switching delay Type1 or Type2 and 2DL CA.

q_29414.question: How many identified cells and SSBs must the UE be capable of performing SS-RSRP, SS-RSRQ, and SS-SINR measurements for during each layer 1 measurement period for FR1?
q_29414.ground_truth: For each intra-frequency layer during each layer 1 measurement period, the UE shall be capable of performing SS-RSRP, SS-RSRQ, and SS-SINR measurements for at least 8 identified cells and 8 SSBs with different SSB index and/or PCI on the intra-frequency layer. Additionally, the UE must meet the requirements for the number of SSBs in GEO and NGSO deployments.

q_29415.question: What should the network inform the UE about the support of specific features, such as IMS voice over PS session, location services (5G-LCS), emergency services, emergency services fallback, ATSSS and non-3GPP access path switching in the 5GS network feature support information element?
q_29415.ground_truth: The network informs the UE about the support of specific features, such as IMS voice over PS session, location services (5G-LCS), emergency services, emergency services fallback, ATSSS and non-3GPP access path switching in the 5GS network feature support information element. In a UE with IMS voice over PS session capability, the IMS voice over PS session indicator, the Emergency services support indicator, and the Emergency services fallback indicator shall be provided to the upper layers. The upper layers take the IMS voice over PS session indicator into account when selecting the access domain for voice sessions or calls. In a UE with LCS capability, location services indicator (5G-LCS) shall be provided to the upper layers. When initiating an emergency call, the upper layers also take the IMS voice over PS session indicator, the Emergency services support indicator, and the Emergency services fallback indicator into account for the access domain selection. In a UE with the capability for ATSSS, the network support for ATSSS shall be provided to the upper layers. If the UE receives the 5GS network feature support IE with the ATSSS support indicator set to "ATSSS not supported", the UE shall perform a local release of the MA PDU session, if any. In a UE that supports non-3GPP access path switching, the network support for non-3GPP access path switching shall be provided to the upper layers. If the UE receives the 5GS network feature support IE with the non-3GPP access path switching bit set to "non-3GPP access path switching not supported", the UE shall not perform the registration procedure for mobility registration update for non-3GPP access path switching.

q_29416.question: What represents the hOReportInformation in the SONInformation-ExtIEs NGAP-PROTOCOL-IES context?
q_29416.ground_truth: It is a report containing information about a handover procedure completed with a PLMN identity as origin and a target SNPN ID as destination, plus a set of extension information related the SNPN-CellBasedMDT context.

q_29417.question: What are the three options for the Area Scope parameter in UMTS?
q_29417.ground_truth: The three options for the Area Scope parameter in UMTS are a list of Cells (identified by CGI), a list of Routing Areas (identified by RAI), and a list of Location Areas (identified by LAI).

q_29418.question: What is the definition of average spectral efficiency in Report ITU-R M.2514?
q_29418.ground_truth: Average spectral efficiency is the aggregate throughput of all users divided by the channel bandwidth of a specific band divided by the number of TRxPs, and measured in bit/s/Hz/TRxP.

q_29419.question: How is the probability of false detection of the ACK defined in PUCCH format 0 testing?
q_29419.ground_truth: The probability of false detection of the ACK is defined as a conditional probability of erroneous detection of the ACK when input is only noise.

q_29420.question: What is the required placement of the initial UTRA FDD carrier in relation to the Base Station RF Bandwidth?
q_29420.ground_truth: The UTRA FDD carrier should be placed in the middle of the Base Station RF Bandwidth.

q_29421.question: What is the purpose of the SCEF-Reference-ID-Ext AVP as defined in the 3GPP AVP specification?
q_29421.ground_truth: The SCEF-Reference-ID-Ext AVP is of type Grouped and used instead of SCEF-Reference-ID when the "Extended Reference IDs" feature is supported by the SCEF and MME/SGSN. The SCEF-Reference-ID is included by the sender but discarded by the receiver in such cases.

q_29422.question: What is the position of the interfering signal in the first set of steps for each supported NR channel bandwidth?
q_29422.ground_truth: The interfering signal is adjusted at the opposite side of the Fc and adjacent to the wanted signal.

q_29423.question: What is the reference point between MME and 3GPP2 1xCS IWS for relaying 3GPP2 1xCS signalling messages?

q_29424.question: What is the function of the SMF in storing and associating received AI/ML assisted parameters with a PDU session in SMF?
q_29424.ground_truth: The SMF stores the received AI/ML assisted parameters and associates them with a PDU session based on the DNN and S-NSSAI included in the message from UDM.

q_29425.question: What should the measurement reporting delay be, excluding certain factors such as delay uncertainty and no UL resources?
q_29425.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay excludes a delay uncertainty resulted when inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH, and a delay which causes by no UL resources for UE to send the measurement report.

q_29426.question: When using the second method, what information must be included in the Authorization Header of the SIP INVITE?
q_29426.ground_truth: The Authorization Header should contain the third-party specific user identity, the realm of the third-party Authorization Server, and the token assigned by the third-party Authorization Server.

q_29427.question: What is the impact of frequency error on SINR?
q_29427.ground_truth: Frequency error has a clear negative impact to SINR

q_29428.question: What should the controlling MCData function do if it has cached the information that the MCData user is in an in-progress emergency private communication state with the targeted MCData user and if the SIP re-INVITE request contains an emergency indication set to a value of "true"?
q_29428.ground_truth: The controlling MCData function shall execute the procedure in clause 6.3.7.1.21 in order to send a SIP re-INVITE request towards the MCData user listed in the "uri" attribute of the <entry> element of the <list> element of the <resource-lists> element of the application/resource-lists+xml MIME body of the received SIP re-INVITE request.

q_29429.question: When would the MME include the extended DRX parameters IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message?
q_29429.ground_truth: The MME includes the extended DRX parameters IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message only if the extended DRX parameters IE was included in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message, and the MME supports and accepts the use of eDRX.

q_29430.question: How many sources observed a negative performance gain in the evaluation of Type 2 training between 1 NW part model and M>1 separate UE part models?

q_29431.question: What is the action taken by the SMF when not all the PCC Rules bound to a QoS flow are removed from a PDU session restricted to Emergency Services?
q_29431.ground_truth: The SMF initiates a QoS flow modification procedure.

q_29432.question: What is the purpose of the tests in 8.2.2.4.1B, 8.2.2.4.1D, and 8.2.2.4.2A?
q_29432.ground_truth: The purpose of the tests in 8.2.2.4.1B and 8.2.2.4.1D is to verify the closed loop rank-one performance with wideband precoding, while the purpose of the tests in 8.2.2.4.2A is to verify the closed loop rank-two performance with wideband precoding.

q_29433.question: What is the maximum number of transmissions for synchronous HARQ, specifically for transmission of a MAC PDU stored in the Msg3 buffer?

q_29434.question: What is the purpose of SSR URA?
q_29434.ground_truth: SSR URA provides the receiver with information about the estimated accuracy of the corrections for each satellite.

q_29435.question: What is the difference between inter-RAT and intra-RAT energy saving in terms of the selection of candidate cells?
q_29435.ground_truth: In inter-RAT energy saving, the candidate cells are eNB, while in intra-RAT energy saving, the candidate cells are gNB.

q_29436.question: What should the MCPTT client do when a SIP 4xx response, SIP 5xx response, or a SIP 6xx response is received for the SIP REFER request?
q_29436.ground_truth: If the MCPTT emergency group call state is set to "MEGC~2:~emergency-call-requested" or "MEGC~3:~emergency-call-granted", or the MCPTT imminent peril group call state is set to "MIGC 2: imminent-peril-call-requested" or "MIGC~3:~imminent-peril-call-granted", the MCPTT client should perform the actions specified in clause~6.2.8.1.5 and shall skip the remaining steps.

q_29437.question: What does it mean when the test procedure states that the UE "responds" to a cell?
q_29437.ground_truth: The UE starts transmitting a preamble on PRACH to perform a Registration procedure for mobility when it re-selects to a specific cell.

q_29438.question: What information does the PCF include in the "evNotifs" array of the HTTP POST request when notifying the NF service consumer about URSP rule enforcement?
q_29438.ground_truth: The PCF includes the URSP rule enforcement information received from the UE, the URSP rules that were matched, the SSC mode (if applicable), the requested DNN (if available), and the redundant PDU session information (if applicable).

q_29439.question: What is the on-demand solution for the End UE in Scenario #2?
q_29439.ground_truth: The on-demand solution for Scenario #2 is a U2U Relay secured PC5 message request and response for a protected direct discovery set.

q_29440.question: What triggers the network to start APN based congestion control?
q_29440.ground_truth: The network may start APN based congestion control when one or more APN congestion criteria, as specified in 3GPP TS 23.060, are met.

q_29441.question: What is the purpose of the Enhanced TNL Address Discovery procedure in the X2 GW architecture?
q_29441.ground_truth: The Enhanced TNL Address Discovery procedure is used to discover the X2 GW support capability of a HeNB and to indicate indirect X2 via the indicated X2 GW.

q_29442.question: How are AP IDs used in NG interface or Xn interface or F1 interface or E1 interface?
q_29442.ground_truth: AP IDs are used in NG interface or Xn interface or F1 interface or E1 interface to uniquely identify a logical connection associated to a UE over the NG interface or Xn interface or F1 interface or E1 interface within a node or over the F1 interface or over the E1 interface or over the W1 interface.

q_29443.question: Which functional element is responsible for generating the values for RFSP Index, UE-AMBR, UE-Slice-MBR, Service Area Restriction, SMF selection management and Network Slice Replacement in the VPLMN for access and mobility related policy control?
q_29443.ground_truth: The V-PCF is responsible for generating these values in the VPLMN.

q_29444.question: What is the role of a PINAPP in the PIN ecosystem?
q_29444.ground_truth: A PINAPP can maintain a registry of ASs available to a PIN and provide information about available ASs to other PINAPPs. It also allows application clients to query for information about an AS.

q_29445.question: What should a UE do after releasing an emergency PDU session if it did not receive WUS assistance information during the last registration procedure?
q_29445.ground_truth: The UE should initiate a registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update to request WUS assistance information.

q_29446.question: What is the procedure for the SMF to send the content of the DN Request Container information (authentication message) to the DN-AAA Server via the UPF?
q_29446.ground_truth: In step 3f, after receiving the N1 NAS message containing DN Request Container information from the UE, the AMF informs the SMF. The SMF then sends the content of the DN Request Container information to the DN-AAA Server via the UPF, which relays it to the DN-AAA Server. This process continues until the DN-AAA Server confirms the successful authentication/authorization of the PDU Session.

q_29447.question: In the CMPv2 based certificate management, what is the significance of the NF generating a new private-public key pair to obtain the operator signed end entity certificate?
q_29447.ground_truth: Generating a new private-public key pair in CMPv2 based certificate management allows for a more secure process while obtaining the operator signed end-entity certificate, as it ensures the key hasn't been compromised earlier, offering better protection for the NF.

q_29448.question: What is the role of gNB-DU in RAN visible QoE measurement in split gNB architecture?
q_29448.ground_truth: In split gNB architecture, upon receiving RAN visible QoE measurement reports from UE, the gNB-CU may forward the corresponding QoE information to the gNB-DU, which may deactivate the transfer of RAN visible QoE measurement results from the gNB-CU by initiating QoE Information Transfer Control procedure towards the gNB-CU.

q_29449.question: What does the source and target gNBs maintain during the handover execution period to process uplink data from the UE?
q_29449.ground_truth: The source and target gNBs maintain their own security and ROHC header decompressor contexts to process UL data received from the UE during the handover execution period.

q_29450.question: What is the effect of activating/deactivating charging for any AMF functionality by CHF?
q_29450.ground_truth: The set of triggers enabled/disabled via charging activation/deactivation by CHF are independent from the invoked AMF functionality. The triggers activation/deactivation take effect at the next AMF functionality invoking the CHF.

q_29451.question: What is the function of the DHCP relay agent in the GGSN in the context of DHCP?
q_29451.ground_truth: The DHCP relay agent relays the requests from the DHCP client to the DHCP server(s) and replies from the server(s) to the corresponding client, allowing for the correct delivery of replies as the logical connection from the MT terminates in the GGSN.

q_29452.question: What is the role of the IWF in interworking between an MCPTT or MCData system and an LMR system?
q_29452.ground_truth: The IWF provides centralized support for interworking between an MCPTT or MCData system and an LMR system. It maps the identities of LMR users and groups to corresponding identities in an MCPTT or MCData system.

q_29453.question: What is the result of completing step 11 in the Session Transfer procedure?
q_29453.ground_truth: Completing step 11 in the Session Transfer procedure releases the source IMS access leg.

q_29454.question: What action should be taken to the contents of the body if the Content-Type of the SIP message is "text" or any of its subtypes?
q_29454.ground_truth: The contents of the body must be overwritten with spaces such that the length of the body remains unchanged.

q_29455.question: What does the UAE layer define in relation to 3GPP TS 23.255?
q_29455.ground_truth: The UAE layer defines the procedures for UAS application communication between the UE and the UAE server, and among UEs over the U1-AE interface. It also defines the usage and interactions of the UAE layer with SEAL services, as well as the message format, message contents, error handling, and system parameters applied by the protocols for the UAE layer.

q_29456.question: Who are the entities involved in the private call key distribution in the MCX system?
q_29456.ground_truth: The private call key distribution involves the MC network entities, MC users, and a KMS for user identity keying prior to performing private communications.

q_29457.question: What should the controlling MCVideo function create when sending a SIP MESSAGE request to remove a regroup?
q_29457.ground_truth: An application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-regroup+xml MIME body including an <mcvideo-regroup-uri> element set to the identity of the regroup and a <regroup-action> element set to "remove".

q_29458.question: What is the difference between an MCS session and an MPS session in the 5G System?
q_29458.ground_truth: An MCS session (Mission Critical Service session) is a session that receives priority treatment for allocating and maintaining radio and network resources to support mission-critical services, while an MPS session (Multimedia Priority Service session) is a session that receives priority treatment for allocating and maintaining radio and network resources to support multimedia priority services.

q_29459.question: What is a new special lower MSD type agreed by RAN4?
