q_29459.ground_truth: A new special lower MSD type, "ALL," is agreed by RAN4, which means all above-mentioned MSD types/orders meet the reported lower MSD threshold/capability class based on the victim band and band combination.

q_29460.question: What is the requirement for a UE supporting ca-IdleModeMeasurements when performing idle mode CA measurements on overlapping carriers?
q_29460.ground_truth: A UE supporting ca-IdleModeMeasurements must perform idle mode CA measurements on serving cell and overlapping carriers, as defined in the section.

q_29461.question: What is the purpose of the test method using a test site with the requirements of ITU-R SM.329 for radiated emission testing?
q_29461.ground_truth: The purpose of using a test site that fulfills the requirements of ITU-R SM.329 for radiated emission testing is to evaluate the ability of the BS to limit unwanted emissions from the enclosure port.

q_29462.question: What message does the NEF send to the AF when the establishment or update of transmission resources occurs?
q_29462.ground_truth: The NEF sends a Nnef_AFsessionWithQoS_Notify message to the AF, which includes the information about the resource allocation status for every UE address in the list.

q_29463.question: What is the EVM budget approved for MPR evaluation by RAN4?
q_29463.ground_truth: The EVM budget approved for MPR evaluation by RAN4 is 3.5%.

q_29464.question: Under what conditions should the UE initiate an IMS emergency registration?
q_29464.ground_truth: The UE should initiate an IMS emergency registration if it is not already IMS registered, roaming outside its home network, has sufficient credentials to authenticate with the IMS network, and is able to detect emergency sessions. The UE should also initiate IMS emergency registration if it receives an "IMS emergency registration required" response.

q_29465.question: What is the default state of the system simulator for the generic test procedures for IMS call establishment in E-UTRA, unless otherwise specified in the test case?
q_29465.ground_truth: The default parameters for the basic single cell environment are used in subclause 4.4.

q_29466.question: What information is signalled from the UE to the LMF in UE-based mode?
q_29466.ground_truth: The UE in UE-based or standalone mode reports the latitude, longitude, and possibly altitude with an estimate of location uncertainty, velocity, and an indication of which GNSSs and possibly other location methods have been used to calculate a fix.

q_29467.question: What should the target eNB do with forwarded downlink SDUs, if it receives a DISCARD DL COUNT Value IE for a UE with no prepared DAPS handover at the target eNB, in an MME EARLY STATUS TRANSFER message?
q_29467.ground_truth: The target eNB should ignore the message.

q_29468.question: What should be the initial conditions of the UE when performing the procedure specified in sub-clause 5.2A.3AA.1?
q_29468.ground_truth: The UE should be in Generic RB Establishment state, UE Test Mode Activated (State 3A-RF)

q_29469.question: What is converged charging in the context of the 3GPP network?
q_29469.ground_truth: Converged charging is a process where online and offline charging are combined in the CCS. It offers charging with and without quota management, as well as charging information record generation in one converged charging service.

q_29470.question: When can the MS send an ACTIVATE SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message after a PLMN change, if the back-off timer is not running or deactivated?
q_29470.ground_truth: The MS can send an ACTIVATE SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message after a PLMN change if the back-off timer is not running or deactivated for the secondary PDP context activation procedure and the combination of new PLMN and APN.

q_29471.question: What information is used by NWDAF to expose slice load level analytics?
q_29471.ground_truth: The NWDAF services as defined in clause~7.2 and clause~7.3 are used to expose slice load level analytics from the NWDAF to the consumer NF.

q_29472.question: What does the UEReachabilityInfoNotify service operation do and how is it triggered?
q_29472.ground_truth: The UEReachabilityInfoNotify service operation is used to send a notification towards the notification URI for the UE(s) which are reachable or do not respond to paging. It is triggered by the AMF after the EnableGroupReachability service operation is invoked. The AMF uses the HTTP method POST, using the notification URI received in the EnableGroupReachability request, to send a notification.

q_29473.question: What is the minimum value of "PacketLossRate" parameter defined as?

q_29474.question: What does the "indirect reporting" method involve in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_29474.ground_truth: The "indirect reporting" method involves sending a data report from a UE Application to the Data Collection AF via an Indirect Data Collection Client function of an Application Service Provider.

q_29475.question: What is the purpose of the QoS Enforcement Rule Correlation ID in the context of GW-U?
q_29475.ground_truth: The QoS Enforcement Rule Correlation ID is used to enforce the APN-AMBR when the UE is in EPC. It correlates QERs from different PFCP sessions associated with all the PDRs corresponding to the non-GBR bearers of all the UE's PDN connections to the same APN.

q_29476.question: What are the IRI events generated by the IRI-POI in the SCEF for NIDD using SCEF?
q_29476.ground_truth: The IRI-POI in the SCEF generates xIRI events when it detects the following specific events or information: PDN connection establishment, PDN connection update, PDN connection release, start of interception with established PDN connection, unsuccessful procedure, and PDN connection establishment failure.

q_29477.question: How many subframes after subframe (n) can DTX not be observed for the event "Deactivation" to be considered a success in the intra-band PCell TDD case?
q_29477.ground_truth: DTX should not be observed in subframes (n+5) to (n+9) and (n+13), subframes (n+6) to (n+10) and (n+13) to (n+14), or subframes (n+7) to (n+11) and (n+13) to (n+14) and (n+18) for the event "Deactivation" to be considered a success in the intra-band PCell TDD case.

q_29478.question: What is the purpose of ProSe Per-Packet Priority in the context of network communication?
q_29478.ground_truth: ProSe Per-Packet Priority assigns a scalar value to a protocol data unit that defines the priority handling to be applied for its transmission.

q_29479.question: What are the two options for spectrum that the 5G system should support for PRAS as per PR 5.18.6-002?

q_29480.question: What information does the USS include in the re-authentication request message?
q_29480.ground_truth: The USS includes the GPSI, CAA-Level UAV ID, and an Authentication message in the re-authentication request message. It may contain the PDU Session IP address if available.

q_29481.question: Upon receiving the SystemInformationBlockType1 message, what should a category 0 UE do if the cellAccessRelatedInfoList-5GC doesn't contain an entry with the plmn-Identity of the selected PLMN?
q_29481.ground_truth: If a category 0 UE receives the SystemInformationBlockType1 message and the cellAccessRelatedInfoList-5GC doesn't contain an entry with the plmn-Identity of the selected PLMN, it should consider the cell as barred.

q_29482.question: In what transmission modes is the UE required to report a type 2b report on each respective successive reporting opportunity?
q_29482.ground_truth: Transmission modes 9 and 10 with certain conditions.

q_29483.question: What is a solution for enabling the 5GS to know the PDU set handling capability of the RAN node?
q_29483.ground_truth: The solution includes enhancements such as adding a "PSH-support" indicator in the N2 SM information during PDU session establishment, and including the indicator in the Path Switch Request (Xn handover) or Handover Request Acknowledge message (NG handover) to inform the SMF and UPF about the PDU set handling capability.

q_29484.question: What is the significance of not encrypting the RTP extension header?
q_29484.ground_truth: Not encrypting the RTP extension header allows UPF to inspect the header, reducing packet inspection complexity.

q_29485.question: What does the "+CGEREP" command do in the context of sending unsolicited result codes?
q_29485.ground_truth: The "+CGEREP" command enables or disables sending of unsolicited result codes in the case of certain events occurring in the Packet Domain MT or the network, with "<mode>" controlling the processing of unsolicited codes.

q_29486.question: What should the UE do if it is in EPS attach type "EPS attach" and does not have a valid GUTI or IMSI available while initiating the attach procedure?
q_29486.ground_truth: The UE should include the valid GUTI together with the last visited registered TAI in the ATTACH REQUEST message if it is available, else it should include the IMSI in the ATTACH REQUEST message.

q_29487.question: In what scenarios is the vPCRF involved in the handover procedure?
q_29487.ground_truth: The vPCRF is involved in the handover procedure for roaming cases, except for the authentication and authorization step, and in non-roaming cases where there is a need for authentication and authorization.

q_29488.question: What is the condition for inter-frequency relative SS-RSRP measurement accuracy?
q_29488.ground_truth: The condition for inter-frequency relative SS-RSRP measurement accuracy is that the absolute difference between the channel 1 and channel 2 reference signals is at least 20 dB.

q_29489.question: When should the UE include the 3GPP PS Data Off Support Indication in the PCO when sending the Request Bearer Resource Modification message to the MME?
q_29489.ground_truth: The UE should include the 3GPP PS Data Off Support Indication in the PCO when sending the Request Bearer Resource Modification message to the MME if the PDN GW indicated support for the 3GPP PS data off feature during PDN connection setup and the 3GPP PS Data Off feature status has changed.

q_29490.question: What is the purpose of Ranging/Sidelink positioning with the assistance of assistant UE?
q_29490.ground_truth: The purpose is to determine the Ranging/Sidelink positioning result or Ranging/Sidelink positioning measurement data for a SL Positioning Client UE in network coverage or partial network coverage.

q_29491.question: What promising technology is mentioned to support online gaming in power- and resource-constrained devices?
q_29491.ground_truth: Split rendering is a promising technology to support online gaming in power- and resource-constrained devices.

q_29492.question: In the context of a URSP rule, what does a DNN Selection component do in a Route Selection Descriptor?
q_29492.ground_truth: It indicates that the traffic of the matching application/PIN shall be routed via a PDU Session supporting any of the included DNNs. If a DNN Selection component is provided in the Route Selection Descriptor, the UE shall use any of the DNNs of the DNN Selection component, instead of the DNN requested by the application for the PDU Session that is used to route the traffic of the matching application.

q_29493.question: How is the IOI concept applied in SIP-based requests for network charging?
q_29493.ground_truth: The IOI concept allows operators to uniquely identify each other for SIP-based requests, and can be used for inter operator accounting identification purposes. The IOI should be included within SIP signalling, such as the originating IOI in SIP requests and the terminating IOI in SIP responses.

q_29494.question: What information does the "request-retransmitted" parameter provide in the 3gpp-Sbi-Response-Info header?
q_29494.ground_truth: The "request-retransmitted" parameter in the 3gpp-Sbi-Response-Info header indicates, in an error response, whether the SCP attempted to retransmit the request to alternative HTTP server instances. When present, it shall be set to "true" if so, and to "false" otherwise.

q_29495.question: Which release of the NR UE does this test apply to?
q_29495.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of NR UE release 16, supporting NE-DC and idleInactiveEUTRA-MeasReport-r16.

q_29496.question: What is the size of an AoIPCodec?
q_29496.ground_truth: An AoIPCodec is an OCTET STRING data type of size 1 to 3.

q_29497.question: In what situations must the UE set the FR field in UDC header of the first compressed PDU to 1?
q_29497.ground_truth: The UE must set the FR field in UDC header of the first compressed PDU to 1 when receiving the checksum error notification and UE performs buffer reset.

q_29498.question: Under what conditions would a new MME/AMF send the Context Request message during TAU/RAU/Idle mode Mobility procedures?
q_29498.ground_truth: A new MME/AMF sends the Context Request message to the old MME/SGSN during a TAU/RAU procedure or idle mode mobility procedure to get the MM and EPS bearer contexts for the UE.

q_29499.question: Which IOC uses the "N6Protection" data type in GSMA NG.116?
q_29499.ground_truth: The "N6Protection" data type in GSMA NG.116 is used in the 6.5 subclause of the IOC, which represents the N6 interface protection information in ServiceProfile and CNSliceSubnetProfile for CN.

q_29500.question: What is the message that initializes the NRPPA-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE for measurementUpdate?

q_29501.question: What is the purpose of the MnS data for exposed MnS in the described procedure?
q_29501.ground_truth: The MnS data for exposed MnS allows the NSC to identify the proper MnS producer for consuming the exposed MnS.

q_29502.question: What information does the address mapping information for traffic routing between on-board UPFs include?
q_29502.ground_truth: The address mapping information includes the UE IP address range and next UPF information corresponding to the address range.

q_29503.question: What is the format of RLC data PDUs used by a TM, UM, and AM RLC entity to transfer upper layer PDUs?
q_29503.ground_truth: The format of RLC data PDUs used by a TM RLC entity is TMD PDU, by an UM RLC entity is UMD PDU, and by an AM RLC entity is AMD PDU.

q_29504.question: What should the UE do if it has not registered in N1 mode over non-3GPP access yet and has at least one active PDN connection which it intends to transfer to TNGF or N3IWF connected to 5GCN?
q_29504.ground_truth: The UE should initiate an initial registration procedure over non-3GPP access. After successful completion of the 5GS initial registration in N1 mode over non-3GPP access, the UE should initiate a UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure with a request type to transfer each of the PDN connections which the UE intends to transfer to TNGF or N3IWF connected to 5GCN, if any.

q_29505.question: How does the hierarchical relationship between SubNetwork instances affect the value of the "parents" and "containedChildren" references in the example?
q_29505.ground_truth: The value of the "parents" reference for a SubNetwork instance includes a reference to allcontaining SubNetwork instances from the root down to the immediate parent. The value of the "containedChildren" reference for a SubNetwork instance includes a reference to all directly contained SubNetwork instances.

q_29506.question: What should the UE do when it receives an AMD PDU with a SN gap?
q_29506.ground_truth: The UE should send a STATUS PDU to request retransmissions of PDUs in the SN gap.

q_29507.question: What is the role of the discovery procedure(s) in ProSe direct discovery?
q_29507.ground_truth: The discovery procedure(s) in ProSe direct discovery are used to establish communication between devices and enable the exchange of information, enabling proximity services and other functionalities.

q_29508.question: What happens when a UE would simultaneously transmit on the UL and receive on the SL in the same carrier, or in two respective carriers, and it is not capable of simultaneous transmissions on the UL and reception on the SL in the two respective carriers?
q_29508.ground_truth: The UE transmits only on the link, UL or SL, with the higher priority.

q_29509.question: What should be the position of a 10 MHz E-UTRA carrier in relation to the Base Station RF Bandwidth edge when placing multiple carriers for transmitter tests?
q_29509.ground_truth: The carriers should be placed adjacent to each other starting from the high Base Station RF Bandwidth edge.

q_29510.question: What is the maximum UL switching time as defined in 6.3B.5?
q_29510.ground_truth: The maximum UL switching time is 120 us.

q_29511.question: What should the MCVideo client set the stored current call type to when downgrading an "IMMINENT PERIL GROUP CALL" to a basic group call?
q_29511.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should set the stored current call type to "BASIC GROUP CALL" when downgrading an "IMMINENT PERIL GROUP CALL" to a basic group call.

q_29512.question: What is the maximum allowed overall delays measured in the intra-frequency event triggered reporting test under fading propagation conditions in asynchronous cells?
q_29512.ground_truth: The maximum allowed overall delays measured in the intra-frequency event triggered reporting test under fading propagation conditions in asynchronous cells is 1002 ms.

q_29513.question: What action will the UE take if it does not receive a REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE message when expected?
q_29513.ground_truth: On the first expiry of timer T3586, the UE shall resend the REMOTE UE REPORT message and shall reset and restart timer T3586. This retransmission is repeated two times, i.e. on the third expiry of timer T3586, the UE shall abort the procedure and release any resources for this procedure.

q_29514.question: What is the name of the mechanism in 6.5.3 that allows an NG-RAN node to request a neighbouring NG-RAN node to switch on certain SSB beams?

q_29515.question: What interface enables the RTC Application Provider to provision resources in the Edge Data Network (EDN) for an application?

q_29516.question: What is the threatened asset for the threat "Insecure Network Services"?

q_29517.question: Which organization is responsible for producing the 3GPP technical specifications, including the NR radio interface and the physical layer specifications?

q_29518.question: What happens to the DRA (proxy) binding when all the Diameter sessions of an IP-CAN session or a UE are terminated?
q_29518.ground_truth: The DRA (proxy) removes the DRA binding when all the Diameter sessions of an IP-CAN session or a UE are terminated.

q_29519.question: What is required for a group-broadcast group call to be released when the group-broadcast group is defined in the MCPTT system?
q_29519.ground_truth: Once the user of MCPTT client 1 completes transmitting, the group-broadcast group call is released. This is done by sending a group-broadcast group call release request to the MCPTT server, which then sends a group-broadcast group call release response to the initiator indicating that the call is now ended.

q_29520.question: What is the significance of the KNASint and KNASenc keys in 5G technology?
q_29520.ground_truth: The KNASint and KNASenc keys are derived based on a KAMF after a successful Network Access and Security Management Procedure (NAS SMC) and are used to protect NAS signaling messages between the UE and the 5G Core network over non-3GPP access.

q_29521.question: In a GSM authentication challenge, what is the purpose of the Ciphering Key Sequence Number information element?
q_29521.ground_truth: In a GSM authentication challenge, the Ciphering Key Sequence Number information element is used to identify the ciphering key Kc stored in the mobile station without invoking the authentication procedure.

q_29522.question: What should the MCData client determine before sending a HTTP request to the media storage function of the MCData content server?
q_29522.ground_truth: The MCData client should determine the value of the absolute URI associated with the media storage function of the MCData content server from the <MCDataContentServerURI> element of the MCPTT user profile document.

q_29523.question: What should the UE do if it receives the Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming" IE in the SERVICE ACCEPT message and the TAI(s) included in the IE is not part of the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming"?
q_29523.ground_truth: The UE shall store the TAI(s) belonging to the serving PLMN or equivalent PLMN(s) and ignore the TAI(s) which do not belong to the serving PLMN or equivalent PLMN(s) included in the IE into the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming" and remove the TAI(s) from the stored TAI list if present.

q_29524.question: Who is responsible for sending event reports in this network management system?
q_29524.ground_truth: The Event Receiving NF is responsible for sending event reports in this network management system.

q_29525.question: What is the purpose of the ISC gateway function in the 3GPP network architecture, and where does it functions as an entry point and as an exit point?
q_29525.ground_truth: The ISC gateway function acts as an entry point for the 3GPP network when it processes a SIP request received from another network, and as an exit point when it processes a SIP request sent to other networks.

q_29526.question: Under what conditions will the interruption on PCell and/or active SCell not occur before subframe n+2 and not occur after subframe n+6 if the activation command is transmitted on the PDSCH with dl-STTI-Length-r15=subslot and proc-Timeline-r15= nplus4set1, proc-Timeline-r15= nplus6set1 or proc-Timeline-r15= nplus6set2?
q_29526.ground_truth: The activated SCell and the SCell being activated belong to E-UTRA FDD and the PCell belongs to E-UTRA TDD.

q_29527.question: What is the status code included in the HTTP response when the PCF successfully fulfills the received HTTP POST request for BDT policies?
q_29527.ground_truth: The PCF includes a "201 Created" status code in the HTTP response when it successfully fulfills the received HTTP POST request for BDT policies.

q_29528.question: What should a UE in NB-NI mode do when there is downlink user data pending for a PDU session associated with non-3GPP access, and the number of PDU sessions with user-plane resources established equals the UE's maximum number of supported user-plane resources?
q_29528.ground_truth: The AMF notifies the SMF that reactivation of user plane resources cannot be performed.

q_29529.question: What should the floor participant do upon receiving a Floor Deny message from the floor control server in the 'U: pending Request' state?
q_29529.ground_truth: The floor participant should provide floor deny notification to the user and stop timer T101 (Floor Request), then enter the 'U: has no permission' state.

q_29530.question: When do PIN Elements forward service access requests to the PIN Element?
q_29530.ground_truth: The PIN Element with gateway Capability forwards the service access request to the PIN Element only if the user authentication is successful. Otherwise, it rejects the request for service access.

q_29531.question: What is the purpose of the "AuthorizationResult" enumeration?
q_29531.ground_truth: The enumeration AuthorizationResult represents the NEF notify the AF about the service parameters authorization updates result, e.g. to revoke an authorization.

q_29532.question: What is the base station output power as defined by the given text?
q_29532.ground_truth: The base station output power (Pout) is the mean power of one carrier delivered to a load with resistance equal to the nominal load impedance of the transmitter.

q_29533.question: What is included in the "targetDataSet" attribute of the AuthDisResData data structure when the 5G ProSe Direct Discovery request is initiated by a monitoring UE?
q_29533.ground_truth: The "targetDataSet" attribute contains N sets of Target PDUID - Target RPAUID - Metadata Indicator, where each Target PDUID is returned with the corresponding Target RPAUID(s) that the RPAUID is allowed to discover.

q_29534.question: What information can the H-SMF indicate to the UE for a PDU Session's use of the EDC functionality?
q_29534.ground_truth: The H-SMF may indicate to the UE that for the PDU Session the use of the EDC functionality is either allowed or required.

q_29535.question: What action does the UE take when it receives a TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message containing a GUTI and/or a mobile identity?
q_29535.ground_truth: The UE transmits a TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message and enters EMM-REGISTERED state.

q_29536.question: What should the UE do if it receives a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message and the de-registration procedure was performed due to disabling of 5GS services?
q_29536.ground_truth: The UE should enter the 5GMM-NULL state for 3GPP access if the de-registration procedure was performed due to disabling of 5GS services, and enter the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state for non-3GPP access if the de-registration procedure was not due to disabling of 5GS services.

q_29537.question: What is the mechanism provided by Solution #1 Alternative 1 in TR 23.700-33?
q_29537.ground_truth: The mechanism provided is for PC5 security setup procedure between a source UE or target UE and a L3 UE-to-UE relay when the L3 UE-to-UE relay is in 3GPP coverage.

q_29538.question: What should a receiving PFCP entity do when it detects an Information Element with an invalid length in a Request message?
q_29538.ground_truth: The receiving PFCP entity should send an appropriate error response with Cause IE value set to "Invalid length" together with the type of the offending IE.

q_29539.question: How does the PCF handle the Maximum Group Data Rate compared to the Maximum Slice Data Rate?
q_29539.ground_truth: The PCF handles the Maximum Group Data Rate per 5G VN group, while it handles the Maximum Slice Data Rate per S-NSSAI. Instead of deducting the value of the authorized Session-AMBR and the MBR of every GBR SDF for every PDU Session of the slice, the PCF deducts such value for every PDU Session accessing to the 5G VN group.

q_29540.question: What limits the aggregated bit rate across all Non-GBR QoS Flows of a UE in a 5G network?
q_29540.ground_truth: The UE-AMBR limits the aggregated bit rate across all Non-GBR QoS Flows of a UE in a 5G network.

q_29541.question: What is the procedure for establishing security during the PC5 link setup between the source UE and U2U relay?
q_29541.ground_truth: During the PC5 link setup procedure between the source UE and U2U relay, if the security policy of either the source UE or U2U relay requires hop-by-hop security protection, the source UE indicates this to the U2U relay by a Direct Communication Request followed by a Direct Authorization and Key procedure. If the security policies of both the source UE and U2U relay are the same, the PC5 link setup includes security establishment, and hop-by-hop security is intended. Otherwise, the source UE and U2U relay only set up the PC5 without security protection.

q_29542.question: What procedure is initiated by the network when a GMM context has been established, and used for GPRS identification?

q_29543.question: What is the definition of the RRH switching point for unidirectional RRH deployment, Scenario-2 in the HST tunnel?
q_29543.ground_truth: The RRH switching point is where the UE switches from the source RRH beam to the target RRH beam based on maximizing SNR among detected beams.

q_29544.question: What occurs when the Target UE receives the Relay Announcement message?
q_29544.ground_truth: After receiving the Relay Announcement message, if the Target UE wants to be discovered by other UEs, it will send a Response message and use Code-Sending Security Parameters to protect it.

q_29545.question: Which attribute of the complex type "UeRegReq-info" is defined as a hexBinary type in the XML schema?

q_29546.question: What is the mandatory parameter when using EAP terminated in UICC?

q_29547.question: What is the maximum allowed RRC re-establishment delay to an unknown NB-IoT FDD inter frequency cell, as given in the requirement section?
q_29547.ground_truth: The maximum allowed RRC re-establishment delay to an unknown NB-IoT FDD inter frequency cell is 12 seconds.

q_29548.question: What sub-element within the <EnterSpecificArea> element indicates the geographical area which, when entered, triggers the functional alias activation?
q_29548.ground_truth: The <PolygonArea> or <EllipsoidArcArea> elements indicate the area.

q_29549.question: When does the GMM entity in the network provide the lower layer with a list of CSG IDs?
q_29549.ground_truth: When there is no PDN connection for emergency bearer services and the network has accepted eDRX for the MS.

q_29550.question: In which bands can V2X operation be performed concurrently?
q_29550.ground_truth: V2X operation can be performed concurrently in band 47, Uu FDD bands 3, 5, 7, 8, 20, 28, 71; Uu TDD bands 34, 39, 41; and NR Uu bands n1, n3, n5, n8, n34, n39, n40, n71, n78, n79.

q_29551.question: What is the definition of "Developer" as given in the catalogue document?
q_29551.ground_truth: As per the catalogue document, a "Developer" is a creator of systems, components, or services for use on or with a 3GPP network.

q_29552.question: What information does the "Max offset" parameter in the 3GPP 5G DDNMF provide?
q_29552.ground_truth: The "Max offset" parameter indicates the maximum time difference between the time on the UE's ProSe clock and the UTC-based counter associated with the discovery slot.

q_29553.question: What are the transport layer requirements for SLPP as specified in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_29553.ground_truth: SLPP requires reliable, in-sequence delivery of SLPP messages from the underlying transport layers. SLPP reliable transport includes duplicate detection, acknowledgement, and retransmission. SLPP message sequence numbers shall be distinct for different SLPP messages sent by the same endpoint for the same endpoint in the same location session. A sender shall include a sequence number in all SLPP messages, and a receiver shall record the most recent received sequence number. If a message is received carrying the same sequence number as that last received for the associated location session, it shall be discarded.

q_29554.question: What is the requirement description for the requirement name "Correct transfer of UE security capabilities in AS security establishment"?
q_29554.ground_truth: The requirement description states that when AS security context is to be established in the gNB/ng-eNB, the AMF sends the UE 5G security capabilities to the gNB/ng-eNB.

q_29555.question: What should the UE do after the SS receives the MeasurementReport message in step 11) or when T4 expires?
q_29555.ground_truth: After the SS receives the MeasurementReport message in step 11) or when T4 expires, the SS shall transmit RRCConnectionRelease message to release the RRC connection which includes the release of the established radio bearers as well as all radio resources.

q_29556.question: What should be done by the MSGin5G Client in the Constrained UE when it receives a CoAP POST request for registration response?
q_29556.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Client in the Constrained UE should generate a CoAP 2.04 (Change) response including the CoAP "Message ID" element and the "Token" element with the same values with those in the CoAP POST request for registration response.

q_29557.question: What is the procedure for UE-initiated bootstrap data channel establishment between two networks A and B?
q_29557.ground_truth: The UE-initiated bootstrap data channel establishment involves UE A sending an INVITE request to initiate an IMS session with UE B, followed by the DCS-M A allocating data channel resources for the bootstrap data channel media streams and sending the INVITE request message to the terminating network. UE B and UE A subsequently execute QoS procedure to establish the dedicated bearer/QCI Flow for the audio/video/data channel media based on the SDP answer in the 18X response.

q_29558.question: What is an ICS proforma and how is it related to UE conformance testing?
q_29558.ground_truth: An ICS (Implementation Conformance Statement) proforma is a questionnaire that, when completed, outlines which capabilities from a given specification have been implemented in an implementation or system. In the context of UE conformance testing, completing the ICS proforma can help determine the test cases relevant to the specific UE implementation.

q_29559.question: What is the function of the IP Edge Node for Ethernet and Fiber accesses in the context of the access-network-charging-info parameter?
q_29559.ground_truth: The IP Edge Node is responsible for tracking the IP Edge Node address (ip-edge parameter) for Ethernet and Fiber accesses in the context of the access-network-charging-info parameter.

q_29560.question: How does the intent-driven management solution relieve the consumer of the management system?
q_29560.ground_truth: The intent-driven management solution relieves the consumer of the management system by allowing them to specify expectations and goals without worrying about the specifics of managing the network slice.

q_29561.question: What message does the S-NG-RAN node send to the M-NG-RAN node to initiate the S-NG-RAN node change?
q_29561.ground_truth: The S-NG-RAN node initiates the procedure by sending the S-NODE CHANGE REQUIRED message to the M-NG-RAN node.

q_29562.question: What should the UE do if it does not receive any response during the IKEv2 SA establishment procedure towards to any of the received IP addresses of the selected N3IWF?
q_29562.ground_truth: If the UE does not receive any response during the IKEv2 SA establishment procedure towards to any of the received IP addresses of the selected N3IWF, then the UE shall repeat the N3IWF selection process.

q_29563.question: What is the purpose of the SCS/AS sending a Monitoring Indication Response message in the monitoring process?
q_29563.ground_truth: The SCS/AS sends a Monitoring Indication Response message with a Cause value to acknowledge the receipt of a Monitoring Indication message.

q_29564.question: If a UE is provided with two TCI-State or TCI-UL-State for a Type 1 power headroom report, when does the UE use the first p0AlphaSetforPUSCH and pathlossReferenceRS-Id-r17 values versus the second p0AlphaSetforPUSCH and pathlossReferenceRS-Id-r17 values?
q_29564.ground_truth: If the reference PUSCH transmission is associated with the first TCI-State or TCI-UL-State, the UE uses the first p0AlphaSetforPUSCH and pathlossReferenceRS-Id-r17 values. If the reference PUSCH transmission is associated with the second TCI-State or TCI-UL-State, the UE uses the second p0AlphaSetforPUSCH and pathlossReferenceRS-Id-r17 values.

q_29565.question: What should the UE do if the serving NB-IoT cell does not meet criterion S in N consecutive DRX cycles within a single PTW?
q_29565.ground_truth: The UE should initiate measurements of all neighbor cells indicated by the serving NB-IoT cell, regardless of the current measurement rules.

q_29566.question: What is the method of the N3IWF or TNGF to initiate the IKE SA deletion procedure?
q_29566.ground_truth: The N3IWF for untrusted non-3GPP access and the TNGF for trusted non-3GPP access shall initiate the IKE SA deletion procedure by sending an INFORMATIONAL request message including a Delete payload to the UE. The Delete payload shall be defined with the Protocol ID set to "1" and no SPIs included in the Security Parameter Index field, indicating that all IPsec ESP security associations within the IKE security association shall be deleted.

q_29567.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network's document on Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access (E-UTRA) and Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access Network (E-UTRAN) in relation to deriving test tolerances for Radio Resource Management (RRM) conformance tests?
q_29567.ground_truth: The purpose is to specify a general method for deriving Test Tolerances for RRM tests and to establish a system for relating the Test Tolerances to the measurement uncertainties of the Test System.

q_29568.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for this test case?
q_29568.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 7.1.1.2.4 of the document.

q_29569.question: What should be ensured for UE operation in the off-network environment?
q_29569.ground_truth: It should be ensured that after the UE is powered up, it considers the geographical area as being one of the geographical areas set in the USIM for operation when UE is "not served by E-UTRAN".

q_29570.question: What is the significance of the Request Type "Handover" when the HSS provides the identity of a statically or dynamically allocated PDN GW?
q_29570.ground_truth: No further PDN GW selection functionality is performed.

q_29571.question: What is the minimum percentage of correct events for the in-sync test described in 7.3.2.5 to be considered a success?
q_29571.ground_truth: The minimum percentage of correct events for the in-sync test described in 7.3.2.5 to be considered a success is 90%.

q_29572.question: What is the procedure for protecting (relayed) Solicitation and Response messages in Solution #24?
q_29572.ground_truth: This solution consists of two protection mechanisms using two sets of security materials: one for the Solicitation and Response message protection and the other one for the direct discovery set(s) protection. The U2U Relay constructs a (relayed) Solicitation message that contains the direct discovery set(s) and protects the message using the provisioned discovery security materials associated with the RSC. Similarly, the U2U Relay constructs a (relayed) Response message and protects it using the provisioned discovery security materials associated with the RSC.

q_29573.question: How is a UE able to access multiple Network Slices simultaneously?
q_29573.ground_truth: A UE can access multiple Network Slices simultaneously by establishing PDU Sessions in each Network Slice instance.

q_29574.question: What should the UE do if it detects the condition for steering traffic from WLAN to E-UTRAN for a time interval TsteeringWLAN?
q_29574.ground_truth: The UE should perform offload from WLAN to E-UTRAN if certain conditions are met.

q_29575.question: What should be used as the freshness parameter in the derivation of KeNB when the UE is using Control Plane CIoT 5GS optimization and there has been a subsequent NAS Security Mode Complete?
q_29575.ground_truth: The value of the uplink NAS COUNT from the latest NAS Security Mode Complete message.

q_29576.question: What is included in the "anIPFlowDescription" for an IP flow description?
q_29576.ground_truth: The IP flow description is based on the definition of the packet filter for an IP flow (direction, IP source and destination address, protocol, and source and destination port) as defined by "FlowDescription" data type and, when the feature "DetNet" is supported, the flow label and the IPsec SPI as defined in the "flowLabel" and "spi" attributes respectively.

q_29577.question: What is the maximum number of cells that can be measured in a measurement object in Release 16?

q_29578.question: What XML schema is used for the GMOP document?
q_29578.ground_truth: The GMOP document conforms to the XML schema described in subclause 7.3.3.

q_29579.question: What is the effect of receiving core network paging on UE CM state in the AMF?
q_29579.ground_truth: A UE in CM-CONNECTED with RRC_INACTIVE state shall enter CM-IDLE state and initiates the NAS signalling recovery if it receives Core Network paging.

q_29580.question: What is the difference between the "minimum RF characteristics" and "minimum performance requirements"?
q_29580.ground_truth: "Minimum RF characteristics" are the basic specifications of the NR Satellite Access Node (SAN), while "minimum performance requirements" are the performance standards that the SAN must meet.

q_29581.question: What is the purpose of the User Plane (UP) function in the PFCP session context?
q_29581.ground_truth: The User Plane (UP) function in the PFCP session context is responsible for performing GTP-U decapsulation and forwarding the packets to the intended destination.

q_29582.question: Which two processes does the motion-to-photon latency primarily depend on?
q_29582.ground_truth: The motion-to-photon latency primarily depends on the time it takes to provide the pose information from the AR runtime to the renderer, and the time it takes for the renderer to use this pose to generate the displayed media.

q_29583.question: Which TS is used as IRP in 3GPP management system but claimed to be valid for both IRP and SBMA in 28.622?

q_29584.question: What is the purpose of the DRMP AVP in the AA-Request Command for S6b DSMIPv6 Authorization Procedures?
q_29584.ground_truth: The DRMP AVP in the AA-Request Command for S6b DSMIPv6 Authorization Procedures indicates that the request is used to authorize the Mobile Node Implicit Yawning procedure as specified in IETF RFC 5779.

q_29585.question: What must a UE do if it has no valid corresponding ProSe Application Code for a ProSe Application ID that an upper layer application intends to announce?
q_29585.ground_truth: The UE must not initiate the Announce request procedure.

q_29586.question: How many IPSec SAs can be established in the Single IPsec SA per PDN Connection Scenario for Non-3GPP access?
q_29586.ground_truth: In the Single IPsec SA per PDN Connection Scenario, only one IPSec SA is established between the UE and the ePDG for all S2b bearers.

q_29587.question: What is a QCI in the context of EPS?
q_29587.ground_truth: A QCI (QoS Class Identifier) in the context of EPS (Evolved Packet System) represents the QoS (Quality of Service) characteristics that the EPS is expected to provide for a Specific Data Flow (SDF).

q_29588.question: What is the purpose of the intermodulation response test in the context of NR UE?
q_29588.ground_truth: The intermodulation response test checks the UE's ability to receive data with a given average throughput for a specified reference measurement channel, in the presence of interfering signals with a specific frequency relationship to the wanted signal, under ideal propagation and no added noise conditions.

q_29589.question: What is the main issue addressed by Solution #40?
q_29589.ground_truth: The main issue addressed by Solution #40 is synchronization of different media flows associated to multi-modality traffic within the same UE or among different UEs that are handled by the same PCF.

q_29590.question: What does the PDN-Type AVP indicate in the TWAN-Connectivity-Parameters AVP?
q_29590.ground_truth: The PDN-Type AVP indicates the type of PDN (IPv4, IPv6, or IPv4v6) requested by the UE or allocated by the network in the TWAN-Connectivity-Parameters AVP.

q_29591.question: What is the test requirement for the fraction of correctly detected ACKs in IAB type 1-O and 2-O?
q_29591.ground_truth: The fraction of correctly detected ACKs shall be larger than 99% for both IAB type 1-O and 2-O.

q_29592.question: What is the purpose of the SyncRef UE (re)selection delay in NR sidelink communication?
q_29592.ground_truth: The SyncRef UE (re)selection delay is the time taken from the beginning of a corresponding time instant to the time UE is synchronized to SyncRef UE and changes its S-SSB transmissions timing and SLSSID to follow SyncRef UE as the synchronization source.

q_29593.question: What is an Elementary Procedure (EP) in the context of S1AP, as per the given document?
q_29593.ground_truth: An Elementary Procedure is a unit of interaction between eNBs and the EPC. These Elementary Procedures are defined separately and are intended to be used to build up complete sequences in a flexible manner.

q_29594.question: How does a voice centric UE behave in a 5GS when IMS for voice is not available?
q_29594.ground_truth: A voice centric UE will not select a cell connected only to 5GC in such cases and will instead select E-UTRAN connected to EPC first, if available.

q_29595.question: What information does UE-R include in the Response message when acting as a UE-to-UE Relay in Model B?
q_29595.ground_truth: UE-R includes the following parameters in the Response message: Type, Discovery Type, Discoveree Info, ProSe UE ID of UE-R, a list of Target User Info parameters, and Layer-2 identifier of the target user's UE.

q_29596.question: What should a participating MCData function do upon receipt of a SIP MESSAGE request for emergency notification for terminating participating MCData function when the binding between the MCData ID and public user identity does not exist?
q_29596.ground_truth: The participating MCData function shall reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 404 (Not Found) response.

q_29597.question: What should the RABM entity do when it receives the RABMSM-DEACTIVATE-IND primitive from the SM entity in the case of a network initiated PDP context deactivation?
q_29597.ground_truth: The RABM entity should release the corresponding RLC links towards the RNC and inform the SM entity that the NSAPI is no longer in use.

q_29598.question: What are the two methods the network can use to obtain the UE location during an emergency call?
q_29598.ground_truth: The two methods are using UE Provided Location Information (UPLI) or Network provided Location Information (NPLI).

q_29599.question: What is the maximum re-selection delay to lower priority cell to less than in this test case?
q_29599.ground_truth: The maximum re-selection delay to lower priority cell is 21 seconds in this test case.

q_29600.question: What is the role of the CHF in the "AAA Server triggered Network Slice-Specific Re-authentication and Re-authorization" charging procedure for NSSAAF in ECUR scenario?
q_29600.ground_truth: The CHF opens a CDR, accounts, rates, and controls the charging data, and provides responses to NSSAAF during the procedure.

q_29601.question: What is the scope of the procedure in 4.5A.3?
q_29601.ground_truth: The scope of the procedure in 4.5A.3 is to allow the successful completion of IP address allocation if it is initiated by the UE, therefore the result from the execution of this procedure shall not lead to assignment of a verdict.

q_29602.question: When does the UDM include Slice-Aware SoR information in the Registration Request?
q_29602.ground_truth: The UDM includes Slice-Aware SoR information in the Registration Request when the UE indicates in the Registration Request that it shall receive Slice-aware SoR information, such as the VPLMN, location, and S-NSSAI combination.

q_29603.question: What shall the SPI associated with the MN-FA be set to during EAP-Re-authentication?
q_29603.ground_truth: The SPI associated with the MN-FA shall be set to the same value of FA-RK-SPI distributed during Access Authentication.

q_29604.question: What are the initial conditions for testing the OTA total power dynamic range for IAB type 1-O?
q_29604.ground_truth: The initial conditions include a normal test environment, RF channels to be tested for single carrier (M), the beam with the highest intended EIRP for the narrowest intended beam, and the OTA peak directions set reference beam direction pair.

q_29605.question: When is the List of Associated URI field used in a SIP message?
q_29605.ground_truth: The List of Associated URI field provides the list of non-barred public user identities (SIP URIs and/or Tel URIs) associated to the public user identity under registration.

q_29606.question: What does the GCI field represent in the 3GPP Vendor-Specific attribute?
q_29606.ground_truth: The GCI field indicates the Global Cable Identifier, which uniquely identifies the line connecting the 5G-CRG or FN-CRG to the 5GS.

q_29607.question: What should the UE do if it receives the Operator-defined access category definitions IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message but it contains no definitions?
q_29607.ground_truth: The UE should delete any existing operator-defined access category definitions for the RPLMN.

q_29608.question: What is one option for the SL PRS resource allocation in a network-centric operation?
q_29608.ground_truth: One option for the SL PRS resource allocation in a network-centric operation is that the network (e.g., gNB, LMF, gNB) allocates resources for SL PRS.

q_29609.question: What is the purpose of the NAS security mode control procedure?
q_29609.ground_truth: The purpose of the NAS security mode control procedure is to take an EPS security context into use, and initialize and start NAS signaling security between the UE and the MME with the corresponding EPS NAS keys and EPS security algorithms.

q_29610.question: What are the two types of resource allocation for discovery message announcement?
q_29610.ground_truth: The two types of resource allocation for discovery message announcement are UE autonomous resource selection and scheduled resource allocation.

q_29611.question: What is the method that a NF service consumer can use to establish a QUIC connection with an HTTP proxy when the NF service producer only supports TCP transport?
q_29611.ground_truth: The NF service consumer can establish a QUIC connection with the HTTP proxy and then send a HTTP CONNECT request to the proxy with the ":authority" pseudo-header set to the NF service producer's FQDN or IP address.

q_29612.question: What is the definition of TTI insertion uncertainty?
q_29612.ground_truth: TTI insertion uncertainty is the delay uncertainty that arises when inserting a measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH. This delay uncertainty can affect the overall delay in reporting events in a cellular network.

q_29613.question: What happens to the ongoing security context when an emergency alert is issued during an existing group call?
q_29613.ground_truth: There should be no change to the ongoing security context for that group. Media protection, floor control protection, and application signalling protection continue to use the existing keys and mechanisms that were in place prior to the emergency alert. However, the call may be downgraded to clear to ensure the emergency alert is setup by the MCX system.

q_29614.question: What is the purpose of the Multicast Signalling Key (MuSiK) in the MCX Server?
q_29614.ground_truth: The MuSiK is used to protect signalling between the MCX Server and the MC client. It is distributed to a client when protected signalling is required over the MBMS bearer or when group-related signalling needs cryptographic protection.

q_29615.question: What should the UE do when it wants to request connectivity to a PDN using a specific APN?
q_29615.ground_truth: The UE should include the requested APN in the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message.

q_29616.question: What does the UE use to select an N3IWF when located in a visited country?
q_29616.ground_truth: When located in a visited country, the UE uses the Non-3GPP access node selection information and slice-specific N3IWF prefix information to select an N3IWF.

q_29617.question: What information should the AF include in the AAR if resource sharing conditions have been changed?
q_29617.ground_truth: If resource sharing conditions have been changed, the AF should include the Sharing-Key-UL AVP and/or Sharing-Key-DL AVP within the Media-Component-Description AVP in the AAR.

q_29618.question: In a UE, what is the profile of RLM using the active TCI state for PDCCH reception in CORESETs in the active DL BWP?
q_29618.ground_truth: The UE selects the NRLM RS provided for active TCI states for PDCCH reception in CORESETs in the active DL BWP in order of shortest monitoring periodicity. If more than one CORESETs are associated with search space sets having the same monitoring periodicity, the UE determines the order of the CORESET from the highest CORESET index.

q_29619.question: What should the UE do when it receives a 200 (OK) response to a REGISTER request?
q_29619.ground_truth: The UE should remove all registration details relating to the public user identity and the associated contact address, store the announcement of the media plane security mechanisms, and follow the noted instructions depending on the presence of other registered public user identities and security associations or TLS sessions.

q_29620.question: What is the maximum number of APNs, for which the PGW may advertise the Load Control Information?
q_29620.ground_truth: The maximum number of APNs, for which the PGW may advertise the Load Control Information, is 10, i.e. the maximum number of occurrences of the tuple (APN, Relative Capacity) within and across various instances of the LCI IE shall be limited to 10, for a given PGW.

q_29621.question: What are the sub-clauses that specify the RSRP measurement accuracy for all measured cells?
q_29621.ground_truth: The RSRP measurement accuracy for all measured cells should meet the requirements in sub-clauses 9.1.3.1 and 9.1.3.2.

q_29622.question: What does GTPtunnelEndpoint represent in the context of the procedure?
q_29622.ground_truth: The GTPtunnelEndpoint element represents the uL-GTPtunnelEndpoint in the E-RABs-To-Be-SetupRetrieve-ItemIEs X2AP-PROTOCOL-IES in the context of the E-RABs-To-Be-Setup-Retrieve-Item sequence.

q_29623.question: What is the purpose of PDP context in the MS or network?
q_29623.ground_truth: Each PDP address can be described by one or more PDP contexts in the MS or network and is used to activate a PDN connection.

q_29624.question: What action should a node take if it does not support the partial failure handling feature?
q_29624.ground_truth: If a node does not support the partial failure handling feature, it shall ignore any received FQ-CSID IE or any partial failure handling specific message.

q_29625.question: What is the duration of the time period for determining the timing of the E-UTRA OTDOA assistance data reference cell during UE's one or both SFN acquisition or cell detection?
q_29625.ground_truth: The duration of the time period for determining the timing of the E-UTRA OTDOA assistance data reference cell during UE's one or both SFN acquisition or cell detection is TRefCell,E-UTRAN = TDetect, E-UTRAN TDD + TMIB + TECGI.

q_29626.question: What should the UE do when the CSI-RS for CBD measurement is in the same OFDM symbol as SSB for RLM, BFD, CBD, or L1-RSRP measurement in FR2?
q_29626.ground_truth: The UE is required to measure one of but not both CSI-RS for CBD measurement and SSB. A longer measurement period for CSI-RS based CBD measurement is expected, and no requirements are defined.

q_29627.question: What is the purpose of the "AMF Re-allocation function" (5.16)?
q_29627.ground_truth: The "AMF Re-allocation function" allows the redirection of an initial connection request from an NG-RAN node from an initial AMF towards a target AMF selected by 5GC.

q_29628.question: What is the function of a short-lived public key in the hybrid approach?
q_29628.ground_truth: The short-lived public key is used to sign a gNB public key and other minimal data, such as expiration time and key usage. It is valid for a short period (e.g., a few hours) and can be verified using one trust anchor.

q_29629.question: Which of the following NFs does not interact with the VERIFICATION AS when Intra-CSP session verification is required?

q_29630.question: What is the measurement control information indicated to the UE in the test described in section 7.6.15.3.4.2?
q_29630.ground_truth: In the test described in section 7.6.15.3.4.2, event-triggered reporting with Event A3 is used for carrier 2.

q_29631.question: What is the purpose of the "LTE-M Indication" in the S1-AP message used to upload the UE Radio Capabilities to the MME?
q_29631.ground_truth: The "LTE-M Indication" indicates to the MME whether the UE is Category M, which is used by the Core Network to be able to identify traffic to/from Category M UEs for charging differentiation.

q_29632.question: What is the action required by the UE after sending a Binding Revocation Acknowledgement message with the status field set to 'Success'?
q_29632.ground_truth: After sending a Binding Revocation Acknowledgement message with the status field set to 'Success', the UE shall remove the entry identified in the BRI as deregistered from its binding update list and use the procedures defined in IETF RFC 4306 to remove the IPsec security associations associated with the DSMIPv6 registration.

q_29633.question: What is the meaning of the "R" bit in the Command Flags field for the Diameter RAR command in 3GPP AAA protocol?
q_29633.ground_truth: The "R" bit in the Command Flags field for the Diameter RAR command indicates that the command is sent from a 3GPP AAA Server or 3GPP AAA Proxy to a PDN-GW.

q_29634.question: What must a participating MCPTT function do upon receipt of a SIP MESSAGE request for emergency notification for terminating MCPTT client, if it cannot process the request due to lack of resources or risk of congestion?
q_29634.ground_truth: It may reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response and include a Retry-After header field in the response.

q_29635.question: What should the UE do when it receives a 5GSM session management reject message with a back-off timer for 5GSM cause values other than certain specific ones?
q_29635.ground_truth: The UE should not send another 5GSM request for the same procedure for the same combination of PLMN, DNN, and S-NSSAI (or without S-NSSAI), or no DNN and no S-NSSAI for the specified duration.

q_29636.question: What is the objective of VoNR as defined in TS 23.501 and TS 23.502?
q_29636.ground_truth: The goal of VoNR, as defined in TS 23.501 and TS 23.502, is to provide functionality equivalent to VoLTE in 4G.

q_29637.question: What is the main purpose of 5G LAN-Type Service?
q_29637.ground_truth: To provide private communication using IP and/or non-IP type communications

q_29638.question: What value of the Recovery (Restart Counter) is used to indicate that neither the MME nor the SGW has restarted?
q_29638.ground_truth: The value of the Recovery (Restart Counter) is 0 when neither the MME nor the SGW has restarted.

q_29639.question: Which simulated network scenarios are listed in this sub clause for NB-IoT single mode multi cell network scenarios?
q_29639.ground_truth: NB-IoT basic intra-frequency multi cell environment, NB-IoT basic inter-frequency multi cell environment, NB-IoT basic inter-band cell environment, NB-IoT multi tracking area intra-frequency multi cell environment, and NB-IoT multi tracking area inter-frequency multi cell environment.

q_29640.question: What is the purpose of the 5G Media Streaming (5GMS) service as specified in the present document?
q_29640.ground_truth: The 5GMS service specifies the set of protocols and APIs for 5G Media Streaming (5GMS) services based on the 5G Media Streaming Architecture (5GMSA), which supports services including MNO and third-party Downlink Media Streaming Services, and MNO and third-party Uplink Media Streaming Services.

q_29641.question: What must the NAF do when it requires an update of the shared key with the UE due to expiration or local validity conditions?
q_29641.ground_truth: The NAF sends a bootstrapping renegotiation request to the UE, which starts a protocol over the reference point Ub to obtain a new key Ks.

q_29642.question: What message does the MN send to the SN in case a security key update is required and no bearer type change is performed?
q_29642.ground_truth: The MN provides a new SgNB Security Key to the SN.

q_29643.question: When will the transmission of the MAC PDU for V2X sidelink communication be prioritized over uplink transmissions?
q_29643.ground_truth: The transmission of the MAC PDU for V2X sidelink communication is prioritized over uplink transmissions if the MAC entity is not able to perform all uplink transmissions and all transmissions of V2X sidelink communication simultaneously, uplink transmission is not prioritized by upper layer, and the value of the highest priority of the sidelink logical channel(s) in the MAC PDU is lower than thresSL-TxPrioritization.

q_29644.question: What is the mandatory security mechanism for IMS media plane security mechanisms in IMS UEs?
q_29644.ground_truth: DTLS-SRTP based media plane security mechanism is mandatory for IMS media plane security mechanisms in IMS UEs.

q_29645.question: What action does the SCEF take if one or more parameters are not within range in a request from the SCS/AS?
q_29645.ground_truth: The SCEF may either reject the request, discard out-of-range values and proceed with the flow, or select and use in-range values for the parameters.

q_29646.question: When does the SMF maintain the same IP address/prefix in an existing PDU Session?
q_29646.ground_truth: The SMF maintains the same IP address/prefix in an existing PDU Session when the Request Type in step 3 indicates "Existing PDU Session".

q_29647.question: What enhancements are made to the PDU session establishment procedure considering application QoS policy?
q_29647.ground_truth: SMF may have PDU set level QoS policy information if dynamic PCC is applied. UE requests PDU session establishment by including XR/media dedicated DNN and S-NSSAI.

q_29648.question: When is an SGW expected to send a Modify Access Bearers Response message as a response to a Modify Access Bearers Request message from an MME?
q_29648.ground_truth: An SGW is expected to send a Modify Access Bearers Response message as a response to a Modify Access Bearers Request message from an MME if it supports the MABR feature and handling of all default bearers to be modified was successful.

q_29649.question: What should the network do upon reception of a NOTIFICATION message and the UE is in the 5GMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE state over 3GPP access and has performed a local release of its user plane resources of MA PDU sessions associated with the 3GPP access?
q_29649.ground_truth: The network should respond with a NOTIFICATION RESPONSE message over non-3GPP access indicating that the local release of its 3GPP access user plane resources of MA PDU sessions was performed.

q_29650.question: Under what condition should octet 6c of the bearer capability IE indicate "none" if the information transfer capability field indicates "facsimile group 3"?
q_29650.ground_truth: Octet 6c of the bearer capability IE should indicate "none" if the information transfer capability field indicates "facsimile group 3" and octet 6c is included.

q_29651.question: What should the UE do with logged measurement entries upon successful delivery of the UEInformationResponse message in TS 36.331?
q_29651.ground_truth: The UE should discard the logged measurement entries included in the logMeasInfoList from VarLogMeasReport upon successful delivery of the UEInformationResponse message confirmed by lower layers in TS 36.331.

q_29652.question: When will the UE consider a neighboring cell on the associated frequency to be applicable when the concerned cell matches the ncc-Permitted for a measId in GERAN?
q_29652.ground_truth: When the corresponding measObject concerns GERAN, and the trigger type is set to 'event', with the entry condition for this event being fulfilled for at least one applicable cell after layer 3 filtering.

q_29653.question: What message is used in step 4, MT-EDT for User Plane CIoT EPS Optimisation, to notify the eNB of further data traffic in excess of that initially signalled in step 2?
q_29653.ground_truth: The MME may include the Pending Data Indication in the S1AP UE Context Resume Response message.

q_29654.question: What is the responsibility of the intent-driven management service producer in the network slice subnet instance creation process?
q_29654.ground_truth: The intent-driven management service producer translates the intent of creating a network slice subnet instance to relevant requirements and provides management capabilities to support the provisioning of the network slice subnet instance.

q_29655.question: How does the MC service server determine the participants for the ad-hoc group communication when the list is determined by the MC service server in 7.1.3.2.2?
q_29655.ground_truth: The MC service server determines the participants by evaluating the criteria received from the MC service client and sending a request to the MC service server 2 for determining the participants satisfying the criteria. The MC service server 2 responds with the list of MC service users satisfying the criteria.

q_29656.question: What is the maximum number of sources that achieved the target requirement of 12-month battery life in the UE-based DL positioning of LPHAP Type B device?
q_29656.ground_truth: The maximum number of sources that achieved the target requirement of 12-month battery life in the UE-based DL positioning of LPHAP Type B device is 5 sources.

q_29657.question: What does pSEPP do after receiving a request to set up a PDU session?
q_29657.ground_truth: pSEPP shall decapsulate the request, forward it to the pNF, receive the response, reformat the response, and forward it to RH2 (if present) or to RH1 (if RH1 is not present).

q_29658.question: What is the requirement for the RSRP measurement accuracy for all measured cells as specified in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 9.1.18.2?
q_29658.ground_truth: The RSRP measurement accuracy for all measured cells shall be as specified in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 9.1.18.2.

q_29659.question: What action is taken by the LMF based on the outcome of the above procedure?
q_29659.ground_truth: Based on the outcome of the above procedure, the LMF updates the assistance data to the UE, indicating each of the PRS sources (i.e., the gNBs) as legitimate or not. The PRS transmitted by the false BS is not considered by the UE and excluded from being reported to the core network for a specified time interval in the future.

q_29660.question: What custom operation is used between the SEPPs to negotiate their security capabilities or to tear down the N32-f connection when negotiated security scheme is TLS?
q_29660.ground_truth: The Security Capability Negotiation custom operation on the exchange-capability URI is used for this purpose.

q_29661.question: What type of input can be specified for the "Type-Allocation-Code-Report" event?
q_29661.ground_truth: The input for the "Type-Allocation-Code-Report" event allows for one UE, a group of UEs, or any UE to be specified, with the option to include filters.

q_29662.question: If the L2TP User Authentication Proxy Authen Type Value is 2, which flags must be set in Octet 7?
q_29662.ground_truth: If the Proxy Authen Type Value is 2, then the PAN, PAC, PAR, and PAI flags must be set in Octet 7.

q_29663.question: What is the new state of the MS when the GPRS update status is set to GU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED and non-GPRS services are not allowed?
q_29663.ground_truth: The new GMM state is GMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-IMSI.

q_29664.question: What are the necessary additions to the existing location procedures to locate a UE with MBSR access in TS~23.273 and TS~38.305?
q_29664.ground_truth: The necessary additions include determining the MBSR position and velocity, informing the LMF about UE accessing MBSR, and reporting MBSR location and velocity when using the LMF to obtain UE location using UL SRS or DL PRS.

q_29665.question: What is the characteristic of IAB that enables it to perform relaying at layer-2 and therefore not require a local S/P-GW?
q_29665.ground_truth: IAB performs relaying at layer-2, which allows it to function without a local S/P-GW.

q_29666.question: What is the maximum DRX upper bound for enhanced RRM HST FR2 requirements?
q_29666.ground_truth: The maximum DRX upper bound for enhanced RRM HST FR2 requirements is 80 ms.

q_29667.question: In the context of 5G, what connects to the core network to provide NR access traffic via NR Uu backhaul links and supports the UE function and the DU function of the CU/DU architecture for IAB?

q_29668.question: What is the performance loss observed in the case of UE first separate training with more than 1 UE part model and 1 NW part model pairing compared to 1-on-1 joint training in the evaluation of Type 3 UE first separate training with dataset sharing manner for CSI compression?
q_29668.ground_truth: The observed performance loss is minor, moderate, and significant, with values of -0%~-1.82%, -2.17%~-4.96%, and -11.56%~-73.7%, respectively.

q_29669.question: What is the purpose of Registration Area management in 5GS Registration Management?
q_29669.ground_truth: Registration Area management comprises the functions that allocate and reallocate a Registration area to a UE, ensuring that the UE can be properly tracked and serviced by the network.

q_29670.question: What should the MCPTT client do upon receiving a SIP INFO request containing an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body with a <release-reason> element, if the cached ambient listening client role is equal to "listening MCPTT user"?
q_29670.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should provide an indication to the MCPTT user that an ambient listening call is being terminated.

q_29671.question: What determines the regulatory regime applying to User Equipments (UEs) on a vessel that is operating outside of sovereign territory?
q_29671.ground_truth: The national registration of the vessel determines the regulatory regime applying to UEs on the vessel when it is operating outside of sovereign territory.

q_29672.question: What is the approximate test time for the 4x2 beam peak searches for constant step size and constant density grids?
q_29672.ground_truth: The approximate test time for the 4x2 beam peak searches is as follows: Constant-Step Size: TX ~0.7hrs; RX ~4hrs, Constant Density: TX ~0.5hrs; RX ~3hrs.

q_29673.question: What is the performance of the AI/ML based CSI prediction in terms of SGCS compared to the nearest historical CSI benchmark from the prediction window length perspective?
q_29673.ground_truth: The performance is related to the prediction length in terms of the distance to the applicable time of the predicted CSI.

q_29674.question: Which element can be used to indicate if the 5G DDNMF cannot accept a request in the "response-reject" element?
q_29674.ground_truth: The "PC3a-control-protocol-cause-value" element can be used to indicate if the 5G DDNMF cannot accept a request in the "response-reject" element.

q_29675.question: How is consumption reporting active determined for a streaming session?
q_29675.ground_truth: Consumption reporting for a session is active when the samplePercentage attribute is not present or its value is 100, or when the Media Session Handler generates a random number less than the samplePercentage value.

q_29676.question: What is the main difference between Msg5 sent by a normal NR UE and one that includes an OAM container?
q_29676.ground_truth: A normal Msg5 includes a NAS container, whereas an Msg5 sent by a non-standalone capable (NCR) UE includes an OAM container and no NAS container.

q_29677.question: What is the interface between the Serving CSCF and the service platform(s) called in the IP multimedia subsystem?

q_29678.question: What is the LTEV2XServicesAuthorized ::= SEQUENCE sequence used for?
q_29678.ground_truth: The LTEV2XServicesAuthorized ::= SEQUENCE sequence is used to authorize an LTE-V2X (vehicle-to-everything) service in the LTE network. It specifies the VehicleUE and PedestrianUE parameters, as well as any additional information (iE-Extensions) that may be required.

q_29679.question: When does the PCF include the "ueLocTime" attribute in the "EventsNotification" data type?
q_29679.ground_truth: The PCF includes the "ueLocTime" attribute in the "EventsNotification" data type when user location was required and the time when it was last known is available.

q_29680.question: What should the participating MCPTT function set as the Request-URI of the SIP INVITE request if it is generated as specified in clause~6.3.2.1.4?
q_29680.ground_truth: It should set the Request-URI of the SIP INVITE request to the public service identity of the controlling MCPTT function determined in step~13).

q_29681.question: What is the role of the NEF in the HPLMN when receiving application guidance on URSP Rule determination from an AF?
q_29681.ground_truth: The NEF in the HPLMN authorizes requests for a GPSI or an External-Group-ID and maps it into a SUPI or an Internal-Group-ID before storing them in UDR as Application Data.

q_29682.question: What tasks are included in the physical layer perspective of a Type-1 L1 random access procedure?
q_29682.ground_truth: The physical layer perspective of a Type-1 L1 random access procedure includes the transmission of a random access preamble (Msg1) in a PRACH, random access response (RAR) message with a PDCCH/PDSCH (Msg2), and a PUSCH scheduled by a RAR UL grant when applicable, and PDSCH for contention resolution.

q_29683.question: What is a "Signalling Radio Bearer" (SRB) in the context of E-UTRA/EPC and NR?
q_29683.ground_truth: SRBs are radio bearers used only for the transmission of RRC and NAS messages.

q_29684.question: In what situation would a UE initiate the announce request procedure before the validity timer T4007 expires?
q_29684.ground_truth: To ensure service continuity if the UE needs to keep announcing a ProSe Restricted Code corresponding to the same RPAUID.

q_29685.question: What action will the SGSN take if the MS requested "SMS-only service" and the MS initiated the combined routing area updating procedure?
q_29685.ground_truth: The SGSN will use GMM cause #28 "SMS provided via GPRS in this routing area" in the ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message and may indicate in the Update result IE that ISR is activated.

q_29686.question: What bit in Octet 7 of the C-TAG IE determines the least significant bit of the C-VID value?
q_29686.ground_truth: Bit 1 in Octet 7 of the C-TAG IE

q_29687.question: In what scenario will the mac-ContentionResolutionTimer be restarted at each HARQ retransmission of the bundle in the subframe corresponding to the last subframe of a PUSCH transmission?
q_29687.ground_truth: This will occur when, for EDT, edt-SmallTBS-Enabled is set to TRUE for the corresponding PRACH resource, and a Random Access procedure was initiated by the MAC sublayer itself or by the RRC sublayer.

q_29688.question: What function does the Control (EDBNC) UP function perform in relation to the EDBNC feature flag?
q_29688.ground_truth: The Control (EDBNC) UP function sets the EDBNC feature flag, which allows the CP to provide the Extended DL Buffering Notification Policy IE in addition to the Buffering Duration IE.

q_29689.question: What does the TSCTSF do if the UE is out of the Requested Coverage Area?
q_29689.ground_truth: The TSCTSF creates a PTP port in a DS-TT and assigns it into the PTP instance but temporarily removes the UE/DS-TT from the PTP instance and indicates the PTP port state as Inactive for the related DS-TT PTP port.

q_29690.question: For which E-UTRA TAB connector band does the basic limit for unwanted emissions, option 2, apply in region 2?
q_29690.ground_truth: For E-UTRA TAB connector operating in Bands 1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 10, 25, 30, 33, 34, 35, 36, 37, 38, 39, 40, 41, 45, 48, 65, 66, 69, 70, the basic limits for unwanted emissions, option 2, apply in region 2.

q_29691.question: When does the EVM equalizer spectrum flatness requirement apply?
q_29691.ground_truth: The EVM equalizer spectrum flatness requirement applies during the measurement interval for EVM and for Pi/2 BPSK modulation.

q_29692.question: Why are verticals not able to guarantee optimal slice requirements parameters on the first try?
q_29692.ground_truth: Verticals make their best effort in specifying slice requirements but cannot account for all potential factors, resulting in a need for ongoing adjustments.

q_29693.question: What is the purpose of the Progressive Download of On-Demand Content procedure?
q_29693.ground_truth: This procedure describes the establishment of a unicast downlink media streaming session with 5GMSd AF interactions for dynamic policy updates. It allows for progressive download of on-demand content using various formats.

q_29694.question: What is the type of the MBSFN Area List parameter, and how many entries can the target MBSFN area list have?
q_29694.ground_truth: The MBSFN Area List is a parameter of type MBSFN Area(s) that consists of a MBSFN Area ID and Carrier Frequency (EARFCN). The target MBSFN area list can have up to 8 entries.

q_29695.question: What is the ProSe Function CTF (ADF) in Proximity-based Services (ProSe)?
q_29695.ground_truth: The ProSe Function CTF (ADF) is the Accounting Data Forwarding (ADF) function block of the Charging Trigger Function (CTF) in the ProSe Function.

q_29696.question: What action does the CHF take in step 3ch-b?
q_29696.ground_truth: The CHF creates a CDR for the notify message provided by TSCTSF.

q_29697.question: What is the purpose of the Edge Repository functionality introduced in TS 23.558 10.1.3?
q_29697.ground_truth: The Edge Repository functionality is introduced to enhance the ECS with a new functionality that allows it to accept registration of other ECSs of the ECSP. The enhanced ECS maintains information of which application is available via which ECS for the ECSP. This improves the accuracy and reduces the time taken to generate the service provisioning response sent to the EEC or the EES, thereby improving the chances of service continuity during ACR procedures.

q_29698.question: What is the purpose of the "type" property in an error response for JSON Merge Patch?
q_29698.ground_truth: The "type" property in an error response for JSON Merge Patch provides high level error information and complements HTTP 4xx and 5xx error codes with more details on the nature of the problem.

q_29699.question: Under which conditions can the SMF stop monitoring the corresponding AF?
q_29699.ground_truth: The SMF can stop monitoring the corresponding AF when it receives the AF address associated with the removed PCC rule(s) from the PCF's notification message.

q_29700.question: What should the controlling MCPTT function do when receiving a SIP re-INVITE request indicating a new emergency indication and the in-progress emergency state of the group is set to a value of "true"?
q_29700.ground_truth: For each of the other affiliated members of the group, the controlling MCPTT function shall generate a SIP MESSAGE request notification of the MCPTT user's emergency indication, set the <emergency-ind> element of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body to a value of "true", and include the <mcptt-calling-user-id> element set to the value of the <mcptt-calling-user-id> element in the received SIP re-INVITE request. If indicated in step 6) b), the controlling MCPTT function shall also set the <alert-ind> element of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body to a value of "true".

q_29701.question: In which mode(s) can an RLC entity operate?
q_29701.ground_truth: An RLC entity can operate in one of the following three modes: Transparent Mode (TM), Unacknowledged Mode (UM), or Acknowledged Mode (AM).

q_29702.question: What type of UE(s) can be specified in the input for the "UEs-In-Area-Report" event?
q_29702.ground_truth: The input for the "UEs-In-Area-Report" event allows for any UE to be specified.
