q_30421.question: What is the requirement for the transmission power when transmitting PRACH in a secondary serving cell and PUSCH/PUCCH in a different serving cell belonging to a different TAG?
q_30421.ground_truth: The transmission power of PUSCH/PUCCH should be adjusted so that its total transmission power does not exceed on the overlapped portion.

q_30422.question: What must the UE do when receiving a RRC message implying conditional handover in NR?
q_30422.ground_truth: The UE must be ready to start the transmission of the new uplink PRACH channel within Dhandover seconds from the end of the last TTI containing the RRC command.

q_30423.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project Technical Specification Group's work on Lawful Interception (LI) architecture and functions in Release 18?
q_30423.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification Group produced the present document to standardize Lawful Interception of telecommunications and specify the architecture and functions required to support LI in 3GPP networks, in accordance with applicable national or regional laws and technical regulations.

q_30424.question: When would a UE set the EPS update status to EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED and the UE store the current TAI in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming"?
q_30424.ground_truth: When the UE receives a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message with the reject cause set to "roaming not allowed in this tracking area" after sending a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message with EPS update type set to 'Combined TA/LA updating'.

q_30425.question: What type of SIP MESSAGE request is sent to the originating participating MCPTT function with the Request-URI set to its public service identity, and contains an XML body with an <emergency-ind> element?
q_30425.ground_truth: A "SIP MESSAGE request for emergency notification for originating participating MCPTT function"

q_30426.question: What will the SCC AS do if it receives SIP 200 (OK) response to the initial SIP INVITE request from the remote UE on the Target Access Leg and a SIP BYE request on an existing dialog on the Source Access Leg with the status code 480 (Temporarily Unavailable) in a Reason header field indicating that this dialog was released by the S-CSCF?
q_30426.ground_truth: The SCC AS will retain the information pertaining to the dialog on the Source Access Leg for a specific time interval, and if it receives an initial INVITE request on the Target Access Leg indicating that this dialog is replacing the dialog on the Source Access Leg, it will not initiate the release of the dialog toward the remote UE.

q_30427.question: What should the value of the "report-suspension" element be in an MBMS bearer suspension report, if the purpose is to prevent an avalanche of identical reports sent by clients roughly at the same time?
q_30427.ground_truth: The value of the "report-suspension" element should be "false".

q_30428.question: What is the specification for early data transfer (EDT) data in UP-EDT?
q_30428.ground_truth: In UP-EDT, security is re-activated prior to transmission of RRC message using the nextHopChainingCount provided in the RRCConnectionRelease message with suspend indication during the preceding suspend procedure and the radio bearers are re-established. The uplink data are transmitted ciphered on DTCH multiplexed with the RRCConnectionResumeRequest message on CCCH. In response to a request for EDT, E-UTRAN may also choose to establish or resume the RRC connection.

q_30429.question: Which application context is used for IMSI retrieval between HLR and VLR?
q_30429.ground_truth: The "imsiRetrievalContext-v2" application context is used for IMSI retrieval between HLR and VLR.

q_30430.question: What is the purpose of the Network Instance attribute in the 5G VN group in the PLMN when more than one 5G VN group is supported?
q_30430.ground_truth: The Network Instance attribute is used to keep the traffic of different 5G VN groups separate from each other during the packet detection and forwarding process, enabling isolation of the 5G VN group communication.

q_30431.question: What is the memory type used to store a list of "Cells-to-be-Activated-List-ItemIEs" in the "GNB-DU-Served-Cells-List" field?
q_30431.ground_truth: It is a SEQUENCE (SIZE(1.. maxCellingNBDU)) OF ProtocolIE-SingleContainer, which is used to store a list of "Cells-to-be-Activated-List-ItemIEs" for each cell of the GNB-DU served cell list.

q_30432.question: When can the 3gpp-Sbi-Target-apiRoot header be used in a request between SEPPs?

q_30433.question: What is the significance of the <mcvideo-off-network-ProSe-media-PPPP> element in the context of the MCVideo group and off-network MCVideo procedures?
q_30433.ground_truth: The value of this element indicates the ProSe Per-Packet Priority value for media transmissions in a call made on the MCVideo group in off-network MCVideo procedures.

q_30434.question: What is the length of the Macro eNodeB ID in bits?
q_30434.ground_truth: The Macro eNodeB ID consists of 20 bits.

q_30435.question: What should the UE do if it receives the ESM cause value #50 or #51 and the selected PDN type is different from the one allowed by the network?
q_30435.ground_truth: The UE should not send another PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message to the same APN (or no APN) to obtain a PDN type different from the one allowed by the network until the UE is registered to a new PLMN, switched off, or the USIM is removed.

q_30436.question: What is Z in the calculation of TdormantBWPswitchDelay, and how is it determined?
q_30436.ground_truth: Z is the length of one slot, corresponding to the SCS of the serving cell where UE receives dormancy indication. It is determined by the SCS of the serving cell at the time the UE receives the dormancy indication.

q_30437.question: What is the transmission power of a PRACH transmission in Dual Connectivity Mode 2?
q_30437.ground_truth: If a UE has a PRACH transmission for CG1 overlapping with subframe i of CG1, the transmission power of that PRACH transmission is denoted by PPRACH, cg1, i. Otherwise, the transmission power is zero. Similarly, for CG2, the transmission power of the PRACH is denoted by PPRACH, cg2, i if there is a PRACH transmission for CG2 in subframe i of CG2, and zero otherwise.

q_30438.question: In Solution #21, what procedures does the UE initiate if the resumption of RRC connection fails when moving out of RNA and within RA?
q_30438.ground_truth: In Solution #21, if the resumption of RRC connection fails, the UE initiates the Mobility Registration Update procedure. In this procedure, the UE includes the MBS session information (i.e. whether the UE wants to join or leave a multicast MBS session) in the MBS session information container together with the associated PDU Session ID(s) in the Registration Request. The SMF then performs the corresponding multicast MBS session procedures based on the information in the MBS session information container, and the UE may be changed to RRC Inactive state to receive the MBS data.

q_30439.question: When will the UE remove an SNPN identity from the list of equivalent SNPNs?
q_30439.ground_truth: The UE will remove an SNPN identity from the list of equivalent SNPNs if it is present in the "permanently forbidden SNPNs" list or the "temporarily forbidden SNPNs" list, or if there is no emergency PDU session established and the UE is not registered for onboarding services in SNPN.

q_30440.question: What is the purpose of feature negotiation in the context of these APIs, as specified in clause 6.8?
q_30440.ground_truth: Feature negotiation is used to determine which optional features are supported by the API and should be used during API invocations.

q_30441.question: What should be the Request-URI set to in the HTTP POST request, when the VAE-S wants to obtain the consent from a user to update group information?
q_30441.ground_truth: The Request-URI should be set to the URI corresponding to the identity of the VAE-C.

q_30442.question: What is the data type of the 3GPP-IPv6-DNS-Servers sub-attribute?
q_30442.ground_truth: The 3GPP-IPv6-DNS-Servers sub-attribute is of Octet String type.

q_30443.question: What is the special co-existence requirement for 3GPP specifications in a case of operation with overlapping frequency arrangements in the same geographical area?
q_30443.ground_truth: Such a scenario may require adherence to additional co-existence specifications that are not covered by the 3GPP standards.

q_30444.question: What is the purpose of the "id-TransactionID" field in the IAB-Donor-CU-UPPSKInfo sequence?
q_30444.ground_truth: The "id-TransactionID" field in the IAB-Donor-CU-UPPSKInfo sequence is used to identify a specific transaction.

q_30445.question: What is the name of the data container that holds the info about the UE's context in UEContextSetupResponse?

q_30446.question: What should the controlling MCVideo function do upon receiving a SIP BYE request containing an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body?
q_30446.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function should copy the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body into the outgoing SIP BYE request, perform the procedures as specified in the clause 6.3.3.1.4, and stop timer TNG1 (acknowledged call setup timer) if the local counter of the number of SIP 200 (OK) responses received from invited members is greater than or equal to the value of the <on-network-minimum-number-to-start> element of the group document.

q_30447.question: Where should the credentials used with EAP-AKA and EAP-AKA' reside if the terminal supports 3GPP access capabilities?
q_30447.ground_truth: If the terminal supports 3GPP access capabilities, the credentials used with EAP-AKA and EAP-AKA' shall reside on the UICC.

q_30448.question: What should the MCData client include in the Request-URI of the SIP INVITE request?
q_30448.ground_truth: The public service identity identifying the participating MCData function serving the MCData user.

q_30449.question: What is the INITIATING MESSAGE for handoverResourceAllocation?
q_30449.ground_truth: The INITIATING MESSAGE for handoverResourceAllocation is HandoverRequest.

q_30450.question: What is the difference between Tethered Standalone AR Glasses and Display AR Glasses?
q_30450.ground_truth: Tethered Standalone AR Glasses run an XR application that uses the capabilities of the Glasses to create a service and are tethered to a 5G device, while Display AR Glasses are tethered to a 5G device that includes the application and the XR functions and run the AR/MR experience. The XR runtime API is exposed to the 5G device/phone in Display AR Glasses.

q_30451.question: In what state must the UE be for the LMF to select an uplink positioning method in UE unaware positioning?
q_30451.ground_truth: The UE must be in CM_CONNECTED state for the LMF to select an uplink positioning method in UE unaware positioning.

q_30452.question: What does the "LADN information +CLADN" unsolicited result code indicate in the 5G Network?
q_30452.ground_truth: The "LADN information +CLADN" unsolicited result code in the 5G Network indicates that there has been a change in the LADN information stored at the MT and it contains the current values of LADN information if available.

q_30453.question: Which 5GS entity sends the overall jitter range and local jitter range to the RAN during PDU Session Establishment/Modification procedure?

q_30454.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP Technical Report on Off-Network for Rail?
q_30454.ground_truth: The purpose of the report is to study the feasibility of further enhancements to the 5G system to support Off-Network for Rail and collect all relevant use cases from the SA1 Study on Future Railway Mobile Communication System.

q_30455.question: What should the MCData server include in the SIP PUBLISH request for sending an affiliation request to a handled MCData group ID?
q_30455.ground_truth: The MCData server should include a SIP PUBLISH request with Request-URI set to the public service identity of the controlling MCData function associated with the handled MCData group ID. The message should include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body, containing the served MCData ID in the <mcdata-calling-user-id> element and the handled MCData group ID in the <mcdata-request-uri> element.

q_30456.question: What action should be taken if the Accept-Contact header field does not include the g.3gpp.mcvideo media feature tag or the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag containing the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcvideo"?
q_30456.ground_truth: The SIP request should be rejected with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response and not processed further.

q_30457.question: Which type of RLC with short SN is indicated as supported in RLC-Parameters?

q_30458.question: What is the impact of the solution on services, entities, and interfaces?
q_30458.ground_truth: The entities impacted by this solution are the UPF at the XR Server and any gNB that supports this functionality. If a new QoS attribute is added for the PDU Set delay budget, there would be some impacts on the PCF and SMF. The AMF and any UPFs in between the gNB and the UPF at the XR Server are not impacted.

q_30459.question: What is the purpose of the provisioning step in the PFD call flow?
q_30459.ground_truth: The provisioning step in the PFD call flow is the process of provisioning one or more PFDs for the traffic identification of a single application.

q_30460.question: What action should the gNB-DU take if the Notification Control IE is included in the DRB to Be Setup List IE and set to active?
q_30460.ground_truth: The gNB-DU should monitor the QoS of the DRB and notify the gNB-CU if the QoS cannot be fulfilled any longer or if the QoS can be fulfilled again. This pertains only to GBR bearers.

q_30461.question: What action does the UE take when it receives a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message with the reject cause set to "UE identity cannot be derived by the network"?
q_30461.ground_truth: The UE deletes any GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI list and KSI, enters the state EMM-DEREGISTERED, and automatically initiates the attach procedure.

q_30462.question: What should the AMF do if all the NG-RANs serving the Broadcast MBS session requested the AMF to release the Broadcast MBS session?
q_30462.ground_truth: The AMF shall release the Broadcast MBS session context and send a notification with the releaseInd attribute set to true to report to the MB-SMF that the Broadcast MBS session (context) is released at the AMF and NG-RANs.

q_30463.question: What is the term used to describe a devastating event where a large number of packets are lost during a limited period?

q_30464.question: What happens after the MCVideo server sends an MBS session stop request towards the 5GS?
q_30464.ground_truth: The 5GS removes the MCVideo UEs from the corresponding MBS session, and resources in both NG-RAN and 5GC are released.

q_30465.question: What is the difference between step 5a and step 6a when generating and sending CDR information in the SMS-SC?
q_30465.ground_truth: Both steps include the SCS Identifier and the SMS Application port ID which is included in the SM User Data Header in the CDR information. However, step 5a is sent to the MTC-IWF with a cause value indicating success, while step 6a is sent to the MTC-IWF as a Trigger Delivery Report for the original trigger message indicating that this message has been recalled, and it is not sent with a cause value.

q_30466.question: What information is provided by the 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-UE Relay in the Direct Communication Accept message?
q_30466.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-UE Relay may provide the IP address of the target 5G ProSe End UE to the source 5G ProSe End UE in the Direct Communication Accept message, if the target 5G ProSe End UE IP address is available at the time.

q_30467.question: What is the role of MMS charging in the charging architecture and principles in GSM/UMTS networks?
q_30467.ground_truth: The present document specifies the offline and online charging description for MMS charging, based on the functional stage 2 descriptions of the MMS. This charging description includes the offline and online charging architecture and scenarios specific to the MMS, as well as the mapping of the common 3GPP charging architecture onto MMS. It further specifies the structure and content of the CDRs for offline charging, and the charging events for online charging.

q_30468.question: What is the purpose of the Storage Approach in this process?
q_30468.ground_truth: The Storage Approach determines how the storage and retrieval of data or analytics are managed, and it is based on either default operator policies or a storage handling request received from the Data or Analytics Consumer.

q_30469.question: What is the role of the local NSACF in 5GS-EPS interworking with EPS counting active?
q_30469.ground_truth: The local NSACF will be updated with the change of UE leaving one Service Area and entering the new Service Area, per policy. However, the actual admission is still determined by the central NSACF, even if the local NSACF is maintaining count.

q_30470.question: What happens if the Location Reporting Control procedure fails?
q_30470.ground_truth: If the Location Reporting Control procedure fails, the eNB shall indicate the failure using the Location Report Failure Indication procedure.

q_30471.question: What should the terminating AS do if the callee is found to be not registered and the terminating AS supports the CCNL service?
q_30471.ground_truth: If the callee is found to be not registered and the terminating AS supports the CCNL service, then the terminating AS shall insert a Call-Info header field with a "purpose" header field parameter set to "call-completion" and an m-parameter set to "NL" in the 480 (Temporarily Unavailable) response generated by the terminating AS to indicate that CCNL is possible.

q_30472.question: What action does the NWDAF take if user consent is not granted for a user for whom data is to be collected?
q_30472.ground_truth: The NWDAF excludes the SUPI or GPSI from requests to collect data for users for whom the user consent is not granted.

q_30473.question: What information does the rolling counter in the GTP-U header indicate for each PDU Set instance within a PDU Family?
q_30473.ground_truth: The rolling counter in the GTP-U header indicates a sequential number for each PDU Set instance within a PDU Family. It helps distinguish between two instances of the same PDU Set Type and indicates the dependency of a PDU Set instance on another PDU Set instance.

q_30474.question: What does the "3gpp-Sbi-Originating-Network-Id" header contain?
q_30474.ground_truth: The "3gpp-Sbi-Originating-Network-Id" header contains the PLMN Identity (MCC-MNC) of the source PLMN or the SNPN ID (MCC-MNC-NID) of the source SNPN of the received HTTP messages.

q_30475.question: What information does the CCF store upon a successful authentication and authorization?
q_30475.ground_truth: The CCF stores the API Invoker profile with API Invoker ID, Onboard Secret, AEF key along with Target AEF information.

q_30476.question: What is the significance of the DRX cycle length in Test 1 and Test 2?
q_30476.ground_truth: The DRX cycle length is the time period for which a UE remains inactive in a cellular network. It is an important parameter that affects the overall delay in reporting events and the power consumption of the UE. In Test 1 and Test 2, the DRX cycle length is used to calculate the overall delay measured.

q_30477.question: What does the "CSRN" resource represent in the Nhss-ims-sdm API?
q_30477.ground_truth: The "CSRN" resource represents the CSRN (Core Support Node Reference Number) in the Nhss-ims-sdm API.

q_30478.question: What is the format of the value for the AppID in the 3GPP_IMS node?
q_30478.ground_truth: The value of the AppID is a globally unique string, determined by OMA.

q_30479.question: What should the network do if the GUTI/IMSI mapping is incorrect during the authentication procedure?
q_30479.ground_truth: The network should respond by sending a new AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message to the UE.

q_30480.question: What type of PCO information should the PDN GW take into account when encoding the APN Rate Control parameters and enforcing APN Rate Control?
q_30480.ground_truth: If received, the PDN GW may take the APN Rate Control Status into account when encoding the APN Rate Control parameters and when enforcing the APN Rate Control.

q_30481.question: What should the 'Applicable for Start of Pause of Charging' Flag be set to, in order to indicate the UP function to stop the usage measurement for the URR when receiving a Start Pause of Charging indication from the downstream GTP-U entity?
q_30481.ground_truth: The 'Applicable for Start of Pause of Charging' Flag should be set to "1".

q_30482.question: What should the AMF (Access and Mobility Management Function) do when the AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message could not be delivered due to a handover?
q_30482.ground_truth: If the AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message could not be delivered due to an intra AMF handover and the target TA is included in the TAI list, then upon successful completion of the intra AMF handover the AMF shall retransmit the AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message.

q_30483.question: What is the requirement for a UE to transmit PUCCH, PUSCH or SRS or receive PDCCH, PDSCH, CSI-RS for tracking or CSI-RS for CQI on reference symbols to be measured for candidate beam detection?
q_30483.ground_truth: The UE is not expected to transmit or receive these signals on reference symbols to be measured for candidate beam detection under certain conditions.

q_30484.question: When should a remote leg update be performed when transferring a session in a IP Multimedia Subsystem (IMS)?
q_30484.ground_truth: A remote leg update should be performed when the IMS network is transferring a session and needs to correlate the SIP INVITE request to the local and remote call legs of the existing session between the UE A and the remote end.

q_30485.question: What is the purpose of the "Event Reporting Information" in data analytics?
q_30485.ground_truth: The "Event Reporting Information" is used to alleviate the load of analytics for "Any UE" by enabling filters such as Area of Interest for AMF and possible analytics filters including Top-Heavy UEs and/or Fixed and/or Camper UEs and/or Analytics Reporting Information.

q_30486.question: What is the purpose of the application layer IDs of the other UEs in the SL-MT-LR request in step 10?
q_30486.ground_truth: The application layer IDs of the other UEs in the SL-MT-LR request in step 10 are used to identify the UEs in the following steps.

q_30487.question: What is the minimum requirement for a 2 Rx RedCap UE to send event triggered measurement reports for inter-frequency cells?
q_30487.ground_truth: The reporting criteria must be fulfilled, and there should be available UL resources for the UE to send the measurement report.

q_30488.question: What should the UE do upon receiving the DETACH ACCEPT message in 3GPP TS 24.301 clause 3.1?
q_30488.ground_truth: The UE shall stop timer T3421 upon receiving the DETACH ACCEPT message.

q_30489.question: What is the requirement for the UE when it receives a MobilityFromEUTRACommand message with a purpose set to 'handover' in the described scenario?
q_30489.ground_truth: The UE should consider inter-RAT mobility as initiated towards the RAT indicated by the targetRAT-Type included in the MobilityFromEUTRACommand message, forward the nas-SecurityParamFromEUTRA to the upper layers, access the target cell indicated in the inter-RAT message in accordance with the specifications of the target RAT, and use the contents of systemInformation as the system information to begin access on the target GERAN cell if the targetRAT-Type is set to 'geran'.

q_30490.question: What information does the MCVideo client include in the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message when a call is upgraded?
q_30490.ground_truth: The MCVideo client includes the stored call identifier, stored current call type, stored refresh interval, stored SDP body, stored originating MCVideo user ID, stored MCVideo group ID, stored call start time, stored last call type change time, and stored last user to change call type in the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message.

q_30491.question: What event triggers the SMF to generate an xIRI containing an SMFMAUnsuccessfulProcedure record?
q_30491.ground_truth: The IRI-POI in the SMF generates the xIRI when an unsuccessful procedure or error condition for a UE matching one of the target identifiers is detected. This includes unsuccefull SMF messages such as PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT, PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT, and PDU SESSION RELEASE REJECT, as well as an ongoing SM procedure being aborted due to a 5GSM STATUS message.

q_30492.question: What should the SMF do if the "EnTSCAC" feature is supported and the burst arrival time is not provided, but the capability for BAT adaptation is received?
q_30492.ground_truth: The SMF should set the value of "capBatAdaptation" attribute as the value of capability for BAT adaptation in the TSCAI, and enable notification control for the QoS Flow in order to receive the BAT offset along with the "GFBR can no longer be guaranteed" notification.

q_30493.question: Which two protocolIEs in the PWSCancelRequestIEs are marked as CRITICALITY reject and PRESENCE mandatory?
q_30493.ground_truth: The two protocolIEs in the PWSCancelRequestIEs that are marked as CRITICALITY reject and PRESENCE mandatory are id-MessageIdentifier and id-SerialNumber.

q_30494.question: What is the delay requirement when the UE transmits a PRACH preamble to Cell 2 in step 6?
q_30494.ground_truth: The UE must transmit the PRACH preamble to Cell 2 within the delay requirement specified in clause 16.3.1.4.5, which is 212 ms in this case.

q_30495.question: What is the difference between the operating band and the radio bandwidth?
q_30495.ground_truth: The operating band refers to a specific frequency range defined with a set of technical requirements in which NR operates. Radio bandwidth, on the other hand, is the frequency difference between the upper edge of the highest used carrier and the lower edge of the lowest used carrier.

q_30496.question: Which bit within Octet 5 of the Packet Delay Thresholds IE indicates if the Downlink packet delay field shall be present?

q_30497.question: What is the procedure for the SS to activate SCC (Secondary Cell Context) in this section?
q_30497.ground_truth: The SS activates SCC by sending the activation MAC CE to ensure the UE receives the message, waiting for at least 2 seconds before sending the message.

q_30498.question: What is the purpose of the WLAN Connection Status Reporting procedure?
q_30498.ground_truth: The WLAN Connection Status Reporting procedure provides feedback to the eNB related to the WLAN status and operation, supporting indications such as WLAN connection failure, success, temporary suspension, and resumption.

q_30499.question: What should the MCVideo client do if the MCVideo emergency group call state is set to "MVEGC 3: emergency-call-granted" and the MCVideo emergency alert state is set to a value other than "MVEA 1: no-alert" and the MCVideo user has indicated only the MCVideo emergency group call should be cancelled?
q_30499.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should include in the SIP re-INVITE request an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body with the <emergency-ind> element set to "false" and set the MCVideo emergency group state of the MCVideo group to "MVEG 3: cancel-pending".

q_30500.question: What is the value T in the DRX parameters, and how is it determined?
q_30500.ground_truth: T is the value of the defaultPagingCycle, and it is broadcast in system information.

q_30501.question: When does the LMF become involved in the sidelink positioning/ranging procedure?
q_30501.ground_truth: In the MO-LR procedure for sidelink positioning/ranging with LMF assistance, the LMF becomes involved when the UEs in network coverage or partial network coverage instigate the procedure and request assistance from the LMF.

q_30502.question: What action will be taken if the "Location update status" stored on the SIM/USIM is set to "Location Area not allowed" in the ME?
q_30502.ground_truth: The GSM Kc128 stored in the ME will be deleted.

q_30503.question: How should the MS handle timer T3396 when it is running when the MS enters state GMM-DEREGISTERED, remains switched on, and the SIM/USIM remains the same?
q_30503.ground_truth: The MS shall keep the timer T3396 running until it expires or is stopped, even after switching off and then back on.

q_30504.question: What should the AF do if it fails to receive a notification from the NEF regarding an MBS User Data Ingest Session status change?
q_30504.ground_truth: The AF should take proper error handling actions, as specified in clause~5.27.7, and respond to the NEF with an appropriate error status code, if it fails to receive a notification from the NEF regarding an MBS User Data Ingest Session status change.

q_30505.question: What should a UE do if it receives an ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message with an EPS bearer identity that matches an already activated dedicated EPS bearer context?
q_30505.ground_truth: The UE should locally deactivate the existing dedicated EPS bearer context and proceed with the requested dedicated EPS bearer context activation.

q_30506.question: When receiving a "SIP INVITE request for terminating participating MCPTT function" for an on-demand session that requires manual commencement mode, what should the participating MCPTT function include in the outgoing SIP INVITE request?
q_30506.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT function shall set the Request-URI to the public user identity associated to the MCPTT ID of the MCPTT user to be invited, include an Answer-Mode header field with the value "Manual" if no Answer-Mode header field was received, include a P-Asserted-Identity header field with the public service identity, include an SDP offer based on the SDP offer in the received SIP INVITE request, and send the SIP INVITE request towards the MCPTT client.

q_30507.question: What should be the value of octet 3, if the default value applies for the recommendation field?
q_30507.ground_truth: Octet 3 shall be omitted if the default value applies for the recommendation field.

q_30508.question: What should the MCData client do to obtain information about success or rejection of changes triggered by the affiliation status change procedure for an MCData user?
q_30508.ground_truth: The MCData client needs to initiate the affiliation status determination procedure for the MCData user before starting the affiliation status change procedure for the MCData user.

q_30509.question: What information is used to identify the TNAP or TWAP in non-3GPP access?
q_30509.ground_truth: The SSID, BSSID, and civic address are used to identify the TNAP or TWAP in non-3GPP access.

q_30510.question: What is the difference between network initiated session release and S-CSCF initiated and P-CSCF initiated session release?
q_30510.ground_truth: Network initiated session release is triggered by a bearer removal, while S-CSCF initiated session release occurs in various service scenarios like administrative or prepaid purposes. P-CSCF initiated session release is initiated by the P-CSCF after removal of IP-Connectivity Access Network bearer.

q_30511.question: What indication does the eNodeB send to the MME when it releases radio bearers in step 0?
q_30511.ground_truth: The eNodeB sends an indication of bearer release to the MME, which may be the Bearer Release Request (EPS Bearer Identity) message, Initial Context Setup Complete, Handover Request Ack, or UE Context Response, Path Switch Request message.

q_30512.question: What is one of the main purposes of this solution in the context of Ranging/Sidelink Positioning service?
q_30512.ground_truth: This solution aims to provide finer-level authorization for preserving UE privacy before SL Positioning Client UE obtains ranging result.

q_30513.question: When is the first nominal repetition omitted for PUSCH repetition Type B carrying semi-persistent CSI report(s) without a corresponding PDCCH after being activated on PUSCH by a 'CSI request' field on a DCI?
q_30513.ground_truth: The first nominal repetition is omitted if the first nominal repetition is not the same as the first actual repetition.

q_30514.question: What resource allocation scheme is supported for PDCCH/EPDCCH with uplink DCI format 0 or 4?
q_30514.ground_truth: Resource allocation schemes Type 0 and Type 1 are supported for PDCCH/EPDCCH with uplink DCI format 0 or 4.

q_30515.question: What are the two types of inter-system load reports in 15.5.1?
q_30515.ground_truth: Event-triggered and periodic inter-system load reports are supported.

q_30516.question: What is the purpose of periodic keep-alive packets during interruptions of media transmission?
q_30516.ground_truth: The purpose of periodic keep-alive packets during interruptions of media transmission is to prevent the deactivation of the MBS session based on MB-UPF notifications and to keep UEs within the MBS session in a state where they can receive the MBS session data without being paged.

q_30517.question: What is the requirement for the measurement reporting delay of Event A4 for UE supporting power class 1 in this test case?
q_30517.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay of Event A4 for UE supporting power class 1 in this test case should be less than 5120 ms from the beginning of time period T2.

q_30518.question: What is the action taken by the initiating UE when the maximum number of allowed retransmissions is reached in the 5G ProSe direct link identification procedure?
q_30518.ground_truth: After reaching the maximum number of allowed retransmissions, the initiating UE aborts the 5G ProSe direct link identification procedure and indicates the failing target end UE to the source 5G ProSe end UE.

q_30519.question: What is the cell-ranking criterion Rs and Rn for serving and neighboring cells, as defined in TS 36.304, clause 5.2.4.6?
q_30519.ground_truth: The cell-ranking criterion Rs for the serving cell and Rn for neighboring cells is defined in TS 36.304, clause 5.2.4.6, as Rs=Pservingcell+Qmeas,s and Rn=Pneighbcell+Qmeas,n, where Pservingcell and Pneighbcell are the measured reference signal received power (RSRP) for serving and neighboring cells, and Qmeas,s and Qmeas,n are the assumed cell reselection measurement parameters for serving and neighboring cells.

q_30520.question: What is the procedure when the private call timer of the controlling MCPTT function expires?
q_30520.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function shall follow the procedure for releasing the ambient listening call session as specified in clause 11.1.6.4.3, with the clarification that the <release-reason> element included in the SIP BYE request shall be set to "private-call-timer-expiry".

q_30521.question: What information does the APN level overload information include in the source node's advertisement?

q_30522.question: What is the difference between EMM-CONNECTED mode and EMM-IDLE mode for a UE?
q_30522.ground_truth: A UE is in EMM-CONNECTED mode when a NAS signalling connection exists, and in EMM-IDLE mode when no NAS signalling connection exists or when the RRC connection suspend has been indicated by lower layers.

q_30523.question: What is the purpose of distinguishing between may and need not in NOTE 4?
q_30523.ground_truth: The purpose is to avoid using "may" and "need not" as substitutes for "can" and "cannot".

q_30524.question: How does the UE determine if it should reselect an inter-frequency cell that is better ranked than the serving cell and has a non-zero Treselection timer?
q_30524.ground_truth: The UE shall evaluate this inter-frequency cell for the Treselection time. If this cell remains better ranked within this duration, then the UE shall reselect that cell.

q_30525.question: What type of attribute is omr-s-att, omr-m-bw, and omr-s-bw?
q_30525.ground_truth: These are media level attributes that are not subject to the charset attribute.

q_30526.question: What action does UE-1 and UE-2 perform after receiving the Link Modification Accept message?
q_30526.ground_truth: UE-1 and UE-2 provide information about the unicast link modification to their respective AS layers. This enables the AS layers to update the context related to the modified unicast link.

q_30527.question: What does the AF do when the EAS relocation is triggered?
q_30527.ground_truth: The AF determines the target EAS and sends the corresponding PLMN ID to request the EAS relocation to the target EAS deployed by OP2 in the target PLMN.

q_30528.question: What should a mobile station do if it cannot resolve the MAC value from a second AUTHENTICATION AND CIPHERING REQUEST message, while timer T3320 is running?
q_30528.ground_truth: The MS should follow the procedure specified in subclause (g), starting again from the beginning.

q_30529.question: What action does the I-CSCF take upon receiving the Cx-Query message from the HSS regarding a Public User Identity that is currently registered?
q_30529.ground_truth: The I-CSCF sends the Cx-Query Resp message to the HSS with the indication of the entry point, such as the S-CSCF.

q_30530.question: What is the purpose of the V-SMF in the PDU Session establishment procedure in Solution 25?
q_30530.ground_truth: The V-SMF selects and inserts UL-CL/L-PSA for the DNS traffic at PDU Session establishment and for the EC application traffic either statically at PDU Session establishment, or dynamically, based on interaction with V-EASDF.

q_30531.question: When would the target UE send a PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message containing PC5 signalling protocol cause value #13?
q_30531.ground_truth: When the 5G ProSe direct link establishment request is for 5G ProSe UE-to-network relaying and the NAS level mobility management congestion control is activated at the target UE or the target UE is under congestion.

q_30532.question: In what scenario can the participating MCPTT function choose to accept a SIP INVITE request with an emergency indication set to true?
q_30532.ground_truth: When the received SIP INVITE request contains an emergency indication set to true, the participating MCPTT function has the option to accept the request.

q_30533.question: What should the participating MCData function determine before sending a disposition notification message?
q_30533.ground_truth: The participating MCData function should determine the group identity related to an FD message request and the MCData user targeted for the disposition notification before sending a disposition notification message.

q_30534.question: What AVPs should be present when Non-IP-PDN-Type-Indicator is set to TRUE (1), and Non-IP-Data-Delivery-Mechanism is set to SCEF-BASED-DATA-DELIVERY (1)?
q_30534.ground_truth: The SCEF-ID AVP and the SCEF-Realm AVP, and optionally the RDS-Indicator AVP, should be present when Non-IP-PDN-Type-Indicator is set to TRUE (1), and Non-IP-Data-Delivery-Mechanism is set to SCEF-BASED-DATA-DELIVERY (1).

q_30535.question: In what condition would the user equipment (UE) diagnose a semantic error in packet filters?
q_30535.ground_truth: When a packet filter consists of conflicting packet filter components which would render the packet filter ineffective, i.e. no IP packet will ever fit this packet filter.

q_30536.question: What message does the PCRF send to the TSSF to initiate the St session establishment procedure?
q_30536.ground_truth: The PCRF initiates the procedure by sending a Diameter TSR to the TSSF, including the Request-Type AVP set to the value "0".

q_30537.question: What abbreviations are used in the 3GPP Technical Report on band combinations for concurrent operation of NR/LTE Uu bands/band combinations and one NR/LTE V2X band in Release 18?
q_30537.ground_truth: The abbreviations used in the report include CA (Carrier Aggregation), CC (Component Carrier), DC (Dual Connectivity), ITS (Intelligent Transportation System), MSD (Maximum Sensitivity Degradation), and REFSENS (Reference Sensitivity).

q_30538.question: What does NWDAF analyze in step 9?
q_30538.ground_truth: CSA (Charging Session Analysis) or CSR (Charging Session Record) data

q_30539.question: What information does the MME store for a UE that supports both NB-IoT and WB-E-UTRAN?
q_30539.ground_truth: The MME stores a separate NB-IoT specific UE Radio Capability information when the UE provides the UE Radio Capability information while camping on NB-IoT. When the UE is camping on NB-IoT, the MME sends the NB-IoT specific UE Radio Capability information to the E-UTRAN. When the UE is camping on WB-E-UTRAN, the MME sends the UE radio capabilities including WB-E-UTRAN UE radio capabilities but not NB-IoT radio capabilities.

q_30540.question: What information does the RAN build for transmission opportunities in the procedure for this solution?
q_30540.ground_truth: The RAN builds transmission opportunities information, which may include a start of frame reference time, a list of offsets for DL opportunities, a list of offsets for UL opportunities, and a periodicity.

q_30541.question: What should an MTSI client in terminal use for identifying different media components of the same media type within a single MTSI session?
q_30541.ground_truth: The SDP content attributes as defined in RFC 81 should be used for identifying different media components of the same media type within a single MTSI session.

q_30542.question: What is the definition of "SCADA" in the present document?
q_30542.ground_truth: SCADA stands for Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition, and it refers to the management system of power grids.

q_30543.question: What is the time period during which the relaxed monitoring criteria for neighbour cells is fulfilled before starting time T1 in the test procedure?

q_30544.question: Under what condition should a UE transmit RRC Connection Request-NB message when it receives paging and access to the cell is barred for mo-data due to UE belonging to ab-Category 'b' and having an Access Class with a value in the range 11..15?
q_30544.ground_truth: The UE should transmit RRC Connection Request-NB message.

q_30545.question: What should the transmission participant do upon receiving a granted response for a Receive media request message?
q_30545.ground_truth: The transmission participant should send a Transmission control Ack message (if acknowledgment is required), provide receive media success notification to the user, set the B-bit to '1' if the Receive Media Indicator field is included and the B-bit is set to '1', stop timer T103 (Receive Media Request), and enter the 'U: has permission to receive' state.

q_30546.question: What should the MCVideo function do if it cannot find a binding between the public user identity and an MCVideo ID?
q_30546.ground_truth: The MCVideo function shall reject the SIP REFER request with a SIP 404 (Not Found) response with the warning text set to "141 user unknown to the participating function".

q_30547.question: What is the function of the PCF in the policy provisioning architecture?
q_30547.ground_truth: The PCF is responsible for providing policies to the mobile base station relay when it is owned by the mobile network operator.

q_30548.question: What should the SL Server UE perform if step 4 was performed and the ranging/positioning result determination is performed by the SL Server UE?
q_30548.ground_truth: The SL Server UE may send a SLPP Request Location Information message to UE1 or request location information for UEs 2 to n using the Supplementary RSPP Location Information Transfer Procedure.

q_30549.question: What are the typical parameters for rasterized video signal format?
q_30549.ground_truth: The typical parameters for rasterized video signal format include 1.5K x 1.5K per eye at 60, 90, 120fps, 2K x 2K at 60, 90, 120fps, and YUV 4:2:0 or 4:4:4.

q_30550.question: What is the relevance of the NRF in the 3GPP northbound and application layer APIs?
q_30550.ground_truth: The provisions and mechanisms using the NRF are not applicable in the 3GPP northbound and application layer APIs.

q_30551.question: What should the P-CSCF do if it receives a reINVITE request from the UE within the same dialog?
q_30551.ground_truth: The P-CSCF shall include the updated access-network-charging-info parameter from P-Charging-Vector header field when sending the SIP request to the S-CSCF.

q_30552.question: Which two protocolIEs in the PWSRestartIndicationIEs are marked as CRITICALITY reject and PRESENCE mandatory?
q_30552.ground_truth: The two protocolIEs in the PWSRestartIndicationIEs that are marked as CRITICALITY reject and PRESENCE mandatory are id-CellIDListForRestart and id-TAIListForRestart.

q_30553.question: What is the role of the "HPLMN" element and what does it contain?
q_30553.ground_truth: The "HPLMN" element specifies the PLMN (Public Land Mobile Network) for a network, and it contains a "service" element that indicates the type of service provided by the network, as well as a "VPLMN" element specifying the list of Visited PLMNs and anyExt element of optional extension data.

q_30554.question: What is the purpose of the "Data Collection AF" in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_30554.ground_truth: The Data Collection AF is a functional entity that collects data and reports it to the Data Collection AF, either directly or indirectly. It is responsible for managing the provisioning state for data collection and reporting.

q_30555.question: What is the name of the NF service specified for MFAF?

q_30556.question: What should be done if there is an outstanding MCVideo emergency alert for this MCVideo user and the `<alert-ind>` element of the received SIP re-INVITE request is included and set to "false" in step 5c)?
q_30556.ground_truth: Include in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body an `<alert-ind>` element set to a value of "true".

q_30557.question: What is the key difference between the energy consumption of a PNF and a VNF in the context of 5G network functions?
q_30557.ground_truth: The energy consumption of a PNF (Physical Network Function) is measured, while the energy consumption of a VNF (Virtualized Network Function) is estimated and cannot be measured directly.

q_30558.question: What are the architecture options for interworking between 5GS and EPS?
q_30558.ground_truth: The non-roaming architecture, roaming architecture with local breakout, and roaming architecture with home-routed traffic, are the architecture options for interworking between 5GS and EPS.

q_30559.question: What shall a participating MCPTT function include in the P-Asserted-Identity header field when sending an outgoing SIP MESSAGE request for a remotely initiated private call?
q_30559.ground_truth: The public service identity of the participating MCPTT function.

q_30560.question: What is the definition of "beam" and "beam centre direction" as provided in the document?
q_30560.ground_truth: A "beam" is the main lobe of a radiation pattern from an AAS BS, and the "beam centre direction" is the direction equal to the geometric center of the -3 dB EIRP contour of the beam.

q_30561.question: What event triggers the MA PDU Session Release procedure over non-3GPP access in the 5GS to EPS mobility scenario without using N26 interface?
q_30561.ground_truth: The PGW-C+SMF triggers the MA PDU Session Release procedure over non-3GPP access in the 5GS to EPS mobility scenario without using N26 interface.

q_30562.question: When is a UE not required to monitor EPDCCH in an MBSFN subframe with a zero-size non-MBSFN region?
q_30562.ground_truth: A UE is not required to monitor EPDCCH in an MBSFN subframe with a zero-size non-MBSFN region.

q_30563.question: What is the effect of the voice mode preferences for the ATD command?
q_30563.ground_truth: The voice mode preferences affect the behavior of the ATD command for making voice calls, in particular, the ATD command gives preference for CS based voice call or VoIP based voice call based on the value of the 'Call Mode'

q_30564.question: What is the purpose of obtaining a secondary NSSAI during the registration procedure in solution #43?
q_30564.ground_truth: The purpose of obtaining a secondary NSSAI during the registration procedure in solution #43 is to support network slice service continuity.

q_30565.question: What information can H-NWDAF provide to V-NWDAF for network slice selection in Solution#11?
q_30565.ground_truth: H-NWDAF can provide the slice Load level information to V-NWDAF for network slice selection in Solution#11.

q_30566.question: What should the UE do with the current EPS security context when it switches off and sends the DETACH REQUEST message?
q_30566.ground_truth: The UE should store the current EPS security context as specified in annex C and mark it as valid.

q_30567.question: What should an NF API data-type placement mapping contain?
q_30567.ground_truth: An NF API data-type placement mapping should contain the identification of the NF API and the mapping of data-types to the location of the IEs (after the SEPP has rewritten the message for transmission over N32-f).

q_30568.question: What message does the source SGSN send to the target MME to request resource allocation during the Inter-RAT handover to the E-UTRAN?
q_30568.ground_truth: The source SGSN sends the message Forward Relocation Request to the target MME, including all PDN Connections and their associated information.

q_30569.question: What is the role of the Scene Manager in the media rendering loop?
q_30569.ground_truth: The Scene Manager in the media rendering loop is responsible for triggering the fetching of media for new objects in the scene, creating a dedicated media pipeline for each object, and establishing a transport session for each component of the media object. It also gets processed media data from the media pipeline buffers, reconstructs and renders the objects, and passes the rendered frame to the AR/MR Runtime for display.

q_30570.question: What action should the S-CSCF take when it expects a UE to reregister a public user identity and its associated set of implicitly registered public user identities?
q_30570.ground_truth: The S-CSCF shall release sessions that currently include the user's contact address, where the session was initiated by or terminated towards the user with the contact address registered to one of the public user identities using the contact address that is being deregistered, which includes the implicitly registered public user identities.

q_30571.question: What is the modulation order used in the physical downlink shared channel if the DCI CRC is scrambled by P-RNTI, RA-RNTI, or SI-RNTI?
q_30571.ground_truth: The UE shall use = 2 if the DCI CRC is scrambled by P-RNTI, RA-RNTI, or SI-RNTI.

q_30572.question: What element must be included in the "response-reject" if a request is not accepted by the ProSe Function?

q_30573.question: How is the measurement in 5.1.1.1.6 obtained?
q_30573.ground_truth: The measurement is obtained by the gNB performing the GTP PDU packet delay measurement for QoS monitoring and recording the time stamps in the GTP-U header of each GTP PDU monitoring response packet. The gNB then increments the corresponding bin with the delay range where the DRdl falls into by 1 for the counters.

q_30574.question: What action does the S-CSCF perform after receiving the SDP answer from the terminating network containing a MIKEY-TICKET response?
q_30574.ground_truth: The S-CSCF forwards the SDP answer to the P-CSCF.

q_30575.question: What may lead to the establishment of dedicated bearers for the UE if dynamic PCC is not deployed?
q_30575.ground_truth: If dynamic PCC is not deployed and the Handover Indication is present or the PDN GW decides to apply local QoS policy, dedicated bearers may be established for the UE.

q_30576.question: What should the UE do if a cell change into a new tracking area occurs before the tracking area updating procedure is completed?
q_30576.ground_truth: The UE should abort the tracking area updating procedure and re-initiate it immediately, setting the EPS update status to EU2 NOT UPDATED.

q_30577.question: What is the responsibility of the Steering of Roaming Application Function (SOR-AF) in relation to the SP-AF?
q_30577.ground_truth: The SOR-AF makes use of the SP-AF services when it needs to protect UE parameters that require updating and are not available in secured packet format.

q_30578.question: What is the role of the PCF in making policy control decisions based on awareness of URSP rule enforcement for an application?
q_30578.ground_truth: The PCF, based on operator policy, can make policy control decisions based on awareness of URSP rule enforcement for an application. It does this using mechanisms such as Policy control decisions based on awareness of URSP rule enforcement with UE assistance or without UE assistance.

q_30579.question: What back-off timer value may the network include in a session management reject message to regulate the time interval at which the MS may retry the same procedure?
q_30579.ground_truth: The network may include a back-off timer value in a session management reject message to regulate the time interval at which the MS may retry the same procedure. The MS is blocked from sending another SM request for the same procedure for the same PLMN and APN combination for the specified duration.

q_30580.question: How many component carrier combinations will be tested for ATCR2b generation if the smallest or largest sum of channel bandwidth of component carriers is supported by the base station?
q_30580.ground_truth: Only one combination having the largest sum and one combination having the smallest sum will be tested, irrespective of the number of component carriers.

q_30581.question: What is the role of the CBC in handling PWS operation failures in the NG-RAN?
q_30581.ground_truth: The CBC is responsible for re-sending the warning message data to the NG-RAN for the affected cell(s) upon receipt of a PWS Restart Indication message.

q_30582.question: What should the MCPTT client include in the SIP MESSAGE request when sending a request to remove a regroup?
q_30582.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-regroup+xml MIME body with the <mcptt-regroup-uri> element set to the unique temporary group identity URI representing the regroup to be removed, and the <regroup-action> element set to "remove".

q_30583.question: In 5.4.3.3.2.2, what is used as a target identifier for all LI functions except parameter provisioning?
q_30583.ground_truth: GPSI and SUPI are used as target identifiers for all LI functions except parameter provisioning in 5.4.3.3.2.2.

q_30584.question: What does a UE do when it detects a DCI format indicating to receive CSI-RS or PDSCH in a subset of symbols from a set of symbols of a slot?
q_30584.ground_truth: The UE cancels the transmission of PUCCH, PUSCH, PRACH, or SRS in the subset of symbols, depending on its partialCancellation capability.

q_30585.question: What is the main subject of discussion in the Technical Report regarding AR glasses?
q_30585.ground_truth: Architectures and processing of AR glasses, especially the partitioning of workloads to remote devices or the cloud to balance the power load, are the main subjects of discussion in the Technical Report.

q_30586.question: What should be the value of bits 3 to 5 of Octet g+3 if the SMeNB flag is set?
q_30586.ground_truth: Bits 3 to 5 of Octet g+3 should be set to 0 by the sender if the SMeNB flag is set.

q_30587.question: Which message is sent by the eNB to the en-gNB to initiate the requested measurement for EN-DC RESOURCE STATUS REQUEST?

q_30588.question: What is the procedure if the 5G ProSe Remote UE receives Direct Security Mode Command message indicating NULL integrity and NULL encryption algorithms, but has not sent an Emergency RSC in step 2?
q_30588.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe Remote UE shall not accept NULL ciphering and NULL integrity algorithms if the 5G ProSe Remote UE has not sent an Emergency RSC in step 2.

q_30589.question: What should the MCData client do upon receiving an SDS SIGNALLING PAYLOAD message with a new Conversation ID?
q_30589.ground_truth: If the SDS SIGNALLING PAYLOAD message contains a new Conversation ID, the MCData client should instantiate a new conversation with the Message ID in the SDS SIGNALLING PAYLOAD identifying the first message in the conversation thread.

q_30590.question: What should the UE do if it receives a PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message with the 5GSM cause value #67 and the ABO bit set to "The back-off timer is applied in all PLMNs or all equivalent SNPNs"?
q_30590.ground_truth: The UE should apply the timer T3584 for all the PLMNs or all the equivalent SNPNs.

q_30591.question: What is the architectural reference model for UAS functionality in the 3GPP system?
q_30591.ground_truth: The architectural reference model for UAS functionality in the 3GPP system includes support for general UAV features, such as authentication and authorization of UAV with USS, USS authorization of C2 Communication, UAV tracking, and Direct C2 Communication. It also includes support for Detect and Avoid mechanisms based on PC5 reference point and Broadcast Remote ID using MBS or PC5 reference point.

q_30592.question: What is the purpose of the WiMAX-specific procedures for discovering and selecting the highest priority Network Service Provider (NSP) in WiMAX access network?
q_30592.ground_truth: The WiMAX-specific procedures for discovering and selecting the highest priority Network Service Provider (NSP) in WiMAX access network are used to ensure that the UE can access the network with the best available service provider.

q_30593.question: What does Bit 1 in Octet 5 of the QFI IE indicate when set to "1" in the context of 3GPP TS 23.501?
q_30593.ground_truth: It indicates that per QoS flow access performance measurement is applicable to this PDU session, and a list of QFI values is present to indicate a list of QoS flows over which access performance measurement may be performed.

q_30594.question: What should the new NG-RAN node do when it receives the UE Context Reference at the S-NG-RAN IE in the RETRIEVE UE CONTEXT RESPONSE message?
q_30594.ground_truth: If supported, the new NG-RAN node should use it to establish dual connectivity with the S-NG-RAN node and trigger the Retrieve UE Context Confirm procedure to the old NG-RAN node when the UE successfully resumes on the new NG-RAN node.

q_30595.question: What information is conveyed in the QoS Info (PFI and PC5 QoS parameters) in the Direct Communication Request and Direct Communication Accept messages?
q_30595.ground_truth: QoS Info (PFI and PC5 QoS parameters) in the Direct Communication Request and Direct Communication Accept messages indicate the Quality of Service (QoS) required for UE-to-UE relay traffic.

q_30596.question: What mode does the SS operate in when testing RLC in control plane mode using loopback mode?
q_30596.ground_truth: The SS operates in transparent mode with L2TestMode enabled.

q_30597.question: What factors can the UDR NF consumer use to select a UDR instance in the case of SUPI or IMSI type SUCI?
q_30597.ground_truth: In the case of SUPI or IMSI type SUCI, the UDR NF consumer can select a UDR instance based on the SUPI range the UE's SUPI belongs to or based on the results of a discovery procedure with NRF using the UE's SUPI as input for UDR discovery.

q_30598.question: What is the purpose of Step 1 in the negotiation of details of marking mechanisms for AS (Application Server) to UPF (User Plane Function) communication?
q_30598.ground_truth: To negotiate the marking mechanism between AF (Application Function) and CN (Core Network), allowing for selection of protocol to be used for PDU Set information exchange between AS and 5GS based on application support

q_30599.question: What is the impact on the PCF when making policy decisions for PDU Sessions with local routing requirements?
q_30599.ground_truth: The PCF must take into account any default non-3GPP delay budget or requested non-3GPP delay budget for a specific flow when making policy decisions for PDU Sessions with local routing requirements.

q_30600.question: In what scenario would an operator apply Action 3, with capabilities to enable PDU sessions to be transferred from one network slice to another network slice?
q_30600.ground_truth: An operator would apply Action 3 if they want to transfer a PDU session from one network slice to another, where the target network slice is either already in the Allowed NSSAI or is being added to the Allowed NSSAI as a part of the transfer process.

q_30601.question: What is the role of CAA-Level UAV Identity in the 3GPP system?
q_30601.ground_truth: A UAV is assigned a CAA-level UAV Identity by functions in the aviation domain and it is used for Remote Identification and Tracking and to identify the UAV. The UAV provides the CAA-level UAV Identity to the 3GPP system during UUAA procedures.

q_30602.question: What should the UE do while the PTI value is not released and it receives a DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message with the same PTI value?
q_30602.ground_truth: The UE should regard it as a network retransmission.

q_30603.question: In what situation should the MCData client display an indication of the cancellation of the in-progress emergency state of the group to the user?
q_30603.ground_truth: When the received SIP MESSAGE request contains an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body with the <emergency-ind><value of "false".

q_30604.question: What is an IMS communication service identifier and where is it required to be included?
q_30604.ground_truth: An IMS communication service identifier is a unique identifier for an IMS communication service, used to identify the service in SIP methods. It is required to be included in the UE, S-CSCF, and AS.

q_30605.question: What should the UE do when it is provided with coresetPoolIndex 0 for first CORESETs and coresetPoolIndex 1 for second CORESETs on an active DL BWP of a serving cell, and is provided with ackNackFeedbackMode = joint for the active UL BWP?
q_30605.ground_truth: The UE should index detected DCI formats from PDCCH receptions in the first CORESETs prior to detected DCI formats from PDCCH receptions in the second CORESETs.

q_30606.question: What should the MAC entity do when the dataInactivityTimer expires?
q_30606.ground_truth: The MAC entity should indicate the expiry of the dataInactivityTimer to upper layers.

q_30607.question: What is the minimum relative throughput requirement for any SCS specified for the channel bandwidth of the wanted signal, where the channel bandwidth of the wanted signal is greater than or equal to 3300 MHz and the lower frequency of the uplink is also greater than or equal to 3300 MHz?
q_30607.ground_truth: The minimum relative throughput requirement is 95%.

q_30608.question: What is the minimum number of E-UTRAN TDD cells that a UE must be able to measure the NR-E-UTRAN TDD RSRP, RSRQ, and RS-SINR for, for each E-UTRA TDD frequency layer, during each layer 1 measurement period?
q_30608.ground_truth: The UE must be able to measure at least 4 E-UTRAN TDD cells per E-UTRA TDD frequency layer during each layer 1 measurement period.

q_30609.question: What type of data does the RequestLocationInformation message contain in the Location Information Transfer procedure?
q_30609.ground_truth: The RequestLocationInformation message contains the type of location information needed and potentially the associated QoS.

q_30610.question: What is the essential information that should be provided to the RAN in order to minimize power consumption in the network?
q_30610.ground_truth: The essential information that should be provided to the RAN includes PDU set boundaries (i.e., indication of the first and last PDU of the PDU set), traffic periodicity, jitter statistics, PDU set size, as well as priorities, dependencies, and validity times of the PDU sets. This information should be provided to the RAN at PDU session establishment or modification via GTP-U header and/or CP signalling (NGAP).

q_30611.question: What does the HPLMN need the ability to control based on user consent, operator policy, regulatory policy, and/or roaming agreements?
q_30611.ground_truth: The amount of UE data exposed in the roaming scenario.

q_30612.question: What action should the source eNodeB take if it determines that the target PLMN does not support the UE Radio Capability ID assigned by the source PLMN during an inter-PLMN handover?
q_30612.ground_truth: The source eNodeB should include the UE radio capabilities in the Source to Target transparent container during inter-PLMN handover to ensure the successful handover.

q_30613.question: How many Regular/Periodic Sidelink BSRs can the MAC entity transmit in a single TTI?
q_30613.ground_truth: The MAC entity can transmit at most one Regular/Periodic Sidelink BSR in a TTI.

q_30614.question: What is the rate of correct events observed during repeated tests in 7.3.22.5?
q_30614.ground_truth: The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests in 7.3.22.5 must be at least 90%.

q_30615.question: What should the AMF include in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message if the UE supports extended CAG information list in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message and the AMF needs to update the "CAG information list" stored in the UE?
q_30615.ground_truth: The AMF shall include the CAG information list IE or the Extended CAG information list IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.

q_30616.question: What property in the MSGin5G Registration Response to Constrained UE schema indicates the result of the registration?

q_30617.question: Who can consume the Area monitoring service?
q_30617.ground_truth: The Area monitoring service can be consumed by OAM and an NWDAF containing AnLF to know the sub-area types and re-use appropriate ML models.

q_30618.question: What is the format of the local emergency numbers received via 3GPP access and non-3GPP access?
q_30618.ground_truth: The local emergency numbers received via 3GPP access and non-3GPP access are lists of numbers in the format determined by the network and sent in a REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.

q_30619.question: Which release of the specification introduced the "discoverySignalsInDeactSCell-r12" field?
q_30619.ground_truth: This field was introduced in release 12 of the specification.

q_30620.question: What is the requirement for the IAB-MT channel bandwidth and declared minimum EIS level when the IAB-MT is capable of redirecting the receiver target, as specified in clause 10.2.2.1.1?
q_30620.ground_truth: If the IAB-MT is capable of redirecting the receiver target, the OSDD must include the IAB-MT channel bandwidth and declared minimum EIS level applicable to any active sensitivity RoAoA inside the receiver target redirection range, and a declared receiver target redirection range describing all the angles of arrival that can be addressed for the OSDD.

q_30621.question: What may happen if the MnS producer updates the intent handling capabilities for one or more intent handling functions?
q_30621.ground_truth: The MnS producer may inform these updates to the MnS consumer.

q_30622.question: What should the UE do if 5GMM cause #75 is received from a cell not belonging to an SNPN or a cell belonging to an SNPN with a non-globally-unique SNPN identity?
q_30622.ground_truth: The UE shall handle this case as an abnormal case and the behavior is specified in subclause 5.5.1.2.7 of 3GPP TS 23.013.

q_30623.question: What should the UE do if it has radio link failure and the re-establishment procedure was initiated due to handover failure as specified in 5.3.5.6 (intra-LTE handover failure) or 5.4.3.5 (inter-RAT mobility from EUTRA failure)?
q_30623.ground_truth: The UE should set the reestablishmentCause to handoverFailure.

q_30624.question: What is the rated carrier output power of the base station for Band 85 NB-IoT standalone operation?
q_30624.ground_truth: For Band 85 NB-IoT standalone operation, the BS rated output power limit of 43 dBm applies over the NB-IoT carriers in the range 728-729 MHz of the DL operating band.

q_30625.question: What information is included in the L2TP Tunnel Information?
q_30625.ground_truth: The L2TP Tunnel Information includes the LNS IPv4 address or IPv6 address, and the Tunnel Password.

q_30626.question: What is the purpose of the TWAN related Access Network Information in case of a TWAN access?
q_30626.ground_truth: The TWAN related Access Network Information such as TWAN Identifier, UE Time Zone, etc. are reported over S2a, Gx, Gy, etc. at PDN connection establishment, at bearer creation / modification / release and at PDN connection release. This information is used for determining the NPLI (Network Provided location Information) of an UE in case of a TWAN access.

q_30627.question: When should the UE perform sensing on the pools of resources for transmission of the sidelink control information and data?
q_30627.ground_truth: The UE should perform sensing on all pools of resources for transmission of the sidelink control information and data if it is capable of non-P2X related V2X sidelink communication, and is expected to transmit V2X sidelink communication.

q_30628.question: What is one possible option to avoid interacting with the UE/User for UE/User LCS notification in the presence of an MBSR?
q_30628.ground_truth: One possible option is the MBSR-centric option, where the MBSR is set to not indicate its LCS notification capability to the AMF during the registration procedure.

q_30629.question: What should be done if for some frequency an individual sub-block spurious emission requirement overlaps with another sub-block bandwidth or general spectrum emission mask?
q_30629.ground_truth: If an individual sub-block spurious emission requirement overlaps with another sub-block bandwidth or general spectrum emission mask, then it does not apply.

q_30630.question: In which direction are the IP-specific components added to the packet filter when deriving a QoS rule in the UE?
q_30630.ground_truth: The IP-specific components are added to the packet filter for UL (upload) direction when deriving a QoS rule in the UE.

q_30631.question: In which clause are simple data types and enumerations defined in the context of the data model?
q_30631.ground_truth: Clause 7.1.3.4.3 defines simple data types and enumerations in the context of the data model.

q_30632.question: Which service operations are used by the TSCTSF for interfacing with the PCF?
q_30632.ground_truth: The TSCTSF uses the Npcf_AMPolicyAuthorization create, update and delete service operations for interfacing with the PCF.

q_30633.question: What should the UE do if it receives a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message and the TAI is forbidden for regional provision of service?
q_30633.ground_truth: The UE shall store the current TAI in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service" and if the message is not integrity protected, memorize the TAI for non-integrity protected NAS reject message.

q_30634.question: What is the role of the resource allocation information in DCI format N1 for NPDSCH?
q_30634.ground_truth: The resource allocation information in DCI format N1 for NPDSCH indicates to a scheduled UE a number of subframes and a repetition number determined by the resource assignment field in the corresponding DCI in NB-IoT.

q_30635.question: Who is responsible for selecting the Assistant UE in Solution #16 and Solution #17?
q_30635.ground_truth: In Solution #16, UE1 or UE2 selects the Assistant UE. In Solution #17, UE1 selects the Assistant UE.

q_30636.question: What is one of the conditions for the SMF to provide the Small Data Rate Control parameters to the UPF?
q_30636.ground_truth: The SMF provides the Small Data Rate Control parameters to the UPF if the SMF initiates an N4 Session Establishment procedure with the selected UPF(s).

q_30637.question: When would the network page the UE to provide localized service information?
q_30637.ground_truth: The network would page the UE when the requested localized service becomes available and the UE is in IDLE Mode.

q_30638.question: What should the UE do when the contention resolution timer expires?
q_30638.ground_truth: The UE shall re-select a preamble and transmit with the calculated PRACH transmission power when the back off time expires if the contention resolution timer expires.

q_30639.question: What is the procedure when the NWDAF supports UE Communication Analytics in the context of 5G network?
q_30639.ground_truth: The NWDAF supporting UE Communication Analytics collects per-application communication description from AFs. If a consumer NF provides an Application ID, the NWDAF only considers the data from AF, SMF, and UPF that corresponds to this application ID. The NWDAF may also collect data from AMF. The NWDAF provides the analytics results to the NFs or an AF in the 5GC. The analytic results include the UE communication statistics or prediction. Depending on the list size limitation, the least probable communications on a given Analytics target period may not be provided.

q_30640.question: What is the difference between GNSS-based and channel-based alignment methods in protection relays?
q_30640.ground_truth: GNSS-based alignment is not affected by communication channel asymmetry, while channel-based alignment is critically dependent on the symmetry of communication channels.

q_30641.question: What is the mean and 5% DL Average-UPT loss provided by the semi-static SBFD at a low load level with 40dBm BS transmission power assumed by 1 source?
q_30641.ground_truth: The mean and 5% DL Average-UPT loss provided by the semi-static SBFD at a low load level with 40dBm BS transmission power assumed by 1 source is -0.81% and -11.82%, respectively.

q_30642.question: What is the maximum value that the networkColourCode and baseStationColourCode in the PhysCellIdGERAN information element can be?
q_30642.ground_truth: Both the networkColourCode and baseStationColourCode in the PhysCellIdGERAN information element are bit strings of size 3.

q_30643.question: What should be the payload type value for ROI feedback messages in the RTCP protocol?
q_30643.ground_truth: The payload type value for ROI feedback messages in the RTCP protocol is PSFB (206).

q_30644.question: What must the MCVideo client include in the SIP re-INVITE request when canceling the in-progress imminent peril group state?
q_30644.ground_truth: The MCVideo client must include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body populated as specified in clause~6.2.8.1.11, a Resource-Priority header field, and an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body with the <mcvideoinfo> element containing the <mcvideo-Params> element.

q_30645.question: What are the conditions under which a UE with NR-DC-PC-mode set to "Dynamic" shall apply the requirements for the default power class for the supported power class, as specified in clause 6.2C?
q_30645.ground_truth: A UE with NR-DC-PC-mode set to "Dynamic" shall apply the requirements for the default power class to the supported power class if the average percentage of uplink symbols transmitted in a certain evaluation period is larger than the maximum percentage of uplink symbols that the UE indicates by maxUplinkDutyCycle-SULcombination-PC2, as defined in TS 38.331.

q_30646.question: What is the purpose of the NEF Northbound interface as defined in the document?
q_30646.ground_truth: The NEF Northbound interface is an API defined between the Network Exposure Function (NEF) and the Application Function (AF) in a 5G system. It specifies RESTful/RPC APIs that allow the AF to access the services and capabilities provided by 3GPP network entities and securely exposed by the NEF.

q_30647.question: What is the difference between the LTE V2X Services Authorized IE and NR V2X Services Authorized IE?
q_30647.ground_truth: The LTE V2X Services Authorized IE and NR V2X Services Authorized IE are two separate sets of information for V2X services authorization that can be signaled over the NG, S1, Xn, X2, and F1 interfaces.

q_30648.question: What is the measurement reporting delay requirement for the test to pass?
q_30648.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay requirement for the test to pass is less than 167 ms (170 ms allowed).

q_30649.question: What is the role of an Ionospheric Model in GNSS receivers?
q_30649.ground_truth: An Ionospheric Model in GNSS receivers provides parameters to model the propagation delay of GNSS signals through the ionosphere.

q_30650.question: In the architecture for SNPN with Credentials Holder using AAA Server for primary authentication and authorization, what are the roles of UDM and NSSAAF in the primary authentication by a AAA Server in a Credentials Holder?
q_30650.ground_truth: The UDM instructs the AUSF that primary authentication by a AAA Server in a CH is required, then the AUSF discovers and selects the NSSAAF, and finally forwards EAP messages to the NSSAAF, the NSSAAF selects AAA Server based on the domain name corresponds to the realm part of the SUPI, relays EAP messages between AUSF and AAA Server (or AAA proxy) and performs related protocol conversion, and the AAA Server acts as the EAP Server for the purpose of primary authentication.

q_30651.question: What is the default number of transmission layers when using two antenna ports in the precoding information field?
q_30651.ground_truth: The number of transmission layers is equal to 2 if both codewords are enabled when using two antenna ports in the precoding information field.

q_30652.question: What should the UE do if it has not received any cryptographically protected IKEv2 or IPSec message for the duration of the timeout period for liveness check?
q_30652.ground_truth: If the UE has not received any cryptographically protected IKEv2 or IPSec message for the duration of the timeout period for liveness check, the UE should send an INFORMATIONAL request with no payloads and deem the IKEv2 security association to have failed, discarding all states associated with the IKE SA and any child SAs that were negotiated using that IKE SA.

q_30653.question: When can't an MTSI client send adaptation requests?
q_30653.ground_truth: When both CMR in the EVS RTP payload has been disabled and RTCP-APP is not negotiated for the session.

q_30654.question: What information from the network does a UE require to support slice based SoR feature and receive enhanced slice-aware SoR information?
q_30654.ground_truth: The UDM requires the UE's support of enhanced SoR information. UE assistance information can either implicitly or explicitly indicate that the UE supports slice based SoR feature. This information is discussed in CT1 and is transparently forwarded by UDM to SoR-AF during the triggering procedure by UDM.

q_30655.question: What is the definition of the Uplink power control window size for E-UTRA CC in the context of 3GPP TS 36.101?
