q_30655.ground_truth: The Uplink power control window size for E-UTRA CC is defined as 1dB (UE power step size) + 1.0dB (UE power step tolerance) + (Test system relative power measurement uncertainty).

q_30656.question: In which section is the transferability analysis missing for the NR SA FR1 Intra-frequency measurement accuracy with FR1 serving cell and FR1 target cell for 1 Rx UE?

q_30657.question: When does the serving system xIRI carry the information of more than one serving system?
q_30657.ground_truth: The serving system xIRI may carry the information of one or more serving systems based on the target UE's network connectivity.

q_30658.question: What is the condition for the UE to ignore an ATSSS rule if the included steering functionality is not supported by the UE?
q_30658.ground_truth: The UE ignores this ATSSS rule and proceeds with the evaluation of the ATSSS rule with the next smallest precedence, if available.

q_30659.question: What state does the UE enter when it receives a PLMN not allowed message?
q_30659.ground_truth: The UE enters the state EMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH when it receives a PLMN not allowed message.

q_30660.question: In what scenario would the UDSF return the HTTP status code "204 No Content" when the NF service consumer sends a request to retrieve blocks?
q_30660.ground_truth: When there are no blocks associated with the provided recordId.

q_30661.question: What is the role of the "AppSessionContext" data type in 4.2.2.5?
q_30661.ground_truth: The "AppSessionContext" data type in 4.2.2.5 is used by an NF service consumer to indicate sponsored data connectivity when the "SponsoredConnectivity" feature is supported.

q_30662.question: How are the selectors bound to an SA?
q_30662.ground_truth: Selectors, including source IP address, destination IP address, source port, destination port, and transport protocol, are passed to the IPsec layer together with the security parameters related to an SA. The selectors are used to bind the SA to specific parameters of the data flows between UE and P-CSCF.

q_30663.question: When does the general CA spectrum emission mask for CA Bandwidth Class C specified in subclause 6.6.2.1A apply?
q_30663.ground_truth: The general CA spectrum emission mask for CA Bandwidth Class C specified in subclause 6.6.2.1A applies for intra-band contiguous multi-carrier operation in V2X Bandwdith Class C.

q_30664.question: What is the minimum number of unmuted repetitions of a PRS resource instance that must be fully covered by the PPW for it to be considered overlapped with PPW occasion?
q_30664.ground_truth: The minimum number is given in the accuracy requirements in clause 10.1.23, 10.1.24, 10.1.25 and 10.1.38 for RSTD, PRS-RSRP, UE Rx-Tx time difference and PRS-RSRPP, respectively.

q_30665.question: In the Handover Cancel procedure, what action should the source eNB take upon receiving the HANDOVER CANCEL message, if the Candidate Cells To Be Cancelled List IE is included and the handover is not associated to a conditional handover?
q_30665.ground_truth: The target eNB shall ignore the Candidate Cells To Be Cancelled List IE.

q_30666.question: What triggers the establishment of a PDU Session between a PINE and a PEGC?
q_30666.ground_truth: A PDU Session is established when an application layer signalling is exchanged between an application on a PINE and an application function (AF).

q_30667.question: What is the security procedure to establish a secure PC5 link between the End UE and the 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-UE Relay without network assistance?
q_30667.ground_truth: The security procedure in clause 6.2 is used to establish a secure PC5 link between the End UE and the 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-UE Relay without network assistance with the inclusion of the RSC in the DCR message.

q_30668.question: What procedure should the MCVideo client follow when receiving a SIP 183(Session Progress) response to the SIP INVITE request?
q_30668.ground_truth: Upon receiving a SIP 183(Session Progress) response to the SIP INVITE request, the MCVideo client may indicate the progress of the session establishment to the inviting MCVideo user.

q_30669.question: What determines the eDRX acquisition period boundaries for E-UTRA and NB-IoT technologies?
q_30669.ground_truth: For E-UTRA, the eDRX acquisition period boundaries are determined by H-SFN values for which H-SFN mod 256 =0. For NB-IoT, the boundaries of the eDRX acquisition period are determined by H-SFN values for which H-SFN mod 1024 =0.

q_30670.question: What is the purpose of sending continuous "down" commands in uplink scheduling information to the UE?
q_30670.ground_truth: The purpose of sending continuous "down" commands in uplink scheduling information to the UE is to ensure that the UE transmits at its minimum output power.

q_30671.question: What should the gNB-CU do if it receives a F1 SETUP REQUEST message containing the gNB-DU Name IE?
q_30671.ground_truth: The gNB-CU may use this IE as a human readable name of the gNB-DU.

q_30672.question: What does the "DER(n=1)" parameter indicate in the "5.1.1.6.6.11 Mean Time of requested conditional handover executions" measurement?
q_30672.ground_truth: DER(n=1) indicates that the measurement is obtained using a DER (Discrete Exponential Run) algorithm with a sample size of 1.

q_30673.question: What are the two types of resource allocation modes used for Relay discovery message transmission for U2N Remote UE?
q_30673.ground_truth: The two types of resource allocation modes used for Relay discovery message transmission for U2N Remote UE are mode 1 and mode 2.

q_30674.question: What is the role of UE in TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message when it supports A/Gb mode or Iu mode and the TIN indicates "P-TMSI"?
q_30674.ground_truth: When the UE supports A/Gb mode or Iu mode and the TIN indicates "P-TMSI", the UE shall map the P-TMSI and RAI into the Old GUTI IE. Additionally, if the UE holds a valid GUTI, the UE shall indicate the GUTI in the Additional GUTI IE.

q_30675.question: What does the SEALDD server do upon receiving a MSGin5G message?
q_30675.ground_truth: Upon receiving a MSGin5G message, the SEALDD server delivers the message to the VAL server or parses the message and provides the content in the payload of the message to the VAL server with SEALDD API.

q_30676.question: What are the new network functions added to the 5GCore in the solution?
q_30676.ground_truth: The new network functions added to the 5GCore in the solution are the PIN control function (PINCTRL) and the interfaces P1 and NPINCTRL.

q_30677.question: In aperiodic CSI report triggering, what is the maximum number of CSI report requests that a UE is expected to receive for transmission in a given slot per cell?
q_30677.ground_truth: A UE is not expected to receive more than one aperiodic CSI report request for transmission in a given slot per cell.

q_30678.question: What is the role of the 5GS DetNet Router in the integration with IETF Deterministic Networking?
q_30678.ground_truth: The 5GS DetNet Router acts as a DetNet transit node, realizing the DetNet forwarding sub-layer, and is composed of the ports on a single UPF network side, the user plane tunnel between the UE and UPF, and the ports on the device side.

q_30679.question: What shall be the content of the Total Volume, Uplink Volume, and Downlink Volume fields if they are present in the UP function?
q_30679.ground_truth: They shall contain the total, uplink or downlink number of octets respectively, encoded as an Unsigned64 binary integer value.

q_30680.question: What happens to the service authorization when the serving PLMN is removed from the list of PLMNs in the service authorization parameters?
q_30680.ground_truth: If the serving PLMN is removed from the list of PLMNs in the service authorization parameters, the service authorization is revoked in the UE.

q_30681.question: What indicators can be included in a Steering Mode for a FAR?
q_30681.ground_truth: A FAR can include a weight for load sharing, a priority for active-standby or priority-based conditions, and a list of URR IDs for separate usage reporting.

q_30682.question: What does the construction "shall" indicate in a 3GPP technical specification document?
q_30682.ground_truth: In a 3GPP technical specification document, the construction "shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

q_30683.question: What does the CP function activate if it wants to enforce a predefined PCC or ADC rule in the UP function?
q_30683.ground_truth: The CP function activates a predefined PCC or ADC rule by determining the service data filters or application IDs, creating the necessary PDRs and QERs, creating the necessary FAR if needed, creating the necessary URR(s) for each monitoring key or charging key, associating the created URR(s) to the newly created PDR(s), and associating the existing FAR or the new FAR to the newly created PDR(s).

q_30684.question: What aspects are included in the analysis for each actual offset and each of the declared offsets?
q_30684.ground_truth: The analysis includes calculating the device orientation, determining the corresponding path losses, and determining the corresponding probe antenna gains for each actual offset and each of the declared offsets.

q_30685.question: What is the condition for the TCI state to be considered known in clause 8.10B.4?
q_30685.ground_truth: The known condition for TCI state defined in clause 8.10.2 is applied.

q_30686.question: What action does the UPF take when incorrect application traffic is detected for the QoS Flow indicated in the PDR?
q_30686.ground_truth: The UPF sends a report to the SMF, and the SMF informs the PCF that the URSP rule is wrongly enforced by the UE.

q_30687.question: In what scenario will the S-CSCF send an authentication request to the HSS indicating that the authentication scheme is unknown?
q_30687.ground_truth: This will occur if the REGISTER request contains an Authorization header field without an "integrity-protected" header field parameter.

q_30688.question: In which step is the status of the L2TP Session setup sent by the UPF to the SMF in a N4 Session Establishment Response?

q_30689.question: What is the probability of false detection of the ACK defined in clause 8.3.1.1?
q_30689.ground_truth: The probability of false detection of the ACK is defined as a conditional probability of erroneous detection of the ACK when input is only noise.

q_30690.question: What is the duration of the time periods for the test in 7.3.49?
q_30690.ground_truth: The test consists of five successive time periods, with time duration of T1, T2, T3, T4 and T5.

q_30691.question: What should be the value of BarringFactorForMMTEL-Video and BarringTimeForMMTEL-Video if the UE has an Access Class with a value in the range 11..15 and the corresponding bit in the ac-BarringForSpecialAC is set to zero?
q_30691.ground_truth: BarringFactorForMMTEL-Video should be set to one and BarringTimeForMMTEL-Video should be set to zero.

q_30692.question: What are the actions taken by the MC service server upon deciding that a certain MBS session is no longer needed for any group communication purposes?
q_30692.ground_truth: The MC service server can release the session by triggering an MBS session release procedure and de-announce it so that the MC service client can stop monitoring or perform a UE session leave.

q_30693.question: When can the UE instruct the lower layers to start monitoring?
q_30693.ground_truth: The UE may start monitoring if the UE is currently authorized to perform E-UTRA-based or WLAN-based open ProSe direct discovery monitoring, has obtained at least one Discovery Filter and its TTL timer has not expired, and has a request from upper layers to monitor for the ProSe Application ID associated with an authorized Application Identity.

q_30694.question: What is the role of NRF in the discovery of NWDAF containing MTLF by NWDAF containing AnLF?
q_30694.ground_truth: NRF is responsible for returning one or more candidate instances of NWDAF containing MTLF that are compatible with the ML model file serialization format supported by the NWDAF containing AnLF.

q_30695.question: What should the MCData client do if it receives a SIP 2xx response to a request for an MCData emergency private communication and the MCData emergency private communication is in the "MDEPC~2:~emergency-pc-requested" or "MDEPC~3:~emergency-pc-granted" state?
q_30695.ground_truth: The MCData client should set the MCData emergency private priority state of the communication to "MDEPP 2: in-progress", set the MCData emergency private communication state to "MDEPC 3: emergency-pc-granted", and if the MCData private emergency alert state is set to "MDPEA 2: emergency-alert-confirm-pending" and the SIP 2xx response to the SIP request for a priority private communication does not contain a Warning header field as specified in clause~4.9 with the warning text containing the mcdata-warn-code set to "149", set the MCData private emergency alert state to "MDPEA 3: emergency-alert-initiated".

q_30696.question: Which HTTP method is used to request the creation of a USS Change Policy at the UAE Server?
q_30696.ground_truth: The HTTP POST method is used to request the creation of a USS Change Policy at the UAE Server.

q_30697.question: What should the SCC AS populate the SDP offer with when sending the SIP UPDATE request towards the remote UE in the remote leg of the determined dialog being transferred?
q_30697.ground_truth: The SCC AS should populate the SIP UPDATE request with the SDP offer which includes the media characteristics as received in the original SIP INVITE request due to ATU-STI for CS to PS SRVCC.

q_30698.question: What is the difference between SLPP information elements and SLPP PDU Common Contents?
q_30698.ground_truth: SLPP information elements are specific information elements used in the SLPP (SLP Plateform Protocol) for representing specific pieces of information. In contrast, SLPP PDU Common Contents are a set of common contents shared among all SLPP-PDU-Types. The specific common contents depend on the SLPP PDU type in question.

q_30699.question: How is the granularity of the 5GS TSN bridge determined?
q_30699.ground_truth: The granularity of the 5GS TSN bridge is per UPF (User Plane Function) for each network instance or DNN/S-NSSAI (Data Network Name/Single Network Slice Selection Assistance Information).

q_30700.question: What is the potential impact of human error in GNP?
q_30700.ground_truth: It can cause denial of service for the GNP system.

q_30701.question: What is the purpose of the measurement reporting procedure as specified in clause 5.5.5 in TS 36.331?
q_30701.ground_truth: The purpose of this procedure is to transfer measurement results from the UE to E-UTRAN.

q_30702.question: What is the definition of user experienced data rate in the document?
q_30702.ground_truth: The user experienced data rate is the minimum data rate required to achieve a sufficient quality experience, with the exception of scenario for broadcast like services where the given value is the maximum that is needed.

q_30703.question: What should the dynamic value for the CN PSDB be, in comparison to the static value, to ensure CN PSDB functionality in 5G-AN?
q_30703.ground_truth: The dynamic value for the CN PSDB should not be larger than the static value for the CN PSDB to ensure CN PSDB functionality in 5G-AN.

q_30704.question: What is the role of the Storage Policy in the Storage Approach?
q_30704.ground_truth: The Storage Policy specifies operator rules for storing data in the ADRF/NWDAF. It may specify whether Storage Handling Information from a consumer is allowed, default rules that apply in the absence of a consumer request, and allowed values or range for Storage Handing Information.

q_30705.question: What parameter is used to indicate the GPRS delivery outcome in case a combination between delivery outcome for GPRS and non-GPRS are sent to the HLR?

q_30706.question: What needs to be the input for the PCF to determine the "authorized RFSP index" together with a Validity period?
q_30706.ground_truth: The PCF can use network analytics on "Service Experience" for an Application Identifier, "any RAT type" and/or "any Frequency value" to determine the "authorized RFSP index" value for the UE. The "Service Experience" analytics includes a Validity period for the Application service experience analytics.

q_30707.question: Which flag is used to indicate whether the PDU is the last PDU of a specific PDU Set?

q_30708.question: What are the advantages of using event list to describe future coverage information compared to provision of satellite orbital data using SIB?
q_30708.ground_truth: Using event list to describe future coverage information provides several advantages, including no requirement for a UE to perform complex calculations, coverage events managed in real-time based on satellite operator knowledge, and availability for both terrestrial and satellite RATs. Additionally, using NAS instead of user plan provides compatibility to all UE types, intrinsic avoidance of additional signaling for data bearer setup, and synchronization of UE and CN for management of discontinuous coverage.

q_30709.question: What is the required accuracy for all measured TPs as specified in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 9.1.15?
q_30709.ground_truth: The required accuracy for all measured TPs is as specified in the 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 9.1.15.

q_30710.question: What is the role of the PCF in generating the QoS monitoring policy in the 5G system?
q_30710.ground_truth: The PCF generates the QoS monitoring policy based on the request from the AF, either directly or via NEF.

q_30711.question: What information should the primary MCPTT server include in the SIP MESSAGE request when the user is permitted to migrate?
q_30711.ground_truth: The primary MCPTT server should include the mcptt-request-uri, partner-mcptt-id, and migration-auth-result elements in the SIP MESSAGE request.

q_30712.question: What is the total length of the S-NSSAI when it includes both the SST and SD fields?
q_30712.ground_truth: The total length of the S-NSSAI is 32 bits when it includes both the SST and SD fields.

q_30713.question: What does QUIC use to provide confidentiality and integrity protection for packets transmitted in each stream?

q_30714.question: What is the procedure followed in an LTE system when there is a collision between a periodic CSI report and a HARQ-ACK in the same subframe without PUSCH?
q_30714.ground_truth: In an LTE system, if there is a collision between a periodic CSI report and a HARQ-ACK in the same subframe without PUSCH and the parameter simultaneousAckNackAndCQI, provided by higher layers is set TRUE or if the parameter simultaneousAckNackAndCQI-Format3-r11 provided by higher layers is set TRUE or if the parameter simultaneousAckNackAndCQI-Format4-Format5-r13 provided by higher layers is set TRUE, the periodic CSI report is multiplexed with HARQ-ACK or dropped. Otherwise, the CSI is dropped.

q_30715.question: What information should the participating MCPTT function use to determine the served MCPTT ID and the served MCPTT client ID in the case of an MCPTT user implicit affiliation?
q_30715.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT function should use the public user identity in the P-Asserted-Identity header field of the SIP request to determine the served MCPTT ID, and the <mcptt-client-id> element of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body in the received SIP request to determine the served MCPTT client ID.

q_30716.question: What must the PCF use to determine the selected PCF address for an AF using Rx, such as P-CSCF?
q_30716.ground_truth: The BSF determines the selected PCF address based on the information carried by the incoming Rx requests.

q_30717.question: What should the UE include in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message if it supports 5G ProSe direct discovery, direct communication, and acting as a UE-to-network relay UE?
q_30717.ground_truth: The UE should set the 5G ProSe-dd bit to "5G ProSe direct discovery supported", 5G ProSe-dc bit to "5G ProSe direct communication supported", 5G ProSe-l2relay bit to "Acting as a 5G ProSe layer-2 UE-to-network relay UE supported", and 5G ProSe-l3relay bit to "Acting as a 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-network relay UE supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

q_30718.question: What should the P-CSCF do before forwarding the request to the I-CSCF based on the topmost Route header field?
q_30718.ground_truth: The P-CSCF should check for the presence of a 3xx response or 480 (Temporarily Unavailable) response and repeat the actions with a different I-CSCF if none of the retransmissions receive a response.

q_30719.question: When should the UE monitor the link for recovery using the evaluation period and Layer 1 indication interval corresponding to the non-DRX mode?
q_30719.ground_truth: Upon start of T310 timer as specified in section 5.3.11 in 3GPP TS 36.331.

q_30720.question: What is the format of a PathSwitchRequestAcknowledge message in NGAP protocol?
q_30720.ground_truth: A PathSwitchRequestAcknowledge message is a sequence containing protocolIEs.

q_30721.question: What action shall the NEF take upon the deletion of an existing MBS Session?
q_30721.ground_truth: The NEF shall interact with the MB-SMF to request the deletion of the corresponding MBS Session.

q_30722.question: Who determines the positioning access type and method based on the QoS requirement, UE/network positioning capability, and UE connectivity state per access type received from the AMF?
q_30722.ground_truth: The LMF determines the positioning access type and method.

q_30723.question: What is the purpose of the 'U: pending Release' state in the MCPTT context?
q_30723.ground_truth: The 'U: pending Release' state is used when the floor participant is waiting for a response to a Floor Release message. In this state, the floor participant can receive floor control messages and RTP media packets while timer T100 (Floor Release) is running.

q_30724.question: What type of information is contained in the UEAggregateMaximumBitRate-ExtIEs?
q_30724.ground_truth: It contains a sequence of extended protocol information for UE Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate.

q_30725.question: In 4.5.2.3, what should a UE capable of ProSe Direct Discovery and SLSS transmission and reception measure within Tevaluate,SLSS if the conditions for SLSS transmissions are met?
q_30725.ground_truth: The RSRP of the cell used to transmit ProSe Direct Discovery announcements.

q_30726.question: What does the term "NF" stand for in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_30726.ground_truth: "NF" stands for Network Function in the 3GPP Technical Specification.

q_30727.question: How should each beam be set for EIRP accuracy requirements?
q_30727.ground_truth: For EIRP accuracy requirements, each beam should be set to maximum EIRP for the tested beam direction pair.

q_30728.question: What is the maximum number of information bits in format N1 when the number of information bits in format N1 is less than that of format N0 and the format N1 CRC is not scrambled by G-RNTI?
q_30728.ground_truth: Zeros are appended to format N1 until the payload size equals that of format N0 when the number of information bits in format N1 is less than that of format N0 and the format N1 CRC is not scrambled by G-RNTI.

q_30729.question: What is the first step a UE takes before requesting to join a multicast group in a MBS session?
q_30729.ground_truth: The UE registers in the PLMN or SNPN and may have established a PDU session that can be associated with multicast session(s).

q_30730.question: What is the first step in the process of a PINE joining a PIN?
q_30730.ground_truth: The PINE discovers the PIN from the PEMC/PIN server first.

q_30731.question: What should be transmitted by the SS when T2 expires?
q_30731.ground_truth: When T2 expires, the SS shall transmit either an RRCRelease message to release the RRC connection or switch the UE off, followed by transmitting a Paging message including matched ng-5G-S-TMSI for the UE if an RRCRelease has been sent, or switching on the UE if it was switched off.

q_30732.question: What is the maximum number of SRSPosResourceSets that can be aggregated across CH-ID carriers for CH-ID sidelink positioning resource pool is FFS?
q_30732.ground_truth: The value is defined by 3GPP and is not specified in this text.

q_30733.question: What filtering method is applied by the UE before using the measured results for evaluation of reporting criteria or for measurement reporting?
q_30733.ground_truth: The UE applies layer 3 filtering as specified in TS 36.331, clause 5.5.3.2 before using the measured results for evaluation of reporting criteria or for measurement reporting.

q_30734.question: What is the main reason for the preference of using statistical models over traces for RAN simulations?
q_30734.ground_truth: The main reason is that RAN1 needs to simulate multiple cells at the same time, for example 63, for interference considerations.

q_30735.question: What is the difference between "NF" and "AF" in the document?
q_30735.ground_truth: "NF" stands for Network Function, while "AF" stands for Application Function.

q_30736.question: What kind of network can support the ATSSS feature?
q_30736.ground_truth: The ATSSS feature can be supported over a network where an MA PDU session can be established, including NG-RAN, untrusted non-3GPP access network, trusted non-3GPP access network, wireline access network, 3GPP access network connected to EPC, and non-3GPP access network connected to 5GCN.

q_30737.question: What should the UE do if the EMM cause #31 is received and the UE has not indicated support for CIoT optimizations?
q_30737.ground_truth: The UE should reset the service request attempt counter and enter the state EMM-REGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE, and enable N1 mode capability for 3GPP access if it was disabled and disable the E-UTRA capability.

q_30738.question: How can the stored EPS NAS security context be marked as invalid?
q_30738.ground_truth: The stored EPS NAS security context can be marked as invalid by setting the record bytes to 'FF', setting the KSIASME to '07', or setting the length indicated in the ASME key TLV to '00'.

q_30739.question: What is the purpose of the NetworkSliceSubnetProviderCapabilities IOC in network slicing?
q_30739.ground_truth: The NetworkSliceSubnetProviderCapabilities IOC stores the capabilities of the network slice subnet provider in terms of network slice subnets it can manage/provide. The attributes of this IOC can be queried to know the capabilities of the provider.

q_30740.question: What information does the Map Group To Bearer message include?
q_30740.ground_truth: The Map Group To Bearer message includes the TMGI, the identifier of the media stream, and the MCVideo Group identifier field.

q_30741.question: What should be the alignment of the manufacturer declared coordinate system orientation of the base station (BS) with the test system for the test specified in 6.6.3.4.2?
q_30741.ground_truth: The manufacturer declared coordinate system orientation of the BS should be aligned with the test system.

q_30742.question: When should the UE start or restart timer T317 with the duration ul-SyncValidityDuration from the subframe indicated by epochTime?

q_30743.question: What is the function of the energy accurate fee control of the smart meter?
q_30743.ground_truth: The energy accurate fee control function allows for the remote troubleshooting of energy problems for the user, and the regular provision of detailed energy consumption analysis reports to guide users to use electricity scientifically and rationally.

q_30744.question: What does the `Max-Simul-Data-Receptions-Nc4` element represent in the context of MCData UE for on-network or off-network group data transmissions?
q_30744.ground_truth: It indicates the maximum number of simultaneous data receptions allowed for an MCData UE for on-network or off-network group data transmissions.

q_30745.question: What action should the UE take if the 5GSM cause value is different from the specified list but the Back-off timer value IE is not included?
q_30745.ground_truth: If the Back-off timer value IE is not included, then the UE shall ignore the Re-attempt indicator IE provided by the network in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message, if any.

q_30746.question: What is the procedure followed for removing QoS Flows or resources in an existing W-UP?
q_30746.ground_truth: The W-AGF may decide to delete an existing W-UP resource when there is no QoS Flow mapped to this W-UP resource. This is covered in step 4c.

q_30747.question: What information is provided by the E-SMLC in a LPPa Assistance Information Control message?
q_30747.ground_truth: In a LPPa Assistance Information Control message, the E-SMLC sends one or more System Information groups, which include the broadcast periodicity, posSIB types, and relevant metadata, and may also include ciphering keys and validity times for ciphered posSIB types.

q_30748.question: What is the purpose of the Time Zone information element in the 3GPP TS 24.008 protocol?
q_30748.ground_truth: The Time Zone information element in the 3GPP TS 24.008 protocol encodes the offset between universal time and local time in steps of 15 minutes and the universal time at which this information element may have been sent by the network.

q_30749.question: What is required for the MC service clients to determine to join the multicast MBS session with the received MBS session ID?
q_30749.ground_truth: The MC service clients determine to join the multicast MBS session with the received MBS session ID based on the multicast MBS service announcement from the MC service server.

q_30750.question: What should be the CQI reporting periodicity during the NR SA FR2 SSB-based beam failure detection and link recovery in non-DRX test setup?
q_30750.ground_truth: The CQI reporting periodicity should be 5ms during the NR SA FR2 SSB-based beam failure detection and link recovery in non-DRX test setup.

q_30751.question: When might an IWF be deployed as a security gateway in an MC system?
q_30751.ground_truth: An IWF can be deployed as a security gateway between the MCPTT system and the LMR system in cases where encryption of voice media is required in the MC system and the MCPTT user(s) and the LMR user(s) use different codecs.

q_30752.question: What is the role of the NEF in relation to the deletion of AF requirements in the UDR?
q_30752.ground_truth: The NEF deletes the AF requirements in the UDR and responds to the AF.

q_30753.question: What should be the destination address for a Downlink Data Notification Failure Indication message in the event of network triggered service restoration?
q_30753.ground_truth: The destination address for this message should be the SGW IP address signalled via the Sender F-TEID for Control Plane IE in the Downlink Data Notification message, or the source IP address of the Downlink Data Notification message received earlier if the Sender F-TEID is not present in the message.

q_30754.question: When must a UE disable the N1 mode capability for 3GPP access and set the N1mode bit to "N1 mode for 3GPP access not supported" in the UE network capability IE?
q_30754.ground_truth: When the UE supporting both N1 mode and S1 mode needs to stay in an E-UTRA cell connected to EPC in order to prevent unintentional handover or cell reselection from E-UTRA connected to EPC to NG-RAN connected to 5GCN.

q_30755.question: What message is sent by the user interface (UE) to the originating party when it receives a session setup attempt and is waiting for an indication from the user before completing the session?
q_30755.ground_truth: The UE sends a provisional response indicating Ringing to the originating party.

q_30756.question: What action must a UE take upon receiving SystemInformationBlockType31 (SystemInformationBlockType31-NB in NB-IoT)?
q_30756.ground_truth: Upon receiving SystemInformationBlockType31 (SystemInformationBlockType31-NB in NB-IoT), the UE shall start or restart timer T317 with the duration ul-SyncValidityDuration from the subframe indicated by epochTime.

q_30757.question: What should the PCF do if the S-NSSAI is subject to network slice data rate limitation and the Remaining Maximum Slice Data Rate reaches a certain operator defined threshold?
q_30757.ground_truth: The PCF may apply a policy decision to strengthen the traffic restrictions for individual PDU Sessions or PCC rules and interact with the SMF accordingly.

q_30758.question: What is the procedure for disassociating the association of the collection of UEs when a game is over?
q_30758.ground_truth: The procedure is similar to the create procedure, except that it deletes related information and modifies the SM policy for the application within the PDU Session accordingly.

q_30759.question: What is the condition for UE A2 to move from frequency F1 to F2?
q_30759.ground_truth: UE A2 moves from frequency F1 to F2 when it starts searching cells on Frequency F2 after moving to location GC.

q_30760.question: What state would the UE be in, if it initiates the tracking area updating procedure by sending a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message to the MME?
q_30760.ground_truth: The UE would be in the EMM-REGISTERED state while performing the tracking area updating procedure.

q_30761.question: What should a P-CSCF operating in a network that supports calling number attestation and signing do for an emergency session?
q_30761.ground_truth: A P-CSCF operating in a network that supports calling number attestation and signing may insert attestation information related to the asserted calling identity associated with an emergency session, based on operator policy.

q_30762.question: What is the role of the SMF in the Time Sensitive Communications charging?
q_30762.ground_truth: The SMF is responsible for collecting the usage of the TSN stream and reporting the charging data information per UE per PDU session from UPF.

q_30763.question: What actions can trigger the UE to invoke the de-registration procedure with appropriate de-registration type?
q_30763.ground_truth: The UE can trigger the de-registration procedure with appropriate de-registration type if it is switched off, as part of the eCall inactivity procedure, or as part of USIM removal.

q_30764.question: What is the data type defined in clause 8.8.4.2.2 of the CAPIF Auditing API service?
q_30764.ground_truth: Type: InvocationLogs is defined in clause 8.8.4.2.2 of the CAPIF Auditing API service.

q_30765.question: What request parameters are required by the MnS consumer to create a managed object instance?
q_30765.ground_truth: The "managedObjectClass" and "managedObjectInstance" parameters are required in the request.

q_30766.question: What security mechanism is used for secure communication between 5G ProSe End UEs via 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relays?
q_30766.ground_truth: The 5G System shall support confidentiality protection, integrity protection, and replay protection for secure communication between 5G ProSe End UEs via 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relays.

q_30767.question: What information is required to receive data from an MBMS bearer using Android APIs?
q_30767.ground_truth: tmgi (Temporary Multicast Group Identifier of the MBMS Bearer)

q_30768.question: In the context of 3GPP TS 23.501, what is a NF service?
q_30768.ground_truth: A NF service is one type of capability exposed by a NF (NF Service Producer) to other authorized NF (NF Service Consumer) through a service based interface. A NF service may support one or more NF service operation(s).

q_30769.question: What is the role of the MCVideo group ID in the basic call control state machine?
q_30769.ground_truth: The stored MCVideo group ID of the call is one of the pieces of information associated with the basic call control state machine.

q_30770.question: What is the exception to mandatory integrity protected signalling in Iu mode, in regards to emergency calls?
q_30770.ground_truth: The exception is for emergency calls, where integrity protected signalling is not mandatory.

q_30771.question: What should the network do if a low layer failure occurs before the message ATTACH COMPLETE has been received from the MS and a new P-TMSI or a new P-TMSI together with a new P-TMSI signature has been allocated?
q_30771.ground_truth: The network shall consider both the old and new P-TMSI each with its corresponding P-TMSI-signature as valid until the old P-TMSI can be considered as invalid by the network or the GMM context which has been marked as detached in the network is released, and shall not resent the message ATTACH ACCEPT.

q_30772.question: Under what conditions should the "Allowed PDU session status" IE be included in a message?
q_30772.ground_truth: The "Allowed PDU session status" IE must be included in a message if the CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message is sent as a response to paging with the access type indicating non-3GPP access or notification via 3GPP access for PDU session(s) associated with non-3GPP access.

q_30773.question: What action should the MCData client take if sending a delivered and read notification for an SDS message?
q_30773.ground_truth: The MCData client should set the SDS disposition notification type IE as "DELIVERED AND READ" when sending a delivered and read notification for an SDS message.

q_30774.question: What is the purpose of the PCF querying other AMFs within the AMF set?
q_30774.ground_truth: The PCF queries other AMFs within the AMF set to obtain the GUAMI and possibly a service name.

q_30775.question: What is the pre-registration procedure used for when transitioning from E-UTRAN to HRPD?
q_30775.ground_truth: The pre-registration procedure allows a UE to establish a presence with an HRPD system in advance of cell re-selection or handover from the E-UTRAN to HRPD.

q_30776.question: Which message type is used for the PMFP PLR report response?
q_30776.ground_truth: The message type for the PMFP PLR report response is "PMFP PLR REPORT RESPONSE".

q_30777.question: What is the NF service-based interface exhibited by the Policy Control Function (PCF) and what is the UE Policy Control Service (Npcf_UEPolicyControl) part of?
q_30777.ground_truth: The UE Policy Control Service (Npcf_UEPolicyControl) is part of the Npcf service-based interface exhibited by the Policy Control Function (PCF).

q_30778.question: What is the purpose of the Generic Network Product model in the 3GPP network?
q_30778.ground_truth: The Generic Network Product model is a description of the functions that cannot be found in 3GPP specifications but are necessary for the GNP. It serves as a reference for the GNP SCAS and provides a comprehensive view of the network product.

q_30779.question: How many ACK/NACK shall be sent during and after identifying the cell global identifier of cell 2?
q_30779.ground_truth: At least 42 ACK/NACK shall be sent during and after identifying the cell global identifier of cell 2.

q_30780.question: What is the role of the MB-UPF in the group message delivery procedure in the 3GCP 5G System?
q_30780.ground_truth: The MB-UPF (MBMS User Plane Function) in the 3GPP 5G System receives packets from the MBSTF and broadcasts them to the UE.

q_30781.question: What response will an MCVideo server return if an "on-network-invite-members" element is set to "false" and the SIP INVITE request contains a specific MIME body with a session-type value not set to "chat"?
q_30781.ground_truth: The MCVideo server will return a SIP 404 (Not Found) response with the warning text set to "118 the group identity indicated in the request is a chat group".

q_30782.question: What is the function of the LWIP-SeGW in LWIP operation?
q_30782.ground_truth: The LWIP-SeGW supports the subset of WT functionality and additional functionality required to support LWIP, including the establishment, modification, and release of an IPsec tunnel between the UE and the LWIP-SeGW.

q_30783.question: What should the transmission participant do upon receiving a Transmission Granted message with the first bit in the subtype set to '1'?
q_30783.ground_truth: The transmission participant should send a Transmission control Ack message, store the Audio SSRC of the Transmitting User and Video SSRC of the Transmitting User, provide Transmission granted notification to the user, stop timer T102 (Transmission Queue position request), and enter the 'U: has permission to transmit' state.

q_30784.question: What is the minimum performance requirement for the UE co-channel Tx model's granularity?

q_30785.question: Which UE types does the test case 6.3A.4.4.3.2 apply to?
q_30785.ground_truth: This test case applies to all types of NR UE release 16 and forward that supports FR2 4UL CA.

q_30786.question: What is the definition of an "ML entity" as given in the document?
q_30786.ground_truth: An "ML entity" is an entity that is either an ML model or contains an ML model and ML model related metadata, it can be managed as a single composite entity.

q_30787.question: What is the role of S-NSSAI in UE registration procedure?
q_30787.ground_truth: S-NSSAI is used for AMF and SMF selection during UE registration procedure in 5GC.

q_30788.question: What is the difference between radiated requirements and conducted requirements for IAB type 1-H in clause 4.2.1?
q_30788.ground_truth: Radiated requirements are defined for the radiated interface between the device under test and the air, measured in terms of transmission power or reception sensitivity. Conducted requirements, on the other hand, are defined at specific connectors at the transceiver array boundary, which is the conducted interface between the transceiver unit array and the composite antenna.

q_30789.question: What action should the controlling MCData function take if it receives a SIP INVITE request and the Accept-Contact header field does not include the g.3gpp.mcdata.sds media feature tag or the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag containing the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcdata.sds"?
q_30789.ground_truth: The controlling MCData function should reject the SIP request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response.

q_30790.question: What should the transmission control server do when an MCVideo client leaves an ongoing MCVideo call?
q_30790.ground_truth: The transmission control server follows a two-step procedure, first stopping the sending of transmission control messages and RTP media packets to the MCVideo client, and then releasing the corresponding instance of the transmission control server state machine when the MCVideo call is confirmed to have been released.

q_30791.question: What information does the NPN-SP consider when deriving requirements for connectivity to external PLMN resources?
q_30791.ground_truth: The NPN-SP considers the SLS of the requested NPN and the connectivity information of the created 3GPP 5G network when deriving requirements for connectivity to external PLMN resources.

q_30792.question: Which network elements support the use of third party ID and token to access the IMS network?
q_30792.ground_truth: I/S-CSCF, P-CSCF, IBCF, and MMTel AS support the use of third party ID and token to access the IMS network.

q_30793.question: What is the role of the SMF in charging for PDU sessions and service data flows within PDU sessions?
q_30793.ground_truth: The SMF is responsible for performing converged charging for charging data related to PDU sessions and service data flows within PDU sessions.

q_30794.question: What is the recommend power level offset when performing the EIS procedure for each component carrier other than the one being tested?
q_30794.ground_truth: The power level of each component carrier other than the one being tested should be increased by a fixed offset of 5 dB compared to the current power level of the component carrier under test.

q_30795.question: What action does the UE take after it sends a Detach Accept message and receives a Detach Acknowledge message from the SGSN?
q_30795.ground_truth: If the Detach Type did not request the UE to make a new attach, then the 3G SGSN releases the PS signalling connection.

q_30796.question: What should the NF service consumer include in the "ascReqData" attribute in the HTTP PATCH request message, if it wants to delete the TSCAI input information and TSC QoS related information of removed TSC traffic?
q_30796.ground_truth: The NF service consumer should remove the corresponding media component entries within the "medComponents" attribute included in the "ascReqData" attribute.

q_30797.question: In what state does the floor control interface send a Floor Taken message to the associated floor participant when in the 'general floor control operation' state machine and the state is 'G: Taken'?
q_30797.ground_truth: The floor control interface shall send a Floor Taken message to the associated floor participant, including the granted MCPTT user's MCPTT ID in the Granted Party's Identity field and the generated audio SSRC to be used by the granted MCPTT participant into the Audio SSRC of Granted Participant field.

q_30798.question: What is the recommended architecture for network slice ordering, provisioning and assurance in clause 8.1.2?
q_30798.ground_truth: It is recommended that the architecture depicted in clause 8.1.1 is included in the normative phase as the reference architecture for network slice ordering, provisioning and assurance.

q_30799.question: What is required for the integrity of the fingerprints sent over the Iq interface?
q_30799.ground_truth: The Iq interface is protected by NDS/IP, and if cryptographic protection is applied, integrity protection must be used.

q_30800.question: When should the UE use the stored small data rate control parameters value as the maximum allowed limit of uplink user data?
q_30800.ground_truth: The UE should use the stored small data rate control parameters value as the maximum allowed limit of uplink user data for the corresponding PDU session that becomes transferred after inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode.

q_30801.question: What test case scenarios does Combination 31 apply to?
q_30801.ground_truth: Combination 31 applies to the following test case scenarios: 3GPP inter-RAT E-UTRA FDD + NR FDD multi cell scenario, 3GPP inter-RAT E-UTRA FDD + NR TDD multi cell scenario, 3GPP inter-RAT E-UTRA TDD + NR FDD multi cell scenario, 3GPP inter-RAT E-UTRA TDD + NR TDD multi cell scenario.

q_30802.question: What is the procedure when the Serving GW is to be relocated due to PLMN change?
q_30802.ground_truth: The target SGSN selects a target Serving GW as defined in clause 4.3.8.2 and sends a Create Session Request message with the indicated information to the target Serving GW. The target SGSN establishes the EPS Bearer context(s) in the indicated order and deactivates the EPS Bearer contexts which cannot be established.

q_30803.question: What message does the USS send in step 5 of the UUAA procedure?
q_30803.ground_truth: The USS sends an Authentication Response message in step 5 of the UUAA procedure, which includes the GPSI, the UUAA result (success/failure), the authorized CAA-level UAV ID, and a UUAA Authorization Payload that contains UAS security information if the USS has such information to send.

q_30804.question: What is the minimum number of Rx antenna ports required for Local Area NCR-MT in all operating bands, except for certain specific bands?
q_30804.ground_truth: A minimum of two Rx antenna ports.

q_30805.question: When the UE is located in the home country and the Non-3GPP Access Node Selection Information for the HPLMN is not available, what should the UE attempt first when selecting an N3IWF?
q_30805.ground_truth: The UE should attempt to select an N3IWF following the procedure defined in clause~6.3.6.2.

q_30806.question: What must the UE do before sending an initial INVITE request when there are multiple domains for initiating a call/session?
q_30806.ground_truth: The UE must perform access domain selection in accordance with the appropriate specification for the IP-CAN in use.

q_30807.question: What is the purpose of the minimum application context version requirement in the MAP handover application context?
q_30807.ground_truth: The minimum application context version requirement ensures compatibility and proper functioning of the handover and relocation processes in different MSCs.

q_30808.question: What is the only time an NB-IoT UE is not required to monitor NPDCCH candidates of a Type2A-NPDCCH common search space during the scheduling gap or processing gap?
q_30808.ground_truth: During any scheduling gap or processing gap.

q_30809.question: What is the role of the NRF in the authorization process?
q_30809.ground_truth: The NRF (Network Repository Function) verifies the CCA and authorizes the NF Service Consumer based on the information contained in the CCA. It also authorizes the SCP to act on behalf of the NF Service Consumer.

q_30810.question: What is the criteria for determining if the first CSI report for SCell is received in a timely matter?
q_30810.ground_truth: The first CSI report for SCell is received in a timely matter if it is received by the SS no later than slot (m+k) (where k is defined in section 7.5.3.4.4.2) or if the slot was subject to interruption, or if the SS is able to monitor CSI reports for SCell sent from the UE before the end of T2.

q_30811.question: What is the maximum allowed Time Alignment Error (TAE) for V2X UE with two transmit antenna connectors in Transmit Diversity scheme?
q_30811.ground_truth: The Time Alignment Error (TAE) shall not exceed 260 ns.

q_30812.question: How does the UE determine the start of the SI-window for the concerned SI message?
q_30812.ground_truth: The UE determines the start of the SI-window for the concerned SI message based on the order of entry in the schedulingInfoList, schedulingInfoListExt, posSchedulingInfoList, and the si-WindowLength, si-Periodicity, or posSI-Periodicity of the concerned SI message.

q_30813.question: What is the typical size range of a XR Viewer Pose associated to time, delivered over the network with latency requirements in the range of 10-20ms?
q_30813.ground_truth: The typical size of a XR Viewer Pose associated to time, delivered over the network with latency requirements in the range of 10-20ms, is several hundred kbit/s and results in packets of size in the range of 30-100 bytes.

q_30814.question: Which element in the MCData function contains the credentials for secondary authentication and authorization method?

q_30815.question: What does the first digit of the version number in 3GPP Technical Specifications and Reports represent?
q_30815.ground_truth: The first digit of the version number in 3GPP Technical Specifications and Reports represents the status of the document in the TSG approval process.

q_30816.question: Which field in the MM7 Submission CDR (7S-CDR) indicates whether the originator MMS VASP has requested reply-charging?
q_30816.ground_truth: The "Reply Charging" field in the MM7 Submission CDR (7S-CDR) indicates whether the originator MMS VASP has requested reply-charging.

q_30817.question: When is the UE behavior in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode with RRC inactive indication different from 5GMM-CONNECTED mode over 3GPP access?
q_30817.ground_truth: The UE behavior in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode with RRC inactive indication is different from 5GMM-CONNECTED mode over 3GPP access when the UE has to apply mobility restrictions and perform PLMN selection procedures as in 5GMM-IDLE mode over 3GPP access.

q_30818.question: What should the UE send as part of the L1-SINR report in this test?
q_30818.ground_truth: The UE should send the L1-SINR report for both CSI-RS #0 as CMR + CSI-IM #0 as IMR and CSI-RS #1 as CMR + CSI-IM #1 as IMR, at slot 26 from the reception of the DCI trigger.

q_30819.question: What charging data should be collected for an Evolved ProSe Remote UE using an Indirect 3GPP Communication?
q_30819.ground_truth: The charging data for an Evolved ProSe Remote UE using an Indirect 3GPP Communication includes the initiation/termination, duration and amount of data transmitted/received, QoS, inter-operator communication, inter-operator signalling, identification of the RAT involved, and timestamp when the connection mode changes.

q_30820.question: What is the minimum number of occurrences of the "restricted-discovery-filter" element in the "RestrictedMonitorRsp-info" complex type?
q_30820.ground_truth: The "restricted-discovery-filter" element in the "RestrictedMonitorRsp-info" complex type has a minimum occurrence of 0, which means it can occur zero or more times.

q_30821.question: What action should be taken if the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body does not contain exactly one FD SIGNALLING PAYLOAD message or FD HTTP TERMINATION message in the SIP MESSAGE request?
q_30821.ground_truth: The SIP MESSAGE request should be rejected with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response, and a warning text set to "209 one FD SIGNALLING PAYLOAD message or FD HTTP TERMINATION message only must be present in FD request" in a Warning header field.

q_30822.question: What is the purpose of the Allocation Retention Priority (ARP) parameter in the 5G System?
q_30822.ground_truth: The ARP parameter contains information about the priority level, pre-emption capability, and pre-emption vulnerability. It is used to decide whether a bearer/flow establishment or modification request can be accepted or needs to be rejected in case of resource limitations.

q_30823.question: What are the requirements for initiating one-to-one MCData communications in step 1 of clause 11.1 in the MCData user profile document?
q_30823.ground_truth: The requirements for initiating one-to-one MCData communications in step 1 of clause 11.1 in the MCData user profile document include checking if the <allow-transmit-data> element of the <actions> element is not present or present with the value "false". If so, the MCData user is not allowed to send MCData communications.

q_30824.question: What type of data does the <user-max-simultaneous-authorizations> element indicate in the <anyExt> element contained in the <OnNetwork> element?
q_30824.ground_truth: The <user-max-simultaneous-authorizations> element indicates the maximum allowed number of simultaneous service authorizations for the MCVideo user.

q_30825.question: What is the effect of supporting mission critical services for MCPTT over the II-NNI?
q_30825.ground_truth: The "g.3gpp.mcptt" media feature tag in the Contact header field, the Content-Type header field with the value "multipart/mixed", and the "application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml" MIME body shall be supported at the II-NNI. The Warning header field with the warn-code set to "399" and with the warn-text set to a quoted-string shall also be supported.

q_30826.question: What procedure is used by a UP function to send any subsequent PFCP Session Report Request messages for the PFCP sessions which are identified by either FQ-CSID(s) or Group Id(s), and towards which interfaces is it performed?
q_30826.ground_truth: The PFCP Session Set Modification Procedure is used by a UP function to send any subsequent PFCP Session Report Request messages for the PFCP sessions which are identified by either FQ-CSID(s) or Group Id(s), it is performed towards Sxb or N4 interfaces.

q_30827.question: What is the condition for the AMF to perform a network triggered Service Request procedure when the UE is in CM-IDLE and RM-REGISTERED state?
q_30827.ground_truth: The AMF performs a network triggered Service Request procedure when it has signalling or mobile-terminated data to be sent to this UE, by sending a Paging Request to this UE, if a UE is not prevented from responding e.g. due to MICO mode or Mobility Restrictions.

q_30828.question: What is the mandatory payload format parameter for AMR and AMR-WB encoded media that the MTSI MGW should support?
q_30828.ground_truth: The MTSI MGW shall support octet-align, mode-set, mode-change-period, mode-change-capability, mode-change-neighbor, maxptime, ptime, channels and max-red.

q_30829.question: What should the UE include in the ATTACH REQUEST message if it is attaching for emergency bearer services and does not hold a valid GUTI, P-TMSI or IMSI?
q_30829.ground_truth: The UE should include the IMEI in the EPS mobile identity IE.

q_30830.question: What is the channel bandwidth (in MHz) for category NB1 and NB2?

q_30831.question: What information is transferred via the UPF during the authentication procedure between the SMF and the DN-AAA?
q_30831.ground_truth: The UPF transparently relays messages related to the authentication procedure between the SMF and the DN-AAA Server.

q_30832.question: What is the purpose of keeping the announcing in Model B a ProSe Response Code corresponding to the same RPAUID?
q_30832.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure service continuity, and the UE can initiate the discoveree request procedure before the validity timer T4011 expires.

q_30833.question: Which UE releases does the test case in 6.5A.1.6 apply to?
q_30833.ground_truth: The test case applies to all types of NR UE release 15 and forward that supports FR2 7UL CA.

q_30834.question: How does the NG-RAN determine whether to change the AMF serving the UEs associated with a Link ID during MBSR mobility?
q_30834.ground_truth: The NG-RAN decides whether to change the AMF serving the UEs associated with a Link ID by examining the (target) NG-RAN's decision during the MBSR mobility process. The procedure involves the NG-RAN sending an AMF Relocation Request (Link ID) to the new AMF-UE and the new AMF-UE invoking a Bulk UE Context Transfer Request (Link ID) towards the old AMF-UE. The old AMF-UE responds with the context of UEs associated with the Link ID, and the new AMF-UE allocates a new Link ID for the UEs and associates them with it.

q_30835.question: What is the interference condition for ACLR2 in the description of cross-band isolation terminology?
q_30835.ground_truth: ACLR2 indicates that the second adjacent channel of the aggressor UL band falls into the Rx channel of victim band.

q_30836.question: What type of information does 5GS QoS model use in differentiating QoS Flows?
q_30836.ground_truth: 5GS QoS model uses packet filter sets, PDRs, QFI, and scheduling parameters in differentiating QoS Flows.

q_30837.question: What condition must be met for the event "Deactivation" to be counted as a success in the TDD PCell case?
q_30837.ground_truth: The PCell and SCells must be intra-band or inter-band with at most 2 non-consecutive DTX subframes outside the specified ranges.

q_30838.question: What should a participating MCData function do upon receiving a SIP MESSAGE request with an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-mbms-usage-info+xml MIME body, if the P-Asserted-Identity identifies a public user identity not associated with an MCData user served by the participating MCData function?
q_30838.ground_truth: The participating MCData function should send a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response as specified in 3GPP TS 24.229.

q_30839.question: For the UE to detect and measure at least n=16 cells for intra-frequency RSTD within a certain time, what should be provided in addition to the reference cell?
q_30839.ground_truth: The physical layer cell identities of neighbor cells and OTDOA assistance data.

q_30840.question: What should the UE do if it has not decided that the service is no longer needed after releasing the IP-CAN bearer?
q_30840.ground_truth: The UE should perform a new P-CSCF discovery procedure and the procedures for initial registration.

q_30841.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for the test described in section 7.6A.4.2?
q_30841.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements are defined in clause 7.6A.4.0.

q_30842.question: What kind of data type is the NumberOfMeasurementReportingLevels?
q_30842.ground_truth: It is an enumerated type, where n2, n3, n4, n5, n10, and n0 are possible values.

q_30843.question: What should the SMF do when the Network Slice instance is overloaded and there are multiple existing PDU sessions associated with it?
q_30843.ground_truth: The SMF may select parts of existing PDU sessions to be migrated to a new Network Slice instance based on the SSC mode and local policy, to prevent overloading of resources in the new Network Slice instance.

q_30844.question: How does the "Number of failed DAPS handover executions" measurement differ from the "Number of failed DAPS handover preparations" measurement?
q_30844.ground_truth: The "Number of failed DAPS handover executions" measurement tracks failures that occur after resources have been allocated, while the "Number of failed DAPS handover preparations" measurement tracks failures during the preparation of resources for handover.

q_30845.question: Under what conditions is the most stringent requirement applicable for the output power of a Home BS?
q_30845.ground_truth: The most stringent requirement is applicable when both adjacent channels are licensed to other operators, or when one of the adjacent channels is licensed to an E-UTRA operator while the other adjacent channel is licensed to a UTRA operator.

q_30846.question: What is the effect of disabling EPS services on the UE's ability to obtain CS services?
q_30846.ground_truth: If the UE has disabled EPS services, it may select GERAN or UTRAN radio access technology to indicate that E-UTRA is not supported, allowing the UE to continue to obtain CS services.

q_30847.question: Which downlink channels have worse coverage than the bottleneck channel when there is a 3-dB UE antenna efficiency loss in an Urban scenario at 4 GHz with a DL PSD of 24 dBm/MHz and maximum 11-PRB UE bandwidth?
q_30847.ground_truth: PDCCH CSS, SIB1, Msg2, Msg4, and PDCCH USS

q_30848.question: What is the role of the "P-Charging-Function-Addresses" header field parameters "ccf" and "ecf" in addressing offline and online charging functions?
q_30848.ground_truth: The "P-Charging-Function-Addresses" header field parameters "ccf" and "ecf" are used to address the CDF (offline charging function) and OCF (online charging function), respectively.

q_30849.question: What are the 2 methods of power control for DC in the intra-cell power control of NB-IoT?

q_30850.question: What message is sent by the UE upon receiving a DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message and entering the state BEARER CONTEXT INACTIVE?
q_30850.ground_truth: The UE sends a DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT message.

q_30851.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement defined in clause 17.1.1.0.4 for the NR SA FR2-FR2 Cell reselection to FR2 inter-frequency NR for UE fulfilling stationary mobility relaxed measurement criterion for 2 Rx UE?
q_30851.ground_truth: Refer to clause 17.1.1.0.4 for the minimum conformance requirement.

q_30852.question: How many interruptions and interrupted subframes are allowed for UE to identify CGI of an NR cell during MIB and SIB1 decoding time periods?
q_30852.ground_truth: Up to K1 interruptions, each with up to X1 interrupted subframes during MIB decoding time period TMIB, and up to L1 interruptions, each with up to Y1 interrupted subframes, during SIB1 decoding time period TSIB1.

q_30853.question: How many haptic packets, without encoding, are generated and sent within one second by a haptic device with 1 DoF?
q_30853.ground_truth: The haptic device generates and sends 500 haptic packets within one second for 1 DoF.

q_30854.question: How many security feature groups are defined in the 3GPP security architecture for non-3GPP accesses to EPS?
q_30854.ground_truth: Five security feature groups are defined in the 3GPP security architecture for non-3GPP accesses to EPS. Each of these feature groups accomplishes certain security objectives, providing secure access to services, protecting against wireline network attacks, securing application and user domain, and protecting user access to the mobile station.

q_30855.question: What is the service provided by the Policy Control Function (PCF) in the 5G System?
q_30855.ground_truth: The Policy Control Function (PCF) provides the BDT Policy Control Service, which enables negotiation of background data transfer policies for a future data transfer.

q_30856.question: What is the measurement reporting delay excluding a delay caused by no UL resources for UE to send the measurement report?

q_30857.question: How does UE select the TLS authentication methods in Solution #6?
q_30857.ground_truth: In Solution #6, UE selects the TLS authentication methods both supported by EEC and ECS/EES. If there is no authentication method supported by both sides, it returns failure.

q_30858.question: What does the SIM need to know regarding LSA ID?
q_30858.ground_truth: The LSA ID consists of 24 bits, numbered from 0 to 23, with bit 0 indicating whether the LSA is a PLMN significant number or a universal LSA. If the bit is set to 0 the LSA is a PLMN significant number; if it is set to 1 it is a universal LSA.

q_30859.question: What are the main focuses of the general requirements and testing frameworks for AI/ML based performance enhancements in 5G NR?
q_30859.ground_truth: The general requirements and testing frameworks for AI/ML based performance enhancements mainly focus on how to define requirements and tests for inference, evaluate feasibility and necessity of requirements/tests for LCM, and requirements for data collection (in particular for training) could/need be defined.

q_30860.question: What type of communication is used in the case of an untrusted non-3GPP IP access for MAG to 3GPP AAA Server and MAG to 3GPP AAA proxy communication?
q_30860.ground_truth: The MAG to 3GPP AAA server or MAG to 3GPP AAA proxy communication should use the MAG to AAA interface functionality defined in IETF RFC 5779 and the NAS to AAA interface functionality defined in IETF RFC 5447.

q_30861.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group in producing the present document?
q_30861.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification Group is responsible for standardizing Lawful Interception (LI) of telecommunications within a 3GPP network. The present document describes protocols and procedures for LI based on 3GPP specifications and covers both internal 3GPP interfaces and external handover interfaces for delivery of intercepted communications to Law Enforcement.

q_30862.question: How do 3GPP specifications support existing 2G services?
q_30862.ground_truth: 3GPP specifications are capable of supporting existing 2G services in a transparent manner for the users. This is an important driver to ensure that established mobile users stay with their existing operator while taking new services into use.

q_30863.question: What does the Reflective QoS Control parameter indicate in PCC rules?
q_30863.ground_truth: The Reflective QoS Control parameter indicates to apply reflective QoS for the service data flow. This is used to control the RQI (Resource Quantity Indication) marking in the DL (Downlink) packets and may trigger the sending of the RQA (Resource Quantity Allocation) parameter for the QoS Flow the service data flow is bound to.

q_30864.question: How does the Content Provider authenticate itself to the BM-SC as specified in clause 4.4.2 of the 3GPP technical specification?
q_30864.ground_truth: The Content Provider shall act as the (D)TLS client and the BM-SC as the (D)TLS server when the Content Provider wants to provision new services or manage existing services.

q_30865.question: What is the importance of sharing security material in ad-hoc group communication?
q_30865.ground_truth: Sharing security material is essential in ad-hoc group communication for providing secure communication between different MC service clients in the group. It is a step towards creating secure ad-hoc group communication to ensure the content shared within the group remains confidential. The security material permits MC service clients to communicate securely, and if end-to-end encryption is enabled, the shared security material is exchanged to identify and verify the user's identity.

q_30866.question: What is the limitation on the authorized session AMBR value within each session rule instance if the "VPLMN-QoS-Control" feature is supported and the PCF receives session AMBR constraints from the SMF?
q_30866.ground_truth: The authorized session AMBR value within each session rule instance shall not exceed the session AMBR supported by the VPLMN, if applicable.

q_30867.question: What should the NF service producer or SCP do when it becomes aware of a change in the NF service consumer to determine whether there is an NF service consumer change?
q_30867.ground_truth: The NF service producer or SCP should not check the Binding Indication to determine whether there is an NF service consumer change, but continue to use its current Notification/Callback URI for subsequent requests until it becomes aware of a change.

q_30868.question: Which events are reserved for 3GPP for future usage in the event list?
q_30868.ground_truth: Events 20, 21, and 22 are reserved for future usage by 3GPP.

q_30869.question: What is the purpose of the announcing UE procedure for UE-to-network relay discovery?
q_30869.ground_truth: The announcing UE procedure for UE-to-network relay discovery is used to enable a ProSe-enabled public safety UE to announce the availability of a connectivity service provided by a UE-to-network relay to other ProSe-enabled public safety UEs, or to measure the PC5_DISCOVERY message signal strength between the ProSe-enabled public safety UE and the ProSe UE-to-network relay UE(s) for relay selection/reselection.

q_30870.question: What is the purpose of the "test" command in the context of network request handling?
q_30870.ground_truth: The "test" command is used to request information on the supported MT modes of operation as a compound value, rather than making a network request.

q_30871.question: What should a 5G ProSe enabled UE acting as a 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay advertise during the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay Discovery?
q_30871.ground_truth: A 5G ProSe enabled UE acting as a 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay should only advertise its support for relaying emergency services during the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay Discovery.

q_30872.question: If a UE supports MPTCP functionality with any steering mode, MPQUIC functionality with any steering mode, and ATSSS-LL functionality with only active-standby steering mode, what should be the ATSSS-ST bits set in the 5GSM capability IE of the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message?
q_30872.ground_truth: The ATSSS-ST bits should be set to "MPTCP functionality with any steering mode, MPQUIC functionality with any steering mode and ATSSS-LL functionality with only active-standby steering mode supported".

q_30873.question: What should the UE do if timer F or timer B expires during the Trying or Calling state of a non-INVITE client transaction or an INVITE client transaction?
q_30873.ground_truth: If the UE is not using the multiple registration mechanism, it should consider the contact address as not bound to any public user identity, mark the currently used P-CSCF address as unavailable, and initiate an initial registration using a different unavailable P-CSCF or get a new set of P-CSCF addresses and initiate an initial registration. If the UE is using the multiple registration mechanism, it should declare the registration flow dead and mark the currently used P-CSCF address as unavailable.

q_30874.question: What happens when the OnlyCallerReports rule is present in the rules for QoE metric reporting?
q_30874.ground_truth: Only the initiator of the call, i.e., the caller, will report metrics to the QoE report server.

q_30875.question: What is the minimum number of transmitter antennas for the E-UTRAN TDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for out-of-sync in release 8?

q_30876.question: What is the requirement for a UE when performing a DCI-based BWP switch between the BWPs in disjoint channel bandwidths or in partially overlapping channel bandwidths?
q_30876.ground_truth: The UE is not required to follow the requirements defined in clause 8.6C.2

q_30877.question: What must the NF service consumer provide in order to provision information about AF signalling IP flows between the UE and the NF service consumer?
q_30877.ground_truth: The NF service consumer must provide the IP address of the UE and a media component including the "medCompN" attribute and one or more media subcomponents representing the AF signalling IP flows.

q_30878.question: What should the UE do to inform the 5G DDNMF that it wants to stop announcing a ProSe restricted code before the associated valid timer expires?
q_30878.ground_truth: When the UE initiates the announce request procedure to inform the 5G DDNMF that it wants to stop announcing a ProSe restricted code before the associated valid timer expires, it should set the requested timer to 0.

q_30879.question: What does the PduSessionType enumeration indicate?
q_30879.ground_truth: The type of a PDU session.

q_30880.question: What should a transmission participant do upon receiving RTP media packets and the SSRC not associated with any transmitter stored in the transmitter list in the 'O: pending delegated' state?
q_30880.ground_truth: The transmission participant should request the MCVideo client to render the received RTP media packets, store the SSRC of the RTP media packet in the transmitter list as an unknown user, start timer T203 (End of RTP media) associated with the SSRC, and remain in the 'O: pending delegated' state.

q_30881.question: What information must the UE check upon receiving the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message from the MME?
q_30881.ground_truth: The UE must check the integrity of the message and compare the received UE security capabilities and nonceUE with what the UE provided in the initial message.

q_30882.question: When can the IMS media bearer be assigned with correct ARP value?
q_30882.ground_truth: The IMS media bearer can be assigned with correct ARP value when it is established after the IMS session of the MPS service has been established.

q_30883.question: What event must be detected by the IRI-POI in the SCEF in order to generate an xIRI containing an SCEFCommunicationPatternUpdate record?
q_30883.ground_truth: The IRI-POI in the SCEF must detect that an SCS/AS has updated the Communication pattern data in order to generate an xIRI containing an SCEFCommunicationPatternUpdate record.

q_30884.question: When should the UE abort the bearer resource modification procedure and release the PTI allocated for this activation after attempting to resend the BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST five times?
q_30884.ground_truth: The UE should abort the bearer resource modification procedure and release the PTI allocated for this activation after attempting to resend the BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST five times.

q_30885.question: What should be done if the leaving condition is fulfilled for one or more of the cells included in the cellsTriggeredList for all measurements after layer 3 filtering?
q_30885.ground_truth: If reportOnLeave is set to TRUE, initiate the measurement reporting procedure. If the cellsTriggeredList is empty, remove the measurement reporting entry within the VarMeasReportList for this measId and stop the periodical reporting timer for this measId, if running.

q_30886.question: In what circumstances should the UE send another PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message for a non-emergency PDN connection without an APN provided by the UE?
q_30886.ground_truth: When the UE did not provide an APN for the establishment of the PDN connection and the request type was different from "emergency" and from "handover of emergency bearer services", and timer T3396 is associated with no APN, if running.

q_30887.question: What is the maximum overall delays measured in the test?
q_30887.ground_truth: The maximum overall delays measured in the test is 802 ms.

q_30888.question: What operation does a UE perform on the set of candidate single-subframe resources in sidelink transmission mode 4?
q_30888.ground_truth: The UE moves the candidate single-subframe resource from the set of candidate single-subframe resources to the set of selected single-subframe resources.

q_30889.question: When verifying single carrier REFSENS requirements for Local Area NCR-MT, how many Rx antenna ports are required for verification in all supported frequency bands?
q_30889.ground_truth: Two Rx antenna ports are required for verification in all supported frequency bands.

q_30890.question: What are the contents of RRCResumeRequest message if useFullResumeID is signaled in SIB1 in 3GPP 5G systems?
q_30890.ground_truth: RRCResumeRequest1, resumeIdentity set to the stored fullI-RNTI value.

q_30891.question: What information does the MME take into account when the Privacy Indicator IE is included in the CELL TRAFFIC TRACE message in E-UTRAN?
q_30891.ground_truth: The MME takes the information into account for anonymisation of MDT data when the Privacy Indicator IE is included in the CELL TRAFFIC TRACE message in E-UTRAN.

q_30892.question: What media feature tag should be included in the Contact header field of the SIP 200 (OK) response?
q_30892.ground_truth: The g.3gpp.mcdata.ipconn media feature tag should be included in the Contact header field of the SIP 200 (OK) response.

q_30893.question: When does the UE provide EPS Bearer QoS parameters to the application handling the traffic flow?
q_30893.ground_truth: The UE provides EPS Bearer QoS parameters to the application handling the traffic flow when it receives an S1-AP Initial Context Setup Request.

q_30894.question: What information is required in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body of an SIP request in a primary MCPTT system?
q_30894.ground_truth: The mcptt-request-uri element set to the value of the MCPTT ID of the targeted MCPTT user and the mcptt-calling-group-id element set to the MCPTT group ID of the MCPTT group on which the MCPTT emergency call, imminent peril call, or the emergency alert state has changed should be included.

q_30895.question: What is the purpose of the UE measurement reports in the described call flow?
q_30895.ground_truth: The UE measurement reports are used by the E-UTRAN to determine if a handover to GERAN without DTM support is necessary for the call.

q_30896.question: What is the requirement for the UE to send an Event A3 triggered measurement report in Test 1?
q_30896.ground_truth: In Test 1, the UE shall send one Event A3 triggered measurement report, with a measurement reporting delay less than 6.4 s from the beginning of time period T2.

q_30897.question: What should the AMF include in the "200 OK" response when it supports the RAN-ID-LIST feature and the request included a list of NG RAN node IDs and a notification URI where to be notified about failures?
q_30897.ground_truth: The AMF shall report failure(s) of the N2 MBS related N2 procedure with an NG RAN node in the list provided by the MB-SMF by including the failureList IE in the "200 OK" response or in a subsequent Notify request towards the notification URI received in the request.

q_30898.question: What is the role of the Primary NSACF in the NSACF system?
