q_31379.ground_truth: The EPS bearer context status IE is included in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message in the following cases: g, s, zb, if the UE has established PDN connection(s) of "non IP" or Ethernet PDN type, and if the UE has locally deactivated at least one dedicated EPS bearer context upon an inter-system mobility.

q_31380.question: What header field must be included in the outgoing SIP MESSAGE request, with the ICSI value "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcdata.fd", in the P-Asserted-Service header field?
q_31380.ground_truth: A P-Asserted-Service header field must be included in the outgoing SIP MESSAGE request with the specified ICSI value to indicate the service capability.

q_31381.question: What should the MCVideo server check for the existence of a binding between the IMS public user identity and the MCVideo ID in the request?
q_31381.ground_truth: The MCVideo server should check if a binding exists between the IMS public user identity in the Request-URI and the MCVideo ID in the <mcvideo-request-uri> element of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body.

q_31382.question: What treatment can sed give to the default bearer and EPS bearer carrying IMS signalling in the EPS prior to and during IMS-based MPS invocation?
q_31382.ground_truth: Sed can give priority treatment to the default bearer and EPS bearer carrying IMS signalling in the EPS prior to and during IMS-based MPS invocation.

q_31383.question: What is the maximum repetition period of relevant system info blocks that needs to be received by the UE to camp on a cell in this test?
q_31383.ground_truth: The maximum repetition period of relevant system info blocks that needs to be received by the UE to camp on a cell in this test is 1.28 seconds.

q_31384.question: What is the main purpose of Power Saving Mode (PSM) in cellular networks?
q_31384.ground_truth: PSM is designed for user equipment (UE) that expect infrequent mobile originating and terminating services and can tolerate latency in mobile terminating communication. It allows the UE to save power by scheduling periodic updates and signalling only when necessary.

q_31385.question: What requirements does E-UTRAN have to meet in terms of radio resource management?
q_31385.ground_truth: E-UTRAN needs to meet requirements related to idle mode cell re-selection algorithms, UE measurement and reporting procedures in connected mode, mobility of radio connections in connected mode, handover decisions, and inter-RAT radio resource management.

q_31386.question: In the context of the described UE behavior, what is the condition for the UE to apply the p-Max value and not the additionalPmax value?
q_31386.ground_truth: If the UE does not support any additionalSpectrumEmission in the specified frequency band list, it will apply the p-Max value.

q_31387.question: What is the duration of the CC-T9 recall timer?
q_31387.ground_truth: The duration of the CC-T9 recall timer is 20 seconds plus some seconds for CC call set-up, with a maximum of 30 seconds.

q_31388.question: What message does the NG-RAN send to the AMF when it cannot continue to provide the Broadcast MBS session due to lack of radio resources?
q_31388.ground_truth: Broadcast Session Release Require (MBS Session ID)

q_31389.question: How does the eDRX setting influence data communication in the UE?
q_31389.ground_truth: The eDRX setting can enable or disable data communication in the UE, and also allow the UE to request and apply specific eDRX values for different access technology types, as well as control the presentation of unsolicited result codes related to the eDRX parameters.

q_31390.question: What is the function of the Reflective QoS Attribute (RQA) in 5G networks?
q_31390.ground_truth: The RQA indicates that certain traffic on the QoS Flow is subject to Reflective QoS. It enables the transfer of the RQI for AN resource corresponding to this QoS Flow when signalled for a QoS Flow.

q_31391.question: How does the solution described in 6.23, address the protection of groupcast and broadcast?
q_31391.ground_truth: The solution described in 6.23 proposes a key provision mechanism that can securely provide groupcast/broadcast protection keys to Target/Reference UEs when they are out of coverage.

q_31392.question: What is the requirement for the RSRP and RSRQ measurement accuracy in sections 9.1.13.1, 9.1.13.2, and 9.1.13.3 for reported measurements contained in event triggered periodic measurement reports?
q_31392.ground_truth: The required RSRP and RSRQ measurement accuracy for periodic reporting is specified in those sections.

q_31393.question: What should a TWAG do when it receives a message with syntactically incorrect optional IEs?
q_31393.ground_truth: The TWAG should take the same approach as the UE and treat all syntactically incorrect optional IEs as not present in the message.

q_31394.question: What is the name of the feature that supports BRID and DAA message transmission via LTE sidelink using autonomous resource selection in both in-coverage and out-of-coverage scenarios?

q_31395.question: What is the purpose of the test procedure described in clause 8.3.1.4.2?
q_31395.ground_truth: The purpose of the test procedure described in clause 8.3.1.4.2 is to measure the performance of a receiver's ability to detect ACK under multipath fading propagation conditions for a given SNR, specifically for single user PUCCH format 0 for ACK missed detection.

q_31396.question: What is the role of the MTK in MBS traffic protection?
q_31396.ground_truth: The MTK is used for MBS traffic protection, instead of deriving a MTK for the specified MBS session ID.

q_31397.question: What should the UE do if it is in CS/PS mode 1 with "IMS voice not available" and the request was related to CS fallback?
q_31397.ground_truth: The UE shall attempt to select GERAN or UTRAN radio access technology and disable the E-UTRA capability.

q_31398.question: What conditions must be met in order to ensure that uplink data is transmitted on the radio bearer associated with the default EPS bearer context after a successful inter-frequency handover from E-UTRA TDD to E-UTRA FDD?
q_31398.ground_truth: The UE must have a default EPS bearer context and successful completion of the inter-frequency handover from E-UTRA TDD to E-UTRA FDD.

q_31399.question: What is the role of the gNB-CU in the paging function?
q_31399.ground_truth: The gNB-CU is responsible for filtering target cells for paging based on the UE Radio Capability for Paging, determining the PA, providing paging information to enable the gNB-DU to calculate the exact PH, PO and PF, and requesting the gNB-DU to consolidate all the paging records for a particular PH, PO, PF and PA, and encode the final RRC message and broadcast the paging message on the respective PH, PO, PF in the PA.

q_31400.question: In the context of 8.2.1.3.5, what is the purpose of the minimum performance requirement for open-loop spatial multiplexing with 2 transmit antennas superposed with simultaneous PDSCH interference?
q_31400.ground_truth: The purpose is to verify the minimum performance of open-loop spatial multiplexing with 2 transmitter antennas superposed with simultaneous PDSCH interference.

q_31401.question: How does the UPF report the QoS monitoring result of the QoS flows?
q_31401.ground_truth: The UPF reports the QoS monitoring result of the QoS flows by sending QoS Monitoring Report IEs to the SMF in PFCP Session Report Request. The UPF may also send QoS monitoring events directly to the Local NEF or AF using the UPF Event Exposure service.

q_31402.question: How many cells are used in the test defined in section 4.5.1.4.4.2?
q_31402.ground_truth: There are two cells used in the test, a single E-UTRA cell (Pcell) and a single NR cell (PSCell).

q_31403.question: In the "ResourceStatusResponse" procedure, what is the criticality type of the "id-CriticalityDiagnostics" protocol information element?

q_31404.question: Which test described in clause 8.4 is applicable to equipment powered by the AC mains and not applicable to AC output ports?
q_31404.ground_truth: The test for assessing the ability of radio equipment and ancillary equipment to limit internal noise from the AC mains power input/output ports.

q_31405.question: What is the purpose of the Number of UEs and PDU Sessions per network slice notification procedure?
q_31405.ground_truth: Its purpose is to handle the case when there is a single NSACF in the PLMN responsible for the S-NSSAI (single Service Area) or when there are multiple NSACFs responsible for the S-NSSAI in the PLMN (multiple Service Areas).

q_31406.question: What is the definition of maximum total output power, Pmax, of a Base Station?
q_31406.ground_truth: Maximum total output power, Pmax, of a Base Station is the mean power level measured at the antenna connector during the transmitter ON period in a specified reference condition.

q_31407.question: What happens when a V2X application-specific server triggers the session-oriented service establishment?
q_31407.ground_truth: The VAE server provides a session-oriented service trigger response to the V2X application-specific server indicating its ability or inability to initiate a session-oriented service with the VAE client.

q_31408.question: What is the purpose of the "id" attribute in the "<tuple>" element of an MCData user information entry in the list of MCData user information entries?
q_31408.ground_truth: The "id" attribute in the "<tuple>" element of an MCData user information entry uniquely identifies the MCData user information entry in the list of the MCData user information entries.

q_31409.question: What is the requirement for the time alignment error (TAE) for a UE with multiple physical antenna ports supporting UL MIMO?
q_31409.ground_truth: The time alignment error (TAE) shall not exceed 130 ns for a UE with multiple physical antenna ports.

q_31410.question: What should be the rate of correct events observed for the L1-SINR measurement report?
q_31410.ground_truth: The rate of correct events observed should be at least 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

q_31411.question: In what situation can the UE initiate a PDU session modification procedure by sending a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message to delete the mapped EPS bearer context with 5GSM cause #42?
q_31411.ground_truth: If there are other types of syntactical errors in the coding of the TFT IE, after sending the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMPLETE for the ongoing PDU session modification procedure.

q_31412.question: What should the VAE-C include in the HTTP 200(OK) response when receiving a request for V2X service discovery?
q_31412.ground_truth: The VAE-C should include a Content-Type header field set to "application/vnd.3gpp.vae-info+xml", an application/vnd.3gpp.vae-info+xml MIME body with a <communication-status-info> element in the <VAE-info> root element, a <V2X-UE-id> element set to the identity of the V2X UE, a <V2V-communication-mode> element indicating the supported V2V communication mode, and send the HTTP 200(OK) response towards the VAE-S.

q_31413.question: What types of handover failures are distinguished for inter-system mobility?
q_31413.ground_truth: Inter-system mobility from E-UTRAN to NG-RAN and from NG-RAN to E-UTRAN, classified as "Inter-system too early handover" and "Inter-system too late handover".

q_31414.question: What should the S-CSCF do if the UE is authenticated and the "integrity-protected" header field parameter in the Authorization header field is set to "tls-pending" or "tls-yes"?
q_31414.ground_truth: The S-CSCF shall associate the registration with the local state of "tls-protected".

q_31415.question: What should the transmission control server do if it receives an implicit Transmission request, but there is only one MCVideo client in the MCVideo call?
q_31415.ground_truth: The transmission control server should reject the request if there is only one MCVideo client in the MCVideo call.

q_31416.question: Which of the provided protocol extended sequences (E-RABToBeUpdatedItem-ExtIEs, E-RABToBeSwitchedULItem-ExtIEs, etc.) is the type of "id-Cause" and its criticality level?
q_31416.ground_truth: The type of "id-Cause" is Cause and the criticality level is ignore.

q_31417.question: What should a non-controlling MCVideo function do if the partner MCVideo system does not have a mutual aid relationship with the primary MCVideo system identified by the contents of the P-Asserted-Identity and the SIP INVITE request is for non-controlling MCVideo function of an MCVideo group?
q_31417.ground_truth: The non-controlling MCVideo function should reject the SIP INVITE request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response, set the warning text to "128 isfocus already assigned" in a Warning header field, and not process the remaining steps.

q_31418.question: What action should be taken when a participated MCPTT function determines that a received SIP request triggering the procedures of clause 9.2.2.2.14 needs to be rejected?
q_31418.ground_truth: The MCPTT group information entry added by the procedures of clause 9.2.2.2.12 should be removed if the MCPTT group ID matches the MCPTT group targeted by the received SIP request, and the MCPTT client information entry contains the MCPTT client ID included in the received SIP request.

q_31419.question: What action should a participating MCPTT function take upon receiving a SIP 2xx response to a SIP MESSAGE request sent for forwarding a private call?
q_31419.ground_truth: Upon receipt of a SIP 2xx response in response to the SIP MESSAGE request sent for forwarding a private call, the participating MCPTT function shall generate a SIP 200 (OK) response and forward the SIP 200 (OK) response to the MCPTT client.

q_31420.question: What is the purpose of the SRS (Sounding Reference Symbol) in E-UTRA physical layer procedures?
q_31420.ground_truth: The SRS (Sounding Reference Symbol) is used in E-UTRA physical layer procedures for estimating the uplink channel quality at the base station. It is transmitted by the UE (user equipment) to assist the base station in scheduling uplink transmissions.

q_31421.question: What message type should the VAE-S include in the Content-Type header field when sending a 200 OK response for successful service discovery?

q_31422.question: What should the AS do when it receives a REFER request for call push handling?
q_31422.ground_truth: The AS should verify that the user is allowed to push a call and if it is allowed, the AS should either forward the REFER request towards the REFER target or start 3pcc procedures to transfer the originating leg from the originator of the REFER request to the REFER target and update the terminating leg if necessary.

q_31423.question: What action does the LMF take in response to a request for the UE available location event?
q_31423.ground_truth: The LMF obtains the UE location and releases all resources, and if (H)GMLC contact address and the Notification Correlation ID is received, the LMF responds to AMF to indicate that the location determination will be sent directly to GMLC.

q_31424.question: What action does the UE take when it receives a DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message during a bearer resource modification procedure and the EPS bearer identity matches the UE requested bearer resource modification procedure?
q_31424.ground_truth: The UE aborts the UE requested bearer resource modification procedure and proceeds with the EPS bearer context deactivation procedure.

q_31425.question: What procedure does the DeNB perform when it receives certain X2 messages from RN or neighbour eNBs?
q_31425.ground_truth: The DeNB may trigger associated non-UE-dedicated X2-AP procedure(s) or pass associated information to neighbour eNBs based on the included cell information.

q_31426.question: What should the UE do if it receives a Local Emergency Numbers List while it is in S1 mode and is in EMM-REGISTERED and EMM-IDLE mode?
q_31426.ground_truth: The UE updates the Local Emergency Numbers List using EMM procedures, adding any new emergency numbers.

q_31427.question: What is the purpose of the <Group call ongoing> field in the Group call ongoing field?
q_31427.ground_truth: The <Group call ongoing> field in the Group call ongoing field indicates whether there is a group call ongoing or not. The field can have two possible values: '0' for no group call ongoing or '1' for group call ongoing.

q_31428.question: What should the value of bit 2 in Octet 7 be, in order to release all bearer resources of the UE at the SGW?
q_31428.ground_truth: The value of bit 2 in Octet 7 should be set to 1, in order to release all bearer resources of the UE at the SGW.

q_31429.question: What information is carried in the N2 SM information when the SMF decides to activate redundant transmission for a new QoS Flow with two I-UPFs in step~2a?
q_31429.ground_truth: The N2 SM information includes the allocated CN Tunnel Info of the two I-UPFs.

q_31430.question: What is the required confidence level to pass each test in this procedure?
q_31430.ground_truth: The required confidence level to pass each test in this procedure is 95%.

q_31431.question: What is the purpose of including Overload Control Information in PFCP messages?
q_31431.ground_truth: The Overload Control Information is used to signal overload, at node level granularity, to a peer network function in PFCP messages, which provides guidance to the receiving network function to decide actions that lead to signalling traffic mitigation towards the sender of the information.

q_31432.question: In what clause of the provided document is the condition of known SCell in FR1 or FR2 defined?

q_31433.question: What should the SGW send to the PGW upon receiving a non-empty Modify Bearer Request used as an implicit resume of the suspended bearers in the SGW and in the PGW?
q_31433.ground_truth: The SGW may send a Resume Notification message to the PGW on the S5/S8 interface upon receipt from the MME/S4-SGSN of a (non-empty) Modify Bearer Request used as an implicit resume of the suspended bearers in the SGW and in the PGW.

q_31434.question: When can a UE disable the NB-IoT capability?
q_31434.ground_truth: A UE can only disable the NB-IoT capability when in EMM-IDLE mode.

q_31435.question: What is the maximum degradation observed in the evaluation of Type 3 NW first separate training with dataset sharing manner for CSI compression for the pairing of 1 NW to 1 UE (Case 1) where the shared output of the Network side CSI generation part is after quantization?

q_31436.question: What is the formula used to calculate the average delay DL air-interface measurement?
q_31436.ground_truth: The average delay DL air-interface measurement is calculated by taking the sum of the point in time when the last part of an RLC SDU packet is sent to the UE minus the time when the corresponding RLC SDU part arrives at the MAC layer, divided by the total number of RLC SDUs transmitted to the UE successfully. This is done per PLMN ID, mapped 5QI or QCI in NR option 3, and per supported S-NSSAI.

q_31437.question: What is the purpose of credit pooling in the context described?
q_31437.ground_truth: Credit pooling is used to avoid credit fragmentation that can occur when separate quotas are granted, causing some of the user's credit to be reserved and potentially resulting in the denial of new services.

q_31438.question: What does the value of the <user-priority> element in the <entry> element of the MCS group document indicate?
q_31438.ground_truth: The value of the <user-priority> element in the <entry> element of the MCS group document indicates the priority of the MCS group member, with a higher value indicating a higher priority.

q_31439.question: How many IP addresses/prefixes are allocated by the UPF to the UE for an MA PDU Session when MPTCP is enabled?
q_31439.ground_truth: The UPF allocates three IP addresses/prefixes to the UE for an MA PDU Session when MPTCP is enabled, one for the MA PDU Session and two "MPTCP link-specific multipath" addresses/prefixes.

q_31440.question: What determines the allocation of RSC and/or Discovery Group IDs to a particular Key Type ID in a UE?
q_31440.ground_truth: The allocation of RSC and/or Discovery Group IDs to a particular Key Type ID in a UE is specific to the UE and does not need to be common across all UEs.

q_31441.question: What is the requirement for the minimum rate at which the UE is required to search for and measure GSM cells if the priority of GSM is higher than the serving cell?
q_31441.ground_truth: The minimum rate at which the UE is required to search for and measure GSM cells, if the priority of GSM is higher than the serving cell, may be reduced to maintain UE battery life.

q_31442.question: What is the definition of "Network Failure towards a Specific Location" in the context of IMS emergency services?
q_31442.ground_truth: Network Failure towards a Specific Location refers to a situation where an emergency request cannot be delivered to a specific location-based PSAP or can be associated with a national or default PSAP/Emergency centre.

q_31443.question: What is the purpose of the Target-Dialog header field in the initial SIP INVITE request sent due to ATU-STI for PS to CS SRVCC?
q_31443.ground_truth: The Target-Dialog header field in the initial SIP INVITE request sent due to ATU-STI for PS to CS SRVCC is used to indicate the dialog identifier of the session being transferred.

q_31444.question: Which power class UE is subject to the requirement of clause 6.2.3A for inter-band carrier aggregation?
q_31444.ground_truth: UE with inter-band carrier aggregation where one uplink component carrier is assigned to one E-UTRA band is subject to the requirement of clause 6.2.3A.

q_31445.question: What is the expected action of the UE in the test described in 9.2.3.1.17, if the UE receives a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message with the reject cause set to "roaming not allowed in this tracking area"?
q_31445.ground_truth: The UE sets the EPS update status to EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED and deletes the last visited registered TAI. It also enters the state EMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH and stores the current TAI in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming."

q_31446.question: What is the role of a Root CA in a security domain?
q_31446.ground_truth: A Root CA serves as the trust anchor in a chain of trust within a security domain, generating the self-signed certificate as the root certificate. All certificates in this security domain are signed by the root certificate directly or indirectly.

q_31447.question: What is the channel bandwidth to be tested for E-UTRA TDD carriers in the test?
q_31447.ground_truth: The channel bandwidth to be tested for E-UTRA TDD carriers in the test is 10 MHz.

q_31448.question: What is the URN identifier for the 5G Media Streaming DASH Interoperability Point?
q_31448.ground_truth: The URN identifier for the 5G Media Streaming DASH Interoperability Point is "urn:3GPP:5GMS:iop:DASH".

q_31449.question: What must the PCF ensure if the "DNAI change" feature is set to true for a specific application's traffic?
q_31449.ground_truth: The PCF must ensure that for the traffic related with the concerned application, no DNAI change takes place once selected initially for this application.

q_31450.question: How can MEC applications and EDGEAPP utilize services provided by MEC platforms and EES?
q_31450.ground_truth: MEC applications and EDGEAPP utilize the services provided by MEC platforms and EES, respectively, for exposing network services and application-specific functionalities. EAS uses the services of EES, while MEC applications utilize the services of MEC platforms.

q_31451.question: What should a mobile station implementing this version of the protocol indicate for speech calls in the Supported Codec List information element?
q_31451.ground_truth: A mobile station implementing this version of the protocol shall indicate all codecs that it supports for UTRAN in the Supported Codec List information element, and for GERAN in the Bearer Capability information element.

q_31452.question: What is the purpose of the "NAS Security Parameters from NG-RAN" information element?
q_31452.ground_truth: This information element provides security related parameters for inter-system handover from NG-RAN to E-UTRAN or from NG-RAN to UTRAN via the eNB to the UE.

q_31453.question: What two options does Rel-18 propose to support UEs in the case where at least one of the S-NSSAIs in the Requested NSSAIs is not supported in the current TA?
q_31453.ground_truth: The two options for supporting UEs in Rel-18 are: 1) providing a RA including TAIs where the AMF provides a list of TAIs in the RA where the rejected S-NSSAI is supported or known to be not supported, and 2) providing an Allowed NSSAI known to be supported in the whole RA (if any) and one or more "Partially Allowed S-NSSAI in the RA" including for each the Partial RA where these are supported.

q_31454.question: What is the impact of activating an SCell with uplink on Power Headroom Reporting?
q_31454.ground_truth: Activating an SCell with uplink will trigger a PHR transmission in the form of an Extended Power Headroom MAC Control Element.

q_31455.question: Which PUCCH format does the UCI block error probability performance requirement apply to, in terms of the number of UCI bits?
q_31455.ground_truth: The UCI block error probability performance requirement only applies to the PUCCH format 2 with 22 UCI bits.

q_31456.question: What is the purpose of L3 filtering in the measurement reporting delay when an event is triggered?
q_31456.ground_truth: L3 filtering is used to smooth out the measurement report, but it results in an additional delay in the measurement reporting.

q_31457.question: In this test scenario, how many CSI reports for SCell1 should be received by the SS during the time period T2 in the case where the test is performed with the PCell and SCells being intra-band between each other?
q_31457.ground_truth: The first CSI report for SCell1 should be received by the SS in a subframe (m+8) or (m+9) if the subframe (m+8) was subject to interruption, and CSI report with non-zero CQI index should be received by the SS earlier than or equal to subframe (m+39) or the next available uplink resource if there are no uplink resources for reporting the valid CSI in a subframe (m+39) and DTX is not observed by the SS anywhere outside the subframes (m+5) to (m+13) and the subframes (m+15) to (m+23) up to the end of T2.

q_31458.question: In the case of asynchronous ProSe and uplink transmissions, what determines the reference subframe for determining the PCMAX tolerance?
q_31458.ground_truth: The reference subframe for determining the PCMAX tolerance is the subframe of the carrier that leads in time.

q_31459.question: What information does the SMF generate and send to the I-SMF for local traffic offload?
q_31459.ground_truth: The SMF generates N4 information for local traffic offload based on the available DNAI(s), PCC rules associated with these DNAI(s), and charging requirements. This information is sent from the SMF to the I-SMF after UL CL/Branching Point insertion/update/removal, and the I-SMF uses this N4 information to derive rules installed in the UPFs controlled by the I-SMF.

q_31460.question: What is the requirement in 3GPP TS 22.261 for supporting a UE using simultaneous indirect and direct network connection mode?
q_31460.ground_truth: The 5G system shall be able to support a UE using simultaneous indirect and direct network connection mode.

q_31461.question: What should be verified after performing the unwanted emission tests for all the relevant intermodulation products and intermodulation products frequency ranges?
q_31461.ground_truth: It should be verified that the emission level does not exceed the required level in clause~6.7.5 with the exception of interfering signal frequencies.

q_31462.question: What is the Criticality level of id-NAS-PDU in the DownlinkNASTransport-IEs?
q_31462.ground_truth: The Criticality level of id-NAS-PDU in the DownlinkNASTransport-IEs is reject.

q_31463.question: What message should the UE send in response to an ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message with a PTI value that does not match any PTI in use?
q_31463.ground_truth: The UE should respond with an ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message including ESM cause #47 "PTI mismatch".

q_31464.question: What should the PCF use to signal maximum data burst volume values higher than 4095 Bytes when the EMDBV feature is supported by both the PCF and the SMF?

q_31465.question: What is the definition of the Uplink power control window size for NR CC in the context of 3GPP TS 38.101-1?
q_31465.ground_truth: The Uplink power control window size for NR CC is defined as 1dB (UE power step size) + 0.7dB (UE power step tolerance) + (Test system relative power measurement uncertainty).

q_31466.question: What is required for telephone-event based DTMF transport in the Customized Alerting Tone (CAT) service?
q_31466.ground_truth: For telephone-event based DTMF transport in the Customized Alerting Tone (CAT) service, the DTMF digits are sent as media and not visible in the control plane.

q_31467.question: What type of services does the 3GPP TS cover when defining the architecture of layer 3 and its sublayers on the GSM Um interface?
q_31467.ground_truth: The 3GPP TS covers non-GPRS services, CTS services, and LCS services when defining the architecture of layer 3 and its sublayers on the GSM Um interface.

q_31468.question: What is the time period between the start of time period T2 and the required measurement reporting delay for Event B1 triggered measurement reports for cells 2, 3, and 4?

q_31469.question: What actions shall the MCPTT client take upon receiving a Connect message in the 'U: Pre-established session in use' state?
q_31469.ground_truth: The MCPTT client shall send an Acknowledge message with the Reason Code field set to 'Accepted' and remain in the 'U: Pre-established session in use' state.

q_31470.question: What is the required timing accuracy for the GNSS signal to be considered a reliable synchronization reference by the UE?
q_31470.ground_truth: The UE shall meet the timing accuracy requirement as specified in 12.2 of TS38.101-1.

q_31471.question: What does the GBR bearer level QoS parameter represent in the EPS network?
q_31471.ground_truth: The GBR bearer level QoS parameter represents the guaranteed and maximum bit rate that can be expected to be provided by a GBR bearer.

q_31472.question: What is one of the procedures supplied within this specification for EPS mobility management?
q_31472.ground_truth: Elementary procedures for EPS mobility management in clause 5.

q_31473.question: What is the procedure for the Service Request procedure via Untrusted non-3GPP Access?
q_31473.ground_truth: The Service Request procedure via Untrusted non-3GPP Access is used by a UE in CM-IDLE or CM-CONNECTED state over non-3GPP access to request the re-establishment of the NAS signalling connection and the re-establishment of the user plane for all or some of the PDU Sessions associated to non-3GPP access. The UE establishes a "signalling IPsec SA" with the N3IWF for this procedure.

q_31474.question: What does the time duration Y represent in the case of DCI-based BWP switch, where the serving cell where UE receives DCI for BWP switch is different from the serving cell on which BWP switch occurs for any involved serving cell?
q_31474.ground_truth: Y equals to the length of 1 slot

q_31475.question: What is the requirement for the first SDP offer in a CLUE-based telepresence session over IMS?
q_31475.ground_truth: The support for CLUE shall be negotiated via the SDP between two TP UEs, indicated using an SDP session-level 'group' attribute.

q_31476.question: What are some types of analytics output that can be provided by the NWDAF to the UE application client?
q_31476.ground_truth: The types of analytics output that can be provided by the NWDAF to the UE application client include QoS Sustainability Analytics, Network Slice load predictions information, NF load analytics, User Data Congestion Analytics, and Network Performance Analytics.

q_31477.question: What is the difference between a signal and control port and a telecommunication port?
q_31477.ground_truth: A signal and control port carries information or control signals, excluding antenna ports, while a telecommunication port is intended to be connected to telecommunication networks, such as public switched telecommunication networks, and similar networks.

q_31478.question: When should the S-CSCF retain the P-Access-Network-Info header field based on local policy rules?
q_31478.ground_truth: The S-CSCF may retain the P-Access-Network-Info header field based on local policy rules and the destination user when the response is sent towards the originating user.

q_31479.question: What is the number of non-dropped associated gap occasions covering PRS occasions within the window W in NR PRS-based measurement in the positioning frequency layer i, after further accounting for MG collisions by applying the selected gap collision rule?
q_31479.ground_truth: Navailable is the number of non-dropped associated gap occasions covering PRS occasions within the window W, after further accounting for MG collisions by applying the selected gap collision rule.

q_31480.question: In the context of off-network floor control, what is the role of the MCPTT client that currently has the floor?
q_31480.ground_truth: The MCPTT client that currently has the floor in off-network floor control serves as the temporary floor arbitrator.

q_31481.question: Who assigns the application identifiers for 3GPP Diameter applications?
q_31481.ground_truth: IANA assigns the application identifiers for 3GPP Diameter applications.

q_31482.question: What is the purpose of registering a UPF in NRF for event exposure services?
q_31482.ground_truth: The purpose is to allow the UPF to provide information about its event exposure services to other network functions (NFs), so they can discover and use these services as needed.

q_31483.question: How does an MCVideo client respond to a SIP INFO request within the dialog of the SIP request for a priority group call?
q_31483.ground_truth: The MCVideo client sends a SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP INFO request and sets the MCVideo emergency alert state accordingly.

q_31484.question: What is the state in which the UE can set up a call or session in E-UTRAN, after undertaking a number of procedures in a hierarchical sequence?
q_31484.ground_truth: Different states in the E-UTRAN UE correspond to different stages of the setup process for a call or session.

q_31485.question: What action will the UE take if there is one or more multicast MBS sessions associated with the released PDU session?
q_31485.ground_truth: If there is one or more multicast MBS sessions associated with the released PDU session, the UE will locally leave the associated multicast MBS sessions.

q_31486.question: What is the requirement for spurious emissions in UL-MIMO for each transmit antenna connector?
q_31486.ground_truth: The requirements specified in subclause 6.6.3 apply to each transmit antenna connector for UEs with two transmit antenna connectors in closed-loop spatial multiplexing scheme.

q_31487.question: What is the purpose of the clockQuality information in Announce messages for PTP instances?
q_31487.ground_truth: The clockQuality information in Announce messages for PTP instances provides UEs with time synchronization status degradation or improvement. It reflects the current clock quality, such as synchronization state, primary source description, and clock accuracy.

q_31488.question: What is required to be included in the <location-tracking-info> element?
q_31488.ground_truth: The <location-tracking-info> element shall include either a V2X-UE-id and geographical-identifier or a result element.

q_31489.question: What is the initial step taken by the 5G ProSe Layer-2 Remote UE when determining the path switching for traffic transmission?
q_31489.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe Layer-2 Remote UE first performs the 5G ProSe Layer-2 UE-to-Network Relay discovery and selection to determine if a 5G ProSe Layer-2 UE-to-Network Relay path exists.

q_31490.question: What is the responsibility of the NF which enables LI in the VPLMN, when VPLMN does not support AKMA?
q_31490.ground_truth: When VPLMN does not support AKMA, the NF which enables LI stores the LI security context for potential LI request in the VPLMN, and deletes the LI security context after expiration of KAF. In case of KAF or KSession key refresh, the NF needs to be informed about the new key with the same procedure.

q_31491.question: In the context of automatic network selection on E-UTRAN and UTRAN, what must a UE do when it is switched on and shared OPLMN cells are available?
q_31491.ground_truth: The UE must select the highest priority OPLMN and RAT combination and attempt to attach on the selected cell and PLMN. Once successfully registered, it indicates the correct PLMN to the user.

q_31492.question: What procedure does the LMF follow to determine the UE location using the UL location measurements received from NG-RAN gNB nodes?
q_31492.ground_truth: The LMF determines the UE location using the UL location measurements received at step 13, without attempting to obtain additional location measurements from the UE or from the NG-RAN.

q_31493.question: What data is taken as input by the PC service?
q_31493.ground_truth: The PC service takes as input the results of the State Estimation service, the electric grid topology and component parameters, real-time data such as the estimation of bus voltages, power flows, and real-time notification of a change in switch or breaker status.

q_31494.question: What is a receiver exclusion band in the context of an AAS base station?
q_31494.ground_truth: A receiver exclusion band in an AAS base station is a band of frequencies over which no tests of radiated immunity are made. It is defined differently depending on whether spatial exclusion is used during the EMC RI testing or not.

q_31495.question: When is a mobile station attached for emergency bearer services?
q_31495.ground_truth: A mobile station is attached for emergency bearer services if it has successfully completed an attach for emergency bearer services or if it has only a PDN connection for emergency bearer services established.

q_31496.question: What is the role of alpha-UE-r15 parameter in uplink power control of a UE?
q_31496.ground_truth: The alpha-UE-r15 parameter is a 3-bit parameter provided by higher layers for each serving cell, used in the calculation of uplink transmit power for a UE when subframe belongs to uplink power control subframe set 2 as indicated by the higher layer parameter tpc-SubframeSet-r12.

q_31497.question: What should the network do if it receives an IDENTITY REQUEST message during a pending GPRS attach procedure and the information elements in the ATTACH REQUEST message have not changed?
q_31497.ground_truth: The network should not treat the new ATTACH REQUEST as a new procedure and keep processing the initial GPRS attach procedure.

q_31498.question: Under what conditions must the SC UE release ongoing sessions before adding Gm control to an existing CS session?
q_31498.ground_truth: The SC UE must release all ongoing full-duplex sessions with speech media component over CS, except for the one it wants to add Gm control to.

q_31499.question: What HTTP method is used for deregistering an EES from the ECS?
q_31499.ground_truth: The EES sends an HTTP DELETE message to the ECS on the resource URI identifying the individual EES registration resource representation.

q_31500.question: How does the RAN send network congestion information to the local PSA?
q_31500.ground_truth: The RAN sends the network congestion information to the local PSA via the GTP-U header of corresponding UL packet. If no UL packet can be used, RAN generates a dummy UL packet for the report.

q_31501.question: What should the UE include in the PDU Session Establishment Request message when requesting to establish a MA PDU Session with ATSSS?
q_31501.ground_truth: The UE should include the "MA PDU Request" Request Type in the UL NAS Transport message and its ATSSS Capabilities as defined in clause 5.32.2 of TS 23.501 in the PDU Session Establishment Request message.

q_31502.question: What is the main focus of Collaboration Scenario 1 in the 5GMSu Application?
q_31502.ground_truth: Collaboration Scenario 1 in the 5GMSu Application focuses on media plane only collaboration for which the 5GMS System is deployed in the trusted domain, and the 5GMS System Provider offers uplink streaming capabilities as a service to an external 5GMSu Application Provider.

q_31503.question: In which MS operation mode is the combined routing area updating procedure not initiated?
q_31503.ground_truth: The combined routing area updating procedure is not initiated by a GPRS MS operating in MS operation mode A if the MS is in state GMM-REGISTERED and MM-IDLE, and if the network operates in network operation mode II or III.

q_31504.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for the handover delay in the test?
q_31504.ground_truth: The handover delay Dhandover shall be less than maximum RRC procedure delay (which is 50 ms) + Tinterrupt in RRC_CONNECTED state.

q_31505.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for RRC-based active BWP switch?
q_31505.ground_truth: The UE shall be able to receive PDSCH/PDCCH on the new BWP on the serving cell on which BWP switch occurs on the first DL slot right after a time duration of slots which begins from the beginning of DL slot n, calculated based on the RRC procedure delay and the time used by the UE to perform BWP switch.

q_31506.question: What are the four analytics specific parameters required when requesting analytics from NWDAF?
q_31506.ground_truth: The four analytics specific parameters are Analytics ID, Notification Target Address, Notification Correlation ID, and Analytics target period.

q_31507.question: How does the MCPTT functional alias controlling server handle functional alias resolution when it belongs to a different MC system?
q_31507.ground_truth: When the MCPTT functional alias controlling server receives a request to resolve a functional alias from a different MC system, it sends a request to the partner MC system's MCPTT functional alias controlling server for resolution, which then returns the terminating MCPTT ID to the requesting server.

q_31508.question: When is the logMeasAvailable included in the RRCResumeComplete message?
q_31508.ground_truth: When the UE has logged measurements available for NR and if the RPLMN is included in plmn-IdentityList stored in VarLogMeasReport.

q_31509.question: What type of messages are transferred between a serving AMF and target UE in the N1 reference point to support privacy notification and verification and change of UE privacy preference?
q_31509.ground_truth: Supplementary services messages are transferred between a serving AMF and target UE in the N1 reference point to support privacy notification and verification and change of UE privacy preference.

q_31510.question: What does the first digit in the version number of a 3GPP Technical Specification signify?
q_31510.ground_truth: The first digit in the version number of a 3GPP Technical Specification indicates the status of the document. A value of 1 means the document is presented to TSG for information, 2 means presented to TSG for approval, and 3 or greater indicates a TSG approved document under change control.

q_31511.question: When is it sufficient to measure the signal at any one of the transmitter antenna connectors?
q_31511.ground_truth: It is sufficient to measure the signal at any one of the transmitter antenna connectors if the manufacturer has declared the transmitter paths to be equivalent.

q_31512.question: What is the role of the PCF in the UCU procedure?
q_31512.ground_truth: The PCF indicates to the UE via AMF to obtain information from the UE for URSP policy in the UE policy container and may update the parameters based on the feedback received from the UE.

q_31513.question: What action should the gNB-DU take if it cannot establish any of the requested modifications of the broadcast context?
q_31513.ground_truth: The gNB-DU shall respond with the BROADCAST CONTEXT MODIFICATION FAILURE message with an appropriate cause value.

q_31514.question: What information is included in the NAI provided by the N5CW device to indicate that it wants "5G connectivity-without-NAS" towards a specific PLMN or SNPN?
q_31514.ground_truth: The NAI includes the 5G-GUTI assigned to the N5CW device and the PLMN or SNPN selected by the N5CW device for "5G connectivity-without-NAS".

q_31515.question: What is the value of PROSE DIRECT LINK SECURITY MODE REJECT message PC5 signalling protocol cause IE when the implementation-specific maximum number of established NR 5G ProSe direct links has been reached during the 5G ProSe direct link establishment procedure?
q_31515.ground_truth: The cause value is #5: Lack of resources for 5G ProSe direct link.

q_31516.question: What is the purpose of the "sg" SIP URI parameter that the UE adds to the public GRUU when acting as a registrar?
q_31516.ground_truth: The "sg" SIP URI parameter uniquely identifies the UA to the public GRUU it received in the "pub-gruu" header field parameter.

q_31517.question: What message is sent by the gNB-DU to gNB-CU in case of unsuccessful Multicast Context Modification?
q_31517.ground_truth: The MULTICAST CONTEXT MODIFICATION FAILURE message is sent by the gNB-DU to gNB-CU in case of unsuccessful Multicast Context Modification.

q_31518.question: In addition to the OTDOA-RequestLocationInformation message, what other message should be delivered to the physical layer of the UE to start the time for the RSTD measurement?
q_31518.ground_truth: The OTDOA assistance data in the OTDOA-ProvideAssistanceData message.

q_31519.question: What is the minimum percentage of ACK/NACK transmissions the UE has to perform on the PCell during the time duration T1?

q_31520.question: What is the role of the BM-SC in the 5GMS architecture?
q_31520.ground_truth: The BM-SC is responsible for ingesting content from the 5GMS AS, using either pull mode or push mode, and broadcasting the MBMS Service Announcement.

q_31521.question: Who can use both the feedback-based mechanism and the event package for load distribution in the IMS?
q_31521.ground_truth: The S-CSCF, application servers, and entities that implement the additional routing capability can use both the feedback-based mechanism and the event package for load distribution in the IMS.

q_31522.question: What should the UE do for operation with shared spectrum channel access when the PSFCH is associated with a SCI format 2-A with Cast type indicator field value of "01"?
q_31522.ground_truth: If the UE determines an ACK value from at least one PSFCH reception occasion from the number of PSFCH reception occasions in PSFCH resources corresponding to every identity of UEs that the UE expects to receive corresponding PSSCHs, the UE reports an ACK value to higher layers; otherwise, the UE reports a NACK value to higher layers.

q_31523.question: What is the downlink cell-specific reference-signal EPRE derived from in 5G NR?
q_31523.ground_truth: The downlink cell-specific reference-signal EPRE is derived from the downlink reference-signal transmit power provided by higher layers.

q_31524.question: What is one characteristic of a SL PRS resource within a slot?
q_31524.ground_truth: One characteristic of a SL PRS resource within a slot is that the symbols of a SL PRS resource within a slot are consecutive symbols.

q_31525.question: What is the expected packet loss rate requirement for delivering pose information in XR applications?
q_31525.ground_truth: The expected packet loss rate requirement for delivering pose information in XR applications is lower than 10E-3 for uplink sensor data.

q_31526.question: What are the conditions for including a P-Preferred-Identity header field in any initial request for a dialog or request for a standalone transaction?
q_31526.ground_truth: The UE may insert a P-Preferred-Identity header field in any initial request for a dialog or request for a standalone transaction as a hint for creation of an asserted identity; the UE can include any of the following in the P-Preferred-Identity header field: a public user identity which has been registered by the user with the respective contact address, an implicitly registered public user identity, or any other public user identity which the user has assumed through means outside the scope of this specification.

q_31527.question: What is the condition that needs to be met for a UE to not perform intra-frequency measurements during cell reselection?
q_31527.ground_truth: If Sintrasearch in the serving cell is greater than SServingCell, the UE may choose not to perform intra-frequency measurements.

q_31528.question: What is the general ON/OFF time mask for CA in the 2UL CA case?
q_31528.ground_truth: The test is designed to verify that the general ON/OFF time mask for CA meets the requirements given in 6.3A.3.1.1.5. Transmission of the wrong power increases interference to other channels, or increases transmission errors in the uplink channel. The test is applicable to all types of NR UE release 16 and forward supporting 2UL CA.

q_31529.question: In the case of handover for Ethernet PDU Session, what is the role of the SMF in signalling to the RAN via the AMF?
q_31529.ground_truth: The SMF signals to the RAN via the AMF to provide the Path Switch Request Ack, which includes the update of the uplink N3 tunnel endpoint to the target UPF. This signalling is defined in clause~4.9.1.2. In steps 9-10, an indication is sent from the SMF via the AMF to the RAN node indicating that the RAN node should not expect to receive an end marker packet. The RAN node may skip trying to reorder the downlink packets.

q_31530.question: How many different CSI-RS or SSB resources are required to be reported in a single reporting instance when the higher layer parameter groupBasedBeamReporting is set to 'enabled' and nrofReported is Group?
q_31530.ground_truth: Two different CSI-RS or SSB resources are required to be reported in a single reporting instance when the higher layer parameter groupBasedBeamReporting is set to 'enabled' and nrofReported is Group.

q_31531.question: What type of AVP is the Coupled-Node-Diameter-ID?
q_31531.ground_truth: The Coupled-Node-Diameter-ID is of type DiameterIdentity.

q_31532.question: What is the minimum degradation observed in the evaluation of Type 3 NW first separate training with dataset sharing manner for CSI compression, for the pairing between 1 UE part model and N>1 separate NW part models (Case 3)?

q_31533.question: What is the role of the default SAI as Source ID on the interface to the target BSS in the depicted call flow for SRVCC from E-UTRAN to GERAN without DTM support?
q_31533.ground_truth: The default SAI as Source ID on the interface to the target BSS is used to identify that the source for the SRVCC handover is E-UTRAN, and to ensure correct statistics in the target BSS. It should be different from the SAIs used in UTRAN.

q_31534.question: What is the value of P for FR2 when the CSI-RS for BFD measurement is partially overlapped with measurement gap and candidate beam detection RS is not overlapped with SMTC occasion?

q_31535.question: What should a UE do if the 5GS network feature support IE with ATSSS support indicator is set to "ATSSS not supported"?
q_31535.ground_truth: The UE should perform a local release of the MA PDU session, if any, and if a locally released MA PDU session is associated with one or more multicast MBS sessions, the UE should locally leave the associated multicast MBS sessions.

q_31536.question: What message does the AMF send to the target gNB to confirm a PATH SWITCH REQUEST message?
q_31536.ground_truth: The AMF sends a PATH SWITCH REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message to the target gNB to confirm a PATH SWITCH REQUEST message.

q_31537.question: What are the two propagation models considered in the non-synchronized scenarios?
q_31537.ground_truth: The two propagation models considered are Free Space Path Loss and RMa model in TR 38.901 with hUT as 30m.

q_31538.question: What is the purpose of the "end marker" in the EPC network?
q_31538.ground_truth: The "end marker" is used for forwarding data between the PDN GW and the Serving GW. Upon reception of the "end marker" by the Serving GW, it shall not send downlink data notification.

q_31539.question: What should the MME do if timer Ts6-1 expires in the process of a Location Update for non-EPS service procedure?
q_31539.ground_truth: The MME should abort the procedure.

q_31540.question: What is the minimum requirement for the Sub-block gap size in the scenario described?
q_31540.ground_truth: The Sub-block gap size must be at least 5 MHz.

q_31541.question: What functionality can be impacted by the provided BAT offset values in the solution?
q_31541.ground_truth: The BAT offset values provided to NEF/AF or TSN AF via PCF can impact the procedures for establishing QoS flows between UPF and NG-RAN. When integration with IEEE TSN applies, the TSN AF can act as a CUC and adjust TSN streams accordingly based on the BAT offset values. When integration with IEEE TSN does not apply, the AF can adjust the data streams accordingly.

q_31542.question: What is the purpose of the TrK and InK in the key management system?
q_31542.ground_truth: The TrK is used to protect the transfer of key material between the KM client and KMS, while the InK is used for integrity protection.

q_31543.question: What are the two procedures provided by the Control plane-based Network triggered ranging device discovery solution?
q_31543.ground_truth: The two procedures provided are the one-shot Control plane-based Network triggered ranging device discovery procedure and the Deferred Control plane-based Network triggered ranging device discovery procedure.

q_31544.question: What should the NF Service Consumer send when it requests the SMF to move a UE EPS PDN connection to 5GS using the N26 interface?
q_31544.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer shall send a POST request towards the SMF (+PGW-C) of each UE EPS PDN connection, including the UE EPS PDN connection, the pduSessionsActivateList attribute, the epsBearerCtxStatus attribute, and the dlDataWaitingInd attribute.

q_31545.question: What should the UE's state be for this test to be performed?
q_31545.ground_truth: The UE should be in state 1N-B with generic procedure parameters Test Mode = On.

q_31546.question: What is the purpose of the M5 interface in a 5GMS Client?
q_31546.ground_truth: The M5 interface in a 5GMS Client is used by a Media Session Handler to invoke services relating to downlink or uplink media streaming at the 5GMS AF.

q_31547.question: How is the pm-dsg measured in this test?
q_31547.ground_truth: The pm-dsg is measured as the ratio of statDTX to the sum of NACK, ACK, and statDTX, and is measured over a duration of 4500 NPDCCH.

q_31548.question: What is the responsibility of the Media Player in the 5GMS architecture?
q_31548.ground_truth: The Media Player is responsible for processing the retrieved MPD, determining the number of transport sessions needed for media acquisition, initializing the media pipelines for each media stream, and retrieving initialization segment(s) referenced by the MPD.

q_31549.question: In what situations will the MME request the UE to include its UE radio capability ID in the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message during an ongoing attach procedure in WB-S1 mode?
q_31549.ground_truth: If the network supports RACS, the UE has set the RACS bit to "RACS supported" and the URCIDA bit to "UE radio capability ID available" in the UE network capability or UE radio capability ID availability IE of the ATTACH REQUEST message.

q_31550.question: What are the conditions that the local MCVideo system should route the SIP request through an MCVideo gateway server that acts as an exit point from the local MCVideo system to the interconnected MCVideo system?
q_31550.ground_truth: If the terminating participating MCVideo function is in an interconnected MCVideo system in a different trust domain.

q_31551.question: What should the MCVideo client do if it does not have enough resources to handle an incoming SIP INVITE request for a multimedia session?
q_31551.ground_truth: The MCVideo client may reject the SIP INVITE request with an appropriate reject code and warning texts if the user is authorized to restrict the reason for failure.

q_31552.question: What should a GPRS MS operating in mode A or B in a network that operates in mode I do when the network is operating in mode II and the GPRS MS wishes to be IMSI attached for GPRS and non-GPRS services?
q_31552.ground_truth: A GPRS MS operating in mode A or B in a network that operates in mode I should use the MM specific procedures listed in subclauses 4.3 and 4.4 in addition to the GMM specific procedures when the network is operating in mode II and the GPRS MS wishes to be IMSI attached for GPRS and non-GPRS services.

q_31553.question: Which message is sent by a UE to another peer UE to reject a DIRECT LINK SECURITY MODE COMMAND message?
q_31553.ground_truth: The DIRECT LINK SECURITY MODE REJECT message is sent by a UE to another peer UE to reject a DIRECT LINK SECURITY MODE COMMAND message.

q_31554.question: What is the minimum length of the User plane node management capability information element?
q_31554.ground_truth: The User plane node management capability information element has a minimum length of 5 octets.

q_31555.question: Under what conditions is an interruption to active E-UTRA serving cells allowed due to CSI and RRM measurements on NR SCell(s) in dormancy?
q_31555.ground_truth: The rate of ACK/NACK feedback loss on any active E-UTRA serving cell resulting from CSI and RRM measurements on NR SCells in dormancy shall not exceed 0.5% and 1.0%, respectively.

q_31556.question: What is the formula to calculate the "Positive Paging Rate" in a network?
q_31556.ground_truth: The "Positive Paging Rate" in a network is calculated by the number of paging requests that result in UEs transitioning from triggering a mobile terminated call divided by the total number of paging requests, expressed as a percentage.

q_31557.question: What should the CoAP URI of the request include in the CoAP PUT request sent by the SNRM-C?
q_31557.ground_truth: The CoAP URI of the request should include the "resUri" of the QoS session participant corresponding to the VAL UE.

q_31558.question: What does the term "served by NG-RAN" mean in this specification?
q_31558.ground_truth: In this specification, "served by NG-RAN" refers to the UE being connected to a NG-RAN cell, while "not served by NG-RAN" means the UE is not connected to a NG-RAN cell and must use resources provisioned in the ME or UICC or other authorized means.

q_31559.question: What may a BS have to comply with, in addition to the requirements in subclauses 6.6.2.1 and 6.6.2.2, when deployed in regions where FCC Title 47 limits are applied?
q_31559.ground_truth: The applicable emission limits established by FCC Title 47.

q_31560.question: How many EPS bearer contexts can the UE and the network support in the present version of the protocol?
q_31560.ground_truth: The UE and the network may support a maximum number of 15 EPS bearer contexts.

q_31561.question: What is the condition for releasing UTRAN specific resources?
q_31561.ground_truth: UTRAN should release all UE dedicated resources upon indication that the UE has completed a connection establishment to the other radio access technology.

q_31562.question: If a 5GMSd Client supports the Television (TV) profile, what audio decoding requirements must it meet?
q_31562.ground_truth: The 5GMSd Client must support eAAC+ stereo and can support xHE-AAC stereo operation points for the Television (TV) profile.

q_31563.question: How did the researcher suggest to better analyze the effects of different shift positions for robustness in the round robin tests?
q_31563.ground_truth: The researcher suggested using an average measure across shift positions to reduce scatter versus labs and provide better consistency between labs.

q_31564.question: What is the value of the "maximumNumberOfReports" for the monitoring event "Number of UEs in a geographic area" if only one-time reporting is supported for this event?

q_31565.question: What minimum conformance requirements are specified in 9.1.61.3?
q_31565.ground_truth: Absolute and relative CSI-RSRP measurement accuracy requirements are specified for SCells operating under frame structure 3 in TS 36.133 clause~9.1.18.4.4 and 9.1.18.4.5.

q_31566.question: What is the role of the Non-3GPP Access Entity in a 3GPP network?
q_31566.ground_truth: The Non-3GPP Access Entity is responsible for interworking between 3GPP Core Network Functions and Non-3GPP access networks. The Non-3GPP Access Entity includes TWIF, TNGF, N3IWF, and W-AGF.

q_31567.question: What is the procedure for terminating data channels in 5G?
q_31567.ground_truth: In the case of data channel associated with an IMS audio/video session, all the data channels should be terminated with the IMS session. In case of abnormal scenarios, the MMTel AS should terminate all the data channels.

q_31568.question: What is the structure of the IMRN in a roaming scenario?
q_31568.ground_truth: In a roaming scenario, the IMRN has the same structure as an international ISDN number as defined in clause 3.4.

q_31569.question: What is the purpose of NR handover as defined in 6.1D.1.1?
q_31569.ground_truth: The purpose of NR handover is to change the NR PCell to another NR cell for RedCap UE.

q_31570.question: What could be the consequence of an incorrect audience claim in an access token?
q_31570.ground_truth: An incorrect audience claim in an access token can lead to unauthorized access to network services as the access token would not match the identity or type of the network product under test.

q_31571.question: Which network function relays NAS messages between the UE and the AF via NWt, and handles PDU data units between the UE and the UPF(s)?

q_31572.question: What action does the Serving GW take after updating its bearer context?
q_31572.ground_truth: The Serving GW returns a Create Session Response message to the SGSN.

q_31573.question: What does the <rx> parameter represent in the HSCSD current call parameters +CHSC command?
q_31573.ground_truth: The <rx> parameter represents the number of receive timeslots currently in use in the HSCSD current call parameters +CHSC command.

q_31574.question: What is use to indicate satellite backhaul category in SM Policy Association Establishment?
q_31574.ground_truth: Satellite Backhaul Category is used to indicate satellite backhaul category in SM Policy Association Establishment.

q_31575.question: What information does the SMF provide to the NEF for PDU session if required?
q_31575.ground_truth: The SMF provides Small Data Rate Control parameters to the NEF for PDU Session, if required.

q_31576.question: What should be the first Access Technology Type in the MS RA capability value part?
q_31576.ground_truth: The first Access Technology Type should not be set to "1111".

q_31577.question: What should the MCVideo client include in the "a=rtpmap" attribute's "name" field if it supports the encoding indicated in the "name" attribute of the "s)>element"?
q_31577.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should insert the value of the "name" attribute in the "<encoding name>" field of the "a=rtpmap" attribute.

q_31578.question: Which functional entities are introduced or enhanced to support data channel usage in IMS network?
q_31578.ground_truth: Data Channel Signalling Function (DCSF), Data Channel Application Repository (DCAR), Data Channel Media Function (DCMF), IMS AS, and NEF are introduced or enhanced to support data channel usage in IMS network.

q_31579.question: How does the proposal affect the security policies for Ranging/SL Positioning control messages?
q_31579.ground_truth: The proposal sets the SR5 security policies for integrity protection of Ranging/SL Positioning control messages as "REQUIRED" and provides flexibility for confidentiality protection by offering "REQUIRED", "PREFERRED", or "NOT NEEDED" options.

q_31580.question: What is required for the MnS producer to obtain the inference output for performance evaluation?
q_31580.ground_truth: The MnS producer needs to have the capability to get the inference output generated by each inference function.

q_31581.question: What should the SMF do when the other access does not accept the QoS profile for a GBR QoS flow, and the QoS notification control is enabled for the corresponding PCC rule?
q_31581.ground_truth: The SMF should delete the GBR QoS flow and report to the PCF about the removal of the PCC rule.

q_31582.question: What should the MTSI terminal do if the negotiated downlink QoS Maximum Bit Rate (MBR) is not aligned with the b=AS bandwidth modifier in the sent SDP?
q_31582.ground_truth: The MTSI terminal should try to align the bandwidth properties in a subsequent SDP offer-answer if the negotiated downlink QoS Maximum Bit Rate (MBR) is not aligned with the b=AS bandwidth modifier in the sent SDP.

q_31583.question: In what state does the network initiate a Network Triggered Service Request procedure over 3GPP access when the UE is in CM-IDLE state and registered over 3GPP and non-3GPP accesses in the same PLMN?
q_31583.ground_truth: The network initiates the procedure in the CM-IDLE state in 3GPP access and in CM-CONNECTED state in non-3GPP access.

q_31584.question: What action does the BSF take when it receives a discovery request from an NF service consumer for an MBS session?
q_31584.ground_truth: The BSF sends an HTTP "200 OK" response to the NF service consumer with the address information of the PCF currently handling the MBS session (i.e. PCF address(es), and if available, the associated PCF set ID, the PCF instance ID and the SBA binding level information).

q_31585.question: Which NF responds to the USS when the re-authentication has been initiated in the USS initiated Re-authentication procedure?
q_31585.ground_truth: The USS receives a response from the UAS NF indicating that the UAA re-authentication has been initiated.

q_31586.question: What mandatory encryption procedure should be applied to both the <mcptt-request-uri> element or <mcptt-client-id> element in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body when processing a SIP REGISTER request for service authorization?
q_31586.ground_truth: Confidentiality protection should be applied to both the <mcptt-request-uri> element or <mcptt-client-id> element in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body when processing a SIP REGISTER request for service authorization.

q_31587.question: What is the purpose of the "NetSliceUsageCtrl" feature when supported in the PCF?
q_31587.ground_truth: The "NetSliceUsageCtrl" feature, when supported in the PCF, allows the provisioning/updating/removal of network slice usage control information (e.g., slice PDU session inactivity timer value) within the "sliceUsgCtrlInfo" attribute of the SmPolicyDecision data structure.

q_31588.question: What is the procedure for adding a PINE to a PIN?
q_31588.ground_truth: The PINE sends a request to the PEMC to join the PIN, including the security credentials of the PIN client, UE identifier, UE location, PIN ID, and PIN client profile(s). The PEMC authorizes the request and notifies the PEGC, which updates the PIN profile.

q_31589.question: What is the role of dl-PathlossChange in the Power Headroom Reporting procedure?
q_31589.ground_truth: dl-PathlossChange determines the minimum change in measured downlink pathloss required to trigger a PHR and the required power backoff due to power management as allowed by P-MPRc to trigger a PHR.

q_31590.question: Which clauses in 3GPP TS 23.558 are enhanced by this solution?
q_31590.ground_truth: The procedures in service continuity scenarios in clause 8.8.2.2, clause 8.8.2.3, and clause 8.8.2.6 of 3GPP TS 23.558 are enhanced by this solution.

q_31591.question: What is the objective of Key Issue #5, "Switching traffic of an MA PDU Session between two non-3GPP access paths"?
q_31591.ground_truth: The objective of Key Issue #5 is to study how the data traffic of an MA PDU Session can be switched between one non-3GPP access path, from the UE to a N3IWFin a PLMN, and another non-3GPP access path, from the UE to a TNGF in the same PLMN.

q_31592.question: What information does the gNB include in SIB9 to indicate a change in clock quality information?
q_31592.ground_truth: The gNB includes a reference report ID in SIB9 that serves as a notification for the UEs to retrieve the new clock quality information.

q_31593.question: What can the NG-RAN node consider when allocating resources to QoS flows within the PDU SESSION RESOURCE SETUP REQUEST message?
q_31593.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node can consider the Additional QoS Flow Information IE in the QoS Flow Level QoS Parameters IE when allocating resources to QoS flows, but it is up to the NG-RAN node implementation to decide whether and how to use it.

q_31594.question: What IE is added to the Additional information IE of the UL NAS TRANSPORT message for reporting periodic or triggered location events to the LMF in NG-RAN LCS?

q_31595.question: What is the purpose of the initial trust establishment between NF and CA/RA in network slicing?
q_31595.ground_truth: The initial trust establishment is crucial to ensure that the requestor NF instance is the correct one and is entitled to request a certificate. A certificate management (CM) proxy is used to verify the NF identities and facilitate this trust establishment.

q_31596.question: What algorithm, with a 128-bit input key, is used by the PDCP entity for ciphering in the Uu interface between the UE and eNB?
q_31596.ground_truth: The algorithms 128-EEA1, 128-EEA2, and 128-EEA3, as specified in TS 36.331.

q_31597.question: Which two systems are considered for time synchronization in 5G systems?
q_31597.ground_truth: The 5G Clock synchronization and the (g)PTP domain synchronization.

q_31598.question: What should a UE do if it receives an ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message with a linked EPS bearer identity that does not match any activated default EPS bearer context?
q_31598.ground_truth: The UE should reply with an ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message with ESM cause #43 "invalid EPS bearer identity".

q_31599.question: What information regarding the PC5 QoS Context and PC5 QoS Rule(s) does the UE maintain in the V2X layer for each PC5 QoS Flow identified by a PC5 QoS Flow Identifier (PFI) per destination identified by Destination Layer-2 ID?
q_31599.ground_truth: The UE maintains the PC5 QoS Context which includes PFI, PC5 QoS parameters, and the V2X service type(s). The UE also maintains one or more PC5 QoS Rule(s), each containing PFI, a PC5 Packet Filter Set, and a precedence value to determine the order in which the PC5 QoS Rules are evaluated.

q_31600.question: What action does the HSS take when there is redirection to another HSS (service) instance?
q_31600.ground_truth: In the case of redirection, the HSS returns a 3xx status code which contains a Location header with an URI pointing to the endpoint of another HSS (service) instance.

q_31601.question: Which types of NR UE does the test in section 7.7.6.2.2 apply to?
q_31601.ground_truth: The test in section 7.7.6.2.2 applies to all types of NR UE from Release 16 onwards, as long as they support L1-SINR measurements.

q_31602.question: What must the controlling MCPTT function include in the Session Initiation Protocol (SIP) request for an MCPTT emergency group call?
q_31602.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function must include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body with the <mcpttinfo> element containing the <mcptt-Params> element. The <mcptt-request-uri> element should be set to the value of the MCPTT ID of the targeted MCPTT user, the <mcptt-calling-user-id> element should be set to the value of the MCPTT ID of the calling MCPTT user, and the <mcptt-calling-group-id> element should be set to the value of the MCPTT group ID of the emergency group call.

q_31603.question: What action does the UE take if 5GMM cause #76 is received from a non-CAG cell?
q_31603.ground_truth: The UE shall replace the CAG information list stored in the UE with the received information list when received in the HPLMN or EHPLMN, and replace the serving VPLMN's entry of the CAG information list stored in the UE with the serving VPLMN's entry of the received CAG information list when received in a serving PLMN other than the HPLMN or EHPLMN.

q_31604.question: What is the total noise power result obtained from the measurements?
q_31604.ground_truth: The total noise powers obtained from the measurements are averaged and expressed as 10 * log10 of this average in dB.

q_31605.question: When can the ProSe UE-to-network relay start announcing Relay Discovery Additional Information?
q_31605.ground_truth: The ProSe UE-to-network relay can start announcing Relay Discovery Additional Information if it is currently authorized to perform ProSe direct discovery Model A announcing in the serving PLMN, has detected the corresponding TMGI in the serving cell, and the timer T4105 or T4107 has not expired (depending on the information being announced).

q_31606.question: Which element is used in the "c2-operation-mode-switching" to indicate the operation mode switching requirement for UAV?
q_31606.ground_truth: The "C2-operation-mode-switching-requirement" element is used in the "c2-operation-mode-switching" to indicate the operation mode switching requirement for UAV.

q_31607.question: In what state does the mobile station enter the state PLMN SEARCH in case of losing coverage while continuously activated and then returning to coverage?

q_31608.question: In the "tPlmnChangeType" complex type, what is the data type of the "mcc" and "mnc" elements of the "tPlmnIdent" type?
q_31608.ground_truth: The "mcc" and "mnc" elements of the "tPlmnIdent" type are defined as strings, and can have a maximum length of 3 and 2 digits respectively, followed by an optional 1- or 2-digit extension.

q_31609.question: What is the operation used by the NF Service consumer to obtain the information about the indicated discovery code from the 5G DDNMF?
q_31609.ground_truth: The MatchReport service operation is used to obtain the information about the indicated discovery code from the 5G DDNMF.

q_31610.question: In the 3GPP TS 36.331 standard, which frequency is included in v2x-InterFreqInfoList?
q_31610.ground_truth: The frequency used for V2X sidelink communication is included in v2x-InterFreqInfoList.

q_31611.question: What is the meaning of "TS" and "TR" in the document titles and other 3GPP documents?
q_31611.ground_truth: "TS" stands for "Technical Specification", which contains normative provisions and is used to specify the technical aspects of a 3GPP system. "TR" stands for "Technical Report", which contains informative provisions and is used to provide additional information on 3GPP systems.

q_31612.question: What UE parameters should be measured to ensure they meet the requirements for the additional spurious emission?
q_31612.ground_truth: The sum of the mean power at each UE antenna connector in the channel bandwidth of the radio access mode should be measured and meet the requirements described in clauses from 6.2D.2.5, or 6.2D.3.5 as appropriate.

q_31613.question: When should the UE store radio link failure information in the VarRLF-Report?
q_31613.ground_truth: The UE should store radio link failure information in the VarRLF-Report upon T310 expiry, T312 expiry, random access problem indication from MCG MAC while neither T300, T301, T304 nor T311 is running, or indication from MCG RLC that the maximum number of retransmissions has been reached for an SRB or DRB.

q_31614.question: What are the entities involved in the AF provided QoS requirement procedure for the PINE communication?
q_31614.ground_truth: The AF (or the PEMC acting as AF), the 5GC, the SMF, and the DN (Data Network) are the entities involved in the AF provided QoS requirement procedure for the PINE communication.

q_31615.question: What should the SMF do if it receives a POST request with the upSecurity IE from the AMF for Xn Handover with I-SMF Insertion?
q_31615.ground_truth: The SMF shall verify that the upSecurity IE included in the received upSecurityInfo IE is the same as the security policy for integrity protection and encryption that the SMF has locally stored.

q_31616.question: What must the participating MCPTT function do if the number of maximum simultaneous MCPTT group calls supported for the MCPTT user has been exceeded?
q_31616.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT function shall respond with a SIP 486 (Busy Here) response with a specific warning text.

q_31617.question: What is 3GPP and what is its role in the development of the NRPPa?
q_31617.ground_truth: 3GPP (Third Generation Partnership Project) is a collaboration between telecommunications standard development organizations. They produced the NRPPa (NR Positioning Protocol A) as part of their Technical Specification for the 5G wireless communication standard.

q_31618.question: When should the controlling MCData function release a one-to-one MCData communication?
q_31618.ground_truth: The controlling MCData function should release the one-to-one MCData communication if it receives an indication from the media plane that the transmission time limit has reached, the transmission data limit per request has reached, or if there are only one or no participants in the MCData communication.

q_31619.question: Which procedure is used by the network to detach the IMSI in the network for GPRS services and/or non-GPRS services and to release a GMM context?

q_31620.question: What should the UE do with out-of-sequence PDCP SDUs after processing the PDCP Data PDUs due to the re-establishment of lower layers?
q_31620.ground_truth: The UE should allocate a bitmap field of length equal to the number of PDCP SNs from and not including the first missing PDCP SDU up to and including the last out-of-sequence PDCP SDUs, and indicate the out-of-sequence PDCP SDUs as ' in the corresponding position in the bitmap field.

q_31621.question: What should an eNodeB do when it receives an MBMS Session Start Request with a different transport network IP multicast distribution address and/or a different IP multicast source address?
q_31621.ground_truth: The eNodeB involved in the broadcast of the MBMS session shall leave the former M1 transport network IP multicast address and join the new M1 transport network IP multicast address (including the IP address of the multicast source) if the MBMS Session Start Request contains a different transport network IP multicast distribution address and/or a different IP multicast source address; the eNodeB should also use the C-TEID received in the MBMS Session Start Request.
