q_31856.ground_truth: BSF derives the K~EEs based on the B-TID, NAF ID of the EES, and key indicator, and sends it to the Zn-Proxy or directly to the EES if connected to the home network of UE/ECS.

q_31857.question: What should the MAC entity do if there is at least one pending SR and there are no UL-SCH resources available for transmission in a given TTI, excluding NB-IoT?
q_31857.ground_truth: If the conditions are met, the MAC entity should initiate a Random Access procedure on the corresponding SpCell and cancel all pending SRs.

q_31858.question: What are the three main organizations involved in sub-use case 2 for network slice exposure?
q_31858.ground_truth: The three main organizations involved are Company-V (Network Slice Customer), Company-A (Network Slice Provider and Network Operator), and Company-X and Company-Y (Communication Service Providers).

q_31859.question: What does the ME do when it receives a secured packet from the network with the integrity check successful?
q_31859.ground_truth: The ME passes the packet transparently to the UICC using the ENVELOPE (SMS-PP DOWNLOAD) command.

q_31860.question: What must the TF in the SMF use to retrieve LI state information from the LISSF?
q_31860.ground_truth: The TF in the SMF must use the LISSF to retrieve LI state information when it is provisioned with a specific XID and access to an LISSF function.

q_31861.question: What exception procedures should the originating AS follow when it receives a 480 (Temporarily Unavailable) response or a 403 (Forbidden) response to an outstanding CC request?
q_31861.ground_truth: The originating AS should stop the CC request timer CC-T2 and confirm to the caller that the invocation was not successful using announcement procedures.

q_31862.question: What message is sent by the UE or by the network at any time to report certain error conditions?

q_31863.question: What message does the Source gNB (SN) send to the Master gNB (MN) when a secondary RAT data usage report is required for released E-RABs?
q_31863.ground_truth: The Secondary RAT Data Usage Report message

q_31864.question: What action does the NSCE Server take upon a successful Policy(ies) deletion?
q_31864.ground_truth: Upon success, the NSCE Server deletes the concerned Individual Policy resource(s), updates the default policy(ies) accordingly, and responds with either an HTTP "200 OK" or an HTTP "204 No Content" status code.

q_31865.question: What is the source layer-2 ID set to in the protocol data unit for 5G ProSe communication over PC5?
q_31865.ground_truth: The source layer-2 ID is set to the layer-2 ID self-assigned by the UE for 5G ProSe communication over PC5 as specified in clause~7.3.2.1.

q_31866.question: What should the UE do if access is barred for signalling and the current cell grants access for signalling?
q_31866.ground_truth: The UE will initiate the Attach procedure on the current cell.

q_31867.question: What is the priority of connection for emergency services?
q_31867.ground_truth: The Remote UE shall prioritize direct connection. It shall request emergency service via UE-to-Network Relay if direct connection is not possible.

q_31868.question: What information is contained in the GNB-CU-CP E1 SETUP RESPONSE message that the gNB-CU-UP may use as a human-readable name?
q_31868.ground_truth: The GNB-CU-CP E1 SETUP RESPONSE message contains the gNB-CU-UP Name IE or the Extended gNB-CU-UP Name IE, which the gNB-CU-UP may use as a human-readable name.

q_31869.question: What message does the UE send to register its Home Address and Care-of Address at the HA if it is in the foreign network?
q_31869.ground_truth: A Binding Update message is sent to the HA to register the Home Address and Care-of Address at the HA if the UE is in the foreign network.

q_31870.question: What is the name of the IE used by the target device to provide capabilities for sensor-based methods to the location server?

q_31871.question: When DRX is used, what is the maximum allowed time for a 2Rx RedCap UE to identify a new CGI of an E-UTRA cell following autonomous gaps, provided that the E-UTRA cell has been already identified by the UE?
q_31871.ground_truth: The maximum allowed time for a 2Rx RedCap UE to identify a new CGI of an E-UTRA cell following autonomous gaps is 150 ms.

q_31872.question: When should the network include the EAP message IE in the REGISTRATION REJECT message?
q_31872.ground_truth: When the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message is sent as part of registration for emergency services and is used to convey an EAP-failure message.

q_31873.question: When should the UE initiate the measurement reporting procedure, as specified in 5.5.5?
q_31873.ground_truth: Upon expiry of the periodical reporting timer for a measurement identity

q_31874.question: What should be the measurement accuracy for RSRP and RSRQ measurements for all cells for category 1bis User Equipment (UE) in periodic and event-triggered measurement reporting?
q_31874.ground_truth: The RSRP measurement accuracy for all measured cells should be as specified in the sub-clauses 9.1.2.7 and 9.1.2.8, and the RSRQ measurement accuracy for all measured cells should be as specified in sub-clause 9.1.5.5.

q_31875.question: What is the LPP protocol and what interfaces does it use in 5G network?
q_31875.ground_truth: The LPP protocol operations are based on a transaction between a target device and a server, with each transaction taking place as an independent procedure. LPP messages are carried as transparent PDUs across intermediate network interfaces using the appropriate protocols such as NGAP over the NG-C interface, NAS/RRC over the LTE-Uu and NR-Uu interfaces.

q_31876.question: Under what condition can the UE be scheduled to transmit a PUSCH starting earlier than the end of the first PUSCH by a PDCCH associated with a different value of coresetPoolIndex that ends later than symbol i?
q_31876.ground_truth: If the UE is scheduled to start a first PUSCH transmission starting in symbol j by a PDCCH associated with a value of coresetPoolIndex ending in symbol i, the UE can be scheduled to transmit a PUSCH starting earlier than the end of the first PUSCH by a PDCCH associated with a different value of coresetPoolIndex that ends later than symbol i.

q_31877.question: What is the initial state of the System Simulator and User Equipment at the start of each test procedure in subclause 6.4.2?
q_31877.ground_truth: The System Simulator condition and the value of system information messages are the ones applicable in the test case referring to the test procedure, and the initial UE condition is one indicated in the test case referring to the procedure.

q_31878.question: What action should be taken by the V-SMF or I-SMF when a request for EBI assignment is received from the NF Service Consumer?
q_31878.ground_truth: The V-SMF or I-SMF shall request the AMF to assign the requested EBIs, and disassociate the EBI(s) with the QFI(s) with which they are associated.

q_31879.question: What is the length of the output sequence for SPUCCH format 3, after the rate matching process, when the input bit sequence is 8 bits long?
q_31879.ground_truth: The length of the output sequence for SPUCCH format 3, after the rate matching process, when the input bit sequence is 8 bits long, is determined by the coding, channel coding and rate matching procedures defined in clauses 5.1.1, 5.1.3.1 and 5.1.4.2 in the document.

q_31880.question: What is the procedure for a UE to switch from Broadcast Reception to Multicast Reception?
q_31880.ground_truth: When a UE detects that it has moved to a cell that is not providing the broadcast session and if the UE had not joined yet the corresponding Multicast session, it triggers MBS join and Session establishment procedure using the TMGI allocated for Multicast session.

q_31881.question: How is the List of NE Types parameter used in measurement control?
q_31881.ground_truth: The List of NE Types parameter in measurement control defines the Network Element types where Trace Session activation is needed.

q_31882.question: What is the effect of multipanelScheme being set to SDMscheme or SFNscheme when determining the association of the first and second indicated TCI states to PUSCH antenna ports?
q_31882.ground_truth: When multipanelScheme is set to SDMscheme or SFNscheme, the first indicated TCI state is applied to a specific PUSCH antenna port of the corresponding PUSCH transmission occasion associated with the first SRS resource set, and the second indicated TCI state is applied to another PUSCH antenna port of the corresponding PUSCH transmission occasion associated with the second SRS resource set.

q_31883.question: What information is stored by the MME in the UE's MM Context?
q_31883.ground_truth: The MME may store the last used 5GS PLMN ID in UE's MM Context.

q_31884.question: What action does the MCVideo client take when in the "S2: waiting for call announcement" state and the call probe retransmission timer (TFG3) expires?
q_31884.ground_truth: The MCVideo client generates and sends a GROUP CALL PROBE message, sets the MCVideo group ID in the message, and starts the call probe retransmission timer (TFG3) again.

q_31885.question: What is the purpose of the Ntsctsf services in the 5G System Architecture?
q_31885.ground_truth: The Ntsctsf services provide Time Sensitive Communications and Time Synchronization function to the 5G System Architecture.

q_31886.question: What measurement is provided by "Number of SMF-NEF connection creation requests" in the context of NEF?
q_31886.ground_truth: The number of SMF-NEF connection creation requests received by the NEF from SMF.

q_31887.question: What does the "5G System" in the document refer to?
q_31887.ground_truth: The 5G System is a set of specifications for the fifth generation of mobile networks, providing stage 3 protocol and data model for the Application Function ProSe Service.

q_31888.question: What should the TWAG do if it receives a WLCP message with an unknown or unforeseen message type?
q_31888.ground_truth: The TWAG should ignore the message if it contains an unknown or unforeseen message type, except that the TWAG should return a status message with cause #97 "message type non-existent or not implemented" if it has enough resources to do so.

q_31889.question: What is the purpose of the feature-capability indicator g.3gpp.thig-path in the context of IP multimedia call control protocol based on SIP and SDP?
q_31889.ground_truth: The feature-capability indicator g.3gpp.thig-path in the context of IP multimedia call control protocol based on SIP and SDP indicates that in a roaming scenario, the visited network IBCF supports topology hiding of a Path header field. This allows for the protection of the network topology from unauthorized access or tampering.

q_31890.question: What is the purpose of the PINE ID in the 5GC architecture?
q_31890.ground_truth: The PINE ID is a unique ID within a PIN and is used to identify PIN Elements. It can be allocated by the PEMC locally or by the network. The PIN ID is a unique ID within a PLMN and is allocated by the network.

q_31891.question: What action is required to cancel further reports of the "Availability after DDN Failure" monitoring event?
q_31891.ground_truth: Explicit deletion of the monitoring event must be performed.

q_31892.question: What is the role of Byte 4 in determining the traffic class in the context of the "+CGEQREQ" extended command?
q_31892.ground_truth: Byte 4 determines the traffic class in the context of the "+CGEQREQ" extended command.

q_31893.question: What should an MTSI client supporting FEC offer for all media streams containing video?
q_31893.ground_truth: The MTSI client should offer Forward Error Correction (FEC) for all media streams containing video

q_31894.question: What action should the UE take when the lowest precedence value of the route selection descriptor matches multiple PDU sessions?
q_31894.ground_truth: It is up to the UE implementation to select which PDU session to use if multiple PDU sessions match the same route selection descriptor of the lowest precedence value.

q_31895.question: What is the main purpose of using "OPTIONAL" or removing certain filter information in Step 3 of Solution #61?
q_31895.ground_truth: The main purpose of using "OPTIONAL" or removing certain filter information in Step 3 of Solution #61 is to enable the NWDAF containing MTLF to have more flexibility in finding and retrieving ML models that match the request or have the most similar features.

q_31896.question: What should the UE set the request type to in the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message during an initial attach?
q_31896.ground_truth: The UE should set the request type to "initial request" in the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message during an initial attach.

q_31897.question: Which numbering plan should be included in the called party address when using CCITT or ITU-T SCCP for inter-PLMN addressing?
q_31897.ground_truth: The called party address should include the global title indicators 0100 and the translation type field should be coded "00000000" when using CCITT or ITU-T SCCP for inter-PLMN addressing.

q_31898.question: What can be deployed within the 5GC for resiliency when using DHCP or AAA server to allocate UE IP address/prefix?
q_31898.ground_truth: One (or more) DHCPv4 or DHCPv6 server or one (or more) AAA server can be deployed within the 5GC for resiliency.

q_31899.question: What is the function of the L2 UE-to-UE Relay in addressing Key Issue #4: Privacy of information over the UE-to-UE Relay?
q_31899.ground_truth: The L2 UE-to-UE Relay facilitates privacy of information by creating a mapping between its Relay specific identifiers and the Source/Target UE's security identifiers, and forwarding messages between the UEs by replacing the E2E identifiers in the PDCP header with relay specific identifiers.

q_31900.question: What is the condition for a UE to reduce transmission power in any portion of slot of the SCG in the context of EN-DC?
q_31900.ground_truth: A UE reduces transmission power in any portion of slot of the SCG if, in any portion of slot, the sum of the linear values of the total UE transmission powers in subframe of the MCG and in slot of the SCG in FR1 exceeds the maximum transmission power, and would not need to be reduced by more than the value provided by XSCALE in order for the linear value of the total UE transmission power in any portion of slot of the SCG.

q_31901.question: What is one of the procedures for IPv4 address and/or IPv6 prefix allocation, which occurs after UPF selection during PDU session establishment procedure?
q_31901.ground_truth: IPv4 address and/or IPv6 prefix allocation after UPF selection during PDU session establishment procedure.

q_31902.question: Which entity provides the GEO satellite backhaul category and GEO Satellite ID to the SMF in the 5G system?
q_31902.ground_truth: The AMF (Access and Mobility Management Function)

q_31903.question: What conditions allow the UE to determine a location by using only UE based or standalone position methods?
q_31903.ground_truth: Obtaining a location at step~6 limits the UE to using UE based or standalone position methods.

q_31904.question: When is a NAS message regarded as ciphered if the "null ciphering algorithm" EEA0 is used?
q_31904.ground_truth: A NAS message with the security header indicating ciphering is regarded as ciphered if the "null ciphering algorithm" EEA0 has been selected as a ciphering algorithm.

q_31905.question: What is the difference between "AC" and "AUSF" in the context of the document?
q_31905.ground_truth: "AC" stands for Application Client, while "AUSF" stands for Authentication Server Function. They serve different purposes in the 5G system.

q_31906.question: What action does the MME take if the supported TAs are to be updated?
q_31906.ground_truth: The MME overwrites the whole list of TAs, including those that are not to be updated

q_31907.question: What are the initial conditions for the FDD inter-frequency relative accuracy measurement of RSRP for 5MHz bandwidth with FGI bits 16 and 25?
q_31907.ground_truth: The initial conditions for the FDD inter-frequency relative accuracy measurement of RSRP for 5MHz bandwidth with FGI bits 16 and 25 are the same as those defined in clause 9.1.3.2.4.1 with the exception that the Channel Bandwidth to be tested is 5MHz.

q_31908.question: What does the "MBS Session Associated Information Non-Support-to-Support" IE provide in a 5G network?
q_31908.ground_truth: This IE provides the association between MBS QoS flows and unicast QoS flows, and is only applicable for deployments deriving the PDCP COUNT values by means of a DL MBS QFI Sequence Number provided on NG-U and requires the appropriate associated PDU Session and MBS session resources to be provided by the same logical gNB-CU-UP.

q_31909.question: What command is sent by the GGSN/P-GW to the Diameter server to terminate a DIAMETER session corresponding to an IP-CAN session of a certain user?

q_31910.question: What should the controlling MCPTT function include in the SIP 200 (OK) response to the inviting MCPTT client if the "on-network-action-upon-expiration-of-timeout-for-acknowledgement-of-required-members" element is set to "proceed" in the group document?
q_31910.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function should include a warning text "111 group call proceeded without all required group members" in a Warning header field.

q_31911.question: In what circumstance may the 5GC include the Emergency Services Support indicator during Registration procedures over 3GPP access?
q_31911.ground_truth: During Registration procedures over 3GPP access in a PLMN, the 5GC includes the Emergency Services Support indicator if the Network is able to support Emergency Services natively over 5GS, E-UTRA connected to 5GC supports IMS Emergency Services and specific conditions are met, among others.

q_31912.question: What is the responsibility of the speech de-jitter buffer in the MTSI MGW?
q_31912.ground_truth: The speech de-jitter buffer in the MTSI MGW is responsible for meeting the 10 milliseconds maximum jitter requirement in clause~6.7.2 of ITU-T Recommendation H.324.

q_31913.question: What should be included in the Handover Resource Allocation Unsuccessful Transfer IE in the HANDOVER REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message for each PDU session resource which failed to be set up?
q_31913.ground_truth: A precise cause value indicating the reason for the unsuccessful establishment.

q_31914.question: What indicator is provided by the serving SMF to the AMF when releasing the PDU session due to inactivity?

q_31915.question: What should the MCPTT client do when it receives a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message with the MCPTT group ID IE matching the stored MCPTT group ID of the call in the "S3: part of ongoing call" state?
q_31915.ground_truth: The MCPTT client can inform the MCPTT user about the call acceptance and remain in the "S3: part of ongoing call" state.

q_31916.question: How many DNS contexts can be created in the EASDF with the same UE IP address, S-NSSAI, DNN and H-PLMN ID in HR-SBO in VPLMN scenario?
q_31916.ground_truth: Only one DNS context can be created in the EASDF with the same UE IP address, S-NSSAI, DNN and H-PLMN ID in HR-SBO in VPLMN scenario.

q_31917.question: What is the content type supported for the HTTP bodies in the Nausf-UPUProtection service, as per section 6.3.2.2.2 of the document?
q_31917.ground_truth: JSON, as defined in IETF~RFC~8259, is supported as the content type for the HTTP bodies in the Nausf-UPUProtection service.

q_31918.question: How should an MCVideo server allocate TMGIs and activate MBMS bearers for MCVideo media plane transmissions?
q_31918.ground_truth: An MCVideo server acting in the participating MCVideo function role should allocate TMGIs and activate MBMS bearers in MBMS service areas as per 3GPP TS 23.468 and 29.468 when providing services over MBMS.

q_31919.question: What is the minimum number of successful tests required out of the total number of tests for the test to pass?
q_31919.ground_truth: The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90%.

q_31920.question: What should the MME do when it rejects the paging restriction in clause 5.6.1.4.1?
q_31920.ground_truth: The MME should include the EPS additional request result IE in the SERVICE ACCEPT message, set the Paging restriction decision to "paging restriction is rejected" and discard the received paging restriction, delete any stored paging restriction for the UE, and initiate the release of the NAS signalling connection after the completion of the service request procedure.

q_31921.question: What is the dependence between CSI parameters (CQI, PMI, RI, and CRI) when calculating LI?
q_31921.ground_truth: LI is calculated conditioned on the reported CQI, PMI, RI, and CRI.

q_31922.question: What type of node is described by the policy on local numbers?
q_31922.ground_truth: It is an interior node that occurs either zero or one time.

q_31923.question: What is the purpose of the Uplink power control window in the test case, as noted in the test description?
q_31923.ground_truth: The purpose of the Uplink power control window is to ensure that the actual UE output power is no less than the target power level, and as close as possible to the target power level. This relationship between the Uplink power control window, the target power level, and the corresponding possible actual UE Uplink power window is illustrated in Annex F.4.2.

q_31924.question: What is the action taken by the transferor UE when a NOTIFY request is received on the REFER dialog indicating that the transferee and the transfer Target have successfully setup a communication?
q_31924.ground_truth: The transferor UE may terminate the original communication with the transferee UE.

q_31925.question: What interfaces should be traced for Service Level Tracing in IMS?
q_31925.ground_truth: HSS: Sh and Cx interfaces, S-CSCF: ISC, Mw, Mg, Mr and Mi interfaces; P-CSCF: Gm and Go interfaces; I-CSCF: Mw and Cx interfaces; MRF: Mr interfaces; MGCF: Mg interfaces; BGCF: Mi interfaces.

q_31926.question: What should be checked if a Resource-Priority header field is included in the incoming SIP INVITE request?
q_31926.ground_truth: The MCVideo client may perform further actions outside the scope of this specification to act upon an included Resource-Priority header field.

q_31927.question: What is the procedure for ensuring that the correct PGK Identity, PTK Identity, and Counter are used for calculating PEK in the header of the PDCP packet when confidentiality protection is not used?
q_31927.ground_truth: The header of the PDCP packet for user plane data shall contain the 5 least significant bits of the PGK Identity, PTK Identity and Counter. This is specified in TS 33.303, clause 6.2.3.6.2.

q_31928.question: What is the role of the IAB-MT part in the integration procedure for NSA?
q_31928.ground_truth: The IAB-MT part connects to the LTE network as a UE in Phase 1-1 of the IAB integration procedure for NSA.

q_31929.question: What is the service operation used when the LMF starts one or more of the positioning procedures described in clauses 6.11.1, 6.11.2, and 6.11.3?
q_31929.ground_truth: The LMF performs one or more of the positioning procedures described in clauses 6.11.1, 6.11.2 and 6.11.3 when the LMF receives an identifier, the serving cell identity and a location request from an emergency services client.

q_31930.question: What is the time period used in the equation for defining the measurement period for inter RAT P-CCPCH RSCP measurements?
q_31930.ground_truth: The time period used in the equation for defining the measurement period for inter RAT P-CCPCH RSCP measurements is 50 ms.

q_31931.question: What is the purpose of interworking without N26 in EPS fallback for IMS voice?
q_31931.ground_truth: The interworking without N26 is used in EPS fallback for IMS voice to indicate that the network supports interworking without N26, which would allow the user equipment (UE) to communicate using IMS without using N26, a specific feature or interface in the network.

q_31932.question: Which attribute indicates the DNN of the allocated PDU session in a notification?

q_31933.question: What is the purpose of QoS parameters mapping functions?
q_31933.ground_truth: The main purpose of these mapping functions is the conversion of QoS parameters from one format to another. For PCC deployments not supporting MBS, QoS parameters mapping functions are located at the AF, PCF, SMF and UE and are used to convert QoS information from different formats into a standardized format.

q_31934.question: When does the UE initiate the transition from RRC Inactive to RRC Connected state in the UE triggered Connection Resume procedure?
q_31934.ground_truth: The UE initiates the transition from RRC Inactive to RRC Connected state in the UE triggered Connection Resume procedure when it sends a RRC message (Resume ID) to the NG-RAN.

q_31935.question: What are the conditions for a correct observed SCell activation delay and SCell deactivation delay during the SCell activation and deactivation test procedure?
q_31935.ground_truth: The observed SCell activation delay and SCell deactivation delay are counted as correct if they are fulfilled in order for the test and the rate of correct observations is at least 90% during repeated tests.

q_31936.question: What should be the modulation order for the UE in case ttiBundling is set to TRUE and the UE does not indicate support for operating without resource allocation restriction?
q_31936.ground_truth: The modulation order should be set to 2.

q_31937.question: What action does the W-AGF take when receiving a PDU session release request message from the AMF for the FN-RG?
q_31937.ground_truth: The W-AGF can trigger the release of the corresponding L-W-UP resource with procedure in scope of BBF/CableLabs.

q_31938.question: What is the measurement called that provides the average RLC SDU delay on the downlink within the gNB-DU, for initial transmission of all RLC packets?

q_31939.question: What should the MCVideo client do if it receives a SIP 4xx response, SIP 5xx response, or SIP 6xx response to the SIP re-INVITE request, with an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body that has an <emergency-ind> element set to "true"?
q_31939.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should set the MCVideo emergency private priority state as "MVEPP 2: in-progress".

q_31940.question: What are the actions taken by the IBCF when "header" level privacy is requested as specified in RFC 3323?
q_31940.ground_truth: The IBCF removes all received Via header fields and adds a single Via header field with its own URI, replaces the value of the URI of the Contact header field with a URI that does not dereference to the originator of the message, and removes any Record-Route header fields.

q_31941.question: What message is sent by the F1-terminating IAB-donor-CU to the non-F1-terminating IAB-donor-CU to modify the context of the dual-connecting IAB-node's offloaded traffic?
q_31941.ground_truth: The F1-terminating IAB-donor-CU sends an IAB TRANSPORT MIGRATION MANAGEMENT REQUEST message to the non-F1-terminating IAB-donor-CU to modify the context of the dual-connecting IAB-node's offloaded traffic. This message may include the DL TNL address information used for the offloaded traffic, reported by the boundary node in step 9.

q_31942.question: Which ITU-T Recommendation studies existing QoE requirements for 5G services?
q_31942.ground_truth: ITU-T GSTR-5GQoE provides a study of existing QoE requirements for 5G services.

q_31943.question: What is the purpose of the S-KgNB key derived in the NAS security key update procedure?
q_31943.ground_truth: The S-KgNB key is derived for use as a security key for the radio bearer in the NAS security key update procedure.

q_31944.question: What is the first step taken by the NWDAF to request analytics from the MDA Management Function?
q_31944.ground_truth: The NWDAF first discovers the MDA Management Function from the MnS discovery service producer by sending a MnS producer discovery service operation.

q_31945.question: What conditions must be met for a UE to send a URSP rule enforcement report to the network?
q_31945.ground_truth: A UE should send a URSP rule enforcement report to the network if the URSP rule includes URSP rule enforcement report indication and if it contains the connection capabilities in the traffic descriptor, and if the traffic descriptor of the URSP rule matches the application information of a newly detected application and associates the application with a new PDU Session or an existing PDU Session.

q_31946.question: What action should the MCVideo client take, when it receives a SIP MESSAGE request containing the ICSI value "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcvideo" and an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-affiliation-command+xml MIME body with a list of MCVideo groups for affiliation and de-affiliation?
q_31946.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should send a 200 (OK) response to the SIP MESSAGE request, seek confirmation of the list of MCVideo groups for affiliation and de-affiliation, and if the user accepts the request, perform affiliation or de-affiliation as specified in clause 8.2.1.5.

q_31947.question: What should the MGCF do when it receives a subsequent request for calls terminating in circuit-switched networks?
q_31947.ground_truth: The MGCF should store the value of the orig-ioi header field parameter received in the P-Charging-Vector header field, if present, insert a P-Charging-Vector header field containing the orig-ioi header field parameter, set the type 2 term-ioi header field parameter to a value that identifies the network in which the MGCF resides, and set the orig-ioi header field parameter and icid-value header field parameter based on the received values in the subsequent request.

q_31948.question: What message does the GGSN send to the SGSN after successfully activating a PDP context?

q_31949.question: What action should the NG-RAN node take if the NAS-PDU IE is included in the INITIAL CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message?
q_31949.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node should pass it transparently towards the UE.

q_31950.question: What should be taken as CSI-part 1 for rate matching in the fourth scenario?
q_31950.ground_truth: CSI part 1 should be taken as CSI part 2 for rate matching in the fourth scenario.

q_31951.question: What is the function of the Restart-Counter AVP in the MBMS heartbeat procedure?
q_31951.ground_truth: The Restart-Counter AVP is used to indicate the number of times a node has restarted in the MBMS heartbeat procedure.

q_31952.question: What is the role of the MME when interworking with 3GPP2 1xCS?
q_31952.ground_truth: The MME acts as a signalling tunnelling end point for 3GPP2 1xCS signalling messages and releases E-UTRAN resources after SRVCC to 3GPP2 1xCS is completed. It also includes information for 3GPP2 network to determine emergency sessions and inserts the equipment identifier during handover of an emergency session.

q_31953.question: What should the MCVideo client do if it receives a SIP 4xx response, SIP 5xx response or SIP 6xx response to a SIP request for a priority group call and the MCVideo emergency group call state is set to "MVEGC 2: emergency-call-requested" or "MVEGC 3: emergency-call-granted"?
q_31953.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should set the MCVideo emergency group call state to "MVEGC 1: emergency-gc-capable", set the MCVideo client emergency group state of the group to "MVEG 1: no-emergency" if the MCVideo client emergency group state of the group is "MVEG 3:

q_31954.question: What is the response from the SGW when it receives a Delete PDN Connection Set Request and is capable of storing at least one CSID value per PDN connection for the type of node?
q_31954.ground_truth: The SGW responds to the Delete PDN Connection Set Request independently with a "Request accepted" response.

q_31955.question: What action should the MS take if the network indicates a new GPRS GSM integrity algorithm to be taken into use, and no authentication is requested?
q_31955.ground_truth: The GPRS GSM Kint of the established UMTS security context in use still applies in the MS.

q_31956.question: What action does the SMF take if the Branching Point or UL CL and the PSA2 are co-located in a single UPF in step 5?
q_31956.ground_truth: Step 5 is not needed if the Branching Point or UL CL and the PSA2 are co-located in a single UPF in step 5.

q_31957.question: What are the options for UE transmission/reception for a physical channel/signal occurring in both SBFD and non-SBFD symbols within a slot?
q_31957.ground_truth: The options include the UE not transmitting or receiving the physical channel/signal within the slot, or the UE transmitting or receiving the physical channel/signal within the slot under certain conditions, which may depend on maintaining phase continuity, same or different transmission/reception parameters, and guard periods between symbols.

q_31958.question: In the context of the 5GS and IMS, what is one of the effects of not supporting priority sharing from the MC system in terms of the treatment that would apply?
q_31958.ground_truth: If the 5GS and IMS does not support priority sharing from the MC system, no shared priority treatment applies, and a new media flow would be set up based on the 5QI/ARP combination.

q_31959.question: What is the minimum requirement for the rate of correct observed SLSS transmission initiation and SLSS transmission cease delay during repeated tests with a confidence level of 95% for each of the events?
q_31959.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for the rate of correct observed SLSS transmission initiation and SLSS transmission cease delay during repeated tests with a confidence level of 95% for each of the events is 90%.

q_31960.question: What is the supported channel bandwidth in BCS0?
q_31960.ground_truth: The supported channel bandwidth in BCS0 is 5MHz, 10MHz, 15MHz, 20MHz, 25MHz, 30MHz, 40MHz, and 50MHz.

q_31961.question: What should a source GTP-C entity do when enforcing overload control for messages targeted for a remote GTP-C entity?
q_31961.ground_truth: A source GTP-C entity should enforce overload control for messages targeted for a remote GTP-C entity based on the overload information of the intermediate and target GTP-C entities, and should not further reject any message towards the source GTP-C entity.

q_31962.question: What is the requirement for enabling power saving for MT reachability in Cellular IoT using MICO mode?
q_31962.ground_truth: Three enhancements to MICO mode are specified in clause~5.31.7: MICO mode with Extended Connected Time, MICO mode with Active Time, and MICO mode and Periodic Registration Timer Control.

q_31963.question: What should the controlling MCPTT function do when the last MCPTT client leaves the MCPTT session?
q_31963.ground_truth: Upon the last MCPTT client leaving the MCPTT session, the controlling MCPTT function shall stop timer TNG3 and release the MCPTT session.

q_31964.question: What should the access stratum layer of the 3GPP access do upon receiving move-traffic-to-WLAN indication in TS 24.302, clause 6.10.4?
q_31964.ground_truth: The access stratum layer of the 3GPP access can provide a move-traffic-to-WLAN indication along with a list of WLAN identifiers, and the user preferences take precedence over the indications provided.

q_31965.question: What issue is discussed in the context of Key issue #18 concerning the Edge Enabler Layer (EEL)?
q_31965.ground_truth: The issue discussed is the impacts on the EEL's support functions created by EAS bundles or dependencies between EASs, with the focus being on coordination at the EEL rather than enabling communication between EASs.

q_31966.question: What should the UE do if a new EPS bearer identity parameter is received in the Authorized QoS flow descriptions IE for a QoS flow that can be transferred to EPS?
q_31966.ground_truth: The UE should update the association between the QoS flow and the mapped EPS bearer context, based on the new EPS bearer identity and the mapped EPS bearer contexts. If the "Delete existing EPS bearer" operation code in the Mapped EPS bearer contexts IE was received, the UE should discard the association between the QoS flow and the corresponding mapped EPS bearer context and delete the corresponding mapped EPS bearer context.

q_31967.question: In the process of inter-system handover from 5GS to EPS with the source node used as the target secondary node, what is the purpose of Step 2?
q_31967.ground_truth: In Step 2, the target gNB infers from the received message that direct data forwarding can be performed in a node-internal way.

q_31968.question: What should the AMF do if there is an S-NSSAI associated with a slice deregistration inactivity timer?
q_31968.ground_truth: The AMF should include the S-NSSAI(s) in the partially rejected NSSAI to the UE.

q_31969.question: What is the method to ensure the integrity and confidentiality protection of ranging result on Uu interface when using Application exposure API?
q_31969.ground_truth: The UP security policies provided to the RAN by the 5GC (e.g. SMF) during PDU session establishment procedure should be set to "REQUIRED" for integrity protection and confidentiality protection when establishing a PDU session for the Ranging/SL Positioning service exposed to SL Positioning Client UE.

q_31970.question: What is the maximum time taken for SSB post-processing?
q_31970.ground_truth: Tmargin is the time for SSB post-processing and can be up to 2ms.

q_31971.question: What are the challenges in positioning requirements for DFF and IFF systems supporting the FR2-1 frequency range and devices up to a 40~cm diameter?
q_31971.ground_truth: Positioning requirements for DFF and IFF systems supporting FR2-1 frequency range and devices up to a 40~cm diameter yield a very high positioning complexity. This complexity can lead to significant increases in measurement uncertainties (MUs) and test tolerances (TTs) due to system complexities and delays in commercial adoption of test cases.

q_31972.question: What is one example of data collection for a NW-side AI/ML model?
q_31972.ground_truth: M1 L1-RSRPs (corresponding to M1 beams) with the indication of beams based on the measurement corresponding to a beam set.

q_31973.question: What should the UAS NF/NEF do if the USS has indicated that the network resources can be released during re-authentication and UUAA-MM has failed?
q_31973.ground_truth: The UAS NF/NEF may trigger the release of relevant PDU sessions associated with aerial services.

q_31974.question: What is the main difference between DUIK, DUSK, and DUCK in the context of 3GPP TS 33.303?
q_31974.ground_truth: DUIK, DUSK, and DUCK are security mechanisms used in 3GPP TS 33.303 for integrated security of IP-based services in 3GPP systems. DUIK is used for key generation, DUSK is used for unscrambling, and DUCK is used for encryption.

q_31975.question: What is the maximum allowed difference in RSRP between two cells in this test?
q_31975.ground_truth: The maximum allowed difference in RSRP between two cells (Cell 1 and Cell 2) is 27 dB.

q_31976.question: What should the SS do if it receives ACK for the hibernation MAC-CE sent by the UE during SCell hibernation?
q_31976.ground_truth: If the SS receives ACK for the hibernation MAC-CE sent by the UE during SCell hibernation, T4 starts in the same subframe.

q_31977.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification in the context of "Access to the 3GPP 5G Core Network (5GCN) via Non-3GPP Access Networks (N3AN)"?
q_31977.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification outlines the procedures for non-3GPP access network discovery and selection, access authorization for non-3GPP access networks, and security association management for establishing IKEv2 and IPsec security associations between the UE, N3IWF, and TNGF over non-3GPP access networks.

q_31978.question: What is the impact of setting the MCPTT emergency state and the in-progress emergency group state on MCPTT clients and MCPTT group calls?
q_31978.ground_truth: The MCPTT emergency state and the in-progress emergency group state determine the priority and authorization level of MCPTT users and MCPTT group calls. The MCPTT emergency state indicates a life-threatening situation and the in-progress emergency group state indicates that there is an ongoing MCPTT emergency group call on the specified group.

q_31979.question: What should the SCC AS set the Request-URI to in the SIP re-INVITE request when populating it?
q_31979.ground_truth: The Request-URI should be set to the URI contained in the Contact header field returned at the creation of the dialog with the remote UE.

q_31980.question: What message contains RRC messages used to carry the S-TMSI and this NAS message in eNodeB towards MME?
q_31980.ground_truth: S1-AP: Initial UE Message (NAS message, TAI+ECGI of the serving cell, S-TMSI, CSG ID, CSG access Mode) is used to contain RRC messages used to carry the S-TMSI and this NAS message in eNodeB towards MME.

q_31981.question: What type of data does the MC service server send over the unicast PDU session?
q_31981.ground_truth: The MC service server sends the MC data and any necessary application layer signalling over the unicast PDU session.

q_31982.question: What must the network do for the UE to associate applications to S-NSSAIs in the non-roaming case?
q_31982.ground_truth: In the non-roaming case, the network should not provide any mapped S-NSSAI to the UE with the Allowed NSSAI.

q_31983.question: When is the Length (L) field present in the MAC PDU header?
q_31983.ground_truth: There is one L field per MAC PDU sub header except for the last sub header and sub-headers corresponding to fixed-sized MAC control elements.

q_31984.question: What is the significance of the "shall set the Conversation ID IE" in both SDS and FD signalling payload messages?
q_31984.ground_truth: It sets the Conversation ID value to a newly generated value or the Conversation ID value of the existing conversation for SDS messages, and to a newly generated Conversation ID value for FD messages.

q_31985.question: What is returned when the LocationUpdate service operation is successful?

q_31986.question: What is the OTA receiver spurious emissions requirement for an OTA AAS BS operating in FDD?
q_31986.ground_truth: For an OTA AAS BS operating in FDD, the OTA receiver spurious emissions requirement does not apply. It is superseded by the OTA TX spurious emissions requirement due to the fact that TX and RX spurious emissions cannot be distinguished in the OTA domain.

q_31987.question: What is the required information for a POST request for I-SMF Insertion, Change or Removal during Xn based handover?
q_31987.ground_truth: N2 SM information received from the target 5G-AN, N2 SM information received from the source 5G-AN (if any), smContextRef, and smfUri (with optional NF instance identifier of the SMF).

q_31988.question: What should be the rate of correct RRC re-establishments observed during repeated tests for this NR SA FR1 RRC re-establishment test case?
q_31988.ground_truth: The rate of correct RRC re-establishments observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90%.

q_31989.question: What is the excluded frequency range for a TDD Base Station operating in BC3 under specific circumstances, regarding another TDD system without synchronization?
q_31989.ground_truth: The excluded frequency range for a TDD Base Station operating in BC3 under specific circumstances, regarding another TDD system without synchronization, is the frequency range from 10 MHz below the lower Base Station RF Bandwidth edge to the frequency 10 MHz above the upper Base Station RF Bandwidth edge of each supported band. NOTE 1 states that local or regional regulations may specify another excluded frequency range, which may include frequencies where synchronised TDD systems operate. NOTE 2 states that TDD Base Stations that are synchronized and operating in BC3 can transmit without these additional co-existence requirements.

q_31990.question: What is the expected result of correctly implementing trust anchoring in the SEPP for N32-c connection setup?
q_31990.ground_truth: The expected result is that the SEPP under test correctly implements trust anchoring when setting up HTTPS (TLS) connections, ensuring the secure authentication and verification of the remote SEPP and the integrity of the communication.

q_31991.question: What is the role of the TNAP in the non-full authentication procedure for UE mobility?
q_31991.ground_truth: The TNAP acts as the EAP authenticator, forwarding EAP messages between the UE and the TNGF.

q_31992.question: What should the UE set the 5G ProSe-l2relay bit to in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message if it supports acting as a 5G ProSe layer-2 UE-to-network relay UE?
q_31992.ground_truth: If the UE supports acting as a 5G ProSe layer-2 UE-to-network relay UE, the UE should set the 5G ProSe-l2relay bit to "Acting as a 5G ProSe layer-2 UE-to-network relay UE supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

q_31993.question: In what mode is a cause #25 service request rejection received and applied?
q_31993.ground_truth: A cause #25 service request rejection (Not authorized for this CSG) is received in UTRAN Iu mode and applied when received from a CSG cell. This case is not applicable in other cases or if received from a non-CSG cell.

q_31994.question: What is the function of the Multi-Session Context Key (MSCCK) when establishing signalling security when using MBMS?
q_31994.ground_truth: The Multi-Session Context Key (MSCCK) is used to protect MBMS subchannel control messages on the general purpose MBMS subchannels for signalling security when using MBMS.

q_31995.question: In which scenario is the id-PosMeasurementPeriodicityNR-AoA information element used in the protocol?
q_31995.ground_truth: The id-PosMeasurementPeriodicityNR-AoA information element is used when the E-CID-ReportCharacteristics IE is set to "periodic" and the E-CID-MeasurementQuantities-Item IE in the E-CID-MeasurementQuantities IE is set to the value "angleOfArrivalNR".

q_31996.question: What is the maximum number of LTM candidate UL TCI states is 64?
q_31996.ground_truth: The maximum number of LTM UL TCI states is 64.

q_31997.question: What is the only mandatory eNBDirectInformationTransferIEs S1AP-PROTOCOL-IES?

q_31998.question: What is the scenario where the End UE is discoverable by actively sending announcement messages?

q_31999.question: What is the method of test for conducted spurious emissions while the transmitter is in operation?
q_31999.ground_truth: The method of test involves measuring conducted spurious emissions while the transmitter is in operation. The test measures the output of the transmitter while it is actively transmitting signals.

q_32000.question: What should the UE do if it receives a Routing Area Update Request message in connected mode when initiating a S1 mode to Iu mode inter-system change?
q_32000.ground_truth: The UE should derive CK' and IK' from KASME and the NAS downlink COUNT value indicated by lower layers, and include the eKSI value in the CKSN field of the GPRS ciphering key sequence number IE in the ROUTING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message. The UE should also reset the START value and store the mapped UMTS security context, replacing the established UMTS security context.

q_32001.question: What should the target UE do to check the integrity of the PROSE DIRECT LINK SECURITY MODE COMMAND message using NRPIK and the selected integrity protection algorithm?
q_32001.ground_truth: The target UE should ask the lower layers to check the integrity of the PROSE DIRECT LINK SECURITY MODE COMMAND message.

q_32002.question: What should the UE do if it cannot re-activate the EPS bearer(s) automatically and the rejected request was not for initiating a PDN connection for emergency bearer services?
q_32002.ground_truth: The UE should perform a new attach procedure.

q_32003.question: What action will the MME take if a UE with emergency EPS bearers cannot access the cell due to CSG access restrictions?
q_32003.ground_truth: The MME will deactivate all non-emergency bearers and accept the Service Request.

q_32004.question: What is the role of user preferences in the RAN rules controlling the WLAN access selection and traffic routing?
q_32004.ground_truth: User preferences take precedence over the indications provided by the access stratum layer of the 3GPP access in both handover scenarios: from 3GPP access to WLAN, and from WLAN to 3GPP access.

q_32005.question: What information does the gNB-CU-UP send to the gNB-CU-CP in the BEARER CONTEXT INACTIVITY NOTIFICATION message during the successful operation of the Bearer Context Inactivity Notification procedure?
q_32005.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-UP sends the DRB Activity List IE, PDU Session Resource Activity List IE, or UE Activity IE in the BEARER CONTEXT INACTIVITY NOTIFICATION message.

q_32006.question: What is the condition for the entering event A3 in the 3GPP TS 36.331 standard?
q_32006.ground_truth: The entering event A3 is considered to be satisfied when the condition A3-1 is fulfilled, which is expressed as the inequality Mn - Ofn - Ocn <= Mp - Ofp - Ocp + Hys + Off, where Mn is the measurement result of the neighboring cell, Ofn and Ocn are the frequency specific and cell specific offsets of the neighbor cell, Mp is the measurement result of the PCell/PSCell, Ofp and Ocp are the frequency specific and cell specific offsets of the PCell/PSCell, Hys is the hysteresis parameter for this event, and Off is the offset parameter for this event.

q_32007.question: How does the eNodeB send uplink data to the Serving GW after a connection suspend procedure?
q_32007.ground_truth: The eNodeB sends the uplink data to the Serving GW address and TEID stored during the Connection Suspend procedure.

q_32008.question: What protocol is used for the S2a interface in 3GPP accesses?
q_32008.ground_truth: The S2a interface for 3GPP accesses is based on Proxy Mobile IP version 6.

q_32009.question: What is one of the alternatives available for forwarding the network timing synchronization status notification to the UE in step 6 of the UE provisioning network timing synchronization status procedure?
q_32009.ground_truth: RRC signalling, where the AMF sends a N2 message to forward the UE's report from the AMF to the NG-RAN node, and the serving NG-RAN node forwards the network timing synchronization status to the UE using RRC signalling.

q_32010.question: What should the UE include in the SERVICE REQUEST, CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST, or REGISTRATION REQUEST message when responding to a notification with an indication for a non-3GPP access type?
q_32010.ground_truth: The UE should include the Allowed PDU session status IE in the message and indicate for each PDU session that re-establishment of user-plane resources via 3GPP access is not allowed.

q_32011.question: What should the initiating UE do upon receipt of the DIRECT LINK IDENTIFIER UPDATE ACCEPT message?
q_32011.ground_truth: Upon receipt of the DIRECT LINK IDENTIFIER UPDATE ACCEPT message, the initiating UE shall stop timer T5009 and respond with a DIRECT LINK IDENTIFIER UPDATE ACK message. Then, the initiating UE shall update the associated PC5 unicast link context with the new identifiers, pass the new layer-2 IDs along with the PC5 link identifier down to the lower layer, and use the new layer-2 IDs to transmit PC5 signalling messages and user plane data.

q_32012.question: What action should an MCVideo client take upon receiving an indication in a state with no specified handling?
q_32012.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should ignore the indication.

q_32013.question: What procedure is used by the UE to resume the ECM-connection if both the UE and network support User Plane CIoT EPS Optimisation?

q_32014.question: What is the role of the 'eutra-NumCRS-Ports-r14' field in the OTDOA-ReferenceCellInfoNB-r14?
q_32014.ground_truth: The 'eutra-NumCRS-Ports-r14' field in the OTDOA-ReferenceCellInfoNB-r14 represents the number of NPRS port measurements in the cell.

q_32015.question: How many physical resource blocks can be assigned to a type-1 hopping user in a single slot?
q_32015.ground_truth: The number of contiguous RBs that can be assigned to a type-1 hopping user in a single slot is limited to 6.

q_32016.question: What should the UE do if it receives a SystemInformationBlockType16 with timeReferenceInfo?
q_32016.ground_truth: The UE may perform the related actions as specified in clause 5.6.1.3 upon receiving SystemInformationBlockType16 with timeReferenceInfo.

q_32017.question: What should the UE do first when it receives the RRCConnectionReestablishment message in idle mode?
q_32017.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T301 and consider the current cell to be the PCell.

q_32018.question: What is the SNPN that the UE was last registered with, if available, or the equivalent SNPN, if available, used for if validity information is met?
q_32018.ground_truth: It is used as the first option for registration if available.

q_32019.question: How many PDU sessions for Emergency services can a UE have at a time?
q_32019.ground_truth: A UE may have only one PDU session for Emergency services at a time.

q_32020.question: What actions should the transmission participant interface perform when a session remains ongoing and an MCVideo client leaves the MCVideo call?
q_32020.ground_truth: The transmission participant interface should stop sending transmission control messages and RTP media packets to the MCVideo client leaving the MCVideo call and discard packets received from that client.

q_32021.question: What is an MBS Policy Association Establishment?
q_32021.ground_truth: MBS Policy Association Establishment is a procedure where an NF service consumer requests the creation of an MBS Policy Association at the PCF and the provisioning of MBS policies for a multicast or a broadcast MBS session.

q_32022.question: What is the role of the RAN in the AN release procedure in 5GS?
q_32022.ground_truth: The RAN may send an N2 UE Context Release Request message to the AMF during the AN release procedure in 5GS. Upon receiving the (R)AN connection release confirmation from the UE, the (R)AN deletes the UE's context. The RAN also confirms the N2 Release by returning an N2 UE Context Release Complete message to the AMF, which includes the list of PDU Session ID(s) with active N3 user plane, user location information, and age of location information.

q_32023.question: What is required for the controlling MCPTT function to allow an MCPTT user to join a prearranged group session?
q_32023.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function must check if the group document contains an <entry> element for the MCPTT user, if there is a <rule> in the group document with the <is-list-member> element of the <conditions> present and with the <join-handling> element of the corresponding <actions> element set to "true", if the <supported-services> element is present and contains the "MCPTT speech" group-media element, and if the <on-network-invite-members> element is not present or set to "true".

q_32024.question: What is the purpose of the AS registration procedure between the AS and the PEMC or PIN Server?
q_32024.ground_truth: The purpose of the AS registration procedure is to enable the AS to provide AS connectivity information to the PEMC or the PIN Server.

q_32025.question: What should the initiating UE do when the need to use a PC5 unicast link no longer exists before the PC5 unicast link security mode control procedure is completed?
q_32025.ground_truth: The initiating UE shall abort the procedure, shall provide an indication to the lower layer of deactivation of the PC5 unicast security protection and deletion of security context for the PC5 unicast link, if applicable, and shall abort the ongoing procedure that triggered the initiation of the PC5 unicast link security mode control procedure.

q_32026.question: What type of field is used to copy the CAMEL Information PDP IE in the SGSN's CDR?
q_32026.ground_truth: The CAMEL Charging Information Container field is represented as Octet String type.

q_32027.question: What is the SBI service used for AM-PCF notification in KI#1?
q_32027.ground_truth: The SBI service used for AM-PCF notification in KI#1 will be determined during the normative phase.

q_32028.question: What is the role of the N3IWF Relocation Command in the 5G registration procedure?
q_32028.ground_truth: The N3IWF Relocation Command is used to establish a NAS security context for the UE and protect further NAS messages. It is sent from the AMF to N3IWF-1 to trigger N3IWF relocation.

q_32029.question: How should the emission power be measured for multi-band TAB connector or TAB connector operating in non-contiguous spectrum?
q_32029.ground_truth: The emission within the Inter RF Bandwidth or sub-block gap should be measured using the specified measurement bandwidth from the closest Base Station RF Bandwidth or sub block edge.

q_32030.question: What should an eNB send to a peer en-gNB to activate one or more cells?
q_32030.ground_truth: An eNB initiates the EN-DC Cell Activation procedure by sending an EN-DC CELL ACTIVATION REQUEST message to a peer en-gNB, requesting for the cells to be activated.

q_32031.question: What is the notation used to represent a composite aggregation association relationship in a model?
q_32031.ground_truth: A composite aggregation association relationship is represented in a model using a filled diamond attached to the end of the relationship, with the diamond attached to the class that is the composite.

q_32032.question: What should be returned in the Location header when the case is redirection in IMS Profile Data retrieval?
q_32032.ground_truth: A Location header with an URI pointing to the endpoint of another HSS (service) instance.

q_32033.question: What is the process of notifying the UE location to the GMLC in the enhanced positioning architecture?
q_32033.ground_truth: The LMF notifies the UE location to the GMLC directly, i.e. without going through the serving AMF in the enhanced positioning architecture.

q_32034.question: What is the result of attempting to destroy a Server Certificate resource that has been reserved but never uploaded in a 5GMS system?
q_32034.ground_truth: In this case, the 5GMSd AF should release any resources associated with the reservation and return a 200 (OK) HTTP response.

q_32035.question: How is the sending sensitivity calculated for a hands-free terminal?
q_32035.ground_truth: The sending sensitivity for a hands-free terminal is calculated by referring the averaged measured level at the electrical reference point for each frequency band to the averaged test signal level measured in each frequency band at the MRP.

q_32036.question: What is the result of the UE requested bearer resource modification procedure if the default PDN connection is not established during the Initial Attach procedure?
q_32036.ground_truth: The aforementioned procedure happens during the first request for PDN connectivity.

q_32037.question: What is the benefit of using the "General context holding time" in the ACR launching procedure?
q_32037.ground_truth: The benefit of using the "General context holding time" in the ACR launching procedure is that it allows the EEC to make an ACR request before it reaches the respective T-EAS service area when it is predicted or planned to move to the T-EAS service area within the time indicated by the IE.

q_32038.question: What should the transmission control interface do upon receiving RTP media packets when the reception control arbitration logic has permitted the transmission participant to receive a media?
q_32038.ground_truth: The transmission control interface shall request the network media interface in the MCVideo server to forward RTP media packets to the media distributor, discard the RTP media packets if the received packet SSRC is not in the Active SSRC list, and remain in the 'U: permitted to receive' state.

q_32039.question: What should be repeated for the ports terminated in a BS capable of NB-IoT in-band or guard band operation?
q_32039.ground_truth: The throughput measurement should be repeated for the terminated ports.

q_32040.question: What is the function of the Target UE in Case I of Vetting functionality in UE-only operation?
q_32040.ground_truth: In Case I, the Target UE interacts directly with SL Positioning Client UEs, vets any incoming location requests, and selects and interacts with the SL Positioning Server UE if necessary.

q_32041.question: What is one aspect to consider when implementing AI/ML based positioning in normative work?
q_32041.ground_truth: Model input design aspects, such as the type and dimension of input, and the format of timing information.

q_32042.question: What should the participating MCData function do if it receives a SIP MESSAGE request for absolute URI discovery request for participating MCData function, but the public user identity is not associated with an MCData ID or the validity period has expired?
q_32042.ground_truth: The participating MCData function shall reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 404 (Not Found) response with the warning text set to "141 user unknown to the participating function".

q_32043.question: What is the purpose of the ion information container in the Registration Request message?
q_32043.ground_truth: The ion information container in the Registration Request message is used to indicate whether the UE wants to join, leave, or remain joined in one or more multicast MBS sessions associated with the PDU Session, allowing for multicast MBS session join/leave during the registration procedure.

q_32044.question: What is the purpose of the solution #35 "Provision of conditional QoS profile(s)"?
q_32044.ground_truth: The purpose of the solution #35 is to provide one or more conditional QoS profile(s) to NG-RAN for a specific QoS Flow, in addition to the QoS Profile of the QoS Flow. Each conditional QoS profile includes the QoS parameters and an event to active the conditional QoS profile. NG-RAN actives the corresponding conditional QoS profile when the event is detected and deactivates the current used QoS profile.

q_32045.question: What is the requirement for T2 during SCell activation in this test?
q_32045.ground_truth: During T2, the UE shall start sending CSI report for the SCell with non-zero CQI index on the PUCCH SCell no later than subframe (m+58), and if there are no uplink resources, then use the next available uplink resource. Interruption of PCell during the SCell activation shall not occur outside the range of (m+5) to (m+9) subframes.

q_32046.question: What is the frequency range for sidelink communication in LTE?
q_32046.ground_truth: Sidelink communication in LTE typically occurs at 700 MHz, 800 MHz, 1.4 GHz, 1.8 GHz, 1.9 GHz, 2.1 GHz, 2.3 GHz, 2.6 GHz, and 3.5 GHz.

q_32047.question: What should the UE include in the Service Request message or Registration Request message if it intends to leave the CM-CONNECTED state or CM-IDLE state and become unavailable?
q_32047.ground_truth: The UE should include the Release Request indication, the Paging Restriction Information, and the Expected Leaving Duration in the Service Request message or Registration Request message.

q_32048.question: Which procedure codes have the "MTCommunicationHandlingRequest" as the initiating message?

q_32049.question: What is the meaning of the '1' value of the "Monitoring State" field?
q_32049.ground_truth: The '1' value of the "Monitoring State" field indicates that monitoring is active.

q_32050.question: What is the difference between SGW-CDR and PGW-CDR containers?
q_32050.ground_truth: SGW-CDR containers are for each QCI/ARP pair, while PGW-CDR containers are for charging per IP-CAN session when IP-CAN bearer charging is being performed for the session.

q_32051.question: In step 1) of the first procedure, when must the participating MCData function or the controlling MCData function consider the MCData emergency group communication request to be an authorized request for an MCData emergency group communication?
q_32051.ground_truth: If the "entry-info" attribute is set to "UseCurrentlySelectedGroup" and the "allow-MCData-emergency-call" element is set to "true", then it is considered an authorized request.

q_32052.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 8.5.2.2.2.4 of the document?
q_32052.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the inter-RAT SS-RSRQ measurement accuracy is within the specified limits for all bands, when the serving cell is E-UTRA and the target cell is NR FR2.

q_32053.question: When must the UE initiate the UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure with the same PDU session ID over non-3GPP access?
q_32053.ground_truth: The UE must initiate the UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure with the same PDU session ID over non-3GPP access when it has successfully established user plane resources on 3GPP access for the MA PDU session and receives the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message including the ATSSS container IE.

q_32054.question: What is the meaning of "should" and "should not" in the context of the present document?
q_32054.ground_truth: "Should" indicates a recommendation to do something, and "should not" indicates a recommendation not to do something.

q_32055.question: What should the 5G ProSe Remote UE do if it receives a Direct Connection Reject from the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay due to CP-PRUK ID not found?
q_32055.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe Remote UE should not attempt to reconnect with the same CP-PRUK ID and may try to connect with the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay using its SUCI instead.

q_32056.question: When must the UE use the received ngKSI to identify the EPS security context in NAS SMC?
q_32056.ground_truth: The UE must use the received ngKSI to identify the EPS security context in NAS SMC when the type value in the received ngKSI indicates a mapped security context. This allows the UE to derive the mapped 5G security context and verify the integrity protection of NAS SMC.

q_32057.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for the SLSS transmission cease delay in the test for eNB as a timing reference?
q_32057.ground_truth: The SLSS transmission cease delay shall be less than 0.56 seconds.

q_32058.question: What is the role of the PCF in generating policy rules for MBS Session?
q_32058.ground_truth: The PCF generates policy rules for MBS Session based on the received service requirement and provides the policy rules to the MB-SMF.

q_32059.question: What should a UE do if it receives the Always-on PDU session indication IE with the value set to "Always-on PDU session required" in a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message?
q_32059.ground_truth: The UE shall consider the established PDU session as an always-on PDU session.

q_32060.question: What is the duration of the channel occupancy measurement period when no DRX is used and Nfreq carrier frequencies are indicated by higher layers?
q_32060.ground_truth: The channel occupancy measurement period corresponds to max(reportInterval, rmtc-Period*Nfreq) in this case.

q_32061.question: What should the participating MCVideo function do before transmitting on an MBMS bearer?
q_32061.ground_truth: Before transmitting on an MBMS bearer, the participating MCVideo function must generate MSCCKs and MuSiKs with corresponding MSCCK-IDs and MuSiK-IDs and distribute the keying material to MCVideo clients using the keying material received from the key management server for security protection.

q_32062.question: What is the purpose of the token provided by UE1 for future DNS query messages to be authorized directly at the UE-to-UE Relay using this token?
q_32062.ground_truth: The token provided by UE1 can be used for future DNS query messages to be authorized directly at the UE-to-UE Relay using this token. This allows UE1 to authorize IP disclosure without requiring additional PC5-S IP Discovery Authorization Request/Accept messages.

q_32063.question: What is the UE's action upon receiving an ATTACH REJECT message with the reject cause set to "Illegal ME" (TS 24.301, clause 5.5.1.2.5)?
q_32063.ground_truth: The UE shall set the EPS update status to EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED and delete any GUTI, last visited registered TAI, and KSI. Additionally, the UE shall consider the USIM as invalid for EPS services and non-EPS services until switching off or the UICC containing the USIM is removed, and enter state EMM-DEREGISTERED.

q_32064.question: What are the three types of EMM procedures that can be distinguished based on how they can be initiated?
q_32064.ground_truth: The three types of EMM procedures that can be distinguished based on how they can be initiated are EMM common procedures, EMM specific procedures, and EMM connection management procedures.

q_32065.question: What approach is not applied for the case when E-UTRA transmission overlaps in time with NR?
q_32065.ground_truth: LTE anchor agnostic approach is not applied for this case.

q_32066.question: What should a UE do if it does not receive new LADN information within an implementation-dependent time?
q_32066.ground_truth: The UE can initiate a registration procedure for mobility or periodic registration update to request the information.

q_32067.question: What is the initial state of the User Equipment (UE) for test cases in subclause 6.4.1.2 and 6.4.1.2A?
q_32067.ground_truth: The UE is in Generic RB established (State 3) for both test cases.

q_32068.question: For CSI-RS based intra-frequency measurements, what is not required for intra-frequency CSI-RS resources measurements?
q_32068.ground_truth: A measurement gap is not needed for intra-frequency CSI-RS resources measurements.

q_32069.question: What should the MCData client do if it receives an emergency alert cancellation request but it is not authorized to cancel the alert?
q_32069.ground_truth: The MCData client should indicate this to the requesting MCData user and terminate the procedure.

q_32070.question: What is the requirement for the minimum difference between the wideband CQI indices of PCell and SCell reported for CA with 2 DL CC under AWGN conditions?
q_32070.ground_truth: The minimum difference between the wideband CQI indices of PCell and SCell reported for CA with 2 DL CC under AWGN conditions is 2.

q_32071.question: What is the method used by PCF to control and manage the group data rate for 5G VN groups?
q_32071.ground_truth: The PCF uses the same procedures as the ones defined for network slice related data rate policy control, but with differences in data rate calculation and handling of related parameters.

q_32072.question: What is the purpose of the NSCOF in the overall network slicing orchestration framework?
q_32072.ground_truth: NSCOF is an integral part of the Network Slice Orchestrator, facilitating the automated certificate management for slices, especially when third parties are involved. It orchestrates the communication in the interfaces between the different entities involved in Network Slicing certificate management.

q_32073.question: In what circumstance will the ME delete the GSM Kc128 in the ME when updating is disabled?
q_32073.ground_truth: If a USIM is in use and the ME supports any A5 ciphering algorithm that requires a 128-bit ciphering key.

q_32074.question: What should the UE do before reporting the application identity in a PDU Session Establishment request or NAS Authentication Message?
q_32074.ground_truth: The UE should first obtain user consent before reporting the application identity in a PDU Session Establishment request or NAS Authentication Message.

q_32075.question: When does the UE generate HARQ-ACK information with ACK value in response to a detection of a DCI format that does not trigger a Type-3 HARQ-ACK codebook report?
q_32075.ground_truth: When the DCI format has associated HARQ-ACK information without scheduling a PDSCH reception.

q_32076.question: What is the interruption time for normal handover in E-UTRAN TDD to TDD intra-frequency handover, Tinterrupt = Tsearch + TIU + 20 ms, if the target cell is known and TIU = 20 ms?

q_32077.question: What is one post-condition after the user has accessed the company's intranet through the fixed IP VPN in this use case?
q_32077.ground_truth: One post-condition is that the user can access the intranet through the VPN server and can also access the devices within the 5G LAN.

q_32078.question: What entity provides the PDU set handling capability in the 5G system?
q_32078.ground_truth: The RAN node provides the PDU set handling capability in the 5G system.

q_32079.question: What action should a participating MCPTT function take when sending SIP 200 (OK) responses and the incoming SIP 200 (OK) response contained an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body?
q_32079.ground_truth: It shall copy the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body to the outgoing SIP 200 (OK) response.

q_32080.question: How many local emergency numbers can the UE store if it receives the Local Emergency Numbers List while it is in A/Gb or Iu mode and is in EMM-REGISTERED and EMM-IDLE mode?
q_32080.ground_truth: The UE is able to store up to ten local emergency numbers received from the network.

q_32081.question: What is the purpose of the Dropped DL Traffic Threshold IE type in the Downlink Traffic Measurement?
q_32081.ground_truth: The Dropped DL Traffic Threshold IE type in the Downlink Traffic Measurement indicates the dropped DL traffic volume thresholds to be monitored by the UP function.

q_32082.question: What should be done if the "/<x>/<x>/Common/MCData/AllowedFD" leaf node present in the group document of the requested MCData group is set to "false"?
q_32082.ground_truth: The MCData client should reject the request for file distribution and not continue with the rest of the steps in this clause.

q_32083.question: What is the role of the TSCTSF when time synchronization error budget is provided by the AF and the targeted UE is part of a PTP instance in 5GS?
q_32083.ground_truth: The TSCTSF determines an Uu time synchronization error budget for corresponding SUPIs that are part of the PTP instance.

q_32084.question: What happens in step 18 of the described process?
q_32084.ground_truth: In step 18, the PS relocation/handover is completed, including sending Relocation Complete/Handover Complete messages, updating the bearer with S-GW/P-GW/GGSN, sending Delete Session Request, and releasing resources related to the UE.

q_32085.question: What are the guidelines for sample-based time scaling when using an MTSI JBM?
q_32085.ground_truth: The guidelines for sample-based time scaling in an MTSI JBM include using high-quality time scaling algorithms, applying time scaling as infrequently as possible, keeping scaling amounts low, avoiding oscillating behavior, and minimizing artifacts resulting from time scaling.

q_32086.question: What should the UE set the ESI bit to in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message if it supports equivalent SNPNs?
q_32086.ground_truth: If the UE supports equivalent SNPNs, it should set the ESI bit to "equivalent SNPNs supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

q_32087.question: In which situations is the user plane location capability included in the MO-LR request message?
q_32087.ground_truth: The user plane location capability is included in the MO-LR request message when UE is using user plane for positioning or when Option 2 for capability awareness is selected.

q_32088.question: How is communication managed within the "game night" PIN?
q_32088.ground_truth: Tom's 5G home access router monitors and controls the communication of devices within the "game night" PIN, based on the policy from M, and may coordinate with M for network management, such as interference management. Also, devices within the PIN communicate with each other using direct device communication with the 26Ghz spectrum, while Howard's console communicates with others' consoles and the local game server via the connection to Tom's 5G Home access router using WLAN.

q_32089.question: What event detected by the IRI-POI present in the PTC server will result in the generation of a PTCFloorControl record in an xIRI?
q_32089.ground_truth: The IRI-POI present in the PTC server will generate a PTCFloorControl record in an xIRI when it detects the PTC target requesting floor control, when floor control is granted to the PTC target, when a floor control request from the PTC target is rejected/released, when the floor becomes open (e.g. idle), when the floor control request from the PTC target is queued, when the floor control request from the PTC target is dequeued, or when the floor control request is revoked.

q_32090.question: What is the purpose of network-assisted interference cancellation/suppression (NAICS) in LTE networks?
q_32090.ground_truth: NAICS allows a UE to mitigate interference from aggressor cells, enabling better reception of PDSCH from its serving cell during communication.

q_32091.question: In what cases will the AMF unsuccessfully attempt to forward the user data container and the PDU session ID?
q_32091.ground_truth: The AMF may unsuccessfully attempt to forward the user data container and the PDU session ID if the Payload container type is set to "CIoT user data container" and the AMF does not have a PDU session routing context for the PDU session ID and the UE.

q_32092.question: What is the overall delays measured in the test case?
q_32092.ground_truth: The overall delays measured shall be less than a total of 8002 ms in this test case, which is 8 s for measurement reporting delay plus 2 ms for TTI insertion uncertainty.

q_32093.question: In the context of updating a VNF, what does the network operator modify in the new NSD?
q_32093.ground_truth: The network operator modifies the new NSD to refer to the VNFD of the updated VNF.

q_32094.question: Which MIME body is required to be included in the outgoing SIP INVITE request if the received SIP INVITE request contains an authorised request for an MCVideo emergency private call, in order for the network to determine the called party and continue with the rest of the steps?
q_32094.ground_truth: An application/resource-lists+xml MIME body is required to be included in the outgoing SIP INVITE request if the received SIP INVITE request contains an authorised request for an MCVideo emergency private call, in order for the network to determine the called party and continue with the rest of the steps.

q_32095.question: What should the controlling MCPTT function do upon receiving a SIP request for an MCPTT group that the MCPTT user is not currently affiliated to and that requires an eligibility check?
q_32095.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function should perform the procedures of clause~9.2.2.3.8 to determine if the MCPTT user is eligible to be affiliated to the MCPTT group.

q_32096.question: In what scenarios is session binding assisted with Domain identity?
