q_32096.ground_truth: Session binding is assisted with Domain identity in the visited access with AF located in HPLMN case, if the Origin-Host of the Gx CCR command is not modified by intermediate Diameter proxies deployed between the PCEF and the PCRF.

q_32097.question: What is the function of reference point M2u in the 5G Media Streaming architecture?
q_32097.ground_truth: Reference point M2u supports the egest of various types of content, including live streaming, on-demand streaming, and static files.

q_32098.question: What is the impact of this solution on the AMF?
q_32098.ground_truth: The AMF needs to support slice re-mapping and send a message to the SMF to trigger a change of S-NSSAI.

q_32099.question: What is the measurement period for the power measurements made in step (1.3) and (2.3) of the test procedure in UL MIMO?
q_32099.ground_truth: The power measurement period shall be 1 sub-frame(1ms).

q_32100.question: What are the SAND messages that the DASH client and DANE negotiate for consistent QoE/QoS in SAND?
q_32100.ground_truth: The DASH client and DANE negotiate the use of the following SAND messages for consistent QoE/QoS: PER: SharedResourceAssignment, DaneCapabilities, Status Messages: SharedResourceAllocation, ClientCapabilities, QoE Metrics: BufferLevel, PlayList.

q_32101.question: How does a UAV UE receive broadcast remote ID information from the RAN in the MBS-based UAV remote ID broadcast solution?
q_32101.ground_truth: The UAV UE selects a gNB of a mobile network in a geographic area to receive broadcast remote ID. This solution does not assume that all gNBs within the MBS service area support UAV MBS services, but it allows for USS/UTM to broadcast the same remote ID information in a geographic area via the mobile network, and for the UAV UE to receive the broadcast remote ID from the RAN even if it is not its home network.

q_32102.question: How does the UE select a non-3GPP access network to connect to?
q_32102.ground_truth: The UE constructs a prioritized list of WLAN access networks and selects the highest priority non-3GPP access network that supports the selected type of trusted connectivity to the selected PLMN.

q_32103.question: When may a participating MCPTT function reject a SIP MESSAGE request for group-selection-change for terminating participating MCPTT function?
q_32103.ground_truth: A participating MCPTT function may reject a SIP MESSAGE request for group-selection-change for terminating participating MCPTT function with a SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response if there is a lack of resources or a risk of congestion.

q_32104.question: What is the initial condition of the UE's synchronization with the cell in the test?
q_32104.ground_truth: Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE is fully synchronized to cell 1.

q_32105.question: What does the downlink PDCP SN transmitter status indicate in RLC AM?
q_32105.ground_truth: The downlink PDCP SN transmitter status in RLC AM indicates the next PDCP SN that the target eNB shall assign to new SDUs, not having a PDCP SN yet.

q_32106.question: What is the role of the NSCE client in the network slice QoS monitoring process?
q_32106.ground_truth: The NSCE client sends the requested QoE data response to the NSCE server for analysis in the network slice QoS monitoring process.

q_32107.question: What should the controlling MCPTT function include in the SIP NOTIFY request as the value of the P-Preferred-Service header field?
q_32107.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function should include the ICSI value "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcptt" in the P-Preferred-Service header field.

q_32108.question: What actions should the PCF take if it receives service information including an MCS session indication and the service priority level from the P-CSCF?
q_32108.ground_truth: The PCF shall set the ARP and 5QI of the default QoS flow and PCC rules as appropriate for the prioritized service.

q_32109.question: What is the requirement for the ME upon receiving an OPEN CHANNEL command related to (I-)WLAN bearer?
q_32109.ground_truth: The ME shall decide if it is able to execute the command and indicate whether the ME should establish the link immediately, in background mode or upon receiving the first transmitted data (on demand).

q_32110.question: In which DCI formats is the starting resource block index the same as the virtual starting resource block index?
q_32110.ground_truth: The starting resource block index is the same as the virtual starting resource block index in PDCCH DCI format 1C or for PDCCH/SPDCCH DCI format 7-1A/7-1B/7-1C/7-1D/7-1E/7-1F/7-1G.

q_32111.question: What steps are involved in the procedure of analytics context information transfer?
q_32111.ground_truth: The procedure involves the consumer NWDAF requesting analytics context from the provider NWDAF and the provider responding with the requested analytics context.

q_32112.question: What is the condition in the pseudocode for the UE to expect to detect a DCI format switching a DL BWP within N3 symbols prior to the first symbol of a PUCCH transmission?
q_32112.ground_truth: The condition is if the UE indicates a capability to receive more than one PDSCH per slot and C(R) is not empty.

q_32113.question: What will the UE do if all QoS rules are evaluated and the UL user data packet is not associated with a QFI?
q_32113.ground_truth: The UE will discard the UL user data packet if all QoS rules are evaluated and the UL user data packet is not associated with a QFI.

q_32114.question: What should be returned if the update is not authorized for the Individual Application Traffic Influence Instance?
q_32114.ground_truth: The EES should return the appropriate HTTP status code indicating the error, along with appropriate additional error information.

q_32115.question: Which initial NAS messages can be sent in the 5GMM-IDLE mode over non-3GPP access?
q_32115.ground_truth: The initial NAS messages that can be sent in the 5GMM-IDLE mode over non-3GPP access are REGISTRATION REQUEST message, DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message, SERVICE REQUEST message, and CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST.

q_32116.question: What should a receiving node do when it receives a message with IEs or IE groups in wrong order or with too many occurrences?
q_32116.ground_truth: The receiving node should consider the procedure as unsuccessfully terminated and initiate local error handling.

q_32117.question: What is the purpose of the test in 6.2.1.1.1.1.1?
q_32117.ground_truth: The purpose of the test in 6.2.1.1.1.1.1 is to verify the variance of the wideband CQI reports is within the limits defined and a PDSCH BLER of 10% falls between the transport format based median CQI-1 and median CQI or the transport format based median CQI and median CQI +1 for 1Rx FDD FR1 periodic CQI reporting under AWGN conditions for RedCap.

q_32118.question: What should the UE do if its Radio Capability information changes and there is no associated UE Radio Capability ID for the updated UE Radio Capability information?
q_32118.ground_truth: The UE shall perform the Tracking Area Update procedure for "UE radio capability update" as defined in clause~5.11.2.

q_32119.question: What should the terminating UE do if no precondition information is available in the initial SDP offer?
q_32119.ground_truth: The terminating UE sets the related media streams in the SDP answer to active or inactive mode, depending on whether the offered media streams were listed as active or inactive.

q_32120.question: What standard defines the Geodetic Information used in 3GPP networks?

q_32121.question: What action does the Serving GW take if it receives a Modify Bearer Request message from a new MME while waiting for the user plane to be established?
q_32121.ground_truth: The Serving GW re-sends the Downlink Data Notification message to the new MME.

q_32122.question: What is the lowest number of <PLMN> elements that can be contained in the <VPLMN-list> element?
q_32122.ground_truth: One or more <PLMN> elements can be contained in the <VPLMN-list> element.

q_32123.question: What should the UE do if a lower layer failure occurs before receiving the ATTACH ACCEPT or ATTACH REJECT message and T3411 has expired and attach attempt counter is less than 5?
q_32123.ground_truth: The UE should restart the attach procedure.

q_32124.question: What is the difference between a VNF and a VNF instance?
q_32124.ground_truth: A VNF is a software implementation of a network function, while a VNF instance refers to a specific execution of a VNF, which may run in one or more virtual machines.

q_32125.question: What is one of the requirements for the "TimeWindow" data type?
q_32125.ground_truth: One of the requirements for the "TimeWindow" data type is that it represents a start time and a stop time of a time window.

q_32126.question: What restriction applies to all serving cells in the same band on the symbols that fully or partially overlap with restricted symbols when intra-band carrier aggregation in FR2-2 is performed and L1-RSRP measurement is performed on the serving cell?
q_32126.ground_truth: The scheduling restrictions apply to all serving cells in the same band on the symbols that fully or partially overlap with restricted symbols when intra-band carrier aggregation in FR2-2 is performed and L1-RSRP measurement is performed on the serving cell.

q_32127.question: What are the two categories of solutions for Key Issue #5 in 7.5?
q_32127.ground_truth: The two categories of solutions for Key Issue #5 in 7.5 are solutions that enable the discovery of an EAS deployed in another PLMN than the one serving the UE, and solutions that facilitate the edge relocation between PLMNs.

q_32128.question: In signalling deactivation for UMTS and EPS, where should the Trace Deactivation always be carried out from?
q_32128.ground_truth: The Trace Deactivation should always be carried out from the Core Network EM only.

q_32129.question: What is the value of the "s" field in the session-level section when generating an SDP body for a private call?
q_32129.ground_truth: The value of the "s" field in the session-level section should be set to a dash.

q_32130.question: What is the default value of timer T5071 in the ProSe direct discovery procedure?
q_32130.ground_truth: The default value of timer T5071 is 4 minutes greater than the value of timer T5070.

q_32131.question: Who determines to accept the floor request from a floor participant in the context of floor control on an interworking group homed in the LMR system?
q_32131.ground_truth: The MCPTT server makes the initial determination, but the IWF and LMR system may also be involved in the final decision.

q_32132.question: What is the function of the n parameter in the +CREG command?
q_32132.ground_truth: The n parameter in the +CREG command controls the presentation of an unsolicited result code when there is a change in the network registration status.

q_32133.question: What should the SMF provide to the PCF in the SM Policy Control Create message if dynamic PCC is to be used for the MA PDU session?
q_32133.ground_truth: The SMF should provide the ATSSS Capabilities of the MA PDU session and the currently used Access Type(s) and RAT Type(s) to the PCF.

q_32134.question: What is the HTTP status code that the SCEF sends to the SCS/AS when it rejects a request due to a parameter being out of range?
q_32134.ground_truth: The SCEF sends an HTTP status code of "403 Forbidden" when it rejects a request due to a parameter being out of range.

q_32135.question: What is the priority value of the HARQ-ACK information when reporting HARQ-ACK information on uplink corresponding to one or multiple PSSCH transmissions with a corresponding SCI format with the field 'HARQ feedback enabled/disabled indicator' set to disabled?
q_32135.ground_truth: The priority value of the HARQ-ACK information is same as the priority value of the PSSCH transmission.

q_32136.question: What is the effect of the CWM Indicator in the warning broadcast ongoing if concurrent warning messages are not supported?
q_32136.ground_truth: If concurrent warning messages are not supported, the NG-RAN node does not stop the existing broadcast message but starts broadcasting the new message concurrently if the CWM Indicator is included in the Write-Replace Warning Request NG-RAN message. Otherwise, the NG-RAN node shall immediately replace the existing broadcast message with the newer one.

q_32137.question: In the test environment described, what is the role of the SS (Node B emulator) in relation to the UE (User Equipment)?
q_32137.ground_truth: The SS (Node B emulator) connects to the UE (User Equipment) antenna and functions as a base station, sending and receiving signals in the test.

q_32138.question: What mechanism does the NG-RAN use to determine a BAT offset and an adjusted Periodicity for a QoS Flow if it receives a TSCAI containing a BAT Window or Periodicity Range?
q_32138.ground_truth: The NG-RAN may provide a Burst Arrival Time offset and an adjusted Periodicity to align the arrival of traffic bursts with the expected time interval between subsequent transmission opportunities over the air interface in each direction. If the TSCAI contained a value range, the adjusted Periodicity should be any value between the lower bound and upper bound. If the TSCAI contained a list of Periodicity value(s), the adjusted Periodicity should be one of these values.

q_32139.question: What is the purpose of QoS handling for 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay?
q_32139.ground_truth: The purpose of QoS handling for 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay is to meet the end-to-end QoS requirement between two 5G ProSe end UEs.

q_32140.question: What is the role of the analytics ID in measuring the performance of NWDAF?
q_32140.ground_truth: The analytics ID identifies the requested analytics and is used to measure the performance of NWDAF based on the granularity of analytics. Each notification/response is added to the relevant subcounter per analytics ID.

q_32141.question: In the test described in 7.4.2.4.2, how many consecutive DTX events must be observed in order to count a fail for the event "DTX"?
q_32141.ground_truth: Two consecutive DTX events must be observed by the SS to count a fail for the event "DTX".

q_32142.question: What is the purpose of Part 1 in a Type I CSI feedback?
q_32142.ground_truth: Part 1 in a Type I CSI feedback identifies the number of information bits in Part 2 and is used to report RI, CRI, and CQI for the first codeword. It is padded with zeros to maintain a fixed payload size if needed.

q_32143.question: What should be the priority level for the requests that establish new sessions compared to the requests that update or end a session?
q_32143.ground_truth: The requests that establish new sessions should have a lower priority than the requests that update or end a session.

q_32144.question: What is the impact of a modified resume cause field in the RRCResumeRequest message in the 5G system?
q_32144.ground_truth: A modified resume cause field in the RRCResumeRequest message could reduce the type of services that the UE can access, leading to a reduced user experience.

q_32145.question: How many ongoing F1AP procedures are allowed at any instance in time between one protocol endpoint related to a certain UE?
q_32145.ground_truth: Unless explicitly indicated in the procedure specification, at any instance in time, one protocol endpoint shall have a maximum of one ongoing F1AP procedure related to a certain UE.

q_32146.question: When does the UE for multimedia telephony communication establish a voice call instead of a video call during the session establishment?
q_32146.ground_truth: The UE prioritizes audio if offered during the multimedia communication session; it performs the barring steps to ensure that the voice call is allowed based on the current access rights.

q_32147.question: What is the purpose of the PFCP association in the 3GPP specification?
q_32147.ground_truth: The PFCP association establishes a connection between a CP function and a UP function, allowing for the exchange of user plane traffic and related signaling messages.

q_32148.question: What steps do UE-1 and UE-2 take to switch the communication path from Uu path to PC5 path?
q_32148.ground_truth: UE-1 determines the ProSe service(s) to be switched to PC5 path and triggers the establishment of a PC5 unicast link. UE-2 responds with a Path Switch Response message to negotiate the ProSe service(s) to be switched.

q_32149.question: What method is used to measure modulation quality for UTRA, E-UTRA, and NR operations?
q_32149.ground_truth: Modulation quality is measured by the difference between the measured carrier signal and a reference signal, expressed as Peak Code Domain Error (PCDE), Relative Code Domain Error (RCDE), or Error Vector Magnitude (EVM).

q_32150.question: What is the potential security requirement when verifying user information provided by the EEC in the UE ID API invocation?
q_32150.ground_truth: The user information provided by the EEC should be verified and the EEC should be authorized to use this information.

q_32151.question: What is the relationship between the subcarrier spacing and cyclic prefix in the context of the BWP information element?
q_32151.ground_truth: The subcarrier spacing and cyclic prefix in the BWP context determine the subcarrier spacing and cyclic prefix used in coverage of a given bandwidth part.

q_32152.question: In the context of the provided example, which element is the root element of the application/simple-filter+xml MIME body?
q_32152.ground_truth: The "filter-set" element is the root element of the application/simple-filter+xml MIME body.

q_32153.question: What should the UE do if it receives additional octets in ATTACH ACCEPT message that it does not comprehend?
q_32153.ground_truth: The UE should ignore the contents of these octets and transmit ATTACH COMPLETE.

q_32154.question: What is the candidate number of MCVideo group IDs?
q_32154.ground_truth: The candidate number of MCVideo group IDs is the number of different MCVideo group IDs in the candidate list of MCVideo group information entries, or in the list of MCVideo group information entries of an MCVideo client information entry.

q_32155.question: What is the minimum resolution bandwidth requirement for measurements in the frequency range of 0-1 MHz?
q_32155.ground_truth: The minimum resolution bandwidth should be as close as possible to, but not less than, 1% of the channel bandwidth.

q_32156.question: What messages are exchanged between the gNB-CU and gNB-DU for inactive-to-active state transition?
q_32156.ground_truth: gNB-CU generates RRCResume/RRCSetup/RRCReject/RRCRelease message and forwards it to the UE, while the UE sends RRCResumeComplete/RRCSetupComplete message to the gNB-DU.

q_32157.question: What is the maximum improvement in combined MSD achievable through antenna isolation, assuming DRX H2 levels at LNA for Paths 2 and 3 are even lower than that for Path 1?
q_32157.ground_truth: Around 5 dB with antenna isolation of 20 dB

q_32158.question: What is one approach identified for overhead reduction in data collection for NW-side AI/ML models?

q_32159.question: What is the response status code indicated for success in the first scenario?
q_32159.ground_truth: The UDM responds with "200 OK" on success.

q_32160.question: What is the role of the MME in this process?
q_32160.ground_truth: The MME is responsible for maintaining the UE's 5G registration state when the UE moves to EPS. It receives the RFSP Index in use and validity timer from the AMF and uses it as long as the UE remains in EPS. If the UE moves back to 5G, the MME informs the old AMF and removes the old AMF address that was stored temporarily.

q_32161.question: In what situations will the MME locally deactivate all EPS bearer contexts associated with a LIPA PDN connection?
q_32161.ground_truth: The MME will locally deactivate all EPS bearer contexts associated with a LIPA PDN connection if a service request is received from a UE with a LIPA PDN connection and a GW Transport Layer Address IE value identifying a L-GW provided by the lower layer is different from the P-GW address included in the EPS bearer context of the LIPA PDN connection, or if no GW Transport Layer Address is provided together with the service request by the lower layer.

q_32162.question: What is the expected result when validating that there are no unnecessary services running on the network product?
q_32162.ground_truth: The expected result is that there are no unnecessary services running in the network product except for the ones which are deemed necessary for its operation, and any undocumented services running on the network product should be highlighted and brought out in the report.

q_32163.question: What is the purpose of the variable Nsymb,allPUSCH in the formula for denoting l as the OFDM symbol index of the scheduled PUSCH?
q_32163.ground_truth: It represents the total number of OFDM symbols of the PUSCH, including all OFDM symbols used for DMRS.

q_32164.question: What is the purpose of the Media Session Handler in 5G Downlink Media Streaming?
q_32164.ground_truth: The Media Session Handler in 5G Downlink Media Streaming establishes, controls, and supports the delivery of a media session on the UE. It may also perform additional functions such as consumption and QoE metrics collection and reporting.

q_32165.question: What is the purpose of the ADAE repository function?
q_32165.ground_truth: The ADAE repository function is responsible for storing application data analytics within the ADAE layer.

q_32166.question: What is the purpose of the "PDU Session(s) whose corresponding SMF+PGW-C(s) are not contacted by AMF for SM context" being released in a handover scenario in 5G systems?
q_32166.ground_truth: The purpose of releasing these PDU Sessions is that the AMF has determined that none of the EBI(s) for the PDU Session can be transferred to EPS, so the AMF requests the release of these PDU Sessions.

q_32167.question: When is an NB-IoT UE not required to monitor NPDCCH candidates during an NPUSCH UL gap?

q_32168.question: Which abbreviation is used for Multi-Path TCP Protocol in the 3GPP technical specification?

q_32169.question: What is the purpose of 3GPP TS 38.508-1, as part of the 5GS UE conformance specification?
q_32169.ground_truth: The purpose of 3GPP TS 38.508-1 is to define the test environment for the 5G System. This includes NG-RAN, 5GC, and interworking between 5GS and EPS for conformance tests of User Equipment.

q_32170.question: What requirement specified in 3GPP TS 24.379 clause 9 should be supported over the II-NNI in the mandatory mode procedure of the affiliation?
q_32170.ground_truth: Service specific requirements in accordance with 3GPP TS 24.379 clause 9 shall be supported over the II-NNI in the mandatory mode procedure of the affiliation.

q_32171.question: What is the definition of the delay uncertainty in the context of measurement reporting delay requirements provided in section 8.13.3.4.1.3 and 8.13.3.4.2.3?
q_32171.ground_truth: The delay uncertainty is defined as 2 x TTIDCCH in the context of measurement reporting delay requirements provided in section 8.13.3.4.1.3 and 8.13.3.4.2.3.

q_32172.question: What method is used by the NF service consumer (e.g. AMF) to update a parameter in the AMF registration for 3GPP access?
q_32172.ground_truth: The AMF sends a PATCH request to the UDM for the resource representing the UE's AMF registration for 3GPP access.

q_32173.question: In the context of the 3GPP Technical Specification, what does the term "TRP" represent and what does it measure?
q_32173.ground_truth: "TRP" refers to Total Radiated Power and it measures the average power output of a NR UE in low, mid, and high channels. Additionally, it averages the power output when hand phantoms are used from both hand left and hand right when necessary.

q_32174.question: In the case where binding procedures are not supported, what information can the NF Service Consumer provide in certain APIs to allow the NF Service Producer to indirectly communicate with the target NF consumer instance?
q_32174.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer can provide in certain APIs the name of the NF service to which these notifications are to be sent. This service can be one of the service produced by the NF (if this NF Service Consumer can also serve as a NF Service Producer) and registered in the NRF, or a custom service registered in the NRF for the purpose of receiving these notifications.

q_32175.question: What should the MCVideo client do when it receives a PRIVATE CALL ACCEPT message in response to a PRIVATE CALL SETUP REQUEST message with the same call identifier?
q_32175.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should store the SDP answer IE received in the PRIVATE CALL ACCEPT message as answer SDP, generate a PRIVATE CALL ACCEPT ACK message, send the PRIVATE CALL ACCEPT ACK message in response to the request message, establish a media session based on the SDP body of the stored answer SDP, start transmission control as terminating transmission participant, start timer TFP5, and enter the "P4: part of ongoing call" state.

q_32176.question: What is the difference between the file delivery methods considered for MCData service in the EPS and 5GS architectures?
q_32176.ground_truth: The file delivery methods considered for MCData service in the EPS architecture are unicast and broadcast, while in the 5GS architecture, only unicast delivery method is considered.

q_32177.question: What information does the I-SMF provide to the SMF to establish a N9 forwarding tunnel to support EAS session continuity?
q_32177.ground_truth: The I-SMF provides the SMF with an indication that a N9 forwarding tunnel to support EAS session continuity is required, along with the UL traffic filter for N9 forwarding by the target UL CL and the value of the timer to detect the end of activity on the N9 forwarding tunnel.

q_32178.question: What shall the BSF include in the server response-header field when communicating over Ub with a UE?
q_32178.ground_truth: The BSF shall always include the product token "3gpp-gba-tmpi" in the server response-header field when communicating over Ub with a UE.

q_32179.question: What is the requirement for NR-E-UTRAN TDD RSRP, RSRQ, and RS-SINR measurement accuracy?
q_32179.ground_truth: The NR-E-UTRAN TDD RSRP measurement accuracy for all measured cells shall be as specified in clause 10.2.2, the NR-E-UTRAN TDD RSRQ measurement accuracy for all measured cells shall be as specified in clause 10.2.3, and the NR-E-UTRAN TDD RS-SINR measurement accuracy for all measured cells shall be as specified in clause 10.2.5.

q_32180.question: What should be the signalling of the Chroma Format in the Adaptation Set constraints?
q_32180.ground_truth: The Chroma Format may be signalled on Adaptation Set level using an Essential or Supplemental Descriptor and shall match the values set in the VUI.

q_32181.question: What is the purpose of the MBS (Multicast-Broadcast Service) in the 5G System?
q_32181.ground_truth: The MBS in the 5G System provides functionalities such as local MBS service, location dependent MBS service, authorization of multicast MBS and QoS differentiation. It is used to deliver MBS traffic from a single data source to multiple UEs.

q_32182.question: What priority do SIP messages related to priority calls have in the IM CN subsystem?
q_32182.ground_truth: SIP messages related to priority calls have the highest priority, and are last to be dropped or rejected, when an IM CN subsystem functional entity decides it is necessary to apply traffic reduction due to overload control.

q_32183.question: What type of E-UTRA UEs does the test case 6.2B.1.6.2 apply to?
q_32183.ground_truth: This test case applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 17 and forward, supporting inter-band EN-DC including FR2 with 1 NR UL CC along with support for UL-gaps.

q_32184.question: What should the en-gNB do upon receiving the SCG Activation Request IE set to "Activate SCG" in the SGNB ADDITION REQUEST message?
q_32184.ground_truth: The en-gNB shall activate the SCG resources and set the SCG Activation Status IE in the SGNB ADDITION REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message to "SCG activated".

q_32185.question: What is the maximum allowed end-to-end delay between two protection relays for high speed current differential protection?
q_32185.ground_truth: Between 5ms and 10ms, depending on the voltage levels.

q_32186.question: In which clause of the 3GPP TS 36.331 does it specify that the UE should apply layer 3 filtering before using measured results for evaluation of reporting criteria or for measurement reporting?
q_32186.ground_truth: It is specified in clause 5.5.3 of the 3GPP TS 36.331.

q_32187.question: In what way can NG-RAN and 5GC control the access of UE via MBSR?
q_32187.ground_truth: NG-RAN and 5GC can control the access of UE via MBSR by using the CAG identifier associated with the MBSR cell and the allowed CAG identifiers for the UE that supports CAG functionality. They can also use other existing mechanisms like forbidden Tracking Area to manage access to MBSR for UEs that do not support CAG functionality.

q_32188.question: What is the behavior of the MTSI client when receiving CMR values in AMR and AMR-WB?
q_32188.ground_truth: The MTSI client should follow each received CMR and shall not use higher modes in media-encoding than indicated by the most recently received CMR, while lower modes within the negotiated mode-set are allowed any time.

q_32189.question: What should be the earliest time for an interruption to occur on the PCell and/or activated SCell when deactivating an SCell in E-UTRA TDD or when the activated SCell being interrupted and the SCell being deactivated belong to E-UTRA FDD and the PCell belongs to E-UTRA TDD?
q_32189.ground_truth: The interruption on the PCell and/or the activated SCell should not occur before subframe n+5.

q_32190.question: In Standalone mode, what should the UE report as per 8.5.2.2.1?
q_32190.ground_truth: In Standalone mode, the UE should report the latitude, longitude, and possibly altitude, together with an estimate of the location uncertainty, if available. The UE should also report an indication of WLAN method and possibly other positioning methods used to calculate a fix.

q_32191.question: What is the uplink timing for the ACK corresponding to a detected MPDCCH indicating downlink SPS release for a BL/CE UE in FDD?
q_32191.ground_truth: The uplink timing for the ACK corresponding to a detected MPDCCH indicating downlink SPS release for a BL/CE UE in FDD is the same as the uplink timing for the HARQ-ACK corresponding to a detected PDSCH.

q_32192.question: Which NF does Solution #50 propose to be responsible for determining DNAI?
q_32192.ground_truth: Solution #50 proposes that the SMF determines DNAI and is responsible for storing mapping information between EAS IP addresses/IP ranges and DNAIs.

q_32193.question: What is the purpose of the COUNT value in the PDCP ciphering function?
q_32193.ground_truth: The COUNT value is a part of the required inputs to the ciphering function, it is used to generate the ciphering keys for encryption and decryption, as specified in TS 33.401.

q_32194.question: Under what conditions are the intra-frequency RSRP accuracy requirements in high doppler conditions applicable?
q_32194.ground_truth: The intra-frequency RSRP accuracy requirements in high doppler conditions are applicable for EVA300, EVA600, EVA875, HST875, and HST-SFN972 propagation conditions with independent interference (noise) at each receiver antenna port.

q_32195.question: What should the MS do upon receiving an ATTACH ACCEPT message that contains an IMSI but no TMSI?
q_32195.ground_truth: The MS should delete any TMSI accordingly and not allocate any new TMSI.

q_32196.question: What message will the transmission participant interface send to the MCVideo client when it receives RTP media packets from the media distributor?
q_32196.ground_truth: The transmission participant interface will instruct the network media interface to send the received RTP media packets towards the MCVideo client.

q_32197.question: What are the existing security requirements for 5G communication in the energy sector?
q_32197.ground_truth: The existing security requirements for 5G communication in the energy sector include support for data integrity protection and confidentiality methods that serve URLLC, high data rates and energy constrained devices, a mechanism to verify the integrity of a message and the authenticity of the sender, and encryption for URLLC services within the requested end-to-end latency.

q_32198.question: What information does the SystemInformationBlockType31-NB contain?
q_32198.ground_truth: The SystemInformationBlockType31-NB contains satellite assistance information for the serving cell and it is only signalled in an NTN cell.

q_32199.question: In what state must the UE be in for the test described in 8.1.3.12a.1(1)?
q_32199.ground_truth: The UE must be in E-UTRA RRC_IDLE state in LTE FDD mode.

q_32200.question: In Test 1, what is the requirement for the overall delay measured when DRX cycle length is 40 ms?
q_32200.ground_truth: The overall delay measured when DRX cycle length is 40 ms shall be less than a total of 1482 ms.

q_32201.question: What action does the PCF take when it receives a HTTP POST request indicating the termination of the AF application session context information?
q_32201.ground_truth: The PCF acknowledges the request and sends an HTTP response message with the corresponding status code. It then frees the network resources allocated for the Service Data Flow(s) corresponding to the deleted AF application session context information and initiates the request for the removal of any related PCC rules from the SMF.

q_32202.question: What should the floor participant interface toward the MCPTT client do upon receiving an instruction to split the ongoing MCPTT call?
q_32202.ground_truth: The floor participant interface toward the MCPTT client should create a new instance of the 'basic floor control operation towards the floor participant' state machine, move information associated with the current state machine to the new one, enter the 'Start-stop' state, and terminate the current 'floor participant interface toward the MCPTT client' state machine.

q_32203.question: What is the triggering event for the MeasurementReport message from the UE?
q_32203.ground_truth: The MeasurementReport message from the UE is triggered by Event A3.

q_32204.question: What method is used by the NF service consumer (S-CSCF) to retrieve the information related to a specific registration for a registered user?
q_32204.ground_truth: The NF service consumer (S-CSCF) sends a GET request to the resource representing the UE's S-CSCF restoration information.

q_32205.question: What are the two NAS signalling integrity protection algorithms that UEs and MMEs shall implement for 5G networks?

q_32206.question: What is the maximum size of a Remote UE Local ID?
q_32206.ground_truth: The maximum size of a Remote UE Local ID is 24 bits.

q_32207.question: What should a UE do if the reference cell on a carrier frequency subject to CCA is not available at the UE?
q_32207.ground_truth: The UE is allowed to use any available activated SCell(s) at the UE in PTAG or STAG as a new reference cell.

q_32208.question: What is the goal of Key Issue #9 in enhancing NWDAF with finer granularity of location information?
q_32208.ground_truth: The goal is to study whether and how the NWDAF can provide additional benefits from location services by identifying use cases, analytics IDs, and input data requirements, and determining how NWDAF acquires the input data.

q_32209.question: Which UE power classes does the test applicability in section 6.5G.3.2.2 apply to?
q_32209.ground_truth: The test applicability in section 6.5G.3.2.2 applies to NR Power Class 1.5, Power Class 2, and Power Class 3 UE released in version 15 and forward with Tx diversity support.

q_32210.question: In what situation should the UE select the synchronization reference source(s) on the concerned frequency(ies) which are included in syncFreqList?
q_32210.ground_truth: The UE should select the synchronization reference source(s) on the concerned frequency(ies) which are included in syncFreqList if no synchronization carrier frequency is selected and GNSS is not reliable.

q_32211.question: What items does the NRInternalcellsearch list comprise of?
q_32211.ground_truth: The NRInternalcellsearch list comprises of a list of PCI candidates with their periodicity and offset choices.

q_32212.question: What is the purpose of the MCPTT-4 reference point in the call over pre-established session procedures?
q_32212.ground_truth: The MCPTT-4 reference point is used for sending Connect and Disconnect messages related to the acceptance, rejection, or release of calls conducted over a pre-established session.

q_32213.question: What determines the number of bits for the time domain resource assignment field?
q_32213.ground_truth: The number of bits for the time domain resource assignment field is determined by the number of entries in the higher layer parameter TDRA-FieldIndexListDCI-0-3.

q_32214.question: In what OFDM symbol should the CSI-RS for BFD measurement and the other CSI-RS not be in the same symbol for FR2?
q_32214.ground_truth: The CSI-RS for BFD measurement and the other CSI-RS should not be in the same OFDM symbol if they are not Quasi-Co-Located (QCL) with respect to QCL-TypeD, or the QCL information is not known to the UE. Additionally, the CSI-RS for BFD measurement should not be in the same OFDM symbol as another CSI-RS for RLM, BFD, CBD, or L1-RSRP measurement on the same or different CCs in the same band.

q_32215.question: In what format are the OpenAPI definitions provided in the present document?
q_32215.ground_truth: The OpenAPI definitions in the present document are provided in YAML format.

q_32216.question: What is the difference between "intra-band" and "inter-band" carrier aggregation?
q_32216.ground_truth: Intra-band carrier aggregation involves aggregating carriers within the same operating band, while inter-band carrier aggregation involves aggregating carriers across different operating bands.

q_32217.question: What should the UE do upon receiving a MobilityFromEUTRACommand message with the purpose set to 'handover' and the targetRAT-Type set to 'cdma2000-1XRTT' or 'cdma2000-HRPD'?
q_32217.ground_truth: The UE should forward the targetRAT-Type and the targetRAT-MessageContainer to the CDMA2000 upper layers for the UE to access the cell indicated in the inter-RAT message.

q_32218.question: What should be included in the BH RLC Channel Setup List IE, if a list of BH RLC channels is successfully established?
q_32218.ground_truth: A list of BH RLC channels which are successfully established should be included in the BH RLC Channel Setup List IE.

q_32219.question: What message is sent by the gNB-DU to request the gNB-CU to modify multicast context information?

q_32220.question: Why may it not be feasible to use RF filters/diplexers after every PA to handle IM distortions in FR2 radio systems?
q_32220.ground_truth: This may not be feasible due to the high cost, significant phase error between antenna paths, and increased power loss caused by filters per path in beamforming phased array with thousands of antenna paths.

q_32221.question: In the SL-AoA positioning procedure, what message does Endpoint A send to Endpoint B to request assistance data?
q_32221.ground_truth: Endpoint A sends an SLPP Request Assistance Data message to Endpoint B to request specific SL-AoA positioning assistance data.

q_32222.question: In the MSGin5G procedure, what should the message type element be set to in the CoAP payload for sending message segments received confirmation?
q_32222.ground_truth: In the MSGin5G procedure, the message type element should be set to "SEGCONFIR" in the CoAP payload for sending message segments received confirmation.

q_32223.question: What should a device do when it receives an Abort message?
q_32223.ground_truth: Upon receiving an Abort message, a device should abort any ongoing procedure associated with the transaction ID indicated in the message.

q_32225.question: What should a message store function do to retrieve the content of a given folder identified by its folder ID in the MCData message store using the message store function?
q_32225.ground_truth: A message store function should validate the MCData access token, process the HTTP GET request by following the procedures described in the specified clause, and generate and send an HTTP response towards the message store client indicating the result of the operation.

q_32226.question: What must the API management function send to the CAPIF core function in order to deregister an API provider domain function?
q_32226.ground_truth: The API management function must send an HTTP DELETE message to the CAPIF core function with the API provider domain function's resource representation.

q_32227.question: What is the meaning of the term "shall" in the present document?
q_32227.ground_truth: In the present document, "shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

q_32228.question: What happens when the SMF receives a UMIC or PMIC from the TSC user plane node functionality of the UPF when using DS-TT or NW-TT functions?
q_32228.ground_truth: The SMF transparently forwards the UMIC or PMIC to the PCF within the SmPolicyUpdateContextData structure.

q_32229.question: What must the S-NG-RAN node do if it receives the DRB IDs taken into use IE in the S-NODE MODIFICATION CONFIRM message?
q_32229.ground_truth: The S-NG-RAN node must act as specified in TS 37.340.

q_32230.question: What is the meaning of the PFCP heartbeat messages in the 5G System?
q_32230.ground_truth: The PFCP heartbeat messages are used in the 5G System across PFCP based interfaces to detect a peer PFCP entity failure or restart.

q_32231.question: In the E1AP, what is the difference between Class 1 and Class 2 Elementary Procedures?
q_32231.ground_truth: Class 1 Elementary Procedures (EPs) have a response (success and/or failure), while Class 2 EPs are considered always successful and do not require a response.

q_32232.question: What is the format of the group-geo-area-ind element in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body in a SIP MESSAGE request for notifying an MCVideo client about entering or exiting from a group geographic area?
q_32232.ground_truth: The group-geo-area-ind element is set to "true" if the MCVideo client has entered the group geographic area, and "false" if the MCVideo client has exited from the group geographic area.

q_32233.question: Which parameter is used to indicate DL GFBR in case of a GBR 5QI?
q_32233.ground_truth: <DL_GFBR> is used to indicate DL GFBR in case of a GBR 5QI.

q_32234.question: What is the purpose of the "UE Radio Capability ID" in the 5G cellular network?
q_32234.ground_truth: The "UE Radio Capability ID" is used to represent a set of UE radio capabilities, allowing for efficient signaling over the radio interface and other network interfaces.

q_32235.question: Under what conditions should the MCPTT client display to the user an indication that this is a SIP re-INVITE request to upgrade this call to an MCPTT emergency private call?
q_32235.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should display to the MCPTT user an indication that this is a SIP re-INVITE request to upgrade this call to an MCPTT emergency private call if the incoming SIP re-INVITE request contains an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body with the <mcpttinfo> element containing the <mcptt-Params> element with the <emergency-ind> element set to a value of "true".

q_32236.question: What is the role of the H-SMF when establishing a new PDU session?
q_32236.ground_truth: The H-SMF selects a UPF and establishes an N4 session with it when there is no existing N4 session. It also notifies the DN-AAA server with GPSI and the IP address(es) or MAC address of the UE.

q_32237.question: In NR sidelink operation, what is the parameter that limits the transmission power based on the maximum UE power and the MPR and A-MPR parameters?

q_32238.question: Which message is sent by the SeNB to inform the MeNB that the SeNB Addition Preparation has failed in the context of EN-DC?

q_32239.question: In the context of 3GPP TS 23.540, what is the MtForwardSm service operation used for?
q_32239.ground_truth: The MtForwardSm service operation is used to transmit downlink SMS messages via IP-SM-GW, and is used in the procedures for successful and unsuccessful Mobile Terminated short message transfer via IP-SM-GW. The NF Service Consumer (e.g. SMS-GMSC) sends a POST request to the IP-SM-GW containing the SMS message to be sent, and the IP-SM-GW returns a 200 OK response with the MT SMS Delivery Report in the response body.

q_32240.question: What should the terminal of type ND do if the alpha identifier is not provided in a "Geographical Location Request" command?
q_32240.ground_truth: The terminal shall respond with "command performed successfully" upon successful completion of the command, and ignore any icon provided together with this command.

q_32241.question: What is the expected action taken by the UE when there are no packet filters for the default EPS bearer and there is an IP packet for transmission?
q_32241.ground_truth: The UE transmits the IP packet in uplink on the default EPS bearer.

q_32242.question: In the "IEEE-802.11", "IEEE-802.11a", "IEEE-802.11b", "IEEE-802.11g", "IEEE-802.11n", or "IEEE-802.11ac" access type, what parameter is used to represent the AP's MAC address without any delimiting characters?

q_32243.question: What is the step size for the CW interfering signal sweep in the out-of-band blocking test?
q_32243.ground_truth: The CW interfering signal shall be swept with a step size of 1 MHz in the out-of-band blocking test.

q_32244.question: What is the formula for the handover delay Dhandover in this test case?
q_32244.ground_truth: Handover delay Dhandover = maximum RRC procedure delay + Tinterrupt

q_32245.question: What should the SC UE do when it receives a SIP 2xx response for the SIP INVITE request during the ICS procedure?
q_32245.ground_truth: Upon receiving a SIP 2xx response for the SIP INVITE request, the SC UE shall send a SIP ACK request and send a SIP BYE request to the SCC AS on the Source Access Leg to terminate the dialog on the Source Access Leg, if the dialog is still active and no active media streams remain on that dialog on the Source Access Leg.

q_32246.question: What HTTP method is used to retrieve a specific File Distribution in the VAE server?
q_32246.ground_truth: The HTTP method "GET" is used to retrieve a specific File Distribution in the VAE server.

q_32247.question: What is the function of the 5G DDNMF in the HPLMN?
q_32247.ground_truth: The 5G DDNMF in the HPLMN is responsible for handling network-related actions required for dynamic 5G ProSe Direct Discovery. It interacts with the 5G ProSe-enabled UE using procedures over the PC3a reference point, authorizes discovery requests, and provides security material for protecting discovery messages transmitted over the air.

q_32248.question: What is the measurement "Max number of Active UEs in the UL per DRB per cell" used for?
q_32248.ground_truth: It is used for performance assurance within integrity area (user plane connection quality) in 5G.

q_32249.question: How does the ProSe Function verify the ProSe Application Code received from the UE in the match report procedure?
q_32249.ground_truth: The ProSe Function verifies the ProSe Application Code received from the UE in the match report procedure by checking whether there is an existing context for the UE identified by its IMSI. If there is no associated UE context, the ProSe Function checks with the HSS whether the UE is authorized for open ProSe direct discovery monitoring. The ProSe Function then checks the PLMN ID in the ProSe Application Code received from the UE. If the PLMN ID in the ProSe Application Code is not the same as that of the PLMN to which the ProSe Function belongs, the ProSe Function executes procedures defined in 3GPP TS 29.345. The ProSe Function then checks whether the received ProSe Application Code is authorized to be transmitted on the monitored PLMN indicated in the Monitored PLMN ID in the received message. If the ProSe Application Code is PLMN-specific, the ProSe Function maps the ProSe Application Code to the corresponding ProSe Application ID from the PLMN-specific database.

q_32250.question: What triggers the PDN GW to start overload control?
q_32250.ground_truth: The PDN GW may detect APN congestion and start performing overload control based on criteria such as maximum number of active bearers per APN, and maximum rate of bearer activations per APN. When performing overload control, the PDN GW rejects PDN connection requests, and the MME rejects the UE's PDN connection request.

q_32251.question: What does the type of extension data in the EXT1 record mean?
q_32251.ground_truth: The type of extension data in the EXT1 record indicates whether it is additional data or Called Party Subaddress.

q_32252.question: What is the mapping of NPDCCH used in NB-IoT?
q_32252.ground_truth: NPDCCH supports aggregations of 1 and 2 control channel elements and repetition.

q_32253.question: What is the term used to describe the relationship between the OTA sensitivity and the sub-block edges relative to the target direction, as specified in clause 10.1?
q_32253.ground_truth: For ACS, blocking and intermodulation characteristics, the negative offsets of the interfering signal apply relative to the lower IAB RF Bandwidth edge or sub-block edge inside a sub-block gap, and the positive offsets of the interfering signal apply relative to the upper IAB RF Bandwidth edge or sub-block edge inside a sub-block gap.

q_32254.question: What is the purpose of the 3D EIRP scan in the procedure?
q_32254.ground_truth: The purpose of the 3D EIRP scan is to find the UE Tx beam peak direction and ensure the UE is in the peak direction for uplink transmission.

q_32255.question: What should the participating MCVideo function include in the outgoing SIP request, if the application/vnd.3gpp.location-info+xml MIME body was not already copied in the received SIP INVITE request?
q_32255.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function should copy the contents of the application/vnd.3gpp.location-info+xml MIME body received in the SIP INVITE request into an application/vnd.3gpp.location-info+xml MIME body included in the outgoing SIP request.

q_32256.question: What is the purpose of KD-sess, derived from KD, and what is it used for?
q_32256.ground_truth: KD-sess is derived from KD to protect the transfer of data between the peer UEs. It is used to derive keys that protect the transfer of data between the source UE and target UE.

q_32257.question: What is the method used for sending uplink non-IP data to the SCS/AS using HTTP?
q_32257.ground_truth: The SCEF uses the HTTP POST method on the notification endpoint in SCS/AS to send the uplink non-IP data to the SCS/AS, using JSON format.

q_32258.question: What is the difference between the Routing Indicator and PLMN ID in the context of SNPN access mode?
q_32258.ground_truth: The Routing Indicator is used to route network signaling to AUSF and UDM instances serving the SNPN-enabled UE, while PLMN ID is used for AUSF and UDM discovery and selection in SNPN access mode.

q_32259.question: What is the condition for cell reselection to a lower absolute priority layer?
q_32259.ground_truth: Cell reselection to a lower absolute priority layer is performed if Criterion 3 or 5 is fulfilled.

q_32260.question: What is the purpose of test 8.2.9.3?
q_32260.ground_truth: The purpose of test 8.2.9.3 is to verify the receiver's ability to detect MsgA PUSCH under multipath fading propagation conditions for a given SNR.

q_32261.question: What must the terminating participating function do, if it is unable to process a SIP re-INVITE request for an existing MCData one-to-one communication session?
q_32261.ground_truth: The terminating participating function may reject the SIP re-INVITE request with a SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response. It may include a Retry-After header field to the SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response.

q_32262.question: What is the "SNPN access mode for Yt interface" in the context of trusted non-3GPP access?
q_32262.ground_truth: The "SNPN access mode for Yt interface" refers to the mode in which the UE operates when connecting to a Specific NodeB over a trusted non-3GPP access.

q_32263.question: What is the purpose of establishing an IKE SA and signalling IPsec SA between the UE and the N3IWF?
q_32263.ground_truth: The purpose of establishing an IKE SA and signalling IPsec SA between the UE and the N3IWF is to securely exchange NAS signalling messages between the UE and the AMF via the N3IWF.

q_32264.question: In what type of operation does the sum of RX spurious emissions over all antenna connectors for BS type 1-C apply in Japan?
q_32264.ground_truth: The sum of RX spurious emissions over all antenna connectors for BS type 1-C applies for Band n41 and n90 operation in Japan.

q_32265.question: What requirement is defined for the SSB for BFD measurement for FR2, when the SSB is in the same or adjacent OFDM symbol as SSB with a different PCI for RLM, CBD or L1-RSRP measurement on the same CC or different CCs in the same band?
q_32265.ground_truth: The UE is required to measure one of the two SSBs with different PCIs.

q_32266.question: What steps does the UAS NF take after receiving the USS re-authentication request for the UAV?
q_32266.ground_truth: The UAS NF retrieves the UE's context, verifies the USS re-authentication request, and determines the target NF (AMF or SMF) before sending the UAA re-authentication request to the target NF.

q_32267.question: What message does the MME send when it receives an S1 UE Context Release Request with Cause=user inactivity and there is no pending MT traffic or signalling and/or NAS Release Assistance Information?
q_32267.ground_truth: The MME sends a Release Access Bearers Request (Abnormal Release of Radio Link Indication, Secondary RAT usage data) message to the S-GW.

q_32268.question: What are the three types of packet filters supported for 5G ProSe direct communication over PC5?
q_32268.ground_truth: The three types of packet filters supported are the ProSe IP packet filter set, the ProSe packet filter set, and the ProSe Ethernet packet filter set.

q_32269.question: Which UE release does the test applicability apply in 6.3B.2.1.2?
q_32269.ground_truth: The test applicability applies to E-UTRA UE release 15 and forward, which support intra-band contiguous EN-DC.

q_32270.question: What is the format required for the bodies of HTTP request and successful HTTP responses in SEAL APIs?
q_32270.ground_truth: JSON format, with a Content-Type header field of "application/json"

q_32271.question: When the MME initiates a re-authentication to create a new EPS security context, what message does it send the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message indicating?
q_32271.ground_truth: The MME sends the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message including the eKSI of the new EPS security context to be used.

q_32272.question: When is the UE required to store an extended local emergency numbers list received via non-3GPP access?
q_32272.ground_truth: The UE is required to store an extended local emergency numbers list received via non-3GPP access if the UE is neither registered nor attached over 3GPP access, the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message is received from a PLMN different from which the stored list was received, and the stored indication in the EENLV field within the Extended emergency number list IE indicates "Extended Local Emergency Numbers List is valid only in the PLMN from which this IE is received".

q_32273.question: In what conditions can the UE use the radio parameters indicated by a cell for ProSe direct communication?
q_32273.ground_truth: If the lower layers report that one or more PLMNs operate in the provisioned radio resources, and none of the PLMNs is the registered PLMN or equivalent to the registered PLMN, but at least one of the PLMNs is in the list of authorized PLMNs for ProSe direct communication and provides radio resources for ProSe direct communication, then the UE can use the radio parameters indicated by the cell for ProSe direct communication.

q_32274.question: What is the effect of the NAS MM congestion control on the AMF and SMF?
q_32274.ground_truth: When the NAS MM congestion control is activated at the AMF, if the UE indicates that the NAS MM message is exempted from NAS congestion control, the AMF shall not reject the NAS MM message and shall forward the NAS SM message to the corresponding SMF with an indication that the NAS SM message was indicated to be exempted from NAS congestion control. The SMF ensures that the NAS SM message is not subject to congestion control, otherwise the SMF rejects the message.

q_32275.question: What should the VLR do if it detects overlapping information within a dialogue?
q_32275.ground_truth: The VLR shall send the error Unexpected Data Value.

q_32276.question: What should a participating MCPTT function do upon receiving a SIP BYE request for on-demand ambient listening call?
q_32276.ground_truth: It should follow the procedures as specified in clause~11.1.3.2.1.1.

q_32277.question: What information is required for a V2X UE to obtain V2X UE service discovery information across multiple V2X service providers?
q_32277.ground_truth: To obtain V2X UE service discovery information across multiple V2X service providers, the VAE client sends a get V2X UE service discovery request to the VAE server 1 of V2X service provider A, with the V2X UE ID and current V2X UE location. The VAE server 1 then sends the get V2X UE service discovery request to the VAE server 2 of the V2X service provider B to get the V2X application server information for the V2X UE.

q_32278.question: Which entity provides a candidate list of V-UPFs to target V-SMF in EAS rediscovery?
q_32278.ground_truth: In EAS rediscovery, V-NRF provides a candidate list of V-UPFs to target V-SMF based on S-NSSAI and UE location information, as well as the N9 IP address of the H-UPF.

q_32279.question: What should the controlling MCVideo function include in the Contact header field of the initial SIP INVITE request?
q_32279.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function should include an MCVideo session identity for the MCVideo session with the g.3gpp.mcvideo media feature tag, the isfocus media feature tag, and the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag with the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcvideo" in the Contact header field.

q_32280.question: How does the 5GS Tracking Area Identity based ePDG FQDN using a 3 octet TAC differ from the trackin area Identity based ePDG FQDN using a 2 octet TAC as given in the example?
q_32280.ground_truth: The 5GS Tracking Area Identity based ePDG FQDN using a 3 octet TAC includes an additional octet representing the most significant byte in the TAC, whereas the trackin area Identity based ePDG FQDN using a 2 octet TAC includes only two octets for the TAC.

q_32281.question: What kind of data is collected by the Data Producer at the DN side?
q_32281.ground_truth: The Data Producer at the DN side collects real-time networking or application data such as RTT, application layer PER, and throughput.

q_32282.question: Which ITU-T Recommendation provides a QoE assessment of eXtended Reality (XR) meetings?
q_32282.ground_truth: Draft ITU-T P.1320 (ex P.QXM) provides a QoE assessment of eXtended Reality (XR) meetings.

q_32283.question: What is the difference in DL Average-UPT between the case with no DL power adjustment and the case with DL power adjustment (3 dB power back off) in FR1 Indoor office based on Source 2?
q_32283.ground_truth: With a large packet size, the DL power adjustment results in a lower mean and 5% DL Average-UPT for all load levels compared to the case with no DL power adjustment.

q_32284.question: What does Solution #26 propose to do in order to solve the open issues related to EAS bundles?
q_32284.ground_truth: Solution #26 enhances AC, EAS, and EES profiles, including adding EAS bundle information and EAS bundle requirements. It also enhances EAS discovery filters and Retrieve EES request.

q_32285.question: What is the role of the UE-to-UE Relay in QoS handling?
q_32285.ground_truth: The UE-to-UE Relay determines the PC5 QoS parameters used on the PC5 QoS Flows between Source UE and UE-to-UE Relay, as well as the PC5 QoS parameters used on the PC5 QoS Flow between UE-to-UE Relay and Target UE.

q_32286.question: What is the value of the notify-remote-user element for not notifying the remote MCPTT user of the remotely initiated group call request?

q_32287.question: How does the UE obtain information about available hosting networks during initial registration?
q_32287.ground_truth: During the initial registration of the UE, the home network (UDM) may provide to the serving network (AMF) an indication of whether it is allowed to provide available hosting network information to the UE. Alternatively, the AMF may send the list of available hosting networks to the UDM first for authorization and then send the authorized list of hosting networks received from the UDM to the UE.

q_32288.question: What should the MCPTT client include in the Contact header field of the SIP REGISTER request when performing service authorization for the MCPTT client?
q_32288.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should include the g.3gpp.mcptt media feature tag and the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag containing the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcptt" in the Contact header field of the SIP REGISTER request.

q_32289.question: What shall the BSF do if the GUSS includes a timestamp when sent from the HSS?
q_32289.ground_truth: The BSF may include the GUSS timestamp in the request message when sending a request to the HSS.

q_32290.question: What is not required during intra-gNB-CU handover or intra-ng-eNB handover?
q_32290.ground_truth: Changing the AS security algorithms is not required during intra-gNB-CU handover or intra-ng-eNB handover.

q_32291.question: How does the RLC PDU sequence number differ from the SDU sequence number?
q_32291.ground_truth: The PDU sequence number carried by the RLC header is independent of the SDU sequence number, which is the sequence number of the PDCP SDUs. This means that the RLC PDU sequence number is incremented for every new RLC PDU, regardless of the sequence number of the SDUs contained.

q_32292.question: What is the identifier used for an IMS UE without MSISDN in a retry context of SMS for IMS to IMS?

q_32293.question: What parameters are used if the PDU Set Content Criteria or the PDU Set Content Ratio of the specific PDU Set are different from the default values of the QoS Flow?
q_32293.ground_truth: PDU Set Content Criteria and PDU Set Content Ratio

q_32294.question: What is the size of the starting number of NPRACH repetitions field in the DCI format N1 when used for random access initiated by a NPDCCH order?
q_32294.ground_truth: The starting number of NPRACH repetitions field is 2 bits in the DCI format N1 when used for random access initiated by a NPDCCH order.

q_32295.question: What determines how measurement quantities are considered for each RAT?
q_32295.ground_truth: Measurement quantities are considered separately for each RAT.

q_32296.question: Which event-triggered reporting is used in the test in clause 7.6.2.8.4.2?
q_32296.ground_truth: Event A3 is used in the test in clause 7.6.2.8.4.2 for event-triggered reporting.

q_32297.question: What is the type of UL channel access procedure where the time duration spanned by the sensing slots that are sensed to be idle before a UL transmission(s) is random?

q_32298.question: What should an AS do when forwarding an initial INVITE request and if its own SIP URI is present in the topmost Route header field?
q_32298.ground_truth: The AS should remove its own SIP URI from the topmost Route header field of the received INVITE request.

q_32299.question: What should the UE do to derive a mapped K'AMF, during inter-system change to N1 mode in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode?
q_32299.ground_truth: The UE should derive a mapped K'AMF using the KASME from the EPS security context, and associate this mapped 5G NAS security context with the ngKSI value received in the S1 mode to N1 mode NAS transparent container IE. The UE should then verify the received NAS MAC, and create a locally generated K'AMF if the received NAS MAC is not verified successfully.

q_32300.question: What is the role of the 5GMS Application Provider in NSCE service provision?
q_32300.ground_truth: A 5GMS Application Provider in the role of an NSCE service provider may provide Network Slice Capability Exposure services to its users, using the procedures and information flows specified in TS~23.435, enabling the application layer to access and manage network slice lifecycle information.

q_32301.question: What are some metrics to consider for beam management testing?
q_32301.ground_truth: Some metrics to consider include RSRP accuracy, beam prediction accuracy, successful rate for correct prediction with maximum RSRP, and combinations of these options. The overhead/latency reduction should be considered for the requirements.

q_32302.question: What should the UE include in the service-level-AA container when requesting C2 communication authorization when a PDN connection is already established for the USS communication?
q_32302.ground_truth: The UE should include the service-level device ID, with the value set to CAA-level UAV ID, the service-level-AA payload type parameter with the value set to "C2 authorization payload", and the service-level-AA payload parameter, with the value set to C2 authorization payload when requesting C2 communication authorization.

q_32303.question: In the context of MCPTT, what does the timestamp Y in the formula (Y - Z) seconds represent?
q_32303.ground_truth: Y represents the current UTC time, in seconds since midnight UTC of January 1, 1970 (not counting leap seconds).

q_32304.question: What does the Implementation Conformance Statement (ICS) in the 3GPP TS 36.521-2 technical specification represent?
q_32304.ground_truth: The Implementation Conformance Statement (ICS) is a statement made by the supplier of an implementation or system, stating which capabilities of a given specification have been implemented.

q_32305.question: What is the significance of the NNB-Iot-freq parameter in NB-IoT cell selection?
q_32305.ground_truth: The NNB-Iot-freq parameter represents the total number of NB-IoT frequencies that are required to be monitored for RRC re-establishment. The value is 1 if the target cell is already known.

q_32306.question: What actions will the SMF take when it receives the "new or updated PCC rule" and the "DDNEventPolicyControl2" feature is supported?
q_32306.ground_truth: The SMF will perform the DDD Status and/or DDN Failure event based on the downlink data notification control information within the PCC rule.

q_32307.question: What is the sum of the mean power of the UE at each transmit antenna connector in the channel bandwidth of the radio access mode that should be measured in step 3 of the test procedure?
q_32307.ground_truth: The sum of the mean power of the UE at each transmit antenna connector in the channel bandwidth of the radio access mode should be measured in step 3 of the test procedure.

q_32308.question: In the case of manual network selection and shared OPLMN cells on E-UTRAN and GERAN, what must the UE do when the USER selects an OPLMN and a RAT combination?
q_32308.ground_truth: The UE must attempt to attach on the selected OPLMN and RAT combination and indicate the PLMN to the user once successfully registered.

q_32309.question: What should the MCVideo client include in a P-Preferred-Service header field of the SIP INVITE request for a private call with transmission control?
q_32309.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should include an ICSI value "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcvideo" (coded as specified in 3GPP TS 24.229) in a P-Preferred-Service header field in the SIP INVITE request.

q_32310.question: What HTTP status code does the UAE-C send to the UAE-S upon successfully updating the registration information of a UAV?
q_32310.ground_truth: The UAE-C sends the HTTP 200 (OK) response towards the UAE-S.

q_32311.question: What are the five functionalities supported by SLPP for sidelink positioning procedures between UEs?
q_32311.ground_truth: The five functionalities supported by SLPP for sidelink positioning procedures between UEs are SL Positioning Capability Transfer, SL Positioning Assistance Data exchange, SL Location Information Transfer, Error handling, and Abort.

q_32312.question: What should the S-CSCF do when it receives a REGISTER request with a security mechanism set to "AKAv1-MD5"?
q_32312.ground_truth: The S-CSCF should include the IK and CK parameters for the P-CSCF in the "ik" and "ck" header field parameters, respecitively, and populate the WWW-Authenticate header field with the "realm", "nonce" and "algorithm" header field parameters.

q_32313.question: What is the purpose of the SMF indicating for each QoS Flow whether redundant transmission should be performed by a corresponding redundant transmission indicator?
q_32313.ground_truth: The SMF may indicate for each QoS Flow whether redundant transmission should be performed by a corresponding redundant transmission indicator to ensure reliable data transfer for specific QoS Flows, if needed.

q_32314.question: What should the SGW do when the SGSN is down for a duration longer than the maximum path failure duration and there is no alternative reachable path?
q_32314.ground_truth: The SGW should locally delete the maintained PDN connections associated with the failed path.

q_32315.question: What type of information does a V'-Trace provide?
q_32315.ground_truth: A V'-Trace provides a time series of received video frames together with an associated encoding and delivery quality.

q_32316.question: What are the three aspects that an MSE implementation may consist of?
q_32316.ground_truth: An MSE implementation may consist of the MSE SDK abstraction, the MSE SDK instantiation, and the MSE service.

q_32317.question: What interfaces are used for the "MME to SGSN Routing Area Update" procedure?
q_32317.ground_truth: The S11 interface is used for the "MME to SGSN Routing Area Update" procedure.

q_32318.question: What is the difference between "shall" and "must" in 3GPP technical specifications?
q_32318.ground_truth: In 3GPP technical specifications, "shall" is used to indicate a mandatory requirement, while "must" is typically used in direct citations from external documents.

q_32319.question: What is the purpose of the test procedure in step 6.3.2.1.2?
q_32319.ground_truth: The purpose of the test procedure in step 6.3.2.1.2 is to verify that the NR inter-frequency RRC re-establishment delay in FR1 without known target cell is within the specified limits.

q_32320.question: How does the value of TreselectionRAT change for the UE in the medium or high mobility state as defined in subclause.3.1?
q_32320.ground_truth: The value of TreselectionRAT is scaled when the UE is in the medium or high mobility state as defined in subclause.3.1.

q_32321.question: What is the maximum difference in SS-RSRP measurement for a UE to consider a NR neighbor cell for reselection based on absolute priorities for 2 Rx RedCap?
q_32321.ground_truth: For SS-RSRP reselections based on absolute priorities for 2 Rx RedCap, the maximum difference is 7.5 dB in FR2 and 6 dB in FR1.

q_32322.question: What is the purpose of the Delay in sending direction (handset UE) in subclause 8.10.1?
q_32322.ground_truth: The purpose is to measure the UE delay in the sending direction by measuring the delay between MRP and the electrical access point of the test equipment and subtracting the delays introduced by the test equipment from the measured value.

q_32323.question: What should the ME do if it receives a command that it does not support?
q_32323.ground_truth: The ME should inform the UICC using TERMINAL RESPONSE (Command beyond ME's capabilities).

q_32324.question: What is the unit for Mn, Ofn, and Ocn in the formula?
q_32324.ground_truth: Mn is expressed in dBm (in case of RSRP), or in dB (in case of RSRQ and RS-SINR), while Ofn and Ocn are expressed in dB.

q_32325.question: What information is delivered over the LI_X2 interface for target positioning and triggered location?
q_32325.ground_truth: The information delivered includes the target identity, target reported location(s), date/time(s) the location(s) were established, additional location parameters based on operator policy, and correlation information.

q_32326.question: Which measurement types are used to determine measurements for connected mode mobility in NR?
q_32326.ground_truth: The measurement types used in NR are Intra-frequency NR measurements, Inter-frequency NR measurements, Inter-RAT measurements for E-UTRA, and Inter-RAT measurements for UTRA.

q_32327.question: What is the minimum information needed to determine if a device supports the playback of a specific media profile in 5G Media Streaming?
q_32327.ground_truth: A well-defined MIME type and a well-defined codecs parameter following the requirements in RFC 6381 are needed to determine if a device supports the playback of a specific media profile in 5G Media Streaming.

q_32328.question: Which clause in the document specifies the minimum requirement for the OTA RE power control dynamic range for BS type 1-O?

q_32329.question: What should the UE do after receiving the AN release with redirection or completing the handover procedure?
q_32329.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the TAU procedure.

q_32330.question: What is the resolution of the reporting range for SRS-RSRP?
q_32330.ground_truth: The resolution of the reporting range for SRS-RSRP is 1 dB.

q_32331.question: What is the purpose of the LIU procedure in the context of UE-to-UE Relay?
q_32331.ground_truth: The Link Identifier Update (LIU) procedure is used to update the identifiers and security parameters of the management link between a UE and the UE-to-UE Relay, in order to maintain security and privacy in the communication.

q_32332.question: When the SCG is deactivated, what sublayer for SCG is not reported in MR-DC?
q_32332.ground_truth: PHR for SCG is not reported while the SCG is deactivated in MR-DC.

q_32333.question: What is a Non-Public Network (NPN) in the context of 5G systems?
q_32333.ground_truth: A Non-Public Network (NPN) in the context of 5G systems is a network that is deployed for non-public use and can be either a Stand-alone Non-Public Network (SNPN) or a Public Network Integrated NPN (PNI-NPN).

q_32334.question: Under what condition the AMF does not provide the valid current 5G NAS security context to the UE upon receiving a REGISTRATION REQUEST message?
q_32334.ground_truth: The AMF does not provide the valid current 5G NAS security context indicated by the UE if it indicates the use of the new mapped 5G NAS security context to the UE by setting the type of security context flag in the ngKSI IE to "mapped security context" and the KSI value related to the security context of the source system or sets the ngKSI value to "000" in the ngKSI IE for a UE that has an emergency PDU session.

q_32335.question: What action should the controlling MCPTT function take if the regroup is in an in-progress emergency state while processing a request to remove the regroup?
q_32335.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function should send a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response with warning text "169 user not authorised to remove regroup in an emergency state".

q_32336.question: How is a channel occupancy time determined in the present document?
q_32336.ground_truth: A Channel Occupancy Time refers to the total time for which eNB/gNB/UE and any eNB/gNB/UE(s) sharing the channel occupancy perform transmission(s) on a channel after an eNB/gNB performs the corresponding channel access procedures described in this clause.

q_32337.question: What is the effect of solution 19 on the UE in trusted non-3GPP access?
q_32337.ground_truth: Solution 19 enables the UE to select an appropriate SSID associated with the requested NSSAI in trusted non-3GPP access, and build the realm of NAI with the appropriate TNGF ID, so that the TNAP can select the target TNGF based on the SSID selected by the UE and the realm part of NAI provided by the UE.

q_32338.question: What is the trigger for interaction between V-CHF and H-CHF in a charging session?
q_32338.ground_truth: The trigger for interaction between V-CHF and H-CHF in a charging session is the reception of a charging data request by the V-CHF from another NF consumer. V-CHF may filter or convert the trigger from its NF consumer for 5G data connectivity charging, using either FBC or QBC triggers to trigger a charging data request towards the H-CHF.

q_32339.question: What action should the transmitting side of an AM RLC entity take when it receives a negative acknowledgement for an AMD PDU or a portion of an AMD PDU?
q_32339.ground_truth: The transmitting side of the AM RLC entity should consider the AMD PDU or the portion of the AMD PDU for retransmission.

q_32340.question: What is the main purpose of the pre-test conditions described in the mentioned test case?
q_32340.ground_truth: The main purpose of the pre-test conditions is to define the initial state of the cell, the system information used, and the state of the UE for the test case execution.

q_32341.question: What should the target UE do if it wants to derive the KNRP-sess and NRPIK when signalling integrity protection is required but not in a direct communication between two specific UEs?
q_32341.ground_truth: The target UE should derive KNRP-sess from KNRP, Nonce_1, and Nonce_2 received in the PROSE DIRECT LINK SECURITY MODE COMMAND message and then derive NRPIK from KNRP-sess and the selected integrity algorithm.

q_32342.question: What is the meaning of the " incoming trunk group" and "outgoing trunk group" parameters in the described CDRs?
q_32342.ground_truth: The "incoming trunk group" describes the trunk on which the call originates as seen from the MSC, and for mobile originated calls this will generally be a BSS trunk. The "outgoing trunk group" describes the trunk on which the call leaves the MSC.

q_32343.question: What must the PCF set when installing a new dynamic PCF-provisioned PCC rule in order to specify the precedence of the rule among other PCC rules?
q_32343.ground_truth: The PCF must set the "precedence" attribute within the PccRule data structure.

q_32344.question: Which network entity is responsible for managing Uu Relay RLC channels for L2 MP Relay using N3C in a 5G network?
q_32344.ground_truth: The F1 UE context management function is used for managing Uu Relay RLC channels for L2 MP Relay using N3C in a 5G network, i.e. establishing, modifying and releasing Uu Relay RLC channel resources. The establishment of Uu Relay RLC channels is triggered by the gNB-CU.
