q_32345.question: In Solution 10, what is the additional information included in the existing procedures for providing the time the UE will remain in coverage?
q_32345.ground_truth: The expected in coverage time is added when the AMF determines the UE is using satellite access and becomes reachable.

q_32346.question: What restrictions apply on UE performing radio link monitoring with a different subcarrier spacing than PDSCH/PDCCH on FR1 if the UE does not support simultaneousRxDataSSB-DiffNumerology?
q_32346.ground_truth: The UE is not expected to transmit PUCCH, PUSCH or SRS or receive PDCCH, PDSCH or CSI-RS for tracking or CSI-RS for CQI on SSB symbols to be measured for radio link monitoring.

q_32347.question: What is the semantic of the x3gpp:DeltaSupport XML element within the MPD update functionality?
q_32347.ground_truth: The x3gpp:DeltaSupport XML element within the MPD update functionality indicates whether the server supports MPD delta files, the URI of the MPD delta, and the availability duration of the MPD delta file.

q_32348.question: What are the functions of the S1 reference point in 5GS?
q_32348.ground_truth: The S1 reference point consists of S1-MME and S1-U sub-interfaces. S1-MME is responsible for the control plane protocol between E-UTRAN and MME, while S1-U handles per bearer user plane tunnelling and inter eNodeB path switching during handover. However, S1-U does not apply to the Control Plane CIoT EPS Optimisation.

q_32349.question: What should the "notifFlag" attribute be set to in order to unmute event notifications and start sending notifications for available events again?

q_32350.question: What is the role of the NEF(PFDF) in 5G network?
q_32350.ground_truth: The NEF(PFDF) fetches the PFD information currently in use from UDR, compares it with the PFD information from the NWDAF, and determines whether to create/update/delete PFD information corresponding to the application ID.

q_32351.question: How many occurrences is the "xs:element" element with the name "discovery-entry-ID" defined in the "RestrictedDiscReq-info" and "RestrictedDiscovereeRsp-info" complex types?
q_32351.ground_truth: The "xs:element" element with the name "discovery-entry-ID" is defined twice, once in the "RestrictedDiscReq-info" complex type and once in the "RestrictedDiscovereeRsp-info" complex type.

q_32352.question: What is the maximum overall delay allowed in Test 1 for a UE supporting power class 1?
q_32352.ground_truth: The maximum overall delay allowed in Test 1 for a UE supporting power class 1 is 7682 ms.

q_32353.question: What is the role of a User info ID in the context of 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay discovery?
q_32353.ground_truth: A User info ID is used for the UE-to-network relay discovery to identify the user information.

q_32354.question: What information is included in the Network Assistance Termination message and how is it sent?
q_32354.ground_truth: The Network Assistance Termination message includes the SessionID parameter, which is allocated by the DANE when the session is initiated. It is sent to the DANE within a SAND message envelope, with the same senderID used in the corresponding session initiation request.

q_32355.question: What should the MAC entity do when a partial reset is requested by upper layers?
q_32355.ground_truth: The MAC entity should initialize Bj for each logical channel to zero, stop all timers, consider all timeAlignmentTimers as expired and perform the corresponding actions, set the NDIs for all uplink HARQ processes to the value 0, stop ongoing RACH procedure, discard explicitly signalled ra-PreambleIndex and ra-PRACH-MaskIndex, flush Msg3 buffer, cancel any triggered Scheduling Request, Buffer Status Reporting, or Power Headroom Reporting procedure, flush the soft buffers for all DL HARQ processes, consider the next received transmission for a TB as the very first transmission, and release any Temporary C-RNTI.

q_32356.question: What must the UE do when the 3GPP AAA server requests IMEI during emergency session via TWAN?
q_32356.ground_truth: The UE provides IMEI as specified in clause~6.4.2.7.

q_32357.question: What information is sent from MME1 to MME2 for further RFSP Index update from PCF?
q_32357.ground_truth: The RFSP index in use is sent from MME1 to MME2 as in the current specification.

q_32358.question: What is the role of the cyclic redundancy check (CRC) in the above passage?
q_32358.ground_truth: The cyclic redundancy check (CRC) is used to detect errors in the UL-SCH transport block in the above passage. It uses a generator polynomial to calculate parity bits for the entire transport block, and attaches the parity bits to the UL-SCH transport block. The bits after CRC attachment are used to calculate the CRC parity bits.

q_32359.question: What is the role of the Relay ID in the Layer-3 based UE-to-UE Relay re-selection procedure?
q_32359.ground_truth: The Relay ID is used as a unique identifier for the relay and is used in the Link Modification Request and Link Modification Accept messages, as well as in the DCR message, to associate the existing PC5 unicast link with the relay and to establish the new PC5 unicast link via the selected Relay.

q_32360.question: What approach is used for simulating antenna arrays in the CFFNF methodology using the Black-Box approach?
q_32360.ground_truth: The Black-Box approach in the CFFNF methodology assumes that the location of the active antenna panel for the far-field beam peak direction is unknown, and only the far-field BP direction is known. The method utilizes a relatively wide area local search at a specific range length and limited local searches at other range lengths.

q_32361.question: When should the mobile station ignore a call control message received with octet 1 part of the TI value not coded as "111"?
q_32361.ground_truth: When the message is received specifying a transaction identifier which is recognized as relating to an active call or to a call in progress.

q_32362.question: In what ways can a depth map be represented?
q_32362.ground_truth: A depth map can be represented in an absolute or relative, linear or non-linear manner, with pixels having the distance attribute. Metadata to explain the depth map is also often provided.

q_32363.question: What should the media storage function do if the user is not allowed to upload files due to transmission control policy?
q_32363.ground_truth: If the user is not allowed to upload files due to transmission control policy, the media storage function should return a HTTP 403 Forbidden response.

q_32364.question: What is the role of the LCS Correlation identifier in steps 9 and 14?
q_32364.ground_truth: The LCS Correlation identifier is used to link the requests and responses between the different entities involved in the process, such as the LMF and the serving AMF.

q_32365.question: What is the horizontal positioning accuracy at CDF=90% for approaches supporting dynamic TRP pattern, relative to approaches supporting fixed TRP pattern, for TRP reduction in direct AI/ML positioning?

q_32366.question: How many of the solutions that assume UE determination of satellite coverage also assume CN determination of satellite coverage?

q_32367.question: What information does SMF use in step~7 when determining the dynamic group that a UE should be part of?
q_32367.ground_truth: SMF uses DNAI and/or EAS in step~7 when determining the dynamic group that a UE should be part of.

q_32368.question: What is the primary difference between intra-band contiguous and non-contiguous UL CA in terms of spurious emissions?
q_32368.ground_truth: Spurious emission limits apply for the frequency ranges that are more than FOO (MHz) from the edge of the UL aggregated channel bandwidth for intra-band contiguous UL CA. However, for intra-band non-contiguous UL CA, testability and spurious emission limits are to be determined (TBD).

q_32369.question: What is the role of the MC server in the connection authorization process?
q_32369.ground_truth: The MC server performs an authorization check for access via the MC gateway UE and sends the connection authorization response to the MC gateway UE, which then sends it to the MC client.

q_32370.question: What should the UE do if no 5G-GUTI is included in the Registration Accept message?
q_32370.ground_truth: If no 5G-GUTI is included in the Registration Accept message, then the UE uses the 5G-GUTI assigned for the existing registration also for the new registration.

q_32371.question: What action does MGCF initiate when the destination party answers?
q_32371.ground_truth: MGCF initiates a H.248 interaction to make the connection in the MGW bi-directional.

q_32372.question: When is a UE not required to continuously measure a cell after detecting it in a higher priority search?
q_32372.ground_truth: If, after detecting a cell in a higher priority search, it is determined that reselection has not occurred, the UE is not required to continuously measure the detected cell.

q_32373.question: What is the main role of the runtime-supplied compositor in the workflow for XR visual media?
q_32373.ground_truth: The main role of the runtime-supplied compositor is to offload the composition of the final image, significantly lowering the rendering complexity for the application.

q_32374.question: What is the role of the UDM in the 5G network when the UE re-attaches to the same AMF or becomes reachable after a failure from the AMF?
q_32374.ground_truth: The UDM checks the authentication pending flag and performs reauthentication if needed. Once UE reauthentication is done, the AMF resets the authentication pending flag.

q_32375.question: Which type of threats are associated with users who deny performing an action without other parties having any way to prove otherwise?

q_32376.question: What indication should be given by a terminating UE in the SDP offer if the desired QoS resources for one or more media streams have not been reserved and the precondition mechanism is used?
q_32376.ground_truth: The terminating UE should indicate the related local preconditions for QoS as not met, using the segmented status type as defined in RFC 3312 and RFC 4032, as well as the strength-tag value "mandatory" for the local segment and the strength-tag value "optional" for the remote segment.

q_32377.question: What must the participating MCVideo function do if it cannot find a binding between the public user identity and an MCVideo ID, or if the validity period of an existing binding has expired?
q_32377.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function shall reject the SIP REFER request with a SIP 404 (Not Found) response with the warning text set to "141 user unknown to the participating function" in a Warning header field and shall not continue with any of the remaining steps.

q_32378.question: What is the purpose of Sub-procedure 6.24.1 in describing 5GS assistance to Federated Learning?
q_32378.ground_truth: Sub-procedure 6.24.1 describes the solution for addressing how and what information the 5GC provides to the AI/ML application server for UE selection in FL operations. The goal is to ensure that the training process does not lead to network performance degradation or significant fee increase for clients.

q_32379.question: Which hash algorithms are recommended for use when creating version 3 certificates?
q_32379.ground_truth: SHA-256 is recommended, SHA-384 should be supported, while MD5, MD2, and SHA-1 are not recommended.

q_32380.question: What should the ATCF do when it receives a SIP INVITE request due to STN-SR, and a transferable session set does not contain any sessions?
q_32380.ground_truth: If the identity in the P-Asserted-Identity header field is a C-MSISDN that is bound to a registration path in the ATCF, the ATCF shall determine whether a transferable SIP INVITE request exists.

q_32381.question: In what mode will the UE stay if the lower layers indicate that access barring is applicable for all access categories except categories 0 and 2?
q_32381.ground_truth: The UE will stay in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode with RRC inactive indication.

q_32382.question: What information can the client use when the 5G Media Streaming system provides dynamic information with the media stream?
q_32382.ground_truth: The client can use the information to optimize its own quality, and act fairly by only requesting higher bit rates when the content is more complex.

q_32383.question: What is the use of the "Ending Suffix Code" parameter in relation to the "ProSe Application Code Suffix Range"?
q_32383.ground_truth: The "Ending Suffix Code" parameter has the same length as the "Beginning Suffix Code" parameter in the "ProSe Application Code Suffix Range". If there is only one ProSe Application Code Suffix, then the "Beginning Suffix Code" represents that single suffix and the "Ending Suffix Code" is omitted.

q_32384.question: When must the UE send a NAS Security Mode Complete message?
q_32384.ground_truth: The UE shall send the NAS Security Mode Complete message to the network in response to a NAS Security Mode Command message. The NAS Security Mode Complete message shall include the complete initial NAS message in a NAS Container if either requested by the AMF or the UE sent the initial NAS message unprotected.

q_32385.question: What is the requirement for the fraction of falsely detected ACKs and correctly detected ACKs in the test for ACK missed detection?
q_32385.ground_truth: The fraction of falsely detected ACKs shall be less than 1% and the fraction of correctly detected ACKs shall be larger than 99%.

q_32386.question: What is the meaning of the example value "0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0" in the reference vector file?
q_32386.ground_truth: The value "0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0" in the reference vector file places the acoustic reference in front of the listener.

q_32387.question: What is the new Application Id for the STa application when using the MAG to AAA interface defined in IETF RFC 5779 and the NAS to AAA interface defined in IETF RFC 5447?

q_32388.question: What is the effect of not providing a usage threshold in sponsored connectivity when the NF service consumer is in the user plane?
q_32388.ground_truth: If the NF service consumer is in the user plane, the AF can handle the usage monitoring and therefore it is not required to provide a usage threshold to the PCF as part of the sponsored connectivity functionality.

q_32389.question: What message does the AMF send to the NG-RAN node to request the start or stop of reporting RAN timing synchronization status information?

q_32390.question: What happens to gaps with lower priority when there is a collision between two gaps with different priorities?
q_32390.ground_truth: The gaps with lower priority will be dropped.

q_32391.question: When should the UE initiate the tracking area updating procedure by sending a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message to the MME?
q_32391.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the tracking area updating procedure in the following cases: when the periodic tracking area updating timer T3412 expires, when the UE has to request resources for ProSe direct discovery or Prose direct communication.

q_32392.question: What should the MSGin5G Server include in the CoAP payload as it sends a message response in a new CoAP POST request to the originating entity?
q_32392.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Server shall include the originating MSGin5G Client's address, the "MSGin5G service identifier", the "Originating UE Service ID", "Message ID", "Delivery Status", "Failure Cause" (if applicable), and a "Message Type" set to "MSGRESP" in the CoAP payload.

q_32393.question: What is the purpose of the NEF in the 5G network with regards to Application AI/ML traffic?
q_32393.ground_truth: The NEF, in collaboration with SA~WG5, sets charging rules for the chargeable party and updates SM policy for the Application AI/ML traffic based on the analysis information, so as to perform the enhanced charging for Application AI/ML traffic transmission.

q_32394.question: What action must the LMF take if the NF service consumer has requested an intermediate response?
q_32394.ground_truth: If the NF service consumer has requested an intermediate response, the LMF must perform positioning procedures and determine multiple location estimates within the maximum response time.

q_32395.question: What is the purpose of service authorization information in scheduled resource allocation mode for Ranging/SL Positioning?
q_32395.ground_truth: The purpose of service authorization information in scheduled resource allocation mode for Ranging/SL Positioning is to be provisioned to NG-RAN for the support of Ranging/SL Positioning.

q_32396.question: What Technical Specifications are included in the analysis for resource control in the 5GS context?

q_32397.question: What are the cells' roles in section 11.6.1.1.4.1?
q_32397.ground_truth: In section 11.6.1.1.4.1, Cell 1 is the PCell, and Cell 2 is the target cell.

q_32398.question: What is the OTA RX spurious emissions requirement for RX only multi-band RIB in each supported operating band?
q_32398.ground_truth: The OTA RX spurious emissions requirements for RX only multi-band RIB in each supported operating band are subject to exclusion zones.

q_32399.question: When does data forwarding from the last serving SN take place in the SN Modification procedure?
q_32399.ground_truth: Data forwarding from the last serving SN takes place as early as the last serving SN receives the early data forwarding address in step 17.

q_32400.question: What is the purpose of adjusting the test signal mean power when setting up the test environment in the OTA test setup?
q_32400.ground_truth: The purpose of adjusting the test signal mean power is to ensure that the calibrated radiated SNR value at the BS receiver is as specified for the respective BS type, and that the SNR at the BS receiver is not impacted by the noise floor.

q_32401.question: Who is the test applicability in 6.2E.1.1.2 and 6.2E.1.3.1.2?
q_32401.ground_truth: The test applicability in 6.2E.1.1.2 is for NR V2X operation or E-UTRA V2X operation, and the test applicability in 6.2E.1.3.1.2 is for all types of E-UTRA UE release 16 and forward supporting concurrent operation between E-UTRA Uu and NR sidelink.

q_32402.question: What does the ' reporting' parameter represent in the 10.1.80 DNS server address reporting command?
q_32402.ground_truth: The ' reporting' parameter in the 10.1.80 DNS server address reporting command enables or disables reporting of DNS server addresses received from the network.

q_32403.question: What procedure is used by the MME to establish a NAS security association between the UE and MME in order to protect further NAS signalling messages or make changes in the security association?
q_32403.ground_truth: The NAS Security Mode Command (SMC) procedure.

q_32404.question: What should the UE do after disabling the E-UTRA capability?
q_32404.ground_truth: The UE NAS layer shall indicate the access stratum layer(s) of disabling of the E-UTRA capability.

q_32405.question: What should be the minimum number of successful tests for the RRC connection release with redirection to GERAN to pass the test?
q_32405.ground_truth: The minimum number of successful tests for the RRC connection release with redirection to GERAN to pass the test is more than 90% of the cases with a confidence level of 95%.

q_32406.question: What is the role of the PEGC in Personal IoT Networks in 5GS?
q_32406.ground_truth: The PEGC supports the relay path between PINE and 5GS, the traffic relay between PINEs, PIN discovery and status report, access control and traffic enforcement, triggering the activation of communication path with the PINE for DL traffic, and traffic routing for non-PIN capable devices.

q_32407.question: What is the responsibility of the Core Functions in the Media Session Handler of a UE in the 5G System?
q_32407.ground_truth: The Core Functions are responsible for realizing a "session" concept for media communications, optionally spanning multiple stateless sessions. It may also interact with network-based 5GMSd AFs.

q_32408.question: What does the value 1 mean in the field "S/U" in the contention-free Random Access Resources?
q_32408.ground_truth: If the value of the field "S/U" is set to 1, it means that SUL (Secondary Universal) is used for PRACH (Physical Random Access Channel) transmission.

q_32409.question: What is the broadcast delivery status reported via the "broadcastDelStatus" attribute in the MbsSessionEventReport data structure?
q_32409.ground_truth: The broadcast delivery status, encoded via the "broadcastDelStatus" attribute in the MbsSessionEventReport data structure, indicates whether the MBS session is STARTED or TERMINATED.

q_32410.question: What is the procedure for providing RAN additional information about all QoS flows to be considered for joint admission?
q_32410.ground_truth: AF requests all service flows from the 5GS together in a single request or a batch of correlated requests with a batch correlation ID, and 5GS handles and admits them one by one.

q_32411.question: What is the percentage of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channel that the throughput measured shall be greater than or equal to, for high speed train in clause 8.2.5.5?
q_32411.ground_truth: The throughput measured shall be greater than or equal to 70% of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channel.

q_32412.question: What action does the MME take after receiving a Reject Paging Indication from the UE?
q_32412.ground_truth: The MME uses the Downlink Data Notification Failure Indication message to notify the Serving GW that the UE rejected the page and no user plane radio bearers will be established.

q_32413.question: What actions should the network take in case of a de-registration procedure collision?
q_32413.ground_truth: If the network receives a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST with "switch off" indication, the network shall consider both procedures completed if the access types are the same, or re-initiate the de-registration procedure for the access type not indicated if they are different. If the network receives a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message without "switch off" indication, the network shall send a DEREGISTRATION ACCEPT message to the UE.

q_32414.question: What is the purpose of the Retrieve UE Context Confirm procedure in RACH based SDT without UE context relocation?
q_32414.ground_truth: The Retrieve UE Context Confirm procedure is used to request the termination of SDT session from the new NG-RAN node to the old NG-RAN node in RACH based SDT without UE context relocation.

q_32415.question: What potential threats face virtualized 3GPP NFs in a MANO system, and what security requirements could address these threats?
q_32415.ground_truth: Without appropriate protection, virtualized 3GPP NFs could be compromised, data within virtualized 3GPP NFs could be eavesdropped or tampered, and incorrect management information could be supplied by a compromised MANO system. Increasing assurance that virtualized 3GPP NFs are protected from being attacked via a compromised MANO system, providing isolation and redundancy, and conducting internal health checks are requirements to address these threats.

q_32416.question: Which reference point is functionally equivalent to the Gy reference point for online flow based bearer charging in PCEF?

q_32417.question: What does the qoe-Streaming-MeasReport-r17 ENUMERATED indicate in the AppLayerMeasParameters-r17 SEQUENCE?
q_32417.ground_truth: The qoe-Streaming-MeasReport-r17 ENUMERATED indicates whether a UE is capable of supporting Streaming measurement report-r17 in RAN.

q_32418.question: What is a new requirement needed to support the use case described in PR. 5.3.6-002?
q_32418.ground_truth: The 5G system shall be able to indicate to the evolved residential gateway that a specific UE connected to it either via 3GPP RAT or non-3GPP (R)AT needs specific QoS and what the required QoS characteristics are.

q_32419.question: When is the measurement time for a single PRS positioning occasion in E-UTRAN FDD intra-frequency RSTD measurements?
q_32419.ground_truth: It is ms, where the PRS measurement time for a single PRS positioning occasion includes the sampling time and the processing time.

q_32420.question: How can a single LPP transaction be realized in 3GPP EPS Control Plane solution?
q_32420.ground_truth: A single LLP transaction can be realized as multiple procedures in 3GPP EPS Control Plane solution. For example, a single transaction for provision of assistance data can consist of several Provide Assistance Data messages, with each message being a separate procedure.

q_32421.question: What is the purpose of the 5-bit "modulation and coding scheme" field in the DCI?
q_32421.ground_truth: The purpose of the 5-bit "modulation and coding scheme" field in the DCI is to indicate the modulation and coding scheme used in the physical downlink shared channel.

q_32422.question: Which ASN.1 module is being imported into the F1AP-PDU-Descriptions module?
q_32422.ground_truth: F1AP-CommonDataTypes, F1AP-PDU-Contents, and F1AP-Constants modules are being imported into the F1AP-PDU-Descriptions module as they contain important parameter types, messages, and constants required for defining and using procedures.

q_32423.question: What does the "associationThreshold" attribute determine in the "GeoAreaToCellMapping" data type?
q_32423.ground_truth: The "associationThreshold" attribute determines the lower boundary of the coverage ratio for mapping a geographical area to cells.

q_32424.question: What should the MAC entity do if the sPBR of a logical channel is set to infinity?
q_32424.ground_truth: If the sPBR of a logical channel is set to infinity, the MAC entity should allocate resources for all the data that is available for transmission on the logical channel before meeting the sPBR of the lower priority logical channel(s).

q_32425.question: What should the MCVideo client do upon receiving a SIP INFO request containing a release-reason?
q_32425.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should not provide any indication that an ambient viewing call is being terminated if the cached ambient viewing client role is equal to "viewed-to MCVideo user". If the cached ambient viewing client role is equal to "viewing MCVideo user", it should provide an indication to the MCVideo user that an ambient viewing call is being terminated. It should also generate and send a SIP 200 OK response to the SIP INFO request and comply with the procedures of clause~15.2.2.5.

q_32426.question: What keys and key identifiers are associated with the on-network group call and are used to derive SRTP-MK, SRTP-MS, and SRTP-MKI for encrypting and decrypting media in SRTP?

q_32427.question: What should the UE do if the maximum number of preamble transmission counter has been reached for the random access procedure on PCell or PSCell?
q_32427.ground_truth: The UE should indicate a random access problem to upper layers if the maximum number of preamble transmission counter has been reached for the random access procedure on PCell or PSCell.

q_32428.question: Who is the intended device for the applicability of the test described in section 9.1.42.1.2 of the document?
q_32428.ground_truth: The applicability of the test described in section 9.1.42.1.2 of the document is for all types of E-UTRA HD-FDD operation Category 0 UE from release 12 and forward.

q_32429.question: What should the UP function do when detecting the start or stop of an application, and a PFCP session is not linked to any specific TDF session?
q_32429.ground_truth: The UP function should initiate the PFCP Session Report procedure and send a Usage Report with the Usage Report Trigger set to 'Start of Traffic' or 'Stop of Traffic'.

q_32430.question: What does the "UE" need to do before initiating the RRC connection establishment in the presence of EAB?
q_32430.ground_truth: The UE must have a valid version of SystemInformationBlockType14 if it is broadcast.

q_32431.question: What is the physical cell identity setting during time period T2, within the loop of the test procedure?
q_32431.ground_truth: The physical cell identity of Cell 2 is changed to ensure Cell 2 is not detected by the UE.

q_32432.question: In what scenario is the HSS required to report the capabilities of different nodes to the SCEF?
q_32432.ground_truth: If the HSS is aware that the UE is registered in an MME and an SGSN, and the services supported by the MME and SGSN are different.

q_32433.question: What should the SC UE do when it receives a SIP BYE request for a session subject for access transfer and before the access transfer is completed?
q_32433.ground_truth: If the SC UE receives a SIP BYE request for a session subject for access transfer and before the access transfer is completed, the SC UE shall send the SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP BYE request and abort the transfer of the session.

q_32434.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification in the document?
q_32434.ground_truth: The purpose of the 3GPP in the document is to define procedures to limit the effects of failure of a location register and to restore the location register data automatically in mobile communication networks.

q_32435.question: What is the purpose of the IWF performing the broadcast group call procedure as specified in subclause~10.3.4?
q_32435.ground_truth: The IWF performs the broadcast group call procedure to initiate a group call involving multiple parties.

q_32436.question: What attribute must be set to a unique string in the "d" element?
q_32436.ground_truth: The "id" attribute of the "d" element must be set to a unique string.

q_32437.question: What must the SMF provide within the "servingNetwork" attribute when requested by the PCF?
q_32437.ground_truth: The SMF shall provide the serving PLMN Identifier or the SNPN Identifier (the PLMN Identifier and the NID) within the "servingNetwork" attribute.

q_32438.question: What must the NF service consumer include in the service request when using indirect communication with delegated discovery?
q_32438.ground_truth: The NF service consumer must include discovery and selection parameters necessary to discover and select a NF service producer.

q_32439.question: Which public warning system developed for the delivery of multiple, concurrent warning notifications uses the same AS mechanisms as CMAS?

q_32440.question: What are some of the issues that may arise with emergency calls in extraterritorial areas, such as at sea or in international waters?
q_32440.ground_truth: One issue is routing emergency calls to the correct Public Safety Answering Point (PSAP), which may be difficult if it is not clear which legal jurisdiction the UE is located in. Another issue is determining which emergency call numbers should be supported in extraterritorial areas, as different countries and regions may use different numbers for similar types of emergency calls. Satellite operators may need to take the location of the UE into account to determine which emergency call numbers apply in a given situation.

q_32441.question: What message does the UE send to the AMF when it sends an Uplink Positioning message in a NAS TRANSPORT message?
q_32441.ground_truth: The UE includes the Routing identifier received in step 3 in the UL NAS TRANSPORT message.

q_32442.question: What must the ADT Transfer Policy support to transport Application AI/ML traffic?
q_32442.ground_truth: The ADT Transfer Policy must support the list of primary and alternative QoS profiles for additional QoS parameters like Packet Delay Budget, Maximum Packet Loss Rate, Guaranteed and Maximum Bitrate for UL/DL per UE per time window.

q_32443.question: What network component stops the running Service Gap timer when a UE moves from EPC to 5GC?
q_32443.ground_truth: The MME stops the running Service Gap timer when a UE moves from EPC to 5GC.

q_32444.question: What is the LTMCells-ToBeReleased-Item::= SEQUENCE sequence used for?
q_32444.ground_truth: The LTMCells-ToBeReleased-Item::= SEQUENCE sequence is used to release an LTE cell from the LTE network. It specifies the NRCGI (Network Cell Global Identifier) of the cell to be released and any additional information (iE-Extensions) that may be required.

q_32445.question: What does the "Slice Support List" IE indicate?
q_32445.ground_truth: The "Slice Support List" IE indicates the list of supported slices.

q_32446.question: In the context of a TAB connector, what does the basic limit P<sub>EM,N</sub> refer to in clause 6.6.5.5.4.3?
q_32446.ground_truth: The basic limit P<sub>EM,N</sub> refers to the level of emissions in the band 470-790 MHz, measured in an 8~MHz filter bandwidth on center frequencies F<sub>filter</sub> for a TAB connector operating in Band~20/n20.

q_32447.question: What should the MCData client do if it receives a SIP 4xx response, SIP 5xx response or SIP 6xx response to a SIP request for a priority group communication?
q_32447.ground_truth: Upon receiving such a response, the MCData client sets the emergency group communication state to "MDEGC 1: emergency-gc-capable" if the emergency group communication state was set to "MDEGC~2: emergency-communication-requested" or "MDEGC~3: emergency-communication-granted". If the emergency group state of the group was set to "MDEG 4: confirm-pending", it is set to "MDEG 1: no-emergency". If the sent SIP request contained an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body with an <alert-ind> element set to a value of "true", it sets the MCData emergency alert state to "MDEA 1: no-alert".

q_32448.question: What is the purpose of the "Linked Traffic Endpoint ID" in the FAR?
q_32448.ground_truth: The "Linked Traffic Endpoint ID" in the FAR identifies the traffic endpoint allocated for this PFCP session to receive the traffic in the reverse direction. It allows the UPF to correlate the uplink and downlink traffic for the same bearer.

q_32449.question: What should the MCVideo server do for a functional alias ID which has an entry in the served list of functional alias information entries, but the expiration time has already expired?
q_32449.ground_truth: The MCVideo server should add a new functional alias information entry in the candidate list of the functional alias information list for the functional alias ID, and set the functional alias status to the "activating" state.

q_32450.question: What is the test described in section 4.3.4.4.4 for, in regards to increased UE carrier monitoring?
q_32450.ground_truth: The test described in section 4.3.4.4.4 is to verify the requirement for E-UTRA TDD to UTRA TDD inter-RAT cell reselection for increased UE carrier monitoring, where UTRA TDD cells are of lower priority than E-UTRA serving cell.

q_32451.question: What are the three EAP authentication methods that the AMF can choose to authenticate UE?
q_32451.ground_truth: 5G AKA, EAP-AKA', or any other key-generating EAP authentication method.

q_32452.question: What should be the value of time alignment timers during the test?
q_32452.ground_truth: Time alignment timers should be set to "infinity" during the test to maintain UL timing alignment.

q_32453.question: What is the total measurement period for aggregated measurements, as defined in clause 5.6.2.6?
q_32453.ground_truth: The total measurement period for aggregated measurements is defined as the maximum of either the total measurement period for non-aggregated measurements or the sum of the total measurement period for non-aggregated measurements and a scaling factor when certain conditions are met.

q_32454.question: What should the NF service consumer respond with when the data change notification is received successfully?
q_32454.ground_truth: The NF service consumer should respond with "204 No Content" on success for data change notification or UE parameters update data delivery via a notification.

q_32455.question: What is the purpose and type of the A&C reference number information element?
q_32455.ground_truth: The A&C reference number information element is a type 1 information element and its purpose is to indicate to the network in the AUTHENTICATION AND CIPHERING RESPONSE message which AUTHENTICATION AND CIPHERING REQUEST message the MS is replying to.

q_32456.question: What action does the SCP take if none of the associated AMF service instances are available due to AMF failure?
q_32456.ground_truth: The SCP selects an AMF service instance from the backup AMF used for failure.

q_32457.question: What should the controlling MCPTT function do upon receiving a SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP INVITE request?
q_32457.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function shall interact with the media plane as specified in 3GPP TS 24.380.

q_32458.question: What should the UE do when the secure exchange of NAS messages has been established and the UE receives a valid NAS signalling message with integrity protection which requires a response from the UE?
q_32458.ground_truth: The UE should send the response as a security protected NAS message.

q_32459.question: If the UE is not able to perform registration update and is operating in single-registration mode, what should the UE handle in addition for the abnormal cases?
q_32459.ground_truth: Handle the EPS update status as specified in 3GPP TS 24.301 for LTE access

q_32460.question: What should the VAE-C include in the HTTP 200(OK) response message indicating acceptance or rejection of a dynamic group information update request?
q_32460.ground_truth: The VAE-C should include a <dynamic-group-update-consent-info> element with a <result> child element set to "accept" or "reject" in the <VAE-info> root element.

q_32461.question: What is the purpose of the 'Sequence number' parameter in messages transmitted over the PC3ach interface?
q_32461.ground_truth: The Sequence number parameter is used to indicate the sequence number of the usage information report. It increases by 1 whenever a new usage information report is created.

q_32462.question: What is the root element of the NetworkQoSManagementInfo document in XML schema?
q_32462.ground_truth: The root element of the NetworkQoSManagementInfo document in XML schema is <network-QoS-management-info>.

q_32463.question: What is the meaning of "SHALL" and "SHALL NOT" in the Network Resource Model (NRM)?
q_32463.ground_truth: "SHALL" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something, and "SHALL NOT" indicates a prohibition to do something in the context of normative provisions.

q_32464.question: What is the detection mode used for measuring TRP?
q_32464.ground_truth: The detection mode used is True RMS.

q_32465.question: Why does the source AMF send the uplink NAS COUNT value of 232-1 for deriving KeNB in a handover procedure from 5GS to EPS?
q_32465.ground_truth: This value is used to avoid any possibility that the same KeNB may be derived again, which can ensure security and prevent replay attacks in the handover process.

q_32466.question: What shall the service type be set to if the MS receives a paging request using P-TMSI for PS domain from the network in PMM-IDLE mode?
q_32466.ground_truth: The service type shall be set to "paging response".

q_32467.question: What is defined as an inter-frequency RSSI measurement?
q_32467.ground_truth: An RSSI measurement is defined as an inter-frequency measurement if the RSSI measurement bandwidth is not contained within the current carrier bandwidth of the UE.

q_32468.question: What is the range of values for the "Event Threshold for Event 1f" parameter in UMTS when the measurement quantity is CPICH RSCP?
q_32468.ground_truth: The range of values for the "Event Threshold for Event 1f" parameter in UMTS when the measurement quantity is CPICH RSCP is -120 to 25 dBm.

q_32469.question: What should a UE in connected mode with SCG activated do when T307 expires and it has PDCP SDUs available for transmission on the MCG DRB?
q_32469.ground_truth: The UE should transmit the uplink data on the MCG DRB.

q_32470.question: What is the procedure followed by the Reference UE to obtain the Ranging measurement of UE#1 and UE#2 in the Ranging service exposure?
q_32470.ground_truth: The Reference UE performs the authentication procedure to determine whether the SL Positioning Client UE is authorized to invoke the Ranging service, performs the Ranging and positioning procedure with UE#1 and UE#2 based on the solutions of KI#4, obtains the Ranging measurement of UE#1 and UE#2, and calculates the Ranging result between UE#1 and UE#2.

q_32471.question: When a UE accesses EPC via S2a using trusted non-3GPP IP access and establishes connections to additional PDNs, what should the UE include in the trigger for additional PDN connectivity?
q_32471.ground_truth: The UE should include an APN in this trigger to connect to the desired PDN and indicate the Attach Type to the trusted non-3GPP access during additional PDN connectivity, distinguishing between Initial Attach and Handover Attach.

q_32472.question: What type of intra-frequency SSB-based measurement is applied to a measurement object i when there is no measurement gap and none of the SMTC occasions are overlapped by the measurement gap?
q_32472.ground_truth: SSB-based intra-frequency measurement with no measurement gap in clause 9.2D.5, when none of the SMTC occasions of this intra-frequency measurement object are overlapped by the measurement gap.

q_32473.question: What is the maximum aggregate adjustment rate?
q_32473.ground_truth: The maximum aggregate adjustment rate is Tq per 200ms.

q_32474.question: What is the condition for the SS to switch the power setting from T1 to T2?
q_32474.ground_truth: The SS switches the power setting from T1 to T2 after the UE re-selects Cell 1 within T1, or when T1 expires.

q_32475.question: What is the trigger for starting the time in the calculation of the RSTD measurement accuracy?
q_32475.ground_truth: The time starts from the first subframe of the PRS positioning occasion closest in time after both the OTDOA-RequestLocationInformation message and the OTDOA assistance data in the OTDOA-ProvideAssistanceData message via LPP are delivered to the physical layer of the UE.

q_32476.question: What interfaces does the CP function control packet rate enforcement on when instructing the UP function?
q_32476.ground_truth: The CP function controls packet rate enforcement on the Sxb and N4 interfaces when instructing the UP function.

q_32477.question: In what format should the P-CSCF build the Via header field entry when adding its own address to the top of the received list, if a security association or TLS session exists?
q_32477.ground_truth: The P-CSCF builds the Via header field entry in a format that contains the protected server port number of the security association or TLS session established from the UE to the P-CSCF and either the P-CSCF FQDN or IP address of the security association or TLS session established from the UE to the P-CSCF.

q_32478.question: What action does the SCC AS take upon receiving a SIP 18x response on the remote leg after receiving a SIP INVITE request due to STN-SR or a SIP INVITE request due to ATU-STI, and this SIP 18x response does not require use of reliable provisional responses?
q_32478.ground_truth: The SCC AS stores the received SIP 18x responses and associated P-Early-Media header fields separately for each early dialog.

q_32479.question: In what situation is the "RAN timing synchronization" information element included?
q_32479.ground_truth: The "RAN timing synchronization" information element is included to provide information related to the RAN timing synchronization to a UE that has set the Reconnection to the network due to RAN timing synchronization status change bit to "Reconnection to the network due to RAN timing synchronization status change supported".

q_32480.question: What procedure is triggered by the PDN Connectivity procedure if the UE already has active PDN connections?
q_32480.ground_truth: The PDN Connectivity procedure may trigger one or multiple Dedicated Bearer Establishment procedures to establish dedicated EPS bearer(s) for that UE.

q_32481.question: What should the UE do if T3411 timer expires and attach attempt counter is less than 5 after sending an ATTACH REQUEST message?
q_32481.ground_truth: The UE should restart the attach procedure.

q_32482.question: Under what circumstances is a non-3GPP IP access network identified as an untrusted non-3GPP access network?
q_32482.ground_truth: When one or more of the security feature groups provided by the non-3GPP access network are considered not sufficiently secure by the home operator, the non-3GPP access may be identified as an untrusted non-3GPP access.

q_32483.question: What should the network do to indicate desired DL TX power adjustment to an IAB-node?
q_32483.ground_truth: The network may indicate to its parent node recommendations for DL TX power adjustment using the DL TX Power Adjustment MAC CE.

q_32484.question: What are the conditions for activation and deactivation of the SCell in the test procedure?
q_32484.ground_truth: Activation of the SCell occurs in subframe m, which is an even number, when the SS receives ACK for the MAC-CE sent by the UE. Deactivation of the SCell occurs in subframe n, when the SS sends the deactivation MAC-CE and receives ACK from the UE.

q_32485.question: What should the tester verify when establishing a secure connection between the network product under test and the peer in the SCAS?
q_32485.ground_truth: The tester should verify that all TLS protocol versions and combinations of cryptographic algorithms that are mandated by the TLS profile are supported by the network product under test, and that the network product under test cannot establish a connection when the peer only offers a feature that is forbidden by the TLS profile.

q_32486.question: What is the consequence for a UE that moves outside the subnetwork ID during the registration process?
q_32486.ground_truth: If the UE moves outside the subnetwork ID during the registration process, the UE does not initiate any procedure towards the hosting network. Instead, the UE may initiate network selection as in clause 6.10.2.1, which allows the UE to perform the network selection process while considering the subnetwork ID for localized services.

q_32487.question: Which field holds the IMS charging identifier for the SIP session/transaction?
q_32487.ground_truth: The ICID parameter, which holds the IMS charging identifier (ICID) as generated by the IMS node for the SIP session/transaction.

q_32488.question: What message is sent by the gNB-CU-CP during bearer context modification to setup the DL TNL address information for F1-U or Xn-U?
q_32488.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-CP sends a BEARER CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message containing the DL TNL address information for F1-U or Xn-U, and PDCP status.

q_32489.question: In subtest 1, what is the maximum duration that the UE shall stop transmitting uplink signal after T3 in both subtest 1 and subtest 2?
q_32489.ground_truth: In subtest 1, the UE shall stop transmitting uplink signal no later than 900 ms after the start of T3 in both subtest 1 and subtest 2.

q_32490.question: When is the relay service code parameter set to the specific value for emergency service?
q_32490.ground_truth: The relay service code parameter is set to the specific value for emergency service when the UE is triggered by an upper layer application to announce availability of an emergency connectivity service and certain conditions are met.

q_32491.question: What is the responsibility of the AMF in the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay scenario?
q_32491.ground_truth: The AMF determines whether the UE is authorized to be a 5G ProSe Remote UE/UE-to-UE Relay, selects a PCF capable of authorization Policy and parameter for 5G ProSe Remote UE/UE-to-UE Relay, forwards UE's PC5 Capability for 5G ProSe Remote UE/UE-to-UE Relay to PCF, and provisions the NG-RAN with indication about the UE authorization status related to UE-to-UE Relay operation.

q_32492.question: What is sent by the application layer to the access stratum after the QMC is completed in LTE?
q_32492.ground_truth: The application layer sends the AT command +CAPPLEVMR including qoEReference and the QMC report to the access stratum in LTE.

q_32493.question: What are the types of measurement results that may be included in a CEF report for NR?
q_32493.ground_truth: The CEF report for NR may include UL/DL CEF reports, RRC connection establishment/resume failure information, and UL/DL packet delay, packet delay variation, and packet loss information.

q_32494.question: What should the ME do if there is no available empty space in the USIM to store the received short message?
q_32494.ground_truth: If there is no available empty space in the USIM to store the received short message, a specific MMI will have to take place in order not to loose the message.

q_32495.question: What happens to stored PDCP SDUs when the PDCP entity is re-established for SRBs?
q_32495.ground_truth: When the PDCP entity is re-established for SRBs, all stored PDCP SDUs and PDCP PDUs are discarded, in-order delivery is stopped, and reordering information is reset.

q_32496.question: What is the role of the AMF in relation to URSP Generation?
q_32496.ground_truth: The AMF is required to support HPLMN URSP Generation and VPLMN URSP Generation indication and forward LBO information to the V-PCF.

q_32497.question: What should the UE do upon the expiry of the T321 timer for a specific measId in the measurement reporting procedure?
q_32497.ground_truth: The UE should include a measurement reporting entry within the VarMeasReportList for the measId, set the numberOfReportsSent for the measId to 0, and initiate the measurement reporting procedure as specified in the specification.

q_32498.question: What is the course of action taken by the MME after receiving a Handover Required message from the eNodeB?
q_32498.ground_truth: The MME initiates the Handover resource allocation procedure by sending a Forward Relocation Request message to the SGSN.

q_32499.question: What is the purpose of the solution for KI#1 in 6.29, on improving correctness of NWDAF analytics?
q_32499.ground_truth: The purpose of the solution is to enhance ML model provisioning to improve the correctness of NWDAF Analytics and study mechanisms to detect ML model degradation and trigger appropriate actions.

q_32500.question: What should the MME do upon receiving a TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message and a new TMSI in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message?
q_32500.ground_truth: The MME should send an SGsAP-TMSI-REALLOCATION-COMPLETE message.

q_32501.question: What should the receiving side of an AM RLC entity do when it receives a RLC data PDU that falls within the current receiving window range?
q_32501.ground_truth: The receiving side of an AM RLC entity should place the RLC data PDU in the reception buffer, update the state variables, reassemble and deliver the RLC SDUs to the upper layer, and start or stop t-Reordering as needed.

q_32502.question: When must the UE apply the timer T3584 for all the PLMNs or all the equivalent SNPNs?
q_32502.ground_truth: If the 5GSM congestion re-attempt indicator IE with the ABO bit set to "The back-off timer is applied in all PLMNs or all equivalent SNPNs" is included in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message with the 5GSM cause value #67 "insufficient resources for specific slice and DNN", then the UE shall apply the timer T3584 for all the PLMNs or all the equivalent SNPNs.

q_32503.question: What should a mobile station (MS) do if it receives the cause codes #22, #95, #96, #97, #99, and #111 and considers them as abnormal cases?
q_32503.ground_truth: The MS should set the location update attempt counter to 4 and wait for the release of the RR connection as specified in subclause~4.4.4.8.

q_32504.question: What are some examples of policies for a SCP trust domain in the SCP trust domain solution?
q_32504.ground_truth: Examples of policies for a SCP trust domain include restricting communication between trust domains, allowing specific domains to communicate, granting access tokens for all NFs within the domain, providing a service only for NFs of a distinct NF Type, and requiring the NF Service Consumer to be part of the same SCP trust domain.

q_32505.question: What is the purpose of the new alternative S-NSSAI parameter in the PDU Session Establishment Request message?
q_32505.ground_truth: The new alternative S-NSSAI parameter in the PDU Session Establishment Request message allows the UE to include an alternative S-NSSAI, if available, in the PDU Session establishment procedure. The S-AMF may use this information for PDU Session handover to the alternative S-NSSAI if the current S-NSSAI is not supported or overloaded in the target network.

q_32506.question: What is the definition of measurement reporting delay for the E-UTRAN HD-FDD inter-frequency OTDOA measurements provided the conditions for reporting are met?
q_32506.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay is defined as the time between the point when UE receives both the OTDOA-RequestLocationInformation message and the OTDOA assistance data in the OTDOA-ProvideAssistanceData message, and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface. This delay excludes a delay uncertainty and a delay that may be caused by no UL resources for UE to send the measurement report.

q_32507.question: How does the network determine the unavailability period for a UE?
q_32507.ground_truth: In this solution, the unavailability period is requested by the UE from the 5GC. The network may accept the unavailability duration indicated by the UE or indicate a different value. If necessary, the network may delay the unavailability period with a backoff timer.

q_32508.question: What is the difference between NTC4a, NTC4b, and NTC4c in terms of the number of carriers and supported RATs?
q_32508.ground_truth: NTC4a is applicable for a BS that supports UTRA and GSM and allows up to 4 carriers, NTC4b is applicable for a BS that supports E-UTRA and GSM and also allows up to 4 carriers, and NTC4c is applicable for a BS that supports UTRA, E-UTRA, and GSM and also allows up to 4 carriers.

q_32509.question: What is the required support for FGI bit 25 for the applicability of the FDD-TDD inter-frequency absolute accuracy test?
q_32509.ground_truth: Support for FGI bit 25 is required for the applicability of the FDD-TDD inter-frequency absolute accuracy test.

q_32510.question: What is the maximum peak-to-peak ripple of the equalizer coefficients (dB) across the allocated uplink block variation for the EVM equalizer spectrum flatness requirement to be met?
q_32510.ground_truth: The maximum peak-to-peak ripple of the equalizer coefficients for the EVM equalizer spectrum flatness requirement to be met is defined by the EVM measurement process in dB.

q_32511.question: Why is it necessary to study authenticate and authorization between two EESes?
q_32511.ground_truth: It is necessary to study authenticate and authorization between two EESes due to the lack of clear definition of how EESes authenticate and authorize each other on interfaces EDGE-3/6/9, which support confidentiality, integrity, and replay protection.

q_32512.question: What should the UE do if the uac-BarringForCommon is applicable or the uac-AC-BarringListType indicates that uac-ExplicitAC-BarringList is used and the uac-AC-BarringList does not contain a UAC-BarringPerCat entry corresponding to the Access Category?
q_32512.ground_truth: The UE should consider the access attempt as allowed.

q_32513.question: What procedure is used for a UE returning to coverage in either 5GS or EPS?
q_32513.ground_truth: If 5GS is used, the Registration procedure is reused and if EPS is used, the Tracking Area Update procedure is used as defined in TS~23.401.

q_32514.question: Under what conditions should the UE start the Tw2 timer and not try again until the backoff timer expires?
q_32514.ground_truth: When the initial attach or handover attach is requested, the cause of failure is #38 "Network failure" and the Tw1 item is included in the item list field with a non-zero timer value that does not indicate deactivation.

q_32515.question: What is the purpose of a Reverse Path Filter (RPF) function in IP-Source address spoofing mitigation?
q_32515.ground_truth: The Reverse Path Filter (RPF) function helps to prevent IP spoofing attacks by checking whether the source address of a received IP packet is reachable through the incoming interface before processing the packet.

q_32516.question: What are the two models used for testing the output power dynamics in the FR1 test?
q_32516.ground_truth: The two models used for testing the output power dynamics in the FR1 test are FR1 test model 3.1a and FR1 test model 3.1b.

q_32517.question: What should the SS transmit in Cell 1 to ensure the UE is in State 3A, in case the paging fails in step 9 of the test procedure loop?
q_32517.ground_truth: The SS should transmit a Paging message with UE-Identity in Cell 1 and switch off and on the UE, then ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF.

q_32518.question: What message does the MME include in the Handover Restriction List to the E-UTRAN to restrict the UE's mobility to NR in 5GS or the Core Network Type (5GC)?
q_32518.ground_truth: The MME includes the restrictions for NR in 5GS and Core Network Type (5GC) in the Handover Restriction List to the E-UTRAN.

q_32519.question: When can the Extended Local Emergency Numbers List be updated in the UE, if it is in S1 mode or N1 mode?
q_32519.ground_truth: The Extended Local Emergency Numbers List can be updated with EMM procedures if the UE is in S1 mode and with 5GMM procedures if the UE is in N1 mode.

q_32520.question: What must a MCData client include in the "m=message" media-level section when composing an SDP offer?
q_32520.ground_truth: When composing an SDP offer, the MCData client must include the port number, a protocol field value of "TCP/MSRP" or "TCP/TLS/MSRP" for TLS, an "a=sendrecv" attribute, an "a=path" attribute containing its own MSRP URI, set the content type as "a=accept-types:application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-payload", and set the a=setup attribute as "actpass".

q_32521.question: What should the CBC do when it receives a PWS Restart Indication message from an (H)eNodeB after a restart and the warning message service is operational in one or more cells of the (H)eNodeB?
q_32521.ground_truth: The CBC should re-load its warning message data if applicable, re-send the warning message data (with the same message identifier and serial number) to the (H)eNodeB for the reported cell(s), and include the identity of the (H)eNodeB received in the PWS Restart Indication into the Write-Replace-Warning-Request message(s) to enable the MME to forward the message(s) only to the (H)eNodeB (or HeNB GW) involved in the restart.

q_32522.question: When is a PLMN selection not performed for a MS?
q_32522.ground_truth: A PLMN selection is not performed for a MS when the PLMN providing the rejection cause is on the "User Controlled PLMN Selector with Access Technology" list, the "Operator Controlled PLMN Selector with Access Technology" list, the "PLMN Selector" list for an MS using a SIM/USIM without access technology information storage, or a PLMN equivalent to any of these within the same country. A MS that does not perform a PLMN selection will perform an IMSI attach for non-GPRS services if not yet IMSI attached for CS services in the network.

q_32523.question: What action should the UE take, if it reselects to a serving cell whose physical cell identity does not match any entry in validityArea for the corresponding carrier frequency?

q_32524.question: What does the NR Carrier List IE indicate in the 3GPP 5G standard?
q_32524.ground_truth: The NR Carrier List IE indicates the SCS-specific carriers per TDD, per DL, per UL or per SUL of an NR cell.

q_32525.question: What information can be included in NGAP messages related with Dual Connectivity and UPF re-allocation?
q_32525.ground_truth: User location information derived from the identity of the cell that is serving the UE in the Master RAN node and the cell identity of the Primary cell in the secondary RAN node.

q_32526.question: What should the BSF do if the "PCF for an MBS Session Bindings" resource does not exist?
q_32526.ground_truth: The BSF should respond with a "404 Not Found" HTTP error code.

q_32527.question: What information does the AF need to provide in the FL UE selection request when requesting 5GS assistance for UE selection?
q_32527.ground_truth: The AF needs to provide the FL Coverage Area, one or multiple sub-areas within the FL coverage area with a maximum number of UEs for each sub-area, and the UE direction.

q_32528.question: In which document is it out of scope how the controlling MCVideo function determines the public service identity of the terminating participating MCVideo function associated with the handled MCVideo group ID or of the MCVideo gateway server in the interconnected MCVideo system?

q_32529.question: How does the PEGC assign an IPv6 address to a PINE?
q_32529.ground_truth: The PEGC uses IPv6 Prefix Delegation via DHCPv6 to acquire a network prefix and assigns an IPv6 address from the address pool available in the PEGC to the PINE.

q_32530.question: What are the organizational roles defined in the context of network sharing?
q_32530.ground_truth: The organizational roles defined in the context of network sharing are Master Operator (MOP), Radio Access Network (RAN) and Core Network (CN) sharing scenarios, and Participating Operators (POPs).

q_32531.question: Under which circumstances should an MCData client report that it no longer wants to receive multicast data identified by a specific MBS session ID, as specified by clause~19A.2.5.2?
q_32531.ground_truth: There are three possible scenarios: (1) the MCData client receives an MBS session announcement containing a deletion of an <announcement> element identified by the same MBS session ID value as received in a Map Group To Session Stream message in an ongoing conversation, and it hasn't reported the "ue-session-leave" status yet; (2) the MCData client receives an MBS session announcement containing a deletion of an <announcement> element, doesn't participate in an ongoing conversation, has reported the "ue-session-join" status due to the availability of the general purpose MBS subchannel in the <announcement> element, and hasn't reported the "ue-session-leave" status yet; (3) the MCData client suffers from bad MBS session radio condition.

q_32532.question: What is used to identify the MBS Session within 5GS for a location dependent MBS service in the 3GPP TS 23.247 standard?

q_32533.question: What is the purpose of using a ProSe UE-to-Network Relay in sidelink communication?
q_32533.ground_truth: A ProSe UE-to-Network Relay provides a generic L3 forwarding function that can relay any type of IP traffic between a Remote UE and the network. It supports one-to-one and one-to-many sidelink communications between the Remote UE and the ProSe UE-to-Network Relay.

q_32534.question: When is the "Never fail a good DUT" principle considered in this specification?
q_32534.ground_truth: The "Never fail a good DUT" principle is considered in this specification when test tolerances are up to measurement uncertainty (TT=MU).

q_32535.question: What action does the en-gNB take when the Registration Request EN-DC IE is set to "add" in the EN-DC RESOURCE STATUS REQUEST message?
q_32535.ground_truth: The en-gNB adds cells indicated in the NR Cell To Report EN-DC List IE list to the measurements initiated before for the given measurement IDs.

q_32536.question: What is the purpose of OTA in-band blocking testing?
q_32536.ground_truth: The purpose of OTA in-band blocking testing is to verify the ability of the base station (BS) receiver to withstand high-levels of in-band interference from unwanted signals without undue degradation of its sensitivity.

q_32537.question: How does the smart energy meter interact with other electric equipment in the home?
q_32537.ground_truth: Every electric equipment with metering functions is connected and interacted with the smart energy meter through HPLC (High-speed power line carrier) or 5G.

q_32538.question: What is the outcome for unsuccessful completion of the "dataCollectionReportingInitiation" procedure in XNAP-Elementary-Procedure?

q_32539.question: What is the test requirement for Tinterrupt in the E-UTRAN TDD-TDD Inter Frequency Handover test?

q_32540.question: What does the APN and Relative Capacity IE indicate in relation to the APN Length?
q_32540.ground_truth: The APN Length in octet '6' indicates the length of the APN field. The APN field, from octet 7 to 'm' shall be encoded as octet 5 to '(n+4)' defined in clause~8.6.

q_32541.question: What are the four base station classes in this specification?
q_32541.ground_truth: Wide Area Base Stations, Medium Range Base Stations, Local Area Base Stations and Home Base Stations

q_32542.question: What should be released when a PC5-S transmission for a specific destination is terminated in upper layers?
q_32542.ground_truth: The PDCP entity, RLC entity, and the logical channel of the sidelink SRB(s) for PC5-S message of the specific destination.

q_32543.question: What should the gNB-DU do if the BH RLC Channel To Be Setup Item IEs IE for a BH RLC Channel is included in the UE CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message and the Traffic Mapping Information IE is contained in it?
q_32543.ground_truth: The gNB-DU should process the Traffic Mapping Information IE following the behaviour described for the UE Context Setup procedure.

q_32544.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) in relation to the UPF network product class?
q_32544.ground_truth: The 3GPP provides technical specifications for the UPF network product class, including security assurance requirements and test cases.

q_32545.question: What must PCF1 receive from NEF before it can create group policy across multiple PDU sessions for UE1 and UE3?
q_32545.ground_truth: PCF1 must receive all requests for the given flow coordination group ID and batch before it can create group policy across multiple PDU sessions for UE1 and UE3.

q_32546.question: What is the purpose of the test described in clause 9.6.2?
q_32546.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described in clause 9.6.2 is to verify that the GSM RSSI measurement accuracy is within the specified limits for E-UTRA TDD UE release 9 and forward that support GSM.

q_32547.question: What should Qhyst be changed to if broadcasted in system information?
q_32547.ground_truth: Qhyst should be changed to "hyst" if broadcasted in system information.

q_32548.question: What should the MCData server include in the P-Asserted-Identity header field of the SIP PUBLISH request?
q_32548.ground_truth: The MCData server should include a P-Asserted-Identity header field with the public service identity of the MCData server in the SIP PUBLISH request.

q_32549.question: What should the I-CSCF do if the user registration status query procedure cannot be completed?
q_32549.ground_truth: The I-CSCF should send back a 480 (Temporarily Unavailable) response to the UE.

q_32550.question: What is the purpose of the notification header's notificationId in the context of multiple managed objects (MOIs) being affected by a single notification?
q_32550.ground_truth: The notificationId in mOIChanges is used to associate a notification to a single MOI only, whereas the former notification id can be associated with changes of multiple MOIs. The correlatedNotifications parameter associates one or more notification ids to a single MOI for notifications reporting events for that MOI.

q_32551.question: What is the name of the root element in the XML schema for application/vnd.3gpp.seal-network-QoS-management-info+xml, which specifies the XML format for network QoS management information?

q_32552.question: What is the role of the AF in the Flexible Federated Learning Operation over 5GS solution?
q_32552.ground_truth: The AF requests group QoS requirements for a list of candidate UEs (i.e. group QoS) and obtains the list of selected UEs that have been provisioned with QoS Flows that meet the group QoS requirements.

q_32553.question: What should the MS do upon receiving a paging request using IMSI?
q_32553.ground_truth: The MS should perform a GPRS attach or combined GPRS attach procedure, after locally detaching and deleting relevant stored information.

q_32554.question: How many cells are deployed for the test described in 6.6.19.4.4.2?
q_32554.ground_truth: Three cells are deployed for the test described in 6.6.19.4.4.2: FR1 PCell (Cell 1), FR1 SCell (Cell 2) and FR1 neighbor cell (Cell 3) on the same frequency as the SCell.

q_32555.question: What is the function of motion sensor method used for positioning of UE?
q_32555.ground_truth: The motion sensor method makes use of different sensors, such as accelerometers, gyros, magnetometers, to calculate the displacement of UE and estimate its relative displacement based on a reference position and/or reference time to determine the absolute position.

q_32556.question: What element in subclause 7.2.4.2 may be included in the `<list-service>` element of an MCPTT group document and is specified to relate to the maximum duration of a call?

q_32557.question: What does the T7 interface between the IWK-SCEF in the visited network and the SCEF in the home network allow?
q_32557.ground_truth: The T7 interface between the IWK-SCEF in the visited network and the SCEF in the home network allows the IWK-SCEF to forward reports received on T6ai/bi to the SCEF, forward MO data to the SCEF, forward MT data to the MME/SGSN and manage connections between the SCEF and the IWK-SCEF.

q_32558.question: What information does the UPF issue to the SMF if the SMF had set the corresponding URR Reporting trigger with a value "IP multicast join/leave"?
q_32558.ground_truth: The UPF issues an UPF report to the SMF the corresponding IP Multicast addressing information.

q_32559.question: What is the expected handover delay for the NR SA FR1-FR1 handover with unknown target cell test?
q_32559.ground_truth: The handover delay can be expressed as: RRC procedure delay + Tinterrupt, where RRC procedure delay is 10 ms and Tinterrupt is 82 ms in the test. This gives a total of 92 ms.

q_32560.question: What is the purpose of the FDD Intra Frequency Absolute RSRP Accuracy for CA Idle Mode Measurements test?
q_32560.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to verify that the FDD intra-frequency absolute RSRP measurement accuracy of the CA idle mode measurements is within the specified limit for all bands.

q_32561.question: In what situation should the MCVideo client include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body when sending a SIP re-INVITE request to cancel an in-progress emergency condition on a chat MCVideo group?
q_32561.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body when sending a SIP re-INVITE request to cancel an in-progress emergency condition on a chat MCVideo group if the MCVideo user is cancelling an in-progress emergency condition and optionally an MCVideo emergency alert originated by the MCVideo user.

q_32562.question: Which HTTP method is specified for retrieving the "Individual 5G MBS Group" resource in clause 5.2.55.3.4 of the 3GPP TS 29.501 standard?
q_32562.ground_truth: The GET method is specified for retrieving the "Individual 5G MBS Group" resource in clause 5.2.55.3.4 of the 3GPP TS 29.501 standard.

q_32563.question: What event triggers the MBS session activation procedure?
q_32563.ground_truth: The MBS session activation procedure can be triggered by an AF request to activate the MBS session or when the MB-UPF receives multicast data and notifies the MB-SMF.

q_32564.question: What is the SNR value at the start of time duration T4?
q_32564.ground_truth: The SNR value at the start of time duration T4 is the same as the SNR value at the end of time window dT before T4.

q_32565.question: What should the UE populate the P-Access-Network-Info header field with during a dialog?
q_32565.ground_truth: The UE should populate the P-Access-Network-Info header field in any request or response within a dialog with the current point of attachment to the IP-CAN (e.g. the current cell information).

q_32566.question: What is the maximum output power of the UE for an uplink signal?
q_32566.ground_truth: UE output power equal to or higher than Transmit minimum power -39 dBm.

q_32567.question: What is the purpose of the RRCConnectionRelease message in this test procedure?
q_32567.ground_truth: The purpose of the RRCConnectionRelease message in this test procedure is to not contain the relevant system information of Cell 2 during time period T1.

q_32568.question: In the context of step 11f, what is the first condition that the SS has to monitor during the SCell1 deactivation for intra-band PCC(TDD) and inter-band SCells?
q_32568.ground_truth: The first condition is that the last CSI report is received by the SS earlier than or equal to subframe (n+8), and DTX is not observed by the SS anywhere outside the subframes (n+5) to (n+9), (n+13), (n+15) to (n+23), (n+25) to (n+33), and (n+35) to (n+43).

q_32569.question: What is the role of the SCEF in the MSISDN-less MO SMS service?
q_32569.ground_truth: The SCEF receives the SMS-MO from the SM-SC and obtains the corresponding External Identifier of the UE sending the SMS from the HSS. The SCEF then forwards the SMS to the SCS/AS including the External Identifier of the originating UE.

q_32570.question: What is the role of the PINE in responding to the PEMC's Create PIN Request or Update PIN Request?
q_32570.ground_truth: The PINE responds to the PEMC's Create PIN Request or Update PIN Request with PIN ID. If the PINE is reachable, the response includes Device Info, which includes Connection Info related to the PIN. If the PINE is not reachable and the PEMC has no direct connection with the PINE, the PEMC performs Remove PINEs procedure and stops. If the PEMC is behind a PEGC, the message is encapsulated in PIN2 and PIN4 interfaces.

q_32571.question: When does the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay trigger a Service Request procedure to enter CM_CONNECTED state?
q_32571.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay triggers a Service Request procedure to enter CM_CONNECTED state when it receives a connection request from the 5G ProSe Layer-2 Remote UE for relaying while in CM_IDLE state.

q_32572.question: What is the function of Solution #31 in enabling a UE to use a Localized service when the UE doesn't know the Hosting network IDs?
q_32572.ground_truth: Solution #31 proposes that the Hosting network supporting Localized service(s) broadcasts information indicating the supported Localized service(s), allowing the UE to discover and select a Hosting network that supports the required service.

q_32573.question: What shall be the test level for signal ports, telecommunication ports, and control ports in the fast transients common mode test as per IEC 61000-4-4?
q_32573.ground_truth: The test level for signal ports, telecommunication ports, and control ports in the fast transients common mode test as per IEC 61000-4-4 is 0.5 kV open circuit voltage.

q_32574.question: What happens to the stored UE Radio Capability information in the MME during the Attach procedure, Tracking Area Update procedure for the "first TAU following GERAN/UTRAN Attach" or "UE radio capability update"?
q_32574.ground_truth: The MME deletes (or marks as deleted) any UE Radio Capability information that it has stored and does not send any UE Radio Capability information to the E-UTRAN during those procedures. The MME triggers the eNB to request the UE Radio Capability from the UE and upload it to the MME in the S1 interface UE CAPABILITY INFO INDICATION message.

q_32575.question: What type of NR UE does the test applicability in 6.3.3.1.2.2 apply to?
q_32575.ground_truth: The test applies to all types of NR UE release 15 and forward.

q_32576.question: What indication does the IMS UE include in the SDP offer for a media stream containing cryptographic information for e2DCe protection of IMS data channel?
q_32576.ground_truth: The indication "e2DCe-security for IMS data channel requested by UE" is included in the SDP offer containing cryptographic information.

q_32577.question: What are the possible time spans, in units of OFDM symbols, of the DCI carried by PDCCH in that subframe of the corresponding DL cell?
q_32577.ground_truth: The possible time spans of the DCI carried by PDCCH in that subframe of the corresponding DL cell are 1, 2, or 3 for system bandwidths, and 2, 3, or 4 for system bandwidths greater than 100 resource blocks.

q_32578.question: What is the tag value for ICE Free Format Content TLV?
q_32578.ground_truth: The tag value for ICE Free Format Content TLV is '81'.

q_32579.question: What is the role of the Edge Node Sharing scenario in the 5G architecture?
q_32579.ground_truth: The Edge Node Sharing scenario in the 5G architecture allows a UE (User Equipment) in one PLMN (Public Land Mobile Network) to access facilities in another PLMN located in close proximity and to route the UE traffic to the identified EAS (Edge Application System).

q_32580.question: What identifies a QoS Flow in the 5G System?

q_32581.question: What action should the MCPTT server take if the <multiplex-support> element is not present and the <multiplex-support> element is set to false?
q_32581.ground_truth: The MCPTT server shall consider this as an indication that the MCPTT client does not support multiplexing of media plane control channels and media streams.

q_32582.question: Which message does the network-requested port management procedure use for initiation?
q_32582.ground_truth: The MANAGE PORT COMMAND message is used for the initiation of the network-requested port management procedure.

q_32583.question: What action does the HA take upon receiving a new MIP-RRQ during re-authentication?
q_32583.ground_truth: The HA determines if re-authentication has occurred by comparing the SPI contained in the MN-HA Authentication extension of the received MIP-RRQ to the locally stored value. If the two SPIs are different, the HA retrieves the new MN-HA key from the 3GPP AAA server.

q_32584.question: Which field in the RejectWaitTime IEs specifies the value in seconds for timer T302?

q_32585.question: What is the process of sending application traffic from VAL client to VAL server using SEALDD connection?
q_32585.ground_truth: The SEALDD client sends the application traffic to SEALDD server in SEALDD traffic, which identifies the application traffic based on the VAL service ID and further sends it to VAL server. The downlink application traffic sent from VAL server to VAL client is processed similarly.

q_32586.question: What is the role of the Network Repository Function (NRF) in 3GPP-defined services and network technologies?
q_32586.ground_truth: The Network Repository Function (NRF) is responsible for managing the network slice selection function (NSSF) in 3GPP-defined services and network technologies.

q_32587.question: What information does the GMS require, besides authorization, to create a group in MCPTT?
