q_32829.ground_truth: When the application and signalling plane has determined that the MCVideo call has been released, the corresponding instance of the transmission control server state machine for 'general transmission control operation' and 'general reception control operation' are also terminated.

q_32830.question: What is the purpose of the list of Link local IPv6 addresses information element?
q_32830.ground_truth: The list of Link local IPv6 addresses information element indicates a list of Link local IPv6 addresses.

q_32831.question: In what state are UEs that initiate the Registration procedure with the indication of receiving emergency services?
q_32831.ground_truth: UEs that are in limited service state (LSM)

q_32832.question: What should the UE do if the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message includes the "UE radio capability ID IE" or the "UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE"?
q_32832.ground_truth: The UE shall return a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF to acknowledge reception of the UE radio capability ID IE or the UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE.

q_32833.question: What is the requirement for the PRACH false alarm probability in 11.1.4.2.2.1.2?
q_32833.ground_truth: The false alarm probability shall be less than or equal to 0.1%.

q_32834.question: What is required in a SIP PUBLISH request for the MCPTT server to update a served MCPTT ID's affiliation status?
q_32834.ground_truth: A SIP PUBLISH request must include the public service identity of the originating or terminating participating MCPTT function, an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body with an mcptt-request-uri element that identifies the MCPTT ID served by the MCPTT server, an ICSI value in the P-Asserted-Service header field, the presence event type in the Event header field, and per-user affiliation information in the application/pidf+xml MIME body.

q_32835.question: What action is taken by the MME after receiving a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message including the eKSI during inter-system change from N1 mode to S1 mode in EMM-IDLE mode?
q_32835.ground_truth: The MME forwards the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message to the source AMF to obtain the mapped EPS security context, and stores the mapped EPS NAS security context with the associated uplink and downlink NAS COUNT counters.

q_32836.question: What should the MAC entity do with uplink transmission upon detecting UL synchronization loss?
q_32836.ground_truth: Upon detecting UL synchronization loss, the MAC entity should flush all HARQ buffers and not perform any uplink transmission.

q_32837.question: What information should be included in the outgoing SIP INVITE request, as per clause 6.3.2.2.6.2, in an on-demand session that requires manual commencement mode?
q_32837.ground_truth: When the "SIP INVITE request for terminating participating MCVideo function" for an on-demand session requires manual commencement mode, the participating MCVideo function must generate a SIP INVITE request as specified in clause 6.3.2.2.3, set the Request-URI to the public user identity associated with the MCVideo ID of the MCVideo user to be invited, perform the procedures specified in clause 6.3.2.2.9 to include any MIME bodies in the received SIP INVITE request, include the Answer-Mode header field with the value "Manual" or the Priv-Answer-Mode header field with the value "Manual", depending on the presence of the Answer-Mode header field or Priv-Answer-Mode header field in the incoming SIP INVITE request, include a P-Asserted-Identity header field in the outgoing SIP INVITE request set to the public service identity of the participating MCVideo function, and send the SIP INVITE request towards the MCVideo client.

q_32838.question: What measures can be taken to reduce the event report latency in Deferred MT-LR Procedure?
q_32838.ground_truth: To reduce the event report latency, LMF and UE may maintain the user plane connection and keep UE from CM-IDLE state.

q_32839.question: What is the purpose of the periodicPHR-Timer and prohibitPHR-Timer in the Power Headroom Reporting procedure?
q_32839.ground_truth: The periodicPHR-Timer and prohibitPHR-Timer are used by RRC to control Power Headroom reporting. The periodicPHR-Timer determines when a PHR is transmitted periodically, while the prohibitPHR-Timer determines the minimum time interval between two consecutive PHR transmissions.

q_32840.question: Which module should be used for cells on bands supporting 2Rx when connecting the SS (node B emulator) and AWGN noise sources for UEs with 4Rx in any band under test?

q_32841.question: What should the UE do upon failing to establish the RRC connection for mobile originating calls if both timers T302 and T303 are not running and a random number is lower than the value indicated by ac-BarringFactor included in ac-BarringForMO-Data?
q_32841.ground_truth: Consider access to the cell as not barred.

q_32842.question: What action should the UE take if there is a single candidate sorting quantity?
q_32842.ground_truth: Consider the concerned quantity to be the sorting quantity.

q_32843.question: What is the relationship between M-TMSI and IMSI in EPS user identity confidentiality?
q_32843.ground_truth: The relationship between M-TMSI and IMSI is known only in the UE and in the MME.

q_32844.question: Who can request the NWDAF or DCCF to delete data or analytics from the ADRF?
q_32844.ground_truth: The NWDAF or DCCF can request the ADRF to delete data or analytics based on the Storage Approach and if the consumer does not indicate that it will retrieve the data or analytics.

q_32845.question: What type of authentication is triggered by the UDM in the Reauthentication Notify procedure?

q_32846.question: What is the successful outcome for the "id-WriteReplaceWarning" procedure code in the S1AP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE?

q_32847.question: What is the minimum requirement for TAB connectors in the PCDE procedure?
q_32847.ground_truth: The minimum requirement is that all TAB connectors, whether tested one at a time or multiple at once, must be tested until all necessary TAB connectors to demonstrate conformance have been tested.

q_32848.question: When is the "CellToReport-NR-ENDC-Item" present in the list?
q_32848.ground_truth: The "CellToReport-NR-ENDC-Item" is present in the list when the Registration Request EN-DC IE is set to "Start".

q_32849.question: What data is used by the FL Client NWDAF to further train the ML model during FL training process?
q_32849.ground_truth: The FL Client NWDAF further trains the retrieved ML model from the FL Server NWDAF based on its own/collected data during the FL training process.

q_32850.question: What should the N3C remote UE do if n3c-IndirectPathAddChange is set to setup?
q_32850.ground_truth: The N3C remote UE shall consider the non-3GPP connection with the relay UE indicated by n3c-RelayIdentification to be used for the N3C indirect path and consider the source non-3GPP connection is not to be used in case of N3C indirect path change (i.e. a new relay UE is indicated by the n3c-RelayIdentification).

q_32851.question: What should the UPF do if the SMF instructs it to activate MPTCP functionality for the MA PDU session?
q_32851.ground_truth: The UPF should allocate the UE "MPTCP link-specific multipath" addresses/prefixes and send the "MPTCP link-specific multipath" addresses/prefixes and MPTCP proxy information to the SMF.

q_32852.question: What is the example of inter-beam interference observed at the UE in a multi-TRP DL transmission scenario?
q_32852.ground_truth: An example of inter-beam interference observed at the UE in a multi-TRP DL transmission scenario is the signal (S2) transmitted from TRP2 creating interference to the UE antenna panel receiving the signal (S1) transmitted from TRP1.

q_32853.question: What information is included in the PS Handover Required Acknowledge message sent by the source SGSN to the source BSS?
q_32853.ground_truth: The message includes TLLI, List of Set Up PFCs, Target RNC to Source BSS Transparent Container, and Cause.

q_32854.question: What must the NF Service Consumer include in the service discovery request when querying the "nf-instances" resource in a different NRF of a Home PLMN?
q_32854.ground_truth: The identity of the PLMN of the home NRF in a query parameter of the URI.

q_32855.question: What is the name of the counter that is used to detect a restart in GTP-C messages and is associated with the GTP-C entity?

q_32856.question: What should the controlling MCData function include in the P-Asserted-Identity header field when sending a SIP INVITE request for an MCData session associated with an emergency group communication?
q_32856.ground_truth: The controlling MCData function should include the public service identity of the controlling MCData function in the P-Asserted-Identity header field.

q_32857.question: What is the requirement for the placement of the BS (Base Station)?
q_32857.ground_truth: The BS shall be placed on a non-conducting support and operated from a power source via a RF filter to avoid radiation from the power leads.

q_32858.question: Who decides whether to accept the NAS request for RRC connection establishment?
q_32858.ground_truth: The network decides whether to accept the NAS request for RRC connection establishment based on the low access priority indicator in NAS signalling and the corresponding low access priority for RRC connection establishment.

q_32859.question: What is the duration of time period T1 and T2 in the test?
q_32859.ground_truth: The duration of time period T1 and T2 in the test is not specified and needs to be determined in order to perform the test.

q_32860.question: What is the required percentage of correct SCell activation and deactivation delays, as specified in the rule "The rate of correctly observed SCell activation delays and SCell deactivation delays shall for repeated tests be at least 90%."?
q_32860.ground_truth: The rate of correctly observed SCell activation and deactivation delays should be at least 90%.

q_32861.question: What does the term "wideband Median CQI" refer to in step 5 of the test procedure described in 6.2.2.2.1.2.4.2?
q_32861.ground_truth: Wideband Median CQI is the wideband CQI that is at or crosses 50% distribution from the lower wideband CQI side.

q_32862.question: What function does an LRF perform with regards to a UE which has initiated an IMS emergency session?
q_32862.ground_truth: The Location Retrieval Function (LRF) is responsible for retrieving or validating location information, providing routing and/or correlation information for a UE which has initiated an IMS emergency session. The information is provided by an LRF to an E-CSCF.

q_32863.question: What method is used to retrieve operator specific data from the UDR in the "OperatorSpecificData" resource?
q_32863.ground_truth: The GET method is used to retrieve operator specific data from the UDR in the "OperatorSpecificData" resource.

q_32864.question: What action should the 3GPP AAA Server take after receiving the SAA command with a successful result from the HSS?
q_32864.ground_truth: After receiving the SAA command with a successful result from the HSS, the 3GPP AAA Server should clear the "pending to be restored in HSS" flag for that user.

q_32865.question: During the Attach procedure or Tracking Area Update procedure, when the MME does not send an S1 interface INITIAL CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST to the E-UTRAN, what message is used to trigger the E-UTRAN to request the UE Radio Capability from the UE?
q_32865.ground_truth: The CONNECTION ESTABLISHMENT INDICATION message without UE Radio Capability information included.

q_32866.question: What actions should the MS take if the TFT operation is "Replace packet filters in existing TFT" and the packet filter to be replaced does not exist in the original TFT?
q_32866.ground_truth: The MS should not diagnose an error, further process the replace request and, if no error was detected, include the packet filters received to the existing TFT.

q_32867.question: What is the format of the NAI for emergency cases when the user's IMEI is used and IMSI is not available?

q_32868.question: What is the function of a ProSe identifier in Proximity based Services (ProSe) in 5GS?
q_32868.ground_truth: A Prose identifier is a globally unique identifier used to identify the ProSe Application associated with the ProSe operation in 5G ProSe Direct Discovery and 5G ProSe Direct Communication.

q_32869.question: Which element does the <QoS-management-initiation-request> include in XML schema?
q_32869.ground_truth: The <QoS-management-initiation-request> includes a <VAL-ue-id> element, a <VAL-ue-list> element, one or more <VAL-ue-id> elements, a <VAL-service-id> element, an <end-to-end-QoS-requirements> element, a <service-area> element, and a <validity-period> element.

q_32870.question: What is the difference between "ResetAcknowledgeIEs" and "ResetIEs" in the passed passage?
q_32870.ground_truth: "ResetIEs" is used in the definition of the "Reset" message while "ResetAcknowledgeIEs" is used in the definition of the "ResetAcknowledge" message.

q_32871.question: What happens if no free records are found in EFEXT1 for storing the called party subaddress in an ADN/SSC?
q_32871.ground_truth: If no free records are found in EFEXT1 for storing the called party subaddress in an ADN/SSC, the ME shall seek for two free records in EFEXT1. If no such two records are found, the ME runs the Purge procedure.

q_32872.question: What is the purpose of the CAG information list in 6.8.8?
q_32872.ground_truth: The CAG information list contains the names of the CAG cells to which the UICC has requested access.

q_32873.question: What is the role of the HANDOVER REQUEST message in the process of switching the U2N Remote UE from direct to indirect path with gNB-CU change?
q_32873.ground_truth: The HANDOVER REQUEST message is used by the source gNB-CU to request the target gNB-CU to accept the indirect path switching to the target U2N Relay UE.

q_32874.question: What happens to the logged MDT trace session in the UE when the duration time of the trace session expires?
q_32874.ground_truth: The logged MDT trace session in the UE is preserved until the duration time of the trace session expires, including also multiple idle or inactive periods.

q_32875.question: What header field and media feature tag should be supported for PS to CS SRVCC for alerting calls at the roaming II-NNI?
q_32875.ground_truth: The "g.3gpp.srvcc-alerting" media feature tag in a Contact header field, the "+g.3gpp.srvcc-alerting" header field parameter, and the Target-Dialog header field in the INVITE request.

q_32876.question: What is the primary purpose of the test for in-channel selectivity (ICS) in the BS receiver?
q_32876.ground_truth: The purpose of the ICS test is to verify the BS receiver's ability to suppress the IQ leakage.

q_32877.question: What is the purpose of maintaining a storage unit/database of potential Reference UEs/Located UEs in the LMF?
q_32877.ground_truth: The purpose of maintaining a storage unit/database is to collect and keep track of potential Reference UEs/Located UEs in an area, including receiving data about their capabilities and location information, which may also include keeping track of potential role changes.

q_32878.question: In which 3GPP Technical Specifications are included in the analysis of the impacts of 5GS network slicing to MC services?
q_32878.ground_truth: 3GPP TS 23.228, 3GPP TS 23.501, 3GPP TS 23.503, 3GPP TS 29.513, and 3GPP TS 38.300 are included in the analysis.

q_32879.question: What action does the PCRF take when it receives from the AF an AA-Request to de-provision the information about the AF signalling IP flows?
q_32879.ground_truth: The PCRF removes the corresponding dynamic PCC and QoS rule if applicable for the AF signalling IP flows.

q_32880.question: What change is made in step 2 for the case of I-SMF removal?
q_32880.ground_truth: The SMF selects a new I-UPF based on target DNAI in step 12.

q_32881.question: Which network entity can trigger inter-system mobility from a 5G MBS session to an LTE eMBMS bearer?
q_32881.ground_truth: The MC service server can trigger inter-system mobility from a 5G MBS session to an LTE eMBMS bearer, with the function entity residing in 5GS, such as NEF, MBSF, MB-SMF, or PCF.

q_32882.question: When the in-progress imminent peril state of the group is set to "true", what should be included in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body?
q_32882.ground_truth: The <imminentperil-ind> element set to a value of "true".

q_32883.question: What type of channel is used for the transport of CLUE messages?
q_32883.ground_truth: The CLUE data channel is a bidirectional SCTP over DTLS channel.

q_32884.question: When is the requirements in clause 8.24 not applicable?
q_32884.ground_truth: The requirements in clause 8.24 are not applicable when all target TCI states in the active TCI state list are unknown or when the UE is requested to switch to a TCI state with the higher layer parameter UL-TCIState associated to SRS.

q_32885.question: What is the HTTP status code that the (source) AMF should respond with if the integrity check is successful and the UE is registered in a different access type?
q_32885.ground_truth: If the integrity check is successful and the UE is registered in a different access type, the (source) AMF should respond with the HTTP status code "200 OK".

q_32886.question: What role must the S-CSCF fulfill when it acts as a registrar?
q_32886.ground_truth: The S-CSCF must provide the UA role when acting as a registrar.

q_32887.question: What is the purpose of the IPDL time mask in this section?
q_32887.ground_truth: The IPDL time mask specifies the limits of the AAS BS output power during idle periods. This requirement applies only to AAS BS supporting IPDL.

q_32888.question: What is the meaning of "shall" in a 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_32888.ground_truth: In a 3GPP Technical Specification, "shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

q_32889.question: What is the requirement for power class 2 intra-band contiguous carrier aggregation in terms of emission mask measurement?
q_32889.ground_truth: The emission mask is measured as the sum from both UE transmit antenna connectors when UE indicates support for dualPA-Architecture IE.

q_32890.question: What is the function of the GGSN in the document?
q_32890.ground_truth: The GGSN (Gateway GPRS Support Node) is the point of PDN interconnection with the GSM PLMN supporting GPRS, containing routing information for GPRS users with a PDP context active. The necessary procedures needed to restore GGSN data information after a restart are described in the document.

q_32891.question: What should a participating MCPTT function do if a private call cannot be made to a specific user?
q_32891.ground_truth: It should reject the SIP REFER request for originating participating MCPTT function with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response, as specified in clause 10iA(ii).

q_32892.question: What should the floor control interface do when it receives a Floor Request message, and the session is a broadcast group call or an ambient listening call?
q_32892.ground_truth: It should send a Floor Deny message to the associated floor participant with the Reject Cause set to '#5 (Receive only)', and remain in the 'U: not permitted and Floor Taken' state.

q_32893.question: What protocol or network element is responsible for digitally signing system information in Solution #20?

q_32894.question: How many entry slots are there in queue B as a network operator option?
q_32894.ground_truth: The size of queue B can be from 1 to 5 entries.

q_32895.question: Which of the following is an attribute of the sealBoolean element: "protectionType", "type", "true", or "false"?
q_32895.ground_truth: There is no attribute of the sealBoolean element named "protectionType" or "type". The only possible attributes for sealBoolean are "xs:boolean" and "sealloc:protectionType". Based on the provided schema, "true" or "false" are the possible values of sealBoolean.

q_32896.question: Which value should be added to the Track Header Box ('tkhd') in a VR Track to specify the track's visual presentation size as fixed-point 16.16 values expressed in on a uniformly sampled grid?
q_32896.ground_truth: The width and height fields for a visual track in the Track Header Box ('tkhd') specify the track's visual presentation size as fixed-point 16.16 values expressed in on a uniformly sampled grid.

q_32897.question: What is the purpose of testing for an IAB node declaring multi-carrier and/or CA operation as per 6.2.4.1?
q_32897.ground_truth: The purpose is to verify the ability to accurately generate and direct radiated power per beam, across the frequency range and under normal conditions, for all declared beams of the IAB-DU type 1-H, IAB-DU type 1-O, IAB-MT type 1-H, IAB-MT type 1-O, IAB-DU type 2-O, and IAB-MT type 2-O.

q_32898.question: What is the main difference between the initial trust building procedure in solution #3 and solution #18 for automated certificate management for network slices?
q_32898.ground_truth: In solution #3, the initial certificate is issued by the operator CA, while in solution #18, the operator CA is replaced with the 3rd party CA for the scenario of automated certificate management for network slices.

q_32899.question: What should the NF service consumer include in the "pduSetQosPara" data type to indicate the PDU Set QoS related information for a service data flow?
q_32899.ground_truth: The NF service consumer may include the PDU Set Delay Budget (PSDB), PDU Set Error Rate (PSER), and/or PDU Set Integrated Handling information (PSIHI) in the "pduSetQosPara" data type.

q_32900.question: What type of SIP MESSAGE request is sent to the controlling MCPTT function with the Request-URI set to its public service identity, and contains an XML body with an <anyExt> element with the <request-type> set to "private-call-call-back-request"?
q_32900.ground_truth: A "SIP MESSAGE request for private call call-back request for controlling MCPTT function"

q_32901.question: What are some of the considerations for quality and bitrate in VR rendering?
q_32901.ground_truth: A minimum signal of 1k by 1k per eye is required, with stereoscopic rendering effectively doubling the required resolution. With current codecs, the pure viewport data can be represented with around 4-10 Mbit/s, but a full omnidirectional presentation may require 20 times more data, leading to 80-200 Mbit/s, depending on the viewport-dependent coding and delivery.

q_32902.question: What should the SNRM-S do upon receiving an HTTP POST request message containing the request for unicast resources procedure with SIP core?
q_32902.ground_truth: The SNRM-S should determine the identity of the sender of the received HTTP POST request, evaluate the need for network resources and use of resource sharing, and then send a SIP MESSAGE request containing request for resources. Upon receiving a SIP 200 (OK) response, the SNRM-S should generate an HTTP 200 (OK) response message indicating success of the resource request operation and send it towards the VAL server.

q_32903.question: What is the purpose of the "Public Warning System (PWS) Cancel" procedure?
q_32903.ground_truth: The PWS Cancel procedure is used to cancel an already ongoing broadcast of a warning message. It uses non UE-associated signalling.

q_32904.question: In what situation should the UE submit the UEAssistanceInformation via SRB1 for transmission?
q_32904.ground_truth: If the procedure was triggered to provide UE preference for SCG deactivation or to indicate that the UE with a deactivated SCG has uplink data to send on a DRB for which there is no MCG RLC bearer.

q_32905.question: When sending a DER command to the 3GPP AAA Server, what condition would cause the ePDG to include a High-Priority-Access-Info AVP in the DER command?
q_32905.ground_truth: If the ePDG had received an indication that the UE has access priority in an IKE_AUTH request message, and if allowed by operator policy

q_32906.question: What is the responsibility of the target MME/SGSN during the CS to PS Handover procedure?
q_32906.ground_truth: The target MME/SGSN is responsible for selecting resources for all PS bearers in E-UTRAN or UTRAN (HSPA) and determining if the Serving GW is to be relocated.

q_32907.question: When the "steerModeInd" attribute is provided, what happens to the traffic load distributed across accesses indicated in "3gLoad" attribute?
q_32907.ground_truth: It may be ignored by the UE and UPF.

q_32908.question: What is the purpose of the xIRI generated in clause 7.10.3.3.2 for N9HR LI?
q_32908.ground_truth: The main purpose of the xIRI generated in clause 7.10.3.3.2 for N9HR LI is to report the UE location, PDU session ID, and the SMF identity.

q_32909.question: What is the role of the Guest PIN Element in a PIN?
q_32909.ground_truth: The Guest PIN Element is a PIN Element that is a member of one PIN (Home PIN) and can access any other PIN if allowed to by that PIN to communicate with the Home PIN. It can communicate with other PIN Elements within the PIN or in other PINs.

q_32910.question: In the 3GPP technical specification, what is a Location Server as it relates to positioning for a target device?
q_32910.ground_truth: In the 3GPP technical specification, a Location Server is a physical or logical entity, such as an E-SMLC, SUPL SLP, or LMF, that manages positioning for a target device. This is done by obtaining measurements and other location information from one or more positioning units, and providing assistance data to positioning units to help determine the device's position. A Location Server may also compute or verify the final location estimate.

q_32911.question: What is the detector setting for the spectrum analyzer during the measurement of spurious emissions in the described test procedure?
q_32911.ground_truth: During measurement, the spectrum analyzer shall be set to 'Detector' = RMS.

q_32912.question: What is the mandatory UE action in subclause 5.2.3.2.1.a)?
q_32912.ground_truth: Initiate the mobility or periodic registration update procedure.

q_32913.question: What is the purpose of the "Definitions and Abbreviations" section in the Technical Specification?
q_32913.ground_truth: The "Definitions and Abbreviations" section in the Technical Specification provides the terms and definitions used in the document, ensuring a consistent and clear understanding of the terminology used in the 5G System specifications.

q_32914.question: What is the initial location of UE A1, A2, A3, and A4?
q_32914.ground_truth: Initially, UE A1, A2, A3 and A4 are located at location GA.

q_32915.question: What action should a floor participant take upon receiving a Floor Request message, when the priority of the received request is higher than that of the floor participant?
q_32915.ground_truth: The floor participant should reset the value of the counter C201 to 1, restart timer T201, and remain in 'O: pending request' state.

q_32916.question: What should the ATCF do if the SC UE supports the CS to PS SRVCC?
q_32916.ground_truth: The ATCF generates the ATGW information for CS to PS SRVCC, sets it to the unspecified address and port number 9, and sends it in a SIP MESSAGE request.

q_32917.question: What system does a UAV need to register with to use UAS services in the 3GPP network?

q_32918.question: What action does the UE take when it receives a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message with the EMM cause set to 'Implicitly detached'?
q_32918.ground_truth: The UE deletes the list of equivalent PLMNs and enters the state EMM-DEREGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE, and then performs a new attach procedure.

q_32919.question: Which network function is responsible for interpreting AI/ML request to generate the AI/ML transport policy in 5G Core Network?
q_32919.ground_truth: PCF (Policy Control Function) interprets AI/ML request to generate the AI/ML transport policy in 5G Core Network.

q_32920.question: What is the pre-condition for migration during an ongoing private communication?
q_32920.ground_truth: The pre-condition for migration during an ongoing private communication is that the MCPTT client has one or more ongoing private calls in the primary MC system and the MCPTT UE detects the need to change the MC system.

q_32921.question: What procedure is used to deactivate the bearers used for voice after the handover is complete?
q_32921.ground_truth: MME-initiated Dedicated Bearer Deactivation procedure is used to deactivate the bearers used for voice and other GBR bearers, while non-GBR bearers are preserved and suspended by sending Suspend Notification messages.

q_32922.question: When should the SC UE send a SIP UPDATE request during the notification procedure?
q_32922.ground_truth: The SC UE should send a SIP UPDATE request during the notification procedure if it receives a SM NOTIFICATION message containing an "SRVCC handover cancelled, IMS session re-establishment required" or fails to retune to the 3GPP UTRAN or 3GPP GERAN after it receives the handover command from the eNodeB or from the NodeB.

q_32923.question: What provides the number of successful network slice selections by the NSSF to the AMF?
q_32923.ground_truth: Number of successful network slice selections made by the NSSF.

q_32924.question: What is the definition of ProSe Group Communication as defined in 3GPP TS 22.278?
q_32924.ground_truth: ProSe Group Communication is a one-to-many ProSe Communication, between more than two UEs in proximity, by means of a common ProSe Communication path established between the UEs.

q_32925.question: Who generates ground-truth labels for UE-based and UE-assisted positioning methods with UE-side model?
q_32925.ground_truth: PRU or UE generates ground-truth labels for UE-based and UE-assisted positioning methods with UE-side model.

q_32926.question: When an AS generates a response to a request, what should it include in the P-Charging-Vector header field?
q_32926.ground_truth: The AS should insert a P-Charging-Vector header field containing the "orig-ioi" header field parameter received in the request, a type 3 "term-ioi" header field parameter, and the "icid-value" header field parameter.

q_32927.question: What is the maximum number of reporting criteria that a UE with support for a single PSCell carrier frequency and a single SCell carrier frequency needs to be able to handle in parallel for inter-frequency measurements?

q_32928.question: What triggers the SMF to release the PDU Session due to slice inactivity?
q_32928.ground_truth: If the PDU Session inactivity timer expires before any packet is received or transmitted, the UPF reports this PDU Session inactivity event to the SMF, causing the SMF to release the PDU Session and possibly indicate the release cause as slice inactivity.

q_32929.question: What is the minimum success rate for selecting the correct coverage enhancement level in repeated tests?
q_32929.ground_truth: The minimum success rate for selecting the correct coverage enhancement level in repeated tests is 90%.

q_32930.question: What message does the LMF send to the NG-RAN node to request detailed information for TRPs (tightening resource parameters) hosted by the NG-RAN node?

q_32931.question: What is the purpose of defining a converged online and offline charging description in the present document?
q_32931.ground_truth: The purpose is to specify a converged online and offline charging description for the Edge Computing domain based on the functional stage 2 description in 3GPP TS 23.501 and 3GPP TS 23.558.

q_32932.question: What element should be set to the value of the <forwarding-reason> element contained in the <anyExt> element of the <mcptt-Params> element of the <mcpttinfo> element in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body of the incoming SIP MESSAGE request, if present, when caching both the <forwarding-immediate-list> and the <forwarding-other-list>?

q_32933.question: In step 1, if the T-C field parameter is set to the same value as the "+g.3gpp.registration-token" Contact header field parameter of the third party REGISTER request, what should the S-CSCF do if an IP address associated with the served user and the AS SIP URI exists?
q_32933.ground_truth: The S-CSCF should forward the SIP message to the IP address associated with the served user and the AS SIP URI.

q_32934.question: What is the role of NEF in the data exposure procedure?
q_32934.ground_truth: NEF is involved in the data exposure procedure in case the NF is not trusted.

q_32935.question: What is the RSTD measurement accuracy for all the measurements on the primary and secondary component carriers as specified in sub-clause 9.1.12?
q_32935.ground_truth: The RSTD measurement accuracy for all the measurements on the primary and secondary component carriers is specified in sub-clause 9.1.12.

q_32936.question: What is the minimum requirement for throughput for LTE based 5G terrestrial broadcast?
q_32936.ground_truth: The throughput shall be greater than or equal to 95% of the maximum throughput as represented by a reported BLER of less than 5% for the reference measurement channels.

q_32937.question: What is the role of PCF when the UE Policy Association is for URSP provisioning in EPS and the PCF for the PDU session receives the last SM policy association termination from SMF+PGW-C?
q_32937.ground_truth: The PCF for a PDU session replaces the AMF in the procedure described in clause 5.6.3.1.2 when the UE Policy Association is for URSP provisioning in EPS, and the PCF receives the last SM policy association termination from SMF+PGW-C.

q_32938.question: When the MCPTT client is initiating a call with an implicit floor request, what attribute can it include in the SDP offer?
q_32938.ground_truth: The MCPTT client may include the "a=ssrc" attribute to indicate the RTP SSRC it would like to use if the implicit floor request is granted.

q_32939.question: What should a UE consider when selecting a time and frequency resource for retransmission opportunities?
q_32939.ground_truth: UE should ensure that it selects the resources with a minimum time gap between any two selected resources and prioritize the use of preferred resource sets in its resource (re)selection if multiple preferred resource sets are received from the same UE.

q_32940.question: What is the structure where the AMR-WB+ stream specific information resides?

q_32941.question: Who forwards the request for user plane reporting when the target UE is not capable of supporting event reporting via user plane?
q_32941.ground_truth: The request for user plane reporting is forwarded by the VGMLC, AMF, and LMF to the target UE, and by the target UE to the LCS Client or AF in the control plane.

q_32942.question: What should the system simulator use for Cell 1 in the preamble?
q_32942.ground_truth: The system simulator should use Cell 1(TDD) that is not supported eIMTA in the preamble.

q_32943.question: What is the OTA operating band unwanted emission requirement for IAB-DU type 1-O in FR1, as specified in clause 9.7.4.2?
q_32943.ground_truth: The OTA operating band unwanted emission requirement for IAB-DU type 1-O in FR1, as specified in clause 9.7.4.2, is that for each applicable basic limit in clause 6.6.4.2, the power of any unwanted emission shall not exceed an OTA limit specified as the basic limit + X, where X = 9 dB.

q_32944.question: What is the purpose of including Data Synthesis and Compression (DSC) information in the storage request?
q_32944.ground_truth: The inclusion of DSC information in the storage request provides additional information about the data and how they were generated. This information can be used to indicate whether the data were generated using a data synthesis tool or a data compression tool, and can also include details about the data synthesis and/or compression technique that was used.

q_32945.question: What does the "0" value mean in the defined values of the <state> parameter, which represents the UE's SMS using IMS availability status?
q_32945.ground_truth: The "0" value in the defined values of the <state> parameter means that SMS using IMS is not available.

q_32946.question: What type of SIP MESSAGE request is sent to the originating participating MCPTT function with the Request-URI set to its public service identity, and contains an XML body with an <anyExt> element with the <request-type> set to "group-selection-change-request"?
q_32946.ground_truth: A "SIP MESSAGE request for group-selection-change for originating participating MCPTT function"

q_32947.question: In the urban macro scenario, what percentage of PC1 UE can achieve the target SNR of 30 dB at 39 GHz (n260) in the urban macro scenario?

q_32948.question: What should a controlling MCData function do upon receiving a request for cancellation of emergency one-to-one SDS communication, with an indication that the applicable MCData subservice is Short Data Service using session?
q_32948.ground_truth: The controlling MCData function shall execute the procedure in clause 6.3.7.1.20.

q_32949.question: Which solutions address key issue #1h and #1i and deal with undefined attributes and values in CDR?
q_32949.ground_truth: Solutions #1.11, #1.12, #1.13, #1.16, #1.17, and #1.20 address key issues #1h and #1i; they propose changes to accommodate undefined CDR structure parameters and storage for Open API.

q_32950.question: What type of amplifier was used to drive the MADIface headphone output (Analog 3) in the prototype 2?
q_32950.ground_truth: A Bruel & Kjaer Type 2716C amplifier with +12dB of gain.

q_32951.question: What should the ME do upon receiving an OPEN CHANNEL related to IMS command, if the ME is unable to process the command because there is no channel available?
q_32951.ground_truth: The ME informs the UICC using the TERMINAL RESPONSE (Bearer Independent Protocol error - no channel available)

q_32952.question: What should be done with the "g.3gpp.mcdata" media feature tag in the Contact header field of the SIP re-INVITE request?
q_32952.ground_truth: The "g.3gpp.mcdata" media feature tag should be included in the Contact header field of the SIP re-INVITE request when generating it in response to an MCData user request to cancel an in-progress emergency condition on a prearranged MCData group.

q_32953.question: What is the significance of the internal parameter Th'(prioriRX) in determining non-preferred resources in a UE?
q_32953.ground_truth: Th'(prioriRX) is the RSRP threshold indicated by the k-th field in sl-ThresholdRSRP-Condition1-B-1-Option2List, where k = prioRX. It is used to determine if a received SCI format 1-A has a higher RSRP measurement than Th'(prioriRX) and thus satisfying one of the conditions for a resource to be considered as a non-preferred resource.

q_32954.question: In the context of UP security policy that indicates UP Integrity Protection as "preferred", what should the MN do in the NE-DC scenario if it has activated certain DRBs of the PDU session with UP integrity protection "on" but wants to offload DRBs of this PDU session to the SN?
q_32954.ground_truth: The MN shall not offload any DRB of this PDU session to the SN.

q_32955.question: What are the conditions for the accuracy requirements in 9.1.26.15 and 9.1.26.16 to be valid?
q_32955.ground_truth: The conditions include the transmission of cell-specific reference signals from one, two, or four antenna ports, and the fulfillment of conditions defined in 36.101 Clause 7.3 for reference sensitivity. Additionally, for 9.1.26.16, the channel between the two cells must be at least 20 dB.

q_32956.question: What should the NF service consumer (MB-SMF) do when the removal of MBS PCC rules fails?
q_32956.ground_truth: The MB-SMF should retain the MBS PCC rules removal request and perform the related necessary actions/procedures in the network when it is possible, when the removal of MBS PCC rules fails.

q_32957.question: What is the role of the "content-type" field in HTTP/2?
q_32957.ground_truth: The "content-type" field in HTTP/2 describes the representation data that would have been enclosed in the data frame. It signals the format of the actual representation included in the data frame.

q_32958.question: What is the role of the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay in the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay connection setup procedure?
q_32958.ground_truth: A 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay performs either unicast link setup or unicast link setup modification procedure when an existing link with the target 5G ProSe U2U UE can be modified to support relay communication, as defined in clause 6.4.3 of TS~23.304.

q_32959.question: What action does the V-Consumer NF take after receiving the user consent modification/revocation notification message?
q_32959.ground_truth: The V-Consumer NF stops to use the obtained analytics information and deletes the obtained analytics information.

q_32960.question: What does the term "Key Quality Indicator" (KQI) refer to in the context of TR 28.863?
q_32960.ground_truth: KQI is an indicator that reflects the end-to-end service experience as perceived by the end user. It may be derived from a combination of network layer measurements, service layer measurements and includes qualitative as well as quantitative components.

q_32961.question: What does NRI in UTRAN stand for and what is its purpose?
q_32961.ground_truth: NRI in UTRAN stands for Node Routeing Identifier. It is used to mask out and supply to the RAN node as IDNNS (Intra Domain NAS Node Selector) for UTRAN.

q_32962.question: What are the conditions for RSRP and RSRQ measurements on the primary component carrier to meet the intra-frequency absolute accuracy requirements in section 9.1.11.1?
q_32962.ground_truth: RSRP and RSRQ measurements of cells on the primary component carrier shall meet the intra-frequency absolute accuracy requirements in section 9.1.2.1 and 9.1.5.1 respectively.

q_32963.question: What are the two location services that MNO may deploy considering deployment and cost, in order to achieve consistent location performances?

q_32964.question: What is the significance of the Solution Set definition in the present document?
q_32964.ground_truth: The Solution Set definition in the present document is significant because it is related to 3GPP TS 28.622 and applicable to deployment scenarios using the Service Based Management Architecture, as defined in TS 28.533.

q_32965.question: What should the Intermediate UPF do upon detecting a peer PFCP entity restart in the SMF and not matching any PDRs?
q_32965.ground_truth: The Intermediate UPF should delete all session contexts affected by the PFCP entity restart that it may have stored and discard any GTP-U PDUs not matching any PDRs, returning a GTP error indication to the originating node.

q_32966.question: What is the purpose of OpenXR as an API for developing XR applications?
q_32966.ground_truth: OpenXR provides an interface between an application and an XR runtime, handling functionality such as frame composition, user-triggered actions, and tracking information.

q_32967.question: What is the role of the NG-RAN in 5G networks in terms of network slicing?
q_32967.ground_truth: The NG-RAN, or Next-Generation RAN, supports network slicing by providing differentiated handling of traffic for different network slices, selecting the RAN part of the network slice based on an NSSAI provided by the UE or the 5GC, enforcing QoS policies, and managing resources for different slices. The NG-RAN also supports the selection of the CN (Core Network) part of the network slice, and provides resource isolation between slices to avoid conflicts and ensure performance.

q_32968.question: What features of 5G system can be reused to support the described use case functionality?
q_32968.ground_truth: The 5G system can reuse features like providing required QoS for a service, supporting QoS for applications in a Service Hosting Environment, supporting the creation and enforcement of prioritization policy for users and traffic, and providing notification of communication events to authorized entities.

q_32969.question: What is the difference between the enumerations with "Rm" suffix and without "Rm" suffix?
q_32969.ground_truth: Enumerations with "Rm" suffix have the OpenAPI "nullable: true" property, while those without "Rm" suffix do not have this property.

q_32970.question: How is the dedicated relocation information provided to a collection of UEs?
q_32970.ground_truth: The dedicated relocation information is provided to a collection of UEs by reusing the existing Application Function influence on traffic routing mechanism and including the target DNAI/EAS for the collection of UEs. The collection of UEs can be identified by the group ID or by the target UEs with service information.

q_32971.question: How are the entries in the featureSetsDownlink-v1540 and featureSetsUplink-v1540 list identified?
q_32971.ground_truth: The entries in these lists are identified by their index position. For example, the FeatureSetUplinkPerCC-Id = 4 identifies the 4th element in the featureSetsUplinkPerCC list.

q_32972.question: What should the UE do if it receives the UEInformationRequest message containing rlf-ReportReq while having radio link failure information available?
q_32972.ground_truth: The UE should send the UEInformationResponse message containing the measurement result for inter-frequency neighbor cell if it receives the UEInformationRequest message containing rlf-ReportReq while having radio link failure information available.

q_32973.question: What does the unsolicited result code +CSDBTSRI report?
q_32973.ground_truth: The unsolicited result code +CSDBTSRI reports the S-NSSAI and DNN based back-off timer parameter values from MT to TE if the back-off timer is started, stopped, deactivated or expires.

q_32974.question: In NR sidelink communication, what does AS functionality allow at least?
q_32974.ground_truth: NR sidelink communication allows at least V2X Communication between two or more nearby UEs, using NR technology but not traversing any network node.

q_32975.question: What is the purpose of reducing overhead using other system information?
q_32975.ground_truth: The purpose is to check the timestamp's proximity to the current time before verifying the signature, in order to prevent replay attacks and ensure the authenticity of the system information.

q_32976.question: What is the message type and direction of the "VIDEO PUSH TRYING RESPONSE" message?
q_32976.ground_truth: The message type of the "VIDEO PUSH TRYING RESPONSE" message is "VIDEO PUSH TRYING RESPONSE" and its direction is from a UE to another UE.

q_32977.question: What operation does an NF service consumer use to request the creation of an MBS Policy Association at the PCF?
q_32977.ground_truth: This method enables an NF service consumer (e.g. MB-SMF) to request the creation of an MBS Policy Association at the PCF.

q_32978.question: What is the principle for selection of test points for A-MPR, A-SEM and A-SE single carrier test cases for different NS values in TS 38.521-1?
q_32978.ground_truth: Test points should include possible worst combinations based on the A-MPR characteristics for each NS value, and match with corresponding spectrum emission requirements test points. The number of test points should be realistic.

q_32979.question: What does the OperatorEdgeFederation IOC include in terms of attributes?
q_32979.ground_truth: The OperatorEdgeFederation IOC includes attributes inherited from ManagedFunction IOC and may contain additional attributes related to supporting an edge data network available.

q_32980.question: What should the BM-SC do to the estimated session duration when it modifies an MBMS session during its failure/restart?
q_32980.ground_truth: The BM-SC should set the estimated session duration to a value corresponding to the remaining duration of the session.

q_32981.question: What is the beam prediction accuracy with a 1dB margin for the Top-1 predicted beam?
q_32981.ground_truth: The beam prediction accuracy with a 1dB margin for the Top-1 predicted beam is the percentage of the Top-1 predicted beam whose ideal L1-RSRP is within 1dB of the ideal L1-RSRP of the Top-1 genie-aided beam.

q_32982.question: What does the UP function use to send heartbeat requests towards SMFs or SMF sets in the SMF set?
q_32982.ground_truth: The UP function uses the PFCP control association to send heartbeat requests towards SMFs or SMF sets in the SMF set.

q_32983.question: What kind of information is included in the network steering functionalities information?
q_32983.ground_truth: The network steering functionalities information includes addressing information for the ATSSS capable UE acting as the client for a functionality and addressing and type information for the proxy for that functionality.

q_32984.question: How does the NF Service Consumer decide on the target NF Service Producer in the case of NF service discovery without delegated discovery?
q_32984.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer selects an appropriate NF Producer / NF Service Producer instance from the list of NF profiles provided by the NRF considering NF and NF service parameters such as TAI, S-NSSAI, locality, priority etc.

q_32985.question: What will the controlling MCPTT function do when it receives SIP 2xx responses to the outgoing SIP MESSAGE requests?
q_32985.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function will generate a SIP 200 (OK) response and forward the SIP 200 (OK) response to the originating participating MCPTT function.

q_32986.question: How many MIMO layers does the UE support for NonCB PUSCH on one carrier of one band entry in a band combination?

q_32987.question: What is the impact of high-quality data on the performance of a learning model?
q_32987.ground_truth: The better the quality of data a learning model utilizes, the better the performance it can achieve, assuming the data are reasonably independent or correctly labelled.

q_32988.question: What is the purpose of the "sip:" URI prefix in decrypting a confidentiality protected URI in an attribute in a XML document?
q_32988.ground_truth: The "sip:" URI prefix is used to indicate the start of the encrypted URI in the XML attribute. It helps determine the range of the encrypted URI that needs to be decrypted.

q_32989.question: What functionalities are provided by a PIN client in the PIN enabler architecture?
q_32989.ground_truth: A PIN client provides functionalities such as registration and discovery of services, communication with PIN clients, selection of relay for direct communication, maintaining the PIN profile, performing to join/leave a PIN, supporting service switch internal PIN, and supporting PIN service continuity of PEGC relocation or changing to 5GS communication.

q_32990.question: What information does the participating MCVideo function not determine about the interconnected MCVideo system or the MCVideo gateway server?
q_32990.ground_truth: How the participating MCVideo function determines the public service identity of the controlling MCVideo function associated with the group identity or of the MCVideo gateway server in the interconnected MCVideo system is out of the scope of the present document.

q_32991.question: What information is included in the message sent from HSS to PGW when trace to the MME is activated?
q_32991.ground_truth: The information included in the message sent from HSS to PGW when trace to the MME is activated are Trace Target, Trace Reference, Triggering Events for MME, Trace Depth, List of NE Types to trace, List of Interfaces for MME, and Trace Collection Entity IP Address.

q_32992.question: What is the purpose of correcting the measured waveform by the sample timing offset and RF frequency offset before calculating the EVM?
q_32992.ground_truth: To ensure accurate and reliable measurement of the Error Vector Magnitude.

q_32993.question: What is the name of the unsolicited result code reporting eMBMS session parameter values?

q_32994.question: What should the MCVideo client do when an indication is received from the MCVideo User to cancel the private call request?
q_32994.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should generate a PRIVATE CALL RELEASE message with the call identifier IE, the caller ID, and the callee ID, send the PRIVATE CALL RELEASE message in response to the request message, start timer TFP3, and enter the "P3: waiting for release response" state.

q_32995.question: What action should the SMF take if the UE has requested to join a multicast MBS session in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message and the SMF determines that security protection applies for the multicast MBS session?
q_32995.ground_truth: The SMF shall include the MBS security container in each of those Received MBS information if security protection is applied for that multicast MBS session and the control plane security procedure is used as specified in 3GPP TS 33.501.

q_32996.question: What is the purpose of the "logme" header field parameter in the SIP Session-ID header field?
q_32996.ground_truth: The E-CSCF shall log all SIP requests and responses that contain a "logme" header field parameter in the SIP Session-ID header field if required by local policy.

q_32997.question: What should the controlling MCVideo function do upon receiving a SIP INVITE request containing an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-location-info+xml MIME body with a <Report> element in the <location-info> root element?
q_32997.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function can remember the location information contained in the <location-info> root element.

q_32998.question: What does the "SMS Node Address" field contain?
q_32998.ground_truth: The "SMS Node Address" field contains the assigned E.164 number of the SMS Node that produced the record.

q_32999.question: What action should an ng-eNB take if it receives a conflict between the most recently received Data Traffic Resource Indication IE and the most recently received Protected E-UTRA Resource Indication IE?
q_32999.ground_truth: The ng-eNB should give priority to the Protected E-UTRA Resource Indication IE in case of conflict.

q_33000.question: What information is obtained by the GMLC from UDM during the 5GC-MT-LR Procedure for the UE LCS privacy profile data of the MBSR?
q_33000.ground_truth: The GMLC obtains the Target UE type in the UE LCS privacy profile data of the MBSR from UDM during the 5GC-MT-LR Procedure, which includes the information that the UE does not require UE LCS privacy check.

q_33001.question: What action does the UE need to ensure when requesting the modification of a traffic flow aggregate assigned to a dedicated EPS bearer context?
q_33001.ground_truth: The UE needs to ensure that at least one packet filter applicable to the uplink direction remains among the packet filters created on request from the UE in that TFT or no own packet filters when requesting the modification of a traffic flow aggregate assigned to a dedicated EPS bearer context.

q_33002.question: What is the test purpose in 9.1.12.1.1 and 9.1.12.1.2?
q_33002.ground_truth: The test purpose is to verify the FDD absolute RSRP accuracy requirements for E-UTRA carrier aggregation with 20 MHz bandwidth.

q_33003.question: What are the request body data types for the "application/merge-patch+json" and "application/vnd.3gpp.merge-patch+json" media types?
q_33003.ground_truth: The request body type for both "application/merge-patch+json" and "application/vnd.3gpp.merge-patch+json" is "Resource".

q_33004.question: If the AMF sends a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message including the 5GMM cause value #62 "No network slices available" in the DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message, what should the UE do?
q_33004.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T3521 if it is still running and restart the de-registration procedure if needed upon expiry of the implementation-dependent time.

q_33005.question: What is the focus of key issue #23 in providing highly reliable edge computing?
q_33005.ground_truth: The focus of key issue #23 is to provide fault tolerance, high availability and service resilience for the application services as well as the application supporting layer in edge computing.

q_33006.question: What is the type of information contained in the "UERadioCapabilityIDMappingRequestIEs" sequence?
q_33006.ground_truth: It contains the information elements for the "UERadioCapabilityIDMappingRequest" procedure.

q_33007.question: What should the network do if it detects a RR connection failure after receiving the CM RE-ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message?
q_33007.ground_truth: The network should release all MM connections associated with the RR connection.

q_33008.question: What is the requirement for the relative difference between the maximum coefficient in Range 2 and the minimum coefficient in Range 1?
q_33008.ground_truth: The relative difference between the maximum coefficient in Range 2 and the minimum coefficient in Range 1 must not be larger than 10 dB.

q_33009.question: What should the UE do if the uac-AC-BarringListType indicates that uac-ExplicitAC-BarringList is used and the corresponding UAC-BarringPerCatList contains a UAC-BarringPerCat entry corresponding to the Access Category?
q_33009.ground_truth: The UE should select the UAC-BarringPerCat entry and use it for the access barring check. If the uac-BarringInfoSetList contains a UAC-BarringInfoSet entry corresponding to the uac-barringInfoSetIndex in the UAC-BarringPerCat, the UE should perform the access barring check for the Access Category using the UAC-BarringInfoSet as the "UAC barring parameter".

q_33010.question: What is the maximum number of access categories minus 1 in paging frame?

q_33011.question: What is the expected response from the gNB-DU after receiving a PWS CANCEL REQUEST message with the Cell Broadcast To Be Cancelled List IE not included?
q_33011.ground_truth: The gNB-DU shall stop broadcasting and discard the warning message identified by the Message Identifier IE and the Serial Number IE in the Notification Information IE in all of the cells in the gNB-DU.

q_33012.question: What state does the floor control interface set for the associated floor participant when entering the 'U: not permitted and initiating' state?
q_33012.ground_truth: The floor control interface sets the state for the associated floor participant to 'U: not permitted and initiating' when entering the 'U: not permitted and initiating' state.

q_33013.question: If the 'COT sharing flag' field in SCI format 1-A is present and set to '1', what is the length of the COT sharing additional ID?
q_33013.ground_truth: The COT sharing additional ID is 24 bits when the COT sharing flag is present and set to '1'.

q_33014.question: What action should the initiating UE take after stopping timer T5007 upon receiving a DIRECT LINK SECURITY MODE REJECT message containing a specific cause value indicating integrity failure?
q_33014.ground_truth: The initiating UE shall abort the ongoing procedure that triggered the initiation of the PC5 unicast link security mode control procedure.

q_33015.question: How many subframes after subframe (n) can DTX not be observed for the event "Deactivation" to be considered a success in the inter-band PCell TDD case, if subframe (n+8) and (n+23) were subject to interruption?
q_33015.ground_truth: DTX should not be observed in subframes (n+5) and (n+24), (n+6) and (n+13), (n+21) and (n+28), (n+36) and (n+43) and (n+48) up to the end of T3, or subframes (n+7) and (n+13) and (n+22) and (n+33) and (n+43) and (n+53) and (n+63), and (n+78) up to the end of T3, or subframes (n+8) and (n+23) up to the end of T3 for the event "Deactivation" to be considered a success in the inter-band PCell TDD case.

q_33016.question: What must the SEALDD Server include in the HTTP DELETE response body upon a failure?
q_33016.ground_truth: Appropriate additional error information, as specified in clause 6.2.7.

q_33017.question: What is the test signal level for the measurements of the sending loudness rating (SLR) of handset terminals?
q_33017.ground_truth: The test signal level for the measurements of the SLR of handset terminals is -4.7 dBPa, measured at the MRP (mouth reference point).

q_33018.question: What is the action taken by the NSSAAF if the Network Slice-Specific Authentication and Authorization fails for all S-NSSAIs in the existing Allowed NSSAI for the UE?
q_33018.ground_truth: The NSSAAF executes the Network-initiated Deregistration procedure and includes the list of Rejected S-NSSAIs, each of them with the appropriate rejection cause value in the explicit De-Registration Request.

q_33019.question: What is the requirement for the initialization of an RLOS connection?
q_33019.ground_truth: Only authorized applications on the UE are allowed to trigger the initiation of an RLOS connection.

q_33020.question: What is the role of an MOI in measurement data correlation analytics?
q_33020.ground_truth: The MOI is responsible for handling the input measurement data correlation analytics, including preparing the pipeline of data input, data cleansing, measurement data correlation analytics, and reporting of results.

q_33021.question: What is the worst-case polarization match between the two TRPs assumed in the two-AoA simulations?
q_33021.ground_truth: In the two-AoA simulations, the worst-case polarization match between the two TRPs assumes that the transmitted signal from one TRP is considered interference without any polarization isolation at the UE when decoding the transmitted signal from the other TRP.

q_33022.question: What is the current method of network slice availability in the 3GPP access type?
q_33022.ground_truth: The network slice availability is currently designed to match deployed TA boundaries in the 3GPP access type.

q_33023.question: What does the IP/UDP/RTP overhead include in the bandwidth value for RTP-based media?
q_33023.ground_truth: The IP/UDP/RTP overhead includes the IP, UDP, and RTP protocol headers in the bandwidth value for RTP-based media.

q_33024.question: What is the requirement for unwanted emissions for the IAB-DU and IAB-MT transmitter as specified in clause 6.6.1?
q_33024.ground_truth: The requirement for unwanted emissions for the IAB-DU and IAB-MT transmitter is specified both in terms of Adjacent Channel Leakage power Ratio (ACLR) and operating band unwanted emissions (OBUE).

q_33025.question: What does DNAI represent?
q_33025.ground_truth: DNAI represents an operator defined identifier of a user plane access to one or more DNs where applications are deployed.

q_33026.question: In what state would the UE be, if it received an indication of "back to E-UTRAN coverage" from the lower layers while in the EMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE state?
q_33026.ground_truth: The UE would be in the EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE state.

q_33027.question: What action should the target NG-RAN node take if the 5G ProSe UE PC5 Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate IE is included in the HANDOVER REQUEST message and it is supported?
q_33027.ground_truth: The target NG-RAN node should use the received value for the concerned UE's sidelink communication in network scheduled mode for 5G ProSe services, if supported.

q_33028.question: What is the recommended delay budget for MTSI-based speech-only with LTE, NR or WLAN access, for meeting the required maximum UE send and receive delay?
q_33028.ground_truth: The recommended delay budget for MTSI-based speech-only with LTE, NR or WLAN access, for meeting the required maximum UE send and receive delay, is 123 ms.

q_33029.question: What should the minimum conformance requirement for UE supporting Tx diversity in 6.3G.3.1.3 be?
q_33029.ground_truth: The general ON/OFF time mask requirements in clause 6.3.3.2.3 apply at each transmit antenna connector for UE supporting Tx diversity in 6.3G.3.1.3.

q_33030.question: What is the action performed by the MAC entity when it receives Hibernation and activation/deactivation MAC CEs, both having Ci = "0", and with i being the same as servingCellIndex of SCell?
q_33030.ground_truth: The MAC entity deactivates the Scell and stops reporting CQI/PMI/RI/PTI/CRI for the SCell.

q_33031.question: Based on 6.4F.2, what defines the modulation quality for expected in-channel RF transmissions from the UE?
q_33031.ground_truth: The modulation quality in 6.4F.2 is defined in terms of Error Vector Magnitude (EVM), equalizer spectrum flatness, carrier leakage, and in-band emissions for non-allocated RBs. The measurement methodology for these parameters is specified in Annex E.

q_33032.question: What state does the 5G-RG or W-AGF enter when enforcing wireline access service area restrictions?

q_33033.question: What should the UE do if it has location information available during the emergency session set-up?
q_33033.ground_truth: The UE should include the location information in a PIDF location object and include it in a message body with the content type application/pidf+xml.

q_33034.question: What should the Refer-To header field of the SIP REFER request contain, as specified in step 1) and step 2) of clause 24.2.2.2.1?
q_33034.ground_truth: The Refer-To header field of the SIP REFER request should contain a URI of the MCData session identity to rejoin and a Content-Type header field containing an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME type of the hname "body" parameter in the headers portion of the SIP URI and the hname "body" parameter in the headers portion of the SIP URI containing the <mcdatainfo> element with the <mcdata-Params> element and with the <session-type> element set to a value of "adhoc-group-sds-session" for standalone SDS message and SDS session or "adhoc-group-fd-session" for FD session.

q_33035.question: When should the Period of Validity be considered expired?
q_33035.ground_truth: The Period of Validity is considered expired when the timer corresponding to the period of validity expires, or when another OCI IE with a new set of information is received from the same GTP-C entity.

q_33036.question: What is the purpose of NSSAA procedure?
q_33036.ground_truth: The NSSAA procedure enables the AAA-S via the NSSAAF to (re-)authenticate or (re-)authorize the upper layers of the UE for a UE supporting it and for a HPLMN S-NSSAI or an SNPN S-NSSAI.

q_33037.question: What is the role of the XR application in the rendering loop of the tethered display AR Glasses context?
q_33037.ground_truth: The XR application retrieves the action state, establishes the location of different trackables, synchronizes its rendering loop to the runtime, performs rendering work, and sends the rendered views to the XR Runtime for final compositing.

q_33038.question: How does the network handle NAS triggered requests access attempts in the NG-RAN?
q_33038.ground_truth: The network handles access attempts with establishment causes "emergency", "mps-PriorityAccess" and "mcs-PriorityAccess" with high priority in the NG-RAN. The network responds with RRC Reject to these access attempts only in extreme network load conditions that may threaten the gNB stability.

q_33039.question: What is the purpose of the Disable UE notifications at changes related to Alternative QoS Profiles parameter?
q_33039.ground_truth: This parameter disables QoS Flow parameter signaling to the UE when the SMF is notified by the NG-RAN of changes in the fulfilled QoS situation, which can be the QoS profile or an Alternative QoS Profile.

q_33040.question: What is the main purpose of bit-rate control in media synchronization for terminal clients using variable bitrate encoding?
q_33040.ground_truth: The main purpose of bit-rate control is to reduce the risk that policing functions in the network drop media packets since the bandwidth of packets is temporarily exceeding the allowed bandwidth.

q_33041.question: What is the function of the 'Last Visited PSCell Information' IE?
q_33041.ground_truth: The Last Visited PSCell Information may contain cell specific information, which is used in the handover process.

q_33042.question: What is the role of the DeNB in supporting RNs?
q_33042.ground_truth: The DeNB provides S1 and X2 proxy functionality between the RN and other network nodes, passes UE-dedicated S1 and X2 signalling messages and GTP data packets between the S1 and X2 interfaces of the RN and other network nodes, and embeds and provides S-GW/P-GW-like functions in phase II of RN operation.

q_33043.question: What are the four core media components considered in the Multimedia Telephony Service for IMS?

q_33044.question: What should be the user plane integrity protection policy for 5G ProSe direct communication between the 5G ProSe remote UE and the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE when the RSC is specific for emergency services and the null integrity protection algorithm and the null ciphering protection algorithm are the selected security algorithms?
q_33044.ground_truth: The user plane integrity protection policy should be set to "user plane integrity protection not needed" and the user plane ciphering policy should be set to "User plane ciphering not needed".

q_33045.question: What is the expected input from a MnS consumer to an intent-driven MnS producer for 5GC network management?
q_33045.ground_truth: A MnS consumer can express an intent containing an expectation for 5GC network, including area information (e.g. geographic area), type of network, included 5GC NF list, PLMN information, supported APN information, transport-related parameters, and target network capacity information.

q_33046.question: When is a UE considered to be in enhanced coverage for NB-IoT?
q_33046.ground_truth: A UE is considered to be in enhanced coverage for NB-IoT if it is unable to acquire SystemInformationBlockType1 but can acquire MasterInformationBlock, SystemInformationBlockType1-BR, and SystemInformationBlockType2 while camped in the cell.

q_33047.question: What message does the UE send together with a PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message to request PDN connectivity when initiating an attach procedure?

q_33048.question: What should the Serving GW do if the Modify Bearer Request message is not sent due to certain reasons and PDN GW charging is paused?
q_33048.ground_truth: If the Modify Bearer Request message is not sent due to certain reasons and PDN GW charging is paused, the Serving GW shall send a Modify Bearer Request message with PDN Charging Pause Stop Indication to inform the PDN GW that the charging is no longer paused.

q_33049.question: What should the MS do if it receives a MODIFY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message and cannot accept the new QoS due to resource reasons or the indicated LLC SAPI?
q_33049.ground_truth: The MS shall initiate the PDP context deactivation procedure for the PDP context, indicating "QoS not accepted" as the reject cause IE value in the DEACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message.

q_33050.question: What was used for playback of the pink noise stimulus in the prototype playback system?

q_33051.question: What is the function of the IP-SM-GW in the SM-over-IP protocol?
q_33051.ground_truth: The IP-SM-GW is responsible for sending and receiving short messages over an IP network. It is used as the address of the SM-over-IP sender or receiver in the SM-over-IP protocol.

q_33052.question: What was the maximum degradation percentage reported regarding different fixed Set B pattern in the first generalization scenario?
q_33052.ground_truth: The maximum degradation percentage reported was 40% for Top-1 beam prediction accuracy and was observed in the AI-BM performance compared to the conventional approach with mismatched Set B design.

q_33053.question: What is the required ratio of successful reported values for the RSRP FDD relative accuracy test to pass?
q_33053.ground_truth: In order for the RSRP FDD relative accuracy test to pass, the ratio of successful reported values in each test must be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

q_33054.question: What is the role of the SEAL Data Delivery server in the SEAL Data Delivery architecture?
q_33054.ground_truth: The SEAL Data Delivery server acts as the application server for data delivery enablement, and supports capabilities such as allocating SEALDD traffic descriptor, interacting with 5GS to provide requested parameters, storing application data, and supporting the storage query and management.

q_33055.question: What is the purpose of the 5GS TAC information element in 5G systems?
q_33055.ground_truth: It is used to uniquely identify a 5GS Tracking Area Code

q_33056.question: What information is stored in the SGSNMMRecord?
q_33056.ground_truth: The SGSNMMRecord includes information such as the serving node identifier, the location area code, the routing area, the duration and time of the session, and the serving node type.

q_33057.question: What does SMF determine in order to ensure UE access localized service in the service area/time?
q_33057.ground_truth: SMF determines if UE meets the location and time conditions for localized services based on LADN mechanism. If UE does not meet the conditions, SMF shall instruct the UPF to stop transmitting the localized services to the UE.

q_33058.question: What action does the MAC entity take when the timeAlignmentTimer associated with the TAG is not running, and there is a scheduled uplink transmission for a serving cell?
q_33058.ground_truth: The MAC entity does not perform any uplink transmission on the serving cell, except for the Random Access Preamble transmission.

q_33059.question: In what situations must the network initiate a security mode control procedure to retrieve the UE radio capability ID from the UE?
q_33059.ground_truth: The network shall initiate a security mode control procedure to retrieve the UE radio capability ID from the UE if the UE has included the UE radio capability ID availability IE in the ATTACH REQUEST message and set the IE to "UE radio capability ID available". The network may also initiate the procedure if the UE has included the UE radio capability ID availability IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message and set the IE to "UE radio capability ID available".

q_33060.question: How many different active communication messages are specified in the S1AP?

q_33061.question: Which message is sent by the AMF to the NG-RAN to setup the user plane resource when the N2 SM information is received from the SMF in step 2?
q_33061.ground_truth: The AMF sends a N2 request message to setup the user plane resource when the N2 SM information is received from the SMF in step 2.

q_33062.question: What is the timespan for a UE to search for NR inter-RAT layers in idle mode DC measurements when Srxlev > SnonIntraSearchP and Squal > SnonIntraSearchQ?
q_33062.ground_truth: The UE shall search for NR inter-RAT layers at least every Thigher_priority_search, where Thigher_priority_search is described in clause 4.2.2.

q_33063.question: What should the 5G-RG or the W-AGF acting on behalf of the FN-RG do if the URSP handling layer requests a PDU session providing specific PDU session attributes during PDU session establishment?
q_33063.ground_truth: The 5G-RG or the W-AGF acting on behalf of the FN-RG should establish a PDU session providing the requested PDU session attributes if the URSP handling layer requests a PDU session with specific PDU session attributes during PDU session establishment.

q_33064.question: What should the non-controlling MCVideo function do with the ID data field of the IDRkmsi payload?
q_33064.ground_truth: The ID data field of the IDRkmsi payload should be set to the URI of the MCVideo KMS used by the controlling MCVideo function.

q_33065.question: What state does the UE enter after sending an ATTACH COMPLETE message in response to an ATTACH ACCEPT message with EPS attach result set to "EPS only"?

q_33066.question: What is the use of the "Remote ID" field in the Remote Transmission request message?
q_33066.ground_truth: The Remote ID field in the Remote Transmission request message is used to carry the identity of the user who remotely initiated the media transmission of another user.

q_33067.question: What must the UE do to report a URSP rule precedence during a PDU session establishment procedure?
q_33067.ground_truth: The UE includes a UE Policy Container (URSP Rule Precedence corresponding to the URSP rule enforced by the UE, and the operating system identifier) in the PDU Session Establishment Request message.

q_33068.question: What is the role of the MME in the EPS network architecture?
q_33068.ground_truth: The MME is responsible for handling signaling between the UE and the EPS network, and it also performs various functions such as security, mobility, and bearer management.

q_33069.question: What is the maximum number of valid WLANSP rules that can be active at the same time?
q_33069.ground_truth: At any point in time, there shall be at most one active WLANSP rule.

q_33070.question: How is the channel bandwidth and allocated resource blocks determined in the intra-band contiguous EN-DC power imbalance tests in FR1?
q_33070.ground_truth: The channel bandwidth and allocated resource blocks are determined by first selecting the CBW combinations with the same BWs between E-UTRA MCG carrier(s) and NR SCG carrier. Next, the CBW combinations with the smallest CBW difference between NR SCG carrier and E-UTRA MCG carrier(s) are selected. If there is no such CBW combination, the EN-DC combinations with smallest CBW difference between the NR SCG carrier and E-UTRA MCG carrier(s) are selected. Among the CBW combinations selected in Step 1, the EN-DC combination with the largest aggregated CBW is then selected. The allocation of test resource blocks depends on the bandwidth of the NR SCG carrier in relation to the E-UTRA MCG carrier(s).

q_33071.question: How many time periods are there in test 1 and 2?
q_33071.ground_truth: There are three time periods in both test 1 and 2.

q_33072.question: When should the UE include the "Release assistance indication" IE in the UL NAS TRANSPORT message?
q_33072.ground_truth: The UE may include the "Release assistance indication" IE in the UL NAS TRANSPORT message to inform the network whether no further uplink and no further downlink data transmission is expected or only a single downlink data transmission and no further uplink data transmission subsequent to the uplink data transmission is expected.

q_33073.question: What is the responsibility of the 5G DDNMF/PKMF of the UE in the authorization process in Model A?
q_33073.ground_truth: The 5G DDNMF/PKMF of the UE sends an Authorization Request to the Ranging Server or the UDM of the UE for announcing or monitoring authorization. It generates Discovery Security Material only if the authorization is successful and includes the authorized Role(s) of the UE in the Discovery Response.

q_33074.question: What is the maximum zenith angle for the Fast Spherical Coverage Method in the first hemisphere for test systems with the device repositioning approach?
q_33074.ground_truth: The maximum zenith angle for the Fast Spherical Coverage Method in the first hemisphere for test systems with the device repositioning approach is up to a zenith of 90o.

q_33075.question: What is an SFC in the 5GC network?
q_33075.ground_truth: An SFC (Service Function Chain) is a logical representation of an ordered set of Service Functions that need to successively handle traffic in the 5GC network.

q_33076.question: What is the implication when the User ID field is included in the Floor Taken message?
