q_33076.ground_truth: The User ID field is used in the off-network mode to carry the MCPTT user ID of the floor participant sending the Floor Taken message.

q_33077.question: Which type of information element is used to indicate the trackin Area Code List in the ASN.1 definition?
q_33077.ground_truth: The type of information element used to indicate the tracking Area Code List in the ASN.1 definition is TrackingAreaCodeList-r10.

q_33078.question: What is the role of the AMF in revoking EBI for allocating to a new SMF request?
q_33078.ground_truth: In order to serve a new SMF request of EBI for the same UE, the AMF may revoke an EBI that was assigned to QoS flow(s). The AMF then takes the ARP pre-emption vulnerability and the ARP priority level into consideration and revokes EBIs with a higher value of the ARP priority level first. The AMF then releases the mapped EPS QoS parameters corresponding to the EBI to be revoked and communicates the change to the related SMF, AN, and UE.

q_33079.question: What is the ability of the UE to set its output power to a specific value for each subframe called in the context of E-UTRA uplink transmission?

q_33080.question: When should a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response be sent with the warning text set to "116 user is not part of the MCData group" in a Warning header field?
q_33080.ground_truth: When the <entry> element of the <list> element of the <list-service> element in the group document does not contain an <mcdata-mcdata-id> element with a "uri" attribute matching the MCData ID of the originating user.

q_33081.question: Which clause in TS 36.304 is referenced in the conformance requirements in section 21.1.7.2?
q_33081.ground_truth: The conformance requirements in section 21.1.7.2 refer to clause 6.2 in TS 36.304.

q_33082.question: What is the required periodic measurement reporting accuracy for RSRP and RSRQ measurements in the absence of DRX or scheduled measurement gaps?
q_33082.ground_truth: The required accuracy for RSRP and RSRQ measurements is specified in sub-clauses 9.1.14.2 and 9.1.14.4, respectively.

q_33083.question: What are the two methods of roaming specified in TS 23.280?
q_33083.ground_truth: The two methods of roaming specified in TS 23.280 are EPC-level roaming as defined in 3GPP TS 23.401 and IMS-level roaming as defined in 3GPP TS 23.228.

q_33084.question: What should be done when a subsequent cell triggers the event in a measurement reporting procedure?
q_33084.ground_truth: When a subsequent cell triggers the event in a measurement reporting procedure, the concerned cell(s) should be included in the cellsTriggeredList defined within the VarMeasReportList for this measId and the measurement reporting procedure should be initiated as specified in 5.5.5.

q_33085.question: What does the <Source Statistics Descriptor> parameter specify for a PDP context?
q_33085.ground_truth: The <Source Statistics Descriptor> parameter specifies characteristics of the source of the submitted SDUs for a PDP context.

q_33086.question: What is the formula for calculating the Cumulative Adjacent Channel Leakage power Ratio (CACLR) for repeater type 1-C for DL and UL for NR carriers?
q_33086.ground_truth: The CACLR is the ratio of the sum of the filtered mean power centered on the assigned channel frequencies for the two carriers adjacent to each side of the gap between passband or the inter-passband gap, and the filtered mean power centered on a frequency channel adjacent to one of the respective repeater type 1-C passband edges.

q_33087.question: What should the network do if the UE paging probability information for the UE value is changed or deleted?
q_33087.ground_truth: The network should assign a new GUTI and consider the old UE paging probability information as invalid if the UE responds to the paging with the new GUTI.

q_33088.question: What action does the UE take when the corresponding time and location condition information is satisfied for automatic network selection?
q_33088.ground_truth: When the corresponding time and location condition information is satisfied, the UE activates SNPN access mode and selects a hosting network based on the Hosting Network Identifier in the Hosting Network Selection and Access Information.

q_33089.question: What is an "External KMS" as defined in the document?
q_33089.ground_truth: An "External KMS" is the KMS which is the root of trust for a specific External Security Domain.

q_33090.question: What should a UE do if the registration request is rejected with the rejection cause "S-NSSAI not available due to maximum number of UEs reached"?
q_33090.ground_truth: Unless the back-off timer value received along with the S-NSSAI is zero, the UE should add the rejected S-NSSAI(s) in the rejected NSSAI for the maximum number of UEs reached and not attempt to use this S-NSSAI in the current PLMN or SNPN over the current access until switching off the UE, removing the rejected S-NSSAI(s), or when timer T3526 expires.

q_33091.question: In which scenario does a session continuity situation occur?
q_33091.ground_truth: A session continuity situation occurs when the service is made available via both 5GMS and eMBMS delivery networks, with only one Representation of each Adaptation Set provided via eMBMS.

q_33092.question: What is the maximum variability allowed in the UE sending delay obtained from different calls for MTSI-based speech with LTE, NR, or WLAN access?
q_33092.ground_truth: A variability of up to 20ms may be expected between different calls due to the synchronization between the speech frame processing in the sending UE and the bits of the speech frames at the UE antenna.

q_33093.question: What is the purpose of the 'Source eNB' produced 'Transparent Container IE' in the intra SAE/LTE S1 DAPS handover case and the S1 handover with time-based trigger condition case?
q_33093.ground_truth: The Transparent Container IE is used to transmit information between eNBs during handover cases and is transparent to the EPC.

q_33094.question: What is the significance of the "Traffic Control Data" in policy decision types?
q_33094.ground_truth: The "Traffic Control Data" in policy decision types defines how traffic data flows associated with a rule are treated, such as blocked or redirected.

q_33095.question: How does the SMF determine the TSCAI for the QoS Flow based on the TSC Assistance Container?
q_33095.ground_truth: The SMF determines the TSCAI for the QoS Flow based on the TSC Assistance Container by correcting the Burst Arrival Time, Periodicity, and Survival Time, and setting other parameters as specified.

q_33096.question: Upon successful completion of an attach or routing area update procedure, when does the MS start using the new UMTS security context and the indicated integrity algorithm and encryption algorithm in the LLC layer?
q_33096.ground_truth: The MS shall take the new UMTS security context and the indicated integrity algorithm and encryption algorithm received in the AUTHENTICATION AND CIPHERING REQUEST message into use in the LLC layer after sending the AUTHENTICATION AND CIPHERING RESPONSE message.

q_33097.question: What are the radiated performance requirements specified for in relation to the fixed reference channels in Annex A and the propagation conditions in Annex G for the BS?
q_33097.ground_truth: The radiated performance requirements for the BS are specified for the fixed reference channels defined in Annex A and the propagation conditions in Annex G.

q_33098.question: What is the value set for the "Request-URI" in a SIP MESSAGE request for initiating a remotely initiated group call?
q_33098.ground_truth: The "Request-URI" is set to the public service identity of the terminating participating MCPTT function associated with the targeted MCPTT user.

q_33099.question: What procedure does the P-CSCF follow when it receives an SDP answer and there are no ICE specific procedures since it did not include candidate attributes for TCP based streams in the SDP offer?
q_33099.ground_truth: It simply discards the candidate attributes for TCP based streams in the SDP answer.

q_33100.question: What message does the IAB-donor-CU send to the source parent node IAB-DU to release the migrating IAB-MT's context?
q_33100.ground_truth: The IAB-donor-CU sends a UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND message to the source parent node IAB-DU to release the migrating IAB-MT's context.

q_33101.question: Which are the access technology types associated to the "Operator controlled signal threshold per access technology" parameter?
q_33101.ground_truth: The access technology types associated with the parameter are E-UTRAN - NB-IoT (NB-S1 mode), EC-GSM-IoT (A/Gb mode), E-UTRAN - Category M1 (NB-S1 mode), and E-UTRAN - Category M2 (WB-S1 mode).

q_33102.question: At which period does the transmitter intermodulation requirement apply in a base station?
q_33102.ground_truth: The transmitter intermodulation requirement applies during the transmitter ON period and the transmitter transient period in a base station.

q_33103.question: What protocol is used by 32% of global internet traffic as of November 2018?

q_33104.question: What is the event package that shall be used to obtain the status of participants in group sessions, as defined by IETF RFC 4575?

q_33105.question: What action should the MT take when the targeted application on the UICC does not support the requested EAP method and the MT does support this method?
q_33105.ground_truth: The MT should handle the EAP method, run the authentication algorithm on the SIM or USIM, and allocate an EAPsessionid to identify the EAP session and its corresponding keys and parameters.

q_33106.question: What must the MME do if an APN Restriction is received in the Create Session Request?
q_33106.ground_truth: The MME must store the APN Restriction value for the Bearer Context, check it with the stored value for the Maximum APN Restriction to ensure there are no conflicts, and determine a new value for the Maximum APN Restriction if the Bearer Context is accepted.

q_33107.question: When should the "LTE-M" RAT-Type be set by the MME for a UE accessing E-UTRAN with satellite access and indicating Category M from the eNB?
q_33107.ground_truth: The "LTE-M" RAT-Type should be set by the MME for a UE accessing E-UTRAN with satellite access and indicating Category M from the eNB.

q_33108.question: What are the conditions for the Charging Data Function (CDF) to construct Charging Data Records (CDRs)?
q_33108.ground_truth: CDRs may be constructed from single charging events or a set of several charging events, and each charging event is used for exactly one CDR, never more than once.

q_33109.question: Which entities does the FLS get the location information from if the target UE is with multiple PLMN accesses?
q_33109.ground_truth: The FLS gets the location information via the non-3GPP defined accesses from the FLS-1 reference point and from the LM-S reference point of each PLMN.

q_33110.question: What information does the NetworkSliceController IOC provide in a 5G network?
q_33110.ground_truth: The NetworkSliceController IOC represents the network slice controller in a 5G network that controls the lifecycle of the NetworkSlice MOI. It includes attributes such as serviceProfileId, operationalState, availabilityStatus, and administrativeState. The serviceProfileId defines the service profile identifier provided by the MnS producer for uniquely identifying the network slice related requirements received from the MnS consumer.

q_33111.question: What action does the S-CSCF take when it receives a 2xx response for a BYE request matching an existing dialog?
q_33111.ground_truth: The S-CSCF deletes all the stored information related to the dialog.

q_33112.question: What is the maximum number of cells for QMC?

q_33113.question: What is the purpose of sending dummy GTP-U packets in the QoS monitoring process?
q_33113.ground_truth: The dummy GTP-U packets are not forwarded to the UE or Packet Data Network; instead, they are used to calculate the delay between the UPF and the next downstreams or upstreams GTP-U peer.

q_33114.question: In sidelink transmission mode 4, what is the parameter PSSCH-RSRP used for in the UE's procedure for determining the subset of resources to be reported to higher layers in PSSCH resource selection?
q_33114.ground_truth: PSSCH-RSRP is used as a threshold for the UE to exclude certain candidate single-subframe resources from the set of resources to be reported to higher layers.

q_33115.question: How does the solution for service continuity planning differ from the procedure specified in 3GPP TS 23.558 clause 8.8.2.5?
q_33115.ground_truth: The solution for service continuity planning differs from the procedure specified in 3GPP TS 23.558 clause 8.8.2.5 in the following ways: (1) The detection entities (EEC, S-EAS, S-EES) detect the ACR may be required and identify the ACID and related ACR type (normal ACR or service continuity planning). (2) If the EEC or S-EAS detect the ACR event, the EEC or S-EAS should inform S-EES with ACID, ACR type and predicted/expected UE location or EAS service area in the ACR launching procedure. (3) When S-EAS detects application context transmission is complete, the S-EAS sends ACR status update request message to the S-EES with ACID. (4) Once S-EES detects the UE has moved to the predicted/expected UE location or EAS service area, then the S-EES sends ACR complete notify message to the EEC indicating that UE has moved to the predicted location.

q_33116.question: What is the purpose of the test in section 11.2.10.1, with the user trying to initiate an emergency call using the UTRAN cell?
q_33116.ground_truth: The purpose of the test in section 11.2.10.1 is to ensure that the UE can make a CS emergency call on the UTRAN cell when it is currently in an area that does not support IMS Emergency, but there is a UTRAN cell available.

q_33117.question: What information should be contained in the request body when sending an HTTP PUT request to the MonitorKey custom operation?
q_33117.ground_truth: The RSC and PC5 UE security capability.

q_33118.question: What should the SCC AS do if it receives a SIP UPDATE request on the Source Access Leg after sending a SIP re-INVITE request to the remote UE and prior to sending any final SIP response on the Target Access Leg, and the Remote Leg is an early dialog?
q_33118.ground_truth: It shall send a SIP 200 (OK) response on the Source Access Leg to acknowledge the receipt of the SIP re-INVITE request.

q_33119.question: What is the purpose of the id-Cause field in the MCBearerContextSetupFailureIEs E1AP-PROTOCOL-IES sequence?
q_33119.ground_truth: The id-Cause field in the MCBearerContextSetupFailureIEs E1AP-PROTOCOL-IES sequence is used to indicate the cause of the MC bearer context setup failure.

q_33120.question: How is the SMF Set FQDN constructed, and what information does it include?
q_33120.ground_truth: The SMF Set FQDN is constructed using the NF Set ID, MNC, and MCC, with a subdomain name derived from the Home Network Realm/Domain. It is used to identify an SMF Set within an operator's network.

q_33121.question: What should the 3GPP management system allow an authorized MnS consumer to define, in order to instruct the AI/ML MnS producer on how to perform the AI/ML capability activation?
q_33121.ground_truth: The policies for activation of AI/ML capabilities, such as when and where to activate which AI/ML capabilities.

q_33122.question: What happens when a UE moves between multiple Service Areas in 5GS-EPS interworking with EPS counting active?
q_33122.ground_truth: The NSACF NF handling the shared 5GS-EPS count simply updates the UE stored information, regardless of whether the NSACF is shared or dedicated for 5GS-EPS interworking.

q_33123.question: What is the solution to avoid sensitive information leakage involving S-NSSAI in the 5G system?
q_33123.ground_truth: In order to avoid sensitive information leakage involving S-NSSAI, S-NSSAI is not sent to or made available to a third party AF. Instead, NEF keeps a mapping between S-NSSAI and ENSI (External Network Slice Information) and ENSI (instead of S-NSSAI) is available at the third party AF.

q_33124.question: In what state does the transmission participant enter when Timer T101 (Transmission End Request) expires N times?
q_33124.ground_truth: The 'U: has no permission to transmit' state

q_33125.question: In section 6.2A.2.0.3, what does the MPR for power class 2 for FR2 4UL CA refer to, as indicated in sub-clause 6.2A.2.0.4?
q_33125.ground_truth: The MPR for power class 2 is specified in sub-clause 6.2A.2.0.4 for FR2 4UL CA. The details of the MPR for power class 2 are not provided in this section.

q_33126.question: What should the MME do upon receipt of an SGs paging request including the CS restoration indicator?
q_33126.ground_truth: If the IMSI is unknown or if the IMSI is known and the UE is marked as EMM-DEREGISTERED, the MME shall send the paging request with the location information provided by the VLR. If no such location information is provided, the MME may page the UE in all the tracking areas corresponding to that MME.

q_33127.question: Which message is sent by the gNB-CU-UP to provide information about the DL data arrival or inactivity of the MC Bearer Context to the gNB-CU-CP in the 9.2.5.2.12 message?

q_33128.question: What is the maximum QoS profile data length for SMF in the UTF-8 encoded QoS Profile field for non-GBR 5QIs in the RADIUS attribute as specified in subclause 16.4.7.2?
q_33128.ground_truth: The UTF-8 encoded QoS Profile field for non-GBR 5QIs in the RADIUS attribute is not specified in the present specification.

q_33129.question: What is the minimum size of the temporary identity part of the ProSe Application Code Prefix?
q_33129.ground_truth: The minimum size of the temporary identity part of the ProSe Application Code Prefix is 8 bits.

q_33130.question: What does the "5.3.126.1 Definition" section specify about the data type "NsacfCapability"?
q_33130.ground_truth: It represents the NSACF service capability.

q_33131.question: What message is transmitted by the SS in Cell 1 after the RRC connection release in the test procedure loop?
q_33131.ground_truth: A Paging message with a PagingRecord containing UE-Identity is transmitted by the SS in Cell 1 after the RRC connection release in the test procedure loop.

q_33132.question: What does the PERIO flag in the Usage Report Trigger IE specify?
q_33132.ground_truth: The PERIO flag in the Usage Report Trigger IE indicates periodic reporting.

q_33133.question: In which substate is the UE not allowed to initiate any 5GMM procedure except for cell and PLMN reselection?

q_33134.question: What information does the RRC Handover FROM E-UTRA PREPARATION REQUEST message include in cdma2000 1xRTT?
q_33134.ground_truth: The message includes the specified target RAT type and any cdma2000 specific 1xRTT access parameters needed by the UE.

q_33135.question: What should the transmission participant do when a Transmission Request message is pre-emptive and the transmission arbitrator determines to revoke a transmitter from the transmitter list?
q_33135.ground_truth: The transmission participant should request the MCVideo client to stop rendering RTP media packets from the MCVideo user to be revoked, send the Transmission Revoked message towards the other transmission participants, and start the Transmission Granted timer.

q_33136.question: Which bandwidth classes are used only for FR2-2 operating bands in NR?
q_33136.ground_truth: Classes V and W in 5.3A.4-1 in 38.101-2

q_33137.question: In which message is the T3346 value IE included?
q_33137.ground_truth: The T3346 value IE may be included in the ATTACH REJECT message by the MME when the NAS level mobility management congestion control is active.

q_33138.question: What is required to initiate the 5G ProSe direct link security mode control procedure?
q_33138.ground_truth: The initiating UE must ensure that the target UE has initiated a 5G ProSe direct link establishment procedure or a 5G ProSe direct link re-keying procedure and that security protection is not explicitly declined.

q_33139.question: What protocol type over S5/S8 interface does the target MME indicate to the target Serving GW for each PDN connection?
q_33139.ground_truth: The Protocol Type over S5/S8 is provided to Serving GW which protocol should be used over S5/S8 interface.

q_33140.question: What is the recommended action for solving the Key Issue #1 described in the document?
q_33140.ground_truth: The recommended action is to study and evaluate the provision of MBS assistance information from 5GC to RAN for an MBS session and enhance procedures for MBS sessions with member UEs in RRC Inactive state, while coordinating with RAN WGs for the final conclusion.

q_33141.question: What is used for the initialization of the scrambler and RE-mappers as defined in TS36.211 using a specific value of p?
q_33141.ground_truth: p = 0, even if the signal is transmitted on a physical port other than port 0.

q_33142.question: What is the goal of edge enabler layer support for EAS synchronization?
q_33142.ground_truth: The goal is to enable seamless communication across different EDNs for specific communication sessions, such as multi-user game sessions.

q_33143.question: What does the IWF performing the participating role do when media control messages are negotiated and protection is required between the IWF and the non-controlling MCPTT function?
q_33143.ground_truth: If media control messages are negotiated and protection is required between the IWF performing the participating role and the non-controlling MCPTT function, the IWF shall encrypt and decrypt media control messages using SRTP-MK, SRTP-MS, and SRTP-MKI generated using the SPK and SPK-ID as specified in clause 13.2 when it comes to floor control messages and media control messages.

q_33144.question: What is the impact of the timer expiry at source MME during indirect forwarding?
q_33144.ground_truth: The expiry of the timer at source MME triggers the source MME to send a Delete Indirect Data Forwarding Tunnel Request message to the S-GW to release the temporary resources used for indirect forwarding.

q_33145.question: What message instructs a UPF that supports the DRTSC feature to report user plane node and port management information directly to a TSN AF or TSCTSF?
q_33145.ground_truth: A Direct Reporting Information IE included in the TSC Management Information IE in a PFCP Session Modification Request.

q_33146.question: What should the UE do if it receives a NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message after sending a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message with the same access type in the UE?
q_33146.ground_truth: The UE should ignore the NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message and proceed with the de-registration procedure.

q_33147.question: What is the default value for the "<integrity-protection>" element of the "<signalling-protection>" element?
q_33147.ground_truth: The default value for the "<integrity-protection>" element of the "<signalling-protection>" element is "true" indicating that integrity protection is enabled.

q_33148.question: Which object does the Report Characteristics IE indicate in the RESOURCE STATUS REQUEST message when initiating the measurement for each cell in the Radio Resource Status IE?
q_33148.ground_truth: The first bit of the Report Characteristics IE, when set to "1", indicates that the Radio Resource Status IE is requested to be reported in the RESOURCE STATUS UPDATE message for each cell where the measurement is initiated.

q_33149.question: What do the probability of false detection of the ACK and the probability of detection of ACK define for BS type 1-O?
q_33149.ground_truth: The probability of false detection of the ACK is a conditional probability of erroneous detection of the ACK when input is only noise, and the probability of detection of ACK is a conditional probability of detection of the ACK when the signal is present for BS type 1-O.

q_33150.question: What is the initial condition for testing the UE's spatial coverage?
q_33150.ground_truth: The UE is set in the Tx beam peak direction found with a 3D EIRP scan as performed in Annex K.1.1.

q_33151.question: What HTTP status code indicates that the NEF has successfully updated the concerned "Individual Data Reporting Session" resource?
q_33151.ground_truth: The NEF responds with an HTTP "200 OK" status code when it has successfully updated the resource.

q_33152.question: When does the "Packer Flow Identifier" information element need to be included in the network's message?
q_33152.ground_truth: The network shall include the "Packet Flow Identifier" information element if the network wants to indicate the Packet Flow Identifier associated with the PDP context, and the MS has indicated PFC procedure support in the PFC feature mode field of the MS Network Capability IE.

q_33153.question: What should be done to the PDSCH PRBs in E-SAN-TM3.1 if 64QAM is supported by SAN with power back off?
q_33153.ground_truth: All 64QAM PDSCH PRBs should be replaced by 16QAM PDSCH PRBs if 64QAM is supported by SAN with power back off.

q_33154.question: What action should the gNB-CU-UP take if it receives a BEARER CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message containing a E-UTRAN QoS IE in the DRB To Setup List IE for a GBR QoS DRB but where the GBR QoS Information IE is not present?
q_33154.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-UP should report the establishment of the corresponding DRB as failed in the DRB Failed List IE of the BEARER CONTEXT SETUP RESPONSE message with an appropriate cause value.

q_33155.question: What entity takes the role of "ProSe Function" in the monitoring UE and discoverer UE procedures?
q_33155.ground_truth: The 5G DDNMF takes the role of "ProSe Function" in the monitoring UE and discoverer UE procedures.

q_33156.question: Which procedures apply for emergency PDN connections for the untrusted WLAN case?
q_33156.ground_truth: The procedures defined in clauses 7.4.3, 7.6, 7.9.2, 7.10, 7.11.1, and 8 apply to emergency PDN connections for the untrusted WLAN case.

q_33157.question: What should the UE do when the "UE Manufacturer Assigned operation requested list" contains PLMN assigned UE Radio Capability IDs that were added to the list in the MMEs?
q_33157.ground_truth: The UE shall not re-use the PLMN assigned UE Radio Capability IDs that were added to the "UE Manufacturer Assigned operation requested list" in the MMEs.

q_33158.question: What is the definition of a correct event in the FD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX for UE Category 1bis?
q_33158.ground_truth: A correct event is defined as a successful detection of the uplink signal or a correct determination of the absence of the uplink signal, where the rate of correct events should be at least 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

q_33159.question: What information element is used to indicate the inability to perform the requested retrieve function?
q_33159.ground_truth: The "RETRIEVE REJECT" message is used to indicate the inability to perform the requested retrieve function.

q_33160.question: What should the MS (Mobile Station) do when it receives an ACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT REJECT message with a request type of "emergency"?
q_33160.ground_truth: The MS may inform the upper layers of the failure to establish the emergency bearer, which can result in the upper layers attempting to establish a CS emergency call or initiating other implementation-specific mechanisms.

q_33161.question: What type of number is the CSRN used for in the IM CN subsystem?
q_33161.ground_truth: The CSRN is used as a number that is used to route a call from the IM CN subsystem to the user in the CS domain.

q_33162.question: What is the function of DMRS in the context of NR cell search?
q_33162.ground_truth: DMRS, or Demodulation Reference Sigal, is used for NR cell search in conjunction with primary and secondary synchronization signals, and PBCH DMRS, which are all located on the synchronization raster.

q_33163.question: What is the main advantage of using stacked patches in interleaved array structures?
q_33163.ground_truth: The main advantage of using stacked patches in interleaved array structures is that they allow different bands to feed different elements which are tuned for the specific band, resolving some of the physical restrictions on the element size.

q_33164.question: What happens to the PIN elements of a PIN when a PIN is deleted by the PEMC locally?
q_33164.ground_truth: The PEMC deletes the PIN and the related information stored in the PIN profile, and the PIN elements can't access the 5GS anymore.

q_33165.question: What mandatory action shall the UE take in subclause 5.2.3.2.3.d) if the new cell is not in the forbidden PLMN list?
q_33165.ground_truth: The UE shall initiate a registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update when the current TAI has changed.

q_33166.question: What are the two Doppler frequency options for the PDSCH requirement in the bi-directional deployment scenario?
q_33166.ground_truth: The two options are 9722Hz targeting 350km/h at 30GHz and 7000Hz with the smallest range of frequency offset estimation.

q_33167.question: How many interruptions are allowed during SCell activation for an unknown SCell in intra-band CA?
q_33167.ground_truth: When the SCell being activated is unknown, up to 1+L3,1 interruptions are allowed during SCell activation in intra-band CA.

q_33168.question: What must the SGM-S do upon receiving a CoAP GET request with a valid VAL group document resource URI?
q_33168.ground_truth: The SGM-S must determine the sender's authorization and return all VAL group documents matching the given query parameters in a 2.05 (Content) response if the sender is authorized.

q_33169.question: What is the role of the transmitting part of the SRAP entity on the Uu interface of U2N Relay UE in transmitting SRAP data packets?
q_33169.ground_truth: The transmitting part of the SRAP entity on the Uu interface of U2N Relay UE receives SRAP data packets from the receiving part of the SRAP entity on the PC5 interface of the same U2N Relay UE, constructs SRAP Data PDUs as needed, determines the egress RLC channel, and submits the SRAP Data PDU to the determined egress RLC channel for transmission.

q_33170.question: What is the maximum size of the UUI data type in the provided code?
q_33170.ground_truth: The UUI data type can have a maximum size of 131 octets.

q_33171.question: What should the NSACF in Serving PLMN do when the requested UE admission quota or UE admission threshold cannot be satisfied?
q_33171.ground_truth: The NSACF in Serving PLMN shall send a POST request to the resource representing the network slice admission control related to the number of UEs in the NSACF in HPLMN.

q_33172.question: What action should the remote UE take if it receives a lower layers indication that using radio resources for relay communication is not allowed?
q_33172.ground_truth: The remote UE should abort any ongoing procedures involving a relay, start a timer, and release all direct links used for communication with relay(s) after the timer expires.

q_33173.question: When would the UE store the SNPN identity in the "temporarily forbidden SNPNs" list for non-3GPP access, if the SNPN is selected using credentials from a credentials holder?
q_33173.ground_truth: If the UE is operating in SNPN access operation mode and the service request procedure is rejected with 5GMM cause #74, the UE should store the SNPN identity in the "temporarily forbidden SNPNs" list for the specific access type (non-3GPP access) for which the message was received.

q_33174.question: Based on TS 36.304, clause 5.2.4.2, when can the UE choose not to perform intra-frequency measurements?
q_33174.ground_truth: When the parameter Sintrasearch is greater than the SServingCell and the UE is not required to perform intra-frequency measurements due to other rules.

q_33175.question: What is the goal of the LMF initiated Assistance Data Delivery in clause 8.4.3.2.1?
q_33175.ground_truth: The goal of the LMF initiated Assistance Data Delivery in clause 8.4.3.2.1 is to provide assistance data to the UE for the network-assisted barometric pressure sensor method when initiated by the LMF.

q_33176.question: What information should the SLM-C include in the "location-capability" object when sending a CoAP POST request to the SLM-S for registering location services?
q_33176.ground_truth: The SLM-C may include the "location-access-type" or "positioning-method" in the "location-capability" object.

q_33177.question: What is the aim of SEALDD data distribution mechanisms?
q_33177.ground_truth: To provide interactions between the SEALDD client and SEALDD server for data transmission, control and manage the SEALDD data distribution between the VAL client and VAL server, and manage the bitrate of different users dynamically.

q_33178.question: What is the name of the procedure used to establish necessary resources in an eNB for an incoming handover?

q_33179.question: What is the initial state of the UE before the start of time duration T1?
q_33179.ground_truth: At the start of the test, the UE does not have any timing information of cell 2.

q_33180.question: How does the AF request selecting the same EAS for a collection of UEs?
q_33180.ground_truth: The AF requests selecting the same EAS for a collection of UEs by including a Dynamic External Group ID per DNAI or per External Application ID in the AF request. The PCF then determines the affected UEs and creates PCC rules with the application ID and the Dynamic External Group ID, along with a DNAI correlation indication and/or EAS correlation indication.

q_33181.question: Which protocol is used to transfer application protocol messages between the MME and the UE in the EPS?
q_33181.ground_truth: A generic "container" message, the Downlink Generic NAS Transport message and the Uplink Generic NAS Transport message, is used to transfer application protocol messages between the MME and the UE in the EPS.

q_33182.question: In the scenario where the session starts in 3GPP access, what is performed in step 5 for each PDN connection that is being transferred from 3GPP access during the handover?
q_33182.ground_truth: If not performed in 3GPP access prior to the handover, Step 5 is repeated for each PDN connection that is being transferred from 3GPP access to initiate the PDN GW Initiated PDN Disconnection procedure in 3GPP access or the PDN GW Initiated Bearer Deactivation procedure as defined in TS23.401 clause5.4.4.1.

q_33183.question: How can the MMSE-based receiver help in interference limited cases in a UE with modules on the same face?
q_33183.ground_truth: The MMSE-based receiver performs better than the RAN4 SINR calculation estimate for narrow AoA offsets where interference limited cases become more dominant in a UE with modules on the same face.

q_33184.question: In which storage location is the KAUSF stored if the USIM supports 5G parameters storage?
q_33184.ground_truth: If the USIM supports 5G parameters storage, the KAUSF is stored in the USIM.

q_33185.question: What is the meaning of the term "multimedia messaging body part (MMBP)" in the context of the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_33185.ground_truth: The term "multimedia messaging body part (MMBP)" refers to the definition of parts of message body that carry multimedia content in the 3GPP Technical Specification.

q_33186.question: What is the test signal that should be used for the measurements in the electrical interface UE sending section?
q_33186.ground_truth: The British-English single talk sequence described in ITU-T Recommendation P.501.

q_33187.question: What is the purpose of the EAP Identifier in the NSSAA procedure?
q_33187.ground_truth: The EAP Identifier is used during the NSSAA procedure to identify the slice authentication for the corresponding NSSAA application. It is stored at the NSSAA application level and can be retrieved and used by the ME.

q_33188.question: What is the procedure when a UE moves a PDU Session from 3GPP access to non-3GPP access and an I-SMF had been inserted?
q_33188.ground_truth: An I-SMF may need to be removed during PDU Session mobility from 3GPP to non-3GPP access. Similarly, an I-SMF may need to be inserted during PDU Session mobility from non-3GPP to 3GPP access if the TA associated with the UE location requires the AMF to insert an I-SMF.

q_33189.question: What is the role of the H-PCRF in case 2b during IP-CAN session establishment when session linking is not deferred?
q_33189.ground_truth: The H-PCRF selects or generates PCC rules and derives QoS rules from them, taking into account the user's MPS EPS Priority, MPS Priority Level, and IMS Signalling Priority.

q_33190.question: What should the eNB do with the HANDOVER REQUEST message if it originates from a source NG-RAN node and certain E-RABs are not included in the message?
q_33190.ground_truth: If the HANDOVER REQUEST message is received for an handover originating from a source NG-RAN node, the list of E-RABs contained in the source eNB to target eNB Transparent Container which are not included in the HANDOVER REQUEST message shall be considered as not to be handed over and ignored.

q_33191.question: Which tests require the UE to report SSB time index?
q_33191.ground_truth: Tests 1 and 2 require the UE to report SSB time index.

q_33192.question: What is the unit of QoS differentiation in the MA PDU Session?
q_33192.ground_truth: The QoS Flow is the finest granularity of QoS differentiation in the MA PDU Session.

q_33193.question: How many bits does the FI field occupy in the AMD PDU header?

q_33194.question: What information should the 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay include in the Remote UE Report when sending it to the SMF if the UP-PRUK ID used as Remote User ID is not in NAI format?
q_33194.ground_truth: The HPLMN ID of the 5G ProSe Remote UE.

q_33195.question: What should the NF Service Consumer include in the POST request if the AMF determines that the RAT type is NB-IoT and the UE has already 2 PDU Sessions with user plane resources activated?
q_33195.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer should include the cpCiotEnabled IE or cpOnlyInd IE with the value "True" in the POST request, indicating that the UE is able to support Control Plane CIoT 5GS Optimisation for the PDU session.

q_33196.question: What is the criticality of the "id-gNB-DU-UE-F1AP-ID" in the "UEContextSetupRequestIEs F1AP-PROTOCOL-IES" sequence?
q_33196.ground_truth: The criticality of "id-gNB-DU-UE-F1AP-ID" is "ignore" in the "UEContextSetupRequestIEs F1AP-PROTOCOL-IES" sequence.

q_33197.question: What is the most significant octet in the type Integer in the RADIUS attribute as specified in subclause 16.4.7.2?
q_33197.ground_truth: The most significant octet is the first one in the type Integer.

q_33198.question: What is the role of the "attributeListIn" parameter in the MnS consumer request?
q_33198.ground_truth: The MnS consumer provides in "attributeListIn" none, some or all values for the attributes specified by the managed object class definition.

q_33199.question: What is used to avoid reuse of the COUNT with the same RB identity and with the same KeNB?
q_33199.ground_truth: The eNB may use different RB identities for successive RB establishments, trigger an intra cell handover or by triggering a transition from RRC_CONNECTED to RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE and then back to RRC_CONNECTED.

q_33200.question: What information should the CHF send in the Charging Data Response message when changing the non-blocking mode?
q_33200.ground_truth: The CHF sends the Charging Data Response with the Non-Blocking mode change and the non-blocking mode set by CHF in the Charging Data Response message.

q_33201.question: What HTTP response would the server return if the document URI in the Request-URI has an incorrect application id?
q_33201.ground_truth: The server would return an HTTP 409 (Conflict) response including the XCAP error element <constraint-failure>.

q_33202.question: What takes precedence when selecting an SGSN based on both low access priority and UE Usage Type parameter?
q_33202.ground_truth: Selection based on the UE Usage type parameter overrides selection based on the low access priority indication.

q_33203.question: What is the purpose of the T8 Long Term Transaction Reference ID in the 3GPP specification?
q_33203.ground_truth: The T8 Long Term Transaction Reference ID (TLTRI) in the 3GPP specification is a parameter that refers to long term transactions between the SCEF and the SCS/AS when using the T8 interface. TLTRI is assigned by the SCEF and is unique through the duration of the transaction. It is stored on both the SCEF and the SCS/AS for the duration of the transaction.

q_33204.question: What is the purpose of the +CMUX command, and what is its default setting?
q_33204.ground_truth: The +CMUX command is used to enable/disable the 3GPP TS 27.010 multiplexing protocol control channel. The default setting for port speed in the +CMUX command is implementation-specific.

q_33205.question: What is the condition for the UE to determine the corresponding PHICH resource of serving cell n for PUSCH transmissions in subframe n?
q_33205.ground_truth: The UE shall determine the corresponding PHICH resource of serving cell n for PUSCH transmissions in subframe n, where n is always 4 for FDD.

q_33206.question: Under what conditions do the PUCCH with DM-RS bundling requirement tests apply for TDD with different subcarrier spacings?
q_33206.ground_truth: The PUCCH with DM-RS bundling requirement tests apply for each subcarrier spacing declared to be supported in TDD with different subcarrier spacings.

q_33207.question: What should an MTSI client do if it receives an SDP bandwidth modifier for RTCP equal to zero from the originating MTSI client in a point-to-point speech only session?
q_33207.ground_truth: If an MTSI client receives SDP bandwidth modifiers for RTCP equal to zero from the originating MTSI client in a point-to-point speech only session, it should reply by setting its RTCP bandwidth using SDP bandwidth modifiers with values equal to zero.

q_33208.question: What is the information provided by the CN to RAN to optimize gNB radio resource scheduling for XR traffic?
q_33208.ground_truth: The information provided by the CN to RAN to optimize gNB radio resource scheduling for XR traffic includes the periodicity for UL and DL traffic of the QoS Flow, DL traffic jitter information, PDU Set QoS parameters, and PDU Set Information and Identification.

q_33209.question: What information does UE-1 include in the Solicitation message in UE-UE Relay discovery in Model B?
q_33209.ground_truth: UE-1 includes the following parameters in the Solicitation message: Type, Discovery Type, Discoverer Info, ProSe UE ID of UE-1, and a list of Target User Info parameters corresponding to the target user(s) of interest.

q_33210.question: What action should be taken by a group management server when it receives a request to delete a temporary MCS group and needs to delete constituent group documents as well?
q_33210.ground_truth: The group management server should send an HTTP DELETE request to the location of each constituent group document as specified in the group document indicated by the Request-URI.

q_33211.question: What information does the SMS-SC store when it fails to deliver a trigger message?
q_33211.ground_truth: The SMS-SC stores the trigger payload, without routing information, if the message delivery fails and is attempted to be delivered again.

q_33212.question: When the SS-UE receives the MIB-SL over the sidelink system control port, how is the DirectFrameNumber set?
q_33212.ground_truth: A dummy value is provided by TTCN, and the SS-UE should set the DirectFrameNumber and DirectSubframeNumber in the MIB-SL.

q_33213.question: What should the source eNB do if the timer TRLOCprep expires before receiving any response from the target eNB after sending a Handover Request message?
q_33213.ground_truth: The source eNB should cancel the Handover Preparation procedure towards the target eNB by initiating the Handover Cancel procedure with the appropriate value for the Cause IE and remove any reference and release any resources related to the concerned X2 UE-associated signalling.

q_33214.question: Which extension is defined for the WWW-Authenticate header field in the SIP core network for UE authentication procedure in 3GPP TS 24.229?
q_33214.ground_truth: This extension defines a new authentication parameter (auth-param) for the WWW-Authenticate header field used in a 401 (Unauthorized) response to the REGISTER request. The S-CSCF appends the integrity-key and cipher-key parameters (directive) to the WWW-Authenticate header field in a 401 (Unauthorized) response and the P-CSCF stores the integrity-key and cipher-key value respectively. The P-CSCF removes the integrity-key and cipher-key parameter from the header field prior to forwarding the response to the UE.

q_33215.question: When retrieving a group document for a non-controlling MCVideo function to initiate a temporary group session, what does the requested group identity refer to in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body of the SIP INVITE request?
q_33215.ground_truth: The requested group identity refers to the group identity of the constituent group contained in the <associated-group-id> element of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body of the SIP INVITE request.

q_33216.question: What field is set to the From header field value as received in the initial INVITE request in the To header field when a SIP dialog is established?
q_33216.ground_truth: The To header field is set to the From header field value as received in the initial INVITE request.

q_33217.question: What functions can the NEF perform regarding the usage of AF specific UE identifier?
q_33217.ground_truth: The NEF can enforce restriction on the usage of AF specific UE identifier, such as rejection of a service request from AF not authorized to use the UE identifier.

q_33218.question: In the context of 7.2.3.7.1 and 7.2.3.7.2, what is the range of the transmitting window, and how does it affect the transmission of AMD PDUs and the updates to VT(A)?
q_33218.ground_truth: The transmitting window includes SNs if VT(A) < SN < VT(MS). When VT(A) = SN for a transmitted AMD PDU, VT(A) is set equal to the SN of the AMD PDU with the smallest SN, whose SN falls within the range VT(A) < SN < VT(S) and for which a positive acknowledgment has not been received yet.

q_33219.question: What is the goal of solution #6 - End-to-end security establishment for Layer-2 UE-to-UE relay?
q_33219.ground_truth: The goal of solution #6 is to address security requirement for providing confidentiality, integrity protection of end-to-end information exchanged between the peer UEs over the L2 UE-to-UE Relay in key issue #2 by performing service authorization and policy provisioning for the Source UE, Target UE and UE-to-UE Relay, security establishment for PC5 link between the source UE and UE-to-UE relay and between the target UE and UE-to-UE relay, and End-to-End PC5 link establishment between the source UE and target UE.

q_33220.question: What type of information is carried in a PDU-Set in the context of 5GS and real-time media?
q_33220.ground_truth: A PDU-Set is composed of one or more PDUs carrying the payload of one unit of information generated at the application level, such as a frame or video slice for XRM Services.

q_33221.question: What is the role of the compositor in the tethered display AR Glasses context?
q_33221.ground_truth: The compositor is responsible for taking all the received layers, performing any necessary corrections such as pose correction and lens distortion, compositing them, and then sending the final frame to the display.

q_33222.question: In subclause 5.6.1.1 a), what should the UE set in the Control plane service type of the CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message when it has pending user data to be sent via the user plane?
q_33222.ground_truth: The UE should set the Control plane service type to "mobile terminating request".

q_33223.question: What should the participating MCVideo function do if it does not receive a 200 (OK) message from a specific MCVideo client upon sending a MuSiK download message?
q_33223.ground_truth: If the participating MCVideo function does not receive a 200 (OK) message from a specific MCVideo client, it shall use unicast signalling for transmission control towards that MCVideo client for the groups for which the MuSiK was intended.

q_33224.question: What is the role of the default V-SMF during a handover procedure in 5G roaming scenarios?
q_33224.ground_truth: The default V-SMF handles the Data Forwarding Tunnel Info in the case of home routed roaming and indicates the mapping between the TEID where the UPF receives data forwarded by the source SGW and the QFI(s) and N3 Tunnel Info for data forwarding where the UPF is selected to forward such data.

q_33225.question: What is the document titled that provides specifications for the 3GPP IMS Management Object?
q_33225.ground_truth: The title of the document is "3rd Generation Partnership Project; Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terms; 3GPP IMS Management Object (MO); Stage 3 (Release 18)".

q_33226.question: What should the MSGin5G Gateway UE do upon reception of a CoAP 2.04 (Change) response for the bulk de-registration request from the MSGin5G Server?
q_33226.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Gateway UE should split the content of the "List of individual MSGin5G UE de-registration response" element into multiple individual de-registration responses and generate one or more CoAP POST requests as de-registration responses to constrained UEs separately.

q_33227.question: When is the network support of remote UE's emergency service provided to a 5G ProSe-enabled UE that is capable of UE-to-Network Relay?
q_33227.ground_truth: The network support of remote UE's emergency service is provided to a 5G ProSe-enabled UE that is capable of UE-to-Network Relay during Registration procedure by the AMF.

q_33228.question: What is the scope of this study?
q_33228.ground_truth: The study aims to identify key issues and solutions in order to address the security aspects of employing AI/ML techniques in RAN.

q_33229.question: Which combinations of system information blocks (NR-X) are used in sidelink communication test cases?
q_33229.ground_truth: Combinations NR-14, NR-15, NR-16, and NR-17 are used in sidelink communication test cases.

q_33230.question: What are the reporting requirements for RSTD measurements in NPRS occasions?
q_33230.ground_truth: The UE physical layer shall be capable of reporting RSTD for the reference cell and all the neighbor cells i out of at least (n-1) neighbor cells, where n is the number of cells including the reference cell, all with a minimum NPRS subframes per cell measurement, and with a maximum NPRP in a corresponding band.

q_33231.question: What indication does the MN include in the SN Addition procedure to request the target SN to allocate resources for the UE in the SN initiated SN change procedure?
q_33231.ground_truth: The MN requests the target SN to allocate resources for the UE by means of the SN Addition procedure, including the measurement results related to the target SN received from the source SN.

q_33232.question: What action must the UE take upon receiving a TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message?
q_33232.ground_truth: The UE must stop timer T3430, reset the service request attempt counter, and set the EPS update status to EU1 UPDATED.

q_33233.question: When the SMF receives a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST during a network-requested PDU session release procedure, what should the SMF do if the indicated PDU session is the same?
q_33233.ground_truth: The SMF shall ignore the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message and proceed with the PDU session release procedure.

q_33234.question: What should the MME do if it receives a tracking area update request from the UE and the serving MME has changed?
q_33234.ground_truth: The MME should stop and reset timer~Ts6-1 and start the location update for non-EPS services procedure.

q_33235.question: What should the MCData client do upon receiving a request to leave an MCData adhoc group session established using pre-established session?
q_33235.ground_truth: Upon receiving a request to leave an MCData adhoc group session established using pre-established session, the MCData client should interact with the media plane, generate an initial SIP REFER request outside a dialog, set the Request-URI of the SIP REFER request to the public service identity identifying the pre-established session on the MCData server, and include a Target-Dialog header field identifying the pre-established session.

q_33236.question: What is the maximum total sum of UE delays in sending and receiving directions (Ts + TR) for MTSI-based speech-only with LTE, NR or WLAN access in error and jitter free conditions for headset UE?
q_33236.ground_truth: The maximum total sum of UE delays in sending and receiving directions (Ts + TR) for MTSI-based speech-only with LTE, NR or WLAN access in error and jitter free conditions for headset UE is 150 ms.

q_33237.question: What is the procedure for selecting the S11 interface of the SGW from the SGW's canonical node record?
q_33237.ground_truth: If it is not obtained from the TAI/eNodeB-ID records, the MME selects the S11 interface of the SGW from the SGW's canonical node record.

q_33238.question: When does the additional BC3 blocking requirement apply?
q_33238.ground_truth: The additional BC3 blocking requirement applies when a BS is operating in the same geographical area as UTRA TDD.

q_33239.question: What should a UE do upon receiving 5GMM cause #80 in a non-satellite NG-RAN cell?
q_33239.ground_truth: The UE shall set the 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, delete certain information, reset the registration attempt counter, store the PLMN identity in the list of PLMNs not allowed to operate at the present UE location, and start a corresponding timer.

q_33240.question: What is the use of a UE to network sidelink relay in 3GPP 5G?
q_33240.ground_truth: The specification covers the use of UE to network sidelink relays by specifying the additional requirements that apply for a sidelink relay UE and a sidelink remote UE, i.e. for such UEs the regular sidelink UE requirements equally apply unless explicitly stated otherwise.

q_33241.question: What should the controlling MCPTT function include in the SIP NOTIFY request when including a conference-info MIME body?
q_33241.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function should include the MCPTT group ID of the MCPTT group in the "entity" attribute of the conference-info element.

q_33242.question: What does the <xs:any namespace="##other" processContents="lax" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded"/> particle in the XML Schema do?
q_33242.ground_truth: This particle allows any element to be present in the XML document with a namespace other than the target namespace and with a lax validation process.

q_33243.question: What actions should the NF Service Consumer take if the delivery of the N1 message fails while moving a non-3GPP PDU session to 3GPP access?
q_33243.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer should delete any stored representation of the N1N2MessageTransfer request resource URI upon receiving this notification.

q_33244.question: Which reference point is not supported by SM-PCF while N7 reference point is not supported by UE-PCF in this solution for URSP delivery from UE-PCF in 5GC to the UE in EPS?
q_33244.ground_truth: SM-PCF does not support N15 reference point while UE-PCF does not support N7 reference point.

q_33245.question: What is the role of the Connection Management sublayer in the 3GPP TS?
q_33245.ground_truth: The Connection Management sublayer in the 3GPP TS is responsible for the functions of the Control, Provision, and Support of services offered by the network. This includes functions such as establishing, maintaining, and terminating circuit-switched connections, supporting supplementary services, supporting short message services, and supporting location services for certain types of MS.

q_33246.question: What should the AMF node name be if the operator wants to use the 3GPP defined AMF instance FQDN for provisioning?
q_33246.ground_truth: The AMF node name should be the 3GPP defined AMF instance FQDN or an alias of the AMF's canonical node name.

q_33247.question: What is required for an SNPN to be deployed as an isolated network from the PLMN?
q_33247.ground_truth: For an SNPN to be deployed as an isolated network from the PLMN, it needs to be identified with a dedicated NPN identifier and optionally connected to the public network services via a firewall.

q_33248.question: What action shall the UE take if no CAG-ID is authorized based on the "allowed CAG list" for the current PLMN?
q_33248.ground_truth: The UE shall enter the state 5GMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH and shall apply the PLMN selection process defined in 3GPP TS 23.122 with the updated "CAG information list".

q_33249.question: What is the effect of phase noise on wireless communications?
q_33249.ground_truth: Phase noise in the receiver can lead to interference, particularly when it is high and the downlink signal is received at very high power, resulting in reciprocal mixing on a high-power signal in the downlink sub-band, causing interference in the uplink sub-band.

q_33250.question: What is the size of the UCI information bit payload per slot for CSI part 1 and CSI part 2?
q_33250.ground_truth: The UCI information bit payload per slot for CSI part 1 is 5 bits, and for CSI part 2 is 2 bits.

q_33251.question: What types of NR UE does the test case for non-concurrent operation apply to?
q_33251.ground_truth: This test case applies to all types of NR UE release 16 and forward that support NR V2X sidelink communication with non-concurrent operation.

q_33252.question: What is the Sidelink interface used for in 3GPP networks?
q_33252.ground_truth: The Sidelink interface is used for direct communication between UEs over the PC5 interface, enabling features like ProSe Direct Communication and sidelink discovery.

q_33253.question: What should be done if a UE supports the UPLF test mode in release 16 or later?
q_33253.ground_truth: The SS should apply a backoff on the PCell power by activating the UE Power Limit Function (UPLF).

q_33254.question: What do the terms "modal verbs" in the document refer to?
q_33254.ground_truth: Modal verbs are verbs that express modality, i.e. they indicate obligation, possibility, or ability.

q_33255.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 8.5.1.3?
q_33255.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described in 8.5.1.3 is to verify the receiver's ability to achieve the throughput under multipath fading propagation conditions for a given SNR.

q_33256.question: What type of data transfer policy is valid for packet switched traffic in a 5GS network?

q_33257.question: In the measurement restriction for CSI-RS based candidate beam detection, which restriction is applied when CSI-RS for CBD measurement is in the same OFDM symbol as SSB for L1-RSRP measurement?
q_33257.ground_truth: UE is not required to receive CSI-RS for CBD measurement in the PRBs that overlap with the SSB from a candidate LTM neighbor cell for L1-RSRP measurement on the same or adjacent OFDM symbol for both FR1 and FR2.

q_33258.question: What action does the EES take upon receiving an EAS discovery request and finding that the EEC is authorized to discover the requested EAS(s)?
q_33258.ground_truth: The EES generates charging data related to the EAS discovery request, sends the charging data request to the CHF for processing, creates a CDR related to the event, and informs the EES of the result of the request.

q_33259.question: What protocol is used by the PDN GW to initiate an authorization procedure for establishing a new PDN connection via a non-3GPP access network?
q_33259.ground_truth: The PDN GW uses the Diameter protocol to initiate an authorization procedure for establishing a new PDN connection via a non-3GPP access network.

q_33260.question: What should the floor participant interface do when it receives RTP media packets from the network media interface?
q_33260.ground_truth: If the RTP media packets are from the media distributor, the floor participant interface should send the received RTP media packets towards the MCPTT client. If the RTP media packets are from the MCPTT client, the floor participant interface should send a Floor Revoke message to the MCPTT floor participant and store the expectation of a Floor Release message from the MCPTT floor participant.

q_33261.question: When do the requirements of the test apply for network signalling values FFS in test cases 6.5A.2.3 and 6.5A.3.3?
q_33261.ground_truth: The requirements of the test apply to all types of NR UE release 15 and forward in test cases 6.5A.2.3 and 6.5A.3.3 for network signalling values FFS.

q_33262.question: What capability should the SEALDD server provide to support the data storage service?
q_33262.ground_truth: The SEALDD server should provide capabilities such as data storage, cache services, and support for data retrieval directly from the server to reduce processing time and transferring resources cost on interacting with the 3GPP network or application server.

q_33263.question: What is the purpose of the "Event Timestamp" field in the SMS CDRs?
q_33263.ground_truth: The Event Timestamp field contains the timestamp of the event that triggered the generation of charging information for the SMS transaction.

q_33264.question: When does a Reference/Target UE authorize the SL Positioning Client UE based on the information of the involved UEs during direct communication establishment?
q_33264.ground_truth: During the establishment of direct communication, the Reference/Target UE should authorize the SL Positioning Client UE based on the information of the involved UEs sent by the SL Positioning Client UE in the Direct Communication Request.

q_33265.question: What happens to the old communication path when UE-1 and UE-2 switch communication paths?
q_33265.ground_truth: If the old communication path is still valid, UE-1 may negotiate with UE-2 to confirm the switching of communication path. After switching, the old communication path is released.

q_33266.question: In what unit is the variable Ms expressed in TS 36.331, clause 5.5.4.8?
q_33266.ground_truth: Ms is expressed in dBm in case of RSRP, or in dB in case of RSRQ.

q_33267.question: What is the difference between scenario 2.1 and scenario 2.2 in the described EAS re-discovery procedure?
q_33267.ground_truth: In scenario 2.1, the H-SMF has knowledge of EAS deployment information in VPLMN and sends an EAS rediscovery indication and impact field to the UE. In scenario 2.2, the H-SMF does not have this knowledge and only sends an EAS rediscovery indication to the UE.

q_33268.question: What is the maximum measurement reporting delay required for the UE in this test case?
q_33268.ground_truth: The maximum measurement reporting delay required for the UE in this test case is 30.72 seconds for Test 1 and 30722 ms for Test 2.

q_33269.question: What is the purpose of the Uplink (UL) Reference Measurement channels set for E-UTRA CG and NR CG?
q_33269.ground_truth: The UL Reference Measurement channels are set for E-UTRA CG and NR CG to ensure proper downlink and uplink signaling for testing.

q_33270.question: What is the purpose of the LowerMSDRequest-r18 in the UE-CapabilityRequestFilterCommon?
q_33270.ground_truth: The LowerMSDRequest-r18 in the UE-CapabilityRequestFilterCommon is used to request UE capabilities for low MSD support in NR. It is included in the capability container request list.

q_33271.question: What should the NF service consumer do if it supports the SBI Message Priority mechanism for an MCS session in 3GPP TS 22.179?
q_33271.ground_truth: The NF service consumer should include the "3gpp-Sbi-Message-Priority" custom HTTP header towards the PCF with a priority value, equivalent to the value of the "resPrio" attribute. Additionally, the NF service consumer will include the "3gpp-Sbi-Message-Priority" custom HTTP header with the lowest value for the highest user priority value in 3GPP TS 29.500.

q_33272.question: What does the term "shall" indicate in a 3GPP TSG Technical Specification or Technical Report?
q_33272.ground_truth: "Shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

q_33273.question: What is the functionality of NSWOF when used for wireline access in the SNPN network?
q_33273.ground_truth: NSWOF of wireline access in the SNPN network interfaces to a 5G-RG using a SWa interface. The device connecting to 5G-RG is authenticated and authorized by the HPLMN of this device. The authentication procedure does not require 5GS registration because it is based on the NSWO authentication procedure.

q_33274.question: Why should "leaf-lists" for "SubNetwork" be defined directly under the class definition in the YANG model, instead of in the "SubNetworkGrp" grouping?
q_33274.ground_truth: This is because the "path" statements for the "leaf-lists" are specific to each class and should not be inherited by child classes.

q_33275.question: What should a mobile station (MS) do if it receives the "Extended wait time" for CS domain from the lower layers when no location updating or CM service request procedure is ongoing?
q_33275.ground_truth: The MS shall ignore the "Extended wait time".

q_33276.question: What is the action taken when T2 expires during the test?
q_33276.ground_truth: The SS deactivates SCell1 by sending the deactivation MAC-CE, and if an ACK is received, T3 starts. If not, the test moves to step 12. After T2 expires, the SS deactivates SCell2 as well.

q_33277.question: What is the result when an MCPTT user is requested to leave a group call due to de-affiliation?
q_33277.ground_truth: The MCPTT user will be notified and removed from the ongoing group call, and the MCPTT client will send a group call leave response to the MCPTT server, leaving the group call.

q_33278.question: What is the procedure for the authentication and authorization of untrusted access?
q_33278.ground_truth: The UE and ePDG perform mutual authentication during IPsec tunnel establishment and an additional access authentication may be required for the untrusted non-3GPP access network.

q_33279.question: Which clause in 7.3A.3.3.3 specifies the minimum conformance requirements for 7.3A.3.3.1?

q_33280.question: Which parameter represents the ResourceCoordinationTransferContainer type in the F1AP protocol?

q_33281.question: What is the difference between direct and indirect data collection methods for UE data?
q_33281.ground_truth: Direct data collection refers to the collection of UE data by the 5GMS AF from the 5GMS Client over the M5 interface. Indirect data collection refers to the collection of UE data by the 5GMS AF from the Application Service Provider (ASP) through the M8 application layer interface. Indirect data collection is not specified in TS 26.501 and TS 26.512 and may be supported by defining a separate interface between the ASP and the 5GMS AF.

q_33282.question: What is the role of the LIPF in the 5GC network?
q_33282.ground_truth: The LIPF, present in the ADMF, provisions the IRI-POI in the AMF and the MDF2. It may interact with the SIRF to discover AMFs in the network and receives the warrant from an LEA, deriving the intercept information from the warrant and providing the same to the LICF.

q_33283.question: What should the GNSS position of a UE do in connected mode before transmitting if it becomes outdated?
q_33283.ground_truth: The GNSS position of a UE in connected mode should acquire the broadcasted parameters upon becoming outdated before transmitting.

q_33284.question: What cumulative basic limit is applied to the sub block gap in a single-band connector operating in non-contiguous spectrum?
q_33284.ground_truth: A combined basic limit is applied to the sub block gap, which is the cumulative sum of the basic limits specified for the adjacent sub blocks on each side of the sub block gap.

q_33285.question: What is the purpose of the IP-SM-GW-Realm AVP, and what information does it contain?
q_33285.ground_truth: The IP-SM-GW-Realm AVP contains the Diameter identity of the registered IP-SM-GW's realm. It is of type DiameterIdentity, and it provides further details on the encoding of this AVP as specified in IETF RFC 3588.

q_33286.question: What is the format of the Content-Type header field when submitting an SM over IP with a SIP URI as the destination?
q_33286.ground_truth: The Content-Type header field shall contain "multipart/mixed".

q_33287.question: What is the difference between FKP Network RTK service and PPP service?
q_33287.ground_truth: FKP Network RTK service derives horizontal gradients of distance-dependent errors from a network of GNSS Reference Stations and broadcasts them to a target device, while PPP service uses precise satellite orbit and clock parameters derived from global networks of Reference Stations to perform single station positioning.

q_33288.question: What should the network do upon reception of a NOTIFICATION RESPONSE message over non-3GPP access, indicating the UE's inability to initiate a service request procedure or registration procedure over 3GPP access?
q_33288.ground_truth: The network should stop timer T3565 and notify the SMF that the UE is unreachable. If the NOTIFICATION RESPONSE message includes the PDU session status information element, the network should release all those PDU sessions which are not in the 5GSM state PDU SESSION INACTIVE in the UE, and request the SMF to perform a local release of all those PDU sessions associated with the 3GPP access.

q_33289.question: What message is sent by the source NG-RAN node to request the cancellation of an ongoing handover?

q_33290.question: What information could the target V-SMF include in the content of the POST response if it supports the HR-SBO feature and the request is to retrieve the complete SM context for a HR-SBO session?
q_33290.ground_truth: The HR-SBO related information, such as hrsboAuthResult, hDnsAddr, hPlmnAddr, vplmnOffloadingInfoList, could be included in the content of the POST response message by the target V-SMF.

q_33291.question: What should the User Equipment (UE) include in the Accept-Contact header field when sending a request if the ICSI for the IMS communication service is known?
q_33291.ground_truth: The UE may include an ICSI value (coded as specified in subclause 7.2A.8.2) that is related to the request in a g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag.

q_33292.question: What should a UE do if the de-registration type indicates "re-registration required"?
q_33292.ground_truth: The UE should ignore the 5GMM cause IE if received.

q_33293.question: What event triggers the AMF to interact with the PCF and generate RFSP index associated with the Target NSSAI?
q_33293.ground_truth: A Generation of a Target NSSAI trigger

q_33294.question: What entities does the temporary network reselection solution impact?
q_33294.ground_truth: The temporary network reselection solution impacts the following entities: the home network, the AMF, AF/NEF/UDR, and the UE.

q_33295.question: What information does the MNO create in the MOI for UPS related information of the MNO site?
q_33295.ground_truth: The MNO creates information about whether the MNO site has UPS installed, the total UPS backup capacity, the status of the remaining UPS backup capacity, the identity of the DSO energy supply meter present in the MNO site, and the identity of the base station present in the MNO site.

q_33296.question: What is the purpose of the IP-SM-GW-SBI-Support-Indicator AVP in 5.3.3.39?
q_33296.ground_truth: The IP-SM-GW-SBI-Support-Indicator AVP in 5.3.3.39 is used to indicate whether the IP-SM-GW supports service-based-interface or not.

q_33297.question: What condition must be met in step 7 in order to increase the number of successful tests?
q_33297.ground_truth: The UE must start to report valid ACK/NACK for the PSCell from the first UL slot that occurs after the beginning of DL slot (i+ ) in step 7.

q_33298.question: What does error code 111 indicate in the context of CS, GPRS, UMTS, and EPS-related errors?
q_33298.ground_truth: Error code 111 indicates that a PLMN is not allowed for CS, GPRS, UMTS, and EPS.

q_33299.question: Which information element in PathSwitchRequestFailure message is mandatory and indicates the released list of PDU session resource?

q_33300.question: What is the function of the NEF B in the EES A and EAS A interaction described in TS 23.558 7.55.2-2?
q_33300.ground_truth: The NEF B is responsible for authenticating the requested edge entity and UE by checking the UEID and PLMN ID in the message sent by EES A. It may also send UE location information in the notification.

q_33301.question: What is the maximum number of ongoing E1AP procedures related to a certain UE or MBS session at any instance in time?
q_33301.ground_truth: Unless explicitly indicated in the procedure specification, at any instance in time one protocol endpoint shall have a maximum of one ongoing E1AP procedure related to a certain UE or MBS session.

q_33302.question: In what scenarios is the barometric pressure sensor positioning method used?
q_33302.ground_truth: The barometric pressure sensor positioning method is used to estimate the UE's vertical component of the position by measuring atmospheric pressure at the UE and applying a height determination algorithm using the reference atmospheric pressure.

q_33303.question: What should be done with uplink power control in the SS during step 1.2?
q_33303.ground_truth: The SS should continuously send uplink power control "up" commands in every uplink scheduling information to the UE, allowing at least 200ms for the UE to reach PUMAX level.

q_33304.question: What field in the corresponding DCI indicates the allocated subcarrier for NPRACH?
q_33304.ground_truth: The Subcarrier indication field in the corresponding DCI is reserved for preamble format 0/1 and is indicated by "PDCCH order".

q_33305.question: What is used to verify the authenticity of system information in this process?
q_33305.ground_truth: Digital signatures, public security key (K-SIGPublic), Time Counter, and the cell's ID-specific PVT are used to verify the authenticity of the system information.

q_33306.question: What action is taken by the LMF when ciphering key information is successfully stored by the NF service consumer?
q_33306.ground_truth: "200 OK" is returned and the response body indicates which ciphering key information was successfully stored.

q_33307.question: What should the UE do upon receiving a SecurityModeCommand message with a valid integrity protection check?
q_33307.ground_truth: Upon receiving a SecurityModeCommand message with a valid integrity protection check, the UE should derive the KeNB, KRRCint, KRRCenc, and KUPenc keys, apply integrity protection immediately, apply ciphering after completing the procedure, and consider AS security to be activated.

q_33308.question: What is the purpose of the Abort-Session-Request (ASR) command in Gmb interface?
q_33308.ground_truth: The ASR command is used by the BM-SC to request that the session identified by the Session-Id be stopped in the Gmb interface.

q_33309.question: What should the controlling MCData function do if the Accept-Contact header field in a SIP INVITE request does not include the required media feature tags?
q_33309.ground_truth: The controlling MCData function should reject the SIP request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response if the required media feature tags are not present in the Accept-Contact header field.

q_33310.question: What type of data does the type Address field contain in the RADIUS attribute as specified in subclause 16.4.7.2?
q_33310.ground_truth: The type Address is a 32 bit value.

q_33311.question: What is the focus of Part 2 of the NR User Equipment (UE) conformance specification?
q_33311.ground_truth: Part 2 of the NR UE conformance specification covers the measurement procedures for the conformance testing of user equipment that contain RF characteristics for frequency range 2.

q_33312.question: What procedure in the 3GPP specification enables the E-UTRAN to send information about released resources for one or several E-RABs to the MME?

q_33313.question: What is the requirement for the measurement reporting delay as specified in Clause 8.13.2.4.1?
q_33313.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay shall be less than defined in Clause 8.13.2.4.1.

q_33314.question: What should the UE do in case of a severe network failure (EMM cause #42)?
q_33314.ground_truth: The UE should set the EPS update status to EU2 NOT UPDATED, delete any GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI list, eKSI, and list of equivalent PLMNs, and set the attach attempt counter to 5. The UE should then enter the state EMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH and start an implementation-specific timer.

q_33315.question: In clause 5.2.2.3.25, what should the SMF return in a 200 OK response, if it can proceed with resuming the user plane connection of the PDU session?
q_33315.ground_truth: The SMF should return a 200 OK response including the upCnxState attribute set to ACTIVATED, and N2 SM information, i.e. Path Switch Response Transfer including the transport layer address and tunnel endpoint of the uplink termination point for the user data for this PDU session (i.e. UPF's GTP-U F-TEID for uplink traffic), or N2 Notification Response Transfer.

q_33316.question: When should a P-Preferred-Identity header field be included in the SIP MESSAGE request for transferring a private call?
q_33316.ground_truth: The P-Preferred-Identity header field may be included in the SIP MESSAGE request containing a public user identity as specified in 3GPP TS 24.229.

q_33317.question: What action should the UE take if the EPS bearer identity indicated in the deactivate EPS bearer context request is that of the default bearer to a PDN?
q_33317.ground_truth: The UE should delete all EPS bearer contexts associated to the PDN after deactivating the identified EPS bearer context.

q_33318.question: What must the MCPTT client include in the body of the SIP PUBLISH request if confidentiality and integrity protection are both disabled?
q_33318.ground_truth: The MCPTT client must include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body with the <mcptt-access-token> element set to the value of the access token received during the user authentication procedures.

q_33319.question: What is the measurement control information indicated in the measurement test?
q_33319.ground_truth: The measurement control information is indicated to the UE that event-triggered reporting with Event A3 is used for both frequency layers in the measurement test.

q_33320.question: What is a challenge in providing traditional security monitoring and policy enforcement for containers compared to VMs?
q_33320.ground_truth: Network security enforcement decision engines cannot make real-time access permission decisions as easily for containers due to their fast cycle times.

q_33321.question: When selecting the same EAS for the UE collection, what does SMF do if the same EAS has not been determined yet?
