q_33321.ground_truth: SMF will use steps~10~15 to discover an EAS and send the selected EAS IP to UDR. If the same EAS for the UE collection has been determined, SMF sends DNS message handling rule with IP address for the EAS instructing EASDF to return the IP address for the EAS to UE.

q_33322.question: What should the transmission control interface do if multiple MCVideo clients have the permission to send media, Cx (Simultaneous Transmission video) has reached its upper limit and the MCVideo client negotiated support of queueing Transmission requests as specified in clause~14?
q_33322.ground_truth: It should set the priority level to the negotiated maximum priority level and not process the implicit Transmission request.

q_33323.question: What is the role of SON Capacity and Coverage Optimization (CCO) in the context of 5G networks?
q_33323.ground_truth: SON CCO provides optimal coverage and capacity for the E-UTRAN, which may also be applicable for 5G radio networks. It consumes management analytical data related to coverage and capacity to realize the situation of coverage and capacity or interference and to trigger optimization if needed.

q_33324.question: When does the UE suspend the transmission of 5GSM messages except during a request message associated with an MA PDU session?
q_33324.ground_truth: The UE shall suspend the transmission of 5GSM messages when it determines to release the N1 NAS signalling connection upon receiving an SOR transparent container during a registration procedure, as specified in 3GPP TS 23.122 Annex C.2, and after sending the REGISTRATION COMPLETE message until the N1 NAS signalling connection is released. However, this suspension does not apply if the UE has an emergency PDU session.

q_33325.question: What is the criterion for the minimum conformance requirements for the UE in section 8.4.9.5?
q_33325.ground_truth: The UE shall send Event A3 triggered measurement reports for cells 2, 3 and 4, with a measurement reporting delay less than 13.2s (cell 2) and 153.6s (cell 3 and 4) from the beginning of time period T2, with a rate of correct events observed during repeated tests of at least 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

q_33326.question: What should the UE do if it is in state Switched OFF and the attach request for emergency bearer services cannot be accepted by the network with EMM cause set to "IMEI not accepted"?
q_33326.ground_truth: The UE should enter the state EMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-IMSI.

q_33327.question: What should the UE do if it receives a UEInformationRequest message with rlf-ReportReq set to true and has handover failure information available in VarRLF-Report, with plmn-Identity stored in VarRLF-Report equal to the RPLMN?
q_33327.ground_truth: It should set the rlf-Report in the UEInformationResponse message to the value of rlf-Report in VarRLF-Report.

q_33328.question: What does the minimum conformance requirement apply to for the test cases 6.5A.3.2.x and 6.5A.3.3.x?
q_33328.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements apply to all types of NR UE release 15 and forward that support FR2 CA (Carrier Aggregation).

q_33329.question: Which interface is used for the "UE Requested PDN Disconnection with GTP on S2b" procedures?
q_33329.ground_truth: The S2b interface is used for the "UE Requested PDN Disconnection with GTP on S2b" procedures.

q_33330.question: What does the MCPTT server do if the MCPTT user is authorized for manual commencement mode and the call is requested in manual mode?
q_33330.ground_truth: The MCPTT server checks if the MCPTT user is authorized to receive a call in manual commencement mode.

q_33331.question: What is the percentage bandwidth of a typical fixed antenna array for FR1 that covers the frequency range of 1710MHz to 2690MHz?
q_33331.ground_truth: The percentage bandwidth of a typical fixed antenna array for FR1 that covers the frequency range of 1710MHz to 2690MHz is 44.5%.

q_33332.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for this test, as specified in clause 6.4.1.0.1?
q_33332.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 6.4.1.0.1 of TS 38.133.

q_33333.question: When is the TDF session terminated in the TDF session termination procedure?
q_33333.ground_truth: The TDF session is terminated in the following cases: when the corresponding IP-CAN session is terminated, when the IPv4 address of a dual stack IP-CAN session is released and there is an active IPv4 address related TDF session for the IP-CAN session, and at any point of time when the PCRF decides that the session with TDF is to be terminated.

q_33334.question: What is the time required to complete the transmission of PRACH in the target cell (TIU) when intra-frequency handover or inter-frequency handover is commanded and the field sameSFN-Indication and mib-RepetitionStatus are not included in the handover command?
q_33334.ground_truth: Tinterrupt = Tsearch + TMIB + TIU + 20 ms. Here, TMIB and 20 ms are constant, but Tsearch is variable, depending on specific conditions. Therefore, TIU cannot be determined without more information.

q_33335.question: What should the USAT application do when sending an SDU if the UICC/ME interface transport level is not present?
q_33335.ground_truth: When the UICC/ME interface transport level is not present, the USAT application is in charge of the network and transport layer.

q_33336.question: What does the term "modality" indicate in the context of the present document?
q_33336.ground_truth: In the context of the present document, "modality" refers to a mandatory requirement or prohibition to do something.

q_33337.question: What does the OTA transmitter intermodulation requirement measure for a base station?
q_33337.ground_truth: The OTA transmitter intermodulation requirement measures the capability of the transmitter unit to inhibit the generation of signals in its non-linear elements caused by the presence of the wanted signal and an interfering signal reaching the transmitter unit via the RDN and antenna array from a co-located base station.

q_33338.question: What is the state of the MME and UE after performing the Detach procedure?
q_33338.ground_truth: After performing the Detach procedure, the state is changed to EMM-DEREGISTERED in the UE and in the MME.

q_33339.question: What is the procedure to be executed when receiving a request from a UE that is not considered a privileged sender and if the alternative identity of the originator of the request was not identified?
q_33339.ground_truth: If the P-Asserted-Identity header field in the request to be sent contains a SIP URI, add a second P-Asserted-Identity header field that contains the first tel URI of the implicitly registered public user identities. If the P-Asserted-Identity header field in the request to be sent contains a tel URI, add a second P-Asserted-Identity header field that contains the first SIP URI of the implicitly registered public user identities that contains the tel URI.

q_33340.question: What is the requirement for the number of successful tests for the test to pass?
q_33340.ground_truth: The number of successful tests must be more than 90% of the total number of cases with a confidence level of 95%.

q_33341.question: What is the minimum SNR required for the TCI state to be considered known?
q_33341.ground_truth: The SNR of the TCI state must be >= -3dB for the TCI state to be considered known.

q_33342.question: What is the base type for the "priorityhierarchyType" simple type?
q_33342.ground_truth: The base type for the "priorityhierarchyType" simple type is "xs:unsignedShort".

q_33343.question: What information does the UE use for the network name check when operating in SNPN access operation mode?
q_33343.ground_truth: The UE uses the SNPN identity of the selected SNPN.

q_33344.question: What is the role of the "DUIK" parameter in 5G ProSe direct discovery?
q_33344.ground_truth: The "DUIK" parameter is an optional key allocated by the 5G DDNMF and used by the UE to compute the MIC (Message Integrity Code) that is included in the PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for restricted 5G ProSe direct discovery.

q_33345.question: What is the absolute limit of the OTA ACLR for an E-UTRA AAS BS of Medium Range BS class?
q_33345.ground_truth: The absolute limit of the OTA ACLR for an E-UTRA AAS BS of Medium Range BS class is -16 dBm/MHz.

q_33346.question: What should the participating MCPTT function do if resource sharing is supported and there is a binding between the MCPTT ID of the MCPTT user and the MCPTT UE?
q_33346.ground_truth: If resource sharing is supported and there is a binding between the MCPTT ID of the MCPTT user and the MCPTT UE identified by the "+g.3gpp.registration-token" header field parameter in the Feature-Caps header field in the "SIP INVITE request for establishing a pre-established session", the participating MCPTT function shall return a SIP 200 (OK) response.

q_33347.question: What modifications are made in step 4 of TS 23.401 when interworking with 5GS is supported?
q_33347.ground_truth: In step 4 of TS 23.401, IP Session Establishment/Modification procedure is replaced by SM Policy Association Establishment/Modification procedure.

q_33348.question: What conditions must be met for a UE to reselect to a new cell?
q_33348.ground_truth: The new cell must be better ranked than the serving cell, and at least 1 second must have elapsed since the UE camped on the current serving cell.

q_33349.question: What is the purpose of the L3 filter that shall be applied to the in-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331?
q_33349.ground_truth: The L3 filter that is applied to the in-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 smoothes out variations in the in-sync indications, preventing false positives and false negatives.

q_33350.question: What is the measure of Rx dynamic range specified in TR 38.863?
q_33350.ground_truth: The measure of Rx dynamic range specified in TR 38.863 is a measure of the capability of the receiver to receive a wanted signal in the presence of an interfering signal at the TAB connector for SAN type 1-H inside the received SAN channel bandwidth, where a throughput requirement shall be met for a specified reference measurement channel and the interference level is increased by a certain amount of margin to mask the receiver's own noise floor.

q_33351.question: What is the purpose of the NEF determining whether the PDU Session is working in HR-SBO mode when receiving an AF request affecting a UE IP address?
q_33351.ground_truth: If the PDU Session is not working in HR-SBO mode, the NEF contacts the PCF of the PDU Session. If it is working in HR-SBO mode, the NEF stores the AF request in UDR.

q_33352.question: What is the purpose of the RE-NWDAF in 5G roaming architecture?
q_33352.ground_truth: The RE-NWDAF is the NWDAF with roaming exchange capability that serves as the exchange point for analytics and input data for analytics in different PLMNs (i.e. HPLMN and VPLMN).

q_33353.question: How often must the UE measure HRPD Pilot Strength when the RSRP of the E-UTRA serving cell is lower than the HRPD Start Measuring E-UTRAN Rx Power Strength Threshold and HRPD is of lower priority than the currently selected E-UTRAN frequency layer?
q_33353.ground_truth: The UE shall measure CDMA2000 HRPD Pilot Strength of HRPD cells at least every (Number of HRPD Neighbour Frequency)*TmeasureHRPD.

q_33354.question: What parameters does the UE take into consideration when determining the starting OFDM symbol for monitoring EPDCCH in subframe n in transmission mode 10?
q_33354.ground_truth: The UE determines the starting OFDM symbol for monitoring EPDCCH based on the higher layer parameter pdsch-Start-r11 for each EPDCCH-PRB-set.

q_33355.question: What is the minimum bandwidth that should be used for the test specified in 6.3.3.2.1.3-1?
q_33355.ground_truth: The minimum bandwidth that should be used for the test specified in 6.3.3.2.1.3-1 is 20 MHz.

q_33356.question: In the context of the provided example, what is the purpose of the "take-over" element in the "functionalAliasType" complex type?
q_33356.ground_truth: The "take-over" element in the "functionalAliasType" complex type indicates whether it is possible to take over the functional alias.

q_33357.question: What is the main principle behind session release procedures?
q_33357.ground_truth: A high degree of commonality in all situations is the main principle behind session release procedures to avoid complicating the implementation.

q_33358.question: What is the potential security requirement for mitigating privacy risks of 3GPP identities used to transport broadcast DAA traffic?
q_33358.ground_truth: The 3GPP system shall provide a means to mitigate privacy risks of 3GPP identities used to transport broadcast DAA traffic.

q_33359.question: In the context of 3GPP TS 23.003, when the MME may re-establish the radio and S1 bearers for all active EPS bearer contexts?
q_33359.ground_truth: If the "active" flag is set in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message and control plane CIoT EPS optimization is not used by the MME, or if the "active" flag is not set and the MME may re-establish the radio and S1 bearers for all active EPS bearer contexts due to downlink pending data or downlink pending signalling, except for certain cases.

q_33360.question: What is the SL DRX cycle used for in the case of unicast Sidelink communication?
q_33360.ground_truth: The SL DRX cycle is used to determine the start time of the OnDurationTimer for the Sidelink communication between two devices.

q_33361.question: What should the NSCE server include in the response body when successfully creating a Slice Related Communication Service?
q_33361.ground_truth: The NSCE server includes a representation of the created "Individual Slice Related Communication Service" resource within the SliceCommService data structure and sets the HTTP "Location" header field containing the URI of the created resource.

q_33362.question: What is the expected response from the gNB-DU after receiving a PWS Cancel Request message with the Cancel-All Warning Messages Indicator IE present?
q_33362.ground_truth: The gNB-DU shall stop broadcasting and discard all warning messages for the area as indicated in the Cell Broadcast To Be Cancelled List IE or in all the cells of the gNB-DU if the Cell Broadcast To Be Cancelled List IE is not included. The gNB-DU shall acknowledge the PWS CANCEL REQUEST message by sending the PWS CANCEL RESPONSE message.

q_33363.question: What should the PCF do when it does not have the access network charging identifier information for a PDU session?
q_33363.ground_truth: The PCF may request the SMF to provide the Access Network Charging Identifier associated to the new dynamic PCC rules.

q_33364.question: What is the requirement to determine the broadcast reception quality level?
q_33364.ground_truth: The broadcast reception quality level is dependent on the modulation and coding scheme (MCS), reference signals from NG-RAN nodes, RTP packet loss, and BLER of the received data.

q_33365.question: What message is sent by the transmission control interface in the 'U: permitted' state when it receives a Transmission End Request message with the first bit in the subtype set to '1'?
q_33365.ground_truth: A Transmission control Ack message is sent.

q_33366.question: What type of network entity is the 5G DDNMF within the 5G Core Network (5GC) ?
q_33366.ground_truth: The 5G DDNMF is the network entity in the 5G Core Network (5GC) that supports Direct Discovery Services.

q_33367.question: What is the process involved in the termination of Diameter sessions if a trigger is received by a Client to initiate IP-CAN session termination?
q_33367.ground_truth: The Client sends a Diameter Termination Request to the DRA (proxy) using the same Session-Id AVP value of the active Diameter session established between the Client and PCRF-1. The DRA (proxy) verifies the active DRA binding for the IP-CAN session and proxies the Diameter Termination Request to the target PCRF-1. The PCRF-1 acknowledges termination of the session by sending a Diameter Answer to the DRA (proxy), which then proxies the Diameter Answer to the Client.

q_33368.question: What is the overall delays measured requirement for T2 in test 1 in 5.6.1.2.4.2?
q_33368.ground_truth: The overall delays measured from the beginning of time period T2 in test 1 is less than 4322 ms.

q_33369.question: What is the role of the MPQUIC Proxy in IP translation when the UPF detects IP packets for which MPQUIC is applicable?
q_33369.ground_truth: Once traffic for which MPQUIC is applicable is detected by the UPF, the UPF forwards this traffic to the MPQUIC Proxy for IP translation. The MPQUIC Proxy uses the stored information in the MPQUIC session entry to perform IP translation to the detected MPQUIC IP packets, e.g. replace the source IP address+port and/or destination IP address+port accordingly.

q_33370.question: What is the requirement for uplink transmission when all component carriers are off in the ON power period and transient periods?
q_33370.ground_truth: The OFF period is only applicable for each component carrier when all the component carriers are off in the ON power period and transient periods.

q_33371.question: How should the number of carriers be set for NRTC4 power allocation?
q_33371.ground_truth: The number of carriers should be set to the number of carriers at maximum TRP (D.15) for each supported operating band, adhering to declared maximum number of supported carriers per operating band in multi-band operation.

q_33372.question: When must the UE indicate the GUTI in the EPS mobile identity IE and include the Old GUTI type IE with GUTI type set to "native GUTI"?
q_33372.ground_truth: When the TIN indicates "GUTI" or "RAT-related TMSI" and the UE holds a valid GUTI.

q_33373.question: In what state does the UE enter upon receiving an ATTACH REJECT message with any EMM cause value when operating in single-registration mode?
q_33373.ground_truth: The UE enters the state EMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-IMSI.

q_33374.question: Which document specifies the information elements for Sidelink information elements for Demodulation Performance tests?
q_33374.ground_truth: Section 5.4.3 specifies the information elements for Sidelink information elements for Demodulation Performance tests.

q_33375.question: Which node sends the "S-Node Addition Request" message in the dual connectivity procedures?
q_33375.ground_truth: The M-NG-RAN node sends the "S-Node Addition Request" message in the dual connectivity procedures to the S-NG-RAN node.

q_33376.question: What is the action taken by MGCF when the PSTN indicates ringing to the destination user?
q_33376.ground_truth: MGCF sends a provisional response indicating Ringing to the originating party through the S-S procedures.

q_33377.question: What is the potential downside of an aggressive up-switch adaptation policy in the context of 3GPP MTSIMA MO?
q_33377.ground_truth: An aggressive up-switch adaptation policy might not necessarily result in higher quality and can influence the service quality of other terminals sharing the same link. It also runs the risk of degrading the quality or even causing backward transitions (ping-pong effects) before transmission conditions fully recover.

q_33378.question: Which UE feature is needed for a UE to support WUS for TDD in TS 36.211, TS 36.213, and TS 36.304?

q_33379.question: What is the difference between the "IAB-DU channel bandwidth" and "IAB-MT channel bandwidth"?
q_33379.ground_truth: The "IAB-DU channel bandwidth" is the RF bandwidth supporting a single IAB-DU RF carrier, while the "IAB-MT channel bandwidth" is the RF bandwidth supporting a single IAB-MT RF carrier.

q_33380.question: What is the purpose of exposure of management services in 3GPP management system?
q_33380.ground_truth: The exposure of management services supports the case where an external MnS consumer, which is outside the 3GPP management system, can indirectly consume the management capability offered by the MnS producer within the 3GPP management system.

q_33381.question: In the ASN.1 specification, which signals are represented as AccessNetworkProtocolId in AccessNetworkSignalInfo?
q_33381.ground_truth: ts3G-48006, ts3G-25413, and other unspecified values.

q_33382.question: Which layer in the SS GERAN model for GSM performs ciphering in normal mode?
q_33382.ground_truth: Ciphering is enabled and performed in L1 in the SS GERAN model for GSM.

q_33383.question: What should the UE and AMF do with MICO mode after completing PDU Session Establishment procedure for Emergency Services?
q_33383.ground_truth: The UE and AMF should locally disable MICO mode after the PDU Session Establishment procedure for Emergency Services is completed successfully. They should not enable MICO mode until the AMF accepts the use of MICO mode in the next registration procedure.

q_33384.question: What is one potential issue with using GNSS information in the 5G security context?
q_33384.ground_truth: One potential issue is that GNSS information can be spoofed and jammed, which may compromise the accuracy and reliability of the location information.

q_33385.question: What is the role of the DCSF/enhanced MRF in protecting application data channels in the bootstrap data channel case?
q_33385.ground_truth: The DCSF/enhanced MRF is responsible for terminating DTLS protection with the user equipment (UE) in the bootstrap data channel case, as well as in the P2A and P2P with DCMF/enhanced MRF cases of application data channels.

q_33386.question: What must the UE supporting 15 EPS bearers not do if it has already 8 EPS bearers established?
q_33386.ground_truth: The UE shall not initiate a UE requested PDN connectivity procedure if it has already 8 EPS bearers established and the UE has not received an Indication for support of 15 EPS bearers per UE or has received cause #65 "maximum number of EPS bearers reached".

q_33387.question: What is the format of the variable extension in the ExtendedAdditionalPathList structure in the provided protocol?
q_33387.ground_truth: The extension of the AdditionalPathList structure in the provided protocol is a SEQUENCE of ExtendedAdditionalPathList-Item, containing relativeTimeOfPath, pathQuality, multipleULAoA, pathPower, and iE-Extensions.

q_33388.question: During a PDN connection establishment, when should the SGW provide SGW FQ-CSID for the particular PDN connection to the MME or PGW?
q_33388.ground_truth: The SGW should provide one SGW FQ-CSID for that particular PDN connection to the MME or PGW when it supports the partial failure handling feature.

q_33389.question: What is the new state of the MS when the MS is attached, the TMSI is deleted and the update status is set to U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED?
q_33389.ground_truth: The new MM state is MM IDLE.

q_33390.question: What is required before the terminating UE can send a new SDP offer to remove one or more media streams in a session?
q_33390.ground_truth: Both the terminating UE and the originating UE need to support the UPDATE method before the terminating UE can send a new SDP offer to remove one or more media streams in a session.

q_33391.question: What is NG-RAN timing synchronization monitoring support for and what is its procedure?
q_33391.ground_truth: NG-RAN timing synchronization monitoring support is for obtaining change of network timing synchronization status of gNBs. The procedure involves the gNB receiving RAN timing synchronization status informationrequest, sending RAN timing synchronization status information, and accepting or rejecting the request based on its capabilities and thresholds for attributes on timing synchronization status reporting. NG-RAN then reports Timing Synchronization Status to AMF for detailed procedure.

q_33392.question: What is the purpose of the NOTIFICATION ENDPOINT in the UUAA-MM procedure?
q_33392.ground_truth: The purpose of the NOTIFICATION ENDPOINT is to enable the UAS NF/NEF or USS to include this endpoint with updated parameters for re-authentication, authorization data or revocation of UAV.

q_33393.question: What action does the TSCTSF take if the UE location is not within any of the TAs from the time synchronization coverage area?
q_33393.ground_truth: The TSCTSF determines to disable access stratum time distribution for the UE.

q_33394.question: What should the producer of ML training, testing, and AI/ML inference services be capable of in terms of data pre-processing?
q_33394.ground_truth: The producer should be capable of pre-processing the training data, testing data, and inference data of an ML entity to satisfy the desired data trustworthiness measure.

q_33395.question: What functions does an LMF perform to support location services?
q_33395.ground_truth: An LMF can perform various functions to support location services, including determining UE location, providing broadcast assistance data to UEs, reporting UE location estimates to a GMLC, handling periodic or triggered location reporting, determining UE location at a scheduled time, and determining indoor or outdoor for a location estimate.

q_33396.question: What HTTP method is supported by the Individual5GVnGroup resource to retrieve the representations of the resource GroupIdentifiers containing 5GVnGroup related information?

q_33397.question: What should the UE do when transmitting the first PDU in the E-UTRA RRC_CONNECTED state?
q_33397.ground_truth: UE sets the Sequence Number field equal to 0.

q_33398.question: What is the purpose of the SMF Charging Trigger Function (CTF) based solution in the satellite access charging scenario?
q_33398.ground_truth: The SMF (CTF) determines the service data flow accessed by satellite access and collects satellite access charging information for charging the data connectivity via satellite access.

q_33399.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) in relation to MCVideo?
q_33399.ground_truth: The 3GPP is responsible for producing technical specifications for MCVideo signalling control in 3GPP systems.

q_33400.question: When does the SMF include the mapping between EPS bearer ID and QFI in the N2 SM information?
q_33400.ground_truth: The SMF includes the mapping between EPS bearer ID(s) and QFI(s) into the N2 SM information when the PDU Session has been assigned any EPS bearer ID.

q_33401.question: What is the cause of up to 20 ms variability in measured UE receive delay between different calls?
q_33401.ground_truth: This variability is attributed to the UE receiving delay, and specifically to speech frames at the UE antenna.

q_33402.question: What is the role of the Network Slice-specific and SNPN Authentication and Authorization Function (NSSAAF) when deployed in a PLMN?
q_33402.ground_truth: When the NSSAAF is deployed in a PLMN, it supports Network Slice-Specific Authentication and Authorization.

q_33403.question: What does the term "NF Instance" represent in the context of 3GPP Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals?
q_33403.ground_truth: An NF Instance is an identifiable instance of the NF that may provide services offered by one or more NF Service instances.

q_33404.question: What should a UE do when it is in EMM-REGISTERED state and wants to request resources for ProSe direct discovery or Prose direct communication?
q_33404.ground_truth: The UE shall set the "active" flag to 1 in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message if it needs to request resources for ProSe direct discovery or Prose direct communication.

q_33405.question: When is it necessary for the network to include the "GMM cause" information element in a DETACH REQUEST (mobile terminated detach) message?
q_33405.ground_truth: The network must include the "GMM cause" information element in a DETACH REQUEST (mobile terminated detach) message if the detach reason has to be indicated to the MS, such as due to a failed IMEI check.

q_33406.question: What action does the UE take when the UE initiates the attach procedure and is in state EMM-DEREGISTERED?
q_33406.ground_truth: In state EMM-DEREGISTERED, the UE shall initiate the attach procedure by sending an ATTACH REQUEST message to the MME, starting timer T3410 and entering state EMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED.

q_33407.question: What is the typical size of "DRBs-Required-ToBeModified-List" and "DRBs-Required-ToBeReleased-List"?
q_33407.ground_truth: The typical size of "DRBs-Required-ToBeModified-List" and "DRBs-Required-ToBeReleased-List" is 1 to maxnoofDRBs.

q_33408.question: In what situations should the MS release the established PS signalling connection?
q_33408.ground_truth: The MS may release the established PS signalling connection when it needs to perform PLMN selection, or when no attach, routing area updating or service request procedure is ongoing and it receives the "Extended wait time" for PS domain from the lower layers.

q_33409.question: What is the purpose of PDU Set Information in 5GS for UE?
q_33409.ground_truth: The PDU Set Information is used by the NG-RAN for PDU Set based QoS handling, which allows for the identification of PDUs that belong to PDU Sets and the determination of their relative importance within a QoS Flow.

q_33410.question: What should the participating MCData function do if it is unable to process a SIP MESSAGE request due to a lack of resources or a risk of congestion?
q_33410.ground_truth: The participating MCData function may reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response and include a Retry-After header field in the response.

q_33411.question: What are the benefits of this solution in MOCN network sharing scenario?
q_33411.ground_truth: This solution provides backwards compatibility with legacy UEs and legacy NG-RAN. It also details the distribution of the MTK key to handle the protected MBS traffic over the MOCN deployment scenarios.

q_33412.question: What is the limitation on the relative difference between the maximum coefficient in Range 1 and the minimum coefficient in Range 2 for uplink allocations within both Range 1 and Range 2?
q_33412.ground_truth: The relative difference between the maximum coefficient in Range 1 and the minimum coefficient in Range 2 must not be larger than 7.4 dB.

q_33413.question: What is the procedure for restoring a Multicast MBS session affected by an NG-RAN failure with or without restart?
q_33413.ground_truth: The UPF or MB-UPF detects the NG-RAN failure and reports it to the SMF or MB-SMF, which then removes the DL-TEID allocated by the failed NG-RAN and buffers the MBS session data for 5GC Individual MBS traffic delivery. After that, the SMF or MB-SMF initiates the restoration procedure for each Multicast MBS session affected by the NG-RAN failure.

q_33414.question: What event triggers the transmission of a RRCRelease message to release the RRC connection and established radio bearers?
q_33414.ground_truth: The events that trigger the transmission of a RRCRelease message are the expiration of T3, no acknowledgement for the activation MAC-CE in step 5, a fail verdict for the event "Activation", no acknowledgement for the deactivation MAC-CE in step 7, or a fail verdict for the event "Deactivation".

q_33415.question: What is the result of a failed "modifyMOIAttributes" operation if the model state does not fulfill the required constraints?
q_33415.ground_truth: The "modifyMOIAttributes" operation will fail if the model state does not fulfill the required constraints, such as cardinality, multiplicity, allowed values, or data types, after applying the modification request.

q_33416.question: What should the S-CSCF do if the received request contains a tel-URI "npdi" parameter?
q_33416.ground_truth: The S-CSCF may update the URI with the obtained NP data.

q_33417.question: What is the purpose of the "Member status" in the context of FA Pilot identity and FA Member identity?
q_33417.ground_truth: The "Member status" indicates whether the FA Pilot identity also holds a FA Member identity.

q_33418.question: What is the minimum period for measuring the mean power of the UE in step 3 of the test procedure in 6.2.2.4.2?
q_33418.ground_truth: The minimum period for measuring the mean power of the UE in step 3 of the test procedure in 6.2.2.4.2 is 1ms over consecutive active uplink slots.

q_33419.question: What is the purpose of this test case?
q_33419.ground_truth: The purpose of this test case is to verify that the UE makes correct reporting of an event under operation with frame structure 3, specifically for new intra-frequency FS3 cells in non-DRX requirements.

q_33420.question: What is the requirement for the test to pass in the FDD RSRP absolute accuracy test?
q_33420.ground_truth: The ratio of successful reported values in each test must be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

q_33421.question: What should the MCData client include in the "uri" attribute of the <entry> element of the <list> element in the application/resource-lists+xml MIME body of the SIP INVITE request?
q_33421.ground_truth: The MCData client should include the URI of the invited MCData user in the "uri" attribute of the <entry> element of the <list> element in the application/resource-lists+xml MIME body of the SIP INVITE request.

q_33422.question: What does an EPS bearer context activated with request type "emergency" or "handover of emergency bearer services" indicate?
q_33422.ground_truth: This indicates an emergency EPS bearer context.

q_33423.question: What is the time duration that the SS waits for random access requests information from the UE to perform cell re-selection to an already detected cell, Ncell 1, in 4G LTE?

q_33424.question: What information does the W-AGF use to build the SUCI for the FN-RG during the initial registration process?
q_33424.ground_truth: The W-AGF uses the GLI (in the case of a BBF access) or the GCI (in the case of a Cable access) and an identifier of the Home network to build the SUCI.

q_33425.question: How many times more users can be supported by CFL compared to FL in terms of uplink payload as per the given data rate?
q_33425.ground_truth: Up to 13 times more users can be simultaneously supported, as CFL can transmit up to 13 times more model information through model compression in comparison with FL for the same uplink payload.

q_33426.question: What is the format of the LocationReportingControlIEs S1AP-PROTOCOL-IES?
q_33426.ground_truth: It is a sequence of one or more ProtocolIEs, each with a mandatory identifier, CRITICALITY, type, and presence specification.

q_33427.question: What is the benefit of IP Traffic offload in a 5G system?
q_33427.ground_truth: IP Traffic offload improves the quality of experience for users by automatically offloading specific IP traffic to an external IP network when QoS requirements are not met, ensuring a good user experience for tasks such as online gaming.

q_33428.question: Under what condition will the target UE ignore a new PROSE PATH SWITCHING REQUEST message during the path switching procedure?
q_33428.ground_truth: If the target UE is processing the path switching procedure from the direct communication path over PC5 to the direct communication path over Uu and the implementation-specific timer is not running.

q_33429.question: What is the effect of Compressed Federated Learning (CFL) on the computational complexity in UEs?
q_33429.ground_truth: For a UE prospective, CFL can reduce uplink and downlink throughput requirements for the federated learning process and also, the computational complexity in UEs can be significantly reduced because of enabling a compressed model.

q_33430.question: What action does the SGSN perform after deciding to deactivate a PDN connection?
q_33430.ground_truth: The SGSN performs the SGSN-initiated PDN Connection Deactivation procedure after the tracking area procedure is completed.

q_33431.question: What is the test applicability in 6.3A.4.1.2 for the test case of power control absolute tolerance for UE category M1?
q_33431.ground_truth: The test case applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 17 and forward of UE category M1 that support satellite access operation.

q_33432.question: What two functions does the "Additional information IE" provide for LCS signaling messages?
q_33432.ground_truth: The Additional information IE in UL/DL NAS TRANSPORT message or CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message provides a mechanism for routing information and correlation ID in the immediate or deferred sense, for LCS messages.

q_33433.question: Which command is used to identify the network capabilities of a device after a requested Purging UE  command?

q_33434.question: What is the purpose of measuring the UE's send clock accuracy in this procedure?
q_33434.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure synchronization between the client and the user equipment. This measurement does not need to be repeated and can be obtained from the setup procedure.

q_33435.question: When fine-tuning for clutter parameter B, if the full training accuracy (using F1-score) for clutter parameter B is E0,B, what is the range of LOS/NLOS indicator accuracy (using F1-score) when the fine-tuning dataset size is x% = 10.0% of the full training dataset size?
q_33435.ground_truth: The LOS/NLOS indicator accuracy (using F1-score) is in the range of (0.56~0.974) x E0,B.

q_33436.question: What is the aim of the joint workshop with Khronos and MPEG on "Streamed Media in Immersive Scene Descriptions"?
q_33436.ground_truth: The aim of the joint workshop with Khronos and MPEG on "Streamed Media in Immersive Scene Descriptions" is to identify common and complementary aspects on defining networked media, and to find areas where collaboration would be beneficial.

q_33437.question: What is the API name and version that should be used for the resource URI structure when communicating with the MSGin5G Server?
q_33437.ground_truth: The API name should be "msgs-msgdelivery" and the version should be "v1".

q_33438.question: What command is sent by the AMF to the (R)AN to initiate the AN Release Procedure in 5GS?
q_33438.ground_truth: The AMF sends an N2 UE Context Release Command to the (R)AN to initiate the AN Release Procedure in 5GS.

q_33439.question: What mechanism is used to replicate data for different multicast groups with different QoS policies?
q_33439.ground_truth: The UE application replicates multiple copies of the data for different multicast groups with different QoS treatments based on the Ethernet PDU Session.

q_33440.question: What is a PDN connection established between the UE and the Service Capability Exposure Function (SCEF) for transmitting the UE's non-IP data related to a specific application?

q_33441.question: What is the default authentication method used by EEC and EES in solution #10?
q_33441.ground_truth: TLS with certificates is adopted as the default authentication for EEC and EES.

q_33442.question: Upon receiving a SIP PUBLISH request for MCData server settings, what should the MCData server do if the procedures in clause 7.3.1A are not successful?
q_33442.ground_truth: If the procedures in clause 7.3.1A are not successful, the MCData server shall send a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response toward the MCData client with the warning text set to "140 unable to decrypt XML content" in a Warning header field, as specified in clause 4.9, and shall not continue with the rest of the steps if the procedures are not successful.

q_33443.question: Which element can appear an unbounded number of times in Group-info complex type with the processContents set to "lax"?

q_33444.question: What is the definition of the relative accuracy of RSRP inter-frequency measurement in 3GPP TS 36.133?
q_33444.ground_truth: The relative accuracy of RSRP inter-frequency measurement is defined as the RSRP measured from one cell compared to the RSRP measured from another cell on a different frequency.

q_33445.question: In what mode(s) does the MME store the mapped EPS NAS security context with associated NAS COUNT counters during an inter-system change from N1 mode to S1 mode?
q_33445.ground_truth: The MME stores the mapped EPS NAS security context with associated NAS COUNT counters during an inter-system change from N1 mode to S1 mode in both 5GMM-CONNECTED mode and EMM-IDLE mode for a UE operating in single-registration mode in a network supporting N26 interface.

q_33446.question: What should the UE do if T3410 expires and the attach attempt counter is less than five?
q_33446.ground_truth: The UE restarts the attach procedure for EPS services only.

q_33447.question: In which case is a CS fallback request indicated to the UE during a handover from E-UTRAN to UTRAN/GERAN in Network Mode of Operation I?
q_33447.ground_truth: If the PS handover fails and the UE fails to establish a connection to the target RAT, the UE considers that CS fallback has failed.

q_33448.question: What is tested in the test case described in section 10.5.3.3.4?
q_33448.ground_truth: Absolute accuracy of SS-SINR intra-frequency measurements is tested in the test case described in section 10.5.3.3.4.

q_33449.question: What is the maximum repetition period of relevant system info blocks that needs to be received by the UE to camp on a cell, in 4G LTE?

q_33450.question: What is the name of the header field used by the S-CSCF to inform an alternative P-CSCF about the failure in a 408 (Request Timeout) response for INVITE requests or a 504 (Server Time-out) response for non-INVITE requests?

q_33451.question: What is the function of a Dataset in the binary option of MMTEL services?
q_33451.ground_truth: A Dataset is a binary description of the service data of a subset of MMTEL services. It contains parameters associated with MMTEL services, such as AOC, FA pilot, and FA member datasets, and defines the rules for extendibility, backward compatibility, and compactness.

q_33452.question: What action does the UE take when T3417 is stopped upon receipt of the SERVICE REJECT message containing an EMM cause value in 9.3.1.12a.1?
q_33452.ground_truth: The UE stops T3417 upon receipt of the SERVICE REJECT message containing an EMM cause value in 9.3.1.12a.1.

q_33453.question: What is the maximum number of HARQ transmissions for a MAC PDU stored in the Msg3 buffer?
q_33453.ground_truth: The maximum number of transmissions for a MAC PDU stored in the Msg3 buffer is maxHARQ-Msg3Tx.

q_33454.question: How are the most significant bits padded with value 0 when the bit width of the Second Precoding information field for the case with transform precoder enabled is not equal to that for the case with transform precoder disabled?
q_33454.ground_truth: A number of most significant bits with value set to '0' are inserted to the Second Precoding information field for the case with smaller bit width until the bit width of the Second Precoding information field for the two cases are the same.

q_33455.question: What message type should an MME include when it sends a Modify Access Bearers Request message to an SGW as part of certain procedures, given that all specified conditions are met?
q_33455.ground_truth: The Modify Access Bearers Request message should include all bearer contexts of all the PDN connections of the UE.

q_33456.question: What is the maximum number of bytes that can be indicated by the length value of a primitive tag?
q_33456.ground_truth: The maximum number of bytes that can be indicated by the length value of a primitive tag is 11.

q_33457.question: What is the purpose of the B-TID in the GBA procedures?
q_33457.ground_truth: The B-TID is used by the UE to supply to the NAF to allow the NAF to retrieve the corresponding keys from the BSF. It uniquely identifies a key in the BSF.

q_33458.question: What is the purpose of the End Marker message(s) in GTP-U tunnels in 3GPP EPS?
q_33458.ground_truth: The End Marker message(s) indicate the end of data transmission on a GTP-U tunnel and are sent after the last G-PDU has been transmitted or after receiving an End Marker Indication.

q_33459.question: How many sublayers does the layer 3 of the 3GPP TS contain, and what are they?
q_33459.ground_truth: The layer 3 of the 3GPP TS is composed of three sublayers for non-GPRS services (Radio Resource Management, Mobility Management, and Connection Management) and four sublayers for GPRS services (Radio Resource Management, Mobility Management, Logical Link Control, and Connection Management). The Connection Management sublayer of the GPRS services is further composed of functional blocks for various call control, short message service support, session management, and location services support functions.

q_33460.question: Which XML schema defines the XML schemas for application/vnd.3gpp.seal-info+xml, application/vnd.3gpp.seal-unicast-info+xml and application/vnd.3gpp.seal-mbms-usage-info+xml?
q_33460.ground_truth: The XML schema that defines the XML schemas for application/vnd.3gpp.seal-info+xml, application/vnd.3gpp.seal-unicast-info+xml and application/vnd.3gpp.seal-mbms-usage-info+xml is 7.4.

q_33461.question: What should the UE do if it cannot accept the security mode command in the 5G system?
q_33461.ground_truth: The UE should send a SECURITY MODE REJECT message with an EMM cause value of #23 (UE security capabilities mismatch) or #24 (security mode rejected, unspecified).

q_33462.question: What should the MCPTT client do if an MCPTT user requests to release an MCPTT ambient listening call and the g.3gpp.mcptt.ambient-listening-call-release feature-capability indicator is not received?
q_33462.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should interact with the media plane, generate a SIP BYE request, and send it within the dialog of the MCPTT ambient call session to release the ambient listening call.

q_33463.question: What provides the number of dictionary entry deletions at the NEF, including the number of failed ones?
q_33463.ground_truth: Number of failed UCMF dictionary entry deletions

q_33464.question: What is the effect of unsynchronization between the UE and network while in the ECM-IDLE state?
q_33464.ground_truth: When the UE and the network are unsynchronized, the UE and network have different sets of established EPS bearers, indicating a lack of consistent connectivity.

q_33465.question: What happens if the Reservation-Priority AVP is not specified for IP flow?
q_33465.ground_truth: If the Reservation-Priority AVP is not specified for IP flow, the requested priority is DEFAULT (0).

q_33466.question: What is the purpose of the g.3gpp.pne-id media feature-tag?
q_33466.ground_truth: The g.3gpp.pne-id media feature-tag is used in a SIP request or a SIP response to indicate the identifier of a PNE (Personal Network Entry) other than a UE (User Equipment).

q_33467.question: What should the P-CSCF do when rewriting the address and port number of its own Record Route entry in a 1xx or 2xx response?
q_33467.ground_truth: The P-CSCF should rewrite the address and port number of its own Record Route entry to the same value as the response to the initial request for the dialog.

q_33468.question: What should the UE do if it receives a 504 (Server Time-out) response containing a P-Asserted-Identity header field and Content-Type header field set in a registration flow?
q_33468.ground_truth: If the 504 (Server Time-out) response includes an IM CN subsystem XML body indicating restoration and initial registration, the UE should initiate S-CSCF restoration procedures and may provide an indication to the user based on the reason for the alternative service.

q_33469.question: What is the effect of the SServingCell value on the UE's measurements and cell reselection behavior in the E-UTRA system?
q_33469.ground_truth: If the SServingCell value of the E-UTRA serving cell is greater than Snonintrasearch, then the UE may not search for or measure inter-RAT layers of equal or lower priority. If the SServingCell value is less than or equal to Snonintrasearch, then the UE shall search for and measure inter-RAT layers of higher, equal, or lower priority in preparation for possible reselection.

q_33470.question: What should the MCPTT client do when it is in the "T0: waiting for the call to establish" state and receives an indication from the MCPTT user to release or reject the call?
q_33470.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should release the stored current call type, release the stored ProSe per-packet priority, release the Last call type change time, release the Last user to change call type, and remain in the "T0: waiting for the call to establish" state.

q_33471.question: When can a BH RLF detection indication be transmitted from an IAB-DU?
q_33471.ground_truth: A BH RLF detection indication can be transmitted from an IAB-DU when the collocated IAB-MT initiates RRC re-establishment, when the collocated IAB-MT is dual-connected and detects BH RLF on a BH link and cannot perform UL re-routing for any traffic, or when the collocated IAB-MT has received a BH RLF detection indication from a parent node and there is no remaining backhaul link affected.

q_33472.question: What interfaces does the SWd interface support HSS initiated detach procedures for trusted non-3GPP access?

q_33473.question: What should be the frequency ranges of the downlink and uplink protection requirements for the protection of DCS1800, UTRA Band III, E-UTRA Band 3 or NR Band n3 in China?
q_33473.ground_truth: The frequency ranges of the downlink and uplink protection requirements for the protection of DCS1800, UTRA Band III, E-UTRA Band 3 or NR Band n3 in China are 1805 - 1850 MHz and 1710 - 1755 MHz respectively.

q_33474.question: What steps does the UE perform if T309 is running, and the selected cell is only connected to EPC?
q_33474.ground_truth: The UE stops timer T309 for all access categories and performs the actions as specified in 5.3.16.4.

q_33475.question: In what way can the rate of user data sent to and from a UE using CIoT EPS Optimization be controlled?
q_33475.ground_truth: The rate of user data sent to and from a UE using CIoT EPS Optimization can be controlled in two different ways: Serving PLMN Rate Control and APN Rate Control. Serving PLMN Rate Control is used to protect the MME and the Signalling Radio Bearers in the E-UTRAN from the load generated by NAS Data PDUs, while APN Rate Control is used by HPLMN operators to offer customer services such as a maximum of Y messages per day.

q_33476.question: What is the role of the Access and Mobility Management function (AMF) in the context of 5G networks?
q_33476.ground_truth: The Access and Mobility Management function (AMF) performs functions such as registration management, connection management, reachability management, mobility management, forwarding of UE Policy towards the served UE, reporting of the UE state to the (V-)PCF, forwarding of the UE policy enforcement result received from the UE to the (V-)PCF, forwarding of the N2 PC5 policy for V2X communications and/or A2X communications and/or 5G ProSe and/or Ranging/SL towards the NG-RAN, and reporting the UE policy enforcement result towards the (V-)PCF.

q_33477.question: What type of information is specified in the present document?
q_33477.ground_truth: The present document specifies the coding, multiplexing and mapping to physical channels for 5G NR.

q_33478.question: What interfaces are impacted by the provision of PDU Set related parameters to the NG-RAN in DL and UL?
q_33478.ground_truth: N6 and NG-UP (between SMF and NG-RAN)

q_33479.question: What should be the value of TreselectionRAT in the specified criteria if the UE is in the medium or high mobility state?
q_33479.ground_truth: The value of TreselectionRAT is scaled when the UE is in the medium or high mobility state.

q_33480.question: What attribute is used to specify the maximum number of times an element from another namespace can appear in the "WLANAssistance-info" complex type?
q_33480.ground_truth: The "processContents" attribute is used to specify how to process content from another namespace and can be set to "lax" to allow any content but only validate if it's valid. The "maxOccurs" attribute is used to specify the maximum number of times an element can appear, in this case, it is set to "unbounded" meaning it can appear an indefinite number of times.

q_33481.question: What is the purpose of the "affiliating" state in the context of an MCPTT user's affiliation to an MCPTT group?
q_33481.ground_truth: The "affiliating" state indicates that the MCPTT user is interested in the MCPTT group, but has not yet been granted access to the group.

q_33482.question: What is the requirement for UE when inter-RAT NR measurements are indicated to be measured in this specification?
q_33482.ground_truth: The UE shall measure SS-RSRP and SS-RSRQ of detected NR cells in the neighbor frequency list at the minimum measurement rate specified in this clause.

q_33483.question: What is the purpose of the Suspend procedure specified in TS~23.060 in the context of the handover process?
q_33483.ground_truth: The Suspend procedure specified in TS~23.060 triggers the Target SGSN to send a Suspend Notification message to the Source MME when the UE tunes to GERAN.

q_33484.question: Which message is sent by a UE to another peer UE to indicate that the link identifier update request is accepted?
q_33484.ground_truth: PROSE DIRECT LINK IDENTIFIER UPDATE ACCEPT

q_33485.question: What should the UE do if the selected WLAN is an untrusted WLAN, and the UE supports access to EPC via untrusted WLAN?
q_33485.ground_truth: The UE shall handover all the offloadable PDN connections from 3GPP access to the WLAN access using procedures in subclause 7.2.1 and subclause 7.2.2.

q_33486.question: How does the AMF obtain the 5G-GUTI of the IAB-node when a UE accesses the network via a mobile IAB-node?
q_33486.ground_truth: The AMF obtains the 5G-GUTI of the IAB-node from the NGAP Initial UE message provided by the NG-RAN when a UE accesses the network via a mobile IAB-node.

q_33487.question: What is the initial condition for the Procedure step 7.5.4.2.2?
q_33487.ground_truth: The initial condition for Procedure step 7.5.4.2.2 is the Normal test environment, and the RF channels or Base Station RF Bandwidth positions to be tested depend on the number of carriers and the type of TAB connector involved.

q_33488.question: What performance measurements for SMF, UPF, and NEF are meaningful to be provided by 3GPP management system for a 5G VN group communication?
q_33488.ground_truth: Performance measurement for SMF: Number of successful PDU session creations, for UPF: Number of incoming GTP data packets on the N3 interface, from (R)AN to UPF, for NEF: Number of application trigger requests accepted for delivery.

q_33489.question: Which mode of operation builds on the existing functionality described in clause 9.2.2 and is limited to the SNPN(s) identified within the mobility restrictions received in the UE context in inactive mode?
q_33489.ground_truth: A UE in inactive mode operates in the SNPN(s) identified within the mobility restrictions received in the UE context.

q_33490.question: What is the maximum transmission timing error for sidelink transmissions in V2V Sidelink Communication?
q_33490.ground_truth: The transmission timing error for sidelink transmissions in V2V Sidelink Communication shall be less than or equal to Te where the timing error limit value Te is specified as 12*Ts and Ts is the basic timing unit defined in TS 36.211.

q_33491.question: What UE capability is used to determine the BWP switching delay on a single CC (TBWPswitchDelay)?

q_33492.question: What is the role of the 5G system in enabling self-healing in the Smart Energy?
q_33492.ground_truth: The 5G system is expected to provide communication services with ultra-low latency, ultra-high reliability and availability, and high data rate at both uplink and downlink to enable fast and precise detection of grid disturbances in the Smart Energy.

q_33493.question: What is the role of DRA (proxy) in the Diameter protocol when the PA2 option is implemented and a Client needs to send subsequent Diameter messages directly to the target PCRF?
q_33493.ground_truth: DRA (proxy) provides the Origin-Host AVP value to the Client, which is the identity of the target PCRF. The Client then populates the Destination-Host AVP with this address and sends any subsequent Diameter messages directly to this PCRF bypassing the DRA.

q_33494.question: What is the impact of the UE not finding a match using the URSP rules associated with the VPLMN ID?
q_33494.ground_truth: If the UE does not find a match using the URSP rules associated with the VPLMN ID, it uses the URSP rules associated with the HPLMN.

q_33495.question: In what circumstances shall the 3GPP AAA Server send the trust relationship to the PDN GW as specified in clause~9.1.2.5?
q_33495.ground_truth: If the 3GPP AAA Server detects that an S6b session already exists for this UE and the S6b session was established as a result of an authentication request for DSMIPv6, the 3GPP AAA Server shall send the trust relationship to the PDN GW as specified in clause~9.1.2.5.

q_33496.question: What value should be set for the <ReportType> element in the <Report> element when including location information in a SIP request for an MCPTT emergency alert?

q_33497.question: What should be the value of the "service type" IE in the SERVICE REQUEST message for case a) in subclause 5.6.1.1, if the paging request includes an indication for non-3GPP access type and the UE has PDU session(s) associated with non-3GPP access for which the associated S-NSSAI(s) are included in the allowed NSSAI for 3GPP access?
q_33497.ground_truth: The "service type" IE should be set to "mobile terminated services".

q_33498.question: What is the role of SMF in the procedure described in section 6.22.3.1 of the solution #22?
q_33498.ground_truth: The SMF is responsible for notifying the consumer NF regarding UPF ID of the Target UPF when the SMF/UPF for serving the PDU Session changes.

q_33499.question: What is the supported channel bandwidth for IAB-MT in FR2-1?
q_33499.ground_truth: The IAB-MT supports a single NR RF carrier in the uplink or downlink in FR2-1, and different IAB-MT channel bandwidths may be supported within the same spectrum.

q_33500.question: What protocol is recommended for establishing secure connections between NDS/IP entities on the Zb interface?
q_33500.ground_truth: The procedure for establishing secure connections using NDS/IP on the Zb interface is specified in detail in clause 5.2.2.

q_33501.question: What is the measurement method for inland emissions in a component carrier with PRB allocation?
q_33501.ground_truth: The measurement method for inland emissions in a component carrier with PRB allocation is specified in Annex E.4.3.

q_33502.question: What is the role of the NG-RAN in the MBS session creation process without PCC?
q_33502.ground_truth: The NG-RAN is responsible for allocating radio resources for the established broadcast MBS sessions, regardless of the number of N3mb tunnels established to deliver the MBS packets in the MBS session creation process without PCC.

q_33503.question: What is a UPF in the context of 5G System architecture?
q_33503.ground_truth: A UPF (User Plane Function) in the context of 5G System architecture is a network function responsible for processing and forwarding user data packets. It can support Inter PLMN UP Security (IPUPS) functionality to protect the network from invalid inter PLMN N9 traffic in home routed roaming scenarios.

q_33504.question: In what circumstances should the MME return an SGsAP-UE-UNREACHABLE message to the VLR, indicating "UE unreachable"?
q_33504.ground_truth: The MME shall return an SGsAP-UE-UNREACHABLE message to the VLR indicating "UE unreachable", if the UE is marked as unreachable and the Paging Proceed Flag is set to false, and the ISR is not activated.

q_33505.question: When the participating MCPTT function receives a request from the MCPTT client to originate an MCPTT emergency group call, what should it check to determine if the request is an authorized request for an MCPTT emergency group call?
q_33505.ground_truth: It should check the allow-emergency-group-call element of the ruleset element of the MCPTT user profile document and if the entry-info attribute of the MCPTTGroupInitiation element contains the identity of the MCPTT group targeted by the calling MCPTT user.

q_33506.question: What does the Broadcast NID List IE contain?
q_33506.ground_truth: The Broadcast NID List IE contains a list of NIDs.

q_33507.question: What parameter determines the time duration for each test iteration?
q_33507.ground_truth: The time duration for each test iteration is determined by the parameters T1, T2, and T3.

q_33508.question: What two possible PUSCH frequency hopping types can a UE performing PUSCH frequency hopping use based on the hopping information?
q_33508.ground_truth: The two possible PUSCH frequency hopping types are hopping type 1, described in section 8.4.1, and hopping type 2, described in section 8.4.2.

q_33509.question: What must the MCVideo client do when it receives a PRIVATE CALL SETUP REQUEST message with Commencement mode set to "MANUAL COMMENCEMENT MODE" and the call type set to "PRIVATE VIDEO PUSH CALL"?
q_33509.ground_truth: The MCVideo client must set the stored current call type to "PRIVATE VIDEO PUSH CALL" and perform the procedures of clause 10.3.2.4.4.

q_33510.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for the LTE anchor agnostic approach?
q_33510.ground_truth: The LTE anchor agnostic approach means that the NR or E-UTRA does not have any specific requirements for the LTE anchor.

q_33511.question: What is the name of the new network function in the home network and hosting network that specifically handles information related to localized services?

q_33512.question: What is the expected behavior of the UE during time duration T4?
q_33512.ground_truth: During T4, the UE is not expected to decode the UL grant and conduct any UL transmission, since the UE is expected to declare RLF during T3.

q_33513.question: What should the UE not conduct during T4 in this test scenario?
q_33513.ground_truth: The UE should not conduct any NPUSCH transmission during T4 in this test scenario.

q_33514.question: How does the Media Service Application request content from the Media Service Provider?
q_33514.ground_truth: The Media Service Application requests content from the Media Service Provider by using the URL for the media service, typically through Android app links or the APIs defined by the Media Service Application.

q_33515.question: What is the use of the 3GPP Vendor-Specific attribute in the Accounting-Request START messages?
q_33515.ground_truth: The 3GPP Vendor-Specific attribute is present for a 5G-BRG accessing the 5GC via wireline access network and is used to provide details such as the HFC Node Identifier, Global Line Identifier, type of the wireline, Network ID, and the S-NSSAI in the Accounting-Request START messages.

q_33516.question: What are the expected conditions for the central MTLF to apply federated learning?
q_33516.ground_truth: Federated learning is applied when data required for training an ML model cannot be collected directly from an NF, or when federated learning is required for a DNAI or a specific service area.

q_33517.question: What component carrier requirements apply for E-UTRA UL transmission in inter-band V2X concurrent operation?
q_33517.ground_truth: The output dynamic requirements specified in clause 6.3 of TS 36.101 apply for E-UTRA UL transmission.

q_33518.question: What is the Timing Advance Command value set during time duration T1?
q_33518.ground_truth: The Timing Advance Command value set during time duration T1 is 31, which results in zero adjustment of the Timing Advance.

q_33519.question: What should the UE do when the counter for "the entry for the current SNPN considered invalid for 3GPP access" events reaches its maximum value?
q_33519.ground_truth: The UE should delete the list of equivalent SNPNs, if any, and enter the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE. Additionally, it should delete 5G-GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI list, and ngKSI for 3GPP access.

q_33520.question: What information may be lost at Xn handover or UE context retrieval due to old NG-RAN nodes?
q_33520.ground_truth: Information provided by the 5GC within the NGAP Mobility Restriction List may be lost at Xn handover or UE context retrieval due to old NG-RAN nodes not being able to recognize the entire content.

q_33521.question: In an on-network group call of an MCVideo group which is not a constituent MCVideo group of a temporary MCVideo group, what protects the transmission control messages sent over the MBMS subchannel from the participating MCVideo function to the served MCVideo clients if a MuSiK and a MuSiK-ID are not associated with the on-network group call?
q_33521.ground_truth: The MKFC and the MKFC-ID of the MCVideo group protect the transmission control messages sent over the MBMS subchannel from the participating MCVideo function to the served MCVideo clients if a MuSiK and a MuSiK-ID are not associated with the on-network group call.

q_33522.question: What is the purpose of the "Service Indication" associated with emergency request in the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay?
q_33522.ground_truth: The "Service Indication" associated with emergency request is used to indicated an emergency service request from the Remote UE. This allows the network to differentiate whether the emergency service is required by the UE or the Relay UE.

q_33523.question: What message should a participating MCPTT function send to the MCPTT client upon receiving a failed call setup indication from the controlling MCPTT function?
q_33523.ground_truth: A Disconnect message should be sent to the MCPTT client.

q_33524.question: What action can the AF apply in response to a Group-MBR monitoring report?
q_33524.ground_truth: The AF may apply traffic mediation action such as requesting 5G Core to apply traffic gating on specific QoS flow, or may decide not to take any action other than using it for its own statistics or charging.

q_33525.question: When should the P-CSCF remove the Geolocation header field's loc-src parameter?
q_33525.ground_truth: The P-CSCF shall remove the loc-src parameter from the Geolocation header field if the P-CSCF receives a Geolocation header field with a loc-src parameter from the UE.

q_33526.question: In what situations must a UE include the "User security key ID" IE when establishing a 5G ProSe direct link?
q_33526.ground_truth: The UE must include the "User security key ID" IE when the 5G ProSe direct link establishment procedure is for direct communication between the 5G ProSe remote UE and the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE or for direct communication between the 5G ProSe end UE and the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE, and the security procedure over user plane or control plane for 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay or UE-to-UE relay is used.

q_33527.question: What action should a non-controlling MCVideo function take if an Accept-Contact header field does not include the g.3gpp.mcvideo media feature tag in a SIP INVITE request for non-controlling MCVideo function of an MCVideo group?
q_33527.ground_truth: The non-controlling MCVideo function should reject the SIP INVITE request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response and not process the remaining steps.

q_33528.question: What is the test purpose in sections 7.3A.3.3.1 and 7.3A.3.3.4?
q_33528.ground_truth: The test purpose is to verify the UE's conformance to specific 3GPP protocols.

q_33529.question: What does the LCS-QoS-Class AVP in 3GPP TS 29.002 indicate?
q_33529.ground_truth: The LCS-QoS-Class AVP indicates the Quality of Service Class for the LCS service, with two possible values: ASSURED (0) and BEST EFFORT (1).

q_33530.question: What is the measurement object for in-band emissions in the 6.4F.2.3 section of the procedure?
q_33530.ground_truth: The in-band emissions are measured as the ratio of the UE output power in a non-allocated RB to the UE output power in an allocated RB.

q_33531.question: What is the test requirement for the in-sync test in 7.3.2?
q_33531.ground_truth: The test requirement for the in-sync test in 7.3.2 is that the UE must transmit uplink signals during specified time durations, with the uplink signal being a power level of at least -39 dBm.

q_33532.question: What is the NF Service Consumer required to do when invoking the EnableUEReachability service operation?
q_33532.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer is required to send a PUT request to the resource representing the ueReachInd resource of the AMF, with the content of the PUT request containing an "EnableUeReachabilityReqData" object.

q_33533.question: What should the MCVideo client include in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body when canceling an in-progress emergency condition and an MCVideo emergency alert originated by the MCVideo user?
q_33533.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body populated as specified in clause~6.2.8.1.3.

q_33534.question: What type of analytics information can the NWDAF provide to a consumer NF regarding UE proximity?
q_33534.ground_truth: The NWDAF can provide relative proximity analytics, which includes statistics or predictions about the relative proximity of UEs.

q_33535.question: What is the entering condition for an event in the context of TS 36.331, clause 5.5.4.3?
q_33535.ground_truth: The entering condition for an event, as specified in TS 36.331, clause 5.5.4.3, is considered satisfied when condition A2-1 is fulfilled.

q_33536.question: What procedure can be used by an LMF to support network assisted and network based positioning in a network-based setup?
q_33536.ground_truth: The procedure in 6.11.2 of the document, which may be based on an NRPPa protocol in TS~38.455, can be used by an LMF to support network assisted and network based positioning in a network-based setup.

q_33537.question: What should the controlling MCPTT function send as a response if it cannot process a request to remove a regroup due to lack of resources or risk of congestion?
q_33537.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function should send a SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response with a Retry-After header field.

q_33538.question: What should the UE provide in step 1 of clause 4.11.2.4.1 if it operates in single-registration mode and is moving from EPC?
q_33538.ground_truth: The UE should provide a Registration type set to "mobility registration update", a mapped 5G-GUTI from the 4G-GUTI, and a native 5G-GUTI if available.

q_33539.question: When is a NR carrier cell not considered in cell reselection?
q_33539.ground_truth: A NR carrier cell is not considered for cell reselection if it is indicated as not allowed in the measurement control system information of the serving cell.

q_33540.question: What information must be provided to the AS layer for PC5 data transmission?
q_33540.ground_truth: The PC5 Link Identifier, PFI, PC5 unicast link-related information including Layer-2 ID information (i.e. source and destination Layer-2 IDs), and ProSe data must be provided to the AS layer for PC5 data transmission.

q_33541.question: What is the minimum measurement filtering requirements that the UE must still meet before it makes any determination that it may stop measuring the cell if the UE detects on a E-UTRA carrier a cell whose physical identity is indicated as not allowed for that carrier in the measurement control system information of the serving cell?
q_33541.ground_truth: The minimum measurement filtering requirements that the UE must still meet before it makes any determination that it may stop measuring the cell if the UE detects on a E-UTRA carrier a cell whose physical identity is indicated as not allowed for that carrier in the measurement control system information of the serving cell are specified later in this section.

q_33542.question: What is the total time for the main radio transition from ultra-deep sleep to the active or micro sleep state?
q_33542.ground_truth: The total time for the main radio transition from ultra-deep sleep to the active or micro sleep state is the sum of ramp-up time and time for sync/re-sync.

q_33543.question: What information is included in the Event Time Stamps fields of the CDR?
q_33543.ground_truth: The Event Time Stamps fields in the CDR contain the event time stamps relevant for each of the individual record types, including a minimum of date, hour, minute, and second.

q_33544.question: How long can the possible interruption period be for SCell activation/hibernation?
q_33544.ground_truth: The possible interruption period for SCell activation/hibernation is 1 subframe, which occurs in the range of subframe m+5 to m+9.

q_33545.question: What should a receiving node do when it receives a message with a Procedure Code IE marked with "Ignore IE and Notify Sender" that it does not comprehend?
q_33545.ground_truth: The receiving node should ignore the procedure and initiate the Error Indication procedure.

q_33546.question: What should a participating MCData function do upon receipt of a SIP MESSAGE request for emergency notification from a terminating MCData client and there is a lack of resources or a risk of congestion?
q_33546.ground_truth: The participating MCData function may reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response, and can include a Retry-After header field in the response.

q_33547.question: What message is sent by a UE to another peer UE when a 5G ProSe direct link re-keying procedure is initiated?

q_33548.question: What is the impact of the extended idle mode DRX on mobile terminated data and specifically on SMS?
q_33548.ground_truth: The extended idle mode DRX may impact the delay tolerance of mobile terminated data, SMS, and device triggers. A network side application must be aware that extended idle mode DRX may be in place and ensure that any mobile terminated CS services or SMS are able to handle the extended idle mode DRX.

q_33549.question: What message is sent by the UE to pass the DIRECT LINK REKEYING RESPONSE message to the lower layers for transmission?

q_33550.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 6.7.4.1.1.4?
q_33550.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the SSB based L1-RSRP absolute measurement accuracy is within the specified limits for all bands.

q_33551.question: How is the transaction identifier coded in case of Data Connection Status Change event?
q_33551.ground_truth: The transaction identifier is coded as an identifier generated by the terminal to uniquely identify the PDP or PDN or PDU data connection, regardless of the bearer of the connection, and the TI flag is always 0 in this data connection transaction identifier.

q_33552.question: What is the difference between the two described test procedures (clause 6.3.6 and 6.3.7) in terms of the initial conditions?
q_33552.ground_truth: The main difference is that in clause 6.3.7, a single E-UTRA TDD serving cell and one UTRA TDD cell are specified, while in clause 6.3.6, two cells (Cell 1 and Cell 2) are specified, with Cell 1 being the active cell for both clauses. The propagation conditions, message contents, and power level settings are also set differently between the two test procedures.

q_33553.question: What is a MnS producer described by?
q_33553.ground_truth: A MnS producer is described by a set of meta data called MnS producer profile.

q_33554.question: What is the procedure for forwarding URSP rule enforcement information in the 5G Core network?
q_33554.ground_truth: The procedure for forwarding URSP rule enforcement information in the 5G Core network involves the UE sending reporting of URSP rule enforcement to the SMF, which then forwards the information to the PCF serving the PDU session. The PCF then forwards this information to the PCF serving the UE.

q_33555.question: What should the UP function do when it receives a PFCP Association Release Request?
q_33555.ground_truth: The UP function always accepts a PFCP Association Release Request.

q_33556.question: What message format should be included in the HTTP POST request when updating group information in the VAE server?

q_33557.question: What is the requirement for CRS based measurements of cells on the primary component carrier in E-UTRA carrier aggregation?
q_33557.ground_truth: CRS based measurements of cells on the primary component carrier shall meet all applicable requirements (FDD or TDD) in clause~8.6.2.1.

q_33558.question: What is the effect of the Transmission Granted message on the Media Transmission Notification message?
q_33558.ground_truth: The Transmission Granted message causes the transmission control server interface to send a Media Transmission Notification message to all participant interfaces except for the transmission participant interface to which the Transmission Granted message was sent.

q_33559.question: What should a controlling MCVideo function do if the terminating participating MCVideo function is in an interconnected MCVideo system in a different trust domain?
q_33559.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function should set the Request-URI to the public service identity of the terminating participating MCVideo function associated to the MCVideo user, and route the SIP request through an MCVideo gateway server that acts as an exit point from the local MCVideo system to the interconnected MCVideo system.

q_33560.question: What radio parameters are provisioned in the UE in support of the UE assuming the role of a 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay when the UE is not "served by NG-RAN"?
q_33560.ground_truth: The radio parameters include NR PC5 with Geographical Area(s) and an indication of whether they are "operator managed" or "non-operator managed". The UE uses the radio parameters to perform 5G ProSe Direct Discovery over PC5 reference point when "not served by NG-RAN" only if the UE can reliably locate itself in the corresponding Geographical Area.

q_33561.question: Which errors are listed in all the operations of the MAP-ShortMessageServiceOperations system?

q_33562.question: What event triggers the generation of the "deregistration xIRI" by the IRI-POI in the RCS Server or IMS signalling function?
q_33562.ground_truth: The "deregistration xIRI" is generated by the IRI-POI in an RCS Server or IMS Signalling Function when it detects that a target UE has been deregistered from RCS services.

q_33563.question: What is the purpose of the "Number of successful handover executions per beam pair" measurement?
q_33563.ground_truth: The purpose of the measurement is to provide the number of successful handover executions received by the source gNB per beam pair, i.e. beam in the source and beam in the target cell.

q_33564.question: When is a cell considered as a "detected cell" by the UE?
q_33564.ground_truth: A cell is considered as a "detected cell" by the UE when it is not included in the measurement object(s) but is detected on the carrier frequency(ies) indicated by the measurement object(s).

q_33565.question: What is the handover delay requirement for the E-UTRAN FDD-FDD intra frequency handover test case?
q_33565.ground_truth: The handover delay shall be less than a total of 50 ms, which includes 15 ms for maximum RRC procedure delay and 35 ms for Tinterrupt.
