q_34548.ground_truth: The MCPTT user should be displayed with the MCPTT ID contained in the '<originated-by>' element of the MCPTT user that originated the MCPTT emergency alert.

q_34549.question: How many bits is the TPC command for PUCCH in format 2?
q_34549.ground_truth: The TPC command for PUCCH in format 2 is 2 bits.

q_34550.question: What is the confidence level used for the measurement uncertainty tolerance interval in the OTA Test System?
q_34550.ground_truth: The confidence level used for the measurement uncertainty tolerance interval in the OTA Test System is 95%.

q_34551.question: What is required when IP address allocation is static and the TWAN receives a static IP address from HSS/AAA during access authentication and authorization procedure?
q_34551.ground_truth: The TWAN should forward the static IP address to the PDN GW during the tunnel establishment request (in PBU or in Create Session Request message).

q_34552.question: In Solution 3, when does gNB inform the AMF whether it supports NCR?
q_34552.ground_truth: During NG-C setup procedure, the AMF is informed by the gNB whether it supports NCR, via the "NCR-supported" indicator in NG SETUP RESPONSE message.

q_34553.question: What is the role of the SEAL group management server in the SEAL based application architecture for enabling PINAPP?
q_34553.ground_truth: The SEAL group management server is responsible for accomplishing PIN management by interacting with the SEAL group management client in the PEGC and PEMC.

q_34554.question: What is the minimum required transmission power level for the UE in the test?
q_34554.ground_truth: The UE is required to transmit at the PUMAX level during the test.

q_34555.question: When should the SMF include the EAS rediscovery indication in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message with impacted EAS IPv4 address range, impacted EAS IPv6 address range or impacted EAS FQDN?
q_34555.ground_truth: The SMF should include the EAS rediscovery indication in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message with impacted EAS IPv4 address range, impacted EAS IPv6 address range or impacted EAS FQDN if the SMF needs to trigger EAS rediscovery, the UE has indicated support for EAS rediscovery in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message or the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message, and the UE supports EAS rediscovery indication(s) with impacted EAS IPv4 address range, EAS rediscovery indication(s) with impacted EAS IPv6 address range, EAS rediscovery indication(s) with impacted EAS FQDN, or any combination of the above.

q_34556.question: What is the impact of the new functionality on the UDR for non-TSC cases?
q_34556.ground_truth: For non-TSC cases, the UDR needs to be able to store additional parameters provided by the NEF and retrieve QoS information from UDR, taking into account the validity conditions related to the QoS information in policy decisions.

q_34557.question: What message is sent from the SMF to the DN-AAA to initiate authentication and authorization in the specified scenario?
q_34557.ground_truth: The SMF sends a Diameter DER message to the DN-AAA server for authentication and authorization.

q_34558.question: What is the discovery feature for an Application Server connected to a PIN?
q_34558.ground_truth: The feature includes application server discovery by PIN Elements or by a UE outside of a PIN via the 3GPP network.

q_34559.question: In the context of 5.3B, regarding roaming support for wireline access, what is the recommended action for the 5G-RG, the W-AGF acting on behalf of the FN-RG, and the W-AGF acting on behalf of the N5GC device?
q_34559.ground_truth: The recommended action is for the 5G-RG, the W-AGF acting on behalf of the FN-RG, and the W-AGF acting on behalf of the N5GC device to consider the HPLMN available on each wireline access network and select the HPLMN for the wireline access network.

q_34560.question: What should the value of Bit 3 in the Packet Replication Information field be if the UPF should continue the packet detection process for the packet?
q_34560.ground_truth: Bit 3 in the Packet Replication Information field should be set to "1" to indicate that the UP function should continue the packet detection process for the packet.

q_34561.question: What action will the UE take if it has pending uplink user data for PDU session(s) with user-plane resources already established?
q_34561.ground_truth: The UE will initiate the service request procedure for N1 NAS signalling connection recovery.

q_34562.question: What is the role of the ER Authenticator in the ERP bootstrapping process?
q_34562.ground_truth: The ER Authenticator resides in the EAP Authenticator and is responsible for sending EAP Request/Identity to the UE and forwarding messages towards the home EAP server during the ERP bootstrapping process.

q_34563.question: Which parameter is used to change the default priority level of the user in the 3GPP network?

q_34564.question: In which conditions should a UE initiate transmission of the ProximityIndication message?
q_34564.ground_truth: A UE should initiate transmission of the ProximityIndication message if it enters the proximity of one or more CSG member cell(s) on an E-UTRA frequency while proximity indication is enabled for such E-UTRA cells, on a UTRA frequency while proximity indication is enabled for such UTRA cells, leaves the proximity of all CSG member cell(s) on an E-UTRA frequency while proximity indication is enabled for such E-UTRA cells, or on a UTRA frequency while proximity indication is enabled for such UTRA cells and if it has not transmitted a ProximityIndication for the RAT and frequency during the current RRC connection or if more than 5 seconds has elapsed since the UE has last transmitted a ProximityIndication (either entering or leaving) for the RAT and frequency.

q_34565.question: What should the Controlling MCPTT function do if it receives a SIP INVITE request with an imminent peril indication while the in-progress imminent peril state of the group is set to "true"?
q_34565.ground_truth: The Controlling MCPTT function should generate SIP RE-INVITE requests for the MCPTT imminent peril group call to the other affiliated and joined participants of the chat MCPTT group.

q_34566.question: What should a SC UE do in order to add Gm control for the newly established CS session after PS to CS SRVCC if it uses ICS capabilities?
q_34566.ground_truth: The SC UE should send a SIP re-INVITE request for each session with speech media component to be transferred, starting with the session with active speech media component that was made active most recently, and indicate the media line for the speech media component as an speech media component over circuit switched bearer in the SDP offer.

q_34567.question: What should the UE do after stopping timer T3430 and entering state MM IDLE after receiving a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message with the EMM cause set to 'Illegal UE'?
q_34567.ground_truth: The UE shall set the EPS update status to EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, delete any GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI List and eKSI, consider the USIM as invalid for EPS and non-EPS services, delete the list of equivalent PLMNs, and enter the state EMM-DEREGISTERED. If A/Gb mode or Iu mode is supported by the UE, the UE shall handle the MM and GMM parameters as specified in 3GPP TS 24.008 for the case when the combined routing area updating procedure is rejected with the GMM cause with the same value.

q_34568.question: What additional information is required when specifying an elliptical arc area location criterion?
q_34568.ground_truth: In addition to specifying the center point of the elliptical arc, the radius, offset angle, included angle, speed, and minimum and maximum speed must also be specified.

q_34569.question: What message is sent if timer T8 (Floor Revoke) expires and the MCPTT client is not permitted to send a Media Burst?
q_34569.ground_truth: The Floor Revoke message is sent in this situation, with the Rejection Cause field set to #3 (No permission to send a Media Burst).

q_34570.question: What action should the controlling MCPTT function take when the imminent peril state of the group is set to "true" in a re-INVITE request for MCPTT emergency group call?
q_34570.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function should include in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body an <imminentperil-ind> element set to a value of "true" in the outgoing SIP re-INVITE request.

q_34571.question: In the case of session continuity upon UL CL relocation, what is the role of the AF in detecting no active traffic over the N9 forwarding tunnel?
q_34571.ground_truth: The AF can send an explicit notification to the SMF when traffic to/from this UE ceases to exist, leading the SMF to release the Source UL CL and the Source UPF (PSA2).

q_34572.question: What is the name of the tel URI parameter that indicates the verification status of a number in a tel URI or a SIP URI with the user=phone parameter?

q_34573.question: What are the main differences between the single network exposure access model and the distributed network exposure access model in a single PLMN operator domain?
q_34573.ground_truth: In the single network exposure access model, network interfaces are available to the IoT-PCS servers providing SEAL services via the SEAL-S reference point to IoT Application (IoT-App) servers as VAL servers. While in the distributed network exposure access model, network interfaces are available to both the IoT-PCS servers and IoT-App servers, allowing them to implement SEAL services. The IoT-PCS servers provide additional SEAL services to IoT-App VAL servers via the SEAL-S reference point, and the IoT-PCS and IoT-App SEAL servers may interact using an instance of the SEAL-X reference point.

q_34574.question: What are the assumed frequency unit granularities for 15kHz SCS with 10MHz and 20MHz bandwidths?
q_34574.ground_truth: For 15kHz SCS, the assumed frequency unit granularity is 4 RBs for 10MHz bandwidth and 8 RBs for 20MHz bandwidth.

q_34575.question: What is the role of the Local AMF/Any AMF in the enhanced positioning architecture for NPN deployment?
q_34575.ground_truth: The Local AMF/Any AMF in NPN deployment is used to transfer the Non-UE Associated Network Assistance Data between the RAN and LMF for the UE Associated Network Positioning procedure. It sends the UE Associated Network Positing message towards the RAN via the serving AMF and receives the response from the RAN via the serving AMF.

q_34576.question: Which field in the "MIABF1SetupTriggeringIEs" F1AP-PROTOCOL-IES has a CRITICALITY value of " reject" and allows for the inclusion of the "GlobalGNB-ID" type?

q_34577.question: What does the term MSR operation represent in the context of a device's capabilities?
q_34577.ground_truth: MSR operation represents a device's ability to operate as a MSR (multi-standard radio) in one or more particular operating bands, including UTRA, E-UTRA, and/or NR operation as Standalone (SR) or multi-RAT based on 37.104.

q_34578.question: What is the multiple access scheme used in the NR physical layer for transmitting data in both paired and unpaired spectrum?
q_34578.ground_truth: The multiple access scheme used in the NR physical layer for transmitting data in both paired and unpaired spectrum is Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) with a cyclic prefix (CP) and Discrete Fourier Transform-spread-OFDM (DFT-s-OFDM) with a CP.

q_34579.question: What are Source and Destination Layer-2 IDs used for in the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay Discovery messages?
q_34579.ground_truth: Source Layer-2 ID and Destination Layer-2 ID are used for sending and receiving the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay Discovery messages.

q_34580.question: What should the UE do if it receives a 401 (Unauthorized) response to the REGISTER request and the Security-Server header field contains media plane security mechanisms?
q_34580.ground_truth: The UE shall store the announcement of media plane security mechanisms and initiate that mechanism on a media level when it initiates new media in an existing session.

q_34581.question: What should the UE re-establish after resetting MAC and re-establishing PDCP for all RBs following the reception of the RRC message triggering the handover?
q_34581.ground_truth: The UE shall re-establish RLC for all RBs that are established and apply the new UE Identity as the C-RNTI.

q_34582.question: What is the purpose of the KMS KeyProv Response in the key management system?
q_34582.ground_truth: The KMS KeyProv Response is used to provide new key material to the user and may also contain a new transport key (TrK) and/or integrity key (InK).

q_34583.question: What is the basis for selecting the MME in the 'IMSI and APN Information retrieval' procedure?
q_34583.ground_truth: The MME is selected based on the TAI of the congested cell or eNodeB in the user plane.

q_34584.question: What are the mandatory metadata fields for object based audio input in the combined format OBA + MASA and OBA + SBA?
q_34584.ground_truth: The mandatory metadata fields for object based audio input are Azimuth and Elevation, which specify the position of the audio object in 3D space.

q_34585.question: In the context of inter-PLMN mobility from 5GC to EPC, what procedure does the UE perform depending on whether it has EPS Bearer ID and mapped EPS QoS parameters or not?
q_34585.ground_truth: The UE performs the Tracking Area Update procedure if it has at least one PDU Session for which Session Continuity is supported during interworking, that is, it has EPS Bearer ID and mapped EPS QoS parameters. The UE performs an initial attach procedure if it doesn't have any PDU Session in 5GC or the UE is registered only with PDU Session for which Session Continuity is not supported during interworking to EPS and either the UE or the EPC doesn't support attach without PDN connectivity.

q_34586.question: In the inter-band PCell case, how many non-consecutive DTX subframes are allowed for a given subframe range?
q_34586.ground_truth: In the inter-band PCell case, up to 2 non-consecutive DTX subframes are allowed to be observed by the SS anywhere during the subframes (m+5) to (m+13), (m+15) to (m+23), (m+25) to (m+33), and (m+35) to (m+43) up to the end of T2.

q_34587.question: Who initiates the NAS security mode control procedure in the cellular network?
q_34587.ground_truth: The MME (Mobility Management Entity) initiates the NAS security mode control procedure in the cellular network.

q_34588.question: What does the SMF/CUC do when it sends the Get Request message to the AN-TL/CN-TL with Interface IDs and/or Interface Capabilities in the 5G System?
q_34588.ground_truth: When SMF/CUC sends the Get Request message to the AN-TL/CN-TL containing Interface IDs and/or Interface Capabilities, the AN-TL/CN-TL shall report their network interfaces and capabilities in the Get Response message.

q_34589.question: What is the required BER for UTRA FDD and UTRA TDD 1,28 Mcps option to meet the iterion requirement?
q_34589.ground_truth: The BER should not exceed 0.001 for both UTRA FDD and UTRA TDD 1,28 Mcps option.

q_34590.question: What shall the System Simulator transmit after receiving 3 preambles in Test 3?
q_34590.ground_truth: The System Simulator shall transmit a Random Access Response containing a Random Access Preamble identifier that matches the transmitted Random Access Preamble after 3 preambles have been received by the System Simulator.

q_34591.question: Which type of sequence is ProtocolIEs in UEContextSetupResponse?

q_34592.question: How does the NSCE server interact with the OAM system to trigger the network slice lifecycle operations?
q_34592.ground_truth: The NSCE server interacts with the OAM system to trigger network slice allocation/modification/deallocation by utilizing the network slice-related management services exposed by EGMF defined in SA5.

q_34593.question: How does Solution #3 propose to measure the accuracy of the ML model in NWDAF containing AnLF?
q_34593.ground_truth: Solution #3 proposes the calculation of ML model validation (Accuracy in Training) in NWDAF containing MTLF and then measuring the ML model accuracy (Accuracy in Use) in NWDAF containing AnLF. The measured accuracy is then reported back to NWDAF containing MTLF for further action.

q_34594.question: What is the maximum allowed measurement reporting delay for UE category 0 in the intra-frequency event triggered reporting test?
q_34594.ground_truth: The maximum allowed measurement reporting delay for UE category 0 in the intra-frequency event triggered reporting test is 1000 ms.

q_34595.question: What is the requirement for LTM cell switch delay for inter-frequency switch?
q_34595.ground_truth: LTM cell switch delay is the delay from the end of the last TTI containing the MAC-CE command for cell switch until the time the UE transmits the first UL message on the target cell. This value is measured in milliseconds.

q_34596.question: What should the UE do if it supports idle/inactive measurements and there are more frequencies to measure or report than it can handle?
q_34596.ground_truth: The UE can prioritize which frequencies to measure or report based on its own implementation.

q_34597.question: What does UE need to indicate in the Registration procedure to receive localized services?
q_34597.ground_truth: The UE indicates that the UE is accessing the network for localized services during the Registration procedure.

q_34598.question: What is the requirement for in-band emissions in intra-band non-contiguous carrier aggregation?
q_34598.ground_truth: The requirements for in-band emissions are defined for each component carrier in intra-band non-contiguous carrier aggregation.

q_34599.question: What entity is responsible for creating and storing a new registration when an NF service consumer registers the use and monitoring capability of the analytics accuracy of an ML Model in the NWDAF?

q_34600.question: What should the value of the <mcptt-request-uri> element be in the initial SIP MESSAGE request from an MCPTT client?
q_34600.ground_truth: The <mcptt-request-uri> element should be set to the MCPTT group identity.

q_34601.question: What is the role of the Immersive Renderer in the 3GPP MPEG-H Audio Operation Point?
q_34601.ground_truth: The Immersive Renderer is optional in the 3GPP MPEG-H Audio Operation Point.

q_34602.question: What are the two separate PC5 links that are necessary for the full security of a UE-to-UE PC5 link in the 5G ProSe network?
q_34602.ground_truth: The two separate PC5 links are the link between the Source UE and UE-to-UE Relay and the link between UE-to-UE Relay and Target UE.

q_34603.question: What is the maximum length of the pseudo-random noise (pn) part of the CSS used in the test measurements?
q_34603.ground_truth: It is recommended to use a pn sequence of 32 k samples with a 48 kHz sampling rate.

q_34604.question: What is the function of a Unicast Link Profile in PC5 unicast link establishment?
q_34604.ground_truth: A Unicast Link Profile includes the Application Layer IDs and Layer-2 IDs of both UEs, the network layer protocol used on the PC5 unicast link, and information about PC5 QoS Flow(s). It helps identify the PC5 unicast link and can be updated during secure layer-2 link establishment or modification.

q_34605.question: What is the procedure for an immersive AR conversational with two parties using EDGAR UEs including an EDGAR-DCMTSI client in the context of the IMS-AGW/MRF with a support of immersive media processing?
q_34605.ground_truth: The procedure involves establishing a call between the two EDGAR UEs, negotiating the required resources, establishing additional data channels for AR application, and processing the AR immersive media for transmitting and rendering.

q_34606.question: What information does NWDAF provide to AF, via NEF, for each time window in steps 7-8 of the analytics process?
q_34606.ground_truth: NWDAF provides predictions about candidate members' expected latency performance, geographical distribution of member UEs, and QoS flow level data for each time window.

q_34607.question: What is required by the 5G System to protect SL positioning signaling in groupcast?
q_34607.ground_truth: The 5G System is required to provide confidentiality, integrity, and replay protection of SL positioning signaling in groupcast.

q_34608.question: What is the function of the CES (Cloud-based Edge Support) in the ACR between CAS (Cloud Application Server) and EAS (Edge Application Server)?
q_34608.ground_truth: The CES supports ACR feature parity between CAS and EAS utilizing all EDGEAPP developed features such as AS discovery, AS registration.

q_34609.question: What is a potential security requirement to address the issue of trust domains in 3GPP network functions?
q_34609.ground_truth: Solutions should be implemented to manage (e.g. define, enforce) the security policies for each trust domain independently.

q_34610.question: What information does the AF provide in the AFsessionWithQoS request?
q_34610.ground_truth: The AF provides a group of flow descriptions, QoS references, and UE addresses, as well as the multi-modal service provider ID and multi-modal data flows group ID in the AFrequest message.

q_34611.question: What is the purpose of the mbms-Priority field in the MBMSInterestIndication message?
q_34611.ground_truth: The mbms-Priority field in the MBMSInterestIndication message is used to indicate the UE's priority for receiving MBMS frequencies above reception of any unicast bearers.

q_34612.question: What action does the ECS take if the service consumer is not authorized to retrieve the target Enabler Server information in the provided scenario?
q_34612.ground_truth: The ECS will take proper error handling actions, as specified in clause 9.2.6, and respond to the service consumer with an appropriate error status code.

q_34613.question: What must the F1-terminating IAB-donor consider when receiving an IAB TRANSPORT MIGRATION MODIFICATION REQUEST message with the All Traffic Indication IE set to "true" in the Traffic to Be Released Information IE?
q_34613.ground_truth: The F1-terminating IAB-donor must consider that all offloaded traffic will be released by the non-F1-terminating IAB-donor when receiving an IAB TRANSPORT MIGRATION MODIFICATION REQUEST message with the All Traffic Indication IE set to "true" in the Traffic to Be Released Information IE.

q_34614.question: Which component is responsible for the provisioning of data collection and reporting features in the 5G Media Streaming architecture?
q_34614.ground_truth: M1, or provisioning of data collection and reporting features in the Data Collection AF, is responsible for this.

q_34615.question: What action does the MME take when it receives a request for CS paging from an MSC/VLR for an IMSI unknown by the MME?
q_34615.ground_truth: If the "MME-Reset" indicator is set to "true", the MME sends the paging request with the location information provided by the VLR. If the indicator is set to "false" and the IMSI is unknown or the UE is marked as EMM-DEREGISTERED, the paging request is rejected.

q_34616.question: What is the purpose of the Narrowband Physical Uplink Shared Channel (NPUSCH) in NB-IoT?
q_34616.ground_truth: The NPUSCH in NB-IoT carries the UL-SCH and Hybrid ARQ ACK/NAKs in response to downlink transmission, as well as SR for the NB-IoT UE.

q_34617.question: What does the pre-established broadcast MBS session enable the MC service user to do?
q_34617.ground_truth: The pre-established broadcast MBS session enables the MC service user to transfer downlink data.

q_34618.question: What is the purpose of the Maximum Time Offset in the overload control procedure?
q_34618.ground_truth: The Maximum Time Offset is used to avoid a large number of UEs causing excessive signalling load on the network when leaving or re-gaining coverage.

q_34619.question: What should the UE do when it receives a TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message containing a new TAI list in a combined tracking area updating procedure?
q_34619.ground_truth: When the UE receives a TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message containing a new TAI list in a combined tracking area updating procedure, it shall consider the new TAI list as valid and stop timer T3430, reset the routing area updating attempt counter, and set the EPS update status to EU1 UPDATED.

q_34620.question: What is the procedure to initiate an IPv4 address Delete Procedure in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_34620.ground_truth: The PDN GW initiates the Gateway Control Session Modification Procedure with the PCRF, with the PDN GW providing information to enable the PCRF to uniquely identify the IP CAN session.

q_34621.question: What is the significance of the version number in the document reference, e.g., x.y.z?
q_34621.ground_truth: The version number indicates the stage of the document's review and approval process. The first digit signifies if the document has been presented to the TSG for information, approval, or if it is TSG-approved and under change control. The second digit is incremented for changes of substance, and the third digit is incremented for editorial-only changes.

q_34622.question: What is the difference between automatic release and retention of PDU sessions based on timing information?
q_34622.ground_truth: Automatic release of PDU sessions occurs when the respective network slices have an end of life timing information, while retention and restoration occur when the network slices have periodic timing information.

q_34623.question: What should the NF service consumer do to indicate that the related media of the modified Individual Application Session Context resource has specific latency and/or loss demands?
q_34623.ground_truth: The NF service consumer should include the "desMaxLatency" attribute and/or "desMaxLoss" attribute within a media component of the "medComponents" attribute in the HTTP PATCH request message.

q_34624.question: What does the TSCTSF do after successful authorization to create a time synchronization service for a UE in an Area of Interest?
q_34624.ground_truth: The TSCTSF creates a PTP port in a DS-TT and assigns it into the PTP instance and adds the DS-TT PTP port to the PTP instance again if the UE moves into an Area of Interest.

q_34625.question: How does a UE determine the referenceSignal value in PUCCH-PathlossReferenceRS when only one set of power control parameters is provided?
q_34625.ground_truth: The UE obtains the referenceSignal value in PUCCH-PathlossReferenceRS from the pucch-PathlossReferenceRS-Id with index 0.

q_34626.question: What condition must be met in order for a UE to decrease the coverage area when two or more interfering signals exist which have a specific frequency relationship to the wanted signal?
q_34626.ground_truth: The UE must be unable to meet the throughput requirement under ideal propagation conditions.

q_34627.question: What should the Early IRAT HO IE be set to in the Inter-System Handover Report IE if the source NR associated cells exceed the threshold until the UE is handed over back to NR within the measurement duration?
q_34627.ground_truth: If the source NR associated cells exceed the threshold until the UE is handed over back to NR within the measurement duration, the Early IRAT HO IE should be set to "true".

q_34628.question: What happens when the number of information bits in format 6-0A mapped onto a given search space is less than the payload size of format 0 mapped onto the same search space?
q_34628.ground_truth: Zeros are appended to format 6-0A until the payload size equals that of format 0 including any padding bits appended to format 0. If format 6-0A is scrambled by PUR-RNTI and Resource block assignment is set to all ones, additional fields are present, otherwise, additional fields are set to zero.

q_34629.question: What is the role of the SX3LIF or LMISF in Lawful Interception in EPC?
q_34629.ground_truth: The SX3LIF or LMISF in Lawful Interception in EPC is responsible for identifying intercepted traffic by the F-TEID in the header of the encapsulating GTP-U packet and forwarding it for further processing.

q_34630.question: What is the purpose of sending the IWF emergency alert cancel request with an indication to cancel the in-progress emergency state on the group?
q_34630.ground_truth: The purpose of sending the IWF emergency alert cancel request with an indication to cancel the in-progress emergency state on the group is to request the cancellation of the ongoing emergency condition.

q_34631.question: In what scenarios does the MME initiate the location update for non-EPS services procedure when receiving an attach request or a combined tracking area update request from the UE?
q_34631.ground_truth: The MME initiates the location update for non-EPS services procedure when it receives an attach request indicating combined EPS/IMSI attach, a combined tracking area update request indicating Combined TA/LA updating with IMSI attach, a combined tracking area update request and the MME detects that the LAI has changed, a combined tracking area update request and the state of the SGs association is SGs-NULL, or a combined tracking area request and the MME serving the UE has changed.

q_34632.question: What should the UE do if it receives an ETWS warning over the paging message, and it has not authenticated the core network of the NodeB it is camped on?
q_34632.ground_truth: If the UE receives an ETWS warning over the paging message, but it has not authenticated the core network of the NodeB it is camped on, the UE should not receive the paging message or perform the reception of the broadcast message described below.

q_34633.question: What elements are required in a `<session-oriented-service-trigger-info>` element?
q_34633.ground_truth: A `<session-oriented-service-trigger-info>` element must include `<V2X-UE-id>`, `<V2X-service-id>`, `<V2X-application-specific-server-id-info>`, `<session-id>`, `<V2X-application-QoS-requirements>`, and `<acknowledgement>` elements.

q_34634.question: What is the test applicability for this test case?
q_34634.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of NR UE release 15 onwards.

q_34635.question: What is the main difference between Solution #6 "MPQUIC-LL Steering Functionality" and Solution #6.2.1 "Support non-3GPP access leg of MA-PDU Session with PDN connection in EPC" in TR~23.700-93?
q_34635.ground_truth: The main difference is that Solution #6 uses MP-QUIC, while Solution #6.2.1 uses non-3GPP access leg of a PDN connection in EPC.

q_34636.question: What are the cleartext IEs in a REGISTRATION REQUEST message?
q_34636.ground_truth: The cleartext IEs in a REGISTRATION REQUEST message are Extended protocol discriminator, Security header type, Spare half octet, Registration request message identity, 5GS registration type, ngKSI, 5GS mobile identity, UE security capability, Additional GUTI, UE status, EPS NAS message container, NID, and PLMN with disaster condition.

q_34637.question: What provides the SMF with the DL Tunnel Info of the new UL CL/Branching Point for the downlink traffic?
q_34637.ground_truth: The DL Tunnel Info of the new UL CL/Branching Point is provided to the SMF from the PSA0.

q_34638.question: What is the method to gather CQI reports in 6.2A.3.1.3.3.2.6?
q_34638.ground_truth: The SS shall start gathering CQI reports for both PCC and SCCs and will continue until 2000 wideband CQI reports have been gathered for each.

q_34639.question: How long does TTI insertion uncertainty last?
q_34639.ground_truth: TTI insertion uncertainty lasts for 2 ms.

q_34640.question: What is used by the NG-RAN node during handover to determine the target cell based on the list of CAG IDs supported by neighbor CAG cells?
q_34640.ground_truth: The source NG-RAN node determines a target cell among the candidates which is compatible with the received PNI-NPN restrictions.

q_34641.question: Who is responsible for providing the security materials for the UE-to-UE PC5 link in the 5G ProSe network?
q_34641.ground_truth: The security materials for the UE-to-UE PC5 link in the 5G ProSe network are provided by the network after passing the authorization check.

q_34642.question: What is the purpose of the Random Access procedure in 3GPP 5G technology?
q_34642.ground_truth: The random access procedure is used in 3GPP 5G technology to establish uplink time synchronization, convey a UE's request for Other SI, or recover from beam failure.

q_34643.question: What is the role of the KDF in the solution described in clause 6.32.2?
q_34643.ground_truth: The KDF is used to generate verification information by taking the IP address and the SUPI as inputs in the solution described in clause 6.32.2.

q_34644.question: What system entity is capable of determining the dynamical satellite backhaul in use and sending the satellite backhaul indication to the SMF?
q_34644.ground_truth: The AMF (Access and Mobility Management Function) has this capability.

q_34645.question: What is the maximum overall delay for a UE supporting power class 1 in the test, and when does the UE need to report the event within that delay?
q_34645.ground_truth: The maximum overall delay for a UE supporting power class 1 is 51202 ms. The UE needs to report the event within that delay from the beginning of time period T2.

q_34646.question: What is a U2N Relay UE in the context of the 5G System?
q_34646.ground_truth: A U2N Relay UE is a UE that provides functionality to support connectivity to the network for U2N Remote UEs.

q_34647.question: What should the User Equipment (UE) send to request modification of bearer resources for one traffic flow aggregate?
q_34647.ground_truth: The UE should send a BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message to the Mobility Management Entity (MME).

q_34648.question: How is the sleep ratio per slot basis and per symbol basis calculated for NR satellite access network?
q_34648.ground_truth: The sleep ratio per slot basis is given by equation (4.8.2.2-1) in the document, while the sleep ratio per symbol basis is given by equation (4.8.2.2-2) in the document.

q_34649.question: What is the role of the NAS signalling in IP address allocation for PDU sessions in 5GCN?
q_34649.ground_truth: The NAS signalling is used by the UE to request IP connectivity and set the PDU session type, based on its IP stack capabilities.

q_34650.question: What should a UE do upon returning in coverage after being out of coverage due to discontinuous coverage?
q_34650.ground_truth: The UE sets the discontinuous coverage maximum time offset value to a random value up to and including the stored discontinuous coverage maximum time offset for this PLMN and satellite E-UTRAN access and starts this timer. The UE shall not initiate any NAS signalling on that satellite E-UTRAN access and PLMN combination while the discontinuous coverage maximum time offset timer is running.

q_34651.question: What should the originator of an HTTP error response include in the HTTP error response to enable an HTTP client to determine the originator of the error?
q_34651.ground_truth: The originator of an error should include a Server header in the HTTP error response with the type and identity of the NF or network entity generating the error, such as "SCP", "SEPP", or "SMF", and the FQDN of the SCP or SEPP, or the NF Instance ID of the HTTP server.

q_34652.question: What is the difference between Ranging/Sidelink Positioning location measurement data or results being returned to the LMF and the LMF indicating to UE1 whether the Ranging/Sidelink Positioning location results will be calculated by the LMF or by UE1?
q_34652.ground_truth: If the Ranging/Sidelink Positioning location measurement data or results are returned to the LMF, the LMF calculates the Ranging/Sidelink Positioning location results at step 19. If the LMF indicates to UE1 that it will calculate the Ranging/Sidelink Positioning location results, UE1 calculates the location results at step 17. If the LMF indicates to UE1 that UE1 will calculate the location results, UE1 calculates the location results at step 14.

q_34653.question: What is the main goal of the XR conference system?
q_34653.ground_truth: The main goal of the XR conference system is to provide an immersive telepresence experience for physically co-located and remote participants using XR technology in a shared conference space.

q_34654.question: Under what conditions will the 5G PKMF accept the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay discovery security material request procedure?
q_34654.ground_truth: The 5G PKMF will accept the procedure if the UE requests the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay discovery security material for 5G ProSe end UE over a TLS tunnel established by a UE authorized to act as a 5G ProSe end UE, or if the UE requests the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay discovery security material for 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE over a TLS tunnel established by a UE authorized to act as a 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE, or if the UE requests the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay discovery security material for both 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE and 5G ProSe end UE over a TLS tunnel established by a UE authorized to act as a 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE and a 5G ProSe end UE.

q_34655.question: What action will the transmission control interface take upon receiving an MCVideo call release step 1 request?
q_34655.ground_truth: The transmission control interface will ignore transmission control messages from the transmission control server, request the media distributor to stop distributing RTP media packets to the network media interface of the MCVideo clients, and ignore transmission control messages received from the transmission participant interfaces.

q_34656.question: What is the maximum allowed Tprocessing value when source and target cells are in different FRs?
q_34656.ground_truth: The maximum allowed Tprocessing value is 40 ms when source and target cells are in different FRs.

q_34657.question: What must the SC UE send when the served user rejects the transferred incoming early session?
q_34657.ground_truth: The SC UE sends a SIP CANCEL request cancelling the SIP INVITE request.

q_34658.question: What provides information of a given IP interface of a UPF?

q_34659.question: What is the criticality level of "id-securityinformation" in the "BearerContextSetupRequest"?
q_34659.ground_truth: The criticality level of "id-securityinformation" in the "BearerContextSetupRequest" is "reject".

q_34660.question: What should an MCPTT server do when providing services over MBMS and no longer needing a bearer?
q_34660.ground_truth: The MCPTT server should deactivate the MBMS bearer and deallocate the TMGIs when no longer necessary.

q_34661.question: What is the minimum channel raster for NR?
q_34661.ground_truth: The minimum channel raster for NR is specified in Clause 5.4.2 of TS 38.104.

q_34662.question: What is the test purpose of occupied bandwidth, as specified in 6.6.2.4.2 (c)?
q_34662.ground_truth: The test purpose is to verify that the emission at the TAB connector does not occupy an excessive bandwidth for the service to be provided and is, therefore, not likely to create interference to other users of the spectrum beyond undue limits.

q_34663.question: What are the two possible solutions provided for the performance indicator selection for ML model training?
q_34663.ground_truth: The two possible solutions are: (1) using the IOC (Information Object Class) named MLTrainingCapability, which contains the inference type and supported performance metrics, and (2) using the IOC MLTrainingRequest with the existing performanceRequirements attribute extended to indicate the MnS consumer selected performance indicator/metric.

q_34664.question: What should the UE do if the AMF indicates the need for the UE to perform a Registration procedure immediately?
q_34664.ground_truth: The UE initiates a Registration procedure with the registration type Mobility Registration Update after the UE enters CM-IDLE state, including the Requested NSSAI and the UE's received rejected S-NSSAIs in the Registration Request message.

q_34665.question: What is the role of the NEF in releasing resources for the MBS session?
q_34665.ground_truth: The NEF requests the MB-SMF to delete resources for the MBS session, and then the MB-SMF requests the MB-UPF to release user plane resources. The NEF responds to the AF once these steps are completed.

q_34666.question: Which message is used to inform the network about a failure detected by the UE?

q_34667.question: What should the MCData client do upon receipt of a SIP INFO request where the Request-URI contains an MCData session ID identifying an ongoing one-to-one session?
q_34667.ground_truth: The MCData client shall follow the actions specified in clause~6.2.8.3.7.

q_34668.question: In what situation will the participating MCPTT function reject the SIP INVITE request with a SIP 404 (Not Found) response?
q_34668.ground_truth: If the binding between the MCPTT ID and public user identity does not exist, the participating MCPTT function will reject the SIP INVITE request with a SIP 404 (Not Found) response.

q_34669.question: What is the role of the N3IWF in the 5G system?
q_34669.ground_truth: The N3IWF (Non-3GPP Interface Wrapper Function) is responsible for the communication between the AMF and the non-3GPP access networks.

q_34670.question: When does the SS activate SCC during SCell activation?
q_34670.ground_truth: The SS activates SCC by sending the activation MAC-CE in a subframe (m+5) during SCell activation.

q_34671.question: In step 2a of the Routing Area Update procedure, what information about the old P-TMSI does the UE indicate in the RAU Request message?
q_34671.ground_truth: The UE indicates the old P-TMSI, the corresponding RAI, and the related KSI in the RAU Request message.

q_34672.question: What is the condition for repeating the procedure for the other SNR point in step 7?
q_34672.ground_truth: The condition for repeating the procedure for the other SNR point in step 7 is if both SNR points of the test have not been tested.

q_34673.question: What is the condition for the test defined in section 9.1.32.5 to pass?
q_34673.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the ratio of successful reported values in each test must be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

q_34674.question: What is the purpose of the PositioningMeasurementUpdate message?
q_34674.ground_truth: The PositioningMeasurementUpdate message is used to update the positioning information of a specific measurement. It contains a ProtocolIE-Container, which includes a set of ProtocolIE-SingleContainer elements, each with a specific ID, Criticality, Type, Presence, and optional Additional Information.

q_34675.question: What is the maximum length of a template information element?
q_34675.ground_truth: The maximum length of a template information element is 257 octets.

q_34676.question: What is the main function of the MAC sublayer in terms of L2 services?
q_34676.ground_truth: The MAC sublayer is responsible for mapping between logical channels and transport channels, multiplexing/demultiplexing of MAC SDUs, scheduling information reporting, error correction through HARQ, priority handling between logical channels of one UE and between UEs, MBMS service identification, transport format selection, and padding.

q_34677.question: Which type is specified for the "RPAUID" element in the "RestrictedDiscReq-info" complex type?
q_34677.ground_truth: The "RPAUID" element in the "RestrictedDiscReq-info" complex type is specified as an "xs:string" data type.

q_34678.question: When should the requirements defined in clause 8.19 apply?
q_34678.ground_truth: The requirements defined in clause 8.19 apply when the UE is operating in NE-DC mode.

q_34679.question: In which mode does a UE in NB-S1 mode always indicate support for control plane CIoT EPS optimization?

q_34680.question: What should be included in the P-Asserted-Service header field when sending an SIP MESSAGE request for FD disposition notification for MCData server?
q_34680.ground_truth: The value "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcdata.fd" should be included in the P-Asserted-Service header field.

q_34681.question: What should the NG-RAN node do if the Location Reporting Request Type IE in the received LOCATION REPORTING CONTROL message contains the Event Type IE set to neither "UE presence in the area of interest" nor "change of serving cell and UE presence in the Area of Interest", but the Area of Interest List IE is present?
q_34681.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node should ignore the Area of Interest List IE and proceed with the Location Reporting Procedure.

q_34682.question: What is the purpose of the "UE radio capability signalling optimisation (RACS)" feature in the 3GPP specification?
q_34682.ground_truth: The RACS feature aims to optimise the transmission of UE radio capability over the radio interface by assigning an identifier, called the "UE radio capability ID", to represent a set of UE radio capabilities.

q_34683.question: What is the difference between version x.y.z presented as a TSG approved document under change control and version x.y.z presented to TSG for approval in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
q_34683.ground_truth: The difference is that version x.y.z presented as a TSG approved document under change control is a TSG approved document under change control, while version x.y.z presented to TSG for approval is not yet a TSG approved document under change control.

q_34684.question: What is the relationship between the Uplink power control window, the target power level and the corresponding possible actual UE Uplink power window?
q_34684.ground_truth: The Uplink power control window is used to ensure that the actual UE output power is no greater than the target power level, and as close as possible to the target power level. The possible actual UE Uplink power window is defined as -MU to -(MU + Uplink power control window size) dB of the target power level, where MU is the test system uplink power measurement uncertainty and the Uplink power control window size includes the UE power step size, UE power step tolerance, and Test system relative power measurement uncertainty.

q_34685.question: What information can the XRM service stream include when provided to the PCF via the NEF?
q_34685.ground_truth: The XRM service stream information can include IP packet filters, GBR and/or MBR, RTP payload type for media type, synchronization source identifier, and special label information.

q_34686.question: What is the purpose of the Facility information element in a Connect scenario?
q_34686.ground_truth: The Facility information element in a Connect scenario may be used for functional operation of supplementary services.

q_34687.question: What is the role of the "Equivalent PLMNs" list in the MS?
q_34687.ground_truth: The "Equivalent PLMNs" list in the MS consists of a list of equivalent PLMNs as downloaded by the network plus the PLMN code of the registered PLMN that downloaded the list. All PLMNs in the stored list, in all access technologies supported by the PLMN, are regarded as equivalent to each other for PLMN selection, cell selection/re-selection, and handover.

q_34688.question: What is the level of the signal of the artificial mouth that shall be measured at the MRP?
q_34688.ground_truth: The level of the signal of the artificial mouth shall be - 4.7dBPa measured at the MRP for handset and headset modes. For handsfree modes, the downlink delay is defined from the system simulator input to the acoustic output from the UE loudspeaker.

q_34689.question: What should be the priority for a MME/SGSN when selecting a target SGSN?
q_34689.ground_truth: When a MME/SGSN supporting DCNs selects a target SGSN, the selected target SGSN should be restricted to SGSNs that belong to the same CN.

q_34690.question: What is the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) and what is the purpose of the Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network (TSG-RAN) within it?
q_34690.ground_truth: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) is a collaboration between multiple standards organizations to create specifications for mobile telecommunications. The Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network (TSG-RAN) is a subgroup of 3GPP that focuses on the radio access network aspects of mobile telecommunications, including Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access (E-UTRA) and Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access Network (E-UTRAN).

q_34691.question: What is the measurement called that provides the fraction of PDCP SDU packets lost at the gNB-DU for packet switched traffic in 5GS?

q_34692.question: When would the UE diagnose a semantic error in packet filters in the context of two or more packet filters with identical packet filter identifiers?
q_34692.ground_truth: When two or more packet filters with identical packet filter identifiers are contained in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message.

q_34693.question: What additional actions does the MB-SMF take during the PFCP session establishment when restoring MBS sessions affected by an MB-UPF failure without restart?
q_34693.ground_truth: The MB-SMF requests alternative MB-UPF to join multicast tree towards SSM address, allocate new N6mb and/or Nmb9 ingress tunnel address, allocate new N3mb and/or N19mb LL SSM address and C-TEID, and send data towards the N3mb and/or N19mb endpoint's DL F-TEID. Then, for each MBS session, the alternativeMB-UPF assigns a new N3mb and/or N19mb LL SSM address and C-TEID, and/or a new N6mb and/or Nmb9 ingress tunnel address.

q_34694.question: What is the function of the MBS QoS flow binding in MBS deployments?
q_34694.ground_truth: The MBS QoS flow binding function resides at the MB-SMF and is used to associate the MBS PCC rule to an MBS QoS flow within an MBS session. This binding is performed using specific binding parameters.

q_34695.question: What is the effect of the AMF providing a different extended idle mode DRX cycle length value than what was requested by the UE?
q_34695.ground_truth: The AMF providing a different extended idle mode DRX cycle length value than what was requested by the UE can adversely impact reachability requirements of applications running on the UE.

q_34696.question: What is the objective of the initial conditions specified in 6.6.18.3.4.1.1?
q_34696.ground_truth: The objective of the initial conditions specified in 6.6.18.3.4.1.1 is to ensure a consistent and controlled testing environment for this test case.

q_34697.question: What is one of the potential standardization needs for the network rendering of XR services to meet immersive limits and low-complexity and low-latency bitrates?
q_34697.ground_truth: One of the potential standardization needs for the network rendering of XR services to meet immersive limits and low-complexity and low-latency bitrates is efficient content delivery and 5G network support.

q_34698.question: What type of procedures are used for invoking and revoking of the call-completion services?
q_34698.ground_truth: Out-of-band stimulus procedures, such as ETSI TR 183 057, and inband interaction procedures can be used.

q_34699.question: Which TS 33.501 clause does solution #19 reuse for primary authentication between the UE and the AAA server in SNPN?
q_34699.ground_truth: Solution #19 reuses clause I.2.2.2 of TS 33.501 for primary authentication between the UE and the AAA server in SNPN.

q_34700.question: What are the requirements for the rated output power, Prated,c, of the base station for Band 85 NB-IoT standalone operation?
q_34700.ground_truth: For Band 85 NB-IoT standalone operation, the BS rated output power limit of 43 dBm applies over the NB-IoT carriers in the range 728-729 MHz of the DL operating band. The BS output power limit of 43 dBm shall be considered as shared among all NB-IoT carriers in the 728-729 MHz frequency range or as the maximum value per NB-IoT carrier in the case where only one NB-IoT carrier is deployed in 728-729 MHz frequency range.

q_34701.question: Which organization is responsible for the management of 5G SA and NSA scenarios?

q_34702.question: What is the difference between Class 1 and Class 2 Elementary Procedures in the NGAP?
q_34702.ground_truth: Class 1 EPs in the NGAP are Elementary Procedures with response, while Class 2 EPs are Elementary Procedures without response. For Class 1 EPs, the response can be successful, unsuccessful, or both, while Class 2 EPs are considered always successful.

q_34703.question: What is the requirement for BS capable of multi-band operation for each supported operating band in clause 4.12?
q_34703.ground_truth: The RF requirements in clause~6 and 7 apply for each supported operating band unless otherwise stated in clause 4.12.

q_34704.question: What functions are supported by the RLC sub layer?
q_34704.ground_truth: The functions supported by the RLC sub layer include transfer of upper layer PDUs, error correction through ARQ (only for AM data transfer), segmentation and reassembly of RLC SDUs, duplicate detection (only for AM data transfer), and RLC re-establishment.

q_34705.question: When can a UE expect to receive a 401 (Unauthorized) response to the REGISTER request in GPRS-IMS-Bundled authentication?
q_34705.ground_truth: A UE can expect to receive a 401 (Unauthorized) response to the REGISTER request in GPRS-IMS-Bundled authentication when the network requires authentication or re-authentication of the UE.

q_34706.question: When is an IPsec tunnel used to terminate interfaces in the W-AGF function?
q_34706.ground_truth: An IPsec tunnel is used to terminate the N2 interface between the W-5GAN and the AMF and the N3 interface between the W-5GAN and the UPF on the W-AGF side.

q_34707.question: What should a participating MCPTT function do if it receives a SIP INVITE request for a originating participating MCPTT function with an unauthorized user trying to call a particular user?
q_34707.ground_truth: It should reject the request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response and the warning text set to "144 user not authorized to call this particular user" in a Warning header field.

q_34708.question: What shall the SGW do if it detects a partial failure and has one or more corresponding CSID(s) assigned?
q_34708.ground_truth: The SGW shall clean up any residual state associated with the CSID(s), send the GTPv2 Delete PDN Connection Set Request message containing the SGW CSIDs to the MME peers supporting the feature, and delete all the retrieved PDN connections and the associated resources.

q_34709.question: What procedure does this solution use to determine URSP rules based on service parameters obtained from VPLMN?
q_34709.ground_truth: The AF provides application guidance for URSP determination to the H-PCF via UDR, and the H-PCF generates new or updates existing URSP rules accordingly.

q_34710.question: What command is sent from a 3GPP AAA Server to a trusted non-3GPP access network NAS to complete SWa authentication and authorization procedures?

q_34711.question: What action should the SMF consider when it receives the Current QoS Parameters Set Index IE for a QoS flow in the QoS Flow Setup Response List IE in the Handover Request Acknowledge Transfer IE in the HANDOVER REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message?
q_34711.ground_truth: The SMF should consider it as the currently fulfilled QoS parameters set among the alternative QoS parameters for the involved QoS flow.

q_34712.question: What measures should a UE take if a GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND, an EMM STATUS or an EMM INFORMATION message is received before the detach procedure is completed?
q_34712.ground_truth: For detach procedures with detach type other than "IMSI detach", the UE should ignore the message. For detach procedures with detach type "IMSI detach", the UE should continue both detach and EMM procedures.

q_34713.question: What is the purpose of the mappingQoS field in the LCS-PeriodicTriggeredInvokeArg sequence?
q_34713.ground_truth: The mappingQoS field in the LCS-PeriodicTriggeredInvokeArg sequence indicates the mapped QoS which appliable to EPS to be sent by the UE for EPS to UE service continuity when UE has moved from 5GS to EPS and detected an event to report to MME.

q_34714.question: When measuring spurious emissions for intra-band contiguous carrier aggregation in co-existence with protected bands, what should be the lowest and highest frequency of the measurement position in each frequency range?
q_34714.ground_truth: The lowest frequency of the measurement position in each frequency range should be set at the lowest boundary of the frequency range plus MBW/2, and the highest frequency of the measurement position in each frequency range should be set at the highest boundary of the frequency range minus MBW/2.

q_34715.question: What should the SS attempt to do if the UE fails to add the FR2 SCell in the UE behavior testing process?
q_34715.ground_truth: The SS shall first attempt to release and add the FR2 SCell.

q_34716.question: When does the UE initiate a registration procedure for initial registration after waiting in 5GMM-IDLE mode?
q_34716.ground_truth: This occurs when the UE is registered over non-3GPP access and has an emergency service ongoing, and the UE parameters update data set does not include a UE parameters update data set with UE parameters update data set type indicating "Routing indicator update data".

q_34717.question: What is the function of the IMS Network Functions when performing interception without the control channel (CC) in a roaming case for voice over IP (VoIP) users?
q_34717.ground_truth: The IMS Network Functions report to the Lower Layer Media Function (LLMF) that the CC is unavailable due to the target's roaming situation when performing interception without the CC for roaming targets.

q_34718.question: What information does the MME include in the S1AP Paging message?
q_34718.ground_truth: The MME may include the paging attempt count information, WUS Assistance Information, Information for Enhanced Coverage, and CE mode B Restricted parameter, based on specific conditions.

q_34719.question: What is the requirement for spurious response for V2X concurrent operation as specified in clause 7.7E.0.2?
q_34719.ground_truth: The requirements specified in clause 7.7E.0.1 shall apply for the NR sidelink reception in the operating bands while all downlink carriers are active, and the requirements specified in clause 7.7 shall apply for the NR downlink reception in licensed bands.

q_34720.question: What is the meaning of the absence of the QoS flow Identifier in the Diameter ASR message received by the SMF?
q_34720.ground_truth: The absence of the QoS flow Identifier in the Diameter ASR message indicates that all QoS flows for the specific user and sharing the same user session should be deleted.

q_34721.question: What is the required throughput measurement for NR bands with DL and UL frequencies below 2700 MHz?
q_34721.ground_truth: The throughput measurement must be 95% or more of the reference measurement channel's maximum throughput.

q_34722.question: What happens when the 5GMS Client requests a Background Data Transfer during one of the advertised time windows?
q_34722.ground_truth: If the 5GMS network services grant the request for the Background Data Transfer, it applies the appropriate Quality of Service policy to the media streaming session. The 5GMS network services will indicate the estimate of the time period for which Background Data Transfer is available and the maximum data volume that it is permitted to transfer.

q_34723.question: What is the meaning of the optional entries in the external orientation file?
q_34723.ground_truth: The optional entries in the external orientation file include HeadRotIndicator, ExtOriIndicator, ExtIntrpFlag, and ExtIntrpNFrames. They indicate how the head rotation, external orientation, and interpolation are handled in the decoder/renderer.

q_34724.question: What is the procedure for the transmission of unsolicited location information in section 5.3.3?
q_34724.ground_truth: The Location Information Delivery procedure in section 5.3.3 describes how Endpoint A can provide unsolicited location information to Endpoint B through the use of ProvideLocationInformation messages.

q_34725.question: What is the responsibility of the MN or SN node in mapping QoS flows to DRBs in MR-DC with 5GC?
q_34725.ground_truth: The MN or SN node that hosts the SDAP entity for a given QoS flow decides how to map the QoS flow to DRBs in MR-DC with 5GC.

q_34726.question: What internal event exposures does the 5GC NFs consider when providing mobility related events to NF consumers?
q_34726.ground_truth: The 5GC NFs consider events independent of the ongoing system procedure, such as during registration, inter-NG-RAN node handover, location reporting, and N2 Notification and AN release procedures.

q_34727.question: What is the role of the Service Enabler Architecture Layer (SEAL) in the 3GPP system?
q_34727.ground_truth: The SEAL is a platform architecture that enables the distribution and delivery of application content/data for vertical applications in the 3GPP system.

q_34728.question: What actions are taken if the SC UE A uses Gm after the PS-CS access transfer in the alerting phase is completed?
q_34728.ground_truth: The SC UE A and the network release the source access leg locally, without any signalling between the SC UE A and the network.

q_34729.question: What shall the NG-RAN node2 initiate if the Report Characteristics IE bitmap is set to "0" in the Resource Status Request message?
q_34729.ground_truth: A RESOURCE STATUS FAILURE message with an appropriate cause value.

q_34730.question: What is the NF Repository Function (NFR) service discovery used for in the context of discovering if a NF instance's SBI supports QUIC as a transport protocol?
q_34730.ground_truth: The NFR service discovery is used to learn which NF instances support QUIC as a transport protocol by checking for IpEndPoint definitions with the transport protocol set to QUIC in the NFProfile.

q_34731.question: What is the role of the AAA server in PINE authentication over 5G CP?
q_34731.ground_truth: The AAA server authenticates the PINE by determining whether the external DN-AAA is allowed to perform PINE authentication and exchanging EAP messages between the SMF, UPF, PEGC, and the PINE.

q_34732.question: How does the S-NAPTR procedure logically output a list of host names?
q_34732.ground_truth: The S-NAPTR procedure outputs a list of host names each with a service, protocol, port and a list of IPv4 and IPvv6 addresses, which can be obtained one host name at a time or in a complete ordered list of all nodes.

q_34733.question: What are the conditions for an MME or SGSN to trigger extended buffering for a UE?
q_34733.ground_truth: An MME or SGSN should trigger extended buffering when the UE is in a power saving state or intermittently in coverage, excluding cases with a "Availability after DDN Failure" monitoring event or a "UE Reachability" monitoring event. The MME/SGSN indicates DL Buffering Requested in the Downlink Data Notification Ack message and includes a DL Buffering Duration time and optionally a DL Buffering Suggested Packet Count. The DL Data Buffer Expiration Time is used to indicate that there are buffered data in the Serving GW and that the user plane setup procedure is needed when the UE makes signalling with the network.

q_34734.question: What is the purpose of identity mapping in the IWF?
q_34734.ground_truth: The purpose of identity mapping in the IWF is to derive the corresponding identities of LMR users and groups in an MCPTT or MCData system. This is done by providing an MCPTT ID for LMR users and an MCPTT group ID for LMR groups.

q_34735.question: What information does the UE send to the network via the user plane when it receives Measurement Assistance Information?
q_34735.ground_truth: The UE sends the dynamically allocated UDP port and, if IPv6 is used for PMF messages, the IPv6 address to the network via the user plane when it receives Measurement Assistance Information.

q_34736.question: What is the function of the Session Management Function (SMF) in 5G networks?
q_34736.ground_truth: The SMF is responsible for the enforcement of policy decisions related to service data flow detection, authorized QoS, charging, gating, traffic usage reporting, packet routing and forwarding, and traffic steering.

q_34737.question: What action should the UE take when it receives 5GMM cause #77 over a wireline access network?
q_34737.ground_truth: The UE sets the 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, deletes specific information, resets the registration attempt counter, and enters the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.

q_34738.question: What is the requirement for a UE to support inter-RAT PS handover to UTRAN when it supports UTRA TDD 7.68 Mcps?
q_34738.ground_truth: A UE that supports UTRAN TDD 7.68 Mcps shall support inter-RAT PS handover to UTRAN.

q_34739.question: Which network product class specific security functional adaptations are covered in the present document?
q_34739.ground_truth: The present document contains gNB-CU-specific security functional adaptations of requirements and related test cases.

q_34740.question: Which procedure is used to notify the sending endpoint by the receiving endpoint that the receiving SLPP message is erroneous or unexpected?
q_34740.ground_truth: The procedure is called Error handling in SLPP.

q_34741.question: What information should the UE include in the UECapabilityInformation message if it does not support FDD and TDD?
q_34741.ground_truth: If the UE does not support FDD and TDD, it should not set the fields fdd-Add-UE-EUTRA-Capabilities and tdd-Add-UE-EUTRA-Capabilities (including their sub-fields) in the UE-EUTRA-Capability within the ue-CapabilityRAT-Container, and should set the other fields to include the values applicable for its supported mode.

q_34742.question: What is the role of the RAA message in the session start procedure for MBMS bearer service?
q_34742.ground_truth: The RAA message is used by the GGSN to indicate to the BM-SC that it has successfully started the session for the MBMS bearer service.

q_34743.question: What is the initial value for the scrambling sequence in the modulation process for the physical sidelink control channel?
q_34743.ground_truth: The initial value for the scrambling sequence is 1010.

q_34744.question: What should the floor control interface do when it receives a Floor Request message from the associated floor participant while being in the 'U: not permitted and Floor Taken' state and the session is a broadcast group call?
q_34744.ground_truth: The floor control interface should send a Floor Deny message to the associated floor participant with the "Reject Cause" field set to '#5 (Receive only)', and remain in the 'U: not permitted and Floor Taken' state.

q_34745.question: What is the purpose of the test defined in section 9.1.32.1?
q_34745.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to verify that the CSI-RSRP absolute and relative measurement accuracies in CSI-RS based discovery signal are within the specified limits.

q_34746.question: What is the target identity associated with the IRI-POI present in the EES?
q_34746.ground_truth: The LIPF present in the ADMF provisions the intercept information associated with the GPSI and EECID target identities to the IRI-POI present in the EES.

q_34747.question: What is the test requirement for 6.5.3.10.5?
q_34747.ground_truth: The test requires the UE to send the first CSI report for SCell in the first available uplink resource and start sending CSI reports with non-zero CQI index at a certain slot. Also, interruption on any activated serving cell should not exceed certain limits during T2.

q_34748.question: What information is needed when the AF request is for influencing SMF routing decisions?
q_34748.ground_truth: The information is used to identify UE(s) whose traffic is to be routed.

q_34749.question: What is the requirement for the measurement reporting delay in the test?
q_34749.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay shall be less than 25.6 seconds in the test.

q_34750.question: What should the UE do if the T3448 value IE is present in the received ATTACH ACCEPT message and the UE is using EPS services with control plane CIoT EPS optimization, and the value indicates that this timer is zero or deactivated?
q_34750.ground_truth: The UE shall consider this case as an abnormal case and proceed as if the T3448 value IE is not present.

q_34751.question: What does a non-empty mbms-FreqList in the MBMSInterestIndication message indicate?
q_34751.ground_truth: A non-empty mbms-FreqList in the MBMSInterestIndication message indicates that the UE has included the MBMS frequencies of interest sorted by decreasing order of interest.

q_34752.question: What is the role of the SCEF in setting up a transfer policy and who is responsible for deriving the PCC rules for the background data transfer?
q_34752.ground_truth: The SCEF, acting as an AF, transfers the request to set up a transfer policy to the PCRF via the Rx interface. The PCRF retrieves the corresponding transfer policy from the SPR and derives the PCC rules for the background data transfer.

q_34753.question: What HTTP method is used to send notifications in ACR Information Notification as specified in 6.4.4.2.2?
q_34753.ground_truth: The POST method is used to send notifications in ACR Information Notification as specified in 6.4.4.2.2.

q_34754.question: Upon receiving the indication for GNSS measurements, what should the UE perform?
q_34754.ground_truth: Upon receiving the indication for GNSS measurements, the UE should perform GNSS measurement using the measurement gap with a gap length indicated by lower layers.

q_34755.question: What should the UE do upon receiving N314 consecutive "in-sync" indications for the PCell from lower layers while T313 is running?
q_34755.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T313.

q_34756.question: What is the GSM/EDGE carrier spacing?

q_34757.question: What is the minimum number of resource blocks that the AllowedMeasBandwidth IE can indicate?
q_34757.ground_truth: The minimum number of resource blocks that the AllowedMeasBandwidth IE can indicate is mbw6, which indicates 6 resource blocks.

q_34758.question: What is the state of the UE and the AMF when the NG-RAN enters the N2 suspend procedure?
q_34758.ground_truth: The UE and the AMF both enter CM-IDLE with RRC inactive.

q_34759.question: What should the MCVideo client do upon expiration of timer TFG2 (call announcement) while in the "S3: part of ongoing call" state?
q_34759.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should generate a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message and send it to the network, and start timer TFG2 again.

q_34760.question: What is the initializing message for the "id-eNBDirectInformationTransfer" procedure code in the S1AP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE?

q_34761.question: What is the LCRB limit for an RB allocation to be considered a Region 1 inner RB allocation in FR2-1 for power class 3?
q_34761.ground_truth: LCRB should be less than or equal to ceil(NRB/4).

q_34762.question: How does the Target UE or the Reference UE request Ranging capability and Ranging assistant data?
q_34762.ground_truth: The Ranging capability request and Ranging assistant data request are transferred via the PC5-S message.

q_34763.question: When performing arithmetic comparisons of state variables or SN values, what modulus base is used at the receiving side of an UM RLC entity?
q_34763.ground_truth: The modulus base used is VR(UH) - UM_Window_Size.

q_34764.question: What should the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay select for security procedures when it is in 3GPP coverage during model A discovery?
q_34764.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay may select both RSCs associated with the security procedures with network assistance and the security procedures without network assistance.

q_34765.question: Which RRC message does a UE in eCall-INACTIVE.LIMITED-SERVICE state not transmit when requested to make an eCall?
q_34765.ground_truth: When a UE is in eCall-INACTIVE.LIMITED-SERVICE state and requested to make an eCall to a URI for test service, it does not transmit any RRCConnectionRequest message.

q_34766.question: What is the behavior of the network upon expiry of the mobile reachable timer when the UE is not registered for emergency services?
q_34766.ground_truth: The network stops sending paging messages to the UE on the first expiry and may take other appropriate actions. If the UE is registered for emergency services, the AMF sets the mobile reachable timer with a value equal to timer T3512 and locally de-registers the UE when the mobile reachable timer expires.

q_34767.question: What determines the size of the sensing window in the mode 2 sensing procedure of NR V2X?
q_34767.ground_truth: The sensing window in the mode 2 sensing procedure of NR V2X starts shortly after the trigger for (re-)selection of resources and cannot be longer than the remaining latency budget of the packet due to be transmitted.

q_34768.question: What is the difference in the QoS model between 4G EPS and 5GS?
q_34768.ground_truth: 4G EPS follows a rigid approach, with all traffic mapped to the same EPS bearer with the same packet forwarding treatment. 5GS uses a more flexible approach, with multiple different QoS flows within a PDU session.

q_34769.question: What is the role of the MBSR IAB-UE in determining the location of the TRP?
q_34769.ground_truth: The MBSR IAB-UE initiates a 5GC-MO-LR procedure to get its location information. The MBSR IAB-DU uses the MBSR IAB-UE's location info to determine the updated location for its TRP. The updated location of MBSR's TRP is then reported to the Donor-CU and further forwarded to LMF which uses the updated location of MBSR's TRP for calculation of the UE's position.

q_34770.question: What is the procedure for restoration of profiles related to UDR in 6.7.2-1?
q_34770.ground_truth: The procedure for restoration of profiles related to UDR involves defining callbackUri for data restoration in the NF profile registered in NRF, storing temporary data in UDR, detecting corruption, loss, or inconsistency in temporary data, querying NRF based on the identity, discovering callbackUri for data restoration in UDR consumers' NF profiles, and forwarding notifications to UDM consumers.

q_34771.question: What should an MCVideo client do to act as the user agent for all MCVideo application transactions?
q_34771.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should initiate and manage group calls, as well as handle the MCVideo client ID as specified in clause 4.10.

q_34772.question: What message is sent by the source HeNB to indicate that the HeNB GW may release all the resources related to the UE context during an X2 handover with HeNBs?
q_34772.ground_truth: A UE CONTEXT RELEASE REQUEST message including an explicit GW Context Release Indication is sent by the source HeNB.

q_34773.question: What does the UE do to the CSG ID of the cell it attempted to attach to when it receives an ATTACH REJECT message with EMM cause #25?
q_34773.ground_truth: The UE removes the CSG ID of the cell from its Allowed CSG list.

q_34774.question: What action does the source SN take when it receives the SN Release Request message from the MN in the MN initiated SN change procedure?
q_34774.ground_truth: The source SN stops providing user data to the UE and, if applicable, starts data forwarding.

q_34775.question: What are the two options for the NWDAF to collect only valid UE location data within the exact target area?
q_34775.ground_truth: Option A: LCS scheme, where the LCS architecture provides valid UE location data when the UE is in the exact target area. Option B: NWDAF scheme, where the NWDAF makes the judgment and counts the valid UE location data.

q_34776.question: How many pairs of security associations are created and used during the IMS signalling handling in IPsec for IMS?
q_34776.ground_truth: During the IMS signalling handling two pairs of SAs consisting of four unidirectional SAs will be used, one pair of SAs between the server port of UE and the client port of the SS, and another pair of SAs between the client port of UE and the server port of the SS.

q_34777.question: What is the maximum allowable value for Pfa in the PRACH preamble detection performance requirement?
q_34777.ground_truth: The maximum allowable value for Pfa in the PRACH preamble detection performance requirement is 0.1%.

q_34778.question: How much degradation in beam prediction accuracy is caused by the existing quantization granularity of L1-RSRP in BM-Case1 for inference of DL Tx beam with L1-RSRPs of all beams in Set B?
q_34778.ground_truth: The existing quantization granularity of L1-RSRP causes less than 5% beam prediction accuracy degradation in terms of Top-1 beam prediction accuracy in BM-Case1 for inference of DL Tx beam with L1-RSRPs of all beams in Set B.

q_34779.question: In what scenario is a single octet Ci bitmap used for the Truncated Enhanced BFR MAC CE, instead of a four octets Ci bitmap?
q_34779.ground_truth: A single octet Ci bitmap is used when the highest ServCellIndex of the MAC entity's SCell for which beam failure is detected, and the evaluation of the candidate beams has been completed is less than 8.

q_34780.question: What should the participating MCPTT function do if the SIP re-INVITE request in step 3b of the rel-transfer procedures indicates that the target MCPTT user is not authorized to make a private call transfer request?
q_34780.ground_truth: If the SIP re-INVITE request in step 3b of the rel-transfer procedures indicates that the target MCPTT user is not authorized to make a private call transfer request, the participating MCPTT function shall reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response including warning text set to "170 user not authorized to make a private call transfer request" in a Warning header field as specified in clause~4.4, and shall skip the rest of the steps.

q_34781.question: What is the purpose of the NRF in this network, and what are its responsibilities?
q_34781.ground_truth: The NRF is responsible for network function (NF) service discovery and management. It maintains a registry of NF instances and their capabilities, and enables NF services discovery by the SCP. In this network, the NRF also provides the target PLMN ID to the SCP by querying the MNPF.

q_34782.question: What should a participating MCData function do if the MCData user identified by the MCData ID is not authorized for MCData communications?
q_34782.ground_truth: It shall reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response and include warning text indicating the reason for the rejection.

q_34783.question: What reference points does MCPTT-6 use when the MCPTT service provider interacts with MBSF directly?
q_34783.ground_truth: MCPTT-6, utilizing Nmb10/MB2-C reference points, is used when the MCPTT service provider interacts with MBSF directly, either for interworking with LTE through MBSF/MBSTF or in full-service mode.

q_34784.question: What should the UE do if it receives the rejection cause "S-NSSAI not available due to maximum number of UEs reached" in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message?
