q_36232.ground_truth: The "min Properties" definition specifies the minimum number of properties that a map must have, while the "max Properties" definition specifies the maximum number of properties that a map can have. These definitions are used to constrain the cardinality of the map data type.

q_36233.question: What are the two different QoS parameters provided by the AF for in the AI/ML model split decision?
q_36233.ground_truth: The AF provides one Alternative QoS parameter for each different split point between the UE and the AI/ML server.

q_36234.question: What should be the alignment of the manufacturer declared coordinate system orientation of the AAS BS with the test system in step 2?
q_36234.ground_truth: The manufacturer declared coordinate system orientation of the AAS BS should be aligned with the test system in step 2.

q_36235.question: What are the two main functions defined in the 3GPP Technical Specification for Real-Time media Communication Architecture?
q_36235.ground_truth: The two main functions are RTC AF (Real-time media Communication Application Function) and RTC AS (Real-time media Communication Application Server), both are dedicated to real-time media communication.

q_36236.question: What is the function of the SSRC of granted transmission participant field in the Transmission Arbitration Released message?
q_36236.ground_truth: The SSRC of granted transmission participant field in the Transmission Arbitration Released message carries the SSRC value for Audio and Video RTP stream of the user transmitting the media, and is used to indicate the identity of the granted transmission participant.

q_36237.question: What should the controlling MCData function do if it receives a SIP MESSAGE request for an emergency alert indication and the <alert-ind> element is set to a value of "false"?
q_36237.ground_truth: The controlling MCData function should perform the procedures specified in clause 16.2.3.2.

q_36238.question: What is the length of the BWP ID field in the Enhanced Unified TCI States Activation/Deactivation MAC CE for Separate TCI States?
q_36238.ground_truth: The length of the BWP ID field is 2 bits.

q_36239.question: In the context of radio link monitoring in TS 38.133, what is the scheduling restriction during RLM for an active Type-D CSI-RS with active TCI state for PDCCH or PDSCH in the CSI-RS that is not in a CSI-RS resource set with repetition ON?
q_36239.ground_truth: There are no scheduling restrictions due to radio link monitoring based on the CSI-RS.

q_36240.question: What is the definition of unidirectional RRH deployment for Scenario-2 in the HST tunnel?
q_36240.ground_truth: For Scenario-2 in the HST tunnel, unidirectional RRH deployment refers to one panel per RRH pointed to the same direction for all RRHs.

q_36241.question: What should the UE do with the list of "PLMNs not allowed to operate at the present UE location" when switching off?
q_36241.ground_truth: When switching off, the UE retains the list of "PLMNs not allowed to operate at the present UE location" in non-volatile memory and deletes it if the USIM is removed. When switching on after a shutdown, the UE restarts or considers expired the timer associated with the entry in the list based on hysteresis principles.

q_36242.question: What should be the value of the <alert-ind> element in the initial SIP MESSAGE request from an MCPTT client?
q_36242.ground_truth: The <alert-ind> element should be set to a value of "false" in the initial SIP MESSAGE request.

q_36243.question: What should the VLR do if it does not receive the SGsAP-TMSI-REALLOCATION-COMPLETE message before the timer~Ts6-2 expires?
q_36243.ground_truth: The VLR shall abort the TMSI reallocation procedure and consider the old TMSI as occupied until the new TMSI is used in a subsequent A/Iu message, or for an implementation dependent time.

q_36244.question: In the home routed roaming architecture where a UPF is inserted in the UP path for the IPUPS functionality, who controls the UPF supporting IPUPS functionality?
q_36244.ground_truth: In this architecture, the UPF supporting IPUPS functionality in VPLMN and HPLMN are controlled by the V-SMF and the H-SMF respectively.

q_36245.question: What is the objective of the "SDM PDSCH PRB Usage" measurement in 5G?
q_36245.ground_truth: The objective of the "SDM PDSCH PRB Usage" measurement is to measure the usage of cell DL capacity in MIMO scenario by providing the total usage (in percentage) of PDSCH physical resource blocks (PRBs) based on statistical MIMO layers in the DL per cell.

q_36246.question: What is the requirement for the test to pass in the E-UTRAN TDD TDD intra-frequency event triggered reporting under fading propagation conditions in synchronous cells for UE category 1bis test case?
q_36246.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the total number of successful tests shall be more than 90% of the cases with a confidence level of 95%.

q_36247.question: What should be done to each character of the field-value of the Subject header if its delivery is unauthorized in a SIP message?
q_36247.ground_truth: Each character of the field-value of the Subject header should be replaced with a space.

q_36248.question: What is not required to be reported in the test?
q_36248.ground_truth: The SSB time index is not required to be reported in the test.

q_36249.question: How are Public User Identities compared in the HSS?
q_36249.ground_truth: Public User Identities are compared in the HSS as defined in IETF~RFC~3966, clause~4.

q_36250.question: What should the transmission control server do if the T1 (Inactivity) timer expires?
q_36250.ground_truth: If the T1 (Inactivity) timer expires, the transmission control server will initiate the process of releasing the MCVideo call.

q_36251.question: What is the responsibility of the conference bridge service in a three-way session?
q_36251.ground_truth: The conference bridge service is in control of the termination sequence in a three-way session. It can either terminate the other two sessions using the session clearing procedures or transfer one of the remaining endpoints to the other, resulting in a simple two-party session.

q_36252.question: What is the purpose of the 8.34 command in a mobile phone?
q_36252.ground_truth: The 8.34 command is used to set a specific ring melody and volume for the selected call type and profile in a mobile phone.

q_36253.question: In what situation would the UE omit CSI reporting for a serving cell in an uplink slot?
q_36253.ground_truth: If there is no valid downlink slot for the CSI reference resource corresponding to a CSI Report Setting in a serving cell, CSI reporting is omitted for the serving cell in uplink slot 'n'.

q_36254.question: What is the total number of successful tests required for the test case of NR SA FR1 event-triggered reporting without gap under non-DRX to pass?
q_36254.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the total number of successful tests should be more than 90% of the cases with a confidence level of 95%.

q_36255.question: What should the TWAN use as the PLMN of the PDN GW if neither the Visited Network Identifier, the FQDN of the PDN GW, nor the PLMN where the 3GPP AAA Server is located are available for static PDN GW assignment?
q_36255.ground_truth: The TWAN should use the PLMN where the 3GPP AAA Server is located.

q_36256.question: When would the V-SMF indicate to the H-SMF whether the request for an always-on PDU Session is accepted or not?
q_36256.ground_truth: If the PDU Session being established was requested to be an always-on PDU Session, the H-SMF indicates to the V-SMF whether the request is accepted or not via the Always-on PDU Session Granted indication in the response message to V-SMF.

q_36257.question: What is the minimum requirement for the wide area IAB-DU type 1-H conducted receiver characteristics dynamic range?
q_36257.ground_truth: The wide area IAB-DU type 1-H conducted receiver characteristics dynamic range minimum requirement is the same as the wide area BS dynamic range requirement for BS type 1-H in TS 38.104, subclause 7.3.2, where references to BS channel bandwidth apply to IAB-DU channel bandwidth.

q_36258.question: What should the UE do when it receives a SERVICE REJECT message with the EMM cause set to 'Illegal ME' after sending a CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message?
q_36258.ground_truth: The UE sets the EPS update status to EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, deletes any GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI list and KSI, considers the USIM as invalid for EPS services until switching off or the UICC containing the USIM is removed, and enters the state EMM-DEREGISTERED.

q_36259.question: What is the impact on UL packet loss after enabling SPS PDSCH reception/Type-2 CG PUSCH transmission/SP-CSI reporting on PUSCH without reactivation after BWP switching?
q_36259.ground_truth: The UL packet loss can be by 28.4%~14.47% after enabling SPS PDSCH reception/Type-2 CG PUSCH transmission/SP-CSI reporting on PUSCH without reactivation after BWP switching.

q_36260.question: What should the UE ensure regarding the feature set IDs if the NR or E-UTRA network requests UE capabilities for nr, eutra-nr or eutra?
q_36260.ground_truth: The UE should ensure that the feature set IDs are consistent across feature sets, feature set combinations and band combinations in all three UE capability containers that the network queries with the same fields with the same values.

q_36261.question: What action should the SMF take if it receives a request for retrieving the complete SM context and there are downlink data packets buffered at I-UPF?
q_36261.ground_truth: The SMF should include the "forwardingInd" attribute with value "true" in the response body to indicate the presence of buffered downlink data packets.

q_36262.question: What is the frequency range specified for out-of-band band blocking for NR V2X bands in clause 7.6E.3?
q_36262.ground_truth: The frequency range specified for out-of-band band blocking for NR V2X bands in clause 7.6E.3 is 30 MHz below or above the UE receive band.

q_36263.question: What is the name of the parent element under RulesForDeaffiliation that specifies the list of active functional aliases?

q_36264.question: What is the initial value of the VT(US) state variable?
q_36264.ground_truth: The initial value of the VT(US) state variable is 0.

q_36265.question: What type of data does the "<RelativePresentationPriority>" element contain and where is it used?
q_36265.ground_truth: The "<RelativePresentationPriority>" element contains an integer value between 0 and 255 and it is used to indicate the presentation priority of the on-network group relative to other on-network groups and on-network users or off-network groups and off-network users. It is used in the "<MCPTTGroupInfo>" element of the "<OnNetwork>" and "<OffNetwork>" elements.

q_36266.question: What procedures are followed by the NWDAF to provide UE mobility analytics with finer granularity than TA/cell?
q_36266.ground_truth: The NWDAF can interface with the GMLC/AMF to obtain location information for a UE using LCS procedures, or act as a GMLC client and obtain location information directly from the AMF.

q_36267.question: When do co-located, synchronized TDD base stations require special co-location requirements?
q_36267.ground_truth: Co-located, synchronized TDD base stations require special co-location requirements when they are unsynchronized.

q_36268.question: What is determined as the CN type when the UE is registered both in EPC and 5GC, or some members of a Group of UEs are registered in EPC while some members are registered in 5GC?

q_36269.question: How does the power allocation differ between case a) and case b) in 4.8.4a?
q_36269.ground_truth: In case a), each carrier is set to the same power such that the sum of the carrier powers equals the rated total output power. In case b), the power allocated per carrier for the RAT on which modulation quality is measured is the highest possible, while the power of the remaining carriers from other RAT(s) is set to the same level as in case a).

q_36270.question: What information is included in the Ranging/SL Positioning Solicitation message in Model B discovery for 5G ProSe capable UE?
q_36270.ground_truth: The Ranging/SL Positioning Solicitation message includes the Type of Discovery Message, security protection element, optionally User Info ID of Discoveree UE, User Info ID of Discoverer UE, and RSPP metadata information.

q_36271.question: What is the required throughput for the PUSCH performance requirement, expressed as a fraction of the maximum throughput for the reference channels listed in Annex A?
q_36271.ground_truth: The required throughput is expressed as a fraction of maximum throughput for the FRCs listed in Annex A.

q_36272.question: What action does the floor control interface take when it receives a Floor Release message from the associated floor participant?
q_36272.ground_truth: The floor control interface sends a Floor Ack message, removes the MCPTT client from the active floor request queue or cached application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-floor-request+xml MIME body, and remains in the 'U: not permitted and initiating' state.

q_36273.question: Which network scenarios are used for FDD and TDD inter-RAT cell environment with UTRA FDD or UTRA TDD in 4.4.1.4?
q_36273.ground_truth: Cell 1 and Cell 5 are used for FDD and TDD inter-RAT cell environment with UTRA FDD or UTRA TDD.

q_36274.question: Which key characteristics of packet domain are found in 3GPP TS 23.060?
q_36274.ground_truth: The key characteristics of PLMN related to the packet domain are found in 3GPP TS 23.060.

q_36275.question: What should be the value of AMR-WB at IPv6 if the mode-set includes 6.60, 8.85, and 12.65, the packetization time is 20, and no extra bandwidth is allocated for redundancy?
q_36275.ground_truth: The value should be set to 38.

q_36276.question: What SDP offer is included in the SIP INVITE request for additional session transfer, if early dialog does not exist?
q_36276.ground_truth: The SDP offer included is the one received in the SIP INVITE request from the served user.

q_36277.question: What information included in the NAICS Information IE replaces corresponding NAICS information at the receiver?
q_36277.ground_truth: When the NAICS Information IE is set to "NAICS Inactive", the existing NAICS information at the receiver is considered invalid and replaced by the new information.

q_36278.question: When the SMF detects that a policy decision cannot be enforced, what action is taken if the SMF does not need to reject the request?
q_36278.ground_truth: The SMF includes one or more PartialSuccessReport data structure(s) in the response message with an HTTP "200 OK" status code to report the partial success of policy decision and/or condition data.

q_36279.question: What information does the SystemInformationBlockType20-NB contain?
q_36279.ground_truth: The SystemInformationBlockType20-NB contains the information required to acquire the control information associated with transmission of MBMS using SC-PTM.

q_36280.question: What must the MME do when sending the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message in the NAS security mode control procedure?
q_36280.ground_truth: The MME must send the message unciphered but integrity protect it with the NAS integrity key based on KASME or mapped K'ASME.

q_36281.question: In what situations can the network use the 5GMM cause value #7 (5GS services not allowed) when rejecting the initial registration request from a UE?
q_36281.ground_truth: If the network does not authorize the UE to use a certain CAG, or if the UE roams and is not allowed to use certain services or PLMNs.

q_36282.question: What is the role of the UE-to-UE Relay in the 5G DDNMF of the Target UE?
q_36282.ground_truth: The UE-to-UE Relay responds to the 5G DDNMF of the Target UE with a Discovery Response message including security parameters and the chosen PC5 ciphering algorithm. It also stores the Code-Sending Security Parameters, Code-Receiving Security Parameters, and the chosen PC5 ciphering algorithm together with the RSC.

q_36283.question: What should the M-NG-RAN node do if it receives a Source NG-RAN Node ID IE in the S-NODE ADDITION REQUEST message indicating a specific source NG-RAN node and the direct data forwarding path is available with the indicated source NG-RAN node?
q_36283.ground_truth: The M-NG-RAN node should include the Direct Forwarding Path Availability IE in the S-NODE ADDITION REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message to indicate the direct data forwarding path availability with the source NG-RAN node.

q_36284.question: What is the role of a PEGC in the PIN architecture?
q_36284.ground_truth: A PEGC in the PIN architecture is responsible for terminating application sessions, maintaining synchronization among sub-flows, and obtaining QoS Rules for the new flow.

q_36285.question: What steps should the MCData client follow when generating a SIP MESSAGE request to send a one-to-one standalone SDS message?
q_36285.ground_truth: The MCData client should build the SIP MESSAGE request as specified in clause 6.2.4.1, inserting an application/resource-lists+xml MIME body with the MCData ID of the target MCData user, and an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body with the mcdata-Params element containing the request-type element set to "one-to-one-sds".

q_36286.question: What is the requirement for the SLSS transmission initiation delay in the cell selection state?
q_36286.ground_truth: The SLSS transmission initiation delay shall be less than 0.84 seconds.

q_36287.question: What is the key difference between Solution #6 and Solution #7 in addressing KI#1 scenario 2?
q_36287.ground_truth: Solution #6 and Solution #7 can be paired and allow AF in VPLMN to provide H-PCF with information that can be used to build URSP rules with PLMN ID(s) in Location Criteria. However, Solution #7 includes the "Revaluation Suggested" indication while Solution #6 does not.

q_36288.question: What should the participating MCPTT function do if the user identified by the MCPTT ID is not affiliated to the group identified in the SIP REFER request?
q_36288.ground_truth: If the user identified by the MCPTT ID is not affiliated to the group identified in the SIP REFER request or in the <associated-group-id> element of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body, the participating MCPTT function shall perform the actions specified in clause 9.2.2.2.11 for implicit affiliation, unless the MCPTT user already has the maximum number of simultaneous affiliations. In that case, the participating MCPTT function shall reject the SIP REFER request with a SIP 486 (Busy Here) response with the warning text set to "102 too many simultaneous affiliations" in a Warning header field as specified in clause 4.4.

q_36289.question: What is the type and length of the relay reselection indication information element?
q_36289.ground_truth: The relay reselection indication information element is a type 1 information element with a length of 1 octet.

q_36290.question: What is the priority of UCI type when a UE determines not to expect more than one PUCCH from the first PUCCH and the second PUCCHs to start at a same slot and include a UCI type with the same priority?
q_36290.ground_truth: The UE does not expect more than one PUCCH from the first PUCCH and the second PUCCHs to start at a same slot and include a UCI type with the same priority.

q_36291.question: What is the rule for UE to measure one of the CSI-RS for RLM when it is in the same OFDM symbol as the SSB for BFD?
q_36291.ground_truth: UE is required to measure one of but not both CSI-RS for RLM and SSB when the CSI-RS for RLM is in the same OFDM symbol as the SSB for BFD or when UE detects beam failure. Longer measurement period for CSI-RS based RLM is expected, and no requirements are defined.

q_36292.question: In the "ReservedSubframePattern" SEQUENCE, what does the "iE-Extension" field represent?
q_36292.ground_truth: The "iE-Extension" field in the "ReservedSubframePattern" SEQUENCE is a ProtocolExtensionContainer that contains additional information related to the subframe reservation pattern.

q_36293.question: What should the UE do if it can determine a TAI that represents the best the tracking area of its geographical location?
q_36293.ground_truth: The UE should select that TAI.

q_36294.question: What should the UE do after sending a CSI report with non-zero CQI index for PSCell in step 6?
q_36294.ground_truth: The UE should stop sending CSI reports for PSCell no later than 20ms from the start of T5.

q_36295.question: What is the condition for the relative accuracy of RSRP inter-frequency measurement in 3GPP TS 36.133?
q_36295.ground_truth: The relative accuracy of RSRP inter-frequency measurement is valid under the condition that the cell specific reference signals are transmitted either from one, two, or four antenna ports, and the conditions defined in 3GPP TS 36.101 clause 7.3 for reference sensitivity are fulfilled.

q_36296.question: What event triggers the transmission of a notify message to the AF in step 5.2.2.3.8?
q_36296.ground_truth: A change in the NG-RAN and/or NW-TT timing synchronization status update.

q_36297.question: What is the procedure for the SMF when it receives the DL Periodicity, if available, from the UPF and the "traffParaData" attribute includes the "reqTrafficParas" attribute?
q_36297.ground_truth: The SMF requests the UPF to monitor and report the measured Traffic Parameter(s) using the N4 Session Modification procedure, and at reception of the measured Traffic Parameter(s) from the UPF, the SMF includes the measured N6 Jitter Information associated with the DL Periodicity in the TSCAI and forwards it to the NG-RAN as specified in 3GPP~TS~29.502.

q_36298.question: What entities are involved in stage 2 and stage 3 verification?
q_36298.ground_truth: In stage 2, the SMF compares the PDU session parameters with the parameters in RSD, and if either one of the parameters is not the same, the SMF determines that the UE doesn't use the URSP rules correctly. In stage 3, the AM-PCF receives the packet detection results from SMF via SM-PCF, performs stage 2 verification and stage 3 verification, and updates the re-evaluated URSP rules to UE if the UE doesn't use the URSP rules correctly.

q_36299.question: What should the UE do when it receives a MobilityFromEUTRACommand message with the purpose set to 'handover' and targetRAT-Type set to 'utra' or 'geran'?
q_36299.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T310, consider inter-RAT mobility as initiated towards the target RAT indicated by the targetRAT-Type, forward the nas-SecurityParamFromEUTRA to upper layers, and access the target cell in accordance with the specifications of the target RAT.

q_36300.question: What is the handover delay requirement for E-UTRAN FDD - GSM handover: unknown target cell test?
q_36300.ground_truth: The handover delay requirement for E-UTRAN FDD - GSM handover: unknown target cell test is less than 200 ms.

q_36301.question: What action can the target NG-RAN node take if the Receive Status of UL PDCP SDUs IE is included for at least one DRB in the SN STATUS TRANSFER message?
q_36301.ground_truth: The target NG-RAN node may use the Receive Status of UL PDCP SDUs IE in a Status Report message sent to the UE over the radio interface if the SN STATUS TRANSFER message includes it for at least one DRB.

q_36302.question: When should an MS perform a routing area updating procedure in Iu mode after an intersystem change from A/Gb mode?
q_36302.ground_truth: The MS shall perform a routing area updating procedure in Iu mode after an intersystem change from A/Gb mode if the MS is required to perform routing area updating for IMS voice termination as specified in annex~P.3.

q_36303.question: Where is the ACR scenario supported by the EAS available?
q_36303.ground_truth: The ACR scenario supported by the EAS is available in the EAS service continuity support of the EAS profile.

q_36304.question: When is the SGsAP-TMSI-REALLOCATION-COMPLETE message sent by the MME to the VLR?
q_36304.ground_truth: The SGsAP-TMSI-REALLOCATION-COMPLETE message is sent by the MME to the VLR to indicate that TMSI reallocation on the UE has been successfully completed.

q_36305.question: What network functions can provide the IRI-POI and CC-TF functions in IMS?
q_36305.ground_truth: The network functions that can provide the IRI-POI and CC-TF functions in IMS include S-CSCF, E-CSCF, P-CSCF, IBCF, MGCF, Conference AS/MRFC, Telephony AS, and PTC server.

q_36306.question: What is the definition of the enumeration StorageOutcome in 6.2.6.3.3?
q_36306.ground_truth: The enumeration StorageOutcome represents the outcome of cipher set data storage at the service consumer NF.

q_36307.question: What are the minimum requirements for RSRP measurement accuracy for all measured cells?
q_36307.ground_truth: The RSRP measurement accuracy for all measured cells shall be as specified in 3GPP TS 36.133 clauses 9.1.13.1 and 9.1.13.2.

q_36308.question: What is the role of the Media Session Handler in the 5GMSd UE functions?
q_36308.ground_truth: The Media Session Handler is responsible for media session handling, control, reporting and assistance that also include appropriate security mechanisms, e.g. authorization and authentication between the Media Player and the Media Session Handler.

q_36309.question: What type of NG-AP message capsulation and decapsulation is supported by the "any AMF" entity in the "any AMF" solution?
q_36309.ground_truth: The "any AMF" entity supports NG-AP message capsulation and decapsulation for UL and DL non UE associated NRPPa message in the "any AMF" solution.

q_36310.question: What procedure is performed by the UE when it receives the HO from E-UTRAN Command message containing a Handover Command message?
q_36310.ground_truth: The UE associates its bearer IDs to the respective RABs based on the relation with the NSAPI and suspends the uplink transmission of the user plane data.

q_36311.question: What action should the network take if a UE supporting MINT is no longer in a disaster condition location?
q_36311.ground_truth: The network should set the 5GMM cause value to #11 "PLMN not allowed" in the DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message.

q_36312.question: What is the primary use of the media feature tag "g-3gpp-registration-token" in 3GPP IP multimedia call control protocol based on Session Initiation Protocol (SIP) and Session Description Protocol (SDP)?
q_36312.ground_truth: The media feature tag "g-3gpp-registration-token" is primarily used to indicate support of using a token to identify the registration used for the current request or response among the set of registrations for the registered URI.

q_36313.question: What are the two types of Elementary Procedures (EPs) specified in LPPa, and what do they consist of?
q_36313.ground_truth: The two types of Elementary Procedures (EPs) specified in LPPa are Class 1 and Class 2. Class 1 EPs consist of an initiating message and a response message (success or failure), while Class 2 EPs consist of only an initiating message.

q_36314.question: Which types of E-UTRA TDD UE does the non-anchor carrier test apply to?
q_36314.ground_truth: The non-anchor carrier test applies to all types of E-UTRA TDD UE release 15 and forward of UE Category NB1 and NB2.

q_36315.question: When should the UE send the connEstFailReport in the UEInformationResponse message to the value of connEstFailReport in VarConnEstFailReport?
q_36315.ground_truth: The UE shall set the connEstFailReport in the UEInformationResponse message to the value of connEstFailReport in VarConnEstFailReport if connEstFailReportReq is set to true and the UE has connection establishment failure information in VarConnEstFailReport, and the RPLMN is equal to plmn-Identity stored in VarConnEstFailReport.

q_36316.question: What is the role of the 5GMSu Provisioning API in the 5GMS system?
q_36316.ground_truth: The 5GMSu Provisioning API allows the selection of Media Session Handling (M5u) and Uplink Streaming (M4u) options, including the option to publish media content to trusted 5GMSu ASs (Application Servers).

q_36317.question: What is the meaning of the constructions "might" and "might not" in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
q_36317.ground_truth: The construction "might" indicates a likelihood that something will happen as a result of action taken by some agency the behavior of which is outside the scope of the present document, while the construction "might not" indicates a likelihood that something will not happen as a result of action taken by some agency the behavior of which is outside the scope of the present document.

q_36318.question: What is the effect of E-UTRA-NR dual connectivity and NR SRS carrier-based switching on UTRA-FDD measurement requirements?
q_36318.ground_truth: The requirements in clause~8.17.5 apply when the UE is operating in E-UTRA-NR dual connectivity mode or when using NR SRS carrier-based switching and measurement gaps, as specified in section 8.17.6 and 8.17.7.

q_36319.question: What is the purpose of the information flow IWF floor request in interworking floor control?
q_36319.ground_truth: The information flow IWF floor request is used to request the floor for media transfer, from the IWF to the MCPTT floor control server and from the MCPTT floor control server to the IWF.

q_36320.question: What procedure is used to allocate a static IP address to the UE during access authentication and authorization process?
q_36320.ground_truth: A static IP address (i.e. a static IPv4 address and/or a static IPv6 prefix) can be received from HSS/AAA during access authentication and authorization procedure, then the non-3GPP access should forward the static IP address to the PDN GW.

q_36321.question: What is the role of the Access and Functions (AF) in the multi-modal communication solution?
q_36321.ground_truth: The AF is responsible for establishing the Quality of Service (QoS) for multi-modal data flows towards multiple User Equipments (UEs) in one AF request.

q_36322.question: What is the role of NAS SM signalling in the 5G core network?
q_36322.ground_truth: NAS SM signalling is used in the 5GC to establish, modify, and release PDU Sessions upon UE request, as well as to trigger a specific application in the UE upon request from an Application Server. It is exchanged over N1 between the UE and the SMF.

q_36323.question: What message does the DS-TT create to initiate the DS-TT-initiated port management capability procedure?
q_36323.ground_truth: The DS-TT creates a PORT MANAGEMENT CAPABILITY message to initiate the DS-TT-initiated port management capability procedure.

q_36324.question: What should the UE do when provided with a new EPS bearer identity, a new EPS QoS parameters, a new extended EPS QoS parameters, a new APN-AMBR or a new extended APN-AMBR in the Mapped EPS bearer context IE of the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message for a QoS flow?
q_36324.ground_truth: The UE should discard the corresponding association(s) and associate the new value(s) with the QoS flow.

q_36325.question: What should the SCC AS send to the PRACK request from the target access leg if a reliable SIP 1xx response or a SIP 2xx response is received on the remote leg and the response contains an SDP answer, but an SDP answer has not been received from the remote UE on the dialog of the SIP response yet?
q_36325.ground_truth: The SCC AS should send a SIP PRACK request on the remote leg with the SDP offer received in the SIP INVITE request due to STN-SR, or send a SIP ACK request on the remote leg and send a SIP UPDATE request on the remote leg with the SDP offer received in the SIP INVITE request due to STN-SR.

q_36326.question: What are the two basic scenarios for offline charging in 5G charging?
q_36326.ground_truth: The two basic scenarios for offline charging in 5G charging are Event based charging and Session based charging.

q_36327.question: What must a UE do upon the reception of a PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for group member discovery solicitation in 5G ProSe direct discovery?
q_36327.ground_truth: Upon the reception of a PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for group member discovery solicitation, the UE must unscramble and decrypt/decrypt the received message using the DUSK, DUCK, and UTC-based counter obtained during the monitoring operation. The UE must then verify the MIC field in the unscrambled PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for group member discovery solicitation.

q_36328.question: What is the role of PCF in the 5G system architecture for ProSe Services?
q_36328.ground_truth: PCF provides the Authorization policy and parameters for 5G ProSe Direct Discovery and Communication, and Authorization policy and parameters for 5G UE-to-Network Relay Discovery and Communication.

q_36329.question: What action does the SS take if it observes more than 2 non-consecutive DTX subframes during SCell deactivation in the intra-band FDD case?
q_36329.ground_truth: The SS counts a fail for the event "Deactivation" in the intra-band FDD case if it observes more than 2 non-consecutive DTX subframes.

q_36330.question: What should the UE do if the effective channel code rate is higher than 0.931 in an initial transmission?
q_36330.ground_truth: The UE may skip decoding a transport block in an initial transmission if the effective channel code rate is higher than 0.931.

q_36331.question: What are the benefits of using the mobility registration procedure for multicast MBS sessions?
q_36331.ground_truth: The mobility registration procedure for multicast MBS sessions brings benefits such as less signalling interactions, time, and radio resource consumption while joining or leaving multicast MBS sessions in RRC Idle or RRC Inactive states.

q_36332.question: Which slice does Rama's UE select based on his preference profile for a normal working day at the office?
q_36332.ground_truth: Rama's UE selects slice M for a normal working day at the office.

q_36333.question: What is the purpose of the "Paging restriction" information element?
q_36333.ground_truth: The Paging restriction information element is used to request the network to restrict paging.

q_36334.question: What should be sent as a request when receiving a SIP response in an early dialog on the terminating side?
q_36334.ground_truth: A SIP CANCEL request should be sent.

q_36335.question: What should the controlling MCVideo function include in the SIP NOTIFY request for an individual participant in the MCVideo session?
q_36335.ground_truth: A single <endpoint> element that includes an "entity" attribute for each participant, indicating the status of the MCVideo session for that participant.

q_36336.question: What should the system do if it receives a SIP RE-INVITE request with an unauthorized MCPTT emergency alert cancellation?
q_36336.ground_truth: The system should clear the cache of the MCPTT ID of the MCPTT user identified as having an outstanding MCPTT emergency group call, and generate SIP RE-INVITE requests to other affiliated and joined members of the MCPTT group as specified in clause 6.3.3.1.6.

q_36337.question: What are the conditions for the delay uncertainty introduced when inserting the measurement report in the TTI of the uplink DCCH?
q_36337.ground_truth: The delay uncertainty introduced when inserting the measurement report in the TTI of the uplink DCCH is equal to 2 x TTIDCCH where TTIDCCH is the duration of subframe or slot or subslot when the measurement report is transmitted on the PUSCH with subframe or slot or subslot duration.

q_36338.question: Which element can contain information about an NG-RAN cell in the XML schema?
q_36338.ground_truth: The "location" element contains information about an NG-RAN cell in the XML schema.

q_36339.question: What must the in-progress imminent peril state of the group be set to, in order to include a Resource-Priority header field for an MCData imminent peril group communication?
q_36339.ground_truth: The in-progress imminent peril state of the group must be set to a value of "true".

q_36340.question: What is the purpose of the Reserved Subframe Pattern IE in the context of E-UTRA DL and UL reference and control signals?
q_36340.ground_truth: The Reserved Subframe Pattern IE indicates the pattern of subframes in which the Protected E-UTRA Resource Indication and Data Traffic Indication do not hold.

q_36341.question: What should the transmission control interface in the transmission control server do when it receives an RTP media packet with payload from the associated transmission participant?
q_36341.ground_truth: The transmission control interface in the transmission control server should forward RTP media packets to the media distributor and remains in the 'U: pending Transmit Revoke' state.

q_36342.question: What is the RSSI measurement bandwidth assumed in defining the accuracy requirements in Section 9.1.18.5.2-1 and 9.1.18.5.3-1?
q_36342.ground_truth: The RSSI measurement bandwidth assumed in defining the accuracy requirements in Section 9.1.18.5.2-1 and 9.1.18.5.3-1 is 6 RB.

q_36343.question: What is the procedure for calculating the checksum used in the compression buffer?
q_36343.ground_truth: Each byte in the buffer is divided into two 4-bit numbers, and the 16 resulting 4-bit numbers are added together to obtain a sum. The checksum is then obtained by taking the one's complement of the right-most 4 bits (i.e. 4 least significant bits) of the sum.

q_36344.question: Which information elements are included in a Remote UE report message?
q_36344.ground_truth: The IE included in the message by the UE when sending a Remote UE report message are Remote UE Context Connected, Remote UE Context Disconnected, and ProSe Key Management Function Address.

q_36345.question: What is a service defined in IETF RFC 5626 that manages client-initiated connections in the Session Initiation Protocol (SIP) and allows requests to be delivered on existing connections established by the User Agent?

q_36346.question: When is a UE required to initiate an announce request procedure in a new PLMN?
q_36346.ground_truth: A UE is required to initiate an announce request procedure in a new PLMN when it selects a new PLMN while announcing a ProSe restricted code and intends to announce in the new PLMN and the UE is authorized for restricted 5G ProSe direct discovery model A announcing in the new PLMN.

q_36347.question: What is the frequency offset for the upper UE RF bandwidth edge or the upper sub-block edge, relative to the Frequency center, high?
q_36347.ground_truth: The frequency offset from FC,high to the upper UE RF Bandwidth edge, or from FC,block, high to the upper sub-block edge is defined as FOOB.

q_36348.question: What is the role of the NRF in SMF discovery and selection?
q_36348.ground_truth: The NRF provides NF profile(s) of SMF instance(s) and the SMF service area of SMF instance(s) to the AMF.

q_36349.question: What should an MS do when it is in an international area and has a satellite NG-RAN or satellite E-UTRAN?
q_36349.ground_truth: An MS supporting satellite NG-RAN or satellite E-UTRAN can attempt to obtain service on a higher priority PLMN as defined in the specification upon a transition in or out of international areas. It is up to the UE implementation to determine when it is transitioning in and out of international areas.

q_36350.question: What is the process when the UE with ongoing PDN connections moves from EPC to 5GC?
q_36350.ground_truth: The SMF+PGW-C triggers a request to decrease the number of the UE registration in NSACF, and the AMF triggers a request to increase the number of the UE registration in NSACF.

q_36351.question: What is the purpose of the EN-DC FR1 SCell activation and deactivation test?
q_36351.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to verify that the SCell activation and deactivation times are within the requirements, when the SCell in FR1 is known by the UE at the time of activation.

q_36352.question: What should the network do when it decides to restrict CE mode B for a UE?
q_36352.ground_truth: If the use of CE mode B is restricted for a UE, the UE shall not use CE mode B in the registered PLMN and in any PLMN which is in the list of equivalent PLMNs.

q_36353.question: Which command is used to send APDU commands to the UICC with a logical channel other than the default channel (channel "0")?
q_36353.ground_truth: The <sessionid> is used to send APDU commands to the UICC with a logical channel other than the default channel (channel "0"). It is an integer type identifier for the session used to send APDU commands to the UICC.

q_36354.question: What is the expected result when the N32-c TLS connection establishment fails using the cryptographic material of the intermediate IPX-system?
q_36354.ground_truth: The connection attempt should fail with the SEPP under test

q_36355.question: What is the phenomenon that allows signals to travel further than normal in TDD networks, potentially causing interference?
q_36355.ground_truth: The atmospheric ducting phenomenon, caused by lower densities at higher altitudes in the Earth's atmosphere, is the phenomenon that allows signals to travel further than normal in TDD networks.

q_36356.question: Under what conditions is an in-progress emergency group state cancel request considered to be an authorized request for a group?
q_36356.ground_truth: An in-progress emergency group state cancel request is considered to be an authorized request for a group if the "<allow-cancel-group-emergency>" element of the "ruleset" element of the MCVideo user profile document identified by the MCVideo ID of the calling MCVideo user is set to a value of "true". In all other cases, it is considered to be an unauthorized request for group emergency state cancellation.

q_36357.question: What is the role of the QFI (QoS Flow Identifier) in boundary between UL and DL?
q_36357.ground_truth: The QFI (QoS Flow Identifier) is used by the UPF to convey the classification of the User Plane traffic belonging to a QoS Flow through an N3 (and N9) User Plane marking.

q_36358.question: What is used to control the maximum data rate of Non-GBR QoS Flows?

q_36359.question: What information does the "omr-codecs" attribute encapsulate in OMR procedures?
q_36359.ground_truth: The "omr-codecs" attribute encapsulates codec related SDP information, including the transport format and list of media formats, that are applicable if a particular border gateway is bypassed.

q_36360.question: In case of BS capable of multi-band operation, what parameters should be declared for each supported operating band in addition to the declared capability set, maximum Base Station RF Bandwidth, total number of supported carriers, rated carrier output power, and rated total output power?
q_36360.ground_truth: The manufacturer should declare supported operating band combinations of the BS, supported operating band(s) of each antenna connector, supported capability set in each supported operating band in multi-band operation, support of multi-band transmitter and/or multi-band receiver, total number of supported carriers for the declared band combinations of the BS, maximum number of supported carriers per band in multi-band operation, total RF Bandwidth of transmitter and receiver for the declared band combinations of the BS, maximum Base Station RF Bandwidth of each supported operating band in multi-band operation, maximum Radio Bandwidth in transmit and receive direction for the declared band combinations of the BS, any other limitations under simultaneous operation in the declared band combinations of the BS, rated total output power as a sum over all supported operating bands in the declared band combinations of the BS, maximum supported power difference between any two carriers in any two different supported operating bands, the rated carrier output power in multi-band operation, and rated total output power of each supported operating band in multi-band operation.

q_36361.question: What is the purpose of the processMonitor attribute in the IOC?
q_36361.ground_truth: The processMonitor attribute represents the status of the implementation of network slice subnet related requirements by the NetworkSliceSubnetController, providing information for the MnS consumer to monitor progress and result.

q_36362.question: What is the AVP code for the Media-Component-Number AVP?

q_36363.question: What is the consequence of receiving an SMS (Service Request) in idle mode while being IMSI attached for non-EPS services?
q_36363.ground_truth: The UE sends an SERVICE REQUEST message followed by a CP-DATA containing an RP-DATA RPDU (SMS SUBMIT TPDU) encapsulated in an Uplink NAS transport message.

q_36364.question: Which ITU-T Recommendation is reserved for Digital Cellular in the command prefix for Mobile Termination (MT) functions and network services?

q_36365.question: What interfaces does the SCEF use to communicate with the MTC-IWF and serving MME/SGSN?
q_36365.ground_truth: The SCEF uses the Tsp interface to communicate with the MTC-IWF and the T6a/T6b interfaces to communicate with the serving MME/SGSN.

q_36366.question: What is the purpose of the ME Identity Check procedure?
q_36366.ground_truth: The ME Identity Check procedure is used to check the Mobile Equipment's identity, e.g. to check that it has not been stolen, or, to verify that it does not have faults.

q_36367.question: What information shall the UP function indicate to the CP function regarding the feature "Restoration of PFCP Sessions associated with one or more PGW-C/SMF FQ-CSID(s), Group Id(s) or PGW-C/SMF IP address(es)"?
q_36367.ground_truth: The UP function shall indicate so to the CP function by setting the RESPS feature bit in the UP Function Feature IE.

q_36368.question: What message is sent by the source NG-RAN to the MBSR during handover, and what information does it include?
q_36368.ground_truth: The source NG-RAN sends Handover Command to the MBSR with MBSR info. This message includes a transparent container with UE info (MBSR info).

q_36369.question: In the S1: start-stop state, what is the expected state of the UE with respect to an ongoing call?
q_36369.ground_truth: The UE is not part of an ongoing call in the S1: start-stop state.

q_36370.question: Which parameter in the Paging message is used to indicate the list of tracking areas?

q_36371.question: Which information element is mandatory in the "UERadioCapabilityIDMappingResponseIEs" sequence?
q_36371.ground_truth: The "ID id-UERadioCapabilityID" and "ID id-UERadioCapability" information elements are mandatory in the "UERadioCapabilityIDMappingResponseIEs" sequence.

q_36372.question: What must the ME do if the UICC responds with '02' in the MO Short Message control result?
q_36372.ground_truth: The ME must send a short message using the data supplied by the UICC.

q_36373.question: What information is included in the measResultListEUTRA field of the handover failure report, if measured for one or more EUTRA frequencies?
q_36373.ground_truth: The measResultListEUTRA field includes detailed measurement results for EUTRA frequencies.

q_36374.question: What feature-capability indicator should be included in the Feature-Caps header field of the REGISTER request to support IMS Centralized Services (ICS) at the roaming II-NNI?

q_36375.question: What should SMF do if it wants to trigger EAS rediscovery for a UE collection?
q_36375.ground_truth: SMF removes the common EAS/DNAI from AF traffic influence request information, UDR notifies PCF, and then PCF updates SMF with an updated PCC rule removing the common EAS/DNAI, and triggers other SMF for EAS rediscovery.

q_36376.question: What is the default behavior upon receiving a floor request during an off-network emergency call in progress?
q_36376.ground_truth: If an emergency call is in progress and a floor request is received, the current talker will be pre-empted, and the floor request will be granted. If the value of a specific leaf node indicates to queue the request, the floor request will be queued, and if not, the request will be denied.

q_36377.question: What should be done for each DRB that is not established in the CounterCheck message?
q_36377.ground_truth: For each DRB that is not established in the CounterCheck message, the UE should include the DRB in the drb-CountInfoList in the CounterCheckResponse message, and set the drb-Identity, the count-Uplink, and the count-Downlink with the most significant bits set identical to the corresponding values in the drb-CountMSB-InfoList and the least significant bits set to zero.

q_36378.question: In the context of 3GPP TS 33.501, what is the purpose of the consumer's IPX (cIPX) and producer's IPX (pIPX) in a roaming scenario?
q_36378.ground_truth: The cIPX and pIPX are the IP exchange services provided by the consumer's and producer's IPX providers, respectively.

q_36379.question: What action does the floor control server take when it receives a valid floor request message from a permitted floor participant during the 'G: Floor Idle' state?
q_36379.ground_truth: The floor control server grants permission if the conditions are met, stores the SSRC associated with the granted user, stops timer T4 (Inactivity), and enters the 'G: Floor Taken' state.

q_36380.question: What is the purpose of time duration T1 in the test environment?
q_36380.ground_truth: The purpose of time duration T1 is to start the test and ensure the UE is in State 2A-NB with CP CIoT Optimisation before changing the SNR.

q_36381.question: What is the method used for obtaining the measurement of "Packet Success Rate" in the uplink?
q_36381.ground_truth: The measurement of "Packet Success Rate" in the uplink is obtained by counting the number of successfully received UL PDCP sequence numbers, representing packets that are successfully delivered to higher layers, of a data radio bearer, divided by Total number of UL PDCP sequence numbers of a bearer, starting from the sequence number of the first packet delivered by UE PDCP to gNB until the sequence number of the last packet.

q_36382.question: In Step 3, how are the MCS values determined for each CC?
q_36382.ground_truth: In Step 3, the MCS values are determined for each CC in the chosen CA bandwidth combination based on the test parameters and the indicated UE capabilities.

q_36383.question: What should the UE do if the timer T3396 indicates zero upon receipt of a BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REJECT message with ESM cause #26 "insufficient resources"?
q_36383.ground_truth: If the timer T3396 indicates zero, the UE may send another PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST, BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST or BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST message for the same APN. If the UE did not provide an APN for the establishment of the PDN connection and the request type was different from "emergency" and from "handover of emergency bearer services", the UE shall stop timer T3396 associated with no APN, if running, and may send another PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message without an APN, or another BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST or BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST message for a non-emergency PDN connection established without an APN provided by the UE.

q_36384.question: Under what conditions is an MCVideo emergency alert request considered to be an authorized request?
q_36384.ground_truth: An MCVideo emergency alert request is considered to be an authorized request if the "allow-activate-emergency-alert" element of the "actions" element of a "rule" element of the "ruleset" element of the MCVideo user profile document is set to "true", and if the "entry-info" attribute of the "<EmergencyAlert>" element is set to "DedicatedGroup" and the "<uri-entry>" element of the "<entry>" element contains the MCVideo group identity targeted by the calling MCVideo user, or if the "entry-info" attribute is set to "UseCurrentlySelectedGroup" and the "<MCVideo-allow-emergency-alert>" element of the "actions" element of a "rule" element of the "list-service" element of the group document identified by the MCVideo group identity is set to "true".

q_36385.question: What should the MCData client do when the payload is for user consumption?
q_36385.ground_truth: The MCData client should determine that the payload is for user consumption and automatically download the file. If a Metadata IE is included, the contents should be delivered to the user.

q_36386.question: What is the result of an unsuccessful submitMetricsReport Request from the target UE in the 5GMS AF?
q_36386.ground_truth: The 5GMS AF returns a submitMetricsReport Response with 400 Bad Request or 415 Unsupported Media Type status code.

q_36387.question: What are the equivalent NF Service Instances if they share the same MCC, MNC, NID, ServiceName, and Set ID?
q_36387.ground_truth: NF Service Instances are equivalent if they share the same MCC, MNC, NID (for SNPN), ServiceName and Set ID.

q_36388.question: During which time duration the SS shall detect uplink power and increase the number of successful tests in the test described in 6.5.1.3.4.2?
q_36388.ground_truth: From time point A to time point F (D1 second after the start of time duration T5)

q_36389.question: What is the input condition specified at the antenna connector of the Home BS for determining the output power adjustments in clause 6.2.4 and 6.2.5?
q_36389.ground_truth: CRS Es, measured in dBm, and Ioh, measured in dBm.

q_36390.question: What should the controlling MCVideo function include in the SIP 403 response for an unauthorized request for an MCVideo emergency call?
q_36390.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function should include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body with the <mcvideoinfo> element containing the <mcvideo-Params> element, with the <emergency-ind> element set to "false" and the <alert-ind> element set to "false".

q_36391.question: What is the role of the NFp and NFc in Solution #10?
q_36391.ground_truth: The NFp represents the producer of the machine learning (ML) model, while the NFc represents the consumer of the ML model in Solution #10.

q_36392.question: What is the role of the BM-SC in a GGSN initiated MBMS broadcast session termination?
q_36392.ground_truth: The BM-SC removes the Diameter session and confirms the operation by sending an STA message to the GGSN.

q_36393.question: In the context of i to vii, under what conditions should the MS select a PLMN offering access to RLOS?
q_36393.ground_truth: The MS shall select a PLMN offering access to RLOS if the MS supports access to RLOS, the UICC is present and the MCC part of the IMSI in the USIM is present in the RLOS allowed MCC list, and one or more PLMNs offering access to RLOS have been found but registration cannot be achieved on any PLMN.

q_36394.question: What information does AF provide during MBS session creation procedures for MB-SMF?
q_36394.ground_truth: AF provides the MBS session priority and information on whether the transmission for inactive reception is allowed for specific multicast MBS service(s) during MBS session creation procedures.

q_36395.question: What action does the SCEF take if the MME/SGSN is aware that the UE is temporarily unreachable and cannot deliver the non-IP data?
q_36395.ground_truth: The MME/SGSN may send a NIDD Submit Response towards the SCEF indicating that the non-IP data was not delivered and the UE is temporarily not reachable. The MME/SGSN sets the Not Reachable for NIDD flag and stores the SCEF address.

q_36396.question: What keyword is used in the OpenAPI specification to describe a list of non-exclusive alternatives in the `exNestedArray` attribute?

q_36397.question: What is the purpose of the A-KID in the AKMA architecture?
q_36397.ground_truth: The A-KID is used to identify the AKMA Anchor Function serving the User Equipment (UE) in the AKMA architecture.

q_36398.question: What is the level of spatial isolation assumed for the LA SBFD in the Ericsson study?

q_36399.question: What does the fixed part of an AMD PDU header consist of?
q_36399.ground_truth: The fixed part of an AMD PDU header consists of the fields D/C, RF, P, FI, E, and SN.

q_36400.question: What is the definition and applicability of OTA transmitter intermodulation?
q_36400.ground_truth: OTA transmitter intermodulation is a measure of the capability of the transmitter unit to inhibit the generation of signals in its non-linear elements caused by the presence of the wanted signal and an interfering signal. This requirement applies during the transmitter ON period and the transmitter transient period at each RIB supporting transmission in the operating band.

q_36401.question: When should the transmission control interface towards the MCVideo client in the transmission control server enter the state 'U: permitted to receive'?
q_36401.ground_truth: The transmission control interface shall enter the state 'U: permitted to receive' if the associated transmission participant has been given permission to receive media.

q_36402.question: What should the MRFC do when sending any request or response related to a dialog and the message contains a "logme" header field parameter in the SIP Session-ID header field?
q_36402.ground_truth: The MRFC should log the message if required by local policy.

q_36403.question: In the context of interruption time for handover, what is the minimum Tsearch if signal quality is sufficient for successful cell detection on the first attempt?
q_36403.ground_truth: If signal quality is sufficient for successful cell detection on the first attempt, Tsearch is 80 ms.

q_36404.question: What is the purpose of the Subsequent Volume Quota IE type in the PFCP protocol?
q_36404.ground_truth: The Subsequent Volume Quota IE type in the PFCP protocol contains the volume quota to be monitored by the UP function after the Monitoring Time.

q_36405.question: What should the UE do if the PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message is received in a PLMN, and the timer T3585 is running for all the PLMNs and that access type?
q_36405.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T3585 for all the PLMNs and that access type.

q_36406.question: What is the role of the UCMF with regards to UE Radio Capability IDs?
q_36406.ground_truth: The UCMF is used for storage of dictionary entries corresponding to either PLMN-assigned or UE manufacturer-assigned UE Radio Capability IDs. The UCMF assigns the PLMN-assigned UE Radio Capability ID values and associates them with the IMEI/TAC of the UE model(s) they are related to.

q_36407.question: What action is taken if the SS-RSRQ value of Cell 3 is outside the limits or if the UE fails to report the measurement value for Cell 3?
q_36407.ground_truth: The number of failed iterations is increased by one.

q_36408.question: What should the UE do upon receipt of a BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REJECT message with ESM cause #41, #42, or #44?
q_36408.ground_truth: Upon receipt of a BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REJECT message with ESM cause #41, #42, or #44, the UE shall reject the allocation request, enter the state PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE, and release the traffic flow aggregate description associated with the PTI value.

q_36409.question: Which AVP (Attribute-Value Pair) is used to indicate the type of server update being performed in a Server-Assignment-Request operation?
q_36409.ground_truth: The Server-Assignment-Type AVP is used to indicate the type of server update in a Server-Assignment-Request operation.

q_36410.question: How can a consumer determine the set of ML entities to achieve a certain outcome?
q_36410.ground_truth: The producer should be able to inform the consumer of the set of ML entities that together achieve the consumer's automation needs.

q_36411.question: What should the ME do upon receiving an OPEN CHANNEL command related to (I-)WLAN bearer, if immediate (I-)WLAN service activation is requested and the ME is unable to activate the I-WLAN service with the network using the exact parameters provided by the UICC?
q_36411.ground_truth: The ME informs the UICC using TERMINAL RESPONSE (Network currently unable to process command) and aborts the operation.

q_36412.question: In the Random Access procedure, what is the default backoff parameter value for NB-IoT UEs when no Backoff Indicator subheader is present?
q_36412.ground_truth: The default backoff parameter value for NB-IoT UEs is 0 ms.

q_36413.question: What is the main desire of verticals regarding network slices in the 5G system?
q_36413.ground_truth: Verticals desire self-management of network slices, including the ability to create, modify, and delete them.

q_36414.question: What is the maximum number of times the "anyExt" can occur in the "ProSeApplicationCodeACE-info" complex type?
q_36414.ground_truth: The "anyExt" can occur a maximum of 1 time in the "ProSeApplicationCodeACE-info" complex type.

q_36415.question: What is the condition for UE A3 and UE A4 to switch fromSlice M to Slice N?
q_36415.ground_truth: UE A3 switches to Slice N when it prefers Slice N to Slice M and the transition from F2 to F1 occurs before crossing location GC. UE A4 switches to Slice N when it moves to Frequency F2 and the transition from F2 to F1 occurs before crossing location GC to minimize impact on the ongoing services over Slice M.

q_36416.question: What triggers the start of time period T3 in the E-UTRAN FDD - HRPD handover test?
q_36416.ground_truth: The start of time period T3 is triggered by the last TTI containing the RRC message implying handover in the E-UTRAN FDD - HRPD handover test.

q_36417.question: What is the role of the NRF (network repository function) in the 5G network?
q_36417.ground_truth: The NRF is responsible for discovering the hAAnF by querying the vAAnF. The vAAnF uses the A-KID (key identifier) and home network information contained in the AKMA key to discover the hAAnF.

q_36418.question: What is the definition of the relative accuracy of SS-SINR in the inter-frequency case?
q_36418.ground_truth: The relative accuracy of SS-SINR in the inter-frequency case is defined as the SS-SINR measured from one cell on a frequency compared to the SS-SINR measured from another cell on a different frequency, with at least one of the two frequencies being under CCA.

q_36419.question: When is a UE required to initiate the tracking area updating procedure in EMM-IDLE mode?
q_36419.ground_truth: A UE initiating the tracking area updating procedure in EMM-IDLE mode may request the network to re-establish the radio and S1 bearers for all active EPS bearer contexts if control plane CIoT EPS optimization is not used. If control plane CIoT EPS optimization is used, the UE may request re-establishment of radio and S1 bearers for all active EPS bearer contexts associated with PDN connections established without control plane only indication.

q_36420.question: What is the role of the SMF in the 5GC?
q_36420.ground_truth: The SMF in the 5GC offers services to NF service consumers via the Nsmf service based interface, providing functionalities such as session management, handling of policy and charging rules, and interacting with the UPF for creating, modifying and releasing user plane sessions.

q_36421.question: What should the SMF/CUC do if the procedure is abnormally completed due to the non-receipt of a PFCP Session Establishment Response or NGAP PDU Session Resource Setup Response message?
q_36421.ground_truth: The SMF/CUC should retransmit the request using reliable delivery procedures, and on the expiry of the Tget timer, it should abort the procedure and log error information.

q_36422.question: What should the UE report out of range after receiving the SCell activation command and until the SCell activation completion at UE?
q_36422.ground_truth: After receiving the SCell activation command and until the SCell activation completion at UE, the UE shall report out of range if the UE has available uplink resources to report CQI for the SCell.

q_36423.question: What is the maximum number of DL band combinations in Release 17?

q_36424.question: What action does the en-gNB take if at least one of the requested modifications is admitted after receiving the SGNB MODIFICATION REQUEST message?
q_36424.ground_truth: The en-gNB shall modify the related part of the UE context accordingly and send the SGNB MODIFICATION REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message back to the MeNB.

q_36425.question: What is the maximum TIU allowed for NR to E-UTRAN handover?

q_36426.question: In the MSGin5G registration response to Constrained UE schema, what is the value of "msgType" property should be?

q_36427.question: What is the purpose of the CAPIF and MEC service API management?
q_36427.ground_truth: CAPIF is the Common API Framework for northbound APIs, used in 3GPP for the northbound API exposure of edge service APIs. MEC platforms support CAPIF in the form of MEC service management API. The CAPIF APIs are similar to the MEC service management APIs and are used for service API management.

q_36428.question: What message transfer is used to forward the LPPa PDU from the MME to the E-SMLC?

q_36429.question: What is the purpose of IMS-ALG bypassing its local GW during session establishment?
q_36429.ground_truth: The purpose is to establish a user plane connection without GW insertion for the media in the outgoing IP realm.

q_36430.question: What should the network do when it receives an ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE message which includes an unassigned or reserved PTI value?
q_36430.ground_truth: The network should ignore the message if the PTI is an unassigned or reserved value. If the PTI is an assigned value that does not match the PTI in use for any ongoing transaction related procedure, the network should respond with an ESM STATUS message including ESM cause #81 "invalid PTI value".

q_36431.question: What is the main function of the cognitive immersive service in 6G?
q_36431.ground_truth: The main function of the cognitive immersive service in 6G is to process media and other interactions to create semantical perception.

q_36432.question: What entities are affected by the implementation of localized service related de-registration information?
q_36432.ground_truth: The UE, AMF, and UDM are affected by the implementation of localized service related de-registration information.

q_36433.question: What is the effect of the SMF updating the N4 rules during non-3GPP access path switching?
q_36433.ground_truth: The SMF updates the N4 rules by replacing the AN Tunnel Info of the old non-3GPP AN with that of the new non-3GPP AN, instructing the UPF to switch traffic from the old non-3GPP access path to the new non-3GPP access path.

q_36434.question: What information is included in a mapping for non-F1 traffic in the IAB-donor-CU?
q_36434.ground_truth: For non-F1 traffic, the mapping includes the appropriate BH RLC channel and next-hop BAP address and/or BAP routing ID.

q_36435.question: What should a participating MCPTT function do if it does not receive a 200 OK message from a specific MCPTT client?
q_36435.ground_truth: If a participating MCPTT function does not receive a 200 OK message from a specific MCPTT client, it should use unicast signalling for floor control towards that MCPTT client for the groups for which the MuSiK was intended.

q_36436.question: How many wideband CQI reports should be gathered before calculating the median wideband CQI-value?
q_36436.ground_truth: 6000 wideband CQI reports should be gathered before calculating the median wideband CQI-value.

q_36437.question: What happens during T3 in the test procedure?
q_36437.ground_truth: During T3, the UE shall send periodic CSI reports in PCell. After receiving at least one such report, the test system shall send an RRC message instructing the UE to release the PCell, and the UE shall stop transmitting uplink signal in Cell 2 no later than time point C (D1 second after the start of the time duration T3).

q_36438.question: What is the length of the Power Headroom (PH) field in the Extended Power Headroom MAC control element?
q_36438.ground_truth: The length of the Power Headroom (PH) field is 6 bits.

q_36439.question: When should a UE initiate deregistration from the ON-SNPN after remote provisioning of SO-SNPN credentials is completed?
q_36439.ground_truth: Based on ON-SNPN policies, the AMF may start an implementation-specific timer once the UE has registered to the ON-SNPN for the purpose of onboarding. Expiry of this timer triggers the AMF to deregister the onboarding registered UE from the ON-SNPN.

q_36440.question: What action should a UE take when it receives a WLCP BEARER MODIFY REQUEST message with semantic errors in packet filters?
q_36440.ground_truth: If the UE detects semantic errors in packet filters, such as conflicting packet filter components, the UE shall reject the request with cause #44 "semantic errors in packet filter(s)".

q_36441.question: What are the two means supported for sending a single immediate message to multiple recipients in IMS (IP Multimedia Subsystem)?
q_36441.ground_truth: A PSI (Public Service Identities) identifying a new group is created in the appropriate Application Server and added to this group, or the user can send an immediate message by indicating the individual addresses (Public User Identities) of the intended recipients as part of the immediate message.

q_36442.question: What are the two options available for QoS support in 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay UE's serving PLMN?
q_36442.ground_truth: The two options are a static QoS mapping mechanism and a dynamic QoS signalling based mechanism.

q_36443.question: Under what conditions does the UE consider access to the cell as barred when the establishmentCause is set to mo-ExceptionData?
q_36443.ground_truth: The UE considers access to the cell as barred if the UE has at least one valid Access Class and the corresponding bit in the ab-BarringForSpecialAC is set to one.

q_36444.question: What should the MAG function of the Trusted Non-3GPP IP Access or ePDG set in the Proxy Binding Update message to indicate handoff between two different interfaces of the UE in the handover of PDN connections to non-3GPP access?
q_36444.ground_truth: The MAG should set the Handover Indicator to indicate handoff between two different interfaces of the UE in the Proxy Binding Update message used in the handover of PDN connections to non-3GPP access.

q_36445.question: What message is sent by the new NG-RAN node to the old NG-RAN node for transferring data forwarding information to the old NG-RAN node during a handover?
q_36445.ground_truth: The XN-U ADDRESS INDICATION message is sent by the new NG-RAN node to the old NG-RAN node for transferring data forwarding information to the old NG-RAN node during a handover.

q_36446.question: What is the step 3 in the procedure of Discover T-EAS used by the CAS in TS 23.558 clause 8.8.3.2?
q_36446.ground_truth: The CES has to be part of the EEL to facilitate the discovery of the T-EAS by interacting with the ECS.

q_36447.question: When should the UE consider access to the cell as not barred even if the establishmentCause received from higher layers is set to mo-ExceptionData and ab-BarringForExceptionData is set to FALSE in the ab-Common?
q_36447.ground_truth: If the UE has one or more Access Classes, as stored on the USIM, with a value in the range of 11..15, which is valid for the UE to use, and for at least one of these valid Access Classes for the UE, the corresponding bit in the ab-BarringForSpecialAC contained in ab-Common is set to zero, the UE should consider access to the cell as not barred.

q_36448.question: What actions does the tester verify when sending GTP-U messages different from EchoRequest?
q_36448.ground_truth: The tester verifies that the messages are correctly received by the network product, and that the messages are discarded and that any response is sent back by the network product.

q_36449.question: What is the maximum allowed interruption for a UE with dormantSCellState capability when performing CQI measurements of dormant SCells?
q_36449.ground_truth: The maximum allowed interruption for a UE with dormantSCellState capability when performing CQI measurements of dormant SCells is 2 subframes if the PCell or activated SCell is in the same band as the dormant SCell, and 5 subframes otherwise.

q_36450.question: What should the UE do if a cell reselection occurs while T300, T302, T303, T305, T306, or T308 are running and the UE is connected to EPC?
q_36450.ground_truth: The UE stops timer T302, T303, T305, T306, and T308, whichever ones were running, and performs the actions as specified in 5.3.3.7.

q_36451.question: What is the initial transmission power level before any adjustments in the test procedure?
q_36451.ground_truth: The initial transmission power level before any adjustments in the test procedure is the target power level plus the uplink power control window size.

q_36452.question: What should the SMF do when the TSC Assistance container of an existing PCC rule is changed?
q_36452.ground_truth: The binding of this PCC rule should not be re-evaluated.

q_36453.question: In what two situations can the UE request the use of PSM during an attach or tracking area updating procedure?
q_36453.ground_truth: The UE can request the use of PSM during an attach or tracking area updating procedure if it is not performing an attach for emergency bearer services or a tracking area updating procedure for initiating a PDN connection for emergency bearer services, and if the network has provided the T3324 value IE with a value different from "deactivated" during the last attach or tracking area updating procedure.

q_36454.question: What should a UE do for at least one TB of the multiple TB in HARQ-ACK transmission if the HARQ-ACK information is disabled?
q_36454.ground_truth: The UE should generate an ACK for HARQ-ACK corresponding to the transport block associated with the HARQ process with disabled HARQ-ACK information.

q_36455.question: What event triggers the transmission of the ASR command in the Gi/Sgi interface?
q_36455.ground_truth: The ASR command is sent by the Diameter server to the GGSN/P-GW to request termination of a PDP Context or an IP-CAN session.

q_36456.question: What features does the 3GP-DASH Release 11 multiview stereoscopic 3D video profile include?
q_36456.ground_truth: The 3GP-DASH Release 11 multiview stereoscopic 3D video profile includes all features defined in clauses 7.3.7, 8, 9, and 10.

q_36457.question: What should a mobile station that does not support eMLPP do if it receives a CALL PROCEEDING message containing a priority level?
q_36457.ground_truth: The mobile station should ignore this information if provided in a CALL PROCEEDING message.

q_36458.question: What are the main services that RRC expects from lower layers in an NR network?
q_36458.ground_truth: The main services that RRC expects from lower layers in an NR network are integrity protection, ciphering, and loss-less in-sequence delivery of information without duplication, as well as broadcast of system information including NAS common information.

q_36459.question: What action should the UE take upon T310 expiry or other conditions leading to the detection of radio link failure?
q_36459.ground_truth: The UE should consider radio link failure to be detected, store radio link failure information in the VarRLF-Report, and set the plmn-IdentityList to include the RPLMN. If detailed location information is available, the locationCoordinates and horizontalVelocity should be included in the locationInfo field.

q_36460.question: What information should the UE try to acquire if the cell indicated by the cellForWhichToReportCGI is a UTRAN cell?
q_36460.ground_truth: The UE should try to acquire the LAC, the RAC and the list of additional PLMN Identities, if multiple PLMN identities are broadcast in the concerned cell; and try to acquire the CSG identity, if the CSG identity is broadcast in the concerned cell.

q_36461.question: What is the purpose of sending an EAP Request/Identity message to the UE during secondary authentication?
q_36461.ground_truth: The purpose of sending an EAP Request/Identity message to the UE during secondary authentication is to authenticate and authorize the UE.

q_36462.question: What value should the VAE-S set for the <result> child element in the HTTP 200 (OK) response message, if the service discovery is successful?

q_36463.question: In 6.8.4.2, what are the procedures required for conducting the test?
q_36463.ground_truth: The procedures required for conducting the test include selecting a CLTA, placing the CLTA, preparing test antenna(s), connecting test antenna and CLTA to the measurement equipment, rotating IAB and CLTA during the OTA emission measurements, and performing TRP measurement using the procedure described in annex I.

q_36464.question: What is the role of the UE-to-UE Relay in forwarding messages from UE3 to UE1?
q_36464.ground_truth: The UE-to-UE Relay forwards messages from UE3 to UE1 by including relay-specific info identifying UE3 in the adaptation header and creating the security context for the extended link.

q_36465.question: What is the purpose of the "Change to Report" flag in the message from the old MME to the new SGSN?
q_36465.ground_truth: The "Change to Report" flag in the message from the old MME to the new SGSN indicates if there was a deferred reporting of change of UE Time Zone, Serving Network, or both towards Serving GW / PDN GW.

q_36466.question: What is the role of the NG interface in the NG-RAN architecture?
q_36466.ground_truth: The NG interface is a logical interface in the NG-RAN architecture that supports the exchange of signalling information between the NG-RAN and 5GC. It separates the Radio Network Layer and Transport Network Layer and is future-proof to support new services and functions.

q_36467.question: How does the UE set the measResultNeighCells in TS 36.331?
q_36467.ground_truth: The UE sets the measResultNeighCells to include the best neighboring cells up to maxReportCells, in accordance with the conditions specified in steps 3 and 4.

q_36468.question: What should the ME (Mobile Equipment) do if the alpha identifier is not provided by the UICC when sending a USSD request message?
q_36468.ground_truth: The ME may give information to the user concerning what is happening.

q_36469.question: What is the role of the 5GMSd AF in the media session handling?
q_36469.ground_truth: The 5GMSd AF is responsible for acquiring the whole Service Access Information, interacting with the PCF or NEF service for policy authorization, and enforcing the applied policy to the media session.

q_36470.question: In which scenarios is P-MPRc applied to allow for electromagnetic energy absorption requirements compliance?
q_36470.ground_truth: P-MPRc is applied to ensure compliance with applicable electromagnetic energy absorption requirements and address unwanted emissions/self-defense for multiple RATs, as well as in case proximity detection is used for such absorption requirements with lower maximum output power for UE conducted conformance testing.

q_36471.question: What is the interruption time for the combination of make-before-break and RACH-less handover?
q_36471.ground_truth: The interruption time for the combination of make-before-break and RACH-less handover is Tinterrupt = 5 + TUL_grant ms.

q_36472.question: Which 3GPP specification defines the functionality for IP transport and IP fragmentation at a RAN node on the Iu interface or S12?
