q_36958.ground_truth: If DNS is used to obtain the IP address of the P-CSCF, the name-address resolution mechanism is allowed to take the load information of the P-CSCFs into consideration when deciding the address of the P-CSCF for the UE.

q_36959.question: When should the initiating UE, which is acting as 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-network relay UE, initiate the 5G ProSe direct link release procedure based on the status of the PDU session and the LADN PDU session?
q_36959.ground_truth: If the initiating UE is a 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-network relay UE, the UE should initiate the 5G ProSe direct link release procedure in the following scenarios: (a) the PDU session established for relaying the traffic of the target UE is released by the initiating UE or the network, (b) a new PDU session is established after receiving the 5GSM cause value #39 "reactivation requested", or (c) the UE is outside the LADN service area or receives the 5GSM cause value #46 "out of LADN service area" in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message and there is at least one 5G ProSe layer-3 remote UE which is served on the PDU session.

q_36960.question: What does the Source eNB to target eNB Transparent Container IE contain in inter-system handovers to E-UTRAN?
q_36960.ground_truth: The Source eNB to target eNB Transparent Container IE is produced by the source eNB and transmitted to the target eNB in inter-system handovers to E-UTRAN, to pass radio related information between the source and the target.

q_36961.question: What should the controlling MCVideo function do after validating the SIP re-INVITE request and sending the SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP re-INVITE request?
q_36961.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function should set the in-progress imminent peril state of the group to "false", cache the information that this MCVideo user no longer has an outstanding MCVideo imminent peril group call, and generate SIP re-INVITE requests to the other affiliated and joined members of the MCVideo group.

q_36962.question: Under what conditions should a UE set the registration attempt counter to 5 when it receives a REGISTRATION REJECT message, other 5GMM cause values than those treated in subclause 5.5.1.2.5, and cases of 5GMM cause values #10, #11, #15, #22, #31, #72, #73, #74, #75, #76, #77 and #78?
q_36962.ground_truth: If the registration request is neither an initial registration request for emergency services nor an initial registration request for initiating a PDU session for emergency services with request type set to "existing emergency PDU session", the UE should set the registration attempt counter to 5 upon reception of the listed causes.

q_36963.question: What procedure can be utilized for a group of target UEs when collecting data using LCS in procedure 6.2.12.2?
q_36963.ground_truth: The bulk operation of LCS Service Request Targeting to Multiple UEs as specified in clause~6.8 of TS~23.273 can be utilized.

q_36964.question: What is the role of the MCPTT-1 reference point between the MCPTT client and server?
q_36964.ground_truth: The MCPTT-1 reference point is used for MCPTT application signalling for establishing a session in support of MCPTT, and uses the SIP-1 and SIP-2 reference points for transport and routing of SIP signalling.

q_36965.question: What is the role of the Offline Charging System (OFCS) in the common charging architecture?
q_36965.ground_truth: The OFCS is a grouping of charging functions used for offline charging. It collects and processes charging events from one or more CTFs, and it generates CDRs for subsequent offline downstream billing processes.

q_36966.question: What is the threat name for a situation where a default password is provided on a system and is not modified in time, allowing an attacker to access sensitive information?

q_36967.question: What should the uplink transmission timing of a UE be relative to the downlink timing in order to meet the Te requirement for an initial transmission?
q_36967.ground_truth: The UE shall meet the Te requirement for an initial transmission provided that at least one SSB is available at the UE during the last 160 ms. The reference point for the UE initial transmit timing control requirement shall be the downlink timing of the reference cell minus the downlink timing, which is defined as the time when the first detected path (in time) of the corresponding downlink frame is received from the reference cell.

q_36968.question: What action is taken by the MME/SGSN or the SCEF when the monitoring duration for a continuous monitoring request expires and the UE is part of multiple groups requiring the same monitoring indication?
q_36968.ground_truth: The MME/SGSN or the SCEF can include multiple SCEF Reference IDs in the monitoring indication message, so that the SCEF can determine what groups the report pertains to.

q_36969.question: What must the controlling MCPTT function do if the in-progress emergency state of the group is set to false and the in-progress imminent peril state of the group is set to true?
q_36969.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function shall include a Resource-Priority header field populated with the values for an MCPTT imminent peril group call as specified in clause~6.3.3.1.19, and include in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body the <imminentperil-ind> element set to a value of "true".

q_36970.question: What security protocol can be used between the UPF and the Intranet if one is specifically needed?
q_36970.ground_truth: If a specific security protocol is needed between the UPF and the Intranet, then IPsec can be used. IPsec authentication header or security header can be used for user data authentication and for the confidentiality of user data.

q_36971.question: What is the coding format for the "list of PLMN(s) to be used in disaster condition" provided by the HPLMN?
q_36971.ground_truth: The coding for the PLMN involves using the Mobile Country Code (MCC) followed by the Mobile Network Code (MNC) as specified in 3GPP TS 24.501.

q_36972.question: After the RRC connection release in step 9, what is the possible action taken by the SS to ensure the UE is in State 3A RF?
q_36972.ground_truth: The SS may transmit in Cell 1 a Paging message with ue-Identity for the UE or switch off and on the UE to ensure it's in State 3A RF.

q_36973.question: What is required for the prequisites for encryption and integrity protection of an MCData payload?
q_36973.ground_truth: The prequisites for encryption and integrity protection of an MCData payload is that the MC client(s) or MC server(s) have a shared MCData Payload Protection Key (DPPK) and a shared key identifier (DPPK-ID).

q_36974.question: What is the role of the Law Enforcement Agency (LEA) in Lawful Interception (LI) architecture?
q_36974.ground_truth: The Law Enforcement Agency (LEA) is responsible for submitting the warrant to the Communications Service Provider (CSP) in Lawful Interception (LI) architecture.

q_36975.question: What are the short message handling capabilities of the USIM when the service is activated?
q_36975.ground_truth: When this service is activated, all MO short messages are first passed to the USIM application before the ME sends the short message.

q_36976.question: What bitrates are sufficient to address high-quality 6DOF VR services based on today's equipment and the one available over the next 2-3 years?
q_36976.ground_truth: Around 100 Mbps are sufficient bitrates to address high-quality 6DOF VR services.

q_36977.question: How does Soln#8 balance resource efficiency and shared tunnel re-establishment efforts in NG-RAN processing?
q_36977.ground_truth: Soln#8 has one broadcast MBS session in each NG-RAN, but it has a trade-off between resource efficiency in CN and NG-RAN processing and the efforts to re-establish the shared tunnel when currently used N3mb tunnel is released.

q_36978.question: What is the discovery mechanism in the Layer-2 UE-to-UE Relay operation?
q_36978.ground_truth: The Layer-2 UE-to-UE Relay discovery uses two models: Model A and Model B. Model A involves a UE-to-UE Relay sending an Announcement message with a list of other UEs and their Layer-2 IDs, while Model B involves a Source UE sending a Solicitation message to discover the Target UE using the Relay Service Code. The UE-to-UE Relay may perform a direct discovery procedure to discover the Target UE if not already discovered. Once a UE-to-UE Relay matches the values of the User Info ID of Target UE and RSC contained in the Solicitation message, it responds with a Response message.

q_36979.question: What information is used to enhance existing network selection in order to allow a UE to access a hosting network for localized services?
q_36979.ground_truth: A new list of hosting network(s), which includes at least NPN ID, optional valid time, or/and area information, is used to enhance existing network selection.

q_36980.question: What is the requirement for the priority of the IMS-based MPS session when it is identified by the terminating network?
q_36980.ground_truth: The requirement is to apply priority treatment to ensure that the call is delivered with priority to the terminating user (either a Service User or normal user).

q_36981.question: What is the state of the UE before the test procedure in this 3GPP scenario?
q_36981.ground_truth: The UE is in state Registered, Idle mode (state 2) on Cell 1.

q_36982.question: Intra-frequency RSTD accuracy requirements for UE category M2 in CE mode B, in terms of expectedRSTDUncertainty signalled over LPP by E-SMLC, under what conditions is the requirement valid?
q_36982.ground_truth: The requirement is valid when the conditions defined in 36.101 Clause 7.3 are met, PRS is available within the UE measurement bandwidth for UEs without a measurement gap, and the measurement gaps contain PRS subframes for UEs with a measurement gap.

q_36983.question: What information is sent in the PFCP PFD Management Request message when at least one Application ID's PFDs IE is present in the request?
q_36983.ground_truth: When at least one Application ID's PFDs IE is present in the request, the PFCP PFD Management Request message contains the full set of PFD IDs and PFD contents to be provisioned in the UP function per Application Identifier.

q_36984.question: What conclusions did the simulation results for 39GHz show regarding the feasibility of different phase noise profiles in achieving the 29.1 dB EVM requirement for UE?
q_36984.ground_truth: The simulation results suggest that either option 3 or option 4 may still be infeasible for MPR evaluation in the 39GHz band.

q_36985.question: How many types of virtualized network product classes are defined in the SECAM technical report?
q_36985.ground_truth: Three types of virtualized network product classes are defined: Type 1 implementing 3GPP defined functionalities only, Type 2 implementing 3GPP defined functionalities and Virtualization layer, and Type 3 implementing 3GPP defined functionalities, Virtualization layer, and hardware layer.

q_36986.question: What is the use of the UplinkTxSwitchRequest-r16 in the UE-CapabilityRequestFilterCommon?
q_36986.ground_truth: The UplinkTxSwitchRequest-r16 is an enumerated value defined in the UE-CapabilityRequestFilterCommon. It is used to indicate if the UE supports Uplink Tx Switch in RLC and is included in the capability container request list.

q_36987.question: What is the function of the sidelink shared channel transport channel?
q_36987.ground_truth: The sidelink shared channel transport channel is used to transmit data between UEs in the form of a maximum of one transport block every transmission time interval (TTI). It follows the downlink shared channel processing, but with differences such as the time-first mapping and the PUSCH interleaving.

q_36988.question: What protects the media sent and received by an MCPTT client in an off-network group call when protection of media is announced?
q_36988.ground_truth: The GMK and the GMK-ID of the MCPTT group

q_36989.question: What action does the AMF take when it interfaces with multiple CBCFs and receives a FAILURE-INDICATION-NG-RAN message from a NG-RAN node?
q_36989.ground_truth: The AMF forwards the same FAILURE-INDICATION-NG-RAN message to all CBCFs.

q_36990.question: What should the UE do when receiving a NOTIFICATION message in the ESM protocol entity?
q_36990.ground_truth: The UE shall provide the notification indicator to the upper layer, with value #1 indicating SRVCC handover cancelled and IMS session re-establishment required.

q_36991.question: What method should the NF Service Consumer use to delete an MBS distribution session in the MBSTF?
q_36991.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer should use the HTTP DELETE method to delete an MBS distribution session in the MBSTF.

q_36992.question: What is the purpose of the Relocation Request message from the target SGSN to the target RNC?
q_36992.ground_truth: The target SGSN requests the target RNC to establish the radio network resources (RABs) by sending the message Relocation Request (UE Identifier, Cause, CN Domain Indicator, Integrity protection information, Encryption information, RAB to be setup list, Source RNC to Target RNC Transparent Container, Service Handover related information) to the target RNC.

q_36993.question: When should the AMF include the NSSAI time validity information in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message?
q_36993.ground_truth: The AMF should include the NSSAI time validity information in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message if the UE supports S-NSSAI time validity information and the AMF needs to update the S-NSSAI time validity information.

q_36994.question: What should the MCPTT client include in the SIP re-INVITE request when an MCPTT user cancels an in-progress emergency condition and optionally an MCPTT emergency alert originated by the user?
q_36994.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body populated as specified in clause 6.2.8.1.3 in the SIP re-INVITE request.

q_36995.question: What type of coexistence is tested for UE in section 6.5A.3.2 of the document?
q_36995.ground_truth: The spurious emission band UE co-existence for UL CA is tested for UE in section 6.5A.3.2 of the document.

q_36996.question: What is the applicability of the test defined in section 9.1.15.2.2?
q_36996.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA TDD and CRS interference handling UE release 11 and forward. Applicability requires support of FGI bit 115.

q_36997.question: What should the transmission control interface do if other MCVideo clients have the permission to send media and the general state machine is initializing in clause~6.3.4.2.2?
q_36997.ground_truth: It should enter the 'U: not permitted and Transmit Taken' state as specified in the clause~6.3.5.4.2.

q_36998.question: What type of frame structure is specified for use by the SS in the SCell when operating in an unlicensed band?
q_36998.ground_truth: Frame structure type 3 is used by the SS in the SCell when operating in an unlicensed band.

q_36999.question: What should a UE do if it receives ESM cause value #66, the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message was sent standalone, the Back-off timer value IE is not included, and the Re-attempt indicator IE is included and indicates that re-attempt in an equivalent PLMN is not allowed?
q_36999.ground_truth: The UE should not send a PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message for the same APN in any PLMN in the list of equivalent PLMNs in S1 mode until the UE is switched off or the USIM is removed.

q_37000.question: What should be set in the choCellId in the VarRLF-Report if the UE supports RLF-Report for conditional handover and the global cell identity is available?

q_37001.question: What is the maximum number of Resource Blocks that can be used for each Component Carrier in Carrier Aggregation?
q_37001.ground_truth: Each Component Carrier in Carrier Aggregation is limited to a maximum of 110 Resource Blocks in the frequency domain using the Rel-8/9 numerology.

q_37002.question: What is the mean and 5% UL Average-UPT loss for operator 1 when using SBFD Alt 2 and large packet size at high load level?
q_37002.ground_truth: The mean and 5% UL Average-UPT loss for operator 1 when using SBFD Alt 2 and large packet size at high load level are -5.22% and -0.92%, respectively.

q_37003.question: When should the UE initiate the procedure the UE uses to transit from ECM-IDLE to ECM-CONNECTED when in EMM-REGISTERED state?
q_37003.ground_truth: The UE initiates the procedure by sending a NAS Service Request message to the MME when it is in EMM-REGISTERED state.

q_37004.question: Which class of single RAT E-UTRA AAS BSs is required to fulfill minimum in-channel selectivity requirements specified in 3GPP TS 36.104 subclause 7.4.1?
q_37004.ground_truth: The single RAT E-UTRA AAS BSs of Wide Area, Medium Range, and Local Area BS classes are required to fulfill the minimum in-channel selectivity requirements specified in 3GPP TS 36.104 subclause 7.4.1.

q_37005.question: What should be done to evaluate the reported RSRP values for Cell 2, Cell 3, Cell 4, and Cell 5 in a MeasurementReport message?
q_37005.ground_truth: The reported RSRP values for Cell 2, Cell 3, Cell 4, and Cell 5 should be compared to the reported RSRP value of other cells for each MeasurementReport message, and counted as a Pass or Fail for the events "Cell 1-2", "Cell 1-4", "Cell 2-3", and "Cell 4-5". If the UE fails to report the measurement value for Cell 2, Cell 3, Cell 4, or Cell 5, the number of failed iterations for the respective event should be increased by one.

q_37006.question: In what state can the network initiate the in-call modification procedure to change the call mode to speech?
q_37006.ground_truth: The network can initiate the in-call modification procedure in the "call delivered" state if service change has been agreed at call setup.

q_37007.question: What is the scope of the network where the logged MDT trace session context is stored in the network?
q_37007.ground_truth: The logged MDT trace session context is stored in the network as long as the trace session is active, including also the periods when the UE is in connected state.

q_37008.question: What does the term "Not served by E-UTRAN" refer to in the context of Proximity-based Services (ProSe)?
q_37008.ground_truth: A UE is considered "Not served by E-UTRAN" if it is outside of E-UTRAN coverage, within E-UTRAN coverage but not camped on any cell, within E-UTRAN coverage but camped on a non-E-UTRAN cell, or camped on an E-UTRAN cell not operating on the carrier frequency provisioned for ProSe direct service.

q_37009.question: What measurement shall the UE determine for NPRACH transmission to the anchor carrier or non-anchor carrier, in order to determine the enhanced coverage level?
q_37009.ground_truth: The UE shall determine the enhanced coverage level based on the NRSRP intra-frequency measurement performed on the anchor carrier.

q_37010.question: Who determines the ranging "constellation" information, and how is it used?
q_37010.ground_truth: The LMF may receive information about ranging "constellations" in an area from an external application or an LCS client. Such information is used to select an AMF and an LMF that serves most of the UEs of the ranging "constellation". The AMF provides the ranging "constellation" information to the selected LMF(s), which use the information to perform UE context transfer and determine the location of the Target UE.

q_37011.question: What is the required measurement reporting delay in Test 1 and Test 3 for a UE supporting power class 1?
q_37011.ground_truth: The required measurement reporting delay in Test 1 and Test 3 for a UE supporting power class 1 is less than 7680 ms from the beginning of time period T2.

q_37012.question: What is a potential security requirement for the NF certificate update key issue?
q_37012.ground_truth: A potential security requirement is to support secure updating of NF certificates, including integrity protection and anti-replay protection of enrolment procedures.

q_37013.question: What should the MME do if the UE is moving from 5GC to EPS and it supports User Plane integrity protection?
q_37013.ground_truth: The MME should not release the signalling connection with the UE based on the indication received in the step~1 that the UE is moving from 5GC.

q_37014.question: What is the recommended scenario for using extended idle mode DRX for applications on UE?
q_37014.ground_truth: Extended idle mode DRX should be used in scenarios where the applications on the UE are tolerant to delay and the expected mobile terminating communication is also tolerant to delay.

q_37015.question: What is the function of the AF in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_37015.ground_truth: The AF (Application Function) is an element that offers applications that require Policy and Charging Control of traffic plane resources (e.g. PS domain/GPRS domain resources) and provides session information to the PCRF via the Rx reference point.

q_37016.question: What does the "cid" parameter represent in the context of the +CGDEL command?
q_37016.ground_truth: The "cid" parameter in the context of the +CGDEL command specifies a particular PDP context definition that can be deleted.

q_37017.question: What action should a participating MCVideo function take when it receives a transmission control message other than the Media Transmission Notification and Transmission Idle message?
q_37017.ground_truth: It should forward the transmission control message, restart timer T300, and remain in the 'M: A transmission is active' state.

q_37018.question: What should the SCC AS do upon receiving a SIP 2xx response to the SIP re-INVITE request sent towards the remote UE, as part of transferring a dialog with inactive speech media component?
q_37018.ground_truth: The SCC AS should send a SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP INVITE request transferring additional session, populate the response with signalling elements, the SDP answer, and the Feature-Caps header field. Then, upon receiving SIP ACK request associated with the SIP 200 (OK) response, the SCC AS should release the source access leg of the determined dialog being transferred and continue handling the procedures in subclause 12.3.10.4.

q_37019.question: What are the EPS Bearer QoS parameter values mapped to for a PDP context when the SGSN maps EPS bearers to PDP contexts?
q_37019.ground_truth: The EPS Bearer QoS parameter values of an EPS bearer are mapped to the Release~99 QoS parameter values of a PDP context.

q_37020.question: What are the two types of resources included in the NFVI?
q_37020.ground_truth: The two types of resources included in the NFVI are hardware resources, which are assumed to be 'Commercial Off The Shelf' (COTS), and a virtualization layer, which can be a hypervisor or container engine.

q_37021.question: What is a requirement for a CSI-RS based intra-frequency measurement?
q_37021.ground_truth: The subcarrier spacing of CSI-RS resources on the neighbor cell should be the same as the SCS of CSI-RS resources on the serving cell indicated for measurement.

q_37022.question: What should the SGM-C do upon receiving a CoAP "observe" request for an observable resource?
q_37022.ground_truth: The SGM-C should register the SGM-C as an observer for the requested resource and send a CoAP 2.05 (Content) response including the current content of the resource.

q_37023.question: What is the procedure for PIN discovery in the case where the PIN elements can communicate with the PEMC?
q_37023.ground_truth: The PIN element receives the PIN ID, PIN description information and IP address of the PEMC from the PEMC and decides whether to join the PIN. The PIN discovery request is initiated by the PIN element and the PIN discovery response is sent by the PEMC.

q_37024.question: What is the mechanism for deriving a non-dialable callback number in E-CSCF?
q_37024.ground_truth: Based on local regulation, E-CSCF shall derive a non-dialable callback number to include as the UE's identity in the session establishment request and the location/routeing request.

q_37025.question: What action shall the SMF take if it receives a "ranNasRelCauses" attribute within the SmPolicyDeleteData data structure from the AMF?
q_37025.ground_truth: The SMF shall provide the received cause(s) in the "ranNasRelCauses" attribute.

q_37026.question: What is the role of the network management platforms in this use case?
q_37026.ground_truth: The network management platforms are used by EnergyCo to measure the KPIs in real-time, check the availability, latency, and packet loss rate of the connection, and generate automatic alarms in case of service degradation or connection loss.

q_37027.question: What should be the condition for the SNR used in the conducted performance requirements specified in clause 8 of the document?
q_37027.ground_truth: The SNR is defined as the signal energy over the noise energy in a bandwidth corresponding to the transmission bandwidth over the same duration where signal energy exists.

q_37028.question: What is the function of the 3GPP AAA server in the IKEv2 and DSMIPv6 fast re-authentication process?
q_37028.ground_truth: The 3GPP AAA server checks the EAP message, generates a new MSK, and sends the Authentication Answer including an EAP success and the key material (MSK) to the PDN GW.

q_37029.question: What is the parameter that determines the downlink path loss estimate in dB for an NPUSCH format 1 or 2 for j=1 in the dynamic scheduled grant or semi-persistent grant?
q_37029.ground_truth: The parameter is provided by higher layers for serving cell.

q_37030.question: What information is included in the notification of a new NF version provided by the vendor?
q_37030.ground_truth: The notification of a new NF version provided by the vendor includes information such as authentication, payment details, requests of data for feedback, the location to fetch the new NF version and the corresponding NF information, the NF information, the tests to be run on the NF as provided by the vendor, and an address where to send feedback to the NF supplier related to operator testing and use of the NF.

q_37031.question: What does the value "7200 sec (5)" represent in the "Logging Duration" parameter for UMTS, LTE and NR?
q_37031.ground_truth: The value "7200 sec (5)" in the "Logging Duration" parameter for UMTS, LTE and NR represents a duration of 7200 seconds, which is equivalent to 2 hours.

q_37032.question: What action must the UE take when it receives downlink data on the radio bearer associated with the default EPS bearer context after a successful inter-frequency handover from E-UTRA TDD to E-UTRA FDD?
q_37032.ground_truth: The UE must deliver the downlink data to upper layers when it receives the data on the radio bearer associated with the default EPS bearer context after a successful inter-frequency handover from E-UTRA TDD to E-UTRA FDD.

q_37033.question: What is the purpose of the Uplink power control window?
q_37033.ground_truth: The purpose of the Uplink power control window is to ensure that the actual UE output power is no less than the target power level, and as close as possible to the target power level.

q_37034.question: When does the UE initiate the relay UE procedure for UE-to-UE relay discovery?
q_37034.ground_truth: The UE initiates the relay UE procedure for UE-to-UE relay discovery when it is triggered by the upper layers to start responding to solicitation on proximity of a connectivity service provided by the UE-to-UE relay and if the UE is authorized to perform the relay UE procedure for UE-to-UE relay discovery.

q_37035.question: What is the difference between ACR monitoring and EEC managed ACR in ACR management?
q_37035.ground_truth: In ACR monitoring, the EEC monitors the need for ACR and notifies the AC as and when required, while in EEC managed ACR, the EEC monitors the need for ACR, decides and initiates ACR using one of the EEC initiated ACR scenarios, and notifies the AC about the imminent ACR and may include the target information.

q_37036.question: What message does gNB-CU initiate to start a measurement, stop a measurement, or add cells to report for a measurement in a successful operation of the Resource Status Reporting Initiation procedure?

q_37037.question: What are the steps taken by the P-CSCF (IMS-ALG) for e2ae protection of MSRP in the SDP Offer?
q_37037.ground_truth: The P-CSCF (IMS-ALG) changes the transport from "TCP/TLS/MSRP" to "TCP/MSRP" in the SDP Offer, stores the received fingerprint of the IMS UE A certificate, and removes it as well as the indication "e2ae-security requested by UE" from the description of the media stream in the SDP Offer if present.

q_37038.question: In basic terms, what is carrier leakage in the context of NR UE?
q_37038.ground_truth: Carrier leakage is an unmodulated sine wave with the carrier frequency, which is an interference of approximately constant amplitude and independent of the amplitude of the wanted signal. Carrier leakage interferes with the sub carriers at its position (if allocated), especially when their amplitude is small.

q_37039.question: What is the difference between "shall" and "might" in a 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_37039.ground_truth: "Shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something, while "might" indicates a likelihood that something will happen as a result of action taken by some agency the behaviour of which is outside the scope of the present document.

q_37040.question: What happens when a charging event is generated for an unsuccessful resource usage attempt?
q_37040.ground_truth: The charging event must describe the reason and circumstances of the failure.

q_37041.question: What should the overall delays measured be less than in Test 1 in order for the test case to pass?
q_37041.ground_truth: The overall delays measured shall be less than a total of 922 ms in this test case.

q_37042.question: In the process of establishing end-to-end security between the Source UE and the Target UE, what is the role of the IPsec Security Association (SA)?
q_37042.ground_truth: The IPsec Security Association (SA) is used to establish the end-to-end security between the Source UE and the Target UE operating on the IP layer. It provides end-to-end protection for the IP packets between the two UEs over the Layer-3 UE-to-UE Relay.

q_37043.question: What type of MIME body is used to indicate per-group dynamic data in a SIP NOTIFY request?

q_37044.question: When would an AMF send a Registration Accept message that does not include specific slices in the Allowed NSSAI?
q_37044.ground_truth: When the AMF receives a Registration Request that indicates that the UE supports Slice-Specific Service Area and the UE requested slices are not available in the current TA.

q_37045.question: What is the maximum number of digits for the "tac-baseType" simple type?
q_37045.ground_truth: The maximum number of digits for the "tac-baseType" simple type is 8.

q_37046.question: What should the UE do if the received measObject includes the cellsToRemoveList?
q_37046.ground_truth: for each cellIndex included in the cellsToRemoveList, remove the entry with the matching cellIndex from the cellsToAddModList.

q_37047.question: How is the sending sensitivity expressed for the calculation of SLR in handset terminals?
q_37047.ground_truth: The sending sensitivity is expressed in terms of dBV/Pa and is calculated as per ITU-T Recommendation P.79 formula (A-23b) over bands 4 to 17.

q_37048.question: What should the UP function do when an implementation specific timer expires after receiving a PFCP Session Deletion Response with the Cause set to "More Usage Report to send", and it has not received the number of usage reports indicated in the Additional Usage Reports Information IE in PFCP Session Deletion Response?
q_37048.ground_truth: The UP function should set the PURU flag to "1" in the PFCP Session Deletion Response, indicating to the CP function that it has pending PFCP Session Report Request messages with unacknowledged reports.

q_37049.question: What is the "handoverControlContext-v3" application context used for?
q_37049.ground_truth: The "handoverControlContext-v3" application context is used for handover procedures between MSCs.

q_37050.question: What is the minimum percentage of correct events that should be observed during repeated tests for the NR SA FR2 event-triggered reporting tests on inter-frequency measurement with NCSG for FR2 when DRX is not used?
q_37050.ground_truth: The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests should be at least 90%.

q_37051.question: What should the PCF include in the RAN and/or NAS release cause in the "ranNasRelCauses" attribute in the "EventsNotification" data type when the "RAN-NAS-Cause" feature is supported?
q_37051.ground_truth: The PCF should include the RAN and/or NAS release cause in the "ranNasRelCauses" attribute in the "EventsNotification" data type when the "RAN-NAS-Cause" feature is supported.

q_37052.question: How does a DASH client obtain the new MPD information when the determined segment list gets to an end?
q_37052.ground_truth: The DASH client typically frequently polls the MPD update server to check if an MPD update is available or the existing MPD can still be used.

q_37053.question: What is the new cause for the PDU Session Reject message used by the AMF if the URSP validity check fails by the PCF?
q_37053.ground_truth: The new cause is called "URSP rules not followed" or a more specific reject cause pointing to which URSP rules are not followed, such as S-NSSAI selection rules not followed, DNN selection rules not followed, Time windows criteria not followed, or Location criteria not followed.

q_37054.question: What should the source eNB do if it receives an MME initiated E-RAB Management procedure on the same UE associated signalling connection after sending a HANDOVER REQUIRED message and before the Handover Preparation procedure is terminated?
q_37054.ground_truth: The source eNB should either cancel the Handover Preparation procedure by executing the Handover Cancel procedure with an appropriate cause value and then continue the MME initiated E-RAB Management procedure, or terminate the MME initiated E-RAB Management procedure by sending an appropriate response message and then continue with the handover procedure.

q_37055.question: What is the "signalling IPsec SA" established between in the Trusted N3GPP network?
q_37055.ground_truth: The "signalling IPsec SA" is established between the UE and TNGF in Tunnel mode for exchanging IP packets in the Trusted N3GPP network. It allows for re-establishing IPsec SAs when the IP address of the UE changes during mobility events.

q_37056.question: Which frequency should the UE use as a reference for synchronization and DL measurements when the concerned frequency concerns a secondary frequency in V2X sidelink communication?
q_37056.ground_truth: The UE should use the concerned SCell (Secondary Cell) as a reference for synchronization and DL measurements when the frequency concerned is a secondary frequency.

q_37057.question: In AI/ML based positioning, how is the number of TRPs that provide measurements selected for model input in Approach 1-A?
q_37057.ground_truth: In Approach 1-A, the set of TRPs that provide measurements to the model input is fixed.

q_37058.question: What should the source NG-RAN node include in the SN STATUS TRANSFER message for each DRB in the DRBs Subject to Status Transfer List IE?
q_37058.ground_truth: The source NG-RAN node should include the DRB ID IE, the UL COUNT Value IE, and the DL COUNT Value IE for each DRB in the DRBs Subject to Status Transfer List IE when sending the SN STATUS TRANSFER message.

q_37059.question: What shall the UE do when the network rejects the registration procedure due to EMM cause value #12?
q_37059.ground_truth: The UE shall set the EPS update status to EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, delete specific information, reset certain counters, store the current TAI in the "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service" list, and reset the tracking area updating attempt counter.

q_37060.question: Which section outlines the cell re-selection requirements for UE category M1 in normal coverage?

q_37061.question: What message can be used to send the access token to the MCX server during SIP registration for user service authorization?
q_37061.ground_truth: A SIP REGISTER message can be used to send the access token to the MCX server during SIP registration for user service authorization.

q_37062.question: What information elements are included in the NAS message IE?
q_37062.ground_truth: A plain NAS message as specified in clause 8.2 and 8.3 is included in the NAS message IE.

q_37063.question: What is the name of the complex type with a sequence containing a "time-temp-data-waiting" element, an "xs:any" wildcard allowing other elements, and a maximum occurrence of 1?

q_37064.question: What is the detection mode that should be used during the measurement?
q_37064.ground_truth: The detection mode can be true RMS voltage or true average power.

q_37065.question: How is TC5a constructed for a Base Station that supports up to 3 carriers?
q_37065.ground_truth: TC5a is constructed by setting the Base Station RF Bandwidth to the declared maximum for non-contiguous operation, placing a GSM carrier at the lower edge, and one UTRA carrier at the upper edge with the specified FOffset-RAT. If the BS supports up to 3 carriers, the method to generate NTC4a for up to 3 carriers is used.

q_37066.question: What is the role of the AIML NF in relation to the 5GS assistance information for Federated Learning operation?
q_37066.ground_truth: The AIML NF processes the request from the AI/ML Application Server by interacting with other NFs and generates assistance information for FL operation based on the collected information.

q_37067.question: Which IEC standard is used to classify the environment in the 3GPP technical specification on EMC requirements for 3rd generation digital cellular mobile terminals and ancillary equipment?
q_37067.ground_truth: The IEC standards used to classify the environment in the 3GPP technical specification on EMC requirements for 3rd generation digital cellular mobile terminals and ancillary equipment are IEC 61000-6-1, IEC 61000-6-3, and ISO 7637-Part 1 and Part 2.

q_37068.question: What action does the MME take when preserving and suspending non-GBR bearers for GBR traffic in the P-GW?
q_37068.ground_truth: The MME sends a Suspend Notification message towards the S-GW, and the S-GW releases S1-U bearers for the UE and sends a Suspend Notification message to the P-GW(s). The MME stores the UE's suspended status and marks the preserved non-GBR bearers as suspended in the S-GW and P-GW.

q_37069.question: What should the controlling MCVideo function do upon receiving a SIP ACK to the SIP 200 (OK) response sent towards the inviting MCVideo client, if a SIP 200 (OK) response was sent with the warning text set to "149 SIP INFO request pending" in a Warning header field as specified in clause~4.4?
q_37069.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function should follow the procedures in clause~6.3.3.1.18.

q_37070.question: What is the impact of the UE speed on the SGCS performance for the AI/ML based CSI prediction compared to the nearest historical CSI benchmark?
q_37070.ground_truth: The results are generally smaller than 30km/h UE speed.

q_37071.question: What is the purpose of test channels in 3GPP?
q_37071.ground_truth: Test channels permit to emulate typical radio conditions in terms delays and losses, and to evaluate the application quality for different representative radio conditions.

q_37072.question: What additional requirements must be supported for assured transfer?
q_37072.ground_truth: In addition to the requirements for call transfer without third party call control, an Expires header field parameter in the Refer-To URI of the REFER Request must be supported at the II-NNI and roaming II-NNI for assured transfer.

q_37073.question: When should the <remotely-initiated-call-request-ind> element be set to "true" in the MCPTT call?
q_37073.ground_truth: The <remotely-initiated-call-request-ind> element should be set to "true" when the MCPTT client is receiving a remotely initiated call request.

q_37074.question: When should the UE stop timer T310 for the corresponding SpCell?
q_37074.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T310 for the corresponding SpCell if it receives N311 consecutive "in-sync" indications for the SpCell from lower layers while T310 is running and stop timer T312 for the corresponding SpCell, if running.

q_37075.question: What message is used to inform the HeNB about the MME UE S1AP ID and HeNB GW assigned UE S1AP ID in case of an S1 PATH SWITCH REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message?
q_37075.ground_truth: The MME UE S1AP ID assigned by the MME and the MME UE S1AP ID assigned by the HeNB GW for the UE.

q_37076.question: Which two interfaces are protected by signalling plane security mechanisms within a MC system as defined in the document?
q_37076.ground_truth: Signalling from the MC client is passed over both HTTP and SIP, and signalling plane security protects the interfaces used by the MC application. The signalling plane security mechanisms for client to server interfaces and between network elements are defined in clause 6.

q_37077.question: What are the two main categories of solutions for switching traffic of an MA PDU session between two non-3GPP access paths?
q_37077.ground_truth: Option 1 includes solutions that switch data traffic after the Registration procedure, while Option 2 includes solutions that switch data traffic during the Registration procedure.

q_37078.question: What is the purpose of introducing a second measurement based on a specific CSI-RS assigned by the target gNB to the UE?
q_37078.ground_truth: The purpose is to avoid the UE connecting to a false base station during the Handover procedure.

q_37079.question: What is the purpose of the AR-5.2.9.2-a requirement in the application enablement layer architecture?
q_37079.ground_truth: The AR-5.2.9.2-a requirement in the application enablement layer architecture mandates that the architecture provide mechanisms for the PEGC to publish its KPIs that it supports or the gateway requirements. This enables monitoring and evaluating the performance of the PIN enabler architecture.

q_37080.question: What should the MS do if it receives a message with cause value #12 in A/Gb mode or Iu mode?
q_37080.ground_truth: The MS should store the forbidden LA identity in a list of "forbidden location areas for regional provision of service" and enter the limited service state.

q_37081.question: What is the condition for a PUSCH of smaller priority index with SP-CSI report(s) without a corresponding PDCCH to be transmitted by the UE, when a PUSCH of larger priority index scheduled by a DCI format overlaps in time with the PUSCH of smaller priority index, given that the earliest symbol of these PUSCH channels starts no earlier than N2+d2,1 symbols after the last symbol of the DCI scheduling the PUSCH of larger priority index, where d2,1 is the maximum of the d2,1 associated with PUSCH of larger priority index scheduled by a DCI format and the PUSCH of smaller priority index with SP-CSI report(s) without a corresponding PDCCH?
q_37081.ground_truth: The PUSCH of smaller priority index with SP-CSI report(s) without a corresponding PDCCH can be transmitted by the UE when the timeline requirement is satisfied, i.e., the earliest symbol of these PUSCH channels starts no earlier than N2+d2,1 symbols after the last symbol of the DCI scheduling the PUSCH of larger priority index.

q_37082.question: What is the function of the senderNonce and recipNonce fields in ACME messaging?
q_37082.ground_truth: The senderNonce and recipNonce fields in ACME messaging provide an additional layer of security by preventing replay attacks and ensuring message freshness.

q_37083.question: What is the role of the SMF in step~6b and step~6c?
q_37083.ground_truth: In step~6b, the SMF receives the SUPI and the QoS Info from the AUSF. In step~6c, the SMF responds to 5G-RG with a PDU Session Third-Party Authentication Result message that contains a Traffic Identifier and the EAP-Success packet and the Master Session Key (MSK).

q_37084.question: What are the three types of changes that can result in a change in the version number's second digit?

q_37085.question: What payload format should be listed before the octet-aligned payload format in the preference order defined in the SDP for the MTSI media gateway to use?
q_37085.ground_truth: The non-redundant speech frames should be listed before the octet-aligned payload format in the preference order defined in the SDP.

q_37086.question: What shall the network indicate in the ATTACH ACCEPT or ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message if it wishes to prolong the PS signalling connection after a GMM specific procedure?
q_37086.ground_truth: The network shall indicate "follow-on proceed" in the ATTACH ACCEPT or ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message.

q_37087.question: What is the principle of Solution #27 in addressing Key Issue #4 and #5?
q_37087.ground_truth: The principle of Solution #27 in addressing Key Issue #4 and #5 is reusing N3IWF overlay architecture and LADN mechanism.

q_37088.question: What is the 5G Media Streaming (5GMS) System defined in the document?
q_37088.ground_truth: The 5GMS System is an assembly of Application Functions, Application Servers and interfaces from the 5G Media Streaming architecture that supports either downlink media streaming services or uplink media streaming services, or both.

q_37089.question: What is the purpose of the tests specified in 8.13.2.4.1-1, regarding CA with 2 DL CCs in the enhanced performance requirement type A for single-layer spatial multiplexing with TM9 interference model using user-specific reference symbols?
q_37089.ground_truth: The purpose of these tests is to verify closed loop rank one performance on one of the antenna ports 7 or 8 without a simultaneous transmission on the other antenna port in the serving cell when the PDSCH transmission in the serving cell is interfered by PDSCH of one dominant interfering cell applying transmission mode 9 interference model defined in clause B.5.4.

q_37090.question: Which value does S-InfoListGERAN-r10 in the code above correspond to?
q_37090.ground_truth: The value of S-InfoListGERAN-r10 in the code above corresponds to the size of an OCTET STRING (SIZE (1..23)).

q_37091.question: What type is the Link local IPv6 address information element?
q_37091.ground_truth: The Link local IPv6 address information element is a type 3 information element.

q_37092.question: How is the key derivation performed during Xn handover or intra-gNB/intra-ng-eNB handover in 5GS?
q_37092.ground_truth: During Xn handover or intra-gNB/intra-ng-eNB handover, the gNB/ng-eNB and the UE derive a KNG-RAN* from either the currently active KgNB (horizontal key derivation) or from the NH parameter (vertical key derivation). If the KNG-RAN* is derived from the NH parameter, it is further bound to the target PCI and its frequency ARFCN-DL.

q_37093.question: What is the type of antenna ports applicable for the measurement of the transmit antenna port for spurious emissions requirements in E-UTRA FDD operation?
q_37093.ground_truth: The spurious emissions requirements can be measured at the transmit antenna port for any type of BS which has common or separate Tx/Rx antenna ports.

q_37094.question: What is the purpose of testing the reference sensitivity level of a SAN type 1-H receiver?
q_37094.ground_truth: The purpose of testing the reference sensitivity level of a SAN type 1-H receiver is to verify that the throughput requirement is met for a specified reference measurement channel at the minimum mean power received at the TAB connector.

q_37095.question: What are the different REGISTRATION modes for 5GS (Fifth Generation System), and what is their purpose?
q_37095.ground_truth: The 5GS has two REGISTRATION modes, multiple registrations in different PLMNs and multiple registrations in the same PLMN. Multiple registrations in different PLMNs ensure the UE has two different 5G security contexts, which are established separately via a successful primary authentication with the Home PLMN. Multiple registrations in the same PLMN means that the UE has two different NAS connections with the network, using the same 5G NAS security context for both 3GPP and non-3GPP accesses. The AMF shall store the security context during registration and can use the stored security context in case the UE deregisters and then re-registers with the same AMF. The AMF and UE shall establish a common NAS security context consisting of a single set of NAS keys and algorithm. This common security context ensures the integrity and confidentiality of NAS signaling and data between the UE and the AMF.

q_37096.question: When M is defined as in the equation for MPR to meet -13dBm/MHz, what is MPR for PC3 without indicating dualPA-Architecture supported when B is greater than or equal to 56.88?

q_37097.question: What conditions must be met for a SC UE to perform access transfer for calls in alerting state as specified in TS 24.237, clause 12.2.3B.2?
q_37097.ground_truth: The UE must support single radio PS to CS access transfer for calls in alerting state, and there must be an early dialog with an active speech media component, where the SC UE has sent or received a SIP 180 (Ringing) response and has not received a final response for the initial SIP INVITE request. The UE must have sent a Contact header field with the g.3gpp.srvcc-alerting media feature tag, and received a Feature-Caps header field with the g.3gpp.srvcc-alerting feature capability indicator.

q_37098.question: What should the VLR do if the IMSI in the SGsAP-LOCATION-UPDATE-REQUEST message is not known?
q_37098.ground_truth: The VLR shall retrieve the MM context of the UE from the HSS.

q_37099.question: What procedures can be applied when the UE is accessing NR or E-UTRA using unlicensed spectrum as a secondary RAT?
q_37099.ground_truth: Usage Data Reporting for Secondary RAT as defined in clause 5.12.2 can apply.

q_37100.question: What is the purpose of the test specified in clause 6.2.4?
q_37100.ground_truth: The purpose of the test specified in clause 6.2.4 is to verify the accuracy of the maximum carrier output power across the frequency range and under normal and extreme conditions.

q_37101.question: What does the PCF provide if it decides to adjust the PCC rules after receiving backhaul network delay measurement information?
q_37101.ground_truth: The PCF provides updated PCC rules (if needed) and the QoS Monitoring information for dynamic satellite backhaul delay control which includes QoS Monitoring for URLLC and optional threshold values.

q_37102.question: What occurs when the maximum number of active user-plane resources are reached and the upper layers request for more user-plane resources for PDU sessions other than those with active user-plane resources?
q_37102.ground_truth: The UE may choose to release one or more PDU sessions with active user-plane resources to cater for the upper layer request.

q_37103.question: What action does the UE take when it receives a BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REJECT message with cause #43?
q_37103.ground_truth: The UE locally deactivates the EPS bearer context(s) without peer-to-peer ESM signaling and releases the traffic flow aggregate description associated to the PTI value.

q_37104.question: What should the SS do when T3 expires during the SCell deactivation process?
q_37104.ground_truth: When T3 expires, the SS shall transmit a RRCRelease message to release the RRC connection, which includes the release of the established radio bearers as well as all radio resources.

q_37105.question: What is the difference between online and offline charging in the context of 3GPP networks?
q_37105.ground_truth: Online charging involves real-time charging messages per domain / subsystem / service, while offline charging involves the content of CDRs per domain / subsystem / service.

q_37106.question: Which procedures described in clause 4.5.6.1 and 4.5.6.2 can be used for accessing multiple channels only for PSFCH or S-SSB transmissions?
q_37106.ground_truth: Type A or Type B procedures described in clause 4.5.6.1 and 4.5.6.2 can be used for accessing multiple channels only for PSFCH or S-SSB transmissions.

q_37107.question: What should be used in exceptional circumstances for inspecting the memory of functions?
q_37107.ground_truth: Delegated administrator roles should be used.

q_37108.question: What is the impact of VLAN ID on data forwarding between the SMF and UPF in 5G?
q_37108.ground_truth: If the traffic is received with a VLAN ID, the above criteria apply only towards the N6 interface or PDU session matching the same VLAN ID, unless the UPF is instructed to remove the VLAN ID in the incoming traffic.

q_37109.question: What happens if the UE is in a cell within the RA but outside the NS-AoS of the S-NSSAI?
q_37109.ground_truth: The UE shall not activate User Plane resources for any already established PDU Session with that S-NSSAI, shall not send user data as payload of a NAS message in uplink direction, and may initiate signalling for PDU Session release procedure or PDU Session modification procedure for PS data off status change reporting.

q_37110.question: What are some of the potential normative works for the XR conference use case?
q_37110.ground_truth: The potential normative works for the XR conference use case include MTSI/FLUS uplink 3D audio, MTSI/FLUS/MCVideo uplink XR streams, downlink XR video with overlaid graphics with local/cloud computation and rendering, downlink XR audio with mixed-in 3D audio objects with local/cloud computation and rendering, and MTSI/MCPTT SWB/FB voice communication.

q_37111.question: What is the spurious response meaning in 7.7A?
q_37111.ground_truth: Spurious response verifies the receiver's ability to receive a wanted signal on its assigned channel frequency without exceeding a given degradation due to the presence of an unwanted interfering signal at any other frequency.

q_37112.question: What is the hopping information used for in determining the PUSCH resource allocation when there is no PDCCH/EPDCCH for the same transport block?
q_37112.ground_truth: The hopping information is determined based on the most recent semi-persistent scheduling assignment PDCCH/EPDCCH, when the initial PUSCH for the same transport block is semi-persistently scheduled, or the random access response grant for the same transport block, when the PUSCH is initiated by the random access response grant.

q_37113.question: What is the length of the interruption window for a single interruption at SCell activation, regardless of DL CCA failures, in CA?
q_37113.ground_truth: For a single interruption (L=0), the interruption window length at SCell activation does not depend on DL CCA failures in CA.

q_37114.question: What is the reason for an inter-RAT measurement to be considered a measurement with NCSG?
q_37114.ground_truth: An inter-RAT measurement is considered a measurement with NCSG when the UE indicates "ncsg" via NeedForGapNCSG-InfoEUTRA for the inter-RAT measurement.

q_37115.question: What parameter is used to determine the maximum RTT in the timing relationship for the Air-to-ground network?
q_37115.ground_truth: The scheduling offset (:) needs to be larger or equal to the max RTT

q_37116.question: What are some aspects considered for interoperability and testability in the assessment of AI/ML based performance enhancements?
q_37116.ground_truth: Some aspects include requirements and testing frameworks to validate AI/ML based performance enhancements and ensuring that UE and gNB with AI/ML meet or exceed the existing minimum requirements if applicable.

q_37117.question: What interfaces does the RCAF use to determine the UEs served by a congested eNodeB or congested E-UTRAN cell and retrieve their APNs?
q_37117.ground_truth: The RCAF uses the Nq interface to determine the UEs served by a congested eNodeB or congested E-UTRAN cell and retrieves the APNs of the active PDN connections of those UEs.

q_37118.question: What should the SC UE do if there are early dialogs and confirmed dialogs supporting a session with speech media component, with all confirmed dialogs having inactive speech media component, and if it has not received a SIP 180 (Ringing) response yet?
q_37118.ground_truth: The SC UE should apply the procedures in subclause 12.2.3B.3.4.

q_37119.question: What is the role of an MCVideo server in relation to MCVideo signalling control?
q_37119.ground_truth: The MCVideo server is responsible for authorizing the user's interest in the MCVideo group and maintaining the MCVideo group state.

q_37120.question: How does MTLF send the ML model to ADRF?
q_37120.ground_truth: MTLF sends the ML model or ML model address to ADRF by using ADRF's ML model storage service.

q_37121.question: What is the scope of the NRPPa as specified in the document?
q_37121.ground_truth: The NRPPa specifies the control plane radio network layer signaling procedures between a NG-RAN (Next Generation Radio Access Network) node and the LMF (Location Management Function) for the concerned functions.

q_37122.question: What should the MAC entity do when an indication of uplink synchronization loss due to satellite switch with re-synchronization is received from upper layers?
q_37122.ground_truth: The MAC entity flushes all HARQ buffers and does not perform any uplink transmission on the Serving Cell until it receives an indication of uplink synchronization again.

q_37123.question: What is the type of the element "OutgoingBarring" in the provided XML schema?
q_37123.ground_truth: The type of the element "OutgoingBarring" is "tOutgoingBarring".

q_37124.question: What is the time duration defined for T3 in the test procedure?
q_37124.ground_truth: The time duration defined for T3 in the test procedure is 5 seconds.

q_37125.question: What will be the behavior of the target NG-RAN node if the MBS session is in Inactive state for Xn/N2 based handover in handover procedures for the MBS session in Active state?
q_37125.ground_truth: If the MBS session is in Inactive state, the target NG-RAN is provided with the MBS session ID, but is not provided with Active MBS Session Information by the source NG-RAN as specified in TS~38.423. The target NG-RAN establishes the shared tunnel with the MB-UPF as usual, but it will not allocate related radio resource until the MBS session turns into Active state.

q_37126.question: When may the MSGin5G Gateway UE initiate a bulk de-registration request to the MSGin5G Server?
q_37126.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Gateway UE may initiate a bulk de-registration request to the MSGin5G Server upon expiry of one or more timers, expiry of the timer for periodic bulk de-registration, or excess of the maximum number of MSGin5G UE de-registration requests from constrained UEs.

q_37127.question: What is the initial state of the user equipment for the generic test procedure for IMS emergency call establishment in EUTRA with normal service?
q_37127.ground_truth: The UE shall be in Registered, Idle Mode state (State 2).

q_37128.question: Which 3GPP Technical Specification defines the stage 2 architecture of the Access and Mobility Policy Authorization service for the 5G System?
q_37128.ground_truth: The 5G System stage 2 architecture of the Access and Mobility Policy Authorization service is contained in 3GPP TS 23.502 and 3GPP TS 23.503.

q_37129.question: How many identified E-UTRAN TDD cells can a UE perform NR-E-UTRAN TDD RSRP, RSRQ, and RS-SINR measurements for, for up to 7 E-UTRA TDD carrier frequency layers, during each layer 1 measurement period?
q_37129.ground_truth: A UE can perform measurements for up to 4 identified E-UTRAN TDD cells per E-UTRA TDD frequency layer during each layer 1 measurement period, for up to 7 E-UTRA TDD carrier frequency layers.

q_37130.question: What transmit intermodulation requirements apply for NR V2X sidelink transmissions concurrent with NR uplink transmissions?
q_37130.ground_truth: The requirements specified in clause 6.5.4.1 apply for NR V2X sidelink transmissions concurrent with NR uplink transmissions.

q_37131.question: What is the role of NWDAF in accessing location data for low power high accuracy GNSS positioning?
q_37131.ground_truth: LMF reuses the AF event exposure service to collect nearby GNSS assistance data in the low power high accuracy GNSS positioning.

q_37132.question: In what contexts are the measurements 5.2.1.1, 5.2.1.2, 5.2.2.1 and 5.2.2.2 valid?
q_37132.ground_truth: Each of these measurements is valid for packet switched traffic.

q_37133.question: What must be checked when the received SIP INVITE request contains the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body with the <mcpttinfo> element containing the <mcptt-Params> element containing the <anyEXT> element with the <call-to-functional-alias-ind> element set to "true"?
q_37133.ground_truth: In this case, the system must check if the "uri" attribute of the <entry> element in the <list> element of the resource-lists XML MIME body matches with any of the <entry> elements of the ListOfAllowedFAsToCall element of the FunctionalAliasList element corresponding to the calling functional-alias-URI in the MCPTT user profile document.

q_37134.question: What is the purpose of the transceiver array boundary in the SAN system?
q_37134.ground_truth: The transceiver array boundary is the conducted interface between the transceiver unit array and the composite antenna. It is where conducted requirements are applied for SAN type 1-H.

q_37135.question: What should be done if an XML element or its sub-elements required for decryption are not present in a MIME body?
q_37135.ground_truth: A SIP 403 (Forbidden) response with the warning text "140 unable to decrypt XML content" should be sent, and the decryption procedure should not be performed.

q_37136.question: What is the method for calculating the sensitivity of the handset UE and headset UE in sending and receiving?
q_37136.ground_truth: The method for calculating to the sensitivity of the handset UE and headset UE in sending and receiving is detailed in clauses 9.4.1.1, 9.4.1.2, 9.4.2.1, and 9.4.2.2. The test signal used, the measurements intervals, the reference point, and the units of expression vary for each case.

q_37137.question: When does the MME consider the UE as unreachable?
q_37137.ground_truth: The MME considers the UE as unreachable until the UE initiates the tracking area updating procedure for normal service again without providing unavailability information.

q_37138.question: What is the maximum number of digits for the snr-baseType?

q_37139.question: What should the PCF do if the remaining allowed usage for a certain Monitoring key reaches zero or below zero?
q_37139.ground_truth: The PCF may apply other policy decisions and interact with the SMF accordingly.

q_37140.question: In solution #8, what does the NF provide to the CeEF/CA during the certificate enrolment procedure to accomplish verification?
q_37140.ground_truth: The NF provides the signature of the parameters in the NF profile.

q_37141.question: What HTTP status code is returned by an intermediate NRF (e.g. NRF-1) when there is redirection to another NRF service instance?
q_37141.ground_truth: The NRF would return a 3xx status code along with a Location header containing the URI of the new NRF service instance.

q_37142.question: What determines when a notification is sent to the Consumer in the context of formatting instructions in the messaging framework?
q_37142.ground_truth: Formatting instructions, such as notification event clubbing, notification time window, cross event reference-based notification, and consumer triggered notification, determine when a notification is sent to the Consumer.

q_37143.question: In what conditions will the OOB range start from the low frequency of the lower E-UTRA or NR band and the high frequency of the upper NR or E-UTRA band?
q_37143.ground_truth: The OOB range starts from the low frequency of the lower E-UTRA or NR band and the high frequency of the upper NR or E-UTRA band when the high frequency of the lower band is greater than or equal to the low frequency of the upper band.

q_37144.question: What must the SLM server receive in an HTTP PUT request for registering a location service?
q_37144.ground_truth: The SLM server must receive an HTTP PUT request containing an 'Accept' header field set to "application/vnd.3gpp.seal-location-info+xml", a 'Content-Type' header field set to "application/vnd.3gpp.seal-location-info+xml", and an application/vnd.3gpp.seal-location-info+xml MIME body with a <location-capability> element included in the <location-info> root element.

q_37145.question: What is one of the use cases of 5G timing resiliency service in financial sector?
q_37145.ground_truth: A reliable common reference time to provide synchronized time stamps for market participants to determine exactly who made what trade, and precisely when is one of the use cases of 5G timing resiliency service in financial sector.

q_37146.question: What should the network do if the selected Bearer Control Mode is 'MS/NW' and the MS requests to modify the QoS of a PDP context without downlink packet filters?
q_37146.ground_truth: The network shall reply with a MODIFY PDP CONTEXT REJECT message with cause #48 "request rejected, Bearer Control Mode violation".

q_37147.question: Which message does the HSS send to the S-CSCF to acknowledge the sending of Cx-Put?
q_37147.ground_truth: The HSS sends Cx-Put Resp to the S-CSCF to acknowledge the sending of Cx-Put.

q_37148.question: What does the 3GPP Technical Report on Tethering AR Glasses focus on?
q_37148.ground_truth: The report introduces Smartly Tethering AR Glasses (SmarTAR) and addresses architectures, QoS and media handling aspects for tethering AR Glasses to 5G UEs based on existing 5G System functionalities.

q_37149.question: What should the MCPTT client do upon receiving a SIP 4xx response, a SIP 5xx response, or a SIP 6xx response to the SIP INVITE request?
q_37149.ground_truth: If the MCPTT emergency private call state is set to "MEPC 2: emergency-pc-requested" or "MEPC 3: emergency-pc-granted", the MCPTT client shall perform the actions specified in clause~6.2.8.3.5.

q_37150.question: What is the API name for Network Slice Life Cycle Management in the NSCE Server?
q_37150.ground_truth: The API name for Network Slice Life Cycle Management in the NSCE Server is "nsce-nslcm".

q_37151.question: What kind of locator is used for specifying an administrative area in the context of GeoFencing?
q_37151.ground_truth: The value of GeoFencing.locatorType shall be urn:3gpp:5gms:locator-type:iso3166.

q_37152.question: What is the overall delays measured test requirement for Event A6 in T2?
q_37152.ground_truth: The overall delays measured for Event A6 in T2 is the time from the beginning of time period T2 to the moment the UE sends one Event A6 triggered measurement report to Cell 6, which includes the measurement reporting delay and TTI insertion uncertainty.

q_37153.question: When is a cell considered known for intra-frequency and inter-frequency handover?
q_37153.ground_truth: A cell is considered known if it has been meeting the relevant cell identification requirement for a time duration equal to or longer than the time duration required for cell identification.

q_37154.question: In the context of TS 36.213 clause 7.1.7.2.1, what value of NDI (New Data Indicator) is used to indicate a new transport block in a PDCCH/EPDCCH for the same transport block using DCI format 1/1B/1D/2/2A/2B/2C/2D with CRC scrambled by C-RNTI?

q_37155.question: What response code should be supported for anonymity disallowance in II-NNI?
q_37155.ground_truth: The response code 433 (Anonymity Disallowed) should be supported at the II-NNI.

q_37156.question: What is the frequency range consists of two or more sub-blocks separated by sub-block gap(s), represented by Non-contiguous spectrum?
q_37156.ground_truth: The non-contiguous spectrum is a frequency range consisting of two or more sub-blocks separated by sub-block gap(s). This type of spectrum is allocated in situations where a single frequency range is not available or sufficient to provide the required bandwidth.

q_37157.question: What is the definition of a localized virtual resource block?
q_37157.ground_truth: A localized virtual resource block is a set of contiguously allocated virtual resource blocks within a narrowband.

q_37158.question: What is a delivery boost request in the context of Network Assistance?
q_37158.ground_truth: A delivery boost request is a request for increased data transmission from the network during a Network Assistance session. It is used to accelerate the start of playback or prevent buffer underflow.

q_37159.question: What feature does the FRMCS System need to support for off-network train control communication?
q_37159.ground_truth: The FRMCS System shall be able to provide integrity protection for off-network train control communication.

q_37160.question: What is the first value in the set of EARFCN for Type B multi-carrier access procedure with a maximum frequency separation of less than or equal to 62 MHz?
q_37160.ground_truth: The first value in the set of EARFCN for Type B multi-carrier access procedure with a maximum frequency separation of less than or equal to 62 MHz is 47090.

q_37161.question: Which abnormal case in the network side of the DS-TT-initiated port management procedure will not be diagnosed as an error?
q_37161.ground_truth: The abnormal case where there is a transmission failure of the PORT MANAGEMENT NOTIFY ACK indication from lower layers is not diagnosed as an error on the network side of the DS-TT-initiated port management procedure.

q_37162.question: What is the minimum number of supported transmission combinations in section 16.7.4.0.2?
q_37162.ground_truth: The minimum number of supported transmission combinations in section 16.7.4.0.2 is 2.

q_37163.question: Which "xs" element is used in the sequence in the complex type "prose-direct-discovery-announcing-alert-response" to define the sequence of "announcing-alert-response" and "response-reject" elements?

q_37164.question: In what situation can later transmission occasions among the K repetitions be used for transmitting the transport block?
q_37164.ground_truth: Later transmission occasions among the K repetitions can be used for transmitting the transport block if they are associated with any RV value and any of the first or second SRS resource sets.

q_37165.question: What must be set to "1" in the Report Characteristics IE of the DATA COLLECTION REQUEST message to request the reporting of the Energy Cost IE?
q_37165.ground_truth: The eighth bit, "Energy Cost" of the Report Characteristics IE included in the DATA COLLECTION REQUEST message must be set to "1" to request the reporting of the Energy Cost IE.

q_37166.question: What is the purpose of the requirement-info sub-element within the request and modification elements?
q_37166.ground_truth: The requirement-info sub-element in the request element contains requested unicast resource information, while in the modification element it contains the modified unicast resource information.

q_37167.question: What is the requirement for the mIAB-MT to perform SS-RSRP, SS-RSRQ, and SS-SINR measurements for, during each layer 1 measurement period, for the other intra-frequency layer(s) in the same band in FR2-1?
q_37167.ground_truth: The mIAB-MT shall be capable of performing SS-RSRP, SS-RSRQ, and SS-SINR measurements for at least 2 SSBs on the serving cell for each of the other intra-frequency layer(s) in the same band in FR2-1.

q_37168.question: When can the CP function choose not to provision a "Number of Reports" IE together with a Monitoring Time and/or a Measurement Information where the "Measurement Before QoS Enforcement' flag is set to "1" in a URR?
q_37168.ground_truth: When the CP function expects to receive the exact number of usage reports as requested in the Number of Reports IE, and will not abstain from provisioning a Monitoring Time and/or Measurement Information with the "Measurement Before QoS Enforcement' flag set to "1" in a URR.

q_37169.question: What is the range of UE power saving gain provided by LP-WUS compared to i-DRX with or without PEI, when the WUR ON power is greater than or equal to 20 units and less than or equal to 30 units and the FAR, effective per UE paging arrival rate, and duty cycle ratio are less than or equal to 1%, (0.1% to 1%], and (1%, 10%], respectively?
q_37169.ground_truth: The range of UE power saving gain provided by LP-WUS compared to i-DRX with or without PEI is -79% to 86%, and the corresponding UE power consumption in legacy I-DRX operation is 14% to 179%.

q_37170.question: What action should the diverting AS take when receiving a REFER request for Communication Diversion Services (CDIV) in the context of a call transfer scenario?
q_37170.ground_truth: The diverting AS should create a new CDIV Session Identifier URI and replace the Refer-To header field with the CDIV Session Identifier URI, then forward the REFER request to the transferee using basic communication procedures.

q_37171.question: What is established when a UMTS authentication challenge is performed in A/Gb mode or Iu mode?
q_37171.ground_truth: A UMTS security context is established in the MS and the network after a successful UMTS authentication challenge in A/Gb mode or Iu mode.

q_37172.question: What type of information does the Sample Description box in an ISO file provide?
q_37172.ground_truth: The Sample Description box in an ISO file gives detailed information about the coding type used, and any initialisation information needed for that coding.

q_37173.question: What should the UE do if the UE supports RRC Connection Establishment failure temporary Qoffset and T300 has expired a consecutive connEstFailCount times on the same cell?
q_37173.ground_truth: The UE uses connEstFailOffset for the parameter Qoffsettemp for the concerned cell when performing cell selection and reselection for a period as indicated by connEstFailOffsetValidity.

q_37174.question: What is the purpose of RAN assistance parameters in the context of RAN-assisted WLAN interworking?
q_37174.ground_truth: RAN assistance parameters are used to provide information to the UE about the RAN in order to facilitate RAN-assisted WLAN interworking, and are used only if the UE is camped normally.

q_37175.question: What is the difference between the Layer-2 ID and User Info ID in the UE-to-UE Relay communication setup procedure?
q_37175.ground_truth: The Layer-2 ID is used to identify the Layer-2 entity of the UE or the UE-to-UE Relay, while the User Info ID is used to identify the user information of the UE or the UE-to-UE Relay. In the UE-to-UE Relay communication setup procedure, the User Info ID is used to match the UE or the UE-to-UE Relay, while the Layer-2 ID is used to identify the link between the UE-to-UE Relay and the source UE or the target UE.

q_37176.question: What happens during idle state mobility events when the MME/SGSN detects that the UE has moved away from the HeNB?
q_37176.ground_truth: The MME/SGSN shall deactivate the LIPA PDN connection when it detects that the UE has moved away from the HeNB during idle state mobility events.

q_37177.question: What should the UE do when it receives an RRCConnectionRelease message with an IE redirectedCarrierInfo including a carrierFreq-r13 different from the frequency it was on in RRC_CONNECTED state?
q_37177.ground_truth: The UE should enter RRC_IDLE state on the new NB-IoT Inter-Band frequency included in the IE redirectedCarrierInfo.

q_37178.question: What is the purpose of VAE layer?
q_37178.ground_truth: The VAE layer defines the protocols for application layer support for V2X services, including the procedures for V2X application communication between the UE and the V2X application server and among UEs, as well as the message format, message contents, error handling, and system parameters applied by the protocols for the VAE layer.

q_37179.question: When can the UE initiate the UE requested PDN connectivity procedure upon the inter-system change from A/Gb mode or Iu mode to S1 mode?
q_37179.ground_truth: The UE may initiate the UE requested PDN connectivity procedure upon the inter-system change from A/Gb mode or Iu mode to S1 mode if it supports N1 mode and decides to enable the transfer of the PDN connection from S1 mode to N1 mode.

q_37180.question: What are the correct events observed during repeated tests, as required by clause 7.6.1.5.4.3?
q_37180.ground_truth: The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests must be at least 90%.

q_37181.question: What is updated by SMF after receiving AF specific service flow group ID from AMF?
q_37181.ground_truth: SMF updates the N4 session accordingly after receiving the AF specific service flow group ID from AMF.

q_37182.question: What is the purpose of real-time transfer of tariff information in interconnection scenarios?
q_37182.ground_truth: The purpose is to support value-added services that are billed by the caller's operator (e.g. Premium rate services 0900 or hotlines).

q_37183.question: Which procedure is used to calculate the NR FR2 data rate for CA bandwidth combinations in Clause 9.4A.1?
q_37183.ground_truth: The NR FR2 data rate for CA bandwidth combinations is calculated using a procedure from Clause 7.5A in Clause 9.4A.1.

q_37184.question: What should the UE do if the inter-frequency cell is better ranked than the serving cell and the TreselectionEUTRAN timer has a non-zero value?
q_37184.ground_truth: The UE should evaluate the inter-frequency cell for the TreselectionEUTRAN time, and if the cell remains better ranked within this duration, then the UE should re-select that cell.

q_37185.question: What is the CQI block error probability minimum requirement for PUCCH format 2 in clause 8.3.9.3.1?
q_37185.ground_truth: The CQI block error probability minimum requirement for PUCCH format 2 in clause 8.3.9.3.1 is 1%.

q_37186.question: What should the network product do in case of an overload situation that cannot be prevented?
q_37186.ground_truth: The network product should react in a controlled way and ensure that it cannot reach an undefined and potentially insecure state. In extreme cases, it may perform a controlled system shutdown to prevent uncontrolled failure of security functions and loss of system protection.

q_37187.question: What information does the "Guaranteed Bit Rate" field contain?
q_37187.ground_truth: The "Guaranteed Bit Rate" field contains the guaranteed bit rate for transparent and Wanted AIUR for non-transparent CS data services based on the given mapping in the described context.

q_37188.question: What type of timing is used for this test?
q_37188.ground_truth: The timing used in this test consists of five successive time periods with durations T1, T2, T3, T4, and T5.

q_37189.question: What is the purpose of the "value 111" that is sent by the User Equipment (UE) to the network during a reauthentication procedure?
