q_37189.ground_truth: The purpose of the "value 111" is to initiate a new Authentication and Key Agreement (AKA) or General Authentication and Key Agreement (GBA) to obtain a new KAMF, which is used to derive other security keys.

q_37190.question: What information is provided by the UAS layer of UE-1 to the application layer regarding the C2 connection over PC5?
q_37190.ground_truth: The UAS layer of UE-1 provides C2 connection status information to the application layer, including signal strength/status of the C2 connection over PC5 and an indication whether C2 connection over network is possible.

q_37191.question: What action does the source SGSN take when the timer in step 7 expires, if the SGSN received the Serving GW change indication in the Forward Relocation Response message?
q_37191.ground_truth: The source SGSN deletes the EPS bearer resources by sending Delete Session Request (Cause, Operation Indication) messages to the Source Serving GW.

q_37192.question: What should a UE do when it receives EMM cause value #7 ("EPS services not allowed") in a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message?
q_37192.ground_truth: When a UE receives EMM cause value #7 ("EPS services not allowed") in a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message, it should set the EPS update status to EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, delete any GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI list, and eKSI, consider the USIM as invalid for EPS services until switching off or removing the UICC, delete the list of equivalent PLMNs, and enter the state EMM-DEREGISTERED.

q_37193.question: What should be provided to the upper layers when the UE requests information on the non-3GPP access outside of a PDU session?
q_37193.ground_truth: Information on the non-3GPP access outside of a PDU session should be provided to the upper layers, without evaluating the URSP rules.

q_37194.question: What is the measurement provided by "TB.TotNbrDlInitial" and "TB.TotNbrDlInitial.Qpsk, TB.TotNbrDlInitial.16Qam, TB.TotNbrDlInitial.64Qam, TB.TotNbrDlInitial.256Qam"?
q_37194.ground_truth: The total number of initial TBs transmitted on the downlink in a cell, split into subcounters per modulation schema.

q_37195.question: What are the differences between Charging Data Function (CDF) addresses and Online Charging Function (OCF) addresses?
q_37195.ground_truth: CDF addresses are used for offline billing, while OCF addresses are used for online billing.

q_37196.question: Which of the entered parameters in the ExitSpecificArea section specifies the maximum heading?

q_37197.question: When does the AMF include the rejected NSSAI in the REGISTRATION REJECT message?
q_37197.ground_truth: If the EAC mode is deactivated for an S-NSSAI and the AMF determines that the maximum number of UEs has been reached for all S-NSSAIs in the requested NSSAI and there are no default S-NSSAIs which can be allowed to the UE.

q_37198.question: What is the name of the feature that compresses the headers of the encapsulated traffic when tunneling IP and/or Ethernet traffic within a DCCP or QUIC tunnel?

q_37199.question: What information should be included in the dedicatedInfoNAS of the RRCConnectionResumeComplete message?
q_37199.ground_truth: The dedicatedInfoNAS should be set to include the information received from upper layers.

q_37200.question: What type of video is supported by the resolution or quality being emphasized in certain regions based on the user's viewing orientation?

q_37201.question: What should the network do if it has received a CALL CONFIRMED message but does not receive an ALERTING, CONNECT or DISCONNECT message prior to the expiration of timer T310?
q_37201.ground_truth: The network shall initiate clearing procedures towards the calling user with cause #18 "no user responding" and towards the called MS in accordance with subclause 5.4.4 using cause #102 "recovery on timer expiry".

q_37202.question: Which provider error is used in the MAP-MT-FORWARD-SHORT-MESSAGE service when the mobile equipment does not support the mobile terminated short message service?
q_37202.ground_truth: SM Delivery Failure with the reason "mobile equipment does not support the mobile terminated short message service" is used when the mobile equipment does not support the mobile terminated short message service.

q_37203.question: What should the MCPTT emergency group state be set to when the SIP re-INVITE request contains a certain MIME body?
q_37203.ground_truth: The MCPTT emergency group state should be set to "MEG 1: no-emergency".

q_37204.question: What is the name of the "ID" in the "Scell-ToBeSetup-List F1AP-PROTOCOL-IES" section of the "UEContextSetupRequest" message?

q_37205.question: What must the participating MCPTT function include in the MBMS bearer announcement message for a new bearer?
q_37205.ground_truth: The MBMS bearer announcement message can contain new MBMS bearer announcements, updated MBMS bearer announcements, or cancelled MBMS bearer announcements. Each initial MBMS bearer announcement message announces one MBMS bearer intended to carry a general purpose MBMS subchannel used for application level multicast signaling in a specified MBMS service area and additionally, the message could also announce zero or more extra MBMS bearers intended to carry media and media control.

q_37206.question: What type of structure is used to define the "ParentTImeSource" enumerated type in the 3GPP TS 38.300 standard?
q_37206.ground_truth: The "ParentTImeSource" enumerated type is defined as ENUMERATED in the 3GPP TS 38.300 standard, which indicates that it represents a set of predefined options rather than a specific value. These options include synce, ptp, gnss, atomicclock, terrestrialradio, serialtimecode, ntp, handset, and other.

q_37207.question: What does the SMF do after receiving the user consent for URSP enforcement reporting?
q_37207.ground_truth: The SMF provisions the information of user consent for URSP enforcement reporting to the UE, which allows the UE to report the URSP Rule Precedence only when the user consent part of the URSP rule is "YES".

q_37208.question: What is the period of measurement for mean power measurement in NR-DC additional spurious emissions in Release-16?
q_37208.ground_truth: The period of measurement shall be at least the continuous duration of 1ms over consecutive active uplink slots for PC1.5, where the measured power is the sum of the two ports. For TDD, only slots consisting of only UL symbols are under test.

q_37209.question: When is the SN Release procedure used?
q_37209.ground_truth: The SN Release procedure is used to initiate the release of the UE context and relevant resources at the SN. It can be initiated either by the MN (Master Node) or by the SN (Secondary Node).

q_37210.question: Which 3GPP specification is used by the MCData-2 reference point to obtain information about a specific user from the MCData user database?
q_37210.ground_truth: The MCData-2 reference point utilises a diameter management application protocol as defined in 3GPP TS 29.283.

q_37211.question: If the UE is in state 5GMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION-UPDATE and timer T3511 expires, what should the UE do?
q_37211.ground_truth: Trigger the registration update procedure again

q_37212.question: What is the Target to Source Transparent Container used for in step 7a and step 8a?
q_37212.ground_truth: The Target to Source Transparent Container sent in step 7a and step 8a includes the same allocation of CS and PS resources.

q_37213.question: What is the effect of the seek() method on the earliest media time?
q_37213.ground_truth: The earliest media time is set to the mediaTime.

q_37214.question: What must the <err> value in the CMAR command refer to?

q_37215.question: Which action does a UE take if it is capable of MBMS Service Continuity and receiving or interested to receive an MBMS service, and can only receive this MBMS service while camping on a frequency on which it is provided?
q_37215.ground_truth: The UE may consider that frequency to be the highest priority during the MBMS session, as long as the reselected cell is broadcasting SIB13 and meets certain conditions related to the USD of this service.

q_37216.question: What information does the UPF send in the "end marker" packets when switching the path for N3 tunnels?
q_37216.ground_truth: The "end marker" packets sent by the UPF in N3 tunnels contain information to assist the reordering function in the Target NG-RAN after switching the path.

q_37217.question: What is the minimum number of times the "Corner" element can appear in the "PolygonAreaType" complexType?
q_37217.ground_truth: The "Corner" element in the "PolygonAreaType" complexType can appear at least 3 times.

q_37218.question: What is the S-NSSAI-ExtIEs NGAP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION means?
q_37218.ground_truth: It is the set of extensions that can be used in the S-NSSAI (Slice of Network Slice of Satellite or Terrestrial Area Identification) sequence, which is used to specify information related to the defined identifiers in the S1AP (Session Management information).

q_37219.question: What is the difference between the "uncertainty" and the "high accuracy uncertainty" in the context of a point?
q_37219.ground_truth: The uncertainty has a smaller range with a resolution of less than 3 meters, while the high accuracy uncertainty has a resolution of less than 5 millimeters for latitude and less than 10 millimeters for longitude.

q_37220.question: What is the measurement uncertainty tolerance interval for a specific measurement that contains 95% of the performance of a population of test equipment, as specified in clause 4.1.2 of the document?
q_37220.ground_truth: The measurement uncertainty tolerance interval is not specified in the clause 4.1.2, but instead, the uncertainties in clause 4.1.2 apply to the Test System operating into a nominal 50 ohm load and do not include system effects due to mismatch between the DUT and the Test System.

q_37221.question: What does the acronym "3DOF" stand for and how many degrees of freedom does it refer to?
q_37221.ground_truth: 3DOF stands for 3 Degrees of freedom, and it refers to the ability to look around and listen from a center point in 3D space.

q_37222.question: What should a UE with IMS voice over PS session capability do when initiating an emergency call if the network does not support IMS voice over PS sessions in N1 mode?
q_37222.ground_truth: The UE should not perform a local release of any emergency PDU session if user-plane resources associated with that emergency PDU session are established and the AMF does not indicate that the PDU session is in 5GSM state PDU SESSION INACTIVE via the PDU session status IE.

q_37223.question: Upon which operation is the PDU Session Resource Modify Indication procedure successful?
q_37223.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node initiates a successful modification procedure by sending a PDU SESSION RESOURCE MODIFY INDICATION message which is then processed by the AMF and SMF.

q_37224.question: For which channel bandwidths should the tests be done when the widest supported channel bandwidth is not specified for a particular subcarrier spacing?
q_37224.ground_truth: The tests should be done by using the performance requirement for the closest channel bandwidth lower than the widest supported bandwidth, and the tested PRBs should be centered in the widest supported channel bandwidth.

q_37225.question: How does Solution #61 propose to improve the accuracy of an existing ML model?
q_37225.ground_truth: Solution #61 proposes further training of an existing ML model instead of training a new ML model. The further trained ML model is then provisioned by NWDAF containing MTLF to NWDAF containing AnLF. The further training process is initiated if no exact match for an ML model with respect to the filter information from a service consumer is found in ADRF.

q_37226.question: What HEVC video profile is required to be supported for a 5GMS UE that supports the transmission of video?
q_37226.ground_truth: The HEVC-FullHD-Enc video profile is required to be supported for a 5GMS UE that supports the transmission of video.

q_37227.question: What information must be provided for the longitude and latitude of a point coordinate type?
q_37227.ground_truth: The longitude and latitude specify the specific point on the Earth represented by a set of coordinates.

q_37228.question: What is the method of generating TC4 when a BS supports only one GSM carrier and one E-UTRA carrier?
q_37228.ground_truth: Place a GSM carrier at the lower edge and an E-UTRA carrier at the upper Base Station RF Bandwidth edge, with the specified FOFFSET-RAT applying. Also place two GSM carriers at the edges using 600 kHz spacing. If possible, add additional E-UTRA carriers in the middle of the Base Station RF Bandwidth.

q_37229.question: What are the three main components of a ProSe discovery message defined in subclause 11.2.2?
q_37229.ground_truth: The three main components of a ProSe discovery message defined in subclause 11.2.2 are the XML schema, the MIME type, and the format of the PC5_DISCOVERY message transmitted over the PC5 interface.

q_37230.question: What actions should the transmission control server take when it stops receiving RTP media packets from another transmission participant on uplink or upon receiving a Transmission End Notify message from the reception control arbitration logic?
q_37230.ground_truth: The transmission control server should send the Transmission End Notify message to the transmission participant, decrease C9 by 1 if it has not reached its lower limit, remove the SSRC of the user transmitting the media from Active SSRC list, and if C9 has reached its lower limit, enter the 'U: not permitted to receive' state.

q_37231.question: What is the formula used for calculating the average DL UE throughput in gNB?
q_37231.ground_truth: The average DL UE throughput in gNB is calculated as the summation of ThpVolDl divided by the summation of ThpTimeDl and multiplied by 1000, expressed as kbit/s. Separate counters are maintained for each mapped 5QI or QCI for option 3, and for each supported S-NSSAI, PLMN ID, and Active BWP.

q_37232.question: What is the function of the P-Charging-Vector header field in the overflow procedure?
q_37232.ground_truth: The P-Charging-Vector header field is used to identify the sending network of the request and is used in the P-Charging-Vector header field to represent the IOI (Interface Identifier) of the network.

q_37233.question: What are the two scenarios defined for the number of RX beams per UE in RAN4 discussion?
q_37233.ground_truth: Scenario A has 2 RX beams for all scenarios, and Scenario B has 6 RX beams for all scenarios.

q_37234.question: What is a PDU session in 5G?
q_37234.ground_truth: A PDU session is a point-to-point communication session between a user equipment (UE) and a data network, established by the 5G system.

q_37235.question: What is the minimum requirement for the UE to be able to evaluate the downlink radio link quality on a CSI-RS resource for RLM, with respect to the CSI-RS resource in the active TCI state of CORESET?
q_37235.ground_truth: The requirement does not apply when the CSI-RS resource in the active TCI state of CORESET is the same CSI-RS resource for RLM and the TCI state information of the CSI-RS resource is not given, wherein the TCI state information means QCL Type-D to SSB for L1-RSRP or CSI-RS with repetition ON.

q_37236.question: Under what conditions do the relative PRS-RSRP accuracy requirements apply for FR1?
q_37236.ground_truth: The relative PRS-RSRP accuracy requirements apply for the cases when PRS-RSRP is measured from PRS resources in the same PRS resource set in FR1, and measured with same Rx beam.

q_37237.question: What is the purpose of the 5G Preferred Network Behaviour in the context of CIoT?
q_37237.ground_truth: The 5G Preferred Network Behaviour indicates the network behavior that the UE can support and what it would prefer to use during registration.

q_37238.question: What is supported in the NR-DC to NR-DC handover scenario?
q_37238.ground_truth: Direct data forwarding from source SN to target MN, from source SN to target SN and from source MN to target SN is supported.

q_37239.question: What should a Multi-USIM UE in ECM-IDLE state do upon receiving a paging indication in E-UTRAN access, when it decides not to accept the paging?
q_37239.ground_truth: The UE attempts to send a Reject Paging Indication via the UE Triggered Service Request procedure, unless it is unable to do so.

q_37240.question: What is the relationship between EDGEAPP, ETSI MEC, and EAS in the ETSI MEC 003 framework?
q_37240.ground_truth: Both EDGEAPP and ETSI MEC can provide support for hosting different edge applications. In some implementations, the EAS and MEC application can be collocated.

q_37241.question: What is the maximum time a sender will keep an original RTP packet in its buffers available for retransmission?
q_37241.ground_truth: The "rtx-time" payload-format-specific parameter indicates the maximum time a sender will keep an original RTP packet in its buffers available for retransmission.

q_37242.question: What should the SCC AS do when receiving SIP 2xx response(s) to the SIP UPDATE request(s) triggered by the SIP INVITE request transferring additional session for dual radio?
q_37242.ground_truth: The SCC AS shall send a SIP 18x response with the status code corresponding to the latest SIP 18x response following the rules of 3GPP TS 24.229 received from remote leg in the dialog to the SIP INVITE request transferring additional session for PS to CS for dual radio containing the relevant media parameter of the SDP answer in the received SIP 2xx response.

q_37243.question: When would the SMFMAPDUSessionRelease record be used to report the release of a PDN Connection?
q_37243.ground_truth: The SMFMAPDUSessionRelease record is used to report the release of a PDN Connection when the IRI-POI present in the SMF+PGW-C detects that an MA PDU Session or PDN Connection associated to an MA PDU Session has been released for the target UE.

q_37244.question: What types of NR UE does the test in section 6.7.9.1.2 apply to, starting from Release 16?
q_37244.ground_truth: The test applies to all types of NR UE from Release 16 onwards, as long as they support L1-SINR measurements.

q_37245.question: What is the role of the SM PCF in solution 6.2?
q_37245.ground_truth: The SM PCF is responsible for registering and updating the tuple (UE address(es), SUPI, GPSI, DNN, S-NSSAI, PCF address(es), PCF instance id, PCF Set ID) for a PDU Session.

q_37246.question: What are the two mobility scenarios when UEs are continuously served by a mobile base station relay?
q_37246.ground_truth: The two mobility scenarios are A) mobility within the same IAB-donor gNB, where the mobile base station relay moves within a limited geographical area while keeping the same IAB-donor gNB; B) mobility between different IAB-donor gNBs, where the mobile base station relay moves over a long distance and connects with different IAB-donor gNBs.

q_37247.question: When is the sr-ProhibitTimer started for a specific SR bundle?
q_37247.ground_truth: The sr-ProhibitTimer is started in the first TTI of an SR bundle.

q_37248.question: What is the purpose of the "re-ordering info" parameter in the MPQUIC-IP steering functionality?
q_37248.ground_truth: The "re-ordering info" parameter in the MPQUIC-IP steering functionality is used to indicate whether the MPQUIC-IP steering functionality should perform packet re-ordering or offload the re-ordering procedure to the application.

q_37249.question: What is one explainability-related indicator for ML entities?
q_37249.ground_truth: Evaluating monotonicity, a quantitative metric for explainability, measures the effect of individual features on ML entity performance.

q_37250.question: In what scenario is the Home Network Public Key identifier used for UDM discovery?
q_37250.ground_truth: The Home Network Public Key identifier is used for UDM discovery in the scenario where the NF consumers belong to the same PLMN as the AUSF.

q_37251.question: What is the purpose of sending a SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message in a NAS security mode control procedure?
q_37251.ground_truth: The SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message is used to indicate that the UE has completed the 5G NAS security context setup or the re-establishment of a 5G NAS security context with the selected 5GS integrity and ciphering algorithms, as specified in the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message.

q_37252.question: What is the purpose of the Overload Start procedure?
q_37252.ground_truth: The Overload Start procedure is used by the MME to indicate to a proportion of eNBs that the MME is overloaded and needs to reject or permit certain RRC connections.

q_37253.question: What is communicated to the user when the transmission control server uses request queueing and determines that the user's request has been granted permission to transmit a video?
q_37253.ground_truth: A "queued" indication is generated for the user when the request is granted permission to transmit a video.

q_37254.question: What is the purpose of the UE radio capability provisioning service?
q_37254.ground_truth: The UE radio capability provisioning service, provided by the UE radio Capability Management Function (UCMF), allows NF service consumers to create, update, and delete UCMF dictionary entries for Manufacturer-assigned UE Radio Capability IDs.

q_37255.question: What is the purpose of SCI format 2-C?
q_37255.ground_truth: SCI format 2-C is used for the decoding of PSSCH and providing inter-UE coordination information or requesting inter-UE coordination information. It can be used only for unicast.

q_37256.question: What message is sent by the MME to the UE if a detach is requested by the HSS for a UE that has bearers for emergency services?
q_37256.ground_truth: The MME sends a DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message to the UE for all bearers that are not allocated for emergency services.

q_37257.question: What type of SIP MESSAGE request is sent to the MCPTT client containing a Content-Type header field set to "application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml" and an XML body with a `<mcptt-info>` root element and an `<anyExt>` element with a `<response-type>` element set to "remotely-initiated-private-call-response"?
q_37257.ground_truth: This type of SIP MESSAGE request is known as a "SIP MESSAGE request for remotely initiated private call response for terminating client".

q_37258.question: What is the role of the local MCVideo system in an interconnected MCVideo system when the controlling MCVideo function is in a different trust domain?
q_37258.ground_truth: The local MCVideo system can route the SIP request through an MCVideo gateway server that acts as an exit point from the local MCVideo system to the interconnected MCVideo system.

q_37259.question: What is the maximum number of Timing Advance Reports that can be included in a MAC PDU?
q_37259.ground_truth: Only one Timing Advance Report MAC CE shall be included in a MAC PDU, even when multiple events have triggered a Timing Advance report.

q_37260.question: What is the behavior of imminent peril calls in LMR systems without group emergency state tracking?
q_37260.ground_truth: For any user talking on an emergency group, the portion of the call transported by the MCPTT system will receive emergency priority, while only a UE in emergency state will be given emergency priority on the LMR system when talking.

q_37261.question: What is needed for a UE to be able to initiate a PC5 unicast link security mode control procedure with a target UE?
q_37261.ground_truth: A PC5 unicast link, the target UE's layer-2 ID for unicast communication, and T5008 timer

q_37262.question: What is the condition for the SP field to be set to 1 in the Truncated Enhanced BFR MAC CE when included in a MAC PDU as part of the Random Access Procedure?
q_37262.ground_truth: The SP field is set to 1 in the Truncated Enhanced BFR MAC CE when beam failure is detected for the SpCell, and the Random Access procedure is initiated for beam failure recovery.

q_37263.question: In what type of message would a 5G DDNMF send a response-reject element with PC3a control protocol cause value #3?

q_37264.question: What are the requirements for FR2 that are applicable to both FR2-1 and FR2-2, excluding specific cases?
q_37264.ground_truth: The requirements for FR2 that are applicable to both FR2-1 and FR2-2, excluding specific cases, include SFTD measurement requirements, CGI identification requirements, and inter-band CA requirements, which are only applicable to FR2-1.

q_37265.question: What should the UE do when it is in E-UTRA RRC_CONNECTED state and it detects radio link failure on expiring of timer T310?
q_37265.ground_truth: The UE should start timer T311 and send RRCConnectionReestablishmentRequest message with ul-NAS-MAC-r14.

q_37266.question: In the context of EN-DC including FR1 and FR2 NR carriers, what is the applicable NR CQI reporting requirements?
q_37266.ground_truth: The NR CQI reporting requirements are specified in Clause 10.2B.1.1 and Clause 10.2B.1.2.

q_37267.question: What is the condition for an inter-frequency SSB measurement to be defined as a measurement without gap?
q_37267.ground_truth: An inter-frequency SSB measurement is defined as a measurement without gap, if the SSB is completely contained in the active BWP of the UE, and the UE supports interFrequencyMeas-Nogap-r16.

q_37268.question: What type of element is the "ProSe-Response-Code" in the "restricted-discoveree-response" element?
q_37268.ground_truth: The "ProSe-Response-Code" is an element defined in clause11.4.2.35.

q_37269.question: What is the UL HARQ RTT Timer length for NB-IoT when multiple TBs are scheduled by PDCCH?
q_37269.ground_truth: The UL HARQ RTT Timer length for NB-IoT is set to 1 subframe plus RTToffset +deltaPDCCH when multiple TBs are scheduled by PDCCH.

q_37270.question: When should a UE consider other cells for cell selection/reselection if it encounters a cell that is "reserved for operator use" for the registered or selected PLMN?
q_37270.ground_truth: The UE should consider other cells for cell selection/reselection if the cell is "reserved for operator use" for the registered or selected PLMN, even if the cell is not barred.

q_37271.question: What action by the PTC server will trigger the generation of a PTCAccessPolicy record in an xIRI?
q_37271.ground_truth: The IRI-POI present in the PTC server will generate a PTCAccessPolicy record in an xIRI when the PTC server receives a SIP PUBLISH from a PTC target to change the access control lists (e.g. PTC user access policy and PTC group authorization rules) located in the PTC XML Document Management Server (XDMS).

q_37272.question: What is the maximum output power for a UE in power class 3, as specified in clause 6.2.2?
q_37272.ground_truth: The maximum output power for a UE in power class 3 is specified in clause 6.2.2 of the document.

q_37273.question: When interworking with DN (Multicast Routing Protocol), what is the function of the UPF acting as PIM router?
q_37273.ground_truth: The UPF receives multicast packets originated from multicast source via PIM function. The SMF determines whether to use PIM-SM or PIM-DM for interworking with the IP network based on local policy.

q_37274.question: What does the PCF use to identify an IP PDU session?
q_37274.ground_truth: The PCF uses the UE IP address to identify the IP PDU session.

q_37275.question: What should the VLR do when it receives an SGsAP-IMSI-DETACH-INDICATION message indicating "Explicit UE initiated IMSI detach from non-EPS services"?
q_37275.ground_truth: The VLR marks the SGs association as "IMSI detached for non-EPS services".

q_37276.question: How does the UE set the contents of the RRCSetupRequest message in 5.3.3.3?
q_37276.ground_truth: The UE shall set the contents of RRCSetupRequest message by setting the ue-Identity as a 39-bit random value, or ng-5G-S-TMSI if provided, and the establishmentCause to mps-PriorityAccess if the release with redirect with mpsPriorityIndication is received, or in accordance with the information received from upper layers. The UE shall submit the RRCSetupRequest message to lower layers for transmission.

q_37277.question: What is the prerequisite for the MAC-CE based TCI state switch delay if the target TCI state is unknown?
q_37277.ground_truth: If the target TCI state is unknown, the TCI state switch command must be received within 1280 ms upon the last transmission of the RS resource for beam reporting or measurement.

q_37278.question: When is it necessary for a UE to initiate a tracking area updating procedure with a UE radio capability information update needed IE in the message?
q_37278.ground_truth: A UE needs to initiate a tracking area updating procedure with a UE radio capability information update needed IE in the message in the following cases: n, zc, ze, zh, zb (as specified in NOTE~3), l, r.

q_37279.question: What sidelink logical channel can be mapped to SL-BCH?
q_37279.ground_truth: The SBCCH can be mapped to SL-BCH in Sidelink.

q_37280.question: How does the UE check the ANID for WiMAX access networks?
q_37280.ground_truth: The UE checks the ANID for WiMAX access networks by applying the rules for comparison of the locally determined ANID and the one received over EAP-AKA as specified in RFC 5448.

q_37281.question: What is the significance of the "qop" header field parameter in the S-CSCF's authentication challenge?
q_37281.ground_truth: The "qop" header field parameter is used to specify the quality of protection used in the authentication request and should be set to "auth" if not provided. It helps to protect against replay attacks and ensures the integrity of the communication between the UE and the S-CSCF.

q_37282.question: In Test 1, what should the UE do if the first 4 preamble transmission attempts do not match the transmitted random access preamble?
q_37282.ground_truth: The UE should re-select a preamble and transmit with the calculated NPRACH transmission power when the backoff time expires if all received random access response contain random access preamble identifiers that do not match the transmitted random access preamble.

q_37283.question: What are the types of certificates for Network Functions used in SBA?
q_37283.ground_truth: The types of certificates for Network Functions used in SBA include TLS client/server EE certificates, certificates for signing the access tokens for authorization, certificates for encrypting HTTP messages between SEPPs, and certificates for signing Client credentials assertion (CCA) tokens.

q_37284.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for GNSS as a synchronization reference source in NR sidelink, as defined in clause 9.1.1.0.1?
q_37284.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements for GNSS as a synchronization reference source in NR sidelink are defined in clause 9.1.1.0.1.

q_37285.question: What message is included in the RESET message to explicitly identify the UE association(s) to be reset?
q_37285.ground_truth: The MME UE S1AP ID IE and/or the eNB UE S1AP ID IE are included in the UE-associated logical S1-connection Item IE to explicitly identify the UE association(s) to be reset in the RESET message.

q_37286.question: Which type of information is the Sequence Number IE indicative of and what is its value coded as?
q_37286.ground_truth: The Sequence Number IE contains an Unsigned32 binary integer value.

q_37287.question: What is the response from the SMF upon successful creation of a SM context resource?
q_37287.ground_truth: The SMF shall return a 201 Created response with the "Location" header present, which contains the URI of the created SM context resource.

q_37288.question: What is included in all types of xIRI parameters?
q_37288.ground_truth: All types of xIRI parameters include the target identity, time stamp, location information, and correlation information.

q_37289.question: What is the role of the AMF when receiving a URSP notification from the UE?
q_37289.ground_truth: The AMF forwards the UE Policy Container received from the UE to the PCF as a Namf_Communication_N1MessageNotify request.

q_37290.question: What is the response of the AMF if the UE is in CM-CONNECTED state when the EnableUEReachability service operation is invoked?
q_37290.ground_truth: If the UE is in CM-CONNECTED state, the AMF shall immediately respond using the "200 OK" status code, with content containing an "EnableUeReachabilityRspData" object.

q_37291.question: What must the AMF do if it receives the Mobile IAB Node Indication IE in the INITIAL UE MESSAGE message and supports it?
q_37291.ground_truth: The AMF shall consider that the message is related to a mobile IAB-node.

q_37292.question: What should the UE do upon the expiry of the T3540 timer if the service request procedure is initiated in 5GMM-IDLE mode and there are no user-plane resources established for PDU sessions?
q_37292.ground_truth: The UE should locally release the N1 NAS signalling connection and initiate the registration procedure as specified in subclause 5.5.1.3.

q_37293.question: How many keys are in the chain of secondary signing keys, if TESLA is used?
q_37293.ground_truth: If TESLA is used, the chain of secondary signing keys contains 1023 keys of 256bit each.

q_37294.question: What are the conditions for unsynchronized TDD base stations to transmit without special co-location requirements?
q_37294.ground_truth: Unsynchronized TDD base stations can transmit without special co-location requirements if they are deployed in the same geographical area, use the same or adjacent operating bands, and are unsynchronized.

q_37295.question: What radio link monitoring requirements does the test verify for HD-FDD CE UEs?
q_37295.ground_truth: The test verifies that the HD-FDD CE UE can properly detect the out-of-sync and in-sync states for monitoring downlink radio link quality of the PCell when DRX is used.

q_37296.question: What is the purpose of the UE Context Resume procedure?
q_37296.ground_truth: The UE Context Resume procedure resumes the UE context, the suspended UE-associated logical NG-connection and the related NG-U transport bearer in the 5GC for a specific UE.

q_37297.question: What is the HTTP status code used in the case of redirection?
q_37297.ground_truth: The NRF returns 3xx status code in the case of redirection.

q_37298.question: What is the difference between the sCellDeactivationTimer actions in TS 38.321 and TS 38.133, except for CSI reporting on an activated serving cell?
q_37298.ground_truth: In TS 38.321, the UE applies the corresponding actions immediately, while in TS 38.133, the UE applies them no later than the minimum requirement.

q_37299.question: What should the algorithm do if the UE selects GNSS as the synchronization reference for NR sidelink communication?
q_37299.ground_truth: If the UE chooses GNSS as the synchronization reference for NR sidelink communication, the algorithm should evaluate the PSBCH-RSRP of the candidate SyncRef UE concerning GNSS. It should choose the candidate SyncRef UE that has a higher priority group and meets the minimum requirement by sl-SyncRefMinHyst.

q_37300.question: Which type of identifier in the 5G ProSe Direct Discovery is used as a code to restrict access to certain ProSe applications?
q_37300.ground_truth: The ProSe Restricted Code is the identifier in the 5G ProSe Direct Discovery that is used as a code to restrict access to certain ProSe applications.

q_37301.question: What is the purpose of the "MCVideo group ID" information element in the message format?
q_37301.ground_truth: The "MCVideo group ID" information element is used to indicate the destination MCVideo group identifier in the message.

q_37302.question: What is the challenge faced in model inference when using a fixed collection frequency mechanism for data collection?
q_37302.ground_truth: If the collection rate is too high, it will lead to excessive consumption of network resources. On the contrary, if the rate is too low, information loss and inaccurate measurement may be caused, and accurate analysis may not be possible in some key scenarios.

q_37303.question: What does the "1st digit" in the 3GPP version number indicate?
q_37303.ground_truth: The "1st digit" in the 3GPP version number indicates the level of approval of the document within the TSG.

q_37304.question: Who is responsible for sending uplink power control "up" commands in the test described in 6.2D.2.4.2?
q_37304.ground_truth: The SS (test system) is responsible for sending uplink power control "up" commands in the test described in 6.2D.2.4.2.

q_37305.question: What is the principle of operation for a repeater in terms of performance assessment?
q_37305.ground_truth: The parameter used for assessment of performance of a repeater is the gain within the operating band.

q_37306.question: What is replaced when interworking with 5GS is supported and a "SMF+PGW-C" is selected for a PDN connection?
q_37306.ground_truth: IP-CAN Session Establishment procedure, IP-CAN Session Modification procedure, IP-CAN Session Termination procedure are replaced by equivalent procedures in SM Policy Association Establishment Procedure, SM Policy Association Modification procedure and SM Policy Association Termination procedure respectively.

q_37307.question: What is the measurement restriction for CSI-RS based L1-RSRP when the CSI-RS for L1-RSRP measurement is in the same OFDM symbol as another CSI-RS for L1-RSRP measurement?
q_37307.ground_truth: The UE is required to measure the CSI-RSRP for L1-RSRP without any restriction.

q_37308.question: What are the media types that may be supported during an IMS MES?
q_37308.ground_truth: Real-time video, session mode text-based instant messaging, file transfer, video clip sharing, picture sharing, audio clip sharing, voice, and Real-Time Text.

q_37309.question: What is the requirement for Transmit Diversity for inter-band Uplink Carrier Aggregation with Transmit Diversity in one of the two frequency bands for the receiver tests?
q_37309.ground_truth: Unless otherwise stated, the receiver requirements of inter-band UL CA are applicable to UE with one Tx antenna connector in each of the two bands, or UE with one Tx antenna connector in one band and two Tx antenna connectors in the other band.

q_37310.question: What is the issue described in section 5.1b regarding autonomous network level for RAN UE throughput optimization?
q_37310.ground_truth: The issue described in section 5.1b is that the solutions for generic MnS requirements of autonomous network level for RAN UE throughput optimization are not well defined, and it is necessary to analyze the solutions for corresponding MnS requirements.

q_37311.question: What factors can influence the way UEs receive MBS data?
q_37311.ground_truth: UE preferences: UEs could prefer to receive MBS data in RRC inactive state to reduce their battery consumption, or in RRC connected state to increase the service quality.

q_37312.question: When can GRUU processing be required by the S-CSCF?
q_37312.ground_truth: GRUU processing is required if the S-CSCF determines that an original dialog identifier is not present and the contact address contains a GRUU assigned by the S-CSCF or a temporary GRUU self-assigned by the UE.

q_37313.question: What is the framing and format used to deliver a notification towards the SCS/AS via Websocket?
q_37313.ground_truth: The SCEF embeds a structure with a "3GPP-WS-Notif-Seq:" header, HTTP headers, and the actual content of the notification into a Websocket data frame. The framing is aligned as much as possible with HTTP delivery for simplicity.

q_37314.question: What attribute is used to specify the timestamp in the "Coverage-info" complex type?
q_37314.ground_truth: The "timestamp" attribute is used to specify the timestamp in the "Coverage-info" complex type.

q_37315.question: What does BAP PDUs stand for in IAB architecture?
q_37315.ground_truth: BAP PDUs stands for Backhaul Adaptation Protocol Protocol Data Units.

q_37316.question: What happens if the source RAN (NG-RAN, E-UTRAN) decides to cancel the handover to the target system during the handover procedure?
q_37316.ground_truth: The source RAN initiates a handover cancel message to the source CN node (AMF or MME), which then sends a Relocation Cancel Request message to the target CN node. The target CN node triggers release of resources towards the target RAN node and sends a Relocation Cancel Response towards the source CN node, which in turn responds with a handover cancel ACK towards the source RAN.

q_37317.question: What triggers the UE to transmit a type 1 SRS for DCI formats 0/0A/0B/6-0A/6-1A in LTE?
q_37317.ground_truth: A type 1 SRS is triggered for DCI formats 0/0A/0B/6-0A/6-1A if the value of the SRS request field in DCI format 0/0A/0B/6-0A/6-1A is set to '1'.

q_37318.question: How does the measurement definition template describe measurements in this subclause?
q_37318.ground_truth: The measurement definition template describes the measurements using a descriptive name of the measurement type, collection method, condition, measurement result, measurement type, measurement object class, switching technology, and generation.

q_37319.question: What is the data type of the "hang-time" element in the "private-callType" complex type?
q_37319.ground_truth: The data type of the "hang-time" element in the "private-callType" complex type is xs:duration.

q_37320.question: What is the reporting range for RS-SINR measurement accuracy requirements in 9.1.17.2 of the document?
q_37320.ground_truth: The reporting range for RS-SINR measurement accuracy requirements is the same as the guaranteed accuracy range in the document.

q_37321.question: What is the purpose of the N41 reference point in the 5G connection and mobility charging architecture?
q_37321.ground_truth: The N41 reference point is defined for the interactions between the AMF and H-CHF in the 5G connection and mobility charging architecture.

q_37322.question: What is the difference between the "AO", "OI", and "OX" parameters in the Facility lock command?
q_37322.ground_truth: The "AO" parameter is used to bar all outgoing calls, the "OI" parameter is used to bar outgoing international calls, and the "OX" parameter is used to bar outgoing international calls except to the home country.

q_37323.question: What should the AMF do after completing the registration procedure if the UE has included the Non-3GPP path switching information IE with NSONR bit set in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message and the AMF supports non-3GPP path switching while using old non-3GPP resources?
q_37323.ground_truth: The AMF shall not release the user plane resources of the old non-3GPP access of the PDU sessions supporting non-3GPP access path switching and whose PDU session IDs are included in the Uplink data status IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message until the user plane resources of the new non-3GPP access are established.

q_37324.question: What should be the state of the CC entity and call control timers when initiating the assignment phase during mobile terminating call establishment?
q_37324.ground_truth: Initiating the assignment phase does not directly change the state of a CC entity nor affect any call control timers.

q_37325.question: What message is sent by the UE when a URSP rule is not allowed due to notification component restrictions?
q_37325.ground_truth: The UE sends a URSP Notification via a UL NAS TRANSPORT message, indicating the rejection of the URSP rule and the reason for rejection.

q_37326.question: What procedure is used for termination of the continuous reporting of network status?
q_37326.ground_truth: The removal procedure for continuous reporting of network status involves the SCEF detecting the end of the requested Duration for an ongoing continuous reporting, identifying the corresponding SCEF Reference ID, and sending a Cancel Network Status Response (Cause) message to the SCS/AS.

q_37327.question: What are the expected service lifetime and considerations for the communication infrastructure used in energy systems?
q_37327.ground_truth: The expected service lifetime of energy system communication services is decades, as they serve an extended period of time, similar to the energy system components' expected lifetime. Communication infrastructure components must consider interworking with legacy deployments due to the long service lifetime.

q_37328.question: What is the role of the non-controlling MCPTT function in an MCPTT group?
q_37328.ground_truth: The non-controlling MCPTT function of an MCPTT group receives and transmits floor control messages from and to the MCPTT client via the participating MCPTT function. It also distributes floor control messages to and from the floor control server in the controlling or non-controlling MCPTT function.

q_37329.question: What is the purpose of the Remove Traffic Endpoint IE in the context of EPC?
q_37329.ground_truth: The Remove Traffic Endpoint IE can be used in EPC to delete a bearer for which multiple PDRs exist with the same Traffic Endpoint ID.

q_37330.question: What should be the length of the MCPTT Group Identity value if it is not a multiple of 4 bytes?
q_37330.ground_truth: If the MCPTT Group Identity value is not a multiple of 4 bytes, it should be padded to the nearest multiple of 4 bytes, with the padding bytes set to zero.

q_37331.question: What should the UE do if it cannot provide the requested identity in the IDENTITY RESPONSE message during the identification procedure in the 5G system?
q_37331.ground_truth: The UE should encode the identity type as "no identity" in the IDENTITY RESPONSE message.

q_37332.question: What is MLB, or Major League Baseball?
q_37332.ground_truth: The professional baseball league in the United States and Canada

q_37333.question: What is the condition that must be fulfilled for inter-frequency channel occupancy measurements when using a single measurement gap pattern for all concurrent inter-frequency measurements?
q_37333.ground_truth: The entire RSSI measurement duration used for channel occupancy measurement should be contained in the measurement gap.

q_37334.question: What is a key feature of the STAR-based architecture for immersive interactive media distribution?
q_37334.ground_truth: The STAR-based architecture places most of the rendering on the user device, with some processing done on the server side.

q_37335.question: What action should the gNB-CU-UP take if it receives a BC BEARER CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message but cannot establish the requested resources?
q_37335.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-UP should respond with the BC BEARER CONTEXT SETUP FAILURE message and an appropriate cause value.

q_37336.question: What is the purpose of the test for UCI BLER performance requirements for IAB DU?
q_37336.ground_truth: The test shall verify the receiver's ability to detect UCI under multipath fading propagation conditions for a given SNR.

q_37337.question: What type of interfaces do network functions within the 5GC Control Plane use for their interactions?
q_37337.ground_truth: Network functions within the 5GC Control Plane only use service-based interfaces for their interactions.

q_37338.question: What should the MCPTT client do when timer TFP1 expires, and the value of the counter CFP1 is equal to the upper limit, in the "Q2: in-progress emergency private call" state?
q_37338.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should release the stored current call type, release the stored ProSe per-packet priority, and enter the "Q0: waiting for the call to be established" state.

q_37339.question: What is the condition for a UE to measure the CSI-IM without restriction for L1-SINR measurement in FR2?
q_37339.ground_truth: When both CSI-RSs are not in any CSI-RS resource set with repetition ON, the two CSI-RS resources and both PDSCHs are overlapped on the same OFDM symbol, one CSI-RS has the same QCL source as the active TCI state of one PDSCH, and the other CSI-RS has the same QCL source as the active TCI state of the other PDSCH, and the resources of the active TCI states for the two PDSCHs have been reported as a resource group in Rel-17 group-based RSRP report.

q_37340.question: How many carrier frequency layers, including one serving carrier frequency, should the UE be capable of monitoring in total?
q_37340.ground_truth: The UE should be capable of monitoring a total of at least 5 carrier frequency layers.

q_37341.question: Under which circumstances should a floor participant send a Floor Release message towards other floor participants if no queued requests exist?
q_37341.ground_truth: A floor participant should send a Floor Release message towards other floor participants if no queued requests exist when the MCPTT user releases permission to send RTP media, and if the session is not initiated as a broadcast group call with the B-bit set to '1' (Broadcast group call). The Floor Release message should include the MCPTT ID of the MCPTT user in the User ID field and a Floor Indicator field set to '0' (normal call).

q_37342.question: What action should the non-controlling MCPTT function take if it receives information about the current speaker from the media plane?
q_37342.ground_truth: Cache the information about the current speaker(s).

q_37343.question: What should the EES do if the UE location is outside the Geographical or Topological Service Area of an EAS?
q_37343.ground_truth: The EES shall not include this EAS in the EAS discovery notification.

q_37344.question: What are the limitations of glTF 2.0 in regards to immersive applications?
q_37344.ground_truth: glTF 2.0 has traditionally been focused on static scenes and assets, which makes it unfit to address the requirements and needs of dynamic and rich 3D scenes in immersive environments. It lacks support for timed media, audio, local and real-time media, and interactions with the scene.

q_37345.question: What should the MCPTT client include in the Contact header field of the SIP 180 (Ringing) response when sending a SIP INVITE request during manual commencement mode for private calls?
q_37345.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should include the g.3gpp.mcptt media feature tag and the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag containing the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcptt" in the Contact header field of the SIP 180 (Ringing) response.

q_37346.question: What is the primary purpose of the TTI insertion uncertainty in the test requirement?
q_37346.ground_truth: TTI insertion uncertainty in the test requirement is the delay resulted when inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH. It is added to the measurement reporting delays to ensure that the actual overall delays measured in the test match the requirements.

q_37347.question: What is the total radiated power defined in for both the near-field and far-field regions?

q_37348.question: In case of more than one UL-SCH transport block transmitted in a subframe of an UL cell, when is the AUL-UCI multiplexed with data on the UL-SCH transport block?
q_37348.ground_truth: The AUL-UCI is multiplexed with data on the UL-SCH transport block with the highest IMSCS value that is indicated by the AUL activation DCI.

q_37349.question: What is the condition for allowing the interruption during RRC-based BWP switching when it involves other parameter changes apart from SCS and the UE is not capable of per-UE measurement gap?
q_37349.ground_truth: Interruptions are not allowed during BWP switch involving other parameter change.

q_37350.question: What is the purpose of sending rejected NSSAI to the UDM in 5G network?
q_37350.ground_truth: The purpose is to assist the UDM to steer the UE to the PLMN supporting rejected NSSAI. During the registration procedure in a VPLMN, if the AMF determines that a S-NSSAI is not allowed, the AMF sends the rejected NSSAI and requested NSSAI to the UDM. When the UDM receives the rejected NSSAI and the requested NSSAI, the UDM can determine which other VPLMN can support the rejected NSSAI.

q_37351.question: For RSTD measurement reporting, which subframes should be available in the measured and reference cells for the UE to comply with the requirement for satisfying the reporting delay?
q_37351.ground_truth: All positioning subframes indicated in the OTDOA assistance data and specified in Section 9.1.21.18 should be available for RSTD measurements in the measured and reference cells.

q_37352.question: Under what condition should the UE set the E field to 0 in the MAC header?
q_37352.ground_truth: The UE should set the E field to 0 when it inserts a R/R/E/LCID field in the MAC header and a MAC SDU or a MAC control element starts at the next byte.

q_37353.question: What is the maximum increase in output power for A-MPR 6.3.3.1.2-1 and 6.3.3.1.2-2 for SL intra-band contiguous CA in section 6.3.3.1.2?
q_37353.ground_truth: The maximum increase in output power for A-MPR 6.3.3.1.2-1 is 4 dB, while for A-MPR 6.3.3.1.2-2 it is 6 dB.

q_37354.question: What entity is responsible for deriving the serving AMF which can serve a specific area in Network assisted Sidelink Positioning?

q_37355.question: What is the shortened form of the GUTI that enables more efficient radio signalling procedures in 5G System?

q_37356.question: What are the roles of gNB-CU and gNB-DU in the NG-RAN architecture, as per the definitions provided in the document?
q_37356.ground_truth: gNB-CU (Central Unit) hosts RRC, SDAP and PDCP protocols of the gNB or RRC and PDCP protocols of the en-gNB that controls the operation of one or more gNB-DUs. The gNB-DU (Distributed Unit) hosts RLC, MAC and PHY layers of the gNB or en-gNB, and its operation is partly controlled by gNB-CU. One gNB-DU supports one or multiple cells. One cell is supported by only one gNB-DU.

q_37357.question: What security mechanism is used for end-to-end security in UE-to-UE relay scenarios in Cellular-V2X networks?
q_37357.ground_truth: The Source UE and the Target UE may use unicast mode security mechanism defined in clause 5.3 of TS 33.536 to establish secure connections with the Relay UE. For the Layer-3 UE-to-UE relay scenario, establishing a secure connection between the Source UE and the Target UE is out of the scope of 3GPP.

q_37358.question: Which ciphering algorithms should the AMF support for signaling data confidentiality?
q_37358.ground_truth: The AMF should support the following ciphering algorithms for signaling data confidentiality: NEA0, 128-NEA1, 128-NEA2, and optionally 128-NEA3.

q_37359.question: What should the MCData server do if the SIP request was not successful in step 6?
q_37359.ground_truth: It should not continue with the rest of the steps.

q_37360.question: In what circumstances can the ME suspend the UICC presence detection?
q_37360.ground_truth: The ME may suspend the UICC presence detection if it has an active PDP context, an active EPS bearer context, or an active 5GS PDU session, and has not exchanged any data with the network within the last 30s on the UICC-ME interface.

q_37361.question: In which clause is described the UE procedure for determining the subframes used for PSSCH in sidelink transmission mode 1?

q_37362.question: What is required for an end-point to use or access end-to-end secure communications in MCVideo?
q_37362.ground_truth: The end-point needs to be provisioned with keying material associated to its identity by the KMS.

q_37363.question: In what scenario does the UE Rx-Tx time difference measurement period requirement apply for a cell that is the downlink reference cell for SRS transmission but not for a cell that is not the downlink reference cell for SRS transmission?
q_37363.ground_truth: When UE uplink transmission timing changes due to the UE autonomous timing adjustment.

q_37364.question: What is the role of the 5GMS AF in provisioning a Dynamic PCC rule?
q_37364.ground_truth: The 5GMS AF provisions the information for a Dynamic PCC rule with the PCF, possibly through NEF.

q_37365.question: In 6.7.2, what use cases are addressed by the Network based UE Sidelink Positioning solution?
q_37365.ground_truth: The Network based UE Sidelink Positioning solution addresses KI#5 for MT-LR cases, where uplink-based positioning is not feasible for a user equipment (UE) located within the network coverage. The solution involves the network initiating the location reporting procedure, and the UE performing positioning measurements and determining whether to use sidelink positioning.

q_37366.question: What is the function of the "Signalling Transport" in E1AP?
q_37366.ground_truth: The signalling transport in E1AP provides in-sequence delivery of E1AP messages and notifies E1AP if the signalling connection breaks.

q_37367.question: What type of sequence is UE Context Setup Response?

q_37368.question: What is the responsibility of the MCPTT server when a new MCPTT private call request is sent with new parameters?
q_37368.ground_truth: The MCPTT server can forward the MCPTT private call response with new parameters to the MCPTT client, which can then choose to end the call or continue with the new parameters. The MCPTT system initiating the call is responsible for managing the floor and issuing floor revoked indications.

q_37369.question: What is the purpose of the "reactivation requested" cause value in the 3GPP TS 23.060 and 23.401 specifications?
q_37369.ground_truth: The "reactivation requested" cause value is used by the MME/S4-SGSN to deactivate and restore certain PDN connections based on operator policies such as QCI, ARP, and APN.

q_37370.question: What should the MCData client include in a SIP request when sending a file download accept notification?
q_37370.ground_truth: The MCData client should set the FD disposition notification type IE as "FILE DOWNLOAD REQUEST ACCEPTED" when sending a file download accept notification.

q_37371.question: What procedures shall the participating MCPTT function follow upon receiving a "SIP INVITE request for terminating participating MCPTT function" for the private call or first-to-answer call with SDP offer not including media-level section for media-floor control entity?
q_37371.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT function shall consider it as a request for a private call without floor control or first-to-answer call without floor control and shall follow the procedures as specified in clause~11.1.1.3.2.

q_37372.question: What must the participating MCVideo function include in a SIP re-INVITE request towards the terminating MCVideo client?
q_37372.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function shall include the option tag "tdialog" in a Supported header field, may include a Resource-Share header field, shall perform procedures specified to copy any MIME bodies in the received SIP re-INVITE request to the outgoing SIP re-INVITE request, and if the received SIP re-INVITE request contains a Resource-Priority header field, shall include a Resource-Priority header field with the contents set as in the received header field.

q_37373.question: What is the maximum carrier output power per TAB connector in an AAS BS?

q_37374.question: What are the two parameters in the CSG Cell Selection event that are mandatory for the ME to set?
q_37374.ground_truth: The two parameters in the CSG Cell Selection event that are mandatory for the ME to set are: the Event list and Device identities.

q_37375.question: What is the format of the UEContextResumeResponse message in NGAP protocol?
q_37375.ground_truth: The UEContextResumeResponse message is a sequence consisting of protocolIEs, which is a ProtocolIE-Container object.

q_37376.question: What is the primary goal of step 3 in the test procedure?
q_37376.ground_truth: The primary goal of step 3 in the test procedure is for the UE to start sending L1-RSRP reports, which include results of both CSI-RS0 and CSI-RS1.

q_37377.question: What is required for an SNPN to support QoS differentiation for UE-requested QoS when the 5QIs used by the PLMN are from the range of standardized 5QIs?
q_37377.ground_truth: The UE can request for an IPsec SA the same 5QI from the SNPN as the 5QI provided by the PLMN. The packet filters in the requested QoS rule can be based on the N3IWF IP address and the SPI associated with the IPsec SA.

q_37378.question: What should be the minimum number of PRS positioning occasions for the UE to report RSTD for the reference cell and all neighbor cells i, as specified in Section 8.1.2.6.1?
q_37378.ground_truth: The UE should be capable of reporting RSTD for the reference cell and all neighbor cells i out of at least (n-1) neighbor cells within at least PRS positioning occasions, as specified in Section 8.1.2.6.1.

q_37379.question: What is the condition for the test to pass in terms of the ratio of successful reported values and the confidence level?
q_37379.ground_truth: The ratio of successful reported values in each test should be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

q_37380.question: What is the role of the UE capabilities in determining the test parameters?
q_37380.ground_truth: Using the UE capabilities advertised in the UE-CapabilityRAT-Container of the type UE-NR-Capability, and the procedure outlined in 7.5.1.3, one set of parameters that would provide the largest data rate is determined and used for setting up the NR cell for the test.

q_37381.question: What EF contains extension data of a CFIS (Call Forwarding Indication Status) and what EF does it reference for contents and coding?

q_37382.question: What is the focus of Solution #15 in 3GPP TR 23.758 Rel-17 for enabling the use of Service APIs in the Edge Enabler Layer?
q_37382.ground_truth: The focus of Solution #15 is to enable access to service APIs offered by Edge Application Servers (EASs) within and across the Edge Data Network, by providing CAPIF functions in a distributed or centralized manner.

q_37383.question: What takes precedence in policy control, the PCC Rules installed in the SMF or the locally stored PCC Rules in the SMF?
q_37383.ground_truth: The installed PCC Rules in the SMF take precedence over the locally stored PCC Rules in the SMF.

q_37384.question: What action does the AF need to take to stop processing data related to UE(s) for which user consent has been revoked?
q_37384.ground_truth: At the reception of the user consent revocation notification from the NEF, the AF shall take the necessary actions to stop processing the data related to the UE(s) for which user consent was revoked.

q_37385.question: What is the specification that defines the encoding for the Flow Quality of Service (Flow QoS) in 3GPP networks?

q_37386.question: What information should be included in the testing report as per section 4.3.2.3 regarding the software components?
q_37386.ground_truth: The testing report should include the name and version of the tool(s) used for identifying the software components, the list of all installed software components with name and version information, the list of allowed and disallowed software components, and the test results.

q_37387.question: What security mechanism is used to protect user plane traffic exchanged over the S2c tunnel in trusted non-3GPP accesses when enhanced security is activated?
q_37387.ground_truth: A child IPsec Security Association is used to provide integrity protection and/or confidentiality protection of user plane traffic exchanged over the S2c tunnel.

q_37388.question: What is the role of the RRC sublayer over the Uu interface in relation to NR and E-UTRA?
q_37388.ground_truth: The RRC sublayer over the Uu interface is responsible for providing services and functions related to AS and NAS, security, signalling and data bearers, mobility functions, QoS management, measurement reporting and control, radio link failure detection and recovery, and NAS message transfer between the UE and NG-RAN or 5GC.

q_37389.question: What is the test procedure for measuring In-band emissions in PUSCH and PUCCH for a UE supporting Tx diversity?
q_37389.ground_truth: The test procedure involves sending continuous uplink power control commands until the UE transmits at the maximum power level, waiting for at least 200ms for the UE to reach that level. Then, In-band emissions are measured using Global In-band Tx-Test at each transmit antenna connector. For TDD, only slots consisting of only UL symbols are under test.

q_37390.question: What information is carried in the port number and user plane node ID that is sent outside of the PMIC in the case of interfaces that correspond to network side interfaces of the UPF?
q_37390.ground_truth: The PMIC in this case includes the IP address, the subnet, and the neighbour information (list of neighbour IP addresses when available) in the port number and user plane node ID that is sent outside of the PMIC.

q_37391.question: What should an MS do when attempting to access the HPLMN or EHPLMN in the background while in automatic PLMN selection mode?
q_37391.ground_truth: If the MS is in a VPLMN, it must periodically attempt to obtain service on the HPLMN or one of its EHPLMNs by scanning, following the requirements defined in the Automatic Network Selection Mode.

q_37392.question: What is the size of the RF carrier frequency information field, and what does each increment of this field represent in terms of frequency?
q_37392.ground_truth: The RF carrier frequency information is stored on 2 bytes and coded on 16 bits. Each increment of the 16 bit value is an increment of 200 kHz in frequency.

q_37393.question: What steps should be taken by the SMF+PGW-C if the negotiation of support of URSP provisioning in EPS fails for the first PDN connection?
q_37393.ground_truth: The UE may retry the aforementioned procedure successively for the next PDN connectivity requests until it succeeds for one of them.

q_37394.question: What is the range of values for the "valueY-P-SP-CSI-RS-r18" parameter?
q_37394.ground_truth: The range of values for the "valueY-P-SP-CSI-RS-r18" parameter is from 1 to 3.

q_37395.question: What action must a functional entity take when forwarding a SIP request or response with a Resource-Priority header field outside the trust domain?
q_37395.ground_truth: If a functional entity forwards a SIP request or response with a Resource-Priority header field outside the trust domain, it must remove the header field.

q_37396.question: What should be coded in bits 5 to 8 of octet 6 if the MNC is 2 digits long, as specified in 3GPP TS 24.008 clause 10.5.1.4?
q_37396.ground_truth: Bits 5 to 8 of octet 6 should be coded as "1111" if the MNC is 2 digits long.

q_37397.question: What is the purpose of the Period of Validity parameter in overload control?
q_37397.ground_truth: The Period of Validity parameter indicates the length of time during which an overload condition is considered valid. It allows for minimizing processing required at overloaded and peer CP functions and avoids the need for the overloaded UP function to remember a list of CP functions to signal when the overload condition ceases.

q_37398.question: What is the expected action of the MS if a DEACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message is received from the network while a MODIFY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message is still pending?
q_37398.ground_truth: The MS shall terminate internally the MS initiated PDP context modification procedure and proceed with the network initiated PDP context deactivation procedure by sending a DEACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT ACCEPT, entering the PDP-INACTIVE state.

q_37399.question: What is the long measurement period allowed for FR2 if certain conditions are met?
q_37399.ground_truth: A longer measurement period is allowed for FR2 when the aperiodic CSI-RS resource is measured for L1-RSRP measurement on any FR2 serving frequency in the same band, and the CSI-RS resource is outside the measurement gap and overlaps with specific symbols.

q_37400.question: When is the Serving PLMN Rate Control field in SGW-CDR main level included in the Traffic Data Container?
q_37400.ground_truth: The Serving PLMN Rate Control field in SGW-CDR main level is included in the Traffic Data Container if there is a change in Serving PLMN Rate Control during the data transfer.

q_37401.question: What is the N4 Session Establishment procedure for T-UPF, if a new intermediate UPF (T-UPF) is selected by the SMF for the PDU Session?
q_37401.ground_truth: An N4 Session Establishment Request message is sent to the T-UPF, providing Packet detection, enforcement and reporting rules to be installed on the T-UPF. The CN Tunnel Info (on N9) of UPF (PSA) for this PDU Session is also provided to the T-UPF. Then, the T-UPF sends an N4 Session Establishment Response message to the SMF with DL CN Tunnel Info and UL CN Tunnel Info.

q_37402.question: How many PHICH are used per group in the NB-IoT test model?
q_37402.ground_truth: 2 PHICH are used per group in the NB-IoT test model.

q_37403.question: What is the purpose of the public key of the interconnection CA being securely stored in each SEG and TLS entity within the operator's domain?
q_37403.ground_truth: The public key of the interconnection CA is stored securely in each SEG and TLS entity within the operator's domain to allow the SEG and TLS entity to verify cross-certificates issued by its operator's Interconnection CA.

q_37404.question: How does centralized counting affect UE registration admission?
q_37404.ground_truth: With central count, admission is solely based on the central NSACF, even if local NFs are involved in the interaction. The central NSACF is able to determine when a UE with a stored state in it as being registered in one service area, has moved to a new service area, and does not perform an admission in this case.

q_37405.question: What is the applicability requirement for this test on E-UTRA UE releases 13 and onwards?
q_37405.ground_truth: Support for FDD, TDD, 2DL TDD-FDD CA with FDD as PCell and PUCCH transmission on SCell in CA, and FGI bit 25 is required.

q_37406.question: Which network element is responsible for the control and user plane packets of the UE when FN-RG/5G-RG is serving a UE?
q_37406.ground_truth: A single FN-RG/5G-RG IP PDU session is used to serve multiple UEs in this case.

q_37407.question: What should eNB1 do with the values in the Failure cell PCI IE, Re-establishment cell ECGI IE, C-RNTI IE and ShortMAC-I IE, if the RRC Conn Setup Indicator IE is present in the RLF INDICATION message?
q_37407.ground_truth: eNB1 should ignore the values in these IEs if the RRC Conn Setup Indicator IE is present in the RLF INDICATION message.

q_37408.question: What is the purpose of the evaluation period in DRX as defined in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.6.2 and A.7.3.7?
q_37408.ground_truth: The evaluation period in DRX is used for monitoring downlink radio link quality of the serving cell when DRX is used, as per 3GPP TS 36.133 section 7.6.

q_37409.question: What is the action taken by the UE when it receives an INFORMATIONAL request message for the IKE SA deletion procedure?
q_37409.ground_truth: Upon reception of the INFORMATIONAL request message from the N3IWF or TNGF for deletion of the IKE SA, if the UE accepts the IKE SA deletion request, the UE shall send an empty INFORMATIONAL response message, close IKE SA, delete all IPsec child SAs associated with the IKE SA, and inform the upper layers that the access stratum connection has been released.

q_37410.question: What information does the source MME include in the Handover Required message to the source MME?
q_37410.ground_truth: The message includes the "old BSS to new BSS information IE" for the CS domain and an indication that the UE is not available for the PS service in the target cell. The SRVCC HO indication indicates to the MME that the target is only CS capable.

q_37411.question: What should the UE do if it has at least one active PDU session associated with non-3GPP access and intends to transfer it to EPS?
q_37411.ground_truth: The UE should initiate an EPS attach procedure and include a PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message with a request type in the ATTACH REQUEST message to activate a default EPS bearer context for the active PDU session which the UE intends to transfer to EPS.

q_37412.question: What action should the GMS take if the identity of the sender of the received HTTP POST request initiating temporary MCS group formation is not authorized?
q_37412.ground_truth: The GMS should respond with an HTTP 403 (Forbidden) response to the HTTP POST request and should not continue with the rest of the steps.

q_37413.question: What is the maximum backoff time for the NCR-MT when receiving no Random Access Response?
q_37413.ground_truth: The NCR-MT shall transmit the msg3 if the Random Access Response is not received within the RA Response window, which is determined by the value of backoff time in clause 5.1.4 of TS 38.321.

q_37414.question: How does a NF obtain permission to consume services of a NF Service Producer?
q_37414.ground_truth: A NF Service Consumer sends an authorization request to the NRF (OAuth 2.0 authorization server), which will then supply access tokens to authorize the NF Service Consumer for gaining access to a service from a NF Service Producer.

q_37415.question: What type of UE-to-UE Relay is specified in TR 23.700-33 Solution #13?

q_37416.question: Which information should the 200 OK response include in step 4a of EPS to 5GS handover preparation for successful handover of EPS bearer contexts to 5GS?
q_37416.ground_truth: The 200 OK response should include the epsBearerSetup IE(s) with the list of EPS bearer contexts that were successfully handed over to 5GS, along with DL data forwarding information, which contains either CN tunnel information or NG-RAN F-TEID per E-RAB accepted for direct data forwarding.

q_37417.question: What should the UE do with the received list of service route values in the 200 (OK) response to the REGISTER request?
q_37417.ground_truth: The UE should store the list of service route values and bind it to the contact address or to the registration flow and the associated contact address.

q_37418.question: How many bits are used for frequency domain resource allocation if the subcarrier spacing for the active UL bandwidth part is 15 kHz?

q_37419.question: What does the "Transport Layer Address" IE represent in the F1 transport layer?
q_37419.ground_truth: The "Transport Layer Address" IE is an IP address used for the F1 user plane transport between gNB-CU and gNB-DU.

q_37420.question: What does the CC-POI in NEF stand for in 5.4.3.3.2.3?
q_37420.ground_truth: The CC-POI in NEF stands for the Control-Plane Connection Point in NEF in 5.4.3.3.2.3.

q_37421.question: What is the function of the permitted-server-NWDAF list in the authorization process?
q_37421.ground_truth: The permitted-server-NWDAF list is a list of authorized server NWDAFs that are allowed to serve as a client NWDAF for a specific Analytics ID. This list is registered to NRF by each NWDAF.

q_37422.question: What does "maxCellinengNB" represent in the "CellToReport-NR-ENDC-List"?
q_37422.ground_truth: "maxCellinengNB" represents the maximum number of cells in an EN-DC network.

q_37423.question: What message does the UE send to the E-SMLC to initiate the location information delivery procedure in Bluetooth positioning?
q_37423.ground_truth: The UE sends an LPP Provide Location Information message to the E-SMLC to initiate the location information delivery procedure in Bluetooth positioning.

q_37424.question: When a user originates a request for a VAL service group communication session in an area where pre-established MBMS bearers are to be used, what should the VAL server include in the HTTP POST request message?
q_37424.ground_truth: The VAL server should include a Request-URI set to the URI corresponding to the identity of the SNRM-S, a Content-Type header field set to "application/vnd.3gpp.seal-mbms-usage-info+xml", and an application/vnd.3gpp.seal-mbms-usage-info+xml MIME body with a <request> element in the <mbms-info> root element.

q_37425.question: What must the controlling MCData function include in the outgoing SIP MESSAGE request with respect to the P-Asserted-Identity header field?
q_37425.ground_truth: The public service identity of the controlling MCData function.

q_37426.question: What is the role of Company-A SML in the use case?
q_37426.ground_truth: Company-A SML is responsible for managing the services that support the products offered by Company-A. It determines which services support the exposed MnS being requested by the NSC, and consumes exposed MnS from other companies directly via its SML.

q_37427.question: What is the issue that solution #53 aims to address?

q_37428.question: What should the transmission control server do if the number of simultaneous transmission videos has not reached its upper limit?
q_37428.ground_truth: The transmission control server should perform the actions specified in clause~6.3.4.4.7A.

q_37429.question: What is the measurement name for the number of RRC connection re-establishment attempts?
q_37429.ground_truth: The measurement name has the form RRC.ReEstabAtt.

q_37430.question: What should the UE do if it receives a NOTIFICATION message with a reserved EPS bearer identity value or an assigned value that does not match an existing EPS bearer context?
q_37430.ground_truth: The UE should respond with an ESM STATUS message, including ESM cause #43 "invalid EPS bearer identity".

q_37431.question: In the backhaul RLF recovery procedure for an IAB-node in SA mode, what does the IAB-MT undergoing RLF recovery send to the new parent IAB-DU?
q_37431.ground_truth: The IAB-MT undergoing RLF recovery sends an RRCReestablishmentRequest message to the new parent IAB-DU in the backhaul RLF recovery procedure for an IAB-node in SA mode.

q_37432.question: What should the SS do if it observes more than 2 non-consecutive DTX subframes during subframes (m+5) to (m+13) for inter-band CA UE during SCell hibernation?
q_37432.ground_truth: If the SS observes more than 2 non-consecutive DTX subframes during subframes (m+5) to (m+13) for inter-band CA UE during SCell hibernation, it counts a fail for the event "Hibernation1".

q_37433.question: What is the consequence if two or more packet filters in a new request have identical packet filter identifiers in the same TFT?
q_37433.ground_truth: The network will reject the modification request with cause "syntactical errors in packet filter(s)".

q_37434.question: What should be the type of the BoxHeader for the AMRWPSpecificBox for AMR-WB+?

q_37435.question: Which vendor identifier was assigned by IANA to 3GPP for the Diameter-based SLg/Lgd interface application in the ELP procedures?
q_37435.ground_truth: The vendor identifier assigned by IANA to 3GPP for the Diameter-based SLg/Lgd interface application in the ELP procedures is 10415.

q_37436.question: What should the UE do if it receives a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message with the 5GSM cause value #69 and the ABO bit set to "The back-off timer is applied in all PLMNs or all SNPNs"?
q_37436.ground_truth: The UE should apply the timer T3585 for all the PLMNs or all the equivalent SNPNs.

q_37437.question: What information is contained in the "SSRC" field of the Receive media request message?
