q_37928.question: What is the purpose of the "oldnfinst", "oldservset", and "oldservinst" parameters in a binding indication?
q_37928.ground_truth: The "oldnfinst", "oldservset", and "oldservinst" parameters indicate the NF Instance ID, NF Service Set ID, and NF Service Instance ID of the NF instance or NF service instance where the group of resource/session contexts are currently served, respectively. These parameters indicate that all the resource/session contexts served by this NF instance, NF Service Set, or NF service instance will use the updated Binding Indication subsequently.

q_37929.question: What additional security procedure is implemented in the AI/ML model retrieval process in the secured AI/ML model sharing mechanism?
q_37929.ground_truth: An additional security procedure is implemented by the ADRF to ensure that the request to retrieve the model is coming from the same NWDAF AnLF which has been authorized by the NRF.

q_37930.question: What should the "Refresher" parameter in the Session-Expires header field of the SIP INVITE request be set to if a "refresher" parameter was not included in the received SIP INVITE request?
q_37930.ground_truth: The "Refresher" parameter in the Session-Expires header field of the SIP INVITE request should be set to "uas" if a "refresher" parameter was not included in the received SIP INVITE request.

q_37931.question: What is the mean DL Average-UPT gain for semi-static SBFD at high load level with SBFD Alt 3 and large packet size?
q_37931.ground_truth: The mean DL Average-UPT gain for semi-static SBFD at high load level with SBFD Alt 3 and large packet size is 214.26%.

q_37932.question: What values shall be included in the AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message sent by the network for 5G AKA based primary authentication?
q_37932.ground_truth: AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message shall include the parameters necessary to calculate the authentication response, ngKSI, partial native security context that is created if the authentication is successful, ABBA parameter, and the ngKSI to be used by the UE and AMF

q_37933.question: What does the Application Layer ID represent in relation to V2X applications within the UE?
q_37933.ground_truth: The Application Layer ID is associated with one or more V2X applications within the UE.

q_37934.question: What is the mechanism used to protect PMFP messages transported between the UE and the UPF?
q_37934.ground_truth: PMFP messages are protected using the same security mechanisms as those used for user data packets transported over NG-RAN or non-3GPP access connected to the 5GCN, as well as over the N3 and N9 reference points. No PMFP-specific security mechanism is specified.

q_37935.question: What actions should the UE take if there is no EPS bearer identity assigned to the QoS flow of the default QoS rule of a PDU session associated with 3GPP access?
q_37935.ground_truth: The UE shall perform a local release of the PDU session if it is not an MA PDU session established over both 3GPP access and non-3GPP access, or release the PDU session over 3GPP access and consider the MA PDU session established over non-3GPP access only.

q_37936.question: What potential security requirement can help to establish initial communication with security sensitive functions in a virtualized environment and install certificates, without reducing the security level to that of general MANO?
q_37936.ground_truth: VNF should include a secured boot process. Solutions to this requirement are expected to be handled inside 3GPP SCAS and outside 3GPP. Additionally, access to the MANO should be restricted to a limited number of administrators. Solutions to this requirement are expected to be handled inside 3GPP SCAS and outside 3GPP.

q_37937.question: What property of the identified alarm resource is patched when clearing a single alarm?
q_37937.ground_truth: The "clearUserId" property is patched when clearing a single alarm.

q_37938.question: What unit of measurement is used for the OffsetAngle in the EllipsoidArcArea section?

q_37939.question: What is the minimum requirement for the NCR-MT to send a beam failure instance indication to the higher layers?
q_37939.ground_truth: When the radio link quality on all the RS resources in set q0 is worse than Qout_LR,R of the NCR-MT should send a beam failure instance indication to the higher layers.

q_37940.question: When must the AMF verify whether UE access is allowed by Mobility Restrictions?
q_37940.ground_truth: The AMF must verify whether UE access is allowed by Mobility Restrictions during transition from CM-IDLE to CM-CONNECTED and during Registration After Connected mode mobility from E-UTRAN to NG-RAN.

q_37941.question: What is the security issue that arises when an unauthorized UE participates in the Ranging/Sidelink Positioning procedure?
q_37941.ground_truth: The security issue is that it can result in active or passive attacks, such as a Denial of Service (DoS) attack, traffic analysis, or privacy leakage.

q_37942.question: What mandatory attribute is included in the PolicyAssociation data type response body?
q_37942.ground_truth: The negotiated supported features, encoded as the "suppFeat" attribute.

q_37943.question: When will the AMF stop timer T3550 and change to state 5GMM-REGISTERED?
q_37943.ground_truth: Upon receiving a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message

q_37944.question: When the timer T3584 is provided during the PDU session modification or PDU session release procedure and no DNN but S-NSSAI is provided by the UE along the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message, what is the timer T3584 associated with?
q_37944.ground_truth: The timer T3584 is associated with no DNN and the S-NSSAI of the PDU session.

q_37945.question: Which type of precoding is supported for PSSCH transmission?
q_37945.ground_truth: Only wideband precoding is supported for PSSCH transmission.

q_37946.question: What information does the AF include in its request for notifications on service area coverage change?
q_37946.ground_truth: The AF request for notifications on service area coverage change includes the desired high throughput for one or multiple target UEs, geographical area or DNN/S-NSSAI, AF transaction identifier, policy expiration time, and Notification Correlation Id.

q_37947.question: What is the difference between subclause 5.4.4.1 and 5.4.4.2 in terms of the mobile station's behavior?
q_37947.ground_truth: Subclause 5.4.4.1 applies to mobile stations that do not support the "Prolonged Clearing Procedure," while subclause 5.4.4.2 applies to mobile stations that do. When the network initiates clearing and the mobile station supports the "Prolonged Clearing Procedure," the network includes a specific indication in the DISCONNECT message, which the mobile station must interpret differently depending on whether it supports the "Prolonged Clearing Procedure" or not.

q_37948.question: What should the modificationBlock contain in the response generated by the Roaming Intermediary?
q_37948.ground_truth: The modificationBlock should contain the JWS signature of the Roaming Intermediary.

q_37949.question: What is the effect of a combined EPS/IMSI detach on the UE and the network?
q_37949.ground_truth: The network and the UE both deactivate the EPS bearer context(s) locally without peer-to-peer signaling. The UE is marked as inactive in the network for EPS and non-EPS services, and the states EMM-DEREGISTERED and MM-NULL are entered in both the UE and the network.

q_37950.question: What tunnel establishment procedure is initiated for each additional PDN connection when the UE is attached for regular services to an ePDG supporting emergency services?
q_37950.ground_truth: The IKEv2 tunnel establishment procedure is initiated with the ePDG that was selected in step~1.

q_37951.question: What message is sent by the NG-RAN node to request the AMF to resume the UE-associated logical NG-connection and UE context?

q_37952.question: What is the requirement for the timing error between IAB-DU and IAB-MT transmitters?
q_37952.ground_truth: The timing error between IAB-DU and IAB-MT simultaneous transmission should be within the limit specified by the minimum requirement.

q_37953.question: What does the Inter-System Mobility Policy (ISMP) do for the UE?
q_37953.ground_truth: The ISMP is a set of operator-defined rules that affect the inter-system mobility decisions taken by the UE when it can route IP traffic only over a single radio access interface at a given time. These rules help in selecting the most preferable access technology type or access network that should be used to connect to EPC.

q_37954.question: Which UE category does the minimum conformance requirement in 9.1.57.3 apply to?
q_37954.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirement in 9.1.57.3 applies to UE category M1.

q_37955.question: In the "HandoverRequestAcknowledge-IEs" section, what does the "CRITICALITY ignore" mean in the "ID id-sourceNG-RANnodeUEXnAPID" field?
q_37955.ground_truth: In the "HandoverRequestAcknowledge-IEs" section, "CRITICALITY ignore" in the "ID id-sourceNG-RANnodeUEXnAPID" field means that this field should be ignored during the process of handover request acknowledgement.

q_37956.question: What is the requirement description for the requirement name "RRCRestablishment in Control Plane CIoT 5GS Optimization"?
q_37956.ground_truth: Upon receiving the RAN CP RELOCATION INDICATION message, the AMF shall authenticate the request using the NAS-level security information received in the UL CP Security Information IE and if the authentication is successful initiate the Connection Establishment Indication procedure including NAS-level security information in the DL CP Security Information IE.

q_37957.question: Under what conditions should the UE maximum output power be measured for inter-band uplink carrier aggregation with uplink assigned to two NR bands?
q_37957.ground_truth: The UE maximum output power should be measured over all component carriers from different bands. If each band has separate antenna connectors, maximum output power is defined as the sum of maximum output power from each UE antenna connector. The period of measurement shall be at least one subframe (1 ms).

q_37958.question: When an SCP selects an NF service instance, what should the major version of the 3gpp-Sbi-Discovery-preferred-api-versions header be?
q_37958.ground_truth: The major version of the 3gpp-Sbi-Discovery-preferred-api-versions header should be the same as the major version of the request URI of the service request message.

q_37959.question: What should the SS look for in subframes (m+5), (m+9), and (m+13) up to the end of T2 for inter-band CA UE in step 6b?

q_37960.question: What is the effect of the GBR parameter on the PDN GW?
q_37960.ground_truth: The GBR parameter denotes the bit rate that can be expected to be provided by a GBR bearer. The PDN GW uses the RAT Type to ensure that GBR bearers are not active when the UE is using NB-IoT.

q_37961.question: What is the time duration of the five successive time periods in the test procedure?
q_37961.ground_truth: The time durations of the five successive time periods are T1, T2, T3, T4, and T5.

q_37962.question: Which message is used by the HeNB to identify to which traffic it shall apply the defined rejections in case of OVERLOAD START/STOP message?

q_37963.question: What must the originating user identify in the SIP INVITE request if they are not authorized to initiate the adhoc group session?
q_37963.ground_truth: The MCData ID of the originating user who is not authorized to initiate the adhoc group session.

q_37964.question: What is the role of the Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF) in establishing a PDU session for localized services?
q_37964.ground_truth: The AMF determines the service conditions based on the DNN and/or S-NSSAI (or service ID) and sends the service conditions, along with the DNN and S-NSSAI, to the SMF when creating a new PDU session.

q_37965.question: What is a polygon mesh in 3D computer graphics and solid modeling?
q_37965.ground_truth: A polygon mesh is a collection of vertices, edges, and faces that defines the shape of a polyhedral object in 3D computer graphics and solid modeling.

q_37966.question: When the gNB activates MDT functionality for the selected UEs, what should it send to the UE in case of Logged MDT?
q_37966.ground_truth: The gNB should send the following information to the UE in case of Logged MDT: Trace Reference, Trace Recording Session Reference, TCE Id, Logging Interval, Logging Duration, Absolute time reference, Area Scope where the UE measurements should be collected (NG-RAN cells and NPN IDs in NR), and MDT PLMN List.

q_37967.question: Which information elements are to be ignored in the PDU SESSION RESOURCE SETUP REQUEST message and PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message when transferred between the Non-3GPP access network node and the AMF?
q_37967.ground_truth: RAN Paging Priority IE and UE Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate IE (except for non-trusted non-3GPP access, trusted non-3GPP access and trusted WLAN access) in the PDU SESSION RESOURCE SETUP REQUEST message and RAN Paging Priority IE in the PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message.

q_37968.question: What action does the MME take if the UE supports WUS assistance and the MME supports and accepts the use of WUS assistance, and the UE is not attaching for emergency bearer services?
q_37968.ground_truth: The MME determines the negotiated UE paging probability information for the UE, stores it in the EMM context of the UE, and includes it in the Negotiated WUS assistance information IE in the ATTACH ACCEPT message.

q_37969.question: What is reference time assistance in GNSS?
q_37969.ground_truth: Reference time assistance in GNSS provides the GNSS receiver with coarse or fine GNSS time information, including GNSS system times and NG-RAN air-interface timing.

q_37970.question: What should a UE do when interworking with an ePDG connected to EPC and the PDN type is either "non-IP" or "Ethernet"?
q_37970.ground_truth: The UE shall not attempt to transfer PDU sessions with PDU session type "Ethernet" or "Unstructured" to an ePDG connected to EPC.

q_37971.question: What is the role of the XRSession instance in WebXR functionality?
q_37971.ground_truth: The XRSession instance is used to create and manage the WebXR functionality. It is responsible for rendering frames and tracking the poses of objects in the scene.

q_37972.question: With which function block of the Charging Trigger Function (CTF) in the 5G DDNMF does the UE perform the usage information report list sending procedure in 5G ProSe direct communication?
q_37972.ground_truth: The UE performs the procedure with the Accounting Data Forwarding (ADF) function block of the Charging Trigger Function (CTF) in the 5G DDNMF.

q_37973.question: What is the procedure for discovering and selecting a SGW during a tracking area update procedure with SGW change?
q_37973.ground_truth: In this case, the selected SGW shall serve the UE's TAI and/or eNodeB-ID derived from the ECGI or received from the source MME/SGSN during the attach/TAU/Handover procedure. Operators shall provision, for each TAI/eNodeB-ID value in their network, NAPTR records under the TAI/eNodeB-ID FQDN corresponding to each valid SGW interfaces from the following "Service Parameters": "x-3gpp-sgw:x-s8-gtp", "x-3gpp-sgw:x-s8-pmip", "x-3gpp-sgw:x-s5-gtp", "x-3gpp-sgw:x-s5-pmip". The MME shall construction the TAI FQDN and eNodeB-ID FQDN to determine the TAI/eNodeB-ID NAPTR record-set for finding a candidate set of SGW nodes.

q_37974.question: What is the VAL server ID and for what is it used?
q_37974.ground_truth: The VAL server ID uniquely identifies the VAL server and is used for referencing the VAL server in network slice operations.

q_37975.question: What is the format of the ePDG FQDN in single-connection mode for accessing EPC via S2a using a trusted WLAN access network?
q_37975.ground_truth: The ePDG FQDN is conveyed in EAP-AKA' signaling and is either provisioned by the home operator or constructed by UE in the Operator Identifier FQDN format.

q_37976.question: What is the role of the SEALDD client in uplink traffic when using MSGin5G services?
q_37976.ground_truth: The SEALDD client is responsible for sending the application data to the SEALDD server in MSGin5G format, upon receiving a request from the VAL client with application data and the option to invoke the MSGin5G transferring service.

q_37977.question: What is the impact of not sending one ActivateTask command to each IEF?
q_37977.ground_truth: The LIPF should send one ActivateTask command to each IEF. If not, the IEF may not be properly enabled and may result in the ActivateTask message being rejected.

q_37978.question: What is the structure of the LocationInfo sequence?
q_37978.ground_truth: The LocationInfo sequence is a bit string of size 1 to 32. A bit set to one indicates that the corresponding requirement is present, and a bit set to zero indicates that the requirement is absent. The locationEstimate requirement is present if the location estimate is required for an event report to the external client.

q_37979.question: What is the minimum number of transmitter antenna ports required for the enhanced performance requirement type C in 8.2.1.3.1B?

q_37980.question: What is the role of the UP function in the time-based measurement method when subsequent traffic is received?
q_37980.ground_truth: The time measurement resumes by the UP function when subsequent traffic is received.

q_37981.question: What requirement for inter-band carrier aggregation with two contiguous carriers assigned to one NR band is specified in subclause 6.4A.2.2?
q_37981.ground_truth: The transmit modulation quality requirements in subclause 6.4.2 apply for those carriers.

q_37982.question: What is the purpose of the trust domain in the context of MTC and Service Capability Exposure?
q_37982.ground_truth: The trust domain covers entities that are protected by adequate network domain security. It may include entities within one operator's control or those controlled by a trusted business partner. The security requirements for the trust domain are out of scope of the specification.

q_37983.question: In DCI Format 1C, what is the purpose of the information for SC-MCCH change notification when the format is used for notifying SC-MCCH change?
q_37983.ground_truth: The information for SC-MCCH change notification is used for notifying the change in the Secondary Common Control Channel for the purpose of MBMS.

q_37984.question: What is the role of the IOI (Inter Operator Identifier) in the IM CN subsystem?
q_37984.ground_truth: The IOI is a globally unique identifier used to share information between sending and receiving networks. The "orig-ioi" header field parameter identifies the operator network that sent the request, while the "term-ioi" header field parameter identifies the operator network that received the request. IOIs of three types are used - Type 1 between the visited network and the home network, Type 2 between the originating network and the terminating network, and Type 3 between other networks.

q_37985.question: What response is sent from the TA to the TE if all commands in a command line have been performed successfully when verbose responses are enabled?

q_37986.question: What is the main purpose of the test described in 10.5.3.1.2?
q_37986.ground_truth: The main purpose of the test described in 10.5.3.1.2 is to verify that the SS-SINR measurement accuracy is within the specified limits when the serving and target cell are subject to CCA.

q_37987.question: How does a UE determine the PDSCH reception providing a retransmission of the transport block for the first HARQ-ACK reporting mode?
q_37987.ground_truth: For the first HARQ-ACK reporting mode, a PDSCH reception providing a retransmission of the transport block can be scheduled either by a multicast DCI format using the same G-RNTI as the initial transmission, or by a unicast DCI format using a C-RNTI.

q_37988.question: What is the purpose of the handover to an intra-frequency neighbor cell to continue SC-PTM service reception?
q_37988.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure that the UE continues to receive SC-PTM service when it performs an intra-frequency handover.

q_37989.question: What attribute of the "affiliation" child element of the "status" element can indicate the expiration of affiliation of the MCPTT user to the MCPTT group at the MCPTT client?

q_37990.question: What should the UE do if the T3346 value IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message is not zero and is not deactivated?
q_37990.ground_truth: The UE should abort the tracking area updating procedure, reset the tracking area updating attempt counter, set the EPS update status to EU2 NOT UPDATED, stop timer T3346 if it is running, and start timer T3346 with the value provided in the T3346 value IE if the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message is integrity protected.

q_37991.question: What entities are involved in the AF request for influencing access and mobility related policy control in non-roaming and LBO roaming cases?
q_37991.ground_truth: The AF, PCF, SMF, and AMF are involved in the AF request for influencing access and mobility related policy control in non-roaming and LBO roaming cases.

q_37992.question: What are the steps taken by the transmitting part of the SRAP entity on the PC5 interface in U2U Remote UE for constructing U2U SRAP Data PDU?
q_37992.ground_truth: The transmitting part of the SRAP entity on the PC5 interface can receive an SRAP SDU from the upper layer and constructs an U2U SRAP Data PDU by determining the UE ID fields and BEARER ID field, constructing a header with the determined values, determining the egress RLC channel, and submitting this U2U SRAP Data PDU to the determined egress RLC channel of the PC5 interface.

q_37993.question: What happens when the update flag parameter from the AMF indicates a decrease in the number of UEs and there is only one UE ID associated with the network slice?
q_37993.ground_truth: The NSACF removes the UE ID from the list of UEs registered with the network slice for each of the S-NSSAI(s) indicated in the request from the AMF and decreases the number of UEs per network slice that is maintained by the NSACF for each of these network slices.

q_37994.question: What is the role of the UE when it receives a device trigger?
q_37994.ground_truth: The UE takes specific actions based on the content of the trigger payload, typically involving initiation of immediate or later communication with the SCS or an AS.

q_37995.question: How many times does the target UE need to perform the 5G ProSe direct link authentication procedure to derive a new KNRP?
q_37995.ground_truth: The number of times the 5G ProSe direct link authentication procedure needs to be performed to derive a new KNRP depends on the authentication method used.

q_37996.question: What are the entering and leaving conditions for event D1, which states that the distance between the UE and referenceLocation1 must be above Thresh1 while the distance between the UE and referenceLocation2 must be below Thresh2?
q_37996.ground_truth: Entering condition 1: Ml1 > Thresh1. This condition is used to identify when the distance between UE and referenceLocation1 is greater than Thresh1. Entering condition 2: Ml2 < Thresh2. This condition is used to identify when the distance between UE and referenceLocation2 is less than Thresh2. Leaving condition 1: Ml1 <= Thresh1 or Ml2 >= Thresh2. At least one of these conditions must be true; they are used to identify when the conditions to maintain the entering condition is no longer valid. Leaving condition 2: Ml1 < Thresh1 or Ml2 > Thresh2. At least one of these conditions must be true; they are used to identify when the threshold violation is lifted.

q_37997.question: What is the purpose of the "Channel needed" IE (Information Element) in 3GPP TS 44.018?
q_37997.ground_truth: The "Channel needed" IE is used to indicate the channel that is needed for the connection in 3GPP TS 44.018. It is coded as the IEI (Information Element Identifier) part and the value part of the Channel Needed IE.

q_37998.question: What must the NG-RAN node do if it receives the CN MT Communication Handling IE in the Core Network Assistance Information for RRC INACTIVE IE in the PATH SWITCH REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message?
q_37998.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node must store it and may subsequently request the CN for mobile terminated communication handling if it is supported.

q_37999.question: What is the role of the 5G PKMF in the user-plane-based security procedure for UE-to-UE Relay discovery?
q_37999.ground_truth: The 5G PKMF takes the role of the 5G DDNMF in the user-plane-based security procedure for UE-to-UE Relay discovery.

q_38000.question: What is the maximum measurement reporting delay allowed for the UE to send the Event A3 triggered measurement report for Cell 3 on PCell in this test?
q_38000.ground_truth: The maximum measurement reporting delay allowed is less than 3922 ms.

q_38001.question: How are AF requests stored in the UDR by the NEF in the VPLMN in the LBO architecture?
q_38001.ground_truth: AF requests providing routing information for roamers targeting a DNN and S-NSSAI or an External-Group-Identifier are stored as Application Data in the UDR(in the VPLMN) by the NEF (in the VPLMN).

q_38002.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for NR UE from Release 15 onwards?
q_38002.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements for NR UE from Release 15 onwards and supporting measurement enhancements in high speed scenario are specified in clause 6.1.2.0.1.

q_38003.question: What protocol is used when the PDU session type is Ethernet only?

q_38004.question: Which IEs are mandatory in the protocolIEs of UEContextResumeFailure message?
q_38004.ground_truth: The id-AMF-UE-NGAP-ID, id-RAN-UE-NGAP-ID, and id-Cause are mandatory IEs in the protocolIEs of UEContextResumeFailure message.

q_38005.question: What is the reporting event label for Event C1 for NR?

q_38006.question: What are the NFs involved in the service type of Messaging?
q_38006.ground_truth: The NFs involved in the service type of Messaging are the NFs in the packet core network, IMS, or MMS Proxy Relay.

q_38007.question: What must the AMF do if it receives PNI-NPN related information within the NPN Access Information IE in the INITIAL UE MESSAGE message and supports it?
q_38007.ground_truth: The AMF shall consider that the included information is associated to the cell via which the UE has sent the first NAS message, and to the PLMN Identity which is indicated within the TAI IE.

q_38008.question: What should the MCPTT client do when there is no "a=key-mgmt" attribute field in the SDP offer during a private call setup?
q_38008.ground_truth: When there is no "a=key-mgmt" attribute field in the SDP offer, the MCPTT client should generate a PRIVATE CALL ACCEPT message, set the call identifier, caller and callee IDs, generate and store the answer SDP, establish a media session based on the SDP body, start the TFP4 timer, and enter the "P5: pending" state.

q_38009.question: What is the maximum time allowed for the transmitter power of the UE to be turned off after the expiry of the T310 timer?
q_38009.ground_truth: After the expiry of the T310 timer, the transmitter power of the UE must be turned off within 40 ms as specified in clause 5.3.11 in 3GPP TS 36.331.

q_38010.question: Which functional entities are involved in the path of data exchange for SDS in the MCData server?
q_38010.ground_truth: The participating MCData function and the controlling MCData functions may be in the path of the data exchange between the authorized MCData users for SDS.

q_38011.question: What network component receives the Requested non-3GPP delay budget from the SMF?

q_38012.question: What is the value of Tprocessing when the CHO execution condition is met but no CPC execution condition is met for FR1-FR1 NR-DC to FR1-FR2 NR-DC?
q_38012.ground_truth: For FR1-FR1 NR-DC to FR1-FR2 NR-DC, Tprocessing is 45 ms.

q_38013.question: In a roaming scenario, what information is constructed by the UE and provided for PDU Session Establishment?
q_38013.ground_truth: The UE constructs the Requested NSSAI and provides a mapping of S-NSSAIs of the Requested NSSAI to HPLMN S-NSSAIs if the mapping is stored in the UE.

q_38014.question: What should the MME or SGSN do when the UE, for which one or more MT SMS have been requested to be retransmitted at a later time, becomes available for MT SMS delivery?
q_38014.ground_truth: The MME or SGSN shall make use of the Alert Service Centre procedure to indicate that the UE is now available for MT SMS delivery to the SMS-GMSC.

q_38015.question: What media bit rate adaptation should be used for G.729.1 to reduce the media bit-rate to 8 kbps when ECN-CE is detected?
q_38015.ground_truth: The media bit rate adaptation for G.729.1 should use the same principles as described for AMR and AMR-WB in clause~10.2.

q_38016.question: What should AMF do if LMF does not indicate to release the secure user plane connection of UE?
q_38016.ground_truth: AMF should maintain the secure user plane connection status of UE.

q_38017.question: What is the main difference between step 7 and step 8 in the test procedure (6.5A.2.2.1.4.2)?
q_38017.ground_truth: Step 7 measures the EIRP of the transmitted signal for the assigned NR channel, while step 8 measures the EIRP of the first NR adjacent channel on both the lower and upper side of the assigned NR channel.

q_38018.question: What is the purpose of the combined basic limit for emissions inside Inter RF Bandwidth gaps for a multi-band TAB connector?
q_38018.ground_truth: The purpose of the combined basic limit is to ensure that the cumulative sum of emissions from all bands does not exceed the cumulative sum of the basic limits specified at the Base Station RF Bandwidth edges on each side of the Inter-RF Bandwidth gap.

q_38019.question: What is required for a UE to support multiple TB scheduling for SC-PTM in Idle mode for NB-IoT when connected to EPC?
q_38019.ground_truth: The UE should support any ue-Category-NB and the operating frequency should be FDD.

q_38020.question: What action does the SMF take if the Policy Control Request Trigger is met in the scenario described?
q_38020.ground_truth: The SMF reports the received information traffic to the PCF serving the PDU Session.

q_38021.question: Which network node is responsible for identifying the importance/dependency information of PDU Set in the described solution?
q_38021.ground_truth: The UPF is responsible for identifying the importance/dependency information of PDU Set.

q_38022.question: What is the primary function of a physics engine in XR applications?
q_38022.ground_truth: The physics engine is responsible for simulating physical forces and collisions within the XR application.

q_38023.question: How is the DL carrier bandwidth and the bandwidth of the initial BWP (BWP#0) indicated in SIB1?
q_38023.ground_truth: The DL carrier bandwidth is indicated as 52 PRBs with a subcarrier spacing of 15 kHz, while the initial downlink BWP is set to 25 PRBs in SIB1.

q_38024.question: How does the HSS handle the expiration of a CP parameter set's validity time?
q_38024.ground_truth: When the validity time expires, the involved nodes (SCEF, HSS, and MME) autonomously delete the associated CP parameter set with no additional signaling.

q_38025.question: In what circumstances should the UE skip the rest of the steps in step 3.3.2.3.2 of TS 24.173 and proceed with session establishment?
q_38025.ground_truth: The UE should skip the rest of the steps if the random number "rand1" is lower than BarringFactorForMMTEL-Video in step 3.3.2.3.2.

q_38026.question: What is the mode of operation of the UE for Ciphering/Integrity (PDCP and NAS) in E-UTRAN, UTRAN, and GERAN?
q_38026.ground_truth: Ciphering/Integrity (PDCP and NAS) are enabled in E-UTRAN, ciphering/Integrity are enabled in UTRAN, and ciphering is enabled in GERAN.

q_38027.question: What should the AMF do with the information elements received from the UE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message (for 5GMM capability, S1 UE network capability, and UE security capability) upon receiving a registration update request over non-3GPP access and detects that the N3IWF used by the UE is compatible with only part of the allowed NSSAI?
q_38027.ground_truth: The AMF shall store all octets received from the UE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message, up to the maximum length defined for the respective information element.

q_38028.question: What action is taken if V-PCRF denies authorization for one or more PCC rules in steps 8b and 10b?
q_38028.ground_truth: The H-PCRF may provide new modified PCC rules to the V-PCRF if it denies authorization for one or more PCC rules in steps 8b and 10b.

q_38029.question: What should the AF not maintain after retrieving an AF specific UE Identifier?
q_38029.ground_truth: The AF shall not keep maintaining a mapping between the AF specific UE Identifier and the UE IP address.

q_38030.question: What does the SMF of the new PDU Session invoke when establishing a new PDU Session for SSC mode 3 and an S-NSSAI subject to NSAC?
q_38030.ground_truth: The NSACF to increase the number of PDU Session and adds the new PDU session ID in the NSACF.

q_38031.question: What is the requirement for a UE to measure SSB for RLM without measurement gaps in the same OFDM symbol as CSI-RS for RLM, BFD, CBD or L1-RSRP measurement in FR1?
q_38031.ground_truth: If SSB and CSI-RS have the same SCS, the UE shall be able to measure the SSB for RLM without any restriction. If SSB and CSI-RS have different SCS and the UE supports simultaneousRxDataSSB-DiffNumerology, the UE shall also be able to measure the SSB for RLM without any restriction. Otherwise, the UE is required to measure SSB for RLM.

q_38032.question: What should be the value of all the relevant fields on the SIM/USIM for the "NOT UPDATED" status as defined in Rel-8?
q_38032.ground_truth: For the "NOT UPDATED" status as defined in Rel-8, all relevant fields on the SIM/USIM must be set to the "deleted" value, including the LAI, TMSI, GSM ciphering key, UMTS integrity key, UMTS ciphering key, and ciphering key sequence number.

q_38033.question: What is the first step in modifying a group message payload for delivery?
q_38033.ground_truth: The NEF transforms the group message payload into a file and uses the determined file meta data.

q_38034.question: What should the MCData client do if the SIP re-INVITE request contains an <alert-ind> element set to a value of "true" or does not contain an <alert-ind> element, and the MCData emergency alert state is set to "MDEA 2: emergency-alert-confirm-pending"?
q_38034.ground_truth: The MCData client should set the MCData emergency alert state to "MDEA 3: emergency-alert-initiated".

q_38035.question: What is the test description for EVM Equalizer Spectrum Flatness for a UE supporting Tx diversity in NR release 15 and forward?
q_38035.ground_truth: The test description involves measuring the mean power at each antenna connector in the channel bandwidth of the radio access mode. The spectrum flatness is then measured using Global In-Channel Tx-Test with uplink symbols under test (excluding transient periods for TDD). If the UE's transmit power is higher than the minimum output power requirement in 6.3G.1.5 at both antenna connectors, the spectrum flatness is measured at both connectors.

q_38036.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects?
q_38036.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects is responsible for the development of technical specifications for the 5G system, including its services and system aspects. This includes the study of use cases and potential requirements for 5G system support of Artificial Intelligence (AI)/Machine Learning (ML) model distribution and transfer.

q_38037.question: What is the only possibility for an AMF that allows unauthenticated IMS Emergency Sessions when the UE and the AMF don't share a secure context?
q_38037.ground_truth: The only possibility for an AMF that allows unauthenticated IMS Emergency Sessions is to run with the NULL integrity algorithm NIA0 and the NULL ciphering algorithm NEA0.

q_38038.question: What is the duration of available PRS in positioning frequency layer i measured during, and how is it calculated?
q_38038.ground_truth: The duration of available PRS in positioning frequency layer i is measured during the same time as PRS duration K, and it is calculated in the same way as PRS duration K defined in TS 38.214 clause 5.1.6.5.

q_38039.question: What is the role of the NF consumer in the 3GPP TS 23.501 standard?
q_38039.ground_truth: The NF consumer is a network function (NF) in the 3GPP TS 23.501 standard that consumes services provided by other network functions.

q_38040.question: How are unknown information elements handled during the analysis of a particular message?
q_38040.ground_truth: Unknown information elements are skipped over, and any following information elements of a particular message are analyzed.

q_38041.question: What is the mechanism for deactivating an MDT trace session in E-UTRAN?
q_38041.ground_truth: When the eNodeB receives the Trace Session Deactivation message from the EM, it shall deactivate the Trace Session for those E-UTRAN Cells that have been indicated in the message.

q_38042.question: What procedure is used by a 3rd party SCS/AS to initiate a background data transfer for a group of UEs?
q_38042.ground_truth: The procedure for resource management of background data transfer involves the SCS/AS sending a Background data transfer request message to the SCEF with parameters such as the volume of data per UE, the expected number of UEs participating in the data transfer, and the desired time window.

q_38043.question: What should be measured for the UTRA test requirement of an AAS BS in single carrier mode?
q_38043.ground_truth: The Error Vector Magnitude (EVM) for each UTRA carrier and every measured slot should be less than 18.5% when the AAS BS is transmitting a composite signal using only QPSK modulation and less than 13.5% when the AAS BS is transmitting a composite signal that includes 16QAM modulation. The peak code domain error for every measured slot should not exceed 32 dB at spreading factor 256, and the average Relative Code Domain Error for 64QAM modulated codes should not exceed 20 dB at spreading factor 16.

q_38044.question: What should the UE do if the TMSI reallocation is part of the combined tracking area updating procedure?
q_38044.ground_truth: The UE should use the TMSI as the new temporary identity, delete the old TMSI, store the new TMSI and return a TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message to the network.

q_38045.question: What action should the AMF take if it decides not to suspend the connection in the procedure of UE context suspend?
q_38045.ground_truth: The AMF will send a UE CONTEXT SUSPEND FAILURE message to the NG-RAN node.

q_38046.question: What should the MBMS interface in the MCPTT client do when it receives RTP media packets or floor control messages over the MBMS subchannel but there is no association with any ongoing conversation in a group session?
q_38046.ground_truth: It should ignore the received floor control message or RTP media packet.

q_38047.question: What should the UE do if the attach procedure is rejected with GMM cause #25, received from a CSG cell?
q_38047.ground_truth: The UE should set the EPS update status to EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED and reset the attach attempt counter. It should also enter the state EMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE.

q_38048.question: What action should the participating MCPTT function take when the pre-established session release indication is received from the MCPTT client?
q_38048.ground_truth: Upon receiving the pre-established session release indication from the MCPTT client, the participating MCPTT function should stop sending RTP media packet and floor control messages between the MCPTT client and the controlling MCPTT function, release any media plane resources and timers associated with this pre-established session, and enter the 'Start-stop' state.

q_38049.question: What action will the ADRF take upon the reception of an HTTP POST request to "<apiRoot>/nadrf-datamanagement/<apiVersion>/data-store-records" for creating a new data store record?
q_38049.ground_truth: The ADRF will create a new data store record, assign a storeTransId, and store the data or analytics.

q_38050.question: What is the purpose of the test described in section 10.5.3.2.2?
q_38050.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described in section 10.5.3.2.2 is to verify that the SS-SINR measurement accuracy is within the specified limits when both the serving cell and the target cell are subject to CCA.

q_38051.question: What is the structure of the ProtocolIE-ContainerPair?
q_38051.ground_truth: The ProtocolIE-ContainerPair is a SEQUENCE containing 'id', 'firstCriticality', 'firstValue', 'secondCriticality', and 'secondValue' fields.

q_38052.question: What is used as the Source Layer-2 ID for groupcast and broadcast in ProSe sidelink communication?
q_38052.ground_truth: The ProSe UE ID provided by higher layer is used directly as the Source Layer-2 ID.

q_38053.question: What should the UE do after receiving a UEInformationRequest message with connEstFailReportReq set to true, if it has stored connection establishment failure information?
q_38053.ground_truth: The UE should send a UEInformationResponse message with connEstFailReport.

q_38054.question: What is a condition to determine the set of MBMS services of interest?
q_38054.ground_truth: The UE is SC-PTM capable, the UE is receiving or interested to receive this service via an SC-MRB, one session of this service is ongoing or about to start, and one or more MBMS SAIs in the USD for this service is included in SystemInformationBlockType15 acquired from the PCell for a frequency belonging to the set of MBMS frequencies of interest.

q_38055.question: What IE (Information Element) should be included in a routing area update request message by the MS to indicate support for PSM and acceptance of its use?

q_38056.question: What is the specific delay requirement for UE supporting power class 2, 3, 4, or 7 in Test 1?
q_38056.ground_truth: The UE supporting power class 2, 3, 4, or 7 must report the event within 4322 ms for Test 1 for the number of successful tests to be increased.

q_38057.question: What is the expected behavior of the UE during time durations T1, T2, and T3 in the test?
q_38057.ground_truth: The UE is expected to transmit uplink signals at least once every DRX cycle in the On-duration part of the cycle during the period from time point A to time point B in the test.

q_38058.question: What are the different types of interfaces that can be used during the whole lifecycle of network slice?

q_38059.question: What is the role of SMF and UDM in monitoring network authorization status for a given UE to participate in a given Application AI/ML operation?
q_38059.ground_truth: SMF and UDM should support a new event for monitoring network authorization status for a given UE to participate in a given Application AI/ML operation.

q_38060.question: What should be the uniform priority value for all APIs and services exposed by the 5GC when setting priorities for Multimedia Priority Services, Mission Critical Services or Emergency calls?
q_38060.ground_truth: The same priority values should be defined in the same order on all SBIs for the same service.

q_38061.question: What should the MAC entity do when there is an ongoing RACH-less handover procedure, and the downlink assignment has been received on the PDCCH for the MAC entity's C-RNTI after the first PUSCH transmission to the Serving Cell?
q_38061.ground_truth: Indicate to upper layers the successful completion of RACH-less handover.

q_38062.question: Who is responsible for sending the Leaving Notification Indication in the described scenario?

q_38063.question: What should the trusted non-3GPP access network do when initiating the Trusted non-3GPP Access Authentication and Authorization procedure?
q_38063.ground_truth: During the authentication, it shall act as a pass-through EAP authenticator and store the non-3GPP user data received from the 3GPP AAA Server for authorizing the PDN connections and the requested home address types.

q_38064.question: What should the UE do when it receives an INFORMATIONAL request message including a delete payload and has established tunnels?
q_38064.ground_truth: The UE shall close all security associations identified within the DELETE payload and delete the incoming security associations corresponding to the outgoing security associations identified in the DELETE payload.

q_38065.question: Who decides which UE-to-UE relay to use when multiple relays can reach the target UE?
q_38065.ground_truth: The target UE decides which UE-to-UE relay to use when multiple relays can reach it, based on signal strength, traffic load of the UE-to-UE relays, Relay Service Code, or operator policies.

q_38066.question: How does ICE help the IBCF with UDP based media streams in a full ICE scenario?
q_38066.ground_truth: ICE provides a systematic method for the IBCF to establish and maintain UDP based media streams between the SDP offerer and SDP answerer, preventing NAT traversal issues and ensuring seamless communication.

q_38067.question: What is the main function of the 5GS mobility management sublayer?
q_38067.ground_truth: The main function of the 5GS mobility management sublayer is to support the identification, security, mobility of a UE as well as generic message transport. It also provides connection management services to the other sublayer(s).

q_38068.question: When is the UE required to be capable of measuring SSB for RLM without measurement gaps in SSB based radio link monitoring?
q_38068.ground_truth: The UE is required to be capable of measuring SSB for RLM without measurement gaps in SSB based radio link monitoring when the SSB for RLM is in the same OFDM symbol as CSI-RS for RLM, BFD, CBD or L1-RSRP measurement.

q_38069.question: What should the UE do if the UE is operating in single-registration mode and the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message for a non-emergency PDU session is rejected with cause value #69 and a Back-off timer value IE is included in the response?
q_38069.ground_truth: The UE should re-initiate the UE-requested PDU session modification procedure after expiry of timer T3584, if applicable, and start a new T3585 timer with the value provided in the Back-off timer value IE. The UE should also avoid sending another PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message or PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message for the non-emergency PDU session until the T3585 timer expires or is stopped.

q_38070.question: What should the ATCF do upon receiving a SIP INFO request carrying session transfer preparation while the session transfer is in progress?
q_38070.ground_truth: The ATCF shall send a SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP INFO request, and start forwarding the audio media in both directions.

q_38071.question: What should the participating MCVideo function do upon receiving a SIP MESSAGE request for an MBMS listening status update?
q_38071.ground_truth: Upon receiving a SIP MESSAGE request for an MBMS listening status update, the participating MCVideo function shall handle the request in accordance with 3GPP TS 24.229 and IETF RFC 3428. If the SIP MESSAGE request contains an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-mbms-usage-info+xml MIME body with an <mbms-listening-status> element and an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body containing an MCVideo ID in the <mcvideo-request-uri> served by the participating MCVideo function, then the participating MCVideo function shall verify that the public user identity in the P-Asserted-Identity header field is bound to the MCVideo ID in the <mcvideo-request-uri> element in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body. If that is the case, the participating MCVideo function shall indicate to the media plane that the MCVideo client in the session identified by the <session-identifier> element is now listening to the MBMS subchannel, or indicate to the media plane that the MCVideo client is not listening to the MBMS subchannel, accordingly.

q_38072.question: What is the role of V-CHF in the charging data message exchange procedure with H-CHF?
q_38072.ground_truth: V-CHF acts as an NF consumer towards H-CHF in the charging data message exchange procedure, triggering a charging data request based on the reception of a charging data request from another NF consumer.

q_38073.question: What should the UE do upon successful delivery of the UEInformationResponse message in the 3GPP TS 36.331 clause 5.6.5.3?
q_38073.ground_truth: The UE should discard the rlf-Report from VarRLF-Report upon successful delivery of the UEInformationResponse message confirmed by lower layers.

q_38074.question: What should a consumer invoke to establish a streaming connection for sending streaming data in the performance data streaming service?
q_38074.ground_truth: The consumer should invoke the "establishStreamingConnection" operation to establish a streaming connection for sending streaming data.

q_38075.question: What is the purpose of Type: Amf3GppAccessRegistrationModification in clause 6.2.6.2.7?
q_38075.ground_truth: Type: Amf3GppAccessRegistrationModification is a derived type of Amf3GppAccessRegistration that deletes all attributes that are not subject to modification by means of the HTTP PATCH method.

q_38076.question: What should an MTSI client in terminal receiving media do, if it uses DL ANBR to detect a needed reduction in throughput of 10% or more?
q_38076.ground_truth: If an MTSI client in terminal receiving media uses DL ANBR to detect a needed reduction in throughput of 10% or more, it should send RTCP TMMBR to request the highest bitrate that is lower than ANBR and all other adaptation triggers.

q_38077.question: What should the mobile station do if a RR connection is available but T3230 expires and no response is given?
q_38077.ground_truth: The mobile station aborts the MM connection establishment, informs the requesting CM sublayer, releases the RR connection, and returns to the MM sublayer state where the request of an MM connection was received.

q_38078.question: In what situations will the UE set the registration attempt counter to 5?
q_38078.ground_truth: The UE shall set the registration attempt counter to 5 upon reception of 5GMM causes #95, #96, #97, #99, and #111.

q_38079.question: What is the role of an AI/ML activation policy in enabling policy-based activation of AI/ML capabilities?
q_38079.ground_truth: An AI/ML activation policy is a sequence of tuples of conditions and activation settings that may be executed by the AI/ML producer, to enable the activation procedure, which intrinsically lacks the automation potential, and to ensure that the producer has a "full picture" on other ML entities/capabilities that are currently in operation, activated by different producers on the request from MnS consumer.

q_38080.question: What HTTP status code is sent if at least one UCMF dictionary entry is successfully provisioned?
q_38080.ground_truth: The UCMF responds with an "200 OK" status code if at least one UCMF dictionary entry is successfully provisioned.

q_38081.question: What is the function of MxTC and MxTS in the traffic duplication procedure?
q_38081.ground_truth: The MxTC monitors the selection criterion and based on ATSSS rules, decides whether traffic duplication should be activated or deactivated for the uplink application traffic. Similarly, the MxTS monitors the selection criterion and based on N4 rules, decides whether traffic duplication should be activated or deactivated for the downlink application traffic.

q_38082.question: What information is provided in the "Multicast CU to DU RRC Information" IE?
q_38082.ground_truth: The "Multicast CU to DU RRC Information" IE indicates the multicast specific CU to DU RRC Information.

q_38083.question: In which type of charging does the network element allow the user session to start prior to receiving the initial authorization from the OCS?
q_38083.ground_truth: The network element may allow the user session to start prior to receiving the initial authorization from the OCS in session based online charging (SCUR), i.e. prior to the start of the Credit-Control session.

q_38084.question: What are the steps to establish an MBS session using a single TMGI in MOCN network sharing?
q_38084.ground_truth: The steps to establish an MBS session using a single TMGI in MOCN network sharing are: 1) AF may request TMGI(s), 2) The same TMGI is used for all related MBS broadcast sessions with MOCN network sharing, 3) The TMGI is provided as part of the service announcement for the MBS session by all AFs performing service announcements for the MBS session. The NEF/MBSF forwards the request to create an MBS session to the MB-SMF, and based on the MOCN network sharing indicator, the NEF/MBSF selects the MB-SMF not based on the TMGI but based on the service area.

q_38085.question: What is Mobility Robustness Optimisation aimed at detecting and enabling correction of?
q_38085.ground_truth: Mobility Robustness Optimisation is aimed at detecting and enabling correction of connection failure due to intra-LTE or inter-RAT mobility, unnecessary handover to another RAT, inter-RAT ping-pong, and inter-system ping-pong.

q_38086.question: How does the UE determine the SRS TPC command signalled on PDCCH with DCI format 3 or 3A for SRS transmission given trigger type 2?
q_38086.ground_truth: The UE attempts to decode a PDCCH of DCI format 3B with CRC scrambled by higher layer parameter srs-TPC-RNTI-r14 in every subframe, and the SRS TPC command signalled on PDCCH with DCI format 3 or 3A for SRS transmission given trigger type 2 is used to adjust the SRS power control adjustment state, where the initial value is provided by higher layers and the accumulation is enabled based on higher layer parameter accumulation-Enabled or accumulationEnabled-additionalSRS. The correction value is added to the SRS power control adjustment state when accumulation is enabled, and is reset when value is changed by higher layers or the UE receives a random access response message for the serving cell.

q_38087.question: What should the candidate number of MCPTT group IDs be reduced to if it is bigger than the N2 value of the served MCPTT ID in the MCPTT user profile?
q_38087.ground_truth: The candidate number of MCPTT group IDs should be reduced to that equal to N2, based on MCPTT service provider policy.

q_38088.question: How many EPS security contexts do the UE and MME need to maintain simultaneously?
q_38088.ground_truth: The UE and the MME need to be able to maintain two EPS security contexts simultaneously, a current EPS security context and a non-current EPS security context.

q_38089.question: What information should a participating MCPTT function use to retrieve the binding between the MCPTT ID and public user identity in the "SIP MESSAGE request for transfer private call for originating participating MCPTT function"?
q_38089.ground_truth: It should use the MCPTT ID present in the <mcptt-request-uri> element of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body of the incoming SIP MESSAGE request.

q_38090.question: What message does the new MME send to the old MME in the new TAU procedure if the security functions do not authenticate the UE correctly?
q_38090.ground_truth: The MME sends a reject indication to the old MME/old S4 SGSN if the security functions do not authenticate the UE correctly.

q_38091.question: What is the action taken by the MS when it receives the P-TMSI REALLOCATION COMMAND message containing a P-TMSI signature?
q_38091.ground_truth: The MS stores the new P-TMSI signature and deletes the old P-TMSI signature if available.

q_38092.question: What must a functional entity consider when determining whether to remove the Reason header field during SIP signalling that crosses the trust domain boundary?
q_38092.ground_truth: A functional entity must only include the Reason header field in a response forwarded to another entity within the trust domain and remove the header field when forwarded to an entity outside the trust domain.

q_38093.question: What should the IWF send to the MCPTT server when it has received individual affiliations from all LMR users of a group, and the MCPTT server sends individual IWF imminent peril group call request for each affiliated LMR user?
q_38093.ground_truth: The IWF should send IWF imminent peril group call response(s) to the MCPTT server for each individual IWF imminent perel group call request received.

q_38094.question: What should the RNC do with the MDT records when the duration time of the trace session expires for Logged MDT?
q_38094.ground_truth: The RNC shall preserve the Logged MDT trace session in the UE until the duration time of the trace session expires, and store the Logged MDT trace session context of the UE in the network as long as the trace session is active.

q_38095.question: How is the modification period defined in SC-MCCH information?
q_38095.ground_truth: The modification period is defined by SFN values for which SFN mod m= 0, where m is the number of radio frames comprising the modification period.

q_38096.question: What is the minimum number of correct events required out of 100% in repeated tests for meeting the requirements for out-of-sync CSI-RS based RLM?
q_38096.ground_truth: The minimum number of correct events required in repeated tests is 90%.

q_38097.question: What is the purpose of the Protection Area (PA) in the 5G network?
q_38097.ground_truth: The Protection Area (PA) in the 5G network includes a list of bsGKI, corresponding encrypted root keys, and corresponding expiry time. It is used to protect the network from false base stations by storing the information on the ME (Mobile Equipment) and only allowing the USIM (User Equipment) to decrypt the root keys.

q_38098.question: What must the participating MCPTT function do if the MCPTT user is not authorized to make an ambient listening call?
q_38098.ground_truth: Reject the SIP REFER request for pre-established session with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response to the SIP INVITE request, with warning text set to "107 user not authorized to make private calls" in a Warning header field as specified in clause~4.4.

q_38099.question: What KPI list KI#3 related to Traffic Characteristics provisioning and Performance Characteristics monitoring?
q_38099.ground_truth: KI#3 lists several parameters as examples of parameters applicable to Traffic Characteristics provisioning and Performance Characteristics monitoring, including transfer interval, data volume per cycle time, average and peak data rate, silence time interval, PDU Session Type, end-to-end latency, service bit rate, and packet error rate.

q_38100.question: What is the "perPlmnOauth2ReqList" attribute used for in the NFService authorization method setting?
q_38100.ground_truth: The "perPlmnOauth2ReqList" attribute specifies the OAuth 2.0-based authorization requirement supported by the NF Service Instance per PLMN of the NF Service Consumer.

q_38101.question: What indicator is used to mute the event notification and store the available events until the NF service consumer requests to retrieve them?
q_38101.ground_truth: The "notifFlag" attribute included and set to "DEACTIVATE" in the request.

q_38102.question: What is the required alignment for the average power per PRB before the start of the test described in 6.3A.4.3.0?
q_38102.ground_truth: The average power per PRB should be aligned across both assigned carriers before the start of the test described in 6.3A.4.3.0.

q_38103.question: What is the requirement for out of band emissions for UL MIMO in the context of NR-DC?
q_38103.ground_truth: The requirements for out of band emissions for UL MIMO are defined as the sum of the emissions from all UE transmit antenna connectors.

q_38104.question: What is the BM-SC responsible for in the MBMS Session Start procedure?
q_38104.ground_truth: The BM-SC is responsible for sending the RAR message to the GGSN(s) when it is ready to send data in the MBMS Session Start procedure.

q_38105.question: How canUL/DL traffic patterns be provided to the RAN to optimize the CDRX cycle duration?
q_38105.ground_truth: UL/DL traffic patterns can be provided to the RAN by the AF or the UPF using GTP-U header extensions or through statistical analysis. The traffic patterns can include periodicity, frequency of UL and DL bursts, and traffic descriptions to describe the type of traffic.

q_38106.question: What is the security issue described in section 5.2.1.2, related to the unauthorized access to the PDU session for local traffic routing to access an EHE in the VPLMN?
q_38106.ground_truth: The security issue is the potential unauthorized access to the PDU session by an unauthorized UE, which could lead to threats described in section 5.2.1.3.

q_38107.question: Which HTTP method allows a service consumer to retrieve an existing Individual Monitoring Job resource at the NSCE Server?
q_38107.ground_truth: The HTTP GET method allows a service consumer to retrieve an existing Individual Monitoring Job resource at the NSCE Server.

q_38108.question: What is the role of a Home eNodeB L-GW in LIPA?
q_38108.ground_truth: A Home eNodeB L-GW receives and processes multicast group membership report messages, forwarding multicast IP datagrams as appropriate. It may also implement a proxying function for UPnP/DLNA service advertisements sent with an IP TTL=1 to make them available to UEs that employ LIPA.

q_38109.question: What is the function of the PLMN network in Solution #32 when local services are provided via PNI-NPN in a PLMN?
q_38109.ground_truth: The PLMN network is aware of the service area of the local services, provides a list of available local services to the UE based on the area where the UE initiates the Registration, and may interact with the local service provider for authorization determination.

q_38110.question: What is the purpose of sending a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message with the EPS update type IE set to "TA updating"?
q_38110.ground_truth: The UE sends a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message with "EPS update type = TA updating" when it detects entering a new tracking area not included in the TAI list.

q_38111.question: What functions are supported by the MCData-FD-5 reference point in the on-network functional model using EPS?
q_38111.ground_truth: The MCData-FD-5 reference point supports the MCData server to access the stored files in the MCData content server for certain file distribution functions, such as retrieval of a file to be distributed through multicast, and it also supports any necessary operational requirements.

q_38112.question: What are the steps taken by the DCCF when historical data is available in the ADRF?
q_38112.ground_truth: The DCCF proceeds with step 5a and step 5b, and skips steps 5c, 6c, and 7c.

q_38113.question: What should the UE do if it receives a PSFCH with conflict information corresponding to a reserved resource indicated in an SCI format 1-A?
q_38113.ground_truth: The UE receives the PSFCH in the resource pool in a slot determined based on sl-PSFCH-Occasion.

q_38114.question: What protocol is used as the transport for Diameter messages over the T6a/T6b, T6ai/T6bi, and T7 interfaces?

q_38115.question: What ciphering mode shall the UE set if it is operating in single-registration mode and has received GMM cause #36?
q_38115.ground_truth: The UE shall delete any GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI list and eKSI and enable N1 mode capability for 3GPP access if it was disabled.

q_38116.question: What should the UE do upon T313 expiry in connected mode with SCG activated with a SCG DRB established?
q_38116.ground_truth: The UE should transmit a SCGFailureInformation message with failureType set to 't313-Expiry'.

q_38117.question: What is the purpose of the Sounding Reference Symbol (SRS) for a UE in LTE?
q_38117.ground_truth: The Sounding Reference Symbol (SRS) allows a UE in LTE to measure the channel quality of the downlink components of the radio channel, which the base station uses for making decisions regarding frequency scheduling and beamforming.

q_38118.question: What is the purpose of the UAS application enabler layer in supporting detect and avoid services and applications?
q_38118.ground_truth: The UAS application enabler layer provides a mechanism for a UAS application specific server to obtain events for a UAV that can be relevant for DAA, and a mechanism for a UAS application specific client to obtain events for a UAV that can be relevant for DAA.

q_38119.question: What does the N2 reference point support between an LMF and a RAN node, or N3IWF in the case of untrusted non-3GPP access?
q_38119.ground_truth: The N2 reference point supports the transfer of positioning messages between an LMF and a RAN node, or N3IWF in the case of untrusted non-3GPP access.

q_38120.question: What must the NEF (PFDF) do if the updated Routing Indicator value is not supported by the UDM where the AMF is currently registered?
q_38120.ground_truth: If the updated Routing Indicator value is not supported by the UDM where the AMF is currently registered, the UDM will request the UE to re-register after updating the data.

q_38121.question: What is the purpose of the "neighbouring-NCGI" sub-element within the "location-information" element?
q_38121.ground_truth: The "neighbouring-NCGI" sub-element within the "location-information" element specifies the NCI of any neighboring cell the SLM-C can detect.

q_38122.question: What should a UE do if timer T3482 expires and a PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message was sent with request type set to "emergency" or "handover of emergency bearer services" in a stand-alone PDN connectivity procedure?
q_38122.ground_truth: The UE should inform the upper layers of the failure to establish the emergency bearer.

q_38123.question: When is a window used to start the uplink grant?
q_38123.ground_truth: The window is used to start the uplink grant when the UE detects the RAR message(s) and a associated random access preamble identity (RAPID) is identified with the transmission of PRACH.

q_38124.question: When should the Security-Client header field, specifying signalling plane security mechanisms and IPsec layer algorithms, be included in a REGISTER request?
q_38124.ground_truth: This header field should be included when the UE uses IMS AKA 3GPP TS 33.203 or RFC 3329 as security mechanisms.

q_38125.question: What is the difference in 5% DL Average-UPT for coordinated scheduling based on L1 UE-UE CLI measurement between low and medium/high load levels?
q_38125.ground_truth: Coordinated scheduling based on L1 UE-UE CLI measurement has similar 5% DL Average-UPT for all load levels.

q_38126.question: What is the requirement for the measurement period of NR SS-RSRQ measurements, as specified in clause 8.5.2.2.0?
q_38126.ground_truth: The measurement period of NR SS-RSRQ measurements should be the same as the measurement period of NR SS-RSRP measurements defined in clause 8.5.2.1.0.

q_38127.question: What should the MCPTT client do if it receives a SIP MESSAGE request for forwarding private call response for terminating client?
q_38127.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should determine the success or failure of the sent forwarding private call request and send a SIP 200 (OK) response accordingly.

q_38128.question: What happens to the PDU Session ID when a UE is handed over from EPS to 5GS during PDN connection establishment?
q_38128.ground_truth: The UE allocates the PDU Session ID and sends it to the SMF+PGW-C via PCO.

q_38129.question: What are the two options for AMF/SMF+PGW-C admission request in 5GS-EPS interworking with EPS counting active?
q_38129.ground_truth: Option 1 is communication directly with the central NSACF NF, and option 2 is sending the admission request to both the central NSACF NF and a local NF in the Service Area.

q_38130.question: What is the maximum number of PLMNs for QMC?

q_38131.question: What action should the MAC entity take if it receives an SRS Pathloss Reference RS Update MAC CE on a Serving Cell?
q_38131.ground_truth: The MAC entity should indicate to lower layers the information regarding the SRS Pathloss Reference RS Update MAC CE.

q_38132.question: In what scenario should the MCPTT client perform the automatic commencement procedures?
q_38132.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should perform the automatic commencement procedures if the SIP INVITE request contains an Answer-Mode header field with the value "Auto" and the MCPTT service setting at the invited MCPTT client for answering the call is set to automatic commencement mode, or if the SIP INVITE request contains an Answer-Mode header field with the value "Auto" and the MCPTT service setting at the invited MCPTT client for answering the call is set to manual commencement mode but the invited MCPTT client is willing to answer the call with automatic commencement mode, or if the SIP INVITE request contains a Priv-Answer-Mode header field with the value of "Auto".

q_38133.question: What should be the relationship between the resolution bandwidth of the measuring equipment and the measurement bandwidth in general?
q_38133.ground_truth: In general, the resolution bandwidth of the measuring equipment should be equal to the measurement bandwidth.

q_38134.question: What is the key issue that Solution #9 addresses in terms of API invoker UE authorization?
q_38134.ground_truth: Solution #9 addresses the key issues of API invoker UE authorization by providing an OAuth 2.0 based API invocation procedure, which enables API invokers to request authorization for services API and resources, and provides a single access token for service API and resource authorization. The resource owner can authorize API invokers for resources via the UE in synchronous and asynchronous manners.

q_38135.question: What should a MCPTT client do if the SIP INVITE request is rejected in step 1?
q_38135.ground_truth: If the SIP INVITE request is rejected in step 1, the MCPTT client should respond towards the participating MCPTT function with an appropriate reject code and warning texts, or with a SIP 480 (Temporarily unavailable) response.

q_38136.question: What should the UE do if P-MPRc is introduced in the PCMAX,f,c equation for serving cell c and the power reduction is needed to ensure compliance with electromagnetic energy absorption requirements or to address self desense requirements for simultaneous transmissions on multiple RATs?
q_38136.ground_truth: The UE should apply P-MPRc for serving cell c in these cases.

q_38137.question: What fields are contained in the Layer-2 format for ProSe 5G communication when communication via stateful Layer-3 UE-to-UE Relay is performed?
q_38137.ground_truth: The Layer-2 header includes the following fields: Source Layer-2 ID and Destination Layer-2 ID. The Layer-2 frame also includes a Destination IP address in the IP packet header to identify the final destination.

q_38138.question: What is the role of the SEID (SMF established SEID) in the CP F-SEID of the PFCP session?
q_38138.ground_truth: The SEID is a unique identifier for a PFCP session within a SMF set. When establishing a PFCP session, the SMF assigns the SEID in the CP F-SEID of the PFCP Session Establishment Request. The assigned CP F-SEID shall be unique within the SMF set.

q_38139.question: What action must the I-CSCF take when it receives a CANCEL request and finds a pending Cx transaction with the HSS?
q_38139.ground_truth: The I-CSCF must answer the CANCEL request with a 200 (OK) response and the original request with a 487 (Request Terminated) response.

q_38140.question: What is a UE-to-network relay and how is it used in MCPTT service continuity?
q_38140.ground_truth: A UE-to-network relay is a network element that facilitates MCPTT service continuity by providing a direct link between a remote UE and the network. It is used in MCPTT service continuity when the remote UE is lost network connectivity and wants to ensure seamless service.

q_38141.question: What status code and message body are returned when the HSS successfully retrieves the PSI activation state?
q_38141.ground_truth: The HSS responds with "200 OK" and the message body containing the PSI activation state (active or inactive).

q_38142.question: How does NG-RAN determine the dynamic value of 5G-AN PDB in UL direction?
q_38142.ground_truth: NG-RAN may determine a dynamic value of 5G-AN PDB in UL direction at the gNB egress and provides this value to the SMF in a response to the QoS Flow establishment or modification request.

q_38143.question: When the "MediaComponentVersioning" feature is supported, what should the PCF include in the "flows" attribute of the QoS notification control information if alternative QoS profiles are not supported in the NG-RAN where the UE is currently located?
q_38143.ground_truth: The PCF may include within the QosNotificationControlInfo data structure the "altSerReqNotSuppInd" attribute set to true.

q_38144.question: What is the purpose of the test case of NR SA FR1 event-triggered reporting without gap under DRX?
q_38144.ground_truth: The purpose of this test case is to verify the UE's ability to make a correct reporting of an event within intra-frequency cell search without gap under DRX.

q_38145.question: What is the purpose of the "APN back-off timer unsolicited result code setting" function?
q_38145.ground_truth: The purpose of the "APN back-off timer unsolicited result code setting" function is to control the presentation of unsolicited result code "+CABTSRI" that reports the APN back-off timer parameters from the MT to the TE if the back-off timer is started, stopped, deactivated, or expires.

q_38146.question: What is the MME state that the UE enters upon receiving an ATTACH ACCEPT message with a TMSI allocation and starting timer T3450?

q_38147.question: What will be the behavior of the UE if the 5GS registration value in the 5GS registration result IE indicates "3GPP access"?
q_38147.ground_truth: The UE will consider itself as being registered to 3GPP access, enter state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION over non-3GPP access, and set the 5GS update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED over non-3GPP access.

q_38148.question: What should the UE do when it receives an ATTACH ACCEPT message containing a GUTI during the combined attach procedure?
q_38148.ground_truth: The UE should use the received GUTI as its new temporary identity, delete the old GUTI (if available), and store the new GUTI. The UE should also set its TIN to "GUTI" when receiving the ATTACH ACCEPT message.

q_38149.question: What is the role of the PDN GW in the Evolved Packet Core (EPC) network?
q_38149.ground_truth: The PDN GW is responsible for terminating the SGi interface towards the PDN and providing connectivity to a gateway for the UE to access the Internet. It also performs various functions, such as per-user based packet filtering, lawful interception, IP address allocation, and accounting for inter-operator charging.

q_38150.question: What is the difference between 'UseCurrentlySelectedGroup' and 'DedicatedGroup' for 'MCPTTGroupInitiation/Entry/Usage'?
q_38150.ground_truth: When set to 'UseCurrentlySelectedGroup', if the MCPTT user has currently selected an MCPTT group, that MCPTT group will be used for an on-network MCPTT emergency group call, imminent peril group call, or MCPTT emergency alert. If not, the MCPTT group identified by the GroupID in clause~5.2.34B will be used for an MCPTT emergency group call or imminent peril group call, or the MCPTT group identified by the ID in clause~5.2.43B for an MCPTT emergency alert. When set to 'DedicatedGroup', the MCPTT group identified by the GroupID in clause~5.2.34B or clause~5.2.43B will be used for the respective MCPTT emergency group call, imminent peril group call, or MCPTT emergency alert, without any consideration for the currently selected MCPTT group or not.

q_38151.question: In the definition of "Full-I-RNTI-Profile-List", what does "Full-I-RNTI-Profile-List" represent?
q_38151.ground_truth: Full-I-RNTI-Profile-List represents the list of Full-I-RNTI profile items.

q_38152.question: How many times should the UE measure RSRP and RSRQ for each intra-frequency cell in the RRC_CONNECTED state?
q_38152.ground_truth: The UE should be able to perform measurements for at least 6 cells when measurement gaps are activated in the RRC_CONNECTED state. If the UE identifies more than 6 cells, the UE shall perform measurements, but the reporting rate of RSRP and RSRQ measurements of cells from UE physical layer to higher layers may be decreased.

q_38153.question: What information does the DRA maintain for PCRF selection in a network that uses the Rx reference point?
q_38153.ground_truth: The DRA maintains information about the user identity, UE IPv4 address and/or Ipv6 prefix, APN, PCEF identity, and selected PCRF identity for a certain IP-CAN session. It uses this information to find the correct PCRF when matching APNs or the user identity and IP domain Id received in the message from the AF.

q_38154.question: What information is signalled from the UE to the E-SMLC in downlink positioning?
q_38154.ground_truth: The information that may be signalled from the UE to the E-SMLC in downlink positioning includes individual UE measurements such as GNSS pseudo-ranges, carrier phase-ranges, and other UE measurements.

q_38155.question: What should the terminating MCData client do when it receives a Map Group To Bearer message over the general purpose MBMS subchannel?
q_38155.ground_truth: The terminating MCData client should associate the TMGI in the TMGI field with the MBMS subchannel for media and the MCData group identity, and start or continue the procedure described in clause~7.4.2.3.

q_38156.question: What response status code indicates that the analytics information request has been accepted?
q_38156.ground_truth: The response status code "200 OK" indicates that the analytics information request has been accepted.

q_38157.question: What is the data type of the attribute SupportedMlTrainingTrustworthiness and SupportedMlInferenceTrustworthiness in the extended MLEntity data type?
q_38157.ground_truth: The data type of both attributes is SupportedMlTrainingTrustworthiness and SupportedMlInferenceTrustworthiness respectively.

q_38158.question: What should the UE do during T2 to send the first CSI report for SCell1 if subframe (m+8) is subject to interruption for FDD PCell and TDD PCell?
q_38158.ground_truth: The UE should send the first CSI report for SCell1 in subframe (m+10) for FDD PCell and (m+9) for TDD PCell if subframe (m+8) is subject to interruption.

q_38159.question: What is the name of the first time period in the test with a duration of T1?

q_38160.question: In what scenario should the transmission control interface send a Transmission Reject message with cause #1 (Another MCVideo client has permission)?
