q_38160.ground_truth: When the Cx (Simultaneous transmission video) has reached its upper limit, the MCVideo client did not negotiate support of queueing of Transmission requests, and the transmission control interface receives a Transmission Media Request message with a pre-emptive priority level.

q_38161.question: What information does the "<Status>" element contain and what values can it have?
q_38161.ground_truth: The "<Status>" element indicates whether this particular MCPTT user profile is enabled or disabled. It can have the values "true" or "false", with "true" meaning the MCPTT user profile is enabled and "false" meaning it is disabled.

q_38162.question: What should be included in the supportedBandCombination field when the UECapabilityEnquiry message includes requestedFrequencyBands and UE supports requestedFrequencyBands?
q_38162.ground_truth: As many as possible of the band combinations included in the list of candidates, including non-CA combinations and up to 5DL+5UL CA band combinations, should be included in the supportedBandCombination.

q_38163.question: What is the main function of the MEC system level management in the ETSI MEC 003 framework?
q_38163.ground_truth: The MEC system level management, as specified in ETSI GS MEC 003, includes the MEC orchestrator as its core component, which has an overview of the complete MEC system and is responsible for resource orchestration and managing the set of MEC application VNFs.

q_38164.question: What does the term "shall" indicate in 3GPP Technical Specifications and Reports?
q_38164.ground_truth: The term "shall" in 3GPP Technical Specifications and Reports indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

q_38165.question: When selecting the DC bandwidth combination with the largest aggregated bandwidth, what should be prioritized if there are multiple sets with the same largest aggregated bandwidth?
q_38165.ground_truth: The set with the largest number of 4 layer CCs should be prioritized.

q_38166.question: When are the rules for choosing the UICC application re-applied?
q_38166.ground_truth: The rules for choosing the UICC application are re-applied whenever a UICC application is successfully selected or terminated.

q_38167.question: What is the requirement for the minimum inner loop power control step size for single RAT UTRA operation in UTRA FDD mode?
q_38167.ground_truth: The Single RAT AAS BS shall have the capability of setting the inner loop code domain power on each TAB connector with a step sizes of 1dB mandatory and 0.5, 1.5, 2.0 dB optional.

q_38168.question: Which transport layer protocol does GTP-C and GTP-U use?
q_38168.ground_truth: UDP (User Datagram Protocol) is the transport layer protocol used for GTP-C and GTP-U.

q_38169.question: Who is responsible for checking the application lists against the UE capabilities in option B?
q_38169.ground_truth: The DC Server checks the application lists against the UE capabilities in option B.

q_38170.question: What should the MCData client do if it receives a SIP 4xx response, SIP 5xx response or SIP 6xx response to the sent SIP MESSAGE emergency alert cancellation request?
q_38170.ground_truth: If the sent SIP MESSAGE request did not contain an <originated-by> element in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body and the MCData emergency alert state is set to "MDEA 4: emergency-alert-cancel-pending", the MCData client should set the MCData emergency alert state to "MDEA 3: emergency-alert-initiated".

q_38171.question: What does the network do when T3313 expires in the paging procedure?
q_38171.ground_truth: The network may re-initiate paging when T3313 expires.

q_38172.question: How is the HARQ process number determined for each scheduled cell?
q_38172.ground_truth: The HARQ process number for each scheduled cell is determined by the corresponding block in the DCI, with each block indicating the HARQ process number for a scheduled cell based on an ascending order of a serving cell index.

q_38173.question: Which parameter is used for initializing the Random Access preamble power in 4-step RA type?

q_38174.question: What attribute is used for providing PDU Session traffic analytics requirements in the "pduSesTrafReqs" attribute?
q_38174.ground_truth: The "pduSesTrafReqs" attribute includes the known Application Identifier, IP Descriptions, or Domain Descriptors for providing PDU Session traffic analytics requirements.

q_38175.question: What should the UE do if the C-RNTI MAC control element was included in Msg3 and the PDCCH transmission is addressed to the C-RNTI?
q_38175.ground_truth: If the C-RNTI MAC control element was included in Msg3 and the PDCCH transmission is addressed to the C-RNTI, the MAC entity should consider this Contention Resolution successful and stop the mac-ContentionResolutionTimer. The MAC entity should discard the Temporary C-RNTI and consider the Random Access procedure successfully completed.

q_38176.question: What type of information does the Required-MBMS-Bearer-Capabilities AVP contain?
q_38176.ground_truth: The Required-MBMS-Bearer-Capabilities AVP contains the minimum bearer capabilities the UE needs to support.

q_38177.question: What is used to determine what localized service information to provide to the UE in the UE request for the localized service data?
q_38177.ground_truth: The UE request for the localized service data includes information such as the service identifier associated with the localized service, and/or a "filter" such as the free text name of the localized service, location, time, or service provider group identifier.

q_38178.question: In the PLMN selection procedure at switch on, when is the user preferred PLMN selection operating mode used?
q_38178.ground_truth: The user preferred PLMN selection operating mode is used at switch on if the MS provides the optional feature of user preferred PLMN selection operating mode at switch on.

q_38179.question: What should the User Equipment (UE) do if it receives a service announcement for a Multimedia Broadcast Multicast Service (MBS) while it is in deep sleep mode?
q_38179.ground_truth: The UE should not go to deep sleep during the MBS data transfer, even if it was initially scheduled to do so due to power saving mechanisms.

q_38180.question: What should the AMF under test include in the Path-Switch Acknowledge message, as per the expected result?
q_38180.ground_truth: The AMF under test should include the locally stored 5G security capabilities in the Path-Switch Acknowledge message.

q_38181.question: What is the role of the Interconnection CA in the NDS/AF PKI architecture?
q_38181.ground_truth: The Interconnection CA is responsible for issuing cross-certificates on behalf of a particular operator to the SEG CAs, TLS client CAs, and TLS server CAs of other domains with which the operator's SEGs and TLS entities have interconnection.

q_38182.question: What procedure does this solution use to assist the positioning of a target UE that is out of network coverage?
q_38182.ground_truth: This solution uses the MT-LR procedure with scheduled location time and local coordinates to assist the positioning of a target UE that is out of network coverage.

q_38183.question: What should the SeNB do if the timer TDCoverall expires before it receives the SENB MODIFICATION REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message?
q_38183.ground_truth: The SeNB should regard the SeNB initiated SeNB Modification Preparation procedure as being failed and should release the UE Context at the SeNB.

q_38184.question: What has a higher priority when associated with DL PRS bandwidth aggregation linkage compared to one that is not?
q_38184.ground_truth: A dl-PRS-ID or nr-SelectedTRP-Index associated with DL PRS bandwidth aggregation linkage has higher priority.

q_38185.question: What are the benefits of application plane signalling security at the edge of the MC Domain?
q_38185.ground_truth: The benefits include not exposing the mission critical core network architecture to external entities, enabling intrusion detection within the XML signalling link, assigning policies to signalling on entry to the Mission Critical network, reducing the number of signalling protection keys, and allowing multicast bearers to be shared across multiple MCX Servers.

q_38186.question: What should the MCVideo client include in the MIME body of the SIP MESSAGE request for creating a temporary group identity for the user regroup?
q_38186.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-regroup+xml MIME body with an mcvideo-regroup-uri element set to a unique temporary group identity URI.

q_38187.question: What method is used by the NWDAF to report observed Events to a NF service consumer?
q_38187.ground_truth: The Event Notification method is used by the NWDAF to report observed Events to a NF service consumer.

q_38188.question: Which CMPv2 general requirements apply to CMPv2 usage in Service Based Architecture in Solution #2?
q_38188.ground_truth: The CMPv2 general requirements that apply to CMPv2 usage in Service Based Architecture include the usage of asymmetric algorithms for PKI message integrity protection, pre-provisioning the NF with the operator root CA certificate, and the RA/CA authenticating key update requests based on signatures that are validated against the operator root CA.

q_38189.question: What property in the MSGin5G Gateway Registration Response schema indicates the allowed time for Gateway Service in seconds?

q_38190.question: What are the three areas the document examines in the context of residential 5G enhancements?
q_38190.ground_truth: Enhancements for wireline wireless convergence, enhancements for fixed LAN - 5GLAN integration, and enhancements for indoor small base stations.

q_38191.question: In what scenario should the UE apply additionalSpectrumEmission from NS-PmaxListAerial within freqBandInfoAerial or multiBandInfoListAerial?
q_38191.ground_truth: When the UE is an aerial UE and it supports at least one additionalSpectrumEmission in the NS-PmaxListAerial within the freqBandInfoAerial or multiBandInfoListAerial.

q_38192.question: What is required for the UE to store the IE "E-UTRA frequency RACH reporting information" in subclause 6.2.4.2.3?
q_38192.ground_truth: The UE must receive the IE "E-UTRA frequency RACH reporting information" and support E-UTRA RACH reporting.

q_38193.question: What should the diverting AS do when Terminating Identification Restriction (TIR) applies for the served user?
q_38193.ground_truth: The diverting AS should add a Privacy header field set to "id" to the P-Asserted-Identity and History-Info header field, and if a Privacy header field set to "none" is received, the diverting AS should remove it.

q_38194.question: What is the procedure for L2TP tunnel and L2TP session setup when both the CP function and the UP function support the L2TP feature?
q_38194.ground_truth: The CP function sends a PFCP Session Establishment Request message including L2TP related IEs to request the UP Function to setup an L2TP session towards the LNS and establish a L2TP tunnel between the UP Function and the LNS. It may include Information Elements (IE) such as L2TP Session Information IE, L2TP User Authentication IE and L2TP Tunnel Information IEs.

q_38195.question: What is the measurement provided by 5.1.1.31.1 in the context of New Radio cell?
q_38195.ground_truth: The distribution of SS-RSRQ received by gNB from UEs in the cell is measured in 5.1.1.31.1.

q_38196.question: What XML schema should be used for defining user data in the Communication Waiting (CW) service in 3GPP TS 24.615?
q_38196.ground_truth: The XML schema defined in 3GPP TS 24.615 subclause 4.8.3 should be used for defining user data in the CW service in 3GPP TS 24.615.

q_38197.question: What action should a UE take upon receiving a STATUS message with cause value #81 (Invalid PTI value)?
q_38197.ground_truth: The UE should abort any ongoing WLCP procedure related to the received PTI value and stop any related timer.

q_38198.question: What is used to distinguish between application flows within a QoS Flow for per-PDU set handling in the 5GS?
q_38198.ground_truth: In 5GS, a QoS Flow's individual application or media sub-flows are distinguished by considering the Application / media-stream / sub-flow as a PDU Set, which allows packets to be identified for per-PDU set handling.

q_38199.question: What are the conditions under which the UE should send a PDCP Control PDU containing EHC feedback packet with Context ID B to upper layers, when SS sends PDCP Control PDU containing EHC feedback packet with Context ID B to UE and PDCP Data PDU containing EHC compressed ethernet packet with Context ID A without ethernet header to UE?
q_38199.ground_truth: The UE should send a PDCP Control PDU containing EHC feedback packet with Context ID B to upper layers, when SS sends PDCP Control PDU containing EHC feedback packet with Context ID B to UE and PDCP Data PDU containing EHC compressed ethernet packet with Context ID A without ethernet header to UE.

q_38200.question: When is the total interruption time on FR1 serving cells in SCG during MGL defined in NR standalone operation?
q_38200.ground_truth: The total interruption time on FR1 serving cells in SCG during MGL is defined only when MGL(N) = 20ms, 10ms, 6ms, 4ms, and 3ms in NR standalone operation.

q_38201.question: When is a UE expected to transmit PSSCH on the PRBs belonging to the allocated sub-channel(s) except for the intra-cell guard band PRBs within the highest sub-channel?
q_38201.ground_truth: When the UE uses more than 1 sub-channel for PSSCH transmission, the highest sub-channel of PSSCH overlaps with a single RB set and intra-cell guard band PRBs, and the higher layer parameter transmissionStructureForPSCCHandPSSCH is set to 'contiguousRB'.

q_38202.question: What is the requirement for the unwanted emission limits for an OTA AAS BS operating in BC1, BC2, and BC3, as specified in clause 6.8.5.1.1?
q_38202.ground_truth: The unwanted emission limits for an OTA AAS BS operating in BC1, BC2, and BC3 are specified in clause 6.8.5.1.1. The limits are for transmitter spurious emission, operating band unwanted emission, and ACLR in the presence of a wanted signal and an interfering signal. The requirement applies outside the edges of the Base Station RF Bandwidth. For RIB supporting operation in non-contiguous spectrum, the requirement is also applicable inside a sub-block gap. For multi-band RIBs, the requirement applies relative to the Base Station RF Bandwidth edges of each operating band.

q_38203.question: What is the purpose of the procedures outlined in 6.5.3.1 for retrieval of peer SMF?
q_38203.ground_truth: These procedures outline the steps for a SMF to discover other SMFs belonging to the same 5G VN group, report the 5G VN group information to the GSMF, and retrieve other SMF information via the GSMF or NRF.

q_38204.question: What kind of list is the DRBs-FailedToBeModified-List?
q_38204.ground_truth: A list that contains information about DRBs which failed to be modified.

q_38205.question: What is the main function of the S- or T-NSCE server in the context of network slice capability exposure in edge data network?
q_38205.ground_truth: The S- or T-NSCE server can send trigger actions to the slice provisioning MnS based on the expected/predicted VAL UE or VAL group mobility.

q_38206.question: What element in the UAE document contains the unique identifier of a UAV which initiates the UAS UE de-registration procedure?

q_38207.question: What function does the "permanently forbidden SNPNs" list serve in an SNPN-enabled UE?
q_38207.ground_truth: The "permanently forbidden SNPNs" list stores a list of SNPNs that are permanently forbidden for access by a UE, and this list is maintained across activation and deactivation of SNPN access operation mode.

q_38208.question: What type of information element is the more data information element?
q_38208.ground_truth: The more data information element is a type 2 information element.

q_38209.question: In the LBO roaming scenarios, what component creates the UE policy container, and when is it provided?
q_38209.ground_truth: The (H-)PCF creates the UE policy container including UE policy information and provides it in step 3 when the UE Policy Association for the UE is established for a UE in EPS.

q_38210.question: What is the solution provided in 6.4.6 for partially applying Common IEs in the service charging specifications?
q_38210.ground_truth: In 6.4.6, the Common IEs are partially applied by showing and referring to the required layers, and not expanding or showing unnecessary sub-IEs.

q_38211.question: What information should be included with URSP rules for supporting LBO PDU Sessions?
q_38211.ground_truth: PLMN ID(s) should be sent with URSP rules.

q_38212.question: What is the role of the PNM application when the gsmSCF has received a CAMEL IDP relating to a terminating call?
q_38212.ground_truth: The PNM application checks if the re-direction is applicable for the call, retrieves the Destination Routing Address, and responds with a CAMEL CONNECT message with the Destination Routing Address set to the MSISDN of the default UE.

q_38213.question: What is the maximum allowed interruption duration on any active serving cell, when activating or deactivating a SCell in the same FR1 band and UE is capable of independent beam management on this FR2 band pair?
q_38213.ground_truth: The UE is allowed an interruption of up to X2 slot on any active serving cell, when activating or deactivating a SCell in the same FR1 band and UE is capable of independent beam management on this FR2 band pair.

q_38214.question: What is the threshold number of HARQ-ACK bits for a UE to perform spatial HARQ-ACK bundling across multiple codewords within a downlink subframe or a special subframe for PUCCH format 3?
q_38214.ground_truth: Spatial HARQ-ACK bundling across multiple codewords within a downlink subframe or a special subframe is performed for each serving cell by a logical AND operation of all of the corresponding individual HARQ-ACKs, and PUCCH format 3 is used if the number of HARQ-ACK bits for multiple subframes in downlink and special subframes associated with a single UL subframe n is more than 21, where n is the index of the UL subframe.

q_38215.question: What are the conditions for a service data flow to pass through the UPF when both policy control and charging control are applicable in 5G networks?
q_38215.ground_truth: The SMF shall allow the service data flow to pass through the UPF if and only if the right conditions from both policy control and charging control are met, i.e. the corresponding gate is open and in the case of online charging the CHF has authorized credit for its charging key.

q_38216.question: When is the IRI-POI in IBCF provisioned with the parameter ReportDiversionPASSporTInfo?
q_38216.ground_truth: The IRI-POI in IBCF is provisioned with the parameter ReportDiversionPASSporTInfo when STIR/SHAKEN is required to be intercepted in the network.

q_38217.question: How many PDU sessions can have active user-plane resources for a UE in NB-N1 mode when the Multiple user-plane resources support bit is set to "Multiple user-plane resources supported"?
q_38217.ground_truth: There can be a maximum of two PDU sessions with active user-plane resources for a UE in NB-N1 mode when the Multiple user-plane resources support bit is set to "Multiple user-plane resources supported".

q_38218.question: What is the maximum length of a DN string?
q_38218.ground_truth: The maximum length of a DN string, including RDN separators and white spaces, shall not exceed 400 bytes (8-bit).

q_38219.question: What should the UE do during T2 if there are no uplink resources for reporting the valid CSI in subframe (m+39)?
q_38219.ground_truth: The UE should use the next available uplink resource for reporting the corresponding valid CSI.

q_38220.question: Which method allows an AF to retrieve all the active MBS User Data Ingest Sessions managed by the NEF using the MBSUserDataIngestSession API?

q_38221.question: What action must the UE take upon receipt of a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message with the 5GSM cause value #86 "UAS services not allowed"?
q_38221.ground_truth: The UE must not send another PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message for UAS services without including the CAA-level UAV ID in the service-level device ID of the Service-level-AA container IE, and upon receipt of the request from the upper layers to establish a PDU session for UAS services, the UE must initiate the UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure by including the service-level device ID in the Service-level-AA container IE of the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message and set the value to the CAA-level UAV ID as specified in subclause 6.4.1.2.

q_38222.question: What should the IWF floor control server do when it receives an instruction from the application and signalling plane to merge the ongoing group call with other group calls in any state other than the 'Releasing' and 'Start-stop' states?
q_38222.ground_truth: The IWF floor control server should perform the actions in clause~6.5.2.3 and enter the 'Start-stop' state.

q_38223.question: Which SSC mode is recommended for performing PDU session transfer from a source network slice to a target network slice?
q_38223.ground_truth: SSC mode 3 is recommended for performing PDU session transfer from a source network slice to a target network slice.

q_38224.question: What is the function of the observationPeriod attribute in the Intent IOC?
q_38224.ground_truth: The observationPeriod attribute in the Intent IOC indicates the time period for which the fulfilment process is observed. It determines when the fulfilmentInfo for corresponding ExpectationTargets, IntentExpectations and Intent is updated.

q_38225.question: What is the purpose of using Rx filtering in the gNB radio unit to prevent ADC saturation?
q_38225.ground_truth: The purpose of using Rx filtering in the gNB radio unit to prevent ADC saturation is to suppress the leakage from the Tx side interfering signal and provide protection against potential dynamic range and saturation issues for ADC or LNA when demodulating the UL subband in the Rx path of the gNB.

q_38226.question: Which attribute is used in the ImplicitAffiliations entry of an MCPTT group list to specify the MCPTT group ID?

q_38227.question: What is the main purpose of the classification of services in the CS CN domain?
q_38227.ground_truth: The purpose is to define the basic services, which include circuit teleservices and bearer services, capable of utilizing standardized supplementary services. The PS CN Domain provides IP bearer services, which are utilized by IP multimedia services, which are IP-based session-related services, including voice communications.

q_38228.question: What is the function of the "Source to Target Transparent Container" IE?
q_38228.ground_truth: The "Source to Target Transparent Container" IE is used to transparently pass radio related information from the handover source to the handover target through the core network.

q_38229.question: What is the maximum transmission gap time for the absolute power tolerance requirements to apply?
q_38229.ground_truth: The maximum transmission gap time for the absolute power tolerance requirements to apply is 40 ms.

q_38230.question: What is the purpose of Vendor-Specific-Application-Id AVP in S6m/S6n interface application?
q_38230.ground_truth: The Vendor-Specific-Application-Id AVP is included in all Command Code Format specifications defined in the S6m/S6n interface application to overcome potential interoperability issues with intermediate Diameter agents that are non-compliant with IETF~RFC~6733.

q_38231.question: What actions are taken by the STUN or TURN server after receiving the allocation request from the application?
q_38231.ground_truth: The STUN or TURN server extracts the 5-Tuple information for each media session and conveys it to the Network Support AF in RTC AF for requesting QoS assistance.

q_38232.question: What action should the participating MCPTT function take if the public service identity is not allocated in a SIP INVITE request for establishing a pre-established session?
q_38232.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT function shall check whether the public service identity is allocated and perform the actions specified in clause~6.3.7.1 if it is not allocated.

q_38233.question: What is the procedure described in step 1.2 for?
q_38233.ground_truth: The procedure described in step 1.2 sets up the transmission of downlink signals, schedules PDSCH and PDCCH transmissions, and sends downlink MAC padding bits on the DL RMC.

q_38234.question: What should the new NF service consumer do if it cannot support handling notifications from the NF service producer after a change?
q_38234.ground_truth: The new NF service consumer should update the NF service producer with the new Notification URI.

q_38235.question: What is the effect of an eNB enforcing the MBR of an uplink radio bearer?
q_38235.ground_truth: The eNB can ensure the UE-AMBR plus the sum of MBRs is not exceeded by triggering congestion indications towards higher layers and shaping the data rate towards the S1 interface.

q_38236.question: What is the definition of a superseding-band?
q_38236.ground_truth: A superseding-band of an operating band includes the whole of the uplink and downlink frequency range of the operating band.

q_38237.question: What is the minimum requirement for the total power dynamic range for a wide area IAB-MT type 1-H and a local area IAB-MT type 1-H?
q_38237.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for the total power dynamic range for a wide area IAB-MT type 1-H is larger than or equal to 5 dB, while for a local area IAB-MT type 1-H it is larger than or equal to 10 dB.

q_38238.question: What are some of the differences between the use of Diameter messages in 17.2 and 17.6 for network slice specific authentication?
q_38238.ground_truth: Some of the differences include the replacement of SMF with NSSAAF or AAA-P, the exclusion of IP, Ethernet and PDU session descriptions and AVPs, and the exclusion of accounting function, ACR and ACA messages. Additionally, 3GPP-S-NSSAI is included in the DER command and the address of NSS-AAA server is included in the Origin-Host AVP in the ASR and RAR commands. The presence of 3GPP-S-NSSAI in the DER command is optional, but it is mandatory for the NSSAAF or AAA-P to include it for network slice specific authentication.

q_38239.question: In what way does solution #5 allow PINEs to join or leave a PIN without 5GC involvement?
q_38239.ground_truth: Solution #5 allows PINEs to join or leave a PIN without 5GC involvement by having the PIN AS authorize whether a PINE is allowed to join a PIN, and having the PEMC invite or expel a PINE from a PIN. A PINE can also request to join or leave a PIN.

q_38240.question: What is the N15 reference point used for and where is it located in non-roaming scenarios?
q_38240.ground_truth: The N15 reference point is used for the AMF to access the UE Policy Control Service at the PCF. In non-roaming scenarios, the N15 reference point is located between the PCF and the AMF.

q_38241.question: Which parameters must be set in the PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message in clause 7.7.2.2 if the initiating UE initiates this procedure?
q_38241.ground_truth: The ProSe identifiers and the target user info must be set in the PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message.

q_38242.question: Upon reception of SIB7, what should the UE do with the received warning message segments when it has all segments of a warning message and the complete warning message has not been assembled within a period of 3 hours?
q_38242.ground_truth: The UE should discard the stored warningMessageSegment and the current values of messageIdentifier and serialNumber for SIB7 if the complete warning message has not been assembled within the specified period.

q_38243.question: What conditions should be met for a UE to include mbms-FreqList in MBMSInterestIndication message?
q_38243.ground_truth: If the set of MBMS frequencies of interest, determined in accordance with 5.8.5.3, is not empty, the UE should include mbms-FreqList and set it to include the MBMS frequencies of interest.

q_38244.question: What are the PUCCH format 2 and CQI reporting periodicity used in this test case?
q_38244.ground_truth: The PUCCH format 2 is used for periodic CQI reporting with a reporting periodicity of 5 ms.

q_38245.question: What network identifiers need to be exchanged by inter-operator agreements in advance for the support of certain SIP requests and responses in IMS networks?
q_38245.ground_truth: Operator network identifiers populated in the type 1 "orig-ioi" and type 1 "term-ioi" header field parameters; type 2 "orig-ioi" and type 2 "term-ioi" header field parameters; and the "transit-ioi" header field parameter.

q_38246.question: What should the MCPTT server consider as the served MCPTT user information entry?
q_38246.ground_truth: The MCPTT server should consider an MCPTT user information entry as the served MCPTT user information entry if it is in the list of MCPTT user information entries and the MCPTT ID of the MCPTT user information entry is equal to the served MCPTT ID.

q_38247.question: What is the role of the MBSF in the MBS session creation process without PCC?
q_38247.ground_truth: The MBSF is responsible for providing MBSF-related interactions and detailed interactions with the MBSTF in the MBS session creation process without PCC.

q_38248.question: What are the conditions for triggering the NG-RAN broadcast PRU wake up information in the target UE camping cell?
q_38248.ground_truth: The NG-RAN broadcasts the PRU wake up information in the target UE camping cell when the target UE supports positioning by PRU and the target UE is in CM-IDLE/RRC-inactive state.

q_38249.question: What should the Refer-To header field of the SIP REFER request contain?
q_38249.ground_truth: The Refer-To header field of the SIP REFER request should contain a Content-ID URL that points to an application/resource-lists+xml MIME body.

q_38250.question: What information does the UE transmit to the LMF when requested to measure DL PRS and UL SRS?
q_38250.ground_truth: The UE transmits UL SRS if requested at step~7 and/or measures DL PRS from the MBSR (and other gNBs) if requested at step~9, including the time of measurements when measured.

q_38251.question: What should be done if the measId value is linked to the measObjectId value corresponding to the source carrier frequency and the UE performs RRC Connection Re-establishment?
q_38251.ground_truth: The measId value should be linked to the measObjectId value corresponding to the target carrier frequency.

q_38252.question: What is a media profile in the context of 3GPP VR?
q_38252.ground_truth: A media profile in the context of 3GPP VR is a set of requirements and constraints for a specific media type in a 3GPP VR track.

q_38253.question: How does the DSO modify or update information in the MOI?
q_38253.ground_truth: The DSO sends a modifyMOIAttributes request to the MNO in order to modify or update any information in the MOI. The DSO can create, read, update, or delete (CRUD) the information in the MOI by using provisioning MnS.

q_38254.question: What is the effect of sending '0' as the <sec> value in the CAPD command?
q_38254.ground_truth: Sending '0' as the <sec> value in the CAPD command dismisses a currently active alarm.

q_38255.question: Which resource allocation scheme is used for PDCCH/SPDCCH with uplink DCI format 7-0A/7-0B for allocating virtual resource block assignments?
q_38255.ground_truth: Resource allocation scheme Type 0 is used for PDCCH/SPDCCH with uplink DCI format 7-0A/7-0B for allocating virtual resource block assignments.

q_38256.question: What is the default value of the <mode> parameter in the HSCSD parameters report +CHSR command?
q_38256.ground_truth: The default value of the <mode> parameter in the HSCSD parameters report +CHSR command is 0, which disables reporting.

q_38257.question: What is the role of DN-AAA Server in the PDU Session Establishment procedure?
q_38257.ground_truth: DN-AAA Server is responsible for confirming the successful authentication/authorization of the PDU Session for the specific application based on the SMF policy associated with the DN.

q_38258.question: What is the role of the 5G U2U Relay PKMF in the U2U relay discovery process?
q_38258.ground_truth: The 5G U2U Relay PKMF is responsible for checking the authorization of the 5G ProSe UE, providing the discovery security materials related to U2U relay discovery, and specifying how the provided security material is used in the U2U relay discovery procedure.

q_38259.question: What should the transmission control server interface do upon receiving a MediaTransmission Notification message that is not destined to a specific transmission participant in an MCVideo client?
q_38259.ground_truth: It should set the first bit in the subtype of the MediaTransmission Notification message to '0' and send the MediaTransmission Notification message to all transmission participant interfaces.

q_38260.question: What parameter in 3GPP TS 52.008 represents a reference associated with a tracing request?

q_38261.question: What is the purpose of the IMS Service Profile and where is it defined and maintained?
q_38261.ground_truth: The IMS Service Profile is a collection of service and user related data that specifies service and user preferences. It is defined and maintained in the HSS and its scope is limited to IM CN Subsystem.

q_38262.question: What action does the UE take if it receives a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message with the reject cause set to "UE implicitly detached"?
q_38262.ground_truth: The UE enters the state EMM-DEREGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE and sends an ATTACH REQUEST message.

q_38263.question: What is the role of 5G-XR AF in the UE and/or 5G-XR Application Provider?
q_38263.ground_truth: The 5G-XR AF provides control functions to the XR Session Handler on the UE and/or to the 5G-XR Application Provider. It may also interact with other network functions, relay or initiate requests for Policy or Charging Function (PCF) treatment.

q_38264.question: What is the impact of Rx beam orientation in the scenario where one boresight Tx beam is used at the RRH and one Rx beam is used at the UE?
q_38264.ground_truth: Rx beam orientation has a significant impact on performance. Wrong orientation of Rx beam results in significant loss of performance, while Rx beam oriented 10-15 degrees from the UE panel boresight towards the RRH provides the best performance in Scenario-B.

q_38265.question: What information is included in the PIN service switch notification sent by the PIN Server to the Application Server?
q_38265.ground_truth: The PIN service switch notification includes the PIN server identifier, PIN identifier, Application Client identifier, target PIN Client, application session identifier, and an IP 4 tuple that describes the traffic of the application session.

q_38266.question: What does the "SM RP DA" parameter contain when used in a mobile-originated short message transfer?
q_38266.ground_truth: The "SM RP DA" parameter contains the Service Centre address received from the mobile station when used in a mobile-originated short message transfer.

q_38267.question: What is the parameter "MME-Diameter-Address-For-MT-SMS" used for in the 3GPP TS 23.012 standard?
q_38267.ground_truth: The parameter "MME-Diameter-Address-For-MT-SMS" is used by an IWF to register an MME for MT-SMS and may be stored in the HLR to be sent in SMS interrogation responses to SMS-GMSCs.

q_38268.question: What state does the transmission control interface enter when it receives a Transmission Grant message from the transmission control arbitration logic in the MCVideo server?
q_38268.ground_truth: The transmission control interface enters the state 'U: permitted' when it receives a Transmission Grant message from the transmission control arbitration logic in the MCVideo server.

q_38269.question: What structure does the ID id-UE-associatedLogicalS1-ConnectionListResAck have in the S1AP protocol?
q_38269.ground_truth: ID id-UE-associatedLogicalS1-ConnectionListResAck has the criticallyality ignore, the type UE-associatedLogicalS1-ConnectionListResAck, and the presence optional.

q_38270.question: What is the meaning of "SNMobilityInformation" in the SN STatus field of the SN Anomaly Report, and how is it used?
q_38270.ground_truth: The "SNMobilityInformation" field in the SN Status field of the SN Anomaly Report contains information about the SN's mobility. It includes the SN's type, the SN's handed-over cell ID (if applicable), and the SN's allowed coverage. The SN Status field also includes the SN's mobility status, which indicates whether the SN is currently in use or not. The SNMobilityInformation field is used to identify the SN's current location and mobility status in the SN Status report.

q_38271.question: What type of information can the NWDAF collect from other 5GC NFs for relative proximity analytics?
q_38271.ground_truth: The NWDAF collects a set of input data from other 5GC NFs such as DCAF and OAM for relative proximity analytics.

q_38272.question: What is the purpose of the primary authentication procedure in the 5GS?
q_38272.ground_truth: The primary authentication procedure is started by the AMF/SEAF to authenticate the UE and establish a security context for the subsequent network procedures.

q_38273.question: What information does the AMF provide if a target AMF instance needs to be selected for intra-PLMN mobility?
q_38273.ground_truth: The AMF may provide AMF Set ID, AMF Region ID, target location information, S-NSSAI(s) of Allowed NSSAI, and optionally, the NRF to use.

q_38274.question: What is the difference between the solution described in section 7.46.2.2 and section 7.47.2.2?
q_38274.ground_truth: The solution described in section 7.46.2.2 focuses on the EAS bundles scenario where bundled EAS(s) are associated with one EES or multiple EES(s), while the solution described in section 7.47.2.2 focuses on the EAS bundles scenario where bundled EAS(s) are associated with one AC and multiple EES(s).

q_38275.question: What is the mean UL Average-UPT gain for semi-static SBFD at low load level with SBFD Alt 4 and small packet size?
q_38275.ground_truth: The mean UL Average-UPT gain for semi-static SBFD at low load level with SBFD Alt 4 and small packet size is 104.37%.

q_38276.question: What must be done before the NAS message can be sent both ciphered and integrity protected?
q_38276.ground_truth: The NAS message is first ciphered, and then the ciphered NAS message and the NAS sequence number are integrity protected by calculating the MAC.

q_38277.question: What action is taken by the MS after timer TE expires in the "PLMNs with E-UTRA not allowed" list?
q_38277.ground_truth: The MS will delete stored information in the "PLMNs with E-UTRA not allowed" list when the MS is switched off, the USIM is removed, or timer TE expires.

q_38278.question: What is the significance of Services and protocol service names for the S-NAPTR procedure under 3GPP TS 23.003 clause 19.4.3?
q_38278.ground_truth: The Services and protocol service names for the S-NAPTR procedure under 3GPP TS 23.003 clause 19.4.3 are used in accordance with the 3GPP specifications to identify the service and protocols in the S-NAPTR procedure.

q_38279.question: What is the purpose of the "E" parameter in the context of 5G ProSe direct discovery?
q_38279.ground_truth: The "E" parameter is used to scramble or unscramble the PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message containing the ProSe restricted code in restricted 5G ProSe direct discovery.

q_38280.question: In which layer of RTP/RTCP signaling are ROI information parameters defined?
q_38280.ground_truth: ROI information parameters are defined in the application layer of RTP/RTCP signaling, independent of the negotiated video resolution for the encoded content.

q_38281.question: In which clause of the 3GPP TS 38.214 standard is the procedure for determining the TBS for DCI format 1C and DCI format 6-2 specified?
q_38281.ground_truth: The procedure for determining the TBS for DCI format 1C and DCI format 6-2 is specified in Clause 7.1.7.2.1.

q_38282.question: Which data type is used in the 3GPP Time Synchronization Exposure API to indicate the supported 5G clock quality (i.e. the source of time used by the 5GS)?
q_38282.ground_truth: The data type AsTimeResource is used in the 3GPP Time Synchronization Exposure API to indicate the supported 5G clock quality (i.e. the source of time used by the 5GS).

q_38283.question: What are the initial conditions for the system simulator in the "Communication with the ProSe Function: Initial Access" procedure?
q_38283.ground_truth: The parameters are set to the default parameters for the basic single cell environment, as defined in subclause 4.4.

q_38284.question: What action does the gNB-DU take if the IAB TNL ADDRESS REQUEST message contains the IAB TNL Addresses To Remove List IE?
q_38284.ground_truth: The gNB-DU considers the listed TNL addresses and prefixes as no longer used by the IAB-node

q_38285.question: When is a Track Fragment Adjustment Box applied in a 3GP file or Media Segment?
q_38285.ground_truth: A Track Fragment Adjustment Box is only applied when randomly accessing a 3GP file or a Media Segment at a movie fragment containing the Track Fragment Adjustment Box. It is not applied during continuous playback.

q_38286.question: What are the possible values for the maximum heading that can be set for a unit's MCPTT deactivation in the context of network functional aliases?
q_38286.ground_truth: The maximum heading that can be set for a unit's MCPTT deactivation in the context of network functional aliases is a value between 0 and 359.

q_38287.question: What do data sampling rules specify about the collection of domain-specific parameters associated with the Event ID?
q_38287.ground_truth: Data sampling rules specify how the domain-specific parameters associated with the Event ID are to be collected by the data collection client, such as sampling frequency and location filter.

q_38288.question: What is the OTA transmitter OFF TRP spectral density minimum requirement for NCR-Fwd type 2-O in NR repeater?
q_38288.ground_truth: The OTA transmitter OFF TRP spectral density for NCR-Fwd type 2-O in NR repeater shall be less than -36~dBm/MHz.

q_38289.question: When should the UE initiate the tracking area updating procedure?
q_38289.ground_truth: The UE in state EMM-REGISTERED and EMM-IDLE mode should initiate the tracking area updating procedure by sending a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message to the MME when the UE detects entering a new tracking area that is not in the TAI list.

q_38290.question: What is the time to first SSB transmission after L1-RSRP measurement for TCI state switching involving QCL-TypeD?
q_38290.ground_truth: Tfirst-SSB is the time to first SSB transmission after L1-RSRP measurement for TCI state switching involving QCL-TypeD.

q_38291.question: What is the significance of ML entity performance indicators for the AI/ML inference?
q_38291.ground_truth: ML entity performance indicators are essential for performance evaluation during the inference phase.

q_38292.question: What should the controlling MCVideo function do if the in-progress emergency group state is "false" and the SIP re-INVITE request contains an imminent peril indication with a valid Resource-Priority header field?
q_38292.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function should validate the SIP re-INVITE request and send a SIP UPDATE request towards the initiator of the SIP re-INVITE request if the request includes an improperly populated Resource-Priority header field. Upon receiving a SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP UPDATE request, the controlling MCVideo function should proceed with the rest of the steps.

q_38293.question: What must be done if uplink PDCP delay results are available for reporting?
q_38293.ground_truth: The ul-PDCP-DelayResultList and ul-PDCP-DelayValueResultList must be set to include the uplink PDCP delay results available and the corresponding average uplink PDCP delay values, respectively.

q_38294.question: What kind of message is transported in a MONP MCVIDEO MESSAGE CARRIER message in an off-network MCVideo group call?
q_38294.ground_truth: The MONP MCVIDEO MESSAGE CARRIER message is the entire payload of the UDP message.

q_38295.question: What should a UE do if it does not have the CFR information and subcarrier spacing for MBS broadcast reception on a non-serving cell at the time it sends the MBS Interest Indication?
q_38295.ground_truth: If the UE does not have the CFR information and subcarrier spacing for MBS broadcast reception on a non-serving cell at the time it sends the MBS Interest Indication, the UE shall send an MBS Interest Indication after it has acquired those information from the non-serving cell.

q_38296.question: When is an MS required to perform a combined routing area updating procedure with IMSI attach?
q_38296.ground_truth: When the MS is attached for GPRS services only and timer T3444 or T3445 is running.

q_38297.question: What is the format of the Communication-Failure-Information AVP as defined in the 3GPP AVP specification?
q_38297.ground_truth: The Communication-Failure-Information AVP is of type Grouped and contains the reason for communication failure. It includes AVPs such as Cause-Type, S1AP-Cause, RANAP-Cause, BSSGP-Cause, GMM-Cause, and SM-Cause.

q_38298.question: Which 3GPP specification defines the requirements for a UE that supports access transfer to the EPS IP-CAN?

q_38299.question: What are the two projection formats permitted by this operation point?

q_38300.question: What does it mean for an enumeration value to be applicable to only optional feature(s)?
q_38300.ground_truth: An enumeration value that is only applicable to optional feature(s) can only be used in JSON files if the corresponding feature has been negotiated and is supported.

q_38301.question: What are the two modes of network selection for WiMAX non-3GPP access network?
q_38301.ground_truth: The two modes of network selection for WiMAX non-3GPP access network are manual and automatic.

q_38302.question: What encryption key should be used to calculate the shortMAC-I for the RRCConnectionReestablishmentRequest message?
q_38302.ground_truth: The shortMAC-I should be calculated with the KRRCint key and integrity protection algorithm used in the source cell (handover and mobility from E-UTRA failure) or the cell where the trigger for re-establishment occurred (other cases).

q_38303.question: When a UE accesses the SNPN over NWu via a PLMN, what indication is sent towards the UE during the Registration procedure to indicate if an IMS voice over PS session is supported or not?
q_38303.ground_truth: The AMF in the SNPN sends the indication during the Registration procedure to indicate whether an IMS voice over PS session is supported or not.

q_38304.question: What analytics information can the PCF request from the NWDAF upon reception of a request from AF/NEF for negotiation for future background data transfer?

q_38305.question: What is the key issue studied in 5.1.1 of the present document?
q_38305.ground_truth: The key issue studied in 5.1.1 of the present document is the determination of application identification, where the application identity is used in the UE to identify the traffic of an application but is non-protected, leading to potential security requirements.

q_38306.question: What function is used in solution #4.1 for 5G VN over satellite backhaul charging?
q_38306.ground_truth: The SMF Charging Trigger Function (CTF) is used in solution #4.1 for 5G VN over satellite backhaul charging.

q_38307.question: When is a UE required to provide the NB-IoT UE radio capabilities to the network?
q_38307.ground_truth: A UE is required to provide NB-IoT UE radio capabilities to the network when it is camping on NB-IoT.

q_38308.question: What entity is responsible for transforming the service area information into Service Area Information expressed in a list of TAI or cell ID?
q_38308.ground_truth: The NEF (Non-3GPP Interworking Function) is responsible for this transformation.

q_38309.question: What is the minimum requirement for ACLR for single-carrier in normal test environment?
q_38309.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for ACLR for single-carrier in normal test environment is specified in TS~36.104 subclause 6.6.2.1.

q_38310.question: What is the minimum RF requirement established by the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) for NR User Equipment (UE) operating on frequency Range 2 in the "3GPP TR 38.101-2: User Equipment (UE) radio transmission and reception; Part 2: Range 2 Standalone (Release 18)" document?
q_38310.ground_truth: The present document establishes the minimum RF requirements for NR User Equipment (UE) operating on frequency Range 2.

q_38311.question: Under what conditions is a UE considered to have met the beam correspondence requirements based on both SSB and CSI-RS?
q_38311.ground_truth: A UE is considered to have met the beam correspondence requirements based on both SSB and CSI-RS if it meets enhanced beam correspondence requirements either based on SSB or based on CSI-RS, and if it meets the minimum peak EIRP requirement as defined in clause 6.2.1.7 using the CSI-RS based side conditions in clause 6.6.8.3.3, where the link direction is determined in the SSB based enhanced beam correspondence test.

q_38312.question: What must the data type be if the presence condition of a data structure in the response body is "C" or "O"?
q_38312.ground_truth: The data type can be "integer", "number", "string", or "boolean", or a data type defined in a 3GPP specification. If the presence condition is "C" or "O", the cardinality shall be set to "0..1".

q_38313.question: What is the requirement for the various user and machine accounts on a system to be protected from misuse?
q_38313.ground_truth: The requirement is that the various user and machine accounts on a system shall be protected from misuse, and this is achieved by using an authentication attribute, which, when combined with the user name, enables unambiguous authentication and identification of the authorized user.

q_38314.question: What action does End UE#1 perform before sending a Link Modification Request message in Scenario #1?
q_38314.ground_truth: End UE#1 decides to perform U2U Relay reselection with End UE#2 and to generate a new KNRP ID with End UE#2 based on this decision to maintain the current connection via Relay#1.

q_38315.question: What should the ATCF do if local policy requires the application of IBCF capabilities in the visited network towards the home network?
q_38315.ground_truth: The ATCF should select an exit point of the visited network and forward the request to that entry point.

q_38316.question: What is the issue addressed by the first solution, "Enable efficient mobility via equivalent SNPNs"?
q_38316.ground_truth: The first solution addresses the issue of enhancing mobility between SNPNs without the need for a new network selection.

q_38317.question: What information is included in the computation of the Buffer Size field in a BSR?
q_38317.ground_truth: The Buffer Size field in a BSR identifies the total amount of data available for transmission in bytes, including all data that is available for transmission in the RLC layer and in the PDCP layer.

q_38318.question: What entity is responsible for applying the received DL UE Slice MBR limit to the set of all bearers for which the SN hosts PDCP for the concerned Slice in MR-DC with 5GC?
q_38318.ground_truth: The PDCP entity at the SN

q_38319.question: What should a UE do when it has initiated a combined tracking area updating procedure, the tracking area updating attempt counter is less than 5, the TAI of the current serving cell is included in the TAI list, and the EPS update status is equal to EU1 UPDATED?
q_38319.ground_truth: The UE should keep the EPS update status to EU1 UPDATED and enter the state EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE. The UE should start timer T3411, and when timer T3411 expires, the tracking area updating procedure is triggered again.

q_38320.question: What information is sent from the EES/UE/EEC to the EES in step 1 of the solution described in clause 6.31.2?
q_38320.ground_truth: The UE's IP address and the verification information (the random number in GBA scenarios or A-KID in AKMA scenarios) are sent from the EES/UE/EEC to the EES in step 1 of the solution described in clause 6.31.2.

q_38321.question: Which test case applies to all types of NR UE that support UL MIMO?
q_38321.ground_truth: The test case in 6.4D.3.2 applies to all types of NR UE that support UL MIMO.

q_38322.question: What action does the floor control arbitration logic take when it receives an implicit floor request due to an upgrade to an emergency group call or imminent peril call?
q_38322.ground_truth: The floor control arbitration logic stops timer T1 (End of RTP media) and T20 (Floor Granted), sets the Reject Cause field in the Floor Revoke message to #4 (Media Burst pre-empted), enters the 'G: pending Floor Revoke' state, inserts the floor participant into the active floor request queue to the position in front of all other queued requests, and sends a Floor Queue Position Info message to the requesting floor participant.

q_38323.question: What do the terms "shall" and "shall not" indicate in the document?
q_38323.ground_truth: "Shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something, and "shall not" indicates an interdiction (prohibition) to do something.

q_38324.question: What is the effect of the timeAlignmentTimer associated with the pTAG expiry on the UE's uplink transmission?
q_38324.ground_truth: When the timeAlignmentTimer associated with the pTAG expires and timeAlignmentTimerSTAG for the sTAG had not yet expired and UL transmission is required, the UE considers all timeAlignmentTimers, including the one for sTAG, as expired, triggers a RA Procedure on the PCell and releases SRS.

q_38325.question: In the context of network failure, what action does the MME take when dedicated bearers fail to be established?
q_38325.ground_truth: The MME indicates the failed bearers in the Path Switch Request Ack message and initiates the bearer release procedure to release the core network resources of the failed dedicated EPS bearers.

q_38326.question: What indications does the UPF report to the CHF and LI when a new IP address has been allocated to a PDU Session together with the corresponding MAC address in the "Combo IP + Ethernet" PDU Session Type?
q_38326.ground_truth: The UPF reports an indication of a new IP address having been allocated to a PDU Session together with the indication of the corresponding MAC Address to the CHF and LI in the "Combo IP + Ethernet" PDU Session Type.

q_38327.question: When is the UE required to transmit PRACH on PUCCH SCell and allowed to drop or cause interruption to SRS or PUCCH or PUSCH transmission on the SpCell or any activated SCell?
q_38327.ground_truth: The UE is required to transmit PRACH on PUCCH SCell and allowed to drop or cause interruption to SRS or PUCCH or PUSCH transmission on the SpCell or any activated SCell if the UE is not capable of parallelTxPRACH-SRS-PUCCH-PUSCH for inter-band CA, and PRACH on PUCCH SCell and PUCCH/PUSCH/SRS on other active serving cells are fully or partially overlapping in time.

q_38328.question: What is the method employed by the target eNB to enforce the correct delivery order of packets after the downlink path is switched at the Serving GW downlink?
q_38328.ground_truth: The method employed in the target eNB to enforce the correct delivery order of packets is outside the scope of the standard.

q_38329.question: What are the factors that affect the TCI state switching delay for a MAC-CE based switch if the TCI state is unknown?
q_38329.ground_truth: For a MAC-CE based TCI state switch with an unknown target TCI state, the delay is affected by the time for Rx beam refinement in FR2 for CSI-RS measurements, the number of resources in the resource set for aperiodic CSI-RS, and the value of TOuk based on whether the TCI state switching involves QCL-TypeD or other QCL types.

q_38330.question: What is the difference between the first digit values in 3GPP Technical Specification versioning?
q_38330.ground_truth: The first digit indicates the stage of approval of the document within the TSG: 0 - presented to TSG for information, 1 - presented to TSG for approval, 2 or greater - TSG approved document under change control.

q_38331.question: What is the role of the "influence-id" in the PCC Rules of the SMF?
q_38331.ground_truth: The "influence-id" in the PCC Rules of the SMF is used to determine the lists of DNAIs in different PDU Sessions that are related to each other. It helps to assign the same traffic influence service data to multiple ad-hoc groups, where each group may have different traffic influence service data containing the same DNN/S-NSSAI.

q_38332.question: What should be set as the PDN type for the default EPS bearer context when creating the contents of a PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message for a PDU session with PDU session type "IPv6"?
q_38332.ground_truth: The PDN type should be set to "IPv6".

q_38333.question: What is the implication of the 'P' field in the Extended PHR MAC control elements being set to 1?
q_38333.ground_truth: If the 'P' field in the Extended PHR MAC control elements is set to 1, it indicates that the MAC entity applies power backoff due to power management.

q_38334.question: What should the UE do when it receives a UEInformationRequest message with rlf-ReportReq set to true?
q_38334.ground_truth: The UE should send a UEInformationResponse message with rlf-Report and PLMN list as detailed in TS 36.331, clause 5.3.11.3 and TP (2).

q_38335.question: In SL-TOA positioning method, what measurements do the peer UEs use to determine the location of the target UE?
q_38335.ground_truth: SL-RTOA (and optionally SL-PRS-RSRP and/or SL-PRS-RSRPP) measurements.

q_38336.question: What message does the TNGF send to the AMF to indicate that it supports the TAI and S-NSSAIs provided in the N2 Setup Request?
q_38336.ground_truth: The N2 Setup Request message from TNGF to AMF includes the supported TAI and the supported S-NSSAIs for this TAI, which informs the AMF about the slices supported by the TNGF.

q_38337.question: What action should the V-PCF take when it determines a received "MANAGE UE POLICY COMPLETE" or "MANAGE UE POLICY COMMAND REJECT" message is related to the result of a "MANAGE UE POLICY COMMAND" message?
q_38337.ground_truth: The V-PCF shall determine if the message is related to the result of a UE policy provided by the H-PCF and forward the corresponding "MANAGE UE POLICY COMPLETE" or "MANAGE UE POLICY COMMAND REJECT" message to the H-PCF.

q_38338.question: What is the minimum requirement for MSR UTRA FDD operation in terms of CPICH power requirement?
q_38338.ground_truth: There is no CPICH power requirement for MSR UTRA FDD operation.

q_38339.question: What is the difference between contention based and non-contention based random access procedure?
q_38339.ground_truth: Contention based random access procedure is applicable to all six events, while non-contention based random access procedure is applicable to handover, DL data arrival, positioning and obtaining timing advance alignment for a sTAG.

q_38340.question: What should the MME do if it receives an ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message as a result of a UE requested bearer resource allocation procedure or a UE requested bearer resource modification procedure?
q_38340.ground_truth: If the ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message is received as a result of a UE requested bearer resource allocation procedure or a UE requested bearer resource modification procedure, the MME should include the procedure transaction identity (PTI) value received by the MME in the BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST or BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST respectively in the ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message.

q_38341.question: What is the maximum number of times a UE can retransmit a Random Access Preamble if a matching Random Access response is not received within the RA Response window?
q_38341.ground_truth: The maximum number of times a UE can retransmit a Random Access Preamble in a Random Access procedure is preambleTransMax+1. After preambleTransMax+1 unsuccessful transmissions, the UE shall indicate a Random Access problem to upper layers.

q_38342.question: In the definition of "IABTNLAddressesRequested", what does "F1-U" in "tNLAddressesOrPrefixesRequestedF1-U" represent?
q_38342.ground_truth: F1-U represents "Frequency Range 1 Uplink" in the context of 5G networks.

q_38343.question: What is the maximum delay uncertainty allowed in the measurement reporting delay as defined in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 8.11.2.1.1.1?
q_38343.ground_truth: The delay uncertainty is 2 x TTI DCCH.

q_38344.question: What are the benefits of supporting both direct AI/ML and AI/ML assisted positioning approaches in indoor factory scenarios?
q_38344.ground_truth: They can significantly improve the positioning accuracy compared to existing RAT-dependent positioning methods in the evaluated indoor factory scenarios.

q_38345.question: When can the network slice data rate limitation control be not applicable for the S-NSSAI(s)?
q_38345.ground_truth: Based on operator policy, the network slice data rate limitation control can be not applicable for the S-NSSAI(s) used for emergency services or priority services.

q_38346.question: Which protocol is used as the basis for the MPQUIC steering functionality in clause 6.11?
q_38346.ground_truth: The MPQUIC steering functionality is based on RFC~9298 "proxying UDP in HTTP" and the HTTP/3 protocol, which operates on top of the QUIC protocol.

q_38347.question: In the overall context, what is the main concern that the introduced solutions aim to address?
q_38347.ground_truth: The main concern that the introduced solutions aim to address is network function (NF) certification, lifecycle management, and security.

q_38348.question: What is the consequence of not receiving an INFORMATIONAL response in the UE-initiated liveness check procedure, as specified in section 7.8.4 of the document?
q_38348.ground_truth: The UE shall deem the IKEv2 security association to have failed, discard all states associated with the IKE SA and any child SAs that were negotiated using that IKE SA, and inform the upper layers that the access stratum connection has been released.

q_38349.question: What field in the Spatial Relation for Resource IDi indicates the type of a resource used as a spatial relation for the i-th Positioning SRS resource?

q_38350.question: What event triggers the IRI-POI in the EES to generate an xIRI containing an EESAppContextRelocation record in 7.14.2.6?
q_38350.ground_truth: The IRI-POI present in the EES detects that an EEC has requested ACR (Application Context Relocation) determination or initiation.

q_38351.question: What action does the gNB-CU-UP take if it does not receive a GNB-CU-CP E1 SETUP RESPONSE message or GNB-CU-CP E1 SETUP FAILURE message?
q_38351.ground_truth: If the gNB-CU-UP does not receive either of these messages, it may reinitiate the gNB-CU-CP E1 Setup procedure towards the same gNB-CU-CP.

q_38352.question: What HTTP status code is returned when a PATCH request to update the PSI activation state is successful?

q_38353.question: What message does the MN send to the source SN to indicate that CPC is prepared in step 5?
q_38353.ground_truth: The MN sends the SN Change Confirm message towards the source SN to indicate that CPC is prepared.

q_38354.question: Which parameter determines the power-ramping factor in case of a prioritized Random Access procedure?

q_38355.question: What should the initiating UE do after receiving the PROSE DIRECT LINK IDENTIFIER UPDATE ACCEPT message from the target UE?
q_38355.ground_truth: The initiating UE should transmit the PROSE DIRECT LINK IDENTIFIER UPDATE ACK message with the old layer-2 IDs if it receives another PROSE DIRECT LINK IDENTIFIER UPDATE ACCEPT message from the target UE before it receives the traffic from the target UE with the new layer-2 IDs.

q_38356.question: What should the MS do when it receives a USAT REFRESH command qualifier of type "Steering of Roaming" in the PLMN Automatic or Manual Mode Selection Procedure?
q_38356.ground_truth: The MS should replace the highest priority entries in the "Operator Controlled PLMN Selector with Access Technology" list stored in the ME with the list provided in the REFRESH command. It should delete the PLMNs identified by the list in the REFRESH command from the Forbidden PLMN list and the Forbidden PLMNs for GPRS service list. It should take the new information into account in subsequent attempts to access a higher priority PLMN and attempt to obtain service on a higher priority PLMN as specified in clause~4.4.3.3 by acting as if timer T that controls periodic attempts has expired.

q_38357.question: What percentage of PC2/PC3/PC5 UE can have a minimum SINR of 25 dB at the BS side in the indoor scenario?

q_38358.question: What action should the controlling MCPTT function take if the number of SIP 200 (OK) responses is less than the value of the "on-network-minimum-number-to-start" element after the expiry of timer TNG1 and the "on-network-action-upon-expiration-of-timeout-for-acknowledgement-of-required-members" element is set to "abandon" in the group document?
q_38358.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function should abandon the setup of the group call and send a SIP 480 (Temporarily Unavailable) response to the inviting MCPTT client.

q_38359.question: What should a UE do upon receiving an IDENTITY REQUEST message with the identity type IE set to "SUCI" while in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode and with timer T3519 already running?
q_38359.ground_truth: The UE should send an IDENTITY RESPONSE message containing the stored SUCI.

q_38360.question: What is the basis of the solution for addressing Key Issue #2 requirement on authorization in the 3GPP network?
q_38360.ground_truth: The solution is based on ProSe direct discovery security mechanism, which needs to authorize whether the UE is allowed to use the service before provisioning discovery security materials to the UE.

q_38361.question: What should the target AMF include in the content when the UE context transfer cannot be supported between networks?
q_38361.ground_truth: If the continuity of the PDU Session(s) cannot be supported between networks, the target AMF shall include these PDU session(s) with release cause in the toReleaseSessionInfo attribute in the content.

q_38362.question: What is the purpose of the paging assistance information in 5G System?
q_38362.ground_truth: The paging assistance information contains UE radio related information that assists the RAN for efficient paging.

q_38363.question: Which clause in TS~23.304 specifies the N5g-ddnmf service?

q_38364.question: What is the purpose of the Overload Stop procedure in this 3GPP communication standard?
q_38364.ground_truth: The Overload Stop procedure is used to signal to an NG-RAN node that the overload situation at the AMF has ended and normal operation shall resume, utilizing non-UE associated signalling.

q_38365.question: What procedure is used when the UE tries to reestablish the RRC connection?
q_38365.ground_truth: The RRC connection reestablishment procedure is used, where the UE sends a preamble to the gNB-DU, which responds with RAR, and then the UE sends RRCReestablishmentRequest message, which contains old C-RNTI and old PCI.

q_38366.question: What should the floor control interface do upon receiving the Floor Idle message from the floor control server arbitration logic in the MCPTT server when in the 'U: permitted' state and an indication that the participant is overridden without revoke is stored?
q_38366.ground_truth: The floor control interface should send Floor Idle message to the associated floor participant, remove the indication that a participant is overridden without revoke, and remain in 'U: permitted' state.

q_38367.question: What is the entering condition for event A4H2 to be satisfied?
q_38367.ground_truth: Both condition A4H2-1 and condition A4H2-2 must be fulfilled.

q_38368.question: What is the role of the Packet Flow Description Function (PFDF) in the 5G system?
q_38368.ground_truth: The PFDF provides the PFD Management Service to NF service consumers, such as the Session Management Function (SMF) and the Network Data Analytics Function (NWDAF), by managing Packet Flow Descriptions (PFDs).

q_38369.question: What should the UE do when the conditions for RSRP measurement based on RSS are met?
q_38369.ground_truth: If the UE performs RSRP measurement based on RSS for a serving cell, it is not expected to perform RSRP measurement based on CRS for the same serving cell.

q_38370.question: What is the responsibilities of the Session Management Function (SMF) in the 5G system?
q_38370.ground_truth: The SMF is responsible for providing session management, including session establishment, modification, and release; UE IP address allocation and management; selection and control of user plane functions; termination of interfaces towards policy control functions; and control part of policy enforcement and QoS.

q_38371.question: What is the procedure for introducing the bundled EAS list in AC profile in the solution described in section 7.46.2.2?
q_38371.ground_truth: The bundled EAS list is introduced in AC profile to represent that the multiple EAS(s) are to serve the same AC.

q_38372.question: What actions does the EES take if the EEC selects an EAS that is not currently instantiated?
q_38372.ground_truth: If the EEC selects an EAS that is not currently instantiated, the EES requests the MnS to perform EAS instantiation for the selected EAS.

q_38373.question: What is the purpose of the "VPLMNs with preferred WLAN Selection" rules in the HPLMN or VPLMN?
q_38373.ground_truth: The "VPLMNs with preferred WLAN Selection" rules in the HPLMN or VPLMN provide information to the UE for selecting a WLAN access network and a PLMN for 3GPP-based authentication over WLAN. These rules prioritize the selection of specific service providers when roaming.

q_38374.question: Which modes does the test applicability defined in 6.6.9.1.2 apply to?
q_38374.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of NR UE release 16 onwards, supporting 2DL CA and idleInactiveNR-MeasReport-r16.

q_38375.question: What information element may be included in the PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for relay discovery additional information?

q_38376.question: What is the HTTP status code range for failures or redirections in the Notify SM Context Status service operation?
q_38376.ground_truth: The HTTP status code for failures or redirections in the Notify SM Context Status service operation is 4xx/5xx.

q_38377.question: How should the network select the codec for UTRAN in a speech call if a Supported Codec List information element is received in the CALL CONFIRMED message?
q_38377.ground_truth: The network shall use the list contained in the Supported Codec List information element to select the codec for UTRAN in a speech call if one is received in the CALL CONFIRMED message.

q_38378.question: Which Release of E-UTRA UE does the test applicability defined in section 4.5.1.4.2 apply to?
q_38378.ground_truth: The test applies to all types of E-UTRA UE Release 15 and forward supporting EN-DC FR1 and long DRX cycle.

q_38379.question: What is the mechanism used in Solution #30 to protect the privacy-sensitive information in the DCR message of UE-to-UE Relay discovery?
q_38379.ground_truth: The mechanism uses a code security parameter to protect the privacy-sensitive information in the DCR message and uses security materials to secure the link establishment.

q_38380.question: What is the aim of the "Distribution of DL UE throughput in gNB" measurement?
q_38380.ground_truth: The aim of the "Distribution of DL UE throughput in gNB" measurement is to provide the distribution of the UE throughput in downlink, split across multiple slots, for large and small data bursts. It is intended for data bursts that are large enough to require transmissions to be split across multiple slots.

q_38381.question: What entity uses the services of both the LLC sublayer and the MM entity of the MM sublayer in addition to the SMS entity for non-GPRS services?

q_38382.question: What is the maximum interruption time allowed if the target cell is known in the E-UTRAN FDD - UTRAN FDD handover?
q_38382.ground_truth: The interruption time shall be less than Tinterrupt1 = TIU + Tsync + 50 + 10*Fmax + TMC ms.

q_38383.question: What information does the 5GMSu Client process when establishing a transport session for uplink media streaming?
q_38383.ground_truth: The 5GMSu Client processes the Media Entry Point to discover the set of available Service Descriptions, and selects a Dynamic Policy with a matching External reference when establishing a transport session for uplink media streaming.

q_38384.question: What is the purpose of the "stale" header field parameter in the 407 (Proxy Authentication Required) response?
q_38384.ground_truth: The "stale" header field parameter is set to "true" in the 407 (Proxy Authentication Required) response, indicating that the client has provided a valid challenge response for a stale nonce and should be re-authenticated.

q_38385.question: What is the purpose of the service-level authentication and authorization procedure in 3GPP?
q_38385.ground_truth: The service-level authentication and authorization procedure is used to authenticate and authorize the upper layers of the UE when establishing a PDU session. It is part of the UE-requested PDU session procedure and uses the UUAA protocol.

q_38386.question: When is the MME able to reject Mobility Management signalling requests from UEs due to general overload conditions?
q_38386.ground_truth: The MME may reject Mobility Management signalling requests from UEs due to general overload conditions when a NAS request is rejected, and a Mobility Management back-off timer is sent by the MME and stored per UE if a request without the low access priority indicator is rejected by the MME and if MME maintains the UE context. The MME may immediately reject any subsequent request from the UE before the stored back-off time is expired.

q_38387.question: What SIP response does the SCC AS send in response to the SIP INVITE request, upon receiving a certain SIP INFO request?
q_38387.ground_truth: The SCC AS sends a SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP INVITE request.

q_38388.question: What is the NF Service Consumer's role when activating the User Plane connection of a PDU session?
q_38388.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer (e.g. AMF) requests the SMF to activate the user plane connection of an existing PDU session by sending a POST request with specific information.

q_38389.question: When can a UE utilize a COT shared by a COT initiating UE when transmitting PSFCH?
q_38389.ground_truth: A UE can utilize a COT shared by a COT initiating UE when at least one of its PSFCH transmissions is intended for the COT initiating UE.

q_38390.question: What is the condition for a cell to be known by the UE before receiving the report CGI command?
q_38390.ground_truth: A cell is known by the UE before receiving the report CGI command if certain conditions for L3-RSRP measurement reports and SSB detectability are met during the last 5 seconds for FR1 or 3 seconds for FR2.

q_38391.question: What does LI stand for in the context of IMS-based services?

q_38392.question: What should a mobile station do when it's in the MM IDLE state and service state SEARCH FOR PLMN, as specified in section 4.2.2.6?
q_38392.ground_truth: When in state MM IDLE and service state SEARCH FOR PLMN, the mobile station should not start any normal location updating attempt, not perform periodic updating, not perform IMSI detach if powered down, reject any request from CM entities for MM connections except emergency calls, and not respond to paging.

q_38393.question: How should the feature negotiation procedures be handled between the functional entity invoking an API and the CAPIF core function?
q_38393.ground_truth: The functional entity invoking an API and the CAPIF core function shall use Feature Negotiation Procedures as defined in 3GPP TS 29.122 with the following clarifications: description of the SCEF applies to the CAPIF core function; description of the SCS/AS applies to the functional entity invoking an API; the CAPIF Core Function should not register any feature in the NRF; and the AEF should not register any feature for AEF_Security_API in the NRF.

q_38394.question: What is the base object of the GET request in Example 3?

q_38395.question: What analytics procedure does the NWDAF use to provide dispersion analytics to an NF or AF?
q_38395.ground_truth: The NWDAF uses the Dispersion Analytic Procedure to provide dispersion analytics in the form of statistics or predictions to an NF or AF.

q_38396.question: What distance from the mirror is considered the optimal distance to position an offset source with a specific angular offset in order to make the wavefront appear planar at the QZ in the far field scenario?
q_38396.ground_truth: The optimal distance is different for each angular offset of the source and should be determined based on the wavefront analysis.

q_38397.question: What should the UE do upon initiating the WLAN status reporting procedure when it fails to connect to any WLAN inside the WLAN mobility set while T351 is running or when T351 expires?
q_38397.ground_truth: The UE shall transmit the WLANConnectionStatusReport message, setting wlan-status to a failed connection attempt.

q_38398.question: What action should an NF Service Consumer take if it is unable to handle a request but knows that another NF Service Consumer can?
q_38398.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer should reply with an HTTP 307/308 redirect response pointing to the URI of the new NF Service Consumer.

q_38399.question: What should be the approach when excluding components from testing in the SCAS instantiation?
q_38399.ground_truth: Components should not be excluded from testing based on evaluation under another scheme or if developed by a third party. Exclusion is only allowed when the SCAS explicitly permits referring to the certificate obtained under a different scheme for a given set of tests.

q_38400.question: What is the maximum number of simultaneous MCPTT sessions that an MCPTT user can have, as specified in NOTE~4?

q_38401.question: What type of UEs does the NR intra-frequency RRC re-establishment delay test without serving cell timing apply to?
q_38401.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of NR RedCap UE from Release 17 onwards.

q_38402.question: What action must the target UE take if it receives a PROSE DIRECT LINK KEEPALIVE REQUEST message with a keep-alive counter value lower than the last sent value?
q_38402.ground_truth: The target UE must discard the PROSE DIRECT LINK KEEPALIVE REQUEST message in this case.
