q_38403.question: When should the PCF include the "relCause" attribute within the SmPolicyDecision data structure of the response to the POST message?
q_38403.ground_truth: The PCF shall do so upon receiving a POST message from the SMF when usage quota is reached and the PCF requests the PDU session termination.

q_38404.question: What is the test requirement for section 6.5A.3.1.5 of the document?
q_38404.ground_truth: The test requirement is the same as in clause 6.5A.3.1.1.5 for section 6.5A.3.1.5 of the document.

q_38405.question: What is the term for a frequency range in which NR operates, defined with a specific set of technical requirements?

q_38406.question: What action should the last user to change the call type take when changing a group call announcement message to "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL" in the initial procedure?
q_38406.ground_truth: The last user to change the call type should set the stored current call type to "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL", set the stored current ProSe per-packet priority to the value corresponding to MCPTT off-network emergency group call, stop timer TFG14 if running, start timer TFG13 with the specified value, and enter the "T1: in-progress emergency group call" state.

q_38407.question: Which type of message is the RRCSystemInfoRequest?
q_38407.ground_truth: The RRCSystemInfoRequest is a message used to request SI message(s) required by the UE as specified in the 3GPP specification.

q_38408.question: Which type of IE is mandatory for the "NG Setup Request" and should be included in the "SupportedTAList" field?
q_38408.ground_truth: SupportedTAList is a mandatory IE for the "NG Setup Request" which defines the supported TA (Tracking Area) list in the NGAP protocol.

q_38409.question: What is the identifier value of the Null Ciphering algorithm?
q_38409.ground_truth: The identifier value of the Null Ciphering algorithm is "00002".

q_38410.question: What should a participating MCPTT function do upon receipt of a SIP 2xx response to the sent SIP MESSAGE request and upon receipt of a SIP 2xx response to the outgoing SIP MESSAGE requests?
q_38410.ground_truth: Upon receipt of a SIP 2xx response to the sent SIP MESSAGE request, the participating MCPTT function shall forward the SIP 200 (OK) response to the MCPTT client. Upon receipt of SIP 2xx responses to the outgoing SIP MESSAGE requests, the participating MCPTT function shall forward the SIP 2xx response to the controlling MCPTT function.

q_38411.question: What are the charging requirements for a service that provides different service phases at different tariffs?
q_38411.ground_truth: The 3GPP system shall be able to charge for a service that offers different service phases at different tariffs by collecting information on the service change on top of the data already available for the underlying communication.

q_38412.question: When does the NEF map the geographical information to the list of TAs?
q_38412.ground_truth: If the AF provides the service area in the form of geographical information, the NEF maps the geographical information to the list of TAs.

q_38413.question: When receiving a HARQ ACK alone, what action does the UE keep in the HARQ buffer?
q_38413.ground_truth: The UE keeps the data in the HARQ buffer.

q_38414.question: What is the role of the MME Load balancing function in the S1 interface?
q_38414.ground_truth: The MME Load balancing function is responsible for achieving load-balanced MMEs with respect to their processing capacity within a pool area during system operation. It distributes UEs newly entering the pool to different MMEs in the MME pool and equally loads MMEs within the pool area after the introduction of a new MME or the removal of a MME from the network.

q_38415.question: What action does the SCEF take upon successful deletion of a service?
q_38415.ground_truth: The SCEF deletes the resource "Individual xMB Service" together with all sub-resources "GMD via MBMS by xMB" if available, and shall respond to the SCS/AS by sending an HTTP response with 204 No Content.

q_38416.question: What is the overall delay measured in the E-UTRAN TDD - UTRAN TDD event triggered reporting test?
q_38416.ground_truth: The overall delay measured is the time from the beginning of time period T2, to the moment the UE sends an Event B1 triggered measurement report to Cell 2.

q_38417.question: What type of detector receiver must be used to deem the equipment as meeting both the average and quasi-peak limits?

q_38418.question: What should the MS do when it disables its N1 mode capability due to IMS voice not being available and the MS's usage setting was "voice centric"?
q_38418.ground_truth: The MS should add the SNPN identity of the SNPN to the list of SNPNs where voice service was not possible in N1 mode, start timer TK if it is not already running and not consider SNPNs where voice service was not possible in N1 mode as SNPN selection candidates, unless no other SNPN is available.

q_38419.question: In the context of the service request procedure not accepted by the network, what should the UE do if a SERVICE REJECT message with 5GMM cause #76 or #78 was received without integrity protection?
q_38419.ground_truth: The UE shall discard the message.

q_38420.question: What is the applicability of the NR SA FR1 Beam Failure Detection and Link Recovery Test?
q_38420.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of NR UE release 16 and forward, supporting standalone NR-U and supporting UL and SSB-based RLM and link recovery on shared channel access.

q_38421.question: What functionality does the Data Collection Coordination Function (DCCF) support in regards to data processing?
q_38421.ground_truth: The DCCF supports determining data sources, determining whether data is being collected, instructing a Messaging Framework to send data to consumers or notification endpoints, formatting and processing of data, and sending data to consumers or notification endpoints.

q_38422.question: What provides the number of input data errors during NF service discovery at the NRF?
q_38422.ground_truth: Number of failed NF service discoveries due to errors in the input data in the URI query parameters.

q_38423.question: What conditions must be met for the tests on two antenna ports for the PUSCH performance requirement?
q_38423.ground_truth: For the tests on two antenna ports the HARQ retransmissions for multiple codewords are independent.

q_38424.question: What is the difference between the two categories of solutions for traffic identification beyond providing non-wildcarded 5-tuples?
q_38424.ground_truth: The two categories of solutions are Charging separation-only and QoS separation. Charging separation-only solutions involve provisioning application detection filters in the UPF with IP Packet Filter Set (PFS) or PFD parameters, while QoS separation involves provisioning application detection filters in the UE and UPF with either IP Packet Filter Set or PFD parameters.

q_38425.question: What is the confidence level required for a test to pass in the context of SS-RSRP measurement accuracy?
q_38425.ground_truth: For a test to pass, the ratio of successful reported values for each requirement (R1 to R3) needs to be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

q_38426.question: What is the role of the MB-SMF in the MBS session creation process without PCC?
q_38426.ground_truth: The MB-SMF is responsible for receiving TMGI allocation and authorization checks from the NEF/MBSF, allocating TMGI(s), and deriving required QoS parameters in the MBS session creation process without PCC.

q_38427.question: Which type of scenario (PEC, IEC, or ECUR) is supported by both the NSSAAF and AMF for charging data related to Network Slice-Specific Authentication and Authorization?

q_38428.question: What is the EPS services status in the EMM-NULL state?
q_38428.ground_truth: EPS services are disabled in the UE and no EPS mobility management function is performed in this state.

q_38429.question: What must the controlling MCData function do with the MCData ID of the MCData user listed in the MIME resources body of the incoming SIP MESSAGE request?
q_38429.ground_truth: The controlling MCData function must copy the MCData ID of the MCData user into the <mcdata-request-uri> element in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body of the outgoing SIP MESSAGE request.

q_38430.question: Upon receiving a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message, what action does the AMF take regarding timer T3550 and their 5GMM state?
q_38430.ground_truth: The AMF stops timer T3550 and changes to state 5GMM-REGISTERED upon receiving a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message.

q_38431.question: What is the information element type of the 5GS tracking area identity list?
q_38431.ground_truth: The 5GS tracking area identity list is a type 4 information element.

q_38432.question: What is the condition under which the basic limit requirement for repeater type 1-C Bandwidth edge is applied in a supported downlink operating band without any carrier transmitted?
q_38432.ground_truth: The basic limit requirement for repeater type 1-C Bandwidth edge is applied in a supported downlink operating band without any carrier transmitted when there are carrier(s) transmitted in another supported downlink operating band.

q_38433.question: How does the API Invoker initiate the service invocation with the AEF?
q_38433.ground_truth: The API Invoker can send an Authentication Initiation Request to the AEF, including the CCF assigned API invoker ID and UE ID. The AEF provides security information related to the chosen security method, including AEF Key and service API authorization information. The API Invoker and the AEF can then perform mutual authentication using the AEF key and establish a TLS session.

q_38434.question: What kind of inputs does the cross domain MDA MnS producer consume for MDA purposes?
q_38434.ground_truth: The cross domain MDA MnS producer may consume the MDA MnS provided by RAN and/or CN domains, and produce MDA MnS that may be consumed by 3GPP cross-domain MDA MnS consumer(s).

q_38435.question: What do the terms "shall" and "shall not" indicate in the context of the present document?
q_38435.ground_truth: The term "shall" in the context of the present document indicates a mandatory requirement to do something, while the term "shall not" indicates an interdiction (prohibition) to do something.

q_38436.question: In what scenario must the UE request for a PDN type IPv4v6?
q_38436.ground_truth: When the IP version capability of the UE is unknown, the UE must request for a PDN type IPv4v6.

q_38437.question: What is the purpose of the "mbsPccRules" attribute in the MbsPolicyDecision data structure?
q_38437.ground_truth: The "mbsPccRules" attribute in the MbsPolicyDecision data structure is used to provision/update/remove MBS PCC rules for an MBS Policy Association.

q_38438.question: What are the responsibilities of the SMF, PCF, UPF, and UE in the context of RSM?
q_38438.ground_truth: The SMF is responsible for creating ATSSS rules and N4 rules with the new Steering Mode in RSM. The PCF provides PCC rules with the new Steering Mode. The UPF duplicates traffic via the available access paths of a MA PDU session for the downlink traffic if RSM is used for a traffic flow. The UE duplicates traffic via the available access paths of a MA PDU session for the uplink traffic if RSM is used for a traffic flow.

q_38439.question: What must a UE do if it determines a conflict for a reserved resource for PSSCH transmission?
q_38439.ground_truth: The UE provides conflict information in a PSFCH.

q_38440.question: What is the procedure followed in an LTE system, in case of collision between a periodic CSI report and a HARQ-ACK in a same subframe with PUSCH, and if an aperiodic CSI report is not triggered for the same subframe and if a UE is transmitting PUSCH only on LAA SCell(s)?
q_38440.ground_truth: In an LTE system, in case of collision between a periodic CSI report and a HARQ-ACK in a same subframe with PUSCH, and if an aperiodic CSI report is not triggered for the same subframe, and if a UE is transmitting PUSCH only on LAA SCell(s), the HARQ-ACK and periodic CSI transmission follows the procedure for the case of collision between a periodic CSI report and a HARQ-ACK in the same subframe without PUSCH.

q_38441.question: What is the purpose of the Facility information element in the supplementary service protocol?
q_38441.ground_truth: The Facility information element is used to indicate the invocation and operation of supplementary services, identified by the corresponding operation code within the Facility information element.

q_38442.question: What is the size and structure of the S-NSSAI location validity information information element?
q_38442.ground_truth: The S-NSSAI location validity information information element has a minimum length of 25 octets and a maximum length of 19307 octets, and it can contain per-S-NSSAI location validity information for maximum 8 S-NSSAIs.

q_38443.question: What is the criterion for a successful test in 7.6.2.6.4.1-2?
q_38443.ground_truth: For the test to be successful, the overall delays measured from the beginning of time period T2 should be less than 7682 ms for UE supporting power class 1, or 4802 ms for UE supporting other power class for Test 1 & Test 3 and 81922 ms for UE supporting power class 1, or 51202 ms for UE supporting other power class for Test 2 and Test 4.

q_38444.question: Which element in the "Subquery-info" complex type can be repeated multiple times?
q_38444.ground_truth: The "response-filter" element in the "Subquery-info" complex type can be repeated multiple times.

q_38445.question: Which entities are involved in the PDU Session Create Request in Solution 27 of the KI#1 description?
q_38445.ground_truth: The entities involved in the PDU Session Create Request in Solution 27 are the V-SMF, H-SMF, and UDM.

q_38446.question: What should the UE do to discover the V2X application server address for uplink transport?
q_38446.ground_truth: The UE should follow the steps listed in priority order in 6.2.6.1, starting from using the IP address and UDP/TCP port if the V2X service identifier is associated with a V2X application server IP address and port for the serving PLMN and geographical area.

q_38447.question: Who are the four individuals that took the tour with Quality Tour Guide (QTG)?

q_38448.question: What is the required distance accuracy of the warning system in relation to the worksite?
q_38448.ground_truth: The required distance accuracy of the warning system in relation to the worksite is +/- 1 meter.

q_38449.question: What is the behavior of the UE if the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message cannot be accepted?
q_38449.ground_truth: The UE shall send a SECURITY MODE REJECT message containing an EMM cause that typically indicates one of the following cause values: #23: UE security capabilities mismatch, #24: security mode rejected, unspecified.

q_38450.question: What action should the SCC AS take when it receives a SIP UPDATE request with specific parameters after performing an access transfer and receiving a SIP BYE request or SIP CANCEL request containing certain information on the target access leg?
q_38450.ground_truth: The SCC AS should not release the original source access leg, treat the SIP UPDATE request as per procedures for removing and adding media, and start forwarding SIP messages from the remote UE to the SC UE for the ongoing dialog.

q_38451.question: What information does the source MN send to the other signalling connections or other candidate MNs if any, after releasing the resources of the source SN?
q_38451.ground_truth: The source MN sends the SgNB Release Request message, including a Cause indicating MCG mobility and, if applicable, data forwarding information to the other signalling connections or other candidate MNs if any, after releasing the resources of the source SN. The source MN also sends the Handover Cancel message toward the other signalling connections or other candidate MNs if any to cancel the CHO for the UE.

q_38452.question: What should the MCData server do when generating an application/pidf+xml MIME body indicating per-user functional alias information?
q_38452.ground_truth: The MCData server should not include information from functional alias information entries with an expiration time already expired or with the functional alias status set to "deactivated".

q_38453.question: What should be the maximum value of x in octet 6 to octet (5+x) of the DSCP to PPI Mapping Information IE, if the DSCP Value is encoded in TOS (IPv4) or TC (IPv6) information?
q_38453.ground_truth: The maximum value of x is 63.

q_38454.question: What is a condition for the SC UE to associate a session with a transaction identifier value and TI flag in 3GPP TS 24.008?
q_38454.ground_truth: The SC UE only has a single call and it is in alerting phase following access transfer, in pre-alerting phase, or has a SIP INVITE request received where all early dialogs are created by a SIP response to the SIP INVITE request.

q_38455.question: What is the service scoping supported by LMISF-IRI in the provisioning of HR LI?
q_38455.ground_truth: LMISF-IRI supports the service scoping of "voice" or "messaging", "reportBeginingAndEnd" or "reportUponChange", and "SuspendOnOutboundInternationalRoaming" in the provisioning of HR LI.

q_38456.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP Technical Report on band combinations for concurrent operation of NR/LTE Uu bands/band combinations and one NR/LTE V2X band in Release 18?
q_38456.ground_truth: The purpose is to study the extension of the band combinations for V2X service to grow the NR V2X ecosystem and analyze the self-desensitization problem of concurrent operation band combinations, including harmonics and IMD problem.

q_38457.question: Who can provide satellite coverage availability information to the MME?
q_38457.ground_truth: Satellite coverage availability information can be provided to the MME by O&M (Operation and Maintenance).

q_38458.question: What should the UE do if UE determines to reuse the existing PDU Session for a newly detected application?
q_38458.ground_truth: UE should initiate a PDU Session Establishment Request and include the Rule Precedence of URSP rule and application identity. The SMF may trigger the PDU Session establishment authentication/authorization procedure with the DN-AAA Server.

q_38459.question: In the context of E-UTRAN/Satellite E-UTRAN Intra-frequency measurements, what does the '05' value indicate?
q_38459.ground_truth: The '05' value in E-UTRAN/Satellite E-UTRAN Intra-frequency measurements indicates E-UTRAN/Satellite E-UTRAN intra-frequency measurements for the Evolved Packet System (EPS) in 3GPP.

q_38460.question: What is the maximum difference in SS-RSRQ that the UE can consider for SS-RSRQ re-selections based on absolute priorities for 2 Rx RedCap?
q_38460.ground_truth: The maximum difference in SS-RSRQ that the UE can consider for SS-RSRQ re-selections based on absolute priorities for 2 Rx RedCap is 4 dB.

q_38461.question: What do the constructions "may" and "need not" indicate in a 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_38461.ground_truth: "May" indicates permission to do something, while "need not" indicates permission not to do something.

q_38462.question: In the context of 3GPP, what does the term "shall" indicate?
q_38462.ground_truth: The term "shall" in 3GPP indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

q_38463.question: What information does the 5G-RG use when requesting the establishment of a PDU Session for a N5GC device?
q_38463.ground_truth: The 5G-RG requests the establishment of a PDU Session for a N5GC device using the GCI of the CRG that connects the N5GC device.

q_38464.question: In the context of CA, when is the in-gap blocking requirement applied to intra-band non-contiguous CA?
q_38464.ground_truth: The in-gap requirement is applied if the minimum gap condition is met, which is defined as the frequency separation between the center frequencies of the component carriers being larger or equal to the sum of half the bandwidths plus 2 times the maximum bandwidth of the component carriers.

q_38465.question: What message is sent by the initiating UE after receiving an acknowledgement for the PROSE DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION REQUEST?
q_38465.ground_truth: PROSE DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION ACK message

q_38466.question: Under what conditions will the EATF send a SIP UPDATE request towards the remote UE?
q_38466.ground_truth: The EATF will send a SIP UPDATE request towards the remote UE if there is only one early dialog related to the originating call not accepted yet available for the served user, the remote UE has provided an Allow header field listing the SIP UPDATE method or has not provided an Allow header field, the remote UE has provided the SDP answer, and the EATF has not received a SIP 18x response requiring use of reliable provisional responses.

q_38467.question: What does the source UE include in the Source Layer-2 ID field for one-to-one ProSe Direct Communication?
q_38467.ground_truth: The Layer-2 ID for unicast communication that is included in the Source Layer-2 ID field of every frame that it sends on the layer-2 link.

q_38468.question: Which field contains the identifier of the SCEF to which the Monitoring Event Report message was sent?
q_38468.ground_truth: The "SCEF ID" field, identified as 5.1.4.8.20, contains the identifier of the SCEF to which the Monitoring Event Report message was sent.

q_38469.question: What should the PGW do if it receives an IP-CAN Session Termination Request for a PDN connection associated with a failed SGW and that has not been restored yet?
q_38469.ground_truth: The PGW should behave as specified in clause~27.2.2.3.

q_38470.question: How does the SMF determine a timer to update the IP address of EAS in DNS message handling rule?
q_38470.ground_truth: The SMF determines the timer to update the IP address of EAS in DNS message handling rule using a method that is out of scope.

q_38471.question: What does the minimum conformance requirements in 6.2E.1.3.1.3 and 6.2E.1.3.2.3 refer to?
q_38471.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements are defined in clause 6.2E.1.0.3

q_38472.question: When does E-UTRAN send an "offload" command to the UE in the context of RAN-Controlled WLAN interworking?
q_38472.ground_truth: E-UTRAN sends an "offload" command to the UE when it requires traffic steering to/from WLAN.

q_38473.question: What is the initial condition for out-of-band blocking for SUL with UL MIMO in 7.6D.3_1.4.1?
q_38473.ground_truth: The initial condition consists of environmental conditions, test frequencies, test channel bandwidths, sub-carrier spacing, uplink and downlink reference measurement channels, OCNG patterns, and propagation conditions.

q_38474.question: After receiving an ATTACH ACCEPT message with EPS attach result set to "EPS only" and EMM cause set to "CS domain not available", what action should the UE take when it enters a TA where it is not registered and which belongs to the PLMN where the UE received the EMM cause "CS domain not available"?
q_38474.ground_truth: The UE initiates a normal tracking area update procedure indicating "TA updating" without valid LAI, TMSI, GSM ciphering key, UMTS integrity key, UMTS ciphering key or ciphering key sequence number.

q_38475.question: What will the gNB-DU do if the MBS Service Area IE is not included in the BROADCAST CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message and it has released or established MBS Session resources?
q_38475.ground_truth: If the MBS Service Area IE is not included in the BROADCAST CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message and the gNB-DU has released or established MBS Session resources, it shall include the Broadcast Area Scope IE in the BROADCAST CONTEXT MODIFICATION RESPONSE message to indicate the cells where MBS Session resources are currently established.

q_38476.question: What is the correct activation procedure for SS in 6.5A.2.1.1.4.2?
q_38476.ground_truth: SS activates SCC by sending the activation MAC CE and waits for at least 2 seconds.

q_38477.question: When does the SMF initiate an N4 Session Modification procedure to remove Tunnel Info of AN in the UPF?
q_38477.ground_truth: The SMF initiates this procedure when the service request is triggered by the network and the SMF removes the old I-UPF, indicating that User Plane resources for the PDU Session(s) are being established.

q_38478.question: What message does the gNB-DU send in response to a successful PDC Measurement Initiation procedure with OnDemand report type?
q_38478.ground_truth: The gNB-DU sends the PDC MEASUREMENT INITIATION RESPONSE message with the PDC Measurement Result IE included.

q_38479.question: What attribute of the "entry" element within the "One-To-One-EmergencyAlert" element of the "OnNetwork" element corresponds to the "DisplayName" element of clause 10.2.92 and indicates the name of the MCData user recipient for an on-network MCData emergency one-to-one alert?

q_38480.question: In the DataCollectionResponse-IEs, which ID is mandatory when Registration Request is set to "stop"?
q_38480.ground_truth: ID id-NGRAN-Node1-Measurement-ID is mandatory when Registration Request is set to "stop".

q_38481.question: What are the necessary standardization needs to be identified for regular XR split rendering?
q_38481.ground_truth: Regular 2D video encoders and decoders that are capable encode and decode 2K per eye as well as 90 fps and are capable to encode typical graphics frame buffer signals, Pose information in the uplink at sufficiently high frequency, Content Delivery protocols to support the delivery requirements, Edge computing discovery and capability discovery, A simple XR split rendering application framework for single buffer streaming, New 5QIs and QoS support in 5G System for split rendering addressing latency requirements in the range of 10-20ms and bitrate guarantees to be able to stream 50 to 100 Mbps consistently.

q_38482.question: What is the purpose of the test specified in 7.2A.2.1.1 for 2Rx TDD FR2 CA PDSCH with normal performance?
q_38482.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify the PDSCH mapping Type A normal performance with different channel models, MCSs and number of MIMO layers.

q_38483.question: What is the function of the SN Addition Request message in the handover procedure?
q_38483.ground_truth: If the target MN decides to keep the UE context in source SN, the target MN sends SN Addition Request to the SN including the SN UE XnAP ID as a reference to the UE context in the SN that was established by the source MN.

q_38484.question: What message does the SCEF send to the SCS/AS after processing the Group MT NIDD Submit Request for all UEs?
q_38484.ground_truth: The SCEF sends a single aggregated response message Group MT NIDD Submit Indication (TLTRI associated with the Request of step~1, Hop-by-Hop Acknowledgment Indication(s), Re-Transmission time(s), Trigger Indication(s), Cause(s)).

q_38485.question: What should the SMF do when it determines that Extended Buffering is allowed and supported by the NEF for mobile terminated data?
q_38485.ground_truth: The SMF should indicate the Extended Buffering support to AMF and forward the mobile terminated data to AMF.

q_38486.question: What does the phrase "containing a normative element" mean in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
q_38486.ground_truth: In 3GPP technical specifications, a phrase containing a normative element refers to the parts of the document that contain mandatory requirements or prohibitions (indicated by the phrases "shall" and "shall not").

q_38487.question: What principles does event-based charging for MMS follow?
q_38487.ground_truth: Event-based charging for MMS follows the principle that the relationship between chargeable events and charging events is 1:1, and the relationship between charging events and CDRs is also 1:1. The chargeable event triggers are defined in clause 5.1.1 to 5.1.4, and relate to transactions at the MM1, MM4, and MM7 reference points.

q_38488.question: What would the user equipment (UE) do if, after inter-system change from N1 mode to S1 mode, there is a QoS flow description not associated with any QoS rule, but associated with a mapped EPS bearer context, and the respective EPS bearer context is active?
q_38488.ground_truth: The UE shall associate the QoS flow description with the EPS bearer context.

q_38489.question: Under which conditions can the PCF send a notification message to the SMF including the "pcscfRestIndication" attribute set to true for the corresponding PDU session?
q_38489.ground_truth: The PCF can send this message when it receives a request for P-CSCF restoration from the P-CSCF as defined in clause 4.4.7 of 3GPP TS 29.214 or in clause 4.2.2.27 of 3GPP TS 29.514.

q_38490.question: What is the intention of the suggested focus on paging UE due to the MBS session activation and MBS session release?
q_38490.ground_truth: The intention is to avoid RRC-INACTIVE group member UE that supports receiving multicast service in RRC-inactive state from blindly resuming the RRC connection if the paging event is for activation and MBS session data can be received in RRC-INACTIVE state.

q_38491.question: What should the UE do when the drx-HARQ-RTT-TimerDL expires for a HARQ process in DL?
q_38491.ground_truth: If the data of the corresponding HARQ process was not successfully decoded, start the drx-RetransmissionTimerDL for the corresponding HARQ process in the first symbol after the expiry of drx-HARQ-RTT-TimerDL-NTN.

q_38492.question: What message type is used by the BM-SC to request the activation of bearer resources for MBMS data transfer?

q_38493.question: What is the primary function of the E-MBMS Gateway (MBMS GW) in E-UTRAN?
q_38493.ground_truth: The MBMS GW sends/broadcasts MBMS packets to each eNB transmitting the service using IP Multicast and performs MBMS Session Control Signalling (Session start/update/stop) towards the E-UTRAN via MME.

q_38494.question: What is the difference between the procedure for Emergency Registration and regular registration in this network?
q_38494.ground_truth: During Emergency Registration, the UE does not include NSSAI in the registration message, and the AMF does not send the Allowed NSSAI in the Registration Accept message. Additionally, certain steps in the registration procedure, such as authentication and AMF check for access restrictions, are skipped for Emergency Registration.

q_38495.question: What constraint is applied to the maximum luminance width and height to a Bitstream conforming to the 3GPP VR Main H.265/HEVC Operation Point?
q_38495.ground_truth: A Bitstream conforming to the 3GPP VR Main H.265/HEVC Operation Point shall not exceed the luminance width of 8192 pixels and the luminance height of 8192 pixels.

q_38496.question: What action does the participating MCVideo function take if the MBMS bearer does not have sufficient capacity for the new conversation?
q_38496.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function may free capacity for the new conversation by transferring an existing conversation over an MBMS bearer to unicast bearers, or may use the MBMS bearer for signaling messages while using unicast bearers for media messages.

q_38497.question: What is the UE power step tolerance value used for calculating the Uplink power control window size for PUSCH transmissions with 1dB power step size?
q_38497.ground_truth: The UE power step tolerance is 0.7dB for PUSCH with 1dB power step size.

q_38498.question: What is the enumerated type of the measurement period for UMTS Data Volume and Throughput measurements?
q_38498.ground_truth: The enumerated type of the measurement period for UMTS Data Volume and Throughput measurements includes the following values: 1000 ms, 2000 ms, 3000 ms, 4000 ms, 6000 ms, 8000 ms, 12000 ms, 16000 ms, 20000 ms, 24000 ms, 28000 ms, 32000 ms, and 64000 ms.

q_38499.question: What should the AMF do when a network slice is to be terminated and a new network slice is to be created?
q_38499.ground_truth: The AMF should update the UE policies (URSP) such that the UE uses the new S-NSSAI for new access attempts and triggers the UE to move the user data from S-NSSAI to be removed to the new S-NSSAI.

q_38500.question: What function does the LM.LocationDeterSucc measurement provide?
q_38500.ground_truth: It provides the number of successful location determinations provided by the LMF.

q_38501.question: What is the effect of DRX on time-of-outage percentage in the uni-directional tunnel scenario with DPS?
q_38501.ground_truth: The time-of-outage percentage is very low when the train is traveling in the same direction as the RRH beams orientation with or without DRX, but it is significant when the train travels opposite to the pointing direction of the RRH beams, even without DRX enabled.

q_38502.question: What should the UE do if it is in EMM-IDLE mode and has uplink signalling pending?
q_38502.ground_truth: The UE shall invoke the service request procedure as specified in TS 24.301, clause 5.6.1.1 if it is in EMM-IDLE mode and has uplink signalling pending.

q_38503.question: How many <GKTP> elements can be included in an MCS GKTP document, as specified in subclause 7.7.4.2?
q_38503.ground_truth: An MCS GKTP document can include zero or more <GKTP> elements as specified in subclause 7.7.4.2.

q_38504.question: What is the requirement for RLM-RS resource overlapping with GAP in the context of SSB-based radio link monitoring?
q_38504.ground_truth: For a measurement gap, an RLM-RS resource or an SMTC occasion is considered to be overlapped with the GAP if it overlaps a measurement gap occasion. For NCSG measurement gap, an RLM-RS resource or an SMTC occasion is considered to be overlapped with the GAP if it overlaps the VIL1 or VIL2 of NCSG, or it overlaps the ML of NCSG and UE does not support IBM between the target carrier and the serving cell.

q_38505.question: What should be the value of bit 3 in Octet 9, if the MME/S4 SGSN supports CSG Information Change Reporting mechanism for the corresponding session?
q_38505.ground_truth: The value of bit 3 in Octet 9 should be set to 1, if the MME/S4 SGSN supports CSG Information Change Reporting mechanism for the corresponding session.

q_38506.question: What does Solution #49 propose to address in the context of Key issue #20?
q_38506.ground_truth: Solution #49 provides a discovery service in the EEL so that other component EASs can be discovered and selected by the AC connected EAS based on need.

q_38507.question: What is the purpose of the uplink power control window in 7.4D.4.2, step 3?
q_38507.ground_truth: The uplink power control window ensures that the actual UE output power is no greater than the target power level, and as close as possible to the target power level.

q_38508.question: What information is contained in the "From Address" field?
q_38508.ground_truth: The information from the SIP From Header

q_38509.question: What should the UE do if the "S-NSSAI not available in the current PLMN or SNPN" rejection cause is received in the rejected S-NSSAI(s) of the DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message?
q_38509.ground_truth: The UE should store the rejected S-NSSAI(s) in the rejected NSSAI for the current PLMN or SNPN, and not attempt to use this S-NSSAI(s) in the current PLMN or SNPN over any access until switching off the UE or removing the rejected S-NSSAI(s) from the list of rejected NSSAI(s).

q_38510.question: What actions should the UE take when becoming available again in Solution #1?
q_38510.ground_truth: When the UE becomes available again in Solution #1, it sends a Registration Request to the AMF without MICO mode indication and re-establishes PDU sessions that are still required.

q_38511.question: What is the criticality of id-BroadcastMRBs-SetupMod-List in the BroadcastContextModificationResponseIEs F1AP-PROTOCOL-IES?
q_38511.ground_truth: The criticality of id-BroadcastMRBs-SetupMod-List in the BroadcastContextModificationResponseIEs F1AP-PROTOCOL-IES is reject.

q_38512.question: When an inter-frequency L1-RSRP measurement layer i is a candidate to be measured in a specific measurement gap j, what is the total number of intra-frequency, inter-frequency and inter-RAT frequency layers and up to one NR PRS measurement on any one positioning frequency layer, inter-frequency L1-RSRP measurement layers, which are also candidates to be measured in gap j?

q_38513.question: What is the purpose of the port management capability information element?
q_38513.ground_truth: The port management capability information element informs the TSN AF of the port parameters supported by the DS-TT or NW-TT.

q_38514.question: How long is the first part of the test signal (comprising of the first 17,0 s) that is discarded from the analysis in order to allow for convergence of the acoustic echo canceller?
q_38514.ground_truth: The first 17,0 s of the test signal is discarded from the analysis.

q_38515.question: What are the principles for the handing of 5GS security contexts and the activation of ciphering and integrity protection when a NAS signalling connection is established?
q_38515.ground_truth: These principles are provided in subclause 4.4.

q_38516.question: How should the manufacturer declared coordinate system orientation of the OTA AAS BS be aligned for the OTA test procedure?
q_38516.ground_truth: The manufacturer declared coordinate system orientation of the OTA AAS BS should be aligned with the test system for the OTA test procedure.

q_38517.question: In 3GPP TS 23.503, which Policy Control Request Trigger is associated with the "pras" attribute, which is defined in clause 4.2.3.3.1 and includes the presence reporting areas for which reporting is required or removed?
q_38517.ground_truth: The Policy Control Request Trigger "Change of UE presence in PRA" or if that trigger was already set and needs to be removed, the presence reporting areas for which reporting was required can be managed using the "pras" attribute.

q_38518.question: What is the purpose of the default MuSiK download?
q_38518.ground_truth: The default MuSiK download is used to set, reset or unset a MuSiK and its corresponding MuSiK-ID and is applicable to all groups supported by the MCVideo client, except for certain identified groups for which MuSiKs and MUSiK-IDs are assigned, reassigned or unassigned separately via explicit MuSiK download.

q_38519.question: What is the maximum number of CSI processes supported by the UE on all component carriers in a bandwidth class that includes multiple component carriers?
q_38519.ground_truth: The maximum number of CSI processes supported by the UE on all component carriers in a bandwidth class that includes multiple component carriers is defined in the field "supportedCSI-Proc-r11".

q_38520.question: In what situations can the E-UTRAN initiate the mobility from E-UTRA procedure?
q_38520.ground_truth: The E-UTRAN can initiate the mobility from E-UTRA procedure in response to a MeasurementReport message, reception of CS fallback indication for the UE from MME, or an MCGFailureInformation message, or possibly in response to a specific event.

q_38521.question: What is the role of the SS in the process described in step 1.3, 2.3, and 3.3?
q_38521.ground_truth: The SS activates SCC (Secondary Cell Component) by sending the activation MAC CE in the mentioned steps.

q_38522.question: What is the event verdict for the intra frequency NR cell re-selection test case if both the "Re-select newly detected Cell 2" and "Re-select already detected Cell 1" events pass?
q_38522.ground_truth: If both events pass, the test passes.

q_38523.question: What should the SMF do when it receives the PCC rule for application detection and control and if the ADC feature is supported?
q_38523.ground_truth: The SMF shall instruct the UPF to detect the application traffic, report the detected application's traffic start/stop events along with the application instance identifier and service data flow descriptions when service data flow descriptions are deducible. The SMF shall report the start/stop of the application to the PCF upon receiving the corresponding event from the UPF.

q_38524.question: What is the variable Ms expressed in?

q_38525.question: What are the procedures defined for management of group documents?
q_38525.ground_truth: The procedures defined for management of group documents include group document creation procedure, group document retrieval procedure, group document update procedure, and group document deletion procedure.

q_38526.question: What is the effect of the Suspend Notification message on the S-GW and P-GW?
q_38526.ground_truth: The Suspend Notification message causes the S-GW and P-GW to mark the preserved non-GBR bearers as suspended.

q_38527.question: What does the LCS-Service-Type-ID AVP define in 3GPP TS 29.002?
q_38527.ground_truth: The LCS-Service-Type-ID defines the identifier associated to one of the Service Types for which the LCS client is allowed to locate the particular UE.

q_38528.question: What should the NF Service Consumer (e.g. V-SMF or I-SMF) do in step 1 of the Transfer MO Data service operation?
q_38528.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer should send a POST request to the URI of Transfer MO Data custom operation on an individual PDU Session resource in the SMF and the content of the POST request should contain the mobile originated data to be transferred.

q_38529.question: What should the UE do when it receives a correct message over Temporary C-RNTI?
q_38529.ground_truth: The UE should send ACK and consider the contention resolution successful, and the random access procedure successfully completed.

q_38530.question: What is the trigger for the SMF in the Distributed Anchor connectivity model to initiate an EAS rediscovery procedure?
q_38530.ground_truth: The SMF initiates the EAS rediscovery procedure in the Distributed Anchor connectivity model when the common DNAI is triggered for reselection.

q_38531.question: In what situation would an E-UTRAN capable UE initiate a tracking area update?
q_38531.ground_truth: An E-UTRAN capable UE would initiate a tracking area update when there is a change in its usage setting or voice domain preference, or when it manually selects a CSG cell not present in its allowed or operator CSG lists.

q_38532.question: What is the basic principle of the solution in 6.11 that addresses Key Issue #4 and Key Issue #5?
q_38532.ground_truth: The basic principle of the solution is reusing existing roaming architecture and LADN mechanism to enable the UE to discover, select and access the NPN as the hosting network and receive localized services.

q_38533.question: What is the role of the W-AGF when the RG is a 5G-RG and the UE behind the RG authenticates to the 5GC using NSWO procedure?
q_38533.ground_truth: When the RG is a 5G-RG and the UE behind the RG authenticates to the 5GC using NSWO procedure, the W-AGF is not involved in the authentication process.

q_38534.question: What does the Serving Gateway do after it receives the MODIFY BEARER REQUEST message, in the context of handover?
q_38534.ground_truth: The Serving Gateway switches the downlink data path to the target side and sends one or more "end marker" packets on the old path to the source eNB before releasing any U-plane/TNL resources towards the source eNB.

q_38535.question: What is the total interruption time (Tinterrupt) in the context of PSCell command?
q_38535.ground_truth: Tinterrupt is the sum of Tsearch, TIU, and Tprocessing, where Tsearch is the time required to search the target cell, TIU is the delay uncertainty due to the random-access procedure, and Tprocessing is the SW processing time needed by UE.

q_38536.question: What is the procedure to replace the DNN during PDU Session Establishment?
q_38536.ground_truth: The PCF provides the selected DNN to the AMF, which uses it in the query towards the NRF for SMF selection and provides both requested and selected DNN to the selected SMF. Whether DNN replacement is performed for roaming sessions depends on operator agreements.

q_38537.question: What should the ADRF use to verify the credentials of the NFc when it presents CCA as credentials?
q_38537.ground_truth: The ADRF should support the verification of CCA by caching the information provided in step 7.

q_38538.question: How does the RAN identify the PDU Set and transmit the PDUs within the PDU Set?
q_38538.ground_truth: The RAN identifies the PDU Set based on the PDU Set info in GTP-U header and transmits PDUs within the PDU Set in an integrated manner, such as dropping the PDU Set as a whole in case of poor network condition.

q_38539.question: What is the effect of not fitting a duplexer when performing tests on a BS?
q_38539.ground_truth: If a duplexer is supplied as an option by the manufacturer, sufficient tests should be repeated with and without the duplexer fitted to verify that the BS meets the requirements of the present document in both cases.

q_38540.question: What is the name of the subheader in the MAC PDU for SL-SCH that consists of the seven header fields V/R/R/R/R/SRC/DST?

q_38541.question: What is the purpose of SAD and SPD in IPsec?
q_38541.ground_truth: SAD (Security Associations Database) and SPD (Security Policy Database) are used by IPsec to store various security parameters for each Security Association. Negotiable parameters for security association setup are agreed during IMS AKA and maintained in TTCN-3.

q_38542.question: What is the role of a V2X application enabler client?
q_38542.ground_truth: A V2X application enabler client is an entity that provides the client-side functionalities corresponding to the V2X application enabler layer.

q_38543.question: What should the gNB-CU-CP do if it receives an IAB UP TNL ADDRESS UPDATE message but the update cannot be performed?
q_38543.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-UP shall respond with an IAB UP TNL ADDRESS UPDATE FAILURE message and include an appropriate cause value.

q_38544.question: When must operators include enhanced "Service Parameters" with the character string "+ue-<ue usage type>" in NAPTR records?
q_38544.ground_truth: When DCN is deployed and the operator needs to provision NAPTR records for UE usage types.

q_38545.question: How does the SCC AS need to distinguish between different types of initial SIP INVITE requests to provide specific functionality relating to access transfer?
q_38545.ground_truth: The SCC AS needs to distinguish between SIP INVITE requests due to STI, SIP INVITE requests due to PS to CS STN, and SIP INVITE requests due to two STIs.

q_38546.question: What is the purpose of determining the impacted UE(s) in this NG-RAN and UPF/NW-TT timing synchronization status reporting process?
q_38546.ground_truth: Determining the impacted UE(s) allows the TSCTSF to take appropriate action based on the status of the timing synchronization and the clock quality acceptance criteria, such as updating the clockQuality information in Announce messages or notifying the service status to the AF.

q_38547.question: From which field does SharedNGU-MulticastTNLInformation come in the context of MBS-SessionTNLInfo5GC?
q_38547.ground_truth: The 'locationdependent' choice within MBS-SessionTNLInfo5GC comes from this field.

q_38548.question: Which complexType has a sequence that includes "CurrentServingNcgi", "NeighbouringNcgi", and "MbmsSaId" elements, none of them having any specified type?

q_38549.question: What principle is used to compare the measurement results returned by the test system against the test requirements?

q_38550.question: What information is signaled from the N3IWF to the 5G ProSe Layer-3 Remote UE in the dynamic QoS signalling based mechanism for QoS support?
q_38550.ground_truth: The N3IWF signals the PDU Session ID, QFI(s), optionally a DSCP value, optionally the Additional QoS Information, and the PDU Session Establishment Accept message to the 5G ProSe Layer-3 Remote UE.

q_38551.question: What are the two possible response parameters for GBA security context (Bootstrapping Mode) in 3GPP TS 33.102?
q_38551.ground_truth: The two possible response parameters for GBA security context (Bootstrapping Mode) in 3GPP TS 33.102 are AUTS, coded as for UMTS Security context, and RES, coded as for UMTS Security context.

q_38552.question: How does the Target UE obtain the Layer-2 ID of the Source UE for future communication?
q_38552.ground_truth: Upon receiving the security establishment procedure messages, the Source UE obtains the Target UE's Layer-2 ID for future communication in UE-to-UE relay operation.

q_38553.question: When generating an FD NOTIFICATION message as specified in clause~15.1.6 and sending a file download completed notification, what should the participating MCData function include in the FD message if the FD message was destined for an application?
q_38553.ground_truth: The participating MCData function should include an Application ID IE set to the value of the Application ID that was included in the FD message or an Extended application ID IE set to the value of the Extended application ID that was included in the FD message.

q_38554.question: What is the role of the PDU-Set Delay Budget (PSDB) in 5GS and real-time media?
q_38554.ground_truth: The PDU-Set Delay Budget (PSDB) defines an upper bound for the time that a PDU-Set may be delayed between the UE and the N6 termination point at the UPF, providing an upper bound for the time a PDU-Set may be delayed in both UL and DL directions. It applies to the DL PDU-Set received by the UPF over the N6 interface and to the UL PDU-Set sent by the UE.

q_38555.question: What is the maximum allowed rate of ACK/NACK feedback loss on any non-dormant serving cell when the UE performs RRM measurements on dormant SCells?
q_38555.ground_truth: The rate of ACK/NACK feedback loss on any non-dormant serving cell resulting from RRM measurements on dormant SCells shall not exceed 1.0%.

q_38556.question: In the context of the Floor Idle message, what does the first bit in the subtype being set to '0' indicate?

q_38557.question: What should the ME do if the UICC responds with "allowed, with modifications" and the modified request is beyond the ME's capabilities?
q_38557.ground_truth: If the request is not initiated by a proactive command, the ME may give information to the user on the modified request and the fact that it is beyond the ME's capabilities. If the request is initiated by a proactive command, the ME shall give a TERMINAL RESPONSE to the proactive command and not give any information to the user on the fact that the modified request is beyond the ME's capabilities.

q_38558.question: What should be the CSI report with non-zero CQI index for SCell1 received by the SS earlier than or equal to subframe (m+49) in the scenario described in part 8b?
q_38558.ground_truth: The CSI report should be received by the SS earlier than or equal to subframe (m+49) in the scenario described in part 8b.

q_38559.question: What advantage does solution #26 have over other solutions in handling users in multiple MBS sessions?
q_38559.ground_truth: Solution #26 is well suited for users in multiple MBS sessions as it avoids possible conflicting state recommendations obtained for the same user via different MBS sessions.

q_38560.question: What is the UE Rx-Tx measurement accuracy requirement for the test described in section 7.6.13.2 of the document?
q_38560.ground_truth: The UE Rx-Tx measurement accuracy requirement for the test is specified in clause 10.1.39.3 of TS 38.133, but the specific value is not provided in the section.

q_38561.question: What is the EARFCN range for the carrier frequency in the uplink and downlink?
q_38561.ground_truth: The EARFCN range for the carrier frequency in the uplink and downlink is 0 - 262143.

q_38562.question: What is the impact of the solution on AMF?
q_38562.ground_truth: The solution defines "CDRX change" as an access related PCRT in the UE context in RAN and sets a "CDRX change" trigger condition in the UE context in RAN. When the trigger condition is met, RAN informs AMF by using an N2 message.

q_38563.question: When should the MS initiate the GPRS detach procedure if it has received a Detach Request message with detach type indicating "re-attach required"?
q_38563.ground_truth: The MS should initiate the GPRS detach procedure and deactivate PDP context(s), MBMS context(s), and logical link(s) after receiving a Detach Request message with detach type indicating "re-attach required".

q_38564.question: What is the role of the N4 Session Context in 5G systems?
q_38564.ground_truth: The N4 Session Context is a set of parameters related to an N4 session, including the N4 session ID, general session-related parameters, PDRs, URRs, QERs, BAR(s), FARs, MARs, and parameters for UPF statistics. The UPF uses these parameters to determine internal resources and manage data traffic for the PDU session.

q_38565.question: What are the additional requirements for Band n26 and n28 operation in Japan?
q_38565.ground_truth: When the narrowest channel bandwidth supported by the BS is 5 MHz or wider, the transmitter intermodulation level shall not exceed the TRP unwanted emission limits specified in clause~6.7.5, 6.7.4, and 6.7.3 in the presence of a wanted signal and an interfering signal.

q_38566.question: What should the SMF do, in terms of QoS parameters allocation, for PDU Sessions with UP integrity protection of UP Security Enforcement Information set to Required?
q_38566.ground_truth: The SMF may perform the EPS bearer ID allocation procedure if the UE supports User Plane Integrity Protection with EPS and the AMF supports the associated functionality.

q_38567.question: What message is sent by the TWAG to initiate the WLCP bearer setup procedure?
q_38567.ground_truth: The WLCP BEARER SETUP REQUEST message

q_38568.question: What should the SS do if the UE is not a Release 16 or forward 5G NR UE as per step 5b?
q_38568.ground_truth: The SS does not need to take any action.

q_38569.question: How are standardized and operator-specific traffic categories supported in URSP rules?
q_38569.ground_truth: The traffic category component in the traffic descriptor part of the URSP rule supports standardized values specified by 3GPP and values reserved for operator-specific traffic categories.

q_38570.question: What action does the MME take when it receives a Trace Session deactivation message from the HSS during an ongoing Trace Recording Session?
q_38570.ground_truth: The MME may stop the Trace Recording Session immediately or at any time until the occurrence of an appropriate stop-triggering event.

q_38571.question: What is a requirement for utilizing overlapping CA approach in an irregular bandwidth from the user equipment (UE) perspective?
q_38571.ground_truth: The UE should support intra-band non-contiguous CA for the combination.

q_38572.question: What is the range of valid values for the barometric pressure measurement in the UtranBaroPressureMeas sequence?

q_38573.question: Which term in the SECAM documentation refers to the formal recognition of a test laboratory's competence in carrying out specific tests or types of assessments related to 3GPP network products?
q_38573.ground_truth: The term "accreditation" in the SECAM documentation refers to the formal recognition of a test laboratory's competence in carrying out specific tests or types of assessments related to 3GPP network products.

q_38574.question: What information is included in the new EDI2 in step 2 of Option 1 for NEF-based EDI provision to a serving operator?
q_38574.ground_truth: When NEF of Operator A translates the received EDI1 from AF to a new EDI2 corresponding to Operator B, it includes the DNAI of Operator B in the new EDI2 and optionally adds N6 traffic routing information in the new EDI2.

q_38575.question: What is the maximum time taken for interruption uncertainty in acquiring the first available PRACH occasion in the new cell?
q_38575.ground_truth: TIU can be up to the summation of SSB to PRACH occasion association period and 10 ms.

q_38576.question: What actions can a UE take while in the RM-DEREGIESTERED state in 5GS Registration Management?
q_38576.ground_truth: A UE in the RM-DEREGISTERED state can attempt to register with the selected PLMN using the Initial Registration procedure if it needs to receive service that requires registration, remain in RM-DEREGISTERED state if receiving a Registration Reject upon Initial Registration, or enter RM-REGISTERED state upon receiving a Registration Accept.

q_38577.question: What is the IE used by the target device to provide UE sensor measurements to the location server called?

q_38578.question: What is the duration of time window dT in this test scenario?
q_38578.ground_truth: The duration of time window dT in this test scenario is not specified exactly; it is only mentioned that there are three successive time windows dT during the test.

q_38579.question: Which data type is used for the "Pre-selected-indication" element in the XML schema?

q_38580.question: What is the purpose of NAS-based redirection in selecting a N3IWF that supports the S-NSSAI needed by UE?
q_38580.ground_truth: The NAS-based redirection method is used when UE connects with a N3IWF that does not support the S-NSSAI(s) needed by the UE. After determining the target N3IWF which supports the S-NSSAI(s) needed by the UE, the AMF provides the target N3IWF information to UE via Registration Reject message so that UE can connect with the target N3IWF to meet the requirement of the UE.

q_38581.question: What is the role of the TWAN-S2a-Connectivity-Indicator in the 3GPP AAA Server's response?
q_38581.ground_truth: The TWAN-S2a-Connectivity-Indicator indicates if the UE's EAP-AKA' challenge response has been successfully checked, and if set, the 3GPP AAA Server may disregard the received EAP-Payload.

q_38582.question: Why is option 3 viable for 3GPP NF services to set up direct HTTP/2 connections despite the lack of support in existing implementations?
q_38582.ground_truth: The HTTP clients for 3GPP NF services are typically built using HTTP client libraries in various programming languages, providing flexibility not available in most existing installations, as explained in NOTE~1.

q_38583.question: What is one way the MME can control signalling load from SGWs during an overload situation?
q_38583.ground_truth: The MME can reject Downlink Data Notification requests for non-priority traffic from SGWs during an overload situation, allowing it to control the signalling load generated by its SGWs.

q_38584.question: What is the value of the ProSe Layer-2 Group ID in the provided policy parameters?
q_38584.ground_truth: The value of the ProSe Layer-2 Group ID is 1.

q_38585.question: What is the significance of local breakout roaming in the 5G connection and mobility charging architecture?
q_38585.ground_truth: Local breakout roaming in the 5G connection and mobility charging architecture allows for the selection of one or both of the architectures depending on the agreement between operators.

q_38586.question: What should the NF service consumer do after sending a successful POST request to the PFDF when the "NotificationPush" feature is supported and the "pfdOp" attribute is set to "RETRIEVE" or not provided?
q_38586.ground_truth: The NF service consumer shall invoke the full pull procedure or the partial pull procedure if the "PartialPull" feature is supported to retrieve the PFDs for the application identifier(s).

q_38587.question: What is the requirement for E-CSCF when routing an emergency session?
q_38587.ground_truth: E-CSCF shall follow the same rules and procedures as defined in clause 7.3 of the Serving IMS network for emergency session establishment.

q_38588.question: What symbols are used in the present document, as specified in section 3.2?
q_38588.ground_truth: AoA, BP, CA, CBW, CFFNF, CFFDNF, DFF, DNF, DUT, EIS, EIRP, EPRE, ETC, EVM, FF, FR1, FR2, FS, IBM, IFF, MU, NF, NFTF, NSA, OTA, QZ, RSRP, SNR, SS, SS-RSRPB, TRP, UBF, UE.

q_38589.question: Who determines a generation or change to the LPI in UE LCS privacy profile and who is allowed to provision the LPI in UE LCS privacy profile?
q_38589.ground_truth: The UE determines a generation or change to the LPI in UE LCS privacy profile and an authorized AF is allowed to provision the LPI in UE LCS privacy profile for specific UE(s) via NEF.

q_38590.question: What is the challenge in providing group message delivery over MBS for feature parity with eMBMS?
q_38590.ground_truth: It involves enhancing the MBS functionality to provide a similar group message delivery as available in eMBMS, and providing a unified group message delivery applicable to both 5GS using MBS and EPS using eMBMS.

q_38591.question: What happens if the AF guidance for URSP determination targets a group of UEs or any UE?
q_38591.ground_truth: Each individual UE authorization is performed at a later stage by PCF, and NEF authorizes the request based on local policy (e.g. based on AF Id) without requesting for any service specific authorization from UDM.

q_38592.question: What is the purpose of the UE Context Modification procedure in 5G?
q_38592.ground_truth: The UE Context Modification procedure is used to partly modify the established UE context in 5G. This allows for updating certain parameters and information related to the UE's context, such as the security keys and mobile IAB authorization.

q_38593.question: What is the purpose of the dynamic DRA binding created by the H-DRA (proxy) in the home PLMN if an active DRA binding does not exist?
q_38593.ground_truth: The dynamic DRA binding is created by the H-DRA (proxy) in the home PLMN to assign a PCRF node per UE or per IP-CAN session if an active DRA binding does not exist. The user information, such as UE-NAI, is stored in the dynamic DRA binding.

q_38594.question: What will the AMF include in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message if the network slice-specific authentication and authorization has been successfully performed for a particular S-NSSAI?
q_38594.ground_truth: The AMF will include the allowed NSSAI containing the S-NSSAI that has been successfully authenticated and authorized in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.

q_38595.question: Who is responsible for encoding the NR-MIB message for the broadcast of SIB1 and other specific SIBs in a 5G network?
q_38595.ground_truth: The gNB-DU is responsible for encoding the NR-MIB message for the broadcast of SIB1, while the gNB-CU is responsible for encoding other SIBs.

q_38596.question: Which interfaces are protected using HTTPS for SEALDD interfaces?
q_38596.ground_truth: The SEALDD-UU, SEALDD-C, SEALDD-S and SEALDD-E interfaces are protected using HTTPS for SEALDD interfaces.

q_38597.question: What is the agreed SMTC periodicity bound for reusing the Rel-16 FR1 HST scaling factor for FR2 HST measurements?
q_38597.ground_truth: The agreed SMTC periodicity bound for reusing the Rel-16 FR1 HST scaling factor for FR2 HST measurements is 40ms.

q_38598.question: What happens when not all attribute modifications can be applied successfully in the "modifyMOIAttributes" operation?
q_38598.ground_truth: The MnS producer has different options on how to proceed, such as not performing any modifications, applying the changes that can be applied, or stopping the processing of the modification request when the first error occurs.

q_38599.question: What is the impact on the SMF in the on-demand multicast MBS session management solution?
q_38599.ground_truth: The SMF is impacted by having to support determining the delivery method and instructing the UPF to perform NATP for multicast data based on the UE MBS capability.

q_38600.question: When a UE roams and receives Inter-system Mobility Policies from both H-ANDSF and V-ANDSF, which set of policies does the UE select when the RPLMN identity is equal to one of the VPLMNs included in the visited PLMNs with preferred rules?
q_38600.ground_truth: The UE selects the set of Inter-system Mobility Policies from V-ANDSF.

q_38601.question: What action should the participating MCVideo function take if the SIP MESSAGE request for binding a functional alias with the MCVideo group(s) for the MCVideo user does not contain an application/resource-lists+xml MIME body or the <binding-ind> element and the <binding-fa-uri> element in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body?
q_38601.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function should reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response, including warning text set to "177 unable to determine target functional alias or group for creating/removing a binding information for the MCVideo user" in a Warning header field.

q_38602.question: What is the requirement during an IMS MES regarding sending emergency-related data?
q_38602.ground_truth: The realization of the transfer of data during an eCall shall minimize changes to the originating and transit networks, and both the voice and data components of the eCall shall be routed to the same PSAP or designated emergency call center.

q_38603.question: What takes place during the first two steps of the random access procedure after detecting the random access preamble in NB-IoT?
q_38603.ground_truth: These steps involve the transmission of the random access preamble and the reception of the random access response, which includes a UL grant for the first data transmission.

q_38604.question: What is the handover delay Dhandover to be less than in this test case?
q_38604.ground_truth: The handover delay Dhandover shall be less than 127 ms in this test case.

q_38605.question: What should the pSEPP do with the extracted values from the JWE object?
q_38605.ground_truth: The pSEPP extracts the serialized values from the components of the JWE object and uses them for further processing.

q_38606.question: In which abnormal cases are covered in TS 24.301, clause 5.5.1.2.6?
q_38606.ground_truth: Access barred because of access class barring or NAS signalling connection establishment rejected by the network.

q_38607.question: What parameter is required in the API version when the major version is higher than 1?

q_38608.question: What is the format of the home network domain name in 3GPP systems if there is no ISIM application?
q_38608.ground_truth: The home network domain name consists of "ims." followed by "mnc<MNC>.mcc<MCC>.3gppnetwork.org" where MCC and MNC are derived from the IMSI.

q_38609.question: What is the purpose of the Rx reference point in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_38609.ground_truth: The Rx reference point in the 3GPP technical specification defines the interface between the Policy and Charging Rules Function (PCRF) and the Application Function (AF) to exchange application level session information and allow Policy and Charging Control decisions.

q_38610.question: What is the role of the LPP procedures in providing assistance data to the UE and obtaining location information in the Deferred MT-LR Event Reporting Support and MO-LR Service Support?
q_38610.ground_truth: The LPP procedures are used in both cases to transfer UE positioning capabilities, provide assistance data to the UE, and obtain location information from the UE. In the Deferred MT-LR Event Reporting Support, the LPP procedures may be instigated by the LMF or the UE, while in the MO-LR Service Support, the LPP procedures are typically instigated by the UE.

q_38611.question: Who is responsible for collecting application or service-enablement layer related information in Solution #2?
q_38611.ground_truth: ADAE supporting application and service enablement layer analytics collects application or service enablement layer related information in Solution #2.

q_38612.question: What is the purpose of including the Source IP address information and Destination IP address information in the Received MBS information when the Type of multicast MBS session ID is set to "Source specific IP multicast address"?
q_38612.ground_truth: The purpose is to allow the UE to perform the mapping between the requested multicast MBS session ID and the provided TMGI.

q_38613.question: In Session based charging, what happens after the CHF performs the process related to the reported usage and the requested reservation, involving rating entity and user's account balance?
q_38613.ground_truth: The CHF updates the CDR with charging data related to the service, grants authorization to NF (CTF) for the service to start, and informs the NF (CTF) on the result of the request.

q_38614.question: What conformance requirement specifies that if manual CSG selection is requested, the UE shall select the requested hybrid cell?

q_38615.question: What are the two channel coding schemes used for TrCHs?
q_38615.ground_truth: The two channel coding schemes used for TrCHs are tail biting convolutional coding and turbo coding.

q_38616.question: What information should be exchanged by the NG-RAN node and the AMF during application layer initialization for the NG interface to work correctly?
q_38616.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node provides the list of supported TA(s) and other information, while the AMF provides PLMN ID and other information needed for the NG interface to work correctly.

q_38617.question: How is the coverage impact evaluated in terms of coverage margins in Rel-17 RedCap SI?
q_38617.ground_truth: The coverage impact is evaluated by obtaining the link budget performance of the channel, obtaining the target performance requirement for the potential Rel-18 UE within a deployment scenario, and finding the coverage margin for the channel by comparing the link budget performance with the target performance requirement.

q_38618.question: What is the requirement for the interfering signal for IAB-MT type 1-H?
q_38618.ground_truth: The interfering signal for IAB-MT type 1-H should be CP-OFDM.

q_38619.question: What should the reception control arbitration logic in the transmission control server do upon receiving a Receive Media End Request message in the 'Gr: Reception accepted' state?
q_38619.ground_truth: It should send the Receive Media End Response message, stop timer T6 (Reception Granted) if it is running, decrement the counter C11(Count of Active Receivers for stream) by 1, start timer T11 (Stream Reception Idle) if C11 has reached its lower limit, decrease C7 (Reception Accepted) by 1 if it has not reached its lower limit, and enter the 'Gr: Reception Idle' state if C7 has reached its lower limit.

q_38620.question: What is the purpose of buffering uplink packets in the target PSA during EAS relocation?
q_38620.ground_truth: Buffering uplink packets in the target PSA during EAS relocation prevents packet loss if the application client sends UL packets to a new EAS before the new EAS is prepared to handle them.

q_38621.question: In the FDD-FDD intra frequency handover test case, what is the condition for Tsearch if the target cell is known prior to the test?
q_38621.ground_truth: If the target cell is known, then Tsearch = 0 ms.

q_38622.question: In what situation will the floor control interface send a Floor Deny message with a Reject Cause value of cause #5 (Receive only) to the floor participant?
q_38622.ground_truth: When the effective priority is "receive only" and the floor control interface towards the MCPTT client in the floor control server remains in the 'U: not permitted and Floor Taken' state.

q_38623.question: What is the format of the E-CIDMeasurementTerminationCommand message?
q_38623.ground_truth: The E-CIDMeasurementTerminationCommand message is a SEQUENCE containing a single field, protocolIEs, which is a ProtocolIE-Container object that contains a set of protocol IEs.

q_38624.question: What information does the NEF support taking from the NWDAF for various network functions?
q_38624.ground_truth: The NEF supports taking various types of analytics information from the NWDAF to assist in the functioning of different network functions such as NWDAF, SMF, AMF, and AF.

q_38625.question: What state does the UE enter after sending a SERVICE REQUEST or EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message in the service request procedure?
q_38625.ground_truth: The UE enters the state EMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED after sending a SERVICE REQUEST or EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message.

q_38626.question: What is the requirement for out-of-band emissions for the SAN transmitter, as specified in 6.6?
q_38626.ground_truth: The out-of-band emissions requirement for the SAN transmitter is specified both in terms of Adjacent Channel Leakage power Ratio (ACLR) and out-of-band emissions (OOBE). Additionally, there is a requirement for occupied bandwidth.

q_38627.question: What field in the frame format is reserved for future PDU type extensions?
q_38627.ground_truth: The PDU type field in the first octet of the frame

q_38628.question: What is the main security concern in Key Issue #1?
q_38628.ground_truth: The main security concern in Key Issue #1 is ensuring the authorization of AF/external servers providing satellite coverage availability information to 5GC/EPC.

q_38629.question: What should the UE do when T311 expires while detecting radio link failure in section 22.4.22.2?
q_38629.ground_truth: When T311 expires while detecting radio link failure, the UE should go to RRC_IDLE state after timer T311 expires.

q_38630.question: What is the role of a "Working Group" defined in the document?
q_38630.ground_truth: A Working Group is an official subgroup of a TSG reporting to that TSG, responsible for a specific technical area. They can propose changes to a specification, and are responsible for agreeing to Change Requests for submission to the TSG for approval.

q_38631.question: How is communication between cSEPP and RH1's proxy protected after receiving a request from an NF?
q_38631.ground_truth: Communication between cSEPP and RH1's proxy is protected by TLS.

q_38632.question: When does the UE suspend measurement logging?
q_38632.ground_truth: The UE will suspend measurement logging if conditions like inter-frequency target info, no measResultServingCell in the VarLogMeasReport, or specific measured results in the last logging interval are met.

q_38633.question: What procedure is added to the existing steps described in solution #9 in the proposal for SEALDD enabled data transmission via N6 Tunnel?
q_38633.ground_truth: A new API for N6 tunnel data transfer for specific VAL service is invoked, and a specific SEALDD traffic descriptor is allocated for SEALDD traffic transferring via N6 tunnel.

q_38634.question: When is the repeater EVM requirement applicable for Repeater type 2-O and NCR-Fwd type 2-O?
q_38634.ground_truth: The repeater EVM requirement is applicable for Repeater type 2-O and NCR-Fwd type 2-O when the repeater is operating with an input power level within the range from what is required to reach the rated beam EIRP output power to the minimum power levels specified in the respective clauses.

q_38635.question: What is the key used to derive the PTK for a group member in the 3GPP Sidelink Positioning system?

q_38636.question: What should the SMF set in the 5GSM cause IE of the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message if the user authentication or authorization failed?
q_38636.ground_truth: The SMF should set the 5GSM cause IE of the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message to #29 to indicate that user authentication or authorization failed.

q_38637.question: How will external entities access the network slice management capabilities as per the suggested solution?
q_38637.ground_truth: External entities can access network slice management capabilities using CAPIF alternative 2 and 3. The CAPIF framework will be extended to support MnS exposure and authorization, with a mechanism defined for granular access to MnS from external entities.

q_38638.question: What is the requirement for a UE to handle the relative receive timing difference between subframe timing boundary of an E-UTRA cell belonging to the MCG and the closest slot timing boundary of a cell belonging to SCG for inter-band EN-DC?
q_38638.ground_truth: A UE shall be capable of handling a relative receive timing difference between subframe timing boundary of an E-UTRA cell belonging to the MCG and the closest slot timing boundary of a cell belonging to SCG to be aggregated for EN-DC operation.

q_38639.question: How many different LADNs can the LADN information information element contain at most?
q_38639.ground_truth: The LADN information information element can contain a maximum of 8 different LADNs.

q_38640.question: What is the difference between "full functionality" and "minimum functionality" in the context of MT power levels?
q_38640.ground_truth: "Full functionality" is the highest level of power where the transmit and receive RF circuits are enabled for all supported radio access technologies. "Minimum functionality" is the lowest level of power where minimum power is drawn, and the transmit and receive RF circuits are disabled.

q_38641.question: What are the two options for the steering mode additional indicator in an ATSSS rule?
q_38641.ground_truth: The two options for the steering mode additional indicator are load balancing percentages adjustment operation (LBPAO) and UE assistance operation.

q_38642.question: Which directional requirement is applicable to BS type 1-H, BS type 1-O, and BS type 2-O?
q_38642.ground_truth: The radiated transmit power is directionally required for these types of base stations.

q_38643.question: What is the purpose of the "unsolicited result code" in the context of bearer operations?
q_38643.ground_truth: The unsolicited result code is a status code that the system returns after processing a bearer operation.

q_38644.question: What is the purpose of using Polar coding for PDCCH and PBCH?
q_38644.ground_truth: Polar coding is used for PDCCH and PBCH to ensure efficient and reliable transmission of data in the physical downlink control channel and physical broadcast channel.

q_38645.question: What is the role of the Accounting Data Forwarding within the Charging Trigger Function (CTF)?
q_38645.ground_truth: The Accounting Data Forwarding is responsible for receiving accounting metrics, determining chargeable events, assembling charging events, and forwarding them to the CDF via the Rf reference point in real-time.

q_38646.question: What does the MeNB include in the SGNB MODIFICATION REQUEST message to request DL forwarding of downlink data for a bearer?
q_38646.ground_truth: The MeNB may include the DL Forwarding IE within the E-RABs To Be Added Item IE of the SGNB MODIFICATION REQUEST message to request DL forwarding of downlink data for a bearer.

q_38647.question: What technologies are used for localized services in the Monster theme park?
q_38647.ground_truth: The localized services in the Monster theme park are shared using blockchain technologies and based on e-agreements. These services are offered by different providers via a hosting network.

q_38648.question: What is the significance of bit 2 of octet 2 of the Long PDCP PDU Number extension header, and what should the other bits be set to?
q_38648.ground_truth: Bit 2 of octet 2 of the Long PDCP PDU Number extension header is the most significant bit of the PDCP PDU number field, and all other bits should be set to 0.

q_38649.question: What are the Transmit OFF power requirements for inter-band carrier aggregation with two uplink carriers assigned to one NR band?
