q_39377.question: What must the API exposing function send to the CAPIF core function in order to obtain the API routing information?
q_39377.ground_truth: The API exposing function must send an HTTP GET request message to the CAPIF core function with the API exposing function Identifier and API identification.

q_39378.question: What should a UE do when it deems that the network has failed the authentication check?
q_39378.ground_truth: The UE should request RRC to locally release the RRC connection and treat the active cell as barred, and start any retransmission timers if they were running when the UE received the first AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message containing an invalid MAC or SQN.

q_39379.question: How do interactions between RE-NWDAFs of different PLMNs take place?
q_39379.ground_truth: Interactions between RE-NWDAFs of different PLMNs may be via SEPPs (Security Edge Protection Proxies), which are not depicted in the architecture for the sake of clarity.

q_39380.question: What is the procedure to determine the location of a user equipment (UE) in a network, if some of the base stations (gNBs) are found to be false?
q_39380.ground_truth: The procedure involved in determining the location of a UE in a network, when some of the gNBs are found to be false, is that the user equipment's location is taken as legitimate if all the gNBs in a given iteration are found to be legitimate. If that is not the case, the same iteration excluding two gNBs is performed, and this procedure is repeated until the remaining gNBs match the registered legitimate gNBs.

q_39381.question: What is the purpose of the Track Info field in the Floor Release Multi Talker message?
q_39381.ground_truth: The Track Info field in the Floor Release Multi Talker message is included when an MCPTT call involves a non-controlling MCPTT function. The coding of the Track Info field is described in clause~8.2.3.13. This field is used to indicate the track or media stream information of the granted floor user.

q_39382.question: What is the definition of the "Uplink power control window size" in this process?
q_39382.ground_truth: The Uplink power control window size is defined as 1dB (UE power step size) + 0.7dB (UE power step tolerance) + (Test system relative power measurement uncertainty).

q_39383.question: What is the role of the DMRS sequences in the context of interference modeling in 3GPP TR 38.902?
q_39383.ground_truth: The DMRS sequences of paired UEs are assumed to be known for channel estimation purposes for all paired UEs, and the DMRS scrambling sequences of paired UEs are assumed to be the same to guarantee orthogonality.

q_39384.question: What should the UE do if it receives a handover cancellation message from the eNodeB and fails to transition to the 3GPP UTRAN or GERAN?
q_39384.ground_truth: The UE should send a SIP UPDATE request containing an SDP offer, a Reason header field with "cause" value 487, and reason-text set to either "handover cancelled" or "failure to transition to CS domain" in each transferred session.

q_39385.question: Under what circumstances does the SGSN send a Detach Request to the UE with an appropriate cause indicating the UE is not allowed to access a CSG?
q_39385.ground_truth: If this Detach procedure is due to the UE's Detach Request via a CSG cell which the UE is not allowed to access, the MME shall send a Detach Request to UE with an appropriate cause indicating the UE is not allowed to access this CSG.

q_39386.question: What is the definition of NACK to ACK detection probability for a particular bit position, in terms of detecting an ACK bit when a NACK bit was sent?
q_39386.ground_truth: The NACK to ACK detection probability is the probability of detecting an ACK bit when a NACK bit was sent on particular bit position. Each NACK bit erroneously detected as ACK bit is counted as one error.

q_39387.question: Which HTTP method is used by the SCEF to send the ManagePort Notification to the SCS/AS?
q_39387.ground_truth: The SCEF uses the HTTP POST method on the notification endpoint in SCS/AS to send the ManagePort Notification to the SCS/AS, using JSON format.

q_39388.question: What is the length of the number digits and sub-services field in the Extended emergency number list IE?
q_39388.ground_truth: The length of the number digits should contain the number of octets used to encode the number digits, and the length of the sub-services field should contain the number of octets used to encode the sub-services field.

q_39389.question: What action should the transmission control server take when it has received RTP media packets from another transmission participant and the Reception Mode field is set to '0'?
q_39389.ground_truth: The transmission control server shall increase C9 (Reception Active) by '1' if it has not reached its upper limit, store the SSRC of the transmission participant granted the permission to send media in the Active SSRC list until the associated transmission is ended towards the participant, and set the first bit in the subtype of the Media Transmission Notification message to '1' if an acknowledgment is required.

q_39390.question: In a single carrier with NR SL CA operating concurrently in an unlicensed and licensed band with maximum output power reduction, what requirements are applied for NR sidelink operation in the unlicensed band, and what requirements are applied for NR Uu operation in the licensed band?
q_39390.ground_truth: The maximum power reduction (MPR) requirements specified in TS 38.101-1 clause 6.2.2 apply for NR Uu operation in the licensed band, and the MPR requirements specified in clause X apply for NR sidelink operation in the unlicensed band. The allowed additional maximum power reduction (A-MPR) is also applied per each component carrier for each band.

q_39391.question: What message is sent to the group intended for the conversation before it starts over unicast bearers?

q_39392.question: What is the length of the MIC information element?
q_39392.ground_truth: The MIC information element is a type 3 information element with a length of 5 octets.

q_39393.question: What type of management components (A, B, or C) are provided by the legacy nodes management domain for the management of legacy nodes (e.g. eNB, ng-eNB, and EPC) in management option #A and #B?
q_39393.ground_truth: MnS component type A, B, and C in management option #A; MnS component type B in management option #B

q_39394.question: What information can the NWDAF retrieve from the GSMA database?
q_39394.ground_truth: The NWDAF can retrieve additional information such as device model, manufacturer, IMEI, supported frequency bands, and equipment type from the GSMA database.

q_39395.question: What information should be included in the "externalDocs" object of an OpenAPI specification file?
q_39395.ground_truth: The "externalDocs" object should contain the 3GPP TS number, version number, and name of the 3GPP TS describing the API, as well as a reference to the folder of that TS within the public 3GPP fileserver.

q_39396.question: What is the purpose of the Assistance Data Delivery procedure in the network-assisted barometric pressure sensor method?
q_39396.ground_truth: The purpose of the Assistance Data Delivery procedure is to enable the E-SMLC to provide assistance data to the UE for use in a positioning procedure, and for the UE to request assistance data from the E-SMLC for use in a positioning procedure or for autonomous self location.

q_39397.question: When should the UE include the cgi-Info containing all the fields that have been successfully acquired in the measurement report message?
q_39397.ground_truth: If the purpose is set to 'reportCGI' and the mandatory present fields of the cgi-Info for the cell indicated by the cellForWhichToReportCGI in the associated measObject have been obtained.

q_39398.question: What is the suggested maximum length of the inner IP datagram to avoid fragmentation when transmitted over non-3GPP access?
q_39398.ground_truth: The maximum inner IP datagram length should be set by the sending entity such that the length of the resulting outer IP datagram does not exceed the MTU of the non-3GPP access network.

q_39399.question: What HTTP request method is used when updating or revoking the authorization for announcing for a UE?

q_39400.question: What shall the UE do when it enters a tracking area included in the TAI list while being in EMM-REGISTERED and EMM-IDLE mode?
q_39400.ground_truth: The UE does not transmit a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.

q_39401.question: In the context of deriving the Public Identity from the SIP URI or Tel URI, what action is taken to remove visual separators and all URI parameters when the Public-Identity AVP contains a Tel URI in E.164 format?
q_39401.ground_truth: All visual separators are removed and all URI parameters are removed.

q_39402.question: What is the purpose of the initial media characteristics determination in mobile-initiated codec and media characteristics flow negotiations?
q_39402.ground_truth: The purpose of initial media characteristics determination is to establish a negotiated set of media characteristics, including common codecs, for the session.

q_39403.question: What action does PEMC take when associating a PEGC with a PINE in the "PEGC and PINE association" case?
q_39403.ground_truth: PEMC updates the old PEMC repository of the association of PEGC and PINE and notifies all affected parties about the new policy association.

q_39404.question: How should a UE handle a not comprehended field in an RRC message on any logical channel?
q_39404.ground_truth: The UE should treat the rest of the message as if the field was absent.

q_39405.question: What actions should the AMF take when the user equipment's (UE) uplink NAS COUNT is close to wrapping around?
q_39405.ground_truth: The AMF can activate a non-current native 5G NAS security context with sufficiently low NAS COUNT values, or initiate a new primary authentication and key agreement procedure to establish a new 5G NAS security context and reset the NAS COUNT to 0.

q_39406.question: What is the effect of removing the related QER or the DL Flow Level Marking IE from the related QER by the TDF-C?
q_39406.ground_truth: The TDF-U shall stop DL DSCP marking for the application during the PFCP session consequently.

q_39407.question: What should the MCVideo client include in the P-Preferred-Service header field, if present, in the initial SIP INVITE request?
q_39407.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should include the ICSI value "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcvideo" in the P-Preferred-Service header field.

q_39408.question: What should the network do if it receives a DETACH REQUEST message before sending a TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message or before receiving a TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message?
q_39408.ground_truth: If the detach cause is "switch off", the network should abort the tracking area updating procedure and progress the detach procedure. If the detach cause is not "switch off", the network should proceed with the tracking area updating procedure and then progress the detach procedure after successful completion.

q_39409.question: What is the role of the PRU in 5G network?
q_39409.ground_truth: The PRU at a known location can perform positioning measurements (e.g., RSTD, RSRP, UE Rx-Tx Time Difference measurements, DL-RSCPD, DL-RSCP, etc.) and report these measurements to a location server. It can also transmit SRS to enable TRPs to measure and report UL positioning measurements.

q_39410.question: What is the role of the AMF when the UE is in CM-IDLE with RRC Inactive, and there is a trigger to page the UE for mobile terminated data?
q_39410.ground_truth: The AMF sends N2 paging message only towards the NG-RAN node where N2 suspension occurred with indication of paging in RRC Inactive with CM_IDLE, and if RAN paging fails, the AMF may initiate CN paging to move the UE to RRC idle/CM idle and initiate service request procedure.

q_39411.question: What is the ETSI ZSM framework reference architecture's role in enabling zero-touch automated network and service management in a multivendor environment?
q_39411.ground_truth: The ETSI ZSM framework reference architecture provides the ZSM framework reference architecture, which includes distributed management and data services, organized into management domains, integrated via an integration fabric, and allows data sharing across domains. It also provides ZSM service capabilities and cross-domain integration fabric to facilitate providing capabilities and accessing endpoints cross-domain.

q_39412.question: What should a GTP-C entity set as the cause when rejecting a message due to overload?
q_39412.ground_truth: A GTP-C entity should set the cause to "GTP-C Entity Congestion" or "APN congestion" when rejecting a message due to overload.

q_39413.question: What message does the SCS/AS send to the SCEF if it has downlink non-IP data to send to a UE?
q_39413.ground_truth: The SCS/AS sends a MT NIDD Submit Request message to the SCEF.

q_39414.question: What happens if the XML schema of a supplementary service does not accept URIs that could be expressed as a relative URI reference causing a resolution problem?
q_39414.ground_truth: If the XML schema does not accept URIs that could be expressed as a relative URI reference causing a resolution problem, then each of the supplementary services should consider if relative URIs are allowed in the subdocument tree and indicate how to resolve relative URI references. In the absence of further indications, relative URI references should be resolved using the document URI as the base of the relative URI reference.

q_39415.question: What is the performance impact of semi-static SBFD on the SBFD operator for UL and DL in all load levels?
q_39415.ground_truth: For the SBFD operator, semi-static SBFD provides performance improvement for UL but suffers from degradation for DL for all load levels.

q_39416.question: How does the UE determine the Tracking/Location Area Identifier FQDN when attempting to select a non-3GPP access node for an IMS service?
q_39416.ground_truth: The UE uses the Tracking Area wherein it is located and constructs an ePDG or N3IWF TAI FQDN based on the 5GS TAI if it is registered to the 5GS, or based on the EPS TAI if it is registered to EPS.

q_39417.question: How can the CP function resume the measurement for an inactive URR that was deactivated by setting the Inactive Measurement flag from "0" to "1"?
q_39417.ground_truth: The CP function can resume the measurement for an inactive URR by setting the Inactive Measurement flag of the Measurement Information IE of the URR to "0" in an Update URR IE in a PFCP Session Modification Request message, with or without the Number of Report IE.

q_39418.question: What is required for the SC UE to initiate a session transfer during the re-establishment procedure?
q_39418.ground_truth: The SC UE can initiate a session transfer during the re-establishment procedure if the related session is still active.

q_39419.question: What is the guideline for the sender when changing the Load Metric parameter?
q_39419.ground_truth: The sender should refrain from advertising every small variation in the Load Metric which does not result in useful improvement in node selection logic at the receiver. Instead, a larger variation, e.g. 5 or more units, should be considered as reasonable enough for advertising the new Load Control Information.

q_39420.question: What action does the MME take when it receives a PDN DISCONNECT REJECT message with ESM cause #49 and EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection is not supported by the UE or the MME?
q_39420.ground_truth: The MME releases all the resources reserved for the PDN in the network.

q_39421.question: Under which circumstances will the NWDAF provide notification on analytics to the SMF?
q_39421.ground_truth: The NWDAF provides notification on the requested analytics to the SMF after deriving the requested analytics and collecting the data as specified in TS~23.288.

q_39422.question: What is the name of the signal that the SS sends downlink on the DL RMC and the UE sends uplink on the UL RMC, both of which are padded with bits when there is no actual data to be sent?

q_39423.question: What should the P-CSCF include in the P-Access-Network-Info header field if the IP-CAN-Type value provided by the PCRF is "DVB-RCS2"?
q_39423.ground_truth: If the IP-CAN-Type value provided by the PCRF is "DVB-RCS2", then the P-CSCF shall include a "network-provided" parameter, set the access-type field to "DVB-RCS2", and set the "dvb-rcs2-node-id" parameter with the value provided by the IP-CAN provider.

q_39424.question: What is the purpose of privacy timer value in the policy/parameters related to privacy?
q_39424.ground_truth: The privacy timer value is used to indicate the duration after which the UE shall change each source Layer-2 ID self-assigned by the UE when privacy is required.

q_39425.question: What is the purpose of the access token request in the service request process?
q_39425.ground_truth: The access token request is the first step in the service request process, where the NF Service Consumer sends a request for an access token to the NRF in the consumer PLMN.

q_39426.question: What information must be included in the AF request to let the NEF determine the common DNAI?
q_39426.ground_truth: A list of candidate DNAI(s) and/or EAS IP address must be included in the AF request to let the NEF determine the common DNAI.

q_39427.question: What is the implication of the one-shot large UL timing adjustment for FR2 power class 6 UE?
q_39427.ground_truth: The UE transmit timing immediately after TCI state switch shall meet the requirements of clause 7.1.2.1, with certain exceptions for the first UL transmission after a TCI state switch.

q_39428.question: What happens if the mobile station supports the enhanced network-initiated in-call modification procedure?
q_39428.ground_truth: The mobile station shall indicate this in the Call Control Capabilities IE in the SETUP message.

q_39429.question: What information does the AF provide to 5GS in step 2 for assistance with FL model training?
q_39429.ground_truth: The AF provides the following information to 5GS about FL model training: Candidate FL members, local model size, aggregated model size, expected number of iterations, time interval between iterations, preferences for time window(s) for FL training, QoS requirements, S-NSSAI, and an optional request for the geographical distribution of FL members.

q_39430.question: What is the difference between the GSM 7 bit default alphabet and 8-bit data in the document?
q_39430.ground_truth: The GSM 7 bit default alphabet in the document indicates that the TP-UD is coded from the GSM 7 bit default alphabet given in the clause. This character set allows for up to 160 characters in a message. On the other hand, 8-bit data indicates that the TP-UD has user-defined coding and allows for up to 140 octets in a message.

q_39431.question: What should be the polarization of the interfering signal for in-band frequencies in the out-of-band blocking test?
q_39431.ground_truth: The interferer shall be polarization matched for in-band frequencies in the out-of-band blocking test.

q_39432.question: When should the deprecating procedure be used for UML defined model elements?
q_39432.ground_truth: The deprecating procedure should be used between releases and not during the development of a single release, as long as the release is not yet frozen.

q_39433.question: What information does the policy information sent from PCF to SMF include?
q_39433.ground_truth: The policy information includes detection template for PDU Set importance/dependency and different QoS parameters for different PDU Sets, and optional dependency related instructions.

q_39434.question: What should an MS do if two or more packet filters with identical packet filter identifiers are contained in a new request?
q_39434.ground_truth: The MS should reject the modification request with cause "syntactical errors in packet filter(s)".

q_39435.question: What is the purpose of the localized service agreements in the Monster theme park?
q_39435.ground_truth: The localized service agreements allow for automatic establishment of temporary relationships among network operators and service providers for a specific occasion (time and location). These agreements enable seamless service continuity for users even with spotty network coverage.

q_39436.question: What is one of the potential reasons for an operator to control the use of a network slice?
q_39436.ground_truth: The operator may experience congestion in a network slice and would like to control the use of the slice to alleviate the congestion.

q_39437.question: What is the role of the provisioning MnS producer in the EES deployment use case?
q_39437.ground_truth: The provisioning MnS producer is responsible for instantiating the EES, determining the location where it will be instantiated, instantiating the EES VNF, establishing the connection with 5GC network functions, and notifying the consumer about the instantiation status.

q_39438.question: What steps does the NSCE server take to retrieve the performance data and analytics data of a network slice from 5GS and OAM system?
q_39438.ground_truth: The NSCE server retrieves the performance data and analytics data of network slice from 5GS by utilizing the APIs defined in TS 23.288 and TS 28.532 for OAM system. The server can also retrieve the network slice status, analytics data, and network slice instance related performance data defined in TS 23.502, TS 23.288, and TS 28.552.

q_39439.question: What entity in the home network is responsible for determining the local hosting network-specific back-off timer range and assigning a back-off timer value to the UE?
q_39439.ground_truth: The home network AMF determines the local hosting network-specific back-off timer range and assigns a back-off timer value to the UE in case of congestion.

q_39440.question: What should the controlling MCData function do when it receives a SIP request for a MCData group that the MCData user is not currently affiliated to and that requires the user to be implicitly affiliated to the group?
q_39440.ground_truth: The controlling MCData function should identify the served MCData group and user information entries, consider the necessary entries, and if the user information entry does not exist, it should insert an MCData user information entry.

q_39441.question: What is the purpose of the AI/ML abstract performance in the inference phase?
q_39441.ground_truth: The AI/ML abstract performance provides a report of the qualified abstract performance for the AI/ML inference MnS consumer, which can be easily interpreted.

q_39442.question: What should the AMF do with the Enhanced Coverage Restriction information stored in its UE context?
q_39442.ground_truth: The AMF should transfer the Enhanced Coverage Restriction information stored as part of its UE context during AMF change.

q_39443.question: What is the size of the NAS COUNT represented in internal form, and how is it constructed?
q_39443.ground_truth: The NAS COUNT is represented as a 24-bit entity constructed with 8 least significant bits for the NAS sequence number and 16 most significant bits for the NAS overflow counter, resulting in 8+16=24 bits

q_39444.question: What is the purpose of the "unavailability period" feature in this solution?
q_39444.ground_truth: The "unavailability period" feature allows the UE to become unavailable for a certain duration, during which the 5GC maintains its context in CM-IDLE and considers the UE unreachable. This is used to address Key issue #1, which is related to the unavailability of the UE.

q_39445.question: Which information element defines SL-ResourcePool?
q_39445.ground_truth: The information element defining SL-ResourcePool is 5.5.

q_39446.question: What is the formula for Kgap in inter-frequency measurements with measurement gaps for UE supporting concurrentMeasGap-r17?
q_39446.ground_truth: Kgap = Ntotal / Navailable, where Navailable is the number of SMTC occasions covered by instances of the non-dropped associated measurement gap within the window W after accounting for collisions, and Ntotal is the total number of SMTC occasions covered by instances of the associated measurement gap within the window W.

q_39447.question: What are the two main types of changes that can result in a new version release of the present document?
q_39447.ground_truth: The two main types of changes are changes of substance, such as technical enhancements, corrections, and updates, and editorial changes, such as formatting or language improvements.

q_39448.question: What must the SMF handle if a PDU session has more than one QoS rule during inter-RAT idle mobility to NB-IoT?
q_39448.ground_truth: The SMF shall initiate a PDU session modification procedure to remove any non-default QoS rules and maintain only the default QoS rule.

q_39449.question: What is the size of the resource block assignment field in the DCI format 0B?
q_39449.ground_truth: The resource block assignment field in the DCI format 0B is 5 or 6 bits.

q_39450.question: In the context of the present document, what does "shall" mean?
q_39450.ground_truth: Indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

q_39451.question: Which EPS access control protocol is used to request assistance information from the network?
q_39451.ground_truth: The AssistanceInformation message is used to request assistance information.

q_39452.question: When should a network consider the old P-TMSI and old RAI as invalid upon receipt of a GMM message containing a new P-TMSI in Iu mode?
q_39452.ground_truth: The network should consider the old P-TMSI and old RAI as invalid as soon as an acknowledge message (e.g. ATTACH COMPLETE, ROUTING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE and P-TMSI REALLOCATION COMPLETE) is received.

q_39453.question: What are the differences between the Pseudo-range and Phase-range measurements provided by a GNSS receiver?
q_39453.ground_truth: The Pseudo-range is the distance between the satellite and GNSS receiver antennas, expressed in meters, while the Phase-range measurement is a measurement of the range between a satellite and receiver expressed in units of cycles of the carrier frequency, which is more precise than the Pseudo-range but is ambiguous by an unknown integer number of wavelengths.

q_39454.question: What is the value of m used in the formula for calculating the SLR and RLR in 8.2.3, 8.2.4, 8.2.4.1, and 8.2.4.2?
q_39454.ground_truth: The value of m used in the formula for calculating the SLR and RLR in 8.2.3, 8.2.4, 8.2.4.1, and 8.2.4.2 is 0.175.

q_39455.question: What procedure is performed to release bearer context in the gNB-CU-UP initiated by the gNB-CU-CP?
q_39455.ground_truth: The procedure consists of three steps, where the gNB-CU-CP sends a BEARER CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message, the gNB-CU-UP responds with a BEARER CONTEXT MODIFICATION RESPONSE carrying the PDCP UL/DL status, and the F1 UE context modification procedure is performed to stop the data transmission for the UE.

q_39456.question: What will happen if the network does not receive the ROUTING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message from a GPRS MS after sending the ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message?
q_39456.ground_truth: The network shall send the ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message again and restart the timer T3350 if an ROUTING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message is expected. In that case, the retransmission counter related to T3350 is not incremented. If the ROUTING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message is not received until the T3350 expires for four times, the routing area updating procedure is aborted.

q_39457.question: When is the 5GC-MO-LR procedure using SL positioning performed in the MO-LR Procedure for Network based SL Positioning for UE with NAS connection?
q_39457.ground_truth: The 5GC-MO-LR procedure using SL positioning is performed when the UE triggers SL-MO-LR service request to obtain its own absolute location and cannot establish a NAS connection or cannot be served by a Ranging/SL positioning capable LMF.

q_39458.question: What is the responsibility of the SEAF in a split DU-CU implementation?
q_39458.ground_truth: The SEAF provides the authentication functionality via the AMF in the serving network for a split DU-CU implementation.

q_39459.question: When should the MCData client include a Resource-Priority header field in the SIP INVITE request or SIP REFER request for an MCData emergency group communication?
q_39459.ground_truth: The MCData client should include a Resource-Priority header field if the MCData emergency group communication state is set to either "MDEGC 2: emergency-communication-requested" or "MDEGC 3: emergency-communication-granted" and this is an authorized request for an MCData emergency group communication, or if the MCData client emergency group state of the group is set to "MDEG 2: in-progress".

q_39460.question: What steps must be taken by the user before initiating the announce request procedure?
q_39460.ground_truth: Before initiating the announce request procedure, the user sets the permissions for the restricted discovery using application layer mechanisms, retrieves the PDUID provisioned to the UE as part of the service authorization procedure, and obtains an RPAUID associated with the UE's PDUID from the ProSe application server.

q_39461.question: What should be delivered by the MAC entity when transmission using PUR is initiated?
q_39461.ground_truth: The MAC entity should deliver the uplink grant, and the associated HARQ information to the HARQ entity for each TTI for which RRC layer has provided uplink grant for transmission using PUR.

q_39462.question: What course of action would the SMF take when it receives a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message during an ongoing network-requested PDU session modification procedure and the PDU session indicated in the message is the same one being modified?
q_39462.ground_truth: The SMF would ignore the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message and proceed with the network-requested PDU session modification procedure as if no message was received from the UE.

q_39463.question: What is the role of the SEAL/NSCE in terms of fault management?
q_39463.ground_truth: The SEAL/NSCE detects whether a fault is caused by the 5GS network and exposes the fault report to the third-party. It may also inform the management functions about the location of the fault for clearing it.

q_39464.question: What is the maximum bandwidth that can be reserved for DCI combination 2 in 7.3.3.2?
q_39464.ground_truth: Four physical resource blocks are reserved for 10 MHz, 15 MHz, or 20 MHz bandwidth for DCI combination 2 in 7.3.3.2.

q_39465.question: Which SSC mode is not mandatory for UEs to support, and can lead to non-functionality of certain features?
q_39465.ground_truth: SSC mode 2 is not mandatory for UEs to support, and can lead to non-functionality of certain features.

q_39466.question: What process is performed on the bits input to the code block segmentation after code block segmentation?
q_39466.ground_truth: The bits input to the code block segmentation are denoted by where B is the number of bits in the transport block (including CRC), and the bits after code block segmentation are denoted by where r is the code block number and Kr is the number of bits for code block number r.

q_39467.question: What procedure is defined in clause 6.8.1.2 that applies to both S8-S2a and S8-S2b chaining for multiple PDN connections to a single APN?
q_39467.ground_truth: The UE-initiated Connectivity to Additional PDN

q_39468.question: In the context of 5GC SBI service APIs, what are the conventions for resource structure?
q_39468.ground_truth: The resource structure shall define the structure of the resource URIs, the resources, the associated HTTP methods and custom operations used for the service.

q_39469.question: What must the SeNB do upon reception of the UE Context Release message in step 5 of the MeNB initiated SeNB Release procedure?
q_39469.ground_truth: The SeNB can release radio and C-plane related resource associated to the UE context, and any ongoing data forwarding may continue.

q_39470.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement defined in clause 16.1.1.8.3 for NR RedCap UE with 2Rx from release 17 and forward?
q_39470.ground_truth: NR RedCap UE supporting Rel.17 stationary idle mode relaxed measurement criterion.

q_39471.question: What action must the AMF take if slices are temporarily allowed for SSC3 type of behavior?
q_39471.ground_truth: The AMF must temporarily include the slices in the Allowed NSSAI towards the UE, and may include a back-off timer for the original slice and/or include the original slice in the Rejected NSSAI to prevent the UE from requesting the slice.

q_39472.question: What is the required Content-Type header field for the HTTP 200(OK) response?

q_39473.question: What is an Alternative Service Requirement that an AF can provide when requesting QoS services?
q_39473.ground_truth: Alternative Service Requirements include a requested 5GS Delay, a requested Guaranteed Flow Bitrate, a requested Packet Error Rate, and an optional Maximum Burst Size parameter.

q_39474.question: What is the role of the EEC in the procedure described in section 7.46.2.2.2?
q_39474.ground_truth: The EEC can be responsible to make decisions on ACR scenarios selection for EAS bundles.

q_39475.question: When a HARQ ACK is received alone, what should the MAC entity do with the data in the HARQ buffer?
q_39475.ground_truth: The MAC entity should keep the data in the HARQ buffer.

q_39476.question: What action does the MME take if it temporarily rejects a Downlink Data Notification message due to stored Paging Restriction Information for the UE?
q_39476.ground_truth: The MME sends a Downlink Data Notification Ack message with an indication that the Downlink Data Notification message has been temporarily rejected.

q_39477.question: In what scenarios can the number of active EPS bearer contexts in the UE not be equal to the maximum number of EPS bearer contexts reached in the network when attempting to establish multiple EPS bearer contexts?
q_39477.ground_truth: In some situations, when attempting to establish multiple EPS bearer contexts, the number of active EPS bearer contexts in the UE when cause #65 is received is not equal to the maximum number of EPS bearer contexts reached in the network.

q_39478.question: What must the P-CSCF do when it receives a 200 (OK) response to a REGISTER request?
q_39478.ground_truth: When the P-CSCF receives a 200 (OK) response to a REGISTER request, it must save the list of service route values in the Service-Route header fields preserving the order, and bind the list either to the contact address or to the registration flow and the associated contact address; it must also associate the list of service route values with the registered public user identity and either the associated contact address or the registration flow and the associated contact address, and store the public user identities, found in the P-Associated-URI header field value, including any associated display names, and any parameters associated with either the user or the identities of the user, and associate them to the registered public user identity.

q_39479.question: What action does the participating MCVideo function perform when generating an SDP offer for on-demand session 1?
q_39479.ground_truth: When generating an SDP offer for on-demand session 1, the participating MCVideo function creates an SDP offer that contains two SDP media-level sections for MCVideo video media and an SDP media-level section for one media-transmission control entity, if present in the received SDP offer. The IP address and port number for the offered media stream and for the offered media transmission control entity, if present, are replaced with the IP address and port number of the participating MCVideo function.

q_39480.question: What is the maximum size of the "EPS quality of service" information element when the value of X is equal to 14 in the context of the bearer parameters for E-UTRAN / Satellite E-UTRAN / NG-RAN / Satellite NG-RAN?
q_39480.ground_truth: The maximum size of the "EPS quality of service" information element is 3 bytes + Bit X+2 when the value of X is equal to 14 in the context of the bearer parameters for E-UTRAN / Satellite E-UTRAN / NG-RAN / Satellite NG-RAN.

q_39481.question: What sources are used for collecting location data in the location accuracy analytics solution?
q_39481.ground_truth: The location data is collected from three sources - NWDAF, SEAL LMS, and A-ADRF. NWDAF provides UE mobility analytics, SEAL LMS provides UE location reports and achieved accuracy, and A-ADRF provides historical location accuracy statistics.

q_39482.question: When should the URIs in the P-Associated-URI header field be removed by the P-CSCF?
q_39482.ground_truth: The URIs in the P-Associated-URI header field might need to be removed when the UE performs the functions of an external attached network, such as an enterprise network.

q_39483.question: How many reference channels are to be measured for the minimum requirement in clause 8.2.4.5?
q_39483.ground_truth: Ten reference channels are to be measured for the minimum requirement in clause 8.2.4.5.

q_39484.question: What are the possible criticality values of E1AP-ELEMENTARY PROCEDURE?
q_39484.ground_truth: The possible criticality values of E1AP-ELEMENTARY PROCEDURE are reject and ignore.

q_39485.question: What should the originating participating MCPTT function do after determining the public service identity of the controlling MCPTT function?
q_39485.ground_truth: The originating participating MCPTT function should generate an outgoing SIP MESSAGE request to the controlling MCPTT function and send it as specified in 3GPP TS 24.229.

q_39486.question: What is the size of the FQDN sequence?
q_39486.ground_truth: The FQDN sequence is an octet string of size 4 to 253.

q_39487.question: What action is taken after receiving a Suspend Notification message for a suspended UE in the E-UTRAN CS fallback procedure?
q_39487.ground_truth: After receiving a Suspend Notification message, the SGW/PGW marks all non-GBR bearers as suspended and discards packets it receives for the suspended UE.

q_39488.question: When is an RCSSessionEstablishmentAttempt record generated by the IRI-POI in the RCS Server?
q_39488.ground_truth: The RCSSessionEstablishmentAttempt record is generated by the IRI-POI in the RCS Server when it detects the request for a SIP session to transfer a Large Message Mode CPM Standalone message or for a CPM 1-to-1 Chat Session.

q_39489.question: What are the two types of trace targets that can be included in the trace activation parameter for AMF in the EPS to 5GS handover using N26 interface procedure?

q_39490.question: What is a scenario where the multipath transmission of a UDP flow using the MPQUIC steering functionality can lead to the reception of double copies of the same packet?
q_39490.ground_truth: This can occur when the MPQUIC steering functionality applies the redundant steering mode (RSM) for a UDP flow.

q_39491.question: What should the user equipment (UE) do first when initiating a UE assistance data provisioning procedure in step 5.4.8.2?
q_39491.ground_truth: The UE should allocate an EPTI value as specified in clause 5.4.2.2.

q_39492.question: What information should a UE include in an LPP Request Assistance Data message in the context of Multi-RTT positioning?
q_39492.ground_truth: A UE should include information such as the UE's approximate location and serving and neighbour cells, as well as NR E-CID measurements, to help the LMF provide appropriate assistance data.

q_39493.question: What is the significance of the two service access points in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_39493.ground_truth: The two service access points are distinguished by their Service Access Point Identifiers (SAPI). SAPI 0 supports the transfer of signalling information including user-user information, while SAPI 3 supports the transfer of user short messages.

q_39494.question: What types of cells does a UE measure and report on when performing NR measurements?
q_39494.ground_truth: For NR measurement objects, the UE measures and reports on the serving cell(s)/serving Relay UE (for L2 U2N Remote UE), listed cells, and/or detected cells.

q_39495.question: What should the UE do if the current TAI is stored in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming" and the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message is not integrity protected?
q_39495.ground_truth: The UE shall memorize the current TAI was stored in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming" for non-integrity protected NAS reject message.

q_39496.question: What element in the MCData function indicates whether integrity protection is enabled for the MCData service?

q_39497.question: What is the goal of federated EAS deployment and termination in edge federation management?
q_39497.ground_truth: The goal is to enable a leading operator (LO) to instantiate an application on EDN of a partner operator (PO) as requested by an application service provider (ASP) over NBI. This allows the PO to provide the application instance status to the LO, which can be exposed to application providers on NBI.

q_39498.question: What should the BBF do if the PCRF requests the same change to the ARP/QCI for all PCC/QoS Rules bound to the same bearer?
q_39498.ground_truth: The BBF should modify the bearer ARP/QCI as requested.

q_39499.question: What should be done to receive notifications from the NSCE Server on network slice related performance and analytics monitoring event(s)?
q_39499.ground_truth: In order to receive notifications from the NSCE Server on network slice related performance and analytics monitoring event(s), the NSCE Server shall send an HTTP POST request to the service consumer with the request body including the MonitoringNotif data structure, and the service consumer shall respond to the NSCE Server with an HTTP "204 No Content" status code to acknowledge the successful reception and processing of the notification.

q_39500.question: What is the purpose of using adaptive filtering and non-linear modeling in the digital domain for self-interference mitigation?
q_39500.ground_truth: The purpose of using adaptive filtering and non-linear modeling in the digital domain for self-interference mitigation is to accurately model and cancel the residual self-interference that cannot be fully captured in the RF or analog domain.

q_39501.question: What should a controlling MCVideo function do if it receives a SIP MESSAGE request for an MCVideo emergency alert and the sending MCVideo user is not affiliated with the MCVideo group identified by the <mcvideo-request-uri> of the MIME body?
q_39501.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function shall check if the MCVideo user is eligible to be implicitly affiliated with the MCVideo group. If the user is determined not to be eligible, it shall reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response and include the warning text "120 user is not affiliated to this group".

q_39502.question: What technique is recommended for coordinating the implementation of HTTP polling process with SUPL procedures?
q_39502.ground_truth: The implementation of the HTTP polling process can be coordinated with the SUPL (Secure User Plane Location) procedures to synchronize the SUPL location report procedures and the HTTP polling procedure so as to reduce unnecessary wait time of polling.

q_39503.question: What parameter is used by the UE when deriving the new Kembt that is used to generate KRRCint, KRRCenc, and KUPenc upon handover, connection re-establishment, connection resume, UP-EDT, and UP transmission using PUR?

q_39504.question: What should the UPF in VPLMN do to support EAS discovery procedure with V-EASDF using IP replacement mechanism for supporting HR-SBO?
q_39504.ground_truth: The UPF in VPLMN should send DNS queries for the FQDN (range) to the V-EASDF and replace the source IP address and/or port number of the DNS response targeting the FQDN (range).

q_39505.question: When should the SMF reduce the received BAT offset from the current BAT in UL direction in the TSCAI for the given QoS Flow?
q_39505.ground_truth: After the SMF has setup a QoS Flow between UPF and NG-RAN, the SMF applies the BAT offset reduction.

q_39506.question: What is the difference between "5GS" and "N3IWFFunction" in the context of these measurements?
q_39506.ground_truth: "5GS" refers to the 5th Generation System (5G) of wireless telecommunications, while "N3IWFFunction" refers to functions performed by the N3 Interworking Function (N3IWF).

q_39507.question: When is the UE required to restart the Rx-Tx measurement on the new cell when DRX is used and the PCell is changed due to handover?
q_39507.ground_truth: When the UE is performing UE Rx-Tx time difference measurement while the PCell is changed due to the handover, the UE shall restart the Rx-Tx measurement on the new cell and meet the UE Rx-Tx time difference measurement and accuracy requirements.

q_39508.question: What is the purpose of the MIC IE set to the calculated MIC value when the 5G ProSe direct link establishment procedure is for direct communication between the 5G ProSe remote UE and the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE or between the 5G ProSe end UE and the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE and the UE has the DUIK?
q_39508.ground_truth: It is used to ensure secure direct communication between the UEs by including the calculated MIC value in the PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message.

q_39509.question: What should an MTSI client do to request a desired region of interest?
q_39509.ground_truth: An MTSI client should support Video Region-of-Interest (ROI) signaling as specified in clause~7.3.7 and must support at least one of the following modes to request a desired region of interest.

q_39510.question: What is the format of the SIP MESSAGE request when the participating MCPTT function requests the MCPTT client to report its location?
q_39510.ground_truth: It includes a Request-URI, an Accept-Contact header field, an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body with an <mcptt-request-uri> element, and an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-location-info+xml MIME body with a <Request> element.

q_39511.question: In what mode of operation must the UE be for the LWA, LWIP, and RCLWI procedures to be applicable?
q_39511.ground_truth: The UE must be in ECM-CONNECTED mode for the LWA, LWIP, and RCLWI procedures to be applicable.

q_39512.question: What is the performance requirement for in-channel selectivity for SAN type 1-H, as specified in clause 7.8?
q_39512.ground_truth: The throughput should be greater than or equal to 95% of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channel for SAN type 1-H in the presence of an interfering signal at a larger power spectral density.

q_39513.question: What is the purpose of using autonomous gaps in downlink reception and uplink transmission in this test?
q_39513.ground_truth: The purpose of using autonomous gaps in downlink reception and uplink transmission in this test is to receive MIB and SIB1 message.

q_39514.question: What is the size of the new data indicator field in the DCI format 0C?
q_39514.ground_truth: The new data indicator field in the DCI format 0C is 1 bit.

q_39515.question: What should the UE do when it wants to cause the network to initiate a PDU session release over a specific access, as specified in clause 6.4.3.2 of 3GPP TS 24.501?
q_39515.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the UE-requested PDU session release procedure as specified in clause 6.4.3.2 of 3GPP TS 24.501 by sending the PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST message to the network over the specific access.

q_39516.question: What is the maximum variability in UE delay due to synchronization in LTE, NR, or WLAN access for speech-based calls?
q_39516.ground_truth: Up to 20ms may be expected between different calls.

q_39517.question: What should the SMF include in the N1 SM container and N2 SM information when sending the PDU Session Establishment Accept in the PDU Session Establishment procedure for non-3GPP access?
q_39517.ground_truth: The SMF should include all QoS information for the QoS Flows, such as QoS Rules in the N1 SM container and QFI(s) and QoS Profile(s) in the N2 SM information.

q_39518.question: What should the AMF do if it receives the Allowed PDU session status IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message and the SMF has indicated pending downlink data only?
q_39518.ground_truth: The AMF should notify the SMF that reactivation of the user-plane resources for the corresponding PDU session(s) associated with non-3GPP access can be performed if the corresponding PDU session ID(s) are indicated in the Allowed PDU session status IE.

q_39519.question: What is the definition of in-band blocking in the context of receiver performance?
q_39519.ground_truth: In-band blocking is a measure of a receiver's ability to receive a wanted signal at its assigned channel frequency in the presence of an unwanted interferer on frequencies within the same band, without causing a degradation of the performance of the receiver beyond a specified limit.

q_39520.question: What HTTP status code does the BSF send to the PCF when it successfully deletes binding information as detailed in clause 8.5.3?

q_39521.question: How is the Home Network Domain for 5GS structured in 3GPP network?
q_39521.ground_truth: The Home Network Domain for 5GS in 3GPP network is in the format "5gc.mnc<MNC>.mcc<MCC>.3gppnetwork.org", where both <MNC> and <MCC> are 3 digits long.

q_39522.question: What is the role of the Media Player in the 5GMS media service playback process?
q_39522.ground_truth: The Media Player is responsible for requesting the media presentation manifest, processing it, selecting the media content, receiving the content from the 5GMS AS, and informing the Media Session Handler about the consumed media content.

q_39523.question: What action does the MSGin5G Server perform when a message is stored for deferred delivery?
q_39523.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Server sends a message response in a new CoAP POST request to the originating entity to confirm the storage of the message for deferred delivery. This response includes the originating MSGin5G Client's address and other specified information.

q_39524.question: How frequently is the UE provided with a new Timing Advance Command MAC control element during each test?

q_39525.question: How does the LMF resolve the cell-ID of the MBSR?
q_39525.ground_truth: The LMF can correlate the cell-ID with the GPSI of the MBSR received by the AMF, query the PLMN level NRF for the MBSR's SUPI and AMF-ID of the AMF serving the MBSR using the cell-ID, or receive the cell-ID with an indication that it is a MBSR from the AMF. In Solution #18, the AMF serving UE provides the cell-ID and AMF ID of the serving MBSR to the LMF.

q_39526.question: Which message serves as the initial message for sgNBinitiatedSgNBModification?

q_39527.question: What steps does the NWDAF follow to receive analytics from multiple NWDAFs with the same "expected waiting time"?
q_39527.ground_truth: The NWDAF Service Consumer indicates the "expected waiting time" as "time when analytics is needed" parameter to those NWDAFs from which it expects to receive analytics latest by the specified time. Each NWDAF generates the requested analytics based on data from related data sources and, if necessary, indicates a "revised waiting time" in an error response. The NWDAF Service Consumer can then receive the analytics based on the indicated time.

q_39528.question: In which scenario would the target cell's bandwidth be larger than the current cell's bandwidth, but the current cell's bandwidth still be within the target cell's bandwidth?

q_39529.question: What is the maximum allowed interruption on an activated SCell during SRS carrier based switching?
q_39529.ground_truth: The maximum allowed interruption on an activated SCell during SRS carrier based switching is 5 subframes.

q_39530.question: What should the participating MCVideo function do if the call is a private call and the received SIP REFER request contains a <functional-alias-URI> element of the <anyExt> element of the <mcvideo-Params> element of the <mcvideoinfo> element in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body?
q_39530.ground_truth: It should check if the status of the functional alias is activated for the MCVideo ID. If the functional alias status is activated, then the participating MCVideo function should set the <functional-alias-URI> element of the <anyExt> element of the <mcvideo-Params> element of the <mcvideoinfo> element of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body in the outgoing SIP INVITE request to the received value. If not, it should not include a <functional-alias-URI> element.

q_39531.question: What is the aim of Sol#19 for reducing latency of LCS request?
q_39531.ground_truth: The aim of Sol#19 for reducing latency of LCS request is to bypass GMLC and report UE location directly to the LCS client. A 'second user plane' is established between LMF/GMLC and AF or LCS client to achieve this.

q_39532.question: What action does the NG-RAN node take when it receives a DISTRIBUTION SETUP REQUEST message with the Shared NG-U Unicast TNL Information IE included?
q_39532.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node uses the included information as the downlink termination point for the shared NG-U transport.

q_39533.question: What are the aspects of the Service Authorization to NG-RAN that needs to be studied for Ranging based services and sidelink positioning over PC5?
q_39533.ground_truth: The aspects of Service Authorization to NG-RAN that need to be studied for Ranging based services and sidelink positioning over PC5 include the service authorization policy/parameter required for the support of Ranging/SL Positioning and how 5GC authorizes the usage of Ranging based services and sidelink positioning over PC5 and the related policy/parameter.

q_39534.question: When is CSI-RS based RLM considered to be within the SMTC window duration?
q_39534.ground_truth: The CSI-RS based RLM is considered to be within the SMTC window duration if it appears within the SMTC window duration.

q_39535.question: What should the PCF do if the request is not authorized or the required QoS is not allowed during MBS session creation?
q_39535.ground_truth: The PCF responds with an error message to the MB-SMF, which then informs the AF about the authorization or QoS failure.

q_39536.question: What message does the target eNB send to the source eNB to inform that the UE has successfully accessed the target cell, in case of DAPS Handover?

q_39537.question: What is the requirement for a 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE to start the announcing UE procedure for UE-to-network relay discovery?
q_39537.ground_truth: The UE is authorized to act as a UE-to-network relay in the PLMN indicated by the serving cell and is served by NG-RAN or authorized to perform 5G ProSe direct discovery when not served by NG-RAN.

q_39538.question: What should be taken into consideration when using the Timing Advance value for distance measurement?
q_39538.ground_truth: Reflections from the external environment, such as buildings, may affect the accuracy of the distance measurement.

q_39539.question: In the context of event A4, what is the condition for the leaving condition of a neighbor cell to be satisfied?
q_39539.ground_truth: The leaving condition for a neighbor cell to be satisfied in the context of event A4 is when the neighbor cell becomes worse than the absolute threshold for event A4.

q_39540.question: In a scheduling request, how would a terminal determine which cell to connect to?
q_39540.ground_truth: The terminal would apply the association guidelines provided in the Reduced Connectivity Information (ResourceCoordinationTransferContainer) message in 3GPP TS38.300 v16.1.0 (2018-july).

q_39541.question: Under what circumstances can a UE use a preferred resource set in its resource (re)selection for transmissions to a peer UE providing the preferred resource set?
q_39541.ground_truth: UE should use the preferred resource set in its resource (re)selection for transmissions to a peer UE providing the preferred resource set if the UE has own sensing results.

q_39542.question: What should the MCVideo client include in a SIP REGISTER request for service authorization with confidentiality and integrity protection disabled?
q_39542.ground_truth: The MCVideo client shall include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body with the mcvideo-access-token and mcvideo-client-id elements in the SIP REGISTER request for service authorization if confidentiality and integrity protection are disabled.

q_39543.question: What header fields are used to identify the start of a PDU set in RTP?
q_39543.ground_truth: A new timestamp, a new Type field in NAL unit header, and the sequence number of the packet with the RTP header M-bit set to 1.

q_39544.question: What is the principle for serving network provisioning of localized service information data?
q_39544.ground_truth: Some solutions following this principle propose to use AMF/SMF in serving network to store the localized service information data, and use MM NAS or SM NAS message to deliver the data to the UE. Other solutions propose to use UDR in the serving network to store the localized service information data as application data for any UE registered to the serving network. This enables the flexibility of obtaining the data from either the serving network or the home network or both.

q_39545.question: What impact does the serving cell's reference signal power have on the measurement reporting procedure?
q_39545.ground_truth: If the reference signal power of the serving cell is better than or equal to the threshold value, the UE does not stop the periodical reporting.

q_39546.question: What is the function of the WRITE-REPLACE-WARNING-REQUEST Request/Indication primitive?
q_39546.ground_truth: The WRITE-REPLACE-WARNING-REQUEST Request/Indication primitive is used by the CBC to request the MME and the AMF to start or overwrite a warning message broadcast.

q_39547.question: What is the requirement for frequency error that applies to E.2F.4 for NR sidelink operation in unlicensed band?
q_39547.ground_truth: The requirements for frequency error in clause 6.4.1 apply.

q_39548.question: What should the MCPTT client do when it receives a SIP MESSAGE request containing a Content-Type header field set to "application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-location-info+xml" and an <mcptt-request-uri> element included in the <location-info> root element?
q_39548.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should send a location report and reset the minimumReportInterval timer.

q_39549.question: What network entities are responsible for controlling the gating in PGW-U and TDF-U for EPC and in UPF for 5GC?
q_39549.ground_truth: The PGW-C and TDF-C for EPC, and the SMF for 5GC.

q_39550.question: Which request can be used for all codecs to pad the RTCP-APP to be 32 bit aligned?
q_39550.ground_truth: The PADDING request can be used for all codecs to pad the RTCP-APP to be 32 bit aligned.

q_39551.question: What values does the IoT-PCS Server suggest for Maximum Latency and Maximum Response Time, as part of the network parameter coordination procedure?
q_39551.ground_truth: The IoT-PCS Server suggests Maximum Latency based on the periodicity derived from the UE unified traffic pattern, which includes the schedule elements for the UE's communications with all IoT-Apps. Maximum Response Time is suggested based on the duration of activity derived from the schedule element of the UE unified traffic pattern, indicating how long the UE should stay reachable for downlink communications.

q_39552.question: What value does the MME store if it determines the unavailability period duration based on satellite coverage availability information?
q_39552.ground_truth: The MME stores the determined unavailability period duration if it is determined based on satellite coverage availability information.

q_39553.question: What is the impact of management capability exposure governance on the Network Slice NRM fragment, and is it within the scope of SA5?
q_39553.ground_truth: It is within the scope of SA5. The NSP sends NSC related information, such as NSC id and NSC granted capabilities, to the NOP. The NOP manages this information in relation to the existing NetworkSlice and NetworkSliceSubnet IOCs.

q_39554.question: What is the purpose of overload control in 3GPP networks?
q_39554.ground_truth: The purpose of overload control in 3GPP networks is to manage the processing load of Public Land Mobile Network (PLMN) entities and Signalling System No. 7.

q_39555.question: What shall the VAE-C include in the Content-Type header field when sending a V2X message reception report?
q_39555.ground_truth: The VAE-C shall set the Content-Type header field to "application/vnd.3gpp.vae-info+xml" when sending a V2X message reception report.

q_39556.question: What is required for testing a notification connection in the VAE HDMap Dynamic Info service?
q_39556.ground_truth: Both the VAE server and service consumer should support testing a notification connection using a separate HTTP connection towards an assigned address.

q_39557.question: What action does the floor control interface towards the MCPTT client in the IWF floor control server take when no MCPTT client has permission to send media, and an MCPTT client rejoins an ongoing MCPTT call without an implicit floor request?
q_39557.ground_truth: If an MCPTT call already exists but no MCPTT client has the permission to send a media, the floor control interface towards the MCPTT client in the IWF floor control server: should send a Floor Idle message to the MCPTT client and enter the state 'U: not permitted and Floor Idle'.

q_39558.question: When does RRC connection re-establishment occur for a NB-IoT UE supporting RRC connection re-establishment for the Control Plane CIoT EPS/5GS optimisation?
q_39558.ground_truth: A NB-IoT UE supporting RRC connection re-establishment for the Control Plane CIoT EPS/5GS optimisation can initiate the procedure in order to continue the RRC connection when AS security has not been activated.

q_39559.question: What is the SDP information used for in the IMS media flow?
q_39559.ground_truth: The SDP information provides details about the codec information expected by the IMS Media Function. It is used to identify the incoming and outgoing media packets.

q_39560.question: What are the two delivery modes for MBS traffic in 5G network?
q_39560.ground_truth: The two delivery modes are 5GC Shared MBS traffic delivery and 5GC Individual MBS traffic delivery.

q_39561.question: What do the terms "shall" and "shall not" indicate in the normative context of the document?
q_39561.ground_truth: "Shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something, and "shall not" indicates a prohibition to do something.

q_39562.question: What is the role of the 5GMSu AF in the 5GMS service?
q_39562.ground_truth: The 5GMSu AF acts as an interface between the 5GMSu AS and the 5GMSu Application Provider, fulfilling various control functions such as requesting the instantiation of the content preparation process and managing the uplink streaming.

q_39563.question: What is the specific delay requirement for UE supporting power class 1 or 5 in Test 1?
q_39563.ground_truth: The UE supporting power class 1 or 5 must report the event within 7202 ms for Test 1 for the number of successful tests to be increased.

q_39564.question: What should the UE do with the stored list of forbidden PLMNs upon receiving an ATTACH ACCEPT message that contains a list?
q_39564.ground_truth: The UE should replace the stored list of forbidden PLMNs with the list contained in the ATTACH ACCEPT message.

q_39565.question: What should the 3GPP AAA Proxy do on receipt of an authentication and authorization request if the Visited-Network-Identifier AVP is not present?
q_39565.ground_truth: The 3GPP AAA Proxy shall insert the Visited-Network-Identifier AVP before forwarding the request to the 3GPP AAA Server.

q_39566.question: When is the requirement to apply the operating band unwanted emission limit for a multi-band TAB connector where multiple bands are mapped on the same antenna connector, not applicable?
q_39566.ground_truth: The requirement is not applicable when there is no carrier transmitted in an operating band, and there is a supported downlink band with carrier(s) transmitted and a supported downlink band without any carrier transmitted, and the inter-band gap between the two does not have any cumulative basic limits applied.

q_39567.question: What should the controlling MCData function do upon receiving a request for cancellation of an emergency one-to-one communication using SDS session?
q_39567.ground_truth: The controlling MCData function should execute the procedure in clause~6.3.7.1.22.

q_39568.question: What is the minimum requirement for a test to be considered successful in the test?
q_39568.ground_truth: Both event detection and percentage of transmitted ACK/NACKs requirements have to be fulfilled simultaneously for a test to be considered successful.

q_39569.question: What must be satisfied for an MCPTT user information entry to be considered as the served MCPTT user information entry?
q_39569.ground_truth: The MCPTT user information entry must be in the list of MCPTT user information entries and the MCPTT ID of the entry must be equal to the served MCPTT ID.

q_39570.question: What value does the MCVideo server set the Expires header field to in the SIP PUBLISH request for an affiliation request?
q_39570.ground_truth: The MCVideo server sets the Expires header field to 4294967295 in the SIP PUBLISH request for an affiliation request.

q_39571.question: What message does the MME send to the eNodeB to deactivate all Radio Bearers associated with a PDN connection?
q_39571.ground_truth: The MME sends the Deactivate Bearer Request message to the eNodeB to release all Radio Bearers associated with the PDN connection.

q_39572.question: What should the User Equipment (UE) do with the MEASUREMENT REPORT message after setting the measuredResults in the procedure specified in clause 5.5.5.1?
q_39572.ground_truth: The UE submits the MEASUREMENT REPORT message to lower layers for transmission, upon which the procedure ends.

q_39573.question: What is the role of the CommonIEsAbort SlPP Information Element?
q_39573.ground_truth: The CommonIEsAbort SlPP Information Element is used to indicate the cause of an abort event, with the options being undefined and slppMessageHeaderError.

q_39574.question: What is the role of the UE in negotiating the use of extended idle mode DRX with the network?
q_39574.ground_truth: The UE includes an extended idle mode DRX parameters information element in the Registration Request message and may also include the UE specific DRX parameters information element for regular idle mode DRX.

q_39575.question: What should the AMF do when the UE does not respond to the NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message for the fourth time during network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure?
q_39575.ground_truth: The AMF should abort the network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure and consider it completed as a failure.

q_39576.question: What is the length of time that a UE must wait after a BWP-inactivity timer expires before starting a timer-based BWP switch?
q_39576.ground_truth: The UE must wait for a time duration TBWPswitchDelay, which starts from the beginning of DL slot n, where slot n is the first slot of a DL subframe immediately after the BWP-inactivity timer expires.

q_39577.question: As specified in 8.1, what radiated performance requirements limit the ability of the OTA AAS BS to correctly demodulate radiated signals?
q_39577.ground_truth: The demodulation requirements for an OTA AAS BS are limited to two OTA demodulation branches, and demodulation requirements are the same as those specified for single RAT UTRA operation in FDD, single RAT E-UTRA operation, and MSR operation.

q_39578.question: What direct link keepalive procedure action does the UE take when timer T4108 expires without any communication and the UE has initiated its own keepalive procedure on the secure direct link?
q_39578.ground_truth: The UE releases the secure direct link with the release reason #3 "Direct connection is not available any more".

q_39579.question: What are the three key end-to-end QoS metrics for an XR application?
q_39579.ground_truth: The three key end-to-end QoS metrics for an XR application are Delay, Packet loss rate, and Bit rate.

q_39580.question: What is the clock skew requirement for 3G, LTE, NR, or WLAN access in MTSI-based speech-only transmissions?
q_39580.ground_truth: The clock skew in send direction between the device under test and the reference client should be less than 50 PPM (in absolute value) in error-free conditions for 3G, LTE, NR, or WLAN access in MTSI-based speech-only transmissions.

q_39581.question: Who is the network entity that sends a request to the (H)GMLC for a location of the target UE?
q_39581.ground_truth: The LCS Client, the NF (e.g. NWDAF), or the AF (via NEF) can send a request to the (H)GMLC for a location of the target UE.

q_39582.question: What should the MS do if there are no accessible PLMNs in manual network selection mode?
q_39582.ground_truth: The MS should indicate "no service" to the user, wait until a new PLMN is available, and then repeat the procedure.

q_39583.question: Which requirements for FR2 are only applicable to FR2-1?
q_39583.ground_truth: The requirements for FR2 that are only applicable to FR2-1 include SFTD measurement requirements in clauses 9.2.5.4, 9.3.8, 10.1.21, CGI identification requirements in clause 9.11, Inter-band CA requirements in all corresponding clauses, and L1-RSRP measurements for a cell with different PCI from serving cell in clause 9.13.

q_39584.question: What information must the NF Service Consumer include in the POST request for I-SMF Context Transfer procedure?
q_39584.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer must include the SMF transfer indication, old SMF ID, and the identifier of the SM Context resource in old SMF in the POST request.

q_39585.question: What is the purpose of "Enhanced Cell ID" (E-CID) based positioning methods?
q_39585.ground_truth: E-CID based positioning methods use UE and/or NG-RAN radio resource related measurements to improve the UE location estimate in comparison to the Cell ID (CID) positioning method.

q_39586.question: What is tested in 8.2.2.4.5-2?
q_39586.ground_truth: The test in 8.2.2.4.5-2 verifies the minimum performance of closed-loop spatial multiplexing with 2 transmitter antennas superposed with simultaneous PDSCH interference.

q_39587.question: What is the minimum number of V2X data and SLSS transmissions that the V2X UE is allowed to drop or delay during T2 in the V2X Synchronization Reference Selection/Reselection test?
q_39587.ground_truth: The V2X UE is allowed to drop or delay no more than 6% of its V2X data and SLSS transmissions during T2.

q_39588.question: What action does the MME take when the timer expires after step 4 during the Serving GW relocation procedure?
q_39588.ground_truth: After the timer expires, the MME releases the bearer(s) in the old Serving GW by sending a Delete Session Request message, which tells the old Serving GW not to initiate a delete procedure towards the PDN GW. The old Serving GW acknowledges the message, and the MME includes any Secondary RAT usage data if the eNodeB had provided it during the procedure.

q_39589.question: What does ECS stand for in the context of 5.4.3.3.3?
q_39589.ground_truth: ECS stands for Edge Computing Service in the context of 5.4.3.3.3.

q_39590.question: What is the role of the LMF in Network assisted Sidelink Positioning?
q_39590.ground_truth: The LMF is responsible for triggering the Ranging/Sidelink positioning procedure, deriving the UE location estimation based on Ranging/Sidelink positioning and Uu positioning measurements, and providing the LCS location estimation of the UE to the GMLC.

q_39591.question: What is the purpose of the path switching procedure from the direct communication path over PC5 to the direct communication path over Uu?
q_39591.ground_truth: The purpose of this procedure is to enable a ProSe-enabled UE to switch the communication path from the direct communication path over PC5 to the direct communication path over Uu when the UE is communicating with another ProSe-enabled UE via the direct communication path over PC5.

q_39592.question: What does the PCF do when the RAN and the UPF have been requested to perform the measurement of QoS Monitoring parameters?
q_39592.ground_truth: The PCF requests the RAN and the UPF to perform the measurement of the QoS Monitoring parameters as needed and as defined in clause 5.8.2.18 of TS23.501.

q_39593.question: When does a UE not expect to detect, in a same PDCCH monitoring occasion, a DCI format with CRC scrambled by a SI-RNTI, RA-RNTI, MsgB-RNTI, TC-RNTI, P-RNTI, C-RNTI, CS-RNTI, MCS-RNTI, MCCH-RNTI, G-RNTI, G-CS-RNTI, or multicast-MCCH-RNTI and a DCI format with CRC scrambled by a SL-RNTI or SL-CS-RNTI for scheduling respective PDSCH reception and PSSCH transmission on a same serving cell?
q_39593.ground_truth: A UE does not expect to detect, in a same PDCCH monitoring occasion, a DCI format with CRC scrambled by a SI-RNTI, RA-RNTI, MsgB-RNTI, TC-RNTI, P-RNTI, C-RNTI, CS-RNTI, MCS-RNTI, MCCH-RNTI, G-RNTI, G-CS-RNTI, or multicast-MCCH-RNTI and a DCI format with CRC scrambled by a SL-RNTI or SL-CS-RNTI for scheduling respective PDSCH reception and PSSCH transmission on a same serving cell.

q_39594.question: What should the EATF do with the session when it receives a SIP INVITE request due to E-STN-DRVCC on the Target Access Leg and no source access leg exists?
q_39594.ground_truth: If the EATF receives a SIP INVITE request due to E-STN-DRVCC on the Target Access Leg and no source access leg exists, i.e. no dialog supporting a session with active speech media component exists, then the EATF shall send a SIP 480 (Temporarily Unavailable) response to reject the SIP INVITE request due to E-STN-DRVCC.

q_39595.question: What is the purpose of Solution #6: Handling C2 connection over PC5?
q_39595.ground_truth: Solution #6 aims to address KI#1 "Transport C2 communication over PC5 interface" by enabling UAV and UAV-C to communicate with each other via C2 connection over PC5. It provides C2 connection status information to the application layer, allowing the user to decide on the C2 communication method. The UAS layer, located between the application layer and the AS layer, is responsible for PC5 related operations.

q_39596.question: What is the purpose of <dfname> in the 8.45 +CCHO command?
q_39596.ground_truth: The <dfname> is used in the 8.45 +CCHO command to select the application in the currently selected UICC that the TE wants to communicate with using logical channels.

q_39597.question: What happens when in-order delivery is required for some QoS flows in the SN?
q_39597.ground_truth: The SN buffers the first packets received from the UE for a certain QoS flow until it receives an GTP-U end marker packet indicating that the MN has delivered all UL packets for that QoS flow.

q_39598.question: What is the relationship between e.i.r.p. and e.r.p. in terms of dB?
q_39598.ground_truth: There is a constant difference of 2,15 dB between e.i.r.p. and e.r.p.

q_39599.question: Which method retrieves an individual SM context resource from SMF, V-SMF for HR roaming scenario, or I-SMF?
q_39599.ground_truth: The "retrieve" custom operation is used to retrieve an individual SM context resource from SMF, V-SMF for HR roaming scenario, or I-SMF.

q_39600.question: What action should the MCPTT client take if an MCPTT user requests to upgrade the MCPTT group call to an in-progress emergency state and it is an unauthorized request for an MCPTT emergency call?
q_39600.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should indicate to the MCPTT user that they are not authorized to upgrade the MCPTT group call to an in-progress emergency state.

q_39601.question: What kind of positioning method uses a network of ground-based transmitters for calculating the UE's location?

q_39602.question: What should the floor participant interface toward the MCPTT client do when it receives a Floor Revoke message from the MCPTT floor participant with the first bit in the subtype of the Floor Revoke message set to '1'?
q_39602.ground_truth: The floor participant interface toward the MCPTT client should store an indication that a Floor Ack message to a Floor Revoke messages is expected.

q_39603.question: What is the uplink timing for the ACK corresponding to a detected MPDCCH indicating downlink SPS release for a BL/CE UE?
q_39603.ground_truth: The uplink timing for the ACK corresponding to a detected MPDCCH indicating downlink SPS release for a BL/CE UE is the same as the uplink timing for the HARQ-ACK corresponding to a detected PDSCH, as defined above in the specification.

q_39604.question: What must an MGCF/IM-MGW do in order to enable end-to-end rate adaptation between a Multimedia Telephony terminal and the CS terminal or IM-MGW?
q_39604.ground_truth: An MGCF/IM-MGW must negotiate the use of ECN with the Multimedia Telephony terminal, perform SDP ability to negotiate to ECN, and enable end-to-end rate adaptation between the Multimedia Telephony terminal and the CS terminal or IM-MGW by negotiating the use of ECN with the Multimedia Telephony terminal.

q_39605.question: How is the start of the SI-window determined for the concerned SI message in the schedulingInfoList?
q_39605.ground_truth: For the concerned SI message in the schedulingInfoList, the start of the SI-window is determined by first determining the number n corresponding to the order of entry in the list, then calculating the integer value x = (n-1) x w, where w is the si-WindowLength, and finally determining the slot a based on the radio frame SFN and T, where T is the si-Periodicity of the concerned SI message and N is the number of slots in a radio frame.

q_39606.question: What interfaces does the TNGF use to support QoS differentiation in the 5G-RG's PDU Session when IPsec is used between the TWAP and TNGF?
q_39606.ground_truth: The TNGF uses different SA (Security Associations) to carry flows of different QoS, and any upstream or downstream data is sent in one of the QoS flows based on the DSCP (Differentiated Services Code Point) markings.

q_39607.question: What should the UE use as the first ECCE index for transmission of a corresponding DCI assignment in MPDCCH-PRB-set when using localized transmission?
q_39607.ground_truth: The UE should use the lowest ECCE index used to construct the MPDCCH in the MPDCCH-PRB-set for transmission of the corresponding DCI assignment.

q_39608.question: Which signalling procedure does the MCE use to update MCCH information in the eNB?
q_39608.ground_truth: The MBMS Scheduling Information procedure enables the MCE to update MCCH information in the eNB whenever necessary.
