q_39609.question: What is the implication of the statement "The same QoS applies to all MBS service areas of a location dependent MBS Session"?
q_39609.ground_truth: The same Quality of Service (QoS) is provided for all MBS service areas of a location dependent MBS Session, ensuring consistent user experience across different locations.

q_39610.question: What is defined as the relative accuracy of RSRQ in inter-frequency case?
q_39610.ground_truth: The relative accuracy of RSRQ in inter-frequency case is defined as the RSRQ measured from one cell compared to the RSRQ measured from another cell on a different frequency.

q_39611.question: What entity is responsible for discovering and selecting SMF instances during 3GPP access and non-3GPP access for managing the PDU session?
q_39611.ground_truth: The SMF selection functionality in the AMF and SCP

q_39612.question: What is manual cross-certification in the context of NDS?
q_39612.ground_truth: Manual cross-certification refers to the mutual cross-certifications established directly between the CAs. The CAs need to have a certificate signed by the local CA for each security domain they wish to trust. This approach requires the management of several certificates locally, but it provides a flexible trust management.

q_39613.question: What is the role of a 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-UE relay UE in satisfying the end-to-end QoS requirement between two 5G ProSe layer-3 end UEs?
q_39613.ground_truth: A 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-UE relay UE satisfies the end-to-end QoS requirement between two 5G ProSe layer-3 end UEs by performing QoS control between the source and target end UEs and through the PC5 interface.

q_39614.question: What is the role of the MCC (Management Committee Chair) in relation to the specification rapporteur?
q_39614.ground_truth: The MCC, in cooperation with the specification rapporteur, is responsible for reviewing all CRs (Change Requests) to the specification prior to agreement in the Working Group. The MCC also oversees the technical quality of the specification and serves as a focal point for technical questions.

q_39615.question: What is the requirement for the PUCCH EVM measurement in steps 2.5 and 2.8?
q_39615.ground_truth: The PUCCH EVM derived in steps 2.5 and 2.8 shall not exceed 17.5 %.

q_39616.question: What is the purpose of the Power Headroom reporting procedure in NB-IoT?
q_39616.ground_truth: The Power Headroom reporting procedure is used to provide the serving eNB with information about the difference between the nominal UE maximum transmit power and the estimated power for UL-SCH transmission or SRS transmission per activated Serving Cell in NB-IoT. This information is important for managing uplink resources and maintaining the required power backoff due to power management.

q_39617.question: What should a UE be capable of in order to handle a relative receive timing difference in FDD inter-band NE-DC with overlapping DL bands, when it is not capable of asynchronous FDD-FDD NE-DC operation?
q_39617.ground_truth: The UE should be capable of synchronized operation.

q_39618.question: What is an ATSSS rule composed of, as defined in 3GPP TS 23.501?
q_39618.ground_truth: An ATSSS rule is composed of an ATSSS rule ID, an ATSSS rule operation, a precedence value of the ATSSS rule, a traffic descriptor matching a service data flow (SDF), and an access selection descriptor.

q_39619.question: What is the difference between Current Location and Last Known Location in Location Reporting Monitoring Event?
q_39619.ground_truth: Current Location is the real-time location of the UE, while Last Known Location is the most recently reported location of the UE.

q_39620.question: What is the test requirement for the UE to transmit a measurement report containing the cell global identifier of cell 2 within the time defined by the test, and the minimum number of ACK/NACKs the UE must detect during the test?
q_39620.ground_truth: The test requires the UE to transmit a measurement report containing the cell global identifier of cell 2 within 170 ms from the start of T3, and detect at least 80 ACK/NACKs from the start of T3 until 170 ms. A total of 90% successful tests are required with a 95% confidence level for the test to pass.

q_39621.question: What is the role of the AI/ML AF or NEF in 5G Core Network?
q_39621.ground_truth: The AI/ML AF or NEF finds the PDU session(s) serving the SUPI, DNN, S-NSSAI from UDM and the allocated IPv4 address or IPv6 prefix or both from the SMF. It stores the UE IP address or any other external UE IDs during the PDU session establishment to the UE. The AI/ML AF (or NEF) may correlate and store a mapping of the UE IP address (or any other external UE ID) and the SUPI retrieved (e.g. via UDM/SMF), using the IPv4 address or IPv6 prefix allocated by the SMF.

q_39622.question: In the context of EMC, what is the difference between "repeater type 1-C" and "repeater type 2-O"?
q_39622.ground_truth: Repeater type 1-C is a repeater that operates at FR1 with a requirement set consisting only of conducted requirements defined at individual antenna connectors. Repeater type 2-O, on the other hand, is a repeater that operates at FR2 with a requirement set consisting only of OTA requirements defined at the RIB (radiated interface b).

q_39623.question: What is the purpose of the discovery security materials and authorization tokens in the described procedure?
q_39623.ground_truth: The discovery security materials and authorization tokens are used to establish a secure communication between UEs and authorize their roles in the Ranging and Sidelink Positioning services.

q_39624.question: What should the AMF do if there is no full native 5G NAS security context available when processing a Registration Request message?
q_39624.ground_truth: The AMF should initiate a primary authentication run if there is no full native 5G NAS security context available.

q_39625.question: What is the function of BBIFF-C and BBIFF-U in the context of N9HR LI?
q_39625.ground_truth: BBIFF-C in N9HR architecture provides the BBIFF-C function, responsible for signalling, while BBIFF-U provides the BBIFF-U function, responsible for user plane related tasks in N9HR LI.

q_39626.question: What action should the eNB take if the CSG Membership Info IE in the UE CONTEXT MODIFICATION message does not contain the Cell Access Mode IE set to ``hybrid''?
q_39626.ground_truth: The MME shall trigger the UE Context Release procedure.

q_39627.question: What is the procedure called when the SMF takes the initiative to activate or deactivate the User Plane connection of a PDU session?
q_39627.ground_truth: Network Triggered Service Request or CN-initiated selective deactivation of the User Plane connection of a PDU session.

q_39628.question: What is the procedure for access availability reporting in the SMF when using the ATSSS Low Layer (ATSSS-LL), MPTCP or MPQUIC steering functionality?
q_39628.ground_truth: The SMF may request the UPF to report when it cannot send downlink GBR traffic over its on-going access, e.g. based on access availability and unavailability report from the UE, by provisioning an SRR with an Access Availability Control Information IE requesting the UPF to report when an access (3GPP or non-3GPP access) becomes available or unavailable.

q_39629.question: What XML element should be included if the session being transferred is not determined in subclause 12.7.2.1 and 12.7.2.1A?
q_39629.ground_truth: The XML element <currently-not-possible> should be included if the session being transferred is not determined in subclause 12.7.2.1 and 12.7.2.1A.

q_39630.question: When can the UE perform uplink transmission on a serving cell?
q_39630.ground_truth: The UE can perform uplink transmission on a serving cell when the timeAlignmentTimer associated with the TAG is running, except when the timeAlignmentTimer associated with the pTAG is not running.

q_39631.question: What is the minimum value of timer T that the MS can use for periodic attempts to obtain service in VPLMN when not registered for disaster roaming services?
q_39631.ground_truth: If the MS does not support any of EC-GSM-IoT, Category M1 or Category NB1, the minimum value of timer T is 6 multiplied by integer M minutes. If no value is stored in the SIM, the default value of M is equal to one. If the MS only supports any of EC-GSM-IoT, Category M1 or Category NB1, the minimum value of timer T is 2 hours. If no value for T is stored in the SIM, the default value is 72 hours.

q_39632.question: What should the MCPTT client do if the <notify-remote-user> element is set to "true" in the received SIP MESSAGE request for remotely initiated private call request for terminating client?
q_39632.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should indicate to the remote MCPTT user that a remotely initiated private call request to call the identified MCPTT user has been received.

q_39633.question: What is the format of the DRBsToBeModified-List-ModificationResponse-SNterminated sequence?
q_39633.ground_truth: The DRBsToBeModified-List-ModificationResponse-SNterminated sequence is a list of data elements that define the modified DRB information in a network. It contains information about the DRBs, including their ID, transport parameters, and RLC status.

q_39634.question: What is the implication for NF Service Producers when they register their profile in NRF for restricted Inter-slice access?
q_39634.ground_truth: They need to include a new information element, "allowedSnssaisPerSnssai", which specifies, for each NF-Service Consumer's S-NSSAI, the list of NF-Service Producer's S-NSSAIs it is allowed to access.

q_39635.question: What types of service links are supported in the NTN network?
q_39635.ground_truth: Three types of service links are supported: Earth-fixed, Quasi-Earth-fixed, and Earth-moving.

q_39636.question: How many time periods are there in the test scenario described in 6.3.1.7.4.2?
q_39636.ground_truth: The test scenario consists of five successive time periods, with time durations of T1, T2, T3, T4 and T5.

q_39637.question: What should a UE do when it receives a registration reject message with a specific 5GMM cause value over non-3GPP access and it is already registered over another access?
q_39637.ground_truth: The UE should enter the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE and may perform a registration attempt over the non-3GPP access if another access point for non-3GPP access is available.

q_39638.question: What information is transmitted through SCI format 2-B for the decoding of PSSCH, with HARQ operation when HARQ-ACK information includes only NACK, or when there is no feedback of HARQ-ACK information?
q_39638.ground_truth: The information transmitted by means of the SCI format 2-B includes HARQ process number, new data indicator, redundancy version, source ID, destination ID, HARQ feedback enabled/disabled indicator, and zone ID.

q_39639.question: What is the bandwidth required for the channel to be tested?
q_39639.ground_truth: The channel bandwidth to be tested is 10 MHz.

q_39640.question: What is the requirement for HTTP error handling as specified in clause 5.2.4?
q_39640.ground_truth: The requirement for HTTP error handling as specified in clause 5.2.4 is that HTTP/2 connection error and stream error shall be supported as specified in clause 5.4 of IETF RFC 9113. Guidelines for error responses to the invocation of APIs of NF services are specified in clause 4.8 of 3GPP TS 29.501, and API specific error responses are specified in the respective technical specifications.

q_39641.question: In what state is the floor control arbitration logic when no MCPTT user currently has permission to send media?
q_39641.ground_truth: The 'G: Floor Idle' state, where the floor control arbitration logic is waiting for a floor request or a queued floor request to be processed.

q_39642.question: Who decides whether to use SC-PTM or MBSFN for carrying the MBMS bearer over the air interface in MBSFN operation?
q_39642.ground_truth: The MCE decides whether to use SC-PTM or MBSFN for carrying the MBMS bearer over the air interface in MBSFN operation.

q_39643.question: What is the maximum number of interruptions allowed on a serving cell during MIB decoding time period TMIB when identifying CGI of an NR cell with autonomous gaps?

q_39644.question: What is required for the test described in 6.7.6.1.4 to pass?
q_39644.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the ratio of successful reported values in each test must be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

q_39645.question: What is the requirement for in-band emissions in intra-band non-contiguous CA?
q_39645.ground_truth: The IQ image requirement is defined with the applicable frequencies based on symmetry with respect to the carrier leakage frequency, but excluding any allocated RBs for intra-band non-contiguous CA.

q_39646.question: What are the mandatory elements that the <MCPTT-Group-Priority> element shall contain?
q_39646.ground_truth: The <MCPTT-Group-Priority> element shall contain an <MCPTT-Group-ID> element and a <group-priority-hierarchy> element.

q_39647.question: In the E-UTRAN initiated UE Context Modification procedure, what is the function of the Master eNodeB when adding an hybrid HeNB as the SeNodeB?
q_39647.ground_truth: The Master eNodeB sends UE Context Modification Indication message to the MME, including the CSG-ID and the CSG Membership Information of the SeNodeB.

q_39648.question: What are the requirements for frequency range 1 and frequency range 2 in receiver characteristics for bands operating on NR?
q_39648.ground_truth: The receiver characteristics for bands operating on NR are specified at the antenna connector(s) of the UE for frequency range 1 and over the air of the UE for frequency range 2. The requirements for frequency range 1 and frequency range 2 can be verified separately. For the carrier in frequency range 1, requirements can be verified with NR FR2 link disabled. For the carrier in frequency range 2, requirements can be verified in OTA mode with E-UTRA connecting to the network by OTA without calibration.

q_39649.question: What is the condition for the ConvergedCharging service to operate in decentralized unit determination in 5G charging?
q_39649.ground_truth: The ConvergedCharging service will operate in decentralized unit determination if the invocation of the Charging Data Request for start of service is done with a valid quota for the rating group. Otherwise, it will operate in centralized unit determination and rating.

q_39650.question: What two types of communications are supported in 5G VN group communication?
q_39650.ground_truth: One to one communication and one to many communication are supported in 5G VN group communication.

q_39651.question: How is the UE ID field and BEARER ID field determined for an SRAP Data PDU received from SL-RLC0 in U2N Relay UE?
q_39651.ground_truth: The UE ID field is determined based on the sl-L2IdentityRemote that matches the Layer-2 ID of the remote UE from which the SRAP Data PDU is received, and the BEARER ID field is determined as 0.

q_39652.question: What message MIME type should be included in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-transmission-request+xml message for each currently transmitting MCVideo client?

q_39653.question: What is the name of the complex type used for defining the geometry area in the "tGeographicalAreaChange" complex type?
q_39653.ground_truth: The name of the complex type used for defining the geometry area is "tSpecificAreaType".

q_39654.question: Which 3GPP specification outlines the SBA/SBI security functional requirements and related test cases for the UDM network product class?
q_39654.ground_truth: TS 33.117 covers the SBA/SBI security functional requirements and related test cases for the UDM network product class.

q_39655.question: Under what circumstances should the mobile station start to use the LLC NULL frame to perform cell updates?
q_39655.ground_truth: In A/Gb mode, if the ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message contains the Cell Notification information element.

q_39656.question: What should be the measurement reporting delay for Event A6 and Event A1?
q_39656.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay for both Event A6 and Event A1 should be less than 6402 ms from the beginning of time period T2.

q_39657.question: What does the RAT field value 51 represent in the 3GPP-RAT-Type sub-attribute?
q_39657.ground_truth: The RAT field value 51 represents NR, which is a Radio Access Technology.

q_39658.question: In what scenario will the UE not diagnose an error and further process the create request for a new mapped EPS bearer context?
q_39658.ground_truth: When the "Create new EPS bearer" operation is used and there is no existing mapped EPS bearer context with the same EPS bearer identity associated with any PDU session.

q_39659.question: What type of base station is BS type 1-C?
q_39659.ground_truth: BS type 1-C is an NR base station operating at FR1 with requirements set consisting only of conducted requirements defined at individual antenna connectors.

q_39660.question: What is the requirement for the average transmit power per PRB to be aligned across both assigned carriers in the reference subframe, in order for the UE to meet the requirements for transmission on both assigned component carriers?
q_39660.ground_truth: The UE must meet the requirements for all possible combinations of PUSCH and PUCCH transitions per component carrier, and for SRS transitions on each component carrier. It must also meet the requirements for RACH on the primary component carrier.

q_39661.question: What is the purpose of the "Retransmission flag" parameter?
q_39661.ground_truth: The "Retransmission flag" parameter indicates whether the NR PDCP PDU is a retransmission NR-U packet or not.

q_39662.question: What action does the network take when the attach request is rejected due to core network redirection for CIoT optimizations?
q_39662.ground_truth: The network sets the EMM cause value to #31 "Redirection to 5GCN required" and takes into account the UE's N1 mode capability, the 5GS CIoT network behavior supported by the UE, or the 5GS CIoT network behavior supported by the 5GCN to determine the rejection.

q_39663.question: Which TWIF message is sent to the SMS-SC to request the submission of a trigger to the UE?
q_39663.ground_truth: The NEF acts as an MTC-IWF and sends a Submit Trigger message to the SMS-SC as specified in clause~4.13.2.2.8.

q_39664.question: What must the UE do if it supports V2X communication over E-UTRAN-PC5 or NR-PC5?
q_39664.ground_truth: The UE should set the V2X PC5 bit to "V2X communication over E-UTRAN-PC5 supported" or the V2X NR-PC5 bit to "V2X communication over NR-PC5 supported" in the UE network capability IE of the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.

q_39665.question: What should the PCF do when deriving PCC Rules for non-MPS service and the Priority PDU connectivity service is invoked?
q_39665.ground_truth: The PCF should upgrade the ARP and/or change the 5QI of the PCC Rules to appropriate values for MPS.

q_39666.question: What are the compatibility and integration aspects of 5G with legacy communication systems in the energy infrastructure domain?
q_39666.ground_truth: 5G compatibility with legacy systems has been reduced compared to 2G through 4G. However, a 2G, 3G, or 4G system can still be operated simultaneously with the 5G system to maintain support for existing services. Realistically, MNO access to spectrum makes it suboptimal for operations to maintain diverse legacy access networks. Volt's equipment are subject to different decisions taken by various MNO's in the world regions where they operate.

q_39667.question: What are the rules for naming subclasses of the Link IOC?
q_39667.ground_truth: The subclass names of Link IOC shall have the form "Link<X><Y>" where <X> is a string that represents the IOC at one end of the association, and <Y> is a string that represents the IOC at the other end. The order of the two strings should be alphabetically before.

q_39668.question: In the mobile IAB-node RLF recovery procedure described in clause 8.17.4, what corresponds to the Recovery IAB-node?

q_39669.question: What security mechanism should the P-CSCF support, as specified in RFC 3329?

q_39670.question: What message should the UE send to the MME upon receiving a GUTI in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message?
q_39670.ground_truth: The UE shall return a TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message to the MME to acknowledge the received GUTI.

q_39671.question: What are the maximum measurement reporting delay allowed for periodically triggered measurement reporting, excluding L3 filtering, for INTRA UE category 0?
q_39671.ground_truth: The maximum measurement reporting delay allowed for periodically triggered measurement reporting, excluding L3 filtering, for INTRA UE category 0 is defined in clause 8.5.2.1.1.1.

q_39672.question: What are the entering and leaving conditions for event A3 in TS 36.331, clause 5.5.4.4?
q_39672.ground_truth: The entering condition for event A3 is fulfilled when Mn + Offn + Offs + Ocn + Ofn + Hys is greater than or equal to Ms + Ofs + Ocs. The leaving condition for event A3 is fulfilled when Mn + Offn + Offs + Ocn + Ofn + Hys is less than Ms + Ofs + Ocs - Off.

q_39673.question: What is the meaning of "shall" and "shall not" in the 3GPP technical documents?
q_39673.ground_truth: "Shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something, while "shall not" indicates a prohibition to do something.

q_39674.question: What is the procedure for the SMF to perform traffic routing for Application AI/ML traffic in the 5G network?
q_39674.ground_truth: The SMF performs traffic routing for Application AI/ML traffic based on analytics information from the NWDAF, and may change or add additional PSA UPF for the PDU Session for Application AI/ML traffic transmission.

q_39675.question: What is the maximum time UE can take for UE processing in handover?

q_39676.question: What is the action supported by the CDIV service?
q_39676.ground_truth: The action supported by the CDIV service is forwarding of calls.

q_39677.question: What is the role of the MC service server in the emergency alert cancel process?
q_39677.ground_truth: The MC service server acts as an intermediary between the MC service client and the IWF, sending and receiving emergency alert cancel requests and responses.

q_39678.question: What should the UE do upon receiving a valid ANDSF notification SMS in the push model of communication?
q_39678.ground_truth: The UE shall establish a secure data connection using the information received in the notification SMS, upon receiving a valid ANDSF notification SMS in the push model of communication.

q_39679.question: Why are the conducted and radiated requirements for tested separately?
q_39679.ground_truth: The conducted and radiated requirements are tested separately due to issues with combined testing of NR FR1 and E-UTRA in conducted mode with NR FR2 in radiated mode.

q_39680.question: What is the action taken when an UMD PDU is received and it falls outside of the reordering window?
q_39680.ground_truth: When an UMD PDU is received and it falls outside of the reordering window, the value of VR(UH) is updated to the received UMD PDU's SN + 1.

q_39681.question: How many non-consecutive DTX subframes are allowed during the hibernation period for inter-band CA UE?
q_39681.ground_truth: Up to 2 non-consecutive DTX subframes are allowed during the subframes (m+5) to (m+13) up to the end of T2 for inter-band CA UE.

q_39682.question: When should the "AuthENTICATIONsetlist" parameter be present in a request?
q_39682.ground_truth: It should be present when a set of one to five authentication vectors are transferred from the HLR to the VLR, from the HLR to the SGSN or IWF, or from the HLR to the BSF, if the outcome of the service was successful.

q_39683.question: What should an ePDG do when it receives a GTP error indication for a non-default bearer from a PGW?
q_39683.ground_truth: The ePDG should delete the bearer context and may notify the Operation and Maintenance network element.

q_39684.question: What should be adjusted to achieve the required SNR for the ACK transmissions in the test procedure?
q_39684.ground_truth: The equipment should be adjusted to achieve the required SNR for the ACK transmissions in the test procedure.

q_39685.question: What is required for a UE to request access to Restricted Local Operator Services (RLOS)?
q_39685.ground_truth: The UE requests access to RLOS during the attach procedure by setting the attach type to "EPS RLOS attach" in the ATTACH REQUEST message.

q_39686.question: What is the result of successful completion of the discoveree request procedure for restricted 5G ProSe direct discovery model B?
q_39686.ground_truth: As a result of successful completion of this procedure, the UE obtains one or more discovery query filters and applies them to the monitoring operation in the PC5 interface. The UE should include the ProSe response code in a PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message and pass the message to the lower layers for transmission over the PC5 interface when there is a match of the discovery query filter(s).

q_39687.question: What is the primary mechanism that can mislead CBM UEs in the context of beam management?
q_39687.ground_truth: The primary mechanism is band-specific beam tilt in the test setup.

q_39688.question: Which message is used to indicate the provision of resources for sidelink discovery announcement on the serving PLMN?

q_39689.question: What are some capabilities provided by MSGin5G Service to enhance message delivery?
q_39689.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Service provides MSGin5G Store and Forward, message delivery based on Messaging Topic, Message Aggregation, Message Segmentation and Reassembly, and usage of Network Capabilities including UE reachability status monitoring and MSGin5G device triggering to enhance message delivery.

q_39690.question: What is the type and presence level of the id-CriticalityDiagnostics field in the bearer context release complete message?
q_39690.ground_truth: The type of the id-CriticalityDiagnostics field in the bearer context release complete message is CriticalityDiagnostics and its presence level is optional.

q_39691.question: What is the conduced interface between the transceiver unit array and the composite antenna?

q_39692.question: What happens to the Multicast MBS session state when radio resources are established and Multicast MBS session data starts to be transmitted to the UE?
q_39692.ground_truth: The Multicast MBS session state transitions from Inactive state to Active state.

q_39693.question: When can the TSCTSF report accumulated usage to the NF service consumer for sponsored data connectivity?
q_39693.ground_truth: The TSCTSF shall report accumulated usage to the NF service consumer when the usage threshold has been reached or when the sponsored data connectivity is disabled.

q_39694.question: What is the test method for SUL with inter-band DL CA testing?
q_39694.ground_truth: The testing for SUL with inter-band DL CA is covered by test cases 7.6.2 and 7.6C.2.

q_39695.question: What should the HSS send to the SCEF if authorization for one or more events is granted or revoked?
q_39695.ground_truth: The HSS should send an RIR command to the SCEF with RIR-flags indicating that authorization has changed for one or more events, and the Supported-Monitoring-Events AVP should indicate the authorized or revoked authorization for each event.

q_39696.question: What should be ensured by the architecture enhancements for EDGEAPP so that it can be deployed independently from the ETSI MEC architecture?
q_39696.ground_truth: The EDGEAPP architecture should be able to remain as a standalone or complete system, which means it can be deployed independent of the ETSI MEC architecture.

q_39697.question: What should a UE do if timer T3396 is deactivated and the UE does not receive an ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message for the same APN from the network?
q_39697.ground_truth: The UE should not send another PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message until the UE is switched off or the USIM is removed.

q_39698.question: What is the purpose of the NAS-Identifier AVP in the AC-Request message format?
q_39698.ground_truth: The NAS-Identifier AVP identifies the NAS that sends the Accounting-Request message to the Diameter server.

q_39699.question: What is the procedure followed when a UE is moving from eMBMS to MBS?
q_39699.ground_truth: When moving to E-UTRAN/EPC, the UE initiates procedures as defined in TS~23.246 to receive MBMS service for the TMGI(s), and the NG-RAN removes the UE from the Multicast MBS session context(s) if it exists, or removes the whole multicast session context if the UE is the last one for the Multicast MBS session.

q_39700.question: What is the scenario when the MS sends the ATTACH REQUEST message with the T3324 value IE and requests a particular T3312 value to be allocated?
q_39700.ground_truth: When the MS includes the T3324 value IE and supports extended periodic timer value indicated in the MS network feature support IE.

q_39701.question: What should the NG-RAN do to a QoS Flow after a successful establishment or modification, if the currently fulfilled QoS matches one of the Alternative QoS Profiles?
q_39701.ground_truth: The NG-RAN should treat the QoS Flow in the same way as if it had sent a notification that the GFBR can no longer be guaranteed with a reference to that Alternative QoS Profile to the SMF.

q_39702.question: What should the UDM do if a DELETE request is received for a 5G-MBS-Group and the external group id does not exist?
q_39702.ground_truth: The UDM should return HTTP status code "404 Not Found" including additional error information in the response body.

q_39703.question: What is the meaning of "shall" and "shall not" in the context of normative provisions in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_39703.ground_truth: "Shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something, while "shall not" indicates an interdiction (prohibition) to do something.

q_39704.question: What action does a U2N Remote UE take when receiving an indirect path failure report from a U2N Relay UE?
q_39704.ground_truth: If the UE is L2 U2N Remote UE in RRC_CONNECTED, it initiates the indirect path failure information procedure to report indirect path failure.

q_39705.question: Which function supports exposure of analytics and capabilities in 5G networks?
q_39705.ground_truth: The Network Exposure Function (NEF) supports exposure of analytics, capabilities, and network events to third parties and Application Functions, and securely provides information from external applications to the 3GPP network.

q_39706.question: What is the required ProtocolIE for OverloadStart S1AP-PROTOCOL-IES?

q_39707.question: What should a participating MCData function do upon receiving a SIP INVITE request for a standalone SDS over media plane for terminating participating MCData function or a SIP INVITE request for SDS session for terminating participating MCData function, if there is a risk of congestion?
q_39707.ground_truth: The participating MCData function may reject the SIP INVITE request with a SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response and include a Retry-After header field.

q_39708.question: What is the factor to be used in the scaling factor for Rx beam sweeping when positioning frequency layer i is in FR2 and UE has 2 Rx branches?
q_39708.ground_truth: If positioning frequency layer i is in FR2 and UE has 2 Rx branches, then the scaling factor for Rx beam sweeping is 2.

q_39709.question: What should a participating MCPTT function do when it receives an RTP media packet that is not already sent over the MBMS subchannel?
q_39709.ground_truth: It should send the RTP media packet over the MBMS subchannel, restart timer T15 (Conversation), and remain in the 'M: A conversation is active' state.

q_39710.question: What is the role of the MC service server 1 in the ad-hoc group communication in 7.1.4?
q_39710.ground_truth: The MC service server 1 handles the ad-hoc group communication setup and release, achieves end-to-end security, introduces a new set of information flows for ad-hoc group communication, and proposes a mechanism for ad-hoc group communication setup with participants determined by the MC service server based on the criteria.

q_39711.question: What should the Transmission control Interface do when it stops sending transmission control messages in the 'Releasing' state?
q_39711.ground_truth: It should request the network media interface to stop sending RTP media packets towards the associated MCVideo client.

q_39712.question: What should the floor participant do upon expiry of timer T204 (Floor Queue Position request) when the value of the counter C204 (Floor Queue Position request) is equal to the value upper limit?
q_39712.ground_truth: The floor participant should reset the counter C204 (Floor Queue Position request) with a value of 1, start timer T230 (Inactivity), clear the stored SSRC of the current floor arbitrator, and enter the 'O: silence' state.

q_39713.question: What is the requirement for the UE to be considered successful in this test case?
q_39713.ground_truth: For the UE to be considered successful, both Event detection and percentage of transmitted ACK/NACKs requirements should be fulfilled simultaneously and the rate of correct events observed during repeated tests should be at least 90%.

q_39714.question: What protocol is used by the NF (Network Function) consumer to establish a single connection and multiplex requests towards different NF providers over a single QUIC connection in the SBI (Service-Based Interface) architecture?

q_39715.question: What is the difference between Wide Area and Local Area IAB-DU for IAB type 1-H?
q_39715.ground_truth: Wide Area IAB-DU for IAB type 1-H are characterized by requirements derived from Macro Cell scenarios with a minimum coupling loss of 70 dB, while Local Area IAB-DU are characterized by requirements derived from Pico Cell scenarios with a minimum coupling loss of 45 dB.

q_39716.question: What message does the SMF send to the UE in the case of IPv6 multi-homing to notify the availability of a new IP prefix @ PSA2?
q_39716.ground_truth: The SMF sends an IPv6 Router Advertisement message to the UE to notify the availability of a new IP prefix @ PSA2.

q_39717.question: What is the purpose of the Prose service(s) in UE-1 and UE-2 communication?
q_39717.ground_truth: The Prose service(s) enable UE-1 and UE-2 to communicate with each other, and its switching from one path to another is based on their proximity, path selection policy, availability, and signal strength.

q_39718.question: What should the MCVideo client do upon receiving a final SIP 2xx response to the SIP REFER request for a locally initiated ambient viewing call?
q_39718.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should interact with the media plane, and not provide any indication to the user that the call setup is in progress.

q_39719.question: What should be retained when interworking with non-IP based networks while interconnecting IMS-based networks?
q_39719.ground_truth: Existing, legacy charging principles should be retained.

q_39720.question: Which sublayer is included in the CM sublayer and provides common services to the entities of the Connection Management sublayer for both UMTS PS domain services and UMTS CS domain services supporting CS/PS mode of operation MSs?

q_39721.question: What should the UE provide to the network during attach procedure to support IP address preservation in case of interworking without N26?
q_39721.ground_truth: The UE should provide the indication that it supports Request Type flag "handover" for PDN connectivity request during the attach procedure.

q_39722.question: What is the MRFC responsible for in the Multimedia Resource Function?
q_39722.ground_truth: The Multimedia Resource Function Controller (MRFC) is responsible for controlling the media stream resources in the MRFP, interpreting information coming from an AS and S-CSCF and controlling MRFP accordingly, and generating CDRs.

q_39723.question: What action does the MCVideo server take if timer F expires for the SIP PUBLISH request sent for a (de)affiliation request?
q_39723.ground_truth: The MCVideo server removes each MCVideo group ID entry that meets the specified conditions.

q_39724.question: How can the UE determine the PLMN's or SNPN's maximum number of PDU sessions, if the 5GSM sublayer receives an indication that the 5GSM message was not forwarded?
q_39724.ground_truth: The UE can determine the PLMN's or SNPN's maximum number of PDU sessions by counting the number of active PDU sessions it has and associating it with the current PLMN or SNPN.

q_39725.question: What is the time difference between T1' and T2 in the context of 0 ms after T2?
q_39725.ground_truth: There is no specified time difference between T1' and T2 in the context of 0 ms after T2.

q_39726.question: What message does the gNB-CU send to the gNB-DU to release the UE context after receiving the UE CONTEXT RELEASE message from MeNB in the 5G Non-Standalone (NSA) network?
q_39726.ground_truth: The gNB-CU sends the UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND message to the gNB-DU to release the UE context.

q_39727.question: What is the length of the M-TMSI in bits?
q_39727.ground_truth: The M-TMSI is 32 bits in length.

q_39728.question: What is the operation mode of TDD in two different systems, where the conditions for synchronized operation are not met?

q_39729.question: What is the purpose of the spurious response test for EN-DC within FR1?
q_39729.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to verify the receiver's ability to receive a wanted aggregated signal on its assigned channel frequency without exceeding a given degradation due to the presence of an unwanted CW interfering signal.

q_39730.question: What is the procedure for reselecting BDT policies after a BDT warning notification?
q_39730.ground_truth: The procedure for reselecting BDT policies after a BDT warning notification consists of three steps: receiving the BDT warning notification, checking the new BDT policies, and informing the 3GPP network of the selected policy.

q_39731.question: What does the "RM.RegInitSuccNon3GPP.SNSSAI" represent in the measurement of the number of successful initial registrations via untrusted non-3GPP access?
q_39731.ground_truth: Each subcounter per S-NSSAI represents the number of successful initial registrations via untrusted non-3GPP access at the AMF.

q_39732.question: What is the action of the UE when the tracking area updating or tracking area updating and routing area updating procedures are completed successfully in both S1 mode and A/Gb or Iu mode, and ISR is activated?
q_39732.ground_truth: The UE shall maintain registration and related periodic update timers in both GMM and EMM.

q_39733.question: What are the relationships between different entities involved in charging in the 3GPP system?
q_39733.ground_truth: The entities involved in charging are Users, 3rd Party Service Providers, Other telecommunications operators, Other mobile operators, I-WLAN operators, IP backbone carriers, 3rd Party content & application suppliers, 3rd Party Portals, and the Internet. Each entity has a different type of charging relationship with the Mobile Network Operator.

q_39734.question: What is the ICSI value that must be included in the P-Preferred-Service header field for MCPTT client?
q_39734.ground_truth: The ICSI value "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcptt" must be included in the P-Preferred-Service header field for MCPTT client.

q_39735.question: What is the status code an ADRF shall respond with upon creating a new "Individual ADRF Data Store Record" resource?
q_39735.ground_truth: The ADRF shall respond with "201 Created".

q_39736.question: What technique does Nokia use to achieve a high RSIC capability of 110 to 120 dBc for self-interference mitigation in a medium range base station?
q_39736.ground_truth: Nokia uses a combination of spatial isolation, Tx beam nulling, frequency separation, and digital IC techniques to achieve a high RSIC capability.

q_39737.question: What are the two types of feedback information taken into account by AnLF to improve accuracy calculating?
q_39737.ground_truth: The two types of feedback information are from AnLF with accuracy checking capability and MTLF with accuracy checking capability.

q_39738.question: What parameter is used to indicate whether the required accuracy has been met in a mobile terminated periodic LDR?

q_39739.question: In what way does the AF provide GNSS assistance data to the UE via the LMF during a positioning session?
q_39739.ground_truth: After LMF gets the GNSS assistance data, it can send the assistance data to UE via the procedures described in clauses 6.14 or 6.11.1 during a positioning session.

q_39740.question: When must the mobile station (MS) set the TIN (temporary mobile station identity) to "GUTI" before initiating the routing area updating procedure?
q_39740.ground_truth: The mobile station must set the TIN to "GUTI" before initiating the routing area updating procedure in the following cases: (1) when inter-system change occurs from Iu mode to A/Gb mode or S1 mode, and the MS does not send a Routing Area Update Request message in A/Gb mode or a Tracking Area Update Request message in S1 mode before changing back to Iu mode, (2) when inter-system change occurs from S1 mode to Iu mode or A/Gb mode, and the MS receives an indication of "RRC connection failure" from lower layers due to lower layer failure in S1 mode, (3) when inter-system change occurs from S1 mode to A/Gb mode, and the TIN indicates "RAT-related TMSI", but the MS is required to perform routing area updating for IMS voice termination as specified in annex P.4, and (4) when inter-system change occurs from S1 mode to A/Gb mode via cell change order procedure not due to CS fallback, and the TIN indicates "RAT-related TMSI".

q_39741.question: What is the purpose of the "id-AMF-UE-NGAP-ID" in the "NGAP-PROTOCOL-IES" section?
q_39741.ground_truth: The "id-AMF-UE-NGAP-ID" is used to identify the AMF UE NGAP ID in the "NGAP-PROTOCOL-IES" section. It is of CRITICALITY reject and PRESENCE mandatory type.

q_39742.question: When is the UE not required to determine the SFN of the target PCell by acquiring system information from that cell before performing RACH access in the target PCell?
q_39742.ground_truth: The UE is not required to determine the SFN of the target PCell by acquiring system information from that cell before performing RACH access in the target PCell for BL UEs or UEs in CE when sameSFN-Indication is not present in mobilityControlInfo.

q_39743.question: Which elements of the document outline the minimum performance requirements for telephony and the test methods and considerations?
q_39743.ground_truth: The main body of the document specifies performance requirements for telephony, and TS 26.132 describes the test methods and considerations.

q_39744.question: What is the feature-capability indicator named g.3gpp.anbr used to indicate support of in the 3GPP network?

q_39745.question: What is the main difference between solutions #3.1 and #3.2 for UE PDU session charging procedure?
q_39745.ground_truth: The main difference is that solution #3.1 uses the same source for volume usage collection for both individual UE and aggregation, providing good accuracy and immediate stop capabilities by NS tenant CCS when NS volume crosses the limit. In contrast, solution #3.2 uses different sources for volume usage collection and lacks online charging control capabilities on actual usage.

q_39746.question: What is the role of the SEAL in the management of network slices and their related services?
q_39746.ground_truth: The SEAL supports the exposure of telco-provided services to the vertical/ASP, including 3GPP control plane services and 3GPP management domain services. It can be used to trigger dynamic slice-related actions and reduce complexity at the ASP side.

q_39747.question: What is the purpose of the procedure for releasing a chat group call on an interworking group defined in the MCPTT system?
q_39747.ground_truth: This procedure describes the case where the MCPTT server releases an ongoing MCPTT chat group call for all the participants of that group call in the MCPTT system.

q_39748.question: What is the name of the IE used by the target device to provide movement information to the location server called?

q_39749.question: What steps should the ME take if the alpha identifier provided by the UICC is a null data object, and an icon is provided as well?
q_39749.ground_truth: The ME should not give any information to the user on the fact that it is determining the location information for the UICC, and display the provided icon as indicated in the command.

q_39750.question: How are the measurement results in 3GPP TS 38.101-3 compared to test requirements?
q_39750.ground_truth: The measurement results returned by the test system are compared without any modification against the test requirements as defined by various levels of "Shared Risk" principle in 3GPP TS 38.101-3.

q_39751.question: What type of networks are Personal IoT Networks (PINs) typically consist of?
q_39751.ground_truth: PINs typically consist of a user smartphone, wearables, and home automation devices.

q_39752.question: What action takes place when the DHCP lease expires?
q_39752.ground_truth: When the DHCP lease expires, the associated PDU session is released.

q_39753.question: What is the procedure for negotiating a Planned Data Transfer with QoS requirements in the 5G Core network?
q_39753.ground_truth: The procedure for negotiating a Planned Data Transfer with QoS requirements in the 5G Core network involves the AF negotiating with the 5G Core for PDTQ policies, which the NEF then translates to the H-PCF for authorization of the creation of the policy. The H-PCF then queries the UDR for existing PDTQ policies and retrieves Network Performance analytics from the NWDAF. Based on this information, the H-PCF determines one or more PDTQ policies and sends them to the NEF, which then provides the policies to the AF.

q_39754.question: What does the TA mean in the SNPN-TAIBasedMDT context?
q_39754.ground_truth: The TA stands for Tracking Area, a geographical area covered by one or multiple NextG cell entities (sNPN) with one or multiple radios.

q_39755.question: What is the purpose of the receiver intermodulation test for BS type 1-C and BS type 1-H?
q_39755.ground_truth: The purpose of the receiver intermodulation test for BS type 1-C and BS type 1-H is to verify the ability of the BS receiver to inhibit the generation of intermodulation products in its non-linear elements caused by the presence of two high-level interfering signals at frequencies with a specific relationship to the frequency of the wanted signal.

q_39756.question: What must be the assigned source layer-2 ID for sending the direct discovery announcement?
q_39756.ground_truth: The UE must self-assign a source layer-2 ID for sending the direct discovery announcement, different from any other self-assigned source or provisioned destination layer-2 IDs.

q_39757.question: What should the UE do if there is any traffic for V2X sidelink communication requiring SPS assistance information to be reported?
q_39757.ground_truth: Include trafficPatternInfoListSL in the UEAssistanceInformation message.

q_39758.question: What is supported by the IBCF/TrGW for data channel media feature tag and data channel media description?
q_39758.ground_truth: The IBCF/TrGW supports data channel media feature tag and data channel media description at the II-NNI.

q_39759.question: Which HTTP method is used to terminate the indicated Network Assistance session in clause 12.2.6?
q_39759.ground_truth: The DELETE HTTP method is used to terminate the indicated Network Assistance session in clause 12.2.6.

q_39760.question: What is the significance of the one-to-one UserList in the MCData user profile MO?
q_39760.ground_truth: The one-to-one UserList is used to define the MCData user and their associated MCData user profiles, as well as their MCDataIDs, DiscoveryGroupIDs, and DeviceInfoBlock information. The DeviceInfoBlock information includes the MCDataIDKMSURI, DisplayName, IPInformation, and FileDistribution parameters.

q_39761.question: What HTTP method is used to read a group message delivery via MBMS by MB2 resource for a given SCS/AS, TMGI, and transactionId?
q_39761.ground_truth: The GET method is used for this purpose.

q_39762.question: In the context of 4.3.5.6-1, what does the establishment of PSA2 imply for PSA1?
q_39762.ground_truth: The establishment of PSA2 conditions the release of PSA1.

q_39763.question: What should the SMF do if the selected PDU session type is "IPv4", "IPv6", "IPv4v6" or "Ethernet" and the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message includes a 5GSM capability IE with the RQoS bit set to "Reflective QoS supported"?
q_39763.ground_truth: The SMF shall consider that reflective QoS is supported for QoS flows belonging to this PDU session and may include the RQ timer IE set to an RQ timer value in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message.

q_39764.question: When is the UE required to search for inter-frequency layers of higher priority at least every 1 hour, when Srxlev <= SnonIntraSearchP and Squal <= SnonIntraSearchQ?
q_39764.ground_truth: When Srxlev > SnonIntraSearchP and Squal > SnonIntraSearchQ, the UE shall search for inter-frequency layers of higher, equal or lower priority at least every 1 hour.

q_39765.question: What should not happen during T1 and T3 regarding the interruption of SCell during PSCell active BWP switch in terms of the BWP switch delay?
q_39765.ground_truth: The start of the interruption should not happen outside the BWP switch delay during T1 and T3.

q_39766.question: What timers shall the UE stop upon receipt of the PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message, if it had provided an S-NSSAI during the PDU session establishment but did not provide a DNN?
q_39766.ground_truth: The UE shall stop timer T3584 associated with the S-NSSAI and T3585 associated with no S-NSSAI.

q_39767.question: What should a UE (User Equipment) in EMM-DEREGISTERED state do with a running T3396 timer if it switches off and then on again, with the same USIM?
q_39767.ground_truth: The UE should restart the timer T3396 with the value t1 - t, where t1 is the time remaining for T3396 timeout at switch off and t is the time elapsed between switch off and switch on.

q_39768.question: What does Tprocessing represent in the equation for calculating the time interval for a frequency handover?
q_39768.ground_truth: Tprocessing represents the time for UE processing, and can be up to 20ms.

q_39769.question: What are the three parameters used to characterize jitter in order to assist the RAN in optimizing CDRX on-duration?
q_39769.ground_truth: Overall jitter range, local jitter average, and local jitter range.

q_39770.question: What should the UE do upon receiving the PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message if the Back-off timer value IE is not included and the UE provided a DNN during the PDU session establishment?
q_39770.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T3396 if it is running for the DNN provided by the UE.

q_39771.question: Which is the only OTDOA positioning method support in this version of specification?
q_39771.ground_truth: In this version of the specification, OTDOA based on LTE signals is the only OTDOA positioning method supported.

q_39772.question: What should the SCC AS do if more than one confirmed dialog supporting a session exists in the transferable session set and exactly one confirmed dialog supporting a session with an inactive speech media component exists?
q_39772.ground_truth: The SCC AS should select the confirmed dialog supporting a session with an inactive speech media component that became inactive most recently.

q_39773.question: Under what conditions would the controlling MCVideo function consider an MCVideo emergency group call request to be an authorized request?
q_39773.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function would consider an MCVideo emergency group call request to be an authorized request if the "entry-info" attribute of the <entry> element of the <MCVideoGroupInitiation> element of the <EmergencyCall> element within the <MCVideo-group-call> element of the MCVideo user profile document is set to "DedicatedGroup" or "UseCurrentlySelectedGroup", and if the <allow-MCVideo-emergency-call> element of the <list-service> element of the group document identified by the targeted MCVideo group identity is set to "true".

q_39774.question: What is the primary focus of the ACME protocol in validating identifiers for certificate issuance?
q_39774.ground_truth: The primary focus of the ACME protocol is to validate identifiers for certificate issuance, with a particular emphasis on validating domain names for the Web PKI.

q_39775.question: What is the name of the evaluation period and Layer 1 indication interval used in the non-DRX mode for the out-of-sync and in-sync evaluations of the PCell?
q_39775.ground_truth: The evaluation period and Layer 1 indication interval used in the non-DRX mode for the out-of-sync and in-sync evaluations of the PCell is specified in clause 4.2.1 of 3GPP TS 36.213.

q_39776.question: Which standard HTTP method is used for creating a new resource in the VAE HDMap Dynamic Info server?
q_39776.ground_truth: The POST method is used for creating a new resource.

q_39777.question: What is the implication of the "e2e" security model in IMS?
q_39777.ground_truth: The "e2e" security model in IMS implies that no IMS core network nodes will terminate IMS media security.

q_39778.question: When must the PDN GW change the requested PDN type to a single address type?
q_39778.ground_truth: If the PDN GW receives a request for PDN type IPv4v6, but the PDN GW operator preferences dictate usage of a single address PDN type, the PDN type shall be changed to a single address PDN type (IPv4 or IPv6) and a reason cause shall be returned to the UE.

q_39779.question: What must the participating MCVideo function do if the number of maximum simultaneous MCVideo group calls supported for the MCVideo user has been exceeded?
q_39779.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function shall respond with a SIP 486 (Busy Here) response with the warning text set to "103 maximum simultaneous MCVideo group calls reached" in a Warning header field as specified in clause 4.4.

q_39780.question: What should the UE do if it detects a cell on a NR carrier with a physical identity not allowed for that carrier in the measurement control system information of the serving cell?
q_39780.ground_truth: The UE is not required to perform measurements on a cell that is not allowed for a NR carrier in the measurement control system information of the serving cell.

q_39781.question: When will the AMF include a list of equivalent PLMNs in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message?
q_39781.ground_truth: The AMF of an SNPN will not include a list of equivalent PLMNs in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.

q_39782.question: What should an MTSI client in terminal do when it receives an ANBR message and a "Request max" message for its media sending direction?
q_39782.ground_truth: The MTSI client in terminal should use the minimum of the two values as the combined bitrate for those two adaptation triggers.

q_39783.question: In the specific message contents, what is the procedure if the UE has to transmit an RRCConnectionRequest message?
q_39783.ground_truth: The UE initiates transmission of the RRCConnectionRequest message in accordance with 5.3.3.3.

q_39784.question: What should the TWAG do upon expiry of the timer T3586 during a TWAG initiated PDN connectivity modification procedure?
q_39784.ground_truth: The TWAG should resend the PDN MODIFICATION REQUEST and reset/restart timer T3586, repeating this four times until the fifth expiry, when the TWAG aborts the procedure and enters the state PDN CONNECTION ESTABLISHED.

q_39785.question: What is the XCAP URI used by the MCData client to access the MCData user's MCData user profile documents?
q_39785.ground_truth: The XCAP URI used by the MCData client to access the MCData user's MCData user profile documents is: CMSXCAPROOTURI/org.3gpp.mcdata.user-profile/users/sip:MCDATAID/mcdata-user-profile-INDEX.xml where INDEX is the index of the MCData user profile as defined in clause~10.3.2.8.

q_39786.question: What is the role of the AMF in the Ranging/Sidelink positioning process?
q_39786.ground_truth: The AMF receives a Ranging/Sidelink positioning request from a UE or a GMLC or any 5GC NF, selects a serving LMF for UE1, sends the Ranging/Sidelink positioning request to the selected LMF, reports the Ranging/Sidelink positioning result to the AMF, and reports the Ranging/Sidelink positioning result to the application.

q_39787.question: What does the GTP-U Extension Header Deletion field indicate when present in the Outer Header Removal?
q_39787.ground_truth: The GTP-U Extension Header Deletion field, when present, provides instructions on the information to be deleted from the incoming GTP-PDU packet, indicating the bits to delete with a bitmask.

q_39788.question: What should the system do if the entering condition for event A1 is fulfilled during timeToTrigger for this event, and the VarMeasReportList does not include a measurement reporting entry for this measId?
q_39788.ground_truth: The system should include a measurement reporting entry within the VarMeasReportList for this measId, set the numberOfReportsSent to 0, and initiate the measurement reporting procedure as specified in 5.5.5.

q_39789.question: What is the purpose of the time domain measurement restriction pattern in the E-UTRAN FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync?
q_39789.ground_truth: The time domain measurement restriction pattern is used to perform serving cell measurements.

q_39790.question: What system determines whether a request has a target in a different system?
q_39790.ground_truth: The LMS in the MC system determines if the request has a target in the LMR system.

q_39791.question: What is the difference between 5GC Individual MBS traffic delivery and 5GC Shared MBS traffic delivery in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_39791.ground_truth: 5GC Individual MBS traffic delivery refers to the 5G CN receiving a single copy of MBS data packets and delivering separate copies of those MBS data packets to individual UEs via per-UE PDU sessions. 5GC Shared MBS traffic delivery, on the other hand, refers to the 5G CN receiving a single copy of MBS data packets and delivering a single copy of those MBS data packets to a RAN node.

q_39792.question: What is the task of S-CSCF#1 in the IMS session modification procedure after S-CSCF#3 forwards the INVITE message to P-CSCF#2?
q_39792.ground_truth: S-CSCF#1 forwards the SDP response from S-CSCF#2 to P-CSCF#1, and increases the QoS resource authorization, if needed, for the remaining media flows and codec choices.

q_39793.question: What is the role of the AF in providing security data for the NEF/MBSF?
q_39793.ground_truth: The AF generates the security data (MTK, MTK ID, MSK, MSK ID and selected algorithm(s)) and provides it to the NEF/MBSF for the MBS session ID.

q_39794.question: What services are applicable in A/Gb mode for mobile stations supporting Voice Group Call Service or Voice Broadcast Service?
q_39794.ground_truth: Voice Group Call Service and Voice Broadcast Service are applicable in A/Gb mode only.

q_39795.question: What is an "Authorised Identity" as defined in the document?
q_39795.ground_truth: An "Authorised Identity" is an application identity given to an authorized user or network entity, containing authorization information.

q_39796.question: What message does the source MME send to the source eNodeB to complete the preparation phase towards the source eNodeB in a handover?

q_39797.question: What information does the SL-MO-LR Response include in step 7, if UE1 requested position calculation assistance at step 3?
q_39797.ground_truth: The calculated UE locations obtained from step 6.

q_39798.question: Who is responsible for producing Security Assurance Specifications (SCASs) in the SECAM process?

q_39799.question: In what condition is the ePWS functionality for UEs with no user interface applied?
q_39799.ground_truth: This ePWS functionality is applied for UEs with no user interface if they are capable of identifying the characteristics of a disaster derived from the message identifier of a received warning message.

q_39800.question: What is the purpose of PFCP in the 3GPP specification?
q_39800.ground_truth: PFCP is used for the Packet Forwarding Control Protocol, which is the interface between the control plane and user plane function.

q_39801.question: What is the role of SMF in Step 2 of changing BP or UL CL and additional PSA for a PDU Session?
q_39801.ground_truth: The SMF establishes the local Target UPF (PSA3) for the PDU Session using N4.

q_39802.question: When should the sl-drx-HARQ-RTT-Timer be started if HARQ feedback is disabled by the SCI and the resource(s) for one or more retransmission opportunities is not scheduled in the SCI?
q_39802.ground_truth: Start the sl-drx-HARQ-RTT-Timer for the corresponding Sidelink process in the slot following the end of PSFCH resource.

q_39803.question: How should the eNB react if the supported encryption algorithms listed in the UE Security Capabilities IE do not match any allowed algorithms in the eNB?
q_39803.ground_truth: The eNB should reject the procedure using the INITIAL CONTEXT SETUP FAILURE message.

q_39804.question: What should the PCF provide if the "TargetNSSAI" feature is supported and a new Target NSSAI is generated in a PDU session with home routed roaming?
q_39804.ground_truth: The new generated Target NSSAI should be encoded in the "targetSnssais" attribute.

q_39805.question: What is the requirement for controlling the scheduling restrictions when a UE performs inter-RAT measurements on a different subcarrier spacing than PDSCH/PDCCH on FR1?
q_39805.ground_truth: The requirements are applicable for UE which does not support mix-numerology capability for scheduling restriction. The UE is not expected to transmit PUCCH/PUSCH/SRS or receive PDCCH/PDSCH/TRS/CSI-RS for CQI on all symbols within EMW duration. When intra-band carrier aggregation is performed, the scheduling restrictions due to a given serving cell also apply to all other serving cells in the same band on the symbols that fully or partially overlap with the restricted symbols.

q_39806.question: What is the purpose of the call flow in 5.10.2.1?
q_39806.ground_truth: The purpose of the call flow in 5.10.2.1 is to establish the delivery of 5GMS media data exclusively via eMBMS, and to specify the procedures for this use case.

q_39807.question: What is the time duration for dormant BWP switching when UE receives the dormancy indication in the first 3 OFDM symbols of a slot in the serving cell where DCI for dormancy indication is received?
q_39807.ground_truth: TdormantBWPswitchDelay =TBWPswitchDelay+ X, provided that the UE receives the dormancy indication within the first 3 OFDM symbols of a slot in the serving cell where DCI for dormancy indication is received.

q_39808.question: What is the performance requirement for interlaced PUCCH format 0 for ACK missed detection, measured by in terms of required SNR at what probability of detection?
q_39808.ground_truth: The performance requirement for interlaced PUCCH format 0 for ACK missed detection is measured by the required SNR at probability of detection equal to 0.99.

q_39809.question: What is the minimum number of occurrences for the "default-pqi" element?
q_39809.ground_truth: The minimum number of occurrences for the "default-pqi" element is 0.

q_39810.question: What action should a call control entity take upon receiving a STATUS message with cause value #30 "response to status enquiry"?
q_39810.ground_truth: The call control entity should stop timer T322 and take further appropriate actions based on the information in the STATUS message, relative to its current state.

q_39811.question: What action will the M-NG-RAN node take if the MR-DC Resource Coordination Information IE is contained in the MR-DC Resource Coordination Information IE in the S-NODE MODIFICATION REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message for the same UE?
q_39811.ground_truth: The M-NG-RAN node may use it for the purpose of resource coordination with the S-NG-RAN node. The M-NG-RAN node shall consider the value of the received UL Coordination Information IE valid until reception of a new update of the IE for the same UE. The M-NG-RAN node shall consider the value of the received DL Coordination Information IE valid until reception of a new update of the IE for the same UE.

q_39812.question: What is the maximum length of the array for the contextValueRange property for NfTypeContext?
q_39812.ground_truth: There is no maximum length for the array, but the array should contain one or more NFType values.

q_39813.question: What type of data does the Equipment-Status AVP contain regarding the status of mobile equipment?
q_39813.ground_truth: The Equipment-Status AVP is of type Enumerated, and shall contain the status of the mobile equipment with possible values as PERMITTEDLISTED, PROHIBITEDLISTED, and TRACKINGLISTED.

q_39814.question: What is the purpose of the CDIV Session Identifier URI in the Communications Diversion service?
q_39814.ground_truth: The CDIV Session Identifier URI is used to solve the service interaction of CDIV and ECT (Explicit Communication Transfer) by being created and inserted by a diverting AS that is routed through the same AS.

q_39815.question: What attribute of the "tuple" child element of the "presence" element indicates the MCPTT client ID?

q_39816.question: What is the function of the Sidelink Positioning and Ranging Function (SPRF) in the upper layer?
q_39816.ground_truth: The SPRF provides the services to create a Sidelink Positioning/Ranging session between a specified group of UEs, on-demand, periodic, or triggered Sidelink Positioning/Ranging of another UE or a specified group of UEs.

q_39817.question: What is the required UE measurement in the 2.9.5-1 test?
q_39817.ground_truth: The UE is required to read the neighbor cell SSB index and report the acquired SSB index in the 2.9.5-1 test.

q_39818.question: What is the additional requirement for BS operating in the same geographical area as UTRA TDD?
q_39818.ground_truth: The additional requirement for BS operating in the same geographical area as UTRA TDD is the BC3 blocking test requirement.

q_39819.question: What are the requirements for an AAS BS of Medium Range BS class operating in Band Category 1, in terms of the location where the requirements apply?
q_39819.ground_truth: The requirements apply outside the Base Station RF Bandwidth edges and inside any sub-block gap for non-contiguous spectrum. For an AAS BS of Medium Range BS class operating in multiple bands, the requirements apply inside any Inter RF Bandwidth gap.

q_39820.question: What is the measurement that provides the number of PFD creation requests received by the NEF from AF?

q_39821.question: What message is sent by the eNB to the WT in response to a successful WT release?

q_39822.question: Which information element in PathSwitchRequestAcknowledge message is mandatory and indicates the identifier of the AMF or RAN?

q_39823.question: What is the role of the 3GPP TS 33.501 standard in the use of TLS certificates in 5G SBA?
q_39823.ground_truth: The 3GPP TS 33.501 standard defines the requirements for the use of TLS certificates in 5G SBA for authentication of network functions. It specifies the compliance criteria for TLS client and server certificate profiles.

q_39824.question: What is the purpose of the ExpectationFulfilmentResult dataType?
q_39824.ground_truth: The ExpectationFulfilmentResult dataType includes the expectationFulfilmentInfo and targetFulfilmentResults for each IntentExpectation. The expectationFulfilmentInfo describes the status of fulfilment of an intentExpectation and the related reasons for the infeasible status.

q_39825.question: What is the difference between the use of "shall" and "must" in 3GPP documents?
q_39825.ground_truth: In 3GPP documents, "shall" is used to indicate a mandatory requirement, while "must" is typically used only in direct citations from external documents or to maintain continuity of style when extending or modifying such documents.

q_39826.question: Which service operations are supported by the Nnef_Authentication service?
q_39826.ground_truth: The Nnef_Authentication service supports two service operations: AuthenticateAuthorize and Notification.

q_39827.question: What should the mobile station do if it responds to a SETUP message with a RELEASE COMPLETE message?
q_39827.ground_truth: If the mobile station responds to a SETUP message with a RELEASE COMPLETE message, it shall release the MM connection and enter the "null" state after sending the RELEASE COMPLETE message.

q_39828.question: What is the formula used to calculate the total layer 2 buffer size for DL/UL in MR-DC?
q_39828.ground_truth: The total layer 2 buffer size is defined as the sum of the number of bytes that the UE is capable of storing in the RLC transmission windows, RLC reception and reassembly windows, and also in PDCP reordering windows for all radio bearers. The required total layer 2 buffer size in MR-DC is the maximum value of the calculated values based on the given formulas.

q_39829.question: Which option tag does the MCVideo client include in the SIP INVITE request for adhoc group call setup using on-demand session?
q_39829.ground_truth: The "timer" option tag is included in the Supported header field of the SIP INVITE request.

q_39830.question: What should be the initial conditions for testing the requirement specified in 6.2D.3.4?
q_39830.ground_truth: Initial conditions consist of environmental conditions, test frequencies, and channel bandwidths based on NR operating bands. These conditions should be tested with applicable test parameters for each channel bandwidth and subcarrier spacing.

q_39831.question: What is the minimum and maximum length of the "Extended rejected NSSAI" information element?
q_39831.ground_truth: The Extended rejected NSSAI information element has a minimum length of 5 octets and a maximum length of 90 octets.

q_39832.question: How is the total number of reported non-zero amplitude coefficients encoded in Enhanced Type II CSI feedback?
q_39832.ground_truth: The total number of reported non-zero amplitude coefficients across layers in Enhanced Type II CSI feedback is encoded separately in Part 1.

q_39833.question: When should a UE initiate the RRC connection establishment/ resume/ re-establishment procedure for all access causes in the context of NB-IoT UE connected to 5GC?
q_39833.ground_truth: A UE should not initiate the RRC connection establishment/ resume/ re-establishment procedure for all access causes until it has acquired the SystemInformationBlockType14-NB.

q_39834.question: What is the role of NEF and the NWDAF in providing the estimated QoS for the XRM stream?
q_39834.ground_truth: The NEF is responsible for forwarding the received new QoS parameter Requested AW from the AF to the NWDAF for the XRM stream. The NWDAF is responsible for predicting the estimated QoS based on the collected information and performing the judgement whether the trigger conditions are met.

q_39835.question: What is the purpose of the STa Re-Authentication procedure in the 3GPP AAA Proxy?
q_39835.ground_truth: The STa Re-Authentication procedure in the 3GPP AAA Proxy is used for re-authenticating the user, and may be initiated at any time by the 3GPP AAA Server based on HPLMN operator policies.

q_39836.question: In the context of FDD mode, what does the acronym "CPICH" stand for?
q_39836.ground_truth: CPICH stands for Common Pilot Channel. It is a type of channel used in wireless communication systems, specifically for FDD mode.

q_39837.question: What should the UE do after storing the UE radio capability ID if the UE receives an ATTACH ACCEPT message with a UE radio capability ID in WB-S1 mode?
q_39837.ground_truth: The UE should initiate a tracking area updating procedure as specified in subclause 5.5.3 after deleting any network-assigned UE radio capability IDs associated with the registered PLMN stored at the UE.

q_39838.question: What specific test requirements must be met for the RSRP TDD absolute accuracy test to pass?
q_39838.ground_truth: The test to pass, the ratio of successful reported values in each test shall be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

q_39839.question: What should the SLM server do upon receiving a CoAP GET request where the CoAP URI identifies a deregistration?
q_39839.ground_truth: The SLM server should determine the identity of the sender of the CoAP GET request, and if authorized, it should generate a CoAP 2.04 (Changed) response and send it towards the SLM-C.

q_39840.question: What is the difference between "Intra-band contiguous carrier aggregation" and "Intra-band non-contiguous carrier aggregation"?
q_39840.ground_truth: Intra-band contiguous carrier aggregation refers to contiguous NR or E-UTRA carriers aggregated in the same operating band, while Intra-band non-contiguous carrier aggregation refers to non-contiguous NR or E-UTRA carriers aggregated in the same operating band.

q_39841.question: How can an NF consumer determine specific QUIC versions supported by a QUIC-supporting NF instance using the NFR service discovery?
q_39841.ground_truth: To determine specific QUIC versions supported by a QUIC-supporting NF instance, the NFProfile would need to enumerate all the supported QUIC versions, or rely on the built-in version negotiation mechanism in QUIC to avoid interoperability issues.

q_39842.question: What indicates the category of an application in the ME file system?
q_39842.ground_truth: The ACDC category in the ME file system indicates the category of an application.

q_39843.question: What should the MCVideo client set the stored last call type change time to upon setting the stored current call type to "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL" in the "T0: waiting for the call to establish" state?

q_39844.question: What is the definition of "Type 1 DL channel access procedures" in the present document?
q_39844.ground_truth: Type 1 DL channel access procedures describe channel access procedures performed by an eNB/gNB, where the time duration spanned by the sensing slots that are sensed to be idle before a downlink transmission is random. This clause is applicable to transmission(s) initiated by an eNB or gNB, including PDSCH/PDCCH/EPDCCH.

q_39845.question: What are the benefits of using LP-WUS/WUR to trigger UE MR paging monitoring compared with existing I-DRX operation?
q_39845.ground_truth: The benefits of using LP-WUS/WUR to trigger UE MR paging monitoring compared with existing I-DRX operation include significant UE power saving gain and lower relative power consumption of LP-WUR ON for LP-WUS monitoring.

q_39846.question: When should the initiating UE not select the null integrity protection algorithm during the PC5 unicast link security mode control procedure?
q_39846.ground_truth: The initiating UE shall not select the null integrity protection algorithm during the PC5 unicast link security mode control procedure if the integrity protection algorithm currently in use is different from the null integrity protection algorithm or if the initiating UE or the target UE's PC5 unicast signalling integrity protection policy is set to "signalling integrity protection required."

q_39847.question: What is the mode in which the detailed design should be determined based on physical layer design/restriction?

q_39848.question: What should the NG-RAN node include in the NG RESET ACKNOWLEDGE message for each UE association to be reset, if the RAN UE NGAP ID IE is included in the corresponding UE-associated Logical NG-connection Item IE in the NG RESET message?
q_39848.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node should include the RAN UE NGAP ID IE in the corresponding UE-associated Logical NG-connection Item IE in the NG RESET ACKNOWLEDGE message.

q_39849.question: What is the measurement reporting delay requirement for the UE to send a MeasurementReport message in the test procedure?
q_39849.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay requirement for the UE to send a MeasurementReport message is less than (3+L)*40 + 2 ms from the beginning of time period T2.

q_39850.question: What is the logical definition of "panel" focus on its behavior rather than physical implementation?
q_39850.ground_truth: A panel is defined as a group of antenna elements that control beams independently, where each panel can select one beam for DL reception, and multiple panels (each selecting one beam per panel) can be used for DL reception simultaneously, assuming a beam is a spatial filter associated with reception, and a physical panel with dual polarization is considered as two "panels."

q_39851.question: What SSL/TLS flag is used in the HTTP GET (upgrade) request for establishing a WebSocket connection?
q_39851.ground_truth: The SSL/TLS flag used in the HTTP GET (upgrade) request for establishing a WebSocket connection is "Sec-WebSocket".

q_39852.question: What is the purpose of the T1, T2, and T3 time durations in the test procedure described?
q_39852.ground_truth: The purpose of T1, T2, and T3 are time intervals for which the UE must transmit uplink signals during specific conditions. T1 and T2 focus on the PCell, while T3 concentrates on the PSCell. They are used to verify the proper detection of out-of-sync and in-sync states for monitoring downlink radio link quality in a dual connectivity scenario.

q_39853.question: What should the eNB do if it receives an E-RAB RELEASE COMMAND message containing some E-RAB ID IEs that it does not recognize?
q_39853.ground_truth: The eNB should report the corresponding invalid E-RABs as failed in the E-RAB RELEASE RESPONSE message with the appropriate cause value, e.g., "Unknown E-RAB ID".

q_39854.question: What are the limitations of the protocol of solution #1 in terms of analysis and comparison with other solutions?
q_39854.ground_truth: The protocol of solution #1 does not have details for analysis, making it difficult to compare it with other solutions such as OMA ULP in solution #2, 'secure user plane' in solution #3, and 'User Plane Transfer of Event Reports' in solution #19.

q_39855.question: When do the AMFRANHandoverCommand and AMFRANHandoverRequest records get generated by the IRI-POI in the AMF?
q_39855.ground_truth: The AMFRANHandoverCommand is generated when the AMF sends a HANDOVER COMMAND message to the source RAN node in response to a HANDOVER REQUIRED message, and the AMFRANHandoverRequest is generated when the AMF receives a HANDOVER REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message from the target RAN node for the target UE.

q_39856.question: What are the two potential security requirements to prevent malicious entities from accessing a slice they are not authorized to access or requesting a service from a slice which they are not authorized to access?
