q_40098.ground_truth: The MCData client ID is a globally unique identification of a specific MCData client instance and is a UUID URN as specified in IETF RFC 4122.

q_40099.question: What action should the NG-RAN node take if the NAS-PDU IE is received for the PDU session and none of the requests included in the PDU Session Resource Modify Request Transfer IE are successful?
q_40099.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node should not pass the NAS-PDU IE to the UE.

q_40100.question: What is the name of the simpleType named "tac-baseType" which is restricted to an 8 digit decimal number?

q_40101.question: What is the role of the I-CSCF in handling a SIP URI representing a telephone number contained in a Request-URI?
q_40101.ground_truth: The I-CSCF translates the SIP URI representing a telephone number contained in a Request-URI into the Tel:~URI format prior to an HSS Location Query.

q_40102.question: What is the criterion used for ranking cells in reselection, as defined in TS 36.304, clause 5.2.4.6?
q_40102.ground_truth: The criterion for ranking cells in reselection is Rs for serving cell and Rn for neighboring cells, with R = Qmeas,n - Qmeas,s where Qmeas,n and Qmeas,s are derived using averaged RSRP results.

q_40103.question: What should a UE do if it experiences a transmission failure of the REGISTRATION COMPLETE message indication from lower layers during initial registration?
q_40103.ground_truth: It is up to the UE implementation how to re-run the ongoing procedure.

q_40104.question: What is the role of the ranging/SL application server in the described authorization process?
q_40104.ground_truth: The ranging/SL application server provides the SL broadcast receiving authorization response to the serving SLPKMF of UE-x.

q_40105.question: What entity provides the Member UE selection functionality to assist the AF in selecting member UEs for application operations such as AI/ML based applications?
q_40105.ground_truth: The Member UE selection functionality is provided by the Network Exposure Function (NEF).

q_40106.question: What information should the UE include in the VarRLF-Report when it considers radio link failure to be detected for the MCG?
q_40106.ground_truth: The UE should include the plmn-IdentityList set to include the list of EPLMNs stored by the UE (i.e. includes the RPLMN), measResultLastServCell to include the RSRP and RSRQ, if available, of the PCell based on measurements collected up to the moment the UE detected radio link failure, measResultNeighCells to include the best measured cells, and the optional fields that are available, such as logMeasResultListWLAN, logMeasResultListBT, locationInfo and failedPCellId.

q_40107.question: In the context of 3GPP technical specifications, what does "NF" stand for?

q_40108.question: What is the role of the I-UPF in a Xn based inter NG-RAN handover with re-allocation of intermediate UPF?
q_40108.ground_truth: The I-UPF is a new intermediate UPF that is changed during a Xn based inter NG-RAN handover and is typically re-allocated when changing the AMF in the handover procedure.

q_40109.question: What is not allowed when it comes to CRL issuance for NDS/AF compliant SEGs and NEs?
q_40109.ground_truth: Delta CRLs are not allowed due to possible interoperability problems and because the full CRL is not expected to grow too large.

q_40110.question: What is the importance of the SIM/USIM interface in enhancing functionality split and modularity inside the user equipment?
q_40110.ground_truth: The SIM/USIM interface is important as it allows for split and modularity inside the user equipment, which can enhance functionality, improve user experience, and enable support for various teleservices, multimedia services, and applications.

q_40111.question: What is the minimum length of the calling party BCD number information element in the network to mobile station direction?
q_40111.ground_truth: The minimum length of the calling party BCD number information element is 3 octets in the network to mobile station direction.

q_40112.question: What should the RAN do if there are still POs remaining in the PTW when sending the N2 message in step 3 of the procedure for handling UE mobility outside the RNA?
q_40112.ground_truth: To make efficient use of the procedure, the RAN should send the N2 message while there are still POs remaining in the PTW.

q_40113.question: What should be included in the request body when updating an Individual Policy using the HTTP PUT method?
q_40113.ground_truth: The updated representation of the Individual Policy resource within the Policy data structure should be included in the request body when updating an Individual Policy using the HTTP PUT method.

q_40114.question: What should the SMF ensure for reporting over different triggers?
q_40114.ground_truth: The SMF should ensure that the multiple granularity levels required by the reporting keys in the Usage Reporting rules satisfy PDU Session level reporting and Traffic flow level reporting without requiring a knowledge of the granularity levels by the UPF.

q_40115.question: What method in the NEF enables an AF to request the update of an existing Individual MBS Parameters Provisioning resource at the NEF?
q_40115.ground_truth: The PUT method in the NEF enables an AF to request the update of an existing Individual MBS Parameters Provisioning resource at the NEF.

q_40116.question: What message is sent by the F1-terminating IAB-donor-CU to the boundary node to update it with UL BH information for offloading traffic?
q_40116.ground_truth: The F1-terminating IAB-donor-CU sends a message to the boundary node to update it with UL BH information received from the non-F1-terminating IAB-donor-CU. This message may also update UL FTEID and DL FTEID associated with individual GTP-tunnels.

q_40117.question: What is the definition of the measurement reporting delay for the E-UTRAN FDD-FDD event triggered reporting for serving cell under fading propagation conditions test?
q_40117.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay is defined as the time from the beginning of time period T2 to the moment when the UE sends the measurement report on PUSCH or starts to send preambles on the PRACH for scheduling request (SR) to obtain allocation to send the measurement report on PUSCH.

q_40118.question: What should the target UE include in a DIRECT LINK SECURITY MODE REJECT message if the selected security algorithms in the DIRECT LINK SECURITY MODE COMMAND message include the null integrity protection algorithm and the target UE's PC5 unicast signalling integrity protection policy is set to "signalling integrity protection required"?
q_40118.ground_truth: The target UE shall include PC5 signalling protocol cause #10 "UE PC5 unicast signalling security policy mismatch" in the DIRECT LINK SECURITY MODE REJECT message.

q_40119.question: What should be done with the band combinations for which the number of CCs in DL exceeds the value indicated in the requestedMaxCCsDL or for which the number of CCs in UL exceeds the value indicated in the requestedMaxCCsUL?
q_40119.ground_truth: These band combinations should be removed from the list of candidates in the UECapabilityInformation message.

q_40120.question: What is the name of the list that contains reference signals and their associated Random Access parameters for recovery?

q_40121.question: What action does the NEF take upon successful reception of an authorized request to retrieve UE Address(es) from the SMF?
q_40121.ground_truth: Upon successful reception of an authorized request to retrieve UE Address(es) from the SMF, the NEF responds to the AF with an HTTP "200 OK" status code and the response body including the SMF allocated UE Address information within the UeAddressInfo data structure.

q_40122.question: What actions should the MB-SMF take when there are failures in modifying currently active MBS PCC rules?
q_40122.ground_truth: The MB-SMF should retain the targeted existing MBS PCC rules active in their current version and report the modification failure to the PCF when modifications to currently active MBS PCC rules fail.

q_40123.question: What sends a session-oriented service termination notification to the V2X application-specific server when the V2X application specific server has triggered the termination?

q_40124.question: What action should the SS take if there is a pending DL transmission with timing info "now" when it receives an E indicating a HARQ NACK for a DL transmission in search space cycle N?
q_40124.ground_truth: The SS should postpone the DL transmission.

q_40125.question: What is the duration for which the SS waits for random access requests information from the UE during the test procedure?
q_40125.ground_truth: The SS waits for random access requests information from the UE during time duration T2 within 70 seconds from the beginning of time period T2.

q_40126.question: Which message serves as the initial message for rRCTransfer?

q_40127.question: Which security protocol does QUIC use for key establishment, and how does QUIC overcome the drawback of network performance monitoring being made impossible by encryption?
q_40127.ground_truth: QUIC uses TLS 1.3 for key establishment and integrates it as its own encryption and integrity layer to protect QUIC packets. QUIC overcomes the drawback of network performance monitoring being made impossible by encryption by introducing a latency spin bit in the short header, which allows middleboxes to measure round-trip time between the middlebox and either endpoint of the connection if enabled by both end-points. However, it cannot support message tracing by content inspection for testing, monitoring, and troubleshooting related scenarios.

q_40128.question: What is the requirement for the UE behavior during time duration T3 in the testing procedure for CSI-RS based beam failure detection and link recovery in non-DRX?
q_40128.ground_truth: During T3, the UE shall detect beam failure and initiate link recovery in the non-DRX testing procedure for CSI-RS based beam failure detection and link recovery.

q_40129.question: What is the effect of including an "iotl" SIP URI parameter in the Path header field upon receiving a 200 (OK) response to the REGISTER request?
q_40129.ground_truth: The "iotl" SIP URI parameter is appended to the IBCF's own SIP URI in the Path header field, and this indicates that the IBCF supports indicating the traffic leg associated with a URI.

q_40130.question: What is the total time for detecting and measuring at least n cells as given in 8.16.2.3.2?
q_40130.ground_truth: The total time for detecting and measuring at least n cells is given in 8.16.2.3.2 as + TMIB ms.

q_40131.question: What should the MME do when it receives a GTPv2 Delete PDN Connection Set Request message from an SGW?
q_40131.ground_truth: The MME shall retrieve all the PDN connections corresponding to each of the FQ-CSID(s) present in the message and delete all the retrieved PDN connections and their associated resources.

q_40132.question: What should the network do if the RRC connection has been resumed when in EMM-IDLE mode with suspend indication?
q_40132.ground_truth: The network shall enter EMM-CONNECTED mode, and if the pending NAS message is one of the certain types, the message shall not be sent, otherwise, the UE shall send the pending initial NAS message upon entering EMM-CONNECTED mode.

q_40133.question: Where are the UE policies for V2X communication over PC5 defined?
q_40133.ground_truth: The UE policies for V2X communication over PC5 are defined in clause 5.2.3 of 3GPP TS 24.587.

q_40134.question: What should the MME do if the linked EPS bearer identity included in the PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST message does not belong to the default EPS bearer context of an established PDN connection?
q_40134.ground_truth: The MME shall reply with a PDN DISCONNECT REJECT message with ESM cause #43.

q_40135.question: What command is used in the Local Key Establishment Control TLV to indicate the security context mode in the MBMS and LTE-WLAN Xhaul procedure?
q_40135.ground_truth: The Local Key Establishment Control TLV is included in the command data to indicate the security context mode in the MBMS and LTE-WLAN Xhaul procedure. It is included in both command data and response data to indicate the operation status.

q_40136.question: What will the MDMS do when the user's remaining electricity is exhausted?
q_40136.ground_truth: The MDMS will issue a trip command and the smart meter needs to implement the trip action within 200ms.

q_40137.question: What is the maximum size limit of NAS messages allowed in NG-RAN (PDCP layer)?
q_40137.ground_truth: The maximum size limit of NAS messages allowed in NG-RAN (PDCP layer) is determined by the limitation in NG-RAN (PDCP layer).

q_40138.question: How many digits are there in the MCC of the 3GPP MCC-MNC?

q_40139.question: What action should the controlling MCPTT function take if the requested group ID for the regroup removal does not exist?
q_40139.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function should reject the request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response with warning text "163 the group identity indicated in the request does not exist".

q_40140.question: How should the UE release active user-plane resources if it decides to do so for upper layer requests?
q_40140.ground_truth: The UE should release the PDU session via explicit 5GSM signalling.

q_40141.question: What is the role of the sending part in content delivery modelling?
q_40141.ground_truth: The sending part of the content delivery can be modeled by several parameters, such as the maximum transfer unit, bitrate restrictions, retransmissions, and forward error correction, which determine how the application data unit is segmented and sent in multiple packets.

q_40142.question: What does the KPI "UTSNSI" measure in the context of 5G networks?
q_40142.ground_truth: The upstream throughput of a single network slice, obtained by measuring the total number of upstream octets provided by the N3 interface from NG-RAN to all UPFs, related to the single network slice, divided by the granularity period.

q_40143.question: When is the Broadcast Empty Area List IE included in the STOP-WARNING-INDICATION-NG-RAN message?
q_40143.ground_truth: The Broadcast Empty Area List IE is included in the STOP-WARNING-INDICATION-NG-RAN message when the AMF has received at least one CANCEL RESPONSE without a Broadcast Cancelled Area List IE.

q_40144.question: What information does the application server need to be aware of to ensure that all UEs using power saving functions can receive the service announcement in time?
q_40144.ground_truth: The application server needs to be aware of the maximum unreachable period of the UEs to ensure that all UEs using power saving functions can receive the service announcement in time.

q_40145.question: What may be used for key management for e2e protection for real-time traffic in IMS?
q_40145.ground_truth: SDP Security Descriptions (SDES) or MIKEY-TICKET key management mechanisms can be used for e2e protection for real-time traffic in IMS.

q_40146.question: What is the role of EPC-GMLC and 5GC-GMLC in the 5G - LCS architecture?
q_40146.ground_truth: EPC-GMLC and 5GC-GMLC serve as LCS (Location-based Charging and Accounting) servers in the 5G LCS architecture. They are responsible for managing location services, handling location requests, and maintaining context between the EPS and 5GS.

q_40147.question: What is the role of the SMF in determining whether to insert an UL-CL/BP and an additional PSA on-board for local data switching?
q_40147.ground_truth: The SMF is responsible for determining whether to insert an UL-CL/BP and an additional PSA on-board for local data switching based on the DNN and backhaul information.

q_40148.question: In non-roaming and LBO cases, what resource does the SMF+PGW-C release during handover preparation phase cancellation?
q_40148.ground_truth: The SMF+PGW-C releases the corresponding resource in the UPF+PGW-U if it was allocated during the handover preparation.

q_40149.question: What should a peer UE do when it receives a message not compatible with the Pc5 signalling protocol state?
q_40149.ground_truth: The actions of the peer UE are implementation dependent - it can either try to treat the message or ignore it.

q_40150.question: When generating a new KAUSF during an EAP-TLS procedure, what should the ME do if specific conditions are met?
q_40150.ground_truth: The ME should generate a new KSEAF from the new KAUSF and the KAMF from the ABBA value received together with the EAP-request message, and create a partial native 5G NAS security context identified by the ngKSI value received together with the EAP-request message.

q_40151.question: What is the purpose of the "loopback-indication" parameter in the P-Charging-Vector header?
q_40151.ground_truth: The "loopback-indication" parameter in the P-Charging-Vector header identifies when loopback applies during the charging process.

q_40152.question: What is used to identify an interface instance for UE associated signalling in case of network sharing with multiple cell ID broadcast with shared signalling transport?
q_40152.ground_truth: For UE associated signalling, the interface instance is identified by assigning appropriate UE F1AP IDs, UE XnAP IDs or UE X2AP IDs for F1-C, Xn-C and X2-C, respectively.

q_40153.question: What does the term "NRF" stand for in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_40153.ground_truth: "NRF" stands for Network Repository Function in the 3GPP Technical Specification.

q_40154.question: When does the MME send a periodic tracking area update request or a combined tracking area update request with a specific LAI value?
q_40154.ground_truth: The MME sends a periodic tracking area update request or a combined tracking area update request with a specific LAI value if the MM context variable "VLR-Reliable" for the UE is set to "false" and the MME received from the UE a combined tracking area update request or a periodic tracking area update.

q_40155.question: In which scenarios can the ES activation procedure in the coverage of Cell B be triggered in the inter-frequency intra-RAT gNB Coverage scenario?
q_40155.ground_truth: The ES activation procedure in the coverage of Cell B can be triggered in case of light traffic in Cell B or when the traffic of the ES area resumes to a high level.

q_40156.question: What are some potential challenges in model delivery/transfer to UE?
q_40156.ground_truth: Some potential challenges include proprietary issues, burdens in some scenarios, and latency associated with model delivery/transfer.

q_40157.question: What should the UE do if the upper layers provide the 'Registered AMF' in the NB-IoT UE procedure?
q_40157.ground_truth: The UE should include the plmnIdentity in the registeredAMF and set it to the value of the PLMN identity in the 'Registered AMF' received from upper layers.

q_40158.question: What will the PCF do if it determines that the same PCF shall be selected for the SM Policy associations to the same UE ID, S-NSSAI and DNN combination in the non-roaming or home-routed scenario and there is no SM Policy association for the UE ID, S-NSSAI and DNN combination?
q_40158.ground_truth: The PCF shall request the BSF to check if there is an existing PCF binding information for the same UE ID, S-NSSAI and DNN combination registered by other PCF(s) and handle the response accordingly.

q_40159.question: What happens to the list of forbidden PLMNs for GPRS service when a new entry needs to be added and the list is full?
q_40159.ground_truth: The oldest entry shall be deleted to make room for the new entry.

q_40160.question: What requirement should be met for the E-UTRAN HD-FDD inter-frequency OTDOA measurements, other than reporting delay, when all positioning subframes are available for RSTD measurements in the measured and reference cells?
q_40160.ground_truth: The same requirements as in clause 8.16.3.2.1 should be met.

q_40161.question: What is the TBS index used for in resource allocations of type 1?
q_40161.ground_truth: The TBS index is used to determine the TBS (Transport Block Size) for the physical downlink shared channel.

q_40162.question: What does the SMF indicate to the (R)AN when redundant transmission has been activated on the PDU Session and the SMF decides to stop redundant transmission in step~2a?
q_40162.ground_truth: The SMF indicates to the (R)AN to release the AN Tunnel and stop packet duplication and elimination associated with the redundancy tunnel of the PDU Session.

q_40163.question: What actions should be taken to remove unauthorized information from SMS data when it is required?
q_40163.ground_truth: The short message (SM) portion of an SMS message should be replaced by the equivalent of "Space" in the original encoding, and the TP-User-Data-Header should be rewritten so that each of the Information Elements, which are not classified as "SMS Control," is converted to a Filler Information Element. The overall length of the TP-User-Data, and if present, the overall length of the TP-User-Data Header, should not be changed.

q_40164.question: What are the security requirements for communication over the S14 reference point between UE and ANDSF?
q_40164.ground_truth: UE and ANDSF shall be mutually authenticated, signaling over S14 reference point shall be integrity and confidentiality protected, and signaling over S14 reference point shall be protected against possible replay attacks.

q_40165.question: What is the measurement reporting delay for Cell1 A1 and Cell2 A1?
q_40165.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay for Cell1 A1 is less than 202ms and for Cell2 A1 is less than 402ms.

q_40166.question: When can the first CSI report timing be expected after SCell activation/hibernation?
q_40166.ground_truth: The first CSI report timing could be invalid CQI, and it is expected at subframe m+8, but it might be delayed to subframe m+10 due to interruption.

q_40167.question: What is the definition of the RM-DEREGISTERED state in 5GS Registration Management?
q_40167.ground_truth: In the RM-DEREGISTERED state, the UE is not registered with the network and has no valid location or routing information in the AMF context, making the UE unreachable by the AMF.

q_40168.question: When submitting an SM over IP, what information should be included in the SIP MESSAGE request?
q_40168.ground_truth: The SM-over-IP sender should include the Request-URI, From header, To header, Content-Type header, and the body of the request with an RP-DATA message and SMS headers with SMS user information.

q_40169.question: What is the name of the message that the HSS sends to the AS when the AS requests user and service information from the HSS?

q_40170.question: What should the UE do upon receiving N310 consecutive "out-of-sync" indications while neither T300, T301, T304 nor T311 is running as specified in TS 36.331 clause 5.3.11.3?
q_40170.ground_truth: The UE should start timer T310.

q_40171.question: What should the TWAG do upon expiry of timer T3585 during a PDN connectivity procedure?
q_40171.ground_truth: On the first expiry of the timer T3585, the TWAG shall resend the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message, reset and restart timer T3585. On the fifth expiry of timer T3585, the TWAG shall release possibly allocated resources for this activation and shall abort the procedure.

q_40172.question: What type of data is supported by the "DownlinkMessageDeliveryData" structure?
q_40172.ground_truth: The "DownlinkMessageDeliveryData" structure supports data related to downlink message delivery, including the time of delivery, message size, and other relevant information.

q_40173.question: What is the purpose of a binding indication in a service request from an NF service consumer?
q_40173.ground_truth: The binding indication allows later communication between the service consumer and producer for the concerned data context.

q_40174.question: What network elements synchronize the H-SFN counter to achieve loose H-SFN synchronization?
q_40174.ground_truth: Each NG-RAN node and AMF synchronizes internally the H-SFN counter to achieve loose H-SFN synchronization.

q_40175.question: What is the role of the Adaptation Layer in ensuring PC5 QoS over the two PC5 links?
q_40175.ground_truth: The Adaptation Layer is responsible for ensuring PC5 QoS over the two PC5 links by performing necessary adaptations in the AS layers of the two PC5 interfaces and transferring the received data based on the adaptation in the AS layer.

q_40176.question: What is the task of inter-eNB CoMP in the context of RRM?
q_40176.ground_truth: The task of inter-eNB CoMP is to coordinate multiple eNBs in order to improve the coverage of high data rates, cell-edge throughput, and system throughput. This is achieved by signaling between eNBs of hypothetical resource allocation information and CoMP hypotheses.

q_40177.question: What is the purpose of the PC5 Connection Establishment enhancement in the context of Layer-2 UE-to-Network Relay?
q_40177.ground_truth: The PC5 Connection Establishment enhancement is used to indicate whether the link establishment is triggered due to an originating emergency service during the Layer-2 link establishment phase.

q_40178.question: In Test case 5.1.47, what is the test requirement related to the handover delay (Dhandover) for the test to pass with a confidence level of 95%?
q_40178.ground_truth: The handover delay (Dhandover) should be less than a total of 17ms, and more than 90% of the cases should pass successfully in order to achieve the specified confidence level.

q_40179.question: What does the 'notsameAsServ' field in various SEQUENCE DEFINITIONS indicate?
q_40179.ground_truth: The 'notsameAsServ' field in various SEQUENCE DEFINITIONS indicates that the field should only be included if the current E-UTRA serving cell frequency (earfcn) is different from the frequency being specified by the  field.

q_40180.question: What is the required support for EVS by an MTSI client with terminal support in a speech media session?
q_40180.ground_truth: An MTSI client in terminal supporting EVS should support RTCP-APP signalling for speech adaptation and the RTCP-APP signalling for call cases.

q_40181.question: What is the difference between the E-MMSE IRC receiver and the R-ML receiver?
q_40181.ground_truth: The E-MMSE IRC receiver is a linear minimum mean square error (MMSE) interference receiver that estimates the transmitted signal by minimizing the mean square error between the estimated and actual transmitted signal, while the R-ML receiver performs joint maximum likelihood detection of the useful and co-scheduled UE signals considering the constellations of both signals.

q_40182.question: Which network entity determines the ATSSS rules to be used by the UE and UPF when the AF requests to start and stop traffic duplication?
q_40182.ground_truth: The NEF provides an API for the AF to request start and stop of traffic duplication and providing traffic duplication criteria.

q_40183.question: What is the function of the authentication service in the 3GPP management system?
q_40183.ground_truth: The authentication service provides identity management capabilities to provision MnS consumer/producer, group of MnS consumers/producers and authentication policies for the identities. It also provides capabilities for authentication of MnS consumer explicitly or implicitly.

q_40184.question: What should the NEF do upon success if it determines that the UE is behind a NAT in UPF?
q_40184.ground_truth: The NEF will discover the UPF implementing NAT functionality for the UE's IP address and then request the UE's IP address and IP domain from the UPF.

q_40185.question: What should be done if T4 expires and the UE has not yet re-selected Cell 1?
q_40185.ground_truth: The SS should continue with step 20.

q_40186.question: What should the UE do when the WLAN connection or connection attempts to all WLANs inside the WLAN mobility set fails due to WLAN radio link issues?
q_40186.ground_truth: The UE should set the status in VarWLAN-Status to failureWlanRadioLink and stop WLAN status monitoring and WLAN connection attempts. The UE should also perform WLAN Connection Status Reporting procedure in 5.6.15.2.

q_40187.question: What is the action taken by the MAC entity when it receives an Enhanced TCI States Activation/Deactivation for UE-specific PDSCH MAC CE on a Serving Cell?
q_40187.ground_truth: The MAC entity indicates to lower layers the information regarding the Enhanced TCI States Activation/Deactivation for UE-specific PDSCH MAC CE.

q_40188.question: When is the MCVideo client required to send an MBS listening status report?
q_40188.ground_truth: If one of the conditions in clause 16A.2.3.1 is fulfilled, the MCVideo client shall report that it is listening to the MBS session as specified in clause 16A.2.3.2.

q_40189.question: What should the Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay transmit to AMF-2 for PDU session modification?
q_40189.ground_truth: The Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay initiates the PDU Session Modification procedure by transmitting a NAS message (N1 SM container (PDU Session Modification Request)) to AMF-2 with additional parameters, including "L3 relay multipath", Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay PDU session ID, Remote UE 5G-GUTI, Remote User ID, PDU session ID, QFI, or QoS rule, and anchor path.

q_40190.question: What should the MS do with the list of forbidden PLMNs when it is switched off or the SIM/USIM is removed?
q_40190.ground_truth: If the MS maintains a list of PLMN-specific attempt counters and PLMN-specific PS-attempt counters, it shall remove the respective PLMNs from the forbidden PLMNs list when the MS is switched off or the SIM/USIM is removed.

q_40191.question: For which subcarrier spacing should PUSCH requirement tests be performed when applying the tests for a specific channel bandwidth?
q_40191.ground_truth: The tests should be performed for the supported subcarrier spacing of that channel bandwidth.

q_40192.question: What is the uplink transmission waveform used in 5G NR?
q_40192.ground_truth: The uplink transmission waveform is conventional OFDM using a CP with a transform precoding function performing DFT spreading that can be disabled or enabled in 5G NR.

q_40193.question: What action can a child node take upon receiving a BH RLF detection indication from its parent node?
q_40193.ground_truth: A child node may perform local rerouting for upstream traffic over an available backhaul (BH) link after receiving a BH RLF detection indication.

q_40194.question: What procedures are affected by the Control Plane data back-off timer in the AMF?
q_40194.ground_truth: The Control Plane data back-off timer in the AMF does not affect any other mobility management or session management procedure, except for the NAS Messages within the Control Plane Service Request.

q_40195.question: What should the UE do if timer T3247 expires when it is in A/Gb mode or Iu mode?
q_40195.ground_truth: The UE should perform the actions as specified in 3GPP TS 24.008.

q_40196.question: What is the meaning of "shall" and "shall not" in 3GPP technical specification group documents?
q_40196.ground_truth: "Shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something, while "shall not" indicates an interdiction (prohibition) to do something in 3GPP technical specification group documents.

q_40197.question: What information must be included in the Floor Granted message when sending it to the requesting MCPTT floor participant in the 'D: Floor Taken' state?
q_40197.ground_truth: The Floor Granted message must include the value of the T12 (Stop talking dual) timer in the Duration field, the granted priority in the Floor priority field, the Track Info field (if stored), the Floor Indicator field with the G-bit set to '1' (Dual floor), and the Floor Indicator field with appropriate indications (if it's a broadcast group call, system call, emergency call, imminent peril call, or temporary group session). If non-controlling MCPTT functions are involved, the SSRC of the granted floor participant must also be included.

q_40198.question: Which element is the root element of the SEALLocationManagement document in the XML schema description of the location management document?
q_40198.ground_truth: The <location-info> element is the root element of the SEALLocationManagement document.

q_40199.question: What event triggers the AMF to interact with the PCF and update RFSP index and/or SMF selection management related policy information in the AMF based on the Allowed NSSAI?
q_40199.ground_truth: A Change of the Allowed NSSAI trigger

q_40200.question: What information may be included in the PIN policies and parameters for each PIN?
q_40200.ground_truth: PIN ID, PIN type, whether the UE is permitted to act as a PINE, PEGC, and/or PEMC, Permitted Discovery Types, and Security policies and parameters for communication within the PIN.

q_40201.question: What is the purpose of collecting data from the UPF by the NWDAF?
q_40201.ground_truth: The purpose of collecting data from the UPF by the NWDAF is to help data analytics.

q_40202.question: What is the main purpose of the "UE mobility event notification" service provided by AMF?
q_40202.ground_truth: The "UE mobility event notification" service provided by AMF is used for reporting UE presence in Area of Interest, which allows SMF to deal with PDU Sessions accordingly, such as reallocating UPF or determining how to handle the PDU Session for LADN.

q_40203.question: What actions are taken by the MME when there is (both idle mode and connected mode) mobility to an eNB that does not support User Plane Integrity Protection with EPS for bearers of PDN Connections with UP integrity protection set to Required?
q_40203.ground_truth: The MME ensures that the PDU session is released.

q_40204.question: Where is the private user identity retained in the UE, if an ISIM is present?
q_40204.ground_truth: If an ISIM is present, the private user identity is retained within the ISIM in the UE.

q_40205.question: What existing analytics does Solution #48 propose to use to adjust URSP fields?
q_40205.ground_truth: Solution #48 proposes using analytics such as "Slice Load Level" for S-NSSAI, "DN Performance" for DNN, and "Service Experience" and "WLAN Performance" for Access Type.

q_40206.question: When can an AMF include a list of supported S-NSSAIs in the Steering of Roaming procedure?
q_40206.ground_truth: An AMF can include a list of supported S-NSSAIs in the Steering of Roaming procedure when the UDM receives an indication that the UE has requested Deregistration due to a lack of S-NSSAI support in a VPLMN.

q_40207.question: Which HTTP method is used to query the IMS restoration information using the specified URI?
q_40207.ground_truth: The "GET" method is used to query the IMS restoration information.

q_40208.question: What information does the SMF report to the PCF when a new manageable Ethernet DS-TT port is detected?
q_40208.ground_truth: The SMF provides User plane node ID, the port number and optionally MAC address of the related port of the related PDU Session to the PCF.

q_40209.question: What HTTP method should be used by the Content Provider to obtain the session properties of a service from the BM-SC?
q_40209.ground_truth: The Content Provider should use HTTP GET for this purpose.

q_40210.question: In 6.3.2.2.6.1, when should the participating MCVideo function perform the actions specified in clause 6.3.2.2.6.3?
q_40210.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function must perform the actions specified in clause 6.3.2.2.6.3 when it receives a "SIP INVITE request for terminating participating MCVideo function" that requires manual commencement mode, the invited MCVideo client has one or more pre-established sessions without an associated MCVideo session, the media-level sections for the offered MCVideo video media stream are the same as the existing pre-established session, and the media-level section of the offered media-transmission control entity is the same as the media-level section for media-transmission control entity in the existing pre-established session.

q_40211.question: How is media encryption implemented for MCPTT and MCVideo?
q_40211.ground_truth: Media is encrypted using the SRTP protocol, with keys derived from the MCPTT or MCVideo user's identity. This unique key derivation process ensures every member of the group encrypts media using a different key.

q_40212.question: What is the length of the HARQ RTT Timer in TDD with short TTI, if the proc-Timeline is set to n+6 set1 or n+6 set2?
q_40212.ground_truth: The HARQ RTT Timer is set to 12 TTIs.

q_40213.question: Which element within the <announcement> contains a list of alternative TMGI used in roaming scenarios?

q_40214.question: What is the requirement for the occupied bandwidth for IAB-DU type 1-H and IAB-MT type 1-H as specified in clause 6.6.2?
q_40214.ground_truth: The occupied bandwidth for each NR carrier shall be less than the IAB-DU channel bandwidth for IAB-DU type 1-H and less than the IAB-MT channel bandwidth for IAB-MT type 1-H. For intra-band contiguous CA, the occupied bandwidth shall be less than or equal the Aggregated IAB-DU Channel Bandwidth for IAB-DU type 1-H and less than or equal the Aggregated IAB-MT Channel Bandwidth for IAB-MT type 1-H.

q_40215.question: What is the default signal level uncertainty at each test port?
q_40215.ground_truth: The default signal level uncertainty at each test port is +/-3dB.

q_40216.question: What happens during the execution of the Session Transfer procedure?
q_40216.ground_truth: The UE tunes to the target cell, the downlink flow of VoIP packets is switched towards the CS access leg, and the source IMS access leg is released after the session is transferred to the target cell.

q_40217.question: What should be the value of the bits representing the version of the protocol in the first octet of the message header?
q_40217.ground_truth: The bits representing the version of the protocol in the first octet of the message header shall be set to decimal value 1 ("001").

q_40218.question: Under what circumstances will the eNB consider the establishment of an E-RAB as failed during the Initial Context Setup procedure?
q_40218.ground_truth: The eNB will consider the establishment of an E-RAB as failed if the INITIAL CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message contains an E-RAB Level QoS Parameters IE with a QCI IE indicating a GBR bearer, but without the GBR QoS Information IE.

q_40219.question: What is the purpose of GTP-C load & overload control mechanism in GTP-C entities?
q_40219.ground_truth: The purpose of GTP-C load & overload control mechanism in GTP-C entities is to control the number of incoming requests so that the receiving GTP-C entity can successfully process them, avoiding the loss of network services and revenue.

q_40220.question: What MESSAGE request containing a MIME body is required to be supported at the roaming II-NNI for the CS to PS SRVCC feature?
q_40220.ground_truth: The MESSAGE request containing the Accept-Contact header field with the "g.3gpp.path" media feature tag and the "application/vnd.3gpp.srvcc-ext+xml" MIME body.

q_40221.question: What is the role of FAR in the network's security measures to block traffic that is not from or to PVS and DNS server addresses?
q_40221.ground_truth: FAR (Firewall Address Redaction) is used in the network's security measures to block traffic that is not from or to PVS and DNS server addresses.

q_40222.question: What is the impact of Option 1) on the SMF?
q_40222.ground_truth: In Option 1), the SMF includes an indication that the PDU Session may be re-established on an S-NSSAI different from S-NSSAI-1 in the PDU Session release/modification procedure.

q_40223.question: What is sent in a session-oriented service termination request from the V2X application-specific server to the VAE server?
q_40223.ground_truth: The V2X application-specific server provides the VAE server with a request to terminate the session-oriented service with the VAE client, which may include the identity of the service session.

q_40224.question: What should be the same port number used for when transmitting and receiving RTP based media to/from the remote network and the MTSI client in terminal?
q_40224.ground_truth: The MTSI MGW shall transmit RTP packets from and receive RTP packets on the same port number, not necessarily the same port number as used to/from the MTSI client in terminal.

q_40225.question: What are the two key issues that this solution addresses?
q_40225.ground_truth: The two key issues that this solution addresses are hindering UEs' access to the network (DoS attack on UE) and hindering the network's ability to provide services to UEs (DoS attack on network).

q_40226.question: What is the meaning of the "might" construction in the context of the present document?
q_40226.ground_truth: The "might" construction indicates a likelihood that something will or will not happen as a result of action taken by some agency the behavior of which is outside the scope of the present document.

q_40227.question: What action will the P-CSCF take upon receiving an SDP answer to an SDP offer from a remote user with an accepted RTP based media?
q_40227.ground_truth: Upon receiving an SDP answer to an SDP offer from a remote user, the P-CSCF will act as defined in the specification, and remove the SDP crypto attribute for the accepted RTP based media.

q_40228.question: What is the requirement for the default setup of the network product in regards to the use of group accounts or group credentials?
q_40228.ground_truth: The requirement is that the default setup of the network product does not enable the use of group accounts or group credentials.

q_40229.question: What is defined as the time between an event that will trigger a measurement report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface, excluding certain delays?

q_40230.question: What action should the SGW take if it receives a GTP error indication for a bearer context other than the default bearer when S4-U is used?
q_40230.ground_truth: The SGW may delete its Bearer context and notify the Operation and Maintenance network element, or send a Downlink Data Notification message to the S4-SGSN to re-establish the user plane path without deleting the bearer context.

q_40231.question: What is the core technology used in Solution #26?
q_40231.ground_truth: Solution #26 uses public-key cryptography (PKC) for signing and verifying system information, while also utilizing a cryptographic CRC (C-CRC) method to detect message replay attacks.

q_40232.question: What is the role of the H-SMF in the HPLMN in N9HR?
q_40232.ground_truth: The H-SMF in the HPLMN assigns a separate QoS Flow Index (QFI) for IMS signalling related packets and IMS voice related packets in N9HR.

q_40233.question: In 3GPP documentation, what can the enum value "notSupported" mean?

q_40234.question: Which element in the UAE document contains a string set to either "positive" or "negative" used to indicate the positive or negative result of the reception?

q_40235.question: When does the UE respond to paging as normal when the Service Gap timer is running?
q_40235.ground_truth: When the Service Gap timer is running, the UE shall respond as normal to paging.

q_40236.question: When can a mobile station enable CCN (Cellular Cellular Network enabled) in accordance with TS 44.060?
q_40236.ground_truth: A mobile station, which has CCN Enabled, can enter CCN Mode when it is camping on a cell, the network indicates CCN ACTIVE/3G CCN ACTIVE/E-UTRAN CCN ACTIVE in system information to all mobile stations in the cell or in an individual order to a certain mobile station, the mobile station is neither in dedicated mode nor Dual Transfer Mode, the mobile station is in NC0 or in NC1 mode, and the mobile station is in Packet Transfer mode.

q_40237.question: What must be done if detailed location information is available for reporting?
q_40237.ground_truth: The locationInfo must be set to include the locationCoordinates and, if available, the gnss-TOD-msec and verticalVelocityInfo.

q_40238.question: What does the "5gsToEpsMob" attribute encoded in the "uePolReq" message indicate?
q_40238.ground_truth: It indicates that the trigger for the UE Policy Association Establishment is the 5GS to EPS mobility scenario.

q_40239.question: What is the purpose of the procedures in section 5.3 of the document?
q_40239.ground_truth: The purpose of the procedures in section 5.3 is to enable Endpoint B to request location measurement data and/or a location estimate from Endpoint A, and to enable Endpoint A to transfer location measurement data and/or a location estimate to Endpoint B in the absence of a request.

q_40240.question: In the RN container in registration request, what actions does the AMF take with the MBS session information container?
q_40240.ground_truth: In the RN container in registration request, the AMF sends the MBS session information container received in the Registration Request towards the SMF(s) serving the associated PDU Session(s). The SMF then performs the corresponding multicast MBS session procedures based on the information in the MBS session information container.

q_40241.question: What condition must be met for the cell re-selection delay to a lower priority E-UTRA cell?
q_40241.ground_truth: The cell re-selection delay to a lower priority E-UTRA cell shall be less than Tevaluate, E-UTRAN + TSI-E-UTRA in RRC_IDLE state.

q_40242.question: What information does the "Age of Location Estimate" parameter provide?
q_40242.ground_truth: It indicates how long ago the location estimate was obtained.

q_40243.question: What interfaces does the Wireline Access Gateway Function (W-AGF) use to connect the 5G-RG to the 5G Core Network CP and UP functions?
q_40243.ground_truth: The W-AGF interfaces the 5G Core Network CP and UP functions via N2 and N3 interfaces, respectively.

q_40244.question: What is the approximate spatial isolation achieved for a ceiling- or wall-mounted base station with directive antenna radiation patterns in the Nokia study?

q_40245.question: What is the maximum value for the CCNR-CC-T3-timer?
q_40245.ground_truth: The maximum value for the CCNR-CC-T3-timer is 180 minutes.

q_40246.question: What is the main purpose of the NAS Security Mode Command procedure in 5G systems?
q_40246.ground_truth: The NAS Security Mode Command procedure is typically executed as part of the Attach procedure in advance of, or in combination with, executing the ME Identity Check procedure and in the TAU procedure. It is used to establish the security mode between the UE and the network.

q_40247.question: What method is used to create an individual SM context resource in the SMF or V-SMF for HR roaming scenarios?
q_40247.ground_truth: The POST method is used to create an individual SM context resource in the SMF or V-SMF for HR roaming scenarios.

q_40248.question: What message does the PDN GW send to the UE after updating its binding with the 'client identifier' and 'chaddr' combination for subsequent DHCPv4 procedure?
q_40248.ground_truth: The PDN GW extends an IPv4 lease offer and sends the DHCPv4 Offer with the assigned UE IPv4 address.

q_40249.question: What types of traffic require different QoS parameters in an IAB network?
q_40249.ground_truth: For different types of OAM traffic, it is necessary to use different DRBs between the IAB-MT and the serving DU, and different BH RLC channels for intermediate hops, with different QoS parameters. Alarm messages and commands are transported on a high-priority bearer, while counters may be transported on a lower priority bearer. OAM software downloads generate larger amounts of data but have a lower required data rate and a lower priority than alarms, commands, and counters.

q_40250.question: What element in the DAA-client-event-info contains a list of UASes where e.g. U2X layer has detected possible flight path conflict?

q_40251.question: What is the role of the SMF in providing XR traffic assistance information to the gNB?
q_40251.ground_truth: The SMF provides XR traffic assistance information (e.g., UL and/or DL Periodicity, N6 Jitter Information) to the gNB through NG AP TSC Assistance Information for better UE power saving.

q_40252.question: In the "E-RABToBeSwitchedULItem" sequence, what is the type of "e-RAB-ID" and "gTP-TEID"?

q_40253.question: What information does the gNB-CU-UP send to the gNB-CU-CP in the DL DATA NOTIFICATION message during the successful operation of the DL Data Notification procedure?
q_40253.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-UP sends the PPI IE, PDU Session To Notify List IE, MT-SDT Information IE, or SDT Data Size Threshold Crossed IE in the DL DATA NOTIFICATION message.

q_40254.question: What should the UE do if it has not selected a SyncRef UE and GNSS is not reliable for sidelink communication?
q_40254.ground_truth: If the UE has not selected a SyncRef UE and it has not selected GNSS as the synchronization reference source, then it should perform a full search to detect candidate SLSS on the concerned frequency, evaluate them using layer 3 filtering and the S-RSRP measurement results, and select the SyncRef UE with the highest S-RSRP that meets the minimum requirement and belongs to a higher priority group than the current SyncRef UE, or select GNSS if it becomes reliable.

q_40255.question: What is the security protection of the NOTIFICATION message?
q_40255.ground_truth: The NOTIFICATION message is always sent within SECURITY PROTECTED 5GS NAS MESSAGE message.

q_40256.question: What should the controlling MCPTT function do if it receives a SIP re-INVITE request with an unauthorized request for an MCPTT emergency private call during an emergency call?
q_40256.ground_truth: If the SIP re-INVITE request contains an unauthorized request for an MCPTT emergency private call, the controlling MCPTT function shall reject the SIP INVITE request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response and send the SIP 403 (Forbidden) response as specified in clause 6.3.3.1.14, skipping the rest of the steps.

q_40257.question: What is the expected result of the set command +CSODCP when the uplink data transfer is completed with this data transfer, and an acknowledgement is not requested from the receiver?
q_40257.ground_truth: The network acknowledges transmission of the user data and does not request acknowledgement for the next received downlink data.

q_40258.question: What happens when the old and the new GUTI shall be considered as valid at the same time on the network side?
q_40258.ground_truth: When a lower layer failure is detected before the GUTI REALLOCATION COMPLETE message is received, the old and the new GUTI shall be considered as valid until the old GUTI can be considered as invalid by the network. The network may then use the old S-TMSI from the old GUTI for paging within the area defined by the old TAI list for an implementation dependent number of paging attempts, and if no response is received to the paging attempts, the network may use the IMSI for paging for an implementation dependent number of paging attempts. In this case, paging with IMSI causes the UE to re-attach.

q_40259.question: What is the difference between "shall" and "might" as used in the present document?
q_40259.ground_truth: "Shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something, while "might" indicates a likelihood that something will happen as a result of action taken by some agency the behavior of which is outside the scope of the present document.

q_40260.question: What does the ICE Free Format Content TLV contain?
q_40260.ground_truth: The ICE Free Format Content TLV contains a ICE Free Format Content (e.g. "Allergy to work").

q_40261.question: What should the MCVideo client include in the Contact header field of the SIP INVITE request for a private call with transmission control?
q_40261.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should include the g.3gpp.mcvideo media feature tag and the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag in the Contact header field of the SIP INVITE request.

q_40262.question: What will the S-CSCF do if the maximum number of allowed simultaneously registration flows for the UE is reached?
q_40262.ground_truth: The S-CSCF shall reject the REGISTER by generating a 403 (Forbidden) response.

q_40263.question: What conditions must be met for an SCell1 activation delay to be counted as correct during repeated tests?
q_40263.ground_truth: The rate of correct observed SCell1 activation delay and SCell1 deactivation delay should be at least 90% with a confidence level of 95% during repeated tests.

q_40264.question: When might the UE need to include the Unavailability information IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message to indicate upcoming availability due to discontinuous coverage?
q_40264.ground_truth: If the network has indicated support for enhanced discontinuous coverage and needs to indicate upcoming availability due to discontinuous coverage, the UE shall include the Unavailability information IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message, with the unavailability type set to "unavailability due to discontinuous coverage".

q_40265.question: What should be the PDP type number in the Requested PDP address information element in the ACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message for non-IP connectivity?

q_40266.question: What does UE need to establish two redundant PDU Sessions and associate duplicated traffic to them?
q_40266.ground_truth: UE needs to use URSP as specified in TS 23.503 to establish two redundant PDU Sessions and associate duplicated traffic to them, or alternatively, UE may perform this task independently from URSP. In the latter case, UE may establish two redundant PDU Sessions even when the application does not duplicate the traffic and does not provide two distinct traffic descriptors. UE may use its implementation of FRER defined in IEEE Std 802.1CB-2017 in the UE's operating system to perform this task.

q_40267.question: Which service operation is used during the SMF-NEF Connection Establishment procedure to create a SM Context for NIDD on NEF?
q_40267.ground_truth: The Create service operation is used during the SMF-NEF Connection Establishment procedure to create a SM Context for NIDD on NEF.

q_40268.question: What happens when a PINE sends a PIN Relay Request to the PEMC?
q_40268.ground_truth: The PEMC sends a Relay Activate/Deactivate Request to the PINMF, which authorizes the request and updates the 5G-LAN accordingly. The PINMF may also trigger the authentication and authorization procedure for security purposes.

q_40269.question: What action does the UE take when it receives the UEInformationRequest message containing rlf-ReportReq and the UE has a DRB with QCI1 and reported radio link failure?
q_40269.ground_truth: The UE sends the UEInformationResponse message with rlf-Report included with IE drb-EstablishedWithQCI-1-r13.

q_40270.question: What information is included in a notification sent by a PIN Server to a PIN Client in a UE?
q_40270.ground_truth: A notification sent by a PIN Server to a PIN Client in a UE includes discovered PIN ID, details of PINAPP capabilities and corresponding PE IDs, such as Device ID, IP address and Port number.

q_40271.question: What is the application-context used between VLR and HLR or SGSN and HLR for reporting of authentication failures in MAP version3?

q_40272.question: When should a UE release the PC5 Relay RLC channel for U2U relay operations?
q_40272.ground_truth: For unicast L2 U2U relay operation, a UE should release the RLC entity and corresponding logical channel associated with an SL-RLC-ChannelID if there is no end-to-end sidelink DRB(s) associated with this RLC channel, or if the PC5 Relay RLC channel release was triggered by upper layers or due to sidelink RLF.

q_40273.question: What is the purpose of the ProSe Function starting timer T4014 assigned for each ProSe Query Code and Discovery Response Filter(s) under this discovery entry of the discoverer UE context?
q_40273.ground_truth: The ProSe Function starts timer T4014 to ensure that the discoverer UE sends a new discoverer request for renewing the query-related information no earlier than the discoveree UE renewing its own ProSe Response Code with the ProSe Function.

q_40274.question: What is the purpose of the test described in clause 16.5.1.14.4?
q_40274.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the UE properly detects the out-of-sync for the purpose of monitoring downlink CSI-RS based radio link quality of the PCell when DRX is used for 2 Rx RedCap UE.

q_40275.question: What is the purpose of GLONASS RTK Bias Information in the MAC Network RTK method?
q_40275.ground_truth: GLONASS RTK Bias Information defines the code-phase biases related to the Master Reference Station.

q_40276.question: What should the UE include in the VarConnEstFailReport if detailed location information is available in clause 5.3.3.6 of TS 36.331?
q_40276.ground_truth: The UE should include the locationCoordinates and the horizontalVelocity, if available, in the VarConnEstFailReport if detailed location information is available.

q_40277.question: What function in a virtualized environment is typically only accessible by a handful of specifically authorized individuals in a legacy PNF network?

q_40278.question: Which TS (Technical Specification) specify the method of test for the measurement of UTRA TDD primary CCPCH power and differential accuracy of the Primary CCPCH power?

q_40279.question: What action must the IWF floor control server take when Timer T11 (End of RTP dual) expires in the 'D: Floor Taken' state?
q_40279.ground_truth: When Timer T11 (End of RTP dual) expires, the IWF floor control server must stop the T12 (Stop talking dual) timer if it's running, request the media distributor to stop distributing RTP media packets received from the overriding media endpoint to other media endpoints, release all resources reserved in the media plane, send a Floor Idle message to any non-controlling MCPTT functions and to those MCPTT floor participants controlled by the IWF performing the controlling role receiving RTP media from the overriding media endpoint, and enter the 'Start-stop' state.

q_40280.question: What should the (H)GMLC do if there is no overlap between the event report expected area and the area provided by the AF or LCS Client for area event reporting?
q_40280.ground_truth: The (H)GMLC should reject the location request with a failure cause.

q_40281.question: What is the purpose of the "required" keyword in JSON schema?
q_40281.ground_truth: The "required" keyword specifies a requirement for the MnS producer, indicating which properties are required in a JSON document.

q_40282.question: What should be the value of the Expires header field if the MCData client wants to cache the current status and later notification?

q_40283.question: Which network architectural components are specified in 3GPP TS 24.301, and what are their significance in networking?
q_40283.ground_truth: 3GPP TS 24.301 specifies the "IMS Voice over PS Session (IMSVoPS)" indicator and the "Persistent EPS bearer context". These network architectural components are significant as they enable the IMS-based multimedia session to be established, maintained, and released securely and efficiently.

q_40284.question: How does the network product under test handle an expired access token?
q_40284.ground_truth: The network product under test verifies the expiration time in the access token against the current data/time. If the expiration time has passed, the network product under test would reject the NF service consumer's request.

q_40285.question: What interfaces are impacted by Solution #9?
q_40285.ground_truth: Solution #9 impacts the N26 interface and applies to UE interworking between 5G and 4G, including 5G to 4G mobility and 4G to 5G mobility with or without N26.

q_40286.question: What is the purpose of the 5G RG's ability to pre-establish QoS-specific IPsec tunnels with the TWIF?
q_40286.ground_truth: The 5G RG's ability to pre-establish QoS-specific IPsec tunnels with the TWIF enables it to support QoS differentiation in the 5G-RG's PDU Session, which is necessary when IPsec is used between the TWAP and TNGF.

q_40287.question: What is the purpose of the test in clause 6.1.11?
q_40287.ground_truth: The purpose of the test in clause 6.1.11 is to verify that the UE is able to send a RRC Connection Re-establishment Request message to the System Simulator within the specified re-establishment delay limits from the moment it detects a loss in RRC connection.

q_40288.question: What does the Technical Report study in terms of network slicing enhancements?
q_40288.ground_truth: The Technical Report studies gaps and performs evaluations of potential architecture enhancements to support network slicing, with the objectives of ensuring service continuity, registration for rejected S-NSSAI, roaming support, network controlled behaviour of network slice usage, support for limited-lifetime services, and enhancement of NSAC when multiple NSACFs are involved.

q_40289.question: What is the definition of the AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message in clause 8.2.1 of the document?
q_40289.ground_truth: The AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message is sent by the AMF to the UE to initiate authentication of the UE identity.

q_40290.question: What is the mandatory requirement to do something indicated by the term "shall" in the context of normative provisions?
q_40290.ground_truth: The term "shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something in the context of normative provisions.

q_40291.question: What should the UPF do for a given multicast MBS session or location dependent MBS service session to receive the MBS session data?
q_40291.ground_truth: The UPF should allocate only one N19mb downlink tunnel, join the multicast group if multicast transport applies over N19mb or allocate a new N19mb DL tunnel if unicast transport applies over N19mb.

q_40292.question: What should an RNC consider when selecting UEs for MDT data collection?
q_40292.ground_truth: The RNC should consider the area received from the EM, the area where the UE is roaming, user consent information received from the core network, and the UE capability when selecting UE for MDT data collection.

q_40293.question: What is the purpose of the path switch negotiation procedure between UE#1 and UE#2 in this solution?
q_40293.ground_truth: The purpose of the path switch negotiation procedure between UE#1 and UE#2 is to have a uniform understanding for the path switch, negotiate the path switching services, QoS flows and the triggers of the service or QoS flows to be switched, and prepare the Uu path for the corresponding ProSe services or PC5 QoS flows transmission.

q_40294.question: What is the purpose of the 2Rx TDD FR1 HST-SFN performance test as specified in section 5.2.2.2.9 of the document?
q_40294.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to verify the PDSCH performance under 4 receive antenna conditions in the HST-SFN scenario defined in B.3.2 for NR UE releases 15 and later and EUTRA UE releases 15 and later that support enhanced demodulation processing for HST-SFN joint transmission scheme.

q_40295.question: Under what conditions will the UE-initiated NAS transport procedure be aborted when there is a transmission failure of the UL NAS TRANSPORT message with change in the current TAI?
q_40295.ground_truth: The UE-initiated NAS transport procedure shall be aborted and a registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update shall be initiated if the current TAI is not in the TAI list and the UL NAS TRANSPORT message has to be sent due to change in the current TAI.

q_40296.question: When does the PCF for the PDU session provision the received policy control requested trigger(s)?
q_40296.ground_truth: The PCF for the PDU session provisions the received policy control requested trigger(s) when an update on the current Policy Control Triggers needs to be sent to the SMF+PGW-C and when 5GS to EPS mobility applies.

q_40297.question: What are the two connections used for SEPPs and when is TLS mandatory and when is PRINS mandatory for protection of N32-f connections between the SEPPs?
q_40297.ground_truth: SEPPs use N32-c connections for management of the N32 interface and N32-f connections for sending of JWE and JWS protected messages between the SEPPs. TLS is mandatory for N32-c connections between SEPPs while PRINS is mandatory for protection of N32-f connections between the SEPPs when there are IPX providers which offer IP routing service between SEPPs.

q_40298.question: What is the first step in the procedure for Integrity protection for the MCPTT client and MCPTT server?
q_40298.ground_truth: The first step is to include a Content-Type header field set to "application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-signed+xml".

q_40299.question: What transport protocol is used by the BM-SC to receive UDP packets?
q_40299.ground_truth: The BM-SC listens on one IP address and one port number to receive UDP packets.

q_40300.question: What is the maximum amount of the magnitude of the timing change that can be made in one adjustment for the uplink transmission?
q_40300.ground_truth: The maximum amount of the magnitude of the timing change in one adjustment for the uplink transmission is Tq seconds.

q_40301.question: When should the P-CSCF remove the Security-Verify and Security-Client header fields?
q_40301.ground_truth: The P-CSCF should remove the Security-Verify and Security-Client header fields if the security association is a temporary one and the contents of the Security-Verify and Security-Server header fields match.

q_40302.question: Who is responsible for controlling the number of QNC messages to be generated by the NG-RAN?
q_40302.ground_truth: The NG-RAN has its own logical to control the number of the QNC messages to 5GC, this is not determined by the AF provided AW.

q_40303.question: What is the primary functional extension of the Iq interface for e2ae protection for RTP in IMS?
q_40303.ground_truth: The primary functional extension of the Iq interface for e2ae protection for RTP in IMS is to associate each RTP media stream with a unique DTLS-SRTP protection profile or SDES crypto attribute.

q_40304.question: What is the purpose of the "Disaster return wait range" information element in the 3GPP specification?
q_40304.ground_truth: The "Disaster return wait range" information element is used to assign a new disaster return wait range to the UE.

q_40305.question: What information does the SCEF send in the Group Message Delivery (TLTRI, TMGI, Delivery Trigger Status) message to the SCS/AS?
q_40305.ground_truth: The SCEF sends the TLTRI, TMGI, and Delivery Trigger Status to indicate whether delivery of the Group Message Payload was successful or not.

q_40306.question: What parameter does the MCPTT server check for authorization when receiving an MCPTT private call request, in addition to the encryption algorithm and mode?
q_40306.ground_truth: The MCPTT server checks if the MCPTT user at the MCPTT client is authorized to receive the private call and if the provided functional alias can be used and has been activated for the LMR user homed in the IWF.

q_40307.question: What should the network do when multiple PLMN IDs are broadcasted in a cell selected by NG-RAN?
q_40307.ground_truth: The NG-RAN shall select a target PLMN, taking into account the prioritized list of PLMN IDs provided via Mobility Restriction List from AMF.

q_40308.question: What is the impact on UE when NG-RAN triggers EPS or inter-RAT fallback in 5GS?
q_40308.ground_truth: When NG-RAN triggers EPS or inter-RAT fallback in 5GS, the UE will continue the IMS voice session on E-UTRA or initiate a handover to EPC or 5GC for the IMS voice session based on the selected RAT in 5GS and the support of EPS/inter-RAT fallback in NG-RAN.

q_40309.question: What does the MRDCOptimization-r16 sequence contain in the UE-CapabilityRequestFilterCommon?
q_40309.ground_truth: The MRDCOptimization-r16 sequence contains different codebook types and their respective options. It is used to optimize Multi-RAT operation with XDD and is included in the capability container request list.

q_40310.question: What is the role of an Application Server (AS) in a PIN network?
q_40310.ground_truth: An AS in a PIN network can process sensitive data locally and perform latency sensitive processing for games and office applications.

q_40311.question: How does the MCData client determine if resource sharing is supported by the participating MCData function?
q_40311.ground_truth: The MCData client checks for the Resource-Share header field with the value "supported" in the third-party SIP REGISTER request from the participating MCData function.

q_40312.question: What is the purpose of testing the transmission power accuracy of a Base Station?
q_40312.ground_truth: The purpose is to verify the accuracy of the maximum carrier output power across the frequency range and under normal and extreme conditions for all transmitters in the Base Station.

q_40313.question: What should an SNRM-S do after receiving an HTTP POST request message containing specific content-type and MIME body from a VAL server?
q_40313.ground_truth: The SNRM-S should determine to activate MBMS bearer and then send an MBMS bearer announcement message to the SNRM-C.

q_40314.question: What is the format of the DownlinkS1cdma2000tunnelling structure?
q_40314.ground_truth: The DownlinkS1cdma2000tunnelling structure is a SEQUENCE that contains a single field named protocolIEs, which is a ProtocolIE-Container containing a set of DownlinkS1cdma2000tunnellingIEs.

q_40315.question: What message triggers the source SeNB to stop providing user data to the UE and initiate data forwarding if applicable during a handover procedure?

q_40316.question: What is the response from the eNB if the Initial Context Setup procedure fails?
q_40316.ground_truth: In case of failure, eNB and MME behaviors are not mandated. Both implicit release (local release at each node) and explicit release (MME-initiated UE Context Release procedure) may be adopted. The eNB should ensure that no hanging resources remain at the eNB.

q_40317.question: What action should the network take upon receiving an AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message from the UE with 5GMM cause #20 "MAC failure"?
q_40317.ground_truth: The network may initiate the identification procedure to obtain the SUCI from the UE and check if the 5G-GUTI used in the 5G authentication challenge corresponded to the correct SUPI. If the mapping of 5G-GUTI to SUPI in the network is incorrect, the network should respond with a new AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message.

q_40318.question: What is the condition that the UE should satisfy to report ACK/NACK from the first DL reception scheduled on Cell 2 after T5?
q_40318.ground_truth: The UE should report ACK/NACK from the first DL reception scheduled on Cell 2 after T5, and not send periodical CSI report on Cell 1 during the entire time period T5.

q_40319.question: What is the importance of the NRM defined by the E-UTRAN NRM IRP in providing support for telecommunication network management purposes and converged networks?
q_40319.ground_truth: The NRM defined by the E-UTRAN NRM IRP plays a critical role in providing support for telecommunication network management purposes, including the management of converged networks. It aids in ensuring efficient and effective management of network resources and ensuring seamless integration of multiple access technologies.

q_40320.question: What is the output of the corresponding Analytics API?
q_40320.ground_truth: The output is stats or predictions on the EDN load conditions, EES or EAS load stats/predictions, and a recommendation for EAS relocation trigger (due to expected high load or edge resources).

q_40321.question: What is the Tinterrupt equation used in the handover delay Dhandover test requirement?
q_40321.ground_truth: The Tinterrupt equation used in the handover delay Dhandover test requirement is Tsearch + TIU + 20 ms, where Tsearch and TIU are the time required to search the target cell and interruption uncertainty in acquiring the first available PRACH occasion in the new cell, respectively.

q_40322.question: What should the network maintain if the authentication procedure was unsuccessful?
q_40322.ground_truth: The network should maintain the EMM-context and EPS security context unchanged upon receiving an AUTHENTICATION REJECT message during an unsuccessful authentication procedure.

q_40323.question: What is the limit that the MAC entity at the SN applies to the scheduled uplink radio traffic at the SN for the UE in all MR-DC cases?
q_40323.ground_truth: The MAC entity at the SN applies the received UL UE AMBR limit to the scheduled uplink radio traffic at the SN for the UE.

q_40324.question: What action must the AMF take when authorization is revoked for an S-NSSAI that is in the current allowed NSSAI for an access type?
q_40324.ground_truth: The AMF must provide a new allowed NSSAI to the UE, excluding the S-NSSAI for which authorization is revoked; and provide a new rejected NSSAI for the failed or revoked NSSAA, including the S-NSSAI in the rejected NSSAI for which the authorization is revoked, with the rejection cause "S-NSSAI not available due to the failed or revoked network slice-specific authentication and authorization".

q_40325.question: What is the main benefit of RAN delay budget reporting for UEs in poor coverage?
q_40325.ground_truth: The main benefit is that it allows UEs to locally adjust air interface delay, improve reliability of uplink transmissions, reduce packet loss, and enhance end-to-end delay and quality performance.

q_40326.question: What is the purpose of the "Associate new ProSe application(s) with existing PC5 QoS flow(s)" link modification operation code in clause 7.7.2.2a?
q_40326.ground_truth: This link modification operation code is used to associate new ProSe applications with existing PC5 QoS flows, allowing for the modification of QoS parameters or the addition of new QoS flows to the existing 5G ProSe direct link.

q_40327.question: What is the purpose of the TMGI field and the Alternative TMGI fields in the Bearer Announcement message?
q_40327.ground_truth: The TMGI field is used to identify the Multimedia Broadcast Multicast Service (MBMS) service, and the Alternative TMGI fields are used to provide additional identities for the same service.

q_40328.question: What should the MAC entity do if a HARQ process receives downlink feedback information and acknowledgement is indicated?
q_40328.ground_truth: The MAC entity should stop the drx-RetransmissionTimerUL for the corresponding HARQ process.

q_40329.question: How much isolation improvement is expected after mounting EM absorber materials next to the antenna array in the base station?

q_40330.question: What information is provided in N2 messages when a User Equipment (UE) is served by a cell of this MBSR?
q_40330.ground_truth: The 'Additional ULI' and User Location Information are provided in N2 messages when a UE is served by a cell of this MBSR.

q_40331.question: What is the time period used for the UE to identify a new UTRA TDD cell in the inter RAT equation?
q_40331.ground_truth: The time period used for the UE to identify a new UTRA TDD cell in the inter RAT equation is 800 ms.

q_40332.question: What should the MS do if an unknown field is recognized within a known Access Technology Type?
q_40332.ground_truth: The MS should ignore the unknown field if it is recognized within a known Access Technology Type.

q_40333.question: What should the MBMS GW do upon detecting a non-transient SGi-mb path failure?
q_40333.ground_truth: Upon detecting a non-transient SGi-mb path failure, the MBMS GW may tear down the affected MBMS sessions by sending MBMS Session Stop Request message(s) to the MME/SGSN(s) serving the MBMS sessions and Session Termination Request message(s) to the BM-SC with a terminating cause signalling a user plane failure.

q_40334.question: What is the SMF's role for secondary authentication/authorization by a DN-AAA server during the establishment of a PDN connection over 3GPP access to EPC?
q_40334.ground_truth: A SMF+PGW-C shall be used to serve DNN(s) requiring secondary authentication/authorization by a DN-AAA server, and the SMF+PGW-C runs the same procedures with PCF, UDM and DN-AAA regardless of whether the UE is served by EPS or 5GS.

q_40335.question: What is the action taken by the UE when operating in NB-S1 mode and receiving an "Extended wait time CP data" in the SERVICE REJECT message?
q_40335.ground_truth: If the UE is operating in NB-S1 mode and supports the timer T3448, it starts the timer T3448 with the "Extended wait time CP data" value. If the UE does not support the timer T3448, it starts the timer T3346 with the "Extended wait time CP data" value. Otherwise, it ignores the "Extended wait time CP data" and proceeds normally.

q_40336.question: What is the maximum output power measured for any transmission bandwidth within the aggregated channel bandwidth in EN-DC of E-UTRA and NR in FR1?
q_40336.ground_truth: The maximum output power is measured as the sum of the maximum output power at each UE antenna connector.

q_40337.question: What action must the UE take after receiving a SECURITY MODE COMMAND message that can be accepted?
q_40337.ground_truth: The UE must take the EPS security context indicated in the message into use and reset the uplink NAS COUNT counter if specified conditions are met.

q_40338.question: What happens to the UE Radio Capability for Paging Information if the UE performs an Attach procedure or a Tracking Area Update procedure for the "first TAU following GERAN/UTRAN/ Attach" or for "UE radio capability update"?
q_40338.ground_truth: The MME deletes all UE Radio Capability for Paging Information that it has stored for that UE.

q_40339.question: What is the expected use case for "Service Indication" associated with emergency request in the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay?
q_40339.ground_truth: It is expected that at least one remote UE emergency service should be concurrently supported by the 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay in addition to the "Emergency Request" from the 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay.

q_40340.question: What should the en-gNB do when it receives the SGNB MODIFICATION REQUEST message containing the RLC Mode IE for an E-RAB in the E-RABs To Be Added Item IE?
q_40340.ground_truth: The en-gNB should consider the RLC Mode IE indicated in the E-RABs To Be Added Item IE in the SGNB MODIFICATION REQUEST message as the mode that the MeNB used for the E-RAB when it was hosted at the MeNB.

q_40341.question: Under what conditions will an MME send a Modify Access Bearers Request message as part of a UE triggered Service Request procedure if there is no suspended bearer for that UE?
q_40341.ground_truth: The MME will send a Modify Access Bearers Request message if the RAT type has not changed, the Serving Network has not changed, the MME does not need to report a H(e)NB local IP address and UDP port number information change, the MME does not need to send UE's location and/or User CSG information or/and UE Time Zone and/or Presence Reporting Area information to the PDN GW, and the MME does not need to send an MME-FQ-CSID as per the requirements.
