q_41055.ground_truth: It stops sending transmission control messages, requests the network media interface to stop sending RTP media packets, ignores any transmission control messages received from the associated transmission participant, requests the network media interface to stop forwarding RTP media packets from the associated MCVideo client to the media distributor, and indicates to the transmission control server arbitration logic that the MCVideo client has started to disconnect from the MCVideo call.

q_41056.question: What is the role of the UPF when the SMF authorizes a PDU Session of Ethernet PDU type and the DN-AAA server provides a list of allowed MAC addresses?
q_41056.ground_truth: The SMF sets corresponding filtering rules in the UPF(s) acting as PDU Session Anchor for the PDU Session and the UPF discards any UL traffic that does not contain any of these MAC addresses as a source address.

q_41057.question: What are the two types of messages specified in IEC 61850 standard for DER communication?
q_41057.ground_truth: The two types of messages specified in IEC 61850 standard for DER communication are GOOSE (Generic Object Oriented Substation Events) and SV (Sampled Values) messages. GOOSE messages are typically used to transfer information closely related to monitoring and control functions, while SV messages are used to transfer numerical samples of current and voltage signals.

q_41058.question: In what mechanism does the PDN GW use when triggering the basic P-CSCF restoration mechanism?
q_41058.ground_truth: The PDN GW sends a Session Termination Request to the 3GPP AAA Server.

q_41059.question: What is used to mark the stored 5GS NAS security context as invalid in the EF5GS3GPPNSC file?
q_41059.ground_truth: To mark the stored 5GS NAS security context as invalid in the EF5GS3GPPNSC file, the record bytes can be set to 'FF', the ngKSI can be set to '07', or the length indicated in the KAMF TLV can be set to '00'.

q_41060.question: When must a UE in NB-IoT acquire the SystemInformationBlockType31-NB?
q_41060.ground_truth: A UE in NB-IoT must acquire the SystemInformationBlockType31-NB upon expiry of T317, where the UE is only required to acquire the SystemInformationBlockType31-NB in NB-IoT.

q_41061.question: What are the E-UTRAN E-CID measurement requirements for PScell and SCell carrier frequencies, and non-serving E-UTRA carrier frequencies?
q_41061.ground_truth: The E-UTRAN E-CID measurement requirements for PScell and SCell carrier frequencies are specified in section 8.19.5, and for non-serving E-UTRA carrier frequencies are specified in section 8.19.3.

q_41062.question: What is the response status code for a successful creation of a new Policy in the NSCE Server?
q_41062.ground_truth: The NSCE Server responds with an HTTP "201 Created" status code for a successful creation of a new Policy.

q_41063.question: What special co-location requirements may apply for unsynchronized TDD base stations that are co-located and using the same or adjacent operating bands?
q_41063.ground_truth: Special co-location requirements may apply for unsynchronized TDD base stations that are co-located and using the same or adjacent operating bands, which are not covered by the 3GPP specifications.

q_41064.question: What should the MCVideo client contain in the SIP INVITE request when pulling a video from a MCVideo server?
q_41064.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should contain an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body with the <mcvideoinfo> element containing the <mcvideo-Params> element with the <session-type> element set to a value of "one-from-server video pull" and the <video-pull-url> element set to the URL of the video file to be streamed.

q_41065.question: What action is it implementation dependent for the UE when the expiration time has expired and the time indicated by the Retry-After header field does not elapse?
q_41065.ground_truth: It is implementation dependent for the UE whether it sends reregistration due to RAT change or feature tag, which includes the ICSI values that the UE intends to use in a g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag or IARI values that the UE intends to use in the g.3gpp.iari-ref media feature tag during the time indicated by the Retry-After header field.

q_41066.question: Under what circumstances do multi-slot PUCCH requirement tests apply?
q_41066.ground_truth: The multi-slot PUCCH requirement tests apply only if the SAN supports multi-slot PUCCH.

q_41067.question: What kind of scheduling restrictions does the UE cause for inter-frequency SSB based measurements without gap?
q_41067.ground_truth: The UE may cause scheduling restrictions for inter-frequency SSB based measurements without gap as specified in clause 9.3.9.4.

q_41068.question: In the case where a SIP REFER request was sent for an MCPTT emergency group call, what should the MCPTT client do if the MCPTT emergency group call state is set to "MEGC 2: emergency-call-requested", and the REFER request contains an <emergency-ind> element set to a value of "true" but does not contain an <imminentperil-ind> element?
q_41068.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should set the MCPTT emergency group state to "MEG 2: in-progress" if it was not already set, and set the MCPTT emergency group call state to "MEGC 3: emergency-call-granted".

q_41069.question: What information does the Serving GW indicate to the PCRF after step B.1 in the Gateway Control and QoS Policy Rules Request Procedure?
q_41069.ground_truth: The Serving GW indicates to the PCRF whether the requested QoS Policy Rules Provision could be enforced or not and indicates User Location Information and/or UE Time Zone Information to the PCRF as an Event Report if the corresponding event trigger is set.

q_41070.question: What is the structure of the 5GS Tracking Area Identity based ePDG FQDN using a 3 octet TAC?
q_41070.ground_truth: The 5GS Tracking Area Identity based ePDG FQDN using a 3 octet TAC is constructed as "tac-lb<TAC-low-byte>.tac-mb<TAC-middle-byte>.tac-hb<TAC-high-byte>.5gstac.epdg.epc.mnc<MNC>.mcc<MCC>.pub.3gppnetwork.org"

q_41071.question: In what scenario would the UE set the failureType as "t310-Expiry" when initiating the transmission of the MCGFailureInformation message?
q_41071.ground_truth: This would occur when the UE initiates transmission of the MCGFailureInformation message due to the expiry of T310.

q_41072.question: What should the MAC entity do when it successfully decodes data in a transport block (TB) and receives a subsequent uplink grant for that TB?
q_41072.ground_truth: The MAC entity should generate a positive acknowledgement (ACK) of the data in this TB.

q_41073.question: If the HTTP DELETE request message from the NF service consumer is accepted, what status code will the BSF send in response?
q_41073.ground_truth: The BSF will respond with an "204 No Content" status code.

q_41074.question: What action is taken after the list "Logged ANR Report Info List" is cleared?
q_41074.ground_truth: After the list is cleared, AM RLC (Abstract Mobile Station Radio Link Control) is used to transmit a UE INFORMATION RESPONSE message on the uplink DCCH (Dedicated Channel).

q_41075.question: What does the "Ci2" field indicate in the IAB-DU Beam Restricted MAC CE?
q_41075.ground_truth: The "Ci2" field in the IAB-DU Beam Restricted MAC CE indicates whether the octet containing the multiplexing mode info IDij field is included or not for each restricted beam within the resource set.

q_41076.question: What is conveyed within an IP-Sec tunnel when the IP-Sec Transport Layer Address IE is present and the GTP Transport Layer Addresses IE within the eNB X2 Extended Transport Layer Addresses IE is not empty?
q_41076.ground_truth: GTP traffic is conveyed within an IP-Sec tunnel terminated at the IP-Sec tunnel end point given in by the IP-Sec Transport Layer Address IE.

q_41077.question: What happens to the traffic type when a UE switches communication paths for the ProSe service?
q_41077.ground_truth: The same traffic type, whether IP type, Ethernet type, or Unstructured type, is maintained between the two communication paths.

q_41078.question: What does the MBMS-Flags AVP provide control indications for?
q_41078.ground_truth: The MBMS-Flags AVP provides control indications for the management of the broadcast or multicast connection in the network, including the setup and release of resources.

q_41079.question: What is the significance of considering the SCell as the serving cell in event A6 of the 3GPP specification?
q_41079.ground_truth: The significance of considering the SCell as the serving cell in event A6 is that the neighbor(s) is/are on the same frequency as the SCell, i.e. both are on the frequency indicated in the associated measObject.

q_41080.question: What interfaces are used in Procedure invoking external product order after receiving product order from NSC?
q_41080.ground_truth: The interface between the NSC and BSS of the NSP, the interface between the BSS of the NSP and BSS of the CSP, the interface between the BSS and the OSS both belonging to the CSP, and the interface between the OSS and the BSS both belonging to the CSP.

q_41081.question: What should the UE do if the timer value in the Back-off timer value IE is not zero, and the timer value is not deactivated or indicates zero, for the bearer resource allocation procedure in the same PLMN and APN combination?
q_41081.ground_truth: The UE shall not send another BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST message in the PLMN for the same APN until the back-off timer expires, the UE is switched off or the USIM is removed.

q_41082.question: What action will the transmission participant interface take when it receives a Transmission Revoked message with the Reject Cause field set to #3?
q_41082.ground_truth: The transmission participant interface will send a Transmission Revoked message to the transmission participant with the Reject Cause field set to #3 (No permission to send a Media Burst), store that a Transmission Release message is expected from the transmission participant, and remain in the 'P: has no permission' state.

q_41083.question: What information must the SLM-C include in the CoAP 2.05 (Content) response when notifying location information?
q_41083.ground_truth: The SLM-C shall include one or more "LocationReport" objects, each "LocationReport" object containing the "valTgtUe", "triggerIds", and "locInfo" attributes.

q_41084.question: In what scenario should the SCC AS send a SIP re-INVITE request towards the remote UE?
q_41084.ground_truth: The SCC AS should send a SIP re-INVITE request towards the remote UE if there are confirmed dialogs supporting a session with active speech media component in the transferable session set.

q_41085.question: What is the purpose of periodic updating in the mobile station?
q_41085.ground_truth: Periodic updating is used to notify periodically the availability of the mobile station to the network and it is performed by using the location updating procedure.

q_41086.question: In which 3GPP document are the starting mechanisms for signalling based MDT in the 5GC described?
q_41086.ground_truth: The starting mechanisms for signalling based MDT in the 5GC are described in 3GPP document TS 23.501.

q_41087.question: What is the purpose of the MPEG Network-Based Media Processing (NBMP) specification?
q_41087.ground_truth: The NBMP specification defines data structures for describing workflows and methods for managing them to enable dynamic creation of media processing pipelines and access to processed media data and metadata in real time or in a deferred way.

q_41088.question: In what scenario is it assumed that multiple UEs involved in a multi-modal service with a flow group policy may be served by multiple PCFs?
q_41088.ground_truth: In the scenario for NEF-based coordination across multiple PCFs for multi-modal flow groups with multiple UEs (Solution #64)

q_41089.question: What is the specification used for TLS with OAuth token in the TLS with OAuth token method?
q_41089.ground_truth: The OAuth 2.0 with authorization code grant model is used for TLS with OAuth token in the TLS with OAuth token method.

q_41090.question: What is the content type specified for HTTP bodies in the present specification?
q_41090.ground_truth: JSON (application/json) is the content type specified for HTTP bodies in the present specification.

q_41091.question: What should the NEF do after receiving a successful response from the UDM, if the NEF received from the UDM an error response with the "cause" attribute indicating an application error?
q_41091.ground_truth: The NEF shall relay this error response to the AF with a corresponding application error, when applicable.

q_41092.question: What is the mandatory HTTP version for SEAL APIs?

q_41093.question: What should the MCVideo client do when receiving a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message with a matching MCVideo group ID IE in the "S6: ignoring incoming call announcements" state?
q_41093.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should store the SDP body, call identifier, originating MCVideo user ID, refresh interval, and call start time of the call, stop timer TFG5, start timer TFG5, and remain in the "S6: ignoring incoming call announcements" state.

q_41094.question: Which message is sent by the eNB to inform the MME that resources for the handover have been prepared at the target side?

q_41095.question: What should the UE include in the Supported header field of the REGISTER request if it supports GRUU and multiple registrations?

q_41096.question: What should the transmission control interface do when it receives a Transmission Revoke message from the transmission control server arbitration logic in the MCVideo server?
q_41096.ground_truth: The transmission control interface should forward the Transmission Revoke message to the transmission participant and enter the state 'U pending Transmit Revoke'.

q_41097.question: What type of information can the UE be provided with via the higher layer parameter NR-TRP-BeamAntennaInfo?
q_41097.ground_truth: The UE can be provided with beam/antenna information via the higher layer parameter NR-TRP-BeamAntennaInfo.

q_41098.question: What are the permitted test methods for transmission and reception tests in 5.1.1.3?
q_41098.ground_truth: The permitted test methods for transmission and reception tests in 5.1.1.3 are DFF, DFF with simplification for centre of beam measurements, IFF, and NFTF.

q_41099.question: What information does the SMF use to determine that all the QoS Flows of a PDU Session are rejected by the target NG-RAN during handover procedure?
q_41099.ground_truth: The SMF receives the notification from the AMF about the failed PDU Session setup.

q_41100.question: What is the action taken if the ratio (NACK /ACK + NACK) is greater than 0.1 in step 4 and step 7?
q_41100.ground_truth: The UE is passed for this test in both step 4 and step 7 if the ratio (NACK /ACK + NACK) is greater than 0.1.

q_41101.question: What does the UPF send to the 5G core (5GC) when it detects 5GS networking timing synchronization status changes?
q_41101.ground_truth: The UPF sends reporting to the 5GC when it detects changes in the 5GS networking timing synchronization status for the original 5G GM timing source. The report contains events like recovery or degradation of the timing source and the corresponding clock class and time validity.

q_41102.question: What is the role of the SCS (Services Capability Server) in the 3GPP system?
q_41102.ground_truth: The SCS in the 3GPP system provides value-added services for MTC and performs user plane and/or control plane communication with the UE, making Tsp a control plane interface internal to the PLMN.

q_41103.question: What should the UE do if the message has been successfully integrity checked by the NAS and the message was received via 3GPP access in single-registration mode?
q_41103.ground_truth: The UE shall set the EPS update status to EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, reset the tracking area updating attempt counter, enter the state EMM-REGISTERED, and handle the EMM parameters as specified in 3GPP TS 24.301 for the case when the normal tracking area updating procedure is rejected with the same EMM cause value.

q_41104.question: What RFC defines the "altc" attribute used to indicate alternate IP address versions in SDP offers?

q_41105.question: What happens to the UE's update status when it is operating in CS/PS mode 1 or CS/PS mode 2?
q_41105.ground_truth: The UE shall set the update status to U2 NOT UPDATED.

q_41106.question: What is the format of the Queued User ID value if its length is not a multiple of 4 bytes?
q_41106.ground_truth: If the length of the Queued User ID value is not a multiple of 4 bytes, it is padded to a multiple of 4 bytes, with padding bytes set to zero.

q_41107.question: What subframes are excluded from the SI-window for DL-SCH reception?
q_41107.ground_truth: Subframe #5 in radio frames for which SFN mod 2 = 0, any MBSFN subframes, and any uplink subframes in TDD.

q_41108.question: What should the gNB-CU-UP do if it receives a BEARER CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message containing a Security Indication Modify IE in the PDU Session Resource To Modify List IE for a PDU session that may result in the change of security status, but the DRBs that have been established for that PDU session are not requested to be released via the DRB To Remove List IEs?
q_41108.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-UP should respond with a BEARER CONTEXT MODIFICATION FAILURE message and appropriate cause value.

q_41109.question: What should the SCC AS do when it receives a SIP 200 (OK) response to the initial SIP INVITE request due to STI containing no media line whose port is set to zero?
q_41109.ground_truth: It shall send a SIP BYE request on the Source Access Leg to terminate the dialog on the Source Access Leg if the dialog is still active.

q_41110.question: What is the applicable range for the reported RSRP in 9.1.12.1.4?
q_41110.ground_truth: The reporting range of RSRP is from -140 dBm to -44 dBm with 1 dB resolution.

q_41111.question: What should the initiating UE do upon receiving a PROSE DIRECT LINK REKEYING REQUEST message that includes a Re-authentication indication?
q_41111.ground_truth: The initiating UE should pass the PROSE DIRECT LINK REKEYING REQUEST message to the lower layers for transmission along with its own layer-2 ID for unicast communication and the target UE's layer-2 ID for unicast communication. The UE should then start timer T5091 and should not send a new PROSE DIRECT LINK REKEYING REQUEST message to the same target UE while timer T5091 is running.

q_41112.question: What is the purpose of the UE-CapabilityRAT-RequestList?
q_41112.ground_truth: The UE-CapabilityRAT-RequestList is used to request UE capabilities for one or more RATs from the UE.

q_41113.question: What is the measurement provided by the "5.1.1.6.6.9 Number of successful conditional handover executions" metric?
q_41113.ground_truth: The number of successful conditional handover executions received by the source gNB.

q_41114.question: When does the IWF sends IWF group call response to the MCPTT server in an encrypted group call with transcoding?
q_41114.ground_truth: After the IWF receives and decrypts the voice media from the MCPTT client, transcodes it to a LMR codec, re-encrypts it if necessary, and forwards it to the LMR system.

q_41115.question: When sending a SIP message with multiple MIME bodies, what should be the position of the application/sdp MIME body?
q_41115.ground_truth: The application/sdp MIME body should be inserted as the first MIME body.

q_41116.question: What happens if the re-authentication of the user is not successful in the STa Re-Authentication procedure?
q_41116.ground_truth: If the re-authentication of the user is not successful, the trusted non-3GPP access network will release all the active PDN connections of the user, except for emergency PDN connections.

q_41117.question: What should the MS do when timer T3319 is running and it receives a Service Request with service type "data"?
q_41117.ground_truth: The MS should not issue the service request unless the flag in the Uplink data status IE has not been set in the last Service Request for the same PDP context.

q_41118.question: What conditions must be met for the source gNB to request the UE for a second time measurement in the Handover procedure?
q_41118.ground_truth: The source gNB must have the feature of second measurement enabled, and the second UE MR must meet the HO trigger condition.

q_41119.question: What is the procedure for USS to authorize direct C2 communication to the USS?
q_41119.ground_truth: In 5GS, the UUAA-MM procedure may be used to authorize direct C2 communication. If the authorization request for Direct C2 Communication is included in step 1, the USS sends the C2 Authorization result and in the case of success, may include a direct C2 pairing information containing the UAV-C's Application Layer ID in the C2 Authorization Payload.

q_41120.question: What is the basis for the responding 5G ProSe End UE to select a new 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay in the negotiated 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay reselection procedure?
q_41120.ground_truth: The responding 5G ProSe End UE selects a new 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay based on the Relay re-selection indication in the Link Modification Request message.

q_41121.question: When do the PUSCH requirement tests apply for different subcarrier spacings in the context of interlaced PUSCH?
q_41121.ground_truth: Unless otherwise stated, the PUSCH requirement tests apply for each subcarrier spacing declared to be supported for interlaced PUSCH. However, if both 15 KHz and 30 KHz SCS are declared to be supported, the tests should be done for 30 KHz SCS.

q_41122.question: What is the condition for the SS to increase the number of successes for the event "Activation" in the test procedure?
q_41122.ground_truth: The SS increases the number of successes for the event "Activation" if a CSI report with a non-zero CQI index is received for the SCell earlier than or equal to a specific subframe or next available uplink resource and DTX in PCell is not observed in certain subframes up to the end of T2.

q_41123.question: What is the goal of synchronous federated learning in "Flocking"?
q_41123.ground_truth: In synchronous federated learning, the goal is to eliminate bias and allow diverse users and devices to participate, ensuring diversity in input data and avoiding a focus on only the "best performing devices."

q_41124.question: When can the location updating procedure be started?
q_41124.ground_truth: The location updating procedure can be started during an RR connection and under specific conditions, such as after network connection request has been rejected, during network operation mode I or II, after a manual network selection, or after entering a new routing area.

q_41125.question: In what situations should the SidelinkUEInformationNR message be transmitted to indicate the UE no longer requires NR sidelink non-relay discovery message resources?
q_41125.ground_truth: The SidelinkUEInformationNR message should be transmitted if the UE is not required to transmit NR sidelink non-relay discovery messages and the last transmission of the SidelinkUEInformationNR message included sl-TxResourceReqListDisc.

q_41126.question: What should the AMF do when it receives the REGISTRATION REQUEST message with a protocol error during the initial registration procedure?
q_41126.ground_truth: The AMF should return a REGISTRATION REJECT message with one of the 5GMM cause values: #96 (invalid mandatory information), #99 (information element non-existent or not implemented), #100 (conditional IE error), or #111 (protocol error, unspecified).

q_41127.question: What is the requirement for the 5G system to support service continuity for a remote UE in the context of changing from a direct network connection to an indirect network connection?
q_41127.ground_truth: The 5G system shall support service continuity for a remote UE, when the remote UE changes from one relay UE to another and both relay UEs use 3GPP access to the 5G core network.

q_41128.question: What should the MCPTT client do when receiving a GROUP CALL PROBE message when the stored probe response value of the call is set to "false"?
q_41128.ground_truth: When receiving a GROUP CALL PROBE message when the stored probe response value of the call is set to "false", the MCPTT client should stop timer TFG2, start timer TFG2 with the value as specified in clause~10.2.2.4.1.1.2, set the stored probe response of the call to "true", and remain in the "S3: part of ongoing call" state.

q_41129.question: In the context of i to vii, if the MS detects a PLMN in satellite NG-RAN access technology which fulfills certain conditions, what should the MS not consider as a PLMN selection candidate?
q_41129.ground_truth: The MS shall not consider the PLMN as a PLMN selection candidate for satellite NG-RAN access technology.

q_41130.question: In what situation would removing packet filters from an existing QoS rule cause an error if there are two or more QoS rules associated with the specific PDU session with the same precedence values?
q_41130.ground_truth: This would result in an error because it could create ambiguity in the QoS rule priority and disrupt the proper functioning of the network.

q_41131.question: What should be the timing error between IAB-DU and IAB-MT simultaneous transmission for MIMO transmission at each carrier frequency for IAB type 1-O?
q_41131.ground_truth: The timing error between IAB-DU and IAB-MT simultaneous transmission should not exceed 90 ns at each carrier frequency.

q_41132.question: Which of the five parameters in the ExitSpecificArea section is used to define a polygon area using latitude and longitude values, with data type 0-16777215?

q_41133.question: What action does the floor control interface need to take when it receives a Floor Taken message while in the 'U: not permitted and Floor Idle' state?
q_41133.ground_truth: Forward the Floor Taken message to the associated floor participant and enter the 'U: not permitted and Floor Taken' state.

q_41134.question: What new rejection cause value should be included in the AMF's Registration Reject message if all the Requested NSSAI(s) are rejected in the current TA?
q_41134.ground_truth: The new rejection cause value is defined as "No S-NSSAI available in the current tracking area".

q_41135.question: What is the required restriction for the UE if it doesn't support simultaneousRxDataSSB-DiffNumerology in FR1, when the SSB for RLM, BFD, CBD or L1-RSRP measurement is within the active BWP and has different SCS than CSI-RS for CBD measurement?
q_41135.ground_truth: If the UE does not support simultaneousRxDataSSB-DiffNumerology, the UE is required to measure one of but not both CSI-RS for CBD measurement and SSB. A longer measurement period for CSI-RS based CBD measurement is expected, and no requirements are defined.

q_41136.question: What is the requirement for the protection of the BS receiver of the same or different BS in the same geographical area, as specified in clause 6.6.5.5.1.2?
q_41136.ground_truth: The requirement for protection of the BS receiver of the same or different BS is to prevent the desensitization of the BS receiver by emissions from a BS transmitter.

q_41137.question: What is the responsibility of the AF in the establishment of broadcast MBS session?
q_41137.ground_truth: The AF performs TMGI allocation and MBS session creation as specified in clause~7.1.1.2 or 7.1.1.3 to establish broadcast MBS session, with the MBS service type indicating to be broadcast service.

q_41138.question: What happens when the UE has an IP packet for transmission and the IP header only satisfies a packet filter in the UL TFT for the default EPS bearer in 22.6.1.1.1 (3)?
q_41138.ground_truth: The UE transmits the IP packet in uplink on the default EPS bearer.

q_41139.question: What is the applicability of the TDD-TDD Inter Frequency WB-RSRQ test in 3GPP TS 36.133?
q_41139.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA TDD UE release 11 and forward that support wideband RSRQ measurement and support FGI bits 16 and 25.

q_41140.question: What should the mobile station do when the security context is successfully established in a UMTS authentication challenge?
q_41140.ground_truth: After a successful UMTS authentication challenge, the MS and network will store the UMTS ciphering key, UMTS integrity key, GSM ciphering key, and the ciphering key sequence number on their respective devices.

q_41141.question: When must the MAC entity not indicate the generated positive or negative acknowledgement for a HARQ process to the physical layer?
q_41141.ground_truth: The MAC entity must not indicate the generated positive or negative acknowledgement for a HARQ process to the physical layer if the HARQ process is associated with a transmission indicated with a Temporary C-RNTI and the Contention Resolution is not yet successful, if the HARQ process is equal to the broadcast process, or if the timeAlignmentTimer is stopped or expired.

q_41142.question: What is the functionality of the ECS Modification use case?
q_41142.ground_truth: The ECS Modification use case allows a consumer to modify the ECS instance in the EDN. If the modification requires changing the virtualized resource of the ECS VNF instance, the provisioning MnS producer requests the NFVO in ETSI NFV MANO for the appropriate operation of the ECS VNF instances.

q_41143.question: What is the maximum interruption time allowed for a UE when reselecting from one cell to another within the same satellite?
q_41143.ground_truth: The maximum interruption time allowed for a UE when reselecting from one cell to another within the same satellite is TSI-NB1-EC + 100 ms.

q_41144.question: What is the purpose of defining the different versions of a document in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_41144.ground_truth: The purpose of defining the different versions of a document in the 3GPP Technical Specification is to indicate the level of approval or modification of the document.

q_41145.question: When should the UE set reducedMaxCCs in the OverheatingAssistance IE?
q_41145.ground_truth: If the UE prefers to temporarily reduce the number of maximum secondary component carriers for SCG in (NG)EN-DC.

q_41146.question: What is the test applicability for intra-band non-contiguous EN-DC (2 DL CCs)?
q_41146.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 15 and forward, supporting intra-band non-contiguous EN-DC in FR1 with 2 DL CCs.

q_41147.question: What is the action that the UE shall take in subclause 5.2.3.2.1.e) if it is acting as a 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE?
q_41147.ground_truth: Initiate the authentication and key agreement procedure.

q_41148.question: What does the "FFS" abbreviation stand for in the provided document?
q_41148.ground_truth: "FFS" stands for "Further Functional Specification" in the provided document.

q_41149.question: What is the main issue addressed by Solution #32?
q_41149.ground_truth: The main issue addressed by Solution #32 is the enhancement of dynamic EAS instantiation triggering for efficient utilization of EDN resources for EAS deployment.

q_41150.question: What does PUSCH refer to as per the specifications?
q_41150.ground_truth: PUSCH refers to the uplink physical shared channel as per the specifications.

q_41151.question: What message does the SN include in the SN Addition Request Acknowledge message to provide data forwarding addresses to the MN in the SN Addition procedure?
q_41151.ground_truth: The SN includes data forwarding addresses to the MN in the SN Addition Request Acknowledge message if data forwarding is needed in the SN Addition procedure.

q_41152.question: What should the UP function include in the Volume Measurement IE in the Usage Report for the volume-based measurement method?
q_41152.ground_truth: The UP function should include all the counters (Total, Uplink and Downlink) of the URR in the Volume Measurement IE and the number of packets counted for Total, Uplink, Downlink if requested by the CP function and if the UP function supports the MNOP feature.

q_41153.question: What should the UE do when it receives a DETACH REQUEST message before the tracking area updating procedure has been completed?
q_41153.ground_truth: The tracking area updating procedure shall be aborted, and the detach procedure shall be progressed.

q_41154.question: What should the UE do if the redir-policy bit is set to "Unsecured redirection to GERAN or UTRAN not allowed" in the Network policy IE of the TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message?
q_41154.ground_truth: The UE shall set the network policy on unsecured redirection to GERAN or UTRAN for the current PLMN to "Unsecured redirection to GERAN or UTRAN not allowed" and indicate to the lower layers that unsecured redirection to a GERAN or UTRAN cell is not allowed.

q_41155.question: When does the mobile station initiate the RR connection establishment procedure?
q_41155.ground_truth: The mobile station initiates the RR connection establishment procedure by sending PACKET CS REQUEST messages on the PACCH.

q_41156.question: What is the data model for the 5GLANParameterProvision API?
q_41156.ground_truth: The data model for the 5GLANParameterProvision API is specified in clause~5.7.2 of the specification and includes data types and structured data types.

q_41157.question: What security measures are used to secure the interface between the 5G ProSe UE and the 5G U2U Relay PKMF?
q_41157.ground_truth: The security for the interface between the 5G Prose UE and the 5G U2U Relay PKMF relies on Ua security if GBA specified in TS 33.220 is used, or Ua* security if AKMA specified in TS 33.535 is used.

q_41158.question: What is the role of the UE channel bandwidth in NR operations?
q_41158.ground_truth: The UE channel bandwidth is the supported bandwidth for a single NR RF carrier in the uplink or downlink at the UE. The UE is unaware of the BS channel bandwidth or how the BS allocates bandwidth to different UEs.

q_41159.question: What is the range for differential PRS-RSRPP reporting?
q_41159.ground_truth: The reporting range of differential PRS-RSRPP is from -30 dB to 30 dB with 1~dB resolution.

q_41160.question: What is the recommended stereo indication type for frame compatible H.264/AVC in a 3GP file?
q_41160.ground_truth: The recommended stereo indication type for frame compatible H.264/AVC in a 3GP file is the stereo indication type that identifies the frame packing arrangement type by using the values defined by the frame packing arrangement SEI.

q_41161.question: Which frequency is supported in the test case for NR SA FR2 event-triggered reporting without gap in DRX?
q_41161.ground_truth: The test case for NR SA FR2 event-triggered reporting without gap in DRX supports a frequency less than or equal to 40.8 GHz.

q_41162.question: What should an AF include in the "suppFeat" attribute in the MBS Parameters Provisioning procedure for multicast MBS Session Assistance information provisioning?
q_41162.ground_truth: In the MBS Parameters Provisioning procedure for multicast MBS Session Assistance information provisioning, the AF should include the features supported by the AF in the "suppFeat" attribute, which shall include the support of the "5MBS2" feature.

q_41163.question: What is the effect of the special form of the set command, +CGDCONT=<cid>, in the +CGDCONT command?
q_41163.ground_truth: The special form of the set command, +CGDCONT=<cid>, causes the values for context number <cid> to become undefined.

q_41164.question: What should the service consumer send to the NSCE Server to request multiple slices optimization?
q_41164.ground_truth: The service consumer should send an HTTP POST request to the NSCE Server, with the request body including the MultiSlicesOptReq data structure, to request multiple slices optimization.

q_41165.question: What should a participating MCPTT client do when it receives a Map Group To Session Stream message over the general purpose MBS channel and participates in a group session identified by the Map Group To Session Stream message, but the status "listening" has not been reported yet?
q_41165.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT client shall send an MBS listening status report.

q_41166.question: What must the IRI-POI in the SCEF detect in order to generate an xIRI containing a SCEFMSISDNLessMOSMS record?
q_41166.ground_truth: The IRI-POI in the SCEF must detect that a target UE has sent a MSISDN-less MO SMS to an SCS/AS in order to generate an xIRI containing a SCEFMSISDNLessMOSMS record.

q_41167.question: What is the purpose of the "complex-query" query parameter in 3GPP~TS~29.571?
q_41167.ground_truth: The "complex-query" query parameter is used when a complex query expression is needed to express a query condition in a 3GPP network. It allows for logical combinations of multiple query parameters, which can be expressed in either CNF or DNF.

q_41168.question: What method allows the creation of a new Individual application AM context for a given AF?
q_41168.ground_truth: The POST method, as specified in clause 5.17.1.2.3.2 of the document, allows the creation of a new Individual application AM context for a given AF.

q_41169.question: When the SMF receives the location information from the AMF, what information about the location of the UE can the SMF encode into the "userLocationInfo" attribute?
q_41169.ground_truth: The SMF can encode both 3GPP and non-3GPP access UE location in the "userLocationInfo" attribute.

q_41170.question: What is the process followed when an MCPTT user rejoins a group call after leaving due to de-affiliation?
q_41170.ground_truth: The MCPTT client or server detects the return to coverage, the media plane between the MCPTT client and the IWF is re-established, and the IWF sends a floor taken message to the MCPTT server if anyone currently has the floor. The MCPTT server forwards the floor taken message to the MC Client if anyone currently has the floor.

q_41171.question: What is the size of the PUSCH Pathloss Reference RS ID field in the PUSCH Pathloss Reference RS Update MAC CE?

q_41172.question: What is necessary to initialize the playback platform with the codec in 5G Media Streaming?
q_41172.ground_truth: To initialize the playback platform with the codec in 5G Media Streaming, appropriate initialization information such as a CMAF Header is needed. Additionally, initialization of content decryption is needed if required by the used DRM system.

q_41173.question: What is the outcome when the gNB-DU is not able to provide the requested resources in the Multicast Distribution Setup procedure?
q_41173.ground_truth: The gNB-CU will consider the procedure as failed and reply with the MULTICAST CONTEXT SETUP FAILURE message.

q_41174.question: What requirement applies to the NCR, as specified in section 6.7.2.3, in terms of meeting the input intermodulation co-location requirements for the downlink and uplink?
q_41174.ground_truth: The requirement applies to the uplink and downlink of the repeater. If the BS side is declared to meet co-location requirements, then it should meet input intermodulation co-location requirements for the downlink, and if the UE side is declared to meet co-location requirements, then it should meet input intermodulation co-location requirements for the uplink.

q_41175.question: When would the overall RRC connection redirection delay be extended in NB-IoT?
q_41175.ground_truth: When the NPUSCH ACK transmission for the received RRC message takes longer than 110ms, the overall RRC connection redirection delay may be extended.

q_41176.question: What is the purpose of continuously sending uplink power control "up" commands in the uplink scheduling information to the UE in the 3GPP TS 36.508 standard?
q_41176.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure that the UE transmits at PUMAX level.

q_41177.question: What is the role of NG-RAN in the location service for a UE served by a mobile IAB-node?
q_41177.ground_truth: NG-RAN provides the 5G-GUTI and ULI information of the mobile IAB-node as part of the NGAP message to the AMF when a UE accesses the network via the mobile IAB-node.

q_41178.question: What is the purpose of the transaction identifier (TI) in a L3 message?
q_41178.ground_truth: The TI allows to distinguish up to 16 different bi-directional messages flows for a given protocol and a given SAP

q_41179.question: What should the SS send to the UE to indicate a switch in uplink TCI state?
q_41179.ground_truth: The SS sends a MAC-CE to indicate switch to a specific uplink TCI state at a particular slot.

q_41180.question: What is the architecture for edge deployment in Solution #3?
q_41180.ground_truth: In Solution #3, the architecture for edge deployment involves the deployment of V2X application layer services at Edge Data Network by utilizing the Edge Enabler Layer services, with interactions between V2X Application Specific client(s), VAE client, and Edge Enabler Client (EEC), and V2X Application Specific Server, VAE server, and Edge Enabler Server (EES) via specific reference points.

q_41181.question: What is the purpose of the MBS Session ID in the 5G system?
q_41181.ground_truth: The MBS session ID is used to identify a Multicast/Broadcast MBS Session by the 5G system on external interface towards AF and between AF and UE, and towards the UE. It may have types like TMGI or source specific IP multicast address.

q_41182.question: What entity acts on behalf of the FN-RG in initiating PDU Session Modification?

q_41183.question: How does the SMF send the IP address of the Local DNS Server to the Local PSA for IP address replacement in NOTE 4?
q_41183.ground_truth: The SMF sends the IP address of the Local DNS Server to the Local PSA and instructs the Local PSA to modify the packet's destination IP address (corresponding to EASDF) to that of the Local DNS Server.

q_41184.question: What action should the target NG-RAN node take if the NR V2X Services Authorized IE in the HANDOVER REQUEST message contains IEs set to "authorized" for relevant service(s)?
q_41184.ground_truth: The target NG-RAN node should consider the UE as authorized for the relevant service(s), if supported.

q_41185.question: When should the UE initiate the monitoring request procedure if it is authorized for ProSe Direct Discovery Monitoring?
q_41185.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the monitoring request procedure when it is triggered by an upper layer application to perform ProSe direct discovery monitoring and has valid Discovery Filters corresponding to the requested ProSe Application ID for that upper layer application.

q_41186.question: What is the minimum amount of MSD improvement that can be achieved through the suppression of PA H2 in Path 1?

q_41187.question: What is the pre-condition for the IWF to initiate the group regroup?
q_41187.ground_truth: At least one MC service group has been defined in the MC system and at least one MC service group has been defined in the IWF.

q_41188.question: What is the QoS handling for multicast and broadcast services in 5G?
q_41188.ground_truth: For MBS services, the network supports QoS control per MBS session, and the 5G QoS model and parameters apply with some differences, such as reflective QoS, wireline access network specific 5G QoS parameters, alternative QoS Profile, QoS Notification Control, UE-AMBR, and UE-AMBR for multicast communication service, are not applicable.

q_41189.question: What action must the UE take if it cannot accept the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message?
q_41189.ground_truth: The UE must send a SECURITY MODE REJECT message with an EMM cause indicating either a "UE security capabilities mismatch" or "security mode rejected, unspecified".

q_41190.question: What is the scope of the UPF data collection by NWDAF?
q_41190.ground_truth: The scope of the UPF data collection by NWDAF is per AoI or per S-NSSAI, which means UE level UPF data needs to be reported to the NWDAF for all UEs associated with the indicated AoI or S-NSSAI.

q_41191.question: What is the purpose of the test described in section 6.3.2.2.1.4 of the document?
q_41191.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify the behavior of the random access procedure and ensure that the PRACH power settings and timing are within specified limits.

q_41192.question: What network entity determines and updates the Mobility Pattern of the UE in 5G system?
q_41192.ground_truth: The AMF (Access and Mobility Management Function) in the 5G system determines and updates the Mobility Pattern of the UE.

q_41193.question: What does the service consumer indicate in the request to learn from the NWDAF the expected UE behavior parameters?
q_41193.ground_truth: The service consumer indicates Analytics ID and Target of Analytics Reporting (a single UE or a group of UEs) in the request to learn from the NWDAF the expected UE behavior parameters.

q_41194.question: How many sample entries can the Sample Description box have?
q_41194.ground_truth: The Sample Description box can have one or more sample entries.

q_41195.question: What should be included in the RRCConnectionReestablishmentComplete message, if the UE has radio link failure or handover failure information available in VarRLF-Report and if the RPLMN is included in plmn-IdentityList stored in VarRLF-Report?
q_41195.ground_truth: The rlf-InfoAvailable should be included in the RRCConnectionReestablishmentComplete message.

q_41196.question: What network functions handle the SIP messages in IMS?
q_41196.ground_truth: The network functions that handle the SIP messages in IMS are referred to as IMS Signalling Functions.

q_41197.question: What is the role of the SMF in the handling of PDU Sets?
q_41197.ground_truth: The SMF generates and distributes the PDU Set identification and marking rules, and distributes the PDU Set level QoS parameters.

q_41198.question: What is the channel bandwidth to be tested for the FDD-FDD intra frequency event triggered reporting under fading propagation conditions in asynchronous cells for 5MHz bandwidth test?
q_41198.ground_truth: The channel bandwidth to be tested is 5 MHz.

q_41199.question: What does the Event Producer NF indicate in the response when the request is accepted for storing data related to Event ID(s)?
q_41199.ground_truth: The response from the Event Producer NF may indicate the maximum number of notifications that the Event Producer NF expects to be able to store and / or an estimate of the duration for which notifications can be buffered.

q_41200.question: What are some of the paging optimizations that can be implemented to reduce signalling load and network resources?
q_41200.ground_truth: Some paging optimizations include sending N2 Paging messages to the last used RAN nodes, considering recommended cells and RAN nodes provided by the RAN at transition to CM-IDLE state, and considering Paging Attempt Count Information at paging.

q_41201.question: What is the primary issue addressed by Solution #6.4 regarding the separation of CHF CDR in a new TS?
q_41201.ground_truth: Solution #6.4 targets the key issue of optimizing CHF CDR representation by separating the CHF CDR in TS32.298 into a new top-level structure in a new TS or 32-series number.

q_41202.question: What is the purpose of the three tests described in 6.2.9.4.2?
q_41202.ground_truth: Test 1 verifies that the UE's behavior is correct when receiving a random access response, Test 2 verifies that the UE's behavior is correct when not receiving a random access response and Test 3 verifies that the UE's behavior is correct when the maximum number of preamble transmission counter has been reached.

q_41203.question: How many subframes after subframe (n) can DTX not be observed for the event "Deactivation" to be considered a success in the inter-band PCell TDD case?
q_41203.ground_truth: DTX should not be observed in subframes (n+5), (n+9), (n+20), (n+24), (n+35) and (n+39), subframes (n+6), (n+13), (n+21), (n+28), (n+36) and (n+40) and (n+43), subframes (n+6), (n+13), (n+21), (n+28), (n+36) and (n+43) up to the end of T3, subframes (n+7), (n+13), (n+22), (n+28), (n+36) and (n+43), up to the end of T3, or subframes (n+8) and (n+23), up to the end of T3 for the event "Deactivation" to be considered a success in the inter-band PCell TDD case.

q_41204.question: What is the purpose of the test described in section 9.2.15.1.4 of the document?
q_41204.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described in section 9.2.15.1.4 of the document is to verify the accuracy of RSRQ measurements under time domain measurement resource restriction with CRS assistance information and non-MBSFN ABS in E-UTRA FDD type UE.

q_41205.question: What is the Type: OperatorSpecificDataContainer data structure represented as in JSON format?
q_41205.ground_truth: It is an object that contains dataType value (a string), value (an object), and dataTypeDefinition (a string) fields.

q_41206.question: What traffic characteristics are supported by the FRMCS Service in Off-Network mode for autonomous train control and operation communication?
q_41206.ground_truth: The FRMCS Service in Off-Network mode supports the following traffic characteristics of data transfer for direct communication for autonomous train control and operation: Delay <10 ms, Data Rate >100 kbps, and Reliability 99.999%.

q_41207.question: How is the Cumulative Adjacent Channel Leakage power Ratio (CACLR) calculated?
q_41207.ground_truth: CACLR is calculated as the sum of the filtered mean power centered on the assigned channel frequencies for the two carriers adjacent to each side of the gap between passbands or the inter-passband gap, divided by the filtered mean power centered on a frequency channel adjacent to one of the respective repeater type 1-C passband edges.

q_41208.question: What should be done if the STMR is below the limit in the sidetone characteristics section?
q_41208.ground_truth: The measurement should be repeated with the electrical sidetone path disabled and both sets of results should be reported. If the STMR is below the limit with the electrical sidetone path disabled, it is not considered a failure.

q_41209.question: In what scenarios is it necessary for the initiating UE to self-assign a source layer-2 ID when sending a PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message?
q_41209.ground_truth: When the 5G ProSe direct communication is as a result of 5G ProSe direct discovery, or when the initiating UE is acting as a 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE with integrated discovery.

q_41210.question: Which is the recommended audio coding for providing narrowband speech support in IMS terminals as per TS 26.114?

q_41211.question: What should the MCPTT user be indicated when receiving a notification of the MCPTT emergency alert cancellation?
q_41211.ground_truth: The MCPTT user should be indicated with the MCPTT emergency alert cancellation and the MCPTT ID of the user cancelling the alert.

q_41212.question: What is the methodology for co-existence simulation?
q_41212.ground_truth: The co-existence simulation methodology includes generating aggressor and victim networks, associating UEs to the networks, using round robin scheduling, and computing throughput with and without ACI.

q_41213.question: What is the pre-condition for a VAE client to send a deregistration request to the VAE server?
q_41213.ground_truth: The VAE client has already registered with the VAE server.

q_41214.question: What is the responsibility of NEF regarding to jitter?
q_41214.ground_truth: NEF is responsible for interacting with AF regarding to network performance i.e. jitter and receive jitter requirement from AF and convey to PCF.

q_41215.question: What should the MCPTT client do if the MCPTT user indicates that they want to cancel the MCPTT emergency alert and the MCPTT emergency group call, but this is not an authorized request to cancel an MCPTT emergency alert?
q_41215.ground_truth: In this case, the MCPTT client should set the MCPTT emergency group state of the MCPTT group to "MEG 3: cancel-pending" and indicate to the MCPTT user that they are not authorized to cancel the MCPTT emergency alert.

q_41216.question: What should be measured for multi-band TAB connectors in single band tests?
q_41216.ground_truth: Repeat the steps for each band, ensuring no carrier is activated in the other band.

q_41217.question: How does a UE indicate support for TMPI to the BSF in HTTP requests?
q_41217.ground_truth: A UE indicates support for TMPI to the BSF in HTTP requests by including a "product" token set to a static string "3gpp-gba-tmpi" in the "User-Agent" header field.

q_41218.question: What are the initial conditions required for the UE to be tested in the EVM equalizer spectrum flatness requirement test?
q_41218.ground_truth: The initial conditions required for the UE to be tested in the EVM equalizer spectrum flatness requirement test include environmental conditions, test frequencies, channel bandwidths, ephemeris, signal propagation conditions, UE location, message contents, and the UE state.

q_41219.question: What are the two components of the DevOps process recommended by ETSI GR NFV-TST 006?
q_41219.ground_truth: The two components recommended by ETSI GR NFV-TST 006 are the DevOps server and the data handling component.

q_41220.question: What must the source eNB indicate to the CN for direct data forwarding in case of Handover Command message?
q_41220.ground_truth: The source eNB must indicate direct path availability to the CN for direct data forwarding in case of Handover Command message.

q_41221.question: What message is sent by the AMF if no security context is required in the NAS Security Mode Command in the context of TS 23.502?
q_41221.ground_truth: The NAS Security Mode Command shall contain the EAP-Success message and the NULL security algorithms, and the EAP-Success message is stored by the TWIF and not forwarded directly to the N5CW. The NAS Security Mode Complete message is sent to the AMF to complete the registration procedure.

q_41222.question: When is the RRC message implying SCell release received at the UE antenna connector, defining the start of time period T5?
q_41222.ground_truth: The RRC message implying SCell release received at the UE antenna connector defines the start of time period T5 in the test.

q_41223.question: In Immediate Event Charging, what is the role of the NF (CTF) in sending the Charging Data Request?
q_41223.ground_truth: The NF (CTF) sends the request to the CHF for the service to be granted authorization and to allow the number of units, if determined, to be rated and accounted.

q_41224.question: What message type must be included in an SIP MESSAGE request when sending an MBMS bearer announcement update?
q_41224.ground_truth: An SIP MESSAGE request must include the same TMGI value as in the MBMS bearer announcement to be updated in the <TMGI> element when sending an MBMS bearer announcement update.

q_41225.question: What should a GPRS MS do when it is rejected for network access with the EMM cause #11, "PLMN not allowed"?
q_41225.ground_truth: The MS should delete any RAI, P-TMSI, P-TMSI signature, and GPRS ciphering key sequence number. It should store the PLMN identity in the "forbidden PLMN list" and start timer T3245. Upon timer expiry, the MS should initiate a PLMN selection.

q_41226.question: What is the purpose of the tests specified in section 8.3.2.2 for dual-layer spatial multiplexing?
q_41226.ground_truth: The purpose of the tests specified in section 8.3.2.2 is to verify the rank-2 performance for full RB allocation for dual-layer spatial multiplexing.

q_41227.question: What is the purpose of the "P-TMSI signature" information element in a P-TMSI REALLOCATION COMMAND message?
q_41227.ground_truth: The "P-TMSI signature" information element may be included in a P-TMSI REALLOCATION COMMAND message to assign an identity to the MS's GMM context.

q_41228.question: What is the goal of using ranging service in sharing content to a particular UE?
q_41228.ground_truth: The goal of using ranging service in sharing content to a particular UE is to efficiently find the target UE by showing the source UE's direction and finding the target UE in the same direction.

q_41229.question: What should the Ethertype field of the Ethernet frame header be set to in order for the UE to add IP-specific components to the packet filter for UL direction based on the IP header of the received DL user data packet?
q_41229.ground_truth: The Ethertype field of the Ethernet frame header should indicate that the data carried in the Ethernet frame is IPv4 or IPv6 data.

q_41230.question: Which interface is enhanced to support Ranging/Sidelink positioning?
q_41230.ground_truth: The PC5 interface is enhanced to support Ranging/Sidelink positioning.

q_41231.question: Which accuracy requirements section applies to the comparison of RSRQ measurements between cells on any of the SCCs and cells on the PCC?
q_41231.ground_truth: The inter-frequency relative RSRQ measurement accuracy requirements in Section 9.1.18.3.3 apply to the comparison of RSRQ measurements between cells on any of the SCCs and cells on the PCC.

q_41232.question: What is the definition of "UAS" in the present document?
q_41232.ground_truth: In the present document, "UAS" stands for "Uncrewed Aerial System".

q_41233.question: What is the state of the UE when the Service Request procedure is performed with the network via untrusted non-3GPP access in CM-CONNECTED state?
q_41233.ground_truth: The UE is in CM-CONNECTED state over non-3GPP access.

q_41234.question: What is the size of the layer-2 ID information element?
q_41234.ground_truth: The layer-2 ID information element is 4 octets in size.

q_41235.question: What is the parameter name that indicates whether the NAS PDU is present or not in the E-RABToBeSetupItemCtxtSUReq?

q_41236.question: What are some performance improvements provided by using HTTP/3 for 5GMS functions compared to earlier versions of HTTP?
q_41236.ground_truth: Single-threading HTTP requests and responses, avoiding TCP Head-of-Line (front-of-queue) blocking, and setting up connections in at most one Round-Trip Time (RTT).

q_41237.question: What action does the PCF take if the request is not authorized and it was registered at the BSF as the PCF handling the MBS session?
q_41237.ground_truth: The PCF deregisters itself at the BSF from being the PCF handling the MBS session by sending an HTTP DELETE request to the corresponding "Individual PCF for an MBS Session Binding" resource.

q_41238.question: What is the role of the "sv" or "schemaversion" parameter in the "application/3gpp-ims+xml" media type if both "sv" and "schemaversion" are specified?
q_41238.ground_truth: If both "sv" and "schemaversion" are specified, the value of "schemaversion" is ignored.

q_41239.question: What must the MeNB do when the SeNB reports the establishment result for all the requested E-RABs in the SENB ADDITION REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message?
q_41239.ground_truth: The MeNB must include a list of E-RABs which are successfully established in the E-RABs Admitted To Be Added List IE and a list of E-RABs which failed to be established in the E-RABs Not Admitted List IE.

q_41240.question: What is the purpose of the "Audio SSRC of Transmitting User" field in the Media reception end response message?
q_41240.ground_truth: The "Audio SSRC of Transmitting User" field in the Media reception end response message carries the SSRC value for the Audio RTP stream of the user transmitting the media.

q_41241.question: How does an API invoker update its profile details on the CAPIF core function?
q_41241.ground_truth: An API invoker can update its profile details on the CAPIF core function by sending an HTTP PUT message to the CAPIF core function to replace all properties in the existing resource, or by sending an HTTP PATCH request message to modify the API invoker's profile if the "PatchUpdate" feature is supported.

q_41242.question: What step is taken if the HSS provides the identity of a dynamically allocated PDN GW and the Request Type indicates "initial Request"?
q_41242.ground_truth: Either the provided PDN GW is used or a new PDN GW is selected.

q_41243.question: For which of the following use-cases does the network not initiate a Network Triggered Service Request procedure when the SMF needs to setup N3 tunnel to deliver downlink packets to the UE for a PDU Session and the UE is in CM-CONNECTED state?
q_41243.ground_truth: The network does not initiate the procedure when the SMF needs to setup N3 tunnel to deliver downlink packets to the UE for a PDU Session and the UE is in CM-CONNECTED state.

q_41244.question: What should the MS include in the CM SERVICE REQUEST message, when it determines that it is in a different location area than the stored location area?
q_41244.ground_truth: The MS should include the Additional update parameters information element indicating "CS fallback mobile originating call".

q_41245.question: When should the UE not retry the authentication procedure with the same WLAN for the same APN to the same PLMN?
q_41245.ground_truth: When the initial attach or handover attach is requested, the cause of failure is #27 "Unknown APN" and the Tw1 item is not included in the item list field.

q_41246.question: When can the IP-CAN support emergency services free of charge?
q_41246.ground_truth: The IP-CAN may provide emergency services free of charge, subject to the applicable PCC rules defined by the operator.

q_41247.question: What is the action the CP function should take if it receives a PFCP Session Report Request message with an unknown F-SEID?
q_41247.ground_truth: The CP function should send a PFCP Session Report Response message with a rejection cause set to "Session context not found".

q_41248.question: What is the effect of setting the TIN to "P-TMSI" when the mobile station is in the process of CS fallback and SMS over SGs?
q_41248.ground_truth: The mobile station can receive an EMM cause #18 during a combined attach procedure or tracking area updating procedure, but not if it has already received this cause and not disabled E-UTRAN capability.

q_41249.question: What is the purpose of the EAP message IE set in the PROSE AA MESSAGE TRANSPORT REQUEST message?
q_41249.ground_truth: The EAP message IE set in the PROSE AA MESSAGE TRANSPORT REQUEST message is used to include the EAP message for the target UE during an EAP based authentication procedure.

q_41250.question: What are the two conditions that need to be met for a MA PDU session with a service that is not a 3GPP PS Data Off Exempt Service?
q_41250.ground_truth: The non-3GPP access should be available and the PCF policies should allow all the traffic of the service to be forwarded using the non-3GPP access.

q_41251.question: What parameter is used to identify the security parameters in the Relay Discovery Additional Information message for 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay?
q_41251.ground_truth: The Relay Service Code in the Relay Discovery Additional Information message identifies the security parameters needed by the receiving UE to process the discovery message for 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay.

q_41252.question: For which attribute was it recommended that the realm string contain a hostname or domain name, following the recommendation in subclause 3.3 of RFC 7616?
q_41252.ground_truth: Realm strings must be globally unique and it is recommended that they contain a hostname or domain name.

q_41253.question: What must the UE do to discover WLANs that support S2a connectivity?
q_41253.ground_truth: The UE must use ANQP procedures to retrieve the 3GPP Cellular Network information advertised by WLANs, which indicates the PLMNs that interwork with the WLAN and the PLMNs to which the WLAN supports S2a connectivity.

q_41254.question: What entity determines if the UE requested PDU session should be checked based on a provisioned URSP rule?

q_41255.question: When should the MAC entity trigger a padding BSR and report a Short BSR?
q_41255.ground_truth: The MAC entity should trigger a padding BSR and report a Short BSR if the UE transmits a MAC PDU, and the number of padding bits is equal to or larger than the size of a Short BSR plus its subheader and the UE has available data for transmission form in the TTI where the BSR is transmitted.

q_41256.question: What is the role of xIRI in the 3GPP system?
q_41256.ground_truth: xIRI is generated by the IRI-POI in the EES when it detects specific events or information in both roaming and non-roaming situations.

q_41257.question: What is the maximum size of the ADD-Info structure?
q_41257.ground_truth: The maximum size of the ADD-Info structure is 5 Octet strings.

q_41258.question: What is the maximum duration of the allowed interruption period by SCell activation?
q_41258.ground_truth: The maximum duration of the allowed interruption period by SCell activation is 1 subframe in the range of m+5 to m+9.

q_41259.question: What should the controlling MCPTT function do upon receiving a SIP request for an MCPTT group that the MCPTT user is not currently affiliated to and that requires a check on the eligibility of the MCPTT user to be affiliated to the MCPTT group?
q_41259.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function should identify the served MCPTT group ID and the handled MCPTT ID in the respective elements of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body of the SIP request, and check if the MCPTT user is eligible to be affiliated to the MCPTT group using clause~9.2.2.3.8.

q_41260.question: What information does the NEF translate when the AF provides the Background Data Transfer Reference ID together with the External Group Identifier of the UE(s)?
q_41260.ground_truth: The NEF translates the External Group Identifier into the Internal Group Identifier when the AF provides the Background Data Transfer Reference ID together with the External Group Identifier of the UE(s).

q_41261.question: What should the UE do when it is switched off and there is a PLMN-specific attempt counter with a value greater than zero and less than the UE implementation-specific maximum value?
q_41261.ground_truth: The UE should remove the respective PLMN from the "forbidden PLMNs for GPRS service" list.

q_41262.question: What is the UE capability requirement for network-based CRS interference mitigation, as specified in Section 8.1.2.6?
q_41262.ground_truth: If network-based CRS interference mitigation is enabled in a cell for which the UE performs RSTD measurements, the UE capable of supporting network-based CRS interference mitigation shall perform RSTD measurements and meet all the requirements in this section, provided the CRS are available within at least the PRS bandwidth in the subframes with PRS during all positioning occasions within the RSTD measurement period.

q_41263.question: What are the two steps taken when an MCPTT client leaves an MCPTT call and the call remains ongoing with other MCPTT clients?
q_41263.ground_truth: The first step is for the floor participant interface to stop sending floor control messages and RTP media packets to the MCPTT client leaving the MCPTT call. The second step is to release the 'floor participant interface state transition' state machine instance when the session with the floor participant is released.

q_41264.question: What is the action taken when the SCI indicates negative-only acknowledgement and the data which the MAC entity attempted to decode was successfully decoded for this TB or the data for this TB was successfully decoded before?
q_41264.ground_truth: Instruct the physical layer to generate a positive acknowledgement of the data in this TB.

q_41265.question: What is the definition of "Availability" as provided in the document?
q_41265.ground_truth: Availability is the percentage value of the amount of time when a ranging system is able to provide the required Ranging-related data within the performance targets or requirements divided by the amount of time the system is expected to provide the Ranging service in a targeted service area.

q_41266.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for NR RedCap UE with 2Rx in release 17 and forward?
q_41266.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements are defined in clause 16.1.1.0.2.

q_41267.question: What is the initial state of the UE in the test scenario described in 13.4.3.15.3?
q_41267.ground_truth: The UE is in state Registered, Idle mode (state 2) on Cell 1.

q_41268.question: What is the format of the Additional information information element?
q_41268.ground_truth: The Additional information information element is coded as a type 4 information element with a minimum length of 3 octets.

q_41269.question: What should the terminating AS do if the callee is busy when a CC call arrives and the retain option is not supported across the networks?
q_41269.ground_truth: The terminating AS shall cancel the corresponding CC request and send a 486 (Busy Here) response with a Call-Info header field with a "purpose" header field parameter set to "call-completion" to the originating AS.

q_41270.question: What should the AMF do if it receives a REGISTRATION REQUEST message with "initial registration" or "emergency registration" in the 5GS registration type IE and the service request procedure has not been completed or a SERVICE REJECT message has not been sent?
q_41270.ground_truth: The AMF may initiate the 5GMM common procedures, such as the primary authentication and key agreement procedure, and after a successful execution, abort the service request procedure and progress the new REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

q_41271.question: What must the UE instruct the lower layers to do when it is triggered by the upper layers to start responding to solicitation on proximity of a connectivity service provided by a 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE?
q_41271.ground_truth: When the UE is triggered by the upper layers to start responding to solicitation on proximity of a connectivity service provided by a 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE and if the UE is authorized to perform the discoveree end UE procedure for UE-to-UE relay discovery, it must instruct the lower layers to start monitoring for PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY messages.

q_41272.question: If the target UE acts as a target 5G ProSe layer-3 end UE, what should it include in the PROSE DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION ACCEPT message when the negotiated 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-UE relay reselection occurs?
q_41272.ground_truth: The target UE should include the relay reselection indication, the newly selected 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE user info ID, the initiating 5G ProSe end UE IP address, and the target 5G ProSe end UE IP address to be used with the newly selected 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE.

q_41273.question: What is the expected information in the "Allowed SSC mode" field?
q_41273.ground_truth: The "Allowed SSC mode" field specifies which "Single- shot CIoT 5GS Optimization" (SSC) mode(s) are allowed for the PDU session.

q_41274.question: Under what conditions may the controlling MCVideo function remove a participant from an ongoing group session when it receives a SIP INVITE request and the number of participants has reached the maximum on-network count?
q_41274.ground_truth: When the user identified by the MCVideo ID in the SIP INVITE request has a higher priority than an existing user in the group session.

q_41275.question: What is the responsibility of the TWAN in the case of GTP/PMIP-based S2a for a trusted non-3GPP access network?
q_41275.ground_truth: The TWAN is responsible for receiving Router Solicitation from and sending Router Advertisement message to the UE.

q_41276.question: What kind of information is used for Service Area Restriction in the AMF Access and Mobility Policy?
q_41276.ground_truth: Service Area Restriction information is encoded using the "ServiceAreaRestriction" data type and consists of a limited allowed area, a limited allowed area represented as a maximum number of TAs of the limited allowed area, or a not allowed area represented as a list of not allowed TAs.

q_41277.question: What is the maximum length of the Daylight Saving Time information element in the 3GPP TS 24.008 protocol?
q_41277.ground_truth: The Daylight Saving Time information element in the 3GPP TS 24.008 protocol is a type 4 information element with a length of 3 octets.

q_41278.question: What happens when the floor control server receives a termination instruction?
q_41278.ground_truth: The floor control server sets the value of timers T1 and T2, releases all resources in the media plane, and enters the 'Start-stop' state. The overriding participant continues to have the floor until its current talk burst is terminated.

q_41279.question: What is the maximum total delay measured for Event A6 in this test case?
q_41279.ground_truth: The maximum total delay measured for Event A6 in this test case is 3202 ms.

q_41280.question: What is a Buffer Status Report (BSR) in the context of 3GPP TS 36.321?
q_41280.ground_truth: A Buffer Status Report (BSR) in the context of 3GPP TS 36.321 is a MAC control element that provides the buffer status of logical channel groups (LCGs) to the lower layers for scheduling purposes.

q_41281.question: What type of requests should the media storage client generate to upload a UE-stored file to the media storage function on the MCData content server?
q_41281.ground_truth: The media storage client should generate an HTTP POST request to upload a UE-stored file.

q_41282.question: What is the role of the Authorization Server in the message flow for UE originated API invocation?
q_41282.ground_truth: The Authorization Server is responsible for authorizing the request based on the identity of the API invoker and the requested scope by applying stored policies and permissions. The Authorization Server also issues the token to the API invoker, which includes claims reflecting the granted scopes and permissions.

q_41283.question: Which type of UE is applicable for the test case 5.5.11.2.2?
q_41283.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of UE supporting E-UTRA and EN-DC from release 17 onwards and supporting unified TCI state operation.

q_41284.question: What is the test procedure for obtaining the limit frequencies required to calculate the occupied bandwidth of a NR UE?
q_41284.ground_truth: The test procedure involves summing up the power upward and downward from the lower and upper boundaries of the measured frequency range and seeking the limit frequency point by which the sum becomes 0.5% of "Total power".

q_41285.question: Which section specifies the minimum conformance requirements for SS-SINR measurement accuracy for RedCap UE with 2Rx?

q_41286.question: What event should be evaluated to check if the first CSI report for SCell1 is received in a subframe (m+8) or (m+10) during T2 in the FDD PCell case?

q_41287.question: Which type of charging event leads to the creation of a CDR by the CHF in the case of Network Slice-Specific Authentication and Authorization, when met as a default trigger condition and the charging is active for the corresponding functionality?

q_41288.question: What is the purpose of adding a routeable SIP URI of the IBCF to the Path header field upon receiving an incoming REGISTER request?
q_41288.ground_truth: The purpose is to hide network topology information and ensure that subsequent requests are identified as being sent by the S-CSCF towards the P-CSCF.

q_41289.question: What action shall the initiating UE take upon receipt of a PROSE DIRECT LINK SECURITY ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message?
q_41289.ground_truth: For each of the PROSE DIRECT LINK SECURITY ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message received, the initiating UE shall create a PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message.

q_41290.question: What is the function of the Backoff Indicator sub-header in the MAC PDU header?
q_41290.ground_truth: The Backoff Indicator sub-header is the first sub-header included within the MAC PDU header and is used to indicate the back off parameter value for the UE.

q_41291.question: What is the action taken by the MAC entity when it receives an Enhanced SP CSI reporting on PUCCH Activation/Deactivation MAC CE on a Serving Cell?
q_41291.ground_truth: The MAC entity indicates to lower layers the information regarding the Enhanced SP CSI reporting on PUCCH Activation/Deactivation MAC CE.

q_41292.question: What is the entering condition for Event W1?
q_41292.ground_truth: The entering condition for Event W1 is specified in TS 36.331, clause 5.5.4.11 and is based on the measurement result of WLAN(s), hysteresis parameter, and threshold parameter.

q_41293.question: How can a monitoring UE determine if a ProSe application code it seeks to monitor has been discovered in 5G ProSe direct discovery?
q_41293.ground_truth: A monitoring UE can determine if a ProSe application code it seeks to monitor has been discovered in 5G ProSe direct discovery if there is a match event for any of the ProSe application masks in a discovery filter.

q_41294.question: What message is sent by the UE or the PDN GW to trigger the removal of a child IPsec Security Association for protecting the traffic sent via the S2c reference point?
q_41294.ground_truth: A Binding Update message is sent by the UE to trigger the removal of a child IPsec Security Association, and the PDN-GW initiates an IP-CAN session modification procedure to provide new tunnel information to the PCRF. Based on the new tunnel information, the PCRF initiates a QoS rules provision procedure to the trusted non-3GPP access indicating the new tunnel information, which leads to the removal of the child IPsec Security Association.

q_41295.question: What is the function of a repeater as defined in the present document?
q_41295.ground_truth: A repeater is defined as a device that receives, amplifies, and transmits the radiated or conducted RF carrier both in the down-link direction (from the base station to the mobile area) and in the up-link direction (from the mobile to the base station).

q_41296.question: What is the solution introduced to manage the usage of multiple operator certificates in the NFs in SBA?
q_41296.ground_truth: Solution #10, which introduces a procedure indicating and validating the purpose of the X.509 certificates used in SBA by using the Extended Key Usage extension of the certificate.

q_41297.question: Which quantity should be set when a neighbor cell is listed in the MeasResultSCG-Failure if the measured SS/PBCH block results are available?
q_41297.ground_truth: The UE must order the cells based on SS/PBCH block if SS/PBCH block measurement results are available, and otherwise use RSRP if RSRP measurement results are available, otherwise use RSRQ if RSRQ measurement results are available, otherwise use SINR.

q_41298.question: What is the function of the Mediation and Delivery Function (MDF) in Lawful Interception (LI) architecture?
q_41298.ground_truth: The Mediation and Delivery Function (MDF) delivers the Interception Product to the Law Enforcement Monitoring Facility (LEMF) in Lawful Interception (LI) architecture.

q_41299.question: What is the meaning of the ENABLED value in the Flow-Status AVP?
q_41299.ground_truth: The ENABLED value in the Flow-Status AVP is used to enable associated uplink or downlink IP flow(s) and to disable associated downlink or uplink IP flow(s), respectively.
