q_41300.question: What should the UE do upon receiving a complete warning message in SystemInformationBlockType11?
q_41300.ground_truth: If the UE receives all segments of a warning message in SystemInformationBlockType11, it should assemble the warningMessage, forward the complete warningMessage, messageIdentifier, serialNumber, and dataCodingScheme to upper layers, and stop reception of SystemInformationBlockType11.

q_41301.question: What information does the "Submission Timestamp" contain in the List of NIDD Submissions?
q_41301.ground_truth: The "Submission Timestamp" contains the moment when the data transfer request NIDD submission was submitted to the CPCN Node.

q_41302.question: What is one function of the XR edge server in the XR distributed computing architecture?
q_41302.ground_truth: The XR edge server is responsible for sensor data processing, XR scene generation, 2D or 3D media encoding, metadata generation, and 5G delivery.

q_41303.question: What is the time allocated for identifying the target GERAN cell?
q_41303.ground_truth: The time allocated for identifying the target GERAN cell is less than 1 second.

q_41304.question: What is the role of the PEMC in the Personal IoT Network (PIN)?
q_41304.ground_truth: The PEMC is a UE belonging to the PIN and having PIN management capability. It is responsible for authorizing the PIN Elements to join the network and managing the local authorization policy.

q_41305.question: What is the expected behavior when the UE receives a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message with the reject cause set to "UE implicitly detached"?
q_41305.ground_truth: The UE enters the state EMM-DEREGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE and sends ATTACH REQUEST message.

q_41306.question: How many preambles shall the UE transmit before receiving a Random Access Response in Test 3?
q_41306.ground_truth: The UE shall transmit 3 preambles before receiving a Random Access Response in Test 3.

q_41307.question: What are the two types of user data rate control?
q_41307.ground_truth: The two types of user data rate control are Serving PLMN Rate Control and Small Data Rate Control.

q_41308.question: What is the role of the 5G ProSe Key Management Function (5G PKMF) in 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay discovery and communication?
q_41308.ground_truth: The 5G PKMF is responsible for handling network-related actions for the key management and security materials required for 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay discovery and communication. It is used to establish a secure PC5 communication link between a 5G ProSe Remote UE and a 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay.

q_41309.question: What should be the EVM measurement periods for BS type 2-O for FR2-2?
q_41309.ground_truth: The EVM measurement shall be performed for BS type 2-O for FR2-2 over all allocated resource blocks and downlink slots within 80 slots measurement periods. The boundaries of the EVM measurement periods need not be aligned with radio frame boundaries.

q_41310.question: Which type of emission is the document concerned with for the mains power input port: harmonic current, voltage fluctuation, or magnetic field?

q_41311.question: What is the function of NPNACF (Non-Public Network Admission Control Function) in Solution #2 and Solution #3, which involve converged charging for a number of UEs and PDU sessions respectively?
q_41311.ground_truth: NPNACF is a new network function introduced in both Solutions #2 and #3 to handle the converged charging architecture.

q_41312.question: What should the UE do when an originating multimedia telephony communication session ends if the session was initiated with offering only audio or only real-time text or only both audio and real-time text?
q_41312.ground_truth: The UE should send the MO-MMTEL-voice-ended indication to the non-access stratum when an originating multimedia telephony communication session ends if the session was initiated with offering only audio or only real-time text or only both audio and real-time text.

q_41313.question: What must the SMF do when MA PDU Session is released over 3GPP access?
q_41313.ground_truth: The SMF revokes the allocated EBI(s) for the MA PDU Session.

q_41314.question: Under what conditions will the controlling MCData function send a SIP 404 (Not Found) response when receiving a SIP INVITE request for an MCData session?
q_41314.ground_truth: The controlling MCData function will send a SIP 404 (Not Found) response if the MCData adhoc group data communication represented by the MCData session identity in Request-URI is not present.

q_41315.question: What is the purpose of the solution described in section 6.30 of the document?
q_41315.ground_truth: The purpose of the solution described in section 6.30 of the document is to address Key Issue #3 and enable on-demand multicast MBS session set up by MB-SMF.

q_41316.question: What is the purpose of test case 4.2.3.5.1 (Protecting sessions - logout function)?
q_41316.ground_truth: The purpose of this test case is to ensure a signed-in user can log out at any time and that all processes under the logged-in user ID are terminated on logout.

q_41317.question: What is the purpose of defining normative specifications for 5G Media functions and 5G System functions?
q_41317.ground_truth: The purpose of defining normative specifications for 5G Media functions and 5G System functions is to make these functions accessible to third-party applications independent of a 3GPP service. This is to ensure that the functions are attractive and accessible to third-party applications, particularly those that include media delivery.

q_41318.question: What information does the SCEF send in the MT NIDD Submit Response message if the Reliable Data Service was requested in step 1?
q_41318.ground_truth: The SCEF sends an MT NIDD Submit Response (Reliable Data Service Acknowledgement Indication, Hop-by-Hop Acknowledgment Indication, non-IP data sequence number, Cause) message to the SCS/AS.

q_41319.question: What is the minimum length of the Padding information element?
q_41319.ground_truth: The minimum length of the Padding information element is 3 octets.

q_41320.question: What is the difference between the ID id-CriticalityDiagnostics in OTDOAInformationResponse-IEs and OTDOAInformationFailure-IEs?
q_41320.ground_truth: In OTDOAInformationResponse-IEs, id-CriticalityDiagnostics is optional, meaning that it may or may not be present in the message. However, in OTDOAInformationFailure-IEs, id-CriticalityDiagnostics is mandatory, meaning that it must be present in the message.

q_41321.question: What should the network do if the TFT operation is "Add packet filters in existing TFT" or "Replace packet filters in existing TFT" and the TFT was successfully deleted?
q_41321.ground_truth: The network should process the new request as an activation request.

q_41322.question: What is one alternative to model delivery/transfer to UE?
q_41322.ground_truth: One alternative is on-device finetuning/retraining of a single model, if feasible.

q_41323.question: What information does the NF include in the Target of Analytics Reporting when requesting UE dispersion analytics?
q_41323.ground_truth: The NF includes the UE ID or Internal Group ID in the Target of Analytics Reporting when requesting UE dispersion analytics from the NWDAF.

q_41324.question: What triggers the PIN server or PEMC to modify the PIN when the PEGC moves out of the area of interests or switches off?
q_41324.ground_truth: The PIN server or PEMC is notified by PEGC of the event notification.

q_41325.question: What is the purpose of a dedicated bearer in E-UTRAN?
q_41325.ground_truth: A dedicated bearer in E-UTRAN is used to transport user plane traffic, and it can be present at all times or be event-triggered, such as during software upgrades.

q_41326.question: What is the field that uniquely identifies the MCVideo user information entry in the list of the MCVideo user information entries?
q_41326.ground_truth: The O ID field is used to uniquely identify the MCVideo user information entry in the list of the MCVideo user information entries.

q_41327.question: When should the Immediate-Response-Preferred AVP be included in the requested authentication info in the 3GPP 29.061-800 specification?
q_41327.ground_truth: The Immediate-Response-Preferred AVP is of type Unsigned32, and it should be included when immediate response is preferred. Its presence indicates that the requested EUTRAN-AVs, UTRAN-AVs, or GERAN-AVs are requested for immediate use in the MME or SGSN.

q_41328.question: What is the purpose of the P-CSCF when retrieving geographical location information for emergency sessions?
q_41328.ground_truth: The P-CSCF is responsible for retrieving geographical location information from the LRF in the case that the geographical location information is not available and is required.

q_41329.question: What is the abbreviation for "Conditional PSCell Addition procedure that is executed only when PSCell addition execution condition is met"?

q_41330.question: What is the purpose of the "SMSF 3GPP Delivery Outcome Indicator" in the context of SMS delivery?
q_41330.ground_truth: The "SMSF 3GPP Delivery Outcome Indicator" indicates the outcome of the SMS delivery with 3GPP service.

q_41331.question: What is the purpose of EF5GSEDRX in the 5GS eDRX Parameters?
q_41331.ground_truth: EF5GSEDRX in the 5GS eDRX Parameters contains the Extended idle mode DRX cycle length value which is used to indicate the maximum time interval that the UE can stay in the idle mode after receiving a call.

q_41332.question: How do the API invoker and the CAPIF core function mutually authenticate?
q_41332.ground_truth: The API invoker can authenticate the CAPIF core function via a certificate, while the CAPIF core function can authenticate the API invoker using a GBA-based authentication mechanism, AKMA-based authentication mechanism, or certificate-based authentication mechanism. The CAPIF core function may also generate a certificate and an OAuth 2.0 token for the API invoker after the authentication.

q_41333.question: Which state does the User Equipment enter when UE Test Mode Activated is used for signalling testing?
q_41333.ground_truth: The UE enters the Registered, Idle Mode state, UE Test Mode Activated (State 2A) for signalling testing.

q_41334.question: What HTTP status code will the NWDAF respond with if the analytics target period provided in the request includes the start time in the past and the end time in the future?
q_41334.ground_truth: The NWDAF shall reject the request with an HTTP "400 Bad Request" response.

q_41335.question: What is the definition of "ancillary equipment" in the context of the present document?
q_41335.ground_truth: Ancillary equipment is defined as equipment used in connection with a receiver, transmitter, or transceiver, providing additional operational and/or control features, cannot be used on a standalone basis, and does not adversely affect the main equipment's basic functions.

q_41336.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for the absolute accuracy of RSRQ measurements in CA idle mode?
q_41336.ground_truth: The absolute accuracy of RSRQ is defined as the RSRQ measured from a cell on the same frequency as that of the serving cell.

q_41337.question: What is the maximum number of additional paths that a UE capable of additionalPathsExtSupport-r17 can report for an RSTD measurement?
q_41337.ground_truth: A UE capable of additionalPathsExtSupport-r17 can report the timing of up to two additional paths with respect to the path timing determining the RSTD measurement.

q_41338.question: What schedule periodicity does the SystemInformationBlockType1 use for NB-IoT UEs?
q_41338.ground_truth: The SystemInformationBlockType1 has a periodicity of 2560 ms for NB-IoT UEs.

q_41339.question: What action does the E-SMLC take when certain TBS assistance data is desired by the UE in a positioning procedure?
q_41339.ground_truth: The E-SMLC sends a LPP Provide Assistance Data message to the UE containing the requested TBS assistance data if available.

q_41340.question: What should the NG-RAN node2 report if the admitted measurements in the Resource Status Reporting procedure have some missing results in the RESOURCE STATUS UPDATE message?
q_41340.ground_truth: NG-RAN node1 should consider that these results were not available at NG-RAN node2.

q_41341.question: What is the purpose of the Old source end UE IPv6 address and New Source end UE IPv6 address fields in the ProSe UE to UE relay update request?
q_41341.ground_truth: These fields are used to indicate the link local IPv6 addresses that have changed at the source end UE.

q_41342.question: What information can be indicated by the UE when fallback from 2-step RA to 4-step RA is performed, as per RACH attempt?
q_41342.ground_truth: The UE can indicate that fallback from 2-step RA to 4-step RA was performed in a RACH attempt.

q_41343.question: Which flag in Octet 5 of the Time Threshold IE indicates the duration to be monitored by the UP function?
q_41343.ground_truth: The Time Threshold field shall be encoded as an Unsigned32 binary integer value, indicating the duration in seconds.

q_41344.question: What is the primary motivation for Solution #17?
q_41344.ground_truth: Solution #17 aims to mitigate user plane and control plane overload caused by a high number of UEs returning from a temporary local access of a hosting network to their home network in a short period of time.

q_41345.question: What provides integrity and confidentiality protection of individual media streams and media plane control messages in MCPTT sessions?
q_41345.ground_truth: Media plane security based on 3GPP MCPTT security solution including key management and end-to-end media and floor control messages protection as defined in 3GPP TS 33.180.

q_41346.question: Under what circumstances will the MME choose to skip the authentication procedure during an attach procedure for emergency bearer services or an attach for access to RLOS?
q_41346.ground_truth: The MME may choose to skip the authentication procedure during an attach procedure for emergency bearer services or an attach for access to RLOS if no EPS security context is available and proceed directly to the execution of the security mode control procedure. This is as specified in clause 5.5.1.2.4 of TS 24.301.

q_41347.question: What kind of message is a G-PDU in the context of GTP?
q_41347.ground_truth: A G-PDU is a GTP user plane message that carries the original packet (payload) and consists of a GTP-U header and a T-PDU.

q_41348.question: Which message serves as the initial message for endcX2Setup?

q_41349.question: What is the requirement for CSI-RS based CBD measurement when two CSI-RS are in the same OFDM symbol on the same or different CCs in the same band?
q_41349.ground_truth: UE is required to measure one of but not both CSI-RS for CBD measurement and the other CSI-RS, and a longer evaluation period for CSI-RS based CBD measurement is expected.

q_41350.question: What should the participating MCData function do if it is unable to identify the controlling MCData function in step 8?
q_41350.ground_truth: Reject the REFER request with a SIP 404 (Not Found) response.

q_41351.question: What triggers a UE to complete an active BWP switch for dormant and non-dormant BWPs simultaneously within or outside of DRX active time?
q_41351.ground_truth: The active BWP switch should be completed within TDormantMultipleBWPswitchDelay = TMultipleBWPswitchDelay + X if dormancy indication is received in the first 3 OFDM symbols of a slot, or TDormantMultipleBWPswitchDelay = TMultipleBWPswitchDelay + X + Z if dormancy indication is received after the first 3 OFDM symbols of a slot.

q_41352.question: What should a mobile station (MS) do if the selected cell supporting GPRS is in a forbidden PLMN, forbidden LA, or a CSG cell with a CSG ID and associated PLMN identity not in the Allowed CSG list or Operator CSG list?
q_41352.ground_truth: The MS will enter the substate LIMITED-SERVICE.

q_41353.question: What is the effect of the NAS COUNT wrap around on the NAS security context?
q_41353.ground_truth: If the NAS COUNT wraps around, the UE and AMF shall continue to use the current 5G NAS security context, and the AMF shall not initiate the primary authentication and key agreement procedure.

q_41354.question: What does the TE do after the LLC link has been established in a successful PDP context activation?
q_41354.ground_truth: The TE starts its PPP protocol and carries out LCP, Authentication, and NCP negotiations.

q_41355.question: What is the exception to the measurement reporting delay when considering the delay uncertainty?
q_41355.ground_truth: The delay uncertainty is not included in the measurement reporting delay, it is instead added to the measurement reporting delay resulting in a higher overall delay.

q_41356.question: What information is included in slice-based cell reselection information?
q_41356.ground_truth: Slice-based cell reselection information includes reselection priorities per NSAG per frequency and corresponding list(s) of cells where the slices of the NSAG are supported or not supported.

q_41357.question: What is the abbreviation "NR" used for in the document?

q_41358.question: What should a NF Service Consumer do to determine if a query parameter is supported by a NF Service Producer?
q_41358.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer should use the feature negotiation mechanism specified in clause~6.6.2 to determine if the query parameter is supported by the NF Service Producer.

q_41359.question: What is the MCS group identity when the MCS group document is an MCPTT group document and defines a non-temporary MCS group?
q_41359.ground_truth: The MCS group identity is also the MCPTT group ID in this case.

q_41360.question: What must the UE do if the T3412 extended value IE is included in the ATTACH ACCEPT message?
q_41360.ground_truth: The UE shall use the value in T3412 extended value IE as periodic tracking area update timer (T3412).

q_41361.question: What is the purpose of measuring the number of notifications in potential solution #2?
q_41361.ground_truth: The purpose of measuring the number of notifications is to indicate the amount of data and how often it is received, and to prevent data sources from having to send multiple notifications by recommending more storage resources to be allocated to NWDAF.

q_41362.question: In what scenario would the UE resend the PROSE PATH SWITCHING REQUEST message and reset timer T5098?
q_41362.ground_truth: On the first expiry of timer T5098.

q_41363.question: What should the AF do if the user plane of a broadcast MBS session from its MB-UPF to the shared NG-RAN is not established?
q_41363.ground_truth: The AF should start the TMGI de-allocation procedure for the broadcast MBS session.

q_41364.question: What is the size of the Node-ID in the FQ-CSID field?
q_41364.ground_truth: The size of the Node-ID in the FQ-CSID field is two octets.

q_41365.question: What action should the ME take if it receives a CP-ERROR when trying to send a Short Message TPDU?
q_41365.ground_truth: The ME should inform the UICC using TERMINAL RESPONSE (network currently unable to process command).

q_41366.question: What is the initial synchronization state of the UE at the start of the test described in 6.5.1.4.4.2?
q_41366.ground_truth: Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to PCell.

q_41367.question: What is the role of the eNB in the broadcast of positioning assistance data?
q_41367.ground_truth: The eNB is responsible for including System Information groups, received from the E-SMLC, in RRC System Information Messages for acquiring the assistance data information by the UE.

q_41368.question: What is the primary consumer of processed UE data, which is exposed by the Data Collection AF in the form of data reporting event notifications?

q_41369.question: What is the filter characteristic defined in 6.5G.1.4 for the power spectrum distribution measurement?
q_41369.ground_truth: The filter characteristic defined in 6.5G.1.4 for the power spectrum distribution measurement is approximately Gaussian.

q_41370.question: What is one factor that can impact the self- and inter-sector interference suppression in wireless communications?
q_41370.ground_truth: The dynamic range of the ADC in the receiver can impact the self- and inter-sector interference suppression. The dynamic range of the ADC must be sufficient to accommodate both the transmit signal in the downlink sub-band and the lower power receive signal in the uplink sub-band.

q_41371.question: Which type of IE is required to be included in the BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST message, if the UE wishes to transmit the maximum and guaranteed bit rate values to the network and at least one of the values to be transmitted exceeds the maximum value specified in the EPS quality of service information element?

q_41372.question: What function does the mobility management sublayer provide to the session management (SM) sublayer and the short message services (SMS) entity of the connection management (CM) sublayer?
q_41372.ground_truth: The mobility management sublayer provides connection management services to the session management (SM) sublayer and the short message services (SMS) entity of the connection management (CM) sublayer.

q_41373.question: What is the action taken when creating a new MCData group information entry in the candidate list if the original entry's affiliation status is "affiliated" or "affiliating"?
q_41373.ground_truth: The affiliation status of the new MCData group information entry is set to the "de-affiliating" state.

q_41374.question: What are the two synchronization reference sources for sidelink transmissions in 12.2.2-1?
q_41374.ground_truth: A NR serving cell on a non-V2X sidelink carrier or a V2X sidelink carrier.

q_41375.question: What action is required by the UE in the 5G system?
q_41375.ground_truth: In the 5G system, the UE shall be able to store the URSP received over EPS entities, send the acknowledgement of UE reception of the UE Policy to the PCF over EPS entities, and send the list of PSIs stored in the UE to the PCF by encapsulating in UE Policy Container, and by including the UE Policy Container into PCO over EPS entities.

q_41376.question: What is the threshold for the measurement reporting delay for Test 1?
q_41376.ground_truth: The threshold for the measurement reporting delay for Test 1 is less than 920 ms from the beginning of time period T2.

q_41377.question: What happens to all triggered BSRs when a BSR is included in a MAC PDU for transmission?
q_41377.ground_truth: All triggered BSRs are cancelled when a BSR is included in a MAC PDU for transmission.

q_41378.question: What can the target SGSN do to PDP contexts that cannot be established?
q_41378.ground_truth: The target SGSN may deactivate the PDP contexts that cannot be established.

q_41379.question: What is the maximum number of E-UTRA carriers in SIB list?

q_41380.question: What should be the criterion for successful deactivation of SCC for intra-band CA UE?
q_41380.ground_truth: For intra-band CA UE, the last CSI report should be received by the SS earlier than or equal to subframe (n+8), and DTX should not be observed by the SS outside the subframes time span (n+5) to (n+13) up to the end of T3.

q_41381.question: What should the ATCF add to the topmost Route header field if it is located in the visited network and local policy requires the application of IBCF capabilities in the visited network towards the home network?
q_41381.ground_truth: The URI of the selected IBCF.

q_41382.question: Which message is used to indicate that the path switching procedure from the direct communication path over Uu to the direct communication path over PC5 is not accepted by the target UE in clause 7.7.2.5?
q_41382.ground_truth: The PROSE DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION REJECT message or the PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message.

q_41383.question: What is the effect of fine-tuning dataset size on positioning error when changing clutter parameter B from its initial training value A?
q_41383.ground_truth: The positioning error varies significantly, with a smaller fine-tuning dataset size resulting in a larger error.

q_41384.question: Which metric contains information about the displayed video resolution and physical screen characteristics, and is logged at the start of each QoE reporting period and whenever the characteristics change?

q_41385.question: What element is required in the `<triggering-criteria>` if you want to monitor changes in a specific cell?

q_41386.question: When is it necessary for the network to include the "T3302 value" information element in an ATTACH REJECT message?
q_41386.ground_truth: The network must include the "T3302 value" information element in an ATTACH REJECT message if the MS included the T3302 value IE in the ATTACH REQUEST message and the network supports PSM and accepts the use of PSM.

q_41387.question: In what ways can AF include MBS session priority and UE session priority?
q_41387.ground_truth: AF includes the MBS session priority in the message sent to MB-SMF, and the UE session priority in the message sent to UDM during External Parameter Provisioning procedures.

q_41388.question: What should the MCPTT client do upon receipt of a request from the MCPTT user to originate a remote initiated ambient listening call, if the "allow-request-remote-initiated-ambient-listening" element is not present or is set to a value of "false" in the MCPTT user profile document?
q_41388.ground_truth: The MCPTT client shall inform the MCPTT user and shall exit this procedure.

q_41389.question: What should the PCF do if it receives the "ExposureToTSC" feature and the TSCTSF or TSN AF has requested direct UPF notifications?
q_41389.ground_truth: The PCF should set the notification URI and correlation id within the "tscNotifUri" and "tscNotifCorreId" attributes, and forward the received direct notification information to the UPF.

q_41390.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP Technical Specification document?
q_41390.ground_truth: The purpose of the document is to specify the mapping of cause codes between 5G Core Network interfaces in the 5G System.

q_41391.question: What is the role of the UE in the procedure enhancement for Multi-path policy provisioning to a 5G ProSe Remote UE?
q_41391.ground_truth: If the UE supports Multi-path transmission and 5G ProSe capability as a Remote UE accessing UE-to-Network Relay and it does not have valid Multi-path policy, the UE includes the UE Policy Container with indicating the Multi-path policy provisioning request during registration procedure.

q_41392.question: What is Scope 1, 2, and 3 in terms of GHG emissions for a company?
q_41392.ground_truth: Scope 1, 2, and 3 are categories of Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions for a company. Scope 1 refers to direct emissions from facilities and vehicles owned or controlled by the company. Scope 2 refers to indirect emissions from the generation of purchased electricity consumed by the company. Scope 3 includes other indirect emissions that result from the company's activities, but occur from sources not owned or controlled by the company.

q_41393.question: What is the requirement for single RAT E-UTRA operation in the context of the throughput of the receiver unit with respect to the reference measurement channel?
q_41393.ground_truth: The throughput should be greater than or equal to 95% of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channel.

q_41394.question: What should a GPRS MS operating in MS mode A or B in network operation mode I do if it is already IMSI attached for CS services in the network?
q_41394.ground_truth: The GPRS MS operating in MS mode A or B in network operation mode I should proceed with the appropriate MM-specific procedure.

q_41395.question: What is the role of the MB-UPF in a multicast MBS Session?
q_41395.ground_truth: The MB-UPF acts as the MBS Session Anchor of an MBS session and receives only one copy of MBS data packets from AF or MBSTF. The user plane between MB-UPF and AF uses multicast transport for the MBS session.

q_41396.question: What is the condition for power scaling in Dual Connectivity Mode 2 in case of SRS transmission overlap?
q_41396.ground_truth: If the SRS transmission of the UE in a symbol on subframe for a given serving cell in a TAG of CG1 overlaps with the PUCCH/PUSCH transmission on subframe or subframe for a different serving cell(s) in CG1 and/or if the SRS transmissions overlap with PUSCH/PUCCH transmission on subframe for a serving cell(s) of CG2, the UE shall drop the SRS transmissions in CG1 if its total transmission power across all CGs exceeds on any overlapped portion of the symbol.

q_41397.question: What is the definition of the cell reselection delay to a lower priority E-UTRAN cell in this test?
q_41397.ground_truth: The time from the beginning of time period T1, to the moment when the UE camps on cell 2, and starts to send preambles on the PRACH for sending the RRC CONNECTION REQUEST message to perform a Tracking Area Update procedure on cell 2.

q_41398.question: What is the minimum bandwidth requirement to achieve the relative positioning accuracy of 1m@90% (Set A) in IIoT use case for InF-SH scenario for at least 5 sources?

q_41399.question: What is the format of the Decorated NAI when the username part includes the IMSI and the service provider has a PLMN ID?
q_41399.ground_truth: The format of the Decorated NAI is 'nai.epc.mnc<homeMNC>.mcc<homeMCC>.3gppnetwork.org !0<IMSI>@nai.epc.mnc<visitedMNC>.mcc<visitedMCC>.3gppnetwork.org' or 'nai.epc.mnc<homeMNC>.mcc<homeMCC>.3gppnetwork.org !6<IMSI>@nai.epc.mnc<visitedMNC>.mcc<visitedMCC>.3gppnetwork.org'

q_41400.question: What standard is the basis for defining the JSON schema of the body of CoAP requests in 7.3.1 of the 3GPP TS 24.546?
q_41400.ground_truth: JSON Schema Draft-07 is the basis for defining the JSON schema of the body of CoAP requests in 7.3.1 of the 3GPP TS 24.546.

q_41401.question: What type of NR RedCap UEs does clause 17.5.2.9.2 apply to starting from Release 17?
q_41401.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of NR RedCap UEs from Release 17 onwards that support pdcch-MonitoringAnyOccasions or pdcch-MonitoringAnyOccasionsWithSpanGap.

q_41402.question: What are some security measures implemented in the NFVI to ensure data protection?
q_41402.ground_truth: The NFVI ensures data protection by encrypting data at rest and in transit, and by using a hardware-mediated execution enclave (HMEE) for secure code execution and data protection.

q_41403.question: What is the sum of Pmax,c,TABC for all TAB connectors for a particular carrier, referred to as Prated,c,sys?
q_41403.ground_truth: Prated,c,sys is the sum of Pmax,c,TABC for all TAB connectors for a particular carrier, and can be Prated,c,sys,GEO for SAN GEO class or Prated,c,sys,LEO for SAN LEO class.

q_41404.question: What security measures could help minimize the impact of hypervisor and VM breakouts in a network function virtualization infrastructure (NFVI)?
q_41404.ground_truth: The NFVI should provide security isolation to minimize the impact of a hypervisor or VM breakout, and solutions for these requirements are expected to be handled outside of 3GPP. Regular patching of the NFVI and VNFs can also help maintain network security.

q_41405.question: What information should eNB1 include in the HANDOVER REPORT message if a completed handover from a cell of eNB2 to a cell in another RAT resulted in an inter-RAT ping-pong and the UE was successfully handed over to a cell of eNB1?
q_41405.ground_truth: eNB1 should include the Failure cell ECGI IE in the HANDOVER REPORT message to indicate the ECGI of the cell where the re-establishment was successful.

q_41406.question: What functionality does RFC 9220 define in the context of the HTTP/3 protocol?
q_41406.ground_truth: RFC 9220 defines support for the Extended CONNECT functionality in the HTTP/3 protocol.

q_41407.question: What is the required performance for the test in 5.2A.2.1.2.4?
q_41407.ground_truth: The test in 5.2A.2.1.2.4 must be evaluated per component carrier and meet the performance requirements specified in 5.2A.2.1.4.

q_41408.question: When can V2X UEs switch to PC5 communication using the VAE server assigned ProSe Layer-2 Group ID?
q_41408.ground_truth: When there is a loss of connectivity with the network by the V2X UEs.

q_41409.question: What are the two cells in this test described in section 4.5.1.2.4?
q_41409.ground_truth: Cell 1, which is the E-UTRAN PCell, and Cell 2, which is the PSCell.

q_41410.question: When is the GPRS attach attempt counter reset?
q_41410.ground_truth: The GPRS attach attempt counter is reset in several situations, such as when the MS is powered on, a SIM/USIM is inserted, a GPRS attach or combined GPRS attach procedure is successfully completed, or a new PLMN is selected.

q_41411.question: In off-network floor control, how do floor participants request talk permission when no specific floor control server exists?
q_41411.ground_truth: In off-network, floor participants request talk permission by sending a Floor Request message to all group members. After a well-defined waiting period, if no response is received, the floor participant sends a Floor Taken message indicating itself in the information element which expresses the group member to which this talk permission is given, and continues the talk burst.

q_41412.question: What is the purpose of the test procedure step 1?
q_41412.ground_truth: The purpose of step 1 in the test procedure is to ensure that the UE is in the correct state before starting the test.

q_41413.question: What is the purpose of the PDU Set based QoS handling feature specified in clause 5.37.5 of 3GPP TS 23.501?
q_41413.ground_truth: The purpose of PDU Set based QoS handling is to identify PDUs that belong to PDU sets and to perform PDU Set marking for a QoS flow.

q_41414.question: What should a UE do when it fails to access the network due to abnormal cases c), d), or e) in subclause~5.5.1.2.7 and it is in the same selected PLMN or SNPN where the last initial registration request was attempted and the PDU session does not need to be established due to handover of an existing PDN connection for emergency bearer services?
q_41414.ground_truth: It should inform the upper layers of the failure of the procedure and attempt initial registration for emergency services.

q_41415.question: What is the purpose of using Global In-Channel Tx-Test in this procedure?
q_41415.ground_truth: The purpose of using Global In-Channel Tx-Test in this procedure is to measure the EVM and carrier leakage in the uplink transmission.

q_41416.question: What is the role of the UE-based Direct Data Collection Client in relation to the Data Collection AF?
q_41416.ground_truth: The UE-based Direct Data Collection Client interacts with the Data Collection AF in the user plane, and so the interaction at reference point R2 does not traverse the service bus.

q_41417.question: What is the test requirement for the multi-band RIB in the context of general narrowband intermodulation test requirement?
q_41417.ground_truth: For multi-band RIBs, the narrowband intermodulation requirement applies in addition inside any Inter RF Bandwidth gap, in case the gap size is at least as wide as the E-UTRA interfering signal. The interfering signal offset is defined relative to the Base Station RF Bandwidth edges inside the Inter RF Bandwidth gap.

q_41418.question: What does the UE-to-UE Relay in the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay Discovery Solicitation message not include in the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay Discovery Response?
q_41418.ground_truth: The UE-to-UE Relay does not include the User Info ID of the discoveree 5G ProSe End UE in the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay Discovery Response.

q_41419.question: What is the subcounter that contains the number of MA PDU sessions created by the SMF, and the measurement is obtained by sampling at a pre-defined interval the number of MA PDU sessions established by SMF, and then taking the arithmetic mean?

q_41420.question: What is the difference between Transmitter ON state and Transmitter OFF state?
q_41420.ground_truth: The Transmitter ON state refers to the time period during which the repeater is transmitting downlink or uplink signals in the corresponding direction, while the Transmitter OFF state is the time period during which the repeater downlink or uplink is not allowed to transmit in the corresponding direction.

q_41421.question: When should a UE select a TAI?
q_41421.ground_truth: A UE should select a TAI when it receives multiple TACs from the lower layers or when it has received multiple TACs from the lower layers upon starting to camp on the current cell and the registration area, and the list of allowed tracking areas is updated.

q_41422.question: What happens if there is no WLAN that matches the WLANSP rule(s) from the H-ANDSF, and at least one WLAN matching one or more groups of selection criteria in the WLANSP rule of the HPLMN becomes available?
q_41422.ground_truth: The UE should re-use the WLANSP policies and Inter-system Routing Policies from H-ANDSF.

q_41423.question: What are the two types of logical interfaces in a GVNP?
q_41423.ground_truth: The two types of logical interfaces in a GVNP are execution environment interfaces and remote logical interfaces.

q_41424.question: What should the UE include in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message when it is performing the PDU session modification procedure to request an always-on PDU session in the 5GS?
q_41424.ground_truth: The UE should include the Always-on PDU session requested IE in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message when it is performing the PDU session modification procedure to request an always-on PDU session in the 5GS.

q_41425.question: What is the role of the H-PCRF in handling a GW control session during S2c-based IP flow mobility, in the case where the UE is not roaming?
q_41425.ground_truth: The H-PCRF stores the information received in the Diameter CCR, derives PCC rules for the PCEF and QoS rules for the BBERF(s), based on the BCM mode of the GW control session, and initiates a Gateway Control and QoS Rules Provision procedure by sending a Diameter RAR.

q_41426.question: What is the format of the Request-URI in a SIP MESSAGE request when sending an affiliation status change request in negotiated mode to a target MCPTT user?
q_41426.ground_truth: The Request-URI in a SIP MESSAGE request when sending an affiliation status change request in negotiated mode to a target MCPTT user is set to the public service identity identifying the originating participating MCPTT function serving the MCPTT user.

q_41427.question: How are the contents of an information element, defined outside of MAP, carried within MAP?
q_41427.ground_truth: The contents of an information element, defined outside of MAP, can be carried as the value of an ASN.1 type derived from the OCTET STRING data type or carried as the value of the ExternalSignalInfo data type defined in the present document.

q_41428.question: What should the BM-SC do when it detects a non-transient SGmb path failure and the MBMS session was activated by a Group Communication Service Application Server(s)?
q_41428.ground_truth: The BM-SC should notify the GCS AS that the MBMS session has been deactivated.

q_41429.question: In the NR SA FR2 event-triggered reporting with gap in DRX test, what is the overall delays measured in Test 2 for UE supporting power class 2, 3 or 4?
q_41429.ground_truth: The overall delays measured in Test 2 for UE supporting power class 2, 3 or 4 is up to 30722 ms.

q_41430.question: What should the SC UE include in the SIP INVITE request when sending a request for transfer of an additional session?
q_41430.ground_truth: The SC UE should include header fields which were included as URI header fields in the Refer-To header field of the received SIP REFER request, if a GRUU was received at registration, include a public GRUU or temporary GRUU in the Contact header field, the signalling elements specified in subclause~6A.2.2.2, and an SDP offer with the same amount of media descriptions as in the "body" URI header field in the URI in the Refer-To header field of the received SIP REFER request.

q_41431.question: How are uplink buffer status reports transmitted in E-UTRAN?
q_41431.ground_truth: Uplink buffer status reports are transmitted using MAC signalling, providing support for QoS-aware packet scheduling and uplink data transmission.

q_41432.question: What should the SMF perform if it receives a negative notification response from the AF in Clause 10-11?
q_41432.ground_truth: The SMF may stop the procedure if it receives a negative notification response from the AF in Clause 10-11.

q_41433.question: When can an ME which does not support FDN send APN to the network?
q_41433.ground_truth: Only when ACL is not enabled, and in this case, the ME shall not send any APN to the network.

q_41434.question: What does the phrase "might indicate" imply in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
q_41434.ground_truth: In the context of 3GPP technical specifications, the phrase "might indicate" implies a likelihood that something will happen as a result of action taken by some agency the behavior of which is outside the scope of the present document.

q_41435.question: What is the format of the EAP message consisting of the EAP-response message from network?
q_41435.ground_truth: The EAP message consisting of the EAP-response message from network is in hexadecimal format, as defined in IETF RFC 3748, RFC 4187, and RFC 5448. This parameter shall not be subject to conventional character conversion as per +CSCS.

q_41436.question: In the E-RAB MODIFICATION INDICATION message, what should the MME do if it receives the CSG Membership Info IE and the PLMN Identity IE?
q_41436.ground_truth: The MME should use the PLMN Identity IE from the E-RAB MODIFICATION INDICATION message for CSG membership verification as specified in TS 36.300.

q_41437.question: When does the UE supporting IPv6 indicate support for multi-homed IPv6 PDU session?
q_41437.ground_truth: The UE indicates support for multi-homed IPv6 PDU session during UE-requested PDU session establishment of a PDU session of "IPv6" or "IPv4v6" PDU session type, and during UE-requested PDU session modification performed after an inter-system change under certain conditions.

q_41438.question: What is the role of the AN-TL or CN-TL when sending a get-response in the process of transferring a TL-Container?
q_41438.ground_truth: The AN-TL or CN-TL sends a get-response to indicate the elements of the Talker or Listener group such as EndStationInterfaces, InterfaceCapabilities, and Buffer capability.

q_41439.question: What is the length of a PDU set in TS 23.501?
q_41439.ground_truth: A PDU set consists of one or more PDUs carrying the payload of a unit of information generated at the application level, such as frames or video slices for XR Services, as defined in TS 23.501.

q_41440.question: What is the responsibility of the IWF in the group regroup process with the MC system?
q_41440.ground_truth: The IWF is responsible for receiving the IWF group regroup request, providing an IWF group regroup response, notifying the group management server regarding the temporary group creation, and handling the translation between temporary group identities and the original interworking group identities used on the LMR system.

q_41441.question: What is the purpose of the "SCPDomainRoutingInfoGet" clause in the SCPDRI feature?
q_41441.ground_truth: The "SCPDomainRoutingInfoGet" clause allows a service consumer (e.g. SCP) to fetch the SCP domain routing information, including a list of all SCP domains registered by SCPs and the interconnected SCP domains per SCP domain. It also allows a service consumer (e.g. NRF) to fetch the local SCP domain routing information based on SCPs registered in the NRF as service producer.

q_41442.question: What are the intra-frequency relative RSRP measurement accuracy requirements for discovery signal occasions?
q_41442.ground_truth: The intra-frequency relative RSRP measurement accuracy requirements for discovery signal occasions are the same as those specified in Section 9.1.2.2 of the document.

q_41443.question: What is the measurement provided by the 5GS NEF for each failed background data transfer policy deletion?
q_41443.ground_truth: Each message incrementing the relevant subcounter per failure cause by 1, where each subcounter is an integer value.

q_41444.question: What bandwidth should the UE meet for PRS bandwidth in case of PCell changing while performing RSTD measurements?
q_41444.ground_truth: The UE shall meet the RSTD measurement accuracy for a PRS bandwidth which is not larger than the minimum channel bandwidth of those PCell/SCell(s) on whose carriers RSTD measurement is performed during the RSTD measurement period.

q_41445.question: What should the SCS/AS include in the PfdManagementPatch data structure when it sends an HTTP PATCH request to partially modify an existing PFD Management Transaction?
q_41445.ground_truth: The PfdManagementPatch data structure should include only the attributes that shall be updated when the SCS/AS sends an HTTP PATCH request to partially modify an existing PFD Management Transaction.

q_41446.question: What action does the NAS take if the UE is operating in dual-registration mode and an access attempt is barred due to an MO-MMTEL-voice-call-started indication or similar events?
q_41446.ground_truth: The UE may proceed in S1 mode with the appropriate EMM specific procedures and ESM procedures to make a PDN connection providing access to IMS available.

q_41447.question: When do the inter-frequency absolute RSRP measurement accuracy requirements in discovery signal occasions apply?
q_41447.ground_truth: The inter-frequency absolute RSRP measurement accuracy requirements in discovery signal occasions apply to a cell or TP on a different carrier frequency from that of the serving cell.

q_41448.question: What shall the ATCF associate with the RTP payload type(s) in the IMS-preferred-codec-list element?
q_41448.ground_truth: The ATCF shall associate the RTP payload type(s) with the RTP payload type number(s) in the IMS-preferred-codec-list element.

q_41449.question: What is the new parameter introduced in the NAS, S11, S5/S8 interface?

q_41450.question: Which parameter specifies the minimum required quality level in the cell in dB?

q_41451.question: What should a group management client do upon receiving a 2xx response to its request for a group document excluding group members?
q_41451.ground_truth: The group management client should consider the received MIME body as the group document excluding group members.

q_41452.question: What should the MCData client indicate when sending a disposition notification message?
q_41452.ground_truth: The MCData client can indicate to an MCData client that an SDS message was delivered, read, or undelivered, or indicate that a request for FD was accepted, deferred, or rejected.

q_41453.question: What is the purpose of the test "ndom Access Test for 2 SCells"?
q_41453.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to verify that the user equipment's (UE) behavior of the random access procedure for the two secondary cells (SCell1 and SCell2) meets the requirements of the E-UTRAN TDD non-contention based random access in an additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) model. It also checks that the power settings and timing for the physical random access channel (PRACH) for the SCells are within the specified limits.

q_41454.question: How is the first set of input parameters used in the detection of abnormal NF behavior?
q_41454.ground_truth: The first set of input parameters provided by the NFs (NF/NRF) and inputs from OAM to NWDAF is used to assist in the detection of abnormal NF behavior in the 5G system.

q_41455.question: In what situations would a UE initiate the match report procedure for open ProSe direct discovery?
q_41455.ground_truth: A UE would initiate the match report procedure for open ProSe direct discovery in one of the following situations: when it receives a ProSe Application Code from lower layers and does not have a corresponding ProSe Application ID stored, when it has a stored mapping for the ProSe Application Code but the validity timer T4004 has expired, when the match report refresh timer T4006 of the ProSe Application Code has expired, or when it receives a ProSe Application Code from lower layers that it has stored but excluding the Metadata Index portion.

q_41456.question: What type of data does the ProvideAssistanceData message contain in the Assistance Data Delivery procedure if the server supports periodic assistance data delivery?
q_41456.ground_truth: The ProvideAssistanceData message contains positioning method specific assistance data control parameters, periodicity conditions for sending the data, and a duration for ending the assistance data delivery.

q_41457.question: What is the structure of the Bootstrapping Server Function (BSF) address for 3GPP systems?
q_41457.ground_truth: The BSF address for 3GPP systems consists of one or more labels, each label with alphabetic characters (A-Z and a-z), digits (0-9), and hyphen (-), beginning and ending with a letter or digit, and a case-insensitive alphabet. The BSF address is derived from the identity information related to the UICC application used during the bootstrapping procedure.

q_41458.question: What information does the SCEF send to the SCS/AS in the MT NIDD Submit Response message if the non-IP data was buffered due to UE being temporarily unreachable?
q_41458.ground_truth: The SCEF sends the MT NIDD Submit Response message to the SCS/AS with the Buffered Indication set to True and the non-IP data sequence number, so the SCS/AS can overwrite or purge the buffered data at a later time. The SCEF also includes the Requested Re-Transmission time to inform the SCS/AS when it is expected to re-transmit the DL data to the currently unreachable UE.

q_41459.question: What does the "T" flag indicate in the GTP-C header and what should its value be for the Echo Request, Echo Response, and Version Not Supported Indication messages?
q_41459.ground_truth: The "T" flag in the GTP-C header indicates if the TEID field is present in the GTP-C header or not. For the Echo Request, Echo Response, and Version Not Supported Indication messages, the "T" flag should be set to "0". For all other EPC specific messages, the "T" flag should be set to "1".

q_41460.question: What is the relative signal level uncertainty between intra-frequency E-UTRA cells?
q_41460.ground_truth: The relative signal level uncertainty between intra-frequency E-UTRA cells is +/-1 dB.

q_41461.question: When does the UE apply ATSSS rules for deciding how to distribute the uplink traffic?
q_41461.ground_truth: After the establishment of a MA PDU Session, the UE applies network-provided policy (i.e. ATSSS rules) and considers local conditions for deciding how to distribute the uplink traffic across the two access networks.

q_41462.question: What information is contained in the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay Discovery Response message (Model B)?
q_41462.ground_truth: Source Layer-2 ID, Destination Layer-2 ID, User Info ID of discoveree 5G ProSe End UE, User Info ID of 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay, and Relay Service Code are contained in the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay Discovery Response message (Model B).

q_41463.question: What is the method to ensure the integrity and confidentiality protection of ranging result on Uu interface when using enhanced MO-LR procedure?
q_41463.ground_truth: The integrity and confidentiality protection of ranging result on Uu interface can be ensured by NAS security when using enhanced MO-LR procedure.

q_41464.question: How does a MAC entity process Sidelink BSR containing buffer status for all LCGs having data available for transmission?
q_41464.ground_truth: When the number of bits in the UL grant is equal to or larger than the size of a Sidelink BSR containing buffer status for all LCGs having data available for transmission plus its subheader, the MAC entity should report a Sidelink BSR containing buffer status for all LCGs having data available for transmission.

q_41465.question: What action is taken by the H-SMF when it receives a MA PDU Session release request from the V-SMF?
q_41465.ground_truth: The H-SMF decides whether the MA PDU Session is released or released over a single access based on its local policy.

q_41466.question: What is the triggering event of the MeasurementReport message in step 6)?
q_41466.ground_truth: The MeasurementReport message in step 6) is triggered by Event A3.

q_41467.question: Which document specifies the 5G NR radio resource control information elements?
q_41467.ground_truth: Section 5.4.1 specifies the 5G NR radio resource control information elements.

q_41468.question: What is the definition of NACK to ACK detection probability in the context of PUCCH format 1?
q_41468.ground_truth: NACK to ACK detection probability is the probability of detecting an ACK bit when an NACK bit was sent on particular bit position. Each NACK bit erroneously detected as ACK bit is counted as one error.

q_41469.question: What should be placed adjacent to the lower Base Station RF Bandwidth edge if NB-IoT operation in NR in-band is supported?
q_41469.ground_truth: An NR carrier with NB-IoT operation in NR in-band should be placed adjacent to the lower Base Station RF Bandwidth edge if NB-IoT operation in NR in-band is supported.

q_41470.question: What must the MCVideo client do when it receives an MBMS bearer announcement and enters an area with available general purpose MBMS, and experiences good MBMS bearer radio condition?
q_41470.ground_truth: The MCVideo client must report that it is listening to the MBMS bearer.

q_41471.question: What is the purpose of using the "type: object" keyword in an OpenAPI specification?
q_41471.ground_truth: The "type: object" keyword is used to define a schema as an object in an OpenAPI specification. It is typically used along with the "description," "properties," and "required" keywords to define a specific schema.

q_41472.question: What should a UE do if it is operating in single-registration mode and the service request procedure is rejected with the 5GMM cause value #39?
q_41472.ground_truth: The UE should handle the 5GMM parameters, 5GMM state, and 5GS update status as specified in 3GPP TS 24.501 for the case when the service request procedure performed over 3GPP access is rejected with the 5GMM cause with the same value.

q_41473.question: What is the maximum allowed time for the UE to identify a new CGI of an E-UTRA cell in clause 16.6.5.3.5?
q_41473.ground_truth: The maximum allowed time for the UE to identify a new CGI of an E-UTRA cell in clause 16.6.5.3.5 is 190 ms.

q_41474.question: What should the UE include in the NAS Transport protocol when establishing a PDU Session with multiple DNNs/S-NSSAIs?
q_41474.ground_truth: The UE should include multiple DNNs/S-NSSAIs or a DNN/S-NSSAI mapped to a group which has subgroups for the multiple DNNs/S-NSSAIs for a PDU Session.

q_41475.question: What action should be taken if an MCPTT user is not affiliated with the MCPTT group upon receipt of a SIP MESSAGE request for emergency notification for originating participating MCPTT function?
q_41475.ground_truth: If the MCPTT user is not affiliated with the MCPTT group, the participating MCPTT function shall perform the actions specified for implicit affiliation in clause 9.2.2.2.11.

q_41476.question: What indication does the UE provide to the E-SMLC when it calculates its own position in TBS positioning?
q_41476.ground_truth: The UE reports the latitude, longitude, and possibly altitude, together with an estimate of the location uncertainty, if available, when it calculates its own position in TBS positioning.

q_41477.question: What information is included in the RRC and S1-AP messages in enhanced 1xCSFB procedure in cdma2000 1xRTT?
q_41477.ground_truth: The 1xRTT information is contained inside RRC and S1-AP messages between the UE and MME and in a generic "transfer" message between MME and 1xRTT network.

q_41478.question: What information element can be included in the START CC message to indicate the mobile station's call control capabilities?
q_41478.ground_truth: The CC Capabilities information element (9.3.23a.1) can be included in the START CC message to indicate the mobile station's call control capabilities.

q_41479.question: What is the purpose of the id-gNB-CU-UE-F1AP-ID and id-RAN-UE-PDC-MeasID in the PDC Measurement Initiation Request?
q_41479.ground_truth: The id-gNB-CU-UE-F1AP-ID and id-RAN-UE-PDC-MeasID are IEs in the PDC Measurement Initiation Request that identify the gNB-CU-UE-F1AP-ID and RAN-UE-PDC-MeasID, respectively. The gNB-CU-UE-F1AP-ID identifies the gNB CU UE F1AP connection ID, and RAN-UE-PDC-MeasID identifies the RAN UE PDC measurement identity.

q_41480.question: What value of the "entry-info" attribute in the <uri-entry> element within the <entry> element of the <MCDataGroupInitiation> element indicates the use of the dedicated group as the destination address for a group emergency alert?

q_41481.question: What message does the eNB generate to request the MME to release a UE-associated logical S1-connection?

q_41482.question: Who are the intended users of Non-Public Networks?
q_41482.ground_truth: Non-Public Networks are intended for the sole use of a private entity such as a college or an enterprise.

q_41483.question: What should a participating MCData function do upon receiving a SIP INVITE request for a terminating participating MCData function in a pre-established session, if it is unable to process the request due to a lack of resources?
q_41483.ground_truth: The participating MCData function may reject the SIP INVITE request with a SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response and skip the rest of the steps.

q_41484.question: What is the purpose of the MAC header in the L1 random access procedure?
q_41484.ground_truth: The MAC header consists of one or more MAC PDU sub-headers, each corresponding to a MAC RAR, and is used for the L1 random access procedure.

q_41485.question: What is the maximum allowed cell re-selection delay to higher priority in this test case?
q_41485.ground_truth: The maximum allowed cell re-selection delay to higher priority in this test case is 68 seconds.

q_41486.question: What message is sent from the eNB to the MME to initiate the S1 Setup procedure?
q_41486.ground_truth: The eNB sends a S1 SETUP REQUEST message including the appropriate data to the MME to initiate the S1 Setup procedure.

q_41487.question: In the context of home routed roaming scenario, what information does the SMF+PGW-C send to the V-SMF during PDU Session Establishment?
q_41487.ground_truth: In home routed roaming scenario, the SMF+PGW-C sends mapped EPS bearer context(s), the mapping between the received EBI(s) and QFI(s), linked EBI and EPS bearer context(s) to V-SMF during PDU Session Establishment.

q_41488.question: From the perspective of AI/ML solutions, what is one aspect that has not been studied for CSI feedback enhancement in Rel-18?

q_41489.question: What is the purpose of the different versions of a Technical Report in the 3GPP?
q_41489.ground_truth: The first digit of the version number indicates the status of the document within the TSG: (a) presented for information, (b) presented for approval, or (c) TSG approved document under change control. The second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, while the third digit is incremented when editorial changes have been incorporated.

q_41490.question: What needs to be done in case a UE is out of coverage and at least one reference UE is in coverage?
q_41490.ground_truth: The out-of-coverage Target UE can implicitly initiate a MO-LR procedure by starting ranging discovery and connection setup with a nearby Reference UE, and the UE may report its ranging measurements/results to the LMF through the Reference UE that is in coverage.

q_41491.question: What are the four basic sources of synchronization for a V2X UE in LTE-V2X?
q_41491.ground_truth: The four basic sources of synchronization for a V2X UE in LTE-V2X are GNSS, the serving eNB, another UE transmitting SLSS (a SyncRef UE), or the UE's internal clock.

q_41492.question: What is the name of the information made available to the split computation 'policy decision point' regarding the network resources for the augmented reality use case?
q_41492.ground_truth: The network provides current network resource information concerning the UE to network communication performance such as new QoS parameters (GBR), the condition information (time point-a) for update of a new QoS, as well as end-to-end performance between the UE and the computation resources (e.g. in the Service Hosting Environment).

q_41493.question: What is the purpose of using asymmetric keys for SLPP signaling groupcast?
q_41493.ground_truth: The purpose is to prevent a receiver from impersonating the groupcaster in the group if the groupcast keys are symmetric keys.

q_41494.question: What condition must be fulfilled for the entering condition of event C2-1 in the measurement reporting procedure?
q_41494.ground_truth: The entering condition for event C2-1 is fulfilled when the measurement result of the CSI-RS resource (Mcr) is greater than or equal to the measurement result of the reference CSI-RS resource (Mref) plus the hysteresis parameter for this event (Hys) plus the offset parameter for this event (Off).

q_41495.question: What is Adjacent Channel Leakage power Ratio (ACLR) in the context of NR channel power measurements?
q_41495.ground_truth: ACLR is the ratio of the filtered mean power centered on the assigned NR channel frequency to the filtered mean power centered on an adjacent NR channel frequency at nominal channel spacing.

q_41496.question: When a public user identity makes a successful registration, what should be the value of the "state" attribute in the <contact> element of the NOTIFY request?
q_41496.ground_truth: The value of the "state" attribute in the <contact> element of the NOTIFY request should be "active" for a successful registration.

q_41497.question: What is the maximum Bit Error Rate (BER) allowed for any measured UTRA FDD carrier outside the base station RF bandwidth or maximum radio bandwidth?
q_41497.ground_truth: The BER should not exceed 0.001 for the reference measurement channel as defined in clause 7.2.5.2.

q_41498.question: What state does the floor control interface enter when another MCPTT client has permission to send media, and the MCPTT client attempts to initiate an already existing MCPTT call?
q_41498.ground_truth: The floor control interface enters the 'U: not permitted and Floor Taken' state as specified in clause 6.3.5.4.2.

q_41499.question: What is the procedure for testing the BS type 1-C receiver and each BS type 1-H TAB connector at the reference sensitivity level?
q_41499.ground_truth: The procedure involves connecting the connector to measurement equipment, setting the BS to transmit a signal, starting the signal generator for the wanted signal, measuring the throughput, and repeating the process for all connectors necessary to demonstrate conformance.

q_41500.question: What type of blocking is measured in the in-band selectivity and blocking characteristics?
q_41500.ground_truth: The in-band selectivity and blocking characteristics are measures of the receiver ability to receive a wanted signal at its assigned channel in the presence of an unwanted interferer inside the operating band and are defined by a wideband and a narrowband blocking requirement.

q_41501.question: In the same scenario as question 1, what should be done regarding the cg-RetransmissionTimer for the corresponding HARQ process?
q_41501.ground_truth: The cg-RetransmissionTimer for the corresponding HARQ process should be started or restarted.

q_41502.question: When should the time and frequency resources be randomly selected for one or more transmission opportunities, as specified in clause 5.28.2 of the destination UE?
q_41502.ground_truth: The time and frequency resources should be randomly selected for one or more transmission opportunities, as specified in clause 5.28.2 of the destination UE, when there are available resources left in the available resources which occur within the SL DRX Active time and the pool(s) in which all RB sets with Sidelink consistent LBT failure detected and not cancelled are excluded.

q_41503.question: What is the general intermodulation minimum requirement for MSR operation?
q_41503.ground_truth: The intermodulation minimum requirement for MSR operation requires that in the presence of two interfering signals, the throughput for any E-UTRA carrier should be greater than or equal to 95% of the maximum throughput for the reference measurement channel, and the BER for any UTRA FDD or TDD carrier should not exceed 0.001.

q_41504.question: What is the purpose of the Uplink power control window in the test procedures for intra-band contiguous, non-contiguous, and inter-band CA?
q_41504.ground_truth: The purpose of the Uplink power control window is to ensure that the actual UE output power is no greater than the target power level, and as close as possible to the target power level.

q_41505.question: What is the role of the N4 Session Establishment procedure in 5G systems?
q_41505.ground_truth: The N4 Session Establishment procedure provides control parameters to the User Plane Function (UPF), allowing it to manage data traffic for a specific PDU session.

q_41506.question: Which clause specifies the application data model supported by the ASTI API?
q_41506.ground_truth: Clause 5.22.4 provides the data model details of the ASTI API.

q_41507.question: What is the test purpose in 6.5B.2.1.1.1?
q_41507.ground_truth: The purpose of the test case 6.5B.2.1.1.1 is to verify that the power of any UE emissions does not exceed the specified level for the specified aggregated bandwidth for the EN-DC intra-band contiguous.

q_41508.question: What out-of-band blocking requirements apply to the lowest level EN-DC fallbacks (two bands) with E-UTRA single carrier and CA operation for FR1, for both intra-band and inter-band cases?
q_41508.ground_truth: The out-of-band blocking requirements for E-UTRA single carrier and CA operation specified in clauses 7.6.2.1 and 7.6.2.1A of TS 36.101 apply for the lowest level EN-DC fallbacks (two bands) in FR1, for both intra-band and inter-band cases.

q_41509.question: How does E-UTRAN handle congestion on the MBMS carrier if the UE prioritises MBMS reception?
q_41509.ground_truth: If the UE prioritises MBMS reception and unicast data cannot be supported because of congestion on the MBMS carrier(s), E-UTRAN may initiate release of unicast bearers. It is up to E-UTRAN implementation whether all bearers or only GBR bearers are released. E-UTRAN does not initiate re-establishment of the released unicast bearers upon alleviation of the congestion.

q_41510.question: What interfaces does the non-roaming architecture use for interworking between ePDG/EPC and 5GS?
q_41510.ground_truth: The non-roaming architecture uses interworking with ePDG is only supported with GTP based S2b, S6b interface is optional.

q_41511.question: What are the responsibilities of the SMF in the enhanced architecture?
q_41511.ground_truth: Based on reporting requirements issued by NEF, SMF receives DetNet related information reported by UPF on the N4 interface and sends it to NEF as required.

q_41512.question: What is WUS assistance and in what type of procedures can a UE include its UE paging probability information in the Requested WUS assistance information IE?
q_41512.ground_truth: WUS (Wake-Up Signal) assistance is a capability that can indicate the UE's assistance during an attach or tracking area updating procedure for the network to determine the WUS group for paging the UE. A UE can include its UE paging probability information in the Requested WUS assistance information IE during an attach or tracking area updating procedure, except when the UE is attaching for emergency bearer services, or has a PDN connection established for emergency bearer services.

q_41513.question: What should the source eNB do when one or more candidate cells in the Candidate Cells To Be Cancelled List IE included in the CONDITIONAL HANDOVER CANCEL message were not prepared using the same UE-associated signaling connection?
q_41513.ground_truth: The source eNB should ignore those non-associated candidate cells.

q_41514.question: What type of information is used to associate a UE accessing an application with a set of UEs using Service information and send the PCC rule to the SMF for the PDU Session?
q_41514.ground_truth: The service information of the UE accessing an application is used to associate the UE with the set of UEs and send the PCC rule to the SMF for the PDU Session with the traffic routing policy information provisioned associated with the set of UEs with the service information.

q_41515.question: What procedure is used by the network to suspend the connection if the UE and the network support User Plane CIoT EPS Optimisation?
q_41515.ground_truth: The Connection Suspend procedure is used by the network to suspend the connection.

q_41516.question: In which case should a MS proceed as specified in subclauses 4.5.1.1 or 4.3.5.2 respectively, and increment the counter for "SIM/USIM considered invalid for GPRS services" events?
q_41516.ground_truth: This should be done if the MS receives an ATTACH REJECT or ROUTING AREA UPDATE REJECT message without integrity protection with GMM cause value #3, #6, #7, #8, #11, #12, #13, #14 or #15 before the network has activated the integrity protection for the PS domain.

q_41517.question: Which identity is used for SC-MCCH and SC-MCCH change notification in MBMS related identities?
q_41517.ground_truth: SC-RNTI(for NB-IoT UEs, BL UEs or UEs in enhanced coverage) and SC-N-RNTI(for UEs other than NB-IoT UEs, BL UEs or UEs in enhanced coverage) are used for SC-MCCH and SC-MCCH change notification. And G-RNTI(for NB-IoT UEs, BL UEs or UEs in enhanced coverage) is used for transmissions of a SC-MTCH and SC-MCCH change notification.

q_41518.question: What should a UE that supports V2X communication over PC5 do when it is triggered to transmit V2X sidelink communication, but does not support partial sensing?
q_41518.ground_truth: The UE does not initiate V2X sidelink Communication when it is not supporting partial sensing.

q_41519.question: What should the UE be capable of in relation to the number of RLM-RS resources to monitor in a corresponding carrier frequency range?
q_41519.ground_truth: The UE should be able to monitor up to NRLM RLM-RS resources of the same or different types in each corresponding carrier frequency range, depending on a maximum number of SSBs per half frame.

q_41520.question: What is the action taken by the UE when submitting the RRCConnectionReestablishmentComplete message in TS 36.331, clause 5.3.7.5?
q_41520.ground_truth: The UE shall include the rlf-InfoAvailable if the UE has radio link failure or handover failure information available in VarRLF-Report and the plmn-Identity stored in VarRLF-Report is equal to the RPLMN.

q_41521.question: In the context of the present specification, what does "DRA binding" refer to?
q_41521.ground_truth: DRA binding refers to the PCRF routing information stored per UE or per PDN in the DRA, which includes the user identity, IP address/prefix, APN (if available), and the selected PCRF identity for a certain IP-CAN Session.

q_41522.question: What should the UE do if it is in the ATTEMPTING-TO-UPDATE substate in EMM-REGISTERED state?
q_41522.ground_truth: The UE should not send any user data, initiate tracking area updating on the expiry of timers T3411, T3402 or T3346, and use requests for non-EPS services from CM layers to trigger a combined tracking area updating procedure. It may also initiate a tracking area updating procedure upon request of the upper layers to establish a PDN connection for emergency bearer services, and if timer T3346 is not running, it may detach locally and initiate an attach for emergency bearer services. Additionally, it may use requests for MMTEL voice call or MMTEL video call from the upper layers to initiate tracking area updating, and initiate tracking area updating in response to paging with S-TMSI or paging with IMSI and domain indicator set to 'CS'.

q_41523.question: What should be modified if the speech media component or the speech media and video media components are not the only media components of the session and they were not transferred in the transferable session set?
q_41523.ground_truth: The remote leg and source access leg should be modified and the media component(s) should be removed.

q_41524.question: What is the function of the Policy Control Function (PCF) in the 5G System architecture?
q_41524.ground_truth: The PCF (Policy Control Function) encompasses policy control decision and flow based charging control functionalities, access and mobility policy decisions, and UE Policy decisions for the control of Access network discovery and selection policy and UE Route Selection Policy (URSP). The PCF offers these capabilities to the NF service consumers, such as the AF and NEF, for the control of service data flow detection, gating, QoS and flow based charging (except credit management) towards the SMF/UPF.

q_41525.question: What should be the minimum reporting criteria for the UE to send event triggered measurement reports, as per clause 8.16.95.4.3?
q_41525.ground_truth: The UE shall not send event triggered measurement reports as long as the reporting criteria are not fulfilled.

q_41526.question: In what state of the cell selection process can the logging be performed at regular time intervals?
q_41526.ground_truth: If the UE is in any cell selection state.

q_41527.question: What is the purpose of the "EventNotify" resource in the 6.4.5 section?
q_41527.ground_truth: The "EventNotify" resource in the 6.4.5 section represents the callback reference of the NF Service Consumer to receive LCS event notify.

q_41528.question: Which ciphering algorithms are supported by the gNB for ciphering user data between the UE and gNB?
q_41528.ground_truth: The gNB shall support ciphering algorithms -NEA0, 128-NEA1, 128-NEA2.

q_41529.question: What is the purpose of the "PSETR" feature in the 5G System?
q_41529.ground_truth: The "PSETR" feature allows a SMF to reselect an alternative peer SMF using the binding indication of the resource/session contexts or based on the NF profile of the peer SMF.

q_41530.question: What network architecture options are available for the CSP in IMS domain for Voice service type and what are the implications of each option on network provisioning?
q_41530.ground_truth: The CSP may have either a local breakout (LBO) based roaming architecture or a home-routed based roaming architecture. In an LBO-based roaming architecture, the BBIFF-C function is provided by the SMF in a 5GC packet core network and by the SGW-C/SGW in an EPC packet core network, while in a home-routed based roaming architecture, the host NFs that provide the LI functions when the target is non-local ID may differ from the host NFs that provide the LI functions when the target is not non-local ID.

q_41531.question: What does the Overload Reduction Metric value of "0" indicate in the Overload Control Information?
q_41531.ground_truth: An Overload Reduction Metric of "0" always indicates that the GTP-C entity is not in overload and no overload abatement procedures need to be applied.

q_41532.question: What defines the maximum allowed aggregate data rate across all QoS Flows within a network slice?

q_41533.question: What should be the impact of PRS symbols dropping during the measurement period within PRS processing window due to collisions with other signals on the UE Rx-Tx time difference measurements?
q_41533.ground_truth: If PRS symbols are dropped during the measurement period within PRS processing window due to collisions with other signals, then a longer measurement period may be used for UE Rx-Tx time difference measurements.

q_41534.question: What should be the value of the "status" attribute in the request body during the NEF initiated SMF-NEF connection release procedure?
q_41534.ground_truth: The value of the "status" attribute should be set to "RELEASED" during the NEF initiated SMF-NEF connection release procedure.

q_41535.question: What is the purpose of studying synchronization signal used by LP-WUR?
q_41535.ground_truth: The purpose of studying synchronization signal used by LP-WUR is to ensure that LP-WUS coverage is equal to or better than that of LP-WUS, and a signal (e.g. preamble) preceding or part of LP-WUS may be used for fine time and frequency synchronization.

q_41536.question: What is the role of the V-CHF in Solution #2.1?
q_41536.ground_truth: In Solution #2.1, the V-CHF communicates with the H-CHF for retail charging of 5G data connectivity, handles charging information for 5G data connectivity usage, and establishes a single charging session for 5G data connectivity and SMS usage towards the H-CHF.

q_41537.question: What should the UE do if the upper layers provide the 'Registered MME' in the NB-IoT UE procedure?
q_41537.ground_truth: The UE should include and set the plmnIdentity in the registeredMME to the value of the PLMN identity in the 'Registered MME' received from upper layers.

q_41538.question: What is the role of the gNB-CU-CP when AMF sends a Trace Start message in a split architecture?
q_41538.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-CP decides if gNB-CU-UP or gNB-DU, or both should be involved in the MDT measurement and sends the TRACE START message to gNB-CU-UP and/or gNB-DU if these nodes should be involved in the MDT measurement.

q_41539.question: What is the role of the API invoker in the message flow for UE originated API invocation?
q_41539.ground_truth: The API invoker is responsible for sending requests to the API invoker on the UE, authenticating the Authorization Server and AEF, and validating the token received from the Authorization Server.

q_41540.question: What value will the MME set in the EPS update result IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message if the UE requested "SMS only" and supports NB-S1 mode only?
q_41540.ground_truth: The MME will set the EPS update result IE to "EPS only".

q_41541.question: How does the P-CSCF identify the public user identity when there is no wildcardedIdentity subelement included in the registration element?
q_41541.ground_truth: The public user identity is taken from the 'aor' attribute of the registration element.

q_41542.question: What does the PPE flag set to "1" in the Alternative SMF IP Address IE indicate in the context of SMF IP addresses?
q_41542.ground_truth: The SMF IP addresses with the PPE flag set to "1" are PFCP entities in the preferred binding entity corresponding to the binding level in the Binding Indication of the resource context. The UPF shall select these preferably when reselection is required.

q_41543.question: What should be done if both events "Re-select newly detected Cell" and "Re-select already detected Cell" pass?
