q_42975.question: What is the purpose of the MBMS heartbeat procedure in the 3GPP network?
q_42975.ground_truth: The MBMS heartbeat procedure enables the BM-SC and MBMS GW to detect an SGmb path failure or the restart of the peer MBMS node.

q_42976.question: What should the UE do if it has transmitted a RACH MSG3 containing RRCConnectionRequest-NB message, and the SS transmits a valid MAC PDU including 'UE Contention Resolution Identity' MAC control element but with un-matched 'Contention Resolution Identity'?
q_42976.ground_truth: The UE reinitiates the RACH procedure.

q_42977.question: What is used to provide A2X Service related parameters to V-PCF for UE and NG-RAN in the roaming case?

q_42978.question: What is the requirement for the UE to send an Event A3 triggered measurement report in Test 2?
q_42978.ground_truth: In Test 2, the UE shall send one Event A3 triggered measurement report, with a measurement reporting delay less than 51.2 s from the beginning of time period T2.

q_42979.question: What is the range of Maximum bit rate for downlink (extended-2) in octet 19?
q_42979.ground_truth: The range of values for octet 19 is from 260 Mbps to 10 Gbps in 4 Mbps to 10 Gbps increments.

q_42980.question: What is the role of the mobile base station relay (IAB-node) in providing 5G coverage and communication to UEs?
q_42980.ground_truth: The mobile base station relay (IAB-node) provides 5G coverage and communication to UEs (both inside the vehicle and in its vicinity) through a wireless connection to the 5G network via an IAB-donor gNB.

q_42981.question: What must the UE do to become aware of proximity of a connectivity service provided by a UE-to-network relay?
q_42981.ground_truth: The UE must initiate the monitoring UE procedure for UE-to-network relay discovery to become aware of proximity of a connectivity service provided by a UE-to-network relay.

q_42982.question: What is the role of the NWDAF in providing observed service experience?
q_42982.ground_truth: The NWDAF provides observed service experience as defined in clause 6.4.3, which can be provided individually per user equipment (UE) or group of UEs, or globally, and can be averaged per application or across a set of applications on a network slice.

q_42983.question: What should the controlling MCData function do when it receives a SIP BYE request from the MCData client?
q_42983.ground_truth: Upon receiving a SIP BYE request from the MCData client, the participating MCData function should send a SIP 200 (OK) response towards the MCData server and release all media plane resources corresponding to the MCData communication with the originating MCData client.

q_42984.question: What is the maximum number of neighboring cells that the UE should include in the measResultNeighCells when storing the connection establishment failure information in VarConnEstFailReport in clause 5.3.3.6 of TS 36.331?
q_42984.ground_truth: The UE should include up to 6 intra-frequency and 3 inter-frequency neighbors per frequency, as well as 3 inter-RAT neighbors per frequency/set of frequencies for each RAT.

q_42985.question: What is the requirement for the UE to use the associated DUSK, DUCK, and DUIK to process a PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for direct discovery response or direct discovery solicitation?
q_42985.ground_truth: To unscramble, decrypt, and verify the MIC field of the message, respectively.

q_42986.question: What information is stored in the EPDGRecord?
q_42986.ground_truth: The EPDGRecord includes information such as the addresses of involved nodes, the duration of the session, and the traffic volume.

q_42987.question: What information does the MME include in the Delete Bearer Command message it sends to the Serving GW to deactivate a selected dedicated bearer?
q_42987.ground_truth: The MME includes the EPS Bearer Identity, User Location Information, UE Time Zone, RAN/NAS Release Cause if available, Secondary RAT usage data, and PSCell ID if received in step 1.

q_42988.question: What is the EVM budget for MPR evaluation?
q_42988.ground_truth: The EVM budget for MPR evaluation is 3.5% for both 29GHz and 39GHz.

q_42989.question: In FR2 massive MIMO antenna system, how is the ECC used to measure the diversity performance?
q_42989.ground_truth: ECC is used to measure the correlation of radiated beams; lower ECC values are desired for good diversity performance.

q_42990.question: Which type of E-UTRA UE does the test case 5.5.1.8.2 apply to?
q_42990.ground_truth: This test case applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 15 and forward supporting EN-DC, CSI-RS based RLM and long DRX cycle.

q_42991.question: What action should the MB-SMF take when the MBS service area requested by the NF Service Consumer is outside the MB-SMF service area?
q_42991.ground_truth: The MB-SMF should reduce the MBS service area to be within the MB-SMF service area and continue the Update service operation.

q_42992.question: What is the use of the parameter <AcT> in the 8.77 command?
q_42992.ground_truth: The parameter <AcT> in the 8.77 command indicates the access technology (mode) of the serving cell.

q_42993.question: What should the Participating MCData function do before transmitting on an MBMS bearer?
q_42993.ground_truth: The Participating MCData function shall generate MSCCK(s) with the corresponding MSCCK-ID(s) and MuSiK(s) with the corresponding MuSiK-IDs as necessary, and shall distribute MSCCKs, MSCCK-IDs, MuSiKs and MuSiK-IDs to the MCData clients, as needed, using the keying material received from the key management server for security protection.

q_42994.question: Under what circumstances will the AMF include an active time value in the T3324 IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message?
q_42994.ground_truth: The AMF will include an active time value in the T3324 IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message if the UE requested an active time value in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message and the AMF accepts the use of MICO mode and the use of active time.

q_42995.question: What should the MGCF do if the precondition mechanism is required during session modification but was not used in session establishment?
q_42995.ground_truth: If the precondition mechanism is required during session modification but was not used in session establishment, the MGCF should reject the request by sending a 420 (Bad Extension) response.

q_42996.question: What is the use of MnS consumer ID in the CAPIF-5 interface within the 3GPP management system?
q_42996.ground_truth: The MnS consumer ID serves to differentiate each MnS consumer during auditing, enabling the MnS producer to recognize each MnS consumer accessing the audit log.

q_42997.question: What information is provided by the MN to the SN when using MCG resources for SN terminated bearers?
q_42997.ground_truth: The MN provides Xn-U DL TNL address information in the Xn-U Address Indication message.

q_42998.question: What should the network do with an already established UMTS security context for the PS domain after a successful handover from S1 mode to Iu mode or S1 mode to A/Gb mode?
q_42998.ground_truth: The network should replace the already established UMTS security context for the PS domain after a successful handover from S1 mode to Iu mode or S1 mode to A/Gb mode.

q_42999.question: When can the UE request a connectivity that requires PAP/CHAP?
q_42999.ground_truth: The UE requests a connectivity that requires PAP/CHAP when it does not have any matching non-default URSP rule, and the application provides the DNN.

q_43000.question: How is the event-triggered measurement reporting delay defined in R-E-UTRAN FDD?
q_43000.ground_truth: The event-triggered measurement reporting delay is defined as the time between an event that triggers a measurement report and the point the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface, excluding the delays caused by other RRC signalling or no UL resources for UE to send the measurement report.

q_43001.question: When is a UE required to measure CSI-RS for L1-RSRP measurement in the PRBs that overlap with an SSB in the same component carrier?
q_43001.ground_truth: A UE is not required to measure CSI-RSRP for L1-RSRP measurement in the PRBs that overlap with an SSB when the SSB for RLM, BFD, CBD or L1-RSRP measurement is in the same OFDM symbol and the active BWP has the same SCS as the CSI-RS for L1-RSRP measurement.

q_43002.question: What is the definition of control plane data confidentiality protection provided in the eNB network product class?
q_43002.ground_truth: The control plane data confidentiality protection in the eNB network product class refers to the requirement that the eNB shall provide confidentiality protection for control plane packets on the S1/X2 reference points.

q_43003.question: What is the structure of the <Default-user-profile> element?
q_43003.ground_truth: The <Default-user-profile> element shall contain a "User-ID" attribute and a "user-profile-index" attribute.

q_43004.question: What message is sent by the AMF if the UE policy update procedure is triggered after the NWtp connection is successfully established in the context of TS 23.502?
q_43004.ground_truth: The AMF sends a Registration Reject message via TNGF to the UE after updating the UE policy as defined in TS 23.502.

q_43005.question: Which MAC CE command is used in the 2Rx TDD FR1 PDSCH HST-SFN Scheme A and B performance test procedures to active TCI state codepoint 0, 1, or 2 for PDCCH periodically?
q_43005.ground_truth: The MAC CE command "Enhanced TCI States Indication for UE-specific PDCCH MAC CE" is used.

q_43006.question: What is the role of the PIN server in the PIN communication via 5GS procedure?
q_43006.ground_truth: The PIN server is responsible for interacting with the 5GS and receiving the credential for the PIN communication via 5GS procedure.

q_43007.question: What message type is sent by the network to the mobile station to indicate that the requested service has been accepted?

q_43008.question: What is the BS transmission power assumed by the 1st source for all results in case of using SBFD Alt 3 and large packet size?
q_43008.ground_truth: The BS transmission power assumed by the 1st source for all results in case of using SBFD Alt 3 and large packet size is 53dBm.

q_43009.question: What is the meaning of "5G ProSe Direct Communication" in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
q_43009.ground_truth: In 3GPP technical specifications, "5G ProSe Direct Communication" refers to the communications between two or more UEs in proximity that are 5G ProSe-enabled, by means of user plane transmission using NR technology via a path not traversing any network node.

q_43010.question: Which Indian regulatory document related to the Radio Waves Act mentions the adoption of new regulatory requirements whenever a new spectrum is introduced?
q_43010.ground_truth: The Enforcement Decree Of The Radio Waves Act in Korea

q_43011.question: What should the UE do if it receives a correct message over Temporary C-RNTI with a UE contention resolution identity included in the MAC control element matching the CCCH SDU transmitted in the msg3 uplink message in Test 5?
q_43011.ground_truth: The UE shall send ACK and consider the contention resolution successful and the random access procedure successfully completed.

q_43012.question: Where and when are localized services available based on localized service agreements?
q_43012.ground_truth: Localized services are available based on service agreements for localized services. These agreements determine the location, times, and coverage for accessing the localized services.

q_43013.question: What is the purpose of the RRC-Container IE in the UE CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message?
q_43013.ground_truth: If the UE CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message contains the RRC-Container IE, the gNB-DU will send the corresponding RRC message to the UE via SRB1.

q_43014.question: What is the SIP MESSAGE request for binding of a functional alias with the MCData group(s) for the MCData user for the controlling MCData function?
q_43014.ground_truth: A SIP MESSAGE request with the Request-URI set to the public service identity of the participating MCData function, a Content-Type header field set to "application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml", and an XML body containing an <mcdatainfo> root element with a <mcdata-Params> element containing an <anyExt> element with the <request-type> element set to a value of "fa-group-binding-req".

q_43015.question: What is the method used to ensure conformance in mapping between logical channels and transport channels in E-UTRA cells?
q_43015.ground_truth: The conformance requirements covered in this test are specified in TS 36.321, clause 5.11, 6.2.1, 5.3.3, and 6.1.2.

q_43016.question: What data type represents information of an SMF Instance?

q_43017.question: How many possible Trigger Detection Points are defined in the MT-SMS-TPDU-Type for D-CSI?

q_43018.question: Which speed-dependent scaling factors can be added to Qhyst if the High-mobility state is detected?
q_43018.ground_truth: The sf-High of "Speed dependent ScalingFactor for Qhyst".

q_43019.question: Who receives the PRU info from AMF or LMF in 6.29.4?
q_43019.ground_truth: GMLC receives the PRU info from AMF or LMF in 6.29.4.

q_43020.question: What restrictions apply to the use of Reflective QoS in PDU Sessions of IP type?
q_43020.ground_truth: Reflective QoS is restricted to service data flows with Protocol ID / Next Header set to TCP, UDP, or ESP in PDU Sessions of IP type.

q_43021.question: What is the name of the interface used for interaction between CHF (UE CCS) and CHF (TSN CCS) in Solution #4?

q_43022.question: What should be done when the resolution bandwidth is smaller than the measurement bandwidth in order to obtain the equivalent noise bandwidth of the measurement bandwidth?
q_43022.ground_truth: The result should be integrated over the measurement bandwidth.

q_43023.question: What does Ranging/SL Positioning Capability indicate during the Registration procedure in clause 6.3.2?
q_43023.ground_truth: The Ranging/SL Positioning Capability indicates the UE's Ranging/SL Positioning service domain information and parameters for Ranging/SL Positioning service during the Registration procedure in clause 6.3.2.

q_43024.question: What are the requirements for the fraction of correctly detected ACKs in the testing procedure for PUCCH format 2 ACK detection in the IAB-DU tester?
q_43024.ground_truth: The requirement for the fraction of correctly detected ACKs in the testing procedure for PUCCH format 2 ACK detection in the IAB-DU tester is larger than 99%.

q_43025.question: What is the S-RSSI measurement period corresponding to in determining the subset of resources to be excluded in PSSCH resource selection in sidelink transmission mode 4?
q_43025.ground_truth: The S-RSSI measurement period corresponds to 1 second in determining the subset of resources to be excluded in PSSCH resource selection in sidelink transmission mode 4.

q_43026.question: What is HARQ information for DL-SCH or for UL-SCH transmissions consisting of?
q_43026.ground_truth: HARQ information for DL-SCH or for UL-SCH transmissions consists of New Data Indicator (NDI), Transport Block (TB) size.

q_43027.question: What is a Buffer Status Report (BSR) in the context of TS 36.321 clause 6.1.3.1?
q_43027.ground_truth: A Buffer Status Report (BSR) is a MAC control element that consists of one or four LCG ID fields and corresponding Buffer Size fields, which identify the amount of data available for transmission across all logical channels of a logical channel group.

q_43028.question: How does the participating MCVideo function determine the served MCVideo user information entry upon receiving a SIP request that requires implicit affiliation of the sending MCVideo client to an MCVideo group?
q_43028.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function considers an MCVideo user information entry as the served MCVideo user information entry if it is in the list of MCVideo user information entries, and the MCVideo ID of the MCVideo user information entry is equal to the served MCVideo ID.

q_43029.question: What should the AMF do if it has no native 5G security context available for the UE, following the handover procedure?
q_43029.ground_truth: The AMF should run a primary authentication, depending on the local operator policy.

q_43030.question: What UE related information is temporarily stored when the UE is attached for emergency bearer services?
q_43030.ground_truth: EMM parameters (GUTI, last visited registered TAI, EPS update status, Allowed CSG list, Operator CSG list, and EPS security context parameters) are temporarily stored if the corresponding file is present on the USIM. The TIN is stored in non-volatile memory in the ME together with the IMSI from the USIM. If the UE is attached for emergency bearer services, the UE shall not store the EMM parameters described in this annex on the USIM or in non-volatile memory.

q_43031.question: When is it required for all authentication and authorization mechanisms, including security roots at the application services layer and SIP signalling plane, to be hidden from and not available to the PLMN operator?
q_43031.ground_truth: Scenario 3: MC service provider separate from SIP core and 5GS

q_43032.question: In what state is the behavior of the UE specified in subclause 5.2.3.2.1?

q_43033.question: What behavior should a UE in the CAMPING NORMALLY state exhibit regarding the detection, synchronization, and monitoring of intra-frequency, inter-frequency, and inter-RAT cells indicated by the serving cell?
q_43033.ground_truth: When the UE is in the CAMPING NORMALLY state on a cell, the UE should attempt to detect, synchronize, and monitor intra-frequency, inter-frequency, and inter-RAT cells indicated by the serving cell. The serving cell may provide explicit neighbor list, or only carrier frequency information and bandwidth information. UE measurement activity is controlled by measurement rules defined in TS38.304, allowing the UE to limit its measurement activity.

q_43034.question: What are some of the security threats that can arise due to inconsistencies between the NF management lifecycle and certificate management lifecycle processes?
q_43034.ground_truth: Some security threats that can arise due to inconsistencies between the NF management lifecycle and certificate management lifecycle processes include unauthorized access to the network and corresponding services, and compromise of cryptographic keys and certificates.

q_43035.question: What should the UE do with the rlf-Report field in the UEInformationResponse message upon successful delivery?
q_43035.ground_truth: The UE should discard the rlf-Report from VarRLF-Report upon successful delivery of the UEInformationResponse message confirmed by lower layers.

q_43036.question: What filter order is appropriate for achieving the required SNR, given a modulation scheme, number of guard RBs, and residual frequency error, in the context of link-level simulations for ASCS?
q_43036.ground_truth: The filter order does not seem to impact performance significantly, given a modulation scheme, number of guard RBs, and residual frequency error.

q_43037.question: How does the MDA provide fault predictions to the NWDAF?
q_43037.ground_truth: The MDA can provide fault predictions to the NWDAF by determining data producers and collecting data, determining a fault, and reporting the fault to the NWDAF. The analytic output of the MDA may include parameters such as the network function identity, the time duration of the fault, and the severity of the fault.

q_43038.question: What is the purpose of the "IP-CAN Session Establishment Procedure" in step 9?
q_43038.ground_truth: The PDN GW provides information to the PCRF used to identify the session and associate Gateway Control Sessions established in step 6 correctly. The PCRF creates IP-CAN session related information and responds to the PDN GW with PCC rules and event triggers.

q_43039.question: What is the resulting action when the UE receives a PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for UE-to-UE relay discovery response?
q_43039.ground_truth: The UE starts monitoring for PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY messages for UE-to-UE relay discovery response from the discoveree end UE and triggers the 5G ProSe direct link release procedure if no response is received after reaching the maximum number of allowed retransmissions.

q_43040.question: What are the symbols used in the document for explanatory purposes?
q_43040.ground_truth: Symbols in the document are used to clarify abstract rules by applying them literally.

q_43041.question: How many NRSRP measurements does a UE need to filter for a measured intra-frequency cell?
q_43041.ground_truth: The UE shall filter NRSRP measurements of each measured intra-frequency cell using at least 2 measurements.

q_43042.question: What action does the PEMC-2 take after being requested to take the role of PEMC in case of PEMC replacement triggered by PIN server?
q_43042.ground_truth: If the PEMC-2 decides to take up the role of PEMC, it sends the success response to the PIN server.

q_43043.question: What action does the serving NG-RAN node take when it needs to send an NRPPa message to the LMF for a target UE?
q_43043.ground_truth: The serving NG-RAN node sends an NRPPa PDU to the AMF in an NGAP Uplink UE Associated NRPPa Transport message and includes the Routing ID received from the AMF.

q_43044.question: What are the recommended total delay times and the measured part of the signal in the test setup?
q_43044.ground_truth: The recommended total delay times in the test setup are 360 ms for the sine-wave signal and 170,667 ms for the measured part of the signal. These durations are selected to be relatively short to reduce the risk of treating the test tone as a stationary signal.

q_43045.question: What is the information included in the "MP-DCCP Connection Setup Information" sent from SMF to UE?
q_43045.ground_truth: Information for establishing a MP-DCCP connection, including associated QFI and steering mode

q_43046.question: Which test procedure is applied in 7.4.4.2?
q_43046.ground_truth: The test procedure in 7.4.4.2 involves the downlink signal level setup, beam selection, uplink power control, beamlock function activation, average throughput measurement, and beamlock function deactivation.

q_43047.question: What mechanism does the 5G system need to minimize the security impact when using an Evolved Residential Gateway?
q_43047.ground_truth: The 5G system needs to support a mechanism as per PR 5.5.6-003 to minimize the security impact on the PLMN or broadband access network when using an Evolved Residential Gateway.

q_43048.question: What security measures are required for securing the F1 interface between the gNB-CU and gNB-DU?
q_43048.ground_truth: IPsec ESP and IKEv2 certificates-based authentication are required for the F1-U and F1-C interfaces with confidentiality, integrity, and replay protection.

q_43049.question: What should be indicated by the "cps" parameter in the "t140" format's "sdp fmtp attribute" in a multiparty session?
q_43049.ground_truth: The rate at which parties are sending, in units of 30 characters per second.

q_43050.question: What should the UE do before initiating ProSe direct communication to ensure that it does not cause interference with other cells?
q_43050.ground_truth: The UE should check with lower layers whether the selected radio parameters can be used in the current location without causing interference to other cells.

q_43051.question: What is the purpose of the test in 8.16.8.1?
q_43051.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify the UE's ability to make a correct reporting of an event on deactivated SCell with PCell interruption in non-DRX within the E-UTRA TDD measurements of the secondary component carrier cell search requirements.

q_43052.question: What is the role of the "VAE server" in the context of Websocket-based notification delivery described in section 6.4.5.4?
q_43052.ground_truth: The "VAE server" is responsible for sending dynamic group notifications to the service consumer using Websocket.

q_43053.question: What protocol shall be used as the content type of the HTTP bodies specified in this specification?
q_43053.ground_truth: JSON (as specified in IETF RFC 8259) shall be used as the content type of the HTTP bodies specified in this specification.

q_43054.question: What is the significance of the first label "topon" or "topoff" in the host name construct within the 3GPP EPC?
q_43054.ground_truth: The first label "topon" or "topoff" in the host name construct within the 3GPP EPC is used to indicate whether or not collocated and topologically close node selection shall be preferred.

q_43055.question: What interference to reference signals is made negligible for measurement accuracy in intra-frequency cells?
q_43055.ground_truth: Interference to reference signals from PDSCH with SI-RNTI of other cells is made negligible.

q_43056.question: What flag must be set in the Feature-List AVP to indicate that the SGSN supports the "SMS in SGSN" feature?

q_43057.question: What is the function of parameter '<n>' in the context of call waiting information?
q_43057.ground_truth: Parameter '<n>' is used to enable or disable the presentation of an unsolicited result code (+CCWA) when call waiting service is enabled.

q_43058.question: What action should the MCPTT client take upon the expiry of timer TFP4 when in the "P5: pending" state, if the value of the counter CFP4 is equal to the upper limit?
q_43058.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should start timer TFP7, release the call type control state machine, and enter the "P1: ignoring same call id" state.

q_43059.question: What information is stored in an IEFAssociationRecord?
q_43059.ground_truth: An IEFAssociationRecord stores the times of association and disassociation and the values of PEI, GPSI, NCGI or TAI list.

q_43060.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for the DL BWP switch delay requirement for RRC-based BWP switch in NR SA FR1?
q_43060.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirement for the DL BWP switch delay requirement for RRC-based BWP switch in NR SA FR1 is specified in clause 16.5.3.2.2.3.

q_43061.question: What is the purpose of the frequency error test in 6.4.1.4.2?
q_43061.ground_truth: The purpose of the frequency error test in 6.4.1.4.2 is to verify the ability of both the receiver and the transmitter to process frequency correctly. The receiver extracts the correct frequency from the stimulus signal, and the transmitter derives the correct modulated carrier frequency from the results gained by the receiver.

q_43062.question: Which protocol extension container is specified as mandatory in the E-RABToBeSetupItemCtxtSUReq message?

q_43063.question: What protects the media in an off-network private call if protection of media is negotiated?
q_43063.ground_truth: The PCK and the PCK-ID protect media sent and received by an MCVideo client if protection of media is negotiated in an off-network private call.

q_43064.question: Which message serves as the initial message for meNBinitiatedSgNBModificationPreparation?

q_43065.question: What is the procedure for the first time period T1 in this test?
q_43065.ground_truth: During time period T1, the UE does not have timing information for NR cell 3. The CCA model is disabled at the start and SS provides UL grants so no SR is required. UE shall send a measurement report at the end of T1 with the correct event A3 measurement.

q_43066.question: What action should be taken by a server upon receiving a request to delete a temporary MCS group when the requesting client is not authorized?
q_43066.ground_truth: The server should respond with an HTTP 403 (Forbidden) response to indicate that the client does not have the required permissions for the action.

q_43067.question: What is defined in clause 5.32.5.2 of the specification?
q_43067.ground_truth: Clause 5.32.5.2 defines the structured data types to be used in resource representations for the MemberUESelectionAssistance API.

q_43068.question: What string is appended to the 'app-protocol' name to identify the UE usage type for which the discovery and selection procedure is performed in the S-NAPTR procedure?

q_43069.question: What must the initiating UE ensure when initiating the 5G ProSe direct discovery procedure over PC5 interface with model B in clause 7.7.2.2?
q_43069.ground_truth: The initiating UE must ensure that the target UE is in proximity.

q_43070.question: What is the recommendation to do something indicated by the term "should" in the context of normative provisions?
q_43070.ground_truth: The term "should" indicates a recommendation to do something in the context of normative provisions.

q_43071.question: What is the purpose of the Notification Control Indication procedure in MR-DC with 5GC?
q_43071.ground_truth: The Notification Control Indication procedure in MR-DC with 5GC indicates that GFBR for one or several QoS flows cannot be fulfilled anymore or can be fulfilled again by the reporting node.

q_43072.question: How should the "realm" parameter be structured for 3GPP-bootstrapping with HTTP Digest authentication?
q_43072.ground_truth: The "realm" parameter should contain the constant string "3GPP-bootstrapping", "@", and the FQDN of the NAF.

q_43073.question: What is the significance of an "MCData emergency one-to-one communication" in the context of the present document?
q_43073.ground_truth: An MCData emergency one-to-one communication is an urgent communication that highlights a situation of potential death or serious injury between two participants. This type of communication has different internal perspectives, including the "MCData emergency alert state", "MCData emergency group state", "MCData emergency private alert state", and "MCData emergency private priority state".

q_43074.question: What is the aim of the early implementation Technical Report in the 3GPP work?
q_43074.ground_truth: The aim of the early implementation Technical Report is to help implementers identify which parts of the specifications are relevant to a specific Work Item and how they should be handled when early implementation is performed, without defining any new technical requirements.

q_43075.question: What is the difference between intra-band contiguous and non-contiguous carrier aggregation in NR operation?
q_43075.ground_truth: Intra-band contiguous carrier aggregation involves aggregating contiguous carriers in the same operating band, while non-contiguous carrier aggregation involves aggregating non-contiguous carriers in the same operating band.

q_43076.question: In the provided protocol, what is the difference between multipleULAoA and pathPower in the AdditionalPath-Item structure?
q_43076.ground_truth: In the provided protocol, multipleULAoA is a protocol extension criticality that indicates the number of UL Asynchronous AoA beams in the AdditionalPath-Item, while pathPower refers to the UL-SRS-RSRPP power of the AdditionalPath-Item.

q_43077.question: What happens to the existing charging session after a 5GS to EPS handover using N26 interface when the trigger for interworking is enabled and set to "immediate reporting"?
q_43077.ground_truth: The PGW-C+SMF will report usage in the source network and request quota for the target network.

q_43078.question: What is the maximum size for link MTU recommended to prevent fragmentation in the backbone network?
q_43078.ground_truth: The recommended maximum size for link MTU is 1358 octets to prevent fragmentation in the backbone network.

q_43079.question: What comes next after the SMF receives the GTP-U path monitoring results indicating the observed delay?
q_43079.ground_truth: The SMF initiates SM Policy Association Modification in order to inform the PCF of the Satellite Backhaul Category and (optionally) the observed delay.

q_43080.question: What does the participating MCPTT function do with RTP media packets under different conditions?
q_43080.ground_truth: If RTP media packets are from an MCPTT client, the participating MCPTT function forwards the RTP media packet to the controlling MCPTT function. If RTP media packets are from the controlling MCPTT function or the non-controlling MCPTT function, they are immediately forwarded to the MCPTT client if the MCPTT client has not reported "listening" status or has reported "not-listening" status in the latest received MBMS bearer listening status report. Otherwise, the actions are performed as specified in clause 10.2.

q_43081.question: What does the "CAMEL modified Service Centre" contain in the context of mobile communication?
q_43081.ground_truth: The "CAMEL modified Service Centre" contains the Short Message Service Center (SMS-C) address that was modified by CAMEL service.

q_43082.question: What is the difference between event-based and session-based charging?
q_43082.ground_truth: Event-based charging relates to a single end-user-to-network transaction, while session-based charging is characterized by the existence of a user session, such as a circuit call, an IP CAN bearer, a PDU session, or an IMS session, resulting in the generation of multiple chargeable/charging events.

q_43083.question: What does the "CUG index" parameter in 7.6.3.25 represent?
q_43083.ground_truth: The "CUG index" parameter in 7.6.3.25 represents the CUG index defined in ETS 300 138.

q_43084.question: What is the purpose of the "roll-out plan" in the process of automated roll-out of a new version of a 3GPP NF?
q_43084.ground_truth: The roll-out plan is used to assign cases (such as UEs or requests) to the new version of the NF in increments and to specify the conditions or thresholds that must be met before moving to the next increment. It also contains other performance KPIs and conditions that signal a failure and may require a roll-back of the new NF.

q_43085.question: How is the cell re-selection delay to a higher priority cell defined?
q_43085.ground_truth: It is defined as the time from the beginning of time period T3, to the moment when the UE camps again on cell 2, and starts to send preambles on the PRACH for sending the RRCSetupRequest message to perform a Registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update on cell 2.

q_43086.question: In what conditions must the SMF report the accumulated usage to the PCF?
q_43086.ground_truth: The SMF must report the accumulated usage to the PCF when a usage threshold is reached, when all PCC rules for which usage monitoring is enabled for a particular usage monitoring key are removed or deactivated, when usage monitoring is explicitly disabled by the PCF, when a PDU session is terminated, or when requested by the PCF.

q_43087.question: What is the function of LPP duplicate detection in LPP reliable transport?
q_43087.ground_truth: LPP duplicate detection ensures that duplicate LPP messages are discarded, avoiding unnecessary processing and resources.

q_43088.question: What should the network do if it receives an ESM DATA TRANSPORT message from a UE which is in a location where the PLMN is not allowed to operate?
q_43088.ground_truth: The network should discard the ESM DATA TRANSPORT message if it is received from a UE which is in a location where the PLMN is not allowed to operate.

q_43089.question: When a UE accesses an SNPN using credentials from a CH, what is the first set of URSP rules that the UE evaluates?
q_43089.ground_truth: The UE first evaluates (in precedence order) the URSP rules, if any, provisioned (signalled) by the PCF of this SNPN, except the URSP rule with the "match all" Traffic descriptor.

q_43090.question: What must the SMF ensure for usage monitoring on a PDU Session level?
q_43090.ground_truth: The SMF must ensure that the UPF supports volume and time measurements simultaneously for a given PDU Session.

q_43091.question: What should the UE do if it has one or more Access Classes that are valid for use and for at least one of these Access Classes the corresponding bit in the ac-BarringForSpecialAC is not set to zero?
q_43091.ground_truth: The UE should draw a random number and compare it with the value indicated by ac-BarringFactor. If the random number is lower, the UE should consider access to the cell as not barred. If not, the UE should consider access to the cell as barred.

q_43092.question: What are the benefits of the connection ID feature in QUIC?
q_43092.ground_truth: The connection ID in QUIC allows for a more flexible network implementation as it is not hard-bound to a particular 5-tuple (Source and Destination IP, protocol, and source and destination port), making it easier to migrate connections between different network interfaces.

q_43093.question: What should be measured for the relevant carriers specified in clause~4.7 and 4.8 for the performance of the wanted signal at the receiver unit associated with the RIB?
q_43093.ground_truth: The throughput of the wanted signal.

q_43094.question: What actions should the UE take if it receives the rejected NSSAI in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message?
q_43094.ground_truth: The UE should store the rejected S-NSSAI(s) based on the rejection cause and may not use it again until certain conditions are met.

q_43095.question: What is the purpose of the test command in 7.35 Communication forwarding supplementary service?
q_43095.ground_truth: The test command in 7.35 Communication forwarding supplementary service returns reason values supported as a compound value.

q_43096.question: What are the general architectural requirements for enabling Personal IoT Networks in different functional aspects?
q_43096.ground_truth: The general architectural requirements include supporting deployment of personal IoT networks, different deployment models, and being compatible with 3GPP network systems.

q_43097.question: What should be set as the measResultNeighCells if the triggerType is set to 'event' and the new measurement results became available since the last periodical reporting or since the measurement was initiated or reset?
q_43097.ground_truth: The applicable cells for which the new measurement results became available since the last periodical reporting or since the measurement was initiated or reset.

q_43098.question: What is the purpose of the Minimum Reporting Interval in Location Reporting Monitoring Event?
q_43098.ground_truth: The Minimum Reporting Interval indicates a minimum time interval between Location Reporting notifications, and the MME/SGSN suppresses sending Location Reporting notification(s) while the timer is running.

q_43099.question: What is the difference between OTA peak directions set and OTA coverage range in NR operation?
q_43099.ground_truth: OTA peak directions set is a set of beam peak directions within which certain TX OTA requirements are intended to be met, where all OTA peak directions set(s) are subsets of the OTA coverage range. The OTA coverage range is a common range of directions within which TX OTA requirements, that are neither specified in the OTA peak directions sets nor as TRP requirement, are intended to be met.

q_43100.question: What is the name of the command used to query supported fax capabilities?

q_43101.question: What is the structure of the ProtocolIE-SingleContainer?
q_43101.ground_truth: The ProtocolIE-SingleContainer is a SEQUENCE containing 'id', 'criticality', and 'value' fields.

q_43102.question: What should the target device do if it receives a RequestLocationInformation message containing one or more positioning methods it does not support?
q_43102.ground_truth: The target device should continue to process the message as if it contained only information for the supported positioning methods and handle the signaling content of the unsupported positioning methods by LPP error detection as specified in 5.4.3.

q_43103.question: What does the MAC entity do upon Msg3 transmission to resolve a contention in the radio network?
q_43103.ground_truth: The MAC entity monitors the PDCCH while the ra-ContentionResolutionTimer is running and takes actions based on the reception of a PDCCH transmission.

q_43104.question: What standard specifies the UE behavior when receiving ATGW information for CS to PS SRVCC in TS 24.237, clause 6.5.4?
q_43104.ground_truth: TS 24.237, clause 6.5.4 specifies the UE behavior when receiving ATGW information for CS to PS SRVCC.

q_43105.question: What should the P-CSCF do if it receives an initial request for a dialog, a standalone transaction, or an unknown method for a registered user over the security association, TLS session, or IP association that was created during the emergency registration?
q_43105.ground_truth: The P-CSCF shall inspect the Request-URI independent of values of possible entries in the received Route header fields for emergency service identifiers and follow the procedure based on the Request-URI of the initial request.

q_43106.question: What should eNB2 do if it is capable to provide some but not all of the requested resource status information and the Partial Success Indicator IE is present in the RESOURCE STATUS REQUEST message?
q_43106.ground_truth: eNB2 should initiate the measurement for the admitted measurement objects and include the Measurement Initiation Result IE in the RESOURCE STATUS RESPONSE message.

q_43107.question: How can the test for spurious emissions from the receiver antenna connector be performed?
q_43107.ground_truth: The test can be performed separately for each receiver antenna connector by measuring the signals emitted by each antenna connector and summing the results, or by combining the signals and performing a single measurement.

q_43108.question: What is the pre-condition for the MC service client to modify the ad-hoc group communication participants?
q_43108.ground_truth: The MC service client that initiates the ad-hoc group communication must be authorized to add or remove participants from the ongoing ad-hoc group communication.

q_43109.question: What conditions must be met for the UE to search for inter-frequency layers of higher priority at least every Thigher_priority_search?
q_43109.ground_truth: If Srxlev > SnonIntraSearchP and Squal > SnonIntraSearchQ

q_43110.question: What is the impact of the AF Key expiry on the AKMA Key and the AUSF Key?
q_43110.ground_truth: The expiration of the AF Key is bound to the expiration of the AKMA Key, which in turn is bound to the expiration of the AUSF Key. Thus, by the time the AF Key expires, the AUSF Key will have already expired.

q_43111.question: What is the first action required when receiving a SIP INVITE request in 3GPP TS 24.229?
q_43111.ground_truth: The participating MCData function shall check if the SIP INVITE request is a re-INVITE or not, and if it is, it shall verify if any additional media feature tags are present in the Contact header field.

q_43112.question: What is the purpose of the Feature-List-ID AVP in the Supported-Features?
q_43112.ground_truth: The Feature-List-ID AVP differentiates the feature lists for the reference point.

q_43113.question: What is the requirement in terms of an additional spectrum emission for UEs in specific deployment scenarios?
q_43113.ground_truth: These requirements are specified in terms of an additional spectrum emission requirement. Additional spurious emission requirements are signalled by the network to indicate that the UE shall meet an additional requirement for a specific deployment scenario as part of the cell handover/broadcast message.

q_43114.question: What are the reference environments used for radio resource signalling and layer 3 NAS signalling in the 3GPP TS 36.523-1 specification?
q_43114.ground_truth: The reference environments used for radio resource signalling and layer 3 NAS signalling are specified in TS 36.508.

q_43115.question: How are suggested groupings of tracks encoded in the session-level SDP of a 3GP file?
q_43115.ground_truth: Suggested groupings of tracks from different alternate groups are encoded by using the "alt-group" attribute in the session-level SDP of the 3GP file. A server may have to prune options from such groupings if certain tracks are not presented to the client.

q_43116.question: What is the input sequence for the channel coding of the channel quality information for payload sizes greater than 11 bits?
q_43116.ground_truth: The input sequence for the channel coding of the channel quality information for payload sizes greater than 11 bits is the result of concatenating the CQI/PMI reports in increasing order of CSI process index for each DL cell and then in increasing order of cell index.

q_43117.question: What is the issue with the current test procedures for time masks in 6.3B.5, 6.3B.6, and 6.3B.7?
q_43117.ground_truth: The issue is that the current test procedures for time masks are based on power measurement in a relatively long period compared with the transient period, and these procedures can't provide enough resolution to identify non-conformant UEs for time masks between 2 active time slots with different power levels.

q_43118.question: What is the role of the AAnF in the solution described in clause 6.31.2?
q_43118.ground_truth: The AAnF maintains the mapping relationship between the A-KID and the SUPI of the UE in this solution.

q_43119.question: What is the term "CSG ID" referring to in the context of NB-IoT UEs?
q_43119.ground_truth: CSG ID refers to the Cell Global Identity of a cell in the context of NB-IoT UEs.

q_43120.question: What is the difference between the P-TMSI type set to "native P-TMSI" and "mapped P-TMSI"?
q_43120.ground_truth: P-TMSI type set to "native P-TMSI" indicates that the MS has obtained a valid P-TMSI and RAI, while P-TMSI type set to "mapped P-TMSI" indicates that the MS has mapped a GUTI to P-TMSI, P-TMSI signature, and RAI using the GUTI allocated by an MME.

q_43121.question: What is the principle of QoS flow Based Charging in clause 5.2.1.5?
q_43121.ground_truth: QoS flow Based Charging allows the SMF to collect charging information related to data volumes per PDU session, categorized per QoS Flow. QBC doesn't support quota management.

q_43122.question: What is the role of the API invoker obtaining resource owner consent solution in CAPIF?
q_43122.ground_truth: The API invoker obtaining resource owner consent solution in CAPIF addresses the key issues of obtaining resource owner consent in the UE- and AF-originated API invocation scenarios. It may reuse well-known authorization procedures such as OAuth 2.0 for obtaining resource owner consent.

q_43123.question: What is the purpose of the Integrity Principle of Operation in the Positioning Integrity section?
q_43123.ground_truth: The purpose of the Integrity Principle of Operation is to ensure that the network will ensure that the probability of errors exceeding a certain bound for longer than a certain time is less than or equal to the residual risk plus a variable IRallocation component.

q_43124.question: What test case scenarios does Combination 1 apply to?
q_43124.ground_truth: Combination 1 applies to the following test case scenarios: E-UTRA FDD single cell scenario, E-UTRA TDD single cell scenario, E-UTRA FDD intra-frequency multi cell scenario, E-UTRA TDD intra-frequency multi cell scenario, E-UTRA FDD and E-UTRA TDD dual mode multi cell roaming scenario, 3GPP inter-RAT E-UTRA FDD + NR FDD multi cell scenario for RRM, 3GPP inter-RAT E-UTRA FDD + NR TDD multi cell scenario for RRM, 3GPP inter-RAT E-UTRA TDD + NR FDD multi cell scenario for RRM, 3GPP inter-RAT E-UTRA TDD + NR TDD multi cell scenario for RRM.

q_43125.question: When is the frequency domain resource allocation determined by uplink resource allocation type 1?
q_43125.ground_truth: The frequency domain resource allocation is determined by uplink resource allocation type 1 when useInterlacePUCCH-PUSCH is not provided by BWP-UplinkCommon and BWP-UplinkDedicated, and the initial UL BWP and initial UL BWP have the same SCS, same CP length, and the active UL BWP includes all RBs of the initial UL BWP.

q_43126.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) in relation to the present document on physical layer procedures for shared spectrum channel access?
q_43126.ground_truth: The 3GPP is an organization that produces technical specifications, including the present document, for mobile telecommunications.

q_43127.question: What is the minimum output power defined as for UE supporting Tx diversity in 6.3G.1.3?
q_43127.ground_truth: The minimum output power is defined as the sum of the mean power at each transmit connector in one sub-frame (1 ms) for UE supporting Tx diversity in 6.3G.1.3.

q_43128.question: What HTTP method is used for the "send-routing-info-sm" custom operation in the 6.2.3.9.4.2 resource?
q_43128.ground_truth: This operation uses the POST method for the "send-routing-info-sm" custom operation in the 6.2.3.9.4.2 resource.

q_43129.question: What is the role of the Charging Gateway Function (CGF) in 3GPP Technical Specifications?
q_43129.ground_truth: The Charging Gateway Function (CGF) is responsible for the transfer of CDR files from the 5G connection and mobility CGF to the billing domain (BD).

q_43130.question: What is the role of the NSCE server in the 5GS network when there is a failure in the application/service?
q_43130.ground_truth: The NSCE server can detect if the application/service error is caused by the 5GS network or not. If it is, the NSCE server sends the fault diagnosis report to the OAM system to indicate the server fault causing the application/service failure.

q_43131.question: When should the MSGin5G Gateway Client start a timer for periodic bulk registration?
q_43131.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Gateway Client may start a timer for periodic bulk registration based on implementation, for example, when the first registration request from the Constrained UE has the "false" value of the "Registration urgent degree" element.

q_43132.question: What information is provisioned in the UE for the role of a 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay?
q_43132.ground_truth: The following information is provisioned in the UE for the role of a 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay: authorization policy for acting as a 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay, radio parameters when the UE is "not served by NG-RAN", and 5G ProSe Relay Discovery policy/parameters for 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay.

q_43133.question: What message does the LMF send to the serving gNB of the target UE to request UL-SRS activation?
q_43133.ground_truth: The LMF sends the NRPPa Positioning Activation Request message to the serving gNB of the target UE to request UL-SRS activation for the target UE.

q_43134.question: If a network cannot accept the attach request for initiating a PDN connection for emergency bearer services with attach type not set to "emergency attach", what should a MS do to attempt GPRS attach for emergency bearer services?
q_43134.ground_truth: The MS should inform the upper layers of the failure of the procedure or attempt GPRS attach for emergency bearer services if access is granted or because of a cell change.

q_43135.question: What should the SMF do if NG-RAN decides to trigger EPS or inter-RAT fallback?
q_43135.ground_truth: The SMF should release resources in the non-3GPP AN as specified in specific clauses.

q_43136.question: What is the purpose of sending a Session with QoS create request in the EAS?
q_43136.ground_truth: The EAS sends the Session with QoS create request to the EES to request the creation of a new session with specific QoS.

q_43137.question: What information should the VAE-C include in the HTTP 200(OK) response message if the PC5 provisioning status request is successful?
q_43137.ground_truth: If the PC5 provisioning status request is successful, the VAE-C should include a <result> element set to the value "success", a <PC5-policy-status-report> element corresponding to the PC5 policy status request, and send the HTTP 200(OK) response towards the VAE-S.

q_43138.question: How many code words are transmitted in each slot?
q_43138.ground_truth: Only one code word is transmitted in each slot

q_43139.question: What is the meaning of the IP type value "0" in the 3GPP-Allocate-IP-Type sub-attribute?
q_43139.ground_truth: The IP type value "0" means that the P-GW/GGSN does not allocate IPv4 address or IPv6 prefix, and it is typically used for PDN/PDP type IPv4v6 and deferred IPv4 addressing, with the IPv4 address allocated by the AAA server and IPv6 prefix allocated by some other means.

q_43140.question: What information does the PCF provide to the TSCTSF for device side ports when integration with IETF Deterministic Networking applies?
q_43140.ground_truth: The PCF provides the user-plane node ID, port number, IP address or IPv6 prefix allocated to the PDU Session, and MTU size for IPv4 or IPv6 (optional) to the TSCTSF for device side ports.

q_43141.question: What are the initial conditions for the method of test for the performance requirements for PUCCH format 1 NACK to ACK detection for BS type 1-O?
q_43141.ground_truth: The initial conditions for the method of test for the performance requirements for PUCCH format 1 NACK to ACK detection for BS type 1-O are test environment: Normal, see annex B.2, RF channels to be tested for single carrier: M, see clause~4.9.1, and Direction to be tested: OTA REFSENS receiver target reference direction (D.54).

q_43142.question: When must the UE include a SUCI in a NAS message?
q_43142.ground_truth: The UE must include a SUCI in the following NAS messages: Registration Request message, Identity Response message, and De-Registration Request message.

q_43143.question: What HTTP method should the NF service consumer use to send a request for updating a record?
q_43143.ground_truth: The NF service consumer should use a PUT request to send a request for updating a record.

q_43144.question: What does the LRN Source Indicator field indicate in relation to a Location Routing Number?
q_43144.ground_truth: The LRN Source Indicator field indicates whether the LRN was obtained from the NP database or from incoming signaling or switching system data.

q_43145.question: What indicates that a MCPTT group member is not allowed to send media in MCPTT group calls in on-network MCPTT procedures?
q_43145.ground_truth: The presence of the <on-network-recvonly> element in the <entry> element of the MCPTT group document indicates that a MCPTT group member is not allowed to send media in MCPTT group calls in on-network MCPTT procedures.

q_43146.question: What is the difference between quantization-non-aware training and quantization-aware training in the CSI compression use case?
q_43146.ground_truth: Quantization-non-aware training involves passing float-format variables directly from the CSI generation part to the CSI reconstruction part during training, while quantization-aware training involves quantization/dequantization being involved in the training process.

q_43147.question: What is the requirement for UE measurement capability for NR CA and MR-DC measurement purposes in idle mode cell re-selection?
q_43147.ground_truth: For idle mode cell re-selection purposes, and for UE supporting IdleInactiveMeasurements-r16 or idleInactiveEUTRA-MeasReport-r16, for NR CA and MR-DC measurement purpose, the UE shall be capable of monitoring at least: Intra-frequency carrier, 7 NR inter-frequency carriers, 7 FDD E-UTRA inter-RAT carriers, and 7 TDD E-UTRA inter-RAT carriers. In addition, a UE supporting E-UTRA measurements in RRC_IDLE state shall be capable of monitoring a total of at least 14 carrier frequency layers, which includes serving layer, comprising of any above defined combination of E-UTRA FDD, E-UTRA TDD and NR layers.

q_43148.question: What are the two alternatives for AI/ML model input in the BM-Case2 sub-use case for beam management?
q_43148.ground_truth: The two alternatives for AI/ML model input in the BM-Case2 sub-use case are L1-RSRP measurement based on Set B or L1-RSRP measurement based on Set B and the corresponding DL Tx and/or Rx beam ID.

q_43149.question: What action does the 3GPP management system take when issues are identified in the performance monitoring of cloud-native VNFs?
q_43149.ground_truth: The 3GPP management system receives the metrics analytics result from the VNF metrics analyser function

q_43150.question: What action should the CP function take upon receiving a PFCP Association Setup Request, if the request is accepted?
q_43150.ground_truth: The CP function should store the Node ID of the UP function as the identifier of the PFCP association and send a PFCP Association Setup Response with a successful cause, its Node ID, and information about the list of optional features the CP function supports which may affect the UP function behavior.

q_43151.question: What is the initial condition for the OTA sensitivity test procedure?
q_43151.ground_truth: The initial condition for the OTA sensitivity test procedure is that the AAS BS is placed in the same place as the calibrated point in the test system and the manufacturer declared coordinate system orientation of the AAS BS is aligned with the test system.

q_43152.question: What should the UE do if the mobility from E-UTRA fails?
q_43152.ground_truth: The UE should stop T304, if running, indicate to upper layers that the CS fallback procedure has failed, and initiate the connection re-establishment procedure.

q_43153.question: What should the transmission participant do when it receives an indication from the user to end the RTP media reception?
q_43153.ground_truth: The transmission participant should send a Media reception end request message towards the transmission control server, remove indications of overriding and overridden without revoke (if stored), start timer T104 (Receive Media Release) and initialize counter C104 (Receive Media Release) to 1, and enter the 'U: pending reception release' state.

q_43154.question: What is the length of the PLMN ID part of the ProSe Discovery UE ID?
q_43154.ground_truth: The PLMN ID part of the ProSe Discovery UE ID is 32 bits in length.

q_43155.question: What does clause X.5 define?
q_43155.ground_truth: Clause X.5 defines the pass/fail criteria for the equipment under test. It lists the test requirements for every minimum requirement referred to in clause X.2, and cases where minimum requirements do not apply need not be mentioned.

q_43156.question: What happens if multiple rules are defined in the Management Object for QoE metric reporting?
q_43156.ground_truth: In case multiple rules are defined in the Management Object, the MTSI client should only report metrics when all individual rules evaluate to true.

q_43157.question: How long does the UE have to wait before it can turn off its transmitter power after the expiry of the T310 timer in non-DRX mode?
q_43157.ground_truth: The UE has to wait for 40 ms before turning off its transmitter power after the expiry of the T310 timer in non-DRX mode.

q_43158.question: How should the UE handle the EMM parameters when receiving 5GMM cause #79 via 3GPP access in single-registration mode?
q_43158.ground_truth: The UE sets the EPS update status to EU2 NOT UPDATED, resets the tracking area updating attempt counter, enters the state EMM-REGISTERED, and may re-attempt the registration procedure for services other than UAS services.

q_43159.question: What HTTP method should the NF Service Consumer use to invoke the "transfer-update" custom operation on the URI of an "Individual ueContext" resource?
q_43159.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer should use the HTTP method POST to invoke the "transfer-update" custom operation on the URI of an "Individual ueContext" resource.

q_43160.question: What should the IWF floor control server do when it receives an MCPTT call release step~1 request or determines that a user in the IWF has released the call in the 'Releasing' state?
q_43160.ground_truth: The IWF floor control server should request the media distributor to stop sending RTP media packets to MCPTT media endpoints and enter the 'Releasing' state.

q_43161.question: What is the CSI-RS measurement behavior for FR1 when the SSB for RLM is within the active BWP and has the same SCS as CSI-RS for RLM?
q_43161.ground_truth: If the SSB for RLM is within the active BWP and has the same SCS as CSI-RS for RLM in FR1, the UE shall be able to perform the CSI-RS measurement without restrictions.

q_43162.question: What is the purpose of the PC5 unicast link security establishment, as defined in clause 5.3 of TS 33.536 in the procedure for UE-to-UE communication?
q_43162.ground_truth: The PC5 unicast link security is established between the UEs and the UE-to-UE Relay to protect the communication between them.

q_43163.question: What is the purpose of the SCEF-Reference-ID-Ext AVP when the "Extended Reference IDs" feature is supported?
q_43163.ground_truth: When the "Extended Reference IDs" feature is supported, the SCEF-Reference-ID-Ext AVP is used instead of SCEF-Reference-ID, and the SCEF-Reference-ID AVP is required in the grouped AVP by the sender. However, its content is discarded by the receiver.

q_43164.question: What is the function of the UE Radio Capability ID for use in the selected PLMN, in the RRC connection establishment signalling associated with the TAU Request?
q_43164.ground_truth: The UE Radio Capability ID for use in the selected PLMN is used to indicate the UE's support of the CIoT EPS Optimisations relevant for MME selection, and to provide the UE Radio Capability ID of the newly selected PLMN in the UE context to the eNodeB.

q_43165.question: What type of value is allocated to the UE in GERAN/UTRAN for the Active Time value, the extended periodic RAU value, and the GPRS READY timer value?
q_43165.ground_truth: One byte in an 8 bit format.

q_43166.question: What is the difference between T3313 and T3315 in Iu mode?
q_43166.ground_truth: T3315 is set to a value smaller than T3-RESPONSE, while T3313 has no such restriction.

q_43167.question: What action should the media storage function take when processing an HTTP POST request with a message/external-body MIME included?
q_43167.ground_truth: The media storage function should decode the contents of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body, determine the resource location to store the file, fetch the file from the MCData message store, and generate a HTTP 201 Created response with a Location header field identifying the stored file's location.

q_43168.question: In the provided format for MobilityRestrictionList, what does 'EquivalentPLMNs' indicate?
q_43168.ground_truth: EquivalentPLMNs indicate a list of equivalent PLMNs in which roaming can be allowed when it is in the MICO Mode.

q_43169.question: What is the procedure step 1 in 8.2.10.4.2?
q_43169.ground_truth: The step 1 in 8.2.10.4.2 is placing the BS with its manufacturer declared coordinate system reference point in the same place as the calibrated point in the test system.

q_43170.question: What procedure occurs if an application request data connectivity and the corresponding S-NSSAI is not in the Allowed NSSAI?
q_43170.ground_truth: The UE first sends a request to register with the S-NSSAI before processing further RSDs or before the UE concludes that the RSD is invalid.

q_43171.question: What is the general requirement in section 6.8 regarding the inhibition of the generation of intermodulation signals in the non-linear elements of a repeater caused by the presence of the wanted signal and an interfering signal reaching the repeater via the output port?
q_43171.ground_truth: The output intermodulation requirement is a measure of the capability of the repeater to inhibit the generation of signals in its non-linear elements caused by the presence of the wanted signal and an interfering signal reaching the repeater via the output port. The requirement shall apply during the transmitter ON state and the transmitter transient period. The output intermodulation level is the power of the intermodulation products when an interfering signal is injected into the antenna connector.

q_43172.question: In the 'O: has no permission' state, what action does the floor participant take if it receives an indication from the MCPTT user that they want to send media?
q_43172.ground_truth: The floor participant sends a Floor Request message to other clients.

q_43173.question: What information does a P'-Trace include that is not in a P-Trace?
q_43173.ground_truth: A P'-Trace includes losses and delays observed due to the delivery over a network, while a P-Trace does not.

q_43174.question: What type of authentication can be used between an SCP and a network function when there is co-location between them?
q_43174.ground_truth: Authentication between the SCP and network function can be implicit due to co-location.

q_43175.question: What should a PIN Element have in terms of management capabilities?
q_43175.ground_truth: A PIN Element should have at least one PIN Element with Management Capabilities.

q_43176.question: What entity maps the priority from the PDCP header to the GTP-U extension header in uplink packets?

q_43177.question: What is the purpose of including the "move together" information in various messages during handover?
q_43177.ground_truth: The "move together" information is used to differentiate the case that UE handover due to moving together with the MBSR from the case that UE handover to leave the MBSR.

q_43178.question: What are the appropriate values for the "g-3gpp-ps-data-off" media feature tag in 3GPP IP multimedia call control protocol based on Session Initiation Protocol (SIP) and Session Description Protocol (SDP)?
q_43178.ground_truth: The appropriate values for the "g-3gpp-ps-data-off" media feature tag are "active", "inactive", and a token.

q_43179.question: What is the purpose of the S-CSCF in forwarding the Offer Response message received from the UE to the originating endpoint?
q_43179.ground_truth: The S-CSCF forwards the Offer Response message from the UE to the originating endpoint to establish the communication session.

q_43180.question: What should the transmission control interface do if the MCVideo client did not negotiate queueing of Transmission requests, other MCVideo clients have the permission to send media and Cx (Simultaneous Transmission video) has reached its upper limit?
q_43180.ground_truth: It should enter the 'U: not permitted and Transmit Taken' state as specified in the clause~6.3.5.4.2.

q_43181.question: What is the time period during which the SS waits for random access requests information from the UE to perform cell re-selection on Cell 2 in step 3 of the test described in 6.1.2.3?
q_43181.ground_truth: The time period during which the SS waits for random access requests information from the UE to perform cell re-selection on Cell 2 in step 3 of the test described in 6.1.2.3 is the duration of T1.

q_43182.question: What is the time required to search the target cell if the target cell is unknown and signal quality is sufficient for successful cell detection on the first attempt?
q_43182.ground_truth: If the target cell is unknown and signal quality is sufficient for successful cell detection on the first attempt, then Tsearch = 80 ms.

q_43183.question: How does the responding 5G ProSe End UE select a new 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay?
q_43183.ground_truth: The responding 5G ProSe End UE selects a new 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay from the candidate UEs based on the Relay re-selection indication in the Link Modification Request message.

q_43184.question: What is the purpose of ProSe direct discovery and EPC-level ProSe discovery in Proximity-based Services (ProSe)?
q_43184.ground_truth: ProSe direct discovery and EPC-level ProSe discovery are functions in Proximity-based Services (ProSe) that enable two ProSe-enabled UEs to discover each other and communicate directly. These functions are applicable for both Public Safety UE and non-Public Safety UE.

q_43185.question: What happens if the cancellation of UEs within an active group is unsuccessful in the SCEF?
q_43185.ground_truth: The SCEF shall respond with a proper error code indicating the error and should return the appropriate additional error information in the POST response body.

q_43186.question: What should the UE do if it has not authenticated with the selected WLAN yet, the selected WLAN is a trusted WLAN, SCM is supported by both UE and network, MCM is not supported by UE, network or both, and the UE is capable of simultaneously routing IP traffic to both 3GPP access and WLAN or not capable but only has one PDN connection in 3GPP access?
q_43186.ground_truth: The UE should handover one offloadable PDN connection from 3GPP access to the WLAN access using procedures in subclause 6.4.2.6.2.

q_43187.question: What should the VAE-S include in the HTTP 200 (OK) response message to the VAE-C after updating group information?
q_43187.ground_truth: The VAE-S should include a Content-Type header field set to "application/vnd.3gpp.vae-info+xml" and an application/vnd.3gpp.vae-info+xml MIME body with a <dynamic-group-update-info> element in the <VAE-info> root element, which includes the result and suggestion (if any) of the dynamic group information update request.

q_43188.question: What is the purpose of scrambling the RI bits in a way that maximizes the Euclidean distance of the modulation symbols carrying rank information?
q_43188.ground_truth: The purpose is to reduce the correlation between the modulation symbols carrying rank information.

q_43189.question: What are the two categories of spurious emissions defined in ITU-R Recommendation SM.329 for testing a base station?
q_43189.ground_truth: The two categories of spurious emissions defined in ITU-R Recommendation SM.329 for testing a base station are Category A and Category B.

q_43190.question: What should the target UE do when timer T5005 expires?
q_43190.ground_truth: The target UE should initiate a PC5 unicast link keep-alive procedure to check the link or initiate the PC5 unicast link release procedure, as left to UE implementation.

q_43191.question: What is the potential consequence of insecure data storage in GNP?
q_43191.ground_truth: An attacker can retrieve sensitive data if it has been stored in an insecure way.

q_43192.question: In what scenario can the AF (Application Function) influence traffic routing?
q_43192.ground_truth: The AF can influence traffic routing in the case of Home Routed deployments with Session Breakout, where Traffic Influence policies are provided directly from V-NEF to V-SMF, bypassing the PCF.

q_43193.question: What action does the transmission control server take when it receives a request queueing transmission request but rejects the request due to ongoing video transmissions?
q_43193.ground_truth: The transmission control server sends a Transmission Queue Position Info message, indicating that the request is queued for potential permission when the current video transmissions end.

q_43194.question: What does the abbreviation "V2X" stand for in the context of the document?

q_43195.question: What should an N5CW device supporting 3GPP access refrain from allocating as PDU session identity value when establishing a new PDN connection in S1 mode?

q_43196.question: Which release of NR UE does the test case for non-concurrent V2X MIMO operation apply to?
q_43196.ground_truth: This test case applies to all types of NR UE release 16 and forward that support NR V2X sidelink MIMO communication with non-concurrent operation.

q_43197.question: What should an AS do when it acts as a SIP proxy and forks the request?
q_43197.ground_truth: The AS should not fork the request if the fork-directive in the Request-Disposition header field is set to "no-fork".

q_43198.question: What action does the LMF take when it becomes aware that UL+DL positioning is used in this procedure?
q_43198.ground_truth: The LMF expects to receive the second event report at step~14 and acknowledges the event report when it is received.

q_43199.question: What is the condition for a successful test in section 4.5.1.4.4.2?
q_43199.ground_truth: The condition for a successful test is if the SS detects uplink power equal to or higher than the minimum output power in the On-duration part of every DRX cycle during the period specified in the test.

q_43200.question: What is the OTA ACLR absolute limit for Category A AAS BS of Medium Range BS class and Local Area BS class?
q_43200.ground_truth: For Category A, Medium Range BS class, the OTA ACLR absolute limit is -19 dBm/MHz, while for Local Area BS class, the limit is -26 dBm/MHz.

q_43201.question: What is the requirement for the initial output power for intra-band contiguous CA, as defined in absolute power control tolerance per component carrier in 6.3A.4.1.1.1?
q_43201.ground_truth: The UE must be able to set its initial output power to a specific value for the first sub-frame at the start of a contiguous transmission or non-contiguous transmission with a transmission gap on each active component carrier larger than 20ms.

q_43202.question: What is the unwanted CW interfering signal band blocking defined for an LTE based 5G terrestrial broadcast?
q_43202.ground_truth: Out-of-band band blocking is defined for an unwanted CW interfering signal falling more than 15 MHz below or above the UE receive band. For the first 15 MHz below or above the UE receive band, the appropriate in-band blocking or adjacent channel selectivity shall be applied.

q_43203.question: How is the average percentage of uplink symbols calculated?
q_43203.ground_truth: The average percentage of uplink symbols is calculated as 0.5*(DutyNR,x/maxDutyNR,x + DutyNR,y/maxDutyNR,y) where DutyNR,x and DutyNR,y represent the actual percentage of uplink symbols transmitted in the same evaluation period for NR Band x and NR Band y respectively, and maxDutyNR,x and maxDutyNR,y represent the field of UE capability 0.5xmaxUplinkDutyCycle-PC2-FR1 or maxUplinkDutyCycle-PC1dot5-MPE-FR1 per band as defined in TS 38.331.

q_43204.question: How does a gNB handle RCEF reports when a UE's RRC connection establishment fails?
q_43204.ground_truth: If the UE fails to establish an RRC connection to one gNB but succeeds with another gNB, the gNB with successful RRC establishment collects the RCEF reports.

q_43205.question: What should an EES do if the EEC registration request fails after the EEC Context Pull relocation?
q_43205.ground_truth: The EES shall determine the EEC Context information stale and send a failure response with a corresponding cause.

q_43206.question: What is the test requirement for high speed train for BS type 1-O and type 2-O in 8.2.5.5 and 8.2.5.5a?
q_43206.ground_truth: The throughput should be at least 70% of the maximum throughput for the moving UE at the specified SNR levels for each BS type.

q_43207.question: What is the potential impact of Solution #5.6 and the possible extension of Solution #5.1 on the current TS32.290 standard?
q_43207.ground_truth: Solution #5.6 with the possible extension of #5.1 solution could be taken into normative work based requirements for key issues #5a, #5b, and #5c in TS32.290.

q_43208.question: What is the purpose of the initial AS security activation procedure in 5G NR?
q_43208.ground_truth: The purpose of the initial AS security activation procedure is to activate AS security upon RRC connection establishment.

q_43209.question: When the UE is switched off and then powered on in the cell belonging to the TAI which was in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service" before the UE was switched off, what should the UE do?
q_43209.ground_truth: The UE should perform registration on that cell.

q_43210.question: What types of NR UE does the test apply to, starting from release 15?
q_43210.ground_truth: The test applies to all types of NR UE release 15 and forward supporting SA FR2 and 2DL CA.

q_43211.question: What is the purpose of the Retry-After header field in the SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response?
q_43211.ground_truth: The Retry-After header field in the SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response indicates the time in seconds that the client should wait before resending the request.

q_43212.question: What is the delay uncertainty for the measurement reporting on the DCCH, excluding the delay caused by inserting the measurement report into the TTI of the uplink DCCH?
q_43212.ground_truth: The delay uncertainty is: 2 x TTIDCCH, where TTIDCCH is the duration of subframe or slot or subslot when the measurement report is transmitted on the PUSCH with subframe or slot or subslot duration.

q_43213.question: What is the difference between a SNPN and a GIN in the context of 3GPP TS 23.003?
q_43213.ground_truth: A SNPN (Secure Network Provisioning Node) is a network entity that provides secure connectivity to a specific 5G network, while a GIN (Global Identifier Number) is a unique identifier for a PLMN (Public Land Mobile Network) or an SNPN.

q_43214.question: What is the consequence of delivering the same broadcast content to multiple CNs in a 5G Multi-Operator Core Network (5G MOCN)?
q_43214.ground_truth: The consumed radio resource will be (N-1) times more than needed, where N is the number of CNs involved.

q_43215.question: Which information element contains a list of CA band combinations?
q_43215.ground_truth: BandCombinationList information element contains a list of CA band combinations.

q_43216.question: What should the BGCF do when it receives a subsequent request whose initial request applied loopback routeing?
q_43216.ground_truth: The BGCF should remove the "orig-ioi" header field parameter received in the P-Charging-Vector header field, if present and insert a type 1 "orig-ioi" header field parameter into the P-Charging-Vector header field and set it to the value that identifies the home network of the served user. The BGCF should not include the "term-ioi" header field parameter.

q_43217.question: What is the purpose of the NSAG information in the 5GMM registration procedure?
q_43217.ground_truth: The NSAG information is used to indicate the network slice support for a particular location, and up to 4 NSAG entries can be associated with a TAI list in the NSAG information IE.

q_43218.question: In what situations is paging on a non-anchor NES cell without SIB or a non-anchor NES cell without SSB and SIB not supported?
q_43218.ground_truth: Paging on a non-anchor NES cell without SIB or a non-anchor NES cell without SSB and SIB is not supported in any scenario.

q_43219.question: What is the name of the method used to model PA behavior in RF link simulations?
q_43219.ground_truth: Polynomial modeling is used to model PA behavior in RF link simulations.

q_43220.question: What information should be included in the "application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME" body of a SIP MESSAGE request?
q_43220.ground_truth: The "application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME" body of a SIP MESSAGE request should contain the MCVideo client ID, and may include functional aliases or user-requested priority.

q_43221.question: What is the requirement described in section 4.3.2.3 regarding software components installed in a network product?
q_43221.ground_truth: The requirement is that the network product should only have necessary software components installed and any unused or disallowed software components should be deactivated or removed.

q_43222.question: Which existing 5GS mechanisms does Solution #1 propose to reuse for AF resource monitoring purposes?
