The test is used to emulate out-of-sync and in-sync states of the downlink SNR in the active cell.

q_43954.question: When receiving a Floor Idle message from the floor control server arbitration logic, what action should the floor control interface take if the floor control server does not receive the Floor Ack message?
q_43954.ground_truth: It is an implementation option for the floor control server to handle the receipt of the Floor Ack message and determine the action to take if the Floor Ack message is not received.

q_43955.question: In what subframe(s) should the SS send the activation MAC-CE for SCell2 in FDD PCell?
q_43955.ground_truth: The SS should send the activation MAC-CE for SCell2 in subframe (m+10) in FDD PCell.

q_43956.question: What should the target UE include in the PROSE DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION ACCEPT message, if it acts as the 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-network relay UE?
q_43956.ground_truth: The target UE should include the source end UE info set to the user info ID of the source 5G ProSe layer-3 end UE.

q_43957.question: Who are the known NF service consumers of the Npcf_UEPolicyControl service?
q_43957.ground_truth: The known NF service consumers of the Npcf_UEPolicyControl service are the Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF) and the Visited Policy Control Function (V-PCF).

q_43958.question: What is the effect on User Determined Directional User Rate calls for UDI/RDI multimedia calls with fallback and service change?
q_43958.ground_truth: Fixed Network User Rate of 32 kbit/s for UDI/RDI multimedia calls with fallback and service change is not supported.

q_43959.question: What action will the NG-RAN node take if the 5G ProSe Authorized IE is contained in the HANDOVER REQUEST message and at least one IE is set to "authorized"?
q_43959.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node will consider that the UE is authorized for the relevant service(s) if it supports this feature.

q_43960.question: What is the impact of the solution described in section 7.47.2.2 on coordinated ACR requirements for EAS bundles?
q_43960.ground_truth: The solution described in section 7.47.2.2 addresses KI#18, which is to satisfy the coordinated ACR requirements for EAS bundles by making decisions on ACR scenarios based on the AC/EEC/EES(s)/EAS(s) abilities of handling bundled EAS ACR.

q_43961.question: What information is included in the N2 message sent to the NG-RAN if a UE is authorized to join an MBS session?
q_43961.ground_truth: The N2 message includes the MBS Session ID(s) the UE has joined and, if applicable, associated QoS Flow, is sent to the NG-RAN to inform it of the UE's authorization to join an MBS session and, if applicable, the associated QoS Flow. This information helps the NG-RAN to determine that the PDU Session identified by the PDU Session ID is associated with the indicated multicast MBS session.

q_43962.question: Which two protocolIEs in the PWSFailureIndicationIEs are marked as CRITICALITY reject and PRESENCE mandatory?
q_43962.ground_truth: The two protocolIEs in the PWSFailureIndicationIEs that are marked as CRITICALITY reject and PRESENCE mandatory are id-PWSFailedCellID and id-GlobalRANNodeID.

q_43963.question: Which message is sent by the UE to the SS to accept a detach request, and always sent within SECURITY PROTECTED NAS MESSAGE message?

q_43964.question: Which network entities need to support UPF event exposure service operations for TSC management information?
q_43964.ground_truth: UPF, TSF AF / TSCTSF, and (optionally) SMF need to support UPF event exposure service operations for TSC management information.

q_43965.question: When is DRX operation used in the MAC entity?
q_43965.ground_truth: DRX operation is used in the MAC entity to control the UE's PDCCH monitoring activity discontinuously for the MAC entity's C-RNTI, TPC-PUCCH-RNTI, TPC-PUSCH-RNTI, Semi-Persistent Scheduling C-RNTI, UL Semi-Persistent Scheduling V-RNTI, eIMTA-RNTI, SL-RNTI, SL-V-RNTI, CC-RNTI, SRS-TPC-RNTI, and AUL C-RNTI.

q_43966.question: What is the maximum duration of an SSB measurement period for SSB based measurements on FR1?
q_43966.ground_truth: The maximum duration of an SSB measurement period for SSB based measurements on FR1 is 5 ms.

q_43967.question: What should the MAC entity do if a PDCCH for BWP switching for a Serving Cell is received while a Random Access procedure is ongoing in the MAC entity?
q_43967.ground_truth: The MAC entity should stop the ongoing Random Access procedure and initiate a new one after performing the BWP switching if it decides to perform BWP switching.

q_43968.question: What must the AMF do in step 2 if it supports non-3GPP access path switching while maintaining two N2 connections for non-3GPP access?
q_43968.ground_truth: The AMF may select a V-SMF that supports non-3GPP access path switching.

q_43969.question: What is the difference between direct and indirect communication in Proximity based Services (ProSe) in 5GS?
q_43969.ground_truth: Direct communication is established between two or more UEs that are in direct communication range using NR technology, while indirect communication is established between two or more UEs via a path that traverses a network node.

q_43970.question: What is being studied for DL AoD regarding error sources in the multipath/NLoS channel/radio propagation environment for DL PRS RSRP/RSRPP measurement?
q_43970.ground_truth: The impact of DL PRS RSRP/RSRPP measurement on positioning accuracy is being studied for DL AoD.

q_43971.question: What conditions must be met before the UE can transmit a Binding Update with the Lifetime field set to "0"?
q_43971.ground_truth: The UE can transmit a Binding Update with the Lifetime field set to "0" once it has detected that it is attached to the home link and there is a valid DSMIPv6 Binding Update list entry at the UE.

q_43972.question: What should the MCVideo client do when the MCVideo user rejects the incoming group call while in the "S5: pending user action with confirm indication" state or the "S4: pending user action without confirm indication" state?
q_43972.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should stop timer TFG4, start timer TFG5, and enter the "S6: ignoring incoming call announcements" state.

q_43973.question: What is the purpose of the Restart-Counter AVP in the MBMS Heartbeat procedure?
q_43973.ground_truth: The Restart-Counter AVP in the MBMS Heartbeat procedure is used to indicate the local restart counter of the sender.

q_43974.question: What IE type contains the value of the Framed-IPv6-Route AVP specified in IETF RFC 3162?

q_43975.question: What action should the UP function take upon receiving a PFCP Session Deletion Request message?
q_43975.ground_truth: The UP function shall release the corresponding L2TP session, and release the L2TP tunnel if there is no other L2TP session using the L2TP tunnel.

q_43976.question: What information is used to advertise the availability of 5GMS content delivered via MBS?
q_43976.ground_truth: The MBS User Service Announcement is used to advertise the availability of 5GMS content delivered via MBS.

q_43977.question: Who is responsible for generating the predictions provided to the NFc?
q_43977.ground_truth: The NWDAF AnLF generates the predictions provided to the NFc based on the collected analytics and data.

q_43978.question: What is the desired objective in the initial access scenario for a network slice service?
q_43978.ground_truth: The desired objective in the initial access scenario for a network slice service is to minimize the time period of service unavailability by enabling the UE to quickly camp on the desired frequency where the required network slice services are provided.

q_43979.question: What happens to the IP multicast distribution address and IP multicast source address when the M1 transport network IP multicast is started with the same transport network IP multicast distribution address but a different IP multicast source address, and the RNC still uses the C-TEID received in the MBMS Session Start Request?
q_43979.ground_truth: The RNC should join the new M1 transport network IP multicast address, which includes the new IP multicast source address, and start sending multicast data with the new IP multicast source address.

q_43980.question: What does LPP stand for in the context of mobile telecommunications?
q_43980.ground_truth: LPP stands for LTE Positioning Protocol.

q_43981.question: When must a UE halt the monitoring operation for PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY messages in 5G ProSe direct discovery?
q_43981.ground_truth: A UE must halt the monitoring operation for PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY messages in 5G ProSe direct discovery in two cases: when the UE is triggered by an upper layer application to stop responding to solicitation on proximity of other UEs in a discovery group, or when the UE stops being authorized to perform the discoveree UE procedure for group member discovery.

q_43982.question: What are the two types of errors in Diameter?
q_43982.ground_truth: The two types of errors in Diameter are protocol errors and application errors. Protocol errors occur at the base protocol level, while application errors generally occur due to a problem with a function specified in a Diameter application.

q_43983.question: What is the delay in milliseconds for activating a deactivated SCell, if the UE supports the L3 reporting for Scell activation capability and reports valid L3 measurement results after receiving the SCell activation command?
q_43983.ground_truth: The delay for activating a deactivated SCell depends on specified conditions.

q_43984.question: What should the UE do if the current TAI is not in the TAI list before the AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message is sent?
q_43984.ground_truth: The UE may discard sending the AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message to the network and continue with the initiation of the registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update.

q_43985.question: What information is used by the AMF to determine whether the UE is performing Inter-RAT mobility to or from NB-IoT?
q_43985.ground_truth: The AMF uses the received "TAI of last TAU" in the EPC MM Context and the RAT Type used for the Registration Request to determine whether the UE is performing Inter-RAT mobility to or from NB-IoT.

q_43986.question: What mobility state will the UE enter if criteria for either Medium- or High-mobility state is not detected during the time period TCRmaxHyst?
q_43986.ground_truth: The UE shall enter Normal-mobility state in this case.

q_43987.question: What measures are taken to ensure that the traffic the PDN GW receives is actually from the UE while connected to a Trusted Access?
q_43987.ground_truth: To ensure this, the Trusted Access must authenticate the UE, protect against source IP address spoofing, provide a secure link between the Trusted Access and PDN GW, coordinate UE detachment to ensure that the IP address is not reused, and allocate IP addresses in the access network such that they are not reassigned to another UE until the MIP Binding has expired or IKE Dead Peer Detection has been run. Additionally, PCC may also be used in access networks that support it to establish a GW control session between the Trusted Access and the PCRF, identifying the UE based on its ID and IP address, and restricting forwarding of packets until the binding at the PDN GW is established.

q_43988.question: What should Layer 1 of the UE do when the downlink radio link quality becomes worse than threshold Qout_CatM1 over the last 400 ms period?
q_43988.ground_truth: Layer 1 of the UE shall send an out-of-sync indication for the PCell to the higher layers within 400 ms Qout_CatM1 evaluation period.

q_43989.question: What is the initial version of the AI/ML model that is sent to the selected users in the first iteration?
q_43989.ground_truth: The sparse global model, which could be an initial version of the AI/ML model in the first iteration.

q_43990.question: Who acquires the latest pose information in the media session loop and shares it with the Media Client?
q_43990.ground_truth: The AR/MR Scene Manager acquires the latest pose information and shares it with the Media Client in the media session loop.

q_43991.question: What is the action taken by the PCEF if all PCC rules bound to a bearer have been removed or deactivated?
q_43991.ground_truth: The PCEF initiates IP-CAN bearer signalling to either deactivate or establish a new bearer, establish a new bearer or request access network information and, if necessary, sends NBIFOM routing rules to the UE in the corresponding access.

q_43992.question: What is the purpose of the parameter exchange procedure for cipher suite negotiation?
q_43992.ground_truth: The parameter exchange procedure for cipher suite negotiation is performed to agree on a cipher suite to use for protecting NF service related signalling over N32-f. It is executed after the security capability negotiation procedure if the selected security policy is PRINS. The SEPP may also reuse this procedure to override what was exchanged before if there is a change in the cipher suite.

q_43993.question: Which field in the MM CDR parameters specifies the time zone of the MMS user agent?
q_43993.ground_truth: The "MS Time Zone" field specifies the time zone of the MMS user agent.

q_43994.question: What is the role of the Non-Access Stratum Layer (NAS) in the user plane?
q_43994.ground_truth: The Non-Access Stratum Layer (NAS) is used to carry Data between UE and MME, and it may include Header compression and security functions of user plane IP data.

q_43995.question: In what scenario will a UE need to wait until emergency services over 3GPP access are completed, before initiating a registration procedure for initial registration?
q_43995.ground_truth: When the UE is accessing over non-3GPP access and is not registered over 3GPP access.

q_43996.question: What is the role of MDA in failure prediction and service failure recovery?
q_43996.ground_truth: MDA is responsible for predicting potential failures, providing required details on potential failures and their degradation trends to enable network health maintenance. Upon failure occurrence, MDA offers analytics to suggest prompt management actions to recover the service in an orderly manner, avoiding other issues such as signaling overload.

q_43997.question: What is the purpose of the Assistance Information Feedback procedure in the context of NG-RAN nodes?
q_43997.ground_truth: The Assistance Information Feedback procedure is used to allow the NG-RAN Node to give feedback to the LMF on assistance information broadcasting, and it applies only if the NG-RAN node is a gNB.

q_43998.question: What is the role of the 5GMS-Aware Application in downlink 5G Media Streaming services?
q_43998.ground_truth: The 5GMS-Aware Application informs the Media Player about the set of Service Descriptions associated with the Media Player Entry document for the content selected, selects one of the available Service Descriptions, provides the External reference of the selected Service Description to the Media Session Handler, and sends Service Operation Point measurements and events to the 5GMSd AF.

q_43999.question: What is the purpose of the Stop MTCH field in the MCH Scheduling Information MAC Control Element?
q_43999.ground_truth: The Stop MTCH field in the MCH Scheduling Information MAC Control Element indicates the ordinal number of the subframe within the MCH scheduling period, counting only the subframes allocated to the MCH, where the corresponding MTCH stops.

q_44000.question: What is the MIME type being extended in section 8.4.1?

q_44001.question: What is the "List of Audio SSRCs of Granted Participants" field used for and what does it contain?
q_44001.ground_truth: The "List of Audio SSRCs of Granted Participants" field is used in a multi-talker scenario and carries the SSRC values for Audio RTP streams of the users transmitting the media. It contains the Audio SSRCs of the granted participants in the same order as the corresponding user IDs in the List of Granted Users field.

q_44002.question: What is the purpose of carrier leakage measurements in NB-IoT NPUSCH and NPRACH testing?
q_44002.ground_truth: The purpose of carrier leakage measurements in NB-IoT NPUSCH and NPRACH testing is to verify the modulation accuracy of the UE transmitter and its ability to comply with the 3GPP specification when operating in NB-IoT FDD frequency division duplex mode with UE categories NB1 and NB2 that support satellite access. Carrier leakage emissions are an additive sinusoid waveform that should not exceed the specified limits, ensuring proper interference management and minimizing unwanted RF transmissions in the wireless channel.

q_44003.question: What is the priority order for a UE to select a WLAN if there are multiple WLANs with the same priority?
q_44003.ground_truth: The UE shall select a WLAN in the following order: (a) a WLAN that directly interworks with the HPLMN, (b) a WLAN that directly interworks with a service provider in EHSP, (c) a WLAN that directly interworks with the most preferred service provider in PSPL.

q_44004.question: What is the role of the MCE in E-UTRAN for MBMS transmissions?
q_44004.ground_truth: The MCE is responsible for admission control, allocation of radio resources, deciding on using SC-PTM or MBSFN, counting and acquisition of counting results for MBMS service(s), and suspension/resumption of MBMS session(s) within MBSFN area(s).

q_44005.question: What action does the mobile station take upon receipt of a MODIFY REJECT message with the bearer capability negotiated at call setup?
q_44005.ground_truth: The mobile station stops timer T323 and enters the "active" state.

q_44006.question: How does an operator authorize the HOLD service in 3GPP TS 24.610?
q_44006.ground_truth: The operator authorizes and activates the HOLD service by setting the "authorized" attribute of operator-communication-hold to "true" in the 3GPP TS 24.610.

q_44007.question: What must the MCPTT client do upon receiving a SIP 4xx response, SIP 5xx response or a SIP 6xx response to the SIP REFER request for an MCPTT emergency private call?
q_44007.ground_truth: If the MCPTT emergency private call state is set to "MEPC 2: emergency-pc-requested", the MCPTT client shall perform the actions specified in clause~6.2.8.3.5 and skip the remaining steps.

q_44008.question: What is the role of the IBCF when it performs IMS-ALG functionality and acts as a B2BUA?
q_44008.ground_truth: The IBCF is responsible for mapping message header fields between the two dialogs it manages, correlating the dialog identifiers, and deciding when to translate a message or perform other functions.

q_44009.question: What action is taken by the H-SMF during the PDU Session Release procedure if the PDU Session is the last HR-SBO PDU Session using a given Offload Identifier on the V-SMF?
q_44009.ground_truth: The V-SMF may remove the Offload Identifier and corresponding VPLMN Specific Offloading Information based on roaming agreements.

q_44010.question: What is the Minimum conformance requirement for the handover delay in E-UTRAN FDD-FDD intra-frequency handover test case for 5MHz bandwidth?
q_44010.ground_truth: The handover delay Dhandover shall be less than Maximum RRC procedure delay + Tinterrupt in RRC_CONNECTED state.

q_44011.question: In which state does the transmission control interface remain when it receives an implicit Transmission request due to an upgrade to an emergency group call?
q_44011.ground_truth: The 'U: not permitted and Transmit Idle' state.

q_44012.question: What are the options for the verticalGridType field in the GNSS-LOS-NLOS-GriddedIndicationsReq-r18 IE?
q_44012.ground_truth: The verticalGridType field in the GNSS-LOS-NLOS-GriddedIndicationsReq-r18 IE can take two values: ground-level and threeD. The ground-level option refers to a 2D grid, and the threeD option refers to a 3D grid.

q_44013.question: For which type of operations does the UTRA FDD Primary CPICH power requirement apply?
q_44013.ground_truth: This requirement applies to the TAB connector group(s) transmitting primary CPICH, including UTRA FDD operation, but not for UTRA TDD 1,28 Mcps, E-UTRA, or NR operations.

q_44014.question: In what state is a transmission participant when they are not sending RTP media packets or waiting for a transmission control message response?
q_44014.ground_truth: The 'U: has no permission to transmit' state

q_44015.question: What is the role of RAN in exempting a 5G ProSe Relay UE from overload control during emergency service?
q_44015.ground_truth: The RAN informs Relay AMF that the 5G ProSe Relay UE is performing emergency service for 5G ProSe Remote UE to exempt from e.g. overload control for the 5G ProSe Relay UE.

q_44016.question: What type of data does the "Priority" element store in the "MCPTT-group-call" element?
q_44016.ground_truth: The "Priority" element stores the priority of the MCPTT user for initiating and receiving MCPTT calls in the "MCPTT-group-call" element.

q_44017.question: What is the threshold value for overall delay measured for Test 2 in clause 16.6.1.3.5-1?

q_44018.question: What is the scenario described in subclause 10.5.4 regarding interworking floor control?
q_44018.ground_truth: Subclause 10.5.4 of the 3GPP 23.379 standard describes a scenario where a transmitting radio cannot be signalled that the floor has been taken or revoked, specifically in the context of interworking between MCPTT and LMR systems.

q_44019.question: What procedure is used to join multicast MBS sessions in the registration procedure?
q_44019.ground_truth: The procedure to join multicast MBS sessions in the registration procedure involves the UE including the MBS session information container in the Registration Request, which contains the MBS Session ID(s) with an indication of "join" for the multicast MBS session(s) that it wants to join. The AMF then forwards the MBS session information container towards the SMF serving the associated PDU Session in the Registration procedures, and the SMF performs the corresponding multicast MBS session procedures based on the information in the MBS session information container.

q_44020.question: What is the role of a Secondary eNB in dual connectivity?
q_44020.ground_truth: A Secondary eNB in dual connectivity provides additional radio resources for the UE but is not the Master eNB.

q_44021.question: What action does UE2 take when it receives the PC5 Relay Update Request message from the UE-to-UE Relay?
q_44021.ground_truth: UE2 saves UE1's new IP address/prefix and sends a PC5 Relay Update Response message to the UE-to-UE Relay including all parameters received on the PC5 Relay Update Request message. UE2 should be able to receive IP data with UE1's old IP address until UE1's new IP address is received, at which point UE2 starts using UE1's new IP address and may forget UE1's old IP address.

q_44022.question: What is the requirement when the UE transitions between DRX and non-DRX modes or when the DRX cycle periodicity changes in the NB-IoT cell?
q_44022.ground_truth: The UE should use an evaluation period that is no less than the minimum of the evaluation periods corresponding to the first mode and the second mode, for both out-of-sync and in-sync evaluations of the NB-IoT cell.

q_44023.question: What should the UE do when it receives an ESM cause value of #65 "maximum number of EPS bearers reached"?
q_44023.ground_truth: The UE should determine the PLMN's maximum number of EPS bearer contexts in S1 mode (see clause~6.5.0) as the number of active EPS bearer contexts it has, and ignore the Back-off timer value IE and Re-attempt indicator IE provided by the network, if any.

q_44024.question: What is the function of the "retain option" in CCNR service?
q_44024.ground_truth: The "retain option" allows the network to maintain the CC request in the destination B queue, if a CC call has failed due to a destination busy condition.

q_44025.question: In what situation is the transport block processed with a single CRC attachment in the UL-SCH transport channel processing?
q_44025.ground_truth: The transport block is processed with a single CRC attachment when the entire transport block is used to calculate the CRC parity bits, and the parity bits are attached to the UL-SCH transport block. This occurs when L is set to 24 bits and the generator polynomial gCRC24A(D) is used.

q_44026.question: What should the SGSN or VLR do when the entire LSA information is received within a dialogue?
q_44026.ground_truth: They shall replace the stored LSA information with the received data set and include the LSA only access indicator value together with the LSA data applicable for the PLMN (if any).

q_44027.question: Which ID is critical when specifying a list of candidate cells in the ParentNodeCellsList?
q_44027.ground_truth: ID id-CellID is critical when specifying a list of candidate cells in the ParentNodeCellsList.

q_44028.question: What is one of the Key Issues being studied to support Federated Learning in 5GC?
q_44028.ground_truth: One of the Key Issues being studied is identifying the use cases that require Federated Learning in 5GC and studying the registration and discovery of the NWDAF supporting Federated Learning.

q_44029.question: What is the purpose of UE Reachability Notification Request procedure?
q_44029.ground_truth: The UE Reachability Notification Request procedure is used to notify a service-related entity when the UE is reachable on EPS.

q_44030.question: What is the purpose of the network-initiated NAS transport procedure in 5G?
q_44030.ground_truth: The network-initiated NAS transport procedure in 5G is used to provide a transport of various types of messages from the AMF to the UE in a 5GMM message, including 5GSM messages, SMS, LPP messages, SLPP messages, UE policy containers, and other specific types of data.

q_44031.question: What does the SMF+PGW-C provide over N4 to the UPF+PGW-U when interworking with EPS?
q_44031.ground_truth: The SMF+PGW-C provides information related to the handling of traffic over S5-U, including the CN Tunnel Info and GBR and MBR values for each GBR bearer of the PDN connection.

q_44032.question: When can the UE indicate Paging Restriction Information to the network?
q_44032.ground_truth: The UE may include Paging Restriction Information in the Service Request message, if supported by UE and network, upon being paged by the network and intending to send a Reject Paging Indication as the response to the paging.

q_44033.question: What should the MCVideo client do when there is no handling specified for a received MONP message or MONP MCVideo message, or an indication from the MCVideo user in a certain state?
q_44033.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should discard the unexpected MONP message or MONP MCVideo message, ignore the unexpected indication from the MCVideo user, or ignore the unexpected expiration of a timer, depending on the case.

q_44034.question: What is the formula for the measurement duration for the last PRS RSTD sample in the effective positioning frequency layer?
q_44034.ground_truth: The measurement duration for the last PRS RSTD sample in the effective positioning frequency layer is calculated as = Tagg,i +, where Tagg is the time duration of available PRS in the effective positioning frequency layer to be measured during the measurement gap, and is the measurement duration for the last PRS RSTD sample.

q_44035.question: What is the primary focus of the SEAL data delivery enabler in supporting vertical applications?
q_44035.ground_truth: The SEAL data delivery enabler focuses on efficiently distributing, storing, and delivering application content/data for vertical applications, taking into account existing 3GPP system user plane aspects.

q_44036.question: Who generates training data and where does it terminate when generating training data for UE-side CSI prediction?
q_44036.ground_truth: The UE generates training data for UE-side CSI prediction and the termination point may include the UE or a UE-side OTT server.

q_44037.question: What action does the NWDAF containing MTLF take when it determines to terminate the ML model training?
q_44037.ground_truth: The NWDAF containing MTLF may notify the NWDAF Service consumer a Terminate Request indication with a cause code.

q_44038.question: What information is required for an MBS service UE to receive MC service data over a specific MBS session?
q_44038.ground_truth: The MBS service announcement shall include the MBS session ID, session type, SDP information, and any other information required to enable the MC service UE to receive MC service data over a specific MBS session.

q_44039.question: What must the SMF include in the 5GSM cause IE of the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message if the DN authentication of the UE was performed with the service-level authentication and authorization procedure and completed unsuccessfully?
q_44039.ground_truth: The SMF must include 5GSM cause value #29 "user authentication or authorization failed" in the 5GSM cause IE of the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message.

q_44040.question: What condition triggers the Timing Advance reporting procedure during a Random Access procedure in NB-IoT?
q_44040.ground_truth: The Timing Advance reporting procedure is triggered during a Random Access procedure if the UE has initiated the procedure and it supports timing advance reporting, while the ta-Report is included in SystemInformationBlockType2-NB.

q_44041.question: If power class of one or both of the bands within the band combination is power class 2 and the corresponding UE capability maxUplinkDutyCycle-PC2-FR1 is absent, what is the corresponding maxDutyNR,x or maxDutyNR,y?
q_44041.ground_truth: If power class of one or both of the bands within the band combination is power class 2 and the corresponding UE capability maxUplinkDutyCycle-PC2-FR1 is absent, the corresponding maxDutyNR,x or maxDutyNR,y is equal to 50%.

q_44042.question: What must the participating MCPTT function do if the incoming SIP INVITE request does not contain an <associated-group-id> element?
q_44042.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT function shall generate a SIP INVITE request as specified in clause~6.3.2.1.3 and follow specific steps for routing the request.

q_44043.question: What should the MCPTT server do if there is no <selected-user-profile-index> element included in the poc-settings event package and multiple MCPTT user profiles are stored for the MCPTT user?
q_44043.ground_truth: The MCPTT server should identify the MCPTT user profile containing the <Pre-selected-indication> element to determine the pre-selected MCPTT user profile to be used as the active MCPTT user profile.

q_44044.question: What is the function of the c-SEPP in the context of the N32 interface?
q_44044.ground_truth: The c-SEPP is the SEPP present on the NF service consumer side in the context of the N32 interface.

q_44045.question: What keys must an MC UE store in a protected state within the UE while not actively in use?
q_44045.ground_truth: CSK(s), GMK(s), MuSiK(s), and identity-based key material (e.g. KMS Key Set(s)) must be stored in a protected state within the UE while not actively in use.

q_44046.question: Which types of NR UE do the additional spurious emission requirements apply to?
q_44046.ground_truth: The additional spurious emission requirements apply to all types of NR UE release 15 and forward supporting UL MIMO.

q_44047.question: What is the difference between SL-DiscRxPoolList-r12 and SL-DiscRxPoolList-r13 in the ASN.1 definition?
q_44047.ground_truth: SL-DiscRxPoolList-r12 is used to specify the resources for receiving discovery signals, while SL-DiscRxPoolList-r13 is used to specify the resources for receiving discovery signals within a specific frequency.

q_44048.question: Which keys are specific to the tracking area, and who provisions them in this process?
q_44048.ground_truth: K-SIGPrivate is specific to the tracking area and is provisioned in the gNB by the MNO, while K-SIGPublic and its lifetime are provisioned in the UE during the location update procedure.

q_44049.question: What is the requirement for the measurement reporting delay in the test described in 8.1.40.4?
q_44049.ground_truth: The requirement for the measurement reporting delay is less than 12800 ms.

q_44050.question: When is a UE required to decode the corresponding PDSCH upon detection of a PDCCH with DCI format 1, 1A, 1B, 1C, 1D, 2, 2A, 2B, 2C, or 2D intended for the UE in a subframe?
q_44050.ground_truth: A UE is required to decode the corresponding PDSCH in the same subframe/slot/subslot upon detection of a PDCCH of the serving cell with one of the mentioned DCI formats intended for the UE in a subframe, unless specified otherwise.

q_44051.question: What should be the pm-dsg value for the UE to pass the test in the second part?
q_44051.ground_truth: If the pm-dsg is greater than 1%, the UE passes the second part of the test.

q_44052.question: What are the requirements for the "ListOfActiveFunctionalAliases" in the "RulesForAffiliation" section?
q_44052.ground_truth: It should specify the list of active functional aliases for the MCPTT group list.

q_44053.question: Who assigns a TEID/TNL address for each E-RAB in case of direct data forwarding?
q_44053.ground_truth: The target NG-RAN node assigns a TEID/TNL address for each E-RAB it accepted for data forwarding in case of direct data forwarding.

q_44054.question: What are the two types of U2U Remote UEs that can transmit traffic to an L2 U2U Relay UE?
q_44054.ground_truth: The two types of U2U Remote UEs are L2 U2U Remote UEs that transmit traffic to the same or different peer L2 U2U Remote UEs via an L2 U2U Relay UE.

q_44055.question: How can a false base station discover the cell ID of a surrounding real gNB in the described attack scenario?
q_44055.ground_truth: A false base station can discover the cell ID of a surrounding real gNB by impersonating as a real gNB and using one of its cell IDs to send and receive signals.

q_44056.question: What entity initiates the location service request in the 5GC network for a target UE?
q_44056.ground_truth: This can be an entity in the 5GC such as GMLC, the serving AMF for a target UE, or the UE itself making a request to the serving AMF for positioning or delivery of assistance data.

q_44057.question: For AI/ML assisted positioning and different network synchronization error, what is the range of the positioning error when fine-tuning dataset size is 50.0% to 100.0% of the full training dataset size?
q_44057.ground_truth: The positioning error is (1.01-1.47) x E0,B.

q_44058.question: What should the MCData client do when it receives a SIP MESSAGE request for notification of exit from an emergency alert area?
q_44058.ground_truth: If the received SIP MESSAGE request contains an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body with the <emergency-alert-area-ind> element set to "false", the MCData client may display an indication to the user that they have exited the emergency alert area.

q_44059.question: Which UE capability is relevant for idle mode DC measurements as defined in section 4A.1.2.8?
q_44059.ground_truth: The UE capability defined in section 4.2.2.14 is relevant for idle mode DC measurements as defined in section 4A.1.2.8.

q_44060.question: What is the maximum power reduction for power class 1 intra-band contiguous UL CA with a cumulative aggregated bandwidth of no greater than 800 MHz and a channel bandwidth of no greater than 10.8 MHz?
q_44060.ground_truth: The maximum power reduction for power class 1 intra-band contiguous UL CA with a cumulative aggregated bandwidth of no greater than 800 MHz and a channel bandwidth of no greater than 10.8 MHz is 14.4 dB.

q_44061.question: What is the format of the parameter "maxnoofPRSresourceSet" in the structure "RequestedDLPRSResourceSet-List"?
q_44061.ground_truth: The format of the parameter "maxnoofPRSresourceSet" in the structure "RequestedDLPRSResourceSet-List" is a positive integer.

q_44062.question: What are the requirements for the ACLR measurement for non-contiguous spectrum operation?
q_44062.ground_truth: The ACLR should be measured inside the sub-block gap for non-contiguous spectrum operation, and the CACLR should also be measured if applicable.

q_44063.question: What should the MCVideo gateway server do if it receives a forbidden response with a warning text "180 service not authorized by the interconnected system"?
q_44063.ground_truth: The MCVideo gateway server should not continue with the rest of the steps and replace the incoming SIP message's addressing information with the addressing information of the targeted MCVideo function in the local MCVideo system.

q_44064.question: What is the goal of Solution #22 in Network assisted Sidelink Positioning?
q_44064.ground_truth: The goal of Solution #22 is to combine the Uu positioning capability and Ranging/Sidelink Positioning capability together to satisfy the Ranging/SL positioning service.

q_44065.question: What parameter is used by the UE to determine if the enhanced coverage feature is restricted or not?
q_44065.ground_truth: The Enhanced Coverage Restricted parameter is used by the UE to determine if the enhanced coverage feature is restricted or not.

q_44066.question: In the MCPTT system, what is the significance of the "affiliating" affiliation status in MCPTT group information entries?
q_44066.ground_truth: The "affiliating" affiliation status in MCPTT group information entries indicates that a user is currently affiliated with the group, and the expiration time for the affiliation has not yet expired.

q_44067.question: When does a UE not need to use gaps for intra-frequency measurements?
q_44067.ground_truth: A UE does not need to use gaps for intra-frequency measurements if it indicates that it does not need gaps with the capability intraFreq-CE-NeedForGaps-r13 for the frequency band of the serving cell or it is measuring a GSO intra-frequency cell or a NGSO intra-frequency cell provided by the same satellite as the serving cell.

q_44068.question: What information is triggered via MPD and segments in server-based ad insertion in DASH?
q_44068.ground_truth: Ad-related information is triggered via MPD and segments, and ad decisions are made by client requests for MPDs and resources described in them in server-based ad insertion in DASH.

q_44069.question: In the 3GPP TS 36.321 standard, what is the timer that specifies the maximum number of consecutive PDCCH-subframe(s) until a DL retransmission is received?

q_44070.question: What action does the MCVideo client take if it receives a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message with the MCVideo group ID IE matching the ongoing call, but the stored last user to change call type of the call is different from the Last user to change call type IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message and specific conditions are met?
q_44070.ground_truth: The MCVideo client sets the stored last call type change time of the call, sets the stored last user to change call type of the call, sets the stored current call type to "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL", sets the stored current ProSe per-packet priority to a specific value, starts a specific timer, enters the "T1: in-progress emergency group call" state, and generates a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message.

q_44071.question: What is used to obtain the awareness of variable delay in satellite backhaul for adapting Rel-17 solution in Rel-18?
q_44071.ground_truth: The capability for the SMF to request QoS monitoring from the UPF is re-used to obtain the awareness of variable delay in satellite backhaul for adapting Rel-17 solution in Rel-18.

q_44072.question: Under what conditions can a new/modified GBR QoS Flow be admitted when the UE-Slice-MBR would be exceeded?
q_44072.ground_truth: A new/modified GBR QoS Flow can be admitted if it can pre-empt any existing GBR QoS Flow of the UE's PDU Session(s) corresponding to the same S-NSSAI based on their ARP values, subject to regulatory requirements and roaming agreements.

q_44073.question: What action should the MME take if it receives a BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message during the EPS bearer context modification procedure and the EPS bearer indicated in the BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message is the EPS bearer that the network had requested to modify?
q_44073.ground_truth: The MME should ignore the BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message received and proceed with the EPS bearer modification procedure as if no BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message was received from the UE.

q_44074.question: Which RFCs define the Per-Hop Behaviors (PHB) used by the DS domain operator?
q_44074.ground_truth: The DS domain operator can use PHBs defined in RFC 2474, sections 4.1 and 4.2.2.2, and RFC 3246 and 2597, to provide different levels of forwarding assurances and low loss or low latency traffic.

q_44075.question: When setting the MCPTT emergency state in the SIP request for initiating an MCPTT emergency private call, what should the MCPTT client include in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body?
q_44075.ground_truth: The MCPTT emergency state in the SIP request for initiating an MCPTT emergency private call should be set to "true."

q_44076.question: When does the UE request the parameters from the lower layers for transmitting or receiving ProSe direct communication?
q_44076.ground_truth: When the UE is served by E-UTRAN and intends to use the ProSe radio resources provided by an E-UTRAN cell, the UE requests the parameters from the lower layers for transmitting or receiving ProSe direct communication.

q_44077.question: Which clause of TS 36.211 specifies the frame structure type 2 is applicable to TDD?
q_44077.ground_truth: Clause 4.2 of TS 36.211 specifies that frame structure type 2 is applicable to TDD.

q_44078.question: When are PRACH requirement tests for long PRACH preamble format 0 with restricted set types A and B applicable?
q_44078.ground_truth: The tests for long PRACH preamble format 0 with restricted set types A and B apply only for the restricted set type declared to be supported.

q_44079.question: What does AMF need to do when the 5G-RG is registered via both 3GPP access and W-5GAN?
q_44079.ground_truth: AMF may provide W-AGF identities to the SMF also when forwarding N1 SM container sent by the 5G-RG via 3GPP access.

q_44080.question: What two criteria does the manufacturer need to meet for demonstrating conformance to the IAB-DU type 1-H and IAB-MT type 1-H spurious emission requirement?
q_44080.ground_truth: The two criteria for demonstrating conformance to the IAB-DU type 1-H and IAB-MT type 1-H spurious emission requirement are: (1) the sum of the emissions power measured on each TAB connector in the TAB connector TX min cell group is less than or equal to the limit for the respective frequency span, or (2) the unwanted emissions power at each TAB connector is less than or equal to the type 1-H limit for the respective frequency span, scaled by -10log10(n), where n is the number of TAB connectors in the TAB connector TX min cell group.

q_44081.question: What is the requirement that the UE must meet during Test 1 for the test to pass?
q_44081.ground_truth: For the test to pass during Test 1, the ratio of successful reported values for requirements R1 to R8 must be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%. Each requirement is evaluated independently of the others.

q_44082.question: Which entity is responsible for checking the authorization of the AF to acquire Ranging/SL positioning information of UEs?
q_44082.ground_truth: NEF (Network Exposure Function) is responsible for checking the authorization of the AF to acquire Ranging/SL positioning information of UEs in the service request initiated by the application server.

q_44083.question: What is required in Option 1 for enabling routing of signalling traffic between the MC service server and the MC service client?
q_44083.ground_truth: In Option 1, there is a one-to-one correspondence of MC service IDs with IMPUs for enabling routing of signalling traffic between the MC service server and the MC service client.

q_44084.question: What should the CP function do if it can process the information reported in a PFCP Session Report Request message?
q_44084.ground_truth: The CP function should process the information as appropriate and send a PFCP Session Report Response message with the cause set to "success".

q_44085.question: What regulation specifies the emission requirements for the TAB connector in certain regions, in addition to the requirements in clauses 6.6.5.5.2 and 6.6.5.5.3?

q_44086.question: Which specification contains the stage 2 procedures and flows for the 5G System?

q_44087.question: What is the role of the PDN GW when the UE attaches to the EPC using the S2a reference point and MIPv4 is used?
q_44087.ground_truth: The PDN GW acts as HA when the UE attaches to the EPC using the S2a reference point and MIPv4 is used.

q_44088.question: What is the process described in clause~5.27.1.2.2 used for in the 5G system (5GS)?
q_44088.ground_truth: The process described in clause~5.27.1.2.2 is used for making ingress timestamping (TSi) for the (g)PTP event messages of all domains and forwards them to the UPF/NW-TT that further distributes the (g)PTP messages to the egress TTs. The PTP port in the ingress TT uses the rateRatio contained inside the PTP message payload to convert the residence time spent within the 5GS in PTP GM time.

q_44089.question: What procedure is used if the NEF authorization request is successful and an External Group Identifier was included in step 4?
q_44089.ground_truth: The UDM maps the External Group Identifier to an Internal-Group Identifier and a list of GPSIs and maps GPSIs to SUPIs.

q_44090.question: What is the minimum performance requirement for the downlink physical channels specified in Annex C.3.2 in section 9.5.3.1-2 and 9.5.3.2-2?
q_44090.ground_truth: The minimum performance requirement for the downlink physical channels specified in Annex C.3.2 in section 9.5.3.1-2 and 9.5.3.2-2 is the ratio of the throughput obtained when transmitting based on UE reported RI and that obtained when transmitting with fixed rank 1.

q_44091.question: Which action does the SCS/AS take if the modification request is set to "Cancel"?
q_44091.ground_truth: The SCS/AS releases the associated MBMS resources if the modification request is set to "Cancel".

q_44092.question: In the relaxed measurement criterion for low mobility, how is the reference L3 RSRP measurement of the SpCell based on SSB determined?
q_44092.ground_truth: SS-RSRPRef is determined by setting it as the current SS-RSRP measurement of the SpCell based on SSB when low mobility criterion is received, MAC of the CG completes a Random Access procedure, or (SS-RSRP - SS-RSRPRef) > 0. If none of the above are met, the UE sets SS-RSRPRef to the current SS-RSRP value of the SpCell.

q_44093.question: What is the population of Portugal?

q_44094.question: How can a P-CSCF act upon receiving a Request or Response containing the Resource-Share header field with the media-sharing value?
q_44094.ground_truth: When the P-CSCF supporting this extension receives a request or response destined for the served UE containing the Resource-Share header field with the value "media-sharing", the P-CFCF may extract resource sharing rules from the "rules" header field parameter and use the extracted resource sharing rules to perform resource sharing procedures.

q_44095.question: What is the action taken by the MAC entity when it receives a TCI States Activation/Deactivation for UE-specific PDSCH MAC CE on a Serving Cell?
q_44095.ground_truth: The MAC entity indicates to lower layers the information regarding the TCI States Activation/Deactivation for UE-specific PDSCH MAC CE.

q_44096.question: What is the communication protocol used to support AR/MR system capability discovery, AR/MR session management, tracking of surrounding area, and rendering of AR/MR content in scene graph in AR glasses?

q_44097.question: What is the test purpose for UE maximum output power for inter-band NR CA between FR 1 and FR 2 without EN-DC?
q_44097.ground_truth: The test purpose is to verify that the UE's maximum output power is within the range specified by the nominal maximum output power and tolerance.

q_44098.question: What is a key issue related to the MBMS support in the MC system with non-3GPP devices connected via an MC gateway UE?
q_44098.ground_truth: MBMS transmissions need to be supported for MC service clients operating on non-3GPP devices via an MC gateway UE while minimizing the impact on the existing MC system. The MBMS support for MC service clients residing on non-3GPP devices should be transparent for the network to minimize the impact on the existing MC system.

q_44099.question: What is the format of the DUCUCellSwitchNotification and CUDUCellSwitchNotification in the F1AP-PROTOCOL-CONTAINER?
q_44099.ground_truth: DUCUCellSwitchNotification and CUDUCellSwitchNotification in the F1AP-PROTOCOL-CONTAINER are SEQUENCE that consist of a protocolIEs field, which is a ProtocolIE-Container containing DUCUCellSwitchNotificationIEs and CUDUCellSwitchNotificationIEs respectively.

q_44100.question: What should an MCVideo client do upon receiving a SIP 2xx response to the SIP MESSAGE request?
q_44100.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should set the MCVideo emergency alert state to "MVEA 3: emergency-alert-initiated".

q_44101.question: What information does the BSF have about the user identity and the selected PCF address for a certain UE?
q_44101.ground_truth: The BSF has information about the user identity, and the selected PCF address for a certain UE, as well as the functionality that determines the PCF address and if available the associated PCF instance ID and PCF set ID.

q_44102.question: What is the difference in handling network side ports and device side ports information translation in the TSCTSF?
q_44102.ground_truth: For network side ports, the TSCTSF transfers the information in PMIC between the NW-TT and the TSCTSF. However, for device side ports, the TSCTSF transfers the information using parameters from the SMF to the TSCTSF via PCF. This difference is important as it reflects the distinction in communication dynamics between device side ports and network side ports.

q_44103.question: What is the format of a MAC subheader for SL-SCH in a MAC PDU?
q_44103.ground_truth: Each MAC subheader except for the fixed-sized MAC CE and padding consists of the four header fields R/F/LCID/L, and the SL-SCH subheader consists of seven header fields V/R/R/R/R/SRC/DST.

q_44104.question: What is the default logical relationship between query parameters in the 3GPP northbound and application layer APIs?
q_44104.ground_truth: The default logical relationship between query parameters in the 3GPP northbound and application layer APIs is the logical 'AND'.

q_44105.question: What is the maximum number of PLMN identities that the "forbidden PLMNs for attach in S101 mode" list can accommodate in implementation?
q_44105.ground_truth: The maximum number of possible entries in the "forbidden PLMNs for attach in S101 mode" list is implementation dependent.

q_44106.question: What is S-NSSAI based congestion control in 3GPP TS 23.501?
q_44106.ground_truth: S-NSSAI based congestion control is a type of congestion control at the session management level in 3GPP TS 23.501. It is applied to reject session management requests from UEs or release PDU sessions when the associated S-NSSAI and optionally the associated DNN are congested.

q_44107.question: What should a participating MCData function do if it is unable to process a SIP MESSAGE request due to lack of resources or risk of congestion?
q_44107.ground_truth: It may reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response and include a Retry-After header field.

q_44108.question: What is included in the Tprocessing value for the NR PSCell addition delay with CCA?
q_44108.ground_truth: The Tprocessing value for the NR PSCell addition delay with CCA is the software processing time needed by UE, including the RF warm up period, and is set to 20 ms.

q_44109.question: What functions of the Xn interface are responsible for supporting dual connectivity between NG-RAN nodes?
q_44109.ground_truth: Procedures to support dual connectivity between NG-RAN nodes and dual connectivity function.

q_44110.question: What should an MS do to deactivate PSM?
q_44110.ground_truth: The MS may deactivate PSM at any time by activating the AS layer before initiating the necessary GMM or MM procedures (if any).

q_44111.question: When the UE receives a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message with the reject cause set to "Illegal UE", what should the UE consider the USIM as, as per TS 24.301 clause 5.5.3.2.5?
q_44111.ground_truth: The UE should consider the USIM as invalid for EPS services and non-EPS services.

q_44112.question: What is the role of the UPF in QoS monitoring and reporting in a 5G system?
q_44112.ground_truth: The UPF performs Per QoS flow QoS monitoring, by provisioning a SRR with one or more QoS Monitoring per QoS flow Control Information IEs for one or more QoS flows and QoS parameters, if the UPF has indicated support of the corresponding features. The SMF provisions one or more QFI IEs indicating the QoS flow(s) for which QoS monitoring is requested, the Requested QoS Monitoring IE indicating one or more QoS parameters to be measured, and the Reporting Frequency IE indicating the type of the reporting as "Event Triggered" or "Periodic".

q_44113.question: What is the purpose of sending a Handover Notify message from the NG-RAN to the target AMF?
q_44113.ground_truth: The purpose is to notify the target AMF that the UE is handed over to the NG-RAN.

q_44114.question: In what mode, after a PS handover, does the network activate integrity protection and assign a ciphering algorithm or deactivate ciphering in the target cell?

q_44115.question: What does SS do to the UL HARQ process in the initial conditions?
q_44115.ground_truth: SS sends uplink scheduling information for each UL HARQ process via PDCC for the initial test conditions.

q_44116.question: What is the procedure for an S4-SGSN to find all S3 interfaces of an MME based on the old GUTI?
q_44116.ground_truth: The S4-SGSN uses a "Service Parameter" of "x-3gpp-mme:x-s3" in the S-NAPTR procedure.

q_44117.question: When is the MME required to request the UE to include its UE radio capability ID in the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message during an ongoing tracking area updating procedure in WB-S1 mode?
q_44117.ground_truth: If the network supports RACS, the UE has set the RACS bit to "RACS supported" in the UE network capability IE of the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message, the UE has set the URCIDA bit to "UE radio capability ID available" in the UE radio capability ID availability IE of the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message, and no UE radio capability ID is available in the UE context in the MME.

q_44118.question: What does the value 0 indicate in the NGAP cause group?
q_44118.ground_truth: The value 0 in the NGAP cause group indicates the "radioNetwork" cause group.

q_44119.question: What does the term "duplex evolution" refer to in the context of the 3GPP's Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network study?
q_44119.ground_truth: Duplex evolution refers to the study of potential enhancements for NR TDD in unpaired spectrum, specifically focusing on identifying applicable deployment scenarios, developing evaluation methodologies, and studying subband non-overlapping full duplex and dynamic/flexible TDD enhancements.

q_44120.question: What value should the ICSI value of the P-Preferred-Service header field have in a SIP MESSAGE request to disable the storage of MCData communications for private and/or group?

q_44121.question: What does the BBERF do after receiving the updated QoS rules and event triggers from the H-PCRF or V-PCRF?
q_44121.ground_truth: The BBERF installs and enforces the received QoS rules, and may also perform bearer binding and service flow activation or deactivation accordingly.

q_44122.question: What action should a GTP entity take if a mandatory information element is missing in a received Response message that needs to be forwarded?
q_44122.ground_truth: The GTP entity should include the rejection Cause "Invalid Reply from remote peer" in the forwarded Response message.

q_44123.question: What procedure does the MeNB initiate if the membership verification fails during the addition of a hybrid HeNB as the SeNB?
q_44123.ground_truth: It is up to the SeNB to decide on further actions.

q_44124.question: What is the purpose of CAPIF support in the SCEF?
q_44124.ground_truth: When CAPIF is supported, the SCEF supports the CAPIF API provider domain functions, which allow for the management of service capabilities and API features.

q_44125.question: What should the UE do if an inter-frequency cell is indicated as not allowed in the measurement control system information of the serving cell?
q_44125.ground_truth: The UE shall not consider the inter-frequency cell for cell re-selection.

q_44126.question: What is the purpose of the test case described in section 7.5.1.9?
q_44126.ground_truth: The purpose of this test case is to verify that the UE correctly follows the RLM scheduling restrictions requirements defined in TS 38.133, and to verify that the UE correctly receives the PDCCH scheduled on the symbols right before the RLM SSB symbols without overlap so that it sends ACK/NACK correctly.

q_44127.question: What information is included in the sftd-NR for NR PSCell in the sftd measObject?
q_44127.ground_truth: In the sftd measObject for NR PSCell, sftd-NR sets the sfn-OffsetResult, frameBoundaryOffsetResult, and rsrp-Result with its respective measurement results when reportRSRP is true.

q_44128.question: What is the role of an intent-driven MnS producer in 5G networks?
q_44128.ground_truth: An intent-driven MnS producer in 5G networks analyzes and selects the optimal balance between the energy saving effect and service experience by utilizing intelligence mechanisms.

q_44129.question: What is the objective of the Rel-18 Study Item "Study on simplification of band combination specification for NR and LTE"?
q_44129.ground_truth: The objective of this study item is to investigate and simplify the working procedure for approving documents for TS and TR to improve the efficiency of specifying band combinations and the quality of specifications, as well as to improve the efficiency and quality of the specification process and reduce the test burden.

q_44130.question: What is the role of Overload Control Sequence Number in PFCP messages?
q_44130.ground_truth: The Overload Control Sequence Number aids in sequencing the overload control information received from an overloaded network function. It contains a value that indicates the sequence number associated with the Overload Control Information IE.

q_44131.question: What does the LI system consist of in a 3GPP network?
q_44131.ground_truth: The LI system consists of all LI components involved in handling the Lawful Interception functionality in the CSP's network.

q_44132.question: What information does the SNRM-C include in the CoAP POST request for network assisted QoS management initiation?
q_44132.ground_truth: The SNRM-C includes the required QoS, list of VAL UEs, valServiceId, serviceArea, validPeriod, and sends the request protected with the relevant ACE profile in the CoAP POST request.

q_44133.question: What information is used by the eNodeB to derive the MME address, if the old GUMMEI is available?
q_44133.ground_truth: The eNodeB uses the old GUMMEI, Selected Network, and RAT (NB-IoT or WB-E-UTRAN) to derive the MME address.

q_44134.question: What is the result if a DELETE HTTP method is used to terminate a Network Assistance session and the termination was successful?
q_44134.ground_truth: Any subsequent calls referring to the terminated session will result in the error 404 (Not Found).

q_44135.question: What is the role of the PCF in the URSP enforcement reporting process?
q_44135.ground_truth: The PCF returns the URSP rule indicated by the URSP Rule Precedence to the SMF, which is used to generate N4 rules (PDR, URR) based on the Traffic Descriptor of the URSP rule received from the PCF and provisions the rules to the UPF. The SMF also indicates the UPF to report the event when incorrect application traffic is detected for the QoS Flow indicated in the PDR.

q_44136.question: What is the test purpose for E-UTRAN TDD event triggered reporting under deactivated SCell in non-DRX?
q_44136.ground_truth: The test purpose is to verify the UE's ability to make correct reportings of Event A2 and A6 under deactivated SCell in non-DRX within the requirements in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 8.3.3.2.1.

q_44137.question: What is the Adjacent Channel Leakage Power Ratio (ACLR) for NR V2X UE?
q_44137.ground_truth: The ACLR requirement for NR V2X UE in clause 6.5E.2.4 is applied for NR V2X operating bands specified in 5.2E.1-1. For NR V2X UE with two transmit antenna connectors, the requirements specified for single carrier shall apply to each transmit antenna connector.

q_44138.question: When should a UE initiate the service request procedure for the established PDU session in a partially allowed NSSAI?
q_44138.ground_truth: If the current TAI is changed and the current TAI is in the list of TAs for which the S-NSSAI is allowed, the UE can initiate the service request procedure to re-establish the user plane resources for the established PDU session.

q_44139.question: What does NEF translate in the case of external AF to create a list of geographic zone identifiers?

q_44140.question: What must a CSP be able to do if they intercept a communication while a target is roaming?
q_44140.ground_truth: They must be able to obtain and report the location of the target, including when the target is active or idle, and use multiple location sources and positioning methods.

q_44141.question: How is the measurement reporting delay, measured without L3 filtering, defined in the 8.13.3.1.2 clause?
q_44141.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay, measured without L3 filtering, is defined in the 8.13.3.1.2 clause as the time between an event that will trigger a measurement report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface, excluding certain delays.

q_44142.question: Which waveform is selected for FR1 CA with UL MIMO test cases in TS 38.521-1, when the uplink transmissions use two layers?

q_44143.question: What should the MCPTT client do when downgrading an imminent peril group call to a basic group call in step 10.2.3.4.8.4?
q_44143.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should set the stored current call type to "BASIC GROUP CALL", set the stored current ProSe per-packet priority to the value corresponding to MCPTT off-network basic group call, set current UTC time as last call type change time of the call, store own MCPTT user ID as last user to change call type of the call, generate a GROUP CALL IMMINENT PERIL END message, and send the generated GROUP CALL IMMINENT PERIL END message.

q_44144.question: What is the responsibility of the NEF in the management of EAS Deployment Information?
q_44144.ground_truth: The NEF is in charge of the management of EAS Deployment Information, which may be stored in UDR.

q_44145.question: What HTTP method should be used to request the creation of a new USS Change Policy?
q_44145.ground_truth: An HTTP POST method should be used to request the creation of a new USS Change Policy.

q_44146.question: In the process of out-of-sync and in-sync evaluations of the NB-IoT cell, what is the minimum time separation between two successive indications?
q_44146.ground_truth: Two successive indications from Layer 1 in the out-of-sync and in-sync evaluations of the NB-IoT cell shall be separated by at least 10 ms.

q_44147.question: What is the name of the feature that enables the terminating UE to determine whether a number has been verified by the network?

q_44148.question: What is the difference between GTP-C Load Control and GTP-C Overload Control features?
q_44148.ground_truth: GTP-C Load Control is an optional feature that allows a GTP control plane node to send its Load Control Information to a peer GTP control plane node, reflecting the operating status of the resources of the originating GTP control plane node. GTP-C Overload Control, on the other hand, is also an optional feature that allows nodes using GTP control plane signalling to communicate Overload Control Information to mitigate overload situations by reducing and/or throttling the amount of GTP-C signalling traffic.

q_44149.question: What is the maximum degradation observed in the evaluation of Type 3 NW first separate training with dataset sharing manner for CSI compression for the pairing of 1 UE to N>1 NW part models (Case 3)?

q_44150.question: How are UEs prevented from accessing a Network Slice allocated for a PNI-NPN in areas where the UE is not allowed to use the network?
q_44150.ground_truth: CAG is used for access control in PNI-NPN to prevent UE(s) which are not allowed to access the NPN via the associated cell(s) from automatically selecting and accessing the associated CAG cell(s).

q_44151.question: What is the purpose of the end marker packets in the N9 tunneling procedure?
q_44151.ground_truth: The end marker packets are used to indicate the completion of DL data transmission on the N9 tunnel between the old and new I-UPFs.

q_44152.question: Which IEs are mandatory in the "PDUSessionResourceModifyResponseIEs" in the NGAP-PROTOCOL-IES?
q_44152.ground_truth: The "id-AMF-UE-NGAP-ID" and "id-RAN-UE-NGAP-ID" IEs are mandatory in the "PDUSessionResourceModifyResponseIEs" IEs.

q_44153.question: In which cases does the PCF discovery and selection procedures through SCP involve?
q_44153.ground_truth: The PCF discovery and selection procedures through SCP involve when there are multiple and separately addressable PCFs in a PLMN or an SNPN, and in the case of delegated discovery and selection.

q_44154.question: How is the hands-free metro/bus validation system used to manage passenger billing during rush hours?
q_44154.ground_truth: The hands-free metro/bus validation system manages passenger billing during rush hours by using Ranging modules installed at the entrance. The modules can perform Ranging with multiple smartphones simultaneously, determining which entrance is closest to a passenger. This allows for a seamless and quick entry process, even when there is heavy passenger flow. The passengers get charged for their trip based on their usage, and the fees are automatically deducted from their accounts.

q_44155.question: What is the impact of LMR systems on emergency call behavior in an MCPTT system?
q_44155.ground_truth: The behavior of emergency calls in an MCPTT system is affected by the LMR system and the IWF, which determines whether an emergency is raised on the user's currently selected group or on a default emergency group.

q_44156.question: What triggers the network to initiate the transport of NAS messages procedure as per TS 24.301, clause 5.6.3.3?
q_44156.ground_truth: The network initiates the procedure by sending a DOWNLINK NAS TRANSPORT message to the UE.

q_44157.question: What information is contained in the Flow-Description AVP in the Gx interface?
q_44157.ground_truth: The Flow-Description AVP contains information about a packet filter for an IP flow, including the direction, source and destination IP address, protocol, and source and destination port.

q_44158.question: What is the maximum number of times the "EnterSpecificPlmn" or "ExitSpecificPlmn" elements can appear in the "tPlmnChangeType" type?
q_44158.ground_truth: The "EnterSpecificPlmn" or "ExitSpecificPlmn" elements can appear unbounded times in the "tPlmnChangeType" type.

q_44159.question: What is the minimum length of a template information element?
q_44159.ground_truth: The minimum length of a template information element is 3 octets.

q_44160.question: In what scenario will the MS not consider PLMNs where voice service was not possible in E-UTRAN as PLMN selection candidates for E-UTRA access technology?
q_44160.ground_truth: This occurs when the MS is in E-UTRAN capable mode but has disabled its E-UTRA capability, and the MS's usage setting is "voice centric". The MS shall not consider PLMNs where voice service was not possible in E-UTRAN as PLMN selection candidates for E-UTRA access technology, unless no other PLMN is available. This does not prevent selection of such a PLMM if it is available in another RAT (Radio Access Technology).

q_44161.question: What happens when the MTC-IWF is unable to find the IMSI for an external identifier or MSISDN?
q_44161.ground_truth: If the MTC-IWF is unable to find the IMSI for an external identifier or MSISDN, the flow will stop and the MTC-IWF sends a Device Action Answer message with a cause value indicating the SCS is not allowed to perform device triggering to this UE.

q_44162.question: What are the interfaces used for in the MCPTT client?
q_44162.ground_truth: The interfaces in the MCPTT client are used for indications of media packet reception, floor control messages to and from the associated MCPTT client, media packets to and from associated MCPTT clients, requests to start or stop distributing media, and requests to store or remove floor request messages.

q_44163.question: What happens to QoS Flows whose ARP parameter is from the set allocated by the Service Provider for prioritised services during QoS Flow load rebalancing?
q_44163.ground_truth: They are exempt from release during QoS Flow load rebalancing.

q_44164.question: What is the definition of "Aggregate maximum bit rate"?
q_44164.ground_truth: The Aggregate maximum bit rate is the maximum bit rate that limits the aggregate bit rate of a set of non-GBR bearers of a UE.

q_44165.question: When should the MAC entity replace the data in the soft buffer for a TB with the data that it attempted to decode?
q_44165.ground_truth: The MAC entity should replace the data in the soft buffer for a TB with the data that it attempted to decode when it fails to successfully decode the data in the TB.

q_44166.question: What is the maximum number of different RSs that can be activated as PL-RS per serving cell among all active UL (or joint) TCI states, as specified in clause 8.24.3 and 8.24.5?
q_44166.ground_truth: The maximum number of different RSs that can be activated as PL-RS per serving cell among all active UL (or joint) TCI states is 4.

q_44167.question: When is Solution #1 applicable?
q_44167.ground_truth: Solution #1, which discusses AF authorization for providing satellite coverage information in 5GS, is applicable to scenarios where the 5GS/EPS needs to ensure that the AF is authorized to provide satellite coverage availability information to 5GC/EPC.

q_44168.question: What user-initiated actions does the UE take when located in the LADN service area and substate 5GMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE?
q_44168.ground_truth: The UE may initiate various PDU session-related procedures for LADN, such as establishing a PDU session for LADN, modifying the PDU session for LADN, re-establishing the user-plane resources for LADN, or sending CIoT user data via the control plane for LADN.

q_44169.question: What is the maximum number of interrupted slots allowed during the test, from the start of T3 until 775 ms?
q_44169.ground_truth: The maximum number of interrupted slots allowed is 876.

q_44170.question: What is used for transmission parameter adaptation in PSSCH and PSCCH resources when they are placed adjacently?
q_44170.ground_truth: CBR measurement of both the PSSCH and PSCCH resources

q_44171.question: What is the role of the PEMC in authorizing a PINE for access to a PIN?
q_44171.ground_truth: The PEMC authorizes the PINE for connectivity to the PIN and may authorize the PINE to access 5GS services via a PEGC.

q_44172.question: What is the currency of Portugal?

q_44173.question: What should the mobile station do if timer T3242 expires or is found to have already expired and timer T3243 is not running?
q_44173.ground_truth: The mobile station shall stop other running timers and perform a combined GPRS detach procedure for GPRS and non-GPRS services if it is also attached for non-GPRS services and the network operates in network operation mode I. If the mobile station is also attached for non-GPRS services and the network operates in network operation mode II, it shall perform a GPRS detach procedure for GPRS services and an IMSI detach procedure. If the mobile station is not attached for non-GPRS services, it shall perform a GPRS detach procedure for GPRS services.

q_44174.question: What message does the AMF send in response to the UE's Registration Request message, indicating that the network supports non-3GPP access path switching for MA PDU Session?
q_44174.ground_truth: The AMF sends Registration Accept which includes Access Path Switching Timer to the UE, indicating that the network supports non-3GPP access path switching for MA PDU Session.

q_44175.question: What does the "SMS Result" field indicate?
q_44175.ground_truth: The "SMS Result" field indicates the result of an attempt for a Short Message transaction (submission or delivery) at SMS Service Center, when unsuccessful.

q_44176.question: What are some of the restrictions an MME/SGSN can apply towards GWs that have indicated overload?
q_44176.ground_truth: During ESM and EMM procedures, the MME/SGSN can reject EPS Session Management requests from the UE, reject mobility management signalling requests from UEs, reject or accept requests for data transmission via Control Plane CIoT EPS Optimisation from UEs with a Control Plane data back-off timer, or reduce/throttle messages towards the GWs indicating overload status.

q_44177.question: What should the MME do, if the INITIAL UE MESSAGE message includes IAB Node Indication IE?
q_44177.ground_truth: The MME should consider that the message is related to an IAB-node.

q_44178.question: What is the SCS of the CORESET for Type0-PDCCH CSS set provided by for FR1 and FR2-1 in operation without shared spectrum channel access?

q_44179.question: What information is used to identify an MBS service area?
q_44179.ground_truth: The MBS service area can be identified by a cell list or a tracking area list, representing geographical area information or civic address information.

q_44180.question: What should the floor control interface send back to the associated floor participant upon receiving a Floor Release message with the first bit in the subtype set to '1'?
q_44180.ground_truth: A Floor Ack message with the Message Type field set to '4' and the Source field set to '2'.

q_44181.question: What are the standard positioning methods supported for NG-RAN access?
q_44181.ground_truth: The standard positioning methods supported for NG-RAN access are network-assisted GNSS methods, observed time difference of arrival (OTDOA) positioning based on LTE signals, enhanced cell ID methods based on LTE signals, WLAN positioning, Bluetooth positioning, terrestrial beacon system (TBS) positioning, sensor based methods, NR enhanced cell ID methods (NR E-CID) based on NR signals, Multi-Round Trip Time Positioning (Multi-RTT) based on NR signals, Downlink Angle-of-Departure (DL-AoD) based on NR signals, Downlink Time Difference of Arrival (DL-TDOA) based on NR signals, Uplink Time Difference of Arrival (UL-TDOA) based on NR signals, Uplink Angle-of-Arrival (UL-AoA) based on NR signals, and SL positioning and ranging based on sidelink signals.

q_44182.question: What network node act as a transparent forwarding node between the UE and the AS?
q_44182.ground_truth: The UPF (User Plane Function) acts as a transparent forwarding node between the UE and the AS (Access System).

q_44183.question: What should the UE consider as a successful random access response reception?
q_44183.ground_truth: The UE should consider the random access response reception successful if the SS sends a message 3 or msg3 following a successful random access response.

q_44184.question: In what scenario would an MCVideo imminent peril call request be considered authorized?
q_44184.ground_truth: An MCVideo imminent peril call request would be considered authorized if the "entry-info" attribute of the <entry> element within the <MCVideoGroupInitiation> element contained within the <ImminentPerilCall> element of the MCVideo user profile document is set to "DedicatedGroup" and the MCVideo group identity targeted for the call is contained in the <uri-entry> element of the <entry> element within the <MCVideoGroupInitiation> element, or if the "entry-info" attribute is set to "UseCurrentlySelectedGroup".

q_44185.question: What should the UE do upon receiving a HandoverFromEUTRAPreparationRequest message during the HandoverFromEUTRA procedure?
q_44185.ground_truth: The UE should indicate the request to prepare handover and forward the cdma2000-Type to the CDMA2000 upper layers. If the cdma2000-Type is set to 'type1XRTT', the UE should also forward the rand and the mobilityParametersCDMA2000 to the CDMA2000 upper layers.

q_44186.question: What is being measured in "Number of successful external parameter updates" in the context of NEF?
q_44186.ground_truth: The number of successful external parameter updates performed by the NEF.

q_44187.question: What should the UE do if it has successful handover information available in VarSuccessHO-Report and if the RPLMN is included in plmn-IdentityList stored in VarSuccessHO-Report or if the current registered SNPN is included in snpn-IdentityList stored in the VarSuccessHO-Report?
q_44187.ground_truth: Include successHO-InfoAvailable in the RRCSetupComplete message.

q_44188.question: What should the UE do after synchronizing to the DL of the target PCell?
q_44188.ground_truth: The UE should reset the MAC for both MCG and SCG, re-establish PDCP for all RBs, and re-establish RLC for all RBs that are established.

q_44189.question: What is the purpose of the urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.rlos URN?
q_44189.ground_truth: The urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.rlos URN indicates that the device has the capabilities to support the restricted local operator service (RLOS).

q_44190.question: What type of NR UE does the test in 5.2A.2.1.2.2 apply to?
q_44190.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of NR UE release 15 and forward that supports 3DL CA and EN-DC with 3 NR CC.

q_44191.question: What is the function of the N1 reference point in the Ranging/SL Positioning Service?
q_44191.ground_truth: The N1 reference point is used for conveying the Ranging/SL Positioning policy and parameters, including service authorization, from AMF to UE, and for conveying the UE's Ranging/SL Positioning Capability from UE to AMF.

q_44192.question: What action does the UE perform after detaching from the source PSCell in the SN initiated Conditional SN Modification procedure without MN involvement?
q_44192.ground_truth: The UE synchronizes to the selected candidate PSCell and completes the CPC execution procedure.

q_44193.question: What should the NF Service Consumer do when the NF Service Instance is no longer reachable, as per the described procedure?
