q_44193.ground_truth: If the NF Service Instance is no longer reachable, the NF Service Consumer should select a different instance of the same NF Service in the same NF Instance or the same NF Set or NF Service Set, if the NF Instance indicates in its NF Profile that it supports the capability to persist their resources in shared storage inside the NF Instance, and if the new NF Service Instance offers the same major service version. The NF Service Consumer can invoke service operations in the newly selected NF Service Instance, and the new NF Service Instance should produce the same result as if the service request would have been successfully delivered to the former NF Service Instance.

q_44194.question: What type of UEs does the test for SLSS transmission initiation and cease delay with V2X Sidelink Communication for SyncRef UE as Timing Reference apply to?
q_44194.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of UEs that support V2X Communication and Band 47 and SLSS transmission.

q_44195.question: What should be the orientation of the IAB-DU in the declared direction to be tested?
q_44195.ground_truth: The IAB-DU should be set in the declared direction to be tested.

q_44196.question: What is the role of the PEMC in adding or updating PINEs for a PIN?
q_44196.ground_truth: The PEMC is responsible for adding, updating, or removing PINEs for a PIN. It can perform the PINE Registration procedure, Device List Information Query procedure, PIN List Information Query procedure, or PIN Information Query procedure before adding or updating PINEs. If the PEMC can interact with the PINE directly, it sends Create PIN Request or Update PIN Request to the PINE, which includes PIN ID, PINE ID, device name, Connection Info, RAT Info, and Discovery Info.

q_44197.question: Which scope of interfaces does the GNP SCAS attempt a full evaluation of the correct internal functioning?
q_44197.ground_truth: Neither the Operating System (OS) nor the hardware

q_44198.question: What is the number of flag bits for indicating format N0/format N1 differentiation in DCI Format N0?
q_44198.ground_truth: One bit is used for indicating format N0/format N1 differentiation in DCI Format N0.

q_44199.question: What is the name of the function that the remote UE performs before re-selecting the new target UE during path switching?
q_44199.ground_truth: The remote UE performs ProSe Direct Discovery based on path Re-selection rules before re-selecting the new target UE during path switching.

q_44200.question: How does Solution #18 obtain MBSR location information?
q_44200.ground_truth: In Solution #18, the NG-RAN keeps the 5G-GUTI of the MBSR and provides it to the UE-AMF in the Initial UE message. The LMF can then obtain the MBSR location information by requesting it from the NG-RAN without any additional interaction between LMF and RAN.

q_44201.question: What should the UE do when the CSI-RS for CBD measurement is in the same OFDM symbol as another CSI-RS for RLM, BFD, CBD, or L1-RSRP measurement in FR1?
q_44201.ground_truth: The UE is able to measure the CSI-RS for CBD measurement without any restriction.

q_44202.question: What network functionality is required to ensure a consumer NF reaches the PCF holding the PDU Session information?
q_44202.ground_truth: The BSF (Binding Support Function) is responsible for ensuring that a consumer NF reaches the PCF holding the PDU Session information.

q_44203.question: What must the GMM layer in the MS notify the LLC layer before sending an initial GMM message in a new cell in A/Gb mode if an established UMTS security context exists?
q_44203.ground_truth: The GMM layer in the MS must notify the LLC layer whether ciphering shall be used or not in such cases.

q_44204.question: What action should a mobile station (MS) take if it receives a MODIFY PDP CONTEXT REJECT message with SM cause value #26 and the Back-off timer value IE is included?
q_44204.ground_truth: The MS shall stop timer T3396 associated with the corresponding APN, if it is running. The MS shall then start timer T3396 with the value provided in the Back-off timer value IE and not send another ACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT REQUEST, ACTIVATE SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST or MODIFY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message with exception of those identified in subclause~6.1.3.3, for the same APN until timer T3396 expires or timer T3396 is stopped.

q_44205.question: What should the UE do if it has its location information available while performing subclause 5.1.6.12.3?
q_44205.ground_truth: The UE shall provide the location information.

q_44206.question: If the attach attempt counter is incremented after receiving an ATTACH REJECT message, what action does the UE take depending on the value of the attach attempt counter?
q_44206.ground_truth: If the attach attempt counter is less than 5, the UE sets the update status to U2 NOT UPDATED but does not delete any LAI, TMSI, ciphering key sequence number and list of equivalent PLMNs. If the attach attempt counter is equal to 5, then the UE deletes any LAI, TMSI, ciphering key sequence number and list of equivalent PLMNs and sets the update status to U2 NOT UPDATED, attempts to select GERAN or UTRAN radio access technology and proceeds with appropriate MM or GMM specific procedures, and may disable the E-UTRA capability.

q_44207.question: What is the purpose of the security establishment procedure in the Layer-2 based UE-to-UE Relay re-selection procedure?
q_44207.ground_truth: The security establishment procedure is triggered via Relay 2 during the Layer-2 based UE-to-UE Relay re-selection procedure to establish security between the Source UE and Target UE on the new PC5 unicast link, allowing a quicker link setup and path switching if the existing security context is reused with the replacing PC5 unicast link.

q_44208.question: What is Solution #8 in the 5G network?
q_44208.ground_truth: Solution #8 is the OAuth 2.0-based authorization for the AF to manage a specific PIN in the 5G network. The access token sent to the AF includes the PIN identity, authorizing the AF to manage the PIN. This solution also ensures the AF's resource requests from a PIN are restricted to the PIN's resources.

q_44209.question: What is the requirement for the UE network capability IE in the ATTACH REQUEST message if the UE supports ProSe direct communication?
q_44209.ground_truth: The UE shall set the ProSe bit to "ProSe supported" and set the ProSe direct communication bit to "ProSe direct communication supported" in the UE network capability IE of the ATTACH REQUEST message if the UE supports ProSe direct communication.

q_44210.question: What is the goal of the 5.2.3.2.16 test in measuring the PDSCH performance under 4 receive antenna conditions, when transmission from the serving cell is interfered by 1 or 2 interfering cells, for both NSA and SA scenarios?
q_44210.ground_truth: The goal of this test is to verify the PDSCH performance under 4 receive antenna conditions, when transmission from the serving cell is interfered by 1 or 2 interfering cells, for both NSA and SA scenarios.

q_44211.question: What triggers the MC service server to send an IWF emergency alert request when an MC service user initiates an emergency alert?
q_44211.ground_truth: The MC service server sends an IWF emergency alert request when an MC service user initiates an emergency alert and there are affiliated group members that are homed on the IWF.

q_44212.question: What is the main factor determining the PA linearity requirement in FR1 as opposed to FR2-1?
q_44212.ground_truth: In FR1, the PA linearity requirement is dominated by out-of-channel emission requirements, such as ACLR, while in FR2-1, it is driven by in-channel requirements, such as EVM and in-band emissions due to spectral regrowth from IM3.

q_44213.question: What display refresh rate is recommended to eliminate visible flicker in VR displays?
q_44213.ground_truth: A minimum of 90 Hz display refresh rate is recommended to eliminate visible flicker in VR displays.

q_44214.question: What information is included in the CSGinfo, and how is it displayed?
q_44214.ground_truth: CSGinfo consists of CSGType, HNB Name, CSGID, and CSG Associated PLMN MCC MNC, each delimited by a comma and in a particular order. It is displayed in alphanumeric format as CSGType, HNB Name, CSGID, and CSG Associated PLMN MCC MNC, and in numeric format only as CSGID and CSG Associated PLMN MCC MNC.

q_44215.question: What is the content of Byte 1 in the EF5GS3GPPLOCI file for 3GPP access?
q_44215.ground_truth: Byte 1 in the EF5GS3GPPLOCI file for 3GPP access contains the first byte of the 5G-Globally Unique Temporary Identifier for 3GPP access.

q_44216.question: What is the measurement "DL Packet Loss rate on Uu" used for in the 5G network?
q_44216.ground_truth: This measurement is used to provide the DL packet (i.e., RLC SDU) Loss rate on the Uu interface for an NR cell and is used for performance assurance within integrity area (user plane connection quality) and for reliability KPI.

q_44217.question: What triggers in a rating group may lead to several charging data requests when a request payload exceeds recommended values?

q_44218.question: What should the SCC AS do if it receives a SIP 3xx, 4xx, or 6xx response to the SIP REFER request or if the SIP INVITE request transferring additional session is not received within the operator defined time?
q_44218.ground_truth: The SCC AS should release, cancel or reject the remote leg, the source access leg and the target access leg of the determined dialog being transferred.

q_44219.question: What is the purpose of the GET method supported for the Location Information resource?
q_44219.ground_truth: The GET method for the Location Information resource is used to obtain the UE(s) information in an application defined proximity range of a location.

q_44220.question: In the context of clause 5.3D.2, if the UE sends an ANQP request for a list of realms, what are the expected size and content of the list received by the UE from the WLAN?
q_44220.ground_truth: The list received by the UE from the WLAN is of limited size and might not contain all the realms available via the WLAN.

q_44221.question: What is the role of the AAA server in 5G networks?
q_44221.ground_truth: The AAA server is responsible for initiating the Network Slice-Specific Authentication and Authorization, or the Authorization revocation procedure in 5G networks.

q_44222.question: In which mode is the MS not allowed to accept a GSM authentication challenge if a USIM is inserted?
q_44222.ground_truth: In Iu mode, the MS shall not accept a GSM authentication challenge if a USIM is inserted.

q_44223.question: What action does the new MME take if a UE with at least one EPS bearer for emergency services tries to access a restricted TA?
q_44223.ground_truth: The new MME accepts the Tracking Area Update Request and deactivates all non-emergency PDN connections.

q_44224.question: What is the task of Bill in the remote access right authorization use case?
q_44224.ground_truth: Bill's task is to authorize Alice's UE to use ranging service with particular doors in CICI.

q_44225.question: How can an NF Service Producer discover AMFs within an AMF set or backup AMF?
q_44225.ground_truth: An NF Service Producer can use the Nnrf_NFDiscovery service to discover AMFs within an AMF set or backup AMF.

q_44226.question: What information is required to identify PDU Sets from 5GS traffic?
q_44226.ground_truth: Additional information about the SDF, which can be provided by the Application Function

q_44227.question: What is the purpose of the procedure in TS 36.331?
q_44227.ground_truth: The purpose of the procedure in TS 36.331 is to transfer measurement results from the UE to E-UTRAN.

q_44228.question: What is the relationship between TRS and EIS in the Anechoic Chamber method?
q_44228.ground_truth: TRS is defined as the inverted integral of EIS over a sphere, where EIS is the minimum power level at which the throughput exceeds or equals 95% of the maximum throughput of the specified reference measurement channel.

q_44229.question: What happens if the NSACF indicates failure for the access different from the access over which the MA PDU Session Establishment Request is received, while the UE is registered in both accesses?
q_44229.ground_truth: The SMF accepts the MA PDU Session Request and does not provide a back-off timer to the UE.

q_44230.question: What should the network include in the ue-CapabilityRAT-ContainerList if the ue-CapabilityRAT-RequestList contains a UE-CapabilityRAT-Request with rat-Type set to eutra-nr?
q_44230.ground_truth: If the UE supports (NG)EN-DC or NE-DC, the network should include in the ue-CapabilityRAT-ContainerList a UE-CapabilityRAT-Container of the type UE-MRDC-Capability and with the rat-Type set to eutra-nr, along with the supportedBandCombinationList and featureSetCombinations.

q_44231.question: What action does the UE take when the RRCReject message is received in response to an RRCSetupRequest?
q_44231.ground_truth: The UE informs the upper layers about the failure to setup the RRC connection, and the procedure ends.

q_44232.question: What is the role of V-PSA in collecting and reporting charging information between UE and V-EAS?
q_44232.ground_truth: V-PSA collects and reports the charging information between UE and V-EAS based on the corresponding URR.

q_44233.question: What should a participating MCPTT function do if the binding between the MCPTT ID and public user identity does not exist in the "SIP MESSAGE request for transfer private call for originating participating MCPTT function"?
q_44233.ground_truth: It shall reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 404 (Not Found) response.

q_44234.question: Which type of UEs is the "halfDuplexRedCapAllowed" field applicable to, and in which message is it indicated?
q_44234.ground_truth: The "halfDuplexRedCapAllowed" field is applicable to (e)RedCap UEs and is indicated in SIB1 message.

q_44235.question: What message does the eNB establish a UE-associated logical S1-connection upon receiving in a DOWNLINK NAS TRANSPORT message?
q_44235.ground_truth: The MME UE S1AP ID IE

q_44236.question: What is the appropriate HTTP status code for success when updating an Individual USS Change Policy using the HTTP PUT method?
q_44236.ground_truth: The appropriate HTTP status code for success when updating an Individual USS Change Policy using the HTTP PUT method is an HTTP "200 OK" status code.

q_44237.question: What is the maximum value that the "Queue Position Info" value can have if the MCPTT client is queued and the MCPTT server can determine the queue position?
q_44237.ground_truth: The maximum value that the "Queue Position Info" value can have if the MCPTT client is queued and the MCPTT server can determine the queue position is '254'.

q_44238.question: What are the two categories of methods for monitoring the accuracy of AI/ML model output in positioning?

q_44239.question: Over what interface is the CFSI bit used and what does it indicate?
q_44239.ground_truth: The CFSI bit (Change F-TEID support indication) is used over the S1-U and S5/S8 interfaces to indicate whether the SGW can change the assigned GTP-U F-TEID in the current procedure. If the SGW needs to modify the GTP-U F-TEID and the CFSI flag is set to 1 in the corresponding request message, the SGW shall include the new F-TEID in the Modify Bearer Response/Modify Access Bearers Response message.

q_44240.question: When should a MS not consider PLMNs which do not advertise support of EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection or EPS services with control plane CIoT EPS optimization?
q_44240.ground_truth: If the MS only supports EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection or control plane CIoT EPS optimization and is camping on a cell which does not support these features, the MS should not consider PLMNs which do not advertise support for these features.

q_44241.question: What is the condition that needs to be met in order to increase the confidence level of successful tests to 95%?
q_44241.ground_truth: The condition to increase the confidence level of successful tests to 95% is that the total number of successful tests should be more than 90% of the cases.

q_44242.question: What action can an AMF take if a UE requests a S-NSSAI that is subject to insufficient network capacity for maximum number of UEs?
q_44242.ground_truth: The AMF can either include the S-NSSAI in the Partially Allowed NSSAI or reject it partially in the Registration Area (RA), depending on the local policy.

q_44243.question: In the test procedure for measuring the average throughput, what is the purpose of the CW signal generator with interfering signals?
q_44243.ground_truth: The CW signal generator is used to ensure that the test procedure is performed in the presence of interfering signals. This is done to ensure that the throughput measurement is robust and accurate.

q_44244.question: How does the PC5 link get established when there is one Source UE and multiple Target UEs?
q_44244.ground_truth: The PC5 link between Source UE and UE-to-UE Relay can be shared for multiple Target UEs while the PC5 link is established individually between UE-to-UE Relay and Target UEs for the shared PC5 link.

q_44245.question: When does the P-GW send an Accounting Request (Interim) to the Diameter server?
q_44245.ground_truth: Upon occurrence of a chargeable event such as RAT change, S-GW address change, QoS change, or IPv4 address allocation/release/re-allocation for deferred IPv4 addressing.

q_44246.question: What is the requirement for the SS to switch the power setting from T2 to T3?
q_44246.ground_truth: The SS shall switch the power setting from T2 to T3 after the SS receives the MeasurementReport message in step 8) or when T2 expires.

q_44247.question: What is the purpose of the maximumInterval field in the AreaEventReporting sequence?
q_44247.ground_truth: The maximumInterval field in the AreaEventReporting sequence specifies the maximum time interval between consecutive event reports, in seconds.

q_44248.question: What information does the "NCGI" attribute in an <app-specific-info> element provide?
q_44248.ground_truth: The "NCGI" attribute in an <app-specific-info> element indicates the NG-RAN Cell Global Identification of the NG-RAN cell where the UE was camping on or which the UE used in the 5GMM-CONNECTED mode when relaying the data.

q_44249.question: What is the penalty for not fulfilling the overall delays measured requirement in Test 1 and Test 2 of 5.6.2.3.5-1?
q_44249.ground_truth: If the UE fails to report the event within the overall delays measured requirement, the number of failure tests is increased by one.

q_44250.question: What security features should be transparent to the user or application?
q_44250.ground_truth: The security features such as AS confidentiality, AS integrity, NAS confidentiality, and NAS integrity should be transparent to the user or application.

q_44251.question: What is the message type that the SMF or SMF+PGW-C sends to the UPF or UPF+PGW-U if any existing L2TP tunnel cannot be used to serve the PDU Session?

q_44252.question: What is the method used to resist replay attacks in this solution?
q_44252.ground_truth: The way to resist replay attack is by adding a nonce in the uplink message, which is used as an input for the MAC calculation.

q_44253.question: When should the measurement logging be suspended due to IDC problems?
q_44253.ground_truth: If the UE detected IDC problems during the last logging interval and the measResultServCell in VarLogMeasReport is not empty.

q_44254.question: What is not forwarded during handover by the eNB for RLC-UM bearers?
q_44254.ground_truth: The eNB does not forward the downlink and uplink RLC context upon handover for RLC-UM bearers.

q_44255.question: What should be the SS's action upon successful decoding of uplink power during time duration T5?
q_44255.ground_truth: The number of successful tests should be increased by one.

q_44256.question: Which network function handles the network related actions required for dynamic 5G ProSe Direct Discovery?
q_44256.ground_truth: The 5G DDNMF is a network function that handles the network related actions required for dynamic 5G ProSe Direct Discovery.

q_44257.question: What the message store function does after receiving an HTTP request to move objects and/or folders from the client?
q_44257.ground_truth: After receiving a POST request from the client, the message store function acting as an HTTP server validates the MCData access token in the request, processes the HTTP POST request by moving objects and/or folders, and generates and sends an HTTP response towards the client indicating the result of the operation.

q_44258.question: In what circumstances, should the LCG be mapped for IAB nodes between the ingress and egress links for Pre-emptive BSR?
q_44258.ground_truth: The LCG mapping between the ingress and egress links of an IAB node for purposes of determining expected change in occupancy of IAB-MT buffers (to be reported as Pre-emptive BSR) is left to implementation.

q_44259.question: What is the usage of the "Mean number of RRC Connections" measurement?
q_44259.ground_truth: The measurement of "Mean number of RRC Connections" is used for monitoring the number of RRC connections in connected mode during the granularity period.

q_44260.question: What is the requirement for PRS resources in the measurement period requirements for NR-Multi-RTT-ProvideAssistanceData and NR-Multi-RTT-RequestLocationInformation messages in 3GPP 5G NR physical layer in order to be measured during a certain time span?
q_44260.ground_truth: The time span of the PRS resource instance in the measurement period requirements for NR-Multi-RTT-ProvideAssistanceData and NR-Multi-RTT-RequestLocationInformation messages in 3GPP 5G NR physical layer should not be greater than the UE reported capability N.

q_44261.question: Which type of NR UEs does the test described in section 7.6.15.2.3 apply to?
q_44261.ground_truth: The test described in section 7.6.15.2.3 applies to all types of NR UEs supporting concurrent gap capability from release 17 onwards.

q_44262.question: What should the UE do if the source E-UTRAN/UTRAN decides to terminate the handover procedure before its completion and the UE is in the pre-alerting state with a SRVCC procedure started?
q_44262.ground_truth: The UE should start a recovery procedure, transmit a SIP UPDATE message and attempt to return to E-UTRAN/UTRAN by sending a re-INVITE towards IMS for the related session.

q_44263.question: What should the P-CSCF do if it receives a 2xx response for a BYE request matching an existing dialog?
q_44263.ground_truth: The P-CSCF shall delete all the stored information related to the dialog.

q_44264.question: After the UE sends an ATTACH ACCEPT message, what action does the MME take related to the TAI list?
q_44264.ground_truth: The MME sends the ATTACH ACCEPT message together with an ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message contained in the ESM message container information element, which includes the TAI list the UE is registered to.

q_44265.question: Which type of UEs does the inter-frequency RRC re-establishment delay test apply to, starting from Release 17?
q_44265.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of NR RedCap UEs from Release 17 onwards.

q_44266.question: How should the SC UE handle a SM NOTIFICATION message containing an "SRVCC handover cancelled, IMS session re-establishment required" during the pre-test conditions of 13.4.3.22.3?
q_44266.ground_truth: If the SC UE receives a SM NOTIFICATION message containing an "SRVCC handover cancelled, IMS session re-establishment required" during the pre-test conditions of 13.4.3.22.3, it should send a SIP UPDATE request containing an SDP offer and a Reason header field with protocol "SIP" and reason parameter "cause" with value "487" as specified in IETF RFC 3326.

q_44267.question: In subclause 5.6.1.1 b), for location services message, what should the UE set in the Payload container type IE of the CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message?
q_44267.ground_truth: The UE should set the Payload container type IE to "Location services message container".

q_44268.question: What is required for the V2X Application Server to know which MBS session(s) are serving the target MBS service area to forward V2X messages?
q_44268.ground_truth: The V2X Application Server obtains the UE location information, such as geographic location or Cell ID, to determine the MBS service area and derive MBS session information.

q_44269.question: What message status code does the DCCF respond with when it successfully sends analytics data to all notification endpoints?

q_44270.question: What should be the value of the Request-URI of the SIP INVITE request for a one-to-one standalone SDS message?
q_44270.ground_truth: The value of the Request-URI of the SIP INVITE request for a one-to-one standalone SDS message should be set to the public service identity identifying the participating MCData function serving the MCData user.

q_44271.question: What must the UE do if it does not receive a response from the LMF after a predefined time in step 26?
q_44271.ground_truth: The UE may re-send the report one or more times. If the UE sends the repeated event report more than the predefined maximum resending time and the UE still does not receive any response from AMF, the UE shall stop resending the report and reserve the event report, then record a corresponding flag to indicate that a report has been sent unsuccessfully.

q_44272.question: In the provided format for MobilityRestrictionList, what does ENUMERATED mean in the context?
q_44272.ground_truth: Enumerated is a type definition that defines a list of possible enumerations for a field to take.

q_44273.question: When the SS starts T3 timer, how long until the SS shall start transmitting the RRCConnectionRelease message to release the RRC connection, as defined in step 10)?
q_44273.ground_truth: The SS shall start transmitting the RRCConnectionRelease message to release the RRC connection 170 ms after starting T3.

q_44274.question: What SIP URI parameter and its values should be included in the REFER request for roaming II-NNI?
q_44274.ground_truth: The "method" SIP URI parameter should be set to "BYE", "INVITE", or not present.

q_44275.question: What message does the IRI-POI in the MME generate when it detects that the MME considers a service request procedure by the target UE to be completed successfully?

q_44276.question: What is the PDU Session ID length?
q_44276.ground_truth: The length of a PDUSessionID is 8 bits.

q_44277.question: What is the maximum autonomous time adjustment step Tq used for in setting the test requirements and tolerances?
q_44277.ground_truth: The maximum autonomous time adjustment step Tq is used for setting the test requirements and tolerances for the UE transmit timing accuracy.

q_44278.question: What is the requirement for SEALDD discovery using EEL?
q_44278.ground_truth: The requirement for SEALDD discovery using EEL is an enhanced EAS profile with seamless transport service continuity capability during EAS registration procedure, which supports TCP/TLS/QUIC context transfer.

q_44279.question: What action should the S-CSCF take when it receives a REGISTER request with a registration expiration interval value of zero and a "sos" SIP URI parameter in the Contact header field?
q_44279.ground_truth: The S-CSCF shall reject the REGISTER request by sending a 501 (Not Implemented) response.

q_44280.question: What should the UE do if the additionalPmax is not present in the same entry of the selected additionalSpectrumEmission within NS-PmaxList, and the frequency band is selected from freqBandIndicator or multiBandInfoList?
q_44280.ground_truth: The UE should apply the p-Max.

q_44281.question: Under which conditions should the source eNB initiate the Handover Cancel procedure if the Security Result IE is not included in the Target eNB to Source eNB Transparent Container IE of the HANDOVER COMMAND message?
q_44281.ground_truth: The source eNB should initiate the Handover Cancel procedure if the Security Indication IE in the Source eNB to Target eNB Transparent Container IE indicated that some of the E-RABs required User Plane Integrity Protection but the Security Result IE is not included in the Target eNB to Source eNB Transparent Container IE of the HANDOVER COMMAND message.

q_44282.question: What should a participating MCVideo function do if the binding between the MCVideo ID and public user identity does not exist for a terminating SIP INVITE request?
q_44282.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function should reject the SIP INVITE request with a SIP 404 (Not Found) response.

q_44283.question: What is the procedure that normal attached UEs follow to receive emergency bearer services?
q_44283.ground_truth: Normal attached UEs initiate the UE Requested PDN Connectivity procedure to receive emergency bearer services.

q_44284.question: How should the media-level b=AS bandwidth be aligned with the MBR of the bearer for several media streams?
q_44284.ground_truth: If a bearer carries several media streams, then it is the sum of the media-level b=AS bandwidths for those media streams that should be aligned with the MBR of the bearer.

q_44285.question: What is the responsibility of the SMF in 5G architecture?
q_44285.ground_truth: The SMF is responsible for the enforcement of session management related policy decisions from the PCF, such as service flow detection, QoS, charging, gating, traffic usage reporting, traffic steering, and access traffic steering, switching and splitting within a MA PDU Session.

q_44286.question: What is the purpose of the Capability Transfer procedure in SLPP?
q_44286.ground_truth: The Capability Transfer procedure in SLPP enables the transfer of positioning and protocol capabilities related to SLPP and the positioning methods supported by it, from Endpoint A to Endpoint B.

q_44287.question: What measures should be taken when measured throughput in downlink is assessed during immunity tests?
q_44287.ground_truth: The output of the transmitter should be connected to equipment meeting the requirements for throughput assessment. The signal supplied to the equipment should be within the range for which the assessment of throughput is not impaired, and power control should be off during immunity testing.

q_44288.question: In what mode is the UE when it has user data pending over non-3GPP access and is in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode over non-3GPP access?
q_44288.ground_truth: The UE is in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode over non-3GPP access.

q_44289.question: When performing a DCI-based BWP switch on a single CC, what is the maximum time duration before a UE can transmit or receive DL/UL signals after the BWP switch occurs?
q_44289.ground_truth: The UE is not required to transmit UL signals or receive DL signals until the first DL or UL slot occurs right after a time duration of TBWPswitchDelay which starts from the beginning of DL slot n except DCI-based BWP switch triggering on the cell where DCI-based BWP switch occurs.

q_44290.question: What is the length of the E-UTRAN/Satellite E-UTRAN Cell Identifier (ECI) for Satellite E-UTRAN?
q_44290.ground_truth: ECI has a length of 28 bits for Satellite E-UTRAN.

q_44291.question: What should be ensured before measuring the packet generation and treatment for MTSI-based speech with LTE, NR, or WLAN access?
q_44291.ground_truth: The clock skew between the UE and the reference client should be compensated by adjusting the clock of the reference client to match the clock of the UE, with an inaccuracy of less than 1ppm. Also, the packet generation by the reference client and the packet treatment of the test equipment should be free of jitter.

q_44292.question: What action should the UE take if the TFT operation is an operation other than "Create new TFT" and there are semantic errors in TFT operations?
q_44292.ground_truth: The UE shall initiate a PDU session modification procedure by sending a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message to delete the mapped EPS bearer context with 5GSM cause #41 "semantic error in the TFT operation".

q_44293.question: What should the transmission participant do when timer T102 (Transmission Queue Position Request) expires less than the upper limit of C102 (Queue Position Request) times?
q_44293.ground_truth: The transmission participant should send a Queue Position Request message towards the transmission control server, restart timer T102 and increment counter C102 by 1, and remain in the 'U: queued transmission' state.

q_44294.question: What is the frame rate that is considered sufficient for sending one XR Viewer Pose in alignment with the rendered video?
q_44294.ground_truth: A frame rate of 60fps (frames per second) is considered sufficient for sending one XR Viewer Pose in alignment with the rendered video.

q_44295.question: What is the value of the "user-profile-document" in 3GPP TS 24.484 if a user wants to include application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-location-info+xml MIME body with a <Report> element in the location-info root element?
q_44295.ground_truth: The value of the "user-profile-document" in 3GPP TS 24.484 should be set to "true" for this scenario.

q_44296.question: What is the size of the HARQ process number field?
q_44296.ground_truth: The size of the HARQ process number field is 5 bits if determined by harq-ProcessNumberSizeDCI-0-2-v1700, or 0, 1, 2, 3, or 4 bits if determined by harq-ProcessNumberSizeDCI-0-2.

q_44297.question: In what frequency range is the maximum value of additional TIB,c applied when determining the applicable additional TIB,c?
q_44297.ground_truth: When the operating band frequency range is greater than 1 GHz, the maximum value of additional TIB,c for all applicable operating bands is applied.

q_44298.question: What is the purpose of the ATSSS-LL functionality in the UE and UPF?
q_44298.ground_truth: The ATSSS-LL functionality is a data switching function that decides how to steer, switch and split the uplink traffic across 3GPP and non-3GPP accesses in the UE. In the UPF, the ATSSS-LL functionalityis enabled for a MA PDU Session by an ATSSS-LL functionality indication in the Multi-Access Rules (MAR). The ATSSS-LL functionality is mandatory for specific cases as detailed in the answer.

q_44299.question: What is the purpose of the HTTP GET method for the "DAA Policies" resource?
q_44299.ground_truth: The HTTP GET method for the "DAA Policies" resource allows a service consumer to retrieve all the active DAA Policies managed by the UAE Server.

q_44300.question: What message does the NSSAAF send directly to the NSS-AAA or via the AAA-P for network slice specific authentication and authorization?
q_44300.ground_truth: The NSSAAF sends a Diameter DER message.

q_44301.question: When should an authorized Resource-Priority header field be included in the SIP INVITE request?
q_44301.ground_truth: When vSRVCC with priority handling is supported and an Allocation/Retention priority (ARP) indication is received.

q_44302.question: What is required for UEs supporting Tx diversity when measuring transmit power?
q_44302.ground_truth: For UEs supporting Tx diversity, the transmit power is measured as the sum of the output power from both UE antenna connectors.

q_44303.question: What should be the input power distribution among the active DL CCs in order to meet the in-band blocking requirement for inter-band carrier aggregation with one component carrier per operating band and the uplink assigned to one NR band?
q_44303.ground_truth: The input power should be distributed among the active DL CCs so their PSDs are aligned with each other.

q_44304.question: What is the minimum requirement for connectors under test in 7.4.2.4.2 Procedure for general blocking?
q_44304.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for connectors under test in 7.4.2.4.2 Procedure for general blocking is applied to all connectors under test.

q_44305.question: What field in Format 6-0B is used for 4 HARQ-ACK indications by bitmap, with the order of the bitmap to HARQ process index mapping in ascending order from MSB to LSB?
q_44305.ground_truth: The 4 LSB bits of the Scheduling TBs for Unicast Field

q_44306.question: What should the UE do if it has a single voice media stream over the PS domain that is handed over to the CS domain via SRVCC, and the call control entity in "null" state receives an indication "MM connection establishment due to SRVCC handover" and the voice media stream is associated with a mobile originated session in the "early" state?
q_44306.ground_truth: The call control entity of the MS shall enter the "call delivered" state for this transaction. The MS and the network shall locally set the TI value of the call to "000" and the TI flag value as in mobile terminated call.

q_44307.question: What are the required elements within the <anyExt> element of an MSR request?
q_44307.ground_truth: The required elements within the <anyExt> element of an MSR request are MCDataContentServerURI and MessageStoreHostname.

q_44308.question: When should the UE ignore the "Extended wait time CP data" from the lower layers?
q_44308.ground_truth: The UE should ignore the "Extended wait time CP data" from the lower layers if it is not operating in NB-S1 mode or if it does not support timer T3448.

q_44309.question: What must an MTSI client do in response to a CVO being offered to be sent in SDP?
q_44309.ground_truth: An MTSI client supporting CVO shall respond to receive CVO when CVO is offered to be sent in SDP, by including exactly one of the offered extmap attributes.

q_44310.question: What is used in Option 3 to identify the importance/dependency relationship between different PDU sets in a PDU sets group?
q_44310.ground_truth: The media application (i.e. AF) may provide/update to 5GS importance/dependency information of PDU sets in the form of group size (i.e. number of PDU set), indication of starting/ending PDU set of a group of PDU sets, and importance/dependency information of the PDU set with respects to the position/order of PDU set in the group of PDU sets.

q_44311.question: If DL positioning or RAT independent positioning is indicated in step~1, what is included in the RRC Resume Request with small data transmission (SDT) sent by the UE to the receiving gNB node in the NG-RAN at step~7 for location reporting?
q_44311.ground_truth: The RRC Resume Request with small data transmission (SDT) sent by the UE to the receiving gNB node in the NG-RAN at step~7 for location reporting includes an RRC UL Information Transfer message containing an UL NAS TRANSPORT message that includes a supplementary services event report message. If DL positioning or RAT independent positioning is indicated, the UE includes an LPP positioning message in the supplementary services event report message that includes the location measurements or location estimate obtained at step~4.

q_44312.question: What is the significance of GTP-U Echo Request/Response messages in QoS monitoring for a QoS Flow?
q_44312.ground_truth: GTP-U Echo Request/Response messages are used in the corresponding user plane transport path(s) to perform packet delay measurement for a QoS Flow, independent of the corresponding PDU Session and 5QI.

q_44313.question: What should the IWF floor participant do if it negotiated pre-emptive priority in the MCPTT call initialization?
q_44313.ground_truth: If the IWF floor participant is authorized for pre-emptive priority in the MCPTT call, it should always request permission to send RTP media packets at a priority level that is lower than pre-emptive priority.

q_44314.question: Which 2 channels are characterized by the fixed pre-defined transport format in downlink transport channel types?
q_44314.ground_truth: Broadcast Channel (BCH) and Sidelink broadcast channel (SL-BCH)

q_44315.question: What is the role of AMF in managing TNL associations in a 5G-AN node?
q_44315.ground_truth: The AMF provides the 5G-AN node with weight factors for each TNL association of the AMF, and can request to add or remove TNL associations to the AMF. The AMF also indicates the set of TNL associations used for UE-associated and non-UE associated signalling.

q_44316.question: What procedure should the MCPTT client comply with if this is an authorised request for an MCPTT emergency private call as determined in step 6.2.8.3.1.1?
q_44316.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should comply with the procedures in clause 6.2.8.3.2 if this is an authorised request for an MCPTT emergency private call as determined by the procedures of clause 6.2.8.3.1.1.

q_44317.question: What does the UDR do after it informs the NEF about the result of the operation in step~3b?
q_44317.ground_truth: The UDR stores, updates, or removes the policy data of step~3a in the UDR, having translated any External Group Identifier to an Internal Group Identifier and any GPSI to a SUPI.

q_44318.question: What is the measurement window where the sum of the power measured in theta and phi polarization is 99% of the "Total EIRP"?
q_44318.ground_truth: The measurement window is identified as the one whose center is aligned on the center of the channel for which the sum of the power measured in theta and phi polarization is 99% of the "Total EIRP".

q_44319.question: What must the UE do in addition, if it has initiated resource release for all the traffic flows for the bearer and deactivated the EPS bearer context locally without peer-to-peer signalling between the UE and the MME while on the first expiry of the timer T3481?
q_44319.ground_truth: The UE must send a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message that includes the EPS bearer context status IE to the MME to synchronize the EPS bearer context status with the MME.

q_44320.question: What is the purpose of using IPv6 multi-homing for a PDU Session?
q_44320.ground_truth: The purpose of using IPv6 multi-homing for a PDU Session is to provide access to the Data Network via more than one PDU Session Anchor, allowing for traffic routing and merging to the UE.

q_44321.question: What happens after the MCPTT client and the IWF release all the media plane resources used for the private call?
q_44321.ground_truth: If the private call was established with floor control, floor control resources are released and the MCPTT client cannot make further requests for floor control or send media.

q_44322.question: When will a UE initiate the transmission of the MBMSInterestIndication message if SystemInformationBlockType20 is broadcast by the PCell?
q_44322.ground_truth: A UE should initiate the transmission of the MBMSInterestIndication message if since the last time the UE transmitted an MBMSInterestIndication message, the UE connected to a PCell not broadcasting SystemInformationBlockType20, or if the set of MBMS services of interest determined in accordance with 5.8.5.3a is different from mbms-Services included in the last transmission of the MBMSInterestIndication message.

q_44323.question: What function does the eNodeB use to distribute UEs entering or being re-directed to an appropriate DCN?
q_44323.ground_truth: The DCN Load Balancing functionality permits UEs to be distributed in a manner that achieves load balancing between the CN nodes of the same DCN.

q_44324.question: What should the SS look for in subframes (m+5), (m+9), and (m+13) and (m+18) up to the end of T2 for inter-band CA UE in step 8a?

q_44325.question: What three quality numbers are measured in the electrical interface UE measurement?
q_44325.ground_truth: The three quality numbers measured in the electrical interface UE measurement are N-MOS-LQOw, S-MOS-LQOw, and G-MOS-LQOw.

q_44326.question: Which subclause of the IOC uses the data type "V2X communication mode" in GSMA NG.116?
q_44326.ground_truth: The subclause 6.5 of the IOC using the data type "V2X communication mode" in GSMA NG.116 is 6.3.16.

q_44327.question: What is the difference between the resource selection window and the contiguous partial sensing window in the context of resource (re)selection in a UE?
q_44327.ground_truth: The resource selection window is the time interval within which the UE performs the resource (re)selection, while the contiguous partial sensing (CPS) window is the time interval within which the UE senses the channel to detect other UEs' transmissions before performing resource (re)selection. The CPS window is a subset of the resource selection window.

q_44328.question: What is the function of the AAR command for the Gmb interface?
q_44328.ground_truth: The AAR command is used for user authorization, modifying an MBMS UE Context in the BM-SC, or registering the GGSN for a multicast MBMS bearer service. It can also be used to activate a Trace Session in the BM-SC.

q_44329.question: What happens to an IMS session if the AF does not provide an emergency indication to the PCRF when establishing a session via the emergency PDN connection?
q_44329.ground_truth: The PCRF rejects the IMS session.

q_44330.question: How can the priority of a network slice be dynamically changed for a UE per application?
q_44330.ground_truth: The 5G system must support mechanisms to allow a 3rd party and the 5G network to negotiate the UE priority of a network slice per application, and support changing the UE priority of network slices per application with minimized interruption.

q_44331.question: What is the method for protecting sensitive application signaling parameters in a one-from-server video pull communication?
q_44331.ground_truth: Sensitive application signaling parameters in a one-from-server video pull communication are protected by encrypting the PCK to the identity of the MCVideo server.

q_44332.question: What should a participating MCVideo function do upon receiving a SIP INVITE request containing an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body with the <session-type> element set to a value of "one-to-one video push", for originating participating MCVideo function?
q_44332.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function should perform the procedures as specified in clause~10.2.2.3.1.1.

q_44333.question: What is an XR Spatial Compute pipeline used for in the context of AR/MR?
q_44333.ground_truth: An XR Spatial Compute pipeline is used for setting up spatial compute downlink and uplink delivery sessions for spatial description related data. This allows for the exchange of spatial compute information between the AR Runtime and the media delivery function.

q_44334.question: What is the role of the NAS message container in the Registration Request message?
q_44334.ground_truth: The NAS message container is used to send non-cleartext IEs in the Registration Request message if the UE has a valid 5G NAS security context.

q_44335.question: In what scenarios are APN rate control and Small Data Rate Control applied?
q_44335.ground_truth: APN rate control is applied in EPS for UE's PDN connections for a given APN, and Small Data Rate Control is applied in 5GS for a PDU session.

q_44336.question: What is the purpose of the FulfilmentInfo attributes?
q_44336.ground_truth: The FulfilmentInfo attributes provide information about the fulfilment of an intent, including the status of fulfilment and the related reasons for an infeasible status.

q_44337.question: What should the network do when it decides to activate congestion control for transport of user data via the control plane?
q_44337.ground_truth: The network may include a value for the control plane data back-off timer T3448 in REGISTRATION ACCEPT, SERVICE ACCEPT or SERVICE REJECT message, and shall store an control plane data back-off time on a per UE basis. The UE starts the timer T3448 with the value informed in the message.

q_44338.question: Which specification provides the test environment for 3GPP TS 36.521-2 testing?
q_44338.ground_truth: 3GPP TS 36.508 provides the common test environment for 3GPP TS 36.521-2 testing.

q_44339.question: What is the effect of changing IMS voice over PS session indicator from supported to unsupported on ongoing IMS sessions?
q_44339.ground_truth: It will not impact the ongoing IMS sessions; any changes apply only to new IMS sessions initiated after the ongoing IMS session is terminated.

q_44340.question: What is the "Service Parameter" that denotes a collocated Release 8 GGSN function on a PGW in the S-NAPTR procedure?

q_44341.question: What is the maximum allowed total handover delay in the E-UTRAN TDD-FDD inter frequency handover test case?
q_44341.ground_truth: The handover delay Dhandover shall be less than a total of 50 ms

q_44342.question: What is the primary focus of RAN4's framework for evaluating ACS and ASCS with guard RBs?
q_44342.ground_truth: The primary focus of RAN4's framework is on evaluating required guard RBs instead of ACS requirements, and it adopts two approaches: filter suppression level analysis and link level simulation.

q_44343.question: What should the UE do when it receives an extended value that is not defined in the version of the transfer syntax supported by the UE, as specified in 8.1.2.15.2 of the document?
q_44343.ground_truth: The UE should consider the value as not comprehended and treat the message as if the field were absent, and establish an RRC connection.

q_44344.question: Under what condition is the UE allowed to initiate Bearer Resource Modification procedure to report 3GPP PS Data Off status change while the EPS Session Management back off timer is running?
q_44344.ground_truth: When there is a change in the 3GPP PS Data Off status, the UE is allowed to initiate the Bearer Resource Modification procedure to report this status change, even if the Session Management back-off timer is currently running.

q_44345.question: What is the purpose of the Extended versions of the BSR formats used for reporting in uplink?
q_44345.ground_truth: The Extended versions of the BSR formats can only be used by IAB nodes for reporting uplink buffer status.

q_44346.question: What should the source eNB include in the HANDOVER REQUIRED message if the SRVCC operation is needed?
q_44346.ground_truth: The source eNB shall include the SRVCC HO Indication IE in the HANDOVER REQUIRED message if the SRVCC operation is needed, indicating if the handover shall be prepared for PS and CS domain or only for CS domain.

q_44347.question: Which information about the user location must the SMF provide within the "userLocationInfoTime" attribute?
q_44347.ground_truth: The SMF derives the value of the "userLocationInfoTime" attribute from the age of location information received in the Location-Report from the AMF.

q_44348.question: What algorithm is used to convert the application layer group ID into a destination layer-2 ID for PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message monitoring?
q_44348.ground_truth: The SHA-256 hashing algorithm is used to convert the application layer group ID into a destination layer-2 ID for PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message monitoring.

q_44349.question: Which two IDs are mandatory in the AccessSuccessIEs F1AP-Protocol-IES?
q_44349.ground_truth: id-gNB-CU-UE-F1AP-ID and id-gNB-DU-UE-F1AP-ID are the two IDs that are mandatory in the AccessSuccessIEs F1AP-Protocol-IES.

q_44350.question: What is the effect of using a high Q-value RF subband filter on the receiver architecture in gNB radio units?
q_44350.ground_truth: Using a high Q-value RF subband filter on the receiver architecture in gNB radio units can provide a certain suppression to filter out interference signals over DL subband(s), but it may also require the use of additional insertion losses which can negatively affect the link budget.

q_44351.question: When the UE is in either Camped Normally state or Camped on Any Cell state, what process allows the UE to limit its measurement activity?
q_44351.ground_truth: The cell re-selection evaluation process allows the UE to limit its measurement activity when the UE is in either Camped Normally state or Camped on Any Cell state on a cell.

q_44352.question: In the EPC network, what node allows interworking between non-3GPP access and 3GPP network, and includes an IRI-POI and a CC-POI for LI capabilities?

q_44353.question: What is the normative reference for the requirement of the event triggered measurement reporting delay for a UE category 0 in LTE?
q_44353.ground_truth: The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clauses 8.5.2.1.1.2 and A.8.1.13.

q_44354.question: What does a base station's maximum output power represent in the 3GPP's technical specifications?
q_44354.ground_truth: A base station's maximum output power represents the mean power level per carrier of the base station measured at the antenna connector in a specified reference condition.

q_44355.question: What is the role of the Service Operation Point in the 5GMS System?
q_44355.ground_truth: The Service Operation Point is an abstract set of requirements that supports a media streaming service and is identified by an external reference. It is embodied in the 5G System by a Policy Template, which carries the external reference and network QoS parameters corresponding to a single Service Operation Point.

q_44356.question: What should the SMF do if it determines that the PDU session is a redundant one?
q_44356.ground_truth: Upon receiving the indication from the PCF that the PDU session is a redundant PDU session, the SMF shall apply the corresponding procedures towards the access network and the UPF for the establishment of the redundant user plane paths as defined in clause~5.33.2.1 of 3GPP TS 23.501.

q_44357.question: What is the value range for the "tMbmsSaIdentityFormat" type?
q_44357.ground_truth: The value range for the "tMbmsSaIdentityFormat" type is from 0 to 65535, inclusive.

q_44358.question: What procedures need to be followed in case of handover delay for UE category M1 in enhanced coverage?
q_44358.ground_truth: The procedures to be followed in case of handover delay for UE category M1 in enhanced coverage are specified in TS~36.331. Refer to clause 5.1.2.1.1 for more details.

q_44359.question: How are the measurement results modified before being compared to the test requirements?
q_44359.ground_truth: The measurement results are not modified before being compared.

q_44360.question: Which 5G ProSe Direct Communication mode supports broadcast, groupcast, and unicast over the NR-based PC5 reference point?
q_44360.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe Direct Communication over NR-based PC5 reference point supports broadcast, groupcast, and unicast modes.

q_44361.question: What is a PSS client and a PSS server as per the given document?
q_44361.ground_truth: A PSS client is a client for the 3GPP packet switched streaming service based on IETF RTSP/SDP and/or HTTP standards. A PSS server is a server for the 3GPP packet switched streaming service based on IETF RTSP/SDP and/or HTTP standards.

q_44362.question: What information can be associated with the Target UE identifier?
q_44362.ground_truth: The Target UE identifier can be associated with a specific UE, a group of UEs, any UE of the PLMN of the NEF, or the PLMN IDs of inbound roamers that the AF request.

q_44363.question: What is the reason for reusing and enhancing the existing periodic or triggered MT-LR procedure for sidelink positioning/ranging?
q_44363.ground_truth: The reason for reusing and enhancing the existing periodic or triggered MT-LR procedure for sidelink positioning/ranging is to reduce new impacts to UEs, 5GCN, and LCS Client and AF.

q_44364.question: When is the scheduled data method applied for RLC tests?
q_44364.ground_truth: The scheduled data method is applied for RLC tests when there is a requirement of receiving multiple UL RLC SDUs, time measurement on looped back RLC SDUs, and sending DL RLC PDUs on consecutive TTIs.

q_44365.question: What refers to information related to the network slice in the context of Network Slice?
q_44365.ground_truth: Network Slice refers to information relating to the network slice instance associated to the S-NSSAI and NSI ID if available, as defined in TS28.541.

q_44366.question: What should a mobile station do to determine if access is allowed or not, for each access to the network?
q_44366.ground_truth: For each access to the network, the mobile station shall determine from the information received via the system information broadcast whether access is allowed or not by evaluating the control information for common access control, domain specific access control, EAB, and specific control information for paging response or location registration.

q_44367.question: What is the difference between the NSSAA application selection and initialisation procedures?
q_44367.ground_truth: NSSAA application selection is the process of selecting the corresponding NSSAA application using the SELECT by DF name command. NSSAA application initialisation, on the other hand, is the process of initialising the selected NSSAA application and preparing it for use in the NSSAA procedure. It includes the retrieval of the EAP Identifier, the supported S-NSSAI list, and the EAP authentication status.

q_44368.question: What must the AMF do when it cannot determine the new Allowed NSSAI for a UE?
q_44368.ground_truth: The AMF must not send any Allowed NSSAI to the UE and indicate to the UE to perform a Registration procedure.

q_44369.question: What is a potential roaming architecture for voice over IMS with local breakout session?
q_44369.ground_truth: A session can be identified as a potential roaming architecture for voice over IMS with local breakout session when a received initial INVITE request contains a Feature-Caps header field with a "+g.3gpp.trf" header field parameter, a "+g.3gpp.loopback" header field parameter or any other implementation dependent indication.

q_44370.question: Which term is used in the document to describe the largest distance between the UE who initiates the Ranging and target UEs in the Ranging operation?

q_44371.question: What must the UE with user interface do if it supports the ePWS language-independent content functionality and is capable of displaying text-based warning messages?
q_44371.ground_truth: It should be capable of displaying the entire warning message that it receives.

q_44372.question: What is the result of a successful PC5 link security establishment procedure over Control Plane?
q_44372.ground_truth: After the successful verification of the Direct Security Mode complete message, the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay stores the 5GPRUK ID in the security context associated to the PC5 link with the source UE and sends a Direct Communication Request message that contains Relay Service Code to the target UE to trigger the second hop PC5 link establishment.

q_44373.question: What is the advantage of using a high-Q value RF filter in the gNB radio unit?
q_44373.ground_truth: The advantage of using a high-Q value RF filter in the gNB radio unit is that it can provide enough attenuation towards high power level interference in the DL subband(s), not only for self-interference but also other co-channel interference sources from co-site inter-sector and inter-site gNBs.

q_44374.question: What is the role of the Network Data Analytics Function (NWDAF) in the 3GPP framework for AI/ML?
q_44374.ground_truth: NWDAF is a network functionality introduced in Rel-15 and enhanced in Rel-16 and Rel-17, which is studied for air-interface corresponding to each target use case regarding aspects such as performance, complexity, and potential specification impact.

q_44375.question: How does the network initiate the identification procedure in the 5G system?
q_44375.ground_truth: The network initiates the identification procedure by sending an IDENTITY REQUEST message to the UE and starting the timer T3470.

q_44376.question: What message is sent by the eNB to the WT to indicate that an initialisation in the WT is required and the corresponding references and resources have been released?

q_44377.question: Which parameter in the Sbi-Binding-Header header indicates the date-time type of the recovery timestamp of the entity?

q_44378.question: What can the PCF do to ensure the network slice data rate does not exceed the Maximum Slice Data Rate?
q_44378.ground_truth: Reject new SM Policy Associations, change the authorized Session-AMBR values, change the MBR values in PCC rules, or take other actions based on operator's policies

q_44379.question: What should be the lifetime of the Interconnection CA certificate to avoid cross-certification actions for renewal?
q_44379.ground_truth: The Interconnection CA certificate should have a longer lifetime than SEG CA or TLS CA certificates.

q_44380.question: What is a main challenge when using a phone as a relay for media content between the cloud and the AR glasses?
q_44380.ground_truth: The main challenge is the absence of a connection to the cloud/edge, which would result in no service being provided.

q_44381.question: What should a UE do upon inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode in 5GMM-IDLE mode?
q_44381.ground_truth: The UE must create a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message for each PDN connection it intends to transfer to 5GS, using the parameters from the default EPS bearer context of the PDN connection.

q_44382.question: What is the purpose of the PINMF sending a PEMC Event Notification?
q_44382.ground_truth: The PINMF sends a PEMC Event Notification when it requires the PEMC to make changes to the 5G-LAN, such as adding or removing PINs, or updating routing rules.

q_44383.question: In the context of service charging, what is the importance of identifying the rating groups for online and offline services?
q_44383.ground_truth: Identifying the rating groups for online and offline services is important in service charging to manage the quota for each service and provide a better user experience.

q_44384.question: What is the condition for the applicability of the minimum conformance requirements defined in clause 6.4D.2.4.3 for UL MIMO?

q_44385.question: What is the role of an MCData gateway server in a different trust domain?
q_44385.ground_truth: An MCData gateway server in a different trust domain acts as an application and security gateway, providing topology hiding, enforcing local policies and security, and serving as an exit point, entry point, or both for an MCData system.

q_44386.question: How is an ePDG FQDN constructed by the UE for selecting an ePDG in a certain PLMN-x?
q_44386.ground_truth: The UE constructs the ePDG FQDN in one of two ways: Operator Identifier FQDN or Tracking/Location Area Identity FQDN based on whether the UE attempts to select an ePDG in the registered PLMN and if the UE knows the TAI/LAI of the area it is located in. If the UE has this information, it constructs a Tracking/Location Area Identity FQDN; otherwise, it constructs the Operator Identifier FQDN.

q_44387.question: What shall the MCPTT client include in the P-Preferred-Service header field of the SIP INVITE request?
q_44387.ground_truth: The MCPTT client shall include the ICSI value "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcptt" in the P-Preferred-Service header field of the SIP INVITE request.

q_44388.question: What shall the UE do with CBS messages whose Message Identifier value range is "A000hex-AFFFhex" if they are not received from HPLMN, EHPLMN, or a PLMN equivalent to either of them?

q_44389.question: What should the UE do if both timers T302 and T303 are not running and the UE is establishing the RRC connection for mobile originating calls?
q_44389.ground_truth: The UE should draw a random number and start timer T303 with a calculated value using ac-BarringTime included in ac-BarringForMO-Data.

q_44390.question: What test purpose is fulfilled by the NR SA FR2 event-triggered reporting without gap in DRX test case?
q_44390.ground_truth: The NR SA FR2 event-triggered reporting without gap in DRX test case fulfills the purpose of verifying the UE's ability to make a correct reporting of an event within intra-frequency cell search without gap under DRX.

q_44391.question: What is the MINIMUM number of indexes in the "id-IndexesToReport-NR" definition?
q_44391.ground_truth: The MINIMUM number of indexes is 1.

q_44392.question: What is the purpose of standardizing service data structures and codings in the IMS Application Server (AS) service for 3GPP interoperability?
q_44392.ground_truth: The purpose is to facilitate interoperation among Application Servers supplied by the same or different vendors within a service provider's IMS network, especially for Multimedia Telephony supplementary services.

q_44393.question: What is the purpose of the Ranging/Sidelink Positioning control interaction procedure between the Target UE and Reference UE?
q_44393.ground_truth: The purpose is to exchange Ranging/Sidelink Positioning measurement results and provide them to the RSPP layer.

q_44394.question: What is the condition for a GSM cell to be considered as having a "verified" BSIC?
q_44394.ground_truth: A GSM cell is considered to have a "verified" BSIC if the UE (User Equipment) has decoded the SCH (Synchronization Channel) of the BCCH (Broadcast Common Control Channel) carrier and identified the BSIC at least one time.

q_44395.question: What should the UE do when it is triggered by an upper layer application to stop sidelink communication reception?
q_44395.ground_truth: The UE should transmit a SidelinkUEInformation message indicating it is no longer interested in sidelink communication reception.

q_44396.question: What is the measurement reporting delay defined for the 3GPP TS 38.133 specification?
q_44396.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay is defined as the time between an event that triggers a measurement report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface, excluding delays from other RRC signalling and inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH.

q_44397.question: What is the purpose of the PDU SESSION RESOURCE NOTIFY procedure in the context of already established QoS flow(s) or PDU session(s) for a given UE?
q_44397.ground_truth: The PDU SESSION RESOURCE NOTIFY procedure notifies that the already established QoS flow(s) or PDU session(s) for a given UE are released or not fulfilled anymore or fulfilled again by the NG-RAN node. It is also used to notify that the updated QoS parameters during the Path Switch Request procedure are not successfully accepted by the NG-RAN node.

q_44398.question: What does Octet 6 in the MPTCP Address Information IE represent in 3GPP TS 24.193?
q_44398.ground_truth: Octets 6 in the MPTCP Address Information IE represent the MPTCP Proxy Type.

q_44399.question: What should the MCData server do if the originating MCData ID is not authorized to modify the functional alias status of the served MCData ID?
q_44399.ground_truth: The MCData server should send a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response and not continue with the rest of the steps.

q_44400.question: What is the main purpose of the downlink E-CID (Equipment-assisted Cell-ID) Positioning Procedures in 3GPP 5G?
q_44400.ground_truth: The main purpose of the downlink E-CID Positioning Procedures in 3GPP 5G is to support the processing of E-CID related measurements obtained by UE and provided to LMF using LPP, which is a UE-assisted and LMF-based mechanism.

q_44401.question: What entity generates URSP rules based on VPLMN information in the solution described?
q_44401.ground_truth: The V-PCF generates URSP rules applicable to VPLMN and provides them to H-PCF for final decision.

q_44402.question: What happens when a better cell is found during cell reselection?
q_44402.ground_truth: The cell is selected and the change of cell may imply a change of RAT.

q_44403.question: What should the UE do if the TAI is present in the Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming" IE?
q_44403.ground_truth: The UE must stop registering its services in the forbidden tracking areas as per the conditions specified in the 3GPP TS 23.401.

q_44404.question: What action does the SCEF take upon successful service creation?
q_44404.ground_truth: The SCEF creates a resource which represents the service creation, addressed by a URI that contains the SCS identity and Service Id. It responds to the SCS/AS with a 201 Created message which may include the service announcement information.

q_44405.question: What interface is used for transmission and reception control messages that will change the state of the transmission between the transmission and reception control arbitration logic and the MCVideo client?
q_44405.ground_truth: The interface between the transmission and reception control interface towards the MCVideo client and the transmission request queue is used for this purpose.

q_44406.question: What should the PDN GW do if the Trust-Relationship-Update flag is set in the RAR Flags when initiating the authorization procedure in DSMIPv6?
q_44406.ground_truth: The PDN GW may send an authorization request with only mandatory AVPs.

q_44407.question: What is the role of the IMS AS in UE initiated P2A/A2P application data channel establishment?
q_44407.ground_truth: The IMS AS connects media to DCMF including information on how to relay data channel media and notifies the MediaControl instruction control response to DCSF.

q_44408.question: What action does UE B2 need to take before crossing location GC?
q_44408.ground_truth: UE B2 needs to prepare for the sudden loss of connectivity by terminating ongoing applications before crossing location GC.

q_44409.question: What is the function of the PDU Session Resource service in the NG-RAN architecture?
q_44409.ground_truth: The PDU Session Resource service is offered from SAP to SAP by the Access Stratum and provides the PDU Session Resource for user plane data transport between the UE and the network.

q_44410.question: What information does the "Announcing UE HPLMN Identifier" field contain?
q_44410.ground_truth: The "Announcing UE HPLMN Identifier" field contains the identifier of the UE's Home Public Land Mobile Network (MCC and MNC).

q_44411.question: What information does the W-AGF send to the AMF upon a successful context creation for the PDU session?
q_44411.ground_truth: The W-AGF sends a N2 Initial Context Setup Response message, which includes AN Tunnel Info, List of accepted QoS Flows, and List of rejected QoS Flows per PDU Session ID for PDU Sessions whose UP connections are activated.

q_44412.question: What is the difference in measurement units for the parameters used in event B1, event B2-1, and event B2-2?
q_44412.ground_truth: In event B1, Mn (measurement result) is in dBm or dB, Ofn (frequency offset) and Ocn (cell-specific offset) are in dB, and Hys (hysteresis) is in dB. For event B2-1, Mp (measurement result) is in dBm or dB, while Hys (hysteresis) and Thresh1 (threshold) are in the same unit as Mp. In event B2-2, Mn (measurement result) is in dBm or dB, Ofn (frequency offset) and Ocn (cell-specific offset) are in dB, and Hys (hysteresis) is in dB.

q_44413.question: What is the procedure for a UE to indicate support for Reflective QoS in a PDU Session established in EPS?
q_44413.ground_truth: The UE indicates Reflective QoS support using the PDU Session Establishment procedure.

q_44414.question: What is an example of a requirement for the intent driven MnS to enable energy saving?
q_44414.ground_truth: An example of a requirement is for the intent driven MnS to have the capability of allowing MnS consumer to express an intent containing an expectation on RAN energy saving for a specified area to MnS producer.

q_44415.question: When is the communication path switching between PC5 and Uu reference points performed?
q_44415.ground_truth: Communication path switching between PC5 and Uu reference points is performed at ProSe service level, e.g. for some or all ProSe services of PC5 unicast link or PDU Session. The UE takes the path selection policy into account to determine whether and for which ProSe service(s) to switch the communication path. The UE operation for the path switch for ProSe service includes evaluating the path selection policy in the policy and parameters for ProSe Direct Communication.

q_44416.question: What should the P-CSCF do when it receives any other response to the above request, prior to forwarding the request for a standalone transaction or a request for an unknown method?
q_44416.ground_truth: If the P-CSCF receives any other response to the above request, it should verify the list of Via header fields, rewrite the IP address and port number of its own Record-Route entry to the IP address and port number where it awaits subsequent requests from the calling party, and include an "icid-value" header field parameter, the "orig-ioi" header field parameter, and a type 1 "term-ioi" header field parameter that identifies the sending network in the P-Charging-Vector header field.

q_44417.question: In what circumstance should the MS consider itself to be attached for emergency bearer services only?
q_44417.ground_truth: The MS shall consider itself to be attached for emergency bearer services only if the network has failed the authentication check, the network has triggered an authentication check during an ongoing session management procedure, or timer T3318 or T3320 has expired during the establishment of a PDN connection for emergency bearer services.

q_44418.question: What should the system do if the group identity is associated with a TGI or the identity of a group regroup and there is no <mcptt-calling-group-id> element in the SIP INVITE request?
q_44418.ground_truth: The system should return a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response to the SIP INVITE request for controlling MCPTT function of an MCPTT group.

q_44419.question: What is the purpose of the VAL-UU reference point in the network slice architecture?
q_44419.ground_truth: The VAL-UU reference point supports interactions related to vertical application layer support functions between the VAL client and VAL server.

q_44420.question: What is the action taken by the SS after T1 expiry and no report is received or the received report did not contain the expected L1-SINR of both CSI-RS #0 and CSI-RS #1?
q_44420.ground_truth: The number of 'failed' iterations is increased by one.

q_44421.question: What is the purpose of the test in clause 6.7.5.4, step 3?
q_44421.ground_truth: The purpose of the test in clause 6.7.5.4, step 3 is to verify that the radiated spurious emissions from the IAB at the RIB are within the specified additional spurious emissions requirements.

q_44422.question: What should be the number of transmission layers when the PUSCH is limited to a single transmission layer?
q_44422.ground_truth: The PUSCH should be limited to a single transmission layer when pusch-DMRS-Bundling is enabled.

q_44423.question: In the context of sending a group standalone SDS message, what needs to be included in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body?
q_44423.ground_truth: The application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body must contain the <mcdatainfo> element with the <mcdata-Params> element, which must contain the request-type element set to a value of "group-sds", the mcdata-request-uri element set to the MCData group identity, and the mcdata-client-id element set to the MCData client ID of the originating MCData client.

q_44424.question: What is the default state of a newly created Policy Template resource in a 5GMS system?
q_44424.ground_truth: The default state of a newly created Policy Template resource in a 5GMS system is PENDING.

q_44425.question: What should the S4-SGSN do when it receives a MBMS Session Stop Request from a different MBMS GW than the MBMS GW that currently controls the MBMS session?
q_44425.ground_truth: The S4-SGSN should reject the request.

q_44426.question: What is the entry-info attribute value that allows initiating an MCVideo emergency private call if the "entry-info" attribute is set to a value of "LocallyDetermined"?
q_44426.ground_truth: If the "entry-info" attribute is set to a value of "LocallyDetermined", it allows initiating an MCVideo emergency private call regardless of the value of the <uri-entry> element of the <entry> element of the <MCVideoPrivateRecipient> element contained within the <EmergencyCall> element of the MCVideo user profile document.

q_44427.question: What action does the UE take when the NTN access and TN access selected by the UE belong to different PLMNs, and the UDM in the Home PLMN receives the UE location receiving from TN access?
q_44427.ground_truth: The AMF2 provides the UE location information in TN access to the UDM for preservation.

q_44428.question: What is the difference between the MCBearerContextSetupRequestIEs and MCBearerContextSetupResponseIEs sequences?
q_44428.ground_truth: The MCBearerContextSetupRequestIEs sequence contains definitions for the protocol IEs that can be included in a MC Bearer Context Setup Request message, while the MCBearerContextSetupResponseIEs sequence contains definitions for the protocol IEs that can be included in a MC Bearer Context Setup Response message.

q_44429.question: How is the modulation quality defined in 9.6.2.2.1?
q_44429.ground_truth: Modulation quality is defined by the difference between the measured carrier signal and an ideal signal, and can be expressed as Error Vector Magnitude (EVM).

q_44430.question: What should the DRA include in the Diameter reply if it uses the redirecting requests procedure for a PA2 solution?
q_44430.ground_truth: The DRA should include the PCRF identity in the Redirect-Host AVP in the Diameter reply sent to the PCEF or the BBERF for a PA2 solution.

q_44431.question: What charging framework requirement involves charging per S-NSSAI based on the "number of UEs" with an exemption for Emergency Registered UEs?

q_44432.question: What should the UE do if it needs to retrieve the last service access number during registration?
q_44432.ground_truth: The UE can find the requested service access number in the hi-entry within the History-Info header field having a hi-index that match the "mp" or "rc" header field parameter value of the last hi-entry containing a "cause" SIP URI parameter set to the value "380". If no "mp" or "rc" header field parameter is received in the concerned hi-entry, the service access number can be found in the hi-entry preceding the hi-entry with the "cause" SIP URI parameter set to "380".

q_44433.question: What must the <alert-ind> element in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body be set to if an alert indication is not contained or contains a value of "true" in the incoming SIP INVITE request, in order for the network to set the <alert-ind> element to "false"?
q_44433.ground_truth: The <alert-ind> element in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body must be set to "false" if an alert indication is not contained or contains a value of "true" in the incoming SIP INVITE request.

q_44434.question: What should the VAE server do when the service consumer sends a DELETE request to terminate the network resource reservation?
q_44434.ground_truth: The VAE server should check if the Individual Application Requirement resource exists, delete the resource if it exists, and respond to the service consumer with a 204 No Content success message.

q_44435.question: What is the default behavior of the S-CSCF when generating NOTIFY requests?
q_44435.ground_truth: The S-CSCF should include the state information of all registered public user identities of the user in every NOTIFY request.
