q_44436.question: How is the statistical pass/fail decisions made on this test case?
q_44436.ground_truth: The statistical pass/fail decisions are done separated for each event. For an event to pass, the total number of successful loops shall be more than 90% of the cases with a confidence level of 95%.

q_44437.question: Who needs to verify the input parameters in the access token request in the process of obtaining an access token for accessing services of a specific NF Service Producer instance?
q_44437.ground_truth: The NRF in the visited PLMN is responsible for verifying the input parameters in the access token request.

q_44438.question: Which bit in Octet 6 of the C-TAG IE contains the most significant bit of the PCP value?
q_44438.ground_truth: Bit 3 in Octet 6 of the C-TAG IE

q_44439.question: What must the TSN AF or TSCTSF do to ensure that all PTP ports in the DS-TT(s) and NW-TT distribute the same values of clockQuality information in Announce messages?
q_44439.ground_truth: The TSN AF or TSCTSF must use the elements in defaultDS in PMIC for the respective DS-TT(s) and in UMIC for NW-TT to ensure that all PTP ports in the DS-TT(s) and NW-TT distribute the same values of grandmasterPriority1, grandmasterClockQuality, grandmasterPriority2, grandmasterIdentity, and timeSource message fields in Announce messages.

q_44440.question: What is the minimum number of successful reported values required for the test to pass, as specified in 9.2.59.5?
q_44440.ground_truth: The minimum number of successful reported values required for the test to pass is 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

q_44441.question: In what scenarios can the PINE discover the PIN/PINE Service directly?
q_44441.ground_truth: If either PEMC or PEGC is available, the PINE can request the target PINE/PIN Service from PEMC directly or via PEGC.

q_44442.question: What techniques are used by the overload control enforcement NF to mitigate overload situations?
q_44442.ground_truth: The overload control enforcement NF can reduce the total number of request messages towards overloaded peers based on the received scope, use request message throttling to discard a fraction of the request messages in proportion to the overload level of the peer, and redirect some requests to an alternative NF if possible.

q_44443.question: What conditions apply to the application of multi-band requirements for an IAB-DU or IAB-MT type 1-H?
q_44443.ground_truth: Multi-band requirements apply when an operating band is supported only by multi-band connectors supporting the same operating band combination. However, if an operating band is supported by both multi-band and single-band connectors in a TAB connector TX min cell group or a TAB connector RX min cell group, this case is not covered in the present release of the specification.

q_44444.question: What should be done if the MCData user requests to cancel an in-progress emergency condition on a prearranged MCData group and the user is authorized to do so?
q_44444.ground_truth: The MCData client should include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body with an "mcdata-info" element that contains an "mcdata-Params" element with the "session-type" set to "prearranged" and the "mcdata-request-uri" set to the group identity.

q_44445.question: What is the mandatory protocolIEs for "UEContextModificationFailure"?
q_44445.ground_truth: The mandatory protocolIEs for "UEContextModificationFailure" are "id-gNB-CU-UE-F1AP-ID", "id-gNB-DU-UE-F1AP-ID", and "id-Cause".

q_44446.question: What must the IAB-MT include in the ULInformationTransfer message when there is a need to transfer F1-C related information?
q_44446.ground_truth: The IAB-MT must include the dedicatedInfoF1c in the ULInformationTransfer message when there is a need to transfer F1-C related information.

q_44447.question: What does the "Not Allowed Cells IEs" specify in the E-UTRAN Neighbour Cell list?
q_44447.ground_truth: The "Not Allowed Cells IEs" specifies a list of E-UTRAN neighbour cells that are not allowed for cell reselection for each E-UTRAN frequency. This information is used to ensure that the mobile station does not reselect the not allowed cells.

q_44448.question: What is the high-level procedure for providing the location information of the current talking MCPTT user to MCPTT clients and the IWF?
q_44448.ground_truth: The high-level procedure is described in 3GPP TS 23.379 subclause 10.6.2.7. The MCPTT server checks the privacy policy of the current talking MCPTT user to decide if the location information can be provided to other MCPTT users on the call, and if permitted, the MCPTT server provides the location information to MCPTT clients and the IWF.

q_44449.question: What is the purpose of PC5 DRX operations in 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay?
q_44449.ground_truth: PC5 DRX operations in 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay enable power saving for 5G ProSe Direct Discovery, Unicast, groupcast and broadcast mode 5G ProSe Direct Communication, and 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay Discovery and Communication. In AS layer, the UE determines the PC5 DRX parameter values for 5G ProSE Direct Communication or 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay Communication over PC5 reference point, taking into account PC5 QoS parameters and/or destination Layer-2 ID provided by the ProSe layer.

q_44450.question: What does the HeadRotIndicator value 0, 1, and 2 indicate in the external orientation file?
q_44450.ground_truth: The HeadRotIndicator value 0 disables the head rotation for the current sub-frame, 1 enables the head rotation for the current sub-frame, and 2 freezes the head rotation value to the current head rotation.

q_44451.question: Which attribute(s) may be present if the "repPeriod" attribute within the "evtReq" attribute is included?
q_44451.ground_truth: The "repPeriod" attribute within the "evtReq" attribute may be present if the feature "EneNA" is supported.

q_44452.question: What will be the HTTP status code returned if the context indicated by the userInfoId already exists in the AnnounceAuthorize service operation?

q_44453.question: What should the MCPTT client in idle mode do when it receives an Application Paging message over an MBMS subchannel?
q_44453.ground_truth: It should make a service request to enter RRC Connected mode.

q_44454.question: What is the definition of the performance requirement of PUSCH in terms of SNR?
q_44454.ground_truth: The performance requirement of PUSCH is determined by a minimum required throughput measured for the moving UE at a given SNR. The required throughput is expressed as 70% of the maximum throughput for the FRCs listed in Annex A, and assumes HARQ re-transmissions.

q_44455.question: Which radio interface is used for direct path in a multi-path relay scenario in 3GPP?
q_44455.ground_truth: Uu radio interface is used for direct path in a multi-path relay scenario in 3GPP.

q_44456.question: How does the 5G System detect the traffic for a 5GMSd-Aware Application?
q_44456.ground_truth: The 5G System detects the traffic for a 5GMSd-Aware Application through a collaboration scenario between the 5GMSd Application Provider and the MNO. The Application Provider provides necessary information to the MNO to detect and identify the traffic, and the MNO applies the agreed traffic treatment.

q_44457.question: What must the server or target do if they determine that the LPP procedure needs to be aborted?
q_44457.ground_truth: They send an LPP Abort message to the other endpoint, carrying the transaction ID for the procedure.

q_44458.question: How many rated beam EIRP values can a manufacturer declare for a pass band where the supported fractional bandwidth is larger than 6%?
q_44458.ground_truth: A manufacturer can declare two rated beam EIRP values for a pass band where the supported fractional bandwidth is larger than 6%.

q_44459.question: When will the UE stop sending CSI reports for SCell1?
q_44459.ground_truth: The UE should stop sending CSI reports for SCell at latest in a subframe (n+8) during T3.

q_44460.question: What shall be the value of at least one bit in the Spare field of the Bit 7 to 8 field in the packet loss cause information message?
q_44460.ground_truth: At least one bit in the Spare field shall be set to "1" in the packet loss cause information message.

q_44461.question: What information needs to be enhanced for the PDU session charging in solution #3.1?
q_44461.ground_truth: The PDU session charging information, specifically the satellite backhaul information, needs to be enhanced for solution #3.1.

q_44462.question: What should the SMF do if a UE is outside of the LADN service area when activating the User Plane connection of a PDU session?
q_44462.ground_truth: The SMF should reject the request if the UE is outside of the LADN service area.

q_44463.question: What is the requirement for spurious emissions for UL MIMO in the context of NR-DC?
q_44463.ground_truth: The requirements for spurious emissions which are caused by unwanted transmitter effects such as harmonics emission, parasitic emissions, intermodulation products and frequency conversion products is defined as the sum of the emissions from all UE transmit antenna connectors.

q_44464.question: In the context of normative provisions, what is the difference between "shall" and "might"?
q_44464.ground_truth: "Shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something while "might" indicates a likelihood that something will happen as a result of action taken by some agency the behavior of which is outside the scope of the present document.

q_44465.question: What type of element is defined by the "tPolygonAreaType" complexType?
q_44465.ground_truth: The "tPolygonAreaType" complexType represents an element that contains a sequence of corner points, which define a polygon area.

q_44466.question: What information does the MME send to the eNodeB when requested, to assist with resource prioritisation decisions between different NB-IoT UEs?
q_44466.ground_truth: The MME sends the QoS profile sent to the eNodeB by the MME consists of the E-RAB Level QoS Parameter in the E-RAB to be Setup List IE.

q_44467.question: What is the requirement for a PLMN to be considered a high quality PLMN by the UE during its search for available PLMNs?
q_44467.ground_truth: The PLMN must satisfy the high quality criterion, which requires the measured RSRP value for an E-UTRAN cell to be greater than or equal to -110 dBm.

q_44468.question: What is a PFCP message and what are its types used for?
q_44468.ground_truth: A PFCP message is a type of message used in PFCP (Packet Forwarding Control Protocol) for network control functions. It is used in various network message types over the Sxa, Sxb, Sxc, N4 and N4mb reference points to provide communication between network nodes and for network control tasks.

q_44469.question: When can a UE transmit SRS over serving cell d when the simultaneous transmission of SRS and other signal/channel would result in uplink transmissions beyond the UE's indicated uplink carrier aggregation capability in LTE?
q_44469.ground_truth: The UE can transmit SRS over serving cell d if PUCCH/PUCCH transmission carrying HARQ-ACK/positive SR/RI/PTI/CRI/PRACH or aperiodic CSI on a serving cell in set S(d) does not overlap with the SRS transmission (including any interruption due to uplink or downlink RF retuning time) on serving cell d, and if PUSCH on a serving cell in set S(d) overlaps in more than one symbol with the SRS transmission, the UE drops the PUSCH transmission.

q_44470.question: What steps does the SCC AS take if it receives an initial SIP INVITE request due to STN-SR?
q_44470.ground_truth: The SCC AS includes the saved P-Asserted-Identity in the SIP 2xx response to the initial SIP INVITE request due to STN-SR and the saved Contact header field of the remote UE in its SIP 1xx responses.

q_44471.question: How is the total noise power calculated for the measurements?
q_44471.ground_truth: The total noise powers obtained from such repeats are averaged, and the total result is 10~*~log10 of this average in dB.

q_44472.question: What is the logical channel for the RRCSystemInfoRequest?
q_44472.ground_truth: The logical channel for the RRCSystemInfoRequest is CCCH.

q_44473.question: What is the purpose of TS 36.331, clause 5.3.14.1 in the proximity indication procedure?
q_44473.ground_truth: The purpose of this procedure is to indicate that the UE is entering or leaving the proximity of one or more CSG member cells. The detection of proximity is based on an autonomous search function as defined in TS 36.304.

q_44474.question: What is the purpose of the UE join or MBS session activation procedure in this solution?
q_44474.ground_truth: The purpose of this procedure is to allocate resources for the UE joining the MBS session. The NG-RAN checks the availability of resources for the UE in the dedicated or shared multicast resource for the UE's slice. If there are no available resources, the NG-RAN may reject the PDU Session Resource setup and inform the UE to report the resource failure to the AF.

q_44475.question: What is the PRACH false alarm probability requirement in section 8.4.1.2?
q_44475.ground_truth: The false alarm probability shall be less than or equal to 0.1%.

q_44476.question: What supplementary services does the barring of access apply to in the VLR?
q_44476.ground_truth: The barring of access applies to interrogation, invocation, control of PLMN specific supplementary services, and processing unstructured SS data.

q_44477.question: What information is used to determine round trip delay for service data flows?
q_44477.ground_truth: The QoS monitoring for packet delay of individual QoS Flows is used to determine the round trip delay for service data flows.

q_44478.question: What action does the User Equipment (UE) take when it has successfully accessed the target eNodeB in the handover procedure?
q_44478.ground_truth: The UE implicitly derives the EPS bearers for which an E-RAB was not established and deactivates them locally without an explicit NAS message at this step.

q_44479.question: What is the capability that a UE supporting cch-InterfMitigation-RefRecTypeB-r13 must also support?

q_44480.question: What is the role of the PFCP protocol in 3GPP functionalities over Sxa, Sxb, Sxc, N4 and N4mb reference points?
q_44480.ground_truth: The PFCP protocol enables packet forwarding, policy and charging control, and lawful interception in 3GPP functionalities.

q_44481.question: What should the AMF assign when it assigns a registration area to the UE registered for disaster roaming services?
q_44481.ground_truth: The AMF shall only include TAIs covering the area with the disaster condition when assigning a registration area to the UE registered for disaster roaming services.

q_44482.question: Which ID should be set to the value identifying the conversation when generating an FD HTTP TERMINATION message?
q_44482.ground_truth: The Conversation ID IE should be set to a value identifying the conversation when generating an FD HTTP TERMINATION message.

q_44483.question: What message types are allowed to invoke services provided by MSGin5G Server to send MSGin5G Messages and MSGin5G message delivery status reports to the MSGin5G Server?
q_44483.ground_truth: The AS, L3G/N3G, BMG, and other MSGin5G servers can invoke the services provided by MSGin5G Server.

q_44484.question: What is the function of the "EEC Context" in the service provisioning phase?
q_44484.ground_truth: It provides EECs with information about which EESs already act as common EESs serving AC associations and which are candidates, enabling the EEC to determine which EES to choose if common EAS association services are needed.

q_44485.question: Which field is used to indicate the carrier indication of NPRACH in the DCI format N1 when used for random access initiated by a NPDCCH order?
q_44485.ground_truth: The carrier indication of NPRACH field is used to indicate the carrier indication of NPRACH in the DCI format N1 when used for random access initiated by a NPDCCH order.

q_44486.question: What should the MTSI media gateway support to enable ECN between the MTSI client in terminal and the MTSI MGW when inter-working with CS GERAN/UTRAN?
q_44486.ground_truth: The MTSI media gateway should support RTP/AVPF and SDPCapNeg if it supports RTCP AVPF ECN feedback messages and be capable of enabling end-to-end rate adaptation between the MTSI client in terminal and the CS terminal by performing inter-working adaptation requests between the MTSI client in terminal and the CS GERAN/UTRAN.

q_44487.question: What is the ProSe Service and what does it do?
q_44487.ground_truth: The ProSe Service is a feature of the 5G System that supports 5G ProSe Direct Discovery authorization, provided by the Application Function (AF) to enable NF service consumers (e.g. 5G DDNMF) to request authorization for a UE of a 5G ProSe Direct Discovery request.

q_44488.question: In what frequency bands do the restrictions in 9.3.9.4.1 apply?
q_44488.ground_truth: The restrictions in 9.3.9.4.1 apply in TDD bands on FR1.

q_44489.question: What network functionality is required to ensure that a consumer NF reaches the PCF serving the UE?

q_44490.question: What is the HTTP status code that should be returned on success when transmitting an uplink SMS message using the MoForwardSm service operation?

q_44491.question: What diameter AVP is used to identify the radio access technology serving the UE?

q_44492.question: How is NAS SM information processed in a Home Routed PDU Session between the V-SMF and H-SMF?
q_44492.ground_truth: NAS SM information is processed by both V-SMF and H-SMF in a Home Routed PDU Session. The V-SMF transfers NAS SM information, which it does not comprehend or is not visible to it, towards the H-SMF, and the H-SMF transfers NAS SM information which the V-SMF does not need to interpret towards the V-SMF. Unknown NAS SM information is appended by the V-SMF to the NAS SM message it sends to the UE in a N16 container.

q_44493.question: What should a UE do if it changes the UE specific DRX parameter in WB-S1 mode or NB-S1 mode?
q_44493.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the tracking area updating procedure by sending a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message to the MME.

q_44494.question: What is the primary responsibility of the AMF in step 25 when forwarding the event report message to the LMF?
q_44494.ground_truth: The AMF includes the deferred routing identifier received in step~25 as the LCS Correlation Identifier. The deferred routing identifier can assist a serving LMF in identifying the periodic or triggered location session if the same serving LMF had assigned the deferred routing identifier at step~16 or can indicate to the LMF that it is acting as a default LMF.

q_44495.question: What is the mechanism used by CHF for partial record keeping during PDU session establishment in a home routed scenario?
q_44495.ground_truth: The "Default partial record" mechanism is used by CHF for partial record keeping during PDU session establishment in a home routed scenario.

q_44496.question: What should the UE do if access is barred for signalling and the UE has reselected a new cell where access for signalling is granted?
q_44496.ground_truth: The UE will initiate the Attach procedure on the new cell.

q_44497.question: What is the expected behavior of the receiver when updating load control information using the Load Control Sequence Number?
q_44497.ground_truth: The receiving entity shall update its load control information only if the Load Control Sequence Number received in the new load control information is higher than the stored value of the Load Control Sequence Number associated with the peer GTP-C entity.

q_44498.question: In the context of EMC testing, what is a network-controlled repeater (NCR)?
q_44498.ground_truth: An NCR is a type of equipment in EMC testing that is capable of amplifying, processing, and repeating signals in a network, ensuring proper communication between devices while complying with electromagnetic compatibility standards.

q_44499.question: What is the requirement for the interface between the POI/NF and the UDSF/UDR?
q_44499.ground_truth: The interface between the POI/NF and the UDSF/UDR shall be protected such that an attacker cannot identify targeted users based on observation of this interface. Access to the UDSF/UDR shall be identical for both intercepted and non-intercepted user communications.

q_44500.question: What is the role of the MDA in the solution described in section 6.72?
q_44500.ground_truth: The MDA is an enabler of automation and intelligence for services management and orchestration. It may play various roles, including MDA MnS producer, MDA MnS consumer, and MDA service consumer. The MDA uses historical and current data, including performance measurements, trace data, alarm information, and CM information, to generate analytics that can be used by other network functions and management systems.

q_44501.question: What action should the UE take if the network fails the authentication check?
q_44501.ground_truth: If the UE deems that the network has failed the authentication check, the UE should request RRC to locally release the RRC connection, treat the active cell as barred, and start any retransmission timers if they were running and stopped when the UE received the first AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message containing an incorrect authentication challenge data causing authentication failure.

q_44502.question: What is the role of the PCF in invocation-related priority mechanisms in the 5GS and 5G QoS model?
q_44502.ground_truth: The PCF can modify the ARP of the QoS Flow used for IMS signalling for prioritized services, and select the ARP and 5QI parameters, plus associated QoS characteristics as appropriate, to provide priority treatment to the QoS Flow(s) for mobile originations and mobile terminations.

q_44503.question: What is the replacement for the term 'PUSCH' in Clauses 8.1.1 and 8.4 for sidelink transmission mode 1?
q_44503.ground_truth: The term 'PUSCH' is replaced with 'PSSCH' for sidelink transmission mode 1.

q_44504.question: What is the maximum allowable cell re-selection delay to a lower priority NR cell?
q_44504.ground_truth: The maximum allowable cell re-selection delay to a lower priority NR cell is 3 seconds.

q_44505.question: What is the purpose of the 2Rx TDD FR1 PDSCH pre-emption performance test as specified in section 5.2.2.2.8 of the document?
q_44505.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to verify the PDSCH pre-emption performance under 2 receive antenna conditions for NR UE releases 16 and later that support the pre-EmptIndication-DL-r16 capability IE.

q_44506.question: What is the role of SEG A's Interconnection CA in the verification of SEG B's certificate?
q_44506.ground_truth: SEG A's Interconnection CA is used to verify the cross-certificate for Operator B's SEG CA, ensuring the validity of SEG B's certificate in the connection negotiation process.

q_44507.question: What is the main reason for the PGW-C/SMF to send signalling towards the ePDG during a PDN connection restoration?
q_44507.ground_truth: The PGW-C/SMF sends signalling towards the ePDG during a PDN connection restoration to move the PDN connection to a different PGW-C/SMF, which can happen when a PGW-C/SMF is de-instantiated, or when a new PGW-C/SMF is reselected for the PDN connection due to unavailability of the serving PGW-C/SMF.

q_44508.question: What action should the controlling MCPTT function take when all invited clients have responded with SIP 200 (OK) responses, but some required group members have not yet responded?
q_44508.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function should include the warning text "111 group call proceeded without all required group members" in a Warning header field as part of the SIP 200 (OK) response.

q_44509.question: What is the difference between the first and second digits in the version number of the 3GPP technical specifications?
q_44509.ground_truth: The first digit of the version number indicates the stage of approval of the document within the TSG, while the second digit is incremented for all changes of substance.

q_44510.question: What modulation scheme is used for testing the transmitted signal quality in the FR1 test model 3.3?
q_44510.ground_truth: The transmitted signal quality is tested using QPSK modulation in the FR1 test model 3.3.

q_44511.question: What function does the AF/NEF provide to the UDM in this solution for the LADN mechanism to work?
q_44511.ground_truth: The AF/NEF provides the External Group ID, 5G VN group membership information, and 5G VN group data to the UDM

q_44512.question: What is the action taken when the condition in step 3 of the algorithm is met and the data for the corresponding Transport Block (TB) was not successfully decoded before?
q_44512.ground_truth: Instruct the physical layer to generate a negative acknowledgement of the data in this TB.

q_44513.question: What should the AUSF do when the CounterUPU is about to wrap around?
q_44513.ground_truth: The AUSF should suspend the UE Parameters Update protection service for the UE in this case.

q_44514.question: What should a 5G ProSe remote UE do if the target 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE is a 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-network relay without N3IWF?
q_44514.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe remote UE should perform the procedure of 5G ProSe communication via 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-network relay without N3IWF, with service continuity support used by the application layer procedures.

q_44515.question: Which three types of non-3GPP access networks are defined in clause 4.2.8?
q_44515.ground_truth: The three types of non-3GPP access networks defined in clause 4.2.8 are untrusted non-3GPP access networks, trusted non-3GPP access networks, and wireline access networks.

q_44516.question: What does Bit 4 in Octet 5 of the Requested Qos Monitoring IE represent when set to "1" in 3GPP TS 23.501?
q_44516.ground_truth: It indicates a request for monitoring the downlink data rate of the QoS flow for the downlink direction.

q_44517.question: What should the "refresher" parameter in the Session-Expires header field be set to in the SIP 200 (OK) response?
q_44517.ground_truth: The "refresher" parameter in the Session-Expires header field should be set to "uas" in the SIP 200 (OK) response.

q_44518.question: What is the procedure code for the "UEContextModificationIndication" in the S1AP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE?

q_44519.question: What is one of the responsibilities of the HSS/HLR regarding non-IP data delivery via SCEF, in addition to mapping of E.164 MSISDN or external identifier to IMSI?
q_44519.ground_truth: The HSS/HLR maps IMSI and Application Port ID to External Identifier.

q_44520.question: What is the purpose of creating a modifiedDataToIntegrityProtect JSON object?
q_44520.ground_truth: The modifiedDataToIntegrityProtect JSON object is used to record modifications made by the roaming intermediary and to associate the update with the original JWE object created by the sending SEPP.

q_44521.question: What is the purpose of the Error Vector Magnitude test described in 6.4E.2.2.1.2.1?
q_44521.ground_truth: The purpose of the Error Vector Magnitude test described in 6.4E.2.2.1.2.1 is to measure the difference between the reference waveform and the measured waveform, also known as the error vector, before calculating the EVM. The EVM is then used to determine the quality of the V2X sidelink transmission.

q_44522.question: What does the secured AI/ML model transfer and retrieval mechanism in Solution #11 include?
q_44522.ground_truth: The secured AI/ML model transfer and retrieval mechanism in Solution #11 includes confidentiality and integrity protection, along with the authorization for retrieval of AI/ML models within 5GS.

q_44523.question: What is the purpose of the first SECURITY MODE COMMAND message after inter-system change to Iu mode, which indicates CS domain and includes only an Integrity protection mode IE, in the scenario described in NOTE~1?
q_44523.ground_truth: The purpose of this message is to activate the integrity protection, but not to load a new key set from the SIM/USIM.

q_44524.question: What is the definition of UCI block error probability in 8.3.9.1?
q_44524.ground_truth: UCI block error probability is defined as the probability of incorrectly decoding the UCI information when the UCI information is sent, and does not contain CSI part 2.

q_44525.question: Which parameters are used for mapping frequency ranges to NR test frequencies NRf1, NRf2, NRf3, and NRf4 to PSCell; and to E-UTRA test frequencies f1, f2, f3, and f4 for PCell in EN-DC Intra-Band Contiguous and EN-DC Intra-Band Non-Contiguous cases with E-UTRA 1CC and NR 1CC?
q_44525.ground_truth: The mapping of frequency ranges to NR test frequencies NRf1, NRf2, NRf3, and NRf4 to PSCell; and to E-UTRA test frequencies f1, f2, f3, and f4 for PCell in EN-DC Intra-Band Contiguous and EN-DC Intra-Band Non-Contiguous cases with E-UTRA 1CC and NR 1CC.

q_44526.question: What restrictions are applied to a UE's scheduling availability during beam failure detection with a different subcarrier spacing than PDSCH/PDCCH on FR1?
q_44526.ground_truth: A UE is not expected to transmit PUCCH, PUSCH, or SRS, receive PDCCH, PDSCH, TRS, or CSI-RS for tracking or CQI on SSB symbols to be measured for beam failure detection. These restrictions apply to UEs that do not support simultaneousRxDataSSB-DiffNumerology.

q_44527.question: What is the difference between UE unaware positioning and user unaware positioning in the context of 5G?
q_44527.ground_truth: UE unaware positioning refers to the process of determining the location of a user equipment (UE) without its knowledge or participation, while user unaware positioning refers to the process of determining a user's location without their explicit consent or knowledge.

q_44528.question: What should the UE do when it receives a UEInformationRequest message with rlf-ReportReq set to true and it has handover failure information available?
q_44528.ground_truth: The UE should transmit a UEInformationResponse message including rlf-Report to the network.

q_44529.question: What should the IWF floor control server include in the Floor Granted message when it sends it to the MCPTT floor participant to which the floor is granted?
q_44529.ground_truth: It should include the value of timer T2 (Stop talking) in the Duration field, the granted priority in the Floor priority field, the stored Track Info field if available, and the Floor Indicator field with appropriate indications if the call is a broadcast group call, system call, emergency call, imminent peril call, or temporary group session.

q_44530.question: What is the purpose of the "+CPWD" command?
q_44530.ground_truth: The "+CPWD" command sets a new password for a facility lock function or returns a list of pairs presenting available facilities and the maximum length of their password.

q_44531.question: In semi-static SBFD evaluation results, what is the rule for deriving median values of all evaluation results for each traffic load?
q_44531.ground_truth: For each sub-case, four median values of all evaluation results for each traffic load are derived. These include the median values for mean DL average-UPT gain, 5% DL average-UPT gain, mean UL average-UPT gain and 5% UL average-UPT gain. The gain is expressed as X% = SBFD performance/TDD performance - 1. If both SBFD performance and TDD performance are equal to zero, NAN is used. To derive a median value, NAN is ignored and the samples are sorted in ascending order. If the number of samples is odd, the median value is the middle one and if the number of samples is even, the median value is the average value of the two values in the middle part.

q_44532.question: What is the motivation for Lily, in the roaming use case, to choose the temporary mobile data service provided by a local network?
q_44532.ground_truth: Lily prefers to have an arrangement for the temporary mobile data service with a local provider in this use case, while keeping an arrangement with her home provider for other services. She may prefer this for various reasons, such as cost-effectiveness, data volume, valid location, and type of service.

q_44533.question: What is the interruption time for RACH-less handover when the target cell is already known?
q_44533.ground_truth: The interruption time for RACH-less handover when the target cell is already known is 0 ms.

q_44534.question: What information should the SCC AS use to identify the network where the UE is registered?
q_44534.ground_truth: The P-Visited-Network-Id header field and the P-Access-Network-Info header field of the SIP REGISTER request.

q_44535.question: In what scenario will the AMF include the allowed NSSAI or the partially allowed NSSAI and the rejected NSSAI in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message?
q_44535.ground_truth: If the EAC mode is activated for an S-NSSAI and the AMF determines that the maximum number of UEs has been reached for one or more S-NSSAIs but not all S-NSSAIs in the requested NSSAI.

q_44536.question: When do UE listener reports become a problem for 5G networks?
q_44536.ground_truth: Listener reports can become a problem in particular for UEs close to the cell border that frequently move between cells, especially while in MBS service area and in RRC inactive mode.

q_44537.question: What is the action taken by the UE when Criterion 4 is fulfilled in TS 25.331, clause 8.1.1.6.19?
q_44537.ground_truth: Cell reselection to a cell on a higher absolute priority layer than the camped frequency is performed if Criterion 4 is fulfilled in TS 25.331, clause 8.1.1.6.19.

q_44538.question: What does the H-PCF do with the VPLMN precedence range provided by the HPLMN?
q_44538.ground_truth: The H-PCF maps the pre-defined VPLMN URSP's precedence values to the VPLMN range provided by the HPLMN, giving HPLMN control over high priority applications in the VPLMN.

q_44539.question: What is the applicability of this test case?
q_44539.ground_truth: This test case applies to all types of NR UE supporting E-UTRA and EN-DC from release 17 onwards, that support long DRX cycle and the BFD relaxation criteria bfd-Relaxation-r17.

q_44540.question: What is the role of the System Information (SI) in NR radio access?
q_44540.ground_truth: The System Information (SI) in NR radio access consists of a Master Information Block (MIB) and other System Information (SI) blocks, which are divided into Minimum SI and Other SI. The MIB contains essential physical layer information and cell barred status information, while the SIB1 defines the scheduling of other system information blocks and contains essential information for initial access. Other SI includes a number of SIBs related to cell re-selection, MBS broadcast, NTN, and NR sidelink communication.

q_44541.question: What is the format of the User ID value in clause 8.2.3.8?
q_44541.ground_truth: The format of the User ID value in clause 8.2.3.8 is a URI.

q_44542.question: Which attribute is used to define the temporary MCPTT group ID in the "regroupedType" complex type?
q_44542.ground_truth: The "temporary-MCPTT-group-ID" attribute is used to define the temporary MCPTT group ID in the "regroupedType" complex type.

q_44543.question: How are the sub-block edges determined in NTC3 for the carrier adjacent to the sub-block gap?
q_44543.ground_truth: The sub-block edges adjacent to the sub-block gap are determined using the specified Foffset-RAT for the carrier adjacent to the sub-block gap.

q_44544.question: What should the SS do if the UE has not yet re-selected Ncell 2 after T2 has expired in 4G LTE?

q_44545.question: What is the procedure for performing RTT or PLR measurement in the UPF, depending on the QoS rule indicated by the SMF?
q_44545.ground_truth: If the measurement is for QoS flows of a non-default QoS rule, the UPF performs the RTT or PLR measurement over the QoS flows of the non-default QoS rule. Otherwise, the UPF performs the measurement over the QoS flow of the default QoS rule.

q_44546.question: In what scenario is the TWAG not able to dictate the use of deferred IPv4 address allocation with the default APN used in Trusted WLAN access?
q_44546.ground_truth: When a UE requests the IPv4 address via DHCPv4, the TWAN delivers the received IPv4 address to the UE within DHCPv4 signalling after the tunnel is established.

q_44547.question: What is the function of the GTP-U path in activating between gNB and UPF on-board during the EAS(UPF on-board) discovery procedure with EASDF?
q_44547.ground_truth: It allows the UPF on-board to know the gNB IP address and initiate GTP-U path monitoring towards this gNBs using echo request/response.

q_44548.question: What action does the UE take when it receives an ATTACH REJECT message with the reject cause set to "Tracking area not allowed" in the 3GPP TS 24.301, clause 5.5.1.3.5?
q_44548.ground_truth: The UE sets the EPS update status to EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, deletes the GUTI, last visited registered TAI and KSI, resets the attach attempt counter and enters the state EMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE. The UE then stores the current TAI in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service".

q_44549.question: What action does the source eNB take if E-UTRAN coverage during a ping-pong event needs to be verified?
q_44549.ground_truth: The source eNB may use the Unnecessary HO to another RAT procedure to verify E-UTRAN coverage and determine corrective measures.

q_44550.question: What should the UE do upon detecting radio link failure in source MCG?
q_44550.ground_truth: The UE should consider radio link failure to be detected for the source MCG, i.e. source RLF, suspend the transmission and reception of all DRBs and multicast MRBs in the source MCG, reset MAC for the source MCG, release the source connection.

q_44551.question: What MIME type shall be included in the HTTP POST request for session-oriented service establishment?

q_44552.question: What should the MS do when the network includes the PDP context status information element in the Service Accept message?
q_44552.ground_truth: The MS should locally deactivate all PDP contexts that are not in SM state PDP-INACTIVE on the MS side but are indicated as being in state PDP-INACTIVE by the Network.

q_44553.question: What should the controlling MCPTT function do if there is more than one entry element in a list element of the resource-lists element, after receiving a SIP INVITE request for controlling MCPTT function of a private call and there is no application/resource-lists+xml MIME body?
q_44553.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function should reject the SIP INVITE request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response including warning text set to "145 unable to determine called party" in a Warning header field as specified in clause~4.4.

q_44554.question: What does the unsolicited result code +COLP support when the connected line identity is available after the reception of the final response to the call setup?
q_44554.ground_truth: The unsolicited result code +COLP does not support numbers of the SIP URI format when the connected line identity is available after the reception of the final response to the call setup.

q_44555.question: What is the periodicity and offset of CSI-IM in 3GPP TS 38.211 CSI-IM-Resource?
q_44555.ground_truth: The periodicity and offset of CSI-IM are defined in 3GPP TS 38.211 CSI-IM-Resource's periodicityAndOffset.

q_44556.question: What is Historical Nomadic Period as defined in this solution?
q_44556.ground_truth: Historical Nomadic Period is the minimum duration that the UE was roving within the visited AOI and its duration is determined by the application implementation decision.

q_44557.question: What will the SNRM-S do if the sender is an authorized user?
q_44557.ground_truth: The SNRM-S will provision the network-assisted QoS management for the SNRM-C and send an HTTP 200 (OK) response message.

q_44558.question: What is the condition for the MAC entity to stop an ongoing Random Access procedure due to a pending SR for SL consistent LBT failure recovery which has no valid PUCCH resources?
q_44558.ground_truth: The MAC entity may stop the ongoing Random Access procedure due to a pending SR for SL consistent LBT failure recovery, if the SL LBT failure MAC CE indicates SL consistent LBT failure.

q_44559.question: What are the two methods for ECSP management system to report the EAS measurement data to the ASP in the performance assurance process?
q_44559.ground_truth: The two methods for ECSP management system to report the EAS measurement data to the ASP in the performance assurance process are performance file reporting service and performance data streaming service.

q_44560.question: What is the intended use of the Resource-Share header field?
q_44560.ground_truth: The Resource-Share header field is used to inform the P-CSCF in the 3GPP architecture regarding potential resource sharing options, and it can be applied within a single private administrative domain or between different administrative domains.

q_44561.question: What is the meaning of the acronym "APN-AMBR" in the context of QoS parameters?
q_44561.ground_truth: APN-AMBR stands for "APN aggregate maximum bit rate". It limits the aggregate bit rate that can be expected to be provided across all non-GBR bearers and across all PDN connections of the same APN.

q_44562.question: What should the MCPTT client display if the SIP INVITE request contains an emergency indication in the MIME body?
q_44562.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should display to the user an indication that this is a SIP INVITE request for an MCPTT emergency group call, along with the MCPTT ID of the originator and the MCPTT group identity with the emergency condition.

q_44563.question: When should the UE set the EPS bearer identity to "no procedure transaction identity assigned" in the response message?
q_44563.ground_truth: The UE should set the EPS bearer identity to "no procedure transaction identity assigned" in the response message of ESM procedures when it is a transaction related message and the sending entity is the network.

q_44564.question: What is the purpose of the "Measurement Information message or SI2quater message" in the context of building the E-UTRAN Neighbour Cell list?
q_44564.ground_truth: The purpose of the "Measurement Information message or SI2quater message" is to provide E-UTRAN Neighbour Cell Description information. This information is used to build the E-UTRAN Neighbour Cell list, which contains up to 8 E-UTRAN frequencies with specified or unspecified E-UTRAN neighbour cells for each frequency.

q_44565.question: In the context of 8.2.1.4.1B, what is the purpose of verifying the closed loop rank-one performance with wideband precoding with two transmit antennas when the PDSCH transmission in the serving cell is interfered by PDSCH of two dominant interfering cells applying transmission mode 4 interference model?
q_44565.ground_truth: The purpose of these tests is to verify the closed loop rank-one performance with wideband precoding with two transmit antennas when the PDSCH transmission in the serving cell is interfered by PDSCH of two dominant interfering cells applying transmission mode 4 interference model.

q_44566.question: What time reference is used to calculate the Rate Control Status Validity Time, which is the time in seconds relative to 00:00:00 on 1 January 1900?
q_44566.ground_truth: Continuous time without leap seconds and traceable to a common time reference.

q_44567.question: What should a server do when it receives a SIP INVITE request with a <session-type> element set to "private" in the application/resource-lists+xml MIME body?
q_44567.ground_truth: The server should copy the URI of the functional alias to be called listed in the application/resource-lists+xml MIME body of the incoming SIP INVITE request, into the <called-functional-alias-URI> element of the <anyEXT> element of the <mcptt-Params> element of the <mcpttinfo> element in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body and invite the identified MCPTT ID(s).

q_44568.question: What state will the floor participant be in after receiving a Floor Granted message from the floor control server in the 'U: pending Request' state?
q_44568.ground_truth: The floor participant will be in the 'U: has permission' state after receiving a Floor Granted message from the floor control server in the 'U: pending Request' state.

q_44569.question: In what way is the "phone-context" tel URI parameter constructed when the IP-CAN is Fiber?
q_44569.ground_truth: The "phone-context" parameter is a domain name constructed from the fiber-location and the home network domain name by concatenating the fiber-location and the string "fiber" as domain labels before the home network domain name.

q_44570.question: What is the handover delay for this test, including RRC procedure delay and Tinterrupt?
q_44570.ground_truth: 572 ms (10 ms RRC procedure delay + 562 ms Tinterrupt)

q_44571.question: What information does the MME include in the Modify Bearer Request message to the Serving GW?
q_44571.ground_truth: The MME includes information such as EPS Bearer Identity, eNodeB address, eNodeB TEID, Handover Indication, and Presence Reporting Area Information in the Modify Bearer Request message to the Serving GW.

q_44572.question: In the same context, what information does the SMF provide to the PCF when the UE has indicated support of transferring Port Management Information Containers and 5GS Bridge/Router information is available?
q_44572.ground_truth: The SMF provides the 5GS Bridge/Router information, including the 5GS user-plane Node ID, port number for the PDU session, MAC address of the DS-TT Ethernet port for Ethernet PDU Session type, UE IP address for IP PDU Session type, and UE-DS-TT Residence Time, as well as the MTU size for IPv4 or IPv6 in the case of Deterministic Networking.

q_44573.question: What is the bandwidth containing 99 % of the total integrated power of the transmitted spectrum for occupied bandwidth in V2X UE supporting Transmit Diversity?
q_44573.ground_truth: The bandwidth containing 99 % of the total integrated power of the transmitted spectrum shall be less than the channel bandwidth specified for single carrier.

q_44574.question: What is the effect of activating 3GPP PS Data Off feature on user's access to services?
q_44574.ground_truth: When the 3GPP PS Data Off feature is activated by the user, the PCF updates the PCC rules in such a way that for 3GPP access only packets for services belonging to the list(s) of 3GPP PS Data Off Exempt Services are forwarded while all other packets are discarded.

q_44575.question: Which new optional AVPs are marked as bold in the DER command for N6 interface?
q_44575.ground_truth: The new optional AVPs for N6 in the DER command are marked as bold in the message format.

q_44576.question: What does the gNB-CU-UP do if the ROHC for SDT bearers is continued via the SDT Continue ROHC IE?
q_44576.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-UP, if supported, continues the ROHC for the SDT bearers for the UE.

q_44577.question: In a shared network, what information is indicated in the RAI contained in the ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message if the MS is a network sharing non-supporting MS?
q_44577.ground_truth: The PLMN identity of the common PLMN

q_44578.question: Which element appears in the "UNR-discovery-security-parameters-accept-type" complex type but not in the "UNR-discovery-security-parameters-request-type" XML complex type?
q_44578.ground_truth: The "PC5-security-policies-for-remote-UE" element appears in the "UNR-discovery-security-parameters-accept-type" complex type but does not appear in the "UNR-discovery-security-parameters-request-type" complex type.

q_44579.question: What action is taken by the SN when it notifies the MN about user data inactivity for SN-terminated bearers and the MN decides to send the UE to suspended RRC connection?
q_44579.ground_truth: The SN releases lower layers after the MN triggers the MN initiated SgNB Modification procedure, requesting the SN to release lower layers.

q_44580.question: What is the test purpose for the E-UTRA component with incomplete CQI reports, disabled SRS, infinite TimeAlignmentTimerDedicated, and disabled scheduling on the E-UTRA carrier?
q_44580.ground_truth: The test purpose is the same as in clause 6.5A.3.1.2.5 in TS 38.521-2 for the NR carrier.

q_44581.question: When should the UE set a display-name of the From header field to "Anonymous" and use Anonymous User Identity as the addr-spec of the From header field?
q_44581.ground_truth: Where the UE requires privacy, it shall set the display-name of the From header field to "Anonymous" and use Anonymous User Identity as the addr-spec of the From header field.

q_44582.question: What is the format of the user equipment policies for 5G ProSe in the 5G system?
q_44582.ground_truth: The user equipment policies for 5G ProSe are provided to the UE in a 5G ProSe policy (ProSeP) UE policy part using the UE policy delivery service as specified in 3GPP TS 24.501.

q_44583.question: Which types of E-UTRA UE does the test case apply to in 6.5B.3.4.1.2?
q_44583.ground_truth: The test case applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 15 and forward, supporting inter-band EN-DC including FR2 with 1 NR UL CC.

q_44584.question: How is the number of notifications received by the Aggregator NWDAF for analytics aggregation measured?
q_44584.ground_truth: The number of notifications received by the Aggregator NWDAF from the other NWDAFs to get analytics information for analytics aggregation is measured by adding each notification received from the other NWDAFs to a relevant counter.

q_44585.question: What is the PDN address of the default EPS bearer context set to, when the PDU session type is "Ethernet" or "Unstructured"?
q_44585.ground_truth: The PDN address of the default EPS bearer context is set to zero.

q_44586.question: What is the purpose of introducing the AI/ML session identifier (AMSID) for the UE?
q_44586.ground_truth: The AMSID is introduced for UE-initiated request to support the flexible FL operation and the UE is provided with an AI/ML session identifier (AMSID) either by the AF or the AFLSF and verifies whether the UE is allowed to perform FL.

q_44587.question: What is the difference between single-connection mode (SCM) and multi-connection mode (MCM) in the procedure described?
q_44587.ground_truth: In SCM, there is only one active PDN connection at a given time, while in MCM, the UE can have multiple active PDN connections simultaneously, with each connection having its own APN and PDN address.

q_44588.question: What should the MCData client do when it receives a SIP MESSAGE request for notification of an additional MCData user in an MCData emergency state joining the in-progress emergency group communication?
q_44588.ground_truth: The MCData client should display an indication of the additional emergency MCData user participating in the MCData emergency group communication to the user, and set the MCData emergency group state to "MDEG 2: in-progress".

q_44589.question: What occurs if the AF does not include the required Service Information when requesting the service in 3GPP networks?
q_44589.ground_truth: The PCRF shall store the received Service Information if it is included in the AA-Request. If the Service Information is not included, the PCRF may indicate that the request is not accepted, and the AF may receive a re-try interval within the Retry-Interval AVP in the AA-Answer command.

q_44590.question: In which clause of TS 38.213 does it define the uplink channel or signal preparation procedure time for clause 5.3, 5.4, 6.2.1, 6.4, and 9?

q_44591.question: What should the SMF do to request the UPF to forward all ARP or IPv6 Neighbour Solicitation to the SMF for an Ethernet PDU session?
q_44591.ground_truth: The SMF should provision a PDR in the UPF with an Ethernet Packet Filter containing EtherType 2054 (hexadecimal 0x0806) and associate the PDR with a FAR for ARP traffic and/or a PDI containing a specific application ID for IPv6 Neighbour Solicitation traffic.

q_44592.question: In which scenario does the network perform a PDN GW initiated bearer modification?
q_44592.ground_truth: The PDN GW initiated bearer modification is performed when the network needs to update the TFT or modify the S2a bearer QoS parameters for an active default or dedicated S2a bearer.

q_44593.question: What is the purpose of the test described in section 17.4.1.1.1?
q_44593.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described in section 17.4.1.1.1 is to verify that the UE can follow frame timing change of the connected gNB and that the UE initial transmit timing accuracy, maximum amount of timing change in one adjustment, and minimum and maximum adjustment rate are within the specified limits.

q_44594.question: What action does the SMF take when it determines the context update is for tunnel release and the NG-RAN nodes share a common user plane entity?
q_44594.ground_truth: The SMF removes the NG-RAN Node ID and possibly DL GTP tunnel endpoint from the stored NG-RAN Node ID(s) for the DL GTP tunnel endpoint for the MBS session, and checks whether the DL GTP tunnel is in use by other NG-RAN nodes.

q_44595.question: In what scenario is the 'Redundancy version for TB 1' in the 'Scheduling TBs for Unicast' field in DCI format 6-0A used to determine the redundancy version for a TB?
q_44595.ground_truth: The 'Redundancy version for TB 1' in the 'Scheduling TBs for Unicast' field in DCI format 6-0A is used to determine the redundancy version for a TB if the corresponding DCI indicates HARQ process IDs h1 and h2 (h1<h2) and the scheduled TB with HARQ process ID h1 is the first of the two TBs.

q_44596.question: What is the purpose of the Triggering Events parameter in measurement control?
q_44596.ground_truth: The Triggering Events parameter in measurement control defines when to start and stop a Trace Recording Session and which message shall be recorded first and last.

q_44597.question: What is the role of the ESM protocol entity in the UE when it receives a NOTIFICATION message in 3GPP TS 24.301, clause 6.6.2.3?
q_44597.ground_truth: The ESM protocol entity in the UE shall provide the notification indicator to the upper layer when it receives a NOTIFICATION message in 3GPP TS 24.301, clause 6.6.2.3. The notification indicator can have a value of SRVCC handover cancelled, IMS session re-establishment required (#1).

q_44598.question: How many companies have concluded that their implementations can achieve a reasonable residual level for co-site inter-sector co-channel inter-subband interference, up to 1dB desensitization?

q_44599.question: What should the AMF do when timer T3550 times out during the initial registration procedure?
q_44599.ground_truth: On the first expiry of the timer, the AMF shall retransmit the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message and shall reset and restart timer T3550. This retransmission is repeated four times. On the fifth expiry of timer T3550, the registration procedure for initial registration shall be aborted and the AMF enters state 5GMM-REGISTERED. If a new 5G-GUTI was allocated, the AMF shall consider both the old and new 5G-GUTIs as valid until the old 5G-GUTI can be considered as invalid by the AMF or the 5GMM context which has been marked as de-registered in the AMF is released. If the old 5G-GUTI was allocated by an AMF other than the current AMF, the current AMF does not need to retain the old 5G-GUTI. During this period, if the old 5G-GUTI is used by the UE in a subsequent message, the AMF acts as specified for case~a).

q_44600.question: In which NR carrier(s) is no DL interruption allowed in case of dynamic switching between two uplink bands with one transmit antenna connector and one uplink band with two transmit antenna connectors?
q_44600.ground_truth: NR downlink carrier(s) which is not indicated by uplinkTxSwitching-DL-Interruption

q_44601.question: What information is included in a cell specific load report for the intra-LTE scenario?
q_44601.ground_truth: The load information consists of radio resource usage, hardware load indicator, transport network layer load indicator, cell capacity class value, and available capacity for load balancing as percentage of total cell capacity.

q_44602.question: What is the guarding time suggested for the Procedure for IP address allocation in the U-plane in subclause 4.5A.1?
q_44602.ground_truth: A guarding time of 1.2 seconds (for satellite access (NTN) 2.48 sec) is suggested for the Procedure for IP address allocation in the U-plane in subclause 4.5A.1.

q_44603.question: What should an MCData client do upon receiving a SIP BYE request for an established dialog?
q_44603.ground_truth: The MCData client should release the associated resources and send a SIP 200 (OK) response towards the received SIP BYE request.

q_44604.question: What information must be included in the outgoing SIP 183 (Session Progress) response, as per clause~6.3.2.2.6.1, when lause~7.3.4 is set to "auto-answer" and the invited MCVideo client has one or more pre-established sessions without an associated MCVideo session?
q_44604.ground_truth: The outgoing SIP 183 (Session Progress) response must include a P-Asserted-Identity header field set to the public service identity of the participating MCVideo function.

q_44605.question: What should the UE include in the Via header field when using UDP and sending keep-alives?
q_44605.ground_truth: The UE shall include a "keep" header field parameter with no value in the Via header field.

q_44606.question: What should be included in the PROSE DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION REQUEST message to remove ProSe application(s) from existing PC5 QoS flow(s)?
q_44606.ground_truth: The PQFI(s) and the corresponding PC5 QoS parameters, including the ProSe identifier(s), and the link modification operation code set to "Remove ProSe application(s) from existing PC5 QoS flow(s)" should be included in the message.

q_44607.question: What information does the SMF send to the PCF after selecting an UPF for the PDU Session?
q_44607.ground_truth: The SMF sends Information on the Policy Control Request Trigger condition that has been met and the measured backhaul delay by the selected UPF.

q_44608.question: What is the role of the 3GPP management system in managing non-3GPP domains?
q_44608.ground_truth: The 3GPP management system directly manages 3GPP managed network components while coordinating with the corresponding management systems of non-3GPP domains.

q_44609.question: What is the function of the direct discovery set in UE-to-UE relay discovery?
q_44609.ground_truth: The direct discovery set contains information about UEs that the Source UE has discovered directly. It is protected by direct discovery security parameters and included in the relay discovery message.

q_44610.question: What is the implication of using the "anyUe" attribute in the "tgt-ue" attribute?
q_44610.ground_truth: When the "anyUe" attribute is set to "true" in the "tgt-ue" attribute, the NWDAF will provide analytics for all UEs, ignoring the target UE(s) of the Analytics Reporting.

q_44611.question: What is the purpose of the key query request and response in the key retrieval phase when the receiving UE-x does not have the SLPBK or SLPPK of the sending UE-1?
q_44611.ground_truth: The serving SLPKMF of UE-x sends a key query request to the serving SLPKMF of UE-1 when the receiving UE-x does not have the SLPBK or SLPPK of the sending UE-1. The serving SLPKMF of UE-1 then checks the local policy and returns the key query response if appropriate.

q_44612.question: What should the ATCF do upon receipt of a UPDATE request with a g.3gpp.ti media feature tag in a specific scenario?
q_44612.ground_truth: The ATCF should store the value of the g.3gpp.ti media feature tag of the Contact header field of the SIP UPDATE request.

q_44613.question: What is the purpose of the test specified in section 8.3.1.3.4 of the document?
q_44613.ground_truth: The purpose of the test specified in section 8.3.1.3.4 of the document is to verify the UE capability of supporting non quasi-colocated antenna ports when the UE receives DCI format 2D in a scenario where the three transmission points have different Cell ID and non-colliding CRS.

q_44614.question: What is the RSRP measurement accuracy for all measured cells when reporting periodically or event-triggered?
q_44614.ground_truth: The RSRP measurement accuracy for all measured cells when reporting periodically or event-triggered is specified in the sub-clauses 9.1.21.1 and 9.1.21.2.

q_44615.question: What did the simulation results from LG Electronics show for 39 GHz regarding the feasibility of different phase noise profiles?
q_44615.ground_truth: The simulation results for 39 GHz showed that the feasibility is only achieved in case 6, while case 4 and case 5 cannot achieve below 3.5% EVM.

q_44616.question: What action should the IP-SM-GW take when it receives a third-party REGISTER request and there is no Authorization header field received from the UE that is contained in a "message/sip" MIME body of the third party REGISTER request?
q_44616.ground_truth: Derive the IMSI from the public user identity obtained from the "To" header field in the REGISTER request received from the UE that is contained in a "message/sip" MIME body of the third party REGISTER request.

q_44617.question: What message type should the SCS/AS use to send non-IP data to the SCEF for a single UE?
q_44617.ground_truth: The SCS/AS should send an HTTP POST message to the SCEF for the "NIDD downlink data deliveries" resource.

q_44618.question: Which protocol is defined in 3GPP TS 24.572 for enabling LCS-UP?
q_44618.ground_truth: The Location Services User Plane (LCS-UP) protocol is defined in 3GPP TS 24.572 for enabling LCS-UP.

q_44619.question: What method is used for Deregistration Notifications in the 6.2.5 resource?
q_44619.ground_truth: The POST method is used for Deregistration Notifications in the 6.2.5 resource.

q_44620.question: What is the purpose of NSAG information in 5G networks?
q_44620.ground_truth: NSAG information includes a list of NSAGs, each with an NSAG ID, a list of S-NSSAIs associated with the NSAG, a priority value associated with the NSAG, and optionally a list of TAIs in which the NSAG is valid. It is used to assist network slice-based cell reselection and random access.

q_44621.question: What should the ATCF do upon receiving a SIP INFO request carrying session transfer cancellation while the home leg hasn't been released yet?
q_44621.ground_truth: The ATCF shall reset the CS to PS SRVCC access transfer in progress flag and send a SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP INFO request.

q_44622.question: What are the conditions for the PRS-RSRPP measurement requirements to apply?
q_44622.ground_truth: The PRS-RSRPP measurement requirements apply when the UE has received a message from LMF via LPP requesting the UE to measure and report PRS-RSRPP measurements, and the UE is capable of supporting the PRS-RSRPP measurement in RRC INACTIVE state.

q_44623.question: What is the state that the MCVideo client sets as true, when it has sent a GROUP EMERGENCY ALERT message?
q_44623.ground_truth: The MCVideo client sets the stored emergency state as "true", when it has sent a GROUP EMERGENCY ALERT message.

q_44624.question: When is the CoMP Information IE considered valid for RRM by the receiving eNB?
q_44624.ground_truth: The CoMP Information IE is considered valid starting in the subframe indicated by the Start SFN IE and Start Subframe Number IE, if present. If the Start SFN IE and Start Subframe Number IE are not present, then the receiving eNB considers the CoMP Information IE as immediately valid. The CoMP Information IE remains valid until an update of the same IE, received in a new LOAD INFORMATION message, is considered valid.

q_44625.question: What should the MCVideo client do if a SIP MESSAGE request is received with an `<alert-ind>` element set to "false" and contains the required information in the MIME body?
q_44625.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should display an indication of the MCVideo emergency alert cancellation and associated information, including the MCVideo group identity and originator of the MCVideo emergency alert.

q_44626.question: What action should the SGSN take if it receives a ROUTING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message from an MS with a LIPA PDN connection, and no L-GW Transport Layer Address is provided together with the ROUTING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message by the lower layer?
q_44626.ground_truth: The SGSN shall locally deactivate all PDP contexts associated with the LIPA PDN connection.

q_44627.question: What is the type of the periodicty in TSCAssistanceInformation?
q_44627.ground_truth: It is an integer that ranges from 0 to 640000.

q_44628.question: What is the sub-domain format for a Stand-alone Non-Public Network (SNPN) in 5GS?
q_44628.ground_truth: The Home Network Domain for a Stand-alone Non-Public Network (SNPN) in 5GS is in the format "5gc.nid<NID>.mnc<MNC>.mcc<MCC>.3gppnetwork.org", where <MNC> and <MCC> are 3 digits long and NID is encoded as hexadecimal digits as specified in clause~12.7.

q_44629.question: What actions should the UE take if the timer value received for timer T3396 in the Back-off timer value IE is not zero or deactivated, and a DNN was provided during the PDU session establishment?
q_44629.ground_truth: The UE shall stop timer T3396 associated with the corresponding DNN, start timer T3396 with the value provided in the Back-off timer value IE, and shall not send another PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message or PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message for the same DNN until timer T3396 expires or is stopped.

q_44630.question: What changes to procedures in TS 23.401 are captured in clause 4.11.0a?
q_44630.ground_truth: Clause 4.11.0a captures changes to procedures in TS 23.401 that are common to interworking based on N26 and interworking without N26.

q_44631.question: What is the header field used to provide announcements during an established communication session as defined in 3GPP TS 24.628?
q_44631.ground_truth: The Call-Info header field in a re-INVITE request should be supported at the II-NNI.

q_44632.question: What is the standard signal level used for calibration in both analogue and digital connections?
q_44632.ground_truth: The standard signal level used for calibration in both analogue and digital connections is -60 dBV for analogue connections and -16 dBm0 for digital connections.

q_44633.question: Which two pieces of information must the UE check after receiving the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message?
q_44633.ground_truth: The UE checks the integrity of the message and verifies that the received UE security capabilities and the received nonceUE have not been altered.

q_44634.question: What is the purpose of the omr-s-att, omr-m-bw, and omr-s-bw attributes in networks with OMR procedures?
q_44634.ground_truth: These attributes encapsulate a session or media-level SDP attribute that is applicable if a particular border gateway is bypassed.

q_44635.question: What is the minimum value for the "MinimumHeading" in the "HeadingType" complex type?

q_44636.question: What is the relationship between the "Minimum Requirements" and "Test Requirements" in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_44636.ground_truth: The Minimum Requirements in the specification do not account for measurement uncertainty. The test specification in RAN5 will define final test tolerances for FR1 TRP TRS. The test tolerances are used to relax the minimum requirements in this specification to create test requirements.

q_44637.question: What is the purpose of the "changeMOIs" operation?
q_44637.ground_truth: The "changeMOIs" operation is invoked by MnS consumers to request a MnS producer to create, delete, and update one or more objects using a single request, making changes to the managed objects in the order they appear in the request.

q_44638.question: What should be the maximum event triggered measurement reporting delay for GSM cells with BSIC verified for Event B2?
q_44638.ground_truth: The maximum event triggered measurement reporting delay for GSM cells with BSIC verified for Event B2 is less than 7202 ms from the beginning of time period T2.

q_44639.question: Which clauses are used to define the primary level settings in 9.1.7.2.5-1?
q_44639.ground_truth: Clause 7.1 of 3GPP TS 36.508, 7.2 of 3GPP TS 36.508, and 7.3 of 3GPP TS 36.508.

q_44640.question: What is the AMF required to perform before the S-NSSAI subject to NSAC is included in the Allowed NSSAI or Partially Allowed NSSAI and sent to the UE, when EAC mode is activated?
q_44640.ground_truth: The number of UEs per network slice availability check and update procedure.

q_44641.question: What is the current sharing factor P and PCBD applied to in RLM and BFD for FR2 HST?
q_44641.ground_truth: The current sharing factor P and PCBD applied to RLM and BFD for FR2 HST is the existing one.

q_44642.question: What is the purpose of the test described in section 16.6.1.8?
q_44642.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the UE makes correct reporting of an event and partly verifies the intra-frequency cell identification and measurement period requirements.

q_44643.question: What is the purpose of the "cellForWhichToReportCGI" field in the ReportCGI information element?
q_44643.ground_truth: The "cellForWhichToReportCGI" field in the ReportCGI information element specifies the cell for which to report CGI. This information element is used to communicate information about the serving cell to the UE.

q_44644.question: In what cases does the H-PCRF select the applicable PCC Rules for application detection and control (ADC)?
q_44644.ground_truth: The H-PCRF selects the applicable PCC Rules for ADC for the PCEF supporting ADC feature, the solicited application reporting with a TDF, or for solicited application reporting with a TDF in the non-roaming case or for the Home Routed scenario.

q_44645.question: Does the UE support channel Bandwidth of 90MHz on one carrier of one band entry in a band combination?

q_44646.question: What is the requirement for identification of a known NR target cell, as defined in clause 5.6.5.0.1.2?
q_44646.ground_truth: The UE shall identify and report the CGI of a known NR target cell when requested by the network for the purpose of reportCGI. Only one cell is provided to the UE with cellForWhichToReportCGI for identifying the CGI.

q_44647.question: What should the floor participant do when timer T206 (Stop talking warning) expires?
q_44647.ground_truth: When timer T206 (Stop talking warning) expires, the floor participant may notify the MCPTT user that the transmission time limit is about to reach, start timer T207 (Stop talking), and remain in the current state.

q_44648.question: What is the UE required to do for SSB based RLM when SSB for RLM is in the same OFDM symbol as BFD, CBD or L1-RSRP measurement for FR1?
q_44648.ground_truth: The UE is required to perform the SSB measurements with measurement restrictions when the SSB for RLM is in the same OFDM symbol as BFD, CBD or L1-RSRP measurement. UE is required to measure one of but not both SSB for RLM and CSI-RS when the SSB and CSI-RS have different SCS and when UE does not support simultaneousRxSSB-DiffNumerology. Longer measurement periods for SSB based RLM are expected in this case.

q_44649.question: What is the task of the SS when it receives the MeasurementReport message in step 6)?
q_44649.ground_truth: After the SS receives the MeasurementReport message in step 6), it transmits the RRCConnectionRelease message to release the RRC connection, including the release of the established radio bearers and all radio resources.

q_44650.question: What are the general data collection principles for network-side model training?
q_44650.ground_truth: The general data collection principles for network-side model training include UE supporting data logging, UE reporting collected data periodically, event-based, and on-demand, and considering UE memory, processing power, energy consumption, and signaling overhead.

q_44651.question: How is a MAC PDU obtained when an uplink grant is received in a Random Access Response?
q_44651.ground_truth: If there is a MAC PDU in the Msg3 buffer, it is obtained from the Msg3 buffer. Otherwise, it is obtained from the "Multiplexing and assembly" entity.

q_44652.question: What type of information is contained in the MT-SDT-Indicator field?

q_44653.question: Who is the current ruler of Portugal?

q_44654.question: How is quota management handled in SSC mode when the granted quota is volume for multiple UPFs?
q_44654.ground_truth: The quota can be shared by UPFs, managed by UPFs, or granted to the SMF for a single UPF, depending on the operator's policy.

q_44655.question: What is the MGCF's response after it sends a CPG(resume) message?
q_44655.ground_truth: After sending a CPG(resume) message, the MGCF initiates a H.248 interaction with MGW instructing it to resume sending the media stream.

q_44656.question: What does the "RS-IndexNR-r15" information element indicate?
q_44656.ground_truth: It is used to identify an NR Reference Signal with an integer value from 0 to maxRS-Index-1-r15-1, where maxRS-Index-1-r15 is the maximum number of RS-IndexN-r15 values that can be signaled in a single message.

q_44657.question: What is the input of the Inference function for generating the Inference Output?
q_44657.ground_truth: The input of the Inference function is the data provided by the Data Collection function, which is also referred to as Inference Data.

q_44658.question: What is the test procedure step that ensures the UE is in State 3A-RF with Cell 1 as the active cell?
q_44658.ground_truth: Step 2.1 in the test procedure ensures that the UE is in State 3A-RF with Cell 1 as the active cell.

q_44659.question: What information is forwarded to the upper layers when the UE receives a MobilityFromEUTRACommand message with the purpose set to handover in the context of inter-RAT mobility?
q_44659.ground_truth: The nas-SecurityParamFromEUTRA information is forwarded to the upper layers.

q_44660.question: What is the role of the NAS (Non-Access Stratum) control protocol in E-UTRA connected to 5GC?
q_44660.ground_truth: The NAS control protocol in E-UTRA connected to 5GC performs functions such as authentication, mobility management, and security control (except data integrity protection for E-UTRA connected to 5GC).

q_44661.question: What should the MS do if it receives a syntactical error in packet filters during a PDP context activation?
q_44661.ground_truth: The MS should reject the activation request with cause "syntactical errors in packet filter(s)".

q_44662.question: What message provides E-UTRAN measurement parameters and neighbor cell information for a multi-RAT MS supporting E-UTRAN?
q_44662.ground_truth: The fast acquisition of system information procedure, as defined in subclause 3.4.1.2.1.11, is used to acquire E-UTRAN measurement parameters and neighbor cell information from SI2quater and MEASUREMENT INFORMATION.

q_44663.question: What can the PDN GW do after releasing the IPv6 prefix to prevent immediate use by other users?
q_44663.ground_truth: After releasing the IPv6 prefix, the PDN GW should not assign that IPv6 prefix to other users immediately. This is true for both IPv4 and IPv6 address assignments.

q_44664.question: What is the term used in this specification to describe the Downlink Control Information?

q_44665.question: What is the definition of spurious response in the context of receiver performance?
q_44665.ground_truth: Spurious response is a measure of the ability of the receiver to receive a wanted signal on its assigned channel frequency without exceeding a given degradation due to the presence of an unwanted CW interfering signal at any other frequency for which a response is obtained. In other words, it is the lack of ability of the receiver to filter out unwanted signals at any frequency except the assigned channel frequency.

q_44666.question: What is the repeater type 1-H spurious emission requirement demonstration criteria?
q_44666.ground_truth: The repeater type 1-H spurious emission requirement can be demonstrated by meeting at least one of the following two criteria as determined by the manufacturer: the sum of the emissions power measured on each TAB connector in the TAB connector TX min cell group is less than or equal to the limit as defined in this clause for the respective frequency span, or the unwanted emissions power at each TAB connector is less than or equal to the repeater type 1-H limit as defined in this clause for the respective frequency span, scaled by -10log10(n), where n is the number of TAB connectors in the TAB connector TX min cell group.

q_44667.question: What is the basic format of an NR-CellIdentity SlPP Information Element?
q_44667.ground_truth: The NR-PhysCellID SlPP information element is used to define the NR physical cell identifier. The NR-PhysCellID is formatted as n integer value between 0 and 1007.

q_44668.question: What does the NTN Control function determine in the feeder link switch over between two gNBs?
q_44668.ground_truth: The NTN Control function determines the point in time when the feeder link switch over between two gNBs is performed.

q_44669.question: What is the general procedure for L-3 U2N Relay in Solution #41 to support redundant communication?
q_44669.ground_truth: The L-3 U2N Relay establishes a PDU Session for relay that supports redundancy and generates the ID of the communication path to send to its SMF, which then sends the ID to NG-RAN in the PDU session establish procedures.

q_44670.question: What is the charging mechanism that affects real-time the service rendered and requires direct interaction with bearer/session/service control?

q_44671.question: What can be done to reduce the test burden for PC3 MOP requirements?
q_44671.ground_truth: One band combination can be chosen to verify PC3 MOP testing for some band combinations in the same row, randomly choosing one band combination that UE supports.

q_44672.question: What must be included in the VarMeasReportList for a measId if a first cell triggers an event during layer 3 filtering?
q_44672.ground_truth: A measurement reporting entry, the numberOfReportsSent set to 0, the concerned cell(s) in the cellsTriggeredList, and initiate the measurement reporting procedure.

q_44673.question: What actions should the transmission control server take when it decides to end sending the RTP media packets on downlink to the transmission participant?
q_44673.ground_truth: The transmission control server should stop sending the RTP media packets to the transmission participant, send the Media Reception End Request message to the transmission participant, and include the SSRC of the user transmitting the media in the Media Reception End Request message.

q_44674.question: How does the MAC entity handle a downlink assignment for a TTI in a bundle for NB-IoT UEs or BL UEs or UEs in enhanced coverage?
q_44674.ground_truth: The MAC entity attempts to decode the received data, and if successful, delivers the decoded MAC PDU to the disassembly and demultiplexing entity. If the data was not successfully decoded, the MAC entity maintains the data and attempts to decode it in subsequent transmissions within the bundle.
