q_44675.question: When will the terminating UE send an 180 (Ringing) response after indicating the resources are not available during SDP negotiation?
q_44675.ground_truth: The terminating UE sends an 180 (Ringing) response after the resources on the terminating side are successfully reserved, if it supports the precondition mechanism and has indicated the resources are not available during SDP negotiation.

q_44676.question: What should be the measurement bandwidth for a multi-carrier and/or CA operation BS in order to improve measurement accuracy, sensitivity, and efficiency while avoiding carrier leakage?
q_44676.ground_truth: The resolution bandwidth should be smaller than the measurement bandwidth when measuring the emission power of a multi-carrier and/or CA operation BS.

q_44677.question: What is the performance impact of semi-static SBFD on the legacy TDD operator for UL and DL in all load levels?
q_44677.ground_truth: For the legacy TDD operator, regarding the performance impact of semi-static SBFD to legacy TDD of another operator, there may be limited improvement or degradation for UL and DL performance.

q_44678.question: What action should the NRM server take if successful upon creating a new "Individual MBS Resource" resource and initiating downlink data delivery?
q_44678.ground_truth: The NRM server should respond to the VAL server with an HTTP "201 Created" status code with the response body containing a representation of the created resource and potentially additional information (e.g. the user plane addressing information of the NRM Server for downlink data delivery) within the MBSResourceResp data structure.

q_44679.question: What must the UE do with Inter-APN Routing Policies, which is delivered by a VPLMN?
q_44679.ground_truth: The UE shall ignore any Inter-APN Routing Policy, which is delivered by a VPLMN.

q_44680.question: What is the role of the "apiRoot" component in the resource URI definition for the Location Information resource?
q_44680.ground_truth: The "apiRoot" component is the base URI for the location management server and is used to define the resource URI for the Location Information resource.

q_44681.question: Which measurement related to the N4 interface provides the number of failed N4 session establishments at the UPF?
q_44681.ground_truth: The "Number of failed N4 session establishments" measurement

q_44682.question: What is a sub-use case in the exposure of network slice as a product?
q_44682.ground_truth: A sub-use case is a scenario with specific organizations and systems involved in the exposure of network slice as a product.

q_44683.question: Under what conditions is an MCData emergency alert cancellation request considered authorized for cancellation of an alert originated by the same user?
q_44683.ground_truth: If the "allow-cancel-emergency-alert" element of the "actions" element of a "rule" element within the MCData user profile document is present and set to "true".

q_44684.question: What is the purpose of the ANDSP based solution for slice related TNGF selection?
q_44684.ground_truth: The ANDSP based solution is designed to aid the UE in selecting a TNGF that supports the S-NSSAI(s) needed by the UE. It adds the supported S-NSSAI(s) for the TNGF in ANDSP to assist the UE in selecting the TNGF that supports the S-NSSAI(s) needed by the UE.

q_44685.question: What should the MCVideo client include in the SIP MESSAGE request to change the selected group?
q_44685.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should include the ICSI value "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcvideo", a P-Preferred-Service header field, an Accept-Contact header field, a P-Preferred-Identity header field (optional), a resource-lists+xml MIME body, and an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body in the SIP MESSAGE request.

q_44686.question: What must the ME do if the UICC responds with '01' in the MO Short Message control result?
q_44686.ground_truth: The ME must not send the short message since it is not allowed.

q_44687.question: What kind of interactions between the Provisioning AF and the Data Collection AF are mediated by the NEF when the Provisioning AF and the Data Collection AF are located in different trust domains?
q_44687.ground_truth: The NEF mediates the interactions between the Provisioning AF and the Data Collection AF when the Provisioning AF and the Data Collection AF are located in different trust domains, as specified in clause~A.3 or A~4 of TS 26.531.

q_44688.question: What happens to the UE upon failed GNSS acquisition in connected mode if the GNSS position is outdated and uplink transmission extension is not active?
q_44688.ground_truth: The UE moves to idle mode upon failed GNSS acquisition in connected mode if the GNSS position is outdated and uplink transmission extension is not active.

q_44689.question: What is the role of a Network Slice Provider (NSP) as defined in the document?
q_44689.ground_truth: A Network Slice Provider (NSP) is responsible for managing the lifecycle of a network slice, including commissioning, operation, and decommissioning.

q_44690.question: What is required to support the steering of roaming capability?
q_44690.ground_truth: For steering of roaming, the 5G network needs to be able to allow the home network to steer its UE(s) to a hosting network, considering the location, times, coverage of the hosting network and the services offered by the home network and hosting network.

q_44691.question: What are the two main functions of the SMF in the 5G System?
q_44691.ground_truth: The two main functions of the SMF in the 5G System are to offer services to NF service consumers via the Nsmf service-based interface and to support session management for Non-IP Data Delivery (NIDD).

q_44692.question: What is the role of a UE-to-UE Relay in the communication between two UEs over the PC5 interface?
q_44692.ground_truth: A UE-to-UE Relay is responsible for relaying messages between two UEs over the PC5 interface through authorization and provisioning, enabling an end-to-end PC5 unicast communication.

q_44693.question: What is the gap requirement between the PDCCH that the UE monitors in the Type2-PDCCH CSS set and the PDCCH that the UE monitors in the Type0-PDCCH CSS set for the UE to receive system information update?
q_44693.ground_truth: The gap between the UE's reception of PDCCH that UE monitors in the Type2-PDCCH CSS set and that notifies system information update, and the PDCCH that UE monitors in the Type0-PDCCH CSS set, is greater than 2 slots.

q_44694.question: What should the UE do when it receives an AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message, with 5GMM cause #71 "ngKSI already in use" from the network?
q_44694.ground_truth: Upon receipt of an AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message from the UE with 5GMM cause #71 "ngKSI already in use", the network performs necessary actions to select a new ngKSI and send the same EAP-request message to the UE. Upon receiving a new AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message with the EAP message IE containing an EAP-request message from the network, the UE should stop timer T3520, if running, process the EAP-request message as normal.

q_44695.question: What should the UE do if the "service-level device ID set" is included in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message and the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message contains the "service-level-AA pending indication"?
q_44695.ground_truth: The UE should return a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF and not attempt to perform another registration procedure for UAS services until the UUAA-MM procedure is completed successfully.

q_44696.question: What is the maximum time allowed for the SS to read BCCH data from a GSM cell during inter-RAT cell re-selection?
q_44696.ground_truth: The maximum time allowed for the SS to read BCCH data from a GSM cell during inter-RAT cell re-selection is Tbcch + 50 ms.

q_44697.question: What is the required condition for the test purpose (TP) in 22.6.1.1.1 (2) and (3)?
q_44697.ground_truth: The UE should be in BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE STATE and in EMM-CONNECTED mode with a default EPS bearer.

q_44698.question: What is the basis for the 5G Media Streaming protocols and formats?
q_44698.ground_truth: The 5G Media Streaming protocols and formats are based on the Common Media Application Format (CMAF), which is a unified format for media streaming across different protocols, such as Dynamic Streaming over HTTP (DASH) and HTTP Live Streaming (HLS).

q_44699.question: What does the floor control server perform when it receives an instruction to merge group calls (R: Merge) from the application and signaling plane?
q_44699.ground_truth: The floor control server performs the actions described in clause 6.5.2.3 and enters the 'Start-stop' state.

q_44700.question: What is the difference between the two sets of requirements specified in the document?
q_44700.ground_truth: The hybrid requirements set applies to AAS BS with both a conducted and a radiated interface, while the OTA requirements set applies to AAS BS with a radiated interface only.

q_44701.question: What is the maximum number of transport blocks that the UE considers when determining a number of HARQ-ACK information bits if maxNrofCodeWordsScheduledByDCI = 1 and nrofHARQ-BundlingGroups = 1?
q_44701.ground_truth: The UE considers a maximum of one transport block.

q_44702.question: When should the initiating UE send a PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message after receiving a PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message from the target UE?
q_44702.ground_truth: The initiating UE should send a PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message after receiving a PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message from the target UE and performing the PC5 QoS flow establishment over 5G ProSe direct link as specified in the corresponding clause.

q_44703.question: What should be done if the user identified by the MCVideo ID in the SIP INVITE request is not authorized to join the prearranged group session?
q_44703.ground_truth: A SIP 403 (Forbidden) response should be sent with the warning text set to "121 user is not allowed to join the group call" in a Warning header field and skip the rest of the steps.

q_44704.question: What is the effect of the Application context relocation in the service switch in Solution #10?
q_44704.ground_truth: In Solution #10, the Application context is relocated along with the application context to another PINE, which allows the service to resume after the context relocation. This procedure changes the destination IP address and maintains the integrity of the application process by terminating the application traffic from the application server at the PINE first.

q_44705.question: What action does the old MME take if the new MME does not support CIoT EPS Optimization?
q_44705.ground_truth: The old MME will release the PDN connection and discard buffered data if the new MME does not support CIoT EPS Optimization.

q_44706.question: What should be the length of the value part of the User data container IE in the ESM DATA TRANSPORT message?
q_44706.ground_truth: The length of the value part of the User data container IE should not exceed the link MTU size for the respective type of user data (IPv4, IPv6 or Non-IP).

q_44707.question: What action does the ME and network take to derive and store a 128-bit packet-switched GSM ciphering key or GPRS GSM Kc128 in an established UMTS security context?
q_44707.ground_truth: The ME and network may derive and store a 128-bit packet-switched GSM Kc128 from an established UMTS security context. The ME with a USIM in use shall compute a new GPRS GSM Kc128 using the GPRS UMTS ciphering key and the GPRS UMTS integrity key from an established UMTS security context. The network shall compute the GPRS GSM Kc128 using the GPRS UMTS integrity key and the GPRS UMTS ciphering key from an established UMTS security context only when a GEA ciphering algorithm that requires a 128-bit ciphering key is to be used.

q_44708.question: When does the PCF request SMF to confirm resources associated with MPS for DTS invocation/revocation?
q_44708.ground_truth: Upon receipt from an AF of a request to report the successful outcome of MPS for DTS invocation/revocation of priority handling for the default QoS flow, the PCF requests the SMF to confirm that the resources associated with the MPS for DTS invocation/revocation are successfully allocated.

q_44709.question: When should a Mobile Station (MS) add an SNPN to the list of "permanently forbidden SNPNs"?
q_44709.ground_truth: The MS should add an SNPN to the list of "permanently forbidden SNPNs" if it receives a message with certain cause values in response to an LR request from the SNPN.

q_44710.question: What shall the UAE-C perform when detecting a condition for switching C2 communication mode?
q_44710.ground_truth: Upon detecting a condition for switching C2 communication mode, the UAE-C shall generate an HTTP POST request with the C2-related-trigger-event-report element, including the expected or actual application QoS/QoE parameters and send the request towards the UAE-S. Upon receiving an HTTP 200 (OK) message containing the C2-operation-mode-switching element, the UAE-C may start C2 communication using the indicated C2 communication mode and generate an HTTP POST request with the C2-operation-mode-switching-performed element, indicating the result of the reception.

q_44711.question: What is the relationship between a group document addressed by a group ID and an associated group document in the users tree?
q_44711.ground_truth: A group document addressed by a group ID should be associated with a group document in the users tree of a particular user which defines the group ID. A group document addressed by a group ID should exist for each associated group document in the users tree, and it should have the same content as the associated group document in the users tree.

q_44712.question: What is the reporting range of RSRP in the FDD absolute RSRP accuracy test for E-UTRA Carrier Aggregation for 20 MHz?
q_44712.ground_truth: The reporting range of RSRP is defined from -140 dBm to -44 dBm with 1 dB resolution.

q_44713.question: When would the ISC gateway function require the periodic refreshment of the session?
q_44713.ground_truth: The ISC gateway function may require the periodic refreshment of the session to avoid hung states in the ISC gateway function when it receives an INVITE request. If the ISC gateway function requires the session to be refreshed, it shall apply the procedures described in RFC 4028.

q_44714.question: What should the UE do if it receives a GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message before completing the tracking area updating procedure?
q_44714.ground_truth: The UE should ignore the GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message and proceed with the tracking area updating procedure.

q_44715.question: What is one security feature used to combat rogue REJECT messages in the 5G system?
q_44715.ground_truth: One security feature used to combat rogue REJECT messages is the use of carefully selected wait timers, which provides an opportunity for UEs to recover and avoid lock-outs.

q_44716.question: What is the role of PRUK in PC5 link security establishment for 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay service?
q_44716.ground_truth: PRUK (Prose Remote User Key) is used in PC5 link security establishment for 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay service. It is used to derive the K~NRP~ different from the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network service. PRUK ID is used to identify the PRUK in the Direct Communication Request (DCR) message.

q_44717.question: In what scenario would the numberOfLBTFailures variable be incremented?
q_44717.ground_truth: The variable "numberOfLBTFailures" would be incremented if at least one LBT failure indication has been received from lower layers during the random-access procedure.

q_44718.question: What is the role of the SCEF in the Get Session Properties procedure?
q_44718.ground_truth: The SCEF acts as a Content Provider after the completion of the Get Session Properties procedure.

q_44719.question: What is the function of the NWDAF in the procedure for NWDAF assisted NTN coverage analytics?
q_44719.ground_truth: The NWDAF produces Analytics with Analytics ID: NTN coverage, based on requested NTN coverage Type, the Target UE ID(s), Analytics Filter Information, and Analytics Reporting Information, and provides it to the AMF as NF consumer.

q_44720.question: What should a UE do if it receives a 5GMM cause value over non-3GPP access and has not yet registered over non-3GPP access, with USIM valid for 5GS services over non-3GPP access?
q_44720.ground_truth: The UE should perform a registration attempt over non-3GPP access if another access point for non-3GPP access is available, or if 3GPP access is available, the UE is not registered over 3GPP access yet, and the USIM is not considered invalid for 5GS services over 3GPP access, perform registration attempt over the 3GPP access.

q_44721.question: How is the EAP ID used to identify the UE and slice for authorization in the NSSAA framework?
q_44721.ground_truth: The EAP ID, which is provided by the UE for S-NSSAI in a NAS MM Transport message, is used to identify the UE and slice for authorization in the NSSAA framework. The EAP ID is sent from the AMF to the NSSAAF, which forwards it to the AAA-S along with the S-NSSAI (Slice/Subnet Specific Application Identifier) and GPSI (Global Proxy Identifier). The AAA-S stores the GPSI to create an association with the EAP ID in the EAP ID response message so that it can later use it to revoke authorization or trigger re-authentication. The AAA-S uses the EAP-ID and S-NSSAI to identify for which UE and slice authorization is requested.

q_44722.question: What is the cause value for the Reason header field in 3GPP TS 24.237, clause 12.2.4.1 and 12.2.4.2?
q_44722.ground_truth: The cause value for the Reason header field in 3GPP TS 24.237, clause 12.2.4.1 and 12.2.4.2 is 487.

q_44723.question: What is one of the conditions for a UE to use 5G NSWO without 5GS registration?
q_44723.ground_truth: The UE must not first connect to a WLAN access network with 5GS credentials and then perform 5GS registration without releasing the WLAN and establishing a new WLAN association for the Trusted non-3GPP access registration procedure.

q_44724.question: What information should eNB1 include in the HANDOVER REPORT message if the mobility information is available for a handover from eNB2 to eNB1?
q_44724.ground_truth: eNB1 should include the Mobility Information IE and the Source cell C-RNTI IE in the HANDOVER REPORT message if the mobility information is available for a handover from eNB2 to eNB1.

q_44725.question: What is the Diameter application identifier assigned to the S6c Diameter application?
q_44725.ground_truth: The Diameter application identifier assigned to the S6c Diameter application is 16777312.

q_44726.question: What is the primary goal of raw format adaptation in the context of media content provision for AR glasses?
q_44726.ground_truth: The primary goal of raw format adaptation is to match the formats received and generated on the phone to those supported on the proprietary link in order to minimize format conversion and transcoding issues.

q_44727.question: What is the name of the complexType "RulesForAffiliationManagementType" that contains a choice of elements, including "ListOfLocationCriteria", "ListOfActiveFunctionalAliasCriteria", an "any" element with processContents set to "lax", and an "anyAttribute" element with processContents also set to "lax"?
q_44727.ground_truth: The name of the complexType is "RulesForAffiliationManagementType".

q_44728.question: What is the procedure when a request issued over the interface fails?
q_44728.ground_truth: When a request issued over the interface fails, the LIPF should raise an alert in the appropriate LI Operations and Management (O&M) system and further procedures are left to CSP policy to define.

q_44729.question: What is required for the network to change the UMTS codec during an ongoing speech call?
q_44729.ground_truth: The network shall send the new selected codec type in the NAS (Network Access Stratum) Synchronisation Indicator IE

q_44730.question: How does a UE determine the antenna ports of a serving cell for NB-IoT?
q_44730.ground_truth: The UE may derive cell-specific reference signal sequence and raster offset from the higher layer parameter eutra-CRS-SequenceInfo if the higher layer parameter operationModeInfo indicates inband-SamePCI for a cell.

q_44731.question: What action does the MME take if the UE Retention Information IE is set to 'ues-retained' in the S1 SETUP REQUEST message?
q_44731.ground_truth: The MME may accept the proposal to retain the existing UE related contexts and signalling connections by including the UE Retention Information IE set to 'ues-retained' in the S1 SETUP RESPONSE message.

q_44732.question: What should the target eNB do with the received FIRST DL COUNT Value IE in the EARLY STATUS TRANSFER message?
q_44732.ground_truth: The target eNB should use the received value as the COUNT of the first downlink SDU that the source eNB forwards to the target eNB.

q_44733.question: What is the purpose of the list of equivalent PLMNs in UE?
q_44733.ground_truth: The UE stores a list of equivalent PLMNs, which are regarded as equivalent to each other for PLMN selection and cell selection/re-selection. The same list is used by 5GMM, EMM, GMM and MM.

q_44734.question: What should the MCPTT client do when it receives a MONP message in a state where there is no handling specified for the MONP message?
q_44734.ground_truth: The MCPTT client discards the MONP message.

q_44735.question: What message should the UE send in order to request connectivity to an additional PDN and in what state should the UE enter?
q_44735.ground_truth: The UE should send a PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message including the requested APN to the MME, start timer T3482 and enter the state PROCEDURE TRANSACTION PENDING.

q_44736.question: Which AVP is mandatory for all Monitoring Event related requests and optional for Non-IP Data related requests?

q_44737.question: What is the name of the interface between the eNB and S-GW in the E-UTRAN architecture?
q_44737.ground_truth: The S1-U interface is responsible for connecting the eNB with the S-GW in the E-UTRAN architecture.

q_44738.question: What should the MCData client do when it receives a SIP MESSAGE request for notification of entry into a group geographic area?
q_44738.ground_truth: The MCData client should send a SIP 200 (OK) to the participating MCData function that sent the SIP MESSAGE request, display an indication to the user that they have entered a group geographic area, and execute the procedure in clause 8.2.2 to affiliate to the group indicated by the participating MCData function.

q_44739.question: What steps should the transmission control server interface follow when receiving a Transmission Request message from a transmission participant?
q_44739.ground_truth: The transmission control server interface should forward the Transmission Request message to the controlling MCVideo function and include all fields from the participant's message.

q_44740.question: What happens when a UE initiates a mobility registration update procedure during intra UE-AMF mobility?
q_44740.ground_truth: The AMF determines the conditions to trigger paging and initiates a paging request message to the IAB-donor gNB-du #2. The UE then initiates the UE Triggered Service Request procedure.

q_44741.question: In NB-S1 mode, what action does the MME take if the UE requested "SMS only" in the Additional update type IE and the MME decides to accept the attach request for EPS services and "SMS only"?
q_44741.ground_truth: The MME indicates "SMS only" in the Additional update result IE and sets the EPS attach result IE to "EPS only" in the ATTACH ACCEPT message.

q_44742.question: What should the network do when it receives a message with syntactically incorrect optional IEs?
q_44742.ground_truth: The network should take the same approach as the UE, which is to treat all syntactically incorrect optional IEs as not present in the message.

q_44743.question: In 4.3.5.2, what is the action to be taken by the UE when its periodic TAU timer expires and it is currently camping on an E-UTRAN cell or in ECM-CONNECTED state?
q_44743.ground_truth: If ISR is activated, the UE shall start the GERAN/UTRAN Deactivate ISR timer, and perform a Routing Area Update when it next returns to GERAN/UTRAN coverage. If the UE is EPS attached only and either camps on an E-UTRAN cell or is in ECM CONNECTED state when the UE's periodic LAU timer expires, the UE shall perform a Location Area Update procedure in NMO II or combined RA/LA update in NMO I when it next returns to GERAN/UTRAN coverage.

q_44744.question: Who is responsible for defining the reporting characteristics related to the data trustworthiness reports of an ML entity?
q_44744.ground_truth: The producer of ML training, testing, and AI/ML inference services should support a capability that enables an authorized MnS consumer to define these reporting characteristics.

q_44745.question: What is the structure of the MBSMulticastF1UContextDescriptor?
q_44745.ground_truth: The MBSMulticastF1UContextDescriptor is a sequence that consists of a multicastF1UContextReferenceE1, an mc-F1UCtxtusage, an mbsAreaSession (optional), and an iE-Extensions (optional).

q_44746.question: What is the procedure followed by the IWF in delivering the affiliation to the LMR system when a MCPTT user affiliates to the group?
q_44746.ground_truth: The procedure is outside the scope of the present document and is not specified.

q_44747.question: What is the purpose of the CN common GSM-MAP NAS system information element for the CS domain?
q_44747.ground_truth: The CN common GSM-MAP NAS system information element for the CS domain provides the MS with actual parameter settings of parameters relevant only for MM functionality.

q_44748.question: What is the test method for determining the delay in the sending direction for handset or headset UE?
q_44748.ground_truth: The delay is measured by subtracting the delays introduced by the test equipment from the measured value between the reference point and the electrical access point of the test equipment.

q_44749.question: What action does the P-CSCF take upon receiving an SDP offer from remote UE with an BFCP-based media in terms of SDP fingerprint attribute?
q_44749.ground_truth: The P-CSCF removes the SDP fingerprint attribute in the SDP offer for each end-to-access-edge protected BFCP-based media.

q_44750.question: In the context of the MCVideo group document, what does the `<mcvideo-allow-imminent-peril-call>` element indicate?
q_44750.ground_truth: The `<mcvideo-allow-imminent-peril-call>` element of an `<actions>` element of a `<rule>` element of the MCVideo group document indicates whether the identity matching the rule identified by the `<rule>` element is allowed to request an imminent peril call on the MCVideo group.

q_44751.question: What is the outcome if the value of timer T3346 is greater than the value of timer T3512 in a REGISTRATION REJECT message during a registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update?
q_44751.ground_truth: If the value of timer T3346 is greater than the value of timer T3512 in a REGISTRATION REJECT message during a registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update, the AMF sets the mobile reachable timer and the implicit de-registration timer such that the sum of the timer values is greater than the value of timer T3346.

q_44752.question: What should IAB-DU apply the performance requirements for PUSCH, assuming HARQ re-transmissions?
q_44752.ground_truth: The performance requirements for PUSCH assume HARQ re-transmissions and are based on a minimum required throughput for a given SNR.

q_44753.question: What should the AMF provide to the UE in a roaming case if it provides a Partially Allowed NSSAI?
q_44753.ground_truth: The AMF should provide mapping information of each S-NSSAI of the Partially Allowed NSSAI to the corresponding HPLMN S-NSSAI.

q_44754.question: Which notifications are valid for the IOC using the TopologicalServiceArea data type as one of its attributes?
q_44754.ground_truth: The clause 5.5, in TS 28.541, of the IOC using this data type as one of its attributes, shall be applicable.

q_44755.question: What message is sent by the AMF to the UDM for 3GPP access deregistration?
q_44755.ground_truth: The AMF sends a PATCH request to the resource representing the UE's AMF registration for 3GPP access.

q_44756.question: What types of information can the ANDSF provide to the UE?
q_44756.ground_truth: The ANDSF can provide various types of information to the UE, which includes inter-system mobility policies, network access discovery information, and inter-system routing policies. The types of information it provides are determined by the operator's requirements and the roaming agreements.

q_44757.question: How is the Random Access Preamble selected for NB-IoT UEs if ra-PreambleIndex and PRACH resource are explicitly signalled?
q_44757.ground_truth: If the ra-PreambleIndex signalled is not 000000, the Random Access Preamble is set using the formula nprach-SubcarrierOffset + nprach-NumCBRA-StartSubcarriers + (ra-PreambleIndex modulo (nprach-NumSubcarriers - nprach-NumCBRA-StartSubcarriers)). Otherwise, the Random Access Preamble is selected based on the PRACH resource and support for multi-tone Msg3 transmission.

q_44758.question: What is the difference between an MnS consumer and an Exposed MnS consumer?
q_44758.ground_truth: An MnS consumer is equivalent to an Exposed MnS consumer with the difference that an MnS consumer is inside the trust domain of the CSP or NOP, while an Exposed MnS consumer is outside the trust domain of the CSP or NOP.

q_44759.question: What parameters does SSR Orbit Corrections provide the GNSS receiver with regarding satellite orbit corrections?
q_44759.ground_truth: SSR Orbit Corrections provides the GNSS receiver with parameters for orbit corrections in radial, along-track, and cross-track components, as well as correlation time and orbit error rate for integrity purposes.

q_44760.question: What action should a participating MCVideo function take if it receives a SIP REFER request for a pre-established session with a "SIP 500 (Server Internal Error)" response?
q_44760.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function may reject the SIP INVITE request with a SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response and include a Retry-After header field. It shall not continue with the rest of the steps.

q_44761.question: What should the UE do when it does not have geographical location information available and does not have a URI that points to the location information during an emergency call?
q_44761.ground_truth: The UE shall not insert a Geolocation header field in the INVITE request.

q_44762.question: What is the procedure when switching the connection of the System Simulator (SS) from the FF probe to the NF probe in order to determine the NF Tx beam peak direction?
q_44762.ground_truth: The procedure involves switching the connection of the SS from the FF probe to the NF probe at range length r1, positioning the device so that the NF probe antenna is pointed towards the FF TX beam peak direction, and performing a NF BP search on a sector around the FF BP direction at range length r1 to determine the NF Tx beam peak direction.

q_44763.question: What is the difference between online and offline charging in the present document?
q_44763.ground_truth: Online charging is a charging mechanism where charging information affects the service rendered in real-time, while offline charging is a charging mechanism where charging information does not affect the service rendered in real-time.

q_44764.question: Which procedures requesting the creation of PDN connection, creation or modification of bearers, or creation of data forwarding tunnel should be given the lowest level of priority and would be throttled during network congestion resulting in denial of new services?
q_44764.ground_truth: Create Session Request during PDN connection request, Create Bearer Request, Update Bearer Request, Bearer Resource Command, Modify Bearer Command, and Create Indirect Data Forwarding Tunnel Request.

q_44765.question: Which HTTP method should be used by the NF Service Consumer to request the retrieval of a list of NF instances that are currently registered in NRF?

q_44766.question: What is the requirement for the probability of false detection of the ACK in 8.3.6.1 in TS 36.104?
q_44766.ground_truth: The probability of false detection of the ACK shall be 0.01 or less.

q_44767.question: What is one potential standardization area for interactive immersive media services?
q_44767.ground_truth: One potential standardization area is cross-layer design, with radio and 5G system optimizations for QoS support.

q_44768.question: Which HTTP protocol versions are required to be supported by the 5GMS AF at interfaces M1 and M5?
q_44768.ground_truth: The 5GMS AF shall expose both HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 endpoints at interfaces M1 and M5.

q_44769.question: How are NAS messages exchanged between the UE and AMF secured during inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode?
q_44769.ground_truth: The UE generates the mapped 5G NAS security context from the NAS security related parameters received in the AS signalling from the AMF. After the inter-system change in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode, the UE sends the REGISTRATION REQUEST message integrity protected using the mapped 5G NAS security context and the AMF decides whether to take the native or mapped 5G NAS security context into use. From that point forward, all NAS messages exchanged between the UE and AMF are sent integrity protected and, except for specific messages, ciphered using the chosen security context.

q_44770.question: What should the MME do with the related MBMS bearer contexts when an Iu path failure is detected by the RNC, and the corresponding MBMS bearer contexts are not re-established via any S4-SGSN?
q_44770.ground_truth: The S4-SGSN should maintain the related MBMS bearer contexts but shall locally delete the RNC related information, i.e., Iu related resources, for all MBMS service associations.

q_44771.question: What is the purpose of the exchange of information between UE-A and UE-B?
q_44771.ground_truth: The purpose of the exchange of information is to give UE-B information about resource occupancy acquired by UE-A which it might not be able to determine on its own due to hidden nodes, exposed nodes, persistent collisions, etc.

q_44772.question: Which device type in the 5G STandalone AR (STAR) UE provides all UE functionalities and is referred to as a STandalone AR UE?
q_44772.ground_truth: The device type that includes all UE functionalities and is referred to as a STandalone AR UE is the 5G STandalone AR (STAR) UE.

q_44773.question: What should the UE do when it receives an ATTACH COMPLETE message during the combined attach procedure?
q_44773.ground_truth: Upon receiving the ATTACH COMPLETE message, the UE should stop timer T3450, enter state EMM-REGISTERED, and set the EPS update status to EU1 UPDATED. Additionally, the UE should forward the ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message to the ESM sublayer, and when the bearer context has been activated, send an ATTACH COMPLETE message together with an ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT message to the network. The UE should also reset the attach attempt counter and the tracking area updating attempt counter, and set the EPS update status to EU1 UPDATED.

q_44774.question: When can AMF send the satellite backhaul category to PCF?
q_44774.ground_truth: It is sent when the UE is accessing gNB with satellite backhaul, and AMF is aware of the satellite backhaul category.

q_44775.question: What state does the AMF move the UE to if it releases the UE context after not being able to buffer MT data for the remaining eDRX cycle?
q_44775.ground_truth: The AMF moves the UE to CM-Idle state.

q_44776.question: What is the maximum number of times the element "xs:any" with processContents "lax" can appear in the XML schema?
q_44776.ground_truth: The maximum number of times the element "xs:any" with processContents "lax" can appear in the XML schema is 1.

q_44777.question: What is the difference between the first digit values in the version number (x in the document)?
q_44777.ground_truth: The first digit of the version number indicates the stage of the document's development: 0 for information, 1 for approval, and 3 or higher for TSG-approved documents under change control.

q_44778.question: What is the purpose of the T5068 timer in the 5G DDNMF discoveree request procedure?
q_44778.ground_truth: The T5068 timer is used in the 5G DDNMF discoveree request procedure to assign a validity timer for the ProSe response code, ProSe query code, and discovery query filter(s).

q_44779.question: What is the purpose of the "<choice>" stereotype in UML?
q_44779.ground_truth: The "<choice>" stereotype represents one of a set of classes (when used as an information model element) or one of a set of data types (when used as an operations model element) to support scenarios where the specific kind of class or data type cannot be determined at model specification time.

q_44780.question: What message is sent by the AMF to inform the source NG-RAN node that resources for the handover have been prepared at the target side?

q_44781.question: What action is taken by the target MME when the timer at the target MME expires in step 7?
q_44781.ground_truth: The target MME starts a timer if the target MME applies indirect forwarding, and informs the Serving GW that it is now responsible for all the EPS bearers the UE has established.

q_44782.question: What actions should the AMF take if the UE has included a ngKSI indicating a current 5G NAS security context in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message, but the AMF cannot retrieve the current 5G NAS security context as indicated by the ngKSI and 5G-GUTI sent by the UE?
q_44782.ground_truth: The AMF should treat the REGISTRATION REQUEST message as failed the integrity check and take actions as specified in subclause~4.4.4.3.

q_44783.question: When is the deletion of bearers between the Serving GW and the MME considered complete?
q_44783.ground_truth: When the Serving GW receives a Delete Bearer Response from the MME

q_44784.question: What are the general requirements for 3GPP enhancement for TV service support?
q_44784.ground_truth: The general requirements for 3GPP enhancement for TV service support include on-demand network capacity assignment for TV services, support for downlink only broadcasting based on a set of EPS functionalities and entities, on-demand network broadcast service area coverage management for TV transport services, support for content delivery up to UHD resolution, and support for combinations of SD, FHD and UHD resolution TV transport services.

q_44785.question: What mechanism can be used for indication of packets to be retransmitted and informing the sender of loss of particular RTP packets for sender to take necessary actions to recover from errors?
q_44785.ground_truth: Generic NACK message can be used for indication of packets to be retransmitted as well as informing the sender of loss of particular RTP packets for sender to take necessary actions to recover from errors.

q_44786.question: Which UE parameter formulation was agreed to be used for the UE co-channel Tx model, as it is a minimum performance requirement rather than a typical requirement?
q_44786.ground_truth: The formulation from the current specification is being used for the UE co-channel Tx model.

q_44787.question: When should the UE associate the PDU session with the control plane only indication after an inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode?
q_44787.ground_truth: When the EPS bearer context(s) of the PDN connection are associated with the control plane only indication and the PDN connection supports interworking to 5GS.

q_44788.question: What are the frequency bands to be used for calculating the sending sensitivity of handset terminals in SLR measurement?
q_44788.ground_truth: For calculating the sending sensitivity of handset terminals in SLR measurement, the 14 frequency bands from 220 Hz to 8 kHz (bands 4 to 17 in ITU-T Recommendation P.79) should be used.

q_44789.question: What is the maximum rate of ACK/NACK feedback loss allowed on any active E-UTRA serving cell when CSI and RRM measurements are performed on NR SCell(s) in dormancy?
q_44789.ground_truth: 0.5% and 1.0% for CSI and RRM measurements, respectively.

q_44790.question: What are the possible subcounters for the measurement DANS.SerSubReceived in 5.18.3.1.1?
q_44790.ground_truth: Subcounters per service name, subcounters per Analytics ID, and subcounters per S-NSSAI.

q_44791.question: What property does the "IntentHandlingCapability" data type contain that describes the expectation object type which can be supported by a specific intent handling function of MnS producer?
q_44791.ground_truth: The "supportedExpectationObjectType" property of the "IntentHandlingCapability" data type describes the expectation object type which can be supported by a specific intent handling function of MnS producer.

q_44792.question: Under what conditions will a UE stay in the current serving cell and attempt to use the rejected S-NSSAI(s) after reaching the maximum number of UEs?
q_44792.ground_truth: When the UE wants to obtain services in the current serving cell without performing a PLMN selection or SNPN selection and has rejected NSSAI for the maximum number of UEs reached.

q_44793.question: What is the effect of having a DNN in both the Traffic descriptor and Route Selection Descriptor of a USRP rule in terms of DNN replacement policy for UEs?
q_44793.ground_truth: To provide uniform service experience for UEs from earlier Releases, when a USRP rule with a DNN in both, Traffic descriptor and Route Selection Descriptor, is provided to the UEs, the DNN(s) used in the Traffic descriptor would also need to be included in the policy for DNN replacement in the network. In addition, a lower priority Route Selection Descriptor without a DNN would also need to be provided to the UEs.

q_44794.question: What components contribute to the user interaction delay in the context of gaming?
q_44794.ground_truth: The user interaction delay in gaming consists of the time taken to capture user interaction in the game client, deliver it to the game engine/server, and process it by the game engine/server.

q_44795.question: What parameter reveals the information of the last radio contact of the UE based on the Last UE Activity Time?
q_44795.ground_truth: The Last UE Activity Time parameter indicates the most recent available point in time of the UE's last radio contact.

q_44796.question: What does the "Constraints" clause in W4.5.2 indicate?
q_44796.ground_truth: This clause indicates whether there are any constraints affecting attributes and each constraint is defined by a triplet (propertyName, affectedAttributes, propertyDefinition).

q_44797.question: What should the S-NG-RAN node do if it receives an S-NODE ADDITION REQUEST message containing a S-NG-RAN node UE XnAP ID IE that does not match any existing UE Context that has such ID?
q_44797.ground_truth: The S-NG-RAN node should reject the procedure using the S-NODE ADDITION REQUEST REJECT message.

q_44798.question: What action should the UE take if the EPS services are not allowed in the current PLMN?
q_44798.ground_truth: The UE shall set the EPS update status to EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED and delete any GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI List and eKSI. The UE shall reset the tracking area updating attempt counter and shall enter the state EMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH.

q_44799.question: What are the two possible values for the update flag in the POST request for the NumOfUEsUpdate service operation?
q_44799.ground_truth: The two possible values for the update flag in the POST request for the NumOfUEsUpdate service operation are "INCREASE" for a UE to be registered to a specific slice, and "DECREASE" for a UE to be deregistered from a specific slice.

q_44800.question: What should an AMF consider when determining its paging strategy?
q_44800.ground_truth: The AMF should take into consideration whether a gNB is using Paging subgrouping based on the UE's temporary ID.

q_44801.question: If the received SIP INVITE request includes a specific alert-info header field value, what should the MCVideo client do?
q_44801.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should not give any indication of the progress of the call to the MCVideo user.

q_44802.question: What are the common mandatory fields within E-CIDMeasurementInitiationRequest-IEs and E-CIDMeasurementInitiationResponse-IEs?
q_44802.ground_truth: The common mandatory fields within E-CIDMeasurementInitiationRequest-IEs and E-CIDMeasurementInitiationResponse-IEs are id-E-SMLC-UE-Measurement-ID, which specifies the measurement ID between the eNodeB and the E-SMLC UE.

q_44803.question: What should the UE do if access for "originating signalling" is barred in NB-S1 mode and the detach signalling procedure cannot be started?
q_44803.ground_truth: The UE stays in the current serving cell and applies the normal cell reselection process. Further UE behavior is implementation specific.

q_44804.question: What is the role of the eNB in RAN-assisted codec adaptation?
q_44804.ground_truth: The eNB sends a codec adaptation indication with a recommended bit rate to assist the UE in selecting or adapting to a codec rate for MMTEL voice or MMTEL video in RAN-assisted codec adaptation.

q_44805.question: What action does the NG-RAN take if the AMF provides a Target NSSAI and the current TA does not support it?
q_44805.ground_truth: The NG-RAN may apply redirection or handover of the UE to a cell in another TA supporting the Target NSSAI.

q_44806.question: What is the role of 5G system in providing QoS for a service in the described use case?
q_44806.ground_truth: The 5G system provides the required QoS (e.g. reliability, end-to-end latency, and bandwidth) for a service and supports prioritization of resources when necessary for that service.

q_44807.question: What should the UE do if the back-off timer is used in N1 mode for a PLMN and APN combination and the network indicates that re-attempt in S1 mode is not allowed?
q_44807.ground_truth: The UE should not send any BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message in this PLMN for the same APN after inter-system change to S1 mode until the timer expires, the UE is switched off or the USIM is removed.

q_44808.question: What action should the UE take if T421 expires or if the target L2 U2N Relay UE changes its serving PCell to a different cell before path addition or change and MCG transmission is not suspended?
q_44808.ground_truth: The UE shall initiate the indirect path failure information procedure as specified in clause 5.7.3c to report indirect path addition/change failure.

q_44809.question: What is the responsibility of the PIN server when the life cycle of a PIN has ended or the PIN server decides to stop providing PIN service in a PIN?
q_44809.ground_truth: The PIN server should trigger a PIN delete procedure to the PEMC which manages the PIN.

q_44810.question: What is the probability of false detection of the ACK parameter defined as in NPUSCH format 2 test?
q_44810.ground_truth: The probability of false detection of the ACK is defined as a conditional probability of erroneous detection of the ACK when input is only noise.

q_44811.question: What should the gNB do before starting a trace recording session for immediate MDT or logged MDT for selected UE(s) that satisfy the MDT UE selection criteria?
q_44811.ground_truth: The gNB should activate a cell trace session for immediate MDT or logged MDT in the gNB from the management system for the given cell(s) before starting the trace recording session.

q_44812.question: How do UEs establish a connection in the IAB network utilizing MBSR mobility?
q_44812.ground_truth: UEs can establish a connection via the cells served by MBSR. The IAB-DU and m-CU pair form the serving gNB for the UEs, and standard procedures are used without impacting the UE.

q_44813.question: What is the method used by the target ng-eNB to validate the UE request and retrieve the UE context when a RRC Resume Request message is received?
q_44813.ground_truth: The target ng-eNB extracts the I-RNTI from the RRC Resume Request message and contacts the source ng-eNB based on the information in the I-RNTI, sending an Xn-AP Retrieve UE Context Request message that includes the I-RNTI, ShortResumeMAC-I, and target Cell-ID, in order to validate the UE request and retrieve the UE context.

q_44814.question: What should the PC5 QoS rule identifier, PQFI, packet filters, and precedence value be passed to in the lower layers for 5G ProSe communication over PC5?
q_44814.ground_truth: The PC5 QoS rule identifier, PQFI, packet filters, and precedence value should be passed to the lower layers for further processing and communication.

q_44815.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for inter-band EN-DC within FR1 and FR2 in TS 38.101-3?
q_44815.ground_truth: The spurious emissions requirement for E-UTRA single carrier and CA operation specified in clauses 7.9.1 and 7.9.1A of TS 36.101, and NR single carrier and CA operation specified in clauses 7.9 and 7.9A of TS 38.101-1 apply. The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.101-3 clause 7.9B.5.

q_44816.question: What is the purpose of the CONNECT message in the Call Control service class?
q_44816.ground_truth: The CONNECT message is used to indicate call acceptance by the Mobile terminated user, and call control is requested to attach the user connection if it is not yet attached.

q_44817.question: When does the cardinality of a data structure in the response body indicate the presence condition of the data structure?
q_44817.ground_truth: The cardinality of a data structure in the response body indicates the presence condition of the data structure when it is set to "0..1" for a presence condition of "C" or "O", and to "1" for a presence condition of "M".

q_44818.question: What operation is performed on the HARQ-ACK information bits of the first and second transport blocks when harq-ACK-SpatialBundlingPUCCH is provided to the UE?
q_44818.ground_truth: A binary AND operation is performed.

q_44819.question: What is the duration of time period T1 in the test procedure?
q_44819.ground_truth: T1 is the duration of time before the UE has timing information of cell 2.

q_44820.question: What should a UE do when it determines that the plink transmission timings based on timing adjustment indications from an MCG and an SCG are different?
q_44820.ground_truth: The UE should adjust the transmission timing for PUSCH/SRS/PUCCH on all serving cells in the band with the synchronous contiguous intra-band EN-DC based on the timing adjustment indication for a TAG from a serving cell in MCG in the band.

q_44821.question: What is the requirement for the cell re-selection delay to an already detected cell in the described test scenario?
q_44821.ground_truth: The cell re-selection delay to an already detected cell should be less than a total of 7.68 seconds (allowed to be 8 seconds) in this test case.

q_44822.question: What factor, aside from a DRX cycle of 160 ms, can cause an increase in the number of failures in beam switch rate?
q_44822.ground_truth: A lower number of beams per RRH

q_44823.question: How many Trace Recording Sessions can be associated with a single Trace Reference in a UE trace session?
q_44823.ground_truth: There can only be one Trace Recording Session Reference per Trace Reference at one given time for a UE trace session. So there shall be only one TR/TRSR to be propagated during NG and Xn handover.

q_44824.question: What is the definition of AI/ML Inference History in 5.2.1.4?
q_44824.ground_truth: AI/ML Inference History is an IOC that contains the critical properties and modules needed to accomplish ML Testing, including the list of MLInferenceHistoryRequests, the list of ML entities, and MLInferenceHistoryReporting to report on MLInferenceHistoryRequests or their related outcomes.

q_44825.question: What information does the S-AMF send to the S-RAN in the Handover Command message when uplink packets are sent from T-RAN to T-UPF and UPF (PSA) and downlink packets are sent from UPF (PSA) to S-RAN via S-UPF?
q_44825.ground_truth: The S-RAN should start forwarding of downlink data from the S-RAN towards the T-RAN towards QoS Flows or DRBs subject to data forwarding. This may be either direct (step~3a) or indirect forwarding (step~3b).

q_44826.question: What should the media descriptions in the SDP offer of the SIP INVITE request look like if the corresponding "m=" line in the hname "body" URI header field in the URI of the Refer-To header field of the SIP REFER request has zero value for the port?
q_44826.ground_truth: The port in the "m=" line of the SDP offer should be set to zero.

q_44827.question: What information does the SMF deliver to the SM-PCF for the PCF to verify the appropriate RSD provided by the UE in the PDU Session Establishment request?
q_44827.ground_truth: Among the Route selection components in URSP rules, the SMF should deliver the DNN, S-NSSAI, PDU Session Type, Access Type, SSC Mode, PDU Session Pair ID, and RSN to the SM-PCF.

q_44828.question: What is the required confidence level for assessing whether the UE's L1-RSRP report meets the specified requirements in the EN-DC FR1 CSI-RS-based L1-RSRP measurement in non-DRX test?

q_44829.question: What is the requirement for measuring the average throughput in step 8 of the procedure?
q_44829.ground_truth: The average throughput should be measured for a sufficient duration to achieve statistical significance as specified in Annex H.2A.

q_44830.question: What is necessary for the 5G system to support authentication of a UE with 3GPP credentials for communication with entities in a CPN?
q_44830.ground_truth: The CPN needs to be connected with the 5G core network.

q_44831.question: When should the UE include its IMEISV in the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message?
q_44831.ground_truth: If the UE supports at least one 3GPP access technology, it must include its IMEISV in the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message when the AMF indicated it was required in the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message.

q_44832.question: Which solutions have no RAN dependency?
q_44832.ground_truth: Solution #18 and Solution #23 have no RAN dependency.

q_44833.question: What action will log off the MCPTT client from the MCPTT service?
q_44833.ground_truth: Removing the MCPTT service settings by setting the Expires header field to zero will log off the MCPTT client from the MCPTT service.

q_44834.question: When should the UE set the RQoS bit to "Reflective QoS supported" in the 5GSM capability IE of the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message?
q_44834.ground_truth: The UE should set the RQoS bit to "Reflective QoS supported" in the 5GSM capability IE of the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message if it supports reflective QoS and it requests to establish a new PDU session of "IPv4", "IPv6", "IPv4v6" or "Ethernet" PDU session type, it requests to transfer an existing PDN connection in the EPS of "IPv4", "IPv6", "IPv4v6", or "Ethernet" PDN type or of "Non-IP" PDN type mapping to "Ethernet" PDU session type, to the 5GS, or it requests to transfer an existing PDN connection in an untrusted non-3GPP access connected to the EPC of "IPv4", "IPv6" or "IPv4v6" PDN type to the 5GS.

q_44835.question: What is the formula for nominal channel spacing in operating band n263?
q_44835.ground_truth: Nominal Channel spacing = ceil((BWChannel(1) + BWChannel(2))/100.8)*50.4 MHz

q_44836.question: What should the SMF do if it detects a mismatch between the UE EPS security capabilities and the one received from the UE during an interworking-handover from EPS to 5GS?
q_44836.ground_truth: The SMF shall send an N2 CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message to inform the target ng-eNB about the correct UE EPS security capabilities and the target ng-eNB shall take the new UE EPS security capabilities into account.

q_44837.question: In the context of antenna ports, what is the property of "quasi co-located"?
q_44837.ground_truth: Two antenna ports are said to be quasi co-located if the large-scale properties of the channel over which a symbol on one antenna port is conveyed can be inferred from the channel over which a symbol on the other antenna port is conveyed, with the large-scale properties including one or more of delay spread, Doppler spread, Doppler shift, average gain, average delay, and spatial Rx parameters.

q_44838.question: What does the 5GMSu-Aware Application do upon deciding to activate the streaming service transmission?
q_44838.ground_truth: The 5GMSu-Aware Application provides the Service Access Information to the 5GMSu Client to initiate the streaming service transmission.

q_44839.question: What is the required total layer 2 buffer size for NR sidelink communication?
q_44839.ground_truth: The required total layer 2 buffer size for NR sidelink communication is the maximum value of the calculated values based on the formula max(MaxSLtxDataRate * RLC RTT + MaxSLrxDataRate * RLC RTT) for each band combination and the applicable Feature Set combination in the supported NR sidelink band combinations. The RLC RTT for NR sidelink communication corresponds to the smallest SCS numerology supported in the band combination and the applicable Feature Set combination.

q_44840.question: What is the fate of successfully received PDCP SDUs at the UE upon handover?
q_44840.ground_truth: Upon handover, all successfully received PDCP SDUs are delivered to the upper layers in the UE.

q_44841.question: When does an eCall only mobile station that is not capable of eCall over IMS initiate a routing area updating procedure in 3GPP TS 24.008?
q_44841.ground_truth: An eCall only mobile station that is not capable of eCall over IMS shall not perform a normal or combined routing area updating procedure.

q_44842.question: What is the general blocking referred to in subclause 7.4.1?
q_44842.ground_truth: General blocking is the ability of the receiver unit to receive a wanted signal at its assigned channel in the presence of an unwanted interferer inside the operating band.

q_44843.question: What must the target eNodeB node do if it has different stored UE radio capabilities compared to the radio capabilities applicable to the target eNodeB node?
q_44843.ground_truth: The target eNodeB node must trigger retrieval of the E-UTRA radio capability information again from the UE.

q_44844.question: What should be met for any transmitter setting?
q_44844.ground_truth: Throughput requirements defined for the radiated receiver characteristics.

q_44845.question: What should the network initiate when the handover procedure is cancelled, and the IMS session re-establishment is required?
q_44845.ground_truth: The network should send a NOTIFICATION message to the UE, indicating "SRVCC handover cancelled, IMS session re-establishment required".

q_44846.question: What should the terminating MCData client do upon receiving an MSRP SEND request from the terminating participating function?
q_44846.ground_truth: The terminating MCData client should process the received MSRP SEND message as a message arriving from the originating side, after decapsulating the payload in SRTP/UDP/IP packets transmitted on an MBMS bearer towards the terminating MCData client.

q_44847.question: In what situation must the UE set the TIN to "GUTI" and stop the periodic routing area update timer T3312 or T3323, if running?
q_44847.ground_truth: When the network informs the UE about the support of specific features in the EPS network feature support information element and the UE is required to set the TIN to "GUTI" as per the conditions specified in the 3GPP TS 24.008.

q_44848.question: Who is responsible for specifying the mapping of W-5GAN resources and 5GC QoS for the FN-CRG?
q_44848.ground_truth: CableLabs is responsible for specifying the mapping of W-5GAN resources and 5GC QoS for the FN-CRG.

q_44849.question: What must the HSS support in terms of barring a Public User Identity from being used for non-registration procedures?
q_44849.ground_truth: The HSS must support the possibility to bar a Public User Identity from being used for IMS non-registration procedures, and the S-CSCF must enforce these barring rules for IMS.

q_44850.question: What does the Length field represent in the floor control messages?
q_44850.ground_truth: The Length field is coded as specified in clause~8.1.2 for each of the floor control messages, indicating the length of the message in 32-bit words, excluding the fixed 32-bit words at the beginning of the message.

q_44851.question: How can Reference UEs in the SL Positioning Server UE role gather information about nearby Reference UEs or ranging "constellations"?
q_44851.ground_truth: Reference UEs in the SL Positioning Server UE role can gather information by performing ranging discovery, exchanging capabilities and location information, or performing ranging with such nearby Reference UEs. This information can then be used to invite other Reference UEs to join a ranging session for sidelink positioning of a Target UE.

q_44852.question: What is a possible function of the Network Exposure Function (NEF) in the 5G Core Network?
q_44852.ground_truth: The Network Exposure Function (NEF) in the 5G Core Network exposes network information and capabilities to an Edge Computing Application Function.

q_44853.question: When TRIV indicates N < sl-MaxNumPerReserve, what happens to the starting sub-channel indexes for the last resources?
q_44853.ground_truth: The starting sub-channel indexes corresponding to sl-MaxNumPerReserve minus N last resources are not used.

q_44854.question: What information is included in the resource representation returned to the 5GMSd Application Provider after creating an umbrella Provisioning Session?
q_44854.ground_truth: The resource representation includes a Provisioning Session Identifier and a canonical 5GMSd AS host name for the Provisioning Session.

q_44855.question: What is the purpose of the capability transfer procedure in SL-AoA and SL-TDOA positioning methods?
q_44855.ground_truth: The capability transfer procedure in SL-AoA and SL-TDOA positioning methods is used to determine the capabilities of the User Equipment (UE) for positioning, and to ensure that both UEs have compatible capabilities and settings for successful positioning.

q_44856.question: What should the NG-RAN node store upon receiving the PDU Session Resource Setup Request List IE in the INITIAL CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message?
q_44856.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node should behave the same as defined in the PDU Session Resource Setup procedure and report the result for each PDU session resource requested to be set up in the INITIAL CONTEXT SETUP RESPONSE message.

q_44857.question: What is the purpose of sending the SYNCH-UL sequence to cell 2?
q_44857.ground_truth: The SYNCH-UL sequence is sent in the UpPTS to cell 2 to check if it is received less than 650 ms from the beginning of T2. If it is received within this time, the number of successful tests is increased by one else, the number of failure tests is increased by one.

q_44858.question: What is the maximum allowed overall delay in the test?
q_44858.ground_truth: The maximum allowed overall delay in the test is 170 ms.

q_44859.question: What should the PCF do if it receives a "307 Temporary Redirect" response when sending a policy update notification request?
q_44859.ground_truth: The PCF should resend the failed policy update notification request using the received URI in the Location header field as Notification URI.

q_44860.question: What should the SCC AS do if it receives a SIP 180 (Ringing) response to the SIP INVITE request from the served user in any of the existing early dialogs associated with the additional transferred session?
q_44860.ground_truth: The SCC AS includes an application/vnd.3gpp.state-and-event-info+xml MIME body with the state-info XML element containing "early" and the direction XML element containing the "receiver" or "initiator" depending on the type of call.

q_44861.question: What must the VAE-C do upon receiving an HTTP POST request containing a V2X message?
q_44861.ground_truth: The VAE-C must evaluate the content of the <result> element.

q_44862.question: What is the role of the length of the Zadoff-Chu sequence in determining the length of zero correlation zones in random access preambles?
q_44862.ground_truth: The length of the Zadoff-Chu sequence determines the number of chips in the sequence, which in turn determines the length of the zero correlation zones in the cyclically shifted versions of the sequence used for random access preambles.

q_44863.question: In which scenarios, apart from the non-roaming case, is the procedure for UE-initiated resource request and release utilized?
q_44863.ground_truth: This procedure is utilized for the Non-Roaming, Roaming, and Local Breakout cases

q_44864.question: What is the result of the MBS session stop request in the 5GS when the MCPTT server decides to stop the corresponding MBS session?
q_44864.ground_truth: The 5GS removes the joined MCPTT UEs from the corresponding MBS session in case of multicast sessions, releasing the respective network resources.

q_44865.question: What is the role of the PIN-1 reference point in the application enablement layer architecture?
q_44865.ground_truth: The PIN-1 reference point allows for interaction between the PIN client and the application client on the PINE to provide and consume services.

q_44866.question: What is one way to improve the federated learning model?
q_44866.ground_truth: Providing feedback on the federated learning model performance in real-world applications

q_44867.question: What should the UE do if it is not registered in its HPLMN or in a PLMN within the EHPLMN list, and it needs to start a back-off timer for a PDU session modification procedure?
q_44867.ground_truth: The UE should use the default value of 12 minutes for the back-off timer.

q_44868.question: What is the purpose of the eNodeB Control Plane Relocation Indication procedure in Control Plane CIoT EPS Optimisation?
q_44868.ground_truth: The eNodeB Control Plane Relocation Indication procedure in Control Plane CIoT EPS Optimisation is used to request the MME to authenticate the UE's re-establishment request and initiate the establishment of the UE's S1 connection and, if necessary, the S11-U connection after the UE has initiated a RRC Re-establishment procedure in a new eNodeB.

q_44869.question: What is the pre-test condition for the system simulator in test case 9.2.3.1.4.3.1?
q_44869.ground_truth: The system simulator in test case 9.2.3.1.4.3.1 has cells A, B, C, and D with specific TAI and PLMN values.

q_44870.question: What is the purpose of the "Steering Functionality" in the context of Access Traffic Steering, Switching, and Splitting (ATSSS) rules?
q_44870.ground_truth: The "Steering Functionality" in the context of ATSSS rules identifies whether the Multi-Path Transmission Control Protocol (MPTCP) functionality, the Multi-Path Quic functionality, or the Access Traffic Steering, Switching, and Splitting - Link Layer (ATSSS-LL) functionality should be used to steer the traffic of the matching SDF. This is used when the UE supports multiple functionalities for ATSSS.

q_44871.question: What should the gNB-CU-CP consider when selecting UEs for MDT data collection?
q_44871.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-CP should consider if the UE is in the specified area and if the serving PLMN is within the Management Based MDT PLMN List when selecting UEs for MDT data collection.

q_44872.question: What is the requirement for the Error Vector Magnitude as per the minimum requirement for E-UTRA and NB-IoT?
q_44872.ground_truth: The Error Vector Magnitude should be within the limit specified by the minimum requirement for E-UTRA and NB-IoT.

q_44873.question: What network entities are responsible for collecting charging information per QoS flow for roamers in Local Breakout scenarios?

q_44874.question: What is the required total handover delay for the test to pass?
q_44874.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the total number of successful tests should be more than 90% of the cases with a confidence level of 95%.

q_44875.question: What is the role of the notify-remote-user element in remotely initiated group call requests?
q_44875.ground_truth: The notify-remote-user element in remotely initiated group call requests indicates whether the remote MCPTT user should be notified of the call request.

q_44876.question: What is the difference in frequency between the two cells for which the SS-RSRQ measurement accuracy is being compared in this case?
q_44876.ground_truth: The two cells are on different frequencies in FR2 (Frequency Range 2) of the NR (New Radio) band.

q_44877.question: What is the purpose of the frequency modulation test in 6.5.2.4?
q_44877.ground_truth: The purpose of the frequency modulation test in 6.5.2.4 is to verify that frequency error is within the limit specified by the minimum requirement.

q_44878.question: What should the SCEF do when it receives an HTTP POST message from the SCS/AS with the trigger payload for the "Procedures for Device Triggering"?
q_44878.ground_truth: The SCEF shall create a resource "Individual Device Triggering Transaction" which represents the triggering transaction and shall respond to the SCS/AS with a 201 Created message, including the trigger and a Location header field containing the URI for the created resource.

q_44879.question: What entity receives the packet description from AF and provides it to the user plane node in 5GS treatment?

q_44880.question: What is the minimum requirement for co-location intermodulation level in NR interfering signal for IAB type 1-H?
q_44880.ground_truth: The minimum requirement is that the transmitter intermodulation level should not exceed the unwanted emission limits in clauses 6.6.3, 6.6.4, and 6.6.5 in the presence of an NR interfering signal.

q_44881.question: What should the UE do when receiving a timing advance command in slot n in test 2?
q_44881.ground_truth: In test 2, the UE should adjust its uplink timing at the first subframe boundary following n+8 slot when it receives a timing advance command in slot n.

q_44882.question: Which entities need to support the emergency request service indication in the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay?
q_44882.ground_truth: PCF supports the provisioning of RSCs associated with emergency services, and AMF/SMF supports the service indication associated with emergency request from the Remote UE.

q_44883.question: When does a GPRS MS in MS operation modes B need to initiate the combined routing area updating procedure after the circuit-switched transaction has been released?
q_44883.ground_truth: After the circuit-switched transaction has been released, if the MS has changed the RA during the circuit-switched transaction.

q_44884.question: Who can include the Response-Source header field in SIP messages?
q_44884.ground_truth: A SIP UA or SIP proxy can include the Response-Source header field when responding to a SIP request with an error response.

q_44885.question: What does the AMF do with ciphering key information when the validity period has expired?
q_44885.ground_truth: The AMF deletes all information for a ciphering key when the validity period has expired.

q_44886.question: What is the responsibility of the UAE layer in providing assistance at change of USS for partially overlapping multi-USS deployments based on UAV location tracking for change of USS/UTM during flight?
q_44886.ground_truth: The UAE layer provides assistance at change of USS for partially overlapping multi-USS deployments based on UAV location tracking for change of USS/UTM during flight.

q_44887.question: What action does the BM-SC take when it receives a STR~message from a GGSN in the BM-SC initiated de-registration procedure?
q_44887.ground_truth: The BM-SC removes the identifier of the GGSN from the "list of downstream nodes" parameter of the corresponding MBMS Bearer Context and confirms the operation by sending a STA message to the GGSN.

q_44888.question: What action should the SMF/CUC take if the procedure is abnormally completed due to a transient communication failure over N4?
q_44888.ground_truth: The SMF/CUC considers the SMF/CUC-initiated Set procedure complete, but the AN-TL/CN-TL does not revert the execution of the operations included in the SET Request message.

q_44889.question: What is the role of the source UE in the Layer-3 UE-to-UE Relay communication setup procedure?
q_44889.ground_truth: The source UE is responsible for sending the Discovery Request or Link Modification Request to the UE-to-UE Relay based on whether a PC5 link exists or not, and providing necessary information such as User Info ID and Layer-2 ID of the target UE, RSC, and end-to-end QoS.

q_44890.question: What is the role of the IAB-UE in the IAB architecture?
q_44890.ground_truth: The IAB-UE is responsible for managing the backhaul connectivity with the PLMN or SNPN it is registered with in the IAB architecture.

q_44891.question: What is the consequence if the IBCF receives a Privacy header field with a value different from "none"?
q_44891.ground_truth: The IBCF shall perform privacy protection as specified in RFC 3323, RFC 3325, and RFC 7044 with the clarifications above, if the Privacy header field with a value different from "none" is received.

q_44892.question: Which network functions are impacted when e2DCe IMS Data Channel media plane security is implemented?
q_44892.ground_truth: The P-CSCF, S-CSCF, IMS AS, and related Mw, ISC, DC2 interfaces are impacted when e2DCe IMS Data Channel media plane security is implemented.

q_44893.question: In what scenarios is the request to originate an MCPTT emergency group call considered to be an authorised request?
q_44893.ground_truth: The request to originate an MCPTT emergency group call is considered to be an authorised request if the <allow-emergency-group-call> element of the ruleset element of the MCPTT user profile document identified by the MCPTT ID of the calling MCPTT user is set to a value of "true" and the "entry-info" attribute of the <MCPTTGroupInitiation> element contained within the MCPTT-group-call element of the MCPTT user profile document contains the MCPTT group identity of the MCPTT group targeted by the calling MCPTT user or if the "entry-info" attribute of the <MCPTTGroupInitiation> element is set to "UseCurrentlySelectedGroup" and the <allow-MCPTT-emergency-alert> element of the actions element of a rule element of the ruleset element of the list-service element of the group document identified by the MCPTT group identity is set to a value of "true"

q_44894.question: What document specifies the converged offline and online charging description for the 5G Data Connectivity domain?
q_44894.ground_truth: The present document, 3GPP Technical Specification "3rd Generation Partnership Project; Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects; Telecommunication management; Charging management; 5G data connectivity domain charging; Stage 2 (Release 18)", specifies the converged offline and online charging description for the 5G Data Connectivity domain.

q_44895.question: What is the difference between RSSI and RSRP/RSRQ in NR?
q_44895.ground_truth: RSSI (Received Signal Strength Indication) is a variable that represents the received signal strength in the E-UTRAN/E-UTRA network, while RSRP/RSRQ (Reference Signal Received Power/Reference Signal Received Quality) is a variable that represents the received signal quality in the NR network. RSSI is defined as a variable that ranges from 0 to 63, while RSRP/RSRQ is defined as a variable that ranges from -131 to -25.

q_44896.question: In the context of clause 6.2D.1.6, what is the period of measurement for the minimum peak EIRP requirements for UEs with UL MIMO?
q_44896.ground_truth: The period of measurement for the minimum peak EIRP requirements for UEs with UL MIMO is at least one subframe (1ms).

q_44897.question: What should a UE do when switched off, for each PLMN-specific attempt counter that has a value greater than zero and less than the UE implementation-specific maximum value, for the determined PLMN with disaster condition?
q_44897.ground_truth: The UE shall consider the PLMN which sent the reject message is available for disaster roaming service for the respective determined PLMN with disaster condition.

q_44898.question: When shall the Core Network Restrictions be present in octets "(l+2) to (l+5)"?
q_44898.ground_truth: If Length of Core Network Restrictions is not zero, then the field of Core Network Restrictions in octets "(l+2) to (l+5)" shall be present.

q_44899.question: When does privacy verification information come from the application layer?
q_44899.ground_truth: The Located UE checks its locally available privacy profile to determine whether it is discoverable or not in terms of privacy. If the Located UE does not have locally available information, the network function responsible for generating and provisioning discovery keys checks the UE privacy profile after contacting the UDM.

q_44900.question: What is the difference between event based charging and session based charging in offline charging?
q_44900.ground_truth: In event based charging, each network or user event corresponds to a single chargeable event, while in session based charging, at least two chargeable events are needed to describe the start and end of a session, with multiple interim events possible for changes to session characteristics or limits.

q_44901.question: When should the 3gpp-Sbi-Target-apiRoot header be forwarded by an SCP that receives an HTTP request targeting a URI with an authority from a remote PLMN?
q_44901.ground_truth: The 3gpp-Sbi-Target-apiRoot header should be forwarded by an SCP that receives an HTTP request targeting a URI with an authority from a remote PLMN, so that the SEPP can use it to route the HTTP request to the target URI.

q_44902.question: What is one of the procedures for (Alt~B) to execute if the IP Address(es) of the UE is available after step~A1?
q_44902.ground_truth: One of the procedures for (Alt~B) to execute if the IP Address(es) of the UE is available after step~A1 is A.2 to A.5.

q_44903.question: What is the purpose of the "group chat modification xIRI" in an RCS group chat session?
q_44903.ground_truth: The "group chat modification xIRI" is generated by the IRI-POI in the RCS Server when it detects that a group chat session the target is participating in is modified.

q_44904.question: What should the UE do after receiving the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message from a PLMN?
q_44904.ground_truth: Upon receipt of the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message, the UE shall reset the registration attempt counter, enter state 5GMM-REGISTERED, and set the 5GS update status to 5U1 UPDATED.

q_44905.question: What is the valid SNR threshold used in 3GPP ACS requirements for QPSK level when the adjacent interferer is 32 dB higher than the wanted signal?
