q_45132.question: What is the situation when MBSFN service is not yet provided in a certain area?
q_45132.ground_truth: Either by MBSFN or by unicast, the service is not yet provided.

q_45133.question: In the context of Step 6, what happens when the Branching Point or UL CL has no traffic filter towards PSA1?
q_45133.ground_truth: The SMF sends a session release request with N4 session ID to PSA1, and PSA1 releases all tunnel resources and contexts associated with the N4 session.

q_45134.question: What is the function of the IRI-POI present in the NEF in handling xIRIs for NIDD using NEF?
q_45134.ground_truth: The IRI-POI present in the NEF handles xIRIs for NIDD using NEF, including PDU session establishment, modification, release, start of interception with established PDU session, and unsuccessful procedure events.

q_45135.question: What happens to the sidelink grant if the associated sidelink process does not have data to be sent?
q_45135.ground_truth: If there is no data to be sent in the associated sidelink process, the sidelink grant will be ignored.

q_45136.question: What must a UE support in order to perform SRS carrier based switching for SCells in E-UTRA FDD, TDD, and TDD-FDD dual connectivity?
q_45136.ground_truth: The UE must support the requirements defined in Section 8.8, provided that at least DL subframe #0 or DL subframe #5 per radio frame is available for measurements at the UE in the measurement cell.

q_45137.question: When should the UP function generate a usage report for a URR in a PFCP session, as requested by the CP function in a PFCP Session Modification Request?
q_45137.ground_truth: The UP function shall generate a usage report for the URR, ensure it is included in the PFCP Session Modification Response or in an additional PFCP Session Report Request message, and proceed as specified if the report is triggered due to a threshold or quota.

q_45138.question: What should the MS do when the SERVICE REJECT message contains GMM cause value #25 and is not integrity protected?
q_45138.ground_truth: The MS should discard the message and take different actions depending on the received reject cause value. For example, if the reject cause value is #3 or #6, the MS should consider the SIM/USIM as invalid for GPRS services and non-GPRS services until switching off or the SIM/USIM is removed.

q_45139.question: What is the role of the AMF in the PLMN when an S-NSSAI is associated with more than one Network Slice instance?
q_45139.ground_truth: The AMF instance serving the UE may logically belong to more than one Network Slice instance associated with the S-NSSAI when multiple Network Slice instances associated with the same S-NSSAI are deployed in the same Tracking Areas. In such cases, the network selects and serves the UE with only one Network Slice instance associated with the S-NSSAI at any one time, except in cases where the currently serving Network Slice instance is no longer valid in a given Registration Area or a change in the UE's Allowed NSSAI occurs.

q_45140.question: What is the logical entity that offers management capability to an Exposed MnS consumer called?

q_45141.question: What is the action taken when the SIP INVITE request for terminating participating MCPTT function is received for a user unable to participate in private calls?
q_45141.ground_truth: The terminating participating MCPTT function shall reject the SIP INVITE request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response, including warning text set to "127 user not authorised to be called in private call".

q_45142.question: Which UE-initiated PMFP procedures can be performed for a non-default QoS rule if the UE supports performance measurement function protocol procedures for it?
q_45142.ground_truth: The UE-initiated PMFP procedures that can be performed for a non-default QoS rule if the UE supports performance measurement function protocol procedures for it are UE-initiated RTT measurement procedure, access availability or unavailability report procedure, UE-initiated PLR measurement procedure, UE assistance data provisioning procedure, and UE assistance data termination procedure.

q_45143.question: What protocol does the UE use to send the "DELETE" payload to the ePDG for closing the incoming security associations associated with the tunnel?

q_45144.question: What is the purpose of the Additional Slice Information in TA granularity in the registration response?
q_45144.ground_truth: The Additional Slice Information in TA granularity in the registration response is provided to the UE to indicate the mapping between an S-NSSAI within the rejected S-NSSAIs and TAIs that can support such S-NSSAI, allowing the UE to start a registration update when it moves to a TA where the rejected S-NSSAI can be supported.

q_45145.question: What should the MCPTT client do if the in-progress emergency private priority state cancel request is rejected?
q_45145.ground_truth: The state of the session does not change, i.e. continues with MCPTT emergency private call level priority.

q_45146.question: What is the role of the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay in PC5 link security establishment between the source UE and the target UE?
q_45146.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay acts as a relay between the source UE and the target UE in PC5 link security establishment. It sends a Direct Communication Request message that contains Relay Service Code to the target UE to trigger the second hop PC5 link establishment. The UE-to-UE Relay verifies the Direct Security Mode Complete message from both the source UE and the target UE to assure that they are authorized to get the relay service. After successful verification, the UE-to-UE Relay sends a Direct Communication Ack message to the target UE to complete the PC5 connection establishment procedure.

q_45147.question: In which 5GMM state can a service request procedure or registration procedure be triggered to transition the UE from 5GMM-IDLE mode or 5GMM-IDLE mode with suspend indication to 5GMM-CONNECTED mode?
q_45147.ground_truth: A service request procedure or registration procedure can be triggered in 5GMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION-UPDATE state to transition the UE from 5GMM-IDLE mode or 5GMM-IDLE mode with suspend indication to 5GMM-CONNECTED mode.

q_45148.question: In the context of the solution 8, what does the discovery of management service exposure enable?
q_45148.ground_truth: The discovery of management service exposure enables the utilization of capabilities/features of the management system by applications, including the discovery of MnS and the capabilities of the network and analysis results from the NSCE Server.

q_45149.question: What is one of the potential standardization needs for viewport-dependent XR media delivery?
q_45149.ground_truth: One of the potential standardization needs for viewport-dependent XR media delivery is very high-bitrate and efficient/scalable streaming protocols.

q_45150.question: What is the requirement for prefixing attribute names when they have the same name in more than one class and different properties?
q_45150.ground_truth: The attribute names should be prefixed with the class name followed by a period.

q_45151.question: What should the S-CSCF do if the WAF or WWSF is barred?
q_45151.ground_truth: The S-CSCF shall send a 403 (Forbidden) response to the REGISTER request.

q_45152.question: What does the "rtx-time" payload-format-specific parameter specify in RTP retransmission?
q_45152.ground_truth: The maximum time a sender will keep an original RTP packet in its buffers available for retransmission

q_45153.question: In step 8a, what is the time interval between the start of CSI reporting for SCell1 and the first available uplink resource for reporting valid CSI, if subframe (m+54) cannot be used?
q_45153.ground_truth: The time interval is up to the end of T2.

q_45154.question: What type of AVP is the Serving-Node, and what does it contain?
q_45154.ground_truth: The Serving-Node AVP is of type Grouped, and it contains the name/number of the serving node to be used for T4-triggering.

q_45155.question: What are the potential impacts of GSMA OPG work on EAS discovery in the 5G architecture?
q_45155.ground_truth: The GSMA OPG work may have potential impacts on EAS discovery in the 5G architecture. The 5GS (5G System) should facilitate edge relocation between an EAS deployed by a source EHE provider to another EHE deployed by a target EHE provider, even in scenarios when EHEs are operated by different service providers.

q_45156.question: When the H-PCRF receives a Diameter CCR message indicating gateway control session termination in step 2b, which message does it send to the V-PCRF or BBERF in response?
q_45156.ground_truth: The H-PCRF acknowledges the session or subsession termination request by sending a Diameter CCA message to the V-PCRF or BBERF.

q_45157.question: What is the purpose of the Management Instruction function in the protocol?
q_45157.ground_truth: The Management Instruction function is responsible for managing the Inference function by making decisions based on data received from the Data Collection function and the Inference function.

q_45158.question: What should the number of transport blocks and HARQ-ACK bits be for a UE to use PUCCH format 4 and a PUCCH resource with a TPC field value to determine the PUCCH resource value?
q_45158.ground_truth: If the total number of HARQ-ACK bits and scheduling request bit (if any) and periodic CSI bits (if any) is more than 22.

q_45159.question: What is contained in the <transmission> element if the UE was out of E-UTRAN coverage?
q_45159.ground_truth: If the UE was out of E-UTRAN coverage, the <transmission> element contains a mandatory "amount" attribute indicating the amount of octets transmitted to the ProSe group during the out of E-UTRAN coverage period and an optional "timestamp" attribute indicating the date and time of the first transmission during the out of E-UTRAN coverage period.

q_45160.question: Which implementation option requires the initiation of the routing area updating procedure followed by a rerun of the service request procedure after a service request procedure was aborted due to a specific cause of RR release in Iu mode?
q_45160.ground_truth: Implementation option b.3 requires the initiation of the routing area updating procedure followed by a rerun of the service request procedure after a service request procedure was aborted due to a specific cause of RR release in Iu mode.

q_45161.question: When does the VLR send an SGsAP-RESET-ACK message to the MME upon receiving a HSS reset indication?
q_45161.ground_truth: After setting the NEAF for all registered UEs in the MME for which a valid SGs association with a VLR exists.

q_45162.question: What is the minimum required interference signal level for the co-location minimum requirement in BS type 1-C, relative to the rated total output power in the operating band?
q_45162.ground_truth: The interfering signal level is 30 dB below the rated total output power in the operating band for the co-location minimum requirement in BS type 1-C.

q_45163.question: What action does the network take if the UE moves out of its RNA and within RA while joined to multicast MBS session(s)?
q_45163.ground_truth: If the UE moves out of its RNA and within RA while joined to multicast MBS session(s) and the resumption of the RRC connection fails, the UE may initiate the Mobility Registration Update procedure with the MBS session information (i.e. whether the UE wants to join or leave a multicast MBS session) in the MBS session information container. The SMF then performs the corresponding multicast MBS session procedures based on the information in the MBS session information container, and the UE may be changed to RRC Inactive state to receive the MBS data.

q_45164.question: What criteria must be met for the L1-SINR test to pass?
q_45164.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the ratio of successful reported values in each test must be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

q_45165.question: What is the meaning of the term "survival time" as defined in the document?
q_45165.ground_truth: Survival time is the time that an application consuming a communication service may continue without an anticipated message.

q_45166.question: Which cell combinations are used for FDD and TDD basic multi cell environment in 4.4.1.3?
q_45166.ground_truth: Cell 1, Cell 10, and Cell 31 are used for FDD and TDD basic multi cell environment.

q_45167.question: What is the required spacing for NR carriers and E-UTRA carriers when added in TC21.1 for transmitter tests?
q_45167.ground_truth: The nominal carrier spacing defined in clause~4.5.1 shall apply.

q_45168.question: In what scenarios should the P-CSCF not forward a REGISTER request containing an "sos" SIP URI parameter in the Contact header field and not containing an Authorization header field?
q_45168.ground_truth: When the network supports IMS Services for roaming users in deployments without IMS-level roaming interfaces, the UE is roaming, there is no II-NNI to the HPLMN of the served user, and the access type is not set to "3GPP-NR-ProSe-L3UNR". Or, if required by operator policy and the UE is not roaming.

q_45169.question: What is the purpose of the FDD-FDD inter frequency absolute RSRP accuracy test for CA idle mode measurements for non-overlapping carriers?
q_45169.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to verify that the FDD-FDD inter frequency absolute RSRP accuracy for CA idle mode measurements for non-overlapping carrier is within the specified limits.

q_45170.question: What entities can use the UE side entities' service experience information and for what purpose?
q_45170.ground_truth: The application service provider or any other event can use the UE side entities' service experience information for predictions of application performance analytics, for determining the VAL server performance analytics, or for further analysis of the service experience report from other UEs to predict analytics.

q_45171.question: What is the variable that defines the interruption uncertainty in acquiring the first available PRACH occasion in the new cell in Dhandover1?

q_45172.question: What is the input information used in E-UTRAN activation mechanisms for management based MDT data collections without IMSI/IMEI(SV) selection?
q_45172.ground_truth: Area information and user consent information stored in the eNB.

q_45173.question: What should a MS do if it is IMSI attached and receives a ROAMING NOT ALLOWED status?
q_45173.ground_truth: The MS should set the update status to U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, delete any TMSI, LAI and ciphering key sequence number, reset the location update attempt counter and change to the MM IDLE state.

q_45174.question: What does the <TAC> in the Tracking Area Identity based N3IWF FQDN represent?
q_45174.ground_truth: The TAC (Tracking Area Code) together with MCC and MNC identifies the Tracking Area Identity the UE is located in.

q_45175.question: What should the UE do upon receipt of an AUTHENTICATION REJECT message with a valid integrity check during an unsuccessful authentication procedure if the network is operating in single-registration mode?
q_45175.ground_truth: The UE should handle the 5GMM parameters as specified in 3GPP TS 24.501 for the case when the authentication procedure performed over 3GPP access is not accepted by the network.

q_45176.question: What should the controlling MCPTT function do upon receipt of a SIP MESSAGE request for emergency notification for controlling MCPTT function if it is an unauthorized request for an MCPTT in-progress emergency group state cancellation and there is no ongoing call on the group on which the cancellation request is made?
q_45176.ground_truth: If the request does not contain an <alert-ind> element or is an unauthorized request for an MCPTT emergency alert cancellation, the system should reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response. Otherwise, the system should clear the cache of the MCPTT ID of the MCPTT user that has the outstanding emergency alert state and send a cancellation notification to affiliated members of the group.

q_45177.question: What is required for throttled Trace Recording Session in terms of clearing up?
q_45177.ground_truth: It shall be possible for the NE to clear up a throttled trace recording session if there are sufficient resources available within the NE.

q_45178.question: What is the role of the "any AMF" entity in the non UE associated NRPPa signalling in the "any AMF" solution?
q_45178.ground_truth: In the "any AMF" solution, for non UE associated NRPPa signalling, it is transmitted using the "any AMF" entity deployed in the campus network.

q_45179.question: What is the functionality of the MAG entity in PMIPv6?
q_45179.ground_truth: The MAG entity in PMIPv6 is responsible for termination of the UE-MAG link-local protocols and forwarding of user plane IP packets between the UE-MAG point-to-point logical link and the S2a tunnel for the UE.

q_45180.question: Which message is sent by the SS to the UE without integrity protection, but with integrity protection and ciphered after NAS security mode control procedure has been successfully completed?

q_45181.question: What should the participating MCPTT function do upon receipt of a SIP 2xx response to the SIP re-INVITE request in step 7?
q_45181.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT function should generate a SIP 200 (OK) response, include an SDP answer in the SIP 200 (OK) response, include Warning header field(s) that were received in the incoming SIP 200 (OK) response, include a P-Asserted-Identity header field in the outgoing SIP 200 (OK) response, send the SIP 200 (OK) response towards the MCPTT client, and interact with the media plane.

q_45182.question: What should the transmission participant do when it receives a Transmission Rejected message and the <User ID> value in the User ID field matches its own MCVideo ID and there is no stored current transmission arbitrator?
q_45182.ground_truth: The transmission participant should stop the timer T201 (Transmission Request), set the stored User ID of the current transmission arbitrator to the value in the User ID of transmission control server field as received in the Transmission Rejected message, provide transmission deny notification to the user, display the transmission deny reason to the user using information in the Reject Cause field, and enter 'O: has no permission' state.

q_45183.question: Which cell measurement procedure must the UE support for the 5G-SRVCC from NG-RAN to 3GPP UTRAN?
q_45183.ground_truth: The UE should support UTRAN cell measurement procedure.

q_45184.question: What are the three basic types of tests that an operator may expect when a new NF is delivered?
q_45184.ground_truth: The three basic types of tests are unit and acceptance tests, which involve testing the independent functioning of the NF; integration tests, which refer to limited functionality horizontal tests with other NF; and system tests, which refer to testing the NFs functioning as part of a complete NSSI, NSI, or communication service instance.

q_45185.question: When a VLR receives the SGsAP-IMSI-DETACH-INDICATION message during the implicit IMSI detach procedure, what should it do if the state of the SGs association is not SGs-NULL and the received MME name is the same as the one stored in the VLR?
q_45185.ground_truth: The VLR moves the state of the SGs association for the UE to SGs-NULL and marks the SGs association as "IMSI implicitly detached for EPS and non-EPS services".

q_45186.question: When would the MME include an "Old location area identifier" information element in an SGsAP-LOCATION-UPDATE-REQUEST message?
q_45186.ground_truth: The MME shall include the "Old location area identifier" information element if the UE included the old location area information in the ATTACH REQUEST or TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.

q_45187.question: What is the purpose of the "Buffering Action Rule (BAR)" in the PFCP session?
q_45187.ground_truth: The "Buffering Action Rule (BAR)" in the PFCP session provides instructions to control the buffering behavior of the UP function for all the FARs of the PFCP session set with an "Apply Action" parameter requesting the packets to be buffered and associated to this BAR.

q_45188.question: What does the Warning Area List consist of and how is it used?
q_45188.ground_truth: The Warning Area List consists of a list of Cell IDs, a list of TAIs, or one or more Emergency Area IDs. It is used by the eNodeB to identify the cells where to distribute the warning message. If it is absent, it is interpreted as "all cells on the eNodeB".

q_45189.question: What does the "mode" parameter represent in the context of UE modes of operation for EPS?
q_45189.ground_truth: The "mode" parameter in the context of UE modes of operation for EPS indicates the mode of operation, with possible values being PS mode 2, CS/PS mode 1, CS/PS mode 2, and PS mode 1.

q_45190.question: What information is provisioned to the UE for V2X communications over PC5 reference point?
q_45190.ground_truth: The provisioned information includes the authorization policy and radio parameters for when the UE is "not served by E-UTRAN".

q_45191.question: What is the reference point between the Media~AS and the Media Access Function in the UE for?
q_45191.ground_truth: Reference point M4 is for the purpose of downlink transport of media from the Media~AS to the Media Access Function (content distribution) or uplink transport of media from the Media Access Function to the Media~AS (content contribution).

q_45192.question: What is the format of the UE-CapabilityRAT-Container list?
q_45192.ground_truth: The UE-CapabilityRAT-Container list is a list of UE-CapabilityRAT-Container, where each UE-CapabilityRAT-Container contains the rat-Type and ue-CapabilityRAT-Container as octet string.

q_45193.question: What is the attribute "intent preemption capability" used for in MnS?
q_45193.ground_truth: The attribute "intent preemption capability" is used by the MnS consumer to specify whether the preemption will be triggered or not for their intent.

q_45194.question: What API is used to log the information related to service API invocations on the CAPIF core function?
q_45194.ground_truth: The Logging API invocations APIs, as defined in 3GPP TS 23.222, allow API exposing functions via CAPIF-3/3e reference points to log the information related to service API invocations on the CAPIF core function.

q_45195.question: What is the purpose of the HSS/AAA-initiated detach procedure for the Evolved Packet Core?
q_45195.ground_truth: The purpose of this procedure is to delete the UE from the Evolved Packet Core and initiate the detach procedure for each access system to which the UE is registered.

q_45196.question: What is the role of the RNC in the activation of a network request session?
q_45196.ground_truth: The RNC starts a network request session, with the Network request session id, for the duration of the network request session, the RNC checks for connections where the UE has the UE Application Layer Measurement Capability and starts a UE request session by sending a MEASUREMENT CONTROL message to the UE.

q_45197.question: What is the ratio of the highest frequency in a supported operating band to the lowest frequency in the same supported operating band?

q_45198.question: When should the SMF initiate a PDU Session modification to retrieve the current access network information of the UE?
q_45198.ground_truth: If the SMF receives a request to install/modify or remove a PCC rule with Access Network Information report parameters, the SMF should initiate a PDU Session modification to retrieve the current access network information of the UE and forward it to the PCF.

q_45199.question: What method is used by the I-CSCF to request for UE's authorization to register or establish a session?
q_45199.ground_truth: The I-CSCF sends a POST request (custom method: authorize) to request for UE's authorization to register or establish an originating/terminating session.

q_45200.question: Which types of E-UTRA UE does this test apply to?
q_45200.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 13 and forward that support DL LAA and have FGI bits 5 and 111.

q_45201.question: What is the purpose of the WT Modification procedure in LWA operation?
q_45201.ground_truth: The WT Modification procedure is used to modify, establish or release bearer contexts or properties of the UE context within the same WT, which can be initiated either by the eNB or the WT.

q_45202.question: What is the role of the NF Service Consumer in the release of RAN resources?
q_45202.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer shall request the source V-SMF or I-SMF to release the resources in the VPLMN without sending a PDU session release command to the UE.

q_45203.question: What is the expected format for the message sent in step 4 if the Correlation ID or SIPTO Correlation ID is included in step~4?
q_45203.ground_truth: The eNodeB shall use the included information to establish a direct user plane path to the L-GW and forward uplink data for Local IP Access or SIPTO at the Local Network with L-GW function collocated with the (H)eNB accordingly.

q_45204.question: What is the procedure used by a UE supporting NR sidelink U2N Relay UE operation to forward NR sidelink integrated discovery messages or Model B Discovery messages?
q_45204.ground_truth: The procedure is used to evaluate AS layer conditions and determine whether a UE is in proximity to a NR sidelink U2U Relay UE in Model A Discovery messages.

q_45205.question: What should the MCData client do when it receives a SIP MESSAGE request from the MCData server containing an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body with the Termination information type IE set to "EXTENSION RESPONSE FOR COMM OVER HTTP"?
q_45205.ground_truth: The MCData client should generate a SIP 200 (OK) response, send it towards the MCData server, and notify the user of the extension response based on the Extension response type IE.

q_45206.question: What is the meaning of "may" in 3GPP Technical Specifications?
q_45206.ground_truth: "May" indicates permission to do something within the context of normative provisions.

q_45207.question: What procedures shall the participating MCPTT function follow upon receiving a SIP BYE request for private call session when using a pre-established session?
q_45207.ground_truth: Upon receiving a SIP REFER request when using a pre-established session with the "method" SIP URI parameter set to value "BYE" in the URI in the Refer-To header field, the participating MCPTT function shall follow the procedures as specified in clause~6.3.2.1.7.

q_45208.question: What is the requirement defined in 6.5G.2.1.3 for the sum of the emissions from all UE transmit antenna connectors?
q_45208.ground_truth: The requirement defined in 6.5G.2.1.3 for the sum of the emissions from all UE transmit antenna connectors is that they shall meet the requirements for Out of band emissions resulting from the modulation process and non-linearity in the transmitters.

q_45209.question: What happens when the transmission control arbitration logic receives a request for an MCVideo call release from the application and signalling plane in the 'Releasing' state?
q_45209.ground_truth: When the transmission control arbitration logic receives a request for an MCVideo call release from the application and signalling plane in the 'Releasing' state, it releases all resources reserved in the media plane, including the state machines and any running timers.

q_45210.question: What is the role of IAK in the set up of initial trust for 5GC NFs?
q_45210.ground_truth: IAK is an initial credential that is distributed out-of-band between the operator CA/RA and the NF via OAM system, and is used as initial trust to authenticate the NF.

q_45211.question: What network element coordinates the tracing procedures for the VLR?
q_45211.ground_truth: The Tracing Co-ordinator process in the VLR is responsible for coordinating the tracing procedures for the VLR.

q_45212.question: What is required in the Accept-Contact header field when firing a trigger?
q_45212.ground_truth: The Accept-Contact header field should include the media feature tag g.3gpp.mcdata along with parameters "require" and "explicit" when firing a trigger.

q_45213.question: In which frequency range does the power of any spurious emission not exceed -27 dBm/MHz for BS operating in Band n13 and n14 in certain regions?
q_45213.ground_truth: The power of any spurious emission shall not exceed: -27 dBm/MHz, for BS operating in Band n13 and n14, within the frequency range from 10 MHz below the lowest frequency of the BS downlink operating band up to 10 MHz above the highest frequency of the BS downlink operating band.

q_45214.question: What should the confidence level be for the statistical pass/fail decisions?
q_45214.ground_truth: The confidence level should be 95% for the statistical pass/fail decisions.

q_45215.question: What is the purpose of 5G VN group communications in the 5G network?
q_45215.ground_truth: 5G VN group communications in the 5G network are used for enabling group communications, where each group maps to a DNN and slice that may be associated with its own QoS policies. Each group is associated with an IP multicast address or a set of IP singlecast addresses and QoS policies to allow for dedicated QoS parameters.

q_45216.question: How many PLMN-ids can a UE read from RK Resources?
q_45216.ground_truth: The UE can read up to 6 PLMN-ids from RK Resources.

q_45217.question: How can load balancing of S-CSCFs be based for received initial registration requests?
q_45217.ground_truth: Load balancing of S-CSCFs for received initial registration requests can be based on load balancing functionality performed by an I-CSCF or it can be based on mechanisms outside IMS functional entities, such as DNS. An example of DNS-based load balancing approach is using functionality that collects load information of S-CSCFs, applies a load balancing algorithm, and provides the outcome to a (Dynamic) DNS.

q_45218.question: What should a participating MCPTT function do when it receives a Floor Release Multi Talker message with a lower or the same message-sequence-number value as the stored one?
q_45218.ground_truth: It should discard the received Floor Release Multi Talker message.

q_45219.question: What should the UE do upon receiving a response with an SDP body, where the precondition mechanism is used, if the response includes the "precondition" option-tag in the Require header field?
q_45219.ground_truth: The UE should include a Require header field with the "precondition" option-tag in subsequent requests with an SDP body that the UE sends in the same dialog.

q_45220.question: What factors does RAN4 consider when evaluating ACS and ASCS guard RBs?
q_45220.ground_truth: RAN4 considers typical filter characteristic, including filter order, pass BW, and cut-off frequency, as well as RF impairment.

q_45221.question: What does V-SMF do after receiving a DNS query in step~11 of scenario~2.1 with HPLMN monitoring?
q_45221.ground_truth: V-SMF provides message handling rules to V-EASDF, including an ECS to append to the DNS query corresponding to the candidate local PSA and H-EASDF as the next DNS server to send the query to.

q_45222.question: What should the source SGSN include in the Forward Relocation Request message when the target cell is a CSG cell?
q_45222.ground_truth: The source SGSN should include the CSG ID in the Forward Relocation Request message when the target cell is a CSG cell.

q_45223.question: What step in the Non-IMS Origination procedure from an external SIP client involves the UE accepting the session with a 200 OK response?

q_45224.question: What information is provisioned in the UE in support of the UE assuming the role of a 5G ProSe End UE and thereby enabling the use of a 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay?
q_45224.ground_truth: Authorisation policy for using a 5G ProSe Layer-3 and/or Layer-2 UE-to-UE Relay, Policy/parameters for 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay Discovery, and validity time indicating the expiration time of the Policy/Parameter for 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay discovery and communication.

q_45225.question: What is the initial condition for the ACS test procedure?
q_45225.ground_truth: The initial condition for the ACS test procedure is that the test environment is normal, as specified in annex B. RF channels to be tested for single carrier (SC) are M, and SAN RF Bandwidth positions to be tested for multi-carrier (MC) are MRBW for single-band connector(s).

q_45226.question: What action should a UE take if the UE is not authorized for restricted 5G ProSe direct discovery model A announcing?
q_45226.ground_truth: The UE should abort the discovery procedure if it is not authorized for restricted 5G ProSe direct discovery model A announcing.

q_45227.question: In the "Shared Risk" principle described in the 3GPP Technical Specification, when would the probability of a borderline good UE being judged as FAIL be greater than the probability of a borderline bad UE being judged as PASS?
q_45227.ground_truth: When the core specification value is relaxed by a positive relaxation value (TT>0).

q_45228.question: What is the timing accuracy required for the normative reference in event reporting?
q_45228.ground_truth: The timing accuracy required for the normative reference in event reporting is 3GPP TS 36.133.

q_45229.question: What is the required condition for sending an RRC message to release PSCell (Cell 2) during T3?
q_45229.ground_truth: The UE must have sent at least one CQI report with a non-zero CQI index for PSCell (Cell 2) during T3.

q_45230.question: How does the AMF determine the central NSACF in the 5GS only slices solution?
q_45230.ground_truth: The AMF determines the central NSACF by discovering the NSACF performing the PLMN global counting and updating the NF profile for the NSACF to indicate that it is the central NSACF for the S-NSSAI handling the PLMN global count for 5GS slices.

q_45231.question: Which solutions propose to use mobility registration procedure when UE moves outside RA and why?
q_45231.ground_truth: Solution #20, #21, and #28 propose to use mobility registration procedure when UE moves outside RA. Solution #20 and #21 propose this to allow a UE to request MBS session join/leave during mobility registration update procedure, and Solution #28 proposes this because the UE may initiate the mobility registration after the RNA update procedure fails.

q_45232.question: What event information is reported by the PCF to AF via NEF for an untrusted AF in 5GS?
q_45232.ground_truth: Event information reported by PCF to AF via NEF in case of untrusted AF in steps 8-19 of the QoS monitoring procedure.

q_45233.question: What information does the NG-RAN node provide in the SECONDARY RAT DATA USAGE REPORT message?
q_45233.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node reports in the SECONDARY RAT DATA USAGE REPORT message location information of the UE in the User Location Information IE.

q_45234.question: What is the process for a UE to be authorized for V2X communication over the PC5 reference point?
q_45234.ground_truth: The UE gets authorization to use V2X communications over PC5 reference point on a per PLMN basis in the serving PLMN by the V2X Control Function in the HPLMN. The V2X Control Function in the HPLMN requests authorization information from the V2X Control Function of the serving PLMN and merges authorization information from home and serving PLMNs to inform the UE of the final authorization information.

q_45235.question: What is the purpose of the LSA Identifier information element in the 3GPP TS 24.008 protocol?
q_45235.ground_truth: The LSA Identifier information element in the 3GPP TS 24.008 protocol uniquely identifies a LSA (Location Area).

q_45236.question: What is used as the sequence number for the challenge in the bootstrapping procedure?
q_45236.ground_truth: The sequence number for the challenge in the bootstrapping procedure is the bootstrapping transaction identifier (B-TID).

q_45237.question: What is the role of S-CSCF#1 in step 6 in the Refer operation information flow?
q_45237.ground_truth: In step 6, S-CSCF#1 invokes appropriate service logic for the Refer operation, stores the "Refer-To" and "Referred-By" information and replaces them with private URIs.

q_45238.question: What is the purpose of the variable Bj in the Logical Channel Prioritization procedure?
q_45238.ground_truth: The variable Bj is maintained for each logical channel j and initialized to zero when the logical channel is established. It incremented by the product of PBR and T (time elapsed since Bj was last incremented) before every instance of the LCP procedure.

q_45239.question: What information does the W-AGF send to the selected AMF during the initial registration process for the FN-RG?
q_45239.ground_truth: The W-AGF sends a Registration Request to the selected AMF within an N2 initial UE message that includes the NAS Registration Request, ULI, Establishment cause, UE context request, Allowed NSSAI, and Authenticated Indication.

q_45240.question: What is the requirement for starting the HARQ RTT Timer in a subframe?
q_45240.ground_truth: A HARQ RTT Timer expires in this subframe and the data in the soft buffer of the corresponding HARQ process was not successfully decoded.

q_45241.question: What is the definition of "Mapped 5QI" in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_45241.ground_truth: 5QI that is used for a DRB within the gNB when a single 5QI is assigned to the DRB, used for separating certain measurements per QoS class.

q_45242.question: How does the DS-TT maintain the Disabled, Initializing and Faulty state for the PTP ports?
q_45242.ground_truth: While in Disabled, Initializing or Faulty state, the port in the DS-TT discards any (g)PTP messages it may receive from the upstream PTP instance or from the NW-TT via user plane.

q_45243.question: What is the relationship between the NF management lifecycle and certificate management lifecycle that needs to be considered in the design of an automated certificate management for SBA?
q_45243.ground_truth: The NF management lifecycle and certificate management lifecycle need to be considered together in the design of an automated certificate management for SBA, because certificates are issued for NFs and their lifecycles have some relations.

q_45244.question: What is the formula for calculating the Uplink power control window size for NR CC?
q_45244.ground_truth: The Uplink power control window size for NR CC is calculated as 1dB (UE power step~size) + 0.7dB (UE power step tolerance) + (Test system relative power measurement uncertainty).

q_45245.question: What is the maximum measurement reporting delay specified in the requirement?
q_45245.ground_truth: The maximum measurement reporting delay specified in the requirement is 7682 ms.

q_45246.question: Which network entity is responsible for activating or deactivating the list of hosting network(s) for a UE to access a hosting network for localized services?
q_45246.ground_truth: The list of hosting network(s) can be activated or deactivated by either the UE or the home network.

q_45247.question: What is the type of data exchanged in AR Telephony Communication based on Data Channel?
q_45247.ground_truth: The AR specific data, which is some additional information related to the multimedia audio or video, is transported through data channel over SCTP/DTLS.

q_45248.question: What should the AMF do if the Trace Recording Session is not terminated, regarding the deactivation of the Trace Session in NG-RAN?
q_45248.ground_truth: The AMF should not deactivate the Trace Session in NG-RAN.

q_45249.question: What is the length of the sensing window used by a sensing UE to maintain a moving sensing window in the immediate past of which resources have been reserved by other UEs?
q_45249.ground_truth: The sensing window is 1000 ms long for FDD systems.

q_45250.question: What does the <Group regroup alias length> value represent in the MBMS notifications control message?
q_45250.ground_truth: The <Group regroup alias length> value is a binary value indicating the length in octets of the <Group regroup alias> value item except padding.

q_45251.question: What are the potential uses of standalone sessions in PFCP session contexts?
q_45251.ground_truth: Standalone sessions in PFCP session contexts are used for forwarding signalling between network functions, such as RADIUS, Diameter, or DHCP, or for forwarding End Marker packets.

q_45252.question: What is the test requirement for the number of missed ACK/NACKs during T3 for Test 1 and Test 2?
q_45252.ground_truth: For Test 1, at least 98.75% of all expected ACK/NACKs during T3 shall be transmitted by the ProSe UE. For Test 2, at least 97.5% of all expected ACK/NACKs during T3 shall be transmitted by the ProSe UE.

q_45253.question: What is the method to facilitate non-critical extensions at the end of the message or at the end of a field that is contained in a BIT or OCTET STRING?
q_45253.ground_truth: Non-critical extensions at the end of the message or at the end of a field that is contained in a BIT or OCTET STRING are facilitated by use of an empty sequence that is marked OPTIONAL.

q_45254.question: What should the 5G-RG acting on behalf of the AUN3 device do when it receives an AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message containing an EAP-request message from the network?
q_45254.ground_truth: The 5G-RG acting on behalf of the AUN3 device should stop timer T3520, if running, and then provide the EAP-request message to the AUN3 device as normally.

q_45255.question: What is the action taken by the UE when the serving cell fulfills Srxlev < ThreshServing, LowP and a cell of a lower priority RAT/frequency fulfills Srxlev > ThreshX, LowP during a time interval TreselectionRAT and more than 1 second has elapsed since the UE camped on the current serving cell?
q_45255.ground_truth: The UE shall reselect a cell from the lower priority RAT/frequency that fulfills the criteria.

q_45256.question: When does the network include a "force to standby" information element in GMM signalling procedures?
q_45256.ground_truth: The network includes the "force to standby" information element to indicate whether or not the READY timer should be stopped when returning to the GMM-REGISTERED state.

q_45257.question: What is the purpose of the tests in 9.2.5.1 and 9.2.5.2?
q_45257.ground_truth: The purpose of the test in 9.2.5.1 is to verify that FDD absolute RSRQ measurement accuracy in carrier aggregation is within the specified limits under AWGN propagation conditions, while the purpose of the test in 9.2.5.2 is to verify that FDD relative RSRQ measurement accuracy in carrier aggregation is within the specified limits under AWGN propagation conditions.

q_45258.question: What must the MME do if the UE indicated support for restriction on use of enhanced coverage and the network decides to restrict the use of enhanced coverage for the UE?
q_45258.ground_truth: The MME must set the RestrictEC bit to "Use of enhanced coverage is restricted" in the EPS network feature support IE of the ATTACH ACCEPT message.

q_45259.question: What should the MnF of performance assurance generate for the object instance of NRCellRelation MOI(s) referring to the neighboring gNB CU NF in the performance data file reporting service?
q_45259.ground_truth: The MnF of performance assurance generates the measurement for the object instance of NRCellRelation MOI(s) referring to the neighboring gNB CU NF in the performance data file reporting service.

q_45260.question: Which model in the 5G ProSe Direct Discovery category has the feature of an application-controlled extension?
q_45260.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe Direct Discovery Model A with application-controlled extension is the model in the 5G ProSe Direct Discovery category with this feature.

q_45261.question: What is the role of UE1 in step 6b?
q_45261.ground_truth: UE1 instigates the SLPP Location Information Transfer procedure among UEs 1 to n, and obtains sidelink location measurements in this step.

q_45262.question: What action should the controlling MCData function take if it receives an invalid combination of data in a SIP request for a priority communication?
q_45262.ground_truth: The controlling MCData function should send a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response with the warning text set to "150 invalid combinations of data received in MIME body" in a Warning header field.

q_45263.question: What action does the P-GW take, when it decides to release the IPv4 address for deferred IPv4 addressing?
q_45263.ground_truth: The P-GW informs the accounting server about the deallocation of the IPv4 address by sending a RADIUS Accounting-Request Interim-Update without the Framed-IP-Address attribute.

q_45264.question: What type of issues are addressed in the document?
q_45264.ground_truth: The present document addresses the issues related to control plane signalling, security, numbering/naming/addressing, and user plane issues such as transport protocol, media and codecs.

q_45265.question: What should the SC UE do if, after vSRVCC procedures, it is not using ICS capabilities and there are remaining media components in the IMS session other than speech and video?
q_45265.ground_truth: The SC UE should send a SIP re-INVITE request to the SCC AS to indicate the removal of the speech and video media components.

q_45266.question: What is the method used by the NEF to report the UP path management event notification to the AF?
q_45266.ground_truth: The Event Notification is used by the NEF to report the UP path management event notification from the SMF to the AF.

q_45267.question: What is the maximum overall delays measured allowed in the test case?
q_45267.ground_truth: The overall delays measured shall be less than a total of 2882 ms in this test case.

q_45268.question: What method is used to modify operator specific data in the UDR?
q_45268.ground_truth: The PATCH method is used to modify operator specific data in the UDR.

q_45269.question: What TS value is given by, k-Offset, in the determination of time and frequency pre-compensation for a BL/CE UE communicating over NTN?
q_45269.ground_truth: The value of k-Offset provided by higher layers, through the higher layer parameter k-Offset, is given by, k-Offset, in the determination of time and frequency pre-compensation for a BL/CE UE communicating over NTN.

q_45270.question: Which feature-list ID does the S6c application use?
q_45270.ground_truth: The S6c application uses the Feature-List-ID AVP value of 1.

q_45271.question: What specification defines the test tolerances used to relax the minimum requirements in the present specification?

q_45272.question: What is the role of the UPF as an anchor point in Intra-/Inter-RAT mobility?
q_45272.ground_truth: The UPF serves as an anchor point for Intra-RAT or Inter-RAT mobility, allowing seamless mobility between different Radio Access Technologies (RATs) while maintaining session continuity.

q_45273.question: What message is sent by the transmission control interface towards the MCVideo client in the 'U: permitted' state when it receives a Transmission Grant message with the first bit in the subtype set to '1'?
q_45273.ground_truth: The Transmission Grant message is forwarded to the associated transmission participant.

q_45274.question: What should the MRFC do when it receives an ACK request for a session?
q_45274.ground_truth: When the MRFC receives an ACK request for a session, this may be considered as an event to direct the MRFP to start the playing of a tone or announcement.

q_45275.question: What should the SEPP do when it receives an HTTP request from a NF with a request URI containing a telescopic FQDN and a 3gpp-Sbi-Target-apiRoot header?
q_45275.ground_truth: The SEPP should ignore the 3gpp-Sbi-Target-apiRoot header and route the request using the telescopic FQDN.

q_45276.question: What should a UE do if it detects a cell in a higher priority search but reselection has not occurred?
q_45276.ground_truth: The UE is not required to continuously measure the detected cell to evaluate the ongoing possibility of reselection.

q_45277.question: What protocol stack is used for the user plane of the PC5 interface in NR sidelink communication?
q_45277.ground_truth: The AS protocol stack for user plane in the PC5 interface consists of SDAP, PDCP, RLC and MAC sublayers, and the physical layer.

q_45278.question: What action does the SNRM-S take when the sender of an HTTP POST request for network assisted QoS management initiation is not an authorized user?
q_45278.ground_truth: The SNRM-S responds with an HTTP 403 (Forbidden) response and avoids the rest of the steps.

q_45279.question: What information does the UAE server provide to the USS when providing a notification about a possible change of USS?
q_45279.ground_truth: The UAE server provides information about the UAV location from the 3GPP network and policies from the USS for multi-USS deployment.

q_45280.question: What is the message content in 8.23.3.4.3?
q_45280.ground_truth: The message content is the same as in clause 8.23.1.4.3.

q_45281.question: What parameters does the UE or application supplier need to provide to indicate the information of the application using network slicing during testing?
q_45281.ground_truth: The UE or application supplier is recommended to provide the following parameters: the application's traffic descriptor, the corresponding application data, the UE's policy section management list, and the UE's policy part.

q_45282.question: What is the role of the UE in this process, and what actions does it take?
q_45282.ground_truth: The UE establishes redundant PDU sessions with the 5G network using updated URSP rules. This allows for the creation of redundant SEALDD traffic for increased reliability.

q_45283.question: What is the role of the BGCF in Procedure S-S#3?
q_45283.ground_truth: The BGCF determines that the MGCF should be in the same network and selects a MGCF in that network. The BGCF then forwards the request to the MGCF when the destination is the PSTN, as in S-S#3.

q_45284.question: What must a UE ensure when sending a UE POLICY PROVISIONING REQUEST message?
q_45284.ground_truth: The UE must allocate a PTI value currently not used, set the PTI IE to the allocated PTI value, include the Requested UE policies IE indicating whether the UE policies for V2X communication over PC5, the UE policies for V2X communication over Uu or both are requested.

q_45285.question: What is the difference between S-NSSAI and Allowed S-NSSAI in the context of 5G networks?
q_45285.ground_truth: S-NSSAI stands for Session Network Slice Selection Assistance Information, while Allowed S-NSSAI refers to the set of network slice selection assistance information that an AMF determines is allowed for the UE in a given location.

q_45286.question: How does data generation differ between model training and network-side model inference in beam management use cases?
q_45286.ground_truth: During model training, data can be generated by either the UE or gNB, while for network-side model inference, input data is generated by the UE and terminated at the gNB. For UE-side model inference, input data is internally available at the UE.

q_45287.question: What is the role of the NRF in generating SCP Domain Routing Information when all SCPs in the network can be managed by the same NRF?
q_45287.ground_truth: The NRF managing the SCPs can generate the SCP Domain Routing Information accordingly without involvement of other NRFs, if all SCPs in the network can be managed by the same NRF.

q_45288.question: What action should an MS supporting S1 mode take if the ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message contains no indication that ISR is activated?
q_45288.ground_truth: The MS shall set the TIN to "P-TMSI" and shall stop the periodic tracking area update timer T3412 or T3423, if running.

q_45289.question: What is the purpose of PRU (de)activation?
q_45289.ground_truth: PRU (de)activation is used to enable or disable the PRU for assisting location service, and it can be triggered by LMF based on LCS requirements.

q_45290.question: What are the initial conditions for testing the performance requirements for PUCCH format 2 ACK detection in the IAB-DU tester?
q_45290.ground_truth: The initial conditions for testing the performance requirements for PUCCH format 2 ACK detection in the IAB-DU tester are a normal test environment and single carrier M frequency channels.

q_45291.question: For which test case is the testability still under analysis for bands other than n257, n258, n260, and n261?
q_45291.ground_truth: The testability is under analysis for 6.5A.3.3.4, 6.5A.3.3.5, 6.5A.3.3.6, and 6.5A.3.3.7.

q_45292.question: What is the condition for the high layer in TS 38.331 signalling of smtc2 to be present?
q_45292.ground_truth: The high layer in TS 38.331 signalling of smtc2 is present when TSMTCperiod follows smtc2.

q_45293.question: What message does the source UTRAN (HSPA) send to the target SGSN when it decides to trigger a handover to GERAN for a 3GPP SRVCC UE?
q_45293.ground_truth: Relocation Required (Target ID, Source to Target Transparent Container, SRVCC Handover Indication) message.

q_45294.question: What is the function of the AC association Profile in the enhanced Discover T-EAS procedure?
q_45294.ground_truth: It includes information about an association between ACs on an UE and other ACs indicating that the use of a common EAS is required, and is used in the EAS discovery request to determine whether a common EAS is available for the associated ACs.

q_45295.question: What should be included in the SRB Modified List IE for successfully modified SRBs with logical channel identities for the primary path, if CA based PDCP duplication is initiated for the concerned SRBs?
q_45295.ground_truth: The SRB Modified List IE should include effectively modified SRBs with logical channel identities for the primary path, if CA based PDCP duplication is initiated for the concerned SRBs.

q_45296.question: In what scenario should the UE initiate a PDU session modification procedure by sending a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message to delete the mapped EPS bearer context with 5GSM cause #44?
q_45296.ground_truth: When a packet filter consists of conflicting packet filter components that would render the packet filter ineffective, after sending the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMPLETE for the ongoing PDU session modification procedure.

q_45297.question: What standard specifies the format and procedure for exchanging JOSE protected messages over the N32 interface in 3GPP networks?

q_45298.question: What is the purpose of the service continuity request in V2X service continuity management?
q_45298.ground_truth: The service continuity request is used by the VAE server to determine the VAE server for serving a VAE client when moving to a new geographical area. The VAE servers send a service continuity response to VAE server 1 after receiving the service continuity request, and the local service information is provided to the VAE client via V1-AE reference point.

q_45299.question: What is the outcome if all the EPS bearers of the UE have emergency ARP value and the new MME proceeds with the update location procedure and it fails?
q_45299.ground_truth: If all the EPS bearers of the UE have emergency ARP value, the new MME may skip the update location procedure and the TAU procedure will proceed, but if the update location procedure is initiated and it fails, the MME releases any local MME EPS Bearer contexts for this particular UE.

q_45300.question: What information can the RAN provide to the PSA UPF regarding congestion for a GBR QoS Flow?
q_45300.ground_truth: The RAN can provide congestion information for both uplink and downlink of a GBR QoS Flow to the PSA UPF.

q_45301.question: How long is the measurement period TMeasurement Period, GSM for 32 GSM carriers being measured?
q_45301.ground_truth: For a Measurement Gap Repetition Period (MGRP) of 80ms, Mgsm is equal to ceil (Ncarriers, GSM /20) where Ncarriers, GSM is the number of GSM carriers on which cells are being measured, so for 32 GSM carriers being measured, TMeasurement Period, GSM is 160ms.

q_45302.question: What is the action taken by the GGSN when the allocated IPv4 address is released?
q_45302.ground_truth: The GGSN informs the accounting server about the deallocation of the IPv4 address by sending Diameter Accounting-Request INTERIM-UPDATE without the Framed-IP-Address AVP.

q_45303.question: What does the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network (TSG RAN) focus on in the present document?
q_45303.ground_truth: The 3GPP TSG RAN focuses on establishing the TRP (Total Radiated Power) and TRS (Total Radiated Sensitivity) requirements for NR UEs operating on Range 1 Standalone and Range 1 Interworking operation with other radios.

q_45304.question: What method should the NF Service Consumer use to retrieve an MBS distribution session in the MBSTF?
q_45304.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer should use the HTTP GET method to retrieve an MBS distribution session in the MBSTF.

q_45305.question: How many bits in Octet 5 of the Steering Mode Indicator IE are reserved for future use and must be set to "0"?

q_45306.question: What is the requirement for NGAP to be extended to indicate the "selected NID" in addition to the "Selected PLMN identity" in the INITIAL UE MESSAGE?
q_45306.ground_truth: The requirement is due to the lack of "selected NID" in the INITIAL UE MESSAGE in Rel-17 for untrusted non-3GPP access, as SNPN support was limited to 3GPP access.

q_45307.question: Which message is used by IAB-MT to request the network to allocate IP addresses for the collocated IAB-DU or inform the network about IP addresses allocated to the collocated IAB-DU?

q_45308.question: What protocol should an SNRM-S use to generate a POST request message for MBMS bearer suspension reporting?
q_45308.ground_truth: The SNRM-S should use HTTP protocol, specifically an HTTP POST request, to send a message for MBMS bearer suspension reporting.

q_45309.question: What should the UE do if the new cell is better ranked than the serving cell for a time interval of TreselectionRAT in TS 36.304, clause 5.2.4.4?
q_45309.ground_truth: The UE shall reselect the new cell only if the conditions are met: the new cell is better ranked than the serving cell during a time interval TreselectionRAT, and more than 1 second has elapsed since the UE camped on the current serving cell.

q_45310.question: How can in-coverage UEs use V2X sidelink transmission resource pools during handover?
q_45310.ground_truth: In-coverage UEs can use V2X sidelink transmission resource pools of the target cell before the handover is completed by performing synchronization with the target cell or GNSS. If an exceptional transmission resource pool is included in the handover command, the UE can use randomly selected resources from that pool.

q_45311.question: What shall the floor control interface do if a Track Info field is not included in the Floor Release message and the floor participant has a queued floor request?
q_45311.ground_truth: The floor control interface shall use the SSRC in the received Floor Release message to check if the floor participant has a queued floor request.

q_45312.question: What should the Source UE (SC UE) do if it receives a SIP 200 (OK) response for the SIP INVITE request due to PS to PS STI sent on the Target Access Leg (outgoing call)?
q_45312.ground_truth: The Source UE should send a SIP ACK request to the received SIP 200 (OK) response, consider the early dialog becoming a confirmeddialog and as being successfully transferred to the Target Access Leg, and terminate the early dialog on the Source Access Leg, by sending a SIP CANCEL request on the Source Access Leg, if this early dialog is still active.

q_45313.question: What TS (Technical Specification) provides the information structure for including satellite backhaul attributes in the CDR (Charging Data Record)?

q_45314.question: What is the parameter <n> in 7.34 Enhanced closed user group used for?
q_45314.ground_truth: The parameter <n> in 7.34 Enhanced closed user group is used to set the CUG activation on a per call basis.

q_45315.question: What is a pre-condition for the use case "Failure of VNFC within cloud-native VNF"?
q_45315.ground_truth: The network is running normally and the 3GPP management system has initiated collection of measurements from the cloud-native VNF

q_45316.question: How many active CP anchor nodes are there per UE and per gNB in the NG-RAN?
q_45316.ground_truth: There is one (active) CP anchor node per UE in the 5GC (AMF) and one (active) CP anchor per gNB in the NG-RAN (gNB-CU-CP).

q_45317.question: What action is triggered at the MeNB if the RLC Mode IE is included for an E-RAB within the E-RABs To Be Released List IE in the SGNB MODIFICATION REQUIRED message?
q_45317.ground_truth: The MeNB shall trigger PDCP data recovery if it receives the RLC Status IE in the SGNB MODIFICATION REQUIRED message and assumes that RLC has been reestablished at the en-gNB.

q_45318.question: What should the UE not do during T4 as specified in 7.3.60.5?
q_45318.ground_truth: The UE shall not conduct any NPUSCH transmission during T4.

q_45319.question: What is the purpose of clause 5.3D.5 of 3GPP TS 23.003?
q_45319.ground_truth: Clause 5.3D.5 of 3GPP TS 23.003 outlines the steps for automatic SNPN selection procedure for onboarding services in SNPN over trusted non-3GPP access.

q_45320.question: What network function does the NWDAF send an HTTP "201 Created" response to after retrieving fine granularity locations of UEs in step 4a-4b?

q_45321.question: What does the AF do after receiving the SMF id and other parameters from the UDM?
q_45321.ground_truth: The AF determines the PDU session used for the user plane connection between UE and AF.

q_45322.question: What is the difference between "EXTENSION" and "SEQUENCE" in the "UEContextInfoHORequest-ExtIEs ::=" definition?
q_45322.ground_truth: In the "UEContextInfoHORequest-ExtIEs ::=" definition, "EXTENSION" is used to specify the format of the data type, while "SEQUENCE" is used to define a sequence of multiple data types.

q_45323.question: What are the two formats of RTP header extension used for piggybacking timestamps?
q_45323.ground_truth: The two formats are the one-byte and two-byte formats.

q_45324.question: In clause 5.2.3.2.5, what is the definition and encoding for blvalue, nfinst, backupamfinst, nfset, nfservinst, and nfserviceset?
q_45324.ground_truth: The definition and encoding for these terms can be found in clause 5.2.3.2.5.

q_45325.question: What is the requirement for DTX observation in step 8b, 8c, and 8d?
q_45325.ground_truth: DTX should not be observed by the SS anywhere outside the specified subframes up to the end of T2 or T3, depending on the step.

q_45326.question: What information should the AMF provide in the InitialRANUEContextSetup type of the xIRI message to the NG-RAN when requesting the setup of the UE context?
q_45326.ground_truth: The InitialRANUEContextSetup type contains information such as the target NSSAI, RAT selection priority, user authorization, and 5G-ProSe authorization.

q_45327.question: What should the I-CSCF include in the P-User-Database header field upon receiving a request from a UE that includes the Redirect-Host AVP value?
q_45327.ground_truth: The I-CSCF should include the received Redirect-Host AVP value in the P-User-Database header field.

q_45328.question: What type of packet-oriented services can be restricted by the "Barring of all Packet Oriented Services" option?
q_45328.ground_truth: All packet-oriented services can be restricted with this option.

q_45329.question: What triggers the "Availability after DDN failure" notification to the SCS/AS?
q_45329.ground_truth: Each notification is triggered by a downlink data discard (DDN) failure, i.e., when the SCS/AS sends a downlink packet which is discarded by Serving GW, and the UE is unreachable.

q_45330.question: When must the UE send a SECURITY MODE REJECT message?
q_45330.ground_truth: The UE must send a SECURITY MODE REJECT message if the UE cannot accept the security mode command, and the security mode command is not integrity protected.

q_45331.question: What type of information element is the NAS security algorithms?
q_45331.ground_truth: The NAS security algorithms is a type 3 information element with a length of 2 octets.

q_45332.question: What should the MME and SGSN consider when making use of the Notification procedure, particularly for emergency-attached unauthenticated UEs?
q_45332.ground_truth: The MME or SGSN shall not use the Notification procedure for emergency-attached unauthenticated UEs. For authenticated UEs using emergency services, the MME should make use of the Notification procedure to inform the HSS about the PDN-GW selected to establish emergency PDN connections.

q_45333.question: What is the role of the PCF (Policy Control Function) in the 5GC network?
q_45333.ground_truth: The PCF is responsible for creating PCC (Policy and Charging Control) rules for PDU sessions based on the SFC classification role of the PSA (Policy and Charging Function) UPF and other information.

q_45334.question: From the perspective of basic performance gain over non-AI/ML benchmark, what is one CSI feedback enhancement aspect that has not been studied in Rel-18?

q_45335.question: What is the format of the BSR (Buffer Status Report) in 3GPP TS 36.321 clause 6.2.1?
q_45335.ground_truth: The BSR format can be either short LCG ID and Buffer Size (one LCG ID field and one corresponding Buffer Size field) or long BSR format (four Buffer Size fields, corresponding to LCG IDs #0 through #3).

q_45336.question: What happens to link layer connections and physical channels when the INTER SYSTEM TO E-UTRAN HANDOVER COMMAND message is received on the mobile station side?
q_45336.ground_truth: The mobile station initiates the release of link layer connections and disconnects the physical channels, including the packet resources if applicable.

q_45337.question: What is the role of the AMF/MME in determining the future periodic registration timer/TAU timer for UEs with no mobility in Solution 9?
q_45337.ground_truth: The AMF/MME determines the future periodic registration timer/TAU timer based on the UE location and the satellite coverage information for UEs with no mobility.

q_45338.question: What should the UE do when it is in E-UTRA RRC_CONNECTED state and it detects radio link failure?
q_45338.ground_truth: The UE should go to the RRC_IDLE state after timer T311 is expired.

q_45339.question: How is key provisioning for groups performed in the MCX system architecture?
q_45339.ground_truth: Key provisioning for groups is performed by a Group Management Server (GMS), which is authorized and provisioned by the KMS. The GMS distributes the key material to MCX users within the group, establishing a group security context.

q_45340.question: What is the unit for UE throughput in kbit per second?
q_45340.ground_truth: Each measurement for UE throughput is a real value representing the throughput in kbit per second, with the number of measurements being equal to one. If optional QoS level subcounters, S-NSSAI subcounters, PLMN ID subcounters, and BWP subcounters are performed, the number of measurements is equal to the number of mapped 5QIs, supported S-NSSAIs, PLMN IDs, and Active BWPs.

q_45341.question: What message does the source SN send to the MN when it initiates the conditional SN change procedure?
q_45341.ground_truth: The source SN sends an "SgNB Change Required" message to the MN when it initiates the conditional SN change procedure.

q_45342.question: What message does the MTC-IWF send to the SCS after receiving a device trigger from the SCS?
q_45342.ground_truth: The MTC-IWF sends a Device Trigger Report (External Identifier or MSISDN and trigger reference number) message to the SCS with a cause value indicating the trigger delivery outcome.

q_45343.question: What should a MS do if it receives a SERVICE REJECT message without integrity protection with a certain GMM cause value and the timer T3247 is not running?
q_45343.ground_truth: If the MS receives a SERVICE REJECT message without integrity protection with a GMM cause value of #3, #6, #7, #8, #11, #12, #13, or #15 before the network has activated the integrity protection for the PS domain and the timer T3247 is not running, the MS shall start timer T3247 with a random value and then proceed as specified in items 6, 7, 8, 9, and 10 above.

q_45344.question: How can duplicate delivery of CC be suppressed in the generation and delivery of xCC?
q_45344.ground_truth: Duplicate delivery of CC can be suppressed by implementing measures to prevent multiple deliveries of the same data packet, such as using unique identifiers for each packet and storing their delivery status.

q_45345.question: In step 9, what does the H-SMF send to H-PCF in the SM Policy Control Create message, if dynamic PCC is to be used for the MA PDU Session, in the context of home-routed roaming and the UE registered to different PLMNs over both access?
q_45345.ground_truth: The H-SMF sends an "MA PDU Network-Upgrade Allowed" indication and ATSSS Capabilities of the MA PDU session to H-PCF.

q_45346.question: When will the SGW send a Modify Bearer Request message on the S5/S8 interface?
q_45346.ground_truth: Upon receipt of a Modify Bearer Request message that includes the Secondary RAT Usage Data Report from the MME, the SGW shall send a Modify Bearer Request message on the S5/S8 interface if the IRPGW flag is set to 1 in the Secondary RAT Usage Data Report IE.

q_45347.question: What is the role of the SEALDD client in downlink traffic when using MSGin5G services?
q_45347.ground_truth: The SEALDD client is responsible for delivering the MSGin5G message to the VAL client or providing the content in the payload of the message to the VAL client with SEALDD API, upon receiving the MSGin5G message from the SEALDD server.

q_45348.question: When will the UE not send any event triggered measurement reports?
q_45348.ground_truth: The UE will not send any event triggered measurement reports as long as no reporting criteria are fulfilled.

q_45349.question: What is the role of the NWDAF in predicting the achieved LCS QoS in the future time?
q_45349.ground_truth: The NWDAF can predict the achieved LCS QoS in the future time by interfacing with the GMLC/AMF to obtain location information using the LCS procedures.

q_45350.question: What is the requirement for service switching in a PIN?
q_45350.ground_truth: The requirement is to support a mechanism for service switching in a PIN between different PIN applications, for achieving better service experience.

q_45351.question: What message is sent by the new NG-RAN node to the old NG-RAN node to initiate the UE Context Release procedure?

q_45352.question: What should the UE do when it receives 5GMM cause #78 from a non-satellite NG-RAN cell?
q_45352.ground_truth: The UE sets the 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, deletes specific information, resets the registration attempt counter, stores the PLMN identity in the list of "PLMNs not allowed to operate at the present UE location", starts a corresponding timer instance, and enters the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH.

q_45353.question: What happens to the USIM's validity for EPS and non-EPS services when the UE receives a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message with the EMM cause set to 'EPS services and non-EPS services not allowed'?
q_45353.ground_truth: The USIM is considered as invalid for EPS and non-EPS services, and the UE enters the state EMM-DEREGISTERED.

q_45354.question: What is the purpose of the frequency gap between sub-blocks?
q_45354.ground_truth: The frequency gap between sub-blocks is used for co-existence in un-coordinated operation.

q_45355.question: What is the mandate of the RAN WGs regarding the use of NWDAF analytics?
q_45355.ground_truth: The RAN WGs need to verify the extent to which NWDAF analytics can enhance the reliability of location verification.

q_45356.question: What is the AVP Header type for the MIP-Home-Agent-Address in 3GPP AAA protocol?
q_45356.ground_truth: The AVP Header type for the MIP-Home-Agent-Address is 279.

q_45357.question: In Test 2, what is the requirement for the overall delay measured when DRX cycle length is 1280 ms?
q_45357.ground_truth: The overall delay measured when DRX cycle length is 1280 ms shall be less than a total of 26882 ms.

q_45358.question: What is the function of ADRF in storing AI/ML models?
q_45358.ground_truth: ADRF is being enhanced to store AI/ML models so that they can be distributed and shared among network functions (NFs).

q_45359.question: What is the distribution of a frame size in TR 38.838?
q_45359.ground_truth: The size of a frame is determined by the given data rates and frame rates, which is modelled as a random variable following truncated Gaussian distribution.

q_45360.question: What can be explicitly specified by the consumer in the context of Area of Interest?
q_45360.ground_truth: The area of interest can be explicitly specified by the consumer for the NWDAF to request the same area capability from MDAF or MDA MnS producer, i.e. be capable to produce analytics in the specified area.

q_45361.question: What action should the initiating UE take when it receives a PROSE PATH SWITCHING REQUEST message during an ongoing path switching procedure?
q_45361.ground_truth: The initiating UE should stop the ongoing procedure and wait for an implementation-dependent time for initiating a new PROSE PATH SWITCHING REQUEST towards the target UE, if still needed.

q_45362.question: What feature is added into the URSP regarding PINE specific guidance by AF?
q_45362.ground_truth: A new Traffic Descriptor component, "Source descriptors", is added into the URSP to uniquely identify the PINE or PIN generating the traffic.

q_45363.question: What are the padding requirements for the <Group broadcast alias> value?
q_45363.ground_truth: If the length of the <Group broadcast alias> value is not (2 + multiple of 4) bytes, it shall be padded to (2 + multiple of 4) bytes with padding bytes set to zero.

q_45364.question: What is the purpose of solution #19 in managing the informing of RAN nodes about the MBS session when they are not serving any connected UEs?
q_45364.ground_truth: Solution #19 describes two options: 1) source RAN informs serving/target RAN about MBS, or 2) MB-SMF informs all RAN nodes in a service area.

q_45365.question: Which message is sent by the SS to the UE, always sent within SECURITY PROTECTED NAS MESSAGE message and with new EPS security context?

q_45366.question: What action should a UE take if the maximum number of preamble transmission counter has been reached for the random access procedure on PCell or PSCell?
q_45366.ground_truth: The UE should indicate a random access problem to upper layers.

q_45367.question: What is the goal of the "Retrieve UE Information function" (5.22)?
q_45367.ground_truth: The "Retrieve UE Information function" enables the NG-RAN node to request UE information (e.g. QoS differentiation information) from the AMF before the setup of the NG connection for NB-IoT UE(s) using Control Plane CIoT 5GS Optimization.

q_45368.question: What action can the PCRF take to ensure that an MCPTT session is prioritized if it receives the MCPTT-Identifier AVP?
q_45368.ground_truth: The PCRF may take specific actions on the corresponding IP-CAN to ensure that the MCPTT session is prioritized if it receives the MCPTT-Identifier AVP.

q_45369.question: When is the UE required to perform tracking area updating for IMS voice termination as specified in 3GPP TS 24.008 annex P.4?
q_45369.ground_truth: When the UE performs an inter-system change from A/Gb mode to S1 mode and the TIN indicates "RAT-related TMSI"

q_45370.question: What are the default and alternative connectivity options used for EN-DC and NGEN-DC testing?
q_45370.ground_truth: The default connectivity option used for EN-DC and NGEN-DC testing is EN-DC, and the alternative option is NGEN-DC, which can be used if a UE does not support EN-DC.

q_45371.question: What message is used to indicate that some error has been detected in the NG-RAN node?

q_45372.question: What information does a VAE client provide to the VAE server when it moves to a new geographical area?
q_45372.ground_truth: The V2X UE provides geographical area information to the VAE server upon moving to a new geographical area.

q_45373.question: What is the requirement for simultaneous support of multiple service level trace instances in PLMN and UE?
q_45373.ground_truth: The requirement for simultaneous support of multiple service level trace instances in PLMN and UE is defined in SLT-OSR-1. This allows for several services initiated from the same UE to each have a Trace Recording Session Reference.

q_45374.question: In what circumstances does the UE shall not initiate an initial registration for emergency services over the current access, if the UE is already registered for emergency services over the non-current access?
q_45374.ground_truth: The UE shall not initiate an initial registration for emergency services over the current access, if the UE is already registered for emergency services over the non-current access, unless the initial registration has to be initiated to perform handover of an existing emergency PDU session from the non-current access to the current access.

q_45375.question: Which new RTCP feedback type has been introduced for DBI signaling in sub-clause 7.3.8?
q_45375.ground_truth: The new RTCP feedback type introduced for DBI signaling in sub-clause 7.3.8 is "3gpp-delay-budget".

q_45376.question: What is the HTTP status code that indicates the deletion of an MBS User Data Ingest Session was successful?
q_45376.ground_truth: The HTTP status code that indicates the deletion of an MBS User Data Ingest Session was successful is 204 No Content.

q_45377.question: What should the participating MCPTT function do if it cannot find a binding between the public user identity and an MCPTT ID?
q_45377.ground_truth: If the participating MCPTT function cannot find a binding between the public user identity and an MCPTT ID, it shall reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 404 (Not Found) response and include the warning text set to "141 user unknown to the participating function" in a Warning header field, as specified in clause~4.4.

q_45378.question: What should be the basis for a GTP-C entity deciding whether to use the overload control feature?
q_45378.ground_truth: A GTP-C entity should decide whether to use the overload control feature based on operator's policy within the PLMN or across PLMN boundaries.

q_45379.question: What action will the UE take if it receives a PDU Session Modification Command with a Cause indicating a change of S-NSSAI and the same DN?
q_45379.ground_truth: The UE will change the S-NSSAI of the corresponding PDU session to the selected S-NSSAI in the PDU Session Modification Command, and may initiate the PDU Session Establishment procedure with the new S-NSSAI.

q_45380.question: What is the role of the NWDAF in the 5G network in relation to URSP enforcement?
