q_45618.ground_truth: All signalling transactions between UEs, SL Positioning Server UE, and SL Reference UE in UE-only operation operate using the RSPP protocol. The protocol used for signalling transactions with the SL Positioning Client UE is FFS.

q_45619.question: What is used to determine the RAT Type for Wireline access in 5GC?
q_45619.ground_truth: The Global W-AGF Node ID and possibly ULI information provided by the W-AGF are used to determine the RAT Type for Wireline access in 5GC.

q_45620.question: What should be included in the <session-type> element for an adhoc-group-fd-session in the hname "body" parameter?
q_45620.ground_truth: The value of "adhoc-group-fd-session" should be set to the <session-type> element for an adhoc-group-fd-session in the hname "body" parameter.

q_45621.question: What is the impact of the Trace-Info AVP received in the authorization response on the PDN GW for GTPv2 based S2a or S2b?
q_45621.ground_truth: For GTPv2 based S2a or S2b, the PDN GW shall ignore the Trace-Info AVP received in the authorization response. However, trace is activated and deactivated via the STa and S2a interfaces or via the SWm and S2b interfaces.

q_45622.question: What is the requirement for RSTD measurement reporting delay for the UE in FDD systems, assuming that the measurement report is not delayed by other LPP signalling on the DCCH?
q_45622.ground_truth: The requirement for RSTD measurement reporting delay for the UE in FDD systems, assuming that the measurement report is not delayed by other LPP signalling on the DCCH, is that it excludes a delay uncertainty resulted when inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH, with a duration of 2 x TTIDCCH. It also excludes any delay caused by no UL resources for the UE to send the measurement report.

q_45623.question: What must a 5G-RG maintain over the W-5GAN after all PDU Sessions for the 5G-RG over that access have been released or handed over to 3GPP access?
q_45623.ground_truth: The 5G-RG shall maintain the NAS signalling connection with the AMF over the W-5GAN.

q_45624.question: What should the controlling MCPTT function do if the received SIP re-INVITE request is an authorized request for an MCPTT emergency alert cancellation and there is an outstanding MCPTT emergency alert for the MCPTT user?
q_45624.ground_truth: If the <originated-by> element is included in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body of the received SIP re-INVITE request, the controlling MCPTT function should clear the cache of the MCPTT ID of the MCPTT user identified by the <originated-by> element as having an outstanding MCPTT emergency alert. If the <originated-by> element is not included in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body, the controlling MCPTT function should clear the cache of the MCPTT ID of the sender of the SIP re-INVITE request as having an outstanding MCPTT emergency alert.

q_45625.question: What is the purpose of the 2Rx FDD FR1 for PDSCH with inter cell CRS interference?
q_45625.ground_truth: The purpose is to verify PDSCH performance under 2 receive antenna conditions when PDSCH is interfered by inter cell CRS signal.

q_45626.question: What should the non-controlling MCVideo function do with the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body in the received SIP INVITE request?
q_45626.ground_truth: The non-controlling MCVideo function should copy and update the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body in the received SIP INVITE request to the outgoing SIP INVITE request.

q_45627.question: What is the initiating message for the "id-MTCommunicationHandling" procedure code?

q_45628.question: What is the role of the IoT-PCS server in an on-network functional model in single network exposure access deployment mode?
q_45628.ground_truth: The IoT-PCS server in an on-network functional model in single network exposure access deployment mode communicates with the IoT-PCS client over the IP-UU reference point, which is an instance of the SEAL-UU generic reference point. The IoT-PCS server provides IoT platform common services functionality to the IoT-App client(s) over the IP-C reference point, which is an instance of the SEAL-C reference point. The VAL IoT-App server communicates with the IoT-PCS server over the IP-S reference point, which is an instance of the SEAL-S generic reference point.

q_45629.question: What action does the SMF take to store DNAI and UE IP/DNN when different SMFs are serving UEs in communication?
q_45629.ground_truth: The SMF interacts with UDM to store DNAI and UE IP/DNN and checks whether two UEs are served by the same DNAI.

q_45630.question: What is the role of the AMF in providing IRI-POI functions?
q_45630.ground_truth: The AMF provides IRI-POI functions in non-roaming, roaming (in VPLMN and HPLMN for non-3GPP access) cases.

q_45631.question: What conditions determine if a UE is expected to transmit from UE port 0?
q_45631.ground_truth: If closed-loop UE transmit antenna selection is disabled or not supported by the UE, the UE shall transmit from UE port 0.

q_45632.question: How can the SNR degradation be minimized for higher ADC bits?
q_45632.ground_truth: For higher ADC bits, such as 4, 6, and 8, the SNR degradation is around 1 dB. This indicates that increasing the ADC bits can help reduce the SNR degradation.

q_45633.question: Which types of NR UE releases 15 and forward does the test in section 8.2A.3.1.2.2 apply to?
q_45633.ground_truth: The test applies to all types of NR UE releases 15 and forward that support 3DL CA.

q_45634.question: What event triggers the AMF to interact with the PCF and update RFSP index related policy information in the AMF based on the Partially Allowed NSSAI?
q_45634.ground_truth: A Change of the Partially Allowed NSSAI trigger

q_45635.question: What should the MME include in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message if the UE indicates support of the extended periodic timer T3412?
q_45635.ground_truth: The MME may include T3412 extended value IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message only if the UE indicates support of the extended periodic timer T3412 in the MS network feature support IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.

q_45636.question: What is the S-NAPTR procedure used for when finding the old SGSN services and interfaces from the P-TMSI?
q_45636.ground_truth: The S-NAPTR procedure is used with specific "Service Parameters" and the Application-Unique String set to the NRI-RAI FQDN based on the NRI, RAC, LAC, MNC, and MCC.

q_45637.question: What should the Serving GW do if it receives the Handover Indication in step 23 and the PDN connection is not served by a SCEF?
q_45637.ground_truth: The Serving GW sends a Modify Bearer Request message to the PDN GW, which includes the Handover Indication and prompts PDN GW to tunnel packets from non-3GPP IP access to 3GPP access system, and immediately start routing packets to the Serving GW for the default and any dedicated EPS bearers established. If Presence Reporting Area Information is included, it should also be sent to the PDN GW.

q_45638.question: What is used to encrypt media between end-points in MCPTT networks?
q_45638.ground_truth: The group call key and private call key, once a security context has been established

q_45639.question: What is the purpose of the hysteresis parameter (Hys) in CondEvent D2?
q_45639.ground_truth: The hysteresis parameter (Hys) is used in CondEvent D2 to define a dead-band or a zone of uncertainty around the threshold values, which helps to prevent rapid and frequent switching of the event's state.

q_45640.question: What is the purpose of the OC-Supported-Features AVP and where it is defined?
q_45640.ground_truth: The OC-Supported-Features AVP is of type Grouped and it's used to support Diameter overload control mechanism, defined in IETF RFC 7683.

q_45641.question: For ATC5b construction in multi-band mode, how many carriers are allowed per band?
q_45641.ground_truth: The maximum number of carriers per band in ATC5b is two.

q_45642.question: What should the UE do when the back-off timer value indicates deactivation and no S-NSSAI was provided during the PDU session establishment?
q_45642.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T3585 associated with no S-NSSAI if it is running.

q_45643.question: What is the measurement provided by "TB.ErrTotNbrDl.X" in 5.1.1.7.4 and 5.1.1.7.9?
q_45643.ground_truth: The number of total faulty TBs transmitted on the downlink in a cell, split into subcounters per MU-MIMO maximum layer.

q_45644.question: What is the reference signal used for the calculation in the electrical interface UE sending section?
q_45644.ground_truth: The reference signal is the same as the test signal and is calibrated to -4.7 dBPa.

q_45645.question: What should the MS do with the list of PLMNs where N1 mode is not allowed when the MS is switched off, or timer TG expires?
q_45645.ground_truth: The MS should delete stored information on PLMNs where N1 mode is not allowed when the MS is switched off, the USIM is removed, or timer TG expires.

q_45646.question: When does the UE consider GNSS not to be selected as the synchronization reference source in NR sidelink communication/discovery?
q_45646.ground_truth: The UE considers GNSS not to be selected if the PSBCH-RSRP of the candidate SyncRef UE exceeds the minimum requirement by sl-SyncRefMinHyst and the candidate SyncRef UE belongs to a higher priority group than GNSS, or if GNSS becomes not reliable.

q_45647.question: What mechanisms may be used for IP address allocation for a PDU session?
q_45647.ground_truth: IPv6 address allocation using DHCPv6 and IPv6 Prefix Delegation using DHCPv6 are mechanisms that may be used for IP address allocation for a PDU session.

q_45648.question: What indication is used to inform UEs that the PLMN supports emergency bearer services over E-UTRAN?
q_45648.ground_truth: The Emergency Service Support indicator in the Attach and TAU procedures indicates to UEs that the PLMN supports emergency bearer services over E-UTRAN.

q_45649.question: What is the consequence of setting the filter coefficient k to 0?
q_45649.ground_truth: When k is set to 0, no layer 3 filtering is applicable.

q_45650.question: What is a condition for the PDSCH BLER (Block Error Rate) using the transport format indicated by the median CQI in a TDD system, to satisfy the requirements for UE DL Category 1bis?
q_45650.ground_truth: If the PDSCH BLER using the transport format indicated by the median CQI is greater than 0.1, the BLER using the transport format indicated by (median CQI - 1) shall be less than or equal to 0.1.

q_45651.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 4.5.2.5?
q_45651.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to verify E-UTRAN PCell and NR PSCell interruptions during the measurement on the deactivated E-UTRAN SCC, the UE missed ACK/NACK does not exceed the limits.

q_45652.question: In the context of FRMCS Service in Off-Network mode, what is required for video transfer?
q_45652.ground_truth: The FRMCS Service in Off-Network mode should support the following traffic characteristics of video transfer for direct communication: up to 2 Mbps for 720p at 30fps, up to 10 Mbps for 1080p at 30fps, and up to 20 Mbps for 4K at 30fps.

q_45653.question: What is the procedure when the UE gets the UE Policy Container in ePCO during 5GS to EPS mobility with N26 interface?
q_45653.ground_truth: The procedure involves storing URSP updates, optionally re-evaluating the mapping of applications into PDN connections, and acknowledging the delivery result in UE Policy Container to the MME.

q_45654.question: What should the UE do when it receives an EMM cause value #12?
q_45654.ground_truth: The UE should set the EPS update status to EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED and delete any GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI list and eKSI. The UE should also reset the attach attempt counter and enter the state EMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE. The UE should store the current TAI in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service".

q_45655.question: How does a UE indicate its support for LCS to a serving PLMN or SNPN?
q_45655.ground_truth: A UE signals its LCS capabilities to a serving PLMN or SNPN at the AS, NAS, and application (positioning protocol) levels to enable the use of supported positioning methods.

q_45656.question: What information does the "RimRSReportInfo" data type define?
q_45656.ground_truth: This data type defines necessary reporting information derived from the detected RIM-RS, including the detected set ID, propagation delay in number of OFDM symbols, and functionality of the RS (RS-1 or RS-2, Enough or Not enough mitigation for RS-1)

q_45657.question: What is the maximum RRC procedure delay?
q_45657.ground_truth: The maximum RRC procedure delay is 50 ms.

q_45658.question: What is the maximum number of UAC barring information sets supported by MNs in REL-15?
q_45658.ground_truth: The maximum number of UAC barring information sets supported by MNs in REL-15 is 8.

q_45659.question: What is the purpose of the "nfTypes" attribute in the "event-filter" attribute?
q_45659.ground_truth: The "nfTypes" attribute in the "event-filter" attribute allows the network to specify a list of NF instance types. This information is only applicable to specific events and, when used, will enable the network to filter the analysis based on the specified NF instance types.

q_45660.question: What should be the polarization of the blocking interferer for the in-band frequencies?
q_45660.ground_truth: The polarization of the blocking interferer should be polarization matched for the in-band frequencies.

q_45661.question: When does the UE need to apply the received Timing Advance value for the next transmission of data in test case 7.1.2.11.1.1?
q_45661.ground_truth: The UE applies the received Timing Advance value for the next transmission of data and restarts the timeAlignmentTimerSTAG for the sTAG to which the SCell belongs, when Timing Advance Command MAC control element with the TAG Id associated with the SCell is received and UE has pending data during the period the timeAlignmentTimer for the PCell and timeAlignmentTimerSTAG are running.

q_45662.question: What information does the resource allocation header in DCI format 2A provide?
q_45662.ground_truth: The resource allocation header in DCI format 2A provides information about the resource allocation type (0 or 1) for a specific UE.

q_45663.question: What is the maximum number of transmission attempts for PDSCH in this clause assuming no specifications to the contrary?

q_45664.question: What should the UE do if it has connection establishment failure information available and the RPLMN is equal to the plmn-Identity stored in VarConnEstFailReport in clause 5.3.7.5 of TS 36.331?
q_45664.ground_truth: The UE should include the connEstFailInfoAvailable in the RRCConnectionReestablishmentComplete message and perform other related actions.

q_45665.question: What information should the MME provide in the S1-AP Paging message regarding the WUS-capable eNodeB?
q_45665.ground_truth: The MME should provide the last used cell ID in the Assistance Data for Recommended Cells IE in the Assistance Data for Paging IE, when receiving an S1-AP Paging message for a WUS-capable UE.

q_45666.question: What is the action taken by the IWF when receiving a Track Info field with multiple Participant Reference values in a Floor Granted message?
q_45666.ground_truth: The IWF removes the last Participant Reference value from the Track Info field in the outgoing Floor Granted message if the Track Info field contains more than one Participant Reference value.

q_45667.question: What is the purpose of the FeatureSetEUTRA-DownlinkId=0?
q_45667.ground_truth: FeatureSetEUTRA-DownlinkId=0 indicates that the UE does not support a carrier in this band of a band combination.

q_45668.question: What actions are performed if the floor control interface receives a Floor Taken message with the first bit in the subtype set to '1' and the session is not a broadcast group call?
q_45668.ground_truth: The granted MCPTT user's MCPTT ID is included in the Granted Party's Identity field, and the 'U: not permitted and Floor Taken' state is entered in this situation. Additionally, a Floor Ack message is sent if the first bit in the subtype of the Floor Release message is set to '1'.

q_45669.question: What are the benefits of using LP-WUS monitoring in the UE power saving and UPT benefit of connected mode UEs with different traffic types?
q_45669.ground_truth: The benefits of using LP-WUS monitoring in UE power saving and UPT benefit of connected mode UEs with different traffic types include up to 60% UE power saving gain and up to 180% UPT improvement depending on the type of traffic.

q_45670.question: What must the UE do if it cannot determine the country it is located in?
q_45670.ground_truth: If the UE cannot determine the country it is located in, it stops the ePDG selection process as it cannot proceed further without this information.

q_45671.question: What is the minimum requirement for the percentage of transmitted ACK/NACKs in this test case?
q_45671.ground_truth: At least 99.5% of all expected ACK/NACKs shall be transmitted by the UE.

q_45672.question: Which solution avoids new service operations by re-using and extending existing service operations?
q_45672.ground_truth: Solution #2 avoids new service operations by re-using and extending the Nnrf_NFManagement service operations (NFRegister, NFUpdate, NFDeregister) allowing any NF to push (register) its set profile to the NRF, modify it at the NRF and delete it from the NRF.

q_45673.question: What must the H-ECS do if the service provisioning request from the EEC does not contain the serving PLMN ID?
q_45673.ground_truth: The H-ECS requests the UDM the list of VPLMN IDs or ECS provider identifier allowed for the UE.

q_45674.question: What does "FWA UE" represent in the context of NR User Equipment (UE) in the "3GPP TR 38.101-2: User Equipment (UE) radio transmission and reception; Part 2: Range 2 Standalone (Release 18)" document?
q_45674.ground_truth: FWA UE represents a UE intended to be used in fixed wireless access scenario.

q_45675.question: What is the proposal for enhancing QoS Sustainability Analytics in the context of FL operation?
q_45675.ground_truth: The proposal is to extend "Target of Analytics Reporting" to include single UE level granularity with additional parameters in Analytics Filter Information. This will provide analytics information at the UE level and require extended input data such as RAN throughput per UE and QoS flow retainability per UE.

q_45676.question: What is the pre-condition for triggering a session-oriented service update?
q_45676.ground_truth: The VAE server has established a session-oriented service with the VAE client and the V2X application-specific server needs to update parameters of the session.

q_45677.question: What is the name of the synchronization function used in the V2X Sidelink Communication test?

q_45678.question: What information does the UE receive within the Registration Accept message during the initial AMF change procedure?
q_45678.ground_truth: The UE receives a 5G-GUTI containing a GUAMI of the non-geographically selected AMF, as well as an Allowed NSSAI and optionally Mapping Of Allowed NSSAI.

q_45679.question: What kind of measurement accuracy should the UE physical layer be capable of reporting when NCSG are provided for inter frequency measurements?
q_45679.ground_truth: SS-RSRP, SS-RSRQ and SS-SINR measurements with measurement accuracy as specified in clauses 10.1.4, 10.1.5, 10.1.9, 10.1.10, 10.1.14, and 10.1.15.

q_45680.question: What are the responsibilities of the UE when it receives additional slice information in TA granularity from the AMF?
q_45680.ground_truth: The UE is responsible for storing additional slice information in TA granularity, initiating the registration update procedure based on additional slice information when needed, and indicating its capability support of receiving additional slice information in the registration request.

q_45681.question: What is the name of the next generation transport protocol for the Internet that is on track to become ubiquitous on end-user platforms and within all server-side workflows?
q_45681.ground_truth: The QUIC (Quick UDP Internet Connections) Protocol

q_45682.question: What happens when the call is released in the "Floor participant state transition diagram for basic operation"?
q_45682.ground_truth: When the call is released, the state machine shall return to the Start-Stop state.

q_45683.question: What interface is exhibited by the MBSF in the 5G System Architecture for MBS?
q_45683.ground_truth: Nmbsf is the service-based interface exhibited by the MBSF in the 5G System Architecture for MBS.

q_45684.question: What should a UE do if the SnonServingCell is greater than Snonintrasearch and more than 1 second has passed since the UE camped on the current serving cell?
q_45684.ground_truth: The UE should perform measurements of E-UTRAN inter-frequencies or inter-RAT frequency cells of equal or lower priority.

q_45685.question: What is the downside of using RAN position for UE location?
q_45685.ground_truth: The downside of using RAN position for UE location is that it increases time latency, especially for satellite communication, and may consume more resources.

q_45686.question: What should the UE indicate to the network to support Multi-homed IPv6 PDU session?
q_45686.ground_truth: The UE should indicate the support of Multi-homed IPv6 PDU session to the network (i.e. SMF) if it supports Multi-homed IPv6 PDU session.

q_45687.question: What interfaces are used for control plane signaling and coordination in MR-DC?
q_45687.ground_truth: In MR-DC, there is an interface between the MN and the SN for control plane signaling and coordination. For each MR-DC UE, there is also one control plane connection between the MN and a corresponding CN entity.

q_45688.question: What is the effect of a UE's position on the width of the MSD = 0 dB region in a victim channel bandwidth?
q_45688.ground_truth: A UE's position in the channel bandwidth can affect the width of the MSD = 0 dB region, with lower MSD capability allowing for a wider MSD = 0 dB region.

q_45689.question: What actions can the analytics consumer take when the accuracy of the analytics does not meet its requirements?
q_45689.ground_truth: The analytics consumer may stop using analytics for a period of time or obtain new analytics, or request updated analytics if it can be generated within the correction time period.

q_45690.question: What is the role of NG-RAN nodes in determining transmission mode for MBS sessions?
q_45690.ground_truth: NG-RAN nodes decide whether to deliver the MBS session in a cell and whether to transmit the MBS session data in RRC-inactive mode for inactive UEs.

q_45691.question: When can the target UE initiate the 5G ProSe direct link modification procedure?
q_45691.ground_truth: The target UE may initiate the 5G ProSe direct link modification procedure if the 5G ProSe direct link between the target UE and the source 5G ProSe end UE is released and the target UE is acting as a 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE and determines to keep the 5G ProSe direct link with the peer 5G ProSe end UE.

q_45692.question: What is the purpose of the Measure Duration field in the location measurement process?
q_45692.ground_truth: The Measure Duration field contains the duration for the section of the location measurement corresponding to the location request and the location report messages.

q_45693.question: What should a UE assume about the application of the same precoder for two PRBs within a PRG, if no DMRS-based SPDCCH candidate is mapped to the last resource block?
q_45693.ground_truth: A UE may assume that the same precoder applies to the two PRBs within a PRG under these conditions.

q_45694.question: What does NB-IoT stand for and what is its relation to standalone operation?
q_45694.ground_truth: NB-IoT stands for Narrowband-Internet of Things, and it operates standalone when it uses its own spectrum that can replace the spectrum currently being used by GERAN systems.

q_45695.question: What is the difficulty faced by the serving base station when detecting the operation of a duplicate false base station from the duplicate Cell IDs in the measurement report of multiple UEs?
q_45695.ground_truth: It is difficult for the serving base station to determine which Cell ID, as measured by the UE in the measurement report, belongs to a genuine base station of the PLMN and which one is false.

q_45696.question: What does the "SSRC of participating MCVideo function" contain?
q_45696.ground_truth: The "SSRC of participating MCVideo function" contains the SSRC (Source Stream ID) of the participating MCVideo function.

q_45697.question: What conditions should be met for the test to pass?
q_45697.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the total number of successful tests should be more than 90% of the total cases with a confidence level of 95%.

q_45698.question: What is the benefit of the solution described in section 6.10, Simplifying the NF service discovery response of inter-PLMN?
q_45698.ground_truth: The solution avoids unnecessary signaling overhead and data storage overhead in inter-PLMN scenario by introducing a simplification mechanism for inter-PLMN NF discovery response.

q_45699.question: What are some security risks brought by historical management of telecoms networks?
q_45699.ground_truth: Historic management of telecoms networks has relied heavily upon standard corporate devices as administrative workstations, bringing significant risk as machines that perform standard 'office' type functionality are also defining the operation of the network.

q_45700.question: What is the purpose of the variable Hys in the context of TS 36.331, clause 5.5.4.3?
q_45700.ground_truth: The variable Hys represents the hysteresis parameter for an event in the context of TS 36.331, clause 5.5.4.3. It is expressed in dB.

q_45701.question: What is the purpose of routing on BAP sublayer?
q_45701.ground_truth: The purpose of routing on BAP sublayer is to determine the next-hop node for packets that have not reached their destination and to determine if a packet has reached the destination node on BAP sublayer.

q_45702.question: What is the procedure for authentication and authorization when IMSI is available and the local regulation and network operator option requires to authenticate the UE for accessing EPC?
q_45702.ground_truth: The authentication and authorization procedures via STa are executed when IMSI is available and the local regulation and network operator option requires to authenticate the UE for accessing EPC.

q_45703.question: What is the function of the Media Access Function in the Media Client?
q_45703.ground_truth: The Media Access Function is an entity on the UE that communicates with the Media~AS in order to access and deliver media content. The media access function may be further sub-divided into content delivery protocols, codecs, media types and metadata representation.

q_45704.question: What is the HTTP method that can be used to request the update of an Individual Slice Parameters Provisioning in the SliceParamProvision API?
q_45704.ground_truth: The HTTP method that can be used to request the update of an Individual Slice Parameters Provisioning in the SliceParamProvision API is PUT.

q_45705.question: What should the UE do if the maximum size of a PC5 signalling message is exceeded?
q_45705.ground_truth: The UE should ignore the message.

q_45706.question: Which function of the Xn interface is responsible for the initial setup of an Xn interface between two NG-RAN nodes, including exchange of application level data?

q_45707.question: What is the reporting range of RSRP, as defined in 3GPP TS 36.133?
q_45707.ground_truth: The reporting range of RSRP is defined from -140 dBm to -44 dBm with 1 dB resolution.

q_45708.question: What is a multimedia messaging body part (MMBP) in the context of this specification?
q_45708.ground_truth: An MMBP is a part of a message body that may include media content, metadata, and processing requirements. It may be the entire part of a message body or a sub-part, with its own media type and associated metadata parameters.

q_45709.question: What information is required as an input when requesting the network to revoke the AF session with requested QoS for a UE or a list of UEs?

q_45710.question: How is user data over GERAN distinguished in the test model?
q_45710.ground_truth: User data over GERAN is distinguished between raw user data (raw mode) and IP data (IP mode) in the test model.

q_45711.question: What is the difference between general requirements and additional requirements in 3GPP TS 38.101-3?
q_45711.ground_truth: In 3GPP TS 38.101-3, general requirements are mandated to be met in all scenarios, while additional requirements are specified for specific scenarios. In addition to meeting the general requirement, the UE is mandated to meet the additional requirements for those specific scenarios.

q_45712.question: What should a UE capable of MBMS reception do upon initializing schedulingInfoList if SystemInformationBlockType13 is present and the UE does not have a valid version stored?

q_45713.question: What is the difference between an inner and outer contiguous allocation in intra-band contiguous carrier aggregation?
q_45713.ground_truth: An inner contiguous allocation is a range of RB in a component carrier with a lower frequency and with a smaller number of RB allocated, while an outer contiguous allocation is a range of RB in a component carrier with a higher frequency or with a larger number of RB allocated.

q_45714.question: When should the 3GPP controlling MCPTT function include the warning text set to "149 SIP INFO request pending" in a Warning header field as specified in clause~4.4 in the SIP 200 (OK) response?
q_45714.ground_truth: The 3GPP controlling MCPTT function should include the warning text set to "149 SIP INFO request pending" in a Warning header field as specified in clause~4.4 in the SIP 200 (OK) response if the received SIP INVITE request contains an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body with the <imminentperil-ind> element set to a value of "true" and the in-progress emergency state of the group is set to a value of "true".

q_45715.question: How is the Visited Country Emergency N3IWF FQDN constructed?

q_45716.question: What frequency range is recommended for the NTN satellite bands?
q_45716.ground_truth: The recommended frequency range for NTN satellite bands is from 2 GHz to 6 GHz.

q_45717.question: What is the function of the 3GPP-Session-AMBR AVP in the RAA command?
q_45717.ground_truth: The 3GPP-Session-AMBR AVP in the RAA command indicates the maximum amount of bitrate assigned to downlink and uplink data traffic for the user.

q_45718.question: What is the role of NWDAF in the solution described in Solution #9 related to anomalous NF behaviour detection?
q_45718.ground_truth: NWDAF is used as a central NF or entry point to collect data in the solution described in Solution #9 related to anomalous NF behaviour detection.

q_45719.question: What is the definition of the reference sensitivity power level (REFSENS) for both Intra-band non-contiguous CA and Intra-band contiguous CA?
q_45719.ground_truth: REFSENS is defined as the EIS level at the center of the quiet zone in the RX beam peak direction, at which the throughput shall meet or exceed the requirements for the specified reference measurement channel.

q_45720.question: What is the effect of inter-frequency measurements on the measurement gap pattern when using a single measurement gap pattern for all concurrent inter-frequency measurements?
q_45720.ground_truth: If the UE requires measurement gaps to perform inter-frequency measurements, a single measurement gap pattern is used for all concurrent inter-frequency measurements, including inter-frequency channel occupancy measurements.

q_45721.question: What procedures should be performed by the MCData client and server to integrity protect XML bodies?
q_45721.ground_truth: The procedure includes including a Content-Type header field set to "application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-signed+xml", performing reference generation and signature generation, and creating the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-signed+xml MIME body containing signatures referring to the XML MIME bodies.

q_45722.question: What does the "Serving Cell ID" field indicate in the SP CSI reporting on PUCCH Activation/Deactivation MAC CE?
q_45722.ground_truth: The "Serving Cell ID" field in the SP CSI reporting on PUCCH Activation/Deactivation MAC CE indicates the identity of the Serving Cell for which the MAC CE applies.

q_45723.question: What is the behavior of AMF based on the "last message indication"?
q_45723.ground_truth: The behavior of AMF based on the "last message indication" is implementation specific.

q_45724.question: What is the purpose of the "Power Saving based on AMF awareness of coverage information" solution?
q_45724.ground_truth: The purpose of this solution is to resolve Key Issue #2, which aims to enhance power-saving mechanisms for UE in discontinuous coverage, ensuring that the UE does not attempt PLMN access when there is no network coverage.

q_45725.question: What is the structure of the TrafficToBeReleaseInformation?
q_45725.ground_truth: It is a sequence containing release type, a list of extended protocol information (with an optional container for TrafficToBeReleaseInformation-ExtIEs), and may contain other optional information.

q_45726.question: What is the procedure to be followed by the UE for manual EPC network selection in WiMAX access?
q_45726.ground_truth: The UE shall present the list of available EPC networks to the user, and if HPLMN or equivalent PLMNs are available, they shall be shown in the highest ranking order.

q_45727.question: What is the function of the DRA in handling multiple PCRFs in an operator's network realm?
q_45727.ground_truth: The DRA is used to keep status of the assigned PCRF for a certain UE and IP-CAN session across all reference points. It supports the functionality of a proxy agent and a redirect agent, and operates in either proxy or redirect mode based on operator's requirements.

q_45728.question: What determines the minimum guardband applied adjacent to 60 kHz SCS when multiple numerologies are multiplexed in the same symbol and the UE channel bandwidth is greater than 200 MHz?
q_45728.ground_truth: The minimum guardband applied adjacent to 60 kHz SCS when multiple numerologies are multiplexed in the same symbol and the UE channel bandwidth is greater than 200 MHz is the same as the minimum guardband defined for 120 kHz SCS for the same UE channel bandwidth.

q_45729.question: In the context of cell reselection, what is the condition for the UE to reselect a new cell to camp on?
q_45729.ground_truth: As per TS 36.304, clause 5.2.3.2, when a cell is ranked as the best cell, the UE shall perform cell re-selection to that cell, provided the new cell is better ranked than the serving cell during a time interval TreselectionRAT and more than 1 second has elapsed since the UE camped on the current serving cell.

q_45730.question: How many MAC PDUs containing a MAC BSR control element can be transmitted by the UE in a single transmission time interval (TTI)?
q_45730.ground_truth: The UE can transmit at most one MAC PDU containing a MAC BSR control element in a single TTI.

q_45731.question: What action does the target MME take for each EPS bearer requested to be established during an Inter-RAT handover to the E-UTRAN?
q_45731.ground_truth: The target MME requests the eNodeB to allocate resources for all EPS bearers received from the source side and ignores any Activity Status Indicator within an EPS Bearer Context.

q_45732.question: In the NDS/AF PKI architecture, what is the significance of the simple trust model and manual cross-certification?
q_45732.ground_truth: The simple trust model of the NDS/AF avoids the introduction of transitive trust and additional authorization information, implying that cross-certification is done manually to ensure security and verify the authenticity of certificates.

q_45733.question: What message does the network send to notify the UE about an incoming mobile terminating CS service when a NAS signalling connection exists?
q_45733.ground_truth: The EMM entity in the network sends a CS SERVICE NOTIFICATION message to notify the UE about an incoming mobile terminating CS service when a NAS signalling connection exists.

q_45734.question: What should the P-CSCF add to the dialog request to indicate that it is an originating request?
q_45734.ground_truth: The "orig" parameter should be added to the dialog request to indicate that it is an originating request.

q_45735.question: What is the function of the OC-Supported-Features AVP and where is it defined?
q_45735.ground_truth: The OC-Supported-Features AVP is used to support Diameter overload control mechanism. It is of type Grouped and is defined in IETF RFC 7683. For more information, see Annex A.

q_45736.question: How is the Mobile IP Root Key (MIP-RK) generated and what is its length?
q_45736.ground_truth: The MIP-RK is generated at the 3GPP AAA Server and the UE using the EMSK and the HMAC-SHA256 algorithm. The length of the MIP-RK is 64 octets.

q_45737.question: What is the purpose of quantization in the CSI compression use case?
q_45737.ground_truth: Quantization is used to compress the CSI generated at the UE side and transmitted to the gNB side, reducing the amount of data that needs to be transmitted.

q_45738.question: What is the requirement for IAB-DU type 1-O and IAB-MT type 1-O operating in multi-carrier or contiguous CA in terms of the outermost carrier's channel bandwidth?
q_45738.ground_truth: The requirements apply to IAB-DU and IAB-MT channel bandwidths of the outermost carrier for IAB-DU type 1-O and IAB-MT type 1-O operating in multi-carrier or contiguous CA.

q_45739.question: What attribute(s) of the MBSUserDataIngSessionPatch data structure can be updated only if the corresponding MBS Distribution Session is in the "INACTIVE" state?
q_45739.ground_truth: The MBSUserDataIngSessionPatch data structure attributes that can be updated only if the corresponding MBS Distribution Session is in the "INACTIVE" state are all the other attributes within each map entry, except for the "mbsSessionId", the "mbsDisSessionId", and the "locationDependent" attributes.

q_45740.question: What should the NF Service Consumer do when it wants to request the SMF to cancel the handover of a PDU session?
q_45740.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer should request the SMF to cancel the handover by sending a POST request with the hoState attribute updated to CANCELLED, and including cause information.

q_45741.question: What is the purpose of the test tolerances (TT) in 3GPP TS 38.101-3?
q_45741.ground_truth: The test tolerances (TT) are used to relax the minimum requirements in 3GPP TS 38.101-3 to create test requirements. For some requirements, including regulatory requirements, the test tolerance is set to zero.

q_45742.question: What is the difference between a Service Profile and a Slice Profile in the context of network slicing?
q_45742.ground_truth: A Service Profile represents network slice-related requirements, while a Slice Profile represents network slice subnet-related requirements.

q_45743.question: What does the LCID field in the MAC PDU sub headers identify in the context of BSR?
q_45743.ground_truth: The LCID field in the MAC PDU sub headers identifies the group of logical channel(s) whose buffer status is being reported in a BSR.

q_45744.question: What information is required for an Aerial UE measurement control and reporting test for event H1?
q_45744.ground_truth: The UE must be able to report measurements for event H1 with periodical reporting based on the Aerial UE height and the event's hysteresis and threshold parameters.

q_45745.question: What is the requirement for the UE to report RSTD for the reference cell and its neighbor cells in inter-frequency OTDOA measurements?
q_45745.ground_truth: The UE physical layer shall be capable of reporting RSTD for the reference cell and all the neighbor cells i out of at least (n-1) neighbor cells within specified conditions.

q_45746.question: What is the confidence level required in the TDD Intra frequency conditional handover test case?

q_45747.question: What should the UE do if it receives Random Access Responses, but none of them contain a Random Access Preamble identifier that matches the transmitted Random Access Preamble?
q_45747.ground_truth: The UE shall re-transmit the preamble with the calculated PRACH transmission power if all received Random Access Responses contain Random Access Preamble identifiers that do not match the transmitted Random Access Preamble.

q_45748.question: What does the "Scope-token" consist of in the context of the 3gpp-Sbi-Other-Access-Scopes header?
q_45748.ground_truth: The "Scope-token" consists of a list of space-delimited, case-sensitive strings, containing one or more NF service name(s) of the NF service producer and/or additional resource/operation-level scope(s) for these APIs that are not already contained in the 3gpp-Sbi-Access-Scope header.

q_45749.question: What is the basic downlink transmission scheme for LTE use centered on OFDM?
q_45749.ground_truth: The downlink transmission scheme for LTE uses OFDM with a cyclic prefix and a sub-carrier spacing of 15 kHz. There are also four reduced sub-carrier spacings, each with different cyclic prefix lengths.

q_45750.question: What should the MME do when it receives a Modify Bearer Response message?
q_45750.ground_truth: If the MME has sent the counter for the RRC Cause "MO Exception data" in the Modify Bearer Resquest, the MME shall reset the counter value when receiving the Modify Bearer Response message.

q_45751.question: What should be the condition for the successful completion of the test?
q_45751.ground_truth: For the successful completion of the test, the UE should transmit a MeasurementReport message triggered by Event A3, with a measurement reporting delay less than 3.2 s from the beginning of time period T2.

q_45752.question: What are the potential specification impacts for sidelink positioning from the perspective of RAN1?
q_45752.ground_truth: The potential specification impacts for sidelink positioning from the perspective of RAN1 include specification changes to support PC5-only-based positioning and combination of Uu- and PC5-based positioning, introduction of RTT-type solution(s) using SL, SL-AoA, SL-TDOA, new sidelink reference signal (SL PRS) including details of sequence design, physical structure, resource mapping, SL PRS resource allocation scheme 1 and 2, SL PRS transmission in dedicated resource pool or shared resource pool, support of Open Loop Power Control (OLPC) for SL PRS transmissions, and details of sidelink positioning measurement reporting.

q_45753.question: What does the 3GPP Technical Report present in relation to 3GPP networks?
q_45753.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Report presents typical media traffic characteristics, including bandwidth and latency requirements, that are important for 3GPP standardization work.

q_45754.question: What is the primary cell referred to when the procedures described in clause 7.2 are applied for the secondary PUCCH group?
q_45754.ground_truth: The primary cell is referred to as the PUCCH-SCell of the secondary PUCCH group when the procedures described in clause 7.2 are applied for the secondary PUCCH group.

q_45755.question: What is the purpose of SMF receiving a redirection indication with PCF ID from the PCF for the PDU session?
q_45755.ground_truth: SMF shall terminate the current SM Policy Control association and reselects a PCF based on the received PCF ID.

q_45756.question: What key issue was identified in terms of IP connectivity between MC systems?
q_45756.ground_truth: The key issue is the lack of investigations on IP connectivity point-to-point and group standalone transmissions that involve two MC systems, as well as scenarios when the MC service user is abroad and uses home breakout or local breakout. The solution includes investigating and developing solutions for these scenarios.

q_45757.question: What is the typical isolation for co-site inter-sector interference between a TX full power transmission of one sector to one receiver chain of the other sector?

q_45758.question: What is the purpose of the second field with one bit in resource allocations of type 1?
q_45758.ground_truth: The second field with one bit is used to indicate a shift of the resource allocation span within a subset, where a bit value of 1 triggers a shift, and 0 does not.

q_45759.question: What message types require both SGW FQ-CSID and MME FQ-CSID in the case of inter SGW HO/TAU when the MME does not support the feature?
q_45759.ground_truth: Modify Bearer Request and Proxy Binding Update (if PMIPv6 is used)

q_45760.question: In which specification and clause is the behavior of the cell selection criterion S defined for NB-IoT in normal coverage?
q_45760.ground_truth: The behavior of the cell selection criterion S for NB-IoT in normal coverage is defined in TS 36.304, clause 5.2.3.2a.

q_45761.question: What security mechanisms are used for the interface between W-5GAN and 5GC?
q_45761.ground_truth: The N2 interface between the W-5GAN and the AMF is secured as defined in clause 9.2 of the present document, and the N3 interface between the W-5GAN and the UPF is secured as defined in clause 9.3 of the present document.

q_45762.question: Which authentication methods can be used by the NF Service Consumer to authenticate to the NF Service Producer for indirect communication if the PLMN uses token-based authorization and its policy mandates that the NRF authenticate the NF Service Consumer before granting an access token?
q_45762.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer can authenticate at the application layer using CCA based authentication as specified in clause 13.3.8. This authentication is optional to use and based on operator policy.

q_45763.question: When should the `<mbs-session-de-announcement-acknowledgement>` element be included in the context of multicast MBS sessions?
q_45763.ground_truth: This element may be included and set to "true" or "false" to indicate whether an MBS session de-announcement acknowledgement is expected or not.

q_45764.question: What are the potential contents of the iE-Extensions field in the PDUSessionResourceModifyIndicationTransfer message?
q_45764.ground_truth: The iE-Extensions field in the PDUSessionResourceModifyIndicationTransfer message can contain ID-SecondaryRATUsageInformation, ID-SecurityResult, ID-RedundantDLQosFlowPerTNLInformation, ID-AdditionalRedundantDLQosFlowPerTNLInformation, or ID-GlobalRANNodeID.

q_45765.question: What should the 5G-RG do when it receives an EAP response/Identity with a NAI-based SUPI from an AUN3 device behind it?
q_45765.ground_truth: The 5G-RG shall construct a SUCI using the null-scheme from the NAI-based SUPI if the NAI-based SUPI is received from the AUN3 device in step 3 (as in clause 7B.7.2).

q_45766.question: What actions can the AF take based on the resource failure reports from the UE?
q_45766.ground_truth: Based on the resource failure reports from the UE, the AF may release the multicast MBS session and use an existing MBS broadcast session or establish a new MBS broadcast session for the group call. Alternatively, the AF may release some low priority group communications which are using the MBS if there is not enough radio resource.

q_45767.question: In what mode must the UE be for the local IP address in traffic flow aggregate description and TFT filter to be supported in order to include the IE in the message?
q_45767.ground_truth: The UE must be in NB-S1 mode.

q_45768.question: What is the procedure for H-ANDSF discovery by the UE during DNS lookup resolution?
q_45768.ground_truth: The UE builds a Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN) that is set to the ANFSF-SN FQDN and included in the DNS request. The UE then selects the IP address of the H-ANDSF included in the DNS response message.

q_45769.question: What is the role of the Technical Specification Group (TSG) in the 3GPP?
q_45769.ground_truth: The Technical Specification Group (TSG) is responsible for producing technical specifications and reports for the 3GPP. The contents of the present document are subject to continuing work within the TSG and may change following formal TSG approval.

q_45770.question: In what scenario would the variable "contentionDetected" be set to true?
q_45770.ground_truth: The variable "contentionDetected" would be set to true if the random access attempt is a 4-step random access attempt and the SS/PBCH block RSRP of the SS/PBCH block corresponding to the random-access resource used in the random-access attempt is at or above rsrp-ThresholdSSB.

q_45771.question: When is a UE able to transmit ProSe Direct Communication utilizing the radio parameters associated with a geographical area and in accordance with the timing of the selected SyncRef UE while being authorized for ProSe Direct Communication with specific radio parameters for when the UE is not served by E-UTRAN and out of coverage?
q_45771.ground_truth: When the UE wants to transmit ProSe direct communication, has determined itself located in that geographical area, and has selected a SyncRef UE with S-RSRP measurement result below the value of syncTxThreshOoC in the MasterInformationBlock-SL message received from this UE and inCoverage is set to TRUE.

q_45772.question: What should the participating MCData function do if it is unable to identify the controlling MCData function for IP Connectivity session?
q_45772.ground_truth: If the participating MCData function is unable to identify the controlling MCData function for IP Connectivity session, it shall reject the SIP INVITE request with a SIP 404 (Not Found) response with the warning text "142 unable to determine the controlling function" in a Warning header field as specified in clause 4.9, and shall not continue with any of the remaining steps.

q_45773.question: What is the purpose of L3 filtering in the measurement reporting delay?
q_45773.ground_truth: L3 filtering can cause an additional delay in the measurement reporting delay.

q_45774.question: What must the manufacturer declare regarding the NB-IoT operating mode for the declared supported band?
q_45774.ground_truth: The manufacturer must declare which NB-IoT operating mode (standalone, in-band, or guard band) the base station supports for each declared supported band.

q_45775.question: What is the procedure followed by the NF Service Consumer during N2 based handover for exchanging N3/N9 forwarding tunnel information with the NF Service Producer?
q_45775.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer sends a POST request containing dataForwarding attribute set to true, n9DlForwardingTnlList attribute carrying the N9 downlink indirect data forwarding tunnel(s) info of target I-UPF, and n9UlForwardingTnlList attribute carrying the N9 uplink indirect data forwarding tunnel(s) info of target I-UPF.

q_45776.question: What should the UE do when it detects radio link failure and the RRC Connection re-establishment is successful?
q_45776.ground_truth: The UE shall be in E-UTRA RRC_CONNECTED state after successfully completing the RRC Connection re-establishment procedure.

q_45777.question: What is the purpose of NWDAF in monitoring the behavior of NFs?
q_45777.ground_truth: NWDAF supports the monitoring of the behavior of all NFs to ensure that they behave as defined/specified. If the NFs behave erroneously, NWDAF should be able to detect the anomaly so that appropriate steps can be taken.

q_45778.question: What should the NTXU,countedpercell value be for FCC guidance in MIMO systems in Region 2?
q_45778.ground_truth: NTXU,countedpercell should be equal to 1 for the purposes of calculating the spurious emissions limits in 6.6.6.2, 6.6.6.3 or 6.6.6.4 in Region 2.

q_45779.question: What is the minimum requirement for a UTRA FDD OTA sensitivity in the presence of an interfering signal?
q_45779.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for a UTRA FDD OTA sensitivity in the presence of an interfering signal is defined in subclause 10.2.3.

q_45780.question: What should the UE do during T2 if there are no uplink resources for reporting the valid CSI in subframe (m+49)?
q_45780.ground_truth: The UE should use the next available uplink resource for reporting the corresponding valid CSI.

q_45781.question: What is the purpose of the FLS-1 interface?
q_45781.ground_truth: The FLS-1 interface is used for the FLS to get location information from non-3GPP defined accesses.

q_45782.question: What should a UE do when it detects a DCI format providing the PDCCH monitoring adaptation field indicating to skip PDCCH monitoring for the duration on the active DL BWP of a SpCell?
q_45782.ground_truth: After the UE detects a DCI format providing the PDCCH monitoring adaptation field indicating to the UE to skip PDCCH monitoring for the duration on the active DL BWP of a SpCell, when contention resolution is successful, the UE resumes PDCCH monitoring on the SpCell.

q_45783.question: What is the E-UTRA serving cell for the EN-DC setup in the test environment?
q_45783.ground_truth: Cell 1, also known as the PCell, is the E-UTRA serving cell for the EN-DC setup.

q_45784.question: What is the In-band blocking requirement for IAB-DU type 1-H, in terms of minimum offset for narrowband blocking?
q_45784.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for In-band blocking for IAB-DU type 1-H is the same as specified for BS type 1-H in TS38.104, subclause 7.4.2.2, where references to BS channel bandwidth apply to IAB-DU channel bandwidth, with the interfering signal offset defined relative to the IAB-DU RF Bandwidth edges.

q_45785.question: What is the TCLw requirement for the desktop hands-free UE when measured under free-field conditions at the nominal setting of the volume control?
q_45785.ground_truth: The TCLw requirement for the desktop hands-free UE when measured under free-field conditions at the nominal setting of the volume control is at least 46 dB.

q_45786.question: What is the scope of the tokenCAPIF in the TLS with OAuth token method?
q_45786.ground_truth: The scope of the tokenCAPIF in the TLS with OAuth token method includes API invoker ID, service API ID, and resource owner ID.

q_45787.question: What should a call control entity do when it receives a STATUS message with an incompatible call control state?
q_45787.ground_truth: It should clear the call by sending a RELEASE COMPLETE message with cause #101 "message not compatible with protocol state".

q_45788.question: What information does the UE include in the RRCConnectionSetupComplete message, if it has connection establishment failure information available and the RPLMN is equal to the plmn-Identity stored in VarConnEstFailReport?
q_45788.ground_truth: The UE includes connEstFailInfoAvailable in the RRCConnectionSetupComplete message.

q_45789.question: What is the purpose of the "Authenticate" service operation offered by the AUSF?
q_45789.ground_truth: The "Authenticate" service operation permits the requester network function, usually the Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF), to initiate the authentication of the UE by providing the UE's identifier and serving network name to the AUSF.

q_45790.question: What is the required BER (bit error rate) for any measured E-UTRA carrier as defined in clause 7.7.5.4-1, 7.7.5.4-2, and 7.7.5.4-3?
q_45790.ground_truth: The BER for any measured E-UTRA carrier should be less than or equal to 0.001.

q_45791.question: What message is sent by the network to the UE to reject the modification of a dedicated bearer resource?

q_45792.question: What protection mechanism is defined for the NIDD API in the NEF?

q_45793.question: What actions does an SMLC perform after a restart to restore data for a specific LMU?
q_45793.ground_truth: The SMLC opens a signalling connection to the LMU, sends an LLP Reset message to the LMU, and the LMU cancels any LCS measurement and O&M tasks and sends an LLP Reset acknowledgement to the SMLC.

q_45794.question: Which header shall be supported by the Data Collection AF at reference points R1, R2, R3, and R4 as per clause 5.3.2.4?

q_45795.question: What is the formula for calculating the Nth uplink grant in the semi-persistent scheduling in TDD?

q_45796.question: What is the purpose of the "Confidentiality, integrity and replay protections over SBA interface" requirement for the AAnF network product?
q_45796.ground_truth: The "Confidentiality, integrity and replay protections over SBA interface" requirement ensures that data transferred over the SBA interface between the AAnF and AF/NEF or AUSF is confidentiality, integrity, and replay protected.

q_45797.question: What is the role of the User Info ID in the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay Discovery?
q_45797.ground_truth: The User Info ID is a unique identifier for each Prose UE, which is used to request and return security materials during the UE-to-UE Relay Discovery procedure.

q_45798.question: What function does an HGMLC perform in terms of cancellations of periodic or triggered location for a target UE?
q_45798.ground_truth: At an HGMLC, support cancelation of a periodic or triggered location.

q_45799.question: What type of SIP MESSAGE request is sent to the terminating participating MCPTT function with the Request-URI set to its public service identity, and contains an XML body with an <mcptt-Params> element with an <emergency-ind> element?
q_45799.ground_truth: A "SIP MESSAGE request for emergency notification for terminating participating MCPTT function"

q_45800.question: What should the en-gNB do upon receiving the UE CONTEXT RELEASE message during EN-DC for E-RABs for which data forwarding has been performed?
q_45800.ground_truth: The en-gNB should continue forwarding U-plane data as long as packets are received from the EPC or the buffer has not been emptied.

q_45801.question: What is the synchronization requirement for the UE before the start of the time duration T1?
q_45801.ground_truth: The UE shall be fully synchronized to the PSCell before the start of the time duration T1.

q_45802.question: What is the purpose of initial key distribution for application signalling between the MC client and MCX Server?
q_45802.ground_truth: Initial key distribution for application signalling is performed using a client-server key (CSK) sent from the MC client to the MCX Server over the SIP interface, securing application signalling between the MC client and MCX Server.

q_45803.question: What must the ME do with new cell broadcast pages?
q_45803.ground_truth: The ME shall identify new cell broadcast pages by their message identifier, serial number, and page values.

q_45804.question: Which transportLayerAddress is referenced in the E-RABDataForwardingItem?
q_45804.ground_truth: Both dL-transportLayerAddress and uL-TransportLayerAddress can be referenced in the E-RABDataForwardingItem, but not necessarily in all cases. Some may be omitted.

q_45805.question: What is the measured value that will be used to decide whether the equipment meets the requirements of the test report?
q_45805.ground_truth: The measured value related to the corresponding limit will be used to decide if the equipment meets the requirements of the test report.

q_45806.question: What happens after the AMF receives an N2 Initial Context Setup Failure from TNGF-1 with a cause value indicating TNGF relocation?
q_45806.ground_truth: After receiving an N2 Initial Context Setup Failure from TNGF-1 with a cause value indicating TNGF relocation, the AMF sends an N2 Initial Context Setup Request to TNGF-2 including the TNGF key and the UE identity to establish an N2 association for the UE.

q_45807.question: What is the default value for the "<allow-signalling-protection>" element of the "<protection-between-mcdata-servers>" element?
q_45807.ground_truth: The default value for the "<allow-signalling-protection>" element of the "<protection-between-mcdata-servers>" element is "true", indicating that signaling protection between MCData servers is enabled.

q_45808.question: What should the UE do if the contention resolution timer expires?
q_45808.ground_truth: The UE should re-select a preamble and transmit with the calculated PRACH transmission power when the back off time expires.

q_45809.question: What does a suffix A subclause specify in TS 36.102 for UE category M1?
q_45809.ground_truth: In TS 36.102, the suffix A subclause specifies the applicable minimum requirements for UE category M1 where they differ from the requirements in the main subclause.

q_45810.question: When must the AMF update the Allowed CAG list in the Mobility Restrictions towards NG-RAN?
q_45810.ground_truth: The AMF must update the Allowed CAG list in the Mobility Restrictions towards NG-RAN if the evaluation of the validity condition of an entry in the Allowed CAG list changes between true and false.

q_45811.question: When should the UE initiate the detach procedure?
q_45811.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the detach procedure if it is switched off, the USIM card is removed, if it wishes to detach for EPS services, if it wishes to detach for non-EPS services, or as part of the eCall inactivity procedure.

q_45812.question: What is the action taken by the SS after T3 expires in the test procedure?
q_45812.ground_truth: After T3 expires, the SS transmits an RRCConnectionRelease message to release the RRC connection including the release of established radio bearers and all radio resources.

q_45813.question: Which entity is required to store a TMPI together with the corresponding IMPI until the next bootstrapping procedure is executed using this TMPI?

q_45814.question: What is the minimum number of downlink cells required for a UE to support NR-DC operation?
q_45814.ground_truth: For a UE to support NR-DC operation, it needs to be capable of monitoring at least one downlink cell for each of the following combinations: Ncells,r15/r16, Ncells,r15/r17, and Ncells,r16/r17.

q_45815.question: In response to a location request from a VAL user, what should the SLM-C include in the <report-request> element?
q_45815.ground_truth: The SLM-C should include at least one child element: an <immediate-report-indicator> element and/or the location reporting elements that are requested.

q_45816.question: What action does the NF service consumer take in response to the NWDAF containing MTLF reporting the ML model information?
q_45816.ground_truth: The NF service consumer responds to the NWDAF containing MTLF with an HTTP "204 No Content" message.

q_45817.question: What is the use of the UE-CapabilityRequestFilterCommon?
q_45817.ground_truth: The UE-CapabilityRequestFilterCommon is used to request filtered UE capabilities. The filter is common for all capability containers that are requested.

q_45818.question: What field in the DL TX Power Adjustment MAC CE and Desired DL TX Power Adjustment MAC CE contains the adjustment to a node's DL TX power or desired DL TX power adjustment?

q_45819.question: What should the UAV include in the Direct Communication Request when setting up C2 communication with PC5?
q_45819.ground_truth: The UAV should include the U2X service type (indicating C2 service), UAV identifier, UAV-C identifier, U2X service security policy specific to the C2 service, security capability, and key establishment information in the Direct Communication Request when setting up C2 communication with PC5.

q_45820.question: What is the purpose of the media handling capabilities of a telepresence client (TP UE) as specified in the document?
q_45820.ground_truth: The media handling capabilities of a telepresence client (TP UE) are specified in the document to support conversational speech, video and text transported over RTP in an IMS-based telepresence service.

q_45821.question: What is the name of the complexType named "SNR-rangeType" which contains a sequence of "Low-SNR" and "High-SNR" elements?

q_45822.question: What should the timestamp field of the ETSI TS 102 232-1 PSHeader structure be set to?
q_45822.ground_truth: The timestamp field of the ETSI TS 102 232-1 PSHeader structure should be set to the time at which the RCS server event was observed (i.e. the timestamp field of the xIRI).

q_45823.question: What should the UE do when it wants to request a modification of bearer resources for a traffic flow aggregate, and the existing GBR needs to be modified?
q_45823.ground_truth: The UE should set the TFT operation code in the Traffic flow aggregate IE to "no TFT operation" and include the packet filter identifier(s) to which the change of the GBR applies in the Packet filter identifier parameter in the parameters list, and indicate the new GBR requested for the EPS bearer context in the Required traffic flow QoS IE.

q_45824.question: What is the purpose of the "Application Context Transfer" procedure in the context of Edge Computing?
q_45824.ground_truth: The Application Context Transfer procedure is part of the service continuity mechanism in Edge Computing, which involves the transfer of the Application Context between the source and target Edge Application Servers during service handover.

q_45825.question: What shall the Controlling MCPTT function reject with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response, when receiving a SIP MESSAGE request for remotely initiated private call?
q_45825.ground_truth: If the incoming SIP MESSAGE request does not contain an application/resource-lists+xml MIME body or contains an application/resource-lists+xml MIME body with more than one <entry> element in all <list> elements of the <resource-lists> element.

q_45826.question: What message does the gNB-DU send to transfer information associated to an F1-C interface instance?
q_45826.ground_truth: The gNB-DU sends the F1 SETUP REQUEST message to the gNB-CU, transferring information associated to an F1-C interface instance.

q_45827.question: What is the purpose of test point analysis and test point selection in the testing of NR/5GC and EN-DC capable devices?
q_45827.ground_truth: The purpose of test point analysis and test point selection is to determine the required number of test points for each test case and ensure adequate coverage in the testing of NR/5GC and EN-DC capable devices.

q_45828.question: When should a UE reselect a cell on an equal priority E-UTRAN frequency than the serving frequency?
q_45828.ground_truth: A UE should reselect a cell on an equal priority E-UTRAN frequency based on ranking as defined in sub-clause 6.

q_45829.question: What should the AMF do if a PDU Session Establishment Request is received from an Emergency Registered UE and the Request Type is not set to "Emergency Request" or "Existing Emergency PDU Session"?
q_45829.ground_truth: The AMF should reject the request with an appropriate reject cause.

q_45830.question: What is the name of the service sequencing that cannot contain any user-specific service-primitives?
q_45830.ground_truth: The name of the service sequencing is "Void".

q_45831.question: What actions does the IWK-SCEF take when the request indicates continuous reporting with successful authorization?
q_45831.ground_truth: The IWK-SCEF stores the received parameters, sends an acknowledgement to the MME/SGSN, and starts watching for the indicated Monitoring Event(s).

q_45832.question: What is the maximum allowable measurement reporting delay for Event B2 in test 1 and test 3?

q_45833.question: What action should a MS take when it receives a rejection cause #7 for GPRS services?
q_45833.ground_truth: The MS should set the GPRS update status to GU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, delete any P-TMSI, P-TMSI signature, RAI and GPRS ciphering key sequence number, and consider the SIM/USIM as invalid for GPRS services until switching off or SIM/USIM removal. The new GMM state is GMM-DEREGISTERED and the new MM state is MM IDLE.

q_45834.question: What event is represented by the "UCM.EntryUpdateReq" measurement received by the NEF?
q_45834.ground_truth: It represents the number of UCMF dictionary entry update requests received by the NEF from the AF.

q_45835.question: In which scenario should the SEPP select the data encryption and modification policy applicable for the specific notification type and target PLMN, using the notification type list stored as specified in subclause 5.2.3.3?
q_45835.ground_truth: When the incoming HTTP/2 message has the "3gpp-Sbi-Callback" header.

q_45836.question: How is the precoding information field utilized in resource allocations of type 0?
q_45836.ground_truth: In resource allocations of type 0, the precoding information field is not present, and the number of transmission layers is equal to 2 if both codewords are enabled; transmit diversity is used if codeword 0 is enabled while codeword 1 is disabled.

q_45837.question: What should the participating MCData function consider as the served MCData user information entry?
q_45837.ground_truth: The participating MCData function should consider the MCData user information entry in the list of MCData user information entries that is associated with the served MCData ID and MCData user information entry.

q_45838.question: What is the maximum allowed probability of ACK/NACK feedback loss on any active serving cell for a UE performing RLM/BFD measurements on a deactivated PSCell in bfd-and-RLM with value true mode?

q_45839.question: What is specified in clause 6.9.2.2.1 of the document, in regards to HTTP standard headers?
q_45839.ground_truth: This clause specifies the usage of HTTP standard headers, as specified in clause 5.2.2 of 3GPP TS 29.500.

q_45840.question: When should the MAC entity set the resource reservation interval in the re-selected resource to replace pre-empted resource?
q_45840.ground_truth: It is up to UE implementation to decide whether to set the resource reservation interval in the re-selected resource to replace pre-empted resource.

q_45841.question: What should the TWIF do when it receives a Decorated NAI in the Registration Request message from the N5CW device?
q_45841.ground_truth: The TWIF should send the NAI which corresponds to the HPLMN by removing the decoration from the Decorated NAI.

q_45842.question: What is the procedure for RTCP signalling protection between a MC UE and MCX Server?
q_45842.ground_truth: The procedure for RTCP signalling protection between a MC UE and MCX Server is the use of a Client-Server Key (CSK) and CSK identifier (CSK-ID) for floor and media control.

q_45843.question: In what scenario will the TBS determination follow step 4?
q_45843.ground_truth: The TBS determination will follow step 4 when Ninf o > 3824.

q_45844.question: What is the role of the "T3396 value" information element in the "deactivate PDP context request" message?
q_45844.ground_truth: The network may include the "T3396 value" information element if the ESM cause is #26 "insufficient resources" in the "deactivate PDP context request" message.

q_45845.question: What should a participating MCPTT function do if the MCPTT user profile document does not authorize the user to initiate private calls?
q_45845.ground_truth: It should reject the SIP REFER request for pre-established session with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response, as specified in clause 9.

q_45846.question: What is the requirement for UE when active BWP switching occurs during the measurement gaps for PRS measurement in RedCap UEs?
q_45846.ground_truth: Active BWP switching should not occur during the measurement gaps for PRS measurement.

q_45847.question: Which network elements are involved in increasing the counter in "5.1.1.10.3 Number of released active DRBs"?
q_45847.ground_truth: The NG-RAN, AMF, and UE are involved in increasing the counter.

q_45848.question: What is the role of access control components in enabling different access permissions for authorized users in MC systems?
q_45848.ground_truth: Access control components can determine the level of authorization of each user and manage their requests, information exchange, and track their access activities to ensure accountability.

q_45849.question: How are the preparation and execution phases of a CHO procedure managed in the control plane?
q_45849.ground_truth: In the control plane, the preparation and execution phases of a CHO procedure are performed without the involvement of the 5GC. Preparation messages are exchanged directly between gNBs, and the source gNB releases resources at the source gNB during the conditional handover completion phase, which is triggered by the target gNB.

q_45850.question: What should a UE do if there is no appropriate 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE around?
q_45850.ground_truth: It is left to UE implementation on how to handle the case when there is no appropriate 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE around.

q_45851.question: What type of NR UE does the test applicability in 6.5A.2.2.1.2 apply to?
q_45851.ground_truth: This test case applies to all types of NR UE release 15 and forward that supports FR2 2UL CA.

q_45852.question: What information does the Access-Network-Info AVP contain in a trusted WLAN?
q_45852.ground_truth: The Access-Network-Info AVP contains the SSID, BSSID, Location-Information, Location-Data, Operator-Name, Logical-Access-ID, and other optional AVPs in a trusted WLAN.

q_45853.question: What is the recommended TCLw for the desktop hands-free UE when measured under free-field conditions at the nominal setting of the volume control?
q_45853.ground_truth: A TCLw for the desktop hands-free UE of at least 55 dB is recommended as a performance objective when measured under free-field conditions at the nominal setting of the volume control.

q_45854.question: What is the authentication method used by the NSWOF during the SWa' Authentication and Authorization procedure?
q_45854.ground_truth: EAP-AKA' as specified in RFC 5448 is used as the authentication method during the SWa' Authentication and Authorization procedure in the 3GPP NS-WL system.

q_45855.question: In the REDUNDANT steering mode, when should the UE and UPF send the traffic of the SDF on both accesses if a threshold value is provided?
q_45855.ground_truth: The UE and UPF shall send the traffic of the SDF on both accesses if the measurement of RTT or Packet Loss Rate on both accesses exceeds the values for RTT or Packet Loss Rate provided in the "rttThres" or "plrThres" attributes.

q_45856.question: What is the definition of "beam" as given in the document?
q_45856.ground_truth: The main lobe of the radiation pattern of an antenna array

q_45857.question: What are the two alternatives being studied for expression of angle of arrival measurement error for determination of positioning integrity for UL AoA?
q_45857.ground_truth: The two alternatives being studied are Alt. 1: No conversion (e.g., the measurement error is expressed as error in AoA or ZoA in LCS/GCS), and Alt. 2: Conversion function (defined as function of AoA/ZoA in LCS).

q_45858.question: What sub-element can be included in the "any-cell-change" element?
q_45858.ground_truth: The "any-cell-change" element can include the following sub-element: "trigger-id", which is used to indicate a unique identifier for the trigger.

q_45859.question: What message does the ER Authenticator send to the ER Server for re-authentication in the ERP exchange?
q_45859.ground_truth: The ER Authenticator sends an AAA message to the ER server for re-authentication in the ERP exchange.

q_45860.question: What does the Hardware Load Indicator IE indicate in the 3GPP 5G standard?
q_45860.ground_truth: The Hardware Load Indicator IE indicates the status of the Hardware Load.

q_45861.question: What are the RFR measurement results for Device 2 on HATS 2?
q_45861.ground_truth: Device 2 fails the RFR mask for all measurement points on HATS 2. In-band sensitivity differences between HATS 1 and HATS 2 exceed 10dB at 250Hz and reach 8dB at 2.5kHz.

q_45862.question: What information is stored in the SGSNPDPRecord?
q_45862.ground_truth: The SGSNPDPRecord includes information such as the addresses of involved nodes, the duration of the session, and the traffic volume.

q_45863.question: What condition determines the non-applicability of a sub-block spectrum emission mask for some frequency?
q_45863.ground_truth: A sub-block spectrum emission mask does not apply for some frequency if it overlaps with the sub-block bandwidth of another sub-block.

q_45864.question: What are the potential threats if security issues are not considered for protecting SL groupcast/broadcast communications?
q_45864.ground_truth: The potential threats if security issues are not considered for protecting SL groupcast/broadcast communications are passive attackers eavesdropping on privacy sensitive data, active attackers intercepting, modifying or replaying data packets, and UEs being impersonated by an attacker.

q_45865.question: In the equation for average DL delay in gNB-DU for a network slice subnet, what does the variable "W" represent?
q_45865.ground_truth: W is the measurement for the weighted average in the equation for average DL delay in gNB-DU for a network slice subnet.

q_45866.question: What is the main objective of the new solution for NTN coverage analysis?
q_45866.ground_truth: The main objective of the new solution for NTN coverage analysis is to leverage NWDAF's data collection and analytics exposure capabilities for NTN coverage estimation.

q_45867.question: What is the procedure for authorization in the UE-to-UE Relay Discovery?
q_45867.ground_truth: The 5G DDNMF of the Source UE/Target UE sends an authorization request to the PCF/UDM of the Source UE/Target UE or the ProSe App Server. If authorized, the 5G DDNMF of the Source UE/Target UE contacts the indicated PLMN's 5G DDNMF of the UE-to-UE Relay by sending a Discovery Request message including the PC5 UE security capability. The 5G DDNMF of the UE-to-UE Relay may exchange authorization messages with the ProSe Application Server. If authorized, the 5G DDNMF of the UE-to-UE Relay responds to the 5G DDNMF of the Source UE/Target UE with a Discovery Response message including the Code Security Parameters and a chosen PC5 ciphering algorithm.

q_45868.question: How long is the delay uncertainty before the ECGI reporting in the uplink DCCH?
q_45868.ground_truth: The delay uncertainty is twice the TTI of the uplink DCCH.

q_45869.question: What is the condition for the reference signals of RLM, BFD, CBD, or L1-RSRP for beam reporting on FR2 serving frequencies to not be fully overlapped by intra-frequency SMTC occasions?
q_45869.ground_truth: If any of the reference signals for RLM, BFD, CBD, or L1-RSRP on any FR2 serving frequency in the same band outside the measurement gap are not completely covered by intra-frequency SMTC occasions, this condition is met.

q_45870.question: What is the effect of L3 filtering on the measurement accuracy and reporting delay in UTRA and E-UTRAN FDD?
q_45870.ground_truth: When L3 filtering is used, there is an additional delay in measurement reporting and an impact on measurement accuracy for all measured cells, as specified in clause 9 and 8.17.5.2.6.
