Similarly, a network should return the status message when it diagnoses a "missing conditional IE" error or an "unexpected conditional IE" error in a message, or when it receives a message with at least one syntactically incorrect conditional IE.

q_46351.question: What is the purpose of the "BdtReqData" data type in the Npcf_BDTPolicyControl_Create service operation?
q_46351.ground_truth: The "BdtReqData" data type in the Npcf_BDTPolicyControl_Create service operation contains information about the background data transfer request, such as the ASP identifier, volume of data per UE, expected number of UEs, desired time window, and network area information.

q_46352.question: What is the purpose of the SGs association between a VLR and an MME in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) system?
q_46352.ground_truth: The SGs association between a VLR and an MME in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) system enables the coordination of location information of UEs that are IMSI attached to both EPS and non-EPS services, and conveys some circuit switched related procedures via the MME.

q_46353.question: When must the UE not activate PSM?
q_46353.ground_truth: The UE must not activate PSM if it is attached for emergency bearer services or has a PDN connection for emergency bearer services.

q_46354.question: What should the MME do with the alternative IMSI value after storing it in the UE context if the MUSIM UE has included a Requested IMSI offset IE in the ATTACH REQUEST message and if the MME supports paging timing collision control?
q_46354.ground_truth: The MME shall calculate an alternative IMSI value using the IMSI offset value and store it in the UE context as specified in 3GPP TS 23.401. The alternative IMSI value is used for deriving the paging occasion as specified in 3GPP TS 36.304.

q_46355.question: What should the UE do if the effective channel code rate is higher than 0.931 in the initial transmission?
q_46355.ground_truth: The UE may skip decoding a transport block in an initial transmission if the effective channel code rate is higher than 0.931.

q_46356.question: Which message is included in the 5G ProSe direct link re-keying procedure if the null integrity protection algorithm is not in use and the 5G ProSe direct link is not for direct communication between the 5G ProSe remote UE and the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE?

q_46357.question: What is the required DCI format for single-layer spatial multiplexing in section 8.3.1.1H of the document?

q_46358.question: What is the test purpose for 8.3.7.3 in TS 36.104?
q_46358.ground_truth: The test purpose for 8.3.7.3 in TS 36.104 is to verify the receiver's ability to detect ACK bits under multipath fading propagation conditions for a given SNR.

q_46359.question: What must the <supported-services> element in the group document contain, in order for the calling MCPTT user to be allowed to initiate the group call?
q_46359.ground_truth: The <supported-services> element in the group document must contain a <service> element with an "enabler" attribute set to the MCPTT ICSI and a <group-media> element containing an entry set to "MCPTT speech" for the calling MCPTT user to be allowed to initiate the group call.

q_46360.question: What should the Request-URI be set to in the SIP MESSAGE request for notifying an MCData client of a pre-defined group geographic area?
q_46360.ground_truth: The Request-URI should be set to the public user identity associated to the MCData ID of the targeted MCData user.

q_46361.question: What is the default floor priority of a Floor Request message if the Floor Priority field is not present?
q_46361.ground_truth: If the Floor Priority field is not present in the Floor Request message, the default floor priority is the minimum value allowed for the Floor Priority.

q_46362.question: What is the function of the Mobility Management Entity (MME) in the Evolved Packet System (EPS)?
q_46362.ground_truth: The Mobility Management Entity (MME) in the Evolved Packet System (EPS) is responsible for managing the mobility of User Equipments (UEs) in the EPS, such as enabling the provisioning of CS-domain services (e.g. voice call, Location Services (LCS) or supplementary services) by reusing CS infrastructure when the UE is served by E-UTRAN. Additionally, SMS delivery via the CS core network is realized without CS fallback.

q_46363.question: What can be required for NR repeaters operating in certain bands for spurious emissions minimum requirements in a specific frequency range?
q_46363.ground_truth: The requirement may vary depending on the region and the specific bands in which the repeater operates.

q_46364.question: What is the role of the NEF (Network Exposure Function) in the Ranging service exposure to server solution?
q_46364.ground_truth: The NEF supports Ranging/Sidelink Positioning service exposure in the Ranging service exposure to server solution.

q_46365.question: What should a UE do when it receives any unknown value within a known traffic descriptor or route selection descriptor component in the context of URSP rule enforcement?
q_46365.ground_truth: The UE should still use the unknown value to identify a match with the application information, the PIN information, the AUN3 device information or the connectivity group information, when the same unknown value is provided by upper layers.

q_46366.question: What is the maximum cell re-selection delay allowed for an already detected cell in the E-UTRAN FDD FDD Intra frequency case for normal coverage?
q_46366.ground_truth: The cell re-selection delay to an already detected cell shall be less than 8 seconds.

q_46367.question: What information is sent by the SMF to the AMF, if the User Plane connection of the PDU Session is active at the time of PDU Session Release?
q_46367.ground_truth: If the User Plane connection of the PDU Session is activated, the message sent by the SMF to the AMF shall include N2 SM Resource Release request.

q_46368.question: What are the two main objectives of the present document?
q_46368.ground_truth: The two main objectives of the present document are to investigate AKMA roaming architecture and requirements by taking regulatory compliance into account, and to study the architecture impact and procedures of introducing the Authentication Proxy into AKMA.

q_46369.question: How is the sending and frequency characteristics of the handset and headset UE checked?
q_46369.ground_truth: The handset and headset UE sending is checked against performance requirements, using a tolerance mask defined for each center frequency of the fractional octave bands in the respective test method. If necessary, the tolerance mask is interpolated linearly for a certain center frequency between the two closest neighboring data points on a log-frequency scale. The sensitivity is expressed in terms of dBV/Pa. Measurements are made at 1/12-octave intervals as given by the R.40 series of preferred numbers in ISO~3 for frequencies from 100 Hz to 8 kHz inclusive. For the calculation, the averaged measured level at the electrical reference point for each frequency band is referred to the averaged test signal level measured in each frequency band. The sensitivity is expressed in terms of dBV/Pa. Optionally, the measurements may be repeated with 2 N and 13 N application force. For these test cases, no normative values apply.

q_46370.question: In what situations will the Failure-List be present in the STATUS-MESSAGE-QUERY Response/Confirm primitive?
q_46370.ground_truth: The Failure-List will be present in the STATUS-MESSAGE-QUERY Response/Confirm primitive when the requested operation failed for all cells indicated in the related STATUS-MESSAGE-QUERY Request, or when the cells CBCH is not available.

q_46371.question: How can PDN GW handle Overload Control feature during certain APNs' status?
q_46371.ground_truth: The PDN GW may detect overload for certain APNs and signal appropriate control information about the APN status. This helps convey the Overload Control Information at APN level, reflecting the operating status of the resources at the APN level, in addition to the mechanism described in clause~4.3.7.5.

q_46372.question: What can be used to help a UE detect the presence of an attacker when two cells use the same PCI?
q_46372.ground_truth: A forged PCI can allow a UE to detect the presence of an attacker when two cells use the same PCI.

q_46373.question: What procedure is used to establish the radio and S1 bearers when user data or signalling is to be sent if the network has downlink signalling pending or if the UE has uplink signalling pending?
q_46373.ground_truth: The service request procedure is used for these scenarios to transfer the EMM mode from EMM-IDLE to EMM-CONNECTED mode. This procedure can also be used for UE initiated transfer of user data via the control plane if the UE is using EPS services with control plane CIoT EPS optimization.

q_46374.question: What should the TWAN include in the Proxy Binding Update message when it selects S2a protocol variant, PMIPv6?
q_46374.ground_truth: The TWAN includes the current TWAN Identifier, UE Time Zone, and IMEI(SV) in Proxy Binding Update when it selects S2a protocol variant, PMIPv6.

q_46375.question: In what situation is only one IWF emergency group call request / IWF in-progress emergency group state cancel request message sent to the IWF at the commencement / release of an emergency group call?
q_46375.ground_truth: Where the group is defined in the MCPTT system and where the IWF has affiliated to an MCPTT group with a single affiliation on behalf of all LMR group members.

q_46376.question: What information does the NWDAF collect from the OAM to derive the Network Status Indication (NSI)?
q_46376.ground_truth: The NWDAF collects measurements from the OAM, but how it derives the NSI from those measurements is not specified.

q_46377.question: What is the difference between a UE-specific search space and a common search space for PDCCH in the context of 3GPP 38.213?
q_46377.ground_truth: A UE-specific search space is a set of resources that are reserved for a specific user equipment (UE), while a common search space is a set of resources that are shared by multiple UEs. The PDCCH in a UE-specific search space uses a UE-specific scrambling sequence, while the PDCCH in a common search space uses a common scrambling sequence.

q_46378.question: What is the test applicability for the Error Vector Magnitude (EVM) requirement for 2UL carrier aggregation?
q_46378.ground_truth: This test case applies to all types of NR UE release 15 and forward that supports FR2 2UL CA.

q_46379.question: What type of information element is the Maximum bit rate for downlink (extended) with a length of 1 octet?
q_46379.ground_truth: It is a type 4 information element with a length of 1 octet.

q_46380.question: After AMF receives the PIN Service Query request, what will it do with the PIN ID?
q_46380.ground_truth: AMF sends the PIN Service Query request to UDM, with the provided PIN ID.

q_46381.question: Who assigns the Layer-2 ID of the DCR message in UE-to-UE communication?
q_46381.ground_truth: The Layer-2 ID of the DCR message is self-assigned by the Source UE in UE-to-UE communication.

q_46382.question: What requirement is specified for E-UTRA MBSFN measurement logging for E-UTRA?
q_46382.ground_truth: UE shall perform MBSFN measurements and MBSFN measurement logging in both IDLE and CONNECTED modes when receiving MBMS service of the MBSFN area(s) targeted for logging.

q_46383.question: What is the pre-condition for MCPTT client 1 to send an MCPTT private call request towards MCPTT server 1?
q_46383.ground_truth: MCPTT client 1 should be authorized to make private calls to MCPTT client 2 and MCPTT client 1 should have the necessary security information to initiate a private call with MCPTT client 2 and MCPTT client 3 if end-to-end encryption is required for the private call.

q_46384.question: What information is included in the C2 authorization payload?
q_46384.ground_truth: The C2 authorization payload includes C2 session security information and possibly other non-security specific information, such as C2 authorization result.

q_46385.question: What should the AMF do when the SMF indicates that a PDU Session has been released?
q_46385.ground_truth: The AMF should remove the stored information of the SMF and apply the behavior described for "the other CP NFs" in clause~5.21.

q_46386.question: What is the maximum number of active EPS bearers per APN that the MME can use as a criterion for APN-based congestion control?
q_46386.ground_truth: The MME can use the maximum number of active EPS bearers per APN as a criterion for APN-based congestion control.

q_46387.question: What should the UE do when it is operating in single-registration mode and receives an initial registration procedure rejected with the 5GMM cause with the same value from a non-satellite E-UTRA cell?
q_46387.ground_truth: The UE should handle the 5GMM parameters 5GMM state, 5GS update status and registration attempt counter as specified in 3GPP TS 24.501 for the case when the initial registration procedure performed over 3GPP access is rejected with the 5GMM cause with the same value.

q_46388.question: What action does the floor participant take when the Floor Granted message is received while in the "O: queued" state?
q_46388.ground_truth: The floor participant should send again the Floor Granted message toward the other floor participants and restart timer T205 (Floor Granted).

q_46389.question: What is the purpose of paging policy differentiation in 5GS?
q_46389.ground_truth: Paging policy differentiation allows the AMF to apply different paging strategies for different traffic or service types within the same PDU session.

q_46390.question: What must a node that supports partial failure handling feature do if it receives a peer node's FQ-CSID during specified procedures?
q_46390.ground_truth: A node that supports partial failure handling feature must store the peer node's FQ-CSID and send appropriate partial failure handling messages to the peer if it receives a peer node's FQ-CSID during the procedures specified in Rule 1.

q_46391.question: What is the difference between the second and third version digit increments in the 3GPP document versioning system?
q_46391.ground_truth: The second digit is incremented for changes of substance, while the third digit is incremented for editorial only changes.

q_46392.question: What happens to the Local Emergency Numbers List when the SIM/USIM is removed or the mobile equipment is switched off?
q_46392.ground_truth: The Local Emergency Numbers List is deleted in both cases.

q_46393.question: What should the ePDG do if it has not received any cryptographically protected IKEv2 or IPSec message for the duration of the timeout period for liveness check?
q_46393.ground_truth: The ePDG should send an INFORMATIONAL request with no payloads and deem the IKEv2 security association dead if no INFORMATIONAL response is received.

q_46394.question: What is one of the quality-of-experience factors in XR applications for providing immersive and present experiences?
q_46394.ground_truth: Immersion is an objective description of aspects of the system, such as field of view and display resolution, while presence is the feeling of being physically and spatially located in an environment.

q_46395.question: What shall the UE do when contention resolution is successful?

q_46396.question: What message does the SCEF send to the HSS to request notification when the UE becomes available after a DDN failure?
q_46396.ground_truth: The SCEF sends a Monitoring Request message to the HSS.

q_46397.question: What is the behavior of the physical layer in the UE when a NACK is decoded on the PHICH for a downlink subframe?
q_46397.ground_truth: When a NACK is decoded on the PHICH for a downlink subframe, the physical layer in the UE shall deliver a NACK to the higher layers.

q_46398.question: What does the MCPTT server do after checking if the number of maximum simultaneous authorizations supported for the MCPTT user has been reached?
q_46398.ground_truth: If the MCPTT server finds that the maximum simultaneous authorizations supported for the MCPTT user has been reached, it shall not continue with the rest of the steps in this clause and send a SIP 486 (Busy Here) response towards the MCPTT client with the warning text set to: "164 maximum number of service authorizations reached" in a Warning header field as specified in clause 4.4.

q_46399.question: What action should be taken upon receiving a Floor Revoke message from the controlling MCPTT function?
q_46399.ground_truth: The Floor Revoke message should be forwarded to the floor participant interface identified by the provided <Participant Reference> value, with the Track Info field removed if it contains more than one <Participant Reference> value.

q_46400.question: Which alternative is suggested to provide Human Readable Localized Services Information to a UE for display to the user when the UE does not know which localized services are available in a particular area?
q_46400.ground_truth: The suggested alternative is to define a new list of hosting network that used for accessing to the target hosting network for the localized service when needed and include the Human Readable Localized Services Information in On-Demand SIB.

q_46401.question: What system provides resiliency support for the GNSS timing service in a smart grid system?
q_46401.ground_truth: The 5G system provides resiliency support for the GNSS timing service in a smart grid system.

q_46402.question: What parameter is used by the SGSN to indicate to the HLR that the UE does not support neither UE Based nor UE Assisted positioning methods for Packet Switched Location Services?
q_46402.ground_truth: PS LCS Not Supported by UE

q_46403.question: What state exists on the mobile station side when the mobile station has requested the network to clear the end-to-end connection and is waiting for a response?
q_46403.ground_truth: The state that exists on the mobile station side when the mobile station has requested the network to clear the end-to-end connection and is waiting for a response is "disconnect request" (U11).

q_46404.question: What should the UE do when the eCall inactivity procedure is triggered due to T3445 expiration in 5GMM-IDLE mode or 5GMM-CONNECTED mode with RRC inactive indication?
q_46404.ground_truth: The UE should stop other running timers, perform a de-registration procedure if it is registered to the network for 5GS services, delete any 5G-GUTI, TAI list, last visited registered TAI, list of equivalent PLMNs, and ngKSI, and enter the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.eCALL-INACTIVE state.

q_46405.question: What is the role of the Area Session ID in the location dependent MBS service?
q_46405.ground_truth: The Area Session ID is used, in combination with MBS Session ID, to uniquely identify the service area specific part of the content data of the MBS service within 5GS.

q_46406.question: In which scenario is there a significant increase in the outage rate only with a DRX cycle of 160 ms?

q_46407.question: What is the difference between the PCRF and PCEF functional elements in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_46407.ground_truth: The PCRF (Policy Control and Charging Rules Function) in the 3GPP technical specification encompasses policy control decision and flow-based charging control functionalities, while the PCEF (Policy and Charging Enforcement Function) enforces the policy and charging control decisions.

q_46408.question: What is the role of a SL Reference UE in sidelink positioning?
q_46408.ground_truth: A SL Reference UE in sidelink positioning is responsible for transmitting and/or receiving reference signals for positioning and providing positioning-related information to assist in determining the location of a target UE.

q_46409.question: How is the value of the T390 timer determined?
q_46409.ground_truth: The T390 timer is calculated by selecting a random number between 0 and 1 and multiplying it by the uac-BarringTime, and then adding 0.7 to the result.

q_46410.question: In what format is the ecid value transferred from the P-GW to the P-CSCF via the Rx and Gx interfaces?
q_46410.ground_truth: The ecid value is transferred in binary format from the P-GW to the P-CSCF via the Rx and Gx interfaces.

q_46411.question: Which business roles are covered in Use Case #1b for 5G connection and mobility?
q_46411.ground_truth: Use Case #1b covers the business roles of the visited MNO and home MNO in relation to 5G connection and mobility.

q_46412.question: What action does the MME take when sending a Modify Bearer Request message to the Serving GW for accepted EPS bearers?
q_46412.ground_truth: The MME includes the eNodeB address, S1 TEID(s) for downlink, Delay Downlink Packet Notification Request, and RAT Type in the Modify Bearer Request message.

q_46413.question: Under what circumstances are special co-existence requirements not covered by 3GPP specifications?
q_46413.ground_truth: Special co-existence requirements may not be covered by 3GPP specifications when two operating bands overlap in the same geographical area.

q_46414.question: What is the purpose of extending predefined 5QIs for MCData service capabilities in the 5G system?
q_46414.ground_truth: The purpose is to provide more flexibility in the use of QoS classes for MCData service capabilities. This includes extending the range of QoS classes on the more stringent bound applicable using guaranteed bit rate assurance with 5QI 82, 83, and 84, as well as adding 5QI 10 for relaxed delay requirements.

q_46415.question: What is the purpose of the NSAC admission mode in the VPLMN for inbound roamers?
q_46415.ground_truth: The NSAC admission mode is included by the NF consumer to indicate the applicable NSAC admission mode in the VPLMN for inbound roamers. It can have two values - VPLMN NSAC admission mode, or VPLMN with HPLMN assistance NSAC admission mode.

q_46416.question: What must the MCData client include in a SIP INVITE request to establish a one-to-one SDS session?
q_46416.ground_truth: When requesting a one-to-one SDS session, the MCData client must include the g.3gpp.mcdata.sds media feature tag and the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag with the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcdata.sds" in the Contact header field of the SIP INVITE request. The client must also include an Accept-Contact header field with the g.3gpp.mcdata.sds media feature tag and set the "require" and "explicit" header field parameters, and include the ICSI value "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcdata.sds" in a P-Preferred-Service header field.

q_46417.question: What does the UE do when T1 expires in the test?
q_46417.ground_truth: The UE switches the power setting from T1 to T2

q_46418.question: What is the purpose of the subcounter per S-NSSAI in the 5G system?
q_46418.ground_truth: The subcounter per S-NSSAI is used to keep track of the number of successful emergency registrations and other relevant measurements, such as the number of PDU sessions, QoS flows, and inter-AMF handovers, in the 5G system.

q_46419.question: What message is sent by the UE to the network to initiate a combined tracking area updating procedure?
q_46419.ground_truth: The UE sends the message TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST to the network.

q_46420.question: What additional information does the SMF provide in the POST response in the Create service operation when a MA-PDU session is established for a UE registered over both 3GPP access and Non-3GPP access?
q_46420.ground_truth: The SMF provides the additionalCnTunnelInfo IE with additional UL N9 tunnel CN information of the UPF controlled by the H-SMF or SMF in the POST response in the Create service operation when a MA-PDU session is established for a UE registered over both 3GPP access and Non-3GPP access.

q_46421.question: What should the UE include in the measResultNeighCells field when storing connection establishment failure information?
q_46421.ground_truth: For each neighbor cell included, the UE should include the optional fields that are available. This is specified in clause 5.3.3.6 of the 3GPP TS 36.331 standard.

q_46422.question: What is the role of the IP-Multicast proxy in handling IP-Multicast traffic for the non-EPC based domain case?
q_46422.ground_truth: The IP-Multicast proxy performs tasks such as maintaining a list of mobiles that have joined Multicast groups, sending multicast routing information to routers, and making copies of multicast packets for delivery as Point-to-Point packets to each mobile of the group.

q_46423.question: What response code is returned if the PCF provisioned policy control request triggers applicable actions?
q_46423.ground_truth: A "200 OK" response code is returned in this case.

q_46424.question: What information does the QoS Mapping Information IE contain?
q_46424.ground_truth: The QoS Mapping Information IE contains information about the DSCP and/or IPv6 Flow Label field of IP packets sent in the corresponding GTP-U tunnel for IAB.

q_46425.question: What field in the DL TX Power Adjustment MAC CE and Desired DL TX Power Adjustment MAC CE indicates whether the octet containing multiplexing mode info is included or not?

q_46426.question: In what circumstances should the Bind to QoS Flow associated with the default QoS rule and apply PCC rule parameters indication be used?
q_46426.ground_truth: It should be used whenever the PDU (Packet Data Unit) Session related information Authorized default 5QI/ARP cannot be directly used as the QoS parameters of the QoS Flow associated with the default QoS rule, for instance with a GBR (Guaranteed Bit Rate) 5QI or when a 5QI (QoS Class Identifier) priority level needs to be changed.

q_46427.question: When does the UE delete the Prioritized list of SNPN Hosting Networks?
q_46427.ground_truth: The UE deletes this list when the Validity Information is no longer met or if the UE no longer needs the SNPN Hosting Network for Localized Services.

q_46428.question: What should the MCPTT client do upon successful completion of the procedure specified in clause~6.2.5.2, if the cached ambient listening client role is equal to "listening MCPTT user"?
q_46428.ground_truth: The MCPTT client may provide an indication to the MCPTT user that the ambient listening call has been terminated.

q_46429.question: What is the behavior of the TSN AF or TSCTSF when the port states change for the PTP ports in DS-TT(s)?
q_46429.ground_truth: Based on the change of the port states, TSN AF or TSCTSF can determine that an external Grandmaster PTP Instance is found to be used instead of the GM in 5GS, or the GM in 5GS is selected as the Grandmaster PTP Instance, and TSN AF or TSCTSF can disable or enable the (g)PTP grandmaster functionality in DS-TT(s), respectively.

q_46430.question: What is one of the pre-conditions for media share within PINs use case?
q_46430.ground_truth: The user has a smartphone (PIN Element) and at least one of smart earbuds, AR glasses, watch and TV, baby monitor speaker (PIN Elements).

q_46431.question: What should be the reporting delay for a UE supporting power class 1 in NR SA FR2 event-triggered reporting without gap in non-DRX?
q_46431.ground_truth: The reporting delay for a UE supporting power class 1 in NR SA FR2 event-triggered reporting without gap in non-DRX should be less than 2.4 seconds.

q_46432.question: What is the purpose of the "NSSAA to be performed" indicator in the Registration Accept message?
q_46432.ground_truth: The "NSSAA to be performed" indicator is provided in the Registration Accept message when all the S-NSSAIs in the Requested NSSAI are subject to Network Slice-Specific Authentication and Authorization, or when no Requested NSSAI was provided and all the default S-NSSAIs are subject to Network Slice-Specific Authentication and Authorization. This indicator indicates that the UE needs to wait for the completion of the Network Slice-Specific Authentication and Authorization before attempting to use any service provided by the PLMN.

q_46433.question: Which clause in TS 36.331 is referenced to ensure that the UE considers the entering condition for Event W3 is satisfied?
q_46433.ground_truth: Clause 5.5.4.13 in TS 36.331 is referenced to ensure that the UE considers the entering condition for Event W3 is satisfied when the inequality W3-1 is fulfilled.

q_46434.question: What is the UE power step tolerance value for a 1dB power step size?
q_46434.ground_truth: The UE power step tolerance is 0.7dB for a 1dB power step size.

q_46435.question: What action should the MAC entity take when a received TB on the PCH is successfully decoded?
q_46435.ground_truth: Deliver the decoded MAC PDU to upper layers.

q_46436.question: What is the purpose of the step 3 in the intermediate KPI monitoring mechanism?
q_46436.ground_truth: The purpose of step 3 in the intermediate KPI monitoring mechanism is to calculate the statistical result of KPIDiff over K test samples to represent the monitoring accuracy performance.

q_46437.question: What should be supported by an MTSI client in terminal offering real-time text conversation?
q_46437.ground_truth: An MTSI client in terminal offering real-time text conversation shall support ITU-T Recommendation T.140 and T.6429, which specifies coding and presentation features of real-time text usage.

q_46438.question: What is the value of the padding bytes if the "Granted Party's Identity" value needs to be padded?
q_46438.ground_truth: The padding bytes are set to zero if the "Granted Party's Identity" value needs to be padded.

q_46439.question: What message type and direction are used for a UE to indicate acceptance of a group call to other UEs?
q_46439.ground_truth: "GROUP CALL ACCEPT" and "UE to other UEs"

q_46440.question: What is the message type that should be sent to probe the liveliness of each peer URCMP entity?
q_46440.ground_truth: The URCMP Heartbeat Request message is used to probe the liveliness of each peer URCMP entity.

q_46441.question: What enhancements occur in step 1 for Location Service Continuity from 5GS to EPS?
q_46441.ground_truth: In step 1, 5GC-(H)GMLC obtains the LDR reference number and EPC-(H)GMLC address from EPC-(H)GMLC for the periodic or triggered location session. Additionally, if the deferred LCS service request contains multiple location QoS, location QoS mapping is performed by 5GC-(H)GMLC to ensure compatibility with EPS.

q_46442.question: What is the significance of the three digits in the version number of a 3GPP document?
q_46442.ground_truth: The first digit indicates the stage of the document's development, the second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, and the third digit is incremented when only editorial changes have been made.

q_46443.question: What should a UE with a running Service Gap timer in the UE not set in the Registration Request message?
q_46443.ground_truth: For a UE with a running Service Gap timer in the UE, it shall not set Follow-on Request indication or Uplink data status in the Registration Request message, except for network access for regulatory prioritized services like Emergency services or exception reporting.

q_46444.question: What should the NEF do when it receives event report(s) from the NSACF(s)?
q_46444.ground_truth: It shall notify the AF via an HTTP POST message with the MonitoringEventReport data type of the MonitoringNotification data type, including the monitoringType, afServiceId, and nSStatusInfo attributes.

q_46445.question: What should the 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-UE Relay include in the Link Modification Request message over the second hop PC5 reference point when adding a new end-to-end QoS flow or modifying an existing one?
q_46445.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-UE Relay should include QoS Info of the second hop QoS to the target 5G ProSe End UE in the Link Modification Request message over the second hop PC5 reference point.

q_46446.question: What action must the UE take, if it deactivated EPS bearer context(s) locally while in the EMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE state and then returns to the EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE state?
q_46446.ground_truth: The UE must send a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message to the MME without peer-to-peer signalling.

q_46447.question: How does the P-CSCF handle duplicate resource sharing rules in the "Resource-Share" header field?
q_46447.ground_truth: When the P-CSCF receives a Resource-Share header field, it extracts and stores the extracted resource sharing rule along with the value of the received "timestamp" header field. If a resource sharing rule is already stored with a lower timestamp value than the value of the received "timestamp" header field, it replaces the stored resource sharing rule with the extracted resource sharing rule along with the value of the received "timestamp" header field. If a resource sharing rule is stored with a higher timestamp value than the value of the received "timestamp" header field, it discards the extracted resource sharing rule.

q_46448.question: When is the T3212 timer started in the mobile station?
q_46448.ground_truth: The T3212 timer is started when the mobile station enters the MM IDLE substate NORMAL SERVICE or ATTEMPTing TO UPDATE.

q_46449.question: What should the Mobile Station (MS) do when it receives the SM cause value #66 "requested APN not supported in current RAT and PLMN combination" and the Back-off timer value IE is not included, but the Re-attempt indicator IE is included and indicates that re-attempt in an equivalent PLMN is not allowed?
q_46449.ground_truth: The MS shall not send an ACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message for the same APN in any PLMN in the list of equivalent PLMNs in A/Gb or Iu mode until the MS is switched off or the SIM/USIM is removed.

q_46450.question: What shall the S-CSCF not add to the list of URIs in the P-Associated-URI header field?
q_46450.ground_truth: The S-CSCF shall not add a barred public user identity to the list of URIs in the P-Associated-URI header field.

q_46451.question: Which enumerated value of "recommendedBitRate" in MAC-Parameters indicates a supported value?

q_46452.question: What should the MME do if the timer~Ts10 expires after sending the SGsAP-IMSI-DETACH-INDICATION message in the implicit IMSI detach procedure?
q_46452.ground_truth: The MME shall repeat the SGsAP-IMSI-DETACH-INDICATION message a maximum of Ns10 times.

q_46453.question: What action does the UE take when it has transmitted an ULInformationTransfer message containing an EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message with Service Type IE set to "mobile terminating CS fallback or 1xCS fallback", handovered to a GERAN cell, and initiated a RA Update procedure?
q_46453.ground_truth: The UE sets up MT CS call on GSM cell.

q_46454.question: What are the base station classes defined for AAS BS without connectors?
q_46454.ground_truth: The base station classes defined for AAS BS without connectors are Wide Area Base Stations, Medium Range Base Stations, and Local Area Base Stations. For AAS BS without connectors, the same deployment scenarios and definitions of base station classes apply as for AAS BS with connectors.

q_46455.question: When can the HPLMN anchor the media in the home network, ensuring that the signalling and media are routed together, in a scenario where the HPLMN operator does not use loopback to the Transit and Roaming Function in VPLMN?
q_46455.ground_truth: If the HPLMN operator does not use loopback to the Transit and Roaming Function in VPLMN, the HPLMN can anchor the media in the home network, ensuring that the signalling and media are routed together.

q_46456.question: What kind of UEs does the test applicability in 6.3.3.1.3.2 apply to?
q_46456.ground_truth: The test applies to all types of NR UE release 15 and forward and all types of EUTRA UE release 15 and forward supporting EN-DC.

q_46457.question: What is the role of fault supervision data report service for NF in 5G networks?
q_46457.ground_truth: Fault supervision data report service for NF is responsible for reporting fault supervision data service for NF in 5G networks.

q_46458.question: What is the CN-initiated selective deactivation of UP connection for an established PDU Session associated with Trusted WLAN access for a N5CW device in CM-CONNECTED state referred to in clause~4.13.2.2?
q_46458.ground_truth: The procedure described in clause~4.3.7, with the NG-RAN corresponding to a TNAN including a TWIF and the user plane between the N5CW device and TWIF being released without RRC signalling or IKEv2 signalling.

q_46459.question: How many frequencies can be included in the MBMS frequencies of interest for a given physical frequency?
q_46459.ground_truth: The MBMS frequencies of interest can include at most one frequency for a given physical frequency. The UE only considers a physical frequency to be part of the MBMS frequencies of interest if it supports at least one of the bands indicated for this physical frequency in SystemInformationBlockType1 or SystemInformationBlockType15.

q_46460.question: What should the UE do for L1-SINR measurement with CSI-RS as IMR, if the UE does not support simultaneousRxDataSSB-DiffNumerology for FR1 and the SSB and CSI-RS have different SCS for L1-SINR measurement?
q_46460.ground_truth: If the UE does not support simultaneousRxDataSSB-DiffNumerology for FR1 and the SSB and CSI-RS have different SCS for L1-SINR measurement, the UE is required to measure one of but not both CSI-RS for L1-SINR measurement and SSB. A longer measurement period for CSI-RS based L1-SINR measurement is expected.

q_46461.question: What HTTP methods are supported for the "PFD Management Transactions" resource?
q_46461.ground_truth: The supported HTTP methods for the "PFD Management Transactions" resource are GET, POST, and DELETE.

q_46462.question: What mapping rule is applied to the sidelink discovery channel for time-first rather than frequency-first mapping in PUSCH interleaving?
q_46462.ground_truth: Clauses 5.2.2.7 and 5.2.2.8 are applied to the sidelink discovery channel for time-first rather than frequency-first mapping in PUSCH interleaving, with no control information.

q_46463.question: What is the send speech signal composed of for the test signal in the hand-held hands-free UE measurements?
q_46463.ground_truth: The send speech signal is composed of 16 sentences of speech for the test signal in the hand-held hands-free UE measurements.

q_46464.question: What is the cell re-selection delay to an already detected cell during time period T1 and T2?
q_46464.ground_truth: The cell re-selection delay to an already detected cell shall be less than 32 seconds during both time periods T1 and T2.

q_46465.question: What should the target eNB do if it receives a Handover Request message containing multiple E-RAB ID IEs set to the same value?
q_46465.ground_truth: The target eNB shall not admit the corresponding E-RABs.

q_46466.question: In what situation does the AMF send the N2 SM Information to the UE without updating the access associated to the PDU Session?
q_46466.ground_truth: If the Service Request was triggered in response to paging or NAS notification indicating non-3GPP access and the AMF received N1 SM Container only from the SMF in step~3a of clause~4.2.3.3.

q_46467.question: In what conditions must a UE perform PLMN selection triggered by 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay discovery?
q_46467.ground_truth: If the UE is in 5GMM-IDLE mode, the UE shall perform PLMN selection triggered by 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay discovery if one or more PLMNs operate in the provisioned radio resources, none of the reported PLMNs is the registered PLMN or equivalent to the registered PLMN, at least one of the reported PLMNs provides radio resources for 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay discovery, and the UE does not have an emergency PDU session.

q_46468.question: What network entity learns part of the auxiliary information through the essential information?
q_46468.ground_truth: The network can estimate the periodicity and jitter statistics of a PDU Set Type by measuring the inter-arrival time of the PDU Set instances.

q_46469.question: Who is responsible for determining if an MCPTT user is authorized to cancel the in-progress imminent peril group state?
q_46469.ground_truth: The MCPTT server should check if the MCPTT user is authorized to cancel the in-progress imminent peril group state.

q_46470.question: What is the identifier for the information element used to indicate the User Location in a Secondary RAT Data Usage Report?

q_46471.question: What should the NF service consumer send as a response if it accepts the received POST request with the "NotificationPush" feature supported and the "pfdOp" attribute set to "RETRIEVE"?
q_46471.ground_truth: The NF service consumer shall send an HTTP "204 No Content" response.

q_46472.question: What is the initial state of a Multicast MBS session before it is created?
q_46472.ground_truth: The initial state of a Multicast MBS session before it is created is "Start (NULL)".

q_46473.question: What response message will the BM-SC send if the Content Provider requests a report for a session that does not exist?
q_46473.ground_truth: The BM-SC will send a 404 message to the Content Provider.

q_46474.question: What is the formula used to compute the RA-RNTI for NB-IoT UEs operating in TDD mode?

q_46475.question: What is the maximum allowed difference between the reported and actual RSRQ value for the measurement to be considered successful?
q_46475.ground_truth: The reporting range of RSRQ is defined from -19.5 dB to -3 with 0.5 dB resolution.

q_46476.question: How is the value of the 5-bit BEARER parameter derived for each SRB in the 5G system?
q_46476.ground_truth: The value of the 5-bit BEARER parameter is derived from the corresponding srb-Identity with the MSBs padded with zeroes.

q_46477.question: In what scenario will the UE store the redirectedCarrierOffsetDedicated and start timer T322 in NB-IoT?
q_46477.ground_truth: When the RRCConnectionRelease message in NB-IoT includes the redirectedCarrierInfo and the redirectedCarrierOffsetDedicated is included in the redirectedCarrierInfo.

q_46478.question: In what situations will the UE abort the registration procedure?
q_46478.ground_truth: The UE shall abort the registration procedure if a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message with specific 5GMM cause values is received before the registration procedure is completed, if a T3510 timeout occurs, if a timer T3346 is running when the network indicates that a cell change is necessary, if the lower layers indicate that the access attempt is barred, if the lower layers indicate that there is a transmission failure or that the RRC connection has been suspended, if a change in the current TAI is detected, if a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message is received before the registration procedure is completed, if the UE needs to start the registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update and de-registration procedure collision, or if this would result in violation of subclause 5.5.1.3.5.

q_46479.question: What should the UE do if the security mode command cannot be accepted and the security mode command indicates a "native EPS security context" in the NAS KSI IE?
q_46479.ground_truth: The UE should take the native EPS security context into use and store it.

q_46480.question: What is the purpose of the gNB-DU Status Indication procedure?
q_46480.ground_truth: The purpose of the gNB-DU Status Indication procedure is to inform the gNB-CU that the gNB-DU is overloaded so that overload reduction actions can be applied, and to inform the IAB-donor-CU about a downlink congestion at an IAB-DU or an IAB-donor-DU.

q_46481.question: How is the Paging Policy Indicator (PPI) determined in the case of UPF buffering downlink packets?
q_46481.ground_truth: When PPD applies, the SMF determines the PPI based on the DSCP received from the UPF in the Downlink Data Report sent to the SMF.

q_46482.question: What should the mobile station supporting multimedia CAT during the alerting phase do if there is a multimedia CAT available during call establishment?
q_46482.ground_truth: The mobile station should attach the user connection for multimedia as soon as an appropriate channel in multimedia mode is available and set up an H.324 call. If an error or H.324 call clearing occurs during the setup or the lifetime of the H.324 call during the alerting phase, the mobile station should not abort the call and the call control entity of the calling mobile station should remain in its current state.

q_46483.question: Which complex type contains the NCGI attribute and what is its data type?

q_46484.question: What is one of the benefits of the procedures described in clause 6.22.2?
q_46484.ground_truth: One benefit of the procedures described in clause 6.22.2 is that both UE using NR satellite access and E-UTRAN satellite access can receive the coverage data in a consistent way.

q_46485.question: In the context of case g), what will the UE do if the 5GMM cause IE is set to the 5GMM cause #28 "Restricted service area"?
q_46485.ground_truth: The UE will pass to the 5GSM sublayer an indication that the 5GSM message was not forwarded due to service area restrictions, enter the state 5GMM-REGISTERED.NON-ALLOWED-SERVICE if the DL NAS TRANSPORT message is received over 3GPP access, and perform the registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update without waiting for the release of the N1 NAS signalling connection.

q_46486.question: What should a participating MCData function do after sending a SIP MESSAGE request and receiving a SIP 202 (Accepted) response?
q_46486.ground_truth: It shall generate a SIP 202 (Accepted) response as specified and send it to the MCData client.

q_46487.question: What information does the Server NWDAF aggregate during Federated Learning training procedure?
q_46487.ground_truth: The Server NWDAF aggregates all the local training results for Abnormal Classifier, including the volume of the local dataset and parameters for update of the Abnormal Classifier.

q_46488.question: What does the "reporting" parameter in the EPSFB status report indicate?
q_46488.ground_truth: The "reporting" parameter in the EPSFB status report indicates whether the reporting of EPSFB status is enabled or disabled.

q_46489.question: What does d'y represent in the Available MIMO Layers Coverage Map measurements?
q_46489.ground_truth: d'y represents the sub-cell radius within the observed cell up to where a UE with the given number of MIMO layers in DL (for 5.1.1.30.7) or UL (for 5.1.1.30.8) per PRB can be localized.

q_46490.question: What does the lifecycle management of the edge components include in the present document?
q_46490.ground_truth: The lifecycle management of the edge components is enabled by the 3GPP Management System, and includes instantiation, termination, modification, and query of the edge components.

q_46491.question: What is the definition of a "5G LAN-type Service" in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
q_46491.ground_truth: A "5G LAN-type Service" is a service over the 5G system that offers private communication using IP and/or non-IP type communications.

q_46492.question: What is the role of the RAI/RNC-ID FQDN when selecting the GGSN for S1-flex tenants in a 3GPP network?
q_46492.ground_truth: The RAI/RNC-ID FQDN is used in addition to the APN FQDN when selecting the GGSN for S1-flex tenants in a 3GPP network.

q_46493.question: What is the periodicity for SystemInformationBlockType1-MBMS in normal subframes?
q_46493.ground_truth: The SystemInformationBlockType1-MBMS uses a fixed schedule with a periodicity of 160 ms in normal subframes.

q_46494.question: What is the maximum bandwidth for measurement of spurious emissions at the edge of each frequency range?
q_46494.ground_truth: The lowest frequency of the measurement position in each frequency range should be set at the lowest boundary of the frequency range plus MBW/2 and the highest frequency of the measurement position in each frequency range should be set at the highest boundary of the frequency range minus MBW/2, where MBW denotes the measurement bandwidth defined for the protected band.

q_46495.question: What is the purpose of the GMOP document in XDM?
q_46495.ground_truth: The GMOP document in XDM enables performing a group management operation which cannot be expressed by HTTP GET, HTTP PUT or HTTP DELETE methods. It has a MIME type of application/vnd.3gpp.GMOP+xml.

q_46496.question: What method is used to generate the MSK (Master Session Key) in step 9, based on the UE's IMEI?
q_46496.ground_truth: The MSK is generated based on UE's IMEI value per clause A.4 in Annex A of the specification.

q_46497.question: What is the requirement for NCR-Fwd and NCR-MT in the uplink for minimum requirement NCR-Fwd type 1-C and type 1-H?
q_46497.ground_truth: The operating band unwanted emissions limits shall apply to the total emissions from both the NCR-Fwd and NCR-MT for joint transmission in the uplink for minimum requirement NCR-Fwd type 1-C and type 1-H.

q_46498.question: Which TS (Technical Specification) document specifies the use and requirements for the presence of the "SS-List" and "Basic Service Code" parameters when the CAMEL service is not involved?
q_46498.ground_truth: 3GPP TS 23.078 specifies the use and requirements for the presence of the "SS-List" and "Basic Service Code" parameters when the CAMEL service is not involved.

q_46499.question: Under what conditions should the controlling MCVideo function include the warning text set to "122 too many participants" in the SIP 200 (OK) response?
q_46499.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function should include the warning text set to "122 too many participants" in the SIP 200 (OK) response if all members were not invited because the prearranged MCVideo group has exceeded the on-network-max-participant-count members.

q_46500.question: How is multiview video coding MVC signalled in a 3GP file?
q_46500.ground_truth: Multiview Video Coding MVC is stored and signalled in a 3GP file as defined in the MVC file format, and at least one track should use the sample entry type 'avc1' to ensure compatibility with H.264 (AVC) file readers.

q_46501.question: What is the purpose of the "catch all" entry with the lowest priority in policy/parameter mappings in 5G ProSe Direct Communication?
q_46501.ground_truth: This entry is used for ProSe services that do not have explicit policy/parameters mapping above.

q_46502.question: What is the required rate of searching and measuring inter-RAT layers of higher and lower priority if Srxlev <= SnonIntraSearchP or Squal <= SnonIntraSearchQ?
q_46502.ground_truth: The minimum rate at which the UE is required to search for and measure inter-RAT layers of higher and lower priority is the same as that defined for lower priority RATs.

q_46503.question: What information does the Message Length field in a PFCP header indicate?
q_46503.ground_truth: The Message Length field in a PFCP header indicates the length of the message in octets excluding the mandatory part of the header.

q_46504.question: What actions must the mobile station take if an appropriate channel for call establishment is not available for 30 seconds?
q_46504.ground_truth: The mobile station may initiate call clearing.

q_46505.question: What is the role of the CAPIF Function in relation to the "authorization before allowing access to resources" solution?
q_46505.ground_truth: The CAPIF Function plays a crucial role in establishing a secure application session with the application key derived from the CAPIF Key related to the Resource Owner.

q_46506.question: What should a BL/CE UE do when there is a collision between a PUSCH transmission with a corresponding MPDCCH and a PUSCH transmission without a corresponding MPDCCH in the same subframe?
q_46506.ground_truth: The PUSCH transmission without a corresponding MPDCCH is dropped from that subframe.

q_46507.question: What operation allows modifying one or more attributes of one or more managed objects on a MnS producer?

q_46508.question: What should the MCVideo client do upon receiving a request from an MCVideo user to leave an MCVideo adhoc group session that was established using a pre-established session?
q_46508.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should follow the procedures specified in clause~6.2.4.2.

q_46509.question: What is the objective of load balancing in the context of 5G networks?
q_46509.ground_truth: The objective of load balancing in 5G networks is to distribute load evenly among cells and areas of cells, transfer part of the traffic from congested cells or areas to improve network performance, and optimize handover parameters and actions to enhance user experience and system capacity.

q_46510.question: What is the function of the "fe-identifier" header field parameter in the IM CN subsystem?
q_46510.ground_truth: The "fe-identifier" header field parameter is used to inform the billing domain which IM CN subsystem functional entities have created charging information. It is added to the P-Charging-Vector header field when generating charging information, and contains information about the specific IM CN subsystem functional entities and associated ASs involved in the charging events.

q_46511.question: What function is used to provide end-to-end QoS for the 5G relay architecture?
q_46511.ground_truth: The 5G network adjusts the delay within the 5G network to compensate for the delays incurred in non-5G networks such as Wi-Fi, the Internet, to provide end-to-end QoS for the 5G relay architecture.

q_46512.question: Which RepetitionFactorExtended value in the SchedulingRequest in 3GPP TS38.300 v16.1.0 (2018-july) indicates 16 times repetition of Counting/Listening/Triggering?

q_46513.question: What are the values for maximum number of No. of RLC duplication state for RLCDuplicationInformation in 3GPP TS38.300 v16.1.0 (2018-july) in 3GPP TS38.300 v16.1.0 (2018-july)?

q_46514.question: What is the scenario described in Scenario #4, where a virtual operator leases a network slice from the MNO to provide service to its customers?
q_46514.ground_truth: Network slicing scenario for a virtual operator

q_46515.question: What procedure is used to retrieve UE location for 5G-MO-LR and other purposes?
q_46515.ground_truth: The procedure "Retrieve UE Location for 5G-MO-LR" is used to retrieve UE location for 5G-MO-LR, ranging, and sidelink positioning.

q_46516.question: How does the UE determine the cooperated LCUP instance when UE IP in ECS exists in the serving UE IP list?
q_46516.ground_truth: When UE IP in ECS exists in the serving UE IP list, the LMF would reply with its cooperated LCUP IP. In this way, the UE can use the LCUP assistance delivered from the serving LMF to establish the User Plane session with the cooperated LCUP instance.

q_46517.question: What is the purpose of the Buffer Status reporting (BSR) procedure in 5G NR?
q_46517.ground_truth: The Buffer Status reporting (BSR) procedure is used to provide the serving gNB with information about UL data volume in the MAC entity. It includes several parameters like periodicBSR-Timer, retxBSR-Timer, logicalChannelSR-DelayTimer, etc which controls the BSR.

q_46518.question: What type of information element is the Confirm mode indication information element?
q_46518.ground_truth: The Confirm mode indication information element is a type 2 information element.

q_46519.question: What is the role of the TWAG in the establishment of an S2a bearer in a multiple point-to-point connection UE-TWAN setup?
q_46519.ground_truth: The TWAG establishes dedicated S2a bearers on S2a for the same PDN connection based on PCC decisions. It also maintains a 1 to 1 mapping between an S2a bearer and a WLCP bearer.

q_46520.question: What is one of the conditions that lead to ATCF acting as a proxy when handling a session to be transferred?
q_46520.ground_truth: If ATCF does not support CS to PS SRVCC and one of the following conditions are true: the ATGW does not anchor the media of the session being transferred, or if the speech media component of the SDP offer in the SIP INVITE request is not the same as the speech media component of the SDP negotiated by the ATCF in the session being transferred and the ATGW cannot provide media transcoding between the speech media component in the received SDP offer and the speech media component in the session being transferred.

q_46521.question: What is the total number of coded bits for all the encoded HARQ-ACK blocks for FDD or TDD HARQ-ACK multiplexing?
q_46521.ground_truth: The total number of coded bits for all the encoded HARQ-ACK blocks is denoted by "z".

q_46522.question: What should the controlling MCData function do upon receiving a request for upgrade to emergency of a one-to-one communication using SDS session?
q_46522.ground_truth: The controlling MCData function should execute the procedure in clause~6.3.7.1.21.

q_46523.question: Which type of X2AP IoT element does the ID-Ethernet-Type represent in the context of the E-RABs-To-Be-SetupRetrieve-Item X2AP-PROTOCOL-IES?
q_46523.ground_truth: The ID-Ethernet-Type element represents the Ethernet-Type in the context of the E-RABs-To-Be-SetupRetrieve-Item X2AP-PROTOCOL-IES.

q_46524.question: How does the Mobile Base Station Relay (MBSR) broadcast the service time information in its vicinity?
q_46524.ground_truth: The MBSR broadcasts the service time information in its vicinity by including it in System Information Blocks (SIBs) when commanded to broadcast SIBs.

q_46525.question: What is the required minimum conformance level for the rate of correct SyncRef UE (re)selection in repeated tests in NR sidelink communication?
q_46525.ground_truth: The required minimum conformance level for the rate of correct SyncRef UE (re)selection in repeated tests is at least 90%.

q_46526.question: What action will the UE take if two or more packet filters with identical packet filter identifiers are not contained in the new request and the old packet filters have the identical packet filter identifiers?
q_46526.ground_truth: If two or more packet filters with identical packet filter identifiers are not contained in the new request, the UE will not diagnose an error, further process the new request and, if successful, delete the old packet filters with the identical packet filter identifiers.

q_46527.question: What is the criticality of the "id-HandoverType" in the HandoverCommand?
q_46527.ground_truth: The criticality of the "id-HandoverType" in the HandoverCommand is "reject".

q_46528.question: What message is used to request the NG-RAN node to transfer OTDOA information to the LMF?
q_46528.ground_truth: The OTDOA INFORMATION REQUEST message is used to request the NG-RAN node to transfer OTDOA information to the LMF.

q_46529.question: What must a UE do if it detects a cdma2000 1X cell that has met cell reselection criterion and Treselection timer has a non-zero value?
q_46529.ground_truth: Evaluate this CDMA2000 1X cell for the Treselection time and reselect that cell if the reselection criteria are met within this duration.

q_46530.question: In 5G Media Streaming, what does the H.264 (AVC) media decoding capability AVC-HD-Dec stand for?
q_46530.ground_truth: AVC-HD-Dec is the capability to decode H.264 (AVC) Progressive High Profile Level 3.1 bitstreams, with a maximum VCL Bit Rate of 14 Mbps and specific cpbBrVclFactor and cpbBrNalFactor values.

q_46531.question: What does the "followingARFCNs" field represent in the "CarrierFreqsGERAN" information element?
q_46531.ground_truth: The "followingARFCNs" field represents a list of GERAN BCCH carrier frequencies, which can be represented as an explicit list, equally spaced ARFCNs, or a variable bit map of ARFCNs.

q_46532.question: What should the P-CSCF do when receiving an INVITE dialog request, regarding the Contact and CSeq header field values?
q_46532.ground_truth: The P-CSCF should replace the saved Contact and CSeq header field values, and save the GRUU received in the Contact header field of the request.

q_46533.question: What does the "3GPP" in the document's title stand for?
q_46533.ground_truth: The "3GPP" in the document's title stands for the "Third Generation Partnership Project", which is a collaboration between telecommunications standards organizations to develop specifications for mobile networks.

q_46534.question: What should be added in the fulfillmentInfo or intent report when a Self-Organizing Network (SON) orchestration fails or succeeds for intent fulfillment?
q_46534.ground_truth: An attribute may be added in the fulfillmentInfo or intent report for the failure or success of SON orchestration.

q_46535.question: What data type is used for the "TriggerId" attribute in the "tNcgi" type?
q_46535.ground_truth: The data type used for the "TriggerId" attribute in the "tNcgi" type is xs:string.

q_46536.question: Which UE peak rate reduction options do not cause a coverage loss?
q_46536.ground_truth: PR1 and PR2 UE peak rate reduction options are not expected to cause coverage loss.

q_46537.question: What is the minimum length of the Service area list information element?
q_46537.ground_truth: The Service area list information element has a minimum length of 6 octets.

q_46538.question: What action does the UE take when T5 expires during the test procedure?
q_46538.ground_truth: The UE transmits a RRCConnectionRelease message to release the RRC connection, including the release of established radio bearers and all radio resources.

q_46539.question: What type of information is being reported when using the "failureReport" operation?
q_46539.ground_truth: The "failureReport" operation is used to report various types of failures, such as system failures, data missing, and unexpected data values.

q_46540.question: What is the definition of a "discovery burst" in the present document?
q_46540.ground_truth: A discovery burst refers to a DL transmission burst including a set of signal(s) and/or channel(s) confined within a window and associated with a duty cycle.

q_46541.question: What is the impact of passing the tests in accordance with the described test procedure?
q_46541.ground_truth: Successfully passing the test indicates that the UE meets the requirements outlined in the test specification, namely the E-UTRA radio link monitoring requirements in 3GPP TS 36.133. It ensures the proper detection of out-of-sync and in-sync states for monitoring downlink radio link quality in various scenarios, which in turn guarantees efficient communication and effective utilization of network resources.

q_46542.question: What is the process for storing the MUK in the USIM during an MBMS security context update?
q_46542.ground_truth: When updating the EF_MUK during an MBMS security context update, the USIM stores the last bootstrapped Ks_int_NAF as the last generated MUK. If a record with the received IDi is present, the MUK ID is stored in the corresponding field and the associated Time Stamp Counter (TS) field is reset. If the record does not exist, the USIM uses an empty record to include the MUK ID and resets the associated TS field.

q_46543.question: In what scenario would the UE set the failureType as "bh-RLF" during the initiation of the MCGFailureInformation message transmission?
q_46543.ground_truth: This would occur when the UE initiates transmission of the MCGFailureInformation message due to a BH RLF indication on BAP entity from the MCG and the UE is connected as an IAB-node.

q_46544.question: Which parameter is used to indicate the relative time since cell identity information was collected by the UE?
q_46544.ground_truth: The cell-info-age parameter is used to indicate the relative time since cell identity information was collected by the UE.

q_46545.question: What is the minimum SNR for the serving cell in uplink TCI state switching?
q_46545.ground_truth: The minimum SNR for the serving cell in uplink TCI state switching is -3dB.

q_46546.question: What is the effect of including the Transport Mode in a PCC rule that is used for the detected SDF?
q_46546.ground_truth: The Transport Mode may be included in a PCC rule that is used for the detected SDF only when the Steering functionality is the MPQUIC functionality.

q_46547.question: What is the capability that can be used by MnS consumer to request intent-driven MnS producer to check the feasibility for intent fulfillment before intent creation?
q_46547.ground_truth: The intent fulfilment feasibility check capability which can be used by MnS consumer.

q_46548.question: What is the maximum number of services that can be indicated by the "AllowedServices" data type in the provided code?
q_46548.ground_truth: The "AllowedServices" data type can indicate a maximum of 8 services.

q_46549.question: What should the SM entity do when it receives the MODIFY SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message from the network in the UMTS case?
q_46549.ground_truth: The SM entity should modify the corresponding PDP context based on the information received in the message and return the MODIFY SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT ACCEPT message to the network to confirm.

q_46550.question: What should the UE include in the REMOTE UE REPORT message for the IPv4 address it allocated to a 5G ProSe remote UE if the UE enabled TCP usage to the 5G ProSe remote UE?
q_46550.ground_truth: The UE shall include in the REMOTE UE REPORT message the TCP port range assigned to the 5G ProSe remote UE in the NAT function of 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-network relay if the UE allocated an IPv4 address to a 5G ProSe remote UE and enabled TCP usage to the 5G ProSe remote UE.

q_46551.question: What triggers EAS rediscovery in the H-SMF during PDU Session modification?
q_46551.ground_truth: V-SMF triggers EAS rediscovery when there is insertion, change, or removal of V-PSA for the PDU Session.

q_46552.question: What is the impact of Squal based cell reselection parameters on cell reselection from UTRAN to E-UTRAN?
q_46552.ground_truth: If the UE supports Squal based cell reselection from E-UTRAN to UTRAN and Squal based cell reselection parameters are broadcast in system information, cell reselection to E-UTRAN shall be performed based on the Squal criteria (criterion 4 or 5). Otherwise, cell reselection to E-UTRAN shall be performed based on Srxlev criteria.

q_46553.question: What will the MME do upon receipt of the SERVICE REQUEST message in the NAS signalling connection if the MUSIM UE does not include the Paging restriction IE in the EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message?
q_46553.ground_truth: The MME shall delete any stored paging restriction for the UE and stop restricting paging.

q_46554.question: What is a condition for the network to trigger the delivery of downlink data to the UE, when using user plane MT-EDT procedures?
q_46554.ground_truth: The UE must support user plane CIoT EPS optimization and the network must have accepted the use of user plane CIoT EPS optimization.

q_46555.question: In what scenario does a UE assume that a DM-RS antenna port for PDCCH receptions in the CORESET and a DM-RS antenna port for PDSCH receptions scheduled by DCI formats provided by PDCCH receptions in the CORESET are quasi co-located with the reference signals provided by the indicated TCI-State?
q_46555.ground_truth: If the UE is provided TCI-State and followUnifiedTCI-State for the CORESET.

q_46556.question: How can an operator control access to service producer resources dynamically?
q_46556.ground_truth: An operator can control access to service producer resources dynamically by requiring NF consumers and producers to mutually authenticate during TLS session establishment via certificates, and then requiring the NF consumer to present an OAuth2.0 authorization token to the producer in the service request within the TLS tunnel.

q_46557.question: What is the effect of setting the "entry-info" attribute to "LocallyDetermined" in the <entry> element of the <MCPTTPrivateRecipient> element in the EmergencyCall element within the PrivateCall element of the MCPTT user profile document for determining an authorized MCPTT emergency private call request?
q_46557.ground_truth: The MCPTT client will consider the MCPTT emergency private call request to be an authorized request.

q_46558.question: What is the role of the PCC framework in QoS control?
q_46558.ground_truth: The PCC (Policy and Charging Control) framework in 5G systems is responsible for providing mechanisms to initiate QoS (Quality of Service) Flow establishment and modification as part of the QoS control. It can handle both guaranteed bitrate (GBR) bearers and non-guaranteed bitrate bearers.

q_46559.question: What should be treated jointly when poor network conditions prevent resource allocation to a service flow?
q_46559.ground_truth: Other service flows in the same coordination group should be treated jointly to save network resources.

q_46560.question: What is the overall delays measured test requirement in 6.6.1.4.4.4?
q_46560.ground_truth: The overall delays measured test requirement is expressed as: Overall delays measured = measurement reporting delay + TTI insertion uncertainty. The measurement reporting delay = Tidentify_intra_without_index and Tidentify_intra_without_index = TPSS/SSS_sync_intra + TSSB_measurement_period_intra.

q_46561.question: What is required from the UE before it can establish a user plane connection for positioning?
q_46561.ground_truth: The UE needs to send its 'user plane location capability' indication to the network, which can be included as part of the '5GMM Capability' in the Registration Request message or covered in the existing LPP capability transfer.

q_46562.question: What is the mean UL Average-UPT gain for semi-static SBFD at high load level with SBFD Alt 4 and small packet size?
q_46562.ground_truth: The mean UL Average-UPT gain for semi-static SBFD at high load level with SBFD Alt 4 and small packet size is 249.09%.

q_46563.question: What is required for an application in a SL Positioning Client UE to retrieve the location information of a Target UE?
q_46563.ground_truth: The SL Positioning Client UE needs to initiate discovery to discover the Target UE and issue a Service Request message over PC5 to the Target UE.

q_46564.question: When should the E-CSCF store the access-network-charging-info parameter from the P-Charging-Vector header field?
q_46564.ground_truth: The E-CSCF should store the access-network-charging-info parameter from the P-Charging-Vector header field when it receives any request or response related to a UE-originated dialog or standalone transaction.

q_46565.question: In what order does a UE apply ISMP, IARP, and ISRP when they are all available and the ANDSF rules control the WLAN access selection and traffic routing?
q_46565.ground_truth: The UE first applies the ISMP, then the IARP, and finally the ISRP.

q_46566.question: What are the two deployment options for IMS in intercepting the service type of Voice?
q_46566.ground_truth: The two deployment options for IMS in intercepting the service type of Voice are Default and Alternate option.

q_46567.question: When should the MME reject a PDN Connectivity Request from an emergency attached or RLOS attached UE?
q_46567.ground_truth: The MME should reject the request if the UE indicated Control Plane CIoT EPS Optimisation supported in Preferred Network Behaviour, supports header compression, and the PDN Connectivity Request is not allowed by the UE's mobility or access restrictions.

q_46568.question: What does the EPFAR feature stands for?
q_46568.ground_truth: Enhanced PFCP Association Release feature (EPFAR) is a feature that ensures no loss of usage reports and signalling efficiency, during a PFCP Association Release procedure. This feature is supported by both CP function and UP function and it is used to inform the peer UP (or CP) function that the PFCP Association is going to be released and the final non-zero usage reports are to be collected for these PFCP sessions which will be affected by the PFCP association release.

q_46569.question: What is the main focus of Solution #1 in addressing Key Issue #1?
q_46569.ground_truth: Solution #1 introduces a new Fused Location Server (FLS) that supports multiple sources of location information and proposes a merged architecture to facilitate interaction between FLS and SEAL LMS.

q_46570.question: What is a 5G Virtual Network (VN) group in the context of 5G LAN-type service?
q_46570.ground_truth: A 5G Virtual Network (VN) group is a set of UEs using private communication for 5G LAN-type services characterized by 5G VN group identities, 5G VN group membership, and 5G VN group data.

q_46571.question: What is the purpose of the SMF in the PDU Session establishment or modification process in 5G?
q_46571.ground_truth: The SMF (Session Management Function) plays a crucial role in the PDU Session establishment or modification process in 5G. It creates or updates the SM policy, which includes traffic routing information, based on received application traffic like DNS Query or service data for the application.

q_46572.question: When must the eNB store the CSG Membership Status IE during the Initial Context Setup procedure and when should it reject the procedure?
q_46572.ground_truth: The eNB must store the CSG Membership Status IE if the cell accessed by the UE is a hybrid cell, and it should reject the procedure if this information is not included in the INITIAL CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message.

q_46573.question: What is the maximum aggregate adjustment rate for the UE uplink timing?
q_46573.ground_truth: The maximum aggregate adjustment rate is Tq per 200ms.

q_46574.question: If the MCPTT user cancels the in-progress emergency condition and an MCPTT emergency alert originated by another MCPTT user, what should the MCPTT client include in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body?
q_46574.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body populated as specified in clause 6.2.8.1.14.

q_46575.question: In what situation should the MCData client display an indication of the cancellation of the in-progress imminent peril state of the group to the user?
q_46575.ground_truth: When the received SIP MESSAGE request contains an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body with the <imminentperil-ind><value of "false", the MCData client should display an indication of the cancellation of the in-progress imminent peril state of the group to the user, and set the MCData imminent peril group state to "MDIG 1: no-imminent-peril".

q_46576.question: What information does the "PDU Session Resources Admitted List" IE provide?
q_46576.ground_truth: This IE contains PDU session resource related information that reports the successful establishment of PDU session resources.

q_46577.question: What is the expected result for the test case to ensure that the policy regarding failed login attempts is adhered to?
q_46577.ground_truth: The expected result for this test case is that the account is locked following a specified number of incorrect attempts, and the block delay is observed before allowing the user to attempt login again.

q_46578.question: What is the purpose of the HXRES* in the 5G HE AV on the AUSF side during 5G AKA authentication?
q_46578.ground_truth: The HXRES* is calculated from XRES* and KSEAF, and replaces XRES* in the 5G HE AV to protect the EAP security features from bidding down.

q_46579.question: What is the relevance of operating bands in NR intra-band contiguous carrier aggregation and inter-band carrier aggregation?
q_46579.ground_truth: operating bands are relevant in NR intra-band contiguous carrier aggregation and inter-band carrier aggregation as they define the frequency range in which NR is designed to operate in these aggregation scenarios.

q_46580.question: What is the key issue that Solution #4 aims to address?
q_46580.ground_truth: Solution #4 aims to address Key Issue #1, which is the ability to establish direct C2 communication between a UAV and a UAV-C over PC5.

q_46581.question: What is the applicability for the spectral emission mask test for intra-band non-contiguous EN-DC?
q_46581.ground_truth: The test applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 15 and forward, supporting intra-band non-contiguous EN-DC.

q_46582.question: What is the definition of "reliability" as defined in 3GPP TR 22.874 V18.2.0?
q_46582.ground_truth: Reliability is defined as the percentage value of the amount of sent network layer packets successfully delivered to a given system entity within the time constraint required by the targeted service, divided by the total number of sent network layer packets.

q_46583.question: What is removed from the stored rejected NSSAI when a new allowed NSSAI is received for a given PLMN or SNPN?
q_46583.ground_truth: The S-NSSAI(s) included in the new allowed NSSAI are removed from the stored rejected NSSAI for the current PLMN or SNPN, the rejected NSSAI for the current registration area, the rejected NSSAI for the maximum number of UEs reached, and the partially rejected NSSAI.

q_46584.question: What is the role of the Leading Operator Platform (L-OP) and Participating Operator Platform (P-OP) in the Edge Federation?
q_46584.ground_truth: The L-OP and P-OP are both ECSP Management Systems, where the P-OP provides its EDN to be shared with the L-OP.

q_46585.question: What is the measurement provided by the "PHR Measurement" in the context of 3GPP 5G specifications?
q_46585.ground_truth: The "PHR Measurement" provides a bin distribution (histogram) of Type 1 power headroom measurements.

q_46586.question: What are the four conditions for a SIP REFER request for transferring additional call?
q_46586.ground_truth: The four conditions for a SIP REFER request for transferring additional call are: the Refer-Sub header field contains "false" value, the Supported header field contains "norefersub" value, the Refer-To header field contains a SIP URI with the Target-Dialog URI header field, and it is sent inside a SIP dialog created by the SIP INVITE request due to STN-SR.

q_46587.question: What is the message sent by the gNB-CU to gNB-DU in case the gNB-CU is not able to execute the requested functions in the Multicast Context Notification procedure?
q_46587.ground_truth: The MULTICAST CONTEXT NOTIFICATION REFUSE message is sent by the gNB-CU to gNB-DU in case the gNB-CU is not able to execute the requested functions in the Multicast Context Notification procedure.

q_46588.question: What action does the MME take when it receives a Downlink Data Notification message for which no MM context exists?
q_46588.ground_truth: The MME returns a Downlink Data Notification Acknowledge message to the Serving GW with an appropriate cause and deletes the related Bearer context.

q_46589.question: What happens to the lists of forbidden tracking areas when the UE is switched off or the UICC containing the USIM is removed?
q_46589.ground_truth: The lists of forbidden tracking areas are erased when the UE is switched off or the UICC containing the USIM is removed.

q_46590.question: Which type of E-UTRA UE does the test applicability described in 5.3.2.2.3.2 apply to?
q_46590.ground_truth: The test applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 16 and forward, supporting EN-DC with FR2 and twoStepRACH-r16.

q_46591.question: What is the purpose of the "UE Identity Index Value" information element?
