q_47074.question: What should the peer CAPIF core function do if it receives an HTTP POST message for publishing a service API and the requesting CAPIF core function is not authorized to publish service APIs?
q_47074.ground_truth: The peer CAPIF core function should reject the HTTP POST request and skip step 3.

q_47075.question: What message type is used to indicate that the mobile station has received the requested call establishment information and no more will be accepted?

q_47076.question: What action should the participating MCPTT function take when replacing the IP address and port number in the received SDP answer, if required?
q_47076.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT function should replace the IP address and port number in the received SDP answer with the IP address and port number of the participating MCPTT function, for the accepted media stream in the received SDP offer, if required.

q_47077.question: What is the function of the IMS-ALG when the P-CSCF acts as a B2BUA for TCP based streams?
q_47077.ground_truth: The IMS-ALG, when used in conjunction with the P-CSCF acting as a B2BUA for TCP based streams, modifies the SDP and performs necessary connectivity checks as part of the ICE procedures.

q_47078.question: What should the UE do if the RestrictDCNR bit is set to "Use of dual connectivity with NR is restricted" in the EPS network feature support IE of the ATTACH ACCEPT message?
q_47078.ground_truth: The UE shall provide the indication that dual connectivity with NR is restricted to the upper layers.

q_47079.question: How many bits is the HARQ process number field in the DCI format 0B?
q_47079.ground_truth: The HARQ process number field in the DCI format 0B is 4 bits.

q_47080.question: What is the result of the STI validation in the process where originating IMS network invokes the signing on behalf of 3rd party?
q_47080.ground_truth: The result of the STI validation determines whether the call is to be completed with an appropriate indicator and passed back to terminating IMS subsystem, or if the call can continue but without showing name card info to terminating SIP UA.

q_47081.question: Which TS covers the conformance requirements for the current test case?
q_47081.ground_truth: The conformance requirements for the current test case are covered in TS 36.212, clause 5.3.3.1.3A; TS 36.213, clauses 7.1.6.3, 7.1.7, 7.1.7.1, 7.1.7.2 and 7.1.7.2.1; and TS 36.306, clause 4.1 and 4.1A.

q_47082.question: What triggers the MC service client to send a MBS listening status report indicating poor broadcast reception quality?
q_47082.ground_truth: The MC service client sends a MBS listening status report when it detects bad broadcast reception, such as moving out of the broadcast service area of the announced TMGI.

q_47083.question: What should the Constrained UE do upon receiving a specific CoAP response from the MSGin5G Server?
q_47083.ground_truth: The Constrained UE should handle the CoAP 2.05, 4.03, or 4.04 response as specified in clause 6.2.1.2.

q_47084.question: What should the UE do if it receives an ATTACH REJECT message with the reject cause set to #17 or #22 and the attach attempt counter is less than 5?
q_47084.ground_truth: The UE should start timer T3411 and shall not delete stored GUTI, and when T3411 expires, restart the attach procedure.

q_47085.question: What is required for the Initialization Segment when Preselection is used?
q_47085.ground_truth: When Preselection is used, the integrity of the Subsegments is not required to be processed in any particular order, resulting in a conforming file when concatenated.

q_47086.question: What is the function of the NWDAF in providing UE mobility analytics with finer granularity than TA/cell?
q_47086.ground_truth: The NWDAF can support more granularities in the preferred granularity of location information and preferred LCS QoS when the consumers request finer location information.

q_47087.question: In Release 18, what two promising techniques are being considered for higher accuracy in NR positioning?
q_47087.ground_truth: In Release 18, the two promising techniques being considered for higher accuracy in NR positioning are: (1) taking advantage of the rich 5G spectrum to increase the bandwidth for the transmission and reception of positioning reference signals using PRS (Positioning Reference Signal) bandwidth aggregation for intra-band carriers, and (2) using NR carrier phase measurements for positioning.

q_47088.question: What action does the UPF take when it receives traffic for a UE that does not match the allowed traffic?
q_47088.ground_truth: When the UPF receives traffic that does not match the allowed traffic, it reports the non-matching traffic to the NWDAF and includes the service data flows of the detected traffic.

q_47089.question: What is the authorization policy for a Ranging/SL Positioning capable UE when it is served by NG-RAN and is authorized to perform as a reference UE for Ranging/SL Positioning?
q_47089.ground_truth: The UE is authorized to perform as a reference UE for Ranging/SL Positioning in PLMNs where it is a Ranging/SL Positioning capable UE and is served by NG-RAN.

q_47090.question: When does the S-CSCF determine if the UE is allowed to use IMS Data Channel within a registration period?
q_47090.ground_truth: The S-CSCF determines if the UE is allowed to use IMS Data Channel based on IMS Data Channel capabilities of the UE and IMS network and optionally from the service profile retrieved from HSS after successful authentication.

q_47091.question: What should a UE do upon receiving the RRCConnectionRequest message when it is connected to EPC?
q_47091.ground_truth: The UE should set the ue-Identity based on whether an S-TMSI has been provided by upper layers or not.

q_47092.question: What should the UE do with uplink IP packets when the 3GPP PS data off UE status is "activated" and the UE is in its HPLMN or EHPLMN?
q_47092.ground_truth: The UE does not send uplink IP packets, except for those indicated in the list of 3GPP PS data off exempt services in HPLMN or EHPLMN.

q_47093.question: What is the registration type value used by a UE for Non-seamless WLAN offload?
q_47093.ground_truth: Non-seamless WLAN offload is an optional capability of a UE and is not dependent on specific registration type values.

q_47094.question: What are the PIN management requirements for the architecture?
q_47094.ground_truth: The architecture should support mechanisms to create, delete, and modify PINs; maintain multiple PIN servers; support PIN discovery and registration; and perform PIN profile/client profile maintenance and updates.

q_47095.question: What does the MB-SMF provide to the MB-UPF if an ingress transport address was not requested in step~11?
q_47095.ground_truth: The MB-SMF provides the SSM received as MBS Session ID to the MB-UPF and requests the MB-UPF to join the corresponding multicast tree from the content provider.

q_47096.question: What type of information element is the N1 UE network capability?
q_47096.ground_truth: The N1 UE network capability is a type 4 information element.

q_47097.question: When will the floor control interface send a Floor Deny message with a Reject Cause field including the value cause #1 (Another MCPTT client has permission) to the associated floor participant?
q_47097.ground_truth: When the MCPTT client did not negotiate support of queueing of floor requests as specified in clause~14, the effective priority level is pre-emptive and either other pre-emptive request is queued or the effective priority level of the current MCPTT client with permission to send media is the pre-emptive priority.

q_47098.question: What is the purpose of the "KPIMonitoring" data type in GSMA NG.116?
q_47098.ground_truth: The "KPIMonitoring" data type in GSMA NG.116 represents the performance monitoring of a network.

q_47099.question: When using AI/ML for DL Tx beam prediction and considering independent measurement errors for all Tx beams at a given Rx beam, how does the Top-1 beam prediction accuracy with a 1 dB margin compare to the one without measurement error for a case where there is a common measurement error for all Tx beams at a given Rx beam?
q_47099.ground_truth: The Top-1 beam prediction accuracy with a 1 dB margin has a slight performance degradation (less than 0.2%) when there is a common measurement error for all Tx beams at a given Rx beam compared to the one without measurement error.

q_47100.question: What is the role of the SMF when a new IPv6 prefix has been allocated for a PDU Session?
q_47100.ground_truth: The SMF is responsible for issuing a Router Advertisement message with the new IPv6 prefix and sending it to the UE via the PSA UPF.

q_47101.question: What is the purpose of the offset parameter for inequalities C2-1 and C2-2 in the measurement reporting procedure?
q_47101.ground_truth: The offset parameter (Off) is used to adjust the measurement threshold for the entering and leaving conditions of the measurement reporting procedure. It is added to or subtracted from the measurement result when comparing it to the threshold, allowing for more fine-grained control of the measurements.

q_47102.question: What does Pm-dsg refer to in the context of 5.3.3.2.4?
q_47102.ground_truth: Pm-dsg stands for the average probability of a missed downlink scheduling grant, which is measured during the test procedure in 5.3.3.2.4.4.2.

q_47103.question: What is the applicable measurement accuracy requirement when the SCell is activated in the context of E-UTRAN carrier aggregation?
q_47103.ground_truth: The applicable measurement accuracy requirements are in Section 9.1.19 when the SCell is activated in the context of E-UTRAN carrier aggregation.

q_47104.question: What message does the gNB-CU-CP send to the gNB-DU to deactivate the UE context during the BH RLC channel establishment procedure?
q_47104.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-CP sends a UE CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message to the gNB-DU to deactivate the UE context during the BH RLC channel establishment procedure.

q_47105.question: What is the role of the PEMC in the described scenario?
q_47105.ground_truth: The PEMC (PIN Element Manager Client) is responsible for performing the authorization check when the PINE A requests a service switch, providing the list of PINEs that can offer the requested services, and sending the endpoint information to the PINE A once the service switch decision has been made.

q_47106.question: When can an AF implicitly request a translation from the address of the UE to a AF specific UE Identifier?
q_47106.ground_truth: When the AF requests external exposure about an individual UE identified by its address.

q_47107.question: What are the conditions for a UE to declare a set of REs as not available for a PDSCH in a specific slot when the rateMatchPatternToAddModList is present among the slots of scheduled PDSCH?
q_47107.ground_truth: If a bitmap pair is included in one or two groups of resource sets, the dynamic indication of availability for PDSCH applies to a set of slot(s) where the rateMatchPatternToAddModList is present among the slots of scheduled PDSCH.

q_47108.question: What is the action taken by the mobile station if a random access failure or RR connection establishment failure occurs during the establishment of an MM connection?
q_47108.ground_truth: The mobile station aborts the MM connection establishment and informs the requesting CM entity.

q_47109.question: What shall the remote UE use while sending packets in a one-to-one ProSe direct communication for mission critical applications and policy control, if the direct link is setup for one-to-one communication between a remote UE and a UE-to-network relay?
q_47109.ground_truth: The remote UE shall use a /64 IPv6 Prefix from a shorter IPv6 prefix assigned to it by the UE-to-network relay.

q_47110.question: What happens to the allocated resources on E1 related to the UE association(s) when the RESET procedure is initiated from the gNB-CU-CP?
q_47110.ground_truth: At reception of the RESET message, the gNB-CU-UP shall release all allocated resources on E1 related to the UE association(s) indicated explicitly or implicitly in the RESET message.

q_47111.question: What message does the MCPTT server send to de-associate the group call from the MBS session?
q_47111.ground_truth: The MCPTT server sends an "UnMapGroupFromSessionStream" to de-associate the group call from the MBS session.

q_47112.question: What should the UE do in CS/PS mode 1 or CS/PS mode 2 of operation in 3GPP TS 24.301 clause 3.1?
q_47112.ground_truth: The UE sets the update status to U2 NOT UPDATED, disables E-UTRAN, and selects GERAN or UTRAN access technology, entering the EMM-NULL state.

q_47113.question: What is the purpose of the "uniqueItems" keyword in JSON schema when mapping the attribute property "isUnique"?
q_47113.ground_truth: The "uniqueItems" keyword is used to ensure that all the elements in the array are unique.

q_47114.question: In which circumstance should the SNRM-C send a location information report towards the SNRM-S?
q_47114.ground_truth: If the VAL UE moves into a new cell in which both TMGI 1 and TMGI 2 are active.

q_47115.question: Which message is sent by the gNB-DU to report the results of the requested measurements?
q_47115.ground_truth: The RESOURCE STATUS UPDATE message is sent by the gNB-DU to the gNB-CU to report the results of the requested measurements.

q_47116.question: What factor determines the value of Tprocessing in a handover?
q_47116.ground_truth: The Tprocessing value can be up to 20ms and is the time required by the UE to complete internal processing for handover.

q_47117.question: What is the difference between bidirectional and unidirectional media interception?
q_47117.ground_truth: Bidirectional media interception involves intercepting media in both directions using the same IP address and UDP port number, while unidirectional media interception involves intercepting media in one direction only, requiring separate triggering for each direction.

q_47118.question: What are the conditions necessary for a UE to report wideband CQI/PMI, subband CQI, or RI when PTI is not transmitted or equal to 1, and the most recent type 6 report for the CSI process is dropped?
q_47118.ground_truth: PTI is not transmitted or equal to 1, and the most recent type 6 report for the CSI process is dropped.

q_47119.question: What condition is required for the EEC to detect or acquire the planned or predicted UE mobility behavior in Solution #12?
q_47119.ground_truth: The EEC will detect or acquire the planned or predicted UE mobility behavior only when the EES verifies and indicates the service continuity planning permission per application in step 2-3.

q_47120.question: When the MCVideo client wants to release an MCVideo session established using on-demand session signaling, what should the MCVideo client do?
q_47120.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should interact with the media plane, generate a SIP BYE request, set the Request-URI to the MCVideo session identity to release, and send a SIP BYE request towards the MCVideo server.

q_47121.question: What is the length of time for near real-time charging and billing information processing?

q_47122.question: What is the role of the UE in the procedure for UE awareness of NTN coverage and UE location?
q_47122.ground_truth: The UE initiates the negotiation of power saving mechanisms by sending a Registration Request message with the NTN coverage information and requested timers/parameters for PSM/MICO/eDRX.

q_47123.question: What are the measurements performed if the reportSFTD-Meas is set to true and the measObject is associated to E-UTRA?
q_47123.ground_truth: The measurements performed are SFTD measurements between the PCell and the E-UTRA PSCell, and RSRP measurements for the E-UTRA PSCell.

q_47124.question: What should the AI/ML MnS producer extend in the MLEntity data type to indicate the update time of the ML entity?
q_47124.ground_truth: The AI/ML MnS producer should extend the MLEntity data type with an attribute "updatedTime" to indicate the time that the ML entity is updated.

q_47125.question: What is the message that the DANE sends to the client in Step 4 of the Network Assistance workflow, indicating the recommended version of the content item in terms of the recommended bitrate?

q_47126.question: What does the "TSG" in the document's title refer to?
q_47126.ground_truth: The "TSG" in the document's title refers to the "TechnicalSpecifications Group" within the 3GPP, which is responsible for the development and maintenance of the technical specifications for mobile networks.

q_47127.question: What type of element must include a <trigger-id> element in the "location-info" type?
q_47127.ground_truth: The elements that must include a <trigger-id> element in the "location-info" type are: <rigger-id>, <periodic-report>, <travelled-distance>, <vertical-application-event>, <geographical-area-change>, <any-area-change>, <enter-specific-area>, <polygon-area>, <ellipsoid-arc-area>, <exit-specific-area-type>, <valid-period>, and <minimum-interval-length>.

q_47128.question: What is the default value of <classx>?
q_47128.ground_truth: The default value of <classx> is 7, which represents voice, data and fax.

q_47129.question: What should the source End UE do when receiving a Discovery Solicitation message with a specific RSC during model B discovery?
q_47129.ground_truth: The source End UE shall use the security procedures with network assistance if the Network Assistance Security Indicator associated with the RSC indicates the security procedures with network assistance. Otherwise, the source End UE shall use the security procedures without network assistance.

q_47130.question: What is the maximum number of child elements in the sequence for the "enhancedStatusType" complex type?
q_47130.ground_truth: The "enhancedStatusType" complex type can have a maximum of 3 child elements in the sequence.

q_47131.question: What networking technology is supported by the E-UTRA connected to 5GC as part of NG-RAN?
q_47131.ground_truth: E-UTRA (Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access) is supported by the E-UTRA connected to 5GC as part of NG-RAN.

q_47132.question: Which spurious emissions limits may need specific solutions for NR Band n28 and n29 base stations?
q_47132.ground_truth: Specific solutions may be required for NR Band n28 to meet spurious emissions limits with E-UTRA Band 27 UL operating band, and for NR Band n29 to meet the limits with UTRA Band XII, E-UTRA Band 12 or NR Band n12 UL operating band, E-UTRA Band 17 UL or E-UTRA Band 85 in certain regions.

q_47133.question: What must the MCData server identify in the <presence> root element of the application/pidf+xml MIME body of a SIP PUBLISH request?

q_47134.question: What is the purpose of the Link Identifier Update (LIU) procedure in the context of a Layer-2 UE-to-UE Relay?
q_47134.ground_truth: The Link Identifier Update (LIU) procedure is used to update all identifiers sent in cleartext on the per-hop and adaptation layer headers in the context of a Layer-2 UE-to-UE Relay.

q_47135.question: What is the startup procedure for a PIN client to join a PIN?
q_47135.ground_truth: The PIN client sends the PIN Management PINE join into PIN request to PEMC, which includes the security credentials, UE identifier, and PIN client profile information. Upon receiving the request, the PEMC performs an authorization check and sends a successful PIN Management PINE join into PIN response to PIN client.

q_47136.question: What message does the UE receive after it sends a combined TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message with "EPS update type = combined TA/LA updating"?
q_47136.ground_truth: The UE receives a TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message containing a GUTI and/or a mobile identity.

q_47137.question: What is the network product's behavior when a user is prompted to change his password and creates a new password?
q_47137.ground_truth: The network product confirms the change in password by displaying "Password Changed Successfully" and allows the user to log in using the new password.

q_47138.question: What should the UE do if the V2X service identifier maps to a V2X application server FQDN in the V2X application server information obtained at step 2?
q_47138.ground_truth: The UE shall perform DNS lookup as specified in IETF RFC 1035 to resolve the IP address(es) of the V2X application server.

q_47139.question: What is a pre-requisite for Key Issue #7 solution?
q_47139.ground_truth: The hPLMN must support at least static authorization.

q_47140.question: Which parameter in the 3gpp-Sbi-Routing-Binding header indicates the preferred binding to a binding entity?

q_47141.question: What should the transferor AS do on the reception of an INVITE request from the transferee?
q_47141.ground_truth: The transferor AS shall deduce the "id" related privacy requirement that the transferee has indicated in the initial call between the transferee and the transferor; and shall include a Privacy header field containing the according value in the outgoing INVITE request.

q_47142.question: What should the (V-)PCF do upon reception of an HTTP POST request during AMF relocation?
q_47142.ground_truth: The (V-)PCF should update the "Individual UE Policy Association" resource, determine the applicable policy, and include the "suppFeat" attribute with the negotiated supported features and the complete "Individual UE Policy Association" resource representation in the PolicyUpdate data structure.

q_47143.question: What is the role of the SMF in 3GPP networks when an external DHCPv6 server in a DN is used to obtain requested parameters?
q_47143.ground_truth: The SMF acts as a DHCPv6 client towards the external DHCPv6 server while acting a DHCPv6 server towards the UE

q_47144.question: What should the transmission participant do when the MCVideo call is going to be released?
q_47144.ground_truth: The transmission participant should stop sending transmission control messages towards other transmission participants, request the MCVideo client to stop sending and receiving RTP media packets, release all resources associated with the MCVideo call, and enter the 'Start-stop' state.

q_47145.question: What is the basic measurement interval of modulated carrier frequency for IAB-MT type 1-O and type 2-O?
q_47145.ground_truth: The basic measurement interval of modulated carrier frequency for IAB-MT type 1-O and type 2-O is 1 UL slot.

q_47146.question: What should the UE do if it receives a MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message for an emergency PDN connection and it has not provided an APN for the establishment of the PDN connection?
q_47146.ground_truth: The UE should not stop the timer T3396 associated with no APN if it is running and it should check the received TFT before taking it into use.

q_47147.question: What is the default value of T when no value is stored in the SIM and the MS only supports EC-GSM-IoT or Category M1 or Category NB1?
q_47147.ground_truth: The default value of T when no value is stored in the SIM and the MS only supports EC-GSM-IoT or Category M1 or Category NB1 is 72 hours.

q_47148.question: What type of data types are defined in clause 6.5.6.3.2 of the document?
q_47148.ground_truth: Simple data types are defined in clause 6.5.6.3.2 of the document.

q_47149.question: What is the purpose of the test defined in 6.5A.2.1.2.2?
q_47149.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the power of any UE emission for FR2 3UL CA does not exceed specified levels for the specified channel bandwidth.

q_47150.question: When selecting an NWDAF for ML model provisioning, what additional factors can be considered by the NWDAF?
q_47150.ground_truth: The NWDAF can consider the S-NSSAI(s), area(s) of interest, ML model filter information parameters, time period of interest, FL capability type, NF type(s) or NF set ID(s) of the data source(s), and ML model interoperability indicator.

q_47151.question: What is the function of the List of Queued Users field in the Floor Queue Request message?
q_47151.ground_truth: The List of Queued Users field in the Floor Queue Request message is used to indicate the list of users whose request for permission to send media is queued when sending a message for cancellation of a queued floor request or sending a response message to the cancellation of a queued floor request.

q_47152.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification on Performance Assurance in the context of 5G networks and network slicing?
q_47152.ground_truth: The purpose is to specify stage 1, 2, and 3 of performance assurance related management services for 5G networks including network slicing. However, it does not specify the performance data, i.e. performance measurements, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

q_47153.question: What should the controlling MCPTT function do if it receives a SIP INVITE request with an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body with an <emergency-ind> element set to a value of "true"?
q_47153.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function should cache the information that the MCPTT user has initiated an MCPTT emergency call.

q_47154.question: What should the PNM AS do when the PNM AS receives an initial request from a UE that is not a member of the same PN as the PN UE that's address is contained in the Request-URI and the address in the Request-URI exists in a <PNController> element in the PN access control list?
q_47154.ground_truth: The PNM AS shall allow the request to continue normally.

q_47155.question: In the SL LBT failure MAC CE, what does the Ri field indicate when set to 1?
q_47155.ground_truth: A consistent LBT failure has been triggered and not cancelled in the RB set.

q_47156.question: Which protocol element is mandatory to be included in the "MeasurementRequest-IEs" sequence?
q_47156.ground_truth: The "ID id-LMF-Measurement-ID" and "ID id-TRP-MeasurementRequestList" elements are mandatory in the "MeasurementRequest-IEs" sequence.

q_47157.question: What should the MCVideo client include in a SIP re-INVITE request when the MCVideo user requests to upgrade the MCVideo group session to an in-progress emergency group state and is authorized to do so?
q_47157.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body by following the procedures in clause~6.2.8.1.1 when sending a SIP re-INVITE request to upgrade the MCVideo group session to an in-progress emergency group state.

q_47158.question: What should the UE do if it receives the 5GSM network feature support IE in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message with the non-3GPP access path switching bit set to "non-3GPP access path switching supported" during the PDU session establishment procedure?
q_47158.ground_truth: The UE may include the NSONR bit with value set to "non-3GPP path switching while using old non-3GPP resources requested" in the Non-3GPP path switching information IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message while performing the registration procedure for mobility registration update for non-3GPP access path switching.

q_47159.question: What information is reported in the Packet Data Header Summary Reports (PDSRs) when packet header information reporting is authorized?
q_47159.ground_truth: Depending on the requirements of the warrant, the PDSRs can be in summary form and include information such as packet flow description, cell identifiers, and packet data size.

q_47160.question: What is the format of the "S-Node Modification Request Reject" sequence?
q_47160.ground_truth: The "S-Node Modification Request Reject" sequence consists of a mandatory "protocolIEs" field, which is a container for a set of "SNodeModificationRequestReject-IEs".

q_47161.question: What is the definition of a UE in enhanced coverage in the context of Rel-13?
q_47161.ground_truth: A UE in enhanced coverage is a UE that requires the use of enhanced coverage functionality to access the cell. It is supported in two modes (mode A and mode B) in Rel-13, where the support of mode A is mandatory for a BL UE.

q_47162.question: What is the required TAE for intra-band non-contiguous carrier aggregation in E-UTRA test requirement?
q_47162.ground_truth: The time alignment error shall not exceed 285 ns.

q_47163.question: What should the UE do when it considers a list of entries to include 'list' in the field name?
q_47163.ground_truth: The UE should create a combined list by concatenating the additional entries included in the extension field to the original field while maintaining the order among both the original and the additional entries.

q_47164.question: What action shall the network take if the timer T3260 expires in the network during the authentication procedure?
q_47164.ground_truth: The network shall abort the authentication procedure and any ongoing MM specific procedure, release all MM connections, and initiate the RR connection release procedure.

q_47165.question: What is the requirement for the MME in TS 23.272, clause 4.6 when UE is performing a CS fallback procedure for a Mobile Originating Call for the purpose of an emergency call?
q_47165.ground_truth: The MME shall indicate to the E-UTRAN via the appropriate S1-AP message that this CS fallback procedure is for emergency purpose.

q_47166.question: What is the purpose of the PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for UE-to-UE relay discovery solicitation?
q_47166.ground_truth: The purpose of the PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for UE-to-UE relay discovery solicitation is to generate a message to the discoveree end UE containing the UE-to-UE relay UE info parameter, relay service code parameter, resource status indicator, MIC, UTC-based counter, and ProSe direct discovery PC5 message type parameter.

q_47167.question: What protocol can be used between the UE and the TNGF to enable NAT traversal?
q_47167.ground_truth: The UDP protocol can be used between the UE and the TNGF to enable NAT traversal.

q_47168.question: What reference points are defined in the non-roaming 5G System architecture for U2X communication over PC5?
q_47168.ground_truth: In the non-roaming 5G System architecture for U2X communication over PC5, the reference points defined are U2X1, U2X5, N1, and N2.

q_47169.question: What is UERetentionInformation?
q_47169.ground_truth: UERetentionInformation is an enumerated type that can be set to one of the two possible values: ues-retained and others.

q_47170.question: What is the minimum elevation angle used in the selection of visible satellites for the test?
q_47170.ground_truth: The minimum elevation angle used in the selection of visible satellites for the test is 15 degrees above the horizon with respect to the UE.

q_47171.question: What are the three packet filter components supported in the V2X Packet Filter Set?
q_47171.ground_truth: The V2X Packet Filter Set supports packet filters based on V2X service type, Source/Destination Layer-2 ID, and Application Layer ID (e.g. Station ID).

q_47172.question: Which enumerated value in the "statusType" simple type indicates that the functional alias is in the process of being activated?
q_47172.ground_truth: The enumerated value "activating" in the "statusType" simple type indicates that the functional alias is in the process of being activated.

q_47173.question: What should the UE apply if the received wlan-OffloadDedicated includes thresholdRSRQ?
q_47173.ground_truth: The UE should apply the received thresholdRSRQ and forward it to upper layers.

q_47174.question: In which 3GPP TS is the high quality signal limit defined for cdma2000 1xRTT radio access technology?
q_47174.ground_truth: The high quality signal limit for cdma2000 1xRTT radio access technology is defined in 3GPP2 C.S0011.

q_47175.question: What is the criticality of the 'id-UESecurityCapabilities' in the NGAP-PROTOCOL-IES list?
q_47175.ground_truth: The criticality of 'id-UESecurityCapabilities' in the NGAP-PROTOCOL-IES list is 'ignore'.

q_47176.question: What should the mobile station (MS) do when it receives an RR, MM, or CC message with a "missing conditional IE", "unexpected conditional IE", or syntactically incorrect conditional IE?
q_47176.ground_truth: The MS should ignore the message, except for returning a status message (STATUS, MM STATUS, GMM STATUS, or SM STATUS) with cause value #~100 "conditional IE error".

q_47177.question: What is the role of the RE-NWDAF in the roaming architecture for data collection and analytics exposure?
q_47177.ground_truth: The RE-NWDAF is responsible for exchanging data or analytics between PLMNs, and it checks user consent in roaming scenarios.

q_47178.question: What is the outcome when the UE is registered with S-NSSAI1 and S-NSSAI2 while camped on TAI2, and the AMF provides Allowed S-NSSAI = (S-NSSAI1, S-NSSAI2) and RA = TAI2?
q_47178.ground_truth: The UE is now able to use both S-NSSAI1 and S-NSSAI2 while camped on TAI2.

q_47179.question: What is the main difference between the URSP provisioning in 5GS in solution #15 and EPC in solution #16?
q_47179.ground_truth: In 5GS (Solution #15), UPDP protocol and N1 Policy Containers are used for the distribution of the policies, while in EPC (Solution #16), the solution proposes using a new ePCO parameter to encapsulate UPDP messages and transfer them to the UE via the PDN connection using existing procedures.

q_47180.question: What is the required value for the <allow-request-first-to-answer-call> element in the second scenario for a user to be allowed to make a first-to-answer call?
q_47180.ground_truth: The <allow-request-first-to-answer-call> element must be present in the <ruleset> element and set to a value of "true" for a user to be allowed to make a first-to-answer call in the second scenario.

q_47181.question: What information can the DN-AAA server send to the SMF upon authorization of PDU Session Establishment?
q_47181.ground_truth: The DN-AAA server may send a reference to authorization data for policy and charging control, a list of allowed MAC addresses, a list of allowed VLAN Ids, Session-AMBR for the PDU Session, L2TP information, and Framed Route information for the PDU Session.

q_47182.question: What is the test applicability for out-of-band band blocking for CA?
q_47182.ground_truth: This test case applies to all types of NR UE release 15 and forward that supports 4DL CA.

q_47183.question: When does the UE need to discover the V2X MBS parameters for receiving V2X communication over Uu using MBS?
q_47183.ground_truth: Before receiving a V2X communication over Uu using MBS bearer, the UE needs to discover the V2X MBS parameters via which the V2X communication is to be received.

q_47184.question: What should the gNB-CU-UP do if the Integrity Protection Indication IE is set to "not needed" for each PDU session for which the Security Indication IE is included in the PDU Session Resource To Setup List IE or the Security Indication Modify IE is included in the PDU Session Resource To Modify List IE of the BEARER CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message?
q_47184.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-UP shall not perform user plane integrity protection for the concerned PDU session.

q_47185.question: Which feature does a UE enable when it indicates support for "subcarrierPuncturingCE-ModeA-r16" or "subcarrierPuncturingCE-ModeB-r16"?
q_47185.ground_truth: A UE indicating support of "subcarrierPuncturingCE-ModeA-r16" or "subcarrierPuncturingCE-ModeB-r16" enables DL subcarrier puncturing for coexistence with NR.

q_47186.question: In what scenario does the network establish a new PDU session before a UE can join a multicast MBS session?
q_47186.ground_truth: If the UE has no appropriate PDU session established with the DNN and S-NSSAI for the multicast MBS session, the network proceeds with establishment of the associated PDU session.

q_47187.question: What is enhanced in PFCP Session Establishment/Modification for QoS Monitoring?
q_47187.ground_truth: PFCP Session Establishment/Modification is enhanced to support new type of session data to report for Direct Reporting, with Control for QoS Flow Bandwidth Measurements including QFI, requested measurements (UL, DL and/or overall bitrate), Reporting Frequency, and complementary information as needed, like thresholds to trigger reporting, or measurement period (periodic reporting).

q_47188.question: What is the purpose of the ATSSS Low-Layer functionality in the UE?
q_47188.ground_truth: The ATSSS Low-Layer functionality in the UE can steer, switch, and split all types of traffic, including TCP traffic, UDP traffic, Ethernet traffic, etc.

q_47189.question: What actions does the UE perform upon reception of the RRCSetup in 5.3.3.4?
q_47189.ground_truth: The UE shall indicate to NCR-Fwd to cease forwarding if the RRCSetup is received in response to an RRCReestablishmentRequest, or if it is received in response to an RRCResumeRequest or RRCResumeRequest1. The UE shall also instruct the MAC entity to stop the cg-SDT-TimeAlignmentTimer if it is running.

q_47190.question: What is the requirement for the operator to minimize the number of interrogations and information sent between the SMF and CHF for their IoT data connectivity offer?
q_47190.ground_truth: Simplify charging for IoT devices and protect 5GS from charging system overload due to many CDRs

q_47191.question: In which section of the document does the requirement for PRACH false alarm probability apply?

q_47192.question: When dynamic satellite backhaul is used, what can be measured by the PCF using QoS monitoring?

q_47193.question: What action does the SMF take when it detects that the provisioning of PCC Rules failed for an IMS Emergency service?
q_47193.ground_truth: The SMF initiates the PCC rule error handling procedure.

q_47194.question: What does the display mode "immediate" and "normal" mean for CBS messages?
q_47194.ground_truth: The display mode "immediate" means that the CBS message is supposed to be on the display all the time, while "normal" means that the CBS message will be displayed only when the user wants to see it.

q_47195.question: What should the MeNB do if it receives a SGNB MODIFICATION REQUEST message containing the Full E-RAB Level QoS Parameters IE or the Requested SCG E-RAB Level QoS Parameters IE with a GBR bearer that does not contain the GBR QoS Information IE?
q_47195.ground_truth: The MeNB should not admit the corresponding E-RAB.

q_47196.question: What are the representative sub-use cases for positioning accuracy enhancements?
q_47196.ground_truth: The representative sub-use cases for positioning accuracy enhancements are direct AI/ML positioning, with the AI/ML model output being the UE location, and AI/ML assisted positioning, with the AI/ML model output being a new measurement or enhancement of an existing measurement.

q_47197.question: What parameter does the UE select while initializing the Random Access procedure?
q_47197.ground_truth: The UE selects a set of Random Access resources.

q_47198.question: What is the role of Client NWDAF 1 and Client NWDAF 2 during the Federated Learning training procedure?
q_47198.ground_truth: Client NWDAF 1 and Client NWDAF 2 further train the retrieved Abnormal Classifier from the Server NWDAF, respectively, based on the local raw data.

q_47199.question: What should a mobile station (MS) do upon receipt of a MODIFY PDP CONTEXT REJECT message?
q_47199.ground_truth: Upon receipt of a MODIFY PDP CONTEXT REJECT message, the MS shall stop timer T3381 and enter the state PDP-ACTIVE.

q_47200.question: What should a GTP entity do when it receives an unexpected triggered message?
q_47200.ground_truth: If a GTP entity receives an unexpected triggered message, it should discard the message and log an error. However, if the message is an unexpected triggered request message (e.g. a Delete Bearer Request), the GTP entity may choose to accept the message.

q_47201.question: Which 3GPP specification document provides the definition for the feature-capability indicator named g.3gpp.in-call-access-update?
q_47201.ground_truth: 3GPP TS 24.229, "IP multimedia call control protocol based on Session Initiation Protocol (SIP) and Session Description Protocol (SDP); Stage 3".

q_47202.question: Which feedback messages should an MTSI client support when offering AVPF for all media streams containing video?
q_47202.ground_truth: An MTSI client is required to support AVPF feedback messages trr-int, NACK, and PLI and the CCM feedback messages FIR, TMMBR, and TMMBN. These feedback messages can only be used together with AVPF and shall be negotiated in SDP offer/answer before they can be used in the session.

q_47203.question: Who is responsible for setting the Downlink signal level to the appropriate REFSENS value, as per the given scenario?
q_47203.ground_truth: The Signaling System (SS) is responsible for setting the Downlink signal level to the appropriate REFSENS value.

q_47204.question: What are the possible values for the polygon area in the context of network functional aliases and unit MCPTT deactivation?
q_47204.ground_truth: The polygon area can have values between 0 and 16777215, and can be used to define the area within which a unit's MCPTT functionality should be activated or deactivated.

q_47205.question: What is the value of P in FR2 when the CSI-RS is partially overlapped with GAP and is partially overlapped with SMTC occasion but the SMTC occasion is not overlapped with GAP?
q_47205.ground_truth: When the CSI-RS is partially overlapped with GAP and SMTC occasion but not overlapped with GAP, P = 0.5 if TSMTCperiod is not equal to xRP or TCSI-RS is less than 0.5*TSMTCperiod when TSMTCperiod is equal to xRP. For all other cases, P = 1.

q_47206.question: What should the UP function do with the usage report when the quota holding time is expired and the reporting trigger QUHTI is set, during the deactivation of a URR?
q_47206.ground_truth: The UP function should send a usage report during the period when the URR is deactivated.

q_47207.question: What is the test setup for E-UTRA PCell in the context of EN-DC within FR1?
q_47207.ground_truth: The test setup for E-UTRA PCell is specified in Clause 9.1.2.

q_47208.question: What should the non-controlling MCVideo function do if it is unable to process a SIP MESSAGE request due to lack of resources or risk of congestion?
q_47208.ground_truth: The non-controlling MCVideo function can reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response, including a Retry-After header field to the SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response, and skip the rest of the steps.

q_47209.question: What is the role of the TNGF during UE's mobility from TNAP1 to TNAP2?
q_47209.ground_truth: The TNGF identifies the UE, retrieves the context, checks the stored context, derives the TNAP' keys, and responds back to TNAP2 with the generated key.

q_47210.question: What is the S-CSCF responsible for upon receipt of a 200 (OK) response for a REGISTER request?
q_47210.ground_truth: The S-CSCF shall create and send a 200 (OK) response for the REGISTER request as specified in the subclause mentioned.

q_47211.question: What does the 5.4.4.3 procedure involve in the 5G System?
q_47211.ground_truth: The 5.4.4.3 procedure involves providing information on recommended cells and RAN nodes for paging to help determine the RAN nodes to be paged and provide information on recommended cells to each of these RAN nodes.

q_47212.question: What assures the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay that the 5G ProSe Remote UE is authorized to get the relay service?
q_47212.ground_truth: The successful verification of the Direct Security Mode Complete message.

q_47213.question: What should be the value of T3412 if the ATTACH ACCEPT message contains the T3412 extended value IE and the UE shall use the value in T3412 extended value IE as periodic tracking area update timer (T3412)?
q_47213.ground_truth: The UE shall use the value in T3412 extended value IE as periodic tracking area update timer (T3412).

q_47214.question: When must a UE select the radio resource parameters for ProSe direct discovery?
q_47214.ground_truth: A UE must select the radio resource parameters for ProSe direct discovery when the UE is not served by E-UTRAN or when served by E-UTRAN and intends to use provisioned ProSe radio resources (i.e. carrier frequency).

q_47215.question: Under what conditions should a participating MCPTT function reject a SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 404 (Not Found) response?
q_47215.ground_truth: If the participating MCPTT function cannot find a binding between the public user identity and an MCPTT ID or if the validity period of an existing binding has expired, it should reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 404 (Not Found) response.

q_47216.question: What is the action for the SS to apply to 5G NR Release 16 and forward UEs related to the backoff on the PCell power?
q_47216.ground_truth: The SS applies a backoff on the PCell power by activating the UE Power Limit Function (UPLF) and performs the ACTIVATE POWER LIMIT REQUEST procedure as specified in TS 38.508-1 clause 4.9.32 with TOTAL NR AGGREGATED BANDWIDTH and PCELL NR bandwidth as per Test CC Combination setting.

q_47217.question: What is the purpose of the Timer-based BWP switch?
q_47217.ground_truth: The purpose of the Timer-based BWP switch is to switch the bandwidth part from BWP-2 back to the default bandwidth part - BWP-1 on PSCell and SCell after the expiration of the bwp-InactivityTimer timer.

q_47218.question: What is the definition for Sub-block Bandwidth (BWChannel,block) in intra-band non-contiguous carrier aggregation?
q_47218.ground_truth: Sub-block Bandwidth (BWChannel,block) is defined as Fedge,block,high - Fedge,block,low (MHz) for intra-band non-contiguous carrier aggregation.

q_47219.question: What type of value should be defined in the "Timers" element for the timer value of floor queue position request?

q_47220.question: Which clause in the 3GPP specification corresponds to the "AllowedLocallyInitiatedAmbientViewing" element?
q_47220.ground_truth: The "allow-request-locally-initiated-ambient-viewing" element corresponds to the "AllowedLocallyInitiatedAmbientViewing" element in clause 13.2.87A2 of the 3GPP specification.

q_47221.question: What are the permitted values for the <CUG_pointer> parameter in the 7.34 Enhanced closed user group?
q_47221.ground_truth: The permitted values for the <CUG_pointer> parameter in the 7.34 Enhanced closed user group is from 1 to n, where n is implementation specific.

q_47222.question: What does the MC service client do when it receives MC service data via unicast delivery and broadcast MBS session?
q_47222.ground_truth: When an MC service client receives MC service data via unicast delivery and broadcast MBS session, the network mechanism stops unicast delivery to these users after some time.

q_47223.question: What is the purpose of the "RulesForDeaffiliation" section?
q_47223.ground_truth: It contains the rules for deactivating the affiliation to a MCPTT group when certain conditions are met, such as exiting a specific area or meeting specific speed requirements.

q_47224.question: What is the purpose of the Application ID or Extended application ID IE in the SDS signalling payload message as specified in clause~15.1.2?
q_47224.ground_truth: It represents the intended application on the terminating MCData client, chosen by the mission critical organization.

q_47225.question: What is the action taken by the BBERF in step 7d after the H-PCRF denies an authorization and informs the V-PCRF, if applicable?
q_47225.ground_truth: The H-PCRF may provide new or modified QoS rules to the V-PCRF, which the V-PCRF acknowledges and provisions to the target BBERF in step 7e.

q_47226.question: What is the role of K~NRP~ in PC5 link security establishment between the source UE and the UE-to-UE Relay over User Plane?
q_47226.ground_truth: K~NRP~ is a parameter used in PC5 link security establishment between the source UE and the UE-to-UE Relay over User Plane. It is derived differently for 5G ProSe UE-to-Network service and 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay service by 5G PKMF. The UE-to-UE Relay derives the session key K~NRP-SESS~ and confidentiality key NRPEK based on PC5 policies.

q_47227.question: What is the purpose of the pre-registration procedure in the optimized E-UTRAN to HRPD handover procedure?
q_47227.ground_truth: The purpose of the pre-registration procedure in the optimized E-UTRAN to HRPD handover procedure is to establish and maintain a dormant session in the target HRPD access, while the UE remains connected to the E-UTRAN/MME.

q_47228.question: In which scenario will the UE initiated Data Forwarding be initiated?
q_47228.ground_truth: The E-RABSubjecttoDataForwardingList container is used to indicate the UE initiated data forwarding when Handover is initiated.

q_47229.question: What is the time duration that the UE is not required to transmit or receive signals during a UE specific CBW change in EN-DC UE?
q_47229.ground_truth: The time duration is defined by the length of the RRC procedure delay and the time used by the UE to perform CBW change.

q_47230.question: What should the mobile station do when the RR connection is released during a local IMSI detach process?
q_47230.ground_truth: The mobile station should delay the local release of the channel to allow a normal release from the network side until the T3220 timeout. If this is not possible, the RR sublayer on the mobile station side should be aborted.

q_47231.question: What header field should the SCC AS populate the SIP INVITE request with when sending it towards the served user and the session being established is anchored in SCC AS?
q_47231.ground_truth: When sending a SIP INVITE request towards the served user and the session being established is anchored in SCC AS, the SCC AS should populate the SIP INVITE request with a Feature-Caps header field that includes the g.3gpp.srvcc feature-capability indicator and the g.3gpp.remote-leg-info feature-capability indicator, an Accept header field with the MIME type application/vnd.3gpp.state-and-event-info+xml, and a Recv-Info header field containing the g.3gpp.state-and-event package name.

q_47232.question: When should the UE include the plmn-IdentityList in themeasurement report message?
q_47232.ground_truth: If the cell is a CSG member cell and the subset of the PLMN identities meets the specified conditions.

q_47233.question: What does the Application metadata container information element do?
q_47233.ground_truth: The Application metadata container information element is used to carry metadata specific to the application and provides a means for the sender of the SDS or file to attach application-specific information to the SDS or file.

q_47234.question: What message does the PDN GW send to the MAG in the trusted non-3GPP access in response to a Proxy Binding Update message with a zero lifetime value?
q_47234.ground_truth: The PDN GW sends a Proxy Binding Ack message with a zero lifetime value and an IPv4 only indicator to the MAG in the trusted non-3GPP access.

q_47235.question: What is the minimum requirement for the mean power spectral density for BS type 1-O, as specified in clause 6.5.2.5.1?
q_47235.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for the mean power spectral density for BS type 1-O is less than -102.6 dBm/MHz for a carrier frequency less than or equal to 3.0 GHz, and less than -102.4 dBm/MHz for a carrier frequency greater than 3.0 GHz and less than or equal to 7.125 GHz.

q_47236.question: What action should a participating MCPTT function take if it receives a SIP re-INVITE request with a risk of congestion for an on-demand session?
q_47236.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT function should reject the request with a SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response and include a Retry-After header field.

q_47237.question: What is the result when a new MCPTT client initiates an MCPTT call with an implicit floor request and the MCPTT call does not exist yet?
q_47237.ground_truth: The floor control interface towards the MCPTT client in the IWF floor control server shall initialize a general state machine as specified in clause~6.3.4.2.2.

q_47238.question: In 6.5.2, what is enhanced with evaluations of conditional handover conditions to enable handover of UEs faster during the switching of NES modes?

q_47239.question: What charging information is reported by the SMF in a PDU session charging SSC mode 3 IPv6 Multi Homed scenario?
q_47239.ground_truth: The charging information for usage reporting of UPF1, quota request for UPF2, and request quota for UPF2 is reported by the SMF in a PDU session charging SSC mode 3 IPv6 Multi Homed scenario, if quota management per UPF is enabled.

q_47240.question: What is the function of the GBA in the context of the 5G system?
q_47240.ground_truth: The GBA (Generic Bootstrapping Architecture) is a system in the 5G network that provides a secure method for establishing a shared secret between the network and a UE, which can be used for authentication purposes.

q_47241.question: How should the PCF notify the NF service consumer about the Service Data Flow QoS monitoring control?
q_47241.ground_truth: The PCF should notify the NF service consumer by including the "EventsNotification" data type in the body of the HTTP POST request.

q_47242.question: What action should a participating MCPTT function take when it receives a SIP MESSAGE request with an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-mbs-usage-info+xml MIME body and a P-Asserted-Identity header field that is not bound to the MCPTT ID in the <mcptt-request-uri> element in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body?
q_47242.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT function shall reject the request.

q_47243.question: What specification document is reused in the definition of the Mandatory Flags field?

q_47244.question: In which mode can the Local Emergency Numbers List be updated in the UE, if it is in S1 mode, A/Gb or Iu mode, or N1 mode?
q_47244.ground_truth: The Local Emergency Numbers List can be updated with EMM procedures if the UE is in S1 mode, with GMM and MM procedures if the UE is in A/Gb or Iu mode, and with 5GMM procedures if the UE is in N1 mode.

q_47245.question: What are the two types of PCI assignment algorithms in the framework for PCI selection?
q_47245.ground_truth: The two types of PCI assignment algorithms are centralized PCI assignment, where the OAM signals a specific PCI value, and distributed PCI assignment, where the OAM signals a list of PCI values and the eNB selects a PCI value randomly from the remaining list of PCIs.

q_47246.question: What should the AMF do if the UE mobility is from EPS to 5GS and the UE is in idle state?
q_47246.ground_truth: The UE should include a TAU request message integrity protected using the EPS security context in the Registration Request and provide the GUAMI part of the native 5G-GUTI in RRC to enable the NG-RAN to route the Registration Request to the same AMF.

q_47247.question: What is required for a UE behind an RG to authenticate to the 5GC using NSWO procedure?
q_47247.ground_truth: The UE behind an RG can authenticate to the 5GC using NSWO procedure by first obtaining a local IP address after authenticating to the 5GC.

q_47248.question: What is the function of the MPTCP Proxy in the context of MPTCP in 3GPP 23.501?
q_47248.ground_truth: The MPTCP Proxy in the UPF is responsible for proxying TCP connection establishment and data exchange between an UE and a remote host for MPTCP traffic, using the mechanism specified in IETF RFC 8684 and RFC 8803.

q_47249.question: What should the transmission participant do upon receiving a MRE response message with the first bit in the subtype set to '1'?
q_47249.ground_truth: The transmission participant shall send a Transmission control Ack message including the Message Type field set to '3' and the Source field set to '0'.

q_47250.question: Which parameter would be set to 1 in the first location report and increment by 1 for each new report in a periodic LDR?

q_47251.question: What action does the MME take if it receives a Detach Request from the UE via a CSG cell with the cause indicating the UE is not allowed to access this CSG?
q_47251.ground_truth: If the UE receives Detach Request from the MME via a CSG cell with the cause indicating the UE is not allowed to access this CSG, the UE shall remove this CSG ID and associated PLMN from its Allowed CSG list, if present.

q_47252.question: What information does an initial SDP contain in a session-based messaging procedure?
q_47252.ground_truth: An initial SDP contains information such as the maximum message size the UE accepts to receive and the necessary details to establish a message session, such as the IP address and port numbers.

q_47253.question: What should an MME do if both the UE and network support discontinuous coverage?
q_47253.ground_truth: The MME should provide the Enhanced Discontinuous Coverage Support indication if both the UE and network support discontinuous coverage.

q_47254.question: What is the purpose of the CDMA2000 1xRTT Parameters in the CSFBParametersRequestCDMA2000 message and why does the UE need them?
q_47254.ground_truth: The CDMA2000 1xRTT Parameters in the CSFBParametersRequestCDMA2000 message are needed for the UE to generate the CDMA2000 1xRTT Registration message used to register with the CDMA2000 1xRTT Network which is required to support CSFB to CDMA2000 1xRTT.

q_47255.question: When should the AMF include the UE Radio Capability for Paging Information in the N2 Paging message?
q_47255.ground_truth: The AMF should include the UE Radio Capability for Paging Information in the N2 Paging message if it is available in the AMF for the UE.

q_47256.question: When are PRACH requirement tests applicable for PRACH formats in high-speed train scenarios?
q_47256.ground_truth: The PRACH requirement tests are applicable for each PRACH format declared to be supported for high-speed train scenarios.

q_47257.question: Why is candidate training device selection more complex in federated learning over wireless links as compared to federated learning in data centers?
q_47257.ground_truth: It is more complex due to the presence of other high priority and non-latency-tolerant data transmitted by the training devices, which affects their ability to upload locally trained models.

q_47258.question: What action does the 3GP-DASH client take when it requests Network Assistance during media segment download?
q_47258.ground_truth: The 3GP-DASH client sends a single SAND signaling exchange to the DANE, which activates either the rate recommendation function or a sequence of both functions, based on whether a delivery boost is needed or not.

q_47259.question: What should the UE do while waiting for the reporting criteria to be fulfilled in test 1 and 2?
q_47259.ground_truth: The UE should not send event triggered measurement reports.

q_47260.question: In a non-roaming scenario, what action should the SMF take after detecting a new interception for a UE is activated and the 5GSM state within the SMF for that UE is 5GSM: PDU SESSION ACTIVE or PDU SESSION MODIFICATION PENDING?
q_47260.ground_truth: The IRI-POI in the SMF generates an xIRI containing the SMFStartOfInterceptionWithEstablishedMAPDUSession record.

q_47261.question: What is one impact of this solution on the User Equipment (UE) for coexistence of MBS delivery and power saving mechanisms?
q_47261.ground_truth: The UE may need to handle potential wake-ups out of deep-sleep due to power-saving for MBMS user service sessions or data transfers.

q_47262.question: What should a floor participant do upon receiving a Floor Granted message in the 'O: has permission' state, when the User ID field matches its own MCPTT ID and the SSRC matches the stored SSRC of the current arbitrator?
q_47262.ground_truth: The floor participant should set the stored SSRC of the current arbitrator to its own SSRC, stop timer T203 and T201, clear the stored SSRC of the candidate arbitrator, and enter 'O: has permission' state.

q_47263.question: What protocol is used to transfer NRPPa PDUs between an LMF and an NG-RAN node?
q_47263.ground_truth: The NRPPa protocol is transparent to the AMF and is carried over the NG interface in either UE associated mode or non-UE associated mode.

q_47264.question: What should be set if contention based random-access resources are used in the random-access procedure and msgA-SubcarrierSpacing associated to the 2 step random-access resources is available?
q_47264.ground_truth: The msgA-SubcarrierSpacing associated to the 2 step random-access resources used in the random-access procedure should be set.

q_47265.question: What information does the signal generator send during the procedure and how is it used?
q_47265.ground_truth: The signal generator sends a test pattern, which is used to check the number of incorrectly decoded CQI and for two antenna ports, it is sent on the same PUCCH resource block with different channel indices.

q_47266.question: What is the minimum and maximum range of values for the ProSe Per-Packet Priority values for the /<x>/<x>/OffNetwork/DefaultPPPP element, as defined in section 6.2.36, 6.2.37, 6.2.38, 6.2.39, 6.2.41, 6.2.41A, and 6.2.41B elements?
q_47266.ground_truth: The minimum and maximum range of values for the ProSe Per-Packet Priority values is 1-8 or 21-26, 55-61, 90-93.

q_47267.question: What is the minimum requirement for an One-To-One-EmergencyAlert element in an MSR request?
q_47267.ground_truth: An One-To-One-EmergencyAlert element must contain at least one entry element.

q_47268.question: What do the constructions "must" and "must not" indicate in the present document?
q_47268.ground_truth: The constructions "must" and "must not" are not used in the present document, except in a direct citation from an external, referenced, non-3GPP document, or so as to maintain continuity of style when extending or modifying the provisions of such a referenced document.

q_47269.question: When is a MCPTT user considered to be in the "deactivating" state?
q_47269.ground_truth: A MCPTT user is in the "deactivating" state when they are no longer interested in using the functional alias, but it is still activated for their use.

q_47270.question: Who is responsible for distinguishing the charging information for H-CHF and V-CHF in the message flow?
q_47270.ground_truth: V-CHF is responsible for distinguishing the charging information for H-CHF and V-CHF in the message flow, determining the charging information for each party based on specific triggers.

q_47271.question: What should the mobile station do if it receives a LOCATION UPDATING REJECT message in UTRAN Iu mode and from a CSG cell with cause #25 (not authorized for this CSG)?
q_47271.ground_truth: The mobile station shall reset the location update attempt counter and set the update status to ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, storing it in the SIM/USIM.

q_47272.question: When should the UE store connection establishment failure information in the VarConnEstFailReport?
q_47272.ground_truth: The UE should store connection establishment failure information in the VarConnEstFailReport by setting its fields as follows if timer T300 expires and the UE is not a NB-IoT UE.

q_47273.question: What is the leaving condition for event H2 to be satisfied?
q_47273.ground_truth: The leaving condition for event H2 to be satisfied is when the inequality H2-2 is fulfilled, which means that the Aerial UE altitude relative to the sea level plus the hysteresis parameter Hys is greater than the threshold Thresh.

q_47274.question: What is the significance of the OPI value provided by RAN in the RAN Assistance Information?
q_47274.ground_truth: The OPI value provided by RAN is a bitmap used by UEs to determine when they should move certain traffic (e.g. certain IP flows) to WLAN access or to 3GPP access. The meaning of each bit in this bitmap is operator specific and may affect the validity of ANDSF rules and RAN rules. The user preferences on WLAN network selection and traffic routing shall take precedence over ANDSF rules and RAN rules.

q_47275.question: What will the MS do after storing the received location area identification and stopping timer T3330 if the ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message contains a TMSI?
q_47275.ground_truth: The MS will use the TMSI as new temporary identity, delete its old TMSI, store the new TMSI, and return an ROUTING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message to the network.

q_47276.question: What should the SEAF do if the verification of the RES* was not successful in the AUSF?
q_47276.ground_truth: The SEAF shall either reject the authentication or initiate an Identification procedure with the UE to retrieve the SUCI and make an additional authentication attempt.

q_47277.question: What step initiates the resource reservation process in the IMS session modification procedure after the final SDP message is sent between UE#1 and UE#2?
q_47277.ground_truth: Step 15 initiates the resource reservation process. UE#1 sends the offered SDP message to UE#2, including the SDP from step 17 if needed.

q_47278.question: What is the function of the S6b reference point in EPC networks?
q_47278.ground_truth: The S6b reference point in EPC networks is used for authenticating and authorizing the UE, updating the PDN-GW address to the 3GPP AAA server and HSS, retrieving and updating mobility-related parameters, indicating PDN-GW reallocation, downloading trace information to the PDN GW, and indicating HSS-based P-CSCF restoration procedure for WLAN.

q_47279.question: What should the PGW do when it detects a partial failure of a component?
q_47279.ground_truth: The PGW should perform implementation-specific operations to clean up any residual state associated with the CSID(s) and send the GTPv2 Delete PDN Connection Set Request (or PMIPv6 Binding Revocation Indication) message containing all the PGW FQ-CSID(s) of the component(s) failing to the SGW, ePDG or TWAN that support the feature.

q_47280.question: What is the feature in 5G TS 22.261 that enables member UEs of a 5G LAN-VN to use multicast/broadcast over a 5G LAN-type service to communicate with required latency (e.g. 180ms)?
q_47280.ground_truth: The 5G network shall enable member UEs of a 5G LAN-VN to use multicast/broadcast over a 5G LAN-type service to communicate with required latency.

q_47281.question: What are the general CMAF Track constraints for CMAF AMR in ISO/IEC 23000-19?
q_47281.ground_truth: The general CMAF Track constraints for CMAF AMR in ISO/IEC 23000-19 include conforming to clause 7.2.1 and conforming to the general CMAF Track constraints as well as the general audio track constraints defined in ISO/IEC 23000-19, clause 10.

q_47282.question: In the context of X2AP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION, what is the purpose of the S10-CSI-RS-Mapping EUTRA-CGI-List data type within ServedCell-Information?
q_47282.ground_truth: The S10-CSI-RS-Mapping EUTRA-CGI-List data type specifies the mapping between the CGI (cell Global Identity) and the corresponding SSB (synchronization sequence burst) positions in a CSI-RS (CSI resource set) burst.

q_47283.question: When is a security key update performed in the 5G system?
q_47283.ground_truth: A security key update is performed whenever there is a need to refresh the secondary key, e.g. upon change of MN with KgNB change or to avoid COUNT reuse.

q_47284.question: What is the testing applicability described in 6.2.2.2.1.3.2?
q_47284.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of NR UE release 16 and forward supporting NR/5GC and NR-U and supporting UL on shared channel access. It also applies to all types of EUTRA UE release 16 and forward supporting EN-DC and NR-U.

q_47285.question: What is the message that should be used for path failure detection for PFCP based Sxa/Sxb/Sxc interfaces?
q_47285.ground_truth: The message that should be used for path failure detection for PFCP based Sxa/Sxb/Sxc interfaces is the PFCP Heartbeat Request message.

q_47286.question: What shall the gNB-CU-CP, gNB-CU-UP, gNB-DU, and ng-eNB network elements support in terms of trace depth levels?
q_47286.ground_truth: At least one of the following trace depth levels: Maximum, Medium, or Minimum.

q_47287.question: How does a packet match a PDR in the UP function?
q_47287.ground_truth: A packet matches a PDR if all the match fields in the PDI are matching the corresponding packet header fields. If a match field is not included in the PDI, it matches all possible values in the packet header field. If a match field in a PDR has multiple instances, a packet matches this match field if any instance is matching the corresponding packet header field.

q_47288.question: What message should be sent by the S-NG-RAN node to the M-NG-RAN node to inform of one or more performed random access procedures at the S-NG-RAN, due to which one or more RA reports are available at the UE?
q_47288.ground_truth: The RACH INDICATION message should be sent by the S-NG-RAN node to the M-NG-RAN node to inform of one or more performed random access procedures at the S-NG-RAN, due to which one or more RA reports are available at the UE.

q_47289.question: What information is requested by the LMF in the E-CID Measurement Initiation Request message in the Uplink NR E-CID Positioning Procedures?
q_47289.ground_truth: The LMF requests NR E-CID measurement information from the serving gNB. The requested NR E-CID measurements are indicated in the E-CID Measurement Initiation Request message.

q_47290.question: What is the definition of the measurement reporting delay?
q_47290.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay is defined as the time between an event that will trigger a measurement report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface.

q_47291.question: What state does a Mobile Station (MS) transition to after receiving a successful combined GPRS attach message for GPRS and non-GPRS services?
q_47291.ground_truth: The MS transitions to state GMM-COMMON-PROCEDURE-INITIATED.

q_47292.question: What is the difference between the upper limit and the lower limit of the dynamic range in the context of the total power dynamic range for E-UTRA?
q_47292.ground_truth: The upper limit of the dynamic range at a RIB is the OFDM symbol power at maximum carrier EIRP when transmitting on all RBs, while the lower limit of the dynamic range at a RIB is the OFDM symbol power when one resource block is transmitted and no RS, PBCH or synchronization signals are contained in the same direction using the same beam.

q_47293.question: What information does the PCF take into account when performing session binding in 5G system?
q_47293.ground_truth: The PCF takes into account the following information when performing session binding in 5G system: For an IP type PDU Session, the UE IPv4 address and/or IPv6 prefix, For an Ethernet type PDU Session, the UE MAC address(es), The UE identity (e.g. SUPI), if present, and The information about the Data Network (DN) the user is accessing, i.e. DNN, if present.

q_47294.question: What information does the TSCTSF control the 5G access stratum time synchronization distribution with?
q_47294.ground_truth: The TSCTSF uses the Time Synchronization parameters as received from the AF to control the 5G access stratum time synchronization distribution.

q_47295.question: What should the receiving UM RLC entity do when t-Reordering expires, as specified in TS 36.322, clause 6.2.1.3?
q_47295.ground_truth: The receiving UM RLC entity updates VR(UR) to the SN of the first UMD PDU with SN >= VR(UX) that has not been received, reassembles RLC SDUs from any UMD PDUs with SN < updated VR(UR), removes RLC headers when doing so, and delivers the reassembled RLC SDUs to the upper layer in ascending order of the RLC SN if not delivered before. If VR(UH) > VR(UR), start t-Reordering and set VR(UX) to VR(UH).

q_47296.question: What subcounter is incremented by 1 for each failed SM policy authorization update?
q_47296.ground_truth: The relevant subcounter for the failure cause of the SM policy authorization update is incremented by 1 for each failed update.

q_47297.question: What does the P-NF need to do in order to authorize a UE as a PEGC?
q_47297.ground_truth: The P-NF needs to check if the UE supports PEGCF, assign an authorization to the UE as a PEGC, and distribute a PIN ID to identify the PIN.

q_47298.question: What are the two conditions for the UE to act upon a Registration Reject message containing an EMM cause indicating to the UE that it shall not use 5GC?
q_47298.ground_truth: The UE shall act upon such Registration Reject message only if received integrity protected and if the UE has verified the integrity of the message successfully.

q_47299.question: What are the conditions for selecting the same SMF for all PDU sessions to the same S-NSSAI and DNN?
q_47299.ground_truth: When the UDM indicates that interworking with EPS is supported, and optionally when the same SMF for all PDU sessions to the same S-NSSAI and DNN is required, and the selected SMF is able to support non-3GPP access path switching if required.

q_47300.question: What are the test requirements for 4Rx TDD FR1 periodic CQI reporting under AWGN conditions for both SA and NSA in the 5G NR TDD system?
q_47300.ground_truth: The pass/fail decision for this test is as specified in the test procedure in clause 6.2.3.2.1.1. There are no applicable test tolerances for this test since there are no parameters in the test setup or measurement process whose variation impacts the results.

q_47301.question: What should be the bandwidth used for additional E-UTRA carriers?
q_47301.ground_truth: The same bandwidth as the already allocated E-UTRA carriers should be used for additional E-UTRA carriers.

q_47302.question: What is the Transmission Indicator field used for in the Transmission Arbitration messages?
q_47302.ground_truth: The Transmission Indicator field in the Transmission Arbitration messages is used to indicate whether a transmission is being requested, released, or revoked, and is coded as specified in clause~9.2.3.11.

q_47303.question: What should a UE do if it receives ESM cause value #54 "PDN connection does not exist" and the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message was sent together with an ATTACH REQUEST, the ATTACH REJECT message is integrity protected, and the Back-off timer value IE is not included?
q_47303.ground_truth: The UE should set the request type to "initial request" in the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message which is included in the subsequent ATTACH REQUEST message to establish a PDN connectivity to the same APN.

q_47304.question: What is the objective of narrowband services as specified in the document?
q_47304.ground_truth: The objective of narrowband services is to provide a quality as close as possible to ITU-T standards for PSTN circuits, considering technical and economic factors that prevent full compliance with international telephone connection and circuit recommendations.

q_47305.question: Where can approved versions of all specifications be accessed?
q_47305.ground_truth: Approved versions of all specifications can be accessed on a file server, which allows anonymous access by any interested party.

q_47306.question: What is the role of aperiodic sidelink CSI reporting in SL unicast transmissions?
q_47306.ground_truth: Aperiodic sidelink CSI reporting in SL unicast transmissions is used to provide the Tx UE with information for sidelink link adaptation and rank adaptation. The reported values are calculated based on sidelink CSI-RS from the Tx UE, which are a simplified subset of the Uu CSI-RS design.

q_47307.question: In which clause of 3A are inter-frequency and inter-RAT test cases performed without frequency overlapping between cells?
q_47307.ground_truth: In clause 3A.1, inter-frequency and inter-RAT test cases are performed without frequency overlapping between cells.

q_47308.question: When should the UE stop logging SIP signalling?
q_47308.ground_truth: The UE should stop logging SIP signalling if a stop trigger event has occurred. If a stop trigger event has not occurred, the UE should continue logging the request or response.

q_47309.question: What is the first action taken by the AS upon receiving a SIP INVITE from the S-CSCF when acting as a voice mail server?
q_47309.ground_truth: AS sends a SIP 200 OK to acknowledge the initiated Voice Mail session.

q_47310.question: In the described procedure, what is the TWAN, and what role does it play in the communication process between the UE and the PDN GW?
q_47310.ground_truth: The TWAN (Trusted WLAN Access Network) is a network component responsible for managing access and data communication between the UE (User Equipment) and the PDN GW (PDN Gateway) in the IP-CAN (IP-based Connectivity Access Network) network. The TWAN handles WLAN access, establishes secure tunnels, and assists in user plane data transmission.

q_47311.question: How does the gNB mark congestion in the downlink when it is detected in the network?
q_47311.ground_truth: The gNB can translate congestion into ECN marks and set them immediately in the PDU IP header or in the PDCP or RLC header to be carried further over options 4, 5 or 6.

q_47312.question: What is the required accuracy for RSRP and RSRQ measurements for all measured cells?
q_47312.ground_truth: The RSRP measurement accuracy for all measured cells shall be as specified in 3GPP TS 36.133 Clauses 9.1.3.1 and 9.1.3.2, and the RSRQ measurement accuracy for all measured cells shall be as specified in 3GPP TS 36.133 Clauses 9.1.6.1 and 9.1.6.2.

q_47313.question: Which mode does a UE have to support if it indicates support for "subframeResourceResvUL-CE-ModeA-r16" or "subframeResourceResvDL-CE-ModeA-r16"?
q_47313.ground_truth: A UE indicating support of "subframeResourceResvUL-CE-ModeA-r16" or "subframeResourceResvDL-CE-ModeA-r16" has to support coverage enhancement mode A.

q_47314.question: What happens after UE#1 receives the 200-OK final response in step 22?
q_47314.ground_truth: After UE#1 receives the 200-OK final response in step 22, UE#1 sends a 200-OK final response to UE#2, and UE#2 clears the original session with UE#1 by sending the BYE message. UE#1 then acknowledges the BYE and terminates the original session.

q_47315.question: What information does the P-CSCF convey to the PCRF/PCF when using priority sharing for concurrent sessions?
q_47315.ground_truth: The P-CSCF conveys the priority sharing indicator and, when available, the pre-emption control information to the PCRF/PCF, in addition to the application identifier and service priority.

q_47316.question: What is the QoS level of the SIP 200 (OK) response associated with the outgoing SIP message for a pre-established session?
q_47316.ground_truth: The QoS level of the SIP 200 (OK) response associated with the outgoing SIP message for a pre-established session is "a high QoS level" as specified in 3GPP TS 24.229.

q_47317.question: What is the role of the NEF in the SMF-NEF connection establishment procedure for MBS?
q_47317.ground_truth: The NEF receives the UE address, i.e. IP address, from the SMF during the SMF-NEF connection establishment procedure and changes the NIDD information in the request to the NEF to MBS information with the same content, i.e. GPSI, AF ID, and additional UE address.

q_47318.question: What does the id-CriticalityDiagnostics field indicate in PositioningActivationResponseIEs and F1AP-Protocol-IES?
