q_47562.ground_truth: A FeasibilityCheckAndReservationJob represents a feasibility check and reservation job for network slicing related requirements to determine whether the network slicing related requirements can be satisfied. The IOC can be used to express a feasibility check and reservation job requirement for the specified network slicing related requirements (i.e. ServiceProfile, SliceProfile) and to represent the consumer's requirements for resource reservation for corresponding network slicing related requirements.

q_47563.question: What is the format of the label that the UE derives from the IMSI to identify the Provisioning GANC when the U()SIM is not provisioned with the FQDN or IP address of the Provisioning GANC?
q_47563.ground_truth: The UE derives the FQDN for the Provisioning GANC by creating a domain name as specified in 17.3.1 and adding the label "pganc." to the beginning of the domain name.

q_47564.question: What should be the initial conditions for the system simulator in this test execution?
q_47564.ground_truth: System information combination 10 as defined in TS 36.508 clause 4.4.3.1 is used in E-UTRA cells, and the pre-test conditions apply to Cell 1, Cell 5, and Cell 24.

q_47565.question: What is the procedure for the UE-to-UE Relay Discovery Key Request in Model B?
q_47565.ground_truth: In Model B, the UE-to-UE Relay initiates the procedure by sending a Relay Discovery Key Request message containing its User Info ID and Relay Service Code (RSC) to its 5G DDNMF to get associated security materials. Then, the 5G DDNMF returns the Code Security Parameters along with the chosen PC5 ciphering algorithm to the UE-to-UE Relay.

q_47566.question: What should the UE do when it detects the release of the NAS signalling connection and has sent a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message with EPS update type set to 'Periodic updating' and the tracking area updating attempt counter set to a value less than four, where the TAI of the current serving cell is included in the TAI list and the update status is equal to EU1 UPDATED?
q_47566.ground_truth: The UE should keep the update status to EU1 UPDATED, enter state EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE and start timer T3411.

q_47567.question: What shall the network do after receiving an ATTACH COMPLETE message?
q_47567.ground_truth: The network stops timer T3350 and changes to state GMM-REGISTERED.

q_47568.question: What is the purpose of the test in section 8.4.2.5 of the document?
q_47568.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify the UE's ability to make a correct reporting of an event without SSB time index detection in non-DRX within E-UTRA - NR FR2 cell search requirements.

q_47569.question: What message does the target SGSN send to the source MME after receiving both the CS relocation/handover request with the PS relocation/handover request?
q_47569.ground_truth: The target SGSN sends a Forward Relocation Response (Target to Source Transparent Container) message to the source MME after receiving both the CS relocation/handover request with the PS relocation/handover request.

q_47570.question: What action should the PCF take when requesting the SMF to report accumulated usage for one or more enabled usage monitoring control instances?
q_47570.ground_truth: The PCF should include the "lastReqUsageData" attribute within an HTTP POST request or response, specifying one or more reference(s) to the usage monitoring data decision(s) within the "refUmIds" attribute or setting the "allUmIds" attribute to true.

q_47571.question: What does Bit 1 in Octet 5 of the CSG Information Reporting Action indicate when set to "1"?
q_47571.ground_truth: It indicates to start reporting User CSG Info when the UE enters/leaves/access through the CSG Cell.

q_47572.question: What is the purpose of the service request procedure in LTE?
q_47572.ground_truth: The purpose of the service request procedure in LTE is to transfer the EMM mode from EMM-IDLE to EMM-CONNECTED mode and establish the radio and S1 bearers when uplink user data or signalling is to be sent.

q_47573.question: What measures should be taken in case the 5G-SRVCC handover from NG-RAN to UTRAN has not been completed successfully and the MS has derived a new UMTS security context for the CS domain?
q_47573.ground_truth: The MS and the network should delete the new derived UMTS security context for the CS domain, and the network should also delete the already established UMTS security context for the CS domain if the CKSN is equal.

q_47574.question: What should the UE not transmit or receive during the measurement of SSB indexes or periodic/semi-persistent/aperiodic CSI-RS resources for L1-RSRP measurement in FR2-2, when using 480 kHz SCS or 960 kHz SCS?
q_47574.ground_truth: PUCCH/PUSCH/SRS or PDCCH/PDSCH/CSI-RS for tracking/CSI-RS for CQI on the corresponding symbols.

q_47575.question: What action triggers the generation of the Debit Units and Reserve Units Request message for MMS online charging?
q_47575.ground_truth: The Debit Units and Reserve Units Request message is generated when the MMS R/S generates Debit / Reserve Units information that can be transferred from the CTF to the OCF for MMS online charging.

q_47576.question: What is the purpose of the "Reset" message in the passed passage?
q_47576.ground_truth: The "Reset" message is used to reset the NAS signaling connection with the UE, and it can be used to reset all or part of the E1 interface connections associated with a UE.

q_47577.question: What is the EVM equalizer spectrum flatness requirement for PUSCH in regard to the V2X sidelink physical channels PSCCH, PSSCH and PSBCH?
q_47577.ground_truth: The EVM equalizer spectrum flatness requirements for PUSCH shall be as specified for PUSCH in clause 6.4.2.4 for the corresponding modulation and transmission bandwidth.

q_47578.question: In the test requirement section, what is the maximum repetition period of relevant system info blocks that needs to be received by the UE to camp on a cell in this test case?

q_47579.question: What is the first step when an MCVideo call is released by the transmission control server?
q_47579.ground_truth: The first step is that the MCVideo server stops sending transmission control messages and RTP media packets to all transmission participants in the MCVideo call.

q_47580.question: What does the pdcp-DuplicationSplitSRB and pdcp-DuplicationSplitDRB fields represent in the PDCP-ParametersMRDC information element?
q_47580.ground_truth: These fields represent the support for PDCP duplication and splitting for source and/or DRB RLCs in MRDC.

q_47581.question: How does the ProSe 5G UE-to-UE Relay operation support Layer-3 UE-to-UE Relay based on IP routing?
q_47581.ground_truth: The ProSe 5G UE-to-UE Relay operation supports Layer-3 UE-to-UE Relay based on IP routing by allowing authorized UEs to act as relays, announcing their availability for serving other UEs, and establishing unicast L2 links for communication between UEs.

q_47582.question: Why are the conducted and radiated requirements tested separately in clause 6.5A.3.1.2?
q_47582.ground_truth: The requirements are tested separately due to issues with combined testing of NR FR1 conducted mode with NR FR2 in radiated mode.

q_47583.question: What is the public user identity that the UE uses in all REGISTER requests when GPRS-IMS-Bundled authentication is used for registration, regardless of the available implicitly registered IMPUs?
q_47583.ground_truth: The UE uses the temporary IMPU as the public user identity in all REGISTER requests when GPRS-IMS-Bundled authentication is used for registration.

q_47584.question: What is the minimum number of successful tests required for the test to pass?
q_47584.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the total number of successful tests should be more than 90% of the cases with a confidence level of 95%.

q_47585.question: What is evaluated to check compliance with the requirements for desktop hands-free UE receiving in TS 26.132?
q_47585.ground_truth: The relevant test described in TS 26.132.

q_47586.question: What action is taken by the LLC sublayer when the LLGMM-SUSPEND-REQ service primitive is issued?
q_47586.ground_truth: When the LLC sublayer receives the LLGMM-SUSPEND-REQ service primitive, all the LLC links will cease sending PDUs. The parameter page indicates that data shall be sent if available and therefore paging shall be needed, or the cause indicates that data shall not be sent until a RESUME-REQ is received.

q_47587.question: What is the function of an aggregator NWDAF in a multiple NWDAF deployment scenario?
q_47587.ground_truth: An aggregator NWDAF is an NWDAF instance with additional capabilities to aggregate output analytics provided by other NWDAFs. It can divide an area of interest into sub-areas and send analytics requests to corresponding NWDAFs based on their supported analytics areas and capabilities.

q_47588.question: When is the "split bearer" alternative used in Dual Connectivity?
q_47588.ground_truth: The "split bearer" alternative is used in Dual Connectivity when the U-plane termination point is changed in the E-UTRAN by means of S1-MME signalling without changing the S1-MME termination point.

q_47589.question: What message does the DN-AAA send to the SMF+PGW-C to initiate the PDU session establishment procedure when the DN-AAA is responsible for IP address allocation?
q_47589.ground_truth: The DN-AAA sends the Access-Accept message to the SMF+PGW-C to initiate the PDU session establishment procedure when the DN-AAA is responsible for IP address allocation.

q_47590.question: How does the "CDRX change" trigger condition be set in RAN?
q_47590.ground_truth: The "CDRX change" trigger condition can be set in RAN by using an N2 message sent from AMF to RAN, indicating the conditions for RAN to inform AMF of a CDRX change.

q_47591.question: Under which condition do the multi-slot PUCCH requirement tests apply?
q_47591.ground_truth: The multi-slot PUCCH requirement tests apply only if the base station (BS) supports it.

q_47592.question: What was the largest percentage increase in beam prediction accuracy for a 320ms prediction time, as reported by the evaluation results from 7 sources?
q_47592.ground_truth: The largest percentage increase in beam prediction accuracy for a 320ms prediction time was 8%.

q_47593.question: What are the steps to produce a 3D mesh in a production facility using stereo cameras?
q_47593.ground_truth: The steps are: capturing the scene using an array of cameras, performing keying to segment foreground and background, generating depth information using a depth estimator for each stereo pair, merging depth information using a 3D fusion process, filtering out occluded 3D points to obtain advanced foreground segmentation, and performing post-processing of the 3D point cloud to obtain a simplified textured mesh.

q_47594.question: What is the UE's minimum requirement for the number of ACK/NACK transmissions during the identification of a new CGI of E-UTRA cell when no DRX is used?
q_47594.ground_truth: The UE shall have more than 60 ACK/NACKs transmitted during the identification of a new CGI of E-UTRA cell when no DRX is used.

q_47595.question: What action should the MCData client take if the in-progress emergency private priority state cancel request is rejected?
q_47595.ground_truth: The state of the session will continue with MCData emergency private communication level priority.

q_47596.question: What is the requirement for a UE when performing search and reselection to an inter-frequency CSG cell that has met the reselection criterion and is in its allow-list?
q_47596.ground_truth: The UE should perform this search and reselection within 6 minutes in the specified conditions.

q_47597.question: What should the E-CSCF convey towards the MGCF if a Geolocation header field is present in the request?
q_47597.ground_truth: The E-CSCF should convey the Geolocation header field towards the MGCF if it is present in the request.

q_47598.question: What is the purpose of including the "ReportDiversionPASSporTInfo" parameter in the ActivateTask message of an IMS session that is later redirected?
q_47598.ground_truth: The purpose is to identify whether the "div" PASSporT information needs to be reported to certain Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs) for the redirected IMS session.

q_47599.question: What message is sent by the network to indicate the activation of a PDP context?
q_47599.ground_truth: The "Activate PDP context accept" message is sent by the network to indicate the activation of a PDP context.

q_47600.question: What does "P* rated,c,TABC" represent in the context of SAN satellite access nodes?
q_47600.ground_truth: "P* rated,c,TABC" represents the rated carrier output power per TAB connector for a single carrier of the SAN satellite access node.

q_47601.question: What message is sent by the BM-SC to the Content Provider if the requested service or session is not found?
q_47601.ground_truth: A 404 Not Found message is sent to the Content Provider in this case.

q_47602.question: What should the MCVideo client do when it is in the "P3: waiting for release response" state and timer TFP3 expires with a maximum number of retransmissions reached?
q_47602.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should terminate the media session, start timer TFP7, and enter the "P1: ignoring same call id" state.

q_47603.question: What is the property of "non-overlapping" Segments and Subsegments used for in 3GPP-DASH?
q_47603.ground_truth: The property of "non-overlapping" Segments (respectively Subsegments) is used to define the terms Segment alignment and Subsegment alignment in 3GPP-DASH.

q_47604.question: When is the NSAG information deleted by the UE?
q_47604.ground_truth: The NSAG information is deleted by the UE when the UE is switched off or when the UE is deregistered from the registered PLMN or the registered SNPN.

q_47605.question: What should be done if the trigger type is set to event, the event includes a numberOfTriggeringCells, and the event's entry condition is fulfilled for one or more applicable cells for all measurements after layer 3 filtering?
q_47605.ground_truth: If the number of cells in the cellsTriggeredList is larger than or equal to numberOfTriggeringCells, include the concerned cells in the cellsTriggeredList. If not, initiate the measurement reporting procedure and include the concerned cells in the cellsTriggeredList.

q_47606.question: Which type name is the PDU Session context type representation?

q_47607.question: What is the definition of QoE and QoS in the context of the present document?
q_47607.ground_truth: QoE (Quality of Experience) refers to the overall performance of a service as experienced by the user, and QoS (Quality of Service) refers to the technical requirements and capabilities that enable the delivery of a service to meet the user's expectations.

q_47608.question: What kind of notification delivery methods are used in the enhanced architecture for Edge Application?
q_47608.ground_truth: The notification delivery methods for Edge Application include Long-polling, WebSocket, FCM, APNS, and OMA Push. These methods allow for flexible notifications delivery to EEC.

q_47609.question: What should the UE include in the supportedBandCombination when it supports more MIMO layers with TM9 and TM10 than implied by the UE category and at least one of the non-CA bands is part of the requestedFrequencyBands?
q_47609.ground_truth: The UE should include all non-CA bands, all 2DL+1UL CA band combinations, and all other CA band combinations that consist of bands included in requestedFrequencyBands, while prioritizing band combinations containing the first-listed band, then the second-listed band, and so on.

q_47610.question: What should the SCC AS do if the SIP INVITE request due to STN-SR is received with a P-Early-Media header field containing the "supported" parameter and the remote UE has already provided a P-Early-Media header field with the "supported" parameter in the current dialog?
q_47610.ground_truth: The SCC AS should include a P-Early-Media header field containing the value of the last P-Early-Media header field received in a SIP message in the dialog of the SIP PRACK request if the SIP 1xx response is received, or in the SIP UPDATE request or SIP re-INVITE request if the SIP 2xx response is received.

q_47611.question: What does the "Call setup time" metric measure on SIP level?
q_47611.ground_truth: The "Call setup time" metric is the time between the transmitted INVITE, and the reception of either "200 OK" or "180 RINGING" (whichever comes first).

q_47612.question: Which method is used to retrieve location information in the PS domain from all nodes (AMF, MME and SGSN)?
q_47612.ground_truth: The GET method with the "requested-nodes" query parameter not included will retrieve location information in the PS domain from all nodes (AMF, MME and SGSN).

q_47613.question: What does the acronym "3GPP" stand for in the document's title?

q_47614.question: What is the purpose of the monitoring UE procedure for relay discovery additional information in 5G ProSe?
q_47614.ground_truth: The purpose of the monitoring UE procedure for relay discovery additional information is to enable a 5G ProSe remote UE to become aware of the additional information of the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE.

q_47615.question: What action does the MME take if the UE requested PDN connectivity in the attach request and the MME supports EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection, but the attach type is not "EPS emergency attach" or "EPS RLOS attach"?
q_47615.ground_truth: The MME sends the ATTACH ACCEPT message together with an ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message contained in the ESM message container information element to activate the default bearer.

q_47616.question: What should the P-CSCF do when it receives an initial request for a dialog or a request for a standalone transaction from a UE that is not considered as privileged sender?
q_47616.ground_truth: When the P-CSCF receives an initial request for a dialog or a request for a standalone transaction from a UE that is not considered as privileged sender, it identifies the originator and served user of the request by the default public user identity.

q_47617.question: What does Solution 28: MBS service de-announcement focus on?
q_47617.ground_truth: Solution 28: MBS service de-announcement focuses on the MBS session being no longer used and the MC service client is informed with the MBS session de-announcement. This allows the MC client UE to stop monitoring the broadcast MBS session or leave the multicast MBS session, promoting efficient usage of network resources.

q_47618.question: What should be done if an MCData user is already in the MCData emergency state and initiates an MCData emergency group communication?
q_47618.ground_truth: All group communications initiated by the MCData user while in the MCData emergency state will be MCData emergency group communications.

q_47619.question: What is the measurement provided by GTP.InDataPktN19PsaUpf and GTP.InDataPktN19PsaUpf.SNSSAI?
q_47619.ground_truth: The number of GTP data PDUs received on the N19 interface by the PSA UPF, optionally split into subcounters per S-NSSAI.

q_47620.question: In what circumstances would the UE receive EMM cause #25?
q_47620.ground_truth: EMM cause #25 is received when the UE tries to attach to a CSG cell that it is not authorized to access.

q_47621.question: What information does the SMF include in the N2 SM information when providing MBS session information to the NG-RAN nodes?
q_47621.ground_truth: The SMF includes the MBS service area and Area Session ID in the N2 SM information when providing MBS session information to the NG-RAN nodes.

q_47622.question: What is the main purpose of IABTC4 in the context of NR IAB testing?
q_47622.ground_truth: IABTC4 is used to test beams which have been generated using transceiver units supporting operation in multiple operating bands through common active RF components, considering the maximum supported number of carriers.

q_47623.question: What is the request type for a SIP MESSAGE targeting the non-controlling MCVideo function of an MCVideo group, with the isfocus media feature tag not included in the Contact header field?
q_47623.ground_truth: A SIP INVITE request from participating MCVideo function for non-controlling MCVideo function of an MCVideo group

q_47624.question: What are the three types of information elements in analytics outputs?
q_47624.ground_truth: The three types of information elements in analytics outputs are common information elements that can be generated by MDA and be applicable for all MDA capabilities, capability-specific information elements, and optionally, vendor-specific extensions.

q_47625.question: What is the purpose of the spurious response test for shared spectrum channel access as specified in sub-clause 7.7F.1.1?
q_47625.ground_truth: The spurious response test verifies the ability of the UE that supports shared spectrum channel access to receive a wanted signal on its assigned channel frequency without exceeding a given degradation due to the presence of an unwanted CW interfering signal at any other frequency at which a response is obtained.

q_47626.question: What information is included in a UE-level request for the UPF event exposure service?
q_47626.ground_truth: The UE IP address, UE ID, PDU session ID, and QFI are included in a UE-level request for the UPF event exposure service.

q_47627.question: What is the purpose of the load balancing mechanism in the context of the load control feature?
q_47627.ground_truth: The purpose of load balancing is to effectively distribute the load amongst nodes, preventing any single node from being overloaded while ensuring that other nodes do not operate near their maximum capacity.

q_47628.question: What data is included in the "QosMonitoringData" instances generated by the PCF if the "EnQoSMon" feature is supported?
q_47628.ground_truth: The "QosMonitoringData" instances include the indication of the type of QoS monitoring parameter (e.g. packet delay or congestion information or data rate), the requested QoS monitoring parameter(s) to be measured (i.e. DL/UL round trip packet delay or, if the "EnQoSMon" feature is supported, UL/DL congestion information or UL/DL data rate), and the frequency(s) of reporting (e.g. event triggered and/or periodic).

q_47629.question: What is the channel raster for category NB1 and NB2 in-band, guard-band and standalone operation?
q_47629.ground_truth: Channel raster for category NB1 and NB2 is 100 kHz.

q_47630.question: What is the CGI reporting scheduling restriction when a RedCap UE is identifying the CGI of an NR cell with autonomous gaps?
q_47630.ground_truth: When a RedCap UE is identifying the CGI of an NR cell with autonomous gaps, the UE is not expected to transmit or receive specific signal types during certain time periods related to MIB and SIB1 decoding.

q_47631.question: What information should be included in the COMMUNICATION RELEASE message sent by the MCData client?
q_47631.ground_truth: The COMMUNICATION RELEASE message sent by the MCData client should include a Content-Disposition header field set to "Info-Package" value and an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body with a COMMUNICATION RELEASE message.

q_47632.question: What should the eNodeB do when it decides to initiate an Inter-RAT handover to the UTRAN Iu mode?
q_47632.ground_truth: The eNodeB sends a Handover Required message to the MME with the necessary details for the handover.

q_47633.question: What are the three types of interfaces specified in the present NDS document?
q_47633.ground_truth: The Za interface, which is the interface between SEGs belonging to different networks/security domains (a Za interface may be an intra or an inter operator interface), the Zb interface, which is the interface between SEGs and NEs and interface between NEs within the same network/security domain, and the Za-interface between two security domains of the same operator.

q_47634.question: What entity forwards the INVITE message containing the added media to the destination UE in the IMS session modification procedure?
q_47634.ground_truth: P-CSCF#2 forwards the INVITE message to UE#2.

q_47635.question: What does the acronym NOA stand for in the diameter header message?

q_47636.question: What action should the receiver take when it receives overload control information with a more recent sequence number?
q_47636.ground_truth: The receiver should overwrite the stored overload control information with the newly received information.

q_47637.question: What are the minimum performance requirements for the downlink physical channels specified in Annex C.3.2 in section 9.5.1.1-2, 9.5.1.2-2, 9.5.2.1-2, and 9.5.2.2-2?
q_47637.ground_truth: The minimum performance requirements for the downlink physical channels specified in Annex C.3.2 are defined in section 9.5.1.1-2, 9.5.1.2-2, 9.5.2.1-2, and 9.5.2.2-2 as the ratio of the throughput obtained based on UE reported RI and that obtained with fixed rank 1 or rank 2 transmissions.

q_47638.question: What is the PRACH transmission time for the E-UTRAN TDD-FDD inter frequency handover test case after the start of time period T3?
q_47638.ground_truth: If the UE transmits the uplink PRACH to Cell 2 less than 50 ms from the beginning of time period T3, then the test is considered successful.

q_47639.question: What condition must be met for the event "Deactivation" to be counted as a success in the FDD PCell case?
q_47639.ground_truth: The PCell and SCells must be intra-band or inter-band with at most 2 non-consecutive DTX subframes outside the specified ranges.

q_47640.question: What should a receiving node do when it receives a message that is missing an IE/IE group with specified criticality "Reject IE"?
q_47640.ground_truth: The receiving node should reject the procedure and report the missing IEs/IE groups using the message normally used to report unsuccessful outcome of the procedure.

q_47641.question: What is not allowed for a UE, whether it has an ongoing IMS session or not, when it comes to transferring the PDN connection providing access to IMS between EPC via non-3GPP access and 5GCN via NG-RAN?
q_47641.ground_truth: If the value of a certain leaf is set to 2, the UE is not allowed to transfer the PDN connection providing access to IMS between EPC via non-3GPP access and 5GCN via NG-RAN.

q_47642.question: What is the security requirement for securing groupcast mode 5G ProSe Direct Communication?
q_47642.ground_truth: There are no requirements for securing the groupcast mode 5G ProSe Direct Communication, but the 5G System shall protect against linkability and trackability attacks on Layer-2 ID and IP address for groupcast mode.

q_47643.question: What is the outcome for the AMF if the originally requested network slice is overloaded or not available and a compatible S-NSSAI is included in the PDU Session Establishment Request message?
q_47643.ground_truth: If the originally requested network slice is overloaded or not available and a compatible S-NSSAI is included in the PDU Session Establishment Request message, the AMF selects an SMF based on the compatible S-NSSAI and continues the PDU Session establishment procedure on the compatible S-NSSAI instead of the originally requested S-NSSAI.

q_47644.question: What is the difference between rated beam EIRP and rated carrier output power in the context of SAN?
q_47644.ground_truth: Rated beam EIRP is the maximum power that the SAN is declared to radiate at the beam peak direction in a particular operating band. The rated carrier output power is the mean power level that the manufacturer has declared to be available for a particular carrier at the RIB during the transmitter ON period.

q_47645.question: What is the requirement for L1-SINR measurement when CSI-RS is used as CMR and CSI-IM as IMR?
q_47645.ground_truth: The number of CSI-RS resources in the resource set for CMR and the number of CSI-IM resources in the resource set for IMR should be the same.

q_47646.question: In what mode is the UE required to perform a detach procedure and then PLMN selection triggered by ProSe direct communication, if it is in EMM-CONNECTED mode and the conditions for sidelink communication are met?
q_47646.ground_truth: The UE is required to perform a detach procedure as specified in 3GPP TS 24.301 and then PLMN selection triggered by ProSe direct communication as specified in 3GPP TS 23.122.

q_47647.question: What is the time duration required for a cell to be considered known in the context of RRC re-establishment for CEModeB?
q_47647.ground_truth: A cell is considered known in the context of RRC re-establishment for CEModeB if it has been meeting the relevant cell identification requirement for a time duration equal to or longer than the time duration required for the cell identification.

q_47648.question: What is the role of ProSe Function of the HPLMN in Proximity-based Services (ProSe)?
q_47648.ground_truth: The ProSe Function of the HPLMN is responsible for obtaining and merging the service authorization for ProSe direct discovery and ProSe direct communication from the UE and the ProSe Function of each local PLMN or VPLMN. It then sends the merged service authorization to the UE. The ProSe Function of the HPLMN also provides the service authorization for ProSe direct discovery and ProSe direct communication for Public Safety UE, indicating the required radio parameters to be used and the ProSe UE-to-network relay related parameters.

q_47649.question: What is the Inter RAT information container, and what is its minimum and maximum length?
q_47649.ground_truth: The Inter RAT information container is an information element that supplies the network with Iu mode related information that needs to be transferred at PS inter-system handover to Iu mode. It has a minimum length of 3 octets and a maximum length of 250 octets.

q_47650.question: What should the UE be capable of, in terms of detecting and measuring inter-frequency RSTD, as specified in Section 8.1.2.6.1?
q_47650.ground_truth: The UE should be capable of detecting and measuring inter-frequency RSTD for at least 16 cells, including the reference cell, within a certain time period as specified in Section 8.1.2.6.1.

q_47651.question: What message does the UE send to the LMF in a REGISTER message to cancel an ongoing periodic or triggered location procedure in 3GPP TS 24.080?

q_47652.question: What are the conditions for performing CSI-RS measurement with restrictions for FR1?
q_47652.ground_truth: The UE shall be able to perform CSI-RS measurement with restrictions if the SSB for RLM, BFD, CBD, or L1-RSRP measurement is within the active BWP and has different SCS than CSI-RS for RLM, unless the UE supports simultaneousRxDataSSB-DiffNumerology.

q_47653.question: What is the role of the PAnF within the 5GC?
q_47653.ground_truth: The PAnF is the network entity in the 5G Core Network (5GC) that supports security procedures over the Control Plane for the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network relay and 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay as specified in 3GPP~TS~33.503.

q_47654.question: How many consecutive PUSCH transmissions are measured to verify that the transmitted PUSCH power is maintained within the required 21ms transmissions?
q_47654.ground_truth: The power of 5 consecutive PUSCH transmissions is measured to verify that the transmitted PUSCH power is maintained within the required 21ms transmissions.

q_47655.question: What is the frequency range to be tested for E-UTRA FDD?

q_47656.question: What is the purpose of the '<actions>' element with an empty value in a matching rule?
q_47656.ground_truth: The purpose of the '<actions>' element with an empty value in a matching rule is to abandon the rest of the rules and continue with the terminating procedures, which can be used to avoid that a communication diversion based on multiple media conditions is diverted by a later rule with only one of these media conditions.

q_47657.question: What should the VAE-S include in the HTTP 200 (OK) response message, if the local service information is successfully determined?
q_47657.ground_truth: A <local-service-info-content> element which provides the local service information to the VAE-C

q_47658.question: What are the conditions for sending a Floor Taken message to any non-controlling MCPTT functions in the 'Start-stop' state when Timer T11 (End of RTP dual) or Timer T12 (Stop talking dual) expires in the 'D: Floor Taken' state?
q_47658.ground_truth: A Floor Taken message is sent to any non-controlling MCPTT functions when the state in the 'general floor control operation' state machine is 'G: Taken' and the session is a temporary group session involving non-controlling MCPTT functions, and the permitted floor participant is an MCPTT floor participant. If the state in the 'general floor control operation' state machine is 'G: Idle', a Floor Idle message is sent to all MCPTT floor participants.

q_47659.question: What is the purpose of the N2InfoNotify service operation in the AMF planned removal procedure with UDSF deployed?
q_47659.ground_truth: The N2InfoNotify service operation is used by an initial AMF to forward uplink N2 signaling to the target AMF in the AMF planned removal procedure with UDSF deployed.

q_47660.question: What is the purpose of the procedure for CN-initiated selective deactivation of UP connection of an existing PDU Session?
q_47660.ground_truth: The procedure aims to deactivate the UP connection of an established PDU Session of a UE in CM-CONNECTED state.

q_47661.question: When is the start of T3 in clause 16.6.5.3.4?
q_47661.ground_truth: The start of T3 is the instant when the last TTI containing the RRC message implying SI reading is sent to the UE in clause 16.6.5.3.4.

q_47662.question: In step 6 of the test procedure given in clause 17.6.1.4.4.2, what values determine the success or failure of the test?
q_47662.ground_truth: In step 6 of the test procedure, the UE performs transmits a MeasurementReport message triggered by Event A3. The delays measured from T2's beginning are compared to X ms for Test 1 or Y ms for Test 2. If the delay is less than X or Y ms, the number of successful tests is increased by one. If the UE fails to report the event within the required delay, the number of failure tests is increased by one.

q_47663.question: What is the purpose of the off-network dynamic group information update procedure?
q_47663.ground_truth: The purpose of the off-network dynamic group information update procedure is to update dynamic group information of an off-network V2X dynamic group.

q_47664.question: What is the initial condition for the test described in section 6.2.7.4.1?
q_47664.ground_truth: The initial condition for the test described in section 6.2.7.4.1 is the normal test environment, AWGN model, and a 10 MHz channel bandwidth for both PCell and SCell.

q_47665.question: What does L1 stand for in the 7.3.22.3 minimum conformance requirement?
q_47665.ground_truth: In the 7.3.22.3 minimum conformance requirement, L1 refers to the first layer of the UE's protocol stack, responsible for modulation, demodulation, and error correction.

q_47666.question: What information is provided in the Announcer Info parameter in the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay Discovery Announcement message?
q_47666.ground_truth: The Announcer Info parameter provides information about the announcing user in the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay Discovery Announcement message.

q_47667.question: What is the primary concern for operators regarding resiliency of public networks?
q_47667.ground_truth: Operators are concerned with resiliency of public networks under national regulations or other operational constraints.

q_47668.question: What is the purpose of the HSS/AAA initiated detach procedure in WLAN on S2a?
q_47668.ground_truth: The HSS/AAA initiated detach procedure in WLAN on S2a is used to detach a specific UE from the network, and it is applicable to the transparent single-connection mode, single-connection mode, Non-Roaming, Home Routed Roaming, and Local Breakout cases.

q_47669.question: What is the solution for QBC and FBC common PDU session level triggers?
q_47669.ground_truth: The QBC triggers and FBC triggers share PDU session level triggers, this means that there is one common PDU session level trigger for both QBC and FBC in the solution.

q_47670.question: What are the new inputs for the Analytics IDs "DN Performance" and "Observed Service Experience" in 5G systems for AI/ML operation?
q_47670.ground_truth: The new inputs for the Analytics IDs "DN Performance" and "Observed Service Experience" in 5G systems for AI/ML operation are the end-to-end network performance data between each pair of AI/ML processing entities in two adjacent layers.

q_47671.question: What message is sent to transfer access and mobility related information to another NG-RAN node?

q_47672.question: What network entities receive Trace Requirements about a UE from the UDM?
q_47672.ground_truth: The AMF, the 5G-AN, the AUSF, and the PCF

q_47673.question: What is the effect of the uplink power control window in the test procedure?
q_47673.ground_truth: The uplink power control window is used in the test procedure to ensure that the actual UE output power is no less than the target power level, and as close as possible to the target power level.

q_47674.question: What should the NF Service Consumer include in HTTP PUT or POST requests to create a resource that requires specific features to be supported by the NF Service Producer?
q_47674.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer should include the 3gpp-Sbi-Discovery-required-features header set to the required features to be supported by the NF Service Producer in HTTP PUT or POST requests to create a resource that requires specific features to be supported by the NF Service Producer.

q_47675.question: Which sub-clauses specify the RSRQ measurement accuracy for all measured cells in the context of 9.1.3.1 and 9.1.3.2?
q_47675.ground_truth: The RSRQ measurement accuracy for all measured cells shall be as specified in the sub-clauses 9.1.6.1 and 9.1.6.2.

q_47676.question: What is the role of the NG-RAN node in MBS traffic delivery?
q_47676.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node uses multicast transport via a common GTP-U tunnel per MBS session for 5GC Shared MBS traffic delivery, or uses unicast transport via separate GTP-U tunnel per MBS session per NG-RAN node.

q_47677.question: What functionality do IMS Transit Functions (TF) provide for IMS transit network scenarios?
q_47677.ground_truth: IMS Transit Functions (TF) provide additional functionalities for IMS transit network scenarios, such as offline charging. They may reside in a stand-alone entity or be collocated with an existing IMS Network Element.

q_47678.question: When should the UE set the tracking area updating attempt counter to 5, if the tracking area updating request is not for initiating a PDN connection for emergency bearer services?
q_47678.ground_truth: Upon reception of the EMM causes #95, #96, #97, #99, and #111, the UE should set the tracking area updating attempt counter to 5.

q_47679.question: When the MCVideo client receives a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message and MCVideo user acknowledgement is required, what should the MCVideo client set the stored current call type to if the Call type is "IMMINENT PERIL GROUP CALL"?

q_47680.question: How are unicast MCData signalling parameters and data signalling payloads protected between a client and a server?
q_47680.ground_truth: Unicast MCData signalling parameters and data signalling payloads between a client and a server are protected using the CSK, which is the DPPK in this case.

q_47681.question: Under what conditions should the MME/SGSN restrict access for NR as secondary RAT?
q_47681.ground_truth: If the Update Location Response is received from the HSS without the "NR as Secondary RAT" bit set in the Feature-List AVP, and all relevant entities except HSS support the restriction, the MME/SGSN may restrict access for NR as secondary RAT.

q_47682.question: What happens when the MME/SGSN receives Change Notification Response containing a Cause value of "IMSI/IMEI not known" and CS bit set to 1?
q_47682.ground_truth: The Change Reporting mechanism shall be stopped in the receiving SGSN/MME for all Bearers of the associated PDN connection and the SGSN/MME shall then initiate PDN disconnection for all of these PDN Connections.

q_47683.question: In the foreword, what does the version number x.y.z represent in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_47683.ground_truth: The version number x.y.z represents the level of approval and changes in the 3GPP technical specification. 'x' indicates the level of TSG approval, 'y' indicates changes of substance, and 'z' indicates editorial-only changes.

q_47684.question: Which message should the IRI-POI in the AMF generate when it detects that the AMF has started a trace session or received cell traffic trace message for a target UE?
q_47684.ground_truth: The IRI-POI in the AMF shall generate an xIRI containing an AMFRANTraceReport record in such cases.

q_47685.question: What type of media encoding is supported for sending RTCP Sender Reports and Receiver Reports when inter-working with a remote network?
q_47685.ground_truth: For PCM, G.722 and linear 16 bit PCM encoded media, the MTSI MGW shall support RFC~3550 for signalling the experienced quality using RTCP Sender Reports and Receiver Reports.

q_47686.question: How does the UE set the contents of the RRCConnectionRequest message?
q_47686.ground_truth: The UE sets the ue-Identity using an S-TMSI if it is provided by upper layers, or a random value if it is not. The UE also sets the establishmentCause in accordance with information received from upper layers.

q_47687.question: What is the purpose of the NRF verifying the input parameters in the access token request?
q_47687.ground_truth: The NRF verifies the input parameters in the access token request to ensure that the NF Service Consumer is authorized to access the requested services from the NF Service Producer instance or NF Service Producer service instance.

q_47688.question: What is the expected reporting delay for the UE to send an Event A3 triggered measurement report in 6.6.2.9.5?
q_47688.ground_truth: The expected reporting delay for the UE to send an Event A3 triggered measurement report in 6.6.2.9.5 is a measurement reporting delay less than 1280 ms.

q_47689.question: What must the NEF store in the UDR when it receives an AF request?
q_47689.ground_truth: The NEF stores the AF request information in the UDR.

q_47690.question: What radio parameters are used for 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay Discovery when the UE is not "served by NG-RAN"?
q_47690.ground_truth: Radio parameters NR PC5 with Geographical Area(s) and an indication of whether they are "operator managed" or "non-operator managed". The UE uses the radio parameters to perform 5G ProSe Direct Discovery over PC5 reference point when "not served by NG-RAN" only if the UE can reliably locate itself in the corresponding Geographical Area.

q_47691.question: What step is executed only if the procedure in clause 8.1.4C is triggered?
q_47691.ground_truth: Step 6b is executed only if the procedure in clause 8.1.4C is triggered.

q_47692.question: What is an additional requirement for the ng-eNB in a split DU-CU implementation?
q_47692.ground_truth: The ng-eNB shall support the use of integrity protection with the UE over the Uu interface.

q_47693.question: When performing measurements on inter-frequency cells, what should the UE assume if channelAccessMode2-r17 is enabled for a neighbor cell in FR2-2 with shared spectrum channel access?
q_47693.ground_truth: If channelAccessMode2-r17 is enabled for a neighbor cell in FR2-2 with shared spectrum channel access, the UE should assume that CCA applies to the cell and perform measurement accordingly.

q_47694.question: How does the UE select a QoS flow for the new UDP flow?
q_47694.ground_truth: The UE selects a QoS flow for the new UDP flow based on the received QoS rules

q_47695.question: What protocol is used by the PDN GW when the UE attaches to the EPC using the S2a or S2b reference points and PMIPv6 is used?
q_47695.ground_truth: The PDN GW acts as a LMA when the UE attaches to the EPC using the S2a or S2b reference points and PMIPv6 is used.

q_47696.question: What is the role of a Network Equipment Provider (NEP) in a network?
q_47696.ground_truth: A Network Equipment Provider (NEP) supplies network equipment to a network. They can provide traditional network equipment or virtualized network functions (VNFs).

q_47697.question: What is the function of the SMF in the process of traffic offload guidance in edge computing?
q_47697.ground_truth: The SMF fetches appropriate SM Policies, requests UPF to perform RTT measurements to the Application Server, sends the PDU Session Establishment Accept or Modification Command to the UE, and includes performance measurement rules, measured RTT value, and Traffic offload rule in the message.

q_47698.question: What action does the NG-RAN node take if the TRP List IE is included in the TRP INFORMATION REQUEST message, and what should it include in the TRP INFORMATION RESPONSE message?
q_47698.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node should include the requested information for all TRPs included in the TRP List IE in the TRP INFORMATION RESPONSE message.

q_47699.question: What must the participating MCPTT function do if it cannot find a binding between the public user identity and an MCPTT ID or if the validity period of an existing binding has expired?
q_47699.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT function shall reject the SIP INVITE request with a SIP 404 (Not Found) response with a specific warning text.

q_47700.question: What should the ATCF do upon receiving a SIP 2xx response to the SIP INVITE request due to ATU-STI for CS to PS SRVCC?
q_47700.ground_truth: The ATCF shall request the ATGW to update forwarding of the audio media from the SC UE to the remote UE.

q_47701.question: What optional management enables the PCF for the UE to instruct the AMF about the 5G access stratum time distribution parameters?
q_47701.ground_truth: The optional management of 5G access stratum time distribution enables the PCF for the UE to instruct the AMF about the 5G access stratum time distribution parameters, such as 5G access stratum time distribution indication (enable, disable) and Uu Time synchronization error budget.

q_47702.question: What should the UE do with the GUTI received in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message?
q_47702.ground_truth: If the message contains a GUTI, the UE shall use this GUTI as a new temporary identity for EPS services and store the new GUTI.

q_47703.question: What factors should be considered when optimizing the shape of wavefront and illumination at the center of the quiet zone by adjusting the distance between the offset antenna and a reflector?
q_47703.ground_truth: The factors to consider are the frequency of the beam, the applicable tilt angles related to the size of the reflector and range length, and the placement of the offset antenna, as it can change the coordinates of the measurement grid.

q_47704.question: How long is the maximum aggregate adjustment rate of timing change, and how long is the minimum aggregate adjustment rate for IAB-MT uplink timing?
q_47704.ground_truth: The maximum aggregate adjustment rate is Tq per 200 ms, and the minimum aggregate adjustment rate is Tp per second.

q_47705.question: How is authorization handled in Method 3 of CAPIF-2e security procedures?
q_47705.ground_truth: Method 3 of CAPIF-2e security procedures uses OAuth 2.0 to authorize and honor API invoker's northbound API invocations to the API exposing function. This method requires pre-provisioned credentials and related information for the API invoker, the CAPIF core function, and the AEF. The CAPIF core function acts as the authorization server, the API invoker acts as the client, and the API exposing function acts as the resource server.

q_47706.question: What is a "qos-hint-property" in the context of SDP negotiation?
q_47706.ground_truth: A "qos-hint-property" is a quality of service (QoS) parameter used in SDP negotiation to specify the desired QoS for a media description.

q_47707.question: What happens when a UE is CM-CONNECTED with RA= TAI, TAI2 with Allowed NSSAI S-NSSAI1 and Partially allowed S-NSSAI in TAI2 S-NSSAI2 where the TAI1 and TAI2 are supported by cells under different gNBs and the PDU sessions for S-NSSAI2 are deactivated?
q_47707.ground_truth: The context is preserved, but the DL data is dropped and is not accounted for.

q_47708.question: What are the test applicability conditions for the HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync without DRX for UE Category NB1 Standalone mode in Normal Coverage?
q_47708.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of NB-IoT HD-FDD UE release 17 and forward of UE Category NB1 that supports NTN.

q_47709.question: What action should the PCRF take upon reception of a P-CSCF restoration request for a corresponding IP-CAN session?
q_47709.ground_truth: The PCRF should send a request for P-CSCF restoration to the PCEF for the corresponding IP-CAN session.

q_47710.question: When should the UE write "TP-Correction-Value-Transmitted" instead of "PUCCHFormatSpecificParameter" in the TMPC field of the DCI format?
q_47710.ground_truth: If the UE decodes a PDCCH with DCI format 1A/1B/1D/1/2A/2/2B/2C/2D/7-1A/1B/1C/1D/1E/1F/1G or an EPDCCH with DCI format 1A/1B/1D/1/2A/2/2B/2C/2D, or an MPDCCH with DCI format 6-1A or an SPDCCH with DCI format 7-1A/1B/1C/1D/1E/1F/1G and the corresponding detected RNTI equals the C-RNTI or SPS C-RNTI or PUR-RNTI of the UE and the TPC field in the DCI format is not used to determine the PUCCH resource.

q_47711.question: How does the AF request a specific time synchronization error budget when requesting a time synchronization service?
q_47711.ground_truth: The AF may request a specific time synchronization error budget by providing a temporal validity condition, which contains the start-time and stop-time attributes that describe the time period when the time synchronization service is active for the targeted AF sessions.

q_47712.question: What should the MCPTT client include in the "name" attribute of the "a=rtpmap" attribute in the SDP offer, as defined in IETF RFC 4566?

q_47713.question: What is the role of the NBI in the Operator Platform as defined by GSMA OPG?
q_47713.ground_truth: The NBI is the interface between the application provider and the Capabilities Exposure Role in the Operator Platform, allowing an operator to advertise its cloud capabilities and for an application provider to reserve a set of resources or request an Edge Cloud service.

q_47714.question: How does the NWDAF use the "Service Experience Contribution Weight" values when calculating Service Experience predictions and confidence values?
q_47714.ground_truth: The NWDAF uses the "Service Experience Contribution Weight" values to improve the accuracy of its Service Experience predictions and confidence value calculations, giving less weight to less important values. The exact method is left to NWDAF implementation.

q_47715.question: What is the time between a command that will trigger an SFTD measurement report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface?
q_47715.ground_truth: The SFTD measurement reporting delay is defined as the time between a command that will trigger an SFTD measurement report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface.

q_47716.question: What should the UE do after initiating software updates and the operation is complete?
q_47716.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the registration procedure again to re-establish connectivity with the AMF.

q_47717.question: What type of signalling connection is used for negotiation in the <negtype> parameter?
q_47717.ground_truth: Negotiation can be done using logical link zero (negtype=0) or with USER INFORMATION messages on a temporary signalling connection (negtype=1).

q_47718.question: What does the MoLcsNotify API specify?
q_47718.ground_truth: The MoLcsNotify API specifies the application data model supported by the MoLcsNotify API.

q_47719.question: What is the test procedure sequence in the 17.4.11.1.3 test case?
q_47719.ground_truth: The preamble is set, followed by specific message contents. The UE is made interested in receiving a MBMS service with MBMS Service ID=0 associated with the MBMS SAI (1) broadcasted in SIB15 mbms-SAI-InterFreq list on Cell 1 and Cell 3. The UE is then made aware that the MBMS service is active.

q_47720.question: What is the issue with relying solely on UE-generated location information for regulatory services like emergency calls and lawful interception?
q_47720.ground_truth: The issue is that this method may not be reliable for regulatory services as it solely depends on the UE-generated location information, which may not always be accurate or trustworthy.

q_47721.question: What should an IAB-MT do with a dedicatedInfoF1c message?
q_47721.ground_truth: The IAB-MT should forward the dedicatedInfoF1c to the collocated IAB-DU.

q_47722.question: Which network entity is responsible for invoking and applying Operator Specific Barring in the context of mobile originated or mobile terminated short messages?
q_47722.ground_truth: Operator Specific Barring may apply to outgoing or incoming calls, or mobile originated or mobile terminated short messages in the HLR.

q_47723.question: What is the applicable standard for UE additional maximum output power reduction for SUL in clause 6.2C.5.3?
q_47723.ground_truth: The applicable standard for UE additional maximum output power reduction for SUL in clause 6.2C.5.3 is TS 38.101-1 in clauses 4.3 and 6.2.3.

q_47724.question: What parameters are defined in the "3gpp-Sbi-Producer-Id" header?
q_47724.ground_truth: The "3gpp-Sbi-Producer-Id" header contains nfinst, nfservinst, nfset, and nfserviceset parameters, which indicate NF instance, service instance, set, and service set IDs, respectively.

q_47725.question: What is the role of the AF in creating a MBS session?
q_47725.ground_truth: The AF provides the associated session ID, which can be SSM or TMGI, to the 5GC when creating a MBS session.

q_47726.question: What is the initial state of the User Equipment (UE) for the adding video to a speech call procedure in 5GC?
q_47726.ground_truth: The UE is in state 3N-A and registered to the IMS.

q_47727.question: In what scenario would a 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-UE relay UE initiate the 5G ProSe direct link modification procedure to remove corresponding PC5 QoS flow(s)?
q_47727.ground_truth: This would occur when the UE determines to keep the 5G ProSe direct link with the peer 5G ProSe layer-3 end UE and needs to remove a specific QoS flow.

q_47728.question: What is used for the identity privacy for communication for 5G ProSe Layer-2 UE-to-UE Relay?
q_47728.ground_truth: The privacy protection procedure in clause 6.2.4 of the present document is used for the privacy protection of the End-to-End communication between the 5G ProSe End UEs via a 5G ProSe Layer-2 UE-to-UE Relay and the communication between the 5G ProSe End UE and the 5G ProSe Layer-2 UE-to-UE Relay.

q_47729.question: What is the role of a dedicated SMF in the 5G LAN-type services?
q_47729.ground_truth: A dedicated SMF is responsible for managing all PDU Sessions for communication of a certain 5G VN group.

q_47730.question: What is the unit used for encoding the Tracking Area Code (TAC) in the TAI field of the User Location Information (ULI) IE?
q_47730.ground_truth: The Tracking Area Code (TAC) in the TAI field of the User Location Information (ULI) IE is encoded in the form of 2 octets using full hexadecimal representation (binary, not ASCII encoding).

q_47731.question: What is the function of the SRAP sublayer at the L2 U2U Remote UE?
q_47731.ground_truth: The SRAP sublayer at the L2 U2U Remote UE supports identification of the peer L2 U2U Remote UE, assigns local IDs to both L2 U2U Remote UEs, and correlates received packets for the specific PDCP entity associated with the right end-to-end PC5 Radio Bearer of the L2 U2U Remote UEs.

q_47732.question: What HTTP status code should be returned if the resource does not exist when updating a parameter (e.g. Memory Available) in the SMSF registration for non-3GPP access?

q_47733.question: What is the purpose of the "oneOf" keyword in the "objectContexts" property?
q_47733.ground_truth: The "oneOf" keyword is used to indicate that the "objectContexts" property can be any one of the specified schemas.

q_47734.question: What is the effect of reestablishRLC being set for an RLC bearer associated with a non-DAPS bearer during DAPS handover?
q_47734.ground_truth: The UE will perform RLC entity re-establishment for the RLC bearer associated with the non-DAPS bearer when the indication of a successful completion of random access towards the target cell is received from lower layers.

q_47735.question: What should the UE do when it receives an RRCConnectionRelease message while in the RRC_CONNECTED state?
q_47735.ground_truth: The UE should release the signalling connection, the established EPS bearer and all radio resources and enter the RRC_IDLE state.

q_47736.question: Which NR UEs does the test case in 7.4A.4.2 apply to?
q_47736.ground_truth: The test case in 7.4A.4.2 applies to all types of NR UEs release 15 and forward that support FR2 5DL CA.

q_47737.question: What is the purpose of defining the terms "shall" and "shall not" in the present document?
q_47737.ground_truth: The purpose of defining the terms "shall" and "shall not" in the present document is to indicate a mandatory requirement to do something and an interdiction (prohibition) to do something, respectively, in the context of normative provisions.

q_47738.question: Which message does the AMF send when the W-AGF triggers the Service Request to establish a signalling connection only?
q_47738.ground_truth: After successful establishment of the signalling connection, the W-AGF and the network can exchange NAS signalling, and steps 5 and 10 are skipped.

q_47739.question: Which interfaces are included in the S8/S2a/S2b interface for EPC based packet domain?
q_47739.ground_truth: The S8/S2a/S2b interface for EPC based packet domain includes GTP-based and PMIP-based interfaces.

q_47740.question: What does Bit 1 in Octet 5 of the PMF Address Information IE indicate when set to "1" in 3GPP TS 24.193?
q_47740.ground_truth: It indicates that the PMF IPv4 Address field is present in the PMF Address Information IE, together with the PMF Port for 3GPP Access and PMF Port for Non-3GPP Access.

q_47741.question: What is the purpose of the serving network name in the 5G system?
q_47741.ground_truth: The serving network name serves a dual purpose of binding the anchor key to the serving network and ensuring that the anchor key is specific for authentication between a 5G core network and a UE.

q_47742.question: What is the maximum overall delays measured in the test for the measurement reporting delay in TS 38.133 section 9.2.7.1?
q_47742.ground_truth: The actual overall delays measured in the test may be up to 2xTTIDCCH higher than the measurement reporting delays above because of TTI insertion uncertainty of the measurement report in DCCH.

q_47743.question: What is the purpose of the sustained downlink data rate performance test for EN-DC in FR1?
q_47743.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the Layer 1 and Layer 2 correctly process in a sustained manner the received packets corresponding to the maximum data rate indicated by UE capabilities.

q_47744.question: When is a UE not required to meet the accuracy requirements for aperiodic CSI-RS resources as CMR when the repetition is set to ON?
q_47744.ground_truth: When the number of resources in the resource set is smaller than maxNumberRxBeam.

q_47745.question: What is the PDCP sublayer used for in 5G network?
q_47745.ground_truth: The PDCP sublayer is primarily used for header compression and decompression, compression and decompression of uplink PDCP SDUs, transfer of user data, in-sequence delivery of upper layer PDUs at PDCP re-establishment procedure for RLC AM, ciphering and deciphering, timer-based SDU discard in uplink, and duplicate detection and reordering of PDCP PDUs.

q_47746.question: What is the OTA total power dynamic range for IAB-MT type 1-O, limited by the IAB-DU maximum carrier EIRP when transmitting on all RBs?
q_47746.ground_truth: The upper limit of the OTA total power dynamic range is the IAB-DU maximum carrier EIRP (Pmax,c,EIRP) when transmitting on all RBs.

q_47747.question: What is the NF service consumer required to send in the HTTP POST request message body to request notified analytics or data from the DCCF?
q_47747.ground_truth: The NF service consumer is required to send fetch correlation identifiers in the HTTP POST request message body to request notified analytics or data from the DCCF.

q_47748.question: What is the role of V-SMF in solution #2.14 for 5G data connectivity charging?
q_47748.ground_truth: V-SMF is responsible for the charging reporting for the V-CHF and H-CHF in solution #2.14.

q_47749.question: What should an NF service consumer do upon successful processing of an HTTP POST request for data retrieval, if the "fetchInstruct" attribute is present in the NmfafDataRetrievalNotification?
q_47749.ground_truth: After successfully processing the HTTP POST request, if the MFAF requests the NF service consumer to retrieve the notified data or analytics with the "fetchInstruct" attribute, the NF service consumer may invoke the Nmfaf_3caDataManagement_Fetch service operation to retrieve the notified data or analytics as defined in clause 4.3.2.2.

q_47750.question: What does the "P" flag represent in the GTP-C header and what should its value be for specific EPC messages?
q_47750.ground_truth: The "P" flag in the GTP-C header represents the "Procedure transaction" flag. For all EPC specific messages, except for Create Session Response and Create Bearer Response messages, the "P" flag should be set to "0".

q_47751.question: What should a UE do if it receives a message with an EMM cause having the same value as the EPS attach request procedure rejection?
q_47751.ground_truth: If the UE is registering for onboarding services in SNPN, it may enter the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH and perform SNPN selection or an SNPN selection for onboarding services.

q_47752.question: In the "IAB-UPTNLAddressUpdate" procedure, what type of object is indicated by the "DLUPTNLAddressToUpdateList" protocol information element?

q_47753.question: What should the source E-UTRAN and eNodeB do after receiving the RRCConnectionReestablishmentComplete message from the UE?
q_47753.ground_truth: The source E-UTRAN and eNodeB should resume SRB1, update the KeNB key, derive the KRRCint, KRRCenc and KUPenc keys, activate integrity protection and ciphering, and perform the measurement related actions.

q_47754.question: What should the participating MCPTT function do if the actions for implicit affiliation were not successful, as specified in step 11?
q_47754.ground_truth: It should reject the SIP REFER request with a SIP 486 (Busy Here) response with the warning text set to "102 too many simultaneous affiliations" and not continue with the remaining steps.

q_47755.question: How is the probability of false detection of the ACK defined for HARQ-ACK multiplexed on PUSCH?
q_47755.ground_truth: The probability of false detection of the ACK on PUSCH is defined as a conditional probability of erroneous detection of the ACK when only data is sent on PUSCH allocated RE, where HARQ-ACK can be allocated. Pseudo-random data is used as an input for PUSCH coding and modulation purposes.

q_47756.question: When does the eNB ignore the UL GTP-TEID IE and/or UL Transport Layer Address IE in the E-RABs Subject to Forwarding Items IE?
q_47756.ground_truth: The eNB shall ignore the UL GTP-TEID IE and/or UL Transport Layer Address IE in the E-RABs Subject to Forwarding Items IE, when the IEs are included in the DOWNLINK S1 CDMA2000 TUNNELLING message.

q_47757.question: What is the main difference between 8.2.1.2.3 and 8.2.1.2.3A?
q_47757.ground_truth: The testing in 8.2.1.2.3 is for 2 transmit antennas without CRS assistance information, while 8.2.1.2.3A is for 2 transmit antennas with CRS assistance information from two aggressor cells.

q_47758.question: What information is included in the DL PDR (Downlink part of the SDF template) and UL PDR (Uplink part of the SDF template)?
q_47758.ground_truth: The DL PDR contains the DL part of the Service Data Flow (SDF) template, and the UL PDR contains the UL part of the SDF template.

q_47759.question: Regarding the terms defined in the document, what does the abbreviation "gNB-CU" represent in the NG-RAN architecture?
q_47759.ground_truth: gNB-CU refers to a logical node hosting RRC, SDAP and PDCP protocols of the gNB or RRC and PDCP protocols of the en-gNB that controls the operation of one or more gNB-DUs. The gNB-CU terminates the F1 interface connected with the gNB-DU.

q_47760.question: What conditions must be satisfied by the UE for steering traffic from WLAN to E-UTRAN?
q_47760.ground_truth: The UE must satisfy certain conditions related to RSRPmeas, RSRQmeas, ChannelUtilizationWLAN, BackhaulRateDlWLAN, BackhaulRateUlWLAN, and BeaconRSSI in order to steer traffic from WLAN to E-UTRAN.

q_47761.question: What is the purpose of the "5GS additional request result" information element?
q_47761.ground_truth: The 5GS additional request result information element is used to inform the UE about the result of additional request.

q_47762.question: What are the advantages of using the IKEv2 multiple bearer PDN connectivity in untrusted non-3GPP access?
q_47762.ground_truth: QoS differentiation is provided if the UE and the ePDG support the IKEv2 multiple bearer PDN connectivity and it is used in the PDN connection.

q_47763.question: In the context of TS 36.331 clause 5.3.7.4, when is the reestablishmentCellId set in the VarRLF-Report by the UE?
q_47763.ground_truth: If the procedure was initiated due to radio link failure or handover failure, the UE sets the reestablishmentCellId in the VarRLF-Report to the global cell identity of the selected cell.

q_47764.question: What is the test requirement in section 8.1.39.5 in terms of the total time from the start of T3 for the UE to transmit a measurement report containing the cell global identifier of cell 2?
q_47764.ground_truth: The test requirement for the UE to transmit a measurement report containing the cell global identifier of cell 2 is 5137 ms from the start of T3.

q_47765.question: What is the primary security measure for NF Service Request and Response procedure for mutual authentication in the SCAS?
q_47765.ground_truth: The primary security measure for NF Service Request and Response procedure for mutual authentication is the Protection at the transport layer, which supports TLS protocol and mutual authentication between NF consumer and NF producer using server and client-side certificates.

q_47766.question: What is the condition for the UE to increase the number of successful tests in step 6?
q_47766.ground_truth: The UE increases the number of successful tests if the overall delays measured from the beginning of time period T2 is less than 5122 ms.

q_47767.question: What should the MCData client do if it receives a SIP MESSAGE request containing a matching mcdata-client-id but the alert-ind in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body is set to false?
q_47767.ground_truth: The MCData client should set the MCData emergency alert state to "MDEA 1: no-alert" and clear the MCData emergency state if not already cleared.

q_47768.question: What is the interruption time defined as, excluding the RRC procedure delay?
q_47768.ground_truth: The interruption time is the time between end of the last TTI containing the RRC command on the old PDSCH and the time the UE starts transmission of the new PRACH.

q_47769.question: What is the difference between "viewing MCVideo user" and "viewed-to MCVideo user"?
q_47769.ground_truth: In an ambient viewing call, the "viewing MCVideo user" is the one who receives the media transmission, and the "viewed-to MCVideo user" is the one who is being viewed to.

q_47770.question: What is the potential security requirement for the 5G system to ensure notification service is only provided to an authorized NF to which a notification message is routed?
q_47770.ground_truth: The 5G system shall ensure notification service is only provided to an authorized NF to which a notification message is routed.

q_47771.question: What is the difference between an Assured Transfer and a Consultative Transfer in a communication session?
q_47771.ground_truth: In an Assured Transfer, the initiator waits for the recipient to successfully complete the new session before issuing the BYE message to terminate its connection, whereas in a Consultative Transfer, the initiator places the existing session on hold, establishes a new session with the target, and then sends a Refer message to the target, which in turn establishes a session with the recipient, before clearing its active sessions.

q_47772.question: What action does the UPF take if it receives an IGMP Leave or MLD Done message in step 1b or 1c?
q_47772.ground_truth: The UPF stops forwarding multicast packets related to the IP multicast Group to the 5G-RG.

q_47773.question: What is the use of the 5QI 75 in V2X communication over Uu reference point?
q_47773.ground_truth: 5QI 75 is intended to be used only for the delivery of V2X messages over MBS (MBMS (Multimedia Broadcast Multicast Service) bearer services) in V2X communication over Uu reference point.

q_47774.question: What is the data type of the "radius" element defined in the "tEllipsoidArcType" complexType?
q_47774.ground_truth: The "radius" element defined in the "tEllipsoidArcType" complexType is of type "xs:nonNegativeInteger".

q_47775.question: What happens when there is no active traffic over the N9 forwarding tunnel to support the EAS session continuity for a specific duration?
q_47775.ground_truth: Upon detection of no active traffic over the N9 forwarding tunnel to support the EAS session continuity, the Source I-SMF releases the source UL-CL/BP, the PSA0 if it is not collocated with the source UL CL/BP, and the N9 forwarding tunnel in the Target UL CL by the Target I-SMF.

q_47776.question: What is the size of the bitmap in a BFR MAC CE when the highest ServCellIndex for which beam failure is detected is less than 8?
q_47776.ground_truth: A single octet bitmap is used.

q_47777.question: What does the <cid> parameter represent in this telecommunications context?
q_47777.ground_truth: The <cid> parameter specifies a particular PDP context definition and is used in commands such as +CGPADDR, +CGDCONT, and +CGDSCONT.

q_47778.question: What message does the MME send when none of the default EPS bearers have been successfully switched and the LIPA PDN connection has not been released?
q_47778.ground_truth: The MME sends a Path Switch Request Failure message to the target eNodeB and performs explicit detach of the UE following the MME initiated detach procedure.

q_47779.question: What is the purpose of the GNB-DU RESOURCE COORDINATION REQUEST message?
q_47779.ground_truth: The GNB-DU RESOURCE COORDINATION REQUEST message is sent by the gNB-CU to the gNB-DU to request resource allocation for data traffic.

q_47780.question: What should the MCData server do when generating a SIP PUBLISH request to carry information about a change in functional alias status for a handled functional alias ID?
q_47780.ground_truth: The MCData server should set the Request-URI to the public service identity of the controlling MCData function associated with the handled functional alias ID.

q_47781.question: What message is returned by the AUSF to the AMF in case of RES* verification failure, when the UE uses the 5G-GUTI in the initial NAS message?
q_47781.ground_truth: The AUSF returns an indication of RES* verification failure to the AMF.

q_47782.question: Which two parameters should be determined for each sampling point when measuring the EIS in the NR System Simulator?
q_47782.ground_truth: The downlink signal level and the minimum power level at which the throughput exceeds or equals 95% of the maximum throughput of the specified RMC.

q_47783.question: What are the scheduling restrictions when intra-band carrier aggregation is performed in FR2?
q_47783.ground_truth: The scheduling restrictions due to a given serving cell apply to all other serving cells in the same band on the symbols that fully or partially overlap with the restricted symbols.

q_47784.question: What is the content of the "SSRC" field in the Media reception end response message?
q_47784.ground_truth: The content of the "SSRC" field in the Media reception end response message is coded as specified in clause~9.2.3.16.

q_47785.question: What is the condition for establishing a dedicated bearer for WB-E-UTRA?
q_47785.ground_truth: The decision to establish or modify a dedicated bearer for WB-E-UTRA can only be taken by the EPC, and the bearer level QoS parameter values are always assigned by the EPC.

q_47786.question: Which 3GPP standards specify the service requirements for MCVideo group and private streaming?
q_47786.ground_truth: The corresponding service requirements for MCVideo group and private streaming are defined in 3GPP TS 22.280 and 3GPP TS 22.281.

q_47787.question: What is the role of the AS in providing location information of other UEs?
q_47787.ground_truth: The AS does not provide location information of other UEs to each AC unless the users involved in the multi-user session have consented to sharing their individual UE (User Equipment) location information. The application layer mechanism for a user to share consent with the AS is outside the scope of SA6.

q_47788.question: In what scenario would the network determine a Target NSSAI for the UE during a Registration procedure?
q_47788.ground_truth: This would occur if the UE requests a new S-NSSAI which is not supported in the UE's current Tracking Area.

q_47789.question: What determines the presentation time of images in an HEVC encoded image/image sequence?
q_47789.ground_truth: The RTP timestamps determine the presentation time of images in an HEVC encoded image/image sequence.

q_47790.question: In the third-party REGISTER request, what should the S-CSCF do if there is more than one message body to be included?
q_47790.ground_truth: The S-CSCF should include a multipart message body and set the value of the Content-Type header field to "multipart/mixed".

q_47791.question: What does the "allow" value in the "Defined values" section determine?
q_47791.ground_truth: The "allow" value in the "Defined values" section determines whether location disclosure is allowed or not.

q_47792.question: When would the step 12 and 13 be skipped?
q_47792.ground_truth: If the PDU session establishment failed between step 5 and step 11, then steps 12 and 13 would be skipped.

q_47793.question: What action must the MME perform if there is a partial fault in one or more components and corresponding CSIDs are assigned?
q_47793.ground_truth: The MME must perform implementation-specific operations to clean up any residual state associated with the assigned CSIDs and send a GTPv2 Delete PDN Connection Set Request message containing all the MME CSIDs of the failing components to the SGW peers that support the feature.

q_47794.question: What measurement provides the number of incoming bytes received for a virtualized 3GPP NF?
q_47794.ground_truth: DataVolum.InBytes measurement provides the number of incoming bytes received for a virtualized 3GPP NF.

q_47795.question: What is the role of the A2X Application Server in the 5G system?
q_47795.ground_truth: The A2X Application Server implements a subset of the V2X Application Server functionality, providing A2X services over the PC5 reference point and parameters for A2X communications.

q_47796.question: What UE action is specified in TS 24.301, clause 5.5.1.2.5 upon receiving the reject cause "EPS services and non-EPS services not allowed"?
q_47796.ground_truth: Upon receiving reject cause "EPS services and non-EPS services not allowed" (TS 24.301, clause 5.5.1.2.5), the UE shall stop timer T3410, set the EPS update status to EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, delete any GUTI, last visited registered TAI, and KSI, and enter state EMM-DEREGISTERED. For A/Gb mode or Iu mode, UE shall also handle specific MM and GMM parameters.

q_47797.question: What is the role of the PCF in Application Detection and Control requirements?
q_47797.ground_truth: The PCF can instruct the SMF on which applications to detect, and whether to report start or stop events to the PCF. Upon receiving the report from the SMF, the PCF can make policy decisions based on the information received and send the corresponding updated or new PCC rules to the SMF.

q_47798.question: What should a UE with no support for IFOM, MAPCON, or non-seamless offload capabilities use if both ISMP and ISRP are available and the ANDSF rules control the WLAN access selection and traffic routing?
q_47798.ground_truth: The UE will use the ISMP.

q_47799.question: When can the controlling MCPTT function release an ambient listening call?
q_47799.ground_truth: It can be triggered by the MCPTT administrator by a mechanism outside of the standard or by a call terminating event occurring at the controlling MCPTT function such as a timer expiration.

q_47800.question: What is the role of the NEF in supporting the Location dependent broadcast service?
q_47800.ground_truth: The NEF selects MB-SMF as ingress control node(s) for different MBS service areas, maps possible external identifiers for MBS service areas to network-internal identifiers, and uses the service area to discover the MB-SMF.

q_47801.question: What information should the media storage client include in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body for one-to-one file distribution?
q_47801.ground_truth: For one-to-one file distribution, the media storage client should include the <request-type> element set to "one-to-one-fd" and the <mcdata-calling-user-id> element set to the originating MCData ID.

q_47802.question: What should the SM entity do when it receives the RABMSM-MODIFY-IND primitive from the RABM entity to indicate the change of the QoS for an NSAPI?
q_47802.ground_truth: The SM entity should adjust the QoS for the corresponding PDP context and inform the RABM entity that the indicated NSAPI and QoS profile are now in use with the RABMSM-MODIFY-RSP primitive.

q_47803.question: What should the UE not transmit on the union of restricted serving cell symbols due to SS-RSRQ measurement on an FR2 inter-frequency cell without MG and NCSG?

q_47804.question: What is the requirement for the order in which grants are processed for MAC PDUs in LTE?
q_47804.ground_truth: The order in which grants are processed for MAC PDUs is left up to UE implementation.

q_47805.question: What is the maximum time duration for T1?
q_47805.ground_truth: The maximum time duration for T1 is 27 seconds.
