q_47806.question: What determines if a Remote UE can participate in ProSe UE-to-Network Relay discovery and communication?
q_47806.ground_truth: The Remote UE can participate in ProSe UE-to-Network Relay discovery and communication if its RSRP is below the broadcasted threshold.

q_47807.question: In what scenario would the Modify Bearer Request message not include any Bearer Contexts during a Tracking/Routeing Area Update procedure?
q_47807.ground_truth: When the Modify Bearer Request message is sent from the old MME/SGSN as part of a Tracking/Routeing Area Update procedure with SGW change and data forwarding, it should only include the Bearer Contexts to be modified. Since the UE has left the old MME/SGSN, other information related to the UE, such as ULI or UE Time Zone, is no longer valid.

q_47808.question: What are the restrictions on scheduling availability for a UE with different subcarrier spacing than PDSCH/PDCCH for RLM?
q_47808.ground_truth: If a UE performs RLM with different subcarrier spacing than PDSCH/PDCCH, there are restrictions on scheduling availability, such as no PUCCH, PUSCH, SRS, PDCCH, PDSCH, or CSI-RS for tracking or CQI on SSB symbols to be measured for radio link monitoring.

q_47809.question: What is the normative reference for the minimum conformance requirements in clause 6.4.1.0.1?
q_47809.ground_truth: The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 clause A.6.4.1.1.

q_47810.question: In the scenario described in section 11a, what is required for the event "Deactivation" to be considered a success?
q_47810.ground_truth: The last CSI report must be received by the SS earlier than or equal to subframe (n+8), DTX should not be observed outside the specified subframes, and at most 2 non-consecutive DTX subframes should be observed within two specific subframe ranges.

q_47811.question: When does the SMF indicate the target access type in step 3a of Network Triggered Service Request?
q_47811.ground_truth: The SMF indicates the access type (3GPP access or non-3GPP access) over which the user plane resources are to be activated for the MA PDU Session in step 3a of Network Triggered Service Request.

q_47812.question: What additional service parameters for Ranging/SL Positioning does the GMLC support when enabling trusted AFs and NFs to perform MT-LR?
q_47812.ground_truth: The GMLC supports additional service parameters for Ranging/SL Positioning when enabling trusted AFs and NFs to perform MT-LR.

q_47813.question: What information is allocated for the target 5G ProSe Layer-3 End UE if IP traffic is used in 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay Communication?
q_47813.ground_truth: IPv6 prefix or IPv4 address is allocated for the target 5G ProSe Layer-3 End UE

q_47814.question: What should be done to ensure that the polarization requirements are met for dual polarized systems?
q_47814.ground_truth: The requirement shall be tested and met for both polarizations for dual polarized systems.

q_47815.question: How is PCF notified of the power mode information in QoS adjustment?
q_47815.ground_truth: The power mode information can be carried by the PDU session establishment/modification procedure and SM policy association establishment/modification procedure via NAS signalling or by informing AF of the power mode info, and then the AF sends the power mode info to PCF directly or via NEF.

q_47816.question: What condition can be used for handling RTCP traffic?
q_47816.ground_truth: PCC Rules are able to specify rules for mapping RTCP packets per Application ID with existing architecture, and an RTCP header parsing information can also be specified to map RTCP packets to a different QoS Flow. Additionally, if AF does not want to use Application ID linked packet filters to identify RTCP flows, there needs to be a support for additional fields in the IP packet filter set to handle RTCP traffic.

q_47817.question: What is the action taken by UEs when close to the timeout of the service time of the MBSR?
q_47817.ground_truth: When close to the timeout of the service time of the MBSR, the UEs start the cell reselection and perform the re-establishment procedure to continue the services.

q_47818.question: In case k) in subclause~5.4.5.2.1, what should the UE do if it has multiple payloads?
q_47818.ground_truth: In case k) in subclause~5.4.5.2.1, the UE shall set the Payload container type IE to "Multiple payloads", and set each payload container entry in the Payload container IE as specified in cases a) to j) above.

q_47819.question: What is the maximum input level requirement for E-UTRA and NR single carrier and CA operation that applies to inter-band EN-DC including FR2, as specified in section 7.4B.4 of the document?
q_47819.ground_truth: The maximum input level requirement for E-UTRA single carrier and CA operation specified in clauses 7.4.1 and 7.4.1A of TS 36.101 and for NR single carrier and CA operation specified in clauses 7.4, 7.4A and 7.4B of TS~38.101-2 apply.

q_47820.question: What HTTP methods are supported for the "Data Storages" resource?
q_47820.ground_truth: This resource supports the GET and POST HTTP methods.

q_47821.question: What action should the MGCF take when it receives an initial INVITE request with Supported header field indicating "100rel" for calls terminating in circuit-switched networks?
q_47821.ground_truth: The MGCF should store the fe-identifier header field parameter of the P-Charging-Vector header field, store the value of the orig-ioi header field parameter received in the P-Charging-Vector header field, send a 100 (Trying) response, send a 183 "Session Progress" response after a matching codec is found or no codec is required at the MGW, set the Require header field to the value of "100rel", and insert a P-Charging-Vector header field in the response with necessary parameters.

q_47822.question: What is the degradation in Top-1 beam prediction accuracy for DL Tx beam prediction, when considering independent measurement errors for all Tx beams with a 1 dB margin, compared to the one without measurement error for Set B/Set A being 1/2 and 1/4 respectively?
q_47822.ground_truth: The performance degradation is 10% and 20% for Set B/Set A being 1/2 and 1/4, respectively.

q_47823.question: When might the AMF remove the additional S-NSSAI from the PDU session?
q_47823.ground_truth: The AMF removes the additional S-NSSAI from the PDU session when it detects that the originally requested S-NSSAI is not congested.

q_47824.question: What is the main focus of the evaluation in clause 6.1.5.1, 6.1.5.2, and 6.1.5.3?
q_47824.ground_truth: The main focus of the evaluation in clause 6.1.5.1 is end user charging for PNI-NPN network usage of access, while in clause 6.1.5.2 is converged charging for number of UEs and in clause 6.1.5.3 is converged charging for number of PDU sessions.

q_47825.question: When should the controlling MCPTT function set the "imminentperil-ind" element to a value of "false" and the "emergency-ind" element to a value of "true" in the SIP INFO request?
q_47825.ground_truth: When the received SIP request contains an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body with the "alert-ind" element set to a value of "true" and this is an unauthorized request for an MCPTT emergency alert.

q_47826.question: What message is sent by the AMF to the UE upon a successful deregistration, except when the deregistration type is switch-off?
q_47826.ground_truth: The Deregistration Accept message is not sent.

q_47827.question: What should the network use as a minimum packet size for a PDU Session type Unstructured in both uplink and downlink?
q_47827.ground_truth: The network shall use a maximum packet size of at least 128 octets for a PDU Session type Unstructured in both uplink and downlink.

q_47828.question: Which TS defines the conformance requirements for the standalone GNSS-Location parameter and under what conditions should the UE include locationCoordinates in logged measurement reports?
q_47828.ground_truth: The conformance requirements for the standalone GNSS-Location parameter are defined in TS 34.306, clause 4.3.13.2. The UE should include the locationCoordinates in logged measurement reports if it has detailed location information available for E-UTRA and the plmn-Identity stored in VarLogMeasReport is equal to the RPLMN.

q_47829.question: What is the method to support PS for SA PDU session between Trusted and Untrusted N3GPP access without changing RAT type?
q_47829.ground_truth: It is recommended to select a solution that supports PS for SA PDU session between Trusted and Untrusted N3GPP access without changing RAT type for seamless communication and mobility.

q_47830.question: How many strongest BCCH carriers of the GSM cells does the UE need to continuously attempt to decode the BSIC in one measurement gap?
q_47830.ground_truth: The UE shall continuously attempt to decode the BSIC of SCH on the BCCH carrier of the 8 strongest BCCH carriers of the GSM cells indicated in the Inter-RAT cell info list.

q_47831.question: What should the UE do with the KeNB key when it receives the RRCConnectionReestablishment message and switches to the new cell?
q_47831.ground_truth: The UE should update the KeNB key based on the KASME key and store the nextHopChainingCount value for future use.

q_47832.question: What does the length value of a primitive tag indicate in the TLV object?
q_47832.ground_truth: The length value of a primitive tag indicates the file identifier and, if applicable, the SFI value of the EF in the TLV object.

q_47833.question: What support indication does the NEF forward to the AF regarding alternative QoS profiles?
q_47833.ground_truth: The NEF forwards the received support indication to the AF when TSCTSF or the PCF supports alternative QoS profiles.

q_47834.question: When is the DMRS sequence initialization set to 1 bit?
q_47834.ground_truth: The DMRS sequence initialization is set to 1 bit when transform precoder is disabled by higher layers or if the Transform precoder indicator field is present.

q_47835.question: What should be the minimum rate of correct events observed during repeated tests for the UE to pass the test?

q_47836.question: What is the RRC re-establishment delay without serving cell timing?
q_47836.ground_truth: The RRC re-establishment delay is defined as the time from the start of time period T3, to the moment when the UE starts to send PRACH preambles to cell 2 for sending the RRCReestablishmentRequest message to cell 2. The RRC re-establishment delay to an unknown NR intra frequency cell without serving cell timing shall be less than 5 s.

q_47837.question: What should the UE do when it detects entering condition for event B2 under specific conditions?
q_47837.ground_truth: Under condition 2, when the UE detects entering condition for event B2 is met, it ensures that the UE transmits a MeasurementReport.

q_47838.question: If the Serving GW receives additional downlink data packets before the expiry of the timer, what action does it take?
q_47838.ground_truth: The Serving GW does not restart this timer and continues to buffer the downlink data.

q_47839.question: What is the purpose of using redundancy in accordance with the requirements and recommendations defined in clause 9 when high packet loss rates are encountered?
q_47839.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure that the quality of the media data is maintained even in the presence of packet loss.

q_47840.question: What should the MCData server do if the selected expiration time is zero?
q_47840.ground_truth: The MCData server should remove the MCData user information entry if the selected expiration time is zero.

q_47841.question: What should the NG-RAN do if it has already established a user plane for an associated broadcast MBS session?
q_47841.ground_truth: The NG-RAN skips the user plane establishment of the broadcast MBS session when it starts.

q_47842.question: Under which conditions the initiating UE can add new PC5 QoS flow(s) to the existing PC5 unicast link in the PC5 unicast link modification procedure?
q_47842.ground_truth: The initiating UE can add new PC5 QoS flow(s) to the existing PC5 unicast link if there is a PC5 unicast link between the initiating UE and the target UE, the pair of application layer IDs and the network layer protocol of this PC5 unicast link are identical to those required by the application layer in the initiating UE for this V2X service, and the security policy corresponding to the V2X service identifier(s) is aligned with the security policy of the existing PC5 unicast link.

q_47843.question: What are the two possible ways of accessing localized services based on the matched RSD?
q_47843.ground_truth: The UE can access localized services via the existing PDU session or by establishing a new PDU session based on the matched RSD.

q_47844.question: What is the duration of DL PRS symbols in ms corresponding to "ppw-durationOfPRS-ProcessingSymbolsN" or "ppw-durationOfPRS-ProcessingSymbolsN2" in TS 37.355?
q_47844.ground_truth: DL PRS symbols duration in ms corresponds to the "ppw-durationOfPRS-ProcessingSymbolsN" if positioning frequency layer i is in Case 1, and to "ppw-durationOfPRS-ProcessingSymbolsN2" if positioning frequency layer i is in Case 2.

q_47845.question: What is the maximum allowed TIU in NR to UTRAN handover?
q_47845.ground_truth: TIU can be up to one UTRA frame (10 ms).

q_47846.question: When does a UE not expect to multiplex in a Type-2 HARQ-ACK codebook HARQ-ACK information that is in response to a detection of a DCI format that does not include a counter DAI field?
q_47846.ground_truth: A UE does not expect to multiplex in a Type-2 HARQ-ACK codebook HARQ-ACK information that is in response to a detection of a DCI format that does not include a counter DAI field.

q_47847.question: What would the MAC entity do if there are no valid PUCCH resources for pending SR triggers due to the SL-PRS resource colliding with PUCCH resources for other SR triggers?
q_47847.ground_truth: If there are no valid PUCCH resources for pending SR triggers due to the SL-PRS resource colliding with PUCCH resources for other SR triggers, the MAC entity would leave the selection of which PUCCH resource to signal the SR on to UE implementation.

q_47848.question: When should a UE transmit MsgA PRACH in association with a contention-free Random Access Preamble for beam failure recovery request?
q_47848.ground_truth: The UE should transmit MsgA PRACH on the next available PRACH occasion from the PRACH occasions corresponding to the selected SSB permitted by the given restrictions, and randomly select the PRACH preamble and occasion amongst the associated PRACH occasions occurring simultaneously but on different subcarriers.

q_47849.question: What is the purpose of studying the procedures and service continuity enhancements for UEs served by the mobile base station relay in the case of mobility within the same IAB-donor gNB and mobility between different IAB-donor gNBs?
q_47849.ground_truth: The purpose is to efficiently deliver data to UEs by enhancing current procedures of mobility and service continuity. The study should consider the cell information change and handover requirements, as well as efficient mobility and service continuity.

q_47850.question: What triggers priority handling of paging in times of congestion at the (R)AN?
q_47850.ground_truth: The inclusion of the "Paging Priority" in the N2 "Paging" message

q_47851.question: What information does the TWAN-S2a-Failure-Cause AVP contain in case of S2a connectivity establishment failure?
q_47851.ground_truth: The TWAN-S2a-Failure-Cause AVP contains a 32-bit cause value field that indicates the cause of S2a connectivity establishment failure to the 3GPP AAA Server by the TWAN.

q_47852.question: What is the applicability of Wide Area operating band unwanted emission requirements for a TAB connector operating in Band Category 2?
q_47852.ground_truth: The requirements apply outside the Base Station RF Bandwidth edges and inside any sub-block gap for a TAB connector operating in Band Category 2.

q_47853.question: What is the ICID and what is its role in the IM CN subsystem?
q_47853.ground_truth: The ICID (IM CN subsystem charging identifier) is a session-level data shared among entities in the IM CN subsystem. It is used for the correlation between SIP transactions and CDRs.

q_47854.question: What does the HSS do in step 2 when performing Location Information Retrieval in the 5GC network?
q_47854.ground_truth: The HSS contacts the MME and/or SGSN to retrieve location information.

q_47855.question: What is the purpose of the procedure in 4.5A.4?
q_47855.ground_truth: The purpose of the procedure in 4.5A.4 is to allow the successful completion of IMS signalling.

q_47856.question: What is the difference between Stand-alone Non-Public Networks (SNPN) and Public Network Integrated NPNs?
q_47856.ground_truth: Stand-alone Non-Public Networks (SNPN) are operated independently and do not rely on network functions provided by a PLMN, while Public Network Integrated NPNs rely on the support of a PLMN.

q_47857.question: What action should the UE take if the network sends a PDN session establishment failure due to reaching the maximum number of PDU sessions?
q_47857.ground_truth: The UE needs to release an established PDU session to establish a new PDU session.

q_47858.question: What is the complex type name for describing a private call on a network?

q_47859.question: What is the definition of the performance requirement for PUSCH in terms of SNR and throughput?
q_47859.ground_truth: The performance requirement of PUSCH is determined by a minimum required throughput for a given SNR, expressed as a fraction of maximum throughput for the FRCs listed in annex A, assuming HARQ re-transmissions.

q_47860.question: What is the purpose of the Queued Floor Requests message when it is a response to the cancellation of a queued floor request originated by a floor participant?
q_47860.ground_truth: The purpose of the Queued Floor Requests message is to specify the request made by the floor participant to the floor control server.

q_47861.question: What is the requirement for the user equipment (UE) when it receives the "Extended wait time" from the lower layers and there is no ongoing procedure?
q_47861.ground_truth: The UE should ignore the "Extended wait time".

q_47862.question: What is the term used for providing per call basis changes to the supplementary service CUG?

q_47863.question: What is the difference between the PTP port states when using a Boundary Clock and when it operates as a Transparent Clock?
q_47863.ground_truth: When the 5GS operates as a Boundary Clock, it maintains the PTP port states and uses the port number of the ingress DS-TT and domainNumber and sdoId in the received PTP message to assign the PTP message to a PTP instance in the NW-TT. However, when the 5GS operates as a Transparent Clock, it does not maintain the PTP port states, and the ingress PTP messages received on a PTP Port are retransmitted on all other PTP Ports of the Transparent Clock subject to the rules of the underlying transport protocol.

q_47864.question: What does the term "RX antennas" refer to in the context of radiated performance requirements description for a BS?
q_47864.ground_truth: In the context of radiated performance requirements for a BS, the term "RX antennas" refers to the demodulation branches (i.e. not physical antennas of the antenna array).

q_47865.question: How is the integrity of the NF profile protected in the modified NF Service Registration procedure with remote attestation?
q_47865.ground_truth: The integrity of the NF profile is protected by using digital signatures in the registration request by the VNF. The NF profile is signed by the OAM, NFV MANO, or an authorized delegate when the VNF instance is provisioned and instantiated on the NFVI.

q_47866.question: What is the role of the 6.3.2.4.1.x clauses in the 6.3.2.4.2 clause?
q_47866.ground_truth: The 6.3.2.4.1.x clauses are used to determine QACK, Q'CSI,1, Q'CSI,2, and Q'CSI,0 for HARQ-ACK, CSI part 1, CSI part 2, and CG-UCI transmission on PUSCH. These Q values are used in the rate matching output sequence length formula for HARQ-ACK and CSI transmission on PUSCH in 6.3.2.4.1 and 6.3.2.4.1.x clauses.

q_47867.question: What type of error is returned if an optional element is missing in an invoke component or inner data structure when it is required by the context?
q_47867.ground_truth: If an optional element is missing in an invoke component or inner data structure when it is required by the context, a "DataMissing" error is returned.

q_47868.question: What should a UE do when it detects release of the NAS signalling connection, has initiated a combined tracking area updating procedure, and has a tracking area updating attempt counter with a value of less than 5?
q_47868.ground_truth: The UE starts timer T3411, does not delete any LAI, TMSI, ciphering key sequence number and list of equivalent PLMNs, and sets the update status to U2 NOT UPDATED.

q_47869.question: What is the purpose of the Reference Time Information Report procedure?
q_47869.ground_truth: The purpose of the Reference Time Information Report procedure is to report accurate reference time information from the gNB-DU to the gNB-CU using non-UE associated signaling.

q_47870.question: What should the en-gNB consider a valid value for UL and DL Coordination Information IE, unless it receives a new update for the same UE?
q_47870.ground_truth: The en-gNB should consider the received UL Coordination Information IE value valid until reception of a new update of the IE for the same UE. The same applies to the DL Coordination Information IE.

q_47871.question: What is included in the 5G ProSe direct link context for UE-to-network relay?
q_47871.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe direct link context for UE-to-network relay includes user info ID and layer-2 ID of the 5G ProSe remote UE and the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE, relay service code, and in the case of Layer-3 UE-to-network relay, the network layer protocol and PC5 QoS flow information.

q_47872.question: What is the structure of the 5G-S-TMSI in relation to the GUTI and 5GS-TMSI?
q_47872.ground_truth: The 5G-S-TMSI is constructed from the AMF Set ID, the AMF Pointer and the 5GS-TMSI. It is a shortened form of the 5GS-GUTI, used for radio signalling procedures such as paging and Service Request.

q_47873.question: What global standards organization develops the 3GPP technical specifications, which include the E-UTRAN NRM IRP specifications?
q_47873.ground_truth: The 3GPP technical specifications are developed by the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP), a global organization that brings together telecommunications standards associations for the creation of specifications for mobile telecommunications.

q_47874.question: If a location estimate is needed for event reporting in RRC INACTIVE state, how does the LMF determine the UE location using the location measurements or location estimate received at step~7 or a Cell ID provided by the AMF at step~7?
q_47874.ground_truth: The LMF determines the UE location using the location measurements or location estimate received at step~7 or a Cell ID provided by the AMF at step~7 without attempting to obtain additional location measurements from the UE or from the NG-RAN.

q_47875.question: What is the role of the NAS Registration Request message during the initial registration process for the FN-RG?
q_47875.ground_truth: The NAS Registration Request message contains the SUCI or 5G-GUTI of the FN-RG, security parameters/UE security capability, UE MM Core Network Capability, PDU Session Status, Follow-on request, and Requested NSSAI.

q_47876.question: What element and attribute are used in the MIME body indicating per-group dynamic data to indicate an MCVideo client's interest in a particular MCVideo group?

q_47877.question: What is the purpose of providing multiple ML models to AnLF?
q_47877.ground_truth: Providing multiple ML models to AnLF may help improve analytics accuracy. Each ML model is assigned a unique ML Model identifier, and the optimal model is selected based on input data type and representative ratio.

q_47878.question: What should the transmission participant do if the SSRC of the transmission participant sending the media matches the stored SSRC of a user in the transmitter list?
q_47878.ground_truth: The transmission participant should request the MCVideo client to render the received RTP media packets, restart the T203 (End of RTP media) timer associated with the User ID, and remain in the 'O: transmission arbitration' state.

q_47879.question: What should the MS do if it receives a DETACH REQUEST message from the network in state GMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED with detach type "re-attach not required" and no cause code, or "re-attach not required"' and the cause code is not #2 "IMSI unknown in HLR"?
q_47879.ground_truth: The GPRS detach procedure shall be progressed and the GPRS attach procedure shall be aborted.

q_47880.question: What should the MAC entity do when it receives an LTM Cell Switch Command MAC CE including a Timing Advance Command?
q_47880.ground_truth: The MAC entity applies the Timing Advance Command for the PTAG and starts or restarts the timeAlignmentTimer associated with the PTAG.

q_47881.question: What HTTP status code is returned by the NRF upon failure?
q_47881.ground_truth: The NRF returns "400~Bad~Request" status code upon failure.

q_47882.question: What factors can affect the UE Rx beam sweeping factor in the measurement period requirement, as specified in clause 4.5.5.5?
q_47882.ground_truth: The UE Rx beam sweeping factor can be affected by the frequency layer being measured, as well as the capability reported by the UE and indicated by the LMF for lower Rx beam sweeping factors in FR2 and FR1.

q_47883.question: What is the requirement defined for the uplink signal detection in 7.3.35.5?
q_47883.ground_truth: UE output power equal to or higher than Transmit minimum power -39 dBm means uplink signal.

q_47884.question: When should the target UE include a Re-authentication indication in the DIRECT LINK REKEYING REQUEST message?
q_47884.ground_truth: The target UE should include a Re-authentication indication in the DIRECT LINK REKEYING REQUEST message when initiating a PC5 unicast link re-keying procedure and the initiating UE needs to derive a new KNRP.

q_47885.question: What is the role of the source IMS access leg in the Session Transfer procedure?
q_47885.ground_truth: The source IMS access leg is released as per TS~23.237 after the remote end is updated with the SDP of the CS access leg in the execution of the Session Transfer procedure.

q_47886.question: What is the action taken when a dynamic sidelink grant is available for retransmission(s) of a MAC PDU?
q_47886.ground_truth: The PSCCH duration(s) and PSSCH duration(s) corresponding to retransmission(s) of the MAC PDU are cleared from the sidelink grant.

q_47887.question: What is the function of the scope parameter in a Binding Indication?
q_47887.ground_truth: The scope parameter in a Binding Indication identifies the applicability of the binding information, i.e. the scenario associated with it.

q_47888.question: What does the UE do upon receiving the PMFP PLR count request message?
q_47888.ground_truth: The UE starts counting the received DL packets over the QoS flow and sends the PMFP PLR count response message to the UPF.

q_47889.question: How can the blocked AoA pairs be addressed without impacting test time in the 3-axis positioner implementation?
q_47889.ground_truth: The blocked AoA pairs can be addressed without impacting test time by exchanging some pre-identified test AoAs across the two hemisphere scans, leveraging the mechanical outline of the inside positioner.

q_47890.question: What should be the value of bit 1 in Octet 8, if the new MME/SGSN has successfully authenticated the UE?
q_47890.ground_truth: The value of bit 1 in Octet 8 should be set to 1, if the new MME/SGSN has successfully authenticated the UE.

q_47891.question: What status code will the NWDAF respond with if the "timeAnaNeeded" attribute is provided and the requested analytics information is not ready when the specified time is reached?
q_47891.ground_truth: The NWDAF may send a "500 Internal Server Error" status code to the NF service consumer.

q_47892.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification in the document presented?
q_47892.ground_truth: The purpose of the 3GPP Technical Specification in the document presented is to specify architecture enhancements to facilitate communications with packet data networks and applications, specifically for Machine Type Communication (MTC) applications on the (external) network/MTC servers.

q_47893.question: How long does the UE need to wait after detecting a new cell in a higher priority search before determining that reselection has not occurred?
q_47893.ground_truth: The UE is not required to continuously measure the detected cell to evaluate the ongoing possibility of re-selection. However, the minimum measurement filtering requirements specified later in this section shall still be met by the UE before it makes any determination that it may stop measuring the cell.

q_47894.question: What is the role of V2X Application Server in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_47894.ground_truth: A V2X Application Server, acting as a Content Provider, may support V2X Localized User Plane procedures for requesting the BM-SC to activate an MBMS bearer for Local MBMS based MBMS data delivery.

q_47895.question: What must the eNB determine for setting the PS-to-CS handover indicator in the described scenario?
q_47895.ground_truth: The eNB must determine if the target is GERAN with DTM but without DTM HO support and the UE supports DTM, or if the target is UTRAN (HSPA) without PS HO support.

q_47896.question: What rule does the initial AMF follow in the case of home-routed roaming scenario to associate the UE's EPS PDN connections to 5GS PDU Sessions?
q_47896.ground_truth: The initial AMF stores an association of the PDU Session ID, S-NSSAI, and the SMF ID for each UE's EPS PDN connections, and the SMF includes mapping between EBI(s) and QFI(s) as part of N2 SM Information container.

q_47897.question: What is the difference in UL Average-UPT between the case with no DL power adjustment and the case with DL power adjustment (3 dB power back off) in FR1 2-layer Scenario B based on Source 1?
q_47897.ground_truth: With a large packet size, the DL power adjustment results in a higher or similar mean and 5% UL Average-UPT for all load levels compared to the case with no DL power adjustment.

q_47898.question: What should the SGSN do after restarting before the next authenticated radio contact with the MS?
q_47898.ground_truth: The SGSN should request the MS to identify itself with the IMSI in order to make a relationship between the IMSI and the received old TLLI.

q_47899.question: What does the EES-B do if the required EAS(s) is not registered with EES-A?
q_47899.ground_truth: EES-B sends EAS discovery request over EDGE-9 reference point to the EES-A to obtain matching EAS details.

q_47900.question: What should the UE do when it is in EMM-REGISTERED and EMM-IDLE mode, and the CSG ID is removed from the Allowed CSG list?
q_47900.ground_truth: The UE should attempt to enter a normal cell and not choose a cell which is not included in the allowed CSG list when it detects entering new tracking areas not included in the TAI list.

q_47901.question: What is the condition for the UE to camp on a lower priority E-UTRAN frequency or inter-RAT frequency than the serving frequency if ThreshX-Q is provided?
q_47901.ground_truth: The serving cell must fulfill Squal < ThreshServing, LowQ, and a cell of a lower priority RAT/frequency must fulfill Squal > ThreshX, LowQ during a time interval TreselectionRAT. Additionally, more than 1 second must have elapsed since the UE camped on the current serving cell.

q_47902.question: How does the ProSe 5G UE-to-UE Relay operate as a DNS server?
q_47902.ground_truth: The ProSe 5G UE-to-UE Relay acts as a DNS server to other UEs by storing an association of the User Info of the peer UE of the unicast link and the IP address allocated to the UE into its DNS entries, and returning the IP address of the target UE or the IP address(es) of UEs which provide the ProSe Service to the source UE upon receiving a DNS query for the target UE or ProSe Service.

q_47903.question: What is the purpose of the DisCoNoserviceapplicability parameter in Solution #13?
q_47903.ground_truth: The DisCoNoserviceapplicability parameter in Solution #13 is used to determine whether to negotiate power saving mechanisms for staying at no service in the current PLMN before entering no service discontinues NTN coverage, and whether to remain in no service or perform PLMN selection procedure after entering no service discontinuous NTN coverage.

q_47904.question: What does a mask with all bits set to "1" in a filter represent in ProSe Direct Discovery?
q_47904.ground_truth: A mask with all bits set to "1" in a filter represents a full matching requirement for ProSe Response Codes in PC5 interface messages.

q_47905.question: What does the 5G DDNMF do when it cannot retrieve the corresponding discoveree UE context for a target RPAUID?
q_47905.ground_truth: If the 5G DDNMF cannot retrieve the corresponding discoveree UE context for a target RPAUID, it can skip the processing of this target RPAUID.

q_47906.question: What is the difference between "will" and "might" in the context of 3GPP technical documents?
q_47906.ground_truth: In 3GPP technical documents, "will" indicates that something is certain or expected to happen as a result of action taken by an agency outside the scope of the document, while "might" indicates a likelihood that something will happen as a result of action taken by some agency outside the scope of the document.

q_47907.question: What should the UE do upon the expiry of T321 for a measId?
q_47907.ground_truth: The UE should include a measurement reporting entry within the VarMeasReportList for the corresponding measId, set the numberOfReportsSent to 0, and initiate the measurement reporting procedure, as specified in 5.5.5.

q_47908.question: What does the first digit in the version number in a 3GPP technical specification document indicate?
q_47908.ground_truth: The first digit in the version number of a 3GPP technical specification document indicates the status of the document in the TSG: presented for information, presented for approval, or TSG approved under change control.

q_47909.question: What is the purpose of the Enhanced Provisioning Paging Policy Indicator (EPPPI) feature?
q_47909.ground_truth: The EPPPI feature allows for the reduction in the number of PDRs/QERs that need to be provisioned in order to support NG-RAN paging using the Paging Policy Indicator (PPI). It enables the SMF to include a DSCP to PPI Control Information in the PFCP Session Establishment/Modification Request message to instruct the UPF to insert a PPI in the GTP-U PDU Session Container extension header of downlink GTP-U packets encapsulating payload packets.

q_47910.question: What does the network have to do upon receipt of a REQUEST SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT ACTIVATION message from the MS, if the TI in Linked TI IE matches an already established PDP context?
q_47910.ground_truth: The network should validate the message by verifying the TI and reply with an ACTIVATE SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT ACCEPT message, if the request can be accepted.

q_47911.question: What should the controlling MCVideo function do when sending a SIP MESSAGE request to remove a regroup from a terminating participating MCVideo function?
q_47911.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function should create an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-regroup+xml MIME body including an <mcvideo-regroup-uri> element set to the identity of the regroup, a <regroup-action> element set to "remove", and a <users-for-regroup> element set to the list of MCVideo IDs served by the terminating participating MCVideo function that are affiliated to the regroup.

q_47912.question: When does the MME respond with an error cause during a TAU request?
q_47912.ground_truth: The MME responds with an error cause during a TAU request if the UE is not known in the old MME or S4~SGSN, or if the integrity check for the TAU request message fails.

q_47913.question: What is the format of the PosSystemInformationDeliveryCommand in the F1AP-PROTOCOL-CONTAINER?
q_47913.ground_truth: PosSystemInformationDeliveryCommand in the F1AP-PROTOCOL-CONTAINER is a SEQUENCE that consists of a protocolIEs field, which is a ProtocolIE-Container containing PosSystemInformationDeliveryCommandIEs.

q_47914.question: What information does SystemInformationBlockType24 provide?
q_47914.ground_truth: SystemInformationBlockType24 contains information about NR frequencies and NR neighboring cells relevant for cell re-selection, and can also be used for NR idle/inactive measurements.

q_47915.question: What information received from the PDU SESSION RESOURCE SETUP REQUEST message should the NG-RAN node store and use for Non-GBR QoS flows' traffic policing for the concerned UE?
q_47915.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node should store the PDU Session Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate IE in the UE context and use it when enforcing traffic policing for Non-GBR QoS flows for the concerned UE.

q_47916.question: What is the purpose of the additional spurious emissions requirements in UL MIMO for a specific deployment scenario?
q_47916.ground_truth: The additional spurious emissions requirements indicate that the UE shall meet an additional requirement for a specific deployment scenario as part of the cell handover/broadcast message.

q_47917.question: What is the difference between ProtocolIE-SingleContainer and ProtocolIE-ContainerPair?
q_47917.ground_truth: ProtocolIE-SingleContainer holds a single ProtocolIE-Field whereas ProtocolIE-ContainerPair holds two ProtocolIE-Fields.

q_47918.question: What is the required action for a UE if it receives a SRVCC handover cancelled NOTIFICATION?
q_47918.ground_truth: The UE should transmit a SIP re-INVITE message on the e-utra cell in the existing dialog.

q_47919.question: What should the TSCTSF do if the HTTP POST request from the NF service consumer is not accepted?
q_47919.ground_truth: The TSCTSF shall indicate in the response to HTTP POST request the cause for the rejection, as specified in clause 6.3.7.

q_47920.question: In which method should the eNB save the RLF report when there is no X2 link between target eNB and source eNB and the RRC connection is re-established successfully at the target eNB?
q_47920.ground_truth: The eNB shall save the RLF report to the Trace Record and transfer it to the TCE directly.

q_47921.question: What are the considerations for ongoing maintenance, enhancement, and new Release versions of specifications when withdrawing a specification or functionality in 3GPP?
q_47921.ground_truth: Ongoing maintenance and enhancement are allowed for unaffected Releases, a new version of a specification may be created for a new Release, and a Category A CR for the specification or functionality that has been withdrawn shall not be produced.

q_47922.question: What is the role of the IMS MMTel AS in the process of DC application data channel establishment?
q_47922.ground_truth: The IMS MMTel AS discovers and selects the DC control function and interacts with it via the DC1 interface for Data Channel call control (establishing bootstrap and application data channels to UE A and UE B) and call event notifications. It also negotiates with the DCSF and DCMF for the SDP modification and constructs and sends the updated SDP with negotiated application data channel media to the originating network S-CSCF and P-CSCF.

q_47923.question: What is the format of the Full Authentication NAI in EAP-SIM and EAP-AKA?
q_47923.ground_truth: The Full Authentication NAI in EAP-SIM and EAP-AKA takes the form of "0<IMSI>@gan.mnc<MNC>.mcc<MCC>.3gppnetwork.org" or "1<IMSI>@gan.mnc<MNC>.mcc<MCC>.3gppnetwork.org".

q_47924.question: What significance does the CSG ID and CSG Membership Indication have if the target cell is in hybrid mode and the target RNC may use the CSG Membership Indication to perform differentiated treatment for CSG and non-CSG members?
q_47924.ground_truth: The target RNC uses the CSG Membership Indication to perform differentiated treatment for CSG and non-CSG members in hybrid mode, and the CSG ID is used to establish the radio network resources (RABs).

q_47925.question: Which mechanism(s) does UPF use to identify PDU Set information?
q_47925.ground_truth: UPF identifies PDU Set information by matching RTP/SRTP header and payload, new 3GPP specific RTP extension header, by information provided by the AS in N6 header, or by non-standardized UPF implementation mechanism based on traffic characteristics.

q_47926.question: What is checked for messages matching the rules?
q_47926.ground_truth: The tester verifies that the matching messages are correctly accounted for both rules.

q_47927.question: What kind of information is not applicable to the header compression when transmitting PDCP SDUs?
q_47927.ground_truth: The header compression is not applicable to the SDAP header and the SDAP Control PDU if included in the PDCP SDU.

q_47928.question: What does the Appl. m-line Number parameter in the MBMS Subchannel field represent in an MBMS subchannel control message?
q_47928.ground_truth: The Appl. m-line Number parameter in the MBMS Subchannel field represents the number of the "m=application" m-line in the SIP MESSAGE request announcing the MBMS bearer.

q_47929.question: What condition must be met for the UE to include the rlf-Cause in the Radio Link Failure Report message?
q_47929.ground_truth: The UE includes the rlf-Cause in the Radio Link Failure Report message when it detects radio link failure.

q_47930.question: What is the requirement for carrier leakage measurement when the UE indicates a carrier leakage frequency of 3300 or 3301 with IE UplinkTxDirectCurrentList or UplinkTxDirectCurrentTwoCarrierList-r16?
q_47930.ground_truth: The requirement for carrier leakage measurement is waived and the UE's UL signal is left uncorrected.

q_47931.question: What should the UE do when it detects T3430 timeout, has sent a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message and has the tracking area updating attempt counter set to a value different from 5?
q_47931.ground_truth: The UE should stop T3430 if still running, increment the tracking area updating attempt counter, set the EPS update status to EU2 NOT UPDATED, set the MM state to MM LOCATION UPDATING PENDING and delete any LAI, TMSI, ciphering key sequence number and list of equivalent PLMNs.

q_47932.question: In which cases is a non-BL/CE UE not expected to receive PDSCH resource blocks transmitted on certain antenna ports for frame structure type 2?
q_47932.ground_truth: A non-BL/CE UE is not expected to receive PDSCH resource blocks transmitted on antenna port 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13 or 14 in the two PRBs to which a pair of VRBs is mapped if either one of the two PRBs overlaps in frequency with a transmission of primary or secondary synchronization signals in the same subframe, for frame structure type 2.

q_47933.question: In the context of 3GPP TS 23.401, when the MME may deactivate ISR for a SIPTO at the local network PDN connection with stand-alone GW?
q_47933.ground_truth: The conditions to deactivate ISR for a SIPTO at the local network PDN connection with stand-alone GW are specified in 3GPP TS 23.401, clause 4.3.5.6.

q_47934.question: What should the M-NG-RAN node do if it receives a S-NODE MODIFICATION REQUIRED message containing the Spare DRB IDs IE and the Required Number of DRB IDs IE?
q_47934.ground_truth: The M-NG-RAN node may take those IDs into consideration for MN-terminated bearers and provide new DRB IDs for SN-terminated bearers if available.

q_47935.question: What is the role of PSM in CS domain support?
q_47935.ground_truth: PSM has no support in the CS domain on the network side. It should only be used by UEs that require SMS and mobile originated IMS or CS services. UEs that rely on mobile terminated CS services other than SMS should not use PSM, as the CS domain does not provide support for mobile terminated CS voice services for UEs that are in PSM.

q_47936.question: When is the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message sent?
q_47936.ground_truth: The SECURITY MODE COMMAND message is always sent integrity protected with new 5GS NAS security context.

q_47937.question: What should the UE do if it receives a 305 (Use Proxy) response to a SIP REGISTER request?
q_47937.ground_truth: The UE shall ignore the contents of the Contact header field if included in the received message, release all IP-CAN bearers used for the transport of media, initiate a new P-CSCF discovery procedure, select a different P-CSCF address, and perform the procedures for initial registration.

q_47938.question: What is the name of the measurement that provides the distribution of UL packet delay between PSA UPF and UE, including the D1 UL PDCP delay occurred in the UE, and is expressed in subcounters per S-NSSAI?
q_47938.ground_truth: This measurement is called "Distribution of UL packet delay between PSA UPF and UE (including D1)".

q_47939.question: Which clause of ETSI TS 102 223 indicates that the UICC shall be targeted using the application identifier "uicc.3gpp.org" when using the addressing mechanism to the UICC?

q_47940.question: What is the principle for determining which band combinations cannot be considered as fallbacks?
q_47940.ground_truth: The principle for determining which band combinations cannot be considered as fallbacks is that if one radio access technology (RAT) of a band combination (BC) only includes supplementary uplink (SDL) bands or only downlink secondary cell (DL Scell) bands and cannot be deployed in reality, it cannot be considered as a fallback.

q_47941.question: What should the UE do if it is registered to a PLMN or SNPN and has a stored list of "allowed tracking areas" while the current TAI is in that list?
q_47941.ground_truth: The UE should stay in or enter the state 5GMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE and is allowed to initiate any 5GMM and 5GSM procedures.

q_47942.question: What is the minimum length of the PC5 QoS flow descriptions information element?
q_47942.ground_truth: The minimum length of the PC5 QoS flow descriptions information element is 6 octets.

q_47943.question: When should the target UE send a PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message with PC5 signalling protocol cause value #111 "protocol error, unspecified"?
q_47943.ground_truth: The target UE sends this message if the 5G ProSe direct link establishment fails due to other reasons.

q_47944.question: What is the role of TS 22.280, 22.179, 22.281, and 22.282 in this use case?
q_47944.ground_truth: TS 22.280, 22.179, 22.281, and 22.282 have a set of specific requirements on Off-Network MCX Services, which partially or fully cover the functionality of this use case.

q_47945.question: Which IOC, as defined in clause 5.3.145 of TS 29.510, incorporates attributes inherited from the ManagedFunction IOC in TS 28.622?

q_47946.question: What should the UE do upon reception of a PMFP UAT COMPLETE message with the same EPTI as the allocated EPTI value in step 5.4.9.3?
q_47946.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T105.

q_47947.question: What is the data type of the parameter "deltaLongitude" in the structure "RelativeGeodeticLocation"?
q_47947.ground_truth: The data type of the parameter "deltaLongitude" in the structure "RelativeGeodeticLocation" is integer.

q_47948.question: What is the MIME media type name and subtype name for the 3GPP IM CN subsystem XML body?
q_47948.ground_truth: The MIME media type name is "application" and the subtype name is "3gpp-ims+xml".

q_47949.question: What is contained within the "key-accept" element in the 3GPP 5G Pro Se PC3ach interface?
q_47949.ground_truth: The "key-accept" element contains a "transaction-ID", a "UP-PRUK-ID", a "Knrp" element, a "Knrp-freshness-parameter-2" element, a "GPI" element (optionally), an "anyExt" element, other elements from future namespaces, and attributes defined in future releases.

q_47950.question: In the MTLF based error monitoring procedure, how does the NWDAF containing MTLF measure the differences between the set of trained data and the collected events/data?
q_47950.ground_truth: The NWDAF containing MTLF measures the differences by comparing the set of trained data to the collected events and data during the ML model target period.

q_47951.question: What are the two options for explicit start and end mark in the GTP-Header for PDU Sets in N3/N9 interface?
q_47951.ground_truth: The two options for explicit start and end mark in the GTP-Header for PDU Sets in N3/N9 interface are: (1) the first GTP-U packet with XQFI has the "start" marker in the GTP-U header, and the last PDU has the "end" marker in the GTP-U header, (2) a timer in the GTP-U sender to detect if there is no any following GTP-U packet, then it marks the "end" in the GTP-U header.

q_47952.question: What should a SC UE do within the SDP offer for sessions with only speech media component when preconditions are used in accordance with 3GPP TS 24.292?
q_47952.ground_truth: The SC UE should indicate the media lines for the speech media component as speech media component over circuit switched bearer in accordance with 3GPP TS 24.292.

q_47953.question: In which mode(s) can the UE disable the E-UTRAN capabilities?
q_47953.ground_truth: The UE can only disable the E-UTRAN capabilities when in EMM-IDLE mode.

q_47954.question: What are the allowed combinations for the Serving-Node, and what does SGSN-Number indicate?
q_47954.ground_truth: The allowed combinations for the Serving-Node are SGSN-Number, SGSN-Name & SGSN-Realm & SGSN-Number, MME-Name & MME-Realm & MME-Number-for-MT-SMS, MSC-Number, MSC-Number & MME-Name & MME-Realm, IP-SM-GW-Number, and IP-SM-GW-Number & IP-SM-GW-Name & IP-SM-GW-Realm. SGSN-Number indicates the number of the Serving General Packet Radio Service (GPRS) Support Node.

q_47955.question: What should the UE do if it receives a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message with reject cause #99 "information element non-existent or not implemented"?
q_47955.ground_truth: The UE sets the tracking area updating attempt counter to 5, starts timer T3402, and performs tracking area updating on the expiry of timers T3402.

q_47956.question: What message does the Serving GW send to the PDN GW in step 13a if Presence Reporting Area Information is included?
q_47956.ground_truth: The Serving GW sends a Modify Bearer Request (Presence Reporting Area Information) message to the PDN GW.

q_47957.question: What is the maximum repetition period of relevant system info blocks that needs to be received by the UE to camp on a cell, assumed in the E-UTRAN FDD FDD Intra frequency case for normal coverage?
q_47957.ground_truth: The maximum repetition period of relevant system info blocks that needs to be received by the UE to camp on a cell is 1280 ms.

q_47958.question: What is the main difference between Model A and Model B discovery procedures for Ranging/SL Positioning UE with 5G ProSe capable UE?
q_47958.ground_truth: Model A uses a single discovery protocol message (Announcement), while Model B uses two discovery protocol messages (Solicitation and Response).

q_47959.question: What is the responsibility of the UE in ensuring the accuracy of the UTC-based counter in 5G ProSe direct discovery?
q_47959.ground_truth: The UE is responsible for ensuring the accuracy of the UTC-based counter in 5G ProSe direct discovery, with the specific implementation details left to the UE.

q_47960.question: What is the purpose of the MOCN TMGI in the NG-RAN?
q_47960.ground_truth: The MOCN TMGI is used to identify a MBS session in a network sharing scenario, and it is identified by a shared PLMN ID.

q_47961.question: What information is required to define the center of an elliptical arc area?
q_47961.ground_truth: The center of an elliptical arc area can be defined by specifying its longitude and latitude, given in terms of point coordinate type.

q_47962.question: What should the UE do if the timer T3585 is zero and the network sends a PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message with Back-off timer value IE for the same S-NSSAI as the current PDU session?
q_47962.ground_truth: The UE shall stop timer T3585 associated with the corresponding S-NSSAI, if it is running, upon the reception of the PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message with Back-off timer value IE for the same S-NSSAI.

q_47963.question: What is the purpose of the Idle mode Signalling Reduction (ISR) function in E-UTRAN UEs that support GERAN and/or UTRAN?
q_47963.ground_truth: The Idle mode Signalling Reduction (ISR) function is used to limit signaling during inter-RAT cell-reselection in idle mode for E-UTRAN UEs that support GERAN and/or UTRAN.

q_47964.question: When can the UE consider a frequency to be the highest priority during an MBMS session?
q_47964.ground_truth: The UE can consider a frequency to be the highest priority during an MBMS session if it can receive the MBMS service of interest on that frequency and the reselected cell is broadcasting SIB13.

q_47965.question: What information does the CP function need to provide to the UP function when controlling Traffic Steering towards SGi-LAN, N6-LAN, and/or N6?
q_47965.ground_truth: The CP function needs to create the necessary PDRs to represent the service data flows or applications to be steered, create a FAR with the Forwarding Policy IE including the Forwarding Policy Identifier, and associate the FAR to the above PDRs of the PFCP session.

q_47966.question: What must the UE include in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message if it has set the WUSA bit to "WUS assistance information reception supported" and needs to obtain new ciphering keys for ciphered broadcast assistance data?
q_47966.ground_truth: The UE must include the Additional information requested IE with the CipherKey bit set to "ciphering keys for ciphered broadcast assistance data requested" in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

q_47967.question: What message is sent by the source eNB to the target eNB during a handover to transfer the uplink/downlink PDCP SN and HFN status?

q_47968.question: What is the purpose of registering a data collection profile with the DCCF during or after data collection?
q_47968.ground_truth: The purpose of registering a data collection profile with the DCCF during or after data collection is to enable data consumers to obtain data which has been collected by NWDAF or ADRF directly. The DCCF can determine if requested data is available and coordinate data collection based on the data collection profile.

q_47969.question: Which two solutions propose an alternative for sending an indication to the UE for avoiding switching away to non-3GPP access?
q_47969.ground_truth: Solution #41 applies existing URSP rules and sets the Access Type Preference to "3GPP," while Solution #47 sends the indication via PCO for dynamic updates to an existing PDU session.

q_47970.question: In Event X1, what does the variable "Ofn" represent?
q_47970.ground_truth: In Event X1, the variable "Ofn" represents the measurement object-specific offset of the reference signal of the NR cell.

q_47971.question: What is the procedure for the Get analytics data request from the analytics consumer to the ADAE server?
q_47971.ground_truth: The procedure involves the ADAE client determining service experience information based on data received from VAL clients and sending it to the ADAE server for predictions and sharing with the consumer of the analytics.

q_47972.question: What is the procedure for establishing an application data channel between UEs in 5G?
q_47972.ground_truth: Establishing an application data channel between UEs involves the use of a re-INVITE request in which a data channel media description for an application data channel is added. The re-INVITE request is sent to the S-CSCF A through the MMTel AS B, which is then forwarded to UE B. The P-CSCF B executes QoS procedure to establish the dedicated bearer/QCI Flow for the application data channel media based on the SDP answer in the 200 OK response. UE A initiates SCTP association and DTLS connection establishment procedures to establish the application data channel with UE B.

q_47973.question: What is the purpose of the source Layer-2 ID in the security establishment procedure for a PC5 unicast link?
q_47973.ground_truth: The source Layer-2 ID is used to determine the Layer-2 ID for the security establishment procedure.

q_47974.question: What is the function of the NG-RAN node in inter-system energy saving?
q_47974.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node is responsible for switching off cells that meet certain load criteria or upon O&M request, and for switching on cells based on cell load information or O&M request. The NG-RAN node responds to re-activation requests and remains switched on until expiration of the minimum activation time.

q_47975.question: What are the two options for signaling transport layer for SLPP in 5.2.2.2, agreed by RAN2?
q_47975.ground_truth: The two options for signaling transport layer for SLPP in 5.2.2.2, agreed by RAN2, are PDCP and PC5-U.

q_47976.question: What are the three options provided in solution#15 for PRU Information Acquisition?
q_47976.ground_truth: The three options provided in solution#15 for PRU Information Acquisition are solution#15-AMF, solution#15-LMF, and solution#15-UDM, which have different impacts on multiple entities.

q_47977.question: What is the difference between aperiodic and semi-persistent UL-SRS in the context of 3GPP TS 38.321?
q_47977.ground_truth: Aperiodic UL-SRS is activated by sending a DCI, while semi-persistent UL-SRS is activated by sending the SP Positioning SRS Activation/Deactivation MAC CE command.

q_47978.question: What is the basic communication part of an IMS multimedia telephony communication service session?
q_47978.ground_truth: The basic communication part of an IMS multimedia telephony communication service session is realized by a single SIP session that utilizes media capabilities and flexibility provided by the SIP protocol and 3GPP IMS specifications. Media capabilities include RTP-based transfer of voice, real-time video, real-time text, and data, as well as UDPTL-based transfer of fax and TCP/MSRP-based transfer of text, arbitrary files, and sharing of media files with predefined formats.

q_47979.question: What type of positioning method makes use of the UE Rx-Tx time difference measurements and the measured gNB Rx-Tx time difference measurements at multiple TRPs to estimate the location of the UE?

q_47980.question: What should the MCData server do if the Expires header field of the SIP PUBLISH request is not included or has a nonzero value lower than 4294967295?
q_47980.ground_truth: The MCData server should send a SIP 423 (Interval Too Brief) response, where the SIP 423 (Interval Too Brief) response contains a Min-Expires header field set to 4294967295.

q_47981.question: What is the goal of the tests in 8.2.2.4.3?
q_47981.ground_truth: The tests in 8.2.2.4.3 are designed to verify the closed loop rank-two performance with wideband and frequency selective precoding.

q_47982.question: What action should a UE take when it receives an indication from the lower layer of transmission failure of a DISCOVERY_RESPONSE message?
q_47982.ground_truth: After receiving an indication from the lower layer that the DISCOVERY_RESPONSE message has not been successfully acknowledged, the 5G DDNMF shall abort the procedure and stop any associated timer(s) T5069, if running.

q_47983.question: What action does the PDN GW take if the UE is temporarily not reachable due to power saving, during the handover of a dedicated bearer?
q_47983.ground_truth: The PDN GW re-attempts the same bearer activation procedure after receiving an indication that the UE is available for end-to-end signaling.

q_47984.question: What is the purpose of the ';' character in a URI path segment?
q_47984.ground_truth: It separates a parameter name and its value in a path segment.

q_47985.question: How are the negative and positive offsets of the interfering signal applied in the context of ACS, blocking and intermodulation characteristics?
q_47985.ground_truth: The negative offsets of the interfering signal apply relative to the lower IAB RF Bandwidth edge or sub-block edge inside a sub-block gap, and the positive offsets of the interfering signal apply relative to the upper IAB RF Bandwidth edge or sub-block edge inside a sub-block gap.

q_47986.question: What information may be included in the `<multicast-mbs-session-related-info>` element in the context of multicast MBS sessions?
q_47986.ground_truth: This element includes additional information that can be used by the MC service client to join the multicast MBS session, such as the PLMN ID of the default PLMN service provider in case of source-specific IP multicast address, DNN, and SNSSAI of the PDU session associated with the multicast MBS session.

q_47987.question: What should the SMF do if it receives a POST request with the hoPreparationIndication IE set to "true" and the DL user plane of the PDU session is not to be switched yet?
q_47987.ground_truth: The SMF should not switch the DL user plane of the PDU session.

q_47988.question: What is the purpose of the "pras" attribute in the PolicyControlRequestTrigger "Change of UE presence in PRA"?
q_47988.ground_truth: The "pras" attribute is used to encode the presence reporting areas for which reporting is required.

q_47989.question: What is the range of moderate degradation observed in the evaluation of Type 2 training between 1 NW part model and M>1 separate UE part models?

q_47990.question: What should the MBMS interface in the MCPTT client do when it receives RTP media packets or floor control messages over the MBMS subchannel and if there is an ongoing conversation in a group session associated with the TMGI, the MBMS subchannel for audio and floor control?
q_47990.ground_truth: It should forward the received floor control messages to the floor participant in the conversation and forward the received RTP packets to the media mixer in the conversation if the received RTP contains a different SSRC value than the SSRC value used by the MCPTT client.

q_47991.question: What procedure is reused to deliver the localized service data towards UE via UE policy?
q_47991.ground_truth: The procedure to deliver the localized service data towards UE via UE policy reuses the procedure defined in clause~6.2.4 of TS~23.287.

q_47992.question: What should a GPRS MS do if the TIN indicates "GUTI" in Iu mode and it has a valid GUTI?
q_47992.ground_truth: The MS should map the GUTI into a P-TMSI, P-TMSI signature and RAI and include the mapped RAI in the Old routing area identification IE and the mapped P-TMSI signature in the P-TMSI signature IE.

q_47993.question: What should the SS do after gathering 1000 filtered ACK+NACK responses for the filtered ACK and NACK responses?
q_47993.ground_truth: If the ratio (NACK / ACK + NACK) is less than or equal to 0.1, then the SS should go to step 6. Otherwise, the SS should go to step 7.

q_47994.question: What is the requirement for the UE when the maximum number of preamble transmission counter has been reached, as specified in section 6.2.7.3?
q_47994.ground_truth: The UE shall indicate a random access problem to upper layers if the maximum number of preamble transmission counter has been reached for the random access procedure on PCell, and the UE shall stop preamble transmission if this number has been reached for the random access procedure on an activated Scell.

q_47995.question: What should the HSS return when redirecting a request to a different service instance using HTTP redirection?
q_47995.ground_truth: The HSS sends an HTTP status code from the 3xx class, which shall contain a Location header with an URI pointing to the endpoint of the other HSS (service) instance.

q_47996.question: When does the UE include the "Source end UE IP address" IE in the "ProSe direct link modification ack" message?
q_47996.ground_truth: The UE includes the "Source end UE IP address" IE in the "ProSe direct link modification ack" message if the IP communication is used, the UE acts as a 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-UE relay UE, and the 5G ProSe direct link is between the 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-UE relay UE and the target 5G ProSe layer-3 end UE.

q_47997.question: What type of network is required for EPS-based mobility between GERAN/UTRAN access and non-3GPP access?

q_47998.question: What are the conditions for a BL/CE UE to transmit a MAC PDU on PUSCH on the granted resources using DCI format 6-0B and a transport block size correspondent to the channel code rate?
q_47998.ground_truth: The conditions for a BL/CE UE to transmit a MAC PDU on PUSCH on the granted resources using DCI format 6-0B and a transport block size correspondent to the channel code rate are: the UE is in E-UTRA RRC_CONNECTED state, the UE has pending data for transmission, and receives a Resource Block Assignment correspondent to physical resource blocks and a modulation and coding scheme for PUSCH scheduling.

q_47999.question: Which enumerated value in AutonomousDenialParameters-r18 indicates the duration of 200 milliseconds?

q_48000.question: What should the UE do if it receives a new 5G-GUTI in step~2a and is registered to the same PLMN via both 3GPP and non-3GPP access?
q_48000.ground_truth: The UE should pass the new 5G-GUTI to its 3GPP access' lower layers.

q_48001.question: What is therole of the sl-CSI-ReportTimer in the Sidelink Channel State Information (SL-CSI) reporting procedure?
q_48001.ground_truth: The sl-CSI-ReportTimer is used by an SL-CSI reporting UE to follow the latency requirement signalled from a CSI triggering UE. The MAC entity maintains an sl-CSI-ReportTimer for each pair of the Source Layer-2 ID and the Destination Layer-2 ID corresponding to a PC5-RRC connection.

q_48002.question: What parameter in the 7.6.4 supplementary services sub-layer contains a string of unstructured information in an Unstructured Supplementary Service Data operation that is sent either by the mobile user or the network?

q_48003.question: What is the Dynamic policy in 5GMS System?
q_48003.ground_truth: Dynamic policy is a term used in 5GMS System to refer to a dynamic PCC Rule for an uplink or downlink application flow during a media session.

q_48004.question: What message does the UE include in the mbms-FreqList if the set of MBMS frequencies of interest is not empty?
q_48004.ground_truth: The UE includes the MBMS frequencies of interest, using the EARFCN corresponding with freqBandIndicator included in SystemInformationBlockType1 for the serving frequency and the EARFCN(s) as included in SystemInformationBlockType15 for neighboring frequencies.

q_48005.question: Which test model in E-UTRA is used for testing output power dynamics and transmitted signal quality?
q_48005.ground_truth: E-UTRA Test Model 3.1 (E-SAN-TM3.1) is used for testing output power dynamics and transmitted signal quality.

q_48006.question: What parameter indicates by its presence that the Network Node Number sent by the HLR, SMS-Router or IP-SM-GW is to be considered as the SGSN number?

q_48007.question: What is the impact of the V field in the Extended Power Headroom MAC control element when it is set to 0 for Type 1 PH?
q_48007.ground_truth: When the V field is set to 0 for Type 1 PH, it indicates that real transmission on PUSCH is used and the associated PCMAX,c field is present.

q_48008.question: As per step 9.6, when should the SS transmit a random access response containing a random access preamble identifier corresponding to the transmitted random access?
q_48008.ground_truth: The SS shall transmit a random access response containing a random access preamble identifier corresponding to the transmitted random access after the first preamble has been received by the SS, as per step 9.6 and 9.2.

q_48009.question: What is the main function of the Scene Manager in AR and MR applications?
q_48009.ground_truth: The Scene Manager in AR and MR applications is responsible for managing a scene graph that represents an object-based hierarchy of the geometry of a scene and allows interaction with the scene.

q_48010.question: When does the UE omit the octets containing Power Headroom field and PCMAX,f,c field for Serving Cells in the other MAC entity?
q_48010.ground_truth: The UE may omit the octets containing Power Headroom field and PCMAX,f,c field for Serving Cells in the other MAC entity except for the PCell in the other MAC entity when the UE does not support dynamic power sharing in a band combination.

q_48011.question: What protocol is used in the MP-DCCP-LL solution to support the multipath scenario and provide access traffic steering, switching, and splitting?
q_48011.ground_truth: The MP-DCCP protocol, as specified in draft-ietf-tsvwg-multipath-dccp, is used in the MP-DCCP-LL solution to support the multipath scenario and provide access traffic steering, switching, and splitting.

q_48012.question: How should the UE select the synchronization carrier frequency from the concerned frequency(ies) included in syncFreqList when at least one SyncRef UE with SLSSID=0 is detected on at least one frequency from the concerned frequency(ies)?
q_48012.ground_truth: The UE should select one frequency from the concerned frequency(ies) with the SyncRef UE(s) with SLSSID=0 detected as the synchronization carrier frequency.

q_48013.question: What should be done with the UE Inactive AS context after discarding the used nextHopChainingCount value associated to the current KgNB?
q_48013.ground_truth: The UE Inactive AS context should be discarded.

q_48014.question: What is the defined behavior for a SC UE when it receives a SIP INVITE request that contains a STN-SR, regarding video media components?
q_48014.ground_truth: Video media components are not removed, and the remote leg is not released when the SC UE receives a SIP INVITE request that contains a STN-SR.

q_48015.question: What should the MCVideo client do if an emergency indication is included in an incoming SIP INVITE request?
q_48015.ground_truth: If the SIP INVITE request contains an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body with the <mcvideo-Params> element containing the <emergency-ind> element set to a value of "true", the MCVideo client should display an indication of an MCVideo emergency group call to the user and set the MCVideo emergency group state to "MVEG 2: in-progress".

q_48016.question: What is the purpose of the "PowerSaving" feature when providing assistance information to enable UE power saving management?
q_48016.ground_truth: The PCF sends UL and/or DL Periodicity information, and based on the presence of the "periodInfo" attribute, may send Traffic Parameter(s) measurement required to the UPF.

q_48017.question: What is the threshold for reducing the A-MPR by 1 dB when dynamic power sharing is not supported?
q_48017.ground_truth: The A-MPR is reduced by 1 dB for B < 2.0.

q_48018.question: What is the purpose of the "Number of failed legacy handover preparations" measurement in 5G mobility management?
q_48018.ground_truth: This measurement is used to provide the number of failed legacy handover preparations received by the source NR cell CU, which is split into subcounters per failure cause.

q_48019.question: What is the parameter that the minimum number of successful tests should be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95% for the test to pass?
q_48019.ground_truth: The total number of successful tests should be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95% for the test to pass.

q_48020.question: What is the applicable test applicability for spurious response of category M1 as defined in 7.7A.2?
q_48020.ground_truth: This test case applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 17 and forward of category M1 that support satellite access operation.

q_48021.question: What information should be included in the NF Service Consumer's POST request to request the AMF to create a broadcast MBS session context?
q_48021.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer's POST request to request the AMF to create a broadcast MBS session context shall contain the following information: MBS Session ID (i.e. TMGI, or TMGI and NID for an MBS session in an SNPN), list of Area Session ID and related MBS service area (for a Location dependent broadcast MBS service), MBS service area (for a Local broadcast MBS session), N2 MBS Session Management container, Notification URI, and SNSSAI. Additionally, the NF Service Consumer may include the maxResponseTime IE, MB-SMF instance ID, MB-SMF service instance ID, and MBS associated session ID.

q_48022.question: What is the difference between "modal verbs" and "normal verbs" in 3GPP technical specifications?
q_48022.ground_truth: Modal verbs in 3GPP technical specifications indicate a requirement or recommendation, while normal verbs indicate a statement of fact.

q_48023.question: In the test procedure for power measurements, what should be the measurement period for UE output power for category NB1 and NB2?
q_48023.ground_truth: The measurement period for UE output power for category NB1 and NB2 should be 1 sub-frame excluding transient periods.

q_48024.question: What is the definition of "necessary bandwidth" in the 3GPP technical specification on EMC requirements for 3rd generation digital cellular mobile terminals and ancillary equipment?
q_48024.ground_truth: The "necessary bandwidth" is the width of the frequency band that is just sufficient to ensure the transmission of information at the rate and with the quality required under specified conditions.

q_48025.question: In which cases can Network based SL Positioning be used for UE with NAS connection in 5GC Sidelink Positioning?
q_48025.ground_truth: Network based SL Positioning can be used for UE with NAS connection in 5GC Sidelink Positioning when the Target UE can establish a NAS signalling connection with the AMF and when 5GC is involved for Sidelink Positioning.

q_48026.question: What message is sent by the participating function to initiate the use of a MBMS bearer for a new conversation in an ongoing group session?
q_48026.ground_truth: The Map Group To Bearer message is sent by the participating function to initiate the use of a MBMS bearer for a new conversation in an ongoing group session.

q_48027.question: When must a UE transmit a PUCCH using all provided PRBs?
q_48027.ground_truth: A UE must transmit a PUCCH using all provided PRBs if the total number of UCI bits is greater than or equal to the product of the minimum number of PRBs, the number of subcarriers per resource block, the number of PUCCH symbols for the format, and the modulation order, and is not greater than the maximum number of PRBs, if a code rate and modulation scheme are provided.

q_48028.question: What is the difference between the "UE-originated API invocation" and the "AF-originated API invocation" scenarios?
q_48028.ground_truth: In the "UE-originated API invocation" scenario, the application on the UE invokes the northbound APIs, while in the "AF-originated API invocation" scenario, the AF invokes the northbound APIs and the application on the UE consumes the service from the AF.

q_48029.question: What is the parameter used in the 8.33 command to disable the voice mail number?
q_48029.ground_truth: The parameter used in the 8.33 command to disable the voice mail number is 0.

q_48030.question: What shall the UE do if a periodic/semi-persistent SRS transmission and PUSCH transmission carrying aperiodic CSI on a carrier of a serving cell in set Sc2 happen to overlap in the same symbol?
q_48030.ground_truth: The UE shall drop periodic/semi-persistent SRS whenever this happens.

q_48031.question: What is the requirement for identical packet filter identifiers when replacing all packet filters in a QoS rule?
q_48031.ground_truth: When modifying an existing QoS rule and replacing all packet filters, two or more packet filters in the resultant QoS rule must not have identical packet filter identifiers.

q_48032.question: What is the type of the MICO indication information element?
q_48032.ground_truth: The MICO indication is a type 1 information element.

q_48033.question: What can the MnS producer do based on the performance evaluation results?
q_48033.ground_truth: Based on the performance evaluation results, the MnS producer can take actions to avoid generating inaccurate model inference output.

q_48034.question: What is the pre-test condition for the UE in the test case described in 8.1.1.2a.3.1?
q_48034.ground_truth: The UE is in state Registered, Idle mode (state 2) and has received extended DRX parameters in the ATTACH ACCEPT message.

q_48035.question: When should the UE stop timer T3411 if the tracking area updating request is not for initiating a PDN connection for emergency bearer services and the TAI of the current serving cell is included in the TAI list?
q_48035.ground_truth: If the EPS update status is equal to EU1 UPDATED and the TIN does not indicate "P-TMSI", the UE should keep the EPS update status to EU1 UPDATED and enter state EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE, starting timer T3411.

q_48036.question: What is used for sending PMF messages to UE over 3GPP access if access performance measurements are performed only over the QoS Flow associated with the default QoS rule?
q_48036.ground_truth: One of the two MAC addresses provided in the Measurement Assistance Information is used for sending PMF messages to UE over 3GPP access if access performance measurements are performed only over the QoS Flow associated with the default QoS rule.

q_48037.question: What MIME body type should be included in a SIP MESSAGE request for binding a functional alias with an MCPTT group or a list of MCPTT groups for the MCPTT user?
q_48037.ground_truth: An application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body containing a <mcpttinfo> element with a <mcptt-Params> element should be included.

q_48038.question: What is required by the MCVideo client or MCVideo server to determine if an XML MIME body is integrity protected?
q_48038.ground_truth: The MCVideo client or MCVideo server needs to look for the `<Signature>` XML element in the XML MIME body, and if present, the content is integrity protected.

q_48039.question: What should an MTSI client in terminal sending or receiving media use as a trigger to detect a needed reduction in throughput of 10% or more?
q_48039.ground_truth: An MTSI client in terminal should use one or more triggers capable of detecting a needed reduction in throughput of 10% or more, which could be based on the reception of an RTCP Sender or Receiver Report.

q_48040.question: What is the meaning of "Connectivity Session Location and Repository Function" (CLF) in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_48040.ground_truth: The CLF is a function that registers the association between the IP address allocated to the UE and related network location information, including access transport equipment characteristics, line identifier, and IP Edge identity.
