q_48518.ground_truth: The transmission participant interface should send the Transmission Revoked message to the transmission participant, store an indication that a Transmission Ack message to a Transmission Revoked message is expected, and remain in the 'P: has permission' state.

q_48519.question: What is one of the functions of the LMF in Network based SL Positioning and Network assisted SL Positioning?
q_48519.ground_truth: One of the functions of the LMF in Network based SL Positioning and Network assisted SL Positioning is to determine the location of the Target UE based on the Ranging/SL positioning measurement data or result reported by the Target UE and the location of Located UE(s).

q_48520.question: What is the action taken by the IWF when it receives a group join request with an implicit floor request indication?
q_48520.ground_truth: The IWF sends a group join request and an implicit floor request to the MCPTT server.

q_48521.question: In which situations does the manufacturer of the base station (BS) need to declare the dynamic range of NB-IoT power it could support?
q_48521.ground_truth: The manufacturer of the base station (BS) needs to declare the dynamic range of NB-IoT power it could support in guard band operation with E-UTRA 5 MHz channel bandwidth signal.

q_48522.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP TS 38.102-0 document?
q_48522.ground_truth: The purpose of the 3GPP TS 38.102-0 document is to specify stage 2 of the UE Positioning function of NG-RAN, providing mechanisms to support or assist the calculation of the geographical position of a UE in NG-RAN.

q_48523.question: What is the role of the MME (Mobility Management Entity) in the E-UTRAN architecture?
q_48523.ground_truth: The MME is responsible for NAS signalling, NAS signalling security, AS Security control, selection of CIoT EPS optimizations, inter CN node signalling for mobility between 3GPP access networks, idle mode UE reachability, tracking area list management, PDN GW and Serving GW selection, MME selection for handovers with MME change, and SGSN selection for handover in the E-UTRAN architecture.

q_48524.question: What action should the NF Service Consumer (i.e. the AMF) take upon receiving a "200 OK" status code with EAP message in step 6a?
q_48524.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer (i.e. the AMF) shall forward the EAP message to the UE in NAS message.

q_48525.question: What is the purpose of the seamless path switch use case?
q_48525.ground_truth: The purpose is to switch from a UE-to-UE direct communication to an indirect communication via an evolved residential gateway.

q_48526.question: What data types can be used in the "Instance-ID-URN" and "IMEI-range" elements of the "MCPTTUEIDType" complex type?
q_48526.ground_truth: The "Instance-ID-URN" element can contain a "xs:anyURI" data type, while the "IMEI-range" element can contain an "IMEI-rangeType" data type.

q_48527.question: When an AS acting as a routeing B2BUA forwards a SIP request, what must it transparently forward?
q_48527.ground_truth: The AS must transparently forward a received Contact header field when the Contact header field contains a GRUU.

q_48528.question: What is the purpose of the additional field "a(n+1) to a(n+4)" in the Cause IE in GTPv2?
q_48528.ground_truth: This field is used to include the offending IE that caused the rejection, explicitly indicating the acceptance or rejection of the corresponding request message.

q_48529.question: What information is included in the Authentication Request sent from the UAS NF to the USS during the UUAA procedure at registration?
q_48529.ground_truth: The Authentication Request includes the GPSI, the CAA-Level UAV ID, a USS NF Routing information, and a transparent container.

q_48530.question: What is the requirement in this specification for a BS capable of multi-band operation supporting TDD operation for synchronized operation?
q_48530.ground_truth: The RF requirements in the present specification assume synchronized operation, where no simultaneous uplink and downlink occur between the supported operating bands.

q_48531.question: What should a UE do when it receives Serving PLMN rate control IE in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message?
q_48531.ground_truth: The UE shall store the Serving PLMN rate control IE value, replacing any existing value, and use the stored serving PLMN rate control value as the maximum allowed limit of uplink control plane user data for the corresponding PDU session.

q_48532.question: What is the service provided by the Access and Mobility Policy Control Service in the 5G System?
q_48532.ground_truth: The Access and Mobility Policy Control Service provides access control and mobility management related policies to the NF service consumer.

q_48533.question: What should the MCVideo client do when it receives a GROUP CALL BROADCAST message when not participating in an ongoing broadcast group call?
q_48533.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should store the information received in the GROUP CALL BROADCAST message as the call identifier, received current call type, SDP body, originating MCVideo user ID, and MCVideo group ID. If the MCVideo user acknowledgement is required, the MCVideo client should start timer TFB3 and enter the "B3: pending user action" state.

q_48534.question: What is the difference between a Class 1 and Class 2 EP in F1AP?
q_48534.ground_truth: A Class 1 EP in F1AP has a response (success or failure), while a Class 2 EP in F1AP does not have a response.

q_48535.question: How many separate timers will be started for each UE at the time of registration?
q_48535.ground_truth: Two separate timers will be started for each UE at the time of registration - one for when the UE is in CM-Idle State and the other for when the UE is in CM-Connected State.

q_48536.question: What is one method by which a UE can obtain the domain name and/or IP address of a Proxy-CSCF after establishing IP connectivity?
q_48536.ground_truth: The UE can use DHCP to obtain the domain name and/or IP address of a Proxy-CSCF and the address of a Domain Name Server (DNS) that is capable of resolving the Proxy-CSCF name.

q_48537.question: What are the test procedures for step 4 and onwards in the non-anchor carrier?
q_48537.ground_truth: The test procedures are the same as test procedures defined in 13.3.2.2.4.2, with step 4 and forward performed on the non-anchor carrier.

q_48538.question: What procedure takes place when a UE registered with an MME selects a UTRAN or GERAN cell and the SGW is changed?
q_48538.ground_truth: The Routing Area Update with SGW change procedure.

q_48539.question: What should the network include in the ue-CapabilityRAT-ContainerList if the ue-CapabilityRAT-RequestList contains a UE-CapabilityRAT-Request with rat-Type set to nr?
q_48539.ground_truth: The network should include in the ue-CapabilityRAT-ContainerList a UE-CapabilityRAT-Container of the type UE-NR-Capability and with the rat-Type set to nr, along with the supportedBandCombinationList, featureSets and featureSetCombinations.

q_48540.question: What is the procedure when a new SIP session is established for a group session in a controlling MCPTT function mode?
q_48540.ground_truth: When a group session is initiated, the floor control server interface stores a message sequence number value, generates a random temporary identifier for each MCPTT client, stores associations and capabilities, and initializes a 'floor participant interface state transition' state machine for each MCPTT client.

q_48541.question: What is the purpose of buffering downlink packets in UPF?
q_48541.ground_truth: Buffering downlink packets in UPF can be activated when the UP connection of a PDU Session is deactivated and is used to enable the SMF to check if the first report is also for the QoS Flow, and to forward the buffered downlink packets when the UP connection of the PDU Session is activated.

q_48542.question: Which type of Reference Measurement Channel (RMC) should be used for a UE supporting multi-DCI with separate transport blocks for receptions from different directions?
q_48542.ground_truth: The legacy RMC can be reused for each layer for a UE supporting multi-DCI with separate transport blocks for receptions from different directions.

q_48543.question: When setting rsIndexResults in measResultLastServCell, based on what should the available measurement quantities of the source PCell (in case of HO failure) or PCell (in case of RLF) be ordered?
q_48543.ground_truth: The rsIndexResults in measResultLastServCell should be ordered such that the highest SS/PBCH block RSRP is listed first if SS/PBCH block RSRP measurement results are available, otherwise the highest SS/PBCH block RSRQ is listed first if SS/PBCH block RSRQ measurement results are available, otherwise the highest SS/PBCH block SINR is listed first, based on the available SS/PBCH block based measurements collected up to the moment the UE detected failure.

q_48544.question: What is the defined value for the <state> parameter in the +CUAEACT command?
q_48544.ground_truth: The defined values for the <state> parameter in the +CUAEACT command are 0 for activate/active UAE layer support, and 1 for deactivate/deactivated UAE layer support.

q_48545.question: What does A.7.3.22 refer to in the 7.3.23.3 minimum conformance requirement?
q_48545.ground_truth: A.7.3.22 refers to the normative reference for the requirement that the transmitter power of the UE shall be turned off within 40 ms after expiry of T310 timer.

q_48546.question: In the case of a UE with scheduled communication patterns, what should the AMF consider when selecting a value for the Mobility Management back-off timer?
q_48546.ground_truth: The AMF may consider the UE's communication pattern when selecting a value for the Mobility Management back-off timer to ensure that the UE does not miss its only scheduled communication window.

q_48547.question: What is the result of the successful MCPTT emergency group call establishment?
q_48547.ground_truth: Once the MCPTT emergency group call has been successfully established, the LMR users via the IWF and the affiliated MCPTT clients have successfully established media plane for communication, with the MCPTT system where the interworking group is defined as the controlling system of the group call.

q_48548.question: What should the UE do when it receives a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message with reject cause #96?
q_48548.ground_truth: The UE sets the tracking area updating attempt counter to 5, starts timer T3402, and performs tracking area updating on the expiry of timers T3402.

q_48549.question: What network function is responsible for checking the authorization of UE1 and UE2 before providing their coarse location to the GMLC in the SL Positioning procedure?
q_48549.ground_truth: The AMF (Access and Mobility Management Function) is responsible for checking the authorization of UE1 and UE2 before providing their coarse location to the GMLC in the SL Positioning procedure.

q_48550.question: What is the basic measurement interval of modulated carrier frequency for UE category M1?
q_48550.ground_truth: The basic measurement interval of modulated carrier frequency is 1 UL timeslot (0.5ms) for UE category M1.

q_48551.question: What error is returned by the network when it is requested to perform an operation which is not compatible with the status of another supplementary service or the teleservice or bearer service for which the operation is requested?

q_48552.question: Under what condition can the maximum uplink packet size when using Ethernet be specified by the network for a PDU Session type Unstructured?
q_48552.ground_truth: In cases where the advertisement message conditions cannot be met, the maximum uplink packet size when using Ethernet can be provided by the network for a PDU Session type Unstructured.

q_48553.question: What is the recommended way to set the default inner MTU size at the PDN GW and UE/MS to avoid IP fragmentation?
q_48553.ground_truth: The recommendations on how to set the default inner MTU size at the PDN GW and UE/MS to avoid IP fragmentation of both inner IP packets and outer IP packets in the backbone are specified in clause 9.3 of 3GPP TS 23.060.

q_48554.question: What must the UE in RLC AM state ensure when it receives RLC AM PDU segments with segments lost?
q_48554.ground_truth: The UE must transmit STATUS PDU to request retransmission of missing segments.

q_48555.question: What is the uncertainty described by a "relative 2D location with uncertainty ellipse"?
q_48555.ground_truth: It describes a set of points which fall within or on the boundary of an ellipse with a semi-major axis of length r1, a semi-minor axis of length r2, and an angle of orientation A in a local 2D coordinate system.

q_48556.question: What should the SNRM-S do upon receiving an HTTP POST request message with a modification of unicast resources and the media bearer modification is required?
q_48556.ground_truth: The SNRM-S should send a SIP MESSAGE request containing the modified parameters of the unicast bearer.

q_48557.question: What action does the SCEF take if a request for deletion of a CP parameter set results in a request for modification of the non-overlapping CP parameter set?
q_48557.ground_truth: The SCEF sends an "Update CP Parameter Request" message with the updated CP parameter set and validity time to the HSS for provisioning to the MME.

q_48558.question: How many padding bytes should be added when the Monitoring State value is 253 bytes?
q_48558.ground_truth: 16 (because 16 is the smallest multiple of four larger than the length of the Monitoring State value, which is 253)

q_48559.question: How many bits are used for scheduling one TB in the "Scheduling TBs for Unicast" field?
q_48559.ground_truth: 12 bits are used for scheduling one TB in the "Scheduling TBs for Unicast" field.

q_48560.question: What reference point is used by the MC service server to indirectly interact with relevant 5GS control plane network functions?
q_48560.ground_truth: The N33~reference point is used by the MC service server to indirectly interact with relevant 5GS control plane network functions, towards the 5GS Network Exposure Function (NEF).

q_48561.question: What is the requirement for wide band intermodulation for intra-band non-contiguous CA?
q_48561.ground_truth: The UE should meet the requirements for each sub-block as specified in clause 7.8.2 and 7.8A.2.1 for one component carrier and two component carriers per sub-block, respectively, with out-of-gap interferers while all downlink carriers are active.

q_48562.question: What is the role of Network A in this use case?
q_48562.ground_truth: Network A provides access to the 3rd party provider's services, manages resources and policies for events, and validates user authorization for accessing the services.

q_48563.question: What is the role of the MB-SMF within the 5GC?
q_48563.ground_truth: The MB-SMF offers services to the SMF, AMF, AF/AS, MBSF, and NEF via the Nmbsmf service-based interface within the 5GC.

q_48564.question: What is the priority order for determining the active WLANSP rule if the UE is roaming and has not registered to any PLMN?
q_48564.ground_truth: The UE shall use WLANSP provided by HPLMN as valid while the UE has not registered to any PLMN during roaming.

q_48565.question: When should the MAC entity transmit the UL data and report a BSR indicating no more data in the buffer?
q_48565.ground_truth: The MAC entity should transmit the UL data and report a BSR indicating no more data in the buffer if there is pending data for transmission, and the UE has UL resources to send all pending data including the BSR.

q_48566.question: What should the MCData client do upon receiving a SIP 4xx response, SIP 5xx response or SIP 6xx response to the SIP re-INVITE request it sent for canceling an in-progress imminent peril condition?
q_48566.ground_truth: The MCData client should set the MCData imminent peril group state as "MDIG 2: in-progress", and if the SIP response did not contain an originated-by element, set the MCData emergency alert state to "MDEA 1: no-alert" if the mcdata-warn-code set to "149" in the Warning header field is not present in the SIP response.

q_48567.question: What information is provided to the BM-SC in the AAR seeking authorization for the roaming UE in visited PLMN?
q_48567.ground_truth: The AAR seeks authorization for the roaming UE to receive data from a particular service, and it contains the multicast IP address and identity of the user.

q_48568.question: What parameter indicates the delivery outcome at the SMSF for non-3GPP access?
q_48568.ground_truth: The "SMSF Non-3GPP SM Delivery Outcome" parameter.

q_48569.question: When the S-CSCF receives 180 (Ringing) or 200 (OK) responses containing the access-network-charging-info parameter in the P-Charging-Vector, where should it retain the access-network-charging-info parameter after storing it from the P-Charging-Vector header field?
q_48569.ground_truth: It should retain the access-network-charging-info parameter in the P-Charging-Vector header field when the response is forwarded to an AS.

q_48570.question: What message is sent by the SMF to the UPF (PSA) in step 7a?

q_48571.question: Which element in the "CancelProximityRsp-info" complex type is used to indicate a value for the cause of the PC3-EPC control protocol?

q_48572.question: What is the function of the Change Condition field in a container?
q_48572.ground_truth: The Change Condition field defines the reason for closing the container and can be set to various values, such as tariff time change, QoS change, or closing of the CDR.

q_48573.question: What is the role of the Network Function/NF Service Context Transfer Procedures in the 5GS and 5G QoS model?
q_48573.ground_truth: The Network Function/NF Service Context Transfer Procedures allow transfer of Service Context of a NF/NF Service from a Source NF/NF Service Instance to the Target NF/NF Service Instance, e.g. before the Source NF/NF Service can gracefully close its NF/NF Service.

q_48574.question: What is the role of the Sh interface between the HSS and an AS in IMS?
q_48574.ground_truth: The Sh interface facilitates the transfer of service data between the HSS and an AS. It is used to ensure sharing and synchronization of Service Data between multiple ASs, allowing for efficient management and maintenance of user-specific service information.

q_48575.question: When evaluating a threshold condition associated with a 3GPP access threshold, what comparison does the UE perform?
q_48575.ground_truth: The UE compares the associated 3GPP access threshold with the corresponding measured value.

q_48576.question: When should a remote UE initiate the TMGI monitoring request procedure?
q_48576.ground_truth: A remote UE should initiate the TMGI monitoring request procedure when it is triggered by an upper layer application to receive MBMS content for a given TMGI, the TMGI monitoring refresh timer T4104 has expired, it receives a request to change the requested ProSe Per-Packet Priority for the TMGI, or it receives a request to change the requested MBMS SAI list for the TMGI.

q_48577.question: What is the ultimate output of SECAM evaluation for 3GPP virtualized network products?
q_48577.ground_truth: The ultimate output of the SECAM evaluation for type 1 of 3GPP virtualized network products is an evaluation report demonstrating compliance of the network product with the 3GPP security assurance specifications, evidence of compliance with the vendor's product and development lifecycle processes, and evidence that the actors performing the evaluation tasks are accredited by the SECAM Accreditation Body.

q_48578.question: What is the task of the MB-SMF when it receives no data for an MBS session for a certain period of time?
q_48578.ground_truth: The MB-SMF sends a MB-N4 Notification (N4 Session ID) to the MB-UPF to deactivate the MBS session if it detects that there is no data received for the MBS session for a certain period of time.

q_48579.question: What should the UE and PGW-U+UPF / SCEF+NEF store when being handed over from 5GS to EPS, in terms of APN Rate Control parameters and APN Rate Control Status?
q_48579.ground_truth: The UE and PGW-U+UPF / SCEF+NEF store the APN Rate Control parameters and APN Rate Control Status while the UE is served by 5GS, so they can be used if the UE moves back to EPS.

q_48580.question: Under what circumstance will the MS enter the GMM-REGISTERED.UPDATE-NEEDED substate?
q_48580.ground_truth: If the MS has to perform a routing area updating procedure, but its access class is not allowed.

q_48581.question: What is the solution described in clause 7.25.2.2.2 providing in regards to ACR between EAS and CAS?
q_48581.ground_truth: The solution enables application service continuity using EDGEAPP mechanisms and supports existing 5 ACR scenarios including service continuity planning in the relocation of application session between EAS and CAS.

q_48582.question: What must the controlling MCData function include in the generated SIP re-INVITE, when cancelling the in-progress emergency state of an MCData group?
q_48582.ground_truth: The controlling MCData function must include a Resource-Priority header field populated with the values for a normal MCData group communication and an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body with the <emergency-ind> element set to a value of "false".

q_48583.question: How does the document address the authenticity of system information?
q_48583.ground_truth: The authenticity is provided by signing system information with a private key only known to the signing party. Authenticity of the received system information is ensured in any RRC state.

q_48584.question: When M is defined as in the equation for MPR to meet -13dBm/MHz, what is MPR for PC2 with indicating dualPA-Architecture supported when B is less than 0.54?

q_48585.question: What should the participating MCVideo function do if the <RemoteGroupSelectionURIList> element does not exist or the MCVideo ID contained in the <mcvideo-request-uri> element does not match with one of the <entry> elements of the <RemoteGroupSelectionURIList> element?
q_48585.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function should reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response and include warning text to indicate that the user is not authorized to change the user's selected group.

q_48586.question: What should a receiving node do when it receives a message initiating a procedure that is missing one or more IEs/IE groups with specified criticality "Ignore IE and Notify Sender"?
q_48586.ground_truth: The receiving node should ignore that those IEs are missing and continue with the procedure based on the other IEs/IE groups present in the message, and report in the response message of the procedure that one or more IEs/IE groups were missing.

q_48587.question: When the P-CSCF receives a request containing a Contact header field with a GRUU, what should it save and associate with the request?
q_48587.ground_truth: The P-CSCF shall save the GRUU received in the Contact header field of the request and associate it with the UE IP address and UE port such that the P-CSCF is able to route target refresh request containing that GRUU in the Request-URI.

q_48588.question: What is the effect of the compromised UE on the transport of PMFP messages, even though transport of PMFP messages between the UE and the UPF is protected?
q_48588.ground_truth: A compromised UE can still send false or incorrect PMFP messages, despite the protection on the transport of PMFP messages.

q_48589.question: In 3GPP TR 38.902, what is the difference between the modulation orders of the PDSCH of paired UEs?
q_48589.ground_truth: The modulation orders of the PDSCH of paired UEs can be selected independently.

q_48590.question: What is an MCPTT server required to support to be compliant with the procedures in the present document?
q_48590.ground_truth: An MCPTT server must support the MCPTT server procedures defined in 3GPP TS 23.379, implement the role of an AS performing 3rd party call control acting as a routing B2BUA as defined in 3GPP TS 24.229, and support the GCS AS procedures defined in 3GPP TS 23.468 for unicast delivery, MBMS delivery and service continuity.

q_48591.question: What happens when the Payload container IE of the DL NAS TRANSPORT message successfully passes the integrity check in the UE policy delivery procedures?
q_48591.ground_truth: The received UE parameter update counter is stored, and the procedure depends on the type of UE parameters update data set present.

q_48592.question: What should the MCVideo client do upon receiving a PRIVATE CALL ACCEPT message response to PRIVATE CALL SETUP REQUEST message with the same call identifier, when in the "P2: waiting for call response" state and the subsequent PRIVATE CALL ACCEPT message does not contain a terminating transmission participant?
q_48592.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should not start transmission control as the terminating transmission participant.

q_48593.question: What is the parameter value of L when conducting transmission in the following slot for a UE supporting less than one slot length of UL transmission?

q_48594.question: What should happen if a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message is received without integrity protection or it fails the integrity check and the UE provided specific information elements in the message?
q_48594.ground_truth: The MME should initiate a security mode control procedure to take a new mapped EPS security context into use.

q_48595.question: What is verified in 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-UE relay for the relayed service when using the user plane?
q_48595.ground_truth: The traffic type of the relayed service is verified (i.e. IP, Ethernet or Unstructured) in 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-UE relay when using the user plane.

q_48596.question: What action is taken by the UE when it receives a serving PLMN rate control IE in the ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message?
q_48596.ground_truth: The UE stores the serving PLMN rate control IE value as the maximum allowed limit of uplink User data container IEs for the corresponding PDN connection.

q_48597.question: What is the format of the least significant bit of a field in a 3GPP-specific coding information?
q_48597.ground_truth: The least significant bit of a field is represented by the lowest numbered bit of the highest numbered octet of the field. When the field extends over more than one octet, the order of bit values progressively decreases as the octet number increases.

q_48598.question: What is the effect of the presence of the <on-network-temporary> element in the <list-service> element of the MCS group document?
q_48598.ground_truth: The MCS group is a temporary MCS group when the <on-network-temporary> element is present in the <list-service> element of the MCS group document.

q_48599.question: In the "determine the candidate number of MCVideo group IDs" section, what does the term "candidate MCVideo group IDs" refer to?
q_48599.ground_truth: It refers to the different MCVideo group IDs which have an MCVideo group information entry in the candidate list or in an MCVideo client information entry that is not equal to the served MCVideo client ID.

q_48600.question: What is the difference between 5GMSd Media Player and third party player?
q_48600.ground_truth: 5GMSd Media Player is a UE function that enables playback and rendering of a media presentation based on a Media Player Entry, while third party player is a part of an application that uses APIs to exercise selected 5GMSd functions to play back media content. The main difference is that 5GMSd Media Player is a module defined in the 5GMS architecture, while the third party player is an external application that uses the APIs to access the 5GMS functions.

q_48601.question: How does the MCPTT server resolve a functional alias to an MCPTT ID?
q_48601.ground_truth: The MCPTT server 1 sends an MCPTT functional alias resolution request message to the MCPTT FA controlling server 1 to resolve the functional alias of the called party. The MCPTT FA controlling server 1 forwards the request to the appropriate server that can resolve the functional alias and return the corresponding MCPTT ID to MCPTT server 1.

q_48602.question: What information is included in the Discovery Request message sent from the Discoverer UE to the 5G DDNMF in its HPLMN in the context of ProSe Direct Discovery?
q_48602.ground_truth: The Discovery Request message sent from the Discoverer UE to the 5G DDNMF in its HPLMN includes the RPAUID and its PC5 UE security capability in the context of ProSe Direct Discovery.

q_48603.question: What should a UE do if it supports sfn-DefaultDL-BeamSetup-r17 for DCI scheduling without TCI field, but does not support sfn-SchemeA-DynamicSwitching-r17 or sfn-SchemeB-DynamicSwitching-r17?
q_48603.ground_truth: The UE should be activated with the CORESET with two TCI states.

q_48604.question: What is the common coverage requirement for inter-band CA in this sub-clause?
q_48604.ground_truth: The common coverage requirement is determined as a percentage, where the percentage is the percentile value in the specification of spherical coverage for that power class from clause 7.3.4.

q_48605.question: What aspects of clause 6.3.1.1 are for future consideration regarding relaxation, measurement uncertainties, and test tolerances?
q_48605.ground_truth: For power classes 2, 4, 6, and 7, the relaxation, measurement uncertainties, and test tolerances are for future consideration in clause 6.3.1.1.

q_48606.question: What are the key issues identified for supporting the exposure of Time Synchronization charging?

q_48607.question: What is the root element of the GMOP document?
q_48607.ground_truth: The root element of the GMOP document is the '<document>' element.

q_48608.question: When should the SS activate SCell2, SCell3, SCell4, SCell5, and SCell6 during the activation of SCell1 in step 7?
q_48608.ground_truth: The SS should activate SCell2 in subframe (m+10) for FDD PCell and (m+15) for TDD PCell, SCell 3 in subframe (m+20) for FDD PCell and (m+15) for TDD PCell, SCell 4 in subframe (m+30) for FDD PCell and (m+15) for TDD PCell, SCell 5 in subframe (m+40) for FDD PCell and (m+15) for TDD PCell and SCell 6 in subframe (m+50) for FDD PCell and (m+15) for TDD PCell by sending the activation MAC-CE.

q_48609.question: What is the test requirement for the FDD WB-RSRQ absolute accuracy for carrier aggregation in 3GPP TS 36.133?
q_48609.ground_truth: The test requirement is that the ratio of successful reported values for each test must be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

q_48610.question: What information does the AF collect in step 1 for running FL training on the AI/ML application server?
q_48610.ground_truth: The AF collects information such as FL aggregated model size, potential FL members, model aggregation latency target in each iteration, expected number of iterations, and time interval between iterations. It also collects information about local model size, time window(s) when FL training needs to be performed, and the option to request the geographical distribution of FL members.

q_48611.question: What is the significance of the "complexQuery" query parameter in relation to other query parameters in a single request message?
q_48611.ground_truth: If a query parameter is included in the "complexQuery", then the same query parameter shall not be included outside the "complexQuery" in the same request message.

q_48612.question: What action should the MS take if timer T3396 is zero?
q_48612.ground_truth: The MS shall stop timer T3396 associated with the corresponding APN, if running, and may send another ACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT REQUEST, ACTIVATE SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST or MODIFY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message for the same APN.

q_48613.question: What does the execution command +CUSATW do in USAT profile writing?
q_48613.ground_truth: The execution command +CUSATW stores the given profile to non-volatile memory in the MT.

q_48614.question: What resources does the "PS User State" resource represent in the Nhss-ims-sdm API?
q_48614.ground_truth: The "PS User State" resource represents the User State information in PS domain in the Nhss-ims-sdm API.

q_48615.question: What should the MCVideo client do when it receives a SIP re-INVITE request containing an imminentperil-ind element set to "false" in the MIME body?
q_48615.ground_truth: It should display to the MCVideo user the MCVideo ID of the MCVideo user cancelling the MCVideo imminent peril group call and an indication that this is an MCVideo imminent peril group call.

q_48616.question: What must the UAV include in the PDU session establishment request when it determines a new dedicated PDU session is required for C2 communication to UAV-C?
q_48616.ground_truth: The UAV must include a CAA-Level UAV ID, a C2 Aviation Payload for C2 authorization, and optionally identification information for the UAV-C to pair in the PDU session establishment request.

q_48617.question: What SNR level is required for 256QAM to reach saturation in throughput performance at 39GHz for MCS21, and what SNR level is needed for MCS23, if saturation is not seen within the simulated SNR range?
q_48617.ground_truth: An SNR level of 24dB is needed for MCS21 at 39GHz. For MCS23, there is no saturation seen within the simulated SNR range.

q_48618.question: In the SLM server CoAP procedure, what should the SLM-S do if it is authorized to report location information after receiving a CoAP PUT request message containing the specified parameters?
q_48618.ground_truth: The SLM-S should store the received location information of the reporting SLM-C and use the location information as needed.

q_48619.question: What is the requirement for an implementation supporting SL-RTT, SL-AoA, SL-TDOA, or SL-TOA in the SLPP-PDU-Definitions?
q_48619.ground_truth: An implementation supporting SL-RTT, SL-AoA, SL-TDOA, or SL-TOA must also support the SLPP-PDU-CommonSL-PRS-MethodsContents PDU.

q_48620.question: What action should an SGM-C take upon receiving an HTTP 200 (OK) response when sending a group list fetch request using HTTP POST method to the SGM-S?
q_48620.ground_truth: The SGM-C should notify the VAL user about the list of the groups where the VAL UE is a member based on the user's request.

q_48621.question: What must a participating MCPTT function do upon receipt of a SIP MESSAGE request indicating successful delivery of emergency notification, if it cannot process the request due to lack of resources or risk of congestion?
q_48621.ground_truth: It may reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response and include a Retry-After header field in the response.

q_48622.question: How is horizontal speed encoded in the velocity coding scheme?
q_48622.ground_truth: It is encoded in increments of 1 kilometre per hour using a 16 bit binary coded number N.

q_48623.question: In case of pre-Rel-12 MEs, what action should UICC take if the AUTHENTICATE command is executed before the pairing procedure has been successfully performed?
q_48623.ground_truth: The UICC may need to trigger a network attachment procedure by sending a proactive command REFRESH(3G SESSION RESET).

q_48624.question: What type of data carrier is CRITICALITY in the context of X2AP-PROTOCOL-IES?
q_48624.ground_truth: It represents the criticality of a specific event or condition in the context of X2AP (5G X2 interface signalling)

q_48625.question: What shall the UE set in the EVENTNOTIFICATION bit in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message if the UE supports event notification?
q_48625.ground_truth: The UE shall set the EventNotification bit to "Event notification supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message if the UE supports event notification.

q_48626.question: What does the eMBMS delivery feature in the 5GMS system support?
q_48626.ground_truth: The delivery of downlink media streaming content via eMBMS User Services sessions

q_48627.question: What information is used by the Media Unit Identification in the UE to detect the media specific properties of packets?
q_48627.ground_truth: Media Unit Identification may utilize techniques such as DPI (Deep Packet Inspection), and examination of RTP (Real-time Transport Protocol) headers to determine the media units associated with a packet. In the case of RTP headers, the AF (Application Function) may provide information regarding the RTP header to be detected.

q_48628.question: Under what conditions should the target UE abort the PC5 unicast link identifier update procedure?
q_48628.ground_truth: The target UE should abort the PC5 unicast link identifier update procedure if timer T5010 expires, after reaching the maximum number of allowed retransmissions, or after sending the DIRECT LINK IDENTIFIER UPDATE ACCEPT message and not receiving the traffic from the initiating UE with the new layer-2 IDs during an implementation specific time that is greater than the value of timer T5010.

q_48629.question: Which reference point is leveraged for service parameter provisioning in 5G System?
q_48629.ground_truth: The AF-based service parameter provisioning for A2X communications in 5G System leverages the NEF services to enable communication between NFs in the PLMN and A2X Application Server.

q_48630.question: When is the Location Report procedure initiated and what information does it provide?
q_48630.ground_truth: The Location Report procedure is initiated by the eNB to report the current location information of a specific UE as a standalone report or every time the UE changes cell.

q_48631.question: What action should be taken if the SIP re-INVITE request contains an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body with the <imminentperil-ind> element set to a value of "false" and the in-progress imminent peril state of the group is "true"?
q_48631.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function should validate the SIP re-INVITE request for a normal priority MCVideo group call and send a SIP 200 (OK) response if valid. If not, it should perform the actions specified in clause~6.3.3.1.8 and proceed with the rest of the steps.

q_48632.question: What action should the floor control interface take when it receives RTP media packets from the MCPTT client and the MCPTT client is not permitted to send media?
q_48632.ground_truth: When the MCPTT client is not permitted to send media, the floor control interface shall not request the network media interface in the MCPTT server to forward RTP media packets from the MCPTT client to the media distributor in the MCPTT server. The floor control interface enters the 'U: not permitted but sends media' state, and upon the expiry of timer T8 (Floor Revoke), it sends a Floor Revoke message to the associated floor participant, including in the Rejection Cause field the value set to #3 (No permission to send a Media Burst).

q_48633.question: What should the MCData MESSAGE request include in the P-Asserted-Identity header field?
q_48633.ground_truth: The MCData MESSAGE request should include the public service identity of the participating MCData function in the P-Asserted-Identity header field.

q_48634.question: What action should the UE take when the UE is in EMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH state and the TAI of the current cell belongs to the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming"?
q_48634.ground_truth: The UE should not attempt to send a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message, instead, the UE should wait until it enters a cell not in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming" to initiate the TRACKING AREA UPDATE procedure.

q_48635.question: What is the purpose of the RPAUID in the context of ProSe direct discovery?
q_48635.ground_truth: The RPAUID is used for restricted ProSe direct discovery, identifying application related information for the ProSe-enabled UE.

q_48636.question: What is the purpose of the "MP-DCCP Connection Setup information" in the MA PDU Session Modification procedure?
q_48636.ground_truth: To determine which MP-DCCP connection to release or establish after the procedure is completed

q_48637.question: What is the purpose of the test specified in 6.2.2.1.1.2 of the document?
q_48637.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify the variance of the wideband CQI reports is within the limits defined and a PDSCH BLER of 10-5 falls between the transport format based median CQI-1 and median CQI or the transport format based median CQI and median CQI +1.

q_48638.question: What is the maximum relative velocity between two vehicles in NR V2X?
q_48638.ground_truth: The maximum relative velocity between two vehicles in NR V2X is 500 km/h.

q_48639.question: What is the procedure called when a new eNB requests the AMF to resume the UE context in 5GS?

q_48640.question: What is the maximum number of consecutive SSB symbols that can overlap with CSI-RS symbols without any measurement restrictions if the UE supports simultaneousRxDataSSB-DiffNumerology?
q_48640.ground_truth: There is no limit on the number of consecutive SSB symbols that can overlap with CSI-RS symbols without any measurement restrictions if the UE supports simultaneousRxDataSSB-DiffNumerology.

q_48641.question: What is the purpose of the PLMN solicitation procedure defined in clause 5.3A.2?
q_48641.ground_truth: The purpose of the PLMN solicitation procedure defined in clause 5.3A.2 is for the UE to determine which PLMNs are available from each WLAN on the list of available WLANs using the WLAN selection procedure described in clause 5.3.2.

q_48642.question: What is the purpose of the ciphering function in the EPS control plane?
q_48642.ground_truth: The ciphering function is performed in the PDCP for the control plane and includes both ciphering and deciphering of the data part of the PDCP PDU and the MAC-I.

q_48643.question: What is the format of the OTDOAInformationRequest message, which is used to request information necessary for OTDOA-based positioning?
q_48643.ground_truth: The OTDOAInformationRequest message is a sequence consisting of protocolIEs, which is a ProtocolIE-Container for OTDOAInformationRequest-IEs. The OTDOAInformationRequest-IEs may include information such as OTDOA-Information-Type-Item and ID-id-OTDOA-Information-Type-Item.

q_48644.question: In the example, what is the wake-up mechanism used for the head-end server to contact end devices for data retrieval?
q_48644.ground_truth: Smart Grid sector specifications have standardized wake-up mechanisms for the head-end server to contact end devices for data retrieval, so that the data can be fetched within the service window determined by a specific business process.

q_48645.question: When measuring and reporting DL RSCPD for DL UE positioning, what should the reference nr-DL-PRS-ReferenceInfo be?
q_48645.ground_truth: The reference nr-DL-PRS-ReferenceInfo should be the same as the one reported for the RSTD measurements.

q_48646.question: What must the Charging ID be assigned for in a PDN connection?
q_48646.ground_truth: The Charging ID is assigned for the PDN connection for charging correlation purposes.

q_48647.question: What message type and direction are used for a UE to send a private remote video push request message to another UE?
q_48647.ground_truth: "PRIVATE REMOTE VIDEO PUSH REQUEST" and "UE to another UE"

q_48648.question: Which field is mandatory supported if the UE supports conditional handover between FDD and TDD cells?
q_48648.ground_truth: The "cho-TwoTriggerEvents-r16" field is mandatory supported if the UE supports conditional handover between FDD and TDD cells.

q_48649.question: What is the purpose of SDPCapNeg in RTP profile negotiation?
q_48649.ground_truth: SDPCapNeg is used in RTP profile negotiation to enable MTSI clients to negotiate and select the appropriate RTP profiles for each media type.

q_48650.question: Who sends the INITIAL UE MESSAGE message to the AMF in the specified context?
q_48650.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node sends the INITIAL UE MESSAGE message to the AMF.

q_48651.question: When does the NG-RAN enforce the UE-Slice-MBR for a UE?
q_48651.ground_truth: The NG-RAN enforces the UE-Slice-MBR for a UE when it receives a UE-Slice-MBR for a UE from the AMF and the UE has active user plane PDU Sessions corresponding to the S-NSSAI.

q_48652.question: What should a UE do when the tracking area updating procedure is rejected due to inter-system change from N1 mode to S1 mode and the MME does not support N26 interface?
q_48652.ground_truth: The MME should send a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message with EMM cause value #9 "UE identity cannot be derived by the network."

q_48653.question: What is the purpose of confidentiality protection in XML encryption?
q_48653.ground_truth: Confidentiality protection is applied to XML elements to protect sensitive information from unauthorized entities. This can be applied to individual identifiers and values, or to the entire XML document.

q_48654.question: What should the MBMS GW do when it fails?
q_48654.ground_truth: When a MBMS GW fails, all the MBMS Bearer contexts affected by the failure become invalid and will be deleted. The MME and SGSN should initiate a M3AP Reset procedure or MBMS Session Stop procedure towards the MCE(s) to deactivate the affected MBMS services. The BM-SC should clean-up internal resources associated with the lost SGmb Diameter session(s) and re-establish the active MBMS bearer services affected by the MBMS GW restart by initiating MBMS Session Start procedure(s) towards the restarted MBMS GW.

q_48655.question: In which message(s) does the SMF send the "edge-anchored" and "5GC-preference" or "3GPP-access-preference" indications?
q_48655.ground_truth: The SMF sends the "edge-anchored" and "5GC-preference" or "3GPP-access-preference" indications in the ePCO (EAPCE at the UE) of the PDU Session Establishment Accept message or PDU Session Modification Command.

q_48656.question: What subframe should the SS receive the first CSI report for intra-band CA UE in step 6b if subframe (m+8) was subject to interruption?

q_48657.question: Which parameters may the NWDAF receiving the ML model use to check authorization when retrieving the ML model from ADRF?
q_48657.ground_truth: The NWDAF may be authorized by the ML model provider when retrieving the ML model from ADRF. The details of the authorization procedure will be discussed in SA3 WG.

q_48658.question: What is the symbol used in this specification to represent Energy Per Resource Element in Downlink?

q_48659.question: What is the purpose of the "User Id of the Transmitting User" field in the Receive media response message?
q_48659.ground_truth: The "User Id of the Transmitting User" field in the Receive media response message identifies the MCVideo Id of the user whose media transmission has been requested to be received.

q_48660.question: When secondary RAT usage data reporting is ongoing, how often is a RAN Usage Data Report message sent for periodic reporting purposes?
q_48660.ground_truth: The eNodeB shall send a RAN Usage Data Report message for periodic reporting purposes to the MME only when the timer set for the time interval for Secondary RAT usage data reporting expires for a UE for which Secondary RAT usage data reporting is ongoing.

q_48661.question: In the context of the 7.43 Implementation, what does the "not camped on CSG Cell" error mean?
q_48661.ground_truth: The "not camped on CSG Cell" error is returned when the ME is not currently camped on a CSG Cell when the +CCSGS read command is issued.

q_48662.question: What is one of the usages of the performance measurements for the distribution of RSRP per SSB, per SSB of neighbor NR cell, and per neighbor E-UTRAN cell?
q_48662.ground_truth: One usage of these performance measurements is to support MDA (Minimization of Drive Tests).

q_48663.question: How can the cSEPP handle an N32-f error response received from the pSEPP due to an encryption policy mismatch?
q_48663.ground_truth: The cSEPP can change the data type encryption policy to 'Parameter shall be encrypted' or 'Parameter shall not be encrypted', if allowed by local policies, and re-negotiate the data type encryption policy with the peer SEPP.

q_48664.question: What list is provided by the MME to E-UTRAN during handover, and what is its content?
q_48664.ground_truth: The MME provides E-UTRAN with a Handover Restriction List containing a list of PLMN IDs as specified by TS~23.251.

q_48665.question: What procedure is used by a UE to retrieve on-demand system information, including Human Readable localized services information, from a network?
q_48665.ground_truth: The UE performs a random access procedure to request on-demand system information by setting raPurpose to requestForOtherSI or msg3RequestForOtherSI and setting intendedSIBs to indicate that it wants to receive the SIBxx as a result of the SI request.

q_48666.question: What is the condition for two measurement gap occasions to be considered colliding?
q_48666.ground_truth: Two measurement gap occasions are considered colliding if at least one of the following conditions is met: (i) the two occasions are fully or partially overlapping in time domain, or (ii) the distance between the two occasions is equal to or smaller than 4ms.

q_48667.question: How many bits is the UL index field in the DCI format 0C?
q_48667.ground_truth: The UL index field in the DCI format 0C is 2 bits.

q_48668.question: What are the two capabilities provided by exposure of time synchronization in the 5G system?
q_48668.ground_truth: The two capabilities provided by exposure of time synchronization are learning the 5GS and/or UE availability and capabilities for time synchronization service and controlling activation and deactivation of the time synchronization service for the target UE(s).

q_48669.question: What is the maximum number of FeatureSets (size of the pool) for E-UTRA UL?

q_48670.question: When should all BFRs triggered for a Serving Cell be cancelled?
q_48670.ground_truth: All BFRs triggered for a Serving Cell should be cancelled when a MAC PDU is transmitted and this PDU includes an Enhanced BFR MAC CE or Truncated Enhanced BFR MAC CE which contains beam failure recovery information of that Serving Cell.

q_48671.question: What is the meaning of the term "presence" in the context of XR?
q_48671.ground_truth: In the context of XR, presence refers to the feeling of being physically and spatially located in the virtual environment.

q_48672.question: What are the possible traffic descriptors for the URSP rules for NAUN3 devices connected to the 5G-RG?
q_48672.ground_truth: The possible traffic descriptors for the URSP rules for NAUN3 devices connected to the 5G-RG are IP descriptors, non-IP descriptors, and Connectivity Group ID. The IP descriptors are matched against header information contained in IP packets sent by NAUN3 devices, while non-IP descriptors are matched against header information contained in Ethernet frames sent by NAUN3 devices. The Connectivity Group ID in the URSP rule is matched against the Connectivity Group ID that the NAUN3 device is associated with.

q_48673.question: What is recommended to be provided along with a Traffic descriptor with two or more components in a URSP rule, in order to increase the likelihood of rule matching for a particular application?
q_48673.ground_truth: A URSP rule with lower precedence and a Traffic descriptor with less components.

q_48674.question: When can the initiating UE select any default destination layer-2 ID for unicast initial signalling?
q_48674.ground_truth: The initiating UE can select any default destination layer-2 ID for unicast initial signalling when different V2X services are mapped to distinct default destination layer-2 IDs and the UE intends to establish a single unicast link that can be used for more than one V2X service identifier.

q_48675.question: What is the method described in RFC 2766 that maps IP addresses from one group to another transparently to end users?

q_48676.question: What is the role of the USS identifier in the re-authentication procedure initiated by the USS?
q_48676.ground_truth: The USS identifier, which is based on the security link between the UAS NF and the USS, is used by the USS to ensure the correct mapping of the GPSI and the USS identifier during the re-authentication procedure.

q_48677.question: When a UE moves from E-UTRAN to GERAN/UTRAN, what does the UE need to map the GUTI to in order to send it to the SGSN?
q_48677.ground_truth: The UE needs to map the GUTI to an RAI, a P-TMSI, and a P-TMSI Signature.

q_48678.question: What should a UE do if it cannot derive its network identity and the rejected request is not for initiating a PDN connection for emergency bearer services?
q_48678.ground_truth: If the network cannot derive the UE's identity, and if it is not a request to initiate a PDN connection for emergency bearer services, then the UE shall set the EPS update status to EU2 NOT UPDATED and shall delete any GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI list and eKSI. The UE shall then enter the state EMM-DEREGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE. Subsequently, the UE shall automatically initiate the attach procedure.

q_48679.question: What should the gNB-CU-UP do upon reception of the MC BEARER CONTEXT RELEASE REQUEST message?
q_48679.ground_truth: Upon reception of the MC BEARER CONTEXT RELEASE REQUEST message, the gNB-CU-UP should initiate the MC Bearer Context Release procedure to release the MBS session resources for a multicast MBS session.

q_48680.question: What is the effect of MPS for Data Transport Service on QoS Flows?
q_48680.ground_truth: MPS for Data Transport Service enables the prioritization of traffic on the QoS Flow associated with the default QoS rule and other QoS Flows upon AF request. The priority modification is based on operator policy and regulatory rules.

q_48681.question: Which RFC defines the usage of IPv4 in the control plane over Sxa, Sxb, Sxc, N4 and N4mb reference points?

q_48682.question: What should the UE do upon receiving SystemInformationBlockType1-NB if the UE is capable of 5G NAS?
q_48682.ground_truth: The UE forwards ng-U-DataTransfer and up-CIoT-5GS-Optimisation to upper layers if present for the selected PLMN.

q_48683.question: What is the requirement in the context of wideband intermodulation for V2X operation in FR1?
q_48683.ground_truth: The requirement is that the intermodulation characteristics should meet the specified standards, as per the wideband intermodulation requirements in clauses 7.8.1G in TS 36.101 and 7.8E in TS 38.101-1 for intra-band V2X operation, and the specified requirements in clause 7.8E in TS 38.101-1 for inter-band NR V2X concurrent operation.

q_48684.question: What is the purpose of location accuracy analytics feature in ADAE?
q_48684.ground_truth: The location accuracy analytics feature allows a VAL server to be notified based on analytics whether the accuracy of a location can be met for a given application and optionally for a given UE/group route.

q_48685.question: When should a UE reselect a cell on a higher priority E-UTRAN frequency or inter-RAT frequency than the serving frequency?
q_48685.ground_truth: A UE should reselect a cell on a higher priority E-UTRAN frequency or inter-RAT frequency than the serving frequency if a cell of a higher priority E-UTRAN frequency or inter-RAT frequency fulfills criteria 1 and more than 1 second has elapsed since the UE camped on the current serving cell.

q_48686.question: What should be done if the received SIP re-INVITE request is an authorised request for an MCVideo emergency alert cancellation and there is an outstanding MCVideo emergency alert for this MCVideo user in step 6b(ii)?
q_48686.ground_truth: Clear the cache of the MCVideo ID of the MCVideo user as having an outstanding MCVideo emergency alert.

q_48687.question: What should the 3GPP system do to support a Short Message to be routed to a specific emergency response center?
q_48687.ground_truth: The 3GPP system should support a Short Message to be routed to different emergency response centers, depending on the type of emergency as specified in 10.1.

q_48688.question: What is the purpose of the id token, access token, and refresh token provided after the MC services user is authenticated?
q_48688.ground_truth: These tokens are provided for MC services user authentication, and the access token is scoped to the services the MC services user is authorized for, such as group management services, key management services, and MC services.

q_48689.question: What information is included in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message, when the UE sends it to initiate a combined tracking area updating procedure?
q_48689.ground_truth: The UE includes the TMSI status IE if no valid TMSI is available, and if the UE has stored a valid location area identification, the UE shall include it in the Old location area identification IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.

q_48690.question: What is the difference between (un)solicited application reporting for EPC and 5GC?
q_48690.ground_truth: For EPC, (un)solicited application reporting refers to the process of reporting the start or stop of applications by the TDF or PCEF, while for 5GC, solicited Application Reporting refers to the process of reporting the start or stop of applications by the SMF to the PCF. Unsolicited application reporting is not applicable for 5GC.

q_48691.question: What happens to the EPS bearer context(s) for the UE if detach procedure for EPS services is performed?
q_48691.ground_truth: The EPS bearer context(s) for this particular UE are deactivated locally without peer-to-peer signalling between the UE and the MME.

q_48692.question: What is the high quality criterion for PLMN identities as specified in TS 36.304, clause 5.1.2.2?
q_48692.ground_truth: The measured RSRP value for an E-UTRAN cell should be greater than or equal to -110 dBm for PLMN identities to be considered high quality.

q_48693.question: What should the UE do if it is operating in SNPN access operation mode and the service request procedure is rejected with an EMM cause value received from a cell not belonging to an SNPN?
q_48693.ground_truth: This is considered an abnormal case, and the UE should follow the behavior specified in subclause 5.6.1.7.

q_48694.question: What is the purpose of the RRC Transfer procedure in the context of Dual Connectivity?
q_48694.ground_truth: The purpose of the RRC Transfer procedure in Dual Connectivity is to deliver a PDCP-C PDU encapsulating an LTE RRC message or NR RRC message to the S-NG-RAN-NODE.

q_48695.question: What RFC standard defines the INFORMATION-REQUEST message as used in section 13.2.2?
q_48695.ground_truth: The INFORMATION-REQUEST message as used in section 13.2.2 is defined in RFC 3315.

q_48696.question: What is the role of the CHF in the 5G system's charging service?
q_48696.ground_truth: The CHF is responsible for the converged online charging and offline charging functionalities in the 5G system's charging service.

q_48697.question: When the DDD Status event and buffered notification type is required, what actions will the SMF take?
q_48697.ground_truth: The SMF will derive a PDR and a related FAR to request the UPF to report an event of the first buffered downlink data packet, and when it receives the corresponding report, it will send the notification to the NEF.

q_48698.question: What is used to carry meta-data on codec, media encoding, timestamp, and PDU set information in a TCP or UDP option for HTTP/2 and HTTP/3?
q_48698.ground_truth: A new TCP option for HTTP/2 or UDP option for HTTP/3 is used.

q_48699.question: What should the UE set the contents of the RRCConnectionReestablishmentRequest message as?
q_48699.ground_truth: The UE should set the ue-Identity by setting the c-RNTI to the C-RNTI used in the source cell and the physCellId to the physical cell identity of the source cell; and set the shortMAC-I to the 16 least significant bits of the MAC-I calculated with the KRRCint key and integrity protection algorithm used in the source cell.

q_48700.question: What is the purpose of the pre-conditions before generating assistance information for V2V communication mode switching?
q_48700.ground_truth: The pre-conditions ensure that the VAE server has acquired the necessary information, including the RAT type the V2X UE supports, the application requirements, the current communication status of the UE, and the network monitoring information, before generating assistance information for V2V communication mode switching.

q_48701.question: What cause should the UE include in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message if errors are detected in packet filter(s)?

q_48702.question: In what situation would the target UE send a PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message containing PC5 signalling protocol cause value #5?
q_48702.ground_truth: When the 5G ProSe direct link establishment fails due to the implementation-specific maximum number of established 5G ProSe direct links has been reached or other temporary lower layer problems causing resource constraints.

q_48703.question: What action should the UE take upon receiving the ATTACH ACCEPT message, when it includes a new assigned GUTI and the old GUTI is invalid or assigned by another MME?
q_48703.ground_truth: The UE shall use the new GUTI as the new temporary identity and delete the old GUTI.

q_48704.question: When is the code rate given by higher layer parameter n4maxCoderateSlotPUCCH-r15 used in LTE system?
q_48704.ground_truth: The code rate given by higher layer parameter n4maxCoderateSlotPUCCH-r15 is used in LTE system for shortened slot-PUCCH format 4.

q_48705.question: What should be considered further during normative work regarding error sources in the multipath/NLoS channel/radio propagation environment for UE-based positioning integrity mode?
q_48705.ground_truth: The boresight direction of DL PRS, beam information of DL PRS, the granularity of boresight direction of DL-PRS and its influence on positioning integrity, the feasibility and complexity of modelling boresight direction and beam information, the feasibility of obtaining quality/statistical parameters of beam information from gNB, and the influence on measurement errors at the UE should be considered further during normative work.

q_48706.question: How long is the TEID-C valid for S3, S10, S16, and N26 interfaces?
q_48706.ground_truth: A TEID-C on the S3/S10/S16/N26 interface shall be released after its associated UE context is removed or the UE is detached.

q_48707.question: What action should the controlling MCPTT function take when it receives a SIP 200 (OK) response from any terminating participating MCPTT functions that were sent a SIP MESSAGE request?
q_48707.ground_truth: When the controlling MCPTT function receives a SIP 200 (OK) response from any terminating participating MCPTT functions that were sent a SIP MESSAGE request, the controlling MCPTT function shall send a SIP 200 (OK) response to the incoming SIP MESSAGE request and store the identity of the user regroup and the list of the users that are members of the user regroup.

q_48708.question: What should the network do if it is in the "CC-establishment confirmed" state and it receives a CC-ESTABLISHMENT CONFIRMED message without a Supported Codec List information element?
q_48708.ground_truth: For UMTS, the network shall select the default UMTS speech codec. For GERAN, the network shall select GSM full rate speech version 1.

q_48709.question: What organizations contribute to the development of the 3GPP technical specifications?
q_48709.ground_truth: The 3GPP (3rd Generation Partnership Project) Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network (TSG RAN) develops the 3GPP technical specifications for the NG-RAN, NR-MIB, and Xn interfaces.

q_48710.question: What is a CLTA and how is it used in the context of conformance testing?
q_48710.ground_truth: A CLTA is a practical antenna used to test conformance to the co-location requirements. In conformance testing, the co-location requirements are translated to the input or output of a CLTA.

q_48711.question: How is the Maximum Power Reduction (MPR) applied to PUCCH formats 0, 1, 3, and 4 in CA operation?
q_48711.ground_truth: The allowed MPR for SRS, PUCCH formats 0, 1, 3 and 4, is as specified for QPSK modulated DFT-s-OFDM of equivalent RB allocation.

q_48712.question: When identical interfering signals should be applied to each receiver antenna port of a UE with more than one receiver antenna connector?
q_48712.ground_truth: Identical interfering signals should be applied to each receiver antenna port of a UE with more than one receiver antenna connector if more than one of these is used (diversity).

q_48713.question: What is the purpose of ANDSF-provided Inter-System Routing Policy (ISRP) rules?
q_48713.ground_truth: The ISRP is a set of operator-defined rules that the UE uses to route IP traffic simultaneously over multiple radio access interfaces when available. The rules help the UE meet operator routing preferences and offload preferences by deciding when a particular access technology or access network is restricted for a specific IP traffic flow and selecting the most preferable access technologies or access networks for routing IP traffic.

q_48714.question: What is the protocol and the function of the AMF in the network?
q_48714.ground_truth: The Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF) is a function in the 5G Core Network (5GC) that performs the user's access and mobility management. It is defined in TS~23.501 of the 3GPP specifications. The AMF is responsible for the network access control, authentication and authorization of the UE, connection establishment and release, session management, and mobility management. It communicates with the other functions in the 5GC to provide a seamless and secure experience for the user.

q_48715.question: What is the requirement for UE to report CQI index = 0 when the UE has available uplink resources for reporting CQI for the SCell?
q_48715.ground_truth: UE shall report CQI index = 0 (out of range) as defined in section 7.7.3 when the UE has available uplink resources for reporting CQI for the SCell.

q_48716.question: What is the recommended action for spare bits included in the MM Context IE of GTPv1?
q_48716.ground_truth: Spare bits in the MM Context IE of GTPv1 should be set to 1's before sending the MM Context IE to Gn/Gp SGSN.

q_48717.question: What is the purpose of the "User reason" parameter in the MAP-U-ABORT service?
q_48717.ground_truth: The "User reason" parameter in the MAP-U-ABORT service is used to indicate the reason for aborting the MAP dialogue from the user's perspective.

q_48718.question: What is the maximum RRC procedure delay defined in 3GPP TS 36.331 clause 11.2?
q_48718.ground_truth: The maximum RRC procedure delay is 15 ms.

q_48719.question: What are the scheduling restrictions on UE performing L1-RSRP measurement on FR2 during TRP specific candidate beam detection?
q_48719.ground_truth: The UE is not expected to transmit or receive certain types of data on reference symbols to be measured for TRP specific candidate beam detection.

q_48720.question: How does the UE handle the deactivation of EPS bearer contexts?
q_48720.ground_truth: The UE deactivates all locally active EPS bearers that are indicated as inactive by the MME.

q_48721.question: What is the function of the "Handover-Info" header field when reaching a UE?
q_48721.ground_truth: The "Handover-Info" header field when reaching a UE only contains information of whether the UE initiated or terminated the call which does not have any security or privacy impacts.

q_48722.question: What is the requirement for UE when using SyncRefUE on a carrier frequency subject to CCA to derive transmission timing for V2X sidelink communication?
q_48722.ground_truth: The UE shall meet all the transmit timing requirements defined in clause 12.2.5 provided that at least one S-SSB is available at the UE during the last 160ms.

q_48723.question: What action does the TSCTSF take when an AF-requested (g)PTP time synchronization service is allowed for the UE and DNN/S-NSSAI?
q_48723.ground_truth: The TSCTSF creates an AF-session and stores the DNN, S-NSSAI, IP address, and SUPI for the AF-session.

q_48724.question: What should the UE do if the Back-off timer value IE is not included or no Back-off timer value is received from the 5GMM sublayer?
q_48724.ground_truth: The UE may send another PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message or PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message for the same S-NSSAI or without an S-NSSAI.

q_48725.question: What is the role of the Application Function (AF) in the described solution?
q_48725.ground_truth: The Application Function (AF) is responsible for requesting SFC policies and influencing traffic routing to an N6-LAN based on predefined SFC policies. The AF can become aware of available SFC policies through SLA agreements or by querying the 3GPP network via a new SBI interface.

q_48726.question: What HTTP status code is returned when the resource for updating the PSI activation state does not exist?

q_48727.question: What must the S-CSCF do when the HSS indicates that another S-CSCF is already assigned for the user?
q_48727.ground_truth: The S-CSCF must return a 305 (Use Proxy) response containing the SIP URI of the assigned S-CSCF.

q_48728.question: Which step in the Movement Behaviour Analytics procedure does the NWDAF derive the Movement Behaviour Analytics based on the data collected from the AMF and/or GMLC?

q_48729.question: What type of SIP MESSAGE request is sent to the controlling MCData function with an "Accept-Contact" header field containing the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcdata.fd", an ICSI value "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcdata.fd" in a "P-Asserted-Service" header field, and with an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body containing an FD NOTIFICATION message?
q_48729.ground_truth: Such requests are known as "SIP MESSAGE request for FD disposition notification for MCData server".

q_48730.question: What should the service consumer include in the request body when sending an HTTP POST request to the NSCE server to request the creation of a Slice Related Communication Service?
q_48730.ground_truth: The SliceCommService data structure should be included in the request body.

q_48731.question: What is the difference between NCR-Fwd type 1-C and NCR-Fwd type 1-H in terms of transmit spurious emissions requirements?
q_48731.ground_truth: NCR-Fwd type 1-H has more stringent requirements, where the power summation emissions at the TAB connectors of the TAB connectors of the TAB connector TX min cell group shall not exceed a limit specified as the basic limit + X, while NCR-Fwd type 1-C has a less stringent requirement where the tx spurious emissions shall not exceed the basic limits specified in clause 6.5.4.2.

q_48732.question: How much of a beam prediction accuracy increase was achieved by AI/ML in terms of Top-1 beam prediction accuracy, when using measurements from 5 time instances with a measurement periodicity of 160ms?
q_48732.ground_truth: AI/ML can increase the beam prediction accuracy by 22.5%.

q_48733.question: For which UE power classes and test frequencies is the 5.6.1.3 test case incomplete?
q_48733.ground_truth: The 5.6.1.3 test case is incomplete for UE power classes other than PC3 and incomplete for test frequencies > 40.8 GHz.

q_48734.question: What is the purpose of the Port management information container in the 3GPP specification?
q_48734.ground_truth: The Port management information container IE is used to convey a port management information container when the UE needs to convey it.

q_48735.question: What status code does the Broadcast Message Gateway send to the MSGin5G Server in response to a successful delivery of a message?
q_48735.ground_truth: The Broadcast Message Gateway responds to the MSGin5G Server with a 204 No Content message when the message delivery is successful.

q_48736.question: What is the role of the SFN in the FBS detection method?
q_48736.ground_truth: The SFN (System Frame Number) is used in the FBS detection method to compare the SFN reported by the UE and the SFN allocated by the gNB to detect the existence of a FBS.

q_48737.question: What information is specified in the "Charge Information" field as per 5.1.4.1.6?
q_48737.ground_truth: The "Charge Information" field consists of two parts: the charged party (sender, recipient, both, or neither) and the charge type (postpaid or prepaid).

q_48738.question: Which message IE includes control information related to the security protection of a 5GMM message and is 4 bits in size?

q_48739.question: What should the gNB-DU do when it has received the Polluted Measurement Indicator IE in the UE context setup procedure?
q_48739.ground_truth: The gNB-DU should include the information contained in the Polluted Measurement Indicator IE as part of the measurement report to be sent to the TCE if it has received the Polluted Measurement Indicator IE in the UE context setup procedure.

q_48740.question: Which subclause specifies the minimum requirement for output power dynamics for NB-IoT operation in NR in-band?
q_48740.ground_truth: Subclause 6.3.5 specifies the minimum requirement for output power dynamics for NB-IoT operation in NR in-band.

q_48741.question: What is the Avp Code of the QoS-Capability AVP defined in IETF RFC 5777 in 3GPP AAA protocol?

q_48742.question: When is the controlling MCVideo function required to send a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response to the originating network with a warning text set to "120 user is not affiliated to this group"?
q_48742.ground_truth: When the user identified by the MCVideo ID is not affiliated with the MCVideo group ID associated with the MCVideo session identity.

q_48743.question: What is the role of the floor control server in the IWF?
q_48743.ground_truth: The floor control server is responsible for managing the floor requests in the IWF.

q_48744.question: Which parameter is used in E-UTRAN and NG-RAN to indicate the identity of an Operation and Maintenance Centre to which Trace Records shall be sent?

q_48745.question: What is required for the AF to indicate a certain media component version to the PCRF?
q_48745.ground_truth: The AF may assign a content version to the media component related to certain service and provide the PCRF with the Content-Version AVP as part of the Media-Component-Description AVP.

q_48746.question: What is the purpose of scheduling the segment availability start time with a small safety delay in the MPD for content authors?
q_48746.ground_truth: This allows the content author to avoid too aggressive requests, have flexibility in publishing segments, and provide a certain amount of safety margins, although it may lead to slightly increased end-to-end latencies.

q_48747.question: In what scenario must the UE include a "response" Authorization header field parameter in the SQN?
q_48747.ground_truth: When the SQN is out of range.

q_48748.question: What is the function of the "PDU session ID" in the DL NAS TRANSPORT message?
q_48748.ground_truth: The "PDU session ID" in the DL NAS TRANSPORT message is included by the AMF when the Payload container type IE is set to "N1 SM information" or "CIoT user data container" to indicate the PDU session.

q_48749.question: What action does the MCVideo client take when the stored current call type is "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL" and a certain timer is started?
q_48749.ground_truth: The MCVideo client starts timer TFG13 with a specific value.

q_48750.question: What is the difference between the second and third version digit in the document?
q_48750.ground_truth: The second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, i.e. technical enhancements, corrections, updates, etc. while the third digit is incremented when editorial only changes have been incorporated in the document.

q_48751.question: What is the maximum allowed interruption of PCell during SCells activation and deactivation for FDD PCell and TDD PCell?
q_48751.ground_truth: The interruption of PCell shall not be more than the values specified for intra-band CA and inter-band CA in Clause 7.8.2 during SCells activation and deactivation for FDD PCell and TDD PCell.

q_48752.question: What characteristic of a far field scenario is important for beam management, and why is it more important than illumination density?
q_48752.ground_truth: A nearly planar wavefront is the important characteristic of a far field scenario. It is more important because the deviation in illumination density seems minor compared to the quality of the wavefront.

q_48753.question: Which parameter gives the identities of the internal PLMN operator clients that are allowed to locate a target MS for an NI-LR or MT-LR?

q_48754.question: When must an AS handle requests addressed to its currently valid GRUUs?
q_48754.ground_truth: The AS must handle requests addressed to its currently valid GRUUs when received outside of the dialog in which the GRUU was provided.

q_48755.question: What should the MS do if it is in state GMM-REGISTERED and an ATTACH REQUEST message is received?
q_48755.ground_truth: If an ATTACH REQUEST message is received in state GMM-REGISTERED, the network may initiate the GMM common procedures; if it turned out that the ATTACH REQUEST message was send by an MS that has already been attached, the GMM context, PDP contexts and MBMS contexts, if any, are deleted and the new ATTACH REQUEST is progressed.

q_48756.question: What should the SS do after activating SCC in step 5?
q_48756.ground_truth: After activating SCC in step 5, the SS shall monitor CSI reports for SCell sent from the UE and ACK/NACK sent in PCell during SCell activation.

q_48757.question: What is the length and type of the WUS assistance information information element?
q_48757.ground_truth: The WUS assistance information is a type 4 information element, with a minimum length of 3 octets.

q_48758.question: What should be included in the list for an application/resource-lists+xml MIME body in a SIP REFER request for an emergency alert adhoc group?
q_48758.ground_truth: The list should include a single <entry> element with a "uri" attribute set to the identity of the adhoc group learned during an adhoc group emergency alert procedure.

q_48759.question: What is the impact of the Ranging service exposure solution on the existing nodes and functionality?
q_48759.ground_truth: The Ranging service exposure solution has impacts on the following entities: UE(s) - requiring support for ranging service exposure, support for invoking the ranging service, and support for Ranging/Sidelink positioning over the PC5.

q_48760.question: What is the required minimum confidence level and rate of correct events during the test?
q_48760.ground_truth: The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

q_48761.question: What are the conditions that must be met before testing the inter-frequency mobility from E-UTRA to E-UTRA?
q_48761.ground_truth: The UE must have a default EPS bearer context, receive downlink data on the radio bearer associated with the default EPS bearer context, and deliver the downlink data to upper layers.
