For uplink data, the UE should transmit the uplink data on the radio bearer associated with the default EPS bearer context. After inter-frequency handover, the UE should continue to deliver downlink data to upper layers and transmit uplink data on the radio bearer if uplink data is submitted.

q_48762.question: What is the maximum allowed cell re-selection delay to an already detected cell in the test case?
q_48762.ground_truth: The maximum allowed cell re-selection delay to an already detected cell in the test case is 3.2 seconds.

q_48763.question: What must the UE do after sending the final event report and receiving an acknowledgment?
q_48763.ground_truth: After sending the final event report and receiving an acknowledgment, the UE shall release the user plane connection to the LCS Client or AF if the LCS Client or AF has not yet initiated release of the user plane connection.

q_48764.question: What is the purpose of the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay discovery security material request procedure?
q_48764.ground_truth: The purpose of the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay discovery security material request procedure is for the UE to obtain the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay discovery security material for 5G ProSe remote UE or 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE.

q_48765.question: What is the effect of initiating or cancelling an MCVideo emergency alert in clause~11 on an MCVideo group or its participants?
q_48765.ground_truth: Initiating or cancelling an MCVideo emergency alert for a group in clause~11 will target the group and result in the initiator being implicitly affiliated to the group, while not impacting the in-progress emergency state of the targeted group or the EPS bearers' priority.

q_48766.question: Which command enables or disables reporting of PS to CS Single Radio Voice Call Continuity (SRVCC)?
q_48766.ground_truth: The 8.64 +CIREP command enables or disables reporting of PS to CS Single Radio Voice Call Continuity (SRVCC).

q_48767.question: Which flag in the Multicast Transport Information IE indicates the Address Type?
q_48767.ground_truth: The Address Type is indicated by the 2-bit fixed length code in the Address Type field of the Multicast Transport Information IE.

q_48768.question: What is the required communication capability for the PC service in the Smart Grid?
q_48768.ground_truth: The PC service in the Smart Grid requires real-time, bi-directional communication capabilities to collect measurement and switch notifications in one direction and to apply control signals to inverters in the other direction.

q_48769.question: Who can request the PIN server discovery procedure via the PEGC?
q_48769.ground_truth: Some PIN elements can initiate the PIN server discovery procedure via the PEGC, typically through application layer connections via WiFi or Bluetooth.

q_48770.question: What is the step taken by the SCP when forwarding a request to the HTTP server for connecting inbound?
q_48770.ground_truth: The SCP shall connect inbound to an authority server for the target resource when forwarding a request to the HTTP server. For connecting inbound to an authority not in the same PLMN, the SCP shall connect to the Security Edge Protection Proxy.

q_48771.question: What is the value of the RF channels to be tested when testing the initial conditions for single carrier tests in 6.7.2.4.1?
q_48771.ground_truth: The value of the RF channels to be tested when testing the initial conditions for single carrier tests is M.

q_48772.question: What should the MCData server set the <p-id-fa> child element of the <presence> root element to?

q_48773.question: What should the SNRM-S do if it receives an HTTP POST request message with a Content-Type header field set to "application/vnd.3gpp.seal-mbms-usage-info+xml" but the sender is not authorized to report mbms listening status?
q_48773.ground_truth: The SNRM-S shall respond with a HTTP 403 (Forbidden) response to the HTTP POST request and shall skip the rest of the steps.

q_48774.question: In which substate can a MS initiate a TMSI reallocation procedure for identity confidentiality?
q_48774.ground_truth: The TMSI reallocation procedure can be initiated by the network at any time while a RR connection exists between the network and the mobile station.

q_48775.question: What is the procedure for the UE to select a Hosting network when multiple Hosting networks broadcast the Localized service ID as per Solution #31.2.3?
q_48775.ground_truth: The UE creates a list of discovered Hosting networks fulfilling the availability conditions, and selects a Hosting network from the list based on the order of the networks, e.g. by using the signal strength. If manual network selection is performed, the list of discovered Hosting networks is displayed to the user.

q_48776.question: Which attribute should the MCData server not include in the <functionalAlias> element?

q_48777.question: What is the maximum time that a UE shall store a "warning message" when the UE is outside the Warning Area Coordinates?
q_48777.ground_truth: The UE shall store the "warning message" in the list of "warning messages" to be checked for geo-fencing during a UE implementation specific time which shall not be greater than 24 hours.

q_48778.question: As per 6.3.2.2, which standardized reference interfaces can the 3GPP intent driven MnS be applicable for, given the potential deployment scenario #2?
q_48778.ground_truth: The 3GPP intent driven MnS can be applicable for the management interactions for Intent-NOP between NOP and NEP, management interactions for Intent-CSP between CSP and NOP, and TM Forum intent management API can be applicable for management interactions for Intent-CSC between CSC and CSP.

q_48779.question: What is the condition for counting a success for the event "Re-select already detected Ncell 1" in the HD-FDD intra frequency cell re-selection test case?
q_48779.ground_truth: A success for the event "Re-select already detected Ncell 1" is counted if the UE responds on the already detected cell, Ncell 1, during time duration T3 within 15 seconds from the beginning of time period T3.

q_48780.question: What is the difference between CMAS and EU-ALERT specific requirements for warning notifications?
q_48780.ground_truth: CMAS supports up to 360 characters of GSM 7 bit Default Alphabet, while EU-ALERT supports 3 levels of severity for alert messages, and 1 level for advisory messages. CMAS supports 5 classes of warning notifications, while EU-ALERT supports 3 types of warning notifications.

q_48781.question: Which two tasks are executed by UEs during a live concert setting?
q_48781.ground_truth: Image shooting and video optimization, as well as artist face recognition and musical instrument identification are tasks executed by UEs during a live concert setting.

q_48782.question: What is the maximum duration of an interruption allowed on the source cell during intra-frequency handover?
q_48782.ground_truth: The maximum duration of an interruption allowed on the source cell during intra-frequency handover is 5 ms for synchronous handover, and 6 ms for asynchronous handover.

q_48783.question: Which extractor is used to get a conforming HEVC bitstream in the context of tile-based streaming?
q_48783.ground_truth: The untransformed sample entry type 'hvc2' is used as an extractor.

q_48784.question: What is the minimum time interval that the UE is required to search for and measure higher priority inter-frequency layers in the first scenario?
q_48784.ground_truth: The minimum rate at which the UE is required to search for and measure higher priority layers in the first scenario is the same as that defined in the clause.

q_48785.question: What should a MnS consumer take into account when constructing the attribute modification request when attribute properties are used?
q_48785.ground_truth: A MnS consumer should take into account the properties "type", "allowedValues", "multiplicity", "isOrdered", "isUnique", "isNullable" and "passedById" when constructing the attribute modification request.

q_48786.question: What is the purpose of the connection migration feature in QUIC?
q_48786.ground_truth: The connection migration feature in QUIC allows a client with multiple network interfaces to move an ongoing QUIC session to a newly validated path via a newly discovered network interface without the need to establish a new connection.

q_48787.question: What response will the SCC AS send if it receives a SIP CANCEL request cancelling the SIP INVITE request due to STI and a SIP 410 (Gone) response to the initial SIP INVITE request on the Source Access Leg, after initiating a transfer of an early dialog to the Target Access Leg?
q_48787.ground_truth: The SCC AS will respond to the SIP CANCEL request and the SIP 410 (Gone) response as specified in 3GPP TS 24.229, and consider the early dialogs as terminated.

q_48788.question: What interfaces are used between the PCF and P-CSCF to enable IMS services in the 5G system architecture?

q_48789.question: What is the purpose of the "deliver-as-message" operation in the MSGin5G Server?
q_48789.ground_truth: The "deliver-as-message" operation is used by the Application Server to deliver a message to a specific MSGin5G Server.

q_48790.question: Which element can contain a list of <Instance-ID-URN> or <IMEI-range> in the mcdata-UE-id element?

q_48791.question: What should the MCData MESSAGE request do if a functional alias status is activated for the MCData ID?
q_48791.ground_truth: If the functional alias status is activated for the MCData ID, the MCData MESSAGE request should set the <functional-alias-URI> element of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body in the outgoing SIP INVITE request to the received value.

q_48792.question: How long is the total time allotted for cell re-selection delay to an already detected cell in the test case for UE fulfilling stationary criterion?
q_48792.ground_truth: The total time allotted for cell re-selection delay to an already detected cell in the test case for UE fulfilling stationary criterion is 154.88 seconds (allow 155 s).

q_48793.question: When does UE store the selected TLS authentication method in Solution #6?
q_48793.ground_truth: UE that hosts EEC(s) stores the selected TLS authentication method while roaming, after receiving the ECS/EES authentication method information from SMF (via PCO) and finding that the selected TLS authentication method is not supported by ECS/EES.

q_48794.question: What message is used to inform the mobile station about rearrangements initiated by a remote non-PLMN user?

q_48795.question: What status code is returned when the NF Service Consumer is not allowed to discover the requested NF type at the NRF?
q_48795.ground_truth: If the NF Service Consumer is not allowed to discover the requested NF type at the NRF, the NRF shall return "403 Forbidden" response.

q_48796.question: What is the role of the FL Server NWDAF in the federated learning process execution phase?
q_48796.ground_truth: The FL Server NWDAF in the federated learning process execution phase monitors the status changes of FL Client NWDAF(s), reselects FL Client NWDAF(s) based on updated status, availability, and capability, discovers new FL Client NWDAF(s) via NRF, and allows FL Client NWDAF(s) to join or leave the federated learning process dynamically.

q_48797.question: What action is (re-)selected by the (target) V-SMF to support EAS discovery with a local DNS server?
q_48797.ground_truth: The (target) V-SMF re-selects a local DNS server, typically based on the target UE location.

q_48798.question: What should the floor control interface do when it receives an implicit floor request during an upgrade to an emergency group call?
q_48798.ground_truth: The floor control interface should indicate to the floor control server arbitration logic that an implicit floor request is received due to an upgrade to an emergency group call, and remain in the 'U: not permitted and Floor Idle' state.

q_48799.question: What is the purpose of the network function vAAnF in the 5G network?
q_48799.ground_truth: The vAAnF is responsible for storing the AKMA keys and associated parameters received from the hAAnF and providing the application key KAF to the AF when requested. The vAAnF also decrypts the GUTI value encrypted by the UE using the KAF and verifies the decrypted GUTI is the same as the GUTI sent by the AMF in clear text. The vAAnF sends the result of the KAF check to the AMF (access and mobility management function) that forwards the result to the UE. The UE can use the KAF if the KAF check was successful.

q_48800.question: What action can the TSG take if they decide that a specification is no longer going to be maintained?
q_48800.ground_truth: The TSG may decide that no further Change Requests should be considered, but the specification remains available.

q_48801.question: What is the main difference between congestion control in NR-V2X and LTE-V2X?
q_48801.ground_truth: In NR-V2X, each packet is associated with a single 'priority' value, which is comparable to PPPP in LTE-V2X. The priority value is transmitted in the first-stage SCI associated with each transport block.

q_48802.question: What does S1AP stand for?
q_48802.ground_truth: Session and mobility management layer application part.

q_48803.question: What is the role of the S-NODE RELEASE REQUEST message in the UE Context Release procedure?
q_48803.ground_truth: The S-NODE RELEASE REQUEST message may trigger the UE Context Release procedure if certain conditions are met.

q_48804.question: What parameters must be present in the request for the HSS to download E-UTRAN authentication vectors to the MME?
q_48804.ground_truth: The Requested-EUTRAN-Authentication-Info AVP must be present in the request.

q_48805.question: What resource represents the Parameter Provision Profile Data for the 5G VN Groups, which is queried by the UDM?

q_48806.question: How can the UE change its identifiers for V2X communication over PC5 reference point?
q_48806.ground_truth: The UE changes and randomizes the source Layer-2 ID and the source IP address over time to ensure that a source UE cannot be tracked or identified by any other UEs. The change of the identifiers of a source UE is synchronized across layers used for PC5.

q_48807.question: What should the participating MCData function do if the <allow-adhoc-group-data-comn-participation> element of the <ruleset> element is not present in the MCData user profile document or is present with the value "false" and the request is for a terminating participating MCData function?
q_48807.ground_truth: The participating MCData function shall reject the "SIP INVITE request for terminating participating MCData function" with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response, with warning text set to "188 user is not allowed to participate in adhoc group data communication" in a Warning header field as specified in clause~4.9.

q_48808.question: What should the UE include in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message if it is in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode and changes the radio capability for NG-RAN or E-UTRAN?
q_48808.ground_truth: The UE shall initiate the registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update including the 5GS update type IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message with the NG-RAN-RCU bit set to "UE radio capability update needed".

q_48809.question: What should the controlling MCData function send towards the authorized MCData client if the communication release request is successful?
q_48809.ground_truth: The controlling MCData function should set the Release response type IE to "RELEASE SUCCESS" and send the SIP MESSAGE request towards the authorized MCData client.

q_48810.question: When the P-CSCF receives an initial request for a dialog, what info should it save from the P-Called-Party-ID header field received in the request?
q_48810.ground_truth: The P-CSCF should save the public user identity from the P-Called-Party-ID header field received in the request.

q_48811.question: What is the recommended version of TLS to be used for the security procedures on PC8* interface when using GBA?
q_48811.ground_truth: The recommended versions of TLS to be used for the security procedures on PC8* interface when using GBA are TLS v1.2 or TLS v1.3. Confidentiality protection should be enabled in both cases.

q_48812.question: What activation/deactivation type is supported by the generic framework described in clause 5.1.11.4.2.1 and extended with the "Switch for 'activated' and 'deactivated' status"?

q_48813.question: How does the UDM respond to the NEF when retrieving the AF specific UE Identifier?
q_48813.ground_truth: The UDM responds to the NEF with an AF specific UE Identifier represented as an External Identifier for the UE which is uniquely associated with the Application Port ID, MTC Provider Information and/or AF Identifier.

q_48814.question: What is the purpose of the test for Initiation/Cease of SLSS Transmission with V2X Sidelink Communication for SyncRef UE as Timing Reference?
q_48814.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify the requirements related to the evaluation time allowed to initiate and cease SLSS transmissions defined in clause 13.3.1.3 when SyncRef UE is used as a timing reference.

q_48815.question: What is denoted by after rate matching the turbo coded blocks?
q_48815.ground_truth: where r is the coded block number, and is the number of rate matched bits for code block number r.

q_48816.question: For sidelink transmission in the SLRB, what modification should be made when performing the header compression of the PDCP Data PDU when the SDU type is IP?
q_48816.ground_truth: The UE should perform the header compression using ROHC as specified in clause 5.7.4.

q_48817.question: What is the maximum repetition period of relevant system info blocks (TSI-NR) assumed in this test case?
q_48817.ground_truth: The maximum repetition period of relevant system info blocks that needs to be received by the UE to camp on a cell is 1280 ms.

q_48818.question: Which element within the 'response-announce' contains the transaction-ID?

q_48819.question: What is the procedure for continuous reporting of performance characteristics to be measured in 5G systems?
q_48819.ground_truth: When performance characteristics to be measured indicate continuous reporting along with certain parameters such as periodic time interval, Group Reporting Guard time, threshold value, Maximum number of reports, or Maximum duration of reporting, the NEF performs the aggregation of the event reporting about performance characteristics to be measured for each UE group member, and sends the aggregated reporting to AF as achieved performance for performance characteristics to be measured.

q_48820.question: What software was used for digital audio playback during the wideband objective measurements and band-passed level adjustment?

q_48821.question: What is the role of SA2 in the 3GPP work?
q_48821.ground_truth: SA2 is responsible for defining the architecture for the features and the system, dividing the features into building blocks, and forwarding the building blocks to the relevant TSGs for the detailed work. SA2 also ensures that all required work for a full system specification of the features relevant to 3GPP takes place within 3GPP without overlap between groups.

q_48822.question: For Sustained downlink data rate performance for NR DC between FR1 and FR2, what carrier is verified during the test procedure described in clause 9.4B.2?
q_48822.ground_truth: Only the PDSCH performance on the NR cell(s) on FR2 carriers is verified during the test.

q_48823.question: If the UE requests the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay discovery security material for 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE, what should the 5G DDNMF include in the response?
q_48823.ground_truth: The 5G DDNMF shall include the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay discovery security material for 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE, the expiration timer of the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay discovery security material for 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE, and the selected ciphering algorithm.

q_48824.question: What is the purpose of Framed Route information in 5G Networks?
q_48824.ground_truth: Framed Route information in 5G Networks is used to support an IP network behind a UE, such that a range of IPv4 addresses or IPv6 prefixes is reachable over a single PDU Session, especially for enterprise connectivity.

q_48825.question: What information does the header of the GRE packet contain when carrying the UL PDU over an IPsec Child SA?
q_48825.ground_truth: The header of the GRE packet carries the QFI associated with the UL PDU and the identity of the PDU Session.

q_48826.question: What is the purpose of the CAPIF Security API?
q_48826.ground_truth: The CAPIF Security APIs allow API invokers to negotiate the service security method and obtain authorization for invoking service APIs. It also allows API exposing function to obtain authentication information of the API invoker for authentication and revoke the authorization for service APIs.

q_48827.question: What is the MCVideo imminent peril group call state that should be set in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body when the MCVideo client receives notification of the cancellation of the in-progress imminent peril state of the group?
q_48827.ground_truth: The MCVideo imminent peril group call state should be set to "MVIGC 1: imminent-peril-gc-capable".

q_48828.question: What is the definition of SLPP-MessageBody?
q_48828.ground_truth: The SLPP-MessageBody identifies the type of an SLPP message and contains all SLPP information specifically associated with that type.

q_48829.question: What is the limit for the RRC re-establishment delay in clause 6.1.10.4?
q_48829.ground_truth: The limit for the RRC re-establishment delay in clause 6.1.10.4 is less than 1.5 seconds.

q_48830.question: What is the role of the UE-to-UE Relay in the communication between Source UE and Target UEs?
q_48830.ground_truth: The UE-to-UE Relay acts as an IP router for IP communication, performs traffic relaying for unstructured communication, and acts as an Ethernet switch for Ethernet communication.

q_48831.question: What information does the NG-RAN node take into account when determining the feedback to provide if the RAN Feedback Type IE is included in the TSC Traffic Characteristics IE?
q_48831.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node takes the RAN Feedback Type IE into account when determining the feedback to provide in the TSC Traffic Characteristics Feedback IE in the PDU Session Resource Modify Response Transfer IE in the PDU SESSION RESOURCE MODIFY RESPONSE message.

q_48832.question: What action does the participating MCVideo function take when it receives a SIP 4xx, 5xx or 6xx response to the SIP MESSAGE request?
q_48832.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function forwards the error response to the MCVideo client.

q_48833.question: What is the role of Cell 1, Cell 2, and Cell 3 in this test?
q_48833.ground_truth: Cell 1 is the PCell on the TDD primary component carrier, Cell 2 is the SCell on the FDD secondary component carrier, and Cell 3 is the neighboring cell on the FDD secondary component carrier used for connection setup.

q_48834.question: What procedure is used for the case when the gNB-CU triggers conditional handover or conditional PSCell change or subsequent CPAC within the same gNB-CU?
q_48834.ground_truth: Inter-gNB-DU Conditional Handover or Conditional PSCell Change or subsequent CPAC

q_48835.question: What is the role of the ISC gateway function as an exit point for SIP transactions?
q_48835.ground_truth: As an exit point, the ISC gateway function receives requests sent from the S-CSCF to the AS via the ISC gateway function. It shall give priority over other transactions or dialogs for requests that support priority and have an authorised Resource-Priority header field. The ISC gateway function can also perform special treatment of such transactions or dialogs, such as filtering, higher priority processing, and routeing.

q_48836.question: What is the role of an SCP in a network?
q_48836.ground_truth: An SCP (Service Capability Server) is a network function responsible for handling service capability management, network capability management, and service characteristics management. It includes SCP capacity information, SCP load information, SCP priority, location information, Served Location(s), Network Slice related Identifiers such as S-NSSAI, NSI ID, and NF sets of NFs served by the SCP.

q_48837.question: What information must the CHF report to the PCF if spending limit reporting is enabled for a policy counter?
q_48837.ground_truth: The CHF must notify the PCF of changes in the status of the policy counter and optionally pending statuses with their activation time.

q_48838.question: When might the SMF handling of the PDU session with respect to the Integrity Protection status be up to SMF implementation decision?
q_48838.ground_truth: In the case of dual connectivity, when the Integrity Protection is set to "Preferred" and the Master RAN node cannot fulfil a User Plane Security Enforcement with a value of Preferred.

q_48839.question: What is the role of the CAPIF Core Function (CCF) in the onboarding process for UE originated API invocation?
q_48839.ground_truth: The CAPIF Core Function (CCF) is responsible for providing the UE with CAPIF Core Function information, determining security context related to the UE, and storing the CCF key, Kccf ID, and UE ID during the onboarding process.

q_48840.question: In the context of this specification, how many 5G VN groups can a PDU Session provide access to?
q_48840.ground_truth: A PDU Session provides access to one and only one 5G VN group.

q_48841.question: What is the purpose of the 3gpp-Sbi-Correlation-Info header in HTTP requests and responses?
q_48841.ground_truth: The 3gpp-Sbi-Correlation-Info header in HTTP requests and responses is used to identify the UE related to the HTTP request or response, enabling network analytics tools or probes to easily identify messages that were exchanged for a given UE.

q_48842.question: What is the criteria for the MME to determine that the serving VLR of the UE is changed?
q_48842.ground_truth: The MME determines that the serving VLR of the UE is changed when the SGs association changes from one serving VLR to a different one or based on implementation-dependent criteria.

q_48843.question: What should the UE do when an emergency call is being made?
q_48843.ground_truth: The UE should not include end-to-end media security on any media in the SDP offer when it detects that an emergency call is being made.

q_48844.question: What should the S-CSCF do with the preloaded Route header fields when reregistering or initially registering a user?
q_48844.ground_truth: The S-CSCF should replace the existing list of pre-loaded Route header fields with a new list, and bind it to either the contact address of the UE or the registration flow and the associated contact address.

q_48845.question: In the 5G Media Streaming scenario, which entity is the Resource Server, which is the Resource Owner and which is the Client in an OAuth 2.0 architecture when authorizing access to Network Assistance feature of the 5GMS AF?
q_48845.ground_truth: The 5GMS AF is the Resource Server, the 5GMS Application Provider is the Resource Owner, and the Media Session Handler is the Client.

q_48846.question: What is the purpose of inter-AMF handovers in the 5G system?
q_48846.ground_truth: Inter-AMF handovers are used to transfer the management of user equipment's access and mobility from one AMF to another in the 5G system.

q_48847.question: What are the three predefined response texts that can be included in the response of the +GCAP command, indicating supported capability areas?

q_48848.question: What system or protocol is used to perform PDN GW selection in step 1 of the trusted non-3GPP IP access?

q_48849.question: What is the definition of AoA in the context of OTA in-band blocking requirements?
q_48849.ground_truth: AoA stands for Angle of Arrival. In the context of OTA in-band blocking requirements, the AoA of the incident wave of a received signal and the interfering signal refers to the direction of arrival of the signals. The requirements apply when the AoA of the received signal and the interfering signal are within a specific range.

q_48850.question: What information is included in the SIP INVITE when using the first method for a third-party specific user identity?
q_48850.ground_truth: The SIP INVITE should include the Public User Identity allocated by the third party.

q_48851.question: In the context of SL RSTD measurement, what is the purpose of the reference UE information that the UE may report?
q_48851.ground_truth: The reference UE information that the UE may report for SL RSTD measurement includes the synchronization source type and the reference time difference with the associated quality metric.

q_48852.question: What is the condition for starting time period T2 after T1 expires?
q_48852.ground_truth: Time period T2 starts after T1 expires and the UE has re-selected Cell 2 within T1.

q_48853.question: What protocol field value should be included in the "m=message" media-level section for the accepted MCData media stream in the SDP answer?
q_48853.ground_truth: The protocol field value should be "TCP/MSRP" or "TCP/TLS/MSRP" for TLS.

q_48854.question: What requirement must be met for the MCVideo client to update the stored SDP body of a call in the "S3: part of ongoing call" state?
q_48854.ground_truth: The MCVideo client updates the stored SDP body of a call in the "S3: part of ongoing call" state only if the media session is adjusted based on the stored SDP body of the call and the transmission control is restarted as a terminating transmission participant.

q_48855.question: What is the role of the ECSP provisioning MnS producer during EAS query by interworking with ETSI NFV MANO?
q_48855.ground_truth: The ECSP provisioning MnS producer receives a query request, queries the concrete EASFunction MOI, and sends a response to the MnS consumer with the requested information.

q_48856.question: In the scenario, how does the IWF handle emergency alert cancel requests when the group's LMR users have individual affiliations?
q_48856.ground_truth: When the LMR users have individual affiliations, the IWF sends an individual IWF emergency alert cancel request message to the IWF for each affiliated LMR user.

q_48857.question: What is the purpose of the probe response information element?
q_48857.ground_truth: The probe response information element indicates that the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message was sent in response of a GROUP CALL PROBE message.

q_48858.question: What are some of the file formats used for storing volumetric media primitives?
q_48858.ground_truth: OBJ, PLY, and GPU command buffer in OpenGL-based languages (e.g., glTF Buffer) are some of the methods used for encapsulating the primitives of volumetric media. A sequence of primitive files, such as multiple OBJs, PLYs or a set of GPU command buffers, in a time may present an animation of volumetric presentation.

q_48859.question: What is the difference between "Open ProSe direct discovery" and "Restricted ProSe direct discovery"?
q_48859.ground_truth: "Open ProSe direct discovery" is a type of ProSe direct discovery that takes place without explicit permission from the ProSe-enabled UE being discovered. In contrast, "Restricted ProSe direct discovery" only occurs with explicit permission from the ProSe-enabled UE being discovered.

q_48860.question: What should a UE using MICO mode do before initiating MO data or MO signaling if it is not within its registration area?
q_48860.ground_truth: The UE needs to perform a Mobility Registration Update before initiating MO data or MO signaling if it is not within the registration area.

q_48861.question: What should an MME do at a Tracking Area Update with an MME change if ISR Activated is indicated?
q_48861.ground_truth: ISR Activated should not be indicated at a Tracking Area Update with an MME change.

q_48862.question: Who is responsible for sending the TIMING SYNCHRONISATION STATUS REQUEST message in the RAN TSS reporting process?
q_48862.ground_truth: The AMF requests RAN TSS reporting by sending the TIMING SYNCHRONISATION STATUS REQUEST message to the gNB-CU. The gNB-CU then requests RAN TSS reporting from at least one gNB-DU by sending the TIMING SYNCHRONISATION STATUS REQUEST message to the gNB-DU.

q_48863.question: What should the controlling MCData function do if the user is not part of the MCData group?
q_48863.ground_truth: If the <list> element of the <list-service> element in the group document does not contain an <entry> element with a "uri" attribute matching the MCData ID of the originating user, the controlling MCData function shall send a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response with the warning text set to "116 user is not part of the MCData group".

q_48864.question: Under what conditions is a MUSIM UE allowed to request the network to release the NAS signalling connection during tracking area updating procedure due to mobility to a tracking area outside the current tracking area list?
q_48864.ground_truth: If the network has already indicated support for NAS signalling connection release in the current stored tracking area list and the UE doesn't have a PDN connection for emergency bearer services established.

q_48865.question: What service provides a list of current calls controlled by the MT for which the <ccidx> is allocated?
q_48865.ground_truth: The 8.74 List of current calls +CLCCS command returns a list of current calls controlled by the MT for which the <ccidx> is allocated.

q_48866.question: What is the test applicability for in-band emissions for 2UL CA?
q_48866.ground_truth: This test case applies to all types of NR UE release 15 and forward that supports 2UL CA.

q_48867.question: What kind of service is MBMS, as defined in TS23.246?
q_48867.ground_truth: MBMS is a point-to-multipoint service in which data is transmitted from a single source entity to multiple recipients, allowing for the sharing of network resources.

q_48868.question: What is the time frame of each H-SFN value in the context of the extended idle mode DRX?
q_48868.ground_truth: Each H-SFN value corresponds to a cycle of the legacy SFN of 1024 radio frames, i.e. 10.24s.

q_48869.question: What is the purpose of Test 8.3.1.1.2 for NB-IoT FDD UE release 17 and forward of category NB1 and NB2 that supports IOT NTN?
q_48869.ground_truth: The purpose of Test 8.3.1.1.2 is to verify the UE's ability to receive a predefined test signal, representing a multi-path fading channel that is determined by the SNR with a percentage of the information bit throughput for a specified downlink Reference Measurement Channel (RMC) not falling below a specified value for transmission on one antenna ports.

q_48870.question: What should the UE do when camping on E-UTRA connected to EPC in regards to Access Class or ACDC category related cell access restrictions?
q_48870.ground_truth: The UE should ignore Access Class or ACDC category related cell access restrictions when selecting a cell to camp on, but check them when starting the RRC connection establishment procedure for UE camping on E-UTRA connected to EPC.

q_48871.question: What is the role of the NAS protocol in the RRC protocol?
q_48871.ground_truth: The NAS protocol provides services for inter-RAT handover procedures, security activation, and transfer of dedicated NAS information and non-3GPP dedicated information.

q_48872.question: What are the requirements for single band tests for multi-band TAB connectors in clause 7.5.4.2.5?
q_48872.ground_truth: The requirements for single band tests for multi-band TAB connectors in clause 7.5.4.2.5 state that the steps from clauses 7.5.4.2.1 to 7.5.4.2.4 should be repeated per involved band for single band tests for multi-band TAB connectors with no carrier activated in the other band.

q_48873.question: What is the starting resource block for a type 0 resource block assignment, if the RIV is 5?
q_48873.ground_truth: The starting resource block for a type 0 resource block assignment, if the RIV is 5, is 0.

q_48874.question: What should the UE do when it receives an ESM INFORMATION REQUEST message with a PTI value that does not match any PTI in use?
q_48874.ground_truth: The UE should ignore the message if the PTI is an unassigned or reserved value. If the PTI is an assigned value that does not match any PTI in use for a pending UE requested PDN connectivity procedure for which the ESM information transfer flag was set in the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message, the UE should respond with an ESM STATUS message including ESM cause #47 "PTI mismatch".

q_48875.question: What is theSS's action when T1 expires in the test?
q_48875.ground_truth: When T1 expires, the SS switches the power setting from T1 to T2 and starts T2.

q_48876.question: What is the function of IPv6 prefix delegation via DHCPv6 for 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay?
q_48876.ground_truth: The IPv6 prefix delegation via DHCPv6 for 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay assigns IPv6 prefixes from IPv6 prefix range that have been assigned to the PDU Session used for the relay traffic via IPv6 prefix delegation.

q_48877.question: What is the procedure to follow when a PUA intends to publish its own view of the presentity's presence information?
q_48877.ground_truth: The PUA generates a PUBLISH request by acting as an Event Publication Agent (EPA) in accordance with RFC~3903, and supports the "application/pidf+xml" content type, the Presence Information Data Format (PIDF) extensions, and location information as defined in the corresponding RFCs. The PUA may also use RFC~5196 and RFC~5264 for advanced features.

q_48878.question: What is the maximum number of data channels allowed in a single SDP media description in the WebRTC data channel specification?
q_48878.ground_truth: There is no limit to the number of data channels in an SDP media description, but the aggregate of all defined data channels shall keep within the set bandwidth limit.

q_48879.question: What information does the "qos-flow-id" attribute in a <qos-flow> element provide?
q_48879.ground_truth: The "qos-flow-id" attribute in a <qos-flow> element contains the parameter defined in clause~11.6.2.15, which indicates the identification of a QoS flow used by the UE for 5G ProSe direct communication.

q_48880.question: What is the role of the NWDAF in the negotiation of power saving mechanisms for UE in the NTN coverage?
q_48880.ground_truth: The NWDAF assists UE in negotiation of power saving mechanisms such as PSM, MICO, and eDRX by providing the UE with the estimate of the in NTN coverage period and the estimate of the out of NTN coverage period. The UE can then use these estimates to negotiate the timer/parameters of power saving mechanisms.

q_48881.question: What is the difference between service initiated by application server and service initiated by 5GC NF?
q_48881.ground_truth: The main difference is that in the service initiated by application server, NEF checks the authorization of the AF, while in service initiated by 5GC NF, 5GC NF checks the authorization of the AF.

q_48882.question: What is the role of the VAL server in the vertical application layer?
q_48882.ground_truth: The VAL server is responsible for supporting both unicast and multicast delivery modes for the VAL client. It communicates with the SEAL server over the reference point SEAL-S.

q_48883.question: What is the definition of the intermediate power point 'Pint' as defined in sub-clause 6.3.4.2?
q_48883.ground_truth: The intermediate power point 'Pint' is defined as a power level between the minimum output power as specified in sub-clause 6.3.1 and the maximum output power as specified in sub-clause 6.2.1.

q_48884.question: What information does the source MME include in the Forward Relocation Request when the target cell is a hybrid or CSG cell, or if there are emergency bearers and the target cell is a CSG cell?
q_48884.ground_truth: The CSG ID and CSG Membership Indication, indicating whether the UE is a CSG member.

q_48885.question: What does the MeasurementReport message contain?
q_48885.ground_truth: The MeasurementReport message contains the indication of measurement results.

q_48886.question: What action should the NF Service Consumer take when it receives a 4xx/5xx response from the SMF during the EPS to 5GS Handover Preparation using N26 interface?
q_48886.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer (e.g. AMF) shall regard the hoState of the SM Context to be NONE.

q_48887.question: What action is taken by the CP function when the UP function indicates support for the DL Buffering Suggested Packet Count parameter in PFCP Session Modification Request feature?
q_48887.ground_truth: The CP function can request the UP function to buffer the suggested number of downlink data packets, when extended buffering of downlink data packet is required in the UP function.

q_48888.question: What is the definition of frequency error for IAB-DU in the context of 6.5.2.1.1?
q_48888.ground_truth: The difference between the actual IAB-DU transmit frequency and the assigned frequency.

q_48889.question: What information does the eNodeB include in the S1-AP Initial UE message when relaying the NAS PDU to the MME?
q_48889.ground_truth: The eNodeB includes the "EDT Session" indication in the S1-AP Initial UE message when the RRCEarlyDataRequest message was received in step 1. The eNodeB may also indicate the UE's Coverage Level to the MME.

q_48890.question: When should the initiating UE initiate the 5G ProSe direct link release procedure based on the expiry of timer T5084?
q_48890.ground_truth: The initiating UE may initiate the 5G ProSe direct link release procedure to release a 5G ProSe direct link upon expiry of the timer T5084.

q_48891.question: How does an APN Network Identifier ensure uniqueness within or between GPRS/EPS PLMNs?
q_48891.ground_truth: An APN Network Identifier is typically a domain name, which is unique, and usually allocated by the PLMN if it belongs to an organization that has officially reserved that name in the Internet domain.

q_48892.question: Where does the EAP server for EAP-AKA and EAP-AKA' reside in EPS?
q_48892.ground_truth: The EAP server for EAP-AKA and EAP-AKA' resides in the EPC in EPS.

q_48893.question: What action should the terminating participating MCData function take when it is unable to process a SIP MESSAGE request to remove a regroup due to lack of resources or a risk of congestion?
q_48893.ground_truth: The terminating participating MCData function may reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response and include a Retry-After header field to the SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response.

q_48894.question: What is the format of the LCID field in a MAC subheader for DL-SCH and UL-SCH?
q_48894.ground_truth: The LCID field is a 6-bit field that identifies the logical channel instance of the corresponding MAC SDU or the type of the corresponding MAC CE or padding. If the LCID field is set to 34 or 33, additional octets are present in the MAC subheader containing the eLCID field.

q_48895.question: What is the objective of clause 4.7.4.0.1?
q_48895.ground_truth: The objective of clause 4.7.4.0.1 is to specify SSB based absolute L1-RSRP measurement accuracy requirements.

q_48896.question: What does the "Assistance Information Type" field describe?
q_48896.ground_truth: The "Assistance Information Type" field describes the type of radio quality assistance information provided by the corresponding node to the node hosting the NR PDCP entity.

q_48897.question: What is the Phase III: ACR Execution in the Discover T-EAS procedure used by the EEC in TS 23.558 clause 8.8.2.2 Initiation by EEC using regular EAS Discovery?
q_48897.ground_truth: Phase III: ACR Execution involves performing Service Provisioning and discovery of T-EAS, and relocation of the application context from the EAS to CAS.

q_48898.question: What is the definition of the "Primary mechanical mode" in the present document?
q_48898.ground_truth: The Primary mechanical mode is the mode of a UE that is most often used for a specific user scenario. Each terminal has at least one primary mechanical mode, with additional primary mechanical modes potentially applicable to different user scenarios.

q_48899.question: What is the condition for 1-RSRP measurement, EMW, and SMTC/SSB/CSI-RS occasions to be considered colliding?
q_48899.ground_truth: The 1-RSRP measurement, EMW, and SMTC/SSB/CSI-RS occasions are considered colliding if the two occasions are fully or partially overlapping in the time domain, provided that inter-RAT measurement during EMW would cause scheduling restriction.

q_48900.question: What happens to the back-off timer if the network allows re-attempt in A/Gb or Iu mode or N1 mode for the same APN?
q_48900.ground_truth: The UE shall consider the back-off timer to be applicable only to the EPS session management in S1 mode for the rejected EPS session management procedure and the given PLMN and APN combination. If re-attempt in A/Gb and Iu mode and N1 mode is not allowed, the UE shall consider the back-off timer to be applicable to all three NAS protocols, i.e. EPS session management in S1 mode for the rejected EPS session management procedure, GPRS session management in A/Gb and Iu mode for the corresponding session management procedure and the given PLMN and APN combination, and 5GS session management in N1 mode for the corresponding session management procedure and the given PLMN and APN combination.

q_48901.question: Which clause in TS 36.331 specifies the requirements for the UE to process messages in order of reception?
q_48901.ground_truth: Clause 5.1.2 in TS 36.331 specifies the requirement for the UE to process messages in order of reception.

q_48902.question: In the UE Policy Association Termination procedure, who notifies the changing of RAT type from EPS to 5GS?
q_48902.ground_truth: The SMF+P-GW-C notifies the PCF for the PDU session of the changing of RAT type from EPS to 5GS.

q_48903.question: What action does an SGW take when it receives a FQ-CSID value of a PGW over S5/S8, or a FQ-CSID value of a MME over S11?
q_48903.ground_truth: The SGW overwrites the current stored FQ-CSID value with the received value

q_48904.question: In which network slices can the 5GMSd AS(s) be accessed?
q_48904.ground_truth: The 5GMSd AS(s) can only be accessed through the DNN(s) used by the network slice(s) provisioned for the distribution of that content.

q_48905.question: What is the syntax of a LPPA-PDU ::= CHOICE?
q_48905.ground_truth: A LPPA-PDU can be either an initiatingMessage, a successfulOutcome, or an unsuccessfulOutcome.

q_48906.question: What is the procedure for a UE to obtain additional IPv6 prefixes for a PDU session through DHCPv6?
q_48906.ground_truth: The UE sends a DHCPv6 Solicit message containing one or more identity association for prefix delegation options to the SMF, which upon receiving one or more identity association for prefix delegation prefixes, allocates additional IPv6 prefixes to the UE.

q_48907.question: Which IE does the source eNodeB include in the Handover Required message when the target cell is a hybrid cell during an IRAT handover to UTRAN Iu mode?

q_48908.question: What is the source address of a GTPv2 Initial message?
q_48908.ground_truth: The source address of a GTPv2 Initial message should be an IP address of the source GTPv2 entity from which the message is originating.

q_48909.question: In what scenario would a UE set the EPS update status to EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED and delete any GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI List and KSI?
q_48909.ground_truth: When the UE receives a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message with the reject cause set to "roaming not allowed in this tracking area" after sending a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message with EPS update type set to 'Combined TA/LA updating'.

q_48910.question: What is the minimum time interval before the UE can perform cell reselection?
q_48910.ground_truth: The UE shall not perform cell reselection until more than 1 second has elapsed since the UE camped on the current serving cell.

q_48911.question: When should the mobile station (MS) start timer T3312 in A/Gb mode?
q_48911.ground_truth: The MS should start timer T3312 with its initial value when the READY timer is stopped or expires, or the mobile station is in a state other than GMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE.

q_48912.question: What is the range of values for the "scalingfactor-r18" parameter?
q_48912.ground_truth: The "scalingfactor-r18" parameter can take one of the three values "n1", "n2", or "n4".

q_48913.question: What is the purpose of step 1.2 in the test procedure for PUSCH?
q_48913.ground_truth: The purpose of step 1.2 is to send uplink power control commands to the UE using a 1dB power step size to ensure that the UE output power at each antenna connector measured by the test system is within the Uplink power control window, defined as +MU to +(MU + Uplink power control window size) dB of the target power level, where MU and Uplink power control window size are defined earlier.

q_48914.question: What operation is invoked by the network slice provisioning MnS consumer to request the provider to deallocate a service profile in an NSI?

q_48915.question: What should the MEASURE IN-BAND EMISSIONS steps (1.3, 1.5, 1.7 and 1.9) measure in the test procedure for PUSCH?
q_48915.ground_truth: The MEASURE IN-BAND EMISSIONS steps (1.3, 1.5, 1.7 and 1.9) measure In-band emission using Global In-Channel Tx-Test (Annex E) for each of transmit antennas of the UE. For TDD, only slots consisting of only UL symbols are under test.

q_48916.question: What is the potential specification impact for L1/L2 based UE-UE CLI measurement compared to L3 based UE-UE CLI measurement?
q_48916.ground_truth: For L1/L2 based UE-UE CLI measurement, there is a potential specification impact, while for L3 based UE-UE CLI measurement, there is no specification impact.

q_48917.question: What is the purpose of the "ProSe direct link modification ack" message?
q_48917.ground_truth: The "ProSe direct link modification ack" message is sent by the UE to a peer UE to acknowledge the direct link modification procedure.

q_48918.question: What is used to identify the subgroups of energy applications within one safety zone?

q_48919.question: Which components of the 5GC use the Coordination Identifier in the tactile and multi-modal communication service?
q_48919.ground_truth: The SMF and PCF use the Coordination Identifier to obtain the QoS Policies for the tactile and multi-modal communication service from the UDR. The UE hosted applications use it to provide to the network during PDU Session Establishment, similar to how a DNN would be provided.

q_48920.question: What should the ME do upon receiving the PROVIDE LOCAL INFORMATION command containing a request for location information?
q_48920.ground_truth: The ME shall return the requested location information, which includes the mobile country code (MCC), mobile network code (MNC), location area code/tracking area code (LAC/TAC), and cell ID of the current serving cell within a TERMINAL RESPONSE.

q_48921.question: What are the pre-test conditions for testing the PDCP functions in E-UTRA RRC_CONNECTED state?
q_48921.ground_truth: The UE is in E-UTRA RRC_CONNECTED state, and the Discard Timer for a PDCP SDU has expired or the successful delivery of a PDCP SDU is confirmed by PDCP status report.

q_48922.question: How does the process of generating a NEST (Network Slice Enablement Set) work in the context of 3GPP network architecture?
q_48922.ground_truth: The NSP maps the service requirements into the attributes of the GST with appropriate values to generate the NEST once the Network Slice Customer (NSC) provides the service requirements for the use case to the NSP.

q_48923.question: In what type of network should the SMF not request EBI allocation when a MA PDU Session is established only over non-3GPP access?

q_48924.question: In what scenarios is the SCell activation delay defined in FR1 for intra-band SCell activation?
q_48924.ground_truth: In FR1, the SCell activation delay for intra-band SCell activation is defined as the occasion when all active serving cells and SCells being activated or released are transmitting SSB bursts in the same slot.

q_48925.question: When should the floor participant request the MCPTT client to stop sending RTP media packets towards other MCPTT clients?
q_48925.ground_truth: The floor participant should request the MCPTT client to stop sending RTP media packets towards other MCPTT clients when the floor participant receives a Floor Request message with pre-emption indication or when timer T207 (Stop talking) expires and at least one Floor Request message is stored, indicating that queueing mode is used in the session.

q_48926.question: Which information element is mandatory in the "BroadcastSessionSetupRequestIEs" sequence?
q_48926.ground_truth: The "ID id-MBS-SessionID", "ID id-S-NSSAI", "ID id-MBS-ServiceArea", and "ID id-MBSSessionSetupRequestTransfer" information elements are mandatory in the "BroadcastSessionSetupRequestIEs" sequence.

q_48927.question: What should a UE do with the radio link failure information after 48 hours of detecting the radio link failure, a power off, detach, or entering another RAT in NB-IoT?
q_48927.ground_truth: The UE may discard the radio link failure information, i.e. release the UE variable VarRLF-Report (VarRLF-Report-NB in NB-IoT).

q_48928.question: What action should the gNB-CU-UP take if it receives a BEARER CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message containing a QoS Flow Level QoS Parameters IE for a GBR QoS Flow but where the GBR QoS Flow Information IE is not present?
q_48928.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-UP should report the establishment of the corresponding QoS Flow as failed in the corresponding Flow Failed List IE of the BEARER CONTEXT SETUP RESPONSE message with an appropriate cause value.

q_48929.question: What should the MME do when it receives a BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message for a PDN connection established for emergency bearer services?
q_48929.ground_truth: The MME should reply with a BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REJECT message with ESM cause #30 "request rejected by Serving GW or PDN GW" in this case.

q_48930.question: What network scenarios are specified in sub clause 4.4.1.2.2 of the document?
q_48930.ground_truth: Non-standalone E-UTRA single cell and FDD or TDD NR intra-frequency single mode multi cell environment, FDD or TDD E-UTRA intra-frequency single mode multi cell and FDD or TDD NR inter-frequency single mode multi cell environment, FDD or TDD E-UTRA inter-frequency single mode multi cell and FDD or TDD NR inter-frequency single mode multi cell environment, and single E-UTRA cell and FDD or TDD NR inter-band single mode multi cell environment are specified in sub clause 4.4.1.2.2 of the document.

q_48931.question: What is the difference between MTCH and SC-MTCH in downlink transport channels?
q_48931.ground_truth: MTCH is used for transmitting traffic data from the network to the UE using MBMS, while SC-MTCH is used for transmitting traffic data from the network to the UE using SC-PTM transmission.

q_48932.question: What statistics should be kept for a signal generator sending random codewords in regular time periods in the context of ACK missed detection?
q_48932.ground_truth: The statistics kept are the number of falsely detected ACK bits in the idle periods and the number of missed ACK bits.

q_48933.question: What should the transmission participant do when timer T102 (Transmission Queue Position Request) expires by the upper limit of counter C102 (Queue Position Request) times?
q_48933.ground_truth: The transmission participant should provide a queued timeout to the MCVideo client, send the Transmission End Request message to the transmission control server, start timer T101 (Transmission End Request) and increment counter C101 by 1, and enter the 'U: pending end of transmission' state.

q_48934.question: How long is the S-SSB period in NR sidelink communication?
q_48934.ground_truth: The S-SSB period is 160 ms in NR sidelink communication.

q_48935.question: In situation 11f, what is the condition for the band relation between PCC(TDD) and SCell1 to be intra-band and the other SCells to be inter-band?
q_48935.ground_truth: The condition is that the band relation between PCC(TDD) and SCell1 is intra-band and the band relation between PCC(TDD) and other SCells are inter-band.

q_48936.question: What is the test purpose described in section 17.5.1.4?
q_48936.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described in section 17.5.1.4 is to verify that the UE properly detects the out of sync and in sync for the purpose of monitoring downlink radio link quality of the PCell.

q_48937.question: What is the expected action of the UE during time duration T3?
q_48937.ground_truth: During time duration T3, the UE is expected to detect Out-Of-Sync (OOS) and declare Radio Link Failure (RLF).

q_48938.question: What is the purpose of energy saving management solutions in 5G networks?
q_48938.ground_truth: The purpose of energy saving management solutions is to lower operational expense by decreasing power consumption in 5G networks, while maintaining coverage, capacity, and quality of service.

q_48939.question: What occurs when a UE moves from EPS to 5GS?
q_48939.ground_truth: The UE Policy Association Establishment procedure is initiated, and if a UE Policy Association for the UE exists in EPS, the UE-PCF will initiate the UE Policy Association Termination procedure to terminate the UE Policy Association in EPS.

q_48940.question: In the context of event triggered measurements, when is it necessary to initiate the measurement reporting procedure as specified in clause 5.5.5?
q_48940.ground_truth: The measurement reporting procedure is initiated when the event is triggered for one or more applicable cells and the VarMeasReportList does not include a measurement reporting entry for this measId.

q_48941.question: When sending continuously uplink power control commands to the UE, what delay is allowed after the first TPC command before the UE reaches its PUMAX level?
q_48941.ground_truth: At least 200 ms from the first TPC command is allowed for the UE to reach its PUMAX level.

q_48942.question: What is the relaying mechanism used by IAB in the NR Uu backhaul links?
q_48942.ground_truth: IAB performs relaying at layer-2, and therefore does not require a local UPF.

q_48943.question: In which time period does L2 interruption occur while identifying CGI of an NR cell with autonomous gaps, where autonomous gaps are used in the frequency range of PCell or any activated SCell?
q_48943.ground_truth: L2 interruption occurs during SIB1 decoding time period TSIB1 (ms) specified in clause 9.11, when the CORESET for RMSI scheduling multiplexing patterns 2 and 3 are used.

q_48944.question: Which Diameter application is specified for roaming cases involving the IWK-SCEF, MME/SGSN, and SCEF?

q_48945.question: In what state does the network enter after starting a de-registration procedure for 5GMM and waiting for a response from the UE?
q_48945.ground_truth: The network enters state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED after it has started a de-registration procedure and is waiting for a response from the UE.

q_48946.question: What is the requirement for the number of antenna ports that must be connected with data source from the system simulator when 4RX is supported?
q_48946.ground_truth: All four Rx ports must be connected with data source from the system simulator.

q_48947.question: What type of base station operation is not supported by the AAS BS?
q_48947.ground_truth: NB-IoT in-band, NB-IoT guard band, standalone NB-IoT operation, Band 46 operation, and Band 49 operation are not supported by the AAS BS.

q_48948.question: What response should the SCC AS send to the remote UE upon receiving a SIP 2xx response to the SIP UPDATE request it sent?
q_48948.ground_truth: The SCC AS should send a SIP 183 (Session Progress) response to the original SIP INVITE request due to ATU-STI for CS to PS SRVCC.

q_48949.question: What constraints should be followed for all Representations in an Adaptation Set?
q_48949.ground_truth: The identical coverage information, frame rates, and stereoscopic information should be present on all Representations in an Adaptation Set, both on ISO BMFF and elementary stream level.

q_48950.question: What action does the MCPTT client take when it receives RTP media packets and there is no stored SSRC of the current floor arbitrator?
q_48950.ground_truth: The MCPTT client requests to render the RTP media packets, resets the counter C201 (Floor Request) to 1, sets the stored SSRC of the current floor arbitrator to the SSRC of the RTP media packet, restarts timer T203 (End of RTP media), and remains in the 'O: pending request' state.

q_48951.question: What is a condition to determine the set of MBMS frequencies of interest?
q_48951.ground_truth: At least one MBMS session the UE is receiving or interested to receive via an MRB or SC-MRB is ongoing or about to start, and for at least one of these MBMS sessions SystemInformationBlockType15 acquired from the PCell includes for the concerned frequency one or more MBMS SAIs as indicated in the USD for this session.

q_48952.question: What action does the T-RAN take if it does not receive the UE Radio Capability ID along with the UE radio access capabilities from the source RAN node during a handover procedure?
q_48952.ground_truth: The T-RAN proceeds with the handover using the received UE radio access capabilities.

q_48953.question: What is the requirement for a UE to support the ce-EUTRA-5GC-HO-ToNR-TDD-FR2-2-r17 feature?
q_48953.ground_truth: A UE that supports the ce-EUTRA-5GC-HO-ToNR-TDD-FR2-2-r17 feature must also indicate support for ce-EUTRA-5GC-r16 and should have a UE Category other than Category M1 and M2.

q_48954.question: What are the four modules that make up the Converged Charging System (CCS) in the common charging architecture?
q_48954.ground_truth: The Converged Charging System (CCS) consists of four distinct modules, namely the CHF, the Account Balance Management Function (ABMF), the Charging Gateway Function (CGF), and the Rating Function (RF).

q_48955.question: For what purposes is the Handover-Info header field used?
q_48955.ground_truth: The Handover-Info header field is used to indicate that the UE needs to be re-authenticated using mechanisms defined in 3GPP TS 24.229, and to inform when a re-authentication of a UE entering the mobile network has been completed. It can also be used to inform the UE of the role in a call, fulfilling legal requirements.

q_48956.question: What should the UE do if it has radio link failure information or handover failure information available and the PLMN identity stored in VarRLF-Report is equal to the RPLMN, upon receiving a UEInformationRequest message with rlf-ReportReq set to true?
q_48956.ground_truth: The UE should set the rlf-Report in the UEInformationResponse message to the value of rlf-Report in VarRLF-Report.

q_48957.question: What percentage of internet traffic is encrypted as of November 2018?

q_48958.question: What should a UE do if the Back-off timer value IE is not included and the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST was sent standalone?
q_48958.ground_truth: The UE may send another PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST, BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST, or BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST message for the same APN.

q_48959.question: How are the default/alternate options determined in a roaming scenario for a non-local ID target?
q_48959.ground_truth: The default/alternate options used in the HPLMN and the VPLMN are mutually independent when the target is a non-local ID in a roaming scenario.

q_48960.question: Which section in this text provides the measurement uncertainties and test tolerances for intra-band contiguous carrier aggregation CA?
q_48960.ground_truth: This information has not been determined yet and might be addressed in the future (labeled as "TBD" in the original text).

q_48961.question: What is the AF request information that the NEF stores in the UDR as "Application Data" when creating a new request?
q_48961.ground_truth: The AF request information that the NEF stores in the UDR as "Application Data" when creating a new request includes the information described in clause 5.2.6.11.

q_48962.question: What services are managed by the Role management & presence application in Off-Network mode?
q_48962.ground_truth: The Role management & presence application in Off-Network mode is responsible for managing the identities, presence and functional addressing for the FRMCS System.

q_48963.question: What should a UE do when the S-NSSAI time validity information indicates that the S-NSSAI is available?
q_48963.ground_truth: The UE may initiate a UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure to establish a PDU session associated with the S-NSSAI.

q_48964.question: When is the PCRF required to validate sponsored connectivity data when enabling sponsored data connectivity?
q_48964.ground_truth: The PCRF is required to validate sponsored connectivity data when it is based on operator policies and the PCEF/TDF supports sponsored data connectivity or the required reporting level is different from sponsored connectivity level.

q_48965.question: What is used to indicate the radio parameters for ProSe direct communication?

q_48966.question: What is a PDP context in the context of bearer operations?
q_48966.ground_truth: A PDP context is a data channel between the mobile device and the network in a packet-based network.

q_48967.question: What is a SLPP PDU data structure?
q_48967.ground_truth: The SLPP PDU data structure is an abstract structure used to represent a SLPP PDU.

q_48968.question: What is the purpose of having a dedicated IMEI/PEI for each registered USIM in a MUSIM UE?
q_48968.ground_truth: The dedicated IMEI/PEI for each registered USIM in a MUSIM UE helps the 3GPP system to treat each registration independently and manage them more efficiently.

q_48969.question: What triggers the mobile station to request the RR sublayer to establish a RR connection in the location updating procedure?
q_48969.ground_truth: The absence of an RR connection at the start of the location updating procedure.

q_48970.question: In what circumstances should a UE select an entry of the list of resource pool entries in discTxPoolCommon to transmit sidelink discovery announcements?
q_48970.ground_truth: When the frequency used to transmit sidelink discovery announcements on is included in discInterFreqList within SystemInformationBlockType19 of the serving cell/PCell, and discTxResourcesInterFreq within discResourcesPS in the corresponding entry of discInterFreqList is set to discTxPoolCommon.

q_48971.question: When is logging of metadata for MCPTT group calls, MCPTT private calls and non-call activities enabled?
q_48971.ground_truth: When set to "true" logging of metadata for MCPTT group calls, MCPTT private calls and non-call activities is enabled. When set to "false" logging of metadata for MCPTT group calls, MCPTT private calls and non-call activities is not enabled.

q_48972.question: What is the requirement for the UE when sending a REGISTER request using IMS AKA as a security mechanism?
q_48972.ground_truth: The UE shall populate the header fields with the "username", "realm", "uri", "nonce", and "response" in the Authorization header field, and further header fields such as the Security-Client header field, set to specify the security mechanism it supports.

q_48973.question: What is the requirement for reporting the RSRP measurement range in UE category M1 with CE mode A?
q_48973.ground_truth: The reporting range of RSRP is the same as defined in section 9.1.4.

q_48974.question: When would the tracking area updating attempt counter be incremented and the UE shall set the EPS update status to EU2 NOT UPDATED, but shall not delete any LAI, TMSI, ciphering key sequence number and list of equivalent PLMNs?
q_48974.ground_truth: If the tracking area updating attempt counter is incremented and it is less than 5, the UE shall set the update status to U2 NOT UPDATED, but shall not delete any LAI, TMSI, ciphering key sequence number and list of equivalent PLMNs.

q_48975.question: What type of SIP MESSAGE request is sent to the originating participating MCPTT function with the Request-URI set to the public service identity of the originating participating MCPTT function, containing a Content-Type header field set to "application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml" and including an XML body containing a <mcpttinfo> root element with a <mcptt-Params> element containing an <anyExt> element with the <request-type> element set to a value of "remotely-initiated-private-call-request" or with the <response-type> element set to a value of "remotely-initiated-private-call-response"?
q_48975.ground_truth: A SIP MESSAGE request for remotely initiated private call for originating participating MCPTT function.

q_48976.question: What types of service links are supported in the described NTN system?
q_48976.ground_truth: Earth-fixed, quasi-Earth-fixed, and Earth-moving service links are supported.

q_48977.question: Who is responsible for ensuring that the vendor information provided by the AnLF is correct?
q_48977.ground_truth: The task of verifying the accuracy of the vendor information of the AnLF is assigned to SA~WG3.

q_48978.question: What action should the gNB-CU-UP take if it cannot establish the requested bearer context?
q_48978.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-UP should consider the procedure as failed and respond with a BEARER CONTEXT SETUP FAILURE message and appropriate cause value.

q_48979.question: What should Endpoint A do when it receives an acknowledgement for LPP message N from Endpoint B and the ackIndicator IE in the acknowledgement matches the sequence number sent in message N?
q_48979.ground_truth: Endpoint A sends the next LPP message N+1 to Endpoint B when it is available.

q_48980.question: Which enumeration defines the enumerated types of Periodic Communication Indicator?
q_48980.ground_truth: PeriodicCommunicationIndicator defines the enumerated types of Periodic Communication Indicator.

q_48981.question: What happens when the EEC sends an ACR request message to the EES for solution #22?
q_48981.ground_truth: The EES, at the time of requesting traffic influence towards 3GPP CN, provides additional requirement for simultaneous PSA connectivity, resulting in simultaneous connectivity with both S-EAS and T-EAS.

q_48982.question: What should the MCData client do if the SIP MESSAGE request contains an <emergency-ind-rcvd> element set to "true" and the <mcdata-client-id> matches the sent MCData client ID?
q_48982.ground_truth: If an <emergency-ind> element is present in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body of the received SIP MESSAGE request and is set to a value of "false", the MCData emergency group state of the group should be set to "MDEG 1: no-emergency".

q_48983.question: What should the I-CSCF include in the P-Charging-Vector header field upon receiving a request from a UE that supports charging?
q_48983.ground_truth: The I-CSCF should store the value of the "icid-value" header field parameter received in the P-Charging-Vector header field and retain the P-Charging-Vector header field in the P-Charging-Vector header field.

q_48984.question: What is the role of the non-controlling MCVideo function of an MCVideo group in an MCVideo call?
q_48984.ground_truth: The non-controlling MCVideo function of an MCVideo group in an MCVideo call is responsible for handling transmission control messages between the MCVideo clients and the transmission control server, controlling the media distributor, and managing the interfaces with the application and signalling plane, transmission participant, transmission control server, media distributor, and the network media interface.

q_48985.question: What bit should the MME set in the EPS network feature support IE of the ATTACH ACCEPT message if the UE indicates support of the paging indication for voice services in the ATTACH REQUEST message and the network decides to accept the paging indication for voice services?
q_48985.ground_truth: The MME should set the paging indication for voice services bit to "paging indication for voice services supported" in the EPS network feature support IE of the ATTACH ACCEPT message.

q_48986.question: What action should the gNB-DU take if the NR V2X Services Authorized IE includes one or more IEs set to "not authorized" in the UE CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message?
q_48986.ground_truth: If supported, the gNB-DU shall initiate actions to ensure that the UE is no longer accessing the relevant service(s).

q_48987.question: What should the AMF do if the UE sets the Request type to "NAS signalling connection release" in the SERVICE REQUEST message and restricts paging?
q_48987.ground_truth: The AMF shall include the 5GS additional request result IE in the SERVICE ACCEPT message and set the Paging restriction decision, either accepting or rejecting the paging restriction.

q_48988.question: What are the two alternatives for ensuring that no lawfully authorized surveillance events are missed in the LI system?
q_48988.ground_truth: 1. Full target list at every POI node, 2. Full target list only in LICF

q_48989.question: What is the function of the LIU procedure in the context of a UE-to-UE Relay based on IP routing?
q_48989.ground_truth: The LIU procedure is used to update identifiers, such as Layer-ID, MSB of Knrp-sess ID, and potentially IP address/prefix and other identifiers, for privacy reasons. When a UE changes its identifiers, the UE-to-UE Relay also needs to update its identifiers since it handles the IP routing of messages exchanged between the UE1 and UE2.

q_48990.question: What is the purpose of EF~VBCSS (Voice Broadcast Service Status) in VBS?
q_48990.ground_truth: The EF~VBCSS (Voice Broadcast Service Status) is used to contain the status of activation for the VBS group identifiers in VBS. The EF shall always be allocated if EF~VBS is allocated.

q_48991.question: When constructing an inner IPv4 datagram in the ESP protected IP packet, what is the source port number set to when the UE constructs the inner IPv4 datagram?
q_48991.ground_truth: The source port number is set to the UE's TCP port number.

q_48992.question: What 3GPP specification outlines the process of handling a SIP REFER request for transfer of an additional session within a dialog established by the SIP INVITE request to STI-rSR in clause 12.2B.3.1?
q_48992.ground_truth: 3GPP specification outlines the process in clause 12.2B.3.1 of TS 24.237.

q_48993.question: What is the benchmark used for the evaluation of the model?
q_48993.ground_truth: The benchmark is Rel-16 Type II codebook.

q_48994.question: What should the UE do if it receives a REGISTRATION REJECT message with Disaster return wait range IE and it supports MINT?
q_48994.ground_truth: The UE shall delete the disaster return wait range stored in the ME, if any, and store the disaster return wait range included in the Disaster return wait range IE in the ME.

q_48995.question: What is the purpose of the Message Identifier parameter in CBS messages?
q_48995.ground_truth: The Message Identifier parameter identifies the source and type of the CBS message. It is used to distinguish a number of CBS messages that may originate from the same source and/or be of the same type.

q_48996.question: What information does the Application Function (AF) support receiving from the NWDAF or via the NEF?
q_48996.ground_truth: The AF supports receiving various types of information from the NWDAF or via the NEF, including UE mobility information, UE communication information, expected UE behavioural information, and more.

q_48997.question: Which message does a UE send to discover the address of the HA during HA discovery based on DHCPv6?
q_48997.ground_truth: The UE sends an Information-Request message including the Home Network Identifier Option to discover the address of the HA during HA discovery based on DHCPv6.

q_48998.question: What type of data can be collected by NWDAF from UPF using the QoS monitoring event?
q_48998.ground_truth: QoS Monitoring Measurement and/or QoS Flow Bandwidth measurements can be collected by NWDAF from UPF using the QoS monitoring event.

q_48999.question: What information is included in the notification towards the SCEF for "UE Reachability" or "Availability after DDN failure" request?
q_48999.ground_truth: Upon the UE's transition to idle mode, the MME/SGSN includes the time at which the UE transitioned into idle mode, the active time, periodic TAU/RAU time granted to the UE, eDRX cycle length, and the suggested number of downlink packets in the notification towards the SCEF, if applicable.

q_49000.question: What should the AMF do if the UE has an emergency PDU session established and is not allowed to access the TA or a specific cell due to CAG restrictions?
q_49000.ground_truth: The AMF may accept the SERVICE REQUEST message and indicate to the SMF to perform a local release of all non-emergency PDU sessions and inform the UE via the PDU session status IE in the SERVICE ACCEPT message.

q_49001.question: What action does the old NG-RAN node take upon reception of the RETRIEVE UE CONTEXT CONFIRM message in the Retrieve UE Context Confirm procedure?
q_49001.ground_truth: The old NG-RAN node releases the resources related to the UE-associated signalling connection between the old NG-RAN node and the new NG-RAN node.

q_49002.question: What should the S-CSCF do if there is no original dialog identifier present in the topmost Route header field of the incoming request?
q_49002.ground_truth: If there is no original dialog identifier present in the topmost Route header field of the incoming request, the S-CSCF should store the value of the "orig-ioi" header field parameter received in the P-Charging-Vector header field, if present, remove received "orig-ioi" header field parameter if next hop is not an AS, and include a type 1 "orig-ioi" header field parameter if next hop is not an AS.

q_49003.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for Carrier leakage in 6.4A.2.2?
q_49003.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirement for Carrier leakage is defined in clause 6.4A.2.2.0.

q_49004.question: What is the effect of the <mode> parameter in the +CSDF command?
q_49004.ground_truth: The <mode> parameter in the +CSDF command affects the date format presented to the user on the phone display and does not affect the date format of the AT command serial interface.

q_49005.question: When should the UE include the header field parameters "require" and "explicit" in the Accept-Contact header field containing the ICSI value or IARI value?
q_49005.ground_truth: The UE should include the header field parameters "require" and "explicit" in the Accept-Contact header field containing the ICSI value or IARI value if the IMS communication service absolutely requires that the terminating UE understand the IMS communication service in order to be able to accept the session.

q_49006.question: What format must a phone number be in to be interpreted as a fully defined international number in an IMS network?
