q_49248.ground_truth: The absolute power tolerance for eMBB operation is the ability of the UE transmitter to set its initial output power to a specific value for the first sub-frame at the start of a contiguous transmission or non-contiguous transmission with a transmission gap larger than 20ms.

q_49249.question: Under what condition should the UE re-initiate the UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure in step 4?
q_49249.ground_truth: The UE should re-initiate the UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure when the PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message includes 5GSM cause #39 "reactivation requested".

q_49250.question: What is the requirement for the delay uncertainty when inserting the ECGI measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH?
q_49250.ground_truth: The delay uncertainty is twice the TTI of the uplink DCCH.

q_49251.question: What is the formula for calculating the lower sub-block edge of the Sub-block Bandwidth (BWchannel,block) for intra-band non-contiguous carrier aggregation?
q_49251.ground_truth: The lower sub-block edge of the Sub-block Bandwidth (BWchannel,block) is defined as Fedge,block, low = FC,block,low - Foffset, low.

q_49252.question: Which frequency band  Indicator (FBI) is  64 in value?
q_49252.ground_truth: The maximum value of the frequency band indicator for the fuel band indicator range is 64 in value.

q_49253.question: In what circumstances will the MCPTT function reject the request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response due to the user's MCPTT user profile document restrictions?
q_49253.ground_truth: If the called user is unable to participate in private calls identified in the called user's MCPTT user profile document, the MCPTT function will reject the request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response.

q_49254.question: What is the difference in the leaving condition's conditions (B2-3 and B2-4) for event B2, and when do they activate, given a positive threshold (Thresh2) and hysteresis (Hys) value?
q_49254.ground_truth: Condition B2-3: Mp - Hys > Thresh1. This condition is used to detect when the PCell's measurement result (Mp) is higher than Thresh1 with hysteresis. Condition B2-4: Mn + Ofn + Ocn + Hys < Thresh2. This condition is used to detect when the inter-RAT neighbor cell's measurement result (Mn) is below Thresh2 after subtracting hysteresis.

q_49255.question: What are the conditions for a UE to declare REs as not available for PDSCH when it monitors PDCCH candidates with the same starting CCE index in non-interleaved CORESET spanning one OFDM symbol?
q_49255.ground_truth: If a UE monitors PDCCH candidates with the same starting CCE index in non-interleaved CORESET spanning one OFDM symbol, and if a detected PDCCH scheduling the PDSCH has aggregation level 8, the resources corresponding to the aggregation level 16 PDCCH candidate are not available for the PDSCH. When at least one of the PDCCH candidates of aggregation levels 8 and 16 linked as indicated by searchSpaceLinkingId, the PDCCH candidates of aggregation level 16 and any other PDCCH candidate(s) linked with any of the PDCCH candidates of aggregation level 8 and 16 are not available for the PDSCH reception at the UE, if a detected PDCCH scheduling the PDSCH is associated with the PDCCH candidates of aggregation level 8 or 16.

q_49256.question: What does the ExternalNRCellCU IOC represent in the MOCN networking sharing scenario?
q_49256.ground_truth: It represents the properties of an NROperatorCellCU controlled by another Management Service Provider.

q_49257.question: When will the AMF release the N1 NAS signalling connection after the completion of the service request procedure?
q_49257.ground_truth: For cases o and p in subclause 5.6.1.1, the AMF shall initiate the release of the N1 NAS signalling connection after the completion of the service request procedure.

q_49258.question: What is the role of the CSI generation part in the CSI compression use case?
q_49258.ground_truth: The CSI generation part is responsible for generating the input of the CSI compression model, which is located at the user equipment (UE) side.

q_49259.question: What procedure is used to release dedicated resources using off-path signalling for PMIP-based S5/S8 deployments in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_49259.ground_truth: The procedure is described in clause 5.5 in the 3GPP technical specification.

q_49260.question: How much degradation in Top-1 beam prediction accuracy did evaluation results from one source show for Case 3 in the third generalization scenario?
q_49260.ground_truth: Evaluation results from one source showed 8%-14% degradation in Top-1 beam prediction accuracy for Case 3 in the third generalization scenario.

q_49261.question: In what state does the floor participant interface remain when it receives RTP media packets from the MCPTT client?
q_49261.ground_truth: The floor participant interface remains in the 'P: has permission' state when it receives RTP media packets from the MCPTT client.

q_49262.question: When is the 428 "Use Identity Header" response code used in SIP requests?
q_49262.ground_truth: When the verification service receives a SIP request that lacks an Identity header.

q_49263.question: What is the purpose of the IPDL time mask requirement in the AAS BS?
q_49263.ground_truth: The IPDL time mask specifies the limits at the RIB output power during idle periods, supporting the IPDL location method in UTRA FDD operation.

q_49264.question: What should the UE do with the TAI list received in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message?
q_49264.ground_truth: If the UE receives a new TAI list in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message, it shall consider the new TAI list as valid and the old TAI list as invalid.

q_49265.question: What is the measurement provided by "Number of requested legacy handover preparations" in the context of 5G mobility management?
q_49265.ground_truth: The number of legacy handover preparations requested by the source gNB.

q_49266.question: Which shapes are relevant to Local Co-ordinates in the GAD specification?
q_49266.ground_truth: Local 2D point with uncertainty ellipse and Local 3D point with uncertainty ellipsoid are relevant shapes for Local Co-ordinates in the GAD specification.

q_49267.question: What should the UE do when initiating emergency calls if access class 10 is indicated as barred in a cell?
q_49267.ground_truth: If access class 10 is indicated as barred in a cell, UEs with access class 0 to 9 or without an IMSI are not allowed to initiate emergency calls in this cell. For UEs with access classes 11 to 15, emergency calls are not allowed if both access class 10 and the relevant access class (11 to 15) are barred. Otherwise, emergency calls are allowed for those UEs.

q_49268.question: What is the structure of the TSCAssistanceInformation-ExtIEs?
q_49268.ground_truth: It is a sequence that contains extended protocol information for TSC Assistance Information.

q_49269.question: What is the purpose of the NR intra-frequency RRC re-establishment delay test without serving cell timing?
q_49269.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to verify that the delay is within the specified limits, ensuring compliance with clause~6.2.1B.

q_49270.question: Who is the applicability of this test case restricted to?
q_49270.ground_truth: This test case applies to all types of E-UTRA FDD UE release 14 and forward, all types of E-UTRA TDD UE release 14 and forward, and all types of E-UTRA UE release 14 and forward that support E-UTRA FDD, TDD and 7DL CA. Applicability requires support for FGI bit 111.

q_49271.question: What should be removed from the list of "candidate band combinations" if the network includes the eutra-nr-only field or if the requested rat-Type is eutra?

q_49272.question: What should a receiving node do when it receives a response message containing one or more IEs/IE groups marked with "Ignore IE and Notify Sender" which it does not comprehend?
q_49272.ground_truth: The receiving node should consider the procedure as unsuccessfully terminated and initiate local error handling.

q_49273.question: Which procedure steps are involved in the test described in 6.4D.4.4.2?
q_49273.ground_truth: The procedure for the test described in 6.4D.4.4.2 involves sending uplink scheduling information for each UL HARQ process, continuously sending uplink power control "up" commands, measuring the mean power of the UE on each antenna port in the channel bandwidth, and calculating the power difference between antenna ports.

q_49274.question: What does the 5GMS Application Provider do in the procedure for dynamic provisioning of 5GMS content delivery via MBS?
q_49274.ground_truth: The 5GMS Application Provider provisions one or more 5GMSd services and permits broadcast distribution of the media content, which can be done dynamically based on demand.

q_49275.question: What should the 3GPP AAA Server do when the HSS-initiated user profile update procedure is not successful?
q_49275.ground_truth: If the HSS-initiated user profile update procedure is not successful, the 3GPP AAA Server shall not modify the stored user profile.

q_49276.question: What should the SLM-C do when receiving a SIP NOTIFY request or HTTP POST message with a specific application/vnd.3gpp.seal-location-info+xml MIME body from the SLM server?
q_49276.ground_truth: The SLM-C should store the received location information and may share it with a group, another VAL user, or VAL UE.

q_49277.question: How does Yuan and Xun's operator managed game services provide accurate absolute positioning for the immersive game NEXGalaxy?
q_49277.ground_truth: The operator managed game services use the operator direct device connections capability and operate on the operator's managed spectrum to provide accurate absolute positioning.

q_49278.question: In what circumstances should a UE start acquiring SystemInformationBlockType8?
q_49278.ground_truth: Following a request from CDMA2000 upper layers.

q_49279.question: What is the purpose of defining abbreviations and definitions in the 3GPP TS?
q_49279.ground_truth: The purpose of defining abbreviations and definitions in the 3GPP TS is to establish a common terminology for the present document, making it easier to understand the specifications and requirements.

q_49280.question: What is the packet delay monitoring mechanism in 5GS?
q_49280.ground_truth: QoS Monitoring for packet delay allows for the measurement of UL packet delay, DL packet delay or round trip packet delay between UE and PSA UPF. The PCF may calculate Packet Delay Variation based on packet delay monitoring results of QoS flows.

q_49281.question: What is the name of the DTMF info package?
q_49281.ground_truth: The name of the DTMF info package is "infoDtmf".

q_49282.question: What is the "DelayE2EUlNs" KPI used to measure in unit of 0.1 ms?
q_49282.ground_truth: The "DelayE2EUlNs" KPI is used to measure the weighted average packet delay from when an UL RLC SDU was scheduled at the UE until the time when the corresponding GTP PDU was received by the PSA UPF in a network slice.

q_49283.question: What should the PGW do during a S5/S8 procedure impacting PDN connection removal or modification?
q_49283.ground_truth: During a S5/S8 procedure, the PGW should clear the currently stored MME and SGW FQ-CSID values, include PGW FQ-CSID in the S5/S8 Modify Bearer Response message, overwrite the respective stored FQ-CSID values with the received values, and erase the MME FQ-CSID value if it doesn't support the feature, and remove stored FQ-CSID values and PDN data during an S5/S8 procedure removing an existing PDN connection.

q_49284.question: What is the condition for satisfying the path loss criterion in 3GPP TS~43.022?

q_49285.question: In the intra-band and inter-band scenario, if DTX is observed by the SS during the subframes (n+5) to (n+13), what happens to the count for the event "Deactivation"?
q_49285.ground_truth: If DTX is observed by the SS in the specified subframes, the count for the event "Deactivation" is reset to 0.

q_49286.question: In 3GPP NR, what is the difference between a "direct path" and an "indirect path" in the context of multi-path?
q_49286.ground_truth: In 3GPP NR, a "direct path" refers to the connection between the UE and gNB using NR Uu, while an "indirect path" refers to the UE connecting to the same gNB via another UE using PC5 unicast link or Non-3GPP Connectivity.

q_49287.question: What information should be mapped from the EPS bearer contexts to the PDP contexts when inter-system changes occur?
q_49287.ground_truth: Linked EPS bearer identity should be mapped to linked TI, PDN address and APN of the default EPS bearer context should be mapped to PDP address and APN of the default PDP context, and TFT of both default and dedicated EPS bearer contexts should be mapped to corresponding TFTs of secondary PDP contexts.

q_49288.question: What is the definition of the basic in-band emissions measurement interval?
q_49288.ground_truth: The basic in-band emissions measurement interval is identical to that of the EVM test.

q_49289.question: What are the two E-UTRA FDD carriers and one cell specified in the test case?
q_49289.ground_truth: There are two E-UTRA FDD carriers and one cell on each carrier specified in the test.

q_49290.question: What must the Serving GW include in the Proxy Binding Update message when sending it to the PDN GW in step A.2?
q_49290.ground_truth: The Serving GW must include the MN NAI, Lifetime, Access Technology Type, Handover Indicator, IP Address Requested, APN, GRE Key for downlink traffic, and Additional Parameters in the Proxy Binding Update message when sending it to the PDN GW in step A.2.

q_49291.question: How many intra-frequency cells shall the UE be capable of performing measurements for when nonUniform1-nonUniform4 gaps are activated?
q_49291.ground_truth: At least Ymeasurement intra but no less than 8 identified-intra frequency cells, where Ymeasurement intra is defined in the provided equation.

q_49292.question: What should the UE do when it receives a measObject that includes the cellsToRemoveList?
q_49292.ground_truth: The UE should remove the entry with the matching cellIndex from the cellsToAddModList.

q_49293.question: What are the three interfaces defined in GGSN-InterfaceList?

q_49294.question: What is the required conformance for out-of-band blocking for EN-DC within FR1?
q_49294.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements are defined in clause~7.6B.3.0.1, exception requirements for both NR and E-UTRA are defined for this test and therefore LTE anchor agnostic approach is not applied. E-UTRA test point analysis is included and E-UTRA measurements are performed.

q_49295.question: In case of EMM cause #31 received by a UE that has not indicated support for CIoT optimizations or not indicated support for N1 mode, what should the UE do?
q_49295.ground_truth: The UE should set the EPS update status to EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, delete any GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI list, and eKSI, and reset the attach attempt counter. If the UE is operating in single-registration mode, it should also handle the 5GMM parameters accordingly.

q_49296.question: What type of value is specified for the "MCC" leaf in the RLOSAllowedMCCList node?
q_49296.ground_truth: The "MCC" leaf in the RLOSAllowedMCCList node specifies a value in the format of a Mobile Country Code (MCC), which consists of digits encoded as ASCII characters.

q_49297.question: What action does the MB-SMF take upon receiving a notification of NG-RAN failure from either the AMF or MB-UPF when unicast transport is used over N3mb for 5GC Shared MBS traffic delivery?
q_49297.ground_truth: The MB-SMF modifies the PFCP sessions corresponding to the affected MBS sessions to remove the NG-RAN DL F-TEID in case NG-RAN failure without restart for unicast transport over N3mb.

q_49298.question: Under what conditions does the V-PCRF send a Diameter Termination Request?
q_49298.ground_truth: The V-PCRF sends a Diameter Termination Request when it receives an external trigger indicating the termination of the Diameter sessions, such as session termination requests from the BBERF or the PCEF.

q_49299.question: What is the purpose of Handover Indication information in the handover scenario?
q_49299.ground_truth: The Handover Indication information instructs the PDN GW and Serving GW to maintain the current PDN connections in the process of handover and to not switch the tunnel from non-3GPP IP access to 3GPP access system.

q_49300.question: What does the term "TSG" stand for in the context of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project?
q_49300.ground_truth: TSG stands for Technical Specification Group in the context of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project.

q_49301.question: What should the UE do when the back-off timer value indicates a non-zero value and an S-NSSAI was provided during the PDU session establishment?
q_49301.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T3585 associated with the S-NSSAI of the PDU session, if it is running, and start timer T3585 with the received value. It should also avoid sending a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message, or PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message with certain exceptions, for the S-NSSAI of the PDU session until timer T3585 expires or is stopped.

q_49302.question: What is the test purpose of 6.3A.4.2.3?
q_49302.ground_truth: To verify the UE's ability to transmit with a broadband output power below the value specified in the test requirement when the power is set to a minimum value.

q_49303.question: What is the total cell re-selection delay that is allowed for an already detected low priority cell (Cell 1) for UE fulfilling low mobility criterion in this test case?

q_49304.question: What is the purpose of the SL consistent LBT failure detection procedure?
q_49304.ground_truth: To detect SL consistent LBT failure per RB set by counting SL LBT failure indications, for all SL transmissions, from the lower layers to the MAC entity.

q_49305.question: What should the source MME do after receiving the Handover Required message from the source eNB?
q_49305.ground_truth: The source MME should check the UE's security capabilities and access rights to decide whether it can initiate handover to 5GS, select the target AMF and send a Forward Relocation Request to the selected target AMF, including UE's EPS security context.

q_49306.question: What is the requirement for a UE capable of V2X sidelink communication and SLSS/PSBCH transmission when transmitting non-P2X related V2X sidelink communication?
q_49306.ground_truth: The UE must transmit SLSS and the MasterInformationBlock-SL or MasterInformationBlock-SL-V2X message on the frequency used for V2X sidelink communication when certain conditions are met.

q_49307.question: What should the UE do if it detects a cell with a physical identity not allowed for a specific carrier in the serving cell's measurement control system information?
q_49307.ground_truth: The UE is not required to perform measurements on that cell.

q_49308.question: What should the UE do if it is in EMM-IDLE mode and timer T3346 is not running?
q_49308.ground_truth: The UE stays in the current serving cell and applies the normal cell reselection process. The service request procedure is started, if still necessary, when timer T3346 expires or is stopped.

q_49309.question: What should the UE do if the GUTI/IMSI mapping is correct but the authentication procedure fails?
q_49309.ground_truth: The UE should terminate the authentication procedure by sending an AUTHENTICATION REJECT message.

q_49310.question: In what scenarios should the MCData client execute the procedures in clause~6.2.8.1.1?
q_49310.ground_truth: When the MCData user has requested the origination of an MCData emergency group communication or is originating an MCData pre-arranged group communication and the MCData emergency state is already set.

q_49311.question: In what mode is the User Equipment (UE) required to perform PLMN selection triggered by ProSe direct communication, if it is in EMM-IDLE mode and the conditions for sidelink communication are met?
q_49311.ground_truth: The UE is required to perform PLMN selection triggered by ProSe direct communication as specified in 3GPP TS 23.122.

q_49312.question: What should the mobile station do when the periodic LAU timer expires, it is EPS attached only, and either camps on an E-UTRAN cell or is in ECM CONNECTED state?
q_49312.ground_truth: The UE should perform a Location Area Update procedure in NMO II/III or a combined RA/LA update in NMO I when it next returns to GERAN/UTRAN coverage.

q_49313.question: Which flag in the Volume Measurement IE type controls the presence of the Total Volume field?
q_49313.ground_truth: The TOVOL flag in the Volume Measurement IE type controls the presence of the Total Volume field.

q_49314.question: What is the probability of re-selection from Cell 2 to Cell 1 during T3 that should be observed during testing for the test to pass?
q_49314.ground_truth: The probability of re-selection from Cell 2 to Cell 1 during T3 that should be observed during testing for the test to pass is less than 10%.

q_49315.question: What is the purpose of the U2U Relay Discovery Key Request in the 5G ProSe UE?
q_49315.ground_truth: The purpose of the U2U Relay Discovery Key Request in the 5G ProSe UE is to request a set of discovery security materials corresponding to the authorized roles from the 5G U2U Relay PKMF.

q_49316.question: In the calculation of TPRS,i, what is the purpose of the least common multiple among Tp,PRS and TPRS,i?
q_49316.ground_truth: The least common multiple among Tp,PRS and TPRS,i is used to derive the maximum PRS resource periodicity among all PRS resources in positioning frequency layer i, and the PRS processing window repetition period in positioning frequency layer i.

q_49317.question: What is the requirement for the PRS-RSRP measurement capability of a RedCap UE, as specified in clause 4.6.3.3?
q_49317.ground_truth: The PRS-RSRP measurement capability of a RedCap UE is as indicated by the UE in NR-DL-AoD-ProvideCapabilities, as specified in clause 4.6.3.3.

q_49318.question: What is the impact on EVM performance for PC1, with 120 kHz SCS, as per the R4-2314677 simulation results?
q_49318.ground_truth: The EVM budget for Phase noise + IQ imbalance, with 120 kHz SCS for PC1, is -30.8 dB.

q_49319.question: How are PDCP SDUs (Packet Data Convergence Protocol Service Data Units) included in a PDCP Data PDU?
q_49319.ground_truth: PDCP SDUs are bit strings that are byte aligned, and are included into a PDCP Data PDU from the first bit onward.

q_49320.question: What does the term "Internet of Things (IoT)" refer to in the context of the present document?
q_49320.ground_truth: The term "Internet of Things (IoT)" refers to a network that supports the interconnection of devices, machines, and low complexity entities in the context of the present document.

q_49321.question: What shall the UE not attempt to use as per 3GPP TS 36.331 section 5.3.3.1b for CP-EDT and UP-EDT?
q_49321.ground_truth: The UE shall not attempt to use CIoT EPS optimizations which are indicated as not supported.

q_49322.question: What information should the VAE-C include in the <V2X-UE-id> element of the HTTP POST request message for obtaining local V2X service information?
q_49322.ground_truth: The identity of the UE which requests the local service information

q_49323.question: What action does the SMF take after step 16 if redundant transmission for one or more QoS Flows of the PDU is performed?
q_49323.ground_truth: If SMF decides to perform redundant transmission for one or more QoS Flows of the PDU, the SMF also indicates the UPF to perform packet duplication for the QoS Flow(s) in downlink direction by forwarding rules. In the case of redundant transmission with two I-UPFs for one or more QoS Flows of the PDU, the SMF provides AN Tunnel Info to two I-UPFs and also indicates the UPF (PSA) to perform packet duplication for the QoS Flow(s) in downlink direction by forwarding rules. The SMF also provides the UL Tunnel Info of the UPF (PSA) to the two I-UPFs and the DL Tunnel Info of the two I-UPFs to the UPF (PSA).

q_49324.question: What action should be taken if a SIP INVITE request for an MCVideo imminent peril group call is received and the SIP INVITE request is an authorized request but the in-progress emergency state of the group is "true"?
q_49324.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function should include the warning text "149 SIP INFO request pending" in a Warning header field as specified in clause 4.4. The function should also send a SIP 200 (OK) response towards the inviting MCVideo client and follow the procedures in clause 6.3.3.1.18.

q_49325.question: What conditions must be met for a successful SCell activation test event?
q_49325.ground_truth: The UE shall transmit the uplink PRACH channel to Cell 3 less than 62 ms from the beginning of time period T2, and report CQI index 0 (out-of-range) until the SCell activation has been completed. CSI report with non-zero CQI index shall be received by the SS earlier than or equal to a specific slot or the next available uplink resource if there are no uplink resources for reporting the valid CSI in a slot, and DTX shall not be observed by the SS outside the slot to up to the end of T2.

q_49326.question: What is the required measurement if the CSI-RS for L1-RSRP measurement is in the same OFDM symbol as the SSB for RLM/BFD/CBD measurement and beam failure is detected in FR2?
q_49326.ground_truth: UE is required to measure one of but not both CSI-RS for L1-RSRP measurement and the SSB for RLM/BFD/CBD measurement when beam failure is detected in FR2.

q_49327.question: What method enables an AF to retrieve an existing Individual Data Reporting Provisioning Session resource at the NEF in the 3GPP 5G System?
q_49327.ground_truth: The GET method, specified in 3GPP TS 29.501, is used to retrieve an existing Individual Data Reporting Provisioning Session resource at the NEF.

q_49328.question: Which message type is used by the NG-RAN node to indicate the successful outcome of the request to modify the MBS session resources or broadcast area in a broadcast MBS session?

q_49329.question: What is the unit for the "MinimumSpeed" and "MaximumSpeed" in the LocationCriteriaForDeactivation/ExistSpecificArea/Speed?

q_49330.question: What shall the target NG-RAN node do upon receiving the HANDOVER REQUEST message containing the Conditional Handover Information Request IE?
q_49330.ground_truth: The target NG-RAN node shall consider that the request concerns a conditional handover and include the Conditional Handover Information Acknowledge IE in the HANDOVER REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message.

q_49331.question: In case of a BearerContextModificationResponse message, what is the only ProtocolIE-Container that is criticality-critical?
q_49331.ground_truth: The System-BearerContextModificationResponse is the only ProtocolIE-Container that is criticality-critical in case of a BearerContextModificationResponse message.

q_49332.question: What action should the SeNB take if it receives a SENB MODIFICATION REQUEST message containing multiple E-RAB ID IEs set to the same value in the E-RABs To Be Added List IE or E-RABs To Be Modified List IE?
q_49332.ground_truth: The SeNB should not admit the action requested for the corresponding E-RABs.

q_49333.question: What should the NG-RAN node do if it receives the UE Context Release procedure upon reception of a UE CONTEXT RELEASE REQUEST message with the release cause different than user inactivity?
q_49333.ground_truth: The UE Context Release procedure should be initiated upon reception of a UE CONTEXT RELEASE REQUEST message with the release cause different than user inactivity.

q_49334.question: What is the test applicability for the EN-DC FR2 SSB based L1-RSRP measurement accuracy?
q_49334.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of NR UE supporting E-UTRA and EN-DC from Release 15 onwards.

q_49335.question: What is the format of the "auth-token" parameter in the "ggsn-charging-info" parameter in the P-Charging-Vector header field?
q_49335.ground_truth: The "auth-token" parameter is a sequence of 1 or more hexadecimal digits.

q_49336.question: What feature enables the modification of multi-modality services in the 5G System?
q_49336.ground_truth: The "MultiMedia" feature enables the modification of multi-modality services in the 5G System.

q_49337.question: What are some performance management features related to URLLC resource load?
q_49337.ground_truth: Some performance management features related to URLLC resource load include CI (Cancellation Indication), PB (Power Boosting), PI (Preemption Indication), UL (Uplink) Cancellation Mechanisms, Enhanced UL Power Control, and PRB (Physical Resource Blocks) usage rate-related measurements in TS 28.552.

q_49338.question: What does End UE#2 establish in Scenario #2 after sending a Link Release Response message to End UE#1?
q_49338.ground_truth: End UE#2 establishes a new KNRP ID combining MSB of KNRP ID with received LSB of KNRP ID.

q_49339.question: What does the HST FR2 Scenario-A mobility performance demonstrate?
q_49339.ground_truth: It demonstrates that the HST FR2 Scenario-A deployment, where the train is traveling in the direction opposite to serving beam orientation, may experience mobility challenges when DRX cycle of 40 ms is used in enhanced requirements. However, mobility robustness is sufficient when DRX cycle of 40 ms is used in Scenario-A with enhanced requirements.

q_49340.question: What are some of the potential normative works for the XR processing and media centric architectures in 6G?
q_49340.ground_truth: The potential normative works for XR processing and media centric architectures in 6G include display, tracking and pose generation, viewport rendering, capture of real-world content, media encoding, media decoding, media content delivery, 5GS communication, media formats, metadata, and other data delivered on communication links, and spatial location processing.

q_49341.question: What should the eNB do if it cannot establish one non-GBR bearer during the Initial Context Setup procedure?
q_49341.ground_truth: The eNB should consider the entire procedure as failed and send an Initial Context Setup Failure message.

q_49342.question: What is the provisioning process for UE's certificates in this solution?
q_49342.ground_truth: The initial UE certificate can be provisioned at manufacture time or at deployment by the NPN operator. UEs should support certificate update/revocation, which can be performed in an implementation-independent way or over the air. Before the expiration date, UEs' certificates will need to be updated. UEs are pre-loaded with X.509 certificates with a signed public key for the network they are allowed to connect. The core network is pre-loaded with the certificates of eligible UEs. This establishes a public and private key pair relationship between UEs and the core network, implying mutual authentication.

q_49343.question: In the SS-UE simulation, what transmission pattern does the SS-UE use to achieve 50% congestion?
q_49343.ground_truth: The SS-UE transmits on 5 (5 full subframes utilizing all RBs on all subchannels of the transmitting TTI) out of 10 consecutive subframes, repeating the same transmit pattern continuously in subsequent frames.

q_49344.question: Which access types does the MP-DCCP solution support in the context of ATSSS?
q_49344.ground_truth: The MP-DCCP solution supports both 3GPP and non-3GPP access in the context of ATSSS.

q_49345.question: What is the purpose of introducing authorization of the role of the UE during discovery in solution #4?
q_49345.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure that the roles of the UEs involved in Ranging/Sidelink Positioning services are properly authorized, which helps to prevent unauthorized UEs from cheating and violating service, privacy, or charging rules.

q_49346.question: In 8.2.2.4.1C, what type of interference model is used in the tests?
q_49346.ground_truth: The tests in 8.2.2.4.1C are conducted using the transmission mode 4 interference model defined in clause B.5.3.

q_49347.question: What is the requirement for replay protection of NAS signalling messages?
q_49347.ground_truth: The AMF must support integrity protection and replay protection of NAS-signalling as specified in TS 33.501.

q_49348.question: What does a role name indicate in an association relationship?
q_49348.ground_truth: A role name in an association relationship indicates the role played by the model element involved in that association.

q_49349.question: What is the purpose of the first test method described in X.4.2?
q_49349.ground_truth: The first test method described in X.4.2 is used to define the initial conditions for each test, including the test environment, the RF channels to be tested, and the basic measurement setup.

q_49350.question: Under shared spectrum channel access, what does a BS need to comply with, in addition to the regional requirements for operation?
q_49350.ground_truth: In addition to regional requirements, a BS may need to comply with operating band unwanted emissions limits, which could be in the form of conducted power, power spectral density, EIRP, or other types of limits.

q_49351.question: What is the purpose of the PC5 interface in ProSe Direct Discovery?
q_49351.ground_truth: The PC5 interface is used for ProSe Direct Discovery communication between User Equipments (UEs) in the same ProSe Relay Cell.

q_49352.question: Who collects information from the peer Dedicated 5GS Network Function in this process?
q_49352.ground_truth: The Dedicated 5GS UE Function is responsible for collecting information from its peer Dedicated 5GS Network Function, such as the 5GMS AS, BM-SC, and MBSF.

q_49353.question: What should a UE do if there is no reference signal received for the CSI measurement over the delay corresponding to the minimum requirements, and there are no uplink resources for reporting the valid CSI in the required subframe?
q_49353.ground_truth: The UE shall use the next available uplink resource for reporting the corresponding valid CSI.

q_49354.question: How should the MGCF indicate support for the preconditions mechanism in responses that include an SDP body to the session modification request?
q_49354.ground_truth: If the precondition mechanism is used for session modification, the MGCF shall indicate support for the preconditions mechanism by using the Require header field in responses that include an SDP body to the session modification request.

q_49355.question: What should the Request-URI of the outgoing SIP MESSAGE request be set to in step 2?
q_49355.ground_truth: The public service identity of the controlling MCPTT function for the binding of a functional alias with the MCPTT group(s) for the MCPTT user service associated with the originating user's MCPTT ID identity.

q_49356.question: What should an MTSI client in terminal do when it receives an ANBR message for the local uplink that triggers an adaptation decision?
q_49356.ground_truth: If the adaptation decision results in a reduction of the media sender bitrate, it should be initiated immediately without further signaling. If the adaptation decision results in an increase of the media sender bitrate, the media sender should wait for sufficient time for the remote media receiver to receive and react to the corresponding TMMBN message.

q_49357.question: What is the interfering signal for the General blocking test requirement for an NR wanted signal with a channel bandwidth greater than 20 MHz?
q_49357.ground_truth: The interfering signal for the General blocking test requirement for an NR wanted signal with a channel bandwidth greater than 20 MHz should be a 20 MHz E-UTRA signal.

q_49358.question: What should the MCVideo server consider as the served MCVideo group information entry in the list of MCVideo group information entries?
q_49358.ground_truth: The MCVideo server should consider an MCVideo group information entry such that it is in the list of MCVideo group information entries and the MCVideo group ID of the MCVideo group information entry is equal to the served MCVideo group ID.

q_49359.question: What are the principles for DS-MIPv6 security as defined in RFC 4877?
q_49359.ground_truth: The DS-MIPv6 security is based on IPsec as defined in RFC 4877, with the IPsec security association established between the UE and the node acting as HA (i.e. PDN GW). The UE and the HA shall use IKEv2, as specified in RFC 5996, in order to establish IPsec security associations, using public key signature based authentication with certificates.

q_49360.question: What is the purpose of the "oauth2-requested-services" parameter in the Sbi-Nrf-Uri header?
q_49360.ground_truth: The "oauth2-requested-services" parameter indicates the list of NRF services for which OAuth2 based authorization is required for accessing the respective NRF services.

q_49361.question: What is the role of the PGW-C+SMF in the 5G core network?
q_49361.ground_truth: The PGW-C+SMF in the 5G core network provides N4 rules to UPF for performing QoS enforcement and for mapping downlink traffic to appropriate GTP-U tunnels.

q_49362.question: What is the role of the Data Channel Application Repository function in the IMS data channel network architecture?
q_49362.ground_truth: The Data Channel Application Repository function supports data channel application storage which can be internally inside the DCSF or a dedicated element outside of the DCSF.

q_49363.question: What decision does the target BSS make based on the ABQP for each PFC to assign radio resources?
q_49363.ground_truth: The target BSS decides which PFCs need resources using an implementation-specific algorithm, and allocates TBFs for each PFC that it can accommodate.

q_49364.question: What information may the E-SMLC request from the UE for barometric pressure sensor positioning?
q_49364.ground_truth: The E-SMLC may request barometric pressure sensor measurements or position estimate from the UE for barometric pressure sensor positioning.

q_49365.question: What is the purpose of the "Manage UE Policy Command" message in the "Contents of UE Policy Delivery messages" section?
q_49365.ground_truth: The "Manage UE Policy Command" message is used to manage UE policies in E-UTRA-PC5 communications. It specifies the V2X services to be provisioned to the UE, and the policy rules for each V2X service.

q_49366.question: What is the function of the "V2X service identifier to V2X E-UTRA frequency mapping rules" section?
q_49366.ground_truth: This section maps V2X service identifiers to V2X E-UTRA frequencies in E-UTRA-PC5 communications, which is used to determine the frequency band for V2X communications.

q_49367.question: What is the aim of Network A's agreement with Network C in the "Use Case of Home Network Steering UEs to Different Localized Service Networks"?
q_49367.ground_truth: The aim is to allow Network A's UEs to use Network C's network during the fair to access the localized services and connectivity provided by Network A.

q_49368.question: What is the requirement for the measurement reporting delay for the E-UTRAN TDD-TDD inter frequency measurements test?
q_49368.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay is defined as the time between an event that will trigger a measurement report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface, assuming that the measurement report is not delayed by other RRC signalling on the DCCH. This measurement reporting delay excludes a delay uncertainty resulted when inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH.

q_49369.question: In what states can the UE be when timer T3402 is running and the UE supports neither A/Gb mode nor Iu mode?

q_49370.question: What should the MME do if the DETACH REQUEST message could not be delivered due to an intra MME handover and the target TA is included in the TAI list?
q_49370.ground_truth: Upon successful completion of the intra MME handover, the MME shall retransmit the DETACH REQUEST message.

q_49371.question: What new measurements are recommended for NR carrier phase positioning?
q_49371.ground_truth: The new measurements recommended for NR carrier phase positioning include the difference between the carrier phase measured from the DL PRS signal(s) of the target TRP and the carrier phase measured from the DL PRS signal(s) of the reference TRP for DL carrier phase positioning, and the carrier phases measured from the UL SRS for positioning purpose for UL carrier phase positioning.

q_49372.question: What are the mechanisms used by the DNS system to provide a translation of the FQDN of an EAS into the address of an EAS as close as possible to the UE in a 5G system?
q_49372.ground_truth: The DNS system uses the source IP address of the incoming DNS Query and/or an EDNS Client Subnet (ECS) option to provide a translation of the FQDN of an EAS into the address of an EAS as close as possible to the UE in a 5G system. The DNS information for private namespaces can be provisioned in the EAS Deployment Information via AF request with the Application Identifier, or DNN and NSSAI.

q_49373.question: What should the UE do if it has connection establishment failure information or connection resume failure information available in VarConnEstFailReport or VarConnEstFailReportList and if the RPLMN is equal to the plmn-Identity stored in VarConnEstFailReport or in at least one of the entries of VarConnEstFailReportList?
q_49373.ground_truth: Include connEstFailInfoAvailable in the RRCSetupComplete message.

q_49374.question: What feature does the HSS support, as indicated in the "Gdd in SGSN" feature?
q_49374.ground_truth: The HSS supports the "Gdd in SGSN" feature, where "Gdd" stands for "Gateway Drug Selection."

q_49375.question: In the 8.69 parameter, when the current serving cell is not an E-UTRA cell, what is set to 255?

q_49376.question: What method is used to request the calculation of authentication vector(s) for the provided SUPI and the requested authentication method in the HssSecurityInformation resource?
q_49376.ground_truth: The "generate-av" custom operation is used to request the calculation of authentication vector(s) for the provided SUPI and the requested authentication method in the HssSecurityInformation resource.

q_49377.question: What should the MCPTT client do if the <allow-cancel-private-emergency-call> element of the ruleset element in the MCPTT user profile document identified by the MCPTT ID of the calling user is set to "true" when receiving a request to cancel an MCPTT emergency private call?
q_49377.ground_truth: The MCPTT emergency private call cancellation request shall be considered to be an authorized request for an MCPTT emergency private call cancellation.

q_49378.question: What does the term "II-NNI" refer to in the document?
q_49378.ground_truth: II-NNI refers to the Inter-IMS Network to Network Interface consisting of Ici and Izi reference points between IMS networks.

q_49379.question: How do power cuts impact the telecom network?
q_49379.ground_truth: Power cuts can impact the telecom network by causing service outages, either as a primary or secondary cause. This is because the telecom network requires electricity and has a limited capacity to operate without energy from the power grid. If there is a failure in the power grid, the faulty part needs to be disconnected to avoid risk for fire or human injuries due to short circuit.

q_49380.question: How does the target 5G-AN node handle handover during inter NG-RAN node handover without Xn interface?
q_49380.ground_truth: During inter NG-RAN node handover without Xn interface, if an NGAP UE-TNLA-binding exists for a UE, the source 5G-AN node sends the N2 Handover Required message using the corresponding TNL address of the AMF. If no NGAP UE-TNLA-binding exists, the source 5G-AN node creates one by selecting a TNL association from the available TNL associations for the target 5G-AN node. The target AMF selects a TNL association from the available TNL associations for the target 5G-AN node and sends the N2 Handover Request message via this TNL association.

q_49381.question: What is the maximum allowed interruption time (Tinterrupt) for an intra-frequency or inter-frequency handover in NR FR2?
q_49381.ground_truth: Tinterrupt should be less than the sum of Tsearch, TIU, Tprocessing, and Tmargin.

q_49382.question: What should the call control entity of the MS in the "disconnect indication" state do upon receipt of a DISCONNECT message with an Allowed Actions IE indicating "Activation of CCBS is possible"?
q_49382.ground_truth: The call control entity of the MS in the "disconnect indication" state, upon receipt of a DISCONNECT message with an Allowed Actions IE indicating "Activation of CCBS is possible", should pass the indication to the upper layer, enter the "disconnect indication" state, stop all running call control timers and await a response from the upper layers.

q_49383.question: When should a UE initiating emergency services not indicate MICO preference during Registration procedure?
q_49383.ground_truth: A UE initiating emergency services should not indicate MICO preference during the Registration procedure.

q_49384.question: What HTTP method is used to modify an existing resource in order to update an individual LPI Parameters Provisioning resource?
q_49384.ground_truth: The PATCH method is used to modify an existing resource in order to update an individual LPI Parameters Provisioning resource.

q_49385.question: What is the measurement provided in 5.1.1.1.7.1, and what does it calculate?
q_49385.ground_truth: The measurement provided in 5.1.1.1.7.1 is the distribution of UL packet delay between NG-RAN and UE, which includes the delay in NG-RAN and the delay over Uu interface, excluding D1 UL PDCP delay in the UE. This measurement is calculated per PLMN ID, per 5QI, and per supported S-NSSAI.

q_49386.question: What is the purpose of the back-off timer value in an EPS session management reject message?
q_49386.ground_truth: It regulates the time interval at which the UE may retry the same procedure.

q_49387.question: What happens if the UE fails to perform the handover correctly in the test procedure?
q_49387.ground_truth: If the UE fails to perform the handover correctly, it will result in a failure test, and the UE will switch back to serving Cell 1 or be switched off.

q_49388.question: What resource does the "UeContextInPgwData" represent in the nhss-sdm API?
q_49388.ground_truth: This resource represents the allocated PGWs (Packet Gateways) for the UE.

q_49389.question: What is one of the requirements for the minimum conformance in 8.16.88?
q_49389.ground_truth: One of the requirements for the minimum conformance in 8.16.88 is the normative reference 3GPP TS 36.133, clause 8.3.3.2.1, and A.8.16.88.

q_49390.question: What is the purpose of the EES termination use case?
q_49390.ground_truth: The EES termination use case aims to enable the termination of one or more EES instances on the EDN. A consumer can request to terminate an EES by providing its identifier, and the provisioning MnS producer will disconnect the EES from the 5GC network functions and terminate the EES VNF.

q_49391.question: What is the meaning of "Unauthorized Requesting Network" in the context of location services problem?
q_49391.ground_truth: The network requesting the location services is not authorized to do so.

q_49392.question: What is the outcome if the failover is too slow or unsuccessful in the use case "Failure of VNFC within cloud-native VNF"?
q_49392.ground_truth: The VNF may experience an overload situation, resulting in abnormal values in performance measurements and possibly indications of a VNF overload situation

q_49393.question: What is the role of the Network Repository Function (NRF) in the IMS network?
q_49393.ground_truth: The NRF maintains the IMS NFs profile and supports service discovery function in the IMS network.

q_49394.question: What should the 3GPP AAA Proxy do upon receipt of a DER message with the IMEI-Check-Request-in-VPLMN bit set to 1 in the DER-Flags AVP?
q_49394.ground_truth: The 3GPP AAA Proxy should check the Mobile Equipment's identity status towards the EIR and determine whether to continue or stop the authentication and authorization procedure based on the IMEI check result and availability of IMEI(SV).

q_49395.question: What is the definition of Nfreq in the context of Increased UE carrier monitoring E-UTRA?
q_49395.ground_truth: Nfreq = Nfreq,n + Nfreq,r, where Nfreq,n is the total number of interfrequency carriers to be monitored with normal measurement performance and Nfreq,r is the total number of interfrequency carriers to be monitored with reduced measurement performance.

q_49396.question: What is the definition of "NF Profile" in the 3GPP TS 33.501 technical specification?
q_49396.ground_truth: A NF Profile is a set of parameters in the NRF that are registered for UPF event exposure services.

q_49397.question: What does the acronym GTP-U stand for in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_49397.ground_truth: GTP-U stands for GPRS Tunnelling Protocol - User Plane.

q_49398.question: In which cases should the UE use a target TCI state's associated TCI state for L1-RSRP measurement reporting in an LTM cell switch?
q_49398.ground_truth: The UE should use a target TCI state's associated TCI state for L1-RSRP measurement reporting when the target TCI state is in the LTM candidate cell active TCI state list or the serving cell active TCI state list, and the time between receiving the MAC-CE activating the target TCI state and the LTM cell switch command meets specific conditions.

q_49399.question: When should the transmission control interface send the Receive Media Response (Granted) message to the associated transmission participant?
q_49399.ground_truth: The transmission control interface should send the Receive Media Response (Granted) message to the associated transmission participant when the reception control arbitration logic in the MCVideo server decides to grant permission to the transmission participant to receive the media. It may also set the first bit in the subtype of the Receive Media Response (Granted) message to '1' if an acknowledgment is required.

q_49400.question: What is the maximum number of NAS security parameters from NGRAN?

q_49401.question: What is the test purpose for the OTA operating band unwanted emissions test in 6.7.4.3 of the test specification?
q_49401.ground_truth: This test measures the emissions of the IAB-Node, close to the assigned channel bandwidth of the wanted signal, while the IAB-Node is in operation.

q_49402.question: What is the purpose of the Determine Location Request message in the SL Positioning procedure?
q_49402.ground_truth: The Determine Location Request message is used by the Target UE to the SL Positioning Server UE to determine the Target UE location. This message includes necessary information as required by the Client and may also include SL Reference UEs if SL positioning or ranging is requested.

q_49403.question: What is the indication state when the VLR handles a "Send Information for MT SMS" procedure, given that the state of the indicator "Location Information Confirmed in HLR" is "Not Confirmed"?
q_49403.ground_truth: The state of the indicator "Location Information Confirmed in HLR" does not affect the "Send Information for MT SMS" procedure, the VLR handles the request in the normal way.

q_49404.question: What is the main mechanism for avoiding and handling overload situations for eHRPD over S2a as specified in clause 4.3.7.5 of TS 23.401?
q_49404.ground_truth: The main mechanism is the rejection of PDN connection requests from UEs.

q_49405.question: What should the SCC AS do when preconditions are not met when the SIP INVITE request due to PS to CS STN is not a precondition-enabled initial SIP INVITE?
q_49405.ground_truth: If preconditions are not met and the SIP INVITE request due to PS to CS STN is not a precondition-enabled initial SIP INVITE, the SCC AS sends a SIP 183 (Session Progress) response populated with an SDP answer based on the SDP answer received from the remote UE and the last received P-Early-Media header field, including the SIP 2xx response to the SIP UPDATE request, if a P-Early-Media has been received from the remote UE.

q_49406.question: What should the controlling MCVideo function do when processing a SIP INVITE request for an MCVideo emergency group call?
q_49406.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function should generate a SIP INVITE request as specified in clause~6.3.3.1.2 and set the Request-URI to the public service identity of the terminating participating MCVideo function associated with the MCVideo ID of the targeted MCVideo user.

q_49407.question: What are the two options for FL Server NWDAF if FL Client NWDAF is not able to complete the training of the interim local ML model within the maximum response time?
q_49407.ground_truth: FL Server NWDAF may send a new maximum response time or inform the FL Client NWDAF to cease ML model training and report the current local ML model updates.

q_49408.question: What is the value of P for FR2-1 when the RLM-RS resource is fully overlapped with SMTC occasion and certain conditions are met?
q_49408.ground_truth: P = 1 for FR2-1 when the mentioned conditions are fulfilled

q_49409.question: What happens when the AMF determines that the UE is reachable during data delivery in the RRC Inactive state?
q_49409.ground_truth: When the AMF determines that the UE is reachable, it informs SMF/UPF to deliver data. The NG-RAN then buffers the downlink data and triggers the RAN Paging message.

q_49410.question: When can a UE re-attempt PDU session establishment for the same DNN in a PLMN?
q_49410.ground_truth: A UE can re-attempt PDU session establishment in a PLMN if it is registered to a new PLMN that was not in the list of equivalent PLMNs at the time of rejection, or if the network allows re-attempt in an equivalent PLMN.

q_49411.question: When must a Direct Communication Accept message be sent to UE-1 by the target UE?
q_49411.ground_truth: A Direct Communication Accept message must be sent to UE-1 by the target UE if the Target User Info is included in the Direct Communication Request message and the Application Layer ID for the target UE matches.

q_49412.question: What happens in the 5GS to EPS handover scenario during the deferred MT-LR procedure?
q_49412.ground_truth: In the 5GS to EPS handover scenario during the deferred MT-LR procedure, after handover is complete, the AMF notifies 5GC-GMLC. The 5GC-GMLC then sends the location request with mapped location QoS to EPC-GMLC, triggering the deferred/periodic MT-LR in EPS.

q_49413.question: How does the SECAM process determine the assurance level of a network product?
q_49413.ground_truth: The assurance level in SECAM is related to the evaluation effort in terms of scope, depth, and rigor, but SECAM considers only one assurance level per network product class as the three parameters are expected to be constant.

q_49414.question: What does the gross bit rate (GBR) QoS Information IE indicate?
q_49414.ground_truth: The gross bit rate (GBR) QoS Information IE indicates the maximum and guaranteed bit rates of a GBR E-RAB for downlink and uplink.

q_49415.question: What should the UE do with the timer Tw1 when the WLAN radio is enabled after being disabled and the USIM remains the same?
q_49415.ground_truth: If t1 is greater than t, then the timer shall be restarted with the value t1 - t. If t1 is equal to or less than t, then the timer need not be restarted. If the UE is not capable of determining t, then the UE shall restart the timer with the value t1.

q_49416.question: What should be done if the UE receives an error message from the BSF when sending a TMPI?
q_49416.ground_truth: The UE shall delete the TMPI and retry the request using the IMPI.

q_49417.question: What is the value of the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag in the SIP REGISTER request when SDS is supported?
q_49417.ground_truth: The value of the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag in the SIP REGISTER request when SDS is supported is "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcdata.sds".

q_49418.question: What is the main advantage of solution #22 in mapping application traffic to a Traffic Category?
q_49418.ground_truth: The main advantage of solution #22 is that the rules to associate an application (or application traffic) are provided by the MNO and do not rely on the application or the OS layer in the UE to indicate a traffic category for an application traffic.

q_49419.question: What information does the UAV include in the C2 Aviation Payload for Direct C2 Communication when requesting C2 authorization in the UUAA-SM procedure in EPS?
q_49419.ground_truth: When the UAV needs to establish a direct PC5 link required for connectivity to UAV-C in step 0, the C2 Aviation Payload sent by the UAV includes an indication that the authorization is also for Direct C2 Communication. The UAV also includes direct C2 pairing information (if available) in the C2 Aviation Payload.

q_49420.question: What message is sent by the Serving GW to the source eNodeB to inform it about the forwarding parameters for data forwarding?
q_49420.ground_truth: Create Indirect Data Forwarding Tunnel Response

q_49421.question: What is the purpose of including the "Service Parameter" of "x-3gpp-pgw:x-gn" in the S-NAPTR procedure?
q_49421.ground_truth: Including the "Service Parameter" of "x-3gpp-pgw:x-gn" in the S-NAPTR procedure potentially biases towards a collocated PGW/GGSN.

q_49422.question: What data type represents information of an AMF Instance?

q_49423.question: What should a node do with the MME's FQ-CSID if it supports partial failure handling?
q_49423.ground_truth: If the SGW receives the MME's FQ-CSID, it shall generate and include its own FQ-CSID in the Sx Session Establishment procedure to indicate support for partial failure handling. If the SGW supports partial failure handling, it shall forward MME's FQ-CSID to PGW with a Create Session Request or Proxy Binding Update message across S5/S8 interface. Similarly, the PGW shall store the MME's FQ-CSID and send its own FQ-CSID back to the SGW if it supports partial failure handling.

q_49424.question: What does UE-to-UE Relay do if it receives a DNS query from UE2 and the IP discovery authorization required indication is set but no token is provided?
q_49424.ground_truth: UE-to-UE Relay sends a PC5-S IP Discovery Authorization Request message with UE2's User Info, UE2's IP address, and the token from UE2 (if received on the Query) to UE1, requesting authorization to share UE1's IP address with UE2.

q_49425.question: What is the procedure if the operator policy at the originating S-CSCF dictates that handling and routing of the request should be performed in the same manner as a SIP URI?
q_49425.ground_truth: The S-CSCF will handle and route the request in the same manner as a SIP URI.

q_49426.question: What is the maximum amount of timing change in one adjustment for the initial transmit timing accuracy in Test 1 and Test 2?
q_49426.ground_truth: The maximum amount of timing change in one adjustment for the initial transmit timing accuracy in Test 1 and Test 2 is Tq seconds.

q_49427.question: What message should the target UE send if it cannot accept the PROSE DIRECT LINK IDENTIFIER UPDATE REQUEST message?
q_49427.ground_truth: The target UE should send a PROSE DIRECT LINK IDENTIFIER UPDATE REJECT message.

q_49428.question: What is the maximum number of re-attempts for the UE to retry the service request procedure when case o) in clause 5.6.1.1 occurs?
q_49428.ground_truth: The maximum number of re-attempts for the UE to retry the service request procedure when case o) in clause 5.6.1.1 occurs is 5.

q_49429.question: What is the value type and range for the "Radius" in the EllipsoidArcArea?
q_49429.ground_truth: The value is expected to be a non-negative integer.

q_49430.question: What is the purpose of the Xn-U Address Indication procedure in the conditional handover procedure?
q_49430.ground_truth: The Xn-U Address Indication procedure provides different forwarding addresses for prepared conditional handovers and stops already initiated early data forwarding for some SN-terminated bearers.

q_49431.question: What is the significance of the <regtype> parameter in the PLMN selection command?
q_49431.ground_truth: The <regtype> parameter in the PLMN selection command indicates whether the registration procedure shall be performed for disaster roaming service or not.

q_49432.question: What should the system display when it receives a SIP INVITE request for an MCData emergency private communication?
q_49432.ground_truth: The system should display an indication that this is a SIP INVITE request for an MCData emergency private communication, the MCData ID of the originator, and if the alert indicator is true, an indication of the emergency alert and associated information.

q_49433.question: What is the purpose of the 'implicit key authentication' in the authentication and key agreement process between the UE and the network?
q_49433.ground_truth: 'Implicit key authentication' refers to the authentication provided through the successful use of keys resulting from authentication and key agreement in subsequent procedures.

q_49434.question: What should the VAE-S include in the HTTP POST request when receiving a request for session-oriented service termination?
q_49434.ground_truth: The VAE-S should include a Content-Type header field set to "application/vnd.3gpp.vae-info+xml", an application/vnd.3gpp.vae-info+xml MIME body with a <session-oriented-termination-info> element in the <VAE-info> root element, a <session-id> element set to the session identifier to be terminated, and send the HTTP POST request towards the VAE-C.

q_49435.question: What should an NF service consumer send to request that subsequent notifications are sent to a new NF service consumer?
q_49435.ground_truth: The "notifUri" attribute within the NsmfEventExposure data structure can be modified to request that subsequent notifications are sent to a new NF service consumer.

q_49436.question: What is the purpose of step 5 in the procedure?
q_49436.ground_truth: The purpose of step 5 is to record and filter the ACK, NACK, and statDTX responses for each PDSCH transmitted by the SS until 1000 filtered ACK+NACK responses are gathered.

q_49437.question: What two system information are acquired by UE from PSS/SSS and MIB if SN is an eNB, or NR-PSS/SSS and PBCH if SN is a gNB in EN-DC?
q_49437.ground_truth: The UE acquires at least, radio frame timing and SFN of SCG from the PSS/SSS and MIB (if the SN is an eNB) / NR-PSS/SSS and PBCH (if the SN is a gNB) of the PSCell in EN-DC.

q_49438.question: What is the purpose of defining a new 3GPP Application Code for 'NSSAA support' in the UICC?
q_49438.ground_truth: The purpose of defining a new 3GPP Application Code for 'NSSAA support' is to identify the application(s) in the UICC supporting NSSAA procedure. This allows the ME to easily identify the appropriate NSSAA application to use.

q_49439.question: What does the may construction indicate in the context of the 3GPP technical specification?
q_49439.ground_truth: The may construction in the context of the 3GPP technical specification indicates permission to do something. It implies that something is possible.

q_49440.question: What is the CGI reporting delay in the context of a UE identifying the CGI of an NR cell?
q_49440.ground_truth: The CGI reporting delay is the time between a command that will trigger a CGI report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface.

q_49441.question: What should the UE do if the leaving condition for this event is satisfied?
q_49441.ground_truth: Consider the leaving condition for this event to be satisfied when the MS is equal to or greater than the threshold parameter plus the hysteresis for this event (inequality A2-2).

q_49442.question: What mechanism is used in the target gNB for duplication detection and reordering for RLC-AM bearers?
q_49442.ground_truth: A window-based mechanism is used in the target gNB for duplication detection and reordering for RLC-AM bearers.

q_49443.question: What is the difference between EN-DC FR2-FR2 event-triggered reporting in non-DRX and DRX with SSB time index detection?
q_49443.ground_truth: EN-DC FR2-FR2 event-triggered reporting in non-DRX verifies the UE's correct reporting of an event within inter-frequency cell search requirements without DRX cycles, while EN-DC FR2-FR2 event-triggered reporting in DRX with SSB time index detection verifies the UE's correct reporting of an event within inter-frequency cell search requirements with long DRX cycles.

q_49444.question: What must the Content-Type header field be set to in the HTTP POST request for receiving a UAV application message?
q_49444.ground_truth: The Content-Type header field must be set to "application/vnd.3gpp.uae-info+xml" in the HTTP POST request for receiving a UAV application message.

q_49445.question: What indicators are involved in the N2 handover in 5GS?
q_49445.ground_truth: The key change indicators involved in N2 handovers are: 1) source AMF indicates AS key re-keying required, 2) source AMF indicates that KAMF is calculated using horizontal KAMF derivation, 3) target AMF indicates horizontal KAMF derivation to the UE, 4) target AMF indicates an AS key re-keying to the gNB/ng-eNB, and 5) gNB/ng-eNB indicates an AS re-keying to the UE.

q_49446.question: What should the PCF do with the remaining allowed usage for a user, if the last PDU Session of a user for a DNN and S-NSSAI combination is terminated?
q_49446.ground_truth: The PCF shall store the remaining allowed usage in the UDR.

q_49447.question: What are some examples of immersive media in the context of AR/MR?
q_49447.ground_truth: Examples of immersive media in AR/MR include 2D/3D media such as overlays and drawings, 3D media such as furniture and animated representations, and volumetric video of a person or a 3D modeled person. Simple textual overlays and 2D video are also considered immersive media.

q_49448.question: What information should the ME include in the MeasurementReport if inter-RAT (UTRAN) measurements are requested by the USIM?
q_49448.ground_truth: The ME should include IE "measResultListUTRA-FDD-r16" in IE "measResults" and report CPICH Ec/No, CPICH RSCP, and Physical Cell ID for the up to 8 strongest inter-RAT UTRAN cells per monitored frequency.

q_49449.question: What is the purpose of the LISSF in connection with a POI present in an UPF, if an SMF belongs to an SMF set?
q_49449.ground_truth: The purpose of the LISSF is to allow the TFs present in different SMFs of an SMF set to manage the interceptions at the POI present in an UPF, modify or stop the interceptions in the POIs present in the UPF, and to provide a continued interception by storing the LI state information. The TF present in the SMF stores the related necessary information (e.g. correlation information) in case a different TF has to manage the interception at that POI.

q_49450.question: What is the purpose of defining callbackUri for data restoration in NF profiles in UDR consumers and UDM consumers?
q_49450.ground_truth: The purpose of defining callbackUri for data restoration is to receive notifications when potential UDR data inconsistency occurs and enable data restoration.

q_49451.question: Which type of data is "DeferredLocationExt" in the LocationNotificationArg sequence?
q_49451.ground_truth: The "DeferredLocationExt" in the LocationNotificationArg sequence is a bit string used to represent various deferred location event types.

q_49452.question: If the MCPTT emergency alert state should be set to "MEA 1: no-alert" when the sent SIP request for a priority group call contained an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body with an <alert-ind></alert-ind> element set to a value of "true", what is the MCPTT emergency alert state before it is set to "MEA 1: no-alert"?
q_49452.ground_truth: The MCPTT emergency alert state is not specified before it is set to "MEA 1: no-alert".

q_49453.question: What should be the priority of the logical channels in order to satisfy the condition "at least one of the MAC CE and the logical channel and pending SL-PRS transmission(s) with the highest priority" for SL grant transmission?
q_49453.ground_truth: The logical channels should have the highest priority based on their sl-threshCBR-FreqReselection value, and they should also have pending SL-PRS transmissions associated with the SL grant.

q_49454.question: What is the Active Time value (T3324) coded as in the GPRS Timer~2 information element?
q_49454.ground_truth: It is coded as one byte (octet~3) of the GPRS Timer~2 information element coded as a bit format, for example, "00100100" equals 4 minutes.

q_49455.question: Which two elements in the "security-parameters-for-remote-UE-type" complex type share the same data type?
q_49455.ground_truth: The elements "code-sending-security-parameters-for-model-A" and "code-receiving-security-parameters-for-model-B" both use the data type "code-sending-or-receiving-security-parameters-type".

q_49456.question: How does the S-NAPTR procedure logically output the candidate list of SGW-Us for a given TAI/eNodeB-ID/RAI/RNC-ID?
q_49456.ground_truth: The S-NAPTR procedure outputs a list of host names coupled with a service, a protocol, a port, and a list of IPv4 and IPv6 addresses for a given TAI/eNodeB-ID/RAI/RNC-ID.

q_49457.question: What HTTP status code indicates success in updating or revoking the authorization for announcing for a UE?

q_49458.question: What is the purpose of the test described in clause 10.4.2.6.4?
q_49458.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify the behavior of the UE when measuring the signal strength of two NR cells and the LTE cell in different frequencies.

q_49459.question: What is the relevance of the TOI in FEC?
q_49459.ground_truth: TOI, or Transport Object Identifier, is used to assign ADUs to the same source block, for example, when using a unique TOI for ADU.

q_49460.question: What type of TAB connectors apply to an operating band that is only supported by single band connectors in a TAB connector TX min cell group or a TAB connector RX min cell group?
q_49460.ground_truth: Single band requirements apply to that set of TAB connectors.

q_49461.question: Which attribute is required and must be included in a <GKTP> element defined in subclause 7.7.4.2?
q_49461.ground_truth: The "id" attribute is required and must be included in a <GKTP> element defined in subclause 7.7.4.2.

q_49462.question: What is the range of the Value field, given that it consists of 4 bits?
q_49462.ground_truth: The range of the Value field is from 1*10-1 to 1*10-6.

q_49463.question: What are the requirements for the FDD inter-frequency relative accuracy test in clause 9.1.3.2?
q_49463.ground_truth: The requirements for the FDD inter-frequency relative accuracy test include support for FGI bits 16 and 25, inter-frequency relative accuracy measurement of RSRP, and the fulfillment of certain conditions such as transmission of cell specific reference signals, fulfillment of 3GPP TS 36.101 clause 7.3 for reference sensitivity, and specific RSRP and channel conditions.

q_49464.question: How many times can the "restricted-code-security-material" element occur in the "RestrictedAnnounceRsp-info" complex type?
q_49464.ground_truth: The "restricted-code-security-material" element can occur only once in the "RestrictedAnnounceRsp-info" complex type.

q_49465.question: When testing RRM CA requirements, what is the number of supported CCs that the UE shall be tested with?
q_49465.ground_truth: The UE shall be tested using the highest number of supported CCs.

q_49466.question: What is the purpose of defining the terms and abbreviations in the present document?
q_49466.ground_truth: The purpose of defining the terms and abbreviations in the present document is to ensure a common understanding of the terms and abbreviations used in the document.

q_49467.question: What should the UE do when it is in EMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE state and the current TAI is in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service"?
q_49467.ground_truth: The UE should not attempt to attach on any other cell.

q_49468.question: What is the objective of the EVM equalizer spectrum flatness requirement?
q_49468.ground_truth: The objective of the EVM equalizer spectrum flatness requirement is to ensure that the correction applied in the EVM measurement process meets a spectrum flatness requirement. This is to validate the EVM result, but it does not limit the correction applied to the signal in the EVM measurement process.

q_49469.question: What is the purpose of using nominal UTIs in beam management discussions?
q_49469.ground_truth: The purpose of using nominal UTIs in beam management discussions is for discussion purposes only, and their actual value can vary based on the specific AI/ML model and implementation.

q_49470.question: What action will the P-CSCF take when receiving an SDP offer with a DTLS-SRTP and certificate fingerprints supporting end-to-edge media security for RTP media from a served UE?
q_49470.ground_truth: If supported by the P-CSCF, it will invoke IMS-ALG procedures, act as defined in the specification, and handle DTLS-SRTP and certificate fingerprints supporting end-to-edge media security for RTP media.

q_49471.question: What enhancement option is preferred for the restriction on SMTC periodicity in FR2 HST?
q_49471.ground_truth: Option 1, which requires enhanced SMTC periodicity in FR2 HST, is preferred.

q_49472.question: What should the NG-RAN do if it receives an OVERLOAD START message and the Slice Overload Response IE is present, with the Overload Action IE set to "suppress all traffic in the affected slice"?
q_49472.ground_truth: The NG-RAN should suppress all traffic in the affected slice, i.e., ensure that no signalling traffic is sent to the AMF for the normalized system slice selection identifiers (NSSAI) contained in the Overload Start NSSAI List IE.

q_49473.question: What is the format of the protocolIEs defined in the MulticastContextSetupFailureIES?
q_49473.ground_truth: The protocolIEs defined in the MulticastContextSetupFailureIES are composed of an ID, a criticality, a type, and a presence, with some fields being mandatory and some being optional.

q_49474.question: What should be measured for Measure ACLR in sub-block gap or Inter RF Bandwidth gap for E-UTRA as specified in subclause 6.6.2.5 and 6.6.2.6?
q_49474.ground_truth: The Adjacent Channel Leakage Ratio (ACLR) should be measured.

q_49475.question: What happens if the ProSe Function cannot retrieve the corresponding discoveree UE context for a target RPAUID?
q_49475.ground_truth: The ProSe Function can skip the processing of this target RPAUID.

q_49476.question: What happens if the provisioned limit of new requests has been exceeded for the originating and terminating AS for CC requests?
q_49476.ground_truth: The network will reject a new request for CC services.

q_49477.question: In what circumstance is the use of the CSG ID in the "Allowed CSG list" removed?
q_49477.ground_truth: The UE removes the CSG ID from the "Allowed CSG list" when it receives a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message with cause "#25 (Not authorized for this CSG)" and with integrity protection, and the CSG ID of the cell where the UE has sent the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message is contained in the Allowed CSG list.

q_49478.question: What parameter is used to identify the end of a PDU Set, allowing the RAN to allocate the appropriate amount of radio resources for the specific PDU Set?

q_49479.question: What is the definition of the term "Policy Control Request trigger report" as given in the document?
q_49479.ground_truth: A "Policy Control Request trigger report" is a notification, possibly containing additional information, of an event which corresponds with a Policy Control Request trigger, indicating the need for the SMF to interact with the PCF again.

q_49480.question: Which type of element can be used in the 'private-call' element, with a minimum of one occurrence and a maximum of unbounded?
q_49480.ground_truth: The 'xs:mcvideo-max-duration' element can be used in the 'private-call' element, with a minimum of one occurrence and a maximum of unbounded.

q_49481.question: What is the request type for a SIP MESSAGE that is routed to the originating participating MCVideo function, contains an XML body with an <mcvideoinfo> root element and an <anyExt> element with the <request-type> set to "group-selection-change-request", or with the <response-type> set to "group-selection-change-response"?
q_49481.ground_truth: A SIP MESSAGE request for group-selection-change for originating participating MCVideo function

q_49482.question: What should the transmission participant do when timer T207 expires and if at least one transmitter information is stored in the transmitter list?
q_49482.ground_truth: The transmission participant should request the MCVideo client to stop sending RTP media packets towards other MCVideo clients, send the Transmission Arbitration Release message toward the other transmission participants, start timer T208 (Transmission Arbitration Release), and enter the 'O: pending delegated' state.

q_49483.question: What information is provided by the PEMC when adding a PIN element to a PIN?
q_49483.ground_truth: The PEMC provides the PIN ID, PIN description, and PEMC IP address when adding a PIN element to a PIN.

q_49484.question: What is the applicable range of hUT for the RMa model in TR 38.901 with hUT as 30m?
q_49484.ground_truth: The applicable range of hUT for the RMa model in TR 38.901 with hUT as 30m is from 1m to 10m.

q_49485.question: What should a GPRS MS do if it is operating in MS mode A or B and the combined tracking area update procedure is rejected with the EMM cause value #9?
q_49485.ground_truth: The GPRS MS should set the GPRS update status to GU2 NOT UPDATED, enter the state GMM-DEREGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE, and delete any P-TMSI, P-TMSI signature, RAI, and GPRS ciphering key sequence number.

q_49486.question: What is a set of NPDCCH candidates defined by, for a given aggregation level and repetition level, in a set of consecutive NB-IoT downlink subframes excluding subframes used for transmission of SI messages starting with subframe x, where x is the first NB-IoT downlink subframe at the start of a monitoring instance?

q_49487.question: What are the two additional criteria for selecting a paging policy in the 3GPP core network?
q_49487.ground_truth: The two additional criteria for selecting a paging policy in the 3GPP core network are mobility information on the UE and application characteristics that are known and trusted at the serving network.

q_49488.question: In the 3GPP TS 24.483 specification, what does the <entry> element of the <MCPTTGroupInfo> element of the <OnNetwork> element indicate for off-network operation?
q_49488.ground_truth: An MCPTT group ID of an MCPTT group that the MCPTT user is authorized to affiliate with during off-network operation.
