q_49489.question: What information is included in the additional ULI provided by the NG-RAN to the AMF when a UE connects to the 5GC via a MBSR?
q_49489.ground_truth: The additional ULI includes the TAI/NR CGI of selected by the IAB-Node when it's registered to the network.

q_49490.question: What is the requirement for an MCVideo private call cancellation request to be considered an authorized request for an MCVideo emergency private call cancellation?
q_49490.ground_truth: The <allow-cancel-private-emergency-call> element of the <ruleset> element of the MCVideo user profile document identified by the MCVideo ID of the calling user must be set to "true" for an MCVideo private call cancellation request to be considered an authorized request for an MCVideo emergency private call cancellation.

q_49491.question: Which UE state should be ensured before executing the RSRP TDD absolute accuracy test procedure?
q_49491.ground_truth: The UE should be in state 3A-RF.

q_49492.question: What should the controlling MCPTT function do if the received SIP re-INVITE request is an unauthorized request for an MCPTT emergency alert and the in-progress emergency state of the group is set to "true"?
q_49492.ground_truth: If the received SIP re-INVITE request is an unauthorized request for an MCPTT emergency alert and the in-progress emergency state of the group is set to "true", the controlling MCPTT function should include the warning text "149 SIP INFO request pending" in a Warning header field as specified in clause~4.4 in the SIP 200 (OK) response.

q_49493.question: What is the condition to meet for the value of P in FR2 when CSI-RS is not overlapped with measurement gap and CSI-RS is fully overlapped with SMTC occasion?
q_49493.ground_truth: P = 3 when CSI-RS is not overlapped with measurement gap and CSI-RS is fully overlapped with SMTC occasion.

q_49494.question: What should the transmission control server interface do upon receiving a Transmission Granted message for an MCVideo client?
q_49494.ground_truth: It should request the network media distributor to forward received RTP media packets to all MCVideo clients in the session controlled by the non-controlling MCVideo function except for the MCVideo client granted the transmission.

q_49495.question: How does a UE indicate support for GRUU in the IMS network?
q_49495.ground_truth: If a UE supports GRUU, it shall indicate this at the time of registration of the Public User Identity using the same instance ID for all registration requests regardless of the access network used. A function that registers on behalf of a UE should use the same Instance ID as if the UE had performed the registration itself.

q_49496.question: In the 11.1.3 generic encoding for message parts, what does the binary encoding system indicate, and when is the 2-complement binary encoding system used?
q_49496.ground_truth: The binary encoding system indicates that concrete strings are mapped to non-signed integers, while the 2-complement binary encoding system is used when concrete strings are mapped to signed integers.

q_49497.question: What is the purpose of the "5G System" in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
q_49497.ground_truth: The "5G System" is a set of functional entities responsible for providing 5G services, such as the Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF), the Session Management Function (SMF), and the User Plane Function (UPF).

q_49498.question: Under what condition will the MCPTT function reject the SIP INVITE request for terminating participating MCPTT function with a SIP 480 (Temporarily Unavailable) response?
q_49498.ground_truth: If the Answer-Mode Indication is not received from the invited MCPTT client and the session type is private, the MCPTT function will reject the request with a SIP 480 (Temporarily Unavailable) response.

q_49499.question: What should the participating MCPTT function do if an `<MKFC-GKTPs>` element is received in a SIP 2xx response?
q_49499.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT function should ignore the element and result in unicast media plane transmission being used for the originating client.

q_49500.question: What is the procedure described in 4.2.2.12.1 that allows a NF service consumer to request prioritized access to system resources?
q_49500.ground_truth: This procedure involves the inclusion of the "mpsId" attribute to indicate a new AF session related to an MPS session, and the "resPrio" attribute to include the priority value of the related priority service.

q_49501.question: What should the NG-RAN do when it receives packets in a broadcast MBS session that has already had its content delivered over the air in another broadcast MBS session associated with the same TMGI?
q_49501.ground_truth: The NG-RAN can silently drop the packets and not deliver them again.

q_49502.question: When is the 5GMSd~Client required to invoke the MBS~Client to initiate reception of the corresponding MBS User Service?
q_49502.ground_truth: When the UE is MBS-capable and the relevant information of the MBS Service Announcement is present in the Service Access Information.

q_49503.question: What information does the SUCI provided by the UE contain when sent to the AMF during initial registration?
q_49503.ground_truth: The SUCI provided by the UE to the AMF during initial registration contains the routing indicator and optionally the Home Network Public Key identifier.

q_49504.question: What is the definition of a "quality ranking region" in the VR Metrics framework?
q_49504.ground_truth: A "quality ranking region" or QR is a factor that represents the viewport quality together with the pixel resolution of one or more regions within the viewport. It corresponds to the monoscopic projected picture from which the packed region covering the viewport is extracted.

q_49505.question: What is the role of the charging identifier in the context of charging and quota management?
q_49505.ground_truth: The charging identifier is assigned by the NF consumer to correlate charging information from different events or sessions, and it can also be used for duplicate detection. The charging identifier assignment is NF consumer dependent, and it is essential for quota management, as it helps track and manage the usage of quota in the network.

q_49506.question: What is the role of the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay in the registration request message?
q_49506.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay indicates its capability in the registration request message.

q_49507.question: What should the AMF do if the "notifFlag" is set to "ACTIVATE" in the request and the event notification is currently muted?
q_49507.ground_truth: The AMF shall send the stored events to the NF service consumer and stop muting the event notification.

q_49508.question: What indications are provided by the SCI?
q_49508.ground_truth: The SCI can indicate a SL-SCH transmission or a SL-PRS transmission on SL-PRS shared resource pool or SL-PRS dedicated resource pool.

q_49509.question: What is the purpose of the Access Transfer Type parameter in offline and online charging of the AS and in offline charging of the ATCF?
q_49509.ground_truth: The Access Transfer Type parameter, in offline and online charging of the AS and in offline charging of the ATCF, provides information on the used access technologies for access transfer, such as PS to CS, CS to PS, PS to PS, or CS to CS.

q_49510.question: What action should the MME take upon receiving a Service Request message or Extended Service Request message from the UE while in EMM-IDLE mode?
q_49510.ground_truth: The MME should proceed by sending the SGsAP-SERVICE-REQUEST message to the VLR, considering the UE's EMM mode, LAI, and if the UE was temporarily unreachable for paging due to eDRX.

q_49511.question: What is the purpose of coordinated multi-point (CoMP) transmission in 5G NR?
q_49511.ground_truth: CoMP transmission is used in 5G NR to coordinate multiple transmission points in their downlink data transmission, improving network coverage and capacity.

q_49512.question: What action should a UE take when it has initiated a combined tracking area updating procedure and has a tracking area updating attempt counter with a value of 5, and then detects release of the NAS signalling connection?
q_49512.ground_truth: The UE starts timer T3402, deletes any LAI, TMSI, ciphering key sequence number and list of equivalent PLMNs, and sets the update status to U2 NOT UPDATED.

q_49513.question: What does the SMF provision if clock drift information is available and the requested Time Domain matches with the Time Domain in the TSC Assistance Container?
q_49513.ground_truth: If the SMF has clock drift information for a requested Time Domain and it matches with the Time Domain in the TSC Assistance Container, the SMF adjusts the TSCAI information to reflect the 5GS Clock.

q_49514.question: What is the purpose of the 'train stop message' in the last iteration?
q_49514.ground_truth: The CFL Server sends 'train stop message' to UEs so that the UEs can stop sending its update any longer, and the CFL Server performs fine-tuning by pruning unnecessary nodes.

q_49515.question: What type of data type is "ParentTImeSource" defined as in the 3GPP TS 38.300 standard?
q_49515.ground_truth: ParentTImeSource is defined as an ENUMERATED type in the 3GPP TS 38.300 standard. It represents a set of predefined options rather than a specific value. These options include synce, ptp, gnss, atomicclock, terrestrialradio, serialtimecode, ntp, handset, and other.

q_49516.question: What interfaces does the Network Support AF use to request QoS allocation?
q_49516.ground_truth: The Network Support AF uses the N5 or N33 interface to request QoS allocation.

q_49517.question: When should a UE interested in receiving MBMS services via SC-MRB apply the SC-MCCH information acquisition procedure?
q_49517.ground_truth: A UE interested in receiving MBMS services via SC-MRB shall apply the SC-MCCH information acquisition procedure upon entering a cell broadcasting SystemInformationBlockType20 and upon receiving a notification that the SC-MCCH information has changed.

q_49518.question: What is the name of the offset used in the calculation of frequency offsets for channel bandwidth for CA?
q_49518.ground_truth: The lower and upper frequency offsets Foffset,low and Foffset,high

q_49519.question: What parameter in the UL PDU SESSION INFORMATION (PDU Type 1) frame indicates if the DL Congestion Information is present or not?
q_49519.ground_truth: Bit 2 of New IE Flags Octet

q_49520.question: What is the purpose of session binding in the context of MC services in 5GS?
q_49520.ground_truth: Session binding associates the AF session information to only one PDU session with its corresponding QoS flows. This is important for ensuring that the AF session information is associated with the correct PDU session.

q_49521.question: How is the Global eNodeB-ID FQDN constructed?
q_49521.ground_truth: The Global eNodeB-ID FQDN is constructed as "enb<eNodeB-ID>.enb.epc.mnc<MNC>.mcc<MCC>.3gppnetwork.org".

q_49522.question: What is the purpose of the Service-Interact-Info header field in SIP messages?
q_49522.ground_truth: The Service-Interact-Info header field is used to convey information about services executed between different Application Servers (ASes) within a trust domain. It can be included in initial SIP requests and responses to initial SIP requests to avoid service conflicts.

q_49523.question: What is expected to happen during time duration T3 in the test procedure?
q_49523.ground_truth: During time duration T3 in the test procedure, the UE is expected to detect OOS (out-of-sync) and declare RLF (Radio Link Failure).

q_49524.question: What information is included in the RAB Assignment Request message when establishing a radio access bearer?
q_49524.ground_truth: The RAB Assignment Request message includes the RAB ID(s), QoS Profile(s), GTP SNDs, GTP SNUs, PDCP SNUs, and the Serving GW's Address for User Plane and TEID for uplink data when Direct Tunnel is established.

q_49525.question: What action is recommended for speech decoders when transitioning from a held full-duplex session to a full-duplex session in the HOLD supplementary service?
q_49525.ground_truth: The recommended action for speech decoders is to be reset.

q_49526.question: What is the significance of "Service Authorized" and "List of FA groups" for FA members?
q_49526.ground_truth: "Service Authorized" indicates if a FA service is authorized for a member, while "List of FA groups" refers to the FA groups a FA member belongs to.

q_49527.question: What entity sends the Mandatory Flags field to a 3GPP AAA Proxy?

q_49528.question: In the context of the test described, what two E-UTRA TDD carriers are being considered and with what specific number of cells on each?
q_49528.ground_truth: There are two E-UTRA TDD carriers with one cell on one E-UTRA TDD carrier and two cells on the other E-UTRA TDD carrier specified in the test.

q_49529.question: Under what conditions must a Presidential Warning Notification be displayed on a CMAS-capable UE?
q_49529.ground_truth: A Presidential Warning Notification must always be presented to the user whenever Cell Broadcast Service via GSM/UMTS or warning notification delivery via E-UTRAN is enabled on the UE.

q_49530.question: How does the UE determine the value of nHARQ-ACK for PUCCH transmission with HARQ-ACK information when there are both unicast and multicast HARQ-ACK information present?
q_49530.ground_truth: The UE determines nHARQ-ACK for a PUCCH transmission with HARQ-ACK information by adding the nHARQ-ACK value from clause 9.1.3.1 or clause 9.1.3.3 to the nHARQ-ACK value from clause 9.1.2.1 or as a sum of the nHARQ-ACK value from clause 9.1.2.1 or clause 9.1.3.3 and the nHARQ-ACK value from clause 9.1.3.1.

q_49531.question: What is the TeDRX cycle used for in extended DRX (eDRX) operation?
q_49531.ground_truth: The TeDRX cycle in extended DRX (eDRX) operation is used to determine the Paging Hyperframe (PH) and the Paging Time Window (PTW) for the UE. The PH and PTW are used to determine when the UE monitors the Physical Downlink Control Channel (PDCCH) for paging messages.

q_49532.question: When does the SeNB start data forwarding and stop providing user data to the UE in the procedure described in 8.6.6.2?
q_49532.ground_truth: Upon reception of the SENB RELEASE CONFIRM message

q_49533.question: What is the objective of this 3GPP study regarding the enhanced testing methods for FR2 NR UEs?
q_49533.ground_truth: The objective is to improve the FR2 RF testing methodology and quantify the impact of the enhancements on UE performance, particularly in relation to polarization basis mismatch and extreme temperature conditions.

q_49534.question: What procedure is used for the SMF+PGW-C to release resources in EPC for the PDN connections transferred to 5GS?
q_49534.ground_truth: The SMF+PGW-C performs PDN GW initiated bearer deactivation procedure as defined in clause~5.4.4.1 of TS~23.401, except steps 4-7.

q_49535.question: How is the distance between two UEs determined via PC5 interface?
q_49535.ground_truth: Ranging refers to the determination of the distance between two UEs or more UEs and/or the direction of one UE from another UE via PC5 interface.

q_49536.question: What is the recommended implementation for all applications in the IVAS codec?
q_49536.ground_truth: The bit-exact fixed-point C code in 3GPP TS 26.251 is the preferred implementation for all applications in the IVAS codec.

q_49537.question: What determines if a URI in an XML attribute is confidentiality protected?
q_49537.ground_truth: If an XML attribute is a URI with the domain name for MCPTT confidentiality protection as specified in the 3GPP TS 23.003, then the URI is confidentiality protected.

q_49538.question: What should be done when the resolution bandwidth is smaller than the measurement bandwidth to obtain the equivalent noise bandwidth of the measurement bandwidth?
q_49538.ground_truth: The result should be integrated over the measurement bandwidth.

q_49539.question: What should the UE do if it receives the forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming" in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message?
q_49539.ground_truth: The UE should store the TAI(s) belonging to the serving PLMN or equivalent PLMN(s) and ignore the TAI(s) which do not belong to the serving PLMN or equivalent PLMN(s) included in the IE, if not already stored, into the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming".

q_49540.question: What message does a UE transmit when it's in eCall-INACTIVE.LIMITED-SERVICE state and requested to make a manual eCall?
q_49540.ground_truth: When a UE is in eCall-INACTIVE.LIMITED-SERVICE state and requested to make a manual eCall, it transmits an ATTACH REQUEST message to attach for emergency bearer services, together with a PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message with 'Request type' set to 'emergency'.

q_49541.question: What is the purpose of the feature-capability indicator named g.3gpp.mrb in the context of IP multimedia call control protocol based on SIP and SDP?
q_49541.ground_truth: The feature-capability indicator g.3gpp.mrb in the context of IP multimedia call control protocol based on SIP and SDP indicates that in a roaming scenario, the visited network supports media resource broker functionality for the allocation of multimedia resources in the visited network.

q_49542.question: What must the MME do when receiving the URRP-MME parameter indicating the need to inform the HSS about UE reachability?
q_49542.ground_truth: The MME must set the URRP-MME parameter to indicate the need to inform the HSS about UE reachability when the next NAS activity from the UE is detected.

q_49543.question: What method is used by the network exposure function (NEF) to report the Time Synchronization Capability to the access function (AF) in the 3GPP Time Synchronization Exposure API?
q_49543.ground_truth: The Notification via HTTP POST method is used by the NEF to report the Time Synchronization Capability to the AF in the 3GPP Time Synchronization Exposure API.

q_49544.question: What information should be included in the <transmission-indicator> element in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-transmission-request+xml message?
q_49544.ground_truth: If available, additional information should be included in the <transmission-indicator> element.

q_49545.question: What action should the UE take if the attach request is neither for emergency bearer services nor for initiating a PDN connection for emergency bearer services with attach type not set to "EPS emergency attach", and it receives EMM cause #95, #96, #97, #99 or #111?
q_49545.ground_truth: The UE should set the attach attempt counter to 5.

q_49546.question: What is the impact of solution #14 on UE and SNPN?
q_49546.ground_truth: The solution has impact on UE (needs to support NSWO) and SNPN needs to deploy a AAA proxy. Additionally, the CH needs to deploy a NSWOF to support all key-generating EAP-mechanisms in solution #14.

q_49547.question: What is the meaning of the "0" value of the "ACR-operation-type" parameter in the unsolicited result code +CE5EECSRV?
q_49547.ground_truth: The "0" value of the "ACR-operation-type" parameter indicates ACR notification.

q_49548.question: What are the three main approaches for 360 video delivery in XR?
q_49548.ground_truth: The three main approaches for 360 video delivery in XR are the single stream approach, the multi-stream approach, and the tiled stream approach.

q_49549.question: What should the target eNodeB do if it does not have a mapping between the UE Radio Capability ID received from the MME and the UE radio capabilities and no UE radio capability is provided in the Source to Target transparent container?
q_49549.ground_truth: The target eNodeB should use the procedure described in TS~36.413 to retrieve the mapping from the Core Network.

q_49550.question: How can expectation targets be specified for multiple objects in the same intent expectation?
q_49550.ground_truth: An intent expectation may include multiple expectation targets on the same object or on different objects with the same properties, as long as they are compatible with the desired characteristics of the object(s).

q_49551.question: What is the effect of including an Activate Predefined Rules IE in a PFCP session?
q_49551.ground_truth: Including an Activate Predefined Rules IE in a PFCP session triggers the updating or activation of the pre-defined PDRs specified in the IE.

q_49552.question: What is the purpose of the N4 interactions between the SMF and I-SMF?
q_49552.ground_truth: The N4 interactions between the SMF and I-SMF are used for traffic offloading, where the SMF provides N4 information to the I-SMF for detecting, enforcing, and monitoring traffic in UPFs controlled by the I-SMF.

q_49553.question: What is the type of data that represents an offered communication pattern parameter set sent from the SCC/AS to the SCEF in the CpParameterSet data type?
q_49553.ground_truth: The CpParameterSet data type represents an offered communication pattern parameter set sent from the SCC/AS to the SCEF.

q_49554.question: What is the expected result after the AMF under test receives the UE security capabilities and NAS algorithms from the source AMF for N2-Handover?
q_49554.ground_truth: The AMF under test should select the NAS algorithms with the highest priority and indicate the selected algorithm to the UE as defined in TS 33.501.

q_49555.question: What information should be included in the multicast MBS session information if the Type of multicast MBS session ID is set to "Temporary Mobile Group Identity (TMGI)"?
q_49555.ground_truth: If the Type of multicast MBS session ID is set to "Temporary Mobile Group Identity (TMGI)", the UE shall set the multicast MBS session ID to the TMGI in the multicast MBS session information.

q_49556.question: What is the goal of enabling local data switching via UPF on-board in a communication between UEs served by satellite backhaul?
q_49556.ground_truth: The goal is to significantly shorten the communication path and reduce end-to-end delay compared with existing 5G LAN local switch at PSA on the ground.

q_49557.question: What is the maximum ranging interval that can provide a fine granularity for capturing the TV remote movement?
q_49557.ground_truth: The maximum ranging interval is 50 ms.

q_49558.question: What is required for a 3GPP working group to utilize 3GPP allocated port number solution #6?
q_49558.ground_truth: A 3GPP working group can utilize 3GPP allocated port number solution #6 if they send an LS request to 3GPP CT4 and meet the specified checklist requirements, including supporting a protocol that is used in intra-domain interfaces and indicating that solution #6 is preferable after evaluating other solutions.

q_49559.question: What should the AMF do if the operator policy indicates selecting the same CHF as the PCF?
q_49559.ground_truth: The AMF should apply the CHF address and associated ID(s) passed from the PCF.

q_49560.question: What is the purpose of the "AAA Server triggered Network Slice-Specific Authorization Revocation" charging in PEC scenario for NSSAAF?
q_49560.ground_truth: The purpose is to create a CDR for collecting charging information related to the specific Network Slice-Specific Authorization Revocation event in the PEC scenario for NSSAAF.

q_49561.question: What is the significance of "Condition Data" in Npcf_SMPolicyControl service operation?
q_49561.ground_truth: The "Condition Data" in Npcf_SMPolicyControl service operation defines the condition(s) where the PCC rules or session rules are applicable and/or not applicable.

q_49562.question: What is the formula used to calculate the two-way propagation delay between a geostationary satellite and a non-moving user equipment (UE)?
q_49562.ground_truth: The formula used to calculate the two-way propagation delay between a geostationary satellite and a non-moving UE is d/c, where d is the distance between the serving satellite and the UE, and c is the speed of light.

q_49563.question: What is the formula used to calculate the PUCCH resource when the value of Nm,max is the same as an index i, where k is the number of elements in the set S?
q_49563.ground_truth: The PUCCH resource is given by n1,pucch(nCCE,nE) = nCCE + nE + n1,max + 1, where nCCE is the number of the first ECCE used for transmission of the corresponding DCI assignment in EPDCCH-PRB-set in subframe and nE is determined from the antenna port used for EPDCCH transmission in subframe.

q_49564.question: What information is used to identify the user's location in trusted non-3GPP access in the "n3gaLocation" attribute?
q_49564.ground_truth: The user local IP address and the UDP source port are used to identify the user's location in trusted non-3GPP access in the "n3gaLocation" attribute.

q_49565.question: What should be included in the outgoing SIP INVITE request's P-Asserted-Identity header field?
q_49565.ground_truth: The public service identity of the originating participating MCPTT function should be included in the P-Asserted-Identity header field of the outgoing SIP INVITE request.

q_49566.question: What is the error handling procedure followed by the MCVideo server upon receiving a request with the Request-URI set to a public service identity that is not allocated?
q_49566.ground_truth: The MCVideo server returns a SIP 404 (Not Found) response.

q_49567.question: What must be the value of the Payload container type IE and Request type IE in the UL NAS TRANSPORT message in order for the AMF to send back to the UE the message which was not forwarded as specified in subclause 5.4.5.3.1 case h6?
q_49567.ground_truth: The Payload container type IE must be set to "N1 SM information" and the Request type IE must be set to "initial request" in the UL NAS TRANSPORT message for the AMF to send back to the UE the message which was not forwarded as specified in subclause 5.4.5.3.1 case h6.

q_49568.question: What is the responsibility of the LMF within Solution 22 related to SL positioning data?
q_49568.ground_truth: The LMF is responsible for invoking the Nlmf_Broadcast_CipheringKeyData Notify service operation towards the AMF carrying SL Positioning broadcast Encryption Key (SPEK) and Integrity Key (SPIK), which are applicable to the Target/Reference UEs for receiving Sidelink Positioning data.

q_49569.question: What is the purpose of the UE Reachable Indicator parameter in the UpdateGPRS-Location message?
q_49569.ground_truth: The UE Reachable Indicator parameter in the UpdateGPRS-Location message indicates the reachability of the user equipment (UE).

q_49570.question: What requirements does TS 23.285 cover for conformance requirements in V2X communications over PC5 reference point?

q_49571.question: What should the MeNB do if the E-RABs to be added in the SGNB ADDITION REQUEST message contain the GBR bearer as defined in TS 23.203 but do not contain the GBR QoS Information IE?
q_49571.ground_truth: The en-gNB shall consider the establishment of the corresponding E-RAB as failed.

q_49572.question: What should be the variation of the downlink SNR during the time periods in 7.3.56.4?
q_49572.ground_truth: The downlink SNR varies in the active cell to emulate out-of-sync and in-sync states during the time periods T1, T2 and T3.

q_49573.question: What should be the transmission power of cell 2 at the beginning of time period T2?
q_49573.ground_truth: The transmission power of cell 2 should be increased to the same level as for cell 1 at the beginning of time period T2.

q_49574.question: What information may SPRF receive from the upper layer?
q_49574.ground_truth: SPRF may receive request for current range/direction, periodic range/direction, or triggered range/direction of another UE or a specified group of UEs.

q_49575.question: What should the SMF do if the traffic is in downlink direction and the "burstArrivalTime" attribute of the "tscaiInputDl" attribute needs to be corrected?
q_49575.ground_truth: The SMF should correct the value of the "burstArrivalTime" attribute based on the latest received time offset measurement from the UPF and set the downlink TSCAI Burst Arrival Time as the sum of the corrected value and the CN PDB.

q_49576.question: What should the SMF do to support uplink packets buffering during EAS relocation?
q_49576.ground_truth: The SMF should set the UPBER bit in the UP Function Features IE and request the UPF to buffer uplink packets related to one or more Service Data Flows sent to the new EAS by setting the BUFF flag in Apply Action IE of the related FAR.

q_49577.question: Which message triggers the increment of the counter for the measurement of number of requested conditional handover preparations?
q_49577.ground_truth: UE CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message or UE CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message sent to target gNB-DU

q_49578.question: What frequency ranges are excluded from the conducted transmitter spurious emission limits?
q_49578.ground_truth: The ranges excluded are UTRA TDD BS, UTRA FDD BS, E-UTRA BS, and MSR BS, each with specific frequency ranges as defined in TS 25.105, TS 25.104, TS 36.104, and TS 37.104, respectively.

q_49579.question: What is the function of the subnetwork ID information in the context of 6.10.4?
q_49579.ground_truth: The subnetwork ID information is used to ensure that the UE only accesses the SNPN hosting network via a cell in the subnetwork ID, and that the AMF checks if the UE is camping in the subnetwork ID before completing the Registration Procedure.

q_49580.question: What action should the floor participant take upon receiving a Floor Revoke message?
q_49580.ground_truth: Upon receiving a Floor Revoke message, the floor participant should inform the user that the permission to send RTP media is being revoked, request the media mixer in the MCPTT client to discard any remaining buffered RTP media packets and stop forwarding encoded voice to the MCPTT server, and start timer T100 (Floor Release) and enter the 'U: pending Release' state.

q_49581.question: What is the basic concept of the virtual coupling scenario in the future railway service?
q_49581.ground_truth: The basic concept of the virtual coupling scenario is that multiple trains, which are in close distance, move together as they are physically coupled.

q_49582.question: What is the allowable time for the PCell interruption due to hibernation for E-UTRA FDD?
q_49582.ground_truth: The PCell interruption due to hibernation shall not occur before subframe n+5 and not occur after subframe n+9 when PCell belongs to E-UTRA FDD.

q_49583.question: What is the purpose of the first step in the content preparation process (M3u) in the 5G Multimedia Streaming (5GMS) service?
q_49583.ground_truth: The first step in the content preparation process (M3u) requests the instantiation of the content preparation process.

q_49584.question: What does the abbreviation "3GPP" stand for in the document title?

q_49585.question: What is the difference between Management Architecture #1 and Management Architecture #2 in the scenario of integrating satellite NBIoT/LTE-M -RAT with a 3GPP RAN?
q_49585.ground_truth: Management Architecture #1 considers a 3GPP RAN integrating a satellite NBIoT/LTE-M RAT, while Management Architecture #2 considers a 3GPP RAN integrating a satellite NBIoT/LTE-M -RAT and a satellite NR-RAT with a Terrestrial RAT.

q_49586.question: What is the purpose of the ProSe restricted code obtained from a successful announce request procedure in a PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message?
q_49586.ground_truth: The ProSe restricted code obtained from a successful announce request procedure in a PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message is used to pass the PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message to the lower layers for transmission over the PC5 interface.

q_49587.question: What is the required SNR at probability of detection equal to 0.99 for PUCCH format 2 for ACK missed detection?
q_49587.ground_truth: The required SNR at probability of detection equal to 0.99 for PUCCH format 2 for ACK missed detection is determined by the probability of false detection of the ACK and the probability of detection of ACK on the wanted signal.

q_49588.question: What is the format of the "Notification" parameter for the "Presence-In-AOI-Report" event?
q_49588.ground_truth: The "Notification" parameter in the "Presence-In-AOI-Report" event includes the UE-ID, Area identifier, and the UE's presence status (IN/OUT/UNKNOWN).

q_49589.question: What value shall be set for the Priority Level if it is rederived from multiple PCC rules with the priority sharing indicator?
q_49589.ground_truth: The Priority Level shall be set to the lowest value (i.e. highest priority) among the PCC rules with the priority sharing indicator.

q_49590.question: What is the prerequisite for the UE to include the "EPS bearer context status" information element in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message in 5GS?
q_49590.ground_truth: The UE shall include the "EPS bearer context status" information element in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message if the UE is performing inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode in 5GMM-IDLE mode, the UE has locally deactivated EPS bearer context(s) for which interworking to 5GS is supported while the UE was in S1 mode without notifying the network.

q_49591.question: In which subframes must the SS not observe either DTX or "NACK/DTX" (defined in 3GPP TS 36.213 clause 10.1) for the event "Deactivation" to be considered a success?
q_49591.ground_truth: The SS must not observe either DTX or "NACK/DTX" in subframes (n+7), (n+13), (n+8), (n+10), or (n+11), (n+18) for the event "Deactivation" to be considered a success.

q_49592.question: In what interfaces is the trace activated and deactivated based on GTPv2 for S2a or S2b?
q_49592.ground_truth: Based on GTPv2 for S2a or S2b, the trace is activated and deactivated via the STa and S2a interfaces or via the SWm and S2b interfaces.

q_49593.question: What is the function of the Layer-2 link modification procedure in the communication between Source UE and Target UE?
q_49593.ground_truth: The Layer-2 link modification procedure is used when the PC5 link is shared between multiple UEs, allowing for efficient communication and reuse of resources.

q_49594.question: What is the purpose of a Public Warning System (PWS) in GSM, UMTS, E-UTRAN, and NG-RAN?
q_49594.ground_truth: PWS provides a service that allows the network to distribute warning messages on behalf of public authorities. It enables the distribution of warning messages in GSM, UMTS, E-UTRAN, and NG-RAN.

q_49595.question: What are the two supported reference points for V2X communication, and on which types of networks are they based?
q_49595.ground_truth: The two supported reference points for V2X communication are the LTE based PC5 reference point and the NR based PC5 reference point.

q_49596.question: When can the NF Service Producer send a notification to a service instance other than the one indicated in the Binding Indication?
q_49596.ground_truth: The NF Service Producer can send a notification to a service instance other than the one indicated in the Binding Indication if the indicated service instance is not reachable and the Binding Indication is for an NF Set or NF Instance. This enables redundancy and high availability in the NF communication.

q_49597.question: What should the mobile station (MS) include in the ROUTING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message if it supports PSM (PICTURE MESSAGING) and requests the use of PSM?
q_49597.ground_truth: If the mobile station supports PSM and requests the use of PSM, the MS shall include the T3324 value IE with a requested timer value in the ROUTING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message. Additionally, if the MS indicates support for extended periodic timer value in the MS network feature support IE, it may also include the T3312 extended value IE to request a particular T3312 value to be allocated.

q_49598.question: What message is sent by the network to initiate a 5G AKA based primary authentication and key agreement procedure?

q_49599.question: What is the difference between transmitter ON period and transmitter OFF period?
q_49599.ground_truth: Transmitter ON period is the time period during which the IAB-DU or IAB-MT transmitter is transmitting data and/or reference symbols, while transmitter OFF period is the time period during which the IAB-DU or IAB-MT transmitter is not allowed to transmit.

q_49600.question: What is the role of the batch correlation ID in the procedure described in clause~6.65.3.1?
q_49600.ground_truth: The batch correlation ID is used to correlate multiple requests within a batch and ensure that all requests in the batch are received before proceeding.

q_49601.question: What is a "free-space open area test site" in the context of EMC testing?
q_49601.ground_truth: A free-space open area test site is a reference test site with precautions taken to ensure that reflections do not influence the measurement. A practical approximation of this test site is a Fully-Anechoic Room (FAR).

q_49602.question: What is the maximum number of SS/PBCH block indexes that can be included in resultsSSB-Indexes in beam measurements?
q_49602.ground_truth: up to maxNrofRS-IndexesToReport SS/PBCH block indexes

q_49603.question: What is established after step 20?
q_49603.ground_truth: Two N9 tunnels between the H-UPF and two different V-UPFs as well as two N3 tunnels between different V-UPF and RAN/AN are established, or two N3 tunnels, one is between V-UPF and RAN/AN over 3GPP access and the other is between H-UPF and RAN/AN over non 3GPP access, as well as one N9 tunnel between H-UPF and V-UPF are established.

q_49604.question: What kind of data can the HSS store about AS service data, and how is it stored?
q_49604.ground_truth: The HSS may store AS service data in a transparent manner, meaning it may not be aware of the structure and semantics of this data. Only the Application Server has this knowledge. The data can be stored in two optional formats: a binary coding format supporting a subset of MMTEL services corresponding to PSTN/ISDN and CS supplementary services, and an XML format supporting the full set of MMTEL Services.

q_49605.question: What is the purpose of maintaining the unicast link after switching to Uu path in solution #20?
q_49605.ground_truth: The purpose of maintaining the unicast link after switching to Uu path is to check whether switching back to PC5 path can be performed, and to reuse the unicast link instead of releasing it.

q_49606.question: What is the difference between the Carrier Bandwidth and the Carrier Smearing Filter in NR?
q_49606.ground_truth: The Carrier Bandwidth is a variable that represents the total bandwidth of a carrier, while the Carrier Smearing Filter is a variable that represents the bandwidth of the DC filter in the NR network. The Carrier Bandwidth is defined as a variable that ranges from 1 to 275 by default, while the Carrier Smearing Filter is defined as a variable that ranges from 0 to 120.

q_49607.question: What is the value of the Time Domain corresponding to "5GS" within the "tscQosReq" attribute within the "TscAppSessionContextUpdateData" indicates?
q_49607.ground_truth: The value of the Time Domain corresponding to "5GS" within the "tscQosReq" attribute within the "TscAppSessionContextUpdateData" indicates that the AF does not provide a Time Domain, and the provided TSCAI input information will be used without adjustments.

q_49608.question: What input is required to create an association between the transmission control server and a transmission participant in the MCVideo client in the 'Start-stop' state?
q_49608.ground_truth: In the 'Start-stop' state, an association between the transmission control server and a transmission participant in the MCVideo client is created when the 'basic transmission control operation towards the transmission participant' state machine is created. This happens when the MCVideo server sends a SIP 200 (OK) response to the originating MCVideo client in the case of an originating MCVideo call, or when the transmission control server receives the SIP 200 (OK) response from the terminating MCVideo client in the case of a terminating MCVideo call.

q_49609.question: What is the entering condition for event H1 to be satisfied?
q_49609.ground_truth: The entering condition for event H1 to be satisfied is when the inequality H1-1 is fulfilled, which means that the Aerial UE altitude relative to the sea level minus the hysteresis parameter Hys is greater than the threshold Thresh.

q_49610.question: In what situation will the P-CSCF send a new offer towards the answerer when it receives an SDP answer with ICE candidate information?
q_49610.ground_truth: The P-CSCF sends a new offer towards the answerer when it receives an SDP answer with ICE candidate information and the selected candidate pair does not match the c- and m- line address information for the associated UDP stream and the P-CSCF acts as an ICE controller entity towards the answerer.

q_49611.question: What does the LMF determine based on the service requirements, UE capability and current status, and operator policy?
q_49611.ground_truth: The LMF determines the appropriate positioning methods based on the service requirements, UE capability (e.g. whether UE has the Uu capability/PC5 capability), UE current status (e.g. reachable or unreachable, CM-CONNECTED or CM-IDLE) and operator policy.

q_49612.question: What is the difference between a Network Induced Location Request (NI-LR) and a Mobile Terminated Location Request (MT-LR)?
q_49612.ground_truth: A Network Induced Location Request (NI-LR) is initiated by the network for regulatory services, such as an emergency call or verification of a UE's location for satellite access. In contrast, a Mobile Terminated Location Request (MT-LR) is initiated by an LCS client or AF external to the network, requesting the location of a target UE.

q_49613.question: What should the VLR do when it detects overlapping information within a dialogue?
q_49613.ground_truth: The VLR shall send the error Unexpected Data Value, which should be ignored if received by any entity other than the VLR.

q_49614.question: What is the function of the id-BroadcastMRBs-ToBeReleased-Item in the BroadcastMRBs-ToBeReleased-ItemIEs F1AP-PROTOCOL-IES?
q_49614.ground_truth: The id-BroadcastMRBs-ToBeReleased-Item in the BroadcastMRBs-ToBeReleased-ItemIEs F1AP-PROTOCOL-IES is used to indicate a broadcast MRB (Minor Release Bundle) that is to be released, and it is a mandatory element with criticality reject.

q_49615.question: What is required from an ML assessment MnS producer in terms of assessment data trustworthiness?
q_49615.ground_truth: The ML assessment MnS producer should support a capability to enable an authorized MnS consumer to request reporting on the supported assessment explainability, fairness, and robustness capabilities of an ML entity. It should also support a capability to test a specific ML entity using assessment data with the required characteristics as defined by the MnS consumer.

q_49616.question: What should the MCVideo emergency group state be set to if an additional MCVideo user participating in the MCVideo emergency group call is received?
q_49616.ground_truth: The MCVideo emergency group state should be set to "MVEG 2: in-progress" if not already set to that value.

q_49617.question: How are PDCP entities established for a radio bearer in the Uu or PC5 interface?
q_49617.ground_truth: A PDCP entity is established when upper layers request it for a radio bearer in the Uu or PC5 interface. The PDCP entity is then associated with corresponding RLC and MAC entities for data transfer services.

q_49618.question: What is the higher layer parameter that provides an RSRP threshold for each combination (pi, pj), where pi is the value of the priority field in a received SCI format 1-B and pj is the priority of the transmission of the UE selecting resources?

q_49619.question: What procedure is used when the UE performs TAU with MME change while the UE has already triggered a pre-registration procedure from LTE to the HRPD?
q_49619.ground_truth: The S101 Tunnel Redirection Procedure is used when these conditions are met.

q_49620.question: What information should the SCAS instantiation contain for Security Compliance Testing and Basic Vulnerability Testing?
q_49620.ground_truth: The SCAS instantiation should contain enough information to execute test cases, determine whether tests completely and accurately cover SCAS, determine the tools to be used, and document all open ports and vulnerability scanning scope in the Basic Vulnerability Testing.

q_49621.question: What is the notification method for the VAE HDMap Dynamic Info service?
q_49621.ground_truth: The notification method is a separate HTTP connection towards an address assigned to the service consumer.

q_49622.question: What is the significance of the PreSelectedIndication leaf node in the MCData user profile MO?
q_49622.ground_truth: The presence of the PreSelectedIndication leaf node indicates that the MCData user profile MO is designated as the pre-selected MCData user profile, while its absence means that it is not the pre-selected MCData user profile.

q_49623.question: What is the initial state of the basic call control state machine for a UE that is not part of an ongoing call?
q_49623.ground_truth: The S1: start-stop state is the initial state of the basic call control state machine for a UE that is not part of an ongoing call.

q_49624.question: What actions should the transmission control server take if the Transmission request is granted?
q_49624.ground_truth: If the Transmission request is granted, the transmission control server should stop the T1 and T2 timers, store the User Id of the Transmitting User, allocate and store one globally unique Audio SSRC and one globally unique Video SSRC for the Transmitting user, and enter the 'G: Transmit Taken' state.

q_49625.question: What is the purpose of the ASR message in the BM-SC initiated multicast service deactivation procedure?
q_49625.ground_truth: The ASR message is used by the BM-SC to indicate to the GGSN that a specific MBMS bearer service is terminated and the corresponding distribution tree should be torn down.

q_49626.question: Which three elements does the <MCPTT-Group-Call> element contain?
q_49626.ground_truth: The <MCPTT-Group-Call> element contains a <Max-Simul-Call-N4> element, a <Max-Simul-Trans-N5> element, and a <Prioritized-MCPTT-Group> element.

q_49627.question: Does the UE verify if a session is indicated on MCCH even if it considers a frequency to be part of the MBMS frequencies of interest?
q_49627.ground_truth: No, the UE does not verify if the session is indicated on MCCH. The UE considers a frequency to be part of the MBMS frequencies of interest even though E-UTRAN may temporarily not employ an MRB for the concerned session.

q_49628.question: What information is provided to the UE during the L3 attach procedure for uplink and downlink directions?
q_49628.ground_truth: IP connectivity between the UE and the PDN GW is set for uplink and downlink directions. At this step, the IP address information is provided to the UE.

q_49629.question: What action does the source NG-RAN node take when it receives the HANDOVER SUCCESS message and the UE has successfully executed the handover?
q_49629.ground_truth: The source NG-RAN node may initiate Handover Cancel procedure towards the other signalling connections or other candidate target NG-RAN nodes for this UE, if any.

q_49630.question: How many pairs of TEID-Cs are allowed per MBMS Bearer Service for Sm and Sn interfaces?
q_49630.ground_truth: There shall be only one pair of TEID-Cs per MBMS Bearer Service (i.e. per TMGI and MBMS Flow Identifier) over the Sm and Sn interfaces respectively.

q_49631.question: What happens after the floor granted causes the user of floor participant A to be notified?
q_49631.ground_truth: Floor participant A starts sending voice media over the session, and all current floor participants receive the transmission, including floor participant B who is still sending voice media (overridden).

q_49632.question: What must the SMF include in the POST response for the UE Registration procedure with I-SMF or V-SMF insertion, change, and removal?
q_49632.ground_truth: The SMF must include the location header in the POST response with the URI of the created SM context resource.

q_49633.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for the NR - E-UTRA cell re-selection test case in AWGN for 2 Rx UE?
q_49633.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements are defined in clause 18.1.1.0.x of TS 38.133.

q_49634.question: What is the requirement for the number of successful tests out of the total number of tests in the procedure described, for the UE behavior in each test?
q_49634.ground_truth: The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90%.

q_49635.question: What happens in Step 3 of the Gateway Control and QoS Policy Rules Request Procedure?
q_49635.ground_truth: The trusted non-3GPP IP access indicates to the PCRF whether the requested QoS Policy Rules Provision could be enforced or not in Step 3.

q_49636.question: What is the periodicity of half frames for reception of the SS/PBCH blocks in a serving cell if not provided by the UE?
q_49636.ground_truth: If not provided, the UE assumes that the periodicity is same for all SS/PBCH blocks in the serving cell, meaning a periodicity of a half frame.

q_49637.question: What is the function of the "bfr" parameter when using the "Set" command for the +CMER command?
q_49637.ground_truth: The "bfr" parameter when using the "Set" command for the +CMER command controls the effect on buffered codes when certain modes are entered.

q_49638.question: What are the frequency regulation considerations for non-terrestrial networks when they operate near a country's border?
q_49638.ground_truth: Non-terrestrial networks must comply with the frequency license they have in each country or region, as well as the frequency regulations of neighboring countries. Regulators may define exclusion areas where non-terrestrial communication is not allowed, and operators should ensure that their networks do not provide service in those areas.

q_49639.question: What is the role of the PCF in the SM Policy Association Modification or Establishment in the context of multi-modal QoS flow?
q_49639.ground_truth: The PCF 2 initiates the SM Policy Association Modification or Establishment in the context of multi-modal QoS flow.

q_49640.question: What is the procedure called when the feeder link is changed from one NTN Gateway to another for a specific NTN payload?

q_49641.question: What should the UE include in the supportedBandCombination when it supports more than 128 CA band combinations and receives a UECapabilityEnquiry message without the requestedFrequencyBands?
q_49641.ground_truth: The UE should include all non-CA bands and all 2DL+1UL CA band combinations in the supportedBandCombination when it supports more than 128 CA band combinations and receives a UECapabilityEnquiry message without the requestedFrequencyBands.

q_49642.question: What message is sent by the source gNB in response to a request for UE context using the target Cell-ID?
q_49642.ground_truth: The source gNB responds with an Xn-AP Retrieve UE Context Response message including the UE context that contains the UE 5G AS security context.

q_49643.question: How many eCCEs are used for Type1-common search space for P-RNTI and Type2-common search space for RA-RNTI?
q_49643.ground_truth: Both Type1-common search space for P-RNTI and Type2-common search space for RA-RNTI use eCCEs with indexes 0 to 23, which is all eCCEs available.

q_49644.question: What should be done if the originating MCData ID is not authorized to send an affiliation status change request in negotiated mode?
q_49644.ground_truth: A 403 (Forbidden) response should be sent and the rest of the steps should not be continued.

q_49645.question: What are the contents of the MAC PDU sub-headers that identify the BSR formats?
q_49645.ground_truth: The MAC PDU sub-headers contain either Short BSR and Truncated BSR format with one LCG ID field and one corresponding Buffer Size field, or Long BSR format with four Buffer Size fields corresponding to LCG IDs #0 through #3.

q_49646.question: What is the purpose of the GMLC (Gateway Mobile Location Center) in the SL Positioning procedure between two UEs?
q_49646.ground_truth: The GMLC is responsible for requesting the SL Positioning service from the AMF of one of the UEs and providing the coarse location of the UEs to the SL Positioning capable LMF for performing the SL Positioning procedure between the network and the UE.

q_49647.question: What is the difference between option A and option B in UE capability negotiation?
q_49647.ground_truth: In option A, the UE retrieves the allowed DC application lists including required UE capabilities for each application from the DC Server (DCSF) via the Bootstrap DC. In option B, the Bootstrap Application in the UE sends its capabilities to the DC Server (DCSF) via the Bootstrap DC, and the DC Server checks the application list against the UE capabilities and replies with a validated DC application list.

q_49648.question: What is the method used to obtain the UE delay for the headset UE in electrical interface?
q_49648.ground_truth: The UE delay for the headset UE in electrical interface is obtained by measuring the delay between the input and output of the electrical reference interface, and subtracting the delays introduced by the test equipment and system simulator from the measured value.

q_49649.question: What is the procedure for initiating ad-hoc group communication within one MC system?
q_49649.ground_truth: The procedure for initiating ad-hoc group communication within one MC system is that the authorized user at MC service client 1 initiates the communication by sending an ad-hoc group communication request containing the list of participants to the MC service server, the MC service server accepts or rejects the request, and MC service client 1 sends an ad-hoc group communication request return message containing the ad-hoc group ID and result of authorization to MC service client 1.

q_49650.question: How many cancelers would be needed in a typical 5G case for MU MIMO with an average of L layers per user?
q_49650.ground_truth: (M+N)xUxL cancelers, where M and N are the number of antennas for transmission and reception, respectively, and U is the number of users.

q_49651.question: What are the channel busy ratio (CBR) and channel occupancy ratio (CR) defined for in TS 36.214, clause 5.1.30 and 5.1.31 respectively?
q_49651.ground_truth: CBR is a positive integer and b is 0 or a positive integer and CR is evaluated for each (re)transmission.

q_49652.question: What indication is sent to the UE in the Routing Area Update Accept message to inform the UE of emergency bearer services support over UTRAN?
q_49652.ground_truth: The Emergency Service Support indicator is set to inform the UE of emergency bearer services support over UTRAN.

q_49653.question: What should the floor control interface do when it receives a RTP media packet with payload from the associated floor participant while in the 'U: pending Floor Revoke' state?
q_49653.ground_truth: The floor control interface shall forward RTP media packets to the media distributor and remain in the 'U: pending Floor Revoke' state.

q_49654.question: What should the initiating UE do upon receiving a DIRECT LINK SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message with a null integrity protection algorithm in a PC5 unicast link security mode control procedure?
q_49654.ground_truth: The initiating UE shall continue the procedure that triggered the PC5 unicast link security mode control procedure without checking the integrity protection.

q_49655.question: What is the motion-to-photon latency requirement for an adequate user experience in AR services?
q_49655.ground_truth: The motion-to-photon latency should be less than 20ms, but preferably even a single digit latency below 10ms.

q_49656.question: What action should the MAC entity take if it has not triggered a Recommended bit rate query for a specific logical channel and direction, and is requested to do so by upper layers?
q_49656.ground_truth: The MAC entity should trigger a Recommended bit rate query for this logical channel, direction, and desired bit rate.

q_49657.question: What type of E-UTRA UE does the test in section 10.4.2.1.2 apply to?
q_49657.ground_truth: The test in section 10.4.2.1.2 applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 16 and forward, supporting EN-DC with a shared spectrum NR carrier and supporting RSSI measurements and channel occupancy on shared channel access.

q_49658.question: What is the purpose of establishing a UE Policy Association between the PCF-SM and the PCF-UE?
q_49658.ground_truth: The purpose of establishing a UE Policy Association between the PCF-SM and the PCF-UE is for the delivery and handling of URSP updates for a UE in EPC.

q_49659.question: What is the minimum and maximum length of the direct discovery set information element and the list of direct discovery sets information element?
q_49659.ground_truth: The direct discovery set information element has a minimum length of 12 octets and a maximum length of 520 octets, while the list of direct discovery sets information element has a minimum length of 15 octets and a maximum length of 8323 octets.

q_49660.question: What is the motivation for the use case described in section 5.12?
q_49660.ground_truth: The motivation for the use case described in section 5.12 is a high-resolution video application service of a live concert, which is only available to be accessed from a local edge server of a local hosting network.

q_49661.question: What indication should the gNB-DU include in the DL RRC MESSAGE TRANSFER message if a UE-associated logical F1-connection exists?
q_49661.ground_truth: The gNB-DU UE F1AP ID IE

q_49662.question: What information is necessary for 3rd party service providers when a network slice is delivered?
q_49662.ground_truth: Delivery should include the standardized NEST, specific service information, and capabilities, as well as security considerations if resource reservation is required. The timing and specific content of delivery may vary based on the 3rd party's needs.

q_49663.question: What is the conditional probability defined as for the probability of false detection of the ACK in the context of multi-slot PUCCH format 1?
q_49663.ground_truth: It is defined as the probability of erroneous detection of the ACK at a particular bit position when the input is only noise.

q_49664.question: What is the purpose of the "precondition mechanism" in the initial INVITE request as defined in subclause 3.1?
q_49664.ground_truth: The precondition mechanism in the initial INVITE request is used to ensure the availability of necessary resources before the session is established.

q_49665.question: What is the use of the +CALM command in the MT?
q_49665.ground_truth: It is used to select the general alert sound mode of the MT.

q_49666.question: What information is determined by the SRAP sublayer when supporting data transfer?
q_49666.ground_truth: The SRAP sublayer determines the UE ID field, BEARER ID field, egress link, and egress RLC channel for data packets.

q_49667.question: What network identifier is added to the existing "Selected PLMN identity" in the 5G connectivity procedure for a specific SNPN?

q_49668.question: What action does the AMF take when the strictly periodic monitoring timer expires and the NAS signalling connection is established for the UE?
q_49668.ground_truth: The AMF restarts the strictly periodic monitoring timer with the T3512 value.

q_49669.question: What should the User Equipment (UE) do if it has UL data available for transmission, has no UL-SCH resources available, and the time alignment timer expires while in Loopback Activated state (state 4)?
q_49669.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the random access procedure.

q_49670.question: What is the function of the PLMN credentials when provisioning SNPN credentials in a UE?
q_49670.ground_truth: The PLMN credentials are used by the UE to establish a secure connection with a PLMN as ONN for the provisioning of SNPN credentials.

q_49671.question: In what type of network is 5GMM cause #75 not applicable when received?
q_49671.ground_truth: When received from a cell belonging to an SNPN with a globally-unique SNPN identity.

q_49672.question: What is the purpose of the Local UPF insertion procedure in the middle of the PDU Session Establishment?
q_49672.ground_truth: The Local UPF insertion procedure is used to determine UL-CL filters based on the V-SBO information provided by the H-SMF, allowing the V-SMF to offload for accessing the EHE in VPLMN without further control from HPLMN.

q_49673.question: What is the effective ranging distance for LOS communication?
q_49673.ground_truth: The effective ranging distance for LOS communication can be several kilometers.

q_49674.question: What are the mandatory protocolIEs for UE Context Release Command in F1AP protocol?
q_49674.ground_truth: The mandatory protocolIEs for UE Context Release Command in F1AP protocol are GNB-CU-UE-F1AP-ID and GNB-DU-UE-F1AP-ID.

q_49675.question: What should be the gap between PUCCH transmission for HD-FDD in subframes?
q_49675.ground_truth: The gap between PUCCH transmission for HD-FDD in subframes should be 9 ms after subframe #7.

q_49676.question: What message is used by the UE to indicate connection establishment failure information in the VarConnEstFailReport, including the plmn-Identity and the failedCellId, when it sends a RRCConnectionSetupComplete message?
q_49676.ground_truth: The plmn-Identity is set to the PLMN selected by upper layers from the plmn-IdentityList in SystemInformationBlockType1, and the failedCellId is set to the global cell identity of the cell where connection establishment failure is detected.

q_49677.question: Which DRBs are excluded from the counting of "5.1.1.10.3 Number of released active DRBs"?
q_49677.ground_truth: DRBs used in 3GPP option 3 are excluded from the measurement.

q_49678.question: What is the effect on the positioning accuracy when N't is reduced to 16, for AI/ML assisted positioning?
q_49678.ground_truth: Reducing N't from 256 to 32~16 may degrade the positioning accuracy, while the measurement size and signalling overhead shrink to (approximately) 1/8 ~ 1/16 that of Nt=N't=256.

q_49679.question: What attribute(s) must the NF service consumer include in the "ascReqData" of the "AppSessionContext" data type in the HTTP POST request when making a session binding request?
q_49679.ground_truth: The NF service consumer must include either the "ueMac" attribute containing the UE MAC address or the "ueIpv4" attribute or "ueIpv6" attribute containing the UE IPv4 or IPv6 address.

q_49680.question: What must a UE do before selecting a new RAT for 3GPP access if it is required to disable the N1 mode capability for 3GPP access and has a persistent PDU session?
q_49680.ground_truth: The UE waits until the radio bearer associated with the persistent PDU session has been released before entering the 5GMM-IDLE mode before selecting E-UTRA or another RAT.

q_49681.question: In which scenarios is the N4 Session Modification Request message sent to the UPF by the SMF?
q_49681.ground_truth: The N4 Session Modification Request message is sent by the SMF to the UPF for PDU Sessions that are modified by the Target NG-RAN or in case of PDU Sessions whose user plane resources are being released.

q_49682.question: What does the conducted requirement apply to in the specification?
q_49682.ground_truth: The conducted requirement is defined at the TAB connector for SAN type 1-H.

q_49683.question: What is the difference between rated carrier TRP and maximum transmitter TRP in NR operation?
q_49683.ground_truth: Rated carrier TRP is the mean power level declared per carrier for a specific carrier in a specified reference condition, while maximum transmitter TRP is the mean power level measured per RIB during the transmitter ON period in a specified reference condition, corresponding to the declared rated transmitter TRP.

q_49684.question: Which parameter in CAMEL Phase 3 and 4 indicates the CAMEL phase 4 CSIs offered in the VMSC/VLR or SGSN?
q_49684.ground_truth: The Offered CAMEL 4 CSIs parameter in CAMEL Phase 3 and 4 indicates the CAMEL phase 4 CSIs offered in the VMSC/VLR or SGSN.

q_49685.question: What information does a Track Fragment Media Adjustment Box provide in a 3GP file or Media Segment?
q_49685.ground_truth: A Track Fragment Media Adjustment Box provides explicit time line offsets, allowing for the delay of playback time of the media in the track for synchronization between tracks.

q_49686.question: What should the UE do if it receives a message over Temporary C-RNTI with a UE contention resolution identity included in the MAC control element not matching the CCCH SDU transmitted in msg3 uplink message in Test 4?
q_49686.ground_truth: The UE shall consider the contention resolution not successful then re-select a preamble and transmit with the calculated PRACH transmission power when the backoff time expires.

q_49687.question: What elements does the Center element of the EllipsoidArcArea element contain?
q_49687.ground_truth: The Center element contains a PointCoordinateType element.

q_49688.question: Which field in the Metrics leaf splits the session duration into a number of equally sized periods where each period is of the length specified?
q_49688.ground_truth: The "Measure-Resolution" field splits the session duration into a number of equally sized periods where each period is of the length specified by the "Measure-Resolution" field.

q_49689.question: What steps are taken in the N3IWF-initiated UE context release procedure, if the N3IWF detects that the UE is not reachable?
q_49689.ground_truth: Three steps are taken in the N3IWF-initiated UE context release procedure: the N3IWF detects that the UE is not reachable, sends a N2 UE Context Release Request message to the AMF, and performs the release of the IPsec tunnel as defined in RFC 7296.

q_49690.question: What does the Teardown-Indicator in the RADIUS Disconnect Request message indicate to the GGSN?
q_49690.ground_truth: The Teardown-Indicator in the RADIUS Disconnect Request message indicates to the GGSN that all PDP contexts for this particular user and sharing the same user session shall be deleted.

q_49691.question: When does (re-)allocating or de-allocating IPv4 address and/or IPv6 prefix (excluding causing PDU session release) require the SMF to inform the DN-AAA server, and by which method?
q_49691.ground_truth: When an IPv4 address and/or IPv6 prefix (including any additional IPv6 prefix of IPv6 multi-homing) is (re-)allocated or de-allocated (not causing the PDU session to be released) by using a method not via the DN-AAA server, the SMF shall inform the DN-AAA server by sending Diameter DER or AAR with the latest list of IPv4 address and/or IPv6 prefix(es).

q_49692.question: What should be done for a multi-band connector under test when measuring the emission within the specified frequency ranges with the specified measurement bandwidth?
q_49692.ground_truth: For a multi-band connector, the emission within the Inter passband Bandwidth or sub-block gap should be measured using the specified measurement bandwidth from the closest RF Bandwidth or sub block edge.

q_49693.question: What is the difference between Method 1 and Method 2 for the Network-and-UE-coordination based procedure in Solution #36?
q_49693.ground_truth: Method 1 involves querying the target hosting SNPN for network performance information, while Method 2 involves instructing the UE to measure and report the signal reception status of the potential target hosting network(s).

q_49694.question: What is the required channel spacing for intra-band non-contiguous carrier aggregation?
q_49694.ground_truth: The channel spacing between two NR component carriers in different sub-blocks in intra-band non-contiguous carrier aggregation shall be larger than the nominal channel spacing defined in clause 5.4A.1.

q_49695.question: What are the key components of the UE-to-UE Relay discovery process?
q_49695.ground_truth: The UE-to-UE Relay discovery process involves the use of a Layer-2 ID for discovery, sending out a Relay Discovery message periodically, supporting the query and response mode for discovery, and establishing unicast L2 links for other UEs to establish connections with the UE-to-UE Relay.

q_49696.question: What is the recommended solution for defining the radio service intent expectation in TS 28.312?
q_49696.ground_truth: The recommended solution is to define the Radio Service Expectation by utilizing the construct of the generic IntentExpectation <dataType> with set of allowed values and concrete dataTypes specified.

q_49697.question: What is the RSRP measurement accuracy for all measured cells for periodic and event-triggered measurement reports?
q_49697.ground_truth: Reported RSRP and RSRQ measurements contained in periodically triggered and event-triggered measurement reports should meet the requirements in sections 9.1.13.1, 9.1.13.2 and 9.1.13.3, respectively.

q_49698.question: What existing services does the NEF interact with when deriving the list of candidate UEs that fulfill the filtering criteria?
q_49698.ground_truth: The NEF interacts with 5GC NFs such as PCF, NWDAF, AMF, and SMF to derive the list of candidate UEs that fulfill the filtering criteria.

q_49699.question: What is the applicability of the test defined in section 9.2.52.2?
q_49699.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA TDD UE Release 13 and forward that support downlink LAA with TDD as PCell.

q_49700.question: What is the maximum VCL Bit Rate for a Bitstream conforming to the 3GPP VR Basic H.264/AVC Operation point?
q_49700.ground_truth: The maximum VCL Bit Rate for a Bitstream conforming to the 3GPP VR Basic H.264/AVC Operation point is 120 Mbps.

q_49701.question: What shall the UE do if the Contention Resolution Timer expires?
q_49701.ground_truth: The UE shall re-select a preamble and transmit with the calculated NPRACH transmission power when the backoff time expires if the Contention Resolution Timer expires.

q_49702.question: What is the function of the "last non-3GPP access location information" in the AMF's response for CancelLocation?
q_49702.ground_truth: The "last non-3GPP access location information" is included in the AMF's response for CancelLocation when the UE is in RM-REGISTERED over non-3GPP access, indicating the latest non-3GPP access location information of the UE.

q_49703.question: What is the purpose of the MCData ID in the context of MCData access token?
q_49703.ground_truth: The MCData ID is part of the MCData access token and serves as the identity of the MCData user. It can also be used as the value for the userId variable when generating the HTTP request URL.

q_49704.question: What are the two types of traffic descriptors that can be used to cross-connect virtual ports and DNN/S-NSSAI in case of URSP?

q_49705.question: How does the MLT MnS producer determine which data to use when training the ML entity?
q_49705.ground_truth: The MLT MnS producer may examine the consumer's provided training data and select none, some, or all of them. Additionally, the producer may select some other training data that are available for a more comprehensive training process.

q_49706.question: What is the purpose of the OC-Supported-Features AVP?
q_49706.ground_truth: The OC-Supported-Features AVP is used to support Diameter overload control mechanism.

q_49707.question: What should the MGCF do when it receives 1xx or 2xx response to a subsequent request for a dialog, in calls originating in circuit-switched networks?
q_49707.ground_truth: The MGCF should store the value of the received term-ioi header field parameter in the P-Charging-Vector header field, if present.

q_49708.question: What is the function of the PCF in the network slice replacement procedure?
q_49708.ground_truth: The PCF receives the AF requested QoS information from the UDR, activates, modifies, or removes PCC rules corresponding to the QoS information as needed based on the invalidity conditions.

q_49709.question: What action does the transmission control interface take when it receives RTP media packets from the media distributor in the 'U: not permitted and Transmit Taken' state?
q_49709.ground_truth: The RTP media packets are forwarded to the associated transmission participant by the network media interface in the MCVideo server.

q_49710.question: What should the participating MCPTT function do upon receiving a SIP REFER request while in the 'G: Pre-established session not in use' state?
q_49710.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT function shall reserve user plane resources for the call session and enter the 'G: Pre-established session in use' state.

q_49711.question: What should the Number of payloads IE be set to when generating a DATA PAYLOAD message in the MCData communication?
q_49711.ground_truth: The Number of payloads IE should be set to 1.

q_49712.question: What is the expected pattern for UE to receive the PDCCH and corresponding PDSCH for RMSI scheduling multiplexing patterns 3 in the Type0-PDCCH CSS set and SSB symbols to be measured for L1-RSRP measurement?
q_49712.ground_truth: UE is expected to receive the PDCCH that UE monitors in the Type0-PDCCH CSS set, and the corresponding PDSCH, on SSB symbols to be measured for L1-RSRP measurement for RMSI scheduling multiplexing patterns 3 in the Type0-PDCCH CSS set and SSB symbols to be measured for L1-RSRP measurement.

q_49713.question: What is the purpose of the security materials in the discovery procedure?
q_49713.ground_truth: The security materials (i.e. the long term credentials) are used to secure the link establishment, authenticate the peer Ranging UEs and protect the Ranging/SL Positioning information.

q_49714.question: What is the purpose of the Transmission Release message?
q_49714.ground_truth: The Transmission Release message is sent as an action from the transmission participant to the transmission control server to inform that the transmission can be released or to cancel the transmission request in the queue.

q_49715.question: Under what conditions would a UE prioritize the reception of a PDCCH associated with a specific CORESET?
q_49715.ground_truth: A UE is expected to prioritize the reception of a PDCCH associated with a specific CORESET if the "qcl-Type" is set to "typeD" of the PDSCH DM-RS and is different from that of the PDCCH DM-RS with which they overlap in at least one symbol.

q_49716.question: What does Exposed MnS represent in the context of network management capability exposure?
q_49716.ground_truth: Exposed MnS represents the management services that can be exposed by the MnS producer to an external MnS consumer.

q_49717.question: What is the required throughput performance for the band, with a wanted and an interfering signal coupled to a BS type 1-C antenna connector?
q_49717.ground_truth: The throughput shall be >= 95% of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channel.

q_49718.question: In an on-network private call, what protects transmission control and reception control messages sent and received by the MCVideo client and by the participating MCVideo function serving the MCVideo client if protection of transmission control and reception messages sent using unicast between the MCVideo client and the participating MCVideo function serving the MCVideo client is negotiated?
q_49718.ground_truth: The CSK and the CSK-ID protect transmission control and reception control messages sent and received by the MCVideo client and by the participating MCVideo function serving the MCVideo client if protection of transmission control and reception messages sent using unicast between the MCVideo client and the participating MCVideo function serving the MCVideo client is negotiated in an on-network private call.

q_49719.question: What is the product identifier that the Media Stream Handler in the 5GMS Client should include in the User-Agent request header when making a request to the 5GMS AF at interface M4?
q_49719.ground_truth: The product identifier that the Media Stream Handler should include in the User-Agent request header when making a request to the 5GMS AF at interface M4 is "5GMSMediaStreamHandler".

q_49720.question: What should the P-CSCF include in the Security-Server header field if any, in the SIP header when sending a 401 (Unauthorized) response to the UE?
q_49720.ground_truth: The media plane security mechanisms supported

q_49721.question: What does the "eUTRA-CGI" field represent in PagingAssisDataforCEcapabUE SEQUENCE?

q_49722.question: What should the UE do upon successful processing of a 5G authentication challenge?
q_49722.ground_truth: The UE responds with an AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message to the network

q_49723.question: What is the requirement for the ratio of successful reported values in each test for it to pass in the TDD RSRQ under Time Domain Measurement Resource Restriction with MBSFN ABS test?
q_49723.ground_truth: The ratio of successful reported values in each test should be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

q_49724.question: What is the role of a Global Root in network management name spaces?
q_49724.ground_truth: The Global Root is the ultimate parent of all MO instances in all managed systems, and it is the parent of all MO instances in a single managed system.

q_49725.question: What actions should the participating MCPTT function take if the user identified by the MCPTT ID is not authorized to make private calls?
q_49725.ground_truth: If the <allow-private-call> element of the <ruleset> element is not present in the MCPTT user profile document on the participating MCPTT function or is present with the value "false", indicating that the user identified by the MCPTT ID is not authorized to initiate private calls, the participating MCPTT function shall reject the "SIP INVITE request for originating participating MCPTT function" with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response, with warning text set to "107 user not authorized to make private calls".

q_49726.question: What mode of GBR traffic requires the use of both a MAR and a Redundant steering mode?
q_49726.ground_truth: A DL PDR corresponding to GBR traffic of a MA PDU session using the Redundant steering mode

q_49727.question: What should the UE do when the drx-ShortCycleTimer for a DRX group expires?
q_49727.ground_truth: Use the Long DRX cycle for this DRX group.

q_49728.question: How does the UE determine the value of the ue-Identity when an S-TMSI is not provided by upper layers?
q_49728.ground_truth: The UE should draw a random value in the range of 0 to 240-1 and set the ue-Identity to this value.

q_49729.question: What is the condition for the entering condition of event A3?
q_49729.ground_truth: The entering condition for event A3 is fulfilled when the measurement result of the neighboring cell is a certain number of decibels (dB) higher than the measurement result of the serving cell.
