q_49962.ground_truth: The emulation of the WLAN Access Point is used to support WLAN security protocol using WPA/WPA2 algorithms and emulates the WLAN station management entity, physical layer, and MAC layer for WLAN testing.

q_49963.question: What is the role of an ng-eNB in 5G network?
q_49963.ground_truth: The ng-eNB is a network element of NG-RAN that provides measurement results for position estimation and makes measurements of radio signals for a target UE, communicating these measurements to an LMF.

q_49964.question: What should be the relationship between the resolution bandwidth and measurement bandwidth when measuring the power of spurious emissions in a repeater?
q_49964.ground_truth: The resolution bandwidth should be equal to the measurement bandwidth, but it can be smaller for improved measurement accuracy. In the case where the resolution bandwidth is smaller, the result should be integrated over the measurement bandwidth to obtain the equivalent noise bandwidth of the measurement bandwidth.

q_49965.question: What is the purpose of the <hAccuracy>, <vAccuracy>, <vertRequested>, <responseTime>, <minorLocQoses>, and <lcsQosClass> elements in the "LocationQoS" type?
q_49965.ground_truth: These elements in the "LocationQoS" type specify the horizontal accuracy, vertical accuracy, vertical request, response time, minor location QoS, and LCS QoS class for location QoS.

q_49966.question: What is the allowed MPR for the maximum output power for ProSe for PSDCH, PSCCH, PSSCH, and PSBCH for QPSK modulation for the corresponding transmission bandwidth?
q_49966.ground_truth: The allowed MPR for the maximum output power for ProSe physical channels PSDCH, PSCCH, PSSCH, and PSBCH for QPSK modulation for the corresponding transmission bandwidth is as specified in subclause 6.2.3 for PUSCH for the corresponding modulation and transmission bandwidth.

q_49967.question: What does the gNB-CU-UP include in the BEARER CONTEXT MODIFICATION RESPONSE message for DRBs that failed to be established for E-UTRAN?
q_49967.ground_truth: A list of DRBs which failed to be established, included in the DRB Failed List IE

q_49968.question: What should the UE do when it receives an ESM cause value of #28, indicating an unknown PDN type, and the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message contained a PDN type IE indicating a PDN connection type?
q_49968.ground_truth: The UE should ignore the Back-off timer value IE and Re-attempt indicator IE provided by the network, and may send another PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message with a different PDN type IE indicating another PDN connection type.

q_49969.question: What information should be added to the aor attribute when a registration set of a public user identity has a wildcarded public user identity?
q_49969.ground_truth: The notifier should set the aor attribute to any public user identity represented by the wildcarded identity and set the <wildcardedIdentity> sub-element in the <registration> element to the wildcarded identity as received via the Cx interface.

q_49970.question: When should the UE send the RRCConnectionSetupComplete message with logMeasAvailableWLAN included?
q_49970.ground_truth: The UE should send the RRCConnectionSetupComplete message with logMeasAvailableWLAN included if it has WLAN logged measurements available and if the RPLMN is included in plmn-IdentityList stored in VarLogMeasReport.

q_49971.question: What is the difference between Mandatory, Conditional, Conditional-Optional and Optional presence requirements for IEs in PFCP messages?
q_49971.ground_truth: A Mandatory IE must be included by the sending entity, and the receiver diagnoses an error if it's not present. A Conditional IE is included by the sending entity only if certain conditions are met, and the receiver checks the conditions to infer if a conditional IE should be expected. Conditional-Optional IEs are included by a sending entity if specified conditions are met and must be present in updated entities, and the receiver need not check their presence. Optional IEs may be included or not and their absence or errors are handled as specified in clause 7.6.

q_49972.question: What is the parameter used by the NSACF to maintain a list of UE IDs that have established PDU sessions with the network slice?
q_49972.ground_truth: The UE ID parameter is used by the NSACF to maintain a list of UE IDs that have established PDU sessions with the network slice.

q_49973.question: What should the receiving side of an AM RLC entity do when it receives an AMD PDU from a lower layer that falls outside of the receiving window?
q_49973.ground_truth: The receiving side of an AM RLC entity should discard the received AMD PDU when it falls outside of the receiving window.

q_49974.question: Which message type is sent by the UE to the network in response to a SECURITY MODE COMMAND message?

q_49975.question: What information is included in the Sponsored-Connectivity-Data AVP when the AF session is associated with a sponsor in step 14?
q_49975.ground_truth: Sponsor-Identity AVP, optionally Sponsoring-Action AVP set to applicable value, and Application-Service-Provider-Identity AVP.

q_49976.question: Who forwards messages in the roaming case when Local Breakout is used?
q_49976.ground_truth: The vPCRF forwards messages between the PDN GW and the hPCRF in the roaming case when Local Breakout is used.

q_49977.question: What are the three charging scenarios defined for the NSSAAF and AMF to interact with the CHF regarding Network Slice-Specific Authentication and Authorization functionality?

q_49978.question: What action does the UE take if indicated by the SN before receiving the cell switch command in SCG LTM?
q_49978.ground_truth: The UE performs DL synchronization with candidate cell(s) before receiving the cell switch command (3a) or performs early TA acquisition with candidate cell(s) before receiving the cell switch command (3b).

q_49979.question: Under which condition is the resultant QoS rule created empty, allowing for the deletion of packet filters if the rule operation is "Modify existing QoS rule and delete packet filters"?
q_49979.ground_truth: This is possible when the QoS rule is created for a PDU session of IPv4, IPv6, IPv4v6, or Ethernet PDU session type, and the packet filter list in the resultant QoS rule is empty after deleting the packet filters.

q_49980.question: What are the three possible visibility settings for a PIN element?
q_49980.ground_truth: A PIN element can set its visibility to Private, Restricted, or Public.

q_49981.question: What is the obligation of the UAE layer in forwarding commands for changing USS from the USS/UTM?
q_49981.ground_truth: The UAE layer forwards commands for changing USS from the USS/UTM.

q_49982.question: Which method is used to modify operator specific data in the UDR in the "OperatorSpecificData" resource?
q_49982.ground_truth: The PATCH method is used to modify operator specific data in the UDR in the "OperatorSpecificData" resource.

q_49983.question: When does the SS activate SCell1 by sending the activation MAC-CE in a subframe m?
q_49983.ground_truth: The SS activates SCell1 by sending the activation MAC-CE in a subframe m, where m is an even number for FDD PCell and 4 or 9 for TDD PCell.

q_49984.question: When does a UE initiate an RRC connection if systemInformationBlockType31 is broadcast in NB-IoT?
q_49984.ground_truth: If systemInformationBlockType31 is broadcast in NB-IoT, a RRC connection is initiated only if the UE has a valid GNSS position. Additionally, the UE may need to re-acquire the GNSS position before establishing the connection to avoid interruption during the connection.

q_49985.question: What is the pre-condition for Network Slice Information delivery while registration?
q_49985.ground_truth: The NSCE server performs to retrieve the Network Slice ServiceProfile from 5GS (e.g., NSMF) using the 'getMOIAttributes' operation as specified in TS 28.532. The delivered Network Slice Service Profile contains the values of attributes such as PLMN, S-NSSAI, SST, maximum number of UEs, maximum number of PDU sessions, Coverage Area, Latency, Data volume, etc which specify the Network Slice characteristics.

q_49986.question: What is the name of the telecommunication service characterization method described in ITU-T Recommendation I.130?
q_49986.ground_truth: The three-stage method for characterisation of telecommunication services.

q_49987.question: If the network receives an ACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message and multiple PDN connections for a given APN are allowed, what action might the network take regarding existing PDP contexts?
q_49987.ground_truth: The network may retain the existing PDP contexts and proceed with the requested PDP context activation procedure.

q_49988.question: What is placed in the generic Source to Target Transparent Container if the target is GERAN?
q_49988.ground_truth: The "old BSS to new BSS information IE" is placed in the generic Source to Target Transparent Container if the target is GERAN.

q_49989.question: What is the purpose of the Idle mode Signalling Reduction (ISR) function?
q_49989.ground_truth: The Idle mode Signalling Reduction function provides a mechanism to limit signalling during inter-RAT cell-reselection in idle mode (ECM-IDLE, PMM-IDLE, GPRS STANDBY states).

q_49990.question: What is the purpose of the LMF initiating assistance data delivery in the DL-TDOA positioning method?
q_49990.ground_truth: The LMF initiates assistance data delivery in the DL-TDOA positioning method to provide unsolicited periodic assistance data to the target UE. This procedure is currently supported for PRU measurement information only.

q_49991.question: What is the purpose of increasing the number of failure tests by one in the test procedure?
q_49991.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure that a wide range of possible scenarios is covered in the testing process.

q_49992.question: What is the purpose of TSCTSF receiving time synchronization status from UPF/NW-TT?
q_49992.ground_truth: The purpose of TSCTSF receiving time synchronization status from UPF/NW-TT is to inform AFs about time synchronization status.

q_49993.question: What is the UE's action in Subtest 1 when there is no payload or loopback data to send?
q_49993.ground_truth: The UE sends uplink MAC padding bits on the NR sidelink RMC.

q_49994.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 6.7.7.1.1?
q_49994.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described in 6.7.7.1.1 is to verify that the inter-RAT E-UTRAN RS-SINR absolute measurement accuracy is within the specified limits for all bands, when the serving cell is NR FR1 and the target cell is E-UTRA.

q_49995.question: What should the UE do during the time durations T4 and T5 for NR Cell 1?
q_49995.ground_truth: The UE is not expected to transmit PUCCH/PUSCH or receive PDCCH/PDSCH on reference symbols to be measured for candidate beam detection.

q_49996.question: What is the purpose of reporting NR carrier phase measurements in NR carrier phase positioning?
q_49996.ground_truth: To estimate the propagation delay/distance between transmitting and receiving nodes and to resolve integer ambiguity.

q_49997.question: What should a UE do when it moves to a new Cell/frequency/PLMN3 while performing ProSe Direct Discovery monitoring on PLMN1 but not authorized for ProSe Direct Discovery Monitoring on PLMN3?
q_49997.ground_truth: The UE should not initiate Monitoring request procedure and should not monitor for messages announced over the PC5 in the assigned resources in Cell/frequency/PLMN3.

q_49998.question: What should an MTSI client that has negotiated the use of ECN for video and RTCP AVPF ECN feedback messages follow when receiving both application-specific requests and RTCP AVPF ECN feedback messages?
q_49998.ground_truth: The application-specific requests for performing media bit rate adaptation.

q_49999.question: What should the UE do when the Taaa timer expires in the SL-MO-LR operation?
q_49999.ground_truth: If the UE's timer Taaa expires in the SL-MO-LR operation, it should assume that the operation has failed and inform the user of the failure. The UE may terminate the dialogue by sending a RELEASE COMPLETE message.

q_50000.question: What information is included in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body of the SIP MESSAGE request to indicate successful emergency communication cancellation?
q_50000.ground_truth: The <alert-ind> element is set to "true", the <alert-ind-rcvd> element is set to "true", the <emergency-ind> element is set to "false", and the <mcdata-client-id> element contains the MCData client ID that was included in the incoming SIP MESSAGE request.

q_50001.question: In the V-PCF not involved roaming scenarios, what component replaces the AMF for the PDU Session?

q_50002.question: What action should the MS take when it receives the REQUEST MBMS CONTEXT ACTIVATION message to establish an MBMS context in the MS and the network for a specific IP Multicast Address using a specific NSAPI?
q_50002.ground_truth: Upon receipt of a REQUEST MBMS CONTEXT ACTIVATION message, the MS should validate the message by verifying the corresponding NSAPI, stop the timer T3396 if it is running for the APN indicated in the message, and send an ACTIVATE MBMS CONTEXT REQUEST, transitioning to the MBMS-ACTIVE-PENDING state and starting timer T3380.

q_50003.question: What does the NW-TT indicate in the MANAGE USER PLANE NODE COMPLETE message for each successful operation?
q_50003.ground_truth: The NW-TT includes the result of each successful operation in the User plane node update result IE of the MANAGE USER PLANE NODE COMPLETE message.

q_50004.question: What type of request shall be supported at the non-roaming II-NNI with an "application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-affiliation-command+xml" MIME body in a MESSAGE request for MCPTT?
q_50004.ground_truth: A MESSAGE request including the specified MIME bodies shall be supported at the non-roaming II-NNI for MCPTT.

q_50005.question: What information must the ATCF include in a SIP response to a SIP INVITE request due to STI-rSR?
q_50005.ground_truth: The ATCF shall include the same response code as the received SIP response, the Record-Route header field containing the SIP URI of the ATCF, and the P-Charging-Vector header field.

q_50006.question: What can an attacker introducing when forced to use the same downlink frequency as a legitimate cell?
q_50006.ground_truth: An attacker can introduce additional signal interference when forced to use the same downlink frequency as a legitimate cell.

q_50007.question: What does the UE do if it activates a service/application requiring a network slice not offered by the serving network?
q_50007.ground_truth: The UE may deregister and trigger a PLMN Search followed by re-registration to find a network providing the required network slice. The UE can provide the supported slice information to the network for prioritizing the available VPLMNs for selection.

q_50008.question: When should a MUSIM UE not initiate a service request procedure to release the NAS signalling connection?
q_50008.ground_truth: A MUSIM UE should not initiate a service request procedure to release the NAS signalling connection if the UE is attached for emergency bearer services or if the UE has a PDN connection for emergency bearer services established.

q_50009.question: What power classes are targeted for inter-band concurrent operation for Power class 3 Uu@Licensed and Power class 2 Uu@Licensed when considering concurrent operation with SL-U?
q_50009.ground_truth: The targeted power classes for inter-band concurrent operation for Power class 3 Uu@Licensed are Power class 5 SL@Un-licensed and Power class 3 SL@Un-licensed. For Power class 2 Uu@Licensed, it is not considered in Rel-18.

q_50010.question: What is the UE power step tolerance for a 1dB power step size, as specified in TS 38.101-1?
q_50010.ground_truth: The UE power step tolerance for a 1dB power step size is 0.7dB.

q_50011.question: How are SIP errors handled in the IMS Network Element regarding charging?
q_50011.ground_truth: If SIP errors occur during service delivery, the IMS Network Element determines the extent of service delivered before the error and acts accordingly with respect to charging, potentially reserving or debiting no units at all.

q_50012.question: What should the MCVideo client include in the SIP REGISTER request if confidentiality protection is disabled as specified in clause~6.6.2.3.1?
q_50012.ground_truth: An application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body with the <mcvideo-access-token> element set to the access token received from the partner IdM server, the <mcvideo-request-uri> element set to the MCVideo ID of the user in the primary MCVideo system, and the <selected-user-profile-index> element set to the value contained in the "user-profile-index" attribute of the MCVideo user profile.

q_50013.question: What message does the W-AGF send to the AMF when it receives a NAS Registration Request from an FN-RG?
q_50013.ground_truth: The W-AGF sends a NAS Registration Request to the AMF, including the SUCI and an AUN3 device indicator when it receives a NAS Registration Request from an FN-RG.

q_50014.question: When should the network include the 5GS network feature support IE in the REGISTRATION REJECT message?
q_50014.ground_truth: When the network wants to inform the UE of the support of certain features, and this information is not included in any other IE.

q_50015.question: In the context of 3GPP TS 36.101, what is the definition of BWChannel in terms of its unit and measurement?
q_50015.ground_truth: In the context of 3GPP TS 36.101, BWChannel is defined as channel bandwidth, measured in Hertz.

q_50016.question: When a UE supporting non-seamless WLAN offload uses ISRP, what is the priority of WLAN access networks compared to 3GPP RATs in the WLAN selection?
q_50016.ground_truth: WLAN access networks can be prioritized with respect to 3GPP RATs but those WLANs do not influence WLAN selection.

q_50017.question: What should the UE do when entering the proximity of one or more CSG member cells and proximity indication is enabled for such E-UTRA cells?
q_50017.ground_truth: The UE shall initiate transmission of the ProximityIndication message in accordance with TS 36.331, clause 5.3.14.3. The UE shall set the contents of the ProximityIndication message and submit it to lower layers for transmission.

q_50018.question: What is the procedure for handling a transiently unavailable access type in an MA PDU session in the SMF?
q_50018.ground_truth: When an access type of an MA PDU session becomes transiently unavailable, the SMF shall notify the UPF that the access type has become unavailable by sending a PFCP Session Modification Request with the Access Availability Information IE indicating so. The SMF should then also notify the UPF when the access type becomes available again.

q_50019.question: What is the role of LP-WUR in waking up the main receiver from sleep mode, and what are the conditions for this to happen?
q_50019.ground_truth: LP-WUR triggers the legacy paging monitoring procedure for the main receiver, which starts up the main receiver to monitor legacy paging. This happens if the UE detects LP-WUR and could determine that it is being paged by finding its own PagingRecord in the paging message. The downlink latency in this case is determined by the periodicity of the legacy paging occasions (POs), and there may be cases where 'continuous' mode does not provide latency benefit compared to 'duty-cycled' mode.

q_50020.question: What action does the SMF take if it establishes N3 tunnel User Plane resources for the PDU Session during UE Registration procedure with I-SMF or V-SMF insertion, change, and removal?
q_50020.ground_truth: The SMF returns a 201 Created response with the upCnxState attribute set to ACTIVATING and N2 SM information to request the 5G-AN to assign resources to the PDU session.

q_50021.question: What is the power level of the first preamble that should be transmitted in the tests specified in section 6.2.15.4.2?
q_50021.ground_truth: The power of the first preamble shall be -26.5 dBm.

q_50022.question: How is the spectrum emission mask applied for inter-band carrier aggregation with two uplink non-contiguous carriers assigned to one NR band?
q_50022.ground_truth: The spectrum emission mask requirements in subclause 6.5A.2.2.2 apply for that band.

q_50023.question: What is the data type of the parameter "zvalue" in the structure "RelativeCartesianLocation"?
q_50023.ground_truth: The data type of the parameter "zvalue" in the structure "RelativeCartesianLocation" is integer.

q_50024.question: How are packet filter identifier values set in the "Traffic flow template" information element?
q_50024.ground_truth: When sending the Traffic flow template information element in the BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST message or the BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message, the UE shall set the packet filter identifier values to 0 when requesting to create a new TFT or add packet filters to an existing TFT. Otherwise, the UE shall set the packet filter identifier values from those of already assigned packet filter identifiers of the existing EPS bearer.

q_50025.question: What action does the VLR take if it has no IMSI record for the MS when receiving a location updating or IMSI attach request?
q_50025.ground_truth: The VLR creates a skeleton IMSI record for the MS and sets various indicators to "Not Confirmed". If authentication is required, the VLR retrieves authentication data and performs an "Update Location" to the HLR once the radio contact with the Mobile Station is authenticated.

q_50026.question: What information does the MME store in the bearer context?
q_50026.ground_truth: The MME stores information related to the bearer context such as APN-AMBR, UE-AMBR, QoS parameters, and the correlation ID for enabling the direct user plane path between the eNodeB and the L-GW.

q_50027.question: What is the purpose of the discoverer end UE procedure for UE-to-UE relay discovery?
q_50027.ground_truth: The discoverer end UE procedure for UE-to-UE relay discovery allows a ProSe-enabled UE to solicit proximity of a connectivity service provided by a 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE or to measure the PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message signal strength between the ProSe-enabled UE and the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE(s) for UE-to-UE relay selection/reselection.

q_50028.question: What should the floor participant do upon receiving a Queued Floor Requests message with the Queued Floor Requests Purpose value set to '2' (Cancel Notification)?
q_50028.ground_truth: If the first bit in the subtype of the Queued Floor Requests message is set to '1' (Acknowledgment is required), the floor participant should send a Floor Ack message, provide a queued floor requests cancellation notification to the MCPTT user, display the requesting user for a cancellation of a queued floor request to the user, stop timer T104 (Floor Queue Position Request) if running, and enter the 'U: has no permission' state.

q_50029.question: What action should the MME take if it fails to perform a uplink path switch for certain E-RABs in the PATH SWITCH REQUEST message?
q_50029.ground_truth: The MME should include those E-RABs in the E-RAB To Be Released List IE of the PATH SWITCH REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message, indicating to the eNB to release the corresponding data radio bearers.

q_50030.question: What should the floor participant do upon receiving the Floor Taken message in the "Floor participant state transition diagram for basic operation"?
q_50030.ground_truth: Upon receiving the Floor Taken message, the floor participant should send a Floor Ack message, may provide a floor taken notification to the user, store the Granted Party's Identity and display the identity of the talking party to the user, store the Audio SSRC of the Granted Participant and start optional timer T103 for the participant for which Floor Taken message was received.

q_50031.question: What should SMF-2 provide to UPF-2 for indoor multipath transmission?
q_50031.ground_truth: SMF-2 provides PDR to UPF-2 for identifying traffic data of the Remote UE for multipath transmission and instructs UPF-2 to send the uplink data received from UPF-1 via forwarding tunnel to the Application Server or send a copy of the downlink data for Layer-3 multipath transmission to UPF-1.

q_50032.question: What must a UE support if it indicates support for "ce-MultiTB-EarlyTermination-r16"?
q_50032.ground_truth: A UE indicating support for "ce-MultiTB-EarlyTermination-r16" must also indicate support for "pusch-MultiTB-CE-ModeA-r16" or "pusch-MultiTB-CE-ModeB-r16".

q_50033.question: What should be the value of the session-type element when initiating a private MCPTT call?
q_50033.ground_truth: The value of the session-type element should be "private".

q_50034.question: What should the UE include in the RRCConnectionSetupComplete message if it supports CIoT EPS optimizations?
q_50034.ground_truth: The UE should include attachWithoutPDN-Connectivity, up-CIoT-EPS-Optimisation, and cp-CIoT-EPS-Optimisation if received from upper layers and the network supports one or more CIoT EPS optimizations.

q_50035.question: For which protocol is the Cause E-UTRAN parameter used to indicate the reason for a particular event in E-UTRAN?

q_50036.question: What information does the NG-RAN node store for each PDU session?
q_50036.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node stores the UL NG-U UP TNL Information IE included in the PDU Session Resource Setup Request Transfer IE contained in the PDU SESSION RESOURCE SETUP REQUEST message and uses it as the uplink termination point for the user plane data for this PDU session.

q_50037.question: Under what circumstances can a mobile station abort the establishment of the first MM connection?
q_50037.ground_truth: The mobile station can abort the establishment of the first MM connection after completing the RR connection and before sending the first CM message during the establish phase.

q_50038.question: What are the conditions for the "DisplayNameElementType" complex type?
q_50038.ground_truth: The "DisplayNameElementType" complex type is a complex type with a simple content extension of a "xs:string" type with an optional "xml:lang" attribute and any attributes from any namespace.

q_50039.question: When do analytics consumers contact the NWDAF via the DCCF for analytics exposure procedures?
q_50039.ground_truth: Analytics consumers contact the NWDAF via the DCCF when using the procedures described in clause~5.2.4 and clause~5.2.5.

q_50040.question: What <dataType> represents a ranges of SUPIs that can be served by the AUSF instance?

q_50041.question: What occurs when T1 expires in this test procedure?
q_50041.ground_truth: When T1 expires, the SS shall change the SNR value to T2, and T2 starts.

q_50042.question: What is the recommended action when the NF service consumer is unable to identify the UL and DL flows involved in a round trip time over two QoS flows?
q_50042.ground_truth: The editor recommends using an entry of the "MediaComponent" data type with the "fDescs" attribute, which contains the flow description for the monitored Uplink and Downlink IP flows.

q_50043.question: What is the purpose of the "Mobile termination control mode +CMEC" command?
q_50043.ground_truth: The "Mobile termination control mode +CMEC" command is used to select the controlling unit of MT keypad, display, touch screen, and indicators.

q_50044.question: What is the criteria for a MAC entity to consider itself in a particular enhanced coverage level?
q_50044.ground_truth: The MAC entity considers itself to be in the enhanced coverage level with the smallest index that is greater than or equal to the index of the enhanced coverage level that the measured RSRP indicates, if the UE is capable of that enhanced coverage level.

q_50045.question: What type of AVP is the Supported-Features in the command ABNF?
q_50045.ground_truth: The Supported-Features AVP is of type grouped.

q_50046.question: What is the role of the relay indication in the UE-to-UE Relay discovery message?
q_50046.ground_truth: The relay indication is used to determine whether the relay UE will broadcast the discovery message or not. If it is 0, the relay UE will not broadcast the discovery message, otherwise, it will decrease the relay indication by 1 and update it in the discovery message.

q_50047.question: What should the UE do when Srxlev-value of the serving cell is less than ThreshServing, LowP and a cell of a higher priority frequency fulfils Srxlev > ThreshX, LowP during a time interval TreselectionRAT?
q_50047.ground_truth: The UE should reselect a cell as follows: If the highest-priority frequency is an E-UTRAN frequency, a cell ranked as the best cell among the cells on the highest priority frequency(ies) meeting the criteria.

q_50048.question: What is the requirement for the confidence level for the rate of correct measurement reports observed with delay during repeated tests?
q_50048.ground_truth: The rate of correct measurement reports observed with delay during repeated tests shall be at least 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

q_50049.question: What is the name of the attributeGroup named "IndexType" which contains an "index" attribute of type xs:token?

q_50050.question: What should the NCR-MT do when measuring SSB for BFD and CSI-RS in the same OFDM symbol with different SCS in FR1?
q_50050.ground_truth: If the NCR-MT supports simultaneousRxDataSSB-DiffNumerology, it can measure both without restrictions. Otherwise, it has to measure one of the two measurements and is expected to have a longer measurement period for SSB based BFD measurement.

q_50051.question: What should the UE do if the "forbidden PLMNs for GPRS service" list is empty after removing a PLMN from it?
q_50051.ground_truth: The UE should re-enable the E-UTRA capability.

q_50052.question: What should be signaled on Adaptation Set level for each Representation in the Main Video Media Profile?
q_50052.ground_truth: The @width and @height, Chroma Format, Colour Primaries and Transfer Function, @frameRate, and Random Access Points should be signaled on Adaptation Set level for each Representation in the Main Video Media Profile.

q_50053.question: When should a UE initiate the procedure to report SCG failures, as specified in TS 36.331, clause 5.6.13.2?
q_50053.ground_truth: A UE should initiate the procedure to report SCG failures when SCG transmission is not suspended and when one of the specified conditions is met, such as detecting radio link failure for the SCG or SCG change failure.

q_50054.question: What should the ADRF do if it successfully processes and accepts an HTTP POST request for deleting data or analytics based on a data or analytics specification?
q_50054.ground_truth: The ADRF should remove any stored data or analytics that match the analytics specification, the data specification, or the data set identifier received in the request and respond with HTTP "204 No Content" status.

q_50055.question: What is the measurement provided by the number of successful parameter gettings at UDM?
q_50055.ground_truth: This measurement provides the number of successful parameter gettings at UDM.

q_50056.question: What is the purpose of sending uplink power control "up" commands in the test procedure?
q_50056.ground_truth: The purpose of sending uplink power control "up" commands in the test procedure is to allow at least 200 ms for the UE to reach maximum output power.

q_50057.question: How is the data volume related to the UPF calculated?
q_50057.ground_truth: The data volume of the UPF is obtained by summing up, for all N3 interface(s), the number of octets of incoming GTP data packets on the N3 interface, from (R)AN to UPF and the number of octets of outgoing GTP data packets on the N3 interface, from UPF to (R)AN. In case of a UPF with N3 interface(s) and in case of a UPF with no N3 interface(s), the data volume calculation method is different.

q_50058.question: What should the media storage client send in the Content-Type header field when including binary data for group file distribution?
q_50058.ground_truth: The media storage client should set the Content-Type header field to application/octet-stream and the Content-Length field to the file size.

q_50059.question: What should the MS do when it has a mobile originating session in the "early" state and is receiving multimedia CAT over the PS domain prior to the vSRVCC handover?
q_50059.ground_truth: The MS stops providing the early media to the user and may internally generate an alerting indication after transitioning from the PS domain.

q_50060.question: What is the implication of the MIPv4 FA-CoA mode selection?
q_50060.ground_truth: If MIPv4 FA-CoA mode is selected, the 3GPP AAA Server calculates the MIPv4 FACoA mobility security parameters and includes them in the authentication and authorization response to the trusted non 3GPP access network.

q_50061.question: For which subcarrier spacings should the performance requirement tests be conducted for IAB-MT?
q_50061.ground_truth: The tests should be conducted only for each subcarrier spacing declared to be supported by IAB-MT.

q_50062.question: What should the AS do when it receives an initial INVITE request identified as a PSAP callback?
q_50062.ground_truth: The AS should suppress diversion when the received initial INVITE request towards the served user is identified as a PSAP callback.

q_50063.question: What is contained in a MCPTT user information entry maintained by the MCPTT server?
q_50063.ground_truth: A MCPTT user information entry maintained by the MCPTT server includes an MCPTT ID that uniquely identifies the MCPTT user information entry, and a list of MCPTT client information entries.

q_50064.question: What is the effect of using the AT+CCMDC command followed by the call identification number and the subcommand 1?
q_50064.ground_truth: It terminates the connection with the specified call identification number.

q_50065.question: What is the role of the AF in determining NF load for a specific area of interest?
q_50065.ground_truth: The AF provides UE trajectory input data to the NWDAF, which is used for UE mobility analytics. This data is collected in addition to MDT input data and/or collective behavior input data to determine NF load.

q_50066.question: When passing SRAP data packets for data packets not corresponding to SRB0, which part of the SRAP entity at the relay UE is responsible for removing the SRAP header when delivering SRAP SDUs to the transmitting part of the collocated SRAP entity at the same interface?
q_50066.ground_truth: The receiving part of the SRAP entity at the relay UE removes the SRAP header when delivering SRAP SDUs to the transmitting part of the collocated SRAP entity at the same interface.

q_50067.question: What is the minimum number of uncorrelated samples that should be used to measure the S-parameters in a reverberation chamber?

q_50068.question: What should the PGW-C request the PGW-U to do upon receipt of a Suspend Notification message for a PDN connection?
q_50068.ground_truth: The PGW-C should request the PGW-U to discard packets for the suspended PDN connection by setting the DROP flag in the Apply Action IE of the FARs or setting the gate fields in the Gate Status IE of QERs to the value CLOSED.

q_50069.question: Under what circumstances would the network set the EMM cause value to #78 in an ATTACH REJECT message?
q_50069.ground_truth: The network would set the EMM cause value to #78 in an ATTACH REJECT message if the attach request is from a UE via a satellite E-UTRA cell, and the network using the User Location Information provided by the eNodeB determines that the UE is in a location where the network is not allowed to operate.

q_50070.question: What does the V-PCF send in step 2 to the "UE Policy Associations" resource to forward UE policy information to the H-PCF?
q_50070.ground_truth: The V-PCF sends an HTTP POST request including parameters received from AMF in step 1 and a Notification URI to the H-PCF in step 2.

q_50071.question: What is the maximum level of spurious emissions that a BS operating in Band n13 and n14 should not exceed for ensuring appropriate interference protection to 700 MHz public safety operations?
q_50071.ground_truth: The maximum level of spurious emissions that a BS operating in Band n13 and n14 should not exceed is the power of any spurious emission, which is different for each band and frequency range.

q_50072.question: What should the HSS do if due to message size constraints or timing constraints the complete list of group user identifier cannot be sent in the NIA response?
q_50072.ground_truth: The HSS shall segment the list, include the first segment in NIA and set the NIA-Flag to "Incomplete Group User Identifier List," and send subsequent segments with separate NIR commands to the SCEF.

q_50073.question: As per the requirements of the test, what should the overall delays measured be less than in this test case?
q_50073.ground_truth: The overall delays measured should be less than 12802 ms in this test case.

q_50074.question: What is the security mechanism for NF service-related signalling over N32-f protection selected by the Security Edge Protection Proxy (SEPP) during security capability negotiation?
q_50074.ground_truth: The security mechanism for NF service-related signalling over N32-f protection selected by the SEPP during security capability negotiation is based on the security capabilities supported by both the SEPPs and their local policies. The selected security mechanism is used for protecting security capability negotiation over N32-c.

q_50075.question: What is the role of a SNPN Identity in the SNPN Access Mode in 5G networks?
q_50075.ground_truth: The SNPN Identity, defined as the pair (PLMN ID, NID), represents the identity of a Stand-alone NPN in the SNPN Access Mode in 5G networks.

q_50076.question: In what case can a GPRS MS not perform a PLMN selection?
q_50076.ground_truth: A GPRS MS can not perform a PLMN selection if the PLMN providing this reject cause is on the "User Controlled PLMN Selector with Access Technology" or "Operator Controlled PLMN Selector with Access Technology" list or if it is a PLMN identified as equivalent to any PLMN, within the same country, contained in the lists above.

q_50077.question: What is the function of a USS in the context of UTM operational requirements?
q_50077.ground_truth: A USS can provide any subset of functionality to meet the provider's business objectives, which may include UTM, Remote Identification or both. It provides a set of functions and services for managing a range of autonomous vehicle operations, such as authenticating UAV, authorizing UAS services, managing UAS policies, and controlling UAV traffics in the airspace.

q_50078.question: What should the gNB-CU-UP do for each PDU session for which the Security Indication IE is included in the PDU Session Resource To Setup List IE or the Security Indication Modify IE is included in the PDU Session Resource To Modify List IE of the BEARER CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message, and the Integrity Protection Indication IE or Confidentiality Protection Indication IE is set to "required", if it cannot perform the user plane integrity protection or ciphering?
q_50078.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-UP shall reject the setup of the PDU Session Resources with an appropriate cause value.

q_50079.question: What is the minimum aggregate adjustment rate for UE transmit timing accuracy in E-UTRAN TDD?
q_50079.ground_truth: The minimum aggregate adjustment rate for UE transmit timing accuracy in E-UTRAN TDD is 3.4*Ts per 1008ms for carrier frequency under 1 GHz or 0.4*Ts per 1008ms for carrier frequency over 1 GHz.

q_50080.question: What is the purpose of testing ACLR as per section 6.6.3.3?
q_50080.ground_truth: The purpose of testing ACLR is to verify that the requirement shall be met as specified by the minimum requirement.

q_50081.question: What should the originating participating MCData function do upon receiving a SIP re-INVITE request for an existing MCData one-to-one communication session and if it is unable to process the request due to a lack of resources or a risk of congestion?
q_50081.ground_truth: The originating participating MCData function may reject the SIP request with a SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response.

q_50082.question: What is the purpose of Retrieve T-EES request message in ACR procedure for bundled EAS located on multiple EES within the same EHE for S-EAS decided ACR scenario?
q_50082.ground_truth: The Retrieve T-EES request message is sent by the S-EES#1 to the ECS to determine the T-EES and target EHE for the bundled EAS based on the all bundled EAS information, and to ensure that all the T-EES and T-EAS are within the same EHE.

q_50083.question: What happens if the list of available PLMNs does not include a PLMN that is also included in a PLMN Selector list?
q_50083.ground_truth: The UE stops the procedure and may attempt to connect via untrusted non-3GPP access.

q_50084.question: What should the target NG-RAN node do if it receives an SN STATUS TRANSFER message for a UE for which no prepared handover exists at the target NG-RAN node?
q_50084.ground_truth: The target NG-RAN node should ignore the message in this case.

q_50085.question: What are the two 5G ProSe Direct Discovery models?
q_50085.ground_truth: The two 5G ProSe Direct Discovery models are Model A and Model B, which are defined in clause~5.3.1.2 in TS~23.303.

q_50086.question: What is the method of ensuring that a source UE cannot be tracked or identified beyond a certain time period for IP based V2X communication over PC5 reference point?
q_50086.ground_truth: The source Layer-2 ID and source IP address must be changed over time and randomized, synchronized across PC5 layers.

q_50087.question: What is the maximum number of symbols in a TTI for NR in the context of 3GPP TS 38.306?
q_50087.ground_truth: The maximum number of symbols in a TTI for NR is 14.

q_50088.question: What HTTP status code should be sent if the ELETE request is not authorized for an HTTP DELETE request?

q_50089.question: What does the Pending Data Indication IE represent in 5G systems?
q_50089.ground_truth: It indicates that the MME is aware of pending signalling or data in the network for the UE, or that the MME expects a response from the UE.

q_50090.question: What action should the newly selected AMF take when there is a transaction with the UE in CM-CONNECTED state?
q_50090.ground_truth: The newly selected AMF should retrieve the UE context from the UDSF based on the UE's SUPI, 5G-GUTI, or AMF UE NGAP ID, process the UE message accordingly, and update the 5G-GUTI towards the UE if necessary.

q_50091.question: What is the requirement for the transmitter intermodulation level for intra-system minimum requirement for BS operation in BC1, BC2, and BC3 in 6.7.2.5?
q_50091.ground_truth: The transmitter intermodulation level shall not exceed the unwanted emission limits specified for operating band unwanted emission and ACLR in the presence of a wanted signal and an interfering signal for BS operation in BC1, BC2, and BC3 in subclause 6.7.2.5.

q_50092.question: How many subframes after subframe (n) can DTX not be observed for the event "Deactivation" to be considered a success in the intra-band PCell TDD case, if SCell2 is activated?
q_50092.ground_truth: DTX should not be observed in subframes (n+20) and (n+24), (n+25) and (n+29), (n+35) and (n+39) and (n+43) and (n+48) up to the end of T3, or subframes (n+23) and (n+38) and (n+53) and (n+78) up to the end of T3 for the event "Deactivation" to be considered a success in the intra-band

q_50093.question: What should the UE do to enable the E-UTRA capability again?
q_50093.ground_truth: The UE can enable the E-UTRA capability again in the following cases: (1) when the UE mode of operation changes from CS/PS mode 1 of operation to CS/PS mode 2 of operation, (2) when the UE mode of operation changes from PS mode 1 of operation to PS mode 2 of operation, (3) when the UE powers off and powers on again, or (4) for the PLMN selection purpose.

q_50094.question: Under what circumstances can a UE operate in extraterritorial areas?
q_50094.ground_truth: UE operations are not explicitly allowed in extraterritorial areas, except for UEs that represent a vessel or aircraft. Such UEs will have to follow regulatory requirements for maritime or aeronautical communication. For example, the International Maritime Organisation (IMO) sets regulatory requirements for radiocommunication in e.g. the SOLAS (Saving Lives at Sea) convention. Part of the SOLAS regulations is the Global Maritime Distress and Safety System (GMDSS) under which all passenger ships and all cargo ships over 300 gross tonnage on international voyages have to carry specified terrestrial and satellite radiocommunication equipment for sending and receiving distress signals and maritime safety information.

q_50095.question: What message is sent by the NG-RAN node to request the AMF to suspend the UE context and the related PDU session contexts?

q_50096.question: What is the minimum transmitter intermodulation level for IAB-DU type 1-H and IAB-MT type 1-H co-location?
q_50096.ground_truth: The minimum transmitter intermodulation level for IAB-DU type 1-H and IAB-MT type 1-H co-location is that the transmitter intermodulation level shall not exceed the unwanted emission limits in clauses 7.6 in the presence of an NR interfering signal.

q_50097.question: What is the role of the PEGC in adjusting the non-3GPP delay budget for a specific flow?
q_50097.ground_truth: The PEGC may use the UE requested PDU Session Modification procedure to request a non-3GPP delay budget for a set of packet filters if the PEGC supports this feature and wants to change the default non-3GPP delay budget for a specific flow.

q_50098.question: What is the role of the IMS GWF in the line charging architecture, from the perspective of the S-CSCF?
q_50098.ground_truth: In the line charging architecture, the IMS GWF is an online charging capable CTF, and from the perspective of the S-CSCF, it is a SIP application server and is triggered the same way.

q_50099.question: What is the condition for the UE to set the rlf-Report in UEInformationResponse when rlf-ReportReq is set to true in TS 36.331, clause 5.6.5.3(TP1)?
q_50099.ground_truth: If rlf-ReportReq is set to true and the UE has radio link failure information or handover failure information available in VarRLF-Report, and plmn-Identity stored in VarRLF-Report is equal to the RPLMN, then the UE sets the rlf-Report in the UEInformationResponse message to the value of rlf-Report in VarRLF-Report.

q_50100.question: Which attribute is used to specify a "uri" for the MCVideo group ID in a network's implicit affiliations?

q_50101.question: Which parameter is used in E-UTRAN and NG-RAN to indicate that the received warning message is a new message to be scheduled for concurrent broadcast with any other ongoing broadcast of warning messages?
q_50101.ground_truth: The Concurrent Warning Message Indicator IE

q_50102.question: What is the purpose of the frequency re-selection test scenario?
q_50102.ground_truth: The purpose of this test scenario is to ensure that when the UE detects the cell re-selection criteria are met for the cell which belongs to a lower or higher priority inter-RAT E-UTRA cell, it reselects the appropriate cell.

q_50103.question: What is the objective of the Xn interface specifications in terms of inter-connection of NG-RAN nodes?
q_50103.ground_truth: To facilitate inter-connection of NG-RAN nodes supplied by different manufacturers and support continuation of NG-RAN services offered via the NG interface.

q_50104.question: What is the role of V-CHF in Solution #2.2?
q_50104.ground_truth: V-CHF determines the charging resource for NF, interacts with H-CHF, generates a charging home request to H-CHF, creates a CDR related to the service, and informs NF (CTF) on the result of the charging data request.

q_50105.question: What should the 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-UE Relay decide when determining the QoS Info of the first hop QoS in establish a Layer-2 link with integrated Discovery?
q_50105.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-UE Relay should decide the QoS Info of the first hop QoS with considering the received second hop QoS when determining the QoS Info of the first hop QoS in establish a Layer-2 link with integrated Discovery.

q_50106.question: How does the evaluation area affect the performance of AI/ML positioning?
q_50106.ground_truth: The performance of AI/ML positioning is better in the evaluation area as the convex hull of the horizontal BS deployment compared to the whole hall area.

q_50107.question: What happens in step 1a2 of the described procedure?
q_50107.ground_truth: In step 1a2, the target V-SMF retrieves SM context from the source V-SMF during V-SMF change.

q_50108.question: What is the durationOfPRS-ProcessingSymbolsInEveryTms in the PRS RSTD measurement in positioning frequency layer i?
q_50108.ground_truth: The least common multiple between the repetition periodicity of the measurement gap applicable for measurement in the PRS frequency layer i and the periodicity of DL PRS resource with muting on positioning frequency layer i.

q_50109.question: What is the procedure that the AMF shall follow if an unsupported DNN is requested by the UE?
q_50109.ground_truth: The DNN replacement of unsupported DNNs indicates that the AMF shall contact the PCF for replacement of an unsupported DNN requested by the UE.

q_50110.question: Which message is sent by the MME as a response to a RESET message?

q_50111.question: What type of information does the VarEventID include?
q_50111.ground_truth: The VarEventID includes information about the current value of eventID-TSS received in SIB9 or in DLInformationTransfer.

q_50112.question: What are the limitations of 0-RTT data for 3GPP SBI?
q_50112.ground_truth: 0-RTT data can be replayed and lacks full forward secrecy, making it insecure for non-idempotent requests, and potentially unaffected by the order of the requests.

q_50113.question: What are the conditions for F to be invertible based on the matrix B?
q_50113.ground_truth: F is invertible if the matrix (GW-a.k3.I) does not lose rank.

q_50114.question: What is the existing feature that could be used to provide time synchronization accuracy in the 5G system?
q_50114.ground_truth: Support of IEEE 1588 PTP (Precision Time Protocol)

q_50115.question: How are spherical videos compressed and stored for Omnidirectional video?
q_50115.ground_truth: Spherical videos are pre-processed and mapped to a 2D texture, encoded with a regular 2D video encoder, and the VR rendering metadata is encoded and provided along with the video bitstream.

q_50116.question: What is the state of the MME when it has started a common EMM procedure and is waiting for a response from the UE?
q_50116.ground_truth: The MME enters the state EMM-COMMON-PROCEDURE-INITIATED, after it has started a common EMM procedure and is waiting for a response from the UE.

q_50117.question: What information does the SDP Media Components field contain?
q_50117.ground_truth: The SDP Media Components field is a grouped field that contains several sub-fields associated with one media component. These sub-fields provide information about the media component in the SDP (Session Description Protocol) data, including the media name, media description, access correlation ID, local GW inserted indication, IP realm default indication, and transcoder inserted indication.

q_50118.question: What is the function of Location Criteria in URSP rules?
q_50118.ground_truth: Location Criteria in URSP rules indicates to the UE that the route should only be established when the UE is served by certain cell(s), RAN node(s), TAI(s) or PLMN ID(s).

q_50119.question: What type of NR UE does the test applicability in clause 7.5A.3.2 apply to?
q_50119.ground_truth: This test case applies to all types of NR UE release 15 and forward that support 4DL CA.

q_50120.question: What is the time required for the UE to search for a target cell (Tsearch) when the target cell is a known inter-frequency cell and the measured SSB and the target SSB for handover belong to the same NR target cell, where the UE supports UE capability IE for FG 53-3?
q_50120.ground_truth: Tsearch = Trs ms, provided that certain conditions are satisfied.

q_50121.question: What should the Old SMF do if it is not capable of transferring the SM Context in step 9?
q_50121.ground_truth: The Old SMF should skip steps 9 to 12 if it is not capable of transferring the SM Context.

q_50122.question: What should the MCPTT client do upon call establishment if the MCPTT user has requested a locally initiated ambient listening call?
q_50122.ground_truth: The MCPTT client shall provide no indication to the MCPTT user that the ambient listening call has been successfully established.

q_50123.question: How should the subcarrier spacing be chosen when testing each PRACH format with a short sequence?
q_50123.ground_truth: The tests should apply only for the smallest supported subcarrier spacing in the FR for each PRACH format with short sequence declared to be supported.

q_50124.question: What attribute in the NnwdafDataManagementNotif data structure indicates the data collected from data sources?

q_50125.question: What should the S-CSCF do when it receives a REGISTER request for NASS-IMS bundled authentication, for a public user identity that is linked to a private user identity and has a new contact address, but the maximum number of allowed registration flows is reached?
q_50125.ground_truth: The S-CSCF shall reject the REGISTER request by generating a 403 (Forbidden) response.

q_50126.question: How is Adjacent Channel Leakage power Ratio (ACLR) defined for UE supporting Tx diversity?
q_50126.ground_truth: For UE indicating Tx diversity capability, ACLR is defined as the ratio of sum of the filtered mean power at each antenna connector centred on the assigned channel frequency to sum of the filtered mean power at each antenna connector centred on an adjacent channel frequency.

q_50127.question: What is the role of NRF in the process of authorizing the selection of participant NWDAF instances in the Federated Learning group?
q_50127.ground_truth: NRF is responsible for checking if the server NWDAF is on the permitted-server-NWDAF list for each Analytics ID, and granting access tokens to the server NWDAF if it is authorized.

q_50128.question: What is the effect of setting all parameters in the "+CSRA" command to indicate "Radio access is disabled"?
q_50128.ground_truth: The MT will return an error if all parameters in the "+CSRA" command are set to indicate "Radio access is disabled".

q_50129.question: What action does the Serving GW take if it receives additional downlink data packets for a bearer with the same or lower priority as the bearer with the highest priority for which it has sent a Downlink Data Notification message?
q_50129.ground_truth: The Serving GW buffers these downlink data packets and does not send a new Downlink Data Notification.

q_50130.question: What is a PSDK in the context of ProSe direct discovery?
q_50130.ground_truth: A PSDK (ProSe Direct Discovery Keyset) is a set of keys used for the discovery process in ProSe direct communication.

q_50131.question: What method is used to retrieve operator specific data from the UDR?
q_50131.ground_truth: The GET method is used to retrieve operator specific data from the UDR.

q_50132.question: What should a UE do when it receives a SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message during an ongoing UE-requested PDU session release procedure, and the PDU session indicated in the message is the same one that the UE has requested to release?
q_50132.ground_truth: The UE should ignore the SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message and proceed with the UE-requested PDU session release procedure.

q_50133.question: What is the purpose of the "dataCollectionRequest" and "dataCollectionResponse" in XNAP-Elementary-Procedure?
q_50133.ground_truth: The "dataCollectionRequest" is used as initiating message for "dataCollectionReportingInitiation" procedure to report data collection status, while the "dataCollectionResponse" indicates a successful outcome.

q_50134.question: What are the procedures involved in the communication between the Application Client and the MSGin5G Client over the MSGin5G-5 reference point?
q_50134.ground_truth: The procedures involved in the communication between the Application Client and the MSGin5G Client over the MSGin5G-5 reference point are Application Registration and Message delivery information, including constructing MSGin5G messages, routing information, and notifications information.

q_50135.question: In what state is the "basic floor control operation towards the floor participant" state machine when it is first created before any floor control related input is applied?
q_50135.ground_truth: The state machine is in the 'Start-stop' state.

q_50136.question: What are the cell types for Cell 1, Cell 2, and Cell 3 in this test?
q_50136.ground_truth: Cell 1, Cell 2, and Cell 3 are satellite access cells (SA FR1-FR1) in this test.

q_50137.question: What is the consequence for the UE if the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message can be accepted and a new EPS security context is taken into use, and the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message does not indicate the "null integrity protection algorithm" EIA0 as the selected NAS integrity algorithm?
q_50137.ground_truth: The UE shall set the downlink NAS COUNT of this new EPS security context to the downlink NAS COUNT that has been used for the successful integrity checking of the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message.

q_50138.question: What is the significance of broadcast and multicast MBS sessions in MCPTT?
q_50138.ground_truth: Broadcast and multicast MBS sessions are significant in MCPTT as they enable MCPTT group communication. In multicast MBS sessions, MCPTT UEs must initiate a UE session join to receive the corresponding MC data, which are announced via the service announcement.

q_50139.question: What action should an MCData server take if the "Expires" header field is not included or has a nonzero value lower than 4294967295 in a SIP PUBLISH request?
q_50139.ground_truth: The MCData server should send a SIP 423 (Interval Too Brief) response to the SIP PUBLISH request with a Min-Expires header field set to 4294967295.

q_50140.question: What can the PCF do in addition to control the network slice data rate, based on operator's policies?
q_50140.ground_truth: Accept new PDU sessions or PCC rule changes that lead to exceeding the Maximum Slice Data Rate, and apply a different charging for them. This can be applied to prioritized services, emergency services, and network slice data rate policy control.

q_50141.question: What is the cause of a Short Message Delivery Failure with the detailed reason "memory capacity exceeded"?
q_50141.ground_truth: The SM entity that is trying to send the message has insufficient memory to complete the message transfer.

q_50142.question: What will the BM-SC do if it receives a GET request to retrieve a specific report for a session, but the report is not found?
q_50142.ground_truth: The BM-SC will send a 404 message to the Content Provider.

q_50143.question: What is the role of the MCPTT server when establishing media plane communication between the MCPTT client and the IWF?
q_50143.ground_truth: The MCPTT server forwards the MCPTT private call response to the MCPTT client and ensures that the established media plane communication between the MCPTT client and the IWF is granted the floor by the LMR system and solves competing floor requests.

q_50144.question: What is the impact of setting the "5.2.48Q /<x>/<x>/OnNetwork/PrivateCall/AllowedCallBackCancelRequest" field to "true" or "false"?
q_50144.ground_truth: When the "5.2.48Q /<x>/<x>/OnNetwork/PrivateCall/AllowedCallBackCancelRequest" field is set to "true", the MCPTT user is allowed to cancel an outstanding private call callback request. If it is set to "false", then the MCPTT user is not allowed to cancel an outstanding private call callback request.

q_50145.question: What requirement is specified in clause 7.5B.1.3 for the intra-band contiguous EN-DC in FR1?
q_50145.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 7.5B.1 for the intra-band contiguous EN-DC in FR1.

q_50146.question: Which field is used to indicate the subcarrier indication of NPRACH in the DCI format N1 when used for random access initiated by a NPDCCH order?
q_50146.ground_truth: The subcarrier indication of NPRACH field is used to indicate the subcarrier indication of NPRACH in the DCI format N1 when used for random access initiated by a NPDCCH order.

q_50147.question: What is the difference between 16.6.5.3 and 16.6.5.4 in the document?
q_50147.ground_truth: 16.6.5.3 is about NR SA FR1 Identification of a new CGI of inter-RAT E-UTRA cell using autonomous gaps in NR SA for 1 Rx UE and 16.6.5.4 is about NR SA FR1 Identification of a new CGI of inter-RAT E-UTRA cell using autonomous gaps in NR SA for 2 Rx UE. The main difference is that 16.6.5.4 is for 2 Rx UE and has a shorter time duration for identifying a new CGI of an E-UTRA cell (150 ms) compared to 16.6.5.3 (190 ms).

q_50148.question: What is the role of IQF in the Identity Caching Function (ICF)?
q_50148.ground_truth: The IQF present in the ADMF is responsible for querying the records held by the ICF using one of the target identifiers such as SUPI, SUCI, 5G-S-TMSI, and 5G-GUTI. The IQF queries the ICF to get information about a specific target identifier, targeting based on GPSI, PEI, IMS identifiers, or other legacy identifiers (e.g. MSISDN) is not supported.

q_50149.question: What is a pre-requisite for the UE to request a PDN connection for USS communication during attach and UE-requested PDN connectivity procedures?
q_50149.ground_truth: Before accessing EPS for UAS services, the UE supporting UAS services must have an assigned CAA-level UAV ID.

q_50150.question: In what scenario may the PEGC UE re-use an existing PDU session for a PINE communication request?
q_50150.ground_truth: The PEGC UE may re-use an existing PDU session for a PINE communication request if the evaluation of the URSP rules provided to the PEGC UE by the network allows it.

q_50151.question: What should the UE do if the "no network slices available" cause value is received in the DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message?
q_50151.ground_truth: The UE should set the 5GS update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED and enter state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE or 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH. The UE should also reset the registration attempt counter.

q_50152.question: In what scenarios does the LI for conferencing services apply?
q_50152.ground_truth: The LI for conferencing services applies when a target initiates a multi-party conferencing session, when a target joins a "meet-me" conferenceing session, or when a "meet me" conferencing session is established with conferencing URI itself being the target.

q_50153.question: Which message is sent by the gNB-CU-CP to request the gNB-CU-UP to modify MBS session resources for a broadcast MBS session in the 9.2.5.1.4 message?

q_50154.question: What action does the floor control interface towards the MCPTT client in the IWF floor control server take when an association between the IWF floor control server and a floor participant in the MCPTT client is created during an originating MCPTT call?
q_50154.ground_truth: The state machine shall return to the Start-Stop state; similarly, when the call is released.

q_50155.question: What kind of control data is channel-coded independently when control data are transmitted in the PUSCH?
q_50155.ground_truth: HARQ-ACK, rank indication, CRI, and channel quality information are channel-coded independently when control data are transmitted in the PUSCH.

q_50156.question: What is the origin of the 3GPP 3DOF coordinate system used to define the sphere coordinates for identifying a location of a point in omnidirectional video and 3D audio?
q_50156.ground_truth: The origin of the 3GPP 3DOF coordinate system is usually the same as the center point of a device or rig used for audio or video acquisition, and the position of the user's head in the 3D space where the audio or video are rendered.

q_50157.question: What data type is used for the "User-Info-ID" in the "ProSeUserEntryType" complex type?

q_50158.question: What is the expected action of RRC-inactive UE if the UE receives the group paging with the paging cause indicating that the paging is for MBS session activation for MBS session they are receiving and allowed to be received in RRC-inactive state?
q_50158.ground_truth: Those UE may remain in RRC-INACTIVE state and do not perform RRC connection resumption.

q_50159.question: What is the SCell activation delay defined in FR2 for the SCell activation when the activated SCell is unknown?
q_50159.ground_truth: The SCell activation delay in FR2 for the SCell activation when the activated SCell is unknown is defined in clause 8.3.2.

q_50160.question: When is the SCell activation delay equal to 3ms + max(TFirstATRS + 2ms, Tuncertainty) for a known FR2 SCell using semi-persistent CSI-RS for CQI reporting?
q_50160.ground_truth: The SCell activation delay is equal to 3ms + max(TFirstATRS + 2ms, Tuncertainty) when the target SCell belongs to FR2 and semi-persistent CSI-RS is used for CSI reporting.

q_50161.question: What is the power headroom reporting range?
q_50161.ground_truth: The power headroom reporting range is from -23...+40 dB.

q_50162.question: What is the maximum duration of the MBMS-Session-Duration AVP in seconds?
q_50162.ground_truth: The maximum allowed value for the MBMS-Session-Duration AVP is 86400 seconds (24 hours).

q_50163.question: How does an AMF send an NRPPa PDU to an NG-RAN node over the NG interface?
q_50163.ground_truth: The AMF forwards the NRPPa PDU to the identified NG-RAN node in an NGAP Downlink Non UE Associated NRPPa Transport message and includes a Routing ID identifying the LMF.

q_50164.question: What steps should the UPF follow to re-establish a PFCP session if the initial SMF is non-responsive?
q_50164.ground_truth: The UPF shall firstly use the IP addresses included in those Alternative SMF IP Address IE(s) with the PPE flag set to "1" (if available) to contact an alternative PFCP entity. If not available, the UPF may use the IP addresses included in Alternative SMF IP Address IE(s) without the PPE flag set to "1". If still unsuccessful, the UPF uses the SMF set FQDN in the CP Node ID to discover alternative SMFs within the SMF Set.

q_50165.question: What is the requirement when the source NF instance and/or the DCCF need to signal their own client credentials assertion towards the NF Service Producer in 3GPP networks?
q_50165.ground_truth: The 3gpp-Sbi-Client-Credentials and 3gpp-Sbi-Source-NF-Client-Credentials headers should be used to convey the client credentials assertion for the DCCF and source NF instance, respectively.

q_50166.question: What protocol is used for protecting WLCP signaling in TWAN?
q_50166.ground_truth: DTLS with pre-shared key as defined in RFC 6347 is used to protect WLCP signaling between the UE and TWAG in TWAN.

q_50167.question: Over which RLM-RS resource is the downlink radio link quality estimated in SSB based radio link monitoring?
q_50167.ground_truth: The downlink radio link quality is estimated on each RLM-RS resource, which can be all SSBs, or all CSI-RSs, or a mix of SSBs and CSI-RSs.

q_50168.question: What is the objective of the solution for migration during an ongoing group communication?
q_50168.ground_truth: The objective of the solution for migration during an ongoing group communication is to enable an MC service user to migrate to another MC system during an ongoing group communication and continue the group communication in the other MC system.

q_50169.question: When meeting the RSTD measurement requirements in TS 37.355, what conditions should be satisfied while performing a PRS-RSRP measurement?
q_50169.ground_truth: The PRS-RSRP measurement shall meet the RSTD measurement requirements defined in clause 9.9A.2, without exceeding the UE reported capability N for a positioning frequency layer's time span.

q_50170.question: What is the function of the Destination Index field in the SL-BSR formats?
q_50170.ground_truth: The Destination Index field identifies the destination associated with the MAC CE, with a length of 5 bits.

q_50171.question: What must the <TMGI> element associate with?
q_50171.ground_truth: The <TMGI> element must associate the received announcement with the received application/sdp MIME body.

q_50172.question: What is the condition for counting a fail for the event "Activation" instead of a success?
q_50172.ground_truth: A fail is counted for the event "Activation" if the conditions for a success in step 6 are not met, leading to a fail and moving to step 7.

q_50173.question: What is the role of the A-DCCF in the ADAE internal architecture?
q_50173.ground_truth: The A-DCCF is a functionality within the ADAE internal architecture that coordinates the collection and distribution of data requested by the consumer (ADAE server). It may also perform data processing/abstraction and data preparation based on the VAL server requirements.

q_50174.question: What architecture is used for wireless relaying in NG-RAN?
q_50174.ground_truth: Integrated access and backhaul (IAB) architecture is used for wireless relaying in NG-RAN, which enables wireless relaying via NR.

q_50175.question: What are the Release Independent Requirements specified in clause 6 of the present document?
q_50175.ground_truth: The Release Independent Requirements include downlink interruption requirements, mandating no DL interruption requirements, and time mask requirements for inter-band CA and EN-DC with tx switching features. These requirements are specified in clauses 6.1 (Inter-band CA) and 6.2 (Inter-band EN-DC).

q_50176.question: What is the main purpose of the SN Status Transfer message in the context of SN Release?
q_50176.ground_truth: The SN Status Transfer message is used to transfer the status of the SN when bearers using RLC AM are released.

q_50177.question: In which conditions should the UE initiate the detach procedure by sending a DETACH REQUEST message to the network after receiving ATTACH ACCEPT message combined with the ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message?
q_50177.ground_truth: If EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection is not supported by the UE or the MME, and the ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message combined with the ATTACH ACCEPT is not accepted by the UE due to failure in the UE ESM sublayer, then the UE shall initiate the detach procedure by sending a DETACH REQUEST message to the network.

q_50178.question: What should an MTSI client in terminal receiving media do when it detects that the throughput is reduced by more than 10% or 25%?
q_50178.ground_truth: When detecting that the throughput is reduced by more than 10%, the MTSI client in terminal receiving media should send a TMMBR message requesting a bitrate that is at least 10% lower than the currently allowed bitrate. If the throughput is reduced by more than 25%, it shall send a TMMBR message requesting a bitrate that is at least 25% lower than the currently allowed bitrate. TMMBR messages for down-switch are urgent feedback messages and shall be sent as soon as possible, using AVPF early mode or immediate mode.

q_50179.question: What does error code 132 indicate in the context of CS, GPRS, and UMTS-related errors?
q_50179.ground_truth: Error code 132 indicates that a service option is not supported for CS, GPRS, and UMTS.

q_50180.question: What is the definition of CACLR in a sub-block gap for a RIB operating in non-contiguous spectrum?
q_50180.ground_truth: The CACLR in a sub-block gap for a RIB operating in non-contiguous spectrum is the ratio of the sum of the filtered mean power centered on the assigned channel frequencies for the two carriers adjacent to each side of the sub-block gap and the filtered mean power centered on a frequency channel adjacent to one of the respective sub-block edges.

q_50181.question: What type of USSR leader & politician presided over the country from 1922-1953?

q_50182.question: In the 8.69 parameter, when the current serving cell is not a UTRA FDD cell, what is set to 255?

q_50183.question: How many NR carriers and cells are used in the test described in section 7.6.15.3.4.1?
q_50183.ground_truth: Three NR carriers and three cells are used in the test described in section 7.6.15.3.4.1.

q_50184.question: What is the length of the SI (Segmentation Info) field in AMD PDU?
q_50184.ground_truth: The length of the SI field in AMD PDU is 2 bits.

q_50185.question: What is the difference between V2X and A2X in the context of 3GPP specifications?
q_50185.ground_truth: In the context of 3GPP specifications, V2X is replaced by A2X to denote air-to-everything communication services.

q_50186.question: What does the cSEPP send to RH1's proxy to indicate the destination of the TLS connection?
q_50186.ground_truth: The cSEPP sends the "CONNECT" command to RH1's proxy indicating the destination to be pSEPP.

q_50187.question: When does the I-CSCF need to perform an HSS query for an initial request?
q_50187.ground_truth: When the initial request contains a single Route header field pointing to itself.

q_50188.question: What are the requirements for per-FR measurement gap capable UE when the serving cell is in E-UTRA and measurement objects are only in FR2?
q_50188.ground_truth: UE can perform measurements without gap, and meets the requirements for FR2 measurement objects based on effective MGRP = 20 ms.

q_50189.question: What message is sent by the BM-SC if a session creation fails?

q_50190.question: What is the mobile station's behavior in state MM IDLE and service state LIMITED SERVICE when it comes to responding to paging?
q_50190.ground_truth: The mobile station may respond to paging (with IMSI).

q_50191.question: What entity initiates the procedure to authorize service specific parameter provisioning requests?
q_50191.ground_truth: The AF (Access and Mobility Function) initiates the procedure.

q_50192.question: What action does the MME take if a UE sends Paging Restriction Information in the Tracking Area Update Request message?
q_50192.ground_truth: The MME may accept or reject the Paging Restriction Information based on operator policy, and inform the UE about the acceptance/rejection of the requested Paging Restriction Information in the TAU Accept message.

q_50193.question: What information is required when exiting a specific area location criterion?
q_50193.ground_truth: When exiting a specific area, the type of area being exited must be specified (polygon or elliptical arc area), as well as the coordinates of the center, longitude, latitude, radius, offset angle, included angle, speed, and minimum and maximum speed, if applicable.

q_50194.question: What is the EPS update status set to when the UE receives a PLMN not allowed message?
q_50194.ground_truth: The EPS update status is set to EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED.

q_50195.question: What should the gNB-CU-UP do if it cannot perform user plane integrity protection or ciphering for a PDU session?
q_50195.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-UP should reject the setup of the PDU Session Resources with an appropriate cause value.

q_50196.question: What should the ATCF set as the c-line when generating the ATGW information for CS to PS SRVCC in the SDP?
q_50196.ground_truth: The ATCF should set c-line to the unspecified address (0.0.0.0) if using IPv4, or to a domain name within the ".invalid" DNS top-level domain if using IPv6.

q_50197.question: What is a Grouped IE in PFCP messages and what is its purpose?
q_50197.ground_truth: A Grouped IE is an IE that contains other IEs, with its own length value in TLV encoding that includes the added length of all embedded IEs. It allows for multiple IEs to be grouped together to serve a specific purpose in a message.

q_50198.question: In the context of UAV operation, what is the role of a USS in authorizing C2 communication?
q_50198.ground_truth: A USS provides authorization for C2 communication by establishing a PDU session or PDN connection for C2 communication, and performing a UUAA procedure during this process.

q_50199.question: What action does the gNB take when the LMF wants to abort an ongoing UL-AoA measurement?
q_50199.ground_truth: The gNB sends a Measurement Abort message to the gNB to abort the UL-AoA measurement.

q_50200.question: When UE is performing a CS fallback procedure for mobile originating calls for the purpose of emergency, what should it indicate to the MME?
q_50200.ground_truth: It should indicate that this CS fallback request is for emergency purpose.

q_50201.question: What does SMF (Session Management Function) do with the PCC (Policy and Charging Control) rules sent by the PCF?
q_50201.ground_truth: SMF generates Alternative QoS Profiles for both the UL and DL QoS flows and sends them to RAN together with the RT latency requirement and the QoS correlation indication.

q_50202.question: What is the allowed overall delay measured for the UE to identify a new CGI of an E-UTRA cell within Tbasic_identify_CGI_LC-UE, intra?
q_50202.ground_truth: The allowed overall delay measured is 207 ms, with a tolerance of 210 ms.

q_50203.question: What procedure does UE follow when receiving a failure report for unsuccessful MO SMS transfer from SMS-IWMSC?
q_50203.ground_truth: UE receives a Failure report from SMSF with the error cause code, indicating the error that occurred during MO SMS transfer.

q_50204.question: Which SCS (Subcarrier Spacing) can be supported with a channel bandwidth of 5MHz?
q_50204.ground_truth: Only 15kHz SCS can be supported with a channel bandwidth of 5MHz.

q_50205.question: What action does the 5G-AN take when it receives a notification of unavailable GUAMI(s) from the AMF?
q_50205.ground_truth: The 5G-AN releases all NGAP UE TNLA binding of the UEs related to the indicated unavailable GUAMI(s), unless the notification from the AMF includes an indicator that the AMF will rebind or release the NGAP UE TNLA binding on a per UE-basis.

q_50206.question: What does the mobile station do when it receives a MODIFY message but doesn't support the in-call modification procedure?
q_50206.ground_truth: The mobile station treats the message as unknown and reacts as specified in subclause 8.4.

q_50207.question: What does the app-service of "x-3gpp-pgw" identify with app-protocols "x-gn" or "x-gp"?
q_50207.ground_truth: The app-service of "x-3gpp-pgw" with app-protocols "x-gn" or "x-gp" identifies the co-located GGSN function on a PGW.

q_50208.question: What should the AF expect from the NEF upon a successful retrieval of AF specific UE ID information?
q_50208.ground_truth: After a successful retrieval of AF specific UE ID information, the NEF responds with an HTTP "200 OK" status code and the response body includes the UeIdResp data structure.

q_50209.question: What does the UE ProSe application layer determine in step 3 of the groupcast mode of 5G ProSe Direct Communication in the groupcast mode communication transmission?
