q_50929.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function should perform a key download procedure for the CSK using a SIP MESSAGE request as specified in 3GPP TS 33.180 clause 9.2.1, if confidentiality protection is enabled and it has received a CSK for service authorization.

q_50930.question: What is the role of the User Plane Function (UPF) in 5G networks?
q_50930.ground_truth: The UPF is responsible for processing and forwarding data packets in the user plane, enforcing policy rules, handling QoS, and managing traffic usage reporting in 5G networks.

q_50931.question: What HTTP method should be used to perform a partial update of the DNS context in the EASDF?
q_50931.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer should use the HTTP PATCH method to perform a partial update of the DNS context in the EASDF.

q_50932.question: What information is included in the request body when updating or revoking the authorization for monitoring for a UE?
q_50932.ground_truth: Discovery Type, TTL, and other relevant information, such as application ID, banned RPAUID, and banned PDUID in the request body when using the MonitorUpdate service operation.

q_50933.question: What does the "required-EEC-services" parameter contain in the unsolicited result code +CE5EECSRV?
q_50933.ground_truth: The "required-EEC-services" parameter contains either or both: the list of EAS characteristics and the list of EAS dynamic information filter, or the list of EAS information including the identifier and endpoint address of the EAS for ACR operation.

q_50934.question: When does UE use old TCI-states before the BWP switch until a new MAC CE updating the required TCI-state information for PDCCH and PDSCH is received after the BWP switch?
q_50934.ground_truth: When UE does not have the required TCI-state information to receive PDCCH and PDSCH in the new BWP.

q_50935.question: What is the purpose of the "AC-security-credential" parameter in the unsolicited result code +CE5EECSRV?
q_50935.ground_truth: The "AC-security-credential" parameter indicates the security credential associated with the application client profile to be used for checking validity of the request by the edge enabling layer in the MT.

q_50936.question: What is the requirement specified in section 4.9 for a UE supporting ca-IdleModeMeasurements?
q_50936.ground_truth: A UE supporting ca-IdleModeMeasurements shall perform the idle mode measurement on the inter-frequency CA candidate frequencies/cells indicated by higher layers and meet the requirement specified in this section. Additionally, the UE shall fulfill the requirements defined for a UE supporting ca-IdleModeMeasurements as defined in this section. The requirements apply provided that the UE is provided with a valid timer T331 by dedicated RRC signaling and T331 is running.

q_50937.question: In what cases can the LMF authenticate the PRU?
q_50937.ground_truth: The LMF can authenticate the PRU using one of three methods: by verifying the SUPI of the PRU, by verifying the authentication information provided by the PRU, or by sending an authentication challenge to the PRU and receiving an authentication response.

q_50938.question: What should a UE do upon receiving the RRCRelease message, if deprioritisationReq is included and the UE supports RRC connection release with deprioritisation?
q_50938.ground_truth: The UE should start or restart timer T325 with the timer value set to the deprioritisationTimer signalled and store the deprioritisationReq until T325 expiry.

q_50939.question: What are the two radio resource allocation modes for sidelink communication in LTE?
q_50939.ground_truth: The two radio resource allocation modes for sidelink communication in LTE are scheduled resource allocation and UE autonomous resource selection.

q_50940.question: What should the participating MCPTT function do when unable to find a binding between the public user identity and an MCPTT ID?
q_50940.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT function shall reject the SIP INVITE request with a SIP 404 (Not Found) response and with the warning text set to "141 user unknown to the participating function" in a Warning header field.

q_50941.question: What action may the PCF take when it receives an "mcVideoId" attribute related to a particular MCVideo session in the "ascReqData" attribute?
q_50941.ground_truth: The PCF may take specific actions on the corresponding PDU session to ensure that the MCVideo session is prioritized.

q_50942.question: What is the purpose of storing the PFD(s) in the UDR (User Data Repository) when the "pull" mode is used and the Allowed Delay is shorter than the caching time value?
q_50942.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure that the PFD(s) are stored and available for use, even if the Allowed Delay is shorter than the caching time value.

q_50943.question: In what state would a UE be, if it is not in the "forbidden PLMNs for GPRS service" and has successfully performed a tracking area update?
q_50943.ground_truth: UE would be in the EMM-REGISTERED state after successfully performing a tracking area update in a non-forbidden PLMN.

q_50944.question: What represents a unique packet filter identifier within the PDN connection in the TFT packet filter identifier and the EPS Bearer identifier?

q_50945.question: What is required of the service consumer when the NSCE Server sends a notification on Network Slice Lifecycle Management event(s)?
q_50945.ground_truth: When the NSCE Server sends a notification on Network Slice Lifecycle Management event(s), the service consumer needs to respond with an HTTP "204 No Content" status code to acknowledge the reception of the notification.

q_50946.question: What are the types of reporting that can be requested as part of the Location Reporting procedure between AMF and NG-RAN?
q_50946.ground_truth: The types of reporting that can be requested as part of the Location Reporting procedure between AMF and NG-RAN include single standalone reports, continuous reports of cell changes, reports when the UE moves out of or into an Area of Interest, and reports for Area of Interest based on UE presence.

q_50947.question: What is the range of high accuracy uncertainty for an ellipsoid point in meters?
q_50947.ground_truth: The high accuracy uncertainty for an ellipsoid point ranges from 0 to 46.49129 meters, with a resolution of less than 5 millimeters.

q_50948.question: What is the duration of T2 in the V2X Synchronization Reference Selection/Reselection test?
q_50948.ground_truth: The duration of T2 is 8.8 seconds.

q_50949.question: What is the reporting range of RSRP for the TDD inter-frequency absolute RSRP accuracy test?
q_50949.ground_truth: The reporting range of RSRP is from -140 dBm to -44 dBm with 1 dB resolution.

q_50950.question: When does the PDN GW provide 3GPP PS Data Off status to the PCRF?
q_50950.ground_truth: If the PDN GW receives 3GPP PS Data Off status in the PCO from the UE and supports 3GPP PS Data Off, it shall provide the 3GPP PS Data Off status to the PCRF.

q_50951.question: What timers can be running when the IWF floor control server is in the 'D: Floor Taken' state?
q_50951.ground_truth: Timer T11 (End of RTP dual) and Timer T12 (Stop talking dual) can be running when the IWF floor control server is in the 'D: Floor Taken' state.

q_50952.question: What is the significance of the EAR mechanism in privileged signalling within the MC System?
q_50952.ground_truth: The EAR mechanism is crucial for authenticating privileged signalling within the MC System, allowing the target's MCX Server and MC client to assess whether the request is authorized.

q_50953.question: How does the SMF control the Priority Code Point of the VLAN Headers within the "access side layer 2 header" in the "Combo Ethernet + IP" solution?
q_50953.ground_truth: The QER is updated for the SMF to be able to control the Priority Code Point of the VLAN Headers within the "access side layer 2 header" in the "Combo Ethernet + IP" solution.

q_50954.question: What is the purpose of the redundant transport mechanism in SEALDD service policy?
q_50954.ground_truth: The redundant transport mechanism is used by SEALDD to improve data transmission quality. It is activated based on measurement reports to meet connection reliability requirements specified in the SEALDD service policy.

q_50955.question: What is the purpose of the "Niwmsc" service-based interface in the 5G System architecture?
q_50955.ground_truth: The "Niwmsc" service-based interface is used by the SMSF to access services offered by the SMS-IWMSC, which facilitates the transfer of Mobile Originated short messages.

q_50956.question: What is the requirement for the success rate of the test in section 7.2.10.5 of the document?
q_50956.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the total number of successful tests shall be more than 90% of the cases with a confidence level of 95%.

q_50957.question: What is the initial condition for NR ACLR for Tx Diversity test?
q_50957.ground_truth: The initial conditions are the same as those in 6.2G.2.4.1.

q_50958.question: What state does the MCVideo client enter upon expiration of timer TFG1 in the "S7: Waiting for call announcement after call release" state?
q_50958.ground_truth: The MCVideo client enters the "S1: start-stop" state upon expiration of timer TFG1 in the "S7: Waiting for call announcement after call release" state.

q_50959.question: How many unique grid points are there in the TRP grid with a step size of at most 5o, for measurement grids with a range length exceeding 35cm and no path loss correction?

q_50960.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP-Session-S-NSSAI attribute in 3GPP Vendor-Specific attribute?
q_50960.ground_truth: The 3GPP-Session-S-NSSAI attribute is used to indicate the S-NSSAI that is associated with the PDU Session.

q_50961.question: What message does the SGW send to the PDN GW to indicate the inclusion of LTE-M RAT type in the Modify Bearer Request?
q_50961.ground_truth: If the UE is using the LTE-M RAT type and the PDN GW expects LTE-M RAT type reporting, the MME includes the LTE-M RAT type reporting to PGW flag in the Modify Bearer Request. The SGW shall include the LTE-M RAT type in the Modify Bearer Request message to the PGW.

q_50962.question: What must the AMF do if it cannot assign EBI(s) for a PDU Session due to Network Slice-Specific Authentication and Authorization?
q_50962.ground_truth: The AMF should indicate EBI assignment failure.

q_50963.question: What should a participating MCPTT function do upon receiving provisional responses to the SIP INVITE request?
q_50963.ground_truth: Upon receiving provisional responses to the SIP INVITE request, the participating MCPTT function should discard them without forwarding them.

q_50964.question: What is the identifier for the measurement of the number of successful intra-NRCell SSB Beam switch executions?

q_50965.question: What are some of the elements that are typically included in Warning Notifications provided through PWS?
q_50965.ground_truth: Warning Notifications typically include an event description, information about the area affected, recommended actions to take, an expiration time with time zone, and the sending agency.

q_50966.question: What information is included in the FeasibilityCheckAndReservationJob IOC?
q_50966.ground_truth: The FeasibilityCheckAndReservationJob IOC includes attributes inherited from the Top IOC (defined in TS 28.622) and attributes such as "resourceReservation" to represent the consumer's requirements for resource reservation, "requestedReservationExpiration" to represent the validity period of the resource reservation, and "feasibilityTimeWindow" to represent the consumer's request for checking whether the network slicing related requirements can be satisfied at a specified time window.

q_50967.question: What is the test purpose described in section 6.3A.1.2.1?
q_50967.ground_truth: The test purpose is to verify the UE's ability to transmit with a broadband output power below the value specified in the test requirement when the power on each component carrier is set to a minimum value, but for 3UL CA instead of 2UL CA.

q_50968.question: What is the transmitter OFF power spectral density minimum requirement for a base station (BS) capable of multi-band operation during the transmitter OFF period?
q_50968.ground_truth: The transmitter OFF power spectral density minimum requirement for a base station (BS) capable of multi-band operation during the transmitter OFF period is less than -85dBm/MHz.

q_50969.question: What additional requirement must be met by the coefficients within Range 1 and Range 2, aside from the ripple requirement?
q_50969.ground_truth: The relative difference between the maximum coefficient in Range 1 and the minimum coefficient in Range 2 must not be larger than 6 dB, and the relative difference between the maximum coefficient in Range 2 and the minimum coefficient in Range 1 must not be larger than 10 dB.

q_50970.question: What should a UE connected to 5GC do with a PDU that failed its integrity check?
q_50970.ground_truth: The concerned PDU should be discarded by the receiving PDCP entity.

q_50971.question: When should the UE not include an "a=3ge2ae:requested" attribute in any of its SDP offers?
q_50971.ground_truth: If the P-CSCF did not indicate support for end-to-access-edge media security using DTLS-SRTP, SDES, TLS, or certificate fingerprints during registration, the UE should not include an "a=3ge2ae:requested" attribute in any of its SDP offers.

q_50972.question: What is the procedure for acknowledging the reception of a notification message from the SCEF in the SCS/AS using Websocket?
q_50972.ground_truth: The SCS/AS sends a separate Websocket data frame with 0x2 (Binary) opcode in a specific format to acknowledge the reception of a notification message.

q_50973.question: What is the parameter that should be at least 90% in the test requirements?
q_50973.ground_truth: The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90%.

q_50974.question: What is the capability that the PWS-UE does not support regarding Warning Notifications?
q_50974.ground_truth: The PWS-UE does not support any capabilities to forward, reply to, or copy and paste the content of Warning Notifications.

q_50975.question: What should the tester verify regarding software package integrity validation?
q_50975.ground_truth: The tester should verify that the network product validates software package integrity during installation/upgrade stages via cryptographic means, such as digital signatures, and that tampered software is not executed or installed if the integrity check fails.

q_50976.question: What is the range for reporting the SS-RSRQ in 4.7.2.0.1?
q_50976.ground_truth: The reporting range of SS-RSRQ is defined from -43 dB to 20 dB with 0.5 dB resolution.

q_50977.question: What is one action that the NG-RAN can take based on the analytics provided by the AMF?
q_50977.ground_truth: The NG-RAN can release the UE if it detects an unexpected UE location.

q_50978.question: When the core specification value is tightened by a stringent value (TT<0), what is the probability of a borderline good UE being judged as FAIL compared to the probability of a borderline bad UE being judged as PASS?
q_50978.ground_truth: The probability of a borderline good UE being judged as FAIL is greater than the probability of a borderline bad UE being judged as PASS.

q_50979.question: What needs to be added to the existing NRCellRelation IOC in the MOCN networking sharing scenario?
q_50979.ground_truth: The NRCellCU instance of the target cell and source cell need to be changed to an NROperatorCU instance.

q_50980.question: What is the role of the AMF after it receives the EAP result for each S-NSSAI from the NSSAA procedure?
q_50980.ground_truth: The AMF stores the EAP result for each S-NSSAI for which the NSSAA procedure in steps 1-17 was executed.

q_50981.question: What shall the UE set in the Reconnection to the network due to RAN timing synchronization status change (RANtiming) bit in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message if the UE supports the reconnection to the network due to RAN timing synchronization status change?
q_50981.ground_truth: The UE shall set the Reconnection to the network due to RAN timing synchronization status change (RANtiming) bit to "Reconnection to the network due to RAN timing synchronization status change supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message if the UE supports the reconnection to the network due to RAN timing synchronization status change.

q_50982.question: How is the group message delivery provided in Solution #12?
q_50982.ground_truth: The group message delivery is provided by the NEF-based group message delivery via MBS method, which utilizes the Object Delivery Method in MBSTF specified in TS~26.502 for reliable delivery of group messages via MBS.

q_50983.question: What are the two types of activation defined in the trace high-level architecture section?
q_50983.ground_truth: The two types of activation defined in the trace high-level architecture section are management based activation and signalling based activation.

q_50984.question: In what cases does the AUSF provide services to SNPNs (Stand-alone Non-Public Networks)?
q_50984.ground_truth: The AUSF provides services to SNPNs in scenarios such as roaming, UE access using credentials from a Credentials Holder, UE onboarding, and the authentication of 5G ProSe Remote UEs and 5G ProSe End UEs.

q_50985.question: What is the minimum interfering signal gap size for which the additional BC3 blocking test requirement applies inside the sub-block gap or inter RF bandwidth gap for RIBs?
q_50985.ground_truth: The minimum interfering signal gap size is 3 MHz for the sub-block gap and 4.8 MHz for the inter RF bandwidth gap.

q_50986.question: What action does the transmission participant take upon receiving RTP media packets in the 'O: silence' state?
q_50986.ground_truth: The transmission participant requests the MCVideo client to start rendering received RTP media packets, stops Timer T230 (Inactivity), starts Timer T203 (End of RTP media), and may provide a transmission taken notification to the MCVideo user.

q_50987.question: If frequency hopping is not enabled, what value is assigned to the frequency hopping flag for TBs?
q_50987.ground_truth: The frequency hopping flag for TBs is set to 0.

q_50988.question: What is the role of the UE's certificates in this solution?
q_50988.ground_truth: The UE's certificates are used for implicit mutual authentication between UEs and the core network during certification provisioning, and they also play a role in encrypting unicast signaling messages and processing system information messages from a legitimate gNB.

q_50989.question: What services is the MS not allowed to request when camped on a cell of a forbidden LA or TA for regional provision of service?
q_50989.ground_truth: The MS is not allowed to initiate establishment of a CM connection, except for an emergency call, or request GPRS services, except for an emergency bearer service or access to RLOS. The MS is also not allowed to request 5GS services, except emergency services, when camped on a cell of a forbidden TA for regional provision of 5GS services.

q_50990.question: What is the purpose of a cross-domain MDA in the context of service assurance?
q_50990.ground_truth: A cross-domain MDA facilitates service assurance by adopting output from one or multiple single-domain MDAs.

q_50991.question: What security procedure is used for PC5 link security establishment between the source UE and the UE-to-UE Relay over User Plane?
q_50991.ground_truth: The PC5 link security establishment procedure over User Plane for 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay involves the source UE performing the discovery procedure and discovering the target UE via UE-to-UE Relay. The source UE then sends a Direct Communication Request (DCR) to the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay, which contains the PRUK ID or a SUCI if the source UE does not have a valid PRUK, Relay Service Code (RSC), and K~NRP~ freshness parameter 1.

q_50992.question: What is the relative power tolerance for local area IAB-MT?
q_50992.ground_truth: The relative power tolerance is the ability of the transmitter to set its output power in a target sub-frame relative to the power of the most recently transmitted reference sub-frame if the transmission gap between these sub-frames is less than or equal to 20 ms.

q_50993.question: What is the difference between downlink radio link monitoring in non-DRX mode and DRX mode?
q_50993.ground_truth: In non-DRX mode, the UE (user equipment) assesses the radio link quality every radio frame, while in DRX mode, the UE assesses the radio link quality at least once every DRX period.

q_50994.question: What is the purpose of the tests specified in 8.2.3.3.1 and 8.2.3.3.2 for TDD FDD CA with TDD PCell and a varying number of DL CCs?
q_50994.ground_truth: The purpose of these tests is to verify the closed loop rank-two performance with wideband and frequency selective precoding.

q_50995.question: What should the CC AS do if a user has activated CFU after the user A has activated CC on the user B?
q_50995.ground_truth: The CC AS shall revoke the CC request by sending a NOTIFY request to the originating AS and send a "CC cancelled" notification to user A.

q_50996.question: What is the unit of the hysteresis parameter (Hys) and the threshold parameter for entering condition 1 (Thresh1) in 3GPP TS 36.331, clause 5.5.4.6?
q_50996.ground_truth: The Hys and Thresh1 are expressed in dB.

q_50997.question: Which MCData client(s) are identified when timer TDC2 (file availability timer) expires?
q_50997.ground_truth: When timer TDC2 (file availability timer) expires, the controlling MCData function identifies the MCData client(s) that received the one-to-one or group standalone file distribution using HTTP for the associated Conversation ID and Message ID but have not yet downloaded the file.

q_50998.question: What is one way for the 5GS network to align the burst arrive time and the next transmission opportunity on the respective direction of the traffic to reduce potential buffering delay?
q_50998.ground_truth: The 5GS and the AF can receive time information from the same master clock, and both pro-active and reactive feedback modes are supported for aligning the burst arrive time and the next transmission opportunity in both UL and DL directions.

q_50999.question: What should be the RTCP bandwidth if the media bandwidth is 100 kbps?
q_50999.ground_truth: RFC 3550 recommends that the RTCP bandwidth default be 5% of the media bandwidth. Therefore, if the media bandwidth is 100 kbps, the RTCP bandwidth should be 5 kbps.

q_51000.question: What is the role of the LMF in the 5G location service?
q_51000.ground_truth: The LMF is responsible for determining the UE's location using procedures specified in clause 6.11.1 or 6.11.2 if the AMF is aware that the UE is served by a MBSR.

q_51001.question: What is the resolution step for differential reporting RSTD measurement for the first DL RSTD measurement?
q_51001.ground_truth: The resolution step for differential reporting RSTD measurement for the first DL RSTD measurement is 2kTc.

q_51002.question: What happens to timer T3346 if the MS enters state GMM-DEREGISTERED while the timer is running and SIM/USIM remains the same?
q_51002.ground_truth: The timer T3346 continues running until it expires or it is stopped, even if the MS enters state GMM-DEREGISTERED and the SIM/USIM remains the same.

q_51003.question: In what mode is the UE required to stay in the current serving cell and apply the normal cell reselection process before starting the mobility and periodic registration update procedure when timer T3447 expires or is stopped?

q_51004.question: What is the primary procedure involved in split rendering for an XR Device to join an XR application?
q_51004.ground_truth: An XR Device collects XR pose (or a predicted XR pose), XR Pose is sent to XR Server, The XR Server uses the pose to pre-render the XR viewport, XR Viewport is encoded with 2D media encoders, The compressed media is sent to XR device along with XR pose that it was rendered for, The XR device decompresses video and uses the XR pose provided with the video frame and the actual XR pose for an improved prediction using and to correct the local pose, e.g. using ATW.

q_51005.question: What is the difference between "BS type 1-C" and "BS type 1-H" base stations?
q_51005.ground_truth: "BS type 1-C" base stations have requirements set only at individual antenna connectors, while "BS type 1-H" base stations have requirements set at individual TAB connectors and OTA requirements at the RIB.

q_51006.question: What is a difference between non-gap-assisted and gap-assisted measurements?
q_51006.ground_truth: In non-gap-assisted scenarios, the UE can carry out measurements without measurement gaps. In gap-assisted scenarios, the UE cannot be assumed to be able to carry out measurements without measurement gaps.

q_51007.question: What is the reporting accuracy of the channel quality indicator under frequency non-selective conditions, as specified in section 9.9.1?
q_51007.ground_truth: The reporting accuracy of the channel quality indicator under frequency non-selective conditions is determined by the reporting variance and the BLER performance using the transport format indicated by the reported CQI median.

q_51008.question: What is the role of the AEF in generating an OAuth access token?
q_51008.ground_truth: The AEF generates and sends an OAuth access token, which includes UE ID and CCF ID along with other claims.

q_51009.question: What is the role of SEALDD enabler layer in the data traffic transition of E2E redundant transmission for outbound data delivery?
q_51009.ground_truth: In the data traffic transition of E2E redundant transmission, the SEALDD enabler layer duplicates the application packets and maps them to two SEALDD traffic with the same Flow ID. Then, it sends the SEALDD traffic to different destination addresses or ports and different source addresses or ports based on the SEALDD traffic descriptors of the SEALDD flow.

q_51010.question: What is the maximum number of values that the ENUMERATED keyword can take in a choice definition?
q_51010.ground_truth: It can take a maximum of 256 values, given that the number of values is represented as an enumerated type in a machine-readable JSON format.

q_51011.question: What procedure is used to allow MCPTT clients to listen to an activated MBMS bearer?
q_51011.ground_truth: The announcement of the TMGI and the definition of an association between the identity of the general purpose MBMS subchannel and the TMGI together with the parameters differentiating this general purpose MBMS subchannel in this MBMS bearer.

q_51012.question: What will the UE do if the message has been successfully integrity checked by the NAS and the UE receives the REGISTRATION REJECT message via satellite NG-RAN, with the Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming" IE in the REGISTRATION REJECT message and if the TAI(s) included in the IE is not part of the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming"?
q_51012.ground_truth: The UE shall store the TAI(s) belonging to the serving PLMN or equivalent PLMN(s) and ignore the TAI(s) which do not belong to the serving PLMN or equivalent PLMN(s) included in the IE, if not already stored, into the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming".

q_51013.question: What is the purpose of the UAS Application Enabler (UAE) layer as specified in 3GPP TS 23.255?
q_51013.ground_truth: The UAS Application Enabler (UAE) layer provides application layer support for UAS services, including UAS application communication between the UE and the UAE server, and among UEs over the U1-AE interface using unicast Uu.

q_51014.question: What is the condition for a neighbor cell to be considered an intra-frequency cell during RRC re-establishment procedures for a RedCap UE?
q_51014.ground_truth: The center frequency and subcarrier spacing of the reference SSB of the serving cell should be the same as the center frequency and subcarrier spacing of the reference SSB of the neighbor cell.

q_51015.question: What should UE do when direct communication path switching from Uu communication path to PC5 communication path is required?
q_51015.ground_truth: UE discovers UE2 in proximity and sends a direct communication request to initiate the unicast layer-2 link establishment incl. PC5 QoS parameters. UE2 accepts the request and confirms QoS Info and optionally PC5 QoS rule(s).

q_51016.question: What is required to ensure that TCP can be decommissioned for SEPP interactions in a PLMN?
q_51016.ground_truth: All other SEPPs in the PLMN should support QUIC, and there should be no IPX on path.

q_51017.question: What message does the UE transmit when it initiates a registration attempt without a valid 5G NAS security context?
q_51017.ground_truth: The UE sends the REGISTRATION REQUEST message without integrity protection and encryption.

q_51018.question: What does the "CC" abbreviation refer to, in the context of the measurements?
q_51018.ground_truth: "CC" stands for Counter, and it refers to the sub-counters that are incremented to keep track of the number of events in a specific range or type.

q_51019.question: What should the MS do if it is in state GMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED and the GPRS attach procedure is aborted and the GPRS detach procedure is performed?
q_51019.ground_truth: This occurs when the MS is in state GMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED and a mobile originated detach is required.

q_51020.question: What is the role of the Multiple Bearer Requested parameter?
q_51020.ground_truth: The Multiple Bearer Requested parameter indicates whether multiple bearers are requested for a relocation.

q_51021.question: What charging-related parameter applies to both 3GPP and Non-3GPP accesses?
q_51021.ground_truth: The other charging-related parameters, excluding the Charging key, apply to both 3GPP and Non-3GPP accesses.

q_51022.question: What message is sent by the eNodeB to the MME if there is no further data expected and no S1-U bearers are established?
q_51022.ground_truth: The MME sends a S1 UE Context Release Command immediately after the S1-AP message including the Downlink data encapsulated in NAS PDU.

q_51023.question: What state exists on the network side when the network has received an answer but the network has not yet awarded the call for a mobile terminating call?
q_51023.ground_truth: The state that exists on the network side when the network has received an answer but the network has not yet awarded the call for a mobile terminating call is "connect request" (N8).

q_51024.question: What is the implication of a UE operating in a cross-border scenario with access provided by a non-terrestrial network operator?
q_51024.ground_truth: The regulations may not be compatible in a cross-border scenario. The UE and the network must comply with the frequency and operational regulations of both territories. If there are access restrictions, data retention and privacy laws, mandatory encryption of traffic or other incompatible regulations in the cross-border region, there must be a negotiated and harmonized set of regulations between the territories.

q_51025.question: In the context of the test case for eCall Only mode with eCall failing in CS domain and EPS supporting IMS voice over PS session, what is the expected outcome when the UE is requested to make an automatic eCall and the CS domain and EUTRA network are not available?
q_51025.ground_truth: The UE does not establish a normal emergency call, eCall over IMS, or eCall over CS domain.

q_51026.question: In the scenario where the UE is provided with pdsch-TimeDomainAllocationListForMultiPDSCH and pdsch-TimeDomainAllocationListForMultiPDSCH for two HARQ-ACK sub-codebooks determination, when does the UE count a serving cell as two times in the pseudo-code operation?
q_51026.ground_truth: The UE counts a serving cell as two times in the pseudo-code operation if, for an active DL BWP of a serving cell, the UE is not provided with coresetPoolIndex or is provided with coresetPoolIndex with value 0 for one or more first CORESETs and is provided with coresetPoolIndex with value 1 for one or more second CORESETs, and is provided ackNackFeedbackMode = joint.

q_51027.question: How may the SMF indicate PSA UPF selection in the ePCO?
q_51027.ground_truth: The SMF includes an "edge-anchored" indication, which tells the UE that the PDU Session has a local PSA UPF and a "5GC-preference" or "3GPP-access-preference" indication, which communicates the network's preference to keep traffic in the 5GC or on the 3GPP access.

q_51028.question: What is the reaction from the SMF when interworking triggers for 5GS and EPC are disabled?
q_51028.ground_truth: The SMF will record usage for both source and target network accesses into a common count and consume the same quota in both networks. The source access specific triggers will no longer be applicable, and the target access specific triggers will apply instead.

q_51029.question: What is the requirement for the overall delays measured in the test, expressed as the sum of measurement reporting delay and TTI insertion uncertainty?
q_51029.ground_truth: The overall delays measured shall be less than a total of 1002 ms in this test case (note: this gives a total of 1000 ms for measurement reporting delay plus 2 ms for TTI insertion uncertainty).

q_51030.question: In the FT key hierarchy, what is the relationship between PMK-R0 and PMK-R1 in Step 4 of the FT procedure?
q_51030.ground_truth: PMK-R0 is provided to the new AP as PMK-R1 during the FT procedure.

q_51031.question: What should a non-controlling MCPTT function do for each group identified in the group-for-regroup element?
q_51031.ground_truth: It shall create a separate list of MCPTT IDs for users belonging to and affiliated with the identified group who are served by the same terminating participating MCPTT function.

q_51032.question: What is the definition of a "telepresence system" as given in the document?
q_51032.ground_truth: A telepresence system is defined as a set of functions, devices and network elements which are able to capture, deliver, manage and render multiple high quality interactive audio and video signals in a telepresence conference.

q_51033.question: What does the "prefer 3GPP RPLMN" indication specify in Home Network Preferences?
q_51033.ground_truth: The "prefer 3GPP RPLMN" indication specifies how a roaming UE selects a PLMN in order to perform 3GPP-based authentication over WLAN access. The UE attempts to select the RPLMN or a service provider included in EVSP of the RPLMN when this indication is set.

q_51034.question: What is a network slice in the context of 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_51034.ground_truth: A network slice is a logical network that provides specific network capabilities and network characteristics, supporting various service properties for network slice customers.

q_51035.question: During what type of coverage period should the UE include the amount of data transmitted if the UE transmitted data while outside of E-UTRAN coverage?
q_51035.ground_truth: During the out of E-UTRAN coverage period.

q_51036.question: What media type should be used by the Content Provider for the bodies of HTTP requests and successful HTTP responses in the xMB API?
q_51036.ground_truth: The MIME media type that should be used within the related Content-Type header field is "application/json", as defined in IETF RFC 8259.

q_51037.question: What should the UE do if the AUTHENTICATION REJECT message is received and the SNPN-specific attempt counter for the SNPN sending the message has reached its maximum value?
q_51037.ground_truth: The UE should set the update status to "5U3.ROAMING NOT ALLOWED", delete certain stored information, store the SNPN identity in the "permanently forbidden SNPNs" list for onboarding services, enter the state "5GMM-DEREGISTERED", and perform an SNPN selection or an SNPN selection for onboarding services.

q_51038.question: What happens if the UE receives two consecutive AUTHENTICATION FAILURE messages with 5GMM cause #21 "synch failure" from the network?
q_51038.ground_truth: Upon receipt of two consecutive AUTHENTICATION FAILURE messages with 5GMM cause #21 "synch failure" from the network, the UE may terminate the 5G AKA based primary authentication and key agreement procedure by sending an AUTHENTICATION REJECT message.

q_51039.question: What action should the S-CSCF take if a P-Preferred-Service header field is present and there is a match between the request and the ICSI value?
q_51039.ground_truth: The S-CSCF should include a P-Asserted-Service header field in the request containing the ICSI value and remove the P-Preferred-Service header field, as specified in 4Cb.

q_51040.question: What should the SC UE do if it receives a specific SM NOTIFICATION message while engaged in a session in early dialog state?
q_51040.ground_truth: The SC UE should send a SIP UPDATE request containing specific parameters.

q_51041.question: What should the NWDAF containing AnLF do when it determines that the ML Model used has low accuracy in procedure 6.2.13.2?
q_51041.ground_truth: The NWDAF containing AnLF determines that it needs to check further the data sources and compute data source rating. It initiates rating of a data source by requesting and receiving supplementary data from different data sources.

q_51042.question: In the F1AP UE messages, what does the Criticality status IGNORE mean?
q_51042.ground_truth: The IGNORE criticality status means that the receiving end should ignore the message if it doesn't understand it.  Even if the end understands the message, the system still treats it as ignorable.

q_51043.question: What is the maximum size of the MAC SDU or variable-sized MAC control element that can be indicated by the F field in the MAC header's L field?
q_51043.ground_truth: If the F field is set to 0, the size of the MAC SDU or variable-sized MAC control element is less than 128 bytes.

q_51044.question: What should a UE do when the highest ranked cell is a cell of a PLMN in the downloaded equivalent PLMN list during the Attach procedure?
q_51044.ground_truth: The UE should reselect to the equivalent PLMN cell.

q_51045.question: In which subclause is the behavior of the UE with access identity 1 described for MPS when operating in SNPN access operation mode?
q_51045.ground_truth: The behavior of the UE with access identity 1 is described in subclause~4.5.2A for MPS when operating in SNPN access operation mode.

q_51046.question: What is the required behavior of the UE when transmitting preamble for UL-SCH resource application during time duration T5 in this test scenario?
q_51046.ground_truth: The UE shall transmit preamble for UL-SCH resource application, followed by MAC-CE on the assigned uplink resources containing a beam associated with the candidate beam set q1 during time duration T5.

q_51047.question: What should the IBCF do when it receives a message with a body part for a UE from an S-CSCF, and the body part is not optional and its Content-Type is the 3GPP IM CN subsystem XML body?
q_51047.ground_truth: The IBCF shall transparently forward the message with the body part and the header field(s) that describe the body part.

q_51048.question: What should a participating MCVideo function do when it decides to apply FEC to protect a given MBMS subchannel?
q_51048.ground_truth: It should declare the usage of FEC within the MBMS bearer announcement, perform FEC encoding if it does the encoding, and instruct the media distribution function to send the RTP media packet over the MBMS subchannel if it is not already sent.

q_51049.question: What methods may be used to send RADIUS Access-Request when IPv4 address and/or IPv6 prefix is (re-)allocated or de-allocated?
q_51049.ground_truth: The SMF (or SMF+PGW-C for EPC interworking) may use the already established authentication session to inform the DN-AAA server by sending RADIUS Access-Request with the latest list of IPv4 address and/or IPv6 prefix(es) when IPv4 address and/or IPv6 prefix is (re-)allocated or de-allocated.

q_51050.question: What are the initial conditions for the test described in 8.16.6.4?
q_51050.ground_truth: The test initial conditions include a normal test environment, specific frequencies to be tested, a 20 MHz channel bandwidth, and specific power levels for the cells used in the test.

q_51051.question: When does the initiating UE initiate the PC5 unicast link identifier update procedure?
q_51051.ground_truth: The initiating UE shall initiate the procedure if it receives a request from upper layers to change the application layer ID and there is an existing PC5 unicast link associated with this application layer ID, or if the privacy timer of the initiating UE's layer-2 ID expires for an existing PC5 unicast link.

q_51052.question: What is the purpose of Group Call Area Identities (Group Call Area Id) in VGCS and VBS?
q_51052.ground_truth: Group Call Area Identities identify service areas within VGCS and VBS, grouping cells together for the services.

q_51053.question: What are some candidate parameters to consider when defining a test decoder?
q_51053.ground_truth: The candidate parameters include training data set for TE decoder training, model structure, performance parameters for the TE decoder, maximum FLOPs allowed for the test decoder, maximum number/size of model parameters, compression ratio of decoder, quantization level, and other parameters that are not precluded.

q_51054.question: What information does the NF service consumer receive upon a successful request to retrieve the location information for the PS domain?
q_51054.ground_truth: Upon a successful request, the NF service consumer receives a "200 OK" response containing the location information for the requested domain (PS) and the requested nodes or all nodes (if no requested nodes were present in the request).

q_51055.question: When should the mobile station attach the user connection during a mobile terminating call?
q_51055.ground_truth: For speech calls, the mobile station shall attach the user connection at latest when sending the CONNECT message, and for data calls, the mobile station shall attach the user connection when receiving the CONNECT ACKNOWLEDGE message from the network.

q_51056.question: What does Solution #13 aim to address in relation to providing access to localized services?
q_51056.ground_truth: Solution #13 aims to address key issues related to enabling NPN as hosting network for providing access to localized services, enabling UE to discover, select and access NPN as hosting network and receive localized services, and enabling access to localized services via a specific hosting network. Additionally, it investigates the communication requirements between a network operator deploying a hosting network and a localized services provider, handles UE access to home network services and localized services via hosting network, and mitigates user plane and control plane overload when a high number of UEs return to home network from temporary hosting network.

q_51057.question: What is the purpose of the test specified in clause 8.2.4.3?
q_51057.ground_truth: The purpose of the test specified in clause 8.2.4.3 is to verify the receiver's ability to achieve throughput under high speed train conditions for a given SNR.

q_51058.question: In what circumstances shall the User Equipment (UE) request for PDU Session Type "IPv4v6" when using 5G network?
q_51058.ground_truth: When the IP version capability of the UE is unknown in the UE (as in the case when the MT and TE are separated and the capability of the TE is not known in the MT), the UE shall request for PDU Session Type "IPv4v6".

q_51059.question: What are the two cells deployed in this test?
q_51059.ground_truth: One FR1 NR PCell (Cell 1) and an E-UTRA neighbour cell (Cell 2).

q_51060.question: What is the applicability of the requirements in subclause 8.16 for UE category M2?
q_51060.ground_truth: The applicability of the requirements in subclause 8.16 for UE category M2 is defined in Section 3.6.

q_51061.question: What is the purpose of the getPose function in the XRFrame?
q_51061.ground_truth: The getPose function returns the relationship between two XRSpaces, which are passed in as input to that function. It is used to determine the position and orientation of objects in the scene.

q_51062.question: How should the hash algorithms and signature algorithms be chosen to generate signatures and proof-of-possession?
q_51062.ground_truth: The hash algorithms used before generating signatures in the protection field of PKIMessage and for proof-of-possession should be the same as the hash algorithms specified in TS 33.310 subclause 6.1.1 for certificate signatures. The signature algorithms should be the same as that used in the related certificate profile.

q_51063.question: What is the effect of the Nchf interface on the Time Sensitive Communications charging?
q_51063.ground_truth: The Nchf interface is used for interaction between CHF (UE CCS) and CHF (TSN CCS) for Time Sensitive Communications charging.

q_51064.question: How many HARQ-ACK bits does the UE need to generate for TBs that belong to the same TB bundle?
q_51064.ground_truth: The UE needs to generate M HARQ-ACK bits by performing a logical AND operation of HARQ-ACKs across all TBs in each TB bundle, where b = 1, ..., M.

q_51065.question: What is the definition of NACK to ACK detection probability in 8.1.3.7.2.1.1?
q_51065.ground_truth: NACK to ACK detection probability is the probability that an ACK bit is falsely detected when an NACK bit was sent on the particular bit position, where the NACK to ACK detection probability is defined as the number of NACK bits decoded as ACK bits at the receiver divided by the total number of NACK bits transmitted.

q_51066.question: When is the OTA transmitter OFF power minimum requirement applicable for a multi-band RIB?
q_51066.ground_truth: The requirement is only applicable during the transmitter OFF period in all supported operating bands when the AAS BS is operating in a multi-band RIB that supports transmission in multiple bands.

q_51067.question: Which solutions address Layer-2 UE-to-Network Relay for 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Remote UE's emergency service?

q_51068.question: What is the security protection of the REGISTRATION REJECT message?
q_51068.ground_truth: The REGISTRATION REJECT message is sent without integrity protection before the secure exchange of NAS messages has been established and within SECURITY PROTECTED 5GS NAS MESSAGE message after the secure exchange of NAS messages has been established.

q_51069.question: What should an MS perform in a new RA if it has eITRI information but no GUTI or P-TMSI?
q_51069.ground_truth: The MS shall perform an initial UE identity request procedure.

q_51070.question: What is the measurement reporting delay that assumes the measurement report is not delayed by other RRC signalling on the DCCH, but excludes a delay uncertainty resulted when inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH?
q_51070.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay assumes the measurement report is not delayed by other RRC signalling on the DCCH, but excludes a delay uncertainty resulted when inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH.

q_51071.question: What message does the floor control interface send to an MCPTT client when no MCPTT client has permission to send media but an MCPTT call exists?
q_51071.ground_truth: The floor control interface sends a Floor Idle message to the MCPTT client, which includes a Message Sequence Number field, a Floor Indicator field (in case of a group call), and sends a Floor Idle message to the MCPTT client.

q_51072.question: In the context of AI/ML-based load balancing model, what is the purpose of collecting output data in OAM (Operation, Administration, and Maintenance)?
q_51072.ground_truth: The output data collected in OAM is used as the supervised learning label data for the AI/ML-based load balancing model training. This data includes selection of the target cell for load balancing and the predicted UE(s) selected to be handed over to the target NG-RAN node.

q_51073.question: What are the two SAN classes currently defined for SAN type 1-O and SAN type 1-H?
q_51073.ground_truth: The two SAN classes currently defined for SAN type 1-O and SAN type 1-H are LEO and GEO.

q_51074.question: In what mode is the UE when it needs to request a RRC connection to transmit an initial NAS message?
q_51074.ground_truth: The UE is in EMM-IDLE mode.

q_51075.question: What information does the EEC include in the ACR request message for solution #21?
q_51075.ground_truth: The EEC includes its expectation or knowledge of the time that it expects the prediction to happen within the ACR request at latest.

q_51076.question: What is the function of the Pre-Shared Key (PSK) in QUIC?
q_51076.ground_truth: The Pre-Shared Key (PSK) in QUIC is used to establish a secure connection between the client and server before the handshake takes place.

q_51077.question: What is a Top-Heavy UE in the context of dispersion analytics?
q_51077.ground_truth: A Top-Heavy UE is a UE with a dispersion percentile rating higher than a threshold value (e.g. 0.9) at a location or a slice, determined based on either Data volume dispersion or Transactions dispersion.

q_51078.question: What is the definition of end-to-end latency as given in the document?
q_51078.ground_truth: End-to-end latency is the time that takes to transfer a given piece of information from a source to a destination, measured at the communication interface, from the moment it is transmitted by the source to the moment it is successfully received at the destination.

q_51079.question: Which positioning method in NR Enhanced Cell ID (NR E-CID) uses additional UE measurements and/or gNB measurements to improve the UE location estimate?

q_51080.question: What is the purpose of the channel coding block in the process described?
q_51080.ground_truth: The channel coding block is responsible for encoding the information bits delivered to it using Polar coding.

q_51081.question: In the <stat> parameter of the +CREG command, what does the value 2 represent?
q_51081.ground_truth: The value 2 in the <stat> parameter of the +CREG command represents that the MT (mobile terminal) is registered in the home network.

q_51082.question: What is the procedure for an LCS PeriodicTriggered Invoke operation in 5G Networks?
q_51082.ground_truth: The LMF sends a REGISTER message to the UE containing the supplementary services LCS PeriodicTriggered Invoke component. The UE returns a RELEASE COMPLETE message to the LMF containing an LCS PeriodicTriggered return result if it can support the periodic or triggered location.

q_51083.question: What is included in the SIP INVITE request for off-network private call establishment?
q_51083.ground_truth: The MCPTT ID of the invited MCPTT user or the functional alias to be called

q_51084.question: What is the purpose of the Selected PLMN IE and Selected NID IE in an S-NODE MODIFICATION REQUEST message?
q_51084.ground_truth: If the S-NODE MODIFICATION REQUEST message contains the Selected PLMN IE and Selected NID IE, the S-NG-RAN node may use the combination of these identities for its own usage or for RRM purposes.

q_51085.question: What should a UE in CM-CONNECTED state in 5GC do if the NG-RAN performs RRC Connection Release with Redirection to E-UTRAN based on certain criteria?
q_51085.ground_truth: The UE should release the RRC Connection with the NG-RAN and establish a new RRC Connection with the E-UTRAN.

q_51086.question: What is the purpose of a PC5 QoS profile in the context of PC5 QoS parameters mapping rules in the 3GPP specification?
q_51086.ground_truth: The PC5 QoS profile contains parameters such as the PC5 QoS, PC5 flow bit rates, PC5 link aggregated bit rate, priority level, averaging window, maximum data burst volume, etc.

q_51087.question: What action should a UE take if the T3442 value received in a SERVICE REJECT message is not zero?
q_51087.ground_truth: The UE should start timer T3442 and enter the state EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE.

q_51088.question: What is the role of the GMLC in Ranging/SL Positioning service exposure to a SL Positioning Client UE through the 5GC network via the control plane?
q_51088.ground_truth: The GMLC is responsible for performing the SL-MO-LR procedure and returning the Ranging/SL Positioning result to the SL Positioning Client UE via the AMF1 and the SL Positioning Server UE.

q_51089.question: What is an example of a nesting level in an RRC message?
q_51089.ground_truth: A field that is one nesting level up compared to the erroneous field is called the 'parent' field.

q_51090.question: What is the minimum requirement for time alignment in UTRA FDD for single RAT UTRA operation?
q_51090.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for time alignment in UTRA FDD for single RAT UTRA operation is the same as those in 3GPP TS 25.104, subclause 6.8.4.1.

q_51091.question: What is the purpose of the "Current time" parameter in the 3GPP 5G DDNMF?
q_51091.ground_truth: The "Current time" parameter is used to carry the current UTC-based time at the 5G DDNMF.

q_51092.question: What is the benefit of the solution for service continuity planning?
q_51092.ground_truth: The benefit of the solution for service continuity planning is that it allows the EAS to not have to monitor the UE mobility and determine when to send the ACR status update message to the EES. This is achieved by having the EES notify the EEC of the completion of ACR once the UE has moved to the predicted or expected location. This reduces the workload on the EAS and allows for more efficient use of resources.

q_51093.question: Who is responsible for sending the Hosting Network Selection and Access Information to the local service providers?
q_51093.ground_truth: The hosting network server sends the Hosting Network Selection and Access Information to the local service providers, who then provide services to UEs accessing the hosting network.

q_51094.question: What is the value of P for FR2 when the CSI-RS for BFD measurement is not overlapped with measurement gap and candidate beam detection RS is fully overlapped with SMTC occasion?
q_51094.ground_truth: The value of P is the Psharing factor, which is equal to 3 by default.

q_51095.question: What is the responsibility of the source gNB/ng-eNB during the RRCResume procedure?
q_51095.ground_truth: The source gNB/ng-eNB responds to the Retrieve UE Context Request message by retrieving the stored UE context and verifying the ResumeMAC-I/shortResumeMAC-I using its own K_RRCint. If validation is successful, the source gNB/ng-eNB calculates a new K_NG-RAN* and responds with the UE context to the target gNB/ng-eNB.

q_51096.question: What actions should the AMF take when aware that some signalling or data is pending in the network for an unreachable UE?
q_51096.ground_truth: If the AMF is aware that some signalling or data is pending in the network for an UE that is known as being unreachable for a long duration, the AMF maintains the N2 connection for at least the Extended Connected Time. The Extended Connected Time value is provided in a NG-AP message to the RAN to keep the UE in RRC_CONNECTED state regardless of inactivity.

q_51097.question: What should the AS do when it determines that the AS shall divert a communication and if the last history-info entry contains no hi-targeted-to-uri element for the served user?
q_51097.ground_truth: The AS shall set the following information in the retargeted initial INVITE request: the diverting parties address, the diverted-to party address, and diversion information.

q_51098.question: What are the required attributes for the "User-ID" element in the "UserProfileType" complex type?
q_51098.ground_truth: The required attribute for the "User-ID" element is "xs:anyURI".

q_51099.question: In what situation would a UE ignore the RAN rules and perform WLAN access selection based on RAN rules?
q_51099.ground_truth: When the UE has a valid IARP rule from HPLMN and cannot simultaneously route IP traffic to both 3GPP access and WLAN access.

q_51100.question: What should the AS performing the CDIV service do when communications diversion occurs in terms of sending the original INVITE message?
q_51100.ground_truth: The AS should always send the original INVITE message without eCNAM information when communications diversion occurs.

q_51101.question: If the sent SIP REFER request was a request for an MCPTT emergency private call and the MCPTT emergency private call state is set to "MEPC 3: emergency-pc-granted", what should the MCPTT client do?
q_51101.ground_truth: The MCPTT client shall set the MCPTT emergency private priority state of the call to "MEPP 2: in-progress" if it was not already set. Then, it shall set the MCPTT emergency private call state to "MEPC 3: emergency-pc-granted".

q_51102.question: What is the definition of RequestCapabilities?
q_51102.ground_truth: RequestCapabilities is a sequence that contains critical extensions and a set of SLPP information elements, including CommonIEsRequestCapabilities, CommonSL-PRS-MethodsIEsRequestCapabilities, etc.

q_51103.question: What is the leaving condition for an event in the context of TS 36.331, clause 5.5.4.3?
q_51103.ground_truth: The leaving condition for an event, as specified in TS 36.331, clause 5.5.4.3, is considered satisfied when condition A2-2 is fulfilled.

q_51104.question: What optional parameter in the IANA registration template specifies the character set for the application/vnd.3gpp.uae-info+xml MIME body?

q_51105.question: What shall the UE do upon the reception of a PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for UE-to-UE relay discovery response?
q_51105.ground_truth: Upon the reception of a PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for UE-to-UE relay discovery response, the UE shall obtain a UTC time, generate a UTC-based counter, use it to recover the UTC-based counter, unscramble and decrypt the PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message and direct discovery set IE, and verify the MIC field.

q_51106.question: What is the requirement for the first CSI report for SCell in subframe (m+8) and (m+10)?
q_51106.ground_truth: The first CSI report for SCell should be received by the SS in subframe (m+8) or (m+10) if the subframe (m+8) was subject to interruption.

q_51107.question: What percentage of successful tests is required for the test to pass?
q_51107.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the total number of successful tests shall be more than 90% of the cases with a confidence level of 95%.

q_51108.question: What is the role of the Target-Dialog header field in the SIP INVITE request during the handling of CS to PS SRVCC?
q_51108.ground_truth: The Target-Dialog header field identifies the dialog being transferred in the SIP INVITE request due to ATU-STI for CS to PS SRVCC. If the determined dialog being transferred identifies a dialog in the transferable dialog set, the procedures in subclause 12.3.10.2.2 will be continued. If the Target-Dialog header field identifies a non-existing dialog, it is out of scope for the current document.

q_51109.question: What event triggers the access network to send a notification to the SMF regarding the guaranteed FGBR (Guaranteed Flow Bit Rate) of a QoS Flow?
q_51109.ground_truth: When the GFBR can no longer (or can again) be guaranteed for a QoS Flow during its lifetime.

q_51110.question: What are the MIME types used in 5G ProSe direct discovery messages?
q_51110.ground_truth: The MIME type used to carry information related to the 5G ProSe discovery operation is application/vnd.3gpp-prose-pc3a+xml.

q_51111.question: What is the time period used for identifying a new CGI of an E-UTRA cell when no DRX is used, as defined in the requirement?
q_51111.ground_truth: The time period used for identifying a new CGI of an E-UTRA cell when no DRX is used is 150 ms.

q_51112.question: What is the shortest periodicity of all RS resources in set when DRX is not used?
q_51112.ground_truth: The shortest periodicity of all RS resources in set for the accessed cell, corresponding to either the shortest periodicity of the SSB in the set or CSI-RS resource in the set.

q_51113.question: What do filtering conditions include in the context of consumer request?
q_51113.ground_truth: Filtering conditions include the conditions in a consumer request which indicate the report triggering criteria. The recipient NWDAF needs to identify where filtering conditions can be applied and include any of them that relate to the subsequent request towards MDAF or MDA MnS producer.

q_51114.question: What is a single-band connector in the context of NR repeaters?
q_51114.ground_truth: A single-band connector in NR repeaters supports operation in a single operating band only or in multiple operating bands but does not meet the conditions for a multi-band connector.

q_51115.question: What is the result returned by the SMF if the validation of some of the received PCC rules is unsuccessful?
q_51115.ground_truth: The SMF replies to the PCF with an HTTP "200 OK" status code and includes one or more RuleReport data structure(s) to report the failure for the affected PCC rule(s) within the PartialSuccessReport data structure.

q_51116.question: What is the purpose of the "9.2.3.102 Alternative QoS Parameters Set List" IE?
q_51116.ground_truth: This IE contains alternative sets of QoS parameters which the NG-RAN node can indicate to be fulfilled when notification control is enabled and it cannot fulfil the requested list of QoS parameters.

q_51117.question: What information should the gNB-DU include in the BROADCAST CONTEXT MODIFICATION RESPONSE message if some MRBs fail to be established?
q_51117.ground_truth: If some MRBs fail to be established, the gNB-DU should include them in the Broadcast MRB Failed To Be Setup List IE of the BROADCAST CONTEXT MODIFICATION RESPONSE message.

q_51118.question: What is the test procedure for section 16.7.5.1.4.2, and where can it be found?
q_51118.ground_truth: The test procedure for section 16.7.5.1.4.2 is the same as the one given in clause 6.7.5.1.4.2.

q_51119.question: What is the purpose of defining the interruption window on PCell or any activated SCell in MCG for NR standalone mode, or on PSCell or any activated SCell in SCG for EN-DC mode?
q_51119.ground_truth: The purpose of defining the interruption window is to allow for RF retuning during PUCCH SCell activation and to ensure that there is no interruption of PRACH on PUCCH SCell and other active SCells in the same band.

q_51120.question: What is the purpose of the UE Radio Capability Info Indication procedure?
q_51120.ground_truth: The UE Radio Capability Info Indication procedure allows the NG-RAN node to provide UE radio capability-related information to the AMF for use in managing UE radio capability information in the network.

q_51121.question: What should the MCVideo client do upon receipt of a SIP BYE request for an ambient viewing call?
q_51121.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should comply with certain procedures, clear the cache of stored data, and provide no indication or an indication to the MCVideo user that the ambient viewing call has been terminated based on the cached ambient viewing client role.

q_51122.question: How does V-SMF set charging information indications in solution #2.15?
q_51122.ground_truth: V-SMF sets an indication for two groups of information elements, one for V-CHF and the other for H-CHF in solution #2.15.

q_51123.question: How should the mobile station respond to an IDENTITY REQUEST message with the TIN (Type of Identity) indicating "GUTI" and the MS holds a valid GUTI?
q_51123.ground_truth: The MS should map the GUTI into a P-TMSI, P-TMSI signature, and RAI as specified in 3GPP~TS~23.003, and indicate the P-TMSI in the Mobile identity IE, the RAI in the Routing area identification IE, and the P-TMSI signature in the P-TMSI signature IE.

q_51124.question: What is the purpose of the out-of-band band blocking test specified in 7.6.3.1?
q_51124.ground_truth: The purpose of the out-of-band band blocking test specified in 7.6.3.1 is to ensure that a UE's average throughput meets or exceeds a specified requirement in the presence of an unwanted CW interfering signal falling outside a frequency range up to 3 times the channel bandwidth above or below the UE receive band.

q_51125.question: What is the impact of the "non-HSUPA" and "non-HSDPA" terms in the context of bearer operations?
q_51125.ground_truth: These terms indicate R99 to pre-HSDPA or pre-HSUPA UMTS bearers.

q_51126.question: What is the total maximum time for overall delays measured in the asynchronous inter frequency cells test in CA mode?
q_51126.ground_truth: The total maximum time for overall delays measured in the asynchronous inter frequency cells test in CA mode is 4802 ms.

q_51127.question: What may the H-RE-NWDAF do with the input data based on HPLMN operator policies and what may it do with the data after that?
q_51127.ground_truth: The H-RE-NWDAF may restrict the exposed input data based on HPLMN operator policies (that may depend on the VPLMN) and may store them for auditing.

q_51128.question: What should the UE do if there are more than one PDN connection and the IP-CAN bearer is not being used by other applications, but it is the bearer for the SIP signalling that is not used for other non-IMS applications?
q_51128.ground_truth: The UE should release the IP-CAN bearer that is used only for SIP signalling and not used for other non-IMS applications.

q_51129.question: What attribute indicates the satellite backhaul category in a notification for satellite backhaul category change?

q_51130.question: What is the default response from UDR on success when deleting a data?
q_51130.ground_truth: On success, the UDR responds with "204 No Content" with an empty response body.

q_51131.question: What is the handover delay test requirement in the case of E-UTRA FDD for UE category 1bis?
q_51131.ground_truth: The handover delay Dhandover shall be less than a total of 50 ms in this test case, which is the sum of maximum RRC procedure delay plus Tinterrupt.

q_51132.question: What should the ME do if the USSD control string is longer than the maximum length that can be transmitted to the UICC?
q_51132.ground_truth: If the USSD control string is longer than the maximum length that can be transmitted to the UICC, then the ME shall truncate the URI to the maximum length that can be transmitted to the UICC and send a URI truncated tag to indicate the truncation.

q_51133.question: What is the task of the ADMF in the context of LI functions in CSP networks?
q_51133.ground_truth: The ADMF receives warrant information from Law Enforcement Agencies and provisions the LI functions present in various Network Functions (NFs) of the serving CSP network. Upon provisioning, the LI is activated in those NFs, and the LI functions within those NFs monitor the target's communications and provide the LI as required by the warrant.

q_51134.question: Which HTTP status code does the MSGin5G Server return to the AS to indicate the successful deregistration of the AS information?
q_51134.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Server returns the HTTP "200 OK" status code to the AS.

q_51135.question: Which interface introduces additional IE for the transfer of UE Policy Container between SMF+PGW-C and SM-PCF?

q_51136.question: What is the formula used to calculate the timer value Ty?

q_51137.question: What do the constructions "must" and "must not" mean in the context of the present document?
q_51137.ground_truth: Their use is avoided insofar as possible, and they are not used in a normative context except in a direct citation from an external, referenced, non-3GPP document, or so as to maintain continuity of style when extending or modifying the provisions of such a referenced document.

q_51138.question: What media feature tags should the MCVideo client include in the Contact header field of a SIP REGISTER request for service authorization?
q_51138.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should include the g.3gpp.mcvideo media feature tag and the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag containing the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcvideo" in the Contact header field of a SIP REGISTER request for service authorization.

q_51139.question: What is the purpose of using a two-way delay budget (TWDB) as a new 5QI parameter in 6.29 solution?
q_51139.ground_truth: The purpose of using a two-way delay budget (TWDB) as a new 5QI parameter in 6.29 solution is to increase the DL PDB by an amount equal to the unused UL PDB (and vice versa) to allow an immersive experience for interactive services by keeping the round-trip delay (RTD) below a certain threshold (RTDmax).

q_51140.question: What action does the MS take if the stored LAI is different from the one of the current serving cell and the routing area updating attempt counter is smaller than 5?
q_51140.ground_truth: The MS deletes any LAI, TMSI, ciphering key sequence number, and set the update status to U2 NOT UPDATED. The MM state remains MM LOCATION UPDATING PENDING.

q_51141.question: What action should the MCData client take when it receives a Map Group To Bearer message and participates in a group session identified by the message?
q_51141.ground_truth: If the status "listening" is not already reported, the MCData client should report that it is listening to the MBMS bearer.

q_51142.question: In what state is the UE when the power levels and other changing parameters are applied?
q_51142.ground_truth: The UE is in state Registered, Idle mode (state 2) on Cell 1 (serving cell) when the power levels and other changing parameters are applied.

q_51143.question: What shall the MME do upon receiving a GTPv2 Delete PDN Connection Set Response message with a specific cause value after sending a Delete PDN Connection Set Request message?
q_51143.ground_truth: The MME is not required to perform any further recovery actions towards SGW and PGW peers for PDN connections in the connection set identified by the MME FQ-CSID(s), regardless of the cause value in the response.

q_51144.question: What should the 5G-RG acting on behalf of the AUN3 device do upon receiving an EAP-failure message in the AUTHENTICATION REJECT message?
q_51144.ground_truth: If the EAP-failure message is received in an AUTHENTICATION REJECT message, the 5G-RG acting on behalf of the AUN3 device should start timer T3247 with a random value uniformly drawn from the range between 30 minutes and 60 minutes, if the timer is not running.

q_51145.question: Which family name is used for measurements related to Data Radio Bearer in the 3GPP technical specification?

q_51146.question: What does the ProSe-Request-Renewal CDR record type correspond to in ProSe-Reason-For-Cancellation AVP?

q_51147.question: What should the MCVideo client do if an imminent peril indication is included in an incoming SIP INVITE request?
q_51147.ground_truth: If the SIP INVITE request contains an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body with the <mcvideo-Params> element containing the <imminentperil-ind> element set to a value of "true", the MCVideo client should display an indication of an MCVideo imminent peril group call to the user and set the MCVideo imminent peril group state to "MVIG 2: in-progress".

q_51148.question: What happens when the PCF provisions a PCC rule with Traffic Parameter Information or PDU Set Control Information?
q_51148.ground_truth: A new QoS Flow is created and the PCC rule is bound to it, with no other PCC rule bound to this QoS Flow.

q_51149.question: What is the solution considered for consistent support of low-latency streaming formats on M4d?
q_51149.ground_truth: The solution considered for consistent support of low-latency streaming formats on M4d is DASH-IF Low-Latency Extensions, which includes UTC Time Sync for accurate latency measurements and new DASH and CMAF functionalities that support enhanced TV services such as pre-selection.

q_51150.question: What is the purpose of the "appReqNotification" structure described in section 6.3.6.2.4?
q_51150.ground_truth: The "appReqNotification" structure defines an application requirement notification message that can be used to notify the result of the network resource adaptation corresponding to the V2X application requirement.

q_51151.question: For which type of IOI is no string prefix used in setting the value of the "orig-ioi" and "term-ioi" header field parameters?
q_51151.ground_truth: If an IOI is a type 2 IOI, no string prefix is used.

q_51152.question: What should the request URI be set to when initiating a SIP INVITE request for a session with speech and video media components to be transferred?
q_51152.ground_truth: The request URI should be set to the STN-SR for the session with speech and video media components to be transferred.

q_51153.question: What is the condition for counting a success for the event "Re-select Cell 2" during the test scenario?
q_51153.ground_truth: The UE must respond on Cell 2 during time duration T1 within 58.9 seconds from the beginning of time period T1.

q_51154.question: What is a PRA ID?
q_51154.ground_truth: The PRA ID is used to identify a Presence Reporting Area (PRA) and can be used for reporting changes of UE presence in a PRA for policy control or charging decisions.

q_51155.question: In what scenario should the UE perform PLMN selection triggered by 5G ProSe direct discovery, as specified in 3GPP TS 23.122?
q_51155.ground_truth: The UE should perform PLMN selection triggered by 5G ProSe direct discovery if it is in 5GMM-IDLE mode and does not have an emergency PDU session.

q_51156.question: What are the two different mechanisms provided for overload control in IMS network elements?
q_51156.ground_truth: The two different mechanisms provided for overload control in IMS network elements are a mechanism based on next-hop monitoring of overload and a filter-based mechanism. The former is used for preventing overload of core network servers where overload is not due to calls to a specific application/destination while the latter is used when the source of overload is due to calls to a specific destination.

q_51157.question: How many types of Elementary Procedures (EPs) are there in X2AP and what are the differences between these two types?
q_51157.ground_truth: There are two types of EPs in X2AP: Class 1 and Class 2. Class 1 EPs include a response (success or failure) in a unit of interaction between two eNBs, while Class 2 EPs do not include a response.

q_51158.question: What determines the RFSP Index for radio resource management functionality in a 5G network?
q_51158.ground_truth: The RFSP Index for Allowed NSSAI and RFSP Index for Target NSSAI define the RFSP Index for radio resource management functionality.

q_51159.question: What is the primary purpose of the Post-conditions of the PC service in the Smart Grid?
q_51159.ground_truth: The Post-conditions of the PC service in the Smart Grid are to optimize the management of distribution grid power flows, prevent possible contingencies and overloading of grid components, improve efficient operation of the power grid, power quality, and grid reliability.

q_51160.question: What should the S-CSCF do if the request is not forwarded to an AS and the outgoing Request-URI is a SIP URI with a "user" SIP URI parameter equals "dialstring" and the domain name of the SIP URI belongs to the home network?
q_51160.ground_truth: The S-CSCF should either forward the request to any appropriate entity in the originator's home network or send an appropriate SIP response to the originator.

q_51161.question: What are the mechanisms for providing location in emergency calls in the IM CN subsystem?
q_51161.ground_truth: The mechanisms for providing location in emergency calls include the UE including a Geolocation header field, the UE including a P-Access-Network-Info header field, the P-CSCF including a P-Access-Network-Info header field, the LRF allocating a location reference, and the S-CSCF including a P-Access-Network-Info header field.

q_51162.question: What is the basic identify E-UTRA FDD UE cat 0 for intra for the minimum measurement period for intra frequency measurements for UE category 0 in the intra-frequency event triggered reporting test?
q_51162.ground_truth: The basic identify E-UTRA FDD UE cat 0 for intra is 1000 ms.

q_51163.question: What is the purpose of the NAS key set identifier information element and what type is it?
q_51163.ground_truth: The NAS key set identifier is allocated by the network and is used to indicate the key set identifier of the current EPS security context. It is a type 1 information element.

q_51164.question: What type is used to report information derived from the Geolocation-header of a SIP message?

q_51165.question: What is the primary function of the QUIC protocol in relation to HTTP/3?
q_51165.ground_truth: The QUIC protocol is used as the transport layer for HTTP/3 and provides functions such as connection and stream multiplexing, fast startup, loss recovery, and congestion control.

q_51166.question: What is the format of the LocationReportingFailureIndication S1AP-PROTOCOL-IES?
q_51166.ground_truth: It is a sequence of one or more ProtocolIEs, including id-MME-UE-S1AP-ID, id-eNB-UE-S1AP-ID, and id-Cause, each with a mandatory identifier, CRITICALITY, type, and presence specification.

q_51167.question: What should the P-CSCF do if it receives a request for an unknown method from the UE that does not relate to an existing dialog and there is a service route value list exists for the served user of the request?
q_51167.ground_truth: The P-CSCF shall select an I-CSCF and insert a Route header field with the URI of the I-CSCF as the topmost Route header field if the UE is performing the functions of an external attached network using static mode of operation, and preserve the order of the Service-Route header field with the list of URIs received in the request if not.

q_51168.question: When does a dedicated PC5 link need to be established for the dedicated RSC for emergency service?
q_51168.ground_truth: A dedicated PC5 link needs to be established for the dedicated RSC for emergency service when the PC5 link for emergency service is released if the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay is not involved in emergency service from any Remote UE.

q_51169.question: What happens if a PDU Session needs to be re-anchored to a distributed anchor point?
q_51169.ground_truth: If a PDU Session needs to be re-anchored to a distributed anchor point, the UE will trigger a DNS Query for an FQDN and the DNS Response from the query will determine the selected EAS. If there's a change in the PDU Session Anchor in SSC mode 2 or 3, the SMF will indicate to the EASDF to discard the DNS Response and the UE will restart the DNS Query.

q_51170.question: Who is responsible for rejecting additional emergency PDN Connection requests in 4.5.7.2.7?
q_51170.ground_truth: The ePDG/TWAG is responsible for rejecting any additional emergency PDN Connection requests in 4.5.7.2.7.
