q_51171.question: What message type should the SCS/AS use to delete the PFDs for an existing individual transaction in the Individual PFD Management Transaction resource?
q_51171.ground_truth: The SCS/AS should use an HTTP DELETE message to delete the PFDs for an existing individual transaction in the Individual PFD Management Transaction resource.

q_51172.question: What are the minimum conformance requirements for the TDD RSRP relative measurements of cells?
q_51172.ground_truth: The TDD RSRP relative measurements of cells shall meet the relative accuracy requirements defined in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 9.1.2.4, and these accuracy requirements are valid under specific conditions, such as the transmission of cell-specific reference signals, fulfillment of reference sensitivity conditions, and specific RSRP values, among others.

q_51173.question: What is the main principle of Solution #35 for accessing localized services through network slicing and URSP?
q_51173.ground_truth: The main principle is reusing existing architectures and functionalities such as network slicing and URSP.

q_51174.question: What is the format of the QoSFlowsToBeSetup-List-Modified-SNterminated-Item sequence?
q_51174.ground_truth: The QoSFlowsToBeSetup-List-Modified-SNterminated-Item sequence is a collection of data elements that define the quality of services (QoS) flows in a network.

q_51175.question: What are some deployment topologies where NF services with QUIC support can be introduced into a network without causing issues?
q_51175.ground_truth: Some deployment topologies where NF services with QUIC support can be introduced include Intra PLMN NF service communication without any HTTP proxy as intermediaries and QUIC between HTTP client and HTTP proxy while TCP is used between HTTP proxy and the HTTP server. For inter PLMN HTTP/3 messaging, SEPP is involved and the transport connection will have to terminate at SEPP. Hence, an NF service consumer at VPLMN needs to only consider the transport capabilities of SEPP and not the transport capabilities of the NF service producer in HPLMN.

q_51176.question: What is the difference between event based and session based charging in the context of online charging in the middle tier TSs?
q_51176.ground_truth: In event based charging, a single network/user event corresponds to a single chargeable event, while in session based charging, at least two chargeable events are needed, one for the start and one for the end of the session, with multiple interim events possible for changes in session characteristics.

q_51177.question: What are the advantages of using pre-established sessions in MCPTT communications?
q_51177.ground_truth: The advantages of using pre-established sessions in MCPTT communications include reduced negotiation of media parameters and reservation of bearer resources during call establishment, resulting in faster call establishment.

q_51178.question: What special co-existence requirements may apply to the case of operation with overlapping frequency arrangements in the same geographical area, which are not covered by the 3GPP specifications?
q_51178.ground_truth: Special co-existence requirements may apply to the case of operation with overlapping frequency arrangements in the same geographical area, which are not covered by the 3GPP specifications.

q_51179.question: What shall the participating MCData function do if the network congestion exists and later delivery is required for the communication?
q_51179.ground_truth: The participating MCData function shall store the communication for later delivery with a Payload IE containing the Payload content type set to "FILEURL" as specified in clause 15.2.13, and include the URL of the file to be stored for later delivery in the Payload data, as specified in clause 15.2.13.

q_51180.question: What should the NG-RAN node do when the Report Characteristics IE is set to "OnDemand" and the Inter-RAT Measurement Quantities IE is included in the E-CID MEASUREMENT INITIATION REQUEST message?
q_51180.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node should provide the corresponding measurements, if available in the NG-RAN node, in the Inter-RAT Measurement Result IE in E-CID MEASUREMENT INITIATION RESPONSE message.

q_51181.question: What action does the SS-UE take when transmitting dummy random data on all RBs on the specified subchannels?
q_51181.ground_truth: The SS-UE transmits dummy random data on all RBs on the specified subchannels, implying congestion on PSCCH and PSSCH.

q_51182.question: Which package is defined as with consumer invokes "sendAuthenticationInfo", NO v1-equivalent, and v2-equivalent, in the context of information retrieval?

q_51183.question: What should the UE do when it receives an ATTACH REJECT message with the reject cause set to "roaming not allowed in this tracking area"?
q_51183.ground_truth: The UE should set the EPS update status to EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED and delete the GUTI, last visited registered TAI and KSI. The UE should then enter the state EMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE or EMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH and store the current TAI in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming".

q_51184.question: When the input bit sequence to the channel coding operation for SPUCCH format 4 has a length of E, how is the output bit sequence obtained?
q_51184.ground_truth: The output bit sequence is obtained by circular repetition of the sequence, where i = 0, 1, 2, ..., E-1.

q_51185.question: What is the aim of Solution #1: Change of USS during flight?
q_51185.ground_truth: The aim of Solution #1: Change of USS during flight is to address the gaps identified in Key Issue #2: Support for multi-USS deployments by registering the UAE clients and the UAE servers multi-USS capabilities to the USS, provision of the capabilities and policies of the USS to the UAE client and the UAE server, and assistance by the UAE layer at change of USS.

q_51186.question: What should the UDM do if the NF service consumer sends a request to delete a Parameter Provisioning Data Entry and the Parameter Provisioning Data Entry for the AF does not exist?
q_51186.ground_truth: The UDM should return HTTP status code "404 Not Found" including additional error information in the response body.

q_51187.question: What is one of the actions taken by the MnS producer after processing an EAS LCM request?
q_51187.ground_truth: The MnS producer sends the EAS LCM result to the MnS consumer after processing an EAS LCM request.

q_51188.question: In the context of adding a NR SCell belonging to MCG, how long may the interruption on PSCell or activated Scell in SCG be, when the SCell is added, and how is the duration of the interruption determined?
q_51188.ground_truth: An interruption on PSCell or activated Scell in SCG when one NR SCell belonging to MCG is added is not allowed to exceed X1 subframes for synchronous intraband NE-DC, X1+1 subframes for asynchronous intraband NE-DC, 1 subframe for synchronous interband NE-DC, or 2 subframes for asynchronous interband NE-DC. X1 is equal to the duration of the SMTC of the Scell being added + 1 ms.

q_51189.question: When should a P-CSCF initiate the PCRF based P-CSCF restoration procedure with a 404 (Not Found) response?
q_51189.ground_truth: When it has no binding for the identity in the Request-URI, the Restoration-Info header field is included in the incoming request, and the PCRF based P-CSCF restoration is supported.

q_51190.question: How is network management capability exposure regulated via BSS?
q_51190.ground_truth: Exposure of service data to companies that are external to the operator is regulated by contracts. Different customers may have access to different management capabilities, which may differ on what attributes/policies/intents are allowed to be changed, which value ranges changes are allowed, and which performance metrics are allowed to be exposed.

q_51191.question: What are the propagation conditions for the gNB SRS-RSRP absolute accuracy requirements in FR1 and FR2?
q_51191.ground_truth: The propagation conditions for the gNB SRS-RSRP absolute accuracy requirements in FR1 and FR2 are AWGN propagation conditions.

q_51192.question: What should the S-CSCF do if the NP data was obtained from the database and there is no "npdi" parameter in the received request, and the translation from an international public telecommunications number to a SIP URI failed?
q_51192.ground_truth: The S-CSCF shall replace the URI in the Request-URI with the obtained NP data, prior to forwarding the request to the BGCF or other appropriate entity.

q_51193.question: When would a UE not transmit subframe-PUCCH in a given subframe if the UE detects PDCCH/SPDCCH with uplink DCI format 7-0A/7-0B corresponding to a slot/subslot-PUSCH transmission in the same subframe?
q_51193.ground_truth: This would occur if the UE is not capable of simultaneous transmission of different uplink signal durations to different serving cells, and if there is a collision between a slot-PUCCH of the first serving cell and a subframe-PUSCH/PUCCH/SRS/PRACH of the second serving cell, or if there is a subslot-PUCCH of the first serving cell and a subframe/slot-PUSCH/PUCCH/SRS/PRACH of the second serving cell.

q_51194.question: What is the procedure for pause of charging when I-SMF is involved for a PDU Session?
q_51194.ground_truth: When I-SMF is involved for a PDU Session, the procedure for pause of charging is applied by replacing the H-SMF with SMF and V-SMF with I-SMF. When a Local UPF (PSA) is involved, the SMF stops or starts the usage reporting including usage reporting at the Local UPF (PSA) via the I-SMF.

q_51195.question: What is the minimum requirement for the OTA occupied bandwidth for BS type 1-O and BS type 2-O?
q_51195.ground_truth: The OTA occupied bandwidth for each NR carrier should be less than the BS channel bandwidth for both BS type 1-O and BS type 2-O. For intra-band contiguous CA, the OTA occupied bandwidth should be less than or equal to the aggregated BS channel bandwidth.

q_51196.question: In the evaluation of PBCH coverage impact, what was the PBCH performance degradation (in dB) of the potential Rel-18 UE with soft/selective combining and RF retuning compared to Rel-15 NR UE with soft/selective combining?
q_51196.ground_truth: The PBCH performance degradation (in dB) of the potential Rel-18 UE with soft/selective combining and RF retuning compared to Rel-15 NR UE with soft/selective combining was 9.3.

q_51197.question: What is the common ground between the two solutions to manage and track the NF instance identifiers per end entity in the trust chain management?
q_51197.ground_truth: Both solutions require building an initial trust between NF and operator CA and verifying the NF identity at the certificate enrolment phase.

q_51198.question: What is the role of the PEMC in registering the PINE and PEGC with the PIN server?
q_51198.ground_truth: The PEMC registers the PINE and PEGC with the PIN server by substituting for them and handling the registration process on their behalf.

q_51199.question: What is the duration of the E-UTRA test models for PBCH?

q_51200.question: What is the header that contains the date and time when the originating entity initiated the request in the 3GPP SBI interface?

q_51201.question: What is the procedure for PCF based Service Authorization and Provisioning to 5G ProSe Remote UE/UE-to-UE Relay?
q_51201.ground_truth: The Registration procedures, UE Policy Association Establishment procedure, and UE Policy Association Modification procedure as defined in TS~23.502 apply with additions for PCF based Service Authorization and Provisioning to 5G ProSe Remote UE/UE-to-UE Relay.

q_51202.question: What should the AMF do with the content of the Payload container IE and Payload container information IE when the Additional information IE is not included in the UL NAS TRANSPORT message and the Payload container type is "Location services message container"?
q_51202.ground_truth: The AMF shall provide the Payload container type and the content of the Payload container IE and Payload container information, if included, to the location services application.

q_51203.question: What should a UE do when it is camped on an E-UTRAN cell that indicates support for ProSe direct communication but it is not authorized for it?
q_51203.ground_truth: The UE should perform either ProSe direct communication procedures specified in subclause 10.2.2 or ProSe direct communication procedures specified in subclause 10.2.3, depending on the network support.

q_51204.question: When is the UE allowed to deactivate MICO mode and activate the AS layer for multicast or broadcast MBS sessions?
q_51204.ground_truth: The UE is allowed to deactivate MICO mode and activate the AS layer at the MBS start time and at any scheduled activation times of a multicast or broadcast MBS session, if those times are available.

q_51205.question: What happens to the location update attempt counter when the mobile station is in the MM IDLE sub-state ATTEMPTING to UPDATE and the location updating procedure is triggered?
q_51205.ground_truth: The location update attempt counter is reset when a new PLMN is selected or a new location area is entered after the location updating procedure is triggered in the MM IDLE sub-state ATTEMPTING to UPDATE.

q_51206.question: What is the purpose of the UUAA Authorization Payload in the UUAA procedure?
q_51206.ground_truth: The UUAA Authorization Payload is used to send UAS security information to the UAV on successful completion of a UUAA. The contents of the security information are out of scope of the 3GPP specifications.

q_51207.question: What does the "UsageThreshold" data type represent?
q_51207.ground_truth: The "UsageThreshold" data type represents a usage threshold.

q_51208.question: What does the "Reserved bit" in the GNSS Validity Duration Report MAC Control Element indicate?
q_51208.ground_truth: The "Reserved bit" in the GNSS Validity Duration Report MAC Control Element is set to 0.

q_51209.question: When should the NF service consumer or the SCP request a new access token when they receive a "401 Unauthorized" response or a "403 Forbidden" response with a "WWW-Authenticate" header from the NF service producer?
q_51209.ground_truth: They should request a new access token when they receive an error response, e.g. to retrieve a new access token with the scopes or claims required by the NF service producer.

q_51210.question: Which System Information Block contains information relevant when evaluating if a UE is allowed to access a cell and defines the scheduling of other system information?

q_51211.question: What is the role of the Application Function (AF) in 5G network?
q_51211.ground_truth: The AF is a network function that offers control to applications for the dynamic change of access and mobility policies for a registered UE.

q_51212.question: How does the Segment Index Box document the presence of Stream Access Points in a subsegment?
q_51212.ground_truth: The Segment Index Box documents the presence of Stream Access Points in the referenced subsegments by indicating whether the subsegment contains a Stream Access Point and providing information about the Stream Access Point, such as IAUSAP, ISAP, and TSAP.

q_51213.question: What is the role of the PC5 SRAP sublayer in L2 U2N Relay for uplink data?
q_51213.ground_truth: The PC5 SRAP sublayer at the L2 U2N Remote UE is responsible for UL bearer mapping between L2 U2N Remote UE end-to-end Uu Radio Bearers and egress PC5 Relay RLC channels.

q_51214.question: What should the network do when it receives a PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST message with an unassigned or reserved EPS bearer identity value?
q_51214.ground_truth: The network should respond with a PDN DISCONNECT REJECT message including ESM cause #43 "invalid EPS bearer identity".

q_51215.question: When should the UE include the Integrity protection maximum data rate IE in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message?
q_51215.ground_truth: The UE shall include the Integrity protection maximum data rate IE in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message to indicate the maximum data rate per UE for user-plane integrity protection supported by the UE for uplink and the maximum data rate per UE for user-plane integrity protection supported by the UE for downlink.

q_51216.question: What is one of the principles of solution #26 to support multiple areas and resource partitioning?
q_51216.ground_truth: One of the principles is to support moving UEs by defining smaller TAs and maintaining a uniform support of network slice availability per TA.

q_51217.question: What is the format of the OS specific application identifier?
q_51217.ground_truth: The format of the OS specific application identifier is manufacturer specific.

q_51218.question: What is the maximum time allowed for the cell to remain known, before the UE is required to meet the corresponding PSS/SSS detection requirement in inter-frequency CCA?
q_51218.ground_truth: The maximum time requirement for the cell to remain known

q_51219.question: What is the purpose of the PHR MAC CEs?
q_51219.ground_truth: The PHR MAC CEs indicate the presence of a Power Headroom (PH) field for the Serving Cell and the presence of a Pcmax,f,c for assumed PUSCH field for the Serving Cell. The PH field indicates the power headroom level and the PCMAX,f,c field indicates the PCMAX,f,c value used for calculation of the preceding PH field.

q_51220.question: What is the purpose of the test described in clause 16.5.4.2.4?
q_51220.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described in clause 16.5.4.2.4 is to verify the UE specific CBW change delay requirement for NR RedCap UEs with 2 Rx.

q_51221.question: What should the UE do if it receives a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message with reject cause #95 "semantically incorrect message"?
q_51221.ground_truth: The UE sets the tracking area updating attempt counter to 5, starts timer T3402, and performs tracking area updating on the expiry of timers T3402.

q_51222.question: How does the registration procedure for a 5G-RG connecting to a 5GC via W-5GAN differ from that of NG-RAN?
q_51222.ground_truth: When a 5G-RG connects to a 5GC via W-5GAN, a W-CP protocol stack message is used between the 5G-RG and the W-5GAN to encapsulate NAS messages. The authentication method is executed between the 5G-RG and AUSF.

q_51223.question: What is the purpose of the Retrieve UE Context procedure in E-UTRAN?
q_51223.ground_truth: The Retrieve UE Context procedure in E-UTRAN is used to retrieve the UE context for a UE which attempts to resume its RRC connection in a new eNB different from the eNB where the RRC connection was suspended or for a UE which attempts to re-establish its RRC connection in a new eNB different from the eNB where the RRC connection failed due to RLF.

q_51224.question: When should the floor control server interface send a Floor Taken message?
q_51224.ground_truth: It should send a Floor Taken message when: (a) there is no stored SSRC for dual floor, (b) there is a stored SSRC for dual floor and the G-bit is not set to '1', or (c) there is a stored SSRC for dual floor and the G-bit is set to '1' for specific floor participants.

q_51225.question: What is a PIN Element with Gateway Capability, and what is its function in a PIN?
q_51225.ground_truth: A PIN Element with Gateway Capability is a UE PIN Element that has the ability to provide connectivity to and from the 5G network for other PIN Elements that use PIN direct connections.

q_51226.question: What is the responsibility of the eNB regarding QoS levels, regardless of the received UE assistance information?
q_51226.ground_truth: The eNB ensures an appropriate QoS level is provided

q_51227.question: What should the UE do if it has a valid GUTI and is initiating the detach procedure for EPS services only?
q_51227.ground_truth: The UE should populate the EPS mobile identity IE with the valid GUTI.

q_51228.question: What action does the HSS take when it decides to cancel a Monitoring Event for indicated UEs?
q_51228.ground_truth: The HSS includes the External Identifier or MSISDN of the indicated UEs towards the SCEF to cancel the Monitoring Event.

q_51229.question: How does the NG-RAN calculate UL packet delay if there is no UL service packet for UL packet delay monitoring?
q_51229.ground_truth: In this case, the NG-RAN sends a dummy UL packet as a monitoring response, which includes the received times and local times at different stages of the process.

q_51230.question: What is the purpose of the "Supplementary service action result" field in the CDR?
q_51230.ground_truth: The "Supplementary service action result" field in the CDR contains the result of an attempted supplementary service action, provided if the action was at least partially unsuccessful.

q_51231.question: Which interface connects eNBs with each other in the E-UTRAN architecture?
q_51231.ground_truth: The X2 interface is responsible for connecting eNBs with each other in the E-UTRAN architecture.

q_51232.question: What is the message sent by an AS to the SLF when querying the Public User Identity?
q_51232.ground_truth: A DH_SLF_QUERY message is sent by an AS to the SLF when querying the Public User Identity.

q_51233.question: Who is responsible for aggregating the collected data in the VPLMN?
q_51233.ground_truth: The V-NWDAF is responsible for aggregating the collected data from different NFs/DCCF in the VPLMN.

q_51234.question: What is the requirement for the ratio of successful reported values for the RSRQ FDD - FDD inter frequency absolute accuracy test to pass?
q_51234.ground_truth: The requirement for the ratio of successful reported values for the RSRQ FDD - FDD inter frequency absolute accuracy test to pass is more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

q_51235.question: Within which frequency range should the subcarrier spacing of the interfering signal be set, as per 7.7.5.2, except for the case of wanted signal subcarrier spacing 60~kHz and IAB-MT channel bandwidth < =20MHz?
q_51235.ground_truth: The subcarrier spacing of the interfering signal should be 30~kHz.

q_51236.question: How many non-consecutive DTX subframes are allowed by the SS when monitoring SCell1 during the subframes (m+5) to (m+13) in the inter-band PCell FDD case?
q_51236.ground_truth: The SS should allow for at most 2 non-consecutive DTX subframes when monitoring SCell1 during the subframes (m+5) to (m+13).

q_51237.question: How long should the PSCell be released if the UE does not re-establish the connection in 1 second?
q_51237.ground_truth: The SS shall ensure the PSCell is released if the UE has not re-established the connection in at least 1 second.

q_51238.question: What is the maximum validity duration that requires the UE to apply the system information acquisition procedure unless explicitly stated otherwise?
q_51238.ground_truth: Upon exceeding the maximum validity duration.

q_51239.question: What is the primary goal of C2 authorization in 5GS, as per clause 5.2.5.1?
q_51239.ground_truth: The primary goal of C2 authorization is to enable secure C2 communication for UAVs. It consists of UAV-to-UAV-C pairing authorization, ensuring compatible pairing between the UAV and UAV-C, and Flight Authorization, authorizing the UAV for flight during C2 operations.

q_51240.question: When is the Network Daylight Saving Time IE sent by the network?
q_51240.ground_truth: When this IE is sent, the contents indicate the value used to adjust the local time zone.

q_51241.question: What is the role of the SMF in updating the default QoS rule when the PCC rule used to generate the default QoS rule is removed or deactivated?
q_51241.ground_truth: The SMF will choose another PCC rule bound to the QoS Flow associated with the default QoS rule to generate the default QoS rule.

q_51242.question: What does the 9.2.3.155 IE indicate in the SCG Activation Status?
q_51242.ground_truth: This IE indicates the status of the SCG resources.

q_51243.question: What steps must the terminating participating MCData function take when sending a SIP 200 (OK) response as specified in 3GPP TS 24.229?
q_51243.ground_truth: The terminating participating MCData function must include warning header field(s) that were received in the incoming SIP 200 (OK) response, and set the P-Asserted-Identity header field in the outgoing SIP 200 (OK) response set to the public service identity of the participating MCData function.

q_51244.question: What is the significance of the first number in the major version of a specification?
q_51244.ground_truth: A major version 0, 1, or 2 of a specification is either a draft or withdrawn and is TSG internal. A major version greater than 2 of a specification is either under TSG WG Change Control or under TSG Change Control or closed or withdrawn and is either authorized for publication or TSG internal.

q_51245.question: How does the API invoker off-board itself as a recognized user of CAPIF?
q_51245.ground_truth: To off-board itself as a recognized user of CAPIF, the API invoker sends an HTTP DELETE message to its resource representation in the CAPIF core function.

q_51246.question: What is the expected response from a UE after receiving a Hangup message indicating the termination of a session?
q_51246.ground_truth: The UE should respond with a SIP-OK message (200) acknowledging the termination of the session.

q_51247.question: What is the role of the UE in the process described for traffic identification with Packet Flow Descriptions (PFDs)?
q_51247.ground_truth: The UE is responsible for interacting with the PCF when activating a Quality of Service (QoS) flow, providing the Application Identifier, UE IP address, and other policy information.

q_51248.question: What should the UE do if at least one of NRSRP1 and NRSRP2 is considered to be invalid when performing TA validation for PUR transmission?
q_51248.ground_truth: The UE shall not validate the PUR using NRSRP1 and NRSRP2 and shall not transmit using PUR.

q_51249.question: What is the purpose of the "Link Modification" procedure in the context of a Layer-2 UE-to-UE Relay?
q_51249.ground_truth: The "Link Modification" procedure is executed between the source UE and the E2E peer UE during (i.e. before completion of) the LIU procedure, in the case where the LIU procedure is triggered due to the change of Application layer ID and/or IP address/prefix.

q_51250.question: What should the initiating UE do upon time-out of timer T5001 during the PC5 unicast link modification procedure?
q_51250.ground_truth: The initiating UE should retransmit the DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION REQUEST message and restart timer T5001. After reaching the maximum number of allowed retransmissions, the initiating UE should abort the PC5 unicast link modification procedure and may notify the upper layer that the target UE is unreachable.

q_51251.question: What is the value of the "cic" tel-URI parameter reported by the UE dependent on?
q_51251.ground_truth: The value of the "cic" tel-URI parameter reported by the UE is not dependent on UE location.

q_51252.question: What is the purpose of the SDS disposition request type information element?
q_51252.ground_truth: The purpose of the SDS disposition request type information element is to identify the type of SDS disposition notification that the sender requires from the receiver.

q_51253.question: What are the requirements for ProSe charging in the Evolved Packet System (EPS)?
q_51253.ground_truth: The requirements include support for online and offline charging, collection of charging data for ProSe Discovery features, ProSe Communication and EPC Path established following ProSe Discovery, and use of ProSe Discovery, ProSe Communication and EPC Path established following ProSe Discovery by an application.

q_51254.question: What should a network do if it receives a DETACH REQUEST message before the ongoing authentication and ciphering procedure has been completed, and the GPRS detach cause is "power off"?
q_51254.ground_truth: The network should abort the authentication and ciphering procedure and progress the GPRS detach procedure.

q_51255.question: What is the closure requirement for SER/PER in the transport block level for 5G NR?
q_51255.ground_truth: The closure requirement for SER/PER in the transport block level for 5G NR is defined in TS 38.331 TS 38.331 Section 25.3.1 Transmission format selection.

q_51256.question: What is the function of the NG Application Protocol (NGAP) in NG-RAN?
q_51256.ground_truth: The NG Application Protocol (NGAP) in NG-RAN is used as transport for LPP and NRPPa messages over the NG-C interface and is also used to instigate and terminate NG-RAN Node related positioning procedures.

q_51257.question: What protocol is the media plane control messages based on in the present document?
q_51257.ground_truth: The media plane control protocols specified in the present document are based on the RTCP Application Packets (RTCP: APP), as defined in IETF RFC 3550. However, the media plane control messages do not conform to the rules for compound RTCP packets or RTCP packet transmission.

q_51258.question: What is the expression for the cell re-selection delay to lower priority cell 2?
q_51258.ground_truth: The cell re-selection delay to lower priority cell 2 is given by the sum of Tevaluatecdma2000 1X and TSI-cdma2000 1X.

q_51259.question: What should the EES do if the EEC includes EAS selection request indication and there are multiple matching EASs for the EES to select from based on EES local policies?
q_51259.ground_truth: The EES shall select EASs from the list of matching EASs based on EES local policies and provide the information to the EEC in the registration response as part of the "discoveredEas" attribute.

q_51260.question: How does SCMF ensure that the same SCMF is selected for all PDU Sessions with the same "influence-id"?
q_51260.ground_truth: The SMF uses the "influence-id" to retrieve the SCMF identity from the BSF to ensure that the same SCMF is selected for all PDU Sessions with the same "influence-id".

q_51261.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for the spurious response test of EN-DC within FR1 with 3 DL CCs?
q_51261.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirement is defined in clause~7.7B.0.1.

q_51262.question: What is the purpose of the SC-MRB establishment in the 3GPP 5G specification?
q_51262.ground_truth: The purpose of the SC-MRB establishment is to inform upper layers about the establishment of the SC-MRB by indicating the corresponding tmgi and sessionId.

q_51263.question: What is the function of the 5G-GUTI in determining the UE location in the presence of a mobile IAB-node?
q_51263.ground_truth: The 5G-GUTI of the IAB-node is used by the LMF to determine the serving AMF and trigger the location estimation of the IAB-node when determining the UE location.

q_51264.question: When one SCell in MCG or SCG is switched from dormancy to non-dormancy or from non-dormancy to dormancy when UE is in DRX active time, what is the interruption requirement on active serving cell in MCG and SCG?
q_51264.ground_truth: The interruption requirement on active serving cell in MCG and SCG is defined in clause 8.2.4.2.13, except that the interruption is allowed regardless of which parameters change between the dormant BWP and the non-dormant BWP.

q_51265.question: What should a UE do when it receives SystemInformationBlockType12 and the received values of messageIdentifier and/or serialNumber are not the same as any of the pairs for which a warning message is currently being assembled?
q_51265.ground_truth: The UE should start assembling a warning message for this messageIdentifier and serialNumber pair, store the received warningMessageSegment, and continue reception of SystemInformationBlockType12.

q_51266.question: What attribute is used to indicate the new RAT type in a notification for RAT type change?

q_51267.question: What is the requirement for the minimum difference between the wideband CQI indices of SCell1 and SCell2, 3... reported for CA with 3 or more DL CC under AWGN conditions?
q_51267.ground_truth: The minimum difference between the wideband CQI indices of SCell1 and SCell2, 3... reported for CA with 3 or more DL CC under AWGN conditions is 2.

q_51268.question: In what situation should a 5 MHz E-UTRA carrier be placed next to a 5MHz / 15kHz SCS NR carrier in TC22 generation?
q_51268.ground_truth: When NB-IoT operation in NR in-band is supported and the power boosted NB-IoT RB is placed at the lower outermost eligible position, and it is the closest to the NR minimum guard band at the lower Base Station RF Bandwidth edge.

q_51269.question: What is the purpose of the multicast MBS session deactivation procedure?
q_51269.ground_truth: The multicast MBS session deactivation procedure is triggered to release radio resources once no further MC data is to be delivered over the associated session.

q_51270.question: What is the format of the "Cells-To-Be-Broadcast-List" in the "WriteReplaceWarningRequest" sequence?
q_51270.ground_truth: The "Cells-To-Be-Broadcast-List" in the "WriteReplaceWarningRequest" sequence is a sequence of "Cells-To-Be-Broadcast-List-ItemIEs" with a minimum size of 1 and a maximum size of "maxCellingNBDU".

q_51271.question: What are some potential requirements for network management capability exposure discovery service?
q_51271.ground_truth: The 3GPP management system may provide capabilities to discover exposed MnS and related exposed MnS producers that are managing a specific managed entity, register exposed MnS to an appropriate discovery service/system, and authenticate and authorize network slice consumers to discover exposed MnS and related MnS producers.

q_51272.question: What should be the SS's action when the UE fails to re-establish the connection within a certain time in the test procedure?
q_51272.ground_truth: When the UE fails to re-establish the connection within 1 second, the SS must switch the UE off and then on. To ensure proper state handling, the SS must ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF-DC2 if DC Split DRB bearer is supported, or in State 3A-RF-DC1 otherwise, based on the UE's capabilities.

q_51273.question: What should the UP function do when it receives a PFCP Session Deletion Request message?
q_51273.ground_truth: The UP function sends the PFCP Session Deletion Response message with an acceptance cause if the PFCP session and associated rules are deleted successfully, and include any pending Usage Report(s) in the message.

q_51274.question: What is the minimum number of slots a UE should wait for before attempting to transmit a PSFCH over a number of first slots?
q_51274.ground_truth: At least a number of slots, provided by sl-MinTimeGapPSFCH.

q_51275.question: What must the SMF provide to the PCF if the RAN-NAS-Cause feature is supported and the RAN cause and/or the NAS cause due to QoS flow termination is received?
q_51275.ground_truth: The SMF must provide the received cause(s) in the "ranNasRelCauses" attribute included in RuleReport data instance.

q_51276.question: What is the purpose of the relay service code parameter in 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay and 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay?
q_51276.ground_truth: The relay service code parameter in 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay indicates the connectivity service provided to the 5G ProSe remote UE in UE-to-network relay direct discovery, while in 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay, it indicates the connectivity service provided to the 5G ProSe end UE in UE-to-UE relay direct discovery.

q_51277.question: In an MA PDU session, what is the maximum number of sets of QoS rules, QoS flow descriptions, and session-AMBR values the UE can have in an access where the MA PDU session has a PDN connection as a user-plane resource?
q_51277.ground_truth: The UE can have two sets of QoS rules, two sets of QoS flow descriptions, and two session-AMBR values in an access where the MA PDU session has a PDN connection as a user-plane resource.

q_51278.question: What happens to the AMF signalling connection when the UE is instructed to release the (R)AN connection?
q_51278.ground_truth: The AMF releases the NAS signalling connection and continues the Service Request or Registration Request procedure if a new NAS signalling connection is established after the UE is instructed to release the (R)AN connection. The old NAS signalling connection will be released before continuing the Service Request or Registration Request procedure.

q_51279.question: What should the UE use in event evaluation and event-triggered reporting for GSM cells after the BSIC has been verified?
q_51279.ground_truth: The UE should use the most recently available GSM carrier RSSI measurement results in event evaluation and event-triggered reporting.

q_51280.question: What is the criticality level of the measurement procedure in NRPPA-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE?

q_51281.question: When does the V-SMF remove the context in the old V-EASDF?
q_51281.ground_truth: The V-SMF is responsible for determining when to remove the context in the old V-EASDF.

q_51282.question: If a lower layer failure occurs before the message REGISTRATION COMPLETE has been received from the UE and timer T3550 is running, what should the AMF do?
q_51282.ground_truth: Abort the procedure and enter 5GMM-IDLE mode. Additionally, consider both the old and new 5G-GUTI, TAI list, Paging subgroup ID, and UE paging probability information value as valid if new ones were assigned in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message. If a new Paging subgroup ID or UE paging probability information value was assigned, consider the old ones as invalid.

q_51283.question: In which common search spaces do the PRB-pairs of the 2 PRB set in the 2+4 PRB set correspond to PRB-pairs with the largest two PRB indices in MPDCCH-PRB-set?
q_51283.ground_truth: Type2-MPDCCH common search space and Type2A-MPDCCH common search space.

q_51284.question: What action does the floor control interface take when an MCPTT client initiates an MCPTT call with an implicit floor request and the MCPTT call does not exist yet?
q_51284.ground_truth: The floor control interface initializes a general state machine as specified in clause 6.3.4.2.2, enters the state 'U: permitted' as specified in clause 6.3.5.5.2, and initializes the 'general floor control operation' state machine.

q_51285.question: What happens if the UE sends the initial NAS message without integrity protection and encryption in an N1 mode to N1 mode handover?
q_51285.ground_truth: The UE uses the parameters received from the target AMF to create a new 5G NAS security context and re-establish the secure exchange of NAS messages.

q_51286.question: Who is responsible for initiating the IPsec SA rekeying procedure in untrusted non-3GPP access?
q_51286.ground_truth: The N3IWF for untrusted non-3GPP access initiates the IPsec SA rekeying procedure in untrusted non-3GPP access.

q_51287.question: What network information does the MME use to perform selection of an appropriate PDN GW, in addition to the Weight Factors received from the DNS server, when the MME supports the GTP-C Load Control feature?
q_51287.ground_truth: The MME takes into account the Load Information received from the PDN GW.

q_51288.question: In TS 24.301, clause 4.11.3, when the UE camps on a satellite E-UTRAN cell and receives multiple TACs, how does the UE select a TAI?
q_51288.ground_truth: If at least one TAI belongs to the TAI list of the UE, the UE shall select a TAI which belongs to the TAI list. If there are multiple TAIs which belong to the TAI list, the UE shall consider each of these TAIs equal and select one in an implementation-specific way.

q_51289.question: What is the N4 Report Procedure used for in 4G Core Network?
q_51289.ground_truth: The N4 Report Procedure is used by the UPF to report information to the SMF that is not related to a specific N4 session, such as reporting a user plane path failure towards a remote GTP-U peer.

q_51290.question: What is the response of the PDN GW if it receives the message Modify Bearer Response (MSISDN) from the Serving GW?
q_51290.ground_truth: The PDN GW updates its context field and returns a Modify Bearer Response (MSISDN) message to the Serving GW, including the MSISDN if it has it stored in its UE context.

q_51291.question: What is the description of Service Flow for Prediction based on NWDAF analytics function of the 5G network?
q_51291.ground_truth: The network data analytics function (NWDAF) does data collection and analytics work for the user's location, mobility, download data size, etc. Based on the NWDAF analytics, the 5G network can predict that lots of users will download a certain amount of data from an AI/ML model server in a specific location area. The network informs the AI/ML server directly or via NEF that certain users will probably download a certain amount of data. The AI/ML server can use such information to adjust its prediction.

q_51292.question: What is the procedure to determine PFD information for a known Application Identifier based on PFD Determination analytics?
q_51292.ground_truth: The NEF (PFDF) fetches the PFD information from the UDR, if not available, and determines whether to create/update/delete PFD information corresponding to the known Application Identifier based on the PFD Determination analytics information notified/responded from the NWDAF.

q_51293.question: What is the purpose of the "Shared Risk" principle in the context of 3GPP TS 38.101-3?
q_51293.ground_truth: The "Shared Risk" principle is used to define the way measurement results are compared to test requirements in 3GPP TS 38.101-3. It ensures that the probability of a borderline good User Equipment (UE) being judged as FAIL is equal to the probability of a borderline bad UE being judged as PASS.

q_51294.question: What action in clause~9.2.4.4.4 triggers the initiation of the procedure to invite an MCData user to an MCData session?
q_51294.ground_truth: The procedure is initiated by the controlling MCData function as a result of an action in clause~9.2.4.4.4.

q_51295.question: When is the "SIP MESSAGE request for remotely initiated private call response for terminating client" sent in the procedure?
q_51295.ground_truth: The "SIP MESSAGE request for remotely initiated private call response for terminating client" is sent after receiving a SIP MESSAGE request for remotely initiated private call response for terminating client.

q_51296.question: Which positioning procedure did not meet the target positioning requirement for RedCap UEs in FR1 based on the results provided by most of the 19 sources for InF-SH in IIoT scenarios?
q_51296.ground_truth: UL TDOA, multi-RTT, DL-TDOA, UL-AoA, and DL-AoD did not meet the target positioning requirement for RedCap UEs in FR1 based on the results provided by most of the 19 sources for InF-SH in IIoT scenarios.

q_51297.question: What is the difference between the authorization procedures of SL Positioning Client UE during direct link establishment and after direct link establishment?
q_51297.ground_truth: During direct link establishment, the authorization occurs between the SL Positioning Client UE and UE1 only. After direct link establishment, the authorization occurs during the control operation procedures via SR5 interface over the established PC5 link and probably using RSPP/SLPP protocol.

q_51298.question: What conditions must be met for an MCData emergency group communication request to be authorized?
q_51298.ground_truth: An MCData emergency group communication request is authorized if the <allow-emergency-group-call> element of the actions element of the rule element of the ruleset element of the MCData user profile document identified by the MCData ID of the calling user is set to "true". If the "entry-info" attribute of the <entry> element of the MCDataGroupInitiation element within the EmergencyCall element contained within the MCData-group-call element of the MCData user profile document is set to "DedicatedGroup" and the <uri-entry> element of the <entry> element of the MCDataGroupInitiation element contains the identity of the MCData group targeted by the calling MCData user or if the "entry-info" attribute of the <entry> element of the MCDataGroupInitiation is set to "UseCurrentlySelectedGroup", then the MCData emergency group communication request is authorized.

q_51299.question: Which node receives the PCC rule from PCF in the described solution?
q_51299.ground_truth: The SMF receives the PCC rule from PCF in the described solution.

q_51300.question: Which parameter defines whether the UE supports UTRA FDD?

q_51301.question: How can in-band measurement be used to make end-to-end delay measurements accurately reflect the end-to-end delay experienced by the data packets?
q_51301.ground_truth: In-band measurement can be used by piggybacking a timestamp message to an RTP packet that carries data and instructing the receiver how to separate the timestamp message and the data. This way, the RTP packet is treated as a data packet with a packet size substantially the same as an RTP packet that carries data only.

q_51302.question: What information should be included in the N6-LAN traffic steering control information when sending an AF request?
q_51302.ground_truth: The N6-LAN traffic steering control information should include the target UE Identifier(s), DNN, S-NSSAI, SFC identifier (uplink and/or downlink) when sending an AF request.

q_51303.question: What is the maximum delay allowed for the MeasurementReport message to trigger Event A3 for UE supporting power class 1?
q_51303.ground_truth: The maximum delay allowed is 10240 ms.

q_51304.question: What should the NF service consumer do if the HTTP POST request from the PCF is not accepted and the "ES3XX" feature is supported?
q_51304.ground_truth: The NF service consumer should send an HTTP redirect response as specified in clause~6.10.9 of 3GPP TS 29.500.

q_51305.question: What is the action taken by the MCPTT client when the stored answer SDP is set in the "Q1: in-progress private call" state?
q_51305.ground_truth: The MCPTT client sets the ProSe per-packet priority to the value corresponding to MCPTT off-network private call, sets the stored current call type to "PRIVATE CALL", and enters the "Q1: in-progress private call" state.

q_51306.question: What are the two ingest modes defined for the MCData server to fetch a file for distribution over MBS sessions?
q_51306.ground_truth: The two ingest modes defined are pull and push. In pull mode, the MCData server provides the resource location from which the MBSTF fetches the file. In push mode, the MCData server directly ingests the file into the MBSTF for distribution.

q_51307.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement in section 8.1.39.3 that must be met for the UE to be considered as meeting the requirements?
q_51307.ground_truth: The requirements defined in 3GPP TS 36.133 subclause 8.13.3.1.5 apply, provided that the UE supports Tx diversity or transmission using multiple antennas in the target cell and supports repetitions of MIB/SIB1bis in the target cell.

q_51308.question: What is the role of the MF/MRF in e2DCe protection for IMS data channel media streams?
q_51308.ground_truth: The MF/MRF is responsible for sending and accepting DTLS-protected SCTP packets for IMS data channel traffic. It also uses certificate fingerprints to verify the establishment of DTLS sessions and convert between protected and unprotected SCTP packets.

q_51309.question: What is the role of the UE Policy Association in service specific parameter provisioning?
q_51309.ground_truth: The UE Policy Association is established by the AMF as specified in clause 4.16.11 to provide service specific parameters to the HPLMN and the UE in the roaming case. The PCF interacts with the V-PCF which interacts with H-PCF.

q_51310.question: When does the LMF map the UE location to a geographical area where a PLMN is or is not allowed to operate in the 5GC-NI-LR Procedure?
q_51310.ground_truth: The LMF performs this mapping if step 2 occurs in the 5GC-NI-LR Procedure.

q_51311.question: What is the procedure for measuring the spurious emissions of a multi-band connector, as specified in clause 6.6.5.4.2?
q_51311.ground_truth: The procedure for measuring the spurious emissions of a multi-band connector is to test one or multiple TAB connectors at a time or in parallel until all necessary connectors have been tested.

q_51312.question: Under what conditions will the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE announce the relay discovery additional information in the PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for relay discovery additional information?
q_51312.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE announces the relay discovery additional information when it is in NG-RAN coverage and has been requested to provide NG-RAN Cell Global ID or TAI of the serving cell. This information will be included in the PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message until timer T5107 expires if the relay UE has been requested by 5G ProSe remote UEs for additional parameters and the timer is still active.

q_51313.question: What service operation is used to notify the NF Service Consumer (i.e. GMLC) about a UE location related event information in the 5GC-NI-LR Procedure?

q_51314.question: What should the MBMS GW do when it detects an Sm path failure and the maximum path failure duration timer of the MME expires?
q_51314.ground_truth: The MBMS GW may move the control of all the affected active MBMS sessions to another MME in the same MME pool (if any other MME is reachable by the MBMS GW) by initiating new MBMS Session Start Request(s) to alternative MME(s).

q_51315.question: What is not supported by the architecture described in Solution #16?
q_51315.ground_truth: Seamless mobility between the SNPN and the WLAN Access Network is not supported by the architecture described in Solution #16.

q_51316.question: What is the purpose of the Access Traffic Steering, Switching and Splitting (ATSSS) feature in 3GPP 23.501?
q_51316.ground_truth: The ATSSS feature enables the support of Multi-Access PDU sessions, which allows a user to connect to a 5G network using one or more access networks simultaneously or at different times.

q_51317.question: What data type is used to store the mBS-Multicast-CU2DU-Cell-Item's mBSMulticastRRCINACTIVEReceptionMode field in the MulticastCU2DURRCInfo structure?

q_51318.question: What are the enhancements provided by the 5GS for support of XR services and interactive media services with high data rate and low latency requirements?
q_51318.ground_truth: The 5GS provides various enhancements for support of XR services and interactive media services with high data rate and low latency requirements, such as QoS policy control for multi-modal traffic, network information exposure based on ECN markings for L4S or 5GS exposure API, PDU set based QoS handling, per-flow packet delay variation monitoring, and Connected mode DRX power saving.

q_51319.question: What is the role of the NW-TT in determining the Sync and Announce message interval for a PTP port in the other end of the link?
q_51319.ground_truth: The NW-TT must determine the Sync and Announce message interval for the PTP port at the other end of the link to which the Follower PTP Port in 5GS is attached.

q_51320.question: What should be returned as an error response if the MnS producer cannot honor a patch request for some reason?
q_51320.ground_truth: An error response with an appropriate error response code such as "400 Bad Request" shall be returned.

q_51321.question: What are some of the identities used for power and slot format control in NR connected to 5GC?

q_51322.question: What is used to protect multicast floor control messages in MCPTT networks?
q_51322.ground_truth: Multicast Signalling Keys (MuSiK), each identified by a corresponding (MuSiK-ID)

q_51323.question: What is the time required to search the target cell specified in 38.133?
q_51323.ground_truth: Tsearch = 0 ms for known target cell

q_51324.question: What should the AMF do after sending a NAS Security Mode Command to a UE and receiving a request for an inter-AMF handover or inter-RAT handover from the serving gNB/ng-eNB?
q_51324.ground_truth: The AMF should wait for the completion of the NAS SMC procedure (i.e. receiving NAS Security Mode Complete) before initiating an inter-AMF handover or inter-RAT handover.

q_51325.question: What is the message that the UE sends to the MME to indicate a handover from non-3GPP access to E-UTRAN?
q_51325.ground_truth: The UE sends an Attach Request to the MME with Request Type indicating "Handover" Attach.

q_51326.question: What should the UE do if it receives an initial request containing an Accept-Contact header field with a g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag?
q_51326.ground_truth: The UE should invoke the IMS application that is the best match for the ICSI value.

q_51327.question: In which EMM state will the UE initiate the combined attach procedure?
q_51327.ground_truth: The UE will initiate the combined attach procedure while in the EMM state EMM-DEREGISTERED.

q_51328.question: How does a UE determine a priority index for a PUCCH transmission with HARQ-ACK information corresponding to a SPS PDSCH reception or a SPS PDSCH release?
q_51328.ground_truth: A UE determines a priority index for a PUCCH transmission with HARQ-ACK information corresponding to a SPS PDSCH reception or a SPS PDSCH release from harq-CodebookID, if provided, in a DCI format that activates the semi-persistent CSI report.

q_51329.question: What type of E-UTRA UE does clause 6.4B.2.4.2D.2 apply to?
q_51329.ground_truth: Clause 6.4B.2.4.2D2 applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 15 and forward that support inter-band EN-DC including FR2 and UL MIMO.

q_51330.question: What should the MCVideo client do after successfully affiliating to the MCVideo group?
q_51330.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should change its selected group to the group identified by the <mcvideo-calling-group-id> element in the MIME body and determine the success or failure of the change of selected group action.

q_51331.question: What should the PCF do if the AMF as NF service consumer is not able to handle the notification but knows that another AMF is able to handle it?
q_51331.ground_truth: The AMF shall reply with an HTTP "307 Temporary redirect" response pointing to the URI of the new AMF.

q_51332.question: What is the maximum allowed probability of missed ACK/NACK for an activated SCell during any interruption?
q_51332.ground_truth: The maximum allowed probability of missed ACK/NACK for an activated SCell during any interruption is 0.5%.

q_51333.question: What is the IP address of the source and what is its corresponding address type value in the provided policy parameters?
q_51333.ground_truth: The IP address of the source is 172.22.2.104 and its corresponding address type value is '01' indicating IPv4.

q_51334.question: What action should the UE take when it receives the Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming" IE in the SERVICE REJECT message?
q_51334.ground_truth: The UE should store the TAI(s) included in the IE which are belonging to the serving PLMN or equivalent PLMN(s), if not already stored, into the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming" and ignore the TAI(s) which do not belong to the serving PLMN or equivalent PLMN(s).

q_51335.question: What functions does the MAC sublayer support?
q_51335.ground_truth: The MAC sublayer supports mapping between logical channels and transport channels, multiplexing and demultiplexing of MAC SDUs, scheduling information reporting, error correction through HARQ, priority handling between UEs and logical channels, Logical Channel prioritization, transport format selection, and radio resource selection for SL.

q_51336.question: What does the term "SA" and "NSA" stand for in the context of FR2 interworking operation?
q_51336.ground_truth: SA stands for Standalone operation, and NSA stands for Non-Standalone operation in the context of FR2 interworking operation.

q_51337.question: What is the state of the MME and the UE when a UE that is not registered is attached in both GMM and EMM?
q_51337.ground_truth: A UE that is not registered shall be in state GMM-DEREGISTERED and in state EMM-DEREGISTERED.

q_51338.question: What is the role of the NAS Signalling Transport function in the S1 interface?
q_51338.ground_truth: The NAS Signalling Transport function provides means to transport or reroute a NAS message (e.g. for NAS mobility management) for a specific UE on the S1 interface.

q_51339.question: What is the purpose of the LCS Privacy Check parameter in 3GPP TS 23.271?
q_51339.ground_truth: The LCS Privacy Check parameter refers to the requested privacy check related actions for a deferred MT-LR procedure. It includes options such as positioning allowed without notifying the UE user, positioning allowed with notification to the UE user, and positioning not allowed.

q_51340.question: What information does the "StatisticOfCellEsState" data type provide in the analytics output?
q_51340.ground_truth: The "StatisticOfCellEsState" data type specifies the type of statistics of cells energy saving state in the analytics output.

q_51341.question: What service is used to automatically recall User A if resources are not used by Destination B within a defined time frame?
q_51341.ground_truth: The CCNL service is used for this action.

q_51342.question: How is the Local Time calculated in SystemInformationBlockType16 ASN.1 definition?
q_51342.ground_truth: Local Time is calculated based on the timeInfoUTC-r11 and dayLightSavingTime-r11 variables from SystemInformationBlockType16. The local Time Offset is added to the timeInfoUTC-r11 to calculate the local Time.

q_51343.question: What information from the UMTS message is used to construct the GSM Cell Broadcast Page header?
q_51343.ground_truth: The 2-byte Serial Number, 2-byte Message ID, 1-byte Data Coding Scheme, 1-byte Number-Of-Pages, and 82-byte CBS-Message-Information-Page of the UMTS message.

q_51344.question: What functional descriptions are provided to support Sidelink Positioning and Ranging-based services in 5GC?
q_51344.ground_truth: Sidelink Positioning and Ranging-based services are supported in 5GC based on architectures in clause 4.3.1. There are two main reference points: SR1 between the UE Sidelink (SL) Positioning and Ranging function and the SL Positioning/Ranging Server, and SR5 between the Sidelink (SL) Positioning and Ranging function in UEs. Other relevant functions include N1, N2, and Uu.

q_51345.question: What is the requirement for the UE to measure SSB for BFD without measurement gaps in FR1 when the SSB and CSI-RS have different SCS?
q_51345.ground_truth: If the UE supports simultaneousRxDataSSB-DiffNumerology, it shall be able to measure the SSB for BFD measurement without any restriction. If not, it is required to measure one of but not both SSB for BFD measurement and CSI-RS, with a longer measurement period expected for SSB based BFD measurement.

q_51346.question: What event in the DN-AAA initiated QoS flow termination procedure triggers all QoS flows for a particular user to be deleted?
q_51346.ground_truth: The Teardown-Indicator set to "1" in the RADIUS Disconnect Request message triggers the deletion of all QoS flows for this particular user.

q_51347.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for EN-DC FR2 SS-SINR measurement accuracy?
q_51347.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 5.7.3.1.3 for EN-DC FR2 intra-frequency measurements and in clause 5.7.3.2.3 for EN-DC FR2 inter-frequency measurements.

q_51348.question: When should the UE set the "active" flag to 1 in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message?
q_51348.ground_truth: The UE should set the "active" flag to 1 in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message when it has uplink user data pending to be sent via user plane or it has uplink signalling not related to the tracking area updating procedure when the UE does not support control plane CIoT EPS optimization.

q_51349.question: What is the effect of setting the MCPTT client emergency group state of the group to "MEG 2: in-progress" in the MIME body to "false"?
q_51349.ground_truth: This will cause the MCPTT client to set the MCPTT client emergency group state of the MCPTT group to "MEG 4: confirm-pending".

q_51350.question: What is the purpose of the POST /vnfm/measuredvalues API for NFs?
q_51350.ground_truth: The POST /vnfm/measuredvalues API for NFs allows for sending measurements (e.g., VcpuUsageMeanVnf, VmemoryUsageMeanVnf, VdiskUsageMeanVnf) to the VNFM, which maps the measured object of the received measurements to the MOI(s) of NF(s) and generates the measurements accordingly.

q_51351.question: What is the format of the Decorated NAI when the IMSI is not used for the authentication?
q_51351.ground_truth: The format of the Decorated NAI when the IMSI is not used for the authentication is 'nai.epc.mnc<homeMNC>.mcc<homeMCC>.3gppnetwork.org !<username>@realm.org' where <username> is the IMSI-based permanent username, and 'realm.org' is the domain name of a service provider.

q_51352.question: What information does the SCEF send to the SCS/AS in a Network Status Report (TLTRI, NSI) message after deriving a NSI that crosses a Threshold for the requested geographical area?
q_51352.ground_truth: The SCEF sends the NSI for the requested geographical area and the corresponding TLTRI to the SCS/AS in a Network Status Report (TLTRI, NSI) message.

q_51353.question: What is the action taken when the candidate number of MCData group IDs is bigger than the N2 value of the served MCData ID?
q_51353.ground_truth: The candidate MCData group IDs are reduced to be equal to N2 based on MCData service provider policy.

q_51354.question: When should a UE prioritize selecting resources in a shared COT with reserved resources?
q_51354.ground_truth: A UE may prioritize selecting resources in the slot(s) for transmission if transmission in slot(s) before a reserved resource is able to share its initiated COT to the reservation.

q_51355.question: Which two things does sending an EVS Channel Aware Request imply?
q_51355.ground_truth: Sending an EVS Channel Aware Request implies changing to the EVS Primary mode and to the 13.2 kbps bit-rate and possibly also changing the audio bandwidth to either WB or SWB.

q_51356.question: What does Solution #37 propose to reuse for network resource utilization monitoring?
q_51356.ground_truth: Solution #37 proposes to reuse the existing UPF Exposure Service by introducing a new event type "Bit Rate Reporting per QoS Flow" to the existing consumer "NEF" for this service.

q_51357.question: What is the maximum length of the Emergency Number List information element in the 3GPP TS 24.008 protocol?
q_51357.ground_truth: The Emergency Number List information element in the 3GPP TS 24.008 protocol is a type 4 information element with a minimum length of 5 octets and a maximum length of 50 octets.

q_51358.question: What should a controlling MCPTT function do upon receiving a SIP ACK to the SIP 200 (OK) response, if the SIP 200 (OK) response was sent with the warning text set to "149 SIP INFO request pending"?
q_51358.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function should follow the procedures specified in clause~6.3.3.1.18.

q_51359.question: What are two things that can happen during RAN user plane congestion?
q_51359.ground_truth: Operators can allocate resources preferentially and select specific users (e.g. heavy users, roaming users) to adjust QoS and apply relevant policies.

q_51360.question: What is the need for defining additional resource/operation-level scopes in a 5GC API?
q_51360.ground_truth: The need for defining additional resource/operation-level scopes in a 5GC API is in enabling restricting the access to certain resource/operations of the 5GC API to specific NF service consumers. This may be the case e.g. when an API supports multiple service operations that may be invoked by different NF service consumers, or when it is needed to differentiate access rights for read vs. create/modify/write operations.

q_51361.question: What is the criteria used to determine if a UE should reselect to a cell on an equal priority E-UTRAN frequency?
q_51361.ground_truth: The criteria is based on ranking for Intra-frequency cell reselection as defined in sub-clause 5.2.4.6.

q_51362.question: Which feature does the "naics-Capability-List-r12" field in the specification indicate support for?
q_51362.ground_truth: This field indicates that the UE supports NAICS, i.e. receiving assistance information from the serving cell and using it to cancel or suppress interference of a neighboring cell for at least one band combination.

q_51363.question: What should the transmission participant do upon receiving an MCVideo call release step 1 request from the application and signalling plane?
q_51363.ground_truth: The transmission participant should stop sending transmission control messages, request the MCVideo client to stop sending RTP media packets, and enter the 'Call releasing' state.

q_51364.question: What are the three PDN disconnection procedures provided when the UE accesses the EPS through S2c?
q_51364.ground_truth: The three PDN disconnection procedures provided when the UE accesses the EPS through S2c are UE-Initiated PDN disconnection Procedure, AAA/HSS-initiated Detach Procedure, and PDN~GW-initiated PDN disconnection Procedure.

q_51365.question: When should the network initiate the paging procedure for EPS services using S-TMSI with CN domain indicator set to "PS"?
q_51365.ground_truth: The network should initiate the paging procedure for EPS services using S-TMSI with CN domain indicator set to "PS" when NAS signalling messages, cdma2000 signalling messages or user data is pending to be sent to the UE, and there is no paging restriction applied in the network for that paging.

q_51366.question: What uplink and downlink information can the AF request to put in the "periodUl" and "periodDl" attributes?
q_51366.ground_truth: The AF can include Periodicity information in the "periodUl" and "periodDl" attributes that indicate the time period between the data bursts in Uplink and Downlink direction.

q_51367.question: What is the effect of the Mobility Management back-off timer on Cell/RAT/Access Type and PLMN change?
q_51367.ground_truth: The Mobility Management back-off timer does not impact Cell/RAT/Access Type and PLMN change, and PLMN reselection or SNPN reselection is not triggered by the back-off timer.

q_51368.question: What must the source eNodeB do regarding downlink data forwarding when the UE has successfully synchronized to the target cell?
q_51368.ground_truth: The source eNodeB starts forwarding of downlink data from the source eNodeB towards the target eNodeB for bearers subject to data forwarding, either directly or indirectly.

q_51369.question: What is the modulus used in the calculation of the Cell 2 physical cell identity in the next iteration of the test procedure loop?
q_51369.ground_truth: 1008 is used as the modulus in the calculation of the Cell 2 physical cell identity in the next iteration of the test procedure loop.

q_51370.question: What action should the UE take if it is located outside the LADN service area for a PDU session when sending a SERVICE REQUEST message over a 5G network?
q_51370.ground_truth: The UE should not include the PDU session for LADN in the Uplink data status IE when sending the SERVICE REQUEST message.

q_51371.question: How many bits form the resource block assignment when the flag for sub-PRB resource allocation is not present and Modulation and coding scheme is not set to all ones?

q_51372.question: What action does the UE take when it receives a PMF-PLR Count Request message from UPF?
q_51372.ground_truth: The UE starts counting the transmitted UL packets over the target QoS Flow and access network when it receives a PMF-PLR Count Request message from UPF.

q_51373.question: What should the UE do if the cellsTriggeredList defined within the VarMeasReportList for this measId is empty?
q_51373.ground_truth: The UE should remove the measurement reporting entry within the VarMeasReportList for this measId and stop the periodical reporting timer for this measId, if running.

q_51374.question: What is the purpose of a PC5 Relay RLC channel in L2 UE-to-Network/UE-to-UE relay?
q_51374.ground_truth: The PC5 Relay RLC channel is used to transport packets over PC5 for L2 UE-to-Network/UE-to-UE relay in 5G networks.

q_51375.question: What should be the value of RTToffset when calculating the HARQ RTT timer in Non-terrestrial networks?
q_51375.ground_truth: RTToffset is taken into account when calculating the (UL) HARQ RTT timer in Non-terrestrial networks, where it is equal to UE-eNB RTT.

q_51376.question: What should the MME do during a tracking area updating procedure if the network receives a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message containing the Old GUTI type IE and the network does not follow the use of the most significant bit of the MME group id to distinguish the node type as specified?
q_51376.ground_truth: The MME should use the Old GUTI type IE to determine whether the mobile identity included in the Old GUTI IE is a native GUTI or a mapped GUTI.

q_51377.question: What information does the SMF provide to the UPF over N4 in relation to UPF event exposure service?
q_51377.ground_truth: The SMF provides user location information (ULI) to the UPF over N4 for the purpose of identifying UEs in the area of interest (AoI).

q_51378.question: When should a UE include multi-tone transmission and multi-carrier operation for NB-IoT in SystemInformationBlockType2?
q_51378.ground_truth: When the UE supports multi-tone transmission and multi-carrier operation for NB-IoT, it should include these parameters for NB-IoT SystemInformationBlockType2.

q_51379.question: What is the definition of Multi-modal Data in the document?
q_51379.ground_truth: Multi-modal Data is defined to describe the input data from different kinds of devices/sensors or the output data to different kinds of destinations (e.g. one or more UEs) required for the same task or application. Multi-modal Data consists of more than one Single-modal Data, and there is strong dependency among each Single-modal Data. Single-modal Data can be seen as one type of data.

q_51380.question: What should the NF Service Consumer send in the POST request when creating a SM context for a single access PDU session?
q_51380.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer should send a POST request to the SM contexts collection resource of the SMF, containing a representation of the individual SM context resource to be created, as well as the requestType IE if the request type IE is received from the UE for a single access PDU session.

q_51381.question: Which parameter is used in the P-Charging-Vector header field to represent the 5G Mobile Network Node (5gmn) that the UE is connected to in the "5gs-charging-info" parameter?
q_51381.ground_truth: The "smf" (Serving Mobile Network Point or SMF) is used to represent the 5G Mobile Network Node (5gmn) that the UE is connected to in the "5gs-charging-info" parameter.

q_51382.question: When IRI-POI/CC-TF uses the Via header or the Route header to determine whether the SIP INVITE is for an originating IMS session or a terminating IMS session, what are the possible values of the headers?
q_51382.ground_truth: For an originating IMS session, the Via or Route header contains the IP address or FQDN of the UE. For a terminating IMS session, the Via or Route header contains the IP address or FQDN of the P-CSCF or the AS/MRFC.

q_51383.question: What security threat could arise if a software catalogue holding the images of virtualized 3GPP NFs is not integrity protected?
q_51383.ground_truth: The information within the catalogue could be exploited by attackers to launch attacks on the 3GPP NFs.

q_51384.question: What information is updated upon the new SEALDD server receiving the SEALDD context from the old SEALDD server?
q_51384.ground_truth: The new SEALDD server may update the allocated IP address and port for SEALDD-Uu communication.

q_51385.question: What are the two potential outcomes when the AMF receives a re-authentication notification?
q_51385.ground_truth: The two potential outcomes are: 1) The AMF replies to the Re-Authentication Notification with a successful response, indicating that the UE is reachable and the primary authentication procedure can be initiated. 2) If the UE cannot be reached, the AMF marks the UE as requiring authentication and stores this information in the UE security context.

q_51386.question: What does the MAC entity do when it receives a downlink assignment for a TTI and Serving Cell on the PDCCH for its C-RNTI or Temporary C-RNTI?
q_51386.ground_truth: The MAC entity toggles the NDI and indicates the presence of a downlink assignment, delivering the associated HARQ information for this TTI.

q_51387.question: What is the difference between intent expectations for delivering network and service related object and intent expectations for network and service related object performance?
q_51387.ground_truth: Intent expectations for delivering network and service related object are used to express the intent expectations for the object (e.g. network, service, slice) to be delivered by the system. On the other hand, intent expectations for network and service related object performance are used to express the performance objectives of the object (e.g. network, service, slice) to be assured.

q_51388.question: What is the purpose of the UE Identifier API in the solution described in clause 6.33.2?
q_51388.ground_truth: The UE Identifier API is used to verify the authenticity of the assigned IP address in the solution described in clause 6.33.2.

q_51389.question: What is the type and minimum length of the SOR transparent container information element?
q_51389.ground_truth: The SOR transparent container information element is a type 6 information element with a minimum length of 20 octets.

q_51390.question: Who is responsible for supporting resolution of the well-known host name "ms.af.3gppservices.org" to the correct IP address(es) in the Trusted DN?
q_51390.ground_truth: The 5G System operator is responsible for this.

q_51391.question: What is the minimum number of SL PRS-RSRP measurements that a UE should be able to perform during the defined measurement period?
q_51391.ground_truth: The number of SL PRS-RSRP measurements is to be determined (TBD).

q_51392.question: What should the target NG-RAN node do if the Management Based MDT PLMN List IE is contained in the HANDOVER REQUEST message and the PLMN serving the UE in the target NG-RAN node is included in the information?
q_51392.ground_truth: The target NG-RAN node should store the information in the UE context and take it into account for management based MDT.

q_51393.question: What should a participating MCPTT function do when updating an MBS session announcement in case of LTE eMBMS and 5G MBS co-existence and the 4G eMBMS bearer related information is included?
q_51393.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT function shall include the eMBMS-bearer-infoType providing the 4G eMBMS bearer related information, which may include a list of additional alternative TMGI in the <Alternative-TMGI> element for roaming scenarios.

q_51394.question: What is the format of the E-CIDMeasurementFailureIndication message, which is used when there is a failure to initiate a measurement?
q_51394.ground_truth: The E-CIDMeasurementFailureIndication message is a sequence consisting of protocolIEs, which is a ProtocolIE-Container for E-CIDMeasurementFailureIndication-IEs.

q_51395.question: In the measurement reporting procedure as specified in TS 36.331, clause 5.5.5, what should the UE do for the measId that triggered the measurement reporting?
q_51395.ground_truth: The UE should set the measId to the measurement identity that triggered the measurement reporting, set the measResultServCell to include the quantities of serving cell, and update the numberOfReportsSent for this measId.

q_51396.question: What should the floor control server interface do upon receiving a Floor Release message from one floor participant interface?
q_51396.ground_truth: The floor control server interface should forward the Floor Release message to the controlling MCPTT function if the controlling function is in the MCPTT system or to the floor control server state transition diagram for basic floor control operation towards the floor participant in the IWF if the controlling function is in the IWF.

q_51397.question: What can be considered as a filter parameter to reduce capability reporting?
q_51397.ground_truth: A network preferred minimum Lower MSD capability class can be used as a filter parameter to reduce capability reporting based on network needs.

q_51398.question: What information does the UE forward to upper layers if the UE supports delay tolerant access or is a NB-IoT UE and the extendedWaitTime is present in the RRCConnectionRelease message?
q_51398.ground_truth: The UE forwards the extendedWaitTime to upper layers.

q_51399.question: What is the condition for a 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-network relay UE to perform the announcing UE procedure for UE-to-network relay discovery?
q_51399.ground_truth: The S-NSSAI associated with the relay service code shall belong to the allowed NSSAI of the UE and the UE is camped on a cell whose TAI is in the list of "non-allowed tracking areas" or not in the list of "allowed tracking areas", then the relay service code shall be associated with high priority access.

q_51400.question: What is the requirement for security context, UE capability context, and QoS context in the target system for handover procedures?
q_51400.ground_truth: There should be no requirement for UE-to-CN signaling for data to start flowing in the target system. The security context, UE capability context, and QoS context should be transferred (or translated) within the network between source and target systems.

q_51401.question: What is the maximum DTX to NACK probability allowed in 11.1.5.1.1.0.2?
q_51401.ground_truth: The DTX to NACK probability shall not exceed 1%.

q_51402.question: How is the occupied bandwidth measured in the test procedure?
q_51402.ground_truth: The occupied bandwidth is measured by identifying the measurement window whose center is aligned on the center of the channel for which the sum of the power measured is 99% of the "Total power".

q_51403.question: What information does the ePDG forward to the 3GPP AAA server in the Terminal-Information AVP in step 8?
q_51403.ground_truth: The IMEI of the UE (User Equipment)

q_51404.question: What does the "powerClass14dBm-Offset-r15" field in the "CellSelectionInfoCE1-v1530" information element represent?
q_51404.ground_truth: The "powerClass14dBm-Offset-r15" field in the "CellSelectionInfoCE1-v1530" information element represents the power class offset at 14 dBm. It is used by the UE for measurement and cell selection for CE mode 1s and 2s.

q_51405.question: When does a UE need to set the establishmentCause to highPriorityAccess upon initiating an RRC connection?
q_51405.ground_truth: When the establishment of the RRC connection is the result of release with redirect with mpsPriorityIndication.

q_51406.question: What measure does the OTA transmitter intermodulation requirement in 6.8.1 assess?
