q_52118.question: What action does the floor control arbitration logic take when timer T20 (Floor Granted) expires and counter C20 (Floor Granted) reaches its upper limit?
q_52118.ground_truth: The floor control arbitration logic remains in the 'G: Floor Taken' state.

q_52119.question: What is the purpose of the classes of 5GS state in the MTLF to detect dynamics on the analytics procedure?
q_52119.ground_truth: The purpose of the classes of 5GS state is to detect crucial changes in 5GS that impact the ML model provision.

q_52120.question: What function does the MLT MnS producer need to provide to the MnS consumer for ML model performance evaluation?
q_52120.ground_truth: The MLT MnS producer needs to provide the name(s) of supported performance indicator(s) for the MnS consumer to query and select for ML model performance evaluation.

q_52121.question: Under what circumstances is a UE not required to monitor NPDCCH UE-specific search space for a certain duration for NPRACH format 0 and 1, and NPRACH format 2 with a certain number of repetitions?
q_52121.ground_truth: If the number of NPRACH repetitions is greater than or equal to 64 for NPRACH format 0 and 1, and greater than or equal to 16 for NPRACH format 2.

q_52122.question: What is the key management mechanism for e2DCe protection in IMS data channel traffic?
q_52122.ground_truth: The key management mechanism for e2DCe protection in IMS data channel traffic is based on certificates and the transmission of certificate fingerprints as defined in RFC 8841 and RFC 8842.

q_52123.question: What will the EATF send in response to the SIP INVITE request due to E-STN-SR if a SIP 1xx response was sent but not received?
q_52123.ground_truth: The EATF will send a SIP 183 (Session Progress) response in response to the SIP INVITE request due to E-STN-SR, without the SDP offer and P-Early-Media header field, if the EATF received a SIP INVITE request from the served user for which a final SIP response has not been received yet, and the EATF sent a SIP 1xx response to the SIP INVITE request without receiving the response due to a timeout or other error.

q_52124.question: What should the MCPTT client do when it receives a SIP MESSAGE request for private call call-back cancel response for terminating client with an <mcptt-calling-user-id> element in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body set to the an MCPTT-ID matching a "PCCB requesting client entry" entry stored on the client, if the private call call-back requesting client state is set to "PCCB-I4: cancel-pending"?
q_52124.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should set the private call call-back requesting client state to "PCCB-I1: no-call-back" and shall delete the "PCCB requesting client entry" associated with the target MCPTT user.

q_52125.question: What is the purpose of presenting a document with the first digit of the version number being "1" in the context of 3GPP?
q_52125.ground_truth: It is presented to the TSG for information.

q_52126.question: What is the potential security requirement described in section 5.3.4.3, related to the transport security for the EDGE10 interface?
q_52126.ground_truth: The potential security requirement is to support confidentiality, integrity, and replay-protection on the EDGE-10 interface.

q_52127.question: What is the name of the element that contains the discovery-user-confidentiality-key and encrypted-bitmask in the code-receiving-security-parameters-for-model-A, code-sending-security-parameters-for-model-A, code-receiving-security-parameters-for-model-B, and code-sending-security-parameters-for-model-B elements?

q_52128.question: When should the IBCF add an "fe-addr" element in an "fe-identifier" header field parameter to the P-Charging-Vector header field?
q_52128.ground_truth: The IBCF should add an "fe-addr" element in an "fe-identifier" header field parameter to the P-Charging-Vector header field if the request is an initial request, "fe-identifier" header field parameter of P-Charging-Vector header field is applied in the operator domain and the IBCF is removing any received "fe-identifier" header field parameter from the P-Charging-Vector header field.

q_52129.question: What is one of the potential new requirements needed to support the use case 5.20.6?
q_52129.ground_truth: The 5G system should provide means to deliver 5G multicast/broadcast services to an eRG

q_52130.question: What is the requirement for a UE to consider a MBMS service as part of the MBMS services of interest?
q_52130.ground_truth: The UE must meet the following conditions: the UE is SC-PTM capable, is receiving or interested to receive this service via an SC-MRB, one session of this service is ongoing or about to start, and one or more MBMS SAIs for this service is included in SystemInformationBlockType15 for a frequency of interest.

q_52131.question: What is the maximum number of digits for an IMSI?
q_52131.ground_truth: The number of digits in IMSI shall not exceed 15.

q_52132.question: When should the "WLAN offload indication" information element be included in the message in the "network to MS direction"?
q_52132.ground_truth: The "WLAN offload indication" information element should be included in the message when the network wishes to indicate if the UE is allowed to offload the traffic of the associated PDN connection to WLAN(s).

q_52133.question: What is the minimum amount of subframe(s) before a DL assignment for HARQ retransmission is expected by the MAC entity, as specified by the HARQ RTT Timer?
q_52133.ground_truth: The HARQ RTT Timer specifies the minimum amount of subframe(s) before a DL assignment for HARQ retransmission is expected by the MAC entity.

q_52134.question: What should a MS do if it is in Manual network selection mode and the HPLMN and VPLMN cells are available, but the EHPLMN list is empty or not present?
q_52134.ground_truth: If the UE is in Manual network selection mode and the HPLMN and VPLMN cells are available, but the EHPLMN list is empty or not present, the MS shall select a cell of the HPLMN.

q_52135.question: In the context of the 5G ProSe direct link modification procedure accepted by the target UE, what information is included in the source end UE info set in the PROSE DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION ACCEPT message, if the UE acts as a target 5G ProSe layer-3 end UE?
q_52135.ground_truth: The source end UE info set is set to the user info ID of the source 5G ProSe layer-3 end UE.

q_52136.question: What is the maximum number of exceptions allowed for spurious response frequencies in step 7.6C.3.3?
q_52136.ground_truth: A maximum of three exceptions are allowed for spurious response frequencies in each assigned frequency channel as specified in the step.

q_52137.question: What is the threshold for Qout and Qin evaluation periods for TEvaluate_Qout_DRX and TEvaluate_Qin_DRX for proper detection of In-sync in DRX for the serving cell when DRX is used?
q_52137.ground_truth: Qout threshold should be used for identifying out-of-sync and Qin threshold should be used for identifying in-sync.

q_52138.question: Which UE sends the relative position 1 to UE2 in the direct ranging procedure?
q_52138.ground_truth: UE1 sends the relative position 1 to UE2 in the direct ranging procedure using Ranging Method 1 based on Ranging accuracy 1.

q_52139.question: What does the MCPTT Group Identity length value indicate?
q_52139.ground_truth: The MCPTT Group Identity length value indicates the length in octets of the MCPTT Group Identity value item, excluding padding.

q_52140.question: What authentication method is used in Solution 2 for the user to access the ANF?
q_52140.ground_truth: The user can access the ANF using GBA, AKMA, or a proprietary method such as username/password.

q_52141.question: What information must the NEF include in the "qosMonConInfoReps" attribute when the feature "EnQoSMon" is supported?
q_52141.ground_truth: When the feature "EnQoSMon" is supported, the NEF must include the uplink or downlink congestion information measurement within the "qosMonConInfoReps" attribute.

q_52142.question: What are the general principles of the 5G network management framework?
q_52142.ground_truth: The 5G network management framework is based on the principles of supporting management of 5G networks with or without network slicing features, management across multiple operators' scenarios, interaction with non-3GPP management systems, and supporting service-based management.

q_52143.question: What is the maximum time allowed for an MTSI client in terminal receiving media to detect a needed reduction in throughput of 25% or more, if no RTCP Sender or Receiver Report is required?
q_52143.ground_truth: If all triggers do not require Sender or Receiver Report reception, the change shall be detected within 15 frame durations of the reduction in throughput.

q_52144.question: What is the delay uncertainty that is excluded from the measurement reporting delay excluding a delay caused by no UL resources for UE to send the measurement report?
q_52144.ground_truth: The delay uncertainty is 2 x TTIDCCH.

q_52145.question: What should be oriented in step 5 of the procedure to perform TRP measurements?
q_52145.ground_truth: The positioner and base station should be oriented in step 5 of the procedure to perform TRP measurements.

q_52146.question: If the MME is aware of additional pending MT traffic, what action does it take before sending S1AP UE Context Release Command?
q_52146.ground_truth: Unless S1-U bearers are established, the MME sends a S1 UE Context Release Command only if it is not aware of additional pending MT traffic.

q_52147.question: What is the recommended window function to achieve less than 0.1 dB leakage for non bin-centered signals?
q_52147.ground_truth: A window function commonly known as a "flat top window" is recommended for achieving less than 0.1 dB leakage for non bin-centered signals.

q_52148.question: What is the purpose of the direct link security mode control procedure in ProSe-Enabled UEs?
q_52148.ground_truth: The purpose of the direct link security mode control procedure is to establish a secure communication channel between two ProSe-Enabled UEs by selecting security algorithms and deriving keys, which are then used to integrity protect and cipher all PC5 signalling messages and data plane traffic exchanged between the UEs.

q_52149.question: What should the H-PCF do if there is no UE policy information retrieved in step 4 when updating the UE policy association?
q_52149.ground_truth: The H-PCF should send an HTTP PUT request to the "UEPolicySet" resource, resulting in an HTTP "201 Created" response.

q_52150.question: How many RSRQ measurements should the UE use for filtering measurements of higher, lower, and equal priority inter-frequency cells?
q_52150.ground_truth: The UE should filter RSRQ measurements of each measured higher, lower, and equal priority inter-frequency cell using at least 2 measurements.

q_52151.question: What should the SS look for in subframes (m+5), (m+9), and (m+13) up to the end of T2 for intra-band CA UE in step 8a?

q_52152.question: What information does the "NOTIFY VIDEO PUSH" message convey?
q_52152.ground_truth: The "NOTIFY VIDEO PUSH" message indicates whether the UE has successfully setup a private/group call for Video Push.

q_52153.question: What functionalities does the 5G PKMF support?
q_52153.ground_truth: The 5G PKMF supports functionalities related to the key management and the security material for discovery and communication between 5G ProSe UEs, including the establishment of secure PC5 communication links and the management of related keys.

q_52154.question: What is the problem with the current authorization scheme for ADRF?
q_52154.ground_truth: The current authorization scheme works only at the service level or resource/operation-level scope, which might not be sufficient for AI/ML model sharing. The ADRF cannot verify if the NF consumer is authorized to retrieve the AI/ML model.

q_52155.question: What information does the Media-Sub-Component AVP contain?
q_52155.ground_truth: The Media-Sub-Component AVP contains the requested bitrate and filters for the set of IP flows identified by their common Flow-Identifier.

q_52156.question: What is the purpose of the MCBearerContextToModifyResponse?
q_52156.ground_truth: The MCBearerContextToModifyResponse is a message that is sent from the RAN to the CU in response to a modification request for an MC bearer context. It contains an mcBearerContextNGU-TNLInfoatNGRANModifyResponse, an mbsMulticastF1UContextDescriptor (optionally present), a mcMRBModifySetupResponseList (optionally present), a mcMRBFailedList (optionally present), and an iE-Extensions (optionally present).

q_52157.question: What information will be included in the Service Provisioning Response to allow the H-ECS to provide a V-ECS information to the EEC on EDGE-4?
q_52157.ground_truth: The V-ECS information sent to the EEC can include address (FQDN or an IP Address), endpoint or service API information of a V-ECS.

q_52158.question: Who receives the AAA Protocol message containing EAP-Success/Failure, S-NSSAI, and GPSI in the described process?
q_52158.ground_truth: The NSSAAF receives the AAA Protocol message containing EAP-Success/Failure, S-NSSAI, and GPSI in the described process.

q_52159.question: What is the role of the PCF in the 5G ProSe context?
q_52159.ground_truth: The PCF includes the 5G ProSe Policy/parameters in a Policy Section identified by a Policy Section Identifier (PSI) and can provide policy/parameters for various ProSe services.

q_52160.question: What should the SS do after receiving the first preamble from the UE?
q_52160.ground_truth: The SS should transmit a random access response containing a random access preamble identifier corresponding to the transmitted random access.

q_52161.question: What is the purpose of the Reference PDU Set SN (RPS-SN) parameter in 5G networks?
q_52161.ground_truth: The Reference PDU Set SN (RPS-SN) parameter is an optional parameter used for PDU Sets that depend on a more important (Reference) PDU Set and need to be transmitted only if the Reference PDU Set has been successfully transmitted.

q_52162.question: What is the name of a message transmitted on UL-SCH containing a C-RNTI MAC CE or a CCCH SDU optionally multiplexed with DTCH for the UP-EDT, submitted from upper layer and associated with the UE Contention Resolution Identity, as part of a random access procedure?

q_52163.question: What should be done if a SIP 4xx response, SIP 5xx response or SIP 6xx response is received with an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body containing the `<mcpttinfo>` element with the `<mcptt-Params>` element containing the `<alert-ind>` element set to a value of "true" and the sent SIP MESSAGE request contains an `<alert-ind>` element set to "false" and the MCPTT emergency alert state is set to "MEA 4: Emergency-alert-cancel-pending"?
q_52163.ground_truth: The MCPTT emergency alert state should be set to "MEA 3: emergency-alert-initiated".

q_52164.question: What should the IP-SM-GW include in the R-URI when sending a SIP MESSAGE request with a delivery report?
q_52164.ground_truth: The R-URI should be set to the address of the entity that has sent the related SIP MESSAGE request identified via the context that relates to the In-Reply-To header field.

q_52165.question: Which data pre-processing technique can be used to ensure individual or group fairness in the ML model?
q_52165.ground_truth: Samples in the training data and testing data can be assigned weights to ensure individual or group fairness in the ML model.

q_52166.question: How is a network slice identified in 5G networks?
q_52166.ground_truth: A network slice is identified by a S-NSSAI (Single NSSAI), which is a combination of a mandatory SST (Slice/Service Type) field and an optional SD (Slice Differentiator) field. The S-NSSAI is used to unambiguously identify a network slice.

q_52167.question: How does the provisioning of PDRs work in the UP function for a PFCP session?
q_52167.ground_truth: Every PDR provisioned for a PFCP session should allow identifying the PFCP session, and PDRs should not have the same match fields in the PDI. Different PDRs in the same PFCP session may overlap, while different PDRs of different PFCP sessions should not overlap unless specified otherwise.

q_52168.question: What should the UE do if the registration request is rejected with a 423 (Interval Too Brief) response?
q_52168.ground_truth: The UE should send another REGISTER request with the registration expiration interval value of at least the value received in the Min-Expires header field of the 423 (Interval Too Brief) response.

q_52169.question: In what situation should the UE include a P-TMSI signature in the Old P-TMSI signature IE?
q_52169.ground_truth: When a P-TMSI signature is associated with the P-TMSI and the UE includes the Old P-TMSI signature IE in the ATTACH REQUEST message.

q_52170.question: What are the two categories of Point of Interception (POI) in Lawful Interception (LI) architecture?
q_52170.ground_truth: The two categories of Point of Interception (POI) in Lawful Interception (LI) architecture are directly provisioned POIs and triggered POIs.

q_52171.question: What message does the AMF send to the W-AGF after completing the registration procedures for a N5GC device?
q_52171.ground_truth: The AMF sends a Registration Accept message to the W-AGF after completing the necessary registration procedures for a N5GC device.

q_52172.question: What action does the UE take when it receives the above message in NB-S1 mode?
q_52172.ground_truth: The UE may disable the NB-IoT capability, indicate the access stratum layer(s) of disabling of the NB-IoT capability, and memorize the identity of the PLMN where the NB-IoT capability was disabled for subsequent PLMN selections.

q_52173.question: What is the frequency difference between the upper edge of the highest used carrier and the lower edge of the lowest used carrier, referred to as Radio Bandwidth?
q_52173.ground_truth: Radio Bandwidth is the frequency difference between the upper edge of the highest used carrier and the lower edge of the lowest used carrier.

q_52174.question: What issues does Solution #3 address?
q_52174.ground_truth: Solution #3 addresses the security and authorization of a UE-to-UE relay, specifically when the L3 UE-to-UE relay is in 3GPP coverage.

q_52175.question: What needs to be retrieved by the PCF when the SMF passes the DNN/S-NSSAI and Internal Group ID(s) to the PCF, and the PCF does not have the traffic influence service data for the given DNN/S-NSSAI and Internal Group ID(s)?
q_52175.ground_truth: The PCF retrieves the traffic influence service data from the UDR in the UDR when the SMF passes the DNN/S-NSSAI and Internal Group ID(s) to the PCF and the PCF does not have the traffic influence service data for the given DNN/S-NSSAI and Internal Group ID(s).

q_52176.question: What are the two types of QoS Flows in 5G NR?
q_52176.ground_truth: There are two types of QoS Flows in 5G NR: GBR (guaranteed flow bit rate) QoS Flows and non-GBR QoS Flows. GBR QoS Flows have guaranteed bit rates and additional QoS parameters, while non-GBR QoS Flows do not require guaranteed flow bit rates.

q_52177.question: What is the role of mapped security context in this process?
q_52177.ground_truth: The mapped security context is a derived security context used to ensure smooth handover between networks, allowing the UE and AMF to continue communication without requiring the full authentication process again.

q_52178.question: What is used to derive the Discovery User Scrambling Key (DUSK), Discovery User Confidentiality Key (DUCK) and Discovery User Integrity Key (DUIK) in a Public Safety Discovery Key (PSDK)?
q_52178.ground_truth: A Key Derivation Function (KDF) is used to derive the DUSK, DUCK, and DUIK for the PSDK.

q_52179.question: What are the high-level requirements for Operations, Administration, Maintenance and Provisioning (OAM&P) of network sharing in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_52179.ground_truth: The high-level requirements for OAM&P of network sharing in the 3GPP technical specification include supporting the management of shared resources, managing S-RANs, generating performance data, and managing network access and security. Other requirements include trace/MDT capabilities, managing resources in a shared Core Network (S-CORE) environment, and supporting POP CN management.

q_52180.question: What should the AS do if it receives a signingRequest, as specified in annex~V, in 5.7.1.26 of the procedures for 3GPP PS data off?
q_52180.ground_truth: The AS should send the signed information in a signingResponse as specified in annex~V.

q_52181.question: What are the conditions for successful testing in 6.5.5.2.4.2?
q_52181.ground_truth: The UE must detect uplink power on NR carrier equal to or higher than the minimum output power during the period from time point A to time point B and not detect preamble on any beam associated with candidate beam set q1 before time point B. The UE must detect preamble on a beam associated with candidate beam set q1 before time point F (D1 after the start of T5) to satisfy all conditions for a successful test.

q_52182.question: What is the role of the ID field within the PDUSessionReleasedList-RelConf?
q_52182.ground_truth: The ID field within the PDUSessionReleasedList-RelConf is used to identify a PDUSession and its associated information.

q_52183.question: Which LLC service primitive is used to establish the LLC ABM mode?
q_52183.ground_truth: The LL-ESTABLISH-REQ service primitive is used to establish the LLC ABM mode.

q_52184.question: What information does the NG-RAN need to support when enabling roaming for mobile base station relays?
q_52184.ground_truth: The NG-RAN needs to support sending MBSR information along with the UE information to AMF.

q_52185.question: What is the role of a "BH RLC channel" in a 5G network?
q_52185.ground_truth: A BH RLC channel is an RLC channel between two nodes, which is used to transport backhaul packets in the 5G network.

q_52186.question: What message is returned by the EES to the EEC upon successful deregistration of the EEC profile in the EES?
q_52186.ground_truth: The EES returns the "204 No Content" message to the EEC, indicating the successful deregistration of the EEC information.

q_52187.question: What action is taken by the PEGC (PIN Element Gateway Component) when it receives a notification of PIN delete from the PEMC?
q_52187.ground_truth: The PEGC disables the 5GS connection permission and access control information for the PIN elements in the PIN that is being deleted.

q_52188.question: What should the system do if an MCVideo user initiates an emergency indication during an ongoing emergency state of the group?
q_52188.ground_truth: If an MCVideo user initiates an emergency indication during an ongoing emergency state of the group, the system should generate a SIP MESSAGE request notification of the emergency indication, set the <emergency-ind> element of the MIME body to true, check if the received SIP INVITE contains an alert indication and meets the conditions specified in clause 6.3.3.1.13.1, and send the SIP MESSAGE request to the other affiliated members of the group.

q_52189.question: What is the name of the procedure initiated by the target UE upon successful completion of the PC5 unicast link security mode control procedure to determine whether the DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message can be accepted or not?
q_52189.ground_truth: The PC5 unicast link establishment procedure.

q_52190.question: What command allows the UE to send the EAP-response message to the EAP-request made by the network for a particular PDU session?
q_52190.ground_truth: The execution command 10.1.74 +C5GPDUAUTHR allows the UE to send the EAP-response message to the EAP-request made by the network for a particular PDU session.

q_52191.question: What was the purpose of using a Griffin Technology PowerMate USB Volume Knob during level adjusted measurements and subjective loudness matching?
q_52191.ground_truth: The purpose was to allow control of the playback level during subjective loudness matching.

q_52192.question: What is the format of the pre-Release-8 APN that pre-Release-8 SGSNs still use for discovering Gn/Gp interfaces in a 3GPP network?
q_52192.ground_truth: The pre-Release-8 format APN is still used in pre-Release-8 SGSN DNS queries and continues to be used as a fallback in Release-8 SGSN for discovering Gn/Gp interfaces.

q_52193.question: In what circumstance does the UE set the EPS update status to EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED and deletes certain information in 3GPP TS 24.301, clause 5.6.1.5?
q_52193.ground_truth: When the UE receives a SERVICE REJECT message with the EMM cause set to 'Illegal UE' or 'Illegal ME'.

q_52194.question: What is included in the 5G ProSe Relay Discovery policy/parameters for 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay?
q_52194.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe Relay Discovery policy/parameters for 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay include 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay Discovery parameters, default destination Layer-2 IDs, PDU session parameters, and security related content.

q_52195.question: What must the target eNodeB do if the target cell is a CSG cell and the CSG Membership Indication is "non member"?
q_52195.ground_truth: The target eNodeB only accepts the emergency bearers and rejects the handover with an appropriate cause if the CSG ID provided by the target MME does not match the CSG ID for the target cell.

q_52196.question: What must the UE consider as the access type for a PDU session if the PDU session reactivation result IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message indicates that user-plane resources have been successfully re-established over 3GPP access?

q_52197.question: What is the format of the BroadcastMRBs-ToBeSetup-List object in the BroadcastContextSetupRequest message?
q_52197.ground_truth: The BroadcastMRBs-ToBeSetup-List object is a SEQUENCE of ProtocolIE-SingleContainer objects that contains a set of BroadcastMRBs-ToBeSetup-ItemIEs.

q_52198.question: What is the purpose of the CAPIF routing info API?
q_52198.ground_truth: The CAPIF routing info API allows an API exposing function via CAPIF-3/3e reference point to obtain the API routing information from the CAPIF core function. Functions from 3rd party API provider domain can also access this API routing information with sufficient permissions.

q_52199.question: What should the UE do if the timer value received for timer T3396 indicates zero and no DNN was provided during the PDU session establishment?
q_52199.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T3396 associated with no DNN if it is running, and may send a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message without an DNN.

q_52200.question: What is the role of the MCX user in Step A-3 of the MCX user authentication framework?
q_52200.ground_truth: The MCX client becomes authorized to receive MCX services by obtaining credentials (credential(s)) during Step A-3, which is used in Step A-3 for MCX user service authorization.

q_52201.question: What should the UE do if both timers T302 and "Tbarring" are running and access to the cell is barred?
q_52201.ground_truth: The UE should consider access to the cell as barred.

q_52202.question: What is one potential solution for addressing key issue #11, "Where are my Keys and Confidential Data"?
q_52202.ground_truth: One potential solution is to use a VM (Virtual Machine) to NF (Network Function) binding with specific security resources, such as Hardware Mediated Execution Environment (HMEE), secure compute, and secure memory, to bind a VNF to a specific host or group of hosts. Solutions to enable this requirement are potentially required both inside and outside 3GPP.

q_52203.question: What state exists on the network side when the network has received a call establishment request but has not yet responded for a mobile originating call?
q_52203.ground_truth: The state that exists on the network side when the network has received a call establishment request but has not yet responded for a mobile originating call is "call initiated" (N1).

q_52204.question: What happens during the detach procedure when a UE wants to preserve a subset of the active PDN connections that use a specific access system?
q_52204.ground_truth: The UE initiates the applicable handover procedure to transfer to the access system through which the UE remains attached to the Evolved Packet Core each of the PDN connections to be preserved.

q_52205.question: What message should the UE send to delete the mapped EPS bearer context with cause #45, indicating syntactical errors in packet filter(s)?

q_52206.question: What action must the UE take after receiving a SECURITY MODE COMMAND message with the type of security context flag set to "mapped security context"?
q_52206.ground_truth: The UE must generate K'ASME from both the nonceMME and the nonceUE, or check whether the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message indicates the eKSI of the current EPS security context to avoid re-generating the K'ASME.

q_52207.question: What should the UE do if GNSS is not reliable for sidelink communication when it is out of coverage on the frequency for sidelink communication?
q_52207.ground_truth: If GNSS is not reliable for sidelink communication when the UE is out of coverage on the frequency for sidelink communication, then the UE should perform a full search to detect candidate SLSS on the concerned frequency and evaluate them using layer 3 filtering and the S-RSRP measurement results. If the UE has selected a SyncRef UE, it should compare the S-RSRP of the strongest candidate SyncRef UE with the minimum requirement and select the SyncRef UE with the highest S-RSRP that meets the minimum requirement and belongs to a higher priority group than the current SyncRef UE.

q_52208.question: What is the purpose of the +C5GPU2NRAUTHS command and what are its defined values?
q_52208.ground_truth: The +C5GPU2NRAUTHS command controls the presentation of an unsolicited result code, which displays an authentication message from the network in the form of an EAP message for a particular <rmid> during a UE-initiated authentication and key agreement procedure for 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay. The defined values are disable reporting and enable reporting.

q_52209.question: What is the objective of the "Number of preparations for handovers from 5GS to EPS" measurement?
q_52209.ground_truth: The objective of the "Number of preparations for handovers from 5GS to EPS" measurement is to track the number of preparations requested by the source gNB for the outgoing handovers from 5GS to EPS, with each measurement being a single integer value.

q_52210.question: What state does the UE enter after receiving an ATTACH REJECT message with EMM cause #25?
q_52210.ground_truth: The UE enters the state EMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE.

q_52211.question: What is the procedure for the Link Identifier Update in the context of PC5 unicast communication?
q_52211.ground_truth: The Link Identifier Update procedure is enhanced to support the periodic change of the source/destination UEs identity information carried into the adaptation header, at the same time as the per-hop identifiers (i.e. L2 IDs) and the end-to-end session key identifiers. All identifiers carried together, in cleartext, and that may be associated, need to be changed at the same time.

q_52212.question: Which types of IAB are specified in clause 4.3.1 for Wide Area IAB-DU, Medium Range IAB-DU, and Local Area IAB-DU?
q_52212.ground_truth: Wide Area IAB-DU, Medium Range IAB-DU, and Local Area IAB-DU are specified in clause 4.3.1.

q_52213.question: What is the status code sent by the AAnF if the requested AKMA Application Key information for the UE does not exist?
q_52213.ground_truth: The AAnF shall respond with "204 No Content".

q_52214.question: What should a participating MCVideo function do if it receives a SIP INVITE request for terminating participating MCVideo function and the isfocus media feature tag is not present in the URI of the Contact header field?
q_52214.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function should reject the request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response with the warning text set to "104 isfocus not assigned" in a Warning header field.

q_52215.question: What action should the UE take when it receives a DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message for the default EPS bearer context related to the UE requested bearer resource allocation procedure?
q_52215.ground_truth: The UE should abort the UE requested bearer resource allocation procedure and shall stop the timer T3480 and proceed with the EPS bearer context deactivation procedure.

q_52216.question: What should the UE do in the N1 mode if it supports control plane CIoT 5GS optimization?
q_52216.ground_truth: The UE should set the Control plane CIoT 5GS optimization bit to "Control plane CIoT 5GS optimization supported" in the N1 UE network capability IE of the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.

q_52217.question: What does the "PFD Management" data type represent in the context of the PfdManagement API?
q_52217.ground_truth: The "PFD Management" data type represents a PFD management resource for a PFD management request.

q_52218.question: What is the numerical value used to account for the effect of call-to-call variation in packet arrival time in the evaluation of speech quality loss?

q_52219.question: What is the requirement for cell re-selection for UE category M1 in normal coverage?
q_52219.ground_truth: The UE shall attempt to detect, synchronise, and monitor intra-frequency and inter-frequency cells indicated by the serving cell when the UE is in either Camped Normally state or Camped on Any Cell state.

q_52220.question: What are the potential aspects considered for charging of data volume usage by the additional actor (wholesaler)?
q_52220.ground_truth: The potential aspects considered for charging of data volume usage by the additional actor (wholesaler) are: RAT (Radio Access Technology) type, S-NSSAI (Single Network Slice Selection Assistance Information), DNN (Data Network Name), and QoS (Quality of Service) information.

q_52221.question: What is the role of the 5GMSd Application Provider in the 5GMS architecture?
q_52221.ground_truth: The 5GMSd Application Provider is responsible for provisioning the 5G Media Streaming System, including content ingest and the authorization to distribute 5GMS content via eMBMS.

q_52222.question: What should the SMF do if the PDU session is a non-emergency PDU session, the UE is not registered for onboarding services in SNPN, and the network has received an alternative S-NSSAI from the AMF?
q_52222.ground_truth: The SMF should set the S-NSSAI IE of the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message to the S-NSSAI of the PDU session and the mapped S-NSSAI (in roaming scenarios) in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message.

q_52223.question: What is the purpose and length of the list of UE IP addresses information element?
q_52223.ground_truth: The list of UE IP addresses information element is a type 4 information element with a minimum length of 9 octets and a maximum length of 255 octets, which indicates a list of IP addresses of the UEs.

q_52224.question: What should a UE include in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message if it needs to request LADN information for specific LADN DNN(s)?
q_52224.ground_truth: A UE should include the LADN indication IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message and request specific LADN DNNs by including a LADN DNN value in the LADN indication IE for each LADN DNN for which the UE requests LADN information.

q_52225.question: What action does the NWDAF take when it collects performance measurement data for a network slice instance?
q_52225.ground_truth: The NWDAF may calculate the network slice (instance) load level analytics based on the collected data.

q_52226.question: What should the UE do if it has a valid GUTI and the network indicates that the UE is in network operation mode I?
q_52226.ground_truth: The UE shall map the GUTI into a P-TMSI, P-TMSI signature and RAI and indicate the mapped P-TMSI in the Additional mobile identity IE and the mapped RAI in the Additional old routing area identification IE.

q_52227.question: What should a UE do if it detects a cell on a NR carrier with a physical identity not allowed for that carrier in the measurement control system information?
q_52227.ground_truth: The UE is not required to perform measurements on that cell.

q_52228.question: What should the SIP MESSAGE request include if the <affiliation-required> element is set to "true" and the affiliation is successful in step 1) c)?
q_52228.ground_truth: The SIP MESSAGE request should include the MCPTT ID in the "uri" attribute of the <entry> element in the list of the resource-lists element, and an <mcptt-request-uri> set to the MCPTT group identity to be selected by the MCPTT user.

q_52229.question: Which OIDC feature set is supported by the UE on the carrier of one band entry in a band combination?

q_52230.question: What is the test scenario for the NB-IoT carriers and Ncells?
q_52230.ground_truth: The test scenario comprises of 2 NB-IoT carriers with 1 Ncell.

q_52231.question: When must the UE send the ATTACH REQUEST message with an ESM DUMMY MESSAGE contained in the ESM message container information element?
q_52231.ground_truth: If EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection is supported by the UE and the MME, and the UE does not want to request PDN connection with the attach procedure, the UE must send the ATTACH REQUEST message with an ESM DUMMY MESSAGE contained in the ESM message container information element.

q_52232.question: What is the difference between the NF service discovery in the same SNPN and in the same PLMN?
q_52232.ground_truth: The NF service discovery in the same SNPN and in the same PLMN follows the same principles, but with additional considerations for the target NF being AUSF or NSSAAF and the Nnrf_NFDiscovery_Request including a Home Network Identifier (HNI) in the form of a realm and the HNI belongs to a CH with AAA Server or a DCS with AAA Server.

q_52233.question: What action does the MME take if it receives an SGsAP-ALERT-REQUEST message for an IMSI that is unknown to it?
q_52233.ground_truth: The MME returns an SGsAP-ALERT-REJECT message to the VLR, indicating the SGs cause information element value "IMSI unknown".

q_52234.question: What should be included in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body in the outgoing SIP INVITE request by the controlling MCPTT function?
q_52234.ground_truth: The mcptt-request-uri element set to the MCPTT ID of the terminating user and the mcptt-calling-group-id element set to the adhoc group identity.

q_52235.question: What would the MT return when the EAP session is handled by the UICC and the TE requests to retrieve EAP session parameters / derived keys after a run of the +CEAP command?
q_52235.ground_truth: The MT shall return the content of the elementary file corresponding to the indicated <EAPparameter> if the EAP session is handled by the UICC.

q_52236.question: What is the goal of ensuring uninterrupted MTC service availability during emergencies in microgrids?
q_52236.ground_truth: The goal is to enable mobile communication for the coordination of Distributed Energy Resources (DER) in microgrids, so that they can perform blackout recovery of an islanded microgrid, without giving these devices additional priority over other network users during normal conditions or adversely affecting the service to prioritized users during emergencies.

q_52237.question: What HTTP method is supported by the metrics reporting endpoint?
q_52237.ground_truth: The only HTTP method supported by this endpoint is POST.

q_52238.question: What is the applicable ARFCN channel raster for NR NTN satellite bands below 3 GHz?
q_52238.ground_truth: The applicable ARFCN channel raster for NR NTN satellite bands below 3 GHz is 100 kHz.

q_52239.question: What should the ATCF include in the SIP MESSAGE request when sending the ATGW information for CS to PS SRVCC to the SC UE?
q_52239.ground_truth: The ATCF should include the contact address of the SC UE in the Request-URI, route set towards the SC UE in the Route header fields, STI-rSR in the P-Asserted-Identity header field, and the generated ATGW information for CS to PS SRVCC in the application/sdp MIME body.

q_52240.question: What should be done with all expired PSDKs except the most recently expired one?
q_52240.ground_truth: All expired PSDKs, except the most recently expired one, should be deleted.

q_52241.question: What is the base data type of the "Radius" element in the "EllipsoidArcType" complexType?
q_52241.ground_truth: The base data type of the "Radius" element in the "EllipsoidArcType" complexType is "xs:nonNegativeInteger".

q_52242.question: What must the "targetNamespace" attribute be set to in the XML schema?
q_52242.ground_truth: The "targetNamespace" attribute must be set to "urn:3gpp:ns:sealLocationInfo:1.0" in the XML schema.

q_52243.question: What is the requirement for an implementation regarding supported "Method" PDUs in the SLPP-PDU-Definitions?
q_52243.ground_truth: An implementation needs to include only the supported "Method" PDUs and not supported methods do not need to be included.

q_52244.question: What information does the ePDG include in the Create Session Request for a non-3GPP to 3GPP access handover?
q_52244.ground_truth: The ePDG includes the RAT type, PDN GW address, UE local IP address, and WLAN location information in the Create Session Request for a non-3GPP to 3GPP access handover.

q_52245.question: What is the definition of "BS type 1-C" in the context of the document?
q_52245.ground_truth: BS type 1-C is a NR base station operating at FR1 with requirements set consisting only of conducted requirements defined at individual antenna connectors.

q_52246.question: What are the OMR related SDP attributes that should be supported at the II-NNI?
q_52246.ground_truth: The "visited-realm", "secondary-realm", "omr-codecs", "omr-m-att", "omr-s-att", "omr-m-bw", "omr-s-bw", "omr-s-cksum", and "omr-m-cksum" SDP attributes defined in 3GPP TS 24.229 should be supported at the II-NNI.

q_52247.question: What is the role of the SMF in QoS monitoring?
q_52247.ground_truth: The SMF reports measured packet delay values to the PCF after receiving QoS Monitoring reports from the 5G Core Network.

q_52248.question: What is the process of MBMS user traffic deactivation in visited PLMN?
q_52248.ground_truth: Upon receiving the leave indication, the GGSN sends an STR to the BM-SC in visited PLMN, and it finds the BM-SC in home PLMN which serves the roaming UE. Then the BM-SC in home PLMN verifies the IP multicast address and responds to the BM-SC in visited PLMN. The BM-SC in visited PLMN sends an STA to the GGSN that originated the Leave Indication.

q_52249.question: What action should the MCPTT client take upon receiving a request from an MCPTT user to release an MCPTT ambient listening call when using a pre-established MCPTT session, if it has not received a specific feature capability indicator?
q_52249.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should skip the rest of the steps.

q_52250.question: What is the meaning of the term "AMF" in the document's definitions, and how does it relate to the 5G network?
q_52250.ground_truth: The term "AMF" in the document's definitions stands for Access and Mobility Management Function, which is a key network function for managing network access and user mobility in a 5G network.

q_52251.question: What information does the application specific server send to the UAE server regarding UAVs in proximity?
q_52251.ground_truth: The application specific server sends DAA support information to the UAE server which includes information of other UAVs in the proximity of the UAV.

q_52252.question: What feature enables a single radio UE to communicate in parallel with both the source and target system during SRVCC?
q_52252.ground_truth: The 3GPP2 1xCS IWS feature enables a single radio UE to communicate in parallel with both the source and target system during SRVCC.

q_52253.question: What should a UE do if it has transmitted a MBMSInterestIndication message during the last 1 second preceding detection of radio link failure and SystemInformationBlockType15 is broadcast by the PCell?
q_52253.ground_truth: The UE should ensure having a valid version of SystemInformationBlockType15 for the PCell, determine the set of MBMS frequencies of interest, and initiate transmission of the MBMSInterestIndication message in accordance with 5.8.5.4.

q_52254.question: What generates charging data related to EAS LCM notification in the converged charging architecture with MnS producer enabled by CEF?
q_52254.ground_truth: The CEF generates charging data related to EAS LCM notification in the converged charging architecture with MnS producer enabled by CEF.

q_52255.question: What is the length of the IMEISV when TAC is 8 digits, SNR is 6 digits, and SVN is 2 digits?

q_52256.question: How are the OIP and OIR services authorized for use by the operator in the 3GPP network?
q_52256.ground_truth: The OIP and OIR services are authorized by setting the "authorized" attributes of <operator-originating-identity-presentation> and <operator-originating-identity-presentation-restriction> to "true".

q_52257.question: What restrictions are placed on output timing conformance for H.265/HEVC decoding?
q_52257.ground_truth: There are no requirements on output timing conformance for H.265/HEVC decoding.

q_52258.question: What should the MME indicate to the UE for power saving features if the UE is not required to perform a TAU procedure when the unavailability period has ended?
q_52258.ground_truth: If the UE is not required to perform a TAU procedure when the unavailability period has ended, the MME indicates this to the UE in the Attach Accept or TAU Accept message.

q_52259.question: Which modulation scheme is restricted for the DL-SCH in 7.3.3.2?
q_52259.ground_truth: The maximum modulation scheme is restricted to QPSK for DL-SCH in 7.3.3.2.

q_52260.question: What signalling integrity protection algorithm is optional for UEs and MMEs to implement for 5G networks?

q_52261.question: What type of delivery mechanism is used for Non-IP data when the MME decides to use SCEF based delivery?
q_52261.ground_truth: A PDN connection is established towards the selected SCEF, with the APN used for SCEF based delivery being an FQDN that resolves to an SCEF hostname or to an SCEF IP address.

q_52262.question: What are the main responsibilities of the Data Channel Media Function (DCMF) in the IMS data channel network architecture?
q_52262.ground_truth: The DCMF is responsible for executing IMS data channel media creation and closure, connecting with IMS network media functions and 3rd party data channel media functions as protocol or content gateways, and handling data channel media content transmission.

q_52263.question: What should the TWAG do upon receiving a PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message with request type "handover of emergency bearer services" and without information about a P-GW currently providing emergency bearer services for the UE?
q_52263.ground_truth: The TWAG shall reject the PDN connectivity request procedure including the ESM cause #54 "PDN connection does not exist", in the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message.

q_52264.question: When does the NG-RAN node release the shared delivery in the new procedure?
q_52264.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node does not release the shared delivery if there are UEs in CM-CONNECTED and RRC-Inactive state.

q_52265.question: When should the MTSI terminal consider the sent b=AS bandwidth for a media stream in comparison with the downlink MBR?
q_52265.ground_truth: If the MTSI terminal receives (and possibly sends) a media stream, it should consider the sent b=AS bandwidth(s) in SDP for that media stream in comparison with the downlink MBR.

q_52266.question: What should the network do, if it receives an ATTACH REQUEST message before the ongoing GUTI reallocation procedure has been completed?
q_52266.ground_truth: The network shall proceed with the attach procedure after deletion of the EMM context.

q_52267.question: What is the role of EES #A and EES #B in relation to CAPIF-6?
q_52267.ground_truth: EES #A and EES #B inter-operate with each other via CAPIF-6 for interconnection operations for publication and discovery of Service APIs managed by each EES.

q_52268.question: What should be released and deleted when transitioning from CM-CONNECTED to CM-IDLE state?
q_52268.ground_truth: The gNB/ng-eNB and the UE shall release all radio bearers and delete the AS security context in CM-CONNECTED to CM-IDLE transitions.

q_52269.question: What should the UE do if the application layer ID of the discoveree end UE in the decrypted direct discovery set does not match the application layer ID of the UE provided by the upper layers in the context of UE-to-UE relay discovery?
q_52269.ground_truth: The UE should discard the direct discovery set in this situation.

q_52270.question: What are the components of a session in the 3GPP system?
q_52270.ground_truth: The components of a session in the 3GPP system include Voice, Audio (real-time), Audio (streaming), Video (real-time), Video (streaming), Data (download/upload), Data interactive (e.g. web browsing), Messaging (SMS text type), E-mail, and Data stream (unspecified content).

q_52271.question: When the MCVideo client receives a SIP BYE request to release an MCVideo session, what should the MCVideo client do?
q_52271.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should interact with the media plane and send a SIP 200 (OK) response towards the MCVideo server.

q_52272.question: What should the value of timer T3412 be set to in the UE if it is attached for emergency bearer services and timer T3412 expires?
q_52272.ground_truth: The UE should not initiate a periodic tracking area updating procedure and shall locally detach from the network.

q_52273.question: What is the default value for the parameters not supplied by the user in the EF~SMSP?
q_52273.ground_truth: The parameters stored in the USIM record, if present, shall be used.

q_52274.question: What is the purpose of HARQ feedback in case of NB-IoT UEs or BL UEs or UEs in enhanced coverage?
q_52274.ground_truth: HARQ feedback is used to indicate the success or failure of a bundle's transmission to allow for appropriate retransmissions and eventual successful data delivery.

q_52275.question: Which of the following fields is mandatory in the "UE-associatedLogicalE1-ConnectionItemRes" container?

q_52276.question: What is the use of the "Local Record Sequence Number" field in the CDR generated by a node?
q_52276.ground_truth: The "Local Record Sequence Number" field in the CDR generated by a node provides a unique record number for each partial or whole CDR, which can be used to identify missing records in post-processing.

q_52277.question: What should the receiving side of an AM RLC entity do when it receives a RLC data PDU and places it in the reception buffer?
q_52277.ground_truth: If a RLC data PDU is placed in the reception buffer, the receiving side of an AM RLC entity shall update state variables, reassemble and deliver RLC SDUs to upper layer, and start or stop t-Reordering as needed.

q_52278.question: What is the mechanism-name token for the security mechanism that is defined in 3GPP~TS~24.229 and will form the basis for IANA registration of the value for the mediasec header field parameter?

q_52279.question: What must the source E-UTRAN determine for the Handover Required message when the target is GERAN with DTM support?
q_52279.ground_truth: The source E-UTRAN must determine that the UE is supporting DTM and include the "old BSS to new BSS information IE" in the additional Source to Target Transparent Container for the CS domain.

q_52280.question: At which interfaces are the NR SUL transmission requirements specified?
q_52280.ground_truth: NR SUL transmission requirements are specified at the antenna connector of the UE with a single or multiple transmit antennas, or at the transceiver array boundary (TAB) connectors of the ATG UE with an antenna array. The RF requirements are defined based on the sum of measurement from all antenna connectors or all TAB connectors.

q_52281.question: What performance measurements does the VISP collect related to VNF/VNFCs?
q_52281.ground_truth: The VISP collects performance measurements related to VNF/VNFCs which compose the NOP 5GC NFs, including vCPU usage and vDisk usage, as defined in ETSI GS~NFV-IFA 027 clause 7.

q_52282.question: What is the default bearer establishment procedure for IPv4v6 PDN type when initial attach and deferred IPv4 address allocation is used with the PMIP-based S5/S8?
q_52282.ground_truth: When initial attach and deferred IPv4 address allocation is used for IPv4v6 PDN type, the Serving GW requests both IPv6 network prefix and IPv4 address in the Proxy Binding Update. However, the PDN GW does not assign an IPv4 address during the attach procedure, and the Serving GW responds to the UE by setting the IPv4 PDN Address to 0.0.0.0. The UE may subsequently initiate DHCPv4 procedure to obtain an IPv4 address.

q_52283.question: What should the H-PCF do if there is UE policy information in step 4 when updating the UE policy association?
q_52283.ground_truth: The H-PCF sends an HTTP PUT/PATCH request to the "UEPolicySet" resource, resulting in an HTTP "200 OK" or "204 No Content" response depending on the presence of existing UE policy information.

q_52284.question: What should the originating AS do if the caller is not available for the recall?
q_52284.ground_truth: If the caller is not available for the recall, the originating AS shall suspend the CC request until the caller becomes available again, and send a PUBLISH request to the terminating AS with the specified information to inform it about the caller's basic state.

q_52285.question: For SMS-MO case, what is the originating party address derived from?
q_52285.ground_truth: For SMS-MO case, the originating party address is derived from the TP-DA field for SMS-DELIVER TPDUs or the TP-RA field for SMS-STATUS-REPORT TPDUs. If the originating SMS party is not a GPSI, PEI, or SUPI, the sMSAddress parameter is populated with the octets received in the field used to derive the address.

q_52286.question: What is the purpose of GSMA E/WBI API definition for federation management?
q_52286.ground_truth: GSMA E/WBI API definition provides information on various API and associated parameters and data models to achieve GSMA federation requirements. It provides information on federation management, federation relationship, and federated EAS resource reservation management.

q_52287.question: What is the new MM state if the MS receives a Paging for non-GPRS services during the routing area updating procedure?
q_52287.ground_truth: The MS returns to MM state MM IDLE and proceeds with the appropriate MM specific procedures to respond to the paging for non-GPRS services.

q_52288.question: What is the behavior of the UE when an higher priority UTRAN neighboring cell becomes available and is better ranked than the serving cell during a time interval TreselectionRAT?
q_52288.ground_truth: The UE reselects the UTRA cell if more than 1 second has elapsed since the UE camped on the current serving cell.

q_52289.question: What types of NR UEs does the test case in 6.2.1.2.1.2 apply to?
q_52289.ground_truth: This test case applies to all types of NR UE release 16 and forward supporting either SSB-based or CSI-RS based enhanced beam correspondence without UL beam sweeping.

q_52290.question: What is the test purpose for in-band blocking in shared spectrum channel access as outlined in 7.6F.2.1.2.1?
q_52290.ground_truth: In-band blocking is defined for an unwanted interfering signal falling into the UE receive band or into the first 60 MHz below or above the UE receive band, at which the relative throughput shall meet or exceed the requirement for the specified measurement channel.

q_52291.question: What is the purpose of the Ut reference point in the IMS network?
q_52291.ground_truth: The Ut reference point in the IMS network is used to manage groups from the UE for different services, hosted by different ASs.

q_52292.question: What are the responsibilities of the MOP as a Master Operator in managing shared NG-RAN network elements for cross-operator accounting based on data volume and QoS?
q_52292.ground_truth: The MOP is responsible for managing data volume measurements with high reliability for the used QoS profile criteria and charging the POPs for the data volume used by POP's users per selected QoS profile criteria.

q_52293.question: What decision does the target BSS make regarding resource allocation for PFCs?
q_52293.ground_truth: The decision is implementation specific, but not all downloaded PFCs may receive resource allocation due to resource limitations

q_52294.question: What should the MSGin5G Server do if the received aggregated message is larger than its supported message segment size?
q_52294.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Server should remove individual messages from the end of the aggregated message until it is smaller than the maximum segmentation size that can be transmitted over available transport.

q_52295.question: What is the "Test Flag" parameter in the Warning Message Content NG-RAN used for?
q_52295.ground_truth: The Test Flag parameter in the Warning Message Content NG-RAN may be included to indicate that the request is to be processed and responded to normally, but shall not result in broadcast over the air and shall not allocate any resources.

q_52296.question: What is the maximum number of app payloads that can be multiplexed in the same QUIC packet in MPQUIC steering functionality?
q_52296.ground_truth: When two (or more) app payloads are provided to the MPQUIC steering functionality, these payloads can be multiplexed in the same QUIC packet, thus reducing the user-plane overhead.

q_52297.question: When are Subclauses 12.2.2, 12.2.3, 12.2.3A and 12.2.4 applied for a SC UE after successful completion of the PS to CS SRVCC?
q_52297.ground_truth: These subclauses are applied for a SC UE engaged in one or more ongoing sessions after successful completion of the PS to CS SRVCC procedures.

q_52298.question: What information is provided by the lower layers to NAS regarding the support of emergency services for the UE in a limited service state?
q_52298.ground_truth: The lower layers indicate to NAS whether the network supports emergency services for the UE in a limited service state.

q_52299.question: What is the definition of a GSM security context?
q_52299.ground_truth: A GSM security context is established and stored in the MS and the network as a result of a successful execution of a GSM authentication challenge. The GSM security context consists of the GSM ciphering key and ciphering key sequence number for the CS domain, and GPRS GSM ciphering key and GPRS ciphering key sequence number for the PS domain.

q_52300.question: In case TCP is used for the determined V2X application server address, what should the UE do if a TCP connection with the determined V2X application server address is not established yet?
q_52300.ground_truth: The UE should establish a TCP connection with the determined V2X application server address.

q_52301.question: In Test 4, what should the SS do after receiving the first preamble from the UE?
q_52301.ground_truth: The SS shall transmit a random access response containing a random access preamble identifier corresponding to the transmitted random access after the first preamble has been received by the SS.

q_52302.question: What action does the BSF take if there is an existing PCF for an MBS Session Binding information for the MBS session ID?
q_52302.ground_truth: The BSF rejects the request with an HTTP "403 Forbidden" status code and includes the address of the existing PCF that is handling the MBS session.

q_52303.question: What message does the network send to the mobile station to initiate the CS to PS SRVCC procedure for an in-call handover from UTRAN to E-UTRAN?
q_52303.ground_truth: INTER SYSTEM TO E-UTRAN HANDOVER COMMAND or INTER SYSTEM TO UTRAN HANDOVER COMMAND message.

q_52304.question: What information does the UE maintain during the handover execution period to ensure uplink data continuity when switching between source and target gNBs?
q_52304.ground_truth: The UE maintains a common UL PDCP SN allocation and separates security context and ROHC header compressor context for uplink transmissions towards the source and target gNBs during the handover execution period.

q_52305.question: What is the purpose of the coordination between the ML capabilities in 5G/RAN and the 3GPP management system?
q_52305.ground_truth: The coordination between the ML capabilities in 5G/RAN and the 3GPP management system aims to improve the overall performance by leveraging the strengths of both systems. The 5G/RAN system collects data with finer granularity while the 3GPP management system collects data over a longer range and from a wide scope, resulting in unbiased predictions.

q_52306.question: What service operation is used by an API exposing function to obtain the API routing information from the CAPIF core function?
q_52306.ground_truth: The Obtain_Routing_Info service operation is used by an API exposing function to obtain the API routing information from the CAPIF core function.

q_52307.question: What should the controlling MCPTT function do if the received SIP MESSAGE request is not from a participant of the current group call?
q_52307.ground_truth: If the received SIP MESSAGE request is not from a participant of the current group call, the controlling MCPTT function should generate a SIP MESSAGE request notification of the cancellation of the MCPTT user's emergency call and send it to the member as specified in clause~6.3.3.1.11. It should also set the <emergency-ind> element of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body to a value of "false".

q_52308.question: How many TAIs can the list of forbidden tracking areas accommodate?
q_52308.ground_truth: The list of forbidden tracking areas can accommodate 40 or more TAIs.

q_52309.question: What should the UE do after receiving the NAS Container from the target AMF and deriving the mapped KAMF' key?
q_52309.ground_truth: The UE should associate this mapped 5G security context with ngKSI, derive the 5G NAS keys and KgNB, and use the 5G NAS keys to cipher and integrity protect the Handover Complete message to the target gNB/ng-eNB.

q_52310.question: In step 8c, what is the time interval between the start of CSI reporting for SCell1 and the first available uplink resource for reporting valid CSI, if subframe (m+54) cannot be used?
q_52310.ground_truth: The time interval is up to the end of T2, with certain subframe exceptions for DTX observation.

q_52311.question: What is the role of the MTLF0 with FL Client in the described scenario?
q_52311.ground_truth: The MTLF0 with FL Client is responsible for training the ML model associated with the Analytics ID based on the collected data over the Area of Interest.

q_52312.question: What is the difference between the radio bandwidth and sub-block bandwidth?
q_52312.ground_truth: Radio bandwidth is the frequency difference between the upper edge of the highest used carrier and the lower edge of the lowest used carrier, while sub-block bandwidth is the frequency difference between the upper and lower edges of a sub-block.

q_52313.question: What should the MS do if the network is validated successfully while T3216 is running?
q_52313.ground_truth: The MS should send the AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message to the network and start any retransmission timers if they were running and stopped when the MS received the first failed AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message.

q_52314.question: Under what circumstances is the number of successful tests increased by one?
q_52314.ground_truth: If the overall delays measured from the beginning of time period T2 is less than 25602 ms and at least 99.5% of all expected ACK/NACKS are detected by the system simulator from the start of T1 until the measurement report is received during T2 then the number of successful tests is increased by one.

q_52315.question: Which language has the most speakers worldwide?

q_52316.question: Which complex type has a choice that includes "uaeURI" and "uaeString" elements?
q_52316.ground_truth: The complex type "contentType" has a choice that includes "uaeURI", "uaeString", and "uaeBoolean" elements.

q_52317.question: What are the minimum conformance requirements for clause 6.4B.2.4.4.3 and 6.4B.2.4.4.3?
q_52317.ground_truth: Same minimum conformance requirements as in clause 6.4B.2.4.3.3.

q_52318.question: What should the MCVideo server do if integrity protection has not been successful for the <mcvideo-access-token> element in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body?
q_52318.ground_truth: If confidentiality protection has not been successful for the <mcvideo-access-token> element, the MCVideo server shall determine that confidentiality protection has not been successful.

q_52319.question: What action should the S-NG-RAN node take upon reception of the S-NODE MODIFICATION REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message?
q_52319.ground_truth: Upon reception of the S-NODE MODIFICATION REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message, the S-NG-RAN node shall stop the timer TXnDCprep. If the S-NODE MODIFICATION REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message has included the S-NG-RAN node to M-NG-RAN node Container IE, the M-NG-RAN node is then defined to have a Prepared S-NG-RAN node Modification for that Xn UE-associated signalling.

q_52320.question: What should the AMF do when it receives an NGAP UE Context Release Request with a cause value indicating that the UE is not in PLMN serving area?
q_52320.ground_truth: The AMF may initiate deregistration of the UE.

q_52321.question: What is the main objective of the solution #42: FL (Federated Learning) operation support by 5GS (5G System) based on AF session with required QoS provided by Application Server?
q_52321.ground_truth: The main objective of the solution #42 is to ensure most of the federated learning iterations are successful, generate an optimum global model, and avoid straggling devices by exposing relevant network status/information to aid the Application Function in selecting the FL members with a best chance for a successful iteration.

q_52322.question: What is the vendor identifier value assigned by IANA to 3GPP in the 3GPP specifications?
q_52322.ground_truth: The vendor identifier value assigned by IANA to 3GPP is 10415.

q_52323.question: What is the name of the minimum requirements in this specification that make no allowance for measurement uncertainty?

q_52324.question: In the 3GPP technical specification for LTE positioning, what is a PRS-only TP?
q_52324.ground_truth: In the 3GPP technical specification for LTE positioning, a PRS-only TP is a TP which only transmits PRS signals or DL-PRS for PRS-based TBS positioning and is not associated with a cell.

q_52325.question: What does a UE do while executing a conditional handover procedure in 5G?
q_52325.ground_truth: While executing a conditional handover (CHO), a UE does not monitor the source cell from the time it starts synchronization with the target cell.

q_52326.question: What is the role of SMF Provisioning of available UPFs in the 5G Core network?
q_52326.ground_truth: The SMF Provisioning of available UPFs is responsible for providing a list of available UPFs to the SMF, which may take place while there is no PDU Session to establish. The UPF and the SMF may exchange information during this step, such as the support of optional functionalities and capabilities.

q_52327.question: What is the function of the URSP rule ID?
q_52327.ground_truth: The URSP rule ID is introduced to uniquely identify the URSP rule sent to a UE, and the network is able to know which URSP rule is enforced by the UE for the request.

q_52328.question: What action does the transmission control arbitration logic take when it receives a Transmission End Response message with respect to a specific transmission participant?
q_52328.ground_truth: Upon receiving a Transmission End Response message, the transmission control arbitration logic requests the media distributor to stop forwarding RTP media packets, decreases the Simultaneous transmission video by 1 if it has not reached its lower limit, and enters the 'G: Transmit Idle' state if the Simultaneous transmission video has reached its lower limit. If the active Transmission request queue is not empty, it selects a new Transmission request for the same transmission participant.

q_52329.question: What is the "activated" state in the context of the functional alias for the MCPTT user?
q_52329.ground_truth: The "activated" state indicates that the MCPTT user has activated the functional alias for use.

q_52330.question: What actions will the transmission control server take upon receiving a Transmission request message in the 'G: Transmit Idle' state?
q_52330.ground_truth: Upon receiving a Transmission request message, the transmission control server will first check if the Transmission request is valid. If it is, the server will grant the Transmission request, stop timer T1 and T2, store the User Id of the Transmitting User, allocate and store one globally unique Audio SSRC and one globally unique Video SSRC for the Transmitting user, and enter the 'G: Transmit Taken' state. If the Transmission request is not valid, the transmission control server will reject the Transmission request and remain in the 'G: Transmit Idle' state.

q_52331.question: What is the content of the "Video SSRC of the Transmitting User" field in the Media reception end response message?
q_52331.ground_truth: The content of the "Video SSRC of the Transmitting User" field in the Media reception end response message is coded as the SSRC specified in clause~9.2.3.Y.

q_52332.question: What message does the server send to the target in step 2 of the Periodic Assistance Data Transfer procedure to indicate the update capabilities of the target device which are supported by the server?

q_52333.question: What action should the MCData client take when it detects a change in an MBMS bearer suspension status?
q_52333.ground_truth: The MCData client should generate a SIP MESSAGE request and include the corresponding g.3gpp.icsi-ref media-feature tag and an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-mbms-usage-info+xml MIME body with the mbms-suspension-status element set to "suspending" or "not-suspending", indicating the change in the MBMS bearer suspension status.

q_52334.question: What is the variable Bj used for in the Logical Channel Prioritization procedure?
q_52334.ground_truth: The variable Bj is used to keep track of the incremental total size of MAC SDUs served to logical channel j, which is incremented by the product of PBR (Prioritized Bit Rate) and TTI duration for each TTI, where PBR is Prioritized Bit Rate of logical channel j.

q_52335.question: What action shall the UPF take if it receives a GTP-U Error Indication from the SMF over the N4-u tunnel assigned to the N4 session for data forwarding?
q_52335.ground_truth: The UPF shall initiate PFCP session related requests towards another PFCP entity if it receives a GTP-U Error Indication from the SMF over the N4-u tunnel assigned to the N4 session for data forwarding.

q_52336.question: What must the participating MCPTT function include in the SIP MESSAGE request when sending an initial MBMS bearer announcement?
q_52336.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT function must generate an SIP MESSAGE request in accordance with 3GPP TS 24.229 and IETF RFC 3428 for each MCPTT client that it is sending an MBMS bearer announcement to. The request must include the media lines and attributes required for the bearer announcement and the MBMS subchannel for audio. Additionally, the request must include a P-Asserted-Service header field with the value "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcptt".

q_52337.question: When shall the RAB ID parameter be included?
q_52337.ground_truth: The RAB ID parameter shall be included if MSC-A supports multiple bearers, and the access network protocol is BSSAP with the RAB ID having a value other than 1.

q_52338.question: What is the difference between the Causes in the UEContextModificationIndication and UEContextModificationConfirm?
q_52338.ground_truth: In the UEContextModificationIndication, the Cause can be either reject or ignore, while in the UEContextModificationConfirm, the Cause is always ignore.

q_52339.question: What should the MCVideo server do with the functional alias information entry if there is no corresponding tuple for a served MCVideo ID in the SIP NOTIFY request?
q_52339.ground_truth: The MCVideo server should set the functional alias status of the functional alias information entry to "deactivated" and set the expiration time of the functional alias information entry to the current time.

q_52340.question: Which information element is used to transfer information associated with network-based IP flow mobility?

q_52341.question: What must the UE include in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message if it supports secondary DN authentication and authorization over EPC?
q_52341.ground_truth: The UE must set the SDNAEPC bit to "Secondary DN authentication and authorization over EPC supported" in the 5GSM capability IE of the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message if the UE supports secondary DN authentication and authorization over EPC.

q_52342.question: Which type of AVP is the "MME-Absent-User-Diagnostic-SM" AVP?
q_52342.ground_truth: The "MME-Absent-User-Diagnostic-SM" AVP is of type Unsigned32, indicating a diagnostic describing the absence of the user given by the MME.

q_52343.question: Which service primitive is used by the CM sublayer to support location services at the type A LMU side?
q_52343.ground_truth: The MNLCS_BEGIN_REQ service primitive is used by the CM sublayer to support location services at the type A LMU side.

q_52344.question: What entities are impacted by the implementation of this solution?
q_52344.ground_truth: The entities impacted by the implementation of this solution are the UE and the AMF. The UE supports the unavailability period indication in the registration procedure, and the AMF supports the unavailability period indication in the registration procedure, stores the unavailability period in the UE context, and handles MT data and control plane procedures for UE unreachable.

q_52345.question: When does the UE initiate further MO signalling after a running Service Gap timer, if there is no MT signalling received?
q_52345.ground_truth: The UE initiates further MO signalling after a running Service Gap timer, if there is no MT signalling received, when it moves to ECM-IDLE state and the Service Gap Timer is not running.

q_52346.question: What is the name of the command used to query wireless data services available?

q_52347.question: In what scenario should the MCVideo client include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body in a SIP re-INVITE request?
q_52347.ground_truth: When upgrading an ongoing MCVideo private call to an MCVideo emergency private call.

q_52348.question: In what situations must the I-CSCF select a new S-CSCF?
q_52348.ground_truth: The I-CSCF must select a new S-CSCF when it is unable to contact a selected S-CSCF after a successful user location query response.

q_52349.question: How is the constrained regional probability calculated in the 'arithmetic mean combining' method?
q_52349.ground_truth: In the 'arithmetic mean combining' method, the constrained regional probability is calculated as the average of the PF outcomes of the AoA pairs that the point participates in.

q_52350.question: For how many TDD UL-DL patterns should the performance requirement tests be conducted for IAB-MT, if it supports multiple TDD UL-DL patterns?
q_52350.ground_truth: If IAB-MT supports multiple TDD UL-DL patterns, only one of the supported TDD UL-DL patterns should be used for all tests.

q_52351.question: What is the condition to consider a CQI value as the median CQI value?
q_52351.ground_truth: The median CQI value is the wideband CQI value that is at or crosses 50% distribution from the lower wideband CQI side.

q_52352.question: What is the maximum number of transmissions for a HARQ process when transmitting a MAC PDU stored in the Msg3 buffer?
q_52352.ground_truth: The maximum number of transmissions for a HARQ process when transmitting a MAC PDU stored in the Msg3 buffer is set to maxHARQ-Msg3Tx.

q_52353.question: Which types of NR UE does the test case for wide band intermodulation for 4DL CA apply to?
q_52353.ground_truth: This test case applies to all types of NR UE release 15 and forward that supports 4DL CA.

q_52354.question: What should the participating MCVideo function do when receiving a request from the MCVideo client to originate an emergency group call or imminent peril group call?
q_52354.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function should use common procedures to determine authorization for originating a priority group call when it receives a request from the MCVideo client to originate an emergency group call or imminent peril group call.

q_52355.question: How are the minimum requirements for inter-band carrier aggregation with one component carrier per operating band and the uplink assigned to one E-UTRA band defined, as specified in subclause 7.8.1A?
q_52355.ground_truth: The wide band intermodulation requirements are defined with the uplink active on the band(s) other than the band whose downlink is being tested. The UE shall meet the requirements specified in subclause 7.8.1.1 for each component carrier while all downlink carriers are active.

q_52356.question: What determines the timer value in the service provider option?
q_52356.ground_truth: The user has the possibility to choose a certain timer value within the defined range based on operator policy.

q_52357.question: What is the purpose of Roaming 5G System architecture for U2X communication over PC5?
q_52357.ground_truth: The purpose is to establish a roaming architecture for U2X communication that is based solely on PC5, as there is no local breakout or home routed scenario.

q_52358.question: What is the format of the Decorated NAI as specified in clause 19.3.3 of the document?
q_52358.ground_truth: The Decorated NAI consists of 'homerealm!username@otherrealm' or 'Visitedrealm!homerealm!username@otherrealm'

q_52359.question: How are SCP domains structured and grouped in the SCP trust domain solution?
q_52359.ground_truth: SCP domains are grouped into SCP trust domains, which are supersets of a distinct set of SCP domains operated in the same trust environment based on a security policy. SCP trust domains could be defined by computer center boundaries, subnetwork operators, regions, or specific equipment.

q_52360.question: When would a UE perform cell reselection to a cell on a higher priority RAT than the serving frequency?
q_52360.ground_truth: A UE would perform cell reselection to a cell on a higher priority RAT than the serving frequency if Squal > ThreshX, HighQ during a time interval TreselectionRAT; or if more than 1 second has elapsed since the UE camped on the current serving cell.
