q_52361.question: What should be done if the UE supports DL channel quality reporting in MSG3 and cqi-Reporting is present in SystemInformationBlockType2-NB for a NB-IoT UE?
q_52361.ground_truth: Set the cqi-NPDCCH to include the latest results of the downlink channel quality measurements of the carrier where the random access response is received.

q_52362.question: What should the UE do upon T310 expiry, random access problem indication from MAC, or an indication from RLC that the maximum number of retransmissions has been reached?
q_52362.ground_truth: The UE should consider radio link failure to be detected and store the relevant radio link failure information in the VarRLF-Report.

q_52363.question: What is the function of the NRF in the 3GPP TS 23.501 network?
q_52363.ground_truth: The NRF (Network Function Repository Function) in the 3GPP TS 23.501 network is a network function that manages the registration of other network functions.

q_52364.question: What happens when the UE receives a URSP rule related to the Background Data Transfer Policy?
q_52364.ground_truth: The UE uses the Route Selection Validation Criteria to determine whether or not a PDU Session should be established. The Time Window and Location Criteria are not required to be checked again during the lifetime of the PDU Session. The UE's support of the Validation Criteria in a URSP rule is optional.

q_52365.question: In the context of the registration request message, what does it mean if the "ty IE" is set to "S-NSSAI time validity information supported"?
q_52365.ground_truth: If the "ty IE" is set to "S-NSSAI time validity information supported", it indicates that the S-NSSAI will become available again.

q_52366.question: When must the CSG ID parameter be present in the CSG Cell Selection event?
q_52366.ground_truth: The CSG ID parameter must be present in the CSG Cell Selection event if the UE is camping on a CSG or Hybrid cell in the Allowed CSG list or the Operator CSG list.

q_52367.question: Which algorithm should not be included in the selected security algorithms IEs if the PC5 unicast link signalling integrity protection policy is set to "signalling integrity protection required"?
q_52367.ground_truth: The null integrity protection algorithm should not be included in the selected security algorithms IEs.

q_52368.question: Under what conditions should the MCVideo client inform the MCVideo user and exit the procedure for originating an ambient viewing call?
q_52368.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should inform the user and exit the procedure if the corresponding element in the user profile document is not present or set to "false" for requesting remote-initiated or locally-initiated ambient viewing calls.

q_52369.question: What action does the MS take when the ATTACH REJECT message is received with GMM cause value #7, indicating "GPRS services not allowed", and the message is successfully integrity checked by the lower layers?
q_52369.ground_truth: The MS sets the GPRS update status to GU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, deletes certain information and considers the SIM/USIM as invalid for GPRS services until switching off or its removal.

q_52370.question: What bandwidth is required for the 1.5m@90% requirement (Set A) in distance accuracy of ranging to be achieved with contributions from 2 sources?

q_52371.question: What should the eNB do if the PLMN in the TraceReference does not match any PLMN in its list?
q_52371.ground_truth: The eNB shall ignore the request if the PLMN in the TraceReference does not match any PLMN in its list.

q_52372.question: What is the impact of Service Gap Control on the UE triggered Service Request?
q_52372.ground_truth: Since UE triggered Service Request is prevented by Service Gap timer, this implicitly prevents the UE from initiating UPF anchored Mobile Originated Data Transport in Control Plane CIoT 5GS Optimisation, NEF Anchored Mobile Originated Data Transport, and MO SMS over NAS in CM-IDLE.

q_52373.question: What should the UE do if the carrierFreq is not included in the RRC message?
q_52373.ground_truth: The UE should consider the target PCell to be on the current frequency.

q_52374.question: Which complexType has a complex sequence with a choice between "hAccuracy" and "vAccuracy" elements, and no other elements in that sequence?

q_52375.question: What is the condition for RSRP1 to be considered valid when the UE is in normal coverage?
q_52375.ground_truth: The condition for RSRP1 to be considered valid when the UE is in normal coverage is (T1 - min(480 ms, N DRX cycle)) <= T1' <= (T1 + min(480 ms, NDRX cycle)).

q_52376.question: In NG-RAN/Satellite NG-RAN Intra-frequency measurements, what is the meaning of the '0A' value in NG-RAN/Satellite NG-RAN Inter-frequency measurements?
q_52376.ground_truth: The '0A' value in NG-RAN/Satellite NG-RAN Inter-frequency measurements signifies NG-RAN/Satellite NG-RAN measurements between intra-frequencies in the NextGen (NG) system.

q_52377.question: What message is used to indicate that some error has been detected in the eNB/en-gNB?

q_52378.question: In OpenAPI, what is the purpose of defining enumerations in schema components section?
q_52378.ground_truth: Defining enumerations in schema components section of OpenAPI specification file helps in creating a schema with all defined values for the enumeration, providing a clear description of the enumeration.

q_52379.question: What must the ProSe Function use for the PLMN ID part of the ProSe Application Code or ProSe Application Code Prefix?
q_52379.ground_truth: The ProSe Function must use the MCC and MNC of the PLMN ID of this ProSe Function for the PLMN ID part of the ProSe Application Code or ProSe Application Code Prefix.

q_52380.question: What type of SIP MESSAGE request is sent to the controlling MCPTT function with the Request-URI set to its public service identity, and contains an XML body with an <anyExt> element with the <response-type> set to "group-selection-change-response"?
q_52380.ground_truth: A "SIP MESSAGE request for group selection change response for controlling MCPTT function"

q_52381.question: What action should the MCPTT client take when it receives a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message for the rejected or released call in the "S6: ignoring incoming call announcements" state?
q_52381.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should store the values of the SDP IE, Call identifier IE, Originating MCPTT user ID IE, Refresh interval IE, and Call start time IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message and remain in the "S6: ignoring incoming call announcements" state.

q_52382.question: What is the OTA total power dynamic range test purpose for IAB type 1-O and 2-O?
q_52382.ground_truth: The test purpose is to verify that the total power dynamic range is within the limits specified by the minimum requirement.

q_52383.question: What does the 3GPP Technical Report specify in Release 18?
q_52383.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Report specifies NR support for high speed train scenario in frequency range 2 (FR2) in Release 18.

q_52384.question: What type of attribute is "tra-SCTP-association" and what is its purpose in networks supporting WebRTC-IMS interworking?
q_52384.ground_truth: "tra-SCTP-association" is a media level attribute used in networks supporting WebRTC-IMS interworking to indicate that a media line relates to an SCTP association in the SDP offers and SDP answers when setting up a session with media plane optimization feature.

q_52385.question: What is the role of the AF in providing location dependent MBS?
q_52385.ground_truth: The AF selects MB-SMF for different MBS service areas, creates a location dependent component of an MBS session for each service area, and provides the service area and Area Session ID to the MB-SMF.

q_52386.question: When is the "New data indicator" field 1 bit if the number of scheduled PDSCH is greater than 1?
q_52386.ground_truth: The "New data indicator" field is 1 bit if the number of scheduled PDSCH among all entries in the higher layer parameter pdsch-TimeDomainAllocationListForMultiPDSCH is 1.

q_52387.question: What is the procedure if the UE is connected to both 3GPP access and TWAN and handover of PDN connection(s) to Trusted WLAN is triggered?
q_52387.ground_truth: If the UE is connected to both 3GPP access and TWAN and handover of PDN connection(s) to Trusted WLAN is triggered, the UE shall perform step 5 for each PDN connection that is being transferred from 3GPP access.

q_52388.question: What is the probability of a borderline good User Equipment (UE) being judged as FAIL when the core specification value is relaxed by a relaxation value (TT>0) and the test tolerance is lower than measurement uncertainty and greater than 0 (0 < TT < MU)?
q_52388.ground_truth: The probability of a borderline good UE being judged as FAIL is less than the probability of a borderline bad UE being judged as PASS.

q_52389.question: What is the maximum time to acquire the MIB message for an NR cell on FR1 or FR2?
q_52389.ground_truth: The maximum time to acquire the MIB message for an NR cell on FR1 is 6 x TSMTC ms, and on FR2 is 25 x TSMTC ms.

q_52390.question: What is the main difference between the handset-sized and notebook-sized test volume in the quiet zone ripple test?
q_52390.ground_truth: The handset-sized test volume has a 30 cm diameter and a height of 30 cm, while the notebook-sized test volume has a 50 cm diameter, a height of 36 cm, and more test positions to cover the larger test cylinder.

q_52391.question: When would a second trigger be sent to the CC-POI in the case of asymmetric media?
q_52391.ground_truth: The second trigger would be sent in the case of asymmetric media when the media streams are not received in the reverse direction after the initial media interception, requiring a separate triggering of media interception for the reverse direction.

q_52392.question: What are the two types of random access procedures supported?
q_52392.ground_truth: The two types of random access procedures supported are 4-step RA type with MSG1 and 2-step RA type with MSGA.

q_52393.question: What is the maximum cell re-selection delay time allowed for both low and high priority cells when not at the cell edge?
q_52393.ground_truth: The maximum cell re-selection delay time allowed for both low and high priority cells when not at the cell edge is 79 seconds.

q_52394.question: Which XML Schema describes the extension for transporting wildcarded public user identities, which can be included in the reg event package?
q_52394.ground_truth: The XML Schema with the targetNamespace "urn:3gpp:ns:extRegExp:1.0" defines the extension for transporting wildcarded public user identities.

q_52395.question: What should the Participating MCData function do if there is a media stream removed in the received SDP answer and it is used in the pre-established session?
q_52395.ground_truth: The Participating MCData function shall interact with the media plane as specified in 3GPP TS 24.582 if there is a media stream that is currently used in the pre-established session and it is removed in the received SDP answer.

q_52396.question: What is the length and type of the Location Area Identification information element in 3GPP TS 24.008?
q_52396.ground_truth: The Location Area Identification information element is a type 3 information element with 6 octets length.

q_52397.question: What is the purpose of the NR SA FR2 RRC based active TCI state switch test?
q_52397.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to verify the RRC based active TCI state switch delay requirement specified in clause 7.5.8.0.2.

q_52398.question: What is the purpose of IMEI-TAC in this clause?
q_52398.ground_truth: It is used to differentiate the TAC from the tracking area code when using IMEI or IMEISV.

q_52399.question: What triggers the AMF to discover a NWDAF instance and associate the UE with the NWDAF?
q_52399.ground_truth: The NTN coverage indication in the UE registration procedure's Registration request message triggers the AMF to discover a NWDAF instance and associate the UE with the NWDAF.

q_52400.question: What is the role of 5G security features in the 5G System?
q_52400.ground_truth: The 5G security features include mutual authentication between UE and network, security context generation and distribution, user plane data confidentiality and integrity protection, control plane signaling confidentiality and integrity protection, user identity confidentiality, and LI requirements protection.

q_52401.question: What action does the UE take when the Discovery Response Filter matches the target RPAUID in the ProSe Query Code?
q_52401.ground_truth: The UE may notify the upper layer application about the match event of restricted ProSe direct discovery Model B with the corresponding target RPAUID and metadata.

q_52402.question: What is the role of gNB-CU-CP in the 5GC network?
q_52402.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-CP is the control plane component of the central unit in the 5G Next Generation Radio Access Network (NG-RAN). It serves as the control plane anchor point for user equipment (UE) in the 5G Core (5GC) network.

q_52403.question: What is the name of the enumerated type in the RF-ParametersMRDC to indicate the class of MSD-Information-r18?

q_52404.question: What is the purpose of the test in step 9.2.1.1.13a.1?
q_52404.ground_truth: The purpose of the test in step 9.2.1.1.13a.1 is the same as in clause 9.2.1.1.13.1.

q_52405.question: In what scenarios could a new deferred routing identifier be included in the event report acknowledgment in clause 6.20.4?
q_52405.ground_truth: A new deferred routing identifier may be included in the event report acknowledgment in clause 6.20.4 to change the serving LMF (e.g. if a UE moves into an area that is better supported by a different LMF or if the serving LMF is overloaded) or to enable a default LMF to become a serving LMF, or if location results are needed for event reporting and not received.

q_52406.question: What is the change in the smartphone's service flow once Charlie leaves the stadium?
q_52406.ground_truth: Once Charlie leaves the stadium, the operator Universal does not provide connectivity service over unlicensed spectrum. Therefore, his smartphone is served by the NG-RAN of the operator using licensed bands, as per usual.

q_52407.question: What is the role of the Network Exposure Function (NEF) in service specific parameter provisioning by the Application Function (AF) to the Home Public Land Mobile Network (HPLMN)?
q_52407.ground_truth: The NEF acts as an intermediate between the AF and the HPLMN by performing mappings, authorizing service specific parameter provisioning requests with the UDM, and storing the AF request information in the UDR as "Application Data".

q_52408.question: What is the maximum number of transmissions that can be performed for a MAC PDU stored in the Msg3 buffer, for synchronous HARQ?

q_52409.question: Which solutions address key issue 1j that requires ensuring the level of accuracy for location information?

q_52410.question: Which network functions provide the CC-TF and CC-POI functions in redirected scenarios?
q_52410.ground_truth: The IMS Network Functions that handle the redirected-to-user side of the session provide the CC-TF and CC-POI functions for redirected scenarios.

q_52411.question: What does the <Traffic handling priority> parameter represent?
q_52411.ground_truth: The <Traffic handling priority> parameter specifies the relative importance for handling of all SDUs belonging to the UMTS bearer compared to the SDUs of other bearers.

q_52412.question: What is the purpose of the Fully Qualified PDN Connection Set Identifier (FQ-CSID) in 3GPP TS 23.007?
q_52412.ground_truth: The FQ-CSID is used to identify a set of PDN connections belonging to an arbitrary number of UEs on a MME, SGW, TWAN, ePDG, or PGW in 3GPP TS 23.007. It is used on S5, S8, S2a, S2b, and S11 interfaces.

q_52413.question: What is the requirement for UE when the SSB for BFD measurement in sets or is in the same or adjacent OFDM symbol as SSB for intra-frequency L1-RSRP measurement or inter-frequency L1-RSRP measurement without gap on candidate LTM neighbour cell in the same band?
q_52413.ground_truth: UE is required to measure one of the two SSBs, and longer measurement period for SSB based BFD is expected.

q_52414.question: What is the minimum bandwidth required to achieve a distance accuracy of 1.5m @ 90% (Set A) in ranging?

q_52415.question: What is the purpose of the testing in 8.2.1.2.3?
q_52415.ground_truth: The purpose is to verify the performance of transmit diversity (SFBC) with 2 transmit antennas if the PDSCH transmission in the serving cell takes place in subframes that overlap with ABS of the aggressor cell.

q_52416.question: What is the purpose of the "Registration Area" in UE procedures in idle mode?
q_52416.ground_truth: A NAS registration area is an area in which the UE may roam without a need to perform location registration, which is a NAS procedure.

q_52417.question: What must the PEMC check when it receives a PIN services registration request?
q_52417.ground_truth: The PEMC must check if the PINE is allowed to register new services and if those services are allowed to be offered by the PIN.

q_52418.question: When should the 5GC SBI APIs be designed following the guidelines provided in the present document?
q_52418.ground_truth: The guidelines should be followed when drafting the 5G System SBI Stage 3 specifications.

q_52419.question: What should the SMF do when it determines that the DNN corresponds to a LADN and the UE is outside of the LADN service area?
q_52419.ground_truth: The SMF shall reject the request if the UE is outside of the LADN service area.

q_52420.question: What shall an MTSI client in terminal do if it receives an indication of a reduction in downlink bandwidth allocation and TMMBR and TMMBN are allowed to be used in the session?
q_52420.ground_truth: The MTSI client in terminal shall notify the media sender of the new current maximum bitrate using TMMBR and adjust the sent media rate to the requested rate or lower. After receiving the TMMBN, it shall send a SIP UPDATE to the other party to establish the new rate.

q_52421.question: What actions should the participating MCData function take if it cannot process a disposition notification request from a MCData user due to lack of resources or risk of congestion?
q_52421.ground_truth: The participating MCData function can reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response and include a Retry-After header field in the response.

q_52422.question: When the UE is performing SRS carrier based switching between carriers of different frequency ranges, what is the maximum interruption, in terms of slots, that the UE is allowed on any active serving cell if the UE is not capable of Per-FR gap?

q_52423.question: What is a potential security threat related to the migration of a virtual workload in a 3GPP network?
q_52423.ground_truth: The potential security threat is that a migration of a virtual workload from a secure environment to a less secure environment could occur, potentially allowing for attacks on data while at rest or in transit.

q_52424.question: What is a Diameter Proxy Agent responsible for in the context of the user identity to HSS resolution mechanism?
q_52424.ground_truth: A Diameter Proxy Agent is responsible for determining the HSS identity based on the provided user identity (MSISDN or IMSI) and forwarding the Diameter request directly to the HSS.

q_52425.question: What message does the LMF include in the LCS Periodic-Triggered Invoke Request if DL positioning or RAT independent positioning is indicated for subsequent location reporting events when the UE is in RRC INACTIVE state?
q_52425.ground_truth: The LPP positioning message included in the LCS Periodic-Triggered Invoke Request requests DL location measurements, RAT independent location measurements, or a location estimate based on these location measurements.

q_52426.question: What is the default nominal distance for the HF setting when the manufacturer does not specify it?
q_52426.ground_truth: The nominal distance dHF shall be 42 cm when not specified by the manufacturer.

q_52427.question: What action is taken by the source SGSN when it receives the Forward Relocation Response message?
q_52427.ground_truth: The source SGSN may start downlink N-PDU relay and duplication towards the target eNodeB or via the Serving GW for data forwarding.

q_52428.question: What is the protocol field set to when constructing an IPv4 datagram protected by the ESP protocol in tunnel mode?
q_52428.ground_truth: The protocol field is set to 06H.

q_52429.question: What modification is made in step 2 for emergency sessions?
q_52429.ground_truth: In step 2 for emergency sessions, if the UE indicates handover attach, the UE also indicates handover via EAP-AKA' to 3GPP AAA. And if the UE has been successfully authenticated, the TWAN may select the "PDN GW currently in use for emergency services" as the anchor PDN GW.

q_52430.question: What should the UE do before sending aperiodic L1-SINR measurement reports?
q_52430.ground_truth: The UE should receive a DCI for triggering report before sending aperiodic L1-SINR measurement reports.

q_52431.question: What is the procedure when the user equipment (UE) is in CM-IDLE state and the 3GPP access is available, and the access and mobility management function (AMF) initiates the paging procedure for a network triggered service request?
q_52431.ground_truth: The UE initiates the UE triggered service request procedure when it receives the paging request from the AMF.

q_52432.question: Under what conditions will the AMF include the non-3GPP de-registration timer value IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message?
q_52432.ground_truth: The AMF will include the non-3GPP de-registration timer value IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message only if the REGISTRATION REQUEST message was sent over the non-3GPP access.

q_52433.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for the E-UTRAN FDD - UTRAN FDD handover test in this test case?
q_52433.ground_truth: Instead of A.5.2.1, use A.5.2.11 for the minimum conformance requirements.

q_52434.question: When is it optional for the MCVideo client to include an "a=ssrc" attribute, indicating its preferred RTP SSRC to the MCVideo server for the subsequent RTP audio media flow?
q_52434.ground_truth: It is optional for the MCVideo client to include an "a=ssrc" attribute if it is initiating a call with implicit transmission request and the final RTP audio SSRC value that the client will have to use has not been received.

q_52435.question: What is the name of the message used to request CDMA2000 1xRTT Parameters from the network?

q_52436.question: When must the UE be in State 3A-RF for the test to proceed?
q_52436.ground_truth: The UE must be in State 3A-RF (idle) for the test to proceed.

q_52437.question: What is the purpose of the mac-ContentionResolutionTimer in TS 36.300, clause 10.1.5.1?
q_52437.ground_truth: The mac-ContentionResolutionTimer is used in NB-IoT to indicate when contention resolution on DL is successful, and the timer is stopped.

q_52438.question: What is agreed for resource allocation in frequency-domain for SBFD operation in case of unaligned boundaries between resource block group(s)/reporting subband(s) and SBFD subbands?
q_52438.ground_truth: For SBFD-aware UEs, the part of the DL RBG inside the DL subband can be used and the part of the UL RBG inside the UL subband can be used for better resource utilization, at least for semi-static SBFD.

q_52439.question: What is the purpose of the 3gpp-Sbi-Max-Rsp-Time header in the 3GPP SBI interface?
q_52439.ground_truth: The 3gpp-Sbi-Max-Rsp-Time header indicates the duration expressed in milliseconds since the absolute time indicated in the 3gpp-Sbi-Sender-Timestamp header or the 3gpp-Sbi-Origination-Timestamp header.

q_52440.question: What is the procedure followed by the UE when it receives an EAP-Failure message from the N3IWF?
q_52440.ground_truth: Upon receiving an EAP-Failure message from the N3IWF, the UE deletes any context related to IKE SA without requiring an explicit INFORMATIONAL exchange carrying a Delete payload.

q_52441.question: In UTRAN deactivation mechanisms, what happens to the Trace Session when the Iu connection to the Core Network is released?
q_52441.ground_truth: The Trace Session is deactivated in the RNC when the Iu connection to the Core Network is released.

q_52442.question: What are the two points of reference for the requirements in the AAS BS?
q_52442.ground_truth: The requirements in the AAS BS are defined for two points of reference - Radiated requirements and Conducted requirements.

q_52443.question: What is the purpose of the "Extended LADN information" information element?
q_52443.ground_truth: The "Extended LADN information" information element is included to assign new extended LADN information to the UE or delete the extended LADN information at the UE side.

q_52444.question: What is the UL index LSB value for a slot-PUSCH transmission in slot 4, 15, or 16 that is scheduled with a PDCCH/SPDCCH in which the LSB of the UL index is set to 1?
q_52444.ground_truth: The UL index LSB value is 5.

q_52445.question: What should be the position of the last CSI report received by the SS, relative to subframe (n+8), for the event "Deactivation" to be considered a success in the intra-band PCell TDD case?
q_52445.ground_truth: The last CSI report should be received by the SS earlier than or equal to subframe (n+8) for the event "Deactivation" to be considered a success in the intra-band PCell TDD case.

q_52446.question: What event triggers the SMF to send a notification before activating the UP path towards a new DNAI?
q_52446.ground_truth: A DNAI change in UP path management events.

q_52447.question: What is the purpose of the 'Releasing' state in the floor control arbitration logic of the IWF floor control server?
q_52447.ground_truth: The 'Releasing' state is used by the floor control arbitration logic in the IWF floor control server while waiting for the application and signalling plane to finalize the disconnection of an MCPTT call.

q_52448.question: What types of policies/parameters can be requested in the UE Policy Container for UE triggered 5G ProSe policy provisioning?
q_52448.ground_truth: The types of policies/parameters that can be requested include those for 5G ProSe Direct Discovery, 5G ProSe Direct Communication, 5G ProSe Layer-2 Remote UE, 5G ProSe Layer-3 Remote UE, 5G ProSe Layer-2 UE-to-Network Relay, 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay, 5G ProSe Layer-2 End UE, 5G ProSe Layer-3 End UE, 5G ProSe Layer-2 UE-to-UE Relay, and 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-UE Relay.

q_52449.question: How does the DC Server decide which DC applications to include in the refined DC application list in option B?
q_52449.ground_truth: The DC Server checks the applications against the UE capabilities and includes the validated DC applications in the refined DC application list in option B.

q_52450.question: What is the primary purpose of the ARP in the context of bearer establishment or modification requests?
q_52450.ground_truth: The primary purpose of the ARP is to decide whether a bearer establishment / modification request can be accepted or needs to be rejected due to resource limitations, with the priority level used to ensure that the request of the bearer with the higher priority level is preferred.

q_52451.question: What parameter is used to control the stability and convergence of the MRO algorithm?
q_52451.ground_truth: The Minimum time between Handover Trigger changes is the parameter used to control the stability and convergence of the MRO algorithm.

q_52452.question: What action is taken when a mobile is in the EMM-REGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE substate?
q_52452.ground_truth: The substate EMM-REGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE is chosen in the UE, if it is known that a selected cell is unable to provide normal service.

q_52453.question: What does CACLR represent in a gap between passbands?
q_52453.ground_truth: CACLR in a gap between passbands is the ratio of the sum of the filtered mean power centered on the assigned channel frequencies for the two carriers adjacent to each side of the gap between passbands, and the filtered mean power centered on a frequency channel adjacent to one of the respective passband edges.

q_52454.question: What needs to be established before E2E PC5 link establishment is performed in Layer-2 UE-to-UE Relay?
q_52454.ground_truth: Per-hop links between the Source UE and UE-to-UE Relay, as well as between UE-to-UE Relay and Target UE, need to be established before E2E PC5 link establishment is performed.

q_52455.question: Which type of packets can be more processing intensive for identifying and characterizing PDU sets in HTTP/2 and HTTP/3?
q_52455.ground_truth: Packets that carry multiple streams that are dynamically ordered and possibly encrypted.

q_52456.question: In the scenario described in step 5.4.6, what is the pre-requisite for the retrieval of the IMEI when requested by an IMS-AS?
q_52456.ground_truth: The IMEI for a given UE stored in HSS and UDM is always synchronized. When the HSS detects that the IMEI for a UE changes (e.g. during an Update Location in EPS), the HSS informs the UDM about the IMEI change which stores the new IMEI accordingly. Similarly, when UDM detects that the IMEI changes, the UDM informs the HSS about the IMEI change which stores the new IMEI accordingly. This allows that the retrieval of the IMEI for a given UE requested by an IMS-AS from HSS via Sh can be executed locally by HSS without the need of additional interworking between the HSS and the UDM.

q_52457.question: What should the transmission participant do upon receiving a Transmission End Request message from the transmission control server?
q_52457.ground_truth: The transmission participant should request the media in the MCVideo client to discard any remaining buffered RTP media packets and to stop forwarding of encoded video to the MCVideo server, and send a Transmission End Response message to the transmission control server.

q_52458.question: What type of service operates in ITS spectrum and/or LTE licensed operating bands for communication between vehicles and everything?

q_52459.question: What is the maximum allowed time for a UE to start transmitting a new PRACH after receiving an RRC command during handover with PSCell?

q_52460.question: What is the reporting range for SRS-RSRP and its resolution?
q_52460.ground_truth: The reporting range of SRS-RSRP is defined from -140 dBm to -44 dBm with 1 dB resolution.

q_52461.question: What is the role of rATType in the PDUSessionUsageReport definition?
q_52461.ground_truth: rATType represents the type of technology used in the radio access network for the PDUSession, which can be nr, eutra, nr-unlicensed, e-utra-unlicensed, or other.

q_52462.question: What type of security context flag must be set in the NAS KSI IE for the UE to use the K'ASME to generate the NAS ciphering and integrity keys?
q_52462.ground_truth: The type of security context flag must be set to "mapped security context" in the NAS KSI IE for the UE to use the K'ASME to generate the NAS ciphering and integrity keys.

q_52463.question: In what situation would a CC SETUP message transfer both ongoing full-duplex sessions, one with active and one with inactive speech media component?
q_52463.ground_truth: When there is no ongoing full-duplex session with active speech media component and there is one or more ongoing full-duplex sessions with inactive speech media component, the CC SETUP message initiates the release of all but the most recently inactive session and transfers the active session.

q_52464.question: What happens when MCPTT client 1 finishes transmission and releases the floor in a private call controlled by the LMR system?
q_52464.ground_truth: The media flows from the LMR user to the IWF and on to MCPTT client 1 (7a) and (7b).

q_52465.question: In the Stale Check procedure, what HTTP status code is returned by the NF service consumer in case of partial success when responding to the POST request sent by the UDM?

q_52466.question: What is involved in the message protection functionality of the N32-f interface?
q_52466.ground_truth: The message protection functionality of the N32-f interface involves applying application layer security mechanisms to protect messages exchanged between NF service consumers and NF service producers across PLMNs.

q_52467.question: What must an originating participating MCData function include in the outgoing SIP MESSAGE request when sending it as specified in 3GPP TS 24.229?
q_52467.ground_truth: A P-Asserted-Identity header field set to the public service identity of the participating MCData function.

q_52468.question: What is the identity used for the UE requested ESM procedures and released when the procedure is completed?

q_52469.question: What is the effect of fine-tuning dataset size on positioning error when changing the InF scenario from scenario A to scenario B?
q_52469.ground_truth: The positioning error varies, with a smaller fine-tuning dataset size resulting in a larger positioning error in some cases and a smaller positioning error in others.

q_52470.question: What is the type of the "latitude" and "longitude" elements in the "tPointCoordinate" complex type as defined in the XML schema?
q_52470.ground_truth: The "latitude" and "longitude" elements in the "tPointCoordinate" complex type are of type "sealloc:tCoordinateType", which likely represents a coordinate within a geographical area.

q_52471.question: How should the ePDG handle a downlink IP packet received via an S2b bearer of the PDN connection?
q_52471.ground_truth: The ePDG shall forward a downlink IP packet received via an S2b bearer of the PDN connection using a UE's ESP SPI bound to the S2b bearer. The ePDG shall set the DSCP field of the outer IP header of the ESP packet based on the QCI and ARP of the S2b bearer via which the downlink packet was received.

q_52472.question: What factors can the UDR selection function in UDR NF consumers consider when selecting a UDR instance?
q_52472.ground_truth: The UDR selection function in UDR NF consumers can consider the Data Set Identifier of the data to be managed in UDR, UDM Group ID the UE's SUPI belongs to, SUPI, GPSI or External Group ID, and UDR capability to store application data that is applicable on any UE.

q_52473.question: What is the recommended range for the ARP priority level for QoS Flows within an operator domain?
q_52473.ground_truth: The recommended range for the ARP priority level for QoS Flows within an operator domain is 1 to 8, with 1 being the highest priority.

q_52474.question: What does the UE do with the assistance data received from the LMF in the DL-TDOA positioning method?
q_52474.ground_truth: The UE stores the assistance data for the TRP and maintains the already stored assistance data for other TRPs. If the UE receives assistance data for a TRP for which it has already stored assistance data, it overwrites the stored assistance data.

q_52475.question: What simple type is used to define the tOperationResultType enumeration that can have one of the two values: "Success" or "Failure"?
q_52475.ground_truth: The simple type tOperationResultType defines the enumeration with two possible values: "Sucess" or "Failure" and is used to specify the operation result in various complex types.

q_52476.question: What is the role of the DCAF and its interaction with the UE, NWDAF, and other network entities?
q_52476.ground_truth: The DCAF is responsible for delivering analytics for UEs in the network. It receives analytics requests from the UE via application layer signaling, discovers NWDAF or DCCF for the received analytics request from UE, stores the UE IP address and UE ID mapping information, and sends the received analytics result to UE via application layer signaling.

q_52477.question: What should the IBCF do if the SDP answer contains at least one of the codecs from the original SDP offer?
q_52477.ground_truth: The IBCF shall not invoke the transcoding function.

q_52478.question: In which scenarios are the CAG restrictions for accessing a PLMN's 5GCN not applied?
q_52478.ground_truth: The CAG restrictions are not applied in a PLMN when a UE accesses the PLMN due to emergency services or emergency services fallback.

q_52479.question: What happens to all IMSI records in a VLR when it restarts after a failure?
q_52479.ground_truth: All IMSI records affected by the failure are erased and must be restored individually through "Provide Roaming Number" requests or "Update Location Area" requests for each mobile station.

q_52480.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement specified in Clause 6.5.2.4.1.3 for NR ACLR for SUL?
q_52480.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements specified in Clause 6.5.2.4.1.3 applies to the UE that support SUL operating on the SUL bands. The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.101-1 clauses 6.5.2.4.1.

q_52481.question: In the context of MCPTT, what does the "served MCPTT ID" represent?
q_52481.ground_truth: The "served MCPTT ID" is a unique identifier for an MCPTT user in the MCPTT system.

q_52482.question: Who is responsible for handling the Ethernet layer towards the UE in the "Combo Ethernet + IP" solution?
q_52482.ground_truth: The UPF handles the Ethernet layer towards the UE in the "Combo Ethernet + IP" solution without instructions from the SMF.

q_52483.question: What message does the UE send to the gNB to initiate the LTM procedure?
q_52483.ground_truth: The UE sends a MeasurementReport message to the gNB.

q_52484.question: What information element is used to associate all the messages belonging to the same procedure?

q_52485.question: What should the UE do when timer T3346 is running and a new PLMN is entered while the UE is in state EMM-REGISTERED?
q_52485.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T3346 when initiating mobility management procedures in the new PLMN.

q_52486.question: What happens if the PCEF rejects the establishment of a default bearer in a roaming scenario?
q_52486.ground_truth: If the PCEF rejects the establishment of the default bearer, this implies that Attach via E-UTRAN will fail.

q_52487.question: What should the IP-SM-GW set the Content-Type header to in a SIP MESSAGE request when sending a short message?
q_52487.ground_truth: The IP-SM-GW should set the Content-Type header to "multipart/mixed" in a SIP MESSAGE request when sending a short message.

q_52488.question: What is the interface used by the data streaming and distribution function of the MCData server to send multicast data stream to the DS function of the MCData client in the MCData-DS-3 reference point?
q_52488.ground_truth: The MB2-U interface defined in 3GPP TS 23.468 is used in the MCData-DS-3 reference point.

q_52489.question: What are the two possible ways to represent a user's position in a volumetric scene?
q_52489.ground_truth: A user's position in a volumetric scene can be represented by either a set of X, Y, and Z coordinates in the Cartesian coordinate system or by a translation matrix.

q_52490.question: What interfaces are present in the reference architecture for network slice ordering, provisioning and assurance?
q_52490.ground_truth: The interfaces present in this reference architecture include Interface ITF-1, ITF-2, ITF-3, ITF-4, ITF-5, and ITF-6, which represent inter- and intra-organization interfaces within the network slice management system.

q_52491.question: How does intent translation occur in Intent-driven MnS?
q_52491.ground_truth: Intent translation involves the MnS producer deriving activities for networks and services or other intents based on the MnS consumer's request. This may involve consuming other management services to fulfil or satisfy the intent. Conflicts between the intent and other intents or non-intent requirements must be detected and resolved during the intent translation process.

q_52492.question: What should the TAC element in the IMEI-rangeType element contain?
q_52492.ground_truth: A decimal value with a maximum of 8 digits.

q_52493.question: What should the UE do with the VarConnEstFailReport, if timer T300 expires and the random access procedure failed?
q_52493.ground_truth: The UE should store the connection establishment failure information in the VarConnEstFailReport.

q_52494.question: What is the maximum code block size in the E-UTRA system?
q_52494.ground_truth: The maximum code block size in the E-UTRA system is Z = 6144.

q_52495.question: What should the 5G System support to allow a PIN to use PIN direct connection in non-operator managed spectrum when it has no connectivity to the 5G system?
q_52495.ground_truth: Mechanisms to provision a PIN and collect charging information regarding PIN Elements.

q_52496.question: What is a device that has both a conducted RF interface and a radiated RF interface in the far field and conforms to a hybrid requirements set?

q_52497.question: What does the MC gateway UE do on receiving the MC GW MapGroupToBearer Request message from the MC client?
q_52497.ground_truth: The MC gateway UE maintains the association between the GW MC Service ID and the corresponding MBMS sub channel on receiving the MC GW MapGroupToBearer Request message from the MC client.

q_52498.question: What message is sent from the AMF to the NG-RAN during downlink data delivery in the RRC Inactive state, as an alternative option?
q_52498.ground_truth: The AMF may notify the NG-RAN of MT service, which can trigger the NG-RAN Paging. This message is sent after the UE enters the RRC_CONNECTED mode.

q_52499.question: What should the ePDG do if it supports emergency services and the UE indicated the establishment of an emergency session during the IKEv2 tunnel establishment?
q_52499.ground_truth: The ePDG shall include the Emergency-Services AVP, with the Emergency-Indication bit set, in the authentication and authorization request to the AAA Server.

q_52500.question: What is the role of NEF (Non-3GPP Network Function Entity) in QoS sustainability analytics for V2X communication?
q_52500.ground_truth: NEF corresponds to the NF (Network Function) consumer, and the V2X Application Server acting as an Application Function communicates with the NEF to obtain notifications on QoS sustainability analytics.

q_52501.question: Which element shall be included in the <service-discovery-info> element?
q_52501.ground_truth: A <V2X-UE-id> element or a <result> element shall be included in the <service-discovery-info> element.

q_52502.question: What is the evaluation method for satellite backhaul category and backhaul delay for Solution #1?
q_52502.ground_truth: The satellite backhaul category and backhaul delay need to be stored for charging and statistics reasons in Solution #1.

q_52503.question: In what scenario is the UE allowed to initiate the Session Management procedures for high priority access and emergency services even when the Session Management back-off timer is running?
q_52503.ground_truth: When the UE needs to establish a session for high priority access or emergency services, it can still initiate the Session Management procedures even if the back-off timer is currently running.

q_52504.question: When will a UE not perform measurements of E-UTRAN inter-frequencies or inter-RAT frequency cells of equal or lower priority?
q_52504.ground_truth: A UE will not perform these measurements if Snonintrasearch is sent in the serving cell and SServingCell is greater than or equal to Snonintrasearch.

q_52505.question: What should an SGW do when it receives a Create Session Request message for a UE for which some S5/S8 bearers are maintained?
q_52505.ground_truth: The SGW should delete all the bearers for this UE and proceed with the Create Session Request message handling as specified in 3GPP TS~29.274.

q_52506.question: What is the RRC Reject message protection solution's goal to address key issue #1 "Security of unprotected unicast messages"?
q_52506.ground_truth: The goal of the solution is to ensure that a UE is able to determine the authenticity of the RRC Reject message from the gNB, regardless of RRC states.

q_52507.question: What are the conditions for the Random Access Preamble in Test 1?
q_52507.ground_truth: The Random Access Preamble shall be one of the Random Access Preambles associated with SSB index 0, arrive on a PRACH occasion which belongs to the PRACH occasions corresponding to the SSB with index 0, and the selected PRACH occasion shall belong to the PRACH occasions permitted by the restrictions given by the ra-ssb-OccasionMaskIndex.

q_52508.question: How does the controlling MCPTT function determine the public service identity for a terminating participating MCPTT function associated with the targeted MCPTT user in a partner MCPTT system?
q_52508.ground_truth: The document does not provide details on how the controlling MCPTT function determines the public service identity.

q_52509.question: In what circumstances should a UE not average CSI-RS measurements in subframe n1 with CSI-RS measurements in subframe n2 for a LAA Scell?
q_52509.ground_truth: The UE should not average CSI-RS measurement in subframe n1 with CSI-RS measurement in a later subframe n2, if any OFDM symbol of subframe n1 or any subframe from subframe n1+1 to subframe n2, is not occupied.

q_52510.question: What message does the MN send to the SN to indicate a change in the bearer context, such as adding, modifying, or releasing SCG bearer(s) or SCG RLC bearer(s)?

q_52511.question: What is the responsibility of P-CSCF in the origination procedures for a session?
q_52511.ground_truth: P-CSCF determines the next hop toward the Serving-CSCF and performs resource authorization. It may have additional functions in handling emergency and priority sessions. Upon registration, P-CSCF determines the name/address of the next hop in the signalling path toward the serving-CSCF.

q_52512.question: If the UE fails to establish a PDU Session with any of the Route Selection Descriptors, what does the UE try next?
q_52512.ground_truth: The UE tries other URSP rules in the order of Rule Precedence with matching Traffic descriptors, except the URSP rule with the "match-all" Traffic descriptor, if any.

q_52513.question: What must the SGM-S do when it receives a group creation request with the "category" attribute value of "LOCATION_BASED"?
q_52513.ground_truth: The SGM-S must obtain the list of users based on the location provided in the "geoIds" attribute and include it in the group document. Additionally, the SGM-S must create a new individual group member resource for each new member in the group.

q_52514.question: What is the IP mobility management selection when the UE provides an indication of its supported mobility modes during handover between accesses?
q_52514.ground_truth: The network makes the IPMS decision on handover to non-3GPP accesses based on the supported mobility modes between the two access technologies involved in the handover and the network's support for those modes.

q_52515.question: What action does the AMF take if it receives a Service Request that cannot be accepted by the network?
q_52515.ground_truth: The AMF responds with a Service Reject message to the UE.

q_52516.question: In which situations does the MAC entity need to flush the HARQ buffer of the identified HARQ process?
q_52516.ground_truth: When no MAC PDU has been obtained for the identified HARQ process and the uplink grant is not ignored.

q_52517.question: What should the UE do if it has an emergency PDU session established or is establishing an emergency PDU session and receives the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message before the timeout of timer T3520?
q_52517.ground_truth: The UE shall deem that the network has passed the authentication check successfully, stop timer T3520, respectively, and execute the security mode control procedure.

q_52518.question: What is the data type of the "ace-enabled-indicator" element in the "RestrictedDiscReq-info" and "RestrictedAnnounceRsp-info" complex types?
q_52518.ground_truth: The data type of the "ace-enabled-indicator" element in both the "RestrictedDiscReq-info" and "RestrictedAnnounceRsp-info" complex types is xs:integer.

q_52519.question: In what scenario will the MME return an SGsAP-PAGING-REJECT message with "IMSI unknown" as the cause?
q_52519.ground_truth: When the MME does not support MT CS services delivery via an alternative MME in the MME pool and the CS restoration indicator is not set in the SGsAP-PAGING-REQUEST message.

q_52520.question: What is the purpose of providing "link-specific multipath" IP addresses/prefixes in the context of MPTCP and MPQUIC functionalities in the UPF?
q_52520.ground_truth: The "link-specific multipath" IP addresses/prefixes are provided for the UE to establish UDP subflows with the MPTCP and MPQUIC proxy functionalities in the UPF.

q_52521.question: What is the duration of the transient period between two SRS resources of an SRS resource set for antenna switching for 15kHz, 30kHz, and 60kHz SCS?
q_52521.ground_truth: The transient period between two SRS resources of an SRS resource set for antenna switching for 15kHz, 30kHz, and 60kHz SCS is one symbol.

q_52522.question: What procedure does the AMF indicate to the UDM if the UE is registering for localized services?
q_52522.ground_truth: The AMF indicates to the UDM that the UE is registering for localized services, and the UDM uses the indication whether to accept UE registration.

q_52523.question: What is the purpose of the Service-level-AA response information element?
q_52523.ground_truth: The Service-level-AA response information element provides information regarding the service level authentication and authorization request, e.g. to indicate that the authentication and authorization request to the service level authentication server was successful, or to notify that service level authorization is revoked.

q_52524.question: What does the extension part of an AMD PDU header consist of, when present?
q_52524.ground_truth: The extension part of an AMD PDU header consists of E(s) and LI(s) when present.

q_52525.question: Which UE releases does the 9.2.29 test apply to?
q_52525.ground_truth: The 9.2.29 test applies to all types of E-UTRA FDD UE release 12 and forward.

q_52526.question: How can conformance to the AAS BS spurious emission requirements be demonstrated for single RAT E-UTRA operation?
q_52526.ground_truth: Conformance to the AAS BS spurious emission requirements can be demonstrated by meeting at least one of the following criteria as determined by the manufacturer for single RAT E-UTRA operation: (1) the sum of emissions power measured on each Tab connector in the Tab connector TX min cell group is less than or equal to the AAS BS limit, or (2) unwanted emissions power at each Tab connector is less than or equal to the AAS BS limit, scaled by -10log10(n), where n is the number of Tab connectors in the Tab connector TX min cell group.

q_52527.question: In "EFPLMNwAcT (User controlled PLMN selector with Access Technology)", what does the "Access Technology Identifier" specify?
q_52527.ground_truth: The Access Technology Identifier specifies the radio access technology (e.g. GSM, UMTS, LTE) of the PLMN that the user has selected.

q_52528.question: What is the purpose of SS activating TCI state 0 and TCI 1 for PDSCH in step 1.3.2?
q_52528.ground_truth: The purpose of SS activating TCI state 0 and TCI 1 for PDSCH in step 1.3.2 is to verify the behavior of the UE when two TCI states are activated simultaneously.

q_52529.question: What method should an AF use to request the creation of an MBS session?
q_52529.ground_truth: An AF should send an HTTP POST request to the NEF to request the creation of an MBS session, with the request message body including the MbsSessionCreateReq data structure.

q_52530.question: What step in the process is performed by the W-AGF when the FN-RG connects to a W-AGF via a layer-2 (L2) connection?
q_52530.ground_truth: The W-AGF selects an AMF based on the AN parameters and local policy.

q_52531.question: What is the maximum RLR at the maximum volume control setting for headset UE?
q_52531.ground_truth: The maximum RLR at the maximum volume control setting for headset UE should be 13 dB.

q_52532.question: What should be the test signal mean power level so that the noise floor does not impact the SNR at the SAN receiver?
q_52532.ground_truth: The test signal mean power should be adjusted to ensure that the calibrated radiated SNR value at the SAN receiver is as specified in clause~11.3.3.2.5.1 and clause~11.3.4.5.1, and that the SNR at the SAN receiver is not impacted by the noise floor.

q_52533.question: What should be included in the SIP request for initiating an MCData emergency private communication?
q_52533.ground_truth: In the SIP request for initiating an MCData emergency private communication, an <emergency-ind> element set to "true" should be included in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body.

q_52534.question: When the CC-POI is expected to populate the SDP Session Description field of X3 PDU with the SDP information received in the LocalSDP?
q_52534.ground_truth: The CC-POI is expected to populate the SDP Session Description field of X3 PDU with the SDP information received in the LocalSDP for the xCC that represent the incoming media streams destined to the IP address and UDP port number specified as the target identifiers.

q_52535.question: What is the role of PDCCHs in the procedure?
q_52535.ground_truth: PDCCHs in the procedure are used to send new transmissions continuously on E-UTRA PCell, PSCell, and SCell to ensure that the UE will have ACK/NACK sending. They are also used to trigger PSCell DL BWP switch and SCell DL BWP switch to switch bandwidth part from BWP-1 to BWP-2.

q_52536.question: What is the purpose of the MAXCELLINEBN and MAXCELLINENGB constants in the ServedEUTRAcellsENDCX2ManagementList data type within END-DC X2 SETUP REQUEST?
q_52536.ground_truth: The MAXCELLINEBN constant represents the maximum number of cells in an ENB, while MAXCELLINENGB represents the maximum number of cells in an ENG-B. These constants define the size of the servedEUTRAcellsENDCX2ManagementList data type used in the END-DC X2 SETUP REQUEST message.

q_52537.question: In what cases does SMF select a DNAI during the process?
q_52537.ground_truth: SMF selects a DNAI during the process when no DNAI could be used in step~5 for the group.

q_52538.question: What is the reporting requirement for Propagation Delay Compensation in an FR2 cell if the PRS or TRS for PDC measurement is QCLed with active TCI state for PDCCH/PDSCH?
q_52538.ground_truth: There are no scheduling restrictions due to PDC measurement performed based on PRS or TRS.

q_52539.question: What is the process of data forwarding scenario "2" specified in clause 5.3.1 for supporting user plane data forwarding from the CP function to the UP function?
q_52539.ground_truth: The CP function provisions a PDR in the UP function that matches the received user plane packets from the downlink direction.

q_52540.question: What is the main difference between rasterization and ray-traced rendering?
q_52540.ground_truth: Rasterization focuses on enabling real-time rendering at a desired quality, while ray tracing is used to mimic light transmission to produce more realistic images.

q_52541.question: What is the condition that the throughput measurement must meet in the test procedure?
q_52541.ground_truth: The throughput measurement must be greater than or equal to 95% of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channels.

q_52542.question: What is the role of the OCS in the IMS Network Element?
q_52542.ground_truth: The OCS (Online Charging System) is responsible for granting service units in the IMS Network Element, such as during session establishment, updates, and termination.

q_52543.question: What should the MCData client do when the timer TDU2 (FD non-mandatory download timer) expires and the FD request is deferred?
q_52543.ground_truth: No action is taken by the MCData client if the FD request is deferred.

q_52544.question: What is the role of the ISC gateway function in terms of addressing?
q_52544.ground_truth: The ISC gateway function exists on a one-to-one basis with its addressed AS, meaning that the URI used to address the ISC gateway function will always reach the same AS beyond the ISC gateway function.

q_52545.question: What is the consequence of failing to meet the requirements in this test?
q_52545.ground_truth: If a requirement is not met, it can lead to the test failing, indicating that the UE does not meet the required specifications for NR SA FR2 SS-RSRP measurement accuracy.

q_52546.question: What are the physical channels defined in the downlink and uplink of the NR radio interface?
q_52546.ground_truth: The physical channels defined in the downlink are the Physical Downlink Shared Channel (PDSCH), the Physical Downlink Control Channel (PDCCH), and the Physical Broadcast Channel (PBCH). The physical channels defined in the uplink are the Physical Random Access Channel (PRACH), the Physical Uplink Shared Channel (PUSCH), and the Physical Uplink Control Channel (PUCCH).

q_52547.question: What entities in the UE interact with upper layers with respect to the URSP?
q_52547.ground_truth: Each of the 5GSM entities in the UE shall indicate attributes of a newly established PDU session to the upper layers if the URSP requires interaction between upper layers and the 5GSM entities in the UE.

q_52548.question: What should be employed for the support of SIPTO service for eHRPD access?
q_52548.ground_truth: Topological naming should be employed to find the shortest user plane path from the HSGW to the PGW based on the topological closeness.

q_52549.question: When will the UE transmit a NACK for the entire bundle in the subframe?
q_52549.ground_truth: The UE will transmit a NACK for the entire bundle in the subframe if the SS transmits a MAC PDU, causing CRC fail on UE side.

q_52550.question: What is the structure of the PDUSessionResourceFailedToSetupListHOAck data type, which is a sequence of PDUSessionResourceFailedToSetupItemHOAck?
q_52550.ground_truth: Each instance of PDUSessionResourceFailedToSetupItemHOAck contains a PDUSessionID, a HandoverResourceAllocationUnsuccessfulTransfer, and an optional ProtocolExtensionContainer.

q_52551.question: What does the V-PCF do when generating VPLMN URSP rules in a roaming scenario?
q_52551.ground_truth: When generating VPLMN URSP rules, V-PCF uses the LBO information (such as DNN/S-NSSAI and SSC mode) received from the AMF to derive Route Selection Descriptors. If the V-PCF receives the VPLMN precedence range from the H-PCF, it assigns the precedence values of VPLMN URSP rules within the received range.

q_52552.question: What information is included in the AS registration request?
q_52552.ground_truth: The AS registration request includes the requestor identifier, security credentials of the AS, the AS service identifier of the service associated with the AS, and the connectivity information of the AS.

q_52553.question: What is the role of EES#1 in the ACR procedure for bundled EAS located on multiple EES within the same EHE?
q_52553.ground_truth: EES#1 is responsible for notifying the associated EES#2 with the need for application context relocation and ensuring that the target EES(s) are in the same EHE by performing retrieve T-EES and T-EAS discovery procedures. It also determines the target EHE for the bundled EAS and performs T-EAS discovery.

q_52554.question: What is the role of a Media Session Handler in the 5GMS system?
q_52554.ground_truth: A Media Session Handler, in the context of 5GMS, is responsible for requesting maximal authorized bit rate and minimal authorized packet loss rate values.

q_52555.question: What are the possible response messages from the BM-SC when updating a session using the HTTP PATCH method?
q_52555.ground_truth: The possible response messages are a 200 success message indicating that the session is successfully updated, or a 204 No Content success message without any message content. If the update failed, the BM-SC may send a 401 message, 403 message, or 404 message.

q_52556.question: What should the User Equipment (UE) do when a reset of the MAC entity is requested by upper layers?
q_52556.ground_truth: The UE should initialize Bj for each logical channel to zero, stop all timers, consider timeAlignmentTimer as expired and perform the corresponding actions, stop ongoing RACH procedure, discard explicitly signalled ra-PreambleIndex and ra-PRACH-MaskIndex, flush Msg3 buffer, cancel any triggered Scheduling Request, Buffer Status Reporting, or Power Headroom Reporting procedure, flush the soft buffers for all DL HARQ processes, consider the next received transmission for a TB as the very first transmission, and release any Temporary C-RNTI.

q_52557.question: Which clause in TS 36.331 provides the conformance requirements for measuring the handover performance in an intra frequency handover scenario?
q_52557.ground_truth: The conformance requirements for measuring the handover performance in an intra frequency handover scenario are covered in TS 36.331, clause 4, 5.3.5.6, 5.3.7.2, and 5.5.6.1.

q_52558.question: What should the MCData client include in the Request-URI of the SIP REFER request when establishing an adhoc group session within a pre-established session?
q_52558.ground_truth: The Request-URI should be set to the public service identity identifying the pre-established session on the MCData server serving the MCData user.

q_52559.question: What is the meaning of the first bit in the Media Flow value?
q_52559.ground_truth: The first bit in the Media Flow value indicates whether the user wants to stop or resume the reception of unicast media. When it is set to '0', it indicates a unicast media stop request, and when it is set to '1', it indicates a unicast media resume request.

q_52560.question: When is the scaling factor for NR PRS-based measurement in the positioning frequency layer i not equal to 1 or n if the UE is requested to measure a PRS resource with multiple Rx TEGs?
q_52560.ground_truth: The scaling factor is equal to n if the UE is not capable of receiving the same DL PRS resource simultaneously from multiple Rx TEGs, and it is equal to n0 if the UE is capable of receiving the same DL PRS resource simultaneously from multiple Rx TEGs, where n is the number of Rx TEGs or RxTx TEGs with which UE is requested to measure a PRS resource, and n0 is the maximum number of Rx TEGs with which UE can support to measure the same PRS resource.

q_52561.question: What information does an EAS instance provide during registration with an Edge Enabler Service (EES)?
q_52561.ground_truth: An EAS instance provides its capabilities and availability information such as time and location constraints during registration with an EES.

q_52562.question: What are the two actions a user can take regarding User Identifiers in their user profile?
q_52562.ground_truth: A user can activate or deactivate User Identifiers, as well as suspend their use temporarily.

q_52563.question: How does PSA UPF mark ECN bits for L4S?
q_52563.ground_truth: PSA UPF uses information sent by NG-RAN in GTP-U header extension to perform ECN bits marking for L4S for the corresponding direction.

q_52564.question: What message does the DN-AAA send to the SMF+PGW-C in the case of home routed to initiate the accounting procedure?
q_52564.ground_truth: The DN-AAA sends the Accounting-Accept message to the SMF+PGW-C in the case of home routed to initiate the accounting procedure.

q_52565.question: What is the purpose of defining high-quality specifications in the context of multivendor interoperability?
q_52565.ground_truth: High-quality specifications ensure seamless communication and functionality between products or services from different vendors, enabling interoperability.

q_52566.question: What is the recommended information to provide in the MPD for a dynamic service without MPD updates?
q_52566.ground_truth: It is recommended to provide values for MPD@timeShiftBufferDepth and MPD@suggestedPresentationDelay in the MPD for a dynamic service without MPD updates.

q_52567.question: What is the measurement parameter that defines the measurement period for the UL and DL of the Data Volume and Scheduled IP Throughput measurements made by the eNB in LTE?
q_52567.ground_truth: The measurement parameter is called "Measurement Period LTE."

q_52568.question: What should the SS do after receiving the MeasurementReport message during the test?
q_52568.ground_truth: After receiving the MeasurementReport message, the SS should transmit a RRCConnectionRelease message to release the RRC connection, which includes the release of the established radio bearers as well as all radio resources.

q_52569.question: What is the format of the V2X Control Function FQDN?
q_52569.ground_truth: The V2X Control Function FQDN is composed of six labels, "v2xcontrolfunction.epc.mnc<MNC>.mcc<MCC>.3gppnetwork.org", where <MNC> and <MCC> are 3 digits long and uniquely identify the PLMN.

q_52570.question: What information must a UE store when it receives the ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message from the network?
q_52570.ground_truth: The UE must store the S-NSSAI and related PLMN ID provided in the message.

q_52571.question: What is the procedure for re-activating PDU sessions, when the 5G NAS security context used by the UE is non-current in the AMF (Access and Mobility Management Function)?
q_52571.ground_truth: The UE shall transmit a NAS Registration Request message, which is integrity protected using the NAS COUNT values and NAS connection identifier associated with the access. The AMF shall delete any existing current 5G security context and make the used 5G security context the current one. The gNB/ng-eNB shall send an AS SMC to the UE to activate AS security, and the UE shall use the uplink NAS COUNT to derive the KgNB. This is further described in sub-clause 6.2.3.1 to derive the RRC and UP protection keys. The same procedure is applied if the UE connects to a different AMF. Additionally, if the AMF selects different NAS algorithms, a NAS Security Mode Command is sent to the UE, requiring it to verify the integrity of the NAS SMC using the algorithm ID from the NAS SMC and protect the NAS SMC Command and NAS SMC Complete messages with the new NAS keys.

q_52572.question: What is the required MPR for PSFCH with single RB transmission for PC3 NR V2X UE?
q_52572.ground_truth: The required MPR for PSFCH with single RB transmission for PC3 NR V2X UE is 3.5 dB.

q_52573.question: What is the role of the CAPIF core function upon receiving an HTTP DELETE message for deregistering an API provider domain function?
q_52573.ground_truth: The CAPIF core function determines if the request sent by the API management function is authorized, and if authorized, deletes the resource representation and related API provider domain profile.

q_52574.question: What does the Serving GW do when the Modify Bearer Request does not indicate ISR Activated and the S-GW is not changed in the handover procedure?
q_52574.ground_truth: The S-GW deletes any ISR resources by sending a Delete Bearer Request to the other CN node that has bearer resources on the S-GW reserved.

q_52575.question: What is the implication of the "authorization before allowing access to resources" solution on AUSF and UDM?
q_52575.ground_truth: The solution extends AKMA security for Resource Owner registration and security establishment, impacting AUSF and UDM.

q_52576.question: What parameters does SM need to have to activate the PDP contexts at inter-system change from S1 mode to A/Gb mode or Iu mode?
q_52576.ground_truth: SM needs the parameters LLC SAPI, radio priority, transaction identifier, and R99 QoS at inter-system change from S1 mode to A/Gb mode, and the transaction identifier and R99 QoS at inter-system change from S1 mode to Iu mode.

q_52577.question: Which measurement provides the average temperature over the measurement period in the context of 5G Network Architecture?
q_52577.ground_truth: "Average Temperature" provides the average temperature over the measurement period in the context of 5G Network Architecture.

q_52578.question: What should the participating MCVideo function do upon receiving a "SIP INVITE request for originating participating MCVideo function" with an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body and the <session-type> element set to a value of "adhoc"?
q_52578.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function should check the MCVideo ID of the calling user, validate the media parameters, check if the maximum simultaneous MCVideo group calls has been exceeded, determine the public service identity of the controlling MCVideo function, and follow the steps specified in the procedure.

q_52579.question: What should the MS initiate after the expiration of timer T3247?
q_52579.ground_truth: After the expiration of timer T3247, the MS shall erase certain lists, set the SIM/USIM to valid for non-GPRS and GPRS services, perform relevant actions specific to the S1 and N1 modes, and initiate a location updating procedure, GPRS attach procedure, routing area updating procedure, or PLMN selection.

q_52580.question: What should the UE do when it has uplink user data pending during a tracking area updating procedure?
q_52580.ground_truth: The UE may set an "active" flag in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message to indicate the request to establish the user plane to the network and to keep the NAS signalling connection after the completion of the tracking area updating procedure.

q_52581.question: What should be done by an MTSI client in terminal that supports EVS codec when offering up to WB?
q_52581.ground_truth: When the EVS codec is offered for up to WB, it should be listed before other WB codecs by an MTSI client in terminal that supports EVS codec.

q_52582.question: In section 8.4.2.2, what is the root element for the per-client restrictions of presence event package notification information?
q_52582.ground_truth: The root element for the per-client restrictions of presence event package notification information is <filter-set>.

q_52583.question: What devices does John use to monitor his heart rate and glucose levels?
q_52583.ground_truth: John uses a heart rate monitoring device provided by his cardiologist and a glucose monitoring device provided by his endocrinologist.

q_52584.question: What must the MME indicate in the EPS network feature support IE if it decides to accept the CIoT EPS optimization and attach request?
q_52584.ground_truth: The MME must indicate "control plane CIoT EPS optimization supported" in the EPS network feature support IE.

q_52585.question: In what situation does NRF return candidate client NWDAFs to the server NWDAF?
q_52585.ground_truth: NRF returns candidate client NWDAFs to the server NWDAF whose permitted-server-NWDAF list for this Analytics ID includes the server NWDAF.

q_52586.question: What is the main objective of the echo cancellation in UE and what are the two main impairments it can introduce?
q_52586.ground_truth: The main objective of the echo cancellation in UE is to fulfil the Acoustic echo control requirements. The two main impairments it can introduce are suppression of echo, which may introduce distortion or clipping of the near-end signal during simultaneous speech from both the far and near-end (double-talk).

q_52587.question: What protocol is used by the MPQUIC-IP steering functionality to apply the Load-Balancing steering mode for an IP flow and transmit packets in a per-packet round-robin fashion?
q_52587.ground_truth: The multipath QUIC protocol is used by the MPQUIC-IP steering functionality to apply the Load-Balancing steering mode for an IP flow and transmit packets in a per-packet round-robin fashion.

q_52588.question: What is the mandatory gap pattern length (MGL) used in the test described in section 16.6.2.9.2?
q_52588.ground_truth: The mandatory gap pattern length (MGL) used in the test described in section 16.6.2.9.2 is 3 ms.

q_52589.question: What is the requirement for the measurement reporting delay in measurement reporting procedure?
q_52589.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay is defined as the time between an event that will trigger a measurement report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface.

q_52590.question: Which NR and E-UTRA band default channel bandwidths are specified in clause 6.2.3.2 for EN-DC signalling testing?
q_52590.ground_truth: The default channel bandwidths for EN-DC signalling test are specified per NR and E-UTRA band in clause 6.2.3.2.

q_52591.question: What is a specific capability that a conference ID would be used for in interactions between the AS and MRFC?
q_52591.ground_truth: The specific capability that a conference ID would be used for in interactions between the AS and MRFC is connecting other endpoints in INVITE messages in a multi-party call.

q_52592.question: What determines how many times an IE may appear in an object set?
q_52592.ground_truth: The presence field in an object determines how many times an IE may appear in an object set (exactly once for "mandatory", at most once for "optional" or "conditional").

q_52593.question: What precondition must be met for the Serving GW to accept and forward TAD filters to the PCRF in the extended TFT filter format?
q_52593.ground_truth: The PCRF declaration of support for the extended TFT filter format

q_52594.question: How does the node that creates the FQ-CSID ensure its global uniqueness in 3GPP TS 23.007?
q_52594.ground_truth: The node that creates the FQ-CSID is responsible for making sure the Node-ID is globally unique and the CSID value is unique within that node in 3GPP TS 23.007.

q_52595.question: In Iu mode, what should the MS use to derive the IDNNS parameter for the PS domain if it is E-UTRAN capable?
q_52595.ground_truth: The E-UTRAN capable MS should use the P-TMSI parameter to derive the UTRAN IDNNS parameter for the PS domain.

q_52596.question: What happens if the NAT message contains an End Indication and no further data or signalling is expected with the UE?
q_52596.ground_truth: The NG-RAN delivers the NAS payload over RRC to the UE and releases the logical NG-AP signalling connection and RRC signalling connection if no further activity is detected.

q_52597.question: What is the purpose of the "Cells-to-be-Deactivated-ExtIEs" in the "Cells-to-be-Deactivated-ExtIEs" F1AP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION?
q_52597.ground_truth: The "Cells-to-be-Deactivated-ExtIEs" in the "Cells-to-be-Deactivated-ExtIEs" F1AP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION is used to extend the IEs of a "Cells-to-be-Deactivated-List-Item" with additional information.

q_52598.question: How does the 5GC deliver MBS traffic between the 5GC and NG-RAN?
q_52598.ground_truth: The 5GC has two possible delivery methods to transmit MBS data between the 5GC and NG-RAN: 5GC Individual MBS traffic delivery method and 5GC Shared MBS traffic delivery method. The 5GC Individual MBS traffic delivery method is used to deliver separate copies of MBS data packets to individual UEs, while the 5GC Shared MBS traffic delivery method delivers a single copy of MBS data packets to an NG-RAN node which then delivers the packets to one or multiple UEs.

q_52599.question: What factors affect the authorization of access token requests by an SCP on behalf of an NF Service Consumer?
q_52599.ground_truth: Authorization is based on the local authorization policy of the SCP and NFs.

q_52600.question: What should the floor participant interface do when it receives a Floor Request message from the MCPTT floor participant?
q_52600.ground_truth: The floor participant interface should send the Floor Request message to the floor control server interface and remain in the 'P: has no permission' state.

q_52601.question: What is the definition of Sidelink Control period in the context of wireless communication?
q_52601.ground_truth: The Sidelink Control period is the period over which resources are allocated in a cell for sidelink control information and sidelink data transmissions.

q_52602.question: What are the main parameters used to control cell re-selection algorithms in idle and inactive modes?
q_52602.ground_truth: The parameters used to control cell re-selection algorithms in idle and inactive modes are thresholds and hysteresis values that define the best cell and determine when the UE should select a new cell.

q_52603.question: What must the Diameter Accounting client function reside in for 3GPP access network?
q_52603.ground_truth: The Diameter Accounting client function may reside in a GGSN/P-GW in a 3GPP access network.

q_52604.question: What action does the MME take if the TAU Request message includes a Release Request indication?
q_52604.ground_truth: The MME does not activate the user plane setup procedure in the subsequent steps and triggers the S1 release procedure after the completion of the TAU procedure.

q_52605.question: What is the purpose of the service request procedure in EPS services with control plane CIoT EPS optimization?
q_52605.ground_truth: To transfer the EMM mode from EMM-IDLE to EMM-CONNECTED mode, establish the radio and S1 bearers when user data or signalling is to be sent, or invoke MO/MT CS fallback or 1xCS fallback procedures.

q_52606.question: Which type of cause is used to indicate rejection in the "Cause" field for the NASNonDeliveryIndication-IEs NGAP-PROTOCOL-IES section?

q_52607.question: Which bit in Octet 5 indicates the presence of the Number of UE IPv6 Addresses field?

q_52608.question: What is the function of the transmitting window in the AM RLC entity?
q_52608.ground_truth: The transmitting window in the AM RLC entity determines whether a Sequence Number (SN) of a data unit falls within the allowed range for transmission.

q_52609.question: What shall the AMF do if the initial registration request is rejected due to CAG restrictions for a UE that supports CAG?
q_52609.ground_truth: The AMF shall set the 5GMM cause value to #76 "Not authorized for this CAG or authorized for CAG cells only" and should include the "CAG information list" in the CAG information list IE or the Extended CAG information list IE in the REGISTRATION REJECT message if the initial registration request is rejected due to CAG restrictions for a UE that supports CAG.

q_52610.question: What kind of data is defined in clause 6.1.6.3.2?
q_52610.ground_truth: Simple data types are defined in clause 6.1.6.3.2.

q_52611.question: What is the condition to apply other actions related to the activation command for a SCell?
q_52611.ground_truth: The other actions related to the activation command should be applied once the SCell is activated at the first opportunities.

q_52612.question: In what circumstances should the UE change the source layer-2 ID and source IP address when initiating V2X communication over PC5?
q_52612.ground_truth: When the V2X service requires privacy for V2X communication over PC5, the UE should change the source layer-2 ID and source IP address when timer T5020 expires or when the application layer identifier is changed.
