q_52613.question: What is the piece of assistance data provided in the barometric pressure sensor assistance data from the LMF to the UE in Barometric pressure sensor positioning of 3GPP 5G?
q_52613.ground_truth: The barometric pressure sensor assistance data from the LMF to the UE includes reference pressure, reference barometric pressure validity point, and reference temperature at the reference point in Barometric pressure sensor positioning of 3GPP 5G.

q_52614.question: What status code is used by an UDM to redirect a service request to a different UDM?
q_52614.ground_truth: An UDM can redirect a service request to a different UDM using an 307 Temporary Redirect or 308 Permanent Redirect status code.

q_52615.question: What is the benefit of using accuracy analytics from NWDAF in the Location Estimation Accuracy analytics aspect?
q_52615.ground_truth: The locations services can benefit from NWDAF by receiving Location Estimation Accuracy analytics, including horizontal or vertical accuracy and indoor/outdoor indication, which can be used by the LMF to determine the Position Method in the area where a UE is located and by the Location client to determine the requested LCS QoS class or adjust application specific parameters.

q_52616.question: What are the units for Mn, Off, and Ocr in event C2?
q_52616.ground_truth: Mn is expressed in dBm, Off, and Ocr are expressed in dB for event C2.

q_52617.question: What is the purpose of mapping 5GS <MCC> to E-UTRAN <MCC> in the UE?
q_52617.ground_truth: The purpose is to keep the same mobile country code (MCC) when a UE moves from 5GS to E-UTRAN.

q_52618.question: What should the participating MCData function do if the payload size is larger than the maximum allowed size?
q_52618.ground_truth: The participating MCData function should reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response, including warning text indicating that the message is too large to send over the signalling control plane.

q_52619.question: What is the role of the Serving GW within the PMIPv6 tunnel, when the UE is accessing a PDN connection and acquiring a network prefix shorter than a /64 prefix?
q_52619.ground_truth: The Serving GW acts as a DHCPv6 relay agent, relaying the DHCPv6 solicit message from the UE to the PDN GW.

q_52620.question: In the context of video encoding, what does VBR/CAE stand for?
q_52620.ground_truth: Variable Bit Rate encoding following the principle to keep the quality constant.

q_52621.question: What is the procedure when EEC-1 sends a Selected EAS announcement request?
q_52621.ground_truth: EEC-1 sends a Selected EAS announcement request with AC ID, EASID, EAS endpoint, and UE ID to the selected EES-1, which is determined based on the selected EAS. The request may include Group ID IE if this information is present in Step-2.

q_52622.question: In what scenario will the AMF not forward the 5GSM message to the SMF during the network slice-specific re-authentication and re-authorization procedure?
q_52622.ground_truth: If the UE requests the establishment of a new PDU session or the modification of a PDU session for an S-NSSAI for which the AMF is performing network slice-specific re-authentication and re-authorization procedure.

q_52623.question: When should a UE ignore the Back-off timer value provided by the network?
q_52623.ground_truth: The UE should ignore the Back-off timer value if the 5GSM cause value is #50, #51, #57, #58, or #61.

q_52624.question: What should the UE do when upper layers request a PDCP entity suspend for a SLRB in NR sidelink communication for groupcast and broadcast?
q_52624.ground_truth: The UE has the flexibility to release the receiving PDCP entity for an SLRB in NR sidelink communication for groupcast and broadcast up to implementation.

q_52625.question: What are the three main elements determining the corresponding delivery mechanism when using 5G MBS for MC services?
q_52625.ground_truth: The three main elements determining the corresponding delivery mechanism when using 5G MBS for MC services are the Application Function (AF), 5GC, and NR-RAN.

q_52626.question: In which subframe should the UE adjust the timing of its uplink transmission timing if a timing advance command is received in sub-frame n?
q_52626.ground_truth: UE shall adjust the timing of its uplink transmission timing at sub-frame n+12 for a timing advance command received in sub-frame n.

q_52627.question: What is the role of the SMF in generating QoS rules for a PDU Session of unstructured type?
q_52627.ground_truth: The SMF generates a single PCC rule that allows all packets for a PDU Session of unstructured type, and the QoS Flow associated with the default QoS rule exists.

q_52628.question: Who should use the option of providing a URI when the domain part belongs to the current P-CSCF or S-CSCF provider?
q_52628.ground_truth: It is suggested that UEs only use this option when the domain part belongs to the current P-CSCF or S-CSCF provider.

q_52629.question: What is the purpose of the "CellInformation-Item" in the loaded information?
q_52629.ground_truth: The "CellInformation-Item" in the loaded information is a sequence of information related to a cell, including cell-ID, uplink interference overload indication, uplink high interference indication information, relative narrowband transmission power, and iE-Extensions.

q_52630.question: What must a node that supports partial failure handling feature do if it is aware that the receiver does not support the feature?
q_52630.ground_truth: A node that supports partial failure handling feature must not send any FQ-CSID IE or any partial failure handling specific messages to the peer node if the sender is aware that the receiver does not support the feature.

q_52631.question: What is the purpose of the test in 5.2A.2.1.2.1?
q_52631.ground_truth: The purpose of the test in 5.2A.2.1.2.1 is to verify the normal PDSCH demodulation performance for 2Rx in CA with 3DL CA for both SA and NSA.

q_52632.question: What message does the MME/SGSN send to the SCEF in step 2a of clause 5.6.3.1 of the procedure for reporting Monitoring Events by the MME/SGSN or HSS?
q_52632.ground_truth: A Monitoring Indication (SCEF Reference ID(s), Monitoring Event Report, User Identity) message

q_52633.question: What is the data type of the id-NG-RANnode1MobilityParameters field in the MobilityChangeRequest-IEs?
q_52633.ground_truth: The data type of the id-NG-RANnode1MobilityParameters field in the MobilityChangeRequest-IEs is MobilityParametersInformation.

q_52634.question: What is the HTTP status code that the NF service consumer sends when making a successful GET request to retrieve an existing "Individual MBS Policy" resource at the PCF?
q_52634.ground_truth: The PCF shall respond with an HTTP "200 OK" status code when successfully retrieving an existing "Individual MBS Policy" resource from the PCF.

q_52635.question: When should the MME include the extended DRX parameters IE in the tracking area update accept message?
q_52635.ground_truth: The MME should include the extended DRX parameters IE in the tracking area update accept message only if the extended DRX parameters IE was included in the tracking area update request message and the MME supports and accepts the use of eDRX.

q_52636.question: What is the requirement for the UE to indicate handover in the Identification Data payload of the Handover Attach message when performing handover from E-UTRAN to ePDG?
q_52636.ground_truth: The UE is required to indicate handover in the Identification Data payload of the Handover Attach message when performing handover from E-UTRAN to ePDG by including the IDR payload containing the APN in the Identification Data, the IDi payload containing the NAI.

q_52637.question: What information is used by the PCF (Policy Control Function) to issue the Network Load Monitoring policy?
q_52637.ground_truth: The PCF issues the Network Load Monitoring policy and QoS policies associated with network load levels.

q_52638.question: What is the response code that the system should return if the SIP PUBLISH request is for activation of a functional alias and the number of activations for the handled functional alias is equal to the maximum simultaneous activations?
q_52638.ground_truth: The system should return a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response to the SIP PUBLISH request.

q_52639.question: What should the non-controlling MCVideo function of an MCVideo group do if the group document retrieved from the group management server indicates that there are on-network-required group members for an ongoing prearranged group call?
q_52639.ground_truth: The non-controlling MCVideo function of an MCVideo group should send a SIP 183 (Session Progress) response to the SIP INVITE request for non-controlling MCVideo function of an MCVideo group and populate the response with a MIME body containing the <required> element set to "true".

q_52640.question: What trigger conditions upon which a UE may execute CHO to a candidate cell in NTN are supported in addition to the RRM measurement-based event A4?
q_52640.ground_truth: A time-based trigger condition and a location-based trigger condition are also supported for CHO to a candidate cell in NTN.

q_52641.question: In Collaboration Scenario 3, what are the responsibilities of the 5GMSu AF when interacting with the 5G System?
q_52641.ground_truth: The 5GMSu AF is responsible for interacting with the 5G System for dynamic policy invocation and other uplink streaming related network features such as metrics reporting and network assistance.

q_52642.question: What action should the UE take upon receiving the ATTACH ACCEPT message with EMM cause value #2 (IMSI unknown in HSS) in 5.5.1.3.4.2?
q_52642.ground_truth: The UE shall set the update status to U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, delete any TMSI, LAI and ciphering key sequence number, and enter state EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE.

q_52643.question: What is the function of the EEC in Solution #29?
q_52643.ground_truth: The EEC in Solution #29 performs the authentication and authorization procedures with EES and generates a nonce with related parameters. It also derives the shared credential with the same inputs as the network side for future use such as API invocation between the EEC and the EES.

q_52644.question: What is the role of the MB-SMF in the MBS session establishment process?
q_52644.ground_truth: The MB-SMF is responsible for deciding whether to establish the MBS session towards the radio, registering itself at the NRF as handling the source specific multicast address, and informing the SMF about the establishment of the MBS session towards the radio.

q_52645.question: What should the UE do when the temporary SIP level lifetime of the temporary set of security associations expires without receiving the 200 (OK) response in GPRS-IMS-Bundled authentication?
q_52645.ground_truth: The UE shall consider the registration to have failed, delete the temporary set of security associations it was trying to establish, and use the old set of security associations. The UE should send an unprotected REGISTER request if it considers the old set of security associations to be no longer active at the P-CSCF.

q_52646.question: What is the pre-test condition for the System Simulator in the context of the test case for eCall Only mode with EPS supporting IMS voice over PS session and EPS supporting emergency service?
q_52646.ground_truth: Cell A is set as the serving cell, and System information combination 10 is used in E-UTRA cells. The SS broadcasts IMS Emergency Call support in System Information Block Type 1 on Cell A and eCall over IMS support in System Information Block Type 1 on Cell A.

q_52647.question: In the 5G system, what is required to ensure end-to-end security for energy services that involve different security domains, such as sensors at the edge of the utility network?
q_52647.ground_truth: For end-to-end security of energy services involving different security domains, this scenario requires application-level security, such as TLS or another transport layer security mechanism, and encryption at the application layer. Additionally, the communication service provider must work closely with the service platform to ensure a secure connection that meets the energy company's security requirements.

q_52648.question: What is the purpose of Communication Diversion (CDIV) as a subset of Communications Diversion (CDIV) services?
q_52648.ground_truth: Communications Diversion (CDIV) is a subset of Communications Diversion (CDIV) services that fulfill specific requirements based on PSTN/ISDN supplementary services for IP based networks.

q_52649.question: In the intra-band PCell FDD case, what is the condition for increasing the number of successes for the event "Activation"?
q_52649.ground_truth: The number of successes for the event "Activation" is increased by one when all the conditions specified in step 8a are met.

q_52650.question: What is the required time alignment error (TAE) for the UTRA TDD test requirement?
q_52650.ground_truth: The time alignment error shall be less than 65 + 78 ns.

q_52651.question: What is the expected overall delay for UE supporting power class 1 in Test 5.6.2.8.4?
q_52651.ground_truth: The overall delay measured should be less than 10082 ms in Test 5.6.2.8.4 for UE supporting power class 1.

q_52652.question: Which HTTP methods does the "EEC Contexts" resource support, as per clause 8.7.2.2.3 of the document?
q_52652.ground_truth: The "EEC Contexts" resource supports GET and POST methods.

q_52653.question: What are the two recordings used to produce the speech quality loss metric?
q_52653.ground_truth: A recording obtained in jitter and error free conditions (reference condition), and a recording obtained during the application of packet arrival time variations and packet loss (test condition).

q_52654.question: What transport channels are supported in the downlink physical-layer processing in LTE?
q_52654.ground_truth: The downlink physical-layer processing in LTE supports DL-SCH, BCH, PCH, and MCH, with transport-channel specific scrambling.

q_52655.question: What is the standard measurement window for the cross-correlation function in the calculation of sidetone delay?
q_52655.ground_truth: The standard measurement window for the cross-correlation function in the calculation of sidetone delay is the test signal period, which is T.

q_52656.question: What UE-stored information is included in the RRCConnectionReestablishmentRequest message when the re-establishment procedure is triggered due to radio link failure or handover failure?
q_52656.ground_truth: When the re-establishment procedure is triggered due to radio link failure or handover failure, the UE sets the reestablishmentCellId in the VarRLF-Report to the global cell identity of the selected cell. The UE then sets the reestablishmentCause in the RRCConnectionReestablishmentRequest message to the value of handoverFailure.

q_52657.question: What is the primary difference between DL UE-assisted NR carrier phase positioning and UL UE-assisted NR carrier phase positioning in terms of the reference signals used?
q_52657.ground_truth: DL UE-assisted NR carrier phase positioning uses DL PRS signal(s), while UL UE-assisted NR carrier phase positioning uses UL SRS signal(s)

q_52658.question: Which attribute is mandatory in the "usage-information-report" element in the XML schema?
q_52658.ground_truth: The "sequence-number" attribute is mandatory in the "usage-information-report" element in the XML schema.

q_52659.question: What must the NF Service Consumer send to request the SMF to create a SM context during UE Registration procedure with I-SMF or V-SMF insertion, change, and removal?
q_52659.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer must send a POST request with additional information including the smContextRef, upCnxState, and smfUri.

q_52660.question: What is the data type of the "transaction-ID" element in the "RestrictedDiscReq-info" complex type?
q_52660.ground_truth: The data type of the "transaction-ID" element in the "RestrictedDiscReq-info" complex type is xs:integer.

q_52661.question: What is the meaning of "SLR" in the list of abbreviations?

q_52662.question: When an SCP discovers a notification endpoint, what should it use to select or reselect the notification endpoint?
q_52662.ground_truth: The SCP should use the 3gpp-Sbi-Discovery* headers, including the notify or callback service operation, API major version, type of notification, N1 Message Class or N2 Information Class, and type of the consumer NF.

q_52663.question: What is the recommended way to indicate recommendations and permissions in 3GPP Technical Reports?
q_52663.ground_truth: The recommended way to indicate recommendations and permissions in 3GPP Technical Reports is to use "should" and "may," respectively.

q_52664.question: What is the requirement for the angle of arrival for the incident wave of a received signal and interfering signal in the context of BS type 1-O OTA ACS testing?
q_52664.ground_truth: The angle of arrival for the incident wave of a received signal and interfering signal should be from the same direction and within the minSENS RoAoA for BS type 1-O OTA ACS testing.

q_52665.question: Which factors may be considered during SMF selection?
q_52665.ground_truth: The Selected Data Network Name (DNN), S-NSSAI of the HPLMN or VPLMN, NSI-ID, access technology being used by the UE, and local operator policies.

q_52666.question: What is the state of the TWAG when PDN connectivity to EPC is established and the WLCP bearer context is active?
q_52666.ground_truth: PDN CONNECTIVITY ESTABLISHED and WLCP BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE in the TWAG.

q_52667.question: What are the media components that 3GPP terminals may support in addition to the scope of the present document?
q_52667.ground_truth: 3GPP terminals may support more than conversational speech, video and text, which is the scope of the present document. However, for the Multimedia Telephony Service for IMS, the present document specifies only conversational speech, video and text support.

q_52668.question: What information should the TNAP advertise per SSID about the slices that the TNGF(s) reachable by the corresponding SSID support?
q_52668.ground_truth: The TNAP should advertise this information via ANQP "3GPP Cellular Network" information that indicates "5G connectivity". The advertising method and format will be decided at the TR conclusion phase.

q_52669.question: What is the resulting QoS hint value for loss=0.02 and latency=600 in the SDP answer?

q_52670.question: What is the maximum length of <number> field that can be written to the phonebook memory?
q_52670.ground_truth: The maximum length of <number> field depends on the specific storage being used and is provided by the TEST command.

q_52671.question: What is the purpose of the "Recording Entity Number" field in the CDR?
q_52671.ground_truth: The "Recording Entity Number" field in the CDR contains the E.164 number assigned to the entity that produced the record. It is used for identifying the entity that produced the record.

q_52672.question: In what priority order should the UE reselect cells when multiple cells of different priorities meet the criteria?
q_52672.ground_truth: The UE should reselect cells in the following order: highest-priority frequency first, followed by the highest-priority frequency(ies) meeting the criteria.

q_52673.question: What HTTP status code is returned when the NF Service Consumer updates the resource representation provided in the PUT request?

q_52674.question: When can one-to-many ProSe direct communication apply?
q_52674.ground_truth: One-to-many ProSe direct communication can only apply when the UE is served by E-UTRAN and is authorized for ProSe direct communication in the registered PLMN. It is applicable only to ProSe-enabled Public Safety UEs.

q_52675.question: What is the role of the CC-POI in intercepting media in an IMS network?
q_52675.ground_truth: The CC-POI is responsible for performing media interception at a specific point in the IMS network, as determined by the IP address and UDP port number provided by the CC-TF.

q_52676.question: What is the action taken when a new instance of the 'dual floor control operation' state machine is initiated?
q_52676.ground_truth: When a new instance of the 'dual floor control operation' state machine is initiated, before any floor control related input is applied, the state machine is in the 'Start-stop' state.

q_52677.question: What does the "PDU Session Resources To Be Setup List" IE contain in the context of transferring UE context between NG-RAN nodes?
q_52677.ground_truth: This IE contains PDU session resource related information used during the transfer of UE context between NG-RAN nodes.

q_52678.question: When can the network initiate the abort procedure for an ongoing MM connection?
q_52678.ground_truth: The abort procedure may be invoked by the network when at least one MM connection exists or is being established.

q_52679.question: What should the gNB-CU do if the NR RedCap UE Indication IE is included in the INITIAL UL RRC MESSAGE TRANSFER message?
q_52679.ground_truth: If supported, the gNB-CU should consider that the accessing UE is a RedCap UE

q_52680.question: Which message does the MME receive from the E-SMLC to request the transfer of a LPP request to a target UE?

q_52681.question: What is a potential solution to the lack of reporting per-direction and per-DRB per-UE MDT measurements?
q_52681.ground_truth: A potential solution is to enhance the existing trace data file XML schema to include per-DRB and per-direction information as part of the existing element "meas" and add optional "direction" and "drb" attributes to indicate the measurement along with the direction (UL/DL) and the DRB number.

q_52682.question: Who is responsible for allocating and releasing the F-TEID in EPC and 5GC?
q_52682.ground_truth: The UP function is responsible for allocating the F-TEID, and it shall be only allocated by the UP function for EPC and 5GC. Upon request to remove a PDR or a Traffic Endpoint, or to delete a PFCP session, the UP function shall free the F-TEID(s) that was assigned to the PDR if there is no more PDR with the same F-TEID, to the Traffic Endpoint or to the PFCP Session.

q_52683.question: What should the MCPTT client include in the SIP re-INVITE request if the MCPTT user is cancelling an in-progress emergency condition and an MCPTT emergency alert originated by the MCPTT user?
q_52683.ground_truth: The MCPTT client shall include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body populated as specified in clause~6.2.8.3.6.

q_52684.question: What is the formula used to calculate the time duration for MAC-CE based TCI state switch delay for a UE in FR1 without antenna arrays support?
q_52684.ground_truth: The formula is: first slot that is after slot n+ THARQ + + TOk*(Tfirst-SSB + TSSB-proc) / NR slot length, where THARQ is the timing between DL data transmission and acknowledgement, Tfirst-SSB is time to first SSB transmission after MAC CE command is decoded, TSSB-proc = 2~ms, and TOk = 1 if target TCI state is not in the active TCI state list for PDSCH, 0 otherwise.

q_52685.question: What is the data type of the "network-initiated-transaction-method" attribute in the "prose-direct-discovery-response" complexType?
q_52685.ground_truth: The data type of the "network-initiated-transaction-method" attribute is "xs:integer".

q_52686.question: What action does the H-PCRF take when acknowledging a gateway control session for a roaming UE in the home routed case?
q_52686.ground_truth: The H-PCRF includes the selected BCM, applicable QoS rules, and event triggers in the CCA and sends it to the V-PCRF.

q_52687.question: In what situation is the back-off timer used for secondary PDP context activation?
q_52687.ground_truth: The back-off timer is used to model the required MS behavior for secondary PDP context activation when attempting to re-establish bearer resources after receiving a reject in selected PLMN and APN.

q_52688.question: When the SMF receives an EAS re-discovery request from the AF, what must the SMF send to the AF?
q_52688.ground_truth: The SMF must send an indication to the AF that an EAS re-discovery request has been sent to the UE.

q_52689.question: What is the purpose of the "GlobalGNB-ID" protocol data unit (PDU) in the ENB-ENDCX2SetupReqIEs data type within EN-DC X2 SETUP REQUEST?
q_52689.ground_truth: The GlobalGNB-ID is used to uniquely identify the EN-DC X2 interface's signalling of the EUTRA/NR cell managed by the EN-DC X2 interface as a Block of served EUTRA/NR cells.

q_52690.question: What components are included in the Re-Synchronization-Info AVP in the 3GPP 29.061-800 specification?
q_52690.ground_truth: The Re-Synchronization-Info AVP is of type OctetString, and it contains the concatenation of RAND and AUTS.

q_52691.question: What is the basic repeater EVM measurement interval for Repeater type 2-O and NCR-Fwd type 2-O in the time domain?
q_52691.ground_truth: The basic repeater EVM measurement interval for Repeater type 2-O and NCR-Fwd type 2-O is one slot in the time domain.

q_52692.question: What message does the gNB-CU send to the gNB-DU for the establishment of a PC5 Relay RLC channel for relaying of U2N Remote UE's SRB2 and DRBs?

q_52693.question: How does the SMF use the relay-UPF in the star topology for SMFs?
q_52693.ground_truth: The relay-UPF is similar to a backbone router, which handles traffic aggregation. In the star topology for SMFs, the relay-SMF selects a relay-UPF that can serve a specific VN and sends the traffic related to the UPFs under the SMF-1/2/3 to the relay-UPF controlled by the relay-SMF.

q_52694.question: What should a network do when terminating a group Function Disconnection (FD) transmission in a multimedia system?
q_52694.ground_truth: When terminating a group FD transmission, a network should insert an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body in the SIP MESSAGE request, set the <request-type> element to "group-fd", set the <mcdata-request-uri> element to the MCData group identity for the FD transmission, and set the <mcdata-client-id> element to the MCData client ID of the originating MCData client.

q_52695.question: Which transmission schemes did RAN4 define for UE demodulation requirements in the uni-directional and bi-directional scenarios?
q_52695.ground_truth: RAN4 defined UE demodulation requirements with transmission schemes for uni-directional scenario A with DPS scheme 1b, and bi-directional scenario B with DPS scheme 1a.

q_52696.question: What is the overall delay measured when the DRX cycle length is 40 ms, as defined in the test requirement?
q_52696.ground_truth: The overall delay measured when the DRX cycle length is 40 ms shall be less than a total of 842 ms.

q_52697.question: What action does the RCAF take after receiving a Cancel Aggregated Congestion Request (SCEF Reference ID) message from the SCEF in the removal procedure for continuous reporting of network status?
q_52697.ground_truth: The RCAF removes the related SCEF instructions and stops monitoring the set of cells or eNodeBs belonging to the Location Area for a change in the congestion status.

q_52698.question: What kind of elements can be included in a <ProSeUserID-entry> element?
q_52698.ground_truth: A <ProSeUserID-entry> element shall contain a <DiscoveryGroupID> element, a <User-Info-ID> element, and an "index" attribute.

q_52699.question: What is the purpose of the MLContext attribute in the ML entity?
q_52699.ground_truth: The MLContext attribute represents the status and conditions related to the ML entity, including the network context and other applicable conditions. It is used for identification, monitoring, and reporting of changes in ML context to address or deal with problems in ML model performance management.

q_52700.question: In SearchSpaceType-r17 of SearchSpaceExt-v1700, how is CHOICE defined to indicate the monitoring slot periodicity and offset?
q_52700.ground_truth: An enumeration of all available setup values is used.

q_52701.question: How does the P-GW handle IP related operations when delivering Non-IP data using SGi PtP tunnelling based on UDP/IP?
q_52701.ground_truth: The P-GW performs the IP related operations, but the IP address or IPv6 prefix is not provided to the UE, and the UE is not informed about the assigned IPv6 prefix and Interface Identifier.

q_52702.question: What is the role of the Traffic Correlation ID in the PCC rules when FQDN(s) parameters are included in the AF request?
q_52702.ground_truth: The Traffic Correlation ID and the EAS Correlation Indication or Common EAS, and FQDN(s) will be included in the PCC rule sent to SMF. The SMF can use the Traffic Correlation ID to determine that the UE belongs to a set of UEs identified by Traffic Correlation ID and a common EAS should be selected for the set of UE for the traffic identified by Traffic Descriptor.

q_52703.question: For what scenario should the UE use BPSK modulation in PUCCH format 1/1a/1b for TDD HARQ-ACK multiplexing?
q_52703.ground_truth: For TDD HARQ-ACK multiplexing and sub-frame, if the number of elements in set is 5, then the UE should use BPSK modulation in PUCCH format 1/1a/1b.

q_52704.question: What should the new eNB do when initiating the Data Forwarding Address Indication procedure for Dual Connectivity or EN-DC?
q_52704.ground_truth: The new eNB should indicate that it requests data forwarding of downlink packets to the GTP TEID indicated in the DL GTP Tunnel Endpoint IE, for each E-RAB included in E-RABs Data Forwarding Address List IE.

q_52705.question: What type of NR UE releases does the test in 6.6.2.9.2 apply to?
q_52705.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of NR UE release 16 onwards supporting the "supportedGapPattern-NRonly-r16".

q_52706.question: Why is it important to manage the physical location of VNFs and sub-components?
q_52706.ground_truth: Managing the physical location of VNFs and sub-components ensures the attestation that the VNF/sub-components provided a commensurate level of security to match the requirements of the service or to meet legal/regulatory requirements.

q_52707.question: What is the recommended approach for verifying E-UTRA FDD vs. TDD technologies in TS 36.523-1 clause 6, 7, 8, 12, 13 with MultiRAT involved?
q_52707.ground_truth: It is recommended to have separate verifications for FDD and TDD in these TCs when MultiRAT is involved.

q_52708.question: What procedure does the terminating AS follow when the callee is no longer busy and the destination B idle guard timer CC-T8 has expired?
q_52708.ground_truth: The terminating AS starts processing the selected CC request.

q_52709.question: What should the system do if the in-progress emergency state of the group is set to false?
q_52709.ground_truth: If the in-progress emergency state of the group is set to false, the system should set it to true, start timer TNG2 (in-progress emergency group call timer) and handle its expiry, generate SIP re-INVITE requests for the MCVideo emergency group call to the other affiliated and joined participants of the chat MCVideo group, generate SIP INVITE requests for the MCVideo emergency group call to the affiliated but not joined members of the chat MCVideo group, send the SIP INVITE request towards the MCVideo client, and cache the information that this MCVideo user has initiated an MCVideo emergency call.

q_52710.question: What are the relevant use cases for shared AR conversational experience?
q_52710.ground_truth: The relevant use cases for shared AR conversational experience include 360-degree conference meeting, XR meeting, Convention/Poster Session, AR avatar multi-party calls, Front-facing camera video multi-party calls, AR conferencing, and shared AR conferencing experience.

q_52711.question: What action should the PGW take if it receives a GTP error indication from a SGW for the default bearer?
q_52711.ground_truth: The PGW should delete all the Bearer contexts associated with the PDN connection (identified by the default bearer) and may notify the Operation and Maintenance network element. The PGW may also send the Delete Bearer Request for the default bearer to the MME/S4 SGSN to delete the associated PDN connection.

q_52712.question: What is the difference between Wide Area and Local Area IAB-MT for IAB type 1-H, 1-O, and 2-O?
q_52712.ground_truth: Wide Area IAB-MT are characterized by requirements derived from Macro Cell and/or Micro Cell scenarios, while Local Area IAB-MT are characterized by requirements derived from Pico Cell and/or Micro Cell scenarios.

q_52713.question: What should the MSGin5G Gateway UE do if the "De-registration urgent degree" element is included with a "true" value in a CoAP POST request?
q_52713.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Gateway UE should forward the CoAP POST request to the MSGin5G Server without any change.

q_52714.question: How does Soln#2 and Soln#7 improve service reliability but decrease resource efficiency in processing broadcast MBS sessions?
q_52714.ground_truth: Soln#2 and Soln#7 establish all user planes for each broadcast MBS session, which improves service reliability but is less resource efficient as only the packets delivered over one broadcast MBS session are used, and packets over other broadcast MBS sessions are dropped.

q_52715.question: What is the goal of the document's versioning system?
q_52715.ground_truth: The versioning system is used to indicate the level of approval and changes to the document, where the first digit indicates the level of TSG approval, the second digit is incremented for changes of substance, and the third digit is incremented for editorial changes.

q_52716.question: What is the purpose of a UE transmitting a MeasurementReport message in the test procedure?
q_52716.ground_truth: A UE transmits a MeasurementReport message to indicate the results of the measurement report. The report is triggered by Event A3, and the contents of the report are specified in the message contents section of the test procedure.

q_52717.question: What is the maximum duration for the PRACH channel transmission in the TDD Intra frequency conditional handover test case?
q_52717.ground_truth: The PRACH channel should be transmitted to Cell 2 less than 860 ms from the start of time period T2.

q_52718.question: What error is returned by the network when it is requested to perform an operation which is not compatible with the current status of the relevant supplementary service?

q_52719.question: What is the meaning of "shall" in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_52719.ground_truth: In the 3GPP Technical Specification, "shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

q_52720.question: In which mode may the UE radio capability ID IE be included?
q_52720.ground_truth: The UE radio capability ID IE may be included in WB-S1 mode if both the UE and the network supports RACS, and the network needs to assign a network-assigned UE radio capability ID to the UE.

q_52721.question: What is the purpose of the Response-Source header field in SIP?
q_52721.ground_truth: The Response-Source header field in SIP is used to provide information about the originator of an error response. It can be used by receiving entities to decide on an appropriate procedure for handling the failure response.

q_52722.question: What kind of mechanism should be used by the source NG-RAN node and target NG-RAN node to minimize data loss of the MBS session in handover preparation phase?
q_52722.ground_truth: To minimize data loss of the MBS session either of, or a combination of, the following methods may be applied: data may be forwarded from source NG-RAN node to target NG-RAN node with MBS progress information exchanged between the nodes, or NG-RAN nodes share a common user plane entity which allows the allocation of identical PDCP numbers to MBS users data when delivered to UEs in cells served by different NG-RAN nodes.

q_52723.question: What needs to be done in order to register the IP-SM-GW address in the UDM for MT-SMS delivery over 5G NAS in deployment scenarios where 2G/3G/4G accesses are not supported?
q_52723.ground_truth: The UDM and the HSS (IMS) need to interact for the registration of the IP-SM-GW address as defined in clause 5.5.6.2.

q_52724.question: What are the two options for obtaining MDA output results from the MDA MnS producer?
q_52724.ground_truth: The two options are obtaining MDA output results either by pulling or pushing mechanisms.

q_52725.question: What message is received by the MS when the network rejects the attach in GMMSS-ESTABLISH-REJ?
q_52725.ground_truth: The MS has received the ATTACH REJECT message when the network rejects the attach in GMMSS-ESTABLISH-REJ.

q_52726.question: What is the procedure concerning in the context of this specification?
q_52726.ground_truth: The procedure concerning both non-roaming and roaming cases for Trusted Non-3GPP IP Access and Local Breakout.

q_52727.question: How does the gain difference between low band (26GHz) and high band (38GHz) affect the antenna directivity and gain?
q_52727.ground_truth: Lower band has approximately 3dB higher gain than higher band, which affects the antenna directivity and gain.

q_52728.question: What should the transmission control interface towards the MCVideo client in the transmission control server do when it receives a Transmission End Request message with the first bit in the subtype set to '1'?
q_52728.ground_truth: The transmission control interface towards the MCVideo client in the transmission control server should send a Transmission control Ack message with the Message Type field set to '4' and the Source field set to '2'. It should also forward the Transmission End Request message to the transmission control server arbitration logic.

q_52729.question: What does the "R" bit in the MAC RAR denote in the Random Access Response?
q_52729.ground_truth: The "R" bit in the MAC RAR indicates whether an UL Grant in Random Access Response is for EDT or not. It is set to "0" for a BL UE or a UE in CE, and set to "1" for EDT.

q_52730.question: What action should be taken if the MCData user is not authorized to upgrade the MCData group session to an in-progress emergency group state?
q_52730.ground_truth: The MCData client should indicate to the user that they are not authorized to upgrade the MCData group session to an in-progress emergency group state and skip the remaining steps of the procedure.

q_52731.question: What interface is used by the AF to transfer the Reference ID and AF session information to the PCF?
q_52731.ground_truth: The N5 interface is used by the AF to transfer the Reference ID and AF session information to the PCF.

q_52732.question: What is the purpose of the E-UTRA - NR Cell Resource Coordination procedure?
q_52732.ground_truth: The purpose of the E-UTRA - NR Cell Resource Coordination procedure is to enable coordination of radio resource allocation between an ng-eNB and a gNB that are sharing spectrum and whose coverage areas are fully or partially overlapping.

q_52733.question: What is the role of the 5GMS AF in the 5GMS architecture with respect to UE data collection and reporting?
q_52733.ground_truth: The 5GMS AF is instantiated as the Data Collection AF for 5G Media Streaming and takes logical responsibility for the UE data collection activities within the 5GMS architecture.

q_52734.question: What is an NTN in the context of 3GPP 5G specifications?
q_52734.ground_truth: NTN stands for Non-Terrestrial Network, a network that provides non-terrestrial NR access to the User Equipment (UE) using satellites and their payloads.

q_52735.question: What should the Payload Direction field in the PDU header be set to if the signaling message was sent from the target?
q_52735.ground_truth: The Payload Direction field in the PDU header should be set to "3" (sent from the target) if the signaling message was sent from the target.

q_52736.question: What procedure is used by the NWDAF service consumer to obtain the QoS sustainability analytics, which are calculated by the NWDAF based on the information collected from the OAM, for a path of interest or for an area of interest with coarse granularity (i.e. TAIs or Cell IDs)?
q_52736.ground_truth: This procedure is used by the NWDAF service consumer (maybe an NF, e.g. AF) to obtain the QoS Sustainability analytics, which are calculated by the NWDAF based on the information collected from the OAM, for a path of interest or for an area of interest with coarse granularity (i.e. TAIs or Cell IDs).

q_52737.question: What is the additional enhancement when Hierarchical NSAC architecture is deployed in the network?
q_52737.ground_truth: When Hierarchical NSAC architecture is deployed in the network, there are two additional enhancements: (1) for option 2, the NSAC for the number of UEs and NSAC for the number of PDU sessions/PDN connections are handled within the same NSACF, and (2) when the local maximum number of UEs with at least one PDU Session/PDN Connection or local threshold is reached, the NSACF may interact with the Primary NSACF before returning the response back to the SMF+PGW-C.

q_52738.question: What action should a UE take if it receives EMM cause #25 when initiating a tracking area updating procedure over a CSG cell?
q_52738.ground_truth: The UE should set the EPS update status to EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, reset the tracking area updating attempt counter, enter the state EMM-REGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE, and remove the entry corresponding to the CSG ID and associated PLMN identity from the Allowed CSG list.

q_52739.question: What must the SMF in PLMN include in the FAR to trigger the PDU session modification procedure for establishing the DL traffic related QoS Flow in PLMN?
q_52739.ground_truth: The URR and the DSCP within the Transport Level Marking IE in the FAR associated to the PDR.

q_52740.question: What is the purpose of User Plane CIoT 5GS and EPS Optimization in network communication?
q_52740.ground_truth: User Plane CIoT 5GS and EPS Optimization enable support for changing from 5GMM-IDLE and EMM-IDLE modes to 5GMM-CONNECTED and EMM-CONNECTED modes, respectively, without the need for using the Service Request procedure.

q_52741.question: What actions can the Event Consumer NF specify for the Event Producer NF on buffered notifications in the Event Reporting Information field of the Event Exposure Framework?
q_52741.ground_truth: The Event Consumer NF can specify 'Send All', 'Discard All', or 'Drop Old' for the Event Producer NF's action on buffered notifications.

q_52742.question: What is the purpose of the test case described in 6.6.18.3?
q_52742.ground_truth: The purpose of this test case is to verify that the UE makes correct event-triggered reporting of concurrent inter-RAT E-UTRAN and NR FR1 measurements when operating in standalone (SA) operation with PCell in FR1.

q_52743.question: How do current QUIC specifications affect transport proxy traversal and troubleshooting?
q_52743.ground_truth: QUIC breaks the layering between the transport and HTTPS layers, making transport optimization proxy functions unfeasible. For troubleshooting, the existing OAM solutions would not be able to troubleshoot the quantum-resistant TLS traffic, and QUIC's decryption can reveal application layer information to network probes. Application level troubleshooting would also require mapping of streams identifiers to get an end-to-end view.

q_52744.question: What percentage of V2X data and SLSS transmissions can the V2X UE be allowed to drop or delay during the duration of T2 and T3?
q_52744.ground_truth: The V2X UE should not drop or delay more than 6% of its V2X data and SLSS transmissions during the duration of T2 and T3.

q_52745.question: What interface does the MCPTT-8 reference point use for multicast media communication between the media distribution function and the media mixer?
q_52745.ground_truth: The MB2-U interface defined in 3GPP TS 23.468 is used by the MCPTT-8 reference point for multicast media communication.

q_52746.question: Who is the target of this test as per 5.5.8.2.2 (Test applicability)?
q_52746.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of NR UE release 15 onwards.

q_52747.question: What should the SMF include in the Received MBS information if it wants to update the security information of an MBS session that the UE has joined?
q_52747.ground_truth: The SMF should include the corresponding multicast MBS session ID and the MBS security container in the Received MBS container IE in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message, and set the MBS Decision to "MBS security information update" in the Received MBS information.

q_52748.question: What is the purpose of the periodic and triggered SL-MT-LR procedure in clause 6.20.4?
q_52748.ground_truth: The purpose of the periodic and triggered SL-MT-LR procedure in clause 6.20.4 is to estimate the relative locations or distances and/or directions between a group of UEs periodically or following certain trigger events.

q_52749.question: What is the purpose of the EN-DC SRS-RSRP measurement accuracy with FR1 serving cell test, as defined in clause 4.7.6.1.1?
q_52749.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to verify that the SRS-RSRP measurement accuracy is within the specified limits. This test will verify the SRS-RSRP measurement requirements in clause 4.7.6.0.

q_52750.question: What is the effect of MBMS counting in LTE?
q_52750.ground_truth: MBMS counting determines if there are sufficient UEs interested in receiving a service to enable the operator to decide if it is appropriate to deliver the service via MBSFN. It allows the operator to choose between enabling or disabling MBSFN transmission for the service.

q_52751.question: Which message is sent by a UE to another peer UE when a PC5 unicast link security mode control procedure is initiated?
q_52751.ground_truth: The DIRECT LINK SECURITY MODE COMMAND message is sent by a UE to another peer UE when a PC5 unicast link security mode control procedure is initiated.

q_52752.question: What is the purpose of the HD-FDD UE Timing Advance Adjustment Accuracy Test for Category NB1 UE in Standalone Mode under Enhance Coverage?
q_52752.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify E-UTRAN Timing Advance adjustment accuracy requirements for category NB1 UE in enhanced coverage in an AWGN model.

q_52753.question: What operation does the LMF send to the serving AMF as a supplementary services message in step 10?

q_52754.question: Who is responsible for deciding the approach to use when more than one S-NSSAI with slice-aware information is needed by the UE?
q_52754.ground_truth: CT1 is responsible for deciding whether to apply a weighted approach or alternative approach for the PLMN selection procedure when more than one S-NSSAI with slice-aware information is needed by the UE.

q_52755.question: What field in DCI format 4B indicates the timing offset for the PUSCH transmission?
q_52755.ground_truth: The timing offset field in DCI format 4B indicates the absolute timing offset for the PUSCH transmission when the PUSCH trigger A is not set to 1.

q_52756.question: When receiving a Push-Profile-Request (PPR) from the HSS, what should the S-CSCF do if the modification consists of deletion of a public user identity while there are active multimedia sessions belonging to this public user identity and contact?
q_52756.ground_truth: The S-CSCF should release these multimedia sessions, synchronize with the UE and IM CN entities, and remove the public user identity from the list of registered, non-barred public user identities.

q_52757.question: What action should a UE take if it is capable of SLSS transmission and authorized for ProSe Direct Discovery Announcing in two PLMNs operating on the same frequency, and the RSRP measurement of the serving cell is below the value of syncTxThreshIC, and syncTxThreshIC is included in SystemInformationBlockType19 broadcasted by the current cell?

q_52758.question: What is the format of the F1AP-PROTOCOL-IES, a sequence containing a list of ProtocolIE-SingleContainer?

q_52759.question: When is it necessary to use application layer procedures for service continuity when a Layer-3 Remote UE switches from Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay to another Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay?
q_52759.ground_truth: Application layer procedures, such as IMS service continuity procedures or mission-critical service continuity procedures, are used when a Layer-3 Remote UE connects to the network via Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay without N3IWF support.

q_52760.question: What issue can occur if the MME selects a "5G prioritized" RFSP Index that conflicts with the one selected by the PCF in 5GC?
q_52760.ground_truth: The ping-pong issue can occur, causing the UE to move back and forth between 5GS and EPS.

q_52761.question: What is the test applicability for the HD-FDD transmit timing accuracy test for Category NB1 UE in in-band mode under enhanced coverage?
q_52761.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of NB-IoT HD-FDD UE release 13 and forward of UE Category NB1 and higher.

q_52762.question: What action will the AF take if it cannot fulfill a received HTTP POST request due to an internal error or an error in the request?
q_52762.ground_truth: The AF will send an HTTP error response as specified in clause 5.7.

q_52763.question: What is the implication of the non-alteration of the DSCP field between N3IWF and the 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay UE's UPF in the static QoS mapping mechanism?
q_52763.ground_truth: It assumes that an SLA and transport-level arrangements outside of 3GPP scope govern the non-alteration of the DSCP field.

q_52764.question: What is the role of User Equipment (UEs) and Application Servers (AS) in the context of PNM?
q_52764.ground_truth: UEs and AS providing PNM capabilities are responsible for implementing the protocols and procedures necessary for enabling PNM services, as specified in the document.

q_52765.question: What should the UE do with the timer Tw1 if it receives a PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message with cause value #26 and without the Tw1 IE?
q_52765.ground_truth: The UE may send another PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message for the same APN.

q_52766.question: When does the AF send a Diameter RAR with the Specific-Action AVP set to indicate the event that caused the request?
q_52766.ground_truth: If the AF requested a notification of the corresponding event and all service data flows for an AF session are deleted.

q_52767.question: How does the UE determine the strongest cells on the associated frequency if the purpose is set to 'reportStrongestCellsForSON'?
q_52767.ground_truth: The UE initiates a first measurement report when it has determined the strongest cells on the associated frequency.

q_52768.question: What is the role of the UL Reference Measurement Channel in the test procedure?
q_52768.ground_truth: The UL Reference Measurement Channel is used as a reference for the measurement of the mean power of the UE in the channel bandwidth.

q_52769.question: What is used to protect Ranging/SL Positioning discovery in the first solution?
q_52769.ground_truth: The first solution protects Ranging/SL Positioning discovery when UEs are out of network coverage using pre-provisioned shared root key materials for UEs.

q_52770.question: How does a functional entity determine if confidentiality protection has been applied to XML elements in a SIP request or response?
q_52770.ground_truth: The functional entity should follow the procedures in clause 6.6.2.4.1, and if confidentiality protection has been applied, use the keying information described in clause 6.6.2.2 and the procedures described in clause 6.6.2.4.2 to decrypt the received values.

q_52771.question: When is a UE authorized to act as a remote UE towards a UE-to-network relay?
q_52771.ground_truth: A UE is authorized to act as a remote UE towards a UE-to-network relay when it is not served by E-UTRAN and is authorized to perform ProSe direct discovery for public safety use when not served by E-UTRAN, or when it is served by E-UTRAN, is authorized to perform ProSe direct discovery for public safety use in at least one PLMN, and the lower layers indicate that discovery operation of a UE-to-network relay is supported.

q_52772.question: What should the network do if the DETACH REQUEST message is received with detach type "IMSI detach" or "re-attach not required" and the EMM cause value is #2 "IMSI unknown in HSS"?
q_52772.ground_truth: The network should not change the current EMM state upon receipt of the DETACH ACCEPT message.

q_52773.question: What indication can the NG-RAN node include in the N2 SM information for PDU Set Based Handling Support in Dual Connectivity?
q_52773.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node can include the PDU Set Based Handling Support Indication in N2 SM information as defined in clause 5.37.5.3 of TS 23.501.

q_52774.question: What information does the SMF provide to the UE for transporting PMFP messages over specific QoS flows?
q_52774.ground_truth: The SMF provides the UE with QoS rules including the packet filters containing the UDP port or MAC address associated with the QoS flow in the measurement assistance information. This ensures that the UDP port or MAC address is unique within the PDU session.

q_52775.question: Which entity is an extension of the SMS entity for non-EPS services and for message transfer uses the services from the EMM entity of the MM sublayer in the EPS PS domain services and non-EPS domain services supporting CS/PS mode 1 or CS/PS mode 2 of operation MSs?

q_52776.question: What must the target NG-RAN node do if it has different stored UE radio capabilities compared to the known radio capabilities applicable to the target NG-RAN node?
q_52776.ground_truth: The target NG-RAN node must trigger retrieval of the E-UTRA radio capability information again from the UE.

q_52777.question: What should the UE do if the ON-DEMAND NSSAI IE is included in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message?
q_52777.ground_truth: The UE should store the on-demand NSSAI as specified in the 3GPP TS 23.502 standard if the ON-DEMAND NSSAI IE is included in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.

q_52778.question: When does the PDN GW delete the bearer context related to the deactivated EPS bearer?
q_52778.ground_truth: The PDN GW deletes the bearer context related to the deactivated EPS bearer when the PDN GW receives no WLAN Location Information from the ePDG.

q_52779.question: How does the AF request impact the delivery of frequency and phase synchronization in the NG-RAN?
q_52779.ground_truth: The AF request provides requirements such as Timing Resiliency, assisted timing/complement timing, and type of timing information to the NG-RAN. Based on this information, the NG-RAN determines how to provide 5G reference timing information to the UE efficiently.

q_52780.question: What is the behavior required of 3GPP Rel-8 and onwards GTPv1-U entity when it receives a GTPv0-U message?
q_52780.ground_truth: A 3GPP Rel-8 and onwards GTPv1-U entity should not listen to the well-known GTPv0 port 3386. If it does listen to the GTPv0 port, the entity shall silently discard any received GTPv0-U message.

q_52781.question: What action should the participating MCVideo function take when sending a SIP BYE request on receipt of a SIP BYE request?
q_52781.ground_truth: Upon receiving a SIP BYE request from the MCVideo client, the participating MCVideo function shall interact with the media plane, generate a SIP BYE request as specified in 3GPP TS 24.229, send the SIP BYE request toward the controlling MCVideo function, and forward a SIP 200 (OK) response to the MCVideo client.

q_52782.question: What is the purpose of Using MPD@suggestedPresentationDelay (SPD) in the DASH client?
q_52782.ground_truth: The MPD@suggestedPresentationDelay (SPD) is used by the DASH client to commit to a constant presentation delay (PD) relative to the announced segment availability start time in continuous presentation.

q_52783.question: When should the UE pass an indication that user plane positioning is not authorized by the network?
q_52783.ground_truth: When the "UPP-CMI container" is included in the DL NAS TRANSPORT message, and the 5GMM cause IE is set to the 5GMM cause #94 "User plane positioning not authorized".

q_52784.question: What are the two main approaches to support irregular channels and irregular BW?
q_52784.ground_truth: The two main approaches are: 1) Combined UE CBW (one cell) and 2) Overlapping CA (two cells).

q_52785.question: How is the received signal vector r expressed?
q_52785.ground_truth: The NRx-dimensional received signal vector r of the k-th subcarrier and the l-th OFDM symbol is expressed as a sum of the target UE's own signal, the co-scheduled UEs' interference signals, and the white noise.

q_52786.question: What is supported in the SN to target NG-RAN node scenario?
q_52786.ground_truth: Direct data forwarding from source SN to target SN for SN change scenario is supported.

q_52787.question: For a NR base station supporting multiple non-contiguous bands and operating with carriers that are not processed in active RF components together with other carriers, which RF requirements should apply for each supported operating band?
q_52787.ground_truth: Single-band RF requirements, such as transmitter spurious emissions, operating band unwanted emissions, ACLR, and transmitter intermodulation, should apply to each supported operating band.

q_52788.question: What should the target UE do if the selected integrity protection algorithm is not the null integrity protection algorithm?
q_52788.ground_truth: The target UE should derive K~NRP-sess~ ID from the MSB of the K~NRP-sess~ ID that it sent in the DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message or DIRECT LINK REKEYING REQUEST message and the LSB of the K~NRP-sess~ ID received in the DIRECT LINK SECURITY MODE COMMAND message. It should use the K~NRP-sess~ ID to identify the new security context.

q_52789.question: What percentage redundancy should be used when the conditions along the call path are not known to be free of loss?
q_52789.ground_truth: 200 % redundancy shall be used when the conditions along the call path are not known to be free of loss.

q_52790.question: What should the controlling MCVideo function do upon receiving a SIP MESSAGE request for unbinding a functional alias with the MCVideo group(s) for the MCVideo user if the request is successful?
q_52790.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function should generate a SIP 200 (OK) response as specified in 3GPP TS 24.229 with a P-Asserted-Identity header field set to the public service identity of the controlling MCVideo function.

q_52791.question: What should the network do if the TFT operation is "Replace packet filters in existing TFT" and the packet filter to be replaced does not exist in the original TFT?
q_52791.ground_truth: The network should not diagnose an error, further process the replace request and, if no error was detected, include the packet filters received to the existing TFT.

q_52792.question: What action should the UE take upon receiving a UEInformationRequest message containing rlf-ReportReq, as specified in TS 36.331, clause 5.6.5.3 (TP2)?
q_52792.ground_truth: If rlf-ReportReq is set to true and the UE has radio link failure information available in VarRLF-Report and plmn-Identity stored in VarRLF-Report is equal to the RPLMN, the UE should set the rlf-Report in the UEInformationResponse message to the value of rlf-Report in VarRLF-Report.

q_52793.question: What is the difference between "HO.IntraSys.TooEarly" and "HO.IntraSys.bTooEarly.NCI"?
q_52793.ground_truth: "HO.IntraSys.TooEarly" is a handover failure event per cell, while "HO.IntraSys.bTooEarly.NCI" is a handover failure event per beam-cell pair during intra-system mobility.

q_52794.question: What should be measured in step 6 of the E-UTRA and NR Procedure (6.6.3.4.2.3)?
q_52794.ground_truth: The time alignment error between the different reference symbols on different beams on the carrier(s).

q_52795.question: What element identifies the L3 protocol to which a standard layer 3 message belongs when the protocol discriminator is set to "extension of the PD to one octet length"?
q_52795.ground_truth: The extended protocol discriminator (EPD) information element

q_52796.question: What IOC represents the properties of a network slice subnet in a 5G network and what does it include?
q_52796.ground_truth: The NetworkSliceSubnet IOC represents the properties of a network slice subnet in a 5G network. It includes attributes inherited from Top IOC and the following attributes: id, name, description, category, slice type, and epTransportRef.

q_52797.question: What information does the gNB-CU store when the Privacy Indicator IE is included in the CELL TRAFFIC TRACE message?
q_52797.ground_truth: The gNB-CU stores the information so that it can be transferred towards the AMF.

q_52798.question: Which type of NR UE does this test case apply to?
q_52798.ground_truth: This test case applies to all types of NR UE from Release 15 onwards.

q_52799.question: What is the state variable that indicates if there is an ongoing MCData emergency group communication in a specific group?

q_52800.question: What is the alternative measure referred to in the Requirement Description for brute force and dictionary attack mitigation if the recommended protection measures are not implemented in the Network Product?
q_52800.ground_truth: The alternative measures referred to in the Requirement Description are the unspecified measures described in the vendor-provided documentation.

q_52801.question: What is the definition of the distance between an SMTC occasion and a measurement gap occasion?
q_52801.ground_truth: The distance between an SMTC occasion and a measurement gap occasion is defined as the time difference between the ending point of one occasion and the starting point of the other, depending on which occasion occurs earlier in time.

q_52802.question: What devices demonstrated low levels of variability for RFR when supports were added or removed from the back of the device?
q_52802.ground_truth: Standard earpiece devices (Prototype 1 and Device 1) demonstrated low levels of variability (< 1dB) for RFR when supports were added or removed from the back of the device.

q_52803.question: What should the SNRM-S include in the HTTP 200 (OK) response message for a successful resource modification request operation in the SEAL framework?
q_52803.ground_truth: The SNRM-S should include a Request-URI set to the URI corresponding to the identity of the VAL server, a Content-Type header field set to "application/vnd.3gpp.seal-unicast-info+xml", and an application/vnd.3gpp.seal-unicast-info+xml MIME body with a <modification-result> element set to "success" in the <unicast-info> root element.

q_52804.question: What are the responsibilities of the UE when using 5GC information for AI/ML operations?
q_52804.ground_truth: The UE should be able to communicate with AIML-T and use the received 5GC information to decide on AI/ML operations, such as model selection and data transfer based on network conditions.

q_52805.question: What initiates the rule-matching process in the Communication Diversion service?
q_52805.ground_truth: The Communication Diversion service initiates the rule-matching process by starting to execute the first rule in the set of rules.

q_52806.question: Which network connection is mapped to access category 3 while a 5GC-MO-LR procedure is ongoing and there are no other ongoing network connections?
q_52806.ground_truth: Any service request procedure or registration procedure initiated in 5GMM-IDLE mode or 5GMM-IDLE mode with suspend indication for the purpose of NAS signalling connection recovery or following a fallback indication from lower layers is mapped to access category 3.

q_52807.question: What is used to negotiate the Capture Sources available in an IMS-based telepresence call?
q_52807.ground_truth: A CLUE protocol, transported via a CLUE data channel

q_52808.question: What is the term used to describe the procedure at the MSGin5G Server side when it handles the origination of a message?

q_52809.question: What are the general architecture requirements specified for SEALDD service in 3GPP TS 23.434?
q_52809.ground_truth: The general architecture requirements specified for SEALDD service in 3GPP TS 23.434 include supporting data delivery services towards VAL clients and servers, enabling SEALDD service to utilize MSGin5G service for data delivery, providing a mechanism for SEALDD service discovery, supporting data transmission requirements, data storage requirements, SEALDD server discovery and selection requirements, and MSGin5G message transfer requirements.

q_52810.question: What information is included in the PDU Session Resource Modify Response Transfer IE if any QoS flows have been successfully setup or modified during the PDU Session Resource Modify procedure?
q_52810.ground_truth: The list of QoS flows which have been successfully setup or modified is included in the QoS Flow Add or Modify Response List IE of the PDU Session Resource Modify Response Transfer IE.

q_52811.question: Which network element controls the SMF and UPF for Service Request procedures in Home Routed roaming case?

q_52812.question: What should a receiving AM RLC entity do when t-Reordering expires?
q_52812.ground_truth: The receiving AM RLC entity should update VR(UR) to the SN of the first UMD PDU with SN >= VR(UX) that has not been received, reassemble RLC SDUs from any UMD PDUs with SN < updated VR(UR), remove RLC headers when doing so, and deliver the reassembled RLC SDUs to the upper layer in ascending order of the RLC SN if not delivered before. If VR(UH) > VR(UR), the receiving AM RLC entity should start t-Reordering and set VR(UX) to VR(UH).

q_52813.question: What action does the SCS/AS take to initiate service creation in the scenario where it acts as a content provider and there is no assigned Service ID for an External Group Identifier?
q_52813.ground_truth: The SCS/AS sends an HTTP POST message to the SCEF to the resource "xMB Services" with the External Group Identifier in the body of the message.

q_52814.question: What is the UE basic measurement interval of modulated carrier frequency for ATG, as specified in clause 6.4J.1?
q_52814.ground_truth: The UE basic measurement interval of modulated carrier frequency for ATG is 1 UL slot.

q_52815.question: How are the values of Mout,RedCap and Min,RedCap assigned for a RedCap UE with 1Rx when CSI-RS resource is transmitted with higher layer CSI-RS parameter density set to 3 and over the bandwidth >= 24 PRBs?
q_52815.ground_truth: For a RedCap UE with 1Rx, Mout,RedCap is 40 and Min,RedCap is 10 when the CSI-RS resource for RLM is transmitted with higher layer CSI-RS parameter density set to 3 and over the bandwidth >= 24 PRBs.

q_52816.question: Who determines the Allowed NSSAI by considering the reason for S-NSSAI registration, S-NSSAI type, and current network conditions?

q_52817.question: What is the format of the S-KID and KSNAAPPY?
q_52817.ground_truth: The S-KID is in NAI format as specified in clause 2.2 of IETF RFC 7542, i.e. username@realm, where the username part includes SNAAPPY Temporary UE Identifier (S-TID), and the realm part includes Home Network Identifier or Authorization Function Address. The KSNAAPPY is derived from KAUSF using a specific input key KEY and parameters FC, P0, L0, P1, and L1. The FC value is determined during the normative phase.

q_52818.question: What is the SNR used to specify radiated performance requirements for SAN?
q_52818.ground_truth: Radiated performance requirements for SAN are specified at the RIB, based on one or two demodulation branches, with the required SNR (Signal-to-Noise Ratio) applied separately per polarization. The SNR is defined as SNR = S/N, where S is the total signal energy in the subframe on a RIB, and N is the noise energy in a bandwidth corresponding to the transmission bandwidth over the same duration where signal energy exists.

q_52819.question: What is the difference between handover and redirection in inter-RAT mobility?
q_52819.ground_truth: Handover and redirection are both methods of transferring a UE from one RAT to another, but redirection is based on radio criteria and availability of the N26 interface, while handover is based on the decision of the source RAT and involves the preparation of radio resources in the target RAT.

q_52820.question: What is the validity of the "DL total available PRB" and "Peak DL PRB used for data traffic" measurements in 5G?
q_52820.ground_truth: Both the "DL total available PRB" and "Peak DL PRB used for data traffic" measurements are valid for packet switched traffic in 5G.

q_52821.question: What shall the answerer include in the answer when it receives an SDP offer with a media description for a media plane control channel?
q_52821.ground_truth: The answerer shall include a media description associated with the media plane control channel in the answer, and may include an SDP fmtp attribute with the media description.

q_52822.question: What action does the MME take when it receives a paging restriction from a UE in this specification?
q_52822.ground_truth: The MME may accept or reject the paging restriction, and upon acceptance, it stores the paging restriction and enforces these restrictions in the paging procedure.

q_52823.question: What is the role of the ID-dL-Forwarding element in the E-RABs-To-Be-SetupRetrieve-Item X2AP-PROTOCOL-IES?
q_52823.ground_truth: The ID-dL-Forwarding element represents the DL-Forwarding in the E-RABs-To-Be-SetupRetrieve-Item IE s in the context of the E-RABs-To-Be-SetupRetrieve-Item sequence.

q_52824.question: What should the UE do if the "Scheduling TBs for Unicast" field in DCI format 6-1A is not present?
q_52824.ground_truth: If the "Scheduling TBs for Unicast" field in DCI format 6-1A is not present, the UE should read the 5-bit extended "modulation and coding scheme ()" field in the DCI.

q_52825.question: What does the SMF not request allocation for when the GBR QoS Flow is only allowed over non-3GPP access?

q_52826.question: How is the "Participant Type" value padded when its length is not a multiple of 4 bytes?
q_52826.ground_truth: If the length of the "Participant Type" value is not a multiple of 4 bytes, it is padded to a multiple of 4 bytes. The padding bytes are set to zero, and they are ignored by the receiver.

q_52827.question: What are the two types of rules defined in 5G architecture?
q_52827.ground_truth: The two types of rules defined in 5G architecture are Session rules and PCC rules.

q_52828.question: What should the controlling MCData function do when receiving a SIP request for a MCData group that the MCData user is not currently affiliated to and that requires a check of the user's eligibility for implicit affiliation?
q_52828.ground_truth: The controlling MCData function should identify the served MCData group ID and the handled MCData ID, check if a MCData group for the served MCData group ID exists, if the handled MCData ID is a member of the group, and if there is a matching group information entry. If none of these conditions are met, the user is considered ineligible for implicit affiliation.

q_52829.question: What is an EHPLMN list in the context of multiple HPLMN codes?
q_52829.ground_truth: The EHPLMN list is a list stored on the USIM that contains multiple HPLMN codes, including the HPLMN derived from the IMSI. It is used for PLMN selection purposes, and if the HPLMN derived from the IMSI is not present in the EHPLMN list, it shall be treated as a Visited PLMN.

q_52830.question: How does the network product under test ensure that the access token's scope matches the requested service operation?
q_52830.ground_truth: The network product under test checks the scope claim in the access token against the requested service operation. If they match, it implies that the request is authorized for the specific scope.

q_52831.question: In which scenarios does a piggybacked initial message share a common IP header with a triggered response message?
q_52831.ground_truth: A piggybacked initial message shares a common IP header with a triggered response message when it is carried as a concatenation after a triggered response message in the same IP packet. In this case, the IP Source Address for the IP packet containing both the triggered response message and the piggybacked initial message should be the same as the IP Address used for the triggered response message. Similarly, the IP Destination Address for the IP packet containing both the triggered response message and the piggybacked initial message should be the same as the IP Address used for the triggered response message.

q_52832.question: What is the degradation in beam prediction accuracy for DL Tx beam prediction with a 1 dB margin, when considering a common measurement error for all Tx beams in a given Rx beam?
q_52832.ground_truth: There is a slight performance degradation of less than 0.2%.

q_52833.question: What should the UE do upon receiving a HandoverFromEUTRAPreparationRequest message with cdma2000-type set to 'HRPD' during the Pre-registration phase of the inter-RAT handover E-UTRA to HRPD procedure?
q_52833.ground_truth: The UE should transmit a ULHandoverPreparationTransfer message containing tunnelled HRPD ConnectionRequest and RouteUpdate messages to the CDMA2000 upper layers in order to prepare for the cell change order to GERAN.

q_52834.question: What is the role of the V2X UE and the V2X application server in the V1 reference point?
q_52834.ground_truth: The V2X UE and the V2X application server communicate over V1 reference point for V2X application related interactions. This reference point supports both unicast and multicast delivery modes.

q_52835.question: What action should the service consumer take to request the termination of a Downlink Message Delivery?
q_52835.ground_truth: The service consumer should send a DELETE method to the VAE Server with the URI of the Individual Downlink Message Delivery resource.

q_52836.question: What should the transmission control server interface do when it receives a Queue Position Request message from a transmission participant?
q_52836.ground_truth: The transmission control server interface should forward the Queue Position Request message to the controlling MCVideo function with all fields from the participant's message.

q_52837.question: What actions should a UE perform if the ATTACH REJECT message is integrity protected and the timer value in the Back-off timer value IE indicates zero or deactivation since the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST was sent together with an ATTACH REQUEST?
q_52837.ground_truth: If the timer value indicates zero or deactivation, the UE shall not initiate a new attach procedure or send another PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message with the same APN or without an APN in the PLMN until the UE is switched off or the USIM is removed.

q_52838.question: What is the expected HTTP status code received upon a successful deregistration of a UE's SMSF registration for 3GPP access?
q_52838.ground_truth: The UDM responds with "204 No Content".

q_52839.question: In the case of 5G-RG initiated deregistration, what should the 5G-RG do before initiating its own deregistration when it has registered AUN3 devices connected to it?
q_52839.ground_truth: The 5G-RG should first deregister each of the registered AUN3 devices connected to it (if any) before initiating the deregistration of itself.

q_52840.question: Which IOC represents an IOC for SEPPFunction and ExternalSEPPFunction, and includes the attributes defined in both IOCs?

q_52841.question: What is the minimum requirement for FDD PCell in 8.13.3.5.1-2 and 8.13.3.5.2-2?
q_52841.ground_truth: The minimum requirement is to verify closed loop rank-two performance with wideband and frequency selective precoding for FDD PCell.

q_52842.question: What should the UE do when the back-off timer value indicates zero and an S-NSSAI was provided by the UE during the PDU session establishment?
q_52842.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T3585 associated with the S-NSSAI of the PDU session if it is running, for the PLMN or SNPN based on the context.

q_52843.question: What is the identity that should be used in the SMF+PGW-C for interception when EPC-5GC interworking architecture is used?
q_52843.ground_truth: SUPI, IMSI, GPSI, MSISDN, PEI, IMEI

q_52844.question: What is the function of the AMF in the 5G network?
q_52844.ground_truth: The AMF is responsible for managing the UE's connection to the 5G network, including determining the appropriate TNGF for the UE to use and establishing the NWt connection between the UE and the TNGF.

q_52845.question: Which method is used to fetch analytics information via the NEF in the AnalyticsExposure API?
q_52845.ground_truth: The "fetch" custom operation is used to fetch analytics information via the NEF in the AnalyticsExposure API.

q_52846.question: What happens when the MS receives a SERVICE REJECT message with the GMM cause set to 'Illegal MS' in 3GPP TS 24.008, clause 4.7.13.4?
q_52846.ground_truth: The MS sets the GPRS update status to GU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, deletes certain information, and considers the SIM/USIM as invalid for GPRS services until switching off or the SIM/USIM is removed.

q_52847.question: What is the condition for cell reselection to a higher absolute priority layer?
q_52847.ground_truth: Cell reselection to a higher absolute priority layer is performed if Criterion 1 or 4 is fulfilled.

q_52848.question: What is the definition of in-channel selectivity (ICS) in the context of the 3GPP specification?
q_52848.ground_truth: ICS is a measure of the receiver's ability to receive a wanted signal at its assigned resource block locations in the presence of an interfering signal received at a larger power spectral density.

q_52849.question: What should the new NG-RAN node do when it receives the NR A2X Services Authorized IE set to "authorized" in the RETRIEVE UE CONTEXT RESPONSE message?
q_52849.ground_truth: If supported, the new NG-RAN node should consider that the UE is authorized for the relevant service(s) for NR A2X.

q_52850.question: What is the difference between a packet flow and a service data flow in the 5G System?
q_52850.ground_truth: A packet flow is a specific user data flow from and/or to the UE, while a service data flow is an aggregate set of packet flows carried through the UPF that matches a service data flow template.

q_52851.question: What sub-elements are included in the "triggering-criteria" element in the example XML document?
q_52851.ground_truth: The "triggering-criteria" element includes the following sub-elements: "cell-change", "plmn-change", "mbms-sa-change", "mbsfn-area-change", "periodic-report", "travelled-distance", "vertical-application-event", and "geographical-area-change".

q_52852.question: Who is notified when MCPTT client 1 is granted the floor in a private call controlled by the LMR system?
q_52852.ground_truth: The MCPTT server informs MCPTT client 1 that the floor has been granted to MCPTT client 1.

q_52853.question: What type of corrections does SSR STEC Corrections provide on a per satellite basis?
