q_53097.question: What should the MCE do when it receives an MBMS Session Start Request after the M3AP path failure, if the "MBMS session re-establishment indication" flag is not set?
q_53097.ground_truth: The MCE should initiate the Reset or M3 Setup Request procedure towards the related MME, and the MME should then subsequently re-establish the MBMS bearer services affected by the M3AP path failure by initiating MBMS Session Start procedure(s) towards the MCE.

q_53098.question: What is the purpose of the Follow-on Proceed information element?
q_53098.ground_truth: The Follow-on Proceed information element indicates that an MM connection may be established on an existing RR connection.

q_53099.question: What is the result of the "BARRING OF REGISTRATION OF ANY COMMUNICATION DIVERTED-TO ADDRESS EXHPLMNC" enumeration value in the tDivertedToAddressRegistrationBarring simple type?
q_53099.ground_truth: Registration of any international communication diverted-to address except addresses within the hplmn country is barred.

q_53100.question: What conditions must be met for the relative CSI-RSRP measurement requirements to be valid?
q_53100.ground_truth: The relative CSI-RSRP measurement requirements apply when the CSI reference signals in discovery signal occasions are transmitted on one antenna port only from each TP, conditions defined in 36.101 Clause~7.3 for reference sensitivity are fulfilled, and CSI-RSRP is specified in Annex B.3.15 or Annex B.3.17 for a corresponding Band, depending on the scenario.

q_53101.question: What information is provided by the HSS to the 3GPP AAA server or MME/S4-SGSN when a UE moves between 3GPP and non-3GPP accesses?
q_53101.ground_truth: The PDN GW identity and the corresponding PDN information for each of the already allocated PDN Gateway(s).

q_53102.question: What is the purpose of the MapGroupToMBSsession message in the MCPTT system?
q_53102.ground_truth: The MapGroupToMBSsession message includes association information between the group call and MBS session, allowing the MCPTT server to send media packets to all users who will receive the call via the MBS delivery.

q_53103.question: What should the UE do during T4 regarding PUSCH transmission for PSCell?
q_53103.ground_truth: The UE should stop sending PUSCH for PSCell no later than the slot defined in T4, otherwise, it should increase the number of failed iterations by one and switch off the UE.

q_53104.question: What action will the EATF take if the SIP INVITE request includes the g.3gpp.ps2cs-srvcc-orig-pre-alerting media feature tag?
q_53104.ground_truth: The EATF will send a SIP 180 (Ringing) response to the SIP INVITE request if the SIP INVITE request included a Contact header field containing the g.3gpp.ps2cs-srvcc-orig-pre-alerting media feature tag and a SIP 180 (Ringing) response to the SIP INVITE request has not been sent yet.

q_53105.question: What happens when a PINE is removed from a PIN?
q_53105.ground_truth: There are two possible ways to remove a PINE from a PIN: the PINE leaves the PIN, or the PEMC/PIN server removes the PINE from the PIN.

q_53106.question: What is the test requirement for the fraction of falsely detected ACKs in IAB type 1-O and 2-O?
q_53106.ground_truth: The fraction of falsely detected ACKs shall be less than 1% for both IAB type 1-O and 2-O.

q_53107.question: In E-UTRAN FDD inter-frequency OTDOA measurements, what is the condition for the UE to report the RSTD for the reference cell and all neighbor cells?
q_53107.ground_truth: The UE physical layer shall be capable of reporting RSTD for the reference cell and all the neighbor cells i out of at least (n-1) neighbor cells within provided the conditions apply for all subframes of at least PRS positioning occasions, PRP is less than or equal to 1,2 dBm, and for all Frequency Bands meet -15 dB for the reference cell and -15 dB for neighbor cell i.

q_53108.question: How are user event logs protected in the MC system?
q_53108.ground_truth: User event logs are protected by encryption and integrity protection while stored, and access to these logs is granted only to authorized personnel, with every access logged.

q_53109.question: Which two elements are common to both the tMbmsLevelType and tNetworkMonitoringInfoType, and what are their data types?
q_53109.ground_truth: The two common elements are "geographical-area" and "time-validity". Their data types are tGeographicalAreaDef and tIntegerAttributeType, respectively.

q_53110.question: What entities are responsible for the interactions when supporting SMS over IP in deployment scenarios with 2G/3G/4G accesses?
q_53110.ground_truth: The interactions are between HSS, UDM, and SMS over IP as defined in 3GPP TS 23.204.

q_53111.question: What is the purpose of using 5G credentials for UE behind an RG when it is not using untrusted Non-3GPP access to register?
q_53111.ground_truth: Using 5G credentials for UE behind an RG, even when it is not using untrusted Non-3GPP access to register, allows operators to identify UE behind RG and offer enhanced services such as Wi-Fi speed increase.

q_53112.question: What action should the UE take if it experiences internal overheating and prefers to temporarily reduce its DL and UL category?
q_53112.ground_truth: Include reducedUE-Category in the OverheatingAssistance IE, and set reducedUE-CategoryDL and reducedUE-CategoryUL to the number to which the UE prefers to temporarily reduce its DL and UL category.

q_53113.question: What should the EATF do upon receiving a SIP 2xx response to the SIP INVITE request due to E-STN-SR if an SDP answer has already been received from the remote UE on the dialog of the SIP response?
q_53113.ground_truth: If the SDP offer received in the SIP INVITE request due to E-STN-SR has already been sent to the remote UE and accepted with a subsequent SDP answer, the EATF should forward the SIP 2xx response on the target access leg as a SIP response to the SIP INVITE request due to E-STN-SR.

q_53114.question: What is the purpose of the 5GS providing Assisted or Complement Timing in this solution?
q_53114.ground_truth: The 5GS provides Assisted Timing as a backup timing service or Complement Timing to complement the external inaccurate primary local source.

q_53115.question: What is the role of an Attester in a typical attestation cycle?
q_53115.ground_truth: The Attester performs integrity measurements on the target system and generates a set of claims, known as Evidence, to show that the system has not been breached and is in a valid state.

q_53116.question: What is the effect on the positioning accuracy when Nt is reduced to 128, for AI/ML assisted positioning?
q_53116.ground_truth: Reducing Nt from 256 to 128 does not appreciably degrade the positioning accuracy, while the measurement size and signalling overhead shrink to (approximately) 1/2 that of Nt=256.

q_53117.question: What is one way that QoS differentiation can be provided in solution #16?
q_53117.ground_truth: QoS differentiation can be provided for different PINEs per PDU session / S-NSSAI and per QoS flow basis. The default QoS associated with the PDU session can be different based on the DNN and S-NSSAI. The PEGC can identify the communication from PINEs based on, for example, MAC address or IP addresses.

q_53118.question: What is the required throughput for the PDSCH in the IAB type 1-O, as determined by the performance requirement?
q_53118.ground_truth: The required throughput for the PDSCH in the IAB type 1-O is expressed as a fraction of the maximum throughput for the FRCs and assumes HARQ retransmissions.

q_53119.question: What is the initial DL BWP set to for the 7MHz allocation in SIB1?
q_53119.ground_truth: The initial DL BWP (BWP#0) is set to 5 MHz to accommodate legacy and new UEs.

q_53120.question: What message does the source gNB-DU send to the gNB-CU when the gNB-CU requests to create an UE context and setup one or more data bearers for inter-gNB-DU mobility?

q_53121.question: What should the UE indicate in the DETACH REQUEST message when it switches off while in EMM-REGISTERED state?
q_53121.ground_truth: The UE should indicate that the detach is due to a "switch off" and keep the native security context and deactivate the EPS bearer context(s) locally.

q_53122.question: In what scenarios should the UE include the Uplink data status IE in the SERVICE REQUEST message when sending it over a 5G network?
q_53122.ground_truth: The Uplink data status IE should be included in the SERVICE REQUEST message when the UE has one or more active always-on PDU sessions associated with the access type over which the SERVICE REQUEST message is sent and the user-plane resources for those PDU sessions are not established. Additionally, the Uplink data status IE should be included if the UE has pending user data to be sent for those PDU sessions.

q_53123.question: What digit range is used for protocol number or next header in IPv4 and IPv6 for the specified <protocol number (ipv4) / next header (ipv6)< parameter?
q_53123.ground_truth: The <protocol number (ipv4) / next header (ipv6)< parameter uses a digit range from 0 to 255.

q_53124.question: What is the purpose of the test case TC-DATA-CIP-eNB-Uu?
q_53124.ground_truth: The purpose of the test case TC-DATA-CIP-eNB-Uu is to verify that the user data packets are confidentiality protected over the air interface.

q_53125.question: What event should be used to indicate to the UE measurement control information indicating to the UE that event-triggered reporting is used?
q_53125.ground_truth: Event A3 is used to indicate to the UE measurement control information indicating to the UE that event-triggered reporting is used.

q_53126.question: What aspects of beam peak search procedures for CA are yet to be determined for certain cases?
q_53126.ground_truth: The aspect of beam peak search procedures for CA is to be determined for the case where the frequency separation is larger than 800 MHz, and the device manufacturer does not explicitly declare that the beam peak is applicable for a group of other intra-band combinations. This aspect is currently not determined in the specifications.

q_53127.question: What should the MCPTT server do if the Expires header field in the SIP PUBLISH request is not included or has a nonzero value lower than 4294967295?
q_53127.ground_truth: The MCPTT server should send a SIP 423 (Interval Too Brief) response to the SIP PUBLISH request and not continue with the rest of the steps.

q_53128.question: What is the action taken when a new MCVideo group information entry is not added to the candidate list for a specific MCVideo group ID?
q_53128.ground_truth: The candidate list is discarded, and the server skips the remaining steps.

q_53129.question: Which bit in Octet 5 of the User ID IE shall be set to "1" for the IMSI field to be present?
q_53129.ground_truth: Bit 1 in Octet 5 of the User ID IE

q_53130.question: What are the models used for subslot TTI tests with different QAM modulation at minimum power?

q_53131.question: What should be the measurement bandwidth defined for the protected band when measuring the UE emission power in the frequency ranges less than FOUTOB from the edge of the channel bandwidth?
q_53131.ground_truth: MBW/2, where MBW is the measurement bandwidth defined for the protected band.

q_53132.question: When does the Inter-UE Transfer field appear in a SIP message?
q_53132.ground_truth: The Inter-UE Transfer field appears in a SIP message when Inter-UE transfer has been performed for IMS service continuity.

q_53133.question: How does intent assurance differ from intent fulfillment in Intent-driven MnS?
q_53133.ground_truth: Intent assurance is a part of intent fulfillment that focuses on the recurring actions needed to keep assurance requirements achieved. This is contrasted with intent deployment, where the intent's goal only describes the availability or presence of a network or service.

q_53134.question: What is the applicability of the test case described in 7.5.1.5.2?
q_53134.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of NR (New Radio) UE (User Equipment) from Release 15 onwards supporting 5GS (5G System) NR (New Radio) SA (Standalone) FR2 (Frequency Range 2) and CSI-RS (Cumulative Spectrogram Image) based RLM (Radio Link Monitoring).

q_53135.question: What is the purpose of the I-SMF (Intermediate SMF) sending a quota request to the CHF in the 19ch-a step?
q_53135.ground_truth: The I-SMF sends a quota request to the CHF in the 19ch-a step to request quota for both its own and I-SMF usage when "start of service data flow" needs quota from the CHF.

q_53136.question: What is the maximum number of GUAMI?

q_53137.question: What does the HSS need to support for multiple public identities to be registered via a single IMS registration procedure from the UE?
q_53137.ground_truth: The HSS shall support the possibility to register multiple public identities via a single IMS registration procedure from the UE.

q_53138.question: How does the UE allocate PDCCH candidates for monitoring to USS sets for the primary cell?
q_53138.ground_truth: UE allocates PDCCH candidates for monitoring to USS sets for the

q_53139.question: What should the network do if it receives a registration request indicating initial or emergency registration from the UE before the UE-initiated de-registration procedure has been completed?
q_53139.ground_truth: The network shall abort the de-registration procedure and the registration procedure shall be progressed.

q_53140.question: What is the maximum power that the SAN is declared to radiate at the associated beam peak direction during the transmitter ON period in a given direction?
q_53140.ground_truth: The rated beam EIRP is the maximum power that the SAN is declared to radiate at the associated beam peak direction during the transmitter ON period.

q_53141.question: What is the topology adaptation procedure where the IAB-MT migrates from an old parent node to a new parent node?
q_53141.ground_truth: The topology adaptation procedure involves the migrating IAB-node becoming a boundary IAB-node with its IAB-DU retaining F1AP with the source IAB-donor-CU while its IAB-MT obtains RRC connectivity with the target IAB-donor-CU. These steps occur during the migration process from the source IAB-donor-CU to the target IAB-donor-CU.

q_53142.question: What is the maximum cycle length for WB-E-UTRA, LTE-M, and NB-IoT in the case where the extended idle mode DRX cycle length is 10.24s or longer?

q_53143.question: What is the function of the CAAR in the 3GPP TS 23.558 clause 8.9.1.5?
q_53143.ground_truth: The CAAR function is responsible for maintaining information on AC Association serviced per EES and can also be integrated in ECS functionality.

q_53144.question: What information can be provided by the AF for the NEF/PCF to minimize jitter in different parts of the 5GS?
q_53144.ground_truth: The AF can provide the end-to-end jitter, air interface transmission jitter, and CN part transmission jitter to the NEF/PCF for the PCF to generate policies to minimize jitter in different parts of the 5GS.

q_53145.question: What is the purpose of step a) in reducing the candidate MCVideo group IDs to that equal to N2?
q_53145.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure that the candidate number of MCVideo group IDs does not exceed the N2 value specified in the MaxAffiliationsN2 element of the Common element of the corresponding MCVideo user profile.

q_53146.question: What should a UE do if it receives 5GMM cause value #11 or #73, and is not in its HPLMN or EHPLMN, via 3GPP access?
q_53146.ground_truth: If the PLMN-specific attempt counter for the PLMN sending the reject message has a value less than a UE implementation-specific maximum value, the UE should increment the PLMN-specific attempt counter for the PLMN.

q_53147.question: What is one of the conditions for the SMF to assume a negative response from the AF after sending a notification regarding the target DNAI?
q_53147.ground_truth: The SMF can assume a negative response if a response is expected and not received from the AF within a certain time window.

q_53148.question: What is the role of the N43 reference point in the 5G communication system?
q_53148.ground_truth: The N43 reference point enables communication between the PCF for a UE and the PCF for the PDU Session.

q_53149.question: What are the three scenarios supported in Solution #1 for registration management charging in a SNPN network inclusive of PEC, IEC, and ECUR?

q_53150.question: What should the UE do during the monitoring operation if one of the specified conditions is no longer met?
q_53150.ground_truth: The UE may instruct the lower layers to stop monitoring.

q_53151.question: What type of MIME body does the SIP PUBLISH request contain to identify the MCVideo ID not served by the MCVideo server?

q_53152.question: What message does the Serving GW send to the PDN GW to acknowledge the change of, for example, the Serving GW relocation or the RAT type?
q_53152.ground_truth: The Modify Bearer Response per PDN connection

q_53153.question: What is the role of the NWDAF in generating a security context for AI/ML model storage and sharing?
q_53153.ground_truth: The NWDAF generates a security context to protect the ML model information, which is then stored protected in the ADRF with the data producer identity. NF consumers can request the protected ML model information and the security context from the NWDAF to unprotect the ML model information for further processing.

q_53154.question: What is used to indicate whether the UE should use the keys associated with the KASME key for E-UTRA/EPC, or KAMF for E-UTRA/5GC, upon handover?

q_53155.question: What is the AVP code value for the "LCS-EPS-Client-Name" AVP in the SLg interface protocol?
q_53155.ground_truth: The AVP code value for the "LCS-EPS-Client-Name" AVP in the SLg interface protocol is 2501.

q_53156.question: What should the UE do if it does not accept the server certificate of the network during the AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message?
q_53156.ground_truth: The UE should start timer T3520 when the AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message is sent and stop any running retransmission timers (e.g., T3510, T3517, T3521).

q_53157.question: What information should be transferred in the locationEstimate parameter in preference to the add-LocationEstimate parameter?
q_53157.ground_truth: A location estimate that is valid for the locationEstimate parameter should be transferred in this parameter in preference to the add-LocationEstimate.

q_53158.question: What is the method for deriving the equalization matrix (A) for the ZF equalization method?
q_53158.ground_truth: In the ZF equalization method, the equalization matrix (A) is generated as the inverse of the estimate (F) of the effective channel (HGW) for each subcarrier.

q_53159.question: What should the network do if it receives a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message before the ongoing identification procedure has been completed?
q_53159.ground_truth: The network should progress both procedures.

q_53160.question: What is the name of the command used to execute phonebook entries that start with a specific alphanumeric string?

q_53161.question: What is the expected reporting delay for the UE in test 1, as specified in section 8.4.2.5.5 of the document?
q_53161.ground_truth: The UE is expected to send one Event B1 triggered measurement report, with a measurement reporting delay less than D1 ms from the beginning of time period T2.

q_53162.question: What is the role of ROHC continuity in the SDT procedure?
q_53162.ground_truth: ROHC continuity is used to maintain the ROHC (Robust Header Compression) context when the UE initiates SDT, either when it receives an RRCRelease message with suspend indication or when it initiates SDT in a cell of its RNA. This helps to reduce the header overhead and improve the efficiency of the SDT procedure.

q_53163.question: What is the purpose of the receiver exclusion band in the context of UTRA?
q_53163.ground_truth: The receiver exclusion band is the frequency range over which no tests of radiated immunity of a receiver are made.

q_53164.question: What action should the network take if it sends an AUTHENTICATION REJECT message to the UE and the message is received without integrity protection with timer T3416, T3418, or T3420 running?
q_53164.ground_truth: The network should start timer T3247 with a random value uniformly drawn from the range between 30 minutes and 60 minutes if the timer is not running. If the network maintains a counter for "SIM/USIM considered invalid for GPRS services" events and the counter has a value less than a UE implementation-specific maximum value, the network should proceed as specified in clause 5.3.7b, list item 1a for the case that the EMM cause value received is #3; otherwise, it should proceed as specified under list item a above for the case that the message has been successfully integrity checked.

q_53165.question: What action should a UE take if it receives a Forbidden TAI(s) in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message and the TAI(s) is not a part of the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming"?
q_53165.ground_truth: The UE should store the TAI(s) belonging to the serving PLMN or equivalent PLMN(s) and ignore the TAI(s) which do not belong to the serving PLMN or equivalent PLMN(s) included in the IE into the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming" and remove the TAI(s) from the stored TAI list if present.

q_53166.question: What is the MAC level message name for ANBRQ in NR access?
q_53166.ground_truth: The MAC level message name for ANBRQ in NR access is "Recommended bit rate query MAC Control Element".

q_53167.question: What happens to the primary authentication performed if the UE accepts NAS SMC selecting NEA0 and NIA0 algorithms from the AMF as part of Emergency Registration request?
q_53167.ground_truth: The primary authentication performed if any is considered as unsuccessful, and the newly generated KAUSF is not stored.

q_53168.question: What should the MCPTT client do when it receives a 200 (OK) response to the SIP MESSAGE request for creation of a regroup?
q_53168.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should store the value of the <mcptt-regroup-uri> element as the temporary group identity and associate that with the group identity received in the <mcptt-regroup-uri> element.

q_53169.question: What should the gNB-CU-UP do if it receives a BEARER CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message containing the PDCP COUNT Reset IE in the DRB To Modify List IE of the PDU Session Resource To Modify List IE but if the Security Information IE is not present?
q_53169.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-UP should respond with a BEARER CONTEXT MODIFICATION FAILURE message and appropriate cause value.

q_53170.question: What should a GPRS MS do if it is operating in MS mode A or B in network operation mode I and the combined tracking area update procedure is rejected with the EMM cause value #11?
q_53170.ground_truth: The GPRS MS should set the GPRS update status to GU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED and the update status to U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED and enter the state GMM-DEREGISTERED. Furthermore, the MS shall delete any P-TMSI, P-TMSI signature, TMSI, RAI, LAI, ciphering key sequence number, GPRS ciphering key sequence number, shall delete the list of equivalent PLMNs and reset the routing area updating attempt counter and the location update attempt counter.

q_53171.question: When does the "PDUSetHandling" feature apply?
q_53171.ground_truth: The "PDUSetHandling" feature applies when PDU Set QoS related information for the single-modal data flow is provided within the "pduSetQosDl" and/or "pduSetQosUl" attribute.

q_53172.question: What conditions must be met for the requirement of identifying a new CGI of an E-UTRA cell to be applicable when no DRX is used and when all the DRX cycles specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 are used?
q_53172.ground_truth: The requirement of identifying a new CGI of an E-UTRA cell is applicable when no DRX is used and when all the DRX cycles specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 are used.

q_53173.question: When must the SCC AS send an SIP UPDATE request for each existing early dialog towards remote UEs in the pre-alerting phase?
q_53173.ground_truth: If there are one or more dialogs in an early dialog phase where all dialogs are early dialogs created by the same SIP INVITE request, a SIP 180 (Ringing) response to the SIP INVITE request has not been received yet in any of the existing dialogs, a g.3gpp.drvcc-orig-pre-alerting media feature tag is included in the SIP INVITE due to static STI, and the SCC AS supports CS to PS dual radio access transfer for originating calls in pre-alerting phase.

q_53174.question: What does the "FD" feature allow a user to do?
q_53174.ground_truth: The "FD" feature allows a user to use the SIM card or active application in the UICC's fixed dialling memory, with PIN2 authentication required in the current session.

q_53175.question: What does the NG-RAN do if the AMF includes End Indication in the DL NAS transport message?
q_53175.ground_truth: The NG-RAN delivers the NAS payload over RRC to the UE and releases the logical NG-AP signalling connection and RRC signalling connection if no further activity is detected.

q_53176.question: What action should a UE take if the new cell is better ranked than the current serving cell and more than 1 second has passed since the UE camped on the current serving cell?
q_53176.ground_truth: The UE should reselect the new cell.

q_53177.question: What is the first step taken by the SCP in the case of delegated service discovery when NF service consumer and NF service producer are in different PLMNs?
q_53177.ground_truth: The SCP recognizes that the request is for a NF service producer in another PLMN.

q_53178.question: Who collects the monitoring data for QoS enforcement in step 7?

q_53179.question: What should SS do for Release 16 and forward 5G NR UEs regarding power control in uplink scheduling information?
q_53179.ground_truth: SS should send continuously uplink power control "up" commands in every uplink scheduling information to the UE and allow at least 200msec for the UE to reach Pmax.

q_53180.question: What should be included in the SIP NOTIFY request when the controlling MCVideo function generates it with the clarification in this clause?
q_53180.ground_truth: A P-Asserted-Identity header field set to the public service identity of the controlling MCVideo function, among other things

q_53181.question: What is the definition of probability of false detection of the ACK in the test for ACK missed detection?
q_53181.ground_truth: The probability of false detection of the ACK is defined as a probability of erroneous detection of the ACK when input is only noise.

q_53182.question: How is the maximum input level defined for ATG UE?
q_53182.ground_truth: The maximum input level is defined as the maximum mean power received at the UE antenna port, at which the specified relative throughput shall meet or exceed the minimum requirements for the specified reference measurement channel.

q_53183.question: What are the pre-conditions before the VAE server sends set PC5 parameters request to the VAE client in the V2X UE?
q_53183.ground_truth: The V2X UE has discovered and connected to the VAE server, and if multicast delivery mode is used, the MBMS bearer being used is activated by the VAE server.

q_53184.question: What are the requirements for a UE measuring CSI-RS for CBD and another CSI-RS for RLM, BFD, CBD or L1-RSRP measurement in FR2 when they are in the same OFDM symbol on the same or different CCs in the same band?
q_53184.ground_truth: The UE is required to measure one of but not both CSI-RS for CBD measurement and the other CSI-RS, without defined requirements for the measurement period.

q_53185.question: What actions does the NSACF perform for each S-NSSAI included in PduACRequestData if the update flag is set to "INCREASE"?
q_53185.ground_truth: If the update flag is set to "INCREASE", the NSACF shall check whether the PDU session is already recorded in the PDU registration list and if the total number of PDU sessions to this slice will exceed the maximum number of PDU sessions allowed to be registered to this slice. If the PDU session is not recorded in the PDU registration list and the total number of PDU sessions does not exceed the maximum number allowed, the NSACF records the PDU session to the PDU registration list and updates the total number of PDU sessions registered to this slice accordingly. If the total number of PDU sessions will exceed the maximum number allowed, the NSACF shall not record the PDU session and shall record this S-NSSAI in the failed list of S-NSSAI in the response message.

q_53186.question: In what state does a UE enter when it receives a "no USIM in the ME" message over non-3GPP access?
q_53186.ground_truth: The UE enters the limited service state over non-3GPP access.

q_53187.question: What should the network do if it receives an EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message for CS fallback before the network initiated detach procedure has been completed and the DETACH REQUEST contains detach type "re-attach not required" with EMM cause #2 "IMSI unknown in HSS" or detach type "IMSI detach"?
q_53187.ground_truth: The network should progress both procedures.

q_53188.question: What is the value of the "Monitoring State" field when monitoring is inactive?
q_53188.ground_truth: The value of the "Monitoring State" field is '0' when monitoring is inactive.

q_53189.question: What is the action instructed by the SMF when credit is no longer available for PCC rules?
q_53189.ground_truth: The termination action instructs the UPF to perform specified actions for all PCC rules of a Charging key when credit is no longer available. This may involve deactivating certain rules or reverting the termination action when credit is available again.

q_53190.question: What is the method of selecting subbands for the calculation of the throughput ratio for FDD?
q_53190.ground_truth: The method of selecting subbands for the calculation of the throughput ratio for FDD is to randomly select M subbands among the best reported by the UE, and compare the throughput obtained in these subbands to that obtained when transmitting the TBS indicated by the reported wideband CQI median on a randomly selected subband in set S.

q_53191.question: What type of information is transported over the interface between the transmission participant interface and the transmission control server interface?
q_53191.ground_truth: The interface between the transmission participant interface and the transmission control server interface transports floor control messages to and from the associated transmission participant, limited to transmission control messages that can result in an action towards the transmission control server.

q_53192.question: What information does the "User Location Information" IE provide?
q_53192.ground_truth: The "User Location Information" IE provides location information of a UE.

q_53193.question: In what state does the mobile station enter the state PLMN SEARCH if an eCall only mobile station loses coverage and then returns to coverage?

q_53194.question: What should the AMF do when it receives a NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message during network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure?
q_53194.ground_truth: The AMF should stop timer T3575 and pass the EAP-response message received in the message to the upper layers or provide it to the AAA-S via the NSSAAF.

q_53195.question: What is required for a MCX user application to connect to the MC domain and obtain authorization token(s)?
q_53195.ground_truth: The MCX user application needs to authenticate the MC user to an Identity Management Server, which then provides the authorization token(s).

q_53196.question: What is the procedure followed by the SEPP for rewriting the telescopic FQDN in a received HTTP request from the Network Function or SCP?
q_53196.ground_truth: The SEPP rewrites the telescopic FQDN with the original FQDN by replacing the unique delimiter in the label with the period character and removing its own suffix part when it receives a HTTP request from the Network Function or SCP.

q_53197.question: Which entity is responsible for reinitialization delays at the boundary of different media presentations in the DASH client?
q_53197.ground_truth: The presentation engine is responsible for reinitialization delays at the boundary of different media presentations in the DASH client.

q_53198.question: What is the outcome if any of the events fail?
q_53198.ground_truth: If one event fails, then the test fails. If both events pass, then the test passes.

q_53199.question: What is one condition to steer user plane traffic to a Service Function Chain in N6-LAN Traffic Steering?
q_53199.ground_truth: One condition for steering user plane traffic to a Service Function Chain in N6-LAN Traffic Steering is when there is a service level agreement between the operator and a third party that includes a list of authorized predefined Service Function Chains (SFCs) and the AF requests for traffic to be steered towards a specific SFC.

q_53200.question: What is the issue with using PRB usage rate to evaluate the resource load of URLLC services under eMBB and URLLC multiplexing scenarios?
q_53200.ground_truth: The PRB usage rate only reflects the overall resource load of the cell, and it cannot reflect the situation where the resources of the URLLC service are insufficient at a particular transmission occasion.

q_53201.question: What is the "IMS voice over PS session supported indication" as defined in clause 5.16.3.2?
q_53201.ground_truth: It is an indication in the 5G system to show whether voice is supported over packet switched (PS) session.

q_53202.question: What happens when the gNB-CU receives a POSITIONING MEASUREMENT FAILURE INDICATION message?
q_53202.ground_truth: Upon reception of the POSITIONING MEASUREMENT FAILURE INDICATION message, the gNB-CU shall consider that the indicated positioning measurements have been terminated by the gNB-DU.

q_53203.question: What value should be set in the lawfulInterceptionIdentifier field of the encoded PDU for xIRI generation in case the LIID is not available at the MME?
q_53203.ground_truth: The value "LIIDNotPresent" should be set in the lawfulInterceptionIdentifier field of the encoded PDU for xIRI generation in case the LIID is not available at the MME.

q_53204.question: What is the formula for the overall delays measured in this test case?
q_53204.ground_truth: Overall delays measured = measurement reporting delay + TTI insertion uncertainty

q_53205.question: What procedures are updated for acquiring the PSAP destination with finer granularity of location info than Cell ID/TA level?
q_53205.ground_truth: The existing Emergency service procedure will be updated to acquire the PSAP destination with the finer granularity of location info than Cell ID/TA level.

q_53206.question: What should the UE do if the UE is connected to 5GC and timer T302 expires or is stopped for an Access Category for which T309 is not running?
q_53206.ground_truth: The UE should consider the barring for that Access Category to be alleviated and inform upper layers about barring alleviation for the Access Category.

q_53207.question: What parameter should always be included in the OCI header?
q_53207.ground_truth: The OCI shall always include the Overload Timestamp, Overload Reduction Metric, OCI Period of Validity and Scope parameters.

q_53208.question: What is a requirement for system handling during overload situations in accordance with industry best practice?
q_53208.ground_truth: The system shall provide security measures to deal with overload situations which can occur as a result of a denial of service attack or during periods of increased traffic, or reach the congestion threshold. Potential protective measures include restricting available RAM per application, restricting maximum sessions for a Web application, defining the maximum size of a dataset, restricting CPU resources per process, prioritizing processes, and overload control method.

q_53209.question: What is the purpose of the minimum requirement in 6.5.3.2 for IAB-MT modulation quality?
q_53209.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for IAB-MT modulation quality is to ensure that the modulation quality is within the limit specified by the minimum requirement.

q_53210.question: What is the URI of the urn:mpeg:dash:sand:channel:websocket:2016 scheme id in the sand:Channel element of the MPD?
q_53210.ground_truth: The URI of the urn:mpeg:dash:sand:channel:websocket:2016 scheme id in the sand:Channel element of the MPD is specified in the @endpoint attribute of the sand:Channel element.

q_53211.question: What are the OTA dynamic range requirements for BS type 1-O and what is the in-band selectivity and blocking requirements for BS type 1-O?
q_53211.ground_truth: The OTA dynamic range shall be met by the receiver unit to receive a wanted signal in the presence of an interfering signal inside the received BS channel bandwidth. The minimum requirement for BS type 1-O is that the throughput should be >= 95% of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channel. The OTA in-band selectivity and blocking requirements for BS type 1-O include the measure of the receiver's ability to receive an OTA wanted signal at its assigned channel frequency in the presence of an OTA adjacent channel signal with a specified center frequency offset of the interfering signal to the band edge of a victim system. The throughput should be >= 95% of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channel. The requirements should be met by the receiver unit when the AoA of the incident wave of a received signal and the interfering signal are from the same direction and are within the minSENS RoAoA.

q_53212.question: In DCI Format 1D, what information does the Downlink power offset provide?
q_53212.ground_truth: The Downlink power offset indicates the amount of power reduction or increase in dB applied to the required transmit power.

q_53213.question: What can the Intent-driven SON orchestration do when it observes contradictions in the intent during execution via SON?
q_53213.ground_truth: The Intent-driven SON orchestration should inform the intent MnS consumer of such contradictions which occur in the SON orchestration.

q_53214.question: What is the criterion for counting a success for the event "Activation" in step 6?
q_53214.ground_truth: The UE must send the first CSI report for SCell no later than slot s, or the next CSI report occasion if there is no CSI report occasion in slots s or s', with non-zero CQI index, and DTX must not be observed by the SS outside the slot to up to the end of T2.

q_53215.question: What should the SLM-C include in the Off-network location management message when sending a location report?
q_53215.ground_truth: The SLM-C should include the "Message type IE" as "LOCATION REPORT", the "Originating VAL user ID IE" as its own VAL user ID, the "Terminating VAL user ID IE" as the target VAL user ID, the location information in the "Location Management Data IE" and a unique "Message ID IE".

q_53216.question: What happens in the MME when barring of Packet Oriented Services is applied by administrative action in the HSS?
q_53216.ground_truth: The MME deactivates all existing EPS Bearer contexts, or deactivates associated EPS Bearer context with a particular path, depending on the barring category.

q_53217.question: What network entity is responsible for controlling interworking between a DCMTSI client in terminal and an MTSI client in terminal?

q_53218.question: What is the mandatory requirement for an action indicated by the term "shall" in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_53218.ground_truth: An action indicated by the term "shall" in the 3GPP Technical Specification is a mandatory requirement to be followed.

q_53219.question: What is the procedure for NF/NF service discovery between SNPN and Credentials Holder hosting AUSF/UDM or between SNPN and DCS hosting AUSF/UDM?
q_53219.ground_truth: The procedure involves the NF service consumer in SNPN invoking Nnrf_NFDiscovery_Request with appropriate identification for the Credentials Holder or the DCS and the NRF in SNPN identifies NRF in CH or DCS based on the identification.

q_53220.question: Who defines the transmit ON/OFF time mask for NR V2X and SL-U transmissions?
q_53220.ground_truth: The transmit ON/OFF time mask for NR V2X and SL-U transmissions is defined by the 3GPP standards body, specifically in clause 6.3F of the 3GPP TS 38.104 specification.

q_53221.question: What should the MS do if it is in the WAIT FOR OUTGOING MM CONNECTION or WAIT FOR ADDITIONAL OUTGOING MM CONNECTION state and receives a CM layer message?
q_53221.ground_truth: The MM sublayer in the MS should establish a new MM connection for the incoming CM message.

q_53223.question: How is the versioning of the document and its content determined?
q_53223.ground_truth: The versioning of the document is determined by the first digit, which indicates the status of the document in the TSG and the second digit is incremented for changes of substance, while the third digit is incremented for editorial changes.

q_53224.question: Which message is sent by the UE to the SS, always sent within SECURITY PROTECTED NAS MESSAGE message and ciphered if the ESM Message Container or NAS message container is present?

q_53225.question: What is the purpose of the AMF sending a De-registration Request to the UE with a specific cause code?
q_53225.ground_truth: The AMF sends a De-registration Request to the UE with a specific cause code to indicate that local services are going to be terminated soon, which prompts the UE to de-register from the current network in a staggered manner to avoid overloading the Home/Serving Network during the registration process.

q_53226.question: What is the maximum number of E-UTRA cells in SIB list for NR DL?

q_53227.question: What is the maximum number of PDP-Contexts that can be present in the GPRSDataList sequence?
q_53227.ground_truth: The maximum number of PDP-Contexts that can be present in the GPRSDataList sequence is 50.

q_53228.question: What is the role of the cSEPP in the discovery process of an NF Service Provider?
q_53228.ground_truth: The cSEPP is responsible for routing the discovery request to the pSEPP representing the target PLMN and applying the correct protection policies to the request.

q_53229.question: How many bits is the scheduled subframes field in the DCI format 0B?
q_53229.ground_truth: The scheduled subframes field in the DCI format 0B is 1 or 2 bits.

q_53230.question: How does the PCF handles the non-3GPP access when the 3GPP PS Data Off feature is activated?
q_53230.ground_truth: The PCF provides PCC rules containing Steering Mode "Active-Standby" with active access as non-3GPP access and no standby access for downlink and uplink direction for the PDU Session used for IMS services. For non MA PDU Sessions, the SMF/UPF prevents the services that do not belong to the list(s) of 3GPP PS Data Off Exempted Services by modifying or removing the dynamic PCC rules or deactivating the predefined PCC rules.

q_53231.question: In which situation would the Telephony AS interact with the SIGNING AS when RCD is supported?
q_53231.ground_truth: When Intra-CSP session signing is required.

q_53232.question: What must the controlling MCVideo function identify and send as a SIP 300 (Multiple Choices) response if the received SIP INVITE request with a "uri" attribute Contains a called functional alias that has been activated by more than one MCVideo user (referred to as MCVideo ID), in order to allow the originating user to select the appropriate called party?
q_53232.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function must identify one of the MCVideo IDs that have activated the received called functional alias in the application/resource-lists+xml MIME body of the SIP INVITE request, and send a SIP 300 (Multiple Choices) response to the originating user with a list of MCVideo IDs that have activated the alias and their corresponding MCVideo session identities.

q_53233.question: In the case of the RRC Resume procedure when the UE receives an RRCReject message, what should the UE do to retry the procedure?
q_53233.ground_truth: The UE should use the same I-RNTI and the same old Krrcint key for the second RRCResumeRequest message after the wait timer expires.

q_53234.question: What is the result of successful S1 release procedure for a UE?
q_53234.ground_truth: The S1-AP signalling connection and S1 bearers are released for a UE and the UE moves from ECM-CONNECTED to ECM-IDLE in both the UE and MME. All UE related context information is deleted in the eNodeB. If Service Gap Control is applied, the Service Gap timer is started in MME and UE when entering ECM-IDLE.

q_53235.question: What is the purpose of the "Forwarding Parameters" in the FAR message?
q_53235.ground_truth: The "Forwarding Parameters" in the FAR message provide instructions on how to forward the packets, including the specific actions to be taken (drop, forward, buffer, duplicate, and notify the CP function).

q_53236.question: What type of assistance data is used with the MAC N-RTK technique to provide information regarding the Master Reference Station?

q_53237.question: What is the purpose of the CCA in this authorization process?
q_53237.ground_truth: The CCA (Consumer's Client Authentication) is used to authorize the SCP to act on behalf of the NF Service Consumer. It contains the NF Instance ID of the consumer, which is used to verify the identity and authenticity of the consumer.

q_53238.question: Which CBS Message Identifier values relate to warning messages delivered in languages which are mandatory to receive?

q_53239.question: What type of connector for an IAB type 1-H can only support operation in a single operating band or multiple operating bands, but not meeting the conditions for a multi-band connector?

q_53240.question: What is mandatory when requesting a list of top applications contributing the most to traffic using the "UserDataCongestionExt" feature?
q_53240.ground_truth: The "maxTopAppUlNbr" attribute for uplink and/or the "maxTopAppDlNbr" attribute for downlink directions must be provided.

q_53241.question: When a UE is authorized for ProSe direct communication with radio parameters associated with a geographical area and out of E-UTRAN coverage, what should the UE do when it wants to transmit ProSe direct communication while located in that geographical area and does not have a selected SyncRef UE?
q_53241.ground_truth: The UE is able to transmit ProSe direct communication using the radio parameters associated with that geographical area based on its own timing.

q_53242.question: What happens if the 'F' bit is set to 1?
q_53242.ground_truth: If the 'F' bit is set to 1, it indicates a horizontal (left-right flip) mirror operation on the video.

q_53243.question: Which attribute group is referenced in the "complexType" element named "On-networkType" for the "anyAttribute" element?
q_53243.ground_truth: The "IndexType" attribute group is referenced in the "complexType" element named "On-networkType".

q_53244.question: What is one of the threats for the lack of protection of system information in the 5G network?
q_53244.ground_truth: A lack of protection of system information could potentially result in denial-of-service (DoS) attacks and rogue services in some cases.

q_53245.question: In UTRA FDD and TDD, what is the channel raster?
q_53245.ground_truth: The channel raster for UTRA FDD and TDD is 200 kHz for all bands.

q_53246.question: In what situations must the S-CSCF insert a Response-Source header field with an "fe" header field parameter in a failure response?
q_53246.ground_truth: The S-CSCF must insert a Response-Source header field with an "fe" header field parameter when sending a failure response to any received request, based on operator policy.

q_53247.question: At what level is the output power Pout specified in Note 1 of clause 6.2.3?
q_53247.ground_truth: The output power Pout is specified assuming a Home BS reference antenna gain of 0 dBi, a target outage zone of 47dB around the Home BS for a UE on the adjacent channel, an ACIR of 33 dB, an adjacent channel UE CPICH Ec/Io target of -18 dB, and the same CPICH Ec for the Home BS and the adjacent channel UE.

q_53248.question: When registered to an SNPN, what are the restrictions on using UE policies and TAIs from other SNPNs?
q_53248.ground_truth: When registered to an SNPN, the UE shall use only the UE policies provided by the registered SNPN and shall only include TAIs of the registered SNPN in the registration area or LADN service area.

q_53249.question: What are the procedures for establishing multiple PDN connections when the UE accesses EPC via S2c using untrusted non-3GPP IP access?
q_53249.ground_truth: The UE shall follow the procedures described in 3GPP~TS~24.303, and establish only one IPsec tunnel to the ePDG.

q_53250.question: What is the state of the UE when a dedicated WLCP bearer context is active?
q_53250.ground_truth: WLCP BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE for a dedicated bearer.

q_53251.question: What is the performance metric used in the evaluation of AI/ML based CSI prediction for wireless communication, and how is it calculated?
q_53251.ground_truth: The performance metric used in the evaluation of AI/ML based CSI prediction for wireless communication is SGCS in linear value for layer 1. It is calculated using a future 4ms or 5ms instance from the prediction output and considering the UE speed from 10km/h to 60km/h.

q_53252.question: What should a transmission participant do when it receives a Transmission Release message and the User ID in the Transmission Release message matches with a stored User ID in the transmitter list?
q_53252.ground_truth: The transmission participant should provide transmission released notification to the MCVideo user, request the MCVideo client to stop rendering the received RTP media packets, stop timer T203 (End of RTP media) for the User ID in the Transmission Release message, delete the User ID in the transmitter list, and remain in the 'O: pending request' state.

q_53253.question: What is the time interval considered when determining if the last symbol of PDCCH and the starting symbol of either Nc1 or NS meet the required time duration?
q_53253.ground_truth: The time interval is based on the smaller subcarrier spacing across any carrier within the set Sc2, c1 and their corresponding scheduling cells.

q_53254.question: What is the impact between Enhanced Calling Name (eCNAM) and Multi-Device (MuD) services?
q_53254.ground_truth: Neither service shall affect the operation of the other service.

q_53255.question: What is the test applicability for In-band blocking for Category M1 as specified in 7.6A.2.2?
q_53255.ground_truth: This test case applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 17 and forward of category M1 that support satellite access operation.

q_53256.question: Which property of the 5GSessionContext object is the name of the property that indicates the contextAttribute?

q_53257.question: What mode of operation does a UE use when only reselecting cells within the selected/registered SNPN or equivalent SNPNs in an SNPN access mode only?
q_53257.ground_truth: A UE in SNPN access mode only reselects cells within the selected/registered SNPN or within equivalent SNPNs.

q_53258.question: What status code is returned by the MBSTF when an MBS distribution session is successfully deleted?
q_53258.ground_truth: The MBSTF returns a "204 No Content" status code when an MBS distribution session is successfully deleted.

q_53259.question: What is the internal state managed by the MCData client for an ongoing group communication?

q_53260.question: Which attribute may be used to indicate the time synchronization error budget within the AccessTimeDistributionData data structure?
q_53260.ground_truth: The "timeSyncErrBdgt" attribute may be used to indicate the time synchronization error budget within the AccessTimeDistributionData data structure.

q_53261.question: What method is used for the RF electromagnetic field test in section 9.2 of the document?
q_53261.ground_truth: The test method is based on anechoic chamber as per IEC 61000-4-3.

q_53262.question: In the same context, what does the variable L represent?
q_53262.ground_truth: Total number of positioning frequency layers

q_53263.question: What is the role of the Dynamic External Group ID in the EDI record?
q_53263.ground_truth: The Dynamic External Group ID in the EDI record is used to identify a group of UEs associated with the same DNAI and/or EAS. This allows the AF to influence the routing for the collection of UEs by using the same DNAI and/or EAS.

q_53264.question: How can the operator customize radio parameters and KPIs in intent-driven SON?
q_53264.ground_truth: The operator can specify customizations, such as expected outcomes on certain parameters or metrics, through the intent-driven MnS interface, which generates appropriate commands for SON to achieve the targets.

q_53265.question: What should the IWF floor control server include in the Floor Revoke message if the current speaker is revoked due to a pre-emptive floor priority request?
q_53265.ground_truth: The IWF floor control server should include a Reject Cause field with the <Reject Cause> value set to #4 (Media Burst pre-empted) in the Floor Revoke message.

q_53266.question: What should the SGW do upon receipt of a PGW Downlink Triggering Notification message during the SGW restoration procedure?
q_53266.ground_truth: The SGW should send a PGW Downlink Triggering Notification message to the MME/S4-SGSN and then send a PGW Downlink Triggering Acknowledge message back to the PGW with an acceptance cause code.

q_53267.question: What protocol is used by the PCF to send an HTTP request to the UDR, in order to update the Remaining Maximum Slice Data Rate information in the "SlicePolicyControlData" resource?

q_53268.question: What should the MCVideo client include in the Accept-Contact header field of the SIP INVITE request for a private call with transmission control?
q_53268.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should include an Accept-Contact header field containing the g.3gpp.mcvideo media feature tag along with the "require" and "explicit" header field parameters in the SIP INVITE request.

q_53269.question: What is the minimum requirement for IAB-DU type 1-H and IAB-MT type 1-H in relation to operating band unwanted emissions for each TAB connector TX min cell group and each applicable basic limit in clause 6.6.4.2?
q_53269.ground_truth: The operating band unwanted emissions requirements for IAB-DU type 1-H and IAB-MT type 1-H are that for each TAB connector TX min cell group and each applicable basic limit in clause 6.6.4.2, the power summation emissions at the TAB connectors of the TAB connector TX min cell group must not exceed the specified limit.

q_53270.question: What should the XCAP server do if it receives a request requiring a password, but the password in the request does not match the current password stored for the user?
q_53270.ground_truth: The XCAP server should respond with an HTTP 409 (Conflict) response.

q_53271.question: What character in ABNF represents the start of a comment that continues to the end of the line?
q_53271.ground_truth: The semicolon character (";") indicates the start of a comment that continues to the end of the line in ABNF.

q_53272.question: What is the condition for the test described in 6.2.2.2.1.4.2 to pass?
q_53272.ground_truth: The test described in 6.2.2.2.1.4.2 passes if both SNR points of the test have been tested and the UE has passed at least one of the SNR points.

q_53273.question: What information can satellite coverage availability information include?
q_53273.ground_truth: Satellite coverage availability information can include details about when and where satellite coverage is expected to be available in a given area.

q_53274.question: What shall a UE operating in CS/PS mode 1 with "IMS voice not available" attempt to select if it receives an update result IE with value "SMS only" in a TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message?
q_53274.ground_truth: It shall attempt to select GERAN or UTRAN radio access technology rather than E-UTRAN for the selected PLMN or equivalent PLMN.

q_53275.question: What is the purpose of the soft buffer management test for FDD PCell in 8.2.3.2.1A?
q_53275.ground_truth: The purpose of the soft buffer management test for FDD PCell in 8.2.3.2.1A is to verify the UE performance with proper instantaneous buffer implementation for FDD as PCell.

q_53276.question: What must the participating MCData function include in the outgoing SIP INVITE request's Request-URI?
q_53276.ground_truth: The public user identity associated with the MCData ID of the terminating MCData user.

q_53277.question: What is the difference between the LocalSDP and RemoteSDP in the IMS media flow?
q_53277.ground_truth: The LocalSDP is associated with the incoming media packets, providing the SDP information expected by the IMS Media Function that has the CC-POI. On the other hand, the RemoteSDP is associated with the outgoing media packets and provides the SDP information expected by the remote end of the media flow.

q_53278.question: What information is included in the logged measurement report for downlink pilot strength measurements in 3GPP TS 38.331?
q_53278.ground_truth: The logged measurement report for downlink pilot strength measurements in 3GPP TS 38.331 consists of measurement results for the serving cell, available UE measurements performed in idle or inactive for intra-frequency/inter-frequency/inter-RAT, time stamp and location information.

q_53279.question: What is the minimum and maximum length of the calling party subaddress information element?
q_53279.ground_truth: The minimum length of the calling party subaddress information element is 2 octets and the maximum length is 23 octets.

q_53280.question: When can the test coverage for FDD and TDD tests be considered fulfilled without executing single carrier tests?
q_53280.ground_truth: The test coverage can be fulfilled without executing single carrier tests if corresponding CA tests are tested for FDD tests specified in 8.2.1.1.1, 8.2.1.3.1, 8.2.1.4.3, and 8.7.1, and for TDD tests specified in 8.2.2.1.1, 8.2.2.3.1, 8.2.2.4.3, and 8.7.2.

q_53281.question: What do Octets "p to (p+3)" or "q to (q+15)" in the Link-Specific Multipath IP Address IE represent in 3GPP TS 24.193?
q_53281.ground_truth: Octets "p to (p+3)" or "q to (q+15)" in the Link-Specific Multipath IP Address IE represent the value for Link-Specific Multipath IP Address for 3GPP or Non-3GPP access.

q_53282.question: What is a condition for initiating ProSe direct communication when the UE is not served by E-UTRAN?
q_53282.ground_truth: If the UE can determine itself located in a geographical area, and the UE is provisioned with radio parameters for the geographical area, the UE shall select the radio parameters associated with that geographical area.

q_53283.question: What should the UE do if it supports ProSe direct discovery, ProSe direct communication, or acting as a ProSe UE-to-network relay?
q_53283.ground_truth: The UE should set the ProSe bit to "ProSe supported" and include the corresponding ProSe direct discovery, ProSe direct communication, or ProSe UE-to-network relay bit in the UE network capability IE of the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.

q_53284.question: What should the UE do if it receives the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message with the T3512 value IE from an SNPN?
q_53284.ground_truth: If the UE receives the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message with the T3512 value IE from an SNPN, the UE shall use the value in the T3512 value IE as periodic registration update timer (T3512).

q_53285.question: What information is returned by the AMF to the UE after successful UUAA during PDU Session Establishment?
q_53285.ground_truth: The AMF sends the UUAA result (success/failure) and the UUAA Authorization Payload to the UE.

q_53286.question: What information is contained in the Global Cell Identity IE?
q_53286.ground_truth: The Global Cell Identity IE is used to globally identify an NG-RAN cell or an E-UTRAN cell.

q_53287.question: When can the UP function initiate the PFCP Association Update procedure, and what should it do when sending a PFCP Association Update Request?
q_53287.ground_truth: The UP function can initiate the PFCP Association Update procedure to report changes to the PFCP association to the CP function, such as a change in optional features, an indication to request to release the PFCP association, or a change in the UE IP address pool identities. When sending a PFCP Association Update Request, the UP function should update the list of optional features of the CP function, send an appropriate error cause if the Node ID is not known by the UP Function, and return a successful cause value if the PFCP Association Update Request is handled successfully.

q_53288.question: What shall the UE include in the mbms-FreqList if the set of MBMS frequencies of interest is not empty?
q_53288.ground_truth: The UE shall include mbms-FreqList and set it to include the MBMS frequencies of interest, using the EARFCN corresponding with freqBandIndicator included in SystemInformationBlockType1, if applicable, and the EARFCN(s) as included in SystemInformationBlockType15.

q_53289.question: What action does the HARQ process take if it is the first received transmission for the TB and it is associated with a broadcast process?
q_53289.ground_truth: The HARQ process considers this transmission to be a new transmission.

q_53290.question: What is Selected IP Traffic Offload (SIPTO) for PS Domain only?
q_53290.ground_truth: SIPTO is a mechanism that enables the 3GPP system to offload selected internet traffic towards a defined IP network close to the UE's point of attachment to the access network. The feature improves network efficiency, and is accompanied by a set of requirements for implementation.

q_53291.question: What device should be used to generate the wanted signal in the SAN test setup?
q_53291.ground_truth: A SAN tester should be used to generate the wanted signal in the SAN test setup.

q_53292.question: How does the PDU Families concept provide flexibility for cases where Media Unit Identification is only available for a sub-set of PDU Families?
q_53292.ground_truth: The PDU Families concept provides flexibility by allowing intermediate classification and marking of packets based on identified media types and layer dependencies, even if some parts of the frame-type and slice remain unidentified. This classification can be used to apply differentiated packet handling policies based on whether packets are associated with a "base layer" or "enhancement layer".

q_53293.question: What is the purpose of the Full name for network IE in GMM information message from the network?
q_53293.ground_truth: The Full name for network IE in GMM information message from the network indicates the full length name of the network that the network wishes the mobile station to associate with the MCC and MNC contained in the routing area identification of the current cell.

q_53294.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project Technical Specification Group's study on continuous integration and continuous delivery support for 3GPP NFs?
q_53294.ground_truth: The study aims to automate CI-CD based testing of 3GPP NFs after delivery to an operator's operation environment, and to describe the support the 3GPP system provides for CI-CD and other testing.

q_53295.question: Which information element is included in the request MBMS context activation message to allow the MS to associate the MBMS context with the PDP context over which the IGMP/MLD join message was sent?

q_53296.question: What is the maximum value for the "MaximumSpeed" in the "SpeedType" complex type?

q_53297.question: What is the function of UE in the described initial conditions?
q_53297.ground_truth: The UE's function in the described initial conditions is to be fully synchronized with Cell 1 prior to the start of the time duration T1, provide periodic CSI reporting, and adhere to UL CCA model in its transmissions.

q_53298.question: What is the name of the IE used by the location server to request location information for sensor-based methods from a target device?

q_53299.question: What is the requirement for the measurement reporting delay excluding a delay uncertainty when the measurement report is transmitted on the PUSCH with subframe or slot or subslot duration?
q_53299.ground_truth: The delay uncertainty is 2 x TTIDCCH, where TTIDCCH is the duration of subframe or slot or subslot when the measurement report is transmitted on the PUSCH with subframe or slot or subslot duration.

q_53300.question: What is the main difference between avoidance-based and runtime-based methods in reducing overall waiting for UEs before re-registration to their home network?
q_53300.ground_truth: Avoidance-based methods allow UEs to return to their Home Network in a distributed or staggered manner, while runtime-based methods directly apply existing congestion control and overload control mechanisms.

q_53301.question: What is the subject of the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network document specified in Release 18?
q_53301.ground_truth: The user equipment (UE) conformance specification for the 5G System (5GS), specifically focusing on the common test environment.

q_53302.question: What is the purpose of the Carrier leakage test in 6.4A.2.2.1?
q_53302.ground_truth: The purpose of the Carrier leakage test in 6.4A.2.2.1 is to exercise the UE transmitter and verify its modulation quality in terms of carrier leakage.

q_53303.question: What is the role of S-CSCF#1 in Procedure S-S#1 when receiving an SIP INVITE request from the UE?
q_53303.ground_truth: S-CSCF#1 sends the INVITE request to S-CSCF#2, which handles the session termination, while also forwarding the initial media description offer in the SDP.

q_53304.question: What does not influence the RTP payload type number(s) in the IMS-preferred-codec-list element?
q_53304.ground_truth: The RTP payload type number(s) indicated in the MSC-server-supported-codec-list do not influence the RTP payload type number(s) in the IMS-preferred-codec-list element.

q_53305.question: How does the TSN CCS (TSN Charging Collection Server) aggregate the volume usage for TSC?
q_53305.ground_truth: The TSN CCS aggregates the volume usage per 5GS bridge via 5GS bridge Id for TSC based on the accumulation of usage reporting per UE via the 5GS bridge.

q_53306.question: What measures should be taken to support the charging of long calls and sessions in packet data services?
q_53306.ground_truth: The serving network should support the transmission of charging information during the life of the packet data session, either when some charge value is reached or some duration or data volume, to allow for both charging settlement and cost control.

q_53307.question: What is the maximum allowed delay for a UE to start sending CSI reports for PCell after the start of T3 in the test procedure 4.5.11.1.4.2?
q_53307.ground_truth: The UE shall transmit at least one periodic CSI report for PCell during T3.

q_53308.question: What is the purpose of the public service identity in the 3GPP system?
q_53308.ground_truth: The public service identity can identify the controlling MCData function in the local MCData system or in an interconnected MCData system. If the controlling MCData function is in an interconnected MCData system in a different trust domain, then the public service identity can identify the MCData gateway server that acts as an entry point in the interconnected MCData system from the local MCData system.

q_53309.question: What is the charging model in a service data flow that is governed by a PCC rule with an "Offline" charging method?
q_53309.ground_truth: Quota management is not required for this service data flow, and usage reporting is required without affecting the delivery.

q_53310.question: How should Test Case 10 (TC10) be constructed in the case where a base station supports more than one NB-IoT carrier?
q_53310.ground_truth: Place two NB-IoT carriers at the edges of the Base Station RF Bandwidth, with two UTRA FDD carriers in the middle. Add NB-IoT carriers at the edges using 600 kHz spacing, and add extra UTRA FDD carriers if possible.

q_53311.question: In operation without shared spectrum channel access and for SS/PBCH block and CORESET multiplexing patterns 2 and 3, when does a UE monitor PDCCH in the Type0-PDCCH CSS set?
q_53311.ground_truth: A UE monitors PDCCH in the Type0-PDCCH CSS set over one slot with Type0-PDCCH CSS set periodicity equal to the periodicity of SS/PBCH block.

q_53312.question: How can the MME reduce message processing load on local competing networks in the event of a network failure?
q_53312.ground_truth: By using a Periodic TAU timer value sent by the HSS and/or the low access priority indication, the MME can allocate a long periodic TAU timer value to the UE, slowing down the rate of movement of UEs from a failed network to other local competing networks.

q_53313.question: What is the requirement for the SFTD measurement reporting delay, assuming that the measurement report is not delayed by other RRC signaling on the DCCH?
q_53313.ground_truth: The SFTD measurement reporting delay shall be less than the measurement period defined in clause 8.17.2.2.

q_53314.question: What is the test purpose in 6.1.1.8.1?
q_53314.ground_truth: The test purpose in 6.1.1.8.1 is to ensure that when the UE is in Automatic network selection mode and RPLMN, EHPLMN cells are available and UE is fitted with a USIM containing the EHPLMN list and the USIM indicates RPLMN or (E)HPLMN should be selected, then UE selects a cell of the RPLMN or EHPLMN and when successfully registered indicates the selected PLMN to the user.

q_53315.question: What triggers the sending of notifications by the 5GMSd AF to the 5GMSd Application Provider?
q_53315.ground_truth: The 5GMSd AF sends notifications in response to event-related occurrences or at periodic intervals.

q_53316.question: What is the level of the test signal for handset or headset UE in this process?
q_53316.ground_truth: The level of the test signal is -4,7~dBPa at the MRP for handset or headset UE.

q_53317.question: What is the role of the SMF in the translation of RAN BAW to 5GS ingress BAW?
q_53317.ground_truth: The SMF translates RAN BAW to 5GS ingress BAW and signals RAN preferences to PCF.

q_53318.question: What should the MCData server do if the candidate expiration interval is nonzero and the expiration time of the functional alias information entry has not expired yet?
q_53318.ground_truth: The MCData server should copy the functional alias information entry into a new functional alias information entry of the candidate list of the functional alias information entries, and set the expiration time of the new functional alias information entry to the current time increased with the candidate expiration interval.

q_53319.question: How are partial CDRs generated for session based charging?
q_53319.ground_truth: A CDR is opened when the initial charging event is received, and information is added to it upon receiving interim events. The CDR may be closed due to certain reasons, such as time limit, volume limit, etc. Multiple partial CDRs may be needed to completely describe the session.

q_53320.question: What is required for a UE to use Allowed CAG information in the case of hosting network being PNI-NPN?
q_53320.ground_truth: The UE shall use the Allowed CAG information only when accessing the hosting network for the Localized service.

q_53321.question: What should the transmission control interface do if multiple MCVideo clients have the permission to send media and a Media Transmission Notification message is handled in the 'U: not permitted and transmit taken' state as specified in clause~6.3.5.4.2?
q_53321.ground_truth: It should handle the message as specified in clause~6.3.5.4.2.

q_53322.question: What should the MAC entity do if the Preamble Transmission Counter is equal to preambleTransMax + 1?
q_53322.ground_truth: If the Preamble Transmission Counter is equal to preambleTransMax + 1, the MAC entity should indicate a Random Access problem to upper layers. If the Random Access Preamble is transmitted on an SCell, the MAC entity should consider the Random Access procedure unsuccessfully completed.

q_53323.question: What is the role of the NG RAN nodes in the MBS session establishment process?
q_53323.ground_truth: NG RAN nodes serve UEs within the MBS session and request the MB-SMF to deliver MBS data towards them. They then multicast the MBS data over the radio.

q_53324.question: What is the action taken by the floor control interface when it receives an RTP media packet with payload from the associated floor participant while in the 'U: pending Floor Revoke' state, as per clause 6.3.5.6.4?
q_53324.ground_truth: The RTP media packet is forwarded to the media distributor and the state remains as 'U: pending Floor Revoke'.

q_53325.question: What should the UAE-S include in the HTTP 200 (OK) response when the UAS UE registration is successful?
q_53325.ground_truth: The UAE-S should include a result element set to "success" in the registration-info element of the UAE-info root element.

q_53326.question: What must the MSGin5G Server do if a message is too large to be sent?
q_53326.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Server segments the message into a set of segmented MSGin5G messages such that each segmented MSGin5G message can fit within the maximum allowed MSGin5G message segmentation size.

q_53327.question: What is the purpose of the "Uplink power control window" in this process?
q_53327.ground_truth: The purpose of the Uplink power control window is to ensure that the actual UE output power is no greater than the target power level, and as close as possible to the target power level.

q_53328.question: What message is required to be created when modifying PC5 QoS parameters for existing PC5 QoS flow(s) in a 5G ProSe direct link?
q_53328.ground_truth: A PROSE DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION REQUEST message is required to be created.

q_53329.question: What is the function of the SCEF in the reliable delivery of Non-IP data between UE and SCEF using the Control Plane CIoT EPS Optimization?
q_53329.ground_truth: The SCEF applies rate control and indicates to the MME the status of the DL data delivery, which may be forwarded to the AS.

q_53330.question: What is the role of the SMF during PDU session establishment and modification regarding QoS for devices behind the 5G-RG?
q_53330.ground_truth: The SMF may signal Non-3GPP QoS Assistance Information (N3QAI) for each QoS flow to the 5G-RG, which the 5G-RG can use to reserve resources in the non-3GPP network behind the 5G-RG for consumer real time applications.

q_53331.question: Which entity interacts with CHF for charging in Solution #8.2 for converged charging for NSSAA?
q_53331.ground_truth: AAA-P interacts with CHF during NSSAA procedure for a given UE and S-NSSAI for CHF to produce appropriate CDR for charging for "requesting (re-)authentication/authorization" between the owner of the NSSAAF and the owner of the AAA-S.

q_53332.question: What message type is to be included in the Floor Ack message, if the first bit in the subtype of the Floor Release message is set to '1' in clause 6.3.5.6.5?
q_53332.ground_truth: The message type included in the Floor Ack message is '4' (Floor Release).

q_53333.question: What is the measurement that, when not supported for the target band and the serving cell's band, results in transmission restrictions on the union of restricted serving cell symbols in simultaneousRxTxInterBandCA?

q_53334.question: What protocols are used for routing user data and control signalling in the backbone network?

q_53335.question: What is the relation between the SLSS transmission initiation delay and the SLSS period in the initiation/cease of SLSS?
q_53335.ground_truth: The initiation/cease delay of SLSS transmissions can be expressed as: Tevaluate,SLSS + SLSS period, where Tevaluate,SLSS is the evaluation time for initiate/cease of SLSS and SLSS period is set as 40ms in this test.

q_53336.question: What information does the NG-RAN node use when setting up the UE-associated logical NG-connection towards the 5GC for access control of subsequent mobility?
q_53336.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node uses the list of CAGs allowed for the UE and, whether the UE is allowed to access non-CAG cells to set up the UE-associated logical NG-connection.

q_53337.question: What should the UE do, if the carrier frequency is not applicable for idle mode measurement reporting?
q_53337.ground_truth: The UE should not consider the carrier frequency to be applicable for idle mode measurement reporting.

q_53338.question: What information element is used to indicate the PLMN Identity?

q_53339.question: What is the name of the threat that involves storing passwords in an insecure way?

q_53340.question: What is the purpose of the release independent features in TSG-RAN agreements?
q_53340.ground_truth: The purpose of release independent features in TSG-RAN agreements is to introduce certain features in a way that they are "introduced" in one release (Rel-N) and are "release independent" starting from an earlier release (Rel-M). UEs supporting these features must meet additional requirements defined in TS 36.307 of Rel-N.

q_53341.question: What should the eNB do if it cannot establish an S1 UE context during the Initial Context Setup procedure?
q_53341.ground_truth: The eNB should consider the procedure as failed and reply with the INITIAL CONTEXT SETUP FAILURE message.

q_53342.question: What is the purpose of the virtual identifier in the 6.6 solution?
q_53342.ground_truth: The virtual identifier is used in the 6.6 solution as a legal identifier of the non-3GPP device behind the 5G-RG for which the 5G-RG is doing the authentication procedure on behalf.

q_53343.question: What is the use of sequence expressions in XPath 2.0?
q_53343.ground_truth: Sequence expressions in XPath 2.0 help to render XPath expressions more compact, for example, by allowing the selection of multiple attributes of an object or multiple objects based on instance names.

q_53344.question: What must be supported by a target eNB and the target MME for PDN connections with UP integrity protection set to Required to be transferred from 5GS to EPS?
q_53344.ground_truth: The target eNB and the target MME must indicate support of User Plane Integrity Protection with EPS.

q_53345.question: Which category of Trustworthy Machine Learning focuses on correcting and eliminating bias in machine learning models?

q_53346.question: What is the purpose of the AI index field in the availability combination of soft symbols or soft RB sets in an RB set group in a slot?
q_53346.ground_truth: The AI index field includes the maximum of the values provided by the corresponding availabilityCombinationId, with a minimum of 1 bit and a maximum equal to the ceiling of the log base 2 of the maximum AI index plus 1.
