q_53593.question: What is the purpose of detecting Unnecessary HO to another system during inter-system Mobility Robustness Optimization?
q_53593.ground_truth: The purpose is to identify situations where the UE is handed over to another system unnecessarily, which may result in an inefficient use of the networks.

q_53594.question: How are the Connectivity Group IDs on the 5G-RG defined, and what are they mapped to?
q_53594.ground_truth: Connectivity Group IDs are defined by the 5G-RG, with each ID corresponding to a separate physical or virtual port, such as a VLAN, WLAN SSID, or Ethernet port. These group IDs are then mapped to a separate PDU Session that is established by the 5G-RG based on the procedures defined in clause~7.

q_53595.question: What procedure shall the UE execute if the received message includes a UE contention resolution identity MAC control element and the UE contention resolution identity matches the CCCH SDU transmitted in the uplink message?
q_53595.ground_truth: The UE shall not re-select a preamble or adjust transmission power, but instead wait for the backoff time to expire before transmitting again.

q_53596.question: What are the conditions for the commanding UE to create a new KD in ProSe direct communication?
q_53596.ground_truth: The commanding UE shall create a new KD when it does not share a known KD with the peer UE or wishes to derive a new one, ensuring the generated KD ID will be unique.

q_53597.question: What should the MCVideo client do when it receives an indication from the MCVideo user to cancel an emergency alert while in the "E2: Emergency state" and the specified condition is fulfilled?
q_53597.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should set the stored emergency state as "false", generate a GROUP EMERGENCY ALERT CANCEL message, send the message, stop timer TFE2 (emergency alert retransmission), and enter the "E1: Not in emergency state" state.

q_53598.question: What is the objective of the test in clause 9.1.25.2?
q_53598.ground_truth: The goal of the test is to verify that the RSRP absolute and relative measurement accuracies in CRS based discovery signal are within the specified limits.

q_53599.question: What is the restriction on the scheduling availability for UE performing intra-frequency measurements in TDD bands on FR1?
q_53599.ground_truth: The UE is not expected to transmit PUCCH/PUSCH/SRS on SSB symbols to be measured, and on 1 data symbol before and after each consecutive SSB symbols to be measured within the SMTC window duration. If SS-RSRQ measurement is applied, additional restrictions apply.

q_53600.question: What message is used by the NG-RAN node1 to indicate the activation state of cells or SSB beams to the NG-RAN node2?

q_53601.question: When is a UE required to re-select to inter-frequency cells in normal coverage over cells in which it has to be in enhanced coverage?
q_53601.ground_truth: A UE in enhanced coverage shall re-select to inter-frequency cells in which it is able to operate in normal coverage over cells in which it has to be in enhanced coverage.

q_53602.question: What is an example of a security consideration for MnS Producer and MnS Consumer error responses?
q_53602.ground_truth: If the MnS Consumer is not trustworthy or the MnS Producer does not want to disclose error details, just the "type" property may be included in the error response to maintain security.

q_53603.question: What is the preferred offset from the system BW edge for improved system performance with lower complexity implementation?
q_53603.ground_truth: More than 2.16 MHz offset is preferred

q_53604.question: What information is provided by the UE in the Service Request message when it wants to re-activate the PDU Session(s)?
q_53604.ground_truth: The List Of PDU Sessions To Be Activated is provided by UE in the Service Request message when it wants to re-activate the PDU Session(s).

q_53605.question: Which power class has the same in-band emissions requirement as power class 5 for uplink allocations contained within both Range 1 and Range 2?

q_53606.question: What is the role of the NEF in the 5G system architecture enhancements to support V2X services?
q_53606.ground_truth: The NEF enables communication between the NFs in the PLMN and the V2X Application Server by storing the V2X service parameters in the UDR.

q_53607.question: What is the difference between a type 2 IOI and type 3 IOI in the "orig-ioi" header field parameter?
q_53607.ground_truth: A type 2 IOI identifies the sending network of the request message, while a type 3 IOI identifies the sending service provider of the request message.

q_53608.question: What is the purpose of the "Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of '5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming'" IE in the 3GPP specification?
q_53608.ground_truth: The "Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of '5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming'" IE is included to indicate the forbidden TAI(s) to be stored in the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming" when the message is sent via satellite NG-RAN access.

q_53609.question: What should the UPF do if the CN Tunnel Info of UPF used for connection to Target NG-RAN and connection to Source NG-RAN are different?
q_53609.ground_truth: The SMF may ask the UPF to allocate new CN Tunnel Info, providing the target Network Instance.

q_53610.question: What should the MS do if it has a mobile originating session in the "early" state and is providing an internally generated alerting indication to the user prior to the SRVCC handover?
q_53610.ground_truth: The MS shall continue to provide the internal alerting indication to the user after transitioning from the PS domain.

q_53611.question: What should a participating MCData function do upon receiving an MSRP 200 (OK) response from the controlling MCData function?
q_53611.ground_truth: The participating MCData function should forward the MSRP 200 (OK) response to the originating MCData client as specified in IETF RFC 4975.

q_53612.question: What should the SMF update in the PSA1 via N4 if a new DL Tunnel Info of UL CL/Branching Point is provided in step~4?
q_53612.ground_truth: The SMF should update the CN Tunnel Info for the downlink traffic in the PSA1 via N4.

q_53613.question: What is the purpose of the GNSS-SSR-URA-Set2 assistance in the location server?
q_53613.ground_truth: The GNSS-SSR-URA-Set2 assistance provides satellite-specific range under assistance from the location server, which helps the target device request precise information from the GNSS satellite.

q_53614.question: What should the MCPTT client set the emergency group state to if the SIP INVITE request contains an emergency indication in the MIME body?
q_53614.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should set the MCPTT emergency group state to "MEG 2: in-progress".

q_53615.question: What is the AMInfluEvent used for in the AMInfluence API?
q_53615.ground_truth: The AMInfluEvent represents the service area coverage outcome event in the AMInfluence API, and it is used to send notifications to the AF about the outcome of service area coverage.

q_53616.question: What is the requirement for the fraction of incorrectly decoded UCI in the test for UCI BLER performance requirements?
q_53616.ground_truth: The fraction of incorrectly decoded UCI shall be less than 1%.

q_53617.question: What is the cause value for "UE authorization failure" when a RPAUID is not associated with a PDUID belonging to the requesting UE?
q_53617.ground_truth: The cause value for "UE authorization failure" when a RPAUID is not associated with a PDUID belonging to the requesting UE is #3.

q_53618.question: What does the UE do when the serving cell becomes better than the absolute threshold plus hysteresis while the periodical measurement reporting triggered by event A2 is ongoing?
q_53618.ground_truth: The UE stops sending MeasurementReport messages when the serving cell becomes better than the absolute threshold plus hysteresis.

q_53619.question: What is the main difference between CRITICALITY reject and CRITICALITY ignore when defining an information element in F1AP-Protocol-IES?
q_53619.ground_truth: CRITICALITY reject means that the information elements must be present and valid for the message exchange to be successful, and the receiver will reject the message in case of their absence or invalidity. In contrast, CRITICALITY ignore means that the information elements may be absent, and the receiver will ignore them in case of their presence. However, if provided, they must be valid.

q_53620.question: What should the AMF do if it cannot find the security context for an initial NAS message?
q_53620.ground_truth: If the AMF cannot find the security context for an initial NAS message, it should initiate an authentication procedure with the UE to establish a new security context.

q_53621.question: What action should the MME take if the resources requested by the UE for bearer resource modification cannot be accepted?
q_53621.ground_truth: The MME should send a BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REJECT message to the UE with the PTI and an ESM cause value indicating the reason for rejecting the requested bearer resource modification.

q_53622.question: What is the purpose of the NR user plane protocol (Release 18) in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_53622.ground_truth: The NR user plane protocol (Release 18) in the 3GPP technical specification specifies the NR user plane protocol functions used within NG-RAN and, for EN-DC and LTE UP-CP split within E-UTRAN. It supports both E-UTRA PDCP and NR PDCP.

q_53623.question: When can the UE send a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message or PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message for the same DNN or without a DNN?
q_53623.ground_truth: The UE can send a new PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message or PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message for the same DNN or without a DNN if the Back-off timer value IE is not included or received from the 5GMM sublayer.

q_53624.question: What is the criticality level for the "dataCollectionReporting" procedure in XNAP-Elementary-Procedure?

q_53625.question: What should the MME do when it receives a PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST message during the EPS bearer context deactivation procedure, and the EPS bearer indicated in the DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message is a dedicated EPS bearer belonging to the PDN connection the UE wants to disconnect?
q_53625.ground_truth: The MME shall proceed with both procedures.

q_53626.question: What is the role of the EES A in the UE location API in TS 23.558 8.6.2?
q_53626.ground_truth: The EES A is responsible for obtaining an NEF B address through an edge node sharing agreement between OP A and OP B, receiving an EAS A discovery request message from the EES B with OP B information, and generating UE location request messages using PLMN ID and UEID.

q_53627.question: What should the S-NG-RAN node do if it receives an S-NODE ADDITION REQUEST message containing a PDU Session Resource Setup Info - SN terminated IE for which the Split Session Indicator IE is included and set to "split", the Security Result IE is not included, and either the Integrity Protection Indication IE or the Confidentiality Protection Indication IE is set to "preferred"?
q_53627.ground_truth: The S-NG-RAN node should reject the PDU session.

q_53628.question: What is the maximum repetition period of relevant system info blocks used in the test?
q_53628.ground_truth: The maximum repetition period of relevant system info blocks that needs to be received by the UE to camp on a cell is 1.28 seconds.

q_53629.question: What is included in the "EAP message" IE of the 3GPP specification?
q_53629.ground_truth: The "EAP message" IE is used to convey an EAP-failure message in a SERVICE ACCEPT message to a UE registered for emergency services.

q_53630.question: Which flag within Octet 5 of the QoS Monitoring Measurement IE, when set to "1", indicates that the DL/UL/Round Trip packet delay fields shall not be present when reporting a packet delay measurement failure?

q_53631.question: What is the purpose of the procedure described in section 7.6.1.2.1?
q_53631.ground_truth: The purpose of the procedure described in section 7.6.1.2.1 is to introduce a method for group membership updates by an authorized user from a partner MC system.

q_53632.question: What is the goal of the testing in 6.2.3.2.2.1.1 in fading conditions?
q_53632.ground_truth: The goal of the testing is to verify that the variance of the wideband CQI reports is within the limits defined, the ratio of the throughput is within the limits defined and that the average PDSCH BLER is greater than or equal to 2% for the indicated transport format.

q_53633.question: What should a UE (User Equipment) do when it receives a message not compatible with the PC5 signalling protocol state?
q_53633.ground_truth: The UE should ignore the PC5 signalling message.

q_53634.question: What is the role of the P-CSCF when a user initiates an emergency session?
q_53634.ground_truth: The P-CSCF is responsible for detecting the request for emergency session when a UE using public network traffic initiates an emergency session. The P-CSCF then forwards the request to E-CSCF in the same network, unless authentication and security procedures require the request to be forwarded to the S-CSCF in the same network.

q_53635.question: What should an MCVideo server do with confirmed content from an incoming SIP request when confidentiality protection is enabled and the encrypted XML element was successfully decrypted?
q_53635.ground_truth: The MCVideo server should re-encrypt the content within the XML element using the keying information described in clause~6.6.2.2 and by following the procedures specified in clause 6.6.2.3.3, and include the re-encrypted content into the same XML MIME body of the outgoing SIP request.

q_53636.question: What is the frequency isolation capability required for the LA BS in the CATT study?

q_53637.question: What should the SGW do when it detects a path failure to the PGW?
q_53637.ground_truth: The SGW may delete all the PDN connections affected by the path failure and send a PGW Restart Notification message to the MME or S4-SGSN if the PGW Restart Notification procedure is supported by the SGW and MME/S4-SGSN.

q_53638.question: What is the name of the custom operation that obtains OAuth 2.0 authorization information from an existing Individual security instance resource in the CAPIF core function?

q_53639.question: What is the requirement for each inter-frequency layer during each layer 1 measurement period for FR2 in terms of SS-RSRP, SS-RSRQ, and SS-SINR measurements?
q_53639.ground_truth: At least 4 identified cells, 10 SSBs with different SSB index and/or PCI on the inter-frequency layer, and 1 SSB per identified cell.

q_53640.question: What is the UE's response if the verification of the hash fails in this procedure?
q_53640.ground_truth: The UE sends a Security Mode Complete with the hash of the MIB/SIBs, which is both ciphered and integrity protected. The UE also indicates the list of SIBs that were used to calculate the hash value.

q_53641.question: What entities are involved in supporting UE unaware positioning in 5G?
q_53641.ground_truth: The entities involved in supporting UE unaware positioning in 5G include the LCS Client, GMLC, AMF, and LMF. The LCS Client or Application Function (AF) sends the UE unaware positioning indication to the GMLC, which then sends it to the AMF. The AMF then rejects the location request or returns the latest UE location to the GMLC. The LMF selects the positioning method based on the UE unaware indication.

q_53642.question: In what cases should the UE stop timer T3430 when the tracking area update was successful for EPS services only and the TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message contained a value included in the SMS services status IE as per clause 5.5.3.2.4A?
q_53642.ground_truth: After a successful tracking area update for EPS services and if the TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message contained a specific SMS services status value (as per 5.5.3.2.4A), the UE shall stop timer T3430, increment the tracking area updating attempt counter, start timer T3411, set the EPS update status to EU1 UPDATED, and enter state EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE. When timer T3411 expires, the normal tracking area updating procedure for EPS services and "SMS only" or the combined tracking area updating procedure for EPS services and "SMS only" can be triggered.

q_53643.question: What is the role of the AF in the One shot Application layer-based Network triggered ranging device discovery?
q_53643.ground_truth: The AF notifies the UE2 to activate the ranging procedure after receiving a request from the UE1, and the proximity is determined by the UE1.

q_53644.question: What is the probability of false detection of the ACK in 8.3.10.1 for interlaced PUCCH format 3?
q_53644.ground_truth: The probability of false detection of the ACK in 8.3.10.1 for interlaced PUCCH format 3 is 0.01 or less.

q_53645.question: Which option is selected as the way forward for MC clients capable of hosting MC service clients?
q_53645.ground_truth: Option 2 is selected as the way forward for MC clients capable of hosting MC service clients.

q_53646.question: Under what conditions does the MAC layer of the UE perform requested transmissions on the UL-SCH?
q_53646.ground_truth: The MAC layer performs requested transmissions on the UL-SCH when it receives HARQ information from lower layers and the UE has a valid uplink grant for transmission.

q_53647.question: What is the condition for the UE to include the eutraFailedPCellId in failedPCellId if MobilityFromNRCommand concerned a failed inter-RAT handover from NR to E-UTRA?
q_53647.ground_truth: The global cell identity and tracking area code should be available, and otherwise, the physical cell identity and carrier frequency of the target PCell of the failed handover should be set.

q_53648.question: What value(s) should be provided in the "exptAnaType" attribute if the NWDAF is to derive the corresponding Exception Ids for mobility related analytics in the Abnormal Behaviour feature?
q_53648.ground_truth: The value of "exptAnaType" attribute should be set to "MOBILITY" to derive the corresponding Exception Ids for mobility related analytics in the Abnormal Behaviour feature.

q_53649.question: What must the network provide in order for the UE to conduct independent measurement gap patterns for different frequency ranges in E-UTRAN cells?
q_53649.ground_truth: The network must provide either per-FR measurement gap patterns for each frequency range where the UE requires per-FR measurement gap for concurrent monitoring of all frequency layers of each frequency range independently, or a single per-UE measurement gap pattern for concurrent monitoring of all frequency layers of all frequency ranges.

q_53650.question: What is the general rule for the requirements in 9.7.5.2.3 regarding the resolution bandwidth of measuring equipment?
q_53650.ground_truth: The resolution bandwidth of the measuring equipment should be equal to the measurement bandwidth.

q_53651.question: What is the primary purpose of SCP domains and what boundaries do they have?
q_53651.ground_truth: The primary purpose of SCP domains is to describe the connectivity topology within a network. All SCPs within an SCP domain can directly interconnect. One SCP can be part of multiple SCP domains. There are boundaries between SCP domains at each SCP in the path.

q_53652.question: What does the presence requirement indication M, C, or O mean for an information element?
q_53652.ground_truth: M means mandatory, C means conditionally mandatory, and O means optional.

q_53653.question: What should the AMF do if the UE is registered for disaster roaming services and the UE is allowed to be registered for normal service?
q_53653.ground_truth: The AMF should set the Disaster roaming registration result value bit to "request for registration for disaster roaming services accepted as registration not for disaster roaming services" in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.

q_53654.question: In the context of non-IMS termination to an external SIP client, what is the function of the UE initiating session modification?
q_53654.ground_truth: UE initiating session modification enables the media transfer to start once both parties agree to the session and media parameters and the UE has established resources for the media.

q_53655.question: What is the purpose of the "HSS Restoration" feature in the procedure described?
q_53655.ground_truth: The purpose of the "HSS Restoration" feature is for the HSS to update the registration data and dynamic data of a user in response to the Server-Assignment-Request (SAR) command sent by the 3GPP AAA Server after a restart event.

q_53656.question: What does the EPS authentication procedure do?
q_53656.ground_truth: The EPS authentication procedure provides mutual authentication between the user and the network and agrees on a key KASME. It is initiated and controlled by the network, and the UE can reject the EPS authentication challenge. During a successful EPS authentication procedure, the CK and IK are computed by the USIM, CK and IK are then used by the ME as key material to compute a new key, KASME. KASME is stored in the EPS security contexts of both the network and in the volatile memory of the ME while attached to the network, and is the root for the EPS integrity protection and ciphering key hierarchy.

q_53657.question: What is the rate of correct events required for repeated tests in this test?
q_53657.ground_truth: The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests should be at least 90%.

q_53658.question: How are the SRS resources and antenna ports associated with layers in a SRS resource set for non-codebook based uplink transmission?
q_53658.ground_truth: When the higher layer parameter multipanelScheme is set to 'SDMScheme', the first SRI is used to indicate resource(s) to be associated with a set of layers and the second SRI is used to indicate resource(s) to be associated with another set of layers, where the UE is expected to use different PUSCH antenna ports for the SRS resources indicated by the two SRIs. When the higher layer parameter is set to 'SFNscheme', the SRS resources indicated by the two SRIs are expected to be associated with different PUSCH antenna ports as well.

q_53659.question: When the MCVideo client receives a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message and the Call type is "BASIC GROUP CALL", and if the stored current call type is "BASIC GROUP CALL", what should the MCVideo client set the stored last call type change time to?
q_53659.ground_truth: The Last call type change time IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message.

q_53660.question: What does the first digit in the version number of a 3GPP Technical Report indicate?
q_53660.ground_truth: The first digit in the version number of a 3GPP Technical Report indicates the stage of the report in the TSG approval process.

q_53661.question: What should be the response of the UE when it receives an AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message with an invalid MAC code?
q_53661.ground_truth: The UE should respond with an AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message to the network, with the reject cause #20 "MAC failure".

q_53662.question: What should the network do upon the first expiry of timer T3570, if a lower layer failure occurs before the IDENTITY RESPONSE message is received?
q_53662.ground_truth: The network should abort any ongoing 5GMM procedure.

q_53663.question: In the INITIAL CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message for Initial Context Setup, how many additional E-RABs can be established?
q_53663.ground_truth: The INITIAL CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message can contain a list of one or more additional E-RABs to be established.

q_53664.question: What does the "maxNumOfBearerServices" field specify?
q_53664.ground_truth: The "maxNumOfBearerServices" field specifies the maximum number of bearer services that can be included in the "BearerServiceList" field.

q_53665.question: What parameter in the <utc-time> element indicates the UTC time associated with the discovery transmission opportunity in which a PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message is sent?
q_53665.ground_truth: The UTC-based counter parameter in the <utc-time> element indicates the UTC time associated with the discovery transmission opportunity in which a PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message is sent. It is expressed in units of seconds and coded in binary format as the 32 least significant bits of the Coordinated Universal Time as defined in 3GPP TS 38.331.

q_53666.question: What action should the MAC entity take when it receives a PSI-Based SDU Discard Activation/Deactivation MAC CE activating the PSI-based SDU discard for a DRB?
q_53666.ground_truth: The MAC entity should indicate the activation of the PSI-based SDU discard for the DRB to upper-layers.

q_53667.question: What is the requirement for the difference between the wideband CQI indices of the SCells for CA with 3 or more DL CC under AWGN conditions?
q_53667.ground_truth: The difference between the wideband CQI indices of the SCells should be greater than or equal to 2 for more than 90% of the time.

q_53668.question: What is the content type of the HTTP bodies specified in the present specification?
q_53668.ground_truth: JSON (application/json) shall be used as the content type of the HTTP bodies specified in the present specification.

q_53669.question: What should the MCData client do if the user defered the FD request while the timer TDU2 (FD non-mandatory download timer) was running?
q_53669.ground_truth: The MCData client generates an FD NOTIFICATION indicating deferral of the FD request.

q_53670.question: What is the method for verifying the authenticity of system information in this procedure?
q_53670.ground_truth: The UE verifies the authenticity of system information by acquiring the system information block carrying the digital signatures, computing a hash over the protected system information along with supplement information elements in the acquired system information block, and then using the public key to verify the digital signature accordingly depending on the digital signing algorithm being used.

q_53671.question: What protocol is used for mutual authentication between the UE and the BSF in 3GPP AKA infrastructure?
q_53671.ground_truth: The HTTP Digest AKA protocol, which is specified in RFC 3310, is used for mutual authentication between the UE and the BSF in 3GPP AKA infrastructure.

q_53672.question: What is the role of the "end marker" packets in the E-UTRAN initiated E-RAB modification procedure?
q_53672.ground_truth: The "end marker" packets are sent by the Serving GW to assist the reordering function in the Master eNodeB and/or Secondary RAN nodes when bearers are switched.

q_53673.question: What is the maximum luminance width and height that a decoded texture signal of a Bitstream conforming to the 3GPP VR Flexible H.265/HEVC Operation point should not exceed?
q_53673.ground_truth: The decoded texture signal shall not exceed the luminance width of 8192 pixels, and shall not exceed the luminance height of 8192 pixels.

q_53674.question: What does the "PHR Measurement" determine the range of PHR value for?
q_53674.ground_truth: The "PHR Measurement" determines the range of PHR value from -32 to +38 dB.

q_53675.question: What is the role of the MRFP, MRFC, IMS-AGW, or the TrGW in transcoding?
q_53675.ground_truth: They are responsible for reserving media transcoding resources if a need for transcoding is determined.

q_53676.question: Which complexType has a sequence that includes "hAccuracy", "vAccuracy", and "responseTime" elements?

q_53677.question: What action should an MS take if the timer T3396 is requested by the HLR for an MS that has PDP contexts for emergency services?
q_53677.ground_truth: The SGSN should send a DEACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message to the MS for all the PDP contexts that are not PDP contexts for emergency services.

q_53678.question: When is the Measured Results IE included in the E-CID MEASUREMENT INITIATION RESPONSE message?
q_53678.ground_truth: The Measured Results IE is included in the E-CID MEASUREMENT INITIATION RESPONSE message when measurement results other than the "Cell-ID" have been requested.

q_53679.question: What are the recommended key performance indicators (KPIs) and quality of experience (QoE) metrics for augmented reality (AR) media?
q_53679.ground_truth: The report recommends defining relevant KPIs and QoE metrics for AR media, but it does not provide specifics.

q_53680.question: What does the NAS (Non-Access Stratum) described in the document form?
q_53680.ground_truth: The NAS is the highest stratum of the control plane between UE and MME at the radio interface (reference point "LTE-Uu").

q_53681.question: What is the function of the NAS Signalling transport in S1AP?
q_53681.ground_truth: The NAS Signalling transport function is used to transfer and reroute NAS (Non-Access Stratum) signalling related information and to establish the S1 UE context in the eNB. It is used to transfer NAS signalling related information when the S1 UE context in the eNB is already established.

q_53682.question: Which parameter represents the BitRate type in the F1AP protocol?

q_53683.question: What is the consequence if the USIM fails to retrieve the needed MSK in MBMS security context?
q_53683.ground_truth: The USIM abandons the function and returns the status word '6A88' (Referenced data not found).

q_53684.question: In what situations should the controlling MCData function clear the cache of the MCData ID of the sender of the SIP re-INVITE request for an MCData emergency alert cancellation?
q_53684.ground_truth: The controlling MCData function should clear the cache of the MCData ID of the sender of the SIP re-INVITE request for an MCData emergency alert cancellation if the received SIP re-INVITE request does not contain an <originated-by> element in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body.

q_53685.question: In the context of SEAL services, what does a "group" refer to?
q_53685.ground_truth: A group, in the context of SEAL services, refers to a SEAL group, which consists of a SEAL group management server (SGM-S) that manages group documents, and SEAL group management clients (SGM-C) that interact with the SGM-S to manage group documents.

q_53686.question: What action can the MCData user take during a communication to control if the communication will be stored in the MCData message store?
q_53686.ground_truth: The MCData user has the option to decide if the communication will be stored in the MCData message store.

q_53687.question: What is a NEST in the context of network slicing?
q_53687.ground_truth: A NEST (Network Slice Example Setup) is a GST (Generic Slice Template) filled with values, used to specify the requirements of a network slice.

q_53688.question: What is the mean and 5% DL Average-UPT gain for operator 2 when using SBFD Alt 2 and large packet size at low load level?
q_53688.ground_truth: The mean and 5% DL Average-UPT gain for operator 2 when using SBFD Alt 2 and large packet size at low load level are 1.15% and 0.43%, respectively.

q_53689.question: What is the maximum aggregate adjustment rate for the initial transmit timing accuracy in Test 1?
q_53689.ground_truth: The maximum aggregate adjustment rate for the initial transmit timing accuracy in Test 1 is Tq per 200 ms.

q_53690.question: What is the format of Unsuccessful Outcome in E1AP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE?
q_53690.ground_truth: Unsuccessful Outcome in E1AP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE is a SEQUENCE of three elements: procedureCode, criticality, and value.

q_53691.question: What should the Event header field be set to in the SIP NOTIFY request for the non-controlling MCVideo function?
q_53691.ground_truth: The Event header field should be set to "conference" in the SIP NOTIFY request for the non-controlling MCVideo function.

q_53692.question: What should the UE do upon start of T310 timer?
q_53692.ground_truth: Upon start of T310 timer, the UE should monitor the link for recovery using the evaluation period and Layer 1 indication interval corresponding to the non-DRX mode until the expiry or stop of T310 timer.

q_53693.question: What information does the UE check in the ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message to identify the PDN connectivity procedure?

q_53694.question: What information does the 'entrycount' field in the '3gppApplicationDataUnitInfoTLV' class provide?
q_53694.ground_truth: The 'entrycount' field in the '3gppApplicationDataUnitInfoTLV' class indicates the number of ADUs (Access Unit Descriptors) in the RTP payload.

q_53695.question: What should the User Equipment (UE) use when it receives a new P-TMSI as part of the Routing Area Update (RAU) procedure in the UTRAN?
q_53695.ground_truth: The UE uses the new P-TMSI (and not GUTI or old P-TMSI) for subsequent network access in the UTRAN, such as via the Service Request procedure.

q_53696.question: Who does this test apply to?
q_53696.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of E-UTRAN TDD UE release 13 and forward that support uplink carrier aggregation and multiple timing advances.

q_53697.question: What action should the SCC AS take upon receiving a SIP UPDATE request from the remote UE, if the SIP INVITE request due to PS to CS STN is not a precondition enabled initial SIP INVITE?
q_53697.ground_truth: The SCC AS should remove any precondition mechanism specific SDP attributes from the SDP offer.

q_53698.question: What is the purpose of the USIM Application Toolkit in the context of 3GPP network operation phase?
q_53698.ground_truth: The USIM Application Toolkit provides a set of commands and procedures for use during 3GPP network operation phase, in addition to those defined in TS~31.101, for ME that supports the specific mechanism(s) required by the application for USIM Application Toolkit.

q_53699.question: Which parameter identifies the alphabet/coding and the language applied to a CBS Message?

q_53700.question: What should the IRI-POI in the MME set the payload format to when generating xIRI for SMS over NAS records in EPS?
q_53700.ground_truth: The IRI-POI in the MME should set the payload format to EpsHI2Operations.EpsIRIContent (value 14) when generating xIRI for SMS over NAS records in EPS.

q_53701.question: What should the SMF do when the QoS notification control is not enabled and the other access does not accept the QoS profile for a GBR QoS flow?
q_53701.ground_truth: The SMF should release the resources for the GBR QoS flow and report to the PCF about the removal of the PCC rule.

q_53702.question: What should a UE indicate if it supports category 11 in MBMS?
q_53702.ground_truth: A UE that supports category 11 in MBMS should also indicate category 9, 6 and 4.

q_53703.question: What is the purpose of the "Control plane only indication" information element in the session management procedure?
q_53703.ground_truth: The Control plane only indication information element is used to indicate that a PDN connection is only for control plane CIoT EPS optimization, such as when the PDN connection is with an SCEF.

q_53704.question: What message does the initiating UE generate when starting the 5G ProSe AA message reliable transport procedure?
q_53704.ground_truth: The initiating UE generates a PROSE AA MESSAGE TRANSPORT REQUEST message when starting the 5G ProSe AA message reliable transport procedure.

q_53705.question: What should the UE do in registration with AMF reallocation via direct NAS reroute before initiating a NAS registration over a second NAS connection to an AMF of the same network?
q_53705.ground_truth: The UE should not initiate a NAS registration over a second NAS connection to an AMF of the same network before primary authentication on the first NAS connection is complete.

q_53706.question: When is an inter-RAT measurement considered as measurement without gap?
q_53706.ground_truth: An inter-RAT measurement is considered as measurement without gap if the UE indicates 'nogap-noncsg' via NeedForGapNCSG-InfoEUTRA for the inter-RAT measurement.

q_53707.question: What should the target UE provide after receiving a PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message in the 5G ProSe direct link?
q_53707.ground_truth: The target UE should provide the PC5 link identifier self-assigned for this 5G ProSe direct link, PQFI(s) and its corresponding PC5 QoS parameters, an indication of activation of the PC5 unicast user plane security protection, and an indication of emergency services if applicable.

q_53708.question: What is the HTTP custom header used for setting and carrying the message priority information between the client and the server in 3GPP networks?
q_53708.ground_truth: The HTTP custom header used is "3gpp-Sbi-Message-Priority".

q_53709.question: What information is included in the GTP-U header extension for conveying PDU Set-related information in the downlink direction?
q_53709.ground_truth: PDU Set ID, indication of last packet of the PDU set, XR stream identifier, XR Multi-modal Data identifier, PDU Handling Type, PDU Set sequence number, and PDU sequence number.

q_53710.question: What information does the PCF need to provide when initiating sponsored data connectivity per PCC rule?
q_53710.ground_truth: The PCF needs information about the sponsor, the application service provider, and optionally the threshold values from the AF in order to provision sponsored data connectivity per PCC rule using the PCC rule provisioning procedure as defined in clause~4.2.6.2.1. The PCF also needs to include the "sponsorId" attribute and "appSvcProvId" attribute within the ChargingData data type which the PCC rule refers to.

q_53711.question: What should an MBMS interface in the MCVideo client do when it receives RTP media packets or transmission control messages over the MBMS subchannel and there is an ongoing transmission in a group session?
q_53711.ground_truth: It should forward the transmission control messages to the transmission participant, forward the RTP media packet to the FEC decoder if the media is protected by FEC, and forward the RTP media packet to the media mixer if the media is not protected by FEC.

q_53712.question: What is the basic limit requirement for single-band connectors operating in non-contiguous spectrum?
q_53712.ground_truth: A combined basic limit shall be applied for single-band connectors operating in non-contiguous spectrum, which is the cumulative sum of the basic limit specified for the adjacent sub-blocks on each side of the gap between passbands. The basic limit for each sub-block is specified in clauses 6.5.3.2.1 to 6.5.3.2.4 of the present clause.

q_53713.question: What are the two types of reporting identified for conveying additional information in a network?

q_53714.question: What is the requirement for the UE to measure CSI-RS for RLM without measurement gaps for FR2?
q_53714.ground_truth: The UE is required to be capable of measuring CSI-RS for RLM without measurement gaps for FR2.

q_53715.question: What is the role of the "SS-Status" in the NotifySS-Arg sequence?
q_53715.ground_truth: The "SS-Status" in the NotifySS-Arg sequence indicates the status of the supplementary service.

q_53716.question: What is the security level of fast re-authentication for EAP-AKA' and what does it depend on?
q_53716.ground_truth: The security level of fast re-authentication for EAP-AKA' is lower than the standard method, and it depends on operator policies.

q_53717.question: What does the term "interdiction" or "prohibition" mean in the context of the 3GPP Technical Specification, as indicated by the term "shall not"?
q_53717.ground_truth: In the 3GPP Technical Specification, the term "shall not" indicates that a certain action is prohibited or not allowed.

q_53718.question: What is the primary advantage of "Solution B: New Band Number" over introducing a new band for a regional sub-band?
q_53718.ground_truth: Solution B does not require new band combinations, and it uses existing UE capability signalling and barring, without requiring new network signalling. Additionally, it does not need any NS values for barring UEs, and it effectively communicates UE support for a specific frequency range.

q_53719.question: What cell reselection timer value specifies the time when a quasi-Earth fixed cell is going to stop serving the area it is currently covering?

q_53720.question: What should be set in the "sl-RLC-ModeIndication" field to include the RLC mode(s) and optionally QoS profile(s) of the sidelink QoS flow(s) of the associated RLC mode(s) in NR sidelink communication transmission?
q_53720.ground_truth: The "sl-RLC-ModeIndication" field should be set to include the RLC mode(s) and optionally QoS profile(s) of the sidelink QoS flow(s) of the associated RLC mode(s) in NR sidelink communication transmission.

q_53721.question: What is the effect of provisioning a bidirectional SDF Filter in the UP function?
q_53721.ground_truth: Provisioning a bidirectional SDF Filter in the UP function allows the filter to be associated to both uplink and downlink PDRs of a same PFCP/N4 session, with a unique SDF Filter ID among all the SDF Filters provisioned for a given PFCP/N4 Session.

q_53722.question: What is the requirement for L1-SINR measurement with CSI-RS as CMR and CSI-IM as IMR?
q_53722.ground_truth: The requirement should apply only if the number of CSI-RS resources in the resource set for CMR and the number of CSI-IM resources in the resource set for IMR are the same.

q_53723.question: Over which frequency band is the interfering signal offset defined for the co-location minimum requirements in BS type 1-C and BS type 1-H?
q_53723.ground_truth: The interfering signal offset is defined relative to the Base Station RF Bandwidth edges or Radio Bandwidth edges in BS type 1-C and BS type 1-H for the co-location minimum requirements.

q_53724.question: What should the MME do upon receipt of the ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message in state BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE PENDING?
q_53724.ground_truth: The MME stops the timer T3485, enters the state BEARER CONTEXT INACTIVE, and aborts the dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure. The MME also requests the lower layer to release the radio resources that were established during the dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure.

q_53725.question: What does the 5GS session management (5GSM) protocol provide in the 5G system?
q_53725.ground_truth: The 5GS session management (5GSM) protocol provides procedures for the handling of 5GS PDU sessions and control of user-plane resources together with the bearer control provided by the access stratum.

q_53726.question: What mechanism is used when the target UE is identified by its IP or MAC address for event exposure in UPF?
q_53726.ground_truth: The mechanism described in solution 5 is used.

q_53727.question: What does the variable Hys represent in event A3H1?
q_53727.ground_truth: The variable Hys represents the hysteresis parameter for event A3H1. It is expressed in the same unit as the variable Ms, which is meters.

q_53728.question: What action should the UE take when the 200 (OK) response for the security association protected REGISTER request is received in GPRS-IMS-Bundled authentication?
q_53728.ground_truth: The UE shall change the temporary set of security associations to a newly established set of security associations, and use the newly established set of security associations for further messages sent towards the P-CSCF if it is the only set of security associations available.

q_53729.question: What is the primary reason for the longer test time in the Black-Box approach compared to the Black-and-White box approach in the CFFNF methodology?
q_53729.ground_truth: The primary reason for the longer test time in the Black-Box approach compared to the Black-and-White box approach in the CFFNF methodology is that the former uses 3 radii for local searches and requires local searches, while the latter does not.

q_53730.question: What action should the controlling MCPTT function take if the number of SIP 200 (OK) responses is less than the value of the "on-network-minimum-number-to-start" element after the expiry of timer TNG1 and the "on-network-action-upon-expiration-of-timeout-for-acknowledgement-of-required-members" element is set to "proceed" in the group document?
q_53730.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function should proceed with the setup of the group call and send a SIP 200 (OK) response to the inviting MCPTT client.

q_53731.question: What is the meaning of "shall" in the context of 3GPP technical documents?
q_53731.ground_truth: In 3GPP technical documents, "shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

q_53732.question: When would the IRI-POI in the SMF generate an xIRI containing an SMFMAPDUSessionModification record?
q_53732.ground_truth: The IRI-POI in the SMF shall generate an xIRI containing an SMFMAPDUSessionModification record when an MA PDU session has been modified for the target UE, including UE initiated or network initiated MA PDU session modification, and handover or MA PDU session establishment over a second access type, among other events.

q_53733.question: What should the terminating MCData client do when it receives an MSRP SEND message via an MBMS bearer associated to the group?
q_53733.ground_truth: The terminating MCData client should decapsulate and, if necessary, decrypt and validate the payload, accept the payload as correctly destined for the terminating MCData client, and process the payload as a received MSRP SEND message during the established MSRP session.

q_53734.question: What actions does the P-GW take after receiving a Suspend Notification message for a suspended UE?
q_53734.ground_truth: The P-GW discards packets received for the suspended UE.

q_53735.question: What is the average horizontal field of view for human vision?
q_53735.ground_truth: The average horizontal field of view for human vision is around 200-220 degrees.

q_53736.question: What action should be taken by the SC UE if it detects handover failure procedure before its completion during an MO IMS PS voice call?
q_53736.ground_truth: The SC UE should transmit a SIP UPDATE message after RRC connection re-establishment procedure.

q_53737.question: What should the SS do if the UE has re-selected Cell 2 within T1?
q_53737.ground_truth: If the UE has re-selected Cell 2 within T1, the SS should continue with step 7.

q_53738.question: What should the MCPTT client do if it receives a request from an MCPTT user to cancel the in-progress emergency condition on a chat MCPTT group and the user is not authorized to cancel the emergency group state?
q_53738.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should indicate to the MCPTT user that they are not authorized to cancel the in-progress emergency group state of the MCPTT group and skip the remaining steps of the current clause.

q_53739.question: How can a UE transfer training data to an Over-The-Top server for UE-side model training?
q_53739.ground_truth: A UE can collect training data and transfer it to an Over-The-Top (OTT) server by directly transferring it to the OTT server, or transfer it to the Core Network which then transfers it to the OTT server.

q_53740.question: What is the purpose of including a Resource-Priority header field in an MCVideo imminent peril group call?
q_53740.ground_truth: The Resource-Priority header field provides imminent peril level priority and starts the infrastructure priority adjustment process sooner.

q_53741.question: What is the purpose of the Additional update result information element?
q_53741.ground_truth: The Additional update result information element provides additional information about the result of a combined attach procedure or a combined tracking area updating procedure.

q_53742.question: Who is required to provide the IAB-DU or IAB-MT for the conducted requirements testing of the IAB type 1-H?

q_53743.question: What are the main scenarios for CHF-to-CHF communication in the message flows?
q_53743.ground_truth: The main scenarios for CHF-to-CHF communication in the message flows are Session Based Charging (SBC), Immediate Event Charging (IEC), and Post Event Charging (PEC).

q_53744.question: What is the maximum allowed measurement reporting delay for Event A1 and Event A6 in the discussed tests?
q_53744.ground_truth: The maximum allowed measurement reporting delay for Event A1 and Event A6 is 6400 ms.

q_53745.question: What should the MCVideo server do when sending integrity protected content?
q_53745.ground_truth: The MCVideo server should use the appropriate keying information specified in clause~6.6.3.2 and perform the procedures in clause~6.6.3.3.3 to integrity protect XML MIME bodies.

q_53746.question: What should the NEF do if an AF service identifier is provided and it needs to interact with the NSACF(s)?
q_53746.ground_truth: The NEF shall translate the AF service identifier into the corresponding S-NSSAI before sending the request(s) to the NSACF(s).

q_53747.question: What is MME's role in load handling and re-balancing?
q_53747.ground_truth: MME contains mechanisms for avoiding and handling overload situations. It can use NAS signalling to reject NAS requests from UEs and may restrict the load that its eNodeBs are generating on it by invoking the S1 interface overload procedure, adjusting the proportion of eNodeBs that receive S1 interface OVERLOAD START message, and deciding the content of the message accordingly.

q_53748.question: What is the purpose of the test in section 9.1.41.1, related to FD-FDD Intra Frequency Absolute RSRP Accuracy for UE category 0?
q_53748.ground_truth: The test in section 9.1.41.1 aims to verify that the FDD intra-frequency absolute RSRP measurement accuracy is within the specified limit for all bands, for UE category 0.

q_53749.question: What is the main difference between Sol#16 and Sol#30 in terms of Assistant UE discovery and selection?
q_53749.ground_truth: The main difference is that in Sol#16, the Assistant UE is selected during the discovery procedure by UE1. In Sol#30, the Assistant UE is discovered and selected by UE1 and UE2 by any solutions for KI#3, and are only involved in measuring but not in result collection or calculation.

q_53750.question: What is the limit for idle channel noise in the sending direction for electrical interface UE?
q_53750.ground_truth: The maximum noise level produced by the apparatus at the output of the SS under silent conditions in the sending direction should not exceed -64 dBm0(A).

q_53751.question: What message is used to convey one or more System Information Blocks in a Bandwith Reduced cell environment?

q_53752.question: Which RFC defines the usage of IPv6 in the control plane over Sxa, Sxb, Sxc, N4 and N4mb reference points?

q_53753.question: What protocol is used by the UE and P-CSCF to provide the User Agent role in SIP?
q_53753.ground_truth: The User Equipment (UE) and the P-CSCF provide the User Agent (UA) role in SIP.

q_53754.question: What procedures shall the controlling MCPTT function follow upon receiving a "SIP INVITE request for controlling MCPTT function of a private call" or a "SIP INVITE request for controlling MCPTT function of a first-to-answer call", with SDP offer not including media-level section for media-floor control entity?
q_53754.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function shall consider it as the request for the private call without floor control or first-to-answer call without floor control, and shall follow the procedures as specified in clause~11.1.1.4.2.

q_53755.question: When the terminating user receives an emergency alert, what must they store from the received GROUP EMERGENCY ALERT message?
q_53755.ground_truth: The terminating user must store the Originating MCData user ID IE and location IE in the list of users in emergency when receiving an emergency alert.

q_53756.question: What parameters do the MME and the UE use to map from R99 to EPS QoS parameters?
q_53756.ground_truth: The MME and the UE use the mapping defined in 3GPP TS 23.401, annex E to map from R99 to EPS QoS parameters.

q_53757.question: What is the method used in Sol#28 to send the ECS address to the UE via DL NAS message?
q_53757.ground_truth: The V-SMF or H-SMF sends the ECS address in ePCO to UE via DL NAS message.

q_53758.question: What message does the source MN send to the target eNB for SN terminated bearers using RLC AM in step 5a?

q_53759.question: What delay does TIDCCH measurement reporting exclude?
q_53759.ground_truth: TIDCCH measurement reporting excludes any delay caused by no UL resources for the user equipment (UE) to send the measurement report.

q_53760.question: What is the maximum value of the "Logging Interval" parameter in NR?
q_53760.ground_truth: The maximum value of the "Logging Interval" parameter in NR is 61440 ms.

q_53761.question: What is the role of SEAL Network Slice Capability Enablement Client (SNSCE-C) and SEAL Network Slice Capability Enablement Server (SNSCE-S) in the context of the present document?
q_53761.ground_truth: The SNSCE-C and SNSCE-S are functional entities that enable the network slice capability enablement service in a trusted network. The SNSCE-S acts as an Application Function (AF) and influences the UE's URSP rules for the application traffic by providing guidance on the route selection descriptors S-NSSAI and DNN.

q_53762.question: What is the purpose of the "CSMT" flag in the LAU Request?
q_53762.ground_truth: The "CSMT" flag is used to avoid missing MT call in roaming retry case.

q_53763.question: What is the requirement for the 5G system to be used as a supplement or backup to the GNSS receiver based (or wired) clock synchronization systems in a Smart Grid?
q_53763.ground_truth: The 5G system should be able to improve the accuracy and availability of the clock synchronization across the Smart Grid when used as a supplement or backup.

q_53764.question: What is achieved by adjusted EPS bearer priority in MCData imminent peril group communications?
q_53764.ground_truth: All participants in the group receive elevated priority, whether or not they initiated the imminent peril group communication.

q_53765.question: What action is expected when the destroy() method is called in any state of the Media Player?
q_53765.ground_truth: All information related to the media and the network is cleared and the Media Player is left in the IDLE state.

q_53766.question: Under what circumstances would the MAC entity identify the logical channel for BRID or DAA for NR sidelink communication?
q_53766.ground_truth: When QoS information associated to BRID or DAA, i.e. PQI(s), is available from upper layers.

q_53767.question: What is the format of the Home Network Realm/Domain in the EPC?
q_53767.ground_truth: The Home Network Realm/Domain in the EPC is in the form of an Internet domain name, consisting of one or more labels, each with the alphabetic characters (A-Z and a-z), digits (0-9) and the hyphen (-) and beginning and ending with either an alphabetic character or a digit. The Home Network Realm/Domain shall be in the form of "epc.mnc<MNC>.mcc<MCC>.3gppnetwork.org".

q_53768.question: What must the NEF ensure when it receives an AF request from the AF via the NEF, targeting an individual UE address?
q_53768.ground_truth: The NEF must ensure the necessary authorization control and map the information provided by the AF into information needed by the 5GC.

q_53769.question: When is the 4th field (OPERATOR-SPECIFIC) present in a 3GPP Release?
q_53769.ground_truth: The 4th field (OPERATOR-SPECIFIC) is present after the OpenAPI freeze of a 3GPP Release, based on operator policy and compliance with the rules in the Semantic Versioning Specification.

q_53770.question: What is the significance of the 5G system for line current differential protection in power distribution?
q_53770.ground_truth: The 5G system can provide low-latency and high-bandwidth communication between protection relays, which is essential for time synchronization and fast protection of power lines.

q_53771.question: What is the goal of Candidate IP-PFS Solution 4c in traffic identification?
q_53771.ground_truth: The goal of Candidate IP-PFS Solution 4c is to map both downlink and uplink traffic for a particular application flow within a PDU Session to a specific QoS Flow and handle them separately by the 5G System.

q_53772.question: What should the UE do if it receives a REGISTRATION REJECT message with T3346 value IE and the timer is not zero or deactivated?
q_53772.ground_truth: The UE shall abort the registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update, reset the registration attempt counter, set the 5GS update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED, and start timer T3346 with the value provided in the T3346 value IE.

q_53773.question: In what scenario would the field "affectedCarrierFreqRangeCombList" be included in the message?
q_53773.ground_truth: When the UE is experiencing IDC problems that it cannot solve by itself, and the center frequency of the affected frequency range is within the candidate frequency range included in candidateServingFreqRangeListNR.

q_53774.question: What established the periodicity of the semi-persistent downlink grant?
q_53774.ground_truth: RRC defines the periodicity of the semi-persistent downlink grant.

q_53775.question: What should be the initial conditions of the system simulator when performing the procedure specified in sub-clause 5.2A.2.1?
q_53775.ground_truth: The procedure should be performed under ideal radio conditions as defined in clause 5. The system simulator should have one cell with default parameters.

q_53776.question: In the definition of "IABTNLAddress-Item", what does "associatedDonorDUAddress" indicate?
q_53776.ground_truth: "associatedDonorDUAddress" indicates the IP address of the donor DU associated with the tunneling link.

q_53777.question: How much time is allowed for interruption when intra-frequency make-before-break handover is commanded?
q_53777.ground_truth: The interruption time shall be less than 5 ms.

q_53778.question: What should the transmission control interface do when it receives an RTP media packet from the associated transmission participant?
q_53778.ground_truth: The transmission control interface should request the network media interface in the MCVideo server to forward RTP media packets to the media distributor in the MCVideo server.

q_53779.question: What is the name of the channel used for the modulation of the carrier signal?

q_53780.question: In the context of event A2, what is the condition for the leaving condition of a serving cell to be satisfied?
q_53780.ground_truth: The leaving condition for a serving cell to be satisfied in the context of event A2 is when the inequality A2-2 (Inequality A1-2 for event A1) is fulfilled, which states that the measurement result of the serving cell must be greater than the threshold minus the hysteresis.

q_53781.question: What should a network do if it receives an unauthorized request for an MCPTT emergency alert cancellation?
q_53781.ground_truth: The network should include an "alert-ind" element set to "true" in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body in the outgoing SIP MESSAGE request.

q_53782.question: What is the relationship between conducted requirements and radiated requirements for SAN type 1-H?
q_53782.ground_truth: Radiated requirements are defined over the air (OTA), where the radiated interface is referred to as the Radiated Interface Boundary (RIB). Conducted characteristics are defined at individual or groups of TAB connectors at the transceiver array boundary, which is the conducted interface between the transceiver unit array and the composite antenna.

q_53783.question: What is the procedure for verifying whether the LIPA PDN connection has been released during the handover procedure?
q_53783.ground_truth: The verification is specified in TS 23.401 as part of the handover procedure.

q_53784.question: What is the purpose of exposing network information to the AF for QoS monitoring?
q_53784.ground_truth: Exposing network information to the AF enables real-time media codec/traffic adaptation to the network conditions. This information includes congestion level, round-trip time, data rate, and the QoS Network Class (QNC) for a specific QoS flow.

q_53785.question: During N2 and Xn handover, what should be done with the DRB and/or SRB connections between the UE and the SN?
q_53785.ground_truth: The DRB and/or SRB connections between the UE and the SN should be released.

q_53786.question: What is the input for the "Presence-In-AOI-Report" event for triggering a notification for any UE?
q_53786.ground_truth: The input for the "Presence-In-AOI-Report" event for triggering a notification for any UE includes only the Area of Interest (AOI) identifier.

q_53787.question: What should the AMF do if the Notification URI is provided and it determines that the paging or NAS Notification has failed?
q_53787.ground_truth: The AMF should notify the NF which invoked the service operation with the specified cause.

q_53788.question: When is there not header compression and no confidentiality protection for non-IP type PDCP Data PDU?
q_53788.ground_truth: When the UE sends an non-IP type PDCP Data PDU for SLRB, there is no header compression and no confidentiality protection for non-IP type PDCP Data PDU. This is specified in TS 36.323, subclause 6.3.14.

q_53789.question: What is the purpose of Slice based VPLMN Selection Policy (SVSP) in 5G network?
q_53789.ground_truth: The purpose of SVSP is to control the UE behavior in cases where a slice the UE wants to use is supported in the VPLMN but temporally rejected by the network due to reasons such as NSAC failure, congestion control, or not allowed in the current registration area.

q_53790.question: What is the maximum number of bits that can be used in the Metric field?
q_53790.ground_truth: The Metric field can take binary coded integer values from and including 0 up to and including 100.

q_53791.question: What is the HTTP status code that indicates a successfully received and processed inter-PLMN application service continuity request?
q_53791.ground_truth: The NSCE Server shall respond with an HTTP "204 No Content" status code.

q_53792.question: What is the goal of the EAS Relocation use case?
q_53792.ground_truth: The EAS Relocation use case aims to enable the relocation of an EAS from one edge compute resource to another. The ASP provides its policy regarding the change of the edge compute resource hosting the Edge Application, and the ESCP Management System considers these policies while relocating the EAS.

q_53793.question: What should an MCVideo client do upon receiving a SIP 4xx, 5xx, or 6xx response to the SIP MESSAGE request?
q_53793.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should set the MCVideo emergency alert state to "MVEA 1: no-alert" and leave the MCVideo emergency state as is, assuming the MCVideo user can clear it manually if needed.

q_53794.question: Which type of sensor is used in the Sensor-ProvideLocationInformation-r13 sequence?
q_53794.ground_truth: Barometric pressure sensor and Motion sensor

q_53795.question: What is the main difference between steps 5a and 5b in the session termination process initiated by the AF in the VPLMN?
q_53795.ground_truth: In step 5a, the H-PCRF sends Diameter STA, session termination answer, to the V-PCRF without including access network information. In contrast, in step 5b, the H-PCRF sends Diameter STA, session termination answer, to the V-PCRF with access network information obtained in step 7.

q_53796.question: What information does the S-CSCF use to identify the user during the registration process for an already registered public user identity linked to the same private user identity?
q_53796.ground_truth: The S-CSCF uses the public user identity as received in the To header field of the REGISTER request and the private user identity as received in the Authorization header field of the REGISTER request to identify the user.

q_53797.question: What is the procedure for accessing EPC when the IMSI is available and authenticated in a cdma2000 HRPD access network?
q_53797.ground_truth: The UE and network shall use the root NAI for EPC access authentication when the UE obtains emergency services via a cdma2000 HRPD access network connected to an EPC in the UE's HPLMN.

q_53798.question: What are the responsibilities of the LMF in reporting the UE location when the target area is defined with finer granularity?
q_53798.ground_truth: The LMF is responsible for determining whether the UE location is in the exact target area or not when the UE can not calculate its exact location and for indicating to the UE whether it is in the target area or not, as well as updating the reporting status only when the UE location is in the exact target area.

q_53799.question: What action should the network take if it detects semantic errors in TFT operations during a PDP context activation?
q_53799.ground_truth: The network should reject the activation request with cause "semantic error in the TFT operation".

q_53800.question: In which clause is the method of test for RE Power control dynamic range defined?
q_53800.ground_truth: No specific test or test requirements are defined for RE Power control dynamic range. The Error Vector Magnitude test provides sufficient test coverage for this requirement, which can be found in clause 6.5.4.

q_53801.question: What should be done in the first slot after the end of the corresponding PSFCH transmission carrying the SL HARQ feedback or its resources in case of UL/SL prioritization failure or SL LBT failure?
q_53801.ground_truth: Start the sl-drx-HARQ-RTT-Timer for the corresponding Sidelink process in the first slot after the end of the corresponding PSFCH transmission or resources.

q_53802.question: What should the SLM server do upon receiving a CoAP PUT request where the CoAP URI identifies a registration update?
q_53802.ground_truth: The SLM server should determine the identity of the sender of the CoAP PUT request and may authorize the location-capability, which includes the identities of the available location access type and positioning methods of the VAL UE.

q_53803.question: What is the difference between an aggregation packet and a fragmentation unit in the context of RTP packets and NAL units?
q_53803.ground_truth: An aggregation packet is when one RTP packet can carry multiple NAL units, while a fragmentation unit is when multiple RTP packets are used to carry one NAL unit.

q_53804.question: What is the first requirement for the MsgA preamble in Test 1?
q_53804.ground_truth: The MsgA shall be one of the Random Access Preambles associated with SSB index 0.

q_53805.question: What is the 5% UL Average-UPT gain for operator 2 when using SBFD Alt 2 and large packet size at high load level?
q_53805.ground_truth: The 5% UL Average-UPT gain for operator 2 when using SBFD Alt 2 and large packet size at high load level is 0%.

q_53806.question: What is the length of the MBMS Subchannel field, excluding padding, in an MBMS subchannel control message?
q_53806.ground_truth: The MBMS Subchannel field length is the total length in octets of the Appl. m-line Number, reserved, IP Version, spare, Media Port Number, and IP address items.

q_53807.question: What is the potential risk of hypervisor and VM breakouts in a fully virtualized network with a common hypervisor and resources?
q_53807.ground_truth: A hypervisor breakout could have a devastating impact on network security, while a VM breakout could compromise all other VMs within a host or a limited set of hosts.

q_53808.question: Under what conditions does a UE that supports shared spectrum channel access have no uplink or downlink intra-cell guard bands?
q_53808.ground_truth: A UE that supports shared spectrum channel access has no uplink or downlink intra-cell guard bands for operation with 10 MHz and 20 MHz channel bandwidths.

q_53809.question: What is the parameter that specifies the minimum amount of subframe(s) before a UL HARQ retransmission grant is expected by the MAC entity in the 3GPP TS 36.321 standard?

q_53810.question: Which flag within Octet 5 of the MT-EDT Control Information IE, when set to "1", indicates that the UP function is requested to report the sum of DL data packets size?

q_53811.question: What is the training data input format used in the precoding matrix for the evaluation of Type 3 UE first separate training with dataset sharing manner for CSI compression?
q_53811.ground_truth: The training data samples are not quantized, i.e., Float32 is used/represented.

q_53812.question: What should be the position of an ancillary RF amplifier when performing tests on a BS?
q_53812.ground_truth: Sufficient tests should be repeated with the ancillary amplifier fitted and, if it is optional, without the ancillary RF amplifier to verify that the BS meets the requirements of the present document in both cases.

q_53813.question: What information should the UE store in VarRLF-Report if a handover failure occurs in Rel-10?
q_53813.ground_truth: The UE should store the following handover failure information in VarRLF-Report: plmn-Identity set to the RPLMN, measResultLastServCell including RSRP and RSRQ of the PCell, and failedPCellId including the global cell identity of the failed target cell.

q_53814.question: What is the effect of sending an SGsAP-EPS-DETACH-INDICATION message to the VLR?
q_53814.ground_truth: Sending an SGsAP-EPS-DETACH-INDICATION message aborts any other ongoing procedure related to the UE on the SGs interface in the MME and the VLR, and moves the state of the SGs association to SGs-NULL.

q_53815.question: What is the time period referred to as the Provisioning Session in the 5G Mobile Media Service (5GMS) system?
q_53815.ground_truth: The Provisioning Session is the time period during which the 5GMSu Client is permitted to upload stream media content.

q_53816.question: What shall the MCData emergency private communication state be set to if the MCData imminent peril group communication state is "MDIG 4: confirm-pending"?
q_53816.ground_truth: The MCData imminent peril group state should be set to "MDIG 1: no-imminent-peril".

q_53817.question: What is the difference between the third digit of the version number in the 3GPP technical specifications?
q_53817.ground_truth: The third digit of the version number is incremented when only editorial changes have been made to the document, such as changes in spelling, grammar, or document layout, without changing the technical requirements.

q_53818.question: Which clause specifies the UE maximum output power requirement for inter-band EN-DC including both FR1 and FR2?

q_53819.question: When is ECN (Explicit Congestion Notification) required to be supported by an MTSI client?
q_53819.ground_truth: An MTSI client must support ECN when offering to use RTCP-APP signalling or when it is offered for speech in RTP streams and the codec negotiation concludes that only fixed-rate operation is used.

q_53820.question: What must the network indicate to the UE if it supports more than 16 packet filters for signalled QoS rules?
q_53820.ground_truth: The network shall indicate the number of supported packet filters for signalled QoS rules, if the UE supports more than 16 packet filters for the PDU Session.

q_53821.question: What is the purpose of the "Address Allocation Preference" in the PCO?
q_53821.ground_truth: The "Address Allocation Preference" in the PCO indicates the UE's preference for obtaining an IPv4 address only after the default bearer activation by means of DHCPv4.

q_53822.question: What do the first digits in the version number of the document indicate?
q_53822.ground_truth: The first digit indicates the stage of approval of the document within the TSG.

q_53823.question: What is the purpose of network slices within the context of this use case?
q_53823.ground_truth: Network slices are used to provide different levels of service for online video, gaming, and other services. High priority users can access network slices that guarantee their QoS compared to other users with lower priority.

q_53824.question: What is the function of Integrity Protection Maximum Data Rate in the 5G network?
q_53824.ground_truth: Integrity Protection Maximum Data Rate indicates the maximum data rate up to which the UE can support UP integrity protection, and is provided by the UE independently of the access type.

q_53825.question: What state does the floor control arbitration logic in the IWF floor control server enter after releasing all resources and timers associated with the state machine in the 'Releasing' state?

q_53826.question: What is the maximum value that can be represented in the Maximum bitrate DL subparameter for the "+CGEQREQ" extended command in hexadecimal?
q_53826.ground_truth: The ME shall fill all octets with 'FF' in case the value exceeds the maximum that can be represented (which is 4294967295 bits per second).

q_53827.question: What is the role of the MnS producer in the energy saving activation procedure for Domain-centralized ES solution?
q_53827.ground_truth: The MnS producer for Domain-centralized ES management is responsible for collecting traffic load performance measurements from the NR capacity booster cell and candidate cells, analyzing the traffic load performance measurements to decide if the NR capacity booster cell should enter the energySaving state, and requesting the NR capacity booster cell to enter the energySaving state.

q_53828.question: What action does the W-AGF take if the W-CP signalling connection and W-UP resources have not been released yet when it receives the cause indicated from step~3 or an internal AMF event?
q_53828.ground_truth: The W-AGF releases the W-CP connection and W-UP resources with a procedure out of scope of 3GPP.

q_53829.question: What entity receives event reports from a VGMLC or LMF for a deferred 5GC-MT-LR for periodic or triggered location and returns the location information to an external LCS Client or NEF?

q_53830.question: What is the field of view (FOV) typically required for an immersive VR experience?
q_53830.ground_truth: Typically, a field of view (FOV) of 100 - 110 degrees is needed for an immersive VR experience.

q_53831.question: How does the PEGC release the respective PDU associated with the PINE?
q_53831.ground_truth: The PEGC releases the respective PDU associated with the PINE by using request-response queries and using the PDU ID and PINE FQDN or IP address of the PINE in the local PIN.

q_53832.question: When should the SidelinkUEInformationNR message be transmitted to indicate it no longer requires NR sidelink relay communication transmission resources?
q_53832.ground_truth: The SidelinkUEInformationNR message should be transmitted if the UE is not required to transmit NR sidelink L2 U2N relay communication, NR sidelink L3 U2N relay communication, or NR sidelink L2 U2U relay communication transmission resources.

q_53833.question: What is the role of the PEMC in the PIN registration process?
q_53833.ground_truth: The PEMC is responsible for sending the registration request to the PIN server, which includes the device metadata and the PEMC ID. Upon receiving a successful response from the PIN server, the PEMC sends the allocated PEMC ID to the PINE/PEGC.

q_53834.question: What is the PROCEDURE CODE for initialContextSetup?
q_53834.ground_truth: The PROCEDURE CODE for initialContextSetup is id-InitialContextSetup.

q_53835.question: What is the required time difference between the start of two consecutive SSB transmissions for the 5 ms requirement in this clause to be applied?
q_53835.ground_truth: The required time difference is 5 ms.

q_53836.question: What does the "type" parameter indicate in the EPSFB status report?
q_53836.ground_truth: The "type" parameter indicates the EPSFB type, which can be handover or redirection.

q_53837.question: What is the purpose of step 3 in the procedure?
q_53837.ground_truth: The purpose of step 3 in the procedure is to calculate the median value of the reported wideband CQI-values.

q_53838.question: What is the failure cause counter for UCMF dictionary entry deletions in the NEF?

q_53839.question: What is the requirement for inter-VNF and intra-VNF traffic separation?
q_53839.ground_truth: The requirement of inter-VNF and intra-VNF traffic separation is to prevent security threats from different networks from affecting each other. A VNFCI should refuse inter-VNF traffic on all intra-VNF interfaces and refuse intra-VNF traffic on all inter-VNF interfaces.

q_53840.question: What is the test applicability for the 6.3.3.1.6 test?
q_53840.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of NR UE release 16 and forward supporting Enhanced Type II codebook with at least 16 ports per CSI-RS resource, and also applies to all types of EUTRA UE release 16 and forward supporting EN-DC and Enhanced Type II codebook with at least 16 ports per CSI-RS resource.

q_53841.question: What is the IP mobility management selection for DSMIPv6 support during initial attach to a non-3GPP access?
q_53841.ground_truth: If the UE indicates DSMIPv6 support only and the network supports and selects DSMIPv6, the trusted non-3GPP access network or ePDG provides a local IP address to the UE to be used as CoA for DSMIPv6/S2c.

q_53842.question: What is the role of the TWAG in providing user plane connection ID for a WLCP bearer?
q_53842.ground_truth: The TWAG provides the user plane connection ID to the lower layers to be used as the MAC address of the TWAG associated with the WLCP bearer.

q_53843.question: What should a GPRS MS do when it is rejected for network access with the EMM cause #13, "Roaming not allowed in this location area"?
q_53843.ground_truth: The MS should store the LAI in the list of "forbidden location areas for roaming" and start timer T3340. Upon timer expiry, the MS should perform a PLMN selection and, if necessary, reset the location update attempt counter.

q_53844.question: What is the MIME body type that should be used to indicate the selected MCS user profile at an MC client in a 3GPP system?
q_53844.ground_truth: The application/poc-settings+xml MIME body is used to indicate the selected MCS user profile at an MC client in a 3GPP system.

q_53845.question: What should the MCData client include in the SIP REFER request if a standalone SDS session is requested?
q_53845.ground_truth: The MCData client should include the g.3gpp.mcdata.sds media feature tag and the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag with the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcdata.sds" in the Contact header field of the SIP REFER request.

q_53846.question: What should a transmission participant do when they receive a Transmission rejected message in the 'U: pending request to transmit' state?
q_53846.ground_truth: They should send a Transmission control Ack message, provide transmission rejected notification to the user, stop timer T100, and enter the 'U: has no permission to transmit' state.

q_53847.question: Who is responsible for providing the service flow coordination group ID and group level treatment policy further to RAN via AMF?
q_53847.ground_truth: SMF is responsible for providing the QoS flow coordination group ID, QoS profile, Alternative QoS Profile, and group level treatment policy to RAN via AMF as part of session management information per UE.
