q_54085.ground_truth: The NRM server should return an HTTP GET response message to the VAL server with an HTTP "200 OK" status code with the TscStreamAvailability data structure as the response body, including the stream specification matching the received query parameters and the corresponding list of traffic specifications.

q_54086.question: What information is included in the MapGroupToMBSsession message and over which reference point is it sent?
q_54086.ground_truth: The MapGroupToMBSsession message includes association information between the group call and MBS session, such as the MCVideo group ID and media stream identifier of the established MBS session. This message is sent over the MCVideo-9 reference point.

q_54087.question: What happens when the DN-AAA initiated re-authentication and re-authorization procedures are not applicable for PAP/CHAP?
q_54087.ground_truth: When PAP/CHAP is used as the authentication protocol with the external DN-AAA server which does not support EAP, the Diameter DN-AAA initiated re-authentication and re-authorization procedures are not applicable.

q_54088.question: What system does the RCAF collect information from to determine the congestion level of an eNodeB or E-UTRAN cell?

q_54089.question: What encryption mode should be used for content that claims conformance to the IOP defined in ISO/IEC 23001-7?
q_54089.ground_truth: Only the AES-128 CTR mode should be used for encryption.

q_54090.question: When does a gNB stop collecting and forwarding RCEF reports for a UE?
q_54090.ground_truth: Upon trace session deactivation in the gNB, RCEF reports are no longer collected for file-based reporting or streaming reporting.

q_54091.question: What should be the value of the "refresher" header field parameter when including it in the "Session-Refresher" header field as per IETF RFC 4028?
q_54091.ground_truth: The value of the "refresher" header field parameter should be set to "uac" when including it in the "Session-Refresher" header field as per IETF RFC 4028.

q_54092.question: What message does the UE use to initiate a PRU disassociation procedure?
q_54092.ground_truth: The UE invokes a PRU disassociation procedure by sending a REGISTER message containing a PRU-disassociation operation as defined in 3GPP~TS~24.080.

q_54093.question: What should the MS do if it is no longer in the coverage of the selected PLMN while performing ProSe communications?
q_54093.ground_truth: The MS shall either perform ProSe communications procedures for using provisioned radio resources or return to the stored duplicate PLMN selection mode.

q_54094.question: What are two potential issues when providing media content from a 5G system to AR glasses through a tethered link?
q_54094.ground_truth: Two potential issues include added latency and distortion due to transcoding, and unnecessary power consumption for encoding and decoding processes.

q_54095.question: What information should the ME include in the MeasurementReport if inter-frequency measurements are requested by the USIM?
q_54095.ground_truth: The ME should include IE "measResultListNR" in IE "measResults" and report Physical Cell ID, related RSRP, RSRQ, and SINR, as well as IE "cgi-Info" for the up to 8 strongest inter-frequency cells per monitored frequency.

q_54096.question: What is the format of the Monitoring Time field in the Monitoring Time IE?
q_54096.ground_truth: The Monitoring Time field indicates the monitoring time in UTC time, encoded in the same format as the first four octets of the 64-bit timestamp format as defined in clause 6 of IETF-RFC-5905.

q_54097.question: Which of the following protocols is preferred for wide area network (WAN) protection mechanisms due to its flexibility in supporting PMU multicast mode?

q_54098.question: What should the participating MCPTT function do in step 10 if the received SIP MESSAGE request for binding/unbinding of a functional alias with the MCPTT group(s) for the MCPTT user contains a SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response?
q_54098.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT function may reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response and include a Retry-After header field to the SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response.

q_54099.question: What is the mean and 5% DL Average-UPT loss provided by the semi-static SBFD at a high load level with 30dBm BS transmission power assumed by 1 source?
q_54099.ground_truth: The mean and 5% DL Average-UPT loss provided by the semi-static SBFD at a high load level with 30dBm BS transmission power assumed by 1 source is -10.03% and -35.08%, respectively.

q_54100.question: What is the required condition for the test case described in TS 36.304, clause 5.2.4.6a to be applied?
q_54100.ground_truth: The current serving cell can only be accessed using enhanced coverage.

q_54101.question: What should a UE do when a HARQ RTT Timer expires in a subframe and the data in the corresponding HARQ process was not successfully decoded?
q_54101.ground_truth: The UE should start the drx-RetransmissionTimer for the corresponding HARQ process and monitor the PDCCH for drx-RetransmissionTimer consecutive NPDCCH-subframes.

q_54102.question: What should the MCVideo client do when the transmission control server gives up?
q_54102.ground_truth: It is recommended that the MCVideo client is disconnected from the MCVideo call when the transmission control server gives up.

q_54103.question: What is one possible outcome after the EAS relocation is performed?
q_54103.ground_truth: The SMF may instruct the local PSA with the EAS IP address replacement using "Outer Header Creation" and "Outer Header Removal" as defined in the TS 23.548.

q_54104.question: What are the two options for the home network to steer a UE to a specific hosting network?
q_54104.ground_truth: The two options are UE-based and Network-and-UE-coordination based.

q_54105.question: What happens when the NG-RAN does not receive the MBS packets from the MB-UPF in the user plane for a broadcast MBS session?
q_54105.ground_truth: The NG-RAN will not receive the MBS packets from the MB-UPF as the user plane for the broadcast MBS session has not been established.

q_54106.question: How does the Non-3GPP IP Access receive operator's policies to be enforced on the usage of local IP address after the authentication?
q_54106.ground_truth: The Non-3GPP IP Access receives operator's policies to be enforced on the usage of local IP address after the authentication by the AAA/HSS and/or the 3GPP AAA Proxy returning the set of home/visited operator's policies in the AAA exchange for network access authentication.

q_54107.question: What are the conditions for the 3GPP AAA Server to select SCM or MCM for Trusted WLAN access?
q_54107.ground_truth: The 3GPP AAA Server selects SCM or MCM for Trusted WLAN access based on the modes supported by the TWAN, the UE, and operator policy.

q_54108.question: What is the function of the CRC in the Downlink control information (DCI)?
q_54108.ground_truth: The CRC in the DCI is used to transport downlink, uplink or sidelink scheduling information, requests for aperiodic CQI reports, LAA common information, notifications of MCCH change or uplink power control commands for one cell and one RNTI. The RNTI is implicitly encoded in the CRC.

q_54109.question: What is the ASCII name string for the MBS subchannel control messages?
q_54109.ground_truth: The ASCII name string for the MBS subchannel control messages is "MCV5".

q_54110.question: What information does the SMF (Session Management Function) generate based on the PCC rules from PCF?

q_54111.question: In Automatic Network Selection Mode, what is the definition of high quality signal?
q_54111.ground_truth: High quality signal is defined in the appropriate AS specification.

q_54112.question: What technology does 3GP-DASH differentiate from in its RTP-based streaming counterpart?
q_54112.ground_truth: 3GP-DASH, a part of the 3GPP Technical Specification, differentiates from RTP-based streaming in that it is carried out exclusively over HTTP, while RTP-based streaming is maintained in TS 26.234.

q_54113.question: When applying PUCCH format 3 or 4 requirement tests, for which option should tests be carried out if both without and with additional DM-RS are declared to be supported?
q_54113.ground_truth: The tests should be done for either without or with additional DM-RS; the same chosen option should be used for all tests.

q_54114.question: What should the SGM-C include in the HTTP DELETE request when deleting a group?
q_54114.ground_truth: The SGM-C shall set the Request-URI to a XCAP URI identifying the XML document to be deleted and include an Authorization header field with the "Bearer" authentication scheme set to an access token of the "bearer" token type.

q_54115.question: Which section specifies the test environment for NTN testing?
q_54115.ground_truth: Section 5.6.1 specifies the test environment for NTN testing.

q_54116.question: What is the purpose of the "reason" parameter in the 3gpp-Sbi-Request-Info header?
q_54116.ground_truth: The "reason" parameter in the 3gpp-Sbi-Request-Info header indicates the reason for which the NF resends or redirects the HTTP request message. It takes one of the following values: unreachable, overloaded, 3xx-redirect, or temporary-rejection-cause.

q_54117.question: What should the NEF do if it receives only one background data transfer policy from the H-PCF in step 2b?
q_54117.ground_truth: The NEF does not require the AF to confirm if it receives only one background data transfer policy.

q_54118.question: What field in the Timing Delta MAC CE indicates the value used to control the amount of timing adjustment?

q_54119.question: What is the requirement for the overall delays measured in the test?
q_54119.ground_truth: The requirement for the overall delays measured is that it shall be less than a total of 4802 ms.

q_54120.question: What is the communication option where network functions communicate directly, without the use of an intermediate function like the SCP?

q_54121.question: What are the entering and leaving conditions for event A2 in TS 36.331, clause 5.5.4.3?
q_54121.ground_truth: The entering condition for event A2 is fulfilled when Ms is greater than or equal to Thresh + Hys. The leaving condition for event A2 is fulfilled when Ms is less than Thresh - Hys.

q_54122.question: What does the T8 reference point specify in the context of 3GPP networks?
q_54122.ground_truth: The T8 reference point specifies APIs that allow the SCS/AS to access the services and capabilities provided by 3GPP network entities and securely exposed by the SCEF.

q_54123.question: What should the MCVideo client do when the PRIVATE CALL REJECT message is received in response to a PRIVATE CALL SETUP REQUEST message?
q_54123.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should stop timer TFP1 and TFP2, start timer TFP7, release the call control state machine, and enter the "P1: ignoring same call id" state.

q_54124.question: What is the purpose of the successful operation in the context of UE-associated signalling in the 8.7.12.2 section?
q_54124.ground_truth: The purpose of the successful operation is to ensure the proper delivery of RRC messages between the MeNB and en-gNB when the en-gNB receives an RRC TRANSFER message with the RRC Container IE.

q_54125.question: What information can the NG-RAN provide to the AF as a response to the QoS Flow establishment request?
q_54125.ground_truth: The NG-RAN may provide a "BAT offset" that is within the BAT window, if available, as a response to the QoS Flow establishment request.

q_54126.question: What information shall be provisioned in the POIs and TFs in the RCS Server, IRI-POI and CC-POI in the HTTP Content Server, File Transfer Localization Function, and S-CSCF when the warrant is for IRI only?
q_54126.ground_truth: The IRI-POI and IRI-TF in the RCS Servers, IRI-POI in the HTTP Content Server, File Transfer Localization Function and the S-CSCF, MDF2, and MDF3 shall be provisioned as specified in clause 7.13.1.

q_54127.question: How many E-UTRA carriers are used in the 9.2.27.1.4 test procedure?
q_54127.ground_truth: There are two E-UTRA carriers with one cell on one E-UTRA TDD carrier and two cells on the other E-UTRA TDD carrier specified in the test.

q_54128.question: What functionality is needed in the network for inter-working between different networks?
q_54128.ground_truth: Functionality such as common codecs, MGCF, and MGW is needed in the network for inter-working between different networks.

q_54129.question: In what scenarios is the sum of the UE delays in sending and receiving directions (Ts + Tr) evaluated for MTSI-based speech-only with LTE, NR, or WLAN access in 8.11.1 and 8.11.2.1 of the document?
q_54129.ground_truth: This evaluation is done in error and jitter-free conditions, as well as in conditions with simulated packet arrival time variations and packet loss in 8.11.1 and 8.11.2.1.

q_54130.question: What is the role of the LMF with respect to user-plane positioning?
q_54130.ground_truth: The LMF may have a proprietary signalling connection to an SLP, which is the SUPL entity responsible for positioning over the user plane.

q_54131.question: What is the expected result for each test case of the SEPP testing process?
q_54131.ground_truth: The expected result for each test case is that the SEPP under test sends an error signalling message to the peer SEPP on the N32-c connection or logs the error.

q_54132.question: What is the size of the <Group call ongoing> value in the MBMS notifications control message?
q_54132.ground_truth: The <Group call ongoing> value is a binary value where the size is 1 octet.

q_54133.question: What is the state that the MS enters when it is searching for PLMNs, and the conditions for state 19.8 are not met?

q_54134.question: What does the MBMS-HC-Indicator AVP represent in the Gmb reference point?
q_54134.ground_truth: The MBMS-HC-Indicator AVP represents an indication if header compression is used by BM-SC when sending for MBMS user plane data.

q_54135.question: What is the minimum interruption time (Tinterrupt) for intra-frequency or inter-frequency handover when the target cell is known and sufficient signal quality is available for successful cell detection on the first attempt?

q_54136.question: What is the requirement for the success rate in repeated tests?
q_54136.ground_truth: The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90%.

q_54137.question: What is the use of the "AC Association ID" in AC associations?
q_54137.ground_truth: It is a unique identifier of an association within the EEL deployment or the system, and is necessary for uniquely identifying AC associations in the absence of the full AAP information.

q_54138.question: Which reference point is defined for the interactions between the SMF and the CHF?
q_54138.ground_truth: The N40 reference point is defined for the interactions between the SMF and the CHF.

q_54139.question: What is the procedure when the UE is connected on an un-trusted non-3GPP access considered to be DSMIPv6 home link for the UE based on clause~4.5.6?
q_54139.ground_truth: The UE may trigger the establishment of S2c IKEv2 SA, e.g. to optimize future handovers to other accesses using S2c.

q_54140.question: What is the purpose of the RRCConnectionResumeRequest message in the early data transmission (EDT) procedure for User Plane CIoT EPS optimizations?
q_54140.ground_truth: The RRCConnectionResumeRequest message is sent to initiate the early data transmission procedure, and includes the user data ciphered and transmitted on DTCH multiplexed with the RRCConnectionResumeRequest message on CCCH.

q_54141.question: What information must the MCVideo client include in the SIP MESSAGE request when sending the MBMS bearer listening status or suspension status report?
q_54141.ground_truth: The MCVideo client must include the MBMS public service identity, the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media-feature tag with the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcvideo," a public user identity in the P-Preferred-Identity header field, a P-Preferred-Serviceheader field with the value "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcvideo," and an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-mbms-usage-info+xml MIME body with the <mbms-listening-status> or <mbms-suspension-status> element.

q_54142.question: What is the measurement period for E-UTRA RSRP and RSRQ measurements in RRC_CONNECTED state?
q_54142.ground_truth: The measurement period for E-UTRA RSRP and RSRQ measurements in RRC_CONNECTED state is specified in clause 9.4.2 and 9.4.3.

q_54143.question: What is the primary responsibility of the CAPIF core function in network slice management capability exposure via CAPIF alternative 2?
q_54143.ground_truth: The CAPIF core function helps the MnS consumer to discover the address of the MnS producer so that the MnS consumer can request MnS consumption, and it may require an extension of the CAPIF-4 interface to support the discovery service for the MnS consumer.

q_54144.question: In what type of system can the public service identity of the non-controlling MCData function or of the MCData gateway server be identified when the non-controlling MCData function or the terminating participating MCData function is in an interconnected MCData system in a different trust domain?
q_54144.ground_truth: The public service identity can identify the non-controlling MCData function or the MCData gateway server in an interconnected MCData system that is in a different trust domain.

q_54145.question: How many active cells and SyncRef UEs are there in this test?
q_54145.ground_truth: There is one active cell (Cell 1) and one active SyncRef UE (SyncRef UE 1) in this test.

q_54146.question: What is the role of the "dnn" attribute in the PCF's selection of a DNN?
q_54146.ground_truth: The "dnn" attribute contains the DNN that the PCF selected.

q_54147.question: What is the intent of 3GPP Service URL handling in the 5GMS system?
q_54147.ground_truth: To launch UE functions based on the execution of a URL and enable 5G Media Streaming services to be announced within a third-party application, a general web page, a messaging service or shared via social messages using a 3GPP Service URL for 5GMS.

q_54148.question: What action should a UE take when a random access problem is indicated by the SCG MAC during CA or NE-DC?
q_54148.ground_truth: The UE should consider radio link failure to be detected for the SCG, i.e. SCG-RLF, and initiate the SCG failure information procedure as specified in 5.6.13.

q_54149.question: What issue does Solution #3 address in polar orbit satellite constellation scenarios?
q_54149.ground_truth: Solution #3 addresses the dramatic change of delay/jitter caused by cross-seam transiting events in polar orbit satellite constellation scenarios.

q_54150.question: Which protocol data units (PDUs) are used in the "Broadcast Session Release Response" and "Broadcast Session Transport Failure" messages in the 5G network?
q_54150.ground_truth: The BroadcastSessionReleaseResponseIEs and BroadcastSessionTransportFailureIEs NGAP-PROTOCOL-IES are used in the "Broadcast Session Release Response" and "Broadcast Session Transport Failure" messages in the 5G network.

q_54151.question: What information does the MCData server store about the MCData user and MCData client?
q_54151.ground_truth: The MCData server maintains a list of MCData user information entries, each containing an MCData ID, and a list of MCData client information entries, each containing an MCData client ID, a list of MCData group information entries.

q_54152.question: What are the two network-based mobility management mechanisms supported by the EPS in 3GPP?
q_54152.ground_truth: The two network-based mobility management mechanisms supported by the EPS in 3GPP are PMIP and GTP.

q_54153.question: What is the purpose of the additional authentication and authorization mechanisms in Clause 9.6 of the MC System?
q_54153.ground_truth: The additional authentication and authorization mechanisms in Clause 9.6 are used to provide evidence of the requester's identity and permission to take an action, especially in cases of privileged signalling or signalling between network entities in separate MC domains.

q_54154.question: When is the "Modify reject" message type used in the 3GPP TS 24.008 standard?
q_54154.ground_truth: This message is sent by the mobile station to the network or by the network to the mobile station to indicate failure of a request to change the bearer capability for a call.

q_54155.question: What is the type of the requested information when the NF service consumer sends a request to the HSS to receive the UE's IMS Profile Retrieval?
q_54155.ground_truth: The type of the requested information is (/ims-data/profile-data)

q_54156.question: What should the UE set the 5G ProSe-dc bit to in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message if it supports 5G ProSe discovery communication?
q_54156.ground_truth: The UE should set the 5G ProSe-dc bit to "5G ProSe discovery communication supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message if it supports 5G ProSe discovery communication.

q_54157.question: What is the role of the 5GC in the solution for Group Management?
q_54157.ground_truth: The 5GC is responsible for determining and selecting a common local part of the DN for the group members in the solution for Group Management.

q_54158.question: What is the procedure for the temporary stop and restart of QoE information reporting during RAN overload in NR?
q_54158.ground_truth: In case of overload in RAN, the gNB may temporarily stop the reporting from the UE and continue recording further information until the data storage capacity for the reporting is fully used or the UE request session ends. The gNB then restarts the reporting from the UE when the overload situation in RAN is ended in NR.

q_54159.question: What is the purpose of "SLDRBs-Required-ToBeModified-List" and "SLDRBs-Required-ToBeReleased-List"?
q_54159.ground_truth: Both "SLDRBs-Required-ToBeModified-List" and "SLDRBs-Required-ToBeReleased-List" are used to specify the list of Service Data Radio Bear (SLDRB) s required to be modified or released during the UE context modification.

q_54160.question: What is the purpose of the SMF's capability to generate specific PDR and FAR to enable local data switching between UEs?
q_54160.ground_truth: The SMF's capability to generate specific PDR and FAR to enable local data switching between UEs is to forward all UL traffic towards group members via the additional PSA to the gNB or other I-UPFs and all DL traffic towards this UE via N9 tunnel.

q_54161.question: What is the maximum number of PLMN for QMC?

q_54162.question: How can an existing federation relationship be removed between the L-OP and P-OP?
q_54162.ground_truth: The L-OP can request P-OP to delete an existing instance of EdgeFederation IOC, which will also result in the deletion of related OperatorEdgeDataNetwork MOI.

q_54163.question: What should the MGCF do when it receives an indication of call release from a circuit-switched network, in calls initiated by a circuit-switched network?
q_54163.ground_truth: The MGCF should send a BYE request to the UE.

q_54164.question: What should the Request-URI be set to in a SIP MESSAGE request to disable the storage of MCData communications for private and/or group?
q_54164.ground_truth: The Request-URI should be set to the public service identity identifying the originating participating MCData function serving the MCData user.

q_54165.question: What feature does QUIC provide to handle data in a lightweight, ordered byte-stream abstraction to an application?

q_54166.question: What should the user equipment (UE) do when there is at least one applicable neighboring cell to report in the measurement reporting procedure?
q_54166.ground_truth: The UE should set the measResultNeighCells to include the best neighboring cells up to maxReportCells.

q_54167.question: What is the time limit for interruptions when carrier based switching is performed between carriers with the same band, and cell specific reference signals are available in the same slot?
q_54167.ground_truth: The time limit for interruptions when carrier based switching is performed between carriers with the same band, and cell specific reference signals are available in the same slot, is Y3 slot + SMTC duration.

q_54168.question: What is the requirement for any measured E-UTRA carrier for the narrowband blocking requirement?
q_54168.ground_truth: The throughput for any measured E-UTRA carrier for the narrowband blocking requirement should be greater than or equal to 95% of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channel.

q_54169.question: What action will the PCF take if the BDT policy is set to "INVALID" during SM Policy Association establishment?
q_54169.ground_truth: The PCF may reject the SM Policy Association establishment or defer to make the policy decisions until the PCF is informed of the result of BDT policy renegotiation finally.

q_54170.question: What modifications are made in Step 18 of the procedure specified in clause 5.3.2.1 of TS 23.401 with interworking with 5GS?
q_54170.ground_truth: In Step 18, the 5G QoS parameters for the PDU session and for the QoS Flow associated with the default QoS rule are stored in the UE.

q_54171.question: What information does the "source-IP-address" attribute in the <transmitter> element provide?
q_54171.ground_truth: The "source-IP-address" attribute in the <transmitter> element contains the parameter defined in subclause~12.4.2.11, of the transmitter.

q_54172.question: What should the IBCF do if it receives a request for a dialog, a standalone transaction, or an unknown method that does not relate to an existing dialog and the request is from an untrusted domain?
q_54172.ground_truth: If the request is not an initial INVITE request, the IBCF should remove all P-Charging-Vector header fields, all P-Charging-Function-Addresses header fields, and all Feature-Caps header fields the request may contain. If the request is an initial INVITE request, the IBCF should respond with a 100 (Trying) provisional response.

q_54173.question: What is the authentication framework used for a 5G-RG connecting to a 5GC via W-5GAN?
q_54173.ground_truth: The authentication framework defined in clause 6.1.3 of TS 23.316 shall be used to authenticate the 5G-RG when connecting to a 5GC via W-5GAN.

q_54174.question: What is the format of the NF Service Set ID for a NF Service Set in a PLMN?
q_54174.ground_truth: The NF Service Set ID for a NF Service Set in a PLMN is in the format of set<Set ID>.sn<Service Name>.nfi<NF Instance ID>.5gc.mnc<MNC>.mcc<MCC> where MNC and MCC identify the PLMN of the NF Service Set and are each 3 digits long, Network Identifier (NID) is encoded as hexadecimal digits, NFInstanceID identifies the NF instance of the NF Service set, ServiceName identifies the NF service of the NF Service of the NF Service set, and Set ID is a service specific Set ID within the NF instance.

q_54175.question: What is the purpose of the UE network capability information element, and what type and length is it?
q_54175.ground_truth: The UE network capability information element is used to provide the network with information concerning aspects of the UE related to EPS. It is a type 4 information element with a minimum length of 4 octets and a maximum length of 15 octets.

q_54176.question: What information is created upon the VAL server's interaction for requesting SEALDD transmission service?
q_54176.ground_truth: The information includes step 1 and 2 in solution #9, such as the SEALDD context.

q_54177.question: What does the Node-Type AVP define in 8.4.48?
q_54177.ground_truth: The Node-Type AVP identifies the type of node sending the information.

q_54178.question: What security methods are applied to SRB3 in 5G communications, and what are the security keys derived from?
q_54178.ground_truth: NR PDCP ciphering and integrity protection are applied to SRB3, with security keys derived from S-KgNB.

q_54179.question: What response must the participating MCPTT function send if it cannot determine the controlling MCPTT function for the ambient listening call service associated with the originating user's MCPTT ID?
q_54179.ground_truth: A SIP 404 (Not Found) response with the warning text "142 unable to determine the controlling function" in a Warning header field as specified in clause~4.4.

q_54180.question: What information does the "in-coverage" attribute in the <transmission> element indicate?
q_54180.ground_truth: Whether the UE was in NG-RAN coverage when transmitting the data.

q_54181.question: What actions can the UE take if the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message sent with request type set to "emergency" or "handover of emergency bearer services" and the UE receives a PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT message?
q_54181.ground_truth: The UE may inform the upper layers of the failure to establish the emergency bearer or attempt EPS attach for emergency bearer services if not detached already. If the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message was sent with PDN type set to "Ethernet" and the UE receives a PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message with ESM cause #58, the UE may attempt a PDN connectivity procedure with the non-IP PDN type.

q_54182.question: In the relaxed monitoring criterion, what is the condition that must be fulfilled to choose not to perform intra-frequency or inter-frequency measurements?
q_54182.ground_truth: The difference between the reference Srxlev value of the serving cell and the current Srxlev value of the serving cell must be less than a specific value.

q_54183.question: What should the MAC entity do for a serving cell when a partial reset is requested by upper layers?
q_54183.ground_truth: The MAC entity should set the NDIs for all uplink HARQ processes to the value 0, flush all UL HARQ buffers, stop all running drx-ULRetransmissionTimers and UL HARQ RTT timers, stop ongoing RACH procedure, discard explicitly signalled ra-PreambleIndex and ra-PRACH-MaskIndex, flush Msg3 buffer, and release any Temporary C-RNTI.

q_54184.question: What must the manufacturer declare if the base station supports standalone NB-IoT operating mode?
q_54184.ground_truth: The manufacturer must declare the number of supported NB-IoT carriers if the base station supports standalone NB-IoT operating mode.

q_54185.question: What is the purpose of the Transfer of Assistance Information procedure in NR PDCP?
q_54185.ground_truth: The Transfer of Assistance Information procedure is used to provide assistance information to the node hosting the NR PDCP entity, such as Radio Quality Assistance Information, PDCP duplication activation suggestion, and QoS monitoring results for UP management and optimization procedures.

q_54186.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) in the context of the E-UTRA system?
q_54186.ground_truth: The 3GPP is an international organization responsible for producing technical specifications for the E-UTRA system.

q_54187.question: What information is included in the UL NAS TRANSPORT message sent by the Located UE?
q_54187.ground_truth: The UL NAS TRANSPORT message sent by the Located UE includes a MO-NW assistant ranging/sidelink positioning request along with the Ranging/Sidelink positioning assistant data based on the network-assisted measurement.

q_54188.question: What statistics are kept during the test for ACK missed detection for PUCCH format 1?
q_54188.ground_truth: The statistics kept during the test for ACK missed detection for PUCCH format 1 are the number of ACK bits falsely detected in the idle periods and the number of missed ACK bits. Each falsely detected ACK bit in the idle periods is accounted as one error for the statistics of false ACK detection, and each missed ACK bit is accounted as one error for the statistics of missed ACK detection.

q_54189.question: What should be done in the source AMF when a HANDOVER SUCCESS message is sent during an Inter-NG-RAN node N2 based handover procedure?
q_54189.ground_truth: The source AMF should release the PDU Session(s) listed in the toReleaseSessionList attribute in the content, release the SM Context at the I-SMF or V-SMF for all the PDU sessions listed in the smfChangeInfoList attribute, remove the individual ueContext resource, and send a HANDOVER SUCCESS message to the source NG-RAN.

q_54190.question: What information does the PEGCF include in its PIN Join request message to the PEMCF?
q_54190.ground_truth: The PEGCF ID, the PIN ID, and the PIN Join request message.

q_54191.question: What does it mean if an IE is Optional in a message?
q_54191.ground_truth: The IE is included as a service option and may be included or not in a message. If it is absent or erroneous, the rules specified in clause 7.4 should be followed.

q_54192.question: What is the document titled "Study on Efficient utilization of licensed spectrum that is not aligned with existing NR channel bandwidths" about?
q_54192.ground_truth: The document discusses a study on how to efficiently use licensed spectrum in 5G networks when it is not aligned with the existing NR channel bandwidths.

q_54193.question: What element carries information about a transmission in a 5G ProSe group or in an unicast mode 5G ProSe direct communication?

q_54194.question: What is the definition of SNR used in 11.2.1 for the radiated performance requirements?
q_54194.ground_truth: The SNR used in 11.2.1 is defined as: SNR = S / N, where S is the total signal energy in a slot on a RIB, and N is the noise energy in a bandwidth corresponding to the transmission bandwidth over the duration of a slot on a RIB.

q_54195.question: What should the MCData client include in the Payload data when generating a DATA PAYLOAD message in the MCData communication?
q_54195.ground_truth: The MCData client should include the remaining amount of data to be sent in bytes.

q_54196.question: What should the MCData server do if there is no <selected-user-profile-index> element included in the poc-settings event package and there are multiple MCData user profiles stored for the MCData user?
q_54196.ground_truth: It should determine the pre-selected MCData user profile that contains the <Pre-selected-indication> element in the collection of MCData user profiles and use it as the active MCData user profile.

q_54197.question: What should the UE do upon expiry of timer T105 for the fifth time in step 5.4.9.4 when the UE decides to terminate the UE assistance data operation?
q_54197.ground_truth: The UE should abort the procedure when the timer T105 expires for the fifth time in step 5.4.9.4 when the UE decides to terminate the UE assistance data operation.

q_54198.question: What is the maximum increase in output power allowed for the RF repeater as per the minimum requirement in section 6.7.2.2?
q_54198.ground_truth: The power in the passband shall not increase with more than 10 dB at the output of the repeater as measured with 1MHz measurement bandwidth, compared to the level obtained without interfering signals applied.

q_54199.question: What changes are needed for NG-RAN and AMF to support connected mode mobility between SNPNs?
q_54199.ground_truth: NG-RAN and AMF need to support equivalent SNPNs in NGAP and make use of the list of SNPN IDs in the Mobility Restriction List from the AMF. For N2 based HO procedure, the source AMF should forward the selected SNPN ID to the target AMF, which then indicates the selected SNPN ID to the target NG-RAN. Additionally, extended NGAP support might be necessary to handle connected mode mobility between SNPNs, and the interface should enable the TAI list to be associated with different SNPNs.

q_54200.question: What should a mobile station do if it receives a CALL PROCEEDING message and the network supports multicall and there are no other ongoing calls to the MS?
q_54200.ground_truth: The mobile station should store this information until the call control state for all calls returns to null.

q_54201.question: What should the UE do when the number of cells in the cellsTriggeredList is larger than or equal to numberOfTriggeringCells, as per 5.5.4.3?
q_54201.ground_truth: The UE sets the numberOfReportsSent defined within the VarMeasReportList for this measId to 0 and initiates the measurement reporting procedure, as specified in 5.5.5.

q_54202.question: How many sources observed significant degradations for scalability Case 3 in the CSI payload size study?
q_54202.ground_truth: Two sources observed significant degradations of up to -14.22% for scalability Case 3 in the CSI payload size study.

q_54203.question: What is the test method used to assess the requirement on JBM performance for speech-only with LTE, NR, or WLAN access?
q_54203.ground_truth: The test method used to assess the requirement on JBM performance for speech-only with LTE, NR, or WLAN access is described in clause 8.13.3. The test profiles are defined in Annex F.

q_54204.question: What is the condition to be met for counting a success in NR SA FR1 L1 SL-RSRP measurement for autonomous resource selection/reselection?
q_54204.ground_truth: Nresource, non-subch 2/ Nresource, total should be less than 10% for counting a success for the event "subchannel #2 resource available".

q_54205.question: What are the attributes within the SessionRule data structure that the PCF shall set when installing a new session rule?
q_54205.ground_truth: When installing a new session rule, the PCF shall set the authorized Session-AMBR within the "authSessAmbr" attribute, the authorized default QoS within the "authDefQos" attribute, zero or one reference to the UsageMonitoringData data structure within the "refUmData" attribute, and zero or one reference to the ConditionData data structure within the "refCondData" attribute.

q_54206.question: What is the purpose of a Routing Binding Indication in an HTTP request?
q_54206.ground_truth: A Routing Binding Indication in an HTTP request conveys binding information to direct a request from a client to a server which has the context.

q_54207.question: Which inference trustworthiness technique can be used to protect predictions from model inversion or model extraction attacks?
q_54207.ground_truth: Perturbing model predictions to obfuscate labels/confidence information.

q_54208.question: What is the purpose of the paging procedure in the 5G system?
q_54208.ground_truth: The purpose of the paging procedure is to transmit paging information to a UE in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE, or to transmit paging information for a L2 U2N Remote UE in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE.

q_54209.question: When is user plane security enforcement information used for 5G?
q_54209.ground_truth: User plane security enforcement information is used for the life time of the PDU session once it is determined at the establishment of the PDU session.

q_54210.question: What action does gNB-DU take if it receives a RESOURCE STATUS REQUEST message indicating "start" for the Registration Request IE and cell-specific measurements with the Cell To Report List IE included?
q_54210.ground_truth: gNB-DU initiates the requested measurement and responds with the RESOURCE STATUS RESPONSE message

q_54211.question: What should a receiving UM RLC entity do when it receives an UMD PDU with SN outside of the reordering window?
q_54211.ground_truth: The receiving UM RLC entity should reassemble RLC SDUs from any UMD PDUs with SN that falls outside of the reordering window, remove RLC headers when doing so, and deliver the reassembled RLC SDUs to the upper layer in ascending order of the RLC SN.

q_54212.question: What does the 5GMSd AF do when it grants a Background Data Transfer request from the Media Session Handler?
q_54212.ground_truth: The 5GMSd AF responds to the Media Session Handler by granting the Background Data Transfer request, indicating the maximum time period for which the Background Data Transfer is available and the maximum data volume granted for the media streaming session during this grant period.

q_54213.question: What does the PINMF check in step 2 of clause 6.8.2.1.2 when additional PEMCs are received?
q_54213.ground_truth: The PINMF checks whether additional PEMCs are included in the Trust Members of the PEMC identified by the PEMC ID using UDM or NEF. This helps to ensure the secured management of the PIN.

q_54214.question: What is the role of the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay in the 5G system?
q_54214.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay is a 5G ProSe-enabled UE that provides functionality to support connectivity between 5G ProSe U2U UEs.

q_54215.question: What condition must be met for the IRI-POI in the PTC server to generate an xIRI containing a PTCStartOfInterception record?
q_54215.ground_truth: The IRI-POI present in the PTC server generates an xIRI containing a PTCStartOfInterception record when a PTC target or a PTC chat group as a target has an active PTC session in progress. This occurs when the PTC server detects that LI is enabled on a PTC participant or a PTC chat group with an active PTC session.

q_54216.question: What is the purpose of testing the adjacent channel selectivity (ACS) of a Base Station Receiver?
q_54216.ground_truth: The purpose of testing ACS is to verify the ability of the Base Station Receiver to suppress interfering signals in the channels adjacent to the wanted channel.

q_54217.question: What is the test applicability for this test case in NR Power Class 1.5, Power Class 2 and Power Class 3 UE release 16 and forward?
q_54217.ground_truth: This test case applies to all types of UE for NR Power Class 1.5, Power Class 2 and Power Class 3 UE release 16 and forward that supports UL full power transmission (ULFPTx).

q_54218.question: What are the options for the coordination system to be used for requirement definition in terms of spherical coverage?
q_54218.ground_truth: Option-1 is the absolute coordination system, and Option-2 is the relative coordination system (relative to the claimed boresight direction).

q_54219.question: What is the solution for detecting false base stations in HPLMN?
q_54219.ground_truth: This solution can detect false base stations in the HPLMN.

q_54220.question: What is the maximum Time Alignment Error (TAE) allowed for UE with multiple physical antenna ports?
q_54220.ground_truth: The maximum Time Alignment Error (TAE) allowed for UE with multiple physical antenna ports is 130 ns.

q_54221.question: What is the role of the "self" member in the representation containing the list of links to the requested resources in the response body?
q_54221.ground_truth: The "self" member in the representation containing the list of links to the requested resources in the response body is a "link" object that contains the URI of the returned representation.

q_54222.question: What should the UE do when it receives a SERVICE REJECT message with a Control Plane data back-off timer T3448?
q_54222.ground_truth: The UE starts timer T3448 with the received value and performs control plane data transmission on the expiry of timers T3448.

q_54223.question: What is the purpose of adding a Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC) to DCI transmissions and how is it calculated?
q_54223.ground_truth: The purpose of adding a Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC) to DCI transmissions is for error detection. The entire payload is used to calculate the CRC parity bits.

q_54224.question: What is the responsibility of the PIN server?
q_54224.ground_truth: The PIN server is responsible for the authorization of the request of the role of PEMC from a PINE and has a verification procedure with 5GC. It also manages the registration of PINEs and PEGCs in the network.

q_54225.question: How are the characters represented in the languagecode field of the various metadata fields?
q_54225.ground_truth: Each character in the languagecode field of the metadata fields is packed as the difference between its ASCII value and 0x60, making it strictly positive and confined to being three lower-case letters.

q_54226.question: What is the condition for the UE to report CQI index = 0 (out of range) for an SCell in activation delay?
q_54226.ground_truth: The UE shall report CQI index = 0 (out of range) for an SCell in activation delay if the conditions in section 7.7 are not met over the entire SCell activation delay and the conditions for CQI reporting defined in Section 7.2.3 of TS36.213 are not met.

q_54227.question: What are the two AVPs that can be included in the Trace-Info and what is the purpose of each one?
q_54227.ground_truth: The two AVPs that can be included in the Trace-Info are Trace-Data and Trace-Reference. The Trace-Data AVP is used when trace activation is needed, while the Trace-Reference is used to signal trace deactivation.

q_54228.question: When is the Requested Party's Identity field included in the Floor Queue Request message?
q_54228.ground_truth: The Requested Party's Identity field is included in the Floor Queue Request message only when the message is originated by a floor participant user to cancel a queued floor request, but it is not included if the message is originated by the floor control server due to local policies.

q_54229.question: What should not be implemented using the private message mechanism for non-standard use?
q_54229.ground_truth: Basic functionality should not be implemented using the private message mechanism for non-standard use; it should be standardized.

q_54230.question: What does EPS security context mean in the context of 3GPP TS 33.401?
q_54230.ground_truth: EPS security context is a synonym for EPS NAS security context specified in 3GPP TS 33.401.

q_54231.question: In 6.3.2, what exception needs to be considered in step 13 if the construction of SUCI cannot be used?
q_54231.ground_truth: A new type of identifier is used, a hash of the key KTNGF potentially using some additional input, and it is sent using the IDi payload.

q_54232.question: What should the MS do with the stored duplicate value of RPLMN if it has successfully registered to a selected PLMN?
q_54232.ground_truth: The MS should delete the stored duplicate value of RPLMN once it has successfully registered to the selected PLMN.

q_54233.question: What action should be taken if the incoming SIP INVITE request contained an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-location-info+xml MIME body with a <Report> element, as specified in step 7 if, clause 2 if?
q_54233.ground_truth: Copy the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-location-info+xml MIME body from the received SIP INVITE request into the outgoing SIP INVITE request.

q_54234.question: In the context of generating a BSF address, what should be added to the beginning of the domain name if the last two labels of the domain name extracted from the IMPI are not "3gppnetwork.org"?

q_54235.question: Which method is used for SEAL Event Notification in section 7.5.1.3.2 of the document?
q_54235.ground_truth: The POST method is used for SEAL Event Notification in section 7.5.1.3.2 of the document.

q_54236.question: Which parameter is used by the MME (via IWF) and the SGSN to determine whether to invoke extended buffering of downlink packets for High Latency Communication?

q_54237.question: In the context of the ITU-R Radio Regulations, which frequency range is allocated to MSS and identified as the first candidate band for NTN satellite operations?
q_54237.ground_truth: The S-band: UL (1980-2010 MHz)/DL (2170-2200 MHz) and L-band: UL (1626.5-1660.5 MHz)/DL (1525-1559 MHz) are the frequency ranges identified as first candidate bands for NTN satellite operations.

q_54238.question: What is the difference between Non UE-associated services and UE-associated services in S1AP?
q_54238.ground_truth: Non UE-associated services are related to the whole S1 interface instance between the eNB and MME, and use a non UE-associated signalling connection. UE-associated services, on the other hand, are related to one UE, and are provided through a UE-associated signalling connection that is maintained for that UE.

q_54239.question: What are the two main approaches for addressing transcoding issues in AR glass media content provision?
q_54239.ground_truth: The two main approaches are using a Layer-2 or Layer-3 relay and raw format adaptation.

q_54240.question: How long does it take for the lower layer to recognize a TAI change?
q_54240.ground_truth: The lower layer might take some time to read the system information and determine if the current TAI is changed.

q_54241.question: What type of location information does the eNB report upon a request for location reporting control in E-UTRAN?
q_54241.ground_truth: The eNB reports E-UTRAN CGI and TAI, or E-UTRAN CGI, PSCell and TAI when a request for location reporting control is made in E-UTRAN.

q_54242.question: What protocol runs over UDP, which is not understood to be well-behaved, causing potential impediments to HTTP/3 deployment?

q_54243.question: What is one of the security mechanisms that the UE must support for security-client, and which RFC specifies the security mechanism?
q_54243.ground_truth: The UE must support the "ipsec-3gpp" security mechanism, as specified in RFC~3329.

q_54244.question: How does the test system measure the power of PUSCH transmissions to verify the UE relative power control meet test requirements?
q_54244.ground_truth: The power of PUSCH transmissions is measured in sub-frames, excluding transient periods between sub-frames. The measurement should satisfy the test requirements specified in clauses 6.3.4.3.5 and meet the power transient requirements between sub-frames.

q_54245.question: What is the effect of setting the value of an indicator to zero in the Indicator Control command?
q_54245.ground_truth: Setting the value of an indicator to zero in the Indicator Control command turns the indicator off.

q_54246.question: What functions are performed in the user plane for E-UTRAN?
q_54246.ground_truth: The user plane for E-UTRAN performs functions such as header compression, ciphering, scheduling, ARQ and HARQ.

q_54247.question: What factors determine the electric field intensity in a quiet zone when a feed antenna is located near a focal point?
q_54247.ground_truth: The electric field intensity in a quiet zone is determined by two factors: the antenna pattern of the feed antenna for a test equipment, and the shape of the reflector, especially the antenna pattern which is the main factor.

q_54248.question: What is the purpose of the failure message after DUIK in 5G ProSe direct discovery?
q_54248.ground_truth: The purpose of the failure message after DUIK in 5G ProSe direct discovery is for integrity check and malformed contents.

q_54249.question: What is one of the channel and message types used in link budget evaluations for coverage impact assessment in Rel-17 RedCap SI?
q_54249.ground_truth: PBCH, PDCCH CSS, and SIB1 are the primary channels and messages used, while PDCCH USS, PRACH, Msg2, Msg3, Msg4, PDSCH, PUCCH, and PUSCH can also be included by sourcing companies.

q_54250.question: What is the size of the BIT STRING used for the AbsoluteTimeInfo-r10 in the ASN.1 definition?
q_54250.ground_truth: The size of the BIT STRING used for the AbsoluteTimeInfo-r10 in the ASN.1 definition is 48.

q_54251.question: What should the NF service consumer send as a response if it determines that the received HTTP POST request needs to be redirected?
q_54251.ground_truth: The NF service consumer shall send an HTTP redirect response as specified in clause 6.10.9 of 3GPP TS 29.500.

q_54252.question: In what situations should the NG-RAN node consider the Reroute NAS Request procedure as failed as specified in 3GPP TS 23.502?
q_54252.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node shall consider the Reroute NAS Request procedure as failed if the total number of S-NSSAIs included in the Allowed NSSAI and Partially Allowed NSSAI exceeds eight or if any of the S-NSSAI which is present in the Partially Allowed NSSAI IE is also present in the Allowed NSSAI IE.

q_54253.question: What response should be returned by the AMF on success, if no additional information needs to be included in the response?

q_54254.question: What are the four functions that the AS shall implement if no authentication proxy is present in the 3GPP system?
q_54254.ground_truth: The AS shall implement the role of a network application function, TLS with the specified TLS profile, HTTP digest authentication, and support certificate authentication.

q_54255.question: What procedure is used by the en-gNB to request a connected eNB to provide UE Radio Capability information that maps to a specific UE Radio Capability ID?

q_54256.question: What information is included in the request when the target NF is SMF or PCF?
q_54256.ground_truth: If the target NF is SMF or PCF, the request may include the MA PDU Session capability, DNN replacement capability, slice replacement capability, 5G ProSe Capability, or V2X capability as specified in relevant TS documents.

q_54257.question: Who is responsible for generating the "UE analytics profile" in the HPLMN?
q_54257.ground_truth: The H-NWDAF generates the "UE analytics profile" in the HPLMN.

q_54258.question: What is the function of the PCRF in roaming scenarios?
q_54258.ground_truth: In roaming scenarios, the PCRF acts as a vPCRF for the scenario of roaming with home-routed traffic and terminates the Gxa, Gxb, Gxc, and S9 reference points. The vPCRF also terminates the Gx reference point for roaming with home-routed traffic.

q_54259.question: What happens to the cumulative event report timer and user plane event reports count when the LMF changes during the procedure?
q_54259.ground_truth: When the LMF changes during the procedure, the cumulative event report timer and the count of user plane event reports are restarted, and a cumulative event report is sent to the H-GMLC and LCS Client or AF by the new LMF.

q_54260.question: What action should be taken if the participating MCPTT function cannot find a binding between the public user identity and an MCPTT ID or the validity period of an existing binding has expired upon receipt of a SIP MESSAGE request for emergency notification?
q_54260.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT function shall reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 404 (Not Found) response and the warning text set to "141 user unknown to the participating function".

q_54261.question: In which circumstances should the SMF include the "sessRuleReports" attribute in the response message when rejecting the request for session rule installation?
q_54261.ground_truth: The SMF should include this attribute in the response message when the validation of all the received session rules was unsuccessful and it needs to report the failure for the affected session rule(s) within the ErrorReport data structure.

q_54262.question: What is the purpose of providing ID of redundant communication path?
q_54262.ground_truth: The purpose of providing ID of redundant communication path is to allow NG-RAN to realize redundancy handling between the two PDU sessions when establishing PDU sessions in step 6.

q_54263.question: What condition should be met for the NAS SMC with the victim UE to fail in this procedure?
q_54263.ground_truth: The NAS keys in the AMF and in the victim UE are different.

q_54264.question: When should the UE store the new T3447 value in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message?
q_54264.ground_truth: The UE should store the new T3447 value if the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message contains the T3447 value IE.

q_54265.question: What action should the SMF take when the network slice is not available for an active PDU session?
q_54265.ground_truth: The SMF should request the RAN (Radio Access Network) to release associated resources for the PDU session, and no NAS (Non-Access Stratum) signaling should be sent to the UE (User Equipment) for the PDU session release in this procedure.

q_54266.question: What is the requirement for NCR-MT type 2-O in terms of frequency error as specified in clause 9.6.1.2.3 in TS 38.174?
q_54266.ground_truth: The requirements specified in clause 9.6.1.2.3 in TS 38.174 apply for NCR-MT type 2-O in terms of frequency error.

q_54267.question: In the context of 5G Network Management Framework, what does the tenant information concept aim to support?
q_54267.ground_truth: The tenant information concept aims to support multiple tenant environments in 5G network management, allowing the association of services with the tenant and controlling the tenant's access to management capabilities.

q_54268.question: What is the difference between the 3GPP specification event A4 and event A5?
q_54268.ground_truth: In event A4, the entering condition for the event is satisfied when the neighbor becomes better than the threshold (Mn + Ofn + Ocn - Hys > Thresh) condition. In event A5, the entering condition for the event is satisfied when both the PCell/PSCell becomes worse than threshold1 (Mp + Hys < Thresh1) and the neighbor becomes better than threshold2 (Mn + Ofn + Ocn - Hys > Thresh2).

q_54269.question: What should be the state of the UE before starting the test?
q_54269.ground_truth: The UE is connected to Cell 1 (PCell) on radio channel 1 (PCC) but is not aware of Cell 2 on radio channel 2. The UE is only monitoring the PCC.

q_54270.question: In which scenarios should the MS stop the timer T3396 upon receipt of the MODIFY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message?
q_54270.ground_truth: The MS shall stop the timer T3396 if it is running for the APN sent by the MS in the case of a non-emergency PDN connection, and for any case if the MODIFY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message was received for an emergency PDN connection.

q_54271.question: What should the network do if it receives a DETACH REQUEST message during an ongoing identification procedure, and the Detach type IE contains the cause "switch off"?
q_54271.ground_truth: The network should abort the identification procedure and progress the detach procedure.

q_54272.question: What is the format of the request URIs used in HTTP requests from the NF service consumer towards the NF service producer?
q_54272.ground_truth: The request URIs used in HTTP requests from the NF service consumer towards the NF service producer have the Resource URI structure defined in clause 4.4.1 of 3GPP TS 29.501.

q_54273.question: What are the three main SID standards used for defining the connection groups in the described solution?

q_54274.question: What information is transmitted by means of the DCI format 1A?
q_54274.ground_truth: The following information is transmitted by means of the DCI format 1A: Carrier indicator (0 or 3 bits), Flag for format0/format1A differentiation (1 bit), Localized/Distributed VRB assignment flag (1 bit), Resource block assignment (bits), Preamble Index (6 bits), PRACH Mask Index (4 bits), and all the remaining bits in format 1A for compact scheduling assignment of one PDSCH codeword are set to zero.

q_54275.question: What is the primary difference between ATC6 and ANTC6, as per subclause 4.11.2.10 and 4.11.2.10.3?
q_54275.ground_truth: For ATC6, the power allocated per carrier for the RAT on which modulation quality is measured is the highest possible, while maintaining the total power as per case a. In contrast, for ANTC6, the power allocated per carrier for the RAT on which modulation quality is measured is the highest possible, even if it is higher than the level defined by case a.

q_54276.question: What are the services and functions provided by the RLC sublayer for sidelink communication in NR?
q_54276.ground_truth: The services and functions of the RLC sublayer as specified in clause 6.3.2 are supported for sidelink in NR with some restrictions, such as using TM for SBCCH, using UM and AM in unicast transmission, and using only UM in groupcast or broadcast transmission.

q_54277.question: What parameter specifies a particular secondary or non-secondary PDP context definition or Traffic Flows definition in the mentioned passage?
q_54277.ground_truth: The parameter '<cid<specifies a particular secondary or non-secondary PDP context definition or Traffic Flows definition in the mentioned passage.

q_54278.question: What is the maximum amount of change in the uplink timing in one adjustment for a UE in NR RedCap?
q_54278.ground_truth: The maximum amount of the magnitude of the timing change in one adjustment is Tq.

q_54279.question: What are the applicable UE category requirements for this test?
q_54279.ground_truth: The test applies to all types of E-UTRA HD-FDD BL/CE UE release 13 and forward of UE category M1 and higher that support CE Mode A.

q_54280.question: How does hands-free access help companies manage sensitive areas?
q_54280.ground_truth: Hands-free access helps companies manage sensitive areas by implementing ranging procedures, which can restrict or grant entry based on the user's privileges. When the unlocking device provides the necessary credentials to the door, the door checks its validation, either through local cache or a remote database. This ensures that unauthorized personnel cannot enter restricted areas.

q_54281.question: What is the requirement for the Tidentify-GERAN in the test to meet the RRC connection release with redirection to GERAN requirements in the test?
q_54281.ground_truth: It shall be less than 1 second.

q_54282.question: What action performed by the PTC server will trigger the generation of a TBCP Talk Burst Granted message?
q_54282.ground_truth: The PTC server will send a TBCP Talk Burst Granted message when the PTC target is granted permission to start media transmission.

q_54283.question: What should be used as the destination address for an on-network group emergency alert, if the "entry-info" attribute has the value of 'DedicatedGroup'?
q_54283.ground_truth: The value in the <uri-entry> element within the <entry> element of the <EmergencyAlert> element should be used as the destination address for an on-network group emergency alert.

q_54284.question: Who is responsible for deciding whether a requirement is mandatory and under what circumstances it applies?
q_54284.ground_truth: The decision of whether a requirement is mandatory and under what circumstances it applies is set by local or regional regulation, not in the present document.

q_54285.question: What is the purpose of starting timer T5091 in the 5G ProSe direct link re-keying procedure?
q_54285.ground_truth: The purpose of starting timer T5091 is to ensure successful 5G ProSe direct link re-keying, and it should be set to a value larger than the sum of T5092 and T5089. The initiating UE should not send a new PROSE DIRECT LINK REKEYING REQUEST message to the same target UE while timer T5091 is running.

q_54286.question: How does a user add a new PIN Element to the PIN?
q_54286.ground_truth: A user can add a new PIN Element to the PIN by placing it within 2 meters of the PIN Element with Management Capabilities for initial communication, then allowing it to communicate with other PIN Elements in the PIN using relays.

q_54287.question: When is the eNB CP Relocation Indication procedure initiated in LTE?
q_54287.ground_truth: This procedure is initiated to request the MME to authenticate the UE's re-establishment request and establish the UE-associated logical S1-connection after the UE has initiated a RRC Re-establishment procedure in an eNB.

q_54288.question: What is the cell re-selection delay test requirement in the test case described in 4.4.1.5?
q_54288.ground_truth: The cell re-selection delay shall be less than a total of 27.9 seconds (26 seconds for TmeasureGSM and 1.9 seconds for TBCCH).

q_54289.question: What should the controlling MCPTT function do if the procedures of clause 11.1.6.4.1 were not successful in inviting the MCPTT user listed in the application/resource-lists+xml MIME body of the received SIP INVITE request?
q_54289.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function shall reject the received SIP INVITE request with a SIP 480 (Temporarily Unavailable) response and skip the remaining procedures of the present clause.

q_54290.question: What is the action taken when there is no available resource left in the resources indicated by the physical layer for more transmission opportunities?
q_54290.ground_truth: Consider the set as the selected sidelink grant when there is no available resource left in the resources indicated by the physical layer for more transmission opportunities.

q_54291.question: What information must be included in every xIRI from the IRI-POI present in the AAnF?
q_54291.ground_truth: Target identity, additional identities associated with the target (if present), time stamp, and correlation information.

q_54292.question: Regarding the transfer of CSFB to 1x parameters, what action does the UE take upon receiving the CSFBParametersResponseCDMA2000 message?
q_54292.ground_truth: The UE forwards the rand and the mobilityParameters to the CDMA2000 1xRTT upper layers.

q_54293.question: What data type is specified for the element "ProSe-Application-Code-Prefix"?
q_54293.ground_truth: The data type specified for the element "ProSe-Application-Code-Prefix" is xs:hexBinary.

q_54294.question: When should the IP address used by the UE be reported in the xIRI?
q_54294.ground_truth: When the access type is non-3GPP.

q_54295.question: What are the defined satellite NG-RAN RAT types in 3GPP TS 38.413?
q_54295.ground_truth: The defined satellite NG-RAN RAT types in 3GPP TS 38.413 are "NR(LEO)", "NR(MEO)", and "NR(GEO)".

q_54296.question: What is the message sent by the gNB-CU to the AMF to indicate the failure of resource allocation for the handover from EPS to 5GS?

q_54297.question: What is the minimum requirement for single RAT UTRA operation in terms of AAS BS receiver spurious emissions requirements?
q_54297.ground_truth: For a single RAT UTRA AAS BS, the power sum of emissions at the TAB connectors of the TAB connector RX min cell group shall not exceed an AAS BS limit specified as the basic limit + X, where X = 10log10(NRXU,countedpercell), unless stated differently in regional regulation.

q_54298.question: What should be done for each serving or neighbouring cell in step 4, if the UE reports results for that cell?
q_54298.ground_truth: The measResultRS-IndexList should be set to include available results of up to maxReportRS-Index beams, ordered based on the quantity determined as specified.

q_54299.question: What network function is used to collect data related to a specific network slice?

q_54300.question: What is the overall delays measured test requirement?
q_54300.ground_truth: The overall delays measured shall be less than a total of 25602 ms in this test case (note: this gives a total of 25.6s for measurement reporting delay plus 2 ms for TTI insertion uncertainty).

q_54301.question: What is the role of the AF in the 5G system for AI/ML operation?
q_54301.ground_truth: The AF negotiates for split inference, collects data from AI/ML processing entities, exposes the collected data to NWDAF, and produces AI/ML assistance information based on the analytics results from NWDAF and the system environmental factors.

q_54302.question: What should the MME do if it receives a SGsAP-PAGING-REQUEST message in the SGs-NULL state, and the "MME-Reset" restoration indicator is set to true?
q_54302.ground_truth: The MME shall accept the SGsAP-PAGING-REQUEST message in this case.

q_54303.question: What is a key challenge in using DNS resolution to launch a 3GPP service?
q_54303.ground_truth: The key challenge is that the URL does not use the HTTP scheme and hence is not supported by the Android intent filter mechanism. A dedicated DNS query would have to be implemented for this approach to work.

q_54304.question: What does the term "ancillary equipment" refer to in the context of the document?
q_54304.ground_truth: Ancillary equipment refers to equipment that is used in conjunction with a receiver, transmitter or transceiver to provide additional operational and/or control features, but cannot be used on a stand-alone basis to provide user functions independently of a receiver, transmitter or transceiver.

q_54305.question: What is the default relationship between the mobile reachable timer and the value of timer T3512 when the UE is not registered for emergency services?
q_54305.ground_truth: By default, the mobile reachable timer is 4 minutes greater than the value of timer T3512.

q_54306.question: What is the maximum value for Reserved-Slots and how long is the schedule period length associated with this value?
q_54306.ground_truth: The maximum value for Reserved-Slots is 40. This value indicates that the number of slots marked as "free slots reading advised" in the schedule message is reserved in a DRX schedule period for incoming high priority CBS messages, not scheduled in the current schedule period. The schedule period length associated with this value is 40.

q_54307.question: In what mode is the UE when it has downlink user data pending over non-3GPP access and is in 5GMM-IDLE mode over non-3GPP access?
q_54307.ground_truth: The UE is in 5GMM-IDLE mode over non-3GPP access.

q_54308.question: What is the subject of the document "Application of the NG Application Protocol (NGAP) to non-3GPP access (Release 18)"?
q_54308.ground_truth: The document describes the applicability of NGAP messages and procedures to non-3GPP access.

q_54309.question: What is the measurement time for a single PRS positioning occasion, which includes the sampling time and the processing time?
q_54309.ground_truth: The measurement time for a single PRS positioning occasion is ms.

q_54310.question: What are the two main differences between LTE-V2X and NR-V2X in terms of SLSS IDs?
q_54310.ground_truth: The two main differences between LTE-V2X and NR-V2X in terms of SLSS IDs are that NR-V2X has 672 SLSS IDs, divided into 336 IDs for in-coverage indication and 336 IDs for out-of-coverage indication. Additionally, the special SLSS IDs of 0, 336, and 337 in NR-V2X are used equivalently to 0, 168, and 169 respectively in LTE-V2X.

q_54311.question: What action is taken by the SS if a potential interruption is not carried out in the correct time span during activation of SCell?
q_54311.ground_truth: The test equipment verifies that potential interruption is carried out in the correct time span by monitoring ACK/NACK sent in PSCell during activation of SCell.

q_54312.question: What length/type value does the UPF use to create the Ethernet frame when sending a PMFP message?
q_54312.ground_truth: The UPF sets the length/type field of the Ethernet frame to the ethertype value included in the measurement assistance information provided to the UE.

q_54313.question: What is the maximum ratio of the number of measurement gap where measurement object i is a candidate to be measured over the number of measurement gap where measurement object i is a candidate and not used for a long-periodicity measurement defined above, represented by Ri?
q_54313.ground_truth: Ri represents the maximal ratio of the number of measurement gap where measurement object i is a candidate to be measured over the number of measurement gap where measurement object i is a candidate and not used for a long-periodicity measurement defined above.

q_54314.question: What information does the MME/SGSN include in the Delete SCEF Connection Response message?
q_54314.ground_truth: The MME/SGSN includes User Identity, EPS Bearer Identity, SCEF ID, and APN in the Delete SCEF Connection Response message.

q_54315.question: What is the role of Redundant Transmission Experience analytics in determining the activation or deactivation of redundant transmission for a PDU session of URLLC?
q_54315.ground_truth: SMF may use Redundant Transmission Experience analytics provided by NWDAF to determine whether redundant transmission for the PDU session of URLLC shall be performed or (if activated) shall be stopped.

q_54316.question: What should the gNB-DU do if the QoS Flow Mapping Indication IE is included in the DRB To Be Setup List IE for a QoS flow?
q_54316.ground_truth: The gNB-DU may take it into account that only the uplink or downlink QoS flow is mapped to the indicated DRB.

q_54317.question: What is a function of the Network Slice Selection Function (NSSF) in the 5G System?
q_54317.ground_truth: The Network Slice Selection Function (NSSF) in the 5G System is responsible for triggering the selection of the set of Network Slice instances for a UE, which can lead to a change of AMF.

q_54318.question: What is the significance of the notation "Equal priorities between RATs are not supported"?
q_54318.ground_truth: This notation means that the network cannot assign equal priority levels to different radio access technologies (RATs).

q_54319.question: When should the RE-NWDAF mute the event notification and store the available events if the "notifFlag" attribute is set to "DEACTIVATE"?
q_54319.ground_truth: When the "notifFlag" attribute is included and set to "DEACTIVATE" in the request, the RE-NWDAF shall mute the event notification and store the available events until the NF service consumer requests to retrieve them or until a muting exception occurs.

q_54320.question: What is the access system used in the described use case for the energy utility network?
q_54320.ground_truth: The access system used in the described use case for the energy utility network is 3GPP access.

q_54321.question: What is the method for resuming suspended bearers in the S-GW and P-GW after an emergency services session handover is complete?
q_54321.ground_truth: Implicit resume using the Modify Bearer request message is triggered by the procedure in operation, e.g. RAU, TAU, or Service Request. The S-GW, aware of the suspend state, forwards the Modify Bearer request to the P-GW. If not triggered, explicit resume using the Resume Notification message should be used.

q_54322.question: What should the MCPTT server do with the served list of the functional alias information entries in clause 9A.2.2.2.3.1?
q_54322.ground_truth: The MCPTT server should replace the served list of functional alias information entries stored in the served MCPTT user information entry with the candidate list of the functional alias information entries in clause 9A.2.2.2.3.1.

q_54323.question: What should the SMF do when it receives a revalidation time value from the PCF within the "revalidationTime" attribute?
q_54323.ground_truth: The SMF shall start the timer for revalidation based on the received value of revalidation time if the revalidation function is not disabled.

q_54324.question: What does the timer T4005 indicate in the ProSe direct discovery service authorization from the ProSe Function of the HPLMN?
q_54324.ground_truth: The timer T4005 indicates for how long the authorisation policy for a certain operation is valid in a specific PLMN.

q_54325.question: What should the UE do upon initiating the connection establishment procedure for mobile originating signalling if SystemInformationBlockType2 includes ac-BarringForMO-Signalling and the UE has valid Access Classes with at least one corresponding bit in ac-BarringForSpecialAC set to zero in ac-BarringForMO-Signalling?
q_54325.ground_truth: Consider access to the cell as not barred.

q_54326.question: What is the purpose of defining measurement communities in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_54326.ground_truth: Measurement communities are defined to identify the end-users of system measurements. This ensures that measurements are defined to address the needs of various user groups, such as network operators, equipment vendors, and traffic engineers.

q_54327.question: What is the normative reference for the active accuracy requirements?
q_54327.ground_truth: The normative reference for active accuracy requirements is 3GPP TS 36.133, clause 9.1.2.4, clause 9.1.4, and A.9.1.10.

q_54328.question: What is the mean UL Average-UPT gain provided by the semi-static SBFD for operator 2 at a medium load level?
q_54328.ground_truth: The mean UL Average-UPT gain provided by the semi-static SBFD for operator 2 at a medium load level is 118.16%.

q_54329.question: What must the 5GMM entity in the AMF not provide during an active emergency PDU session when the UE is trying to access 5GS via CAG cells?
q_54329.ground_truth: The 5GMM entity in the AMF must not provide the "allowed CAG list" and an "indication that the UE is only allowed to access 5GS via CAG cells" for the current PLMN or per equivalent PLMN, even if available.

q_54330.question: What is the responsibility of the UDM when a user moves from EPC to 5GC?
q_54330.ground_truth: The UDM should check for any authentication result stored in the UDM. If there is no authentication result, it should send a notification to the AMF with SUPI and the "re-authentication required" flag set to true.

q_54331.question: What type of data is defined in clause 8.6.5.3 of the document?

q_54332.question: What is the measurement reporting delay excluding in the delay uncertainty resulted from inserting the measurement report to the uplink DCCH?
q_54332.ground_truth: The delay uncertainty is 2 x TTIDCCH.

q_54333.question: What should the UE do if both the WLAN selected and the UE support ANQP and the UE did not obtain a list of realms using ANQP in clause 5.3.2.3 item 1?
q_54333.ground_truth: The UE shall send an ANQP request for a list of realms, PLMN identities, or both.

q_54334.question: What should be done when a downlink assignment for this TTI has been received for this Serving Cell on the PDCCH for the MAC entity's Semi-Persistent Scheduling C-RNTI, and the NDI in the received HARQ information is 1?
q_54334.ground_truth: The NDI is considered not to have been toggled, and the associated HARQ information is delivered to the HARQ entity for this TTI.

q_54335.question: What should a participating MCPTT function do if it is not authorized to make a private call transfer request?
q_54335.ground_truth: It should reject the SIP REFER request for originating participating MCPTT function with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response, as specified in clause 10d.

q_54336.question: When is the number of bits used for the second SRS resource indicator equal to 0?
q_54336.ground_truth: The number of bits used for the second SRS resource indicator is equal to 0 when SRS resource set indicator field is not present.

q_54337.question: What should the UE do if it receives a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message during the UE-requested PDU session release procedure, and the PDU session indicated in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message is the same as the PDU session requested to be released?
q_54337.ground_truth: The UE shall ignore the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message and proceed with the PDU session release procedure.

q_54338.question: What are the two cause values that the PC5 signalling protocol cause IE in a DIRECT LINK IDENTIFIER UPDATE REJECT message can be set to?
q_54338.ground_truth: The two cause values are #3 (conflict of layer-2 ID for unicast communication is detected) and #111 (protocol error, unspecified).

q_54339.question: What is the root element for the per-user affiliation info in section 8.4.1.2?
q_54339.ground_truth: The root element for the per-user affiliation info is <presence>.

q_54340.question: What should an AS do when sending an initial request for a dialog and privacy is required?
q_54340.ground_truth: The AS should set the display-name of the From header field to "Anonymous" and set the addr-spec of the From header field to "Anonymous User Identity".
