q_54579.ground_truth: If the "Carrier indication of NPRACH" is non-zero, it indicates a NPRACH carrier derived from SystemInformationBlockType22-NB, where the index in the list is equal to the carrier indication.

q_54580.question: What should a network do if it receives an ACTIVATE SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message with a bearer control mode violation?
q_54580.ground_truth: Network should respond with an ACTIVATE SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT REJECT message containing cause code #48 to indicate the violation.

q_54581.question: What information can be retrieved from the Direct Communication Request message in step 4a if the Target User Info is not included?
q_54581.ground_truth: If the Target User Info is not included in the Direct Communication Request message, the UEs that are interested in using the announced A2X service type(s) over a PC5 unicast link with UAV1 respond by establishing the security with the UAV1.

q_54582.question: When establishing an MA PDU session of Ethernet PDU session type, when does the UE select the MAC address of the PMF in the UE?
q_54582.ground_truth: The UE selects the MAC address of the PMF in the UE upon establishment of an MA PDU session of Ethernet PDU session type and uses the same MAC address till release of the MA PDU session.

q_54583.question: What does the storedGnbID in VarGnbID-r18 represent?
q_54583.ground_truth: The storedGnbID in VarGnbID-r18 represents the current value of GnbID received as the value of gNB-ID-Length leftmost bits of the 36-bit long cellIdentity in the first PLMN-IdentityInfo IE of PLMN-IdentityInfoList in SIB1.

q_54584.question: What is the role of LMISF-IRI in the VPLMN with home-routed roaming for HR LI?
q_54584.ground_truth: LMISF-IRI is responsible for target-based interception of IMS services in the VPLMN with home-routed roaming for HR LI.

q_54585.question: What happens if the VPLMN does not provide the Transit and Roaming Function address with which the HPLMN steers the selection of the Transit and Roaming Function?
q_54585.ground_truth: If the VPLMN does not provide the Transit and Roaming Function address, the HPLMN will use the default derived address for the VPLMN.

q_54586.question: Which security requirement is required both inside and outside 3GPP to increase assurance that the virtualization platform prevents one function from inspecting the memory of other functions?

q_54587.question: What is the purpose of the time window in Scenario #1 for the End UE's announcement?
q_54587.ground_truth: The time window indicates when the End UE should send its announcement to the Relay for inclusion in the next Relay announcement.

q_54588.question: What are the Transmit intermodulation requirements for each component carrier in EN-DC with Tx Diversity and DC with Tx Diversity within FR1?
q_54588.ground_truth: The transmit intermodulation requirement specified in clauses 6.7.1 of TS 36.101 and clauses 6.5G.4 of TS 38.101-1 apply for each component carrier in E-UTRA bands and NR bands, respectively.

q_54589.question: Which data type represents User management openness in GSMA NG.116?
q_54589.ground_truth: The data type "UserMgmtOpen<dataType>" represents User management openness in GSMA NG.116.

q_54590.question: Which release of the specification introduced the "multipleUplinkSPS-r14" parameter?
q_54590.ground_truth: This parameter was introduced in Release 14 of the specification.

q_54591.question: What should the UE do when it needs a service provided by a slice that is not available in the current visited PLMN during registration in a roaming case?
q_54591.ground_truth: The UE may send expected S-NSSAIs as a container.

q_54592.question: What is the difference in reporting methods between PerfMetricJob and TraceJob for file-based reporting?
q_54592.ground_truth: The reporting methods differ in terms of the specified reporting periods and the location where the files shall be stored. In the case of TraceJob, the UE indicates availability of MDT measurement results when it goes to RRC CONNECTED mode.

q_54593.question: Which key issue do solutions #5.3 and #5.4 address in the context of finding the correct CHF for 5G data connectivity usage charges?
q_54593.ground_truth: Solutions #5.3 and #5.4 address key issue #5d, which deals with finding the correct CHF for 5G data connectivity usage charges.

q_54594.question: What is the effect of NAS key re-keying or NAS key refresh on the current running procedure when the UE is registered over both 3GPP and non-3GPP accesses and is in CM-CONNECTED state on one of the accesses?
q_54594.ground_truth: The new NAS security context will only be activated over the access where the re-keying or refresh took place. The NAS security context in use on the other access will not be changed. To activate the new NAS security context over the other access, a second NAS SMC run needs to be triggered either in the current running procedure or a subsequent NAS procedure.

q_54595.question: What is the purpose of providing "Abstract activation steps" when activating AI/ML inference capabilities for an ML entity or an inference function?
q_54595.ground_truth: The purpose of providing "Abstract activation steps" is to ensure that AI/ML inference capabilities of an ML entity or an inference function being activated in an operational system will bring the expected/planned benefits and will not further downgrade the existing network performance.

q_54596.question: What should be the value of the "Cause Type" field when coding the F-Cause field for RANAP Cause in 3GPP TS 36.413 clause 8.2.2?
q_54596.ground_truth: The "Cause Type" field should be ignored by the receiver when coding the F-Cause field for RANAP Cause in 3GPP TS 36.413 clause 8.2.2.

q_54597.question: Who assigns the Source Layer-2 ID for the 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-UE Relay when establishing a PC5 link for IP traffic?
q_54597.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-UE Relay assigns the Source Layer-2 ID for itself when establishing a PC5 link for IP traffic.

q_54598.question: What should the MCData Notification server do after successfully processing an HTTP POST request for a PULL notification delivery method from the Message notification client?
q_54598.ground_truth: After successfully processing an HTTP POST request for a PULL notification delivery method from the Message notification client, the MCData Notification server should send the notification towards the Message notification client using the channelURL received from the MCData Notification server during the channel creation procedure and in the request message.

q_54599.question: What is the format of the "UEContextModificationRefuseIEs" in the "UEContextModificationRefuse" sequence?
q_54599.ground_truth: The "UEContextModificationRefuseIEs" in the "UEContextModificationRefuse" sequence is a choice of different IEs, where each IE has an ID, criticality, type, presence, and an optional field for additional information.

q_54600.question: What is the maximum allowed rate of ACK/NACK feedback loss on any non-dormant serving cell when the UE performs CQI measurements on dormant SCells?
q_54600.ground_truth: The rate of ACK/NACK feedback loss on any non-dormant serving cell resulting from CQI measurements on dormant SCells shall not exceed 0.5%.

q_54601.question: Who acts as a B2BUA when performing IMS-ALG functionality in the IBCF?
q_54601.ground_truth: The IBCF acts as a B2BUA when it performs IMS-ALG functionality.

q_54602.question: What are the two interfaces used for calculating DL PDCP SDU Data Volume in the 5G network?
q_54602.ground_truth: The two interfaces used are X2 and Xn interfaces.

q_54603.question: What information does the Serving PLMN S-NSSAIs list contain when requested?
q_54603.ground_truth: The Serving PLMN S-NSSAIs list contains a list of PLMN S-NSSAIs with or without S-NSSAI mapping information when requested.

q_54604.question: In what frequency range is the g type set to Type A or Type B, as defined in clause 7.4.1.1.2 of TS 38.211?
q_54604.ground_truth: The g type is set to Type A or Type B in the frequency range above 6 GHz.

q_54605.question: What action does an MCVideo client take upon receiving an authorised request to cancel an in-progress emergency group state of a group from a third-party?
q_54605.ground_truth: The MCVideo client generates a SIP re-INVITE request with a specific MIME body and sets the MCVideo emergency group state to "cancel-pending".

q_54606.question: In the context of 3GPP TS 23.540, what is the RoutingInfo service operation used for?
q_54606.ground_truth: The RoutingInfo service operation is used in the procedures for successful and unsuccessful Mobile Terminated short message transfer via IP-SM-GW, and is used to provide and update routing information by the NF Service Consumer (e.g. UDM) and IP-SM-GW.

q_54607.question: What are the typical transport protocols used for streaming media applications?

q_54608.question: What message must the NG-RAN node include the User Location Information IE in, if supported?
q_54608.ground_truth: The PDU SESSION RESOURCE SETUP RESPONSE message

q_54609.question: What does the Transmission Stop Indicator IE indicate?
q_54609.ground_truth: The Transmission Stop Indicator IE indicates to stop the data transmission at gNB-DU side for an DRB not subject to DAPS Handover.

q_54610.question: What should the controlling MCVideo function do when it receives a SIP INVITE request for a private call or first-to-answer call with an SDP offer not including a media-level section for media-transmission control entity?
q_54610.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function should consider it as a request for the private call without transmission control or first-to-answer call without transmission control and follow the procedures as specified in clause 10.2.2.4.2.

q_54611.question: What is the implication of the following train further approaching the leading train in terms of communication?
q_54611.ground_truth: As the following train further approaches the leading train, the safe braking distance gets shorter, requiring a connection with short end-to-end latency. At this moment, they seamlessly switch the connection from the on-network to off-network for delicate train control.

q_54612.question: What is the difference between the range and the relative location?
q_54612.ground_truth: A range refers to a straight line distance between the target UE and another UE, such as another target UE, a Located UE or a SL Reference UE. A relative location refers to the location of a target UE relative to a network element or another UE, and the relative location can be in 2 dimensions or 3 dimensions.

q_54613.question: What is the role of the S-EES in the ACR Execution phase if the ACR is self-detected by the S-EAS?
q_54613.ground_truth: If the ACR is self-detected by the S-EAS, the S-EAS requests the S-EES to discover the targets. When the S-EES determines that no relevant EAS is available, it finds out the details of the CAS and provides the details to the S-EAS. After the S-EAS determines to use the CAS, it applies the AF traffic influence with the N6 routing information of the CAS in the 3GPP Core Network (if applicable).

q_54614.question: What is the message type for PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST?

q_54615.question: What does the "SRUDN" bit, when set to '1', indicate in the 3GPP specification?
q_54615.ground_truth: It indicates the presence of Length of Secondary RAT Data Usage Report Transfer and Secondary RAT Data Usage Report Transfer fields.

q_54616.question: What information is included in the PIN server discovery request and response?
q_54616.ground_truth: The PIN server discovery request includes the GPSI, MAC address (if available), and UE location, while the response includes endpoint information of the PIN server, such as URI(s), FQDN(s), and IP address(es)).

q_54617.question: What field carries the range class for a specific proximity request?

q_54618.question: When is the UE authorized to perform the announcing UE procedure for group member discovery?
q_54618.ground_truth: The UE is authorized to perform the announcing UE procedure for group member discovery if it is served by NG-RAN and authorized to perform 5G ProSe direct discovery using the announcing procedure, or if the UE is not served by NG-RAN and meets certain conditions.

q_54619.question: What is the role of UDM in determining user consent in the analytics procedure?
q_54619.ground_truth: UDM helps NWDAF in performing user consent check to determine if the analytics procedure is allowed or not.

q_54620.question: In the 3GPP architecture, what is the function of the LMF?
q_54620.ground_truth: The LMF is responsible for managing the resources required for Ranging based services and sidelink positioning, such as positioning calculation, storage, and retrieval.

q_54621.question: What is the procedure when the network supports user plane CIoT EPS optimizations and S1-U data transfer in the 3GPP TS 24.301?
q_54621.ground_truth: If the network supports user plane CIoT EPS optimization, it shall also support S1-U data transfer.

q_54622.question: Under which conditions can the PCF send a report for packet delay monitoring?
q_54622.ground_truth: The PCF sends a report when the measurement result matches or exceeds the indicated Reporting threshold. However, it does not send subsequent reports during the Minimum waiting time. If measurement results are produced during the Minimum waiting time that match or exceed the indicated Reporting threshold, the PCF sends a report only after the Minimum waiting time is over.

q_54623.question: In 9.10.3.4.1, which clauses should reported CSI-RSRP, CSI-RSRQ, and CSI-SINR measurements meet for periodic reporting?
q_54623.ground_truth: In periodic reporting, the requirements in clauses 10.1.4.2, 10.1.5.2, 10.1.9.2, 10.1.10.2, 10.1.14.2, and 10.1.15.2 must be met.

q_54624.question: What is the purpose of 5G-RG and FN-RG in supporting UE's access to 5GC via W-5GAN or NG-RAN?
q_54624.ground_truth: The 5G-RG and FN-RG provide connectivity for a UE behind the RG to access an N3IWF or TNGF, allowing the RG, W-5GAN and the RG's connectivity via 5GC to support UEs behind the RG as untrusted/trusted Non-3GPP access network.

q_54625.question: In the HPLMN NSAC admission mode, what is the responsibility of the primary NSACF or central NSACF in HPLMN when determining whether the NSAC admission request for a roaming UE is accepted or rejected?
q_54625.ground_truth: In the HPLMN NSAC admission mode, the primary NSACF or central NSACF in HPLMN determines whether the NSAC admission request for a roaming UE is accepted or rejected for both the number of registered UEs or the number of LBO PDU sessions.

q_54626.question: What is the definition of the "WLAN identifier list" in the WLAN offload assistance data unsolicited result code?
q_54626.ground_truth: The WLAN identifier list is a tuple consisting of the SSID, BSSID, and HESSID identifiers, with up to a specified number of entries indicated by "<WLANIdentifierListLength>". If any identifier is not present for a tuple, it will be indicated as an empty string.

q_54627.question: What should a P-CSCF do when it receives, destined for the UE, a request from a UE performing the functions of an external attached network using static mode of operation, and there is no response to the standalone SIP request and its retransmissions?
q_54627.ground_truth: Repeat the actions of the above bullets with a different I-CSCF. If the P-CSCF fails to forward the unknown SIP request to any I-CSCF, it shall send back a 504 (Server Time-Out) response to the UE.

q_54628.question: What is the paging retransmission strategy determined by the AMF for extended DRX length of 10.24s?
q_54628.ground_truth: The AMF determines the Paging Time Window length and a paging retransmission strategy, and executes the retransmission scheme.

q_54629.question: In the case of using SBFD Alt 4 and large packet size for operator 1, what is the mean and 5% DL Average-UPT loss at a high load level?
q_54629.ground_truth: Mean DL Average-UPT loss is -0.14% and 5% DL Average-UPT gain is 3.06%.

q_54630.question: What is the heading of the section defining the services offered by the UAE Server?
q_54630.ground_truth: The heading of the section defining the services offered by the UAE Server is "5 Services offered by the UAE Server".

q_54631.question: What is the first action taken when a QMC job is initiated in LTE?
q_54631.ground_truth: When the application in the serviceType starts, the QMC is initiated in LTE.

q_54632.question: When can the floor control server give an early indication to send RTP media packets to the inviting MCPTT client?
q_54632.ground_truth: The floor control server can give an early indication to send RTP media packets to the inviting MCPTT client when the first unconfirmed indication is received from the invited participating MCPTT function, and the floor server has buffering capabilities for RTP media packets.

q_54633.question: How does the IWF handle identity mapping during exchange of signalling and media messages?
q_54633.ground_truth: The IWF can perform identity mapping between an MCPTT system or MCData system and an LMR system during exchange of signalling and media messages. It can also assign a functional alias to a user in the MC system for mapping to a role-based addressing scheme applicable in the LMR system.

q_54634.question: When should the target eNB store the information in the IMS voice EPS fallback from 5G IE in the Source eNB to Target eNB Transparent Container IE within the HANDOVER REQUEST message?
q_54634.ground_truth: The target eNB should store the information in the IMS voice EPS fallback from 5G IE in the Source eNB to Target eNB Transparent Container IE within the HANDOVER REQUEST message if the UE is handed over from NG-RAN to E-UTRAN due to an IMS voice fallback.

q_54635.question: What is a service-based approach in the context of 5G network slices for mission critical functionalities?
q_54635.ground_truth: A service-based approach refers to utilizing separate 5GS network slices for different mission critical services, such as MCPTT, MCData, MCVideo, and MCIoT. While these services might be operated independently within their respective slices, synchronization between the media of each service still needs to be achieved.

q_54636.question: Which type contains the definition of the priority hierarchy for on-network calls?
q_54636.ground_truth: The type that contains the definition of the priority hierarchy for on-network calls is "on-networkType".

q_54637.question: What is the purpose of the provisioning capability in the external exposure of network capabilities?
q_54637.ground_truth: The Provisioning capability allows external parties to provision information that can be used for the UE in 5GS.

q_54638.question: What are the factors that affect the encoding of UE policies for 5G ProSe direct discovery?
q_54638.ground_truth: The encoding of UE policies for 5G ProSe direct discovery depends on several factors, such as the use of public or private keys, the type of proximity discovery (direct or indirect), and the certificate-based or non-certificate-based discovery method.

q_54639.question: What is the purpose of the C2 direct mode feasibility reporting in the UAS application architecture?
q_54639.ground_truth: The purpose of C2 direct mode feasibility reporting in the UAS application architecture is to provide a mechanism for monitoring and reporting the feasibility of ProSe/PC5 link for C2 communications.

q_54640.question: For which packets/slots does the specification define the maximum of band combinations?
q_54640.ground_truth: The specification defines the maximum of band combinations for 2 midsize to large and 4 to 6 small bandwidths.

q_54641.question: How is the location information obtained from the UE in the case of non-3GPP access when a UE is served by a single PLMN?
q_54641.ground_truth: The LPP protocol in TS~37.355 is used to obtain location information from the UE using the UE Assisted and UE Based Positioning procedure (step 3d). The location information returned by the UE can include information specified in clause~5.3.1.

q_54642.question: What are the two options for RAN nodes to be made aware of a multicast session?
q_54642.ground_truth: Option A: RAN nodes inform their peers serving parts of RAN notification areas of UEs in an MBS session about the MBS session. The peer RAN nodes request assistance information from the CN via shared delivery establishment. Option B: The MB-SMF informs all RAN nodes in a service area of an MBS session via the AMF about the MBS session.

q_54643.question: Which network functions are part of the 5G System architecture?
q_54643.ground_truth: Authentication Server Function (AUSF), Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF), Data Network (DN), Unstructured Data Storage Function (UDSF), Network Exposure Function (NEF), Network Repository Function (NRF), Network Slice Admission Control Function (NSACF), Network Slice Selection Function (NSSF), Policy Control Function (PCF), Session Management Function (SMF), Unified Data Management (UDM), Unified Data Repository (UDR), User Plane Function (UPF), UE radio Capability Management Function (UCMF), Application Function (AF), User Equipment (UE), (Radio) Access Network ((R)AN), 5G-Equipment Identity Register (5G-EIR), Network Data Analytics Function (NWDAF), CHarging Function (CHF), Time Sensitive Networking AF (TSN AF), Time Sensitive Communication and Time Synchronization Function (TSCTSF), Data Collection Coordination Function (DCCF), Analytics Data Repository Function (ADRF), Messaging Framework Adaptor Function (MFAF), Non-Seamless WLAN Offload Function (NSWOF), Edge Application Server Discovery Function (EASDF), Service Communication Proxy (SCP), Security Edge Protection Proxy (SEPP), Non-3GPP InterWorking Function (N3IWF), Trusted Non-3GPP Gateway Function (TNGF), Wireline Access Gateway Function (W-AGF), Trusted WLAN Interworking Function (TWIF)

q_54644.question: What is a UE that communicates with other UEs via a U2U Relay UE called in 3GPP specifications?

q_54645.question: What are the conditions under which the minimum required throughput is verified for the reference sensitivity power level?
q_54645.ground_truth: The minimum required throughput is verified for the reference sensitivity power level under conditions of low signal level, ideal propagation, and no added noise.

q_54646.question: What are the protocols used for the control plane interface between the 5G-AN and the 5G Core (N2)?
q_54646.ground_truth: NG Application Protocol (NG-AP) and Stream Control Transmission Protocol (SCTP)

q_54647.question: What must a UE support if it includes the cch-IM-RefRecTypeA-OneRX-Port field?
q_54647.ground_truth: For DL Category 1bis UE, if this field is present, the UE supports Enhanced downlink control channel interference mitigation Type A receiver for 2 CRS antenna ports with 1 receiver antenna port and Enhanced downlink control channel interference mitigation Type A receiver for 4 CRS antenna ports with 1 receiver antenna port. For DL Category M2 UE, if this field is present, the UE supports Enhanced downlink control channel interference mitigation Type A receiver for 2 CRS antenna ports with 1 receiver antenna port.

q_54648.question: What is the requirement for the <allow-imminent-peril-call> element of the <ruleset> element of the MCVideo user profile document identified by the MCVideo ID of the calling user for an MCVideo imminent peril call request to be considered an authorized request for an MCVideo imminent peril call?
q_54648.ground_truth: The <allow-imminent-peril-call> element of the <ruleset> element of the MCVideo user profile document identified by the MCVideo ID of the calling user must be set to a value other than "true" for an MCVideo imminent peril call request to be considered an authorized request for an MCVideo imminent peril call.

q_54649.question: In which cases must the UE include the Additional information requested IE with the CipherKey bit set in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message, except for cases b) and z)?
q_54649.ground_truth: The UE must include the Additional information requested IE with the CipherKey bit set in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message in cases a), z), and during mobility registration updating if the UE supports ciphered broadcast assistance data.

q_54650.question: What action does the SGSN take when it receives a DL packet for a non-accepted bearer, during Serving GW relocation?
q_54650.ground_truth: The SGSN drops the DL packet and does not send a Downlink Data Notification to the SGSN

q_54651.question: What would be the method for UE associated NRPPa Response message transmission in key issue #2?
q_54651.ground_truth: Two options are being discussed: via local AMF (Solution #4) or via AMF in the public network (Solution #5).

q_54652.question: How many times can the UE retransmit the PROSE DIRECT LINK IDENTITY REQUEST message before aborting the procedure?
q_54652.ground_truth: The maximum number of allowed retransmissions is UE implementation specific.

q_54653.question: What information does the Service Access Information in 5GMS contain?
q_54653.ground_truth: The Service Access Information in 5GMS contains the information needed to use the Dynamic Policy Invokation API, including the sdfMethod indicating the usage of ToS.

q_54654.question: What is the minimum requirement for the Repeater ACRR in sub-clause 6.9.2 in TS~38.106?
q_54654.ground_truth: The minimum requirement is specified in TS~38.106 sub-clause 6.9.2.

q_54655.question: What type is the <phone lock code> defined as in the CMAR command?
q_54655.ground_truth: The <phone lock code> is defined as a string type in the CMAR command.

q_54656.question: What is the maximum allowed time for the RRC procedure delay in the target GERAN cell?
q_54656.ground_truth: The RRC procedure delay in the target GERAN cell shall be less than 110 ms.

q_54657.question: How are PSCCH and PSSCH transmitted in LTE sidelink within a resource pool?
q_54657.ground_truth: For PSSCH, a resource pool is divided into sub-channels in the frequency domain, which are consecutively non-overlapping sets of PRBs in a subframe. PSCCH is defined as lowest pair of PRBs in each subchannel or sequential pairs of PRBs starting at the lowest frequency of the resource pool for PSCCH.

q_54658.question: What action should an NF service consumer take when the "Retry-After" HTTP header field is received with a 403 Forbidden response message, indicating a temporary condition in the network?
q_54658.ground_truth: The NF service consumer shall not send the same service information to the NEF again until the specified retry interval has elapsed.

q_54659.question: What happens after the step 7 in the path switching negotiation procedure between UE#1 and UE#2?
q_54659.ground_truth: After step 7, UE#1 and UE#2 transmit the data of the ProSe services or PC5 QoS flows to the Uu path, and may release the PC5 connection using the existing Layer-2 link release over PC5 reference point.

q_54660.question: What message is sent by the PINE to the PEGC when a PINE wants to leave a PIN?
q_54660.ground_truth: The PIN Management PINE leave from PIN request.

q_54661.question: What action does the UE take when it receives a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message with the reject cause set to "Not authorized for this CSG"?
q_54661.ground_truth: The UE removes the CSG ID from the Allowed CSG list.

q_54662.question: What is the procedure for maximum number distribution among NSACFs?
q_54662.ground_truth: In this solution, there is one centralized NSACF controlling the overall maximum number of UEs and maximum number of PDU Sessions of the S-NSSAI. The distributed NSACF requests the local maximum number from the centralized NSACF. The centralized NSACF may also update the local maximum number to the related NSACFs.

q_54663.question: What is the applicability of the intermodulation characteristics test for category NB1 and NB2 in 3GPP release 17 and forward?
q_54663.ground_truth: This test case applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 17 and forward of category NB1 and NB2 that support satellite access operation.

q_54664.question: What should the AMF do if it does not support the RAN-ID-LIST feature and there is a list of NG-RAN nodes for distributing the MBS related N2 message?
q_54664.ground_truth: If the AMF does not support the RAN-ID-LIST feature, it shall distribute the MBS related N2 message to the list of NG-RAN nodes that have established shared delivery that the AMF stores locally.

q_54665.question: Who can this test specified in step 6.3.3.2.3 apply to?
q_54665.ground_truth: This test specified in step 6.3.3.2.3 applies to all types of NR UE release 15 and forward supporting 4 Rx antenna ports, and all types of EUTRA UE release 15 and forward supporting EN-DC and 4 Rx antenna ports.

q_54666.question: What action should the network take if the requested new TFT is not available for allocation?
q_54666.ground_truth: The network should send a BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REJECT message with ESM cause #60 "bearer handling not supported".

q_54667.question: What is the role of the analytics consumer in determining a location?
q_54667.ground_truth: The analytics consumer, such as LMF, determines a location and can use location accuracy analytics to inquire the accuracy of the determined location.

q_54668.question: What information must the consumer NF include in the request for relative proximity analytics?
q_54668.ground_truth: The consumer NF must indicate the analytics ID, target of analytics reporting (e.g. a UE or a group of UEs), analytics filter information (e.g. S-NSSAI, DNN, Area of Interest, direction of interest, number of UEs to be accounted for relative proximity, and additional attributes like velocity, average speed, orientation, and mobility trajectory), optionally request specific analytics subsets, preferred level of accuracy of the analytics, and the analytics target period.

q_54669.question: What is the purpose of service gap control (SGC) feature?
q_54669.ground_truth: The purpose of service gap control (SGC) feature is to control the frequency UEs can transit from EMM-IDLE mode to EMM-CONNECTED mode.

q_54670.question: What is the condition for the "anyExtType" complex type?
q_54670.ground_truth: The "anyExtType" complex type is a complex type with a sequence that can contain any number of particles that are any elements from any namespace and can be processed with a processing depth of "lax".

q_54671.question: What happens to the NGAP UE-TNLA-binding when the AMF releases it while keeping the UE in CM-CONNECTED state?
q_54671.ground_truth: When the AMF releases the NGAP UE-TNLA-binding while keeping the UE in CM-CONNECTED state, the AMF sends a UE-specific NGAP UE-TNLA binding release message on the current TNL association. The 5G-AN may immediately trigger creation of a new NGAP-UE-TNLA-binding with the same AMF or may leave the NGAP UE association without a binding. In the latter case, the binding is re-created upon the subsequent AN-initiated or AMF-initiated UE-specific N2 signalling. If the AMF releases the NGAP UE-TNLA-binding after AMF unavailable status indication, the 5G-AN re-creates N2AP UE-TNLA-binding for subsequent N2 messages for the given UE.

q_54672.question: What information should the target UE provide along with the initiating UE's layer-2 ID and the target UE's layer-2 ID for unicast communication upon sending the PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message?
q_54672.ground_truth: The target UE provides an indication of deactivation of the PC5 unicast security protection and deletion of security context for the 5G ProSe direct link, if applicable.

q_54673.question: What is the function of solution 11 in addressing sub-key issue #13.5 related to MC data transmission over broadcast and multicast MBS sessions?
q_54673.ground_truth: Solution 11 identifies the required information elements associated with the corresponding procedures for MC data transmission over both broadcast and multicast MBS sessions.

q_54674.question: What should be used as the content type for JSON format in HTTP bodies?
q_54674.ground_truth: The content type for JSON format in HTTP bodies is "application/json".

q_54675.question: What is the role of the UPF in secondary authentication?
q_54675.ground_truth: The UPF forwards the EAP Response/Identity message to the DN AAA Server and establishes an end-to-end connection between the SMF and the external DN-AAA server for EAP exchange.

q_54676.question: How many separate PC5 unicast links are established between a 5G ProSe Layer-2 UE-to-Network Relay and a 5G ProSe Layer-2 Remote UE?
q_54676.ground_truth: A single PC5 unicast link is established between a 5G ProSe Layer-2 UE-to-Network Relay and a 5G ProSe Layer-2 Remote UE.

q_54677.question: What are the procedures for Data Channel establishment in IMS for A2P and P2A scenarios?
q_54677.ground_truth: The procedures involve three phases: bootstrap DC establishment, application acquirement, and application DC establishment, requiring new interfaces and functions such as DC Server, DC Control Function, and DC Media Function.

q_54678.question: What state does the MCVideo client enter when the stored current call type is set to "BASIC GROUP CALL" and a specific event occurs?
q_54678.ground_truth: The MCVideo client enters the "T2: in-progress basic group call" state.

q_54679.question: What is the role of RFC 9297 in the HTTP/3 protocol?
q_54679.ground_truth: RFC 9297 provides support for HTTP datagrams in the HTTP/3 protocol.

q_54680.question: What is the minimum number of layers that must be supported for downlink spatial multiplexing in all bands?

q_54681.question: Which protocol stack is used by the 5G ProSe Layer-2 UE-to-Network Relay for the control plane connection between the 5G ProSe Layer-2 UE and NG-RAN?
q_54681.ground_truth: The control plane protocol stack used by the 5G ProSe Layer-2 UE-to-Network Relay is defined in clause~8.2.2 of TS~23.501.

q_54682.question: What is required in the SIP 200 (OK) response that the controlling MCVideo function generates for the SIP INVITE request?
q_54682.ground_truth: An SDP answer to the SDP offer in the incoming SIP INVITE request

q_54683.question: What are the minimum power requirements for uplink combinations in the specified bands?
q_54683.ground_truth: Power Class 2 requirements are applicable for uplink combinations with 1Tx antenna connector in each band or single uplink carrier with up to 2Tx antenna connectors in the downlink/uplink combination. Power Class 1.5 requirements are applicable for a single uplink carrier with up to 2Tx antenna connectors in the downlink/uplink combination.

q_54684.question: What specific inputs are required for the corresponding Analytics API in solution #x?
q_54684.ground_truth: The inputs for the corresponding Analytics API in solution #x are per UE-to-UE session performance measurements, such as latency, channel losses, data rate, and jitter.

q_54685.question: What should the VAE-S do if the authorization to update group information fails or if the updated group information is not valid?
q_54685.ground_truth: The VAE-S should respond with an HTTP 403 (Forbidden) to the HTTP POST request and skip the rest of the steps.

q_54686.question: In which two states can the implicit emergency alert cancel procedure be performed?
q_54686.ground_truth: The implicit emergency alert cancel procedure can be performed in either "E1: Not in emergency state" or "E2: Emergency state".

q_54687.question: How many detach procedures are there in the EPS when the UE accesses the EPS through E-UTRAN?
q_54687.ground_truth: There are four detach procedures in the EPS when the UE accesses the EPS through E-UTRAN.

q_54688.question: What should the SS do if it receives a valid CSI report with a non-zero CQI index from the UE for SCell1 earlier than or equal to subframe (m+44) in the intra-band PCell FDD case?
q_54688.ground_truth: The SS should increase the number of successes for the event "Activation" by one.

q_54689.question: What should the MME/S4-SGSN do after sending a PGW Downlink Triggering Notification message to the SGW during the SGW restoration procedure?
q_54689.ground_truth: The MME/S4-SGSN should send a PGW Downlink Triggering Acknowledge message back to the PGW with an acceptance cause code.

q_54690.question: What should the UE do for each measId included in the received measIdToAddModList in the 5.5.2.3 procedure?
q_54690.ground_truth: The UE should replace the entry if an entry with the matching measId already exists, or add a new entry if no such entry exists. It should also remove the measurement reporting entry for this measId from the VarMeasReportList if included, and stop/reset the periodical reporting timer for this measId.

q_54691.question: What is the default E-UTRA channel bandwidth for non-CA signaling testing for all operating bands?
q_54691.ground_truth: The default E-UTRA channel bandwidth for non-CA signaling testing for all operating bands is 5MHz.

q_54692.question: What is the type of data in the "EUTRANRCellResourceCoordinationRequest-IEs" sequence that is defined as mandatory and has a presence of mandatory?

q_54693.question: Which common URI variable is used by the DCCF Data Management Transfers resource and the Individual DCCF Data Managment Transfer resource to specify a transfer identifier?
q_54693.ground_truth: The common URI variable used by both resources is "transferId".

q_54694.question: What is the purpose of the RCS Capability discovery record in the RCS Server?
q_54694.ground_truth: The RCS Capability discovery record is used by the IRI-POI in the RCS Server to report the detection of RCS service capabilities received for a target's contact(s) or capabilities sent to a contact. This triggers when the RCS Server receives or sends specific SIP requests and responses that contain the capabilities of the target or its contact.

q_54695.question: What mechanism is used in the 5GS to expose System Performance Predictions and Statistics to an authorized External party?
q_54695.ground_truth: The mechanism relies on NWDAF and Network Exposure functionality to generate predictions and expose them to 3rd parties via the NEF. The same mechanism can be extended to provide System Performance Statistics and Prediction to the UE.

q_54696.question: What is the purpose of 'MCPTTGroupCall/EmergencyAlert/Authorised' being set to 'true'?
q_54696.ground_truth: If set to 'true', the MCPTT user is authorized to make an MCPTT emergency alert.

q_54697.question: What is the purpose of the Positioning Information Request message?
q_54697.ground_truth: The Positioning Information Request message is used to request positioning information from a specific source. It contains a ProtocolIE-Container, which includes a set of ProtocolIE-SingleContainer elements, each with a specific ID, Criticality, Type, Presence, and optional Additional Information.

q_54698.question: What shall the UE do if the message has been successfully integrity checked by the NAS and the USIM is considered invalid for 5GS services over non-3GPP access?
q_54698.ground_truth: The UE shall set the counter for "USIM considered invalid for 5GS services over non-3GPP access" events to UE implementation-specific maximum value if the UE maintains these counters.

q_54699.question: Which data type specifies the type of energy saving recommendations on NR cells?
q_54699.ground_truth: The data type "EsRecommendationsOnNRcell" specifies the type of energy saving recommendations on NR cells.

q_54700.question: What should the UE do, if it receives an ATTACH ACCEPT message with a received T3447 value in the UE, after an inter-system change from N1 mode to S1 mode?
q_54700.ground_truth: The UE shall keep T3447 running, store and replace the currently stored T3447 value with the received T3447 value, and use the new value when starting T3447 again upon expiry of the running T3447 timer.

q_54701.question: What is the purpose of the Queue Info field in the Transmission Rejected message?
q_54701.ground_truth: The Queue Info field in the Transmission Rejected message defines the queue position and granted transmission priority in the queue for each waiting transmission participant.

q_54702.question: What should the UE enhanced for vSRVCC do when the multimedia codec negotiation is necessary after the vSRVCC handover is completed?
q_54702.ground_truth: The UE enhanced for vSRVCC shall initiate the multimedia codec negotiation on the CS domain if required.

q_54703.question: What type of JSON object is used to represent the HTTP Request/Response transaction in SEPP messages?

q_54704.question: What is the effect of beam tilt when multiple sources illuminate the mirror?
q_54704.ground_truth: Beam tilt reduces the effective QZ size, which is the common area across the beams from all sources.

q_54705.question: What is the role of the PCRF in the service data flow detection and QoS control in the 3GPP network?
q_54705.ground_truth: The PCRF provides network control regarding the service data flow detection, gating, QoS, and flow based charging (except credit management) towards the PCEF in the 3GPP network.

q_54706.question: What information must be included in the direct discovery set IE of a UE-to-UE relay discovery solicitation message?
q_54706.ground_truth: In the direct discovery set IE of a UE-to-UE relay discovery solicitation message, the UE shall include the discoveree user info parameter set to the application layer ID of the discoveree end UE, the discoverer user info parameter set to the application layer ID of the discoverer end UE, the MIC field, and the UTC-based counter LSB parameter.

q_54707.question: What is the maximum number of subframes allowed for an interruption on the PCell during the hibernation of an SCell?
q_54707.ground_truth: The maximum number of subframes allowed for an interruption on the PCell during the hibernation of an SCell is 5 subframes, if the PCell is in the same band as the hibernating SCell. Otherwise, the interruption on the PCell is up to 1 subframe.

q_54708.question: When do the receiver exclusion bands not apply for NR BS requirements testing?
q_54708.ground_truth: The receiver exclusion bands do not apply for SDL bands.

q_54709.question: What action may the NRF in the Serving PLMN take if it receives a service discovery request for the NF Discovery service of the NRF in Home PLMN, but without an access token, and if it knows that Oauth2-based authorization is required for accessing the NF Discovery service of the NRF in Home PLMN?
q_54709.ground_truth: The NRF in the Serving PLMN may reject the request with a 401 Unauthorized.

q_54710.question: What should the UE do if the UE supports CIoT optimizations in the NB-IoT UE procedure?
q_54710.ground_truth: The UE should include attachWithoutPDN-Connectivity, up-CIoT-EPS-Optimisation, and cp-CIoT-EPS-Optimisation for NB-IoT. For non-NB-IoT UEs, the UE should also include cp-CIoT-5GS-Optimisatoin.

q_54711.question: What does the UE derive from the P-TMSI to use in GERAN when mapping the GUTI to an RAI, P-TMSI, and P-TMSI Signature?
q_54711.ground_truth: The UE derives a foreign TLLI from the P-TMSI to use in GERAN when mapping the GUTI to an RAI, P-TMSI, and P-TMSI Signature.

q_54712.question: What is the expected result of the test case 5.5.11.2.4.2 for the number of successful tests to be increased by one?
q_54712.ground_truth: The number of successful tests is increased by one if the SS receives ACK/NACK on each UL transmission occasion scheduled on both uplink TCI state 0 and state 1, as specified in the test case.

q_54713.question: What types of E-UTRA UE are required to meet the minimum conformance requirements for this test case?
q_54713.ground_truth: This test case applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 15 and forward that support inter-band EN-DC including FR2 with 4 NR UL CCs.

q_54714.question: What must an RLOS attached UE do before initiating an emergency attach?
q_54714.ground_truth: The UE shall first perform a local detach prior to initiating an emergency attach.

q_54715.question: What should be the expected first CSI report timing for intra-band CA UE?
q_54715.ground_truth: The first CSI report for SCell should be received by the SS in a subframe (m+8), or (m+10) if the subframe (m+8) was subject to interruption, and it should be received earlier than or equal to subframe (m+24), or the next available uplink resource if there are no uplink resources for reporting the valid CSI in a subframe (m+24).

q_54716.question: What is the TypeDerivationMethod used in the "fc-timers-countersType" complex type?
q_54716.ground_truth: The TypeDerivationMethod used in the "fc-timers-countersType" complex type is union.

q_54717.question: How is the serving network name constructed by the UE and the SEAF in the 5G system?
q_54717.ground_truth: The serving network name is constructed by the UE by setting the service code to "5G", setting the network identifier to the SN Id of the network that it is authenticating to, and concatenating the service code and the SN Id with the separation character ":". The SEAF constructs the serving network name by setting the service code to "5G", setting the network identifier to the SN Id of the serving network to which the authentication data is sent by the AUSF, and concatenating the service code and the SN Id with the separation character ":".

q_54718.question: In what network mode should the MS perform a periodic routing area updating procedure if it returns to coverage in a cell in the same RA that supports GPRS and indicates network operation mode II?
q_54718.ground_truth: The MS should perform the periodic routing area updating procedure indicating "Periodic updating".

q_54719.question: What is the purpose of the impact field in the SMF's PDU Session Modification Command to the UE?
q_54719.ground_truth: The impact field in the SMF's PDU Session Modification Command to the UE is used to identify which EAS(s) information need to be refreshed.

q_54720.question: In what procedure is the TBS determined for a transport block mapped to two-layer spatial multiplexing?
q_54720.ground_truth: The TBS for a transport block mapped to two-layer spatial multiplexing is determined by the procedure in Clause 7.1.7.2.2.

q_54721.question: In which situation should the UE initiate the measurement reporting procedure for a measId, if the trigger type is set to 'event' and the corresponding entry condition is fulfilled for one or more applicable cells for all measurements after layer 3 filtering?
q_54721.ground_truth: The UE should include a measurement reporting entry within the Variable Measurement Report List (VarMeasReportList) for that measId, set the numberOfReportsSent to 0, include the concerned cells in the cellsTriggeredList and initiate the measurement reporting procedure, as specified in clause 5.5.5.

q_54722.question: What information does the "Voice domain preference and UE's usage setting" information element signal to the network in 3GPP specifications?
q_54722.ground_truth: The "Voice domain preference and UE's usage setting" information element signals the UE's usage setting (voice centric or data centric) and voice domain preference (CS Voice only, CS Voice preferred and IMS PS Voice as secondary, IMS PS Voice preferred and CS Voice as secondary, or IMS PS Voice only) for E-UTRAN to the network.

q_54723.question: When is the M-bit of the Supported-Features AVP set in the ULR command?
q_54723.ground_truth: The M-bit of the Supported-Features AVP is set in the ULR command if the support of a feature by the receiver is required in order for the receiver to be able to correctly process the request command.

q_54724.question: What kind of charging information does not affect, in real-time, the service rendered and is processed after the service is rendered?

q_54725.question: During which subframe should the UE start sending CSI reports for SCell with non-zero CQI index in the test procedure for E-UTRAN TDD hibernation and activation of unknown SCell in non-DRX test?
q_54725.ground_truth: The UE should start sending CSI reports for SCell with non-zero CQI index at latest in a subframe (m+24) in the test procedure for E-UTRAN TDD hibernation and activation of unknown SCell in non-DRX test.

q_54726.question: In what situation is the "Negotiated QoS" information element included in the message in the "network to MS direction"?
q_54726.ground_truth: The "Negotiated QoS" information element is included in the message when the network assigns a new QoS.

q_54727.question: What UE capability is defined by ue-Category-NB?
q_54727.ground_truth: ue-Category-NB defines a combined uplink and downlink capability in NB-IoT, including the parameters set by the UE Category.

q_54728.question: How is the receiving sensitivity calculated in the 1/3-octave frequency bands for a hands-free terminal?
q_54728.ground_truth: The receiving sensitivity is calculated from the averaged measured level at each frequency band, which is referred to the averaged test signal level measured in each frequency band.

q_54729.question: In the context of SBMA, what is the potential solution to address the gaps in signalling trace activation for troubleshooting or debugging purposes?
q_54729.ground_truth: The potential solution is to have NG-RAN buffer exchanged messages when UE starts communication. When tracing is triggered, NG-RAN adds all buffered messages to the trace record. If the UE is not requested to be traced at the point on which NG-RAN typically receives trace activation, NG-RAN discards the data from the buffer.

q_54730.question: What is the recommended time for the UE to mark resource reservation for voice and video in multimedia telephony, if required?
q_54730.ground_truth: The UE should only mark resource reservation as required for voice and video in multimedia telephony, if required at any point in time.

q_54731.question: What are the two representative use cases (rUCs) for the function of inventory?
q_54731.ground_truth: The two representative use cases (rUCs) for the function of inventory are rUC1: Indoor inventory and rUC5: Outdoor inventory.

q_54732.question: What is the root element in the 3GPP IM CN Subsystem XML schema?
q_54732.ground_truth: The root element in the 3GPP IM CN Subsystem XML schema is the "ims-3gpp" element.

q_54733.question: What is the purpose of BSIC re-confirmation in GSM cells?
q_54733.ground_truth: BSIC re-confirmation is the process of tracking and decoding the BSIC of a GSM cell after the initial BSIC identification has been performed. This helps to ensure the accuracy and reliability of the BSIC information.

q_54734.question: When would the UE trigger a location information delivery message to the LMF for AoA Bluetooth positioning?
q_54734.ground_truth: The UE triggers a location information delivery message to the LMF using AoA Bluetooth positioning when it has changed Bluetooth advertising address, specifically for the random-private-resolvable address type.

q_54735.question: What is the DD DL-CPP horizontal positioning accuracy for a single carrier with Case 6, FR2 in the InF-SH scenario with a 1cm ARP error and a 50% and 80% success rate, respectively?

q_54736.question: Which message is sent by the new NG-RAN node to the old NG-RAN node or vice versa, to forward QoE measurement results and/or the RAN visible QoE measurement results received from the UE?
q_54736.ground_truth: The "RRC TRANSFER" message is sent by the new NG-RAN node to the old NG-RAN node or vice versa, to forward QoE measurement results and/or the RAN visible QoE measurement results received from the UE.

q_54737.question: What should be set as the value of ssbFrequency in measResultFreqList when an entry in measResultFreqList includes an MeasObjectNR with a measurement result available for ssb frequency?
q_54737.ground_truth: The value indicated by ssbFrequency as included in the MeasObjectNR.

q_54738.question: What determines which entity initiates the resource reservation for an IP-CAN session?
q_54738.ground_truth: The bearer establishment mode selected for the IP-CAN session determines whether the UE or the IP-CAN itself initiates the resource reservation.

q_54739.question: What is obtained on receipt by an AMF from a UE of a registration request with the registration type indicating a mobility registration update?
q_54739.ground_truth: Each mobility registration update request is added to the relevant subcounter per S-NSSAI in the measurement of number of mobility registration update requests received by the AMF.

q_54740.question: What is an Edge Hosting Environment in the context of the 5G system enhanced for Edge Computing?
q_54740.ground_truth: An Edge Hosting Environment (EHE) is an environment that provides support necessary for the execution of Edge Application Servers (EAS) in the 5G system enhanced for Edge Computing.

q_54741.question: As per TS 24.301 clause 5.5.3.2.5, when the network sends a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message with the reject cause set to "EPS services not allowed", what should the UE do?
q_54741.ground_truth: The UE must delete any GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI list and KSI, consider the USIM as invalid for EPS services until switching off or the UICC containing the USIM is removed, delete the list of equivalent PLMNs, and enter the state EMM-DEREGISTERED.

q_54742.question: What is the purpose of the "MBS-Session-ID" field in the SN Status field of the SN Status Report, and how is it used?
q_54742.ground_truth: The "MBS-Session-ID" field in the SN Status field of the SN Status Report is used to identify the SN's MBS session in the SN Status Report. The MBS (Multi-Broadcast Service) session ID is a unique identifier for an MBS (Multicast Broadcast Service) session in the network. It is used to keep track of the sessions that are currently active on the network and to ensure that each session's status is accurately represented in the SN Status Report. The SN Status field's MBS-Session-ID is used to provide information about the SN's MBS session in the SN Status Report.

q_54743.question: In the case of an intra-frequency handover, what is the Tsearch value if the target cell is an unknown intra-frequency cell and the target cell Es/Iot >=-2 dB?
q_54743.ground_truth: Tsearch = Trs ms, where Trs is the SMTC periodicity of the target NR cell.

q_54744.question: When should the MME consider itself unregistered for SMS?
q_54744.ground_truth: The MME considers itself unregistered for SMS when receiving the IDR-Flags with the "Remove SMS Registration" bit set.

q_54745.question: What is the mandatory security mechanism for e2e IMS data channel media plane security in IMS UEs and IMS core network elements?
q_54745.ground_truth: DTLS-based media plane security mechanism is mandatory for e2e IMS data channel media plane security in IMS UEs and IMS core network elements.

q_54746.question: What is the signalling impact of Soln#9 in 5GC and NG-RAN?
q_54746.ground_truth: Soln#9 requires passing the complete TMGI list from AF to NG-RAN via 5GC, which impacts signalling in 5GC and NG-RAN.

q_54747.question: What is the unit of time used for the drxStartOffset and HARQ RTT timer in the example provided?
q_54747.ground_truth: The unit of time used for the drxStartOffset and HARQ RTT timer is normal subframes, where 1 normal subframe is equivalent to 1 ms.

q_54748.question: What should the VAE-S include in the HTTP 200 (OK) response message, in the V2X service de-registration procedure, if the de-registration is successful?
q_54748.ground_truth: The VAE-S shall include a <de-registration-info> element with a <result> child element set to the value "success" indicating a successful de-registration.

q_54749.question: What shall the UE do if it receives a REGISTRATION REJECT message with 5GMM cause #76 or #78 but without integrity protection?
q_54749.ground_truth: The UE shall discard the message if it receives a REGISTRATION REJECT message with 5GMM cause #76 or #78 but without integrity protection.

q_54750.question: What is the purpose of the NB-S1 DRX parameters information element?
q_54750.ground_truth: The NB-S1 DRX parameters information element is used to indicate that the UE intends to use the UE specific DRX parameter in NB-S1 mode and for the network to indicate the negotiated UE specific DRX parameter to be used at paging in NB-S1 mode.

q_54751.question: What is the horizontal positioning accuracy for a Wo PFL in Case 15 with a 50% and 80% success rate, respectively?

q_54752.question: What is the purpose of the Location Information Transfer Procedure in network-assisted GNSS method?
q_54752.ground_truth: The Location Information Transfer Procedure in network-assisted GNSS method is used to enable the LMF to request position measurements or location estimate from the UE, or to enable the UE to provide location measurements to the LMF for position calculation.

q_54753.question: What is the first substate that the UE chooses as the primary substate when it enters the state 5GMM-REGISTERED?

q_54754.question: What is the definition of the overall delays measured for the test case in 8.1.7.5, and what is the maximum allowable overall delays measured for the test to pass?
q_54754.ground_truth: The overall delays measured is defined as the time from the beginning of time period T2, to the moment the UE sends one Event A3 triggered measurement report to Cell 2. The maximum allowable overall delays measured for the test to pass is 1002 ms.

q_54755.question: What should the MME/S4-SGSN do if it detects a restart of an ISR associated counterpart?
q_54755.ground_truth: The MME/S4-SGSN should wait for the next RAU/TAU procedure to deactivate ISR.

q_54756.question: What is the allowed interruption on PCell or any activated SCell with up to 0.5% probability of missed ACK/NACK when one E-UTRA SCell in SCG is deactivated, as specified in clause 8.2.3.2.5.2?
q_54756.ground_truth: The allowed interruption on PCell or any activated SCell with up to 0.5% probability of missed ACK/NACK when one E-UTRA SCell in SCG is deactivated, as specified in clause 8.2.3.2.5.2.

q_54757.question: What protocol is used to transport NRPPa PDUs between the NG-RAN node and the LMF?

q_54758.question: What is the role of IKE initiator and IKE responder in the security procedure for non-3GPP access to the 5G core network?
q_54758.ground_truth: The role of IKE initiator is taken by the UE, and the role of IKE responder is taken by the N3IWF.

q_54759.question: What is the IE ThresholdNR and IE ThresholdListNR used for within the NR related inter-RAT measurements?
q_54759.ground_truth: The IE ThresholdNR and IE ThresholdListNR contain thresholds for NR related inter-RAT measurements. The ThresholdNR indicates the minimum RSRP, RSRQ, and SINR threshold required for a measurement report, while ThresholdListNR indicates the measurementthreshold ranges for NR related inter-RAT measurements.

q_54760.question: What should the UDM do when it receives a notification of a potential data-loss event from the UDR?
q_54760.ground_truth: The UDM should send a POST request to the dataRestorationCallbackUri and include the POST request body in the scenario where the UDM notifies the NF Service Consumer about the need to restore data.

q_54761.question: What is the condition for a user equipment (UE) to exclude a single-slot resource in step 6a when determining a preferred resource set?
q_54761.ground_truth: The UE excludes a single-slot resource in step 6a when determining a preferred resource set if it is a destination UE of the transport block (TB) for whose transmission the preferred resource set is being determined, the higher layer parameter sl-Condition1-A-2 is not set to 'Disabled', and the UE does not expect to perform SL reception of the TB in the slot where the single-slot resource belongs.

q_54762.question: What action does the NSACF take when admitting a PDU session would exceed the local maximum PDU session number for an S-NSSAI?
q_54762.ground_truth: The NSACF delegates the request to the Primary NSACF for an updated local maximum PDU sessions from the Primary NSACF.

q_54763.question: How many Charging Identifiers correspond to a single PDU session ID in any scenario of SSC modes specified in TS 23.501?
q_54763.ground_truth: One Charging Identifier corresponds to a single PDU session ID.

q_54764.question: What should the UE be capable of to estimate channel occupancy on one or more carrier frequencies?
q_54764.ground_truth: The UE should be capable of estimating channel occupancy on one or more carrier frequencies based on RSSI samples provided by the physical layer.

q_54765.question: What are the purposes of the Pre-emptive BSR format and Extended Pre-emptive BSR format used for?
q_54765.ground_truth: The Pre-emptive BSR format and Extended Pre-emptive BSR format are used to identify the total amount of data expected to arrive at the IAB-MT of the node where the Pre-emptive BSR/Extended Pre-emptive BSR is triggered and does not include the volume of data currently available in the IAB-MT.

q_54766.question: What is the role of the time alignment timers in the test?
q_54766.ground_truth: The time alignment timers are set to "infinity" to maintain UL timing alignment during the test.

q_54767.question: When a BL/CE UE detects a PDSCH within subframe(s) intended for the UE, at what subframe(s) will the HARQ-ACK response be transmitted if the PRACH coverage enhancement level for the UE is 2?
q_54767.ground_truth: The HARQ-ACK response will be transmitted in subframe(s) n+ki with i = 0,1,...,N-1, where N is provided by higher layers parameter pucch-NumRepetitionCE-Msg4-Level2-r13 and subframe n is the last subframe in which the PDSCH is transmitted.

q_54768.question: When does the UE request resources for V2X communication over PC5, 5G ProSe direct discovery over PC5, and 5G ProSe direct communication over PC5?
q_54768.ground_truth: The UE requests resources for V2X communication over PC5, 5G ProSe direct discovery over PC5, and 5G ProSe direct communication over PC5 to perform ranging and sidelink positioning service over PC5.

q_54769.question: What is the preferred solution for establishing an LBO PDU Session to access an EHE in the VPLMN?
q_54769.ground_truth: A URSP based solution is preferred.

q_54770.question: What should be the physical cell identity of Cell 2 after the power setting switch from T2 to T3?
q_54770.ground_truth: The physical cell identity of Cell 2 should be equal to (current Cell 2 physical cell identity + 1) mod 1008) after the power setting switch from T2 to T3.

q_54771.question: What is the purpose of the N4 Session Release procedure in 5G systems?
q_54771.ground_truth: The N4 Session Release procedure removes all control parameters related to an N4 session, indicating that the session has ended and freeing up resources in the UPF.

q_54772.question: What is the parameter the MME sends to eNodeB via S1 signaling indicating whether the UE is "restricted" or "not restricted" for the use of CE mode B?

q_54773.question: What is the purpose of step 7 in the Post-ACR Clean up phase?
q_54773.ground_truth: Step 7 in the Post-ACR Clean Up phase, the S-EAS sends the ACR status update message to the S-EES, informing it about the status of the ACR.

q_54774.question: What should the transferor AS do before executing the ECT logic when a REFER request is received on a separate dialog?
q_54774.ground_truth: The Target-Dialog header field shall identify an existing dialog towards the transferee identified by the Request-URI, the REFER request's Request-URI (transferee) shall be targeted at the same UE instance involved in the dialog and the REFER request's Refer-To header field shall contain a URI so that the method constructed from the URI is equal to INVITE.

q_54775.question: When should the NF Service Consumer include the `vsmfReleaseOnly` indication in the POST request?
q_54775.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer should include the `vsmfReleaseOnly` indication in the POST request during 5GS to EPS Idle mode mobility or handover, for a Home Routed PDU session associated with 3GPP access and with assigned EBI(s).

q_54776.question: What action will an MCVideo server take if an SIP INVITE request for controlling function of an MCVideo group is received but the requested group identity is a regrouped MCVideo group ID?
q_54776.ground_truth: The MCVideo server will reject the SIP INVITE request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response with the warning text set to "148 group is regrouped".

q_54777.question: What is the requirement for the MAC entity to stop an ongoing Random Access procedure due to a pending SR for SL-BSR?
q_54777.ground_truth: The MAC entity may stop the ongoing Random Access procedure due to a pending SR for SL-BSR if the SL grant can accommodate the SL-BSR MAC CE for transmission and the PDU contains an SL-BSR MAC CE.

q_54778.question: What types of PDN Connectivity Requests can result in a rejection with a timer value for T3396 and ESM cause value #26 "insufficient resources"?
q_54778.ground_truth: A PDN Connectivity Request without APN and with a request type different from "emergency" and "handover of emergency bearer services", sent together with an ATTACH REQUEST message; a stand-alone PDN Connectivity Request message without APN and with a request type different from "emergency" and "handover of emergency bearer services"; or a BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST or BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST message sent for a non-emergency PDN connection established without APN provided by the UE.

q_54779.question: What should the AMF do if UUAA-MM fails and network policy indicates that the UE should be de-registered?
q_54779.ground_truth: The AMF may decide to de-register the UE with an appropriate cause value in the De-Registration Request message. Alternatively, the AMF may keep the UE registered with a failure UUAA result in the UE context and ensure that the UE is not allowed to access any aerial service. If the UE is de-registered, the UE may re-attempt to re-register without including the CAA-level UAV ID.

q_54780.question: What is the role of the P-CSCF in IMS emergency sessions?
q_54780.ground_truth: The P-CSCF is responsible for checking the validity of the caller's TEL-URI and providing it in the session establishment request if it is aware of the TEL-URI associated with the Public User Identifier used for emergency registration. It may also respond to the UE with an emergency service indication and inform the PCRF about the service data flow associated with the emergency service.

q_54781.question: What is the definition of a successful test for this requirement?
q_54781.ground_truth: A successful test is achieved when both the event detection and percentage of transmitted ACK/NACKs are fulfilled simultaneously, and when the rate of correct events observed during repeated tests is at least 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

q_54782.question: What should a participating MCPTT function do when sending a SIP BYE request on receipt of a SIP REFER request containing a Refer-Sub header field with the "method" SIP URI parameter set to value "BYE"?
q_54782.ground_truth: It shall determine the MCPTT ID of the calling user, send a SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP REFER request, generate a SIP BYE request with the Request-URI and P-Asserted-Identity header field set, and send the SIP BYE request toward the controlling MCPTT function.

q_54783.question: What should the UE do when it is required to report HARQ-ACK information separately for first CORESETs and second CORESETs on active DL BWPs of serving cells?
q_54783.ground_truth: The UE should separately apply the procedures described in clauses 9.1 and 9.2.3 for reporting HARQ-ACK information associated with the first CORESETs on active DL BWP of the serving cells and for reporting HARQ-ACK information associated with the second CORESETs on active DL BWP of the serving cells.

q_54784.question: What should the MCData emergency private priority state be set to if a specific condition is met during an MCData emergency private communication?
q_54784.ground_truth: If the SIP INVITE request contains an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body with the <mcdatainfo> element containing the <mcdata-Params> element containing a <request-type> element set to a value of "one-to-one-fd" and also containing an <emergency-ind> element set to a value of "true", then the MCData emergency private priority state should be set to "MDEPP 2: in-progress" for this private communication.

q_54785.question: What is the role of a SECAM Accreditation Body in establishing security requirements and test cases for network products?
q_54785.ground_truth: A SECAM Accreditation Body is responsible for writing and managing accreditation and monitoring rules, as well as handling the dispute resolution process. SECAM does not preclude the direct use of 3GPP SECAM security requirements and tests cases between vendors and operators without the accreditation process, providing flexibility and avoiding delays in deliverables or conflicting requirements from different countries.

q_54786.question: What information does the new AMF store in the UE Context in AMF upon successful registration for Onboarding?
q_54786.ground_truth: The new AMF stores an indication that the UE is registered for onboarding in the UE Context in AMF upon successful registration for Onboarding.

q_54787.question: What is the effect on positioning error when Nt is reduced from 256 to 128 or 64 for direct AI/ML positioning?
q_54787.ground_truth: Reducing Nt from 256 to 128 results in a positioning error that is 0.81 ~ 1.19 times the positioning error of Nt=256, while reducing Nt from 256 to 64 results in a positioning error that is 0.88 ~ 3.00 times the positioning error of Nt=256. Reducing Nt from 256 to 32 results in a positioning error that is 1.05 ~ 4.29 times the positioning error of Nt=256.

q_54788.question: What is the role of the Primary NSACF in the Hierarchical NSACF Architecture?
q_54788.ground_truth: The Primary NSACF is responsible for managing the global maximum number of UEs or PDU sessions for a given S-NSSAI, which is valid across service areas. It also registers its NF profile to the NRF, which can be discovered by other NFs.

q_54789.question: What message does the SMF send to the DN-AAA in a home routed scenario for initial access requests?
q_54789.ground_truth: The SMF sends a Diameter DER message to the DN-AAA server.

q_54790.question: What should the UE do during the discoveree operation if the validity timer T5068 for the ProSe response code and corresponding discovery query filter(s) has expired and there is no request from upper layers to perform discoveree operation?
q_54790.ground_truth: The UE may instruct the lower layers to stop monitoring, and if required, trigger the corresponding procedure in the lower layers as specified in 3GPP TS 38.331.

q_54791.question: What signal defines the start of time period T2 in the test?
q_54791.ground_truth: The start of time period T2 is defined by the MAC message received at the UE antenna connector, in a slot # denoted m.

q_54792.question: What should a MCPTT client do if it receives an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body in an SIP INVITE request?
q_54792.ground_truth: If a MCPTT client receives an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body in an SIP INVITE request, it may notify the user with the adhoc group identity received in the <mcptt-calling-group-id> element contained in the MIME body.

q_54793.question: What is the notation used to represent a unidirectional association relationship in a model?
q_54793.ground_truth: A unidirectional association is represented in a model using an open arrowhead pointing to the target model element.

q_54794.question: What is the purpose of defining a specification template for Media Service Enablers?
q_54794.ground_truth: The purpose of defining a specification template for Media Service Enablers is to provide a standard format for specifying the properties and functionalities of such enablers, which will aid in the development and implementation of third-party applications that make use of the 5G System.

q_54795.question: What should the AMF do if the UE indicates support for non-3GPP access path switching in the PDU Session Establishment Request message?
q_54795.ground_truth: The AMF should select a SMF that supports non-3GPP access path switching, if one is available.

q_54796.question: What is the responsibility of the UE in Network assisted Sidelink Positioning?
q_54796.ground_truth: The UE is responsible for supporting Ranging/SL Positioning, providing capability of being a Located UE to the AMF, and triggering the Ranging/Sidelink positioning procedure which includes the discovery and service operation procedure over PC5.

q_54797.question: What is the difference between full reset and partial reset in the Reset procedure for the NG-RAN node2?
q_54797.ground_truth: Full reset requires the NG-RAN node2 to abort any other ongoing procedures and release all context information related to NG-RAN node1, whereas partial reset only requires the NG-RAN node2 to abort other ongoing procedures and release context information related to the indicated UE associated signalling connections.

q_54798.question: What is the responsibility of the UE during the origination of a dedicated bearer?
q_54798.ground_truth: The UE stores the QoS Negotiated, Radio Priority, Packet Flow Id and TI for use when accessing via GERAN or UTRAN. The UE NAS also links the dedicated bearer to the default bearer indicated by the Linked EPS Bearer Identity.

q_54799.question: What types of NR Power Class 3 UE that support satellite access operation must the requirements of this test apply to?
q_54799.ground_truth: The requirements of this test apply to all types of NR Power Class 3 UE that support satellite access operation, as specified in clause 7.3.2.2.

q_54800.question: What is the maximum allowed S-SSB transmission cease delay in the test described in 9.1.2.2.4.2?
q_54800.ground_truth: The maximum allowed S-SSB transmission cease delay in the test described in 9.1.2.2.4.2 is 560ms (Tevaluate,SLSS + S-SSB period).

q_54801.question: If the triggerType is set to 'event', and the leaving condition for the event is fulfilled for at least one of the cells included in the cellsTriggeredList for the measId, what should the UE perform?
q_54801.ground_truth: The UE should remove the concerned cell(s) from the cellsTriggeredList defined within the VarMeasReportList for that measId. If the cellsTriggeredList is empty, the UE should remove the measurement reporting entry within the VarMeasReportList for that measId and stop the periodical reporting timer for that measId, if running.

q_54802.question: What is the direction of the Delete Session Request message?
q_54802.ground_truth: The direction of the Delete Session Request message is from MME/S4-SGSN to SGW, from SGW to PGW, and from TWAN/ePDG to PGW.

q_54803.question: What is the first label of the BSF address when the IMPI in use is "234150999999999@ims.mnc015.mcc234.3gppnetwork.org"?

q_54804.question: What is the BS transmission power assumed in all cases for semi-static SBFD with SBFD Alt 4 and small packet size?
q_54804.ground_truth: The BS transmission power assumed in all cases for semi-static SBFD with SBFD Alt 4 and small packet size is 53dBm.

q_54805.question: What is the purpose of the requirement for measuring the overall delay in Test 1 and Test 2?
q_54805.ground_truth: The purpose of measuring the overall delay in Test 1 and Test 2 is to ensure that the delay in reporting events in a cellular network meets certain requirements. This is important for maintaining the quality of service and efficiency of the network.

q_54806.question: What action should be taken if the other MAC entity is an E-UTRA MAC entity?
q_54806.ground_truth: Obtain the value of the Type 2 power headroom for the SpCell of the other MAC entity, and obtain the corresponding Pcmax,c field for the SpCell of the other MAC entity from the physical layer.

q_54807.question: What type of data does the "entry-info" attribute store when it's used in the "EmergencyAlert" element to indicate the destination address for an on-network group emergency alert?
q_54807.ground_truth: When it appears in the "entry-info" attribute within the "entry" element of the "EmergencyAlert" element, it can store the MCPTT user currently selected MCPTT group or the value in the "uri-entry" element for an on-network group emergency alert.

q_54808.question: What must be the event triggered measurement reporting delay for the UE to be considered successful in Sub-test 1 with per-UE gap?

q_54809.question: What is the difference between 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay and 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-network relay?
q_54809.ground_truth: 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay is used for UE-to-network communication while 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-network relay is used for UE-to-network communication via a layer-3 UE-to-network relay UE.

q_54810.question: What is the aim of the test described in clause 6.1.13.2?
q_54810.ground_truth: The aim of the test is to check if the UE is able to send a RRC Connection Re-establishment Request message to the System Simulator within the specified re-establishment delay limits from the moment it detects a loss in RRC connection.

q_54811.question: What does the pending state of a Policy Template mean in the 5GMS system?
q_54811.ground_truth: The pending state of a Policy Template means that it is awaiting validation, potentially because not all required parameters have yet been provided.

q_54812.question: Which information does the AF include as part of the member UE selection request to the NEF?
q_54812.ground_truth: The AF includes the historical location of UEs (Target AoI where the UEs have been roving), the current AoI (FL coverage area where the selected UEs located in to participate in the FL operation), UE direction, and UE separation distance as part of the member UE selection request to the NEF.

q_54813.question: What is the probability of a borderline good User Equipment (UE) being judged as FAIL when the core specification value is not relaxed (TT=0) and the test tolerances equal to 0 (TT=0)?
q_54813.ground_truth: The probability of a borderline good UE being judged as FAIL is equal to the probability of a borderline bad UE being judged as PASS when TT=0.

q_54814.question: What is the name of the XML document's root element?

q_54815.question: What activities does the preparation phase in network slicing management include?
q_54815.ground_truth: The preparation phase in network slicing management includes network slice design, network slice capacity planning, on-boarding and evaluation of the network functions, preparing the network environment and other necessary preparations required before the creation of a NetworkSlice instance.

q_54816.question: What type of traffic is the measurement valid for in 5.8.2.2.1 and 5.8.2.3.3?

q_54817.question: What does Band Category 1 (BC1) include, as defined in section 4.5?
q_54817.ground_truth: Band Category 1 (BC1) includes bands for NR FDD, E-UTRA FDD and/or UTRA FDD operation, and bands in this category are also used for NB-IoT operation (all modes).

q_54818.question: What is the role of NEF in the service initiated by 5GC NF?
