q_55061.question: What action must the UE take when it receives an EMM Information message but does not support it?
q_55061.ground_truth: The UE must ignore the contents of the message and return an EMM STATUS message with cause #97 "message type non-existent or not implemented".

q_55062.question: What information is associated with the session being established when the ATCF receives an originating SIP INVITE request from SC UE with ATCF management URI in the topmost Route header field?
q_55062.ground_truth: The ATCF associates the session being established with the C-MSISDN and the ATU-STI for PS to CS SRVCC bound to the registration path.

q_55063.question: What is the mandatory requirement for Instance IDs if the UE supports GRUU or multiple registrations?
q_55063.ground_truth: If the UE supports GRUU or multiple registrations, then it shall have an Instance ID in conformance with the mandatory requirements for Instance IDs specified in RFC 5627 and RFC 5626.

q_55064.question: What is the purpose of the E-SMLC initiated Periodic Assistance Data Delivery?
q_55064.ground_truth: The purpose of E-SMLC initiated Periodic Assistance Data Delivery is to provide unsolicited periodic assistance data to the target UE for high-accuracy GNSS positioning techniques such as RTK, with the possibility for the UE to request periodic assistance data from the E-SMLC.

q_55065.question: What is the purpose of the EXT1 record in the led party subaddress?
q_55065.ground_truth: The EXT1 record in this case is specified as subaddress data or additional data, depending on the type of the record.

q_55066.question: Which information element in HandoverCancel message is mandatory and indicates the cause of handover cancellation?

q_55067.question: In what situation would a UE include an ESM DATA TRANSPORT message in the ESM message container IE?
q_55067.ground_truth: A UE includes an ESM DATA TRANSPORT message in the ESM message container IE when it has pending IP or non-IP user data to be sent via the control plane radio bearers, as indicated in cases b and m in subclause~5.6.1.1.

q_55068.question: What should the AMF do when a CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message has a Payload container type IE set to "CIoT user data container"?
q_55068.ground_truth: The AMF shall look up a PDU session routing context for the UE and the PDU session ID, and forward the content of the Payload container IE to the SMF associated with the UE. If the corresponding PDU session is a PDU session for LADN, the AMF determines the UE presence in LADN service area (see subclause 6.2.6) and forwards the UE presence in LADN service area towards the SMF.

q_55069.question: What is the name of the procedure defined in clause~4.13, which defines the additional procedures or additions to existing procedures to support specific services such as SMS over NAS in clause~4.13.2.1?
q_55069.ground_truth: The procedure is referred to as Application Triggering.

q_55070.question: What is one of the key solutions to address the Local Area Restriction for an LMF and GMLC in the LCS architecture?
q_55070.ground_truth: One of the key solutions to address the Local Area Restriction for an LMF and GMLC in the LCS architecture is the LMF discovery and selection mechanism enhanced to use LMF ID as an input parameter.

q_55071.question: What should the MCPTT client include in the SIP re-INVITE request when canceling the in-progress imminent peril group state, as specified in clause 6.2.8.1.11?
q_55071.ground_truth: The MCPTT ID of the originating MCPTT user, MCPTT session type, and MCPTT request URI.

q_55072.question: What information can the SMF provide to the UE in the N1 SM container if per QoS-flow Non-3GPP QoS Assistance Information is required based on the S-NSSAI and DNN for PIN?
q_55072.ground_truth: The SMF can provide per QoS-flow Non-3GPP QoS Assistance Information to the UE in the N1 SM container, if required based on the S-NSSAI and DNN for PIN.

q_55073.question: What should a participating MCData function include in the outgoing SDP offer in a SIP re-INVITE request?
q_55073.ground_truth: A participating MCData function should include an SDP offer containing the current media parameters used by the existing session in the outgoing SIP re-INVITE request.

q_55074.question: What is the 5% DL Average-UPT gain for semi-static SBFD at low load level with SBFD Alt 4 and large packet size?
q_55074.ground_truth: The 5% DL Average-UPT gain for semi-static SBFD at low load level with SBFD Alt 4 and large packet size is 0%.

q_55075.question: What is the relationship between the far-field region and the radiated requirements in the context of SAN?
q_55075.ground_truth: The radiated requirements for SAN apply in the far-field region, which is associated with the transceiver array boundary and is measured at a distance where the radiation pattern is established.

q_55076.question: What are the two main purposes of location information in emergency services?
q_55076.ground_truth: The initial purpose of the location information is to enable the IMS network to determine which PSAP serves the area where the UE is currently located, so that the IMS network can route the emergency session to the correct PSAP. The second purpose is for the PSAP to get more accurate or updated location information for the terminal during or after the emergency session where required by local regulation.

q_55077.question: What should the MCData client include in the Refer-To header field if the data communication setup request includes a list of MCData users to be called?
q_55077.ground_truth: The MCData client should set the Refer-To header field of the SIP REFER request with a Content-ID (cid) Uniform Resource Locator (URL) that points to an application/resource-lists+xml MIME body that contains an <entry> element for each of the targeted MCData users.

q_55078.question: What is the data type of <OSid> in 7.39 Application Start and Stop indication for applications other than MMTEL and SMSoverIP +CACDC?
q_55078.ground_truth: The data type of <OSid> is an operating system identifier.

q_55079.question: What is one of the pre-conditions the UE needs to meet before initiating the match report procedure?
q_55079.ground_truth: A request from upper layers to monitor for the ProSe Application ID, which resulted in the matched ProSe Application Code, should still be in place.

q_55080.question: What action is taken for each QoS flow that needs to be released in 5.8.2.3.1?
q_55080.ground_truth: Each QoS flow requested to release increments the relevant subcounter per 5QI and the relevant subcounter per S-NSSAI by 1 respectively.

q_55081.question: What controls the maximum data rate of a GBR QoS Flow?
q_55081.ground_truth: Authorized MBR value of the associated PCC rule

q_55082.question: What information does the "5G ProSe Authorized" IE provide regarding a UE's authorization status for using 5G ProSe services?
q_55082.ground_truth: The "5G ProSe Authorized" IE indicates whether the UE is authorized to use 5G ProSe services.

q_55083.question: What parameters are used to provide 5G VN group-MBR information from AF to NEF or UDM?
q_55083.ground_truth: 5G VN group-MBR is provided to NEF as a parameter of 5G VN group data information and to UDM in the same way.

q_55084.question: What parameter is sent by the AF to the NEF and UDM for 5G VN group information through Nnef_ParameterProvision_Create and Nudm_ParameterProvision_Create?
q_55084.ground_truth: 5G VN group information (GPSI, DNN, S-NSSAI and 5G VN group service area)

q_55085.question: What information should be contained in the <forwarding-immediate-list> when there is a forwarding request for terminating client?
q_55085.ground_truth: The <forwarding-immediate-list> should contain the MCPTT ID of the forwarded MCPTT user, the forwarding sequence number, the forwarded-by-mcptt-id, forwarded-by-functional-alias, forwarding-target-orig-id, forwarding-target-is-functional-alias, and forwarding-target-id when there is a forwarding request for terminating client.

q_55086.question: What should a PN UE do when performing the PN controller function and the user allows the request to be forwarded to the PN controllee UE?
q_55086.ground_truth: The PN UE shall send a 302 (Moved Temporarily) response and include a Contact header containing the URI from the target URI-parameter in the Request-URI of the incoming request.

q_55087.question: What is the definition of the directional response for scene-based audio?
q_55087.ground_truth: The directional response for scene-based audio is the transfer function between a device under test and a loudspeaker located at an equal distance and a set of predefined directions.

q_55088.question: What is the purpose of the secondary authentication for PDU session authorization?
q_55088.ground_truth: The secondary authentication is used for PDU session authorization to access an EHE in the VPLMN. It is reused for both LBO and HR PDU session scenarios.

q_55089.question: What is the purpose of emulating typical radio conditions in test channels?
q_55089.ground_truth: The purpose of emulating typical radio conditions in test channels is to permit emulation of typical radio conditions in terms of delays and losses.

q_55090.question: What is the UE mean power saving gain provided by LP-WUS compared to i-DRX with or without PEI when the FAR, effective per UE paging arrival rate, and duty cycle ratio are less than or equal to 1%, (0.1%,1%], and (1%,10%], respectively, and the WUR ON power is less than or equal to 1 unit?
q_55090.ground_truth: LP-WUS provides UE mean power saving gain of 31% to 91%, corresponding to 9% to 69% of UE power consumption in legacy I-DRX operation.

q_55091.question: What is the purpose of the IMEI-Change AVP, and in which situation is the new IMEI(SV) value reported to the SCEF?
q_55091.ground_truth: The IMEI-Change AVP is of type Unsigned32 and contains a bit mask. The new IMEI(SV) value is reported to the SCEF in the Terminal-Information AVP inside the Monitoring-Event-Report AVP when a change of IMEI(SV) is reported.

q_55092.question: What is the reporting accuracy of CQI under AWGN conditions determined by in 6.2.1.2.1.1?
q_55092.ground_truth: The reporting accuracy of CQI under AWGN conditions is determined by the reporting variance and BLER performance using the transport format indicated by the reported CQI median in 6.2.1.2.1.1. To account for sensitivity of the input SNR, the reporting definition is considered to be verified if the reporting accuracy is met for at least one of two SNR levels separated by an offset of 1 dB.

q_55093.question: In case of USS communication, what is the length of the service-level-AA container included in the MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message?
q_55093.ground_truth: The length of the service-level-AA container included in the MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message is two octets.

q_55094.question: Which test applicability applies to the general spurious emissions test for the E-UTRA component supporting inter-band EN-DC including FR2 with 5 NR UL CCs?
q_55094.ground_truth: The same minimum conformance requirements as in clause 6.5.3.3 for the NR carrier are applied to the E-UTRA component supporting inter-band EN-DC including FR2 with 5 NR UL CCs. No exception requirements are applicable to NR or E-UTRA. The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.101-3 clause 6.4B.3.4.

q_55095.question: What is the OTA RX spurious emissions requirement for BS type 1-O operating in TDD?
q_55095.ground_truth: The OTA RX spurious emissions requirement for BS type 1-O operating in TDD applies during the transmitter OFF period only.

q_55096.question: What does the PDN GW do after receiving the Create Session Request message from the Serving GW in step 9?
q_55096.ground_truth: After receiving the Create Session Request message from the Serving GW in step 9, the PDN GW may execute a PCEF-Initiated IP CAN Session Modification Procedure with the PCRF.

q_55097.question: How is the 5GS Tracking Area Identity (TAI) FQDN constructed?
q_55097.ground_truth: The 5GS TAI FQDN is constructed using the TAC, MCC, and MNC. It identifies a specific tracking area within the 5GS network and is used for mobility management.

q_55098.question: How does a UE ensure secure direct link for one-to-one ProSe Direct Communication?
q_55098.ground_truth: A UE capable of sidelink communication shall select the radio resources for one-to-one ProSe Direct Communication based on the service authorization procedure as specified in clause~5. If the direct link setup is for isolated one-to-one ProSe Direct Communication, both UEs are required to have fetched in advance the public key of the Key Management Server (KMS) and a set of credentials associated with the UE's identity.

q_55099.question: What is provided by the CSP in case of cell database information reporting?
q_55099.ground_truth: The CSP may provide CSI, which includes cell site information and cell radio-related information, asynchronously in a stand-alone CSR (Cell Site Report) IRI message or in the IRI message itself, when a cell identity is provided in an IRI message for the target's location.

q_55100.question: What is the allowed time span for potential interruptions on PCell during DL BWP switching on SCell1 and SCell2?
q_55100.ground_truth: Potential interruptions of PCell due to DL BWP switching on SCell1 and SCell2 are carried out within the correct time span, and are within the correct length, by monitoring ACK/NACKs sent in PCell for PCell.

q_55101.question: What should the ME do if it receives a SEND SS command with an alpha identifier that is not a null data object?
q_55101.ground_truth: The ME should use the alpha identifier to inform the user, and not give any other information about the SS request.

q_55102.question: What media feature tag must be included in the Accept-Contact header field along with the "require" and "explicit" header field parameters for generating a SIP MESSAGE request to indicate successful receipt of an emergency alert or emergency cancellation?

q_55103.question: What is the significance of 5G Media Streaming Architecture in downlink and uplink media streaming?
q_55103.ground_truth: 5G Media Streaming Architecture is used for both unicast downlink and unicast uplink media streaming. It specifies the format and protocol for media streaming services between the UE and the Media Application Server.

q_55104.question: What does the CDIV service allow the diverting user to do?
q_55104.ground_truth: The CDIV service allows the diverting user to divert communications addressed to them to another destination.

q_55105.question: What is the difference in DL Average-UPT between the case with no DL power adjustment and the case with DL power adjustment (3 dB power back off) in FR1 2-layer Scenario B based on Source 1?
q_55105.ground_truth: With a large packet size, the DL power adjustment results in a higher or similar mean and 5% DL Average-UPT for all load levels compared to the case with no DL power adjustment.

q_55106.question: What must the UICC respond with to indicate successful processing of a TERMINAL RESPONSE for a proactive command in 6.8.8?
q_55106.ground_truth: The UICC must respond with '90 00', '6F XX', '62 XX' or '63 XX' to indicate successful processing.

q_55107.question: What is the trigger for increasing the number of successful tests in the test procedure?
q_55107.ground_truth: If the SS detects uplink power in NR carrier for CSI transmission, does not detect PUCCH with LRR before time point B, and detects PUCCH with LRR and BFR MAC CE before time point F, the number of successful tests is increased by one.

q_55108.question: What additional information does the source eNB include in the HANDOVER REQUEST, if it proposes to do forwarding of downlink data for each E-RAB?
q_55108.ground_truth: For each E-RAB, the source eNB includes the DL Forwarding IE within the E-RABs To be Setup Item IE of the HANDOVER REQUEST message, and the DL GTP Tunnel Endpoint IE within the E-RABs Admitted Item IE of the HANDOVER REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message.

q_55109.question: What is one of the actions taken by the LMF in step 27 if a location estimate is needed for event reporting?
q_55109.ground_truth: The LMF may perform one or more of the positioning procedures described in clauses 6.11.1, 6.11.2, 6.11.3 and 6.11.4 and as described for step~8 in clause~6.1.1 and step~12 in clause~6.1.2. The LMF then determines the UE location using the location measurements and/or location estimate(s) obtained at this step~and/or received at step~25.

q_55110.question: What should the network do if the SETUP message contains no bearer capability IE?
q_55110.ground_truth: The network should perform compatibility checking of the CALL CONFIRMED message in the same way as the compatibility checking of the SETUP message in the mobile originating call case.

q_55111.question: When is the "PDU Session Resources Not Admitted List" IE used for?
q_55111.ground_truth: This IE contains a list of PDU session resources that were not admitted to be added or modified.

q_55112.question: What is the requirement for the battery life of the PWS-UE regarding PWS?
q_55112.ground_truth: The battery life of the PWS-UE shall not be significantly reduced by PWS.

q_55113.question: What should the SMF do when the UE becomes reachable after performing extended buffering for a PDU session?
q_55113.ground_truth: The SMF should send the buffered data to the UPF and establish the User Plane(s) for the PDU Sessions, or deliver the buffered data to the UE as per the 4.24.2 procedure of Control Plane CIoT 5GS Optimisation.

q_55114.question: When should the MAC entity not indicate the generated positive or negative acknowledgement for a TB to the physical layer?
q_55114.ground_truth: The MAC entity should not indicate the generated positive or negative acknowledgement for a TB to the physical layer when the HARQ process is associated with a transmission indicated with a Temporary C-RNTI and the Contention Resolution is not yet successful, when the HARQ process is equal to the broadcast process, or when the timeAlignmentTimer for the TAG containing the serving cell on which the HARQ feedback is to be transmitted is stopped or expired.

q_55115.question: In what sub-state of the GMM-REGISTERED state are the lower layers prevented from sending user data or signalling information?
q_55115.ground_truth: In the GMM-REGISTERED.SUSPENDED sub-state, the lower layers are prevented from sending user data or signalling information.

q_55116.question: What is the meaning of "shall" in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_55116.ground_truth: In the 3GPP technical specification, "shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

q_55117.question: Which interfaces within the 3GPP LCS logical architecture does the EPC LCS Protocol (ELP) apply to?
q_55117.ground_truth: The EPC LCS Protocol (ELP) applies to the SLg interface between the GMLC and the MME and the Lgd interface between the GMLC and the SGSN in the Evolved Packet Core (EPC).

q_55118.question: What data type is used to represent several digits from 0 through 9, *, #, a, b, c in the ASN.1 specification?

q_55119.question: In step 11a, what condition must be met for the SS to count a success for the event "Deactivation"?
q_55119.ground_truth: The last CSI report for SCell1 must be received by the SS earlier than or equal to subframe (n+8), and DTX must not be observed by the SS anywhere outside the specified subframes during T3.

q_55120.question: What is the purpose of Maximum Number of Reports and Maximum Duration of Reporting parameters?
q_55120.ground_truth: Maximum Number of Reports and Maximum Duration of Reporting limit the duration for which events are reported, either to a certain number of reports or a specific time period.

q_55121.question: What is the condition for using a Test System with a measurement uncertainty greater than that specified in clause 4.1.2?
q_55121.ground_truth: If the Test System for a test is known to have a measurement uncertainty greater than that specified in clause 4.1.2, it is still permitted to use this apparatus, provided that an adjustment is made to tighten the test requirement, making the test harder to pass.

q_55122.question: In the 5G NSWO use case, what is the format of the NAI for an anonymous SUCI?
q_55122.ground_truth: The NAI format for an anonymous SUCI is either: type1.rid678.schid0.useridanonymous@5gc-nswo.nid<NID>.mnc015.mcc234.3gppnetwork.org or type1.rid678.schid0.userid@5gc-nswo.nid<NID>.mnc015.mcc234.3gppnetwork.org

q_55123.question: Which clause in TS 38.174 provides the minimum requirements for IAB-MT type 2-O in terms of OTA in-band blocking?
q_55123.ground_truth: The minimum requirements for IAB-MT type 2-O are in TS 38.174, clause 10.5.2.4.

q_55124.question: What is the role of the non-3GPP delay in the communication between PIN and PEGC via 5GC?
q_55124.ground_truth: The non-3GPP delay is the delay between the PEGC and the PINE, and 5GC may need to compensate for this delay in 5GS.

q_55125.question: What is the purpose of a Registration Request with an emergency registration type in the 5G system?
q_55125.ground_truth: It is used to request an emergency registration for packet switched traffic in the 5G system.

q_55126.question: In what way is the "phone-context" tel URI parameter constructed when the IP-CAN is EPS?
q_55126.ground_truth: The "phone-context" tel URI parameter is constructed from the MCC, the MNC and the home network domain name by concatenating the MCC, MNC, and the string "eps" as domain labels before the home network domain name.

q_55127.question: What must the NG-RAN broadcast during a Disaster Condition to notify UEs of accessibility for Disaster Roaming service?
q_55127.ground_truth: The NG-RAN broadcasts an indication of accessibility for Disaster Roaming service and a list of one or more PLMN(s) with Disaster Condition for which Disaster Roaming service is offered by the available PLMN.

q_55128.question: What is the difference between Type A1 and Type A2 multi-channel access procedures described in clause 4.1.6.1.1 and 4.1.6.1.2?
q_55128.ground_truth: The difference between Type A1 and Type A2 multi-channel access procedures lies in how the counter N is determined and maintained. In Type A1 procedures, the counter N is independently determined for each channel, while in Type A2 procedures, the counter N is determined for the channel with the largest CWp value and is the same for all channels. Additionally, when the eNB/gNB ceases transmission on any one channel, the eNB/gNB shall reinitialize the counter N for all channels in Type A2 procedures.

q_55129.question: What should the UE do upon successful delivery of the UEInformationResponse message confirmed by lower layers, if the rlf-Report is included in UEInformationResponse?
q_55129.ground_truth: The UE should discard the rlf-Report from VarRLF-Report.

q_55130.question: Which features share the same RF implementation for the same band combination?
q_55130.ground_truth: UL NR CA, UL NR DC, EN-DC, and NE-DC features share the same RF implementation for the same band combination.

q_55131.question: What is the identifier for the entry in the Functional Alias List?

q_55132.question: What is the definition of transmitter OFF power for UTRA and E-UTRA in the context of testing the transmitter OFF power of a base station?
q_55132.ground_truth: Transmitter OFF power for UTRA and E-UTRA is defined as the mean power measured over 70 microseconds filtered with a square filter of bandwidth equal to the Base Station RF Bandwidth of the BS, centered on the central frequency of the Base Station RF Bandwidth during the transmitter OFF period.

q_55133.question: In the 3GPP RRM tests, what is the method for combining test system uncertainties and how do they combine uncertainties?
q_55133.ground_truth: The method for combining test system uncertainties is based on the root-sum-squares method, which is used to maintain the same tolerance interval for the combined uncertainty as is already specified for the contributing test system uncertainties. The uncertainties are assumed to be uncorrelated, and are added result root-sum-square unless otherwise stated. The combination of uncertainties is performed using dB values for simplicity.

q_55134.question: What information is included in the Location Request when the LCS Client or AF requests user plane reporting?
q_55134.ground_truth: In addition to a request for user plane reporting, the Location Request includes an IP address or FQDN for the user plane connection and security information to enable a secure connection.

q_55135.question: Which complexType has the attribute "namespace" set to "##other" and the processContents attribute set to "lax"?

q_55136.question: What does the "(n-1) out of n" approach mean in the context of performance measurements?
q_55136.ground_truth: The "(n-1) out of n" approach allows a vendor to choose any (n-1) out of the n defined counters for implementation, while the missing nth value can be calculated in post-processing. This approach is used to avoid redundancy in measurements.

q_55137.question: What is the effect when the ProSe Function assigns a new ProSe Response Code and ProSe Query Code with a new validity timer T4011?
q_55137.ground_truth: It implies that the ProSe Function shall allocate Discovery Query Filter(s) based on the allocated ProSe Query Code and starts timer T4012, which is longer than timer T4011.

q_55138.question: What are the steps taken by the MCVideo client when the SIP request for originating MCVideo imminent peril group calls is received and it is an authorized request?
q_55138.ground_truth: If the MCVideo client receives a request from the MCVideo user to originate an MCVideo imminent peril group call, and this is an authorized request, the MCVideo client sets the MCVideo emergency group call state to "MVIGC 2: imminent-peril-call-requested" state, sets the "<imminentperil-ind>" element of the MIME mcvideoinfo body to "true", and if the MCVideo client imminent peril group state of the group is not "MVIG 2: in-progress", sets the MCVideo client emergency group state of the MCVideo group to "MVIG 3: confirm-pending". If the MCVideo client imminent peril group state of the group is set to a value other than "MVIG 2: in-progress", the MCVideo client sets the MCVideo client emergency group state of the MCVideo group to "MVIG 3: confirm-pending".

q_55139.question: In the context of 5G, what is a type of communication between a UE and a Data Network that provides a PDU connectivity service and can use one access network at a time, or simultaneously one 3GPP access network and one non-3GPP access network?

q_55140.question: What does the ADRF do after receiving the trained ML Model from the NWDAF containing MTLF?
q_55140.ground_truth: The ADRF stores the trained ML model(s) and/or the ML model(s) information sent by the NWDAF containing MTLF. It may determine if the same trained ML Model is already stored and decide to update it.

q_55141.question: What state does the floor control server remain in when cator is set to '1'?
q_55141.ground_truth: The floor control server remains in the 'G: Floor Taken' state when cator is set to '1'.

q_55142.question: What is the abbreviation for Adjacent Channel Leakage Ratio, and what does it represent?
q_55142.ground_truth: ACLR stands for Adjacent Channel Leakage Ratio, which represents the amount of signal energy unintentionally emitted into nearby frequency channels, caused by the design of a transmitter.

q_55143.question: What indication is used in network switching solutions to ensure that the access and session management function (AMF) and session management function (SMF) are informed about traffic switching between two non-3GPP access paths?
q_55143.ground_truth: A single indicator or information element is used to inform the AMF and SMF that the PDU session establishment request is intended for switching the traffic between two non-3GPP access paths, allowing both the AMF and SMF to establish new user plane resources on the target access while preserving existing user plane resources on the source non-3GPP access path.

q_55144.question: What is the predefined size limit that the H-PCF checks against the size of determined UE policy information?
q_55144.ground_truth: The predefined size limit in H-PCF is related to the maximum size limit allowed in NG-RAN (PDCP layer) for NAS messages from AMF to UE.

q_55145.question: What is the measurement time for the time-domain average of the received signal power in a specific RE, TL1-RSRP, for the first and second TCI state in FR2 when assuming M=1 and TReport=0?

q_55146.question: What is the use of SCI format 2-B in the physical layer?
q_55146.ground_truth: SCI format 2-B is used to provide HARQ information, Source/Destination L1 ID or distance-based HARQ related parameters in the physical layer.

q_55147.question: What is the role of Paging Time Window in the extended idle mode DRX for NR?
q_55147.ground_truth: Paging Time Window applies for extended DRX lengths greater than 10.24s in NR. The AMF does not include a Paging Time Window if the UE is accessing NR, and the AMF provides an extended idle mode DRX cycle length value of 10.24s, and the registration area of the UE contains only NR cells.

q_55148.question: What are the parameters consumers may include in the request message for preferred granularity of location information?
q_55148.ground_truth: The consumer may include Analytics ID, the target of analytics reporting, analytics filter information, analytics target period, maximum number of objects, preferred level of accuracy, preferred order of results, and preferred granularity of location information.

q_55149.question: What should the UE do when there are QoS flow descriptions that are not associated with any QoS rule after processing all QoS operations on QoS rules and QoS flow descriptions, as indicated in NOTE 5?
q_55149.ground_truth: It is not considered an error if the UE is not in NB-N1 mode.

q_55150.question: How does the UE determine the factor and time for MMTEL-Voice while initializing the local variables if the SSAC-BarringForMMTEL-Voice relation is present?
q_55150.ground_truth: If the UE has valid Access Classes and at least one of the corresponding bits in the ac-BarringForSpecialAC is set to zero, the UE sets BarringFactorForMMTEL-Voice to one and BarringTimeForMMTEL-Voice to zero, otherwise, the UE sets the factors and time to the value of ac-BarringFactor and ac-BarringTime included in ssac-BarringForMMTEL-Voice, respectively.

q_55151.question: In what scenario can another UE transmit unicast PSCCH/PSSCH transmissions sharing the initiated channel occupancy within the RB set(s)?
q_55151.ground_truth: If the destination and source IDs in the corresponding SL control information match the source and destination IDs, respectively, in the unicast PSCCH/PSSCH transmission carrying the channel occupancy information or match a pair of additional source and destination IDs and associated cast type if provided by the channel occupancy sharing information and the corresponding COT sharing cast type indicates '10' value for unicast cast type.

q_55152.question: What is the applicability of the test in clause 6.1.12?
q_55152.ground_truth: The test in clause 6.1.12 applies to all types of E-UTRA FD-FDD UE release 13 and forward of UE category M1 and higher, including non-BL/CE UE, with support for CEModeB.

q_55153.question: What does the "origin" header field parameter in the "Resource-Share" header field identify?
q_55153.ground_truth: The "origin" header field parameter in the "Resource-Share" header field is used to identify the source of the resource sharing information. It can indicate that the application server or the P-CSCF that included the Resource-Share header field is serving the UE sending the initial INVITE request (session-initiator), or the application server or the P-CSCF that included the Resource-Share header field is serving the UE receiving the initial INVITE request (session-receiver).

q_55154.question: What is the purpose of the Interoperability ID in this discussed solution?
q_55154.ground_truth: The Interoperability ID is a list of Vendor IDs that are allowed to access the ML models in the ADRF.

q_55155.question: What is the purpose of the intent-driven management for 5GC fault management?
q_55155.ground_truth: The intent-driven management for 5GC fault management uses intent expectation to express the intent of fault detection and recovery for 5GC, and to provide particular inputs of fault detection and recovery by setting the name and value of ExpectationTargets.

q_55156.question: What message does the source gNB-DU send to the UE upon deciding to execute LTM to a candidate target cell?
q_55156.ground_truth: The source gNB-DU sends the Cell Switch command to the UE.

q_55157.question: What is the purpose of the RACH Indication procedure initiated by the gNB-DU to inform the gNB-CU about successful random access procedures occurring in the gNB-DU in successful operation?
q_55157.ground_truth: The gNB-CU may trigger retrieval of RACH Reports from the UE upon receiving the RACH INDICATION message.

q_55158.question: What information does the SMF require from the PEGC to initiate PDU session modification for the PINE?
q_55158.ground_truth: The SMF requires at least the PINE ID from the PEGC to initiate PDU session modification for the PINE.

q_55159.question: What is the measurement used for relay reselection trigger evaluation when there is data transmission from U2N Relay UE to U2N Remote UE?
q_55159.ground_truth: SL-RSRP measurements are used for relay reselection trigger evaluation.

q_55160.question: Which protocol is used for the distribution of time in wireless systems, as defined in the 3GPP TS 38.300 standard?
q_55160.ground_truth: PTP, or Precision Time Protocol, is used for the distribution of time in wireless systems, as defined in the 3GPP TS 38.300 standard.

q_55161.question: What kind of action is indicated by the term "may not" in the context of 3GPP Technical Specifications?
q_55161.ground_truth: "May not" in the context of 3GPP Technical Specifications is ambiguous and can be replaced by "might not" or "shall not" depending on the intended meaning.

q_55162.question: What is the impact of transcoding on the end-to-end performance gains when DBI signaling is used between the MTSI sender and MTSI receiver in the packet-switched domain?
q_55162.ground_truth: There may be a possible reduction in the end-to-end performance gains due to the additional delays incurred from transcoding.

q_55163.question: What functions are included in the 5GC Network?
q_55163.ground_truth: The 5G Core Network (5GC) includes a range of functions that work together to provide 5G services. These functions include AMF (Access and Mobility Management Function), SMF (Session Management Function), UPF (User Plane Function), NEF (Network Exposure Function), NWDAF (Network Data Analytics Function), PCF (Policy Control Function), and CHF (Charging Function).

q_55164.question: What 5G technology improvement is highlighted as beneficial for providing more reliable connectivity to M2M devices?
q_55164.ground_truth: The 5G technology improvement highlighted is enhancement of technology evolution and introduction of adequate quality assurance mechanisms to add to warranty.

q_55165.question: What should the VAE-S include in the HTTP POST request when initiating session-oriented service update?
q_55165.ground_truth: The VAE-S should include a Content-Type header field set to "application/vnd.3gpp.vae-info+xml", an application/vnd.3gpp.vae-info+xml MIME body with a <session-oriented-change-info> element in the <VAE-info> root element, a <session-id> element set to the session identifier to be updated, and send the HTTP POST request to the VAE-C.

q_55166.question: What is the maximum power reduction (MPR) for the NTN L-/S-band as specified in 3GPP TR 38.801 ?
q_55166.ground_truth: The maximum power reduction (MPR) for the NTN L-/S-band is the same as for other NTN bands, such as L-band n255 and S-band n256.

q_55167.question: When should the MCPTT UE or MCPTT server perform XML content encryption and integrity protection?
q_55167.ground_truth: The MCPTT UE and MCPTT server should perform XML content encryption and integrity protection before sending a SIP request or SIP response, as specified in clauses 6.6.2.3.1, 6.6.2.3.2, and 6.6.2.5, if confidentiality protection is enabled.

q_55168.question: What is the default maximum number of parallel talkers in a MCPTT group session in on-network MCPTT procedures?
q_55168.ground_truth: The default value of the `<max-number-simultaneous-talkers>` element of the `<list-service>` element of the MCPTT group document is "1".

q_55169.question: What is the purpose of potential solutions for NWDAF analytics-related timing performance management?
q_55169.ground_truth: The purpose of potential solutions for NWDAF analytics-related timing performance management is to monitor NWDAF services failures due to infringement of timing attributes and satisfy the requirements provided in clause 4.7.2.

q_55170.question: What function is provided by the N3IWF for the UE to register with an SNPN over untrusted non-3GPP access for Onboarding?
q_55170.ground_truth: The N3IWF provides a function for the UE to select and connect to the 5GC network of an SNPN and convey the "selected NID" to the AMF, in addition to the "Selected PLMN identity".

q_55171.question: What should be done if the user identified by the MCVideo ID in a SIP INVITE request for an ongoing MCVideo group call is not affiliated to the group identity and the received SIP INVITE request does not contain an emergency indication or imminent peril indication?
q_55171.ground_truth: A SIP 403 (Forbidden) response should be returned with the warning text set to "120 user is not affiliated to this group" in a Warning header field and skip the rest of the steps.

q_55172.question: What is the minimum duration of the period of measurement for the sum of the mean power of the UE at each transmit antenna connector in the channel bandwidth of the radio access mode?
q_55172.ground_truth: The minimum duration of the period of measurement is 1ms.

q_55173.question: What action does the Serving GW take after receiving the "Step 11 triggers the release of the EPS bearer resources" message in the old Serving GW?
q_55173.ground_truth: The Serving GSW acknowledges the message with "Delete Session Response (Cause)" messages and discards any buffered packets for the UE.

q_55174.question: Which organization produces the 3GPP technical report and what is its role?
q_55174.ground_truth: The 3GPP (3rd Generation Partnership Project) produces the technical report. It is a cooperation between seven telecommunications standard development organizations (Associations), which develop, maintain and enhance the technical specifications required for the harmonized global industry convergence of 3GPP systems.

q_55175.question: What is the default number of repetitions for CSI report transmission if the higher layer parameter SP-CSI-MultiplexingMode is enabled?
q_55175.ground_truth: The default number of repetitions for CSI report transmission if the higher layer parameter SP-CSI-MultiplexingMode is enabled is 2.

q_55176.question: What is the maximum duration of time period T2 in the test described in section 5.1.50.4?
q_55176.ground_truth: The maximum duration of time period T2 in the test described in section 5.1.50.4 is 3900 ms.

q_55177.question: What function provides the N1 interface to AMF on behalf of a FN-RG that is not 5G capable and connected via W-5GAN to 5GC?
q_55177.ground_truth: The W-AGF function provides the N1 interface to AMF on behalf of the FN-RG.

q_55178.question: What happens when the network rejects a UE-requested V2X policy provisioning procedure?
q_55178.ground_truth: Upon rejection, the PCF creates a UE POLICY PROVISIONING REJECT message and sends it to the UE with the UPDS cause IE set to indicate the reason for rejection.

q_55179.question: In what circumstances are the procedures for implicit affiliation triggered at the MCPTT server owning the MCPTT group?
q_55179.ground_truth: The procedures for implicit affiliation at the MCPTT server are triggered when an MCPTT user wants to join an MCPTT chat group, initiate an MCPTT emergency group call or MCPTT imminent peril group call, or initiate an MCPTT emergency alert targeted to an MCPTT group, and the MCPTT client is not already affiliated to the MCPTT group.

q_55180.question: What is required to be included in the PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message when the 5G ProSe direct link establishment procedure is for direct communication between the 5G ProSe remote UE and the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE?
q_55180.ground_truth: The PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message shall include the KNRP ID (if existent), the UE PC5 unicast signalling security policy, the Relay service code IE, the UTC-based counter LSB, the UE identity IE (SUCI), the User security key ID IE (UP-PRUK ID or CP-PRUK ID), and the HPLMN ID (if necessary).

q_55181.question: What is the function of the "ProSe identifier to default destination layer-2 ID for unicast initial signalling mapping rules" field in the "ProSe identifier to PC5 QoS parameters mapping rules" section?
q_55181.ground_truth: The "ProSe identifier to default destination layer-2 ID for unicast initial signalling mapping rules" field specifies the mapping of ProSe identifiers to default destination layer-2 IDs for unicast initial signalling in PC5 communications. This is used to determine the destination layer-2 ID for V2X communications.

q_55182.question: What should the MS do if it is in A/Gb mode and tries to camp on a cell for which it does not have service entitlement?
q_55182.ground_truth: The MS should store the forbidden LA identity in a list of "forbidden location areas for regional provision of service" and enter the limited service state.

q_55183.question: What should the NRF do if there is no NF profile registered with it for the NF Service Consumer?
q_55183.ground_truth: The NRF should validate the parameters from the Access token request against the parameters in the NF Service Consumer certificate if there is no NF profile registered with it for the NF Service Consumer.

q_55184.question: What shall be the value of the NAS Downlink Count in the next NAS message?
q_55184.ground_truth: The value of the NAS Downlink Count shall be set to the value that shall be used to send the next NAS message.

q_55185.question: What is the maximum number of possible entries in the stored list of equivalent PLMNs?
q_55185.ground_truth: The maximum number of possible entries in the stored list of equivalent PLMNs is 16.

q_55186.question: What measures does the MCPTT client take when the MCPTT user indicates that he is no longer interested in one or more MCPTT group(s) at the MCPTT client?
q_55186.ground_truth: The MCPTT client checks the `<manual-deaffiliation-not-allowed-if-affiliation-rules-are-met>` element within the `<anyExt>` element of the `<entry>` element corresponding to the group information within the `<GroupList>` list element of the `<anyExt>` element of the `<OnNetwork>` element of the MCPTT user profile document. If this value is set to "true" and the affiliation to the group has been activated due to a rule being fulfilled, the MCPTT client suppresses the MCPTT user's request.

q_55187.question: What is the use of the Energy Supply ID in this use case?
q_55187.ground_truth: The Energy Supply ID is a unique identifier for each point of supply to an energy consumer. With the Energy Supply ID, the distribution system operator (DSO) can identify where the energy supply connects to its feeders and prioritize the recovery of major MNO's sites such as base stations and core network sites in the distribution system of energy service.

q_55188.question: What is the energy efficiency of 5GC based on the useful output of 5GC user plane KPI?
q_55188.ground_truth: EE5GC,UO,UP,DV = (Useful Output of 5GC user plane) / (Energy Consumption of 5GC) The higher UsefulOutput5GC is for a unit of EC5GC, the higher the generic 5GC EE KPI is, i.e. the more energy efficient the 5GC is.

q_55189.question: What should be done to Cell 2 during time duration T2?
q_55189.ground_truth: Cell 2 should be powered OFF during time duration T2.

q_55190.question: When can the per TA restricted S-NSSAIs be provided to the AMFs of the AMF Sets?
q_55190.ground_truth: They can be provided at the setup of the network and whenever changed.

q_55191.question: In the procedure for session termination at an Application Server based on service logic, what is the role of the S-CSCF?
q_55191.ground_truth: The S-CSCF evaluates the filter criteria and routes the request towards the AS identified by the filter criteria, where the session is then terminated instead of allowing it to continue on to the address end user.

q_55192.question: What should the MME do when it receives an MBMS Session Stop Request from a different MBMS GW than the MBMS GW that currently controls the MBMS session?
q_55192.ground_truth: The MME should reject the MBMS Session Stop Request received for an on-going MBMS bearer service from a different MBMS GW than the MBMS GW that currently controls the MBMS session.

q_55193.question: What are the two parts of the solution provided in Solution #1 inform UE and AF about network timing synchronization status?
q_55193.ground_truth: The two parts of the solution are enabling UEs and AFs to learn about network timing synchronization status and informing 5GC and AFs about network timing synchronization status.

q_55194.question: What should the UE include in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message when it requests to delete a QoS flow description due to errors in QoS operations?
q_55194.ground_truth: The UE should include the 5GSM cause IE in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message when it requests to delete a QoS flow description due to errors in QoS operations.

q_55195.question: When does the MS need to increment the service request attempt counter and abort the procedure if timer T3317 expires?
q_55195.ground_truth: If the MS is in PMM-IDLE mode, the MS shall increment the service request attempt counter, abort the procedure and release locally any resources allocated for the service request procedure, except for certain conditions.

q_55196.question: What is the purpose of the signal information element?
q_55196.ground_truth: The signal information element is used to convey information to a user regarding tones and alerting signals.

q_55197.question: What message does the HSS send to the MME after storing the PDN GW identity or the "PDN GW currently in use for emergency services"?
q_55197.ground_truth: The HSS sends a Notify Response message to the MME.

q_55198.question: What is the name of the network node that assigns the same 5G-GUTI for use over both 3GPP and Non-3GPP access when the UE is successfully registered to the same PLMN via both accesses?

q_55199.question: What happens to the usage monitoring if the usage thresholds for a Monitoring key are not provided in the acknowledgement of a PDU Session modification where its usage was reported?
q_55199.ground_truth: If the usage thresholds for a Monitoring key are not provided in the acknowledgement of a PDU Session modification where its usage was reported, then the usage monitoring shall not continue in the SMF for that Monitoring key.

q_55200.question: What are the different code rates for MPDCCHs realized by?
q_55200.ground_truth: Aggregating different numbers of enhanced control channel elements.

q_55201.question: What must be included in a MESSAGE request for page-mode messaging over the II-NNI?
q_55201.ground_truth: A MESSAGE request containing a body carrying payload or the "application/im-iscomposing+xml" MIME body should be supported at the II-NNI for page-mode messaging.

q_55202.question: Which type of NR UE released since version 15 is applicable for the test case described in section 6.3A.1.1.3?
q_55202.ground_truth: This test case applies to all types of NR UE release 15 and forward that support intra-band contiguous 2UL CA.

q_55203.question: What should be included in a response message if the Cause contains a value that indicates that the request is not accepted?
q_55203.ground_truth: The Cause IE at the message level should be included in the response, regardless of whether there are other mandatory or conditional IEs defined for the given response message.

q_55204.question: What is the newer version of ResumeMAC-I/shortResumeMAC-I used for in the 5G system?
q_55204.ground_truth: The newer version of ResumeMAC-I/shortResumeMAC-I is used in the 5G system if supported by both the source and target gNB/ng-eNB and the UE.

q_55205.question: What should the System Simulator do if the contention resolution is successful?
q_55205.ground_truth: The System Simulator should send an ACK message to the UE.

q_55206.question: In what type of sidelink communication is the Sidelink DRX Command MAC CE used?
q_55206.ground_truth: The Sidelink DRX Command MAC CE is only supported in sidelink unicast.

q_55207.question: What are the possible values for the minimum speed that can be set for a unit's MCPTT deactivation in the context of network functional aliases?
q_55207.ground_truth: The minimum speed that can be set for a unit's MCPTT deactivation in the context of network functional aliases is a non-negative integer in units of kilometers per hour.

q_55208.question: What is the duration for which a UE stays awake and starts the inactivity timer after successfully decoding a PDCCH indicating the DL-SCH to which this SC-MTCH is mapped?
q_55208.ground_truth: The UE stays awake and starts the inactivity timer for the duration of downlink subframes that the UE waits to successfully decode a PDCCH, from the last successful decoding of a PDCCH indicating the DL-SCH to which this SC-MTCH is mapped, failing which it re-enters DRX.

q_55209.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Report on further architecture enhancements for uncrewed aerial systems and urban air mobility?
q_55209.ground_truth: The purpose is to support additional scenarios and requirements for UAV (Uncrewed Aerial Vehicles) and UAM (Urban Air Mobility) by identifying how and whether existing mechanisms can be re-used, and identifying architectural and functional modifications required.

q_55210.question: What is the role of the Location Triggering Function (LTF) in the LALS triggered location architecture?
q_55210.ground_truth: The LTF is responsible for triggering the IRI-POI in the LI-LCS Client when a specific event related to the target is observed at the co-located IRI-POI or received at the MDF2 in which the LTF is residing.

q_55211.question: Which UE capability shall be supported to perform RSTD measurements when CRS muting is enabled in a cell?
q_55211.ground_truth: The UE capable of supporting CRS muting shall perform RSTD measurements when CRS muting is enabled in a cell for which the UE performs RSTD measurements, provided the CRS are available within at least the PRS bandwidth in the subframes with PRS during all positioning occasions within the RSTD measurement period.

q_55212.question: What is the maximum number of transmissions for the HARQ process when transmitting a MAC PDU stored in the Msg3 buffer?
q_55212.ground_truth: The maximum number of transmissions for the HARQ process when transmitting a MAC PDU stored in the Msg3 buffer is maxHARQ-Msg3Tx.

q_55213.question: What is the difference between RSRP-Range and RSRQ-Range in 5G NR Master-Slice measurement in the "RSRP-RangeSL-r12" and "RSRQ-RangeSL-r12" fields of the RS-Range and RS-RangeNR information elements?
q_55213.ground_truth: RSRP-Range and RSRQ-Range define different sets of value ranges for RSRP and RSRQ measurements and thresholds in 5G NR Master-Slice measurement. RSRP-Range specifies the value range for RSRP measurements and thresholds, while RSRQ-Range specifies the value range for RSRQ measurements and thresholds.

q_55214.question: What data type represents information of a PCF Instance?

q_55215.question: What is the procedure for a UE in limited service state to attach for access to RLOS?
q_55215.ground_truth: The UE shall indicate "EPS RLOS attach" in the EPS attach type IE when initiating the attach procedure for access to RLOS.

q_55216.question: What should the UE do if the frequency band indicated in the freqBandIndicator is not part of the frequency bands supported by the UE, and the UE is not in a barred cell?
q_55216.ground_truth: The UE considers the cell as barred and performs barring as if intraFreqReselection is set to notAllowed.

q_55217.question: What is required for the UE to support secure storage of certificates?
q_55217.ground_truth: The UE should support the secure storage of certificates, which can be performed in an implementation-independent way or over the air.

q_55218.question: What kind of UEs does this test apply to?
q_55218.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA UEs starting from Release 15 that support EN-DC.

q_55219.question: What should the SMF include in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message if it needs to replace the S-NSSAI or mapped S-NSSAI of the PDU session during a network-requested PDU session modification procedure?
q_55219.ground_truth: In this case, the SMF should include the Alternative S-NSSAI IE in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message.

q_55220.question: What should the MCPTT client do if it receives a SIP 4xx response, SIP 5xx response or SIP 6xx response to the SIP re-INVITE request?
q_55220.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should set the MCPTT emergency group state as "MEG 2: in-progress", set the MCPTT emergency alert state to "MEA 3: emergency-alert-initiated" if the response contains an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body with an <alert-ind> element set to a value of "true", or revert the MCPTT emergency alert state to its value prior to entering the current procedure.

q_55221.question: What is the role of the SMF(CTF) in the 5G system for converged charging of Edge Computing with satellite backhaul?
q_55221.ground_truth: The SMF(CTF) provides the charging information to support the Edge Computing charging with satellite backhaul by sending the Charging Data Request including satellite backhaul charging information.

q_55222.question: Under what circumstances shall the MME locally deactivate all EPS bearer contexts associated to the PDN connection with the default EPS bearer context without peer-to-peer ESM signalling to the UE?
q_55222.ground_truth: If the default bearer is associated with the last remaining PDN connection of the UE in the MME and EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection is supported by the UE and the MME.

q_55223.question: What should the UE do if the end of unavailability period report indicates "UE does not need to report end of unavailability period" upon returning in coverage of a TAI in the current registration area after discontinuous coverage?
q_55223.ground_truth: The UE does not need to perform a registration procedure for mobility registration update.

q_55224.question: What steps should the MCData client take when receiving a CSK key download message?
q_55224.ground_truth: The MCData client shall operate as specified in clause 7.2.5.

q_55225.question: What message type is sent by the network to the UE in order to carry an application message in encapsulated format?

q_55226.question: What action should the UE take when it is reporting N3C indirect path failure?
q_55226.ground_truth: The UE should include n3c-relayUE-InfoList to report relay UE information with non-3GPP connection(s) if available.

q_55227.question: In the AR-MTSI client procedure, what action does the STAR UE take after receiving a 200 OK in step 11?
q_55227.ground_truth: The STAR UE sends a SIP ACK message to acknowledge that the call has been established.

q_55228.question: What are the valid options for the codebookType when performing interference measurement on NZP CSI-RS?
q_55228.ground_truth: The valid options for the codebookType when performing interference measurement on NZP CSI-RS are 'typeII-CJT-r18', 'typeII-CJT-PortSelection-r18', 'typeII-Doppler-r18', or 'typeII-Doppler-PortSelection-r18'.

q_55229.question: What is the expected @codecs parameter value on the Adaptation Set level for the AAC-ELDv2 Operation Point in a DASH Media Presentation Description?
q_55229.ground_truth: The @codecs parameter is expected to be set to 'AAC-ELDv2' on the Adaptation Set level for the AAC-ELDv2 Operation Point in a DASH Media Presentation Description.

q_55230.question: What is the effect of the UE receiving the IP address of the PDN Gateway in the Registration Reply message from the FA?
q_55230.ground_truth: The UE should include the PDN Gateway address in the Home Agent address field of subsequent RRQ messages, ensuring that all traffic will go through the PDN GW in the handover process.

q_55231.question: What does the field CSI-RSRP-Range specify within the CSI-RSRP measurements, and what is the field value range?
q_55231.ground_truth: The CSI-RSRP-Range field specifies the value range used in CSI-RSRP measurements, with an integer value ranging from 0 to 97 as specified in TS 36.133.

q_55232.question: When must the AMF remove the policy context for the UE and send an acknowledgement including success or failure in the context of AM Policy Association Termination?
q_55232.ground_truth: After the AMF decides to terminate the AM Policy Association during Deregistration procedure or due to mobility with change of AMF and PCF in the registration procedure or handover procedure.

q_55233.question: What is the purpose of the MME Status Transfer procedure in the handover process?
q_55233.ground_truth: The MME Status Transfer procedure is used to transfer the uplink PDCP-SN and HFN receiver status and the downlink PDCP-SN and HFN transmitter status from the source to the target eNB via the MME during an S1 handover for each respective E-RAB for which PDCP-SN and HFN status preservation applies.

q_55234.question: What is the purpose of the PDN GW Identity Notification from AAA Server procedure?
q_55234.ground_truth: The PDN GW Identity Notification from AAA Server procedure is used for PDN GW registration, where the 3GPP AAA Server updates the HSS with the PDN GW identity of the selected PDN GW and the APN associated with the UE's PDN Connection.

q_55235.question: What requirement is set for the IMS-ALG related to the ECN negotiation for multimedia priority service?
q_55235.ground_truth: The IMS-ALG shall prohibit the negotiation of ECN during SDP offer/answer exchanges associated with multimedia priority service by removing any ECN attribute "a=ecn-capable-rtp" from the SDP offer and shall not invoke ECN for SIP transactions associated with multimedia priority service.

q_55236.question: What is the requirement for the data producer in streaming trace reporting method in Trace Session activation?
q_55236.ground_truth: In case of streaming trace reporting method being selected, the data producer shall establish the connection to the data consumer upon Trace Session Activation and provide data consumer with information about Trace Session.

q_55237.question: What is the target accuracy requirement for sidelink positioning in Release 17 NR?
q_55237.ground_truth: The target accuracy requirement for sidelink positioning in Release 17 NR is less than 1 meter.

q_55238.question: What occurs when the entering condition for a specific event is fulfilled for one or more applicable cells after layer 3 filtering during the timeToTrigger for this event, and the VarMeasReportList does not include a measurement reporting entry for the corresponding measId?
q_55238.ground_truth: A first cell triggers the event and a measurement reporting entry is included within the VarMeasReportList for this measId.

q_55239.question: In the 'Releasing' state, what actions does the floor control arbitration logic take when it receives an MCPTT call release step~2 request from the application and signalling plane?
q_55239.ground_truth: The floor control arbitration logic releases all resources reserved in the media plane, including any running timers, and enters the 'Start-stop' state.

q_55240.question: What is the purpose of the keep-alive procedure in 5G ProSe direct link?
q_55240.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe direct link keep-alive procedure is used to check the viability of the link between two UEs and to ensure that it is still valid.

q_55241.question: What is the function of the DeNB in the E-UTRA radio interface protocols?
q_55241.ground_truth: The DeNB supports a subset of the UE functionality and protocols to wirelessly connect to the eNodeB. It also embeds and provides S-GW/P-GW-like functions for RN operation, managing EPS bearers and terminating S1-AP and S11 interfaces.

q_55242.question: What is the purpose of ETC1 in 4.10.1?
q_55242.ground_truth: The purpose of ETC1 in 4.10.1 is to test all BS requirements excluding CA occupied bandwidth, using the two outermost carriers within each supported operating band for receiver tests.

q_55243.question: What is the meaning of the "base-time" parameter in the "RegRetryBaseTime" leaf?
q_55243.ground_truth: The "base-time" parameter in the "RegRetryBaseTime" leaf represents the base-time value (if all failed) parameter of the algorithm defined in subclause 4.5 of RFC 5626.

q_55244.question: When does an MS consider a PLMN as a PLMN selection candidate for satellite NG-RAN or satellite E-UTRAN?
q_55244.ground_truth: An MS considers a PLMN as a PLMN selection candidate for satellite NG-RAN or satellite E-UTRAN if it is not part of the list of "PLMNs not allowed to operate at the present UE location" or if the current MS location is not known, and a geographical location is stored for the entry of the PLMN and the distance to the current MS location is larger than a MS implementation specific value.

q_55245.question: What information is used for IMS domain correlation?
q_55245.ground_truth: The IMS charging correlation is based on IMS Charging Identifier (ICID), access network charging identifier, and IOI.

q_55246.question: How is the value of Ntotal calculated in the context of SSB resource occasions within a window W?
q_55246.ground_truth: Ntotal is the total number of SSB resource occasions within the window W, including those overlapped with measurement gap occasions or SMTC occasions within the window.

q_55247.question: What is the role of the SDS distribution function in the MCData server's media plane?
q_55247.ground_truth: The SDS distribution function in the MCData server's media plane is responsible for distributing short data, which can be in the form of text, hypertext, binary string, or location information.

q_55248.question: In what situations would the MAC entity consider the SR transmission as a prioritized SR transmission?
q_55248.ground_truth: The MAC entity would consider the SR transmission as a prioritized SR transmission if an SL-PRS resource overlaps with the PUCCH resource for the SR transmission occasion for the pending SR triggered as specified in clause 5.22.1.5, and the priority of the triggered SR determined as specified in clause 5.22.1.5 is higher than the priority of the MAC PDU and SL-PRS, if available, determined as specified in clause 5.22.1.3.1a for the SL-PRS resource.

q_55249.question: In the 5G NSWO use case, what is the NAI format for PLMNs and SNPNs?

q_55250.question: What should a UE do if it does not have the required TCI-state information to receive PDCCH and PDSCH in a new BWP?
q_55250.ground_truth: The UE should use old TCI-states before the BWP switch until a new MAC CE updating the required TCI-state information for PDCCH and PDSCH is received after the BWP switch.

q_55251.question: Which two values from the Node Identifier must be present and non-zero when the Node Identifier contains a SGSN Identifier or MME Identifier?
q_55251.ground_truth: Both the Node Name and the Node Realm should be present and neither the Length of Node Name nor the Length of Node Realm should be zero, when the Node Identifier contains a SGSN Identifier or MME Identifier.

q_55252.question: What message does the source eNodeB send to the source MME when it has decided to initiate an Inter-RAT handover to the target access network, UTRAN Iu mode?
q_55252.ground_truth: Handover Required (S1AP Cause, Target RNC Identifier, CSG ID, CSG access mode, Source to Target Transparent Container) message.

q_55253.question: What is the formula for entering condition for event C2 to be satisfied?
q_55253.ground_truth: Inequality C2-1 must be satisfied for the entering condition for event C2.

q_55254.question: What should a UE utilize when transmitting SL-SSB in a shared COT with a COT initiating UE?
q_55254.ground_truth: A UE can utilize a COT shared by a COT initiating UE when it intends to transmit SL-SSB in the shared COT.

q_55255.question: What is the method used to synchronize the stimuli and degraded condition before applying the P.863 algorithm?
q_55255.ground_truth: The synchronization between stimuli and degraded condition is done by the test system before applying the P.863 algorithm on each sentence pair.

q_55256.question: What UE classes are incompletely tested for the NR SA FR2 SSB-based L1-RSRP measurement in DRX?

q_55257.question: What information does the UDM provide in step~4a if the Access Network Identity is different from "5G:NSWO"?
q_55257.ground_truth: The UDM provides the QoS Info in step~4a if the Access Network Identity is different from "5G:NSWO".

q_55258.question: What is the function of UE unaware indication and user unaware indication in sol#14?
q_55258.ground_truth: UE unaware indication is provided by LCS Client/AF when the target UE is in CM_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE state, and it does not page the UE during the positioning procedure. User unaware indication skips the interaction between network and user during the positioning procedure.

q_55259.question: What event causes the overall delays measured in the test to be up to 2xTTIDCCH higher than the measurement reporting delays because of TTI insertion uncertainty of the measurement report in DCCH?
q_55259.ground_truth: The ECGI reporting delay occurs due to the delay uncertainty when inserting the ECGI measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH. In case DRX is used, the ECGI reporting may be delayed until the next DRX cycle.

q_55260.question: What service does the EF3GPPPSDATAOFFservicelist file contain if present?
q_55260.ground_truth: A list of particular IMS services not defined by 3GPP, where each such IMS service is identified by an IMS communication service identifier.

q_55261.question: In Solution #14 and #19, when is a LMF involved in Sidelink positioning and ranging, and what is the reference point between UEs?
q_55261.ground_truth: A LMF is involved in Sidelink positioning and ranging when at least one of the Target UE or the Reference UE is in the network coverage. In Solution #14 and #19, the PC5 reference point between UEs is used with non-IP PDCP SDU types or "unstructured" PDCP SDU types for 5G ProSe UEs.

q_55262.question: What action must the PCF take if the SMF indicates that the lowest priority Alternative QoS parameter set cannot be fulfilled?
q_55262.ground_truth: The PCF must indicate to the AF that the lowest priority QoS Reference or the lowest priority set of Requested Alternative QoS Parameters of the Alternative Service Requirements cannot be fulfilled.

q_55263.question: How does the MMBP player model work in this specification?
q_55263.ground_truth: The MMBP player model describes the components of an MMBP player, including the MMBP parser, sub-part processors, and the rendered message output. The MMBP parser is responsible for receiving the MMBP and playback instructions, with the client providing the sub-parts for processing and decoding. The rendered message output may be handed back to the Messaging Service client or rendered directly.

q_55264.question: What should be done if the UE does not have any Access Classes with a value in the range 11..15 which is valid for the UE to use?
q_55264.ground_truth: In this case, BarringFactorForMMTEL-Voice and BarringTimeForMMTEL-Voice are both set to one.

q_55265.question: What is the reused requirement for adjacent channel leakage power ratio (ACLR) for ATG base station transmitters?
q_55265.ground_truth: The reused requirement for ACLR for ATG base station transmitters is 45 decibels relative to the carrier (dBc).

q_55266.question: What should a UE do if it is provided by higher layers to transmit a CSI-RS or PDSCH in a set of symbols and it detects a DCI format with a slot format value other than 255?
q_55266.ground_truth: The UE would have to cancel the CSI-RS reception or PDSCH reception in the set of symbols if the slot format value is other than 255, and if the subset of symbols from the set of symbols is indicated as uplink or flexible in the DCI format or if the UE detects a DCI format indicating to transmit PUSCH, PUCCH, SRS, or PRACH in the set of symbols.

q_55267.question: What is the difference between AMFLocationUpdate and MMELocationUpdate records in the context of location acquisition?
q_55267.ground_truth: AMFLocationUpdate and MMELocationUpdate are both records used in location acquisition, but they are specific to the 5GC and EPC networks, respectively. They contain location information about the target UE and are generated by the LARF when it detects that MME/AMF returns the location for the corresponding LARF transaction.

q_55268.question: What is the applied approach for inter-band EN-DC including FR2 for UL MIMO in clause 7.3B.2.4D?
q_55268.ground_truth: An LTE anchor agnostic approach is applied and only NR carriers need to be tested.

q_55269.question: In Solution #31, what happens when the target UE is out of coverage?
q_55269.ground_truth: In Solution #31, when the target UE is out of coverage, the GMLC determines to use Network assisted sidelink positioning to locate the target UE and selects a Located UE based on the target area. The LMF then triggers the LCS procedure of the Located UE to get the location of the Target UE.

q_55270.question: What should the UE indicate in the Extended Service Request message when it sends a Response to a paging indication in both EMM-IDLE and EMM-CONNECTED modes?
q_55270.ground_truth: The Response is indicated in the CSFB response information element in the EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message in both EMM-IDLE and EMM-CONNECTED modes.

q_55271.question: What is the minimum and maximum length of the list of user info ID information element?
q_55271.ground_truth: The list of user info ID information element has a minimum length of 4 octets and a maximum length of 257 octets.

q_55272.question: What does the "CellMeasurementResult-Item" sequence represent?
q_55272.ground_truth: The "CellMeasurementResult-Item" sequence represents a collection of measurements for each cell in the network.

q_55273.question: What are the QoS parameters that the PCF derives in the process of 5G QoS Identifier (5QI), Authorized Allocation and Retention Priority (ARP) and Authorized Maximum/Guaranteed Data Rate DL parameters derivation?
q_55273.ground_truth: The PCF derives the Authorized QoS parameters from the MBS service information, including the Authorized 5QI, ARP, Authorized Maximum/Guaranteed Data Rate DL parameters, Priority Level (PL), Averaging Window (AW) and Maximum Data Burst Volume (MDBV).

q_55274.question: What happens when UEs in CM-IDLE state using an NTN RAN with discontinuous coverage in the same geographical area recover to be in coverage due to the expiration of the Periodic Registration Update timer?
q_55274.ground_truth: Signalling overload will occur as UEs may simultaneously initiate the Periodic Registration Update procedure and service Request procedure, leading to the arrival of multiple 5G NAS procedures at 5G CN.

q_55275.question: Which network entity performs the analysis of the destination address in the Serving-CSCF/MGCF to Serving-CSCF/MGCF procedures?
q_55275.ground_truth: The Serving-CSCF handling session origination performs the analysis of the destination address.

q_55276.question: What is the main difference between hybrid services and regular services in 5GMS content delivery?
q_55276.ground_truth: Hybrid services allow for a basic service to be available on both unicast and eMBMS, with potential additional user experiences on unicast, while regular services are only available on one delivery network.

q_55277.question: What is the purpose of the MDT PLMN List IE?
q_55277.ground_truth: The MDT PLMN List IE provides the list of PLMN allowed for MDT.

q_55278.question: What approach does Solution #12 propose to reduce service interruption during handover of user equipment (UE) in AMF-MBSR?
q_55278.ground_truth: Solution #12 proposes a full migration approach with a 2-step handover procedure, where the first step is MBSR handover without F1 anchor change, and the second step is UE handover trigger.

q_55279.question: In clause 7.6.1.5, what is the meaning of HTTP error handling being "supported" as specified in clause 6.7?
q_55279.ground_truth: This means that the API will follow the HTTP error handling rules as defined in clause 6.7, such as returning appropriate HTTP status codes for different types of errors.

q_55280.question: Under what circumstances would the UE send a PMFP PLR count request message over the QoS flow of the non-default QoS rule?
q_55280.ground_truth: The UE sends a PMFP PLR count request message over a QoS flow of the non-default QoS rule if it intends to measure the PLR of the SDF (Selected Data Flow) over a non-default QoS rule. Otherwise, it sends the message over the QoS flow of the default QoS rule.

q_55281.question: What action does the UE take upon receiving N311 consecutive "in-sync" indications for the PCell from lower layers while T315 is running?
q_55281.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T315.

q_55282.question: What should the PCF include within the TrafficControlData data instance if the PDU session should be correlated via a common DNAI?
q_55282.ground_truth: The PCF should include within the TrafficControlData data instance the "traffCorreInd" attribute set to true.

q_55283.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement specified in clause 11.6.2.4.3 for NR SA FR1 inter-frequency SS-RSRQ measurement accuracy on a carrier frequency with CCA?
q_55283.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clauses 11.6.2.0.3 and 11.6.2.0.4 for absolute and relative accuracy under CCA, respectively.

q_55284.question: What action should the ePDG take upon receiving an uplink IP packet via an ePDG's ESP SPI bound to an S2b bearer of the PDN connection?
q_55284.ground_truth: The ePDG shall forward an uplink IP packet received via an ePDG's ESP SPI bound to an S2b bearer of the PDN connection using the S2b bearer.

q_55285.question: What should the new NG-RAN node do when it receives the PC5 QoS Parameters IE in the RETRIEVE UE CONTEXT RESPONSE message for MBS session resources context?
q_55285.ground_truth: If supported, the new NG-RAN node should use this information to establish an NG-RAN MBS session resources context.

q_55286.question: What is the attribute that should be included when the UL and DL flows are defined in different media subcomponents and require Round-Trip delay monitoring over two QoS flows?
q_55286.ground_truth: The "rttFlowUlref" attribute or the "rttFlowDlref" attribute should be included with the reference to the flow number and, optionally, media number that describe the UL and DL respectively.

q_55287.question: Which network elements are associated with MSC-S-InterfaceList?

q_55288.question: How is the receiver handling duplicated PDUs in the RSM mechanism?
q_55288.ground_truth: The receiver retains the PDU that arrives at the destination first and discards the one arriving later.

q_55289.question: What is the function of I-SMF in terms of local traffic steering when it is inserted into a PDU Session?
q_55289.ground_truth: The I-SMF is responsible for the insertion, modification and removal of UPF(s) to ensure local traffic steering. It determines which DNAI(s) are to be selected, selects UPFs acting as UL CL/BP and/or PDU Session Anchor based on the DNAI(s) of interest for this PDU Session.

q_55290.question: What information is included in the notification of QoS sustainability analytics?
q_55290.ground_truth: The notification of QoS sustainability analytics includes Analytics ID = "QoS Sustainability", target of analytics reporting (any UE), analytics filter information (5QI and additional QoS parameters or QoS characteristics attributes), location information, S-NSSAI (optional), analytics target period, reporting threshold(s), notification correlation id, and notification target address.

q_55291.question: What is the purpose of the MMBP metadata parameters in this specification?
q_55291.ground_truth: The MMBP metadata parameters provide information about the MMBP, such as the media type, size, accessibility, and processing requirements. They help the client decide which MMBP to playback and how to process it.

q_55292.question: What is the NAS COUNT behavior when NIA0 is used for integrity protection in 5G NAS messages?
q_55292.ground_truth: When NIA0 is used for integrity protection in 5G NAS messages, if the NAS COUNT values wrap around, the NAS connection shall be kept even if a new KAMF has not been established before the NAS COUNT wrap around.

q_55293.question: What is the defined measurement reporting delay excluding for event triggered measurement reporting, assuming no delay from other RRC signaling on the DCCH and excluding a delay uncertainty from inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH?
q_55293.ground_truth: The defined measurement reporting delay for event triggered measurement reporting, assuming no delay from other RRC signaling on the DCCH and excluding a delay uncertainty from inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH, is the time between an event that will trigger a measurement report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface.

q_55294.question: In which scenario will the "plmnId" attribute and "dnn" and "snssai" attributes be provided in the NsmfEventExposureNotification data structure?
q_55294.ground_truth: If the "HR-SBO" feature is supported and the SMF determines that the UE has moved to a serving PLMN in which local traffic offload is allowed.

q_55295.question: What is the issue described in clause 5.4.2 within the context of CCA?
q_55295.ground_truth: The issue described in clause 5.4.2 is that, even if there is a minimum level of trust, the CCA validity time cannot avoid the threat of an SCP sending a service request and receiving a valid service response on behalf of an NF Service Consumer, without the explicit authorization of the Consumer.

q_55296.question: What is the role of the AS (Application Server) in the originating session-based messaging procedure?
