q_55765.question: What should the UE do when it receives a valid NAS signalling message without integrity protection after the NAS security mode control procedure has been successfully completed?
q_55765.ground_truth: The UE should discard this NAS signalling message.

q_55766.question: Which reporting trigger, indicated in Octet 5 of the Reporting Triggers IE, is triggered when no packets have been received for a period exceeding the User Plane Inactivity Timer?
q_55766.ground_truth: Bit 2, when set to "1", indicates a request for reporting when no packets have been received for a period exceeding the User Plane Inactivity Timer.

q_55767.question: What components contribute to the age of content in the context of gaming?
q_55767.ground_truth: The age of content in gaming consists of the time taken to create one or more video buffers, encode them into a video stream frame, deliver the video frame to the game client, decode the video frame by the game client, and present the video frame to the user.

q_55768.question: In the context of step 11b, how many non-consecutive DTX subframes are allowed during the SCell1 deactivation for inter-band PCC(FDD) and SCells?
q_55768.ground_truth: Up to 2 non-consecutive DTX subframes are allowed during the SCell1 deactivation for inter-band PCC(FDD) and SCells.

q_55769.question: What is required for a UE to connect to a WLAN access network using 5GS credentials without a 5GS registration?
q_55769.ground_truth: The UE has to use a NAI format for 5G NSWO that has a realm different than the realm used for Trusted non-3GPP access to the 5GC.

q_55770.question: What are the two basic mechanisms by which downlink sub-band transmissions can impact the performance in the uplink sub-bands?
q_55770.ground_truth: The two basic mechanisms are unwanted emissions from the downlink sub-bands that occur at frequencies corresponding to the uplink sub-band and cause interference, and a high downlink power from the downlink sub-bands passing through the uplink receiver that can induce interference in the uplink sub-band due to non-linearities in the RF.

q_55771.question: What is the method used for the PFD Management Notification to report the asynchronous PFD management result?
q_55771.ground_truth: The HTTP POST method is used for the PFD Management Notification to report the asynchronous PFD management result.

q_55772.question: What is the method for determining the best non-serving cell on a serving frequency to be included in the MeasurementReport message?
q_55772.ground_truth: The best non-serving cell on a serving frequency is determined based on RSRP, and is the one with the best measured result among the applicable neighboring cells.

q_55773.question: What is the purpose of the Instance Id carried in the Contact header of a SIP request?
q_55773.ground_truth: The Instance Id is used to uniquely identify a specific device among all other devices in a SIP network.

q_55774.question: What information does the SMF use to select a PCF instance when making a delegated discovery and selection in SCP?
q_55774.ground_truth: The SMF includes information such as the SUPI range, results of a discovery procedure with NRF, UE's SUPI, MA PDU session capability of the PCF, PCF Group ID, PCF Set ID, Same PCF Selection Indication, and URSP delivery in EPS capability of the PCF.

q_55775.question: What function can the AF (Application Function) provide in terms of sponsored data connectivity?
q_55775.ground_truth: The AF may provide the PCF with sponsored data connectivity information, including optionally a usage threshold, and may request the PCF to report events related to sponsored data connectivity.

q_55776.question: What is the difference between a Gateway Control session that serves a single IP-CAN session and one that serves all the IP-CAN sessions from the same Care-of address of the UE?
q_55776.ground_truth: A Gateway Control session that serves a single IP-CAN session is used for S-GW/BBERF connecting to PDN-GW using S5/S8 PMIP, while a session that serves all the IP-CAN sessions from the same Care-of address of the UE is used for a UE connecting to PDN-GW using S2c.

q_55777.question: What does the ID id-ServingCellMO-encoded-in-CGC-List represent?
q_55777.ground_truth: The ServingCellMO-encoded-in-CGC-List represents a list of serving cell information that is encoded in the CGC.

q_55778.question: What should the UE do if it detects a cell on a NR carrier whose physical identity is not allowed for that carrier in the measurement control system information of the serving cell?
q_55778.ground_truth: The UE is not required to perform measurements on that cell.

q_55779.question: When shall the UE transmit a MBMSInterestIndication message including the mbms-Priority IE?
q_55779.ground_truth: The UE shall include mbms-Priority if the UE prioritises reception of all indicated MBMS frequencies above reception of any of the unicast bearers.

q_55780.question: What information does the DCSF include in the data channel control request it sends to the AS?
q_55780.ground_truth: The DCSF includes the actions for terminating or forwarding/initiating the application data channel establishment in the data channel control request it sends to the AS.

q_55781.question: When does the EES send an ACR selection notification to the selected EAS?
q_55781.ground_truth: The EES sends an ACR selection notification to the selected EAS providing the selected ACR scenario list after the EEC selects the ACR scenario(s) that should be used for the given AC and selected EAS.

q_55782.question: What should the MS do if an unknown Access Technology Type is received?
q_55782.ground_truth: The MS should ignore all the corresponding fields if the received Access Technology Type is unknown.

q_55783.question: What is the size of the Message type information element?
q_55783.ground_truth: The Message type information element is a type 3 information element with a length of 1 octet.

q_55784.question: What is the procedure for determining the physical cell identity of Cell 2 in the next iteration of the test procedure loop?
q_55784.ground_truth: The SS shall set Cell 2 physical cell identity to ((current cell 2 physical cell identity + 1) mod 14+2) for the next iteration of the test procedure loop.

q_55785.question: What should the P-CSCF do with a 401 (Unauthorized) response received from the S-CSCF when the REGISTER request was challenged?
q_55785.ground_truth: The P-CSCF should delete any temporary set of security associations established towards the UE, remove the "ck" and "ik" WWW-Authenticate header field parameters from the 401 (Unauthorized) response, and bind the values to the proper private user identity and to the temporary set of security associations which will be setup as a result of this challenge. The P-CSCF shall forward the 401 (Unauthorized) response to the UE if and only if the "ck" and "ik" header field parameters have been removed. Additionally, it should insert a Security-Server header field in the response, containing the P-CSCF static signalling plane security list and the parameters needed for this security association setup.

q_55786.question: What is the format of N6RP in the "IP.N6OutLinkUsage.N6RP" measurement of the N6 interface?
q_55786.ground_truth: The format of N6RP is vendor specific

q_55787.question: In single RAT UTRA operation, what shall the emissions inside any sub-block gap not exceed?
q_55787.ground_truth: The emissions inside any sub-block gap shall not exceed the cumulative sum of the minimum requirements specified for the adjacent sub blocks on each side of the sub-block gap.

q_55788.question: What information does the USS send to the UE during the UUAA procedure?
q_55788.ground_truth: The USS sends an Authentication Response message, including the GPSI, the UUAA result, the authorized CAA-level UAV ID, and a UUAA Authorization Payload to the UE.

q_55789.question: What should the floor participant do upon receiving RTP media packets during the 'U: pending Request' state?
q_55789.ground_truth: The floor participant should request the MCPTT client to start rendering the received RTP media packets, start the optional timer T103 (End of RTP media) for the floor participant form which RTP packets were received, and remain in the 'U: pending Request' state.

q_55790.question: How do the MME and HSS maintain sessions when using the Diameter protocol?
q_55790.ground_truth: Between the MME and the HSS and between the SGSN and the HSS, Diameter sessions are implicitly terminated, meaning the server does not maintain state information about the session and the client does not send re-authorization or session termination requests.

q_55791.question: What is the purpose of the MIC field in the PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message?
q_55791.ground_truth: The MIC field is used to verify the integrity protection of the PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message.

q_55792.question: What must the NEF do after receiving information from the LMF2 about the location context transfer operation results in step 3?
q_55792.ground_truth: The NEF releases all resources for the procedure after receiving information from the LMF2 about the location context transfer operation results in step 3.

q_55793.question: What is used to signal the use of JSON format for the content type in the HTTP bodies specified in the specification?
q_55793.ground_truth: The content type "application/json" is used to signal the use of JSON format for the content type in the HTTP bodies specified in the specification.

q_55794.question: How long should a UE consider stored system information to be valid, unless specified otherwise?
q_55794.ground_truth: 3 hours or 24 hours from the moment it was confirmed to be valid.

q_55795.question: What should a UE do if it is in the process of establishing a non-emergency PDN connection without an APN provided by the UE and it has already sent a BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message without an APN?
q_55795.ground_truth: The UE should not send another BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message without an APN and with request type different from "emergency" or "handover of emergency bearer services", or another PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST or BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST message for a non-emergency PDN connection established without an APN provided by the UE, until the UE is switched off or the USIM is removed, or it receives an ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST or DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message for a non-emergency PDN connection established without an APN provided by the UE. The UE may send another BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message in the PLMN for the same APN if the Back-off timer value IE is not included in the network's response.

q_55796.question: What is specified in sub clause 4.4.3 of the document?
q_55796.ground_truth: Sub clause 4.4.3 specifies the common parameters for the simulated NR cells in standalone NR and non-standalone network scenarios.

q_55797.question: In what situation should the RRCEarlyDataComplete message include redirectedCarrierInfo for NB-IoT?
q_55797.ground_truth: When the redirectedCarrierOffsetDedicated is included in the redirectedCarrierInfo.

q_55798.question: What should the IBCF do if the SDP answer contains none of the codecs from the original SDP offer?
q_55798.ground_truth: The IBCF shall select one of the returned codecs and invoke the transcoding function.

q_55799.question: What should the SCC AS do when it receives a SIP BYE request on the Source Access Leg with a specific response code?
q_55799.ground_truth: If the SCC AS receives an initial SIP INVITE request on the Target Access Leg within a time defined by the operator policy after the SIP BYE request reception, then the SCC AS shall not initiate release of the Remote Leg.

q_55800.question: What should the SS do after time duration T1 if the UE has not re-selected Cell 1 and T1 has expired?
q_55800.ground_truth: The SS should switch off and on the UE and continue with step 11.

q_55801.question: What function does the GSMF perform in the 5G VN group management?
q_55801.ground_truth: The GSMF handles a new NF type, registers to NRF, retrieves peer SMFs, manages N19 tunnels and manages UE IP/MAC addresses for VN group communications.

q_55802.question: In case of Emergency Attach, what information is used as the UE Identity to the PCRF when the IMSI is marked as unauthenticated?
q_55802.ground_truth: The IMEI (International Mobile Equipment Identity) is used as the UE Identity in the message to the PCRF.

q_55803.question: In the context of an ADRF, what does the "storeHandl" attribute indicate?
q_55803.ground_truth: The "storeHandl" attribute indicates the storage approach to be followed for the data or analytics, such as the lifetime of the data or analytics and the deletion notification URI.

q_55804.question: In the SP/AP SRS TCI State Indication MAC CE, what field indicates whether to activate or deactivate indicated SP SRS resource set?

q_55805.question: What are the attributes of the InferenceFeedback IOC?
q_55805.ground_truth: The attributes of the InferenceFeedback IOC are: inference report ID, indication of whether there are actions to be taken due to the inference report, and feedback for the inference report in the form of lack of confidence or accuracy for a specific output information element.

q_55806.question: What are the two operations applied in the Ranging/Sidelink Positioning control procedures?
q_55806.ground_truth: UE-only Operation and Network-based Operation are the two operations applied in the Ranging/Sidelink Positioning control procedures. UE-only Operation is applied for cases where neither the Target UE nor SL Reference UE is served by NG-RAN, Network-based Operation is not supported by the 5GC network, or the network allows the UE-only operation for a period of time due to congestion. For any other cases, Network-based Operation is applied.

q_55807.question: With which PLMN identity should the MS initialize the Routing Area Identification in a shared network for GERAN using the A/Gb mode in 3GPP TS 24.008?
q_55807.ground_truth: The chosen PLMN identity should be indicated to the GERAN in the first RLC data block of an upper layer PDU when a foreign TLLI is used by the network sharing supporting MS for transmission.

q_55808.question: What is the function of the "S-NG-RAN node Security Key" information element in the same section of TS 23.501?
q_55808.ground_truth: The "S-NG-RAN node Security Key" information element is used to apply security in the S-NG-RAN node (Next Generation-RAN node). It is used to establish and maintain security in the connection between the AMF and the S-NG-RAN node.

q_55809.question: What is a necessary condition for a UE to be selected for MDT data collection in the gNB-CU-UP?
q_55809.ground_truth: A necessary condition for a UE to be selected for MDT data collection in the gNB-CU-UP is that the serving PLMN is within the Management Based MDT PLMN List.

q_55810.question: Which condition is required for the maximum input level for Intra-band non-contiguous CA in 7.4A.0.2?
q_55810.ground_truth: The condition for maximum input level for Intra-band non-contiguous CA in 7.4A.0.2 requires the same conditions as in 7.4A.0.1.

q_55811.question: What is the function of the AAA-P in the network?
q_55811.ground_truth: The AAA-P in the network acts as a proxy for the NSS-AAA when it belongs to a third party, or when the operator deploys it towards third parties. It is used by the NSSAAF to send the access-request message for authentication/authorization information.

q_55812.question: What action does the UDM take when it receives the UE location information through the registration procedure via TN access?
q_55812.ground_truth: The UDM stores the UE location information received from TN access and provides the UE location information to the AMF.

q_55813.question: What is the maximum length of the Session-Id field in the AA-Request (AAA) command in 3GPP AAA protocol?
q_55813.ground_truth: There is no maximum length of the Session-Id field in the AA-Request (AAA) command.

q_55814.question: What does the "Number of scheduled TB for SC-MTCH" field in the corresponding DCI determine in NPRACH transmission?
q_55814.ground_truth: The "Number of scheduled TB for SC-MTCH" field in the corresponding DCI determines the number of UL subframes in which the UE transmits the physical random access response message for the NPRACH transmission.

q_55815.question: What should a receiving node do when it receives an IE/IE group marked with "Reject IE" in a message that it does not comprehend?
q_55815.ground_truth: The receiving node should reject the procedure and report the rejection of one or more IEs/IE group using the message normally used to report unsuccessful outcome of the procedure.

q_55816.question: What is the difference between a new transmission and a retransmission in the context of a HARQ process?
q_55816.ground_truth: A new transmission is the initial (re)transmission, while a retransmission is any subsequent transmission of the same bundle after the initial transmission.

q_55817.question: What is an AMF within the context of 3GPP 23.501 and 29.510?
q_55817.ground_truth: An AMF (Access and Mobility Management Function) in 3GPP 23.501 and 29.510 is responsible for the network access, mobility management, and session management of UEs.

q_55818.question: What is the name of the data structure used to store and exchange XR Spatial Description information?

q_55819.question: What does the slice profile consist of in the context of network slicing management?
q_55819.ground_truth: The slice profile consists of an associated set of requirements (e.g. those derived from service level requirements) that are applicable to the network slice subnet constituents, such as TN requirements (e.g. set of QoS attributes for the links interconnecting network slice subnet constituent network functions). The slice profile may be common or specific (applicable to only AN network function or only to CN network function network slice subnet constituents).

q_55820.question: What should the UE do after sending the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMPLETE for the ongoing PDU session modification procedure in case 6 if the QoS rule is not the default QoS rule?
q_55820.ground_truth: The UE shall send a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message with 5GSM cause #83 "semantic error in the QoS operation" to delete the QoS rule.

q_55821.question: What is the purpose of the Return Preferred information in the Context Response?
q_55821.ground_truth: The Return Preferred information in the Context Response is an indication by the MME of a preferred return of the UE to the last used EPS PLMN at a later access change to an EPS shared network. Based on this indication, the AMF may store the last used EPS PLMN ID in UE Context.

q_55822.question: What protocol stack is used for the control plane of the SCCH for the PC5 interface in NR sidelink communication?
q_55822.ground_truth: The AS protocol stack for the control plane for SCCH for RRC in the PC5 interface consists of RRC, PDCP, RLC and MAC sublayers, and the physical layer.

q_55823.question: Which command is used to attempt to perform a PS attach if it is not already attached?
q_55823.ground_truth: When the 'S0=n' (n>0) command is received, the MT shall attempt to perform a PS attach if it is not already attached.

q_55824.question: Which file identifies the number of the first record in the LSA Descriptor file forming the LSA?
q_55824.ground_truth: The LSA Descriptor Record Identifier field in the LSA Descriptor file identifies the number of the first record in the LSA Descriptor file forming the LSA.

q_55825.question: What happens during an Emergency Attach when the MME receives an unsuccessful Update Location Response from HSS?
q_55825.ground_truth: The MME shall ignore it and continue with the Attach procedure.

q_55826.question: What requirements should the E-UTRAN intra-frequency measurements under time domain measurement resource restriction meet in section 8.1.2.8?
q_55826.ground_truth: The requirements in sections 8.1.2.8.1 and 8.1.2.8.2 should be met, except for the measurement reporting requirements. The measurement reporting requirements for E-CID RSRP and RSRQ are defined in section 8.1.2.8.3.

q_55827.question: How does the UDR handle multiple optional query parameters defined as an array?
q_55827.ground_truth: The UDR returns Individual Influence Data resources for each matching combination of the values of the elements of the array of the provided query parameters.

q_55828.question: What value should the network set for back-off timer T3346 in the event of general NAS level mobility management congestion control?
q_55828.ground_truth: The network should assign a value for back-off timer T3346 when the service request for mobile originated services is rejected due to general NAS level mobility management congestion control.

q_55829.question: In what situation will the MS deactivate all MBMS contexts locally that are not in SM state PDP-INACTIVE?
q_55829.ground_truth: When the MBMS context status information element is not included in the ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message.

q_55830.question: What is the role of an ML entity loading MnS producer in deploying an ML entity?
q_55830.ground_truth: An ML entity loading MnS producer is responsible for loading the ML entity to the target inference function(s) after the ML entity is trained and tested. This may be done based on a request from the MnS consumer or initiated based on a consumer predefined loading policy.

q_55831.question: What is the name of the first time period in the test procedure, with duration of T1?

q_55832.question: What action does the receiving gNB node take following the receipt of the acknowledgment of the event report from the LMF?
q_55832.ground_truth: The receiving gNB node sends a Subsequent DL SDT message to the UE and includes the NAS message received in step~18. The receiving gNB node then sends an RRC Release message to the UE to keep the UE in RRC INACTIVE state.

q_55833.question: What information is required for a UE to assist GPS initialisation in the ASN.1 definition?
q_55833.ground_truth: The ASN.1 definition for GPS-related information includes the timeInfoUTC-r11 field, which provides the number of seconds since January 1, 1900, at midnight 00:00:00 UTC. The UE may use this information to assist GPS initialisation.

q_55834.question: What is the network slice usage control information provisioning behavior in roaming scenarios?
q_55834.ground_truth: Network slice usage control information provisioning/update/removal by the PCF is not supported in roaming scenarios.

q_55835.question: What happens in the VLR if the HLR receives a request that should be barred due to Operator Determined Barring, and the VLR does not support this feature?
q_55835.ground_truth: The VLR will reject the request with an appropriate phase 1 error, such as illegal SS operation or system failure.

q_55836.question: What is the MBMS HC Indicator field used for in the MBMS IP Multicast Distribution in 3GPP TS 25.413?
q_55836.ground_truth: The MBMS HC Indicator field in the MBMS IP Multicast Distribution is used to indicate if header compression should be used for MBMS user plane data in 3GPP TS 25.413. It is encoded as a one octet long enumeration, with two enumeration values: 0 (indicates "uncompressed-header") and 1 (indicates "compressed-header").

q_55837.question: What is the purpose of increasing the transmission power of cell 5 at the beginning of T2?
q_55837.ground_truth: The purpose of increasing the transmission power of cell 5 at the beginning of T2 is to trigger Event A6.

q_55838.question: What message is sent by the gNB-CU to the AMF to indicate the successful preparation of resources for the outgoing handover from 5GS to EPS for EPS fallback?

q_55839.question: When is the LMF required to perform additional support in the privacy verification process?
q_55839.ground_truth: The LMF may require additional support in the privacy verification process when some of the UEs have different HPLMN, are not in network coverage, or have different serving AMF.

q_55840.question: When is secure exchange of NAS messages established during inter-system change from N1 mode to S1 mode in EMM-CONNECTED mode?
q_55840.ground_truth: Secure exchange of NAS messages is established using NAS security related parameters encapsulated in the AS signalling from the AMF to the UE triggering the inter-system handover, and using the mapped EPS security context in the NAS messages exchanged between the UE and the MME.

q_55841.question: What action should be taken by the participating MCPTT function when composing the SDP offer for a pre-established session?
q_55841.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT function should use the IP address of the participating MCPTT function for MCPTT speech and the offered media plane control channel from the SDP negotiated during the pre-established session establishment.

q_55842.question: What is the interference signal used in the additional BC3 blocking minimum requirement for BS operating in the same geographical area as UTRA TDD?
q_55842.ground_truth: The interference signal is a 1,28 Mcps UTRA TDD signal as specified in 3GPP TS 37.104 Annex A.

q_55843.question: What is the test requirement specified for out-of-band blocking for intra-band non-contiguous EN-DC (2 CCs) in clause 7.6B.3.2?
q_55843.ground_truth: The test requirement is the same as that for NR carrier in clause 7.6.3.5 of TS 38.521-1.

q_55844.question: What does the Certificate Update Orchestrator (CUO) do in the context of bulk certificate updates?
q_55844.ground_truth: The CUO is a network management functionality that monitors various factors such as certificate expiry, revocations, and incoming triggers, and schedules certificate updates in a staggered and prioritized manner to avoid service disruptions during bulk certificate updates.

q_55845.question: When is the SCell activation delay equal to TFirstATRS + Tgap + TATRS + 5ms in the FR1 band?
q_55845.ground_truth: The SCell activation delay is equal to TFirstATRS + Tgap + TATRS + 5ms when the SCell is an FR1 cell, contiguous to an active serving cell in the same band, and fulfills the specified conditions.

q_55846.question: In which situations should the UE include an EPS bearer context status IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message?
q_55846.ground_truth: The UE may include an EPS bearer context status IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message if it has at least one dedicated EPS bearer context active in the UE, if it has established PDN connection(s) of "non IP" or Ethernet PDN type, or if it has locally deactivated at least one dedicated or default EPS bearer context upon an inter-system mobility or inter-system change.

q_55847.question: What should the participating MCData function do with the SDP offer in the received SIP INVITE request from the MCData client?
q_55847.ground_truth: The participating MCData function shall include an SDP offer based on the SDP offer in the received SIP INVITE request from the MCData client in the SIP INVITE request

q_55848.question: What does the username part of the NAI represent in the context of 5GCN registration via a trusted non-3GPP access?
q_55848.ground_truth: The username part of the NAI is not used to identify the UE, it is rather used by the trusted non-3GPP access for TNGF selection.

q_55849.question: Which command code is used for the STR (Session-Termination-Request) Command for STa?

q_55850.question: What is the purpose of the 5GC-MT-LR procedure?
q_55850.ground_truth: The 5GC-MT-LR procedure is used to obtain the current location of a UE in a non-roaming scenario, for a request from an LCS client for a current location of the target UE.

q_55851.question: What does the document define in the context of USIM Application Toolkit?
q_55851.ground_truth: The document defines the interface between the UICC and the ME, the commands, the application protocol, and the mandatory requirements on the UICC and ME for each procedure in the context of USIM Application Toolkit.

q_55852.question: What is the purpose of the KASME in the NAS security of the E-UTRAN?
q_55852.ground_truth: The KASME is a key used for NAS and AS protection in the E-UTRAN. It is derived in the EPC/UE from a NAS level AKA procedure and identified with a key identifier (KSIASME).

q_55853.question: How should messages related to MPS, MCX, and Emergency calls be ranked when it is known by the application sending the message?
q_55853.ground_truth: They should be ranked based on their priority, such as ARP priority level, 5QI priority level, MPS Priority, etc., with MPS and MCX having higher priorities than Emergency calls, and Emergency call related messages having higher priority than the rest of the messages.

q_55854.question: What is the delay requirement when the UE receives a RRC message implying E-UTRAN/UTRAN TDD handover?
q_55854.ground_truth: When the UE receives a RRC message implying E-UTRAN/UTRAN TDD handover, the UE shall be ready to start the transmission of the SYNC-UL within Dhandover seconds from the end of the last TTI containing the RRC MOBILITY FROM E-UTRA command, where Dhandover equals the RRC procedure delay plus the interruption time stated in clause~5.3.2.2.2.

q_55855.question: Based on Solution #12, what is an objective of the 5G system for interactive media services?
q_55855.ground_truth: Based on Solution #12, an objective of the 5G system for interactive media services is to be aware of the PDU set and handle packets of one PDU Set in an integrated manner, with the option to drop the entire PDU Set when one or some PDUs fail to be transmitted.

q_55856.question: How many times does the PC5 unicast link authentication procedure need to be performed to derive a new KNRP, depending on the authentication method used?
q_55856.ground_truth: The number of times the PC5 unicast link authentication procedure needs to be performed to derive a new KNRP depends on the authentication method used.

q_55857.question: What should the E-UTRAN broadcast in a cell for a PLMN to ensure that each Tracking Area (TA) is Earth-stationary in case of moving cells for Cellular IoT over satellite access?
q_55857.ground_truth: The E-UTRAN should change the TA values that are broadcast in a cell's system information as the cell moves to ensure that each TA is Earth-stationary.

q_55858.question: What do values 0 to 127 of the SST field represent?
q_55858.ground_truth: Values 0 to 127 of the SST field belong to the standardized SST range, as defined in 3GPP TS 23.501.

q_55859.question: Upon receiving a Disconnect message in the 'U: Pre-established session in use' state, what actions shall the MCPTT client take?
q_55859.ground_truth: The MCPTT client shall send an Acknowledge message if acknowledgment is required, enter the 'U: Pre-established session not in use' state, and act as specified in clause 6.2.4.

q_55860.question: What should the floor control server do upon receiving a unicast media stop request?
q_55860.ground_truth: The floor control server should notify the media distributor to stop sending media to the MCPTT client and may deallocate associated bearer resources.

q_55861.question: What is the role of the predefined dictionary provided to the UE in the context of UL data compression?
q_55861.ground_truth: The predefined dictionary provided to the UE is used by its compression function to compress data sent in the uplink direction.

q_55862.question: What is the measurement reporting delay defined in Clause 2.2.2.1.3, excluding certain delays?
q_55862.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay is defined as the time between an event that will trigger a measurement report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface, excluding a delay uncertainty resulted when inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH and a delay which caused by no UL resources for UE to send the measurement report.

q_55863.question: How does the UE handle failures occurring consecutively in different cells for NR?
q_55863.ground_truth: The UE stores multiple CEF report entries in the CEF report list for failures occurring consecutively in different cells for NR.

q_55864.question: What is the maximum number of USIMs that can be supported by a commercially deployed UE?
q_55864.ground_truth: Typically, commercially deployed UEs support up to two USIMs, but the 3GPP system is required to support ME with multiple USIMs (on the same UICC or on different UICCs) that are registered at the same time.

q_55865.question: What should the MCVideo client include in the NOTIFY VIDEO PUSH message if the result is set as FAILURE?
q_55865.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should set the Reason IE with the stored failure reason if the result is set as FAILURE in the NOTIFY VIDEO PUSH message.

q_55866.question: What is the first digit in the version number of a 3GPP Technical Specification signifying?
q_55866.ground_truth: The first digit in the version number of a 3GPP Technical Specification signifies the stage of development of the document. A value of 1 indicates that the document has been presented to the TSG for information, a value of 2 means that the document has been presented to the TSG for approval, and a value of 3 or greater indicates that the document is a TSG approved document under change control.

q_55867.question: Which IEs are to be included in the MaxMIMO-LayerPreferenceFR2-2 IE if the UE has a preference for the number of downlink and uplink MIMO layers for each BWP of each FR2-2 serving cell in the cell group, and the UE prefers to reduce the number of maximum MIMO layers of each serving cell operating on FR2 2?

q_55868.question: What action does the AMF take in step 3 based on its support for non-3GPP path switching and the UE's indication in step 1?
q_55868.ground_truth: The AMF indicates whether the UE supports non-3GPP path switching to the V-SMF.

q_55869.question: Which document defines the stage 2 level requirements and signaling flows for the NEF Northbound interface?
q_55869.ground_truth: 3GPP TS 23.502, 3GPP TS 23.247, and 3GPP TS 26.531 define the stage 2 level requirements and signaling flows for the NEF Northbound interface.

q_55870.question: What is the purpose of the Multi-Device (MuD) service in the 3GPP IP Multimedia Subsystem (IMS)?
q_55870.ground_truth: The Multi-Device (MuD) service in the 3GPP IP Multimedia Subsystem (IMS) is an operator specific service that enables a user to use different UEs (User Equipments) that are registered under the same public user identity, providing a synchronization of communication logs between the federated UEs which support communication log.

q_55871.question: What should the UE do if it is triggered by the upper layers to stop responding to solicitation on proximity of a connectivity service via a 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE?
q_55871.ground_truth: The UE should instruct the lower layers to stop monitoring and trigger the corresponding procedure in lower layers as specified in 3GPP TS 38.331 if it is in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode.

q_55872.question: Under what conditions is a UE required to treat a cell as reserved for operator use during cell selection and reselection procedures?
q_55872.ground_truth: A UE assigned to Access Class 11 or 15 operating in its HPLMN/EHPLMN must treat a cell as reserved for operator use during cell selection and reselection procedures if the field cellReservedForOperatorUse for that PLMN is set to "reserved".

q_55873.question: What is the difference between the local NRF deployment model and the NF Service Consumer directly accessing the NRF where the NF Service Producer is registered model?
q_55873.ground_truth: In the local NRF deployment model, NFc goes first to its local NRF, which authenticates NFc and then forwards or redirects the request to the target NRF holding the policy for NFp services. In the NF Service Consumer directly accessing the NRF where the NF Service Producer is registered model, the NF (e.g., AMF) can register and/or be known as OAuth 2.0 client to a PLMN-wide NRF, but can also address a specific NRF directly.

q_55874.question: What is a precondition in the context of QoS-Assured sessions?
q_55874.ground_truth: A precondition is a set of constraints about the session that are introduced during the session initiation, and must be met before the session is established.

q_55875.question: What should the UE do when the back-off timer is not deactivated and is switched to another network (PLMN or SNPN)?
q_55875.ground_truth: The UE should not stop timer T3585 upon a PLMN change, SNPN change, or inter-system change.

q_55876.question: What does the EF (Elementary File) in the 3GPP technical specification contain?
q_55876.ground_truth: The EF is a part of a file which represents a complete logical entity, and each EF has specific attributes e.g. file size, record length, etc. that determine how data is accessed in the file.

q_55877.question: What message type is used in the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay update request?
q_55877.ground_truth: PROSE UE TO UE RELAY UPDATE REQUEST

q_55878.question: What information is provided by the 3GPP AAA server to the ePDG at the SWm Authentication and Authorization procedure or upon request of the ePDG, in the case of untrusted WLAN access?
q_55878.ground_truth: WLAN Access Network location information, which it considers as network provided location, is provided by the 3GPP AAA server to the ePDG at the SWm Authentication and Authorization procedure or upon request of the ePDG, in the case of untrusted WLAN access.

q_55879.question: When does the UE signal its UE Specific DRX Parameters to the Core Network during Attach and Tracking/Routing Area Update procedures?
q_55879.ground_truth: The UE signals UE Specific DRX Parameters during Attach and Tracking/Routing Area Update procedures in E-UTRAN and UTRAN. The UE can propose a DRX cycle length separately for WB-EUTRA and NB-IoT. In NB-IoT, the UE can request UE specific DRX for NB-IoT during Attach and Tracking Area Update procedures if the cell supports it. The eNodeB sends the UE Specific DRX Parameters for the UE's current RAT to the MME in S1 interface Page Request messages, together with information derived from the IMSI, to help determine the DRX cycle length. The UE Specific DRX Parameters are sent from the old CN node to the new CN node as part of the MM context information during mobility.

q_55880.question: What should the MS include in a Service Request message for Iu mode if it has MBMS contexts with an SM state different from PDP-INACTIVE?
q_55880.ground_truth: The MS should include the MBMS context status IE in the Service Request message for Iu mode if it has MBMS contexts with an SM state different from PDP-INACTIVE.

q_55881.question: What should the old V-SMF or I-SMF do during an inter-PLMN procedure with an I-SMF or V-SMF change when returning the attributes of the SM context?
q_55881.ground_truth: The old V-SMF or I-SMF should return the attributes as they were received from the anchor SMF.

q_55882.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement defined in clause 6.3A.4.4.0 for aggregated power tolerance for CA?
q_55882.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirement defined in clause 6.3A.4.4.0 for aggregated power tolerance for CA is the ability of the UE transmitter to maintain its power during non-contiguous transmissions within 21ms in response to 0 dB TPC commands with respect to the first UE transmission and all other power control parameters as specified in TS 38.213 kept constant.

q_55883.question: What should be done when the leaving condition is fulfilled for one or more of the cells included in the cellsTriggeredList for a measurement reporting procedure?
q_55883.ground_truth: When the leaving condition is fulfilled for one or more of the cells included in the cellsTriggeredList for a measurement reporting procedure, the concerned cell(s) should be removed from the cellsTriggeredList, and if the cellsTriggeredList is empty, the measurement reporting entry should be removed from the VarMeasReportList and the periodical reporting timer for this measId should be stopped.

q_55884.question: How does tilting the offset antenna mitigate the impact of beam centre shift to the QoQZ value?
q_55884.ground_truth: Tilting the offset antenna shifts the beam peak position, making the distribution of the field intensity close to symmetric in the quiet zone like the one from the main antenna, and mitigating the impact of beam centre shift to the QoQZ value.

q_55885.question: What message is sent by the gNB-DU to confirm the setup of a multicast context?

q_55886.question: What is the basic requirement for a successful test result?
q_55886.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the total number of successful tests shall be more than 90% of the cases with a confidence level of 95%.

q_55887.question: Which interface is used for requests to start or stop distributing media to participants in the MCVideo call and indications that the media distributor has started or stopped receiving media packets from the network media interface?
q_55887.ground_truth: The interface between the transmission and reception control arbitration logic and the media distributor is used for this purpose.

q_55888.question: What is the action taken when the MAC entity considers the NDI to have been toggled?
q_55888.ground_truth: The presence of a downlink assignment is indicated, and the associated HARQ information is delivered to the HARQ entity for the current TTI.

q_55889.question: When the SMF gets the information about real-time measurements of QoS monitoring parameters for SDFs from the UPF, what should the SMF do when it gets information about uplink packet delay(s)?
q_55889.ground_truth: The SMF shall inform the PCF about the uplink packet delay(s) for the impacted PCC rules.

q_55890.question: What is the significance of the two-way delay budget (TWDB) in the context of data transmission?
q_55890.ground_truth: With the TWDB, as long as the PDUs for UL and DL are delivered within the TWDB, the corresponding PDUs are not counted as lost and thus not included in the PER.

q_55891.question: In the condition for handling PDSCH transmissions in a j-th serving cell, what does M represent?
q_55891.ground_truth: M represents the number of TB(s) in the PDSCH(s).

q_55892.question: When would the IRI-POI in the SMF generate an xIRI containing an SMFUnsuccessfulProcedure record?
q_55892.ground_truth: The IRI-POI in the SMF generates an xIRI containing an SMFUnsuccessfulProcedure record when the IRI-POI present in the SMF detects an unsuccessful procedure or error condition for a UE matching one of the target identifiers provided via LI_X1.

q_55893.question: In what situation would a UE retransmit the DISCOVERY_REQUEST message?
q_55893.ground_truth: When there is no response from the 5G DDNMF after the DISCOVERY_REQUEST message has been successfully delivered.

q_55894.question: What is the role of the CN domain MDA MnS producer in the 3GPP cross domain MDA MnS producer's interactions?
q_55894.ground_truth: The CN domain MDA MnS producer may consume analytics results produced by NWDAF, MnS provided by CN domain management, other MDA MnS producers, management data derived by subnetwork management function(s), and management data derived by element management function(s).

q_55895.question: What should the PCF set when revoking MPS for DTS, in terms of the ARP and 5QI for the default QoS flow and the PCC rules bound to it?
q_55895.ground_truth: The PCF sets the ARP and the 5QI (along with any associated QoS characteristics) as appropriate for its decision, for the default QoOS flow and the PCC rules bound to it that had the same ARP and 5QI as the default QoS flow or had the "defQosFlowIndication" attribute set to true.

q_55896.question: What does the "UnidirectionalQoSSpecification" data type describe?
q_55896.ground_truth: It describes a network Quality of Service specification for media streaming in one direction.

q_55897.question: What information does the PDN GW include in the Modify Bearer Response message if there has been a RAT change towards E-UTRAN and location information change reporting is required and supported in the target MME?
q_55897.ground_truth: The PDN GW includes MS Info Change Reporting Action in the Modify Bearer Response message if there has been a RAT change towards E-UTRAN and location information change reporting is required and supported in the target MME.

q_55898.question: What value should be set for the <Status changing MCVideo User Identity> value if its length is not (2 + multiple of 4) bytes?
q_55898.ground_truth: The <Status changing MCVideo User Identity> value should be padded to (2 + multiple of 4) bytes with padding bytes set to zero if its length is not (2 + multiple of 4) bytes.

q_55899.question: What is the length in octets of the Reception Priority length value item, including the Reception Priority field and spare bits?
q_55899.ground_truth: The Reception Priority length value is '2' octets.

q_55900.question: What conformance requirements apply for the eLAA SCell PUSCH with DCI4A/4B in one step scheduling and two step scheduling?
q_55900.ground_truth: The conformance requirements for the eLAA SCell PUSCH with DCI4A/4B in one step scheduling and two step scheduling are specified in clause 7.1.4.32.0.

q_55901.question: What is the absolute time reference chosen for calculating the Initial Energy (IE)?
q_55901.ground_truth: The absolute time reference chosen is the 1980-01-06 T00:00:19 International Atomic Time (TAI).

q_55902.question: Under what conditions should the participating MCData function include its MSRP URI before the MSRP URI in the "a=path" attribute in the SDP answer?
q_55902.ground_truth: If the IP address is replaced, the participating MCData function should insert its MSRP URI before the MSRP URI in the "a=path" attribute in the SDP answer.

q_55903.question: Which type of fading is used for calculating antenna gain in RAN1 SLS if small scale fading is not modeled?
q_55903.ground_truth: If small scale fading is not modeled, antenna gain is calculated based on the line of sight (LOS) direction instead of the multipath directions.

q_55904.question: Which procedure is triggered when the upper layers request the establishment or resumption of the RRC Connection for Mobile Originated data in MO-EDT?

q_55905.question: What are the three modes supported in Bluetooth positioning methods?
q_55905.ground_truth: The three Bluetooth positioning modes are Standalone (UE performs Bluetooth measurements and computation), UE-assisted (UE provides Bluetooth measurements to the network for computation), and UE-based (UE performs Bluetooth measurements and computation with network assistance).

q_55906.question: What should a network do when it receives a 5GSM message with "missing mandatory IE" error?
q_55906.ground_truth: The network should return a status message (5GSM STATUS) with cause #96 "invalid mandatory information".

q_55907.question: What is the parameter that defines a list of up to four different available slot offset values for an aperiodic SRS-ResourceSet?

q_55908.question: What should the UE do if the cellsTriggeredList for a measId is empty and the periodical reporting timer is running?
q_55908.ground_truth: The UE should remove the measurement reporting entry within the VarMeasReportList for this measId and stop the periodical reporting timer for this measId.

q_55909.question: What is the exception for message contents in 6.6.19.3.5?
q_55909.ground_truth: The exception for message contents in 6.6.19.3.5 is defined in 6.6.19.3.4 regarding SA and FR1 measurement test procedures.

q_55910.question: Which sub-element within the <adaptation> element contains the identity of the VAL UE or VAL group of UEs for whom the network resource adaptation occurs?
q_55910.ground_truth: The sub-element can be either <VAL-ue-id-list> or <VAL-group-id>, both of which contain the identity of the corresponding VAL UE or VAL group of UEs.

q_55911.question: What is the purpose of using NSI ID and NRF in the network selection procedure?
q_55911.ground_truth: The Network Slice Selection Function (NSSF) is used to select the Network Slice instance (NSI) and determine the appropriate NRF (Network Function Repository) to select NFs (Network Functions) or services within the selected NSI. The NSI ID is an optional parameter that may be returned by the NSSF.

q_55912.question: What is the purpose of the MCPTT-9 reference point between the floor control server and the floor participant in the context of MCPTT?
q_55912.ground_truth: The MCPTT-9 reference point provides floor control signalling between the floor control server and the floor participant over a multicast bearer.

q_55913.question: How many emergency PDU sessions can a 5G ProSe Layer-3 relay UE establish during emergency service communication?
q_55913.ground_truth: A 5G ProSe Layer-3 relay UE is allowed to establish 2 emergency PDU sessions during emergency service communication.

q_55914.question: What action will the transmission participant interface take upon receiving a Transmission Request message in the 'P: has no permission' state?
q_55914.ground_truth: The transmission participant interface will send the Transmission Request message to the transmission control server interface and remain in the 'P: has no permission' state.

q_55915.question: What are the conditions for automatically obtaining local emergency numbers when the UE is connected to a PLMN through untrusted non-3GPP access?
q_55915.ground_truth: Local emergency numbers can be provided through DNS query or IKEv2. The UE shall store the local emergency numbers if the UE is connected to a PLMN through non-3GPP access and registered to the same or different PLMN through 3GPP access in the same country. The UE shall not use the received local emergency numbers if it is connected to a PLMN through non-3GPP access and registered to different PLMN through 3GPP access that is not in the same country.

q_55916.question: What is the name of the complex type with the "PLMN-list-type" name that includes an unbounded sequence of PLMN elements with the type "PLMN-info"?
q_55916.ground_truth: The name of the complex type is "PLMN-list-type".

q_55917.question: What is the use of a GPSI in the Network Slice-Specific Authentication and Authorization procedure?
q_55917.ground_truth: A GPSI is used to create an association with the EAP Identity in the EAP ID response message, so the AAA-S can later use it to revoke authorization or to trigger reauthentication.

q_55918.question: What protocol is used to encapsulate Non-IP data for tunneling between the GGSN/P-GW and the AS in the Gi/SGi based Non-IP data delivery?

q_55919.question: In scenario 1 step 5-11, what message is sent from the SMF+PGW-C to the DN-AAA to forward the UE authentication/authorization information?
q_55919.ground_truth: The SMF sends a Diameter DER message to the DN-AAA to forward the UE authentication/authorization information.

q_55920.question: In what situation will the network send the ATTACH REJECT message with the EMM cause set to #15 and include the Extended EMM cause IE with value "E-UTRAN not allowed"?
q_55920.ground_truth: This will happen if the PDN connectivity reject is due to ESM cause #29, subject to operator policies.

q_55921.question: Which HTTP method is used to create a new TMGI Allocation resource for a given SCS/AS in the GMDviaMBMSbyMB2 API?
q_55921.ground_truth: The POST method creates a new TMGI Allocation resource for a given SCS/AS in the GMDviaMBMSbyMB2 API. It is initiated by the SCS/AS and answered by the SCEF.

q_55922.question: What are the two modes for UL scheduling in NB-IoT for the UE in RRC connected mode?
q_55922.ground_truth: The two modes are RACH procedure mode and polling mode.

q_55923.question: What should the core network node to which the mobile station was redirected do with the first message received after the redirection in the MM+CC+SS (via CS domain) message flow if accessed by a release 98 or earlier mobile station, if the send sequence number of the first message received after the redirection and the value of N(SD) received during the redirection procedure are identical?
q_55923.ground_truth: The core network node to which the mobile station was redirected should discard the received message from the mobile station, if the send sequence number of the first message received after the redirection and the value of N(SD) received during the redirection procedure are identical for a release 98 or earlier mobile station.

q_55924.question: What information is included in the locationInfo field of the handover failure report, if detailed location information is available?
q_55924.ground_truth: The locationInfo field includes the locationCoordinates and, if available, horizontalVelocity.

q_55925.question: When does the new AMF perform feature renegotiation in AMF relocation scenarios?
q_55925.ground_truth: The new AMF may perform feature renegotiation in AMF relocation scenarios if the feature "FeatureRenegotiation" is supported and any of the relevant parameters about the UE context need to be updated.

q_55926.question: What algorithm is used to calculate the shortMAC-I value in the RRCConnectionReestablishmentRequest message?
q_55926.ground_truth: The KRRCint key and integrity protection algorithm that was used in the source cell or of the cell in which the trigger for the re-establishment occurred is used to calculate the shortMAC-I value.

q_55927.question: How many sources observed a performance gain between 0.1% and 0.2% for Max rank 1 and CSI feedback overhead C in RU less than or equal to 39%?
q_55927.ground_truth: 5 sources observed a performance gain between 0.1% and 0.2%.

q_55928.question: What information does the "CurrentUpgrade" data type provide?
q_55928.ground_truth: The "CurrentUpgrade" data type specifies whether it is optimal to upgrade the gNB at present.

q_55929.question: What should the UE do when there is no PDCCH addressing the C-RNTI in msg3 transmission?
q_55929.ground_truth: The UE should perform the Random Access Resource selection procedure and transmit with the calculated PRACH transmission power when the Contention Resolution Timer expires and then after the backoff timer expires.

q_55930.question: What does the "AS" leaf node in the "Bandwidth" interior node provide for the video part?
q_55930.ground_truth: The "AS" leaf node in the "Bandwidth" interior node gives the preferred video codec bandwidth by the network for the bearer set-up, including RTP/UDP/IP headers, in kbits/sec.

q_55931.question: What is the procedure to follow if the MME is unable to derive the GUTI from the received P-TMSI and RAI pair after step 12?
q_55931.ground_truth: The bearers are deactivated and/or suspended as in step~22a.

q_55932.question: In what scenario would the MME include the Secondary RAT usage data in the message?
q_55932.ground_truth: The MME includes the Secondary RAT usage data in the message if the Serving GW has been relocated and PGW Secondary RAT reporting is active or if the MME received Secondary RAT usage data in step~9a and the Serving GW has not been relocated.

q_55933.question: What is the role of ECSP management system in relation to EAS, ECS, and EES in the context of 5GC NFs?
q_55933.ground_truth: The ECSP management system is responsible for connecting EAS, ECS, and EES to 5GC NFs based on the connection information provided by the PLMN management system.

q_55934.question: What should the UE do if it receives a new transmission and the TB size is different from the last valid TB size signalled for this TB?
q_55934.ground_truth: The UE may replace the data currently in the soft buffer for this TB with the received data and then attempt to decode the data in the soft buffer for this TB.

q_55935.question: What is the role of AF (Application Function) in Key Issue 6 solutions?
q_55935.ground_truth: The AF plays an important role in the Key Issue 6 solutions by providing the BAT window, consisting of earliest and latest arrival time of traffic, which is used by the NG-RAN to provide a BAT offset for UL and DL directions.

q_55936.question: When can the UE send another PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message for the same S-NSSAI and the same DNN in the current SNPN, after receiving the PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message with the 5GSM cause #29 "user authentication or authorization failed" and the Back-off timer value IE?
q_55936.ground_truth: The UE can send another PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message for the same S-NSSAI and the same DNN in the current SNPN, if the timer value in the Back-off timer value IE indicates neither zero nor deactivated, and it is not running and is not deactivated for the S-NSSAI and the DNN in the current SNPN.

q_55937.question: What is the initial requirement for the channel bandwidth in the test described in 6.1.1.4.2?
q_55937.ground_truth: The initial channel bandwidth used is 10 MHz.

q_55938.question: What is one of the components of the MPQUIC steering functionality used for data transmission in the uplink direction?
q_55938.ground_truth: QoS flow selection & Steering mode selection

q_55939.question: What parameters are required in the QMC report for post-processing purposes?
q_55939.ground_truth: The qoEReference, Client Id, in the reporting container (that represent the UE request session), and recordingSessionId are needed in the QMC collection entity for post-processing purposes.

q_55940.question: What is the purpose of the Range field in the PC5 QoS Flow of 3GPP TS 36.413?
q_55940.ground_truth: The Range field is in the unit of meters, and only used for groupcast communication. It is encoded as a one octet long enumeration with several enumeration values, such as 0 for "m50", and 1 for "m80".

q_55941.question: Which antenna ports are not supported for UE-specific reference signals with extended cyclic prefix?
q_55941.ground_truth: UE-specific reference signals are not supported on antenna ports 9 to 14 with extended cyclic prefix.

q_55942.question: What should be the value of BarringFactorForMMTEL-Voice and BarringTimeForMMTEL-Voice if ssac-BarringForMMTEL-Voice is not present?
q_55942.ground_truth: If ssac-BarringForMMTEL-Voice is not present, then BarringFactorForMMTEL-Voice is set to one and BarringTimeForMMTEL-Voice is set to zero.

q_55943.question: What request-type element can be contained in a SIP INVITE request for SDS session for an originating or terminating participating MCData function?
q_55943.ground_truth: The request-type element can be set to "one-to-one-sds-session" or "group-sds-session".

q_55944.question: What is the expected solution for direct communication between UAVs?
q_55944.ground_truth: Enhanced PC5 is the expected solution for direct communication between UAVs, which can improve performance and connectivity.

q_55945.question: Which clause is the Editor's note present in, relating to 6.3A.4.2.3?

q_55946.question: Which TTI length, other than 1 ms, is the requirement for the UE radio access capability parameters scaled for in NB-IoT?
q_55946.ground_truth: The requirement for the UE radio access capability parameters in NB-IoT is scaled for other TTI lengths, such as a TTI length of 2 ms.

q_55947.question: How does the TWAG determine the bearer to which an uplink packet is routed in a multiple point-to-point connection UE-TWAN setup?
q_55947.ground_truth: The TWAG routes uplink packets to the different bearers based on the incoming WLCP bearer and the corresponding S2a bearer. If no match is found, the uplink data packet shall be sent via the bearer that does not have any uplink packet filter assigned.

q_55948.question: What should the participating MCPTT function do when it receives a SIP request containing a Content-Type header field set to "application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-location-info+xml" and a <Report> element included in the <location-info> root element?
q_55948.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT function should authorize the location report based on the MCPTT ID received. If the MCPTT user is authorized to send a location report, it should use the location information as needed and follow the procedure of clause~6.3.2.4.1 or 6.3.2.4.2 based on if the MCPTT client has entered into or exited from an emergency alert area or a group geographic area.

q_55949.question: What should a UE do when it receives a WLCP BEARER MODIFY REQUEST message with a semantic error in the TFT operation?
q_55949.ground_truth: In case of a semantic error in the TFT operation, such as creating a new TFT when there is already an existing TFT for the WLCP bearer, the UE shall reject the WLCP bearer modify request with cause #41 "semantic error in the TFT operation".

q_55950.question: What is the time period used for calculating the measurement period for UTRA FDD measurements in the E-UTRAN FDD - UTRAN FDD event triggered reporting test?
q_55950.ground_truth: The period used for calculating the measurement period is 480 ms.

q_55951.question: What is the purpose of the application/vnd.3gpp.sms+xml MIME body in the SM-over-IP message?
q_55951.ground_truth: The application/vnd.3gpp.sms+xml MIME body contains the To URI of the receiver of the short message.

q_55952.question: How are the time and frequency resources selected for initial and retransmission transmission opportunities with a sidelink grant?
q_55952.ground_truth: The sets of initial transmission opportunities and retransmission opportunities are considered as the selected sidelink grant and the selected sidelink grant is used to determine the set of PSCCH durations, PSSCH durations, and SL-PRS transmission occasions, if available.

q_55953.question: What is the name of the data type "ConversationManagementType" with a sequence containing elements for managing the hang time of a group and delivered/read dispositions?

q_55954.question: What is the purpose of UE Activity Notification procedure?
q_55954.ground_truth: The UE Activity Notification procedure is used to trigger notifications to the appropriate entities when the UE becomes reachable.

q_55955.question: What is the uplink power control window size specified for NR UE in Release 15 and forward?
q_55955.ground_truth: The uplink power control window size is 1dB (UE power step size) + 0.7dB (UE power step tolerance) + (Test system relative power measurement uncertainty).

q_55956.question: What should the UE do when the PDU session reactivation result IE is included in the REGISTRATION REJECT message and there is at least one PDU session for which the user-plane resources cannot be re-established?
q_55956.ground_truth: The UE should indicate the cause of failure to re-establish the user-plane resources for the affected PDU sessions in the PDU session reactivation result error cause IE.

q_55957.question: What is In-band blocking defined as in the specification?
q_55957.ground_truth: In-band blocking is not applicable in this version of the specification.

q_55958.question: What should be sent as a response when receiving a SIP INVITE request in an early dialog on the originating side?
q_55958.ground_truth: A SIP 404 (Not Found) response should be sent.

q_55959.question: What should be done in case rated total output power is not reached and there are E-UTRA and/or NR channel bandwidths that support rated carrier output power?
q_55959.ground_truth: The narrowest E-UTRA and/or NR channel bandwidths that support rated carrier output power should be selected and alternately placed adjacent to the carriers at the lower and upper Base Station RF Bandwidth edges until the rated total output power or the total number of supported carriers is reached.

q_55960.question: What PDU Set QoS parameters are defined to support PDU Set handling?
q_55960.ground_truth: The PDU Set QoS parameters include PDU Set Error Rate (PSER) and PDU Set Delay Budget (PSDB). PSER defines an upper bound for the rate of PDU Sets that are not successfully delivered, while PSDB defines an upper bound for the delay that a PDU Set may experience for the transfer between the UE and the N6 termination point at the UPF.

q_55961.question: What is the size of the resource block assignment flag field?

q_55962.question: When should the UE start T3411 with the duration of MinRetryTimer if the lower layer fails to establish the RRC connection and does not have a PDN connection for emergency bearer services?
q_55962.ground_truth: If the UE implementation specific attempt counter is less than the value of MaxMinRetry.

q_55963.question: What is the objective of the Graceful network slice termination solution?
q_55963.ground_truth: The objective of the Graceful network slice termination solution is to avoid service disruption caused by an abrupt PDU Session release when terminating a network slice due to planned maintenance or end of network slice lifetime.

q_55964.question: What happens when a multicast MBS session is inactive, and the multicast MBS session is activated again with high number of public safety UEs?
q_55964.ground_truth: The AMF maintains the complete group paging information (i.e. list of UEs and the paging area) for joined CM-IDLE UEs, which helps optimize group paging and minimize group paging signals between the AMF and the NG-RANs.

q_55965.question: What entities can generate ground-truth labels and corresponding label quality indicators for AI/ML based positioning?
q_55965.ground_truth: The options include a UE with an estimated/known location, a network entity such as a PRU, LMF, or gNB-side model.

q_55966.question: What is the purpose of the SRS carrier based switching in the test procedure in 5.5.2.8.4.2?
q_55966.ground_truth: The purpose is to switch SRS between PSCell and SCell in the test.

q_55967.question: What is the purpose of performing a decryption procedure upon receiving a 200 (OK) response to the REGISTER request?
q_55967.ground_truth: The purpose of decryption is to avoid mismatches between the SIP URI in the P-Asserted-Identity header field received in a 504 (Server Time-out) response and the SIP URIs the UE received in the Path header field.

q_55968.question: What is the main function of a JBM (Jitter Buffer Manager) used in MTSI?
q_55968.ground_truth: A JBM used in MTSI is responsible for managing variations in the arrival time of packets, ensuring the smooth delivery of speech frames for decoder consumption while supporting source-controlled and non-source-controlled rate operations, handling clock drift, managing out-of-order and duplicate speech frames, and minimizing jitter-induced concealment operations.

q_55969.question: What is the role of the subnetwork ID used to assign a specific area where localized services are provided?
q_55969.ground_truth: The subnetwork ID, used in Identification Mode 2, is broadcasted in SIB together with the SNPN ID or GIN to assign a specific area where localized services are provided. It may be used as a new ID or as an extension of the CAG ID. One or more localized services may share the same subnetwork ID if offered in the same area, and the UE uses this information for SNPN hosting network selection for localized services.

q_55970.question: What SIP response codes may be returned by the I-CSCF upon an unsuccessful user location query when the user is not a user of the home network?
q_55970.ground_truth: A 404 (Not found) or 604 (Does not exist anywhere) response.

q_55971.question: In what scenario should the transmission control interface send a Transmission Reject message with cause #5 (Receive only)?
q_55971.ground_truth: When the received Transmission Media Request message has a priority level of "receive only", and the associated transmission participant does not have a queued Transmission request with a higher priority level.

q_55972.question: What is the parameter that controls the presentation of an unsolicited result code when there is a change in the MT's IMS registration information?

q_55973.question: What is the purpose of the measurement "Number of DRBs attempted to setup in case of Dual Connectivity"?
q_55973.ground_truth: This measurement provides the number of DRBs (Data Radio Bearers) that were attempted to setup to support all requested QoS flows in the PDU sessions that are to be setup by the S-NODE ADDITION REQUESTs and S-NODE MODIFICATION REQUESTs message received by the S-NG-RAN node from M-NG-RAN node. This measurement is split into subcounters per mapped 5QI and per S-NSSAI.

q_55974.question: What is the requirement for UE when NR UL carrier 1 is capable of one transmit antenna connector and NR UL carrier 2 is capable of two transmit antenna connectors with 3dB boosting on the maximum output power for CA power class 3 in clause 6.3A.3.3.2?
q_55974.ground_truth: UE shall support single layer transmission with one antenna port and two-layer transmission with two antenna ports on the two uplink carriers following the scheduling commands and rank adaptation.

q_55975.question: What is the issue described in section 5.2.1.1 regarding generic autonomous network level for RAN NE deployment?
q_55975.ground_truth: The issue is that the additional MnS requirements for level 4 are not specified in clause 7.2.4 in TS 28.100.

q_55976.question: When should the UE enable E-UTRA capability after disabling it due to the area updating attempt counter reaching 5?
q_55976.ground_truth: When the UE is in Iu mode or A/Gb mode and is in idle mode, when the RR connection is released in Iu mode with an RR connection, when the PS signalling connection is aborted before enabling E-UTRA capability in Iu mode with a PS signalling connection and no RR connection, and when the UE is in N1 mode and is in 5GMM-IDLE mode in 3GPP TS 24.501.

q_55977.question: What should the network do if it receives an ATTACH REQUEST message with the Old GUTI type IE and the EPS mobile identity IE with type of identity indicating "GUTI"?
q_55977.ground_truth: The network should use the Old GUTI type IE to determine whether the mobile identity included in the EPS mobile identity IE is a native GUTI or a mapped GUTI if it does not follow the use of the most significant bit of the <group id> as specified in TS 23.003.

q_55978.question: What action should the floor participant interface towards the MCPTT client take when it receives floor control messages or RTP media packets in a state where no procedure is specified?
q_55978.ground_truth: The floor participant interface towards the MCPTT client should discard the floor control message, request the network media interface to discard any received RTP media packet, and remain in the current state.

q_55979.question: What should the initiating UE do if timer T5091 expires before receiving a PROSE DIRECT LINK REKEYING RESPONSE message?
q_55979.ground_truth: The initiating UE should retransmit the PROSE DIRECT LINK REKEYING REQUEST message and restart timer T5091. If the maximum number of allowed retransmissions is reached, the UE should abort the 5G ProSe direct link re-keying procedure, provide an indication of deactivation of the PC5 unicast security protection and deletion of security context for the 5G ProSe direct link to the lower layer, and may initiate the 5G ProSe direct link release procedure.

q_55980.question: Which protocol IE is mandatory and has CRITICALITY ignore in the UECapabilityInfoIndication structure?
q_55980.ground_truth: There are multiple protocol IEs that are mandatory and have CRITICALITY ignore in the UECapabilityInfoIndication structure, including id-UERadioCapability and id-UERadioCapabilityForPaging. Additionally, there are several protocol IE's that are optional and have CRITICALITY ignore in the UECapabilityInfoIndication structure, including id-UE-Application-Layer-Measurement-Capability, id-LTE-M-Indication, id-UERadioCapability-NR-Format, and id-UERadioCapabilityForPaging-NR-Format.

q_55981.question: What should the call control entity of the MS do if the upper layers request "CCBS activation to be attempted" upon receipt of a DISCONNECT message?
q_55981.ground_truth: If the upper layers request that the "CCBS activation is to be attempted", the MS should send a RELEASE message containing a Facility IE including an Invoke=CCBSRequest to the network, stop all running call control timers, start timer T308, and enter the "release request" state.

q_55982.question: What are the steps for an N5CW device to access SNPN services via a trusted WLAN access network?
q_55982.ground_truth: The N5CW device initiates the access network selection procedure, constructs a list of available SNPNs, selects an SNPN, and initiates the "Initial Registration and PDU Session Establishment" procedure.

q_55983.question: What does the choice-preferences-PLMNSupport-Item-ExtIEs contain in the definition provided for PortNumber?

q_55984.question: How does UE operating in SNPN access mode select or attempt registration on available and allowable SNPNs in what order?
q_55984.ground_truth: The UE first selects and attempts registration on available and allowable SNPNs which broadcast the indication that access using credentials from a Credentials Holder is supported, in the following order - SNPNs in the user controlled prioritized list of preferred SNPNs, SNPNs in the Credentials Holder controlled prioritized list of preferred SNPNs, SNPNs that broadcast a GIN contained in the Credentials Holder controlled prioritized list of preferred GINs.

q_55985.question: What does the "Paging Measurement" in the context of 3GPP 5G specifications provide?
q_55985.ground_truth: The "Paging Measurement" provides the number of CN Initiated and NG-RAN Initiated paging records received or discarded by gNB-CU.

q_55986.question: What information is included in the Slices Status Change event?
q_55986.ground_truth: Slices status, Slices information with S-NSSAI mapping, Slices information, Rejected Slices information with S-NSSAI mapping, and Rejected Slices information are included in the Slices Status Change event.

q_55987.question: What is the possible service API solution for the service-based interface between home CHF and additional actor CHF for retail charging of 5G data connectivity?
q_55987.ground_truth: A possible solution is to create a new service API for the interaction between home CHF and additional actor CHF, this would mean that the H-CHF would translate the request from the AMF, SMF or SMSF to the new service API towards the H-CHF, allowing for flexibility and customization of the message format and triggers.

q_55988.question: What is the significance of the version numbering system used in the technical specification?
q_55988.ground_truth: The version numbering system indicates the level of approval and changes made to the document. The first digit indicates the level of approval, the second digit is incremented for changes of substance such as technical enhancements or corrections, and the third digit is incremented for editorial changes.

q_55989.question: What action should be taken if the MS receives a REQUEST SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT ACTIVATION message for an emergency PDN connection?
q_55989.ground_truth: The MS should not stop the timer T3396 associated with no APN if it is running and initiate the secondary PDP context activation procedure or send a REQUEST SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT ACTIVATION REJECT message.

q_55990.question: What is the maximum number of AoIPCodecsList that can be sent in one message?

q_55991.question: What is one way to determine that a 5GS node is a 3GPP defined 5GS system in a DetNet controller?
q_55991.ground_truth: One way to determine that a 5GS node is a 3GPP defined 5GS system in a DetNet controller is by checking if the interface type indicates a 3GPP interface.

q_55992.question: What should the SMF do if the maximum number of PDU sessions on a network slice associated with an S-NSSAI has been already reached?
q_55992.ground_truth: The SMF should reject the PDU session establishment request using S-NSSAI based congestion control.

q_55993.question: What information does the MMS R/S collect for charging purposes in MM transactions?
q_55993.ground_truth: The MMS R/S collects information such as destination and source addresses, identification of MMS R/S involved, amount and type of user data transmitted, storage duration, bearer resources used, and identification of a VASP if involved, for MM submission, retrieval, forwarding, MMbox transactions, and transactions involving a VASP.

q_55994.question: Which message is sent by the eNB to provide OTDOA information?

q_55995.question: What is the maximum size of a T-PDU that can be transmitted without fragmentation by GGSN or MS in a IP path carrying outer IP packets?
q_55995.ground_truth: This is defined in 3GPP TS 23.060 and is the value that should be set as the default inner MTU size at the PDN GW and UE/MS to avoid IP fragmentation of both inner IP packets and outer IP packets in the backbone.

q_55996.question: In the context of clause~4.23.7.3.2, what is the task of the T-AMF in step 2, when a (new) Target I-SMF needs to be selected based on Target UE location and service area of the SMF or of the old I-SMF during inter NG-RAN node N2 handover procedure?
q_55996.ground_truth: The T-AMF determines whether a (new) Target I-SMF needs to be selected based on Target UE location and service area of the SMF or of the old I-SMF.

q_55997.question: What type of network is an E-UTRAN consisting of eNBs, which provide non-terrestrial LTE access to UEs by means of an NTN payload embarked on a space-borne NTN vehicle and an NTN Gateway?

q_55998.question: What information is used by the NWDAF in the NTN coverage analytics model?
q_55998.ground_truth: The NTN coverage analytics model uses satellite data, UE-related analytics, and UE-related information as input data to generate NTN coverage output analytics.

q_55999.question: What is a component that can be used to improve sensitivity but adds complexity and power consumption in the heterodyne architecture with IF envelope detection?

q_56000.question: When must the NF service consumer retrieve the shared data identified by the shared data Ids in the UE-individual data?
q_56000.ground_truth: The NF service consumer must retrieve the shared data identified by the shared data Ids in the UE-individual data when the feature SharedData is supported and the retrieved UE-individual data contain SharedDataIds, unless the identified shared data are already available at the NF service consumer.

q_56001.question: What is the procedure for determining the transferable session set when receiving a SIP INVITE request due to STN-SR?
q_56001.ground_truth: Upon receiving a SIP INVITE request due to STN-SR, the ATCF shall determine the transferable session set, which includes all sessions with a speech media component associated with C-MSISDN equal to the URI in the P-Asserted-Identity header field of the SIP INVITE request due to STN-SR or the URI in the P-Asserted-Identity header field of the SIP OPTIONS request due to STN-SR. The transferable session set potentially includes recently released sessions for which the ATCF temporarily retains session state.

q_56002.question: What should the SC UE do when the served user rejects the transferred incoming early session when supporting CS to PS SRVCC?
