q_56002.ground_truth: The SC UE should send a SIP CANCEL request cancelling the SIP INVITE request and populate it with a Reason header field containing protocol "SIP" and the appropriate cause and text parameters indicating the selected status code and reason phrase.

q_56003.question: What must the UE do when the international validity time of dedicated priorities (T320) expires or a PLMN selection is performed on request by NAS?
q_56003.ground_truth: The UE shall only perform cell reselection evaluation for E-UTRAN frequencies and inter-RAT frequencies that are given in system information and for which the UE has a priority provided.

q_56004.question: What action must be taken by the IRI-POI in the SCEF to generate an xIRI containing a SCEFDeviceTriggerReportNotify record?
q_56004.ground_truth: The IRI-POI in the SCEF must detect that the SCEF has returned a Device triggering delivery report notification to the SCS/AS with a cause value indicating the trigger delivery outcome.

q_56005.question: What should the UE do when the bearer resource allocation requested cannot be accepted by the network, and timer T3480 has expired four times?
q_56005.ground_truth: The UE shall abort the procedure, deactivate all EPS bearer contexts for this PDN connection locally without peer-to-peer signalling between the UE and the MME, release the PTI allocated for this invocation and enter the state PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE.

q_56006.question: What is required before a UAV can establish a PDU Session/PDN Connection for UAS services?
q_56006.ground_truth: A UAV must be authenticated and authorized by the USS before it can establish a PDU Session/PDN Connection for UAS services.

q_56007.question: What is the format of the keyname NAI for ERP exchange with an ER server located in the 3GPP AAA Server?
q_56007.ground_truth: The keyname NAI for ERP exchange with an ER server located in the 3GPP AAA Server takes the form "username@nai.epc.mnc<MNC>.mcc<MCC>.3gppnetwork.org".

q_56008.question: What should a UE do upon reception of a paging for EPS services using IMSI?
q_56008.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T3346, locally deactivate any EPS bearer contexts, if any, and locally detach from EPS. Additionally, the UE should delete the last visited registered TAI, TAI list, GUTI, and KSIASME. The UE should set the EPS update status to EU2 NOT UPDATED and change the state to EMM-DEREGISTERED. The UE should stop all timers T3396 for this attach procedure and its reattempts.

q_56009.question: In what scenario would the operation "Create new QoS rule" and the DQR bit set to "the QoS rule is the default QoS rule" result in an error when there is already a default QoS rule with a different QoS rule identifier?
q_56009.ground_truth: This would result in an error if the network attempts to create a new QoS rule with the same identifier as the default QoS rule, while the current default QoS rule still exists and has a different identifier.

q_56010.question: Which entities are notified by PEMC when a PIN entity de-registers for services?
q_56010.ground_truth: PEMC notifies all the PIN entities including PIN server and PEGC about the details of the services being de-registered.

q_56011.question: What is the role of the "AF" in the background data transfer policy negotiation with the NEF in 5G?
q_56011.ground_truth: The AF is responsible for sending a notification to the NEF during the background data transfer policy negotiation, which includes a data structure with the notification destination URI. The AF then responds to the NEF with an HTTP response to confirm the reception of the notification. The AF may also select one policy from the candidate of BDT policies and indicate whether the BDT warning notification is enabled or disabled. Additionally, the AF may include a traffic descriptor of background data within the "trafficDes" attribute in the Bdt data type.

q_56012.question: What information does the MDT-Allowed-PLMN-Id AVP contain?
q_56012.ground_truth: The MDT-Allowed-PLMN-Id AVP contains the concatenation of MCC and MNC (Mobile Country Code and Mobile Network Code) to identify the PLMN in which the MDT data collection shall take place.

q_56013.question: What is the definition of transmitter intermodulation level for BS type 1-C and BS type 1-H?
q_56013.ground_truth: The transmitter intermodulation level for BS type 1-C is the power of the intermodulation products when an interfering signal is injected into the antenna connector, while for BS type 1-H, it is the power of the intermodulation products when an interfering signal is injected into the TAB connector.

q_56014.question: What are the different path switching scenarios for UE-to-Network Relaying with service continuity consideration?
q_56014.ground_truth: The different path switching scenarios are Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay with N3IWF switching from/to Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay with N3IWF, Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay without N3IWF switching from/to Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay without N3IWF, Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay without N3IWF switching from/to Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay with N3IWF, Layer-2 UE-to-Network Relay switching from/to Layer-2 UE-to-Network Relay, Layer-2 UE-to-Network Relay switching from/to Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay without N3IWF, and Layer-2 UE-to-Network Relay switching from/to Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay with N3IWF.

q_56015.question: What happens when both a Volume Threshold and a Volume Quota are set, and only the reporting trigger for the threshold is set?
q_56015.ground_truth: A usage report is sent only when reaching the Volume Threshold, and the UP function stops forwarding packets based on operator policy when the Volume Quota is reached without sending a new usage report.

q_56016.question: When does the UE need to send Event triggered measurement reports?
q_56016.ground_truth: The UE shall send event triggered measurement reports as long as the reporting criteria are fulfilled.

q_56017.question: What should an MTSI client in terminal do when it receives a TMMBR message requesting the remote media sender to change its rate to match the local downlink restriction?
q_56017.ground_truth: If TMMBR/TMMBN is supported in the session, a corresponding TMMBR message requesting the remote media sender to change its rate to match the local downlink restriction should be sent. If the most recently received TMMBN from the remote media sender indicated a lower bitrate than the TMMBR message, the remote media sender is then owning the bitrate limit itself, and no TMMBR message should be sent.

q_56018.question: What actions does a PGW take when it receives a GTP-U PDU for which no Bearer context exists?
q_56018.ground_truth: The PGW discards the GTP-U PDU and returns a GTP error indication to the originating node

q_56019.question: What should the UE do with all the ULDedicatedMessageSegment messages generated for the segmented RRC message after setting the rrc-MessageSegmentType correctly based on the segment order?
q_56019.ground_truth: The UE should submit all the ULDedicatedMessageSegment messages generated for the segmented RRC message to lower layers for transmission in ascending order based on the segmentNumber, upon which the procedure ends.

q_56020.question: What should the UE do if it receives the PLMN not allowed indicator (#11) while operating in single-registration mode?
q_56020.ground_truth: The UE should set the EPS update status to EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, delete any GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI list and eKSI, delete the list of equivalent PLMNs and reset the attach attempt counter. The UE should also store the PLMN identity in the "forbidden PLMNs for attach in S1 mode" list and enter state EMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH.

q_56021.question: What is the type of connection used for up-link traffic in a native N6 deployment with Ethernet PDU Sessions?
q_56021.ground_truth: The up-link traffic in a native N6 deployment with Ethernet PDU Sessions is forwarded based on the destination MAC address.

q_56022.question: What procedure is defined in clause~4.13.4.2 of the 3GPP TS 23.501 standard?
q_56022.ground_truth: The Emergency Services Fallback procedure is defined in clause~4.13.4.2 of the 3GPP TS 23.501 standard.

q_56023.question: Which interface is used by the SGW to the SGSN as part of the "Enhanced Serving RNS Relocation with SGW relocation using S4" procedure?
q_56023.ground_truth: The S4 interface is used by the SGW to the SGSN as part of the "Enhanced Serving RNS Relocation with SGW relocation using S4" procedure.

q_56024.question: What condition must be met for a UE to support EUTRAN measurements and reporting in connected mode?
q_56024.ground_truth: A UE must support all E-UTRA bands it indicates support for to indicate support for EUTRAN measurements and reporting in connected mode.

q_56025.question: What does the term "modem verb" mean in the foreword of a 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_56025.ground_truth: In the foreword of a 3GPP Technical Specification, a "modem verb" is a verb with a specific meaning, such as "shall" indicating a mandatory requirement or "may" indicating permission.

q_56026.question: Which service access point provides registration services, including location updating, IMSI attach/detach, at the MS side?

q_56027.question: What must the PGW, SGW, ePDG, eNodeB, and TWAN set when relaying a G-PDU with the Sequence Number flag (S flag) set to '0'?
q_56027.ground_truth: They must set the S flag to '0' when relaying the G-PDU.

q_56028.question: What is the maximum input level requirement for inter-band EN-DC including FR2 (1 NR CC) test case?
q_56028.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements for the inter-band EN-DC including FR2 maximum input level requirement (Clause 7.4B.0.4) apply to this test case. No exception requirements are applicable to NR or E-UTRA, and the LTE anchor agnostic approach is applied.

q_56029.question: What HTTP method should be used to request the creation of a new "Individual Data Reporting Session" resource?
q_56029.ground_truth: An HTTP POST request should be used to create a new "Individual Data Reporting Session" resource.

q_56030.question: What is the primary difference between coordinated recovery of energy service with redundant topology and without redundant topology?
q_56030.ground_truth: With redundant topology, the DSO has access to multiple means of communication, while without redundant topology, there is only one means of communication, making it critical to resolve key issues quickly to ensure continued communication.

q_56031.question: What is the margin for reselection based on ranking in NB-IoT?
q_56031.ground_truth: The margin for reselection based on ranking in NB-IoT is 5dB.

q_56032.question: What is the time alignment error minimum requirement for a UTRA time alignment error?
q_56032.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for a UTRA time alignment error is the same as defined in subclause 6.5.3.3.

q_56033.question: What information does the DS-TT include in the port management capability IE of the PORT MANAGEMENT CAPABILITY message?
q_56033.ground_truth: The DS-TT includes the DS-TT port management capabilities in the port management capability IE of the PORT MANAGEMENT CAPABILITY message.

q_56034.question: How does the MS handle session management timers T3396 during APN based congestion control?
q_56034.ground_truth: The MS starts and stops session management timers T3396 on a per APN basis, and they are associated with the APN sent by the MS when the PDN connection is established. If no APN is included in the ACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message, then T3396 is associated with no APN.

q_56035.question: What message is sent by the target SGSN when it establishes the required EPS Bearer, MM, SNDCP, and LLC contexts in the E-UTRAN to GERAN A/Gb mode Inter RAT handover execution phase?
q_56035.ground_truth: The target SGSN sends a Forward Relocation Response message to the source MME to confirm the establishment of the necessary resources for the handover.

q_56036.question: What should the S-CSCF do if there was no original dialog identifier present in the topmost Route header field of the incoming request and the served user is not considered a privileged sender?
q_56036.ground_truth: If the P-Asserted-Identity header field contains only a SIP URI and the S-CSCF has knowledge that the SIP URI is an alias for a tel URI, it should add a second P-Asserted-Identity header field containing the tel URI. If the P-Asserted-Identity header field contains only a tel URI, it should add a second P-Asserted-Identity header field containing a SIP URI.

q_56037.question: Which clause describes the enhanced UTRA FDD cell identification requirements, with a more relaxed detectability threshold, when no DRX is used or when DRX cycle length is less than or equal to 40 ms?

q_56038.question: What is the requirement for measurement reporting delay for Event A6 in this test case?
q_56038.ground_truth: The requirement for measurement reporting delay for Event A6 in this test case is 3200 ms.

q_56039.question: What is the required minimum percentage of correct events observed for each of the events to pass the test?
q_56039.ground_truth: The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests must be at least 90% with a confidence level of 95% for each of the events.

q_56040.question: What happens when the IWF receives knowledge of the LMR user's talker ID?
q_56040.ground_truth: The IWF sends an IWF talker ID update to the MCPTT server informing the server that a new talker is using the floor, but the floor should not be released.

q_56041.question: What is the purpose of the Network Slice Capability Exposure (NSCE) Server in the 3GPP network architecture?
q_56041.ground_truth: The NSCE Server forms part of the SEAL Enabler Layer and aims to ensure efficient use and deployment of network slice capability exposure capabilities to vertical applications by exposing network slicing capabilities based on 5GS management system services and network services.

q_56042.question: What is the purpose of the N4 reporting procedures in 5G?
q_56042.ground_truth: The N4 reporting procedures are used by the UPF to report events to the SMF. For example, the UPF reports measurement information, start and stop of traffic detections, downlink data reports, and user plane inactivity reports, enabling the SMF to manage the PDU sessions effectively.

q_56043.question: What is the implication of this solution on AF entity?
q_56043.ground_truth: AF needs to receive the BAT offset, provide a BAT window, and notify the applications to adapt the DL transmission schedule to it.

q_56044.question: What type of message does the SMF send to the UPF to enforce ATSSS policy in the downlink direction?
q_56044.ground_truth: The SMF sends N4 rules to the UPF when the MA PDU Session is created or updated by the SMF to enforce ATSSS policy in the downlink direction.

q_56045.question: What is the purpose of using EAS (Edge Application System) in the 5G architecture?
q_56045.ground_truth: EAS is used for recognizing, modelling, and rendering of a group of objects. It is also used for processing applications for a group of UEs in a single EAS instance.

q_56046.question: What action does a UE take when it receives a request from the Device Management server to deactivate a management operation?
q_56046.ground_truth: Depending on Operator conditions, the UE may either continue the Trace Recording Session(s) until they end gracefully or stop them immediately

q_56047.question: When will the AMF include the MICO indication IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message, and what indication may it include in the MICO indication IE?
q_56047.ground_truth: The AMF will include the MICO indication IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message only if the MICO indication IE was included in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message and the AMF supports and accepts the use of MICO mode. If the AMF supports and accepts the use of MICO mode, it may indicate "all PLMN registration area allocated" in the MICO indication IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.

q_56048.question: What is the length restriction for the "name" attribute in the "xs:simpleType" definition for "ext-tele-service"?
q_56048.ground_truth: The length of the "name" attribute for "ext-tele-service" can be between 1 and 10 characters.

q_56049.question: What message is used by the MME to initiate the default bearer context activation procedure?
q_56049.ground_truth: ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message

q_56050.question: What security mechanisms does IMS UE A use to integrity protect/encrypt the media stream sent towards IMS UE B and to check integrity/decrypt the media stream arriving from IMS UE B?
q_56050.ground_truth: IMS UE A uses key K1 (and possibly further master keys) to integrity protect/encrypt the media stream sent towards IMS UE B, and key K2 (and possibly further master keys) to check integrity/decrypt the media stream arriving from IMS UE B.

q_56051.question: What was the maximum increase in beam prediction accuracy shown by AI/ML for a 960ms prediction time?
q_56051.ground_truth: AI/ML had a beam prediction accuracy improvement of 12.8%.

q_56052.question: What is the RAN UE ID used for in the 3GPP 5G system?
q_56052.ground_truth: The RAN UE ID is an identifier allocated to a UE by the gNB-DU during UE Initial Access or by the gNB-CU during UE Context Setup. It is used to correlate data for a given UE in case of disaggregated gNB deployment.

q_56053.question: What is the minimum requirement for RE power control dynamic range for BS type 1-C and BS type 1-H?
q_56053.ground_truth: The RE power control dynamic range for BS type 1-C and BS type 1-H is the difference between the power of an RE and the average RE power for a BS at maximum output power (Pmax,c,AC or Pmax,c,TABC) for a specified reference condition. The requirement is 3 dB for BS type 1-C, and 4 dB for BS type 1-H.

q_56054.question: What is the procedure for testing when beamCorrespondenceWithoutUL-BeamSweeping is NOT supported and beamCorrespondenceSSB-based-r16 is supported (1.1)?
q_56054.ground_truth: The testing procedure when beamCorrespondenceWithoutUL-BeamSweeping is NOT supported and beamCorrespondenceSSB-based-r16 is supported (1.1) consists of measuring using only side conditions defined in clause 6.6.2.3.1.3.1 for PC3 and clause 6.6.2.3.4.3.1 for PC7 and then ending the test procedure.

q_56055.question: What does "UE responds" mean in the context of the test procedure?
q_56055.ground_truth: In the context of the test procedure, "UE responds" means that the UE starts transmitting access probe preambles on the Access Channel on cell 2.

q_56056.question: What is the effect of the "warning type" in the warning message on the UE's actions?
q_56056.ground_truth: The "warning type" value in the warning message determines how the UE alerts the user. For "earthquake", "tsunami", or "earthquake and tsunami", the UE immediately alerts the user, while for "test", the UE silently discards the primary notification.

q_56057.question: What is the procedure to request Location accuracy analytics by LMF?
q_56057.ground_truth: The procedure involves LMF requesting Location Accuracy Analytics from NWDAF, which has a trained supervised ML model for deriving the analytics. This is specified in clause 6.17.4 of TS 23.288.

q_56058.question: What are the two main approaches for NR carrier phase positioning being studied?
q_56058.ground_truth: The reporting of the carrier phase measurements together with the existing positioning measurements and the reporting of the carrier phase-based measurements alone without reporting the existing positioning measurements.

q_56059.question: When does the MAC entity consider itself to be in an enhanced coverage level during the Random Access procedure, regardless of the measured RSRP?
q_56059.ground_truth: If the UE is in enhanced coverage or if the starting enhanced coverage level has been indicated in the PDCCH order or provided by upper layers.

q_56060.question: What should the MCVideo client do if it receives a SIP 2xx response to the SIP re-INVITE request to cancel an in-progress emergency condition on a chat MCVideo group?
q_56060.ground_truth: The MCVideo client shall set the MCVideo emergency group state of the group to "MVEG 1: no-emergency", shall set the MCVideo emergency group call state of the group to "MVEGC 1: emergency-gc-capable", and if the MCVideo emergency alert state is set to "MVEA 4: Emergency-alert-cancel-pending", it shall set the MCVideo emergency alert state to "MVEA 1: no-alert".

q_56061.question: What range should the Overload Reduction Metric have, and how frequently should it be advertised?
q_56061.ground_truth: The Overload Reduction Metric should have a value between 0 and 100, indicating the percentage of traffic reduction requested. It is recommended to advertise a new Overload Reduction Metric Information when there is a larger variation, e.g. 5 or more units, to balance the processing requirement of the receiver.

q_56062.question: What are the services provided by the Call Control service class?
q_56062.ground_truth: The Call Control service class includes mobile originated and mobile terminated call establishment for normal calls, mobile originated call establishment for emergency calls, call maintaining, call termination, and call related Supplementary Services Support.

q_56063.question: When should the ATCF include the g.3gpp.ps2cs-srvcc-orig-pre-alerting media feature tag in the Contact header field?
q_56063.ground_truth: The ATCF should include the g.3gpp.ps2cs-srvcc-orig-pre-alerting media feature tag in the Contact header field when the SIP INVITE request includes the g.3gpp.ps2cs-srvcc-orig-pre-alerting media feature tag in the Contact header field.

q_56064.question: What is the purpose of establishing an S2c IKEv2 SA in a 3GPP network, and when is it triggered by the UE?
q_56064.ground_truth: Establishing an S2c IKEv2 SA (IPsec Security Association) is used to optimize future handovers to other accesses using the S2c interface. It is triggered by the UE when it is attached to the PDN (Packet Data Network) over the trusted non-3GPP access. Each PDN connection requires a separate S2c IKEv2 SA establishment.

q_56065.question: What is the implication of the term "cannot" as used in the normative elements of the present document?
q_56065.ground_truth: The term "cannot" as used in the normative elements of the present document indicates that something is impossible.

q_56066.question: What is the impact of the absence of the <mcdata-off-network-ProSe-signalling-PPPP> element in the <list-service> element of the MCData group document?
q_56066.ground_truth: A call cannot be established on the MCData group in off-network MCData procedures.

q_56067.question: What is the time duration of T1 and T2 in the test?
q_56067.ground_truth: The time duration of T1 is not specified, but T2 is 21 seconds.

q_56068.question: What should the SMF send to the UE in the case of IPv6 multi-homing if a new UL CL that replaces existing UL-CL/BP is selected in step~2?
q_56068.ground_truth: The SMF should send the IPv6 multi-homed routing rule along with the IPv6 prefix corresponding to the PSA1 to the UE in the case of IPv6 multi-homing if a new UL CL that replaces existing UL-CL/BP is selected in step~2.

q_56069.question: What information should the NF service consumer provide if the "TimeSensitiveNetworking" or "TimeSensitiveCommunication" feature is supported?
q_56069.ground_truth: The NF service consumer should provide TSC user plane node related information as specified in clauses~4.2.3.24 and 4.2.3.25.

q_56070.question: What optional claim in an access token should the network product under test verify if it supports identifying and understanding this claim?
q_56070.ground_truth: The network product under test should verify the "NF Set ID" claim in an access token if it supports identifying and understanding it. If the NF Set ID in the claim does not match the NF Set ID of the network product under test, the network product under test would reject the NF service consumer's request.

q_56071.question: What should the controlling MCPTT function do in step 5 if there is a <functional-alias-URI> element with an activated functional alias status in the received SIP MESSAGE request?
q_56071.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function should set the <functional-alias-URI> element of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body in the outgoing SIP MESSAGE request to the received value.

q_56072.question: What are the units used for the measurement of "MM.HoExeInterReq.TimeMean.SNSSAI.NRCellCU"?
q_56072.ground_truth: The units used for the measurement of "MM.HoExeInterReq.TimeMean.SNSSAI.NRCellCU" are milliseconds.

q_56073.question: When should all requirements for the default power class be applied in the context of EN-DC?
q_56073.ground_truth: All requirements for the default power class should be applied in the context of EN-DC when the UE supports a different power class than the default UE power class for EN-DC band combination, and the supported power class enables higher maximum output power than that of the default power class, while also meeting certain conditions.

q_56074.question: What is the condition for a single RAT E-UTRA operation, when adjusting the signal generators for in-band blocking test requirements?
q_56074.ground_truth: The CW interfering signal shall be swept with a step size of 1 MHz within the specified range.

q_56075.question: What is the purpose of the measurement reporting procedure in LTE networks?
q_56075.ground_truth: The purpose of the measurement reporting procedure in LTE networks is to transfer measurement results from the UE to E-UTRAN.

q_56076.question: What happens after the MC service server of the primary MC system sends the group call request to the affiliated group members of the ad-hoc group?
q_56076.ground_truth: The MC service clients receive the group call request, notifying their corresponding MC service user, accepting or rejecting the call, and responding with the group call response message.

q_56077.question: How does a UE determine the modulation order for the Physical Downlink Shared Channel?
q_56077.ground_truth: A UE shall first read the 5-bit "modulation and coding scheme" field in the DCI and then consult TS 36.213 clause 7.1.7.1-1 to determine the modulation order. If the DCI CRC is scrambled by P-RNTI, RA-RNTI, or SI-RNTI, the UE shall use a modulation order of 2, otherwise, it uses the value determined from TS 36.213 clause 7.1.7.1-1.

q_56078.question: In what scenario should the Floor Idle message be sent to all floor participant interfaces with the exception of those only listening to RTP media from the overriding MCPTT client?
q_56078.ground_truth: When the Floor Taken message is received with the G-bit set to '0' (Not dual floor) and there is a stored SSRC of granted floor participant associated with a dual floor.

q_56079.question: What service do layer 3 and its supporting lower layers provide to upper layers for GPRS services?
q_56079.ground_truth: The Mobile Network Signalling (MNS) Service and User Data Transfer (UDT) Service are provided to the upper layers for GPRS services.

q_56080.question: What is the key issue related to the reporting of per-direction and per-DRB per-UE MDT measurements?
q_56080.ground_truth: The key issue is that the existing trace data file XML schema does not have a means to report measurements that are measured per direction and per DRB.

q_56081.question: What is the implication when the TIN is set to "RAT-related TMSI"?
q_56081.ground_truth: If the TIN is set to "RAT-related TMSI", the UE can change between all registered areas and RATs without any update signaling and it listens for paging on the RAT it is camped on. Additionally, the UE's P-TMSI and RAI as well as its GUTI and TAI(s) shall remain registered with the network and shall remain valid in the UE.

q_56082.question: What is the function of the AR Application Server in the AR communication architecture?
q_56082.ground_truth: The AR Application Server is responsible for AR service control related to AR communication, including AR session media controlling, AR media rendering negotiation, and AR service handling.

q_56083.question: What should the MCVideo client include in the SDP answer in the SIP 200 (OK) response when the incoming SIP INVITE request contains a Replaces header field?
q_56083.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should include the parameters used for the pre-established session identified by the contents of the Replaces header field.

q_56084.question: What are the additional parameters required to support mobility of MLContext?
q_56084.ground_truth: The additional parameters required are monitoringScope, validityScope, and preparedScope.

q_56085.question: What should the UE do when it receives an "Extended Wait Time" in the RRCConnectionRelease message after sending an ATTACH REQUEST message with NAS low priority signalling indication?
q_56085.ground_truth: The UE starts timer T3346 and aborts the attach procedure. When the timer expires, the UE restarts the attach procedure.

q_56086.question: What is the maximum number of PDN connections to a single APN that is supported by the MAG function of the Trusted Non-3GPP IP Access or ePDG and the Serving GW in the handover of PDN connections to non-3GPP access?
q_56086.ground_truth: The MAG function of the Trusted Non-3GPP IP Access or ePDG and the Serving GW support multiple PDN connections to a single APN in the handover of PDN connections to non-3GPP access. However, the specific maximum number of connections may vary depending on the implementation.

q_56087.question: What should the P-CSCF do when it receives an INVITE request that requires resource authorization and the IP-CAN indicates that the requested resources cannot be granted?
q_56087.ground_truth: Based on local operator policy, the P-CSCF shall return a 503 (Service Unavailable) or 500 (Server Internal Error) response to the received INVITE request.

q_56088.question: What are the key impacts of UE-to-UE Relay re-selection on the Source UE, Target UE, and UE-to-UE Relay?
q_56088.ground_truth: The Source UE identifies the candidate UE-to-UE Relays and initiates relay re-selection via the existing connection, the Target UE decides the new UE-to-UE Relay, and the UE-to-UE Relay sends/receives discovery messages to/from the Source UE or the Target UE.

q_56089.question: What should the participating MCPTT function do upon receiving a SIP BYE request from the MCPTT client?
q_56089.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT function should check whether there is a MCPTT call using the pre-established session, remove the MCPTT client from the MCPTT session, release the MCPTT session, and interact with the media plane for releasing media plane resources accordingly.

q_56090.question: What is the purpose of Split SRB in MR-DC?
q_56090.ground_truth: In MR-DC, an SRB between the MN and the UE in Split SRB allows selection of either the direct path or the path via the SN as well as duplication of RRC PDUs across both paths. This allows for redundancy and reliability in the communication between the MN and the UE.

q_56091.question: What is required for the IWF to send only one IWF group call request message to the IWF in step 5 of subclause 10.3.3.2?
q_56091.ground_truth: The IWF must have affiliated to the group on behalf of the group's LMR users.

q_56092.question: What is the value of the Accept-Contact header field included in the SIP MESSAGE request by the MCPTT client?
q_56092.ground_truth: The MCPTT client must include an Accept-Contact header field with the media feature tag g.3gpp.mcptt along with parameters "require" and "explicit" in accordance with IETF RFC 3841 in the SIP MESSAGE request.

q_56093.question: What is the definition of in-channel selectivity (ICS) for IAB-DU type 1-H?
q_56093.ground_truth: ICS is a measure of the receiver ability to receive a wanted signal at its assigned resource block locations TAB connector for IAB-DU type 1-H in the presence of an interfering signal received at a larger power spectral density.

q_56094.question: What are the functional entities described in the present document?
q_56094.ground_truth: The functional entities described in the present document are the SEAL Network Slice Capability Enablement Client (SNSCE-C) and the SEAL Network Slice Capability Enablement Server (SNSCE-S). The SNSCE-C is an application client that manages network slice capabilities, while the SNSCE-S is a functional entity that administers the network slice for one or more vertical applications.

q_56095.question: What is the paging frame (PF) given by in the DRX parameters?
q_56095.ground_truth: The paging frame (PF) is given by SFN mod T = (T div N) * k, where N is the minimum of T and nB, and k is an integer between 0 and N-1.

q_56096.question: How many times should the overall delays measured test requirement be met for the test to pass with a confidence level of 95%?

q_56097.question: What is the maximum period of measurement for the maximum output power for the UE Power Classes in subclause 6.2.2E and 6.2.2F?
q_56097.ground_truth: The maximum period of measurement for the maximum output power for the UE Power Classes in subclause 6.2.2E and 6.2.2F is at least one subframe (1ms), unless otherwise stated.

q_56098.question: What is the time duration within which the UE shall perform search and reselection to an allowed inter-RAT E-UTRA CSG cell that has met the CSG reselection criterion and is in its allow-list?
q_56098.ground_truth: The UE shall perform this action within 6 minutes.

q_56099.question: What should a participating MCPTT function include in the outgoing SIP re-INVITE request's MIME body for the mcptt-calling-user-id?
q_56099.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT function should include the MCPTT ID of the originating user in the mcptt-calling-user-id element of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body of the SIP INVITE request.

q_56100.question: What is the procedure when downlink data is received and the SMF/UPF is requested to perform buffering in the RRC Inactive state?
q_56100.ground_truth: During this procedure, the UPF/SMF checks with the AMF for the possibility of data delivery. If the AMF determines that the UE is not reachable in the RRC INACTIVE state, it provides the Estimated Maximum Wait time in the response message based on the stored extended DRX information.

q_56101.question: What information does the MMTel AS A report to the DCSF A based on the initial SDP O/A media negotiation?
q_56101.ground_truth: The MMTel AS A reports the media event of data channel to the DCSF A and indicates if it need to start one-side data channel procedure in this IMS session.

q_56102.question: In the context of WLAN offload cell measurement unsolicited result code, what does the parameter "<rscp>" indicate?
q_56102.ground_truth: The parameter "<rscp>" indicates the received signal code power in the WLAN offload cell measurement unsolicited result code.

q_56103.question: Which fields may change frequently and how can Solution #20 accommodate such fields?
q_56103.ground_truth: Some fields in SIB may change frequently during high load scenario. Solution #20 can accommodate such fields by generating new signatures for the SIBs when they are changed or by precomputing signatures for all possible values of the field during the window it is expected to change.

q_56104.question: What capabilities does a UE that is capable of supporting 5GC NAS procedures have?
q_56104.ground_truth: The UE is also capable of supporting EPC NAS procedures.

q_56105.question: What is the period of the target pathloss reference signal when it is associated with the serving cell, as specified in clause 8.24.3?
q_56105.ground_truth: The period of the target pathloss reference signal when it is associated with the serving cell is Ttarget_PL-RS.

q_56106.question: What is the objective of slice coverage analysis in MDA?
q_56106.ground_truth: The objective of slice coverage analysis is to optimize the slice coverage, leveraging slice-aware statistics, slice SLA, and access node capabilities, and to fulfill a given slice SLA involving the fewest possible cells.

q_56107.question: What is the purpose of the "lcs-all-MOLR-SS" feature?
q_56107.ground_truth: This feature allows for the implementation of the ability to perform location retrieval for a specific service type, including those involving MOLR-SS, for all PLMNs and operators.

q_56108.question: What information does the AF provision when mapping between Application Layer ID and GPSI to UDR in application data?
q_56108.ground_truth: The AF provisions the mapping between Application Layer ID and GPSI to UDR in application data, which allows for the correct identification of UE GPS information.

q_56109.question: What is the response from the MCPTT server when it receives a group join request with an implicit floor request indication?
q_56109.ground_truth: The MCPTT server sends a group join response indicating the acceptance of the group join request and establishes the media plane between the IWF and the MCPTT server.

q_56110.question: What is the impact of EUTRADisablingAllowedForEMMCause15 on disabling the E-UTRA capability?
q_56110.ground_truth: The EUTRADisablingAllowedForEMMCause15 leaf indicates whether the UE is allowed to disable the E-UTRA (Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access) capability when it receives an Extended EMM (Evolved Packet System Mobility Management) cause IE (Information Element) with value "E-UTRAN not allowed".

q_56111.question: What should a UE do when the cell is a CSG cell and the cell is barred?
q_56111.ground_truth: The UE shall exclude the barred cell as a candidate for cell selection/reselection for 300 seconds.

q_56112.question: What is the "5G AS security context for 3GPP access" used for in the 5G system?
q_56112.ground_truth: The "5G AS security context for 3GPP access" contains cryptographic keys, their identifiers, the Next Hop parameter and counter, the identifiers of selected cryptographic algorithms, the UE security capabilities, and the UP Security Policy at the network side in the 5G system.

q_56113.question: What should the ME do when it receives a FACILITY message containing a USSD Request message with a null alpha identifier?
q_56113.ground_truth: The ME should not give any information to the user at the reception of a USSD Request message.

q_56114.question: What is the procedure for DNS procedures to support DCNs?
q_56114.ground_truth: DNS procedures to support DCNs shall be supported as specified in the rest of the specification, with the addition of the UE usage type used during the DNS procedure, the S-NAPTR procedure, and retrieving the MMEGI or Null-NRI/SGSN Group ID to identify the DCN serving a particular UE usage type.

q_56115.question: What are the network adjustment solutions represented in REQ-ANL-RANES_1 for supporting MnS requirements for the 3GPP management system?
q_56115.ground_truth: NR NRM (e.g. NRCellCU, beam, and NRCellRelation, CESManagementFunction IOC)

q_56116.question: What should the MAC entity do upon receiving a Differential Koffset MAC CE on a Serving Cell?
q_56116.ground_truth: The MAC entity should indicate to lower layers the information regarding the Differential Koffset MAC CE.

q_56117.question: What is the purpose of defining symbols N and M in the present document?
q_56117.ground_truth: The symbol N represents the release in which a feature is introduced into TS 38.101 or TS 38.133, while the symbol M indicates the release from which onwards (including release M) a feature is release independent.

q_56118.question: What is the general minimum requirement for BS receiver blocking in the presence of an unwanted interferer?
q_56118.ground_truth: The blocking characteristics are a measure of the receiver unit's ability to receive a wanted signal at the TAB connector at its assigned channel in the presence of an unwanted interferer.

q_56119.question: What is the requirement for the UPF to support per QoS flow congestion information monitoring?
q_56119.ground_truth: The UPF shall set the QMCON feature flag in the UP Function Features IE if it supports per QoS flow QoS monitoring for congestion information.

q_56120.question: What action does the UPF take if the IP multicast address information included in the IGMP or MLD message received in step 1b or 1c does not include the IP address(es) of a multicast group?
q_56120.ground_truth: The UPF stops forwarding the packet to the 5G-RG.

q_56121.question: How is the QoS parameters of each UE decided when switching from the PC5 to Uu reference point?
q_56121.ground_truth: The Uu QoS parameters of each UE are decided based on PC5 QoS parameters and negotiated via the existing PC5 connection between the UEs. The UE may perform the UE requested PDU Session Modification to request the Uu QoS parameters. For IP type traffic, the IP addresses/prefixes of the peer UEs over the Uu reference point can be shared via the existing PC5 connection between the UEs using application layer signalling.

q_56122.question: What should a UE do if it supports simultaneousRxDataSSB-DiffNumerology when performing CSI-RS for RLM measurement?
q_56122.ground_truth: If a UE supports simultaneousRxDataSSB-DiffNumerology, it is able to perform CSI-RS for RLM measurement without any restrictions.

q_56123.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects document?
q_56123.ground_truth: The purpose of the document is to specify test methods for assessing the minimum performance requirements of electro-acoustic characteristics for GSM, 3G, LTE, NR, and WLAN terminals when used to provide narrowband, wideband, super-wideband, or fullband telephony.

q_56124.question: What information does the ASM client send to the ASM server when pushing a service experience report?
q_56124.ground_truth: The ASM client sends a service experience report containing details such as end-to-end response time, connection bandwidth, request rate, server availability, and the VAL UE ID, VAL service ID, and VAL server identity for which the report is being sent, along with a timestamp.

q_56125.question: What is the difference between the P2A and P2P types of application data channels?
q_56125.ground_truth: P2A application data channels are used for transferring data between a UE and a data channel application server, while P2P application data channels are used for transferring data between two UEs.

q_56126.question: What should the UE include in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message if it supports NSAG and the Sending of REGISTRATION COMPLETE message for NSAG information?
q_56126.ground_truth: The UE should set the NSAG bit to "NSAG supported" and the RCMAN bit to "Sending of REGISTRATION COMPLETE message for NSAG information supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

q_56127.question: What is the measurement interval for UTRA TDD for the required modulation quality?
q_56127.ground_truth: The measurement interval for UTRA TDD for the required modulation quality is one timeslot.

q_56128.question: What should an Access Server (AS) do if it receives an initial or standalone SIP request that contains credentials but it does not contain a P-Asserted-Identity header field?
q_56128.ground_truth: The AS should check the correctness of the credentials. If the credentials are correct, then the AS should consider the identity of the user verified and proceed with the authentication process. If the credentials are not correct, the AS may either rechallenge the user or consider the user as anonymous.

q_56129.question: Which element specifies the maximum data size for Short Data Service (SDS) in MCData?
q_56129.ground_truth: The "mcdata-on-network-max-data-size-for-SDS" element specifies the maximum data size for Short Data Service (SDS) in MCData.

q_56130.question: What action does the floor control arbitration logic take when it receives a unicast media stop request message from a floor participant with Media Flow Control Indicator set to '0'?
q_56130.ground_truth: The floor control arbitration logic may de-allocate associated bearer resources by the MCPTT server, notifies the media distributor to stop sending media to the MCPTT client, and stays in the 'G: Floor Taken' state.

q_56131.question: What factors determine the preferred level of accuracy for analytics?
q_56131.ground_truth: The preferred level of accuracy for analytics can be influenced by the parameters such as Uniformly distributed datasets, Datasets with or without outliers, Time window for historical analytics, Data time window, Preferred level of accuracy per analytics subset, Analytics ID, and Dataset Statistical Properties.

q_56132.question: In which clause of TS 44.060 does it describe the cell change order procedure for multi-RAT mobile stations supporting UTRAN?
q_56132.ground_truth: The cell change order procedure for multi-RAT mobile stations supporting UTRAN is described in clause 7.4.2 of TS 44.060.

q_56133.question: What is the responsibility of the E-UTRAN in selecting an MME for a PLMN indicated by the UE?
q_56133.ground_truth: The E-UTRAN is responsible for selecting an appropriate MME for the PLMN indicated by the UE.

q_56134.question: What steps does the MCVideo server take if confidentiality protection is applied to the <mcvideo-request-uri> element and <mcvideo-client-id> element in a SIP PUBLISH request with an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body?
q_56134.ground_truth: The MCVideo server should use the keying information described in clause~6.6.2.2, and the procedures described in clause~6.6.2.4.2 to decrypt the received encrypted values in the <mcvideo-request-uri> and <mcvideo-client-id> elements of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body. If all decryption procedures succeed, it shall identify the MCVideo ID and MCVideo client ID from the decrypted values.

q_56135.question: What is the maximal ratio Ri used in the calculation of the carrier specific scaling factor for L1-RSRP measurements within measurement gaps?
q_56135.ground_truth: Ri is the maximal ratio of the number of measurement gaps where inter-frequency L1-RSRP measurement layer i is a candidate to be measured over the number of measurement gaps where inter-frequency L1-RSRP measurement layer i is a candidate and not used for a long-periodicity measurement.

q_56136.question: Which RFC specifies the Datagram Congestion Control Protocol (DCCP) for the transport layer to complement TCP and UDP for traffic that does not require reliable transport and re-transmission?

q_56137.question: What is the allocation information in uplink DCI format N0 for NPUSCH transmission in NB-IoT?
q_56137.ground_truth: The allocation information in uplink DCI format N0 for NPUSCH transmission in NB-IoT indicates to a scheduled UE a set of contiguously allocated subcarriers and a number of resource units determined by the corresponding DCI. The subcarrier spacing of NPUSCH transmission is determined by the uplink subcarrier spacing field in the Narrowband Random Access Response Grant.

q_56138.question: What action should a MS take when it receives a rejection cause #13 for location area services?
q_56138.ground_truth: The MS should delete any RAI, P-TMSI, P-TMSI signature, and GPRS ciphering key sequence number, set the GPRS update status to GU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, reset the GPRS attach attempt counter, store the LAI in the "forbidden location areas for roaming" list, and start timer T3340.

q_56139.question: What should the UE do when it selects a cell belonging to a TAI in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming" while in the EMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE or EMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH state?
q_56139.ground_truth: The UE should not attempt to attach when it selects a cell belonging to a TAI in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming".

q_56140.question: What is the measure of a receiver's ability to receive a signal on its assigned downlink subband in the presence of interference power on the adjacent uplink subband referred to as?

q_56141.question: What should the receiving eNB do with the ABS Pattern Info IE received in the LOAD INFORMATION message?
q_56141.ground_truth: The receiving eNB may take such information into consideration when scheduling UEs, and may consider the ABS indicated in the ABS pattern info IE as valid until reception of a new LOAD INFORMATION message carrying an update.

q_56142.question: What should be included in the Contact header field when sending SIP provisional responses other than the SIP 100 (Trying) response?
q_56142.ground_truth: TheContact header field of SIP provisional responses other than the SIP 100 (Trying) response should include the g.3gpp.mcptt media feature tag, the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag containing the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcptt", the isfocus media feature tag, and an MCPTT session identity mapped to the MCPTT session identity if provided in the Contact header field of the incoming provisional response.

q_56143.question: What is the purpose of the "mask(s) for the ProSe Restricted Code Suffix(es)" within the "proSeRestrictedMasks" attribute in the AuthDisResData data structure when the 5G ProSe Direct Discovery request is initiated by a monitoring UE?
q_56143.ground_truth: The "mask(s) for the ProSe Restricted Code Suffix(es)" within the "proSeRestrictedMasks" attribute in the AuthDisResData data structure give the indication for an authorized Target RPAUID to become discoverable in a restricted manner for an AN or ANN UE, where the masks are implemented using the Reed-Solomon error correction codes.

q_56144.question: What is the role of the NRF in the OAuth2 authorization process?
q_56144.ground_truth: The NRF plays the role of the authorization server in the OAuth2 authorization process.

q_56145.question: What shall the mobile station do if the AUTHENTICATION REJECT message is received with integrity protection in MM connections context?
q_56145.ground_truth: The mobile station shall set the update status in the SIM/USIM to U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, delete from the SIM/USIM the stored TMSI, LAI and ciphering key sequence number.

q_56146.question: What is the role of the Media Session Handler in the 5GMS Service URL handling procedure?
q_56146.ground_truth: The Media Session Handler plays the role of 3GPP Service Handler for 5GMS Service URLs by registering itself as the URL handler for the domain name ms.launch.3gppservices.org.

q_56147.question: When is the UE allowed to cause interruptions on an activated SCell that is not in the same band as the deactivated SCell?
q_56147.ground_truth: The UE is allowed to cause interruptions on an activated SCell that is not in the same band as the deactivated SCell immediately before and immediately after an SMTC.

q_56148.question: What precautions should be taken when connecting cables to ports that are not connected during normal operation for the purpose of EMC testing?
q_56148.ground_truth: Precautions should be taken to ensure that the evaluation of the EUT is not affected by the addition or extension of these cables.

q_56149.question: What is the top-level service type for a country specific emergency service URN?
q_56149.ground_truth: The top-level service type for a country specific emergency service URN is "sos".

q_56150.question: What is the purpose of step 4a in clause 4.23.4.3?
q_56150.ground_truth: In step 4a of clause 4.23.4.3, the new I-SMF retrieves SM Context from the old I-SMF or SMF to obtain information about the PDU Session for the service request procedure.

q_56151.question: When is WUS assistance used by the UE and when is it deleted?
q_56151.ground_truth: The UE uses WUS assistance only if it received the Negotiated WUS assistance information IE during the last attach or tracking area updating procedure. If the UE did not receive the Negotiated WUS assistance information IE during the last attach or tracking area updating procedure, the UE shall delete any existing WUS assistance information received from the network.

q_56152.question: What is the function of the ML Model Interoperability indicator in the NWDAF containing MTLF?
q_56152.ground_truth: The ML Model Interoperability indicator in the NWDAF containing MTLF comprises a list of NWDAF providers (vendors) that are allowed to retrieve ML models from this NWDAF containing MTLF. It also indicates that the NWDAF containing MTLF supports the interoperable ML models requested by the NWDAFs from the vendors in the list.

q_56153.question: Which downlink channels, besides PDSCH, have a coverage margin of at least 3dB compared to the bottleneck channel when there is no UE antenna efficiency loss in an Urban scenario at 4 GHz with a DL PSD of 24 dBm/MHz and maximum 11-PRB UE bandwidth?

q_56154.question: What should the SCC AS do if it receives a SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP INVITE request due to PS to CS STN and a SIP 2xx response to the SIP re-INVITE request?
q_56154.ground_truth: The SCC AS should send the SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP INVITE request due to PS to CS STN on the target access leg and remove non-transferred audio media components and release the source access leg for the session supporting an active speech media component.

q_56155.question: What is the main issue that the Solution #67 addresses?
q_56155.ground_truth: The Solution #67 addresses the key issue of 5GS information exposure for XR/media enhancements.

q_56156.question: What is the impact of a mobile base station relay on location services for UEs accessing 5GS?
q_56156.ground_truth: When the mobile base station relay (IAB-node) is present, it may affect not only positioning procedures but also regulatory services that require UE location. Potential solutions should address this issue without changing the LCS framework, and coordination with relevant NR WGs and SA WG2 is necessary.

q_56157.question: How many MHz bandwidth is required for each of the available RBG sizes in DCI combination 2?
q_56157.ground_truth: The RBG size is 2 for 5 MHz, 3 for 10 MHz, and 4 for 15 & 20 MHz.

q_56158.question: In VGCS Group ID, what does the fourth byte of the coded VGCS Group ID represent?
q_56158.ground_truth: The fourth byte of the coded VGCS Group ID represents the least significant digits of the VGCS Group ID. It is coded on four bytes, with each digit within the code being coded on four bits corresponding to BCD code.

q_56159.question: Which parameter is not included in the first list inside MAC-Parameters?

q_56160.question: When must a GTPv2 entity fallback to GTPv1, except during an inter-SGSN handover?
q_56160.ground_truth: A GTPv2 entity must fallback to GTPv1 if a "Version Not Supported" message in GTPv1 format is received from the peer node, or if a GTPv2 message with a Cause value "Fallback to GTPv1" is received.

q_56161.question: What is the highest bandwidth supported by 5G?

q_56162.question: What should the controlling MCVideo function do upon receiving a SIP 180 (Ringing) response if the SIP 180 (Ringing) response or the SIP final response has not yet been sent to the inviting MCVideo client?
q_56162.ground_truth: If the SIP 180 (Ringing) response is associated with a SIP INVITE that contained a session-type set to "private", the controlling MCVideo function should generate a SIP 180 (Ringing) response to the SIP INVITE request and send it towards the inviting MCVideo client.

q_56163.question: What information must the UE include in the Registration Request message during the Registration procedure?
q_56163.ground_truth: The UE must include the PC5 Capability for A2X as part of the "5GMM capability" in the Registration Request message. This indicates whether the UE is capable of A2X communication over PC5 reference point and which specific PC5 RAT(s) it supports.

q_56164.question: In what circumstances would a UE initiate the procedure to indicate it is interested in receiving NR sidelink communication?
q_56164.ground_truth: Upon successful connection establishment or resuming, upon change of interest, or upon receiving UECapabilityInformationSidelink from the associated peer UE.

q_56165.question: What technology does the IP-CAN use to enforce restrictions for the IM CN subsystem traffic?
q_56165.ground_truth: The IP-CAN uses rules and ratings to enforce restrictions for the IM CN subsystem traffic, including SIP, DHCP, DNS, and HTTP traffic.

q_56166.question: What should the UE do if it receives an indication of a change in the RAN timing synchronization status while in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode with RRC inactive indication?
q_56166.ground_truth: The UE will request the lower layers to transition to RRC_CONNECTED state.

q_56167.question: What is the TTI insertion uncertainty when the test requires the overall delay measured to be less than a total of 842 ms when the DRX cycle length is 40 ms?
q_56167.ground_truth: The TTI insertion uncertainty is 2 ms when the test requires the overall delay measured to be less than a total of 842 ms when the DRX cycle length is 40 ms.

q_56168.question: When is a successful response sent to the DCSF, indicating that the ARMF resource was applied successfully?
q_56168.ground_truth: After the ARMF returns a successful response carrying the termination addresses information allocated on ARMF to the MMTEL AS.

q_56169.question: What does the policy/parameters for PC5 RAT selection and for PC5 Tx Profile selection specify?
q_56169.ground_truth: It specifies the mapping of V2X service types to PC5 RAT(s), such as LTE PC5 and NR PC5 or both, and for each RAT, the corresponding Tx Profiles, such as MFBR/GFBR, etc.

q_56170.question: What list does the UE store in the attach procedure if there is no valid GUTI available?
q_56170.ground_truth: The UE includes the IMSI in the ATTACH REQUEST message if there is no valid GUTI available.

q_56171.question: What should the reception control arbitration logic in the transmission control server do upon receiving a Receive Media Request message when in the 'Gr: Reception Accepted' state and the Receive Media Request is granted?
q_56171.ground_truth: It should stop timer T5 (Inactivity), stop timer T11 associated with the User Id of the Transmitting User if it is running, increment the counter C11 associated with the User Id of the Transmitting User by 1, store the Audio SSRC and Video SSRC of the Transmitting User, send the Receive Media Response (Granted) message, start timer T6 (Reception Granted), increase C7 (Reception Accepted) by 1 if it has not reached its upper limit, and remain in the 'Gr: Reception accepted' state.

q_56172.question: What information about a PDU session does the SMF report to the PCF in the context of time synchronization?
q_56172.ground_truth: The SMF reports the device side port number, DS-TT MAC address, TSC user plane node Id, and UE-DS-TT residence time (if available) to the PCF to identify the PDU session.

q_56173.question: In which section of the specification do the RRM requirements for IAB MTs specified in section 12.3 apply?
q_56173.ground_truth: The RRM requirements for IAB MTs specified in section 12.3 apply only for the local area IAB class defined in section 4.4.

q_56174.question: When should the network initiate procedures for authentication and authorization or manipulation of PDU sessions in 5GS session management?
q_56174.ground_truth: The network initiates procedures for authentication and authorization or manipulation of PDU sessions when the UE is successfully registered to a PLMN and a 5GMM context has been established between the UE and the AMF.

q_56175.question: What should the AS include in the P-Charging-Vector header field when it generates a subsequent request for a dialog while acting as a terminating UA?
q_56175.ground_truth: The AS should include a P-Charging-Vector header field with the "icid-value" header field parameter set to the value populated in the initial request for the dialog, a type 3 "orig-ioi" header field parameter, and set it to a value that identifies the service provider from which the request is sent.

q_56176.question: What should the pSEPP do after verifying the updates and PLMN-ID in step 6?
q_56176.ground_truth: The pSEPP updates the modified values of the attributes in the clearTextEncapsulationMessage in order.

q_56177.question: What is the time limit for the UE to discard the radio link failure information from VarRLF-Report after radio link failure is detected?
q_56177.ground_truth: The UE may discard the radio link failure information, i.e. release the UE variable VarRLF-Report 48 hours after the radio link failure is detected.

q_56178.question: What must happen in a subframe for a UE with TDD and default 'specialSubframePatterns' = ssp6 for any one of P-RNTI, RA-RNTI, or C-RNTI?
q_56178.ground_truth: In a subframe, either 1 DCI for P-RNTI, 1 DCI for RA-RNTI, or 1 or 2 DCIs for C-RNTI will happen.

q_56179.question: What is the measurement report delay requirement for an event triggered measurement report in this test case?
q_56179.ground_truth: The measurement report delay shall be less than 4 + L* measCycleSCell s

q_56180.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for NR V2X UE with two transmit antenna connectors in this test case?
q_56180.ground_truth: The requirements specified for single carrier in clause 6.4E.2.2.1.3 shall apply to each transmit antenna connector for NR V2X UE with two transmit antenna connectors.

q_56181.question: When does the authorization for link establishment or Ranging/SL positioning operations take place for Ranging/SL positioning capable UE?
q_56181.ground_truth: The authorization can be performed either during link establishment or during Ranging/SL positioning operations.

q_56182.question: What does the first line of the Codec-Data AVP indicate?
q_56182.ground_truth: The first line of the Codec-Data AVP indicates the direction of the source of the SDP used to derive the information. If it indicates "uplink", it relates to properties of the UE and is applicable for IP flows in the downlink direction. If it indicates "downlink", it relates to properties of the network and is applicable for IP flows in the uplink direction.

q_56183.question: Which UE releases does the test described in 8.3.1.1 apply to?
q_56183.ground_truth: This test applies to all E-UTRA UE release 15 onwards and capable of NR measurements.

q_56184.question: When should the UE start ignoring cells with PSC reserved for CSG cells for intra-frequency and inter-frequency measurements and cell re-selections?
q_56184.ground_truth: The UE may ignore cells with PSC in the stored range "CSG PSC Split Information" for intra-frequency and inter-frequency measurements and cell re-selections if the UE has no or an empty Permitted CSG list, as per TS 25.304, clause 5.2.6.4.1.

q_56185.question: When the UE is in EMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE state and the current TAI is in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service", what should the UE do when it re-selects a new cell in the same TAI it was already rejected?
q_56185.ground_truth: The UE should not attempt to attach.

q_56186.question: What are the requirements for the SC UE to apply the procedures in subclause 12.2.3B.3 for access transfer for calls in alerting state?
q_56186.ground_truth: The SC UE must support single radio PS to CS access transfer for calls in alerting state, and there must be one or more early dialogs created by the same SIP INVITE request with at least one dialog that is an early dialog supporting a session with active speech media component, where the SC UE has sent a Contact header field in a SIP INVITE request or 180 (Ringing) response containing the g.3gpp.srvcc-alerting media feature tag, and has received a Feature-Caps header field in a SIP INVITE request or 180 (Ringing) response containing the g.3gpp.srvcc-alerting feature capability indicator.

q_56187.question: What actions can the controlling MCPTT function take to release a group call session?
q_56187.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function can release a group call session if the T4 timer expires, there are no or only one participants, the initiator leaves the call, the minimum number of affiliated MCPTT group members is not present, or TNG3 timer expires in case of a broadcast group call.

q_56188.question: What should be the minimum pass rate and confidence level for the number of correct events observed in this test?
q_56188.ground_truth: The minimum pass rate should be 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

q_56189.question: What action is taken by the SEALDD Server upon a successful request to push a DD Context to it?
q_56189.ground_truth: The SEALDD Server responds with an HTTP "200 OK" status code and the DdContextResp data structure in the response body.

q_56190.question: How many beams per panel are used in Scenario-A for Samsung's uni-directional RRH deployment evaluation?
q_56190.ground_truth: One beam per RRH panel and one beam per UE panel are used in Scenario-A for Samsung's uni-directional RRH deployment.

q_56191.question: What should the target AMF derive from the received KASME and NH values to construct a mapped 5G security context?
q_56191.ground_truth: The target AMF should derive a mapped KAMF' key from the received KASME and the NH value in the EPS security context.

q_56192.question: What is the use of the "Invoke id" parameter in the described services?
q_56192.ground_truth: The "Invoke id" parameter is used to uniquely identify a service request, allowing the receiver to match responses with the correct requests.

q_56193.question: What procedure is used in EPS for a UE leaving coverage?
q_56193.ground_truth: The TAU procedure is used instead of the Registration Procedure, and the ATTACH procedure may be used in addition. The NWDAF and UCU procedure are not available in EPS.

q_56194.question: What is the entity that provides RT latency requirement to the PCF in the solution described in section 6.28?
q_56194.ground_truth: The AF (Application Function) provides RT latency requirement to the PCF directly when the AF is trusted or via NEF when the AF is untrusted in the solution described in section 6.28.

q_56195.question: What is the function of the "CC request retention" option in CCBS service?
q_56195.ground_truth: The "CC request retention" option allows the network provider to maintain the CC request in the destination B queue, even if a CC call has failed due to a destination busy condition.

q_56196.question: How is the event triggered measurement reporting delay defined in the test procedure?
q_56196.ground_truth: The event triggered measurement reporting delay is defined as the time between an event that will trigger a measurement report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface, assuming that the measurement report is not delayed by other RRC signalling on the DCCH.

q_56197.question: What is the objective of the resilient 5G system time synchronization use case?
q_56197.ground_truth: The use case aims to maintain time synchronization in the 5G system during a loss or degradation of GNSS reference timing signals, which are used for network synchronization. This is accomplished by receiving accurate timing signals from one or more independent timing sources, detecting when GNSS reference timing signals are no longer viable, and maintaining accurate time synchronization during degradation or loss of GNSS timing signals.

q_56198.question: What is the distribution of the UE location that can be used for generating the training dataset?
q_56198.ground_truth: The distribution of the UE location can be either grid distribution or uniform distribution.

q_56199.question: What should be the initial conditions of the user equipment when performing the procedure specified in sub-clause 5.2A.2A.1?
q_56199.ground_truth: The UE should be in Generic Default RB Established, UE Test Mode Activated (State 3A-RF) and the Test USIM should be inserted.

q_56200.question: What should be the value of the R field in the Activation/Deactivation MAC control element when setting the state of an SCell?
q_56200.ground_truth: The R field should be set to "0" in the Activation/Deactivation MAC control element when setting the state of an SCell.

q_56201.question: What should the VGMLC do in the case of roaming if the UE is unable to send event reports in step 28 or step 29?
q_56201.ground_truth: The (H)GMLC may cancel the periodic or triggered location reporting using the procedures defined in clause 6.3.3. The UE may also cancel the periodic or triggered location reporting either locally or using the procedure defined in clause 6.3.2 once the UE can access an access network that is allowed for event reporting.

q_56202.question: What method allows an AF to create an MBS User Service resource at the NEF using the MBSUserService API?

q_56203.question: What should the transmission participant do when it has received Transmission Arbitration Taken message, and if it is a broadcast group call, system call, emergency call or an imminent peril call?
q_56203.ground_truth: The transmission participant should include a Transmission Indicator field indicating the relevant call types in the Transmission Arbitration Taken message, and enter 'O: transmission arbitration' state.

q_56204.question: What is the difference between "single-band connector" and "single-band RIB"?
q_56204.ground_truth: "Single-band connector" refers to a BS type 1-C antenna connector or BS type 1-H TAB connector that supports operation in a single operating band only or in multiple operating bands but does not meet the conditions for a multi-band connector, while "single-band RIB" refers to an operating band-specific RIB supporting operation in a single operating band only, or in multiple operating bands but does not meet the conditions for a multi-band RIB.

q_56205.question: What should the MCData emergency private priority state be set to when it receives a SIP INVITE request for an MCData emergency private communication?
q_56205.ground_truth: The MCData emergency private priority state should be set to "MDEPP 2: in-progress."

q_56206.question: How does the process of network-verified UE location specification support in Rel-18 work in the context of 3GPP?
q_56206.ground_truth: The present document analyzes the regulatory requirements for UE location service for a set of use cases/services in 3GPP Rel-18, and identifies the possible need for network-verified UE location specification support.

q_56207.question: What is the difference in conducted test requirements between single-band and multi-band connectors for IAB-DU or IAB-MT capable of multi-band operation in non-contiguous spectrum?
q_56207.ground_truth: Single-band connectors have requirements such as single-band transmitter spurious emissions, operating band unwanted emissions, ACLR, transmitter intermodulation and receiver spurious emissions. On the other hand, multi-band connectors have exclusions or provisions that apply to them. The requirements for each type of connector are specified in detail in the document, with specific limitations and conditions that apply.

q_56208.question: What action does the receiving UM RLC entity take when t-Reordering expires?
q_56208.ground_truth: When t-Reordering expires, the receiving UM RLC entity updates state variables, reassembles and delivers RLC SDUs to the upper layer, and starts t-Reordering as needed.

q_56209.question: What should an MCVideo gateway server do when receiving an incoming SIP message when acting as an entry point in an MCVideo system?
q_56209.ground_truth: The MCVideo gateway server should identify the MCVideo system identity of the interconnected MCVideo system from the P-Asserted-Identity header field of the incoming SIP message and may enforce local policy, such as rejecting a SIP request if there is no mutual aid relationship with the interconnected MCVideo system.

q_56210.question: Which element in the XML schema has the type "xs:string" and can appear up to once in the schema?
q_56210.ground_truth: The element "result" has the type "xs:string" and can appear up to once in the schema.

q_56211.question: What is the criticality type and presence of the "id-TransactionID" protocol information element in the "ResourceStatusRequest" procedure?
q_56211.ground_truth: The criticality type is "reject" and presence is "mandatory".

q_56212.question: What must an AS do when it receives a P-Access-Network-Info header field which contains a Cell Global Identity (CGI) or a Service Area Identifier (SAI) information and contains the "network provided" header field parameter?
q_56212.ground_truth: If required by local operator policy and if the AS is able to deduce a Geographical Identifier from the contained Cell Global Identity (CGI) or form the contained Service Area Identifier (SAI), the AS shall insert an operator-specific-GI header field parameter in that received network provided P-Access-Network-Info header field.

q_56213.question: In EMM-CONNECTED mode, what should the MME do if the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST contains a valid KSIASME but does not contain a valid KSI in the Non-current native NAS key set identifier IE?
q_56213.ground_truth: The MME should remove the non-current native EPS security context and initiate a security mode control procedure using the KASME.

q_56214.question: When updating the cellsTriggeredList in the VarMeasReportList for a measId in the context of event triggered measurements, what must be included in the list?
q_56214.ground_truth: The concerned cell(s) are included in the cellsTriggeredList defined within the VarMeasReportList for the measId when the trigger conditions are met for one or more cells.

q_56215.question: What protocol is used to support location requests sent by an LCS Client to a GMLC or LRF in the Le reference point?
q_56215.ground_truth: The Mobile Location Protocol (MLP) defined by OMA can be used to support the Le reference point.

q_56216.question: Which IEs are to be included in the minSchedulingOffsetPreferenceExt IE if the UE has a preference for the value of K0 for cross-slot scheduling with 480 kHz SCS?

q_56217.question: What is the purpose of the 5G ProSe Layer-2 UE-to-UE Relay procedures?
q_56217.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe Layer-2 UE-to-UE Relay procedures outline the steps for a user equipment (UE) to act as a relay for direct communication between two other UEs in the same ProSe group.

q_56218.question: When is the "BC repeat indicator" information element included in the "Setup" message?
q_56218.ground_truth: The "BC repeat indicator" information element is included in the "Setup" message if and only if both the "bearer capability 1" and "bearer capability 2" information elements are present in the message.

q_56219.question: What are the steps taken by a UE Application to initiate traffic for the tactile and multi-modal communication service in 5GC?
q_56219.ground_truth: The UE Application may provide the Coordination Identifier to the NAS layer as a Traffic Descriptor and use a PDU Session Modification procedure to provide the Coordination Identifier to the network. If a new PDU Session is established, the UE uses a PDU Session Establishment procedure to provide the Coordination Identifier to the network. The PCC Rules obtained by the SMF are used to derive QoS Rules for the flows of the service.

q_56220.question: What happens to the State of the UE and gNB/ng-eNB when the RRC connection is released?
q_56220.ground_truth: When the gNB/ng-eNB releases the RRC connection, the UE and the gNB/ng-eNB shall delete the keys they store such that state in the network for CM-IDLE state UEs will only be maintained in the AMF.

q_56221.question: What is the purpose of a callback URL in the 5GMS system?
q_56221.ground_truth: A callback URL is used by the 5GMS AF to verify the authorization token with the 5GMS Application Provider, ensuring that the 5GMS-Aware Application is authorized to active the dynamic policy. The callback URL is stored together with the Policy Template parameters so that the use of the network policy resource can be revalidated periodically.

q_56222.question: What should the HTTP status code be if the creation of a 5G-VN-Group cannot be accepted due to MTC Provider or AF not being allowed to perform the operation for the UE?

q_56223.question: What is the action taken by the SS after receiving the MeasurementReport message in step 6 or when T2 expires, before starting the next iteration of the test procedure loop?
q_56223.ground_truth: The SS transmits a RRCRelease message to release the RRC connection and the established radio bearers as well as all radio resources or switches the UE off. Then, it sets the Cell 2 and 3 physical cell identities for the next iteration of the test procedure loop.

q_56224.question: How many cells are deployed in the test?
q_56224.ground_truth: Three cells are deployed in the test: E-UTRAN PCell (Cell 1), PSCell (Cell 2), and a neighbor cell (Cell 3).

q_56225.question: What must the MS/user include in the CALL CONFIRMED message if they accept a multimedia call only and provide a single bearer capability IE?
q_56225.ground_truth: A single multimedia bearer capability IE.

q_56226.question: What are the information attributes used for calculating the digital signature in Solution #20?
q_56226.ground_truth: PCI (PSS, SSS), MIB, SIB1, Time counter, Downlink frequency

q_56227.question: What is the subcounter value incremented when a failed parameter getting occurs at UDM?
q_56227.ground_truth: Each message of a failed parameter getting increments the relevant subcounter per failure cause by 1 at UDM.

q_56228.question: What should an SDP answerer do if an unknown or malformed "qos-hint-property" is received in an SDP offer?
q_56228.ground_truth: The SDP answerer should ignore the unknown or malformed "qos-hint-property", omit it from the SDP answer, and continue processing the rest of the SDP offer without rejecting it.

q_56229.question: What is the requirement for emissions in single RAT UTRA TDD operation?
q_56229.ground_truth: The power of any spurious emission shall not exceed the levels specified for co-existence with other systems in the same geographical area.

q_56230.question: What is the performance criteria for ancillary equipment in continuous phenomena?
q_56230.ground_truth: The apparatus shall continue to operate as intended during and after the test with no degradation of performance or loss of function below the performance level specified by the manufacturer.

q_56231.question: What modification is made to the LIU procedure in the context of a Layer-3 UE-to-UE Relay?
q_56231.ground_truth: The LIU procedure is modified to request the UE-to-UE Relay to allocate a new IP address/prefix to the source UE, and to send this new IP address/prefix to the peer UE.

q_56232.question: What is the requirement for unknown SCell activation in a multiple SCells activation scenario?
q_56232.ground_truth: The requirement for unknown SCell activation in a multiple SCells activation scenario is that the PDCCH order (when applicable) and the activation commands for TCI, UL spatial relation and PL-RS (when applicable) are based on the latest valid L1-RSRP reporting via Primary PUCCH group.

q_56233.question: What scenarios can be distinguished in MMS charging?
