q_56468.ground_truth: The Intranet Protocol is used to ensure security between the UE and the intranet when data is transmitted over an insecure network. This protocol is responsible for user authentication and encryption of user data.

q_56469.question: After how many attempts will the initiating UE abort the 5G ProSe direct link establishment procedure if it does not receive a PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message?
q_56469.ground_truth: The maximum number of allowed retransmissions is UE implementation specific.

q_56470.question: What happens during the user/UE accessing services provided by PIN devices?
q_56470.ground_truth: Based on the location of the UE, the communication method connecting the UE and PIN Element vary. When the user is out of home, the 5G network connects the UE and the PIN Element behind the PIN Element with gateway Capability. When the user is at home, the PIN Element with gateway Capability discovers and connects the UE via PIN direct connection or direct device connection.

q_56471.question: When no uplink transmission can be made due to measurement gaps or Sidelink Discovery Gaps for Transmission, what kind of retransmission follows?

q_56472.question: What is the UE requirement for intra-band contiguous carrier aggregation with one uplink carrier and two or more downlink sub-blocks, as specified in subclause 7.8.1F?
q_56472.ground_truth: The UE shall meet the requirements for each sub-block as specified in subclauses 7.8.1.1 and in this subclause for one component carrier and two or more component carriers per sub-block, respectively, with requirements applying for out-of-gap interferers while all downlink carriers are active.

q_56473.question: What are the conditions that must be met for the inter-frequency relative CSI-RSRP measurement accuracy requirements to be valid?
q_56473.ground_truth: The conditions include the transmission of CSI reference signals in discovery signal occasions on one antenna port only from each TP, the fulfillment of conditions defined in 36.101 Clause 7.3 for reference sensitivity, the measurement of CSI-RSRP as specified in Annex B.3.24.3 for a corresponding Band, and the absence of MBSFN subframes in the discovery signal occasion. Additionally, the measured channels or TPs must include at least one operating under frame structure 3, and the difference in CSI-RSRP must be 20 dB.

q_56474.question: What happens if the target Cell ID reported by the UE is a false base station during the X2/Xn link setup for handover?
q_56474.ground_truth: The X2/Xn link set up will fail.

q_56475.question: What XML schema should be used for defining user data in the Confirmation of Manual Service Operation (CONF) service in 3GPP TS 24.605?
q_56475.ground_truth: No user data is defined for 3GPP TS 24.605 subclause 4.16.1. The operator part of the CONF service does not contain any user-defined data.

q_56476.question: What are the main steps in the UE-initiated Application Data Channel Establishment procedure for an existing bootstrap data channel connection in the IMS data channel?
q_56476.ground_truth: The UE-initiated Application Data Channel Establishment procedure for an existing bootstrap data channel connection includes sending a SIP re-INVITE request with an updated SDP to the Application Server (AS), negotiating the data channel media content transmission between the UE devices, and establishing the application data channel connection between the UE devices. The UE devices can then send application request messages to the Data Channel Media Function (DCMF) via the established data channel.

q_56477.question: What is the procedure for protecting IPX provider modified attributes?
q_56477.ground_truth: The IPX providers use JSON Web Signature (JWS) with asymmetric methods and private/public key pairs to integrity protect the modifiedDataToIntegrityProtect object.

q_56478.question: What do the terms "shall" and "shall not" mean in the context of 3GPP documents?
q_56478.ground_truth: The term "shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something, while the term "shall not" indicates a prohibition to do something.

q_56479.question: What is the purpose of the "Last Visited PSCell Information" IE in the context of 3GPP radio access networks?
q_56479.ground_truth: The "Last Visited PSCell Information" IE contains cell-specific information related to CN paging subgrouping for a specific UE in 3GPP radio access networks.

q_56480.question: What is the formula used to calculate nrs-Power in the determination of the downlink path loss estimate in dB for serving cell?
q_56480.ground_truth: nrs-Power is provided by higher layers and Clause 16.2.2 for serving cell.

q_56481.question: What indicator is used in the Proxy Binding Acknowledgement when deferred IPv4 address allocation is allowed and a new IPv4 address is not assigned during initial attach procedure?
q_56481.ground_truth: The DHCPv4 Address Allocation Procedure Indication is returned in the Proxy Binding Acknowledgement.

q_56482.question: When is the CA duplication deactivated for a DRB in a MAC entity?
q_56482.ground_truth: When none or only one of RLC entities of the DRB in the MAC entity remains activated.

q_56483.question: When providing the authenticated identity of the originating party for calls terminating to the PSTN, what information must the MGCF insert into the PSTN signalling?
q_56483.ground_truth: The MGCF must insert information received in the SIP message, including the privacy setting and potentially the display name.

q_56484.question: How are subband CQI values encoded when reported for each codeword?
q_56484.ground_truth: Subband CQI values are encoded differentially with respect to their respective wideband CQI values using 2-bits as defined by Subband differential CQI offset level = subband CQI index - wideband CQI index.

q_56485.question: What should the network indicate during the attach procedure if it supports one or more MUSIM features and the UE has indicated support for those features?
q_56485.ground_truth: The network should indicate the support of one or more MUSIM features during the attach procedure if it has decided to accept them and the UE has indicated support for those features.

q_56486.question: What information is assigned to each of the SR5 service elements to support operation over different PC5 RATs?
q_56486.ground_truth: Each of the SR5 service elements is assigned a V2X Service Type (e.g. PSID, ITS-AID, or AID) and a ProSe Identifier (e.g. Application ID) to support the operation over different PC5 RATs.

q_56487.question: What happens when the CBCF receives a RESTART-INDICATION-NG-RAN message shortly after a preceding one with the same Restarted Cell List NG-RAN included in both messages?
q_56487.ground_truth: The CBCF considers the RESTART-INDICATION-NG-RAN as a duplicate message and ignores it.

q_56488.question: How is a global ML model generated in Federated Learning among multiple NWDAFs containing MTLF?
q_56488.ground_truth: In Federated Learning among multiple NWDAFs containing MTLF, the FL server NWDAF generates global ML model by aggregating local model information from FL client NWDAFs. It sends the global ML model back to FL client NWDAFs and repeats training iteration if needed.

q_56489.question: What is the purpose of the MCData function in 3GPP TS 24.582?
q_56489.ground_truth: The MCData function in 3GPP TS 24.582 executes the procedure in clause 6.3.7.1.22 and is used for file distribution (FD) and short data service (SDS) in 3GPP systems.

q_56490.question: Which is the highest average power saving gain provided by LP-WUS for DL only XR traffic in low load compared to the legacy schemes, assuming MR enters micro sleep during LP-WUS monitoring?

q_56491.question: In the procedure for actions upon reception of SIB2, when should the UE apply the p-Max?
q_56491.ground_truth: In the procedure for actions upon reception of SIB2, the UE should apply the p-Max in step 2, if the UE does not support at least one additionalSpectrumEmission within the frequencyBandList; in step 3, if the UE does not select a frequency band for the supplementary uplink; and in step 4, if the UE does not support at least one additionalSpectrumEmission within the frequencyBandListSUL. Additionally, the UE should apply the p-Max for SUL in step 6, if the additionalPmax is not present in the same entry of the selected additionalSpectrumEmission within nr-NS-PmaxList for the supplementary uplink.

q_56492.question: What is the default power class in the 5G NR specifications?
q_56492.ground_truth: Power class 3 is the default power class in the 5G NR specifications.

q_56493.question: Which procedure is applied for redundant I-UPF or redundant N3/N9 tunnels for URLLC in Service Request procedures from 3GPP access?
q_56493.ground_truth: The procedure in clause~4.2.3.2 is applied for this scenario.

q_56494.question: What is the procedure followed when the candidate expiration interval is zero in clause 9A.2.2.2.3.1?
q_56494.ground_truth: When the candidate expiration interval is zero, the MCPTT server constructs the candidate list of the functional alias information entries for each functional alias ID that has an entry in the served list of the functional alias information entries. The server then sets the functional alias status of the new functional alias information entry to the "deactivating" state and sets the expiration time to the current time increased with twice the value of timer F.

q_56495.question: What happens to the MA PDU Session when UE moves from 5GS to EPS in idle mode or connected mobility and the PDN connection is moved to EPS as well?
q_56495.ground_truth: The SMF triggers PDU Session Release procedure to release the MA PDU Session over Non-3GPP access.

q_56496.question: What is one of the functions provided by the Visited Policy Control Function (V-PCF) to the visited network as NF service producer?
q_56496.ground_truth: The Visited Policy Control Function (V-PCF) provides functions such as receiving policy control request triggers and/or UE policy (e.g. ANDSP, URSP, V2XP, A2XP, ProSeP, RSLPP) from the H-PCF, and reporting the UE state and UE policy enforcement result to the H-PCF.

q_56497.question: When is the UE not required to conduct reception/transmission from/to the corresponding serving cells during the gap occasion for a per-UE Pre-MG pattern as per the network-controlled or autonomous activation/deactivation mechanism?
q_56497.ground_truth: If the per-UE Pre-MG pattern is activated then the UE is not required to conduct reception/transmission from/to the corresponding serving cells during the gap occasion, otherwise, the UE can be scheduled for reception/transmission of signals in all the serving cells during the gap occasion.

q_56498.question: What action does the MCVideo server take after replacing the list of MCVideo group information entries in the served MCVideo client information entry with the candidate list?
q_56498.ground_truth: The MCVideo server performs the procedures specified in clause 8.2.2.2.6 for the served MCVideo ID and each MCVideo group ID that has an MCVideo group information entry in the candidate list with an affiliation status of "affiliating."

q_56499.question: Which HTTP method is supported by the All service API invocation logs resource, as per 8.8.2.2.3.1?
q_56499.ground_truth: The GET method is supported by the All service API invocation logs resource, as per 8.8.2.2.3.1.

q_56500.question: Which HTTP method is used to read a transaction resource to obtain details of an active chargeable party transaction in the specified system?
q_56500.ground_truth: The GET method is used to read a transaction resource to obtain details of an active chargeable party transaction in the specified system.

q_56501.question: What variables are used to determine the leaving condition for this event, as specified in 5.5.4.4?
q_56501.ground_truth: Mn, Ms, Ofn, Ocn, Ofs, Ocs, Hys, and Off are used to determine the leaving condition for this event.

q_56502.question: When does the 3GP-DASH client initiate a Network Assistance session with the DANE?
q_56502.ground_truth: The 3GP-DASH client initiates a Network Assistance session with the Network Assistance DANE at a convenient stage in the process of preparing to receive the content, and it ends when the playback of that content item stops.

q_56503.question: In what scenarios is the AN-GW-Address AVP included in the CCA command sent by the H-PCRF to the V-PCRF?
q_56503.ground_truth: The AN-GW-Address AVP is included in the CCA command sent by the H-PCRF to the V-PCRF if the PCC rules are applicable only for a single BBERF in the CCA command.

q_56504.question: What is the purpose of the S-CSCF adding an "fe-addr" element of the "fe-identifier" header field parameter to the P-Charging-Vector header field?
q_56504.ground_truth: The purpose is to add its own address or identifier if not already available to support charging purposes.

q_56505.question: What is the maximum number of active transmitter units that can be considered when calculating the emissions limit for an AAS BS in single RAT UTRA operation and UTRA only MSR AAS BS?
q_56505.ground_truth: The maximum number of active transmitter units that can be considered is four times the number of cells.

q_56506.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 9.1.61.2?
q_56506.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that CSI-RSRP measurement accuracy is within the specified limits for SCells operating under frame structure 3.

q_56507.question: What should the UE do during T3 if it doesn't send at least one CSI report for PSCell with a non-zero CQI index?
q_56507.ground_truth: The UE should increase the number of failed iterations by one, switch off the UE and continue to step 11.

q_56508.question: What is the name of the complex type defined in the schema that allows any XML attribute to be used in the future?

q_56509.question: What is the role of the first field with bits in resource allocations of type 1?
q_56509.ground_truth: The first field with bits is used to indicate the selected RBG subset among RBG subsets.

q_56510.question: In what scenario can a UE trigger a Mobility Registration Update to switch traffic from an old non-3GPP access to a new non-3GPP access?
q_56510.ground_truth: When the UE supports non-3GPP access path switching, the AMF has indicated support for it, and the PLMN of the selected new non-3GPP access is the same as the old one.

q_56511.question: What must the NF Service Producer support in the inter-PLMN scenario for Key Issue #7 solution?
q_56511.ground_truth: The NF Service Producer must support whichever authorization mechanism is determined by the hNRF.

q_56512.question: What should the UE do if it does not receive the extended idle mode DRX parameters information element in the relevant accept message from the MME?
q_56512.ground_truth: The UE shall apply its regular discontinuous reception as defined in clause~5.13.

q_56513.question: What is the minimum number of inter-frequency cells that a UE shall be capable of performing RSRP and RSRQ measurements for in the E-UTRAN TDD-TDD inter frequency measurements test?
q_56513.ground_truth: The UE shall be capable of performing RSRP and RSRQ measurements of at least 4 inter-frequency cells per TDD inter-frequency.

q_56514.question: What action does the User Equipment (UE) take when it has the capability to support both Terrestrial Network (TN) and Non-Terrestrial Network (NTN) access?
q_56514.ground_truth: The UE informs the network of its capability to support both TN and NTN access.

q_56515.question: What message does the UE send to the N3IWF to terminate the EAP-5G session?
q_56515.ground_truth: The UE sends an EAP-Response/5G-Stop message to the N3IWF to terminate the EAP-5G session.

q_56516.question: What is the value of in-channel sub-band selectivity agreed upon for modeling the inter-sub-band selectivity?

q_56517.question: What is the condition for a successful test case in the test procedure?
q_56517.ground_truth: A successful test case is when the overall delays measured (time from the beginning of time period T2 to the moment the UE sends an Event A3 triggered measurement report) is less than 1002 ms.

q_56518.question: What is the abbreviation used in this specification to describe Physical Downlink Shared Channel?

q_56519.question: When should a MS return a status message with cause #97 "message type non-existent or not implemented" when receiving a message in acknowledged mode?
q_56519.ground_truth: When the message is not defined for the PD or not implemented by the receiver.

q_56520.question: What is the purpose of the measurement "Number of PDU Sessions successfully setup"?
q_56520.ground_truth: This measurement provides the number of PDU Sessions successfully setup by the N3IWF for the PDU SESSION RESOURCE SETUP REQUESTs received from AMF, and it is split into subcounters per S-NSSAI.

q_56521.question: What is the purpose of NR Enhanced Cell ID (NR E-CID) positioning methods?
q_56521.ground_truth: NR E-CID positioning refers to techniques which use UE and/or NR radio resource related measurements to improve the UE location estimate.

q_56522.question: What is the meaning of "5G-GUTI" in 3GPP TS 23.003?
q_56522.ground_truth: 5G-GUTI is an abbreviation for 5G Globally Unique Temporary Identifier, defined in 3GPP TS 23.003.

q_56523.question: Which carriers are used for generating IABTC2 in the context of NR IAB testing?
q_56523.ground_truth: IABTC2 is generated using all component carrier combinations supported by the beam which have different sums of channel bandwidths. Additionally, it tests combinations with the narrowest carrier spacing at the lower and upper IAB RF Bandwidth edges.

q_56524.question: What should the UE do if the Contention Resolution Timer expires when performing a random access procedure?
q_56524.ground_truth: The UE needs to re-select a preamble and transmit with the calculated PRACH transmission power when the backoff time expires if the Contention Resolution Timer expires.

q_56525.question: What is the second step in switching from a controlling MCPTT function mode to a non-controlling MCPTT function mode?
q_56525.ground_truth: The second step is for the controlling MCPTT function to start acting as a non-controlling MCPTT function. The floor control server sends a Floor Request message for each queued floor request, stores the active floor request queue in a passive floor request queue, and performs specified actions.

q_56526.question: What are the scenarios for LTE V2X sidelink communication and NR sidelink communication?
q_56526.ground_truth: The scenarios can be categorized into standalone and MR-DC scenarios, with the standalone scenarios supporting LTE V2X sidelink communication and NR sidelink communication through gNB, ng-eNB, and eNB. The MR-DC scenarios support LTE V2X sidelink communication and NR sidelink communication through Uu, NGEN-DC, and EN-DC.

q_56527.question: What is the expected behavior of a RedCap UE when identifying CGI of an NR cell with autonomous gaps in section 16.6.5.0.1 of the document?
q_56527.ground_truth: When a RedCap UE is identifying CGI of an NR cell with autonomous gaps, the UE is not expected to transmit PUCCH/PUSCH/SRS or receive PDCCH/PDSCH/TRS/CSI-RS for CQI on PCell for the following slots specified in section 16.6.5.0.1 of the document.

q_56528.question: When an access technology is disabled for a PLMN within the list of equivalent PLMNs, how does the UE implementation ensure that registration to a different PLMN within the list of equivalent PLMNs does not result in reselection or inter-system change to the disabled access technology of that PLMN?
q_56528.ground_truth: The UE implementation ensures that registration to a different PLMN within the list of equivalent PLMN does not result in reselection or inter-system change to the disabled access technology of that PLMN by using the same access technology selection as in NOTE 3.

q_56529.question: What are the operating bands specified for the downlink signals of NR cells before measurement, as specified in Annex C?
q_56529.ground_truth: The operating bands for the downlink signals of NR cells before measurement are specified in Annex C.

q_56530.question: What should the eNB do if the X2 Removal Threshold IE is included in the EN-DC X2 REMOVAL REQUEST message?
q_56530.ground_truth: If supported, the candidate eNB should accept to remove the interface instance with the en-gNB if the X2 Benefit Value of the interface instance determined at the candidate eNB is lower than the value of the X2 Removal Threshold IE.

q_56531.question: What information can the NG-RAN node take into account when deciding whether to accept the setup of a QoS flow or not during the PDU SESSION RESOURCE SETUP REQUEST message handling?
q_56531.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node may accept the setup of the QoS flow when notification control has been enabled if the requested QoS parameters or at least one of the alternative QoS parameters sets can be fulfilled at the time of setup.

q_56532.question: What is the maximum length of the Mobile Identity information element?
q_56532.ground_truth: The maximal length of the Mobile Identity information element is 11 octets.

q_56533.question: What is the result of step 9 in the 3GPP AAA Server when the IMEI is not provided by the UE to the ePDG?

q_56534.question: What condition must be met for the IRI-POI in the PTC server to generate an xIRI containing a PTCSessionStart record?
q_56534.ground_truth: The IRI-POI in the PTC server generates the xIRI containing a PTCSessionStart record when the IRI-POI present in the PTC server detects that the PTC Session is initiated and communication begins for both an on-demand and pre-established PTC session.

q_56535.question: What does the NOP build using performance measurements and PEE parameters?
q_56535.ground_truth: The NOP builds EE KPIs using performance measurements and PEE parameters for its own purpose, i.e. the EE KPIs are not communicated to any other roles.

q_56536.question: What does the absence of the "UTRAN Barometric Pressure Measurement" parameter imply?
q_56536.ground_truth: A barometric pressure measurement was not available or could not be successfully obtained.

q_56537.question: What is the purpose of the NPUSCH format 1 tests in clause 8.5.1.1?
q_56537.ground_truth: The purpose of these tests is to verify the receiver's ability to achieve a minimum required throughput for a given SNR, assuming HARQ re-transmissions, for the narrowband IoT NPUSCH format 1.

q_56538.question: When can the AMF-UE send a Page Relay towards the AMF-MBSR when the UE moves with the MBSR?
q_56538.ground_truth: When the AMF-UE knows the serving RAN node for the MBSR and the UE context includes a Link ID.

q_56539.question: What does AAS BS refer to in the document?
q_56539.ground_truth: AAS BS stands for Active Antenna System Base Station.

q_56540.question: What is the role of a multimedia telephony participant in an IMS multimedia telephony communication service?
q_56540.ground_truth: A UE shall implement the role of a multimedia telephony participant, which is responsible for participating in IMS multimedia telephony communication service sessions.

q_56541.question: When SMF provides charging information related to 5GS CIoT during PDU session establishment, what are the three types of information it provides?
q_56541.ground_truth: The indication of Control Plane 5GS CIoT optimization, small data rate control indication, and the RAT types (NB-IoT or LTE-M).

q_56542.question: What is the main goal of using ECN bits for L4S as per Solution #41?
q_56542.ground_truth: The main goal of using ECN bits for L4S as per Solution #41 is to enable codec/rate adaptation to meet requirements for services in 5G System.

q_56543.question: What are the three actions that the eNodeB takes after sending an S1 UE Context Release Request (Cause) message to the MME to release the S1 UE context?
q_56543.ground_truth: The three actions that the eNodeB takes after sending an S1 UE Context Release Request (Cause) message to the MME to release the S1 UE context are specified in TS 23.401, such as releasing S1 UE context in the eNodeB.

q_56544.question: In which scenario is the end-to-end (e2e) encryption for the data channel used in application data channel?
q_56544.ground_truth: The end-to-end (e2e) encryption for the data channel is used in application data channel when the external Data Server supports both HTTP and IETF RFC 8831 WebRTC data channel protocols for the P2A/A2P Application data channel use cases or P2P cases when the DCMF is not used to anchor the Application data channel.

q_56545.question: What is the meaning of the indication or signalling of an NS value in this specification?
q_56545.ground_truth: The indication or signalling of an NS value refers to the corresponding indication of an NR frequency band number of the applicable operating band, the IE field freqBandIndicatorNR and an associated value of additionalSpectrumEmission in the relevant RRC information elements.

q_56546.question: What network behavior does the UE indicate during the registration procedure to prefer control plane CIoT 5GS optimization or user plane CIoT 5GS optimization?
q_56546.ground_truth: The UE may indicate preference for control plane CIoT 5GS optimization or user plane CIoT 5GS optimization, which is considered as the request to use the corresponding behavior.

q_56547.question: What should the participating MCData function include in the outgoing SIP MESSAGE request for FD disposition notification for MCData server if the FD disposition notification type IE is set as "FILE DOWNLOAD REQUEST ACCEPTED"?
q_56547.ground_truth: The participating MCData function should include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body in the outgoing SIP MESSAGE request, containing an <mcdata-calling-user-id> element set to the MCData ID of the originating user, the ICSI value "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcdata.fd" in the P-Asserted-Service header field, and send the SIP MESSAGE request as specified in 3GPP TS 24.229.

q_56548.question: What is the purpose of specifying the interface for USIM Application Toolkit?
q_56548.ground_truth: The purpose of specifying the interface is to ensure interoperability between a UICC and an ME independently of the respective manufacturers and operators for USIM Application Toolkit.

q_56549.question: How does the EES handle graceful shutdown for maintenance or other reasons?
q_56549.ground_truth: The EES pushes all related context to a selected alternate EES instance and notifies all its consumers, who then re-connect to another EES instance within the same EES set for subsequent communication.

q_56550.question: What are the differences between originating IMS application services and terminating IMS application services?
q_56550.ground_truth: Originating IMS application services are provided by the IMS operator for SIP traffic being received from the served network operator or enterprise network. The traffic is then routed towards the destination endpoint after the application services are invoked. Terminating IMS application services, on the other hand, are provided by the IMS operator for SIP traffic that is destined to a served network operator or enterprise network, where the application services are invoked after the served network has been identified as the next network or when the traffic has been identified as destined to the served network.

q_56551.question: What is one of the responsibilities of the MTC-IWF regarding device triggering functionality, in addition to receiving a device trigger request from an SCS and reporting to the SCS the acceptance or non-acceptance of the device trigger request?
q_56551.ground_truth: The MTC-IWF may apply MTC-IWF and/or SGSN/MME induced congestion/load control as part of the response to trigger requests.

q_56552.question: What is the default mode of sending user plane data in the 3GPP network?
q_56552.ground_truth: The default mode of sending user plane data in the 3GPP network is IP unicast encapsulation of IP multicast datagrams.

q_56553.question: How does the SMF provide the access network charging identifier information within the "accNetChId" attribute of the SmPolicyContextData data structure?
q_56553.ground_truth: The SMF provides the access network charging identifier information within the "accNetChId" attribute of the SmPolicyContextData data structure by including the "accNetChaIdValue" attribute containing the Access Network Charging Identifier for the PDU session (i.e., for the default QoS flow) and the "sessionChScope" attribute set to true. The SMF may also provide the address of the network entity performing the charging functionality within the "chargEntityAddr" attribute.

q_56554.question: Which field defines whether the UE supports height-based measurement reporting?

q_56555.question: What should the UE do with the list of service route values received in the Service-Route header field?
q_56555.ground_truth: The UE should store the list of service route values and bind it either to the contact address or to the registration flow and the associated contact address.

q_56556.question: In the event of multiple service types being applicable for a target identifier in 5GC, what is the approach for provisioning the LI function?
q_56556.ground_truth: The LIPF may provision the LI function in a NF only once for all applicable service types, or may determine the services that need to be intercepted at the LI function present in a NF and then provision that LI function for all services together.

q_56557.question: What is the maximum number of transmission occasions allowed for a single transport block transmission?
q_56557.ground_truth: The maximum number of transmission occasions allowed for a single transport block transmission is K*N.

q_56558.question: What is the average horizontal positioning accuracy at CDF=90% when the number of active TRPs is reduced from 18 to 3, for TRP reduction in AI/ML assisted positioning?
q_56558.ground_truth: The average horizontal positioning accuracy is E = (2.01~42.76) x E18TRP (meters)

q_56559.question: What is the purpose of the QoS verification capability described in the solution?
q_56559.ground_truth: The purpose of the QoS verification capability is to enable the VAL server to verify QoS data of a network and check whether the existing QoS data is able to satisfy the VAL client's requirement.

q_56560.question: What is the method used by the SMF to send the P-CSCF address(es) to the UE for a PDU Session establishment procedure relating to IMS?
q_56560.ground_truth: The SMF sends the P-CSCF address(es) to the UE transparently through the AMF, and in case of Home Routed, also through the SMF in the VPLMN.

q_56561.question: What should be the format of a JSON document for an NRM in the SA5?
q_56561.ground_truth: A JSON document in an NRM for the SA5 should have only one root element, as per the well-formed XML document structure, and the XPath expression to identify the base object is defined accordingly.

q_56562.question: What should the MTSI client use as the maximum data rate if the ECN-triggered adaptation indicates AMR5.9 and the PLR-triggered adaptation indicates AMR4.75?
q_56562.ground_truth: The MTSI client should use a maximum data rate of AMR4.75.

q_56563.question: What is the parameter that enables and disables reporting of primary notification events when received from the network?

q_56564.question: Which HTTP method is used to create an individual MBS distribution session resource in the MBSTF?
q_56564.ground_truth: The POST method is used to create an individual MBS distribution session resource in the MBSTF.

q_56565.question: What is the definition of the reference duration in the context of contention window adjustment for UL transmissions?
q_56565.ground_truth: The reference duration is a duration starting from the beginning of the channel occupancy until the end of the first slot where at least one PUSCH is transmitted over all the resources allocated for the PUSCH, or until the end of the first transmission burst by the UE that contains PUSCH transmitted over all the resources allocated for the PUSCH, whichever occurs earlier.

q_56566.question: Which data type is used to indicate the unavailability cause of a service?
q_56566.ground_truth: The data type UnavailabilityCause is used to indicate the unavailability cause of a service.

q_56567.question: Which cell, A, B or 24, has its power level set to the Serving Cell level?

q_56568.question: If the UE is not registered to the access other than the access the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message is received and the 5GS registration result value in the 5GS registration result IE value in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message is set to "3GPP access and non-3GPP access", what should the UE consider itself as being registered to?
q_56568.ground_truth: Only the access where the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message is received

q_56569.question: What is the name of the media-level SDP attribute specified in clause 6.2.9 to indicate ANBR support?
q_56569.ground_truth: The name of the media-level SDP attribute specified in clause 6.2.9 to indicate ANBR support is "anbr".

q_56570.question: What is mandatory in the 5G system to provide secure communication between entities?
q_56570.ground_truth: All network functions support mutually authenticated TLS and HTTPS.

q_56571.question: What should the NW-TT do when it receives a USER PLANE NODE MANAGEMENT NOTIFY message from the TSN AF and the USER PLANE NODE MANAGEMENT NOTIFY COMPLETE message cannot be transmitted to lower layers?
q_56571.ground_truth: The NW-TT shall not diagnose an error and consider the NW-TT-initiated User plane node management procedure complete.

q_56572.question: What is the impact on the UE's Link ID when a new AMF-UE is allocated during UE mobility with the MBSR?
q_56572.ground_truth: When a new AMF-UE is allocated, the NG-RAN responds to the new AMF-UE with a new Link ID, associates the new Link ID with the UEs, and replaces the old Link ID in the context of the MBSR and the context of UEs with the new Link ID.

q_56573.question: What should be met for the UE physical layer to be capable of performing CSI-RSRP measurements of identified inter-frequency TPs with an explicit inter-frequency TP list, as specified in 8.11.3.2?
q_56573.ground_truth: The UE physical layer should be capable of performing CSI-RSRP measurements of at least 3 identified inter-frequency TPs per FS3 inter-frequency, for up to 3 FS3 inter-frequencies, with the specified measurement period.

q_56574.question: What action should the participating MCPTT function take if no binding is found between the public user identity and the MCPTT ID, and the validity period of an existing binding has expired?
q_56574.ground_truth: If the participating MCPTT function cannot find a binding between the public user identity and an MCPTT ID or if the validity period of an existing binding has expired, then the participating MCPTT function shall reject the SIP INVITE request with a SIP 404 (Not Found) response.

q_56575.question: What is the appropriate range for the RelativePresentationPriority of an MCPTT group transaction?

q_56576.question: Where in the SIP (Session Initiation Protocol) Header Fields registry is the Handover-Info header field defined?
q_56576.ground_truth: The Handover-Info header field is defined in the IANA registry: Header Fields registry for the Session Initiation Protocol (SIP)

q_56577.question: What direction should the base station be aligned during the test to meet the minimum requirement for time alignment error in the OTA coverage range?
q_56577.ground_truth: The direction to be tested for the base station should align with the RIB (Remote Integrated Center) reference direction in the OTA coverage range.

q_56578.question: What data object contains the SIP or TEL URI of the Calling Party in the ENVELOPE (EVENT DOWNLOAD - MT call) message?

q_56579.question: In what condition does the UE select the time and frequency resource for SL-PRS retransmissions if the selected resource pool is a SL-PRS dedicated resource pool?
q_56579.ground_truth: The time and frequency resource for SL-PRS retransmissions is selected randomly from the resources indicated by the physical layer, taking into account the selected number of SL-PRS retransmissions and the remaining SL-PRS delay budget.

q_56580.question: Which message is sent by the source eNB to the target eNB to initiate the Handover Preparation procedure?

q_56581.question: Which UE releases and duplex modes are applicable for the 8.16.100 test?
q_56581.ground_truth: Applicability for the 8.16.100 test requires support for FGI bit 111 for all types of E-UTRA FDD and TDD UE, from release 14 and forward, supporting 7DL CA.

q_56582.question: When must a UE trigger the UE-to-network relay selection procedure?
q_56582.ground_truth: The UE shall trigger the UE-to-network relay selection procedure if it is authorized to act as a 5G ProSe remote UE towards a 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE, and has obtained a list of 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE candidates fulfilling ProSe layer criteria and lower layers criteria.

q_56583.question: When downlink assignments are received on the PDCCH for the UE's C-RNTI, what should the UE do if this is the first downlink assignment for this TTI?
q_56583.ground_truth: If this is the first downlink assignment for this TTI, the UE should consider the NDI to have been toggled and indicate the presence of a downlink assignment and deliver the associated HARQ information to the HARQ entity for this TTI.

q_56584.question: What is the purpose of the CC-PAG in the LI system?
q_56584.ground_truth: The CC-PAG performs the function of aggregating the xCC (cross-correlation cases) from different CC-POIs towards the MDF3. It is an optional LI function that may be deployed in networks that need aggregation of xCC from potentially large number of different CC-POIs towards the MDF3.

q_56585.question: What must the UE include in the To header field if it supports RFC 6140 and performs the functions of an external attached network?
q_56585.ground_truth: The main URI of the UE.

q_56586.question: What is the role of the Mediation and Delivery Function (MDF) in a 3GPP Communication Service Provider (CSP) network?
q_56586.ground_truth: The Mediation and Delivery Function (MDF) performs any necessary mediation of the Interception Product before delivering it to the Law Enforcement Monitoring Facility (LEMF) in a 3GPP Communication Service Provider (CSP) network.

q_56587.question: In which substate does the UE search for PLMNs or SNPNs?

q_56588.question: What is the definition of a Geosynchronous Earth Orbit as specified in the document?
q_56588.ground_truth: A Geosynchronous Earth Orbit is an Earth-centered orbit at approximately 35786 kilometers above Earth's surface and synchronized with Earth's rotation. A geostationary orbit is a non-inclined geosynchronous orbit, i.e. in the Earth's equator plane.

q_56589.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Report on enhancements to the 5GC Location Services?
q_56589.ground_truth: The purpose of the report is to study further enhancements to the 5GC Location Services, including architectural enhancements, support for low power positioning, regulatory requirements, and location service continuity.

q_56590.question: What should the participating MCData function do with the candidate MCData group IDs if the number of different MCData group IDs with an affiliation status of "affiliating" or "affiliated" is bigger than the N2 value of the served MCData ID?
q_56590.ground_truth: If the number of candidate MCData group IDs is bigger than N2, the participating MCData function should reduce the number of candidate MCData group IDs to N2 as per MCData service provider policy.

q_56591.question: What is one of the policy control request triggers in Solution #2 for 5GS Bridge Information?
q_56591.ground_truth: The PCF may provide a policy control request trigger for 5GS Bridge Information during SM Policy Association.

q_56592.question: What message does the MeNB consider to concern CPAC if supported, when receiving an ED message from the MeNB?

q_56593.question: When will the UE set to NACK value in the HARQ-ACK codebook any HARQ-ACK information corresponding to PDSCH reception or SPS PDSCH release or TCI state update that the UE detects in a PDCCH monitoring occasion that starts after a PDCCH monitoring occasion where the UE detects a DCI format scheduling the PUSCH transmission?
q_56593.ground_truth: When a UE multiplexes HARQ-ACK information in a PUSCH transmission that is scheduled by a DCI format that includes a DAI field, but is not provided with fdmed-ReceptionMulticast and pdsch-HARQ-ACK-Codebook = 'semi-static' for both unicast and multicast HARQ-ACK information.

q_56594.question: What action should the UE take if a packet filter consists of conflicting packet filter components which would render the packet filter ineffective?
q_56594.ground_truth: The UE shall initiate a PDU session modification procedure by sending a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message to delete the mapped EPS bearer context with 5GSM cause #44 "semantic errors in packet filter(s)".

q_56595.question: What exception is there to including a deferred routing identifier indicating a default LMF in the LCS Periodic-Triggered Location Invoke in clause~6.3.1 for event reporting?
q_56595.ground_truth: A default LMF cannot be included in the LCS Periodic-Triggered Location Invoke because the LMF needs to know which type of positioning was indicated at step~1 for correctly supporting the subsequent steps. A default LMF would not know which type of positioning had been indicated at step~1.

q_56596.question: What is the role of the UAS NF in Solution #5?
q_56596.ground_truth: The UAS NF may play a role similar to the ProSe AF on behalf of the USS to ensure secure discovery between UAV and UAV-C.

q_56597.question: What is the ACLR requirement for the interfering signal in step 7.5.4.2.3, and what is its purpose?
q_56597.ground_truth: The ACLR requirement for the interfering signal in step 7.5.4.2.3 is at least 63~dB, and its purpose is to eliminate the impact of interfering signal adjacent channel leakage power on the ACS measurement.

q_56598.question: What is the function of the UAV identifier (UAV ID) as defined in the present document?
q_56598.ground_truth: The UAV identifier (UAV ID) is an unique identifier of a UAV. It can be in the form of a 3GPP UE ID (e.g. GPSI, External Identifier) or CAA level UAV ID as assigned by civil aviation authorities (e.g. FAA) via USS/UTM.

q_56599.question: What must the MCPTT client include in the SIP re-INVITE request when cancelling an MCPTT emergency private call that was originated by another MCPTT user?
q_56599.ground_truth: The MCPTT client must include an <originated-by> element set to the MCPTT ID of the MCPTT user who originated the MCPTT emergency alert in the SIP re-INVITE request when cancelling an MCPTT emergency private call that was originated by another MCPTT user.

q_56600.question: What is the maximum Doppler frequency offset for the PDSCH requirement in the uni-directional deployment scenario?
q_56600.ground_truth: The maximum Doppler frequency offset for the PDSCH requirement in the uni-directional deployment scenario is 9722 Hz targeting 350km/h at 30 GHz.

q_56601.question: What is the total power output when 128 power amplifiers (PA's) each outputting 20mW are combined?
q_56601.ground_truth: The total power output is 2.56W or 34dBm.

q_56602.question: What does the 0 value of the <hidden> parameter indicate in the context of phonebook entry?
q_56602.ground_truth: The phonebook entry is not hidden

q_56603.question: When may the SMF send a PDU Session Modification Command to indicate that the PDU Session is no longer edge-anchored?
q_56603.ground_truth: The SMF sends a PDU Session Modification Command to indicate that the PDU Session is no longer edge-anchored when there is no longer a local PSA UPF for the PDU Session and the SMF reselects a PSA UPF for the PDU Session.

q_56604.question: What should the SNRM-S include in the HTTP POST request to the VAL server when sending a user-plane delivery mode?
q_56604.ground_truth: The SNRM-S shall include a delivery-mode element indicating whether to deliver the user data to the UE(s) via unicast mode or multicast mode, an MBMS-media-stream-id element indicating the MBMS media stream to be used to deliver the media currently over unicast or the MBMS media stream currently being used, and one or more unicast-media-stream-id element(s) indicating the unicast media stream to be used to deliver the media currently over multicast or the unicast to be stopped and switched to multicast.

q_56605.question: What is the overall delays measured when DRX cycle length is 1280 ms test requirement is expressed as?
q_56605.ground_truth: Overall delay measured = measurement reporting delay + TTI insertion uncertainty + DRX cycle length

q_56606.question: How does the UPF handle forwarding of unicast Ethernet traffic in 5G?
q_56606.ground_truth: The UPF forwards DL unicast traffic (with a known destination address) on a PDU Session determined based on the source MAC address(es) used by the UE for the UL traffic. It forwards UL unicast traffic (with a known destination address) on a port (PDU Session or N6 interface) determined based on the source MAC address(es) learned beforehand.

q_56607.question: What is the purpose of the "supplementary service" in the context of bearer operations?
q_56607.ground_truth: Supplementary services are additional services offered by the network to the user, such as call forwarding, call waiting, etc.

q_56608.question: What happens when a UE moves to a new PEGC within the same PIN network?
q_56608.ground_truth: The new PEGC will allocate a new PINE identifier for the UE to access 5GC via this PEGC, and notify the PEMC to update the PIN profile in UDM with the new PINE information.

q_56609.question: When should the UE discard the rlf-Report from VarRLF-Report upon successful delivery of the UEInformationResponse message, in Rel-11?
q_56609.ground_truth: The UE should discard the rlf-Report from VarRLF-Report upon successful delivery of the UEInformationResponse message confirmed by lower layers in Rel-11.

q_56610.question: What should the UE do if the complete SIB28 has not been assembled within a period of 3 hours?
q_56610.ground_truth: The UE should discard any stored segments for SIB28.

q_56611.question: What information does an IRI-POI/CC-TF examine when an IMS session is terminated at an IMS UE to verify for a target match when the target identity is IMPU?
q_56611.ground_truth: The Request URI and To header present in the SIP INVITE.

q_56612.question: What should the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay do when it is out of 3GPP coverage during model A discovery?
q_56612.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay shall only select the RSC associated with the security procedures without network assistance.

q_56613.question: What is the maximum allowable time alignment error (TAE) between any two transmissions on different transmit antenna connectors in the UL MIMO scheme?
q_56613.ground_truth: The time alignment error (TAE) shall not exceed 130 ns for UE(s) with multiple transmit antenna connectors.

q_56614.question: What is the role of the PDC Report Type IEs in the PDC Measurement Initiation Request-IEs?
q_56614.ground_truth: The PDC Report Type IEs in PDC Measurement Initiation Request-IEs indicate the type of report that should be generated based on the measurement. The report type can either be periodic or event-triggered.

q_56615.question: What are the possible indication types that a U2N Relay UE can set when initiating the NotificationMessageSidelink message transmission?
q_56615.ground_truth: The possible indication types include relayUE-Uu-RLF, relayUE-HO, relayUE-CellReselection, and relayUE-Uu-RRC-Failure.

q_56616.question: When is an xIRI containing a FiveGMSAFNetworkAssistance record generated by the IRI-POI in the 5GMS AF?
q_56616.ground_truth: When the IRI-POI in the 5GMS AF detects that the 5GMS AF has received a network assistance from the target UE.

q_56617.question: What is the required resource URI variable for the Individual PAS Registration resource?

q_56618.question: What is the requirement for the network when providing a per-UE measurement gap pattern for concurrent monitoring of all frequency layers?
q_56618.ground_truth: During the per-UE measurement gaps, an ATG UE is not required to conduct reception/transmission from/to the corresponding NR serving cells, except for the reception of signals used for RRM measurement(s).

q_56619.question: What is the ACLR LEO class limit for the conducted transmitter requirements of SAN?
q_56619.ground_truth: The ACLR LEO class limit for the conducted transmitter requirements of SAN is 14 dB.

q_56620.question: In the process of handling services data, if the ServiceData XML element is present with or without content, what is defined in clauses 6.1 to 6.4?
q_56620.ground_truth: The Service Data element is present, and clauses 6.1 to 6.4 provide details about its handling.

q_56621.question: What action should an SGM-S take if the sender of a received COAP DELETE request is not authorized to delete the requested group member resource?
q_56621.ground_truth: The SGM-S should respond with a CoAP 4.03 (Forbidden) response to the CoAP DELETE request and skip the rest of the steps.

q_56622.question: Which category of session management procedures belongs to the next lower level of priority and should be throttled during network congestion?
q_56622.ground_truth: Release Access Bearer Request, Modify Bearer Request, Change Notification, Suspend Notification, and Resume Notification.

q_56623.question: What should the UE do upon expiry of T310 timer in the no DRX mode?
q_56623.ground_truth: The UE should turn off the transmitter power in the monitored cell within 40ms after expiry of T310 timer in the no DRX mode.

q_56624.question: What is the maximum number of interrupted slots on a serving cell in NR standalone operation when MGL = 3 ms and MG timing advance = 0ms?
q_56624.ground_truth: The maximum number of interrupted slots on a serving cell in NR standalone operation when MGL = 3 ms and MG timing advance = 0ms is 3.

q_56625.question: When does the "CSI request" bit field in a DCI format trigger an aperiodic CSI report and the UE is expected to receive a value of N > 1 as determined by the procedure in Clause 8.0?
q_56625.ground_truth: If DCI format 4B is used and for both TBs, or if DCI format 0B is used and UE is not expected to receive the value of N > 1 as determined by the procedure in Clause 8.0.

q_56626.question: What is the purpose of the 5G SRVCC indication in the 3GPP 5G system?
q_56626.ground_truth: The 5G SRVCC indication is used in the 3GPS 5G system to indicate that the PDU session for IMS is released due to PS to CS handover for 5G SRVCC.

q_56627.question: What is the purpose of the TDD Absolute RSRP Accuracy test for E-UTRA Carrier Aggregation for 20MHz + 10MHz?
q_56627.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to verify the accuracy of the RSRP measurement for E-UTRA TDD UE in carrier aggregation scenarios with 20MHz + 10MHz.

q_56628.question: When is the UE required to meet the requirements for a given frequency layer while performing intra-frequency measurements of GSO cells in UE category M1 with CE mode A?
q_56628.ground_truth: The UE is required to meet the requirements for a given frequency layer only if it is measuring cells associated with a satellite that is not subject to t-serviceStartNeigh for cells in that satellite.

q_56629.question: What is the purpose of the discoveree UE procedure for UE-to-network relay discovery?
q_56629.ground_truth: The discoveree UE procedure for UE-to-network relay discovery enables a ProSe-enabled UE with a UE-to-network Relay to respond to solicitation from other ProSe-enabled UEs on proximity of a connectivity service provided by the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE, upon a request from upper layers.

q_56630.question: What is the maximum occurrence of the "Corner" element in the "PolygonAreaType" complex type?
q_56630.ground_truth: The maximum occurrence of the "Corner" element in the "PolygonAreaType" complex type is 15.

q_56631.question: What must the NG-RAN node do upon reception of the PDU SESSION RESOURCE NOTIFY message?
q_56631.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node shall, upon reception of the PDU SESSION RESOURCE NOTIFY message, transfer the PDU Session Resource Notify Transfer IE or PDU Session Resource Notify Released Transfer IE to the SMF associated with the concerned PDU session.

q_56632.question: What header field must the MCData client include in the SIP MESSAGE request when it sends a location report in response to a location request from the participating MCData function?
q_56632.ground_truth: The MCData client must include a <ReportID> attribute set to the value of the <RequestID> attribute in the received Request in the <Report> element in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-location-info+xml MIME body in the <location-info> root element when it sends a location report in response to a location request from the participating MCData function.

q_56633.question: What should an MS do if it is in eCall only mode and is not able to select any PLMN in the first iteration of the PLMN search procedure with no restriction?
q_56633.ground_truth: As an implementation option, the MS can perform a second iteration of the PLMN search procedure with no restriction.

q_56634.question: When should the first CSI report for SCell be sent during T2, in the absence of interruption?
q_56634.ground_truth: In the absence of interruption, the first CSI report for SCell should be sent in subframe (m+8) during T2.

q_56635.question: When does an eNB initiate the Trace Failure Indication procedure in E-UTRAN?
q_56635.ground_truth: An eNB initiates the Trace Failure Indication procedure in E-UTRAN when it is not able to stop the trace session due to an ongoing handover of the UE to another eNB.

q_56636.question: What should the floor participant do when a Floor Deny message is received with a matching User ID and current floor arbitrator SSRC?
q_56636.ground_truth: The floor participant should stop timer T204 (Floor Queue Position request), stop the T233 (Pending user action) timer if running, notify the user about the denied floor, and enter the "O: has no permission" state.

q_56637.question: When does the SS deactivate SCell1 by sending the deactivation MAC-CE?
q_56637.ground_truth: The SS deactivates SCell1 by sending the deactivation MAC-CE in a subframe n, where n is an even number for FDD PCell and 4 or 9 for TDD PCell.

q_56638.question: What is the role of the SS (Node B emulator) and AWGN noise sources in the test setup?
q_56638.ground_truth: The SS (Node B emulator) and AWGN noise sources are connected to the UE (User Equipment) antenna for the test.

q_56639.question: What is assigned to the logical entities for I-CSCFs used in registration?
q_56639.ground_truth: SIP URIs are assigned to the logical entities for I-CSCFs used in registration.

q_56640.question: What should be the value of bits 5 to 8 of octet 6 for Global CN-Id if an Administration decides to include only two digits in the MNC?
q_56640.ground_truth: Bits 5 to 8 of octet 6 should be coded as "1111" if an Administration decides to include only two digits in the MNC.

q_56641.question: What is the condition under which the UE, in 5GMM-IDLE mode over 3GPP access, shall request the lower layer to establish an RRC connection?
q_56641.ground_truth: The UE, in 5GMM-IDLE mode over 3GPP access, shall request the lower layer to establish an RRC connection when it needs to transmit an initial NAS message.

q_56642.question: What should the participating MCPTT function do upon receipt of a SIP REFER request for a pre-established session, with the Refer-To header containing a Content-ID (URL) pointing to an application/resource-lists+xml MIME body?
q_56642.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT function should determine the MCPTT ID of the calling user from the P-Asserted-Identity header field of the SIP REFER request, retrieve the group identity in the "uri" attribute within the <entry> element of a <list> element within the <resource-lists> element of the application/resource-lists+xml MIME body, and check if the number of maximum simultaneous MCPTT group calls supported for the MCPTT user has been exceeded.

q_56643.question: What is the procedure for the UE to instruct the lower layers to start monitoring for PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message?
q_56643.ground_truth: The UE instructs the lower layers to start monitoring for PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message by using the group identifier as the input to the SHA-256 hashing algorithm and using the 24 least significant bits of the 256 bits of the output as the destination layer-2 ID. The SHA-256 hashing algorithm is implemented in the ME.

q_56644.question: What is the condition in the pseudocode for the UE to expect to receive more than one PDSCH in a same DL slot associated with a coresetPoolIndex value if the UE is not provided with multiPDSCH-perSlotType1-CB?
q_56644.ground_truth: The condition is if the UE is not provided with multiPDSCH-perSlotType1-CB and the UE does not indicate a capability to receive more than one unicast PDSCH or multicast PDSCH per slot and MA,c is not an empty set.

q_56645.question: Which URI variable defines the SCEF-assigned unique identifier of a group message delivery via MBMS by MB2 resource?
q_56645.ground_truth: transactionId is the URI variable that defines the SCEF-assigned unique identifier of a group message delivery via MBMS by MB2 resource.

q_56646.question: What action does the DN-AAA server take if the PDU Session Establishment is authorized?
q_56646.ground_truth: When DN-AAA server authorizes the PDU Session Establishment, it may send DN Authorization Data for the established PDU Session to the SMF. The DN authorization data for the established PDU Session may include one or more of the following: A DN Authorization Profile Index, a list of allowed MAC addresses for the PDU Session, a list of allowed VLAN tags for the PDU Session, DN authorized Session AMBR for the PDU Session, Framed Route information for the PDU Session, and L2TP information.

q_56647.question: What is the format of FQDNs in Multi-Vendor eNodeB Plug-and-Play?
q_56647.ground_truth: The format of FQDNs in Multi-Vendor eNodeB Plug-and-Play is "<vendor ID>.<system>.<OAM realm>".

q_56648.question: In what scenarios can the UE and AMF not suspend the transmission of 5GSM messages during 5GMM procedures?
q_56648.ground_truth: The UE and AMF will not suspend the transmission of 5GSM messages related to other PDU session(s) during a service request procedure for re-establishing user-plane resources of PDU session(s), as long as the UE is in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode and the procedure does not include PDU session status IE or Allowed PDU session status IE. Additionally, the UE and AMF do not suspend the transmission of 5GSM messages if the 5GMM procedure is piggybacking 5GSM messages.

q_56649.question: In what order should the MME candidates be tried for selection?
q_56649.ground_truth: The MME candidates should be tried in the order they are given, as topological closeness is not a factor in MME selection.

q_56650.question: Which message is sent by the MME to indicate the successful access of the UE toward the target eNB?

q_56651.question: What type of observables are provided by RTK Observations in the assistance data?
q_56651.ground_truth: RTK Observations provides the GNSS receiver with all primary observables, including pseudo-range, phase-range, phase-range rate, and carrier-to-noise ratio.

q_56652.question: What is the condition that the EN-DC UE must meet when transmitting an event triggered measurement report as specified in clause 4.6.2.1.5-1 of the test requirement?
q_56652.ground_truth: The EN-DC UE must transmit an event triggered measurement report with a measurement reporting delay less than 920 ms from the beginning of time period T2, and the rate of correct events observed during repeated tests must be at least 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

q_56653.question: What is the purpose of SystemInformationBlockType1-NB in NB-IoT?
q_56653.ground_truth: SystemInformationBlockType1-NB in NB-IoT contains information relevant when evaluating if a UE is allowed to access a cell and defines the scheduling of other system information blocks.

q_56654.question: What is the purpose of the test procedure in 4.5A.2B.2.2?
q_56654.ground_truth: The purpose of the test procedure in 4.5A.2B.2.2 is to establish multiple PDN connections in S1 mode after the first PDN connection is established during the ATTACH to EPS procedure.

q_56655.question: What is evaluated during the vendor accreditation process for network product development and network product life cycle management?
q_56655.ground_truth: The security relevant part of the vendor network product development and network product life cycle management processes is evaluated during the vendor accreditation process by the SECAM Accreditation Body. The vendor will define their own processes and describe them in written format. During an audit, the processes will be evaluated and their application on development activities in practice will be verified.

q_56656.question: What should the Controlling MCPTT function do if an MCPTT user initiates an MCPTT imminent peril call while the in-progress imminent peril state of the group is set to "true"?
q_56656.ground_truth: The Controlling MCPTT function should generate SIP MESSAGE request notifications of the MCPTT user's imminent peril indication to each of the other affiliated members of the group.

q_56657.question: How are analytics exchanged between PLMNs in 5G roaming architecture?
q_56657.ground_truth: The NF consumer in the HPLMN can retrieve analytics from the VPLMN via the H-RE-NWDAF and V-RE-NWDAF in both HPLMN and VPLMN. Similarly, the NF consumer in the VPLMN can retrieve analytics from the HPLMN via the V-RE-NWDAF in VPLMN and H-RE-NWDAF in HPLMN.

q_56658.question: What is the requirement for the S5 interface to fulfill in terms of accessing multiple PDNs?
q_56658.ground_truth: The S5 interface shall allow access to multiple PDNs, and it shall be possible to allow a UE to connect to different packet data networks.

q_56659.question: How are the measured BRIR positions passed to the mpegh3daLocalSetupInformation() in MPEG-H 3DA?
q_56659.ground_truth: The measured BRIR positions are passed to the mpegh3daLocalSetupInformation() as specified in ISO/IEC 23008-3, clause 4.8.2.2 in MPEG-H 3DA.

q_56660.question: What are some types of network-assisted GNSS methods?
q_56660.ground_truth: Some types of network-assisted GNSS methods include UE-Assisted, where the UE performs GNSS measurements and sends these measurements to the LMF for position calculation, and UE-Based, where the UE performs GNSS measurements and calculates its own location using additional measurements from non-GNSS sources and assistance data from the LMF.

q_56661.question: What is the name of the message that is used for unsolicited capability transfer in SLPP procedures?

q_56662.question: Where can an AS be hosted in a PIN network?
q_56662.ground_truth: An AS can be hosted on a locally connected hardware hosting platform, embedded in a PIN Element with Gateway Capability, or as an on-site extension of an in-network service hosted on a hosting environment like an edge computing platform.

q_56663.question: What are the emergency session handling functions that an AS should provide if it is the first point that identifies an IMS emergency session?
q_56663.ground_truth: If the AS is the first point that identifies an IMS emergency session, it should detect the emergency session establishment request, verify that the UE is not roaming, optionally obtain the location, prioritize the emergency session, provide the TEL URI associated with the public user identity in the session establishment request if known and not already present, check the validity of the caller TEL URI if provided by the UE, and mark the request as an emergency session request.

q_56664.question: What is the reporting range of RSRQ defined in 3GPP TS 36.133?
q_56664.ground_truth: The reporting range of RSRQ is defined from -19.5 dB to -3 with 0.5 dB resolution.

q_56665.question: What business roles are involved in the Edge Computing environment in the 5G network?
q_56665.ground_truth: The involved business roles in the Edge Computing environment in the 5G network are ASP (Application Service Provider), ECSP (Edge Computing Service Provider), and MNO (Mobile Network Operator).

q_56666.question: What is the time duration of the paging Hyperframe (PH) when a UE starts monitoring paging DRX during a Paging Time Window (PTW) used in ECM-IDLE?
q_56666.ground_truth: The time duration of the paging Hyperframe (PH) would be dependent on the eDRX cycle and UE's identity, the formula of which is known by the MME/AMF, UE and (ng-)eNB.

q_56667.question: What is the purpose of the MC service server sending an MC service emergency alert cancel request towards the MC service clients of the affiliated group members?
q_56667.ground_truth: This is to notify the relevant MC service clients of the cancellation of an emergency alert request.

q_56668.question: How does the EEC use the "General context holding time" to make an ACR request?
q_56668.ground_truth: The EEC can use the "General context holding time" to make a timely ACR request by performing an ACR launching procedure when it predicts to move to the service area of the discovered EAS within the time indicated in the IE.

q_56669.question: What conditions are required for the UE to be in State 3A-RF-DC2 in this test?
q_56669.ground_truth: The UE is required to support DC Split DRB bearer and to be in State 3A-RF-DC2.

q_56670.question: What is the purpose of the Neighbour Removal Function in the ANR?
q_56670.ground_truth: The Neighbour Removal Function in the ANR is responsible for removing outdated NCRs (Neighbour Cell Relations) from the NCRT.

q_56671.question: When does the MAC entity consider the Random Access procedure successfully completed?
q_56671.ground_truth: When the MAC entity receives the Random Access Response and the following description of events occur.

q_56672.question: What information does the MaxNumberofUEs data type represent in network slicing?
q_56672.ground_truth: The MaxNumberofUEs data type represents the maximum number of concurrent UEs supported by the network slice. This data type can be used in the FeasibilityCheckAndReservationJob IOC and in other network slicing operations to ensure that the network slice can support the required number of UEs.

q_56673.question: What does the term TAE stand for in the context of frame timing in the transmitter?
q_56673.ground_truth: TAE stands for Time Alignment Error in the context of frame timing in the transmitter.

q_56674.question: What does the number "x.y.z" in the Technical Specification represent?
q_56674.ground_truth: The number "x.y.z" in the Technical Specification represents the version of the document, with "x" indicating the level of approval, "y" representing changes of substance, and "z" denoting editorial changes.

q_56675.question: What is the action taken by the UE when it receives a Resume message?
q_56675.ground_truth: When the UE receives a Resume message, it resumes sending the media stream to the remote endpoint.

q_56676.question: What is the role of the V-NEF in HR-SBO PDU sessions as per clause 6.7?
q_56676.ground_truth: The AF may send an AF request to the V-NEF to influence traffic routing and support Edge Relocation. The steps involving PCF are skipped in this case.

q_56677.question: What should be done with the UUAA context if the NF service consumer removes the successful UUAA result during the UUAA Revocation procedure?
q_56677.ground_truth: The NEF (UAS-NF) shall remove the UUAA context in this case.

q_56678.question: What information is indicated in the 200 OK (Offer response) message of the session-based messaging procedure?
q_56678.ground_truth: The 200 OK (Offer response) message may indicate the maximum message size the receiver (UE#1 or UE#2) accepts to receive, possibly decreased by the AS.

q_56679.question: What entity is responsible for authorizing a MBSR node to operate as a mobile IAB node?
q_56679.ground_truth: The OAM system of the serving PLMN

q_56680.question: What is the role of the HPLMN supported mechanism list in the authentication process between the EEC and EES?
q_56680.ground_truth: The HPLMN supported mechanism list is a priority-ordered list of authentication mechanisms that the EEC obtains during registration with the HPLMN. This list is used by the EEC to choose an authentication mechanism to send to the ECS.

q_56681.question: What does the Di field in the PSI-Based SDU Discard Activation/Deactivation MAC CE indicate?
q_56681.ground_truth: The Di field in the PSI-Based SDU Discard Activation/Deactivation MAC CE indicates the activation/deactivation status of the PSI-based SDU discard of DRB i.

q_56682.question: What is the requirement for each measured E-UTRA and NB-IoT carrier for the throughput to be?
q_56682.ground_truth: The throughput for each measured E-UTRA and NB-IoT carrier should be greater than or equal to 95% of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channel.

q_56683.question: What is the procedure used by the VAE server to provide service requirements to the 3GPP network system?
q_56683.ground_truth: The procedures for the VAE server to provide service requirements to the 3GPP network system involve the use of the Service Capability Exposure Function (SCEF). The SCEF provides a means to expose the services and capabilities provided by 3GPP network interfaces and provides a means for the discovery of the exposed services and capabilities.

q_56684.question: What is the Certificate Signing Request defined as in the 3GPP-m1 API?
q_56684.ground_truth: The Certificate Signing Request is defined as a Base64-encoded DER certificate request or certificate, including leading and trailing encapsulation boundary lines in the Privacy-Enhanced Mail (PEM) textual format.

q_56685.question: What type of E-UTRA FD-FDD CE UE does this test apply to?
q_56685.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA FD-FDD CE UE, including both BL/CE and non-BL/CE UE.

q_56686.question: What are the new requirements needed to support the use case of haptic feedback for a personal exclusion zone in dangerous remote environments?
q_56686.ground_truth: The new requirements needed to support the use case of haptic feedback for a personal exclusion zone in dangerous remote environments include the 5G system shall be able to support real-time multi-modal communication for interactive haptic control and feedback with KPIs.

q_56687.question: What action does the SMF take when it receives the notification response from the AF, indicating that buffering of uplink traffic to the target DNAI is no more needed as traffic to the target DNAI /EAS is now authorized by the AF?
q_56687.ground_truth: The SMF updates the PSA2 by indicating the PSA2 to send the buffered uplink packets and to stop buffering, then releases PSA1.

q_56688.question: Who needs to trigger the deallocation of one or more TMGIs in the 3GPP TS 23.247 standard?
q_56688.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer (e.g. NEF, MBSF and AF)

q_56689.question: What is the role of the Policy Control Function (PCF) in 5G architecture?
q_56689.ground_truth: The Policy Control Function (PCF) is responsible for policy control decisions and flow based charging control functionalities in 5G architecture. It provides policies to the SMF, such as policies for application and service data flow detection, gating, QoS, flow based charging, traffic steering control, and usage monitoring control.

q_56690.question: What is the role of the MAC entity in this process?
q_56690.ground_truth: The MAC entity determines the timing and duration of the SL-SCH and SL-PRS transmission based on the sidelink grant received for the PDCCH (Physical Downlink Control Channel) occasion.

q_56691.question: What must a source UE (e.g. vehicle) do to randomize its identifiers (Layer-2 ID, source IP address) when transmitting V2X messages over PC5 reference point?
q_56691.ground_truth: A source UE must change its identifiers (Layer-2 ID, source IP address) over time and randomize them to prevent tracking and identification of the UE for more than a short time-period required by the application.

q_56692.question: Which operating band is subject to specific regulations in order to protect GPS, as established in FCC Order DA 20-48?
q_56692.ground_truth: Operation in Band n24 requires additional FCC regulations for protection of GPS.

q_56693.question: How many maximum size IPv6 packet filters can fit into one TFT for USS communication?
q_56693.ground_truth: 4 maximum size IPv6 packet filters can fit into one TFT for USS communication.

q_56694.question: What action does the MME take upon receiving a paging request message with priority indication from the MSC?
q_56694.ground_truth: The MME processes this message and the subsequent CS fallback procedure preferentially compared to other normal procedures.

q_56695.question: What are the initial TWAN specific L2 procedures and who are responsible for performing them?
q_56695.ground_truth: The initial TWAN specific L2 procedures are performed by the TWAN, and these procedures are outside the scope of 3GPP. These procedures may include authentication, authorization and accounting (AAA) related functions, and access point discovery and selection for the UE.

q_56696.question: What list does the UE store the PLMN identity in when it receives a PLMN not allowed message?
q_56696.ground_truth: The UE stores the PLMN identity in the "forbidden PLMN list" when it receives a PLMN not allowed message.

q_56697.question: Which ID is mandatory and present in the HandoverRequestAcknowledge message?
q_56697.ground_truth: 'ID id-AMF-UE-NGAP-ID', 'ID id-RAN-UE-NGAP-ID', and 'ID id-PDUSessionResourceAdmittedList' are mandatory and present in the HandoverRequestAcknowledge message.

q_56698.question: What should be set as the value of mcgRecoveryFailureCause if the fast MCG recovery procedure fails due to expiry of timer T316?

q_56699.question: What is the length of the OCTET STRING SuccessfulHandoverReport-Container in the SONInformation-ExtIEs NGAP-PROTOCOL-IES context?
q_56699.ground_truth: It is a maximum of 16 bytes in length.

q_56700.question: What should be the value of the <min-length-alias> element within the <common> element?
q_56700.ground_truth: The value of the <min-length-alias> element should be between 0 and 255.

q_56701.question: What is the minimum TCLw requirement for hand-held hands-free UE at any volume control setting?
q_56701.ground_truth: The minimum TCLw requirement for hand-held hands-free UE at any volume control setting is 40 dB.

q_56702.question: What is the purpose of the message type "request SECONDARY PDP context ACTIVATION reject"?
q_56702.ground_truth: This message is sent by the MS to the network to reject the request of a secondary PDP context activation initiated by the network.

q_56703.question: What type of identifier is used as the temporary identifier for the UE that is common to both 3GPP and non-3GPP access in 5G System?

q_56704.question: What is the purpose of the RRC Establishment Cause IE in the S1AP protocol?
q_56704.ground_truth: The RRC Establishment Cause IE in the S1AP protocol indicates to the MME the reason for RRC Connection Establishment or RRC Connection Resume as received from the UE in the EstablishmentCause IE, EstablishmentCause-NB IE, or ResumeCause IE as defined in TS 36.331.

q_56705.question: When must the GGSN send a Diameter Accounting-Request INTERIM-UPDATE message for deferred IPv4 address allocation?
q_56705.ground_truth: The GGSN must send a Diameter Accounting-Request INTERIM-UPDATE message to inform the accounting server about the allocated IPv4 address when the IPv4 address is allocated or re-allocated.

q_56706.question: In Solution 19, what does the Application Function do for an ad-hoc group?
q_56706.ground_truth: The Application Function creates an ad-hoc group of a collection of UEs, based on common use cases or applications. It assigns an (external) Group ID to the collection of UEs and provisions this group information to 5GC either directly or via NEF.

q_56707.question: What does the "maxNumberUpdatedCSI-Proc-SPT-r15" field define if short processing time is supported?
q_56707.ground_truth: It defines the maximum number of CSI processes to be updated per UE which aperiodic CSI is requested for CA with more than 5CCs.

q_56708.question: What is the type of data in the "En-gNB-EUTRA-NRCellResourceCoordinationReqIEs" sequence that is defined as mandatory and has a presence of mandatory?

q_56709.question: What action does the SMF take if it receives the clock drifting from the UPF and the received Time Domain matches the Time Domain information within the "tscaiTimeDom" attribute included in the PCC rule?
q_56709.ground_truth: The SMF may determine the time offset and cumulative rate ratio (when available) based on received Time Domain information and adjust the TSCAI information as described above.

q_56710.question: What is the definition of Pmax,c,AC?
q_56710.ground_truth: Maximum carrier output power measured per antenna connector

q_56711.question: Which types of E-UTRA HD-FDD UE does the test applicability in section 8.1.39.2 apply to?
q_56711.ground_truth: The test applies to all types of E-UTRA HD-FDD UE release 13 and forward with supports CEModeB, DRX and intra-frequency SI acquisition for HO.

q_56712.question: What is one requirement for the communication path between UE1 and UE2 when performing Ranging/Sidelink positioning?
q_56712.ground_truth: The communication path between UE1 and UE2 must be established before Ranging/Sidelink positioning can take place. This can be done through existing technologies, such as direct PC5 communication or communication via UE-to-UE relay.

q_56713.question: How many non-consecutive DTX subframes are allowed in each specified time period for the event "Deactivation" to be successful in the inter-band PCC(FDD) and SCells scenario?
q_56713.ground_truth: Up to 2 non-consecutive DTX subframes are allowed in each specified time period for the event "Deactivation" to be successful in the inter-band PCC(FDD) and SCells scenario.

q_56714.question: What is the difference between the two MBMS cell types in E-UTRAN?
q_56714.ground_truth: MBMS-dedicated cells only support MBMS transmissions, while MBMS/Unicast-mixed cells support both MBMS and unicast transmissions.

q_56715.question: What action should the receiving PDCP entity take if the integrity verification fails when performing deciphering and integrity verification of the PDCP Data PDU?
q_56715.ground_truth: The receiving PDCP entity should indicate the integrity verification failure to the upper layer and discard the PDCP Data PDU, considering it as not received.

q_56716.question: What is the difference between EARFCN and NR-ARFCN?
