q_56716.ground_truth: EARFCN (E-UTRAN Frequency NR) is a variable that represents the frequency resource allocation in the E-UTRA/E-UTRAN network, while NR-ARFCN (New Radio Absolute Radio Frequency NR) is a variable that represents the frequency resource allocation in the NR network. The EARFCN is defined as a variable that ranges from 0 to 430 by default, while the NR-ARFCN is defined as a variable that ranges from 0 to 1599.

q_56717.question: What are the parameters used to interpret variations in energy efficiency KPI values in 5G networks?
q_56717.ground_truth: The parameters can be classified into demography, topography, and climate classes, which describe the network characteristics with regard to population density, geographical conditions, and climate zones. These parameters can be further classified into subclasses, such as dense urban, urban, sub-urban, rural, or unpopulated scenarios in the demography class.

q_56718.question: When the rlf-Report is included in the UEInformationResponse, what action is taken by the UE regarding the rlf-Report from VarRLF-Report?
q_56718.ground_truth: When the rlf-Report is included in UEInformationResponse, the UE discards the rlf-Report from VarRLF-Report upon successful delivery of the UEInformationResponse message confirmed by lower layers.

q_56719.question: What is the method used by the IWF to negotiate the establishment of the media plane control channel?
q_56719.ground_truth: The IWF uses the SDP offer/answer mechanism to negotiate the establishment of the media plane control channel.

q_56720.question: What should an MS do if it is in A/Gb mode and receives a page in a different network type?
q_56720.ground_truth: The MS shall perform a normal or combined routing area updating procedure depending on the network operation mode in the current RA.

q_56721.question: What is the goal of NG-RAN positioning operations?
q_56721.ground_truth: The goal of NG-RAN positioning operations is to support positioning of a target UE by obtaining location related measurements for the UE and computing a location estimate and possibly additional information like velocity.

q_56722.question: What is the definition of "Feeder link" as used in the document?
q_56722.ground_truth: A Feeder link is the wireless link between the NTN-Gateway and the satellite.

q_56723.question: What should be the value of the "state" attribute within each <contact> element after the S-CSCF processes the registration request?
q_56723.ground_truth: The value should be set to "active".

q_56724.question: What should the UE do if cell selection or reselection occurs while T309 or T302 is running and if the UE is connected to 5GC?
q_56724.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T309 for all access categories if it is running, perform the actions upon leaving RRC_INACTIVE if it is in RRC_INACTIVE and T302 is running, or stop timer T302 if it is running and perform the actions as specified in 5.3.16.4.

q_56725.question: What is the purpose of PUCCH resource indicator field in DCI formats for determining a PUCCH resource for HARQ-ACK transmission?
q_56725.ground_truth: The PUCCH resource indicator field in DCI formats is used to determine the PUCCH resource for HARQ-ACK transmission, indicating a same slot for the PUCCH transmission. It is used in conjunction with a PUCCH resource set provided to the UE for HARQ-ACK transmission.

q_56726.question: What indication may the MME include in the Bearer Modify Request message to the eNodeB regarding traffic offload to WLAN?
q_56726.ground_truth: The MME may include an indication whether the traffic of this PDN Connection is allowed to be offloaded to WLAN in the Bearer Modify Request message to the eNodeB.

q_56727.question: What are the essential parameters in the "QoS Sustainability" Analytics ID request?
q_56727.ground_truth: The essential parameters in the "QoS Sustainability" Analytics ID request are Analytics ID, Target of Analytics Reporting, Analytics Filter Information, Location information, Optional maximum number of objects, Analytics target period, and Reporting Threshold(s).

q_56728.question: What is the requirement for the measurement report delay when L3 filtering is used?
q_56728.ground_truth: When L3 filtering is used, an additional delay can be expected in the event triggered measurement reporting delay.

q_56729.question: In what situation can the mobile station delay the location updating procedure in the new location area?
q_56729.ground_truth: The mobile station may delay the location updating procedure in the new location area if it is initiating an emergency call but moves to a different location area due to cell re-selection or redirection by the network.

q_56730.question: What is the purpose of RIM Information Transfer between two RAN nodes via 5GC?
q_56730.ground_truth: The purpose of RIM Information Transfer between two RAN nodes via 5GC is to enable the transfer of RIM information. The AMF does not interpret the transferred RIM information.

q_56731.question: What is the overall delays measured test requirement for the initial cell identification time (Tidentify,E-UTRAN FDD) in this procedure?
q_56731.ground_truth: The overall delays measured shall be less than a total of 3840 ms in this test case.

q_56732.question: What are the two mechanisms for QoS and policy differentiation in the case of one PDU Session serving multiple PINEs?
q_56732.ground_truth: The two mechanisms for QoS and policy differentiation in the case of one PDU Session serving multiple PINEs are during UE-initiated PDU Session Modification procedure with PINE information and during network-initiated PDU Session Modification procedure for a PEGC.

q_56733.question: What action should the initiating UE take upon receiving a DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION REJECT message from the target UE with PC5 signalling protocol cause value #5?
q_56733.ground_truth: The initiating UE shall not attempt to start PC5 unicast link modification with the same target UE to add the same V2X service or modify the same PC5 QoS flow(s) for at least 30 minutes.

q_56734.question: What should the AMF store upon successful PDU Session Establishment?
q_56734.ground_truth: The AMF stores the access type associated with the PDU Session and the identification of the serving SMF of the UE.

q_56735.question: What should the SS do after 5 preamble transmission attempts have been received in Test 1?
q_56735.ground_truth: The SS should transmit a random access response containing a random access preamble identifier corresponding to the transmitted random access after 5 preamble transmission attempts have been received by the SS.

q_56736.question: What are the three different formats for producing audio for VR?
q_56736.ground_truth: The three different formats for producing audio for VR are channels-based, objects-based, and scene-based audio formats.

q_56737.question: What is the protocol compatibility of the MO for BCP of MMTEL communication service?
q_56737.ground_truth: The MO for BCP of MMTEL communication service is compatible with OMA Device Management (DM) 1.2.

q_56738.question: What are two examples of immersive media that are not specifically volumetric media formats?
q_56738.ground_truth: 2D video and Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) such as NeRFs, Signed Distance Functions (SDFs), and Occupancy Networks (ONet) are two examples of immersive media that are not specifically volumetric media formats.

q_56739.question: What is implied by the authorization needed indication set by the source UE during the PC5 Link Establishment procedure with the UE-to-UE Relay?
q_56739.ground_truth: The authorization needed indication set by the source UE implies that the UE-to-UE Relay should only share the source UE's IP address with target UEs if prior authorization from the source UE is obtained.

q_56740.question: What should the UE do if it receives a BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REJECT message with the procedure transaction identity (PTI) indicated in the BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message and a cause "Protocol error, unspecified"?
q_56740.ground_truth: The UE should enter the state PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE.

q_56741.question: What action does the PCF take when the NF service consumer is not able to handle the notification during the request for termination of the policy association?
q_56741.ground_truth: The PCF resends the failed request for termination of the policy association to the new AMF's URI, or to its alternate or backup IPv4, IPv6 Address(es) or FQDN(s) if it is aware of them.

q_56742.question: What should the eNB do if the NR V2X Services Authorized IE is contained in the UE CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message and includes one or more IEs set to ``not authorized''?
q_56742.ground_truth: If supported, the eNB shall initiate actions to ensure that the UE is no longer accessing the relevant service(s).

q_56743.question: What is the requirement for the minimum radius of the NF probe antenna in white box testing?
q_56743.ground_truth: The minimum radius of the NF probe antenna from the center of the quiet zone generally must exceed the maximum diameter of the device to prevent interference of the near field scanning probe with the DUT.

q_56744.question: What is included in the Uu QoS flow descriptions in ProSe path switching request?
q_56744.ground_truth: The Uu QoS flow descriptions are included if the initiating UE derives the requested QoS flow description based on the PC5 QoS parameters of the PC5 QoS flow(s) between the initiating UE and the target UE.

q_56745.question: In the scenario of TS 36.331, clause 5.5.4.17, when is the entering condition for event H2 considered to be satisfied?
q_56745.ground_truth: The entering condition for event H2 is satisfied when the inequality H2-1, as specified in the clause, is fulfilled.

q_56746.question: What is the difference between Single base RTK service and MAC Network RTK service?
q_56746.ground_truth: Single base RTK service uses a reference station with known position to improve positioning accuracy, while MAC network RTK service uses a group of reference stations and one of them is chosen as the Master station, and the others are Auxiliary stations. The Master station provides full raw observations and coordinate information, while the Auxiliary stations provide reduced ambiguity-levelled observations and coordinate differences.

q_56747.question: What should the MCVideo client do upon receiving a SIP NOTIFY request containing an application/pidf+xml MIME body indicating per-user functional alias information?
q_56747.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should determine the status of the MCVideo user for each functional alias in the MIME body. If the p-id-fa element value of the application/pidf+xml MIME body of the SIP NOTIFY request is included, the p-id-fa element value indicates the SIP PUBLISH request which triggered sending of the SIP NOTIFY request. If the MCVideo client detected a functional alias activation or deactivation, it should perform the procedure specified in clause~8.2.1.7.

q_56748.question: What is the current adoption rate of HTTP/2 and HTTP/3?
q_56748.ground_truth: HTTP/2 is used by about 45% of websites, while HTTP/3 is only used by about 5% of websites.

q_56749.question: What action does the UE take upon receiving a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message with the reject cause set to 'Tracking area not allowed'?
q_56749.ground_truth: The UE sets the EPS update status to EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, deletes certain information, and resets the tracking area updating attempt counter. It also enters the state EMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE and stores the current TAI in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service."

q_56750.question: What is the name of the cotrol channel in 5G NR that is used to schedule DL transmissions on PDSCH and UL transmissions on PUSCH?

q_56751.question: What is the method used for obtaining the "Packet Loss Rate" in the uplink provided by the "UL PDCP SDU Loss Rate" measurement?
q_56751.ground_truth: The "UL PDCP SDU Loss Rate" measurement is obtained by counting the number of missing UL PDCP sequence numbers, representing packets that are not delivered to higher layers, of a data radio bearer, divided by Total number of UL PDCP sequence numbers (also including missing sequence numbers) of a bearer, starting from the sequence number of the first packet delivered by UE PDCP to gNB-CU-UP until the sequence number of the last packet.

q_56752.question: What security measure is required for interfaces internal to the 5G Core, such as N4 and N9, for transporting signaling data and privacy sensitive material?
q_56752.ground_truth: Confidentiality and integrity protection is required, which is achieved using NDS/IP.

q_56753.question: What are the two main types of charging data messages in the context of offline charging?
q_56753.ground_truth: The two main types of charging data messages in the context of offline charging are Charging Data Request and Charging Data Response.

q_56754.question: What action should the network take if it receives a transaction identifier value that is non-existent or not implemented?
q_56754.ground_truth: The network should abort any ongoing SM procedure related to the received transaction identifier value and stop any related timer.

q_56755.question: What is the test purpose in 5.3.2.2.5?
q_56755.ground_truth: The test verifies demodulation performance of PDCCH 2RX TDD Minimum requirements for PDCCH with intra-slot repetition under 2 receive antenna conditions and a specific SNR, for which the Pm-dsg should be below the specified value.

q_56756.question: Which RF and BB bandwidths are used in UE peak rate reduction options PR1 and PR2?
q_56756.ground_truth: The resource allocation spans a bandwidth of maximum 20 MHz (maximum UE channel bandwidth) for PR1 and PR2, allowing for good performance while minimizing RF complexity.

q_56757.question: What must the MME do when it receives the S1 signalling message containing the Trace Recording Session Reference, Trace Reference, serving cell CGI, and Privacy Indicator from the eNodeB?
q_56757.ground_truth: The MME shall send the IMEI-TAC together with the Trace Recording Session Reference and Trace Reference to the TCE when the Privacy Indicator is set to Logged MDT.

q_56758.question: What should the ME do if the number of additional digits exceeds the capacity of the additional record in EFEXT8?
q_56758.ground_truth: The ME can chain another record inside the EFEXT8 by the identifier in the last byte of the record, and indicate the number of bytes within the same record in byte 2 of each record for additional data within the same chain.

q_56759.question: Which command is used to read the 5GS ATSSS rules of the QoS flow of the default QoS rule associated with a specific context identifier <cid>?
q_56759.ground_truth: The 10.1.70 +C5GATSSSRRDP command is used to read the 5GS ATSSS rules of the QoS flow of the default QoS rule associated with a specific context identifier <cid>.

q_56760.question: What is the recommended content delivery model for XR split rendering?
q_56760.ground_truth: The recommended content delivery model for XR split rendering includes sending eye buffers at the same time, slice to IP mapping with fragmentation, RTP-based time codes and packet numbering, RTP/RTCP-based feedback ACK/NACK, and RTP/RTCP-based feedback on bitrate.

q_56761.question: What should a participating MCData function do if it is unable to identify the controlling MCData function?
q_56761.ground_truth: It shall reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 404 (Not Found) response with the warning text "142 unable to determine the controlling function" in a Warning header field.

q_56762.question: How shall the UICC store the Ks, which is the concatenation of CK and IK, on the UICC?
q_56762.ground_truth: The UICC stores Ks, which is the concatenation of CK and IK, on the UICC.

q_56763.question: What is the role of Criticality Information in S1AP messages?
q_56763.ground_truth: Criticality Information in the S1AP messages instructs the receiver on how to act when receiving an IE or an IE group that is not comprehended and is used in case of missing IE/IE group abstract syntax error. The three possible values of the Criticality Information for an IE/IE group are Reject IE, Ignore IE and Notify Sender, and Ignore IE.

q_56764.question: What feature of the 5GMS system enables the use of edge computing capabilities for media streaming?

q_56765.question: How many inter-frequency cells per TDD inter-frequency should the UE be capable of performing RSRP and RSRQ measurements for?
q_56765.ground_truth: The UE should be capable of performing RSRP and RSRQ measurements of at least 4 inter-frequency cells per TDD inter-frequency.

q_56766.question: When does the UE defer access barring checks until it has obtained SIB1?
q_56766.ground_truth: After a PCell change in RRC_CONNECTED, the UE shall defer access barring checks until it has obtained SIB1 from the target cell.

q_56767.question: What is the difference between a local MBS service and a location dependent MBS service in terms of the MBS service area?
q_56767.ground_truth: A local MBS service is provided in one MBS service area, while a location dependent MBS service is provided in several MBS service areas.

q_56768.question: How many cells are used in this test with each carrier having one cell?
q_56768.ground_truth: There are two cells per carrier in this test; one cell for the primary cell (Cell 1) and one cell for the secondary cell (Cell 2).

q_56769.question: What must be done upon receiving the MeasurementReport message?
q_56769.ground_truth: The MeasurementReport message should be submitted to lower layers for transmission upon which the procedure ends.

q_56770.question: What type of traffic is the DL PRB usage measurement valid for?
q_56770.ground_truth: The DL PRB usage measurement is valid for packet switched traffic.

q_56771.question: What is the requirement for the RSRQ measurement accuracy for all measured cells as specified in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 9.1.18.3?
q_56771.ground_truth: The RSRQ measurement accuracy for all measured cells shall be as specified in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 9.1.18.3.

q_56772.question: What does the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) technical specification group focus on in the "Study on charging aspects for enhanced support of non-public networks" document?
q_56772.ground_truth: The 3GPP technical specification group focuses on studying charging scenarios and potential charging requirements for Non-Public Networks (i.e. Stand-alone Non-Public Network (SNPN) or Public Network Integrated NPN (PNI-NPN)), possible charging solutions for Non-Public Networks with potential impact on charging architecture, charging functions and charging procedures, as well as end user charging and Inter-Provider charging in the document.

q_56773.question: What is the definition of the Eb/N0 used in the measurement performance requirements?
q_56773.ground_truth: Eb/N0 is the ratio of the received total energy of the desired signal to the total noise power spectral density, defined as Ec/N0 multiplied by the ratio of the number of chips per frame (Lchip) to the number of information bits per frame (Linf).

q_56774.question: What is the purpose of connecting to a Premises Radio Access Station (PRAS) in a Customer Premises Network (CPN)?
q_56774.ground_truth: The purpose is to provide cellular access to User Equipment (UE) and enable priority access for certain UEs within the limits set by the operator policy.

q_56775.question: What is the purpose of the Assistance Data Transfer Procedure in DL-AoD positioning?
q_56775.ground_truth: The Assistance Data Transfer Procedure in DL-AoD positioning is used to enable the LMF to provide assistance data to the UE, and for the UE to request assistance data from the LMF as part of a positioning procedure.

q_56776.question: What is the channel bandwidth applied to the signalling test for FDD and TDD?
q_56776.ground_truth: The default channel bandwidth of 1.4/5/10/20 MHz is applied to the signalling test for FDD and TDD.

q_56777.question: What should the UE do if no random access response is received within the RA Response window of 48 sub-frames in Test 2?
q_56777.ground_truth: The UE should consider the random access response reception not successful and re-select a preamble, transmitting with the calculated NPRACH transmission power when the backoff time expires if no random access response is received within the RA Response window of 48 sub-frames.

q_56778.question: What should the ME do when at least one of the stated conditions is met, in reference to storing (TMPI, IMPI)-pairs in non-volatile memory?
q_56778.ground_truth: The ME shall delete all stored (TMPI, IMPI)-pairs when any of the following conditions are met: (1) the UICC is removed from the ME while the ME is in power on state, (2) another UICC has been inserted to the ME upon power up, (3) no UICC has been inserted to the ME upon power up.

q_56779.question: Under what conditions must the MCVideo client report that it is not listening to the MBMS subchannels?
q_56779.ground_truth: The MCVideo client must report that it is not listening to the MBMS subchannels if it receives an MBMS bearer announcement, suffers from bad MBMS bearer radio condition, and/or the MBMS bearer is cancelled.

q_56780.question: What action does the SGSN take when it receives the Suspend message from the UE, if it is in Gn/Gp-SGSN, and deactivates GBR bearers towards S-GW and P-GW?
q_56780.ground_truth: The SGSN starts the preservation and suspension of non-GBR bearers, sends Suspend Notification message to the S-GW, and the S-GW releases all RNC related information for the UE.

q_56781.question: What is the PDN address of the default EPS bearer context set to, when the PDU session type is "IPv4", "IPv6" or "IPv4v6"?
q_56781.ground_truth: The PDN address of the default EPS bearer context is set to the PDU address of the PDU session.

q_56782.question: How does the flexibility of QoS handling differ between the EPS and 5GS models?
q_56782.ground_truth: The main distinguishing feature is that the flexible use of the priority, latency and reliability parameters in 5GS are not tied to a bearer, unlike in the EPS model.

q_56783.question: What is the relevance of Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) technology in autonomous networks?
q_56783.ground_truth: AI/ML technology can help achieve certain autonomous network levels by supporting analytics or decision autonomy capabilities.

q_56784.question: What is the requirement for the rate of correct handovers observed during repeated tests?
q_56784.ground_truth: The rate of correct handovers observed during repeated tests should be at least 90%.

q_56785.question: What is the maximum timing error that can be tolerated for Redcap UEs in commercial scenarios?
q_56785.ground_truth: The maximum timing error that can be tolerated for Redcap UEs in commercial scenarios is 2ns.

q_56786.question: What is the difference between the transceiver array boundary and the TAB connector?
q_56786.ground_truth: The transceiver array boundary is a conducted interface between the transceiver unit array and the composite antenna, whereas the TAB connector is a transceiver array boundary connector in IAB type 1-H, IAB type 1-O or IAB type 2-O.

q_56787.question: What is the purpose of the "mode" and "restriction" elements in the operator-originating-identity-presentation-restriction in the 3GPP network?
q_56787.ground_truth: The "mode" element specifies the identity presentation mode, while the "restriction" element specifies the identity presentation restriction in the operator-originating-identity-presentation-restriction.

q_56788.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP VR Headend in the end-to-end architecture for the distribution of VR content?
q_56788.ground_truth: The 3GPP VR Headend is responsible for generating content that can be consumed by receivers conforming to the present document, typically this includes 3D audio and spherical video signals that are properly encoded.

q_56789.question: What is the purpose of the Service Description in this specification?
q_56789.ground_truth: The Service Description indicates 5G ProSe service domain information.

q_56790.question: What is the benefit of Solution #9's approach in addressing key issues #1 and #2?
q_56790.ground_truth: Solution #9's approach dynamically provisions keys of gNBs to the ME encrypted with assistance of the home network, which cannot be decrypted by the ME. The gNB uses a symmetric algorithm to generate a 32-bit MAC-I for the radio signaling, and the ME verifies the MAC-I with assistance of USIM.

q_56791.question: What is the value of M for aperiodic CSI-RS resources as CMR in FR2?
q_56791.ground_truth: For aperiodic CSI-RS resources as CMR in FR2, M = 1.

q_56792.question: What is the role of PKMF/PCF in authorizing the SL Positioning Client UE?
q_56792.ground_truth: PKMF/PCF is a network function that supports the authorization of the SL Positioning Client UE. It provides information of Ranging/SL positioning exposure to the UE during Service Authorization and Information Provisioning procedure. It authorizes the Client UE based on its local information and sends the authorization result to UE1.

q_56793.question: What attribute in the "pPolicyCtrlReqTriggers" specifies the type of access?

q_56794.question: What should an MCVideo client do when a timer expires in a state with no specified handling?
q_56794.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should ignore the expiration of the timer.

q_56795.question: What is the purpose of Solution #40 in EAS instantiation status provision provided by ECS?
q_56795.ground_truth: Solution #40 enables the EES to ensure the proper number of EAS instances are instantiated in the EDN, indicates what information may be utilized by an EES to decide to trigger dynamic EAS instantiation, and updates the EES profile provided to the ECS in the EES registration request and provided to the EEC in the service provisioning response with EASID(s) available at the EES and EAS instantiation status for each EASID.

q_56796.question: What events can trigger a Buffer Status Report (BSR) in LTE?
q_56796.ground_truth: A BSR can be triggered if UL data becomes available for transmission in the RLC or PDCP entity for a logical channel with higher priority than the priorities of other logical channels with available data, if UL resources are allocated with a certain number of padding bits, if the retxBSR-Timer expires and the MAC entity has data available for transmission, or if the periodicBSR-Timer expires.

q_56797.question: Which types of NR UE does 5.3.2.2.5 apply to?
q_56797.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of NR UE release 17 and forward. It also applies to all types of EUTRA UE release 17 and forward supporting EN-DC.

q_56798.question: What are the valid values for carrierType-r14 in the ASN.1 definition?
q_56798.ground_truth: The valid values for carrierType-r14 in the ASN.1 definition are mbms, fembmsMixed, and fembmsDedicated.

q_56799.question: What is the format of the "Facility" information element in the "Facility" message as defined in TS 24.010 in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
q_56799.ground_truth: The format of the "Facility" information element in the "Facility" message as defined in TS 24.010 is TLV.

q_56800.question: What should the UE do if it detects the condition for steering traffic from E-UTRA to WLAN for a time interval TsteeringWLAN?
q_56800.ground_truth: The UE should perform offload from E-UTRAN to WLAN.

q_56801.question: What should the system do if it receives an unauthorized MCPTT emergency alert in a SIP RE-INVITE request?
q_56801.ground_truth: The system should include the warning text "149 SIP INFO request pending" in a Warning header field as specified in clause 4.4 in the SIP 200 (OK) response message.

q_56802.question: What action does the originating UE take after receiving a SIP 200-OK final response from the terminating endpoint?
q_56802.ground_truth: The originating UE starts the media flow(s) for this session.

q_56803.question: What happens during the execution of the Session Transfer procedure regarding the data flow of VoIP packets?
q_56803.ground_truth: During the execution of the Session Transfer procedure the remote end is updated with the SDP of the CS access leg, and the downlink flow of VoIP packets is switched towards the CS access leg at this point.

q_56804.question: What is the downlink power step size limit when determining the EIS (Effective Isotropic Sensitivity) in the context of the TRS testing?
q_56804.ground_truth: The downlink power step size shall be no more than 0.5 dB when the RF power level is near the NR sensitivity level.

q_56805.question: How many resource blocks can be reserved for random access preamble transmissions in a subframe?
q_56805.ground_truth: A random access channel occupies 6 resource blocks in a subframe or set of consecutive subframes.

q_56806.question: What entity generates and provides PCC rules with the Policy Control Request Trigger in response to a backhaul delay control request from the AMF?

q_56807.question: What should the source E-UTRAN/UTRAN do after it decides to terminate the handover procedure before its completion?
q_56807.ground_truth: The source E-UTRAN/UTRAN shall attempt to trigger handover cancellation procedures and send a session reestablishment trigger notification to the UE to start the recovery procedure if the session transfer procedure is in progress.

q_56808.question: What should the MS consider all other values of the Traffic handling priority, octet 11, as?
q_56808.ground_truth: The MS should consider all other values as reserved.

q_56809.question: What should the UE do during step 4.5.6.1.2.4.6?
q_56809.ground_truth: During step 4.5.6.1.2.4.6, the UE should switch its bandwidth part from BWP-1 to BWP-2 on SCell.

q_56810.question: What is the role of a DSO's RADIUS server in the example, in relation to the MNO's RADIUS (as a proxy)?
q_56810.ground_truth: The DSO's RADIUS server is responsible for end-to-end authentication of the meters or Smart Grid terminal devices, and communicates with the MNO's RADIUS via a dedicated VPN connection.

q_56811.question: What parameters can the CP function provision in a BAR for the UP function?
q_56811.ground_truth: The CP function can provision parameters such as the Downlink Data Notification Delay IE, DL Buffering Duration IE, DL Buffering Suggested Packet Count, Suggested Buffering Packet Count IE, and Extended DL Buffering Notification Policy IE.

q_56812.question: What is the overall delay measured when DRX cycle length is 1280 ms?
q_56812.ground_truth: The overall delay measured when DRX cycle length is 1280 ms is expressed as: Overall delay measured = measurement reporting delay + TTI insertion uncertainty + DRX cycle length and measurement reporting delay = Tidentify_inter = 25600 ms.

q_56813.question: What should be done if the cellsTriggeredList for a measId is empty?
q_56813.ground_truth: The measurement reporting entry should be removed from the VarMeasReportList for that measId, and the periodical reporting timer for that measId should be stopped if it was running.

q_56814.question: What information does the "V2X-service-ids-list" element contain?
q_56814.ground_truth: The "V2X-service-ids-list" element is a mandatory element that contains a list of V2X service IDs that the V2X UE is no longer interested in receiving, along with their corresponding layer 2 IDs.

q_56815.question: What information does the network check when authorizing the SL Positioning Client UE to discover a UE?
q_56815.ground_truth: The network checks if the SL Positioning Client UE is authorized to use Ranging/SL Positioning service and if it is authorized to request the Ranging result of the specific UEs.

q_56816.question: What is the purpose of the WLCP bearer modify procedure?
q_56816.ground_truth: The WLCP bearer modify procedure is used to modify a dedicated WLCP bearer context between the UE and the TWAN.

q_56817.question: What is the procedure for the BM-SC to detect an MB2-C path failure in deployments without a Diameter Agent between the BM-SC and the GCS AS?
q_56817.ground_truth: The BM-SC can detect an MB2-C path failure in deployments without a Diameter Agent between the BM-SC and the GCS AS by using mechanisms as specified in the Diameter Base Protocol, such as transport connection failure, GCS AS peer not responding, Diameter Device-Watchdog-Request and Device-Watchdog-Answer messages during periods when there is no need for other MB2 signalling, or by using the MBMS Heartbeat procedure.

q_56818.question: What should a UE operating in CS/PS mode 1 of operation with "IMS voice not available" and with a persistent EPS bearer context do when the radio bearer associated with the persistent EPS bearer context has been released and the UE is registered for EPS services only, operating in CS/PS mode 1 of operation with "IMS voice not available"?
q_56818.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T3402, if already running, attempt to select GERAN or UTRAN radio access technology and proceed with appropriate MM or GMM specific procedures and disable the E-UTRA capability.

q_56819.question: What is the impact of different UL power control parameters on the mean and 5% UL Average-UPT in the case of higher and lower UE Tx power for all load levels?
q_56819.ground_truth: In the case of higher UE Tx power, different UL power control parameters have a higher and similar mean and 5% DL Average-UPT for all load levels. In the case of lower UE Tx power, different UL power control parameters have a similar mean and 5% DL Average-UPT for all load levels. Additionally, they have a lower and similar mean and 5% UL Average-UPT for all load levels in the case of lower UE Tx power.

q_56820.question: What is used as a reference to a specific QoS forwarding behavior for a 5G QoS Flow?

q_56821.question: In what scenarios can both the V4 and V6 flags be set to "1"?
q_56821.ground_truth: The V4 and V6 flags can be set to "1" in two scenarios: when the CP function is providing F-TEID and when the UP function is requested to allocate the F-TEID.

q_56822.question: What is the role of the server in credit fragmentation?
q_56822.ground_truth: The server is responsible for granting separate quotas, which can result in credit fragmentation and cause some of the user's credit to be reserved.

q_56823.question: What happens if the S-CSCF receives a REGISTER request with the value "*" in the Contact header field and the value zero in the Expires header field?
q_56823.ground_truth: Remove all contact addresses that were bound to the public user identity found in the To header field and have been registered by this UE identified with its private user identity.

q_56824.question: What are the two sets of identifiers contained in the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay Discovery message?
q_56824.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay Discovery message contains a Direct Discovery set, which is part of the contents of the 5G ProSe Direct Discovery message, and a UE-to-UE Relay Discovery set, which contains information to support the discovery of the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay and extensions of the Direct Discovery.

q_56825.question: What should a UE do if it prefers to use the Uu communication path for the ProSe service and the PC5 path is currently being used?
q_56825.ground_truth: The UE should switch to the Uu communication path for the ProSe service.

q_56826.question: What is the maximum distance (X) between UEs that can be used for relative positioning to achieve a distance accuracy of 0.5m @ 90% (Set B) in 3 sources?

q_56827.question: What is the meaning of the MCVideo session identity in the context of MCVideo?
q_56827.ground_truth: The MCVideo session identity is a SIP URI assigned by the MCVideo server that identifies an MCVideo session between an MCVideo client and a participating MCVideo function or between a participating MCVideo function and a controlling MCVideo function.

q_56828.question: What information is included in the CDRs for differentiated charging if the message delivery fails?
q_56828.ground_truth: The SCS Identifier, SMS Application port ID, and Trigger Indication are included in the CDRs for differentiated charging if the message delivery fails.

q_56829.question: What information is included in the logged measurement report for WLAN and Bluetooth measurement logging in 3GPP TS 38.331?
q_56829.ground_truth: The logged measurement report for WLAN measurement logging consists of WLAN measurement results, and for Bluetooth measurement logging, the logged measurement report consists of Bluetooth measurement results, respectively.

q_56830.question: What is the function of NG-RAN as specified in TS 38.300?
q_56830.ground_truth: NG-RAN supports radio access network sharing and remote interference management as specified in TS 38.300.

q_56831.question: What is the parameter used to determine the receiver characteristics of the PHICH?
q_56831.ground_truth: The receiver characteristics of the PHICH are determined by the probability of miss-detecting an ACK for a NACK (Pm-an).

q_56832.question: What is the difference between intra-band contiguous carrier aggregation and intra-band non-contiguous carrier aggregation?
q_56832.ground_truth: Intra-band contiguous carrier aggregation is when contiguous carriers are aggregated in the same operating band, while intra-band non-contiguous carrier aggregation is when non-contiguous carriers are aggregated in the same operating band.

q_56833.question: What is one of the functional enhancements required for the 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay to obtain emergency services without involving N3IWF?
q_56833.ground_truth: One of the functional enhancements is the authorization policy for acting as a 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay that includes a list of PLMNs where the UE acting as 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay is allowed to provision emergency services to the remote UE.

q_56834.question: What should a network do after a 5G-SRVCC handover with an emergency PDU session, where the "null integrity protection algorithm" 5G-IA0 was used in N1 mode?
q_56834.ground_truth: The network does not need to apply security procedures for this connection.

q_56835.question: What does the SMF do when there are multiple access type conditioned session rules with authorized Session-AMBR and the UE's current access type and RAT type matches with the conditions of more than one policy?
q_56835.ground_truth: The SMF applies the Session-AMBR with the policy that has the most strict matching condition, e.g., Policy2 that specifies access type and RAT type when the UE's current access type and RAT type matches both conditions.

q_56836.question: What is the role of the NSCE server in the slice requirements alignment procedure?
q_56836.ground_truth: The NSCE server checks if the VAL server is authorized to trigger the service, retrieves network slice related performance data, compares the requirements with network slice performance statistics, and generates the optimal slice requirements for the required service of the vertical.

q_56837.question: Which HTTP method is used to cancel a NIDD downlink data delivery in the Individual NIDD downlink data delivery resource?
q_56837.ground_truth: The HTTP DELETE method is used to cancel a NIDD downlink data delivery in the Individual NIDD downlink data delivery resource.

q_56838.question: What is the role of the ePDG in handling IPSec tunneling for non-3GPP accesses?
q_56838.ground_truth: The ePDG handles tunnel authentication and authorization, and decapsulation/encapsulation of packets for IPSec tunneling for non-3GPP accesses. It also includes functionality for transportation of a remote IP address for S2b and allocation of downlink GRE key for each PDN connection within the ePDG for PMIPv6-based S2b interface.

q_56839.question: What message is sent by the UE to other UEs to indicate termination of emergency mode in the group call?

q_56840.question: What Information Elements are included in the Modify Bearer Request message when the Serving GW relocates?
q_56840.ground_truth: The User Location Information IE, UE Time Zone IE, and User CSG Information IE, as well as the Serving Network if it is received in step~4, are included in the Modify Bearer Request message when the Serving GW relocates.

q_56841.question: What action should the NG-RAN take upon receipt of a PWS Restart Indication message?
q_56841.ground_truth: Upon receipt of a PWS Restart Indication message, the NG-RAN should consider the warning message service as restarted and re-send the warning message data to the NG-RAN.

q_56842.question: What is the minimum expiration time of the idle mode generic timer in idle mode operations?
q_56842.ground_truth: The minimum expiration time of the idle mode generic timer is at least 6 minutes.

q_56843.question: Who are the intended recipients of the ML models provided by the MTLF?
q_56843.ground_truth: The ML models are shared with the same vendor's AnLF, but not with other vendor's AnLF.

q_56844.question: How can the P-CSCF determine whether the UE is roaming?
q_56844.ground_truth: The P-CSCF can determine whether the UE is roaming by analyzing the home network domain name of the user received in the Request-URI in the REGISTER request.

q_56845.question: What is the maximum number of interworking RAT containers?
q_56845.ground_truth: The maximum number of interworking RAT containers is 8.

q_56846.question: What URI variable is used in the resource definition for an individual MBS distribution session in the MBSTF?
q_56846.ground_truth: distSessionRef is used in the resource definition for an individual MBS distribution session in the MBSTF.

q_56847.question: Which entity is responsible for determining the distance between two UEs or more UEs via PC5 interface in the context of the 3GPP specification?

q_56848.question: When would non-GBR bearers be preserved and suspended during the handover process?
q_56848.ground_truth: Non-GBR bearers are preserved and suspended by sending Suspend Notification messages towards the S-GW when the MME starts the preservation and suspension of non-GBR bearers during the handover process.

q_56849.question: Which data does the SS-UE transmit in the UE simulation?
q_56849.ground_truth: The SS-UE transmits dummy random data on all RBs on the specified subchannels, implying congestion on PSCCH and PSSCH.

q_56850.question: When must the network include the Negotiated WUS assistance information IE in its message?
q_56850.ground_truth: The network shall include the Negotiated WUS assistance information IE if: the UE supports WUS assistance, the MME supports and accepts the use of WUS assistance, and the UE is not attaching for emergency bearer services.

q_56851.question: What report should the UE send no later than 640ms plus 80 slots from the beginning of time period T2?
q_56851.ground_truth: The UE should send an L1-SINR report including results of both SSB#0+CSI-RS#0 and SSB#1+CSI-RS#1 no later than 640ms plus 80 slots from the beginning of time period T2.

q_56852.question: What is the value of the "addrtype" portion in the "c" field in the session-level section when generating an SDP body for a private call?
q_56852.ground_truth: The value of the "addrtype" portion in the "c" field should be set to the IP version of the unicast IP address of the MCPTT client.

q_56853.question: What message is sent by the MeNB to the en-gNB to cancel all prepared PSCells during a Conditional PSCell Change?

q_56854.question: What is the unit used for the measurement in 5.1.1.31.3?
q_56854.ground_truth: The measurement in 5.1.1.31.3 is reported in dB and identified by the SSBIndex.

q_56855.question: What is the minimum requirement for the rate of ACK/NACK feedback loss on any active E-UTRA serving cell resulting from CSI and RRM measurements on NR SCells in dormancy?
q_56855.ground_truth: The rate of ACK/NACK feedback loss on any active E-UTRA serving cell resulting from CSI and RRM measurements on NR SCells in dormancy shall not exceed 0.5% and 1.0%, respectively.

q_56856.question: What is the role of NRF in selecting the AAnF in VPLMN in Solution #5?
q_56856.ground_truth: NRF can be utilized to discover and select the AAnF in VPLMN when AF provides the KAF and when UE is from another serving network.

q_56857.question: What is the purpose of the sidelink common control information in the specified 3GPP protocol?
q_56857.ground_truth: The sidelink common control information carries information that may change at any transmission and applies to NR sidelink discovery and communication.

q_56858.question: What triggers the establishment of NG-C interface instances towards the target gNB and the switching of the DL data path towards the target gNB?
q_56858.ground_truth: A PATH SWITCH REQUEST message sent by the target gNB to the AMF triggers the establishment of NG-C interface instances towards the target gNB and the switching of the DL data path towards the target gNB.

q_56859.question: What is the role of the Federated Learning Assistance Function in FL operations?
q_56859.ground_truth: The Federated Learning Assistance Function assists the AI/ML application server in selecting UEs for FL operations and monitors the availability and suitability of the selected UEs.

q_56860.question: Of what type is the id-DUtoCURRCInformation in UEContextSetupResponse?

q_56861.question: What criteria does the test verify in the context of RedCap for NR UE release 17 and forward in 6.4.2.1.1?
q_56861.ground_truth: The test verifies whether the reported rank indicator accurately represents the channel rank for NR UE release 17 and forward in 6.4.2.1.1.

q_56862.question: What should the I-CSCF do upon successful user location query, when the response contains the URI of the assigned S-CSCF?
q_56862.ground_truth: The I-CSCF should insert the URI received from the HSS as the topmost Route header field, store the value of the "icid-value" header field parameter received in the P-Charging-Vector header field, and retain the P-Charging-Vector header field. It should also optionally include the received Redirect-Host AVP value or the HSS Group ID in the P-User-Database header field.

q_56863.question: What is the requirement for the test in 7.6.2.5.4.2 regarding the DRX cycle?
q_56863.ground_truth: UE is allocated with PUSCH resource at every DRX cycle.

q_56864.question: What is the role of the PCF in the non-blocking mode change from CHF to SMF?
q_56864.ground_truth: The PCF sets new PCC rules for the "service data flow handling while requesting credit" to SMF, based on the non-blocking mode change from CHF.

q_56865.question: What should the AMF do if it receives a NAS Security Mode Command procedure that is ongoing and a N2 procedure including a new key at the same time with the UE?
q_56865.ground_truth: The AMF should not initiate any of the N2 procedures including a new key towards the UE if a NAS Security Mode Command procedure is ongoing with the UE.

q_56866.question: What type of E-UTRA UE does the test in section 10.4.2.2.2 apply to?
q_56866.ground_truth: The test in section 10.4.2.2.2 applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 16 and forward, supporting EN-DC with a shared spectrum NR carrier and supporting RSSI measurements and channel occupancy on shared channel access.

q_56867.question: When can the resolution bandwidth be smaller than the measurement bandwidth in 9.7.5.2.3?
q_56867.ground_truth: The resolution bandwidth can be smaller than the measurement bandwidth to improve measurement accuracy, sensitivity, and efficiency.

q_56868.question: In case of a successful termination procedure for the identified session and the required STR from the PDN GW, what shall the PDN GW send to the 3GPP AAA Server?
q_56868.ground_truth: The PDN GW shall send an STR to the 3GPP AAA Server with the Termination-Cause set to DIAMETER_ADMINISTRATIVE.

q_56869.question: What is the valid range for the parameter "Time to Trigger for L1 Event"?
q_56869.ground_truth: The parameter "Time to Trigger for L1 Event" is an enumerated type with valid values ranging from 0 ms to 5120 ms.

q_56870.question: What is the maximum bandwidth that can be occupied by a NB-IoT carrier in NR in-band operation, relative to the base station channel bandwidth?
q_56870.ground_truth: The maximum bandwidth that can be occupied by a NB-IoT carrier in NR in-band operation is less than the base station channel bandwidth.

q_56871.question: What is the role of the SMF in determining the TSCAI for the QoS Flow?
q_56871.ground_truth: The SMF determines the TSCAI for the QoS Flow based on the TSC Assistance Container of the PCC rule bound to the QoS Flow. It represents a range for the latest possible time when the first packet of the data burst arrives at the AN based on the BAT-early and BAT-late in the TSCAI.

q_56872.question: What is the requirement for the handover delay Dhandover in the test case?
q_56872.ground_truth: The handover delay Dhandover shall be less than a total of 200 ms in this test case.

q_56873.question: What are the required mechanisms for IMS interworking in GGSN/P-GW?
q_56873.ground_truth: The required mechanisms for IMS interworking in GGSN/P-GW are P-CSCF discovery, a dedicated signalling bearer, Gx interface, and P-CSCF restoration.

q_56874.question: What is the purpose of sending a Handover Command message to the UE in inter-RAT handover setups?
q_56874.ground_truth: The Handover Command message instructs the UE to complete the handover to the target access network.

q_56875.question: What message type is sent by the network to the mobile station to indicate that the requested service cannot be provided?

q_56876.question: What type of IP-CAN charging information is represented by the "gprs-charging-info" parameter?
q_56876.ground_truth: GPRS (General Packet Radio Service) charging information.

q_56877.question: What should the UE do when lwip-UL-Aggregation is set to FALSE for a DRB identity using lwip-WLAN-AC?
q_56877.ground_truth: The UE should indicate to higher layers to stop inserting LWIPEP header with GRE sequence number for both LTE and WLAN UL transmissions for the DRB associated with the drb-Identity.

q_56878.question: What action does the network take when it receives a Detach Request message with a Detach type IE indicating "switch off"?
q_56878.ground_truth: The procedure is completed when the network receives the DETACH REQUEST message.

q_56879.question: What is the role of the Home KMS in relation to external communications?
q_56879.ground_truth: The Home KMS maintains control of external communications by providing External KMS certificates for the partner security domains that the user is able to communicate with.

q_56880.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for NR SA FR1 inter-frequency SS-RSRQ measurement accuracy under CCA?
q_56880.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements for absolute and relative accuracy under CCA are specified in clauses 11.6.2.0.3 and 11.6.2.0.4 of TS 38.133.

q_56881.question: What type of NR UE does the test described in section 7.5.3.2.2 apply to?
q_56881.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of NR UE from Release 15 onwards and supporting 2DL CA.

q_56882.question: What action should the TSCTSF take if it cannot fulfill a received HTTP POST request due to an internal TSCTSF error or an error in the HTTP POST request?
q_56882.ground_truth: The TSCTSF shall send an HTTP error response as specified in clause~6.1.7.

q_56883.question: When must the UE use the radio resource parameters obtained from the serving cell for ProSe direct discovery?
q_56883.ground_truth: The UE must use the radio resource parameters obtained from the serving cell for ProSe direct discovery when it is served by E-UTRAN and intends to use the ProSe radio resources (i.e. carrier frequency) obtained from the serving cell.

q_56884.question: What is the type of communication supported over the PC5 reference point?
q_56884.ground_truth: The V2X communication over PC5 reference point is connectionless and supported when the UE is "served by E-UTRAN" and when the UE is "not served by E-UTRAN."

q_56885.question: Which types of E-UTRA FD-FDD UE, starting from release 12, does the test case 6.1.6 apply to?
q_56885.ground_truth: The test case applies to all types of E-UTRA FD-FDD UE release 12 and forward of UE category 0.

q_56886.question: What services does the physical layer provide to the MAC sublayer?
q_56886.ground_truth: The physical layer provides data transfer services, signalling of HARQ feedback, signalling of Scheduling Request, and measurements such as Channel Quality Indication (CQI).

q_56887.question: What should be done for 8Rx capable UEs if there are no 2Rx or 4Rx supported RF bands and all single carrier tests specified in 8.2 to 8.8 with 2Rx are to be tested?
q_56887.ground_truth: Fading channel should be duplicated from each Tx antenna and add independent noise for each Rx antenna with 3 dB less than the number specified for 2Rx tests.

q_56888.question: What is the requirement for the measurement reporting delay for cells 2, 3, and 4, as specified in the test?
q_56888.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay for cells 2, 3, and 4 should be less than 13.17s, 153.6s, and 153.6s, respectively.

q_56889.question: What is the name of the complex type with a sequence containing an optional "tx-and-rx-control" element, a "protection-between-mcdata-servers" element, an optional "file-availability" element, and an "xs:any" wildcard allowing other elements, with a maximum occurrence of 1?

q_56890.question: What should the ME do with the alpha identifier provided by the UICC (Universal Integrated Circuit Card) in the response data to the ENVELOPE (CALL CONTROL)?
q_56890.ground_truth: The ME should use the alpha identifier to inform the user during the PDP/PDN context activation, PDU session establishment, or call set-up, if the UICC responds with "allowed, no modification" and the alpha identifier is not a null data object.

q_56891.question: What type of message should be generated to terminate a File Download (FD) using HTTP?
q_56891.ground_truth: An FD HTTP TERMINATION message should be generated to terminate a FD using HTTP.

q_56892.question: What is the effect of the Serving GW receiving a Proxy Binding Acknowledgement from the PDN GW in the handover process with Trusted Non-3GPP IP Access?
q_56892.ground_truth: The Serving GW creates a binding cache entry for the PMIPv6 tunnel towards the trusted non-3GPP access or ePDG and establishes the internal forwarding state for the concatenation of the PMIPv6 tunnels.

q_56893.question: What should the UE do if it receives a DETACH REQUEST message containing detach type "re-attach not required" and EMM cause #2 "IMSI unknown in HSS" before completing the tracking area updating procedure?
q_56893.ground_truth: The UE should follow the procedure described for the detach type "IMSI detach".

q_56894.question: What is the purpose of the Uplink power control window in the context of the described technical specification?
q_56894.ground_truth: The purpose of the Uplink power control window is to ensure that the actual UE output power is no less than the target power level and as close as possible to the target power level.

q_56895.question: What is the action taken by the NG-RAN when it receives the MBS Session Resource Setup Request from the MB-SMF with multiple Area Session IDs and MBS service areas?
q_56895.ground_truth: The NG-RAN uses the received MBS Session ID and Area Session IDs to determine the local Broadcast MBS session contexts and responds for service areas it handles with the Area Session ID(s) and DL tunnel endpoint(s) for the DL tunnel(s) from MB-SMF if unicast transport applies between MB-UPF and NG-RAN.

q_56896.question: What does the "Multiplexing mode info IDij" field indicate in the IAB-DU Beam Restricted MAC CE?
q_56896.ground_truth: The "Multiplexing mode info IDij" field in the IAB-DU Beam Restricted MAC CE indicates which of the four multiplexing modes defined in TS 38.473 is applicable and whether it is applicable to non-overlapping frequency resources.

q_56897.question: What is the function of the Model Info/Analytics ID and the allowed NF Type/Id and allowed NF Id per Model in the registration stage in NRF?
q_56897.ground_truth: The Model Info/Analytics ID, allowed NF Type/Id and allowed NF Id per Model are required to be included in the registration stage in NRF so that the ADRF can authorize the NFc to retrieve the AI/ML model.

q_56898.question: What does the "IPv6-Required" element in the <MCPTT-Service-Details> specify for accessing the MCPTT service?
q_56898.ground_truth: Whether IPv6 shall be used to access the MCPTT service.

q_56899.question: What information element is used to indicate if the UE is allowed to offload traffic to WLANs for the associated PDN connection?

q_56900.question: What are the measurement channels specified for NR Power Class 1.5, Power Class 2 and Power Class 3 UE in release 15 and onwards?
q_56900.ground_truth: The measurement channels are specified in Annex A.2 of the document.

q_56901.question: What is the overall delay measured when DRX cycle length is 80 ms and the measurement reporting delay is 3922 ms or less?
q_56901.ground_truth: The overall delay measured is the sum of measurement reporting delay, TTI insertion uncertainty, and DRX cycle length, which is 3922 ms + 2 ms + 80 ms = 4004 ms or less.

q_56902.question: What should a UE do when it receives a WLCP message with semantically incorrect contents?
q_56902.ground_truth: The UE should perform the foreseen reactions of the procedural part of the document, and if none are specified, it should ignore the message except that the UE should return a status message with cause #95 "semantically incorrect message".

q_56903.question: What should be done to establish an EMM context when in the EMM-DEREGISTERED state?
q_56903.ground_truth: To establish an EMM context, the UE shall start the attach or combined attach procedure.

q_56904.question: What is the purpose of the "sendRoutingInfoForGprs" operation in the "gprs location information retrieval operations" category?
q_56904.ground_truth: The "sendRoutingInfoForGprs" operation is used to retrieve GPRS location information.

q_56905.question: What should the UE do upon receiving the partially allowed NSSAI?
q_56905.ground_truth: The UE should regard the S-NSSAI(s) included in the partially allowed NSSAI as the allowed S-NSSAI(s) for the current registration area and store the received partially allowed NSSAI.

q_56906.question: How does the 5G System architecture define the interaction between network functions?
q_56906.ground_truth: The 5G System architecture defines the interaction between network functions using a service-based representation and a reference point representation.

q_56907.question: What are the steps for the PINE to register with the PIN server when the PEMC is used for registration?
q_56907.ground_truth: The PEMC registers on behalf of the PINE by sending a PINE registration request to the PIN server, which includes device metadata (MAC address, vendor name, device description, and PINE address). After successful registration, the PIN server allocates a PIN client ID to the PINE.

q_56908.question: What should the floor participant do when the MCPTT call is going to be released or when the floor participant is leaving the MCPTT call?
q_56908.ground_truth: The floor participant should stop sending floor control messages and stop all running timers, and request the MCPTT client to stop sending RTP media packets, and enter the 'Releasing' state.

q_56909.question: What action should the SLM-S take if the sender of the received CoAP POST request is not authorized to register any location services?
q_56909.ground_truth: The SLM-S should respond with a CoAP 4.03 (Forbidden) response to the CoAP POST request and skip the rest of the steps.

q_56910.question: What is the size of the generator polynomial used for calculating the CRC parity bits in the BCH transport block?
q_56910.ground_truth: The size of the generator polynomial used for calculating the CRC parity bits in the BCH transport block is 24 bits.

q_56911.question: What is the use of the "Global RAN Node ID" parameter in the Warning Message Content NG-RAN?
q_56911.ground_truth: The Global RAN Node ID parameter in the Warning Message Content NG-RAN is used to globally identify an NG-RAN node, such as a Global gNB ID or a Global ng-eNB ID.

q_56912.question: What format are the sources for the OpenXR specification marked up in?

q_56913.question: What is the procedure code for the "UEContextResume" in the S1AP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE?

q_56914.question: How does the UE check the consistency of time counters from multiple cells?
q_56914.ground_truth: When the digital signature from each cell is valid but the time counters recently received from multiple cells fail verification, the UE checks the consistency of the time counters from those cells. If they are close to each other, it indicates that the UE time is out of sync with the network. If the timer counters are inconsistent, it indicates the presence of an attacker.

q_56915.question: What procedure should the H-DRA use for sending messages through the H-DRA if the V-PCRF receives establishment messages from the AF in the VPLMN?
q_56915.ground_truth: The V-PCRF may send the message to the H-PCRF directly if it receives establishment messages from the AF in the VPLMN based on the stored information provided by H-DRA during the IP-CAN session establishment.

q_56916.question: What does the IE "GUTI" indicate in the context of a combined attach during the Attach Accept message?
q_56916.ground_truth: The "GUTI" IE may be included to assign a GUTI to the UE during attach or combined EPS/IMSI attach.

q_56917.question: What should the controlling MCPTT function do upon receiving a SIP 183 (Session Progress) response containing a Require header field with the option tag "100rel" to the SIP INVITE request?
q_56917.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function should send a SIP PRACK request towards the MCPTT client.

q_56918.question: How is the number of inter-system handover ping-pong events measured?
q_56918.ground_truth: By accumulating the number of failure events detected during the inter-system mobility between NG-RAN and E-UTRAN.

q_56919.question: How many pairs of TEID-Cs are allowed per UE for S3, S10, S16, and N26 interfaces?
q_56919.ground_truth: There shall be only one pair of TEID-Cs per UE on each of the S3, S10, S16, and N26 interfaces.

q_56920.question: What action does the NG-RAN take when it needs to perform MBS session release for operator A but there are other corresponding broadcast MBS sessions for other PLMNs available?
q_56920.ground_truth: The NG-RAN removes only the TMGI for operator A from the MCCH while keeping the rest of the TMGIs and switches to another MBS session to receive data.

q_56921.question: What secure link is established between the Source UE and the Target UE via the U2U Relay in the procedure described in Solution #30?

q_56922.question: What is the Control Plane data back-off timer used for in 3GPP networks?
q_56922.ground_truth: Under overload conditions, the MME may restrict requests from UEs for data transmission via Control Plane CIoT EPS Optimisation by returning a Control Plane data back-off timer in Attach/TAU/RAU Accept messages, Service Reject message or Service Accept message. While the Control Plane data back-off timer is running, the UE shall not initiate any data transfer via Control Plane CIoT EPS Optimisation.

q_56923.question: What happens when the candidate expiration interval is nonzero?
q_56923.ground_truth: The MCPTT server constructs the candidate list of the MCPTT functional alias entries by creating a copy of the list of the MCPTT functional alias entries of the served MCPTT user information entry if the candidate expiration interval is nonzero.

q_56924.question: What information does the NWDAF collect to produce "UE Communication" analytics?
q_56924.ground_truth: To produce "UE Communication" analytics, the NWDAF collects UE communication information, UE communication trends, UE session behaviour trends and/or UE access behaviour trends, as defined in clause~6.7.3.2.

q_56925.question: What is a Key Quality Indicator (KQI) in the context of service management?
q_56925.ground_truth: A KQI is an indicator that reflects the end-to-end service experience as perceived by the end user and may be derived from a combination of network layer measurements, service layer measurements, and qualitative and quantitative components.

q_56926.question: What should the MUSIM UE do if it receives an ATTACH ACCEPT message without the Negotiated IMSI offset IE?
q_56926.ground_truth: The MUSIM UE shall indicate to lower layers to erase any IMSI offset value, if available.

q_56927.question: What is the purpose of initiating the Handover Cancel procedure?
q_56927.ground_truth: The Handover Cancel procedure is used to enable a source eNB to cancel an ongoing handover preparation or an already prepared handover.

q_56928.question: What message should the UE return to the AMF to acknowledge the reception of the Negotiated PEIPS assistance information IE?

q_56929.question: What is the function of a TLS client CA in the NDS/AF PKI architecture?
q_56929.ground_truth: A TLS client CA is responsible for issuing end entity TLS client certificates to TLS entities within a particular operator's domain in the NDS/AF PKI architecture.

q_56930.question: What is the role of the ePDG in routing uplink packets in the Single IPsec SA per PDN Connection Scenario for Non-3GPP access?
q_56930.ground_truth: The ePDG routes uplink packets to the different bearers based on the uplink packet filters in the TFTs assigned to the bearers in the PDN connection, and if no match is found, the uplink data packet shall be sent via the bearer that does not have any uplink packet filter assigned.

q_56931.question: What message type is sent by the mobile station to the network to request a service for the connection management sublayer entities, e.g. circuit switched connection establishment, supplementary services activation, short message transfer, location services?

q_56932.question: What is the effect of the "monDur" attribute in the response from the AF?
q_56932.ground_truth: The "monDur" attribute in the response from the AF represents the AF selected expiry time that is equal to or less than the expiry time received in the request.

q_56933.question: Which IMS Communication Service Identifiers indicate the support of mission critical services for MCPTT, mission critical video communications and mission critical data communications over the II-NNI respectively?
q_56933.ground_truth: The IMS Communication Service Identifiers for MCPTT are "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcptt", for mission critical video communications "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcvideo" and for mission critical data communications, the ICSIs of Short Data Service and File Distribution are "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcdata.sds" and "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcdata.mcfd" respectively.

q_56934.question: What happens when the cellsTriggeredList within the VarMeasReportList for a measurement identity is empty and the periodical reporting timer is running?
q_56934.ground_truth: The measurement reporting entry for that measurement identity is removed and the periodical reporting timer is stopped.

q_56935.question: Who is responsible for determining the "authorized RFSP index" in the 5GS to EPS mobility without N26 interface procedure?
q_56935.ground_truth: The PCF is responsible for determining the "authorized RFSP index" in this procedure.

q_56936.question: What must the network provide the UE with signalled QoS rules for a PDU session?
q_56936.ground_truth: An indication of whether the QoS rule is the default QoS rule, a QoS rule identifier (QRI), a QoS flow identifier (QFI), a set of packet filters, and a precedence value.

q_56937.question: What are two of the features supported in 5G ProSe?
q_56937.ground_truth: Authorization and Provisioning; Direct Discovery; Direct Communication (unicast, groupcast, and broadcast); UE-to-Network Relay (Layer-2 and Layer-3).

q_56938.question: What interfaces does the 5G System architecture allow user plane information exposure to some network functions via?
q_56938.ground_truth: The 5G System architecture allows user plane information exposure to some network functions via the service-based interface in UPF and through PFCP over N4 to SMF.

q_56939.question: What steps does G-UE follow to protect the groupcast message?
q_56939.ground_truth: G-UE forms the SLPP message, encrypts the SLPP payload using the group key, calculates the MAC of the SLPP message using the group key, forms L2 message by including the protected SLPP message and L2 header, and appends the L2 header.

q_56940.question: What is the definition of the Air Interface operating band in the context of the present specification?
q_56940.ground_truth: The Air Interface operating band is defined as the operating band specific radiated interface in the Radiated Interface Boundary (RIB).

q_56941.question: What is the difference between SSB based intra-frequency measurement and SSB based inter-frequency measurement?
q_56941.ground_truth: SSB based intra-frequency measurement is conducted when the center frequency and subcarrier spacing of the SSB of the serving and neighbor cells are the same, while SSB based inter-frequency measurement is conducted when either the center frequency or subcarrier spacing is different.

q_56942.question: How does the IMS core acquire location information in an emergency session?
q_56942.ground_truth: The IMS core may seek to determine the UE's location from the LRF (Location Retrieval Function) if the location information provided in the INVITE is insufficient or if the IMS core is required to validate or map the location information.

q_56943.question: What should the network do if the UE initiates a registration procedure with emergency services and the AMF allows it?
q_56943.ground_truth: The network should not follow the procedures specified for the transporting EAP-failure message in the AUTHENTICATION REJECT message; instead, it may include the EAP-failure message in a response of the current 5GMM specific procedure or in the AUTHENTICATION RESULT of the EAP result message transport procedure.

q_56944.question: What is the purpose of the procedure described in clause 5.6.7 of TS~23.501 in relation to AF influence on traffic routing?
q_56944.ground_truth: The purpose of the procedure is to apply the AF's influence on traffic routing mechanism during the relocation of the AF.

q_56945.question: What are the selection criteria for the CSI feedback enhancement use case?
q_56945.ground_truth: The CSI feedback enhancement use case aims to provide improved overhead reduction, accuracy, and prediction for the CSI feedback. The AI/ML approaches used in these use cases should be diverse enough to support various requirements on the gNB-UE collaboration levels.

q_56946.question: Which string value is expected in the targetName property for RANEnergyEfficiencyTarget?

q_56947.question: What is the trigger for the UE to send a measurement report in the test procedure?
q_56947.ground_truth: The trigger for the UE to send a measurement report in the test procedure is Event A3, which is defined in clause 8.2.4.4.3 of the test procedure.

q_56948.question: What should the UP function do when being instructed to remove a URR or the last PDR associated to a URR?
q_56948.ground_truth: The UP function should stop its ongoing measurements for the URR and include a Usage Report in the PFCP Session Modification Response or in an additional PFCP Session Report Request if there are non-null measurements to report for the URR.

q_56949.question: What is the format of the second sub-service in a country specific emergency service URN?
q_56949.ground_truth: The format of the second sub-service is an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

q_56950.question: In what scenarios is the described capability required for a UE in relation to the NR sidelink carrier?
q_56950.ground_truth: The capability is required when the UE is in any cell selection state, out of coverage on the sidelink carrier and associated with a serving cell on a non-sidelink carrier, or in coverage with a serving cell on a NR sidelink carrier.

q_56951.question: What is the meaning of the 'FFFFFF' value in the EFPLMN file?
q_56951.ground_truth: The 'FFFFFF' value in the EFPLMN file is not regarded as a termination of valid data, and it could occur in any position when less than n PLMNs exist in the EF.

q_56952.question: What action does the MeNB take if multiple target en-gNBs are prepared and the Multiple Target SgNB Node List IE is included in the SGNB CHANGE REQUIRED message?
q_56952.ground_truth: The MeNB may include the Additional List of Forwarding GTP Tunnel Endpoint IE in the SGNB CHANGE CONFIRM message to provide different data forwarding addresses for different target en-gNBs

q_56953.question: What is the method used by the BM-SC to pull files from the Content Provider in Pull Mode?
q_56953.ground_truth: HTTP v1.1 over TLS is used in Pull mode. The BM-SC uses the GET method to request each file as defined by the file-list or alternatively by the manifest received from the file-delivery-manifest-url.

q_56954.question: What should the UE do if it receives an EAP-request message while handling primary authentication and key agreement in an SNPN and certain conditions are met?
q_56954.ground_truth: The UE should generate a new KAUSF from the EMSK or MSK, generate a new KSEAF from the new KAUSF, create a partial native 5G NAS security context using the new KAUSF, and store the new KAUSF and the new KSEAF for use in the verification of SOR transparent container and UE parameters update transparent container, if any are received.

q_56955.question: What should a participating MCData function do if there is no binding between the MCData ID and public user identity of the terminating MCData user when receiving a SIP INVITE request for standalone SDS over media plane for terminating participating MCData function?
q_56955.ground_truth: If the binding between the MCData ID and public user identity of the terminating MCData user does not exist, the participating MCData function should reject the SIP INVITE request with a SIP 404 (Not Found) response and shall not continue with the rest of the steps.

q_56956.question: What is the format of the Request-URI in the SIP PUBLISH request for sending a functional alias status change towards the MCPTT server owning the functional alias?
q_56956.ground_truth: The Request-URI is set to the public service identity of the controlling MCPTT function associated with the handled functional alias ID.

q_56957.question: What must the NF service consumer include in the request header fields when sending a GET request to retrieve a block, for the UDSF to evaluate preconditions?
q_56957.ground_truth: The NF service consumer must include preconditions such as "if-match" or "if-unmodified-since" in the request header fields.

q_56958.question: In what scenario would the IRI-POI in the SMF generate an xIRI containing an SMFStartOfInterceptionWithEstablishedPDUSession record?
q_56958.ground_truth: The IRI-POI in the SMF generates an xIRI containing an SMFStartOfInterceptionWithEstablishedPDUSession record for each of the PDU sessions associated with the newly identified target UEs that meet the specified criteria.

q_56959.question: What role does the MME play in the E-UTRAN initiated E-RAB modification procedure?
q_56959.ground_truth: The MME is responsible for sending a Modify Bearer Request message to the Serving GW and updating the CSG membership based on the provided information. It also maintains ISR and informs the UE about the ISR status in the Tracking Area Update procedure.

q_56960.question: What type of value is the Min-Requested-Bandwidth-DL AVP, and what information does it indicate?
q_56960.ground_truth: The Min-Requested-Bandwidth-DL AVP is of type Unsigned32, and it indicates the minimum requested bandwidth in bits per second for a downlink IP flow, including all the overhead coming from the IP-layer and the layers above.

q_56961.question: What should the transmission control server do if it receives a Receive Media Request message from the associated transmission participant and the counter C9 has reached its upper limit?
q_56961.ground_truth: The transmission control server should reject the request, skip the forwarding of the Receive Media Request message to the reception control server arbitration logic, and include the Reject Cause field with the cause#0 (Insufficient downlink bandwidth) or cause#1 (No permission to receive) in the Receive Media Response (Rejected) message.

q_56962.question: In what scenario would the VPLMN have knowledge of EAS Deployment information in VPLMN for specific areas?
q_56962.ground_truth: For scenario 2.2 in clause 5.1.2, VPLMN has the knowledge of EAS Deployment information in VPLMN for specific areas.

q_56963.question: What is the format of the MulticastMRBs-SetupMod-List in the MulticastContextModificationResponse?
q_56963.ground_truth: The MulticastMRBs-SetupMod-List in the MulticastContextModificationResponse is a SEQUENCE of ProtocolIE-SingleContainer, containing MulticastMRBs-SetupMod-ItemIEs.

q_56964.question: What security properties does 0-RTT data in QUIC have that differ from data sent after the handshake completes?
q_56964.ground_truth: 0-RTT data in QUIC can be replayed by an attacker that has seen the client to server exchange, while data sent after the handshake completes does not have this property.

q_56965.question: What happens if a receiver does not have sufficient information to infer if a conditional IE is expected in a message?
q_56965.ground_truth: The receiver should not abort the procedure in this case. It should only abort the procedure if a conditional IE is missing and it is necessary for the receiving entity to complete the procedure.

q_56966.question: What is the requirement for the PDSCH BLER in low power subframes using the transport format indicated by the wideband CQI median if it is greater than 0.1?
q_56966.ground_truth: If the PDSCH BLER in the low power subframes using the transport format indicated by the wideband CQI median is greater than 0.1, the BLER in low power subframes using the transport format indicated by (wideband CQI median - 1) shall be less than or equal to 0.1.

q_56967.question: What is the impact of Solution #17: Integrity protection of the whole RRCResumeRequest message on the UE and the gNB/ng-eNB?
q_56967.ground_truth: When the UE decides to resume the RRC connection, it uses the whole RRCResumeRequest message, except the ResumeMAC-I/shortResumeMAC-I, as an additional input parameter to calculate ResumeMAC-I/shortResumeMAC-I. The UE sends the calculated ResumeMAC-I/shortResumeMAC-I in the RRCResumeRequest message. The gNB/ng-eNB validates the ResumeMAC-I/shortResumeMAC-I received from the UE to ensure the integrity of the message.

q_56968.question: What is defined as a conditional total probability of erroneous detection of the preamble when input is only noise in the context of PRACH preamble detection?
