The ME shall respond with an NAS message Authentication Failure with a CAUSE value indicating the reason for failure, and include the AUTS provided by the USIM if the synchronization failure is due to the AUTN.

q_57445.question: What are the requirements for performing RSS-based RSRP measurements for detected intra-frequency cells on serving and neighbor cells for UE category M1 with CE mode B?
q_57445.ground_truth: For performing RSS-based RSRP measurements on detected intra-frequency cells, the UE assumes that the RSS transmission of each neighbor cell starts in the radio frame that is closest in time, i.e. within a window of +/- 5ms, around the corresponding radio frame offset calculated from RRC signalling in the serving cell. The requirements for RSS-based RSRP measurements for a neighbor cell apply provided that the RSS transmission of each neighbor cell starts in the radio frame within a window of +/- 5ms around the calculated radio frame offset of the serving cell.

q_57446.question: What is the condition for a UE with low mobility to fulfill the relaxed measurement criterion in 5.2.4.9.1?
q_57446.ground_truth: The condition is (SrxlevRef - Srxlev) < SSearchDeltaP, where SrxlevRef is the reference Srxlev value of the serving cell, Srxlev is the current Srxlev value of the serving cell, and SSearchDeltaP is a threshold value.

q_57447.question: What is the purpose of the short window time duration when searching for a match?
q_57447.ground_truth: The purpose of the short window time duration is to identify the correct association match when there are multiple associations in the cache and to prevent missing of otherwise matching associations due to discrepancies between their stored association/disassociation time and the observed time provided by LEA.

q_57448.question: What is the procedure if the AMF receives a Control Plane Service Request with uplink data, and the AMF has a Control Plane data back-off timer running for the UE?
q_57448.ground_truth: The AMF may decide to process the Control Plane Service Request with uplink data, i.e. decrypt and forward the data payload, or not based on certain conditions.

q_57449.question: What is the purpose of the "Target 5G ProSe layer-3 end UE MAC address" IE in 5G ProSe direct link establishment?
q_57449.ground_truth: The "Target 5G ProSe layer-3 end UE MAC address" IE is used to indicate the MAC address of the target 5G ProSe layer-3 end UE when the 5G ProSe direct link establishment procedure is between the source and target 5G ProSe layer-3 end UEs and the MAC address of the target 5G ProSe layer-3 end UE is available in the 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-UE relay UE.

q_57450.question: What information is required for the Exit Specific Area regarding speed?
q_57450.ground_truth: The Exit Specific Area speed criteria define the minimum and maximum speeds in kilometers per hour that determine when an object is considered to have left the defined area.

q_57451.question: What is used by the UE and UPF to derive an estimation of the average RTT over an access type and QoS Flow?
q_57451.ground_truth: The UE and UPF derive an estimation of the average RTT over an access type and QoS Flow by averaging the RTT measurements obtained over this access type and QoS Flow.

q_57452.question: What is the format of an instance-id when an IMEI is available?
q_57452.ground_truth: When an IMEI is available, the instance-id shall take the form of a IMEI URN, where the imeival shall contain the IMEI encoded as defined in RFC 7254. An example of such an instance-id is: "urn:gsma:imei:90420156-025763-0".

q_57453.question: When would the MME trigger a Network Triggered Service Request from step~3?
q_57453.ground_truth: The MME triggers a Network Triggered Service Request from step~3 when the UE is in ECM-IDLE state and the QoS parameter ARP is modified, or when extended idle mode DRX is enabled for the UE.

q_57454.question: Which element can appear multiple times in the "prose-direct-discovery-response" complexType?
q_57454.ground_truth: The element "response-announce", "response-monitor", "restricted-announce-response", "restricted-monitor-response", "restricted-discoveree-response", "restricted-discoverer-response", "response-reject", and "discovery-update-request" can appear multiple times in the "prose-direct-discovery-response" complexType.

q_57455.question: What is included in an MCPTT group information entry maintained by the MCPTT server?
q_57455.ground_truth: An MCPTT group information entry maintained by the MCPTT server includes a MCPTT group ID that uniquely identifies the MCPTT group information entry, an affiliation status, an expiration time, an affiliating p-id, and a next publishing time.

q_57456.question: What is the delay uncertainty in acquiring the first available PRACH occasion in the target NR cell in NR RRC re-establishment?

q_57457.question: What is the role of the Policy Control Function (PCF) in the 5G system?
q_57457.ground_truth: The Policy Control Function (PCF) in the 5G system is responsible for policy and charging control (PCC) and is a key component of the policy framework functionality, working in conjunction with other functions such as SMF, UPF, AMF, NEF, NWDAF, and AF.

q_57458.question: When does the SCEF send the NIDD Submit Response message to the MME/SGSN in the roaming case?
q_57458.ground_truth: The SCEF sends the NIDD Submit Response message to the IWK-SCEF over T7 and the IWK-SCEF forwards the message to the MME/SGSN over T6a/T6b, if it can deliver the data.

q_57459.question: What is the notification URI variable for specifying the callback URI for EAS Deployment notification events?
q_57459.ground_truth: The notification URI variable for specifying the callback URI for EAS Deployment notification events is "<notifUri>".

q_57460.question: What conditions must be met for the UE to request the parameters for restricted Prose direct discovery model A announcing?
q_57460.ground_truth: The UE requests the parameters for restricted Prose direct discovery model A announcing if the transaction ID, the Announcing Type is set to "on demand", and the on demand announcing enabled indicator is not set to 1 in the UE's context for this discovery entry.

q_57461.question: What are the channel types supported by SPDCCHs?
q_57461.ground_truth: SPDCCH supports C-RNTI and SPS C-RNTI.

q_57462.question: What is the scope of the NFs that provide the LI functions within the CSP network?
q_57462.ground_truth: The scope of the NFs that provide the LI functions within the CSP network is determined based on various factors such as LI service type, CSP deployment choice, and the scope of LI as authorized in the warrant.

q_57463.question: What should the UE do when it is requested to make a non-lossless handover by SS?
q_57463.ground_truth: The UE should transmit the next PDCP Data PDU with SN value 0.

q_57464.question: In which message protocol and procedures are the NAS aspect explained?
q_57464.ground_truth: In the message protocol and procedures described in 3GPP TS 24.501.

q_57465.question: How does the BSF determine the network slice selection for a UE?
q_57465.ground_truth: The BSF selects the network slice for a UE based on the user identity, DNN, S-NSSAI, and, if available, the UE IP or MAC address, and the level of binding. The BSF may register, update, and remove the stored information about the selected PCF using the Nbsf management service operations.

q_57466.question: What is the format of the HTTP POST request for setting up an AF session with required QoS for a target UE identified by its UE address in 5GS?
q_57466.ground_truth: In the HTTP POST request, the AF may include a "dnn" attribute and/or a "snssai" attribute, and in the HTTP PUT request, the AF shall keep the same value(s) of the "dnn" attribute and/or the "snssai" attribute as set in the HTTP POST request if provided.

q_57467.question: What is the condition for a UE to be considered successful in the test in Section 8.4.2.2?
q_57467.ground_truth: The UE must report an event correctly and within the required time limit as specified in the normative reference.

q_57468.question: What is the definition of MCBD for FR1 and FR2 in the context of the measurement restrictions described?
q_57468.ground_truth: MCBD is the measurement quantity in use for evaluating the spatial network interface (CSI) in 5G NR communications. For FR1, when the CSI-RS is transmitted over a bandwidth greater than or equal to 24 PRBs, MCBD = 3. For FR2, MCBD is calculated based on the number of CSI-RS resources and the number of bands on which UE is performing beam failure detection for SCell.

q_57469.question: What is the condition for the serving cell to fulfill for a frequency/RAT change to a lower priority frequency to be performed?
q_57469.ground_truth: The serving cell must fulfill Srxlev < ThreshServing, LowP and a cell of a lower priority RAT/frequency must fulfill Srxlev > ThreshX, LowP during a time interval TreselectionRAT.

q_57470.question: What event triggers the PS handover in an inter-RAT handover from E-UTRAN to UTRAN or GERAN?
q_57470.ground_truth: The eNodeB indicates in the Source RNC to Target RNC Transparent container that PS handover was triggered due to CSFB.

q_57471.question: What should the UE do when it receives an ATTACH ACCEPT message with EPS attach result set to 'EPS only' and EMM cause set to #22 'Congestion' in Rel-11?
q_57471.ground_truth: When the UE receives an ATTACH ACCEPT message with EPS attach result set to 'EPS only' and EMM cause set to #22 'Congestion', then the UE initiates a Combined tracking area procedure indicating 'combined TA/LA updating with IMSI attach' after time=T3402.

q_57472.question: What subtitle decoding capability should a 5GMSd Client support if it has the Television (TV) profile?
q_57472.ground_truth: If a 5GMSd Client supports the Television (TV) profile, it should support IMSC-1.1-TEXT-DEC decoding capabilities.

q_57473.question: What message does the H-NWDAF send to the V-NWDAF if the user consent parameters, operator policy, and/or regulatory policy indicate that the analytics information is allowed to be exposed to the VPLMN?
q_57473.ground_truth: The H-NWDAF sends analytics response to V-NWDAF, which contains analytics information.

q_57474.question: What is the format of a security requirement description in SECAM?
q_57474.ground_truth: A security requirement description includes a unique requirement name, a unique requirement reference, a detailed description for the security requirement, a list of security objective references achieved through fulfilling this requirement, and a test case that defines how the requirement is tested.

q_57475.question: What should the UE do with the V2X application server information received via MBS?
q_57475.ground_truth: The UE should use the V2X application server information received via MBS for transmission of V2X communication over Uu via unicast only when the UE is registered in the PLMN from which this V2X application server information was received.

q_57476.question: What is the Permission to Request the Transmission field used for in the Transmission Arbitration Taken message?
q_57476.ground_truth: The Permission to Request the Transmission field in the Transmission Arbitration Taken message indicates whether the user has the permission to transmit media or not, and is coded as specified in clause~9.2.3.7.

q_57477.question: In what type of network can the "GERAN Positioning Data" parameter be included in a message?

q_57478.question: What is the purpose of the AS registration update request?
q_57478.ground_truth: The AS sends an AS registration update request to the PEMC or PIN Server where it registered to update the registration information associated with the AS registration identifier.

q_57479.question: What information does the +CUSATE command provide in the context of USAT?
q_57479.ground_truth: The +CUSATE command allows the TE to send a USAT envelope command to the MT and receive a response with information about the status and busy state of the UICC. The command can also be used to send the UICC the status words provided by the MT in response to a USAT envelope command that it has executed.

q_57480.question: What is the purpose of defining trust domains in a 3GPP network?
q_57480.ground_truth: The purpose of defining trust domains in a 3GPP network is to provide separation between workloads, allowing resources to be used in the most efficient and secure manner. This ensures that critical and sensitive workloads do not run on the same host pool as vulnerable functions.

q_57481.question: What is the definition of radiated transmit power as per clause 6.2.1?
q_57481.ground_truth: Radiated transmit power is defined as the EIRP level for a declared beam at a specific beam peak direction. It is declared for IAB-DU and IAB-MT separately, for one or more beams with beam identity, reference beam direction pair, beamwidth, rated beam EIRP, OTA peak directions set, the beam direction pairs at the maximum steering directions and their associated rated beam EIRP and beamwidth(s).

q_57482.question: What distance is used to trigger the opening of the door in hands-free access?
q_57482.ground_truth: In hands-free access, the ranging service starts checking the user's proximity when they are 10 meters away from the door, ensuring that the door will open when the user is about 5 meters away from the door. This is done to avoid unnecessary opening of the door if the user only intends to pass by.

q_57483.question: What action should a floor participant take upon receiving a Floor Granted message in the 'O: pending request' state, when the User ID field does not match its own MCPTT ID and the SSRC of the floor participant sending the message matches the stored SSRC of the current arbitrator?
q_57483.ground_truth: The floor participant should request the MCPTT client to stop rendering received RTP media packets, set the stored SSRC of the candidate arbitrator to the SSRC of the user to whom the floor was granted, reset the counter C201 associated with timer T201, restart timer T203 and T201, and remain in 'O: pending request' state.

q_57484.question: What action does the SMF take if it detects that the UE is outside the MBS service area?
q_57484.ground_truth: If the SMF detects that the UE is outside the MBS service area, it rejects the multicast session join and sends a Join Reject to the UE, indicating that the MBS join is rejected due to the UE being outside of the local service area.

q_57485.question: When the UE requests Ranging/SL Positioning policy/parameters, what parameters are provided by the PCF depending on the type of Policy Provisioning Request indicated?
q_57485.ground_truth: There are three scenarios depending on the type of Policy Provisioning Request indicated: (1) PCF provides Ranging/SL Positioning policy/parameters in the V2XP if V2X Policy Provisioning Request is indicated together with Ranging/SL Positioning Policy Provisioning Request, (2) PCF provides Ranging/SL Positioning policy/parameters in the ProSeP if 5G ProSe Policy Provisioning Request is indicated together with Ranging/SL Positioning Policy Provisioning Request, and (3) PCF provides Ranging/SL Positioning policy/parameters in both the V2XP and the ProSeP if both V2X Policy Provisioning Request and 5G ProSe Policy Provisioning Request are indicated together with Ranging/SL Positioning Policy Provisioning Request.

q_57486.question: What is a benefit of using QUIC for congestion control in 3GPP SBI?
q_57486.ground_truth: QUIC can achieve faster connection establishment compared to TCP+TLS, which is useful in short-lived connection models.

q_57487.question: What action is taken by the HSS when it responds with a 3xx status code?
q_57487.ground_truth: The HSS includes a Location header with an URI pointing to the endpoint of another HSS (service) instance.

q_57488.question: What is the role of the AUSF in the SoR/UPU Counter Wrap Around Use Case?
q_57488.ground_truth: If the SoR/UPU Counter is about to wrap around, the AUSF notifies the UDM about the wrap around condition, along with the SUPI. The UDM then needs to initiate primary (re-)authentication for a UE by sending a request to the serving AMF.

q_57489.question: What is the difference between the first and second HARQ-ACK reporting modes?
q_57489.ground_truth: The first HARQ-ACK reporting mode requires the UE to transmit a PUCCH for HARQ-ACK information with either ACK or NACK value, whereas the second HARQ-ACK reporting mode has the UE only transmit a PUCCH for HARQ-ACK information with NACK value. The second mode also has different PUCCH resource selection rules.

q_57490.question: What is the frequency to be used for the RRC re-establishment delay test in clause 6.1.10.4?
q_57490.ground_truth: The frequency to be used for the RRC re-establishment delay test in clause 6.1.10.4 is 10 MHz.

q_57491.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for RRC based uplink spatial relation switch delay as specified in clause 7.5.9.0.2?
q_57491.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirement for RRC based uplink spatial relation switch delay is defined in clause 7.5.9.0.2.

q_57492.question: What is the main purpose of the XPath data model in JPath?
q_57492.ground_truth: The main purpose of the XPath data model in JPath is to serve as a conceptual model for describing relationships between nodes and mapping JSON to it for XPath expression use.

q_57493.question: What should a UE do when it receives a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message with EMM cause value #22 "Congestion"?
q_57493.ground_truth: If T3346 value is not zero or deactivated, the UE aborts the tracking area updating procedure, resets the tracking area updating attempt counter, sets the EPS update status to EU2 NOT UPDATED, and stays in the current serving NB-IoT cell. The tracking area updating procedure is started when timer T3346 expires or is stopped.

q_57494.question: What is the method used by MPEG G-PCC for encoding volumetric media?
q_57494.ground_truth: MPEG G-PCC divides volumetric media into multiple sub-blocks. It then recursively subdivides a volumetric media until no more sub-blocks are left. Tools including arithmetic encoding are used to encode all the tree information into the bitstream.

q_57495.question: Which field defines whether the UE supports QoE Measurement Collection for MTSI services?

q_57496.question: For CSI reporting, when is a UE expected to transmit a sidelink CSI-RS and a sidelink PT-RS that overlap?
q_57496.ground_truth: A UE is not expected to transmit a sidelink CSI-RS and a sidelink PT-RS which overlap when reporting CSI.

q_57497.question: Which functional entity of IAB is responsible for providing NR Uu access to UEs and child IAB-nodes?
q_57497.ground_truth: The gNB-DU in the IAB-node is responsible for providing NR Uu access to UEs and child IAB-nodes.

q_57498.question: When would the UE initiate the failure information procedure as specified in 5.6.21 to report a DAPS HO failure?
q_57498.ground_truth: After releasing the MAC entity for the target PCell and before re-establishing the RLC entity for the target PCell for each DAPS bearer, and after discarding any PDCP SDUs along with the PDCP data PDUs for the source PCell for each SRB.

q_57499.question: What should the UE do if it does not have the required activated TCI-states information in the new BWP to receive PDCCH and PDSCH?
q_57499.ground_truth: The UE should continue to use old TCI-states before the BWP switch until a new MAC CE updating the required activated TCI-states information is received after the BWP switch.

q_57500.question: What should the UE do if it receives an SOR transparent container during a registration procedure and decides to release the N1 NAS signalling connection?
q_57500.ground_truth: The UE shall suspend the transmission of 5GSM messages after sending the REGISTRATION COMPLETE message and until the N1 NAS signalling connection is released, with the exception of an emergency PDU session.

q_57501.question: What happens when the NF service consumer sends an HTTP GET request to fetch analytics from the DCCF?
q_57501.ground_truth: The DCCF responds with HTTP "204 No Content" status code

q_57502.question: In which clause is the measurement reporting delay defined as the time between an event that triggers a measurement report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface?

q_57503.question: What is key issue #2c and possible solutions?
q_57503.ground_truth: Key issue #2c is finding the correct CHF for solutions #2.1 and #2.3 where V-CHF communicates with H-CHF. Possible solutions for this issue are using NRF (Solution #2.8) or SUPI (Solution #2.9) to find the H-CHF.

q_57504.question: What is the procedure for creating the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-signed+xml MIME body?
q_57504.ground_truth: The procedure is defined in Annex~F.6.2 and the semantic described in Annex~F.6.3 of the document, which involves performing reference generation and signature generation on the MIME bodies included in the SIP request or SIP response.

q_57505.question: What should the UE include in the logMeasReport of the UEInformationResponse message, if VarLogMeasReport includes one or more logged measurement entries?
q_57505.ground_truth: The UE should include the absoluteTimeStamp, traceReference, traceRecordingSessionRef, tce-Id, and logMeasInfoList in the logMeasReport of the UEInformationResponse message.

q_57506.question: What should the MCPTT server do with the MCPTT user information entry after identifying the served functional alias information entry?
q_57506.ground_truth: The MCPTT server should remove the MCPTT user information entry if the MCPTT user information entry has the MCPTT ID set to the target MCPTT ID, and the MCPTT user information entry is in the list of the MCPTT user information entries of the served functional alias information entry.

q_57507.question: What is the purpose of the test for E-UTRAN TDD UE transmit timing accuracy for CE UE in CEModeA?
q_57507.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to verify that the CE UE have the capability to follow the frame timing change of the connected System Simulator by measuring the reception of the SRS and verifying the requirements.

q_57508.question: What type of traffic is the UE Context Release Request measurement valid for?
q_57508.ground_truth: The UE Context Release Request measurement is valid for packet switched traffic.

q_57509.question: What is the procedure for verifying the TLS certificate between intra-domain TLS entities?
q_57509.ground_truth: The NF TLS client checks the sender's certificate to ensure it is not expired, uses the intermediate CA's public key to verify the signature, verifies the intermediate CA's certificate, and then verifies that the intermediate CA's certificate is trusted using the provisioned self-signed root certificate. A successful transaction results in a self-signed root certificate that the receiver implicitly trusts.

q_57510.question: What is the event described in section 5.8.10.4.3, where the serving becomes worse than a threshold, called in the NR sidelink measurement system?

q_57511.question: What information is used for the initial signalling of PC5 unicast link establishment if a prior unicast link to the same Application Layer ID doesn't exist?
q_57511.ground_truth: The initial signalling for the establishment of the PC5 unicast link may use the known Layer-2 ID of the communication peer, or a default destination Layer-2 ID associated with the V2X service type.

q_57512.question: What is the minimum number of bytes that a "Granted Party's Identity" value should be if the MCPTT standard requires the "Granted Party's Identity" value to be padded?
q_57512.ground_truth: The minimum number of bytes that a "Granted Party's Identity" value should be if the MCPTT standard requires the "Granted Party's Identity" value to be padded is (2 + multiple of 4) bytes.

q_57513.question: What should the reception control arbitration logic do when it receives a Transmission End Notify message from a user with User Id X?
q_57513.ground_truth: It should decrease C7 by the value of C11 associated with User Id X, and if C7 has reached its lower limit, it should enter the 'Gr: Reception Idle' state.

q_57514.question: What are the RF channels used in this test?
q_57514.ground_truth: The primary cell (Cell 1) is on RF channel 1 (PCC) and the secondary cell (Cell 2) is on RF channel 2 (SCC).

q_57515.question: What should the EASDF send to the NF Service Consumer to indicate that some of the modification instructions for unknown attribute(s) in the PATCH request have been ignored?
q_57515.ground_truth: The EASDF should respond with "200 OK" with the response body containing PatchResult if some of the modification instructions for unknown attribute(s) in the PATCH request have been ignored.

q_57516.question: What information is provisioned for 5G ProSe Direct Discovery?
q_57516.ground_truth: The information provisioned includes authorization policies and parameters such as the mapping of ProSe services to Destination Layer-2 IDs for sending/receiving discovery messages.

q_57517.question: What is the power step size used for sending uplink power control commands in the test procedure for 256 QAM?

q_57518.question: What is the SRTP PRF supported for providing confidentiality and data authentication of SRTP packets?
q_57518.ground_truth: The AES-CM-128 algorithm as defined in IETF RFC 3711 is supported for providing confidentiality and data authentication of SRTP packets.

q_57519.question: What is one of the functions that the control plane CIoT EPS optimization provides?
q_57519.ground_truth: The control plane CIoT EPS optimization enables support of efficient transport of user data (IP, non-IP) or SMS messages over control plane via the MME without triggering data radio bearer establishment.

q_57520.question: What should a participating MCPTT function do if it is unable to process a SIP MESSAGE request for a remotely initiated group call for terminating participating MCPTT function?
q_57520.ground_truth: If the participating MCPTT function is unable to process the SIP MESSAGE request due to a lack of resources or a risk of congestion, it may reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response and include a Retry-After header field to the response.

q_57521.question: What must the UE check before initiating the discoveree request procedure for Model B in a new PLMN?
q_57521.ground_truth: The UE must be authorized for restricted ProSe direct discovery model B discoveree operation in the new PLMN.

q_57522.question: What is the difference in QoS monitoring reporting between the UPF (PSA) and the PSA for IPTV service?
q_57522.ground_truth: The UPF (PSA) does not insert timestamps into the GTP-U PDU Session Container extension header for downlink packets in QoS monitoring reporting, while the PSA does not include RAN UL or DL delay when calculating Uplink or Downlink delay for IPTV service.

q_57523.question: What action does the AMF take if the UE supports multiple records of NAS security context storage for multiple registration and has two records stored, and is attempting registration to the PLMN associated with the second record of that access?
q_57523.ground_truth: The UE uses the second NAS security context of that access to protect the initial NAS message, and the AMF re-establishes the secure exchange of NAS messages.

q_57524.question: What should be done when a semantically incorrect mandatory or verifiable conditional information element is detected in a received Request message?
q_57524.ground_truth: The receiver should discard the request, log the error, and send a response with the Cause IE value set to "Mandatory IE incorrect" together with a type and instance of the offending IE.

q_57525.question: As per TS 36.323, clause 5.1.2.2, when should the receiving UM RLC entity update VR(UR) and reassemble RLC SDUs?
q_57525.ground_truth: The receiving UM RLC entity should update VR(UR) to the SN of the first UMD PDU with SN > current VR(UR) that has not been received and reassemble RLC SDUs from any UMD PDUs with SN < updated VR(UR), removing RLC headers when doing so. The reassembled RLC SDUs are then delivered to the upper layer in ascending order of the RLC SN if not delivered before.

q_57526.question: What is the purpose of the test procedure described in clause 16.1.1.8.4.2?
q_57526.ground_truth: The purpose of the test procedure is not clear from the given text, as it only refers to clause 16.1.1.7.4.2.

q_57527.question: Which method can create, retrieve, update, or delete repository data for a given service indication?
q_57527.ground_truth: The PUT, GET, and DELETE methods can be used to create, retrieve, update, or delete repository data for a given service indication.

q_57528.question: In the "UEContextInfoHORequest" section, what does the "indexToRatFrequencySelectionPriority" field indicate?
q_57528.ground_truth: In the "UEContextInfoHORequest" section, the "indexToRatFrequencySelectionPriority" field indicates the index of the RAT (Radio Access Technology) frequency selection prioritized list. It is an optional field that specifies the priority of selecting the rat frequencies in case of handover.

q_57529.question: In what scenario should the AMF set the Payload container type IE to "UE policy container" when forwarding a UE policy container to the UE?
q_57529.ground_truth: The AMF should set the Payload container type IE to "UE policy container" when it receives a UE policy container from the PCF and forwards it to the UE.

q_57530.question: What is the maximum number of transmissions that can be performed for a MAC PDU currently in the buffer, for synchronous HARQ?

q_57531.question: How is the actual value for thresholds calculated in the "RSRP-RangeNR-r15" field of the RSRP-RangeNR information element?
q_57531.ground_truth: The actual value for thresholds is (field value - 156) dBm, except for field value 127, in which case the actual value is infinity.

q_57532.question: What is the maximum number of additional positioning data that can be included in the UtranAdditionalPositioningData sequence?

q_57533.question: What are the two new attributes introduced in the ML Assessment Request IOC and ML Assessment Response IOC to allow the MnS consumer to request the assessment of ML entity fulfilment of trustworthiness requirements and report the achieved assessment trustworthiness score?
q_57533.ground_truth: The two new attributes are ML Assessment Request IOC and ML Assessment Response IOC.

q_57534.question: What is the requirement for the timing offset in terms of frame start timing between any pair of TDD cells?
q_57534.ground_truth: The timing offset between any pair of TDD cells shall be less than 3 microseconds.

q_57535.question: What is the number of search space sets that a UE expects to monitor for detecting up to 3 sizes of DCI formats with CRC scrambled by C-RNTI per serving cell?
q_57535.ground_truth: A UE expects to monitor PDCCH candidates for up to 4 sizes of DCI formats that include up to 3 sizes of DCI formats with CRC scrambled by C-RNTI per serving cell.

q_57536.question: What are the three CSI feedback overhead ranges defined for evaluating CSI feedback reduction?
q_57536.ground_truth: CSI feedback overhead A, CSI feedback overhead B, and CSI feedback overhead C

q_57537.question: What is the alternative to disabling the HTTP service on a network product?
q_57537.ground_truth: The HTTP service can remain active for user-friendliness, but queries to the web service are answered from a redirected HTTPS service.

q_57538.question: What does the Number of Active UEs IE indicate in the 3GPP 5G standard?
q_57538.ground_truth: The Number of Active UEs IE indicates the mean number of active UEs as defined in TS 38.314.

q_57539.question: Which network element decides to trigger the SRVCC handover based on the UE's measurement reports?

q_57540.question: What is the maximum repetition period of relevant system info blocks that needs to be received by the UE to camp on a cell?
q_57540.ground_truth: The maximum repetition period of relevant system info blocks that needs to be received by the UE to camp on a cell is 1280 ms.

q_57541.question: What should be done for a multi-band capable BS with a separate antenna connector when testing a single band?
q_57541.ground_truth: The antenna connector not being under test should be terminated.

q_57542.question: What is the expected priority value received from the EPS for a "normal" group or private call when the MCPTT client receives a "normal" Resource-Priority header field value for a priority group call?
q_57542.ground_truth: The expected priority value received from the EPS is the same as the "normal" priority received from the EPS when initiating a call with no Resource-Priority header field included.

q_57543.question: What are the characteristics of the V2X communication over PC5 reference point?
q_57543.ground_truth: The V2X communication over PC5 reference point is connectionless, and there is no signaling over PC5 control plane for connection establishment. V2X messages are exchanged between UEs over PC5 user plane, supporting both IP-based and non-IP based V2X messages, and IP-based V2X messages use IPv6 format. The UE is authorized to transmit and receive V2X messages by the V2X Control Function in its home PLMN.

q_57544.question: What is the role of the AMF in the URSP Notification procedure?
q_57544.ground_truth: The AMF is responsible for mapping the PCF responsible for the UE and forwarding the URSP notification towards the PCF.

q_57545.question: What should the SCC AS do upon receiving a SIP reliable provisional response to the SIP re-INVITE request and the reliable provisional SIP response contains an SDP answer?
q_57545.ground_truth: The SCC AS should forward the SIP response on the target access leg, depending on whether the SIP INVITE request due to PS to CS STN is a precondition enabled initial SIP INVITE request or not.

q_57546.question: When shall the octets for Old EPS Security Context be present in a S10 Forward Relocation Request message?
q_57546.ground_truth: The octets for Old EPS Security Context shall be present if the OSCI (Old Security Context Indicator), bit 1 of octet 6) is set to "1"; otherwise they shall not be present.

q_57547.question: What should the <request-type> element be set to in the <mcptt-Params> element of an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body for binding a functional alias with an MCPTT group or a list of MCPTT groups for the MCPTT user?
q_57547.ground_truth: The <request-type> element should be set to a value of "fa-group-binding-req".

q_57548.question: What system is responsible for performing real-time credit-control in a packet-switched domain?

q_57549.question: What does the "Correlation ID" indicate in the context of MSISDN-less SMS in IMS?
q_57549.ground_truth: The "Correlation ID" indicates the presence of an MSISDN-less SMS in IMS and is used to identify the originating and destination users, as well as the HLR-Id.

q_57550.question: What is the definition of the block error probability (BLER) for PUSCH in clause 8.2.4?
q_57550.ground_truth: The block error probability (BLER) is the probability of incorrectly decoding the PUSCH information when the PUSCH information is sent, as specified in clause 8.2.4.

q_57551.question: What is the test procedure for test 1 in the UE behavior of the random access procedure?
q_57551.ground_truth: The UE shall send the signalled preamble and wait for a random access response. If the received responses are not successful, the UE shall re-transmit the preamble with the calculated PRACH transmission power.

q_57552.question: What cause value does the SGW return if no response is received from the PGW or MME/S4-SGSN?
q_57552.ground_truth: The SGW returns the cause value "remote peer not responding" if no response is received from the PGW or MME/S4-SGSN.

q_57553.question: What are the main functions of the PCRF in the EPC network?
q_57553.ground_truth: The PCRF is responsible for policy and charging control in the EPC network. It terminates the Rx interface and the Gx interface, associates the sessions established over the multiple reference points for the same UE's IP-CAN session, and implements PCC session binding.

q_57554.question: What is the purpose of padding in a MAC PDU?
q_57554.ground_truth: Padding is placed at the end of the MAC PDU if present, and its presence and length are implicitly based on the TB size and size of MAC subPDUs.

q_57555.question: Which field identifies the specific Monitoring Event being requested in the context of CHF-CDR?
q_57555.ground_truth: The "Monitoring Type" field, identified as 5.1.4.8.14, identifies the specific Monitoring Event being requested, which can have various values, including "Loss of connectivity", "UE reachability", "Location Reporting", "Communication Failure", "Availability after DDN Failure", and "Number of UEs present in a geographic area."

q_57556.question: How does a L2 U2N Relay UE send paging to a L2 U2N Remote UE via PC5?
q_57556.ground_truth: A L2 U2N Relay UE uses unicast signalling to send paging to a L2 U2N Remote UE via PC5.

q_57557.question: What is the length of the field F1 in the Spatial Relation for Resource IDi?
q_57557.ground_truth: The length of the field F1 is 1 bit.

q_57558.question: What is the conformance requirement reference for 6.1.1.7.2?
q_57558.ground_truth: The conformance requirements for 6.1.1.7.2 are specified in TS 23.122 clauses 4.4.3.1 and 4.4.3.3.1.

q_57559.question: What is the main focus of Key Issue #2 in the Technical Report?
q_57559.ground_truth: Key Issue #2 aims to study how a roaming UE can obtain prioritization information of the VPLMNs with which the UE may register for the network slice.

q_57560.question: What should be the minimum number of least significant bits (LSBs) set to zero in D0 to ensure that the values of D0 differ from another by a large value?
q_57560.ground_truth: D0 should contain at least 16 LSBs set to zero.

q_57561.question: What should the system do if it receives an imminent peril indication in a SIP RE-INVITE request?
q_57561.ground_truth: The system should perform the procedures specified in clause 10.1.2.4.1.3, which include validating the Resource-Priority header field, and sending SIP UPDATE requests with the required clarifications.

q_57562.question: What does the ADRF respond with if none of the requested ML model(s) exist in the ADRF ML Model Store?
q_57562.ground_truth: The ADRF responds with "204 No Content".

q_57563.question: What is the maximum allowed time for the UE to identify a new CGI of an E-UTRA cell, provided that it has already been identified?
q_57563.ground_truth: The maximum allowed time is 5120 ms.

q_57564.question: What should the participating MCPTT function include in the outgoing SIP re-INVITE request generated for a terminating MCPTT client of a chat MCPTT group in a pre-established session?
q_57564.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT function should include a Resource-Priority header field with the contents set as in the received Resource-Priority header field and an SDP offer based on the SDP offer in the received SIP INVITE request or SIP re-INVITE request.

q_57565.question: What should the UE do when the RS in spatialRelationInfoPos being accurately measured after suspending the transmission of the SRS for positioning resource?
q_57565.ground_truth: The UE should resume the SRS transmission.

q_57566.question: What is the evaluation precedence index parameter defined for in the mentioned passage?
q_57566.ground_truth: The <evaluation precedence index< parameter is an integer type that defines a relative priority among packet filters when there is more than one packet filter for a specific context in the mentioned passage.

q_57567.question: In what situation can bits 5/1 and 5/2 of the Outer Header Creation Description field both be set to "1"?
q_57567.ground_truth: Bits 5/1 and 5/2 of the Outer Header Creation Description field can both be set to "1" if an F-TEID with both an IPv4 and IPv6 addresses has been assigned by the GTP-U peer.

q_57568.question: What are the different ways to associate an NW-TT with a network instance in a 5G System?
q_57568.ground_truth: An NW-TT can be associated with a network instance or with network instance together with DNN/S-NSSAI in the UPF, and the same NW-TT is used for all PDU Sessions in the UPF for the given DNN/S-NSSAI.

q_57569.question: What is the role of the N3IWF, W-AGF or TNGF in the CM-CONNECTED state of the UE?
q_57569.ground_truth: The N3IWF, W-AGF or TNGF provides connectivity for the UE in the CM-CONNECTED state, and if the new AMF and the old AMF are in the same PLMN, the new AMF creates an NGAP UE association towards the N3IWF/TNGF/W-AGF to which the UE is connected, which releases the existing NGAP UE association between the old AMF and the N3IWF/TNGF/W-AGF.

q_57570.question: What should the MCData client do if the <manual-deaffiliation-not-allowed-if-affiliation-rules-are-met> element is present and is set to a value of "true"?
q_57570.ground_truth: If the affiliation to the group has been activated due to a rule being fulfilled and the <manual-deaffiliation-not-allowed-if-affiliation-rules-are-met> element is present and is set to a value of "true", the MCData client should suppress the MCData user's request.

q_57571.question: What is the Bearer Service parameter used for in the 7.6.4 supplementary services sub-layer?
q_57571.ground_truth: The Bearer Service parameter is used in the 7.6.4 supplementary services sub-layer to indicate the bearer service or set of bearer services related to Network Signal Info 2 for SCUDIF calls.

q_57572.question: What should the VAE server do if the authorization is successful when receiving a POST request from the service consumer to create an Individual Application Requirement?
q_57572.ground_truth: The VAE server should create a new resource representing the Individual Application Requirement, interact with the SEAL NRM server for the V2X application requirement, and respond to the service consumer with a 201 Created message, including the URI for the created resource.

q_57573.question: What is the transmission scenario in section 8.3.1.3.1 of the document?
q_57573.ground_truth: The transmission scenario in section 8.3.1.3.1 of the document is a scenario where two transmission points share the same Cell ID and the UE receives DCI format 2D.

q_57574.question: What does the UDM use to map the SUCI to the SUPI and select an authentication method?
q_57574.ground_truth: The UDM uses the "username" part of the SUPI, the "realm" part of the SUPI, the AUN3 device indicator, a combination of the "realm" part and the AUN3 device indicator, or the UDM local policy to map the SUCI to the SUPI and select an authentication method.

q_57575.question: Which AVP indicates the time for the radio resources setup in the E-UTRAN access type?
q_57575.ground_truth: The MBMS-Data-Transfer-Start AVP (AVP code 929) indicates the time for the radio resources setup in the E-UTRAN access type.

q_57576.question: What is the mean UL Average-UPT gain for semi-static SBFD at low load level with a large packet size and 30dBm BS transmission power?

q_57577.question: What is the maximum allowed interruption on a PCell when switching carriers for SRS transmission or non-contention based PRACH?
q_57577.ground_truth: The maximum allowed interruption on a PCell when switching carriers for SRS transmission or non-contention based PRACH is 1 subframe.

q_57578.question: In the context of OpenAPI files, what does the "type: array" definition signify?
q_57578.ground_truth: The "type: array" definition signifies that the attribute is of the array type. It is used to define the structure of an array, including the data type of its items and any cardinality constraints.

q_57579.question: When receiving a SIP MESSAGE request containing a MuSiK download message, what should the MCPTT client do if the received message contains an <mbms-defaultMuSiK-download> element with <group> subelements?
q_57579.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should first dissociate those groups identified by the <group> subelements from currently valid associations with explicit MuSiK downloads and then set the impacted groups to be all groups not associated with currently valid explicit MuSiK downloads.

q_57580.question: What should the floor control interface do upon receiving a Queued Floor Requests message, including a Queued Floor Requests Purpose field with the Queued Floor Requests Purpose value set to '0' (Cancel Request), from the associated floor participant?
q_57580.ground_truth: If the MCPTT ID of the associated floor participant is an authorized user, the floor control interface shall forward the Queued Floor Requests message to the floor control server arbitration logic, otherwise it shall send a Queued Floor Requests message to the associated floor participant with the Queued Floor Requests Purpose value set to '1' (Cancel Result)

q_57581.question: What is the required header field that the originating participating MCPTT function should include in the SIP PUBLISH request?
q_57581.ground_truth: A P-Asserted-Identity header field containing the public service identity identifying the originating participating MCPTT function serving the MCPTT user.

q_57582.question: What is the length of the Queued Floor Requests Purpose field, as indicated by the Queued Floor Requests Purpose Length value?
q_57582.ground_truth: The Queued Floor Requests Purpose Length value has a length of 2 octets and indicates the total length of the Queued Floor Requests Purpose value item.

q_57583.question: What is the effect of setting octet 12 and octet 13 to "11111110" in the Guaranteed bit rate for uplink and downlink?
q_57583.ground_truth: If the sending entity wants to indicate a Guaranteed bit rate for uplink or downlink higher than 8640 kbps, it shall set octet 12 or octet 13 to "11111110", i.e. 8640 kbps, and shall encode the value for the Guaranteed bit rate in octet 18 or octet 16.

q_57584.question: What level of frequency isolation is feasible for a base station by the Nokia example?
q_57584.ground_truth: The feasible level of frequency isolation for a base station is 45 dB, which is in line with the 45 dB ACLR requirement.

q_57585.question: What does the Interface value in the Destination Interface IE represent?
q_57585.ground_truth: The Interface value in the Destination Interface IE is encoded as a 4 bits binary integer that specifies the type of the interface towards which an outgoing packet is sent.

q_57586.question: What should the UE do upon receiving an ATTACH REJECT message with EMM cause #25 or #78 that was received without integrity protection?
q_57586.ground_truth: The UE should discard the message.

q_57587.question: How is a UPF selected for a particular PDU Session in the 5G Core network?
q_57587.ground_truth: After the SMF Provisioning of available UPFs, the SMF selects an UPF for a particular PDU Session. The SMF then initiates N4 session management procedures for the selected UPF, as defined in clause 4.4.1 of TS 23.502.

q_57588.question: What should the ME do with the GPRS UMTS ciphering key and GPRS UMTS integrity key when switching from S1 mode to Iu mode or A/Gb mode?
q_57588.ground_truth: The ME should handle the GPRS UMTS ciphering key, the GPRS UMTS integrity key, the GPRS GSM ciphering key, and a potential GPRS GSM Kc128 depending on the current EPS security context or the UMTS security context for the PS domain stored in the MS and the network.

q_57589.question: What is the role of the Mns Producer in the solution 6.3.3 volume control by CCS based on performance collection?
q_57589.ground_truth: The Mns Producer is responsible for collecting volume from UPFs, aggregating per S-NSsAI, and notifying on volume thresholds triggers supplied by CCS during the mechanism.

q_57590.question: What kind of information about a network is included in the PLMN list with 5G connectivity using trusted non-3GPP access?
q_57590.ground_truth: This type of information includes details about the network that support 5G connectivity and trusted non-3GPP access for the PLMN, providing a secure connection between the UE and the 5GCN via a trusted non-3GPP access network.

q_57591.question: What information is the CSeq header of a BYE request set to if no CSeq value was stored for that session?
q_57591.ground_truth: The CSeq header of a BYE request is set to a random number within the valid range for CSeqs if no CSeq value was stored for that session.

q_57592.question: What is the maximum number of warning messages that a UE can re-assemble simultaneously, as per the given text?
q_57592.ground_truth: The maximum number of warning messages that a UE can re-assemble simultaneously is a function of UE implementation.

q_57593.question: What information is transmitted by DCI format 1 in the context of scheduling a UE for PDSCH transmission?
q_57593.ground_truth: DCI format 1 is used for scheduling one PDSCH codeword and includes information such as resource allocation header, resource block assignment, and modulation and coding scheme. The resource allocation header and resource block assignment indicate the PRBs assigned to the UE, while the modulation and coding scheme dictate the modulation order and transport block size.

q_57594.question: What is the 'MCPTTGroupInitiation/Entry/Usage' option for 'DedicatedGroup' used for?
q_57594.ground_truth: When set to 'DedicatedGroup', the MCPTT group identified by the GroupID in clause~5.2.34B will be used for an MCPTT emergency group call or imminent peril group call, regardless of whether the MCPTT user has currently selected an MCPTT group or not.

q_57595.question: What action must the SMF take when receiving the rejection of the QoS flow creation or modification from the network?
q_57595.ground_truth: The SMF must report the enforcement error of the PCC rule to the PCF if the time zone was requested by the PCF and the SMF received the rejection of the QoS flow creation or modification.

q_57596.question: What is the basic concept of the FEC system used in commercial XR split rendering and cloud gaming services?
q_57596.ground_truth: The basic concept is to add Application Data Units (ADUs) to a source block that then generates packets of basically equal size to distribute the content. Each ADU is assigned a size F and additional properties, and forms a source block with K encoding symbols. The source block is then divided into K source packets and N-K repair packets, which are sent as part of the same ADU.

q_57597.question: What is the purpose of the UTRA carriers adjusting their transmission power to the UE's PMAX level?
q_57597.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure that the UE's transmission power reaches the PMAX level within at least 200 ms of the first TPC command in this step.

q_57598.question: What should the AMF do if the UE has triggered the registration procedure for mobility registration update for non-3GPP access path switching from the old non-3GPP access to the new non-3GPP access and the UE receives the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message over the new non-3GPP access?
q_57598.ground_truth: The UE should consider itself as de-registered for 5GS services over the old non-3GPP access.

q_57599.question: What happens to active PDP contexts when the attachment state changes to detached?
q_57599.ground_truth: Any active PDP contexts will be automatically deactivated when the attachment state changes to detached.

q_57600.question: What provides the number of successful data record creations at the UDR?
q_57600.ground_truth: 5.13.1.2.2 provides the number of successful data record creations at the UDR.

q_57601.question: What should be the delay requirement for Event A3 triggered measurement report in the test described in section 16.6.2.10.4?
q_57601.ground_truth: The UE (User Equipment) shall send one Event A3 triggered measurement report, with a measurement reporting delay less than 1280 ms from the beginning of time period T2, in the test described in section 16.6.2.10.4.

q_57602.question: What is the purpose of verifying that the preferred sub-bands can be used for frequency-selective scheduling under frequency-selective fading conditions?
q_57602.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure that the reported sub-band channel CQI (Channel Quality Indicator) can accurately represent the channel conditions, which can help improve the efficiency of frequency-selective scheduling.

q_57603.question: What message is sent by the MN to initiate the Secondary Node Release procedure in case of MN initiated SN Release?

q_57604.question: What is a "Cache-Control" header in HTTP responses, and what should be its value?
q_57604.ground_truth: The "Cache-Control" header in HTTP responses indicates the amount of time in seconds after which the received response is considered stale. Its value should be a "max-age" value.

q_57605.question: What is the definition of an "Active Antenna System (AAS) Base Station (BS)" as provided in the document?
q_57605.ground_truth: An "Active Antenna System (AAS) Base Station (BS)" is defined as a base station system that combines an Antenna Array with an Active transceiver unit array and a Radio Distribution Network.

q_57606.question: What are the implications of using hUT as 30m in the RMa model in TR 38.901 with hUT as 30m?
q_57606.ground_truth: The simulations use hUT as 30m, which is above the limit in the RMa model in TR 38.901 with hUT as 30m, causing limitations to the model's validity and accuracy.

q_57607.question: What is the role of the NWDAF containing AnLF during the discovery of NWDAF containing MTLF as FL client?
q_57607.ground_truth: During the discovery of NWDAF containing MTLF as FL client, a consumer (e.g. an FL server) includes in the request FL capability type as FL client, Time Period of Interest, a list of NF type(s). The NRF returns one or more candidate instances of NWDAF containing MTLF as FL client to the consumer. The NWDAF containing AnLF can act as an FL server for the ML model training.

q_57608.question: What actions does a UE take when new UE policies for V2X communication are included in the MANAGE UE POLICY COMMAND message?
q_57608.ground_truth: If new UE policies for V2X communication over PC5 or Uu are included in the MANAGE UE POLICY COMMAND message, the UE stops the relevant timer and starts using the new UE policies for V2X communication included in the MANAGE UE POLICY COMMAND message.

q_57609.question: What is the purpose of the Uplink power control window in step 7 of the procedure?
q_57609.ground_truth: The Uplink power control window is used to ensure that the UE output power is within a specific range of the target power level while measuring the average throughput of both carriers.

q_57610.question: What type of information is specified in the "tLocalServiceType" element?
q_57610.ground_truth: The "tLocalServiceType" element specifies information about local services.

q_57611.question: What should the UE do if the eab-Param is present in SystemInformationBlockType14 and includes the eab-Common with the UE belonging to the category of UEs as indicated in eab-Category and for the Access Class of the UE, the corresponding bit in the eab-BarringBitmap is set to one?
q_57611.ground_truth: The UE should consider access to the cell as barred.

q_57612.question: What is the namespace and MIME type signalling for Rel-9 Adaptive HTTP Streaming in the MPD?
q_57612.ground_truth: The namespace is "urn:3GPP:ns:PSS:AdaptiveHTTPStreamingMPD:2009" and the MIME type signalling is "application/3gpp-ahs+xml".

q_57613.question: What are the threshold values for the TB success rate and the PDCP SDU loss, as specified in 9.4B.1.1.5?
q_57613.ground_truth: The threshold value for the TB success rate is greater than 85% and the threshold value for the PDCP SDU loss is 0.

q_57614.question: What is the function of EES (OP-A) in the edge node sharing scenario?
q_57614.ground_truth: EES (OP-A) registers EAS on its EES, and also registers itself on ECS (OP-A) via EDGE-6 reference point.

q_57615.question: What happens to the remaining downlink RLC PDUs when a target node begins transmitting packets to a UE during handover?
q_57615.ground_truth: The eNB discards any remaining downlink RLC PDUs.

q_57616.question: How does the performance change when multiple Tx beams are used and the Rx beam is parallel to the track?
q_57616.ground_truth: Adding more Tx beams when only one Rx beam parallel to the track is used does not provide significant gain. However, if the Rx beam is oriented more towards the RRH, the received signal power can be significantly increased in the areas next to the RRH.

q_57617.question: What are the requirements for the password structure in order to comply with the industry best practice?
q_57617.ground_truth: The password should have a minimum length of 8 characters, with at least three of the following: an uppercase character, a lowercase character, a digit, and a special character. The network product should support passwords of a length up to 64 characters or more. Also, a central system or the Network Product should enforce the same password complexity rules.

q_57618.question: What is the action that the SS shall take after receiving a MeasurementReport message in step 6?)
q_57618.ground_truth: The SS shall transmit an RRCRelease message to release the RRC connection which includes the release of the established radio bearers as well as all radio resources.

q_57619.question: What must the UE do when it finds a cell which provides access by NB-IoT RAT and supports attach without PDN, in order to establish a control plane CIoT EPS optimization and release the RRC connection when requested by the Network?
q_57619.ground_truth: The UE must establish RRC connection, perform an attach procedure for Control Plane CIoT EPS optimisation, and release the RRC connection when requested by the Network.

q_57620.question: What procedure for additional authentication and authorization with an external AAA Server is not expected during the IKE tunnel establishment procedure?
q_57620.ground_truth: The procedure for additional authentication and authorization with an external AAA Server as specified in RFC 4739 and TS 33.402 is not expected during the IKE tunnel establishment procedure.

q_57621.question: When does a Multi-Access PDU Session use user-plane resources of an associated PDN Connection in EPC?
q_57621.ground_truth: A Multi-Access PDU Session may use user-plane resources of an associated PDN Connection in EPC when the UE has not indicated support for Ethernet PDN connection type or if the network does not support Ethernet PDN connection type.

q_57622.question: When determining Ncsirs, what PDCCH candidate is used if the PDCCH reception includes two PDCCH candidates from two search space sets?
q_57622.ground_truth: The PDCCH candidate that ends later in time is used.

q_57623.question: What message does the target Serving GW send to the target MME after allocating its local resources?

q_57624.question: When is the de-registration procedure with appropriate de-registration type invoked by the network?
q_57624.ground_truth: The de-registration procedure with appropriate de-registration type is invoked by the network if the network informs the UE to re-register to the network.

q_57625.question: What information does the H(e)NB return when the IP address is requested?
q_57625.ground_truth: The H(e)NB returns the IP address reported to H(e)MS and/or HNB-GW for location verification. If no such IP address is available, the H(e)NB returns a "ME currently not able to process command - no service" message.

q_57626.question: What is the purpose of using security procedures for Restricted 5G ProSe Direct Discovery in Solution #5?
q_57626.ground_truth: The purpose is to provide confidentiality protection of the discovery messages to ensure the privacy of the UAV/UAV-C when dynamic discovery is used between UAV and UAV-C equipped with a UE.

q_57627.question: What field is present in an AMD PDU header only when the Data field consists of an RLC SDU segment which is not the first segment?

q_57628.question: When is the primary authentication considered successful and the new KAUSF stored as the latest KAUSF in 5G?
q_57628.ground_truth: The primary authentication is considered successful and the new KAUSF stored as the latest KAUSF in 5G when the UE receives a valid NAS Security Mode Command message from the AMF during the authenticated procedure.

q_57629.question: What is the recommended port number to use for sending and receiving RTP packets for a given RTP based media stream?
q_57629.ground_truth: For a given RTP based media stream, the recommended port number to use for sending and receiving RTP packets is the same port number.

q_57630.question: What should the SMF do if it receives a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message with request type set to "existing PDU session" or "existing emergency PDU session", and it does not have any information about that PDU session?
q_57630.ground_truth: The SMF should reject the PDU session establishment procedure with the 5GSM cause set to #54 "PDU session does not exist" in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message.

q_57631.question: What is the difference between a 5G System and a 5G Virtual Network (5G VN)?
q_57631.ground_truth: A 5G System refers to the overall architecture and components of the 5G network, while a 5G Virtual Network (5G VN) is a set of network resources and services that are isolated from the rest of the network, allowing for customized services and control.

q_57632.question: Which HTTP method is specified for the "Data Management and/or Status Information Notification" in SEALDD?
q_57632.ground_truth: The HTTP method specified for the "Data Management and/or Status Information Notification" in SEALDD is POST.

q_57633.question: Under what conditions can the transmitter unit(s) associated with the RIB under test be turned off for the out-of-band blocker tests?
q_57633.ground_truth: The transmitter unit(s) associated with the RIB under test can be turned off for the out-of-band blocker tests when the frequency of the blocker is such that no IM2 or IM3 products fall inside the bandwidth of the wanted signal.

q_57634.question: What is the maximum time allowed for the mobile station to receive a CC-ESTABLISHMENT message before initiating clearing procedures towards the network?
q_57634.ground_truth: If no CC-ESTABLISHMENT message is received by the call control entity of the mobile station before the expiry of timer T332, then the mobile station shall initiate clearing procedures towards the network using a RELEASE COMPLETE message.

q_57635.question: Which solution addresses the authorization and policy/parameter provisioning for multi-path transmission in UE-to-Network Relay?

q_57636.question: What happens if the request processing failed when sending an AS registration response?
q_57636.ground_truth: If the request processing failed, the PEMC or PIN Server indicates failure and may provide a failure reason.

q_57637.question: What message is sent by the NEF to the AF upon successful creation of a new "Individual application AM Context" resource?
q_57637.ground_truth: The NEF sends an HTTP "201 Created" response with the AppAmContextExpRespData data structure and a Location header field containing the URI of the created resource to the AF.

q_57638.question: What must the UE do when it loses the IP address of the N5CW device when accessing 5GC via the TWIF?
q_57638.ground_truth: The UE shall initiate the UE-requested PDU session release procedure.

q_57639.question: How many test frequencies can a band have for NR sidelink operations with up to three test frequencies?
q_57639.ground_truth: A band can have up to three test frequencies for NR sidelink operations with up to three test frequencies.

q_57640.question: What state and EPS update status will the UE enter after sending the ATTACH COMPLETE message to the network upon receiving a successful ATTACH ACCEPT message with EPS attach result set to "EPS only" and EMM cause set to "CS domain not available"?
q_57640.ground_truth: The UE enters state EMM-REGISTERED and sets the EPS update status to EU1 UPDATED.

q_57641.question: What is the action that the Serving GW takes to assist the reordering function in the target eNodeB when the Serving GW is relocated and the PDN GW switches the path?
q_57641.ground_truth: The Serving GW sends one or more "end marker" packets on the old path immediately after switching the path to assist the reordering function in the target eNodeB. The source Serving GW forwards the "end marker" packets to the source eNodeB.

q_57642.question: How does the UE determine which cells to include in the MeasurementReport message when the triggerType is set to 'event'?
q_57642.ground_truth: When the triggerType is set to 'event', the UE includes the cells in the cellsTriggeredList as defined within the VarMeasReportList for this measId in the MeasurementReport message.

q_57643.question: What should the UE do if it exceeds certain measurement thresholds (Mm,max, Md,max, or Me,max) while monitoring a cell?
q_57643.ground_truth: The UE should restart measurements if it exceeds Mm,max, Md,max, or Me,max while monitoring a cell.

q_57644.question: When are the route selection descriptors of the URSP rule evaluated in the UE's connection to non-3GPP access?
q_57644.ground_truth: The route selection descriptors of the URSP rule are evaluated in the UE's connection to non-3GPP access after the URSP rules, except the default URSP rule, have been evaluated with a traffic descriptor that matches the application information or the PIN information in increasing order of their precedence values.

q_57645.question: What are the three transport modes that can be used for transmitting a UDP flow between UE and UPF in the MPQUIC steering functionality?
q_57645.ground_truth: The three transport modes are Datagram mode 2, Datagram mode 1, and Stream mode.

q_57646.question: What happens upon expiry of the periodical reporting timer for a measId?
q_57646.ground_truth: The measurement reporting procedure is initiated again for the measId.

q_57647.question: When should the "reason" property be included in an error response for JSON Merge Patch?
q_57647.ground_truth: The "reason" property may be present in an error response for JSON Merge Patch to provide more details on the error conditions, but it may be omitted if the MnS Producer does not want to disclose details to the MnS Consumer.

q_57648.question: In which subframes should a UE not receive NPDSCH assigned by NPDCCH with DCI CRC scrambled by G-RNTI?
q_57648.ground_truth: A UE is not required to receive NPDSCH assigned by NPDCCH with DCI CRC scrambled by G-RNTI in subframes in which the UE monitors a Type1A-NPDCCH common search space or in subframes in which the UE receives NPDSCH assigned by NPDCCH with DCI CRC scrambled by SC-RNTI.

q_57649.question: What should be the level of the wanted signal at the base station antenna connector as specified in clause 7.6.5?
q_57649.ground_truth: The level of the wanted signal measured at the BS antenna connector shall be set to the level specified in subclause 7.6.5.

q_57650.question: What is the purpose of the procedure described in clause 5.10.2.2?
q_57650.ground_truth: The purpose of this procedure is to inform E-UTRAN that the UE is interested or no longer interested to receive sidelink communication or discovery, as well as to request assignment or release of transmission resources for sidelink communication or discovery announcements.

q_57651.question: What should be the data type of the request body if the cardinality is "M..N" for data type "array(<type>)"?
q_57651.ground_truth: The data type of the request body should be an array containing elements of the specified data type "<type>", with the number of elements within the array being between M and N (inclusive).

q_57652.question: What information should the VAE-S include in the <dynamic-group-id> element of the HTTP PUT request message, when assigning a ProSe Layer-2 Group ID to a dynamic group?
q_57652.ground_truth: The identity of the dynamic group

q_57653.question: Which UE categories are applicable for the FDD-FDD intra frequency handover test case in 5.1.13.2?
q_57653.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA FD-FDD UE release 13 and forward of UE category M1 and higher, including non-BL/CE UE.

q_57654.question: How are carriers placed in the ANTCR8 receiver tests?
q_57654.ground_truth: In the ANTCR8 receiver tests, a NR carrier is placed adjacent to the upper Base Station RF Bandwidth edge, and another NR carrier is placed adjacent to the lower Base Station RF Bandwidth edge. The sub-block edges adjacent to the sub-block gap are determined using the specified Foffset,RAT for the carrier adjacent to the sub-block gap.

q_57655.question: In which scenarios is the SMF able to support the charging of redundant transmission for high reliability communication?
q_57655.ground_truth: The SMF is able to support the charging of redundant transmission for high reliability communication in any scenario where high reliability communication is required.

q_57656.question: Which of the following is a type of IMS messaging service that expects immediate message delivery in real-time fashion?

q_57657.question: What information should not be included in the information transfer capability field if it indicates "speech" in the backup bearer capability IE?
q_57657.ground_truth: Octets 4, 5, 5a, 5b, 6, 6a, 6b, 6c, 6d, 6e, 6f, 6g and 7 should not be included if the information transfer capability field indicates "speech" in the backup bearer capability IE.

q_57658.question: What are the types of network-controlled repeaters and downlink classes?
q_57658.ground_truth: There are three types of network-controlled repeaters and downlink classes: Wide Area NCR, Medium Range NCR, and Local Area NCR.

q_57659.question: What message does UE1 broadcast when it wants to initiate the Ranging/SL Positioning measurement with UE2 via an Assistance UE?
q_57659.ground_truth: UE1 broadcasts Direct Communication Request containing UE1 ID and UE2 ID, Ranging Service Code, long term credential ID, nonce 1 and its security capabilities.

q_57660.question: What message is sent by a PFCP entity when it only supports earlier version(s) of the PFCP protocol and receives a message from a peer over the same protocol with a higher version number?

q_57661.question: What is the responsibility of the MME in the "MBMS Session Start procedure" in the 3GPP E-UTRAN network?
q_57661.ground_truth: The MME sends MBMS session start request message to the MCE(s) controlling eNBs in the targeted MBMS service area, and may include the list of cell identities if available.

q_57662.question: What is the purpose of the "A-ADRF" and "A-DCCF" in the 3GPP system?
q_57662.ground_truth: The "A-ADRF" is an "Analytical Data Repository Function" and the "A-DCCF" is a "Data Collection and Coordination Function" that operate at the application layer of the 3GPP system.

q_57663.question: What is the maximum number of broadcast GINs in r17?

q_57664.question: What does the Serving GW do after receiving the Create Session Response from the target MME?
q_57664.ground_truth: The Serving GW starts a timer, assigns addresses and TEIDs for downlink traffic from the PDN GW, sends a Modify Bearer Request message per PDN connection to the PDN GW(s), updates its context field, and returns a Modify Bearer Response message to the Serving GW.

q_57665.question: What is the format of an Authorised Identity, and how is it obtained?
q_57665.ground_truth: An Authorised Identity is conveyed as an MC entity's identity (e.g. MC Service ID) and is used to sign the EAR (Evolved Packet System Authentication and Authorization). Authorisation information is contained within a SIP URI Header (known as an MC authorisation field), which is provided by the IdM (Identity Management).

q_57666.question: What is the maximum number of layers that a UE which supports Increased UE carrier monitoring E-UTRA is required to monitor?
q_57666.ground_truth: A UE which supports Increased UE carrier monitoring E-UTRA is required to monitor a maximum of 4 x Nfreq, E-UTRA + 4 x Nfreq, UTRA + 3 x MGSM + 4 x Nfreq, cdma2000 + 4 x Nfreq, HRPD + 4 x Nfreq, NR inter-RAT carriers.

q_57667.question: What is the effect of sending a +CMUX command while in any multiplexer mode?
q_57667.ground_truth: If a +CMUX command is issued whilst in any multiplexer mode, it shall be ignored, and the MT/TA shall return a +CME ERROR: <err> response.

q_57668.question: What is the significance of Step 5 in the solution evaluation?
q_57668.ground_truth: In Step 5, the solution is granted access to the server NWDAF if it is authorized based on the permitted-server-NWDAF list. This confirms the implementation of the authorization mechanism for the selection of participant NWDAF instances in the Federated Learning group.

q_57669.question: When a 5G-RG is connected via both NG-RAN and W-5GAN, how many N1 instances will exist for the 5G-RG?
q_57669.ground_truth: There will be one N1 instance over NG-RAN and one N1 instance over W-5GAN.

q_57670.question: What must be ensured for time duration T4 and T5 in the described procedure?
q_57670.ground_truth: During time duration T4 and T5, the UE shall detect beam failure and initiate link recovery. Also, it measures and evaluates beam candidates from beam candidate set q1 during these time periods.

q_57671.question: What is the national flower of Portugal?

q_57672.question: Which Key Issue investigates how to support network slice access based converged charging service on the simultaneous/max. number of UEs for specific charging requirements?

q_57673.question: What is the significance of the NF service discovery procedure in the same PLMN?
q_57673.ground_truth: The NF service discovery procedure is crucial in determining whether to provide the NF producer to the NF consumer based on the certificate status of the NF producer. This ensures that only NF producers with valid certificates are provided during the service discovery.

q_57674.question: Which UEs is this test case 8.16.94 applicable to?
q_57674.ground_truth: This test case applies to all types of E-UTRA FDD UE release 11 and forward that support 5DL CA, all types of E-UTRA TDD UE release 11 and forward that support 5DL CA, and all types of E-UTRA FDD and TDD Release 12 and forward UE that support E-UTRA FDD, E-UTRA TDD and 5DL CA.

q_57675.question: What is the format of the PositioningMeasurementFailureIndication message?
q_57675.ground_truth: The PositioningMeasurementFailureIndication message is a SEQUENCE that contains a ProtocolIE-Container, which includes a set of ProtocolIE-SingleContainer elements, each with a specific ID, Criticality, Type, Presence, and optional Additional Information.

q_57676.question: What action should the HSS take if it receives a message from a service-related entity requesting EPS User State and/or EPS Location Information without the Serving Node Indication IE?
q_57676.ground_truth: The HSS shall set the "EPS User State Request" bit and/or "EPS Location Information Request" bit respectively in the IDR-Flags and may also set the "Current Location Request" bit, unless it knows that the registered MME and/or SGSN do not support state/location information retrieval.

q_57677.question: What are the aspects of redundant network deployment managed by the operator and not subject to 3GPP standardization?
q_57677.ground_truth: The aspects include the support for dual connectivity in RAN and sufficient RAN coverage for dual connectivity in the target area, UE support for dual connectivity, alignment of UPF deployment with RAN deployment and support for redundant user plane paths, alignment of the underlying transport topology with RAN and UPF deployment and support for redundant user plane paths, a topology and geographical distribution of functions that support the redundant user plane paths, and independent operation of the redundant user plane paths, such as independent power supplies.

q_57678.question: What format is used for the "addr" property in the MSGin5G JSON schema?
q_57678.ground_truth: The "addr" property in the MSGin5G JSON schema uses the "uri" format.

q_57679.question: How many phases are there in the radio link failure procedure, and which part involves UE-based mobility?
q_57679.ground_truth: The radio link failure procedure comprises first and second phases. The first phase does not involve UE-based mobility, whereas the second phase does.

q_57680.question: What are the key steps in the terminal rendering process for AR communication?
q_57680.ground_truth: The UE initiates an AR communication session, establishes audio and video session connections, and creates bootstrap and application data channel connections with the peer UE. The UE then performs AR media rendering based on the AR media obtained locally or sent by the peer through the RTP channel.

q_57681.question: What should the CP function do when a PFCP session related message is received from a UP function with which no PFCP association exists?
q_57681.ground_truth: The CP function should reject the message with a cause indicating that no PFCP association exists with the peer entity.

q_57682.question: What is the role of the USS in the 5G System?
q_57682.ground_truth: The USS provides UAS-specific AF services to NF service consumers, such as NEF, and functions as a part of the AF.

q_57683.question: What is the purpose of the Hosting E-UTRAN/NG-RAN Operator collecting start and end service events in the Shared E-UTRAN/NG-RAN for the UEs of the Participating Operator?
q_57683.ground_truth: The purpose is to facilitate interoperator accounting between the Hosting E-UTRAN/NG-RAN Operator and the Participating Operator.

q_57684.question: When should a UE treat a cell as if the cell status is "barred" when the cellBarredNES is absent?
q_57684.ground_truth: When cellBarredNES is absent and cellBarred is set to "barred", a UE capable of NES cell DTX/DRX shall treat this cell as if cell status is "barred".

q_57685.question: What is the maximum number of GMLC that can be present in the GMLC-List sequence?
q_57685.ground_truth: The maximum number of GMLC that can be present in the GMLC-List sequence is 5.

q_57686.question: What must the Permitted MCPTT client include in the Message Sequence Number field when sending a Floor Revoke message?
q_57686.ground_truth: The Permitted MCPTT client must include a Message Sequence Number field with a value increased with 1 when sending a Floor Revoke message.

q_57687.question: What is the format of the QoEInformationTransfer in the F1AP-PROTOCOL-CONTAINER?
q_57687.ground_truth: QoEInformationTransfer in the F1AP-PROTOCOL-CONTAINER is a SEQUENCE that consists of a protocolIEs field, which is a ProtocolIE-Container containing QoEInformationTransfer-IEs.

q_57688.question: What operation package is used for initializing a supplementary service procedure between VLR and HLR in v1?

q_57689.question: When is the Broadcast Scheduled Area List IE or Broadcast Scheduled Area List NG-RAN IE included in the WRITE-REPLACE WARNING INDICATION?
